Author: TAndrewK
Title: Great food- lovely host
Review: We stopped here for lunch and we're really glad we did. Very relaxed and warm host. The food was carefully handmade to order and tasted delicious

Author: Ahmed S
Title: A gem of a restaurant
Review: Without a doubt, this is the best Arabic restaurant I’ve visited in a long time. The interior is so stylish yet equally as homely and cosy. The food feels homemade and has a distinct quality that only comes from an authentic Syrian chef. We met the owner personally and were highly impressed by his enthusiastic attitude and hospitality. I would 100% visit again. Alhamdulillah Show less

Author: Saft1987
Title: Australia
Review: Very delicious food, clean restaurant great service. Food was really good. Excellent portion sizes. We will definitely be back.Show less

Author: Paradise44960454978Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Quick and nice lunch in Langkawi
Review: After being in splash out with our kids we look for a nearby place for a lunch.We just walk in a 2pm when the restaurant was just opening and the young owner’s daughter welcome us inside.The chicken Kebab my son ordered was definitely the best dish but overall we liked the warm atmosphere especially when the owner start to explain my son how the “shisha” works and told us about his arrival in Malaysia from Syria and his previous working experience.Definitely a nice place to go if you are in this part of Langkawi close to overprice hotel restaurants.Show less

Author: Buzz_BuzzyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food at an excellent restaurant.
Review: Many restaurants in the area have closed or changed menus, so finding vegetarian/vegan options can be challenging. Alhamdulillah is the solution to this problem. We've eaten here twice in the past week. The falafel plate is delicious and very reasonably priced. The hummus and foul were nice as well. The food is fresh, the restaurant is very clean and uniquely decorated, and the owner and his daughter are lovely. Make sure to visit them for dinner when you're in Langkawi.Show less

Author: S GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food especially for vegetarian, vegan & gluten free options
Review: We had a lovely meal here and enjoyed chatting to the owner and his daughter. He is clearly passionate about what he does, and the restaurant has been put together with great care. There is a great selection of vegan and vegetarian options on the menu, all clearly labelled, and many dishes can be gluten free if needed. The food was delicious and we'd definitely eat there again.Please note that the restaurant has changed location to a couple of minutes further along the same road, and looks different to some of the pictures online, so if you've been there in the past or are looking at an out of date listing, don't worry, you can still find it!Show less

Author: Erja V
Title: Fantastic
Review: Excellent food. Only takeaway now. Great people. Easy to get to location, ample parking. We will definitely go there when they are open for dine in!Show less

Author: mohamadbin
Title: Cash only
Review: This is my scond time for arabic food, it was great expiriance for meThe price was good for what i had.the quality was perfect thos food come fresh with steam going u.We ordered chicken and rice+ kabsa chicken rice.This place is cash onlyShow less

Author: philipa193
Title: Good food and welcoming owners
Review: Very nice foot including Falafel and Humus. Family run restaurant and a nice environment for children

Author: langkawiloverstay
Title: hidden place for me
Review: i live in Langkawi but never saw this place.i was working in the shop next door and i dicided to try, after i check the menu i found shawarma chicken whiche i know so i ordered and it was not frim this world. waooo so yameeeShow less

Author: mellevk
Title: definitely worth a visit
Review: Been here twice while staying in Langkawi. Would come back here more times if I didn’t had to leave Langkawi. Very courteous man and the wife is an amazing cook! Really try to visit this place, you won’t regret it.

Author: alexander230900
Title: Very good food.
Review: Very good food. Especially falafel . Also very cheap. Very nice owner aswell:) No problem that occurred

Author: GlutenFreeMax
Title: Very supportive
Review: Very supportive in my dietary needs (gluten free), absolutely delicious food for a fair price. Will definitely come back

Author: EgyptSarah
Title: Delicious meal
Review: Was really excited to go to this restaurant having lived many years in the Middle East and it was just great! Loved every dish we had for its freshness and authentic flavours. Lovely Syrian owner too, whose wife cooks all the delicious food. Highly recommended

Author: Mobeen ALahore, Pakistan
Title: Amazing food
Review: One of the best restaurant with best food. Well being Pakistani craving for food was at peak and luckily i found this place to be the best place in langkawi so far. I tried Syrian flaffil and arabic rice with chicken both dishes were un expectingly great. Chicken was so cozy and juicy its a must try placeShow less

Author: World_traveller_6398
Title: Excellent food!
Review:
The food was great, the service was very good, the owner is a very nice guy.
Good choice, nice quantities and great atmosphere!
Paulo

Author: pierrew715
Title: Excellent
Review: Nice restaurant with excellent food for a very good price. It wasn‘t overcrowded and had a very pleasant atmosphere.

Author: 599grantd
Title: Great Syrian cuisine
Review: Amazing service and great home style food! The host was very welcoming and friendly and even ordered us a taxi back to our hotel as we didn’t have phone access. Definitely recommend heading here If visiting Langkawi. Get the chicken Schwarma.

Author: Krufki
Title: Great value
Review: Food made with care and love. In this restaurant you can find the best arabic flavours and tastes. Just enjoy It!

Author: 923duniaaPhu Yen Province, Vietnam
Title: Delicious food, nice owner.
Review: Very nice restaurant, offers few vegan options, generous portions. Nice atmosphere and the owner is a very nice gentleman who serves the food himself. I will definitely come back! Show less

Author: D308RXsimonet
Title: Very tasty food and nice owner!
Review: I got food to take away, which was no Problem. The Friese and the Falafel are very tasty and so is the Tahina! I can reccomand this place, also for vegetarians and vegans!

Author: TomMontagnani
Title: Very good food!
Review: Very nice light falafel, good presentation! The place is clean, simple but nice. Try some iced lemon tea (no sugar) for a very refreshing drink 😉

Author: adamsweita
Title: Awesome food
Review:
Super delicious food and good prices!
Me and two friends ordered 5 dishes and we got them at the same time. Super tasty!

Author: AuvoKSliema, Malta
Title: Family-cooked meal, just as if visiting a friend’s house
Review: Intriqued by the good reviews and suggested dishes went in on a Wed night dinner. Got very attentive service by the host, were treated just as friends visiting their home. Food was simple but outstanding in quantity and quality yet very modestly priced. No doubt, a place well worth a visit if in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Compass715407
Title: Great food
Review: Everything was very good. True and honest syrian food. Great prices and a fantastic welcome by the owner.

Author: grisa300
Title: Good food!
Review: We tried to come here to eat earlier this week, but they were closed. Recommend to call them and make sure that they are open and maybe book a table. Food was delicious, after one hour of arring we did have foods, so prepare to wait a while. Chickenswarma was delicious!! Really good food, worth trying.Show less

Author: momdsag
Title: Good but not as the other reviews
Review: I read the restaurant reviews in tripadvisor and I went there because of that I try the shawarma which is OK but not that much delicious.Also I try two types of kabab.The restaurant overall is good but all kind of food will prepare after your order which will take long time of waiting also the restaurant is very small.Show less

Author: chechearoundtheworld
Title: Best food in Kuah!
Review: We went there twice and allways got delicious food and good service!We tried falafel and chicken shawarma.

Author: ErinJ85Brisbane, Australia
Title: Unexpected gem tucked away in the side streets of Langkawi
Review: Lovely (and cheap) middle eastern food but the best thing about this place is the family who own. They are Syrian refugees who have started this business from nothing and have got by cooking yummy and authentic home cooked Syrian food. Meeting the owner was a real privilege and I hope that he is able to continue to thrive after his family's adversities. Had the shwarma and garlic sauce and it was very yummy! Show less

Author: Ryano1978Toowoomba, Australia
Title: Great little restaurant ... Amazing Food
Review: My wife and I went here last Saturday night for dinner, met at the door by an open sign that was lovingly created by the owners Daughter who coincidentally offered him use of her play cash register for the nights takings - very cute. We both had the Chicken Shawarma and it was absolutely delicious. Will definitely go back next time we are again in Langkawi.Only a small family run restaurant, so get in early if you want to guarantee a table.Thanks for a great meal.Show less

Author: vaccation_HStockholm, Sweden
Title: Fantastic food and great service
Review: Fantastic food and great service by the owner.One of my top 5 best meals in life. Do not miss a visit to this place when in Langkawi, you won’t regret the investment in time.Show less

Author: Kandbtravelspree
Title: Excellent Shawarma
Review: My husband and I visited our first night in Langkawi. The shawarma was excellent, and the owner was very gracious. We arrived early to avoid a crowd and enjoyed a nice, quiet meal. A must try!

Author: paulwaldnerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wow!
Review: Wow! Genuinely one of the nicest meals I’ve had in such a long time. Food was terrific with a lovely host, very personable and passionate about the food and service he was delivering. We were lucky to have called ahead and made a reservation! Thanks again! Show less

Author: Mobile742225
Title: Great food and excellent service!
Review: Great food and excellent service! Very good falafel and Foul. The restaurant was very clean and modern.

Author: mmariya85
Title: Excellent food & impeccable service!
Review: This place definitely live up to its No. 1 ranking. Rami was a very cordial host and talked us out of over ordering food. You could tell he cares about this customers and their experience.We visited the restaurant twice during our stay in Langkawi. We enjoyed the chicken shawarma and the grill fish during our first visit. For our 2nd visit we had pre-ordered the whole chicken stuffed w/ rice. All the food we tried was excellent.It’s a small restaurant so make reservations or manage expectations accordingly. We highly recommend this restaurant. Show less

Author: MoezR2
Title: Excellent !
Review: if you want a real authentic syrian food, this is the adress. Très bon plats variés, service impeccable. A recommander sans modération !

Author: MrMmmmmmmmmmmmmHuizhou, China
Title: One of the best meals ever
Review: One of the best meals I’ve ever had in my life. It is a small operation. There was one table before us and we did have to wait 45+ minutes for our food, but the owner did warn us and was very considerate. Literally the food... it could not have been better. The chicken shawarma, beef kabob and humus were so packed with flavor. Blew my mind with every bite. Show less

Author: holidaygirlWaikato
Title: Great food!
Review: Excellent food! Freshly prepared! Friendly service! Good atmosphere! A really yummy meal ! Thank you!

Author: wander-travel789Sydney, Australia
Title: Best middle eastern food!
Review: We had dinner at this small family run restaurant. It is very clean and simple but nice atmosphere of Syria homeland. The hummus and Chicken Shawarma were divine. The falafel and beef skewers were very good. There was a bit of a wait for our meal but it was worth it. The owner takes pride in his restaurant and his food. We would happily return if we had more time! Show less

Author: EatDrinkSleepDo
Title: Extraordinary food and value.
Review: WOW. Just magnificent. The owner fed 3 adults and 2 x 16 years olds with an absolute feast. You must go here. Note thou - he is a one man band so he will take you order and then disappear behind the curtain. He literally limits the amount of people in the restaurant so he can ensure quality. All his food is freshly cookedShow less

Author: Freedom786580Syracuse, New York
Title: You must try the Syrian falafel
Review: You must try the Syrian falafel shawarma & fatoosh & fish delicious الاكل بيشهي ونظيف وكلشي مرتب بلتوفيق ياربي Show less

Author: louaym308
Title: Best place to eat syrian food in langkawi
Review: Nice & clean restaurant with very friendly staff. The food is authentic, delicious. The best place I eat syrian food in all Malaysia.

Author: XeraphimmHong Kong, China
Title: 100% recommended.
Review: The restaurant food is very lovely and delicious! My husband and I had come to this restaurant 3x during our trip to Langkawi because we just absolutely loved it. The owner was so kind and very friendly. My opinion on the food: it’s very authentic and delicious. Very well seasoned, halal, vegetarian-friendly!!!We would definitely come back here when we visit Langkawi again!!! 100% recommended! Show less

Author: J7453DNmatthewk
Title: One of the best meals we've had!
Review: We've been travelling around SE Asia for 5 weeks and this was by far one of the best meals we've had. We both had the Chicken Shawarma and shared a hummus and it was absolutely delicious. The owner saw me drinking some of my wife's water to take some tablets and offered to give me the water for free as he thought I'd bought it to take tablets. This was such a kind offer, but I was happy to pay for it. They also don't charge a 10% service charge which I've noticed a lot of restaurants do. I'd recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Kauh in Langkawi, I'd definitely go back if I was to return. Show less

Author: Sami_El-Ghrably
Title: Your Destination for Arabic Cuisine In Lankawi pl
Review: An excellent restaurant with friendly staff and warm atmosphere.Food is nice and very well made.If you want to try Arabic food in Lankawi, make this as your first option and you won’t regret it. Show less

Author: jackfT1306HQHong Kong, China
Title: Absolutely recommended!
Review: It was our first day in Langkawi and my wife and I decided to come to this restaurant. I would say we absolutely loved it! The food was phenomenal and so delicious!!! The guy that welcomed and served us was so considerate, friendly and kind to us. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere. We ordered 1 Syrian Falafel, 1 Syrian Beef Kebab and 1 chicken shish with Arabian Rice and all of that for a reasonable price considering how delicious the food is. Would DEFINITELY RECOMMEND! We’ll go back again for sure! Show less

Author: hallothere
Title: Awesome food and service
Review: My wife and I went to this little Syrian restaurant for dinner; the food was extremely delicious. The price is also very reasonable. We recommend both the dishes as shown in photos.

Author: saf_bhamBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Authentic Home Made Syrian Food
Review: Lovely little family restaurant with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The food is cooked by the family and as authentic as it comes. I had the chicken shawarma and I didn’t know the humble shawarma could taste so good. Best shawarma I’ve had. My wife has the kasba chicken and rice. Chicken was soft and flavourful. The rice was full of flavour too. We also had hummus which tasted so fresh. All I can say is the reviews don’t lie. We got a grab taxi here and it was a great final dinner on the island before our onward travels. A must try if you are in Langkawi. Show less

Author: Ibby96
Title: 10/10 food and service
Review: Really lovely service owner was welcoming and food was good authentic arabic food recommend the chicken

Author: TheOtherSideVlog
Title: BEST MIDDLE EASTERN FOOD ON LANGKAWI
Review: Our meal was so delicious that we came back another day for more! The owners are from Syria and their food is so authentic! It was some of the best middle eastern food I have ever had, especially the rice... JUST WOW! We loved the chicken shwarma, falafel and hummus! But you can't go wrong with anything on the menu. We hope to be able to go back someday for more because we are already missing it! WOOT WOOT!Show less

Author: marcwint55Los Angeles, California
Title: Fantastic Langkawi restaurant with excellent food
Review: This restaurant is ranked #1 on trip advisor and well deserves the ranking. The food was fantastic, the service was excellent and the owner was one of the friendliest restaurant owners I have ever encountered. The chicken shwarma was recommended and it is amazing. The owners are Syrian refugees who left their homeland with nothing and now run a very successful restaurant that is just great. The atmosphere is casual and the prices are quite reasonable. I can't say enough to describe how wonderful the food and the people are.Show less

Author: Jibber123
Title: Excellent food for a reasonable price
Review: We had a fantastic meal here, the owner was incredibly welcoming and provided excellent service. The food is delicious authentic syrian cuisine made from fresh ingredients which the owner and his family eat themselves, so you know it’s good!

Author: Johann RTagum City, Philippines
Title: This place is extraordinary
Review: Going to a particular restaurant may have various reasons: It could be the food and that's it. With this restaurant it's a bit different coz here excellent food is combined with a very welcoming host who represents the 'soul' of this place. I enjoyed not just a well prepared meal but also the interesting story the owner shared with me. The truckload of positive reviews are NOT a coincidence, it is the personality of the owner giving his restaurant a special flavour.Show less

Author: 94yasserh
Title: Excellent
Review: Amazing food with even better hospitality. This restaurant does some of the most authentic Arabic food I've had and you have to go here if you are in langkawi. 10/10

Author: josephmcg16Glasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Hosts and Brilliant Food
Review: We visited this restaurant as a group of 12 and Rami was very accommodating for us. We felt very welcome in the restaurant and many of us said it felt as if we were being invited to eat in someone’s home. The restaurant and bathrooms were well kept while the dining area had beautiful Syrian styled decor.Easily the best Arab cuisine in Langkawi and a brilliant place to spend an evening. :)Thanks from Scotland/Netherlands/ Ireland!Show less

Author: 197leonardpHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Just Perfect
Review: To start, this is the best falafel I’ve eaten! The interior is really cozy, and the owner really kind and helpful! He even asked Where We were from and then he even put on some music in our language! Me and my girlfriend had a great time here! The food is delicious but even more so, the owner makes you feel so welcome! :)Show less

Author: ShummuLucknow, India
Title: Excellent Arabic food
Review: We tried the ‘Syrian kabab dish with fries’ and ‘ Shish Tawouq with rice’ ....food was excellent, serving quantity was more than enough for both of us and the man who was serving us , was very calm and sweet. We went there late almost closing time still he entertained us with a smiling face. I would highly recommend to try this restaurant if you are fond of arabic food...Show less

Author: JaninaJ143
Title: Excellent food
Review: We enjoyed excellent, tasty and fresh Middle-Eastern food. Very good service as well. Highly recommended!

Author: RLanceirex
Title: Excellent Syrian Food!!
Review: Delicious Syrian food made us visit the Restaurant twice in a couple of days. Owner is extremely helpful. We will be back!!

Author: 616gabicTimisoara, Romania
Title: Delicious food
Review: We tried here delicious chicken shawarma and chicken fajitas. The owner is very nice and offered to help us with info about the island. All the food is freshly cooked so it will take a few minutes to receive your food,but the waiting is definitely warth it. Show less

Author: jessicasxott
Title: BEST FOOD IN LANGKAWI
Review: Myself and two friends visited this lovely place. On arrival we had no cash but the owner insisted we sat down first and paid later. The food was some of the best we have eaten in Asia. Very authentic food in a lovely setting. The restaurant has a lovely feel and excellent service by the owner. Also amazing value for money. We couldn’t recommend this restaurant more to anyone!! If your in Langkawi pay this lovely little place a visit !! Show less

Author: danaa480Timisoara, Romania
Title: Excellent food!
Review: The place is nice, and the food was delicious! The owner is very kind, he gaves us advices about the island. The restaurant deserves his no 1 place on tripadvisor! Shukran!Show less

Author: 298iqramHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: My husband and I went to the restaurant for dinner and it was lovely. We had a really nice time and the food was one of the best meals we’d had while in Langkawi, it was completely freshly made, the chef is an amazing cook. The service was also excellent. Would highly recommend coming here! Show less

Author: SophieChubb
Title: Delicious food
Review: I visited the restaurant with my two children, 5 and 3, and we all thoroughly enjoyed all the food. The waiter/owner was as very friendly and for the quality the cost was very reasonable. I would highly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: mrnt lMalaysia
Title: Tasty
Review: I had fish meal with my friends and it was really tasty and best in town i think.There are lots of places where we can eat but this one is the best in my thought.we really enjoyed our time with amazing food.And those staff was really friendly.hope to catch this place again.Show less

Author: subhib2019Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great dinner
Review: Simple place with delicious plates , Arabic foods and Shisha , amazing and affordable for family or sharing business in quiet place.Show less

Author: Dr_armanDhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: So Tastyyy!
Review: We ordered a fish meal and 4 Chicken Kabsa. It was a wonderful experience. The fish was 560 gm.It was so fresh, cooked to the perfection.and the chicken was very well cooked and perfectly spiced. 9.5/10 for the food and 10/10 for the owner. He is from Syria, he was such a gentleman with a good heart. His wife is the chef,I recommend this restaurant for anyone who wants a good food and good experience. They serve in authentic Mediterranean style. Must go place for a food lover. You won't be disappointed. Check the picture for reference.Show less

Author: bigv8tKeilor Downs, Australia
Title: Great
Review: Went here with my family. The owner is a fantastic guy with quite a sad background story. The food is great especially for my kids who are quite picky. Its not over powering with sweet and saucy flavours very good syrian food. The fish was amazing, the chicken shish kabab was beautiful. The rice it was great finally having what i call real rice with flavour. Keep up the great work and i wish the owner all the best.Show less

Author: Federico Z
Title: Ridicolous
Review: No idea how this plsce is ranked number 1 on Langkawi. Food much below the average, restaurant looks worst than a food stall, service appaling and extremely pushy asking to write a positive review on tripadvisor.Save your money for a better place and meal.Show less

Author: Savvystraveler
Title: Underwhelming and overpriced
Review: Based on the reviews you would think this is an amazing restaurant, it's not. Definitely not worth 5 stars.Only tourists eating here, which is a a bad sign.We had to wait 40 minutes for food and drinks to arrive. Iced tea didnt have sugar (which to be fair the waiter mentioned) but didnt taste good. Food was mediocre and priced between 20-30 ringgit. Not crazy expensive but not cheap by Malaysian standards.To sum it up; there are (much) better options for a nice dinner.Show less

Author: Mutsy52
Title: Delicious
Review: Amazing fresh food and instant service with a smile. Highly recommended for locals and tourists alike.Show less

Author: mohammedibnabdullahWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food for great value
Review: We heard about this restaurant on Tripadvisor and travelled 55 mins via car hoping for some great food - and no doubt about it we were not disappointed. we were greeted by a very kind and gentle owner. the food was delicious and cooked fresh, not too heavy - a perfect supper. the menu was not too complicated and overcrowded - just filled with basic Syrian dishes. we were very impressed. i thoroughly recommend anyone in the area to come down and enjoy this quaint little restaurant.Show less

Author: Jade245Utrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Traditional and fresh food!
Review: We really loved our dishes. Every dish is made fresh (even the hummus). When you have the opportunity to check this place out, go do it.Show less

Author: Giovanna M
Title: Delicious
Review: My partner and I dined here last night for dinner after discovering this place on trip advisor. We were very impressed overall. The food was sooo good, the restaurant was very clean and the owner is very lovely. We highly recommend!Show less

Author: tobias912
Title: Fantastic Restaurant
Review: This is a very good Restaurant. Ramy the owner is a very welcoming host and has a lot of stories to tell. The food we ate was great and we liked it so much that we returned two more times during our 3 day weekend on Langkawi. The Fish was amazing, but honestly everything we had was very good. This is also a very good place to smoke hookah, only place I personally have seen so far in south east Asia. PS: Order the hummus!Show less

Author: 751maxioMunich, Germany
Title: Amazing food, definitely deserves being no. 1 on Langkawi
Review: Definitely a must-go on Langkawi. The food is amazing, especially the white snapper was tremendously good. Probably one of the best dishes I had in SE Asia. The owner is welcoming and offers great hospitality. Hygiene is great as well, water used for cooking is filtered and vegetables are treated with vinegar against possible bacteria, as the owner explained. We ended up going three times in the end and it was definitely worth it. Show less

Author: Ameertumbi
Title: Little syria
Review: This is a very cozy botique type Syrian food place with amazing gentle men making sure everything is on point and giving personalised attention to every detail to the presentation of the food .this homely place serves scrumptious food that is treat to taste buds

Author: michai952
Title: Amazing food in cozy atmosphere
Review: Very very delicious oriental food in a nice restaurant. All dishes are freshly cooked table by table. Really friendly owner who is running his restaurant with his wife. Check it out, it's worth visiting!

Author: Kerdoud KEl Oued, Algeria
Title: a friendly place to visit
Review: if langkawi is a wonderful place to visit ,Alhamdulillah is the most interesting Arabic restaurant in it. delicious flavours and tasty food, JUST TRY IT U WILL NEVER REGRET...U WILL NEVER FORGET. Show less

Author: mosogaMexico City, Mexico
Title: Lovely, home cooked food
Review: This little restaurant serves excellent Syrian/Arabic food. The proprietor is a lovely, polite gentleman. The ambience is lovely and the restaurant is very clean and modern decor. Highly recommended during a visit to Langkawi. The fired fish and potatoes had us coming back a second timeShow less

Author: joewD1475SB
Title: Amazing chicken shawarma!!
Review: I could have driven past this place and not noticed it - however, you must notice it because the food is absolutely fantastic!! The chicken shawarma is so good we came  back a second time!! Highly recommended! Friendly host :)

Author: Alexey K
Title: Great! Great Again!
Review: We've had a long stay at Kuah. For a month. Family with two children (5 and 9). And when kids were asking for some grill (shawarma or chicken). I knew, the place which has the proper one!We’ve been at Alhamdulillah for several times. And always satisfied with atmosphere, taste of dishes and quality at all!!! You shouldn't wait some decor, luxury or special treatment! It is just about the food! Tasty food! Every time! Thanks a lot to the host! Best wishes!Show less

Author: FerasBardi
Title: Review
Review: Bery good and delicious food with great and very polite staff. I definitely recommend this to any visitors to langkawi.

Author: ThePrincessTravelsAdelaide, Australia
Title: Delicious!
Review: We dined here tonight after reading reviews on TripAdvisor. We didn’t have a booking and managed to get a table, however, I would recommend booking a table so that the husband and wife team who own and run the restaurant have fair notice of your intention to dine and so that you don’t miss out. The food is delicious, fresh and arrives hot on the table. I had a chicken and rice dish, whilst my husband had a whole fish with potatoes. Both meals were great and apparently traditional Syrian dishes. No alcohol is served as they don’t have a license but they do serve a variety of cold drinks. Dining here is highly recommended.Show less

Author: FN2
Title: Fabulous genuinely good food
Review: Lovely homely food...we got chicken schwarma with chips and chicken schwarma with arab rice and humous to start with. The owner helped us order and was very helpful and helped us not to order too much!! Very friendly service lovely and clean and gorgeous food!!! Would definitely recommend this place.Family run place which we loved.Show less

Author: myrfnd
Title: Awesome food
Review:
Syrian Arabic n Mid Eastern..worth going but best call first just in case..
Hospitable n the owner will recommend what best to take..
Do try their fish..
Ample parking
No regrets but some gravy please..

Author: 44taniam
Title: Delicious food and wonderful service
Review: We came to the restaurant off the back of all the favourable reviews and was not disappointed. We had the Syrian falafels and lamb and Arabic rice - they were both delicious. The warm and friendly welcome from the owner made our night - we would definitely go back and recommend to anyone looking for authentic middle eastern food. Show less

Author: AnneG740
Title: Beautiful fresh food. Very tasty
Review: Thank you Rami and your wife for the beautiful food. We will be back again in the next few days for more. We wish your family all the best for the future.

Author: 21risiko
Title: Authentic Arabic food and a nice atmosphere
Review: We went there yesterday for dinner due to the amount of positive reviews on trip advisor. The place is run by a family of Syrians, the father manages the orders and his wife cooks, and the food was very delicious and tasted, as far as we can judge that, very authentic. he gave us some advice on what to take and how everything tastes and after the dinner we had a short talk about they came to Malaysia and what they like about living in Malaysia. The food was a little more expensive than in a foodo court but we paid for a dinner for two with drinks just under 60 RM, which is totally fine. We would definitely go there again for our next stay in kuah and we wish them all the very best for their future. Show less

Author: 923abbasm
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Highly recommended, like home dishes, good staff and many thanks to our chief,, the lady in the kitchen for the amazing Falafel and shawerma

Author: Moshiur CDhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Amazing Food!!
Review: Went there on 08/02/19. Was greeted by the gentleman (Probably Mr. Rami) who took our order and suggested a few. Food took almost 30 minutes to be made. But once we ate, it was worthy of waiting. Some of us ordered traditional Khapsa rice with chicken, I ordered for Sharma and one of my friends ordered for Kebab. We were all very pleased with the portion along with the taste. A must visit for all.Show less

Author: Susan1603
Title: Tasted yammi :)
Review: A sweet nice place for having really good arabic food made by a lovely and calm cook. I definitly can recommend. Thanks a lot!

Author: Mick Y
Title: Mick
Review: I have traveled around world as filmmaker, cannot believe this is no1 restaurant in Langkawi, taste very average and over priced ,hardly any people in there,TripAdvisor must be something wrong rated no1,never come backShow less

Author: zoeltsLa Rochelle, France
Title: Very good
Review: We loved our food, it was chicken donuts (I do not know 'name') excellent! Thank you for this good timeShow less

Author: MapleandCinnamon
Title: Very tasty!
Review: Very good food at a very good price! The service is great, very welcoming. Definitely recommend trying it.

Author: sandykemperPerth, Australia
Title: Amazing food
Review: A really nice Restaurant! The food was so good that we came back again the next day. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Fiq35
Title: GOOD FOOD, FRIENDLY OWNER
Review: The food was great, the chicken with the arabic rice is tender and the kebab was well seasoned. The owner is very friendly and engaging. Would like to come back again soon

Author: Lama S
Title: Good Food, Good Service
Review: The owners did an outstanding job serving our group of 14 people and the food tasted great... best of luck

Author: Penr15The Netherlands
Title: Good falafel
Review: We went here twice in a week and both times the food was excellent. Great falafel, hummus and chicken shoarma. The restaurant is family owned with a small kitchen and can get busy, but we were lucky both times. The owner is pleasant and there is free wifi available. Clean interior. Highly recommended for a simple but delicious meal.Show less

Author: FlovechFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Go there even if taxi drivers recommend sth else
Review: Had the best Shawarma and Hummus ever and already visited the place twice. Dont get fooled by the taxi drivers that want to bring you different restaurants as they work on a commission basis. We told this to the owner and he confirmed that other restaurants pay the taxi drivers to recommend there place - Alhamdulillah Restaurant doesnt do this and is unbelievable good.Show less

Author: iiayman
Title: THE BEST OF THE BEST OF THE BESTEST
Review: Nothing but the best Arabic resturant you will ever try ! Responsible prices and good services with the best taste . BUT PLEASE NOTE THAT :1- The orders take time because it is FRESH made ( home cook ) which was fine for me . 2- they have an order if you want it you will have to order it a day before . 4- Kabab and shawerma is really recommended and have not tasted as good as theirs . 3- VALUE OF MONEY AND WAITING . Show less

Author: vegista_uae
Title: Good Arabic food place
Review: Very simple ambience and good service . We ordered Hummus , Falafel , Fattoush and soft drinks . The quantity served is good for the price charged . Taste was also good .

Author: khalids191Edmonton, Canada
Title: Best shawerma
Review: Best shawerma I have had in a long time.Great food, great service and very clean.A must go to for a full Lingkawi experience Show less

Author: amzshaky
Title: Excellent Service!
Review: My husband and I visited this lovely Arabic restaurant on our honeymoon 3 times! They have a nice menu something for everyone to try... food is made to perfection and service was great every time! We thoroughly enjoyed our visits and will definitely be going back again if we visit Langkawi in the future. Definitely worth trying if you visit this beautiful Island. :)Show less

Author: FAIISAL_OYMedina, Saudi Arabia
Title: Excellent
Review: The food is wonderful.. taste good.. fresh and well prepared. And that’s coming from someone who lives in the Middle East.The owner is very nice gentleman who greeted us warmly. Definitely worth the time and money you spend here.Hopefully I’ll have a chance to visit again.Show less

Author: Hikka123
Title: Best shawarma I’ve ever had
Review: Found the restaurant as it was number 1 on trip advisor and it definitely did not disappoint. Great end to the holiday enjoying some delicious chicken shawarma as well as other home cooked dishes. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting or even locals!Show less

Author: Nadia Van Camp ... TBarcelona
Title: Best shawarma
Review: Best shawarma ever and very friendly people! Food is prepared by the lady of the house, real Syrian food.Show less

Author: Suuultan
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: This restaurant was probably one of the cleanest on the island. The food was very flavoursome but not overbearing, enabling everyone to enjoy the dishes. We had hummous, fries, chicken + rice, salad and falafel. We all enjoyed our meals immensely. The owner was very friendly and made us feel very welcome. You won't regret it, be sure to have a meal here!!Show less

Author: Dursunnnz
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: I went here for dinner with my family. Its very cheap and delicious. We were sad that we discovered this place on our last night in Langkawi. I had the chicken with the rice; my daughter had the falafel. Very tasty food!!! The owner was very polite and we had a great chat. Definitely recommend this place, you won't be disappointed!!Show less

Author: Farhan A
Title: Very Authentic and value for money
Review: 5 Stars ...Excellent Food with taste and value for money.I tried the falafel and shawerma and both were Amazing !

Author: eidalgara
Title: The taste is average and overpriced
Review: The taste is average , nothing surprised me .It’s not worth for what you pay, I will not come bake طعم الأكل عادي جدا والأسعار مبالغ فيها ربع دجاجة مع رز 27 رينجت Show less

Author: Marie NPerth, Australia
Title: Full of flavour
Review: My partner and I had just arrived in Langkawi and needed an evening meal after travelling all day. I had read about this place on Trip Advisor so went there on others recommendations. It didn't disappoint. The food was full of flavour. I had the falafels which we very yummy and freshly made. My partner had the chicken with Arabic rice which was so full of flavour. The meal was filling. The service was really - lovely friendly people. You may have to wait for your meal as they do make it fresh but they tell you that before you order. We used the maps on our phone to find it as there are no street signs anywhere. It is near the water front quite close to the Baron Resort complex. The falafel was 15 MRY and my partners meal was 27 MYR we also had a side of rice that was 12 MYRShow less

Author: MathetCaro
Title: Amazing service and food
Review: The food was really good and the waiters were super nice. It is relatively cheap and really delicious !

Author: 94djamelm
Title: delightful experience!
Review: The food was delicious, and the staff was very friendly. Would definitely recommend this place when in Langkawi!

Author: S1561HCamyw
Title: Very Tasty Food a must visit!
Review: Well worth a visit! The food was delicious and the hospitality was great! If we had longer in Langkawi we would definitely make a return visit

Author: SerhatSozen92Rotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Definitely a must visit in langkawi!
Review: Me and my wife visited today this restaurant based on the tripadvisor reccommendations. I trully can say, glad that we visit it! We enjoyed in a warm hospital environment of our delicious food! This restraunt does only serve fresh, so not warming up. For all the langkawi visitors: your holiday is not completed if you don't visit this place!Show less

Author: JamieM1988Bearsden, United Kingdom
Title: Good food
Review: We enjoyed our meal here but are thoroughly confused over how this is the number #1 place in Langkawi. The food was freshly prepared for each table (so there will be a wait which is made clear on arrival). The food was quite plain and while tasty doesn’t give a wow factor that you might expect from the highest rated restaurant in a location. Show less

Author: Yellow_GumbootsMudgee, Australia
Title: Good food, great hospitality!
Review: We visited today for a late lunch at about 3. We arrived just as they were opening but the owner and his father were very warm and welcoming. You can tell there’s a lot of love here. From the owner to his country, Syria, and between the family members. And especially into the food.The meal was great. We had the hummus, the chicken shawarma, the chicken shish tawook and the beef kofta things. All were beautiful and the owner has some great recommendations about the meals, the rice and having the chips with the hummus (yum!).Well worth the trip from Cenang Beach!!! If we have time we’ll definitely be back! Hope the business goes well!Show less

Author: tamialvarez
Title: Delicious hummus
Review: Fantastic place, food and owner. If you try once, you will come back for sure during your holiday! Falafel and hummus totally recommended. All the best for Ramy and his family!Show less

Author: Charif A
Title: Excellent
Review: Fantastic Syrian cuisine done with fresh food and love. This family owned restaurant will make you happy.Show less

Author: Jodi S
Title: A must try restaurant - simply amazing!
Review:
This restaurant has the most delish food.... we went with the owners recommendation and it did not disappoint. The food was incredibly fresh and the owner was very lovely. 
You really must go here you won’t be disappointed

Author: Paul Pshanghai
Title: Comfort food done well
Review: Enjoyed most dishes very much. This is a simple no fuss place that permeates family. The proprietor is a very hospitable, gentleman. If you are fond of middle eastern food this place will satiate. My favorites were the falafel (excellent textures), hummus and Syrian kebab (dry version) Highly recommended, free WiFi too but come for the food.Show less

Author: Mirek K
Title: Amazing food worth the wait!
Review: This is a great family run restaurant in Langkawi. The food is truly well spiced and fresh. If you arrive at peak time (as we did at 8 pm) you might need to wait (for us this was approx. an hour) but you are advised of this in advance when you enter and can make a decision. We were happy we waited as the quality of the food was worth our time. The falafel and hummus were the best we've tried in years! The waiter actually made a mistake in the queue of our order and people arriving after us were served first. Since the food is prepared fresh for a single table at a time this actually adds up to a good extra wait time, however the owner was professional about it and genuinely apologised.Altogether amazing food well worth waiting for but make sure you are not in a rush if you come at peak time.Show less

Author: Tareq S
Title: Just the best
Review: Best food you can get in Langkawi, The place to be if you want try the arabic hospitality at it best, family owned family foodShow less

Author: dankar73Atlanta, Georgia
Title: Very good!
Review: Very good and tasty Syrian food.Simple,cheap and tasty. You might wait for around 1 hour to get the food but you will get a tasty food from the Syrian culture.The owner and his wife serves the food by them self. (hand made dishes).The owner is very gentle and trying his best to give an excellent impression.The fish is great as the owners l are originally from a coastal city in Syria.If you are looking for a mdetterian food and specifically from Syrian culture,this place would be the best in the area.Show less

Author: Florianhe1995
Title: Great place to go for dinner
Review: First time for us trying out Syrian cuisine and it was super delicious! The owner is a very friendly person. We had nice chats together. About the food: His wife is cooking these great dishes which is all fresh and handmade and doesn’t come on a plate after 5 minutes ... The price is reasonable and his wife makes sure everything is fresh with great quality prepared.All in all we enjoyed our dinner and would recommend it to everyone who wants to try out a new cuisine or just wants to enjoy good food!Show less

Author: aussielivinthelifeAdelaide, Australia
Title: The best Shawarma we have found yet, with a charismatic host!
Review: So glad we left the 5 star comforts of the St Regis to visit this restaurant!We had delicious shawarma, humus, and fattoush which was spiced and cooked to perfection!This is a very small family business run by a couple with their young daughter from Syria who have found their life as refugees, has not been easy. Being resourceful they have a wonderful story about their journey and the opening of their restaurant. Love the first dollar bill pinned to the wall!We would go back to this small restaurant again and recommend it to anyone who visits Langkawi. It's small so get there early to nab a table and have a chat with the owner.Thank you and best of luck in your future!Show less

Author: Travelguru52818
Title: Jo Overly
Review: The food was fantastic and the owner was very hospitable. 100% recommend this place to anyone traveling on Langkawi. It is a must visit.Show less

Author: Ethar AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Alhamdulilah Restaurant.
Review: Delicious food and people are so friendly. It was my first time visit this restaurant, of course I’ll come back a gain. We spent really nice time in Alhamdulilah RestaurantShow less

Author: 547keithwGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Great food with amazing people!
Review: It’s easy to understand why everyone rates this place (apart from the bogus 1 star rating!). My wife and I were here because of the rating and both loved it. The food was delicious and they chat with the owner was so warm and friendly. I happily recommend this place to anyone looking for good food and great people. Show less

Author: gemini99australia
Title: Delicious food - friendly service
Review: The food here is magnificent - we had hummus, fattoush, shawarma and everything was so fresh and full of flavour! I would recommend this restaurant for people looking for something different in Kuah! We will ba back and we wish you every success!Show less

Author: 870kartikjMumbai, India
Title: Amazing authentic food and great service
Review: We found this place on trip advisor and it was great. Amazing rice and chicken. Chicken shawarma was yummm. My daughter just loved the food which had the right amount of spices and flavour, cooked just right. The owners were so kind and warm. Show less

Author: Nicolewathers23
Title: Wonderful food and amazing service!
Review: The owners of this place are so kind and attentive. The hummus and chicken shawarma was SO good! Highly recommendedShow less

Author: Angelluga
Title: AMAZING AS ALWAYS!!
Review: My wife and myself come to this place again and again because both the food and the service are incredible!! Today falafel wraps!! A must in Langkawi!

Author: 209philippah
Title: Best arabic food
Review: This restaurant has the best arabic dishes I‘ve eaten so far. It‘s a lovely family restaurant and cooked by the mother you taste the love and quality of the food. Everything for a very good price. If you ever come to Langkawi you have to visit this place.Show less

Author: clarkfamily_advenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Chicken Shawarma of my life!!
Review: My wife and I love Mediterranean and Arabic cuisine! This restaurant is a Syrian family owned and operated restaurant. It doesn’t look like much from the street, but the food is made with love and care. We travel the world and are very much foodies. We love food with lots of flavor, so let me say that this place did not disappoint at all! The food was cooked perfectly, very well seasoned with distinct flavor notes. We would highly recommend the Chicken Shawarma. We were gasping with joy and pleasure as we savored every bite of this delicious dish. If you visit Langkawi, you must stop here for an early dinner before the rush. Show less

Author: Ruari1967
Title: Amazing meal in a relaxing family environment.
Review: Fantastic Syrian food in a nice and welcoming environment. I ordered the houmous and chicken shawarma, both of which were some of the best I have had. The shawarma in particular was phenomenal and of a much higher quality than most you will find elsewhere. Strongly recommend!Show less

Author: Jaimegrimmett
Title: Delicious Syrian Food!
Review: We asked for recommendations from the lovely owner, and decided to order the hummus, fattoush and chicken shawarma with rice. It was all delicious and we enjoyed having a bit of difference from South East Asian food without defaulting back to western food. Very delicious!!

Author: 02churchillc
Title: Excellent little gem of a restaurant
Review: Having been travelling for 7 months we were delighted to find this restaurant offering delicious Middle Eastern food In Langkawi. The food not only tasted great, the portions are plentiful and prices are reasonable for the quality you receive. The owner is extremely friendly and we had a good chat about his background. When we come back to Langkawi we will be back for sure! Show less

Author: NopainNogain88Lagos, Nigeria
Title: hard to believe the Nr.1 on Langkawi
Review: Honestly speaking it's really hard to believe, that such enviroment is ranked Nr. 1 among the langkawian restaurants.We got a couple of items (chicken shwarma, beef kebab, hummus...) and none of them was outstanding. The beef kebab slightly cold inside and the hummus quite oily.The owner not really welcoming. On the island you can find much better places to enjoy middle east food.Show less

Author: Jessica4519Spain
Title: Very nice restaurant
Review: My husband and me went there to have dinner and the food was great we ordered a salad a shawama and falafel, all was delicious. The owner is very kind and as well they have the facility to smoke shisha.The surrounding is not the best (no views or anything and a little bit noisy) but to eat in town I recommend this place.Show less

Author: LeeKlan
Title: Excellent food
Review: The boss is very helpful & patient in guid8hg us to the restaurant. Foid is cook with full love and everything taste so good here. Just that the serving time is a bit long but it worth to wait. Show less

Author: hhwaugh
Title: Great food!
Review: Our dinner here was excellent! The food takes about 45 minutes to be prepared, but it is well worth the wait. The hummus was delicious and the falafel was the best we've had in years. The chicken and rice was great as well. Chicken was flavorful and fell off the bone. If you're not in a rush, definitely check this place out! Food is amazing.Show less

Author: kshabiLa Fox, Illinois
Title: Authentic food by great people
Review: Finally an authentic place to find middle eastern food! My family and I were in search of a place to find great middle eastern food while in langkawi. After trying several other places, we found alhumdulillah restaurant. Everything was made fresh and with high quality ingredients. The bread and hummus were my children's favourite. The chicken was my favourite and had a grilled lemon flavor to it. My husband enjoyed a beef dish which was tender and flavorful. The owner is great with kids and is very friendly. We enjoyed visiting and dining with them very much. Show less

Author: djjcwhiteh8
Title: Delicious food and Friendly Service
Review: As other reviews have stated excellent food, shawarma chicken, falafels and hummus.  Owner was very helpful and ordered a "grab" for us back to our hotel, half the price of a taxi.  Highly recommend.

Author: nijinsky7
Title: Lovely meal with perfect host
Review:
My wife and I went on the recommendation of TripAdvisor.
We were impressed with the food and welcome and would definitely recommend this small family concern.

Author: JordanTheExplorerCao Bang, Vietnam
Title: So delicious!!!
Review: This place was SO GOOD!!! Fresh, light, filling, and TASTY food served beautifully. I can see why it’s the #1 place in Langkawi! Everything was simply delicious, and the owner is a very kind man with an amazing story. So happy to support this place and his family. Definitely go here!!! Won’t disappoint. Affordable, good WiFi, comfortable, convenient location. Show less

Author: yibei_vipKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Food
Review: The owner is really friendly and approachable. We called to check the closing time of the restaurant because we will be arriving late around 10pm, even though he told me that they stop taking orders at 10pm, but he still invite us over. He recommended some choices of food. It took some time to prepare the food although there were no other customers (mentioned at a board hanging at the front door). Overall the food are delicious, especially the shawarma chicken, highly recommended. The environment is comfortable. I would like to have another visit if I ever coming back. Ps. The food is worth the price.Show less

Author: AndyHUB
Title: Awesome Authentic Arabic Cuisine
Review: Falafels to die for. Wonderful no nonsense home style Arabic cuisine cooked with love. We enjoyed our dinner and the hospitality of the friendly owner of this family run restaurant.

Author: taagy2019
Title: Best Falafals ever
Review: What a great little spot.   Come here because of the great reviews on tripadvisor.  Did not disappoint, wonderful food and wonderful owner.   Highly recommend, especially the Falafals.

Author: Yuxinloo
Title: Good food
Review: One of the best food ever !!!!!! Recommend everyone to come. Location are nice and the owners are so kind.

Author: elizabethastraLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, casual atmosphere
Review: We came here for dinner (and an escape from the crazy prices at our resort) and we were not disappointed! The food was very tasty— we strongly recommend the chicken shawarma dish with the Arabic rice and of course the hummus. The food was delicious and a great value for money. Strongly recommend eating here when in Langkawi Show less

Author: Giles H
Title: Amazing hummus
Review: Best hummus I’ve ever tried - the falafel was fantastic too. It was very authentic food and the worker was polite and friendly. It was interesting to hear a bit of his story! Easy eating well priced and would 100% return.

Author: 868tinabSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious!!
Review: The restaurant is unassuming when you arrive but the food is amazing. The place is ran by a husband, wife, and their four year old little girl. Welcomed with a warm smile and honest suggestions we ordered the shawarma, hummus, and kebabs. The food was perfectly cooked, large portions, and deliciously flavored. Everything was fresh and the chicken was juicy. I had to stop overeating because the food was so good. Afterwards we ordered an Arabic coffee and because it was so tasty, we ordered another. No wonder this place is #1 - they deserve it!! If you are visiting, make this a spot to NOT miss. You won’t be disappointed. I promise!Show less

Author: vickil379
Title: Yummy!
Review: We came here due to the good reviews on Trip Advisor and we were not disappointed, the food was excellent. It was quiet as we came early, we ordered falafel and chicken shawarma, so lovely and fresh tasting. Would highly recommend.

Author: ID0612Sydney, Australia
Title: Warm and beautiful service, delicious food!
Review: Alhamdulillah restaurant, by far, the best meal and dining experience our family had while on holiday in Langkawi. The couple who own the restaurant are so warm and hospitable, they treated us like their own family and modified some dishes as per the requests of my picky grandfather! We loved talking to them, and the food was wholesome, so fresh and absolutely delicious. The restaurant is clean and comfortable. You couldn't possibly ask for more. If we ever come back to Langkawi, you can be sure we will be headed straight to Alhamdulillah!Show less

Author: 4everTravelerLGK
Title: Best Syrian restaurant in the island
Review: We came to try the shawarma, as you know there is many you can find here, but trust me, go to Kuah for this one. We were really surprised for the tasty food... Even the owner and his family are really kind. May Allah give them more baraka. El hamdulillah. We will come back insha AllahShow less

Author: JentePosthumus
Title: Best falafel ever
Review: Went here for dinner, the owner told us on forehand it would take some time because it was very busy. After 30 min we got oir food, it was worth the waiting! Very good food! I think it's the best falafel ever!

Author: skdcitravellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Loved Ramy’s story and food was ok!
Review: Intrigued by no.1 restaurant rating. Booked on evening when there was a water outage in the area. Ramy kindly welcomed us in and we were the only guests as he treated us to Syrian cuisine. I had a shawarma and my wife had a koftka which were good. Not sure this restaurant warrants the rating for food alone but his story is both interesting & intriguing! The restaurant decor is put together through donations and although it is fairly bare he does much to entertain guests whilst his wife cooks. Prepare for a wait if you go here. No alcohol served. 1411.Show less

Author: pshemassHong Kong, China
Title: 10PM and all food finish
Review: Really dissapointed as we planned to visit 1st restaurant (Tripadvisor rank) in Langkawi on our last day. Anyway, owner (probably) welcomed us and sent us back to doors with answer „all food is finish”. So probably will never again visit this place and never try the tastes which are described in comments. One ⭐️ gone Show less

Author: Mahmoud_dirdiri
Title: Arabic cuisine
Review: Food tastes great, took the shawrma loved the spices and yoghurt, coleslaw is amazing. Prices are good.Show less

Author: leslieg262Las Vegas, Nevada
Title: Delicious, healthy food
Review: We have eaten here twice now and both times the food was delicious, fresh, and healthy. The owners are welcoming and take the time to make sure you enjoy.Show less

Author: 906mohammadh
Title: This is a must to go resturant
Review:
The best resturant in Langkawi ever
The best and fresh food , cooked with passion from the great family of Rami the owner and his wife, shawarma , falafel, and kabsah and many more delicious food 
Seriously highly recommend.

Author: KSAandbeyond
Title: Amazing food!!! Very Authentic Arabic Food!!!
Review: The food brings me back to my time growing up in the middle east!!! The Chicken Shawarma is top notch and I would always recommend adding on a fattoush salad to the meal when dining for two. Typically I try and drop by at least once a week and continue to be impressed! As mentioned in other reviews the Falafel is a great appetiser too. Lastly don't miss out on the perfectly seasoned half chicken with arabic rice. Looking forward to many excellent meals ahead and when not dining in take-away is a great option and they always prepare your items right on time (: Great personalised service from Ramy the Owner as well!!Show less

Author: DMIE89
Title: The reviews are solid!!
Review: Similar to a lot of reviewers, we went for dinner owing to the Tripadvisor rank and we were not disappointed. We both had the chicken shawarma and it was excellent. Big portions and served by the owner who was very friendly to us. Gave us some good tips for the island too! Would definitely recommend a visit.Show less

Author: feruskaAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Really worth coming here!
Review: This place has delicious food and looks really nice. We found it on TripAdvisor as number 1 restaurant in Langkawi and it definitely is! We were staying in Pantai Cenang so it was a little bit of a trip to come here. But it was worth travel! We had the best falafel ever. Really fresh and crispy. We also had chicken kebab and this was also fresh and very yummy. It is to bad that this restaurant is in Kuah. I know for sure that the place would be packed with long waiting lines if was located in cenang. We hope that they will move or open a second restaurant in the future. If you are looking for a nice place to eat with the most delicious food, visited this place. Show less

Author: marnicfil
Title: Arab-Mediterranean cuisine
Review: We went to this restaurant following the comments on this site. The very superior ranking of the restaurant is deserved. The food is excellent, the portions generous and the service that is done with a smile. Highly recommended

Author: drizz12
Title: Just great flavors
Review:
Exceptional flavors. We were trying chicken shawarma, chicken shish tawok and hummus. 
The owner and his wife were very welcoming and gave us a lot of advices about Langkawi nice places

Author: tamialvarez
Title: Amazing food!
Review: Me and my partner love syrian food. This is our first time in Alhamdulillah and we can say it's fantastic. Delicious food, big portions and good price (Falafel is highly recommended) Also the place is very clean and Ramy is so friendly! We'll come back soon.Show less

Author: martin p
Title:
Fresh and really tasteful food 
Exelelent service
Review: I really recommend a visit to this resturant during stay in langkawi. Really tasteful food and a very friendly owner of the restaurant.

Author: 1234julienn
Title: Great experience close to waterfront
Review: We had a great experience in this restaurant with kind and friendly staff further the food was very good! Highly recomand this place!

Author: Geoffrey D
Title: Great Chicken Shawarma
Review: Very nice food, and the owner is a very nice man. If you are in Langkawi you must try this restaurant.

Author: Huzaifah SAjax, Canada
Title: AMAZING FOOD
Review: This food is amazing! The chicken Shawrma was really good, came here with a few friends and did not leave disappointed. The owner is very nice and you can carry a good conversation with him, he's very open. Hummus was not bad as well and the oranges juice here almost tastes as if it's freshly squeezed!Show less

Author: kinehd23
Title: Excellent
Review: My husband and I visited this very nice restaurant and had a great foodexperience. Lovely staff aswell.

Author: kim1an
Title: Love it!
Review:
Perfect small place with really good food! The family who owns it are very kind aswell! 

A must visit if you are in Langkawi!

Author: Rorosam83
Title: Mouth watering food
Review: It was yummy food. My hubby and I enjoyed the arabic music and Atmosphere. My order was chawarma sandwatch and fatoosh,then we finished our seating with the arbic coffee that took me to the Paradise. General speaking, good food with reasnoable price and respctful staff.RShow less

Author: mortenm104
Title: Excellent
Review: Looked in Tripadvisor, and wanted a great dinner for my wife and me.  Food was just excellent, spices/combinations/meats, just a very good harmony. Thanks. Obviously-we from Europe enjoy a good glass of wine to an excellent dinner.... understand this is maybe not that easy.

Author: Lailatul B
Title: Great Food, Great Service
Review: Great food and Service. They have a selection of food ranging from meat to fish. I am sure will come again because of the waiter and the food. Hope this review will help you and them.

Author: Nikkylee
Title: Must do and taste!
Review: Had dinner twice here with husband and daughter. The food is absolutely delicious (the reason for going back ;-) ). Also their hospitality is amazing, so personal and our daughter loved playing with their daughter too.Must visit! We would love the go back one day.Show less

Author: NeilMcB1de
Title: A must when visiting Langkawi
Review: Me, my wife and daughter came here twice for dinner and it was incredible each time. The food was amazing with the most incredible flavours and the service was always with a big smile. I had the nicest shawarma I have ever tasted which is a big statement considering how many different styles I've tried and tasted, the black beans were also out of this world. Our daughter is a very fussy eater and on both occasions finished her plate. If you come to Langkawi you must visit this place, you will not regret it.Show less

Author: TheOmaris
Title: Great Food and Exceptional Service
Review: We came for a holiday to Langkawi. one evening we were looking for different food to try than the usual local cuisine. Stumbled across this restaurant. Quirky and cosy family ran business, husband and wife personally wait the tables and cook too food too which adds a personal touch. Very friendly people. Well priced delishious food and big protion sizes. We wouldn’t usually choose a fish dish but we were recommended a dish when placing our order and it did not disappoint. Very close to the Westin, St Regis and Kuah Jetty.Show less

Author: Mihai D
Title: Best price/quality restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Being a fan of middle eastern food I was surprised to find some in Asia. But I was definitely not expecting this quality! The owners are lovely Syrian couple that cook everything from scratch - and you can feel that. So if you're around do not hesitate and give them a try! I've been twice and can recommend falafel and hummus, but plenty of options for meat lovers too.Enjoy :)Show less

Author: Angel L
Title: OWNER RAMY, GREAT PERSON
Review: Despite my wife and myself have not try out his food yet (we Will very soon as we know is one of the best good on the whole Island), Ramy opened his door for us (out of business time!) to give some advice and share his business experience. Thousands of thanks!! Looking forward to see you soon!Show less

Author: Al B
Title: Delicious
Review:
The food was really good and the owner is fantastic. I would eat there again.
Highly recommended. It was nice to meet you.

Author: sadek510Melbourne, Australia
Title: We had a good time
Review: A syrian smart man travelled all the way from syria to serve a lovely syrian and arabic food for this touristic island, he’s doing a great job Love this place Show less

Author: Fara NLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Food with a great story behind it.
Review: I went to this restaurant just to know why it's number one in TripAdvisor,I work in luxury brand property ,the ambience was just an okay look.Food & beverages arrived in a good time and the taste was exceptionally great.have a fast WiFi.But after knowing the story behind the opening of the restaurant ,the owner (manager in front and his wife (the chef here) only two of them running the restaurant, are Syrian refugees ,fleeing here to get visa, had to go for 6-7 times working visas and finally open it here.Their struggle,preseverance and their strong-will never faded to ensure their restaurant will always have good yet cheap food with moderate portion.Should try the Turkish tea very recommendable and the falafel and hummus set is a good healthy selection.Recommended for families,halal food,have shisha too.Good Arabic & English speaker.Will come back for more.Show less

Author: BaThongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Syrian food
Review: It’s a family run business . Rami runs the front and his wife runs the kitchen. The chicken shawarma is excellent. Rami is one of the refugees from Middle East who starts his own business in Langkawi and he reminds me the time when I was myself a refugee from Indochina. Show less

Author: FeliciaR184Ireland
Title: Cheap Eats
Review: We had dinner here and were happy with the food. Note that they seem to only have two people working so the restaurant was half full and he sort of turned people away saying that it would be a very long wait so maybe you could make reservation or have a back up plan. They also have free WiFi which was helpful to get a grab back to hotel. All of our food was nice and the price is very very reasonable. Would recommend.Show less

Author: Sheikhkobob
Title: One word .. WOW
Review: My first night in Langkawi and after 3 flights consisting around 16 hours. I can say there is no way better to start off the holiday. Have had syrican cuisine all around the world but to date this is the best I have tasted. Amazing food, lovely owner, you will have to wait a little long usual for your food but it is worth every minute. The honours/ falafel and chicken shawarma have to be tried to experience the culinary brilliance. A must visit in Langkawi !! Will be coming here again before I leave.Show less

Author: GabrielKaaa
Title: Excellent family run place
Review: We ate excellent food very well attended. Our best dinner in malaysia so far. The shawarma is totally perfect

Author: MahbvbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: We ate here this evening having read the reviews. The restaurant was closed for a few days and has now reopened. We were greeted by one half of the team. He front of house, welcoming guests, she working her magic in the kitchen.Our chicken, lamb and fatoush dishes arrived well presented and tasty. We ate everything.We were assisted with some explanation of the ingredients in the food and a call to a taxi to take us home.Thank you for a satisfying meal.Show less

Author: OsamaOb
Title: Oussama
Review: Great food, and professional service, definitely would come again and recommend this place to friends

Author: 94otiliat
Title: Amazing food
Review: This is a small restaurant with a couple that runs it by them self. The food is delicious!! We ate there 2 days in a row and will eat again before we leave. Can recommend this restaurant if you are on Langkawi.

Author: K610HYmartaa
Title: Fresh and typical Food
Review: We had such a great time here. The food is very delicious and the price performance is very good. The food is fresh and we will definitely come back. The owner is friendly interested in shortly talks. Show less

Author: L8684MYpatrickb
Title: Nice authentic food
Review: Very nice authentic food, fast, very friendly staff. Definitely recommend it. Prices are cheap for the served quality. Would bring some friends here too. Show less

Author: martaf428Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Syrian food
Review: We drove over than 30 min to get to the restaurant, and we were not disappointed. Amazing food, Rami and his wife cooked freshly food and everything had a special taste. How lucky Langkawi is for having this restaurant here you must try chicken shawarma Show less

Author: casec300Tamborine Mountain, Australia
Title: The food is worth the wait
Review: We read the reviews and thought we had to try this restaurant. The host is very friendly and also very honest about wait times and recommendations on food.Our food did take a little while to come ( as we were advised) but it was definitely worth the wait. The falafel was excellent and the beef and lamb absolutely superb. Prices are very reasonable.Thoroughly recommended.Show less

Author: vonErlachKevinFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Absolutely delicious
Review: My wife took me here after reading all the great reviews and we were NOT disappointed. The owner is a very nice host and the food is delicious. We can definitely recommend this little restaurant to anyone. We also recommend to make reservations, you can do that easily over Facebook.Show less

Author: AlexSebettim Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso
Title: Delicious food, worth the trek over
Review: Heard about this place from a girl at my hostel. It was in a different town from where I was staying but her recommendation was so strong some friends of mine and I decided to make the 30 minute journey over. We were not disappointed, we had falafel, chicken, a salad and the humous, all of which were delicious. I strongly recommend visitingShow less

Author: lucyhD2359VR
Title: Amazing food
Review: I really miss falafels whilst traveling, but these were reasonably priced for once and so perfect I could cry. It was 15 ringgit for 8 falafels, some salad, bread and tahini and it made for the perfect sized meal. Although after I had finished I did consider re-ordering, but that was because it was delicious not because it wasn’t enough. I went back the next day!Show less

Author: damo235
Title: Wonderful 😊
Review:
Great little restaurant serving homemade Syrian food. All fresh ingredients, a lovely atmosphere and super friendly service.
I would definitely book in advance..

Author: Alice WLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: Perfect food. Perfect service. What a wonderful experience. We travelled 40 minutes to go, and it was well worth it!Show less

Author: l_ga_2016
Title: Best place in Langkawi
Review: Best place in Langkawi!!! Adorable place, owner and dishes! Afther first dinner me and husband returned here every evening while staying in Langkawi. The owner loves his job and his place, and you can feel it in every bite. Chicken Shawarma is something adorable, definetely recommend for everybody.Show less

Author: Stefan S
Title: Best food in Langkawi.
Review: We went here right before closing time and the owner kept us company and even told us how to make the perfect hummus. We had the hummus, falafels and chicken shawarma. All of them were delicious. As a dessert I had the Turkish coffee. Can recommend to anyone. Definitely worth a visit!Show less

Author: Raumbegrenzer
Title: Part of the best food I've eaten
Review:
Chicken shawarma and Hummus. Get it.

Owner is great and honest. Everything here is authentic and works perfect.

Author: saintlyharp23
Title: Really lovely restaurant, great food!
Review: My boyfriend and I really loved the food at this restaurant. The chicken shawarma and hummus were delicious. A great little gem in kuah.

Author: Markus K
Title: Perfect food, friendly people!
Review:
The food was amazing we really loved it. We are traveling since 14 months non stop around the world and this was one of the best restaurants we have visited. Don't expect fast food, but freshly cooked very tasty food. 
We will come back! Thanks!

Author: Renars Ž
Title: Excellent experience
Review: Went here with my wife and we had an excellent dinner. Everything was really tasty and my wife said that she had the best chicken she has ever tasted. Highly recommend this place. Owner is very friendly.

Author: MostafaM87
Title: Friendly Manager and good food
Review:
I had a Chicken Shawerma and rice, orange juice and shisha.
It was very good for the value. The manager is great.
Hope him all the best.

Author: ShmsyDurban, South Africa
Title: Good Syrian food ,delicious and wholesome
Review: Authentic Syrian food which was freshly made and very delicious. Went quite late to the restaurant which is relatively small. The owner advised that he could only serve us in one hour and appreciated his honesty. It was worth the wait as the food we ordered was absolutely wholesome and fresh. Had a delightful conversation with the owner and overall great evening. Show less

Author: Junior_8968Ribeauville, France
Title: Best restaurant in town
Review: Not once, not twice, but three times I had the pleasure of diner in this restaurant. The food was fresh, fairly priced and absolutely delicious! Speak to the owner, a very sympathetic man with stories to tell! I will be back and bring friends and family! :)Show less

Author: Bluubi259
Title: Great Host, Great Food
Review: Food was awesome and well priced, great hospitality from the host too. We‘re coming again, for sure!

Author: 933jeanpierrew
Title: Delicious food, wonderful owner.
Review: My wife and I visited this restaurant because we were looking for a reasonably priced place with vegerarian options. We were so happy to have found this place because it is an excelent value for money. The owner is very kind and honest. We ordered a side of the vegetable rice and he informed us that he used butter so it wasn't vegan, which was fine. The falafel and the bean dish were superb. We will definitely be back and we highly recommend this restaurant! Show less

Author: Tazy_y786
Title: Best falafel ever!
Review: Was definitely worth the wait. One dish I'd highly recommend is the falafel, nice crispy and light. Fattoush was very tasty. Great customer service. Nice fresh healthy clean food. Restaurant is clean and has a homely feel. Well decorated and one of the best spots in langkawi!!!Show less

Author: WorldTraveller36040Wakefield, United Kingdom
Title: Well worth the visit!
Review: Reading previous reviews it seemed an obvious choice. Having nothing to compare with as Arabic food 'novices' we can only say that the food we had was fresh & fabulous. The highlight being the Chicken Sawarma as others have commented. It's only a small restaurant but don't be put off by that or the sign that says they're fully booked; if seats are available you can go in and ask. You may have to wait a little but it's worth it.Show less

Author: jusanothergal
Title: Arabic delight in Langkawi
Review: We drove from Cenagh beach just to have dinner here and I must say it's worth the trip. I have never had such amazing shawarma. The filling was so tender juicy and flavourful. The Arabic rice was full of flavours and the kebab was just out of the world. The Turkish coffee at the end was cherry on the top. Overall, it was worth the drive and food justifies all the hype. Amazing experience.Show less

Author: Bayansalemfalahat
Title: الأردن
Review: مطعم جميل جدا واكله طيب ونظيف وصاحب المطعم  لطيف جدا وقصته ملهمة .. انصحكم بتجربتهVery nice, clean, authentic mediterranean food reasonable prices and variable menu Rami and his family are Very pleasantShow less

Author: alist30
Title: Amazing arabic restaurant with an delicious secret Syrian dish
Review: We had dinner and Sisha in this restaurant. It was delicious, if you go ask for the his specialty and you will enjoy it for sure! The owner is a very nice and a good host! If you are in Langkawi and you love Arabic food, I recommend you to have an visit! Cheers, Ali Show less

Author: Fatima693New York City, New York
Title: Another Amazing Review
Review: Amazing Food!This restaurant definitely has the "it" factor. The owner is very passionate about his restaurant and makes your visit personable. Reservations are highly recommended!!! If the restaurant is full, they turn people away, but you can opt to wait and they are honest about letting you know how long. Tip: If you just hang out, you may get lucky and the wait is a lot less. In return you get fresh food made to order.There is free wifi available as the food may take a minute. Our food however came out fast, the service was prompt. We had grilled local fish with homemade potatoes and salad. Loved the falafel. Great fresh tea as well. Great for vegans and people who eat gluten free. And no worries, there are plenty of meat options. CASH ONLYShow less

Author: JoDeaToowoomba, Australia
Title: Want the most enjoyable evening? Dine here!
Review: Enjoy simple pleasures? While you holiday in Langkawi, dine here. We had the falafels (it's true, they are the best!), chicken shawarma and Arabic rice - all delicious! Turkish coffee also very well received.In the one year they have been operating, Rami and Maya have done an exceptional job with their restaurant. Absolutely love the recycled timber furnishings, the cleanliness and above all else, the friendliness!! Show less

Author: Ads2401
Title: A Good, Simple Feed
Review: This simple little resturant punches well above its weight. It is well situated, easily accessible, clean, well decorated and the food is excellent! It may not be the most fancy dining experience, but you cannot beat the value for money. The chicken shawarma was delicious and the portion size was perfect! There is complimentary Wifi, which is perfect for passing the time while you wait for your food.
