While it certainly is not fast food, the wait time is perfectly acceptable and understandable considering everything is fresh cooked.And you cannot beat the exceptional service from the friendly owner!Show less

Author: Matonen82
Title: Good food
Review: We had some chicken food, dont remember the names. I had to try falafells, only because someone sayed that they were the best and i had nothing to blame.. The food was very good. I can recommend this place to everyone; Good food, lovely people, and not expensive.Show less

Author: tbag24Helsinki, Finland
Title: Best falafels in the world
Review: The food is truly fresh and home made, the falafel meal is just amazing. I had tasted so many good falafels before, I couldn't believe how good these were. The portion size is just perfect, the tahini is absolutely delicious and the owner of the restaurant is super kind and welcoming. You might have to wait a while, as they only have a small kitchen and they really make an effort for every meal to taste as good as possible. But this food is definitely worth the wait. Highly recommended!!Show less

Author: MarryfermontMiddelburg, The Netherlands
Title: Homemade fresh food
Review: If you are traveling for a long time it’s nice to have a home cooked meal. That’s what you will have here. Rami and Maya put a lot of efford in making food on the spot fresh and tasteful. We loved the falafel and the atmosphere. We came back not only for the food, but also their company. This restaurant deserves your visit. Show less

Author: dicksonchongPenang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Came back to this restaurant and the food still taste fabolous !!
Review: I have just returned from my Middle Eastern travel, and was craving for some Arab dishes, alhamdurillah restaurant pop up my mind so I came back, the food taste the same as it was before, and the owner is so friendly as usual! Portion are big, and taste just like what I had in Syria. Recommend you to come !Show less

Author: 191sophiemDa Lat, Vietnam
Title: Excellent service, delicious food!
Review: We received excellent service throughout our meal. A little wait for the food as everything is cooked fresh but the owner was very honest and clear about how long things would take. The restaurant is clean and nicely decorated. Food was delicious and cooked perfectly. If we’re ever in Langkawi again, we’ll be back!Show less

Author: Mayakj98Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: A very good restaurant!, and the owner is friendly as well!. However, the service is slow but the food was fresh from the ovenShow less

Author: K2516AZmarcp
Title: Best Arabian food
Review: I ain’t go lie, the best shawarma in the country! 5 stars for that. The host is very friendly as well.

Author: Alba S
Title: Very nice restaurant
Review: The owners are really cheerful and friendly, they speak English and recommend some dishes for you. The food is really good and fresh. Very recommendable.

Author: deefaujourLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food! Veggie/Vegan Friendly!
Review: This place is absolutely amazing! A lovely family run restaurant and it is very veggie/vegan friendly. The hummus and falafel taste super authentic and exactly how it should taste! The owner is so so friendly and sweet! Would totally recommend a trip here! Thank You!Show less

Author: 943RhonaCLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Evening Meal
Review: The restaurant is very clean and tidy and the owner, who also is the waiter, is polite and friendly. All food is freshly prepared and therefore there is a waiting time from ordering until the food is served. The menu is limited and there are a few vegetarian and vegan options. The hummus, falafel, salad and chicken shawarma were tasty but felt the portion of vegetable rice lacked fragrance.However would recommend for an initial visit. Show less

Author: maykoll2019
Title: Delicious shawarma
Review:
Eat there with friend was warmly served and the food was delicious, saved to my favourite place.
The price is cheap and the quality was great.

Author: markwcliffordReading, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning
Review: Just got back from a meal at this wonderful place. We went because of the great reviews and were not disappointed. My wife and I shared these dishes- humus, falafel, fattoush and chicken shawarma.Lovely creamy humus with good simple flat bread. The falafel were, as my wife said, unusually flavoursome and nicely textured. The highlights however were the fattoush and the shawarma. To my shame Nicky wrestled the fattoush away from me with the words " I think you've had quite enough of that ". I'm not known as a salad person but this was exceptional. So what adjectives can we apply to the shawarma? It was, quite simply, the best I've ever tasted. No more words; just get yourself to this magical little restaurant in Kuah and prepare to be blown away.Show less

Author: Field_trip2010
Title: Best chicken shawarma!!
Review: The food is excellent! We are a family of four and we all greatly enjoyed our time there and can’t wait to go back again!!

Author: Carmen-c122594
Title: Food
Review: Excellent food especially the chicken shawarma! Will come again to try other dishes. Friendly host as well.

Author: Rosiepudandpie
Title: Highly recommend
Review: Don’t expect the fast food experience as all food here is cooked fresh (don’t worry, your tastebuds will thank you). An all round lovely experience provided by this heartwarming family run business!

Author: ChloeScarletAdelaide, Australia
Title: Amazing Syrian Food
Review: Food here was excellent. There is so much pride and care put into each meal. The service isn't super fast as it is a husband and wife team doing everything, but so worth the wait. We ordered based on the recommendations previously, chicken shawarma, hummus and fallafels. I think they might be the best fallafels I've ever eaten. I couldn't fault a thing. The cost is very reasonable, especially considering the food is so fresh and everything is prepared to order. Thank you for our lovely meal!Show less

Author: 274jasongKuah, Malaysia
Title: The best!
Review: Amazing food! Ramy and his wife have created a wonderful little restaurant that provides you with a simple but delicious meal every time! Ramy is also a wonderful host who’s very caring for his guests. The food is made on the spot so there’s little waste and it’s always as fresh as it can be. We highly recommend eating here during your visit to Langkawi! Show less

Author: kinchiepanKuah, Malaysia
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: We came back, one year after, and was an immense pleasure... see all the improvement, all the love and passion that you put in your place and in each plate... is not only the food that will make you go there again and again!Well done Ramy, we wish you all the best..Ps... I didn’t order the Falafel , mean that we have to come back... see you soon!!Show less

Author: Sarah ALondon, England, United Kingdom
Title: Most delicious meal in Langkawi
Review: My friends and I visited this small but welcoming restaurant for dinner at 8pm and were greeted by the friendly owner. We ordered hummus, falafel, syrian kebab and chicken shawarma to share and everything was absolutely delicious.We were amazed by the quality of the food, such that we haven't found anything that measures up in London, where we are from. The food was made with love and care by the owner's wife and we felt truly at home. The food was incredibly tasty, beyond anything else I've ever experienced.My friend who was born in the middle east has been taken back to warm memories of her childhood eating at this restaurant.Highly recommended, you can't miss it!Show less

Author: muysquetaireWinterthur, Switzerland
Title: Super Delicious
Review: Guys, this is THE PLACE to eat!The chicken shawarma isn’t from this world! It is soo good... we came the next evening again to eat it!Yummy yummy yummy!The Owner is such a lovely and interesting man. Everything is cooked by his wife and him. Give it a try - i highly recommend it!Maybe take a reservation if you want to be sure to have a place!Show less

Author: hameer266
Title: Amazing food
Review:
Best Chicken Shawarma by far!
We recommend ordering it, and trying their Arab tea.
Price is very reasonable.

Author: Adam0565Knivsta, Sweden
Title: ALLHAMDULILLA Restaurant
Review: This amazing Syrian restaurant serves delicious meals, that taste an look good! The owner is welcoming and kind, he told us about how he came to Malaysia and when he fled from Syria. His perspective of treating customers and running a business is amazing.You must try the Hummus and then the Chicken Shawarma, the chicken is marinated just right. Just Amazing! Then the chicken is wrapped in flat bread, you also get yoghurt and Arabic rice on the side!Best time to eat would be around 6 o'clock. If you want to eat later you need to reserve a table. I really recommend this restaurant because it has good food and wonderful people Show less

Author: V106BGTHCSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Must visit
Review: We had a really lovely evening at the restaurant, enjoyed the service and ambience.Other tips to arrive early are worth heeding, it gets full every night and they limit how many customers they serve to avoid compromising food or service. A genuinely lovely restaurant and also recommend the shisha - a bargain at 35myr. Show less

Author: jayin2016
Title: Must try!
Review: Love the chicken shawarma. Lamb is also delicious. Fattoush is super refreshing. Everything tastes so fresh. Very welcoming and interesting owner. One piece of advice: Better come early and order stuff beforehand or you will have to WAIT! Show less

Author: Chi EHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: A dive into the Syrian culture
Review: The best food I had in Langkawi! While Mimo cooks delicious Syrian food for you, Rami will share his story about his journey to Malaysia with the most genuine and humorous anecdotes. A unique dive into a culture and its food. Highly recommended! Go early (around 6pm) or make a reservation to ensure you don’t miss out on a memorable experience.Show less

Author: 87mirna
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: It is the best restaurant in langkawiThe food is delicious and the service is very good.I recomend to visit it Show less

Author: starlyc2018Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Good services
Review: This restaurant is an Arabic restaurant. The food is super duper delicious and the services is top notch.Show less

Author: 914alexanderlHamburg, Germany
Title: Eating at a friends place, feels like
Review: It really feels like the best restaurant in Langkawi, it’s traditional food and our host is a real host. I would recommend you to come here at least one time when you are here. Show less

Author: ReginaldEv
Title: Good Mediteranian Authentic Taste
Review: As expected from other reviews, the food taste was good and fresh. All the dishes here are cooked on order so can ensure best quality of ingredients and cooking.I ordered beef kebab, the meat was really good and fresh. Must try if you visit Langkawi and looking for a great food around Show less

Author: jaybob93
Title: Delicious Syrian Food prepared by welcoming people!
Review: Visited while on my trip to Langkawi. The host and his family are very kind and welcoming, the food was delicious. They take their time preparing the meal which guarantees their good quality food. Can really recommend going there!

Author: 35lu_sf
Title: The noble restaurant!!
Review: Family restaurant very cozy. Restaurant with a very fresh and tasty food. The owner is an incredible person both for his kindness and professionalism as well as his history and way of life. when the restaurant has a certain number of people it puts a warning in the door to wait a little because the quality is a decisive factor. does not want to turn space into something where money is the main point. very noble. Whenever I visit the island I will visit it again.Very taste and authentic fresh food managed by a incredible person.Thank you Show less

Author: y35813
Title: Awsome fatoush salad and more
Review: Highly recommended!!! Home cooking, great lamb steak. But we loved the fatoush salad and the Turkish coffee the best. Thank you for the wonderful service. Show less

Author: jveesung
Title: Heartwarming Meal!!!
Review: The meal was delicious, especially the rice! There is a bit of wait (30 mins) but it is understandable as it is managed only by a couple and their cute daughter. The beef we ordered was flavourful, juicy and bursting with fragrance! Everything had a heartwarming feel to it, like eating home cooked food. Truly a home away from home.Show less

Author: 915madss
Title: Really good food and service! The owner puts all of his passion in his restaurant
Review:
Top top service. The owner was very sweet from we arrived, and talked with us alot. The food was excellent, took a little bit of time, but it was well worth it. The dishes tasted so good and was really fresh.

- mr. Mahdi

Author: Capventure172
Title: Best food in langkawi
Review:
Amazing place run by a syrian couple. The food is amazing. You must go there for the best arab shawarmas and falafels. 
The decor is so homely! 
I loved it.

Author: Departure827435
Title: Awesome restaurant
Review: Came there to have a quick meal. The food was so great and afterwards we stayed very long and chatted with the owner. Very kind and wise men. We will definitely come back. This is a must do for everybody on langkawi. Show less

Author: haziqri
Title: Nice and good restaurant
Review:
The food is nice, the service is good and the workers are good too.
The restaurant is nice,near the jetty, easy to find, lots of accommodation
Clean environment

Author: paitep
Title: My trip
Review:

Author: alezzn
Title: Nice restaurant

Author: ameridris
Title: Great Food
Review: Very nice food. Very nice decor. very friendly and professional owner. All around a great experience.

Author: abdulsyafiqSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Taste of Arab Culture in Langkawi
Review: We ordered the Hummus, Chicken Shawarma and Coleslaw. The Chicken Shawarma is a must try. The owner, a Syrian, was so friendly, he shared with us his culture and made us feel like home. We recommend this place to anyone looking to learn about Syrian culture and also for those looking for authentic Arab food.Show less

Author: 524crazyhSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food
Review: The food was excellent. We had the Hummus, kabsa and swish. The tea was crazy good too. Spent abour rm75 for 2 pax which is pretty reasonable for the quality. Show less

Author: 173ziadz
Title: Alhamdulilah restaurant
Review: Cleanliness is one of the main ingredients of this restaurant....everything is perfect starting food with very delicious spices like a magic hand cooker....feel very comfortable in this restaurant...Definitely I will come back again and again to enjoy the food here....and one more thing really impressive me which is the owner of the restaurant really cares about customer and keep watching even small details...this is my favourite place start from today Show less

Author: daniv779The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Lovely place with lovely people and great food!
Review: Very clean place with awesome chicken shawarma. My husband and I both ordered the same dish and didn't regret it. We also felt very welcome with our two kids who had already eaten and we're playing in the restaurant, they even got some fries on the house. I also loved the decoration. It's minimal but you can see they've put love into the place, we would certainly recommend eating here!Show less

Author: Sunshine60462074788
Title: Wonderful Food
Review: Superb Taste...!!!Such as nice Atmosphere..Awesome day at that restaurant.!I'm really enjoyed the food!Show less

Author: 356S-1
Title: Delicious food
Review: We had falafel, hummus, beans (sorry can't remember what they're called) and french fries all to share. Food was really good and the owner was really friendly.

Author: Micky8hoyUK
Title: Fabulous
Review: Ate here last night and can’t fault it. You must visit. Hummus was as everyone else has said fantastic, as was the salad. Dressing vary more ish. Chicken (I can’t spell the work) was really tasty too. Place super clean and the owner very hospitable.If you are in Langkawi then visit and you won’t be disappointed.Show less

Author: Sannee_san
Title: Lovely dinners over here!
Review: I really loved this restaurant. The owner was very kind, generous! You can feel he loves his job. And the food was really delicious. You must go here when you’re in langkawi!Show less

Author: whale95Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food

Author: MathiasR1985Zurich, Switzerland

Review: We enjoyed our evening at the Alhamdulillah very much! The food was great and the owner, his wife and his daughter were very nice and helpfull!Thanks for a wonderfull meal!Show less

Author: R636QWfrankbLandau in der Pfalz, Germany
Title: Authentic
Review: We were looking for a place for dinner with two (picky) kids and found this lovely place. The host is super authentic, every meal is fresh cooked and we learned a lot about his hometown in Syria.They cook like they cook at home, so the meals are super authentic and super tasty.I especially recommend the Hummus and the Falaffel as a starter. You will hardly find a better Hummus outside the Middle East Show less

Author: johnwF5968RP
Title: Fantastic Food
Review: We were so glad to find this restaurant. The Syrian food was amazing, really helpful and hospitable host. This is a must if you are looking for something different to eat in Kuah. We will be visiting again before our holiday finishes.

Author: Camicastro89Santiago, Chile
Title: Perfect and affordable food
Review: We fell in love with this place, we have been here twice, and after both visits we finished completely delighted. This is a must if you are in LangkawiShow less

Author: johnjT7523FV
Title: Nice gem
Review:
In my opinion this restaurant has the best chicken shawarma and beef kebab i had ever.
Very Clean restaurant, friendly staff.
The price is the best.
Recommended

Author: Maxine Y
Title: 好特别！Authentic Middle Eastern Food
Review: 老闆很體貼。都只用新鲜的材料。正宗的中东餐。好吃！Authentic tasteful Middle Eastern Food! Highly recommended! Pay extreme attention to freshness of food! Will come back again!!

Author: Explorer39938174944
Title: Best kebab in the town
Review: This is the first time i try syria food. But this is the best kebab i ever taste. if you are coming to langkawi, MUST drop by and try the kebab.

Author: mikeg2015Baldivis, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: First time eating Syrian cuisine. This isn’t a fancy posh restaurant but what you will find is a husband and wife team cooking up fresh made to order home cooked food. The meals we had were delicious. Afterwards a lovely chat with our host who is very hospitable. This restaurant is well worth looking up if you are in Langkawi. Please note it is cash only.Show less

Author: onedanfitzall
Title: Stunning food and great service
Review: We decided to venture out from Pantai Cenang to Kuah based upon the TripAdvisor reviews for this restaurant. We were not disappointed, the food was excellent at a reasonable price and the host Rami was great company.Good luck for the future Rami and your family, great to meet you!Daniel & OliviaShow less

Author: sallyc369Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Place
Review: The restraunt is so clean and bright, and it has unique furniture which makes the place have a very good atmosphere. Rami (the owner) is so welcoming and kind, offering us seats and the wifi password as soon as we arrived.We ordered hummus to share and it was honestly the best hummus i have ever had, i would go back just to have some more!Then i had chicken shawarma which was cooked beautifully and tasted very fresh. We drove from Pantai Cenang area and it was so worth the visit. Definitely recommend anyone to go!!! The prices are good, food amazing and staff so friendly.Thank you for a lovely evening.Show less

Author: afroshopper
Title: Very good food!
Review: The owner is a very nice guy and the food was amazing! We would definitely recommend and will go back! Show less

Author: 3bdullah91
Title: Best Arabic / Middle Eastern food so far in Langkawi
Review: Personally i love food and try new staff , after checking trip advisor for best halal food in Langkawi i found this restaurant with very nice reviews we took bike from our hotel around 20 minuets far from Cenang , very basic restaurant but full with love & passion , liked the food we ordered shish tawook very nice & freshPs pic taken after I finished my meal :) Show less

Author: andyetc120Battambang, Cambodia
Title: Delicious and very friendly
Review: The food is delicious with the chicken Shawarma the stand out dish for me.Rami and his family are very welcoming and kind, and even shared some recipes with me.An absolute pleasure. Thank you!Show less

Author: Jsw2089West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: An absolute gem of a place!
Review: After reading the reviews online we decided to give this place a go, and we were so glad that we did! The food is incredible, by far the best that we’ve had in Malaysia. Not only this but the owner was so welcoming and it truly is a family affair with his wife doing the cooking. As for recommendations the humous is an absolute must (but then based on what we experinecd we can imagine that anything from the menu would be!). If you’re in Langkawi I cannot recommend this place enough (just make sure you bring cash as the owner is unable to accept card).Happy dining!Show less

Author: alexchandran84Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best shawerma in langkawi.
Review: Amazing food with a friendly owner who's extremely passionate about his food. We were on cenang and it was definitely worth the 45minute drive (one way). The lamb and rice dish was amazing can't remember what it was called. Humus was delicious, better than KL. Highly recommend the chicken shawerma! Crispy and crunchy on the outside, creamy goodness on the inside. My partner is from the Middle East and she loved it. Please visit! Show less

Author: jockbauerEDINBURGH
Title: Lovely family run restaurant.
Review: Great, authentic food at very reasonable prices. Family run restaurant, nice interior and friendly hosts! Will definitely go back! Excellent service and great coffee.Show less

Author: MustikaMohd
Title: Langkawi trip, 22/10/18
Review: We ordered the arabic rice with lamb, syrian kebab and beef steak and syukran, the food were delicious and fresh! A nice ambience and great hospitality indeed! Worth recommending! 👍🏻☺️

Author: Compass825378
Title: Great chicken shwarma
Review: Both the food and service were great. Came here twice during our trip because it was so good. Ordered the chicken shwarma and would recommend it.Show less

Author: yoanney2018Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service
Review: Excellent service ! Food as described . Cooked to perfection ! The owner was very polite , kind and friendly . Restaurant was clean. Overall I recommend this place to anyone who is looking to have a good Arab/ Syrian cusine ! I had the chicken shawarma , was actually the best one Iv ever had !Show less

Author: dheemaaminath
Title: Excellent place , delicious food
Review: The food was amazing (chicken shawarma) (beef kebab) the owner was very friendly and nice, the interior was super cute had a touch of the owners culture.

Author: chetan19Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, nice little famiky run restaurant
Review: Good food, friendly owner, nice little family run restaurant. Try the chicken shawarma, and hummus. Highly recommended... Show less

Author: BenedetoM1
Title: best arabic food
Review: best shawarma i ever tried, not too heavy, not too strong, perfectly made! very friendly ownerwil come backShow less

Author: Jimbo A
Title: Great food and relaxed atmosphere!
Review: Really enjoyed the home made meals making you feel at home! We took the humus, shawarma and the falafel was perfect!Show less

Author: Marie P
Title: Vegan Heaven
Review: We frequented this small, family-owned restaurant two days back to back as we enjoyed the food so much! Being vegan, we found a decent selection of tasty dishes here, we especially fell in love with the Fattoush, a local veg salad, Fouhl, a bean salad served warm as well as the tasty hommous and falafel. It was all freshly prepared and tasted absolutely delicious. I‘d recommend this place to anyone who‘s in the mood for traditional Syrian cuisine, especially to vegans and vegetarians (but the meaty dishes served to other guests smelled and looked fantastic as well). Prices were absolutely reasonable and we felt most welcome by the lovely owner and his sweet little family. Thank you for this experience, I hope to come back one day!Show less

Author: Kusashimaru
Title: Totally worth it!
Review: We saw it was first on tripadvisor so we said let's give it a try! It was over our expectations.The shawarma is the clear winner seconded by shish taouk.We were quite lucky to find it open since the owner, also the one who served the food and has been a pleasant host, told us that he will be on holiday for 9 days starting 26th of September until 6th of October.If I would ever visit Langkawi and the restaurant is still here I will definitely try it again!Show less

Author: Yara G
Title: Highly recommended
Review:
The food was soooo delicious!! We were about to eat another plate of the yummmmy chicken! You should definitely try their food, you won’t regret it :)
We would love to come back.

Author: EmmeCYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth the hype! Great food and service!
Review: Came across this place after searching through TripAdvisor and Google reviews: this was the most highly rated eatery!Do try:- shawarma- falafel- coffeeTheir good food and even better hospitality will make you go back for more!Show less

Author: LogarKatjaKranj, Slovenia

Author: 469elvinc
Title: Nice food and good service
Review: Chicken Swarma is a must try if you were to visit this restaurant. The owner is friendly and me and my mate totally enjoyed the meal.

Author: HamidahM79
Title: Good service
Review: The food n beverages are delicious n good presentation also. Very nice services n comfortable for families

Author: HadiOscar
Title: Nice Food And Good Presentation
Review: Nice food very delicious and very nice Presentation for the Food. The place is good. Owner was very friendly.

Author: Ronaldinho EPhuket, Thailand
Title: Best foul muddamas ever
Review: We came here after seeing a review that mentioned vegan options. We were pleasantly surprised by the amount of vegan food. The foul was honestly the best one we ever ate. The beans were cooked to perfection: not too soft and not too hard, just perfect. Hummus, falafel and fries were also very nice. Our hotel is quite far away but we will definitely try to come back here. It is minutes from the ferry port. The interior is nice as well, the owner made it with a friend using pallets in a very cool artistic way. Eco-friendly too! If this hasn't convinced you yet, then maybe the fact that you support a Syrian refugee family by eating here will. They put effort and love in their dishes :)Show less

Author: Moonchild444Sydney, Australia
Title: Incredibly tasty and flavoursome food
Review: This restaurant is a must visit; excellent, delicious and fragrant food served by a lovely Syrian husband and wife team. My partner and I ordered hummus, fattaosh, falafel, chicken shawarma and beef kebabs. The chicken shawarma was the standout favourite, but all dishes were delicious. We walked out full and happy!Show less

Author: Anish85London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food in Kuah
Review: Visited several times during our holiday. Freshly prepared food, nice decor and a very hospitable owner. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: Irshad Q
Title: Best food at reasonable prices, must visit
Review: Owner is a very nice person and food is really good. Shwarma is the best you will find in Langkawi. If you come to Langkawi, it should be on your to do list.

Author: yoannf535
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: I'm arrived just after he finished to install the A/C, so the place is fresh now ! The owner looks like he's really trying to improve his restaurant and he's a really nice guy.I ate shawarma chicken and it was delicious for a reasonnable price, would recommend.Show less

Author: bangzi
Title: nice little eatery for our kebab fix!
Review: came here late at night looking for a bite of kebab. and we found the right place. the owner was very friendly, the portion was generous, we were happy!

Author: Benjamin S
Title: Awesome place to eat!
Review: If you are looking for arabic food this is the perfect place to go! Really good food and friendly staff, we can really recommend it.

Author: LuluLemon83
Title: Nice Shawarma, plan to come back for rice!
Review: Went with my husband today. The owner mr rami is very friendly. We ordered chicken shawarma and the portion is enough for two person. Didn’t eat there but take away. Plan to come back

Author: LindyD90
Title: Fabulous food!!’
Review: The owner is very friendly and explains all of the options on the menu (as we are westerners). The food is amazing and so tasty! I would  highly recommend eating here with very reasonable prices. Oh and little Sophia (owners daughter ) is absolutely gorgeous😀😀😀

Author: dalep950
Title: Nice Veggie Options :)
Review: We checked this place out after reading all of the positive reviews. We're both vegetarians so it was nice to be catered for. We had a falafel and hummus meal and everything was delicious. Warm and welcoming host, highly recommended. :)

Author: dr7mdaDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Best Levantine Food in Malaysia!
Review: I visited with a few friends. We had a very delicious meal. It seems like a small family business. The location is near the Kuah Ferry Port in Langkawi.Definitely worth the visit.The chicken and fish is fresh and delicious.Prices are affordable.Spacious seating inside and a few tables outside. We sat outside for the cool breeze.Modestly but tastefully decorated.Wifi is free.Toilet and hand washing basin available.There is a beach with the most magnificent sunset at a 5 minutes walking distance if you wish to take your food and have it there.Show less

Author: chrisgC5364HJQueanbeyan, Australia
Title: Delicious food and friendly family
Review: We had a great dinner here which was made nicer by the warm and welcoming owner/waiter. He gave us tips about the food and was very friendly. It was a nice touch at the end when he told us his wife was cooking out the back and his daughter was also there. Highly recommend!! Show less

Author: PerkyBoingo
Title: Great food
Review: Host was very warm and welcoming. He explained all of the vegetarian sections of the menu to us which was appreciated. Food was very fresh. The foul was my favourite and the falafel was also delicious. Recommended.

Author: fabandnat
Title: Great middle eastern food, nice family
Review:
The chicken shawarma was delicious and the friendly owner discretely shared with us some of his syrian refugee adventure making the evening even more special. The entire family will always remember the meaning of Alhamdulilah
A very nice evening

Author: tayebakh
Title: Amazing food
Review: My husband and I checked the restaurant out after reading loads of reviews. We drove an hour to visit this place. And we were not disappointed. The food was absolutely delicious. The owner was genuine and a great host who is passionate about his food. We would strongly recommend the chicken shawarma. The best we have tried by far. Would come again in a heartbeat. Show less

Author: Judith S
Title: Very welcoming host & Nice food
Review: Great place to have dinner with friends or family. Nice food and very interesting stories. Very welcoming host. We had falaffel, grilled fish and chicken shoarma, all very good.

Author: Todd HAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Great middle eastern food
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed the middle eastern at Ramy’s restaurant. We had the chickpeas, foul mudammas, fattoush and falafel. All of the food we had was prepared fresh, vegan and simply delicious. Incredible flavours and the service was outstanding. We would highly recommend to others looking for a change from the local cuisine.Show less

Author: SolK100Seoul, South Korea
Title: Very friendly owner
Review: Very nice owner it takes some time to get the food. grilled lamb was yummy and garnish itself nice too. 한국입맛에는 생선은 민물생선 향이 나는 편이라 호불호가 있을 수도있고 양고기는 괜찮았고 소고기는 한국에서 드세요! 1위 잘모르겠어요..Show less

Author: P458MKtimr
Title: Lovely people and lovely foof
Review: Nice simple place a little out of the way. Well worth the 5* rating. Lovely people who made us very welcome and served really good food at very reasonable prices.

Author: Elreev83
Title: Great food for the whole family!
Review: A lovely family that serves excellent food! Everything is made fresh. The best chicken shawarma we have ever tasted 😉 the kids loved the food too. We would definitly come again.

Author: Razika A
Title: The best Arabic food in Langkawi made by a lovely family with the best price
Review: Tasty, fresh and very delicious food made by a lovely family with the best price.. A must try in Kuah!!

Author: AminA1542
Title: Nice and halal food
Review: Very nice food and delicious.the restaurant is very beautiful and comfort.the husband very friendly.

Author: namnami
Title: Excellent middle eastern food at a correct price
Review:
Nice place that serves excellent middle eastern food! We had the hummus, falafels and some minced meat, everything was very tasty. Highly recommend the local iced tea - home made, healthy and delicious.
The owner was very friendly!

Author: FarAway394867
Title: Very friendly owner and delicious cuisine
Review: Very friendly owner and the food we order were so nice. The chicken kebab was the top of my favorite. The sauce was so match to all ingredients.

Author: AndreaP9420
Title: Lovely food and friendly service
Review: Great husband and wife team running this place. We waited a little while for our food but we were told upfront it was just the two of them running the restaurant and it could take 30+mins to arrive which we were ok with.Food was fresh with lovely flavors and a perfect portion size. Definitely recommend this place!Show less

Author: LeonieWuUtrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Great food and really nice owner
Review: We went to this restaurant on a late Saturday evening. We didn't have anymore cash, so the owner kindly directed us to an ATM. After getting back we indulged on some of the best food we had in all of Malaysia, and we have had a lot in our travels. The rich fattoush and the flavorsome chicken shawarma were something different, in the most positive sense of the word. Lots of love to the owners and their beautiful daughter. Show less

Author: hym4u2
Title: Very nice evening
Review:
I was there with my wife for our last day of honeymoon. We were looking for tasty Arabic food
Excellent food. Great hospitality 
The place is comfort with nice music
Highly recommended

Author: Nabs103London, United Kingdom
Title: A must for good wholesome Syrian food 👍
Review: Don’t be fooled by the simple interior , this is a friendly restaurant run by a husband and wife team with fresh and tasty food . We were recommended the shawarmas and true to form they were superb. In fact they were one of the best shawarmas we have tasted . Actually we tried 3 different dishes and they were all great . The owner took time to talk to us and The free WiFi was a bonus .Show less

Author: yasir m
Title: Great food in Langkawi
Review: Nice cosy environment..☺️tasty food😋..very welcoming host.. 😄😋  chicken shwarma and shish tawook were the best!!

Author: j0rdan232323Kaohsiung, Taiwan
Title: Really good fresh meal!
Review: The meal was very delicious, fresh, and clean. We had the lamb, fish, and a side of hummus. It was all flavorful! Show less

Author: SometimesBackPackerKuala Lumpur
Title: Syrian food that feels like someone’s mum cooked it!
Review: We were a very hungry party of 8 who arrived at the restaurant at 7.30. Place was empty but owner was just cleaning up 2 tables so we thought this should be ok. Unfortunately, was told (very aplogetically) that we will have to wait. Ended up waiting an hour but that meant my children could sleep even more. Ordered the chicken kasbah, grilled fish, chicken shawarma and hummus. Everything was super flavourful but my favourite was the sea bass. Fresh, delicate and yummy! Later, we found out the team was just the wife and husband so that explained the delay. But perhaps a simple suggestion: have the drinks fridge in front and let us self-service. We were parched but the drinks only arrived when food was served. As a token of their apology for the wait, they offered us Syrian coffee. That was awesome as it was a first try for me and I liked the twist of some spice in it. I will certainly return on my next trip.Show less

Author: JosephP3031
Title: Excellent meal, friendly owner
Review: We ate here on our last day in Langkawi, and are sad that our plane leaves before they open again. We had fattoush, hummus, Syrian kebab, kabsa rice with chicken, and the best chicken shawarma we ever had. Every thing was delicious but the shawarma really stood out. The owner was friendly, helpful and happy to explain all about the food. We came with a picky eater, and even he was fond of the bread, hummus and kebab.Show less

Author: Jason43v3r
Title: Very friendly owner and nice food from Middle East
Review: The food is very nice and amazing, first time I try this kind of food. Will come here again next time!

Author: Mahmoud MCairo, Egypt
Title: Awesome
Review: I liked the food and hosting very much , must visit ... it’s a family business, when you go there you feel like you visited your friends in their house , price is also a pro .Show less

Author: dickson c
Title: Feel just like Syria
Review: I’ve been to Syria a couple of times, words can describe how much I love this country. After coming back I’ve been trying so hard to find something that would remind me of it, or at least the feel and emotion. This is it, this restaurant I’ll assure you that authentic taste of Syrian cuisine. Friendly atmosphere with Arabic song in the air, and perfect food ! So good that I almost cried. Thanks to the family now I can call my friends ! Everyone please pay a visit if you can! You’ll not regret your choice ! WallahiShow less

Author: NSchmitty1Australia
Title: Great food and hospitality!
Review: We came here to eat for a casual family dinner and loved it. The food was delicious with generous servings at a reasonable price. The ambience was cosy and clean and the owner was very hospitable and friendly. If you love Arabic food or want to give it a try then this is the place to go!Show less

Author: shubhangi s
Title: Good food in great ambience
Review: I ordered fish fry and chicken Kansas rice. It was very good. Owner has been quite attentive. I would recommend this place to travelers for relaxed meal.

Author: mitchhermans
Title: Excellent food and great service
Review: The food was amazing! Also the service and hospitality. Everyone should pay a visit here :) we are dutch and we loved it!

Author: lillymarleneee
Title: Very delicious and a nice owner!!
Review: In our first evening on langkawi we went to alhamdulillah and we are so satisfied! The food was delicious (especially the falafel) and the owner was so nice! He even gave us the recipe for the falafel and tipps how to make them proper. We will defintly come back again in the next days and i would recommend it to anyone to do the same!Show less

Author: moeyh007Auburn, Australia
Title: Finally some great arabic food in Langkawi
Review: It was great to finally have some Arabic food that actually taste like Lebanese, especially after 3 weeks of traveling around Malaysia and Bali. My wife is loving life after this meal. She finally got her falafel hit. The food and service was excellent.It was worth the 35 minute ride here on the scooter.The owner Rami and his wife are doing a great job here in LangkawiShow less

Author: iMax89Cologne, Germany
Title: Good Food, music and stylish interior
Review: I went to Alhamdulillah with my girlfriend - it was a 35 Minute scooter ride but we were carving falafel and shawarma.As we entered the very friendly owner approached us and we were seated. We ordered falafel, hummus, and chicken shawarma.The food was simply delicious! See picture attached. We entered the “clean plate club” :-) Especially the garlic dip is amazing! Also, the owner told me his recipe :)The interior design is modern and the place is clean.Also, there is background Music in the typical style which works really well with the overall Ambiente of the restaurant.In car you’re looking for honest and proper Syrian food, definitely go here. Our 35 minute ride (one way!) was totally worth it! Show less

Author: AlbertS2633
Title: Fantastic food and hospitality
Review: We drove more than 30 minutes from Pantai Tengah for our first ever meal in Langkawi. It was also our first ever Arabic meal. The friendly owner made recommendation. My children loved the Shish Tawook so much they reckon it was the best meal they have had in Malaysia. I had beef with Arabic rice. The rice was flavourful. The beef , according to the owner is from NZ where we reside. Recommended by the owner, I am sipping a cup of Turkish coffee after a fantastic meal. What an enjoyable experience.Show less

Author: SangwanS6
Title: The best in the island
Review: This is the best arabic food in the island.We had chicken shawarma, kebab, and kabsa rice.Every thing was perfect, the flaver was amaizing and the price was so nice.This syrian restaurant is a must in Langkawi.Since I was so happy with food and service, I submit this comment in spot Show less

Author: tsun006Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Very caring host
Review: The owner is a lovely chap although I must say our food didn’t quite live up to the massive reviews on TA - It was fine but not excellent. The restaurant lacked atmosphere, it needs a little music going and some art or photos etc. However a friendly owner who is trying his best and a nice clean and tidy place. Worth a visit, perhaps we didn’t order the right things so happy to give them the benefit of the doubt. Show less

Author: Ashraf A
Title: good Syrian food
Review: I was here today with my family, we ordered grill fish, hummus and frerensh fries.all was so good, fresh and tastey.it take so time, but I am good.this restaurant is a must in Langkawi.Show less

Author: FariahA3
Title: Great place
Review: Great food, must visit whilst in langkawi. Simple, nice food- can’t go wrong really. Recommend the shish tawook. Very good service & restaurant also has wifi 👍🏽👍🏽

Author: saadjaf
Title: Great food!
Review:
Yummy!! Had an excellent meal! The shawarma & kebabs were so flavourful and the rest of the food, including the roti, made fresh on the spot was really good too. 
A beautiful Syrian restaurant with great service!!

Author: geo_matt_87
Title: Delicious food and wonderful hosts
Review: The food was so delicious and the owners are wonderful. Thank you so much for your extraordinary hospitality tonight. Steffi & Matt

Author: Eric T
Title: I was skeptical but I was wrong.
Review: Maybe due to the raya period, the place was literally empty. 8 of us went in and the boss told us the food will take a longer time as they were shortage of staff. We took the bet and boy I was surprised. The food didn't disappoint at all. A must try dishes are the Grilled Fish and Fattoush! Their sheesha was good too! Good for big groups! Kudos!Show less

Author: x-masia
Title: Great Restaurant!
Review: Really love the food here, restaurant is owned by a lovely family. I really liked it! And if you want to make your night complete you can also order a Shisha, just sit and relax.

Author: flyalot73Melbourne, Australia
Title: Syrian gem
Review: Finding a quality meal in Langkawi is surprisingly difficult, so we were thankful to stumble upon this place. All dishes were made fresh and well worth the wait. Prices are reasonable and the owner and his family are delightful. We will be back again before we return to our Australian winter.Show less

Author: KatKojouriBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, lovely find!
Review: My partner and I found this gem of a restaurant on tripadvisor, the reviews are all true! Excellent food, run by a lovely family. Portion sizes are decent and everything is clearly made fresh. Prices are reasonable too. Thank you for a great experience :)If you are visiting the eagle landmark, I would definitely choose to stop here for food! Best wishes, Kat and Luke (age 27, from England) ps. The best hummus we have ever tasted, and we love our hummus!!!Show less

Author: usepointsAustralia
Title: Great meal at this little gem.
Review: decided to check out this hotel as we wanted something different.the service and attitude of this little restaurant was wonderful the food delicious and very affordable.another couple that arrived were instantly recognised as having been there the night before.definitely on the list if staying near this restaurant.Show less

Author: alinareichowLahr, Germany
Title: Great syrian food and lovely family!
Review: We had some syrian Kebab, hummus, a coleslaw salad and some syrian chicken with the greatest garlic sauce! All meals were just really delicious and the flavour was awesome as well. Later in the evening we also tried some shisha together with the family and this was so amazing! Show less

Author: Kitkat071Canning Vale, Australia
Title: Lovely meal
Review: A few of us went here for dinner tonight. This lovely restaurant had ten or so tables in its restaurant. We arrived and were seated and the owner gave us the password for the wifi. Nothing here is pre prepared and all food is from the freshest ingredients. We had the hommus to start with and it was one of the nicest hommus I have had. I then had lamb and rice which was so moist and tasty. Definately reccomend here for a meal. Very reasonably priced Show less

Author: Julita J
Title: Cozy clean excellent restaurant
Review: The first place we visited in Langkawi was this restaurant. That time we went there were no people. Actually we are not used to go if there are no people inside but this time in may is different because of Ramadan. A lot of empty places. So we desided to choose that restaurant even it was empty.The place is really cosy, clean, nice decorated and smells really nice with natural wood. The hummus was the best in my life. Even my husband liked it a lot (usually he doesn't like humuss), french fries with some strange garlic source was fantastic! The lamp as well was really good.Service is just perfect. Even the owner of the restaurant helped us with our journey. He gave us a lot of advises and pointed out good places to visit. He is really nice and outgoing person.You should visit this guy to say hi and try his wife's dishes. This family make effort and put their all hearts to this restaurant.Prices are reasonable and sisa (local smoke) was good!Thanks to this family to make our evening special and thanks for your story and sincerity!:) Best wishes and good luck with your business! You really worth for each star! Million stars to your restaurant!Show less

Author: jamiel976Washington DC, District of Columbia

Review: Can't recommend this restaurant enough. I've had plenty of Arabic cuisine but this place tops it. Some of the best I've ever had. They make the food as though it were for themselves, tastes homemade. Portions are generous, quality terrific. It's worth the wait! The ambience of the restaurant is amazing too. Run by a friendly family, they are more than willing to sit down and talk, share a tea or coffee, and have a good time.If you're feeling adventurous just ask Rami for his recommendation for your meal. He will ensure you or your group get enough food and you will not be disappointed... Charcoal roasted chicken with fattoush, hummus, and Arabic bread is one of the best meals I've had in awhile. We enjoyed the lunch so much that we went for dinner again the next day at their main outlet at Pantai Tengah which was about 6 mins drive from our Pelangi hotel at Pantai Cenang. These time we tried glass noodle seafood and jjajangmyeon. Both were super delicious. Isabella made complimentary drinks for us - soju mixed with promagranate and sparkling juice which was amazingly good. She also offered complimentary ice cream mixed with her favourite snacks which tasted so good too. The ambience here was so nice at night. There were indoor and outdoor seating, and a high chair counter which was very nice place to hang out for drinks. Tomorrow we are going back to the Kuah branch to have another round of their other korean food for lunch before we leave Langkawi.Show less

Author: MowgliSingh
Title: A Delightful Experience with amazing service
Review: A delightful experience with amazing food and super kind service. I was given personal attention and recommended dishes which really hit the spot! Will definitely come again and bring my friends, Haroo Haroo is a must go! Thank you so much for the kindness and yummy hearty food :DP.S. While i was writing this review i was given a complementary ice cream. Fantastic!Show less

Author: Zuraida MKuala Lumpur
Title: Excellent Korean food and service
Review: We came to Haroo twice, because we found the food delicious, and the service and waiting staff excellent.The gracious owner Bella goes out of her way to provide us complimentary dishes to sample.We had the Tukbaegi Bulgogi, Sundubu Jji-Gae, amongst others. Portions are generous.Haroo will be our regular dining place when we come to Langkawi. There is also a branch in Kuah. If only they had a branch in KL!One of the best Korean restaurants in Malaysia.Show less

Author: allattk
Title: Wonderful Korean food and great staff
Review: This restaurant serves delicious Korean food with a wide variety. Highly recommend. The staff are attentive and helpful too.

Author: EWayC
Title: Great Restaurant with lovely crew
Review: The food is great, i can taste the genuine homecooked style food here. The service crew is excellent, and they make sure everything is well taken care of. The owner is super friendly and nice.

Author: m0viesl
Title: Korea food
Review: Excellent taste for the food. They even provide options for vegetarian.. Most important was the servise provided. I was impressed and grateful for the kind servise... Definitely recommend for all to try..

Author: GaryS0609
Title: Good food great service
Review:
Went there on weekday night and the restaurant is so quite. Food was delicious staff are friendly. 

Order a grill platter and they allow me to refill the wrapping lettuce for free. Also complementary side dish and ice cream. That a plus.

Author: Daisy22dooNerja, Spain
Title: Big portions and lovely people
Review: Loved our meal here. The chef came and helped us with our order and was so friendly. Big portion's so glad we asked for advice. The extras they give are lovely and refilled. We were stuffed by the end and then give ice cream that was delicious. We will definitely return soon. Show less

Author: Der_Macher68Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service and value for money
Review: Haroo Haroo is a good choice once you are in Langkwai, especially the traditional Korean food is pretty good and service is absolutely excellent.Staff is attentive and kindYou will get several complimentary small bites including a refreshing ice cream, together with your meal and the end the bill is absolutely honest.Show less

Author: Dornehl
Title: Great food
Review: Great food, especially the traditional dishes like the bulgogi and bibimbap. Pancakes and extra condiments also amazing. Service was really exceptional with complimentary sides given - very attentive staff. Soju and beer available. Would def recommend to anyone looking for extraordinary food.

Author: htungl
Title: Best Korea Restaurant across Malaysia!
Review: I'd say this is one of the best Korea Restaurant I ever tried. The foods are amazing, not to mention the politeness and the good service from the owner of the restaurant. Really recommend this place and will 1000% come on my next trip!

Author: Zhlee4
Title: Good service and food really authentic!
Review: The food are so authentic and taste REALLY GOOD!!! This is the first time I write a review for a restaurant. Just because the food and services are too good! Visited here twice during my short trip in Langkawi ☺️

Author: NorthStar755948Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best service
Review: The food was delicious but by far the service was amazing! We got a platter of free testers which we could refill. And ice cream. We even got some Korean drinks to try. The owner running the place was super friendly and we had a nice conversation with her. I would definitely recommend this restaurant! Thank you very much.Show less

Author: Atty142427
Title: So good and delicious
Review: This meal was very delicious!!!!!!! The staff were very friendly and the owner very kind. The food tasted very good and the atmosphere is nice.

Author: EdinburghSmileredinburgh
Title: So good we ate there twice!
Review: We had read so many good things about this restaurant we hoped it would live up to the hype and it certainly did! The service was fantastic and the manager was brilliant, making sure everyone was ok, making suggestions and recommendations and he was very entertaining! The food was delicious, so much to choose from and was such good value! The complimentary little starters and dessert were great! We came here twice as the food was so good and the portion size perfect. We thoroughly recommend this restaurant for great food, friendly staff and amazing value for money!Show less

Author: Departure552842
Title: Thank you for having us!
Review: Thank you for having us. We where the family from the Netherlands. The food was realy tasty, we recommend this restaurant for the food but also for the hospitallity. You feel realy welkom!!

Author: I7323UMjefff
Title: Good food
Review: Excellent menu and nice staff-very friendly. Can’t remember what we had, but i do remember it was very good.

Author: vintagepotatoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Please come to Singapore!!
Review: Food was superb, presentation was good and the meal was well worth the money. Ordered chicken bokeum and dubu kimchi, portions were just right and its the best food we've had at langkawi thus far. Location was pretty near to our hotel (RWL), ambience was good. Customer service was great, the staff were really on the ball and took the effort to make customers feel welcomed by striking conversations :) Plus point: we got to learn many interesting funfacts as well, so thats great! Show less

Author: vic_grc
Title: Delish & Rustic home cooking...Beware Cash payments only.
Review: They only use machine filtered water for all their cooking n iced water. Dumplings, Chicken Bulgogi, Pajeon and Squid Bokeum are to die for. Money well spent.

Author: seasonangelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food, friendly staff
Review: The best spicy chicken bbq (dakgalbi) and seafood japchae I had ever tasted in Malaysia. Really had satisfied my craving for Korean spicy food. They can adjust the spicy level upon request. The owner recommended their house special yuzu (citron) soju and it was delicious. Our meal was complimented with ice-cream. The staff were friendly and efficient in serving. Would definitely come back to try their other menu.Show less

Author: Rusty174Kent, United Kingdom
Title: Totally Overrated!!
Review: I have read all the glowing reviews and after experiencing the place I would say that this restaurant is highly overrated as I had a bowl of “seafood noodles” with 2 prawns and a few shellfish with non existent contents and my wife had essentially a basic goreng total price 120myr with a couple of alcoholic drinks.Totally overrated much better to go to the smaller restaurants where the food is less than half the price with actual meat/seafood/vegetables content etc for my money.Left this place hungry! Will never go back.Show less

Author: ronjomanrLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Awesome service
Review: Went here twice in the 5 days I stayed in Langkawi. Went first because of the reviews on here and it was spot on. Service is the best by far of any restaurant i went to and the food is awesome and fresh. Staff very helpful in choosing food you like. Free ice cream at the end too! Highly recommend Show less

Author: W9853NLmikel
Title: Excellent
Review:
Good cocktails, excellent food, and magnificent service. 

THIS IS A MUST TRY 

100 signs needed, so bye

Author: kirsi_nessu
Title: Stunning food.
Review: Stunning food. I am happy for recommended dishes and awesome service. Spices were adjusted based on our liking and it was a spot on!

Author: trilochansainiRiyadh Province, Saudi Arabia
Title: Dinner @ Haroo
Review: Excellent taste of the food. The waiter Umesh is a star. He knew exactly what we would like and offered the same. Complementary starter, excellent food, good ambiance, helpful staff, a complementary ice cream as desert and shots of a fruit paunch on the top of everything. The Korean owner was very sweet about everything.Show less

Author: Bryan Redstone ... C
Title: Not to my taste.
Review: Not to my taste.  Thin, greasy & tasteless. Supposed to have soy sauce but, if there was any, you couldn't taste it.

Author: AlyonaAlun
Title: Best service and food in this area
Review: We are regular customers of both Haroo in Pantai Tengah and Haroo in Kuah town at Langkawi Fair mall. High quality of the food, amazing choice and service.  I’d definitely recommend for a visit to those who is fussy about the places where they eat

Author: WusserladDerby, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous Restaurant!
Review: So having read the reviews we caught a Grab to this restaurant and from the first minute the place was delightful.The Host was so welcoming and helpful, we told him we had never been to a Korean restaurant before and he patiently talked us through the menu - he even advised us when we had ordered to much! They serve alcohol as well.The food was wonderful, only matched by the service and atmosphere! All at a reasonable price too.Great job.Give it a try.You will not be disappointed!Show less

Author: IrinaJuha
Title: Excellent Korean food and fun experience!
Review: During our four nights in Pantai Cenang, we visited two night in this lovely Korean restaurant. We were not the only ones coming back... The owner made as laugh multiple times and the service overall was supergood! Ice cream as a dessert was complimentary, which I enjoy a lot ;) On the second night we ordered Korean BBQ, where the food was made in our table. Great experience and very tasty food!Show less

Author: Louise L
Title: Best Korean food!!
Review: This was the most wonderful food, served by the most attentive owner and his staff. A definitive must visit when in Langkawi. Be aware they only take cash, but don't let that put you off. Definitely going back again!

Author: crisic2016
Title: Amazing experience
Review: The service has been incredible and the food amazing, we highly recommend to follow their advise for the order

Author: randhusseinAmman, Jordan
Title: HOLY DAMN
Review: This place was unreal! I read reviews thought people were being dramatic, but this was soooo good, I really loved this place we had this salad as main dish it was unreal. the chef was so kind she came around and gave us ice cream after and kept checking on our food. the old waiter gives you great recommendations for food honestly just greatShow less

Author: Taroko28
Title: Fabulous
Review: Went to this restaurant during the CNY and we were definitely not disappointed. Food was delicious and came in big portion!

Author: hauklOslo, Norway
Title: Serving all kinds of Korean
Review: Serving all kinds of Korean dishes, and each one just wonderful. Meals are prepared by the proprietress, and carry that homemade feeling whilst being presented delicately.The head waiter/maitre makes sure the level of service is better than most restaurants, and happily gives advice on anything. Give it a try! Cash only.Show less

Author: Tony B
Title: Great Meal
Review: Quality Korean restaurant with efficient service and tasty food. Not the cheapest place in town but well worth the cost.

Author: SunSunSunshine
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Really excellent place. It has rather large portions! The prices are quite reasonable and it serves alcohol.

Author: 39trevorl
Title: Love it
Review: I come to this place quite often. the service is great, the food is excellent and has a good variety and a good choice of healthy eating. Its a great place to come with a group of friends or as a romantic couple. It is definitely a place you have to try while in LangkawiShow less

Author: Noel K
Title: Excellent!
Review: World class service. I have some allergies and they modified and made sure that the food doesnt have any of those ingredients in there. And the food was excellent!

Author: boxy64Brighton, Australia
Title: Good Food, Just one Haroo
Review: Ok restaurant with good food. We thought his was different to the Haroo Chain because of the name repeat - but it is not. The setting is not pleasant and really don’t like to be tricked. If you like Korean it is probably good for you.Show less

Author: 656nadinel
Title: Stunning high quality food
Review: Stunning high quality food, very friendly people work there, we had a great dining experience and will definitely come back

Author: O7603SItonyl
Title: Great Korean food at a great price
Review: We had a fantastic meal here, the service is quick and very friendly and all of that at a fair price.

Author: Bondy2204Southwater, United Kingdom
Title: What a great place.
Review: My wife and I, having never tried Korean food before, decided to try this based on other reviews. What a pleasure, the staff are so friendly and informative even advising when we might be over ordering. The food was delicious too!We loved it so much that we went back 3 days later to try some of the other items on the menu. Can’t recommend it enough, well worth a visit if you get the chance.Show less

Author: IstoP5Jarvenpaa, Finland
Title: Best food and service experience in Malaysia
Review: Went for a last night dinner whilst in Langkawi and must say it was the best food experience during the whole trip in Malaysia. Not even the fine dine restaurants in Kuala Lumpur could beat it. They stick with the three main pilars of a good dinner.1. Excellent service2. Excellent food3. Did I mention about the excellent service?We had at least 4 different persons from time to time visiting our table and it just kept going better! Great stories, great expertise and the friendliness! Did I mention about that? Dinner was a mix of fried dumplings, hot fried squid and beef platter served with a "lettuce tortillas", complimented with a coffee/chocolate ice cream. And even a taxi order with a bargain price!Whilst in Langkawi, go there or be square.Show less

Author: eatdrinkstayBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Superb
Review: We were made to feel so welcome here it’s a fantastic place. A few restaurants in a row this place stands out as so busy. The waiter kindly explained the menu and we had a very enjoyable meal. Plenty to eat and great choice of drinks and reasonable priced wine. Definitely will go again before leaving .Show less

Author: 470pauliusrVilnius, Lithuania
Title: One of a few places in Langkawi, where you want to return, as you feel welcomed like at your best friend’s place.
Review: The only place in Langkawi, where we have eaten a meal more than once. Bibimbap was great, fried squid was melting in the mouth as well. Servers there are enjoying their work, as we got recommendations for meals there (and not necessarily for the most expensive ones), lots of tips, what to do in an island, various sincere and not primitive jokes and so much more. Enjoy it there!Show less

Author: llashanMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must to visit
Review: I can easily get authentic Korean food at cheaper prices back where I'm from, but we seem to eat here every time we are in Langkawi. I'm pretty sure we always go back because of the great service:DGreat food, very tasty and very generous portions. Order less than you think you'll need! The service staff are very helpful, recommending dishes made in-store over some of their mass-produced offerings to cater to people used to those, explaining dishes if needed. They routinely check if our drinks and side dishes are topped up, offered us complementary ice cream and generally ensuring everyone was happy.The owner herself was very friendly and personally brought everyone at the restaurant a free drink to try and top up our side dishes.Definitely eating here again (and again) if we go back to Langkawi.Show less

Author: LindsayTravelGirlMontana
Title: Great customer service
Review: I see why this place has such great reviews. The staff is super friendly and accommodating. As a vegan and husband as vegetarian, we really enjoy the menu options. I'd return for sure! Loved the extra dishes that they brought to the table. A great extra touch!Show less

Author: trilochansainiRiyadh Province, Saudi Arabia
Title: Visit to Malaysia
Review: Excellent dining experience. One of its kind. Didn't enjoy any meal more than here. Waiter, Umesh knew what we were looking to eat and gave the exact advise on selection and quantity. The food tasted excellent. The start was with complementary starter, end was with a complementary ice-cream. In addition we got complementary shots of delicious fruit juice. Food was excellent and the complimentary part was the iced topping.Show less

Author: adam oWaterford, Ireland
Title: Excellent
Review: Who ever gives this restaurant a bad review was just having a bad day in general!!The Malaysian manager was just a breathe of fresh air, knowledge of the menu was second to none, recommendations on food and portions we're spot on. Attention to detail on service and quality of food in a country famous for cuisine/dining was outstanding. Ate here the first night and glad we did have us not only a great first experience but local knowledge to help us carve out our next four days. Highly recommend Salad, chili beef and chicken dumplings washed down with Korean beers  Bon Appetite.....Show less

Author: Raziraziiii
Title: a nice dining experience
Review: The service was good. the waiters are attentive and helpful. The food was delicious and the price was reasonable. I will definitely go again.

Author: yassinebeqqali
Title: Very good
Review: Amazing food and great service. Chef had a talk with us and explained the dishes very well. Got ice cream for free and very good service. The dishes were amazing. Thank you!

Author: jussi93
Title: The food was extremely good
Review: The food was extremely good and the service was even better! Great tastes and easygoing atmosphere had us coming there for second time. Prices are very reasonable

Author: L394EEmonicaa
Title: Culinary highlight in Langkawi
Review: Excellent experience, the food was amazing...and we did try quite a few dishes...and the service was one of the best we ever had: funny, informative and a great combination of polite and cheeky- in an adorable way.

Author: Cpedley09
Title: Fantastic service - glass
Review:
Fantastic service - glass never empty and nothing too much trouble 
Fantastic tasting food at great prices
Would definitely recommend

Author: Carmen C
Title: Best service in Langkawi
Review: We had lunch and the restaurant manager gave us very nice recommendations and detailed explanations of the menu and the Korean food. The food was delicious and the service excellent. I do recommend this place.

Author: grisa300
Title: Really good food!
Review: Food was delicious!! There was very nice weithress who told us the best foods in the menu and took really good care of us! Really tasty food! I recommend!

Author: MACa_05Seoul, South Korea
Title: Best Restaurant in Sout east asia (한번도 경험하지 못한 한식당)
Review: There are not enough stars here. I want to give 1.8 million stars. We came into this restaurant by accident on a trip to Langkawi. This restaurant provides water for free. The moment I tasted the food, I thought of the table in mainland Korea. Kimchi stew, soybean paste stew, pajeon, and beef stir-fry are all more than perfect and are admired. It's a Korean food that you won't even taste in Seoul. You have to go. It's the best restaurant in Langkawi.여기는 별5개도 부족합니다. 별 180만개 주고싶습니다. 저희는 랑카위를 여행하다가 우연히 이 식당에 들어왔습니다. 이 식당은 물을 무료로 제공합니다. 음식을 맛본순간 한국 본토의 식탁이 생각났습니다. 김치찌개, 된장찌개, 파전, 소고기 볶음 모두 완벽을 넘어서 감탄이 나오는 수준입니다. 서울에서도 맛보지 못할 한식입니다. 꼭 가보셔야합니다. 랑카위 최고의 맛집입니다.Show less

Author: Kibbles8Scarborough, Australia
Title: Fantastic!
Review: All aspects were very good at this place. Great food, fantastic staff and a good location (very convenient for where we were staying). It was a hot lunchtime so being greeted with cold ice water was awesome then some excellent recommendations for the food was very beneficial. It is cash only so when we were short on cash for the service charge, they were more than happy for us to walk to an atm to return with the remainder later on. It’s a bit of a trek so come with enough to enjoy the awesome food! Some complimentary ice cream topped off a wonderful dining experience!Show less

Author: Julia S
Title: Great Food, outstanding service!
Review: The food was super great and the service is just outstanding. Don’t hesitate to ask for recommendations. You can also get compliments of food you don’t know and would like to try. The recommendations are just awesome and the atmosphere and prices are just great! It’s worth every penny!Show less

Author: SleapyTimManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Wow!
Review: I saw this place was #2 in Langkawi on TripAdvisor and had to check it out. It is thoroughly deserved! The manager is such a friendly guy and the food is amazing. Our kids both had a great time and he went out of his way to make sure that they had enjoyed themselves (they were 4 and 8 months). Sadly our last day of holiday but a great way to end it. Show less

Author: Leanne S
Title: Excellent
Review: Had dinner there with my partner, the Korean waiter was very informative and entertaining. He gave us suggestions on what was good and most popular. We went with his suggestions and the dishes were delicious. The female owner was lovely as well she was cooking the meals as well as serving the food. At the end of the meal we got a complimentary scoop of ice cream and a drink, not sure what the drink was but it was served in a champagne glass and tasted like ribena. Overall it was a really fun experience.Show less

Author: CHARLESBRIGHTON1981Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Amazing Best Korean and Best Service!!
Review: I've been travelling with my family now for 3 weeks and and this was one of the best restaurants we went to by far. We started the experience by meeting the extremely friendly staff who were all willing to accommodate for all our needs. Our waiter was funny, kept cracking jokes and kept us all laughing the entire night. They recommended great food which was delivered quickly and tasted delicious. My children felt more than comfortable in this pleasant and enjoyable environment due to the friendly staff and family friendly vibe. All in all, Haroo exceeded our expectations by a mile and this is a place i could easily recommend to groups of all sizes and ages... I may even consider another trip to Malaysia just for this placeShow less

Author: acumenam
Title: Great Korean Food and Host
Review: We visited the restaurant for a Korean dinner, food was amazing! Tastes delicious and the host was very attentive and fun! Definitely recommend it!

Author: muhanadm
Title: Extremely Awesome restaurant ☺️
Review:
Extremely nice food, the waiters were nice and the manager was one of the nicest managers funny and very friendly, 

The food is awesome and well prepared 

“Must visit in Langkawi”

Author: MadsC42
Title: Superb meal and exceedingly friendly service
Review: We had a great meal. The food was perfectly prepared and presented. What made the evening perfect - though - was the wonderful service. It is rare to experience that kind of commitment to your customers.

Author: Emmar1234567
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Best food in Langkawi! Great service and fantastic food, can really recommend! We had everything from spring rolls, spicy chicken and grilled beef. Excellent balanced dishes with flavor and spices.

Author: AnnaR8287
Title: Visit this restaurant!
Review: This is the best restaurant we have been to in Langkawi! Except for the great food, the service is no doubt perfect. Fantastic!!

Author: jonnymurphy89
Title: Great food and service
Review:
Visited the restaurant last night. The food was great with a lot of options available and good recommendations from the staff. 

Service was fantastic and would definitely recommend visiting. Ended the meal with a free icecream, what's not to like!?

Author: Kandbtravelspree
Title: A Must Try
Review: My husband And I visited on our last night in Langkawi. The food was exceptional and so was the service. We were given many samples to try as well. Good portions & good prices.

Author: NatthebatCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous!
Review: Both food and service was excellent. The restaurant was very busy but we were still served quickly. The fried pancake starter and both mains were superb. Far and away the best food we have eaten in Malaysia anywhere. The free water and ice cream were an added bonus. Remember it’s cash only if you visit. Highly recommend. Show less

Author: Lindsey8413Knutsford, United Kingdom
Title: Special place- incredible service and delicious food!
Review: We spent our last night in Langkawi at Haroo restaurant and did not regret it- exceptional service from all the staff and particular mention to the manager who did an incredible job of making us feel welcome, explaining the menu to us, providing recommendations, making us laugh, serving us quickly whilst at the same time doing the same for all the other customers (and the restaurant was full!). The lovely chef also came out to meet the customers which I thought was a really nice touch.This is the first time we have both eaten Korean food and found it absolutely delicious- this restaurant provided some great choices to give customers a real authentic experience of Korean cooking and used beautifully fresh ingredients! The Chicken dumplings and Jap-Chae were gorgeous, and my husband had the grilled beef which he really enjoyed too.The menu is fantastic as it explains the menu choices and explains how to eat them in a traditional way- which is also helped by the staff. We will now be looking for our nearest Korean restaurant when we get home so thank you so much for introducing us!!! Show less

Author: Bowi72Kriftel, Germany
Title: Little Seoul in Pantai Cenang
Review: Specialities from South Korea served by a very attentive team. De well-being of de customer‘s is in de center, waiters even pas by to spray water on your skin to cool down in the hot Climate of Langkawi. Dishes come with free ice water and a scoop of ice afterwards. The quality of the food is great and comes at affordable prices. There is a parkinglot in front and seething is either in- or outside.Show less

Author: LauraHdezGlez
Title: Amazing food and excellent staff and service.
Review: We had a very special 31st Dec night dinner and we enjoyed the food so much. Their lovely manager recommended us the top dishes, giving us free water and desserts. One of the best restaurants in Langkawi. It really worth a try!

Author: JoanaS2138
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: The food is good and the waiters are very attentive to clients, always advising what to eat. We went there for lunch and there was no problem for gettting a table for two, but at dinner time they told us that normaly is very crowded, so you should go early or late in the evening to avoid waiting. The Korean dishes are a nice alternative for those looking for a different taste experience.Show less

Author: ulfv2019
Title: Brilliant food and service.
Review: Brilliant food and service. Something extra. Complementary starter and dessert. Maybe o e downside since they dont take VISA.

Author: Coastal43213785110
Title: Amazing experience!
Review: Thank you very much for an amazing experience! The food was excellent, the service was flawless and the staff so friendly and easygoing - they made us laugh and enjoy the evening even more! About the food: we ordered chicken dumplings for a starter, beef bulgogi and chicken bokeum for main dishes. Beside those the restaurant served us three small complimentary side dishes (kimchi, korean omelette and scallion pancake) and complimentary desserts (icecream and a refreshing sweet dessert drink/juice) free of charge. All dishes were prepared and served with authentic korean style and tasted so goooood! And the pricing was ridiculously low! We left with our bellies full and a wide smile on our faces. We highly recommend this restaurant for food-enthusiasts like us :)Show less

Author: mllados
Title: Excellent and super friendly
Review: Great place! Staff super friendly and amazing food! I would definitely recommend it. We celebrated Ny eve and we got lots of freebies!

Author: DazDoofManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing, we have travelled
Review: Amazing, we have travelled Asia a lot in the past and I must say this must have been the best meal and experience I have had, that is a big statement to make but I stand by it, the food was stunning, we ordered a few dishes between the 2 of us and nothing was left on the plate, the owner I liken to Zebedy off magic roundabout, he works the tables with a friendly and funny manner, complimentary water comes to your table when your glass is empty, complimentary ice cream is served when your plates are empty, I cannot fault the staff or the owner or the food in the slightest. Amazing place. Show less

Author: ElinlindvallVaxjo, Sweden
Title: Increadible staff!
Review: Increadible staff and amazing service!They were so kind and service-minded, and gave is lots of examples and tips. You get lots of food, it’s not to expensive and they had many vegetarian options for my sister.And on top of everything, we got free water, Ice cream (!!!) aloe vera drink and a little piece of candy from the friendly chef. Would absolutely recommend if you like korean food or/and if you want to try something new, like us.Show less

Author: David R
Title: Absolutely fantastic...
Review: Where to start, we are seasoned travellers and this is one of the best restuarants we have ever visited. Best Korean food we have ever tasted, very reasonably priced and the service is unbelievable. We visited on christmas eve with no reservation and the owner and rest of the staff couldnt do enough for us. Brilliant.Show less

Author: Darbuka
Title: Returning customers from Finland
Review: Haroo Restaurang is our must vitsit place when in Langkawi. Food is great and Service top Bosch. And try Korean ricewine Soju like a milder version from vodka.

Author: danielmH8421IT
Title: Great food and nice place
Review: Visited this restaurant for lunch with my family. The staff was very kind and the food quality and taste was great. I will definitely visit this restaurant more times during my stay.

Author: EriKytEspoo, Finland
Title: Excellent food and service
