Review: The food was really tasty and portions were big.But the best part was the service. I don't know the name of the older gentlemen, but he was excellent! He taught us how to eat the portion in correct korean way and seemed that he really liked to talk to us.Great place all in all.Show less

Author: JuliaNazateh
Title: Amazing food, amazing service!
Review: Amazing food, amazing service, very nice staff! I would totally recommend it for anyone :) good value for money

Author: Laipengchin
Title: Amazing Food and Service ❤❤
Review: Amazing food so delicious. The Spicy Seafood Noodles and Gun Mandu are to die for .. so yummy. The one special favourite of ours Rice Ball !!! Always return for another great time. So special the service. Personal attention by the Chef , Owner and Maitre D' ! Thank you !! Show less

Author: yannicknoahkDusseldorf, Germany
Title: What a warm welcome!
Review: This restaurant is a must visit. The owner is so lovely! You can see that he loves what he is doing. Perfect little chat, great selection and really good food. We never had Korean food before but we now would love to eat it again. This restaurant accepts only cash and we had none with us but we were offered a drive to the next cash machine. Wow! Thanks you for this great experience and this lovely evening.Show less

Author: JamesO848
Title: Lovely!
Review: Great for kids. Food was tasty and prepared quickly. The owner was friendly and knowledgable. The free ice cream was a treat!

Author: nandasch
Title: Wonderful food and service - cash only
Review: The food is very tasty and the service is very nice. We were very pleased about this place. The kitchen is clean.

Author: KaiV1989Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Went there twice!
Review: It’s easy to see why people are so positive - we went here on day two and thenagain on our last day because we liked it that much.The dishes taste awesome, and the sweet staff will spoil you with all kinds of extra’s during your dinner.Please go there, if you’re ever staying in Langkawi!Show less

Author: M1105PCsarahkTaito, Japan
Title: Must eat place
Review: My friend and I were having such a great day so decided to go somewhere nice for dinner. This place made our day. The man who served us (unfortunately didnt get his name) was incredible at his job and really made a amazing experience. The food was incredible and delicious. I hadnt had Korean before but got some good recommendations from our sever which were excellent. Would recommend this to anyone visiting as the hospitable nature of the restraunt and food was second to none. Definitely made our day and stay in Lengkawi.Show less

Author: amy1408Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dumplings on point
Review: Decided to pay a visit from all the great reviews. Honestly, should go for the fried dumplings, it’s really good (it’s as if they mix fish cakes n chicken in it). 10/10 would order that again. The seafood pancake was not bad, but do note the serving is huge. Tried the bimbibap, nothing to shout about. But service was top notch!Show less

Author: Kevin S
Title: It's okay if you really want Korean Food
Review: The owner and staff provide great service. Unfortunately the taste not as good as those restaurant in Kuala Lumpur. Selected this restaurant due to high ranking in TripAdvisor, so need to read the review with pinch of salt. Price wise it's comparable to restaurant in KL. Show less

Author: Pam L
Title: Great Korean food
Review:
What a find
A great place to eat Authentic Korean food.Staff are friendly and helpful and they are happy to assist in recommending dishes from their menu.
The food was delicious and the dining area is pleasant with a nice atmosphere.
We would recommend

Author: ProxysPoland
Title: Top of the Top!
Review: The food was faboulous! If You are In Langkawi You need to go there. Instead of AWESOME food You can meet a menager who will make You Lought... A lot! 😁

Author: LaurenRd13Hertfordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Let's get this restaurant to #1 in Langkawi please!
Review: My husband and I went to Haroo twice during our 4 day stay in Langkawi and we would definitely have gone back for more if we had been there longer. From the moment we entered we felt very welcome and special by the staff and the owner who was one of the most interesting and down to earth people we met during our stay in Langkawi - the staff were very considerate of the heat and kept asking us if we were okay, the owner 'jenny' also sprayed us with water to cool us down - i've never had such treatment from somewhere i've dined before.. thank you so much. As for the food.. the food was DIVINE. the tastiest Korean food I have ever tried in my life - we had the Beef Bocheum which was full of flavour and spice, beef bibimbap and the chicken dumplings which were super moreish. I would say one main and one starter is more than enough for two people to share, though you may want to ask for more rice if ordering the Bocheum and sharing. Thank you so much 'Jenny' for all of the hospitality. Your England friends.Show less

Author: Chanshane1
Title: Korean food. Quite authentic. Eager service
Review: The serving was quite big. No air-con but they moved a fan to our table to ensure it is not too hot. I find food ok. Normal korean food we can find in Singapore but in Langkawi I think it is a pretty good find. The restaurant was pretty quiet when we went. Comfortable. The food was served quite fast. They checked on us quite regularly. Topped up water. Asked if food was ok.Show less

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: The "Number 1" ranked Asian Restaurant.
Review: Among the many restaurants in Langkawi, there are about 50% which serve Asain food.... BUT very few have as diverse menu as Haroo-- and the prices are very affordable. In addition, the service is excellent! It is located nearby, but to the south of Pentai Cenang- on the "main road". Of the many "food offerings"-- I really enjoyed the "bulgogi dish". I also liked the idea of complementary/"free" pancakes! The Restaurant has been awarded for each of the past 5 years TripAdvisor's coveted "Certificate of Excellence" (which is based on feedback provided by travelers like you and me! A visit (and a return visit) will be rewarded with many "very pleasant memories". I hope that this review has been "somewhat helpful".Show less

Author: eleven_sg
Title: Great service with decent good Korean BBQ
Review: Decent good food. Kimchi is on the sour side. Complimentary ice cream and side dishes. Great service. Worth a try.

Author: tasdatur
Title: Excellent service, wonderful dishes
Review:
We went for dinner after reading lots of good reviews about this place..
Indeed very forthcoming and attentive service, the food was delicious as well!
Complimentary water and ice cream scoop.

Author: Izzybell_l89
Title: Best restaurant & service in Langkawi!
Review:
Wonderful Korean food! If you are not familiar with Korean dishes, the waiters take their time and explain everything in detail and give recommendations!
Food was exquisite and more than worth the money!! Go there and enjoy a delicious dinner in a relaxed atmosphere!

Author: CH_FINZurich, Switzerland
Title: Super food, atmosphere and service
Review: Did not have any big expectations for this place but was positively surprised. Food was very good, with all kind of Korean specialities. Nice and cozy atmosphere with excellent and attentive service. Would highly recommend this place if you visit Langkawi and want a change from the local food. Will definitely visit again :-) Show less

Author: bacci1977Frankfurt, Germany
Title: Korean Paradise on Lankawi
Review: An absolute must-go. We prefer local options but got animated by the superb comments here and .... aaaaall so true. Very friendly and attentive staff, complimentary water (and a scoop of ice cream after dinner), reasonably priced. Had 2 appetizers and 4 mains (boneless chicken, grilled beef, 2 different bibimbap). Very delicious. Yummy. Just great!Show less

Author: Geordieboy88Linslade, United Kingdom
Title: First time at Korean restaurant
Review: First time we have been to a Korean restaurant and the staff and manger especially took so much time chatting to us about the food choices and recommendations. He couldn't have been more helpful..The food was excellent and plenty of it, portion sizes were definitely generous ..... and to say it was value for money is an understatement. Definitely recommend!Show less

Author: 464NLLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Korean food
Review: The food here is a little more expensive than other local restaurants (35-45RM per main). However we were given a selection of free starters and ice cream for dessert so overall it was good value for money. The food is some of the best Korean food I’ve had and the restaurant itself has a nice atmosphere. The bibimbap in particular was great! Show less

Author: Marie P
Title: Simply the best
Review: The food was cooked with perfection with a authentic Korean flavour. Staff were welcoming and warm. Highly recommend if in Langkawi.

Author: Sinead56
Title: Excellent food
Review: I’ve never tried Korean food before but this place is amazing. Both service and food. You have to try the Bibimbap dish .

Author: thughes71530Leighton Buzzard, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent...
Review: Neither of us have sampled Korean food before, the manager was attentive and explained to us in great detail all about the various dishes on offer, we went with his recommendations and he was spot on, we will be back.. all the staff reflected his professionalism and expertise too! Show less

Author: vegantraveller12
Title: Amazing Korean food!! + vegan options
Review: Amazing restaurant with good atmosphere and great food! Servers are friendly, helpful and have great English.  Vegan and vegetarian options available, bibimbap AMAZING!! Can’t recommend it enough! Even get sprayed with water to cool you off. 10/10

Author: Aiste BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food, restaurant management was not professional
Review: Once my boyfriend and I entered the restaurant, first we heard was the manager shouting on the staff in the middle of the restaurant, which affected our mood for the rest of the night. I do understand that sometimes you need to tell your staff off, but this must be done in private. In general, the staff was very attentive and nice, the food was delicious. At the end we got a complimentary ice-cream, which was a nice touch.Show less

Author: Jones4984
Title: This is Korean!
Review: Real Korean food, top quality, tender meet, authentic taste. These guys know what they are doing. Definitely worth the extra buck! Do it!

Author: junderhill33Whistler, Canada
Title: Perfect lunch
Review: We were riding by looking for some lunch and the name caught our eye. The experience was perfect from start to finish. Our server ran us through the most popular dishes and we ended up choosing one of his suggestions which was our favourite dish. Our waters were always filled, food was fast and super tasty, server was personable and intuitive, restaurant was clean and inviting, and the overall experience was perfect. We would highly recommend this place and will go back for dinner.Show less

Author: Casey C
Title: Excellent experience
Review: Had a very good meal there where we had a salad for starter and a main course each to share.  These 3 dishes are their signature dishes.  We enjoyed it very much.  The host was great  in recommending the dishes and very helpful.

Author: fouzanalikKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Experience beyond anything!!
Review: We walked into a normal looking place for food and oh my god was the food great! The host (he who must not be named ) walked us through the menu and gave us the recommendations that exploded with taste in our mouths. Everything is amazing - clean seating, great music, friendly hosts, finger licking food - everything was perfect!Thank you for the delightful experience. Adding a few pictures which frankly do not do justice. One must try it out!!Show less

Author: paulr412Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic Korean food
Review: We tried this as we wanted something different to Malaysian food for one night. Everything was really good and good quality. My fave was the chicken dumplings could of eaten another portion.The staff were very friendly and the head waiter was extremely helpful he talked us through the menu and made recommendations. Would come back here the next time we are in langkawi. Show less

Author: Theresa6315
Title: Nice meal
Review: We dropped in for our evening meal.Portions were big and we enjoyed our meal.We had their pancakes and Bibimbap.Both very tasty and pleased with our choices.Nice kimchi.Nice touch with ice cream after our meal

Author: 709shawngPerth, Australia
Title: Thank you for the recommendation trip asvidor
Review: After reading the reviews I stopped in for lunch. With high reviews I am alway dubious, but I shouldn’t have worried. The service was some of the best I’ve had with meals being explained and recommended, along with options to de spice for our more western pallets. We went for the safe option of grilled beef and grilled chicken. I can honestly say they were some of the best meals we have had in some time. Fully deserve the high rating and we will be returning to try dine if the other recommended dishes in the next few days. It’s a must try from me....Show less

Author: heng7676Stockholm, Sweden
Title: Good service clean food
Review: Service was good. They made extra effort to take care of our kids during our first visits. The kids got free drink to try, costumes or hats to try etc. My kids were amused and entertained.Food is authentic korean. And most important clean. Environment is also clean compare to some other restaurants . Value for money. I like the kimchi pancakeShow less

Author: Jinnma75Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely delicious
Review: My first time to try Korean food and was somewhat apprehensive as we arrived for lunch but the food was excellent particularly the Kimchi which I'd never tried before. The style of the restaurant is very nice, the service from the waiters is very good and was knowledgable to give us recommendations. Very good, will return.Show less

Author: Ely DIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Worth the price
Review: Food is well made and authentic Korean. Kimchi also is good though they have to buy it. It takes to long to make it and with the Malaysian heat may go bad quickly.Waiters are attentive and the location is also nice and calm. Of course is not exactly cheap, but which Korean restaurant around the world is cheap?We really enjoyed our lunch!Show less

Author: 298iqramHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Beyond amazing!
Review: My husband and I had lunch at the restaurant and it was so good we had to come back a second time which was great as it was the first time we were trying Korean cuisine! We’d highly recommend the chicken dumplings and the chicken bokeum. The service was better than we’d experienced anywhere before. If we’re ever in Langkawi again we’d definitely eat here again! Show less

Author: liang0525
Title: amazing dinner
Review:
juz try it，food is good，service also damn nice
especially the waiter help us to know the detail about the food tat is very helpful

Author: Gearoid D
Title: Must try in langkawi
Review: Can't remember the last time I ate such delicious food. The owner is so helpful with recommendations and gives great detail about each dish. He even threw in a complementary side and ice cream. I got a beef in broth recommended by the owner it was superb. I've been to langkawi a few times and this is the best place I've found there by far.Show less

Author: sharwindb
Title: 200% amazing food and service!🙌🏼
Review: The food and service is absolutely top notch and far beyond expectation! Love the place, keep it up!

Author: jrroberts10
Title: Evening Dining
Review: Lovely little find. Friendly attentive service good quality food and a lovely change from Malaysian dishes. Would definitely recommend to ring the changes.

Author: DerGeniesser1970
Title: Memorable Evening
Review:
We (2 adults and two girls) enjoyed a wonderful evening at the restaurant. 
The service was excellent and to be honest,  we just followed all recommendations given. Everything was cooked to the highest quality with fair prices. 
We will certainly come back!

Author: AntoninCanton
Title: Will revisit again definitely!
Review: The waiter was awesome and nice! He recommended a lot of delicious but cheap  restawesome in Langkawi. The food was awesome! Especially the beef and the vegetable  饼。

Author: saundersmb
Title: Great friendly service and fantastic food
Review:
Really enjoyed this friendly restaurant.
Great menu and some the staff helpful in advising on levels of spice.
Both carnivores and vegetarians catered for.
Lots of additional little portions were also supplied as part of meal.
Very enjoyable.
Free WiFi too.

Author: Bjorn R
Title: Foods perfect
Review: Luckily we were in the Mood for Korean, the food was very nice and the host was a funny Guy. The dog kept us safe.

Author: katielA1473PM
Title: Must try bibimbap
Review: Had a great meal at this restaurant - so good that we went back the next night. Lovely host who guided us through the menu and made us feel very welcome. Complementary side dishes and ice cream. The bibimbap was definitely our favourite.

Author: jbbettiAustralind, Australia
Title: Great Korean Meal
Review: Lovely meal, great service. From the moment we walked in we were welcomed by the very friendly staff. We were talked through the menu and asked for recommendations. We thoroughly enjoyed our meal and left very full. The free iced water was great along with the refreshing complimentary ice cream to finish. Thoroughly recommend for a great meal.Show less

Author: majie93Antwerp, Belgium
Title: Just lovely
Review: I specially made a TripAdvisor account just to write this review. Went for dinner and the staff welcomed us with free (drinkable) water and this was refilled during the whole evening. The waiter asked us if he could he could walk us through the menu and what a good job he did (loved this guy btw). We then chose some of his suggestions and the food was delicious!!! During our meal we got some free apetizers and after our meal we got some free ice cream. Long story short: if you are looking for great food, atmosphere and service, this is the place to be. Thank me later Show less

Author: abfwilliamsHitchin, United Kingdom
Title: Wow!
Review: We had such an amazing meal at Haroo last night. The service was amazing from the second we sat down, and the food was divine! The chef/owner made a real effort to meet us which was a really nice touch. And the complimentary ice cream and kimchi sides were an added bonus. Can’t recommend this place enough! Thank you again for such a great evening! :)Show less

Author: Dion C
Review: The service is really good, the staff and the owner are really friendly. The water and side dishes come free and are automatically topped up. The place looks really good too.

Author: MathiasTSenec, Slovakia
Title: Fantastic restaurant!
Review: This really a perfect place. Outstanding kitchen, one of my best gastronomic experience ever. We have a family group of 4 there, everyone of us tried 2 courses and everything was just incredible. The owner was very welcoming, client friendly and funny at the same time. Unforgetable evening - thank you for that Haroo Haroo ♥️Show less

Author: greteerrasTallinn, Estonia
Title: A piece of Korea in Malaysia
Review: We've been to many countries around the world and have always chosen a restaurant recommended by Tripadvisor. And of all the restaurants we've been to this one really stands out! The owner is super-friendly and explains the whole menu if you're not familiar with Korean food. The food is really tasty - especially the bibimbap, beef bokeum and beef bulgogi. We ended up visiting this place multiple times and we definitely recommend it to everyone.Show less

Author: swanstonanthonyPhuket, Thailand
Title: Great food
Review: You can park right outside the door of this Korean restaurant. The staff are friendly and attentive and will take time to talk you through the menu in particular explaining the spice levels and adjusting them to your taste.Beer is reasonable in price, wine is not over the top. The food itself is first class and the complementary ice cream top rate. Seating is either indoor or outdoor. The only negative is the ambiance. The place just has no atmosphere. But you can’t have everything.Show less

Author: JasonOSB
Title: Good service but average food
Review: The service was good at this restaurant, however unfortunately the food seemed to have been toned down to suit the tastes of the European patrons.

Author: marcydsmithVenice, California
Title: Fantastic service & great food!
Review: This place is great! The owner is super helpful and explained the whole menu. We ordered the beef bimimpap, a chicken glass noodle dish, and the kimchi pancake for 3 people...it was all fantastic! Plenty of food for 3, as well as a ton of delicious vegetables in each dish. The owner went around and sprayed cold water on everyone’s necks to cool us down which was a nice touch!! We even received complimentary chocolate chip ice cream at the end of our meal. He even ordered grab cars for patrons as they were leaving. Highly recommend this place! Show less

Author: hdjdh373
Title: Super tasty
Review: Really good food, friendly staff, portions are a good size, have authentic Korean drinks too. Kimchi was great!

Author: Menkau
Title: Outstanding service
Review: Amazing experience for my family. We had The most amazing waiter ever. The food was delicious and presented nicely. Highly recommend the marinated beef.

Author: vic_grc
Title: Still very Yum and Delish
Review: Last year I ate here and I was wow by the cordial service and tasty foods.Haroo did not disappoint me this time also.My only negative is that I cannot try more dishes as the portion is huge and they do not accept credit cards. But overall, it is still money well spent. See you again next year!!!Show less

Author: Patrick400
Title: Nice restaurant and reasonable price
Review: Went there on afternoon and found the food delicious and price in reasonable range , though the choices are not really extensive, but we would not mind to go bk again! The service staff is Super friendly , which is a plus point.

Author: rasmusstolpe
Title: Must go in langkawi!
Review: The food was brilliant! Service was defenitely best i had in our 2 week trip, they we’re so knowing about their food and passion about it!

Author: axlLondonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best food on the island!
Review: I’m a major foodie and also quite like good service, this place has all in abundance! Stayed on Langkawi for 2 weeks and pretty much ate here on at least 5 occasions. Firstly there’s Ben, who is the most charismatic person, there to greet you with passion about the food and a bit of banter along the way. Then there’s the food..... bags of flavour in every dish. You get complimentary sides to accompany your meal, and ice cream to finish. On our last night Ben gave us the most amazing VIP treatment for being loyal customers, he went above and beyond. I can’t recommend this restaurant highly enough, just go.....!! Eat, drink and have fun, that’s the ethos here..... there’s also a few dress up masks available to make your night even more enjoyable at the bar! Thank you to the whole team for making every one of our dining experiences amazing, you have a very special place in my heart now!!Show less

Author: APisME95
Title: Delicious food and wonderful service!
Review: A must try restaurant if you’re near Tengah or Cenang! The food was delicious, was great quality, and the service was very attentive and friendly. Definitely recommend while on Langkawi!

Author: georgiaa451Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service
Review: We visited Haroo after seeing how highly reviewed it is and we weren’t disappointed! It was the first time any of us have had Korean food and we had the menu explained to us which was fantastic. The vegetarian options were fantastic! We enjoyed our visit so much that we ended up going back a second time. Haroo also caters to children and the staff were so good with them. Show less

Author: chravnaasKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: Amazing food and a nice place to have dinner. We had a shared BBQ as a main course, and it really lived up to our expectations. Excellent service, and we even got ice cream on the house. We would definitely come again if we get the chance. Show less

Author: Z2846QUmarcob
Title: amazing authentic food!
Review: You should absolutely visit this place if you’re nearby! the staff is very friendly and gave us excellent recommendations on what to eat. Great service and superb food!

Author: HERALTHOG
Title: Lovely experience
Review:
4 days on Langkawi. Haroo served us wonderfull dishes. We had to return for a second time. The employees and boss (a charming woman) were very enjoyebal speaking partners.

When you are hungry, love verry good eating! GO GO GO!

HERALT HOGEBOOM

Author: jwjyoy
Title: GREAT FOOD AND SERVICE
Review: Excellent food and good value for money. Great service from an amazing manager happy to explain dishes with enthusiasm and energy. Great for families and groups.

Author: Odyssey637350
Title: Excellent food & service
Review: We had a fantastic meal here served by extremely courteous & friendly staff. Our waiter gave excellent recommendations & we enjoyed complementary drinks & ice cream. The atmosphere was warm & cosy. We cannot recommend highly enough.

Author: Andreas G
Title: Great food and service
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed the squid and beef barbecue, excellent service and authentic Korean food. Free ice-cream for desert was another bonus...staff was very attentive Thank you

Author: LRose S
Title: ABSOLUTELY OUTSTANDING!!!
Review: Food was unbelievable. I will now go in search for Korean food wherever I go in the world. The manager was amazing - probably the best customer service I have ever received. Very attentive and knowledgable and provided us with lots of options and advice based on foods we like and spice level etc. Also v good value for money! Thank you also for the complimentary vegetarian pancakes and chocolate ice cream. Cannot recommend highly enough. You’d be silly not to go here on your travels to Langkawi!!Show less

Author: JmMalle
Title: Super nice food
Review: The food was one of the best that we ate so far in Malaysia. It was really delicious and the service was super. We got water and a scoop of ice cream on the house :)

Author: lisaireland14
Title: Superb dining experience
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed our evening at the restaurant. The staff were incredibly attentive and helpful and the food was absolutely superb. Our favourite restaurant during our stay in Langkawi, a must when in town.

Author: jazzaj212121
Title: Superb
Review: What a fantastic restaurant! We ate here two nights in a row and loved it. The owner is one of the most thoughtful restauranteurs I have encountered and of course the food matches the service. Worth every Myr! If you are a fan of Korean food then this matches or excels most of the best we have had in London (Not been to Korea yet so cannot comment on that). Enjoy. A must if hungry in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Salem247
Title: Amazing Staff & Delicious Food
Review: The staff were very attentive and kind. The food was delicious. The complimentary ice cream was a really nice touch. Thanks Haroo Restaurant

Author: shougie123
Title: Super good food and service!
Review: I really recommend this restaurant. The waiters are really kind to the customers, give relevant information about the dishes and guide you through the menu, and make sure that you have a good evening. And the food is excellent! The chef also pays visit to the customers to chat and inquire whether we like to food or not, and also to show us how to eat it. We had a really good experience. Thank you Haroo!Show less

Author: deziren1980Armstrong Creek, Australia
Title: Best meal in all of Langkawi
Review: Called in for a late lunch one day and was met with a gregarious host, who was full of entertainment (my 4 year old daughter loved him) and he explained and recommended things off the menu to help us along. Well his suggestions were spot on, hands down this was the best meal I had in Langkawi (over 10 days). Not the cheapest place to eat on the island, but it didn't matter, everything was full of flavour and we scoffed the whole lot. I wish we visited here on our first day - I would of came back a few times.Show less

Author: Gak9898Liverpool, England
Title: Fabulous Meal
Review: What a welcome to a lovely restaurant! We visited here twice during our stay in Langkawi. We have never visited a Korean restaurant before! The menu was explained to us all in great detail. You could state how spicy you wanted your meal as well. One veggie in our group and she was catered for very well. I would highly recommend a visit here. Try the chicken dumplings as a starter. Beef stew mmmm is all I can say. Please try you will love it.Show less

Author: Stacynlm
Title: Excellent service
Review: Went with my family of 9. Had a wonderful dinner there. The staff there was very friendly, and gave good recommendation of the popular food in their restaurant. While waiting for food, staff entertained the kids with accessories (princess tiara, pig nose, etc). Food is great! We had a wonderful time there.Show less

Author: Thiyaghessan
Title: Amazing food and excellent service
Review: The restaurant staff kept checking up on us to see if we needed anything and if the food was okay. The food itself was delicious. Definitely a must try in Langkawi

Author: bluekev2
Title: Excellent
Review: A first time visit to a Korean restaurant (definitely not the last ).From the moment we were seated till we left, the evening was excellent ,the staff were so attentive and helpful explaining the menu and making recommendations .The food was wonderful and very reasonably priced ,will definitely return before leaving LangkawiShow less

Author: Susan1603
Title: Soooooo good :)
Review: A restaurant with really nice ambience. The food, the staff and the cook were more than i could aspect. It was amazing!! Thanks a lot!

Author: Mulrobs
Title: Delicious Korean food!
Review: We enjoyed a delicious dinner here. Staff were attentive and the complimentary appetizers a really nice touch. I loved the kimchi and also the omelette. We had a soup to start of bean curd, shrimp broth and squid, followed by a bulgogi stew and a stir fried beef dish. All was beautifully cooked and so flavourful. It made us want to visit Korea so bad! Show less

Author: Caro H
Title: Amazing
Review:
There is nothing more to say than: amazing.
The food (!!!), the waiters(!!!) and the whole atmosphere(!!!)  A must do in langkawi!  

Greetings from Germany

Caro, Michi , Dania

Author: christopherjohne
Title: Great food and service
Review:
Amazing meal with attentive staff they were very helpful and understanding of food allergies. 

Food was amazing, fresh and quick.

Author: Peter_pulice
Title: Incredible service delicious food!
Review: My wife and I patronized this resaurant with 2 young kids (4 and 2). As we enetered the restaurant we noticed there were 2 large parties and and a nearly packed house. We figured the wait would be long for our food. Our gracious host would have none of it!Our charming waiter immediately had a high chair ready for our 2 year old. He encouraged us to order quickely before the large parties so our restless children wouldnt be waiting. He gave us a quick but detailed rundown of the menu and we ordered. We were so excited to see a variety of beef items on the menu as it seems most of Langkawi only had chicken items available. We were entertianed the whole time with our kids being showered with toys, free appitizers and funny, pleasant banter.Our meals arrived about 10 minutes or less! Food was absolutley delicious and our picky kids were well fed! We finished off the night with complementary icecream and sweets. We even got to meet our chef and she was most pleased to see us satisfied! We left the restaurant all smiles.I highly recommend visiting this restaurant if youre visiting Langkawi!Show less

Author: HebaNader
Title: Amazing food and top notch customer service!
Review: we visited this restaurant because of the high ratings it got on trip advisor, and thank goodness we did!The food was amazing, tasty and just about the best I’ve had but the customer service was incredible! I’ve never had such good customer service in my life! I’m very happy we came and it surely won’t be the last one.Highly recommended!Show less

Author: morrisv745Prinsenbeek, The Netherlands
Title: Great service, great food!
Review: Tonight we had dinner at Haroo Haroo korean food. We had such a great evening, the service was outstanding. They helped a lot with their recommendations because we didn’t know what to choose. They also took great care of us during the dinner. They know how to run a restaurant.The food was very good, dishes where not too spicy but exactly right. Great flavors, We loved it!If you visit Langkawi, you should definitely have dinner here••• Show less

Author: Ginny267Knaresborough, United Kingdom
Title: Lunch time visit
Review: My husband and I decided to have lunch at Haroo Haroo Korean restaurant. We have never had Korean food before so it was a new experience for us both.The staff and owner were very friendly and welcoming. The food we had was exceptional. They offer a good range of vegetarian options and are very accommodating. We would definitely recommend a visit here if you are in the area. Great food and super attentive staff. Show less

Author: ChuaZhenLong
Title: Amazing food with excellent service
Review: The food served over at the restaurant was phenomenal and very reasonable in terms of price (35 - 45rm). The whole team was very friendly, with the manager occasionally checking in on your dining experience and explaining thw various food items. Free side dishes and ice cream is also served alongside refillable ice water. Overall haroo brings to you an unique dining experience with cool weather, impeccable service an most importantly splendid food.Will recommend the bibimbap as well as the pa-jeon over there!!!Show less

Author: TheLonelyKiwi
Title: Best service!!!
Review: It was on the last night of our getaway and we decided to check out Haroo for some authentic korean food. We arrived at 930pm, and there were still a few tables occupied. We ordered a Bibimbap and 2 Pa Jeons (pancake), one vegeterian and one seafood. It was really huge and we almost couldn't finish them. Their service on the other hand was awesome, the crew will occasionally come over to ask us if our food was alright, and refill our ice water and side dishes. The Korean lady was very pleasant with the customers and we enjoyed ourselves thoroughly :) We were served a scoop of ice-cream each at the end of our meal and its on the house! Overall, it was a very good experience and I greatly recommend!!Show less

Author: N1249JLdannyhLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food, even better service!
Review: We were in Langkawi for 8 days and went for dinner here twice. It has completely changed what were completely wrong opinions on Korean food. I've never even thought to try it before, until I found Haroo Haroo on TripAdvisor and decided to give it a go. We arrived and the service we received was just mind blowing - the manager explained the entire menu for us, listened to what we both liked and then recommended dishes. We ordered loads and ate every last dish. I have to emphasise that the manager is incredible - he checked on us throughout our entire meal, our drinks were consistently refilled, we got some free taster dishes and free ice cream at the end of the meal. He was working the tables unbelievably well, taking time to chat to everyone. He makes your restaurant experience, which is why we went back (plus the food was insane). We ended up sitting with him after close for an hour or so just chatting - his English is amazing. The owner (and chef) brought some of our dishes out, she came over to see how the food was and thanked everyone as they left (if she was out of the kitchen). Overall it was one of the best dining experiences we've ever had, on both occasions. Couldn't recommend anymore. BIG thank you to the manager and owner.TIPS: Get the beef bulgogi, bibimbap, dumplings, chicken or beef bokkeum (think that's what it is called) and the Japchae. All insanely delicious.Show less

Author: EmmaFromFinland
Title: One of the best restaurant experiences in a while
Review: Just extremely delicious food, especially the bibimpap was amazing and authentic and superb service all the way!

Author: ShinaxHelsinki, Finland
Title: Food is super delicious, but service is top notch!
Review: 1. Amazing service! Staff (especially one male waiter) explained thorougly about the dishes. I got my dish spicy as I asked for, the owner/head chef brought our food and made sure we know what we eat, do we like it, brought complimentary dessert etc. Many extra things taken care of as we had dinner.2. The food is GOOD! Have travelled to South Korea twice and got to say this was better than the ones I’ve had there. The head chef is from South Korea and loves to show people her food and what Korea food is like.3. Atmosphere and location good! Next to Pantai Tengah, walking distance to Pantai Cenang. Also Grab works in case your hotel is more far away. I truly recommend this place for people who love Korean food + want to have a perfect dinner experience in Langkawi.Cheers!Show less

Author: WorldWeary13
Title: Excellent
Review: Our server was world class. Professional with a genuine concern for our meal while being very funny. The food was in a class of its own. The seafood was fresh and the beef excellent. An excellent value for money meal.

Author: pppppppppppi
Title: The Scottish family
Review: Haroo is a great place to go and eat the food is top class and the service is impeccable. Would highly recommend to anyone. They go over and above to make sure your dining experience and taste of Korea is the best it can be.

Author: gillmcwill
Title: Amazing dinner experience
Review: One of the best dining experiences we have had abroad! The staff were all unbelievably friendly and the food was fabulous! Definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Langkawi

Author: C1519OKrebeccamFalkirk, United Kingdom
Title: Great experience from start to finish!
Review: We came here for lunch and were looking for tasty food, this place did not disappoint! It was the first time we had eaten proper Korean food, so welcomed the offer of an explanation of the menu from the waiter (Jenny/cash). He recommended three dishes - beef tukbaegi bulgogi, chicken bibimbap & beef Bokeum. All three dishes were excellent and made us wish we had room to eat more! There is lots to choose from on the menu and we will definitely be back to try them. The staff are so accommodating and just want you to have a great time. Brilliant service and great food - what more could you ask? Show less

Author: msquare7Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Service + Amazing Food
Review: The owner and the chef are the main reasons to go here. While the food is great, its their personal service that makes for a wonderful experience. The owner was making a special effort to entertain our 10 month old baby girl with balloons, water sprays, etc to ensure we could have a peaceful lunch. He even gave us a complimentary shot of soju and free ice-cream at the end. The portions are huge so we ended up coming back for dinner to try out other dishes.Show less

Author: Saldogger400
Title: Cosy food
Review: Came here during a downpour. Desperately wanted good food and service and got it. Good vego options.

Author: moosterveerEindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Hidden gem but exposed by Tripadvisor
Review: This visit was full of surprises. First we had a very warm welcome of the staff members, unforgettable. Than how do the dishes meet up with the already build up expectations. We were so eager to know and above that to taste them. Starter was perfect, followed by the chef’s suggestions the main dishes. What a treat, wonderful servers and behind this al the lady in charge, working in the kitchen as the chef and owner. We had a wonderful night with we could only remark with the highest score. Thanks and as promised we came back for a second time and again you have proven us right again. Top score Show less

Author: Milesaway31
Title: Best meal after 5 weeks in Malaysia
Review: Amazing food at Haroo. The service was great and really enjoyed the Chicken Bokeum, was probably the best meal I've eaten in Malaysia.

Author: miloklen
Review: Amazing food!!! the staff are really professional and treated everyone with respect and were very informative.

Author: trieu181989
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Food are excellent, reasonable price and service are very good. Highly recommendation for group of friends who are looking for delicious food and warm environment.

Author: SCEHSMelton, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: The restaurant and staff were beautiful especially the manager. The food was of high quality, the manger told us his favourites and we ordered all the favourites for our group of 7. They even brought out extra food, and drinks for us to try. Highly recommend and price was good especially for the quality and service of the food.Show less

Author: OHGonthemoveUnited Kingdom
Title: First time tasting Korean and it won’t be the last
Review: A great little find. We stumbled across this restaurant and were intrigued. We were greeted by Jenny and he very quickly introduced us to a few Korean delicacies. He enhanced the experience with a few complimentary Korean dishes that we grew to love (Kuchai) and of course the ice cream! Would definitely recommend to all visitors of Langkawi. Hospitable staff, excellent food and an overall great atmosphereShow less

Author: SalzagalbackpackerMelbourne, Australia
Title: Tasty food and great service
Review: We stumbled on haroo looking for a quick feed at 9.30 one night. The manager bent over backwards for us. He quickly bought us cold water and menus and recommended a few dishes. He then bought us complimentary side dishes. Food came quickly and bimibap and a beef dish were delicious! Followed by the complimentary scope of ice cream. Yes, it costs more than a local roadside place...but when you consider all the food you get, the quality, the size of the dishes and the service, it’s a bargain! Also if you haven’t had korean , it’s a great chance to try it....good for vegetarians too. Show less

Author: caitlinsalmonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: These guys just reinvented what customer service means
Review: Rarely write on here but this place is really worth a mention. Complementary ice water and ice cream for desert, but what really needs talking about is their staff- been to plenty of London restaurants and have never had the menu explained like this and a waiter be so thoughtful. Luckily the food more than lived up to expectations too. Chef also came and checked on us afterwards too ♥️Just 10/10 really Show less

Author: zorro360
Title: Fantastic
Review:
Amazing food and service! 

The staff is very attentive and professional

Many side dishes and complementary drinks and ice cream. 

I would recommend the bulgogi and the grilled beef which were tasteful and well balanced. 

A lovely place 👌🏻

Author: 780brianePerth, Australia
Title: Best dining experience in Langkawi
Review: This was a good restaurant when it was in Pantai Chenang, but the move to Pantai Tengah has taken it to the next level. The greeter in this restaurant is the happiest and most helpful man in Langkawi. Clearly explained the menu and recommended dishes and alternatives. We were given free filtered water all evening, complimentary entree samples and ice cream. The food was delicious and the chef (and owner) came to every table to enquire if we were enjoying the food. Everyone was. The house wine, can-sav was excellent and it was an overall great dining experience. Show less

Author: Erik D
Title: Great food, great service
Review:
Sweet potato noodle dish was very tasty.
Complementary ice cream was a delicious surprise. Waiter was very helpful and have many suggestions as well as giving us a tasting of kimchi. Even booked us an Uber afterwards.

Author: Cmannfolk
Title: Great food at ok price with attentive service
Review:
Great food, with a very interesting and appetizing menu. Good amount of food.
With very attentive service.
Was definitely worth the price which might otherwise been considered a tad expensive

Author: Cdrews
Title: Unique food and quality service.
Review: Great food, 5 star service, and lots a free snacks and treats! You will feel at home here and all the food is so well-made and unique.

Author: Chinchin1
Title: Deserve its ranking in TripAdvisor
Review: The Korea eatery is a definitely a highlight for the trip. Service is very good and attentive. Outdoor seating but airy. Food tastes very nice but reasonably price. Try to go early as it will be very packed.

Author: Alisonnt99
Title: Best dinner at Langkawi
Review: Haroo in Chenang is my favorite restaurant in Langkawi so far. The food was amazing, so delicious, and the service the best you could imagine. Everything is above expectations. Kash, the restaurant manager was amazing, so friendly and welcoming made the best dinner experience. Totally recommend this place to go!Show less

Author: Sarah R
Title: Amazing food excellent costumer service. Definitely recommend!
Review: Amazing options with excellent costumer service. Fans to keep you cool. Chef personally comes to check on food, and one staff member in particular is an absolute joy. Such humour! Good food, good company, and plenty of laughs. I would definitely recommend you make a visit.Show less

Author: W2378KFdavidc
Title: Fantastic place
Review: Very nice staff. Telling historic stories and helping us choose in the menu. The food was excellent and we are very pleased that we went to this restaurant.

Author: Evy BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service
Review: It’s always the people who make or break the place. This restaurant has very attentive staff, great service and good food. Just remember that Korean food is usually on the higher end of food price range in Malaysia (think grilled beef with fresh veggies, etc). So just make sure you bring cash as they don’t accept card. It has big portion, be considerate or ask them if you order good amount of food. Nice touch with the complimentary ice cream and also the attention they gave us to make sure we had a ride home. In general, highly recommended.Show less

Author: leonienjasonAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best restaurant meal in Langkawi
Review: Brilliant experience. The chef took our booking by phone and upon our arrival came out to greet us which was a lovely personal touch. She also came to say goodbye and ensured we enjoyed our meals, which we absolutely did.The waiter who called himself ‘Jenny’ was fantastic-humorous, informative and one of the most welcoming people we’ve ever met. Given I wore a white dress to dinner he immediately applied a bib to preserve my outfit, laughing at the same time. If we could have hired him back home we would have in a heartbeat. The kind of guy you’ll always remember.My husband ordered the bibimbap which is one of his favourites and it was brilliant. I had a spicy squid dish which I’d highly recommend.Complimentary ice cream was a nice touch although we were too full to enjoy it.Do yourselves a favour and eat at this place!We will be back for sure.Show less

Author: JUnniMorgan
Title: Great culinary experience
Review: Pricey (RM100+ for two people) but for us having authentic Korean food for the first time it was a great culinary experience. The ambience is homely. Service staff is very attentive, the cook was happy to explain dishes and reduce the spiciness for us.

Author: 707ritav
Title: Fantastic!
Review: You should go here just for the experience. The staff make sure the service is second to none, make you feel high classThe owner was very friendly and enthusiastic and made sure he gave us all the recommendations about Kuala Lumpur, our next destination, that he could think of. Before we sat down we indicated we did not have enough cash so the owner offered to let someome of his staff take us on motorbike to an atm after the meal.Besides the excellent service the food is fantastic. The whole experience is 10/10Show less

Author: CCALLO88
Title: Tasty
Review: I had the fried chicken dumplings and bimibap. The dumplings were a bit generic and tasteless I'm afraid but the bimibap fresh and delicious. The service was second to none and they went out of their way to make me feel welcome. Would revisit

Author: Frederic18
Title: Awesome Food with GENEROUS PORTION
Review: The BBQ beef bulgogi is a MUST try!! They recommend it for 2 people but the portion is really big is suitable for 3 people. And they also give us free ice cream at the end of meal which is really kind. Highly recommended!!

Author: KazL94
Title: Incredible experience - worthy of the high rating
Review: After seeing this restaurant had received such a high rating and was nearby our hotel, we thought it would be great to try.I can confidently say that this restaurant well and truly deserves its ranking and offered a fantastic experience both through the delicious food and excellent service.We ordered the fried chicken dumplings for starter which were delicious and fragrant, then rice noodles and claypot chicken for main, with fresh mango juice and ice plum tea to drink. We were also treated to ice cream for dessert (which we could barely finish due to the very generous portions!)Our waiter advised us against ordering an additional dish we had been considering because we likely wouldn’t be able to finish (which turned out to be true, and it was refreshing to see the staff not trying to upsell). The staff were extremely attentive throughout the meal, and seemed to predict what we would need before we even asked.At the end of the meal we were told the restaurant was cash only, but unfortunately we only had cards with us and there were no ATMs nearby. The kind owner happily agreed to let us return and pay the next day and even lent us a large umbrella for the walk back to our hotel in the very heavy monsoon rain.Overall we were extremely impressed and would recommend this restaurant to anyone. Thank you!Show less

Author: Tendai MSydney, Australia
Title: Must visit
Review: We had an early dinner at Haroo. It was already pretty busy when we got there but we were seated quickly. We were given the option for explanations on what everything was and recommendations on favourites..we have chicken hotpot and beef bulgogi. The bulgogi was to die for, so much flavour in one dish. The hot pot was really good too but the bulgogi was the star. We were given complimentary sides as well as some ice cream. I definitely would return to Haroo..my only issue was this is a cash only establishment, so we had to get cash to be able to settle the bill. The staff were very accommodating with us having to find money after we had already eaten which was a very pleasant surprise!The food and service at Haroo were exceptional!Show less

Author: Trevor & Kellie... P
Title: Amazing
Review:
Amazing customer service, the service we received was above and beyond that was even before food was served. Food was awesome and plate sizes quite big.
Would definitely return again

Author: Allycat2013Melbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing night out
Review: Dinner at the Ha Roo Korean Restaurant and what a great experience. Staff were very friendly and attentive. The waiter made some very wise recommendations as the food portions were very large and delicious. Staff ensured our experience was memorable. Food was amazing. Restaurant has indoor and outdoor seating. Would highly recommend a night out at this fabulous restaurant. Will go back for dinner before we leave the island.This was a special birthday dinner and we enjoyed many laughs.Show less

Author: LondonerAbroad29
Title: Excellent
Review:
Excellent excellent excellent. Five stars before the food is even served; the owner is hilarious. Genuine comedy. 

Excellent food. Stunning service. Great tea. Good prices. Massive plates.

11/10.

Author: LysB28
Title: Amazing
Review: Everything was amazing. The food was really good and the service was way beyond what we usually get in Malaysia.

Author: mertyc
Title: great food and service
Review: had a lovely time here, the staff are friendly and helpful and attentive, the food and drinks are delicious and lots of veggie options, complimentary ice cream for dessert and fair pricing! would eat here again 100%

Author: joeyan76
Title: Great Find
Review: Food is awesome-tasty and delicious. Service was also good. Friendly and helpful. Definite must have when in Langkawi

Author: 822edwinkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food
Review: Anyone who is travelling to Langkawi and craving for Korean food must try this place out. Nothing fanciful about this place, just simple well executed dishes. Its a lot better than what big cities can offer. I can attest to that cause i came from a big city. Seafood is fresh and the bibimap is so well balanced and the gravy doesn't overpower the overall taste. Added the fact that the service staff is so genuine. Its highly unlikely you will walk out being not satisfied.Show less

Author: Tompacey0710Perth, Australia
Title: Best dining experience we've had in Malaysia
Review: We were impeccably looked after all night. Our waitor broke the menu down, explaining each dish and recommended food based on our dietary requirements. We were actually downsold because we ordered too much! Extremely glad this was the case as portions were huge. Food was incredible; aromatic, flavoursome and filling. We were given complimentary ice cream for desert and a free moped ride to the ATM because there were no EFTPOS facilities. Will entertain many a restaurant before getting food this good anywhere else.Show less

Author: sunshine_city88
Title: Excellent foods and service
Review: The foods are delicious and the service is prompt. Price is reasonable and everything is perfect. Just the place u need to be after a tiring swim.

Author: 94sft
Title: Good choice
Review: Wonderful atmosphere and good food. The people operating this place are very friendly and goes above and beyond to make you feel welcomed and comfortable.

Author: msomers2018London, United Kingdom
Title: So so good
Review: It doesn’t matter what you came to Langkawi for, visiting this restaurant is reason enough. If the menu doesn’t grab you at first sight don’t be put off. I nearly walked away but because of the excellent reviews I gave it ago. The service is impeccable and the guy that ran through the menu was a true professional. The food was sublime. Don’t miss it.Show less

Author: Mahender VSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to eat Korean
Review: Recommended by a friend who had visited earlier, we went there for an early lunch. Pleasant welcome, and great introduction to Korean food by the Service manager. Helped us to decide what to eat. Lots of veggie options. complimentary ice-cream served at end of the meal. Good location on Pantai Tengah.Near a couple of good Spas - Yuan Spa and SunSpaShow less

Author: Nicsh19
Title: Make sure you visit here
Review: Had a fab meal at this restaurant from arrival to finish due to excellent service and delicious food. Keep doing what your doing and your guests will keep coming back !

Author: jraffa86Albert Park, Australia
Title: Best dining experience in lanklgkawi
Review: Party of 3 went to haroo on our last night in langkawi are being already fairly impressed with the islands food offerings we decided we wanted Korean We were greeted with probably the happiest person on the island and it got better from there.They we more than accommodating of my wife serious nut & sesame allergy and had her food cooked first as to not contaminate it while making the rest.Every mouthful was perfect and dishes were of generuous size, price was slightly more than we had spent in other venues but well worth every RM COMPLIMENTARY RAINBOW ICE CREAM WAS A NICE FINAL TOUCHShow less

Author: 436mayaw
Title: delicious and fun dinner
Review: we had a beef bbq on the table that was delicious and a nice experience! lots of complimentary side dishes! kids enjoyed food and the funny owner who entertains the customers and kids very nicely!

Author: Biancas0207
Title: Amazing food and service!
Review: What a fantastic restaurant! By far the best restaurant we dined at during our stay in Langkawi. Food was flawless and the service was fantastic - very attentive and welcoming!

Author: NorthStar755948Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best service and Korean food
Review: Not only is this a restaurant which is good for its food the manager is also a great entertainer. Great bibimbap and beef soup.Good way of truly serving your customers right. We were eating with children so he made sure to keep them entertained.We will definitely come back again and make this a recurring event!Show less

Author: stuartb878
Title: Great Korean Food & Service
Review: Excellent customer service, food quality is fantastic, and they even throw in some rainbow coloured ice cream and some green tea without charge.

Author: Marie17979Preston, United Kingdom
Title: Our favourite Lankawi meal
Review: We have eaten some great meals during our visit to Langkawi but this was one of our favourites. Never eaten Korean before so didn't know what to expect but thoroughly enjoyed it. Ordered fried dumpling starter then seafood omelette thing and delicious beef dish with rice for main and got some complimentary tasters which went down well. The guy who seemed in charge was great with our 5yr old bringing him water balloons and having fun with him. Very reasonably priced for great food. ~£50 for 2.5 of us including 2 glasses of nice wine each and complimentary ice cream for all. Would definitely visit again. Show less

Author: M_I_Mapril
Title: Best food and service in Langkawi
Review: I ate here with my girlfriend during our time in Langkawi. The staff were very helpful, the food was very good quality and we received complementary water and ice cream. As recommended the Bokeum and Gunmandu were great. It was the best meal we ate during our time there: the food was obviously fresh and very well prepared.  It wasn't until after our dinner that we found out just how amazing the staff were. I unfortunately lost consciousness as we were leaving HaRoo, falling over backward and splitting my head open. The staff immediately came to help, first trying to call me an ambulance before insisting they take me to a medical centre themselves as the ambulance was taking too long. A staff member waited with us and translated at the medical centre, even paying for our Grab home. I can't thank the staff enough. Also to the German gentleman who offered help while I was on the pavement, if you are reading this then thanks a lot- you are a good man. I could not think of a better place in Langkawi to recommend, and there is no business that deserves your patronage more than HaRoo.Show less

Author: crebernik7791Berlin, Germany
Title: Friendly, best food in town
Review: We have been there with the kids and have been looking for some vegetarian options. It was a bliss. Amazing service. Fun with the kids. Excellent food. Complementary servings like kimchi and ice cream. Definitely best restaurant on Langkawi so far. And congrats to the chef.Show less

Author: 4everTravelerLGK
Title: bimbimbap
Review:
excellent service, the best in the island for sure. The food is authentic corean. A must try!
We came already many times...

Author: e_zacharySingapore, Singapore
Title: Exceptional!!!
Review: This is probably on one of the best Korean food we've have ever tried.Food was great. Taste near perfect. Service was beyond exceptional. The manager was very friendly and recommended a few dishes that we enjoyed.Food portion is really generous.Will return the next time we are on the island!!Show less

Author: Eviannamaria
Title: Amazing
Review: Perfect service, with an incredible friendly owner and cook who are insanely customer friendly, have patience and have time to talk to you. Food is delicious. Lots of choice. Atmosphere is great. Definitely recommended!

Author: BigTone72Melbourne, Australia
Title: One of the best in Langkawi
Review: Haroo Haroo would have to be one of the best restaurants in Langkawi. 8 of us went out for dinner and were greeted by the manager who is a great man and gives honest insight into the menu. The food is soooo tasty and everyone including the children loved it. Drinks are well priced and i highly recommend this restaurant when visiting Langkawi. I cant recommend any one dish in particular cause we had 6 different dishes and they were all excellent.Show less

Author: RX1207
Title: Very Friendly and passion Owner
Review:
Very Friendly and passion Shop Owner. The food is normal Korean food price and with big portion. 
Food is good for taste.

Author: dael13Hervey Bay, Australia
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We wish we had tried this place earlier on our trip, we walked past a few times. The food and service was absolutely fantastic. The manager even sprayed us down with cooling water as it was so hot. Best food so far on Langkawi. We had fried chicken dumplings, a seafood noodle and the beef stir fry.Show less

Author: Seatroutfisher-1Hexham, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best restaurant experiences...ever!
Review: This restaurant was amazing. Not only was the food was excellent, but the service was unbelievable! It is refreshing when a floor manager offers suggestions...which are not the most expensive on the menu, but may be more to your taste. He was attentive,. but not pushy or in the way, and extremely interested in his guests, prepared to engage in conversation with all. We were treated to several 'over and above' free treats, with the owner made a point of meeting all of her guests. Do try this high point of our trip to this beautiful island.Show less

Author: HE1974ADBrussels, Belgium
Title: Very good Korean Restaurant
Review: We have been welcome very nice. Great hospitality and outstanding, very friendly staff. From the beginning to the end service was great and very considerate. The food was nice and recommendations were made. Especially since I was traveling with a vegetarian we could not have all choices of the menu. If you can't take spicy food let them know and they would either prepare it the 'non-spicy' way if possible or recommend something that suits. Overall very good choice to go. However, I would say it is in a very high price segment compared to what I have experienced in Malaysia so far and for the price.... you better make sure to have enough cash since they do not accept any credit cards which to me is very unusual as well.Show less

Author: 130herberts
Title: Best Korean food in Langkawi
Review: We were staying close by and ate here twice during a four day trip.Followed recommendations from taxi driver and TA - not disappointed.Manager (he won’t divulge his name!) is attentive, knowledgable and engaging. Explained the menu and his recommendations were spot on. Service fast and efficient. Complimentary side dishes, dessert and cool mist spray is a nice touch.Food tasty and reasonably priced. Well worth a visit even if staying downtown.Show less

Author: Joshua C
Title: Awesome experience
Review: Really delicious food. The manager (nicest guy we've ever met) had wonderful recommendations when it came to the cuisine. We followed his advice and were not disappointed.Food was well worth the money - enormous fresh portions, and there was complimentary additions, which added for a nice touch.The manager was so attentive and offered a really interesting insight into the places he had travelled to and recommendations of where to go.Such a lovely experience. It's always nice to dine somewhere where they really care about the food, the service and the customers.Show less

Author: nonstopwanderlustingGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect dining experience!
Review: Wow! Where do I even start... This has been a fantastic experience from start to finish! We never checked the reviews, saw the place when driving past on the way to our hotel. After eating Malaysian food for over a week, we suddenly felt the urge for some kimchi. We walked in late at night and were greeted by the nicest guy (the manager of the place), who turned out to be passionable about both- food and customer service. He talked us through the menu, told us a little about Korean cuisine & made some great recommendations! The food was served quickly, and was beautifully presented. Tasted incredible too! Kimchi is complimentary, beer is cold and service incredible! It’s one of those places we would go back to every night if we weren’t leaving Langkawi today! Also, to all the fellow foodies out there: the way the manager spoke about food was so great I could have listened for hours! :) Thank you Haroo Haroo! If we’re ever back in Langkawi, we’ll visit for sure! Show less

Author: Keith CCumbria, United Kingdom
Title: Good food enjoyed.
Review: I went with my wife following other reviews and we both enjoyed our experience of Korean food. The owner was very helpful if not a little eccentric. We were misted with cold water to help us cool down ( not asked for) We asked for our order to be delayed 20 mins so we could enjoy a drink first, it was however served within 5 mins. This caused the owner to have a hissy fit with his staff most of which was in our earshot. It was all a bit Fawlty Towers and we were not upset by it more amused. The food was very good and I would go back. Show less

Author: lydias666London, United Kingdom
Title: It’s the little things that count
Review: My partner and I decided to eat here as we had read great reviews and love Korean food. Although it’s a little over priced, like most restaurants in Langkawi, the food was great and the service was very helpful. I ordered the vegetarian bibimbap which was humongous but it was so good that I ate most of it. We were give complimentary pancake and omelette and ice cream after our meal. I was stuffed with good healthy food and would have returned if we had spent longer in langkawi. Show less

Author: lpainan
Title: Authentic Korean
Review: Awesome food!Attentive service. Better than our meal at the popular Orchid Ria. Definitely worth a visit while in Langkawi.

Author: vojta157Surbiton, United Kingdom
Title: i would give 6 out of 5 !
Review: Brilliant restaurant and none of the other comments are wrong. Super attentive owner?? gave his full attention to all tables describing the menu and helping with choices. What an positive energy bursting out of this gentleman! Undesirably best hospitality i have met in months - and i work in the industry ! .. absolute star !! .... The food is amazing and huge portions, staff is super attentive.Complimentary ice cream for dessert and also free water mist :))))Checkback done by very nice young lady chef (who the gentleman called the boss ;) ) who also helped tables around with their signature bbq this place really goes above and beyond and i cant wait to talk about it as perfect example of how to do things in the industryhats downs and thank you so much again for the experience !!!i was so wowed i even forgot to take pics .. hopefully will visit againShow less

Author: lisamZ4289ZL
Title: Above and beyond
Review: My boyfriend and I visited for dinner recently and we had a lovely time. We have never had Korean food and the menu descriptions as well as the staff made sure we were comfortable with everything we ordered. They also even suggested that we may be ordering too much food - I hardly ever get this from servers but it’s so appreciated. We had the prefect amount of food to try and even leftovers for lunch. The servers will bend over backwards to take care of you and the food was delicious! Also, free ice cream!!!Show less

Author: Zana M
Title: great service - delicious food
Review: the service in this restaurant is among one of the best service experience I've had. I highly recommend this restaurant!

Author: 68mickcLondon, United Kingdom
Title: “Ditto”
Review: I have to agree with most of the reviews, we found ourselves trying Korean food in Malaysia due to it’s TA ranking.Warm welcome from the owner, who even sprays you with water at your table to cool you down on humid evenings. He also told me that I should think again about ordering too much food, as we would probably not finish all of it, and that although he was grateful for the custom, he did not want us to waste our money. You don’t get that very often. The food was very tasty, and as the owner told us, plentiful. You will not be disappointed. Show less

Author: SeanR956
Title: Wow!!
Review: 10/10 experience. Perfect service and amazing food! I never write reviews but this place deserves it as it is obvious they have put a lot of time and thought into creating a perfect dining experience

Author: ljwaller42Kent, UK
Title: give it a go you won't be disappointed
Review: didn't expect to go to a Korean restaurant in Malaysia but gave it a go based on TA reviews and it was great. Good menu which staff will go through with you if you want. Shared dumplings to start which were lovely then had beef & squid bokkeum dishes, both good with nice level of spice without being overpowering. Service was faultless & the owner/chef spoke to every table after dinner. Great touches of free kimchi side dish (lovely), free ice cream & free yuzu juice at end of meal, Yum!Show less

Author: 282SueHHove, United Kingdom
Title: What lovely Food - fab
Review: We went based on trip advisor- yes the restaurant overlooks parking area but you will not regret it. The service was perfect, the food was divine and the owner a beautiful lady who was also the chef personally came and spoke with everyone. Free ice cream and drink at the end. They even made sure they called the cab as it would be cheaper and the owner waited to say goodbye. I cannot stress what a lovely experience this restaurant was. No doubt an absolute must doShow less

Author: Andy SCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Good honest food
Review: Being veggies we did find it a bit of a struggle for choice, but the waiter, a guy from Punjab, sorry didn’t get his name, was very good at understanding our needs and was so polite and attentive. Offering us little taster dishes free of charge to try as we waited. Food was awesome. Yeh it’s not cheap as other places, but still a fraction of UK prices for what u get. I’d go back in a heart beat. To the waiter, once again many thanks what a genuine nice guy .Show less

Author: LukeysarbearBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious and different
Review: This restaurant offers a good range of vegetarian, fish and meat options. Including delicious starters and a complimentary scoop of ice cream to finish. We both really enjoyed out meal. It was an especially hot evening and so we were greatful of the friendly staff misting us with cold water!!Not the cheapest but far from expensive and worth it. Not quite 5 stars as restaurant's location next to road is not ideal.. Show less

Author: Totta_AndersStockholm, Sweden
Title: Great food, great staff!
Review: We went here three times during our two week stay in Langkawi and it was our favourite place. The food is really really good and the staff superfriendly (and fun)!The dish with squid was super tasty, as well as the one with chicken wrapped in lettuce.Lots of great options on the menu, as well as a very tasty white wine.After dinner you even get a complimentary scoop of ice cream - nice touch!Show less

Author: iheart2travel_8
Title: Excellent
Review:
Loved this place and owner!  Food and service was amazing!  The owner explained the food in the menu and made great recommendations plus I enjoyed the conversation with him.  
Nice complimentary ice cream as well.  
Highly recommend this restaurant.

Author: wendi aParis, France
Title: Adding my 5-star rating to the plethora of others!
Review: This restaurant doesn’t need another 5 star rating but I’m taking the time to put my 5 star rating in the pile. The food is amazing! We were only on Langkawi for 3 nights and we ate here 2 of them, it was that good! Perfectly balanced seasonings, the freshest ingredients, beautiful presentation-a real delight for the sensesI And the service was over the top! Really friendly and attention to,every detail. A winner at all levels!Show less

Author: Destination679551
Title: excellent food
Review: Excellent food and very friendly staff, they had very good recommendations. This was the 4th time here, never disappointed. Hope to come back again

Author: AgniesKielceKielce, Poland
Title: Great! Marvelous!
Review: My daughter is vegan and I do not eat meat, yet we have enjoyed very delicious supper. We had spring rolls that are a bit different of what we are used to but very testy. And I had very, very and once more, very delicious noodles made of sweet potato strach. My daughter had kimchi And tofu And she had loved. Additionally, płace is really nice And clean and service is on high level. I trully recommend not obły to vegan vegtarians - as I have seen, meat is also servedShow less

Author: bostonbear75Boston, Massachusetts
Title: Excellent food and service!
Review: I read the reviews before I went to this restaurant. I have to say there’s a reason that it’s ranked as #3 among the 432 restaurants in Langkawi.The food was delicious. We ordered bimbimbam, seafood scallion pancake, beef soup with glass noodles (forgot the actual name of the dish), and soup with squid and tofu. The service was excellent and very attractive. The only shortcomings were fly issues and no air conditioning. Except that, everything was perfect.Show less

Author: ElenaC1788
Title: Best service in Langkawi
Review: Very good food and the best service in Langkawi. The kids loved the attention, the ice cream offered before leavind. The atmosphere is so relaxed. We definitely enjoyed ourselves and recommend the place.

Author: Breebee7
Title: Best service in down
Review:
If you want a good food experience then this is the must go place in langkawi
 Service was over the top and food was good too.

Author: BenChen86Singapore, Singapore
Title: Service blew us away!
Review: Came here for dinner after seeing the great reviews on TripAdvisor and the restaurant did not disappoint. Ordered drinks, Beef Bibimbap and Kimchi Stew and the food was as authentic as u can get outside Korea. Total bill was RM110, not cheap but well affordable. Definitely perfect for anyone craving a Korean fix. The kimchi stew was especially heart-warming. What really blew us away was the amazing service! Great conversationalists and attention to every table, the atmosphere was just so welcoming. They even threw in additional items to round off an amazing night.Absolutely loved the place, the food and the service. Try it for yourself! Show less

Author: MartlorrPerth, Australia
Title: The Best Place to Eat.
Review: We ate in a lot of places in Langkawi, but this was by far the best. The Korean food was exceptional and the manager Kash was extremely helpful describing and recommending certain dishes on the menu. We chose what he recommended and went back two more times to order the same thing. It was delicious. Staff were very attentive without being annoying. We will definitely eat here again when we return to Langkawi.Show less

Author: DnL88
Title: Best restaurant in langkawi
Review: We visit the Restaurant two times in the evening and the service was unforgettable! The food was really perfekt - i would say it is the best food in langkawi! If i come ro langkawi again i would spend everyday here!!!

Author: KimberJet
Title: Ok If You Fancy Korean Food
Review: Food was okay, but there were lots of flies... and even sand on the table and plates.  Service was good though.

Author: Luggsy
Title: Evening meal
Review: Busy midweek restaurant. Welcoming, attentive staff who talked us through the menu. Food was delicious and came out as ordered fairly quickly and was piping hot. Reasonable priced. Would highly recommend.

Author: ToneHelen
Title: Outstanding service
Review: After visiting some restaurant with very little English knowledge me and my friend came over this restaurant. Here we got good recommendations and they patiently helped us through the menu. And the best of all, they food was well done! The recommendations was worth it!

Author: behnazz2018Stockholm, Sweden
Title: Amazing food experience!
Review: The best korean food ive tasted. Friendly staff that not only went through the menue with us cause we had difficulties deciding but also made sure all the customers was satisfied and well taken care of. Even the owner came to say hello when we about to leave, such friendly lady. Amazing food, nice ambience and friendly staff what more is needed. Show less

Author: saraalias
Title: Excellent korean food
Review: You should not miss this restaurant in Langkawee. Excellent food, Excellent customer service. Im vegetarian and this place could offer great vegetarian food, many options and also you can drink wine here😊

Author: BazBooklover1992
Title: Super tasty!
Review: Best Korean food ive ever had the bbq was a lot of fun and the staff were friendly and polite- great experience overall :)

Author: Christopher P
Title: Great Korean food and even better service
Review: Those people know the meaning of "guest". Let's not forget the genuine high-quality Korean food. We had a thouroughly enjoyable evening. If you don't know what to choose, just ask.

Author: Virginie T
Title: Really good korean barcebue
Review: We followed Tripadvisor comments and were not disappointed at all ! We went there for lunch and the staff was really nice, the food excellent (we had korean barbecue). The owner even recomended some places to eat in Langkawi.Would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants to try korean food in Langkawi !Show less

Author: Linda D
Title: Korean Food in Langkawi
Review:
Fabulous Korean food, nice atmosphere and fast friendly service. 
Not only was the food good but the attentiveness of the staff and the complimentary side dish and ice cream made the dining experience so special.
Many thanks from Canadian Grandmas.

Author: Nicole_711
Title: Good try Korean restaurant
Review: For the gourmet Korean food patrons, would recommend the wider choices in KL. However, given the limited Korean variety on offer in Langkawi, is reasonable in taste and price.

Author: katvigil33Denver, Colorado
Title: So delicious!
Review: A few days ago, my sister, her husband and I decided to go eat at Haroo and this place exceeded our expectations! Not only was the food amazing and authentic, but the entire staff was on point. We had the pleasure of being served by Cash. He guided us through the menu, introduced us to delicious new dishes and treated us like family. This place is definitely a must. Enjoy! We can’t wait to go back! Thanks again Cash! You truly are a rockstar! P.S. We tried mango sticky rice for breakfast here in Thailand. So amazing! Show less
