Author: Kezmictravellers
Title: Great food. Great service
Review: The food was excellent here on both lunch and dinner visits. The owner is very accommodating and helpful. The price s very moderate for tourists. Would recommend.

Author: DennomrasekFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Awesome!!!
Review: Had an awesome evening, staff were overwhelming friendly and most important, the food was delicious. Big portions, good quality and we even get two portions of ice cream per person on top for free.I do highly recommend it to anyone who wants to try Korean food! There really is nothing to complain about! Show less

Author: Sally TAlbuquerque, New Mexico
Title: A truly authentic Korean restaurant with the best service!
Review: My hubby and I were misled by Waze and when we googled for Haroo's location. Both still showed their former location in Pantai Cenang when the owners had relocated to Pantai Tengah a year ago. Haroo is next to a cafe called "KAYA"! We found it by chance 3 days later on a tourist map which we picked up from our resort. Haroo is a family owned restaurant and is very personalised. The lady boss is friendly and hands on at the tables when the place is busy.We love Korean food and we must say this place is really good with their Tukbaegi Bulgogi, thinly sliced beef with broth and glass vermicelli served in a claypot. We also have the Bibimbab, an assortment of vegetables with chicken, egg, seaweed on brown rice. Here they bring along a squirt bottle of Gochujang (a Korean spicy bean sauce) when other Korean restaurants just slap the sauce on the Bibimbab. The nice gesture is the serving of complimentary ice cream at the end of our meal. A few reviews complain of the over pricing but believe me, the price you pay for your meal is worth every cent! The service is exceptional cos the servers are attentive and well trained.Show less

Author: SelenaCoolSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Authentic Korean food
Review: Love the food! We had a veggie pancake and beef rice. Simply delicious. The service was really good too. The staff kept checking on us. They gave us ice cream for dessert. Complimentary. Would have gone back to try out other dishes if we had more time there. Highly recommended place. Show less

Author: Cas C
Title: Delicious amd friendly.
Review: The best Bibimbap and Japchae I have ever eaten. Service was amazing with super helpful staff. We had a party of 20 which they easily accommodated. The food arrived quickly as did our drinks. I highly recommend Haroo Haroo if you want an exceptionally delicious meal, incredibly attentive and helpful staff and a relaxed dining experience. If you've never eaten Korean before the staff will recommend something to your taste. You will not be disappointed. Show less

Author: Wakey40Aus
Title: Holiday Adventure
Review: Had the fortune of going to Haroo Haroo on the 16th of Jan 2019 as part of our friends birthday celebrations and what a sensational experience it was being our first time enjoying a traditional Korean food - Great food, friendly and knowledgeable staff, definitely recommended giving Haroo Haroo a try if your in Langkawi.Show less

Author: s0us0uradaKastoria, Greece
Title: Amazing staff & food
Review: We went to eat with friends and our kids.The metre very friendly suggest us where to sit.The restaurant is very nice decorated and the plates are big enough and have a nice presentation.The food was delicious.At the end the chef/owner comes in our table to see if everything was ok and offer to us the sweet.Thank you so much hope to see you again in our country!Show less

Author: SusanM801
Title: Lovely Food
Review: Great food.  Fabulous service.  Very pleasant experience.  Would love to return sometime in the future.

Author: Jase8213Shoreham-by-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Korean Taste bud extravaganza!
Review: Firstly let me say neither my wife or I have never eaten Korean food before, that will change in the future. From the very warm and personal welcoming, to the full explanation of the menu (even though we both felt it was also well explained on the paper copy), with a real in depth description of the tastes, spices and things to expect by the friendly and passionate gentleman. The starter, chicken dumplings (very good!) followed Tukbaegi Bulgogi for the wife, and a spicy chicken dish (forgot the name) for myself was finished up with a small palate cleaning ice cream (complimentary) and some fairly decent red wine. Great hospitality, customer service all finished with the owner and chef also making an appearance. If in Langkawi and within the vicinity, you will not be disappointed!Show less

Author: 527martineeMelbourne, Australia
Title: Blown away by the service and food
Review: Let me start by confessing that I have never eaten Korean food before. That will certainly be changing when I get home. We were made to feel so welcome when we arrived and the host went through the menu with us and guided us on what the most popular dishes were and what could be shared or not. The food was delicious. The chicken dumplings (gun Mandu)were yummy (and I don’t normally like dumplings). and the bibimbap was to die for! The staff were so friendly sharing travel stories and funny jokes. They really made everyone feel welcome. They even gave us free ice cream and yuja tea. The owner came and introduced herself and again was so welcoming. Truely a great experience and the best service I have had in a long time. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Bekkamobo
Title: Most friendly staff around
Review: This restaurant has outstandingly good staff and they were extremely friendly. Food was good and the ice cream made the whole deal perfect. Recommending!

Author: Marc FBali, Indonesia
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Amazing menu. Amazing service. Great ambiance. The menu has lots of choices and the staff explain the dishes very well and how to properly eat them. High quality food. A bit pricey for Langkawi but justified because the food is great! Will go back for sure.Show less

Author: karoliinaSaa70
Title: Our vacations best restaurant
Review: Amazing service, they did more than would expect. It felt like the waite really cared about our well-being. Foods that the waiter recommended were excellent and costing reasonable price. Also the restaurant felt and looked Korean.

Author: Graeme641
Title: Great food, friendly staff
Review: We ate at this restaurant twice. We haven't eaten much Korean food before but it was delicious. Service was good and the price was reasonable. I'd definitely recommend it.

Author: shaei2014
Title: Delicious and friendly staff
Review: Really enjoyed our late lunch here. Service was impeccable, with suggestions on what to choose and large portion sizes.

Author: 464lenak
Title: Little Korean paradise in langkawi
Review: Go for it with your family and kids. And omg, perfect ice cream as compliments will make you very, very happy!

Author: Arne Kristian AOslo, Norway
Title: Great service and wonderful food
Review: The best food and the best service on our trip so far. They were trying hard to accomodate to our somewhat picky kids, and made good recommendations. They also made sure we ordered enough, but not too much food. On top of that, our food was absolutely deliscious. I rarely write reviews, this time I do because they deserve it!Show less

Author: rodk548Prague, Czech Republic
Title: Christmas Day Fast Food
Review: We found this restaurant on Trip Advisor and chose to try based on the reviews. The staff made sure we didn’t choose too much. Unfortunately the seafood dish we wanted was finished.The food was ok if a little pricey for the soups we ordered.However, what made out visit memorable, for the wrong reasons, was the speed at which the waiters ran back and forward between the kitchen and tables, led by the manager/owner. It felt like there was panic due to something we were unaware of and this made the whole experience quite stressful.The only thing that was missing was the staff performing ‘the lightning bolt’ (Usain Bolt victory celebration) as we left.It brought a whole new meaning to fast food!Show less

Author: kimreynard
Title: Great service
Review: Great service, delicious selection of food. The owner gave us recommendations and we took his advice and did not regret. LOVED the spicy chicken lettuce cups. Would go back time and again

Author: NanehZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellence service bar none
Review: Food was delicious, service particularly by the owner is excellent!!!!! The moment we sat down, he ensure that we were comfortable by putting a portable fan near us and also offering us cold ice water. He then recommended us and also advised us on the portion so that we would not over order. Food was great and awesome! Highly recommended!! Thank you for the great experience!Show less

Author: noimingguLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Never disappoint me
Review: It's the most comfort food in Langkawi. Must visit and try the food over here. It's original Korean food. They also give you side dishes and ice cream for desert as complimentary. It's really nice. Really recommend this place and definately gonna back all the time Show less

Author: heracles2626 .
Title: Everything was amazing!! An experience not to be missed!
Review: Amazing food, fantastic service. We were planning our 2nd visit before we had even finished our 1st! Highly recommended!!

Author: Gmoney33
Title: Beautiful food and great service
Review: We are here twice during our stay in Langkawi and we loved it each time. The serves were generous and the food was delicious. The service was also friendly and helpful and helped make the whole dining experience really special

Author: Carol GBaldock, United Kingdom
Title: Return visit
Review: Recently had a wonderful week in Langkawi and visited Haroo Haroo twice. On both occasions we had beef bokeum and the grilled beef platter which were delicious. We are great fans of Korean food and this restaurant didn’t disappoint. The manger was also very helpful in advising us on food choices and we loved the complementary Oreo ice cream. Will definitely go again on our next visit to Langkawi.Show less

Author: ller
Title: Best place to Eat
Review: Super friendly service and delicious food. Like the Bibimbab, japchae and grilled beef. They even recommended a local restaurant (WK12) and the dishes to try.

Author: Pia L
Title: Great foodexperience
Review: Amazing food and great servie! Go there if you can!  Best food and service we had during our stay in Langkawi!

Author: Maximilian L
Title: Amazing food, fantastically friendly staff
Review: Had dinner here with my family and tried a few different different dishes - it was all amazing! Very tasty and the staff really made an effort to present the food, show us how to eat it in a traditional Korean sense (never had much Korean) etc. A dish is around 30-50 ringgit, and worth every penny :). Definitely worth a visit while in Langkawi! Best regards from SwedenShow less

Author: Foodieman75
Title: Must Try Restaurant
Review: This is a must try restaurant in Langkawi. They combine mouth watering Korean culinary delights with excellent 6 stars service.The restaurant manager speaks flawless Queen's English and gives you a running commentary on the menu to help you choose dishes which suit your taste buds.Go for it! You must try Haroo!Show less

Author: claud1neJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: We loved it!
Review: Good food and good service! The best Korean food i had in Malaysia! The place is nice and quiet and the staffs are really friendly and for the Mister, we did went to the warung you recommended us the day after, thank you for the recommendation! We will definitely go to this restaurant if we go to Langkawi again!Show less

Author: Shannon-breaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food. Great service.
Review: My partner and I have been finding it hard to find good food on the island. The service was amazing. We were made to feel very welcome by I assume the owner, who had great recommendations on their favourite dishes. Food comes out quickly and large portion sizes. We were given a complimentary dish at the beginning which was yum. The price is reasonable for the food but high for the island. Good experience, highly recommend. Show less

Author: LesleyB767London, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: We had read about Haroo Haroo on trip advisor and were so glad we had. We drove from the Datai for lunch and it was worth the drive. The food was outstanding, however it was so much more. The serving staff were fabulous but most importantly they were informative, we tried everything they recommended and we were not disappointed. It felt like we were on a Korean eating journey, and I am certain we willSearch out Korean restaurants on our return to London, absolutely loved the food. When we come back to Langkawi, Haroo Haroo will be a must visit on our itinerary. This is the type of place you love to find on holiday, so glad we did. Show less

Author: PalinaKozyravaCologne, Germany
Title: Food need improvement
Review: The staff is very friendly and the place itself is quite nice. Nevertheless I really don’t like to get convenient food at a restaurant. The spring rolls were industrially made and tasted not good. They need to improve their kitchen and products definitely bit the restaurant has potential for sure.Show less

Author: ekta p
Title: Fantastic vegetarian
Review: Our host "Jenny" was so welcoming and friendly. He ensured we get a great meal that is less spicy based on our request. Kept entertaining us throughout the lunch. Made a special Korean lemonade and the kimchi was super good.

Author: betsyt26Los Angeles, California
Title: Highly recommended
Review: The manager of this restaurant MAKES this restaurant so entirely your own that it is hard to believe that you haven’t been coming here for years. He works diligently to know each of his customers names and preferences, especially the children! He visits each table personally throughout your dining experience to ensure that all of the needs of all of his guests are met!The food is fresh, and very well prepared by Isabel; she even prepared plain noodles for our pickiest eater! While we are practicing vegetarians, our guests were meat eaters and we all ate our fill! The menu is large and yet no request was too small to be accommodated! This place should be on the top of your list for places to eat and revisit time and again! Kudos to the manager Mr. Ban!Show less

Author: claudiabsyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly Owner
Review: The owner of the restaurant is friendly. He's good at recommending what's on the menu. We ordered 2 dishes but couldn't recall the name of the dishes. The soup in a hot pot was good and suitable for children. The bulgogi was so so. Price is a bit steep. Can consider this place if you crave for Korean food when visiting Langkawi. Show less

Author: LeslieYWK71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Probably the best Korean food I have eaten in my life
Review: My wife recommended me this restaurant as she read ab it via TripAdvisor. I had my reservation initially but hey, how wrong was I - the owner was super friendly and humourous too lol...he recommended the bibimbap and tukbaegi bulgogi and I had such a satisfying time! Thank you to the Malaysian owner for such awesome hospitality and great food Show less

Author: lavender86
Title: The best meal!
Review: We are craving for korean food and found this place. Amazing service and yummy food (huge portion too). They do not serve banchan. Kimchi is chargeable.

Author: RedDaisy88
Title: Get the Bibimbap!
Review: We dined here last week and it was great! The service was top notch - super friendly and happy to make recommendations. They food was all delicious, especially the bibimbap - it was all well priced too. Definitely recommend.

Author: craigc243Staffordshire, United Kingdom
Title: First time
Review: First time many of us has had Korean food. The menu was explained beautifully by a very entertaining helpful member of staff.All the food we had was deliciousThe staff stopped us from over ordering and kept bringing goodies for our two year old.Very happy experience and would recommend thisShow less

Author: mias207
Title: Excellent Korean food and wonderful service
Review: We had the best Bibimbap we have ever tasted! And the waiters were so service minded and friendly! We got extra starters and even a dessert. We would abselutely recommend this to everybody!

Author: AodreenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great time in Haroo Haroo Korean Restaurant
Review: We had a great dinner in Haroo Haroo 10 days ago. Love the food so much with a nice ambience. Thanks for the great hospitality, we had a great laugh throughout the night. Highly recommended to Korean food lovers. notes: no air-conditioning and cash term only.Show less

Author: prashantkatariabangalore
Title: Stellar Service (and food too)!
Review: had lunch here on a hot and humid day (if there any other kind in Langkawi?) and left beaming from ear to ear! the service was superb with excellent suggestions and regular dosage of jokes! the vegetarian korean food I had here was excellent. had jap-chae, bokeum and spring rolls. Meat eaters in our group loved the food as well. I would Definitely come back when next in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Stay27635761249
Title: Spectacular food dinning area
Review: A must try , authentic Korean restaurant , serve with scrumptious, juicy beef stew, delectable chicken and with many other excellent choices. Drink wise, you ask? Refreshing!!! Aloe Vera tea and Yuk tea is a must. If you are an alcohol lover , you are most welcome here.Servers here is extremely helpful and friendly. Peaceful environment with serene music , definitely a noteworthy hidden gem in LANGKAWI!Perfect for every occasion, as a person which is critical and picky with food. I would definitely recommend this restaurant!!!!Show less

Author: Trifve
Title: Nice food, nice hospital & dine in✨
Review: Korean food menu choices is a lot. Food taste good. Good evening place for dinner with love ones. Great staff hospitality also✨

Author: kmb34
Title: Delicious Korean dinner made with local ingredients and friendly service
Review: Friendly service, delicious food brought quickly, and even a small complimentary ice cream to finish. An excellent dinner - would recommend and would go back.

Author: Altern8d
Title: Authentic Korean Food
Review:
Excellent Korean food!Fresh ingredients,great service and good comes out quickly also!
Highly recommend and will definitely be back.

Author: Chazmus
Title: Delicious
Review: Excellent service from Kash and absolutely delicious, authentic tasting, Korean food. Hugely recommended!

Author: KLVictoriaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I am back for more!
Review: My second visit to Langkawi and also to Haroo Pantai Tengah. The quality taste of their food and hospitality are still above average in my opinion as I am picky eater and not easy to please. We had Tofu Bibimbap salad to start (sharing) and later Chicken Bulgogi Stew (zero spicy) and Calamari Bokeum. (less spicy) Simple plating presentation, but amazing interesting flavors. Pricing is not cheap for locals but moderate for tourists. The overall dining experience makes the extra price seem minuscule. You do not have to believe my words...drop by and be amazed yourself. You will get your money's worth. Happy to be there again.......Gamsahamnida!Show less

Author: andreasg678London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Korean food with the best customer service
Review: We found this restaurant on trip advisor and we decided to give it a go. The waiters were very attentive and they explained all the dishes. They didn’t try to convince us to take more food than needed for the two of us. The food was very tasty!Show less

Author: DannyC145
Title: Great night
Review:
From the minute you step foot in the restaurant you are taken care of. Host was more than accommodating.
Food was amazing. Good price. Great tips for around the island.

Author: EuniceLiu
Title: Over priced and not authentic
Review: It’s really over-priced for all the foods in the menu. I rather pay this type of price for fine dining in Italian restaurant. Furthermore, only can pay in cash. Nothing special to brag about.

Author: annaf451
Title: A real gem
Review: We had the most amazing service, they took so much time and looked after us like princesses, the food was amazing, anything you try will be delicious!

Author: AzriHussain
Title: Good food with genuine people
Review:
Our second visit here!
Our favorite Korean restaurant so far in Langkawi!
We really love the food here.
The portion are always generously a lot!
You can always tell them to customize the spiciness according to your preference.
The staffs are always helpful.

Author: ZeeHamdan1989
Title: Simply superb!
Review: I’ve had my first korean meal in London. And I thought that was already superb. Until I tried the food here! Superb food, generous portion and super friendly people and staff! Highly recommended! 💖

Author: aoidinc
Title: Impeccable Korean Cuisine, Even Better Service
Review: This place is an experience and a half if your visiting langkawi. The service is something else - our waiter (presumable the owner?) was absolutely hilarious, gave us fantastic recommendations. The restaurant itself is in tip top condition - decked out in traditional Korean style. All 5 people in our group thoroughly enjoyed our meals - a mixture of veggie and non veggies. Got kimchi, tofu, beef and chicken dishes, all fantastic quality! Show less

Author: mathiaskall
Title: Best Korean food in a long time
Review: Exceptional food and service. The waiter gave us recommendations regarding the menu and explained the different kinds of dishes. So good I had to create an account and give my first review. Highly recommend the Bokeum Chicken and the Yu Ja iced tea. The waiter together with the food was really 5* and it is must visit in Langkawi.Show less

Author: JPFerreira30
Title: Best food in town
Review: Awesome and friendly staff. Great suggestions... had wonderful time and the food is magnificent. Trully recommend.

Author: bryanoh07
Title: Excellent dinner with even better host
Review: We had dinner here last night. Fantastic food and the host was excellent. Explained the menu and gave us his recommendations without being pushy. The free ice cream and sprays of water to cool down also definitely helped!

Author: Priteshshah74
Title: Wonderful!!
Review: An exceptional restaurant with great food and great service. Owner is on tap to advise on the menu. Food was exceptional, a credit to Korean food. Seafood pancake was incredible, light, tasty and wonderfully seasoned. Exceptional place, recommend.

Author: SmileypokeyPenticton, Canada
Title: Wonderful food and exceptional service.
Review: Wonderful restaurant! Food, service and ambiance all exceptional. The host helped us with the menu and carefully described the Korean dishes for us. We chose Beef Bulgogi and Chicken Bukchon. Delicious complex flavours, perfectly spiced. Each dish comes with Korean rice as well as a small condiment dish of kimchi, green onion cake and some other delicious morsel. Complimentary ice cream is served at the end. With 2 beer, bill was 108 MYR, very good value.Service is really outstanding and made us very comfortable. When we finished, the host sprayed us with mist to cool us off. We ate outside and he made sure a cooling fan was nearby along with mosquito coils. Highly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: Tijn H
Title: Nice place
Review:
What a nice place to go to, lovely staff and great food! 

The way the staff treat you makes you feel as a guest instead of a customer!

Author: StefvanWoudenbergEnschede, The Netherlands
Title: Great experience
Review: We went to have dinner here as the place got very recommended and al the expectations we had were confirmed. The manager was indeed very attending and took great care of us as were the other two waiters. The place is situated near the road, but this doesn't bother at all. The manager recommended some of the dishes and we took most of his recommendations to heart and we didn't regret this one moment. When we saw that the place only takes cash and we checked our wallet we expected to not have enough and mentioned this to he manager. He offered to scooter us to the nearest ATM after dinner or to bring the remeinder to him the next day...great! The dinner was over before we knew it and we were very satisfied and the bill was far below our expectations so we were able to pay the same evening ;-). When you have time to visit this restaurant, you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Gurpreet V
Title: Nice weather awesome food n great service
Review: Last day we was here for dinner.They welcome us with welcome drinks. we ordered Tukbegi bulgogi and chicken bukom which was very delicious n after finished our meals they give us complimentary ice cream. Its a nice touch. we are very very happy to doing dinner here. i wish on my next travel in langkawi i will be come back again.Show less

Author: Peter KAustralia
Title: All talk , no action
Review: We dropped by the night before we actually decided to eat here and there was a very smooth talking guy who was intent on telling us everything we should know but wasn't too keen on listening to what we wanted. When we did arrive the following night he presented us two menus and I explained that I would have liked the on table BBQ but as he explained it was only for two people both eating the meat BBQ, I explained that my wife does not eat red meat and he then suggested a dish for me that was BBQ prepared in the kitchen and a dish that came in a choice of chicken , beef or seafood for my wife, she chose chicken. Well a delicious beef dish arrived in front of me and I started to eat and a few minutes later a beef dish arrived placed in front of my wife. When we explained that she had ordered chicken all hell broke loose , my dish was taken away from under my eyes and I was given what they had for my wife , ten minutes later a chicken dish arrived for my wife after mister smooth insisted she had ordered beef, not! When the bill arrived I noticed we were charged for two beef dishes but they had tried to placate us prior to this with a small scoop of "complimentary" ice cream. I couldn't be bothered arguing by this time , we paid the bill and left , never to return.Show less

Author: Exploration822461
Title: Great
Review: The food was delicious n the service was awesome. I highly recommend this place for spend a great time in here😍😍😍😍🤩🤩🤩

Author: Fastapoh
Title: "Great value for money"
Review:
Clean cosy environment,customer service that is passionate and seems to care attitude topple with great tasting foods that has interesting flavors. Overall, a memorable and enjoyable dining experience.Amazing job and kudos to the proprietor..great crew you have.Keep it up.
(Be aware..Ringgit only, no cards.)

Author: illyariffin
Title: You got try this place out 😁
Review: Glad that we decided to have dinner here on our 5th night at langkawi. Should have come earlier.Tried many other shop and after many night we get bored of seafood so korean seems like a nice change for our taste buds. We enjoyed the yummy meals (chicken glass noodle soup + pancake + spicy beef set). We can easily said they served good kimchii. The host abd staff are very friendly and even gave us recommendation to try out other places. Portion are very generous, you can even share a meal for 2 person. Very child friendly. Both of our kids are given with complimentary toys + balloons + funny specs. We even received complimentary ice cream before we go off. Hospitality is simply tip top. We are a happy customer and would definately come back to dine if we come to langkawi again :)Show less

Author: Judith N
Title: NEVER EATEN KOREAN BEFORE...DELICIOUS
Review: We stopped for just a light lunch and a beer which is on the main road of Pantai Tengeh. We thought we'd try a Korean pancake. Delicious.

Author: 207yurik
Title: Not an authentic Korean restaurant
Review: If you are familiar with Korean cuisine, this is not a place to go. Food tasted like cheap Malaysian local cuisine. Disappointed!

Author: KGunnell
Title: Fantastic food and great recommendations!
Review: We loved this restaurant so much we went back 3 times! Highly recommend the food, especially the beef claypot and the limoncello lemonade! The service was faultless and the proprietor was super friendly and helpful, even giving us recommendations for other food spots in Langkawi (we went to 3 of his recommendations and they were all brilliant!) Really lovely people and restaurantShow less

Author: Kamil_Basheer
Title: Amazing Korean food
Review: Their meals is fantastic as it is our first time tasting korean food. Taste very delicious and we enjoyed their BBQ so much with family

Author: pinkbeach46Melbourne, Australia
Title: Good food
Review: We weren't really a fan of the local food so we thought we'd have some Korean food. The owners are Korean and the manager is Malaysia. The manager is an awesome guy and super friendly. The customer service is really good here and the food is decent too. You are not paying local prices here but you don't expect to either. Would definitely come by if you need some decent food that ain't Chinese or Malaysian. Show less

Author: Rebeccanaulor6Polington
Title: First time eating Kaorean
Review: Arrived at Haroo Haroo not knowing what to expect. The manager greeted us, offered chilled water whilst we looked at the menus. Seating area is nice with cushions provided on the seats and a spare chair to put your bag. After a short while he came to offer his advise on dishes on the menu. We went with his recommendation and we more than happy. Food was tasty and flavoursome. A suggestion of a Korean beer was made, hesitantly we said yes , and what a enjoyable drink. Customer service was excellent, its the nice touches such as cold water on arrival, Korean lemonade to sample and ending the meal with complimentary ice-cream. A lovely night. Anyone visiting Langkawi I would suggest a meal here. Thank you for a great introduction to this cuisineShow less

Author: hohohokoKK
Title: Superb service!!
Review: Totally recommend this place! Good service. Good food. Good staff. Genuine care for the guest. Instantly move the fan blowing towards us when he saw that we feel hot, without us asking to. First class to “Janie” the Chinese gentlemen! He is truly amazing! Very detail to the guest! Show less

Author: MaryEllenIre
Title: Incredible service!
Review: I had a lovely lunch at Haroo Haroo and it was probably the best service I have ever received! The restaurant manager was incredibly friendly and attentive and made some great recommendations for food and drinks. Lots of options for vegetarians too!

Author: Biya233
Title: Amazing food and lovely service
Review:
Simply awesome! Great food & Great service ! 
Highly recommended! We have been welcomed and recommended some great food which we throughly enjoyed ! 
Must try all

Author: 159fritsc
Title: Briljant
Review: Briljant restaurant, honest food, great taste. Excellent personnel, friendly and all working with passion. Superb hygiene. Can really recommend this place!!!

Author: ChandraS3New Delhi, India
Title: Amazing Korean Restaurant
Review: It was a visit for lunch with a Korean friend. We did not have too much time, requested the Mangaer for a Vegetarian preparation. the Restaurant Manager and the Chef were more than obliging, Nice decor, friendly and efficient staff. Highly recommended even for vegetarians, having a wonderful first hand experience.Show less

Author: Go817075
Title: Nice korean restaurant ...
Review:
I love this place so much, I love the foods, and Kimbab is my favorite korean food ...
The menu was change together with the price so expensive, but still oke for delicious food with big portion ...

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: First Time Tasted Good Korean Food
Review: This is the first restaurant we went after we touched down from KL. After reading do many good reviews and top rank restaurant in Langkawi, we decided to give a try even though we are not a big fan of Korean food. But after eating the food here, we have the liking of Korean food. All dishes we ordered (couldn’t remember the name) tasted very delicious and freshly prepared. We will definitely come here again in the future. Show less

Author: Say L
Title: Good restaurant
Review: The food is fresh, clean and tasty. A good restaurant in here. Suitable for health lovers. Owner Recommend to eat thoroughly.

Author: PooPaeK4
Title: Good service 👍🏼
Review: Delicious food, taste is traditional Korean, good service staff, good-hearted, friendly. Overall, it is a very good restaurant.

Author: Rach BAbu Dhabi
Title: Great Food and Fantastic Service!
Review: We decided to try this place as we were walking past one night. We were warmly welcomed by the staff and presented with the menus. As my friend and I were both new to Korean food we must have looked very confused. The server came over and put us out of our misery by walking us through the menu and making some super recommendations along the way. He then gave us a few minutes to decide. What we really liked was that when we were placing our order, he told us that we were ordering too much and suggested that we put some dishes on hold until we could decide if we wanted more. We were quite surprised given that often times restaurants are just happy to let you order and waste/take home rather than advise you against ordering too much. We happily took his advise and held off on some dishes. We tried the Bulgogi soup (delicious and warming) and the Beef Bokeum (flavourful). True enough due to the huge portion sizes we were stuffed and could not order our 'on hold' dishes any more. We also had the Yuja Lemonade which was refreshing and just sweet enough. The complimentary kimchi before the meal and the ice cream after was a nice touch and added to our experience! We hoped to go back and try some more dishes the next day but did not have much time. Highly recommended for a nice time out when in Langkawi!P.S. Restaurant is cash only so make sure you have enough when you go.Show less

Author: Epi P
Title: A Great Choice
Review: Love love the ambience and the food. Value price and the staff are very friendly! Great food too. LOVE a LOTtttt. Good luck guys!

Author: NanthiniR14
Title: tasty Korean food, nice setting
Review: Slightly pricier than other restaurants around pantai Cenang/Pantai Tengah area but the waiter that served us was very attentive and helped explained the menu really well. He also made recommendations according to our preferences. The food was good, large portions and tasty.

Author: maguibeer
Title: Fantastic meal! The best at Langkawi.
Review:
Quality of food and service.

 Sympathy and helpfulness.
Efficient and very attentive and accurate service

Author: HarambaeXX
Title: GREAT STAFF N FOOD
Review: The staff were so friendly they were very polite and made us feel very happy, would definitely come back to Langkawi for this

Author: VincentL4295
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Friendly hospitality and awesome food. The seafood pancake was even better than the ones we tried in Korea. Highly recommended.

Author: ValueSeeker83
Title: Always my 1st stop everytime in Langkawi
Review: I think it is the best restaurant in Langkawi. Clean, free side-dishes and a lot of Asian beverage. It will always be my 1st stop everytime visiting Langkawi. Great vegetarian option.

Author: lina_kiwiAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Amazing service and lovely food!
Review: Had lunch here and it was truly an amazing experience. My partner and I loved the food. I am not a massive fan of Korean food but this place is real nice. We had fried dumplings which were very tasty and the kimchi was best I have ever had. The service was incredible. The portions are real large so one main between two is enough. It’s super clean, water is filtered so can have ice with no worries, they even spray you with water to keep you cool and refreshed (sounds a little odd but go for it!!) They really though about every little thing to make their customers happy. Show less

Author: srdbsoUnited Kingdom
Title: Great service and lovely food!
Review: This is a great place to eat in Langkawi! The waiter we had was really great. He talked us though all the popular dishes and offered us a taster of some Korean tea. He also sprayed us with water as we were so warm! The food was delicious and came out really quickly! There is a 10% service charge added on but we didn’t mind paying when we’d had great service and complimentary ice cream! Show less

Author: Devon H
Title: Small slice of heaven!
Review: Myself and two other friends have just left Haroo Haroo restaurant extremely satisfied with both the food and the service. Dumplings, korean style chicken soup and seafood pizza to name just afew, all of which were amazing. Proper Korean food! Thanks again from New Zealand :) Show less

Author: kylez_182Bentleigh, Australia
Title: Korean delight!
Review: I'm not a huge fan of Korean food but after reading the TA reviews i had to give it a go...and it was AWESOME! From the food, the ambiance and the staff this place has it all. The manager is so friendly and loves a chat. He made some great recommendations to order and we were not disappointed! With complementary kim chi and ice cream to finish it couldn't get any better. They even scootered us to an atm when we didn't have enough cash to pay (it's cash only). It was enough to make me a korean food convert. Show less

Author: adequate8Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food
Review: Went last night on back of TA reviews and not disappointed! Nice setting with a number of tables in and outside to choose from. The manager (?) went above and beyond to explain the menu, suggest best sellers and inform us of details on specific dishes - helped us tremendously!All the food with amazing, especially the beef bokeum which is out of this world! Show less

Author: review_princess2010Gatley, United Kingdom
Title: Absolutely amazing food & service!
Review: Simply amazing!!! Had dumpling to start and two different beef dishes. The beef bokeum was to die for, absolutely fantastic. Service was amazing, the waiter asked if we wanted recommendations and we said yes and he explained the menu very well. Lovely ambience and restaurant design, and we got complimentary welcome drink and Oreo ice cream to finish! Our best meal in Langkawi. Show less

Author: 867vickih
Title: Delicious
Review: Lovely restaurant with spectacular service and authentic Korean cuisine.  We thoroughly enjoyed a varied menu which presented a good choice of dishes.  The restaurant provided a lovely setting for dinner.

Author: Marta MCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely place with amazing host
Review: Went to this restaurant because of reviews on TA and was not disappointed. I ordered chicken tukbaegi after hearing recommendation from the manager(?). Even though the dish didn’t look very interesting to me it was actually very tasty. The best part of the dinner however was encounter with the host who went over and beyond to make sure me and my boyfriend had a special time at the restaurant. The rest of the staff was also very friendlyShow less

Author: WRtootingLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and service
Review: Lankawi can be a bit hit and miss for food but this place was excellent. The food was great! We had the beef bokrum a beef stew dish and a warm salad type dish. All were excellent. The service was the real standout though. The waiter had spent time on cruise ships so was very used to providing great service and some excellent jokes. Really great place. Only downside is it is quite far from the main town but worth the journey!Show less

Author: Laura NAmersfoort, The Netherlands
Title: Best restaurant in town!
Review: Me and my boyfriend found this restaurent on Trip Advisor and even though we have not tried Korean before, we decide to give it a try. I can assure you, this is a restaurant that you really have visited during your stay in Langkawi! The staff was amazing and explained the menu very well and the food was even more amazing! We tried the Beef Bokeum and Bibimbap,that looks like a Poke bowl. Absolutely fantastic! The restaurant is very modern and very hygienic. If my path ever brings me back to Langkawi, I will definately visit haroo haroo again! Many Thanks!Show less

Author: Low Z
Title: Langkawi trip
Review: Very friendly served by the staff and nice korean food here especially the bibimbap. Nice environment as well. Highly recommend for having dinner or lunch here. There is also vegetarian menu for vegan.

Author: billalr2016
Title: Great spot!
Review: This place is wonderful. Our waiter was incredibly knowledgable and made great recommendations. Highly recommended.

Author: arjunlalbBengaluru, India
Title: Great food, amazing service!
Review: Right when 2 friends and I walked in, we were greeted with a smile and given a warm welcome. Both the staff were a delight to interact with. They started by asking if we are familiar with Korean cuisine. When we said no, they went on to describe the whole menu in detail, including the ingredients, how its prepared, spiciness level, etc. They also recommended items for us and told us the portion sizes. Every single dish we ordered were amazing! So were the drinks. The served the food items without much delay. When we didn't order any desserts because we were too full, they insisted we have something and served us delicious ice creams, on the house.Show less

Author: Jan CMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hurray Haroo Haroo!
Review: I had tried to book this restaurant from my hotel but they were obviously very busy and didn’t pick up. So chose a different restaurant. But on the way in my GRAB car saw Haroo Haroo and decided to chance it. No problem. The owner had even rung my hotel back and knew who I was when I arrived!! Well single retired Aussie lady might have been a bit of a give away.Five stars from the moment I arrived until I left. The owner placed me in a cool, breezy spot, and helped me choose a vegetarian version of their famous spicy bokeum, with sides of brown rice, egg roll, kimchi and pancake. Absolutely delicious!! The complimentary cookies and cream ice cream and the grape lollies were also unexpected extras. The wine was moderately priced as was the food.Wonderful service! Would love to visit again!!Show less

Author: ChicoY81
Title: Great food & great service
Review: We went with 4 adults and 3 small children. Food was really good, also for the children. Complementary desert was a nice addon. Service was very nice and helpfull. I would recommendate this restaurant!

Author: NomesR5
Title: Delicious food and great service!
Review: We had the chicken dumplings and spring rolls which were delicious! The manager was very talkative and the service was excellent. Highly recommended 😊

Author: phile614New York City, New York
Title: Our favourite restaurant of our Honeymoon
Review: We travelled around Langkawi for a week on our Honeymoon and decided we’d visit our favourite restaurant again at the end of our trip.What sets this restaurant apart from the rest on the island is the balance of excellent friendly customer service, quality food and value for money. The waiters have a real sense of humour to the service too.3 courses all in for a couple with drinks comes to approximately 150 MR and you’re full for this cost. The service is great recommending you different drinks which you wouldn’t ordinarily order to sample and on our second visit when I didn’t have enough cash on me to pay our bill they even offered me a lift to the nearest cash point. The restaurant is cash only.The food is delicious with enough kick to their spice but not overwhelmingly so. I’d definitely recommend a visit if you’re searching for nice places to eat whilst in Langkawi. Show less

Author: MarkcusC1
Title: Jalan2 makan2
Review: They provide vegetarian foods here so save us the trouble to look for vegetarian restaurant. Foods are tasty and the staffs are nice and friendly, service is fast as well. Price is also reasonable.

Author: KimberlyC2627
Title: Awesome food, Awesome Service
Review:
I was impressed by the food and staff here, they are nice, friendly and helpful.
The food we tried were delicious, allied with very reasonable price. I will be coming back!!

Author: NatalieC3795
Title: Korean restaurant at langkawi
Review: 很好吃，下次还会去光顾 good service,  nice place,  会介绍周围的朋友去光顾。各种菜色都合我的味口，价钱不会太贵，在langkawi 3 天2 夜共去了2 天😂😂😂 , 谢谢你们的招待

Author: 24kathrynbDunchurch, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional Food, Exceptional Service
Review: This place was incredible. We stayed the Four Seasons Resort, but wanted to get out to eat as the price of eating was so high. We found this place on Trip Advisor, and despite it being the other side of the island (a 40 minute taxi ride) we decided to give it a go.It was definitely worth the trip. For a start the taxi fare there and back, a starter, a main each, and 2 beers each cost the same as just one main course at Four Seasons!The service was faultless. We ordered 2 Tiger beers and were advised to try the Korean beer (not on the menu). We had never tried it before but really enjoyed it. We were also helped with the menu and advised not to order 2 starters as we would be too full to enjoy our mains.The food itself was incredible. I had the chicken bokeum and my husband had the beef - both were beautiful and had just the right amount of heat. We were also given some complimentary side dishes, and ice cream to finish.All in all this place is definitely worth a visit if you are staying on the island, even if you are on the other side! Show less

Author: nateokuzay
Title: Amazing food and customer service
Review: 10/10 customer service and 10/10 food. Would recommend to anyone visiting. Very generous and attentive staff.

Author: Cam H
Title: Great beef bokeum!
Review: We were very impressed by the quality and quantity of the food and the service!  Grab a seat inside under the fans.

Author: livga
Title: Great
Review: Very friendly and attentive staff. We felt very comfortable. Good korean food, with a complimentary ice cream for dessert.

Author: tishytoshy
Title: Great place
Review: Had evening meal here. Waiter fantastic- explained the menu and gave recommendations which we followed and were great. Spring rolls excellent and large enough portion for both of us. Good vegetarian options. Free ice cream :-) Good value.

Author: Jason N
Title: We went 3 times!
Review: We were only in Langkawi for about a week, yet we went to this restaurant three times because the food was so sensational and the customer service was far and above anywhere else we found in Langkawi. On our first night, we had the beef BBQ and the portions were more than generous. On the other nights, we tried the other dishes and we always left feeling full and completely satisfied. The attentive staff creates a friendly and positive atmosphere, so you can't help but want to return. Even if you don't think you like Korean food, give this place a try. It's away from the busyness of the main street, but close enough in proximity that you'll have no trouble finding your way. And, of course, you won't be disappointed. Prices are quite reasonable. Enjoy!Show less

Author: victorialu13
Title: Very pleasant and friendly
Review: The food is very tasty, the service is fast and the staff is lovely and kind. If you’re a bit lost or indecisive the owner will help you  find something for you and will even tell you his recommendations. And there’s free ice-cream!!!

Author: D3mureHitchin, United Kingdom
Title: Superb evening - everything was a delight
Review: Decided to try the restaurant as it looked busy and lively. The owner is super friendly and helpful with dish selection. We all loved our choices - my daughter and I had the bokkeum and my husband the chicken stew. The prices are not cheap by Malaysian standards but they throw in free water - pickles (I wasn’t keen on the kimchi but my husband loved it) and cookies and cream ice cream. The mango smoothie was divine. My daughter is a fussy eater and is already asking to return tomorrow night. Highly recommend Show less

Author: Roseundalex
Title: Fantastic service and quality food
Review: Their servers are very attentive, and the food is amazing! Good menu, portions are big and generous, i was also given complimentary ice cream. The place is clean and well decorated too. Must visit if you’re craving proper korean food!

Author: Fiona LWoori Yallock
Title: Great food and service
Review: Came to Haroo on tripadvisors great reviews. Wonderful greeting by staff , given cushions for the hard wooden chairs. We came around 6pm so it wasn't too busy. Wait staff came to help us with the menu as we hadn't had Korean before. We ordered chicken dumplings which were delicious and a non spicy beef stew, also yummy and a chicken vegetable stir fry- pretty fiery, but good. The stew and chicken came with mixed grain rice. Couldn't eat it all but managed the free ice cream and a couple of beers. All up came to about 140 ringgit. Probably the best service we had in Langkawi. Recommended.Show less

Author: AAli_12
Title: Very Nice food
Review: Friendly Staff and very nice services. Food and ambiance is very nice too. They have their complimentary pickle which is very good.

Author: EmmaCourtneyMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must visit in Langkawi
Review: We visited because of the high reviews and oh boy it didn’t disappoint. Service from the moment we walked in was attentive and they were very helpful with ordering - the waiters English made it very easy to communicate. Started off with the dumplings and they were heaven in your mouth! My partner and I then shared the Beef Bulgogi on the BBQ and it was amazing. Have been to many Korean bbqs before and this was by far the best! It was then topped off with a complimentary cookies and cream ice cream scoop. Highly recommend this restaurant, for not only its food but also the service Show less

Author: V6990YNphilipc
Title: Free ice cream!
Review: Herro Haroo Haroo Korea,We came because we were around the area and this has the highest rating.Our ringgit was low because a friend was poor with his wallet compartmentalisation. Even with the limited cash, we still had a great time and the service was excellent (i was fed by the korean waitress <3)Free ice cream!!!!!!Show less

Author: dimdav
Title: Great service
Review: Waiter was very friendly, passionate and energetic made it a fun experience. Food was also great. Location shown on TripAdvisor seemed to be a bit off but google maps can direct you.

Author: Deiseboyz
Title: Excellent friendly service.
Review: Good food very tasty. Good  atmosphere. Really good service very friendly and attentive. Extensive menu. Recommended.

Author: 23pernillelBerlin, Germany
Title: Best food on our trip
Review: We visited Haroo Haroo because of the recommendations from tripadviser. The service was the best experienced in whole South East Asia, it was personal and the waiter was very good at explaining and recommending a few dishes from the menu. We tried some kind of salat to start with and two hot dishes with the best beef we’ve ever tasted. The food is not comparable to any other Asian food but was so delicious and perfectly spicy. Would indeed recommend going to Haroo Haroo if you’re in Langkawi. Show less

Author: asrlt
Title: Great food & host
Review: Had a lovely family meal. Very friendly and informative host, the recommended dishes are must haves as is the kimchi. Definitely worth a visit.

Author: jespermcHouston, Texas
Title: Fantastic Korean food and service
Review: Haroo has definitely earned its spot as #1 in Langkawi restaurants. We went as 2 adults and 2 kids and started ordering. 1 Bulgogi and a kor am pancake with seafood and then wanted to order more but the server said that it should be more than enough for the 4 of us so we kept a few other dishes on hold. The bulgogi came out and we immediately knew that we should not order more. The food was very tasty and the service was great throughout the meal. We barely managed to finish the food if we did not have a boy of growing age. So he took ok it upon himself to finish the rest of the bulgogi. The surprise for the kids and the adults was the complimentary ice cream that made a great dinner complete. Show less

Author: Mujalled
Title: Best service ever
Review: One of the greatest experiences in langkawi... Every one should try it... The waiters are very very lovely and friendly

Author: MazzaM-LondonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Loved it
Review: A short walk from our hotel we discovered this gem. We were greeted in such a friendly way. Our waiter explained the menu and gave his recommendations, then left us to decide. Can’t remember what we ordered I just know it was all so tasty. Our waiter, who appeared to possibly be the owner was funny, he wanted people to enjoy their dining experience and we certainly did.Show less

Author: Emily MManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Korean food!
Review: Went here after struggling to find decent food in Langkawi main street, as this was the top place on TA we thought we would try even though we have never eaten Korean food before. I have tried kimchi but nothing else! The whole of our order was delicious, I went with a ginger iced tea, kimchi stew with tuna (served with red rice) and spring rolls. We were also served a complimentary side dish of some kimchi (cold which I actually prefer), omelette and possibly pancake with seaweed. Followed up with free ice cream! The staff were so friendly and seemed really pleased that we were trying and enjoying the Korean food. I would highly recommend this even if you haven't tried Korean before, and please try the kimchi - like a spicy cabbage pickle! Also, if visiting during the day, go to Dev's Adventure Tours next door to book any trips as they are great. :)Show less

Author: iMax89Cologne, Germany
Title: Superb Service and delicious food
Review: I went to Haroo with my girlfriend. I casually mentioned that it’s our first time eating Korean food to the waiter and he suggested to give us a run down of the menu. We placed our orders based on his recommendation:We shared the “fish soup” as a starter, I went for the spicy beef stir fry, and my girlfriend tried bibmbap.The food was simply delicious! For drinks we have been given a free sample of a Korean lemonade (for the lack of a better word). I highly recommend spiking this with the Absolute Citrus ;)After our meals we have been served some ice cream (courtesy of the restaurant) - it was vanilla with what I believe was a bit of Oreo cookie in it. Lovely.All in all this restaurant well deserves the 1st place on Langkawi!Greetings to the owner / chef and her staff!Show less

Author: Dylan W
Title: Great Staff and Food
Review:
Went here twice and had a lovely time. The girl who served us on monday night was so sweet and welcoming that we had to come back.
Not to mention the food was delish!

Author: KLVictoria
Title: Scrumptious !
Review: Great korean food ! Great service ! Passionate staff ! Great drink! Well done Haroo Haroo ! We will be back for sure.....Gamsahabnida! Tto boja !

Author: CraigN1120
Title: Loved it!
Review: Recently had a meal here and it was superb. The waiter was so passionate, knowledgeable and had a great sense if humour - even constructed a made up proposal for me and my gf that thankfully went down well. Lots of nice touches thrown in along the way, No charge for water, ice cream, a pear shot - just made us feel even more welcome. The beef bokum was superb! Unfortunately we couldn't get back for another meal but we passed a few nights later and the waiter was out chatting away to us. Definitely visit if you have the time in Langkawai.Show less

Author: AndersWoOslo
Title: Great food and service
Review: Had a great time at Haroo! The food was delicious and the service was great. Recommended place with friends. The food was plentiful when we shared two appetizers between the seven of us and a main each. Try the Soju with your meal!Total cost for dinner with beers for seven, 610 MYR.Show less

Author: 221lisamaries
Title: Brilliant
Review: Friendliest staff, great service and delicious food including complimentary snack and dessert! We will definitely come back during our stay in Langkawi!

Author: Julius F
Title: fantastic cuisine and service
Review: We had a nice evening with fantastic food and simply a perfect service. One of the most friendly waiters ever met. Thx for your great hospitality.

Author: 449christophsAlmhult, Sweden
Title: Very nice restaurant and food
Review: My wife and me are here in Langkawi for vacation (4 nights).We walked down the main street several times and passed by Haroo Haroo as well.Once back in the Hotel we checked out trip advisor and decided to try Korean food for the very first time. Even if we live in a foodie paradise, Dubai, we didn’t try Korean food so far.Fortunately we went to this restaurant, actually two times in our short stay, and we were not disappointed! The service was very good, especially for newbies like us who didn’t have an idea what to try. The recommendations didn’t disappoint us, we even decided to go a second time, so the food really really nice and we will for sure eat again Korean food thanks to this nice place and experience.Our recommendation is to try the bokkeum chicken or beef, even if it is a bit spicy. And the best time to go there is around 7:00 PM, before the „rush hour“.So if you are staying in Langkawi, don’t miss to spend (at least) one dinner here.Show less

Author: katytanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food and service!!
Review: A must try restaurant on Langkawi! It was one of our favourite meals of our whole stay on the island. The staff were so attentive and knowledgeable about the menu and seemed to be very passionate about the food they were serving. Everything was super delicious and we even got complimentary ice cream at the end of finish off the meal!Show less

Author: David W
Title: Perfect
Review: Great food, great service, great place! The food was absolutely top quality and presented well all at a reasonable price. Service from the staff were on point. Would recommend to anyone.

Author: LynSmith66Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Korean BBQ
Review: Although a little tricky to find (TripAdvisor map is not accurate), it was well worth persevering for. Beautiful fresh ingredients with lots of flavor, cooked at your table for you on a mini BBQ. It was more than enough for my wife and I. Service was great with very friendly and efficient waiters. A trap for young players, they only accept cash. Not expensive, so you don’t need a wallet full. Show less

Author: LaydeelocksKo Samui, Thailand
Title: Delicious vegetarian options, incredible service
Review: Literally the most delicious food we had in Langkawi! We stumbled across it but went back twice and received complimentary ice creamboth times. I struggled with food the whole trip (vegetarian no egg) but this was the freshest and most incredible food! My fiancé had two different meat meals said both were amazing too. Perfect value for money. The highlight was also the service, the humble, lovely and funny man who served us wouldn’t let us name him specifically as he said it was a team effort. So knowledgeable, local tips and spent time explaining things on the menu. Do yourself a favor and seek this place out!!!!! (5min walk to main Cenang area). Show less

Author: Ally LSingapore, Singapore
Title: 👍 food & Service
Review: We have to say that the service was excellent and the food was as good! Staff was very attentive and I loved the complimentary Cookie & Cream Ice Cream and topped off with a nice warm green tea at the end. Well done ! And next time we are in town !WE’LL BE BACK! Show less

Author: ryanjogorman
Title: Best Dining Experience in Langkawi
Review: Our introduction to Korean food here at Haroon Haroo was unforgettable. The service was excellent and entertaining, we were walked through some top recommendations and they delivered. The food was tasty and reasonably priced. Would definately visit again.

Author: Adventurer747426
Title: Woah!
Review: What an amazing experience !! Fabulous food. Order their bokeum beef it's sumptuous! The staff is friendly and also gave us some delicious home made ice cream.

Author: LMurray3011London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic service
Review: My husband and I went went here for dinner after reading the reviews and we were so glad we did. This was our first time eating Korean food and it was superb. The service was faultless and really made the meal. The kind gentleman recommended some dishes to us, which were all wonderful and he was extremely engaging. I wish I could employ him back home!The food was very reasonably priced, however do bear in mind that you can only pay by cash.I would definitely recommend and will be looking for a Korean restaurant when back in London Show less

Author: LizzieSkeltonSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant service I have ever had
Review: We were so impressed by the service in this restaurant! They moved the fan for us to ensure we were cool enough, they sprayed us with water to cool us down, they pushed our chairs for us, consistently topped up our waters and even gave us complementary icecream! They were so lovely and attentive. The food was absolutely delicious! We would recommend the vegetarian bibimbap, kimchi jeom and so ju drink. 100% impressed!Show less

Author: beat92Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Korean Restaurant
Review: My friends and I went to Haroo Haroo upon reading all the positive reviews on TripAdvisor and the food sure didn’t disappoint! The korean food served in Haroo Haroo tasted even better than most of the korean food in Singapore. We ordered the beef bulgogi, seafood pancake, dumplings (can’t remember the korean name for it) and tofu salad. The only underwhelming dish was the tofu salad which was a little plain, but the balance dishes were cooked really well. The beef bulgogi was very tender and tasty. The seafood pancake was really authentic and handmade (not the frozen type of korean pancakes). The dumplings were also handmade and the stuffing in the dumplings were very fresh and delicious. The staff of Haroo Haroo were also very friendly and continued to serve us even though we stayed past their closing hour (10.00 pm). They even offered us complimentary ice cream to end our meal. Overall the best meal we had in Langkawi and we would recommend Haroo Haroo for all who are looking for good food in Langkawi.Show less

Author: gurusains
Title: Great food, excellent service, Haroo is the place
Review: We were served by a very friendly manager, MK, who recommended us excellent korean dishes for our dinner. We will come again.

Author: Sro1234Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great food, great service
Review: I used to be in the former place of this restaurant, near the aquarium a year ago. I had great memories of it, and wanted my wife to taste that. We went to the new place, which is much better environment. She loved the food too, first time eating Korean.Soups, meat, pancakes... everything is yummy!There is no desert except ice cream, but it is not a problem for us.Service was really friendly and attentive to every detail. We went the twice in a row as we wanted to try other dishes !Muster try !Show less

Author: ReignYeo
Title: Great service, delicious & generous portion
Review: We had a fantastic dinner for 3 adults and 3 kids. Very friendly and thoughtful service crew and even the Korean lady boss cooked for us. We had seafood pancake and bulgogi beef. Would highly recommend if you crave for authentic Korean food.

Author: GloriaSomeHobart, Australia
Title: Excellent Korean restaurant in Pantai Tengah
Review: We dined here on the strength of the TA reviews and we weren't disappointed. The food is excellent, the 'guiding' through the menu was polished and well rehearse, maybe a little too well rehearsed as I listened to the exact same discussion occur twice at nearby tables. Nevertheless there is no question the restaurant aims to please and we were impressed by all the dishes. I would recommend Haroo Haroo if you like or are interested in Korean food.Show less

Author: lindseyh121
Title: YUM YUM YUM!!!
Review: There wasn’t anything that we ordered that wasn’t amazing!! The waiter was extremely helpful and so nice. The food was so full of flavour and cooked perfectly. We left with very full bellies! Especially after our complimentary ice cream!!

Author: matthewcA6926RSLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, amazing service
Review: The food was fantastic and the service was ever better. The waiter was extremely helpful in navigating the menu and all his suggestions were fantastic. The highlight for me were the chicken dumplings that were out of this world. The complementary ice cream and aloe Vera drink really finished off the meal perfectly. The only negative was that the tofu lacked a little texture and flavour. We would have preferred it grilled, fried or BBQed but I’m sure had we asked, they would have done this for us. Show less

Author: GroupBA
Title: HAROO, I LOVE YOU 😂
Review: Well my title is pretty cheesy but One restaurant that I would definitely recommend to those who are in langkawi would be Haroo.. The waiters were extremely friendly and attentive. They greeted me and my friends with so much warmth as soon as we walked into the restaurant and I don’t recall feeling such hospitality at a restaurant. One of the waiters went through the menu, giving a thorough explaination on specific dishes which I definitely found very helpful as it was my first time trying Korean food. We had a Korean barbecue and the food was simply amazing..we also got free ice cream and I really appreciated that as it was quiet a hot day.. Me and my friends spent hours talking to one of the waiters who was exceptionally kind and he even gave us a complementary cool drink.. I would like to thank every one of the staff at Haroo for the wonderful experience I had..I will definitely be back soon Show less

Author: JlobouToronto, Canada
Title: The best part of Langkawi!
Review: We looked forward to eating here every night. It was probably the only reason we would ever come back. The food is amazing. The staff is hit or miss but completely loveable. You may wait a while for your food but it is worth it. The staff was incredible regardless of the wait times. It was just deliciousShow less

Author: AnanyaP54
Title: Amazing hospitality!!!!
Review: A must try if you are going to Langkawi. Amazing food and the owner is SO kind! They even serve you complimentary drink, ice cream and salad. And if you think this place is not for vegetarians, fret not. The owner is nice enough to customize the menu for your taste .Show less

Author: Robert_89_2016Dublin, Ireland
Title: Great Food, Great Service!
Review: So good we visited twice in 3 days!High quality dishes with wonderful waiting staff (in particular the front of house Malay/Chinese waiter who was a pleasure to deal with). Complimentary dishes were a nice touch. Highly recommended.Note: cash only with ATM not nearby, be prepared.Show less

Author: zoeb813London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, amazing service and great ambience
Review: The waiters were extremely friendly and attentive which made us feel very welcome and looked after. Our waiter went through the menu, explaining specific dishes and outlining their best sellers - this was most helpful. When the food came it was absolutely delicious! The best Korean food I’ve ever had, and not at all oily or greasy. The free ice cream scoop was such a lovely touch! We will definitely be back! Keep doing what you’re doing Haroo!Show less

Author: 448sks
Title: Great place and excellent services
Review: two thumbs up. highly recommended place for dine-in. great staffs and service. and they do serve complimentary drink & ice cream for us.

Author: rostislaffLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great dinner !
Review: We went where in may 2018. Based on all the reviews on TripAdvisor this place was one of the most highly rated. When we came there - we didn't regret ! Indeed, Place was absolutely fantastic- great service from the super friendly staff , food was super delicious , few complimentary bites etc. If you've never tried Korean cousine - try this out , friendly staff will recommend you what is the best according to your tastes .If we go to langkawi again we will certainly come back here Show less

Author: Journey745182Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Great service, must visit
Review: Came with a family, were met by a very professional manager who explained the menu and took great care of our kids. The portions are huge, food quality is very high. In terms of taste we’re used to a slightly different approach in Korean cuisine but all in all highly recommend!Show less

Author: seestanley
Title: Eating out
Review: We had never tried Karen food before and came to eat with our Son, the service was fantastic everything was explained to us and the food was great we had a lovely night

Author: N PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice lunch. Good food. Great staff
Review: Came for a light lunch and was greeted by the super friendly and helpful owner who explained through the menu. When we explained we weren't too hungry, he kindly advised to order in stages as there were many dishes that looked appealing. He was right, the portions are huge (ideally for 3 to share) so would recommend ordering a number of dishes or going in larger groups if you want to sample. It's very clear though with each dish around £6 to £7 So we still ended up over eating. Nice place, food was good. Would recommend. Show less

Author: Alvin A
Title: Worth the trip
Review: I drove from Westin to try out this place.  Food is good but the service, wow, very attentive and you are made to feel so welcome.  Highly recommended place for authentic Korean food in Langkawi.

Author: NielsG257
Title: Treated like royals
Review: Regarding to the reviews on TripAdvisor we visited this place, food was delicious and their service was absolutely amazing! They recommended some food after giving us the opportunity to try it first, all waiters were extremely friendly and took the time to serve us. We kinda felt like royals in this place. If you’ve the chance to get a table, experience this new level of hospitality by yourself!Show less

Author: KatsK11
Title: Supergood restaurant
Review:
10/10 for the customer service
10/10 for the food
Very good place to have dinner- super
We visited several times.

Author: aliciah350Thornlie, Australia
Title: A one of a kind experience!
Review: My partner and I decided to try this place out on the last night in Langkawi. We arrived with lots of mosquito bites and were greeted by staff who provided us with mosquito repellant, and some water and cloth to wash our hands after application. He even brought us a mosquito coil to keep the mosquitoes away. It gets better when one of the staff came over and explained the restaurant’s best dishes and was willing to tweak the dishes to suit your taste. The food we had were very yummy and we even had complimentary ice cream! To top up the excellent customer service, one of the staff even called us a “grab” car as our WiFi router ran out of power. Excellent restaurant with great staff who would go out of their way to provide you an unforgettable night. Thank you! Show less

Author: francoiscZ692SHBelgium
Title: Nice Korean food
Review: We got a very pleasant dinner. The food was delicious. We followed the advice of one of the staff and took signature dishes. Portions are huge so if you are not too hungry better to share. We got some complementary side dishes and ice cream to finish the dinner.For those who want Asian food but different than Malay, it is a place to go.Show less

Author: 518cz
Title: Amazing service and food
Review: This was our first introduction to the Korean cuisine and we enjoyed it tremendously! Thanks to all the staff members for the great service. You made the experience!

Author: Terence78Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good authentic Korean food
Review: We ordered a few dishes (seafood pancake, spicy rice cake, beef bulgogi) all tasty and generous in serving. Kimchi (side dish) is refillable at no extra charge. Pleasantly surprised when the waiter served us free Oreo ice cream after we called for the bill. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Sumeetbasrani
Title: Great food. Excellent service
Review:
The service at the restaurant is impeccable. The manager is a fun and extremely understanding guy.

One of the best meals I had in Langkawi

Author: Elizabeth845Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service!
Review: We asked the waiter for advice as they have quite a large menu. He was able to give a very detailed account of everything on there. The vegetarian recommendation was incredible, so much flavour and such generous portions too! The staff were very helpful and always on hand. They sprayed us with water when we arrived to cool us down after a trip up the mountains and they gave us complimentary ice cream at the end of the meal.We ordered veggie spring rolls and chicken dumplings to start expecting maybe four of each, we ended up with 10 spring rolls and 8 dumplings. Such generous food portions.The service, food and drinks were all A*, I would highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: chuajoeyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service
Review: The food was excellent with big portion. They gave us complimentary ice cream after our meal too ! The biggest point is their excellent service ! All the staffs were friendly and the sajangnim was also very friendly and kind and fun-going the only bad thing is you guys posted our ugly photo And also if the side dishes got more choices it will be betterIn conclusion, it worths every penny. Show less

Author: derevorSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Perfect service with excellent menu and portion!
Review: This place only accepts cash. Do not follow the address in Google Maps. Food was awesome, waiters were very kind and knowledgeable. Perfect service, just that it does not have air conditioning. Not an issue nonetheless as they have enough fans to go by and the waiters take note of you from afar. They come and go at precise moments so that you can enjoy your time here.Highly highly highly recommended for all aspects I could think of.Show less

Author: roshanthomas99Bengaluru, India
Title: Awesome food
Review: Visited with family on a Monday night - super friendly and helpful staff ( never seen as enthusiastic a restaurant staff like the person here - think his name was Jenny). Enjoyed some Soju based drinks to start off. We were not too familiar with Korean food, but they explained the dishes very well - and everything we tried was really tasty, made with fresh ingredients. Overall we had a great experience and would highly recommend to anybody visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: 110kirkr
Title: Fantastic introduction to Korean food
Review: Last night’s introduction to Korean food was truly superb. The staff were extraordinary and we had the menu explained with recommendations aplenty and tweaks according to our heat tolerance . Felt really special until they rattled off the same dialogue to every newcomer!! ho humStarters of Gun Mandi, mains of Chicken Bokeum and Tukbaegi Bulgogi. I even ate the complementary brown bread ice cream!! Yum Yum Yum xxShow less

Author: MartinS10900
Title: Great service, awesome food!
Review: First of all - the service was supreme. Our waiter gave great recommendations, explained the dishes in detail and answered all of our questions. The food was great - we asked for added spicyness and we got it.Complimentary kimchi with our main course and a ball of ice cream after the meal were nice touches. The only regret is that we couldn't try more dishes (the portions were hefty), since the whole menu looked terrific. Definitely worth the visit when you're in Langkawi.Martin & KadiEstoniaShow less

Author: Migliosi
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi
Review:
This is without doubt the best food experience I’ve had in Langkawi. You should not leave this island until you have tried dining at this AMAZING Korean restaurant. 

Great service.
Great food.
Over all - GREAT!

Author: Steph N
Title: Great food and service
Review: Loved our meal at Haroo so much we have been back twice more this week! Great food with good quality ingredients. Friendly staff were so helpful. Clean and nice setting. Highly recommend this restaurant.

Author: suemcooperGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Dinner
Review: Four of us had a dinner at Haroo Haroo last night. The service was excellent - the waiter helping us choose, making suggestions as to how many dishes, bringing cushions and constantly filling up the water glasses. The food was lovely with lots of extras thrown in for free like the ice cream for dessert. Great value for money!Show less

Author: dbfun48Elizabeth Town
Title: Very enjoyable Korean meal
Review: Like many we questioned how a Korean restaurant could be no 1 for Langkawi. It was though soon clear why. The owners service is significantly more professional and client focused than what we have experienced in the island. We recommend that you take his offer or explaining the menu. It is quickly apparent that he is proud of the food served.The prices are mid range for Langkawi. You also need to factor in 10% service charge. Most mains are 40 to 60 rm. we started with the fried chicken dumplings. They were succulently delicious and not greasy. Next we had grilled chicken lettuce wraps. You make these your self. A large serving. Extra tasty sauce made the dish. Last we had a beef bulging Stew. A big serving, excellent broth and rice. I would have liked a little chilli sauce to give it a little more zing. My partner loved it as it was.We also had the recommended citrus flavoured cold Korean tea. It was so refreshing and not overly sweet! A complimentary scoop of ice cream finished our very nice meal. A testament to their quality is that most restaurants on this might within a couple of km had 0 - 4 diners whilst we were at Haroo there were 28!For an Australian this restaurant is similar to our mid range Korean cafes in quality but with cheaper beer and no KFC.The restaurant is opposite a new being built hotel development which detracts a little from the ambience.For us not quite a 5 but close and we have no hesitation recommending.Show less

Author: jacobt660Perth, Australia
Title: Awesome and already excited to come back
Review: An awesome restaurant with 6 star service. Everything they could do to make sure our dinner was amazing, they did. Always ready to serve and offer suggestions. Food was incredible and the beer was cheap and cold. New location, so quiet and so enjoyable. Loved it and recommend it to anyone searching for an awesome meal and great service. Well done Haroo, keep it up. Show less

Author: ljosgood133Dartmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great experience at Haroo
Review: We had trouble finding the restaurant as they have moved to a new location (sorry I can’t remember the address but it’s no longer in the centre of Pantai Cheong).
