Anyway after a bit of riding about on our moped and asking around we found it (in fact it’s near to the Hornbill Cafe so head to that and keep going another 500 yards and it should be on your left).The manager / owner could not be a better advertisement for Korean food. He has amazing enthusiasm and passion, takes you through the menu making useful suggestions and away you go! The food was excellent and the house margarita is also v good and is a proper drink, not a watered down cocktail like some we had elsewhere.Show less

Author: SH2017Stratford City, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent bibimbap and hot tea
Review: We walked to the restaurant from her hotel and from the outset service was excellent. The prices are higher compared to other places to eat in Langkawi but still very reasonable if you’re used to going out for food in Europe. The serving size for mains is very filling so if you’re ordering starters make sure you have an empty stomach!We were sprayed with water to cool us down which was unexpected :) and fans were around most tables to keep the diners comfortable. The food was great, we ordered chicken dumplings and kimchi for starters followed by bibimbap and chicken bokeum. We were also offered complimentary ice cream following the dinner which again was yummy. Overall, definitely go if you are around, this place does not disappoint. Show less

Author: Ronnie20182018West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Visited last night and was our first time eating Korean food. They helped us with our choices and the food was really good! We just had two main dishes both came with rice and were given complimentary side dishes. Finished off with a dish of ice cream also on the house. Lovely restaurant, very friendly staff and they sorted us a taxi back to our hotel. All for only 100 myr this included a couple of beers. Would definitely recommend a visit.Show less

Author: CurlymikeT
Title: Good Korean food with good service
Review: Very nice authentic Korean food. Everything was tasty and fresh.  Wine Soju and beer were also good and of course the kimchi was good. Service was the best we experienced in Langkawi, from the staff and the boss.

Author: Suzann77United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: We visited with friends and previously recommended that we try the BBQ. As only ‘I’ wanted the ‘cook your own beef’ it was sadly served already cooked by the chef! That said; the service was excellent, the food good, I was disappointed that I didn’t have the experience of cooking my own food at the table, but enviously watched the couple on the neighbouring table cook theres. The waiter should have explained when ordering food. Show less

Author: Olivia D
Title: Awesome Customer Service
Review: I grew up eating Korean food. Not only did Haroo offer amazing, fresh food, but Jenny our server went above and beyond

Author: tomtD1632UG
Title: Brilliant- that’s all I can say!
Review: The staff are amazing .... they explained the menu perfectly and did everything they could to make our meal great. I’d happily eat here every day!

Author: FeliciaG119
Title: Delicious Tasty Food!
Review: Perfectly seasoned beef cooked to perfection. Best Mango drink I tasted on the Island. Servers friendly, personable and responsive. We came back twice during our week long stay in Langkawi.

Author: E5077TBdavid_
Title: Haroo top service/food
Review:
Best service experience I ve had in my entire life!

Food and drink are best on Langkawi you can find.

Author: TrailBlazer675909
Title: Great food and excellent service
Review: We were wondering how a Korean restaurant can become the top restaurant in Langkawi and after dining here on our first day in Langkawi it made sense. The front staffs were very friendly and attentive and took time to recommend their best dishes. And the food was great. Loved their beef cooked with Kimchi dish & Beef bulgogi soup. They gave complimentary side dishes and ice cream which was perfect because I was craving for ice cream after that. What really made this restaurant stand out is the people serving us and for that I have to say bravo.. Definitely will come again.Show less

Author: E2570OBbriant
Title: Best Meal in Langkawi
Review: Great atmosphere, great service, great food! The beef bibimbap was delicious. Complimentary ice cream a nice touch. Thank you.

Author: nill nUK
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Had a lovely meal at Haroo Haroo. The service was brilliant from the start. The waiter sprayed us on arrival to cool us down. He provided us with a detailed suggestion of dishes to try. We took his advice and the food did not disappoint. He speaks amazing English and was warm and friendly. We received a complimentary side dish and ice cream. They charge a 10% service charge which really makes a difference as you are waited on, every minute of your stay.I would definitely recommend this restaurant and would visit again. Show less

Author: VivienC219Tiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: So great that we went twice- Awesome Korean food, service
Review: Please take note that you go to the correct address i.e. beside Sunba, not the old one!It was our wedding anniversary trip & we were really hungry after the morning's jet ski activities. The food was great- serving was generous. We had a late lunch of seafood pancake and bibimbap. The prices were higher than Langkawi's typical prices but I found it good value (versus Korean food in Singapore).A plus- the service here is fabulous! The head server is hilarious (we asked for his name but he wouldn't provide! He said if it's complaints he would go by the name Jenny= this is a joke) sprayed us with water on a hot day and provided little treats like free ice cream, free welcome drink, free mini dish which he was having for his staff lunch. He constantly came back to check on us and also provided us some tips for great local food nearby.We came back again for dinner service on our last night and had another yummy meal of bubbling egg omelette and tofu soup. Yummy.This place is a gem, the "Head Server" deserves a promotion for his passion towards customers.Show less

Author: barth378Salzburg, Austria
Title: Fantastic Service & Food
Review: We loved this place our favourite meal on the trip.I asked the waiter for his advice as they have quite a large menu. He was able to give a very detailed account of everything on there. I took his recommendations, I can't remember what I had but was good. My partner enjoyed her veggie option as well. Whenever we needed something the staff were there clearing empty plates asking if you need a new drink, spraying you with water to help you cool down, giving you complimentary ice cream and tasters. The drinks did take a while coming but I think they were training a new barman and they were great when we got them.The portions were generous! we got veggie spring rolls and chicken dumplings to start expecting maybe four of each I think we got 10 spring rolls and 8 dumplings. I'm not complaining they were all fantastic!The service was great the food was great the drinks were great. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.Show less

Author: 58TimSydney, Australia
Title: What a spot!!!!
Review: We arrived here after finding the restaurant we were wanting to go to closed. So glad we came. The staff were so good. Our waiter was hilarious. He chose our dishes, and they were excellent. When we looked hot, and sweaty he sprayed us with cold water. Highly recommended. Good price too!!!Show less

Author: Maree DNewcastle, Australia
Title: Generous servings
Review: We ate here early 1 night before heading back to our resort. We felt like a change from the resort restaurants and this was great. The menu was explained to us and we were advised not to order 2 main courses as 1 of our chosen dishes was quite large. We ended up with fried chicken dumplings to share then a seafood and vegetable pancake (?) that was very filling. We appreciated the advice not to order 2 mains as we would not have been able to finish. Both dishes were delicious and the total for a shared entree and a shared main, plus 2 cokes and a vodka and tonic was 104 rm which was excellent value for the standard of meal. We were also given a complimentary tasting plate with some kimchi and other dishes, 2 complimentary aloe vera and honey digestive drinks, and were also offered free ice cream which we declined as we were both too full! We will definitely be back before leaving Langkawi. The only small complaints were the waiter who was a little too keen to remove plates and drinks and wanted to wipe the table down before we had finished. I think he was just being too keen to give good service but he could probably relax a little! There could also be a small break between entrée and main, as 1 dish was being cleared the next was on the table. We also appreciated the cold water misting given to us by the owner when we arrived, obviously looking hot and in need of refreshing!Show less

Author: Cris M
Title: Good customer service
Review: The owners are the servers, they are friendly and gives complimentary dishes esp ice cream. Good resto and ambiance. Clean with good music. Spacious and nice style. Price is average.

Author: 259roberte
Title: Location changed!! Awesome food!
Review: Location is not like on google maps shown make sure you type in the adress instead of using the maps location! Very nice people and best food we had in Lankawi, they will explain all the meals to you and gave us some free treats. 5 Stars, which i almost never give to restaurants. They deserve it. Make sure you bring Cash, no card possibleShow less

Author: atiff_gLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing customer service
Review: Visited this place after reading reviews on TripAdvisor. This is the first place that lived up to its expectations. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. Explained the menu gave recommendations. Food is reasonably priced and tasted great. Complimentary ice cream is great touch. Defs worth visiting if you are in langkawi. Show less

Author: Siro87
Title: One of the amazing experiences i had
Review: This was the first time i try Korean food,but it was waw,very friendly staff,amazing food and excellent customer services,they just added small details but they made a big difference,even the lim juice was extraordinary,not to mention the complementary drinks and ice cream.thank you very much

Author: russellj691Eccles, United Kingdom
Title: 1st Korean Experience - WOW Excellent in every way
Review: From our arrival we were treated fantastically by all the staff.The menu was fully explained to us by 'cash' including the recommended dishes.I have to say the service from all the staff was exemplary and the food was if a very high class (although we don't have anything to compare with).We had a starter to share and two main dishes (Chicken Tukbaegi & Beef Bokeum) which was sufficient for us.We had complementary Ice Cream and a small drink to refresh our pallette.The Manager even ordered a Taxi for our return home.We had a fantastic meal, a Fabulous night and we will be returning before we leave Langkawi.Please do not miss an opportunity. Show less

Author: Qwen323Sungai Petani, Malaysia
Title: Nice korean restaurant
Review: I would like to give 10/10 marks to the owner and the staffs. First of all, they welcome us and put small sofa on the chair for us. All the foods served in short time and it was all quite big portion and delicious.They even helped me to put on napkin since im wearing a white cloth. Definitely will visit again, hope to see chimac on the new menu very soon.Show less

Author: Tiara T
Title: The best korean restaurant
Review: The staff was so friendly, the owner so nice and their food is amazing. Great bibimbap and kimchi. They gave me ice cream for complimentary.  Totally recommended

Author: Yulia D
Title: Great food, amazing service!
Review: Everything was just great! :)One of the best customer service in my life - the owner is super nice and explained everything regarding food and drinks in detail. The special tea was amazing!My bf is a vegetarian and he didn't have any problem in choosing the meal, there are a lot of vegetarian options.In the end, they gave us a free ice cream and sang me a birthday song :)Totally recommended if you are in Langkawi! :)Just be sure you know their updated address.Show less

Author: Cameron T
Title: YUMMM!!!
Review: Definitely the best food my girlfriend and I had eaten in quite some time. Service impeccable, friendly and helpful! We were recommended certain dishes, and they did not disappoint, We enjoyed our experience more than our favourite Korean restaurant in London! CASH ONLY!

Author: WafryNazaley
Title: EXCELLENT !
Review: we have our dinner last night, and all staff very friendly. normally their recommend the best food , witch one is the best, witch one you should fill up your empty tummy. the test it’s so good,very good i mean it.

Author: louxadraLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food!
Review: Amazing food! I don't have experience in Korean food so I can't vouch for its authenticity but it was the most enjoyable meal I had during my stay in Langkawi. Really polite and knowledgeable staff as well, and they even wrapped up our leftovers for us to take home. My bf told them it was my birthday so the waiters sang happy birthday to me which made the visit really special. Definitely recommend, anyone visiting Langkawi shouldn't miss out from having a meal at Haroo.Show less

Author: Jim BFort Lauderdale, Florida
Title: Double Check That Location Before Going!
Review: Just finished dining there this evening. Can't honestly say it's the best restaurant in Langkawi because we only spent 2 days here and didn't try them all, and we certainly were not able to sample everything on the menu. But we didn't experience anything that would make us doubt for a second that possibility. Everything positive you've read here is true. A very friendly and inviting venue, unparalleled attentive service. Excellent recommendations from the host, served promptly in an orderly manner. Just make sure you got the new location correctly. The cab drivers all know where it is now, but if you're driving or walking on your own the Trip Advisor map had the old location as of this review, although the address listed in Trip Advisor appears to be correct.. Google Maps currently shows both the old and new location. Cash only, no credit cards,Show less

Author: Martin_Bensvik
Title: Best restaurant on Langkawi
Review: For sure the best restaurant on Langkawi with super dedicated staff and genuine Korean food! The only problem is that maps haven't updated their location yet. Call for directions!

Author: Brooke W
Title: Best in Langkawi
Review: My husband and I came here twice during our stay in Langkawi we loved it so much.The staff are the most friendly I’ve ever come across. The food was so delicious and so filling.If you’re in Langkawi you must visit Haroo, you will be so glad you did!I really wish we had this restaurant at home! Show less

Author: Chris BAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best korean food
Review: Not much to say. It is simply the best korean food i had. The kimchi was as awesome as the rest of the food. The staffs were so nice, they explained everything to you and gave really good recommendations. Just go there and enjoy a great korean dish.Show less

Author: joerib83
Title: Great food, lovely people!
Review: We visited Haroo by accident, it was a lovely suprise! The menu got explaned to us as we were not familiar with korean food. It all sounded lovely and we choose 2 dishes to share. It was very good food! The only small improvement we can think of is that it would be convienent for guests to have wifi as many people use uber these days. Overall we were very pleased with the experience and would defenitely return and recommend. Show less

Author: KristinaD886London, United Kingdom
Title: Really good food and service!
Review: Went there for dinner after reading the reviews and the reviews don’t do it justice! The food was really great and I would recommend it to anyone going to Langkawi. It is definitely worth the trip. Only thing which they should say in the beginning is that it is cash only. Luckily we had cash on us, but it was not always the case while we were in Langkawi, so could have been an uncomfortable situationShow less

Author: ThanasisT165
Title: Great food and service
Review:
The stuff was very friendly and helpful from the moment we arrived. They explained us every plate and did recommendations for our taste.
The food was delicious and well cooked. They also offered us desert for free.

Author: LalaK115
Title: Easy 5*
Review: It was the first time I ate korean food. Springrolls were of course tasty and main dish looked very good. Anyway, i wasnt prepared korean food to be that spicy, so it didnt "fit to my mouth". But it's not foods fault, we just have different tastes! :) Staff brought me un-spicy soup and I also got icecream. Food was 3stars in my taste but I dont wanna give anything but 5 stars. Staff were so incredible and very professional as a customer care. They all also speak very good english, also! Show less

Author: Darren BFern Bay, Australia
Title: The best
Review: My wife and I ate here last night and could not believe how good the service was. They staff were so welcoming and friendly I have never had such good service anywhere. The staff are truly a credit to the business.The food was incredible, I loved every single dish, so flavoursome and fresh. We will definitely be back before we leave Langkawi Show less

Author: AnnicamariellaHelsinki, Finland
Title: Friendly place and great food
Review: This place was a very good place to eat. In Langkawi there was only few good restaurants and this was one of those. Food was Korean food. Menu looked first quite cheap - there was pictures of every dishes. But then there was a very friendly host that came to tell us what they recommend and what those dishes includes, are they spicy or not and so on.Price was also quite low compared to other Langkawi restaurants. Show less

Author: H919QInickh
Title: Great tasting food
Review: Having read the reviews on Haroo before going to Langkawi we wanted to give it a try, but had difficulty in finding it, until by chance we were on our scooter looking around a found it.  We weren't disappointed great food at a reasonable price.

Author: molkushaBrussels, Belgium
Title: First time Korean food
Review: We decided to eat here due to extremely good tripadvisor rating and because we wanted to taste Korean food for the first time. We made a reservation as it was Saturday night via Facebook (very responsive!). Staff is extra nice, he went through the menu with us and explained almost every dish in details. We tried their ice tea with lemon, which was nice and order a starter (soup with squid and tofu) which was also great! We didnt manage to finish the starter when we already got our main dish which was OK but nothing special for my taste. I would say I was expecting more from my dish (than just a rice, tofu and greens), but my boyfriend was extremely happy with his beef :)After that we got a complimentary ice cream. All in all staff is super nice and willing to help but we expected a nice, slow evening and at the end we finished our dinner in 20 minutes :)Prices are reasonable and majority of dishes can be made for vegans/vegetarians. All of their dishes are mid-spicy. Show less

Author: Nevcan MYangon (Rangoon)
Title: Lovely place, great service, yummy food
Review: We had Bibimbap and Bokeum for lunch at Haroo, and both were very delicious. Service was wonderful; they were very attentive in a good way. They even send someone to the money changer nearby to change money for us while we were having lunch. I loved the complimentary pancake they served as appetizer. Very good experience overall and definitely recommend a visit while in Langkawi.Show less

Author: ExploreandTravelKLDevon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing staff and delicious food
Review: We ate here during our Langkawi stay. The waiter who met us was really great and enthusiastic about the menu, he explained what each individual dish was and recommended what we may like to eat. The food was GREAT and we enjoyed trying new korean dishes. Even if you've never eaten Korean food I would highly recommend eating here as it was delicious!Show less

Author: 840justinask
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: Food is very fresh and delicious! Service even more outstanding! Highly recommend to visit this place!

Author: JialetanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious korean food and extremely great hospitality!
Review: Both my Partner and I wanted to try this Korean restaurant and we definitely did not regret going! Although when we went, we already ate a pizza beforehand so we were full and not sure what to order, the waiter came over to ask us if we needed a recommendation and told us vividly what is nice and gave us a very detailed explanation which we appreciated a lot. As both of us were pretty full, the waiter told us to order 1 set meal first just in case we were too full to finish both sets.The meal was fantastic, loved the beef as both my partner and I shared the meal. They provided us with two complimentary ice-cream after that although we only ordered 1 set meal. We extremely loved the service as they did not force us to purchase and in fact, the service thinks of the customer point of view and provided us with what we needed. Love it so much! thank you so much for the wonderful dining experiences!Show less

Author: Ferry_TangRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Excellent delicious Korean food, great hospitality, on a new location!
Review: Haroo is really a recommended place to eat. For really delicious Korean meals. From the bimbim bap to the bulgogi and the kimchi pancake these dishes are full of flavors that explode and immerse you into an delightful food experience. It's really a great addition to Langkawi. If you plan to visit please check the updated location. Since the address was not correct (old location near pantai cenang not the correct one). Correct address is : Lot 31, Jalan Pantai Tengah, Jl. Teluk Baru, Mukim kedawang, 07000 Langkawi, Kedah, Malaysia.Show less

Author: diverfromsgboston
Title: great korean food
Review: Had a great meal here! Better korean food than K-Town in NYC or Singapore. I had the bulgogi stew, enjoyed it very much. Wife had the seafood soup noodles, was great too! Probably one of the best meals we had in Langkawi. Plus the service was amazing!Show less

Author: Hoss_KarCanada
Title: Does not accept Credit Cards
Review: The food was very delicious and the service was great, but cash only and it is rated one????. Usually to get to be #1 you must be good at providing all aspects of service to the customer. I choose the Sun Cafe as our #1 restaurant.CheersShow less

Author: ValueSeeker83
Title: Great as always. The restaurant has been relocated
Review: Looking for this restaurant at their original place, but it has been relocated down further down to the Pantai Tengah. The food is great as always, but the portions of side dishes are getting a bit smaller. Pajeon and japchae. Great healthy food!!

Author: creamteaanyoneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant Meal
Review: I visited this restaurant after a recommendation from a friend who had visited last year. Between the lovely food, the great atmosphere and the attentive staff this was a wonderful dinner experience. The food is lovely, and the staff are willing to give you detailed explanations and recommendations for your choices. The staff were genuinely engaged in the their patrons' dining experience and it showed in their genuine conversations and high level of service.I really enjoyed my dish, and the little accompaniments of kimchee and pickled vegetables, the after dinner ice cream and the friendly conversation.Show less

Author: valley0000Perth, Australia
Title: Wonderful food, Friendly staff
Review: We came here for a late lunch on our last day in Langkawi, and wished that we'd found this place sooner!The staff was very friendly when we came in. Once seated one of the guys went through the menus with us, explaining what their most popular dishes were, as well as answering questions we had about some other dishes. He was very informative when we asked for vegetarian/vegan options as well.The food was amazing, and were served very quickly. We shared 3 main dishes and 2 sides between the 5 of us and we were full for the rest of the day. The iced tea we had was also wonderful, and only 10RM for a pretty tall glass!We received ice cream as dessert as well which was a nice refresher.Overall, we really enjoyed our meal and wished they'd open a store in Aus :)Show less

Author: SghillHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Fantasic Service and Food
Review: This restaurant was a treat after exploring in Langkawi. Beware that the trip advisor address was not correct, we went to the original location to be greeted by a sign. But the new location is not a far drive and worth it. We went with the waiter's recommendations for food and drink and shared dishes as a family. The Iced Honey Pomelo tea is a great refreshment for a hot day. The recommended chicken and beef dishes were tasty and good quality meet. The spring rolls were also tasty. The waiter was extremely attentive, complete with water spray and fans to cool us down. My son wished he would follow us around all day. Tip: They only accept cash!Definitely worth the extra effort to find Haroo!Show less

Author: suko91Eindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Fantastic night out in langkawi
Review: It took a bit of searching to find Haroo as they have recently moved and TripAdvisor is not up to date (not the restaurants fault). Google for bamboo bar or Sunba bar, it's next to these. The new location is very nice though and we were greeted very warmly. You are given some time to study the menu which is very detailed and gives some nice background on the dishes. Then a waiter came over and gave us some further explanation and recommendations. He did this with such enthusiasm that we followed his advice and we didn't regret it! The food was simply amazing and the Korean lemonade was also delicious! A complementary scoop of ice cream sealed the deal and made this our best dining experience in Malaysia so far! PS be aware that you can only pay by cash!Show less

Author: LEE_SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Service and Ambience ... but beef was a let down
Review: I would have given a full 5-stars but the beef was a let down. Expected a medium rare type of beef but it was cooked so well done that the ribeye was lost. Lesson learnt is do not trust the cook to decide or assume that they would know how the beef should be done. One the brighter note, the Korean Seafood Pancake was really good. I will go back but will be careful to specify the how the beef should be cooked. The kimchi is also authentic.Show less

Author: felicityp344
Title: Incredible
Review: Decided to give this place a try after reading great reviews and was not disappointed. The food was absolutely incredible and the service was also spectacular. The food was fresh, flavourful and beautifully cooked. You have to try this!!

Author: Kate MWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Amazing!
Review: This was the best restaurant I went to in Langkawi, they were very accommodating moving tables for our large group, gave my friend a free drink as we all had drinks, moved the fan so we wouldn't be hot, gave us tips for Langkawi and the food was amazing! Really delish and affordable! And they gave us complimentary icecream!Show less

Author: pinkystar14
Title: Great food!
Review: This place offer alot of good food and very generous amount per servings . The staff are very welcoming and provided us with great service. The staff also recommended us what to eat if were unsure and also explained some choices we have for the menu. The restaurant have a very nice ambiance for couple or family :) Highly recommended !!Show less

Author: zalnikor
Title: Good Korean food
Review: A nice Korean restaurant.Tried their vegetarian pancake,tasty.Good selection for vegetarians,one of the better places for vegetarians along the beach.The kimchi was very good.Prices a bit expensive.Worth the visit.

Author: PPontus
Title: Best service in whole of Asia.
Review: This was a real treat! If you’re ever in Langkawi, you’ll have to visit. Food is great, staff is super firiendly and the the service is spot on. Can’t recommend it enough!

Author: Tom MFinchampstead
Title: Absolute must!
Review: We visited this evening and it has been the best place we’ve been to.The restaurant looks great, the menu looks great, the food was absolutely brilliant and the team who work there genuinely want you to have a fantastic meal.I recommend the ‘non-sake sake’ as a drink for afterwards.You’ll miss out if you don’t this place.Show less

Author: Erik E
Title: Excellent service and food, not to forget the drinks at the nice old-fashioned bar
Review: We had a very good meal there one evening and when we passed the place a couple of nights later on our way to the beach to watch the sunset, my wife remembered the delicious mango juice drink she had had with the meal. So we decided to sit down at the bar for a quick drink before moving on. The juice drink was as good as the first night and when the female Korean “boss” mixed us a very tasty second drink “on the house”, we let the sun set without our assistance. Instead, we moved on to the restaurant part to enjoy another excellent meal. A well spent evening and btw, we did reach the beach in complete darkness, watching the green lights on the many fishing boats far out at sea. We knew that the beautiful sunset at Pantai Tengah beach could be enjoyed any other night.Show less

Author: Lila B
Title: Very good
Review: Very good food and the staff is very nice. We went for a late lunch at 3pm and it was among very few restaurants that were open at that time. Highly recommended!!!

Author: Camee v
Title: Amazing atmosphere and food
Review: The restaurant was giving us a warm welcome. The service staff is speaking perfectly English, they are sweet and funny. The food was a lot and the taste was really good!! We had a nice evening here, we would love to come back once!

Author: WQM1
Title: Great food, great service, warm hospitality
Review: Was on food hunting with gf, walked in and ordered only a cup of noodle but still was given with 5 stars service full with hospitality. Cant help but to install tripadvisor just to write this review. This restaurant certainly deserves it.

Author: MarkusP1606
Title: Excellent choice!
Review:
The food was magnificent and the staff was very friendly. We enjoyed a lovely dinner here with friends. The menu has good variety of dishes, and the staff was very helpful of explaining about the different choices. 
Please note that this restaurant only accepts CASH.

Author: ApinnickHampshire
Title: Great first experience of Korean Food.
Review: We chose this place as the reviews seemed good and it was close to where we were staying, and so glad we did.From the beginning we were welcomed with a warm and friendly smile, service continued to be some of the best we have experienced. Not being familiar with Korean food we needed some help from the waiter, who was very helpful and explained the various dishes. I have to say our choices did not disappoint, the food was wonderful. It was spiced to our liking and the variety of flavours and textures were excellent, our first time with Kimchi and I found it lovely. There is a great selection here and don’t be afraid if you are not familiar with it as they are very helpful in matching your tastes to the dishes.The service here is excellent, warm and friendly and only to keen to help, food is top quality and the location worked well for us.Thanks guys, I would highly recommend this place, beware I am not sure the map is accurate, it is next to the Jazz Bar and Bam Boo Ba, well worth the trip.Show less

Author: Pearlie22Basingstoke, Hampshire
Title: First taste of Korean food
Review: As we were struggling to find more than one Malay restaurant we looked at the reviews for Haroo and what a find. We had never tried Korean food before so did not know what to expect. The staff were so helpful with explaining the dishes to us. We were not disappointed. The food was very tasty. And we even got a complimentary ice cream after. A great find if you are looking for something different. Show less

Author: bengtelin
Title: Awesome food and service!
Review: Been here 3 times in a week and will probably visit more times. Incorrect adress in tripadvisor app (feb 2018), it’s placed oposite to frangipani resort on main road.

Author: briansM9927DQ
Title: Fantastic meal and service
Review: Never tried Korean food before but the staff were brilliant and explained each dish to make it easier to choose. The whole experience from the food to the service was outstanding. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Author: ebszsLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Super!
Review: We had a particularly pleasant experience at this restaurants that we stumbled upon. Food was delicious, served fast and most notably of all staff was superfriendly! Made sure everything was in order, and the chef came to our table to show how to eat korean barbecue properly. Also has several different vegan options.Show less

Author: YLYamKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Well deserved top Korean restaurant!
Review: Definitely the best food I had in Langkawi, had the thoughts that this place may be overrated but I was wrong!! the kimchi was delicious and beef bulgogi was great! Portion was huge too!!TripAdvisor should update the address as the place is moved 2km down the road.Show less

Author: G9418QPsamg
Title: Just Great!
Review: Great food, great service. Even gave us complimentary ice cream. I recommend Haroo to anyone visiting Langkawi. I suppose the downside is it's quite a walk from the centre of town but totally worth it especially if you're a fan of Korean food.

Author: Mr_Haf
Title: Probably the best korean food you can get in SOUTH EAST ASIA.
Review:
To simplify :

Staff : 10/10
Service : 10/10
Food : 10/10
SOJU : 10/10 

what else to mention? :D the owner is friendly and we were regular there so she would cook for us personally ! Thank you Isabella !

Author: karolinaz418
Title: Would 10/10 recommend
Review: Absolutely delicious and super friendly service! We got the bibimap and it was delicious! The waiter is super nice, helpful and funny:) Really recommended!

Author: manuellV9379UDMajorca, Spain
Title: Fantastic
Review: Was there with my wife and my 1y old son - before we arrived to our table they had already prepared the baby chair (we had no booking, was a walk in) even with a pillow to make it fit perfectly for our small guy. Besides the perfect service, like great recommendations and everyone joking with our boy, the food was just delicious. We will definitely come back to try more of their great food. #1 in Langkawi well deserved!!Show less

Author: AkiP102
Title: Loved it!
Review: Excellent food, great service. We had never been to a Korean restaurant before, so the staff was very helpful in guiding us through the menu.

Author: PetriinaR
Title: Excellent service, good food
Review: The staff is very friendly. Trust the waitress's recommendations... you must try (Korean traditional) cold yuja cha tea, it's the best!!!

Author: RonanSully
Title: A great find!
Review: I would highly recommend this place! The flavours are so good and the food is seasoned with spice to your individual taste. The staff are so friendly, attentative and professional; especially our main host, aka Jenny. Jenny is so charismatic and gave us a detailed guide of the menu and recommendations.Show less

Author: MTRChicagoFoodiePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Food & Service
Review: We had a terrific meal here on Saturday. The restaurant itself is well designed, and the staff couldn't be more pleasant. We ate the beef bokeum & chicken japchae both were fantastic! It isn't your typical Korean BBQ so don't expect that. They told us they were changing the menu soon, which seems sad because what we had was great.Overall one of the best restaurants I have experienced in my nearly five years in Malaysia. Start another restaurant a branch in Penang, please!Show less

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Really good tasty food plus great service!
Review: We had dinner at this Korean style restaurant and were blown away by the great tasting of the food we had. The glass noodles and beef "kabouh" (not sure I spelled that right) were sure nice and as we visited Korea just last year very closed to being authentic. The prices are truly OK and the service was excellent with good and honest advice about taste and what to expect.The place had outdoor and indoor seating and slightly beside the main road. The view is OK but do not expect stunning views.We are definitely coming back for more of this wonderful food !Show less

Author: Shakera W
Title: Very good!
Review: The service was quick and friendly. Our servers were happy to explain anything on the menu and recommend some of their favorite and most popular dishes. They even gave us tasters to make sure we would like the dish before the full dish was served! I'm vegetarian and my bf is not, but we were both able to order something delicious without any fuss. They also gave us complementary ice cream! We're very happy with the choice to eat there.Show less

Author: 578ninyalAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great experience & choice of korean food & lovely people
Review: Great choice of korean food with lovely people who explained the dishes very well to make choose your dish. We only knew korean barbeque style food but this is something different and a great experience to the korean kitchen. Good portions and again great tastes. We have spent several days at Langkawi and we have eaten here twice.Show less

Author: Jennifer TLongmont, Colorado
Title: Delicious food and attentive service
Review: We loved our meal here! The dishes were perfectly seasoned and tailored to our preferred level of spiciness. The owner was super charismatic and attentive, giving us suggestions and making sure we enjoyed our meal. We love our Korean food but he was great about explaining menu items we weren’t familiar with. Will definitely be back and would recommend this to anyone staying on Langkawi. Show less

Author: 436justinhBerkhamsted, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing meal and service
Review: Never had Korean food before, very tasty and no idea what half the dishes were on the menu. Thankfully the main host was on hand. He is amazing. He walked us through whole menu and brought it to life. Would post a picture of him on here but he refuses photos as people are looking for him. His words. Show less

Author: tmunyi
Title: Ok
Review: Friendly staffs, very nice environment, food taste ok but a bit pricey. KL korean food are much better.

Author: SMP999
Title: Superb food, great service
Review: I ate here last night (18/1/18) and was not disappointed. I had the spicy squid with rice. It was a large portion of exceptional deliciousness. It also came with kimchi and 2 packages of something, not sure what it was but it was tasty. You get a drink on arrival and complimentary ice cream.Service was exceptional, attentive but not intrusive.I would definitely recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: pippolino_muc
Title: Great Korean Dinner
Review: Thanks for a great night with fantastic Korean food, great service and recommendations as well as nice chats. ‘Vielen Dank’ ;)

Author: David E
Title: Great food and service!
Review: Authentic delicious Korean food. Quick and friendly service too. Very nice welcoming and  casual atmosphere. Clean & well kept restaurant.

Author: 215AnneC
Title: Amazing Korean restaurant in Langkawi
Review: First Korean meal, very very tasty. Good recommendation from the staff. The chef was lovely as we’re all the staff. Very good value for money.

Author: Peter TBirkdale, United Kingdom
Title: First class restaurant
Review: This is a really excellent restaurant with very tasty food,I particularly liked the seaweed soup dish.We ate there on several occasions and were treated wonderfully by the staff, Ben is a great man with charm and great stories.I highly recommend this restaurant It’s better to go there earlier than 8 as it gets really busyShow less

Author: MrsMackThe3rd
Title: Lives up to the excellent reputation
Review: Service, atmosphere and food were all fantastic. We are staying on the other side of Langkawi and visited the restaurant on returning from the cable. It was worth the taxi ride detour and will not disappoint. Particularly loved the tofu bibimbap.... really fresh ingredients and gorgeous flavour. Make the time to go!Show less

Author: AHappyWander
Title: Amazing.
Review: Staff took there time to run through the menu (which also has pictures). We had a very positive experience for both food and service and would definitely be back!

Author: kennethr830Gedved, Denmark
Title: The Best service on the Island
Review: We vissited the Haroo sine days ago.. The service was amazing, and we was welcomed and guided through the menu.. We haven’t tried Korean cuisine before, so it was nice with a guide.. We selected some dishes which was very tasty and where of good quality.. Compared to the prices, I think it was fair - maybe a bit cheap - which only is a good thing..:) We recieved the food fast, and it was one of the best food experience that we had on the island.. We can highly recommend the place..Show less

Author: Soul_Surfer009
Title: Impeccable Korean food
Review: Everyone raves about the service, and they’re right, but let’s not forget the perfectly cooked Korean food. Good quality beef in all dishes, like in the classics bibimbap or bulgogi. If you’re a Kimshi fiend, don’t forget to try the fried version, with Tofu.

Author: dinouggylondon
Title: Amazing!!!!!
Review: Literally the best experience ive had in a restaurant for a while. The staff are so welcoming, upon arrival we got a walk though of some recommendations and a bit of korean history behind certain dishes. We had the stir fry and the bibimbap. It was the tastiest food ever! After we got complimentary ice cream, a cleansing drink shot and a little sweetie. It was such a lovely experience away from all the craziness of cenang. Its a service charge i am more than happy to pay for. Show less

Author: rachel c
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: We popped in for lunch and had the most amazing service of all time - including recommendations and a spritz down with cooling spray! the food was incredible and the drinks were too. Would highly recommend and will definitely be going back!

Author: Paetti0106
Title: Highly recommanded
Review: The owner and his crew did a awesome job, we felt welcome from the very beginning. The food was delicious. If you want an excellent evening with very good food , you have to get here.

Author: andreasg541
Title: Must Try!
Review: We had a wonderful dinner at Haroo! Food, service, atmosphere, everything was wonderful, amazing and perfect!

Author: SusannaN244
Title: Best service ever!
Review: Great food and even better service. Many complimentaries, like dessert and snacks between meals. Highly recommended!

Author: RachHas
Title: Best service in Makaysia
Review: Such helpful & attentive service, great food, went there twice. The menu was explained, suggestions given. Told the water was filtered. Food came fast.

Author: Jacob S
Title: An experience to remember
Review: The service was something never experienced before, with the perfect balance between friendliness whilst not being too disturbant. The food was amazing and was great value as well. Me and my girlfriend like to try out loads of places to eat normally when we go on holiday, but this was so good we ended up going back the night after, an experience to rememberShow less

Author: alysonm120Brooklyn, New York
Title: Delicious food, impeccable service
Review: Our best meal in Langkawi. Made us feel at home as soon as we got there. Incredibly helpful service. My husband and I love eating Korean food at home but the server recommended two dishes we never tried before. Beef bokeum and seafood jap chae. Both were incredible and had just the right amount of spice. The kimchee and veggie pancake were delicious as well. We shamelessly devoured everything!Show less

Author: Expedition746824
Title: Food here reminds me of home,Seoul
Review: Come dinner with my family and order Sundubu Jjigae,Seafood Jap Chae,Beef Bokeum and Grill Beef.We were very happy with the attentive service and very tasty food.Very home cooking,remind me of home.Try to come before 8pm..or else full house.Be aware this place do not credit cards, cash only.Will come again next summer.대단하다(Amazing).Show less

Author: 889g_ntherb
Title: New location, still excellent!
Review: This restaurant moved 19 days ago to another location, it's now 1,2km by car more in the south-south-east in a calm area (GeoLocs: 6,2785750, 99,7332735). The owner and chef are still the same, the food is at least as excellent as before!

Author: Machoic
Title: Excellent service but so-so food
Review: Local traveler with family. Came as staying nearby and no.1 restaurant in Langkawi on TripAdvisor at present.Fairly crowded, but 95% foreigners. The service was exceptional from the moment we came in till left.But menu wise was pretty limited for a Korean joint. Also only 2 banchan!!! One kimchi and the other a vegetarian pancake. Food tasted so so. Free ice cream. So no. 1 restaurant in Langkawi? For service, I would agree.Food wise, would not even be in top 10 in my opinion. Price wise is comparable with the better Korean restaurants in KL. Ok For those wishing for good food in Langkawi, better look for TripAdvisor reviews by locals.Show less

Author: SuviP124
Title: Wonderful experience!
Review: We eated first time korean food and we just loved it! Staff was very friendly and especially the waitress lady was so nice and funny. She also recommended us foods because we didn't know what to order. Thank you for the wonderful experience! :)

Author: lukarnas
Title: Great service
Review: Very good food. Service was excellent! I really enjoyed dinner in this place, in my opinion one of the best restaurant in Langkawi. Thank you Haroo

Author: HarriL61
Title: Best restaurant experience in Malaysia
Review:
Absolutely a fantastic place. Great food, outstanding service and such a warm hospitality. Went there twice, the more you go the more you like it. Not just the best place in Langkawi but a remarkable restaurant experience in whole Malaysia. 

FYI their location has changed!

Author: M_2027Singapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty Korean food with vegetarian options!
Review: This is a family run restaurant and there is enough personal touch to your food. Slight customisation easily possible. There is ample variety and the vegetarian dishes are really nice. They place is fairly central but in the back lanes so slightly hard to find; use Google maps.Show less

Author: RonyK177
Title: Best in langkawi
Review: Haroo is easily the best restaurant in langkawi. Food is amazing and the service is fast. Waitress are very friendly and offers you many complimentary. Even the prices are quit affordable.(less than 6e many maincourses)

Author: Nathalie_198714
Title: Haroo Korean Restaurant
Review: By coincedence me and my sister walked past this restaurant. We were going for a quick bite, but it became an experience! The staff is really nice! Because we are from the Netherlands, we didn't have much experience with Korean food. We didn't even have to ask; the waiter started passionly talking about what he would recommend for Korean drink (a very refreshing lemon and honey lemonade!) and went with us through the dishes. It was all very friendly, so we didn't feel obliged to anything at all. He also went to get some sauce, so I could taste a bit first (indeed too spicy for me). The lunch (potato spaghetti!) was delicious. After the lunch we wanted to get the bill, but we received free cookies and cream icecream (yummie!). We ordered a taxi after, because we thought that was it after all the service, but we got another free drink and he got cooling down spray with aloë vera. Because the taxi was already there, we left in a bit of a rush, so couldn't try the sweets that he wanted to give us after, but these guys spoil you! And it all feels very relaxed. Take your time if you're going there for lunch, because it is a great introduction to Korean hospitality!Show less

Author: David GPoole, United Kingdom
Title: First time Korean. Fantastic
Review: Fabulous service brilliant food which is explained to you and you will receive expert advice about the dishes. We choose out own dishes and the waiter checked that we had made the correct choices, spicy, non spicy etc. One dish was explained to us on how to eat it correctly to get the full eating experience, Daughter Mum and Dad, Great restaurant experience. Also free ice cream at the end plus a sweetie to eat on the way home. We were there twice in a short breakShow less

Author: Kenneth P
Title: Great food, great service
Review: My family and I visited this place to eat dinner. We were greeted by a a very nice staff, friendly and very service minded, recommending from the menu. They were very kind explaining the "spicy-ness" of the different dishes, even allowing us to get a taste of some of the condiments. A big five-star recommendation from all four of us.Show less

Author: 658hampusb
Title: Amazing everything
Review: If you go there before rush hour (8pm) the service is incredible! Food is excellent and tasty and at a very good price! 5/5 will go back there again!!!

Author: paulB1043YTLeamington Spa, United Kingdom
Title: INCREDIBLE FOOD BUT IT HAS MOVED LOCATION
Review: If you're in Langkawi, you must eat here. We tried to go there for dinner a few nights ago and realised it changed location. But we still wanted to eat here to went for lunch. Head towards Sunba retrobar and Haroo is just on the left before that.Can't remember the guys name serving us but he was a great guy, great service and recommended us some fantastic food!!If anyone could let us know what the Korean names for the below foods are that would be great as I'd like to try them again! And they serve some fruity, gingery drink that was amazing too!! (Probably won't be as nice as they were here though!!).Eat and drink what we had below and it'll be an amazing meal!!Show less

Author: rebeccakX3650KESydney, Australia
Title: Spectacular service and delicious food!
Review: Delicious bibambap, I’ve never had it before so it was a great first experience for me. The service was impeccable, it started with a yummy refreshing shot of some kind of fruit that takes over a year to grow before harvest! The waiter gave us an overview of all the dishes that are native to Korea and recommended. Just as we were finishing up about to pay our bill our waiter emerged with a delicious scoop of ice cream on the house. Such a delightful experience, we’re going back tonight to try another dish. Show less

Author: MasterDisaster87
Title: Fully recommended!!
Review: We went to Haroo for dinner and it was absolutely delicious. Very nice korean food and so friendly stuff, we absolutely loved it! Go there and try the tasty nice meals...

Author: MatheiFBerlin, Germany
Title: Extraordinary service
Review: At first we couldn't find Haroo, because they had just moved to a new place 2 days ago. So we called them and asking where they are located now and instead of just giving us a new address the owner came to pick us up with her own car. The new place is really beautiful and the food is great. But service was the reason why we liked that place the most. I really recommend to go there, if you enjoy a nice evening with great and super friendly service and also good food.Show less

Author: Zoran S
Title: Must go in Langkawi
Review: You should visit this place even if you do not like Korean food as the service us rrally something special. We felt the most wellcoming. Just let the people there lead you through the dishes and you will most ceartnly enjoy.

Author: lindarZ4690YZ
Title: Amazing service and perfect food!
Review: Member of staff told us about korean food (that we knew nothing about) and gave us suggestions from the menu. Yuja with limoncello shot is a must have! When we finished our delicious meals, he sprayed us with refreshing aloe vera. He also gave us ice cream and some drink to sip (not to take as a shot like my boyfriend thought). Definetly our best dinner in Langkawi! Show less

Author: Wagirl2012Perth, Australia
Title: Delicious Korean food
Review: We had the privilege of going to the new look Haroo, they have moved to a new location, instead of up an alley was in Cenang Beach they are around the corner. ( Not sure of the street but the address on here is correct.) food is amazing and service was excellent. They are cash only, but definitely worth a visit. We were recommended a citrus Korean drink, which was so refreshing a bbq chicken and a beef dish. We were served a vegetarian pancake and kimchi with our meals. We were offered some of the best ice cream dessert. I wish I had taken my phone to take some pictures of the beautiful food and new location.Show less

Author: Rcg0806
Title: Excellent!!!!!
Review: Loved this restaurant! The food was incredible and the service outstanding. Our waiter was attentive and offered really helpful advise when we were choosing our food. We visit Langkawi a lot and this will definitely be somewhere we come back to. 100% recommend! :-)

Author: San D
Title: Nice Food, Friendly Staffs
Review: Visited on 3pm to 5pm, they were not busy on that time and enjoyed to have a nice chat and gain a lot of helpful information (especially about food that only locals know).

Author: 601isiKo Lipe, Thailand
Title: Genuine Korean cuisine with great culinary skill
Review: The food is superb, detail preparation make it presentable and delicious. Very great service and caring toward customer. I have witness the waiter spray with cold water to a guest who is obviously sunburn during the hot day and it makes her having a good relief from the hot sun weather. It is well explained why Korean restaurant can be no.1 in langkawi but not local food restaurant. I have tried few restaurant in langkawi and ironically this restaurant give me the best impression and will return again. Show less

Author: TheHungryStudent
Title: Great service
Review: All the food and drinks we had were delicious and reasonably priced but the service we received really stood out. We left very happy customers!

Author: ingridw219
Title: Not to be missed culinary experience
Review: Although we've been to Langkawi many times we had never visited Haroo before as Korean food had never appealed to us. However, we stumbled upon this restaurant in its new location (it had only been open a few days) while walking along Pantai Tengah just past the Frangipani hotel and, impressed by its attractive exterior and menu, we decided to give it a try. And we're so glad that we did! The whole experience from beginning to end was outstanding. The staff are all very friendly, efficient and knowledgeable guiding customers like us who know nothing about Korean cuisine to make the best choices for their own individual taste and palate. Taking the lead in this is Isabella, the owner, who helped us decide what to order. Her enthusiasm for Korean cuisine was infectious and we were excited to be trying something new. Our meal definitely lived up to our expectations! We had the seafood pancake, the famous bibimbap and the chicken bokeum and it was hard to decide which we enjoyed most as they were all equally delicious but perhaps the seafood pancake had the edge! It also has a bar next to the restaurant with a selection of beers, wines and spirits so it was nice for me to enjoy a couple of glasses of Sauvignon Blanc with my meal too. I'm sure Isabella and her family will make an even bigger success of their restaurant in its new location. It's an eating experience not to be missed and excellent value for money. Show less

Author: AiniyapPasir Ris, Singapore
Title: Everything was fabulous.
Review: FAB. The food is really amazing. The host was really kind and accommodating . We ordered bibimbap and kimjie jigae. It was very full-filling!! There was ice cream on the house and the host spray some free aloe vera moisturiser! It was a nice gesture for the hot weather! Will definitely come back! Really recommend this. Ann&Chels ❤️-ps-this shop doesnt show any HALAL sign but there is no pork seen on the menu. Your own judgement. Show less

Author: Phil dPerth, Australia
Title: First time Korean food experience
Review: Based on Trip Advisor Restaurant reviews we decided to try out this highly rated establishment. We eventually found it down an alleyway and went in to be told it was their last night there and they were relocating down the road and had to be open for business the next day. I asked if they did Korean BBQ and was told that was on the new menu. Sadly it was our last night so I didn’t have an opportunity to go back.We were warmly greeted and they were very patient and helpful explaining the dishes, offering suggestions. It was apparent that this was a popular restaurant as there were many people eating there and a steady flow of people trying to get in. As the night got later, they had to tell people arriving that they were closed. We ordered a glass noodle dish and a beef dish which came with a selection of vegetables and rice. With the second dish you placed into a lettuce leaf the combination of ingredients, along with a delicious splash of sauce plus kimchi, wrap and eat in 1 mouthful. That dish was sensational, clean and healthy…. Loved it. The glass noodle dish was nice but found the texture of the glass noodles a little slimy, however it was a well-executed dish. We were told that a citrus drink they did (cannot recall the name of the fruit as it was unfamiliar to me) was a refreshing drink to compliment the dishes. After requesting a shot of vodka in it, they happily obliged and it was delicious. A complimentary bowl of cookie and cream ice cream was given to us and it was out of this world.My only regret was that we were flying out the next day so we couldn’t go back to their new location and try other dishes. After asking where they sourced the stainless steel chopsticks (which were awesome), the owner told us from Korea and she wasn’t sure I’d be able to source them from Australia. She took it upon herself to give us a set to take home. What a delightful host.We were winding up to leave and a group of young Dutch people almost begged to be let in and they obliged. We observed as they ordered up big having no idea of the portion sizes. My wife asked if they would be able to eat that amount and everyone laughed saying they were hungry, but also by the look on their faces they realised they misjudged the generous portions. Of course my wife took photos of their dishes as they came out.Had a wonderful night. It was almost like eating at a Korean home rather than a restaurant. Don’t change a thing (apart from adding Korean BBQ to your menu) and thank you for such an awesome experience.Show less

Author: Taha A
Title: Perfection
Review: "Oh-em-gee" one of the best experience in Lankawi, the food was awesome and the service was more than great , there new location near to Sun spa and Kaya is better than the old one We had spicy seafood noodles and refreshment Korean drink and they were great If you go there ask for a guy called "Ben" he is like the boss there , this guy is full of energy and informations , if u need any help , this guy is on the rescue Show less

Author: 440linenOdense, Denmark
Title: I would go to Malaysia again only for the Korean food!
Review: This little hidden gem of a place is unbelievably good! In the backstreets of the crowded and touristy mainstreet is a Korean food heaven! We were welcomed by a very friendly waiter who knew just the right meal for us! We were advised to have the yu-ja which is a refreshing ice cold lemonade made from a Korean citrus fruit. Then we had the Bibimbap and the chicken bokeum, the Kimchi comes free of charge and is delicious! Both meals were enough to feed two - but the food was so good that we just ate until there wasn't any more. Please go - and spread the word that you can actually get brilliant authentic food in the most touristy of areas! Show less

Author: CharlieonTravelLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious vegetarian bibimbap! Best food in Langkawi.
Review: Haroo and Haroo+ are by far the best restaurants in Langkawi, and deservedly #1 here. If you're vegetarian, then you'll love the vegetarian bibimbap. At this Haroo, the veggie version of the bibimbap isn't listed on the menu but just ask and the staff are very friendly and accommodating. They said it was no problem to make a vegetarian version (or vegan if we wanted) and included tofu instead of meat. All fresh and delicious, a big bowl of rice, fresh veggies, tofu, egg and add your own spicy sauce. Loved it.Just a note that Haroo+ in town has a slightly different menu and a different style of vegetarian bibimbap. At Haroo+, a whole section of their menu is vegetarian with about 6 or 7 vegetarian options. Their vegetarian bibimbap is made with purple rice and fried egg instead, and their kimchi is vegetarian too. Definitely worth trying both places!Show less

Author: StartrekersNewton Abbot, United Kingdom
Title: Hooray for Haroo
Review: Family of four spent ten nights in Langkawi and tried various eating establishments, have never tried Korean food before but took a chance based on TA reviews.Firstly it's not easy to find down an unwelcoming lane with potholes and puddles but for info it's just opposite Underwater world.It's run by a lovely family who clearly care about what they produce and are keen to show what Korea has to offer. We liked it so much we ate there on three occasions and at no time did the quality slip, my particular favourite was Bibnbap and the seafood pancake.Now to the cost, we had two rounds of cocktails two bottles of wine and ten plates of mains to share for £63. It would have been good value at double that.All I can say is take a chance and find Haroo this is the top restaurant in Langkawi. Just a warning they only take cash.Show less

Author: DigoryStokenham, United Kingdom
Title: Can see why it is number 1
Review: First time eating Korean food and has to be the best place to try it. Enthusiastic staff delight in explaining food and making reccomendations. The food was excellent, service impeccable at a reasonable cost. Korean Beer (Hite i Think) was also a nice change from Tiger. Show less

Author: Akupetteri
Title: Dinner with family
Review:
Very very frendly staff,service is faboulous and helpful. Food is very nice,first time ever i taste Korean food but al three like much.
Not easy find but absolute taste place.

Author: 78giels
Title: Fantastic food served by wonderful people
Review: We had the bibimbap, ojingeo bokkeum and jap chae. All absolutely delicious! (with complementary dessert)They didn't mind us staying a bit longer after closing time due to heavy rainfall, and also arranged for a taxi to drop us off back home.Note they are moving soon to a new location a few km down the road, but definitely worth a visit!Show less

Author: Hwee Mean T
Title: Hearty hot food
Review:
Visited on a rainy evening.
Hot and hearty food suitable for family dining.
Not much kids meal variety.
Only accept cash.

Author: SK1808London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent!
Review: Stumbled upon this fabulous Korean restaurant while we were wandering down the Main Street. I love Korean food so was very excited when I spotted this Korean restaurant sign! It is a lovely little restaurant with a really nice atmosphere. The staff were exceptionally nice and friendly. We ordered the beef platter and kimchi pancake which were both excellent! My two year old daughter really enjoyed the food too. It was very good and very reasonably priced. Dinner was finished off with a complementary ice cream each which was such a nice touch. Would highly recommend Haroo!Show less

Author: joonasj338
Title: Very good food
Review: Best eat so far, bibimbap was good first experience on Korean food. Foods came quite fast and service was nice.

Author: 478lucasb
Title: Great food and service!
Review: The food was so good! The owners were so sweet and explained everything to us. What a lovely hidden gem tucked away from the main street. We will be back for some cheap food and drinks! We had bibimbap,  beef bulgogi, and spring rolls.

Author: VesaA40Yekaterinburg, Russia
Title: Very nice find
Review: We got into this restaurant by reading tripadvisor. Restaurant was on side road from beach road so probably woulnd't wandered there in accident.Food was absolutely delicious! Youngish waitress english was very ok and rest of the staff seemed pretty friendly too. Price was very moderate compared to the quality of food which was very good!Show less

Author: kimbT4469DYNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: First experience of Korean food
Review: Having never tried Korean food before, I was not disappointed, was hard to decide what to have as I liked the sound of all the dishes. On ordering sundubu jigae have to say it was delicious. The owner were so friendly and very helpful, and the service was fab will definitely be going back. Show less

Author: Adnan_Chowdhury67
Title: good Korean food
Review:
Read the reviews in TripAdvisor and decided to give this place a try. 
We ordered bibimbab, Grilled beef, kimchi and chicken tugbagi.
Food was good and served with a smile. The owner showed up and chatted with us.

Author: Chantalle88Leiden, The Netherlands
Title: Such a lovely place!
Review: We were warmly greeted when we arrived, and got a nice explanation of which dishes would be the best choice based on our preferences. We ordered the bibimbap and a sliced beef dish. Both were really yummy! What really made this place stand out was the kindness of the staff (and a free scoop of icecream!). Would definitely recommend this place!Show less

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Good Korean Food
Review: We love Korean food and this restaurant met our expectations. Coming from near London, where Korean food is very trendy, and having visited Korea we are used to the cuisine.The food on offer was a selection of standard Korean dishes with nothing to scare the visitor. Both dishes we had were excellant and the side order on Kimchi delicious. The spicing could have been a little hotter but as its in a tourist area thats to be expected.We will certainly add Haroo to out list of reliable and enjoyable Langkawi restaurants.  Show less

Author: Emma T
Title: Great food, great hosts
Review: Really enjoyed our meal here. Very friendly and relaxed. Food was excellent. Recommend the kimchi...

Author: NinaF1860
Title: Place is bit hard to find but certainly worth to drop by
Review:
Absolutely nicest service in the village. Hostess was really lovely person and food was really fresh, interesting and tasty.  Prices are on average level but the food was well above average.
Certainly worth to try Korean food in Langkawi

Author: Venture675381
Title: Best restaurant we tried on the island
Review:
Very nice people and very nice food,
Definitely the best restaurant we tried on the island...will come back again soon!

Author: HungryHungryBuddhaAdelaide
Title: The best Korean Food outside of Korea
Review: We happened to stumble (literally) on this little eatery while wandering down the main street of Langkawi. Tucked away in a backstreet, a small quaint shop sits. Outside, a lovely older gentleman waves at us, and we wave back. We were then hit with the smell of delicious food, and our stomachs roared with hunger. We sat down at a table outside, and were immediately given menus and a smile. Within a few minutes the old man was back, ready to take our orders, and boy was he in for a shock. We ordered almost everything on the menu, as we couldn't decide what to eat! He wrote all this down, looked at us and just smiled, patting his stomach. He knew we were in for a huge treat!The food arrived and oh my lord, it was incredible! From the Kimchi tofu hotpot, to the seafood pancakes and the tteokbokki... MY WORD! We were stuffed! The food was so lovely, the old man ever so generous! If I had to pick a spot to eat at for the rest of my life, this would be a top contender for sure. Do yourself a favour, get down to Haroo and enjoy the food - trust me, you won't ever be disappointed.Show less

Author: jodyreynoldsGreat Dunmow, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely.
Review: Hidden around the back of the main street I am so glad we found this restaurant. It was just lovely. Very basic in appearance, but so welcoming. The hostess was very attentive and we were made to feel very welcome. Our food was fresh and delicious. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: mbbszaman
Title: Delicious Korean Food
Review: I visited this cafe few times and love the food. The food is delicious and nice. The owner is warm and friendly. I like the ambience as well.

Author: Beequeen-DenmarkCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Perfect hostess
Review: First time at a Korean restaurant. The hostess made very good suggestions as what to eat, also very helpfully of how to eat Korean bbc. When we asked for the bill, we were given a little bowl of ice cream. They really cared about their guests.Show less

Author: Thomas G
Title: Lovely
Review: Lovely and friendly hostess. Great food. Very tasty food, and the owner was help to pick our choice from the menu.

Author: Emer NMadrid, Spain
Title: Tasty food and excellent staff!!
Review: We visited last night for dinner. The food was very tasty, reasonably priced (as were generously poured drinks!!) And we weren't waiting too long for it to come after a busy day. The waitress and boss were lovely and the free ice cream at the end was just what we needed!Show less

Author: LourensJSchiedam, The Netherlands
Title: Great dinner
Review: We had a great night at Haroo. Very nice hosts and amazing food! Also friendly atmosphere sitting outside on the veranda. A bit hard to find although in the centre of the village. Great value for money, we might go again in this few days in Langkawi!Show less

Author: rayram83Enschede, The Netherlands
Title: Nicest owner
Review: We had dinner at this place which was our 1st time eating Korean. The owner and staff helped us to pick our choice and it was very good. The food tastes great. I still prefer thai food, but that is personal. If you want to try Korean food for the 1st time, this is the perfect place. The staff is absolutely great and very nice. They deserved a big tip. I would definitely reccomend this place if you want to try something different which tastes good!Show less

Author: bmarsg
Title: A taste of Korea
Review: We stumbled upon this restaurant while looking for a place to have dinner. It was located behind a Chinese restaurant, we actually walked passed so many times during the day without noticing it. The restaurant is very cozy with very nice murals of different themes on the walls which you can take pictures of. The staff are very friendly and helpful. Not to mention also the boss is super polite as he checked on his guests frequently to make sure everything is taken care of.The food was nice with a home-cooked feel to it. Portion was big enough to share. Honestly it was not the best Korean food I've tasted before but it was delicious and also they provided us with free ice cream at the end of the meal. We are really happy, and will come again!! Kamsahamnida!!Show less

Author: alex k
Title: Nice korean food
Review: Good service with good food! Food portion is quite big, advisable for sharing if appetite is not big

Author: GaryS0609Malaysia
Title: Authentic Korean Cuisine in Langkawi
Review: Is located in the hidden ally opposite The Underwater World, but is not difficult to find with their huge signboard at the ally's entrance.Is small Korean restaurant but with a great ambiance, the food only one word i can describe - Authentic ! unlike other Korean restaurant serve localize or customized Korean cuisine, the taste in Haroo stay authentic. And also there is some Korean waitress in the restaurant and they are friendly and helpful, they even show us how to eat the food in "Korean's way". The price might be a little expensive but trust me, IS WORTH !!!Show less

Author: Elyysa
Title: Bring back seoul memories
Review: This is authentic korean food. Although a bit pricey (as everywhere else in cenang), the food we had was delicious and big portion too. Staffs and owner were very friendly.

Author: eleanor_tzy
Title: Huge portion, food just OK 'so so'👌
Review: We had their special bbq course for 2 person (rm175) and we 3 person(1male2female) could not finish it and end up packing some beef back. Their staff here provides tip top service. However the bbq beef is not that tender and juicy and not well marinated. The jap-chae glass noodle is however really good. Show less

Author: Andrei N
Title: Good place to try Korean food
Review: For us it was very different food style. Tasty, unorthodox. Excellent service. Not cheap but inexpensive. Definitely worth exploring while on Cenang.

Author: 589lenkas
Title: The best food and staff at Langkawi
Review: So nice staff!! And food is really delicious :) cooker is asking guests, if everything it's ok, I like it :) owner of this restaurant helped me mix their special food. If you want, you get recommendations what to order. Love that place.

Author: JChuaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonder why is this rated number 1?
Review: Had our first meal in Langkawi here due to its high ratings. Arrived at 7pm on a weekday but we were the only customers here. More customers arrived around 7.30pm. Ordered the Hotplate seafood for RM$60, thinking that the 3 of us could share but to our surprise, there were 5 prawns, 1 scallop, 2 mussels, 1-2 squids and some rice - all for a staggering RM$60 .... Frankly, this price is still quite acceptable in a Singapore Korean restaurant but come on, this is Malaysia. With the price that this Restaurant charges, its prices are even higher than nearby Penang where we visited twice recently, in fact, much much higher! Next, the side dish of seafood pancake was reasonably priced and portions acceptable but we hardly find any visible seafood in the pancake ....After we complained about the RM$60 main course, we were served complimentary plate of vermicelli with vegetables - a token from the nice owners, who are undoubtedly friendly, humble and very engaging. But the bill for the 3 of us came up to more than RM$100 (add another 10% service charge), and it has become the least value for money meal for us in a 6 days Langkawi trip. We later had real seafood meals in Langkawi and almost all costs less than this first Korean meal. Show less

Author: Maxime926
Title: Good Korean food & great service
Review: Adorable waiter and waitress will explain to you all the details about the menu and serve you complimentary ice cream for dessert.Spring rolls were really nice as appetizers. I had the Kimchi Jeon (Kimchi Pancake), slightly spicy and very filling. I recommend if you like kimchi.Otherwise the Bimbimbap is quite famous there.All prices were reasonable.We will come back!Show less

Author: Dishari
Title: Authentic Korean food in a Malaysian Island
Review: The place is low key, nicely done and has very friendly and cooperative staff. We ordered the famous Bibimbap and Jap Chae. The food was quite good, loved the complimentary cookie icecream.

Author: F1287PPandrews
Title: Wonderful little eatery with energetic staff
Review: Great spot.. it's low key and cosy which adds to the charm. The vegetarian rice special is a must which comes with kimchi and mini pancake ... the spring rolls were average tbh... best bit though are the staff for sure who get 15/10 for enthusiasm! Show less

Author: anji sWarkworth, United Kingdom
Title: First experience of Korean food
Review: We visited here with very little knowledge of Korean food. The staff and manager were really helpful, making suggestions and advising on how to eat the food. It was really good, nice and fresh and reasonable price. Would definitely recommend even if, like us, you had no idea what you were eating!Show less

Author: ValueSeeker83
Title: Authentic Korean Food in Langkawi
Review: Went there for brunch. I ordered the bimbimbap and seafood pancake. Fresh and nice. As an authentic restaurant, there is complimentary side dishes, which is the Cabbage Kimchi. It is also fresh and nice.

Author: eskilj2017Vaerloese, Denmark
Title: Good and freindly atmosphere
Review: Really nice food, looking good and tasting well, good prices and freindly service. It is halal, so there is none of the great barbeque pork the koreans do. Our barbeque in lettuche it was really nice, though from visits in Korea I'm used to more different leaves (perilla etc) and more vegetables ( marinated spring onions, bean sprouts, garlic slices, chili slices etc) to put into the lettuche bundles. I guess some of that is hard to get here. I don't know if they should be the #1 restaurant on Langkawi, but it is a nice place. Show less

Author: Jorgfr
Title: Excellent
Review:
Thanks to TripAdvisor :-)
Excellent welcome and care during the meal of the staff. Very good food. Reasonable prices as well.

Author: francoise_armando
Title: The place to have diner in Pantai Cenang
Review:
We enjoy the diner. The good is great and the people are vert nice.
I recommand strongly this restaurant .

Author: scottjausMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious and friendly
Review: Visited Haroo for lunch after reading great reviews on TripAdvisor. Food was delicious. I haven't eaten much Korean food but I definitely will be looking for it more when I return home. Generous with side dishes too, including a free small bowl of icecream - great if you have something spicy!Highly recommended. It's in a back street so relatively quiet and was very quick when I visited around 1pm.Show less

Author: R_K_TripleB
Title: Very good
Review: The staff was very friendly and we could order our meal very fast. The food was delicous and more than enough. The price-performance-ratio is good. And you can find it easily, bc it's right behind the mainstreet.

Author: FionaMerryShepparton, Australia
Title: Great food and friendly service
Review: We had a delicious lunch here. Our waiter from Nepal was very friendly and helpful and made you feel welcome. The vegetable pancake was very tasty, the glass noodles and the bibimbap were also very enjoyable. The lime drink was the best drink we had in Langkawi. You must eat here if you visit Langkawi. Show less

Author: RainaWong
Title: Nice kimchi, but overpriced
Review: FOC pancake and kimchi are very tasty, but main course is overpriced. By the way,  the owner is friendly.

Author: arijit2671Bhopal, India
Title: Great Food
Review: Great Korean food. Situated in a lane almost opposite the Langkawi Underwater world. They close at 9.30 pm every night, and you won't get anything to eat if you are late . We had their signature dish, and it was awesome. Service was very prompt. They do not serve any liquor. A must visit when you are at Langkawi Show less

Author: PetraT4Sumperk, Czech Republic
