Title: Korean restaurant
Review: Food was so delicious that we went there more times. I always going different places but this one I had to go back and try more dishes. Food was fast and the employees were nice and friendly.Show less

Author: S611YMmarcocAsinara, Italy
Title: Great friendly service, tasty food!!!
Review: The great reviews we read on a trip advisor led us to come to eat at Haroo. We have been eating a lot of Malay food and fancied something different on our holiday. We were made to feel welcome immediately by the incredibly friendly staff. The owner was very helpful in helping us select some dishes. The food was superb, I would recommend this hidden gem. Great food at a great price and with great service. What more can you ask! Show less

Author: Twaro
Title: Great food
Review: The best food we had in Langkawi. Everything we've ordered was delicious. We had jap- chae, kimchi - jeon and haemul - pajeon. Besides, the staff is really friendly and helpful in Haroo. We definitely recommend this place!

Author: Tun M
Title: Always be my favorite!
Review: Had late lunch here since my first visit was a blast. Indeed a warm place with great food. A Korean lady was at the shop very welcoming, and check me and my delicious korea spicy soup. This is my fav place and will definitely come here again whenever I come to here for work.Show less

Author: Mansoor999
Title: Great friendly place
Review: Isabelle is super hospitable and knows how to take care of guests. Lovely food coupled with super service led to a fantastic food and an enjoyable evening. Korean food was nicely cooked. Good variety and authentic

Author: Sambam1993
Title: Delicious
Review: Found this place thanks to trip advisor and it was great! Meals super tasty and fresh and the restaurant is set off the Main Street so a nice, quiet place to enjoy dinner. Definitely recommend

Author: peattielis21
Title: So yummy
Review: Delicious food with very attentive service from the staff. Cheap prices  with free icecream and candy after mains. I would definitely go back and have a new love for korean food

Author: elbertlim
Title: Good Foods
Review: Visited this with my family. Ordered bibimbap, jab chae and seafood soup noodle. There are free kimchi and small pancake. Not really like the pancake. The food really good

Author: trisarahtopstravelsAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Amazing service
Review: Visited as a group of 6 with no booking and recieved outstanding service. Tucked down a little alleyway it has cute decor, fairy lights and much needed fans at every table. We were all very pleased with our meals, one of the best dinners we've had on langkawi. They were generous enough to give us a bowl of ice cream each for dessert free of charge and a Korean candy as we left. Definitely recommend. Show less

Author: Pınar A
Title: Amazing place!
Review: We accidentally found Haroo and I am very glad that we have! The dishes are so good, tasty, and the portions are HUGE. The prices are not expensive, and the lady there is such an exceptional hostess.At the end of the meal you get complimentary ice cream, and even give you candy when you are leaving. We had to go back once more on our final night because it was just amazing. Show less

Author: 944angiep
Title: Great authentic Korean food
Review: Our family enjoyed the food recommended and cooked by the lady boss (who also acts as the Chef). It was a wonderful dinner despite the journey from datai. Recommended 👍👍👍

Author: 404charlotteh
Title: Loved everything!
Review: Amazing people, great food and a lovely little establishment! Couldn't have asked for more. Went for dinner tonight and couldn't wait to write a review to recommend it to more people :)

Author: Oldestbull
Title: Family who cares
Review: Had a great local flavored meal , served by members of the family. You could tell they appreciated the business by the way they took care of you. Free ice cream to finish. Just off the main street but dont be discouraged.

Author: bettyk915Geelong, Australia
Title: yum!
Review: We decided to try out Haroo based on the good rating. The hype is true! The restaurant is set just off the main road in Cenang. I had the Japchae, which was delicious! The staff also gave us some kimchi and pancake slices for the table to try. The service was great, and efficient. Vanilla ice cream appeared on the table soon after we finished eating.Show less

Author: ThomasFrank1989
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Fantastic fresh food, beautifully cooked with great service. Really lovely family. Great price too. What more can you ask for?! So good 👍🏻

Author: bellaakjSingapore
Title: Healthy and wholesome korean food!
Review: Very cozy place. Friendly owner and staff.. good and attentive service.. the food didnt take too long to be prepared and when it came it was heaven! My husband had the bulgogi and for me the sundubu jigae and on a rainy day like today.. the soups were just heavenly.. and there were lots of veggies! My husband and 2 kids enjoyed ourselves very much! To finish off we were then given ice cream for free and the kids were really beaming by then. Thank you for the wonderful meal and we will definitely come back the next time we are in Langkawi! Show less

Author: Anna P
Title: Delicious dinner and fantastic service
Review: My husband and I saw this restaurant on trip advisor as highly recommended and having now eaten there we can see why! We ordered the Kimchi rice and Bibimbab - both absolutely delicious!! We also were given complementary sample of vegetable pancake, side of kimchi and ice cream to finish off. Staff were very friendly and attentive. Definitely recommend!! Show less

Author: yings332
Title: Out of expectation😏😏
Review: The food is surprisingly delicious. 4 dishes are big enough to serve 5 pax! They gave free ice cream as well😇😇 thumbs up for Haroo Haroo!!!!

Author: Nicola G
Title: Excellent food and friendly staff
Review: We ordered Bibimbap with kimchi sides. Best place I ate in pentai cenang and extremely welcoming and friendly staff. Would highly recommend a visit.

Author: Trinet1702
Title: God mad, fantastisk service
Review: We had read the reviews and wanted to try it out. I ordered some kind of pancake, which they told me were sour, but I didn't thought it Would be a problem. Unfortunately it didn't fall in ny taste, so they wanted to make another pancake for me without paying extra. It was a really good service. They were all very smiling and friendly, and We really felt like We were welcome. After dinner they served a scoop of icecream, which We very Nice as an ending to the dinner. They food were very Nice. I Will definitely recommend it if you Want to Try traditionel korean food to a good Price.Show less

Author: annworth2009Sandringham, Australia
Title: Lunch
Review: Service was amazing. I was the only diner and served by owner and young male.Without asking they sat me under a fan and gave me a glass of ice for the water I had with me.I was cautious re eating seafood but meal was lovely.$10 ringette for spring rolls Think seafood was $38 ringette.So cheap. Food far superior than Orkid. And half the price.The walk down the lane and the appearance from the lane I nearly walked away.Give it a try.Show less

Author: Tun M
Title: A not disappointing introduction to Korean Food
Review: Gave myself a try after reading many good reviews on Tripadvisor about thia restaurant.Definitely the visit and food was not disappointing.Ordered spicy noodle and it was yummy. I was the only customer at the time I dine roughtly around 12pm, and the waiter was pleasant. Crowd started to build up in the restaurant around 1.30pm.I even got a complimentary dessert - vanilla ice cream before I leave.This place is recommended to those who love Korean Food or a beginner.Show less

Author: Cameron B
Title: Excellent
Review: My wife suggested trying this restaurant as it had great reviews. So after a brief search down an alley accross from underwater world we found it.From the front it doesn't look like much, but from the moment you enter you feel welcomed. Service is quick and polite and the owners always have a smile on their face.Both ordered the bipimbap. By far the best thing we've eaten since being in langkawi. As someone who rates harshly 10/10 and will definitely be returning. Show less

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: As good as Haroo+ in Kuah
Review: Visited this restaurant twice ordering the same seafood spicy noodle soup and kimchi fried rice. Always so delicious and satisfying. Staffs are friendly that they will always approach you and ask if you satisfied with their food. Ice cream will be served as a dessert too (depends on availability). Worth going! Show less

Author: britishaussie55Adelaide, Australia
Title: OUTSTANDING!!!
Review: The best meal we have eaten in Malaysia. Isobella provided the most amazing service. Such a fresh and friendly face, which we have struggled to find in Langkawi. My partner ordered the Bibimbap which he said was the best he had eaten, even coming from Australia where we have a strong Asian influence of food. I had the Bulgogi, a recommendation to try from Isobella. I was not disappointed. Amazing. She also brought us a complimentary taste of the savory pancake, yum! And to top it off, a complimentary scoop of icecream each. 10/10. You are missing out if you don't visit Haroo while on your visit to Langkawi. Show less

Author: flyhigh_jiyoung
Title: Good to try.
Review:
As a Korean, it tastes quite okay. We tried kimchi stew and beef grill. Kimchi stew was good and beef grill is okay. 
The Korean boss and staff are friendly.

Author: Mark R
Title: Delissioso
Review:
Can't wait to go back. 
Staff are incredibly welcoming without being pushy, food was second to none and very generous, and pistachio ice cream to finish was perfect.

Author: AdrianY397
Title: Superb bibimbap and kimchi
Review: 1. Small alley in front of under water world 2. Start operation by 12pm.3. Very very good bibimbap and kimchi. And I will definitely come back again.Very difficult to find car park, better park by roadside and walk into the alley.We lunch there, but with the heat during 12pm is really very challenging. Show less

Author: 151annaoRzeszow, Poland
Title: first impressive experience with korean restaurant !
Review: We visited the korean restaurant Haroo during our visit in Langkawi based on very good rating on Trip Advisor. And it was really worth to try new style of eating, new tastes and perfect service which was offered us. If you don't like too spicy food you can always ask them to prepare less spicy meal and you can enjoy korean cusine - one of the best in Langkawi Island!Show less

Author: dilz303Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Tasty meal
Review: Really delicious food. Lots of vegetarian options too. In a nice quiet spot just off the main street.Show less

Author: Mikael SEspoo, Finland
Title: Very good to excellent Korean with friendly and genuine service
Review: On a quiet side alley, very child-friendly, very good food, tentative service. The presumed owner of the place personally mixed the Bibimbap for our kids and they cooked the egg separately since our younger child is allergic to eggs. Very nice atmosphere, the waiter and the owner spent time with us explaining and listening when we had questions.Show less

Author: DavidJ7183Singapore, Singapore
Title: Blink and you will miss it
Review: Tucked away down a side street opposite the aquarium this little Korean is easy to miss. Quaint decor, attentive staff and great food. We loved this place. The owners are just so warm and gracious. The food is up there with the best home cooked Korean food I have had in Asia and it's so reasonably priced. I should give Haroo ***** Show less

Author: jschwa1United Kingdom
Title: Delightful!
Review: This Korean restaurant is in the middle of Pantai Cenang, but set back from the main street, so is a lot less busy and feels more relaxed as a consequence.The owner is very friendly and helpful guiding you through choices of food and demonstrating the best way to stir up the contents of your Bibimbap.The food was really tasty and well prepared/presented. Service was friendly and efficient, but not pushy etc.Also added in some free savoury pancakes and ice cream which were not added to the bill.All in all, our best meal in Pantai CenangShow less

Author: Wagirl2012Perth, Australia
Title: Korean food
Review: We went here for dinner, the food was amazingly good value. A family home style restaurant but the food was good.We were welcomed in and provided cold drinks quickly, the food was so tasty. We were new to Korean food, and would highly recommend with lovely ice cream at the end.We were the only ones in the restaurant at 7:30 but quickly filled with families, groups of friends and couples.A real find!Show less

Author: AndrewPhilWoo
Title: Wonderful!
Review: The food was marvellous and super cheap. The owner is a bloody great bloke, super attentive and the ice cream was a beautiful post meal touch. Highly recommended. APW Show less

Author: fridaradmarkVasteras, Sweden
Title: Very good food and friendly service
Review: It's a must for good food in Langkawi. Even though it's approx 30 meters off the main road, it serves some great food and very service-minded staff. Show less

Author: lalila1234Berlin, Germany
Title: Food delicious and nice restaurant
Review: If you like Korean food you should definitely try it, my food was delicious and it's also nice to sit there , the restaurant is cute and the service was very friendly and nice as wellShow less

Author: _H1413NRSingapore, Singapore
Title: A rarely authentic Korean food in Langkawi....even to Koreans !
Review: We didn't expect such an authentic Korean taste in Malaysia...definitely not in Langkawi but we were fortunate enough find this place where the owner served us with some great food not to mention A1 service. Dishes were tasteful and were satisfactory to all of us and we would definitely visit again. Show less

Author: Adriana_tripsGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Amazing Korean food
Review: This restaurant is excellent. The Bibimbap is very tasty, the cold tea excellent and the owner is kind and funny (although his English is not great). They offered us ice cream.Show less

Author: themanfromearthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummmmmmyyyy!
Review: Super friendly owner, welcomes you with such a big smile. Very pleasant ambience too.We ordered the kimchi salad, bibimap and a veg broth with rice. There are instructions on the table on how to eat the bibimap! All the items were super delicious. Easily one of the best we have had in Langkawi. Would definitely recommend going there!!! Food that fills the stomach and the heart! Show less

Author: Bray363London, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly helpful owner
Review: First time we have had Korean food the staff were very pleasant and helpful explaining all the dishes the little restaurant is just off the main road but well worth a visit value for money while you are in pantai cenang langkawi with a free ice cream nice little touchShow less

Author: Cesc4FabLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cannot sing enough praise!
Review: We came to this restaurant fairly late in the evening, and as a group we were greeted by an extremely friendly man who remained pleasant and attentive throughout. The food was fantastic. Everyone in the group quietly tucked away through their meals; extremely happy. I still salivate thinking about the wonderful bibimbap! Fantastic food, service second to none - our best meal on the island.Show less

Author: kikifhrnFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Best Korean Food in Langkawi
Review: Honestly, you need to try this restaurant when you're Langkawi. Worth every penny!The owner is very nice and he mixed my Bibimbap. The portion is big enough. Not very cheap, but it's best value in Pantai Cenang.Also, you get free ice cream!!!!Show less

Author: Leona_NLKMainland, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty!
Review: That was the first time I tried Korean cuisine & I totally loved it! Every dish in a menu is well explained so you won't be in a situation when you have no idea what to order as you can't understand anything.Really tasty food, huge portions, nice service.The only downside: fresh juices. Tried mango & pineapple, both tasted like water with a hint of fruit. For 10 MYR each we expected better quality drinks. So definitely come to eat here but don't order juices!Show less

Author: V1857XOjansBangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice one with very friendly stuff
Review: Really good food and very helpful owner, explaining about dishes and korean cuisine.Must have try seafood pie, based on potatoes.Show less

Author: Nicole BEdmonton, Canada
Title: Fantastic!
Review: We went here twice for dinner during our stay in Langkawi. It's just off the main drag, easy stroll from our hotel. The owners are incredibly friendly and likeable. There's instructions on how to properly mix your own bibimbap (nice touch) and the decor is friendly and very inviting. The food though. So good! We tried the kimchi, spring rolls, bibimbap, seafood pancake, and the sweet potato noodles (twice).. all of it amazing! All very reasonable prices too (approximately 90-100 ringgit for a very filling, nongreasy meal - not an easy thing when my husband has 'hollow legs'). Not super budget prices, but reasonable. In the end we wish we could box this place up and bring it home. But then we'd spend too much money :)Show less

Author: lkirby405Guangzhou, China
Title: Best Korean Resturant I have ever been to.
Review: In my opinion, this was one of the best Korean restaurants outside of Korea. Although , I have never been to Korea, my parents have and they said that it has one of the best bibimbaps they have ever ate. While we were inside Haroo , we looked at the wonderful paintings on the walls , which had some touching quotes on them. Although we were the only ones there , the Haroo staff were quick and speedy to make the food. I would definitely come here again the next time I come to Langkawi. And maybe get more free ice cream ! (yes, they gave us free ice cream )Show less

Author: Nicholas K
Title: Great food!
Review: For me, this was one of the best Korean restaurants I've ever been to. The food was amazing, I was really considering ordering more than I could eat! The staff are quite nice, the owner is Korean and is very polite and helpful. Would definetly go again! I would recommend this to anyone in the Langkawi region looking for something to eat with family or friends.Show less

Author: Stina1978Den Bosch, The Netherlands
Title: Made me want to go to Korea!
Review: I don't know how come that this restaurant doesn't show up in the Pantai Cenang area on TA, but in all of Langkawi instead, that makes it hard to find which is a shame. Anyway we saw its name on an island map given at our hotel and decided to visit one night... We ended up coming here 3 more times in our two weeks stay.Its a little off the main road making it a bit more difficult to just walk in but its worth looking for.Great food, very attentive owner (who even showed us how to mix the bibimbap right), and its cheap too! Menu is not very extensive but the portions are large, just one main dish was more than enough for each of us. It is definitely a must when in Pantai Cenang!Show less

Author: juliah0ds0nKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: An absolute MUST!
Review: If you're in Langkawi you HAVE to eat at this place. The food is absolutely amazing. It was one of the best meals we had on our trip. All the dishes tasted so good but if you get the traditional Korean BIBIMAP the adorable man who owns the shop will come and mix it for you the "traditional" way. Pretty cool to see. My 8 friends and I each had a dish and we ordered 4 bottles of wine between us and it only cost $20 AUD which is cheap for Melbourne... not necessarily cheap for Malaysia but it was honestly worth every penny. Couldn't recommend it more.Show less

Author: Flint_piggyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food at a price
Review: Excellent little restaurant, hidden in a side street off the main cenang road. Very friendly and attentive staff, who made us feel at home. It's not the best Korean restaurant I've eaten at, there's much better in KL, but for the Cenang area it's worth it. The prices are higher than average, 3 main courses, plus 2 fruit juices and 2 beers came to RM175. The owner offered us some appetizers and ice cream for free without us asking. Worth going, just to try something different.Show less

Author: tyroner762
Title: Awesome
Review: Great service, attentive owner. Exceptional food quality and flavor. Complements to the chef. Price not cheap cheap, however very reasonable.

Author: carabiner1
Title: Nothing special
Review: The portions are big enough but the price is a lot more than you would expect from such a restaurant.

Author: traveltheworldandeat
Title: Amazing Dinner!
Review: We had a great night out here. The food was amazing and the staff very very friendly. We will for sure go again!

Author: Mariersuper
Title: Go here!
Review: Amazing korean food! Beautiful dishes and great tastes. The bokeum chicken was heavenly. We were really positively surprised!

Author: carmanhee
Title: Nice food & nice people
Review: Nearby Cenang beach, delicious Korean food and reasonable price. Very friendly Korean boss, clean and cozy place to have dinner.

Author: pianocelloShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: If you have been to good Korean restaurants in Penang and Kuala Lumpur, this restaurant is nothing special. For what it is, it is the best Korean restaurant in Langkawi. The food is delicious but not spectacular. The owner is friendly but the decor is nothing special. It is a bit expensive for what it is but it did satisfy my craving for Korean food. Show less

Author: Michi P
Title: Very kind staff, very good Korean food
Review:
We had bibimbap which was absolutely delicious. The manager told us exactly how to eat it the right Korean way. 

You can also order there white wine, which was great as well.

Author: katlala
Title: delicious, tastes legit
Review: Yummy Korean food!! A nice surprise here in Langkawi. Very authentic, also attentive and fast service.

Author: NATASHAT1322
Title: Amazing food and service at a good price! Vegetarian option too
Review: I travelled with my parents (who are from Malaysia), my sister (we were born and raised in London) and my boyfriend who is vegetarian. Haroo ticked all the boxes for our range of tastes, including restoring my mum's faith in Korean food after a few duds in London. The chef brought out some of the food herself and the owner came out to welcome us and mix my boyfriend's bibimbap properly! They also brought out a free starter and free ice cream for us all. It had been a long and very rainy day for us, so it was great to be able to finish it with an excellent meal at Haroo. I tried the Korean sweet-potato noodles (jap chae) which I highly recommend! Show less

Author: StormBear11Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Korean food
Review: We had a wonderful meal here, best so far on Langkawi. We both ordered bibimbap from the friendly and attentive waiter. It arrived super fast. The friendly Grandfather of the family who owns the restaurant then offered to mix it up correctly for us, as he could see we were struggling. Anywhere else this might have been a bit creepy, but honestly it was a kind and helpful thing to do. The ambience here was lovely, it's set slightly back from the Main Street so it's quiet and peaceful. Prices very reasonable. The food tasted amazing. We will return before we leave the island.Show less

Author: Shaun B
Title: Excellent food
Review: Excellent food and very friendly staff. Meals came out quickly and our order was 100% correct. Also very easy to find and and an easy to read menu.

Author: Viviean W
Title: Originally Korean cuisine
Review: Should try this, they serve original taste of Korean cuisine. We like it, especially Japchae and Kimchijeon

Author: dewdrop1303Singapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly & Personal
Review: Came for lunch on a wet day so only another table is occupied. Owner is extremely attentive and friendly. We ordered seafood pancake, bimbimbap and seafood kimchi soup (natural choice on a wet afternoon). All dishes were delicious and we enjoyed every bit. Owner even treated us to a scope of mango ice cream each. Thanks a lot! Show less

Author: druidmaciek
Title: Great food and staff
Review: Amazing Food, and friedly staff. I had bibimbap which was so delicious and korean grape juice. I recommend this place to everyone.

Author: 255grainnejDa Nang, Vietnam
Title: Amazing Korean food and great service !!
Review: Such a lovely place to grab dinner. We were treated like royalty in this restaurant! And the food was Devine! The staff there were very friendly and we were each given mango icecream at the end of our meal- so lovely! Wish we could have gone again!! Go here if in langkawi!!!! Show less

Author: Philippe J
Title: Nice dinner in Pentai Cenang
Review:
The owner of this little korean restaurant is so sweet.  We order the Bibimap and that was so good. The owner event mix it for me to make sure I would enjoy it. 
Try it!!

Author: James K
Title: Amazing food! And service!
Review: Food ranges between 20 and 35 for a meal which is an absolutely fair price. The meals are big and extremely tasty!!!! The staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly and there were few people in the restaurant. They gave us mango ice cream at the end of our meal also . It was very very nice! Tasty Korean food! Show less

Author: Wayne-Dennis C
Title: authentic korean food
Review: the food are genuinely authentic. owner is a family of 3, great service, attentive and patient while we choose our food. also thorough on explaining to us the items on the menu.

Author: jiah169
Title: Best Korean food ever, very nice staff. Love it!
Review: The chef is a Korean couple, the taste is soooooo good, different but better taste than the Korean food I had before. Highly recommended, the rank is only 16 I think because western ppl can not take spicy.

Author: 780briane
Title: Excellent Korean restaurant
Review: Charming couple run this unpretentious restaurant, food quality is excellent but does run to the spicy end of the spectrum. Friendly and informal service, great value and unique

Author: Pam CLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Superb Dining Experience
Review: This is a very clean and friendly establishment with a great menu, serving utterly delicious food. The beautiful hand-crafted menus contain really helpful explanations about Korean food for the uninitiated. Our kids (18 and 13) hassled us until we went back and dined there a second time. Very tastefully decorated, gorgeous front verandah to eat on. Tucked down a side street opposite the underwater world attraction and therefore away from all the traffic fumes and the smell from the large open gutters on the street. Even if you've never eaten Korean food before I highly recommend you give this place a go. It was our first experience of Korean cuisine and it left us googling similar establishments in our home city! That's how good it was.Show less

Author: Lynn s
Title: Delicious
Review: Woow this food was absolutely the best thing we've eaten in weeks ( we had dinner at a lot of places during our travels) You should really check it out and definitely try their bibimbap, it's so delicious and full of vegetables! Oh and those people? They're really lovely as well! Show less

Author: keepinggracekeepinggrace
Title: Great Korean Food
Review: Ran by a Korean family, it has quite diverse food choices. It's on Pantai Chenang(near underwater world) so easy to get to, yet tucked in enough you'll have a peaceful meal. I would not say it is budget though - should be min around rm40 per head. Good food, cute shop. Show less

Author: Marlinde v
Title: So friendly
Review: Go off the main road and try this Korean restaurant. Staff is so friendly, advised us on the dishes and let us try some typical Korean food. Would go there again.

Author: Miez-dHorst, The Netherlands
Title: Very nice korean Experience
Review: This is the first time my family and I ate Korean food and it was really nice! We had the jap-chae, bimbibap and tukbaegi bulgogi. It was all very good and not too spicey. Another plus is that the white wine (sauvignon blanc) is good, affortable and available by glass. The service was also very friendly. We even got free icecream after dinner, so nice! The vibe is really nice as well! Can definitelly recommend this place! Show less

Author: Rogelio2004
Title: Malaysia 2016
Review: Excellent food and excellent service. Stay away from the crowd and enjoy  a truly and tasteful korean food for a reasonable price

Author: lake332
Title: Do u wana really Korean food.?
Review: Just here.!! In cenang, only Korean food restaurant. price is..um so so..why not? here is cenang.!! :)

Author: colinb541Sydney, Australia
Title: Just visit - address changed.
Review: This is t h e best Korean in Langkawi, and one of the best (period) in Langkawi. The elderly owner is so courteous and is attentive to all your needs. He is seriously a respectful man who can cook. Let him guide you to the cuisine and just eat. It's that good. And your wallet will not be burdened by the experience. The restaurant is situated down a side road opposite the far edge of underwater world - No. 82 Jalan Pantai Cenang, Langkawi. Toilets clean and good. Lovely place. Lovely food. Lovely people. Show less

Author: DarbukaVantaa, Finland
Title: Lunch in Ramadan time Korean style
Review: Malay kitchens everywhere very much closed during Ramadan festivities. One is hungry anyways so almost opposite Langawi Sea World is small alley where Haroo in waiting for you. We had Biminbab with Kimchi and Korean Pancake with squids and schrimps.Portion were big enough and tasty. Korean chilisauce was extra superb good! For exelent food, price is right for the quality.Show less

Author: poweragt1
Title: Original Korean Food
Review: The food is very Korean but the pricing is on the high side.  Many tables available to diners. If you are into original Korean food, this the place to be. Owner is Korean and friendly.

Author: sbrady123London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely meal at reasonable prive
Review: My partner and I had dinner at Haroo tonight and is was a really lovely and tasty meal!We shared spring rolls to start and then had the bibimbap and kimchi pancake. Everything was really good, my personal favourite being the kimchi pancake. On top of the food, they gave us a couple of free sides and a scoop of ice cream for dessert!! It was very generous portions and we were stuffed after. Not sure if it is authentic Korean food as never had it before, but who cares if it tastes nice?!People have said its expensive but I disagree. A main was about RM28, but that comes with rice included as well as the free sides and ice cream. This is very similar to all other restaurants in the area. For example, the local Indian restaurants may have some mains for RM20 but then you pay for rice and naan on top of that. You don't need anything else here!Finally, the staff are really friendly, especially the main owner who is very smiley! Show less

Author: FA1987London, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food
Review: This place was hard to find so look out for the big HAROO sign on the main road. But it was a great find, the owner was delighted to serve us, and the food was excellent. Order the spring rolls for 7RM, they were great, and we were also given complimentary Spanish omelette, kimchi and ice cream. Show less

Author: Rona NLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Won't ever comeback
Review: It was actually last year but I think it a must to share my experience . We thought it's authentic Korean food but I saw there is Thai food and Malay food . A little bit confused because all the dishes we ordered slightly same taste and all ingredients slightly same , we didn't know actually what we ate . Pricey compared to what they served .Won't ever come back again .Show less

Author: SinghGauravSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic korean food
Review: While having the food cheaper would have been amazing. But the food quality in terms of authenticity and taste was excellent. I eat a lot of Korean food but never in too expensive places. Compare to other restaurants around eating Korean in langkawi did feel kind of expensive. Anyhow, the food was fab and the people running it very nice. Expensive soju...Loved that complimentary ice cream too!Show less

Author: Koz N
Title: Good food but over priced!
Review:
Good food but over priced!
Had dinner with family, gave us free ice cream, over charged for beer but I didn't say anything, family run, polite folks

Author: Toubi007Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: Great!
Review: The restaurant is a little bit off the path,but easy to find! Very friendly owner and great food! I was going for the traditional Korean dishes such as Kimchi and Bibimbap, both delicious! Plus I got an extra Omelette and ice cream even without asking and paying. Try it out! Show less

Author: David UDoha, Qatar
Title: Great food lovely staff
Review: Eating at haroo was simply a pleasure. The place is owned by a Korean husband and wife both of them in their early sixties. They make one of the best stir fried noodles you have ever eaten. furthermore after going there for a third time they gave us a tasty dessert of homemade pistachio ice cream. if i get a chance to visit langkawi again this is the first place I'm going!Show less

Author: Kyle E
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Went here one evening and the food is very authentic. Great tasting and reasonable in price. Enjoyed our visit

Author: 5334david
Title: Nice food
Review: My wife and I read the good reviews and have never tried Korean food The first thing we noticed was how clean the restaurant was ( spotless )It is opposite underwater world , down a small alleyReally enjoyed the food and highly recommend it Definately yes Show less

Author: andkebaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic, finger-licking Korean food!
Review: The service was outstanding, the food was delicious and everything was reasonably priced - what more can you ask for?! Haroo was a marked uplift from the food we ate at our 5-star hotel so if you are in Langkawi you definitely have to make a point to eat here.Show less

Author: Suresh RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Korean Food in the North
Review: By far I would rate this restaurant the best Korean food in the north. If you are looking for authentic / fusion korean food this is the place you should come to.... they have 3 different branches with different themes. Haroo in Cenang is the innitial set up followed by Haroo+ in Kuah town. The latest addition is Haroo Story which is probably focusing on a quick preprepared dishes. Prices are superbly reasonable too. You have to try the dolsot bibimbap, the kimchi jiggae, galbi and definitely the kimchi. The best kimchi I have ever had. Better than the ones i tried all over Seoul and Busan. The place is operated by a Korean family and they have been in Langkawi for a couple of years now. The service is superb and the Korean owners are friendly and hospitable. Definitely a must to try place if you are in Langkawi!Show less

Author: xangelfacex
Title: Great food and service!
Review: Best food in the area of downtown and the service is also impeccable. The price is not 'cheap' but bit excessively expensive. Worth it!!

Author: TeeeeeevaPenang, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food! Must try in Langkawi!
Review: Food in Haroo was very delicious as the owner of Haroo is a typical korean. The onwer is friendly and patient. However, side dishes were only served with bibimbap.Free ice cream also made our day in Langkawi!Nice try in Haroo and we will definitely come again!The average price of food is within RM28-35Show less

Author: inlovewithcarribeanDublin
Title: I suppose they call it hidden gem?
Review: It is a bit out of the way and misleading position on the app so we only got to Haroo on our last night. The food was delicious, price reasonable and atmosphere vert friendly and welcoming. I'd say with all that Pantai Cenang has to offer this one is one of the best. i you can get a beer no problem! i'd say that a bonus...Show less

Author: Cher_hp24Luzon, Philippines
Title: First and Last
Review: Ordered kimchi and BibimbapServed in a plastic bowl Egg was Over-cookedFresh pineapple juice was not really a fresh one but extremely sweet artificial one.Its gonna be my first and last visit for food! This is the 2nd korean food i visited in Langkawi both were bad.Show less

Author: Maija83Voula, Greece
Title: Delicious, fresh korean
Review: As a huge fan of korean food, I really wanted to try this place for dinner based on the great reviews, and was not disappointed! The restaurant is very clean, food is super fresh and tasty, and the owners are so friendly and welcoming. I would definitely make an effort to return if I'm ever in the area again.Show less

Author: yinsterLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Unexpected
Review: You don't go to Lang Kawi and come out having experienced really tasty korean food. Well worth the find. If you go on the same day as the Night Market, it is a treat to eat. It was so good, we went twice out of the three days we stayed in LK. Portions are big and the restaurant is clean. Owners are so friendly, make you feel like good friends.Show less

Author: adelka5Prague, Czech Republic
Title: Great food
Review: Can be more difficult to find, as the restaurant is not right on the main street. It is opposite UnderWater and just in the back street. Very friendly staff, very good food, definitely worth the money. For us the best place to go for a lunch while staying at Pantai Cenang beach. We were there twice and we always got something extra for free, for example more kimchi or egg omelette and icecream at the end! You can pay by card or cash. All meals we tried were realy tasty and delicious.Show less

Author: SAM552015Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: An unexpected treat
Review: on the other side of the road, opposite underwaterworld in Cenang, we saw a sign for Haroo and Korean food. Never having tried this food before, we really enjoyed experiencing two of the dishes favoured in Korea. You can choose spicy or not or even add to your taste. Side omelette and small vegetable dish and icecream came as unexpected additions at no extra charge. really enjoyed the meal very tasty and piping hot.Show less

Author: Tommi_71Malmo, Sweden
Title: Hidden gem
Review: Hidden away in an alley off the main road we found this little Korean restaurant. The owner, formerly of the South Korean navy, serves up some great tasting food. We were not very familiar with Korean cuisine, but the illustrated menu made it easy to order. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Hamza CDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Give it a try :)
Review: Came here because of the good reviews and proximity. I was not disappointed. Delicious meals with generous portions. Im not a food expert, but we loved the food here. The owner is a nice guy (korean). I had a chicken plate, my wife had the seafood soup (both spicy, both delicious). I tried pinning the location. Its not what the app says; its right across underwater world, few steps down the alley. Show less

Author: 309grahamf
Title: Off the main dtrip
Review: You need to search for this place as its set back from the road on opposite side to beach. There is abiding at the start of the side road. We ordered beef spicy something and beef not spicy. Sorry can't recall actual name. We had draught tiger beer. They ad an omelette and pickled veg side and the ice cream all in. They add 10% service. Food was delicious and good value Show less

Author: djl2701Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Food! HIGHLY Recommended!!
Review: Great food and service. The young Korean girl was very nice and explained the dishes well.We ordered the Kimchi Pancake (Yum), the glass noodles (Yum) and a spicy beef dish (not the bulgogi) (Yum) and Bibimbap (Yum) - we ordered too much food but it was sooo good!! You also get a free omelette and kimchiEverything was really good - some of the best Korean food I have eaten outside of Korea!!One ever so slight criticism was the kimchi side dish that was given (free) seemed more pickled and not much chilli!! It was still good though!!Show less

Author: Jae S
Title: Excellent Korean Food
Review: Owner is korean, so authentic Korean food. We got the Squid pokum, Dan jang Jigae, and Bibim Babp, which were all excellent. If you like spicy, you can request so. Would definitely go back if I visit Langkawi.

Author: xrispohSG
Title: Nice authentic Korean food
Review: They serve nice authentic Korean food and service was prompt and fast. The only thing is the restaurant is kinda humid and warm for us to enjoy a good meal especially when we are eating something hot and soupy on the hot evening. Other than that, I would say good food!Show less

Author: Anna S
Title: Dinner with family
Review: Super fast and very friendly service, food is very well cooked and very tasty. We had bulgogi and Kimchi and bibimbap. Loved this place!

Author: Harlina_MinosAlor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Nice Korean food
Review: Nice Korean food and the staffs are very friendly. I asked for a recommendation and they answer straight away. The owner (I think) is even asking us about the food while we're eating. And we have free ice cream for the dessert. The price is quite expensive but worth it because of the big portion.Show less

Author: EarlystoneZurich, Switzerland
Title: Okay but...
Review: Okay but not a restaurant I would recommend to friends or go visit again. The personel was friendly. We had the 2 signature dishes. I'm not an expert of korean food, but I think it left a lot to be desired. The ambience was horrible. Loud volume unsorted music from crappy speakers.Show less

Author: 59ondras
Title: Very good food and service
Review: We went in Haroo for a lunch. It was perfect - Service, food and smile korean guy as and waiter. And surprise ice cream for free.

Author: leeds29Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: A real treat .
Review: Opposite underworld down the alley so not easy to find but worth it . Run by a family who are so enthusiastic and friendly. They selected starters and mains for us as we had a few people who didn't eat fish .we had two starters the glass noodles were a big favourite and 5 main courses.The food was fresh and tasty ,service was quick and everything was eaten. very fairly priced . Worth a visit Show less

Author: 766victoriadSurfers Paradise, Australia
Title: Excellent food & service
Review: We went to Haroo for dinner! as it had good reviews on Here! We were not disappointed as a group of 6 & not having eaten Korean food before we asked the owner to pick dishes for us. Entrees & mains Absolutely delicious couldn't fault a thing. The owner and staff very humble people looked after us well. Hidden gem a must in Langkawri Show less

Author: 896nilesht
Title: Authenticly Korean
Review: Great authentic Korean food with large servings. Had many options for vegetarian which is rare in Korean restaurants. We had the kimchi pancake and bibimbaap which was huge.

Author: PeteNHannahBrisbane
Title: A hidden gem!
Review: Haroo is a hidden gem, tucked away in an alley across the road from Underwater World. It is not where indicated on the TripAdvisor map.The owners are Korean and very friendly and the food is incredibly delicious and without fault!We had the Bibimbap, spicy seafood soup, seafood pancake and spicy kimchi. As well, we received a complimentary smaller pancake, plain kimchi, ice cream and chocolates.One of the tastiest meals we've had during our 6 day stay on the island.Show less

Author: vanessa p
Title: Absolutely delicious Korean food
Review: Awesome food and service from this family run restaurant down a little laneway off the main strip. Don't worry if you don't know the food, just ask 'mummy' to make a selection of dishes for you and you'll be delighted.

Author: 277junyic
Title: Great delicious lunch
Review: Christmas Korean lunch. Kind of strange there is no people here for lunch, so it is quiet and comfortable. The serve is fast. The boss is Korean but doesn't speak much English, very kind person. The one in Kuah is her daughter. We got bibimbap, seafood noodles, vegetable pancake and grill chicken. Very delicious and the size is good. The boss even gave us extra fried eggs and green tea ice cream.Show less

Author: Grazza2981
Title: Great Korean Food
Review: Came here after reading reviews and we weren't dissapointed my food was great and the owners are nice and attentive. Food came out quick and the BiBimBap was very tasty. Wifeys Noodle Soup was delicious too

Author: shamopi
Title: Hidden location, perfect hearty food
Review: Haroo is located in a really unassuming location. The best way is to locate an alley opposite the underwater world for a small rectangular signboard.The food is genuinely Korean as it is run and operated by am elderly Korean couple. You have side dishes along with any meal that you order. They typically serve omelette and Kim Chi as the sides.I would highly recommend to try the bibimbap and the pa jeon (vege pancake). The serving portion is definitely sizeable for a grown hungry man. Though you should also note that the food comes at the pricey end. You should expect to fork out RM20+ for mains but its well worth it.Lastly, they would also put a sweet ending note to your experience but serving pistachio ice cream. All this is well worth the money you paid for. Especially when compared to Korean outlets in the KL city.The tranquil surrounding (albeit located along the alley) serves as a good quick pitstop from the crowd along Pantai Cenang. I personally hoped that the pricing could hover closer to sub RM20 though.Minor complain on the pricing but the food is definitely good if you are craving for Korean food on the Langkawi IslandShow less

Author: rci2016
Title: Great food
Review: Super friendly service, amazing bibimbap and kimchi. Fresh ingredients and decent sized portions. Highly recommended.

Author: Jennifer K
Title: Worth to try it!
Review: Went to have a try on the last day of my trip. Tasty foods with big portion especially Bibimpab! Nice staff that will feel welcomed! Friendly staff was try to explain their foods & cultures! Is worth it!

Author: LomalaisetHelsinki, Finland
Title: Fell a bit short
Review: The owner and staff of Haroo were nice and friendly and made us feel welcomed. We tried kimchies, bibimbab and other dishes, yet it was good, but frankly we expected more based on splendid earlier reviews. Somehow it felt the dishes fell a bit short in taste side. Note that the google map is placing the restaurant in wrong place, it is actually in small street across the Underwater World.Show less

Author: levictoria_msia
Title: Friendly owner and good food
Review: The food tastes good and large portion. the owner is friendly and tried to explain how to eat bibimbap. My friend and I had nice brunch at here. However, the drink is expensive.

Author: yywong12
Title: Give a try!
Review: The food taste good! The owner very friendly! The portion of food is big! Worth for the money we paid! Dessert are servers after meal!( it free oh)

Author: Zeyen L
Title: Great food
Review: The food here is sooooo good!!! And the owner here is so nice. We keep on asking what is good to eat and he answered us patiently. They are koreans hehehe. The portion here is big!!! We only order 1 set because we just had our lunch. End up they gave us 3 ice creams stating that they have 3 guests (we are a group of 3). Will come back here next time on our next visit!Show less

Author: Chirag SBengaluru, India
Title: Awesome ! Awesome ! Awesome !
Review: No doubt it looks very simple that will make you to think if this is the right place. But trust me, this is great place for tasty food. Spring rolls are really finger licking experience and complementary dishes are mind blowing :P. Must visit place that has wooden decoration, near by to Chenag mall.Imp note : Googlemap doesn't has correct location marked for it. This place is just opposite to underwater world langkawi in a small narrow street. You will find one old person reading something always with a very calm face. The moment you ask Haroo, great hidden smile will come from that person's face. That will be a confirmation that you are at right place. He is the owner of this place.Show less

Author: Lim H
Title: Korean delight at Kuah Town, Langkawi
Review: Spent much time shopping in Langkawi. For outdoor activity went for cable car ride and the suspension bridge. Happening place drove to Pantai Cenang night time.

Author: hannahmarymei
Title: Great food, friendly service!
Review: It's so great to eat such good Korean food in Langkawi! I loved the atmosphere of the restaurant, and the warmth of the staff. The food was delicious, and the free sides were a great touch!

Author: KellyH91382Taichung, Taiwan
Title: Lovely dinning experience
Review: It was our last night in Langkawi and we decided to try this place. the Korean family who run this place is SUPER friendly and the service is beyond words!! the price is higher than what you usually spend in Langkawi for food, but the C/P value is definitely high!!! I recommend the beef plate and the Korean clear noodles!! Show less

Author: kyk4
Title: Excellent service
Review: It is located in the small street, opposite of underwater world. Manned by an old Korean couple. It is clean with very good service. Food tastes good but a bit expensive though. Highly recommended to try bi-bim-bap there.

Author: LingHueyF
Title: Super delicious korean food & friendly service :)
Review: Was there two days ago, greeted by a very friendly korean owner! :D And all the food we ordered are great and the price are reasonable too! The meal came with pistachio ice cream and some side dishes so it's a pretty good deal.Overall service is really good and love the authentic korean food taste ( especially their kimchi, thumbs up!!! ) Show less

Author: catsaymau
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review:
+ Nice service
+ Reasonable sized portions
+ Free small omelet for appetizer and dessert pistachio ice cream

If you order soju it comes in a large bottle (approximately 3 dl),

Author: H3211ULtomkHilversum, The Netherlands
Title: Great food, even better service!!
Review: We saw the restaurant on TripAdvisor and decided to eat here. It was our first time Korean and it was delicious! The food was from great quality and really tasty. According to one of us, it was the best dinner he had during this vacation.The service was great aswell, truly kind people. We had a great evening and would go back if possible, too bad it is too far from our home town. Can we take the restaurant with us?Show less

Author: philip pmalaysia
Title: Great if you are hungry for home styled Korean food
Review: Haroo is opposite Underwater World along a little lane just off the main Pantai Cenang road. Nothing pretentious, manned by a friendly husband (Yohan) and wife team from the southern part of Korea. Good home cooking, with generous portions of Bibimbap (great for hungry teenagers) and a good variation of spicy and non-spicy authentic Korean dishes. No exotic stuff like ganjang gejang or raw soy crab. All the dishes we ordered were good and reasonably priced (for Pantai Cenang, Langkawi) with prices ranging from Rm28-30+ per dish. We were surprised with a free treat of pistachio ice cream for dessert, so felt it was a pretty good deal. Their daughter runs a similarly good Korean restaurant called Haroo + at Kuah town. I would strongly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for a hearty authentic home styled Korean cooking.Show less

Author: resirnusPenang, Malaysia
Title: Very nice and quaint little Korean restaurant
Review: Served by the owners themselves. This restaurant is run by one elderly couple who serves us very well. The food tasted very authentic, not too salty or sweet to my living. Good place for a meal. They gave ice cream and omelet for free for our meals. Price is around rm30 per dish.Show less

Author: koksiong71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Korean food, Kids Love It!
Review: Haroo is tucked in a nice little corner opposite the Underwater World in Langkawi. Peaceful place for a meal. We ordered a Chicken Bugolgi, Beef Bulgogi and a Bibimbab with 3 additional bowls of rice for a family of 5. Portion was sufficient for all, and the kids absolutely love the food, though this is their first time eating Korean food.Total bill come to about RM130, including drinks and beer. Definitely worth the price.Show less

Author: 현호 이
Title: best Korean rest' I ever found in malaysia
Review: reached Langkawi for a holiday and came across with this Korean restaurant~ went in with notuch of expectations but the service and the food was perfect~ it was authentic Korean taste~ which I hardly experience in Malaysia trips~thank you very much for great food and kind service~ will definitely return for this~Show less

Author: AdpressoPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Most tasteless Korean food ever! Don't even try
Review: We were very hungry driving around searching for food. Saw this place Haroo and wife decided not to search anymore and just eat at Haroo. The spicy noodle was neither spicy, salty, sour, sweet, nothing! It was totally tasteless! Not even the a bit of seafood taste!!! The service was friendly (probably due to the fact that there aren't any customers at all), but it could not make up for the tasteless noodles! Horrible experience (luckily only 1) spoiling our otherwise perfect trip to Lgk.Show less

Author: SiilverwingSan Francisco, California
Title: Delicious food, friendly workers!
Review: Like everyone else said, Haroo is right across the street from Underwater World. We visited for lunch and there was no one there, but we stayed for delicious Korean food. Boy, was it delicious! I had the bibimbap (28rm) and bf had the beef bugolgi (30rm), and the owner super sweet and gave us 2 appetizers. We both really liked our dishes! In the end, we also got complimentary pistachio ice cream. Mmm, delicious! Would definitely recommend this place. Oh and as a side note, it isn't air conditioned unfortunately. Still, don't let that stop you from eating delicious Korean food! Show less

Author: Mirek S
Title: Perfect service
Review:
Good food and great service ... we will definitely stop by once again!

Prices around 30MYR for main dish

Author: sarahbQ5065XL
Title: Delicious food
Review: This resturant was great. We went there 3 times during our stay as the food was so good. The owner was also very friendly.

Author: christina108Melbourne, Australia
Title: Yummy Korean!
Review: We love Korean food and loved this restaurant. The owners are very sweet and welcoming. The food was very fresh, and tasty with generous servings. I loved my bimimbap which was served with lots of fresh vegies and salads. My partner really enjoyed his beef bulgogi. We also liked the kimchi. After our delicious mains we got some complimentary ice cream. Great place try it! Show less

Author: suerayaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Korean food
Review: Found a review of this restaurant on trip advisor & wanted to try Korean food for dinner. The restaurant is on a small street, right opposite of Underwater World. The Bibimpap & seafood pancake is superb! The portions are quite huge & Since we takeout our dinner, the owner is so nice to add in omelet for us :) If only we had more time, I would have tried the other dishes. A must go to place!Show less

Author: 687jinglSeattle, Washington
Title: Great PLC to go
Review: The owner is so nice n friendly. The FD is delicious, even sent me free ice cream after bill. The location marked wrong in trip advisor n costed me a lot of time to find it. The correct location is opposite to underwater world, just a little inside of the Main StreetShow less

Author: markrankin82Ilkley, United Kingdom
Title: Would go here all the time if I could!
Review: This restaurant is set back slightly from the main road opposite Underwater World. We've not seen it busy in the 5 days we've been here, but don't let that put you off; we were very glad that we gave it a try. Spring rolls were addictively good, whilst the kimchii and mains we ordered were really tasty. The portions are a good size and the owner brought out some samples to try of a couple of the dishes we hadn't ordered. That meant that even though we were hungry, we couldn't finish everything. The service was very friendly and hospitable.If we had longer here, we would definitely go back to try some of the other dishes on the menu which looked tasty. Wish this place was local to us back home!Show less

Author: EeeroP
Title: Great Korean food!
Review: If you like Korean food you should not miss Haroo at pantain cenang. The owner couple is sweet and helpfull, and the restaurant is pleasant. Bibimbap and jap-chae were excellent!

Author: rain2storms
Title: Great hospitality and food
Review: Haroo is a Korean restaurant with a great menu and very hospitable staff. We enjoyed learning about Korean cuisine on our first visit, which we were not familair with, and returned again before leaving to fly home.

Author: JudyKL88
Title: Best place for quietness and good food!
Review: Dined here sometime ago and loved it!! It was so nice to go somewhere off the beaten track where there was no noise or queues!! Peace and quiet and really good food!! The owner is a lovely man!

Author: junp308Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Just go there for the foods..
Review: Suddenly, feel like trying something new on this midweek .. park the car opposite Underwater Langkawi and walk across the road. We are the only customers on that night, and friendly greeted by the owner (husband & wife) at the entrance. Ordered few dishes recommended. Seafood platter is abit out, beef grilled platter was delicious, Korean pancake was not too bad, chicken/onion soup is tasty, bimbimbap rice is nice, egg omelete is normal. Overall, foods are not bad... but just the foods. The lacking is the atmosphere and ambiance...Show less

Author: kimmyj_99Ballarat, Australia
Title: Yummy Korean
Review: My husband and I visited Haroo after reading about it on TA. We had never eaten Korean food before but were very keen to try. The food was delicious and they were very generous with complimentary side dishes, including ice cream at the end. The best part about the experience was the owner. He was the sweetest, most gentle man ever. He and his wife have made a real effort with the decor of their restaurant and the presentation of their menus and everything looked clean and tidy. This restaurant is easy to find, down a side street across from Under Water World.Show less

Author: Michele P
Title: authentic, great taste, lovely people
Review: I have cooked a little Korean and was excited to taste the real deal. The owners were very welcoming, helped us order and explained the dishes. They even added extra for us to taste, the pistachio ice cream was divine. Thank you for a memorable experience. Location easy to find opposite the aquarium just off the main street.Show less

Author: Karley G
Title: Amazing Korean food!
Review: Great service! Lovely couple who served up - Bibimbap, spicy squid, vege pancake, kimchi and complimentary ice cream! The best meal I had in Langkawi!

Author: 198steffeng
Title: Delicious, delicious, delicious
Review: Located in opposite of Underwater World in Pantai Cenang. The owner was such a friendly man with always a smile on his face. Beside our order we also got an omlette, kimchi and a dessert for free. Everything was really delicious.

Author: b_lo_zer0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Go for the Bibimbap
Review: Go for the bibimbap, it was indeed delicious as most have mentioned. Also ordered kimchi, kimchi pancake and 2 korean soft drinks. Good portion sizes. 90 MYR for 2 people.Kimchi was pretty good as well, but I guess I overdid the whole Kimchi thing by also ordering the kimchi pancake, so I didn't really enjoy the pancake too much. The Korean soft drinks were nice, but yes, a little expensive for 10 MYR each. Not too surprised given the effort needed to import though.Very friendly service by the Korean owner who always have a warm smile on his face. They also added in freebies, like an omelette which together with my own orders, totally made me stuffed.Show less

Author: 혜진 서
Title: It's good~^^
Review: Harroo is very delicious korean restaurant. Good location. It is located near cenang mall. So l've drop by haroo twice for 3days.

Author: Vicente5715Phuket, Thailand
Title: ma-sit-sso-yo!
Review: I have a confession to make. Although as a Malaysian, that loves and is proud of Malaysian foods, the best food I ever had in Langkawi is actually Korean!During my working days in Langkawi, I would very often rent a motorbike or car, and drive up to Cenang from Kuah, just to get a munch in this modest Korean family-style restaurant. All dishes are genuinely korean. Above all, I would recommend the bibimbap (korean mixed rice), pajeon (onion pancake) and to get some makgeolli (rice wine) for drinks. The restaurant belongs to a modest old couple which always has a smile on their face. Upon ordering, the friendly old man will gladly make an introduction of all the dishes on the menu, and also the way to pronounce them to you, “bee-bimp-pup...bee-bimp-pup...” after countless of visits, I seemed to be able to order like a korean eventually!Since the restaurant is located away from the mainstreet, it is quite homey, and they play oldies as background music. Touche!One thing though, is that the food is actually quite pricey for local standards. Price of a dish is averaging about 20-30 Malaysian Ringgit, but so do many overrated restaurants in Cenang.I never realized how good the food is until I left Langkawi. Now working in Thailand, I would always go to a korean restaurant, order a bibimbap, and grieve that it never tasted as good as what I used to have. After all, fortunately and unfortunately, I guess my time in Langkawi had set a ridiculously high standard in Korean food, to me.Show less

Author: Mianeumann
Title: Best food we have ever tasted
Review: Haroo Haroo produces without doubt the best food we have ever tasted. The service is fantastic and super friendly. You must visit before leaving Langkawi. In our 2 week vacation, we visitet Haroo Haroo 6 times. 💋😍👍😊😀

Author: teuneniwanScheveningen, The Netherlands
Title: When visiting Langkawi you must eat here.
Review: Never had the opportunity to taste Korean food. Luckily we found Haroo in Langkawi. Good hospitality and great food. The owners will do anything to make you feel comfortable and give you all the time and advise to make the right choice. BTW it's opposite of Underwater World, just behind a pizzeria.We hope to visit this restaurant again!Show less

Author: libbyv620Langkawi District, Malaysia
Title: Great authentic Korean food
Review: We have eaten at a number of Korean restaurants in various countries but can say Haroo is the equal of the best, while the restaurant is tucked away it is worth the effort to track down. The seafood pancake and signature dish Bibimbap are musts. The service is friendly and courteous and they start the dinner with a complimentary mini pancake and finished with a delicious pistachio ice cream. If you don't order drinks it is about 100 ringgit for two people.Show less

Author: travellertrevoryorkshire
Title: good food -generous hosts
Review: We went here after reading reviews . We were the only people there .It is a bit of the main drag but the food (1st time we had eaten in a Korean restaurant .) was good and we were given extra nibbles throughout the meal .Show less

Author: Kebab65London UK
Title: Lovely friendly Korean restaurant
Review: The owner and his wife made us very welcome, and the service was just as we like, attentive but not overbearing. The food was really great, having never eaten at a Korean restaurant before, it was a new experience for us and we will certainly return next year.The price of the meal was very reasonable too, much cheaper than many other restaurants in "the strip".Show less

Author: travellerQBK
Title: Real Korean food with Art Deco
Review: Went there for lunch, the restaurant is with basic settings but with cute paintings on walls, the owners are a pair of Korean couple. They were so very nice and friendly to us. We had bulgogi, bibimbap and kimchi. Very good food. The whole meal with drinks only cost us 75RM, nice price nice food nice people. If you like Korean food, you would love this place. It was the first time for my boyfriend to try Korean food, he loved it and wanted to go back there again! Show less

Author: Evelyn X
Title: Hidden gem!
Review: The best food I had in langkawi. The bibimbap and jap chae were amazing. Eat here and you won't regret it.

Author: SHong2011Penang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Warm reception and tasty Korean food
Review: The Korean food here is really good. You also get the feeling of being warmly welcomed by the owner even if he doesn't speak a lot. Lots of vegetables in the dishes, which may not be to everyone's liking. Can drinks imported from Korea are a bit pricey. But definitely recommend this restaurant. The location is just opposite Underwater World, so it's not difficult to find. Also, just wanted to thank the family running this restaurant again. My niece lost a souvenir here and we were very happy to get it back the next day.Show less

Author: Danhoby
Title: Excellent home-cooked Korea Food
Review: Haroo is run by a Korean family and the establishment serves great home-cooked Korean food that's authentic and delicious. A must try in Langkawi if you love Korean food! However, the location on google map is off by about 1km+ (this happened to a few other locations)...fortunately, the locals was a great help.Show less

Author: LipSengYap
Title: Best Korean food in Langkawi!
Review: Amazing authentic Korean food and personalized service from the family run restaurant. You can't go wrong here. My usual place for lunch/dinner.

Author: KinamyunLangkawi District, Malaysia
Title: Excellent !!!
Review: As a Korean, I would say this is one of best Korean restaurant you can eat on abroad. Taste is almost same as real Korean food and I think the ower brings many ingredient from Korea.Compare to other Korean restaurants in KL, Haroo is definitely much better than those restaurantsSome guys think it is over-priced compare than other Korean restaurants in KL, it's true but it's worthy. It is not typical Korean BBQ restaurant but more like general Korean food.I highly recommend this restaurant !!!Show less

Author: NeeNee_ChoPenang
Title: Expensive
Review: The restaurant is like a beach house off the busy main road at Pantai Cenang, I knew it is not a cheap area for food but this restaurant is seems to be really over-priced. For one korean pancake, one bowl of noodle and 2 glasses of local beer, we were paying RM90+. Food is nice but might be too pricey for a quick lunch.Show less

Author: JenLooiPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A Bit Over-Priced...!!
Review: Since it is highly reviewed in TripAdvisor, so we went there for dinner during our holiday in Langkawi. Maybe there are limited Korean restaurants available in Langkawi, therefore people has given very good reviews.It is not a typical Korean restaurant where one can find Korean BBQ. Their selections are pretty limited and a bit over priced. As for the food, nothing spectacular as we can find better Korean food selection back here in Petaling Jaya.Show less

Author: sueekhy
Title: Honest, genuine tasty meal
Review: Finally a place to get a healthy meal of light, refreshing and spicy food amongst rows of western food at Cenang beach. English speaking waiter is a plus for menu explaining.

Author: cjcook1990Hiroshima, Japan
Title: Best meal in Langkawi
Review: My partner and I ate here last night and where blown away by the food, atmosphere and hospitality. After reading good reviews on trip advisor we thought we would give it a go, it was a bit hard to find as it was not accurately placed on google maps and is just back off the main road. When we arrived we were greated so friendly by all the staff, and placed right under the fan out of the heat. The service was wounderful and fast. My partner is a very adventurous eater but neither of us had eaten Korean styled food before and very eager to try. Both our meals were sensational, in fact I would go as far to say it was the best meal that ny partner and I had eaten our entire trip, and being foodies that we are we have eaten in a lot of places in penang and langkawi. The flavours in the food were amazing, and I was surprised how quickly it came out (ontop of being served steaming hot, which is a massive plus for me). I honestly would recommend this place to anyone who comes to langkawi, as for those who think it is not reasonable priced I have to disagree in terms of quality of the meal I would go as far to say it was underpriced. Only 80 myr for my partner and I - we were surprised thinking it would cost more. Overall I think everyone should try this place at least once!!!Show less

Author: Tresna WMaida Vale, Australia
Title: Tasty tasty food at a good price
Review: This restaurant deserves to be rate highly. We had a table of 6 people and everyone ordered different dishes. No one complained. The seafood pancake was delicious and the beef bogolgi was exceptionally tasty. The restaurant surroundings was very plain but the food and the very friendly owner who could not do enough for us made it a very enjoyable eating experience. If you want tasty Korean food at a good price I would highly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: TomEKingBrisbane, Australia
Title: Lovely little joint
Review: Cute little kitschy joint, the staff were very polite even though it was very late. We got served quickly, and the food was elegantly presented and culinary well balanced. A lovely experience. The only thing I could complain about it that it was a bit pricey, but it was worth it, I'd definitely go back.Show less

Author: Sherene1308Malaysia
Title: Above expectations!
Review: I brought my family there after reading some good recommendation from Trip Advisor. The family run restaurant serves authentic Korean home cook meal, which taste very homely and unlike the normal commercial Korean food I have in big cities. The Bibimbap is the best I have tasted so far. With most of the foods here in Langkawi are over priced due to its tourism status, Haroo provides great dining experience at a decent price. I will definitely visit them again!Show less

Author: Celia A
Title: Good korean food
Review: Great korean food and not too expensive!  The food was tasty, spicy and delicious. Will recommend this place to other travellers :)

Author: StefvgiTurnhout, Belgium
Title: Tasty Korean food
Review: We stopped at this quiet place for lunch, located close to the main road. The restaurant makes you very calm and relaxed when you sit there. There are a few sayings on the wall, defining the spirit of the restaurant. It breathes a certain atmosphere. The chicken dish i ordered tasted very well, and the staff was really friendly. Not expensive, worth a visit!Show less

Author: MaisieFSydney, Australia
Title: Quiet, delicious, good value
Review: My husband & I visited Haroo last night after seeing good reviews on Trip Advisor. The restaurant is slightly off the main street, across the road from Underwater World. We weren't disappointed! For $25AUD we got 2 mains plus sides, a beer each and dessert. The mains were absolutely delicious with so much flavour. Wear your 'fat pants' if you visit - we were so full when we left! We definitely recommend this place. Show less

Author: Julian C
Title: Fantastic!!!
Review: Girlfriend and I stopped by to check this place out. We absolutely loved it. It's a bit off the road and was not too busy, however don't let that deter you. Service was great and the food even better!

Author: ellyvate
Title: Amazing food & staff!
Review:
It's the best meal I've eaten in Malaysia. It's delicious!
The service and hospitality was outstanding too. They even gave us free dessert!
It's a must when visiting Langkawi!

Author: vinnybrodeur
Title: good food
Review: So, the food is good and the service is very pleasant, the only rub is its expensive and no sea view, otherwise it's just nice

Author: 625kayt
Title: Lovely restaurant
Review: The restaurant is located near the main road, the food was really delicious, the staff very friendly. I would deffinitely come back again.

Author: Zulfiqur073Dhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: authentic korean food with very very friendly people
Review: we planned much earlier to have a lunch here..it took a little bit of time to find the place. but it was not that tough.though everything was new for us, we ordered to signature dish of Korea which BIBIMBAP & BOKUEMBAP.i had the bibimbap one which was really tasty with tender beef pieces with fresh vegetable.My wife had Bokuembap there.. it was friend rice item with sauces. because of the sauces i didnt like it that much. but my one was too good..Also, the juices..awesome..try it..Show less

Author: comfy2Hampshire, United Kingdom
Title: Korean food just off the main Pantai Cenang road - charming service
Review: We came here for a change from the hotel food. It is just off the main street across from the Aquarium. Served by a Korean family who have moved here 8 years ago, it has a relaxed cafe style, nothing fancy but clean and hospitable. We sat inside in their one one-con room but others were sitting outside having a drink. The food was good - noodles with pretty authentic and quite hot sauces, with seafood or meat, good Korean 'pizza' and lovely service by the family. This is a good alternative if you want a change from Western or Asian food.Show less

Author: Laurent S
Title: Super nice
Review: Very good food and super friendly service.   I recommend this restaurant to all the people craving for korean food while staying in Langkawi

Author: tomd427
Title: Really good, authentic Korean
Review: We felt like a change from everything else on Langkawi and were stoked to find this place.  My wife is Korean and she rated it as one of the best meals she'd had.  Service was great also.  Highly recommend this place.

Author: Liz PCairns, Australia
Title: Good food with good friends, what more can you ask for?
Review: Haroo Haroo is a mid-range restaurant set back off the main Cenang road but within a 2 minute walk of the beach bars. (The lane way entrance to the restaurant is opposite underwater world and across the road.) Excellent food both in quality and quantity plus the setting is a relaxed atmosphere where shorts and flip-flops are not uncommon. The staff are a Korean family who always welcome you with smiles and are ready to help explain the menu. This was very welcome for me as sometimes eating in the local area is a challenge as I have to be careful when eating fish or spices. There was the standard drinks menu but with a couple of Korean favourites such as sweet mandarin juice or blended pear offered...and something described to me by my dining partner as 'rocket fuel' distilled from fermented rice.As the restaurant is set off the road a little, it is not as frequented as many other restaurants but it is a hidden jewel we will be frequently returning to in future.Show less

Author: Jamie M
Title: Great Food, Lovely Host.
Review: Lovely place for a lunch. Food was delicious. The guy who runs/works at the place is very friendly and welcoming.

Author: Mian ARyde, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: The restaurant is not exactly where the tripadvisor location says, it is in a small street directly opposite the Underwater world. We spent half an hour looking for it but the effort was well worth it. Asked the hostess to recommend some appetizers and mains and loved every single one of them. This was one of the best meals that we had ever had.Show less

Author: Joonas HHelsinki, Finland
Title: Excellence in food quality and service!
Review: Went to Haroo with my girlfriend. Very warm and genuine welcome by an old couple, seemed to be really interested of our well being! Good start.We ate kimchi and spring rolls to start, Bokeum (veggies and meat in a korean chili sauce) with beef and chicken for main. Spring rolls were nothing special, but still as tasty as spring rolls come! Kimchi was probably the best kimchi we ever tasted (4th time we ate it)! And the bokeum was heavenly. I myself had it with beef and it was tender and well cooked. The spices were in the right balance, so that you could feel the burn, but it didn't cover up the flavor of rest of the food.Suprise vanilla ice cream was offered us, for free, after the meal! One small ball of heaven.Only negative would be the price. Not a big minus, but still worth mentioning. Our food + water cost 100myr, about 22€. Pretty expensive compared to the local eateries, but still two times cheaper than our only korean restaurant back home in Finland. And this was much better too!Definately will go again.Show less

Author: tiffanyshe
Title: very decent korean food
Review: Love the korean dishes so much, especially fried squids, kimchi soup, kimchi fried rice. owners are very friendly, big smile to welcome us at the entrance. limited parking in front of the restaurant, but more parking space is available next to.a b&b inn.

Author: ShereenThamLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: First time went there
Review: Bosses are very warm and affable. From time to time ask us food okay, I feel great restaurants, unique flavor. Not only that, they are always a smile on his face. South Korean family super good service attitude. Beautifully! ! Even if there are service charges are worth giving. Remember to taste ah!Show less

Author: BlondeonwyeHereford, United Kingdom
Title: First time diners
Review: We hadn't previously tried or even thought of visiting a Korean restaurant. Then we wandered to Haroo - just off the cacophony of Pantai Cenang's main strip - and into a bonanza for our taste buds. We hadn't a clue what to order so took our lead from the proprietor. Her suggestions and service were so good that we are going back tomorrow night.Show less

Author: ELLENDESBrussels, Belgium
Title: Healthy tasty food and a very guestfree reception
Review: Haroo restaurant is located central across to Underwater world, in a little street away from the mainstreet so you can enjoy your dinner in peace. The reception is really very warm and friendly, the service very quick and the food very tastefull, healthy and fresh. It is also recommended For vegeterians as they have adapted menu for vegeterians. The price is similar to other restaurants, around 30 rm for a main course. In the end they offered a small desert, something that we hadn't had before in other restaurants. I recommand to visit Haroo if you are in the neighbourhood, it is less visible because it is not located on he mainroad but very easy to find (indicated on a panel).Show less

Author: Catharina KAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: delicious food, great service!
Review: While in Langkawi we had diner here twice, that much we liked it here! The girl serving and her father are both so friendly and very helpful to teach you about the Korean food. We never tried this before but really liked it. It contains lots of fresh vegtables, very tasteful! Their vegetarian springrolls are a must-try, so delicious!Show less

Author: KandMWKEsbjerg, Denmark
