Title: First and second time at Korean restaurant
Review: Went here two times. It's located in a side street, which makes it much quieter than the restarants on Pantai Cenang's main road. Service was so nice and personal by the young girl who recommended fantastic dishes - and taught us their pronounciation. Among other things Haemul Paejon and Bibimbap (according to my wife the best meal ever). And it was dirt cheap.Show less

Author: Linda123W
Title: Excellent food
Review: Lovely family run restaurant. Small and simple with excellent food at an amazing price!  One of the best meals we have had during our trip to Malaysia.  The food was fresh and well cooked.  The service was the best.  Highly recommended.

Author: LDN_StickyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Happy Hosts + Fabulous Food
Review: This Korean family run Korean restaurant is a real hidden gem. The family who run it are so lovely and their daughter is a fantastic chef. They specialise in serving authentic Korean dishes, we chose Kimchi Jji Gae and Beef Boukeum, both were absolutely delicious - we really wished we had discovered this place before our final night!Show less

Author: henryphillKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Magnificent service
Review: What else can you ask for other than a sunshine and warm smile from the reception. The best and probably the only Korean restaurant you can find in Langkawi. It is a place you can't miss if you're a foodie! Freshly made food and superb customer service. A one stop restaurant to satisfy your Korean food cravings. Located in an alleyway off the Main Street of Pantai Cenang. Whet your appetite with an authentic bibimbap beautifully served with fresh vegetables and the Korean hot sauce.Show less

Author: Ville J
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Definitely the place if you want to have a good dinner. Great food and very friendly servise. Best korean food ever. Highly recomended!

Author: durianduranNew York City, New York
Title: Great food and service
Review: I wish I'd found this place earlier on in our stay. We might have eaten dinner here every night, instead of just the two nights we did. The food is straightforward Korean, and it's delicious, especially considering the surrounding options — roti, roti, roti, or overpriced western fare. Both times my friends and I ate here, we cleaned our plates. But what really makes this place shine is the service, which, for midrange and cheap eats in Langkawi, seemed to be pretty much nonexistent otherwise. The proprietors and wait staff — all family, we guessed — were so warm, friendly, and attentive. And on the second night we ate there, they brought us some chocolate ice cream — gratis — to end the meal. Great place to eat, don't miss it. Eat outside.Show less

Author: la_vie_est_belle_85Luxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Great Korean food
Review: We arrived quite late at night and the warm reception we received was so lovely, followed by great food and great personalised service. The restaurant is tucked nicely away from the main street in Pantai Cenang and they do great veggie options - fresh, authentic and delicious.Show less

Author: sunseanfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Food, Great Service
Review: I have already visited this place several times now and will still be going back again. Good food and excellent service is its main attraction. They serve both Western and Korean meals, and so far I have only tried their Korean dishes, except for a bowl of mushroom soup, and everything tastes great. I am especially in love with their bibimbap. It is my favourite dish here. The price may be slightly on the higher side but considering that it is probably the only Korean restaurant around the area, I think its ok. Besides, you pay for what you get.The restaurant has a homey feeling to it and adding to that the walls are painted with lively colour, making it vibrant and fun looking. Ps: locals / regular patrons get 10% off service chargesShow less

Author: Bellatomato
Title: excellent
Review: We ate a couple of times at haroo and it was excellent. Surprisingly for a Korean restaurant they have a section of vegetarian food, which a real treat as good vegetarian/vegan food can be hard to find in langkawi. Our meals (vege bibimbap, korean pancake and glass noodles) were super tasty and obviously prepared with care. The staff are extremely friendly and the restaurant has lots of cute murals and a nice atmosphere. On both our visits there were not many other guests, probably because the restaurant is a bit back from the main street, so I am writing this review to encourage you not to overlook it. Haroo deserves many more customers!Show less

Author: kaiyomaSan Francisco, California
Title: Great food and service
Review: Stopped in here for a late lunch today and was pleasantly surprised by this place. In my experience, Korean food isn't especially vegetarian friendly, but Haroo's menu makes a point of highlighting their vegetarian options, which was appreciated. The spring rolls were tasty, but the pa jeon (veggie pancake) was really fantastic. The owner was super friendly and smiley too. Great place all around.Show less

Author: JacobLinda_WStockholm, Sweden
Title: Friendly and yummy!
Review: We visited Haroo two times during a stay in Langkawi in july 2013. Staff here is super friendly and food is really yummy! We had not had a lot of korean food prior to our visits here and the waiter girl was happy to tell us everthing we wanted to know about the items on the menu. The second time we were there we got complimentary ice cream for dessert. Such a nice treat! The setting is really cute as well. Everyone should come here!Show less

Author: Poyong89Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Korean in Langkawi
Review: At first we wanted to try a Korean style dinner but when we got there I was quite disappointed because they didn't offer any side dishes to go together with the food we ordered. We ended up ordering 2 sets of lamb chop which was RM30 each and 2 sets of bibimbap for RM28 each. The bibimbap wasn't as nice as the lamb chop. I wish I ordered the lamb chop!! A jug of water costs us RM5, but the glasses weren't even full ( if we ordered 4 cups it would only cost us RM4). Service was ok I guess.Show less

Author: kathleentffLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best Sundubu Jiggae
Review: What else can I say? They have the best sundubu jiggae in town and perhaps in Malaysia. Sundubu Jiggae is a hot and spicy Korean stew with tofu and some seafood. The hosts were very friendly. The restaurant is located opposite of the Underwater World through a small lane. It also has a cosy set up with some nicely hand drawn murals. Strong recommended if you feel like having some Korean food.Show less

Author: LK_ChocaholicManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent fresh food!
Review: Haroo is a lovely little restaurant just set back from the main street. The food was delicious, I had a teriyaki chicken and my friend Bibimbap and we both enjoyed the fresh food with lovely flavours. Great service and friendly owners - the best meal I've had in Langkawi, and reasonably priced!Show less

Author: ismewlinPenang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Yummy Korean & Western food
Review: A cafe that runs by korean family, the food is nice, environment is warm.We ordered Creamy Spaghetti & 1 korean dish(i forgot the name), is tofu &seafood cook in spicy soup, i miss this dish a lot. Maybe the price is slightly higher but the food portion is very big so might give this cafe a try!Show less

Author: DonaMalagaTorremolinos, Spain
Title: Very nice place.....
Review: We went there for a late lunch and you feel at once - this is a nice place. Yes - as one mentioned - there is a construcion going one just opposite - but it has nothing to do with the nice place.Its clean, the owner is very nice and the food is nothing but perfect! We went for the Korean options.Pa Jeon - Korean pancake with spring onion and other vegatables and soysauce dipKimchi Jjigae - Korean spicy cabbage soup with tuna and tofu and rice on the sideEach course 28 RM. Its a bit more expensive compared to other places but VERY good!A glass of wine 15RM, thats to much. Everything plus 10% service charge!But go there and if you want something really nice.Show less

Author: jphDingle
Title: Tasty, solid standard and fresh !
Review: After staying on the strip for almost a week and eating plenty everyday we were running out of places that could tempt us in ...q few were nice but others bad a very grimy feel. Haroo's was actually our first stop when we arrived but we so much choice we only returned today. The food is very tasty and cooked to perfection, the menu is clear and easily read with decent descriptions of what to expect and the man at front of house is friendly and adds no pressure so its easy to relax...his wife seems to be the cook and if so he's very lucky. Stayed in the resort on nearby rebak and whilst it cost twice as much it couldn't compete with the flavour of the satayed beef in haroo....well worth a visit ! Ps. No roaches! Show less

Author: JudyKL88Killarney, Ireland
Title: Brilliant service and food
Review: One of the best places to eat on the island hands down. The restaurant is across from the Underwater world, few meters down a lanewat but visible from the road.Korean and western style food is served here.Brilliant when u need a break from the boisterous quick turn over restaurants on the main strip.The owner here is very warm and welcoming, nothing is a bother for him.The restaurant is spotlessly clean and the food is so tasty. The korean food is authentic and it is very reasonably priced!Loved everything about the restaurant :)Show less

Author: ZESTYPDX
Title: Heartwarming!
Review: After 8 months of travel and hundreds of restaurants, it is easy to get jaded. This place was heartwarming. The owner and his daughter seemed genuinely happy to be working. The service was great, the food was great, and the music was a refreshing, eclectic blend - from Chubby Checker to Abba.Show less

Author: VeronOng3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced
Review: Haroo serves a mixture of Western and Korean food. I popped by one day for lunch and I must say that prices are slightly high for the standard of the food.I had the Spaghetti Bolognaise that cost about RM25. It wasn't bad, it was quite tasty actually however the prices charged are usually for restaurants that are located on the beach side which I am fine paying given that sometimes excellent sea view dining comes with a price.This is not the case for Haroo though, it is located across the street from Pantai Cenang and I had a view of a construction site.Pay the slightly high price if you have Korean food craving in Langkawi, notice that there aren't many or any Korean restaurant but for other dishes you can get better options for the price with a seaview included.Service is pleasant though.Show less

Author: Firdausapy
Title: Lunch Date With Love
Review: Everything sooo good. The food, environment, scenery, friendly staff, clean toilet, parking, signage.Surely, we will come again next time. ThanksShow less

Author: Aishahyahya83
Title: Best dinner at Langkawi
Review: We went for sunset dinner. The service was superb. The ambient of the restaurant just perfect for couple or for people looking for quite and nice place. Recommend 3 course meal for only rm80. We spent more than 2 hours here. Looking forward to come again next timeShow less

Author: AshaM298
Title: Rimba Restaurant @ Ambong Langkawi
Review: The best dining experience in langkawi with a multi million view of sunset. The food is superb and the staff Is friendly and helpful especially Mr Azhar surely will come back again soon...Show less

Author: dicksonc2022
Title: Lunch
Review: A must-go if you happen to be in Langkawi. The staff is very friendly and their service is superb. Most importantly, you get to enjoy delicious food with scenic sea view. Definitely worth visiting!

Author: jccs99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch in Rimba Restaurant Langkawi!
Review: Good food good views good environment! 5 out of 5 I would say! It’s a must try in Langkawi! Will definitely come back again!Show less

Author: Maps23444692618Kajang, Malaysia
Title: Great dinner with great view
Review: Had our dinner here at Rimba Sky… dinner was so great. The Sourdough bread with olive oil and balsamic vinegar served as starter was so good that we could not resist for another round. We had homemade patty burger and squid ink pasta for the main course. Love the ambience and the location of this restaurant. The staff are more than helpful. Mr Azhar was so nice and offered us for tour around the restaurant and one of the villa. Not forgetting the other staff that more than happy to explain about our meal. For sure will comeback to this place for another great and memorable dinner. Thanks Mr Azhar & team for a great dinner experience. Show less

Author: YL SPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great view, great service
Review: We enjoyed our dinner at Rimba very much with the attentive service. We arrived for an early dinner to catch the sunset, and although did not get the golden hue due to the cloudy weather, the view over the balcony at the dining area and the upper deck was still stunning.We liked the oxtail soup, although a tad oily but robust in flavour. The portion was big for a starter and despite sharing with my partner, was left a bit too filled up to fully enjoy my main course.We had the signature dishes, whole grilled fish and rendang. Both were pretty good, and generous in portion.I noticed that they have a small selection of western popular dishes like pasta, burgers, and fish and chips, pretty good idea to cater to groups with differing taste esp for younger members of the party.I would definitely think of this venue for a romantic dinner or for entertaining.Show less

Author: WLChoong
Title: Lunch with great view, service and food
Review: We were recommended by a friend to Rimba restaurant and it truly surpasses our expectations with great food, service and view. Azhar, one of the restaurant staff member, particularly stood out with great customer service. We order their signature dishes as can see in the photos uploaded and they were yummy! The view from the restaurant overlooking the rainforest towards sea was heavenly. Will definitely come back again.Show less

Author: chriswee2868
Title: Hidden Gem of a restaurant!!
Review: So glad to have found this place on TripAdvisor, an absolutely magnificent view, coupled with delicious food and fantastic service from extremely friendly and knowledgeable staff. The surrounding area is beautiful, with a great view of the sunset. Book an upper-deck table, and get there before 7.08pm, for the best sunset view. Don't forget to look up occasionally too, eagles do fly-bys often. Definitely coming back, the garlic prawn starter is a MUST have, and while this place has really great local cuisine, the signature burger is one of the best I've ever had. - CWShow less

Author: Farahfarhaain
Title: Came here for dinner and had a fantastic experience
Review: Please give our thanks to the Manager(s) and the Crew for the wonderful Anniversary dinner. Absolutely amazing! The food was excellent and so was the service. Dessert was the bomb and the view was breathtaking.

Author: Amanda Laura H
Title: Excellent veggie-friendly food with stunning views
Review: During our stay in Langkawi, me and my brother kept returning here as they catered excellently to my vegetarian diet and his ‘refined’ palatte . With a mix of western and south east asian food , we particularily loved the fancy twists on the local delights. Not to mention the staff was incredibly friendly and the place is gorgeous! Especially at sunset :) We def will be returning to the restaurant and be considering staying at Ambong villas next time!Show less

Author: adwinaambhatique
Title: Hidden gem in Langkawi
Review: Visited Rimba at Ambong on November 17th, it is so memorable for us. Such a lovely place, good foods and nice ambiance. Thank you so much to Mr Azhar and team for being superbly nice to us. And thank you for letting us stays for a bit (its raining). Kudos! Definitely will come here again for our next visit.Show less

Author: markvhkiHelsinki, Finland
Title: Dining with amazing views and superb food
Review: Absolutely fantastic place with very affordable prices. Menu is pleasantly focusing on Malaysian cuisine with just enough Western flavors, all dishes we ate were exquisite! Staff is very attentive and ambience is just incredible. We ate here every night during our five night stay, there is simply no reason to even consider other places as Rimba delivers so great value for the money. Satays are must.Show less

Author: warissadk
Title: Food
Review: Great experience in having dinner at rimba by Ambong villa surrounded by nature and viewing sunset. Marvellous and delicious Malay cuisine prepared by the chefs really meet our taste buds. Friendly staff making us feel pleasant and appreciated. Definitely will come again and recommending everyone who want to enjoy meal with the sound and view of the nature.Show less

Author: TeragiaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Superb restaurant
Review: We highly recommend this restaurant. Awesome breakfast and dinner at Rimba Restaurant with western and local delicacies. A special mention to their delicious nasi lemak and awesome coffee! The girl who attended to us during breakfast and dinner is a gem, friendly and efficient. We only have praises for the Chef and the F&B Manager Mr Azhar and his team. Thank you Mr Azhar for looking after us!Show less

Author: kdksShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful Restaurant
Review: This time on out trip to Langkawi, we decided to try this restaurant after hearing so much about it. Made a reservation for a late lunch. When we got there we were the only patrons for lunch. Ambience was beautiful, food was good (especially the local dishes). Service was outstanding especially by Encik Azhar. He went out of his way to make us comfortable and we had a lovely time speaking to him. Will definitely be back for his company especially.Show less

Author: 398usmans
Title: Sunset Dinner
Review:
Mr. WAN took care of us in such an amazing way.
I forgot to post this earlier. Truly grateful. I hope to return

Author: hannisRaslin
Title: good food ,good price, beautiful environment 🌅
Review: the food were amazing! the staff were friendly as well . The price is really affordable . will definitely come again

Author: sylvainl165
Title: Everything we had was very
Review:
Everything we had was very well prepared and delicious 
Especially enjoyed the whole seabass, grilled and so moist and tasty

Author: Kevin TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good night out for a quiet dinner
Review: As promised, the view was spectacular. We had chosen the lower deck because it had more privacy and we ended up enjoying it. Service was excellent. Staff spoke good English & was attentive. We ordered the Ikan bakar/skewered fish with asam/tamarind sauce. The fish was fresh but the sauce was a bit on the flat side. The sesame maguro salad was good though. The mojito & Long Island tea was delicious. At the end, we enjoyed a 20% discount! ; )Show less

Author: 370celiag
Title: Great food, drinks and view
Review: The restaurant has 2 levels, inside and outside. Spectacular views from the terrace over islands, and sunset. Food is very very good, well priced and staff are fantastic. Great experiene

Author: AmazingAzrina
Title: The Best Masak Lemak Udang in Langkawi Island, with beautiful scenery.
Review: A great place for relaxing .. to those who loves nature. Trust me you will get lost with such a quiet and beautiful scenery. Tried their signature lunch, Masak Lemak Udang.. I could say its the best masak lemak i ever tried in Langkawi Island: To Die For ♥️ Will come back again soon.Show less

Author: ditchnapperLuang Prabang, Laos
Title: View
Review: We particularly enjoyed the view during our lunch at this resto. Spectacular sights over the forest towards the Andaman Sea. A few dusky leaf monkeys were hanging out nearby. The food was good but not spectacular (the watermelon feta salad unusually included lettuce). However, the service was excellent. Main annoyance was trying to find the place, having mistakenly driven in to the other Ambong Villas location a half km down the hill, then being told to go further. The first place needs a large sign indicating to continue for 500 m to reach Rimba.Show less

Author: marcuskuchiakKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Rimba Restaurant
Review: With spectacular views from the restaurant throughout the day and even better views from the rooftop bar at sunset, this is one of my favourite places to go in Langkawi. The food is delicious and the service is unbelievably good. If you do nothing else, go for drinks as the sun sets and you will be in for a treat. Show less

Author: Iggies64Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrific little hideaway restaurant with great views
Review: Rimba came recommended by a local and for good reason. The service was very professional and the food was terrific. Calamari, spring rolls and hummus for starters all great, then the speciality fish, beef rendang and the vegetable green curry completely filled us up (along with a couple of cocktails). The storm and rain ruined being outside but not their fault and more incentive to go again!Show less

Author: Stay12558227159
Title: food is good n very recommended...nice
Review: food is good n very recommended...nice rooftop view ...very good & friendly crew especially mr WAN...👍👍👍

Author: SyikinAlfianKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Great View, Great Food & Great Assistance!
Review: I went there with my colleagues to have our dinner and the view is spectacular. The oxtail soup, ambong skewers, ‘udang masak lemak nanas’ and the ‘ikan bakar’ are so delicious and plus the Sagu Gula Melaka is nice as it’s not too sweet, love everything here and you can contact en Azhar as he’ll arrange from A to Z. Excellent service by him and all the staff in Rimba Restaurant. Thank you for this memorable experience Show less

Author: firdausmerican
Title: Ooh La La
Review: Breakfast was yum delicious. We had our breakfast there instead in the room because of the view & friendly staff. You can go up to take photo. Menu to try is Mee Goreng Mamak, Oxtail Soup with Caramelised Bone Marrow.

Author: EmilioRR9669
Title: Amazing view
Review: Amazing view. Food is great. Service is excellent. All staff are well-trained. A must visit for travelers.

Author: cooldoc1971Kuala Lumpur
Title: Best Malay food with great ambience and view
Review: It was an uphill walk from Aloft. The view of Pulau Tepor was breathtaking. Nice ambience surrounded by thick foliage. Great hospitality. Food was superb. I had the best Gado-Gado in a long while. Constructive criticism : maybe it is best to open the water bottles for the guests, and be a bit responsive to our calls.Show less

Author: VivIamblessedMalaysia
Title: Fantastic!! Beyond 5 Stars!!
Review: This is the best restaurant in Langkawi!! The food, service and ambiance are beyond fantastic!! I would give this restaurant a 10 star if there’s one I would especially like to commend Biha, who attended to us with warmth and impeccable service attitude. She went beyond what was expected of her which is rare these days. Good service is very rare especially in Langkawi. Keep up the good job!! Oh... did I also mention how delicious the food was? It’s soooooo yummy!!! It’s even better than some Michelin restaurants Show less

Author: Amyliz91Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Favourite Langkawi restaurant with vegetarian menu!
Review: Wow!Everything about this restaurant is fantastic.5 star service! Every staff member is so friendly and attentive. Absolutely the best service we've received anywhere on the island.The food is delicious, full of flavour and beautifully presented. The fact that they have a completely separate vegetarian menu is amazing and rare in Langkawi! The setting is wonderful, almost like a giant tree house in the middle of the jungle. We watched the sunset and observed dusky leaf monkeys playing in the trees whilst we ate our food.It was so peaceful and a wonderful atmosphere.After our meal we enjoyed some cocktails upstairs on the rooftop with an incredible view of nearby islands.Thank you for your excellent service.I recommend the Green curry and vegetable spring rolls.Show less

Author: kamalmnorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great sunset view in Langkawi
Review: If you are looking a great sunset view with good food for companies, this is the place to be. Love the ambience and it was a great experienced to dine here. Currently the restaurank is practically quiet after MCO. I love the place especially the design and interior and they have good hospitality. The food was delicious. Squid ink sambal speghetti was awesome!Come and dine here during sunset. You will love it!Show less

Author: TheYumL
Title: Must visit the upstairs sky bar
Review: Rimba has beautiful views surrounded by treetops but for spectacular sunsets, you must go upstairs to Monsoon Sky Bar - some of the prettiest views in Langkawi.

Author: clareguCullercoats, United Kingdom
Title: Great meal in beautiful surroundings
Review: The food was really good and the service was great too! The view is beautiful. It was too wet to go upstairs which is a shame as the view was even better from there. The cocktails were delicious as was the big main course platter - it was a selection of a variety of things from the menu, all really well cooked. Highlights were the chicken poppers and the prawn and pineapple curry (I hate fruits in things but this was delicious!), The oxtail soup and the tuna starter were both delicious. They did half portions (half price) for starter and main for my daughter. We saw a troupe of leaf monkeys in this trees outside including one baby orange one from the balcony :) and some big brahminy kites. At the end of the meal they arranged for someone to drive use home. Show less

Author: shuwei_i
Title: Birthday celebration for girlfriend
Review: It’s my first visit to Langkawi after more than 15 years, this time with my beloved girlfriend together for her birthday celebration. Found this restaurant in trip advisor and called for dinner reservation. The food was amazingly nice, love the Nasi Lemak. The birthday setup was superb and above my expectation! My girlfriend loved it very much, kudos to the staffs who helped me to prepare for the romantic setup!! Very friendly staffs during the whole night and it was definitely very much recommended for couples.Show less

Author: Ricksmida
Title: Ambong Ambong
Review: The best rainforest retreat in langkawi the rooms the staff the service and food is just sensational we returned for a second time and were treated like royalty if you want to experience a true langkawi experience this is the place to stay hidden in the rainforest it blends in with nature with warm colours and cosy rooms you'll feel part of nature a little more expensive than the ugly hotels around but you will not be disappointed I can't say enough about this place 11 out of 10Show less

Author: BobAMarpleMarple, United Kingdom
Title: A secret hideway
Review: Amazing views from the upper terrace having cocktails whilst watching the sunset. The restaurant located on the floor below was excellent with good choices of food on the menu. We managed three courses with really nice wine. The whole experience was delightful and we recommended the place to fellow guests at our hotel. We only found out about it's existence through recommendation also. If you are going to Langkawi make this restaurant high on your wish list.Show less

Author: AnReul
Title: Ideal place for a romantic dinner
Review: We absolutely loved it! The beautiful view, the delicious dinner, the friendly staff,... A real treat to explore ❤️

Author: marmacin
Title: Best Meal in Langkawi
Review: We had a great meal at Rimba last week. Staff especially the young waiter were very helpful and pleasant. Food was great. We would have returned but found this place on our second last night

Author: Tóth THungary
Title: Must visit, amazing sunset and food
Review: You have to visit this place its amazing. Go by taxi, bc. its tricky to get there. The green curry was one of my favs. Arrive before sunset, if you would like to see something beautiful. One of the best places in Pantai Tengah. The restaurant is literally on the tree.Show less

Author: kirsi_nessu
Title: Awww sunset dinner!
Review:
Same here before sunset and enjoyed lovely drinks before dinner.
Service was excellent and food lived up to expectations. Prawn pineapple curry(?) was the best prawn dish I have eaten for years!

Author: Pam M
Title: Out of the way restaurant with to die for views!
Review: Went here after a recommendation, Food and service excellent, not cheap but not too expensive if you want a nice venue and view. Staff great. You need to take a taxi there and back.

Author: poppy186414Salisbury, United Kingdom
Title: Eat among the trees and check out the Monsoon Bar too
Review: Delicious food with the friendliest of staff in a magical setting amongst the trees. We had a beer in the Monsoon Bar one evening and watched the sun set and the little fishing boat lights come on. Very lovelyShow less

Author: 609janh
Title: Great location, friendly and
Review: Great location, friendly and caring staff, Good looking and tasty food, nice live music. Felt good all over!

Author: melmo_meWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Holiday Highlight
Review: Went to Monsoon sky bar to have a little look see try a cocktail whilst watching the sunset. It was simply breathtaking and you can tell the cocktails have been made with passion the ingredients compliment each other perfectly. We then decided to stay for dinner and our barman (Fidaous) was so accomodating, he set up a romantic table for us to dine on at the roof above Rimba. We ordered the Pandan Chicken Pops and the Watermelon and Feta salad to start, both were so flavoursome unlike anything we have had, so perfectly balanced. We then indulged in the Udang Masak Lamak with Blackened Pineapple and the Whole Fish Bakar with Air Assam, again such amazing flavour combinations and so fresh. Unfortunately we were to full for desert but highly recommend this place the service was next level and the food was just divine, cannot fault the entire experience we were both made to feel right at home. They even organised a car to take us back to our hotel down the road. Show less

Author: strawberrygirl26Singapore, Singapore
Title: Magical evening made perfect!
Review: It was such a magical evening, as made perfect by the Rimba & Monsoon team. Special shoutout to Fatin, a smiley and cheerful service crew whom made our evening such a lovely one! I’d liaised with them beforehand via email to plan a private dinner to celebrate my partner’s birthday, and the decors were hands-down gorgeous! At night, they lit up the fairy lights and the candles, and helped us took loads of pretty photos too. Thank you so much - because of the beautiful ambience, amazing service and setting, many of our friends have been asking for more details about this great restaurant. Thank you so much for making our first Langkawi trip such a memorable one!Show less

Author: Jetsie2Vienna, Austria
Title: Wat a place..AWESOME
Review: Food ambient is so beautiful ..the service is excellent waiter n waitress very friendly and willing..pleasant.We all love the place.The service unbelievable all with Smiley faces.The food oxtail soup ,Gado Gado n the satay skewer is a must for starter. Main course Ikan Baker oooo yummylicious, rendang n the Udang lemak is a must ..but the LIFE MUSIC we can do without.. it will be perfect just to listen the sound of nature that surrounds the restaurant..why spoil it with LIFE MUSIC..seriously it be better with perhaps soft background pleasant lounge music.The GM Nizam n staff we thank you for the lovely evening.Show less

Author: dirkm338Bali, Indonesia
Title: Beautiful place, excellent service and great food
Review: Having been a guest in one of the resorts villas last night we had a feast at the restaurant. Being familiar with the island I can recommend not only the food quality but also the service. Nothing so common here on Langkawi. And the view from the top terrace is second to none here on the island. Being back soon. Thank you!Show less

Author: Jonathan HTralee, Ireland
Title: Beautiful views and amazing service
Review: Ate here on valentines day - it could not have been better! The staff were extremely friendly and attentive and went out of their way to give us a nice experience. They have a lovely rooftop terrace for drinks and the food was lovely. They even gave us a free cocktail. You get a beautiful sunset view from over the treetops - highly recommended!Show less

Author: Zamri A
Title: Warm Welcoming Restaurant , Superb!!!
Review: I come to see the view, maybe a drink after hard day work. I very please with the services and absolutely great food. Superb Oxtail soup. Thanks to Wan, MiMi, Syed and Fatin. Even I frequently came, but the services always superb. Very very recommended .Show less

Author: oyeendolly
Title: Restaurant
Review: This is my first time to try dinner at this restaurant. The food is nice but service time too long...

Author: eatdrinkstayBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic evening
Review: Last night on the island and wanted some where special , we pre booked. We got it so right picking this fabulous place. Wonderful friendly perfect service from start to Finnish . The menu was mouth watering I could not easily choose but settled for the most wonderful seared tuna starter that was so delicious and partner had the Squid and again perfect. Mains I had the mixed skewers absolutely delicious and partner had the prawn curry, we were both so happy with the choices .Perfect wine selection. Lovely dessert ! Can’t fault it, best meal and service in three weeks of visiting Malaysia Thank you Show less

Author: BistroDelPuerto
Title: Nice view
Review: The food was good, but nothing extraordinary. A litlle bit overrated. The sunset is very nice from there.

Author: lcwong
Title: Could Have Been Better
Review: Setting, view and service was great but food taste and waiting time could be really be improved. Such a pity.

Author: WjwjSingapore, Singapore
Title: Gorgeous view but mediocre food
Review: The sunset view was gorgeous at this restaurant and service was excellent as well. However, the taste of the food was not quite up to our expectation. Mushroom soup was way too salty and the rest of the dishes we ordered just tasted mediocre. We had to wait pretty long for the food to arrive as well. Would give it a better rating if the food was better.Show less

Author: 750katarinas
Title: Divine!
Review: We visited Rimba at Ambong Pool Villas two consecutive nights in a row which I think says it all! This is an amazing venue with the most breathtaking view overlooking the ocean and the sunset just before you’re feet. The food is excellent and the staff is beyond friendly. They make you feel like part of a family with such a loving and kind spirit. A special shout out to Wan for taking such amazing care of us!Show less

Author: aj2288Hyderabad, India
Title: Great food, welcoming staff and stunning views
Review: Rimba was a fantastic restaurant with great food, drinks and the staff was so so wonderful. The views are out of this world, especially the sunset. The staff went out of their way to make us feel comfortable and were very thoughtful and warm. Thank you to the Rimba team for being so accommodating and cheerful!!Show less

Author: 375EmA
Title: A must-visit in Langkawi - fantastic!
Review: We had such a beautiful meal at Rimba! Not only was the meal absolutely delicious, the staff were so beautiful and friendly. The seafood dishes are delicious and fresh. The cocktails are great and the view and atmosphere of the restaurant are really amazing! The bar above the restaurant is also sensational- watch the sunset up there with a drink then head down for dinner - perfect! Thank you for such a lovely evening. Show less

Author: Amandandgreg
Title: Highly recommend!
Review: We were privileged to have Wan and his amazing team look after us for an outstanding and world class meal! We booked last minute and somehow secured a table that overlooked the stunning ocean below, with front row seats for a glorious pink sun set. We enjoyed the watermelon and feta salad as a light entree — it was fresh, well balanced and delivered with a smile and a warm chat! For mains we loved the prawn and coconut curry with pineapple (an absolute standout) — the prawns were large and juicy, the curry had the perfect amount of kick — and the whole fish with coconut rice (cooked exceptionally, flaking off easily with the fork, still beautiful and moist). When desert rolled around, though we were already satisfied, we dived into a melt-in-your-mouth banana fritter with coconut ice cream, and mango with coconut cream rice. The food was outstanding and easily some of the best we have had in any city around the world but what really stood out was the service! Wan and the team were warm, approachable, happy to have a chat, answer questions and make recommendations and provided easily some of the best restaurant service we have ever experienced! When our meal ended it was quite dark and Wan even insisted on walking us out to the driveway. Our best experience in Malaysia so far!Show less

Author: charl26Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: This restaurant deserves a Michelin Star!
Review: We booked in advance and secured the best seat in the house thanks to the great communication from the restaurant.We arrived in time for sunset which enhanced our experience as the view is just mesmerising.The menu is fresh and exciting and the food is just wonderful.Staff were courteous and aimed to please,they even arranged to drop us off at our hotel at the end of evening.5 star service from a restaurant which deserves to have a Michelin star to it’s name.Show less

Author: W8967VEsusanp
Title: Fantastic
Review: We had the best meal at Rimba Restaurant in Ambong Villas Resort while staying in Langkawi for 10 nights. Service, atmosphere and of course the food were faultless. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who is staying in Langkawi.

Author: Wiij99Uppsala, Sweden
Title: Fantastic in every regard
Review: Just came back from our second time dining at the Rimba restaurant at Ambong Pool Villas. The restaurant offers food of great quality in combination with service minded staff and a breathtaking scenery. The interior parts of the restaurant, even the restroom, provides a modern- and clean impression which I consider to be very inviting. Due to being recognized by the staff during our second visit, the house even offered complimentary plates of fresh fruit! Prices are around 30-40 RM (about 7-10$) per dish, which is very afforfable in relation to the quality of the food. Wan and his colleagues really made a good impression by being open, service minded and charming. I would definitely recommend the Rimba restaurant for customers who value scenery along with quality of service and appearance in addition to the selection of food. Show less

Author: 9southamerica2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: We came here a few weeks ago for our last night in Langawi, this restaurant was amazing. Firstly the ambience is incredible as its set in the hills with surrounding forests and views of the sea. The food- just amazing, we wanted to try local foods and the dishes were just yum! And the staff well they were the nicest we came across in the whole of Malaysia to be honest! Wan ( I think this was his name) was just so nice and accomodating he even let us enjoy the bar with sea views upstaires with no pressure to purchase any extra drinks. This restaurant and bar is just so nice and more people need to visit! Wan was also kind enough to arrange a lift back to our hotel! I would visit again and maybe even stay at the villas if we come back! ThanksShow less

Author: Imessel
Title: Restaurant
Review: Lovely staff, sea and sunset view and of course food. Really recommend this place. The villa was fully booked, but I would love to stay there next time

Author: ZainulIkhwanZ
Title: Anniversary Dinner
Review: Very good & friendly services given, excellent food and very nice view. Good live music...recommended!

Author: Dennis K
Title: Super caring
Review:
Had birthday dinner with my girlfriend and the staff was super caring. They prepared a special table with decoration for us and even had a dessert with name for my girlfriend. 
Would always recommend to go there.

Author: Rickyaaron1245
Title: Horrible
Review: We had emailed in advance to book a table yet no table was ready when we arrived. When we finally got round to ordering (which took a long time in itself) it took over half an hour for the starters to come out. At no point were we asked if we wanted more drinks from our first order. When the mains came out it was literally seconds after our starters had been taken away. Most of our mains came out cold, my burger came out as if it had been painted with mayo, this lead to the burger falling apart and eating it with my knife and fork. If this was all not bad enough there was some dinner time “entertainment” which was a very old man killing any kind of ambience that this restaurant would have had as it was a beautiful restaurant overlooking the sea but unfortunately we were unable to enjoy that. I would not recommend going here at all.Show less

Author: Madison L
Title: Brilliant food, atmosphere and service
Review: A really lovely restaurant away from the busy tourist strip and up high amongst the tree tops. Atmosphere is great here and we had live music too! Staff very friendly, brilliant food. It is a limited menu with a lot of squid featured.

Author: kimjB7537GWPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Anniversay
Review: One of the most beautiful places I have been on the island. Truly magical and romantic. The drive up to the restaurant/hotel can be challenging due to the hilly and narrow road up which can accommodate a single vehicle at a time.Upon arrival, you will be greeted by nature and the friendly staff of the hotel who are ever willing to help and remembers you by name. The restaurant location is perfect, the ambiance is relaxing with a nice vibe. However the entertainment main a one-man band can be improved. Overall, it was a wonderful experience and a must-try at least once. Food and drink are pricy thou well this is because they are not locally price Show less

Author: Nomad661087
Title: Great place to eat
Review:
Fantastic food. Fantastic views. Brilliant and helpful staff. Just go there. You will enjoy everything about your visit
David and Sally

Author: Thricey37Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ambong Pool Villa: Nice place to chillax!
Review: Having stayed at Ambong Ambong Rainforest Retreat, we decided to venture out their sister... Ambong pool villa.Food is great especially the local dishes and happy hours from 5pm to 7pm! Yeah! And a gentleman singing live during dinner, that is awesome! For that nice ambience and view, it's all good! Should give it a try! Show less

Author: lazara1155Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Romantic Anniversary Dinner
Review: We’ve decided to celebrate our anniversary at Rimba. It was a last minute reservation as we couldnt decide where we shld celebrate our anniversary. There are soooo many good restaurant in Langkawi. After reading reviews on tripadvisor and comparing restaurants, we chose Rimba. It was the best decision we’ve ever made. Upon arrival, we were ushered to our table. There were some rose petals, candles n red roses for our table setting..overlooking tree tops n beautiful sunsets. The scenery was breathtaking. We’ve ordered popiah for starters and udang masak lemak n skewers for our main course and sago gula melaka for desserts. It was amazingly delicious!!! Suddenly we heard the singer wished happy anniversary and to our surprise..the whole staff came to us wth a plate of nicely decorated brownies..we were speechless n truly impressed!! Thank you Encik Wan for the extra effort for making our night a night to b remembered..thank you to all the Rimba staff for being so attentive and very friendly..u were superb!!!!Show less

Author: 344lukas
Title: Awesome dinner experience.
Review:
Last day in Langakawi, we wanted to treat ourselves to a nice dinner, eating out mostly at food trucks etc... The staff was very friendly and and and catered to our every need
The

Author: 709shawngPerth, Australia
Title: Lunch with a view
Review: Rode up to rimba for lunch, (for those walking up expect a bit of a hike up the driveway). Greeted with the customary friendly welcome and sat outside overlooking the treetops and water. A pleasant way to enjoy lunch. The food was good with a lot of flavour with my wife really enjoying her prawn dish. A enjoyable lunch indeed.Show less

Author: jazilahjahrill
Title: Our son's birthday celebration
Review: We're really enjoyed all the menu...mee goreng mamak and burger are highly recommended...For those who love nature view,romantic place to dine...this is the one.tqsm to all the staff who treated us well..

Author: natreview1234
Title: Best birthday dinner ever!
Review: I visited recently with my friends for my birthday and we had the most perfect time over a beautiful meal and cocktails. The team made a huge effort to make it a special evening getting balloons, cake and even a birthday picture!Thanks so much !!Show less

Author: 320preyapCanton of Zurich, Switzerland
Title: Divine experience!
Review: We dined at the Rimba restaurant and what a lovely little gem this is! Set in the rainforest, with a gorgeous ocean view, we spent hours relaxing, eating a variety of delicious food while enjoying the ambience of the restaurant.We tried a number of different items over two meals, from the calamari to the signature skewers, Nasri goreng and delicious dessert! The customer service makes this dining experience even more pleasurable, lovely service with a smile! Although the prices are high for Langkawi dining, you get what you pay for. The service, quality of food and gorgeous setting is worth the price to pay for dining in paradise.I recommend giving this place a try!If you are arriving by taxi, ensure you inform the restaurant so they can have a driver take you up the hill, if your taxi is unable to make the drive up in their car :)Show less

Author: alexandersJ4317RW
Title: Restaurant based in unique
Review: Restaurant based in unique place with amazing view, especially for dinner. Food amazing, staff is really polite. We found this restaurant as the best on the island! Highly recommended for all

Author: Ramiz S
Title: Amazing
Review: I would highly recommend going here. Food was amazing, The staff were amazing especially Wan, he went above and beyond to ensure the experience we receieved was fantastic. We could not ask for anything more.

Author: shukrisafie
Title: Great experience
Review: The food, environment and staff were great. We also received a complimentary cake for our wedding anniversary. Thank you Rimba. We will definitely come again.

Author: mwagiehDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: The proposal..
Review: I was really lucky that day, It was my gf birthday and I picked same day to give her the ring so I searches for a nice restaurant preferably with great view for such memorable day. Once I decided I called them to book for 7:00 pm sunset time. They were very understanding and helpful and offered me to help with the whole “ring” thing. The only issue is the restaurant on top of a hill but once we reached the location we found a small car waiting to take us top.I was amazed. We got a super view table and talked to the manager there. He told me not to worry about anything. Took the ring and helped with the whole proposal thing. With a complimentary desserts with the ring inside it. I’ve got to admit we both were shocked of the idea but it was brilliant. Once we finished the day they offered the same small car to take us down again. It was awesome. Worth all the effort.thanks guys for making that day special. Show less

Author: abfwilliams
Title: Amazing
Review:
We had such a lovely, romantic meal here last night! The food was amazing, the mojitos were amazing, the setting/scenery was amazing and the staff were amazing!! Thank you so much.

Abi and Ross

Author: yasmin6911
Title: Family friendly, picturesque view with actual delicious food!
Review: Omg where do I start. From the picturesque view to the delicious food and the best service ever. We a family of 4 with 2 toddlers went there to eat dinner at 6pm. I suggest go early for sunset and lovely view. It was raining after dinner and our grabcar did not want to drive up to the restaurant so the hotel/restaura t staff avtually sent us down the hill. So helpful. Actual good food. Best view of sea and nature. Overall no regrets and would go there again. Had 3 mains and 1 dessert with some drink RM190.Show less

Author: FMS29
Title: Recommended Hidden Gem of Langkawi
Review: Dined at this restaurant on 24th Aug and I liked the place and found out about it from a friend's Instagram. I have lived in Langkawi for 2 years 2 years back (never heard of it haha) and my friends who were still staying in Langkawi have not been there too, truly a hidden gem! I picked the place based on reviews on TripAdvisor and the picturesWe loved it, reservations was made a day before (smoothly) for a long table. I personally liked the bridge to the restaurant set a tops of trees. Environment was cozy and it was not crowded or noisy, it was a good spot for a farewell dinner shared among close friends.Food overall was good!I would return again when in Langkawi :)Show less

Author: Neale1810Kingston-upon-Hull, United Kingdom
Title: Everything was perfect
Review: This was by far the next meal we have had so far in our week in Langkawi. The location n the rainforest is spectacular but it does mean you have to do a couple of minutes climbing up to it as the road up is steep and taxis don’t seem to want to go up!We didn’t have a booking but they had a table for us - it’s fairly small so it’s probably worth booking especially in the high season. There are a few tables outside and 5 or 6 inside. You still get a good view of the rainforest from inside but the sunset view is best from an outside table or just go upstairs on the terrace and have a drink up there watching the sun set.Our waitress was superb and so friendly and helpful throughout the meal and afterwards as we needed a taxi back to our hotel.The menu isn’t vast but enough to chose from. We hadn’t had a lot of seafood since arriving so we chose that. To start with we both had a prawn dish - my wife’s was cooked in oil, lemon and soy and mine came with a salad Nicoise style and a lovely satay sauce. Both were excellent.For our main dish we both went for the whole cooked fish of the day (which was sea bass today) which was served with rice and a spicy dipping sauce. The fish was cooked really well - as usual it’s a faff to de-bone it but it was worth it in the end.We don’t normally have a desert but as the rest of the meal was so good we had scoops of coconut and mango gelato. Both of the scoops were so flavoursome.Superb meal and such excellent service. They provided a car to take us to the bottom of the hill where the taxi they had ordered was waiting for us.Show less

Author: rosada_8888Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Superb!
Review: This is a gem in.langkawi ,.fine dining,excellent service,i would suggest to go to the top deck first for sunset and some cocktail drinks,,lovely view,than have your dinner at the rimba restaurant downstairs..fusion ,malaysian ,western food ..many mouth watering choices..i will be back pretty soon..well done and keep up the good work!Show less

Author: Cruiser16422147736
Title: Beautiful setting
Review: Rimba is a restaurant situated in Ambong Ambong.This eco friendly resort is built amonst the lush of the green tropical forest.The aerial roof top with sunset background gives you a picture perfect of this beautiful jewel of Langkawi island.Gado gado with peanut sauce & Mee Mama are one of the many delicious food available.Show less

Author: drzulkarnain1969
Title: Wonderful natural surrounding,Excellent Food
Review: The restaurant is located at Ambong-Ambong Pool Villas, a unique resort right smack in a jungle with a nice view of the sea. Tasted their Ox tail soup, Gado-gado and Mee Mamak..all were nicely prepared. Staff were very pleasant and helpful..2 thumbs up..

Author: Alan_BlighKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch with a view
Review: This is a lovely restaurant set amongst the tree tops with the view of the sea. Must return for sunset next time. Good food. I had the Tuna Salad which was fresh and perfect for a light lunch with a good cup of coffee to end the meal. The staff we friendly and engaging.Show less

Author: evangelia m
Title: Excellent!
Review: We had a very delicious dinner. Service, ambience and view were excellent! I definitely recommend it, especially for a romantic dinner during the sunset.Show less

Author: karynthong
Title: Best spot for dinner ever!
Review: Went here for dinner with my little sister. A waitress who named Fatin are very nice and good service! Vote 5 stars a part because of her. We do really enjoy our dining time at here. Foods, drinks and those stunning view, love it! Definitely will pay a visit again!Show less

Author: aifaazain
Title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR TASTY FOOD
Review: Thank you to Mr Sharidan and to MR AZHAR and all of f&b staff for treating us with care while we're in Rimba. I love the view, the ambience, the food and the people there. Thank you so much you guys.

Author: mohammedbfhKuwait
Title: Hands down The best restaurant i've tried in langkawi
Review: This restaurant is really amazing!.i found it by Tripadvisor and went to it. The view was really amazing and the staff are the most friendly staff i've ever met. The food is something else, real delicious food. We ordered fish of the day and one of the pastas and both were very delicious!You have to come to this restaurant if you ever visit langkawiShow less

Author: Rashidi R
Title: ''GOOD FOOD & EXCELLENT SERVICE"
Review: Excellent eating experience, from walking in the entrance and being greeted by staff. Love the fish! meal was hot and excellent taste.Our server Wan was great!Special thanks to Mr.Nizam for surprise Anniversary cake. All of you made my day special.We will definitely come back!

Author: Federico Z
Title: Room for improvement
Review: During my recent trip to Langkawi, I decided to give Rimba a try! The location is simply stunning, unfortunately the service was extremely slow and it turned out we have to wait very long time for our straight main courses, despite only e tables were occupied. The food was nice and well priced, but it doesn't justify the long waiting time(around 45 minutes).Show less

Author: chrisjavassalPulau Redang, Malaysia
Title: Simply gorgeous
Review: A truly hidden gem in Langkawi, very professional, courteous and helpful welcome, service.Food and drinks were yummy set in a very exclusive and unique fe or between jungle, sea and small islands.A real pleasure for all our senses.Definitely recommend it!Thank you for this charming experience Show less

Author: Ruchi B
Title: Spectacular food, service and view
Review: Please do not miss this one while at Langkawi. This was our best evening on the Island. Get there before sunset.

Author: KarenMcClymontKuching, Malaysia
Title: Sunset Dining to Remember.
Review: Located at Ambong Pool Villas, Rimba Restaurant is exquisitely located to create a romantic and memorable evening. With superb ambiance, exceptional service and exquisite and delicious food options, at a reasonable price, it's a highly recommended sunset dinner location. Local and western delicacies are offered to satisfy any pallet; I particularly recommemd trying the whole fish followed by the fried banana and cocunut gelato, the mango gelato is also a must to try ... Show less

Author: vincentdN9490WGGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great
Review: Super kind staff, but the food was disappointing. The prices don’t match the quality of the food. Too much cheap white baking bread and small portions regarding the starter and main course.Show less

Author: L1v2pLfCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunchtime lushiousness
Review: The view from the restaurant is to die for. I can see this being perfect anytime of day. I went at lunchtime via a hired scooter and opted to start with humus with two way pita bread and pickled vegetables. For main I had seared tuna, avocado, cherry tomatoes and salad. The ambience and setting of the restaurant is just perfect and would suit all types of travellers. The staff are very friendly and accommodating to all your dinning and non dinning needs. It's a must!Show less

Author: alexandrakU7157TGKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great atmosphere. Great food. Great service.
Review: The food was excellent. The staff recommended some dishes that were Devine. Very friendly, hospitable staff. Unfortunately we came a bit later in the evening so couldn’t admire the views but I’m sure it’s stunning. Even in the dark, the forest & atmosphere around is wonderful. Show less

Author: Ruchi BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing place!
Review: We went there at sunset and the view is not to be missed! The staff is very friendly and the food and drinks were quite amazing! The bartender even made us a few drinks off the menu. Do try their mee goreng and don't miss the sunset. Even liked the live music there :) Show less

Author: Sasu123
Title: Great Find
Review: What a great evening we had - the thai spice cocktail went down a treat! There was live music and the staff were fantastic. I think the whole fish was my favourite. The view is great and is in a tropical paradise in the trees! Will def be back!Show less

Author: tramps2016
Title: Awesome meal with view of the sea over trees with a breeze
Review: A pleasant discovery! We had lunch at Rimba on Saturday and were really impressed with the service, location and taste. Service was exceptional. We ordered roast mushroom soup to start, it was a standout! Mains were whole fish and the prawn curry. Equally delicious. We will return! Show less

Author: Courtneyhooper
Title: Best meal we had in Langkawi
Review: A must try. Food was beautiful and fresh, all the meat was cooked to perfection. The view is to die for. Malaysian and western dishes. You won’t regret coming here

Author: haizam4840
Title: Breaking Fast with family.
Review: Very nice place to visit and delicious food. Thanks to Mr.Syed and the rest of restaurant staff... Well done and good job guys... :)

Author: val812017St. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and perfect service
Review: I ate at Rimba restaurant in the lovely Ambong Pool Villa resort. From start to finish, the staff were personable, helpful and did anything to make our meal great. The restaurant itself is nestled in the jungle with the most amazing sunset views of the Andaman sea - breathtaking. The food has many interesting dishes including mamak mee goreng, fried rice and western dishes to suit all palates. My toddler enjoyed the pasta which was brought out quickly. Good wine selection, lovely cocktails and the coffee was good too. All round, beautiful food, tranquil setting, tres chic! Had a peep at the sky bar that is sue to be finished later this year and I will definitely return. Great meal away from the hustle of CenangShow less

Author: NopainNogain88Lagos, Nigeria
Title: nothing to write at home about
Review: Had dinner few days ago. The setting was nice, service quite average, the food was really good (specially the oxtail soup) pricing was also alright.What was really disturbing in my point of view, was the pushy way to ask guests for a review on trip advisor. I think it should be very spontaneous (writing a review) and also an enviroment like this shouldn't need to push guests to write a review.Show less

Author: SteveM5471
Title: Rimba Restaurant Langkawi
Review: Fantastic food and drink. Great location to watch the sunset. Staff super efficient and friendly. Thoroughly recommend a visit here.

Author: TheYumL
Title: Loved Rimba
Review: This is one of the prettiest settings to dine. Set in an almost tree house like a restaurant, you dine among the treetops and have spectacular sunset views. They serve both western and regional food but we only tried the local - it was very good - fresh and tasty. I highly recommend the gado gado - the peanut sauce is divine.Show less

Author: maddiemeath
Title: Beautiful Birthday Surprise
Review: The amazing staff sure did deliver! Beautiful food paired with even more beautiful views made for a memorable night. The staff were very accommodating and helped make my mother’s birthday a wonderful evening. We very much appreciated the surprise piece of chocolate brownie cake and happy birthday song. A specific mention to our server Syed who did a great job and got us everything we needed. Show less

Author: Panapur
Title: Beautiful sunsets, friendly staff and delicious cuisine
Review: A truly wonderful restaurant, surrounded by the rainforest with views over the water to see the sunset. Much like the Datai setting but much more reasonably priced, closer location to town and laid back atmosphere. Amazing that even though this isn't that far from Cenang beach you feel like it's another island. Food highlights include the whole baked fish, tiger prawn curry and sago mango pudding. The staff are awesome! So friendly, jovial and genuine. We loved it here. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: locker22
Title: Beautiful food and staff
Review: We felt so looked after while staying here in the pool villas, and in particular the Rimba restaurant is excellent. Stunning sunset views with monkeys and eagles to watch. Truly delicious food, the whole fish was fresh and flavourful. Very good cocktails and desserts too. The friendliest staff, jovial and kind. We can’t wait to return.Show less

Author: teohkokseng
Title: Best service ever
Review: Was having dinner with kids at this restaurant, the experience is remarkably unforgettable, the server Shahidan deserve 1 of the best server I met.Shahidan: Any drinks for you and your kids? How about juices? All are fresh juices.Brandon: Papa, can I have a coconut?Me: Sure you can. Uncle will pluck the FRESH coconut for you.Shahidan: Oh yes, but I won’t pluck for you, I will get a monkey to pluck for you. There is a lot monkey here.Then he turn to the jungle and start to shoutShahidan: 1 coconut please. Hi Boy, the monkey will pluck a FRESH coconut for you.He then continued with lot more of table touch and information to us despite he is having puasa during work. Regardless the coconut is fresh or not, this experience is fresh for me. We should be sharing and embrace those kind of service attitude to make sure he continue to influence othersWelldone Shahidan, you have gained my respect and if I do open up restaurant at this area, I will after you.Show less

Author: MelGardiniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Brilliant service, delicious food, great views
Review: This place is a lovely, tranquil escape from the busyness of Pantai Cenang, yet only a short trip away. The walk/shuttle up the hill to the restaurant is totally worth it - fresh air and great views as a reward. Food was really delicious and so fresh. The service was second-to-none: relaxed & friendly, and couldn’t be more attentive. All the staff were fantastic, but a special mention goes to the F&B manager Mr Azhar, who was so accommodating. Thanks so much for a really memorable lunch. We will definitely be back. Show less

Author: hugomendonca721
Title: Wonderful meal, location and service!
Review: We enjoyed a truly wonderful meal here. The service was friendly and the food was fresh and tasty. The restaurant sits within a wonderful elevated setting and I would certainly recommend visiting if you are in Langkawi. :-)

Author: simonkoksewunPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced and overstated restaurant
Review: Not worth to dine in as the food is like street food but charge you like 5 star hotel price. The space is small and the view is so-soShow less

Author: foom839Pantai Tengah, Malaysia
Title: Thanks Wan and the team for awesome 8th Anniversary dinner
Review: Made a reservation thru phone 2 days advance to reserve a nice spot with sunset view.Went there 6:30 PM and the view is just great and windy. Ordered their Signature Nasi Campur and one Fish & Chip. All foods are fresh and taste good! Especially their fish.Wan, the person in charge did an amazing job helping us to get a nice seat, bring us plain water and even gave us a surprise cake for our anniversary. Well done to Wan and the team! We had a great experience here & highly recommend whoever visit Langkawi to visit here.Show less

Author: cindymarieazurValencia, Spain
Title: Excellent!
Review: Deserve to receive recognition not only the place itself but also their staff *own*, yes that is his name. When we came there, we didn’t know that their 3rd floor is under construction thus they’re closed for lunch time. But what *own* did amazingly, he asked his boss whether they can open their kitchen for us since we came all the way from our resort. And Yeap, they opened it for us. We felt the exclusivity treatment from the restaurant all the way to their staff and obviously the food. You can see from my photos how amazing and yummy their food. Definitely a place to visit not only for lunch but also for dinner to view the sunset. These 2 dishes we ordered definitely must try and you won’t get disappointed with quality of service either. Kudos and keep up the good work.Show less

Author: A VHilversum, The Netherlands
Title: Wonderful dinner with the kids
Review: I went to Rimba this evening with two of my kids. We had a wonderful time. The view was breathtaking, the food high quality, service so friendly and cooperative because of the children. And as a bonus we got to see monkeys in the trees nearby. Really a very good experience.Show less

Author: summerdays83London
Title: Lives up to the hype
Review: We went there for dinner on a Sunday evening - a rather rowdy crew of 2 adults, 2 young kids and a baby. We went early to minimise the disruption to honeymooners and diners looking for a quiet place to watch the sunset!The staff were lovely - very accommodating and helpful, even offering to take baby off us at one point so we could dine in peace! Our kids loved the pesto pasta with veggies and homemade chicken nuggets. And my husband who’s a vegetarian was delighted by the options, all available on a separate menu. They weren’t fazed even when our 6 year old dropped a glass and broke it - just efficiently cleaned up the mess.We’ll definitely be back, hopefully when baby is slightly older, so we can properly enjoy the views which were spectacular!Show less

Author: bubber_20Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Top service and top view
Review: Went here 2 out of 4 dinners, when we was in the area.Food, view and staff is 5 out of 5.Moneys and eagles comes pretty close.Enjoy.Show less

Author: jenniferlY7184YXSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Malaysian food.
Review: Rimba is a hilltop restaurant overlooking the straits to Tepur island. There’s a choice of dining with the sunset or relaxing for lunch. Either is pleasant because of its clever design of catching the sea breezes with a 270* view of sea and forest in a tranquil setting. I was pleasantly surprised by the Oxtail Soup with Bone Marrow. It had a spicy local flavour n the bone marrow was very tender. When the Sago Gula Melaka dessert arrived, the coconut milk had the right amount of salt and the sago was firm. Next day, some of the Gado-gado was left raw and crunchy - a nice healthy take from the traditional parboiled vegetables. The accompanying sauce was not too hot nor sweet - manageable for both local and overseas palates. Anyway Rimba staff would happily oblige with their local sambal (homemade chilli sauce) if you wanted it spicy. Staff and service were attentive and very friendly. Yes I would come again for assured quality, comfort and service. Show less

Author: newmartmanSanya, China
Title: A delicious treat in a beautiful setting
Review: I rarely write reviews, but felt compelled to after my visit to Rimba today. The food was delicious - I recommend the skewers, which were served with a selection of vibrant/tangy/spicy/colourful sauces. The service was excellent, attentive (without being too attentive) and friendly. The view at sunset was beautiful. Would be perfect for a romantic evening, though I was just treating myself. For such a great place with such good food I was surprised not to see more people there - though my waiter explained that they opened recently. There's a good chance I'll be eating here again before I leave Langkawi.Show less

Author: 650maureenc
Title: Birthday celebration dinner
Review: Celebrated my birthday there. Great service with good food. They went the extra mile by going out to get a cake for my birthday. It was a night to remember. Definitely a place to celebrate a special event at.

Author: tmunson24Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing setting, great food, but a few areas for improvement
Review: Upon arriving, we were immediately impressed with Rimba. As you can see in the photos posted by other users, the setting is amazing, especially at sunset. We had a table outside, but the restaurant is effectively open air, so even the inside tables will have a nice breeze. Overall the food was excellent. The shrimp starter, Udang Masak Lemak, and Whole Fish, were all delicious, and in particular I recommend ordering the whole fish. I ordered the fish and chips--and perhaps it was my mistake for ordering something like this--but the menu described it as "market fresh fish fillets" in a golden batter, fried. Given the theme of the menu was fresh and local fish, I was intrigued by their take on fish and chips. What arrived however, looked like a frozen fish fillet you would find in the freezer section of your grocery store. I could be wrong, but I cannot imagine this was actually "market fresh".Lastly, the service was a little slow, and we had to follow up on the status of our starter as it had been nearly 30 minutes since we ordered. The staff was incredibly nice throughout the evening though, so I cannot fault them. I think that diners try to time their visit around sunset, which leads to a bottleneck in the kitchen. Overall I highly recommend Rimba, especially at sunset. You'll just need a little patience, and to avoid the fish and chips!Show less

Author: Matthew G
Title: Superb restaurant in amazing location
Review: Excellent food, fantastic location with amazing sea view at sunset, and outstanding service from the friendly and attentive waiting staff. Highly recommended!

Author: VeemalRajPillay
Title: Excellent Service and excellent Food
Review: I will highly recommend this restaurant the view are awesome/amazing and food really good. The staff are super friendly and helpful. They are excellent service by the staff. We are very impressed with service they provide.

Author: Eduard_R15
Title: Awesome view, wonderful food
Review: We came to enjoy the sunset by recommendation of Ambong-Ambong hotel staff, where we stayed. The food was delicious and the staff very friendly and helpful.  Truly relaxing experience.

Author: Abby M
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: Just had a great meal here. The food was terrific, the staff was kind and helpful and the setting was over the top. Like getting to have dinner in a fancy treehouse overlooking the bay!

Author: cosmov2015
Title: Dinner Seafood
Review: Great place for a romantic dinner and sunset watching. Broad range of local food presented in a sophisticated way. Good quality and good price plus AMAZING VIEW! Very nice and friendly personnel.

Author: Tessie77
Title: Very special visit
Review:
They took great care of us and the food was perfect!! We come on a special occasion and they made us feel so special

Thanks

Author: Darcy AHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Excellent food, excellent service, perfect setting
Review: We came here a little late after the sun had set, but the setting was still very peaceful and romantic. The service is super friendly and welcoming, and not too intrusive. The food is nothing short of spectacular. We waited a little while, but it was well worth it. I had the oxtail soup and squid ink spaghetti. Both were amazing and I think I probably ate them a little too fast. If you visit Langkawi, make the effort to find this place.Show less

Author: ElfbrookSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: great food in wonderful setting
Review: At here several times while staying at the Ambong Pool Villas. Great food - both Malay and international - and wonderful views over the Andaman sea. Became addicted to nasi lemak and roti cenai for breakfast. Also tropical fruits we'd never tasted before such as jackfruit and dragon fruit. It really is a very special place.Show less

Author: JeanieMZLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful setting for dinner
Review: We are currently staying at a hotel in Langkawi and wanted to get out for a change of scenery for dinner. After much searching on TripAdvisor I stumbled upon this restaurant, the reviews were good at the setting looked lovely. Booking was very easy, I emailed and the restaurant responded quickly answering all my queries and promptly booked me a table. On arrival we were seated inside (which still feels like being outside), the views are stunning and if you get there to watch the sunset then I would recommend sitting on the balcony outside for photo opportunities and to just eat with a beautiful view. You can see the monkeys jumping from tree to tree and hear them in the distance whilst you are eating, which I have never experienced before. Our waiter was super friendly and staff simply couldn't do enough for us. Food was nice but I think I went for the safe option and maybe should have been more adventurous with my choices. I would definately return as the staff were so lovely and welcoming. Thank you for a lovely evening and also helping us to get a taxi home.Show less

Author: sturladimmens2016Trondheim, Norway
Title: Dinner with returning visit
Review: two nights in a row at Rimba. The most amazing views, sunset and food/drinks were topped by the greatest service and staff of all of Langkawi. We cannot recomend this place enough and will definitely make a return visit here the next time we come to Langkawi! Thank you to the team at Rimba Restaurant for providing such excellent service! Sturla and LotteShow less

Author: DartydoLangkawi
Title: Ladies lunch party
Review: What a great location for a ladies lunch. Beautiful glass surrounded restaurant up in the jungle with amazing views of the sea and Langkawi rocky outcrops. We saw lots of local birds and we were visited by dusky monkeys curios to see so many ladies gathered together.The menu is varied with choices of local and European food. All delicious!The service is exemplary and there is a happy hour for cocktails.An evening at Ambong Ambong is equally enjoyable with a light music accomplelement of old favourites.Show less

Author: KimberJetMalaysia
Title: Must Visit To Dine-In!
Review: The food was good, hospitality was great and the view was amazing! Had breakfast with my kids at Rimba... and we get to observe so many species of birds flying from tree to tree. Really spectacular!Show less

Author: azrinaz2014
Title: A great place to relax and enjoy the beautiful sunset
Review: We called ahead to make reservations for dinner as we heard that the restaurant can get quite busy in the evenings. The phone was answered quickly and there were no hassles experienced in making dinner reservations. When we arrived at the restaurant, we were greeted in a warm and welcoming manner and escorted to our tables. We were given the table that afforded the best view of the sunset. Wan and his team were excellent and made great recommendations for both our food and drink orders. They were very attentive and even offered to take us up onto the roof so that we could enjoy the unhindered panoramic views. We did not have to wait long for our food to arrive and when it did, it was absolutely delicious. As we were about to leave after having such an enjoyable dinner, it started to rain heavily. We had parked quite a distance away and when the waitstaff discovered this, they immediately offered us umbrellas and even walked us to our car so that we didnt have to make an extra journey to return the umbrella. I cannot recommend this place enough and will definitely make a return visit here the next time we come to Langkawi! Thank you to the team at Rimba Restaurant for providing such excellent service!Show less

Author: HenrikAndTheGangPantai Cenang, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful view of the sunset and really nice staff
Review: Best sunset view in all of langkawi. Awesome drinks and ever better staff. Special thanks to Fairus who took great care of us and should be expecting a return visit. Drinks are delicious and the beer is cheap. Music is good and a restrooms are nice and clean. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for the perfect evening!Show less

Author: 767tetianas
Title: Relaxing atmosphere
Review: Amazing place. So relaxing, yummy food, nice live music and fantastic view of the sunset. Vegetarian options. Very friendly staff.

Author: JoakimDHunspach, France
Title: Great view and service
Review: Located in the middle of the woods with great view and service. While waiting for our dinner a waiter offered to show us the panorama view from the roof top and took some great photos. We had fish and the kids got a burger. Very tasty, but also about twice the price as normal Cenang restaurants.Show less

Author: rameshg114
Title: Restaurant

Author: RSRANU

Author: penny j
Title: RIMBA restaurant, Langkawi
Review: Awesome view of the Andaman Sea as we enjoyed the very delicious, beautifully plated lunch. Excellent service. We’ll definitely be back.Show less

Author: SusanM801Sydney, Australia
Title: SENSATIONAL FOOD, VIEW and STAFF
Review: Our group of seven adults had three fabulous meals at this restaurant. Food presentation was wonderful, and absolutely delicious.Nothing is too much trouble for Fairus (manager of the restaurant). Wine not chilled enough, sure no problem. Could we please have fish curry? No problem (it was delicious).The location for sunset is simply breathtaking. Listening to the local cicadas was strangely compelling (and very loud). Could we please eat on the deck? Sure! Everything is truly perfect. When in Langkawi - this is a MUST to visitShow less

Author: ACDC29Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Views & Superb Food!
Review: We have had some really mediocre meals in Langkawi so it was such a joy to discover this place.The flavours are really authentic and natural and the produce used are fresh and high quality. Both our Malay and Western choices hit the spot.Amazing views of the sea and islands too - the restaurant is located on a hill surrounded by greenery and we even saw a family of langurs in the trees. Sunset here is the best.Show less

Author: ddantsz

Author: sel s
