Author: Doortjemaria
Title: Best of the best
Review: This place is wonderfull, it has a dreamview, the staff is amazingly nice and friendly! And the food is Very delicious! A must visit on the island! Thank you 👌🏽

Author: llicetiNuremberg, Germany
Title: Great atmosphere, food and service :)
Review: We stayed at Ambong Ambong hotel and decided to try the restaurant Rimba. It was great; especially the service... people are so kind and attentive. really enjoyed a beautiful evening with delicious food, both local and international dishes. Best part: the ambience; there was a musician singing some old classic songs; really perfect for a chilled nice dinner. I recommend the whole fish bakar & air asam and as dessert... the black rice with mango... delicious! Great cocktails as well and happy hour daily from 5:00 to 8:00 pm. I think we are coming back tomorrow :)Show less

Author: lachrymist
Title: Highly recommend!
Review: Food was excellent and staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. You also get to see an amazing sunset and enjoy the great ambiance. There's also happy hour until 8pm where drinks are half off.

Author: kristiinamartin
Title: Wonderful experience
Review:
Food was amazing.
View was super beautiful at the sunset.
Service was literally fantastic
And the atmosphere was great, feels like in the middle of jungle but also you can have a beautiful sea view.

Author: 725mariahiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mesmerising...
Review: Came here to celebrate my birthday with friends.. Fantastic service..cheerful staff.. great ambiance.. tasty food... what more could u asked for !!! It is so full of tranquility. But first of all..Go early & get the best table out in the balcony terrace and enjoy the moments of sun setting... its simply breathtaking..Show less

Author: Jjdateaveler
Title: Awesome dinner experience

Author: 189jitkak
Title: Epic View
Review: Stunning place with gorgeous views as well as fantastic food👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻 recommended for anybody who loves to listen nigh wildlife sounds after amazing evening⭐️

Author: Lilyp_travels
Title: Amazing food and ambiance
Review: Came today to Rimba for delicious food and cocktails. We had a breathtaking view as we watched the sunset. We highly recommend visiting, best dinner in Langkawi!

Author: jackliong
Title: Nice view
Review: Great view from the above and amazing food serve especially delicious grill fish. Mock tail and cocktail are also serve which are a good pair for the food.

Author: L7629BSfernandol
Title: Great food, amazing service
Review: Food was great! Different options for breakfast, I had an avocado toast and it was very good. They had fresh juice, fresh fruits and brewed coffee. Service was exceptional! Super friendly and welcoming staff. By far the best meal I had in Langkawi!

Author: ESme9011
Title: Our best meal in Langkawi
Review: We were staying elsewhere and took a taxi here for a romantic sunset dinner. It was worth it, as this was our best meal in Langkawi, beating the Four Seasons and other excellent restaurants. You are dining high up on a hill, surrounded by lush forest and as we were on the terrace, we had an unobstructed view over the sea. Incredible view. The service was exceptionally attentive and personable. We had cocktails, wine and three courses of local food. Amazing flavours and presentation. Delicious seared tuna salad for starter. The flavour of the prawn curry I had was exceptional, one of the best curries I have ever had. Cocktails were very original, but a bit strong on the booze for our tastes (this tended to be true for many bars in Langkawi, you may mention this when ordering). An unforgettable dinner overall!Show less

Author: Carol GBaldock, United Kingdom
Title: Magnificent setting
Review: Visited the Rimba a few times whilst staying at the ‘Retreat’ and Pool Villas. So firstly the setting is amazing, one of the best I’ve experienced. We were shown the under construction sky bar on the level above and look forward seeing it completed. I’m sure it will be spectacular. Joan the owner also introduced herself to us on one visit and we had a lovely chat. We ate at the Rimba twice in the evening and my husband had lunch once. Menu is quite small but adequate, service and food presentation good and great value. My husband had mushroom soup at lunch time which he is still raving about now. Other highlights were the oxtail soup and whole fish bakar. Finally the cocktails were really well made. Our favourites were the Spicy Thai Daiquiri and the Margarita. We find it common practice in Malaysia though to put sugar in both so if you like them spicy and tangy as we do then specify no sugar.Show less

Author: Singapore1704Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent all round
Review: It was a mini adventure looking for the restaurant. But it was all worth it. We ordered a mix platter (rice and dishes) to be shared by two. The taste was authentic Malay cuisine, cooked with love, and presented in a lovely manner. The view (the restaurant was nestled amongst the treetop level of a rainforest, overlooking a Bay) was picturesque. Staff was friendly and attentive. One of our best meals in Langkawi. Show less

Author: Princeofnorway
Title: Best in langkawi
Review: Best food, service and view in Langkawi and possibly all of Southeast Asia. Waiters were all extremely attentive and friendly. The hotel villas were also out of this world.Show less

Author: schmgaBrisbane, Australia

Author: SzuFen LPenang
Title: Gorgeous food with even more gorgeous views!
Review: We dined as a family of four while staying at the resort. While the restaurant is incredibly romantic - especially at sunset overlooking the Andaman Sea - it is also very family friendly. The staff were great with the kids, accommodating meal requests and trying (successfully) to entertain my infant allowing us to eat in peace. The menu is small and the food is mostly local fare but is superbly presented and so good. They make a fried rice and satay skewers exciting!!Definitely one of the best restaurants in Langkawi!Show less

Author: AJ_Jade
Title: A perfect dinner with great view and authentic service
Review: Delicious food served in a tranquil setting surrounded by nature with a great view of the sea and sunset. It is a must visit place in Langkawi, specially for those who enjoy to dine in peace and quiet with great views. Menu is small but food was perfect. The staff are very attentive to our needs, seem to love their jobs, and exceeded our expectations, led by the Wan. We look forward to going back someday, not only to Rimba, but also to experience and stay at the villa.Show less

Author: geeshariffPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Food Great Staff
Review: We had dinner at Rimba and also breakfast here. Menu is not extensive but food were nicely presented and great. The staff service was wonderful especially En. Azhar. The place is serene and great for conversations. You can look out to the jungle and beyond it the sea and Tepur and Rebak Islands. You can get a free shuttle from Ambong-Ambong Rainforest retreat to to Ambong Pool Villa for breakfast. No breakfast buffet spread here, you order from the ala carte menu. Congee and local fruits of the day are the extras (as far as I am aware) that you can get here when compared to the breakfast menu at Ambong-Ambong Rainforest retreat. Tried the congee, it was very well made. The owner came over to say hello. Very welcoming and friendly person.Show less

Author: 110irenekSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Malaysian Food in great atmosphere
Review: My husband and I stayed in the Ambong Ambong for 4 nights! Rimba is the restaurant of the villas!We usually like to eat outside in different places, but wanted to trythe hotelrestaurant the first night. We weretotally blown away and came every night back here to enjoy the pristine views, the delicious food and the amazing service!The menu offers tasty localand internationaldishes and a very good selection of cocktails!The restaurant is hidden away in the rainforest overlooking the oceanoff cenang bech!The staff here is 5 star plus and they always made us feelspecial! We enjoyed our dinners here and totally recommend the place!!Thank you very much all of you !Show less

Author: TominsingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Went there every night of our stay
Review: ...because it was the beautiful place we could find. Menu is not huge but food is very tasty and the staff are just lovely! 50% during happy hour was awesome also...did I mention the view!?!Show less

Author: MST1976Singapore

Author: RomanFallenbacherSion, Switzerland
Title: Dinner at Rimba Ambong
Review: rimba/ambong2 has got one of the most beautiful settings on the island. After crossing a small bridge you enter a light flooded space opening to a spectacular panorama of luxurious vegetation and views over the beach of Cenang and the small islands offshore. The modern architecture may surprise in a place like this, but paired with a delicious and authentic malay cuisine, the contrast is just perfect . rimba/ambong2 just opened but will for sure become one of the most appreciated restaurants in Langkawi. We enjoyed a lot. Effa & RomanShow less

Author: niclasj2013Oslo, Norway
Title: Fantastic hidden gem!
Review: We checked in to Ambong Ambong early on a Wednesday and stayed for three nights. We had 8 nights in Langkawi at two other hotels, so had tried a few other restaurants before. We went for lunch at Rimba the first day and never went anywhere else for any meal during our whole stay. What a fantastic almost serene place, newly opened and with a service and friendliness you rarely meet. Food was amazing, obviously the chef a master of his craft. The same must be said about the bartender. Currently you need to stay with the hotel (has both Villas/Suites and Rooms) as Rimba currently is not open to others than hotel guests. Rimba is well worth booking a room just to get there!Show less

Author: AeinJamilMalaysia

A spacious room with large & comfortable pillow & matteres, huge bathroom with walk in wardrobe, gym, spacious dining restaurant with various choices at affordable price, infinity pool with jacuzzi and a lot more. We travel with a baby and the prepared a kids tent with kids toys in room.. so my baby will not boring. Overall it’s really represent a real *Marriot* and worth every penny.Big thanks to Ms hanis for a great hospitality and very attentive to our need throughout our stay. Come and InsyaAllah u will not regret….Show less

Author: shahrizansaadLangkawi, Malaysia

Shocked!! then ask this guys why we cannot seat together while they can? He said because they are family, AND HOW ABOUT US ( ME, WIFE & TWO KIDS?) he replied i don't know u came with family . Damn!! my kids 9&10yo you expect they can come by themselves to hotel???3rd SceneWhile everyone already having their Iftar, im going to take my 1st meal (lamb grilled)asking for outer side of the meet (look crips) Me: Can i have this onestaff : Cannot!! we give what we has slice 1st then only we can give other portionMe: im your customer and we pay full price for IftarShow less

Review: The moment we arrived at the restaurant, we were already in awe. The interior that welcomed us was stunning, on top of the warmth of the staff greeting us at the entrance. We were attended by Alif through most of the night and his recommendations were spot on - not too much nor too little food for the both of us and the taste was just too exquisite. We've been to a few fine dining restaurants and some Michelin restaurants, we're very impressed that the food served in Kayuputi was beyond par. From the oyster, to the risotto and finally the creme brulee, we were just overwhelmed by every dish, all thanks to Alif's recommendations. He was very attentive to our needs but not intrusive either and his service was excellent. My husband booked the dinner to commemorate our honeymoon. Unfortunately under the online booking, we couldn't put Honeymoon as the purpose of our visit. Alif came over towards the end of our dinner to confirm this with us and then surprised us with a little treat that said "Happy Honeymoon" instead. It's these level of details that make our visit more memorable and make us want more. We look forward to coming back soon and will definitely include Kayuputi in our itinerary! They did very nice cocktail too and I would imagine how chill it is to enjoy one while watching the sunset which I've missed due to cloudy sky.The service is simply outstanding. Author: nfthahJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Dinner At Kayuputi
Review: Definitely 5/5! With Alif assistance, he assist me and my husband to choose the menu and suggest recommendations food in Kayuputi.Show less

Author: minimim627
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: We visited here to celebrate my husband’s birthday last week. We had a great night here. The food was great, lobster risotto is superb. Great interior, the view is amazing, I love the vibe! Price is reasonable compare to KL. They surprised my husband with their lovely dessert. My hb was super happy about it! All servers are friendly and gentle, especially Alif.S did great job. He is very professional and in the same time he’s very fun. He made us feel comfortable! And I want to say thank you to a staff who made awesome bloody marry for me! Sorry I cant recall the name. My bad. I really enjoyed it so much! It was super strong as I requested! XD We will definitely visit again when we go to Langkawi! Thank you :)Show less

Author: AREVINKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: The ambiance made the difference and ofcourse the service crew Mr. Alif syazwan was very attentive and informative with the menu. Within few minutes ,there comes the complementary teh tarik birthday cake from Alif when i told him, its my wifes birthday. Not to miss complementary cocktail from the bar crew Krimeas well. Covid made no difference in human. ThanksShow less

Author: RuthZulkiflee
Title: Anniversary dinner
Review: The best. Food was good. Ambiance was good. View was perfect. The staff who attended us Aliff was very attentive, polite and proactive. Kudos to having staff like Aliff Kayuputi.Show less

Author: ShaliinPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A must try fine dining in Langkawi
Review: Ambience is great with beautiful scenery of sunset facing the sea. There are hammocks for you to enjoy your evening pre-dinner drinks overlooking the breezy sea. Thumbs up for Executive chef: Mandy Goh and everything we had for dinner were really delicious and exquisite.Highly recommended to those who wants to try something different.Show less

Author: FlixxeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful view and amazing cocktails.
Review: A place to be if you fancy watching sunset with an amazing cocktail in your hand. Tip top service. Lounge on the hanging pavilion overlooking the seas to enjoy an obstructed view of the the beautiful sunset. A big shoutout to Alif - he is passionate, friendly and knowledgable and whips up unique concoctions that will excite your tastebuds. Alif becomes animated when he explains what goes into your drink. Tell him your taste and he will surprise you with his creation. As we spent 3 nites in the hotel, Kayuputi became our spot for that 3 nites and never failed to surprise us every nite. To the management who reads this, we would like to thank and commend Alif as well as the rest of the crew for their spectacular service. Show less

Author: meeniee
Title: MOM BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION
Review: It was an amazing night to remember. We had welcomed by Sarra who had nicest smile on. We had sunset drink before proceed to the dinner. Mr Krimie serve us the best drink and had a nice talk with him about his experience in mixologist. Azwan and Alif serve us and also recommend the best menu in Kayuputi. Azwan and Sara sang a birthday song to my mom and this is the highlight. Thanks Azwan and Sarra for the pure. The view is wonderful. Food is fantastic and I personally love the Patagonian Tootfish and Panko Bacalhau. I was not had a chance to have a tour of how the restaurant was built but I will definitely come again and recommend everyone to visit this superb restaurant.Show less

Author: akcl1103Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Parfaite
Review: One of the most pleasant experience ever, all the staff are helpful and friendly, we are served by Joey and he did a very great job! Food is fantastic and I personally love the Lobster Bisque, it's rich with flavours! Thank you chefs for such a great food! Thank you everyone too!Show less

Author: naimmohsin
Title: Anniversary dinner
Review: Went there for our anniversary dinner and ordered the course meal. Overall experience was great. Chef Mandy checked on us to make sure everything is in order. The waiters, Mr Krimie, Alif, Iqa, Joey and the rest were very attentive, friendly and accomodative to us. Even had a tour of how the restaurant was built by Mr Krimie. Will definitely come again and recommend everyone to visit this superb restaurant.Show less

Author: thatcgrimm
Title: Wonderful evening ... sunset,
Review: Wonderful evening ... sunset, drinks, food and service absolutely top notch.  Executive Chef Mandy and her sous chef gave us personalized service and even arranged for a kitchen tour!

Author: Serge F
Title: Kauputi
Review: Chef Mandy terima kasih for the wonderful food from this amazing location . Keep going with your dreams for the ST REGIS kitchens.

Author: Traveller5970
Title: Amazing Views
Review:
What an amazing setting. Fabulous place to enjoy a sundowner whilst watching the sunset. 

Excellent food and wine selection but may be on the expensive side for some.

Author: jadeenep
Title: Anniversary Meal - Outstanding evening
Review: We chose this restaurant to celebrate our anniversary and wow wow wow did it over achieve on our expectations. We received a free glass of champagne when we arrived and sat on the nets over the ocean to watch the sunset. We also had some cocktails which were delicious. We then went inside and sat with a sea view and tucked into incredible food with the most amazing service. We were even given an extra glass of champagne and a free dessert on the house and the head chef came and made sure everything was okay for us at the end of the night. We were devastated to leave, it was truly the most perfect evening and we will be back. Thank you so much for making our evening so very special. Show less

Author: jcilius
Title: Great staff, service, drinks,
Review: Great staff, service, drinks, and food at great location overlooking sea and fabulous sunset. Best in area - and Langkawi?

Author: lovesusaStockton Heath, United Kingdom
Title: Mandy Goh is a star!!
Review: Went here first of all for the bar above the water next to the restaurant. We were so impressed by the service and information given to us by (I think this is his name, sorry if I have it wrong) Jolie. A very well mannered gentleman in the bar and how passionate he was about their restaurant that we decided to book it for our last evening, 2 nights later. The cocktails were gorgeous, the spot is fantastic and so pretty and nothing was too much trouble.2 nights later we were back for pre dinner cocktails and it was just like the choc eclair ad we almost melted with relaxation and enjoyment! We have eaten in some fabulous restaurants around the world and this is up there with the best. We went for the Journey tasting menu. There is a smaller option and the 7 course one and we decided to go for the larger one as we were assured that portions were not too large. Oh went for the wine pairing version.Had the usual amuse bouche and then a lovely small loaf with a marmalade cream - yummy. The starter of mudcrabs was exquisite. Didn't know what to expect from this but what a wonderful start to the whole experience. Mandy, the chef, came to talk to us after this and was very helpful in how I could adapt this myself. One of the ingredients isn't generally available for me so I was delighted to have a small giftbag at the end of the meal with 2 vials for me to take home!The barman from our first evening came to see us to check we were enjoying ourselves. All these touches make you feel that they really care what you think and how you are enjoying yourself.We had a wonderful, wonderful evening. The cheese course came on the biggest cheeseboard ever and was served, as in France, before the pudding course. It was expensive but so worth it and beautiful memories of our last evening in Langkawi. Buggy transfer back to the Westin and then bed!Show less

Author: Louise L
Title: Beautiful spot
Review: We had great cocktails at the most amazing sunset spot. Service was great, but the food was okay. I would definitely go for the view.

Author: 4RBSKuah, Malaysia
Title: Space to eat in privacy ...
Review: Excellent menu in a beautiful setting overlooking the Straits of Malacca. All sea p food and good wines - expensive, but you’re getting what you are paying for. Two taster menus, one vegetarian, with a bar at the far end of a stilted property approached by an extended walkway above the water. The high ceilings and unique decor make for a special evening. Lobster bisque was excellent! Will return ...Show less

Author: SambaSydneyBrisbane, Australia
Title: Langkawi’s Best Restaurant
Review: This is the signature restaurant at the St Regis, Langkawi and a memorable experience. From the sunset cocktail to the tasty dishes it is a journey ably assisted by willing and competent staff. Under the leadership of Executive chef Mandy Goh, it is a gastronomic winner!Show less

Author: Craige1959London, United Kingdom
Title: Unexpected, breathtaking, a must!
Review: We are currently staying on the island at the Ritz Carlton and I asked the concierge to recommend a couple of alternative restaurants outside of our own hotel. This was one of several that was recommended and after reading reviews we went ahead and booked it.Firstly the setting is beautiful, set out on the water giving great news back to the hotel and very attractive and comfortable seating arrangements.We perused what was a very mouthwatering menu and decided to treat ourselves. We started with half a dozen oysters to have with our pre-dinner drink. They came with an in-house Bloody Mary sauce that with the oysters was outstanding and a great start.We then had individual starters, both of which could not be faulted. For the main course we had decided to share the seabass that was prepared in front of us ahead of serving. We have both had seabass numerous times before but this without question was the best we’ve ever had.Normally we do not have room for dessert, but last night was an exception with my partner having a chocolate desert and I decided to have a selection of excellent soft cheeses.The following morning I was still talking about our meal and without doubt it is one of the best I have ever had and I highly recommend this venue to anyone visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: mizzkteeNumurkah, Australia
Title: Breathtaking
Review: This restaurant was fabulous - we ended up eating here three times on our holiday. superb service and beautiful surroundings and simply amazing food. The food has been lovingly prepared with a blend of flavors and textures. If you love your food and enjoy fine wine or cocktails in beautiful surroundings you can’t go wrong here.Show less

Author: TallyHo_8
Title: Romantic sunset cocktails
Review:
Romantic sunset cocktails in an unparalleled location. Private with very attentive service.
#amazing

Author: AHA2006New York City, New York
Title: Spicy risotto?
Review: We came in as a big group and I cannot speak for everyone. Most of us ordered 3-4 courses. The lobster bisque was well done, and so as the Hokkaido scallops. I ordered a fish dish with risotto for my mother who cannot take very spicy food, and duck w/ truffle for myself. The risotto turned out to be very spicy so my mom had to trade her dish w/ me. Spicy risotto wasn't what I would expect from such dish. The dessert was ok, with puffs served dry. The ambiance is top notch, but not the food, unfortunately. We appreciate executive chef Goh came out to greet us with all sincerity. However, there's room for improvement.Show less

Author: juliancQ1965UBMiami, Florida
Title: Could have been amazing
Review: This is one of the best looking restaurants that I’ve ever seen. The view, the white wood, just amazing all around. If we visit again, we’ll have cocktails here and eat off property. Ambience: 5 out of 5Taste: 3 out of 5Portion Size: lolShow less

Author: Hemant_Ggn
Title: Beautiful setting for a meal
Review: Went there but found it very expensive. So did not try the food. However looks really nice. Maybe will try once?

Author: pInK1402Malaysia
Title: Perfect dinner date
Review: We had a stay at Westin but having dinner at Kayu Puti. They are under same management group, you can bill your meal to room at Westin (if you stay at westin). We decided to pick our own menu instead of course that recommended by the Chef/ menu. The chef mix between western, Asia and Japanese taste. I would say this is beyond superb! Eventually we are a bit sceptical about the menu, but turn out the taste WERY WELL and beyond than those fine dining from KL. What to order? I would not write here what we ordered, please try to suit your taste and preference . Oh ya, not to mention the waiter and waitress are super friendly too! I highly recommend this fine dining restaurant when you’re at Langkawi. They make our date unforgettable....for wedding anniversary. 5 star for the food and service. Highly recommended and sure will be back.Show less

Author: Masked-CaperLos Angeles, California
Title: Superb ambience. Terrible food
Review: The ambience is brilliant. The drinks were good. Service was by amateurs. They couldn’t follow the requests. Very high priced but the Entree quantities are probably the smallest portions I have seen in the world. Food served lukewarm. Cooked too fast and the chicken was tough. The fish on the menu says it takes 30 mins to make but in reality they said it would take an hour and half! The menu and the reality are very different. Terrible taste. But the presentation of the food is very good. You can definitely come during sunset for drinks and clearly avoid the dinner menu. Show less

Author: diiaannxSan Francisco, California
Title: Go for drinks, do not stay for dinner
Review: We were staying at the St. Regis so we thought, wow so convenient that there was such a well reviewed restaurant on premises. If you've been to Hawaii, I was hoping it would be Merriman's but Asian. I would give doing cocktails outside 5 stars. Unfortunately the food 1/5. If I was given the option to have the meal I had for free, I would have opted for something else on the island. It felt like a waste of a meal in a country with incredible food.  Why was it bad? Lack of flavor and consistency in the flavor. For example, we had some duck, where there was whole gradient of saltiness int he pieces. On the veggie end of the spectrum, the pea dish was very bland even if it's meant to be a more subtle dish.Add insult to injury, the coursing was also incredibly slow. We were tired and hoping to get on with our evening. I also loathe wasting food so we ate everything and didn’t complain. At the end, someone on the staff said something along the lines of oh you ate everything so you must have liked everything. NOPE! I’m accepting of mediocre food if you have great ambiance. The ambiance outside is great, but dinner is only served inside. The decor also is a bit of a head-scratcher. Cowhide chair in a beach vibe place?Come for drinks and enjoy the hammock during sunset but do not stay for dinner...Show less

Author: Davemc60
Title: Now Favorite Restaurant
Review: The most beautiful restaurant. From laying on the suspended trampolines over the water with a champagne to the sensational food and wonderful service this is  a special place. The decor is amazing. Can't wait to return.

Author: patrickB3805ZBAarburg, Switzerland
Title: Very romantic
Review: My fiancé and I ate here to celebrate our engagement. The restaurant was very private and romantic. The staff were very well trained and very friendly. They have an open kitchen where you can watch as your food gets prepared. I even had the honor and pleasure to exchange a few words with chef Mandy who came out of her way to say hello and explain her philosophy of cooking. The food is very creative. Don’t expect big sizes of dishes and be prepared to pay the price of such high class cuisine! Show less

Author: cecechelseaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great and friendly service by the staff
Review: Went twice - first time to make a booking (but it did not materialize as we got into a little mishap earlier during the day) and second time by chance as we took a walk after dinner. Alexander (the restaurant manager) has been so kind. As I was feeling rather unwell and requested for something out of the menu - ginger tea. He promptly prepared a freshly grated ginger tea with Langkawi honey on the side. It soothed my gastric almost immediately and I’m so thankful for that. Staff have been incredibly friendly and kind too. We really enjoyed our stay there and hope to visit the restaurant for dinner soon.Show less

Author: lizziem27
Title: Wonderful experience - very special!
Review: Lovely sunset views, great service and our food was great. Fine dining experience, go for a special occasion!!!

Author: russellcjmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre food, good service
Review: We had dinner at KayuPuti at the St. Regis last evening as it was my parents' wedding anniversary.We found the food to be rather mediocre (each course took rather long to serve), and the portions were relatively small as well. The service at the restaurant was quite a hit or miss. When we first arrived, we headed outside to lounge and catch the sunset. We were asked multiple times whether we wanted to get drinks, and it felt almost like we were forced to order. This was slightly off-putting. As such we decided to order a drink, but *it was never served*, but was still billed to us at the end of the evening when we received our bill for the dinner. This was a rather unpleasant experience.However, some of the service staff was quite attentive as well. After they heard my family toast to my parents' anniversary, they discreetly asked one of us whether we were celebrating something, and a small dessert was served to us at the end of our diner. This was a very pleasant surprise and a very kind gesture that spoke of excellent service.Would probably return for drinks and to catch the sunset outside as it was really rather gorgeous, but the food at dinner was quite average and we felt it did not really justify the price point.Show less

Author: Syafinaz Vani R
Title: Wonderful dinner experience
Review: The atmosphere, service and the food is amazing. Top notch on every aspect. Looking forward to my next visit already! :)

Author: OMGPOPHong Kong, China
Title: Best sunset at Langkawi and amazing dinner
Review: Came to Kayu Putih for wedding anniversary.Was greeted by hostress and proceed to the outdoor area for sunset.After the sunset was seated in an area facing the sea for dinner.Took the journey menu and enjoyed the whole dining experience. Special thanks to John and Alex for good recommendations and services provided.Show less

Author: snfield_33Sydney, Australia
Title: Wonderful Experience
Review: We visited for dinner and had a wonderful experience. The views from both the bar and the restaurant were amazing. The food was incredible and delicious. Would highly recommend a visit whether you’re staying at the St Regis where it is located or somewhere else. We were staying elsewhere but we’re very glad we made the trip ☺️Show less

Author: 227ChristopherG
Title: Great dinner
Review: This restaurant was gorgeous situated out of the water even though it was raining when we went. Staff, food and wine were all excellent, definitely recommend if you want a special night out.

Author: mrapini
Title: simply gorgeous
Review: you cannot miss sunset drinks, continue with a top quality dinner with an excellent selection of wines at a reasonable price considering the standing of the place

Author: varunaja
Title: Lovely experience, excellent location
Review: Built on top of poles, the place is in the sea. The views are breathtaking and the architecture is very colonial and artistic.The staff is good and attentive and food quality is excellent. Highly recommended for an evening dinner and you must start while the sun is setting. The views are really fantastic.Show less

Author: Lisa CHobart, Australia
Title: Must do
Review: We celebrated my husbands birthday here while staying at the Westin next to the St Regis. The food and drinks and the service plus the view and the ambiance are a definite “must do” if staying on Langkawi. Definitely one of the best nights of my life. Show less

Author: CraigHWSouth Australia
Title: Another level
Review: Our Langkawi experiences are either average local, good local or good international. Kayu Puti is good international.The setting is fantastic, the service excellent and the menu gives a good cross section of choices.we chose duck and red snapper for mains and we were both very happy. My wife had the coconut (about 3 different ways) and really enjoyed it. The meal was expensive as was the drink list.It was worthwhile for our last night at St RegisShow less

Author: Robert-Jan TBrussels, Belgium
Title: Sensational
Review: We enjoyed the discovery menu at the Kayu Piti restaurant and it was a sensational journey of all kind of local dishes. I am surprised this restaurant does not have a Michelin star as it definitely deserves one. The experience starts with an outside sunset drink in one of the hammocks. The DJ gives the sunset a special touch. The experience continued with a nice sea view table inside. All dishes were displayed very tasteful and the way the bread was presented I have never seen before. The staff was very attentive and gave us a superb feeling of hospitality. Overall a superb experience to finish our stay at the St Regis. Show less

Author: 77Sunny77UK
Title: Perfect for a special evening
Review: We were celebrating a special occasion & so pleased we chose Kayu Puti to have dinner! We saw the tips about arriving just before sunset so we could sit out on the over water beds for a cocktail. Perfect. We originally went with the intention of getting ‘The Journey’ tasting menu. However they had a different menu on the night we went (see photo) so that’s what was on offer. All the staff were amazing - SO attentive and made us feel special, with touches such as giving us an extra dessert to share (which was DELICIOUS) and also two glasses of champagne at the end of our night. It was so lovely to finish it off in this way and mark our special occasion. Food was great, we love seafood so it was a perfect menu for us. The presentation of each dish was a particular highlight. We regularly eat out in fine dining restaurants and would definitely recommend this restaurant for the standard of food, beautiful location and excellent staff. We were staying at the Westin hotel just 5 mins walk away, and just as we were leaving, a thunderstorm started. The staff will call you a buggy to take you back :-)Show less

Author: paulmX8109HX
Title: Enjoyable Evening
Review: We arrived at sunset and watched the sun go down, sipping cocktails and listening to some funky ambient DJ tunes...beautiful and relaxing. The menu had something for everyone, with western and traditional foods. Between us we ordered seafood and pasta, everything was cooked to perfection. Meals were perfectly paced allowing time to enjoy the beautiful surroundings. Staff were attentive, friendly and fun. Thank you for a memorable evening. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: WellTravelled1810London, United Kingdom
Title: Just Amazing
Review: My wife and I visited here twice on our holiday in February as it was just so good. The first time we sat on the sails and had some fizz whilst watching the setting sun and it was just magical, bringing tears to my wife's eyes. Our second visit was to eat in the restaurant and it was equally as good as the food is on a par with that served in the best restaurants in London. It is not cheap, but it is truely worth the money and was a real highlight of our holiday and we will return when we are next in Langkawi.Show less

Author: NopainNogain88Lagos, Nigeria
Title: simply amazing
Review: by far the best restaurant's experience not only on Langkawi, but in the entire Malaysia. From the food, to the beverage to the setting...but mostly the staff: well trained, skillful, they make you feel like at home. Very attentive but never intrusive.Thumb up to Chef Gaetan and the rest of the crew. Keep it up!Show less

Author: BizT
Title: Absolutely Divine
Review: The Chef is a genius. Everything we ordered was absolutely wonderful. Flavours were amazing - fish - duck - carpaccio - rissoto, and the desserts! You have to experience fine dining at it’s best. Without doubt one of the best restaurants in the Malaysia.

Author: Sasu123
Title: The highlight of Langkawi
Review: This place is so magical, I kind of don’t want to write this review but it is so incredibly deserving. The whole experience from start to finish is world class from the service, food, drinks, location, decor and atmosphere is outstanding. It’s our little bit of heaven!Show less

Author: fionajmoloneyWagga Wagga, Australia
Title: Beautiful
Review: My partner and I dined here while staying at the St Regis and were blown away by the food, the service and the exquisite service and setting. We had the tasting menu with matching wines. While it is expensive by Malaysian standards, it was faultless and could not recommend it more highlyShow less

Author: Dr_Ozzwoldo
Title: Doesnt get better than this in Langkawi
Review: Beautiful views, good sunset, good menu offerings, and great coffee. Overall, a memorable experience

Author: Frederick K
Title: Romatic Restaurant , best for sunset view
Review:
We had drinks at Kayu Puti Restaurant , sitting on the hammock facing sunset view.
Wonderful and memorable evening with excellent service.

Author: aussielivinthelifeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Beautiful Restaurant in a Perfect Setting. Good but not Great!
Review: Our pre-dinner drink on the over the water tarps was a great way to start a fantastic night of dining. We had a glass of champagne and a whisky neat. A busy place for sunset drinks.We decided to go a la carte rather than the degustation menu. The seared Hokkaido scallops were cooked to perfection. We shared the Roasted Pumpkin Tortellini, which did not have a whole lot of flavour.For mains we had the Andaman Red Snapper which was very good with the purple sweet potato coconut, pineapple and laksa sauce, and the Larnaudie Duck Moulard, which my partner thought was rather average.We have been to some amazing restaurants in our own state, Hentley Farm, Penfolds Magill Estate, Orana, as well as overseas. Unfortunately, the Kayu Puti Langkawi did not pull up a 5 star meal with 5 star pricing. Our meal and a bottle of wine (not an expensive one, although they start at $100), was $350AUD which did not reflect the quality of food.The service was outstanding and the location superb. Show less

Author: SychimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Gorgeous setting
Review: The pier restaurant at the St Regis, Kayu Puti offers a magical experience in a beautiful setting. If you go at dusk, the experience is amplified. Service was excellent all round, very warm, welcoming and personal. Special kudos to all staff members. Food is western/fusion style with an emphasis on local ingredients. Presentation was gorgeous but not everything worked. Not that they were bad but they lacked excitement and texture. Also, be prepared to pay fine dining prices. But for a special occasion or on vacation, it's worth it to splurge a little here.Show less

Author: GSUKKENTLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, excellent service and outstanding menu
Review: An amazingly good restaurant. The location is stunning, the staff are very personable and friendly - but not over the top - and the food is excellent. The “Journey” tasting menu was international but fresh and original drawing on ingredients from Langkawi. We travelled from another resort c 20 minutes away; definitely worth the effort. It is expensive but the quality makes it worthwhile - not sure there is anything else this good on the island.Show less

Author: KJW2406Noosa, Australia
Title: Unforgettable experience in amazing location.
Review: As guests at St Regis Langkawi, we were keen to try Kayu Puti as we had read many glowing reviews. To our great delight our experience more than surpassed our expectations. The flavours of the food, fresh local produce (including the unique fermented slightly sour flavour of Langkawi black bee honey) and skills of Chef's kitchen team combined to create a meal we will not forget in a hurry. Lim, our very knowledgeable and friendly waiter, went out of his way to make sure our evening was perfect, and talking to him about local black bee honey production was very informative. I must also make special mention of Wulan, a young lady with a bright future in hospitality. And don't miss the stunning sunset views from the outdoor hammocks for pre-dinner drinks, absolutely spectacular! Kayu Puti is a true credit to the St Regis brand.Show less

Author: taagy2019Burleigh Heads, Australia
Title: Beautiful food, atmosphere and scenery
Review: We went twice to this restuarant as we were staying at the St Regis Resort. First we just went for a cocktail on the hammocks. What a special place to watch the sunset. Must do when you are here. Then we went back for dinner and the food was just beautiful. Only complaint from my husband was it needed more scallops for the entree. Having only 2 for the price, was a little disappointing. But the flavours and our choices were beautiful. Show less

Author: ID0612Sydney, Australia
Title: Five star experience with breathtaking surroundings
Review: Our family of five dined here on our last night as guests at the St Regis. We were so delighted with the attention to detail at every stage of our dinner, from the fresh bread served on hot stones before our entrees right down to the decadent desserts, one of which we were served complimentarily! The staff are the most professional, attentive and warm people. The food is as perfect as it looks in the photos. Absolutely loved the gift of asam pedas salt on our way out - a gorgeous touch and a wonderful memory to bring home.Show less

Author: Chatan123Woking, United Kingdom
Title: Just take in the view
Review: We visited this amazing restaurant just fir sunset drinks. And i have to be honest the sunset view is absokutely amazing. Simply breath taking.We sat out on a trampoline type seat ( no other way of describing it) and to watch the sun set over the ocean is amazing. The pictures will tell you more tha i can with words !!!!Show less

Author: skdcitravellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Sundowner extravaganza
Review: Cocktails at dusk in comfort whilst watching the sunset with with vivid shades of red, pink, yellow....you name it! Get there at 6.30 pm for seat, drinks, nibbles, music & the over water light show. If staying at the Westin just book at concierge and they will take you the on the buggy. Take your camera!Show less

Author: Jess187520Sydney, Australia
Title: Beautiful and Intricate Fine Dining
Review: Thank you to Chef Gaetan and his team. Staying off site we were strongly recommended to try Kayu Puti and as foodies we had high expectations. These were not only met, but exceeded. Kayu Puti is more than just a restaurant, it is a full experience. From delicate cocktails on the deck watching the sunset, to the luxurious furnishings of the dining room, there is nothing to fault with this venue. Every detail is well thought through, the display of bread and butter and every course that followed was interesting, highly unique and an amazing combination of flavours. All this topped by fantastic service. What a pleasant experience, if not staying at the St. Regis, then it is definitely worth the visit.Thank you again!!Show less

Author: OrionOneGlobalSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best restaurant at the St Regis, just leave you kids at home
Review: This restaurant is the fine dining restaurant for the resort and it was the best for dinner and drinks. The one thing for parents to note is the deserts for kids are 45RM for fruit and ice cream and an adult desert was 50RM. The adult desert was a piece of art and the kids was a handful of fruit and a dab of ice cream, go figure?Show less

Author: ClaireW3699
Title: Amazing resturant with top notch service and ambience
Review:
Staff (Alexander) was very attentive and warm. They were very attentive to my food intolerances and took the imitative to replace any ingredients that contained gluten etc. 

The sunset views on the hammock were amazing...! It’s truly an unique and immaculate experience.

Author: EmiliaKMGNew York City, New York
Title: Genius at play 🌟
Review: Culinary Experience is the star highlight of staying at this resort: Chef Gaetan has brilliantly curated the most delicious experience for your taste buds in all 3 restaurants. Kayu Puti is a must - Chef Gaetan genius' playground. Using local herbs and spices, he infuses each dish with his imagination, skillfully reinventing it. I highly recommend chosing a predesigned  menu and have Chef Gaetan take you on a magical journey through his couture culinary creations. I'm truly surprised that Kayu Puti doesn't have a Micheline star The experience that we had was incredible, 10 times better than some restaurants with a Micheline Any critics, if you are reading this, you gotta take a trip to Kayu Puti. (Tough job, but somebody's gotta do it )All 3 restaurants, including the beach grill will delight your senses. And,  this place (the resort) has the best macaroons *On a side note: the decor and the ambiance of this place is pretty special. Magical sunsets turn into romantic candlelit dinners, surrounded by wonderful art and special antiques. Guys, if you are looking for the perfect spot to do something special, this is it Show less

Author: momdad5kidsOttawa, Canada
Title: Best food and scenery in Langkawi
Review: My husband and I enjoyed our last dinner in Langkawi at Kayu puti. We were greeted and attended like royalty throughout the evening. We arrived around 6pm and were the first one there. We got to sit outdoors on the net and enjoyed multiples cocktails there all of them delicious. The live band was amazing and the whole experience felt out of this world. For dinner, we decided to eat inside and it was just as beautiful as outdoors. Everyone would make sure that we had everything we needed and they were very attentive to our needs. Moving on to the food...WOW. Incredible food from appetizer to dessert. Great selection, presentation and just melts in your mouth. We were sad that we didn’t eat there 1 or 2 other nights while in Langkawi. Definitely a place not to miss while in Langkawi. We will be back. Thanks to all the staff and to chef G! Love, from Canada. Show less

Author: ascotchrisAscot, United Kingdom
Title: Special trip to eat here
Review: We first ate at Kayu Puti last November whilst staying elsewhere in Langkawi and just loved the food and experience.So much so,when we made a snap decision to have a week end away we flew from KL to Langkawi just so we could dine here.The restaurant is both quirky and stunning. The food, from the enormously talented Gaetan and his team is equally stunning.The service and ambience are perfectly managed by the lovely Prem and her professional and welcoming team.Prior to dinner, the open air cocktail bar is also recommended with its adventurous drinks and fabulous views. Again, a nice, warm experience.Our second visit here more than lived up to the first and we can't wait to go again.Show less

Author: FeliciaR184Ireland
Title: Poor Service
Review: We had made a reservation for Saturday night but noticed that they had a mid week special set menu and decided to try it on Thursday as well. After enjoyed a cocktail on the sun hammocks we were escorted to our table and our waiters introduced themselves, a head waiter and a trainee. Included in the set menu was a blood orange cocktail which was nice and we were also give an amuse-bouche. There had been a group at the hotel which one of the staff mentioned were GMs and when they entered the restaurant our experience took a turn for the worse. Our waiters both moved to their section without any notice to us. Our final course was served to us by a hostess (she was very nice but your waiters should not disappear and it was not busy enough to even amuse an excuse). They literally did not return to our table at all during the meal and we waited too long to get someone’s attention for the bill. In the end we were so put off by the blatant ‘favoritism’ for lack of a better term that we canceled our Saturday reservation. The food was good but when it comes to fine dining the service is half of the experience. Even at a normal restaurants would be inappropriate for another waiter to take over unless the first was actually leaving and this would warrant an apology and introduction of the new waiter. I would suggest giving it a go as the food is nice but other restaurants at the hotel have superior service and equally fine cuisine.Show less

Author: Dot1972Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: 70th birthday celebration
Review: My husband booked ourselves and two friends for my birthday meal as a surprise for me on our last night before returning home. As soon as we arrived we are told that it would be best for us as it may be noisy around the bar area for 10 -15 minutes as a very large party of people arrived after us all descended on the area, presumably to enjoy the view and obviously a convention or something . My husband and friends husband pointed out that part of the reason we booked was to view the sunset from the deck and not sit inside until said party left and refused to move inside. The manager then asked other people to move around a large sofa area so we could be a accomadated. His attitude was very oh well and no offer of a free drink or anything because he could see we were by then very annoyed.We were finally led to our table and from then on we were treated very professionally by staff.Said manager did come back to table and said he thought it was better for us to be away from “noise” as though we were really ancient ,and yes I know I was celebrating my 70th birthday but then he laughed and at this point our friend told him he weren’t laughing and we didn’t see him again all night .Food,service all excellent but definitely left a sour taste in our mouths as I’m sure he thought we were only there for the view and only came over then because we were actually spending some money in this 6 star restaurant. As I said before his attitude could have been so much nicer and professional even offering a token drink would have eased the tension .Beautiful setting and decorations and superb food but not a mention of my birthday even though they were informed why hubby made the booking .Would recommend it just don’t go if they have a big delegation arrive !Rating would have been five but for attitude of mamagerShow less

Author: chintan vSingapore, Singapore
Title: Loved it
Review: Go early in the evening, have their mixologist Karimi (Or Creamy-sorry if I didn’t get the name right) prepare you one of his magic concoctions from the Gin trolley to start off , enjoy the amazing sunset and follow up with a delectable meal prepared by Chef Gaetan and his team. Amazing location and ambience with refined food and drinks to match.Show less

Author: brown4682
Title: Wonderful birthday dinner!
Review: Thank you Kayuputi Team in arranging a wonderful birthday dinner for us! We started off the evening by chilling on the hammocks. It was very relax and beautiful sunset. We then proceed to the dinner, it was an awesome experience with great food and attentive hospitality. Special thank you to The Venue Manager Prem and her team, not forgetting the Culinary Team as well. Last but not least, thank you Jat for arranging it for us. Kudos! #LiveExquisite #Luxury#BestAddress#Bespoke Show less

Author: HM_from_NHHanover, New Hampshire
Title: Wow!
Review: Wow! is an understatement.The setting is spectacular — an overwater restaurant with breathtaking views (particularly at sunset). The interior of the restaurant is beautifully decorated as well.The food was extraordinary, both in terms of its flavor as well as its elegant presentation. Everything we ordered was outstanding, but if I had to single out one item, it would be the cod. Don’t miss it. And make sure you leave room for dessert!The staff are beyond wonderful. The prices are not cheap, but a meal of similar quality would be significantly more expensive back home.It’s hard to imagine a nicer dining experience. Highly recommended!!Show less

Author: JanineMohamed73Canberra, Australia
Title: De’vine
Review: Loved loved our Journey Menu at this amazingly located restaurant. We arrived to have a cocktail on the decking with live music. You have the option to lay down in sails which are suspended over the ocean- we didn’t, but it looks good. The mountains and islands are amazing to watch change colour as the sunsets.We were seated in some special and unique chairs which kind of explains our experience. The service was attentive and well timed. Alexander was knowledgeable about world wine and we had a trainee assist us which was nice to see this establishment was happy to declare and train new people. A great experience for the memory bank.Show less

Author: Erika RParabiago, Italy
Title: Amazing dinner
Review: We had dinner here during our stay at the St Regis. We also celebrated our anniversary and the staff and most of all the chef Gaetan were so nice with us making everything special. The food was great, really fine cuisine and top quality ingredients. The atmosphere was amazing too. And last but not least the pineapple daiquiri was the best I have ever had.Show less

Author: LornaRoseW
Title: An eating Experience
Review: Wonderful venue over the water on stilts, fabulous interiors and furniture and bar, food is a tasting delight, but as with these types of restaurants, you could leave hungry !! The St. Regis hotel is great.

Author: 656sidneyr
Title: Fantastic Meal and Great Service
Review: We had a great meal at Kayu Puti on our final night in Langkawi. The service was great. Thanks so much for the complimentary champagne. Thanks to Alex and the staff for making this a memorable meal. Yes, it is fine dining and so the prices reflect this but we felt that it was more than worth it. No hesitation in recommending thus restaurant. Show less

Author: Educat2018
Title: Five star dining before a top shelf jazz night
Review: Periodically St Regis hosts wonderful jazz nights with brilliant well known jazz musicians. My wife and I are huge fans of St Regis and especially Kayu Puti (White wood).

Author: WonderGeySingapore, Singapore
Title: Highlight of St Regis, Wow !
Review: If we were to come back to St Regis Langkawi again, the reason will be Kayu Puti. Nice little pier to watch the sunset while sipping the local inspired Bloody Mary “Lang-Mary”. We had 2 course a-la cart dinner at the restaurant after the sunset. Truly amazing experience. Love the Asam Pedas tomato (local flavours) to go with turmeric bread. What a new and yet familiar Malaysians flavour. Amuse bouche was a smart way of using local malay snack topped with Rojak. This was the first time we were so looking forward to what appetiser might taste like after the bread and amuse bouche. Chef used the local ingredients and flavours smartly without masking them with too much “western” techniques. It is truly Malaysian fine dining at its best for me. New flavours, Creative presentation, it was a really enjoyable dinner for our palates. Well worth the money! Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Wendy07byrne
Title: Amaaaaaaazing!!
Review:
Absolutely loved the food, the atmosphere, the decor, the spectacular views, and the staff were incredible!!!!!
Well worth the value in our opinions xxx

Author: mgiulieriSanta Rosa, California
Title: Sunset and dinner
Review: My wife and I had a notable dinner on our first night. The restaurant is at the end of a pier with a beautiful view. We had a couple glasses of champagne and enjoyed the journey into dusk. While the sunset was not spectacular, the view is special and highly recommended. The use of their hammocks is a nice touch as well. For dinner we had the tasting menus—Discovery for me and Vegetarian for my wife. Both were very good—we recommend. The service is excellent and very helpful. They serve a couple of breads that are also very nice. Show less

Author: 13AstroboyGreater Melbourne, Australia
Title: very romantic
Review: What an outstanding location set on stilts in the water where you can have drinks at the outdoor bar on trampoline style seating or on couches, watching the sun set. You dont have to eat here , can just have drinks but we had a meal and its worth the experience. The meals are typically small but very well presented and very tasty (and expensive) definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: F8331DSfabiosKuah, Malaysia
Title: That’s really AMAZING
Review: First of all, the location: incredible overwater colonial building with superbe decoration and stunning view....Then: a super charming, creative and passionate executive chef, Gaetan Biesuz; with a top chef de cuisine and a wonderful local team. Result: we had dinner in this fantastic restaurant tre times in 5 days, which is the absolute confirmation of a “solid” place to have an extraordinary food experience. Great choice of raw materials, careful search on regional influences, superbe execution.We travel a lot and we can suggest this as one of those places in which you come and then you come back and then again to try all a la carte menu. Well done Gaetan, well done St. Regis. Show less

Author: Greeny18London
Title: Kayu Puti
Review: Lim who we met at lunchtime at the hotel sorted out a delicious Italian wine for dinner and we were set . Friendly and knowledgeable service in a stunning setting . The Red Snapper was beautiful...Thank you Kayu Puti team .More of the DJ less piped music please ...Show less

Author: mcnamee11Oxford, United Kingdom
Title: Welcome back
Review: My host was Eprem she surprise me by asking my likes then, i arrive in evening i get no menu because she arrange perfect meal form me. the staff here are excellent they always look after me i look forward to going back again. the bar is excellet cocktails are perfectShow less

Author: richardLKTSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful restaurant
Review: Wasn't expecting much but was very impressed with the view/scenery, the sunset, the level of service and the quality of the food.Our server Dean took great care of us, made good menu suggestions and even helped us take beautiful photos! If you are going during busy season. Make reservations to avoid disappointment. Come around sunset time to enjoy the sunset view. The food was delicious and some of the food creations were truly unique. Well done Chef!Show less

Author: FCR_BayernLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Impressive scenery
Review: Went there fairly skeptical of fancy restaurants on tropical islands. Left very impressed:- went for the a la carte options. One starter and one main left me as a good eater very full. - menu looked great. - wine selection is wide and fairly prices with cheapest bottles around 30 usd- service was very good- make sure to come with closed shoes- cocktail bat with over-water hammocks is one of the most scenic bars i have experienced- cocktails around 16 usd and very big- French chef served our main courses- for an evening plan to spend at least 90 usd a person which is way above local prices but you also get an outstanding dinner experience - spg platinums get 20% which can be a lot of money... also make sure to get the points at this can be another 10% cashbackDinner only served inside. Restaurant is airconditioned so make sure to wear something not too light (wink wink to the ladies)Show less

Author: TigerLibraAspen, Colorado
Title: Superb meal - But spoiled by pushy insistence for Trip Advisor review
Review: Five stars for the gracious staff, and excellent location, ambiance, decor, presentation and above all superb, innovative and tasty food. Expensive, and worth it.One star off for, on hand using paper straws in the cocktails, but then also including a plastic stirrer. When I asked if they used the stirrers again, I was told they just throw them away. If you are going to "go green" please take it seriously and commit to STOPPING the use on one-time-use-plastic.Worse, however, the experience was seriously marred at the end of the meal. We were presented with an oversized "gift" bag that contained a small glass bottle of flavored salt, a thank you card from the chef and staff, and a small card with a QR code asking for a review on Trip Advisor. We decided to accept the "gift" of the salt, but did not want to be wasteful (the bag was way out of proportion to the contents) and declined the bag with the cards inside. The staff took the bag back, but then pulled out the TripAdvisor card and handed it back to us. Not wanting to be rude, we accepted it. Perhaps the "gift" bag was a bribe of sorts to get the receiver to write a good review? In this case, it seriously backfired. One would think an establishment like the St. Regis does not need TripAdvisor reviews to stay in business. By reducing themselves to pandering for reviews, they took the shine off an otherwise stellar dining experience. Go there for the lovely staff, the five-star food and experience, ask for your cocktail without a plastic stirrer, and politely decline the "gift".(PS. To the management, if you read this, may I suggest that this experience has nothing to do with the individual server, and everything to do with management.)Show less

Author: adeline_potterCanberra, Australia
Title: Amazing service and beautiful view
Review: The ambience of Kayu Puti is in unbeatable, and the atmosphere and service from the staff is certainly beyond compare. The overwater view is beautiful and a drink at the balcony or on the hammock is the perfect way to relax! The food is also delicious and we had an enjoyable time on our last night at St Regis, but I did feel that it was not particularly outstanding, as we have experienced fine dining at other locations where the food was amazing. However, I would recommend Kayu Puti for the overall experience.Show less

Author: OutiMKHelsinki, Finland
Title: The perfect sunset and dinner spot!
Review: Visit Kayu Puti! Totally a 5/5 star experience.We stayed at St Regis Resort and had dinner at Kayu Puti twice. Amazing spot, great atmosphere, food and vibes. We watched the sunset on the terrace and after that had the tasting menu and it was perfect.Show less

Author: Renee M
Title: Absolutely fabulous
Review: We had a cocktail here for 6 evenings, watching the sunset from the hammock balconies, while listening to the live entertainment, and being attended to by all the lovely staff, especially Sarah. On our last night at St Regis, we had a meal at this restaurant. It was delicious, elegantly presented, and the staff and surroundings were lovely. A memorable experience. We’ll be back.Show less

Author: shakilaTagariPreston, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing resturant
Review: E. K. Prem and her team have an amazing hidden gem if a resturant. Great food. Second to none service. Reasonably priced food which not does only look great but tastes great too. One can not come to langkawi and not come to this resturant !!! Great team.. great hospitality .. a little piece of paradise .. Thank you Prem and your staff. Sorry its taken me awhile to write the review .. as a successful business woman free time is only when im on holiday .. what ever these guys are paid, its not enough compared to the great service and fond memories i still have after 2 months .. miss you prem ..Show less

Author: MartinH641Coventry, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: This restaurant is part of the St Regis resort. The dining is very elegant and has a sophisticated feel to it, the bar is over the water and is a great place to start or finish your dinner The menu is fairly extensive and everything we tasted was exceptional, the scallops particularly but also the snapper. Dessert was a must, very pretty and heavenly to taste Show less

Author: AliSeaAhh
Title: Excellent!
Review: Everything was EXCELLENT! The food here was just amazing!! The servers were also impeccable. My only fault is the portion sizes were too small!! I wanted more!! Nonetheless, I can't recommend this place enough!! Try it!!

Author: 336stevenjMelbourne, Australia
Title: When you really want to impress
Review: Kaye Puti is the premium dining experience at St Regis Langkawi.There are a bunch of highlights to consider in the experience:1. Get to the deck early enough to settle in for the sunset - either in an overwater hammock or comfy chairs2. Try the customised gin experience where the mixologist will create something to your specific taste profile3. Settle in for an amazing degustation experience and travel around the region with your tastebuds.Once again the chefs led by Executive Chef Gaetan are engaged in the whole process and take the time to personally explain each dish whenever they can.The wait staff are exemplary - Lim is a gem.A wonderful experience in the middle of our honeymoon and a highlight at the end.Show less

Author: starcat20
Title: Divine
Review: We had a great experience here. First we enjoyed cocktails on the hammocks over the water, then we moved inside to partake in the Journey tasting menu. Each course was beautifully presented, and explained to us (sometimes by the executive chef). Absolutely delicious food.

Author: saly2015
Title: 10 stars!!!!
Review: We had an amazing time at Kayu Puti! Excellent service, amazing views, dream-like atmosphere, beautiful decor! We loved every bit of the experience. We watched the sunset with their signature Sunset Cocktails...! Yum! Can’t wait to be back!

Author: M HTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Creative cuisine in an upscale environment
Review: Although the dress code for Kayu Puti is casual, don’t make the mistake of thinking that their approach to food is. Reservations are a good idea, since this is the top restaurant at the St. Regis Langkawi. When you arrive, you’re warmly greeted and shown to a suspended hammock overlooking the water, for drinks. Yes, it’s a little awkward sitting Indian style to drink expensive drinks (read: Taittinger at 450RM a bottle), but the view is gorgeous. At dinner, the wait staff place the linen napkin in your lap and offer a eucalyptus-scented towel to cleanse your hands and cool down (it can get hot out on the hammock deck). There are multiple options for dinner: several set menus starting at 285RM ($71 USD), and ala carte. He had the Discovery menu (3 courses plus dessert at 330 RM) and I ordered 2 courses and dessert ala carte. Each course was a beautifully-plated mini work of art, and the servers explained all the ingredients. In truth, I found this to be a bit fussy and would have preferred fewer ingredients, but still beautifully plated. During the meal, several amuse bouche were offered, along with some amazing artisan breads and butters. We drank water at dinner. Our total bill came to nearly 700RM ($175). My only disappointment was the chocolate dessert that came with the set meal. They used Valhrona chocolate for the mouse, but the cake bites, instead of being dense and moist, were more like a chocolate-flavored croutons which detracted from the enjoyment of the dish. NOTE: I spoke with executive chef Gaetan abut this and he told me that they had just tested several new desserts. I’m hoping any chocolate cake offerings will be much more cake-like. Show less

Author: Karen CHobart, Australia
Title: Creative food, explosion of flavours.
Review: Under the creative direction of french-born Executive Chef, Gaetan Biesuz, dining at St Regis' signature restaurant Kayu Puti is an experience to remember. We chose the Vegetarian Discovery Menu and can honestly say the Asian-inspired dishes were the most beautifully-plated and exceptionally flavoured vegetarian meal we have had. Ever. The restaurant is set in an elegant and sophisticated building overlooking the Andaman Sea, adding to the first-rate experience. Definitely would return!Thank you Chef Gaetan and staff! A Bientôt ! !Karen & BrunoShow less

Author: Erinlmling
Title: Amazing journey at Kayu Puti
Review: Stay at St Regis Langkawi for 2 nights. Decided to have drinks and dinner at Kayu Puti.Was greeted with a very warm welcome by Ms Syahira at the entrance.... addressed me by my name! A nice Hammock was reserved with view of sunset. Mr Krimie recommended some great Pink G&T and we tried all of them! Ms Prem Epong the venue manager came to introduce her self and to make sure everything was fine. Head to dinner after the beautiful sunset,drinks and music.Had a wonderful gastronomic dining experience. Amazing food and excellent service.Executive Chef Gaetan took time to explain every single course we had, pretty magical till the end of our dinner.Ms Prem Epong was there all the time to ensure all was well executed. Mr Lim came later as well to make sure all went well.The restaurant team was more than wonderful. They were amazing.We were so well take care till the moment we left. This journey at Kayu Puti was definitely a memorable one.Show less

Author: ADV883Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fusion Fine dining
Review: As we were guests of st Regis, we decided to celebrate our anniversary dinner at Kayu Putih.Good food, and excellent service. A bit spendy US$83 for for a 4 course discovery menu. But they were kind enough to give us nice discount on our meal to boot. I would totally recommend this if you’re looking for something posh and romantic. Show less

Author: Passenger40132837199
Title: Best service with beautiful of sunset scenery!
Review: The best restaurant in the island... Thr best sunset spot...friendliness from services team....amazing food from Chef Gaetan and team,chef always on the floor to serve and check guest satisfaction. Its feel "WOW" right? & really make my dinner is special..highly recommended especially Asam pedas risotto,the best risotto...Show less

Author: Expat_VacationsSpokane, Washington
Title: 6 star
Review: This is an amazing restaurant. We enjoyed it so much, we went there three times in six days. Amazing views and wonderful selection. They do lack a little on the wine and whiskeys available, but did offer to get something from the St. Regis hotel if needed. The waiter was very knowledgable with the wine list and we spent quite some time discussing the wine selection.The restaurant was great for accommodating the kids, quick to serve them and was an excellent food. They loved it. The first night we had great experience with the degustation menu and wine pairing. They were great with making slight changes to the menu as well. Every other night there we tried almost everything else on the menu. Really cannot say enough great things about it. The spices they use are fantastic.And thank you to the chef that came out each night and spoke with us. Highly recommend the cod and risotto.Show less

Author: Jamesthefirst
Title: Magical experience
Review: We stayed at the hotel in May 2018 and had an amazing evening dining at the restaurant and sipping cocktails whist listening to live music. The location and feel of this restaurant and bar are a fab and a definite must do.

Author: 367chanelb
Title: Kayu Puti
Review:
Unbelieveable restaurant and team! We were looked after from the minute we were greeted to the minute we walked out. 
Incredible fine dining experience - one we will never forget. 
We will definitely be back!
Thank you

Author: Shummy45Southall, United Kingdom
Title: Sea front fine dinning
Review: My husband booked this restaurant last night as a surprise dinner for my birthday while our stay in Langkawi. Wow this restaurant had Amazing views and great ambiance, with very friendly and professional staff. We decided to try one of their set menus called “the journey” which was expensive over £100 per person but it was worth it. We had seven different dishes and each one came with a story to tell which I won’t spoil it for everyone here you need to experience it yourself. All I can say it was an amazing experience and the special touch was my birthday surprise dessert something I never had before. It’s a shame we couldn’t meet the chef as we wanted to thank him personally for his creativity and inspirational work. The last surprise I had when the waitress Shahira gave me a little bag with a gift inside it was a tiny bottle of spice mixed salt that I had admired tasting on the chicken I had as my main dish... and a lovely card from the staff. Really loved everything about this restaurant. Show less

Author: lamiananda
Title: Excellence
Review: The best I ever had... food is good , service excellent and the ambience is awesome... everything is just perfect... just love it

Author: SetchielEdmonton, Canada
Title: Must, Must Visit!
Review: Where do I begin? From the moment we walked in it felt like home. The excellent decor, exceptional service, fantastic food and ambiance. I am at a loss for words (maybe for the first time, according to my wife)... I’ll let the pictures of the the food speak the volumes they deserve). Spectacular evening followed by cigars and whiskey on the patio. Our second time to Langkawi, first time here and surely we will return if not only to indulge in the mastery provided by Chef Getan. Cheers to fine dining at its finest and amazing service by Nazri on the pavilion.Show less

Author: JerryW205London, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: This white wooden house on stilts over the water at the St Regis Langkawi is outstanding !From the amazing bar facing west to see the sunsets, to home made spiced cocktails , sitting over the water, everything is excellent. Service is friendly and very attentive and the views are stunning.And this is before you see the menu. Whether you fancy a tasting menu or a la carte, the quality and presentation is first class. Each night we went, the Chef was visible both in the kitchen and table side explaining his creations. Meat, fish or vegetarian , all are available and to a superb standard.The service is as per the bar outside, excellent and attentive.The decor is hard to describe - quite eclectic but it really works, especially the emperors chairs !The wine list is very good with a choice of countries, varieties and prices to suit your Budget or your taste.Even if you aren’t staying at the hotel, go to eat there - seriously one of the best restaurants I have visited for both location and food.Show less

Author: rfergus2018Greater Hobart, Australia
Title: Pre dinner drinks.
Review: Fantastic experience, pre dinner cocktails of pink gins prepared by mixologist Jambunazz from his gin trolley were unbelievable. Hand blended bitters and carefully selected spices and other ingredients led to an explosion of amazing tastes in the mouth. The Fire Pink & Spice Pink in particular have to be tasted to be believed. The atmosphere and view at sunset are impressive.Show less

Author: drzulkarnain1969
Title: Dinner at KayuPuti Restaurant Langkawi
Review: Dinner during sunset was phenomenal..ambience is suitable for a romantic dinner for two..food was exceptional and service was impeccable..highly recommended..

Author: W164ITrobertorRome, Italy
Title: Pampering dinner
Review: Great atmosphere with a restaurant OVER the water and fantastic staff pampering us from the beginning till the end of the meal. Food was well executed, but you can say that there a lot of thinking in the way it was prepared. I loved the amouse-bouche, the appetisers and the Red Snapper (possibly the best fish I have eaten on the island both in terms of freshness and preparation). All the rest was still very good quality!Show less

Author: asada527
Title: Dinner
Review:
One of the best restaurant. Good food and wine. Excellent service. Especially the personalised welcome and service by the manager Alexander. 
.

Author: GertrudePickles
Title: Amazing experience - fantastic restaurant
Review: Loved sitting outside drinking cocktails and watching the sun set listening to a great band and singer.

Author: Mumof1fromGlenIrisGlen Iris, Australia
Title: Wow and wow
Review: It’s not often a hotel restaurant outshines a hotel. The St Regis are an incredible hotel chain. This restaurant is the tops Staff make you feel welcome- greeting by name. They were professional and friendly The decor had me feeling like I was in some hip London/Paris restaurant- simply stunning The food was terrific we had one slight issue on our second visit that was handled very very well. The bread selection- despite me being wheat intolerant- was enjoyed vicariously through my husband. What a treasure that experience is. A parting glass of Tattinger Rosè was the icing on a very lovely cakeThank you to all the teamShow less

Author: renggas2017
Title: Concierge familiarization dinner
Review: Axceptional view & food. Thank you so much to the KayuPuti team for hosting us. Special shoutout to EPrem, Chef Beno, Alex, Nana & Ayu.

Author: sophswestie
Title: Fabulous Food and Attentive and Delightful Staff!
Review: The setting and decor were beautiful, the staff were very helpful and the food was sublime! I would highly recommend!

Author: Glen WHervey Bay, Australia
Title: Dinner Delight
Review: If you are staying at the St Regis resort or nearby i suggest you try out Kayu Puti restaurant. The name means white wood and it truely is a fine dining experience. This fairly new restaurant has a great chef Gaetan Biesuz who is very friendly and professional with the dining experience and you can see he is passionate about his food when he greets you. The menu is quite extensive and the dishes are beautifully presented with the taste and flavours of a 5 Star restaurant. Both with Malaysian & western flavours this restaurant is a fantastic night out and you will not be disappointed with any part of the experience. The restaurant is set on a wharf over the water out front of St Regis and has a fantastic pre dinner bar with sunset views second to none. Not only is the food and service exceptional you will also enjoy the extensive wine list St Regis has through there decanter bar, with over 1000 international labels to choose from. Show less

Author: YJA777Berlin, Germany
Title: Excuisite, sublime, need I say more?
Review: Had the Journeys set dinner course which was Malay Ringgit 550 per head for a 5 course meal. How can I describe the food...the kind that's too beautiful to eat, and makes your toes curl with the first bite, your tiny hairs on the back of your neck stand up from wonderment, makes everything wrong in your life right again and makes you feel giddy like a teenager having a crush and give the French chef a French kiss. Simply divine food. Absolutely creative plating and genius mixture of flavors, textures and story telling behind each dish.
