A lot of thought went into the selection of ingredients, preparation for each flavor and plating and if you enjoy cooking and appreciate fine dining, there is nothing to fault on the food. The price, I felt, considering the caliber of the food, totally worth it. Dont trust the bad reviews - as I nearly didnt go because of them on TripAdvisor. Wine prices are very reasonable too. The only bad comment I could make is that they didnt have a sommelier and the wait staff seemed quite nervous and didn't really have the calm confidence you find in top class restaurant. Other than that, magical experience.Show less

Author: cakeforall
Title: Delicious and great views
Review: High end dining set in a beautiful restaurant on the water. Canopy beds near the bar facing the sunset. Get your cocktail there and proceed to dinner afterwards. Food was delicious and service was excellent.

Author: Sarahp12345
Title: Exquisite last night dinner
Review:
Cocktails on the deck
Beautiful dinner. Fabulous service , not oppressive
Every dish was lovely to look at, delicious to eat
I could not fault anything

Author: ZiqB
Title: Excellent Staff
Review: We did not make any reservation and only walked in to the place. So, we (especially me) did not wear proper attire for the fine dining experience. Nevertheless, all the staff still welcome us and treated us wonderfully with a smile and respect.They offer to provide me a proper attire and shoes for the dining. They also let us to take a look inside the place before making our decision. The male staff also provide us a buggy service to get to the restaurant.Since my friend and I were only there to have a drink, we just spend our time facing the sea view on the hammock with a live band playing in the background. It was a peaceful and enjoyable experience made happen with the helpful and friendly staff.Overall, we had a wonderful day and I can not say thank you enough for the amazing staff with their services and friendliness.To Ms. Syahirah, Ms. Ika, Ms. Nana, Ms. Prem and the male staffs that I did not manage to get their name, we both thank you from the bottom of our heart. We will be sure to come and visit Kayu Puti again. Keep on doing the wonderful service for everyone. God bless you and everyone in Kayu Puti :)Show less

Author: Raphael_GOPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: excellent
Review: Outstanding experience, they were fully booked but still accomodated us as SPG gold member. We had a full set and every single dish came close to perfection. Service was professional with good wine knowledge. Great international winelist including european top choices but also new world selections, that are very reasonable priced, considering the offerings. The place deserves 2 michelin stars to my opinion. And yes the atmosphere is maybe the best of all. I will return soon. congrats!Show less

Author: Sunshine548689
Title: Delicious!!
Review:
This was a special meal and for anyone going I would recommend ‘The Journey’ degustation along with paired wines. All servings were delicious & pretty, the service was personal, friendly and knowledgeable.
Thanks for a great experience!

Author: timboc
Title: Fantastic location with great food...but expensive
Review: We ate at Kayu Puti twice during our stay on Langkawi. Both meals were excellent with some real innovation and excellent service. The wine list is very good, too. But it is very expensive.

Author: Aznan_WanderlustSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great sunset spot, meal and service
Review: Even though there was a wedding celebration afoot, the team led by executive Chef Gaetan, restaurant manager Prem and our great looking server Deen still managed to extend to us a highly personalised service and walkthrough of how best to enjoy the sights, wonderful food at this elegantly put together restaurant. I loved how Deen shared with us on the interesting historical features of the pieces of fixtures that came from an old ship and also what made the recommended dishes standout. Try the smoked cod on top of an asam pedas risotto or the wonderfully spiced duck breast with Langkawi honey and also the Lankamisu for dessert. And get a table right by the west side to see the sun set over the sister hotel, the Westin. Show less

Author: YeeFengLPenang, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Place
Review: Had our anniversary dinner there and my fiance made a surprise proposal with the help of the staffs at Kayu Puti. One of the most unforgettable moment - the view, drinks, food and service are all top notch. "Hanging" on the sea having drinks overlooking the sea with sunset background is perfect. Would give a 10/10 for a perfect night however towards the end of our dinner we saw a huge rat ran across the restaurant. Informed one of the staff there and she just mentioned she will check about it. However till we left the restaurant, there was no feedback and apology from the staff. Did not expect this type of service from a fine dine restaurant. Other than this, all is perfect. Just hope they could do some pest control or at least have the courtesy to explain or apologize to the customer.Show less

Author: Cbrowne23
Title: A world class dining experience.
Review: Congrats to the Kayu Puti team for creating a Michelin style restaurant in Langkawi. It is a total sensory overload...the beautiful smells, spectacular decor and divine food will be impossible to forget.

Author: katytanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Incredible dining experience!
Review: Myself and my boyfriend came here for my birthday and the restaurant did not disappoint! This was overall one of the best dining experiences I have ever had. From the minute we arrived to the minute we left the staff went out of their way to make you feel comfortable. We started off by having drinks on the balcony over looking the seafront and surrounding islands. We then opted for the discovery menu which was absolutely delicious. Each dish was exquisite! Everything about this restaurant is brilliant - the setting, the staff and most importantly the food. Thoroughly recommend!!Show less

Author: Asin77Minato, Japan
Title: Amazing Food
Review: This was really really good food, actually great!! The chef has really taken Asian flavors and made every dish remarkable. Crab Appetizer, Prawn Consume, Cod main course were great/amazing. Langkawimisu looked great but did not inspire in taste, I will be there again tomorrow and try a different dessert as they all looked great. Show less

Author: raihanah aLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing service and friendly staff❤️
Review: I just had the black bee honey, and its so delicious! I love love love panna cotta. So silky and smooth. Unfortunately i found hair on my plate, but its okay. Im not take it too serious. But the service so good, your staff's name Nana so friendly. I love to dine in again at Kayu Puti❤️Show less

Author: LynSmith66
Title: A Dining Experience
Review: For a great dining experience, you cannot go past Kayu Puti. The food and service were fantastic, not to mention the location and setting. Would rival any five star restaurant I’ve been to.

Author: LMurray3011London, United Kingdom
Title: The most amazing setting
Review: We now know why this is number 1 on Trip Advisor in Langkawi. The food was sensational - we had the tasting menu with wine pairing.The service was probably the best we have ever experienced (we have a lot to compare with).The food was fabulous and the executive chef was at every table explaining the food and wine which was a brilliant touch.The ambience was superb, the decor was exquisite and the drinks in the bar after were amazing. All in all, a splendid dining experience Show less

Author: mcnamee11
Title: Exquisite food
Review: Excellent food perfect eating area clean tidy on sea, staff excellent very friendly always smiling taking excellent care of guests!

Author: 421RichardMMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fine Dining over the Water.
Review: What could be better than Fine Dining over the Water, Beautiful Hampton style Restaurant with a bar decking area.The Chef from Lyon has created some wonderful tastes and textures, we had The Black Cod and risotto, the risotto was poached in a spicy asian broth to cook, and was incredible.The desert was nouvelle cuisine and a Coconut shell was actually made out of Chocolate.Not cheap but worth treating yourself every now and then.Show less

Author: hossanleong
Title: Langkawi sunset
Review: Wow just amazing. Thank you chef Gaëtan for the fabulous food and service 💯 the east-west fusion was truly inspired and where can I get Langkawi Ulam??????

Author: Jenny ASydney, Australia
Title: Amazing
Review: We stayed at the St Regis and were fortunate enough to have diner here one of the nights and cocktails every night on the hammocks watching the beautiful sunsets. The food was delicious and the staff were amazing. Can’t say enough good things about our visit to Kaye Puti. Loved it. Show less

Author: manningrichardson
Title: Amazing Place
Review: We loved the food and the setting of this restaurant. I had my birthday dinner there, and  we went for Menu..'The Journey', well worth it, absolutely perfect!!.

Author: dynasmokhtar
Title: Finally dinner for Lamer Blue Heart campaign
Review: The view is amazing and the food is delicious . They put extra effort on the presentation and the ambiance is amazing. The decoration of the restaurant is exquisite and the workers is super friendly . Had a really good time .

Author: Kitkat071Canning Vale, Australia
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: We went here tonight for dinner for a birthday. Staying at the st Regis. It’s a lovely view. Upon arriving we were asked if we wanted to have a drink and we were seated st our table. They quickly served us and bought out some wonderfully hot bread that was served on hot rocks. It came out with French style butter and a tomato type paste which was out of this world and we were bought a apple and pomegranate appetiser. We were left to chat and had a yummy dinner. Highly recommend the duck moulard. All the meals looked like art when it came out. Then we had desert. Desert we ordered langimisu a take on terrimisu and it was lovely. Price wise the meal was a bit pricey but all the meal used the freshest ingredients and we were told about the dish we were going to eat. If you are looking for a fine dining experience Kayu Puti was very nice Show less

Author: anirudh70Kolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: No words to praise
Review: Kaya Puti (wood house) is "the destination" for fine dining and to savour some signature dishes from Gaetan Biesuz (Executive Chef). Gaetan is an artist who spoils you with his wizardry. E Prem Epong was the best host one can expect to tell you about the style, food, venue and everything to make your dining an experience. The venue is straight out from a Utopian land. Do visit and get mesmerized.Show less

Author: YWC3238
Title: Beautiful sunset view
Review: Enjoyed the beautiful sunset while having drinks at Kayu Puti before dinner The staffs were very pleasant.

Author: CamerabuffSeattleKirkland, Washington
Title: Excellent dinner at Kayu Puti!
Review: This dinner at Kayu Puti at the St Regis on Langkawi was our best meal of our trip to Malaysia. Our table of 4 chose to do “The Journey”. This experience was fantastic as Executive Chef, Gaetan Biesuz, incorporates local ingredients native to this area in every dish. We were fortunate to have him personally serve each course and explain each dish to our group. Truly a magical experience with a personal touch from a very talented executive chef! Gaetan is originally from Lyon, France but has worked throughout the world to learn how to incorporate the local ingredients and flavors.Show less

Author: 467lunalVillach, Austria
Title: Best dinner on the island
Review: We spent almost 11nights on Langkawi and we v tried several kinds of restaurants. The best food, the best wines and the best service we v defintely had in Kayu Puti. A MUST for everyone, who loves special food, delicious wines, super nice service and an unique place...Show less

Author: kalleraunKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful place
Review: Was now the third time at the St. Regis and also at the Kayu Puti restaurant.The bar is a great place for a sundowner and their gin topic is really something special.The staff is so friendly, knowledgeable and attentive. Love the ambiance of the restaurant and service and food are outstanding. Best fusion cuisine I know in Malaysia.Show less

Author: Lori B
Title: Incredible
Review: Fantastic location, cuisine, service, entertainment, cocktails, sunsets all in this gorgeous over the water restaurant and bar.

Author: melandstefHull
Title: Kayuputi restaurant Langkawi
Review: Wonderful food and service from Syahira -two excellent evenings at this very special restaurant- food is amazing and the ambiance is enchanting. Watch the sunset from the hammocks on the deck area before dinner - perfect for a romantic night. All the staff are lovely and welcoming- congratulations to the chefs on creating such fantastic dishes. Memorable.Show less

Author: xs1415San Francisco, California
Title: michelin star cuisine above the Adamman sea
Review: this is certainly the BEST restaurant in Langkawi . Chef Gaetan creates a menu that uses a lot of local products , spices and Malaysian recipes to give his guests a great , creative culinary experience . this has to be one of Asia top 50 restaurantsShow less

Author: Stefan RMacau, China
Title: Sundowner drinks and dinner
Review: We stayed at St.Regis hotel and I have reviewed the hotel already but this restaurant deserves a separate review: WOW! This is THE place to enjoy a romantic sunset with drink in hand and live music in the background. The band is very talented and offers to play your special requests. After the sunset, we were escorted to our table and enjoyed a exquisite dinner. Service was on point and always found the right balance of attention and allowing us to enjoy the food that Chef Gaetan and his team had prepared. It was an evening to remember and we will cherish these memories for a lifetime!Show less

Author: Ronnie20182018West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: Just beautiful
Review: Stunning location and food. We came for dinner and started off with a cocktail on the deck. Shown into a beautiful dining room and enjoyed 3 courses chosen from the al la carte menu. Great service and presentation. We finished off back on the deck with coffee and brandy. Show less

Author: Siobhan DMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious Dinner
Review: We spent our last evening in Langkawi enjoying a cocktail and the sunset on the deck at Kayu Puti and then indulging in the degustation menu. The service was outstanding and the food delicious. The tuna tartare with mango salsa (delight of the day) was delicious, in particular for one of us who is not a seafood fan. The Hokkaido scallop was just devine - could not be faulted. The only let down of the meal was the duck, we felt that the fat had not been rendered well enough and as a result it was a little tough. However it tasted fantastic. The desert was a generous portion and was beautifully balanced. The wines that were paired with the dishes were delicious and it was a great experience overall. The gift bag we were given as we left contained a recipe and some sea salt to use in it. Will definitely be making the dish when we are home. Show less

Author: EstelleW72Somerset, United Kingdom
Title: Sublime experience - fine dining at its best
Review: I can’t speak highly enough of this beautiful restaurant. The building itself is fabulous and the staff are happy to tell you the interesting facts about some of its pieces of art, it’s architecture and some of the pieces that make up the building e.g doors and windows.The setting of Kayu Puti is incredible - don’t miss a sundowner here on the over water canopies. Bliss.We ate here for my daughter’s 12th birthday and as my children (17 and 12), are both foodies, this was truly a dining experience we could all enjoy, appreciate and remember. We all had the Degustation menu which was absolutely sublime. We were taken care of my the fabulous Hazif ( I hope I have that correct), who is as knowledgeable about the building as he is the amazing food. He can describe the ‘layers’ of the foods you are about to enjoy and does so with such passion. Whilst we did not opt for the wine pairing (we both know what we enjoy and are not wine connoisseurs), I’m certain that Hazif would have enthused as much about the wines as the food.The executive chef came to our table and spoke with us whilst himself serving sauces at our table. Lovely touch and fantastic to be able to personally congratulate and thank him and his team for a truly memorable experience.We enjoyed eating here so much, we did so again on the last evening of the holiday but this time we chose from the a la Carte menu which did not disappoint. We all enjoyed The degustation menu so much we wanted the opportunity to try more dishes!! I don’t usually take photos of food but could resist here...On our penultimate night, we came to Kayu Puti for a sundowner and were just as well looked after. Sunset was incredible. Please, do not miss this experience - you just will not be disappointed. A lovely touch and much appreciated was that you’re given a little gift at the end of your meal). We ate there twice and were given different gifts each time (mine is sat next to my stove in my kitchen at home, right now). I don’t want to spoil too much but hope what I’ve written and the pictures I post will encourage many many people to visit wonderful Kayu Puti. Fabulous work guys. All staff were fabulous - I must also mention the lovely gentleman who took care of us on the deck and the fabulous mixologist made me a bespoke vodka cocktail to die for (which I will try to recreate now I’m home ). We will remember our evenings with you for many many years to come!! Thank you all so very much ❤️Show less

Author: 402annaoSoutham, United Kingdom
Title: 5 stars all around!
Review: As we were staying in the St Regis, Kayu Puti was a must. After reading the reviews I was worried it may not live up to expectations but I was not disappointed!! From the moment we arrived we were waited on hand and foot. We sat on the big hammock (highly recommend!) and had a pre drink before our meal. We chose the tasting menu which was incredible. Each course was explained in detail and was in line with Michelin star quality (service and food). We got to talk to the chef who was obviously very passionate about his food, which made the experience even more special. We will definitely be returning! Show less

Author: xiaoyunfattyLos Angeles, California
Title: 5 Start experience.
Review: The restaurant is happily situated on the water with the spectacular view of the sunset during the dinner. it also has a bar under a canopy extended from its side further into the ocean with unobstructed views all around. The natural spice scented cocktails are must try. We had both 6couse and 4couse set menu between us at the restaurant. Everything is good. Fresh ingredients, light preparation, beautiful presentation. Service is also top notch from the whole team-attentive but not intrusive. I wish I had the paring wine to go with it but, I arrived Langkawi pretty late the previous night, was just recovered from the headache of flying. So I just had a very light cocktail. I couldn't comment on the wine. I can't say it is cheap but it is still on the low end compare to a similar meal in any big cities of Asia-HK, Sing, Tokyo etc. Will definitely return if I visit Langkawi again. Highly recommended Show less

Author: Green_kermitTiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: Amazing
Review: What’s not to like about this place? You wonder along a little jetty (walk or buggy). You wonder into a white building which has a kind of Moroccan opulent beach house type of feel. You can watch a beautiful sunset whilst sipping a cocktail with actually pretty good band playing quietly in the background.Then you wonder inside for some great, friendly and informed service. They have a great wine list and some really good options. One word of advice - fish. It’s so fresh and good, you should make sure one of your courses have it. I had scallops and beef (technically neither is fish) and both were amazing. My wife had fish, and it was jealous. Puddings - they are ok but the mains and starters are where you should use your calories. Great with kids too, they asked him what he wanted - they made it just for him. So it isn’t cheap (similar to a good meal in Hk or Sing), but this was the highlight of our holiday and I was left wondering when we can next come back. We had a great time.Show less

Author: fasteddieb75Darlinghurst, Australia
Title: Very very special
Review: What can one say about Kayu Puti. Where to start?Firstly, this restaurant is located within the St. Regis property on a pier over the water. It’s stunning. Gorgeous. My wife and I had every intention of eating there at least once. But time at the St. Regis slips through your fingers and before you know it you’re chasing a flight back to reality. On our last night at the resort, we got back from feasting on crab at the charming local Wonderland eatery recommended by the concierge. It was too late and we were too full for another meal, so we visited Kayu Puti to take some photos and perhaps a night cap. We were taking a photo from the front of the restaurant back to the St. Regis, when a friendly staff member invited us in to take some photos of the restaurant. This turned into an impromptu tour! We were loving it! Our tour guide was so knowledgeable on the history of every item in the restaurant it was amazing. And he retold stories with such infectious enthusiasm he had us laughing and marveling all at once. For instance, the front doors were taken from the Dutch embassy in KL. The ceiling timber struts were taken from a sailing ship that was torn down. The vases in the foyer are covered in barnacles after being purposely submerged in the ocean for 20 years! So much cool amazing stuff!It turns out our tour guide is the resident master mixologist. He makes his own bitters from herbs and spices and adds them to his signature cocktails. After seeing his passion for his craft, he offered to make us 2 specialty drinks. One fruity and the other ‘refreshing’. We were offered seats on the rear floating canvas that stretches out over the ocean like the boon on a sailing ship. Properly ensconced in cushions and cool sea breeze, our drinks arrived with a side platter of nibbles. The drinks were awesome. Really tasty and refreshing. Our new friend also said he would arrange a small gift for us! Wow! We just wanted to take some photos! HahaHe prepared a small bottle of salt rub called Asam Pedas that they make in the restaurant and a recipe card of the chefs signature dish in a little bag. Such a genuinely wonderful guy. And the staff were all great and very accommodating. In the end we were left to enjoy our drinks till closing. Our friend gave us our drinks on the house. He only asked in return that we review the experience honestly on trip advisor. So here I am, still grinning at the memory. And honestly, I would have written this review regardless, as this place is so special in so many ways. My only regret is that I can’t remember the name of our guide and master mixologist.... and never actually eating there. Show less

Author: cuph
Title: Wonderful dinner
Review: The best service, the best food, the best environment. We have our dinner there with starter, main, and desert.  All are excellent.  Services are excellent too.

Author: Melanie DAracena, Spain
Title: Phenomenal Views, Spectacular Sunsets, Delicious Food and Unbeatable Staff
Review: As we approached the restaurant each evening we were greeted by the most elegant hostess, draped in traditional Malaysian dress. The design of the restaurant and bar is, as with the entire St Regis Resort, stunningly beautiful. Combine this with fantastic service and delicious food and beverages and its an absolutely winning combination.We had cocktails here 6 of the 7 nights that we were in Langkawi and it was one of the highlights of each day. The colours of the sunset changed every evening as did our choice of cocktail. The bar staff were amiable and affable and easily established a rapport with us - a desirable skill along with great mixology and pride in their cocktails. On the strength of their efforts, we decided that we would treat ourselves to a degustation meal at the restaurant towards the end of our stay - now that was a great decision!The meal was wonderfully conceived and artfully executed. A wonderful blend of modern techniques with traditional flavour combinations. We enjoyed every single morsel.A huge thank you to the staff - our time spent at your bar, suspended over your waters, being pampered and fussed over, make up so many of the best memories of our week in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Fadi081577Amman, Jordan
Title: Mind blowing restaurant experience
Review: Without a doubt the best restaurant I’ve been to in my life , and I’ve eaten in countless restaurants in my day so that is a bold statement. I’m so happy we went there on our first night at the St. Regis as this was the best introduction to what would be our most blissful vacation of all time. The restaurant is like nothing I’ve seen before , built on stilts over the water with an enormous hammock that stretches the length of the restaurant , also suspended over the water in such a way that allows honeymooners to lounge around enjoying the sunset while sipping one of their many deliciously crafted cocktails .. This unique concept left us speechless and frantic to snap as many pics as possible to capture the beauty of it all but still not doing it justice . We then were escorted to our table in the interior of this magical restaurant and again stunned by the interior decor - totally unique with the most interesting yet tasteful furniture . The cathedral ceilings lend the place an air of charm and splendor. I don’t know who designed this restaurant but it is worthy of awards of the highest accolades . We could not stop gasping and admiring every detail adorning the space so perfectly and so harmoniously . We ordered four main dishes which we shared family style : duck with a honey bee sauce , angus steak , local grouper and ravioli filled with eggplant - everything was exquisite and incredibly presented. We loved each dish , rich in flavor and tantalizing to the senses . We had the absolute pleasure of meeting the genius behind these fabulous dishes - Executive Chef Gaetan - who became one of our closest friends during this visit greeting us each morning at the main hotel restaurant for breakfast . As if that wasn’t enough , the desserts also did not cease to impress - we ordered a banana dessert and a chocolate sphere both to die for and that we devoured to the last crumb despite our already full stomachs . The restaurant then surprised us yet again with a dessert specially made for my parents anniversary - it was equally delicious and a gesture that truly moved us beyond words - on our way out we were met by the beautiful hostess who gave my parents an anniversary gift that consisted of sea salt encased in a gorgeous glass vile along with the recipe for one of their chicken dishes - we thought this to be an incredibly charming gesture - one of many we were about to experience throughout our most pleasant and memorable stay at the beautiful St Regis . In conclusion , whether you are staying at the St Regis or not , a visit to this one in a million kind of restaurants is not to be missed . Show less

Author: Walid101Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Very nice sunset view
Review: Since we arrived to the island and we spend every night in here, so private , nice view overlooking the beach, and the staff are extremely nice and friendly Show less

Author: Christopher L
Title: Dinner and Sunset cocktails
Review: One of the top Locations worldwide for a sundowner Cocktail! My wife and I stayed there each evening enjoying awesome Cocktails and great sunset views over the Andaman Sea!Show less

Author: 23lizpSydney, Australia
Title: Beautiful views and fabulous service but left hungry
Review: Some hits and misses in this restaurant which we were told was the best in Asia. Overpriced for what we had but the service and freshness was fantastic. A lot of fabulous looking garnish but the food seemed left out!Show less

Author: londoner2304London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food in an idyllic setting
Review: We were guests of the hotel and visited for dinner one night. If dining here, arriving early to enjoy the sunset is a must. The outdoor bar area has been beautifully set up, with tarpaulins protruding over the water and live music playing. It makes for a really great setting from which to enjoy the sunset. There are around 8 tarpaulins (each accommodating one couple), and these were all occupied when we arrived 30 minutes before sunset, but there were still a few regular tables available.After sunset we headed in for dinner. They do have a couple of tasting menus available, but we opted for 3 courses a la carte. The two of us tried the lobster and scallops to start, and both had the Wagyu beef for mains. We finished with the Black bee honey and chocolate sphere for dessert. All of the food was excellent! Really well presented as well. This was true fine dining, and I’d say on par with some 2-Michelin starred restaurants in London. The portions were small though, even for fine dining standards (e.g. I’d guess the main course steak serving was just 125 grams or so) – so we had to top up with the bread selection on offer. Desserts were relatively much larger though, so we did end up feeling full afterwards.Service was friendly and efficient, no complaints there. The venue itself is impressive, and the décor (including some of the seating) is quite differentiated. I think our bill would have come to around RM 1,000 (including a few drinks), but due to an issue we had with our hotel room, this meal was on the house. This was a great meal all-round and I’d highly recommend a visit!Show less

Author: MarcoG1981Travel
Title: Amazing fine dining at a wonderful location
Review: I went to the Kayu Puti twice during my stay at the St. Regis Hotel and enjoyed the outstanding dining experience which has been made truly remarkable due to the attentive, friendly and highly professional service provided by all staff. You feel very welcomed the minute you walk in the restaurant. Food and presentation is just amazing! Pricing is comparable to other fine dining places in the world, but definitely worth it. Thanks to the great staff!Recommendation: Enjoy a drink prior to dinner at the bar facing the sunset with some light lounge music, just a magical experience!Show less

Author: SusanR123456Perth, Australia
Title: A breathtaking view; a striking building; an exquisite meal
Review: So good was our first dining experience with Kayu Puti, we (four) returned again the next night. We had no idea that the restaurant was oriented towards the West and, when seated, were treated to an amazing sunset whilst sipping cocktails. The staff were all very attentive, friendly and knowledgeable, and the food was simply the best! Each course was explained in detail and every bite was savoured as we admired the interesting artefacts carefully placed throughout the restaurant. An unforgettable experience.Show less

Author: anncaroljames
Title: Restaurant Review
Review: We have been to many fine dining restaurants around the world and found that this was in our top 3.  The service, the food presentation, food quality, restaurant position and all aspects of the establishment were exceptional.

Author: earsawitoJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Truly Fine Dining Experience
Review: Had my wedding dinner with my family in Kayuputi and everything was excellent! The food presentation are beautiful, the Local Grouper fish I had was perfectly cooked and the taste was fantastic. Were afraid that the portion might not be satisfying but in fact it was perfectly fulfilling 3-course set menu for the whole family. Not to forget that the most impressive one is the service that is very informative to explain about the food and not being intrusive. Definitely will come back.Show less

Author: eileeno671London, United Kingdom
Title: Magnificient
Review: We had a booking for dinner and started with a cocktail in the Pavilion....pure bliss....the view, the staff and the rosemary infused G&T were so heavenly we went back the next night! What a shame the holiday was ending...The vegetarian options were delicious and my husband thoroughly enjoyed the lamb and beef dishes he tried.Havis and the other staff could not have been more hospitable. They explained everything, and thank you Havis for the sunset cocktail recommendation.We thought it was great value for money.Thanks againEileen and GeraldShow less

Author: 708paulinen
Title: Valentines Tasting Menu
Review: Visited this restaurant twice during our stay at St Regis. The location is stunning and hard to beat . The menu for Valentines paired with wine was delicious. It’s a great experience . But be prepared to pay top London prices.

Author: Liveinhope2306
Title: World class location with decor and food to match
Review: Simply stunning,  Not inexpensive but worth every cent.  An absolute pleasure to have enjoyed Kayu Puti for dinner, cocktails of an evening and even for a special brunch.  Food is exceptional.  Service is exemplary.  Very happy memories created at this amazing restaurant.

Author: Cato B
Title: Holiday
Review:
Food, service and ambience are all excellent, the sunset view is spectacular and it is a very 
special dining experience

Author: WebHar
Title: Excellent experience 💌
Review: Had dinner with my wife we choose valentine set and its was very nice creative ..its super delicious and outstanding ..very high recommend to try and experience..suit with the price ..and valuable and memorable experience. Thanks to Chef Beno and Chef Akmal

Author: d0ct0rsv
Title: Views Spectacular. Food was nice but not the highlight.
Review: Views Spectacular. Food was nice but not the highlight. Staff were attentive. Had to eat from the set menu. Would have really preferred to eat a la carte.

Author: ZoeR1242
Title: Fabulous
Review: We stayed at the St Regis Langkawi for 5 Nights and spent every evening before dinner at Kayu Puti... the Bar is probably the most beautifully set bar I’ve ever been too, the views are Paradise and they have the Gin Bar of my dreams.Krimie made us the best Gin and Tonics, we come from London and love our Gin, we always seek out Gin Bars in every place we travel to, so we’ve done a lot of research!It was so lovely seeing Krimie and the other staff so passionate about what they do.We also had dinner here one night and it was amazing, fine dinning that you would expect to find in London.The staff were informative and super helpful... their recommendations were great.Show less

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Million dollar view, 5/10 food, wait staff with attitude problems
Review: Lounging on the hammock watching the sun go down was certainly a million dollar experience, but I would rate the dishes (I ordered the degustation menu with wine pairing) only between 5/10 to 7/10.The wait staff were either novice or had attitude problems (unteachable & defensive to the rut)- I’m unimpressed by that.Best advise- have cocktails while watching the sun go down on the hammock... but your money is much better spent at other restaurants. Show less

Author: Ingri-ingriVancouver, Canada
Title: Phenomenal
Review: This is hands down the best restaurant in Langkawi! Amazing fine dining experience with beautiful views and exquisite food. Service was impeccable and we loved the decor of the restaurant. One of the best restaurants I’ve ever been to anywhere. My favorite was the seafood paella - simply out of this world! Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Camper169280
Title: Brilliant restaurant
Review: Visited with my husband and young son and another family and their children.Watching the sun go down with predinner drinks on the family hammocks stretched out over the water was magnificent. The dinner menu is inventive and varied.A special place.Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: jonnyolsson
Title: Top quality food, top quality service
Review: best meal in a long time, great attention to details and top notch service, cannot imagine any better restaurant on the island

Author: Susan M
Title: Wonderful evening
Review: I absolutely loved this restaurant.  it is in a beautiful location and the staff are very accommodating and friendly.  We thoroughly enjoyed all of the food and enjoyed talking to the Julan at the end of the evening.

Author: ErickySPHong Kong, China
Title: Great lounge deck but restaurant lacks quality and service
Review: The lounge bar is great with live music, it is very small with beautiful materials which gives it an exclusive atmosphere. However the service was not great, it took a long time for drinks to arrive and our peanuts never arrived. The restaurant’s interior is very stylish, looks really good. But the food has not enough quality to justify these prices. We chose the discovery menu with 7 courses or so including wine pairing. The foi gras on one of the courses did not look and taste like it. The duck was not well cooked. Every course we had a new waiter of which some were difficult to understand their English. The wine was good, but the food is not worth while. I understand people go there to have a drink but not stay for dinner (as our neighbors did). Disappointing despite the beautiful building and location. Show less

Author: Ron FCanberra, Australia
Title: Christmas delight
Review: As a result of meeting (by chance) Exec Chef, Gaetan, we were lucky enough to secure a table for Christmas dinner. We arrived early enough to have a drink at the outside bar with stunning views of the mountains and Andaman Sea. The restaurant is accessed by buggy out on a pontoon. The interior of the restaurant is interesting, maybe a little busy but lovely. You can see into the kitchen and watch the chefs cook and plate up. The food is fresh, interesting and imaginative. There is no shortage in quantity. The wine list is quite extensive and as expensive as you would expect in a 5 star resort. We would recommend this restaurant for a special occasion. Only downside was the wait for our buggy on the way back but understandable on a busy night. Show less

Author: Loz-1988Sydney, Australia
Title: Great service, delicious food
Review: Beautiful location set out in a large overwater bungalow, when you walk in you will be amazed with the ambience of the venue and the incredible warm hosts. Food was delicious, we ordered the Alaskan Crab, Lobster and the Scallops with all 3 starters being delicious and presented beautifully. For mains we had the Beef which was incredibly tender and the duck which although had amazing flavour, was very tough. Dessert was delicious as we had the black bees honey and the lankamisu. It was also lovely to meet the Exec Chef Gaetan who was very friendly and passionate about food and hospitality. Really "good bloke". Wishing him and his team all the best for the future and again thank you for the beautiful evening.Show less

Author: stephenh4543
Title: A Langkawi must..
Review: Visited Kayu Puti for sunset drinks and dinner. Very reasonably priced champagne whilst watching the sunset on the water overhanging day beds is brilliant.The food and service from this restaurant is without doubt the best I've experienced in Langkawi after visiting this island regularly for over 7 years. Go with high expectations; you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Juz_azSingapore
Title: Worth it to experience at least once
Review: I took my family to Kayu Puti for dinner and the experience was beyond our expectations. This was our first fine dining experience as a family and with 3 young children, I was initially worried if we would stick out like sore thumbs. Instead, we felt warmly welcomed and we had a wonderful dinner with gorgeous view of the sunset. Everything was splendid. The steak was cooked perfectly, the lobster we had for starters was fresh and yummy. My mom really enjoyed her asam pedas risotto. Hafiz who attended to us was exceptional in his mannerism, explaining the dishes to us and went out of the way to ensure even our little one had a plate of fries to keep her occupied even though it was not on the menu. Truly enjoyable experience and highly recommended. Of course it is rather pricey but in my opinion worth a visit if u are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: TaniB_12Perth, Australia
Title: Excellent food and service - Great View
Review: The Lang Mary is an absolute must try for anyone who likes a spicy bloody mary. The french chef combines french and malaysian delicacies and des a great job. The service from the staff is excellent. Thank you for providing us with an excellent dining service.TIP - go to the restaurant 45mins prior to your booking and enjoy a drink on the sunset view barShow less

Author: Beachbilly
Title: Very nice fine dining.
Review: Inventive and elegant cuisine. Whimsical delightful decor - even if you don't eat here check out the interior - amazing. The outdoor bar at the rear of the restaurant is terrific and open to non-diners - beautiful place to sit even in a rain storm.

Author: -Cheng-Hui-__-Singapore, Singapore
Title: There’s something magical here..
Review: Out of the many wonderful restaurants that we visited in the world, few would live up to the nostalgia of the first visit. Kayu Puti has definitely attained this distinction. Seeing a few familiar faces among the staff was a good omen and I’m glad that our expectations were exceeded once again.We visited Kayu Puti on 2 separate occasions on the evenings of the 29th and 30th. Each was as excellent as we had remembered from an earlier visit in April. The service was attentive on both days, and the food, top notch. It is, indeed, an epitome of how western fine dining with a dash of Asian flavours should be executed. While the restaurant interior is wonderful, al fresco dining, especially if you arrive earlier in the evening, is a must — even when it is pouring. The million dollar view from the patio and the pavilion is not to be missed.The real test of their ability came on the 30th when they had a full house due to some celebration. They did fall a little short of their usual standards by missing an order of mine, which is rather inexcusable for a restaurant of their calibre. However, the team more than made up for any shortfall with their hospitality and understanding. My hyperactive 15 month old was running amok and not once did they chid us for making the experience less enjoyable for the other patrons. While I unfortunately could not remember the names of all the rest of the stellar staff, Prem, Dean and Syahira deserve a special mention for making our evening a memorable one.Show less

Author: s-a-y-a-s-trip
Title: Wonderful location and nice food
Review: Atleast on two occasions in the evening I was there. Beautiful location and nice food. Staff were exceptional. Superb experience.

Author: John DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Pure excellence
Review: We dined here while staying at the St. Regis Langkawi on two occasions. It was immediately apparent that the staff are trained to a very high degree. We were addressed by our names and received impeccable service. The atmosphere is calm and classy. I was worried that the food might be too refined but it is absolutely delicious with just the right balance of flavours and portions. I particularly enjoyed the fish and seafood dishes. We were also very fortunate to dine for breakfast on two occasions while the main restaurant at the St. Regis was being refurbished.Highly recommended and definitely worth a visit if staying at the St. Regis or Westin and I would even consider it if staying elsewhere in Langkawi.Show less

Author: monica2506Sydney, Australia
Title: Incredible
Review: My husband and I had drinks and dinner here on one night of our honeymoon. The service was absolutely incredible, every staff member was fantastic. We had cocktails and watched the sunset on the day beds that are suspended over water and then ate dinner inside. The food was just beautiful. Highly recommend to any couple looking for an incredibly romantic night out. Can’t top Kaya Puti in Langkawi!Show less

Author: AZakry
Title: Sunset cocktails is a must!
Review: We stayed there for two nights and both evenings we spent it at Kayuputi. The drinks were good (they have a Gin cart!) and the food was also superb. If you're not going for dinner, then stay for the live acoustic performance.

Author: Marianna500Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Pure magic
Review: Kayu Puti was pure magic. A warm welcome at the entrance as our eyes were delighted by the whimsical relaxed decor. We were escorted to the bar at the back where we took to the hammocks suspended over the calm waters of Langkawi to watch the sunset. We chose Bellinis, but the choices are many. The soft sounds of gentle live music playing in the background, it was a beautiful memory just there. But there is more to come.After an hour of relaxation we ventured to our table and chose the degustation menu.Each dish showcased a wonderful combination of quality local and international ingredients and depth of flavours. Our senses were delighted by local scallop and lobster flavours, grade 4 Australian wagu tartare, and duck. The amazing coconut tiramisu was an outstanding finish to a wonderful experience. We thank the chefs and staff for making this a memory we will treasure. The best food experience of Malaysia.Show less

Author: Helene G
Title: heaven
Review:
Highly recommend cocktails at sunset. Dream location sitting over water with spectacular sunset and first class service topped of with soothing live music.
Then the degustation menu with paired wines offers taste sensation and creative flair.

Author: Yologer
Title: First ever restaurant that 'forgets' a pre-booked Birthday celebration!
Review: This was my first visit to Langkawi and pre-planned for my birthday. The reservation was made a week or more in advance and the restaurant was informed that it was a birthday celebration. However, it was disappointing that they omitted the celebratory cake and singing but did it for another party celebrating at the same time. Not sure how its possible to 'forget' someone's reservation and notification in advance but some processes need to be improved. Thanks for making it not memorable for me.If you are willing to pay for a pricey dinner with views at sunset (randomly cloudy then) and experience lying on hammocks overhanging the sea, the food was so-so. The server we had was quite indifferent and lacked a sincere warmth; very cursory and curt.Show less

Author: etsijaHelsinki, Finland
Title: A tranquil dining experience
Review: We took UBER from the Ritz Carlton to the St Regis on the other side of Kuah. We had heard that Kayu Puti ( white wood ) offered some of the best food in Langkawi. We arrived at sundown and at our request we were shown around the Hotel. Definitely one of the top resort hotels in Langkawi. Finally we took the buggy to the end of a long pier and entered the whitewalled dining room. The sun had gone down and it was pitchblack outside. Only the last silhuettes of the surrounding mountains could be discerned.We were not disappointed with the menu for it offered a wide choice of both Asian and European tastes. Later on the French doors were opened to let in a very light breeze .The French Executive Chef, Gaetan Biesuz , came by our table and we thanked him for a thoroughly enjoyable dining experience. Gaetan has travelled the world which has greatly enhanced his understanding of food in different cultures. He can then create his own take on traditional dishes. When in Langkawi do not miss the Kayu Puti.Show less

Author: anniewicksmombasaMosman, Australia
Title: Extraordinary!
Review: A beautiful stroll down the beach from The Westin for the sumptuous over-water sunset bar and restaurant. And what a bar, what a sunset it turned out to be. Best cocktails ever - complimentary nibbles and charming service. The whole place is over the top and not to be missed. Be warned -there is a dress code. Show less

Author: J6381MClindan
Title: The Journey to the resturant is an experience
Review: The journey to the restaurant is an experience of its own. from the Westin you can take a walk by the beach followed by a walk on the jetty to jet to the floating structure. great spot to view the sunset of Langkawi

Author: WebHar
Title: "Delicious and Wonderful Experience"
Review: Please do visit Kayu Puti langkawi everything is delicious from begining and the end..Thanks to Chef Akmal and the team not to forget give such very good food especially Asam Pedas Risotto that he customized special for me..and my husband having duck is super delicious variation carrot..they using local ingredients and improvised be nice fine dinning,,..if visit them say hello to the Chef Akmal and the service team...they super nice if we nice to them..for sure they will make us happy and appreciate..Show less

Author: Mickshell999
Title: One of the best dining experiences I've had
Review: This was the second meal in a week and again was not disappointed with our dining experience. A modern slant with all the courses and a relaxed, unrushed service provides a great evening. Thank you to Taupik whose friendly service made us feel special.

Author: warrenf195Melbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent restaurant with great views and food
Review: We dined here twice on a five night stay at the St Regis resort. The service was as good as anywhere in the world, attentive but not intrusive. My wife is coeliac and the restaurant catered for that effortlessly. The views are spectacular, especially from the bar. The food was excellent. On the first night we had the degustation menu with matched wines, which was really memorable. On our next visit we ate al la carte, and were assisted with matching wines by the glass for each course. Alex, who served us both times, deserves a special mention. In a restaurant with really excellent service he stood out. I have n doubt we will be going back.Show less

Author: Alex RParis, France
Title: Delicious and wonderful
Review: Do yourself a favour and go to kayu puti! Everything is delicious from the cocktails to the entire menu and the staff are all so friendly and wonderful. They even organised surprise treats for my wife on her birthday. Also the view is stunning :) yay hooray! Show less

Author: Nancy T
Title: Absolutely amazing!!
Review: The food was fantastic.  the presentation, the quality and the flavours were amazing.  The staff (Prem and Nana)were so friendly and welcoming.  the surroundings, indoors and out were stunning.  This is a must do!!

Author: BobosweetLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Evenings drinks
Review: Love this place such a nice view for sunset and evening cocktails ...my wife very enjoy it..so much ..service level 5star thanks to eeprem such energetic woman and friendly..also not to forget Chef beno such delicious food and handsome....also chef akmal not to forget his recommendations is very nice to fulfilled ur tummy’s and he very nice chef...good luck in futureShow less

Author: Gregg D
Title: Wow
Review: Views, service and some of the best food ever. We have had the pleasure to travel to many areas around the world. The combination is second to none. Did I mention the Food!!

Author: l33tdudeSydney, Australia
Title: The perfect evening
Review: My wife and I visited Kayu Puti on our last night at the Westin. For those staying at St Regis or Westin the two resorts share the same beach and are seamlessly conjoined. They are both connected by the same Hotelier group so you are able to easily book dinner at both hotels and charge to your room which is great.Our night stared off with a complementary transfer from the westin to Kayu Puti. On arrival we were greated with many a warm welcomes from all the staff and offered pre dinner drinks on the deck over looling the ocean. We opted to take 1 of the hammocks suspension seats. This is where you are able to lie comfortably on a large canvas suspension with pillows ~7 meters above the ocean looking put to the ocean and archipelago of the Langkawi islands with the setting sun in view. We ordered the Champange special. The champange was ceromonially opened with sword by Hirfaz who was a wonderful host. The drinls menu is extensive and impeccable. We were also served an array of lovely/complimentary hors d'oeuvers including salted nuts with anchovies, salted/chili sweet peas and dried sweet patato and beetroot crispz. The sunset was amazing and staff were perfect at their service. We were able to order oir meals in advance during the sunset at our own request. Upon moving to dinner we were served a lovely appetiser which was an egg custard with carmalosed onion served with parmasan crisp. Our entrees were quickly served (as requested as we had an infant being baby sat at our hotel). We ordered the lobster and seasoned vegetables, both of which were lovely. For mains we had the chicken and duck long with srasoned fruit and sorbet and the choclate composition for dessert.Both mains and desserts were devine and in and off themselves deserve individual reviews but easily 5 star dishes. During our dining the service was perfect, the ambiance of the restaurant is amazing and the insight into the wine list by staff is also of high standard. We had Alexander and hirfaz serve us for most of thr night and theybare definately masters of their craft. Staff kindly organised our return to the westin.We would and will definately return. A night not tp be missed for couples who come to langkawi.Show less

Author: monicachirilloSydney, Australia
Title: Opulence at it’s best
Review: We booked kayu Puti after having been told about it’s reputation and it exceeded it!We started with pre dinner drinks on the deck with a magnificent sunset. We then entered the main dining room and were lucky to have been sat at the table with the very beautiful and comfortable peacock chairs, at must for a romantic dinner.We ordered the degustation menu which was absolutely stunning! Each dish was beautifully presented, from the wagyu carpaccio to the charred duck and carrot purée and the peace de resistance, langkawimisu for dessert.The service, decor, attention to detail are second to none. Do yourself a favour and eat here once in your life before you die... you will die happy! Show less

Author: WebHar
Title: Very valuable
Review: Very nice restaurant ..all staff is friendly..very talented chef (Beno wicaksana and akmal all the food is very unique and staff service is 5 star

Author: stupfel25Munich, Germany
Title: What a fantastic experience!
Review: We had a fantastic Champagne -Dinner which was in just one simple word : far over all expecations. So to make a Long Story Short: if you are looking for a Perfect Setting, Great Food and Perfect Service : this is the place to be! Definitely a Must-visit in langkawi!Show less

Author: AlwaysHungryForLifeAustralia
Title: Fantastic restaurant
Review: What a great restaurant in a beautiful part of the world. We enjoyed cocktails whilst experiencing stunning sunsets each evening here. Fantastic staff who are so polite, eager to please, and knowledgeable. The food is excellent, we particularly loved the red snapper with bouillabaisse, Asian styled risotto and ravioli. Kids menu was also very popular with the kids. We've thoroughly enjoyed our time here. Thank you especially to all the staff. Show less

Author: delrust1
Title: Last meal
Review: Food and the whole experience was amazing, such a beautiful setting, and the staff were fist class. If we had our time again we would have gone there on more than one occasion.

Author: Kym PMiddle Dural, Australia
Title: How good is this experience
Review: From the brochure I knew this was going to be magnificent and magical but it even elevated itself more than that. Once we arrived, the decore is Arabic meets beach Hamptons style. An eclectic melting pot that meets all styles. The staff are all of high standards. The food is truly incredible and truly executed beautifully. Presentation , service and menu is world class The team are fantastic wether your being romanced by sunset drinks on the overseas hammock , serenaded by the the impressive vocalist or served by crimie ( he deserves all accolades , he is the maestro here , such a top class individual) or inside being attended to by Alexander the magnificent, who helps navigate you on your food and wine journey. We had an opportunity to speak with the head chef and I love his passion and high standards. This is new it can only keep impressing. Loved the time and experiences. Thank you. Show less

Author: lizziem27Warilla, Australia
Title: Perfect Experience!
Review: From cocktails at sunset, all the way through the night, this was a wonderful experience. We opted for the Discovery Menu with wine pairing so that we could try different dishes and every single one was fantastic. Presentation was great, service flawless. Definitely recommend this place as an extra special treat!Show less

Author: lovetotravel386
Title: Amazing birthday dinner at Kayu Puti
Review: Food is excellent! Views are to die for! Go here for sunset and sit on their hammocks, you will not be disappointed!

Author: Boeing777Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Truly Memorable
Review: I had the good fortune of staying at this amazing hotel for 5 nights recently. I felt utterly pampered and looked after by all the staff headed by executive chef Gaetan. The menu is undoubtedly international with a good dose of sophistication. The interior is quirky and very tastefully done. The chef noticed I was there a few days, offered to look after me personally by indulging my craving for pasta one evening. This is the level of service and attention to details you can expect from KayuPuti. Also, do not miss sunset cocktail hours on the deck, it was simply breathtaking. All in all, everybody is eager to please and will bend over backwards to make guests comfortable.Show less

Author: SyifaYinIzhar
Title: Amazing!
Review: Very nice view, excellent foods and service. The Wagyu beef cooked to perfection and we loved it! Definitely will come again.

Author: db7andy
Title: Amazing setting & staff
Review: The only reason I didn't give a 5 rating is the price of the meals; just a little high for Malaysia, extracting every last Ringitt from tourists, which I find slightly rude. On the plus side, food, drinks, setting and staff are fantastic.

Author: thecarryonlifeDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Amazing visual and culinary experience!
Review: What I will remember from Langkawi is Kayu Puti!Let's start with the setting and decor:Located in the st. Regis, make sure you're there for the sunset. They have these trampoline contraptions that have you sitting on top of the ocean! Breathtaking, you can enjoy yourself a drink or two or ten... and head inside for dinner. There is a band on most days playing quietly in the corner on the outside deck. You can come in with casual clothing, but make no mistakes this IS fine dining. During our 4 days stay, I insisted we had dinner there twice (if I had it my way, it would have been every night!). The food:The food was absolutelyExquisite, by far one of the most memorable food experiences we've had. Having travelled a bit and coming from a city where all the recognized chef's have a restaurant in the city, I can easily say that Kayu Puti is in my top 3 favs. Right (excuse me not remembering the names of the dishes correctly), for the entree we had the vegetarian pea deconstructed salad and the lobster entree. The mains were: the Wagyu beef steak, the eggplant ravioli and the prawn risotto; for dessert we had 2: the local honey one and the chocolate variation one. Everything was fantastic, I can almost foresee every item on the menu being of the same caliber. My favorite if I had to pick was the simple yet delicious ravioli eggplant. NOT your average ravioli by any means. So light and with an after taste from the eggplant. The Chef outdid himself! You start with bread freshly made followed by an amuse bouche and the rest is history.The service and the crew:The restaurant has an open kitchen which means you see everything and everyone. Smiles all the way through! The waiters are very knowledgeable and courteous, they'll guide you through the options, some history about your dish and recommendation on how to eat it!We had the pleasure meeting and chatting with the executive chef, Chef Gaetan Biesuz, extremely friendly and passionate about his craft. He is always available for his customers and makes sure to pass by and check on you and how your experience is going.All in all, if you are in Langkawi, you have to visit this restaurant!Show less

Author: great_blackbatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice view and pretty decor
Review: The decor of the place if fantastic. The view at sunset is also great.A couple of points to improve: 1. The dress code is inconsistent for men and women which is bizarre. Women are aloud in with revealing swimwear but men can't wear sleeveless tops. 2. The service is a bit slow. 3. Kids are aloud to run around and be loud during sunset which is the time when you want to relax most.Show less

Author: maher k
Title: Best Restauranrt in Malaysia
Review: Excellent food. The waiters were very knowledgeable and friendly. Great service, food and amazing view.

Author: Patricia B
Title: Amazing - A must experience
Review: Wow, wow, wow! The decor, the ambience, the location, the team, the food all amazing. A dining experience I will remember forever. Thank you Chef Gaetan and the team for making my birthday so memorable. 😀

Author: khallodi84
Title: افضل مطعم في ماليزيا
Review:
المطعم الوحيد في ماليزيا يستحق ٥ نجوم 
St.Regis hotel with great seafood 5stars restaurant the best vacation in Langkawi ever

Author: Janine M
Title: Best sunset venue yet!
Review: A fabulous spot to relax, unwind and watch the sunset. We made an over water nautical sail reservation, complete with a bottle of Tattinger champagne for just under $100AUD. There was live jazz music and the ambience and panoramic vista was superb! Highly recommend

Author: 279benitarBurradoo
Title: Night to remember
Review: Kayu Puti restaurant juts out into the Andaman Sea and stunning decor inside. Best time to arrive is just before sunset and enjoy cocktails sitting in the hammocks that are suspended over the Andaman Sea - truly memorable experience. We had the degustation menu with matching wines and this dining experience is worth every cent. Each course beautifully presented and tasted sensational and all wines were superb. Please do go and enjoy a very unique dining experience! Show less

Author: FMS29
Title: Lovely Night during Happy Hour
Review: The Bar is closed for refurbishment and they have move over to Kayu Puti temporarily. The ambiance in Kayu Puti was peaceful and lovely. Service was exceptional & drinks were good.  Coconut sorbet is a must try!

Author: 446philipf
Title: Superb !!!
Review: We came to enjoy the new opened St. Regis, especially the stunning outlet on the water "Kayu Puti" designed by Bill Bensley. It is most probably the nicest place I've been so far, living on the island for only couple of weeks I can recommend passing by as the place itself, the service delivery by Mahamad Hafiz and team as well as the food made it exceptional - adding the views leaves me no doubt to rate it 5 stars. Recently awarded with the best landscaping this resort is a gem. Insider Tipp: Try to reach before sunset and benefit from their Champagner promotion.Thumbs up .. we will come back and appreciate the hospitality we were able to experience. Show less

Author: ST K
Title: Will surely come back for more!
Review: I visited Kayu Puti along with my wife as we were in Langkawi for the holidays. Firstly, the place is scenic and beautiful and I haven’t even gotten to Kayu Puti yet :) We got there early to take in the sunset with a few cocktails. The view – absolutely magnificent! We then moved into the dining room and the we took a moment to soak in the ornaments – abstract patterned tiles and the razzle-dazzle lights! Scenic insta-worthy photos that will command social media respect! Tables are generously proportioned which gave us good privacy. We both shared an entrée platter, a main course and a dessert each. The food – super sumptuous!! Our waiter was Hafiz, who was polite, respectful and extremely responsive to our questions recommended the Langkawi Grouper, Stanbroke Farm Wagyu Beef and the Langkawi Black Bee’s Honey. Highly recommend that too! There aren’t many restaurants in Langkawi that have a view, great service and food. Kayu Puti has pulled it off with this sophisticated concept which will keep many people (including us) coming back for more and more! Highly recommended!!Show less

Author: Herr G
Title: Wow
Review: What to choose from the menu if every single dish seems to worth to order and enjoy? Choose the discovery menu. It's gorgeous. It's artistic combinations from what you get on this island and from overseas - composed to a firework for your tongue. And: try the house champagne. It's worth it too. Totally priceless is the scenery and location of Kayu Puti. Above the sea, white, elegant like the old maritime Seebrücken at the coast of the Baltic Sea.Wonderful place, awesome food, best desert on this island, great staff.Terima kasih. Jumpa lagi! Show less

Author: eeky94Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: A truly magical experience.
Review: Absolutely amazing. From the food, to the ambience, to the service, what else can I say? My husband and I dined at Kayaputi during our stay with St Regis after reading so many fantastic reviews about it. I have to say this was our favourite meal during our stay in Langkawi. We are big foodies so that says a lot. The whole restaurant was just magical in itself. Make sure you arrive just before the sun sets for the most gorgeous views whilst lying on the hammocks, simply amazing.I would also like to add the lady in the white shirt with the lovely ponytail who we have seen various times working in Kayaputi and L'orangerie is amazing. Thank you xxxShow less

Author: Rebbecca RMelbourne, Australia
Title: Our new favourite!
Review: There aren't enough words to describe the amazing degaustation menu we just finished!!! From start to finish we were in heaven! As a couple who love to fine dine, this was the perfect sensory overload! Go early so you can catch the sunset with a few drinks on the hammocks over the beach. The fabulous staff topped off the experience, everyone was so friendly and helpful!!Show less

Author: cynthiaalfieri
Title: Dinner with a View
Review: Amazing dinner at the most lovely restaurant on the Andaman Sea. Magical ambience. Delicious dinner. And, Andy was the most fabulous waiter. He Tik care if everything perfectly.

Author: zaak0536
Title: Excellent Sunset View
Review: Had our dinner at this magnificent restaurant.  Our dinner started off with cocktails over a netting hammock viewing the sunset.  Thereafter we adjourned to the dining table where the service and food were impeccable.  We had the degustation menu.  Excellent choice !

Author: Jenniferdone87Hedge End, United Kingdom
Title: Truly spectacular
Review: We recently stayed at the St Regis and visited Kayu Puti. We loved it so much we visited twice! We started both evenings with drinks on the canopy over the water watching the sunset which was beautiful and made the evenings even more special. They have a great range of drinks for the canopys and the staff were very attentive but allowed us time to relax too. Both meals were delicious with warm bread and flavoured butters provided with an amuse bouche free of charge. My husband is unable to eat cheese and they quickly changed his amuse bouche to one without cheese with no hassle and without us asking.Both meals were creative, beautifully presented and full of flavours. A true dining experience. We want to say a huge thank you to the staff for being so friendly, attentive and welcoming - particularly Hafiz who was brilliant and taught my husband how to champagne saber. The restaurant also massively surprised me with a birthday cake and a glass of my favourite champagne for husband and I. I would definitely recommend visiting Kayu Puti.Show less

Author: Daryllee84Singapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful view, great service and quality food
Review: Having stayed at St. Regis Langkawi for 3 nights, I must say that our dinner at Kayu Puti was the absolute highlight. From the wonderful sunset view from the hammocks to polished service throughout dinner and lovely food, it was certainly a great experience.Having made arrangements through Jan, the restaurant manager, he most certainly delivered. I was surprised the staff would need to double check my arrangements with me, but perhaps that is what they've been taught to do, as such it is a minor quibble. After settling down at the hammock for some champagne and the sunset view, the staff were most kind to offer me a private champagne sabering. A wonderful added touch to the lovely view. The staff who waited on us, Hafiz, was most polite and very informative. He was also our server throughout much of the dinner and I found him most delightful and quite polished.After the sunset, we were ushered into the restaurant itself a provided with rather comfortable seats with a decent view of the Andaman Sea. We were first provided with an amuse of foie gras lollipops, an interesting concept. It was nice but on a personal level, I felt the peanuts somewhat overwhelmed the delicate foie gras taste. The first course was a medley of fresh and picked vegetables, quite lovely and refreshing on the palate. This was followed by Andaman tiger prawn, enjoyable but nothing to shout about. Next came the roasted eggplant ravioli. It was nice, the texture was great but the ravioli just a bit too thick. Then came one of the mains, an absolutely delicious snapper with a hearty bouillabaisse that was so delicious that I was tempted to lick the plate. As we both do not consume beef, the following course, we chose different fish courses at the chef's recommendation, one of Milkfish and one of Red Snapper. Both excellent recommendations. Oddly enough, I preferred the Milkfish but the sides from the Red Snapper. Finally came dessert, Chef Gaetan personally came out to introduce the dish, Langkawi Black Bee Honey ice cream with honey comb crumbles and sponge cake with a delicate dark chocolate nest. It was evident that he took pride in that creation. It seems the honey in the dish is specially farmed for the St. Regis Langkawi. Chef Gaetan explained that the many elements of honey might be overwhelming, hence the dark chocolate nest and he was absolutely right. On its own, the honey ice cream was exceedingly sweet, and this is coming from a person with a sweet tooth, but when all the elements were eaten together, the dark chocolate provided a perfect counterbalance.Throughout our time at Kayu Puti, the service was very attentive. Hafiz, Jan and Chef Gaetan in particular would check in on us. I was surprised that Chef Gaetan would take the time to make recommendations and introduce a course, what with having to run a busy kitchen. He was also sure to drop by other tables to make sure all was well. I also bumped into the team during breakfast service and they, as well as another restaurant manager, Alfredo (I hope I got his name right), were kind enough to address me by name and ask if I had any concerns. Overall I must say that Kayu Puti is definitely the crown jewel of the St. Regis Langkawi. I'd even argue that it is worth a visit for outside guests. A final note, Chef Gaetan and Jan had just finished a meeting and on noticing I was about to check out, they took the effort to approach me again. I really appreciate the warm service from them. They are undoubtedly proud of what they do and deservedly so. I know running F&B service is not the same as the frontline service in a hotel but I would suggest the rest of the property learn from them and Hafiz as well.Show less

Author: Nina2115Melbourne, Australia
Title: St Regis Langkawi restaurants
Review: The restaurants were lovely. Staff attentive and friendly. Remembered us on each visit. The executive chef introduced himself to us at breakfast and explained about new menus on offer that day. We proceeded to book for dinner and were served food of the highest quality in both taste and presentation. We were also offered suggestions for other restaurants to visit in other cities around the world which we wouldn't have found without his advice. All in all made for a memorable experience on our trip. Would highly recommend a visit to Kayu Puti restaurant and bar if you are in the area. Show less

Author: ApolloGenitoAtlanta, Georgia
Title: Insatiable
Review: Wrapping up my birthday week at the St Regis and decided to have a evening of champagne at sunset and seafood. This is a gorgeous restaurant with exceptional views of the straight. There was something unsettling but rather peaceful, sipping on champagne on a hammock over water... absolutely beautiful. Inside, the bright and lite decor is vibrant. The kitchen is airy and open. And the seating... well, the thrones caught my eye so naturally we had to sit there. My entire trip has been about exploring and tasting new things. My partner in crime helped me chose my dinner but it was the chef who came out himself and insisted on my dessert... a taste if the region, a black bee's honey thingy ma bob with teh tarik ice cream. I'm being funny but I do have a good pallet and good taste and this entire experience was memorable. The presentation was art on a plate or food porn. It's the kind that always leaves you wanting more. Just means I'll have to go back.Show less

Author: Globetrotter_9607Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional in Every Way
Review: We ate at Kayu Puti a few times during July 2017 while on honeymoon in Malaysia and our experience was exceptional on every occasion. From the service and the setting to the food and the beverage menu, this restaurant is an absolute must if your budget allows. Allow about RM1000 per couple for three courses with a glass of wine and you will not be disappointed! Watch the sunset while eating incredible and innovative dishes and enjoy the beautiful ambience and service to match. I particularly enjoyed the snapper main course with sweet potato and vegetable accompaniments as well as the beef wagu main course, and the chocolate pudding with cotton candy was phenomenal! The staff genuinely care about your experience and nothing is too much trouble. We will be back!Show less

Author: drseetoSingapore, Singapore
Title: A real surprise :)
Review: This is my first visit to a St Regis on the suggestion of my cousin who always stays at St Regis world wide and now I know why!I won't review the hotel here only the restaurant it was a real surprise because from the name and outside of the building you would think it to be a typical Asian restaurant but it wasn't :)Firstly the interior is out of this world one of the best I have been in from sunset views to hill to views it had it all too. Come lunch or dinner which we did because the food was wonderful in presentation, taste and something's we haven't experienced before in many Singapore based Michelin star restaurants.....and this isn't rated yet so it's affordable too vs singapore.Try the egg, scallops, waghu and lobster. Only failing was that the bread choices didn't have a soft bread option all hard but tasty though.The whipped potatoes on the waghu degustation menu wasn't tasty at all but the other potatoes were very nice.The local dessert wasn't wow in taste but presentation wonderful. But I only tried one desert. Oh special mention for strawberry ice cream fantastic.Show less

Author: Scott MMelbourne, Australia
Title: As Good as It Gets!
Review: perfectly positioned hanging over the sea, the location is breathtaking and the building itself equally as good. Make sure you get there for sunset drinks on the deck bar and lay back on the suspended hammocks over the water. The restaurant design and attention to detail of the interiors is nothing short of amazing and its the best kitchen i have viewed anywhere. The team of staff were amazing and while informative weren't in your face. The team of chefs lead by Gaetan Biesuz delivered up super food.Show less

Author: BM_SGP
Title: Lovely Sunset views and very good dinner menu
Review: Loved the sunset view. The dinner menu is great too. They have a fusion menu mostly focused on seafood. You can try the degustation menu - it's good!

Author: RezafeiliLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A dream
Review: A wonderful place on top of the sea Nice , calm and lovely restaurant ,Perfect wines , well trained staff , amazing artist chef , warm in hospitality and cool in room , reset your busy life in a calm time ,A little amuse bouche was an abustle art ,Starter was tasty , meal was really nice , Thanks to the lovely staff who make your dining time a good memory , Every body looking for fine and lux dine in langkavi island must visit this place Real name "white wood " Show less

Author: GhislainBruxelles
Title: Wonderful dinner
Review:
White beautiful restaurant 
Incredible Tasting menu and also incredible very friendly service
One of the best restaurants in Malaysia.
A sophisticated restaurant in a classy and marvelous hotel.
It's not a dream it's really true

Author: Paloma dNew York City, New York
Title: Not great for the price
Review: Coming from NY it's quite difficult to find this experience as great as it's described by other users. Service was good, food...not on point. We decided to have the discovery experience and it was disappointing. I have to say it took us 2.5hs to eat, almost 20min between courses sometimes...seems that the table with an Indian actor next to us that arrived after us had all the attention for the night...not acceptable. Our favorite, poached egg with mushrooms ( not thrilled it was not the lobster or the wagyu beef...). Food came room temperature, not ideal if you are eating beef or cod. Nothing had the wow factor. If you want to eat while staying at the hotel and do not want local food your best bet is the bar near the lobby, huge cheese plate and amazing mezze platter, sad this is a St Regis because the only thing that feels like a St Regis is the property, not the dinning options and not the service...doubt this will be a St Regis many more years.Show less

Author: Sweetpea1000Hong Kong, China
Title: Great food with a local touch and amazing sunsets!
Review: Great food and great service. Well thought out menu incorporating fresh seafood and local ingredients. We enjoyed lunch, dinner and drinks here during our stay at the St. Regis. The restaurant decor is fantastic. Its also a great spot to watch the sunsets, especially from the hammocks while enjoying the signature sunset cocktail.Show less

Author: MES_LondonLondon
Title: Unique
Review: The atmosphere at Kayu Puti is unique and everyone entering to watch the sunset on one of the over water trampolines or at the bar goes "wow"! This alone is a must do on Langkawi.
