The dining area has the feel of a house in the Hamptons. The food is good but the small menu aims to be exquisite and could do with a slightly more basic approach (recommend the seafood risotto). The vine and cocktail choices are great though and service is excellent. So overall dinner with pre-sunset drinks will make for are a unique and memorable evening. Show less

Author: BillaUSA
Title: The Best It can get
Review: Simply incredible! Location, view, food, wine, ambiance and service.  Even if I wanted to find faults, I couldn't.  I will certainly go back and highly recommend Kayu Puri for a unique fine dinning experience.

Author: mingtings
Title: 這是一個絕對可以造訪的餐廳
Review:
這是一個絕佳可以造訪的餐廳，我在St Regis Langkawei 體驗到世界最差的服務，但是在這餐廳好像是跟這飯店沒有任何關係，服務極好，餐點也有特色，餐廳裝潢也吸引人，但怎麼樣都比不上夕陽時的絕佳景致，這間飯店的除了這間餐廳，服務的水準大概就是50分，反而顯出這間餐廳的出類拔萃，如果你去蘭卡威千萬不要去住St Regis Langkaswei但是這間餐廳是你必訪之地。
if you go to langkawei, please do NOT stay in St regis langkawei it is one of the worse hotel in the world, but Kayuputi in this hotel is one of must go in town.

Author: MsuizaSan Sebastian - Donostia, Spain
Title: Excellence
Review: From A to Z our dining experience was excellent. Beautiful sunset, amazing decoration, perfect food and amazing staff. E prem, Hafiz and the rest of the team did an amazing job. We would recomend this restaurant to anyone. Dont miss the sunset in their hammocks with a bottle of champagne. The best dining experince we ever had. Congratulations!! DominikShow less

Author: WelshBird07
Title: Gorgeous Sunset
Review: Would highly recommend this restaurant / bar for the sunset view with a fantastic array of cocktails. Wonderfully friendly staff and not pretentious in any way.

Author: favoureds
Title: Key Highlights For Our Langkawi Getaway
Review: We were recommended to dine at Kayu Puti and it was the key highlights for us. The sunset view was beyond lovely ... food was awesome and they've got a service staff, Hafez who exuberated so much knowledge and passion for his work.I would totally recommend this place to all who would be visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: HMFLau
Title: A must-visit when in Langkawi
Review: Superb ambience, great food and fantastic view. Highly recommended for lunch, dinner or cocktails!!!

Author: PravrajanNavi Mumbai, India
Title: Limited food but an awesome experience!
Review: Kayputi is part of the St. Regis and one the signature restaurant. The entire restaurant has a sea facing view and the highlight of is the hammocks giving you a sunset experience along with a glass of wine or champagne. The food choices are limited but it doesn't really matter much. A must visit place !Show less

Author: rafharoldTangalle, Sri Lanka
Title: A beautiful modern castle on the sea.
Review: After we checked in at The Westin we had a walk on the beautiful beach. At the left side we discovered a beautiful building on a platform above the sea. Curious as we are we had a look and were welcomed by Mister Gaetan, the executive chef. The building is like a luxury modern castle with an incredible design. There are different spaces for dining, a beautiful open kitchen and a deck + terrace with a great view over the sea.We came for diner the next evening. We first had champagne on the terrace with a breathtaking sunset. Meanwhile Hafiz, our personal waiter explained us the menu and we opted for the Discovery Menu, 7 different dishes with custom wines.The food and presentation was amazing. Mister Gaetan and his team are real magicians with food and realize delicious combinations. The custom wines were well matched and the glasses were well stocked. Hafiz had a very good knowledge about the food which was served.We had a great evening with an amazing dining experience.Strongly we recommend Kayu Puti for food lovers. Thanks to Mister Gaetan, Hafiz and the rest of the team to give us an unforgettable evening !Warm regards,Raf & HaroldShow less

Author: Waleed J
Title: ROMANTIC NIGHT
Review:
The food is super nice taste but very small size so you can consider it as a snakes.

The view is amazing if you set  outdoor 

The shisha is ridiculously expensive and taste just ok

Author: dlcasan
Title: Cocktail and dinner
Review: The most beautiful place for dinner. Relaxing in one of the hammock hanging over the water while having a bottle of champagne. Then have fabulous dinner with perfect service is all I can ask for.

Author: sarah-ghajar
Title: Here is were you need to spend your money...
Review: We spend our anniversary dinner in this restaurant, it was easy choice since we were staying at St. Regis, unfortunately the weather didn't let us to see the beautiful sunset and I am very disappointing for that but experience was so good that we forgot about it in a second.At first we had our drinks at the balcony (where we thought we would see the sunset) followed by dinner inside, considering having 2 years old staff went beyond expectation to help us enjoy our meal. you can imagine how boring this kind of restaurant is for 2 years old, they just keep him busy while we had our wonderful dinner and wine!You need to go if you are in Langkawi and ask Hafiz to choose your wine, my god he knows everything and what he proposed was absolutely worth it. yes it is expensive but i think here is the place you need to spend your money.We both ended up having wagyu beef after seafood appetizer platter and it was to die for.Thank you so much Hafiz for making this night even more special for us.Show less

Author: 884warreneValbonne, France
Title: NOT to be missed - wherever you eat in Langkawi, DO NOT MISS THIS!
Review: AWESOME!From arrival to departure staff at this uber-stylish Boho Chic restaurant (shared between Westin and St Regis hotels) staff tailor your experience entirely.Arrive before sunset and enjoy professionally prepared cocktails in the bar or better still on one of numerous huge hammocks suspended above the sea - worth the visit in itself! Easily the best sunset views in the area. Food is entirely the best I have ever eaten on Langkawi, and beats several European Michelin-starred restaurants hands down (my opinion)... and at a fraction of the price.Try the tasting menu with wine pairings - creative concoctions, beautiful to see, and even better to taste. A delightful assault on the tastebuds.Every course is both a visual and palatable pleasure.If you visit Langkawi and enjoy top level cuisine, this restaurant should be top of your list!Show less

Author: shevlinpierceOrlando, Florida
Title: Stunning Views. Intimate. Architectural Heaven.
Review: This new restaurant is high end. The food was good but not worth the $ unfortunately. Advice: just go for apps and drinks outside overlooking the Strait of Malacca. There shouldn't be kids allowed because the baby crying next to me somewhat spoiled the most beautiful sunset I've ever seen in my life. I rate it a 4 still because of the ambiance! The crab spring rolls were great, scallop was awesome but so expensive for just one, lobster bites were chewy and tiny, the tuna was just mediocre. Service was good, slower than I typically like but fine because it was so peaceful and relaxing. Show less

Author: peksanong
Title: Fantastic service !
Review: Great service provided by Hafiz. We were impressed with the top notch service provided and the food is excellent! Will sure come back again!

Author: smileykoLos Angeles, California
Title: Unforgettable!
Review: I am staying next door at the Westin so I see this white building standing just offshore. I came here in my morning run to see what this thing actually is. I ended up here the same night. All I can say is this is the WOW place in all of Langkawi. After 15 years of living and traveling throughout Asia I must say this is in my top ten in it's dramatic setting alone. The staffs are very worm people. I am traveling solo so it's great to have a place where the staff interacts with you. I ordered the red wine from Australia and just took my time with the pictures and waited for the sunset. Now the food, absolutely stunning to look at, tasted great. This is really a 6 star restaurant and I have to say I shorted them one. You will always remember this place for years and years.Show less

Author: StevenB786
Title: Fabulous
Review: What a great place. Only open for about a year so everything looks new. The restaurant looks quite theatrical - we sat outside which was lovely. The food was amazing and the staff are very friendly thank you Alexander

Author: bremen1018Hong Kong, China
Title: Good tapas
Review: We do not have lots of expectation to the restaurant at the beginning, located inside the St Regis, just like a high-valued canteen. However, it happened that it is not so obvious. I would recommend to try the tapas, not as salty as the original spanish one and served with variety of seafood. Staff there are very patient to answer your queries and explain the dishes one by one before you taste it.Show less

Author: _juliana_berneckerLuneburg, Germany
Title: thumps up!
Review: I stayed for two weeks on Langkawi Island with my Mother and there was one special evening at this beautiful property. I spent some time with my mom at the Kayuputi restaurant which is part of the St. Regis Hotel, we did not expect that we could even eat or stay there as we are not in-house guests, what I can say is just stunning location and top service! Especially Kayuputi when you get through the antique door of Kayuputi restaurant, you dive into a new world of fascinating art décor with an fantastic food and beverages offer, a mix of royal interior and hammocks, which invite you to relax– while the professional service reminds you continually to just enjoy. It was amazing! But not only because of the ocean - view & the “sunset cocktail” service was fantastic, especially because there was no second we had to wait for something. The first thing was the service offered us a cold towel in the outside terrace with an own eucalyptus smell “which they call Kayuputi essence” After discovering the island on an hot sunny day this cooled towel was a nice refreshment. The service was something, I never expected on an Malaysian escape island. Jan the manager of the Restaurants recommended very professional some special drinks from the cocktail Menu and he talked about Langkawi island and their standards which they call St. Regis Rituals. We felt very comfortable and this Restaurant was one of my favorite spots about Langkawi Island. We hope we can come again next year or the year after to stay in that Hotel. (Thumbs up!)Show less

Author: GuyfromkzAlmaty, Kazakhstan
Title: Gourmet tasting
Review: This is a great place for a special dinner. We went with our children and found it not suitable for children, but still they enjoyed veranda with some desserts. Design of the place, experience menu with a personal touch from French chef and greeting from GM created a feeling of personalized service. Our dinner amounted to 2000 myr, which is quite a lot for a family dinner, but we enjoyed the wine pick and 67 degrees poached egg. All was great, but i believe that kids menu doesn't worth the money charged.Show less

Author: François S
Title: Kudos for location, cuisine, chef and staff
Review: Superb lunch and dinig experience in this over the water, luxury restaurant.Food is creative e.g. vacuum, low temperature cooking of fish or meat - and delicious. Staff is professional and pleasant. The view on the surrounding bay and islands is simply paridise. As expected, not really cheap but quite an experience.Show less

Author: IDC637Washington Dc
Title: Wonderful setting, food and service
Review: When with three other friends for lunch and had a wonderful experience. The restaurant is located in the St. Regis resort in Langkawi, Malaysia. It's away from the main buildings and it occupies its own pavilion built on stilts over the water and its beautifully and whimsically decorated with grand views of the surrounding waters. We were taken to the Kayuputi restaurant pavilion on an over-sized golf cart and it avoided a lot of walking, after lunch they did the same thing in reverse. The place has a very individual look in lite blues, grays, whites and distressed wood. The chairs are of very different shapes and many are covered on calf skins and a few have high feathers on top like processional horses. None of this whimsical decor detracts from the excellent service and the food quality.We were seated at a corner table with views of the villas and the beach, just picture perfect. We ordered regular Western drinks like martinis and Bloody Marys and they were terrific. We ordered local grilled red snapper and French fries and roasted vegetables to share, just great.For dessert we we ordered a couple of cake made around a small banana and with maple ice cream all very delicious. At the end we had espresso coffees. This was a very special experience and highly recommended.Show less

Author: VineyardBluefish
Title: Amazing.
Review: This place is truly amazing. We did the tasting menu and every dish was amazing, creative and beautiful.  Go.

Author: Expat_TravellerSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful setting, lovely menu and attentive staff!
Review: A stunning setting and a fantastic interior sets the scene for a special dinner. I am staying at the St Regis solo and was a little apprehensive about dining alone but the staff were acutely aware and made a great effort to talk to me and ensure that every need was catered for. The restaurant offers a small menu that showcases both local fish and seafood and some more classic pasta dishes for the less adventurous. If anything, it would have been great to see more of a Malay influence through the menu but I had the scallops to start followed by fantastic tortellini and I was very happy with my choices!It is on the more expensive side but it wasn't nearly as much as I was expecting given that it is part of the St Regis. Certainly money well spent and I look forward to returning with my partner so we can really draw out the evening and soak up the stunning views! Show less

Author: Richard Y
Title: Amazing restaurant
Review:
Fantastic restaurant
Excellent food
Amazing views
A tad expensive, for Malaysia
Even if not staying at the St Regis, it's a must visit

Author: GinaloveShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: beautiful restaurant with breathtaking view
Review: If you are staying at St Regis, please do not miss the opportunity to visit this signature restaurant. Kayuputi is a superbly beautiful restaurant infused with local architecture with mediterranean interior flair and was beyond words. Even if you choose not to have lunch or dinner here, please take the time to walk to the restaurant and enjoy the sunset over an evening cap on the water hammock.It is so beautiful, it will take your breath away.Show less

Author: ShaneLiuwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great little gem of a place
Review: Found this restaurant while walking along the beach when we were staying at Westin Langkawi. Great find as it's currently not found listed on TripAdvisor Langkawi as it doesn't show it as a nearby restaurant or things to do. Really quiet place during lunch and after dinner time. Great little place for photo takings and relaxing while sipping away a glass of wine and a very good mix of sangria. Food was really good too! Wagyu tenderloin, 63 degrees egg and foie gras were our favourite! A little pricey here but well worth for the food quality, service and scenery. Been back 3 times already. Will highly recommend. Show less

Author: AndyGers766Culcheth, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful restaurant and setting
Review: Enjoyed cocktails here on the beautiful white wood ("Kayu Puti") outside deck, where patrons can watch the sun set as they recline on cushioned catamaran-style trampolines, suspended above the Andaman Sea listing to live soft jazz.Welcomed, showed around the restaurant with its stunning open kitchen and served impeccably by Hafiz, we shared the seafood paella which, we were told, employed a local variety of rice instead of a classic paella variety. It was a success, not creamy like arborio but a pleasant alternative. Very fresh snapper, green muscles, scallops, squid and king prawns helped make this one of the better paellas I've had in SE Asia and a good hearty portion for two.We couldn't manage dessert and declined the offer of a buggy to return to our suite, choosing instead to offset the carb fest with a short walk back to our suite at the St Regis, along lantern-lit raised walkways over the sea...Whether we might have fared better with a £100 (two cocktails, no wine, one starter, main course) at a local independent restaurant, we shall have to see but there can be no doubt that this restaurant is making a valiant effort to deliver food and service a cut above the standard luxury outlet.Show less

Author: BeachLife2620Santa Rosa, California
Title: Simply perfection!!!
Review: This restaurant has the most captivating ambiance on the island!!!! The decor is breathtaking. So many amazing areas to highlight. The outdoor hammocks are beautiful and romantic. The staff has such attention to detail and are truly genuine in creating the perfect cocktails for you. Dinner--- where to begin. The tuna tartare is amazing and plated beautifully. The snapper is incredible and the lamb as well. Jan and his team are remarkable. This restaurant will forever make a lasting impression on you. Don't pass up the opportunity to experience this romantic setting! Show less

Author: ghettomasterMelbourne, Australia
Title: Romantic dinner and drinks location
Review: We found this place by accident and ended up going for a drink each night we were in Langkawi. Situated on stilts out over the bay in between the Westin and the St Regis make sure you grab a cocktail on one of the hammocks for the sunset. The food here is incredible and the degustation was as good as any 5 star restaurant - highly recommended. We went for my girlfriends birthday and were very well looked after by all the staff. 5 stars all round.Show less

Author: josephg493Hong Kong, China
Title: twice there for dinner
Review: lovely setting, above water, and the right scale of the interiors ...first night i had roasted lamb (presented well but not to my liking), and the signature chocolate cake (presented beautifully but tasted a little sour, funny for a desert). everything else was perfect: the starters, her cod fish, and the pandan tart. the wine list was fairly priced.service was great. brief chat, good menu suggestions, never intrusive. had to return.the second night we chose paella for two, good choice. I ordered something new for dessert, coconut pudding. strange, it tasted somewhat off with that cooked banana sour flavor ... not for me.we enjoyed ourselves both nights. thank you.Show less

Author: JeremyC13
Title: One of the best restaurants outside London.
Review: Stunning location, wonderful attentive staff (s who remember your name), and excellent food, beautifully presented. Try lying on the deck whilst watching the sun go down!

Author: Asteroid2015
Title: Great place the watch sun set
Review: Great place to watch the sun set with a loved one laying in the sail. The restaurant have a great look.

Author: jamiep84Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Lovely setting, well presented but just not there on flavour
Review: We watched the sun set from the veranda, which was great, had a lovely cocktail and the waiters brought round canapes which was a nice touch. We then went for dinner which was a little disappointing sadly. The food was incredibly well presented and looked beautiful, but the flavours just weren't as good as we expected. The menu choice is slightly limited, so you don't have a whole lot of freedom which doesn't help either, but even the meat itself just wasn't as good as we expected. It was a good meal, but for the price they're charging we expected it to be exceptional. Service however was very good as you'd expect from a St Regis restaurant.Show less

Author: Pezaad
Title: Overpriced, limited choices, okay food
Review:
We were staying at Westin and went here for dinner one night. 
The food is mediocre. Nothing special.
Overpriced food
Limited options
The staff lacks basic fine dining restaurant etiquettes. 
Please avoid
The restaurants at Westin are far better

Author: SARAHDEHAYSPerth, Australia
Title: delicious food & excellent service
Review: I love love love this restaurant at the st.Regis langkawi, the food, the views and the service is fantastic, one of the most amazing dinners we have ever had. the views are breathtaking. So much to choose from on the menu , I highly recommend the red snapper! the interior of this restaurant is just outstanding , one of the most beautiful restaurants Ive ever been to.Show less

Author: Nicoleb12345sydney
Title: One of the best paella's ever eaten!

Author: Memory_maker_mumMelbourne, Australia
Title: Breathtaking!
Review: A 5 star experience! We were greeted with open arms from the moment we arrived. We were taken to the deck, where we relaxed on the canopies with amazing cocktails. As a coeliac, I was also catered for with beautiful gluten free bread and a gluten free meal. Thank you St. Regis. We will definitely be back Show less

Author: dawsonpdMelbourne, Australia
Title: Luxurious, Peaceful,
Review: Kayuputi is 'White Wood' inspired by its Balinese owner, presents a decor of mother of pearl, peacocks, Vietnamese colonial windows and Persian influences. Suspended over the quiet waters of the Andaman sea, the restaurant is positioned to watch the sun set with couches, and cantilevered sails with cushions to sip cocktails and watch the fishing activity begin as the day ends. Entering the air-conditioned restaurant, it separates into multiple rooms with high ceilings to keep the dining experience intimate. The Decor is quirky, multinational and interesting and amazingly flows despite multiple unrelated exhibits. As a family of five adults we elected the degustation with matched wines. Positioned to watch the kitchen we could see the care in preparation. The standout was the tuna tartare on a bed of avocado matched with a flinty Semillon from Orange (AUS) It followed with scallop matched with a mineral french chardonnay from Chablis, an egg, spinach and potato dish brilliantly matched with a St Emillion red before the Australian wagu steak rare, gorgeous jus with steamed vegetables. The vegetables plain, unsalted, slightly cooked to maintain an intense flavour. The NZ Craggy Range merlot was a worthy companion. Finally deconstructed lemon tart presented as 'Saturn' and a Taittinger champagne. The service was synchronised - which I have only found once before in a three star michelin. The staff proud and happy to be working in such an establishment. The Swiss Sommelier was enthusiatic and displayed understanding of wines from the world and their presentation. He is likely to maintain and develop their association with food. The selections were perfectly matched. The style of food unashamedly ranged from simple presentation of flavour and brilliantly sourced produce to complex deconstruction. It is expensive with our evening at over $A1000. It is worth joining as an SPG member to get a discount. This is a great evening with no multiple sittings and noise, but aims to transport by its peaceful surrounds and sunset and beauty of world designs new and old.Show less

Author: KLGuy69Ampang, Malaysia
Title: The best Moroccan cuisine in Malaysia. A must visit if you're in Langkawi.
Review: My friends and I decided to try out this restaurant after reading about it in TripAdvisor. Plus we have travelled to Morocco back in 2018 for almost 3 weeks and have learned a thing or two about Moroccan cuisine. We absolutely LOVED Moroccan food especially all of their tagine dishes.We visited Argan Trees in mid December 2020 and let's just say we glad we did. Although we were the only diners there that night, the food did not disappoint at all. The whole meal was hearty, earthy and so delicious, it brought back very fond memories of our trip to Morocco. Cumin is one of key ingredients in Moroccan cuisine and we tasted the fragrant cumin together with other spices in the chicken and vegetable tagines we ordered. The couscous that was served together with the vegetable tagine was perfectly cooked, seasoned and making it a hearty compliment to the chicken tagine. We also ordered an appetizer and they served it with very warm buns. The pickled olives and pickled white onions were very refreshing. The mashed brinjals, tomatoes and hummus were all savory appetizers to tease your taste buds, making you wanting more of it. It was the perfect combinations to start a meal. I have posted some pictures of the dishes we ordered and enjoyed. See how we 'cleaned' out each dishes.Both the owner and his son were very hospitable and made us feel very warm and welcoming to their family owned restaurant. When we shared with them about our holiday trip to Morocco, they offered us to wear their men's traditional robes and took pictures of us in it. It was indeed an amazing dinner experience as we will remember that night's dinner for years to come.Now, my only complaint about the food or restaurant is that they are located in Langkawi and not in KL. You see, there are no authentic Moroccan restaurants in KL. There are quite a few middle eastern restaurants in KL that served some Moroccan dishes but they are far from being an authentic Moroccan restaurant. Overall, I love the food, the ambience and the hospitality showered to us by the owner. I'm looking forward (and am already planning) my next visit to The Argan Trees.If you are in Langkawi, don't forget to dine here. Sample their authentic Moroccan dishes and I bet you will remember them for quite some time after that.Show less

Review: A mixed bag really. We were expecting great things from the reviews and it started well with the mixed starter which was excellent. My meatball tagine was well over done, actually black around the edges. By the time it finished sizzling it was virtually dry. One of our party had the Saffa Surprise after some rave reviews on here. It was actually just some very bland couscous, we all tried it and felt the same. Someone did suddenly present us with some sauce but we’d nearly finished by then. The fish tagine however was excellent, very tasty indeed.After our mains plates were taken we were looking forward to trying the tea mentioned several times in these reviews and may be some fruit or dessert. However, after being totally ignored by the waiter for a full 20 minutes, we gave up, paid the bill and left.Really not what we expected from all the good reviews on here.Show less

Author: louise BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best meal I have enjoyed in a long time
Review: Having visited Morocco and loved the food I was keen to try the Argan Trees. The family owners were very friendly and had wonderful photography books that they shared, full of pictures so I could remember my trip to Morocco. I ordered the beef with Prune Tagine and this was “melt in your mouth” delicious. It came with warm bread to soak up the sauce. This meal was even better than what I had in Morocco.They do not serve alcohol but have plenty of juices plus the traditional mint tea. The menu also has other non Moroccan options but seriously, you are crazy if you miss a Moroccan tagine so full of flavour. Have a meal and go to a bar afterwards if you must have alcohol. The restaurant was not busy, although I was there early and it is very reasonably priced.I did try to convince them to move to Melbourne Australia (where I live) as I would love to eat here all the time.Show less

Author: CeJayLBuenos Aires, Argentina
Title: You will fall in love with this restaurant and the family who runs it!
Review: It’s impossible not to fall in love with this restaurant. It’s run by a lovely family, who will make you feel you’re at home. They were super attentive and kind, sharing their culture and love for Morocco. It was my birthday and they surprised us with a delicious cake with my name on it, singing happy birthday in their native language. It was very moving. I felt at home. And about the food, it was our first time trying Moroccan food, so when we didn’t know what to order. And they took the time to go through the menu with us and give us recommendations. Every single thing we tried was delicious. The quality, presentation, taste, and smell were just beautiful.The mix appetizers give you a little taste of everything, great way to begin a meal. Then the barkok meat tagine was amazing, sweet and salty and so good! The saffa surprise felt like I tried for the first time a new kind of food, something completely different from every other thing I tried in my life. It was delicious. And the Moroccan tea was amazing, being poured right at your table. It was a show on its own.After the meal, they asked us if we wanted to dress in traditional clothes and take pictures. They were super kind, taking many pictures and, again, making us feel right at home.I cannot express in words how lucky I felt having my birthday dinner in this place. It was truly moving. The Argan Trees is more than a restaurant. It’s an experience. Two thumbs up!Show less

Title: If you like food, you will love it here!
Review: Most restaurants just provide food. At Argan Trees they provide an experience you’ll never forget. It’s run by a loving family, super attentive and kind. They showed us books about Morocco, talked to us about their culture. After a few minutes, we desperately wanted to visit their country! And, after the food arrived, we even started looking at plane tickets to Morocco. The dishes were a piece of art: beautiful, smelling like heaven and tasting even better. We had the mix appetizers, saffa surprise and barkok meat tagine, all with moroccan tea. Every single thing was delightful. And when we finished our food, they asked us if we wanted to dress in traditional clothes to take pictures. It was so fun! The Argan Trees is more than a restaurant: it’s an ever-lasting experience, a way into a new culture, and a night you’ll never forget.Show less

They offer Moroccan & Mediterranean cuisine and the food tastes like real homemade. In addition, this amazing restaurant makes you have a memorable experience since you get to experience true Moroccan Hospitality. You can dine while wearing a Moroccan ‘Tarboush’ hat and even take a photoshoot with several traditional Moroccan clothes. Guests can also read many books about Morocco while waiting for their food. I recommend the best seller dish ‘Meat with Barkok Tagine’ which is absolutely delicious. Furthermore, they have numerous unique foods and products for sale from Morocco. Last but not least, the service is outstanding and all the family and staff are very friendly. Thank you for everything & see you again soon!Show less

Author: maria8842
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: That was my first time trying Moroccan cuisine and it was fantastic!!! It’s absolutely not spicy (unlike most Asian cuisine), very understandable for Europeans (without chicken feet or weird taste combinations), presenting was impressive (mesmerizing way of pouring tea into a glass from height, sizzling tagine). Staff was very hospitable, they seem to love what they’re doing. Don’t miss it out while in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Niller82
Title: Grelt food, moroccan cuisine😋
Review: We went as family, and we are Happy to finding this place. Great service, food was well cooked and great tasteWe will come back next time Langkawi is in the travel calender fore sure.The Great Danes - Who loves tasteful food...☺️Show less

Author: Niall MSingapore
Title: Must visit

We ate the hummus and chilli prawns to start and then as a main we had a vegetable tangine, mixed grill, and a chicken dish with rice and some side bread. All the food was of such high quality and we will definitely go back here before our stay is over. Would recommend to anyone. Show less

Author: eatdrinkstayBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: A little taste of Morocco
Review: Lovely friendly place, good menu and nice to have a change of cuisine when away for a long time. We knew before hand but they do not serve alcohol. The food is all very delicious not big big portions but we were satisfied with what we had. It’s moderate in price but compared to home very reasonable . All very fresh and very tasty authentic Moroccan food.Show less

Author: SueAnneChew
Title: Happy hour
Review: Love the happy hour deals. Music is great, ambient is cozy. The selection of gin is crazy. Happy hour half price was very cheap.

Author: jellsieScotland, United Kingdom
Title: Stay cool
Review: Verandah is nice and comfortable place.congratulation to person incharge of Verandah. Suzi Nico especially wati good job Show less

Author: anne_milleyScotland, United Kingdom

Author: W8967VEsusanpHong Kong, China
Title: Stunning
Review: We celebrated our Wedding Anniversary at The Verandah. Fabulous place for the occasion. Service was impeccable. Surroundings are oppulent but relaxing. The highlight of food would be the Chaeteubriand. This is a sharing plate, more than enough for 2 people. Would highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: MARIAmixaelaAthens, Greece
Title: Best collection of gin and amazing people working there
Review: Staying at the Danna we really enjoyed our afternoon drinks at the Verandah. Thanks God they do have amazing people working there willing to help you to choose the gin , the garnish and even the tonic water. But the most helpful of all was Sam, such a lovely person, always with a smile on her face, and with amazing knowledges about all types of gin, all the garnish you can try depending on your taste and very attentive to your taste in drinks just to be ready next day to suggest you something else. She made me love the gin more then I even imagine and even teach me a lot of things to can enjoy this drink in my own house. Thank you Sam for the amazing job you do and for being so attentive and congratulations to Danna management to taking so good care in choosing their staff.Show less

Author: Cat Z
Title: Calling all gin lovers...!
Review: Verandah has a massive selection of Gins if you are a lover and you can customise your mixer and even your garnish. Verandah is a beautiful space with excellent service. Show less

Author: kristaridingWellington, New Zealand
Title: We had many lovely evenings here

Author: Coleman37
Title: Good food, great service
Review: We had breakfast every morning. The best part was the faultless service. Food was good, in a buffet style with a small a la carte menuShow less

Author: TheYumL

Author: mike cTownsville, Australia

Author: Dawn SPerth, Australia
Title: Fabulous
Review: A lovely ambience and a great place to while away an evening. A gin collection to die for, not to mention some rather special whiskeys. Great cocktails all served by lovely friendly staff.Show less

Author: drizz12Bucharest, Romania
Title: Great cocktails
Review: Great cocktails and nice life music every evening. Nice winery room near and also special cigarettes roomShow less

Author: Sandy B

Author: Harry LSydney, Australia

Author: twiggyseymourHong Kong, China

We especially enjoyed the wonderful Negronis that we're served to us, the best we've had. Show less

Author: jamiecooteLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing place
Review: First class staff and fantastic choice of drinks, from beers and cocktails to fine wines and champagnes. Entertainment is good with a very good resident singer and band.I wish this place was my local Show less

Author: Suni-JayHope Island, Australia

Author: 222frankaSingapore, Singapore

Author: Adrian H

Show less

Author: musasuhaidah281

Author: mike c

Author: katemillyjBathurst, Australia

Author: adamlh58

Author: aphsanayasmin

Author: 43cliffgDarebin, Australia

Author: Umair S

Author: SamB1368

Author: Mikael KCopenhagen, Denmark

Time stoppedNd we chit chatted and sipped our drinks, until hunger drove us further...Show less

Author: Moskito_manLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice Bar
Review: The main hotel bar in Danna is the Verandah. The setting is lovely and the staff proficient in serving you quickly. Unfortunately not many guests use the bar so it is often empty. This bar also has a happy hour from 10.30pm and is great value if you want an after dinner drink. As there were 4 in our party we enjoyed the quietness as we played cards most evening.Show less

Author: koenv526Bornem, Belgium

They even let my wife try out to make our own cocktails during a quiet moment in the bar, which she (and I) enjoyed very much!Show less

Author: Eimear N
Title: Luxury stay in Danna Langkawi
Review: Had some drinks in the Verandah bar during our stay in the Danna, amazing cocktails nice nibbles and excellent bar staff service

Author: BBMC78
Title: Great dinner!
Review: We enjoyed the Italian dishes that we ordered alongside the view! The waiter recommended to refreshing drinks which we enjoyed.

Author: Charissa P
Title: Nice relaxing ambience
Review: The verendah is opened from 5pm onward to 1am. You can enjoy your drinks and live music at 8pm. I do love the environment.  It creates a good relaxing time with your love ones.

Author: L967GValanlBourne End
Title: Great cocktails, great ambience and lovely staff
Review: We spent 13 nights at the Danna Hotel and enjoyed cocktails in The Verandah every night before and after dinner. There is a great choice (I think we worked our way through most of them!) always beautifully served with some local snacks. Arasu King, the Bar Manager became more of a friend always happy for a chat and very entertaining, with great knowledge of the cocktails and even made us individual ones one night when we were talking of one that was not in the menu. My husband is interested in wines and he was happy to show us the wines in the 'wine room' which was very interesting. Shout out to the other boys who served in there who were all very courteous and happy to chat - Azif, Hairul and the lovely trainee Edward - he had a great sense of humour and will go far. There is live music most evenings provided by Azlin Abdullah and either her son or husband, they were great - background music at this time of year as low season but much more lively in the high season even playing in the beach on BBQ evenings. You can have a meal in the Verandah if you wish, we tended to go into Planters restaurant as it was the same menu, coming back for more cocktails afterwards. The decor is very colonial in fitting with the rest of the hotel and very high quality comfortable chairs. There is an outside room and a separate smoking room . I highly recommend The Verandah and thank you Arasu and your team for making our time with you so much fun. Hope to be back one day. Show less

Author: 43cliffg

Review: Nice space to sit and relax, read a book or play games.   Unwind after a shopping trip or outdoor activities.

Author: wing_wingggg

Review: We went here a number of times whilst staying at the Danna.  Arasu served us some great cocktails and was always up for a chat.

Author: TravelwithGarIreland

Author: jamesmacneilAuchterarder, United Kingdom

Title: A comfortable and relaxing place to enjoy a drink

Author: gunnarhansli

Author: JulieSwanseaSwansea

Author: Olive M
Title: Lovely
Review: Had a lovely meal here. There was a beautiful sunset as well.The food was delicious in the true Italian manner.

Author: izumit2017
Title: Tasty food, friendly staff and superb service
Review: The staff were super friendly, and they were well trained too.. We came in for lunch and also to celebrate my mom's birthday. We had a tikka chicken and chicken satay for starters, and yes, it was much tastier than I imagine it would be. For the mains we had beef rendang, prawn sambal, fish and chip from the kids menu (which was a generous portion) the fish curry and also stemmed grilled chicken and it was a nice lunch.After we finished our main, I asked them to serve the cake that they prepared for mom and all the three staff that was serving us came singing along the birthday song with us, it was a happy moment for my mom.. Overall, it was a nice lunch with a small birthday celebration. Please forward my thanks to Mr Kritik for receiving my reservation and making time to come and greet us, and also my thanks for the three friendly staff that served us, we had a lovely afternoon and we enjoyed our time there.Again, thank you so much for giving us a great time. We really enjoyed it. Keep up the good work and all the best for your carrier.Show less

Author: adybrown74Brighton, United Kingdom

Author: firieguy

Author: michaeltA1182UL
Title: By far the best venue in Langkawi for dinner & drinks
Review: I was blown away by the friendliness a professionalism delivered by the team.We decided to order dinner from the main restaurant which was personally delivered to our tableThe culinary & beverage experience was truely memorable and clearly the best dining experience in Langkawi.We felt that our overall experience wouldn't have been possible without the service and hospitality provided by Arasu he is truly an asset to the venue and I hope to experience his hospitality on our next visit in the coming months.Arasu kindly guided us through each course and ensured nothing short of perfection from himself and staff.We were also introduced to bespoke cocktails that was amazing and not to mention one of the best private cigar lounges i have ever seen!At the end of the evening, we felt like family and was truely sad to leave, we will return to Langkawi based on this experience and will continue to speak highly of the experience received by Arasu and the team at The Verandah. - Thank You!Show less

Author: MelnETPerth

Author: granitavGosford, Australia
Title: Away from the crowds
Review: The Verandah is a beautiful, quiet relaxing lounge where we always went at 5pm for Happy Hour even though you can enjoy Happy Hour throughout the complex. Magnificent furniture and fittings including a grand piano, piped music and dance floor when needed. Meals and snacks, coffee etc can be served here too though we had most meals in the Plantation restaurant. Happy Hour is from 5-7.30 pm and all at 50%discount. The average cost is about A$9 for 2 people and believe me they give you a real mean cocktail, no skimping on content. Tasty nibbles come with the drinks whilst you await your drinks.Also there is a very well stocked wine cellar including some huge Jeroboams of French champagne for anyone game to buy one and drink it.The staff there were most friendly, helpful and inquisitive about Australia so we chatted freely and openly with them all. The room whilst we were there was probably underused which suited us fine and probably due to the many other areas you can sit, drink and dine. For a quiet time seek out this lounge,Show less

Author: Shazzax
Title: Relaxing lounge for pre and post dinner drinks
Review: What more can be said. A very comfortable and relaxing lounge for a special cocktail or after dinner drink. The staff in this lounge were wonderful. Live music is a bonus that was very enjoyable.

Author: Redknaps
Title: Verandah
Review: Great place to enjoy a cocktail and unwind. Great staff extremely welcoming and friendly, especially Hairun.

Author: CherrieR19
Title: Nice bar
Review: Enjoyed happy hour at The Veranda each afternoon, staff wonderful, especially Wan and Bella. Husband and son even enjoyed a cigar in the cigar and wine room !!Show less

Author: Frans_12255060Broadbeach, Australia
Title: Outstanding venue, great value
Review: The Verandah is a beautiful lounge bar, and the perfect place To have cocktails before dinner.The space has a soaring ceiling, beautiful marble, mirror and timber finishes, and classy furniture. It oozes style.The cocktails are mixed with care and genuine desire to please-- we were asked each time if they were to our liking, and they were,The prices at any time are very reasonable ( US$7 for a cocktail) , but at happy hour between 5pm And 7pm they are half price, which is outstanding value. You also get a bowl of just deep fried cashews, plus some other nibbles, so it's great. Wine by the glass is served with a small carafe in a little ice bucket-- a bit of fun, and great if you like your wine cold. There is nice recorded jazz, plus live music at certain times. If you want you can have a full meal, chosen from the menu from Planters Restaurant.Our only problem was leaving-- it was very tempting each night just to settle in and pass the time chatting, watching, and of course sipping a great cocktailShow less

Author: Helen M
Title: Very good
Review: Very lovely bar ! Relaxed and friendly ! Bella and Wan very good bar staff keen to help and give recommendations on things to do and see. Very welcoming Show less

Author: stefgaughranLondon, United Kingdom
Title: holiday
Review: Bella and Wan were both very helpful and friendly . They made us very welcome each night and took the trouble to get to know us well. Show less

Author: helenpX7012EDWellington, New Zealand
Title: Fab staff
Review: Great setting. Live music most nights. Unfortunately this bar is not taken advantage of enough. Thanks Bella and Awan. You're great people. Keep up the good work. Show less

Author: Getaway534209
Title: Relaxed Casual Yet sophisticated...
Review: Loved the Verandah room - fantastic cocktails great staff, excellent place for a pre dinner drink or night cap! Show less

Author: sushicrazy
Title: Great service, happy hour, snacks, music and service
Review: Very pleasant bar to enjoy nightly happy hour.  Loved the music in the background. Favorite server was Hairu, the smile on his face was a delight. Comfy inviting bar to relax and be catered to.

Author: HENRYTCTSingapore, Singapore
Title: Relaxing Family Moments
Review: Great environment to have a family chilling out time and enjoying get together drinks after a long day out exploring the beautiful island. Friendly and accommodating staff was prompt to our needs for some quick snacks. Overall, wonderful and relaxing experience in a fantastic setup. Show less

Author: Douglas D
Title: Happy hour 5-7 pm
Review: Always visited at happy hour, for a pre-dinner cocktail (or two). The drinks were beautifully presented and served. Wonderful experience.

Author: Susanna H
Title: Best spot!!!
Review: My favorite time in Langkawi was spent on The Verandah.. :-) The girls working there are soo friendly, professional and kind!! Takes great care of you and knows a lot about the wine. Great prices, especially during happy hour. Drinks are excellent and selection of wine by the glass is wide. And sooo nice wines! Wish to go back some day!Show less

Author: chrissI6403OJ
Title: Great for cocktails
Review: The cocktails made here are excellent, even better when it is happy hour. Service is extremely good, nice ambience at the end of the day, nice staff

Author: Gordon H
Title: Great place to chill out
Review: Nice bar, good service, great range of drinks. Live music some evenings. Just a nice place to sit and chill after a long day sightseeing.

Author: JilllianLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: After dinner drinks
Review: Nice enough bar for a drink after dinner, but never anybody in it really. Think they must all go to bed early or maybe we'll have to try it pre dinner. Show less

Author: Narcissus666Williton, United Kingdom
Title: The best place to eat for fine dining in Langkawi
Review: If you visit Langkawi this place is a must. Wonderfully prepared food with the finest of ingredients, oriental, European and Malaysian fayre of the finest. This is not a cheap option so don't come here if you are on a budget but if you adore your food and want to dine in lovely sophisticated surroundings with a very accomplished piano player expertly interpreting some beautiful pieces of music both classical and modern this is the place for you. Well behaved children are welcome. Outside dining on the terrace overlooking the pool beach and sea or inside in the lovely cool air conditioned restaurant. My favourite place in Langkawi thanks to the wonderfully run and impressive Dana Hotel.Show less

Author: Porkpie78
Title: Calm and serene
Review: We recently stayed at the Danna and had drinks a Verandah. The bar is very relaxing with a lovely ambient feel. Staff are courteous and the quality of the drinks and service was excellent.Show less

Author: 757DanIRoche, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Great menu offer, great service. The menu has a large selection which will appeal to all tastes. The food was well presented. The service was very good, all of the staff were very good and made sure you had what you wanted. The wine list covered all the top wines and the wine by the glass offer was quality. Show less

Author: MischaG84
Title: Relaxed atmosphere, gorgeous food
Review:
Stayed at the Danna; ate here a couple of times and had drinks most other evenings. Absolutely loved the food, drinks and service. Cannot fault it.

Live music was a nice touch too

Author: Sheila FBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Happy hour and live entertainment
Review: Drinks before and after dinner with attentive staff who remember your preferred drink(s)All staff willing to converse while delivering drinks and pass on hints of where to visit the following day.Show less

Author: LovDac
Title: Feb 2016
Review:
Perfect for the afternoon Happy hour after time in the sun. 
Great staff. 
You can also enjoy the evening of soft music. 
This is s large room for socializing and enjoying a drink

Author: PedritocalheirosPorto, Portugal
Title: Nice Bar with live music
Review: We ate here a lot since we had our 10 months baby and we wanted a more private place than the main restaurant, besides it has live music every night.The food is the same as in the main restaurant and it's a more quiet place, overall very nice.Show less

Author: TravelwithGar
Title: Superb cocktails
Review: If you are looking for an excellent cocktail in Langkawi, then 'the Verandah' @ the Danna is a must visit. Nabila & team offer a very warm welcome & superb cocktails.

Author: markjhiggs
Title: Excellent!
Review: This is an excellent place for exceptional cocktails. Happy hour is from 5-7 pm. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed!

Author: AshwindSMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great cocktails, attentive staff and good live entertainment
Review: We stayed at the Danna and went to the Verandah most nights for happy hour (5-7pm) which was great. Fantastic cocktails and a nice atmosphere. The staff were great, in particular Nabila was lovely. There was a great singer on every evening from 8pm also. You can also get dinner at the Verandah which was lovely and nicer than sitting at the hotel restaurant because of the live entertainment.Show less

Author: dougg812
Title: Cocktails at the Verandah
Review: Happy hour can not be missed, the choice of cocktails was exceptional and the service was perfect. Happy Hr is 1700-1900.

Author: RCHLMHFleet, United Kingdom
Title: I don't normally eat in a hotel bar...
Review: However, the staff and the food in this bar are really five star! Most evenings there is a singer, but inside it doesn't really gel in terms of atmosphere. There is however a nice quiet outside terrace which is an ideal place for an evening drink or lighter meal. The staff are exceptionally pleasant and well trained, and this area really works.Show less

Author: Steve LPenarth, United Kingdom
Title: Boring no atmosphere
Review: I stayed at the hotel for 2 weeks and didn't hardly use this bar. It was mostly empty and had therefore no atmosphere. They had a duet singer who sang almost to an empty roomShow less

Author: UKcriticLancashire, England
Title: Great for a drink but food arrived cold
Review: Comfortable and classy bar with sensible drinks prices (especially Happy Hour). As with everywhere in the Danna, the staff are lovely. The food is prepared in the main restaurant so ours was cold after being transferred. Shame really.There's also a Cigar Lounge attached. I did consider trying it but didn't get chance. Cigar prices are about where you would expect and pleasingly there's no big mark-up like you see in some other hotels. They have a decent selection although many weren't actually available.For me, the food is the only blemish at the Danna. If it matched the staff and facilities, it would be a truly stellar place to stay.Show less

Author: stephb157
Title: Great cocktail bar
Review: An extensive array of cocktails and other drinks. Service was impeccable, we were served by Nabil and Hairul who were excellent.

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Great Cocktails !!!!!!!!!
Review: Been meaning to come here for cocktails but we were a bit early last week and were ushered to partake our cocktails at the pool bar area instead which was equally as nice. Very happy with our Peach Margarita and Bloody Mary.So, we just had to come again to Verandah ... Missed its 7-9 pm happy hours time slot but no big deal since the price for the cocktails are actually reasonable for the quality they serve. Our Kir Royal, Midnight Mint, Grasshopper and a chocolaty-vodka-based cocktails were simply divine.And to top it up, the lady who served us, Nabil, was absolutely charming and professional. Definitely a credit to the establishment.Will be back again in the very near future.Show less

Author: Just4delanziSydney, Australia
Title: Ate lunch whilst waiting for check in
Review: Average food at really high prices. Suggest restaurants at the Marina in front of the hotel instead or at Pantai ChenangShow less

Author: HO DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Restaurant by the river
Review: Most selection preferably western cuisine to be precised a good choice when dinning at this place by the river where many yachts anchored nearby. Sit outside opposite the restaurant would be ideal & breezy provided it does not rain. The staff service is normal & friendly and food portion & taste reasonable. When you dine here, forget about the price.....dine yourself like a VIP and enjoy your food. There are a selection of food...chicken, beef, lamb, fish, veggie & desserts depends on what you want & how you want it done. The main attraction is not sitting inside the restaurant but experienced outsideShow less

Author: masimkhanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: A great bar and live music spot but their specialty is making you feel at home
Review: The place has a great collection of wines, great ambiance and to top it all off, great live music except Tuesdays i think. The staff is really helpful (not to mention really pretty). They also have a very good collection of teas if you have a taste for that kind of thing.Show less

Author: Phil YSunderland, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service and drinks
Review: We have been staying at the Danna for the last 10 days. The service at the Verandah is excellent. Happy hour available 1700 to 1900. Excellent cocktails and a band plays there several nights a week. Very comfortable environment to sit back and relax. Show less

Author: MissRed77Dublin, Ireland
Title: Lovely hotel bar serving restaurant food
Review: I've already submitted my overall Hotel Danna review, but wanted to add one specifically for the restaurant(s). The main restaurant is Planter's, but the Verandah bar also provides the same menu as the restaurant. As hotel guests, we breakfasted in Planter's every morning and enjoyed a dinner there on one night. We elected to dine in the Verandah on a further two nights, largely for a change of scenery and because it was a bit livelier and more casual than Planter's. There is a wide variety of food on offer. We tried Malaysian food offerings - selection of Rendang, Malay Tiffin selection and North Indian Tiffin on the third. The tiffin is a stack of four tins, each with a different dish to be shared by two, with rice also served. The Malaysian dishes were superior to the North Indian in our opinion, but the food was always tasty and we had excellent service from our charming waitress. We had room for desserts on one occasion and they were excellent. There's clearly a very skilled pastry chef working here. A nice venue for dinner, with good food and not bad value by European standards, but at the pricier end of the scale for Langkawi. Show less

Author: Ian M
Title: Great friendly staff
Review: I was traveling solo and Bella and Am went out of there way to make sure I was being looked after and always had time to talk with all there customers in a warm and friendly way.

Author: Maud R
Title: Nice place to have drinks

It's also possible to order food.
Thanks to Ashley and Razif who were taking care of us and making us laugh every day !

Author: rbsingsingapore
Title: Excellent restaurant with awesome food
Review: this place is primarily a bar but one can also order all the foods..they have a very nice band on some of the evenings..the staff are very attentive and friendly..good selaction of food and drinks..very cozy for chill out evenings..this is inside the hotel and is not on the beach..Show less

Author: LOVE2PEACEJeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: nice for chill out time
Review: it is in the Danna Langkawi resort where I stayed a week, the overall experience was great.this is where you can enjoy a romantic dinner and enjoy the live music with the nice singer.Staff are great and so much friendly.Show less

Author: bander1980Dammam, Saudi Arabia
Title: Most excellent place ever!
Review: Excellent service in the Verandah, especially Ashley and Christine were always very friendly and attentive at any time. Ezran makes the shisha always very tasty!! Thank you so much you taking care of me every day. You are the best! A place where I want to return soon! Show less

Author: RoamingAroundWorld2Wilton Manors, Florida
Title: Great drinks!
Review: We really liked the singapore sling and the long & cool! Great for before and after dinner at Planters! They have live music sometimes too. Happy hour is 5-7.Show less

Author: 4midastouchSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nabila and Izham!!! nice staff at the Verandah
Review: First night with my family, three kids from Singapore. We arrived hotel 10 pm and my wife and i went The VERANDAH 11:30.We were hungry but dont want sandwich and bread. Thanks a lot Nabila and Izham. They really served guests very kindly. They are the best of Danna hotel. Show less

Author: robustaarabicacafePuchong, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Great Night!
Review: Enjoyed my last night in Langkawi and visited the Verandah at The Danna. It was late at night and we were the only one at the bar, but nonetheless enjoyed the night and had a great time with their singer, Lin and her son. I even had the chance to go in front and sang a song. I hope I could have done this more than just one.Show less

Author: 412sunaeSydney, Australia
Title: Good music and cocktails
Review: The mother and son duo were very good, the atmosphere was comfortable and the bar service exceptional. Show less

Author: Wendy SNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Opulent luxury with excellent friendly service
Review: We visited Langkawi between 23rd January and 3rd February 2015 and were staying at the Berjaya Resort next door to The Danna. We visited The Danna to sample their cocktails, which were superb, and to get a feel for the place. All we can say is that we visited so many times that the reception staff kept welcoming us back!! It was amazing. The staff in the Verandah Lounge were professional and always friendly greeting everyone with a smile and very obliging. Ashley has to be mentioned here as an outstanding member of staff who always looked after us with such attention. We booked for the Friday night barbecue by the pool which was a memorable and enjoyable evening and highly recommended. We had dinner in the restaurant on our last night which was also an amazing experience with excellent customer service. Happy hour for wine and cocktails by the pool is 5pm to 7pm and then it continues in the Verandah Bar from 7pm to 9pm. Amazing sunset view from the beach enjoying a cocktail!! A special thanks to the singing duo at The Danna for performing my husband's favourite song of all time "Hotel California" by The Eagles. Although, they didn't know it initially, they practiced it and two days later delivered and outstanding performance.Highly recommend The Danna and would definitely look to stay here if we ever return to LangkawiShow less

Author: JamesstewardBrigstock, United Kingdom
Title: Perfection
Review: We made a reservation to eat at The Danna to round off an amazing trip to Australia and Langkawi. What a fantastic choice this was. We had a couple of pre dinner cocktails and could not believe that from 7 to 9 it was Happy Hour and they were half price!! Some of the finest cocktails that we have had in a stunning lounge for around 13 ringgit, it doesn't get much better we thought. Well it did,we were then taken to our table which was on the verandah with breathtaking views of the sun setting. From the moment we arrived at The Danna,the first thing that we noticed was the exceptional service that the staff offered,making you feel so welcome, I have to say that every aspect of customer service was faultless and this was combined with a genuine friendliness that made us feel really special.Choosing what to eat was really difficult from such an extensive menu,we took our waiters advice and started with Lemongrass Chicken, it was a great choice, I then had the Malaysian Tasting Platter whilst my wife opted for the Seafood Pasta. My dish was out of this world,4 different curries with rice and accompaniments, the Sambal was my favourite but all were amazing,my wife was also suitably impressed with her pasta. Our biggest regret was not having enough room to have one of the fabulous looking deserts!!We decided to have one last drink in the Verandah Bar,another good call as there was entertainment in in the form of a duo playing really good music, so good in fact that one drink soon lead to two. Quite often hotel entertainment can be poor but not at The Danna,we later spoke to Azlin and Shaheth,they were wonderful people and were more than happy to do requests. A further mention must go to Nurul who served us with drinks and chatted with us,she is a perfect example of what makes The Danna a cut above other hotels.Our next visit to Langkawi will definitely include a meal or two at The Danna,if not a night staying in the hotel.Show less

Author: VayuYBangkok, Thailand
Title: Dinner time
Review: Wow.. I'm guess to be here. We drove so far a way from our hotel and another side of island. But anyway arrived safe and happy to have dinner here. I ordered salad, Thai seafood both and my main course spaghetti seafood with tomato s. The best! But we are fully booked outside. Show less

Author: DrDougster
Title: Best cocktails
Review: Just faultless - could eat the cashews/nibbles all night. We had drinks in here three nights and the prices are just giveaway cheap.

Author: Mez_Spence

Review: The best resturant in Langkawi! Excellent seafood and choice of wines. The crepe suzette dessert was a great finish to a wonderful dinner in a gorgeous setting.

Author: Sandra R
Title: Pre dinner cocktails.
Review: Make sure you go during happy hour. Half price cocktails. Later in the night the live music is awesome!

Author: mlienGold Coast, Australia
Title: Outstanding
Review: The best restaurant food we had in Malaysia coupled with outstanding service and great location overlooking the sea. There is the option of sitting inside or outside. We also had the romantic dinner on the beach which was absolutely awesome and I highly recommend anyone to do this as it was an incredibly romantic experience. Show less

Author: Anthony M
Title: Excellent
Review: Luxurious setting. With a wide range of cocktails , beer and wine. But there is a dress code of smart casual.

Author: SpeedoSydneyWellington, New Zealand
Title: Old Charm Elegance
Review: The Verandah Lounge is a fantastic place to have pre dinner cocktails. It has a happy hour from 7pm till 9pm and a wide selection of drinks to choose from. It has a charm and elegance with a colonial feel that is perfect to relax at the end of the day.Show less

Author: Cristopher S
Title: Specialized in Indian
Review: An amazing experience I had at the Dana Indian restaurant. An amazing service which showed the 5 star hotel. (I have only been guest of the restaurant ).We asked the best food to the waiter and he gave us a delighted variety of delicious food. He made us taste Malaysian and Indian and I have to say that they were amazing.My advice is to not get forebear food because it's not what they are specialized in. If you don't know what to get ask a waiter. The price was ok and right for the food quality but it's still to expensive in my standards. But it deserves a 5 even thought I put a 4. Show less

Author: CrisSpagnaShanghai
Title: Great service and amazing Indian food
Review: This restaurant is Indian and if you go there you must like Indian. They have other foods but are not as good as the food they are specialized in "Indian'.The service is amazing, it's a 5 star hotel. You should ask the people there to tell you what to get and you will be surprised. In convolution I agree that 'the Dana ' is in first place in the city. Show less

Author: AustraliaFelizAustralia
Title: Very stylish
Review: The Verandah bar is a long well appointed bar within the Danna Hotel. It opens at 5 each evening and is well worth a few drinks. The staff are attentive and lovely, the wine, spirit and cocktail menus are huge. The bar has another glass room attached full of some of the world more exclusive wines and where you can sit and enjoy them with a cigar... Show less

Author: Freedom449139
Title: Fantastic
Review: We stayed at the Danna for a week and drank in the Danna Lounge bar prior to eating dinner in their restaurant Planters. The cocktails were half price at happy hour and were delicious. We took them into dinner ........wise move as no need to purchase drinks at dinner! We had curry from the new North Indian menu and despite the meal taking a little longer than we had hoped to be cooked there was no doubt that these meals were fresh, hot and most of all DELICIOUS! Our most favourite meal of the week although The Danna Friday night BBQ was equally as nice albeit....a little expensive at 125 ringitts pp.Show less

Author: LillyP66
Title: Great cocktail, good band
Review: Great lounge bar to retreat to after a meal. The band are very good and the cocktails are excellent. Some people ate here and the food looked very good.

Author: Jane PHertford, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful bar area.
Review: We were staying at the hotel and some evenings the bar was practically empty. Happy Hour from 7 - 9pm was very good and the bar area is beautiful and the atmosphere was very calm and relaxing. We had drinks here before eating in Planters restaurant which was very good. The menu had extensive choice and was reasonably priced.Show less

Author: EastStandSeagullEast Sussex, United Kingdom
Title: A relaxing place.
Review: Just the place to sit and relax with friends after a lovely meal and a stroll.The staff are very attentive and will make any cocktail you ask for or a cold beer, nothing is too much trouble. Most evenings there was a singer or group to entertain you playing relaxing music.Show less

Author: Wanderlusting1979
Title: Great luxurious Bar
Review: Visited here several times while staying at the Danna. Great happy hour 7-9 where most drinks are half off. Atmosphere was plush and rich and sophisticated. Beautiful furnishings and great service- the drinks were great too!

Author: jacquiw610Singapore, Singapore
Title: The best food I have had in Malaysia
Review: We have traveled around Malaysia a fair bit and this is by far the best food we have had in Malaysia. The menu offers extensive options in western and local cuisine and it is difficult to choose based on the number of quality options. In the end we decided to eat here a few times because our other meals outside of The Planters was disappointing in comparison. Our son chose from the kids options and the meals were substantial and the food good quality. It wasn't just small junky meals like some kids meals can be. Once my son tried our satay however he did not want to stick to the kids menu and then happily ordered from the main menu in fact also ordering the satay when having lunch by the pool instead of his much loved burger and chips.We ordered the trio of rendang which was the best rendang we have ever eaten. The satay sticks were incredibly tasty and the satay sauce accompanying them was fantastic. Could not write positively enough about the service of all of the staff at this restaurant and the incredible food. I normally like to eat at different places during a stay in a country but this restaurant had us visiting multiple times. We couldn't have asked for more.Show less

Author: Y0rkie1986
Title: Cocktails, Snacks and Band
Review: Go between 7 and 9 enjoy very cheap cocktails, delicious snacks and the outstanding band at 8! Loved it!

Author: Moree48
Title: Great Breakfast Buffet
Review: This is one of the best breakfast buffets we have had. Plenty of choice. Coffee good and service excellent.

Author: Joanna F
Title: Cocktails
Review: We only spent one night in the verandah due to us being so tired from running around during the days. Just wish we had chance to go back. Brilliant cocktails and great entertainment. Bartenders were really friendly.

Author: Debra B
Title: Wonderful Cocktails
Review: This is a lovely lounge , the cocktails are the best I have ever had , try the Mia Tia wonderful , some nights there is live music which was very good

Author: AnoifLancaster
Title: Fabulous cocktail selection!
Review: We couldn't understand why this bar was so quiet. The selection and quality of the cocktails was very very good. Kannan is a very good mixologist and he was a pleasure to talk to, attentive but not intrusive. Live music was debatable, maybe a younger music theme might encourage other people to try the bar!Show less

Author: CynWorldTraveller
Title: Our private bar
Review: We were surprised each night to find that we generally had The Verandah bar to ourselves.  Not a bad thing, service on tap and we were looked after very very well.

Author: Claus_Nielsen
Title: Expensive but fair quality
Review: This restaurant is part of the five-star hotel The Danna and the pricelevel is much higher than outside The hotel. Only a fem places outside so book your tabel one or two days before

Author: GFMVHACAdelaide, Australia
Title: Mixed feelings... The Planter's @ The Danna
Review: The Planter's restaurant is certainly one of the most beautiful restaurant's to dine in on Langkawi. The room is expensively appointed, lush, romantic and everything you'd expect to find in a fine dining establishment. However - there's just a few things we were unhappy with the night of our visit which is why I can't give this place a score of 'excellent'. Firstly, we made the effort to go to The Danna personally a couple of days in advance to book a table. It was a special occassion (anniversary) and we wanted to dine at one of the lovely tables out on the terrace overlooking the pool. When the restaurant receptionist asked for our room number and realised we weren't guests of the hotel, she immediately advised all the tables outside were booked - we accepted this at the time and made a reservation anyway. When we arrived on the night and gave our reservation details the receptionist (a different one this time) made a point of saying 'oh yes - you're the one's from outside of the hotel) which we thought was very strange and made us feel a little uncomfortable and unwelcome. We were seated by the window (a very nice table) and all night we continued to watch the supposedly 'reserved' tables on the terrace remain mostly empty - by the time we left at 11pm, two out of the five tables were still empty and had been since our arrival just before 8pm. Obviously The Danna has a perference to look after their hotel guests over us outsiders and if they don't then that's how they made us feel which was very unfortunate. Unlike other reviewers, the service was very good when we could get service but mostly it was non existent and we spend a great deal of time trying to wave staff down. We ordered the Tiffan (Malaysian option) which was very nice except one of the dishes was completely inedible (so fishy - full of blachen we think) and unlike everyone else who'd ordered the same meal set and had their rice left on the table, they served us some rice then promptly removed it so that by the time we could get someone's attention to replace it our food had gone cold. We also couldn't get a finger bowl to wash our hands in after having to peel sticky prawns so had to opt to leave the restaurant and find the rest rooms instead. This is an expensive restaurant and I'm afraid our expectations just weren't met on the night.Show less

Author: Tileman_13
Title: Unbeatable
Review: Yes I know it's a bold statement, but I've never been anywhere as professional , friendly,  and value for money

Author: DB1958Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Near Michelin Star Quality - The Planters Restaurant @The Danna
Review: What an excellent restaurant. The service and quality of food are some of the best I have eaten. My partner and I stayed at The Danna and had occasion to eat there several times in the evening. The service is outstanding and the food is to match. Curries are a delight and the The Tiffin is a must. Please note, you need to be have a good appetite as you get plenty of quite delicious food. We ate at most other restaurants in the top five for this island on trip advisor and none, absolutely none, came close to the food served in this restaurant. The Privilege restaurant is just a short walk away from The Danna Planters restaurant, whilst tis restaurant is very good too, the ambience and food served at The Planters beats it hands down. A table outsider overlooking the pool is very romantic setting.Show less

Author: Sazwanieholiday
Title: Great dinner
Review: Excellent food presentation even though simple meals ordered, food quality and quantity awesome....... so satisfied.Great atmosphere and facilities.Not forget the friendly and sincerely great service from Executive Chef Ridzuan,Mr.Ingo and Mr.Fuad....The Best in Langkawi Thank you

Author: CarcharodonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Classy but not snobbish
Review: The Verandah is just like the rest of The Danna. Opulent, classy and somehow just so very friendly. The decor and atmosphere are relaxing and soothing, from the mood lighting and aromatherapy blend that the entire hotel magically has, to the polite yet not overbearing staff who are always there when you need them, but magically out of sight and discreet when required. Spent several very relaxing evenings there with friends and family being serenaded by the pianist and band. A little above average in pricing but then the best things do come at a premium. Plus it keeps the rabble away.Show less

Author: A5764LNgregs
Title: High Quality Dining in Langkawi
Review: Drinks and dinner in a fantastic venue. The atmosphere is awesome as is the food. Not cheap, but well worth it.

Author: rima D
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Great drinks and cover band.  If you have the time try and get out there.  Even better stay at the hotel.

Author: mangoesmicheleLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Top Class Dining
Review: We were invited to the Danna as a special treat by friends and WOW what an incredible experience!!! The food was out of this world, the presentation spectacular and very attentive service....couldn't have wanted more!!! We enjoyed it so much that when we had visitors from Australia recently we decided to try it again....Excellent ...it lived up to our first impressions.I highly recommend this for a treat or a special occasion when you want to pamper yourselves. Congratulations to Chef Horst and his team, a brilliant evening both times!!! WE will definitely be back again.Show less

Author: minna296Sylt-Ost, Germany
Title: Awesome Dinner at Danna
Review: Highly recommended by friends we had dinner at the Danna two weeks ago. Starting from cocktails at the poolbar and right through a five course dinner we enjoyed the service of the staff with their friendly and welcoming, malaysian hospitality, The food and the presentation were outstanding, so that for the first time I decided to write a review on tripadvisor to share our experience and thank the chef and his team! To my great surprise I came across "foodie's" review. Besides my personal belief, that critism should be polite and not insulting, I was astonished, how many meals were taken to find out how ineatible the food was.( .....and the choice: pasta ,pizza, srambled eggs doesn't indicate a gourmet) But again, this is my very own opinion. All I actually really wanted to say: My friends and I will certainly come back and we have told all our friends already, that a visit to the Danna is an absolutely must while beeing here on Langkawi.Thanks for a great evening!Show less

Author: Maxamillain
Title: A lovely way to start or end the evening!
Review: The ambiance is perfect for this lounge and the staff work hard to produce drinks and cocktails to please. The lounge is light and airy and well furnished and as with the rest of the hotel everything is spotless and high quality.

Author: Joseph g
Title: verandah Lounge
Review: The Verandah Lounge was so sumptious & welcoming. Razif & his staff were so friendly and efficient. Rachel ( singer) was a joy!

Author: Pedro_Collins68Box Hill, Australia
Title: Just loved this place
Review: The Verandah at the Danna was a great place to have a drink or coffee and dessert while listening to live entertainment. The duo musicians were absolutely fabulous. It was a wonderful spot to wind down after a day in the sun and before going to bed.Show less

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Danna Verandah Lounge
Review: The Danna Verandah Lounge is gorgeous! The lounge is situated inside the Danna Hotel and it looks like a very expensive place to be but reality is not. Even if without their current promotion for one to one the price for their wonderful cocktail price at Rm 25 perglass is pretty fair. My favorites cocktail is Millionaire and few others that I never see in others places. With their in house live band from Philippine that sing harmonically almost every night and they have a huge cigar room where you could smoke like a big boss in a high class upholstery sofa . That place is very suitable for couple and family who enjoy quiet and very clean atmosphere. I highly recommend that place to anyone especially the locals to go.Show less

Author: Ching NSeattle, Washington
Title: Surprising find in Langkawi
Review: We were staying at the Berjaya Resort and I was looking to see what restaurants were close by so we don’t have to eat at the hotel all the time during our stay. Came across this highly reviewed restaurant and suggested we eat there. My husband was skeptical about eating western food in an Asian environment like Langkawi but agreed to try. First meal we ordered lamb burgers and a piece each of cheesecake and walnut apple pie. The burgers were pretty good but the pie was excellent. Next evening we ordered 2 kinds of schnitzel and once again the 2 kinds of pie. The food was delivered free of charge and still warm. The schnitzels (one with onions and the mushroom sauce) were delicious as were the pies. If we had stayed any longer in Berjaya Langkawi, we would have happily tried other items on the menu and hopefully different kinds of desserts.
