So if you are staying at Berjaya Resort or visiting the Cable car and Sky Walk, make sure you stop by for a delicious meal at very reasonable prices.Show less

Author: SawBeeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A real gem
Review: A real gem in oriental village.Stumbled on it few days ago and just tried the mixed salad which I really enjoyed.Then I saw all the excellent reviews on it so went back this evening.I had grilled fish and potato salad.The fish was perfectly done and normally I’m not that keen on potatoes, both were so tasty.Stayed in berjaya so very handy and was told they do free delivery to the hotel.I will definitely be back. Thank you.Show less

Author: rohaya a
Title: Mission to try food in Langkawi
Review: The cheesecake, grilled fish fillet and original salad was out of this world, tastes heavenly and delicious. Recommended.

Author: yoongxaol
Title: Good German food
Review:
The nice cold cake out of the fridge served  is a life saver when  it's 32 degree outside. Very good authentic German food.

My family and I enjoyed GFC meals very much yesterday afternoon after visiting the langkawi skybridge.

Author: ck1873Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: My Fav go to place for lunch or dinner
Review: This is our family favorite store for a simple and yet very nice German food at Langkawi. It has been our must go place for our trip there for the past 10 years. My wife and son love the tiger prawn grill and the sausage is great.Show less

Author: hengkee_2000Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Schnitzel In Malaysia
Review: I ordered schnitzel because I wanted to try a truly original German schnitzel. When I took in the first piece, my first words to my family were O M G! It was the most delicious deep fried pork chop I had ever tasted in Malaysia! Do not miss the schnitzel if you dine at this place. The couple that ran this place are also very friendly. I hope they'll still be there for many more years so that I can try their schnitzel again if I ever return to Langkawi!Show less

Author: jokl78
Title: Good food
Review: Came here purposely just to try out the food from our hotel after reading good reviews. We were not disappointed. Had the fish and chips and schnitzel and a mango juice. All is very nice. Must come if you are in Langkawi.

Author: nonn16
Title: Yummy and affordable
Review: Went to German Food Corner before we tooked the skycab. Food was yummylicious, services was good, waiter was polite, affordable and delicious tasty food so far in Langkawi.

Author: Seaside49297756469Rodenbach, Germany
Title: German Food Corner, really fantastic!
Review: I would like to praise the German Food Corner Restaurant, close to the cable car to the highest mountain on the island, for this great food.I ate there 5 times during my 10-day stay!Regardless of whether ist was schnitzel, chicken or cake (the cheesecake was extremly tasty!), all of the dishes were great in taste and beatifully presented!Unfortunately, I have a great weakness, I am very difficult to remember names. The Lady is from Hessen in Germany and her partner is Maroccan with an understanding of football. Both are very friendly and humorons, just great hosts! If you come to Langkawi, you should definitely eat there!Jens SchillingShow less

Author: tche tKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Langkawi Sky Cab outing
Review: The cheesecake and almond mango fruit cake was out of this world... Tastes heavenly and definitely delicious... Their shop is run by a Egyptian man by the name of Ahmad and his German wife. Both were extra warm and friendly and hospitable polite. Recommend those cakes to anyone...did not have the time to try the other German Cuisine as had no time to do so due to a technical fault encounter at SkyCab Langkawi when coming down as there was a 1 hour delay at the top station when coming down by the gondolaShow less

Author: DaliawestGermany
Title: Delicious homemade German Food
Review: Finally we found a place where we can enjoy authentic German food. We ordered the Wiener Schnitzel with Potato salad. Both were so delicious that we could not resist to have the Cheese cake and Bienenstich for desert. If you want to enjoy homemade German food it is a must to visit this place. Show less

Author: Romeo1248937
Title: German Corner
Review: Extremely nice staff and excellent food definitely recommend this place if you are in langkawi!!!!!!

Author: Nur_aizat193
Title: Good foods
Review: Good foods, big portion.. we try to finish it slow slow.. ahmad, the owner and her wife from germany.. so friendly!!

Author: Nadia S
Title: Great food worth the money
Review: Great food, where the portions are big and fresh. Would recommend the garlic sauce prawn spaghetti for the delicious sauce, and chicken chop for the ultimate around of protein - juicy tender yet not oily.

Author: NicionsozNew Zealand
Title: Excellent taste and good price.
Review: Food exceeded our expectation, cooked by a German Lady Chef and the helper was very professional and patience in taking our food order and clearing our table. It was so delicious that we ordered extra portion. They don't serve German beer inside the food court, but it wad not an issue as we bought beer elsewhere. A must try restaurant.Show less

Author: camensurya
Title: Really juicy chicken
Review: Loved the chicken wiener with potato salad and garlic cream sauce. Exceeded our expectations! Friendly owner

Author: Citygal12456
Title: best schnitzel in langkawi
Review: after the skycab adventure, hubby myself and daughter got hungry. twas a very pleasant surprise to see german food in the oriental village! The schnitzel bolognese and creamy garlic sauce just hit the spot. The host was very lovely as well.

Author: midzurllMalaysia
Title: Delicious German Food!
Review: We went here for lunch on Sunday afternoon, I have to say that Mr Ahmed is a very friendly host, he's very understanding and helpful. Their food was really delicious especially the Schnitzel with their homemade garlic sauce, yummy! We had fun along with their cat, Lucky. When Mr Ahmed found out it was my wife's birthday, he gave us a piece of their homemade cheesecake which tasted like home, thank you so much! Show less

Author: Dietmar S
Title: Delicious German Food
Review:
The German Food Corner, inside Oriental Village.Offer you many of very delicious,typical German Food!
Also the original Cheese Cake was fantastic.And the Service to!
Big Compliment see you again!

Author: jocelyn1611Singapore, Singapore
Title: Explore something different from the usual food when in Langkawi
Review: The freshly brewed (Lavazza Beans) coffee was perfect for us - smooth, not too acidic, even when we had it iced. Despite the food here being pricier than the other local food stalls at this makan corner, the portion of each of our mains were huge (I couldn't finish the generous portion of fries served with my chicken fajitas with fries & pita bread). The chicken wiener with onion was a good portion of tender chicken & flavourful saute onions too! Oh friendly shop owners too! Great choice we did here! ;)Show less

Author: khalid M
Title: Mr
Review: I visited this place two times, had my lunch there. Tasty food & friendly staff with very good quality and price. Great work. Keep it up 👍👍😋😋

Author: Jerilin98Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth price
Review: We ordered cordon bleu and frankfurters- cordon bleu was two chicken cutlets sandwiching a kraft single and slice of picnic ham. The frankfurters tasted like it could be bought at a minimart. Total price RM50 (incl our drinks). Food was not unpleasant but not quite worth the expenseShow less

Author: tnflee
Title: Simple western food at a food court
Review: I had the Spaghetti 911 with chilli, garlic and shrimps. Excellent! The shrimps couldn't get any fresher and they were meaty. Ahmet from Egypt was really friendly. 2 thumbs up!

Author: sheehiantSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and service
Review: Although I read some reviews beforehand, I was still surprised to find this food stall in a pretty run down food court. The food was not bad, I had the cheese schnitzel and the kids had fish and chips. The fresh juices were great too. The owners were friendly and offered lollipops to the kids. The place had ceiling fans, but it was still fairly hot...Show less

Author: klmom121Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A hidden gem in Langkawi
Review: Don't let the location throw you off. The food is good, in fact it could be the best in Langkawi in the same price category. Ordered 2 chicken schnitzels, black pepper and garlic sauce respectively. If you are a fan of garlic, you'd love the garlic sauce which they gave quite generously in a separate bowl. Our kids had the carbonara pasta, creamy and garlicky. Yums! Service was fast and the server was helpful. Note to the kitchen, one of the chicken schnitzel was extremely oily we could see puddles of oil beneath the chicken so do strain it before plating. Maybe a commercial deep fryer would be helpful.Show less

Author: minvinho
Title: Unexpected Good Food
Review:
We were very much disappointed by the quality of food in Langkawi throughout the entire trip, this place however, blew our mind.

Quality that comes with the price. It is very proper comfort food and also delicious one to beat. Simply amazing.

Author: datin_tan
Title: Best food in the Oriental village
Review: Great food at restaurant standard but operates at a food court. Price is reasonable, generous portion. Service was prompt and friendly.

Author: gsle24Melbourne, Australia
Title: What you see is what you get!
Review: On the way to the sky bridge I decided I was a bit hungry and wanted a quick snack.Stumbled across this shop which had quite a few customers sitting and eating. All the customers seemed to be finishing their meals happily.Menu was easy to read and understand with pictures accompanying so you know exactly what to expect.I ordered the bratwurst sausage with chips. Was cooked to order and filled my hunger.Owner/staff are extremely welcoming and friendly.In all, it was a simple meal but I enjoyed myself and would happily come back to try other menu items.Show less

Author: Sloebertjeping
Title: Very good German food. We liked it very much.
Review: We were several times in the restaurant during our stay on Langkawi Island. We always went back because we liked the food very much. I liked especially the " gulasch " and the " cordon blue ". The owners are very nice people and very helpful.We will certainly go back during our next visit.Show less

Author: DindianPerth, Australia
Title: Can't understand the high ratings
Review: This was one of those rare visits where I have been disappointed by a high rated place. The food was okay but all deep fried and pretty much over cooked, the carbonara sauce had split so it was a lumpy mess. We had tried various items on the menu. Having recently travelled to Germany, I can't say the food is what I would have expected. The only pluses are that it is open later than most of the food court shops, service was friendly enough and the iced coffee was decent. Ok for an occasional meal.Show less

Author: Meriko SToronto, Canada
Title: Huge portions for a great price!
Review: This restaurant exceeded my expectations for a small outdoor food court in a very busy touristy place. The food was great and the owner was even kinder! The menu and portions are huge and for a modest price. I have been traveling through Asia for over a year now and this just hit the spot! It was a great break from Asian food haha! I ate here for dinner the one night and came back again the next night. It closes at 8pm but the owner had no problem with people over staying a little and we felt no pressure in having to leave quickly. He was also very easy going with allowing us to substitute some food options. One minor problem we did run into was that he didn’t have or he ran out of certain menu options, but it’s such a big menu it’s easy to find something else. (I only took pictures of a few pages of the menu.)Show less

Author: Zeo M
Title: Nice Food
Review: The cheesecake is delicious. And I saw their food is big in portion and looks good ! Coffee is so so...

Author: Jennifer L
Title: Best burgers we have had in Langkawi for the price.
Review: We all had the beef burger, fries and soda package. It was a decent burger (tasty, with good-sized patties--not the super-skinny ones you sometimes find), the fries were plentiful, hot and crisp, and the price was reasonable. The portion was very generous. It is in the food court near the Cable Car. The proprietor was very nice and the service was quick. We want to come back for the desserts: cheesecake and waffles with ice-cream...Show less

Author: Paula P
Title: Sensational
Review: It was absolutely delightful to eat so good and cheap for the first time in Malaysia. Highly warmly recommended. Do not dare to leave Langkawi without eating here.

Author: emma101996Greater Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and service
Review: My partner and I stayed at Berjaya Langkawi Resort and came to the German Food Corner on multiple occasions. The food was fantastic !!!!! It was delisious , athetnitic , very affordable and portions were incredibly generous. The food was great but the service was equally wonderful. All staff were very kind , respectful and eager to help in anyway possible. The German Food Counter was one of our favourite resterunts in Langkawi and its defiantly worth a visit.Show less

Author: Lighthouse07
Title: Everybody liked it
Review: Very good service, amazing food. Would be nice to be back, but quite far from the city. Still amazingly good though

Author: leketso
Title: Falling in love
Review: Love the food and very good location ( close to Skycab) , good taste, price and size of portions , very polite and friendly staff. Recommend it to everyone.

Author: C8875BOjasonrEchuca, Australia
Title: Basic food done well
Review: Let me start by saying that I would rate this as good (3.5) if I could but these ratings go from average to very good. The food is basic but well done, we had a bit of a wait but the service was good. I had the chicken snitzel with pineapple and cheese which was large and very tasty, sadly the melted cheese slice detracted from it. The fajitas were ok but only provided with a piece of flat bread and not a wrap which would make it easier and more authentic. Show less

Author: mekagem
Title: Good portions for the price
Review: Tasty and average prices. Very good place to “just eat” when one got tired of spicy Chinese food. Check it out!

Author: vishalTripAdvise
Title: Good Option @ Sky Bridge Area
Review: Tried there Shrimp Pita Bread and Feta was very tasty , its more like sit , eat and move kind of place , nothing to write about Ambiance as it has open /common sitting . If you ar looking for Non asian option for food then definitely can tryShow less

Author: V8040BKglenna
Title: Awesome schnitzel
Review: Who would have thought that the best schnitzel I've ever had, would be from a small food store in Langkawi. Creamy garlic sauce is awesome.  Highly recommended.

Author: edloh
Title: Good service, average food
Review: Schnitzel was good and generous in portion but carbonara pasta was average at best, burgers was below average. Perhaps we should have stuck with the German items on the menu ....

Author: beejeanstSingapore, Singapore
Title: Large Portion German Nosh in a Food Stall/ Court, non-Airconditioned
Review: This is located at the Food Court, so there's shared seating with the other food stalls.Food was good ! Generous portions, made to order so there could be a bit of wait if there's a long queue. It's priced higher than the other food stalls, and can be considered slightly expensive in the surroundings, but it really isn't expensive, as the portions are large and very generous. Show less

Author: wkiat
Title: New food with great service
Review: Love the schnitzel. The owner was very kind, provided us with 2 baby chairs for my 2 young kids. Thank you!

Author: b14w4k42p41Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Lovely quick meal before the cable car ride
Review: We ordered Chicken Schnitzel with mushrooms sauce and a cheese cake. Fresh pineapple juice too. For me the chicken portion was too much for one person, but hey, that’s me. I’m sure many would love to have hearty meal. We enjoyed the fries too. Next time we’ll go for the sausages and burgers. Thank you for the great service :)Show less

Author: 99MarkRAustralia
Title: Quick Lunch
Review: Was at The Oriental Village and had read reviews about this place, worth hunting down, it's in a little food court. Had simple chicken schnitzel with either fries or potato salad , the chicken was very generous and cooked to perfection. Service is friendly and fast. No photos as we emptied our plates quickly!! Would return. Show less

Author: 162joels
Title: Great schnitzels
Review: We had a nice lunch after visiting the 3d museum. All ate different schnitzels which were nicely prepared. Good value.

Author: Michael C
Title: Snitzel with mushroom sauce n potato salad
Review: Had the Snitzel with Mushroom Sauce and Potato Salad and it was GOOD. Portion and serving to my liking and not too 'heavy'.Would definitely return but will try their sausages the next round as Germans are well known for their sausages.Looking forward to my next visit.Auf Wiedersehen für jetzt.Show less

Author: trebellodiasTianjin, China
Title: Late lunch
Review: After an exhausting day around, it was with great happiness that we found this place. The food is excellent! The service is even better. We had sausages, potato salad, black pepper chicken and everything was first class! We also found some space to fit the pies!!! Congratulations on your service!! Really good!! Show less

Author: 43bakira
Title: Best restaurant in oriental village
Review:
- Very delicious lamb shoulder and chicken wiener.
- Very good service special thanks to the stuff their.
- it will be great if it’s a full restaurant not just a restaurant in a foodcourt.

Author: DeeDub002Dublin, Ireland
Title: Good tasty food
Review: We were staying in the Berjaya resort nearby where the food was mediocre and expensive, so having read reviews of GFC we tried it out and weren't disappointed. Basic good food done well and very tasty and great value.It was so yum we went back for more before we left. Its part of a food court and seating is basic, but service and value are excellent. Far better than Berjaya resort at a third of the cost. If you're in the area go!Show less

Author: wankashLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Best Currywurst Everrr!!
Review: First, thanks to humble Monika & Ahmed to open this German cafe here in Langkawi!! Im so thankful for that. Now i can taste German food again and again and again, and remember some of my favourite menu when i was in Germany during my study. My fav still goes to Currywurst and Kartoffelsalat... its the best everr!! I wish they had Auflauf too in their recipe list!! Good luck and all the best guys!!Show less

Author: patriciav345
Title: GOOD FOOD
Review:
If you are looking for fresh, go for this!
Very affordable and nice food. I ordered spaghetti carbonara and fish n chips which made right after we ordered.

Author: jkw94lyt
Title: Simply Amazing
Review: I have always thought, food at tourist location were normally dull, nothing special. GFC has prove me wrong. Their Spaghetti Carbonara is simply - amazing. Chicken Cordon Bleu is much more flavorful and tasty. Big portion, nice and friendly owner. Must visit for the tourist!

Author: Mohammed LJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Tasty, fresh and nice portions of food plus very friendly owners
Review: We stayed for 4 days at Geopark Hotel and ate here everyday!Their food was fresh, tasty and came in generous portions. The lamb burger is excellent. Also the currywurst was something we had never eaten before and tried it. It was delicious. Their French Fries were always fresh and in all of Malaysia this was the one place that had SALT!! Also their fresh juices and cheesecake are excellent.The owners/managers are very friendly people! The gentleman from Egypt was always helpful with tips and guidance on things to do etc. Also the 2 ladies were friendly.The menu is much more extensive but we really enjoyed certain items an stuck to them.I definitely recommend GFC to anyone coming to Langkawi. You will enjoy your meal.Show less

Author: ammarturkoLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Best food in my life
Review: The food here is possibly the best I've tasted in my whole life. I ate there for lunch for five days and it is very close to berjaya resort. The German lady that served me was very nice and friendly. Her chicken nuggets were delicious. If you ever come to Langkawim, go to the oriental village and eat here. Her restaurant is very clean. She cooks your food fresh everytime and makes every dish and drink perfect. I strongly recommend this place.Show less

Author: KirstenG379
Title: Great food!!
Review:
Great food!! Lovely people!! 
Delicious lamb burger!! Yummy cakes!!
Everything tasted was really good!!

Author: andrelB14PN
Title: Great Food!
Review: Great German and international food! During our holidays we went several times to the GFC in the Oriental Village. All dishes were super tasty and we could not stop trying new ones. I highly recommend the German cakes and the fresh fruit juices! :-)

Author: Ameliatcy
Title: Convenient and good!
Review: Tasty, quality food with fair prices. Convenient location for lunch after visiting Langkawi’s attractions!

Author: gedimizVilnius, Lithuania
Title: Like fast food
Review: We ordered fried Chicken with french fries and sausages with fries. It was not bad but really like not good quality fast food. The place is in the village with simple seats and it looks not like restaurant. Maybe in that place there are no better place but we would not eat second time. The worst was tea. It was with maybe 5spoons of sugar. Too sweet. They didn't ask if we wanted sugar in the tea.Show less

Author: phuiannlim
Title: Big and Nice
Review: This is a stall in Oriental Village Food Court, dont find it wrong.The Schnitzel was good with the garlic cream sauce.Cordon Blue was not so special like how it should be but overall is good. Food with reasonable price.

Author: Melissa zKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simply superb
Review: We ate in many restaurants that supposedly serve German dishes, so to have one that reminds me of the dishes in Germany, well, it is excellent. Fresh fruit juices... and even freshly made meals make our short trip just to visit this little stall worth it. Thank you for serving us such wonderful meals.Show less

Author: david h
Title: Simple but superb
Review: We've been frequenting GFC for our last two trips to Langkawi. Not many food outlets stay open beyond 1830 in the Oriental Village but this one does.We always eat here as the food is superb, freshly cooked, generous portions and very reasonably priced. We recommended GFC to another couple and they were not disappointed so if you are in the Oriental Village try it, Monika and Ahmed are very friendly.Show less

Author: TravelAnnekeKalamunda, Australia
Title: Authentic German food
Review: We stumbled on to this place while strolling back to the car park and we were glad we stopped here. I paid 35 RM for 2 very delicious authentic German meals. My partner had the Wiener Schnitzel which was juicy and just right. The chips were crispy and not drenched in fat. My fish burger was great too. I loved the complementary mayo with it. I had a deja vue back to my Belgian childhood. I would highly recommend this place. Show less

Author: Munique B
Title: Nice food
Review: Really nice food and good service.  Stayed near the cable car Langkawi and my boyfriend and l always went there to eat. The price is reasonable.  Will definitely recommend it.

Author: matthewgR6986NN
Title: Great
Review: We came across this place whilst walking around the oriental village. It's super value for money and really tasty food

Author: juliejoobjoob14
Title: Amazing food
Review:
We ate lunch there every day while staying at the berjaya.
The Egyptian owner was very friendly.
The food was all freshly cooked and very cheap.
Everything we had was very tasty but the almond cake was divine!

Author: ChristopherO671
Title: Ate here every day!
Review: Stayed 3 days at Berjaya and ate lunch here every day. Wunderbar! Great authentic currywurst... Great schnitzel!!! They have WiFi as well. I don't normally write reviews... But I'm compelled to share my experience :-)

Author: Emma O
Title: A nice surprise
Review: We were staying at berjaya resort near by and liked coming here for a lovely schnitzel or currywurst! Very nice and cheap prices at the heart of the orientale village!

Author: Not_The_DigitalNomad
Title: Cheese cake
Review: We did not eat a meal there but the cheese cake was really yummy and was recommended by another guest at that place

Author: Daniel PVancouver, Canada
Title: Good basic food
Review: When visiting Langkawi Sky Cab, I wanted a change from the usual Malaysian food so I had read about this restaurant and decided to try it.It was part of an Asian food court which I found strange, but hey that is where they are.Place and area is by no means fancy, almost picnic table like, however under an open air roof.I ordered Schnitzel, it took a while but was very good. Came with standard french fries that were ok.I was a little leery about food safety as the server brought straws for the drinks in his hands and the straws were not wrapped in paper or plastic. So I chose to not use the straw. Just be aware always with how restaurants and their servers handle food and drinks.Aside from that, not much to report on. I didn't meet the cook as others had. She was busy in the back cooking.If at Sky Cab park and hungry for a little western food, give them a shot. Decent food.Show less

Author: kmblaxlandNewcastle, Australia
Title: Amazing Food!
Review: My partner and I found out about German Food Corner through TripAdvisor and can understand why it is rated so well! We ordered the weiner schnitzel, one with garlic sauce and fries and the other with mushroom sauce and potato salad. Our meals were cooked fresh, came out very quickly and were absolutely delicious! We eat a lot of schnitzel at home in Australia and agreed that these were up there as the nicest we have ever eaten. It was incredibly cheap too, considering the large portions we received. Show less

Author: drakoshkacoolMoscow, Russia
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We have been here more than 5 times during our stay in Oriental Village. The lamb shoulder was the best I've ever try: it was tender and succulent. And so was the fish fille. We tried a lot of courses and all of them were great. The owners are so nice and welcome. It was a pleasure to visit this place.Show less

Author: LiJames77Sanya, China
Title: First class quality, range of food and hospitality in a great location
Review: Not much more to say than the title already suggests - we had delicious pasta with garlic and chilli prawns alongside some fabulously tasty gyros with tzatziki, all fantastic value with a great owner with good English and a friendly manner. The location is excellent, even though obviously a purpose-built tourist village, they have done it with taste and style, reminds me a bit of Port-El-Kantaoui in Tunisia in a strange (but not unpleasant) way.Show less

Author: LeonazeMettmann, Germany
Title: Best German food in Langkawi
Review: Langkawi is known for its wide variety in asian cuisine and seafood. For tourists and locals this may sometimes be a little too overwhelming, hence a perfect place to indulge in traditional german dishes. From schnitzels to a very german curry-wurst the GFC really does satisfy the western apetite. The small restaurant is run by a german woman and her husband who are very kind and helpful, they both speak german and have the same (if not better) knowledge of the island than the locals.Show less

Author: Azzurra R
Title: Great food and wonderful owners
Review: Great food! Owners very friendly, lovers animals and very kind to guests! They give up a map and explain things to do and visit in the island! A very lovely place where to eat before going to the cable cab and sky bridge! I really suggest you to go!!! Show less

Author: basti2018Steinau an der Strasse, Germany
Title: Food like home made by my mom
Review: I have been twice at the german food corner, once to see the cable car and couple days later to see the waterfall which is close to the german food corner. Me as a german I can say the food is absolutely authentic and tast astonishing home made like my mom would do it. I can really recommend especially for those who don´t endure the asian food that much good to eat there, and in the end I have to admit that the owners are really kind.Show less

Author: 681siddharthadKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: German food in Oriental Village
Review: I am not sure what German food tastes like but given the host I was assured of the Authenticity. The food was not very suited to an Indian palette but we liked what was served. The burger was pretty great and the chicken did not disappoint either...Show less

Author: holly sLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great quality food, huge portions and cheap price!
Review: Had expectations after reading lots of reviews - however these were easily met. This is just in a food court/open space however we had an amazing meal. So good we went back again the next day!Food quality was excellent - with the best quality chicken we have had having spent 3 weeks in Malaysia. All ingredients were fresh and delicious with an awesome choice on the menu too.Owners were super friendly and happy to help! Had freshly baked cheesecake too which was just excellent. The only possible negative point is that the portions were just so bad I felt guilty when I couldn’t finish the meal!Show less

Author: Alper Buğra Ö
Title: Not bad
Review: A good place to eat German style fast food. Nice staff, reasonable prices. If you are already at Oriental Village, worth to go.

Author: ACDC29Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food Court Offering
Review: We went here based on TA reviews. I would just like to clarify that I was with my husband and 2 yo and we found the proprietress and staff very efficient and welcoming, however the food is really basic, as expected from a food court setting. I'm talking deepfried bratwurst, over mayo-ed potato salad and shnitzel with orange breading that comes ready made and burger patties that are also ready made from the same supplier supplying the entire row. So basic food, basic prices but not high-quality. Fruit smoothies were delicious and homemade cakes looked promising.Show less

Author: 203vickie
Title: German Food Corner
Review: Ended up visiting here twice for a meal during our stay. Both times very nice food and great service.  Chicken schnitzel was lovely, really enjoyed it. Couldn’t fault this little place, very good prices too.

Author: Ulla_J_1980
Title: Best currywurst ever
Review:
I was totally surprised (I'm german), but here you'll get the best currywurst ever. It's better than every currywurst I've had in germany!!!!
And all the cakes here are homemade by the lovely owner, Moni.

Highly recommended!!!!

Author: lazytoad2001Halifax, United Kingdom
Title: Really enjoyed our meal
Review: We stopped here for lunch before heading off back to our hotel after visiting the cable car. I have to say I’m very pleased we made the time to stop. We had a couple of cans of pipe as well as a currywurst for me and a schnitzel for my other half both freshly prepared and delicious. Show less

Author: ehsanlegzianMashhad, Iran
Title: Taste of Germany
Review: I visited German Food Corner for a lunch and mid day rest during our visit of oriental village(After cable car rides and before departure to Seven Wells Waterfall).I tried grilled fish with potato salad. A typical German cuisine.It was tasty and the price was resonable.The staff were kind.I recommend this place to Oriental village visitors.Guten Appetit!Show less

Author: Rahul DSingapore
Title: The location underwhelms, the food does not!
Review: This is located in the food court in oriental village but man can they cook delicious food! I had the Chicken Weiner in Mushroom Sauce and it was yummmmm!! The spouse had grilled chicken (Chicken Steak in the menu) and that was cooked perfectly! Fries were just alright but the potato salad was good.Show less

Author: AFAK25Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Interesting German Food...
Review: We were passing the stall to get to the other end of the small food court when I noticed the Tripadvisor sticker. So I looked up the entry in Tripadvisor and saw many favourable reviews for this establishment.Initially we ordered only the cakes - banana chocolate and vanilla almond (if I recall correctly) but as we were finishing the cakes I thought why not have a light lunch as well and proceeded to order the currywurst with potato salad and another with fries.The cakes were homemade and I can vouch that they don't have the 'perfection' associated with mass-produced cakes sold franchises. They tasted mild and not cloyingly sweet, the same way mum would have baked hers.The currywurst was nice. I don't have any experience eating original currywurst elsewhere so I can't really compare it against any set benchmark. The curry sauce was reminiscent of Japanese curry, with hints of spices, sweetish and thick. The potato salad had some grated cucumber in it giving it a slight crunch.Overall a good meal at affordable prices.Show less

Author: Nevine G
Title: Vacation
Review: Food and desert are very good.service is excellent and people are very pleasant.if you are at the oriental village and need to eat non malysian food then this place will be an excellent choice.

Author: Brian G
Title: Holiday visits August 20q7
Review: Visited a number of times during our stay in Langkawi. Excellent for light lunch. Very helpful friendly staff. Great value.

Author: dr_fathy
Title: best place at oriental village food court
Review:
service was friendly and helpful
food was better than expected.
price in low
may be the best place to dine in the oriental village

Author: meowleng92Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Still missing the taste...
Review: My friends are satisfied with the dishes and it is BIG portion tho.We are super hungry after visited skycab and etc so that we are able to finish all our meals.Worth the price and service is good!Have a try, no regret! Keep it up!*Actual visit was May 2016*Show less

Author: Lutz FDoha, Qatar
Title: Can't recommend
Review: We visited the restaurant and ordered the Chicken Wiener and nuggets with fries and potato salad. The service was prompt, the tables were clean. But I can't help, the food wasn't really nice. Now we are here several thousands of kilometers away from Germany and I know I have to compromise but still I was not even a little satisfied. Normally I insist that my child finish the dishes he order in order not to waste food. Here I didn't. He complained about the taste of the chicken wiener, so I ordered nuggets instead which normally is a very high chance he eat. Also these were not tasty. Maybe it's a fusion of Malaysian spices etc. Paired with German dishes but don't have to high expectations. Show less

Author: romantissimo
Title: Good food and staff
Review:
Its a good place for a quick lunch in the oriental village.

Ahmed was very helpfull and his juices was refreshing.

Author: Amr M
Title: Excellent place , best of the best
Review: I used to eat at the German corner all days of my stay at Langkawi, it was perfect in everything, the price is cheap and the food with different types and its recommended. the welcoming is perfect from Mr Ahmed, and we become friends at last. thanks for everything, it was my honeymoon and they make my days happy :)Show less

Author: BK_ShanghaiLeuna, Germany
Title: German style food on Langkawi
Review: We've read about the place and had to go there. It is a part of the food court in the oriental village by the cable car. We went during Ramadan, just before Hari Raya, so very few visitors only...Anyway... the place is nice. The offer a nice menu of Halal food...so don't expect beer. The food is home made and we liked the the potato salad especially. Nice quick service and the cakes are really a piece of Germany out there...We've enjoyed the place and went back again for a second time..Show less

Author: Novita S
Title: Excellent
Review: I love the food.. i went with my family (4 people) we are order steak and spagetty.. all recomended. The price not too expensive. I think 1 dish can eat for 2 people.. its veey big size..

Author: FalconVision
Title: A Gem at Oriental Village
Review:
We had a wonderful continental lunch out here. We ordered lots of variety and whatever we had was excellent! The quantity and quality of food was great!

The owner was very friendly and he did recommend some of their best dishes.

Author: 651emmaq
Title: Amazing waffles
Review: Waffles with ice cream were gorgeous. Fresh pineapple juice was the best we've had on the island. Great location.

Author: Islandgarden
Title: Good food at reasonable price
Review: Within the amusement park there is this good western food that is worth the try.  This eatery stall is at the corner within the food court.

Author: Vacationcaptain2017Cluj-Napoca, Romania
Title: Nice prices and friendly owners
Review: We went almost every day there as the quality and the quantity of the food is really excellent. But most of all we enjoyed very much the helpful owners who took their time to explain to us what is worth visiting on the island and also how to travel from there to Koh Lipe. We even received recommendations for our next trip to Bali. Just amazing! Thank you guys, we really miss you!Show less

Author: kinyongl
Title: Worth for Money
Review: Nice chicken chop, big portion and the mushrooms source is delicious. Although we waited quite a long time but due to they lack of manpower and the staff did explain and apologize to us, it is well accepted. Definitely will return for another meal.

Author: RENERONO
Title: GOTTEN APPETITE
Review: Try the german food at this place and acceptable with nice taste and presentation. nice harbour view with a lot of big boats

Author: Diyana t
Title: Best dishes
Review: The food was amazing come with large portion you will satisfied with what you pay, chicken grill its fantastic so juicy.. The staff also great and friendly.

Author: IvanaB1683
Title: VERY GOO,GFC
Review: We travel to Malaysia for the third month and here we had the first good European food. The owner and cook it \ German, because German Food Corner. It IS typical German potato salad, which just know from Germany and the other was excellent, ESPECIALLY TATZIKY, mushrooms and garlic sauce and, of course SCHNITZELs. Food and the environment has a truly European level, the portions are LARGE AND PRICES ON QUALITY MALÉ.VŠEM WHO will visit CABLE TO CAP A ORENTAL willage Highly recommendedShow less

Author: Trevor S
Title: A shining star
Review: Just eaten at the German Food Corner stall at the Oriental Village on Langkawi Island. The food was authentic, hot, tasty and well served very quickly, not only that but reasonably priced for a tourist attraction. Will certainly recommend it to my friends. Good job

Author: limwc78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good cheese cake and chicken chop
Review: Really good cheese cake and chicken chop. I think is the best food in that food court, we order from different store , and I choose the food from this store. Really no regret, the food is nice. Nicer than other food store, love the chicken chop as well. Before leaving, I only recall the cheese cake. Order 2 slides, and share with other. They all say very delicious. Can not believe just a small store the cake is so delicious. Thumb up.Show less

Author: RoadTrippin406
Title: Small cafe in Food Court
Review: Not far from Subway sandwich shop is a far better choice for western food, GFC.  Look for it on the extreme left of the Food Court, close to the bumper cars.  Hard working staff seem to care about quality and service.  Well done!

Author: Sandeepa K
Title: Best place to enjoy some yummy food with fresh juices😍
Review: I really really really like the food of this restaurant.. My friend and I prefer to go this restaurant when we had our day off.. This restaurant serves really yummy food and the prices are reasonable.. French fries, Lamb chop and vanilla cake is my favorite.. And I really like the staff over here they are very friendly.. This is the place where I can spend all of my money and the watermelon juice that's so fresh.. Keep going ❤ your restaurant is only reason to visit Oriental village Show less

Author: rozkev2004Kenmare, Ireland
Title: Reasonably priced food in a theme park
Review: The atmosphere is not great unless you are a lover of theme parks. But we were looking for food here when a lot of places had closed at 7 so was pleased to find somewhere open still. We had the cheapest thing on the menu burger and chips which is not the greatest food in Malaysia but it was fine. There were other things on the menu and I think they could have been good. We took a piece of German cheesecake away with us which was excellent.Show less

Author: Gio FManama, Bahrain
Title: Great food at the oriental village
Review: We needed a quick meal before heading to the waterfalls. After reading a lot of reviews about this place we had burgers and we enjoyed the flavors and the service. As simple as it is, we appreciate a good service and definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a meal during their cable car visit.Show less

Author: m1nm
Title: Good affordable food
Review: We went there after the sky cab. The food was very delicious and affordable, the staff was friendly.

Author: MHQ37
Title: Clean nice food with nice prices
Review:
Good service.good food and nice prices.
Clean food with nice menu.
Different people from different countries were eating there

Author: ispraniVodice, Croatia
Title: Like we are in Europe
Review: After 7 days on trip we came here as children requested. Wiener schnitzel is like home made, but also there is Malaysian food that is also great. Apple strudel is best I ever had. Waiter is very nice and friendly so because of that and tasteful food I give highest grade.Show less

Author: jeknoir
Title: Delicious food
Review: Very tasty food, tried four different dishes and all of them were very good. Friendly staff, juices are good.

Author: SophieNgSingapore
Title: Delicious Cakes
Review: The German Food Corner is a cozy food outlet at the food court in the Langkawi Oriental Village. Though the facade of the food corner may appear to be nondescript, the food absolutely blew me away! The cheesecake was phenomenal and the banana chocolate cake equally fantastic. Surely one of the best small food stalls I have been to and I would definitely recommend you head there too for some amazing delicacies! :)Show less

Author: 84stacey
Title: Great food
Review: During our holiday we went to the German Food Corner three times. During the three visits we had a selection of different foods. Every meal we had was tasty and very filling. I really liked the potatoe salad. I would definitely recommend you eat at the German Food Corner. Show less

Author: Adventurer_Roshan
Title: The cake I tried
Review: The apple with almond cake that I took was simply delicious I couldn't argue about that at all. It is as good as how it seems on the outside

Author: DJ23455
Title: Cheap, good service but average food
Review: Now it's probably my fault for ordering burger at a German food establishment (3 star rating). I'm sure the currywurst is much better. However pop in the waiter is really friendly and it's good value.

Author: EmiliazmiPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Delicious meal at GFC
Review: Had our lunch at the oriental village food court while waiting for the turn to ride the cable car. I was actually eating local food next stall and everything we've ordered is spicy and the kids cannot eat them. My husband suddenly said he's going to order pasta for the kids at German Food Corner. He ordered tuna pasta and it's simply delicious! The kids love it and we love it! Before we went back to the hotel, we've ordered another tuna spaghetti, shrimp and garlic sauce spaghetti and fish and chips for the kiddos coz we cant just stop thinking about it! Both of them are satisfying. Portion is big and worth the price. Would love to try more foods here in the future. Can't wait to be back!Show less

Author: LeopoldVonSchill
Title: Excellent place!
Review: We lived in Geopark about a week, usually we have a dinner in this corner European food. Very good service, big and tasty meals, fantastic mango juices!! Big thank you! Если вы из России и вас занесло в геопарк, то вам должно понравится это место. Кухня привычная, порции большие, персонал очень приветлив)Рекомендую. Show less

Author: 425nickn
Title: German food with German beer
Review: Took beer from nearby duty free (you need to have a passport to buy beer) and had nice dinner with wonderful schnitzel and lamb (40 rm for both)

Author: xx_FAHAD_
Title: Amazing
Review:
Thanks a lot 
Wondrful place and amazing people.
Near of skycap 
If you come to langkawi you must visit it

Author: Andi W
Title: Best Currywurst next to the Äquator ;)
Review: Me and my girl friend tried Spaghetti Bolognese and Currywurst with Fries. Spaghetti was okay, could have been more Beef in but nevermind. But i have not eaten many Currywurst in Germany that could reach this one. Not to mention the mixed fruit Juice (banana and Mango), that was fantastic! Show less

Author: Milandeep
Title: Great European food
Review: GFC is located inside the Oriental Village. It’s a great place to have spaghetti, burgers and home made cake. My daughter enjoyed playing with their cats. And great service.

Author: Coppenst
Title: Expectations met
Review: Lived up to my expectation, great service. Friendly staff. If you want quick European food come here.

Author: wankashLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: The Best "Kartoffelsalat" I Ever Had!!
Review: Had my first kartoffelsalat for take away today (made with love by Monika the cafe owner). It was the best kartoffelsalat in town (I can say) that I ever had!! Pls pls pls try also their special "Currywurst" (German origin consisting of steamed, then fried sausage with curry sauce). Definitely would be my favourite dish whenever I come visit this restaurant again!! Thank you Monika and Ahmed, you both really made my dayy!!Show less

Author: RosnahMSKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Missed the Cakes
Review: We love the taste once we tried the cakes. Wow the cakes are tasty and cheap too.The spaghetti and the chicken chop are delicious very generous with the portion we can’t finish and have to share it with our friends.Since I already felt in love with the cakes I make my 2nd trip the next day just to get more cakes so that I can share them with my family and friends. They too love the cakes. I’m now thinking about the cakes now…yum…DankeShow less

Author: _christ_harry
Title: Not only for Germans!!
Review: Great food and service. If you visit Oriental Village stop over for a nice meal and also try the home made cake. You will come back again....

Author: Mahmoud E
Title: Mahmoud
Review: Amazing food fast service great hospitality from Ahmed he also served the food for us assets me to make my trip better than the average

Author: Mohamed SDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Sooo Delicious Food from friendly People
Review: I would like to take this opportunity to thank you .... lovely people Ahmed & his lovely partner to make my day for me & my spouse after amazing trip in cable car.First we was worry as we don't know any Resturant around area , but after we tried Home made food from German Food Corner especially spaghetti with shrimps , I do recommended for every one, they a lot of varieties in menu.Special Thanks to you Ahmed , enjoy our talk with u , so proud by you , Keep on good hospitality , definitely with tasty food of your Lovely German partner.Show less

Author: 90angadr
Title: Awesome !
Review: Amazing food, loved it. Plus the freshly baked dessert. So since its located in the complex of Langkawi Sky Cab, its unlikely that one would visit just for food.. but id still do that.

Author: 478faridv
Title: The menu includes good variety of food
Review: It's has different kinds of food such as seafood, burgers, snacks, spaghetti that's why I believe it's more international rather than German but the quality of the food & service were good, also the price was reasonable.

Author: Ericascia91
Title: Great food and service!
Review: Excellent food and service! I had an absolutely delicious chicken dish. Definitely worth visiting whilst your in the oriental village.

Author: swim_jessKuching, Malaysia
Title: Not so German
Review: We were a bit disappointed with the food here - it is not so German after all except for the sausages on the menu. We asked what was recommended and he mentioned the spaghetti (not so German after all). We also ordered the gyros with tzatziki which was pretty good but this is also not German but more like Greek food!Show less

Author: sfk20
Title: Excellent food!!
Review:
Situated in Oriental Village...just next to the bumper cars.  Best place to eat...  We ordered 3 dishes for a family of four. It was more than enough,  and everything was excellent! 
Highly recommended...  Especially after the skycab ride :-)

Author: KingHoW2
Title: EAT HERE when visiting Langkawi panorama
Review: We returned to the oriental village from langkawi panorama/cable car around 4pm today, only to find that most shops and restaurants are closed :(Dragging out hungry stomachs, we crossed the footbridge and got to the other side of the oriental village, where we were attracted by an open sign. It was the German food corner.Menu is very extensive (ranges from pastas, steaks, snacks to desserts etc.), very reasonably priced, and the owner was very attentive. We enjoyed a very pleasant late lunch. Will definitely be back next time we visit langkawi.Show less

Author: 619sweepSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and valuable price
Review: We are walking around the skyline park and we came to this food court area. We had a nice discovery - German food corner. Initially we order the chicken nuggets n fries. The kids love them so much. Then, we order another burger and chicken schnizdel with the garlic sauce. They all tasted so nice. All are finished in no time.All visiting skyline park and has craving for westen food much visit the German food corner.Show less

Author: rabeels
Title: Great value for money
Review: Tucked away in a corner, GFC has quite a large menu. I ordered the cheese burger meal and it was delicious. The burger was the right size and really good value for money. Must visit for reasonable yet tasty food

Author: Brennen H
Title: Have to try. So good and staff is helpful
Review: So I went to the food court after going up the cable car, after looking at the food choices we decided that this place looked best. We went over and they were more than helpful. Recommended dishes, brought us cups for our water and then drinks later on. They also went and got us naan bread from another place so we could have our chicken and tzitziki in a wrap. The food was amazing and so filling! Would definitely recommend to anyone who is going to the cable car Show less

Author: Pitbullz
Title: Great food, a must visit place to eat in LK
Review: I cant recommend this place enough. Tried several dishes here and i can honestly say i was never disappointed. Service, quality and prices are all spot on!

Author: memorakoo
Title: Perfect simple food
Review: Delicious food I eat pasta and grilled chicken ,staff was so friendly and cheap price I recommend it if you don't like the Malaysian food.

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Yummy German food at local rates!!
Review: authentic german food but at nearly local rates!! the food are excellent and nice if I am not mistaken the chef and owner are from German as well@@ Never expect you could find a little german food store in Oriental local village. !! I hope they could offer german beer in near by future as I spoke to the owner they don't allowed to do it~~~ hmmm For sure I will drop by for a glass of two german beer!! maybe consider selling it in german Octobest!!Show less

Author: Eman A
Title: Langkawi Honeymoon trip
Review: The best place to have lunch in the whole langkawi, yumiiii pasta, friendly staff, tried it once and kept visiting the place..

Author: Medadams
Title: Awesome food
Review: We had amazing and well prepared european food here after having asian food for months. The place should be on the beach not up here ;)

Author: sarahnphil
Title: Western food and more, great shakes too.
Review: In the food court, very good value, good choice, friendly staff, great choice, yummy fresh shakes, all food in this court was good.

Author: Lauren_NSW93
Title: Yum
Review: Ate here when visiting the cable cars and it was so good. They were very careful with my food and made sure it didnt contain anything i was allergic to. Great food, great service. Worth the trip just for the food :)

Author: georgesX6165IW
Title: Great place!
Review: Food is very nice there and the host is very experienced and friendly. This place really helped our breakfast since it was a very short walk from Geopark Hotel where we stayed.

Author: Mo_E_G_128Doha, Qatar
Title: Amazing food !
Review: After a long day at the skycab and 3D art museum, we went for the food court, its a 3 mins walk.We were having sea food almost daily, we though we give it a change.German food corner is a really cool spot , great food, very friendly and fast service , very nice food portions , tasty and affordable.Highly recommended ;) Show less

Author: LeeQ53
Title: Food is excellent
Review: Although it is located at the food court but the food is good and way better than expected. We shared cordon blue and fish & chip. The portion is big enough for 3 people. The cordon Bleu is quite good especially the potato salad is really good. Show less

Author: seafare74
Title: Good Service and Food
Review: Of the many choices in the food court this one seemed to provide very good service by the couple that own it and also generous portion sizes for a reasonable price. Nice selection of fresh fruit juices too.

Author: Edmund H
Title: Average
Review: Food was plain. The cordon blue was merely a schnitzel cut into half with cheese and ham sandwiched between them. But on the bright side, the food was not oily and the schnitzels weren't dry.

Author: SusanneSch111Hamburg, Germany
Title: Tastes like home!
Review: After months of rice and roti I felt the need of some change and found out about that German food Corner close to cable car. What a gem!Yes, it is mainly German fast food - but really good one. Trust me, I am German and I love Currywurst and Bratwurst (german sausages). THIS Currywurst can compete with any great Currywurst you can get in Berlin and/or Hamburg!I also loved Moni's freshly made Mayonnaise Potatosalad - really yummy.Also the Sauce Bolognese is great. I tried it in other places on the island, but the meat was a bit chewy. Not the case in Monis and Achmets place. Very delicious!And the good part in it: Everything comes in big portions. Initially I wanted to round up my lunch by a piece of their homemade cakes, but never managed - I was just too full from their main dish.Oh... and Moni and Achmet are really nice people. Easy to talk to. They even helped me find a cheap motorbike rental on the island...I try to go there as often as I can!Show less

Author: vampiirec
Title: Excellent food!
Review: The place is in oriental village food court, since that I'm a student, I have not much income. So we looking cheap and nice food in this place. We ordered lamb burger, beef burger and a chocolate banana cake. Those food are very tasty and the price is acceptable! Staff are friendly and efficient! This is one of my favourite restaurant in Langkawi!Show less

Author: markjhiggsBeijing, China
Title: An Excellent Surprise
Review: This restaurant is in the food court in the Oriental Village and it's a real gem. We have tried a variety of dishes and they have all been very good. You can also pre order a fish (one day's notice) which we did and it was excellent. They provide a take away service so we take food back to the hotel and sit on our balcony mostly. This restaurant produces much better food than the restaurants down on Telega Harbour and the Berjaya, it's a real find. The two owners are lovely and very helpful. We will be using this restaurant lots more during our 32 nights stay. I have no hesitation in recommending this place.Show less

Author: NomadicBoys
Title: Good safe food (v yummy dessert)
Review:
We came here on a Friday after Eid- all the other eateries were shut except this gem which meant it was very busy!

Despite this, we had a nice omelette and chicken giro kebab. The real highlight is their dessert!

Author: Vineet05Perth, Australia
Title: Great food!
Review: Loved the friendly and efficient service of the staff. We went around the time of Ramadan so it seemed quiet. But the cook who also takes orders is extremely quick, efficient and professional and friendly too. Loved this place. It's located near the pond in Oriental Village in Langkawi.Show less

Author: wanderlustipsMumbai, India
Title: The German touch in the tropics !!!
Review: This place is in the Oriental Village Food Court . The bakes are made by a nice German lady . We located this after our lunch hence missed the main dishes . However ordered an Almond Banana Cake ....and it was out of the world . The price range is between RM 9 to RM 25 . It makes the lunch quite affordable . For Europeans this will be a welcome break .Show less

Author: Sameera Y
Title: Average
Review:
I ordered a shrimp burger set but it didn't really taste like shrimp.
Food is not great. Prices are okay.
Service is okay as well.
I guess just an average small restaurant in oriental village.

Author: 76lucye
Title: Great sandwiches
Review: Stopped here when visiting the Oriental Village and the Cable car ride. Friendly service and lovely freshly prepared sandwiches.

Author: Stefan_Shanghai
Title: German food in a typical Malay foodcourt
Review: As we are living since a couple of years outside of Germany it was a pleasure to eat for small price fantastic German "fast" food. sausages and cheesecake!

Author: ilansmithLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent taste,Big portion and very acceptable price
Review: we have been in this restaurant for many times because we had stayed at Berjaya hotel which is so nice place but the food in the hotel is not tasty and so highly prices,we had a walk through the oriental village and we found this nice restaurant at the food court. the food was so tasty and the portion was so big and the price is really so cheap,the restaurant itself is so clean and the owners they serve by themselves and they are so friendly and help us with many tips about what to do in the island and where to go,we ate the whole menu heheh even we ask about fish "which is not in the menu" and they have done for us a grilled fish with garlic and BBQ sauce yummy was so tasty and really cheap price too . the juice also so good there and the service is perfect and fast too.Show less

Author: Tom1The1Explorer
Title: Delicious Western Halal food in a Friendly Clean Budget Restaurant!
Review:
Delicious Western Halal food in a Friendly Clean Budget Restaurant!
We really enjoyed the food during our last stay in Langkawy

Author: YousefZ83
Title: Nice food and friendly atmosphere
Review: The place is nice, offering good quality western food at good prices, the owners are serving themselves so the atmosphere is friendly even for a place in a food court

Author: kencarvossoSandhurst, United Kingdom
Title: A very non German corner
Review: This is a very poor name for a cheap corner , open fronted fast food bar in the chair lift park on Langkawi. Not a thing about this place is at all German except the flags and the name. If you are looking for proper German food try Mangoes. Don't bother with this place and by the way I've lived in Germany on and off since 1977.Show less

Author: Conny K
Title: very friendly and very jummy....
Review: kindly owners, monicas german cheese cake, delicious..... you can try what you want, all very jummy..... visit this locations so oft as possible....

Author: Scott L
Title: Great Food and Great Service
Review: We ate here a few times and loved the food. Service was great with some very helpful tips on what and where to visit while we were in Langkawi. Great place for lunch or an early dinner at a very reasonable price.

Author: BZ91
Title: Excellent price/quality offer and kind welcome
Review: Gret choice of simple but delicious dishes at low prices. We thank the staff for their kindness and their availability. Beyond serving food, they advise us on things to do and boring places to avoid. Our kids loved this restaurant.

Author: Wusserlad
Title: OK but never the number one place in Cenang!
Review:
We called here based on the T/A reviews.
The food was nice and the service OK but I am puzzled to why it is so highly rated?

We only went once and didn’t go back.
Then again not everyone is wrong.

Author: Krinnakoo
Title: Delicious food
Review: A nice, small restaurant with friendly service and excellent galettes and crepes. Best food on my holiday.

Author: Marina B
Title: Delicious
Review:
It’s very nice and clean place , food is tasty and delicious 😋 
Highly recommended 
Very kind French owners

Author: rahelnaef
Title: Best Crêpe
Review: One uf de best Crêpes if ever eat! Such a sweet little french family. Wish u all the best! Also the watermelon juice was so good!

Author: zmmri
Title: Nice cafe
Review: The food was very nice. We had a good breakfast at Breizh up. It felt like a good home made breakfast. The owner Karim and his wife are very nice and welcoming people!

Author: Jehonest
Title: Delish!
Review:
We really enjoyed our tuna crepe and sandwich, the ingredients are super fresh and the coffee was perfect!
Would definitely recommend for a light lunch or breakfast. 😀

Author: Yahyaa01
Title: Beautiful
Review: The resturant being their home had a warm feeling and was very very clean. Very good french food that was worth every ringgit. Definitely plan on returning before leaving langkawi

Author: markhR473HY
Title: Hidden gem with delicious crêpes!
Review: We went here because of tripadvisor reviews, otherwise we would have just walked passed it without even noticing or thinking it would be worth a visit. Shared a savory and a sweet crêpe together (egg, onion & cheese and the nutella banana one) and ordered an extra one because it was so delicious! We will come back. Show less

Author: joshua_Solo
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi,
Review: Best restaurant in Langkawi, the food is so good and the people are very nice, definitely come here to eat.

Author: Nicochocko
Title: Homemade Brittany cuisine in Langkawi
Review: Coming from Brittany myself I had big expectations and was absolutely amazed by the galettes and crêpes of Krimo and Vanessa. The Ponpom rouge galette and salted caramel butter ones are my favorite but all is great. Thanks for the yummy experience.

Author: Discover15624314152
Title: Brunch
Review: Breizh Up is a nice little cafe located in pantai cenang, right above 7-11. The owners are very welcoming and the crepes were delicious. Will definetly visit again. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: LaurentL643Brittany, France
Title: Brittany in ur plate
Review: If you want try Crêpes in Malaysia so goto this asap.... . Galettes and Crepes are very nice and tasty.Owners very friendly.Show less

Author: jyswitBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Friendly Owners & Good Breakfast
Review: Note that you have to remove your shoes like how most of us do at home. Just a heads up in case you are not used to removing your shoes in public places. Very clean environment. Simple deco. Love the simple food too. Breakfast sets for RM20, comes with chilled orange juice and double espresso (for non-coffee experts, espresso is served in mini mug) and your choice of English (Omelette), French (Crossaint) and Breizh (Sugar Crepe). All taste good to me. Nutella Mango Crepe was good too! Fresh mango served. Show less

Author: Karoline_HaBerlin, Germany
Title: Super good!!
Review: The best crepes and galettes outside of France! We loved the little cafe and the service was super nice! Show less

Author: cowboyb2019
Title: Great French crepes in Langkawi
Review: The food was amazing and the two French owners very nice and talkative about their personal experience in Langkawi. I highly recommend this place for its traditional French crepes and cosy ambiance. Show less

Author: ChloeOnTheRoad
Title: Nice breakfast
Review: The couple which owns the restaurant is very friendly. They gave us a nice table on the balcony where you have a good view on the street. The breakfast was tasty, we had banana crêpes, coffee, orange juice and egg with baguette. I would come again.Show less

Author: NopainNogain88
Title: OK
Review: I tried the Gallette, a Crepe with nutella, chicken sandwich cappuccino and fresh juice. Nothing spectacular but ok

Author: raebranbriPerth, Australia
Title: Family breakfast
Review: We came here for a late breakfast to try the crepes and coffee. The Americano coffee was really good and so was their herbal tea. We enjoyed the buckwheat and wheat crepes with caramel sauce and mango, and honey crepes. This place is run by a lovely French couple. Not to be missed especially if you want to have something other than local food. Show less

Author: DufreneSebSG
Title: Delicious french crepes meal at Pantai Cenang
Review: Our second time there with more than a year in between. Still great as the first time. Delicious galettes (buckwheat crepes) and sweet crepes for dessert. And a good coffee. The space is really nice and it's a very relacing environment. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: CaelumcelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, good place, good service
Review: Found this place after reading good reviews here. Definitely not disappointing. The galettes and crepes were so good. Perhaps can have more spaghetti choices since their one and only spaghetti was kinda good as well. Its above a 7-11 store which could be easily missed so do walk slowly and look out for it. In short, affordable prices, yummy food, friendly service and cosy place!Show less

Author: Whateverwoolala
Title: Yummy pasta and crepes with handsome boss.
Review: Went for lunch and order pasta, pompon rouge, crepes ( nutella and banana, dark chocolate with mango) . They have only one pasta but is damn good. E noodles are thick and the cheesy taste are just nice n right. Crepes are super soft and every part of It is soft. Unlike some shops, they have uneven texture of the crepes. I will definitely go there again .Show less

Author: Wy0209Singapore, Singapore
Title: Cozy atmosphere, awesome crepes
Review: Went for lunch and 3 of us ordered their one and only choice of pasta, pompon rouge, crepes,ie, nutella and banana, dark chocolate and mango. Pasta was done right, not too heavily flavored and nearly wanted to order another plate of it. Their crepes are really up to standard. Soft and springy, fresh ingredients and the combination leave us feeling satisfied and value for $$. Very pleasant and cozy atmosphere. No issue with cleaniness at all. Good and prompt service as well. Definitely will go back if holiday in Langkawi again. Oh! Awesome americano as well!Show less

Author: Jasmine NNelson, New Zealand
Title: Best Crepes in town!
Review: Food was delicious, along with some of the best customer service we’ve received since visiting Langkawi! %100 would recommend :-)Show less

Author: Stormy_SAShanghai, China
Title: Refreshingly good food
Review: We had the tuna salad , tuna crepe and banana caramel crepe. It was all well prepared and quite tasty. Really enjoyed the food and the coffee is the best I’ve had in Langkawi! Much better than the other French crepe restaurant in Langkawi. Double thumbs upShow less

Author: Camper63112484883
Title: Fresh, light, homemade, delicious
Review: With a lot of their offerings made freshly in house, it's no surprise that the end results are very satisfying and authentic. The savoury options are great, but if you're a chocolate lover then be sure not to miss the crêpes with homemade dark chocolate.Show less

Author: shuicai301Geelong, Australia
Title: Relaxing brunch
Review: Second floor restaurant with a clean , fresh and breezy feel. Super yummy crepes, it was great that celiac (gluten free) family member could be catered for with a buckwheat crepe alternative. Show less

Author: rajarshis2013
Title: Soulful breakfast
Review: Yesterday was my first visit to this restaurant managed solely by a lovely couple.The food is so filling and yum.But apart from the food the ever smiling faces of the restaurant host fills you up with positivity.Loved the place loved the helpful hosts.They do have real honest feedback of the places to visit in langkawi!!.Do ask them more about the content of the food,being an Indian I barely had any idea of French food,but they explained to us in detail,helping us choose the perfect breakfast.Surely coming back again,hopefully they are still operating from this lovely restaurant.Show less

Author: xk3lvinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great ambience with friendly staff
Review: Chanced upon this place on TripAdvisor as we have no idea what to eat for breakfast. Turns out it’s really good! The price is relatively cheap and the staff are really friendly towards us. Will def recommend! Show less

Author: jami_182
Title: Tasty food, bit overpriced for the area
Review: We really enjoyed the galette and the Nutella/Caramel crepe as well as our coffees. However I would say that you can probably eat food that is just as tasty for a lot cheaper in this area.

Author: FelixFrejStockholm, Sweden
Title: Best possible breakfast
Review: Amazing place, a must visit in Langkawi! Appreciate the advice we got about the island too, they were super helpful hereShow less

Author: DD7250Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely little restaurant
Review: We came across this restaurant quite by accident, as it is located on the 2nd floor along the Pantai Cenang town area. We were pleasantly surprised, the ambiance was very relaxing and food was good. Prices are also very affordable, should give this place a try if around the area.Show less

Author: pushpalpKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Breizh up... A definite visit!
Review: We were looking for a great breakfast on Sunday morning. The shop opened a bit late.. but would have missed it if not waited. We all had Galettes and Crepes and they were just awesome. The staff were really friendly and welcoming. Also try the kusumi tea. Must be in your bucket list for good food and a relaxed morningShow less

Author: joshua_SoloKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast
Review: The breakfast and dessert crepes are very delicious! The staff is very friendly and polite as well. Definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: berecbarAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious food and friendly people
Review: We came here for brunch and it was amazing. Prices were little higher than local food, but it was worthy. I would defenetly recommend this restaurant!Show less

Author: NIKINYBeijing, China
Title: Great Breakfast
Review: Good food, good service, extremely clean. Above the 7-11 so it is easy to miss but another world when you go upstairs.Show less

Author: stennuzzAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Amazing pancakes
Review: The real French galettes and crepes! Amazing. Juices and coffee also really good. We will come back again.Show less

Author: elphinaBratislava, Slovakia
Title: Authentic amazing french crepes
Review: It's not easy to find this place by chance because it's on the second floor of building above 7 eleven, but it's definitely worth it. If you are looking for something different than Malay, Indian, Chinese ........or if you're simply fan of French crepes and galletes like me don't miss it. Taste is as real as it can get, run by friendly French guys. It's also nice place with a view of the town promenade very near to main beach. Show less

Author: ilario fMelaka, Malaysia
Title: French touch in Langkawi
Review: Nice and very friendly place. Crepes are very well done at a very reasonable price. Try the sweet crepes with homemade dark chocolate and mango. And finish with a nice espresso. All excellent. Show less

Author: Britta456
Title: Great Crepes
Review: Great crepes and very nice atmosphere. A small clean and cozy oasis in the main street of Pantai Cenang. We recommend.Show less

Author: William M
Title: Closed on Saturday 26th Jan 2019
Review: Went there 7pm as advertised opening hours, waited till 7:30pm and still closed. Tried to ring no answer.. so have they closed shop for good or temporary?

Author: steffi8313Cologne, Germany
Title: Perfect place
Review: Great place to be! We just had breakfast there, two sweet pancakes, coffee and orange juice. Everything was perfect! Food is delicious and the waiters are super nice. The place is absolutely clean and since it’s on the upper floor (above 7/11 store), you have a nice view to the road! They have inside and outside tables. A bit more expensive than local food restaurants, but absolutely worth it!!!!! We‘ll come back!! Show less

Author: juliatryzUppsala, Sweden
Title: Great service
Review: Had lunch here when it wasn’t too busy. Got taken care of in a good way, the food was served fast and it was very delicious. Very clean and nice facilities in the restaurant as wellShow less

Author: Destination679551
Title: very good food
Review: The food was very good, and also the ice cream, very good service, too. First good cafe for a few days.Show less

Author: 168johannesrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent coffee
Review: First time visited the place for quick meal. Both Pasta and galette were delicious. Coffees was also excellent.Show less

Author: ALAAYASMINMalaysia
Title: Friendly Owners, FOOD IS SPECTACULAR!!
Review: I’ve been living in Langkawi & this was my first visit to the restaurant & I wish I came here before, the owners are very friendly and welcoming, I felt like I was back home. Their salads were delicious and if you ever decide to come here do try their breakfast options & their crepes. One of the best French restaurants in langkawiShow less

Author: Isabelle LShanghai, China
Title: Nice French food from Brittany in a friendly atmoshere
Review: Thumbs up for Breiz Up the French crepes and galettes restaurant in Langkawi. Nice food with a warm welcome from the owners, it is worth going there to share a nice moment with friends or family.Show less

Author: rove9053Kanpur Nagar District, India
Title: breakfast
Review: This place is good for french break fast and dinner staff and chef was awesome and service was excellent and taste was too good must try.Show less

Author: ekta pMalaysia
Title: Crepes!
Review: The chef veganised the savory crepes. They were quite good but not as excellent as the sweet ones. The place is neat and quiet.Show less

Author: Scenic07383346770
Title: The joy of crepes in Langkawi
Review: We had a very nice lunch with salted crepes (galettes) then sweet crepes for dessert (yum yum) ! The staff and place is very welcoming and the location is very convenient when being at Cenang Beach.Show less

Author: alexchandran84Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It's a nice little restaurant on cenang
Review: This is nice spot up above 711 on cenang. We missed break fast :( but had a nice pasta and eggs with crepes and sausage. Would go early cos their breakfasts looks good. Show less

Author: jeandault
Title: Great crêpes and very useful advices
Review: We enjoyed the good meals (trust us, we are French ;) ) and the useful advices (places to go, tips for sightseeings) from this very nice and welcoming couple. It eased our stay and saved us a lot of time!And we specially recommend the "caramel au beurre salé" waffle :)Show less

Author: LattejunkieMalaysia
Title: Cosy French cafe with awesome Crepes!
Review: This cafe was recommended by my husband and it's quite a cosy and homey French cafe in Langkawi. It's located upstairs and you have to remove your shoes, hence the home-like feel. The crepes was indeed fantastic! I ordered one which was a nasi lemak flavour and wow, the spicy-ness was spot on, hats off! And of course, we ordered a dessert crepe too, can't resist! The owners, a French couple who served us were very friendly too.Overall, I like it and would recommend to friends to give it a try!Show less

Author: trebellodiasTianjin, China
Title: Late night snack!
Review: Great we found this place! They offered us a delicious crepe! We had been searching for some sweet around!! The place is nice and the couple was really friendly and efficient! Show less

Author: azraa14Johannesburg, South Africa
Title: Amazing find!
Review: Decided to have a late night snack and so we stopped here and we were not disappointed! Had freshly squeezed fruit juice and a chicken wrap! We ended our meal with authentic crepes with caramel drizzled over. Was out of this world! The couple who run the place are so friendly and service was excellent! Definitely a place to try out if you want to have a break from seafood.Show less

Author: 72TimSMelbourne, Australia
Title: A nice change from Malaysian Breakfast
Review: While I do enjoy spicy Malaysian breakfasts we stumbled across Breizh Up run by a lovely French couple. They serve wonderful crepes and galettes and in a nice environment. Would highly recommend.Show less

Author: kiiutheexplorer
Title: Eould recommend
Review: Very nice French food and fast service! Breakfast menu was only for one hour in the morning so we unfortunately missed it. But i had the savoury crepes and they were delicious

Author: ValueSeeker83Lahad Datu, Malaysia
Title: Homey restaurant and Friendly Owner !!!
Review: Excellent customer service. The lady owner understands Bahasa Malay. They serve delicious Galette. which was my brunch. She offers very flexible option on the add-on. Even it was a hot weather, I enjoy my hot "Be Cool" drink as the sea breeze is coming through the cosy balcony. If there is wind chime around, I would probably stay a bit longer. Love the setting. The young couple creates a very lovely setting. I think they care about the environment and their customer.Magnifique!!!!PS: Remember to take out your shoes. It is in the second floor above 7-Eleven.Show less

Author: Climber147786Linz, Austria
Title: Nice French Place at Langkawi
Review: We went to the restaurant for crepes and waffles, which all were very delicious. The french owners of the place are very friendly - would definitely visit again!Show less

Author: CalvinT210
Title: Excellent food and service!!!
Review: Good food and service. Since owners are French, they have good knowledge of Paris. Had great seats at the verandah and excellent coffee, and not to mention excellent crêpes.Show less

Author: Valeria H
Title: Good service and friendly staff
Review: Breizh up is a nice place with authentic French food. We had the Galette and it was delicious, as well as the coffee. We'll definitely come here again!Show less

Author: Wendy T
Title: Delicious!
