Review: Really delicious crepes in a bright, clean, upstairs cafe. We stumbled upon it by accident and if we were staying longer we would have gone back. Absolutely recommend.Show less

Author: Saraleonard
Title: Delicious food, beautiful location
Review: Came here for lunch and had the tuna sandwich which was absolutely incredible!The staff were lovely and the 'bon appetite' as our meal was served was a lovely touch.Brilliant location for a spot of lunch.Show less

Author: pipburghamHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Perfect for a sandwich near the beach
Review: This place is so near to the beach, so it is perfect for lunch if you are spending a day at the beach. We all chose to have sandwiches, which were fantastic (fresh ingredients and crusty bread). The owners were very friendly, I would recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: Patrick VParis, France
Title: Delicious breakfast
Review: Delicious craps and ciabatta's at this place. Went here three times to get breakfast during our 5 day stay at Langkawi. Not very cheap, but the food is worth the money. Very kind owners too!Show less

Author: kateisnot0nfireSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Good crepes and nice interior!
Review: I had the sugar crepe with fresh lemon juice and it was AMAZING. Their caramel waffle is pretty good too, love their homemade caramel, it's so good! Service was pretty nice too, as the staffs were lovely people. The interior is pretty clean and modern, has a very crisp look to it. We enjoyed our time here and we will definitely visit again when we happen to be back to Langkawi.Bonus point: There's this lovely and gentle calico cat that always sits at the bottom of the stairs of their shop. She's a real good luck charm and she should always be there.Show less

Author: Sebastian S
Title: Eating like God in France
Review: Sweet little bistro located upstairs above a shop. The French owners serve croissant, crêpes, galette, sandwiches, coffee, and various fresh juices.Everything tastes very well and is served quickly. Can fully recommend it!Show less

Author: KoobumSingapore, Singapore
Title: authentic and delicious
Review: We were a little disappointed the "la Malaisienne" galette was not properly localised with ikan bilis (replaced with tuna), but the overall ambience and the very french owners made up for it with their hospitality. We had a sweet crepe which was also very delicious with their home made caramel sauce. Do note the location is not difficult to find but you do need to know that it's on the upper floor of a shophouse. Overall a fun experience.Show less

Author: ThommyUU
Title: Great people with great food
Review: I was looking for a change to Malaysian food and found this French café. It offers crèpes, galettes and some other dishes. Finally I tried the Malaysian palette which was a perfect mix of French food and local ingredients. Coffee was also good.Have a chat with the owners - they're cool ;)Will come back on my next trip to Langkawi - merci beaucoup!Show less

Author: 719enzovLille, France
Title: Amazing breizh restaurant
Review: Very nice hosts ! The atmosphere and the food introduce yourself to the french breizh atmosphere The food is as good as the restaurant team ! Show less

Author: Tim v
Title: Nice, clean and helpfull
Review: So nice to have a wonderful lunch. After 3 weeks Malaysian food, it was nice! Great crepes! Tommorow we come back to have breakfast. Food looks Nice! When work is done on the other side you have a nicer view, but the staff is so nice. Gave us good advice for activities in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Compass792384
Title: Excellent service & home style cooking
Review: Visited this restaurant eith my mother for dessert and everything was perfect, the atmosphere, the view and the food I'd recommend the nutella waffle/crepe also vanilla ice cremaShow less

Author: aaronv16Rulzheim, Germany
Title: Slow service and average breakfast
Review: Took them long time to take the order and bring out the drinks even tho we were the only ones in the restaurant. The food tastes alright but for us this is not one of the best restaurants in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Lucie M
Title: Delicious !
Review: After months far from Brittany we were so pleased to find "Breizh Up"! The owners are very nice and the food is tasty! Feels like home...Thanks ! Show less

Author: Salina JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy!
Review: My family of 5 with 2 teens and an 8 year old went there for dinner and lunch. I had the Malasiene crepe which was fabulous. They ran out of “ikan bilis” which was a shame cause I bet it would have been great. They subtituted it with spicy tuna which was also good. Kids loved the spaghetti and the Pompom Rouge. We also ordered sweet crepes of nutella banana, caramel and lemon and sugar. All were excellent and the plate was cleaned. I especially loved the homemade caramel as it tasted very buttery and not sickeningly sweet. They also do a mean ice lemon tea. The owners were very nice and oh so french which added to the ambience. The place could be hard to find as it’s upstairs but just look for 7-Eleven and it’s right next door. The only bad point was the crepes are very light so if you can eat a lot, I’d order more than one crepe! Would highly recommend it.Show less

Author: FlavbyJuNanterre, France
Title: Simple, fresh and frenchy!
Review: After almost 3 weeks in Malaysia, I wanted to feel eat differently and check how French food was exported! Dishes are appealing, with French names and taste very good! The owners cook and wait and they are really nice to chat with! If you want to taste typical French cuisine, climb the stairs and pick up a crêpe at Breizh’up enjoying a calm view on busy Cenang from the terrace! Show less

Author: beccakeogh41
Title: Good crepes
Review: Would recommend if you want a snack... the crepes are very good and the wifi is fast. Service was great! Show less

Author: llyradSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very nice place and crepes
Review: The food here is delicious. From the bread to the waffles and the crepes. Yummy. Pity their breakfast is only from 9.30-10.30am. I Guess that’s when normal people have breakfast Owner is a very friendly French couple. Really hands on and sincere to provide a good meal and experience. Show less

Author: LynSmith66Melbourne, Australia
Title: Delightful Cafe
Review: We’d been for a long walk and we’re looking for a nice spot to have a drink and something nice to eat. Breizh Up did not disappoint. Set above the 7-Eleven on the main road through Cenang, it is an oasis above the street. Incredibly clean, great service and beautiful food, all based around crepes. It is run by a delightful young French couple. The recipe is an authentic French recipe, passed down through the family, who originated from Brittany. A real surprise given the area is dominated by Asian, Middle Eastern and Indian restaurants.Show less

Author: jackaspencer1Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing crepes and service
Review: Delicious breakfast right next to malibest resort. Crepes were perfect and Krimau was very kind and helpful with questions on what to do on the island.Show less

Author: S6620IZnicolerMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great crepes 😀
Review: Visited just today for breakfast. The crepes were wonderfully cooked and tasted amazing! Highly recommend the nutella and banana crepe. The service was great and the crepes came out efficiently. There was barely a wait for food. We enjoyed sitting on the outdoor balcony with a beautiful sea breeze. The interior was nicly decorated also. Highly recommend for a delicious breakfast. Also try the Kushmi teas they we really good. They also serve coffee. Great place. Plan to go back Show less

Author: lindy1993Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious breakfast and lunch
Review: We loved having breakfast at Breizh Up. Delicious pancakes, croissants and ciabattas and very kind owners. Definitely a recommendation! Show less

Author: soanonymous3China
Title: Delicious and authentic
Review: We had the banana/nutella crepe and an americano. Both were delicious! The place is immaculately clean and it’s run by a sweet French couple. Will definitely be back. Show less

Author: 179helenaaSundsvall, Sweden
Title: Realy Nice lunch
Review: We eat crepe and sanwich. The sanwich with feta and apple was superb!!! God service and nice staf. The place was clean. Show less

Author: Julie RRaglan, New Zealand
Title: Great food + friendly owners!
Review: We came here two times for breakfast and dessert and had both savoury and sweet crepes. Both were fantastic and reasonably priced. Very clean restaurant and owners were very friendly. Show less

Author: seestanleyTootgarook, Australia
Title: Great Croissants and Coffee
Review: Lovely people great food , we had croissants , waffles and they were delicious, lovely people with lots of local knowledgeShow less

Author: carolinedV5023WHSaint-Jacques-de-la-Lande, France
Title: Un petit coin de Bretagne en Malaisie
Review: The food was really amazing, I felt like I was in Brittany, I highly recommanded this place, U can have proper galette with Real flour, and the crêpe are really good too. The owner are so nice, they gave us advice for visiting the island. If u are not from France, come and try the real taste of BrittanyShow less

Author: whysixteen
Title: Post-breakfast snack
Review: Friendly owners, greeted us with a smile, made us feel very welcomed. However, there were many guests before us, so they had to serve us later. They did tell us that it’s going to take a while, and we appreciated that. However, perhaps they could serve us our drinks first so that we will have something to sip on while waiting. Nonetheless, food was great, perfect! Highly recommended if you’re into crepes. Show less

Author: b7wdnHong Kong, China
Title: Decent Breakfast
Review: Nice cosy place, with decent food. If you like crepes you won’t find better in Langkawi! Lovely staff, very polite and attentive. Worth a visit for sure. Show less

Author: Olivier L
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We went to breiz up and were pleasantly surprised by the service and the quality of the food. If we can we will come back.

Author: Haseebo
Title: Best crepe desserts in langkawi
Review: Been here 3 times already! Crepes well worth it and delicious.Clean and neat. French family recipe! Show less

Author: peichin-1Malaysia
Title: Good food and friendly owner
Review: The place is very cosy and clean. Owner is very friendly and nice. I like their crepes very much. Definitely will pay them a visit in future. Value for money! Show less

Author: 271cecilev
Title: Great food and coffee
Review: We went to Breizh Up for lunch and coffee. The gallettes were amazing! The rest of the menu also looked really good. We loved the French vibe and the service was great. Plus, they serve Nespresso coffee, so we will be back soon :) Show less

Author: hazimihaririMalaysia
Title: OK
Review: This cafe run by friendly couple. The services were good and excellent.The food price is a bit expenses. I eat crepe dark chocolate and hot americano for RM26.The place inside also hot because they not open aircond or fan. Better eat outside.Show less

Author: RafaelGPintoBraga, Portugal
Title: Amazing and cozy
Review: The Breizh Up is managed by a very friendly couple. The food is amazing its quite nice. They deserve the 6th star because they have a proper coffee for the western people.. A nespresso machine. Definitely deserves the visit! Show less

Author: PatrikA423
Title: Easy to miss
Review: Nice place, French food. Went there for breakfast. Easy to miss - located right on top of 7-11 opposite to Malibest. Show less

Author: O7133MQhannahHelsinki, Finland
Title: Amazing Breakfast!
Review: If you want to have absolutely amazing breakfast you have to visit in Breizh Up! Place is very clean and it has nice patio where you can enjoy your meal. I recommend to taste that feta chiapatta and crepes! Show less

Author: Chloé G
Title: Amazing Feta ciabatta!
Review: Had lunch here with my boyfriend! We order the crepe with nutella and a ciabatta with feta, apple and lettuce. The taste was amazing! The coffee is also good! We definitely are coming back to this place and try the breakfast! Show less

Author: elsas2016Svay Dangkum, Cambodia
Title: Excellent but inconsistent opening times
Review: We went there twice for breakfast and it was lovely. The crepes are delicious and the coffee is heaven. Service was great and the staff are really friendly. We wanted to return for lunch on two different occasions and both times found the place closed (even though the board outside says they remain open until 3:00PM). Show less

Author: julieptutuDisneyland Paris
Title: tasty
Review: nice place to relax and enjoy good food ! the fresh juices are yummy and the galettes and crepes really good. everything is fresh ! the owners are really friendly as well. i recommend :)Show less

Author: Devlin K
Title: pass
Review: overpriced, underwhelming, and they add a 10% "service charge" to your bill. you can get much better for cheaperShow less

Author: 624talulaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent place
Review: If you’re in the market for a crepe then this place is good. We thought the quality and food was good, but service was just ok and we left still hungry. Place is cute and clean.Show less

Author: diverfromsgboston
Title: Yummy crepes!
Review: Had dinner here, I had the chicken and egg crepe (forgot the name on the menu) and my wife had the ikan bilis crepe. The style of the crepes are unique to the restaurant’s namesake, I enjoyed it! Crispy, thin yet still savory. The ikan bilis crepe was hot even for Asian tastes though!Finished it off with a sugar crepe, which I thought was nicely done.Noticed the restaurant is run by the owners who are a couple. We saw them make the crepes with love (and diligently). That makes a difference!Show less

Author: chefmel99Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Delicious crepe place run by a friendly French couple
Review: Randomly walked into this place when I was searching for breakfast with my husband. It was fairly empty (maybe cause we were early) but having visited the island many times, Langkawi isn't the best place for food so we actually didn't expect much from this place too. Was a pleasant surprise that the savory crepe was delicious! It wasn't like any other crepe I've had - wrapped in fiery sambal and an egg. This was the most memorable food I've eaten in my entire four days trip. The other thing you may noticed the moment you stepped in the cafe is the very clean floor - I've honestly never seen an eating place with floor as clean as theirs. Haha. Show less

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Excellent
Review: The crepe with homemade caramel & grated coconut was excellent... I didn’t eat more only because I was restaurant-hopping that day.The French couple who runs this place takes a genuine interest in the food quality & takes time to chat with each customer... Truly a pleasant experience.Show less

Author: Thea J
Title: Best crepes in Malaysia
Review: This restaurant is absolutely amazing. The owners (a French couple) are so sweet, and they make the visit even better! The crepes are absolutely amazing, and so are the sandwiches and salads!You cannot go to Langkawi without visiting this place!!!Show less

Author: Farhan_NasirIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Tea Time? This is the place to be
Review: Every time I visit Langkawi. I will not miss the opportunity to come here to enjoy my crepe (La Salidou Caramel + fresh Banana). The homemade salted caramel sauce will always have place in my taste bud n memory! First time visited here was in 2017. The taste and quality well maintained. Not to be forgotten is the wide variety of their Kusmi Tea! Just love it! For tea lovers....come here alright. And the owner themselves will serve you with their warmest hospitality! If you visit them please say hi in behalf of me. Say hi To Krimo and Vanessa!! Show less

Author: bjorn bAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: French prices for OK French food
Review: Expensive. 20 ringgit for a very poor chicken sandwich.Wife had a nice pancake. Nice view to the street.Do you want a dash of milk with you your coffee? That is a extra 4 ringit!!Show less

Author: 589lenkasPanama City, Panama
Title: The best salad at langkawi
Review: Amazing food, staff, nice place, definitely recommend this place :) go for chicken salad! I will come back. Show less

Author: pplaice
Title: Delicious crepes
Review: Delicious crepes and lovely, friendly service! Authentic French experience in Langkawi! Great for sweet or savoury!

Author: Cojmo
Title: Nice lunch
Review: Very nice lunch location with friendly staff; delicious French gallettes! The only thing that didn‘t work out was the order for drinks...

Author: Ron FCanberra, Australia
Title: Little piece of France in Langkawi
Review: Many of our fellow customers were French - a good sign. The coffee is excellent and the crepes were superb. The service is very en-francais and helpful. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Sherpa721565
Title: Good french crepes
Review: Very nice crêpes! It was like beeing in France so I recommend this place. The place is nice, the prices are reasonable and the service is good, what else...

Author: SuN865
Title: Surprisingly authentic French in Langkawi
Review: We were served by 2 French staff (I believe they are French). The caramel crepe with coconut ice cream taste very good. The shop is very clean including the washroom but please note that you are required to take your shoes off in the restaurant. A hood choice of dessert place after dinner. Show less

Author: Leong MPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great ambience with a remarkable service
Review: It's really a nice place to chill out after a long day out. Not to mention the food is excellent. Cleanliness is also top notch. My family really enjoy it and it's a overall very satisfying experience Show less

Author: AkuOrangBelandaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great crepes and coffee!
Review: If you like crepes - or any sweet desserts - you will love this place. Very friendly couple and attentive. Great crepe! Maybe they could pimp up the place a bit as I found it a bit "empty" ... maybe bit more color.. bean bags or make it bit more lively :-)Show less

Author: ena1510
Title: Very good food and amazing staff
Review: We went there for breakfast after more than 13h of travelling - good choice! The food was delicious and the staff very friendly and gave us some very helpful tips where to go on the Island. But as it's french and thus european, the prices are quite high for Asia. I'd come Back :) Show less

Author: arrontanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crepe selection galore
Review: Great service, and great crepes!There's not much of breakfast options in Cenang, since most starts business late. This lovely little gem is pretty much the only one that operates earliest.First thing you will notice after climbing the stairs is that no footwear allowed, a little quirk but understandable once you see the decor. They kept things authentically French as you can see from their menu, as well as importing their tea (which you can buy in boxes if you love them). All in all great service & value!Show less

Author: ahmed a
Title: best sweets in Langkawi
Review: this place is amazing. they've got awesome crepes and waffles for me is the best in my life . very clean place. amazing service.Show less

Author: _D3198VHHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Breakfast
Review: It was the first place around me which is open on Monday for breakfast at 9:30. I don't have a choice. First rules when you enter: no shoes...?! If people do something like this I'm expecting healthy and organic food but unfortunately not here.No good view- all contraction work is around! I ordered French breakfast. Omelette was ok. Orange Juice is not fresh, has weird taste from the bottle I guess.And Guys, coffee is so bad! You should change a coffee machine!If someone expect something special it's not here - very ordinary! Now I start thinking should I trust TripAdvisor review 100%..?Show less

Author: Qila L
Title: heavenly taste
Review: the cafe was just in front of our hotel above 7 eleven. me and my sister ordered caramel waffle and nutella crepe with banana. the homemade caramel tasted amazing. try it if you come to pantai cenang and you wont regret it.Show less

Author: 24MericanRoadPenang, Malaysia
Title: Thumbs Up!
Review: We had the pompon rouge galette and caramel & fresh mango crepe. Both were delicious. What's even more impressive was the cleanliness of the place, it was immaculate and we felt like having the food in their home. Good food, cozy place, reasonable price and friendly staffs. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Lil_JFHereford, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious!
Review: We stopped here for something different after months travelling. We ordered the crepes, 1 with Nutella and banana, 1 with the homemade salted caramel and banana. We could not fault either of them. Beautifully cooked and well presented. (I can be fussy over how crepes are cooked and these were perfect for me.)And the banana was fresh and tasty, not slimy like you sometimes find in warmer climates. The staff/owners were also very friendly and attentive. Service was quick and with a smile and a brief chat. Plan to visit again before we leave Langkawi.Show less

Author: StineS354Aarhus, Denmark
Title: Best service ever!
Review: We went there for dessert and their pancakes are really good! The owners were amazing. They gave us a map of Langkawi and marked the places they think are a must see. I would definitely recommend the place. The food is good, it is really cozy and the service is top notch. Show less

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Little Cafe owned and operated by A Lovely Couple
Review: Visited this cafe after recommended by my friend. Ordered a crepe (homemade caramel + mango) and a Kusmi Tea. Price was a little bit high but with the crepe was so good that I wish I could order a second one but I was too full that time. Sorry to say but I dunno how to enjoy a cup of Kusmi Tea, wished Badoit was avaiable but sadly no. Will definitely go back to have another crepe or maybe an additional waffle!Show less

Author: denisemY7115BJMy An, Vietnam
Title: Very delicious
Review: Went here for breakfast. Really delicious. Such a cute and well thought out space. Clean, looks new, beautiful aesthetic. The food was delicious. Really appreciated its run by a French couple (???). They obviously take pride and care in what they do and it shows. Go check it out if you're in town! Show less

Author: CaitLou89
Title: Delicious
Review: The crepes were amazing and it is right in the middle of town. This place will settle your sweet cravings

Author: dianedl17
Title: Great crêpes
Review:
The place is very cosy, especially the outside balcony. Very nice owners. 

Good salty crepe! I recommend

Author: Patrick V
Title: Lunch time
Review: Had a very nice lunch on their first storey terras. Very friendly people who gave us a lot of advice on what to do in Langkawi! Start your vacation on Langkawi there! Show less

Author: sandrahR451QR
Title: Delicious crepés and amazing owners
Review: Seriously, this place is a hidden jewel. We are amazed by the people owning it, genuine and extremely nice.Good crepés and thr breakfast toasts were very tasty. We came back 3 times on 3 days. Higly recommend!Show less

Author: Joe N
Title: Place is over rated
Review: The coffee is very bad ordered a cappuccino it was more like a bad latte an the espresso tasted bad too its not even made with beans or a proper coffee machine just a cheap nespresso machine and as for the food it is over priced plus small portions Show less

Author: travelloveXX90
Title: Nice Crêpes, good coffee
Review: Spent an afternoon here with a nice Crêpe and a coffee and it was all very delicious. I wanted iced coffee which they didn't have, so I asked them if they could put ice in the regular coffee. That was fine with them, so I was happy. In general, maybe a bit too expensive though. Show less

Author: 448michelkBrussels, Belgium
Title: Delicious
Review: We had an incredible French style breakfast and the owners gave us also nice tips for activities on the island. To recommend!Show less

Author: Ilia M
Title: Cozy, beautiful, quite place with excellent food.
Review: The food is excellent! You have to try all menu's food. The stuff is friendly and helpful. If you visit Langkawi, this is the right place to go.Show less

Author: pradyumnac2017
Title: Quaint French Cafe @Pantai Cenang
Review: Breizh Up is a quintessential French cafe perched on the first floor of the happening Pantai Cenang, Langkawi, with excellent food, fleeting view of the ocean from the balcony and gracious hosts/owners. We had forgotten our bags after the stumptous waffles and pancakes. The owner chased us to return it! Now thats how you win hearts, three at a time! Show less

Author: melissabrinkct
Title: Nice Cafe
Review: The waffles were not available but we ordered crepes and they were really good! We enjoyed them. The atmosphere was pleasant and the staff were friendly.Show less

Author: hannah_mackayNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxing atmosphere and good food 🇫🇷
Review: If there's one thing I missed in Malaysia it was good bread, and the home made ciabatta sandwiches here are amazing! Crepe was nice too, and the relaxed atmosphere and friendly staff really made it Show less

Author: Hannah SSandakan, Malaysia
Title: Along cenang
Review: We found this cafe by accidentally walking by and the male owner passed our their flyer. Looking at the menu and we decided to give it a try. Quiet environment and their services is good. I think the husband is busy with other guest order, the wife in the kitchen area came out and took our order. Food taste good and we had the special nasi lemak crepe. The only things that it has a lot of mosquitoes, maybe this is unavoidable due to it located next to the sea. Overall we are happy with our dining experience. Show less

Author: Vicknes N
Title: I love' it
Review: Love the cleanliness. Good ambience. Very nice people. (The owner are couples from Paris, France. Living permanently in Langkawi). Ok so here's my comment about the food.I've never tried any french breakfast before. This was my first time. We took the Crepe. I ordered the sugar crepe and my partner took the Crepe on Nutella. Drinks: 1. I took hot chocolate. (80% cocoa) without sugar. You should try it without the sugar! It taste so good! Went well with my crepe.2. French spice tea (Nice aroma. Feels like being in a SPA)Well, it's a worth spending for a good french cuisine in Langkawi for breakfast. (If you plan to try something different for breakfast.)Show less

Author: Sightseer712565
Title: Good french food
Review: Place is quite spacious and clean. We went as a couple and both had different galettes. Serving time is reasonably fast considering the place was full and only 2 of them were working. We both really enjoyed the food. The galettes looked thin but they were filling! A little overpriced though. But we'll definitely come back and try the crepes and waffles next time.Show less

Author: val_rianr2017
Title: French food
Review: Really nice food and good service. If you want to have a good french food in Langkawi that the place to be.

Author: Helene v
Title: France restaurant in Langkawi
Review: If you want something different then go to this place. They have a lot of homemade specialities and the staff is very nice. it is on the first floor so you also have a nice view.

Author: geelongianMelbourne, Australia
Title: Crepes and omelettes
Review: Something a little different in Malaysia but the best crepes and waffles, crepes are in the Brittany style and are delicious. Omelette was delicious and nutritious, delicious. Restaurant was incredibly clean with nice Outlook over the street. Staff, owners I think, we very nice and great to talk to.Show less

Author: Lay Huan T
Title: Nice food and good service
Review: The food are nice especially the tuna bread with olive taste. The dishes taste match perfectly. The atmosphere was nice to relax. Nice place to visit for family and coupleShow less

Author: xxkokoGuangzhou, China
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Went there for breakfast with my wife and friends, My wife was very happy with her feta sandwich, chicken salad was big and tasty. Unfortunately so called English breakfast was very poor, consisted only of omelette no bread or vegetables. Coffee though was delicious!!! Nice atmosphere and friendly owners. My wife would happily come back for some pancakes.Show less

Author: FunkyMarshmallowBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Cold crepes and charged for simple extras like butter and milk
Review: We ordered bread and were charged for the butter, we ordered a cup of tea and they said we would have to pay for milk? Both at crazy prices for what we actually got.We were recommended to crepes by fellow traveller but were disappointed, served luke warmOverly priced, under impressedShow less

Author: liliant
Title: Cest bien
Review:
Yummy crepe! 

Nice and cosy place.

Def. recommended. 

We will be back again. 

Down the street, there is another crepe shop which we also visit from time to time.

Author: 151annao
Title: Perfect place for breakfast and lunch
Review:
Very nice staff, great crepes, sandwiches and tasty caffe.
Fully recommended for people who miss european tastes on Asia 😃

Author: PhilsgonemissingBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Full of hidden extras, beware!!
Review: Came here for crepes with my partner and was really disappointed. The crepes were alright but nothing special but what upset us was everything was a paid for extra. Partner wanted a cup of English tea, but they want to charge you a extra 4 MR for milk!! We had french bread with jam but if you wanted butter it was a extra 1 RM. Sorry but English tea comes with milk and toast comes with butter. They also charge 10% service charge, for bringing out a couple of crepes!! No where else that i ate in Langkawi charged a service charge. Go here if you want but be prepared to pay extra for itShow less

Author: martyna_polskaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good spot for a sweet brekkie
Review: We had crepes with banana, jam and mango accompanied by fresh orange juice and very very good coffee (nespresso) . The staff was nice and in general it was a good brekkie! Show less

Author: Footprints606621
Title: Amazing.
Review: This place had amazing food. The chefs were very friendly. We had a nice chat while we were there. All in all it was a fantastic breakfast experience.Show less

Author: AndrewPhilWoo
Title: Good, not great
Review: Thought it was good, bit pricey for what you get. Had to request water a few times. I think table service would have made the experience better. Also, asked for eggs, thinking that they served omelettes so deviation wouldn't be too much, but the request was declined.APW Show less

Author: GlynnW36
Title: Inconsistent opening time
Review: I had wanted to visit this cafe for all 3 days I was there for breakfast but they were very inconsistent with their opening times and days. It says it opens at 9.30am but on Monday morning, we went there and it was still closed. Walking back from our breakfast around 10+am, then it was opened. Next day on Tuesday, it was not opened at all. There's no notice here and at the cafe that it was closed on Tuesdays. Disappointed, I wanted me some waffles! Perhaps next time.Show less

Author: lalila1234Berlin, Germany
Title: Very tasty and nice location !!
Review: We went there three times for breakfast and it was always delicious and the service was nice.The restaurant seems very clean and it's nice to sit outside on the balcony.Show less

Author: helloohollyPhillip Island, Australia
Title: Pricey but good
Review: Western prices so quite pricey relative to the country, clean and Western style environment. good food, soft fluffy crepes and enjoyable pompon rouge Show less

Author: InashaAleeMale
Title: Delicious food and amazing atmosphere
Review: Cozy little place with different atmosphere compared to the other restaurants. It is quiet and lovely.with delicious food; tried the waffles and breakfast. They were truly amazing.The owners are friendly and warmDefinitely would visit the place again!Show less

Author: gillmarLlandudno, United Kingdom
Title: Great gallettes and crepes
Review: A complete change from the street food....and absolutely delicious. Probably the best gallettes we have tasted worldwide. Spotlessly clean, with exceptionally high standards. First floor dining area with open balcony onto the bustling street. Shame it was our last day. Magnifique...merci beaucoup!Show less

Author: AnnaKfirstOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic place!
Review: The restaurant is upstairs. It's a fantastic French place - worth visiting even if you are on holiday in Malaysia. We had great lunch, the food is delicious. The couple who runs the place is super friendly! They gave us many tips on where to go and places to visit! Show less

Author: andreeadumitru
Title: Awesome food and great service !
Review: We had Pompon Rouge and it was very tasty. The waiter gave us great advice on what to see and where to go. Great!

Author: passielees
Title: Good Service
Review: The waiter and waitress are friendly,  the crepe is nice and love the ambient. Will definitely come back if I come to Langkawi again.

Author: Nick_and_Diane-UK
Title: Great Visit for Great Pancakes and Great Coffee
Review: We had good tasty Americanos with hot milk on the side and delicious French pancakes. Good and friendly service.

Author: Mikekeit1Bangkok, Thailand
Title: The best in town!
Review: We were walking by the ocean road looking for breakfast on a scorching hot day and bumped into a very attractive banner featuring crepes.... full of nice pictures.... didn't hesitate... crêpe s bretonnes.... :) rien de meilleur. Truly delicious and authentic.... the couple who runs the crêperie are so friendly.... very nice people.... will be back. :DShow less

Author: JoyceL711Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Crispy crepe!
Review: Dropped by whilst we were at Pantai Cenang and was well fed by a French couple who were both very friendly! Ordered the tuna, olives and cheese crepe and also the chocolate banana crepe to be shared. I would say that I was satisfied!Show less

Author: sammy321321
Title: Artistic Perfection
Review: Expertly prepared crepes graciously served by a wonderful French couple.  The homemade caramel is exquisite and the coconut ice cream to die for.   Too bad they don't ship to Europe! :D

Author: Kadri Z
Title: Little Paris in Asia
Review: Sunday and crepes, we loved it! Nice and very clean place.Prices are not cheap but you will get good French food! Definitely best coffee in this area! Good wifi too!

Author: beacookie
Title: Great crêpes
Review: Excellent food in a clean and quiet setting, we had to come back to also try the Galette. There are also fresh juices.

Author: siebosCelle, Germany
Title: Expensive breakfast
Review: I was here for breakfast with my family and was surprised by the bad value for money factor. The breakfast itself was delicious but way too less.We ordered an english breakfast that was basically a soft drink (orange juice, not fresh), a double espresso which was really good and an omlette with chicken ham. No toast, no butter, tomatoe, cucumber, ... Just a plain plate with an omlette on it for 20RM.Same for the Morning Breizh breakfast. Crêpe was really good but there was only the Crêpe (and espresso + orange juice). Nothing more.We also ordered two baguettes (Tartine) where you have to choose between four toppings (butter, honey, jam or nutella). You really only get the above-mentioned plate, half of a baguette and the topping. Nothing more. No jam AND butter. Just one pack of jam. No "decoration".Altogether the taste of the food was really ok but the price way to high.Show less

Author: bnnahcy
Title: Lovely place
Review: Came here with my friends. Loved the place. Owned by a French couple, place was very french. The crepes were delicious! And the hot chocolate was superb! Best I've ever tasted. Highly recommended! Show less

Author: haaletajaTartu, Estonia
Title: The best place for breakfast in Patai Cenang
Review: I love this place, had many breakfasts here. I liked the crepes, which are really authentic and tasty. Also the ice tea, and coffee are good (good coffee in Patai Cenang is hard to find). Also the staff is great, always positive and friendly.Show less

Author: ainee_921
Title: Strongly Recommended
Review: Great Place! Friendly People!! Wonderful experience!!! Will revisit when we come to Langkawi again 😉

Author: monituisimmin
Title: Great crepes, nice atmosphere
Review: I took crepes with caramel sauce and it was really good. The atmosphere was nice and the staff very friendly. Thumps up!

Author: _velva_abdulMalaysia
Title: Awsome breakfast
Review: My friend and i not the morning type as normal people. But since shes pregnant, she is craving for something that sometime her husband cant get for her. So this one find thursday night she asked for waffle. At 12 midnight! Waffle??? Then i promised her we gonna look for it first thing in the morning. Lucky i can depends on tripadvisor. I got interested with this breizh up and went there as i promise my pregnant friend. So we went there one fine friday morning. We was greeted lively was seated comfortly ( they have 2 section air-conditioned and fresh air ) with the nice scenery and was served awesome WAFFLE WITH HONEY N VANILLA ICE CREAM as the preggy mom wish, fantastic taste of melesenie gelate ( if im not mistaken) and the chicken wrap. Our latte n capucino also in nice smell and good taste. We even play UNO there because it is a great place to hangout. Keep it up Show less

Author: Pim R
Title: Tasty variety of crepes and nice coffee
Review: Our breakfast included sandwiches, crepes, and coffee. The sandwiches were very nice, with fresh ciabatta bread and properly filled. The crepes were delicious (and creative) but slightly small. Coffee was good. Service was very good, nice and punctual (by the two owners) and the seating was comfortable. It was a little pricey for the two breakfasts.Show less

Author: L250XPmariaeHollviken, Sweden
Title: Amazing crepes
Review: We went to Breizh Up for dessert after reading about it on TripAdvisor. It was not so easy to find the place but we did. You take your shoes of before stepping inside it is a very clean and really nice place. My son ordered crepes and he liked it so much he ordered anotherone. We do recommend this fresh, nice place. The couple who runs the place work hard. Show less

Author: TengKiatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent crepes
Review: Delicious crepes in a comfortable setting. Liked the touch of having customers leave shoes before entering the space at the second floor. Only a group of five customers were there when I went, so it was a pretty chill place to be at. Very friendly couple who run the place. Nice refuge from the Langkawi heat!Show less

Author: maryasyk_13
Title: Great place for breakfast
Review: Very cozy place run by a French couple. The hosts are very friendly and the crepes are delicious! Espresso as well :)

Author: Marconi91
Title: Good quality, need more staff
Review:
The quality of the coffee and food was very good and made with love.
But at the peaktime of the day, they need more staff to handle the restaurant.

Author: danielacris1Norfolk Island, Australia
Title: Delicious brunch
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed our gluten-free buckwheat galettes. Great service and the restaurant is beautiful. Cute modern decor tables set on on a beautiful balcony that oversees the bustling shopping street of Pantai Cenang. Show less

Author: Elina SHelsinki, Finland
Title: Really good!
Review: Lovely place, nice ambiente! Everything we ordered was tasty and good, except little dissapointment was when we ordered freshly squeezed juices (carrot+orange) and they were mixed with water and not 100% juice. Tasty crepes and good dark coffee! Show less

Author: Mca1969
Title: Breakfast spot
Review: Lovely little spotless find on our last morning. Serving delicious breakfast, crepes and juices. Definitely recommend with lovely hosts too.

Author: Linda0807
Title: Great crepes
Review: We had dessert here a couple of times during our stay. Crepes are delicious. Try the ones with homemade caramel butter. Staff are very friendly and place is very clean.

Author: Michelle KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Crepes & Relaxing Hang Out
Review: It is surprisingly difficult to find a dessert place, let alone a good one in the area. We stumbled on Breizh Up. Unfortunately, it isn't the most visible location. But boy, we were glad to come across this place. Excellent crepes and Parisian teas. Clean hang out and great staff.What a great way to end our trip in Langkawi. Thanks Breizh Up!Show less

Author: cheryltehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expanded Menu with still the best crepes on Langkawi
Review: Nice to see that they have expanded their menu since my last visit; with more varieties of breakfast items, sandwiches, salads and pastas in addition to their yummy crepes of course. Would definitely consider the place for breakfast in the future as the croissants are delicious as well.To accompany your crepes, there's also a wider range of Nespresso coffee and Kusmi tea. The place is very clean and it was also a great place to get some work done.Do note that they close between 3pm-730pm daily (break) and that you do have to remove your shoes (which is a wonderful way to keep the floors clean)Had a great experience as always.Show less

Author: asyeh s
Title: Spotlessly Clean. Great Staff
Review: You can tell the owners really love what they do. The place was immaculately clean unlike most of the establishments on the cenang strip. So clean in fact we had no reservations letting our little one crawl around on the floor. (You have to take your shoes off at the entrance). We had the Tuna sandwich and the Nutella crepe. As well as the ginger tea, a vanilla cappuccino and carrot juice. Portions sizes were more on the European side than North American but food was very well prepared and tasted great. Show less

Author: SamsonLiew
Title: Nice food
Review:
很棒👍🏻第一次尝试法国人做的法国餐。室内没有华丽的装修，但是食物味道很好，老板也很友善亲切。
这间Coffee Shop 值得一试😋位置位于在一家便利商店7-eleven楼上。
Thank you for you to make delicious food🙏🏻
Next time will come again.

Author: Capricornkeong
Title: Wonderful tea and good food
Review: We visited breizh up after chancing upon it on TripAdvisor. The place is located on the second storey right above one of the rare few 7/11 I can spot in cenang area. The ambience is really good and you have the option of dining indoors or outdoors. As we were all sweaty from our morning skytrex adventure, my partner and I opted for the outdoor seating. The area itself is very clean, we ordered a sugar crepe, creamy chicken spaghetti and had their freshly pressed fruit juice. It was excellent, I enjoyed the kusmi tea very much as well! Food pricing is decent and it will be a popular hangout for beach goers in the vicinity!Show less

Author: pianocelloShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Very friendly staff
Review: The owners are friendly and helpful and the restaurant provides fast wifi. This place is located in a busy part of Pantai Cenang so parking can be a problem at peak hours. I do think that even though the food was okay, the portions could be much bigger and the price could be less considering that there are many cheaper options around. Show less

Author: Katja W
Title: Delicious
Review: Fresh and delicious. Authentic frensh restaurant wth not only sweet crepes. Great sandwiches and also breakfast. Becaue its located in 2nd floor it is a kind of insider tip for Cenang, Langkawi.Show less

Author: JKTravelKParis, France
Title: Great quality and original food in Langkawi
Review: Friendly and neat place, with great salty and sweet crepes (made with imported ingredients from France; on the menu you will find and original crepe recipe with malaysian food); the juices are made with freshly squeezed fruits, there's a large selection of tea, and is one of the few places with actual coffee Show less

Author: MuhammadAdzlanI
Title: Great taste
Review: Went to Breizh Up for dessert almost every night for the past few weeks. Great place with excellent food. Friendly environment and clean. Will keep going for the dessert.

Author: carmen_kaiwen
Title: Nice food nice vibes
Review: Nice and friendly couple who serve nice crepes 💞💞definitely would visit back there next time when I come to langkawi 😊

Author: Patrick G
Title: Great crêpes !!!
Review: Great and authentic French crepes !My friend and i are both French and wanted a break from local food. The crepes (savoury and sweet) were very good and cheap. Staff is very friendly too. Highly recommend it.Show less

Author: _C8063DB
Title: Great authentic crepes in the middle of Langkawi
Review: We saw this place while hunting for lunch at Pantai Cenang and decided to give it a try. Savoury galettes were really tasty and full of flavour while a sweet Salidou crepe was simply delicious and a very fine ending to our meal. Will recommend it to everyone in the area. Show less

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Creperie in Langkawi!
Review: Friends have recommended we try this creperie, and we are happy this was our first stop from the airport! We ordered the breakfast crepe, chocolate banana crepe and waffle with icing sugar and ice cream - and we enjoyed each and every one. The restaurant set-up is clean, simple and homely with an al-fresco area for people-watching from a floor above.Wished we had our crepe fix before heading home, as there is nothing like it in KL!Show less

Author: jojoleen1983
Review: we went today at 9.30 am and it was closed but they wrote it is opened from 9 am . i am very disapointed cause i wanted to give it a tryShow less

Author: Kellyk82
Title: Fantastic Crepes and Waffles
Review: Nearly missed out on it as the shop was situated on the second store. We had the Caramel with Banana Crepe and Icing waffle with a scoop of ice cream. The ingredients used were fresh and was prepared from the heart. Flavor and texture were spot on. Couldn't remember a time when we had a better tasting Crepe/Waffle!Show less

Author: frorqf13
Title: Best french crepes never eat before even in France
Review: Do not be first surprised by naked table...menu set quality with so nice brittany crepes will give you the best pleasure for your taste buds.

Author: kzamhari
Title: Awesome food & great ambience
Review: Authentic crepes both savoury and sweet. Great place for breakfast and/or lunch with attentive and personalised service. Looking forward to trying out the items on the menu! Will be back soon.

Author: FellowTraveler676561
Title: Just amazing !
Review:
We found a very good address for french crepes, spaghettis and more.

Not expensive for the quality.

The restaurant is so clean. Owners are nice.

I wish all the best

Author: DoctorVra4
Title: Little peace of France in Asia
Review: Super cozy place with wide choice of meals, especially good for breakfast and lunch. Waffles were amazing. And of course have a little nice conversation with friendly owners.

Author: LE MEUR D
Title: A good French taste in Asia
Review: The young owners have a liking for the food they serve in their peaceful restaurant.No too much dishes to choose but all are perfects.A quiet atmosphere, an interior decoration and a very good music.So, have a seat and enjoy !Show less

Author: AmeliaWanYMLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Tasty sweet treat
Review: Everything looked so good on the menu we wanted to try it all! Had pancakes, salted caramel salido amd nutella waffle - all were delicious and freshly made. Comfortable and quiet environment for a nice tea break. Will definitely visit again.Show less

Author: Gayathiri K
Title: A pleasant place to chill
Review: Came here to have a crepe but ended up ordering pancakes, waffles and homemade caramel crepes. It was raining heavily so The got latte and homemade hot chocolate also was just nice. If you are here with your friends to chill this is a perfect place and the staffs are very friendly. Would love to come back here Show less

Author: 516sabrinee
Title: Lovely crepes!
Review: I just had a lovely nutella-banana crepe and a latte with a very nice view. Also, the owners are super friendly!! We will definitely come back here :)

Author: RN316
Title: Lovely casual dinner
Review: Super clean place and delicious crepes. We had a variety of savoury and sweet and ordered seconds! Good price and service

Author: Ah Z
Title: Tasty breakfast
Review: Tasty breakfast nice attitude and friendly, come here and have a nice breakfast/lunch.cheap and reasonable

Author: François A
Title: Salted caramel crêpe ❤️ — salidou
Review:
Breizh Up cook the best handmade crêpes, galettes amd waffles in Langkawi. The Salidou was super yummy! They have a nice location and the service is flawless! 
I really recommend this place, 100% breton!

Author: Hussain A
Title: Best in Langkawi
Review: Just visited here with my friends, has to be the best place we've been to in Langkawi by far. The interior is extremely clean, contemporary and inviting, the menu is easy to navigate and choose from with various options and the food is fresh and tastes fantastic. The owners Krimau and Vanessa are probably the most friendly and hospitable people we've come across on our travels through southeast Asia. Strongly recommend a visit here if in the area!Show less

Author: FellowTraveler439149
Title: Friendly service
Review: Crepes were a delight and we were spoilt by such friendly service. Glad we decided to give it a try.

Author: Sarah D
Title: Lovely!
Review:
Lovely place for breakfast and good coffee in a clean, modern setting. Great customer service! 
We enjoyed sitting on the balcony!

Author: Vincentosl
Title: Great food! Awesome service
Review: Hearty homemade food with great environment! Worth the price! Service is perfect and make you feel like you are home. Keep it up!

Author: migratoryleyKathmandu, Nepal
Title: Really good
Review: Like : French good. The Salidou (salted butter caramel) is home made and a pure treasure. The crepes are good, the juices fresh and delicious, and the coffee is strong. The terrace is very nice, on the first floor of the building right on top of the 7/11, meaning you can spend time reading your book without being annoyed by the streets trafic.Nice and fast service.A bit expensive for Malaysia, that would be our only down point. A crepe, not such a big one really, and rather thin one instead, is around 20 RM in a country where at every corner there are awesome big rotis with Nutella for 5RM.At least for that price the crepes should be bigger !But it's delicious anyway... Bravo!Show less

Author: wah2002
Title: Tasty and good service
Review: Went in twice for breakfast and had galettes which were very nice, coffee was good and service was friendly :) will come again if we're back in Langkawi.

Author: Claire C
Title: Tasty French breakfast
Review: Directly across from our hotel, friendly staff/owners. French inspired food. We had crepes one day and waffles the next, both delicious! Very good prices. Recommended.

Author: Inspire318319
Title: Dessert
Review: Nice environment with fresh crepe . Owner is friendly and helpful. Nice place chill out with couple or friend . Highly recommended .

Author: Ivan Ng S
Title: Dinner and dessert
Review: The crepe is nice and worth to eat here...the service was very good and you will come again for sure...price is reasonable and Must try!

Author: boudlr
Title: Real excellent French crêpes!
Review: If you wanna test a crêpes restaurant, try the simple "beurre-sucre" (butter and sugar). In this restaurant, the "beurre-sucre" is simply delicious, just the way it should be. Don't hesitate, go for it, again and again.

Author: TheMohicanFamily
Title: Good ambience, Great french authentic food..
Review: This was our first time & surely won't be the last time. Really like the place,.. clean, cozy, chill & can see clear blue sky. Traditional french crepes was good too. Strongly recommend this place to others.

Author: wayfarer21
Title: French crepes in langkawi!
Review: We stumbled upon this bright cheery cafe run by a french couple while buying water at 7-Eleven. It is right above the convenience store and serves great savoury and dessert crepes.

Author: Verrina S
Title: Great place for Great moment !
Review:
Best french crêpe of langkawi !!
Very good réception  
Very friendy staff
Nice place with a beautiful view
An address not to be missed

Author: LisAmp2015
Title: Good French crepes and very nice staff
Review:
Traditional crepes from Brittany were delicious. The restaurant owners are very nice.
Strongly recommend this place

Author: cheryltehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best crepes in Langkawi .. and beyond!
Review: Absolutely love the crepes here - perfect texture and balance of thickness / chewiness / sweetness. A cool respite in hot and humid Langkawi - premises is very clean and perfect for a place to start the day with a yummy breakfast or after dinner dessert. Lots of seats to wind down and chat. They also serve imported tea and coffee from France. Friendly owner and VERY CLEAN toilets!! Definitely the must-go place in Langkawi.Show less

Author: John A
Title: Look Up for French food
Review: A great place to eat.  Food is very nice and the crepes also great. The price of food here is a little more than other fare you can get in the local area.

Author: Pottsy4
Title: Authentic arabic food
Review: Went twice,friendly staff.had arabic starters with freshly made bread & the chicken shawarma platter washed down with lemon & mint juice.Authentic arabic food.They also use contactless payment as well as cash.

Author: AmirSawas
Title: The best Restaurant in Langkawi
Review:
Every thing was really perfect, the food and meals were super delicious and the Team was kind.

I eated three times there with my Wife and I hope I can visit this Restaurant again in the Future.

Author: Passion4Foo
Title: Gathering
Review: Cozy environment, clean and nice place to chill with friends, the foods are tasty. I like hummus so much and it’s served with the bread that really soft. Highly recommended

Author: Yen_Kwan
Title: Good experience!
Review:
Food was nice! Staff was friendly 
Price reasonable 
Great environment for gathering chit chat
Is a best place to recommend

Author: wan_wmwa
Title: Syrian food in Langkawi
Review: I am very happy with the food here. Theres so many to choose. Place is comfortable and easy to park. Definitely will come again.

Author: W6135UKjanes
Title: Delicious food
Review: Cenang beach area restaurant, close to The Pelangi and Casa Del Mar. Good, clean, reasonably priced Middle Eastern food. Hummus and flat breads are delicious. Service is quick, food is fresh.

Author: julie d
Title: Traditional and deliciously made Syrian food
Review: Deliciously traditional Syrian food made with fresh eggplant, yogurt and fantastic meat. The highlight is the home made bread!

Author: Trangdoan1302
Title: Good place of pizza need to come 😍😍😍
Review: I was so express with the service n the owner was very friendly. He welcome us by upsize the pizza from M to L for free., love it…❤️❤️❤️

Author: Skeets2014Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Best Arabic Ever!
Review: Yasmin’s is the best Arabic food I’ve had outside of the Middle East! I used to live in Jordan and ate a lot of Arabic food in the region. We went there shortly after Langkawi reopened to domestic tourists, and they were so accommodating for our large group of 7. Their hummus was so good, the shawarma plate to die for, and it was the best falafel I’ve ever had. If you like Arabic food, please try Yasmin!Show less

Author: 740wqHuntsville, Alabama
Title: Good food and great service for a relaxed and casual dinner
Review: Good ambience, good food and great service. The staff was very accommodating with customizing some dishes based on our taste. We had Halabi Lamb Kabab, Lamb Maklouba, Chicken Mandy with Mushroom Soup. We topped these up with mint tea and Sheesha. The lamb was succulent and the Halabi Kabab came with a delicious tomato based gravy. Good for a casual visit with friends and family. The place is also kid friendly.Show less

Author: Pokegoal54
Title: Amazing 🤩 unexpected restaurant !!
Review: Quality and fresh daily bread is making a huge different ! Cheap and good   😊 what else ! And Farid is so nice 😊

Author: pushpalp
Title: Good food
Review: Good food at pantai cenang beach. Staff was cordial and helped us with the selection and our needs. A plesant place for lunch and dinner

Author: MrsHelenJones
Title: Fabulous
Review: Delicious, fresh and healthy food. Would highly recommend. The staff were also super friendly and helpful. Great for the children and vegetarians with us. Loved the falafels, hummous, Greek salad and…well everything really!

Author: SamE-00900
Title: The Best!!
Review: Never miss this place when visiting Langkawi.The food was fantastic and the restaurant is clean.Must try their mix BBQ, Lamb ,Falafel and their mix epetizer .

Author: Caseystravelin
Title: Great Arabic Restaurant
Review: Was in Langkawi for 5 days and ate at Yasmin’s 3 times, and several times before on other visits. The food is authentic, fresh and flavorful. The service is truly fantastic as well. Love this place!

Author: Jaymin B
Title: Great to eat in or take away
Review: The tabbouleh, chicken shawarma, and rocca salad were all great. We did take away  twice and ate the food on the beach. It is much better fresh, but holds up for a beach eats as well.

Author: garethgorst
Title: Yasmin restaurant cool
Review: All the classic dishes of Eastern Mediterranean cuisine, with friendly service that makes you feel at home. The food tastes as good as it looks and the ambience outside is our favourite in Langkawi

Author: Clarelouise88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Arabic food in MALAYSIA!!
Review: Absolutely LOVE this restaurant! Amazing tasty food at a great price. One of the owners- Alaa, always looks after us, helps us with takeaways etc. have been known to eat here every day when I visit langkawi. Recommend the falafel wraps, hummous, fresh bread, chicken, vine leaves. Basically eberythjng I’ve tried has been amazing! Thank you Show less

Author: rizvi_20
Title: Pocket Friendly
Review: visited this place two times, last night we went almost around the closing time but they facilitated us. Ordered spicy chicken shwarmas and fresh juices. Nice ambience with cultural displays. Good taste with pocket-friendly prices. Keep it up!!

Author: vanessadsouza1London, United Kingdom
Title: Great find! Great price! Great food
Review: Visited here as I was fed up of my fancy hotel food and needed a change. I was not disappointed at all! The bread made fresh is to die for! I could eat that all day with hummus! The bill for ordering a few dishes despite being on my own was so reasonableI'd definitely visit againShow less

Author: artzmazter
Title: Ordered hummus meat. The portion
Review: Ordered hummus meat. The portion is good, suits the price. Got 2 bread, hummus & the meat was minced (bummer for me). But the hummus taste, not so delicious for my taste.

Author: Josephwong74
Title: Delicious Lamb Mandy Rice
Review: We took the promo package for 2 pax for RM60.50 including tax. Food is delicious. Since it's a Syrian restaurant, they should play Syrian or Arab songs instead of latest english songs. Anyway, this restaurant is recommended for it's food taste.

Author: ekta p
Title: Hummus!!
Review: Just went there by chance and enjoyed the dinner. Great hummus! Lentil soup was just amazing! Good staff

Author: Zzzz3456
Title: Delicious!
Review:
Lovely food and location is perfect for lunch.
Kiwi juice was delicious and worth a try. Would defo go back

Author: Ирина МPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Had a lovely dinner at Yasmin.
Review: Had a lovely dinner at Yasmin. Staff is very welcoming and accommodating. Freshly baked bread is amazing! We had some starters and mixed grill - I loved my lamb kebab and my son preferred his chicken shish tawook. We had a tiny issue with our tabouleh which has a bit too much lemon, but we were so pleased with the rest that weren’t even upset. However our waiter insisted the kitchen prepared a new serving for us from scratch. We were so full, had to take it to go.Overall, great food, lovely experience - happy to recommend the place. Show less

Author: HussamSaeidMalaysia
Title: Fresh, authentic, and delicious food
Review: I dined in the Yasmin Restaurant several times and I liked the food and service very much. I also tried their delivery which was on time and free of charge. The only comment I have is that the prices are a little bit high compared to other restaurants in the same area, especially with the discount offers everywhere; however, the quality of the food is really good and worth a try.Show less

Author: Raed A
Title: Best lamb mandi I’ve ate in malaysia
Review: If you’re visiting langkawi and want to eat till you’re stuffed definitely visit it. Nothing on the menu disappoints

Author: 760usmanm
Title: Yasin
Review:
If you are looking for the best Arab food in Langkawi, this is the place. The food is great, the ambiance is amazing and the staff is incredible.

High recommended

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Middle Eastern food
Review: My wife and I remember eating at Yaskin 3 years ago and loved the food. We were not disappointed on our return.Admittedly it was quiet so didn't have an atmosphere. We ate earlier due to the ages of our kids.Menu is reduced at the moment. Probably due to covid/low season.However, food is amazing!They do a fantastic shawarma and shish kebab. We had salad, bread and hummus.Bread was so fresh. Lovely meal.Service was quick and easy going.Great to see Yasmin are still providing the same quality of food and service 3 years later! Thank you. Show less

Author: asiaoncceayear
Title: great shawarmas
Review: Went to their main restaurant and also the smaller express outlet.both were very clean and provided good service,tasty food and good service.both restaurants on the main strip in Langkawi

Author: pvanmerchLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Inconsistent: Can be amazing and dissapointing.
Review: I use to dine or get take out at Yasmine once a week. Normally get a spread of greens and Lamb Chops for mains.The food is generally great, but after the 3rd occasion of delivering poor quality lamb chops I'm going to have a break to build up my tolerance again. Show less

Author: DebbieGibbo1Great Yarmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous Find
Review: We arrived at Langkawi on Tuesday 17th March 2020....the day before the unfortunate lockdown and in the evening found this restaurant for our 1st meal. The food is absolutely fabulous, tasty, good size portions and value for money. We ate in the restaurant that night but from the next day Wednesday 18th all the restaurants were unable to offer sit down service......only takeaway.We returned to the Yasmin for the remainder of our 8 night stay as the staff were so polite and friendly and always gave great service.During our stay we tried the Arabic salad, half BBQ chicken, BBQ fish, lamb chunks, mixed kebab, spaghetti Bolognese, chicken mandi, and the best lamb moussaka we have ever tasted. The food was cooked while we waited and was very hot, very tasty and cooked to perfection. I would strongly recommend you eat at this Arabic/Syrian restaurant as all the guys were so friendly and happy to see us every night (including chef) and every dish we ordered was delicious.Thank you Yasmin for your fantastic hospitality and ensuring we were well fed throughout our 9 day vacation. Hopefully we will return next year when circumstances will be different to visit other areas of the island that we were unable to do and we will most definitely return to Yasmin.You all take care and stay safe.Debbie and Paul xxShow less

Author: DebraJOCLeamington Spa, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, great people. Don’t miss this 😊
Review: We ate here on our last couple of nights (here for 6) and it was by far the best food we have eaten here in the evening. Also the mango juice was superb (great taste, quality and no ice). Ahmed and his team looked after us really well. The food was melt in the mouth good and so fresh. It came out reasonably quickly too but they gave you time to enjoy your starters and breads so it wasn’t too rushed. We had the same both nights (not something we normally do), but had enjoyed it all so much the night before! Would highly recommend the hummus with meat, taboulleh (they give you lovely fresh flatbreads with them) and the shish kebab/chicken taut(kebab) which comes with chips, side salad, mini topped bread etc and you can ask for rice instead etc. Big portions, delicious. Thanks all and very best wishes to you Show less

Author: Maria V
Title: Great falafel and hummus!
Review: We were at the restaurant with 10 people group. Great falafel and hummus!!Tabbouleh was good but I recommed to share it because it so big. BBQ skewers were okay. Good price quality ratio.

Author: Gill J
Title: Great food
Review:
Small restaurant serving  great food, good value and friendly staff.
Very clean and food freshly cooked

Author: Dionysus38Irvine, California
Title: Superb slice of Syria
Review: After finding out that there is a direct flight from Qatar, our expectation for Yasmin was high. It did not disappoint. The kebobs were bbq'ed to perfection, and so juicy. Baba ganoush was refreshing. And the freshly made bread was a fan favorite among my kids. Show less

Author: DesPUSBHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty Food
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for 10 days and went to eat their 3 times we liked it so much.The food is fresh and although the surroundings are not particularly elegant the food truly makes up for it.You can eat like a king ,have what you don't eat wrapped up to takeaway and it won't cost you a fortune Happy Days :)Show less

Author: aarya569Mumbai, India
Title: Very good Middle Eastern Food
Review: Had the Lamb Kebab and Lemon Mint juice..both items were very nice. Portion size is also good and they give some fries with the kebabThey also have very good hummus and falafelResteraunt is at prime end of Cenang Beach..always a bit crowded but you do get a seatWould strongly recommend if you are looking for middle Eastern food..Show less

Author: eugenrusu

Review: The best food in Langkawi! Very friendly staff and service! Very good prices. I strongly recommend this place if you wanna have the best experience. Ahmed is the best!

Author: fhd_30

Review: One of the best Arabic restaurant in Langkawi. The food is fresh and delicious. The service was great by the cashier & waiter Mr. Ahmed. Wish you guys all the best!

Author: Jean1571991

Review: Popped in because of the good reviews, and was not disappointed! Lamb kebab and hummus were really nice, price is fair too! Will definitely recommend and go back again myself!

Author: WusserladDerby, United Kingdom

Author: 679maxh
Title: Incredible syrian food

Author: Kiff1974

Author: dennisqh

Author: 6811goefisVienna, Austria
Title: Awsome falafel wrap!
Review: Crazy falafel!!!!!!They make really good falafel wraps for 10RM. Fresh homemade falafel and fresh bread. I ate many falafel in my life and here its definetly one of the best i had! Came here every night with my girlfriend but we just ate falafelwrap all the time so i cant really give any opinion about the other stuff they sell!But go there and try the falafel Sandwich ;)Show less

Author: ScottM454Glasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Simply YASMIN Greatness.....
Review: First time in Langkawi and this was our first meal and we were not disappointed at all..location in a pretty busy bit so it was buzzy..Food was so tasty and fresh, portions are generous service was really fantastic nothing was too much trouble.Casual dining, we loved it only issue was we only went once during our stay(sad face…)We will return!!!!Show less

Author: boxy64
Title: Falafel for Heaven
Review: The BEST falafel we have ever. Didn’t realise a falafel could rise to the level of haut cuisine - but here we are. hummus amazing, tandor bread incredible, mixed entree is great, chicken shawarma noteworthy. Highly recommended for a great lunch.

Author: grisa300
Title: The best hummus ever!!
Review: we did eat here twice on our holiday lunch. really good service and ecxellent hummus!! also chicken kebab was delicious. staff were really friendly and was all the time checking that eveyrhing was okey. Highly recommend!

Author: 768maddieb
Title: Fabulous
Review:
We ate here for three nights in a row and loved every bite. Couldn't find one fault in the service or food if we tried. 
Quality of ingredients is way above other restaurants in the area.

Author: CGJJ726San Francisco, California

Author: emmarX7309WQ

Review:

Title: Ahmed was super just like
Review: Ahmed was super just like the wonderfull food, our lady night in langkawi ehi che was the best! Keep on going like this, Great job and by the was best humus ever

Author: tommasoo544Pattaya, Thailand
Title: Super!!!
Review: This restaurant is realle super , we spend 5 days in Langkawi and we come back two times. We tried almost all the dishes, the staff is super kind and follow carefully the customers. My favourite dish have been masala with lumb, but I repeat everything is super tasty. You must trie!!!Show less

Author: 464lenak
Title: One of a kind!
Review: We keep coming here second year in a row and it’s becoming just better and better. Highly recommend the squids on grill while my boys are obsessed with the grill meat here. So cool to be back! Thank u, guys! Ps. L

Author: mAsim123
Title: Amazing food authentic Syrian/
Review: Amazing food authentic Syrian/ Arabic food. The food is amazing and the staff are brilliant cater to your needs. We have been to the restaurant 5 times in 6 days.

Author: NikitaD394
Title: Amazing!!!! I grew up in the
Review: Amazing!!!! I grew up in the Middle East, and currently live in London where the food scene is equally amazing and this restaurant was as good, if not better than London restaurants! Can’t recommend it enough. Great service, well priced, DELICIOUS food :)

Author: binaq2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: My son and I had dinner there
Review: My son and I had dinner there after reading all the great reviews and this place really was the best so far we had in Langkawi. I ordered shish tauk and my son had chicken shawarma plus we ordered humus and Lamb kebob. Everything was so yummy !! Will definitely recommend to anyone coming to Langkawi to try Atleast one meal here. Show less

Author: sasmust
Title: Fantastic Syrian Food in Langkawi
Review: The falafel was excellent (quite extraordinary i must say). The other items we ordered were also very fresh and tasty - mushroom soup was delightful, chicken kebab yummy, fried prawn very crunchy. They make the bread fresh and soft. Hummus was delightful, so was the Turkish coffee. Very friendly staff and quick service. Ambience is cosy and the restaurant is moderatly spacious. Excellent overall. Show less

Author: demahomdiaz
Title: Tasty food, great place to dine
Review: We had a wonderful time in yasmin restaurant. The food was fantastic. Staff were friendly and very helpful. Reasonable prices and the restaurant location is also very good.

Author: louaym308
Title: Tasty food and friendly staff
Review: Very nice place to visit and have tasty syrian food. Friendly staff and good service. Everything was delicious and the coffee also was great.

Author: AimanSalah
Title: My food at yasmin restaurant
Review:
Very nice food , the price is reasonable, I recommend it as one of the best Arabic restaurants in Langkawi.

Aiman Salah

Author: 668ren_ev
Title: Loved the falafel and hummus
Review: We went here for lunch and ordered falafel and Hummus. The service is very friendly and the food is tasty. The prices are good! It is a nice place to have lunch.

Author: epalash
Title: Excellent!
Review: This Syrian restaurant is excellent.  All the dishes are made in house including the pita which you do not see very often.  Would eat here on a regular basis.

Author: 89farhan
Title: Good Food, Good Service.
Review: Good Food ! Good Service !. We went there twice during our stay. Must have when you are in Langkawi.

Author: kristiinal2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very tasty Syrian food
Review: Easy to find in a touristy area, cozy and clean restaurant. Family friendly, high-chairs available. Food was excellent and very generous portions. We ordered a variety of dishes for 6 pax and everything was delicious. Special thanks for authentic and very delicious made on the spot flat bread! Service was quick and staff was very friendly. Best of all, they deliver! Show less

Author: alexandrakategarlandLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food including vegetarian
Review: The food here was really lovely. I’m vegetarian so I opted for the mixed mezze appetiser and a plate of falafel. All the food was super yummy and my meat eater husband even stole quite a bit of it because it was so good! (Note that he also loved his plate of grilled meat too!) It was plenty so they even gave me a box to take my leftover falafel home with me. Very happy. Show less

Author: thefitmum_mumSingapore, Singapore
Title: Neat & Friendly
Review: Good food, delicious cocktails. Everything is freshly made to order. Friendly, attentive and courteous staff and owner/ manager. Food - complementary fresh baked piping hot pita and Arabic tea after meal.I ordered lentil soup ( hearty and comfort food- just the kinds you want end of tiring day) and falafel again very fresh n piping hot with delicious mild tahini.Husband ordered the chicken kebab - big portion came with a salad , fries and a garlic curd dip ( finger licking good dip).I had 2 fruit cocktail because I loved it so much - combination of apple , carrot, orange mango I skipped the banana. Not a 10 page long menu with too many things but just right I would say.Would highly recommend in langkawi !! Sorry for the picture taken too late. Show less

Author: viveks530Mumbai, India
Title: Good Food Good Service
Review: Best vegetarian friendly mediterranian restaurant on Pantai Cenang . Ordered Hummus with Pita bread and Falafel . Both tasted very good and fresh . Quantity was sufficient for me and my wife . They also gave us complimentary peppermint tea which was very refreshing . Quality of the food was top notch and service also .Food is reasonably priced . Will visit again .Show less

Author: 638h_l_nec
Title: Delicious
Review:
Very good service, fast and with nice people, very tasty Arabic Syrian food !
It is a quality restaurant

Author: Littleprettyangel
Title: DELICIOUS
Review: The pizza is very good is better then all the pizza I have tasted .So I recommended all of you to try this restaurant at Langkawi express 🥰👍🏻👍🏻

Author: Travissue
Title: Fall in love with the food
Review:
Food very nice
Service very good
Definitely will go back again 
Highly recommended for those who visit langkawi .

Author: veekaybe
Title: Very good - friendly - not cheap !
Review:
Enjoyed my food very much today. 
Big portions - almost too much for me. 
Taste, preparation, service very good. 
Going to be back !

Author: Madison L
Title: Great value
Review: Nice restaurant, very big portions, lots of flavour. Staff friendly and welcoming. Good prices. Enjoyable meal here.

Author: kareem_ss
Title: Excellent!
Review:
This is an excellent choice for Arabic food. The kebab and shawarma are amazing and the service was extremely professional and friendly especially Abdullah.

They also have delivery for nearby hotels.

Author: tamaraak
Title: Amazing
Review: Food and service here was amazing!! We had to come back a second time before we left Langkawi! Definitely going to miss the tabbouleh

Author: gwennot2019
Title: Great food and great service
Review: Delicious food and really nice staff!!! The wraps are very nice. If you come to langkawi you should come here :)

Author: emilyjA5366DT
Title: Great service, delicious food,
Review:
Great service, delicious food, fun atmosphere

Helpful and communicative staff who are very friendly and kind

Author: Ztayob
Title: Good food
Review:
The service was really good. Restaurant was clean and presentable.
We ordered the lamb chops and lamb kebab. Really tasty and enjoyable. Portions were good and price was reasonable.

Author: Robynxx9
Title: Tasty!
Review: Lovely place! Great food would definitely recommend the hummus and bread is a must! Also the chicken kebab was very juicy would return for more. Thank you!

Author: Marysebali
Title: Absolutely fantastic Middle Eastern food in Langkawi
Review: I had a great meal delivered to my hotel. Seriously great food, not to be missed. This may very well be the best restaurant on the island, with their freshly made warm pita, delicate hummus, and a lamb eggplant stew to write home about.

Author: NopainNogain88
Title: delicious middle eastern fare
Review: delicious arabic food, from the places tried between Cenang and Tengah probably the best one. The lamb shank was really tasty, so the hummus and the beef kebab. I suggest.

Author: AzriHussain
Title: Great food!
Review:
Great syrian restaurant!
Food is good
Hummus with their freshly made bread is a must!
Nice ambience and friendly workers.

Author: khanrezwan2016
Title: Nice middle eastern food
Review: The shwarma (wrap) and ceaser salad were awesome, the service was good and the behavior was really good. Worth trying.

Author: SteveLSW
Title: Good but not great
Review: We had lamb kabsah/chicken kabsah. Portion is great but I’ve tried these dishes before and I know it’s not that great. Prices are mid-high range for locals. It’s not super ex, but hey it’s Cenang.

Author: Yamin p
Title: Excellent service and the food
Review: Excellent service and the food- service was econd to none and the food was of very good quality. Really enjoyed it, we had the kebabs and the shawarma and they were done to perfection, would definitely recommend. Also you must try the lemon juice with mint and have some mint tea at the end. Very enjoyable evening. Show less

Author: Sophiemacklan
Title: Miss
Review: Went there twice in 2 days and it was beautiful food every time I had vine leaves both times and I recommend it

Author: PengFeiL30
Title: Expansive and normal
Review: Not worthy to try, its hot and the food is just Soso. We got 2 adults and 2 children spent around 170rm.

Author: goodgoodfood2017
Title: Quality middle eastern food
Review:
Good quality food on the main strip. Clean and inviting.

Ordered a chicken kebab and lamb kabsa with two drinks.

Reasonably priced as well.

Author: Neale1810Kingston-upon-Hull, United Kingdom
Title: Great Syrian food
Review: A Syrian restaurant in Langkawi was a bit of a surprise - but so pleased we decided to give it a try. It’s an indoor restaurant with AC and ceiling fans so pleasant environment to eat. Menu is not long but with photos of the dishes it’s easy to make choices. They don’t serve alcohol so just had soft drinks.Staff all very attentive and friendly.I ordered the mixed starter and my wife a salad to begin with. Both were excellent - really tasty and large helping. We both chose the mixed BBQ for our main course which was very filling and beautifully cooked - kebabs of chicken, lamb, lamb mince and chicken mince with a side salad.
