Cost approx £35 for the 2 of us which we thought was good value.Show less

Author: joby69Cirencester, United Kingdom
Title: Superb!
Review: Excellent food - home made and great quality. Big portion sizes too. The houmous was so tasty and the mousakka was huge and gorgeous. My husband has lamb kebab and chips which he said was equally as nice. Just to note, they do not serve alcohol only soft drinks. We would definitely go back and recommend to anyone.Show less

Author: 252nadiadGroningen, The Netherlands
Title: Highly reccomanded! :-)
Review: This food is great! Try as much as possible that is on the menu. I loved te lamb kebab, the humus, the best and fresh garlic sauce. The fresh juices are also worthly of trying them all! My personal favorite is the fresh apple juice. The staff is very friendly and the place is clean. I loved it enough to skip Malay dinner twice. Show less

Author: swanstonanthonyPhuket, Thailand
Title: good food, good service, no atmosphere
Review: We went for lunch and the service was excellent with polite attentive staff who spoke good English. Please remember that this is a Syrian restaurant and so does not serve alcohol. My fresh orange juice and my friend's Turkish coffee were both excellent. The main courses arrived promptly and the meat in each was superb although my French fries served with the lamb cubes were soggy - either cooked at too low a temperature or hot-plated for too long. Interestingly there are no deserts on the menu.All in all good food at a reasonable price given the location. But the place just has no atmosphere.Show less

Author: SimiPanaechSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good meat, great starters
Review: This was our favourite meal. All the food we had from local to the hotel's was very mediocre, this was our best meal. We ordered the mixed appetizers and the mixed grill. Superb tasting, freshly made, hot bread, everything was great. Shisha after with complimentary mint tea (although very strong tea and lesser mint taste) was a great end to it all. Staff are friendly too. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Aleina TAndalsnes, Norway
Title: Best chicken
Review: Doesn't look fab to be honest. But these ppl know how to cook!! Hubby and I tried food we never tried before and got good help in what to go for. I har something with chicken and it was seriously perfectly prepared. Both dishes were so good, and price also. We will reccomend this place Show less

Author: EugeneYap
Title: Food Trail
Review: We decided to go on a Food Trail, trying out food from different countries. The sharwarma is absolutely tasty!

Author: Zi_London
Title: Best restaurant in the area
Review:
Ate here, for two. has the Mixed BBQ grill.

Meat was juicy and flavourful. Cooked to perfection. Had too order more food, was tooo nice :)

Staff very friendly. Must go place!!!!

Author: andy nKuching, Malaysia
Title: A regular stop
Review: We come to Langkawi 3 or 4 times a year. We always have 1 or 2 dinners here each trip. Love the place! Food is amazing & reasonably priced. Staff are friendly & they have a quiet BYO policy as they don't serve alcohol. Lovely food & friendly people, highly recommended Show less

Author: APisME95
Title: Delicious food
Review: Delicious Syrian food in Cenang. The service was good too. Nice to switch it up from the noodle and local dishes. Staff was very friendly as well.

Author: peterppatrickLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: Great food Very tasty Good choice of middle eastern dishesQuite a noisy restaurant when we went about 8pm as lots of small children eating10% service charge added to bill. Really? No other restaurants we ate at over 2 weeks added service charge do why here?Tips should be based on the experience and service received, not added automatically.Show less

Author: jp13abk
Title: Amazing humus / exceptional service!
Review: What an amazing food they have! Everyone is always making sure that you have everything you need and making you feel welcome. Definitely one of the best places in the area.

Author: Judith M
Title: a delight
Review: the menue is interesting with a lot of variety the staff are polite and friendly  it was only a short walk from casa del mar

Author: sallysouthofriver
Title: Awful don’t go
Review: We couldn’t understand why this place has good reviews. Food was not great (chicken very dry, salad tasteless & limp, bread dry) staff basically rude. Service was slow, wrong and attitude terrible. General atmosphere in there is not great. Bright, loud.. simply don’t bother.

Author: HuggsyBear123
Title: Great ARABIC restaurant
Review:
Coming from Dubai it's nice to have so home comforts. Shish tawook is great. The Hummus beautiful and the mix grill really nice.
The serve shisha as well. Really nice place very relaxed.

Author: JAMBING
Title: Outstanding restaurant
Review: The best restaurant in Langkawi.  Absolutely divine Lebanese food. Atmosphere and service was outstanding.

Author: Leonida_7
Title: Great Food
Review: Highly recommended, fresh and delicious! We had Falafel, Chicken Kebab, Salad, Wraps. Everything was delicious.

Author: flyadela
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: This was the best food I had on the whole island! Fresh bread, Hummus, Schawaram!! Loved everything!! Thank you!

Author: Muhannad-Anabtawi
Title: Dinner
Review: Arabic restaurant food, the Shawerma is good, Tabolah, Humos and bread, all good, Argelah not bad, the only thing that the mixed rill wasn't good

Author: JamessKr
Title: Excellent experience
Review: An excellent restaurant. A bit more expensive than we were expecting. The service is superb and food is delicious. Would highly recommend trying it if you are in the area.

Author: STazamKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Best Mandi I have had and AMAZING SHISHA
Review: Just go there seriously. The restaurant is always busy so you can have a good idea that its good. Its ten minute walk from Cenang mall. We ordered the mandi, shish towk and ended up with arabic tea and shisha. One of the most memorable dinners. We loved it so much we also tried their Yasmin Bistro next to Cenang mall which is a smaller sized cafe but the main restaurant tasted better. Special thanks to Ali who gave us excellent service!Show less

Author: rquantrillo
Title: Excellent Food
Review: The food is authentic and comes uin big portions. Very calm place with great staff. Lot of dishes to choose from and all looking delicious. Very very good food😎👌

Author: kimgodschalkVenray, The Netherlands
Title: Great food, lovely people!
Review: We had dinner at Yasmin. The food was amazing (hummus, lamb kebab and tabouleh/parsley salad) and the complementary bread (freshly baked in a tandoori outside) was simply outstanding! The service was also really great, the people were very friendly and funny too! They also offer shisha outside on the terrace. Show less

Author: Benjamin D
Title: Very good
Review: Very good restaurant, really not expensive and very friendly staff. If you want to change from typical malaysian dishes, this is the good option.

Author: nimraha2019
Title: Good food always fresh!
Review: I’ve been here a couple of times now and the food we’ve always been served has been hot and fresh! It’s also located right next to Cenang mall so it’s easy to get to after shopping.

Author: Nicole S
Title: Yummy pizza
Review: Was very surprised to find this little place on the corner! Really good pizza, cooked to perfection in a pizza oven. My boyfriend had the Greek salad and was equally impressed. Best westernised meal in Malaysia.

Author: Askar80Malmo, Sweden
Title: Very good food
Review: Best Syrian - Arabic food we had at the island You should expect some flies around but thats typical around the Island . Its a tropical jungle so dont expect them to stay away :))) But the food was worth it The toilets need to be cleaned frequently guys . Not only once a day !! Show less

Author: yousefa952
Title: Magnificent Middle Eastern foods
Review: Don’t miss the dishes ... I liked it for that I visit it again ,,, it’s convenient for the vegetarian people

Author: meganp94xBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food
Review: Really great food at Yasmins this evening! I had the mixed grill, it was a great portion size and so yummy. The staff are really friendly and accommodating here! The atmosphere is also really great! :)A must visit if in the area, would definitely return! Show less

Author: Jordan MUnited Kingdom
Title: If you’re looking for a good feed, this is the one!
Review: Hands down best food I’ve had in this area so far. Fresh fruit juices are a must! I went for the Lemon Mint and had a mint tea too. We also went for the mixed BBQ grill. Good portion sizes but I’ll hopefully let the picture do justice.100% would come back again! Show less

Author: CarlosGhiselli
Title: Real Fresh Food
Review: We came across this restaurant by luck, and we were very lucky. Fresh and cook to order food is outstanding! The staff very friendly and the fresh baked bread is a must. 10 out of 10. Thank you from Brazil!

Author: eccythumpBunbury, Australia
Title: Fresh and delicious
Review: Dined here twice during our 6 day stay and loved our meals on both occasions. The salads are so fresh, healthy and tangy. Do try the tabouleh and the fattoush. The hummus dip was absolutely delicious as were the other appetisers in the mixed plate (eggplant dip, baba gounash and vine leaves) - was hard to pick a favourite. We ordered Eggplant Maklouba Lamb and Lamb Cubes and really enjoyed both. And the Lemon Mint juice was perfectly refreshing. Highly recommend the Yasmin for its quality meals and friendly service. Show less

Author: SyedH1361
Title: Excellent Arab food
Review:
We went with family delicious food . 
Time taking for prepare food  : 5/5 
Service : 5/5
Taste :4/5
Price :5/5

Overall it’s a good restaurant to eat dinner . it’s near to beach also . Enjoy beach then come here for eat .

Author: emmgee8World
Title: Fantastic
Review: In my visit to langkawi I visited this restaurant 4 times in 10 days. I almost tried everything in their menu. & everything tastes great. The least is their kofta styles. Other than that, the soups, the salad mix, the vine leaves, the meat & shawarma are all fantastic.Show less

Author: SamerKotb
Title: Best restaurant in Malaysia till now
Review:
Excellent restaurant, one of the best I’ve visited in Malaysia. 
Food shawerma and fish 5/5
Waiting time: very little 5/5
Stuff: 5/5
Price: valuable 5/5
Location: inside cenang beach area 5/5
Sitting: nice 4/5

Author: Bil_sgp
Title: Excellent service, deliciously authentic Arabic food
Review: Food was very good and fresh, the service made it better. Waiters were able to speak good English and Arabic. Asked for more sahaweeq cause it was so nice. We were given a complimentary pot of tea at the end of our dinner. Satisfactory experience!

Author: Manon L
Title: An amazing place to eat
Review: We were in this restaurant a few days ago with my family ( we were 7 French people ) and we loved so much this restaurant. If you want to eat very good food, this is the best place for you. I will never forget the taste of your plate. It was amazing. The personnel of the restaurant was amazing too. Go there, this is one of the best restaurant of Langkawi for me and my family. We enjoy our holidays thanks to them ! So thanks you yasmin’s team !!Show less

Author: nooribeck
Title: Out for a satisfied meal
Review:
Food is good one of the best kebabs and shawarma
Fruit cocktail is exemplary i love this restaurant
Clean n close to few hotels
Staff are courteous 
Cr edit card accepted

Do come along
Best
Noor Beck

Author: khaus2016
Title: Delicious food and superb service!
Review:
All the staff were very friendly! Hummus came with 2 huge naan bread, amazing falafel that is crispy and tasty, fresh BBQ fish and chicken kebab. 
Owner let us try their Arabic mint tea, complimentary!
Price is reasonable too!

Author: jessicanJ1907JN
Title: great food
Review: food quality is awesome, the meat is nicely grilled & very juicy at the same time. Had a nice time eating here, shisha was pretty good too

Author: Sian G
Title: Great Syrian food
Review: Freshly baked pitta and delicious hummus, baba ganoush, fatoush salad and kebabs. The crew is super efficient, friendly and accomodating of families. Recommend

Author: flojoe18San Diego, California
Title: Overrated
Review: So I went to Yasmin’s because of the rave reviews on TripAdvisor and this is the first time ever I was steered wrong. First off, the food was mediocre. Not much flavor going on. As far as service, never have I felt so uncomfortable. When I got to the restaurant, I was sat on the foreigners only side. All of the locals were to the right and they sat me on the left. Several locals who were sat after me and ordered after me, got their meals before I did. I had several waiters who barely talked to me, only to take my order. They never checked on me to see if I needed a refill or to see how the food was. Throughout my time there, the male waiters just stared at me as if they didn’t want me there. I have never felt so uncomfortable. I don’t know why anyone would bother going there. Don’t waste your time.Show less

Author: Camper63112484883
Title: Authentic flavours
Review:
The hummus, tabbouleh and chicken kebabs were all brilliant. Fresh, homemade, and full of flavour. 
The chicken shawarma, however, was disappointing, so go for the kebabs!

Author: shams_ovi
Title: Mouthwatering experiences
Review:
This is the most memorable experience in the entire Langkawi tour. We were looking for dinner and found this place just adjacent to the Pentai Cenang beach. 
We ordered Khabsa with rice and BBQ squid grill. The food was really good, freshly cooked.

Author: rosie_am_pm
Title: I got a tripadvisor account just to rate Yasmin’s highly!
Review: Yasmin’s has mouthwatering quality food, wonderful attentive service and all in a clean comfortable setting. I grew up with this food and I have to say the kebab, the eggplant mousaka dish and the bread made fresh in the tandoor tasted perfect. It was nice to find people from the Middle Eastern diaspora running such a great business. If you want a break from all the delicious Malay dishes you’re sure to find in Langkawi, then head to Yasmin’s.Show less

Author: 873abdullahq
Title: BEST BAKLAVA IN LANGKAWI😍😍
Review: This was the most delicious Baklava I've ever had. Its just amazingly delicious, nutty and sweet. Everyone should give it a try with a cup of tea😍😍  Will deffinitely come back for some more!

Author: durhamdonkeyDurham, United Kingdom
Title: Come eat here
Review: Visited the restaurant after reading some previous reviews and it been close to our hotel. We were not disappointed the food is excellent, we had mixed kebab and some orange and yellow rice, make sure you ask for this rice, it’s really good. The service is friendly and efficient and reasonably priced, I don’t think you will be disappointed.Show less

Author: chlorobs19
Title: First taste of Syrian food and I want more
Review: This place was such a good find! The service was really great from start to finish and the food was even better. The hummus was so tasty and the freshly made bread to dip made it even better - my family and I all really enjoyed our separate meals and the portion sizes are really big but be warned that all the kebabs come with chips as my mum ordered rice thinking hers didn't come with anything!Show less

Author: lieutenantcobrettiJitra, Malaysia
Title: Great food. Exceptional service
Review: Really enjoyed my time here. Plentiful options in the menu. Friends and I were really satisfied with our meal. Our kebabs and shawarmas was alright but the hummus and falafel was udoubtedly exquisite,both in taste and the plating and presentation. And what really stands out is the exceptional service. The owner of the establishment (Mr.Ali) was very warm and friendly,as were the staff.Show less

Author: AlanRafferty
Title: The place to go for tasty arabic food.
Review: Service was great, falafel and hummus was delicious, as was the chicken sharwarma. highly  recommend  it -  Value for money

Author: fillapitasg
Title: The real shawarma
Review: We had great time, the dinner was delicious especially the shawarma :) The starters were amazing too.

Author: Marta V
Title: The best!!
Review: We found it upon arrival and I can assure you that the best falafel.  that is why we have repeated twice more and we never repeat.  Also the lovely guys there.  100% recommended

Author: kmjen91
Title: my favorite food in langkawi
Review: Came across the street after a jet skiing tour. Had an amazing meal and fantastic service! Would have loved to return a different day, however, was far from my hotel. Highly recommend, will not disappoint.

Author: vojta157Surbiton, United Kingdom
Title: no idea why so high scores
Review: honestly i have no idea why is this placed ranked so high. It is mwdiocre kebab place with little dining room. Main course arrived before starter, chicken doner was dry, minced lamb kebab alright but nothing spectacular. The hummus was great though.Overall, honestly, dont get excited for culinary or real restaurant experience for that matter.Show less

Author: nightmanager1
Title: Favourite meal in langkawi
Review: Went here twice as the food was so good. Best food weve have in langkawi. Service was great, falafel and hummus was delicious, as was the chicken shish. Would recommend!

Author: LordydordyHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious
Review: I will as very impressed with menu and found it difficult to choose so went for the mixed appetisers and bbq platter. The service was fast and friendly and the food all delicious, only the lamb was w little tough. Freshly made oita was exceptional. Very reasonable price. I would definitely go backShow less

Author: ali18242016London, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: Came here after reading all the reviews, service is great the guys working at front line really do a good job but the food really lacked flavour, i had the chicken shawarma but it tasted very dry. So i ordered the Fish which was overpriced for a fish in Langkawi!! My Bill came to 200 ringgit which is quite pricey when i didnt have starters dessert...Show less

Author: duff3833Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Great food, great service
Review: My wife and I were driving down the strip on Pantai Cenang and spotted the packed Yasmine Restaurant. We waited only a few minutes before we were seated. The waiters were very prompt and polite. We had the hummus with meat, a beef shawarma and a lamb kebab. Everything was fantastic. So good, we came back the next night just for the shawarma. Keep it up guys, excellent job! PS - kudos to the shawarma and bread oven chefs who stand by these heaters in already super hot conditions! Show less

Author: Rgw18762019
Title: Great food
Review: Clean restaurant with nice staff. Very authentic Syrian food. We ordered chicken shawarma and falafel both excellent. Soft drinks very cheap. Nice atmosphere. Definitely worth a visit.

Author: Carol L
Title: Lovely food
Review:
Falafel was incredible. Partner loved his 
shawarma. Really big portions,  we left stuffed! Staff were very nice and the place was very clean.  We'll definitely be back

Author: jami_182Sydney, Australia
Title: Amazing food for very reasonable price
Review: We ordeeed the mix appetiser plate and everything was so fresh and delicious. The pita bread was hot and fresh and incredible. Some reviews on here say that it is overpriced, but for the amount of food you get this really isn’t true. There are good vegetarian options on the menu, I’d recommend the felafel!!! Service was good and we were even given complimentary tea at the end of the meal. Everyone who visits Langkawi needs to eat hereShow less

Author: Mark C
Title: Awesome meal.
Review: Just dined here tonight. Had a great experience. Try the Arabic salad and beautiful Hummus. I had half a dozen prawn which were well cooked and fresh. Great service and food. Even our kids who can be fussy ate everything on the table. Yum!

Author: toddp6Pattaya, Thailand
Title: So nice, we did it twice!
Review: Excellent food quality from the bread, to the lamb, to the fish. Everything we had here was fantastic with great service as well. The falafel was up there with the best! Don’t miss this place if you are in Langkawi, our family went twice in one week.Show less

Author: U9484VMstevec
Title: Top Draw
Review: Ate here on numourous occasions now, everyday in fact.. People you cannot go wrong here, the boys go that little bit more to look after you.. Always a greeting smile, the food is amazing, the bread to die for, back to resort next year & will be definitely eating here again , 5stars keep up the good work Show less

Author: courtneyw829
Title: Great Food
Review: The food was amazing! Very light and fresh for the hot days here. The appetizer platter was absolutely delicious.

Author: Bru1Christchurch, United Kingdom
Title: "Just love this place"
Review: We ate here in March 2018 and again in March 2019. It is still as good. Excellent value for quality Middle Eastern food. You cannot go wrong and the their bread is really special.Highly recommended. Looking forward to eating there again when next in Langkawi March 2020.Show less

Author: Saintnicolas86
Title: A service with a smile
Review:
We enjoyes our lunch at Yasmine. SERIAN FOODS 
The foods are very cheap and also very friendly waiter 
We wpild highly recommend

Author: MD2014-SS
Title: Good value
Review:
Among all claimed middle eastern style resturants in Langkawi, this one offers good value for money, with nice cooked foods from fresh materials. They have plenty of Turkish, Arabic and Persian dishes.
Staff are polite and really fast service.

Author: vas o
Title: Worth the visit
Review: Food is fresh and tasty , portions big enough and prices are normal . At the end they give you hot tea . For a Middle East taste is very good .

Author: Keith C
Title: Ok but nothing special
Review: We ate here after reading Tripadvisor reviews. The meal was acceptable but nothing to write home about. The staff were friendly and the the restaurant was clean if a little basic. Fine but would hope to have better when on holiday.

Author: Jabran K
Title: Top quality Syrian/Middle eastern food
Review: What a wonderful little middle eastern gem hiding in the midst of Langkawi’s Cenang Beach. We were attended to, promptly served and waited on by a number of staff. Food quality was very good, very fresh and tasty. The Mix Grill was enjoyable, lamb cubes could have had more flavouring personally. Lamb moussaka and the chicken shwarma were excellent. Nice variety of drinks, watermelon juice was spot on.. not much option for desserts unfortunately. The Arabic bread was made fresh and super luxurious.. The place was clean, spacious and air conditioned. Staff spoke decent English. Definitely recommend if you fancy something different from Noodles, rice or lasi namak.Show less

Author: Zana M
Title: love the bread
Review:
the bread is amazing, very good food and you always get a tasty tea in the end

recommend to come in the evening as it is very warm inside during the day

Author: Kyri1986Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: A must visit if you are in Langkawi. By far the best restaurant. Everything is super tasty, fresh and excellent flavours of the Mediterranean cuisine. Reasonably priced and good size portions. We had a selection of food which included the eggplant moussaka, tabbouleh, hummus, falafels and Arabic salad. I can’t wait to eat there again! Show less

Author: tt53
Title: Great find
Review: After reading other reviews we felt we needed to try and so glad we did. Food was super tasty and piping hot. Flat breads also freshly cooked. Restaurant super clean and staff so nice. Will visit on next holiday.

Author: ankexin
Title: One of the best places in Langkawi
Review: This place has delicious and run by wonderful, cheerful people. It was a pleasure to dine there. One of 2 best places we ate in Langkawi. Healthy, great atmosphere and yummy.

Author: lucykeebs
Title: Delicious!
Review: The food was absolutely wonderful, we had hummus and bread for starter then chicken shish and it was soooo tasty and so filling! We went on our first night and I plan to go back before we leave, definitely recommend.

Author: CHD6265
Title: No alcohol, but don't be put off!
Review: Visited on the back of good TripAdvisor reviews and so glad we did. Excellent salads, breads, starters, hummus, etc. I had chicken kebabs as main which we're excellent.  All washed down with various fresh juices we sampled (don't waste your time / money on coke)

Author: saggis2017
Title: Must visit 😋
Review: I am a vegetarian ..I loved the veg falafel with spicy dipping served in Yasmin ...its so yummy finally felt satisfied with the food I had in the whole trip..it's yum and a must visit place...my husband loved his dish(non veg)..the naan roti is tasty...I wish they had more variety of dishes for vegetarian foods ...hence the 4 ⭐Show less

Author: rothwell40
Title: Something different
Review:
Went to Yasmin’s last night with my husband for dinner. Really enjoyed our meal. We had the hummus with flatbreads,kibbehs & moussaka. All
were delicious & at approx £16 including a large bottle of mineral water was exceptional value. Would recommend.

Author: D-zengin
Title: Lovely food and really good size portions
Review:
I have Visited twice, and will return again during my stay in Langkawi. 
Really tasty food, fast service and really good portion sizes. 
Highly recommend!

Author: Liennekke
Title: Delicious
Review: We where struggling eating all the food because it was so much. But it was to good to not eat. We ate at a lot of restaurants in langkawi but for us this was the best restaurant we ate at. The bread you get with the hummus was still warm and I guess it was unlimited. I forgot the name of the salad but it was delicious! We also ordered the bbq mix and lamb chops. I found the bbq mix a bit more taste full. Rice was good to but a bit to much for us. They give you chips with the meal so no need to order rice.Show less

Author: Jarl_FroylandPantai Cenang, Malaysia
Title: Great food and great service
Review: Best meal we have had so far in LangkawiBeen a bit dissapointed about hotel restaurants on the island so far, and used Tripadvisor to find this gem.Middle-east / Syrian food. Great kebab-both lamb and chicken, lovely hummus and a very good falafel. Fruit cocktails (non-alcoholic) are great as well. Got some fries with the food, only thing on the plate that was not needed. Plenty of food. Service outstanding. Show less

Author: HmosoftTripoli, Libya
Title: Very good food
Review: This is one of the best restaurants offered delivery services.First, they are technology oriented, they accept locations by WhatsApp for delivery. Zero hassle.The packing of their food is excellent. It's microwave friendly and comes with the proper Syrian sides.It tastes really good. Makes you feel Damaskawi :)It's bit costy, but was worth it.Show less

Author: 520tarekh
Title: Phenomenal Restaurant, Delicious food😍
Review: Words can't express how delicious the food was. The shawarma, hummus, shish tawook & falafels were absolutely delicious. The staff are very friendly and great. I will definitely go back and eat here again. Legit, one of the best restaurants on the island.

Author: RomanKryvosheyev
Title: Good and tasty food!
Review: Perfect place! Good and delicious lamb and chicken. Really amazing and tasty. Big portions. Clean and cozy.

Author: iheart2travel_8
Title: Delicious
Review: The food was delicious with good service!  I had falafels which were absolutely delicious, served with the tastiest bread and dip.  The prices were a little high but worth it for the quality of food and service. I would definitely go back!

Author: emmap157London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: We don't usually visit the same restaurant twice on holiday but made an exception as the food at Yasmin was so delicious. Freshly cooked and of a high quality we loved the flatbreads that were served to all tables and made on site. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, the restaurant was very clean too. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: ally_m_27387
Title: Yum!
Review: We went here twice and both times we were so full afterwards! Great service and tasty food that was served fresh but quickly. Highly recommended

Author: aliemad47
Title: Good not perfect
Review:
An arabic restuarant we tasted lamp chops and shawarma both were good
Staffs were kind and cleanness was good
Space of restuarant was a little hot so maybe its better to go there for dinner

Author: simonmE6749FI
Title: Wedding in langkawi
Review: Friendly service. Good food.  They do beer but don't advertise it. Home made bread with the meal is a lovely touch.  A lovrly touch of western food and Malaysian sea food.

Author: Heddyfan
Title: Nice staff nice food and nice location!
Review: The appetizer especially the bean paste( I forgot their name) are super delicious. Nice food at a reasonable price. Strongly recommend!

Author: philipjblake
Title: Delicious Mousakka
Review:
Very delicious food and great service. Really friendly staff and a good sized menu to keep everyone happy.

We also tried the baked lamb which was delicious.

Author: Karen_and_Roy111210Earls Barton, United Kingdom
Title: Devine...
Review: We ate here a few times whilst staying locally. The restaurant is clean, the staff super friendly and the food was absolutely delicious. Everything is fresh and tasty, good portion sizes and excellent value for money. They don't serve alcohol but it doesn't matter, you go here for the food and boy did we eat well! Thanks for making us so welcome!Show less

Author: sally29aBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Great Kebabs
Review: We were recommended to Yasmin from my daughter and she certainly was right It’s not a flash place but the food is just wonderfulMy husband had lamb kebab and I had chicken kebab, a mixed salad and bread with hummus.... bread cooked on site... the food was delicious...and the guys serving very helpful and friendly Show less

Author: Martin aryeh W
Title: Great
Review: Ate here twice on both occasions the food and service were superb , it’s not the cheapest place by any means but is definitely good value for money and we would recommend if you like Arabian food

Author: Q7367ZTlisam
Title: AMAZING
Review: This place is so good. The first time we were here we tried a sharing plate and the falafel, so tasty. The second time we had the shawarma chicken wrap and the falafel wrap, both were soooo good.

Author: Victor NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yasmin has a faulty scale to weight the seafood
Review: The bread, hummus and mint tea were fine, but the main dishes were average. The accompanying fried potatoes and salad were quite poor. However, what made me write this review is that we paid for 300g of medium-large prawns, when in fact we were served five not so medium-large prawns, which certainly must not have weighted 300g when fresh. For comparison, I show what six fresh medium-large prawns weight. I also cook and I know they shrink; the spaghetti is just to test the scale. Definitely, not a good value for money.Show less

Author: ParagliderBaselBasel, Switzerland
Title: Superb!
Review: We visited this restaurant over the Christmas holidays. Was a great choice for dinner. The service was prompt and helpful. The waiter helped us with our choice of food. We ordered the kebab platter along with the humus and babaganoush and each one was a winner. Topped off with the tasty, warm bread it was a treat. Not very expensive either. Hope to come back when in Langkawi the next time.Show less

Author: AvisitoRinTown
Title: Whole Chicken
Review: Was excellent, no alcohol but tea served in reasonable sized tea cups. Service was nothing too special but well above average for the strip. Lacks atmosphere, which is something many of the restaurants have in common. Otherwise clean, tidy and priced to suit anyone’s budget.

Author: Marc FBali, Indonesia
Title: Fantastic food!
Review: One of the best middle eastern/mediterranean restaurants we visited. Staff is very friendly. Menu is large and every meal we had was very fresh and tasty. We went twice during our short 3 day stay. The ingredients are high quality and fresh. Will definitely go back there again. Show less

Author: 464lenak
Title: My best humus
Review: Surely one of the best place in here! And my best humus and falafel! And... best bbq! Everybody should try!!!

Author: 595muhammadfarhan
Title: Restaurants
Review: Good and awesome tasting food. The price is also extremely affordable. Staff there are also very kind, friendly and accommodating. Place is very clean and well maintained. Even the toilet is clean. Superb place to eat with friends and/or family.

Author: ontheroadagain1992
Title: Delicious, and amazing service
Review: Brilliant food across the board. The mixed appetizer is gorgeous. We've visited twice and had it with each of the lamb and chicken kebabs. Decided to try the falafel as well this time, which a bit ambitious, so the waiter gave me a box to take it away. Was looking a bit dry as we'd eaten all the dips so he gave us some extra sauce! A really lovely meal and experience. Show less

Author: juliatryz
Title: Nice dinner
Review: The staff was friendly and nice, hummus was excellent and to it you get freshly baked bread (you can see them making it just outside the restaurant). We got a good impression overall.

Author: IainT9
Title: Great food
Review: Great food and amazing service....best Syrian/Arabic food in Langkawi....second to none. Will definatley visit there again when me and my family return to Langkawi

Author: billpar2015
Title: Just ok
Review:
Not bad but really nothing special despite the reviews.
Had to ask for the table to be cleaned twice. 
Had to ask twice for our drinks.
Food was okay but certainly had better

Author: DelwinkrielSydney, Australia
Title: Best Mediterranean food
Review: Great chicken, beef, lamb kebabs... quick and easy eating, great location, no reservations required. Brilliant service, start off with the dips platter to share with freshly made flat bread- finger licking good. Portions are large and if hungry order the BBQ platter with a selection of meat kebabs.Highly recommended Show less

Author: Colzthecat
Title: Fantastic shawarma
Review: The best shawarma I have eaten is served at this small restaurant. Also have nice fruit drinks, pizza and some small dishes. Well worth a visit. Nice staff.

Author: valentinaarjona
Title: Amazing food and attention
Review: We order starters to share and each of us a main (4) and EVERY SINGLE THING WAS AMAZING! So recomended!! On the Main Street and the service was perfect!!

Author: ImadABH
Title: Great food and service! Highly recommended!
Review: We visited Yasmin during our recent stay in Langkawi. Great middle eastern food and great service. Their appetisers (Hommos, Taboule, moutabal, etc.) as well as their meat (chicken chich taouk, kebbe, etc.) are home made and taste great.

Author: jaewooc370
Title: Great food!! We loved it!
Review:
Lamb and chicken kebab, hummus with pita bread, lemon mint ice teas and chicken bbq. 
Great food very delicious would go back any time..

Author: JohnnyZZZZ
Title: Great Arab food
Review: The top TripAdvisor Arab restaurant is a Moroccan place my partner and I tried and was disappointed.. This place is much tastier and a better portion and value.

Author: Sue O
Title: Great place for lunch or dinner
Review: We ate in and had take-away from Yasmin and enjoyed the food both times. The service was reasonably fast.

Author: lukaslehr
Title: Great Middle-Eastern restaurant
Review:
Great food, friendly and accommodating staff and free complimentary home baked bread with every meal. Came back 3 more times after our first visit.
I highly recommend it

Author: Kayleigh1610Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Amazing Arab food
Review: This place was so incredible! The food was that delicious I couldn’t even take a photo as it was devoured so quickly! The hummus and baba ganouj were so so tasty! Everything was so fresh, even the bread that is made to order at the restaurant. We will definitely go back. It’s also very reasonably priced. Show less

Author: Librarian-go-gaga
Title: Authenticity and quality
Review: We had mixed platter as appetizer and half a grilled chicken.  Love the hummus, freshly made bread etc including the smooth garlic sauce for the chicken.  Perfect in terms of taste and texture!

Author: Kelly O
Title: You have to eat here when in Langkawi!
Review: 100% the best food and service we had in Langkawi. We ate here twice, we tried a few other places but had to come back! The food is delicious, perfectly cooked and presented and the service is outstanding. Yes, as a backpacker it may seem pricier, than some other places but for the quality and portion size it is TOTALLY worth it. We would eat here again and again. Also the shisha is really good quality. Definitely give Yasmins a visit if your in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Capventure172
Title: Best arab food
Review: Hands down the best arab food in langkawi! Loved the food. Staff were very friendly and very hospitable.

Author: mahdialjamal
Title: Lunch
Review: We were heading back from KILIM geopark to cennag beach, we stopped by yasmin alsham resturant, had to shawerma sandwiches, the stuff were very kind and helpful, and the food was greaaaat with normal reasonable price

Author: Ania Ł
Title: Everything was great
Review: Staff is super nice, service really good and food amazing. I truly recommend this place. The place is really clean and has a convenient location.

Author: cappa123
Title: Great food and staff
Review: I ended up eating here twice while in Langkawi. The food was fantastic fresh and tasty. Lamb chops were amazing my kids could not get enough. Staff are really friendly and attentive. Recommended for sure.

Author: ZeeHamdan1989Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Authenticity and Quality!
Review: The best restaurant serving authentic Syrian food in Malaysia! The hummus is definitely the star in my opinion. Comes with the best bread; crispy on the outside, super soft once you get a bite! I always have the same main dish; the chicken shawarma. It’s perfectly done, moist and tender chicken pieces with just the right amount of sauce. You’ll be happy to know that the portion is huge! Perfect price, affordable and for the quality of the food, it’s the perfect place! Highly recommended! The owners and staff are super friendly too. -Zi- Show less

Author: markusl206Aarau, Switzerland
Title: Just perfect
Review: Not to have dinner at our hotel all the time we, we chose to have dinner here.It was simply perfect. Friendly staff, great food. We had the mixed starter plate and chicken kebap and chicken shawarma. It was so much and delicious food, we didn‘t even expect that.We got the bill and were quite surprised how cheap it was.Nothing to complain about.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently Good
Review: We have visited Yasmin on our last three visits to Langkawi and on each occasion, have thoroughly enjoyed the mixed appetiser with flat breads.Service has always been friendly and food has arrived quickly.This is an informal dining experience and not somewhere you would sit and chat all night however you are never rushed even when it is a very busy period.We will definitely return on our next visit to Langkawi.Show less

Author: BlnDxbSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful Arabic food
Review: What a great lunch we had here. My family and I used to live in the Middle East for many years and have been craving Arabic food since moving to Asia. This is by far the best we had in a long time. Perfect hummus and shawarma, delicious bread and kebabs. The staff was super friendly as well. We will be back! Shukran!Show less

Author: V776FTalaaa
Title: Delicious Food & Incredible staff
Review:
It's almost impossible to be in langkawi and not drop by the best restaurant in pantai cenang, yasmin Restaurant. The food is beyond delicious, their kebabs, shawarma, falafel and appetizers .... mouth watering. Very Authentic and an incredible staff. 
 Deffo worth a second visit.

Author: Anas S
Title: Yasmin restaurant
Review: Yasmin restaurant It’s the best Arabic food ever in langkawi I love all the food there. Wish to have it in Germany I wish to stay longer in langkawi to have that food everyday And the people who working there are very friendly I will said thank you very much for the good treatment wish the best....Show less

Author: Md ali H
Title: The best food i ever had in Malaysia
Review: Bout bout Acha rice or in ki bout Achi roti best dish lamb rice or ya mix mza Hain ya to kamla Ka Hain west root b bout Achi hain

Author: Arfat K
Title: FOOD & RESTAURANT IS HEAVEN
Review: Tasted the Falafel and Hummus and it was absolutely delicious words cant even describe the goodness. The food and the staff, everything was just perfect.

Author: LoveTravel817088
Title: Yummy food and nice fresh bread
Review:
We went there twice everything was nice 
Highly recommended
Friendly staff
Good job guys ،😚😚
Hope  can come back soon again and get my lovely falaffel

Author: Edesapa
Title: Highly recommended in Langkawi!
Review:
We have been at this fantastic place four times on our one-week holiday in Langkawi. This already tells a lot, I think:) The staff is very nice, the foods are tasty and they give a big portion in a clean restaurant. 
Higly recommended! :)

Author: Lorraine M
Title: Great meal
Review: Four of us enjoyed a delicious dinner here. The lamb mousaka and the hummus are both delicious. The bread is good too!

Author: 416kazimr
Title: Delicious food and excellent service
Review: The food was just amazing and piping hot. Went there with my family the ambiance was on point aswell. Also dont forget to try their amazing fresh juices

Author: Kempston_MillKempston, United Kingdom
Title: Great Middle Eastern food
Review: Visited for evening meal. Appetiser mixed platter at 38MYR was more than enough for 3 with good mix of food typesMain courses were also large portions with favourites being chicken kebabs with chips and chicken mandiTop: It is very muslim so if you want beer or any alcohol, you’ll need to have your fill before or after the visit. That said Thirstday is just across the road and great for a beer.Show less

Author: Mamun KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Was decent,,,get the bread!
Review: We ate here on our first night, the restaurant was packed, I think they have about 40-50 seats or so in total. The waiters were really friendly, I got the lamb shish, although I felt the portion was small in comparison to the UK Turkish places, the food was nice. My wife is vegetarian so they custom made a vegetarian dish for her too which was nice. Price wise it’s not bad, I think for 2 mains and 2 drinks we paid under £20. It’s worth a visit and every time I walked past this restaurant they were busy.Show less

Author: FellowTraveler816898
Title: Good food, service not so good
Review: Ordered three dishes, got only two and there was a mixup on the third one. What we ordered was probably given to customers who were being served by the owner directly. Food was good, but the service left a bad taste at the end.

Author: KarlaM2262
Title: Yum!
Review: Incredible food, with amazing service! Would 100% recommend. We had the half bbq chicken which came with the best bread made freshly in the restaurant.

Author: DrAhmadAfiq
Title: excellent restaurant!
Review: generous portion, super yummy food with nice ambiance.. you will never regret coming to the restaurant:)

Author: ZibrBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely fresh bread
Review: The freshly made bread is the highlight. Crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. I ordered falafel which was delicious and my husband ordered the shawarma and grilled chicken which were tasty. Told my family and they went twice during our stay in Langkawi. Will definitely come againShow less

Author: DimwiddleCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Decent falafel, better bread
Review: Really nice vegan options here! The classic falafel, hummus and bread were pretty tasty... especially the bread as it was baked fresh. We also got the veggie sharing platter which was decent! The owner and staff were really nice and friendly, food came out fairly quickly as well.Only issue was the portion size didn’t really reflect in the price... but definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: ClausP
Title: Great food
Review: Had the chicken shawarma with fries and it tasted great. Quite a small serving though and very few fries. So if you are really hungry, then you will need to go with an additional dish.

Author: mahbub51
Title: Fantastic
Review: Good & dellicious food....lamb is Very nice, they do lamb beriani so tasy..good place to eat...stuff is friendly

Author: perdana89
Title: Yummy kebabs and hummus with quick service
Review: We had the falafel (after so many reviews here) and chicken shish taouk, alongside other dishes. They were all tasty, and service was prompt, though their drinks (we had Turkish coffee and mint tea) were average.

Author: adequate8Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: TASTY FOOD
Review: Stopped off for lunch and was delighted with the food! Nice little cafe inside with fans, and the bread is made onsite by the road side! Had hummus and falafel for starters which were absolutely delicious, followed by chicken shwarma and chicken skewer kebab - fantastic! Could eat that bread and hummus by the kilo! Show less

Author: review_princess2010Gatley, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Syrian food!!!!!!
Review: Really excellent quality food here - hummus is so good and the bread is baked fresh at the front of the place in a clay oven. Fantastic! Good service and excellent value (£10 for two courses and a soft drink including service charge). No air con but good fans and accepted international MasterCard. We also discovered later there is a Yasmin express at opposite end of Cenang beach! Show less

Author: 247stens
Title: Delicious!
Review: Perfect place for a cheap but very tasty meal, with the lamb kebab as absolute highlight! The staff is very friendly and everything you ask for is there in a second. We also got bread en extra sauce for free, so there is nothing to criticize about the service. The only (little) downside was the interior, the fluorescent light and some random decoration didn’t make it very cosy. But would definitely come back!Show less

Author: WRtootingLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food!
Review: The food here was excellent. They cook fresh bread in front of the restaurant which you can dip in some excellent humous along with your amazing falafel. I had the shwama main and my wife had the chicken kebab both of which were first class. The only thing that made this 4 star rather than 5 was the random order the food came out. Mains, starters, drinks in that order to be fair the place was really busy.. But you cant have 5 stars for that. Overall well worth a visit if you are laid back and not in a rush as the food wins out. Also point to note this is a Muslim place so no alcohol is served there are fantastic juices though.Show less

Author: GAkimberlyPEACH
Title: The best food we ate on Langkawi
Review:
I can only say this food was DELICIOUS! 
PERIOD.

I still think about it today.... My first time eating Syrian food and I am now a HUGE fan!

My mouth is watering just writing this.

Author: ياسمين ا
Title: Nice and deliouse very clean   ‘Shisha is the best shisha I take in my life , I advice everyone to visit this res
Review: Very nice place, tasty and delicious food, very clean and worm welcoming from all the staff, l like shisha too much, I advice every one to visit this restaurant and enjoying 👍👍👍.

Author: RababS14
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: The food is so delicious. Real taste of Syrian food. Great service and staff. Best restaurant in Langkawi. Must try it.

Author: annahlbg
Title: Soooooo tasty!
Review: We ate at the Yasmin Restaurant on three consecutive days. It was so tasty. We would come back anytime.

Author: patricklP9251HB
Title: Such a lovely place
Review:
We had a very nice dinner. We shared many different things e.g. the chicken, the lamb, salad, falafel and also the hummus. The food was awesome and the services was fast and very friendly. So nice people here around!! 
We will definitely come back!!

Author: EAB_78South East England, United Kingdom
Title: One of my favourite restaurants
Review: After a bad experience at a different restaurant me and my family found Yasmin’s and we LOVED it. The food was perfect and we cleared our plates in no time. I would recommend this restaurant to every single person even if they weren’t coming to langkawi! Thank you so much for such lovely food!Show less

Author: danielleee90
Title: Good roast dinner
Review: When you really fancy a traditional English roast dinner this is the place to be. The owners are lovely as is there food

Author: chuckyJellieGold Coast, Australia
Title: 3 visits
Review: We were so lucky our friends found this place, as during the MCO lockdown we were all missing Sunday Roasts.Bookings were made for the 3 occasions and food preference given.I had chicken twice and beef once. The baked potatoes were so good and we could ask for extra, which we always did. Generous serves and plenty of gravy served separately.We always had to sign in and temperature was taken. Nice bar area for pre-dinner drinks. Lovely garden setting.Plenty of parking, friendly owners.Show less

Author: kerryk670
Title: Wonderful home cooked food
Review: We saw the reviews on here for this bistro and came during our week long stay in Langkawi. All I can say is wow! This was some of the best food we have eaten in Malaysia, especially for our children who loved a taste of home. My husband and I both had steak, cooked to perfection and our kids had the Irish Stew which they both lapped up. We returned on the Sunday for gorgeous Sunday roasts. This place looks so unassuming you may miss it,but it would be such a shame. Fabulous place Show less

Author: Cam87Johor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful and Authentic Irish Stew in Langkawi
Review: I had wonderful and authentic Irish Stew with lamb, potatoes and carrots. Make sure you order bread to soak up the stew to enjoy every bite. The setting is relaxing in a garden. The brownie with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce was the perfect finishing touch with a cup of coffee. Note the evenings it is open or call ahead to reserve a seat. The service was excellent. It was a romantic evening with candle light on each table. We hope to return soon!Show less

Author: michaelduggysmith
Title: Incredible
Review: Irish stew was phenomenal, Scottish tourist expecting less and wow we were overwhelmed with how good it was. 10/10

Author: MancJRGWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Absolutely superb food!
Review: Coco's Bistro was a short taxi ride from our resort in Pantai Tengah (Grab taxi cost RM 13). We luckily visited on a Sunday evening so we could sample their Sunday dinner.On arrival staff were very welcoming, acknowledging our telephone booking (does get busy so remember to book a table via Whats App). Good quality menu, with chicken or beef roast dinner available. Excellent value for money and selection of drinks for all tastes.My mouth watered when the roast beef dinner arrived. It was divine - tender slices of roast beef, mash and roast potatoes, Yorkshire pudding, carrots and white cabbage....All topped with a delicious rich gravy. As an alternative to local cuisine, it was a real taste of home cooking. I definitely recommend this restaurant and will be returning myself before my flight back to the UK. Thank you to all the staff who made us so welcome. Show less

Author: Markstarling
Title: Wow wow wow great place to
Review: Wow wow wow great place to have a treat from home excellent food great staff great value food excellent drinks great atmosphere

Author: tt53Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food and lovely staff
Review: There comes a time while you are on holiday when you fancy a taste of home. Cocos is a great place for this. Sunday roasts are always good but you must book as it is so busy on Sundays. Love the roast beef! Other menu options for the rest of the week are also great. Never had a bad meal here. Staff attentive and friendly.Show less

Author: Clearyhh
Title: Comforts of home
Review: Lovely western food in an amazing location.  Food was excellent and hosts were very welcoming and friendly.  Well worth a visit when in Langkawi.

Author: P6320TYmikemMacau, China
Title: Don't hesitate...just go !!
Review: One of the best places that we had for food, in our case, dinner. The place is surrounded by lots of green, staff really friendly and helpful, and of course a menu that shows its quality on the plate. We had a grilled seabass and Irish Stew and a terrific garlic bread. I must say, it was probably one of the best dinner meals we have eaten in Langkawi. Great work guys. Keep going Coco's Bistro...Show less

Author: robbie106gloucestershire
Title: Please don't miss it.
Review: What a great restaurant tucked away off the main road to Kuah.A great find and not to be missed. A great alternative to the Asian food if after a few days you are hankering for Western Fayre.We visited twice being such a good place. Excellent simple dishes and beers all at a good price.It was nice to sit outside under the trees with all the nightlife insect noises which creates a lovely tropical atmosphere.Service was excellent from Malaysian English speaking waiter.If you like an Irish Coffee just ask or in our case it was with Rum and very strong.Show less

Author: Prinserd
Title: Great food and service
Review: An unassuming place, tucked out of main road. You would never guess the quality of food from its exterior.

Author: ikarrtiniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Coco's superb food and ambience
Review: Coco's is tucked in an idyllic location surrounded by greenery and romantic too. Owners and staff super friendly. All speak English. For a good western meal Coco's is the place. My favourite is the Chicken Thermidor. The pastry just nice and the filling so delicious. My boyfriend loves their 3 cheese chicken. Also awesome is their roast beef so yummy. It's a weekly visit to Coco's for me!!!!Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Simply the best.
Review: On our latest three week holiday we repeatedly went to Coco's as we had already done so on many previous trips.Yet again the word "outstanding" applies yet hardly does justice this unique restaurant which raises the bar every time we eat there.It is simply the best and no matter what dish you select the result is the same - perfect and excellent.We greatly look forward to our next trip and repeated visits to this multi-star restaurant.Show less

Author: Agitha ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome steak
Review: I have never eaten steak so fresh and delicious. Their deserts are good. I heard from the driver this place is run by a former chef who worked in royal carribean cruise if i am not wrong. Worth every penny spent there. Not that expensive and left with a satisfied tummy. Burp!! Show less

Author: Mohd-Z-K
Title: stake and scalop
Review:
one of the best restaurant in langkawi
i tried stake and scalop both of them are perfect it is romantic place and quite and very good staff

Author: garry p
Title: Great Pub food!
Review: If you are a Westerner looking for comfort food in Langkawi this is the place, decent portions,great location in a tropical garden Steaks, Lamb shanks,and more could do with an extra desert or two on the menu but we had a great night

Author: Neale1810Kingston-upon-Hull, United Kingdom
Title: Sunday menu
Review: We had hope to go to an Italian restaurant nearby but it unexpectedly closed so our Grab driver took us here instead. Although it’s on a main road it is quite secluded as it’s down a short drive.Didn’t know what to expect and certainly didn’t anticipate a British Sunday lunch type menu! About half of the items on the menu had run out so there was limited choice by 8:30pm. Both chose the ribeye steak in the end and a drink each. They don’t accept credit cards so had to limit what we drunk as hadn’t brought out much cash.The steaks were OK, served with some nice crunchy chips and a sauce (peppercorn for me and mushroom for my wife). Nothing special but for 55 ringgit it was good value.Service was friendly and efficient.Show less

Author: 869martink
Title: Craving for European classics - go to Coco's Bistro!!!
Review: An excellent restaurant with an absolute fair price level, the steak was awesome, the beef stew tender and well seasoned, I highly recommend it!

Author: CassiecareriMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and cheap!
Review: We stopped in at coco’s for a quick bite to eat. The chicken cordon bleu was really good, along with the creamy mashed potato. My mum had the chicken schnitzel with chips and vegetables, schnitzel was good although the vegetables were sautéed with LOTS of garlic. Staff were friendly and service was prompt. Do take repellent though as there are lots of mosquitoes where the restaurant is located.Show less

Author: Sian GSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprise find: Good hearty pub food in thw middle of langkawi!
Review: Came with my husband and toddler for a lovely dinner of Irish stew, grilled fish and cottage pie. All deliciously home cooked and filling. Coco was lovely and welcoming and looked after our son while we finished our dinner too. We will be back on our next trip!Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent, yet again.
Review: Superb food, excellent service, sensible prices all in conducive surroundings.Apart from the world famous Irish Stew and Sunday Roast dinner, to name but a few off the menu, we had the Rack of Lamb special order which was simply delicious such that we repeated that order on a later visit and will most certainly be repeating the order on our next visit to Langkawi.Thanks for everything "TEAM COCO", especially for making my husbands birthday so memorable.Show less

Author: mike cTownsville, Australia
Title: great little bistro
Review: we visited here with local friends for dinner, what a surprise!! cosy and tidy, good & varied menu (Asian & western ) wine at bottle shop prices, icy cold tiger beer on tap, prices very reasonable, quality & service outstanding. would go again. 10 out of 10.Show less

Author: nickandjaysadven2018Bali, Indonesia
Title: Fabulous Roast Beef and Yorkshire Pudding
Review: This is a fabulous restaurant set in beautiful gardens with very attentive helpful staff.We had Roast Beef Sunday Dinner with amazing Yorkshire Puddings and all the usual trimmings which was superb. Highly recommend this!We loved the no smoking rule so we could enjoy our food sitting outside in fresh air. Bonus!Show less

Author: berlindal2018
Title: Finest chicken gordon blue!
Review: The title can speak for itself. Very good service, odd and beautiful restaurant with good food. A bit annoying with the mosquitos but it is little of a concern since they have a fan and some candles fixed for that.

Author: Q6935TNwayneh
Title: A 'must' place to eat
Review: Both my wife and I are well travelled and have been incredibly fortunate to have eaten in some of the best restaurants and hotels around the world. Whilst visiting Langkawi we are staying in a 5* luxury hotel in a remote area of the north of the island. Thats enough about us! Tonight we have made the effort to drive the 45 minutes to Coco's Bistro for our supper. The food and the hospitality was quite simply out of this world, stunning and I would have walked here if I hadn't got a car. This won't be our last visit to Coco's, and if you want to immerse yourself in 5* luxury, a visit here is truly the way to go. Thank you to everyone at Coco's for such a memorable visit.Show less

Author: RawtalentIsle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: Sunday...there's only one place to go to...
Review: Just had our umpteenth visit to Coco's. The rest of our party had the Roast Beef, I chose the rib eye steak with Garlic butter. It came with a nice side of crunchy salad and homestyle fries.....absolutely yummy. Unfortunately to full to try the boozy ice cream. It'll have to wait until next year!Show less

Author: IanLoveAyr, United Kingdom
Title: GREAT FIND
Review: We went here on the recommendation of someone from our hotel and I'm so glad the gave us the heads up. It's a 15 minute taxi ride but well worth going, best to make a reservation though as it's not that big.They don't do starters so straight on to the main course, my wife ordered the grilled fish and she was delighted with a beautifully cooked piece of seabass with vegetables and sautéed potatoes and I went for the ribeye steak which was perfectly cooked and came with chips and salad to finish we had the homemade Baileys ice cream which has to be one of the booziest desserts I've ever had - lovely.We were so impressed we made another reservation for a few nights later and once again my wife had the fish and I chose the Irish Stew which was awesome. Dessert this time was a Black Forrest Trifle - OMG this was good and again very boozy.Give this place a try you will love it.Show less

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Evening
Review: Coco's over the years has been established at various locations but has been in its present location I believe over 4 years. It is a good 3 years since my last visit and nothing has really changed. Still the same great food and ambience. It is run by Steve a large strapping Irishman who is the chef and his tiny Chinese wife Coco along with her front of house staff.Steaks are very popular and always praised for there tenderness. I had fish with some mashed potatoes and roasted vegetables. Again delicious. Another house favourite is Chicken Cordon bleu and the ubitious Irish Stew is very popular. I would recommend you give it a try. Just ask any taxi driver and they will take you there. Show less

Author: Tracy C
Title: Really good food
Review: Only had chance to visit once during my stay, really good food served hot.  I had the chicken and mushroom pastry, a large vol uv vent packed full. Large portions served here.

Author: jaxx2410
Title: Beef Wellington first class
Review: Great atmosphere great service great food. I would highly recommend the Beef Wellington, steaks are also best I've had on the island. You have to pre order the beef Wellington 24 hours in advance thought I better mention that 😁

Author: tonycoo
Title: Wonderful
Review: Excellent food,amazing home made ice cream,great service, very reasonable prices.Highly recommended.Thankyou CoCo's.

Author: Daniaist_93
Title: Great food!
Review:
Great European food
Very clean and tasty, nice staff
It’s owned by a family so it is small and kinda cosy
Loved it there, i hope i can go for another time

Author: Kamil_Basheer
Title: Great european taste western dining
Review: DIning in cocs was truly a great experience. The chef Steven was so welcoming, always greet with a smile and the food he prepares was simply delicious. Price is also affordable as one might expect it to be higher with the plate that he serves (big portion. The Chicken Cordon Bleu was the best ive tasted anywhere for a long time. Thx steven ure the man Show less

Author: GrahamStephensPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Out of the way place
Review: You need to keep your eyes peeled to spot the sign on the main road that passes this place. But once you find it there is plenty of car parking and a warm welcome. However I recommend a Grabcar as you wont want to drive after a visit to this place. The Sunday Roast seems to be the primary attraction and by 8pm the restaurant was full, with mostly British long stay expats, retirees and tourists. The menu is very short and only one red and one white wine choice (plus beer and spirits) is offered but the place is amazing value - even for duty-free Langkawi with a bottle of very drinkable Chilean Tocornal for just RM 45 Nett. There are no starters offered. The roast beef was superb, one of the best in Asia, and the chef can do a very respectable crisp yorkshire pudding and roast potatoes. We followed it with rum and raisin ice cream as the desert choices were mainly just bakery items. Not sure about the "Irish"reference as this place is pure English pub grub done very well. Service is brisk and courteous. But beware, they don't take credit cards. The place only opens at 5.00pm and closes by 10.00pm (closed Wednesdays) so your Sunday Roast treat is an evening meal, not a lunch. But it's highly recommended for westerners who are tired of asian food or tourist pizza joints.Show less

Author: agaig_partdeuxchester
Title: WHAT AN AMAZING LITTLE PLACE
Review: We had a lovely meal there a couple of nights back, everything was cooked to perfection. I had the best Black Forrest trifle ever. Coffee was superb, just so sorry that we could not go there again, a little gem of a place. No wonder everyone is raving about the place.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Once again, excellent food.
Review: During our three week holiday to Langkawi we again migrated from the hotel to Coco's Bistro for it is like a magnet to us.Excellent food, excellent friendly staff and very reasonable prices make this one of our favourite restaurants throughout the Far East.Other travellers have mentioned many times about the Sunday Roast Dinner and we add to the chorus of compliments. It is a must do for anyone visiting Langkawi.Additionally try the Irish Stew for that is in a class of it's own hence over one million have been sold.We greatly look forward to our next visit to the one and only Coco's.Show less

Author: shauwy
Title: Comfort food
Review: After a week of Malaysian food, we needed a change and came to Coco’s. very simple menu - just classic western food but dishes are well cooked. We had the steak, 49RM and it came with salad and potato. Nicely cooked and at reasonable price.

Author: Educat2018Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: We took some friends from overseas
Review: We all enjoyed really good rib-eye steaks, three with Steve's special pepper sauce and one with a delicious mushroom sauce. Excellent french fries and delicious fresh green salad complimented our meals. The verdict was a unanimous thumbs up! There was a heavy thunderstorm during our meal and although we were sitting outside enjoying the frog chorus, we were able to relocate quickly and easily under cover. Well priced wine, cold beer and excellent service makes Coco's one of our favorite restaurants close to home!Show less

Author: Cam H
Title: Great garden setting for a romantic dinner
Review: We had the ribeye steak and chicken cordon bleu and were very pleased.  Restaurant is tucked away from the Main Street, a quiet garden retreat.

Author: aaronv16
Title: Delicious food and good service
Review:
We came to Coco's for dinner and ordered the steak and the roast beef. Both of the dishes were very delicious. The service is fast and friendly. 
We really recommend this restaurant to anyone who is looking for some good British and Australian food.

Author: xclaudiamoreirax
Title: Super attentive staff!
Review: I went to Coco’s Bistro for Sunday dinner. They were very accommodation making some special changes for me from the menu. Lovely food and great staff. Great decor too. Great place to spend a nice evening with friends and family.

Author: Mac808Penang, Malaysia
Title: Yum
Review: My husband and I went here for dinner tonight. What a beautiful surprise set off a main road. Everything was great - the setting, the ambience, the pleasant staff, the prices and most of all the food. My husband had the chicken cordon bleu and I had the chicken & mushroom thermidor. Both were delicious, generous portions, beautifully presented and reasonably priced. This place is a definite "come back to" place for us.Show less

Author: Peter F
Title: Superb Sunday Roast Beef
Review: This restaurant offers a great value tender Roast Beef meal on Sundays making this a possibly welcome change from Asian food. Service is friendly and professional. This is definitely a restaurant I would visit again.

Author: beppef59
Title: very good restaurant
Review: we eat in this place several time and is always good, consistent and with friendly staff. one of the best in Langkawi

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Simply the best.
Review: Repeatedly visited Coco's for dinner during our three week holiday in Langkawi as it is our favourite restaurant.First class, excellent food at sensible prices served by friendly staff. On my husbands birthday we took five guests with us and without hesitation each one could not speak more highly of Coco's.As mentioned by other travelers, the Sunday Roast is superb and not to be missed.We certainly will be visiting Coco's on our next holiday in Langkawi.Footnote :- My husband was disappointed he missed being the one millionth consumer of the famous Irish Stew by only one place !!Show less

Author: katieNLincs123
Title: Sunday roast
Review: Came here and had a sunday roast (missing home and english food) ordered beef. It was delicious. Fast ands excellent service. Dessert was great too. Going back next sunday.

Author: davidwplaird
Title: Go there for Sunday Roast
Review: Good European food. The staff are always very welcoming and the Sunday Roast is always good. I also like the Bangers and Mash and I believe that Steve makes the bangers himself.

Author: 116dave
Title: Best steaks on the Island
Review: Spent 5 weeks on Langkawi, we visited Coco`s several times and the Steaks were the high light. See you next year.

Author: DaniPrice1980Wolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning!
Review: We were recommended this place by a lovely local lady and, man, we were not disappointed!! At first sight the place looks gorgeous, and we were seen to immediately. Try the steak, it was cooked to perfection and melted in my mouth. My mother-in-law had the fish, best she had tried in Malaysia. Staff were lovely, can't praise the place enough. Finished off the meal with hand made black Forrest gateaux. We were so impressed we sent a beer to the chef!Highly recommend!! Show less

Author: TwoLostAmericansJersey City, New Jersey
Title: Great Roast Dinner
Review: Wow. We went here on a Sunday with some local friends and we were blown away by the tender roast chicken with all the trimmings. Finally we understand why all our British friends get so excited about "Sunday roast." If you're on the island and craving perfectly cooked western home cooking, go to Coco's. Want more recommendations? Please stop by our blog: twolostamericans.com Show less

Author: RawtalentIsle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: 3 visits this year.
Review: Love Coco's. The garden setting, the pond, the lighting. Food is still wonderful. The roast beef is still superb. I had the rib-eye on our second visit and it was melt in the mouth.The place is packed on a Sunday, so you should try and book.Show less

Author: oarydpanama city
Title: Nearly there
Review: Having been relatively disappointed with the offerings of the restaurants of Langkawi this was a pleasant surprise. I ordered the steak and also chose the garlic bread and onion rings to go with it. Well cooked steak, lovely pepper sauce and even the dressing on the salad was bang on.However if you have a good appetite order lots, twelve chips!!!!! . I might look like I need a diet but I am not on one.On saying that its a nice setting, attentive staff and relatively good value for money.In comparison to the restaurants on Cenangs main drag it wins hands over heels.Try.Show less

Author: R1207EDkarens
Title: My birthday dinner
Review: Visiting family in Langkawi from Perth Australia preordered the Beef Wellington and it was by far the best meal I’ve had in forever.  Amazing service and fabulous food,  we will be back.  Put it on your must do list.

Author: Jason E
Title: my vegan experience
Review: it would be unfair to criticise on the basis that there was not much for vegans on the menu as this is not a vegan restaurant. the manager made the effort to discuss with me what i would like and what he could prepare and in the end i had a very enjoyable potato and veg dish. my friends said the fish was the best they had eaten in langkawi - they live here and so should know! nice al fesco setting also. can recommend.Show less

Author: selinachong8Ampang, Malaysia
Title: A must visit in Langkawi!
Review: I arrived there coincidentally on their Sunday Roast day. I've heard so much from my expatriate friend and so decided to hop over for dinner. It was an unforgettable experience. Their roast beef with hot Yorkshire pudding was better than in England. The chilled sirloin melts in your mouth served with horseradish and delicious brown sauce...was the best I've tasted. It makes me want to look forward to the next Sunday. You have a choice of Irish lamb stew or other personally cooked meal by their Irish chef. It's a gem and a must visit when you are in Langkawi..an iconic place like Pak Malau nasi Dagang. No where in KL can I find such a juicy and delightful roast beef. Enclosed is their menu and pictures of my meal.Show less

Author: richard b
Title: Authentic, home cooked Western food
Review: I may be biased because I'm a regular here, but the Sunday roast is by far the best I've found in Malaysia. Ask Steve about the home made deserts too, they're not always on the menu!

Author: meowleng92Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food
Review: No doubt, it has excellent taste of food. 5 of us ordered different meals and we enjoyed it to the max. However, the place is full of mosquito and insect, maybe we are sitting outside near to the grass and water area.But, if focus only the food, you will need to have a try.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Top class in every respect.
Review: We once again went to Coco's Bistro during our latest holiday to Langkawi visiting on a number of occasions by ourselves and with friends.This Bistro is our favourite eating place and is simply unbeatable. The food, the service, the quiet setting, it has everything including the World Famous Irish Stew which my husband certainly hopes to take the honour of being the one millionth person to place an order for.Simply Excellent, simply Outstanding, both with capital letters. We so look forward to our next series of visits and learning of the new ice cream flavours.Show less

Author: ChikStaaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, lovely location, friendly staff, what more could you want?
Review: This is probably my favourite restaurant in Langkawi, so we've been here a lot over the years.The food is excellent (I think we've tried almost all of it!), reasonably priced and good size portions. It has a really nice ambience in a garden setting with friendly staff.It's a bit off the beaten track but we'll worth the discovery.Show less

Author: sdhilawsingapore
Title: Tasty food in an offbeat location
Review: We went with a local friend and found the food very decent. The restaurant is run by an Irishman and the he does the Irish stew great credit - a must have ! It's located in a house off the Ulu Melaka junction - with it's cosy outdoor dining. Abit hard to find so look out for the small sign. The grilled fish was also excellent although we found the chicken cordon-blue abit over cooked and rough. Show less

Author: TamaraB2726
Title: A must go!
Review:
Coco's bistro has it all.. nice, friendly staff, great, cozy location and amazing food!! 
The mix of these three things makes it the best restaurant in langkawi!

Author: FeonsN
Title: Nice & Friendly Restaurant
Review: Went there yesterday. We order the cottage pie & grilled chicken. The foods is nice & service good!!! We will come again to taste the others food.

Author: syashak2017
Title: Good
Review: Went there with my friends. Food excellent, service tip top... I'm so satisfied.. The owner,staff are friendly..

Author: PETER LLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: LOBSTER THERMIDOR
Review: I live in Langkawi and I eat at COCO's quite regularly. The food is always really tasty and beautifully cooked.I arranged a party of fourteen locals and Steve prepared a Lobster Dinner with Prawn Bisque as a starter and Lobster Thermidor as the main course with Creme Brulee for desert. What a magnificent meal right up there with the best in Langkaw!Everybody was full of praise and well done Steve and Coco! Peter LaymanShow less

Author: VTonksCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Best Irish stew
Review: This place is amazing. The Irish stew blew us away. The amount of lamb was overwhelming, it was delicious! We ended up tipping over 30rm because we were so happy!If you're in langkawi and you need a hearty meal. Go here. Don't miss it, you won't regret it. Thank you chef!Show less

Author: D0des10Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Sunday Roast
Review: If you get fed up with noodles and rice, this is the place to go. Sunday roast beef was excellent - beef cooked to order, yorkshire puds, roast potatoes etc etc - very tasty. Unfortunately no room left for dessert - but as they passed the table, they looked equally goodShow less

Author: 0Jools0Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Little gem!
Review: Well worth heading out of the main resorts to find this lovely place in a pretty, peaceful garden setting.Steve & Coco are great hosts, the staff are friendly and welcoming, the service excellent and the food so tasty.We dined here 3 times and all the meals were impressive, we cleared our plates every time. The steak was cooked to perfection, bangers and mash yummy and best of all the delicious Irish stew, all washed down with ice cold beers. Sadly we missed the Sunday roast which we hear is very popular but we will definitely be back.Thanks Steve & Coco, glad we found you.Show less

Author: 217geraldinesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Tropical Hideway
Review: Nestled amongst cool lush tropical garden. We were there for Davali night. Easy long bar, easy staff, good food. Sunday nights is the" Roast Night". Drop in for drink, share a plate. But at sunset watch out for the Mosquitos as per usual.A pleasant experience with that special Tropical Island feel that often is missing here.Show less

Author: SweehoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pleasantly surprised!
Review: Given the number of good reviews this bistro had garnered, I undoubtedly had high expectations before the visit. Much to my amazement, the food was indeed very good and authentic. In particular, the bangers and mash were perfectly done. The Irish stew is another recommended dish. I can't wait to visit this place again! Show less

Author: Ballsy66York, United Kingdom
Title: Best food on the island
Review: Went to Coco's with friends from the island, so glad we did. We went to get some good proper English food, not a Sunday so Cottage pie was the favourite, that's what I was going for until the mention of a "Special" Beef Rangdan (I hope that is spelt correctly) so that's what I went for and I was not disappointed lots of succulent tender beef in a wonderful flavoured, not hot sauce/curry. I sampled the cottage pie which was fabulous too. We are going back today to try the highly recommend Sunday roast. Steve and Coco well done and thank you for your hospitality, great surroundings and amazing food.Show less

Author: Sage2724
Title: Fantastic
