Review: We have only been to Cocos for Sunday roast dinner so cannot comment on other meals. The Sunday roast is sensational !! Service is friendly and welcoming, drinks well priced, great atmosphere sitting outside amongst the garden. We love it .

Author: josd704Vessem, The Netherlands
Title: Diner with family
Review: The restaurant is slightly hidden and might be difficult to find. The location is great and it really great for a family diner. The food was good but not great. So if you would like to get a European like diner for a change this could be a good option. Show less

Author: swanstonanthonyPhuket, Thailand
Title: Very different and very, very good
Review: Eight of us booked for the Sunday Roast. (Booking essential for the roast on Sunday's). The service was efficient and friendly and Coco came along to check that everything was OK while husband Steve worked the kitchen. The roast beef (big portions) was served to order, some rare, some medium and some well done and accompanied by a huge Yorkshire pudding. Excellent chicken with stuffing and masses of good veg including Champ, and Irish potato delicacy.This is a top class affordable restaurant and not to be missed if you are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: linapenn
Title: Nice & Natural Bistro
Review: Nice & Natural Bistro , kind & friendly staff . Lightning & environment very comfortable for business ,couple , friends meeting . Enjoy meet up with my old friend in coco's Bistro !

Author: TsuyokiTokyo Prefecture, Japan
Title: Good dinner!
Review: Picked this restaurant from the list of restaurants in langkawi on tripadvisor because it is located near the hotel we stayed though it was a bit hard to find. We came late when they almost closed so some items of the menu were not available. Friendly Irish owner, nice staffs, good food (except for the sauted potato). We enjoyed our dinner with a few beers. Only 1 thing to consider, mosquitos.Show less

Author: janeyk419South Tangerang, Indonesia
Title: Fantastic roast in lovely setting
Review: We were staying at the Box Chalet, less than 2km down the road, otherwise we might not have visited this little gem of a restaurant as it is away from the main tourist hubs of the island and quite well tucked away/hidden.So glad that we did pay a visit. The food was great: we both had the roast chicken to which we added a Yorkshire pudding and we were delighted with what we got. Big portions of perfectly cooked chicken served with good veg, roast potatoes and mash (the mash was actually champ with scallions which was a real treat for me as a Northern Irish woman!!) and a big boat of gravy. There was nothing on my plate that I wasn't thoroughly pleased with!The menu, particularly on Sunday, is brief, significantly shorter than the "do anything" approach of so many other places I've been to on the island. I have no problems with that though as it means that the standard is high and what is served is great quality. I rarely have the chance to have a good old fashioned roast just like home and this was a pure delight. Thank you Coco's Bistro - we will be back!Show less

Author: whateveriwan
Title: Delicious
Review: Not bluffing... it's really great!! I had a chicken schnitzel cost RM 25 and it's really satisfying and worth it ... the bistro also gives a calming and relaxing atmosphere... me and my friends are definitely having a good time there...

Author: swim_jessKuching, Malaysia
Title: Sunday Roast & Irish Stew
Review: Came here after reading the rave reviews on Tripadvisor and it did not fail us. We had the Sunday Roast and the Irish Stew - both were vert tasty and delicious. We were here on a Sunday night and the place was packed. There are many Europeans dining here during our visit - which also means the food must remind them of home.The only downside is that it is not in any distance from the main touristy place, so you will either need to have a car or take a taxi and make sure you are able to take a taxi back to where you want to go next.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Yet again - excellent.
Review: Went to Coco's repeatedly on my last holiday which I have just returned from.Truly first class food with the Irish Stew and Sunday Roast tying for first place in my estimation. This is a restaurant I really enjoy and look forward greatly to visiting many, many more times in the future.Thanks to all the staff.Show less

Author: nedwood8you2Greater London, United Kingdom
Title: Another find, you only find these place by word of mouth
Review: You only find these place by word of mouth. Lovely restaurant just of the main carriage way via the Airport you would never find it if you drove taxi 25 Ringgit £5 great variety of food lovely people. Shame we didnt have time to go the second time. Very reasonable to a point we had to check the bill.Show less

Author: Tim G
Title: Good food.
Review: It is a nice restaurant with good staff and nice food. Especially when you are English and miss your own food it is a good place to have dinner.

Author: bmw740il2015
Title: Sunday Roast
Review: Well beyond my expectations . A proper English roast beef right down to the gravy and Yorkshire pudding .

Author: Max v
Title: Best food we had in Langkawi!
Review: After a day of adventure with one of our new found local friend he showed us this place that is friend was chef on.At first we tough he was just taking us here to support his friend, but the food here was really amazing!The menu is small, but that's a good sign meaning the food they actually serve is very good. All three of us ordered the chicken cordon blue with 3 cheeses with mashed potatoes and all i can say is that it was the best food experience we had in Langkawi.The restaurant itself gives a very calm and friendly atmosphere, the prices was average, about 40 RM but the quality made it worth it several times over!Show less

Author: drsashi74Alor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Where everybody knows your name....
Review: I live and work on the island of Langkawi and during my time here, I have become a regular at Coco s Bistro. For those of you visiting Langkawi, Coco s offers great food in a cozy, relaxed atmosphere. Set in a converted bungalow far away from the congestion of the popular tourist spots on the island, owners Connie and Steve serve up great western fare 6 days a week ( they re closed on Wednesdays). Portions are sizeable, service is friendly and draught Guinness goes for 10 Rinngit a pint...what more could you ask for?? No wonder that Coco s is a favourite haunt of a lot of expats and locals alike.Show less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Back to Home Again!!
Review: This is one of our favorite hang out and we will drop by whenever we are here in Langkawi, 2 nights in a row. Coco and Steve are great host as usual, food portions are huge and filling, of course taste great. If any of you looking for a Irish Yoga Master, look for Steve whom is doing some yoga classes . Will come back next year. :-)Show less

Author: richardc0eAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Great British/Irish Food
Review: What a great little restaurant. The roast Beef was sensational. Easily the best roast beef I have ever had. The roast chicken was also terrific. And we washed it all down with pints of ice-cold Guinness. Definitely a must-do when you go to Langkawi. The chef is certainly top class, and the prices very reasonable.Show less

Author: 757marcm
Title: Great Sunday lunch
Review: Went here this evening for a Sunday lunch after reading the reviews, and I must say they were right. The Sunday lunch was great, with a super relaxed atmosphere, and the Guinness was also very good. My girlfriend said the chocolate brownie was really good as well.We asked them to order us a taxi, and there was a mix up, so we ended up drinking with the owners and there friends who were great people, and wouldn't accept any money for our drinks. What kind and friendly people, thanks for making us feel so welcome. Show less

Author: carvenhperth
Title: Good old British or Irish food
Review: If you've been travelling around in Asia for too long and longing for some good old British or Irish food. This is the place for you. Nice settings as it was relaxing and easy going. We had the Irish Stew and the Chicken Cordon Bleu with 3 cheese. Both meal were yummy and at affordable price. The mash potato was really good! Gotta trust an Irish chef when it comes to mash potato! The side veges served on the cordon bleu was really tasty too. Cheap beer too! Definitely recommend if you need a break from rice, chillies and spices. Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent - yet again.
Review: During our latest four week holiday in Langkawi, we went to Coco's on a number of occasions.The Sunday Roast is certainly not to be missed as is the World Famous Irish Stew.The Dinner Party (previously commented on) was an outstanding evening, lots of people, perfect service, superb food, great entertainment.Coco's is top class in every respect and not to be missed.Show less

Author: premselviLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: PERFECT DINNER PARTY ..8TH FEB 2016
Review: What a great evening! For me and my family, that was a perfect dinner party ever. It’s our pleasure to be a part of your dinner party. We had so much fun. I appreciate your kindness for allowing us to join that dinner party.Everything was simply outstanding ,perfect, and fun. I want you to know that we enjoyed it a lot.. I know it’s not easy and I want to thank you and Steve for your time and effort. Thank you! Prem & SelviShow less

Author: Sage2724Australia
Title: Great, esp for Sunday Roast
Review: We have not been to Cocos for 12 months. It is a great restaurant and the new setting is so lovely. We went for Sunday roast dinner with a group of friends and is was sensational. It is great to have some western food from time to time and certainly Coco's is a perfect restaurant for this. It was very busy but the staff coped very well. Fresh juices are delicious. Roast was cooked to perfection and with all the right trimmings. Show less

Author: Yau Kyn C
Title: Good for friends n family gatherings
Review: Garden-like Atmosphere is good 😍😍👍👍 pleasant, polite waiter n waitress. The chef is courteous n establishes good relationship with the diners esp the repeat customers.

Author: karienj_12Ibiza, Spain
Title: Not so tasty
Review: The location is okay but there is not much flavor in the food. I shared a salad and the fish and chips. Maybe not the best choice. In the salad there was too much mayonnaise and the battery of the fish was without any taste. Would not come back here. Show less

Author: travellingKitch
Title: Tasty for English food
Review: The food was very nice, I would say that it's the same standard as a good pub in the UK! Good portion sizes, little bit in the middle of nowhere but sweet venue.

Author: monistorzMelbourne, Australia
Title: Coco HO HO
Review: Coco HO HO (Ho means good in Hokkien, Chinese local dialect spoken widely in Langkawi). I had two meals there and Steve, an Irishman, ex chef in the QE2, has not lost his touch since 2006 when I first met him & ate his fish and chips at Debbie's Bar which he owned at that time. Now at Coco (name of his partner) his meals are quintessentially British - Irish stew, fish & chips, cordon bleu chicken breast, steak, and above all, his wonderful mash. No one makes mash potatoes like Steve at Coco's Bistro in Langkawi. Trust an Irishman to do that well! Prices are incredibly reasonable for the quality and quantity of the dishes. Not to mention the service and ambience of the place: cool, balmy night under big trees, eating an Irish stew, is an experience not to be missed in languid Langkawi.Show less

Author: Stephen F
Title: Simply delicious.
Review: Want a real treat? Home away from home comfort food? Honest, fresh and delicious. A must try when a plate of fried noodles or fried rice is just not going to cut it.

Author: LangkawiD
Title: ***Great Western Food*******
Review: Beautiful setting, casual and rustic. Coco and Steve, make you feel very welcome and at home. Wide range of drinks, alcoholic and non alcoholic......Great menu with a wide range of loveable Western Dishes.

Author: Rwillcardiff
Title: Food food with great prices
Review: After 2 weeks of Asian food coco's was a real find. Sunday eve ,beef with Yorkshire pud followed by choc profiteroles! Called again and had fish/chips mushy peas. Well worth a visit .

Author: 1luvfoodkuala lumpur
Title: Fantastic Sunday roast
Review: Great surrounding, quiet location along the highway. Plenty of choices on the menu. Great chef and crew. Should try the steak but the Yorkshire pudding & the roast beef every Sunday is a favourite among the locals and the expat community. Recommended if you like beef n Guinness on tap.Show less

Author: zahairi
Title: Food that worth the money, time & energy
Review: Great food, nice ambience, friendly service. People who visited langkawi & did not try the food here miss a gem in thier vacation

Author: adriano dNaples, Italy
Title: Good European-Irish food + Nice atmosphere
Review: Good European-Irish food: The chef and co-owner is a very friendly Irish guy; after dinner we staid with him drinking a Guinness pint at Coco's Bar, he told us that his goal is to offer simple european dishes...and this, after having 20 days of delicious Asian food, was extremely appreciated!Everything was very goooooood, with affordable prices :)The atmosphere is really cool, there is a nice and relaxing mini garden with a small fountain.Is not that easy to spot. Once there you can easly park your car/scooter for free.Recommended.Show less

Author: civic2923
Title: Nice and great bistro at langkawi
Review: Food was great.price are average not so expensive.the bistro are easy to find and is near to airport.

Author: Courtney M
Title: Best  roast!
Review: Cocos is the only place in Asia I've  been able to find a traditional  Sunday  roast and its bang on! Love it!!

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: First class food.
Review: Coco and Steve have set yet another high standard at their relatively new location. The food is excellent, likewise the service, all at a sensible price. The Irish Stew is superb and, by all accounts, the one millionth bowl of it was sold during our visit.If in Langkawi on a Sunday, book early for the Sunday Roast Dinner to avoid disappointment.A Bistro NOT to be missed.Show less

Author: nomadskKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Great food!!!
Review: Coco n Steve are so passionate about their Bistro can be seen n felt from d moment you walk in, dine n leave..They have a small limited menu as Steve overseas each order dished out personally..Food is nothing but perfection.The earlier venue was more arty n cute n this is more open n no aircon too..Its a must visit place...Show less

Author: Venice0990
Title: Great food in holiday paradise
Review: We are very pleased with Irish lamb stew and cottage pie served at its best. Best one we ever tasted as claimed by my 9 years old girl. Great value too. Will definitely come back again.

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: a home and family run restaurant
Review: I deleted my previous review because is not relevant anymore as they have move to a new location and no longer attached to a guest house where you could stay there. Overall if you want to try some western food made by Irish Chef Steven the owner itself and Coco, this is the place you must not miss!! I personally recommend the Irish Lamb stew, they have a bar counter now and you could drink all night long and watching the TV too, last call at 10 if I am not mistaken.Show less

Author: Christopher_Chandler
Title: Mangoes vs Coco's
Review: After eating at mangoes restaurant last night we got talking to some local expats who recommend Coco's. I love these tips. I must say the garlic bread was the best I've had in Langkawi ( sorry Mangoes), and the chicken cordon bleu I had was superb! Dessert was good but the pav at mangoes wins hands down. If I had more time in Langkawi I'd definitely return , lovely staff and food. Big thumbs up! But mangoes by a nose.Show less

Author: danewtlKlang, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Good Steak
Review: Had a ribeye and told the boss I love it middle rare whilst the external was slightly well done. The Steak came up to my expectation and quite happy about the food.The location is alright and the restaurant is a bungalow with beautiful and simple settings. A nice place to have a cosy dinner outing with family or friends. The food in my opinion is very reasonable as my experience with other food outlet made me conclude that Langkawi restaurant is really expensive.However, thought a few things could be improved. First of all, the lights are a little to romantic ie. too dim. And mosquito and insects are a bother. Overall, still think this is a excellent place and will come back one dayShow less

Author: RRSNSingapore
Title: Great food!
Review: We have a bit difficulty in finding the place because it cant be found in GPS. We have called them to ask for directions. For the food, it is heavenly. We enjoyed our anniversary dinner. We ordered Rib eye and chicken cordon bleu. Both is superb! Worthy to visit and reasonable prices.Show less

Author: Penny G
Title: Excellent Bistro.
Review:
Once again such a pleasure to visit and eat at.
First class food at sensible prices. Coco and Steve plus the excellent staff are doing a superb job in their new location.
The Irish Stew is NOT to be missed.

Author: Steady
Title: Brilliant Food
Review:
Really enjoyed the food at this restaurant, which is very European cooking.
I had the chicken kiev which was filled with three cheeses, and it was delicious.  The mashed potatoes were also great after numerous meals of rice or noodles.
Will certainly visit here again.

Author: keithhQ4662AL
Title: Good home cooked European fare
Review: We enjoyed the Sunday Roast Dinner which was really enjoyable but would have been better if some green vegetables had also been served. One of our group selected the grilled fish and said it was beautiful.

Author: Gusty50Nakhon Si Thammarat, Thailand
Title: Outstanding Value.
Review: Outstanding value for money, good atmosphere and Steve the Owner/chef was a good host.Yes some will say not in the class off Fine dining, not Bold or innovative, but this is not a Michelin star restaurant. what it offers is good home cooked food with all the trimmings. On tap beer is also a bonus.Show less

Author: flashman974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Traditional roast
Review: Situated on the main highway, plenty of parking in a quiet area set back. The hostess and staff are friendly. We went there for the traditional Sunday roast, recommended by friends. Beef roast cooked to perfection for me, accompanied by roasted carrots, potatoes, and of course, Yorkshire pudding. Nice apple pie for dessert finished up a wonderful meal.Show less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Feels Like Home!
Review: This was my first visit to their new place since they moved from Kuala Teriang. Very cozy place and feels just like home with Steve and Coco and their friendly staff. Ample of parking space and more seats available. Excellent food as usual and very generous portions. We will be back , hopefully next year - Raymond, Cheryl and Russell.Show less

Author: alang763Sydney, Australia
Title: does not deserve No 1
Review: The number one restaurant anywhere should be bold, innovative and creating taste sensations. Cocos do not do this. So I guess it is more of a function of who posts to tripadvisor that makes a restaurant that serves well prepared but standard western fare at a cheap price the No 1 restaurant on an island teeming with zesty food in a variety of styles and cultures.Ordered rare rib eye steak and got rare scotch fillet cooked well. She had a chicken thermidore which was also well cooked and tasty.It is also ages since I had a pint of Guinness for $A3.50!!! So I had two!!The menu is small, there are only mains and a couple of desserts.The apple pie got leathered in the microwave.So. ... It is the place to go if you want reliable and cheap western food served well in a friendly atmosphere.But Langkawis number one? Definitely not.Show less

Author: Jul1ian2Stuttgart, Germany
Title: Finally found it!
Review: My girlfriend and me had dinner at coco's. It was a bit hard to find since they moved. So I try to help you with this link: http://goo.gl/maps/3aQuqIt's a nice place with a little lake. We were welcomed very friendly. We ordered chicken and fish, which both were good tasting. A little disappointment was that both came with mushed potatoes and carotte mush. So no diversity. The desert from the day was a brownie with ice cream. Very nice.With two glasses of wine and a water we paid 85 MRT. Thank you for this nice evening.Show less

Author: satusampoLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: New location, still great food and friendly service!
Review: I visited "the new" Cocos with my friends. I've always loved their food but this time I visited Cocos with my friends and one of them is an owner of three restaurants. He (and his family) was of course satisfied. We had steaks and fish. It's unbelievable they can serve this high quality food with a fraction of the prices in Europe. The garden setting is nice and there is enough parking space. It might be a good idea to book a table beforehand because they seem to have a lot of customers (many of them expats).Show less

Author: Sathiyananthan
Title: Lovely place, decently priced
Review: Coco and Steve are an amazing couple who will make you feel at home right away.Have been a regular stop each time I've been back to Langkawi.Most locals and tourist have been there since they started their charming setup in Kuala Teriang, then Laguna and now in Padang Mat Sirat.The food is fabulously simple but abundant in taste and feel. Bangers and mash is a must try.Ask Steve for his baked Alaska to top off a nice dinner!Show less

Author: reg_butlerLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Coco's Bistro is well worth a visit
Review: Went with a friend a few days ago. Actually we had tried to eat there a week before but it is so popular that we could not get a table, so this time reserved one.It has a nice setting with most tables inside but some out in the pleasant garden.They have a very good and varied menu. We both opted for the Grilled Seabass which was an excellent choice. A good sized cut and so succulent and tasty. Nice choice of Stir Fried Veggies with Mashed Potato to go with it.Only downside on this great place is that it is quite a run out on the road to the airport from Kuah, but well worth the effort.Show less

Author: Rawtalent
Title: Sunday Roast
Review: Tried the Sunday Roast. Melt in the mouth rare roast beef, absolutely beautiful. Served with Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes and vegetables, plenty of gravy on the side. Washed down with a glass or two of wine. Wonderful.

Author: rustytooMansfield Woodhouse, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Excellent food. We went on a Sunday night and had roast beef. Wonderful comfort food. The only problem was that we had the last table available near to the bar where the owner sat chain smoking, As a non smoker I found that very bad especially while eating.Would of course go again but not at that table.It is not an easy place to find even our taxis driver had difficulties getting there but at least we now know where it isShow less

Author: LondonRalph
Title: Best restaurant so far in langkawi
Review: Just finished an excellent meal of roast beef with all the trimmings!  Lovely red wine inexpensive. Worth the taxi ride from villa molek.  Will return👍😀

Author: Brenda HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice Location
Review: Went there tonight 27th Feb with friends that live here, the food was excellent a nice menu and the prices were so so reasonable- it's a but difficult to find off the main road but a very rustic ambiance would definitely go again - one of the nicest restaurants in LangkawiShow less

Author: justaname10Singapore, Singapore
Title: A Real Home Feel
Review: I been to coco's bistro one time when they were still at the Laguna. After they moved to Kedawang(I guess it belong to that area), I attended the opening party and I like the place so much. It like a big house at the corner of traffic light, if you didn't see carefully, you might miss the place. They are the one of the place who serve Guinness draught!! (In Langkawi only two places serve Guinness draught). They grilled salmon also excellent! For those who like to enjoy talk, fresh cold beer, should come to coco.. The owner also very friendly..Show less

Author: 530deborah
Title: MUST try!!!
Review: amazing, fantastic and superb :) this is the best western restaurant....totally fell in love with the food....u hav not visited langkawi if u did not eat here...

Author: balloons142_13
Title: Amazing Roast Beef Dinner
Review: Have just had an amazing Roast Beef Dinner here, the full works, Yorkshire Pudding, and lovely Gravy, thank you , never thought I would have this on Langkawi

Author: Rawtalent
Title: Superb steaks
Review: This is the best restaurant on Langkawi for western food. The steaks are divine,cooked perfectly and the accompanying sauces delicious. Great value for money and the new garden location is lovely. Well done Steve and Coco.

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Coco's new location.
Review: This was our first visit to the new Coco's location which we think is totally in keeping with the theme Coco and Steve have sought to bring to their restaurant. It certainly is not to be missed.Excellent food with a special mention of the Sunday Roast Dinner, prior booking is essential to avoid disappointment.The Irish Stew is outstanding and it is only a matter of time until the magic figure of one million having been consumed becomes reality.We greatly look forward to our next holiday and visiting Coco's for yet another first class meal.Show less

Author: Canterbury808Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Cool Coco's
Review: Love its new garden setting with huge car park. Very private. Coco's is indeed the place to dine if one craved for traditional English home-cooked meals. We thoroughly enjoyed Bangers and Mashed, Cottage Pie and its Sunday roast. Every time we went there the place was busy, one evening we had to wait for almost an hour for our meals but its worth the wait!. Reservation is recommended. Coco's only open fro 5pm onwards. Highly recommended. Will definitely be back...Show less

Author: scottcoates73Bangkok
Title: The place to eat on Langkawi
Review: While searching for places to enjoy Guinness Draught on Langkawi I came upon Coco's online. The reviews were glowing to say the least, mostly about the food, and I was a bit suspicious. Could it be that good?We sought out their new location (most online reviews mention the old address), set off hungry and enjoyed immensely. One thing I dislike about most beach vacations is that the food is over-priced, but more importantly, just not often any good. Coco's has figured out the solution.The menu is just the right size, with and handful of western staples/favorites, all at very reasonable prices, and they taste great. The chef Steve pretty much said the same thing about the food/menu when he came out both nights to say 'hi' - he keeps it simples and delivers. Coco's sure does that!Coco herself is out front and a great host, always happy to make recommendations and it's a real feeling of eating at home here. Getting very tasty food, at extremely reasonable prices, and the least expensive Guinness Draught on the island is an incredible combination. Experience it!Show less

Author: wendy494Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but too busy
Review: On the main road from Chenang to Kuah. Not easy to find but worth the effort. The restaurant was busy (probably 50 people or more) Most people seemed to know each other so I suppose ex pats place.We had chicken liver pate and garlic bread to start. Ordered steak & kidney pie and 3 cheese chicken cordon bleu. After 5 mins were told steak & kidney pie has sold out - ok we order beef stroganoff. then 5 mins after that was told 3 cheese cordon bleu sold out - ok 1 cheese cordon bleu will do. Both when received were tasty.Waited so long for our 3rd drink that I went to the bar and bought it back to the table myself Other stuff on menu - fish & chips, irish stew, bangers & mash, cottage pie so not too much but all homely western food. My issue was that this restaurant needs to order enough food to ensure they have sufficient for the numbers of diners & get some more staff so service is betterPrice was good at 127 MYRShow less

Author: 997MichaelB997Brittany, France
Title: Fantastic meal
Review: This restaurant has relocated since our last visit and is now situated in a lovely garden setting but with indoor tables if required.A warm welcome from Coco and the rest of the staff were very friendly and efficient.Small menu but every dish is excellent. Difficult to know what to choose!This place is always busy so maybe an idea to book. Popular with ex-pat community.As it was Sunday, we had the roast dinner! So much meat and veg...and yorkshire pudding! Just like mother used to make! It was fantasic value.Will definitely go again.Show less

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Cosy, good quality food, great price and super friendly!
Review: This is probably one of our most liked restaurants as the new settings are really nice laid out in the garden and veranda. The quality of the food is truly good and the portions are of good size. The friendliness of the staff and owners is very warm and personal. Although it is a bit harder to find it is very much worth going there.Show less

Author: maureen rSingapore River, Singapore
Title: foody heaven
Review: Absolutely love this place.. Food very good, atmosphere excellent, Coco and Steve such wonderful hosts. Magical setting, nothing is too much for this excellent team. All of the staff are first class and do their jobs so well..I would advise anyone to try this bistro if looking for excellent freshly cooked western food.Show less

Author: Boromarl-1
Title: The new cocos
Review: The new cocos has wonderful outside seating and the same wonderful food also a great bar for drinks!

Author: Johnnie1948Clontarf, Australia
Title: If you want a bit of Western food in an island atmosphere
Review: Thus is a funny little place with an unusual menu. Totally Western with veal cordon blue, lamb shanks, fish and chips etc as well as pizzas!My family of eight really enjoyed the "undercover open air" restaurant. We were looked after very well. We requested that my starving grandsons be quickly fed as a priority. Done.Show less

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Deserves A Higher Ranking On TA !!
Review: It may be a wee bit trying for Coco's 'afficionados' to keep track of their favourite restaurant, from Kuala Teriang to.Laguna and now its current location but hopefully, this time the move is more or less permanent !!!Love its new garden setting. Beautiful lamp shades, handcrafted by Coco herself, hanging from its matured garden. Food is ever so delightful. I would rate their steaks higher than any of the restaurants in KL of equivalent standing (let's not even talk about Langkawi).I have been in and out of the island since 1994'ish and seen many Western restaurants come and go. Steve and his missus have indeed set a high standard for their nosh (and hospitality). P.s. They are currently away post-Christmas and, if I recall correctly, Coco's will reopen on the 4th of January, 2015. It's definitely worth the hike to seek out their new location !Show less

Author: ganesh vani a
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Amazing food, great company, beautiful location n atmosphere.. Coco n Steve are great hosts. Had a beautiful birthday celebration with friends of 20 pax n they catered to us flawlessly..

Author: Janeonland
Title: Coco's new bistro is great!
Review: Being a regular at Coco's for several years I awaited the new venue with anticipation. Wow! All the charm of the original but spacious,sophisticated bar area and of course Steve's excellent food and Coco's welcome.

Author: Philip GLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Coco's new location
Review: Coco's has been around now for quite a few years and have enjoyed a great reputation. They have recently relocated to a new place that fits perfectly their style of operation. The surroundings and atmosphere are really great and the service impecable.The food is top notch and reasonably priced. Their Sunday night special of roast beef is excellent.Ample off street parking is available.I heartily recommend it to all.Show less

Author: kateg207Nhulunbuy, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere food and service
Review: We recently visited the new restaurant and it's the best yet. The ambience is fantastic with a great little bar where you can have pre dinner drinks. The service is as efficient and friendly as ever. Try the cordon bleu with three cheeses. If you are looking for some good western food this is the place. This is where all the expats goShow less

Author: Dan TLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Restaurant
Review: I've lived in Langkawi for the last year and have dined at Steve and Coco's restaurants on numerous occasions, they have moved to a new location on the way to Kuah which is set in a lovely mature spacious garden they still offer the same menu as before which is very good comfort food if you miss the taste of home, they also have Guinness on tap which is my favourite. There is always a nice welcoming atmosphere and it is very popular with the expat community here. I would recommend this place to any of my friends or take them there for dinner.DanielShow less

Author: Robw1407Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Good food. Good price.
Review: The meals here are a good size. You will not go hungry. We had the lamb shanks and the Cajun chicken fajitas. Both were delicious. Service was quick and really helpful. They even organised a taxi to take us back to our hotel. The price was very reasonable. The only downside was that people are allowed to smoke in the restaurant. For a non smoker that is not great.Show less

Author: omar_ashqar_213Melbourne, Australia
Title: Same Title as the review below , Best rib eye... & Change of location
Review: My friends and I came to this place just after reading the review below saying this place has the a very good rib eye steak, well it wasn't good , it was perfect I ordered it meduim-well and I actually got it meduim-well and it tasted superb. Thumbs up to the cheif . We meet the owner and told her how we came here according to a review on trip advisor. Well we liked it so much we came the next day too, all three of us also ordered the rib eye steak again, this time we meet the other owner the husband, very friendly guy , thanked us for coming in again and gave me a small paper with the new location of the restaurant ,They were closing and opening there own place . So I told him I'll post the new location on trip advisor so check the pictures, Thanked me and we left.Show less

Author: Daryl CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best rib eye steak in town. a must try
Review: I came to this restaurant few months ago for two days straight. Although, its quite difficult to find this restaurant, its worth the visit. I tried the rib eye steak as recommended by the lady boss and it was one of the best i have ever tried. I went back to this same restaurant just for the rib eye steak. It was just so delicious. On my 2nd trip, i arrived there a little bit late which was after their opening hours. However, we were going back to KL and they will be closed the following day. We told the owner about how badly we really wanted to try his rib eye steak again. Without hesitation, the owner said i wouldnt let my customer leave Langkawi with remorse and regrets. So, he went to his kitchen and made us two sets. Thumbs up for both the owner and his wife for being so friendly towards up and double thumbs up for their food.Show less

Author: Rex_RossWestport, Ireland
Title: Great Sunday Roast!!!!
Review: Located at The Laguna, this Bistro was relocated from its previous location near Kuala Teriang. Second time around, the food is simply delicious! We had Roast Beef with Yorkshire pudding and Roast Chicken both served with creamy mashed potato and vegetables of the day, also a bowl of gravy! It was so good and nothing left on the plates!The place was full around 8pm with both holiday makers and local expatriates. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: solocalitraveler
Title: Hooray for "Western" Food
Review: After weeks in Malaysia, we came to this British pub on one of our last nights in Langkawi. We had a group of 8 and all of our meals were excellent. The mashed potatoes were a welcome treat after weeks of rice and noodle dishes. The service was typically Malay (slow, but polite) and we came on Hari Raya so it was totally dead. This place is a little hard to find, as it's buried at the back of the property, but it's worth looking for. Honestly, this was the only delicious "western" food I ate the entire time I was in Malaysia.Show less

Author: O L
Title: Elegant and delicious food, good atmosphere
Review: I just had my launch there, order grilled fish(mashed potato and fried vegetable as side and garnish ) 25 RM no service charge no tax, it was simply delicious. Silky mashed potato , tasty side and not to mention very affordable The only problem was that my fish was a little bit under-season , and the parking was closed , I could not find it easily, but they said it is temporary...Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Bistro not to be missed.
Review: During my three week stay in Langkawi I went to Coco's many times taking friends with me on several occasions.Excellent food, coupled with very reasonable prices make this Bistro a "must" for all visitors to Langkawi. I can thoroughly recommend any of the selections on the menu and also encourage anyone to try the Irish Stew which is a culinary and gastronomic delight not to be missed.Additionally, if fortunate to be there on a Sunday, the Sunday Roast is outstanding, get in early to avoid disappointment.I look forward to my next holiday in Langkawi and going to Coco's many more times.Show less

Author: Sage2724Australia
Title: Great meal if you are seeking western fare
Review: When you just want a change from Asian food, Cocos is the palce to go and you will not be disappointed in any way. We have been a couple of times especially for the Sunday roast which is traditional, delicious and great value. The other dishes are also excellent . Drinks are reasonably priced so it is a great value night. There is no airconditioning, just overhead fans so wear light clothes especially in the monsoon. The service is great and atmosphere is friendly and lots of people enjoying themselves at the restaurant. It is a bit hard to find but worth the effort. The decor is clean and modern and suits the style of restaurant. Well done Cocos!!!!Show less

Author: vmangrove
Title: Honest food at reasonable rates
Review:
Everything is good in the menu. Must try everything if you can. If you find it a bit tricky to find, ask around. 

Thank you.

Author: MoiraKWA
Title: Sunday Roast
Review: Have been before on previous trips on a week day. This time having heard they put on a Sunday roast decided to make that our one western food fix of our stay on Langkawi. Choice of roast beef or chicken. Opted for the beef and heaps of it with yorkshire pudding, roast and mashed potato and 2 other veg all cooked to perfection. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: 545johne
Title: Best steak in over year (since the last time)
Review: I had been looking forward to going back to Langkawi again for various reasons, but especially to try the steak again at this restaurant in its new location. I was not disappointed. Has to be the best value steak in Asia. Rib-Eye, medium rare with peppercorn sauce on the side accompanied by very nice sauteed potatoes and a salad. All for 40 Ringgit. The decor of the newly opened restaurant is very tastefully done and the service was great. Will be back again next year - if not before! Highly recommend! Show less

Author: EleanorM532cork
Title: Twice in three days
Review: Having read the reviews for coco's on trip advisor we decided to try it out,and we are so glad we did. I was very pleasantly surprised at how nice it was, ok it is in an underground car park but you forget that when you walk in.We sat at the bar having a drink talking to Coco who then took our order.The food when it came did not disappoint, two of us had chicken and mushroom in pastry and two had the fish and chips. Four clean plates went back to the kitchen. Steve the chef came to speak to us and I asked him about his tiramisu having read a review about how good it is. He promised to make it for me if we were coming again so we came back two days later. Again the food did not disappoint with home made steak pie and cottage pie our choice followed by delicious tiramisu. The food is delicious, very reasonable, staff friendly and I would recommend anyone to go there. P.s congrats to Steve and Coco on their recent nuptials, hope you have a long and happy life together .Show less

Author: LWilsonnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice and cozy
Review: We are dining here literally every time we visiting Langkawi, from the old bistro to now a new and cozy place. They still remain a small menu but the quality and freshness of their food still upkeeps.And not to mention, this trip is just a night stop for us prior leaving to Thailand on the early morning. Without a second thought, dining in Coco's Bistro always make it to the top of our list when comes to dinner! We would like to think it's the friendliness of the host Coco who draws us back every time, but no, we indeed truly enjoy ourselves and the food here.Show less

Author: mystkl85
Title: Quality food at reasonable price
Review: Good English / Irish food, had the chicken cordon blue and it's decent. Awesome tiramisu (loved the rum!) but dessert menu changes everyday so you gotta ask what's on the menu. However, the place is very warm and could use some ventilation.

Author: JaanaKatariina
Title: Great food and great service
Review: Fabulous place to have a good meal. Not a fancy gourmet restaurant but solid, tasty food from fresh incredients. Lovely!

Author: dasht2014Canberra, Australia
Title: Wanted to come back the next day
Review: Found this place on our last night in Langkawi after looking at Trip Advisor. Wish we had found it sooner, great food, awesome location, you don't feel like you are in a "car park". Staff was great and prices were cheap! We wanted to come back the next night for dinner before flying out but couldn't with timing. Would recommend everyone go here at least once!Show less

Author: satusampoLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: A little hard to find, but worth the search.
Review: Coco's Bistro's new location has not changed their pricing, nor the quality of their food. After staying some time in Malaysia I certainly want some European/Western food every now and then. Coco's have it. With reasonable price and attentive and friendly service. With art on the walls and very up to date deco it's hard to believe that you can really eat a rib-eye stake priced less than 10€... I can honestly recommend their fish and chips as well as bangers and mash or home made chicken liver pate. Don't forget to ask for their daily chanching dessert.Show less

Author: Blackheart0221
Title: Nice food friendly service
Review: I like the food and the atmosphere at here.... My girl friend and I have a nice dinner at here for my birthday.... Strongly recommend his rib eye.... The host is so friendly too.....

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: First Class Bistro.
Review: We have eaten at Coco's numerous times before, both in their old location and in this their latest surroundings.During this, our one month holiday in Langkawi, we ate at Coco's many times, both on our own and with friends who we took there from our hotel. Without exception, the guests we took were full of praise for the food, service and surroundings. Nobody raised a single complaint about any of the services that go to make up this excellent Bistro that attracts many local and overseas visitors.It is a small Bistro, not of the kind one would expect in a big city. The menu is more than adequate for any person not garnering thoughts of spending time ploughing through a leather bound menu produced by nouvelle-cuisine cognoscenti. The surroundings, or décor, are as chosen by the owners of the building and unless customers are of an artistic bent requiring Turneresque murals to view while eating, the modernist presentation hardly warrants critical, microscopic appraisal. Reiterating that this is a small Bistro, likewise one would hardly expect to sit eating off Wedgewood China sat at Chippendale furniture drinking from Waterford Crystal.Coco's food, service, surroundings - in fact - in toto are excellent and above reproach hence they have a multinational base of loyal followers, and rightly so.If fellow travellers are lucky enough to be in Langkawi on a Sunday evening they must book for the "Sunday Roast Dinner" which is a gastronomic pleasure.First Class is the only description appropriate for Coco's.Show less

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best steak on the island
Review: Steve & Coco have moved into their new surroundings in the basement of the Laguna apartments. Really well decorated with some fabulous art on the walls and the menu still the same as the old place. The best rib eye steak on the island and several ringitts cheaper than most. Over the last four years I have worked my way through the menu and have never been disappointed. It is all high quality food with excellent service . We'll recommendedShow less

Author: JuleznzChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Never been disappointed
Review: Our first dinner in their new location, wow! The food is great as ever and if I could only pass up on the scrumptious freshly battered barracuda and chips with mushy peas and tartare sauce, I am sure I would be equally delighted with anything else on the menu! My partner happily munched away on a deep filled steak and kidney pie just loaded with tender steak and kidney and served with a generous helping of chunky chips and salad.A tasty fruit of the forest trifle for dessert hit the spot nicely for dessert. Thanks Steve and CocoShow less

Author: MARKO663885Cheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Sorry not what we expected
Review: Went to Cocos as reviews were excellent. We were really disappointed both with the restaurant and the food.To be fair the food is very very average pub grub considering that you are in Langkawi and not the UK. The menu has no starters just mains which consist of as previously stated Fish and Chips, Irish stew etc. there is one mention of desserts but as to what it/they are is not disclosed on the menu.When the food came it was ok but nothing special but certainly not overpriced.The basement restaurant reeked of the deep fat fryer and the decor is post Berlin Wall basement German not easy on the eye. The tables were brown plastic and functional akin to any shopping mall food hall anywhere in the world. No table cloths(even paper ones) and just a cruet set and a candle in a red what looked like beer glass.Service was brisk and friendly enough.We sat down at 8.30 and were out by 9.05.Do go if you are desperate for a home from home basic tea your local could give you but if you want a special occasion with special food with special surroundings forget it.Show less

Author: janec737Sydney, Australia
Title: new surroundings, still great food
Review: Was a bit put off to hear they had moved to "a car park" under Laguna.it is lovely! Food was great, and prices have not increased. Couldn't believe how they made the surroundings so nice! A really MUST to visit.Will be back next week!Show less

Author: Weatherspoon
Title: Still one of the best on the island
Review: We were introduced to Coco's many months ago by our host. It was located behind a guest house in a small fishing village with sea view. Loved the set up and the food was exceptionally cheap and delicious.We were very very impressed with their new outlet located in a resort-like apartment block, 20 mins drive from our accommodation in pantei Tengah. Very modern with beautiful paintings and black and white prints on the wall.Their menu we noticed has changed slightly with additional new items. But the price is still similar. Cottage Pie and delicious Goulash at MYR18!Owner/chef Steve and his lovely partner Coco are a winning combination. Their friendliness coupled with excellent service and delectable ala carte menu make this little gem probably one of the must-eat restaurants on the island..Show less

Author: MoiraKWA
Title: Excellent Western Food
Review: Their new venue is just the opposite end of the spectrum to their previous one. Very modern decor and surroundings and in the basement of the Laguna Apartments. We got dropped off outside by our taxi driver and found a very small sign just inside the entrance to the basement parking for the apartments and literally wandered through the car park to get to Coco's. We hadn't booked a table and the bistro was full, but we sat at the bar and had a drink until a table became free.The menu is not extensive but covers most western tastes - steak and kidney pie, fish and chips, steak, chicken. On a previous visit we had opted for the steak and did so again. It is the best steak we have had in ages and just melted in the mouth. Service was as good as the food. Coco's is definitely the place to go if you want a western food 'fix' during your stay on Langkawi.Coco and Steve have a winning formula!Show less

Author: Peter MLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Best of Western Food on the Island
Review: I left Langkawi in May 2013 i'm now in Phnom Penh Cambodia - I tell you - even I have loads of good food in Phnom Penh - I miss Coco's and Steve's food, looking forward to go and visit them at there new place and stuff myself with all the goodies they are serving - not to forget the always friendly service with a smile.Continue the good work you twoShow less

Author: peter wLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Top Notch Restaurant
Review: Located in a plush Laguna Apartment, Coco's is a undoubtedly a must-eat restaurant. Very limited menu but the place was heaving not only with expatriates but tourists like ourselves. We were indeed very lucky to find this gem (we became Coco's regulars of sort) as we went there with our local friends. The prices are very reasonable (or even cheaper) compared with some of the eateries we patronised along Pantei Cenang. The most expensive item on Coco's menu is steak which is merely MYR35. Cooked to perfection accompanied by either mashed or sauteed veg. I also tried the Chicken and Mushroom Thermidore and it was just fab. Others include all-time favourites fish and chips, Cottage Pies and Goulash. As a matter of fact, I don't mind going there every night if I were to live on the island...Show less

Author: toddary
Title: What a great place
Review: My wife and i went today for dinner and i must say i was admired,,, the taste of food are divine and the staff are very friendly, the food and drinks quality is a 5 star rated while the price is the lowest

Author: Dave-KitsonBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: A little bit of home from home.
Review: After more than a week in Malaysia, and being a pretty stereotypical Brit, I dragged my partner to Coco's after it was mentioned to me by a fellow resident at our hotel.Our hotel was 3.5 miles from Coco's, and when our taxi driver finally gave up trying to find it after 30 minutes of driving (visiting the Cucu Beach restuarant on the way), Google Maps reckoned we were 8.5 miles from our destination :DSo, for anyone else trying to find Coco's tell your taxi driver to head for the car park underneath the "Laguna Appartments" - it's easy then!It was defintely worth the expedition though. Steak and Kidney Pie and chips was just what the doctor may have ordered (probably) and after paying 14 Ringetts for a beer at the hotel, Coco's 5 Ringetts seemed to make it taste even better. We had a short chat with a lady (might have been the owner, Coco maybe?) about getting a sign put up on the road and she said they were thinking of doing that, and everyone was lovely and the atmosphere was very pleasant.Two main courses, a shared cheesecake for desert and a couple of drinks each left us with change from £15 too.What's not to like?Show less

Author: Alistair C
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Needs a sign by the roadside but make sure you find it and eat here. Very tasty and extremeley nice place and good value

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: First Class.
Review: As mentioned in previous reviews, Coco's has relocated.In every respect the standards, which were excellent at the last site, have been retained and without exception all the friends we have taken to dinner at Coco's reiterate our praise.Full marks and deservedly so. A MUST to visit.Show less

Author: holidaytime26Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: New location, same quality
Review: Coco's has just moved to the basement of The Laguna apartment building. It is definitely a much nicer and more accessible location, but prices remain the same for the still generously portioned good food. Steak and steak and kidney pies are a welcome addition to the menu. The only setback is that customers cannot use the condo car park and will have to park on the roadside.Show less

Author: LWilsonnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Warning!!
Review: Warmth, Delicious and Excellent! If only three words are allowed to describe this lovely restaurant! But of course, the lists to describe the food, the host and the place are a bucket long! Warning, you will get addicted to their food!!We discovered this lovely place by accident, which we are attracted by the helpfulness of Coco in directing us for a beautiful sunset spot in the island, and it turned out, we get addicted to these beautiful and lovely restaurant!As a start, it's not the easiest way to look for this restaurant, but, the rule is to just follow the direction given from either Coco or Steve, and not to follow one's instinct in the direction, and you shall be landed in the right place, with surprise, at least that's what we fel!t :)The restaurant gives us a rustic kind of feel and the warmth of the "home-cook" style meal, plated and presented in style. They have small menu but all the ingredients are freshly prepared and cook on the day by the only head chef, Steve and thats what speaks for their menu sizes. However, I strongly recommend to ask for the day's special, which doesn't printed in the menu.We had fish and chips and chicken cordon bleu on the first day. The fish is cook to perfection. The fish is so fresh and the batter is light & crisp at the outside, n the fish is just melt in the mouth. The chicken cordon bleu is very well seasoned, non greasy and the cheese just ooze out once it's cut open! We had the homemade tiramisu for dessert. And hell yes, we made up our mind to have our dinner on the next day at Coco's bistro once we have our last bite. We loves the ambience, the food and the host, Coco is so attentive and welcoming. She treat you just like a guest, welcoming you to their 'home' with her genuine service. The next evening, we were having the infamous Irish stew and the day's special, Grilled Chicken with stuffing. As I am the person who is very particular when comes to food, I truly think their Irish Stew is really one of the best I've ever had! And not kidding which they 'advertised' in their menu that it had sold a million... One bowl is never enough, really! We ends our evening with the chocolate brownies with ice cream. The brownies is moist and aromatic, and that's really is a perfect sweet ending for the meal.Both Steve and Coco are the most congenial of hosts! Coco is very friendly and makes the guests felt so welcoming and she just never wear out of smiles. We felt so privileged able to have some conversations with both Steve and Coco after our dinner, til wee hours. Although it's a long but really great session. We felt comfortable and enjoying ourself with both the hosts and we can tell both Steve and Coco are really genuine, good people who loves people and food! We spent a week in Langkawi, trying different food from different cafes and restaurants and its ashamed we were only to dine here for the last 2 evenings. It's abit 'too late' for us to discover this hidden gem. They shall be moving away to a new place by now and we sincerely wish their success and very best in their new location and to be frank, we definitely will go back to Coco's Bistro whenever we returning to Langkawi!Show less

Author: kencarvosso
Title: Best Steaks on the island
Review: Lovely people running it, best chef on the island, all food excellent nice atmosphere.  Mainly english menu but all beautifully cooked.

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Coco's Bistro.
Review: First a few words of warning. Coco's will be moving to a new location in July which is about one mile from the present location and will be right on a beach.We visited Coco's many times during our latest four week holiday and, just like our last visits in January/February, the food was superb. It is the only restaurant where my husband manages two bowls of their Irish Stew pretending it is only his contribution to getting the numbers up to one million sold.The local boy who served us was so polite and professional yet was only working while on his school holidays. He made each outstanding dinner even more memorable.We wish everyone at Coco's every success in their new location and look forward greatly to eating there on our next holiday.Show less

Author: Weatherspoon
Title: Wonderful meals and cheap too...
Review: Went there last Oct for the first time. Food quality hasn't changed a bit. Same limited menu. Lovely steak cooked to your likings, delicious goulash. Enjoy its bangers and mash and Irish stew immensely. Highly recommended for travellers who craved for high quality British pub grubs.Show less

Author: Kevmac1
Title: Find this place!
Review: A little hard to find, but easily the best western food I've had in Asia! The bangers and mash are AmAzInG! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

Author: krobbo1Penguin, Australia
Title: Great value, food and service.
Review: This is one of our favourite restaurants in Langkawi. It has a pleasant seaside outlook and friendly, relaxed atmosphere. The menu is small but all dishes are delicious and servings are generous. Check the specials for fish of the day - the barracuda is awesome and the steak is great. Good value meals and drinks.Show less

Author: holidaytime26Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Great meal for 3 with drinks for under Rm100
Review: Good Western food, generous portions and very reasonably priced -- no wonder Coco's is popular with the expat community on Langkawi. We went there on a Tuesday night and it was almost full. The menu is limited, which I think is often a mark of a good restaurant. My husband's Hungarian goulash was substantial as was my Irish stew and our friend's barracuda fish and chips. Service was equally good and friendly and the drinks inexpensive. There were a couple of men sitting at the bar but it is more a restaurant. The seafront view is a bonus. A very satisfying evening for under Rm100 (£22, $34) for three.Show less

Author: nicholas s
Title: Great Place to Eat
Review: The menu is small but all dishes are well cooked and the atmosphere is nice. Its well tucked away so you may have to ask for directions.

Author: AntiquemanCotswolds
Title: A Hidden Treasure
Review: During our holiday we visited on three occasions, the food was excellent, Irish Stew to die for, Fish and Chips, Wonderful Steak at a more than reasonable price. A limited menu but a welcome taste of home after too many Chinese Meals.Coco made us very welcome and the surroundings were delightful, Thanks to all the staff for making what were for us memories which will linger. Will certainly return next year, which will be our 14th visit to Langkawi!! Boring or not?Show less

Author: Penny G
Title: Coco's Bistro for really good food.
Review: The Irish Stew is absolutely excellent, a "must try" and have two bowls of it if you are able as the second seems to taste even better.

Author: nurse1898Exeter, UK
Title: Great Location
Review: Blink and you could miss this place as hidden off the road and en route out of the main strip. Not a large menu, but delicious and we can vouch for that as my pops during his two month plus stay ate every main on the menu. Situated near the beach it's great location to review the sunset over Rebak, I came here once during my stay and wasn't disappointed. The steak is to die for.....huge, tender and beautifully cooked. The service is attentive ADHD friendly, if you want to get off the main strips and try something western, then this is the place to comeShow less

Author: 997MichaelB997Brittany, France
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Very friendly restaurant in a quiet little corner of Langkawi. Not in a tourist area and the place is popular with some expats! Don't let that put you off! The menu is small and simple but the food is massive on taste and value for money. When you need a night off from curry and noodles....try this place! You won't be disappointed!Fish and chips with mushy peas...cottage pie...Hungarian Goulash...you are spoilt for choice! Have tried them all!Wine and good beer served too.A nice location near the coast. Highly recommended! Thanks to Coco and Steve who run it! See you next year!!Show less

Author: XINStella
Title: Impressive , beyond my expectation
Review:
Impressive , beyond my expectation, the steak is wonderful!!!
It is a little restaurant in a corner of langkawi, you can find a quiet experience here not like another busy restaurant. Also good food and good prices. We love it!

Author: 658LeeR
Title: Fantastic food
Review:
Lovely simple menu, Hungarian Goulash was to die for, friendly staff, really reasonably priced.
Can be a little difficult to find, but worth the effort.

Author: RizhaoBob
Title: Expat hangout with good western food
Review: Out of the way, pleasant atmosphere, good western food... an expat hangout away from the tourist scene.

Author: gypsymamanworld
Title: Congenial restaurant
Review: This is a lovely little restaurant tucked away in a quiet corner of Langkawi. They have a small menu but the food is good and the portions are generous. They say they have a vegetarian menu on request and sure enough they made me a veggie cottage pie in short order. Helpful staff, good food and good prices. What's not to likeShow less

Author: Stereobit
Title: Lovely place
Review:
Spend a bunch of nights there when I visited Langkawi last year. Every single one was great. Steve and Coco are great hosts who love what they are doing.

Thank you,
Tobi

Author: Ccher
Title: Delicious British style food
Review: The best chicken cordon bleu I've had with the delicious cheese oozing out. The booze was a steal at 5 ringgit for a glass of house wine. Do watch out for mozzies if you're seated outdoors

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Food and Service
Review: We are on the island for two months holiday and have already eaten at this establishment 3 times. A small menu that ensures the head chef and co-owner Steve can concentrate on providing excellent tasting food. The Irish stew is legendary as are the Rib-eye steaks. I have also tried the Fish & Chips, again excellent. Coco provides front of house and she and her staff are very welcoming and look afetr all the customers. Really worth a visit once you have found it!Show less

Author: RawtalentIsle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: Best kept secret
Review: Were you a fan of the food served in the Irish Bar when it was situated at the North end of Pantai Cenang? Yes? Well Steve is now located at Coco's Bistro. You can still get those wonderful steaks and the best Fish and Chips on Langkawi. It's a shame we didn't find Steve till the end of our trip, as we would have visited several times, shame we weren't here long enough to try the Irish stew - I'm sure it's as good as I remember from a few years ago . Booking ahead advised.Show less

Author: Cam S
Title: Warm, friendly atmosphere.
Review: We made Coco's our local when on the island. The food is excellent and very reasonably priced, service attentive and the setting magical. The oldie style music lends to the atmosphere. Steve and Coco make you feel so welcome. This place will not disappoint.

Author: Gideon B
Title: Einmalig und nostalgisch!
Review:
WOw, has been one of the best resteraunts ever for me! Escpecially because youre not used to this food in asia! Liked the atmosphere, old music and the nice people staying their! 

Thank you Coco and Frank, 
Gideon

Author: Raymond-KIpoh
Title: Nice hang out place
Review: A bit hard to find, it was raining when we went there. Place was packed, but managed to get seats luckily. Had ordered fish and chips, it was okay. Overall good place to hang out with friends.

Author: dawnKedahkedah
Title: Steak !!!!
Review: Have visited Coco's Bistro many times, the food is great, in particular the Steak, and Fish. Steve and Coco are so friendly and give you such a warm greeting. Love the setting, very rustic, all items are very reasonably priced.This one is on my hit listShow less

Author: johanbodo
Title: chicken cordon bl.
Review: traveled with the taxi to terian. First ended up at the wrong place, but finally there. no cordon bleu for every one and no stew.Food ok but just nice average. Service just do it yourself, don't expect anything.

Author: Pinoy_PeteBucharest, Romania
Title: Hard to find but a great find...!
Review: A wonderful place, it had it all... food, serice, value..! i dont like writing this review beacuse if it gets busy it might change! While staying in Chanai someone in the bar mentioned this place and gave us the number of Steve the chef as he was quite sure we'd get lost. We did but Steve sent a young man to fetch us and I'm glad he did. I had a rare travelling treat of steak the first night and again the second and third by special request. DONT MISS THIS PLACE IF YOU SUFFER FROM HUNGER :)Show less

Author: Nickcoombe
Title: What a delightful find to end our holiday in Langkawi
Review: We had a short visit to Langkawi and we managed to dine only at two restaurants, both strongly recommended. On our last night we went to Coco's Bistro. It was exactly the way the restaurant was described. Tucked away in a fishing village. Yes, the menu is limited but from what I heard every single item on the menu are delicious. I ordered steak and my other half prefered roast chicken, which was their today's special. My steak was perfectly cooked to my liking, medium rare with black pepper sauce. The roast chicken too was yummy with stuffing. And Steve, who is the chef/owner came to our table and introduced himself. By the time we finished our meals Coco's was heaving. Show less

Author: Weatherspoon
Title: Simply delicious meals
Review: We went there three times as it was highly recommended by our hosts and each time we wanted to come back for more. Unfortunately we were on the island for only a week. Fish and homemade chips is stunning coupled with mushy peas, delicious steak served with sauteed potatoes and mushroom sauce and their today's special succulent chicken Kiev is to die for. The lemon cheese cake and ice cream cake are delicious. No wonder the restaurant was always packed to the brim every time we were there. Show less

Author: joe bOslo, Norway
Title: just chicken
Review: just normal food, no need to write about the way it is done now!!! Be square and write worth while things.Show less

Author: kathleentff
Title: Small but friendly service
Review:
The menu was quite restricted but it was good. Been here twice and would recommend the chicken cordon bleu. Overall, this restaurant is quite value for money for western food.  

The service was also not too bad.

Author: Trinabelle
Title: Hidden gem
Review: We struggled to find this place - it is not on Jalan Kuala Teriang! A previous reviewer helped with the comment it was off the beach. If looking for some tasty western food, in a cosy and friendly evironment, Coco's is your place, shame we didn't try it earlier in our Langkawi stay. We had the steak which was cooked as requested and the fish & chips, followed by a gorgeous piece of choc brownie with banana icecream - all was delicious, definitely recommend.Show less

Author: admin37
Title: hard to find but do look
Review: we found this only by taxi it is a very small restaurant but food very good and cheap worth the find

Author: vincentdindonMadrid, Spain
Title: Just the perfect place to enjoy a delicious diner
Review: If you want a nice and quiet place with smiling staff and amazing western food look no further, Steven the irish cook and Coco the manager will deliver it for you.Not only is the atmosphere amazing but the chicken cordon bleu is something wroth fighting for, the rib eye steak is delicious and cook perfectly with a nice dressing, according to market availability you can have fresh grilled fishes I tried the Barracudas and even though I m not a huge fan of fishes I loved it.At the end of the day no matter how long you stay in Langkawi you hae to tried that restaurant by yourselfShow less

Author: naturelover222Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Everything was perfect!!!
Review: We had a bit of a hard time finding it but it was well worth the effort! There were 4 of us and we were all impressed. This quality of Western food for these prices.... I don't think there is another restaurant in Langkawi that can even come close! The portions were huge. We tried the fish and chips, the steak and the Gordon bleu. All 3 dishes were phenomenal. The steak, ordered medium rare actually came medium rare! Quite unusual for Langkawi's more affordable places. The sauteed potatoes with onions that came with it was really good. Can't be easy to cook a large quantity to that quality. The fish and chips is the "proper" British way with the beer batter, not bread crumbs. The Gordon Bleu was quite good and came with the most delightful roasted vegetables. And not just one or 2 pieces either! The mashed potatoes were flavored with spring onions i believe, which made them quite nice to eat on their own. I normally love gravy with my mash!All in all we were all blown away and will definitely be back soon. Oh, forgot to mention the very efficient, friendly and helpful staff. No long waiting periods to get your food! AND all the food comes at the same time. Often in Langkawi in the more affordable places the food dribbles in little bit at a time and the first guy is finished by the time the last one gets his. NOT SO HERE!We paid rm 109 for the 4 of us for 4 main courses and 4 drinks and a coffee.Keep it up! We hope that you will be here for a long time so we have somewhere to go to eat good, affordable western food!Show less

Author: ZuiverLisbon, Portugal
Title: The best steak in a long time!
Review: Been in Langkawi for 6 nights and had dinner at this lovely place 3 times!Had a perfect steak and a delicious Cordon Bleu amongst other delicious yammies :-) (needless to say the Chef is a very experienced guy ;-)The hosts are very friendly, always available for a chat. Free wifi is a plus!It seems there are some hornbills that go and lounge in front of the restaurant daily but I was never there on time for that sight cause I always have dinner quite late :-)If you ever go down to that area, you must visit the place!Show less

Author: sunshinegirlMalaysiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Food Lovely Owners.
Review: After reading reviews we decided to try this little gem as we were staying at the Sheraton. The only problem was nobody had heard of it and the taxi driver had to call someone to find out where it was. No problem when he knew the way. It was 9.30 by the time we arrived but the place was still busy with people eating and locals having a drink.It closes at 11.30. It is not a fancy place just a nice homely eating place by the beach,The kind of place you could make your local.The menu is British and limited but don't let that put you off.. We had the steak and kidney pie and it was fantastic It came with Salad and chips.I was stuffed and couldn't eat dessert. We had a wine and soda and a beer and the bill was so cheap I will not tell you how much Just go and try it for yourselves. The best value meal we had in Langkawi.The owners made sure everything was ok and I said we had a problem finding it and we had tried to phone to see exactly where it was but couldnt find a phone number. So they have given me the number which is 0163241198 if you decide to go and get lost but once you know where it is you wont forget. The owners even phoned for a taxi to take us back to the Sheraton. There hospitality was very welcome. I look forward to going back on my next visit.Show less

Author: HimmelswesenDuesseldorf
Title: Langkawi's real pot of gold!
Review: I am staying in Langkawi since quite a long time but usually never go out at evening/night. Well, everything changed since I know Coco's Bistro. Fingerlicking food and the best hosts in the whole world... that's more than one good reason to change the habits.It's a cosy place run by the most friendly people you can imagine. I am enjoying every single second of my (nearly) daily visits!! Thanks so much for all the good times!Show less

Author: mark lNorwich
Title: cocos
Review: what a find.the food is the best i have eaten on the island.the service is excellent.the dining out experience would grace any decent restaurant in London, Paris, New Yyork.The menu is simple and uncomplicated, the steaks are a delight. anyone reading this review just has to try it. You wont be disappointed. .Show less

Author: samanthafreeman
Title: Best food
Review: If you want good food, nice ambience and reasonable pricing, this is the place. It's off the beaten track, a hidden gem.

Author: jeromeBali
Title:
Very lovely place
You feel at home
Adress on the map is not good. Close to Sheraton
Enjoy this top adress!!!
Review:
Perfect food!!!
Fresh baracouda is incredible
Menu is short but nice proposition
Don t miss chocolate dessert!

Author: KeatsLangkawiIsland of Gozo, Malta
Title: Coco Magic
Review: Having returned to Langkawi after an absence of three months I was very pleasantly surprised to find that a new bistro had opened. So many of my friends told me that I had to go there that I wasted no time in doing just that. What a place! Steve and Coco are the most congenial of hosts and the food is great. As others have pointed out the menu is limited but the food, unashamedly western, is delicious. There are normally one or two specials that are not on the menu which help to stop things getting too monotonous. I've eaten liver and onions and steak and kidney pie, both of which were perfect. Coco's has now become my favourite hangout and go there a couple of times a week. My only worry is that it will become so popular that I won' be able to get in. Maybe I should have slammed it instead of telling the truth. All the best Steve and CocoShow less

Author: selvi_premLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful dinner
Review: It was great having dinner at this Bistro. Food was great and i enjoyed the potatoe saute..I didnt know you do have dessert of the day, Steve. May be next visit i will not miss the dessert.Very happy to see you again. Your struggle and hardwork convert into the happiness in your life. Wishing you and Coco good luck and best wishes for your new bussiness. Will definitely come again to your place.Show less

Author: donjeanne642langkawi
Title: At last!
Review: We have found a tucked-away little gem. Coco's Bistro takes a little finding, but well worth the effort. For us, a delightfully homely feel, lovely setting, welcoming, friendly people and the finest food at the most value that we have found after 8 years on the island. The menu is small but well rounded and our all time favourite, fish and chips was not disappointing. Portions were large, well presented and absolutely delicious; (and they serve Savanah's!) We will be back time and again....for the music as well as the food!Show less

Author: KawidawnHong Kong
Title: A hidden gem
Review: What a find!!! We were told about this place by Annette from The English Tea Room. Stephen and Coco were friendly, fun and great hosts. It maybe a small restaurant but it packs a mighty punch for location, service and food. The menu has a limited choice but the quality is fantastic. I had the Fish and Chips and was offered for a few ringgits more the Barricuda caught by the local fishermen that morning. (Coco's is next to a local fishing village). If you love fish then this is a real treat at a fantastic price. Cold beers, small wine selection and juices are all available. Although no proper coffee machine yet, but I believe they are working on it.I want to recommend the Hot Brownies and ice cream but I fear if I do there will be none left for my next visit.The one thing I would have liked to see on the menu was a vegetarian choice. With their cooking skills I am sure they could add a veggie dish that was not the usual veggie lasagne or mushroom risotto.We will definitely be going back to Coco's on our next trip to Langkawi.Show less

Author: Canterbury808Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Unpretentious no-frill cafe...love it
Review: Had a string of fabulous meals there. Limited menu but delicious and not pricy. Tucked away behind a guest house facing the beach, this little gem offers typical British pub grubs ranging from Bangers and Mash to its national pride, Fish and Chips. Enjoyed the steak too. I must say the best steak in town! Will definitely be back. Well done Steve and Coco for giving us yet another great find on the beautiful island of LangkawrShow less

Author: Damien_oct73
Title: Great comfort food for weary travelers craving the simple things from home
Review: Best Irish stew ever. 2 meals and four drinks for 50 Ringit (16 Aussie $)- great value

Author: minxSgSG
Title: Great food irish stew, great beef goulash and a nice dessert of the day
Review: One can easily miss this corner tucked restaurant but we know we would have missed out a lot on the delicious food waiting to be dished out by Steven and Coco. We were told of this great place by cafe owner Annette (The English tea room, Langkawi), who gave us road directions to Coco's Bistro. We were greeted warmly by Coco, who picked up a friendly conversation, like we were close friends. We found out that at that time, Coco's Bistro started out only for 6 weeks. With 2 primary-school-going kids, we ordered Irish stew, Beef goulash and Fish and chips. The kids were picky eaters and to have them say, 'Delicous! Can we go again?' is already a testament to the plate-licking-good (literally!) food. The meat in the Irish stew and the Beef goulash was tender enough for the little ones to chew on, and the tartar sauce for the fish and chips was a great condiment to the dish itself.
