My hubby ordered the special dessert of the day and it was just as excellent. Don't forget to ask Steven for the special dessert and he will tell you what he has for that day. We are back home, and the kids are still asking to return to langkawi to eat Auntie Coco's food. A must visit if you are in Langkawi, or you might be missing out some great food there. Opens only for the evenings 5.30pm till 11pm.Show less

Author: Larganboy
Title: Best Food and Service in Langkawi
Review: My wife and I went to Langkawi on our honeymoon. We stumbled across Coco's Bistro is a really cool place in a picturesque fishing village where you can have a great dinner and chill out with drinks afterwards. The two running the place are so friendly and helpful and know a lot about the island. If you are in Langkawi make sure you allow an evening and night to relax and have a great time here.Show less

Author: MillaPeuraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best food and service in Langkawi
Review: My holiday in Langkawi was complete when I ate in Coco's Bistro! First of all the staff, Coco and Stephen are awesome, I couldn't have met any more helpful and friendly people than them. The food was so delicious and also pretty cheap! The location is in a village out from the city and it's a really chill out place. Coco's bistro is definitely a place to visit!Show less

Author: Helena WMontreal, Canada
Title: A beautiful find
Review: Found this bistro by accident. It was a great find! Food is absolutely wonderful. I'd a chicken cordon bleu for only RM20 & my bf had the best steak of our whole holiday for only RM32. Steve & Coco took great care of us & also told us about the nice places to visit in Langkawi. We highly recommend this place & will definitely return on our next visit to Langkawi.Show less

Author: Yee_Choong
Title: Lovely italian food in langkawi
Review: Finally manage to visit this place after doing some research on what to do and what to eat in langkawi. Lovely 3 course set lunch meal prepared by the chef/owner and his team.

Author: stacey_tyng
Title: Must give a try, you will not regret.
Review: Hidden Gems. Great foods, nice environment and polite staffs. Continuous 2 visits one at night and another during lunch before heading to airport. The lunch set worth every penny!

Author: Blee79singapore
Title: Great taste,good service
Review: Great option to the langkawi dining scene dominated by 5 star hotel chains. Unpretentious yet authentic Italian upmarket set up.good food and service.highly recommended if you are looking for Italian food on the island.that said,variety is not their strength but detail and taste to what they have on the menu is commendable.will be back again definitely.Show less

Author: dbasha
Title: A must in Langkawi!
Review: This was our second visit and we were once again blown away. The octopus, eggplant, prawn ravioli, lamb shank, tiramisu and panna cotta were excellent, as were the wines and cocktails. Prices were very reasonable. Definitely one of the top restaurants in Langkawi!

Author: msialeong
Title: Compliments to the chef
Review: Compliments to the chef. Food is excellent. The angus steak is very good and we have eaten in many italian restaurants in KL. Surprisingly the best is found in Langkawi at Nerro Gallo.

Author: WeiSeongTanDungun, Malaysia
Title: Pity chef
Review: This place was recommended by a dear friend. We arrived at 8.30pm and ordered 3 escargot 1 scallop for starters, and 3 lobsters and 1 stake for the mains. The starters came after 30mins and it was not bad... We had our wine while waiting for our main dishes. After another hour, we ask for our main but the waiter said they had just began to defrost our lobster (what were they doing an hour and a half ago?) then the owner of the restaurant, also the chef, came out to talk to us. He seems drunk as he could not stand straight and he scolded us for our impatient. Why can't we wait 5 mins for our food when he had waited to open his restaurant after one half year due to covid lock down..... So we thought we can't reason to someone... Angry and drunk... So we cancelled our order and paid for what we ate. He even threatened to call the police... Thanks to his staff... We manage to pay and leave to find a better place to dine in.... I hope the chef recovers from depression...Show less

Author: StanUP
Title: Set lunch
Review: Came here for lunch before taking flight back home. Very near to airport so it's good place to get some foods before or after flight. Lunch set is very value for money, good portion and tasty. Will come back again next year for dinner.

Author: chansausoon
Title: A gem in Langkawi
Review:
We were introduced to your restaurant by a good friend. Amazing food and your friendly demeanor added to the experience, Lorenzo!
Can’t wait for our next visit😋

Author: PeterT5164
Title: Worth the drive to Gallo Nero Italian Restaurant, Langkawi.
Review: The food is great at very reasonable prices. Chef Lorenzo cooks with passion and this Italian restaurant is in a fairly remote tourist island of Langkawi. Excellent duck confit and great tasting appetisers. Friendly staff as well.

Author: Amzwright
Title: Delicious food, great service.
Review: Delicious Italian food using local ingredients. The food was amazing and the staff were very friendly and helpful. This restaurant doesn’t have the beach views of other restaurants in the island but the food definitely makes up for it.

Author: bobchuaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Absolute Disaster
Review: Went for lunch today. Waited 1hour+ with absolutely no food forthcoming. Large group coughing and spluttering away inside. Walked out with no lunch and hungry kids and unapologetic staff. Don’t even bother. Second and last time here, and food is mediocre anyways. Absolute terrible experience and waste of time.Show less

Author: ashtonalex123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dining at Langkawi
Review: Writing this as I have just left the restaurant after two consecutive lunches.The best restaurant that we had food in Langkawi and much better than other Italian places we have tried in the Klang valley.Visited: mid October 2021. Closed on: Mondays and Tuesdays. Location: Near the airport. Time taken for a meal: 1.5 hours or 2.Show less

Author: Mansoor999Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing given its position and ratings. Based on my orders, very over rated
Review: Been to Langkawi many times and this was a place on our list. Finally got there and oh so disappointing. Atmosphere nice and service friendly but firstly they couldn’t get the aircon adjusted. Cold air was directly on us and we asked if we could be moved. They looked baffled and tried making adjustments with no luck. There was a massive space empty next to us and out of the range of the aircon but they didn’t suggest moving the table there. Took a bit of time but finally got a better table. Next the starters arrived. Croquets and Carpaccio were very nice. Then we ordered the prawn ravioli and salmon linguini. The two orders of ravioli came out at the same time. This took almost 40 mins which I thought was excessive. My wife and daughter had almost finished before they came to me and told me that my food will arrive shortly (20 mins later). At that point I highlighted that my family had almost finished so they accelerated the process. A minute later the food comes out and it’s bland and almost undercooked. All the main sounded fantastic but were very disappointing. No real apology until the ‘see you again’ at the end. Disappointing food experience. Felt very let down for a restaurant so highly rated. Expectations were high given their popularity but don’t understand the big deal.Show less

Author: Sergey P
Title: Good food and nice personnel
Review: Visited this place today, food is great and they have a very nice serving staff, thank you for the evening!

Author: ChrisS13085
Title: One of the best
Review: This place is extraordinary, the service, the food, the ambience, really cannot fault it. Fantastic artworks on the walls, food was one of the best Italian restaurants we have been to in Malaysia.

Author: ch00sen1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super rude
Review: The staff is rude and provided wrong info We waited outside restaurant 15min before entertain. The place were full with non Malaysian so we were ignored . Show less

Author: DoctorBakar
Title: Service has improved and food quality superb
Review: Management has obviously upped their service quality. Food remains excellent and wine prices remain affordable. It was full house on Xmas night and despite the absence of the chef/owner, the service team was almost faultless! Well done!

Author: EmbunEmbunlgk
Title: Great Local Italian Restaurant
Review: Lorenzo and his team never fail to hit the mark. This great Italian restaurant continues to surprise on every visit, it keeps getting better.... for truly authentic Italian cuisine, look no further. With Lorenzo on the pans and a wonderful front of house team, you are always assured a warm welcome and a great evening.Show less

Author: JenniferAmman_Jordan
Title: Pasta with passion
Review: The food is fresh and delicious. The passion of the chef bursts forth in every dish. Can not wait to go back again

Author: asdfhhjklmnbvcxz
Title: Do not miss this one!
Review: I have been in Langkawi on and off for four years now. There is a lot of good food on the island but Gallo Nero falls into a class of its own. Outside of five star hotels it is one of the few places where you can experience fine dining. And not pay five star prices. We were a Lange lunch party of 11 but all drinks were served promptly. All of the food arrived at the same time; a truly professional set up.We had a wide variety of dishes which were all excellent and beautifully presented. After pudding the owner and chef (Lorenzo) came out to talk to us - a nice touch.For sure I will be back and really sorry that I did not discover the place sooner.Show less

Author: roseanna172Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food, service and ambiance
Review: We came here for my husbands birthday along with three of our friends. The whole evening was just exceptional, the food was absolutely delicious, we chose for starters seared Hokkaido Scallops, Half mozzarella Buratta and Pollo Tonnato followed by Black Angus rib-eye Steak, spaghetti with garlic olive oil chilli and salmon, spaghetti and salmon in a creamy lemon sauce and Potato Gnocchi “alla sorrentina” followed by a chocolate flan which had a candle on it for the birthday boy. From start to finish the whole evening was amazing along with great service from the very friendly staff who kept our drinks topped up. I would highly recommend you visit this place you will not be disappointed, a must for a special occasion or a romantic meal. I will be returning when I come back to Langkawi very soon. Show less

Author: zainaladwin
Title: Exquisite
Review: Excellent steak which was cooked till perfection. Other food on the menu was also perfect. The deserts were not too sweet or too bland. Highly recommended

Author: Der_Macher68Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very good with few steps missing to become excellent
Review: Without doubt Gallo Nero is a good Italian restaurant, if you are tired of Asian food it is most probably the best alternative in the island, being myself Italian, I can be trusted. Still there is room for improvements, whilst appetisers and desserts were really good, my spaghetti didn't match my expectations, taste was not as good as I expected, missing some important aromas.Said that, service is good,even if a bit slow and, considering the nature of the restaurant, price is overall fair. The ambiente is quite nice but slightly noisy for my personal taste, easy to park just outside the restaurant, which is an additional plus.Show less

Author: Hafiz300Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: We dropped by for dinner here because there wasn't much choice nearby our hotel due to current RMCO situation. We had a few pastas and salmon fish, for dessert we had the chocolate cake with almond ice cream, all food dishes was delicious and went well with the red wine that was recommended.Service was attentive and good overall including recommendation on selection for our dining menu.There is only indoor seating for dining with a cozy ambience, and a bar section too.Overall, we were happy with our decision on dining here.Show less

Author: vijaiaPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Decent place with average food
Review: Decent place with average food. Tried the restaurant as it was highly rated on TripAdvisor but somewhat disappointing. The standout was the desert. Show less

Author: brendajm23
Title: Wonderful surprise
Review: On a cold and wet evening we came for dinner without checking any reviews or such. Thankfully we had such a wonderful meal. The ciabatta was crusty on the outside and pillow soft inside. The pastas were delicious and the prawns I had were beyond delicious. We were so full but could not resist the desserts and the chocolate flan was to die for..plus they offered us grappa which left me feeling all warm and fuzzy on the inside! I wish I lived in langkawi so I could eat here all the timeShow less

Author: julian lKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: We enjoyed a good family meal at Gallo Nero. Decent wine list and tasty food. I recommend the quail, and I also enjoyed the beef carpaccio. The scallops were a little bland and needed more seasoning but otherwise it was a great evening. Good atmosphere and friendly, efficient service,Show less

Author: TheYumL
Title: Italian
Review: Gallo Nero is possibly our favourite food find in Langkawi. Exceptional food experience with quality ingredients and every single dish made from scratch.

Author: beltonbenYangon Region, Myanmar
Title: Extremely excellent Italian food
Review: I have eaten at many good Italian restaurants across Asia over the past decade and this is the best one by a large margin. So good we came back twice, and would have been more if we had stayed in Langkawi longer. Every single dish and all drinks delicious. Best restaurant in Langkawi for dinner hands down Show less

Author: ericihaveatripKo Kut, Thailand
Title: 100% Italian food
Review: We had a great dinner at Gallo Nero here in Langkawi. I love Malaysian food but I’m from Italy and I was looking for something familiar after a while here.Food is Italian 100% and wine too.We had gnocchi and fettuccine with a bottle of white wine. An espresso with Sambuca for close the meal.If we’re considering how far we are from Italy and last but not least that Langkawi is an island I can say those prices are really affordable, probably better than a Italian restaurant in Italy.Thanks to the staff, very kind and polite, and Lorenzo the chef.We will back again soonShow less

Author: Cam87Johor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Italian Food in Langkawi
Review: My husband and I have eaten at Gallo Nero a few times on our visit to Langkawi. We keep returning as the food is delicious, and the service is excellent. With each visit, we are pleased with the gourmet dishes and excellent consistency of the food. We recommend you try the homemade bread which arrives at your table fresh out of the oven in its own small loaf. The seared Hokkaido scallops with sauteed spinach, roasted capsicum, and black olive dressing is a feast for the eyes and taste buds. Our favorite dish is the fresh orange sweet potato gnocchi with creamy blue cheese sauce, rocket and nuts pasta dish. The blue cheese gives the pasta dish an additional layer of flavor. The roasted quails with sauteed spinach, roasted potatoes and cranberry sauce were especially amazing with the sauce. Another favorite was the 12 hours slow cooked duck leg, roasted pumpkin and potatoes, grain mustard and orange reduction dish. If you like panna cotta with mixed berries, it is a wonderful dessert to end the meal. We look forward to returning again.Show less

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Reopened
Review: Could hardly wait for the reopening of this amazing place. Food is absolutely worth the wait. My girlfriend and I had a lovely girly evening there , I had the steak which was done to perfection and she had the roasted chicken. Very tasty and pleasantly presented. Thank You Lorenzo.Show less

Author: juvinileSipitang, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food and service
Review: We had a wonderful meal in this restaurant. Lots compliments to the Chef Lorenzo & his team prepared very nice and tasteful dishes. Service team are very welcoming & created memorable dine experience. Thank you Ina & Fizol.Special thanks to Hasni for attentively looked after us throughout the evening. Really recommended this restaurant. We will come back again next time. Show less

Author: nielsolej2014
Title: We had the degustation menu
Review: We had the degustation menu with wine - great food and good wine - good service - excellent value for the money - go there :-)

Author: Evanepy
Title: Pleasant Meal
Review: Food is quality and my girlfriend loves the ravioli here. Definitely will come back. One of the better italian restaurants i have eaten so far.

Author: Sightseer96426
Title: Excellent Service and Food
Review: Staying close by and so thought we would try this restaurant, based on feedback on Trip Advisor. It was lovely and definitely will visit again before we leave Langkawi. Service was impeccable and all the team were fantastic. Food was delicious and a good choice on the menu. Value for money and recommend it! Well done Gallo Nero Show less

Author: glennhH6959XD
Title: Lovely
Review: Nice restaurant with relaxing atmosphere.  Great menu very good food and service. Parking in the area. Close to Smith House Hotel

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Amazing
Review: We went for Valentines Day and the meal was to die for! It was extremely busy, and despite that the staff was attentive and made us feel very special. The Chef accomadated our special request and even came to see us making us feel very welcomed. I have never felt disappointed at any time I have gone there and I try to go regularly when I am on the island.Show less

Author: ggtrees91Colombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Okay
Review: Although it was not that busy we had to wait to be greeted by someone. The waiter who was very pleasant gave us menu's several of them he then disapeared and only came back when I managed to catch his eye. Wine was excellent food was good although a smallish portion for the cost in my view.Show less

Author: yashivramdarie
Title: Just what we needed on an
Review:
Just what we needed on an Asian holiday. Warm comforting Italian food! Awesome service and even better food! A must to anyone wanting Italian in Langkawi! 

PS. Apologies for the finished plate. Food was that good that I forgot to take a pic before!

Author: HertsOldie
Title: Excellent Lunch
Review:
Bargain 3 course lunch for RM38. Excellent cooking, one of the best Italian restaurants in Malaysia and certainly on the island. 

We eat here several times every time we visit Langkawi. Highly reccomended.

Author: Emmar1234567
Title: Really nice restaurant!
Review: Good service and excellent food! We ate everything from duck, pasta to fish and everything was great! And we also had appetizers and desserts, and Italian wine and everyone was more than satisfied. Can really recommend this place!

Author: AnnaR8287
Title: Great Italian food!
Review: We wanted to try out European food one day as a change from all great Asian dishes. This was a very positive experience. If you like Italian food and wine - go here!

Author: LauraHdezGlez
Title: Buonissimo!
Review: Really nice and tasty food. We tried the seabass carpaccio and two different pasta dishes; everything was perfect, my baby lobster pasta was particularly amazing. Good atmosphere and lovely Italian manager! cheers guys.

Author: W8967VEsusanp
Title: Superb
Review: We have visited Gallo Nero for a second time while staying in Langkawi. The food, atmosphere and service are to be applauded. Would highly recommend this place to anyone who is visiting Langkawi.

Author: MJMJM1963Sydney, Australia
Title: Decent food Poor service
Review: I went here after reading mixed reviews on Trip Advisor.The food was decent, the bisque served with the mussels was too watery and the Penne was not home made as we were led to believe.The service was a whole different story, shocking, we had to ask for a wine list, when we did get wine we were left to refill our glasses ourselves, our 1/3full bottle of water was taken from the table and when I requested a refill I was given a new bottle and of course charged for it, I brought this to their attention only to be told I was wrong.When a client spends 300rm+ you do not treat them like that.Lesson here if they try to steal from your table stop them because once its gone it was never actually there.The manager was on duty but aside from chatting to a few clients he did nothing to ensure his staff attended to their customers.All in all this was very poor value for the outlay.Show less

Author: 259kopp
Title: Waiting, waiting
Review: If you want to wait 75 minutes for simples pastas, this is your place. If not: forget it. The announcement before was: it tooks ten oder some more minutes, to prepare the meal.

Author: keeleyellisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very disappointing experience.
Review: Very disappointing experience. The service was extremely slow took nearly 1 hour for our main course to arrive .. the menu says fresh pasta and we actually saw them take a bag of dried shop bought Penne pasta into the kitchen to cook for us ... the food was extremely average, the wine we ordered in fairness was nice but over priced . The lamb shank was served cold and had no flavor and was tough .. you don’t serve cold food it’s not acceptable. I wouldn’t recommend this place. We even travelled 30 min in a taxi as was expecting an amazing Italian meal .. sadly wasn’t the case. Show less

Author: ZhenJ8
Title: To own of restaurant gallo
Review: Food was excellent n price cheaper too, staff with good services.my kid n my hubby love it so much n my hubby say the best restaurants in langkawi food was fresh.

Author: David R
Title: Don't let the decor influence you.
Review: Lets start with the cocktails which were excellent and great value, other than that thoughts are extremely overrated. Starters average and steaks extremely poor along with the service and wine. We probably should of ordered from the wine list but as they say do you ever receive a bad Italian house wine? On this occasion it was the worst I've ever tasted. Owner clearly passionate and we liked the concept but the execution was all wrong. Perhaps it depends what you're used to, not worth the gamble given the price tag.Show less

Author: SD87Wolvo
Title: Distinctly average!
Review: We decided to visit after reading the raving recommendations.We ordered some cocktails which were great - unfortunately it was all pretty average after that. I had a caprese salad which is generally simple but tasty, on this occasion it was just simple, my partner had the croquettes which were reasonable (decent sauce but generally lacking much else). We ordered steaks (medium - well done) they came medium - rare so we sent them back, they came back much better but the raddicio side dish was just a bit bizarre, potatoes were ok. Maybe our expectations were too high but given it’s one of the most expensive meals we’ve had in Malaysia it should’ve been better. The carafe of merlot tasted and looked watered down, the service was not the best and we were not offered any limoncello - clearly our faces didn’t fit. If you’re bored of local cuisine and are looking for average Italian food then I would recommend otherwise I’d look elsewhere.Show less

Author: HPT89
Title: Excellent Italian Restaurant
Review: Great Italian Restaurant. Delicious foods, nice ambiance and good services. Reasonable price. Highly recommend.

Author: SiniStahle
Title: Great dinner
Review: Food was great and service was nice. Panna cotta was absolutely delicious. I recommend to everyone who is looking for fine dinner in Langkawi.

Author: Giuseppe B
Title: Excellent and authentic italian restaurant
Review:
We had a great time here, the restaurant is really nice and the food was superb. 
Authentic Italian taste, we will be definitely coming back here..highly recommend

Author: mimi1065
Title: Eccezionale
Review: Complimenti Gallo Nero for a wonderfully authentic Italian dinner outside of Italy. Really delicious food & the complimentary Limoncello at the end of the meal a nice touch...

Author: 678paolol
Title: Buonissimo
Review: Autentic Italian food and atmosphere created by Chef Lorenzo. Generous portion amazing food for reasonable price. Da provare 😋

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: My Favourite
Review: This is probably the best Italian restaurant on the island and the best thing is that there is not a pizza in sight!!I love the sweet potato gnocchi with blue cheese sauce which is a very rich, filling dish.On this visit the restaurant was very busy so there was a bit of a waiting time but no one seemed to be bothered and the food, when it arrived, was excellent as always.Show less

Author: Dexlovefood
Title: Best Italian restaurant.
Review: This is by far the best restaurant for a date in Langkawi, the lamb shank is so tender and so juicy. They gave a bread platter for start. We had the chocolate lava cake for dessert but its not called chocolate lava cake in the menu, I forget the name. The service was superb, waitress and chefs are very friendly. I would definitely come back here if I come to Langkawi again. Show less

Author: m0n0p0lin
Title: 5 star Italian restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Finally after so many fake restaurant in Langkawi. I find the real Italian Restaurant . I went 2 time and I find excellent atmosphere and Yummy food . If I will came I return to eat many excellent Italian dish . The taste is even Better then some Italian restauranti Italy . I High recommend . Show less

Author: mcaracGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Great
Review: Lovely restaurant . Great food and fabulous service. Nice touch with a bread plate for starters . Lamb was superb as was my husbands fish. Prosecco was really reasonable and we got a complimentary limoncello at end of meal . Chef came out to make sure everything was okShow less

Author: Tricia E
Title: This is real italian food cooked with passion!
Review: One of the best italian food in Malaysia and nice people. When you walk through the door time stands still and the experience begins. We have tried many dishes here and nothing disappoints. The wine selection is also excellent. We recommend this place to everyone, be it for lunch or dinner.Show less

Author: LangkawiD
Title: LOCAL DELIGHTS
Review: Gallo Nero is one of Langkawi’s delights, The Local sourced cheese was excellent I would highly recommend the cheese platter, generous portion of beef carpaccio, which again was excellent. Decor and lighting is ambient and adds to the dining experience, staff very attentive and helpful.

Author: PhuahKTKuah, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for dinner
Review: We have a lovely dinner a day before we leave langkawi. The food and service is excellent. Love the gnocchi where the sauce taste very strong. The lamb shank is so tender and it mix so well with the sauce. Personally think that the dessert is ok, I will try another dessert next time. Will definitely pay another visit next time. Show less

Author: shahrizansaad
Title: Best Steak
Review:
For those steak lover, here is the right place for you to have good & well prepared steak by chef (owner) with his own signature source. 

I’m not sure how many time i’ve keep repeating to come here for lunch/dinner, everything is tasty.

Author: 88gaian
Title: Best Italian food
Review: Been there last night, the ambience was calm and romantic. The waiter and waitress are very polite and patient. Environment was clean and neat.Food was excellent. Best that I ever have. Butter fish was great with creamy mushroom sauce. Potion was abit low but enough for normal people (I am a big eater). The gnocchi with ragoût bolognaise was delicious. Even the bread they serve was super nice. Can’t have enough of it. Definitely will come again. Price was at higher end but worthy.Show less

Author: corak747
Title: Tasty
Review: Really enjoyed the food and service so much that we ate there two out of the three nights that we stayed in Langkawi! Food was great and came in a timely manner, waiters and waitresses were always very eager to help us.

Author: garry p
Title: Absolutely the best Italian food in Langkawi!
Review: No visit to Langkawi would be complete without a visit to Gallo Nero beautifully presented Italian food using superb fresh ingredients.The sweet potato gnocchi served in a blue cheese and orange sauce was exquisite and the buffalo motzarello is a must have.Make sure you keep an extra night for a second visit!Show less

Author: Valerio D
Title: Great resturant
Review:
Lorenzo was so great,  I can't find  more words to  say thanks to him, he did everything  perfect, our dinners were perfect and done the way  we  liked.. Thanks again Lorenzo (Il magnifico ..lol )  and say hello  to  the girls as well 
Regards,
   Valerio

Author: Roam225381
Title: We don't mind going back to Langkawi for the dinner at Gallo Nero!
Review: ペナンに住む友人に勧められ行ってきました。シンガポールにも様々なイタリア料理屋はありますが、これほど美味しい料理は食べられません。新鮮な食材とシェフのこだわりを感じる品々に、このお店へ行くためにまたランカウイへ行きたいと思うほどです。ほかのイタリアンではなかなか食べることができなくなりそうなくらい、美味しいお店だったので、おすすめです。My friend in Penang, the foodie, suggested me to visit them. We tried on the first night and decided to go back on the last night as well. We had no words other than amazing for any dish came to our table. We had carpaccio of sea-bass, crab meat pasta, mozzarella, burrata, grilled sea-bass, gnocchi with basil pesto and tiramisu. we base in Singapore and I guess many people believe "oh in Singapore there must be so many places with this restaurant quality" but I must say, NO WAY!This restaurant provides the real food with the caring service. The freshness of ingredients and taste of chef's original recipe, you would not know what to say once you try them. See you again, hopefully soon, Gallo Nero!Show less

Author: Dommeltje14Mohnesee, Germany
Title: Very good!!
Review: We have been here 5 days, and eaten here 4 times and every time it was very good. The owner, Lorenzo, is italian and very nice and knows how italiaan food needs to be prepaired. The menu is very various and all are delicious. The waithers are very nice and friendly.Show less

Author: zjenpangKuching, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Came for dinner with family. was disappointed despite all the good reviews. Service was impeccable. However, food was far from satisfactory. the gnocci was overcooked. we also took the seafood platter. not all the items were fresh. the complementary bread had variety but fresh bread would be appreciated.given the restaurant’s pricing, was hoping for a better meal. Show less

Author: natalieng709Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic and authentic Italian restaurant
Review: Had their 3 courses lunch menu after read about their good reviews and we were not disappointed.Warm and attentive service and we love how Al dente the spaghetti was cooked to perfection. Top up with a glass of prosecco only cost rm12 which is a steal. Will definitely recommend and revisit. Show less

Author: 400lesleyrSeria, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Very happy customers
Review: Passing by and seen this restaurant - and what a lucky find.3 course meal set lunch menu for 38RM. They gave us the children’s menu (we have 3 kids ages 11,8 and 6) which they don’t normally do at lunch time.Kids loved their food. Great service, great food, great food and definitely recommend Show less

Author: 356jaswindersLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Black Cockerel
Review: This is a new Italian restaurant . It’s small and cosy and located in a strip mall. The service at the restaurant is exceptional . They are all very welcoming and the ambiance is good. The food is good - the mixed antipasti and the scallops gratinee were our starters and were both good . For main I had the linguine vongole - the amount of shellfish in the linguini was very generous and it was a great dish. The sea bass was grilled and we had a very dry Prosecco which was very reasonably priced . I thought the price to value ratio was very good and it’s certainly a restaurant I will return to.Show less

Author: GordonHartPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great Italian restaurant
Review: We chose to have dinner at Gallo Nero based on a comment from one of our friends. It is a little out of the way from the Beach area, but only a few ringgit in a Grab cab, and only took a few minutes to get there.The interior is very nice. Modern, clean and welcoming.Menu choices were good. Prices were reasonable as well.For starters we had the mushroom salad and burrito salad. Both were excellent. For mains we had Osso Bucco and the fried chicken. Again, very good.House wine was reasonably priced and good quality.The limoncello was good and was even better as it was given to us on the house.We would definitely go to Gallo Nero again.Show less

Author: sergioo2013Lima, Peru
Title: A must in Langkawi
Review: Do you want a break of Asian food? This is the place. Italian food coked by an Italian chef (Lorenzo), tasty food, lovely service and in the middle of the island. We live in Singapore and always miss good European food! We had a really nice dinner a looking forward to enjoying tomorrow’s lunch menu. He had a beef carpaccio as starter and fresh pasta as main dishes, to finally finish with a tiramisu, all with a bottle of red Italian wine. All we can say, thanks Lorenzo for such a great dinner!! All the best! Show less

Author: hollebollegeezaHaarlem, The Netherlands
Title: Superb lunch!
Review: Whereas many Italian restraurants in Malaysia serve food that is only mediocre, Gallo Nero is a real Italian restaurant with quality Italian food. We had their lunch menu (3 courses for only 38 RM). There is a selection of around three options per course. Bruschetta, pasta, tiramisu and coconut icecream were all very good. Lunch was served inside the restaurant which is air conditioned (although not too cold). Good music. Very friendly service. If we have time left would love to come again!Show less

Author: maddy_s_1fdChessington, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great staff
Review: I went on recommendation from trip advisor so it’s only fair that I leave a review as well! The restaurant is lovely to walk into, nicely done up and the tables are laid out really well. There is parking for free out the front as well.The staff were really friendly and one waitress in particular, Julia took the time to ask our names and how we were finding our trip. She also recommended places for us to see during our time in Langkawi. I liked that they gave everyone complementary bread and dip to start. I had duck for a main course and it was cooked perfectly! I would go back here and try other dishes but we found this place on our last night.Show less

Author: stevelincoln94Malaysia
Title: Must visit
Review: Set lunch was nice to have. In fact we were here for a weekend holiday and the meal here was one of the best meals compared to those seafood restaurants along the hotel chenang area. Definitely try it if you just came from the airport or heading there for a flight. Grazi ragazzi Show less

Author: flo2295
Title: Amazing lunch for amazing prices
Review: Feeling like in Italy, very nice personal, AMAZING food and the lunch was super cheap. 3 course menu for 38 Ringgit. It was so good we returned the same evening as we had to leave the day after. Very very good!

Author: darknight1973
Title: Nice Italian food
Review: Quiet place with nice Italian food. Servers are friendly too. Tried their ravioli and wasn’t disappointed at all.

Author: moradez
Title: Nice and quite place
Review:
You should go there if you want good food and quite place. The product are very good quality and the Italian wine is good.
According to me, it is one of the best table on the island.

Author: Sian G
Title: Outstanding food as always
Review: Totally memorable and delicious Italian food cooked to perfection. Pasta is homemade and Al dente, slow cooked duck was to die for. Love this place. And the prices are so reasonable too. Very child friendly  and accommodating even with my boisterous toddler.

Author: midnight-moonHarrogate, United Kingdom
Title: Really tasty
Review: (Bit late writing this-visited about a month ago)After being ill I wanted something my stomach was a little more used to.Really friendly staff, chef came to talk to us and talked through the menu. Partner had a starter which was great and mains were both super tasty. Enjoyed it so much that came back the next night! Welcomed back like we were family, really nice owner and staff! Really enjoyed our meals again and offered limoncellos to end with. Really recommend visiting this restaurant Show less

Author: MaggieG5678Ashford, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely home cooked Italian food
Review: I was taken to Gallo Nero last year when I was in Langkawi. I really enjoyed the food. I had the duck with orange sauce which was lovely and all my friends enjoyed their food. I went again this year and had the duck ragu which was fantastic so returned for a second visit. This time I had the 3 course set menu for 38MR which didn't disappoint and was great value. The staff are friendly and I can highly recommend this if you like Italian food. I will definitely return next time I am back in Langkawi Show less

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: This restaurant is great for Italian food and the food never disappoints.There is a great 3 course menu for 38RM, which is excellent value. I chose from the al la carte menu and the sweet potato gnocchi with blue cheese sauce was amazing.A very warm welcome from the staff and good, attentive service.Show less

Author: cindymarieazur
Title: Great place, food and staff
Review:
Overall we’re happy with food, drinks and place. Can say that it’s hidden place for great Italian restaurant and wonderful service :)
Will definitely come back to have dinner.

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great Evening
Review: We , was there for Dinner with our Friends . 9 of us .And all of us . We had a Amazing Evening . Delicious Food and a nice Wine . Great Service and very nice Location!When you are in Langkawi ...Is a must to go to Gallo Nero Restaurant in Padang Matsirat .AMAZING !Show less

Author: Astartatr
Title: Nice dinner
Review: We visited this restaurant several times during our stay in Langkawi. This place is the best in island, if you searching for Italian cuisine with great choice of wines. Stuff is beyond any expectation. Food is delicious. Highly recommended.

Author: HenkW164Neuchatel, Switzerland
Title: Contemporary Italian restaurant with great food.
Review: Contemporary Italian restaurant with great food. Seafood linguini and ravioli with truffle were excellent. Good choice of wines and grappa.Service was friendly and efficient. Owner Lorenzo came to our table to greet us.Although located some 20 mins away from Pantai Cenang, this place is well worth a detour.Very reasonable prices. Show less

Author: gekteng28
Title: One of the best dinner spots in the island
Review: I was raised in this small island, always like exploring new restaurants with my family. I’d highly recommend this restaurant for dinner! My seabass fillet was well cooked and juicy, though I thought it’ll be better to have more greens for the side. The ambience is great for a cosy dinner with family or friends. There are also a few vegetarian options. The price is reasonable considering the portion of the food! Show less

Author: ofantiLumut, Malaysia
Title: Original Italian Restaurant
Review: Fine environment, quality service and tasteful food. Really an Italian experience in Langkawi. We had to return three more times during our stay in the island, so much the kids loved. Try the coconut water and peach juice for drinking. Full course menu, very well prepared.For sure you will enjoy having a lunch or dinner there, we totally recommend like much many more users of TripAdvisor!Show less

Author: SimonW4283
Title: Authentic Italian, Clean & Modern
Review: Clean, modern and fresh. Best Italian, great service and excellent value with the lunch time set menu. Highly recommended. You won't find better in Langkawi.

Author: leannpsu23Woodstock, Georgia
Title: Wonderful Italian food in Langkawi
Review: We visited at 7pm on a Saturday and were promptly seated. The menu had a great selection of appetizers, salads, pasta dishes, and main course meals. We shared the special salad- warm mushrooms cooked to perfection, walnuts, and blue cheese. It was wonderful. For our main course my husband chose the tuna steak and I had the special mushroom ravioli. Both were amazing. We were staying at the Ritz and were not sure if the cab ride would be worth the trip into town to eat. We are so glad that we did. Amazing meal. Highly recommend. Advice- use grab app ( similar to Uber) to save a substantial amount on cab fare from your resort.Show less

Author: Sian GSingapore, Singapore
Title: A real gem of a restaurant. Highly recommended
Review: My husband, toddler and me had a wonderful lunch here. Possibly the best homemade gnocchi I've had - ever (including in Italy and the UK). The set menu was all delicious and fantastic value for 3 fresh, delicious courses. The chef and owner is a lovely guy who's created one of the best restaurants on the island, Asia and beyond! We will be back for many many more, meals.Show less

Author: Veronica C
Title: Delicious lunch set
Review: Gallo Nero was recommended by our host and we decided to have our first lunch in Langkawi by visiting it few days ago. We were not disappointed. The lunch was fresh and served by polite waiters. The restaurant is clean and decorated tastefully.

Author: LipSengYap
Title: Hidden Gem Authentic Italian Cuisine
Review: Not your usual location for a decent Italian Restaurant but Gallo Nero does exceptionally well even for lunch. Chef & owner makes sure of perfection, and decent wine accompanies the meal. Reasonably priced too.

Author: Garry700Melbourne, Australia
Title: TOP Quality
Review: This restaurant is only a short walk from the Smith House Hotel my girlfriend and I thought it looked nice and what a surprise even better than it looks almost brand new Italian chef and owner who really knows his stuff the food was sensational nice wine list and very friendly staff you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Sanj130
Title: Brilliant Italian food and great service
Review: All the reviews are true about this place. Great service, nice food and reasonably priced, including the wine. I highly recommend this place.

Author: eddymayaYork, United Kingdom
Title: Not quiet up to scratch
Review: My lovely wife and I visited Gallo Nero for dinner one evening. We were staying just 10 minutes drive away and this coupled with the desire to escape the hustle & bustle of the main strip of bars & restaurants was enough to convince us to give them a go. It's a nice, stylishly decorated place with white tablecloths and more staff than customers. It's run by a guy from Milan so it's only fair to judge the food by Italian standards. And unfortunately it doesn't quiet measure up. I had the spaghetti alla vongole, a dish I have enjoyed many times in Italy. The clams were nice enough but the dish was lacking in something. Maybe not enough chilli? Or garlic? Or seasoning? Or perhaps the olive oil wasn't high enough quality? Nice enough but not quite right. My wife had the pasta from the daily specials, which was penne with fresh tuna, tomatoes, chilli and capers. Again it was fine but not great. She said the version of this dish I cook at home is nicer. Prices were a bit on the high side with the bill coming to nearly RM100 including one beer and one soft drink. So all in all not brilliant. Not worth going out of your way for but if like us you're staying nearby then you may want to pop by.Show less

Author: 970cristinew
Title: One of the best Italian restaurants in the Region ;)
Review:
Good Italian wine selection with reasonable prices ! 
Good food and good service 
Must visit when you looking for Italian cuisine

Author: Seniortravelers1
Title: Vacationing
Review: Make it a point to visit this restaurant for dinner. The food is fabulous!! What sets this Italian restaurant apart from others in Langkawi is the owner is from Milan so the food is very authentic. The staff is great. This is a must-visit restaurant on your checklist of restaurants to try in Langkawi.Show less

Author: RebeccaR638Stockholm, Sweden
Title: You won’t get this pasta even in Italy!
Review: Went without any expectations, because who would think one would get Italian pasta in Malaysia. Such an unexpected culinary experience - you couldn’t wish for better pasta even in Italy. The chef is very Italian and from Milan, which might explain it. In busy times you might have to wait a while but it’s compensated by delicious, good quality Italian food! We got passion pannacotta and limoncello ”on the house”. Very much recommended!Show less

Author: natashap697Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best dinner in Langkawi!
Review: We had dinner at Gallo Nero. The food was amazing! The best western food we had in Malaysia, much better than the 5 star resort we stayed at. The service was excellent, very attentive wait staff and the chef was very friendly. Cannot recommend this restaurant highly enough. A must for dinner in Langkawi Show less

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Italian Restaurant
Review: Visited Gallo Nero for lunch as we were unable to get into our first choice.We went for the 38RM set lunch/dinner. Great value for excellent cooking. I had the gratinated baby scallops and my wife the salmon as starters. For mains I chose the pan fried sea bass and my wife the penne. We both had the ice cream dessert.The food was really good and the sea bass was perfection. I have visited many Italian restaurants in SE Asia but Gallio Nero is amongst the best. I could easily believe I was in Italy the food was so good.We were so pleased our first choice was full and we had the opportunity to eat at Gallio Nero.Show less

Author: tzerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hidden gem in langkawi
Review: Interesting restaurant sits in a Malay village district. Choices of foods are not extensive however every dish is worth to try! Love their steak!! Above average quality with reasonable price! Nespresso coffee. Service is top notch maybe due to restaurant not busy. Overall a quiet and decent place to enjoy a couple dinner.Show less

Author: K3444ARclaudiorChaweng, Thailand
Title: Good food
Review: Visited this place in January 2019 to take break from local food. We had the bruschetta and Carpaccio for starters which was very good. For mains we had the pasta arrabiata and the spring chicken. The pasta was good the chicken lacked some flavor. The service was not great. Show less

Author: Elepenapa
Title: Excellent Italian food
Review: We had dinner three times there and the food has been excellent every time. The gnocchi are delicious and the panna cotta something to die for! Really good service too. We tried the cassata too, which was nice, but too frozen, to really appreciate the taste. A little disappointment is that they use plastic straws. Not sure why you even need one with lemonade. Anyway, we would totally recommend eating there.Show less

Author: rathit2014Alor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: My friend and I had lunch on Tuesday 18th Dec as it came highly recommended plus we have dined when it was at a different location on the island. I had set lunch and my friend alcarte menu. Service was good but food was below expectation. Don't be deceived by the beautiful presentations. We have dined in Italian restaurants and known how the food is suppose to taste. Set meal selected the carrot pumpkin soup which was tasteless and bland. It was just a corse thick puree. Neither was it a soup nor a broth. Crab cake tasted more of potato rather than crab. Main course the pasta rigatoni for set meal was not cooked properly (we do know how al dante should taste) and the sauce (which was just slightly coating the pasta) tasted like a Maggie seasoning cube was used with just a small teaspoon of mozzarella or goat cheese on the middle. We had a hard time chewing the pasta. Risotto was also not cooked down to perfection but the fish served on top of it tasted fresh and nice. Dessert we ordered the chocolate ice cream and panacota which was excellent. Our expectations was very high but was let down. Not to mentioned the entire lunch with just 3 beers ( mind you it's a duty free island ) was rather expensive bill around RM170.00 for lunch which we believe could have been better taste wise as it's owner and chef himself is Italian if I'm not mistaken. Show less

Author: TigerLibraAspen, Colorado
Title: Superb and authentic Italian food in Langkawi
Review: Lorenzo and his staff serve up superb food in a bright airy setting. The food was fresh, innovative, well prepared and served with care. Reasonable prices for great quality food. Highly recommend this restaurant for a much-needed change of pace from the usual (and often not very exciting) offerings on Langawai.Show less

Author: Jadji88Singapore
Title: Excellent Italian food in town...
Review: This restaurant does not disappoint at all! Went there today for dinner with wife and kid. We enjoyed the food very much. Must try:1. Lamb Shank - what can I say? It’s just sublime. Truly a labor of love. Thick brown sauce with deep red wine flavors. I dare you to suck the marrow out of the shank...2. Grilled octopus - perfectly cooked, charred evenly. The pesto sauce is excellent.The bread appetizer was great! Loved the puff pastry with tomato and the olives and garlic condiments are fantastic.Show less

Author: jamiecoote
Title: A lovely evening
Review:
We came here as we wanted a change from our hotel food, and so glad we did.
Very friendly staff and excellent food in a lovely clean well decorated restaurant made for an extremely good evening.
Would definitely go back 👍

Author: Kayleigh1610Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Delicious food!
Review: This place is really modern and clean with great food! They have the option of a set lunch menu, but we went for some food from the a la carte. My husband got the spring chicken and I went for the gnocchi with tomato and mozzarella. Both dishes were really tasty and fresh. The only slight downside to the gnocchi was the it was a tiny bit too oily. The staff are really friendly too. We will definitely go back. Show less

Author: Gabbygail56Kitchener, Canada
Title: We highly recommend the delicious gourmet food in this lovely spot
Review: We just arrived in Langkawi after three exhausting overnight flights and are staying at the Smith House hotel near the airport. We read many excellent reviews for Gallo Nero and were so happy that it turned out to be a short 5 minute walk from our hotel. The bruschetta, grilled sea bass and penne with salmon were amazing! So was the scrumptious semi fredddo with passion fruit coulis. We were not disappointed and hope to come back before we leave,Show less

Author: CaptainEvaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing lunch!
Review: Lorenzo surely is the only "real" Italian here on the island! I had been in his previous restaurants over the years many times but only recently in Gallo Nero as I was in Matsirat anyway.The set up lunch for some 38 Ringgit was absolutely amazing. I had the best pasta ever. Crispy ice cold white wine to wash it down!I will be a regular here, that's is for sure!Well done, Lorenzo!EvaShow less

Author: Educat2018Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: The best lunch I have had this year!
Review: Yes, I was hungry and yes we were lucky to find Gallo Nero open this Friday for lunch when normally they are closed for lunch on Fridays! I had superb crab meat and potato croquettes followed by egg fettuccine with beef ragout and a delightful ice desert for the give away price of RM38 for a really good three course meal! Washed down with a couple of ice-cold Tiger beers this was the perfect lunch! The fettuccine was al-dente and everything including the presentation was just marvellous!Show less

Author: Helen L
Title: Truly Italian!
Review: Really good tasting food! Lamb shank and sea bass were really really nice. Excellent service!Service staff overheard that we were celebrating my hubby's birthday and initiated a surprise birthday song with lava cake! They were so sweet. Possibly the best lava cake I've ever eaten.Show less

Author: ZeeHamdan1989
Title: Authentically Italian!
Review:
Wow! Just wow! It was exquisite. Love the food, the ambience and the people! Highly recommended! The seafood linguine was superb and it was generous! Compliments to the chef. 

Zi, Azri, Akma, mus and baby aralynn ♥️

Author: Silvermartian
Title: Great food and service
Review: Didn't feel like eating in a hotel and was recommended to try this. Menu was interesting, excellent service and very good value. Turned out that the owner was a friend of the Head Chef at The Danna Hotel

Author: MarcelM2871
Title: Top care and attention
Review:
Lorenzo's restaurant is remarkable for it's attention and care for all aspects of a good meal.
I visited regularly in the last year and must say all food items are always succulent, service amicable, and great ambiance.
You want a GOOD restaurant, that's the place.

Author: Maxine Y
Title: I Love it.  Taste so Good!
Review: It been a while that I had a good & delicious Italian food.  This is real Italian food…Just fabulous! It was worth driving 40mins from my hotel. I will come back again.

Author: hn_4y
Title: 19,  Bandar Padang Matsurat
Review: Nice and real Italian food and have very good chef lorenzo  from italiy, when back to Langkawi we will come back

Author: EuniceLiuSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic and best in town
Review: The food is awesome. Authentic Italian cuisine. Chef Lorenzo is really nice and friendly, came out & talked to us most of the time. We enjoyed everything served in this restaurant. Chef arranged the special cheese platter to satisfy our craving. We really had a great time here. Can’t wait to come back. Love the burrata cheese so fresh and creamy. Mille Grazie Chef Lorenzo. Show less

Author: syashak2017
Title: Amazing food
Review: Me and my Japanese friend was surprised with the food. I been there once,last year,The food,still,was amazing, delicious,and portion was good. Nice ambience...my friend already plan to go there next time.. good wine selection too..

Author: olegrutkovskiTegalalang, Indonesia
Title: TOP Langkawi restaurant
Review: Absolutely amazing place with delicious food. Been there twice already and will return back for sure. First time this restaurant was recommended me by my host Didi. For me it was unbelievable to find the place with so high standards of service and food. The Chef Lorenzo is a master in what he cooks. I really enjoyed beef carpaccio, sea bass as well as deserts. In the restaurant u may find a good selection of wines. Second time was there after fishing and Chef Lorenzo cooked the fish we catch. Amazing experience. This is probably the best fish I’ve ever eaten. Highly recommend this place. Sure everyone will be happy with food and drinks. Thanks Lorenzo for his professionalism and my gastronomic satisfaction!Show less

Author: ascotchrisAscot, United Kingdom
Title: So Italian - So Good
Review: Visited this restaurant having seen reviews on TA and were so pleased we did.Best, most authentic Italian food I have had in a long time, even in Italy.If you are looking for Margarita Pizza or spag Bol this may not be for you but if you want honest, fresh food cooked with skill and passion and nicely presented you will love this place, as we did.We both had the tomato and buffalo mozzarella as a starter. The mozzarella was locally sourced (really!) and was a completely different product to the usual stretchy cheese served in most places. When cut, this became a soft, luscious cheese complimented by flavoursome tomato and a light dressing.For mains I tried the home made spaghetti with chilli and meaty perfectly cooked prawns. Yum. My husband had lamb shank which was a real star dish. The lamb just fell off the bone and was immersed in a gravy full of flavour, good enough to eat on its own. I couldn't manage a desert but had a taste of my husbands sorbet which was packed with fruit flavour and not too sweet.With a decent wine selection and finished off with a home made limoncello, perfection!The service from a young team was delightful and professional.My only regret about this restaurant is that it's not in KL where we currently reside and we will have to wait for our next visit to Langkawi to eat there again.Show less

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Fish de la Casa
Review: We was at a TOP Restaurant in Langkawi , Gallo Nero !Located in Padang Matsirat .Our Guests and Friends and our self Had a Amazing Fish Dinner ala Chef Lorenzo . He created a TOP Dinner for us Fish of the Day , yummy! Spaghetti with some Vegetables . For starters we have Mozzarella Cheese and Beef Carpatio.All was so Delicious , we can't Stop .Lecker Wine's and lovely Desserts !We all want say . Thank you so much for a Great Evening !The Service and Staff very nice and very Friendly!At Gallo Nero , we have a Feeling of a very warm Welcome! Thank you for everything Show less

Author: Douglas FSydney, Australia
Title: Stunning food at great prices
Review: Gallo Nero was really a surprise. The restaurant is located in quite plain area of town and looks nothing special from outside. Don't be fooled! The menu, food and staff are all outstanding. Lorenzo, the owner, is a very creative and skilled chef and every meal we had was superb. The staff are attentive and friendly and knowledgeable on the menu. Drinks are reasonably priced and the food is extremely good value. Thanks to Lorenzo and staff for 3 great experiences.Show less

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: The Best of fine dining with budget prices.
Review: I love this place, the chef is outstanding and always ready to meet your specific requirements. It is a lovely place for romance or simply meeting up with friends. The atmosphere is clean, lovely lighting and warm. It is a go to place as the price is not overly expensive and you certainly get your value for your dollar.The food is generally to die for and I love to go just to saviour and enjoy the colourful and energetic Chef.Show less

Author: flashman974
Title: Delicious as usual
Review: Popped in for lunch, 3 course lunch with 2 options, healthy, innovative, well presented and everything delicious. Favourite stop in this part of the island.

Author: Climber816591Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent value for money
Review: Food definitely above average. Price below average for this kind of restaurant. Wine is good too. Excellent value for money. Downside: a bit far from the most busy areas of the island, but well worth a visit. Definitely recommended - for lunch or dinner!Une découverte inattendue pour nous, mais très plaisante.Show less

Author: AlanM579Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Doing Italy Proud
Review: A salute to Lorenzo, the proprietor. And his friendly team. I salute him for opening a splendid restaurant in Padang Matsirat. It is near the airport and so easy to reach from tourist traps of Pantai Cenang and Pantai Tengah. Grab a Grab. It’s worth the trip and, if you’re driving, yes, you can get parked there. The food is not Italian stereotype stuff. It is interesting, varied and not ‘just another Italian restaurant’. It is cooked with love and does Italy proud. And, the prices for food and wine are reasonable indeed. I am a retiree and I don’t have a fat wallet. Finish off with a glass of homemade Limoncello. It’s delicious. Try not to break the delicate glass. The owner confesses to breaking three himself. Just a nasty glance at them can do it. I know this because, when he can, Lorenzo will come out from the kitchen and talk to his guests. What you think it important to him. Show less

Author: Angelbaby832
Title: Amazing Italian Restaurant in Langkawi!!
Review: Went there for birthday celebration. Loved the sweet potato gnocchi and duck breast. Good food and friendly service. Definitely will go again.

Author: adequate8Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: Tried and tested a number of Langkawi’s top rated restaurants and Gallo Nero is fat and away the best! very friendly and helpful staff, nice atmosphere with a clean environment.Location wise it’s around 15 mins in a cab from Cenang beach area and close to airport. We had the spaghetti with prawns (HUGE prawns!) and seafood linguine. Also shared the delicious bruschetta mozzarella for starter.Came to around 160RMB with 2 cocktails and ice creams for desert and worth it!Show less

Author: review_princess2010Gatley, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing authentic Italian!
Review: We shared a bruschetta starter and both had seafood/prawn pastas. All the food was absolutely 100% authentic Italian and absolutely delicious! Apparently it only opened recently, the chef had created a new cocktail menu and they offered us buy one get one free on them and asked for feedback! Really excellent service and lovely restaurant design with air con. Nice wine menu as well although we didn’t drink any wine. We took a 20 min cab from Cenang just to come here based on the reviews, and it did not disappoint! Around £40 total for 2x 3-course meals and a round of cocktails - excellent value. Show less

Author: nanthiwaphon
Title: Awesome Cocktails and Delicious Foods
Review: We enjoy our Cocktails and out Delicious Foods so much !Oh yes when you are in Langkawi .It's a must to go there . Gallo Nero offers you special Meals .The Owner and Chef he is a original Italian Guy . From Milan . And knows what to do in his Kitchen . He cooking with his Heart and Love ! And surprise you with very tasty Food . And nice Cocktails or Italian Wine's .We have Fettuccine with Duck Bolognese . Fried Pan Fish with boiled Potatoes .Both of our Meals was very very Delicious ! We like give for that Restaurant Gallo Nero 10 Star's .He deserve it !Also the decoration inside of Gallo Nero Restaurant very nice !And the Service to !And his Welcome Drink and Starter comes from his Heart i mean his Kitchen .We can really High Recommend Gallo Nero !Everything was Excellent for us !Thank you for a great Evening ! at Gallo Nero Restaurant Langkawi Gallo Nero Restaurant Langkawi Show less

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: One more Star
Review: Gallo Nero Restaurant Deserve one more Star Because of his Delicious Food!Great Wine's , Good Grappa , Nice Original Limoncello Great Location , Amazing Decorations And Awesome Chef , Lorenzo the Italian Guy from Milan Gallo Nero Restaurant do a Great Job Thank you , Grazie Lorenzo Show less

Author: Meg00001
Title: Delicious pasta!!
Review: Lovely, attentive staff and delicious food! The gnocchi was the perfect texture and the sauce was superb. We are hoping to go again before our trip is over.

Author: 654carters
Title: Go!! Don’t miss out!!
Review: This is a definite repeat.The restaurant had amazing food, is clean, has a fun atmosphere with great music, the staff is very friendly, and it caters to children.The chef visited our table when we ordered and was very happy to make food off the menu for our three children. We had high chairs for both little ones!! Bread came out literally a minute after ordering and children’s meals came out about ten minutes after that! It was fantastic service, and their pasta was honestly amazing!!To top it off, one of the waitresses took our baby a few times during dinner so all the adults could enjoy the meal at once! AMAZING AMAZING SERVICE!If I were to offer any constructive feedback at all, it would be that a “Watch Your Step” sign should be on the front door as one exits and on the restroom doors as one enters.This is an amazing restaurant. It’s the best food I’ve tried on the island!Show less

Author: 172jaynee
Title: Very happy!
Review: Just wanted some takeaway and chill time in my hotel room (although the restaurant looked nice!) thus decided to get takeaway. Service was friendly, prompt and git a complimentary glass of sparkling to ease the wait! Food was hot, flavoursome, and the most satisfying western cuisine ive had in malaysia. Show less

Author: Emily V
Title: food with friends
Review: Nice Italian Restaurant with good food & friendly service. I can recommend the sweet potato gnocchi as dish and the chocolade flan cake as dessert!

Author: lyndaclaytonTamworth, United Kingdom
Title: ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC MEAL
Review: This is a small, newly opened Italian Restaurant and we visited here whilst on our holiday in Langkawi. WOW, what a fantastic restaurant and great find. The food is amazing and the staff wer so helpful and kind. They went out of their way to order a taxi for us and when it didn't arrive, they arranged for their own driver to take us back to our hotel. Reasonably priced and a MUST to visitShow less

Author: jacqui c
Title: Amazing
Review: After reading reviews and wanting some pasta we ended up here. We were not disappointed. Beautiful food and the staff were attentive and friendly. Such a great night out. Thank you.

Author: EKRelaxo
Title: BEAUTIFUL!!!!
Review: Wow! Was not expecting this! The staff were attentive and friendly. And the food... WOW... I'm from Melbourne where we have a LOT of fantastic Italian restaurants, but this tops them all!

Author: HK C
Title: A dinner outing (hunt for western cuisines)
Review: 5/5, a must try. (Try the Risotto with fish, it's superb)Some food might need a touch more seasoning for some (black pepper + salt please) but overall the cooking is top notch.Its price is comparable to ones available in KL/PJ but the taste can be rivals.Show less

Author: fabiop463Sydney, Australia
Title: Great Italian food
Review: We started with the burrata, served with very tasty and sweet tomatoes and spaghetti with clams, slow cooked duck and seafood platter for 2 as mains and we finish it off with passionfruit panna cotta and Sicilian cassata. Overall a very well cooked meal in a nice and clean setup. Fairly good selection of Italian wines, both white and red. Show less

Author: owen04Christchurch, New Zealand
Title: What a Gem
Review: From the time we walked in when we were given very attentive service and offered free Prosecco and Campari and a child 'alcohol free' version right through to the end when we were given limoncello to finish off our meal we were suitably impressed. The owner/chef came out and met us and chatted about his food. His passion for food and his restaurant was very apparent. We started with Buffalo cheese and tomato which was incredible. Two of our fellow diners had gnocchi with blue cheese/hazelnuts. It is hard to describe how good this was. Mains consisted of lamb shank fettuccini with a rich meaty sauce and sea bass fillet on saffron risotto. This was all amazing but the gnocchi which was the highlight of the evening. Until we came to the desserts. The rich chocolate flan with chocolate icecream was to die for. This was a gem of a restaurant with great food, service and a lovely owner who knows how to cook! We just wish we had found it at the beginning of our holiday rather than at the end. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: Emily MManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious evening meal!
Review: Went here after reading all the reviews on TripAdvisor and we were not disappointed! This is a lovely Italian restaurant, very clean and modern in style inside with air con etc. On arrival we were given a welcome drink (alcoholic) and some bread and oil. We then ordered starters and mains each, we both ordered a fish-based main and could happily say the fish was cooked to perfection! Best fish we have had in Malaysia. It was fairly quiet when we went but had a nice chilled and intimate atmosphere. Wouldn't hesitate to go again if we had more time in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Gajah57Melbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent food and extremely good value
Review: We went there for lunch last Saturday. We had the set menu and shared each dish. On arrival we had some specialty bread with olive oil and balsamic. Entree was a salmon nicoise salad and also crab and potato croquettes. The salmon was perfectly cured. This was followed by penne with basil pesto and green vegetables. The other main was fish grilled to perfection with potato and salad. Both were delicious. Dessert was homemade chocolate cream with banana. Including a glass of pinot grigio all up costing 50 RM per head. Amazing quality and value. The service was also excellent. I would recommend it to anyone.Show less

Author: MurrayW53Perth
Title: Fine Dining at a reasonable price
Review: This restaurant should be number 1 on TripAdvisor . I went twice during my stay and each time the food was perfect.The moment you enter the restaurant you know your in for a treat. The white table clothes and cloth napkins to the great decor you know the food will be good. I started my meal with bruschetta followed by Seabass. Both were presented very well and tasted divine.The deserts were also fantastic. This is the best restaurant in Langkawi and it is worth the trip to get there. They have wine and beer but no cocktails.I feel that if they served cocktail drinks it would be perfect.It is located basically in Smith House Complex near the Airport.Show less

Author: ChristophN203
Title: Amazing food
Review: I wish we found the resraurant earlier. The whole setup is just perfect, you really feel to be in Italy. The staff are very helpful and Lorenzo the owner taking care of you. The food is really authentic Italian with best ingredients and made with perfection. We got the tip from other review to order tomato with mozzarella as a appetizer and it was the best mozzarella I've ever had.I had a rissoto with seabass, my wife linguine seafood and it was super tasty! As a dessert we choosed home made Sicilian Cassata Semifreddo and it was delish creamy melted in your mouth.Thanks again Lorenzo to made our night:-)Highly recommended if you are in the island!!!Show less

Author: Paradise571527
Title: Delicious dinner
Review: Just returned from a meal at Gallo Nero, we found it by accident and are so glad we did! The food was absolutely delicious, the service was great and the atmosphere was perfect. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone wanting a tasty and special meal! I have food allergies and the owner/chef personally came to our table to tell me whether I could eat certain dishes - fantastic.Show less

Author: renchung
Title: Good restaurant
Review:
We ordered pasta with a salad. Very good. Price is reasonable for what you get.

Only complaint is there were a few mosquitos, although it is indoor and air-con. Suggest to management to get a mosquito zapper or similar.

I'd come here again.

Author: Tresna WMaida Vale, Australia
Title: Amazing best meal ever
Review: Husband and I have just had an amazing meal. He had Sea Bass & said it was the best fish he has EVER eaten. My gnocchi was fantastic as were our entrees & desserts. Can't wait to go back for another meal. Staff are really lovely, music was just the right volume, just a fantastic evening. Give it a try. Thanks to the staf & owner, look forward to see you again soon.Show less

Author: Marie D
Title: Delicious
Review: We weren’t planning on visiting an Italian restaurant on our vacation in Langkawi but since the night market closed early and it is very close to the Smith House Hotel, we gave it a try.So glad we did! It started off with a delicious appetizer: bruchetta with Buffalo Mozzarella. I can tell you, even in Italy the mozzarella doesn’t always taste this good!Our waiter Wan explained that this Mozzarella is made on the Island Langkawi. So we were eating more local then we expected ;-)Our main dishes ware also very tastefull and the orange zabaglione didn’t disappoint either!Wan, colleagues and chef, thank you for the lovely dinner and making us feel welcome.We wish you all the best with your business in Langkawi!Show less

Author: 186janiem
Title: Best Buffalo mozzarella ever!
Review: Very restaurant and kitchen, great atmosphere, very nice staff and superb authentic (best in Langkawi) Italian food!!

Author: katieNLincs123Kirton in Lindsey, United Kingdom
Title: Mixed review
Review: Restaurant clean, spacious and with ACHad bruscettabto start. Very tasty and well presented. Then had garlic and chilli pasta. It was ok a bit oily for my liking. They didnt come round with black pepper or cheese which most italians do. My boyfriend has steak. The meat was nice however the whole dish in the potatoes and salad was smothered in balsamic vinegar so he left most of it. Ps welcome drink & nibbles was a lovely touch. Show less

Author: Tatiana L
Title: The best Italian restaurant!
Review: The best Italian restaurant on Langkawi! My friends and me were there two times during our holidays. The both times we were impressed with the variety and quality of the dishes and wine, with the professionalism of the chef and with the excellent service. The chef, the owner of the restaurant, is from Italy and cooks original Italien dishes from the lokal and Italian products. There is also the big choice of Italian wine. The price for the dinner was very affordable. Unfortunately this restaurant is on Langkawi and not in our hometown.Show less

Author: N9731YQnatalied
Title: Even better than most restaurants I've been to in Italy!
Review: At some restaurants I've been to in Italy I could only wish for a chef and food like this. The food is awesome. The staff is super friendly. Everything just seems to be so lovingly: ranging from food to interior. Just perfect! :) PS: Try the limoncello homemade by the chef. Show less

Author: reflectionsv37Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wow! What a great surprise!
Review: This restaurant has only been opened for a couple of months and yesterday we decided to stop in for lunch. The three course set lunch menu is probably the best deal on the island of Langkawi.We found the food fresh, creative, unique and delicious! The service was top notch and the presentation exquisite! This is not a pasta house. It's dishes are the creation of a talented chef with a menu that changes daily. You are certain to enjoy it.This will be regular place for lunch as we are running errands. We can't wait to go back!Show less

Author: phuiannlimPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Reasonable price and nice food
Review: Where could you find such a reasonable priced three courses set lunch? There are one or two choices in each course, with clear description stated on the menu. They provide complimentary bread with vinegar and olive oil to start off the meal and coffee to go with dessert. You may add RM12 for a glass of white wine to go with the set lunch. Not crowded during lunch time, and plenty of parking available as well. Will come back to try their a la carte menu!Show less

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: I have been wanting to try this restaurant and I certainly was not disappointed.A very friendly welcome from the staff and Chef Lorenzo and my dish of orange sweet potato gnocchi with blue cheese sauce, hazelnut and rocket was exceptional and probably very fattening, but who cares....!There were lots of very interesting vegetarian options on the menu, which does make a welcome change.Will definitely visit again and very soon.Show less

Author: Esther LMalaysia
Title: No Ala-Carte during lunch hour
Review: We went there for lunch but the waitress provided us set lunch menu. No Ala-Carte. Not kids friendly due to the limitation on the food choices. We have no choice but to leave the restaurant and look for another restaurant nearby.Show less

Author: ITan66Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious lunch
Review: My family had lunch here even before we checked into The Smith House, entrance of which is just round the corner. We were served complimentary bread with balsamic vinegar and olive oil. We ordered the set lunches on the menu and they were very good and reasonably priced.The staff are friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: JackY1003
Title: Overrated
Review: Food is below average & the staff ain't friendly at allCome for the lamb shank that some say it's the best ever.. wondering is that the 1st shank they ever had?Show less

Author: LauraM17277
Title: Amazing
Review: Went here for my mums birthday and they really took care of us! Amazing food, welcome drinks and they even sung her happy birthday! Thanks so much!

Author: Ingy1215Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing meal
Review: Wow this was an amazing meal from the complimentary bread and olives, prosecco and limoncello to delicious squid, tomato and mozzarella starters to the rib eye steak and seafood pasta to the panna cotta and cassata all just delicious and beautifully presented. Friendly waiter,Wan, and all the staff were friendly and welcoming. Felt very relaxed and welcome an unmissable restaurant if you are visiting Langkawi. Show less

Author: Suzann77United Kingdom
Title: Perfect!
Review: From the welcome at the door, excellent service & food throughout. We were offered a complementary drink on arrival to home made Limoncello to finish! I’m coeliac & the lovely chef/owner came to speak to me and assured me he understood my need for gluten free food (he even mentioned that he would not cross contaminate with gluten containing foods) He made his own bread & pasta & also gluten free pasta too. ‘Wan’ - what an amazing young man; who noticed that I had left a small amount of fresh tuna-he immediately offered to sauté it! Wow , such attentive staff. The bathroom was amongst the cleanest in Langkawi (honestly)! Thank you Show less

Author: Tracie M
Title: Excelllent restaurant!
Review: We were staying at The Smith House just down the road from this restaurant and ate here five times! Excellent Italian food - they specialise in seafood, which is very fresh - caught by the fisherman down the road! There are lots of choices if you prefer not to eat seafood though. Fantastic wine and a welcome drink and bread to dip on arrival. Very clean, friendly staff and a nice ambience.Show less

Author: Gee RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Creative Tasty and affordable Italian Restaurant
Review: I cannot fault the restaurant - it is as authentic Italian as you can get while respecting the local Malay clientele requirement for a pork free restaurant. As with any new restaurant I don't expect everything to be working like clockwork but in time they will get there. This is how it is for every new food outlet I believe.I have had to wait for food sure & it's no problemo, but this is Langkawi what's the rush? Anyhow all good things come to those who wait.I think now I have tried most items on the menu ( I share with my partner) and its exceptional food . I spoke to the owner on the few times I have been there and he comes across as a very driven person wanting to give the customer the best service and the best food plus he welcomes constructive criticism as he knows it can only help make the restaurant better. I will be back - Grazie!Show less
