Author: Steve211252Warrington, United Kingdom
Title: First Ever 5 stars For An Italian Restaurant
Review: What a fab surprise. We were staying at (very) nearby Smiths House and were recommended by several other guests to give Gallo Nero a try before we looked at anywhere else to eat. This was like homemade italian food as good as anything I have tasted in Italy and service better than i am used to in Italian restaurants. Really nice staff who are clearly proud of the experience/environment they are welcoming you into. They gave us a complimentary glass of coffee and were very knowledgeable about a menu that clearly changed frequently. Its not cheap but the whole experience is great value for money and really was highlight of our days spent in Langkawi.We both chose from the days specials and were delighted with portions and taste. We expressed our appreciation of food to a waiter and we were asked if we would like to chat to the chef who came to our table and proved to be a true food enthusiast delighted to chat to his customers. He even gave us free lemoncellos. Wish we had stayed there even longer and had the time to visit again. My highest recommendations possible.Show less

Author: DeftlyDPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Would we eat here again? Hell yes. Great restaurant.
Review: We have heard about this restaurant from a number of friends who rate it highly and eat here frequently. We were thrilled to be invited for lunch there as part of a group of 16 people. As you walk through the door the air con and the calming ambience hits you. The decor is tastefully done and very comfortable. We chose from the set menu, 38 MYR for 3 courses and coffee, and a glass of pinot griggio for an extra 12MYR. I had the mozzarella and tomato salad followed by a vegetarian pasta - this wasn't on the menu and was made specially for me. Dessert was raspberry ice cream. All of our food arrived at the same time and all of it was hot. I was amazed! The food was delicious, tasty and filling. The ice cream - well, one scoop was really not enough.The wifi was very fast and the bathrooms were spotless. All the staff were polite, friendly and helpful.Lorenzo clearly has a passion for his trade and this is evident through the whole restaurant, the decor, the food and the staff. Gallo Nero is a real gem of a place.Show less

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: The excellent food from an ever changing menu means you are never bored with the same old, same old
Review: The menu changes are lovely, just one or two dishes on an excellent menu just to make sure that you want to come back. It is extremely clean and tidy with a/c and wifi but it is the Chef that makes the highlight of this lovely place by coming out and greeting old and new friends. The services is above and beyond what you normally get here and definitely a favorite,Show less

Author: Anna L
Title: Authentic Italian food!
Review: Amazing gnocchi, they melt in your mouth and tasted much like my grandma’s ( best achievement possible for an italian). The Australian steak was also amazing and the staff very attentive! Definitely recommended.

Author: Joe R
Title: Fantastic every time
Review: My wife and I stumbled across Gallo Nero in December and fell in love with the place. Lorenzo is a wonderful host. The place is spotless and welcoming. The food is always amazing. We've been in many times since and love it. Lunch is a set menu for 38rm and is a great value for the quality of food.Show less

Author: federicoz534
Title: Buonissimo
Review:
Living on the island, Gallo Nero is one of my first options when i go to eat.
Good food, attentive staff, great location and last but not least the very friendly owner Lorenzo.
Thumb up!

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Dinner with Friends
Review: We had at Gallo Nero , amazing Dinner !We are 8 Persons . And all our different Dishes was great , Very Delicious!The Starters , Pastas , Chicken , Lamb and Fish also the Wines . And not forget the Sweets ...We all Happy at Gallo Nero on this Evening . That's why we want say thank you to the Kitchen Team . And also to the very Friendly Staff , all of them do a Great Job !Show less

Author: Pompey_JTPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: We were here for dinner a few days ago. Upon being seated we were offered bread to share and welcome drinks at the table.We were a group of 4 adults and 1 child. We had the lamb shank, pan fried sea bass, prawn spaghetti and the rissoto (with pan fried sea bass).We all really enjoyed our food, which was served to us by friendly staff in a great atmosphere - it was nice to dine in an air conditioned (more importantly clean and tidy) restaurant.We even met the Italian chef towards the end of the evening when he came out to introduce himself and spoke with all the customers.We would definitely be returning! See you next time!Show less

Author: 472petero
Title: Real Italian Cuisine
Review: Yesterday we ate the third time in this excellent Italian restaurant. The food was great and the price ratio is amazing. Even though the restaurant is not close to the tourist areas it is worth while to grab a cab or ride with your scooter.

Author: rustytoo
Title: Best
Review: This is one of the best restaurants in Langkawi. Went there four times and the food was excellent every time. The staff are all very friendly and helpful as is the owner/chef   Will definitely visit again.

Author: Takhmina Y
Title: Best Italian restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Loved the food and ambience. Owner is super friendly. Food is authentic. Atmosphere is semi-finedining.

Author: billym331
Title: Wondeful experience
Review: If you are on Langkawi take time to visit this little gem. Fantastic food and service. We will be back. Soon.

Author: 104LuisM
Title: A great host Lorenzo and a wonderfull food.
Review: Great and tasty Italian food. Better than several restaurants in Itália. A must in Langkawi.  Don't miss it when you're um holidays in this paradise on Earth

Author: WanderKattKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing!
Review: Food ordered were way below expectation. The fish was very salty. The chicken very dry and tough. The pasta was tasteless. Ordered additional bread but it was never served even when we reminded them again. Nice clean place does not make up for the poor quality food.Show less

Author: lodgen
Title: Wonderful Meals and experience
Review: We dined here on 2 nights whilst in Langkawi - everything was wonderful and top class - we were astounded to find such an authentic Italian restaurant, serving brilliant authentic Italian dishes.  The service is also attentive but not intrusive.  Great space.

Author: 116daveAbingdon, United Kingdom
Title: Little Italy
Review: My wife, her sister and myself visited Gallo Nero three times during our stay on the Island, each time we were treated brilliantly by the staff. The food was superb, having travelled widely in Italy this is the closest we have ever come to real Italian cuisine. On each of our visits the owner came and chatted to us, well done, one of Langkawi`s top restaurant.Show less

Author: junek187Helensburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent!
Review: We popped in for a light meal after just arriving at The Smith House . We were very impressed with the pasta that we ordered, it was fresh tasting and very flavourful. We would have like to have had more...but the jet lag kicked in from the flight from Australia and sleep beckoned. The staff were efficient and pleasant. Wan made us very comfortable, he obviously enjoys his job. We will return before we head home to Scotland, for a proper meal this time! Thank you.Show less

Author: Martin D
Title: Best dinner in langkawi
Review:
This is a must visit , great setting you 
Must not miss this ,food out of this world 
The evening was very good 10 out of 10 
Every time 👍

Author: Bedford2004Halifax, Canada
Title: Pure magic
Review: After a month on the road enjoying simple fare, a night at Gallo Nero was pure magic. The food is stellar (the octopus/squid appie, the lamb shank osso bucco, and the perfect pasta made us happy), but the vibe of the place really sets it apart. The owner/chef has created a refined but cheerful environment that shows in the superb staff team. The chef/owner did pop by to chat, but rather than feeling perfunctory, his personality brought an extra genuine quality. We left feeling perfectly sated in every regard ... and maybe even a little elevated.Show less

Author: peter wLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Faultless
Review: In no time this newly-opened restaurant would rank Langkawi top 3 restaurants simply because their food is amazing and service is faultless! Galle Nero offers superb menu - typical Italian fare (unfortunately minus pizza). Can't never get enough of their Beef and Seabass Carpacio, Sweet potato gnocchi and Seafood Linguine. Lava cake, Panna Cota and Tiramisu are too die for...Show less

Author: Anita M
Title: Gallo Nero
Review: Nice restaurant, friendly and efficient staff, if you like real italian food (not just pizza and pasta) this is the place to eat. Chef lorenzo does a great job. The tuna was perfect.

Author: francoise r
Title: Italian Street Food night
Review:
Absolutely superb. Food fabulous, atmosphere great and a lots of fun. Fantastic night.
Lorenzo and his staff created a wonderful evening.

Author: AdenS61
Title: Excellent food and service!
Review: Although a bit far from our hotel in Kuah, we decided to visit based on the recommendation of our hotel's manager , on our way back from the cable car. BEST Italian food since a very long time!Fresh, authentic, great value and superb wine selection.Pasta is to die for and the rib eye steak is tender and juicy!We will be back!Show less

Author: Katerinafortun
Title: Exellent Italian food and service!
Review: Delicious pasta, fish, seafood, desserts and wine! It is the best Italian restaurant that we discovered in our five months travelling in Asia. Soo good that we went back three times until we left the island. We very much appreciated the outstanding service and attention, and more over the chef’s recommendations. Bravo! Show less

Author: mikeleekcUSJ
Title: Delicious Authentic Italian Food
Review: I was staying in The Smith House and by chance I say this new Italian restaurant that was not there during my last trip there. I had the lunch set. It was absolutely wonderful. The food was excellent and authentic. To top that, we were attentively served by the waiters who were professional and polite. Special mention goes to Mr. Hisham. He is one friendly waiter that made us feel very comfortable.The set menu was also a steal as far as the price is concerned.Kudos to the Gallo Nero team.Show less

Author: GiovaJabba
Title: Excellent restaurant service and cheese
Review: Is rare to find an excellent Italian restaurant in Asia....but Gallo Nero is one of them. Big selection of wine...food and amazing locally produced Buffalo cheese

Author: Emma OSingapore, Singapore
Title: AMAZING Italian cuisine: so authentic
Review: What a lovely and unexpected surprise to discover this restaurant on our last night of holiday!! The food is 100% Italian, the sauces tasted like Italia, the pasta were amazing! The chef is dedicated and friendly! It was a pleasure to meet him! We were pleasantly surprised by the food and also by the staff, so well trained!! Kudos to Megat! Great job! We live in Singapore and regularly crave the food from that place! We will be back!! Also try the homemade lemoncello! Yummmmy!!!!Show less

Author: Sherry4873
Title: Nice
Review: Thank you for the good service and obviously nice food recommended to my family.... Credit to Megat, azie,hisham and zul. Those in langkawi should go to Gallo and try their Italian food. Will come back definitely

Author: superblue63Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Anniversary Suprise
Review: We went to this restaurant based on a recommendation from our host at ocean lodge Didi, he also gave us a lift there as it is slightly off the tourist area. The restaurant was beautiful the service was excellent and the food was simply amazing,I have enclosed a few photos but these certainly don’t do it justice. The restaurant is owned by Lorenzo who has worked in many places including London he came out after we finished our meal to speak with us as he did with all of the other tables nice touch.We also received complimentary breads and olives and a glass of prosecco once again a nice touch. Location is near the Smith house hotel and very near to the airport so if you are in Langkawi and you fancy something a little Italian please try this place we went for our anniversary and it was a great choice. It is not cheap but it is very reasonable for the quality of the food and service. We had three courses and a bottle of wine for just over forty pounds. Many thanks Lorenzo and your team for making this a special evening we will return again.Show less

Author: jasvinn
Title: Italian outing with friends
Review: Clean restaurant,friendly staff ,and excellent food what else I can ask for .... special thanks to Megat ,Azie, Hisham, & Zul thank you for the lovely evening.... we will for sure to come back & recommend to others .....

Author: CharlyCracKFerrol, Spain
Title: 15 min car drive for lunch, fail
Review: All the pictures are before the waitress took them back.The salad, bitter untouchable.The pasta... well, considering I made my way here to eat pasta in a Italian restaurant... It was almost al dente, needed 3 min more cooking and well, spicy flakes on it says so.. No taste, just spicy.Sad that in a Italian restaurant the only option for pasta, it's spicy.Coz btw, it just 1 menu, in Italian, so...OK so... The icecream, vanilla, cocholate topping, cloying chocolate topping. The waitress thing, seems the wait for someone coz they are going to the door all time. Show less

Author: Doug H
Title: we came back two times
Review: Wonderful meal the first time ... we came back two times and every thing just as good as on first visit  ...Chef/ owner Lorenzo and waiter Hisham  make this a great place.  Will definitely go again

Author: ValueSeeker83Lahad Datu, Malaysia
Title: Affortable 3-course fine dinning
Review: Entering the restaurant, I saw a wall-sized mirror one size while Jazz music was broadcasted. Having the lunch by myself, the staff still professionally serves the entre, maincourse and dessert in order. Fantastic foods. Croquette, pasta and a scoop of ice cream. Love the fact that with addition of RM 12, I can enjoy a glass of white wine. Hope that I can enjoy this meal with someone special. However, this area is next to a primary school and a mosque. So do choose the right time to come. Show less

Author: rustytoo
Title: Another excellent meal
Review: Wonderful meal here again  Third time and every thing just as good as on first visit   Chef/ owner Lorenzo and waiter Hisham  made our night one to always remember   Will definitely go again

Author: Rona N
Title: Always great
Review: Always happy when I left the restaurant . Great-food and efficient service . Really recommend this place if you are in Langkawi . Keep it up.

Author: Rian T
Title: Great dinner
Review: High quality food and nice and hospitable service. It’s close to The Smith House hotel as well, and they offer a discount for guests who stay there.

Author: DawnB62014Minneapolis, Minnesota
Title: A classy restaurant
Review: The staff at the restaurant did a good job and worked hard to provide a quality experience. The bread plate was a very tasty way to start the meal off, as was the complimentary glass of Prosecco. It was a good wine selection and we ended up getting a bottle. For dinner we got the steak which was prepared as ordered (medium well) and the chicken entree which was a very generous portion size. Very thing was tasty and we would definitely recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: TravelOver55British Columbia, Canada
Title: Fabulous
Review: Not many restaurants have an owner who really cares about customers. Lorenzo, the owner and chef, is spectacular. This small, intimate restaurant delivers on quality, service and atmosphere. His staff are very well trained and attentive. In fact, the experience was so delightful, we are returning, in six weeks from traveling, just to eat here again.Thank you, amd continued success!Show less

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Restaurant !
Review: When you are in Langkawi It's a must to go to Gallo Nero !Because of a Amazing Food !You have a wonderful Lunch or Dinner there . The Chef and owner is a Original Italian Guy . He always smiling and like to talk with his Guests . He offer you a Great Italian Dishes . Seafood or Pasta and more ... a lot of nice Wines !Also great Starters , Original Italian Coffee and more ...The Staff at Gallo Nero , very Professional and very Friendly!For us was a feeling we stay and eat on the Right Restaurant because we feel you are really Welcome !Thank You for everything!Show less

Author: nanthiwaphon
Title: Romantic Dinner
Review: Gallo Nero Restaurant offer us a very nice Romantic Dinner . The Food there is Amazing . And also the Wine Card is great. The Chef is also the Owner he cooking with his Heart . And he knows to cook . The Staff very Friendly and Professional . The Decoration inside the Restaurant so Wonderful .Thats why i can say when you are in Langkawi . It's a must to go there .We can really High Recommended that Restaurant Gallo Nero  Show less

Author: kirawi
Title: Excellent food!
Review:
Definitely best Italian restaurant in Langkawi!!! 
We went for a lunch; mozzarellasalad, pasta, ice cream and coffee costs 38MYR. Cheap and very delicious!😛

Author: Christopher O
Title: bad service
Review: Yesterday was my second visit to that restaurant. The first time when i went there for dinner was good. service & food were good. they will served you sparkling wine as a welcome drink, but i seldom drink alcoholic drinks especially with my family so the waiter offered me their fruit juice which i was so impress that time. However, yesterday dinner was terrible. i seldom comment especially in social media but yesterday the service really piss me off!!! Waiting for bread nearly 20 minutes. Inform the waitress to get me the bread first so that i can feed my baby. call for second , third time still not coming. only arrived nearly 20 minutes. I only order 2 main course which the food serve quite fast. No napkin for us, I had to ask for napkins. I spoke to the waitress that you do served welcome drinks when guest arrive but i did not get it. the waitress apologize to me that they are busy. ( i assume will get the same service like my first visit which she will offer me) However, she just walk off. After finished my meal i went to counter to settle the bill & inform the senior person that i was not really happy about the service experience today. The gentleman say sorry & inform me the service will be better next time for mine next visit. i wrote this comment so that their boss will be alert because he always busy in the kitchen.Show less

Author: AnmcanmcVejle, Denmark
Title: Don't leave Langkawi before dining here!
Review: This was not what we expected, it was so much more!!Lovely Italian food! Home baked bread, olive oil and good Italian wine.We had the gnocchi with fresh basil pesto and the spring chicken.So so good!Just a good tip, say yes to the pink sparkling welcome drink, it's so delicious!Show less

Author: Michymosh
Title: Ogni aspetto eccellente
Review: Authentic and delicious Italian eating experience! Well thought-out menu choices, just the right list of wine selections, definitely returning as soon as possible!

Author: JJGraf
Title: Fantastic food
Review: went there for Dinner with my wife. We had the ricotta gnocchi on blue cheese sauce and the tortellini,  both home made and truly delicious.

Author: shilpan2018
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Having driven past this newly opened restaurant a few times, we decided to try it last night. The interiors are quite stylish and warm... love the flooring and quirky art on the wall. They serve sparkling wine as welcome drink and a plate of three types of bread with olive oil as welcome snack. The food is quite nice and authentic, tortellini with spinach and ricotta was my favourite and rocket leaves salad with cheese was good too. Panna cotta was the best I had in a long time. Wan was in-charge of our table and was very attentive and engaging. Definitely a gem in Langkawi and sure as time passes will be one of best in Langkawi. My only suggestion is to include pizza and a few more vegetarian options. We shall be back Show less

Author: Monica2109
Title: Italian gem in the middle of Langkawi
Review: Wonderful Italian food. Great service from Megat and team. Absolutely recommend making the effort to visit. 5 stars.

Author: GrandparentsGoGlobalCasper, Wyoming
Title: Another night out to dinner.
Review: This is a new resturant as I understand it, just a few months old. However, owner and executive chef Lorenzo Zecubi (he is from Italy) certainly has a all the right instincts in the right places.The resturant is located in an attractive strip mall for Langkawi and the inside of the smallish resturant is tastefully decorated. This is not a terribly expensive resturant and it is very kid friendly.The food was well prepared and tasty. The wine list was a little thin and of what they listed two varieties of table wine were no longer in stock. The list is essentially table wines. If you want library wines go elsewhere.There is plenty of staff and they are responsive with decent English skills.Do stop here on your stay in Langkawi. You will likely not be disappointed and Lorenzo will personally visit your table to insure your satisfaction.Show less

Author: JOEY529London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious authentic and affordable
Review: Coming from an Italian I can tell you the food is very good! And the prices very fair. The staff are very friendly and professional. They give free bread at the start like a true Italian restaurant! The prosecco welcome drink is a beautiful touch. Would come time and time again if I was here for longer. I wish this new restaurant lots of success they deserve it! Show less

Author: Julie F
Title: This is a new place, with a chef beyond par..
Review: This is small and intimate, with full on par excellence service and food to die for.  A MUST!  Atmosphere and above excellence in menu choice ( small but certainly something for everyone.)  The chef will cook to your specific request without hesitation.

Author: Compass719507
Title: Perfect meal lovely food
Review: The food here was gorgeous, cooked to perfection! Wine also very nice , if your looking for great Italian this is the place to go!! Come away from the touristy area and eat some amazing food , good prices and feel like a fine dining experience. The service was also perfect , Hisham our waiter very professional and friendly really felt like a 5 * experience, really recommend. Show less

Author: genevievew2018
Title: Great 3 courses
Review: Came back for the second time to try the carpacio & zabaglione, both were fantastic. Our daughter came backk for the bruschetta, highly recommend for a family or a romantic evening.

Author: Dion P
Title: Great restaurant !!
Review: A real gem. Great food and great service. Stumbled across this not knowing any reviews. A thoroughly enjoyable atmosphere. We will be back!

Author: francoise rLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: New restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Italian Restaurant, absolutely delicious. Excellent carpaccio sea bass, fantastic duo of octopus ans squids, the choice of the menu is not too big it means everything is fresh and frequently changed.The decor is modern and unusual for Langkawi.Excellent staff, doing their best and of course Lorenzo the owner chef is great. Go for lunch or dinner you will love, but it is not a pizzeria !!!!Show less

Author: rustytoo
Title: Wonderful food
Review:
This restaurant is excellent in every way. The food  the staff the restaurant itself, cannot fault it.
Had pasta for starter which was very very nice and steak for main course, excellent and wonderful panna cotta to finish.
Would recommend to everyone

Author: Gastr0_N0madSingapore, Singapore
Title: COMFORT FOOD WITH A CONTEMPORARY TWIST
Review: We loved the pasta selection, especially the spinach ravioli with a surprisingly good local mozzarella. A place where you can enjoy the classics, but with a hint of contemporary execution. The brined baked quail was a perfect example of the later, juicy with a crispy skin.It was a welcome change from the range of dining choices on the island, both for lunch and dinner.Show less

Author: Geert L
Title: What a pleasant surprise!
Review: Perfect Italian restaurant just around the corner of the Smith House (our hotel). Great carpaccio, excellent duck and risotto, amazing zabaglione!

Author: Sharon Tderby
Title: Quite nice
Review: We visited here twice during our stay in Langkawi , its a very clean and modern restaurant something which is quite hard to come by in this area. The food we had was good but we did find the menu a little limited choice wise - no pizza , and the pasta sauces were a bit limited . Service was a little up and downShow less

Author: yummyy2014
Title: Best duck ever!
Review:
Located just in the corner our hotel, The Smith House. Cozy & modern place for dinner after travelled around the island.
The carpaccio was great and the duck was amazing!
Must place to go while in Langkawi specially when you’re staying in the smith house

Author: sixdegreesN
Title: Great Italian!
Review: Super food, great service!  We will be back for sure.  Lovely new modern, Italian restaurant. Easy to find, easy parking or to get there by taxi.

Author: O6693NHkevino
Title: Delicious
Review: Excellent restaurant, the food is superb, I had sea bass fillets, and my wife had lamb shank. I tasted my wife's lamb shank, and we both agreed it was one of the best shanks we had tasted. My fish was very good as well. The quality of the food, was also matched by the excellent service. Both meals were at a fair price, about half we would pay back in the UK.Show less

Author: TomPelota
Title: Excellent set lunch menu for less than 40rm!
Review: While staying at Smith House, popped in for a quick lunch and was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food. As good as any chain Italian in London but a fraction of the price.

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great dinner and great atmosphere
Review: It was my company year end dinner and we had a very good italian dinner at this place! There are many italian restaurant in langkawi but the food here is something very italian make you remember for its cruisine! Even our kids were dancing on the floor after the dinner! Highly recommendation for all to try it! Thank you mr. Lorenzo for the wonderful setting and arrangement! Show less

Author: joshuaknight50
Title: Italian delight
Review: Well we heard about this little gem from a local, and were not disappointed! Excellent staff great food very close to the Smith house so if you are staying there it’s a must !

Author: hong45
Title: beef carpaccio best in langkawi.
Review: Lorenzo took some timeto open but the result is there. A very welcome Italian restaurant in the over flooded restaurant business of langkawi. A must to go!

Author: Wendie GToronto, Canada
Title: Excellent service and food
Review: Located at The Smith House; guests of TSH get 10% discount so of course we went and were glad we did. Bread and Prosecco gratis was brought to the table which was lovely. The server gave us a taste of the house red and was glad he did b/c we decided to get a bottle of something else. I had gnocchi and my partner had spaghetti and both were excellent. My partner asked for the tuna spaghetti without the tuna since we do not eat meat or seafood and I believe he was still charged the full price. Too bad. Really he wanted the ravioli which was on the set menu but apparently it wasn't ready yet even though it was 7pm. For dessert, we had the strawberries with raspberry sorbet which was fresh and tasty. All was excellent but I do wish they had more veg options.Show less

Author: AndyT2667
Title: Very good
Review: Very good food, friendly staff and nice experience. Clean, and set meals are very affordable. Highly recommended though not in town but worth the effort to go there for a nice Italian meal.

Author: Jason E
Title: I enjoyed it!!
Review: Very pleasant eating experience, wonderful staff (very attentive), fine food.  Some more vegan options would make it a perfect experience nevertheless myself and my two companions thoroughly enjoyed.  If you like pop-art you will also admire the decor!!

Author: nuurulmaulidya
Title: Uncommon & Unforgettable!
Review: Went there for my birthday.  The food we had was delicious and uncommon! Besides warm welcoming from the staff, my husband & I had a real pleasure enjoying what been served. Definitely will return again.

Author: Adrian PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wow wow *wow*
Review: The ambience is great, the staff attentive , kind and well trained, it's a good feeling when the people serving actually care.So the food. Well that's another story, a level above most and superb. If your visiting Langkawi don't miss this place if you have a special celebration. Show less

Author: Educat2018Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Mediterranean cuisine
Review: We know the owner and chef, Lorenzo , from his days at The Brasserie at Pantai Cenang. At The Black Rooster, Lorenzo is presenting a brilliant Italian menu and delivering it with style and panache. Gudrun and I thoroughly enjoyed the food, the ambiance, the service and the value for money. A real gem and a really great restaurant. We'll definitely be back!Show less

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: We want to eat typical Italian Food
Review: We hear , not far from our Place , is a real typical Italian Restaurant .And the Chef is also Italian .Okay , we said let's go ...And we are all can say . That's was the right choice ! I know from what I talk . I work , for some Italian Brand ... and I go many often to Italy for my Business ...And for Today , I so surprised . I can go on this lovely Island . To a real Italian Restaurant Gallo Nero . Only the Name , is Amazing ! The Location , is near by the Airport . Staff , very Professional and Friendly ! Great Service !When you read the Menu , it's very difficult to choose what you like to eat . Because all of the Offers sounds great .Also the Wines ...And the Chef , Lorenzo . Comes to your Table. And offers his Special Dinner . I follow his offers and all was very Delicious! Thank you !See you sure again !Kind Regards DietmarShow less

Author: Tom_SLAMalton, United Kingdom
Title: FANTASTIC & AUTHENTIC Italian Food
Review: My wife & I really wanted a salad for lunch & happened to drive past this Italian.I highly recommend going - whatever food you are in the mood for. The place is really great quality decoration inside, the owner Lorenzo is the chef there also & the food is absolutely classic authentic Italian.We tried 5 dishes (including the sorbet for desert) & everyone was excellent!!!We will return for 1 more meal - probably a dinner. Highly recommended - whatever mood & whoever you are with...Thank youShow less

Author: Rustyslass
Title: Simple but very tasty
Review: What a great little place. Great home style schnitzel, lovely staff and a laid back simple vibe. Definitely worth seeking out

Author: chateaudep
Title: A charming place
Review: One of the best restaurant on the island, it looks like the 30's. The food is just marvelous. We appreciate wednesday's curry receipes.

Author: criisalbarran
Title: Really nice food and attentive
Review: Really nice food and attentive service! The ambiance is really fun and they make you feel like home. The burger is just one of the best ones and tallest ones I have ever seen and tried!

Author: tourcoxCulver City, California
Title: Great Food, Great Atmosphere, Wonderful Staff
Review: We ate there after reading reviews on this site. Initially we could not find the Restaurant, but after telephoning, The owner, guided us to it & was waving to us from outside. The restaurant is a gem on Langkawi, , very delicious food, wonderful service & a great atmosphere. We will certainly return next time we are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: mariagE8740PS
Title: Really nice restaurant!
Review: The place is really nice and beautiful! We ate the fish steak and chicken schnitzel and both were good ! The best was the pavlova!!

Author: 703shaunm
Title: Great service, welcoming and relaxed atmosphere with great food.
Review: A hidden oasis that was a dining experience highlight on our Langkawi holiday. We discovered Mangoes by word of mouth. Luckily for us they were open on Sunday (our last full day in Langkawi!!!) for lunch. We were not disappointed and will definitely return on our next visit.Show less

Author: 397maximep
Title: Authentic but mediocre Aussie grub
Review: Nice little place with very nice people. Soup was good but mains were disappointing and bland. If you’re a middle-aged Anglo tourist looking for hearty comfort food you’ll like it though. That’s clearly the target audience.

Author: packrat95
Title: Delicious Dinner at Mangoes
Review: My wife and I enjoyed a sunset dinner at Mangoes. The owner is a joy to talk with and the food was delicious with large portions and very tasty, and a great price. My wife had fish and I had roast chicken. We highly recommend visiting here for this out of the way treasure on Langkawi.Show less

Author: KeithrowSteeple Morden, United Kingdom
Title: Tucked away off the beaten
Review: Tucked away off the beaten track lies this bohemian gem. The food is more international than most restaurants in the region, including a bit of bacon and ham. The service is informal but prompt and attentive.Michelle, the friendly Australian owner, pops out to say hello and make sure you’ve enjoyed the meal. It’s all very different.Show less

Author: brad0nj
Title: Hands down the best meal I’ve
Review: Hands down the best meal I’ve had in malaysia! Host were brilliant and very interactive with all guest. Portions were huge. Now to sleep it off

Author: Nicksky91
Title: Just! Yes!
Review:
It's a food paradise!!
A great selection of Australian inspired food, stubby coolers and a great family welcoming reception.

Portion size to knock and heavy weight out!

Caution!!! Food coma

Author: BazKeen
Title: Mangoes Review
Review: Have been many times and the food is always excellent. First rate. Have never had a bad meal here in the 4 years that I've been coming to Langkawi. Staff are always pleasant and accommodating.

Author: Seaneeyan
Title: Best place ever
Review: Best barman ever Shaun. Cold glasses, crazy owner who is a generous doll that drove me back to my hotel the first time I ever walked in with a broken leg. Best food on the island and a library as well. Big welcomes with people who care. Thank you MangoesShow less

Author: 993andrews
Title: Home from home....
Review:
.... one of the first places we go after getting off the plane!

Not to be missed. 

Friendly welcome and great food.

Author: veneziaaaaaaaa
Title: MUST VISIT
Review: Food is good, not over seasoned and we can add our own seasoning. Staff is friendly and attentive, have good knowledge about the attractions in Langkawi. Nice ambiance, good food and though it takes some effort and time to find the place, it's all worth itShow less

Author: IanRap
Title: Brilliant Place
Review: Visited again for dinner with a group of friends, the food was excellent as usual and Michelle and the staff friendly and attentive.  A great location for dinner or Sunday Brunch.

Author: Andrew W
Title: AWESOME EAT
Review: When it comes to home cooked European food look no further. Michelle is the friendliest and most attentive owner I have ever met. The food is the best euro aussy you will taste in this part of the world. Perhaps why I've been coming to the restaurant for 13 years xx love you guys keep it up...Show less

Author: PatrickF581
Title: Hideout for the rain
Review: We ended up here because it started raining when we were driving around on a rented scooter. Had lunch, which was nice. Staff and owner realy friendly and helpful. You can only pay with cash and nearest ATM is a 5-10 minute drive.

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Once again, excellent.
Review: We again went to Mangoes on our latest holiday and it remains one of our favourite restaurants.Lots of choices for the main course and a good selection for desert, including the famous Pavlova which is a "must" should you have room for it after the main course.Excellent food coupled with very good service in a congenial atmosphere made even more of an experience with the introduction of the imported lights from Turkey.Will most definitely be visiting Mangoes again on our next holiday.Show less

Author: SayD22
Title: Cozy and chill!
Review: A friend recommended this place so we decided to check it out. Friendly staff and owner so took the time to get to know us and vice versa! Waited a while for the good but well worth the wait!

Author: Ken NPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent brunch location in Langkawi
Review: A craving for bacon from one of our party let us to Mangoes in Langkawi. Although a pretty good drive out of the tourist area of Pantai Cenang, the short trip was worth it. The drive was pleasant and scattered with local lifestyle.Mangoes is semi-hidden and is nestled in a wooded beach area. Do order the breakfast player. Generous servings of bacon and well cooked eggs. A Langkawi must-go. Enjoy!Show less

Author: MarathonBugKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Ausie homecooked food.
Review: Was pleasantly surprised that lamb shank recommended by Michelle was excellent.One of the best that I tasted. The burger recommended was excellent too. Would have tried the deserts except was too full.Would recommend to anyone looking for good western food. Look for Michelle or Chris for recommendations if you are there.Show less

Author: estores2016Whitley Bay, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous!! Recommended!!
Review: A great find ....a little out of the way but well worth the visit!The food was outstanding.....Shepherds pie better than you could get at home.My partner loved the Pork chop and to finish frangipani pear tart !!Very accommodating and friendly owner (Michelle)Plan to return Sunday for the special brunch ...see you soon!!Show less

Author: DaleJ246
Title: Best brunch on the island
Review: Excellent service and amazing food, the staff are Super nice and friendly and catered well for what I wanted. Highly recommend and Sunday brunch there or any other night there open 😊

Author: Leochong3111
Title: Great hangout night
Review: Just awesome, everything is good, nice environment, nice food, nice drink, most important is nice service, should be awesome service!

Author: Heneeroy
Title: Hidden Treasure
Review: This place is a haven almost hidden away and is honestly so lovely! You won’t regret it! The staff are great! (We met Michele and her good friend Chris on the other side of the island days prior) we took the short drive there and it felt like home the second we walking in! They even remembered our names.... Holidays are about meeting people and enjoying everyone’s company! The food was great, the service was impeccable and the value is outstanding! Had the best Sunday brunch we’ve had in a long time and a highlight of our Langkawi trip! Not to mention the book wall of books to swap, homemade marmalade and the regular patrons who were just lovely to chat to! Thank you mangoes team Show less

Author: C8341VSstevej
Title: Not Family Friendly Venue
Review: If you have kids, don’t visit ( especially on weekends ). All you’ll notice are grumpy old retired people sitting around the bar getting pissed.The people who really spend money are not taken care off and me and my family experienced this first hand. My 2 year old let out a little scream and a grumpy old person at the corner of the bar shouted asking her to shut up. Wonder if he could do it in his own country ?Show less

Author: HollowmancrAjman, United Arab Emirates
Title: Simply the best in malaysia so far
Review: Simply delightful. I barely saw the entrance and only knew where it was when I came by grab. It proved to be a massive surprise. Best restaurant in malaysia so far. Food is delicious, waiter (Shawn) and the owner were both lovely and friendly and the ambience is fantastic. Definitely coming back daily. The lamb shank was luscious and the chicken, leek and mushroom was hearty. Dessert (chocolate walnut pie) was amazing.Show less

Author: hazzazhossain
Title: Awesome
Review: Highly recommended. If u visit langkawi then u must visit this place at least 1 time, owner is very friendly, nice environment, cosy. U will enjoy your visit here. Love them. Too good

Author: 563emilydDudley, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food and friendly atmosphere
Review: We found this restaurant on tripadvisor as fancied something different from the restaurants at our hotel!! Definitely hits the spot in terms of wanting European food after a good few days of spicy food! Shaun was really friendly and made us feel very welcome. Lovely setting basically sitting in the jungle and also to have fresh mangoes from the surrounding trees was delicious!Show less

Author: Amoenster
Title: Hidden gem!
Review: Wauw! What an amazing place!? The host is such a warm-hearted woman! This is a place where lots of locals are coming to have dinner. It’s a beautiful place with a beautiful sunset. Food is good, lots of different things to choose from. Staff is doing a great job, looking after you. I ate too much (because it was marvelous) so I couldn’t try the pavlova anymore, but I will definitely be back to try this famous dessert!!Show less

Author: swanstonanthonyPhuket, Thailand
Title: Great hostess, average food
Review: I went in a group. You will need to know where this place is to find it. The ambience is good and Michelle, the hostess, will give you a warm greeting. As will the rest of the well trained staff. The service was attentive. Prices are OK, but not particularly cheap. Perhaps we were unlucky that night but the food was distinctly average. The roast potatoes which other reviewers raved about just did not happen. The hollandaise sauce on the eggs benedict had split, all of the roasts (chicken, pork and lamb) were dried out. But we had fun!Show less

Author: 813renev
Title: Nice hidden restaurant
Review:
Good food, good price, good people. Did really enjoy! Its a bit hard to find, but a lovely place.

Germans will love the fried kartoffel

Author: Penny G
Title: First class restaurant.
Review:
Once again on our latest holiday we went several times to Mangoes and it was the perfect experience.
Excellent food, very good service, sensible prices all served in a perfect setting.
We certainly look forward to returning to Mangoes on our next holiday to Langkawi.

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: HANGING OUT FOR A ROAST DINNER
Review: My husband was craving a roast dinner last evening, so where else would one go to when in Langkawi but Mangoes.Len was not let down. The roast was tender and mouth watering with all the trimmings, apple sauce, crispy roast potatoes, cauliflower, broccoli and gravy.I had my "must have" Mangoes meal of spinach lasagne, and last night was the best ever..As usual service was top notch, nothing too much trouble, and the always happy Michelle was watching over everyone.Thanks Mangoes, as always a terrific night and thanks for maintaining the high level of service and the delicious food.cheersShow less

Author: ansonchonghs
Title: Small restaurant serving western food
Review: Ambience is good. Menu price is reasonable, menu lack of choices and no kids menu. Food is good.but not excellent.

Author: jaxxesplin
Title: Tropical garden hideaway
Review: Excellent foods and ambience. One of the few places you can enjoy pork in Langkawi. I would recommend the ribs. Attentive smiling front of house. Thanks Shaun. Oh and cocktails a must try.

Author: AS71London, United Kingdom
Title: Nice hidden island gem
Review: We were lucky to find this restaurant which we visited twice during our stay in Langkawi. The restaurant offers very simple non-Asian home-made food (including pork) in very simple, but nice and clean jungle setting. What makes it special is the clientele which is mainly made of Europeans living in Langkawi permanently. Lots of people seem to be regular visitors, who know each other.Very quick and efficient service. Nice and welcoming owner Michelle who is Australian living in Langkawi for over 19 years. Tasty and simple food with good selection of wine. Not expensive to any standard. Excellent value for money. Thank you, Michelle!Show less

Author: TimothyKlHong Kong, China
Title: Great Find in Langkawi
Review: My wife and I found Mangoes on trip Advisor and the owner Michelle did not disappoint.We enjoyed Sunday Brunch in a lovely setting, very relaxed.I had the full English Breakfast which was amazing and my wife had the Eggs Benedict, and the Baileys warm cheesecake and a few screwdrivers. All good!They have a full dinner menu as well with a daily special board, but we did not have time for a second visit.We highly recommend Mangoes. It made a nice change from the five star hotel.The value for money is fantastic. Very reasonable.Show less

Author: Peter FHermanus, South Africa
Title: Cozy setting average food
Review: This restaurant/bar is tucked away just behind a beach offering a rustic ambience. It is run by an Australian lady called Michelle. The waiters are friendly and speak good English. I opted for Chili con Carne. A bowl of rice is charged extra. This meal tasted rather bland and I rate it as average. It cost about RM 35 and as such I found it a bit on the expensive side. My wife had a Rib-eye steak (RM 40) which turned out to be as tough as a shoe sole. When we brought this to Michelle's attention she told us that the meat is imported from Australia and therefore one never knows what one might get. I think that inferior quality meat should not be sold with a premium price tag. A glass of reasonable house wine can be had for RM 10 per glass. For desert we had a Pavlova which was great. However, overall food quality is average at relatively high prices so we won't rush back in a hurry.Show less

Author: jimmie1234Sandhurst
Title: Great place to eat
Review: Mangos is a great find. Look it up before you go as it's unlikely that you will just stumble across it. It is run and owned by fabulous funny lady called Michelle. The food was great and the cocktails delicious. I had a mango madness cocktail and we both had the Aussie burger (make sure you are hungry!). Michelle is very knowledgeable about the island and is only too happy to answer any questions you may have. Looking forward to going back.Show less

Author: Aliciakhy
Title: Rustic atmosphere but slightly pricey
Review:
Pricing for a main course is about rm 35-50. But lovely atmosphere and lovely host :) there’s also two smol dogs in the cafe too! Super cute and quaint. 
Five pax ~ RM 190, for 3 mains, 2 cocktails

Author: HakkaPoh
Title: Nice German Food in Rustic Setting
Review: Had dinner w family (5pax).  Ordered 3 main course - cukup kenyang.  The lasagna is the fav. Excellent & attentive service.

Author: 565angelaz
Title: Very romantic place
Review: The place is wonderful and very romantic . Western cuisine on good taste , mostly meat and some vegan options as well . Staff very helpful and friendly . Absolute try and the desserts

Author: Ellen KThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Garlic bread, steak, potatoes & a nice evening!
Review: Are you craving some nice western food? Then I'd definitely recommend Mangoes.We were craving nice steak and found Mangoes Bar & Grill online. And immediately got excited when we read the menu. It wasn't really close to where we were at that moment but impulsively as we are we went for it. (and I just really love potatoes.. And they make them in different ways, Yes!)When we entered the restaurant the first thing I noticed was the nice and cosy ambiance.All excited we ordered garlic bread (crunchy!) as a starter and the Rib eye as a main. As a side dish we chose the fried potatoes.. It's with garlic and onion and it really made my day. Unfortunately we didn't have any space left for dessert..A shout out to our waiter as well. Service with a lovely smile.They've around 10 tables which makes the overal experience quite intimate. If you like a more intimate but still cosy place to eat, I also recommend Mangoes.Had a lovely chat with the owner Michele as well. Fun fact: they do Sunday brunches! And by what she told me I should definitely swing by next time I visit Langkawi! Thank you for opening up this restaurant and giving me a little piece of backhome.We were so happy that we decided we'll have a quick bite there again before flying back. Just have to try the apfelstrudel and bratwurst... Convenient enough they're about 5min away from the airport.Show less

Author: julle0
Title: Great food, excellent service
Review: This place is the hidden secret of Langkawi! Delicious home cooked food, huge portions and lovely atmosphere. Prices were very reasonable. Totally recommend to eat here!

Author: tt53
Title: As good as ever
Review: This place never disappoints. The food is tasty and great value. Star of the evening was Michelle’s super dooper pavlova. Love it.

Author: billgN6987FK
Title: Excellent food and restaurant!
Review: From the moment we walked into Mangoes, the relaxed atmosphere and happy staff made us feel welcomed. Drinks were served quickly and with a smile, and when the food arrived it was a delight! The Aussie Burger is not for the faint hearted, and is packed with delicious meat and fillings. Every mouthful was a real treat. I would thoroughly recommend Mangoes and their excellent menu. Thank you Michelle and your excellent team! Show less

Author: Dartydo
Title: Outside catering
Review: If you’re looking for party catering I highly recommend Michele at Mangoes. Delicious food delivered to the door.

Author: Murray S
Title: Mangoes a delight
Review:
Friendly staff on arrival, meal very good and plenty of it, nice to have real proper bacon. Rustic setting but more than satisfactory, enjoyed and will be back.
Out of the way a bit but worth the trip.

Author: Fenwick1965London, United Kingdom
Title: A.M.A.Z.I.N.G
Review: We went for my husbands birthday, from the moment we arrived we received a very warm welcome from Michelle and her staff. All that needs to be said is the food is AMAZING. Very reasonably priced and the service was excellent. Our waiter was a lovely friendly lad and nothing was to much trouble.If you want some tasty western type food then this is the place to be.Show less

Author: P3076BYnicolabDa Lat, Vietnam
Title: Great Christmas Eve dinner!
Review: We were staying on Langkawi over Christmas and really wanted somewhere to eat on Christmas Eve with a bit of atmosphere and more traditionally western Christmas food as we'd be eating Malaysian food on Christmas day. What a find Mangoes was! The owners were very welcoming and the food was fantastic. I had the steak tartar to start and my husband the salmon- both were excellent. The turkey dinner was brilliant, with excellent accompaniments. Nothing was too much hassle and all the staff were very attentive! The cocktails were fabulous as well. Well worth a visit! Show less

Author: jaxx2410
Title: Great food Great atmosphere
Review: Love this restaurant.Made to feel welcome from the moment you arrive. One of the few places on the island you can enjoy pork. Ribs were amazing. The restaurant also makes their own ham, this can also be bought to take away

Author: shonab210Shropshire, United Kingdom
Title: Mangoes; Secret Garden
Review: We hired a car for a few days during our trip in Langkawi and looked for somewhere to eat on google. We decided to head to Mangoes and it was beautiful.Everyone was so friendly, the service was excellent and the food was tasty!The view of the sea and the sun sets were an additional bonus, fabulous little secret garden Show less

Author: Ezra T
Title: Great
Review: Had a great night with my girlfriend. The owner offered us a free ride to the airport afterwards. Would totally recommend

Author: Lodnikka
Title: Dinner with a view
Review: Relaxed place with a home-like atmosphere. Service was really friendly. Place serves western style food with Malaysian twist. I was craving for a burger and Aussieburger made me happy :)

Author: Matt N
Title: Great food and people
Review: Great view, great people, Amazing food! If want to splurge go here. Loved the koozie. Try the cordon bleu schnitzel.

Author: Passenger25728679925
Title: Nice family dinner with lovely sunset view
Review: Had dinner here with the kids who enjoyed their dinner of Homemade Ham & mash, Goulash and Schnitzel. Dessert of Apple Strudel and Mango Crepe (asked rimless for the kids) also went down well. The Serving stuff are friendly. Other than the usual mosquitoes (mosquitoe coil is burnt under the table but I guess I'm too sensitive to the mosquitoes) we had a great dinner. Will hope to go back again before we leave Langkawi.Show less

Author: Norma KMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Very disappointing
Review: Looking at reviews we decided to visit by taxi. We ordered pate to start which came scraped on french bread slices. Too much bread not enough pate. Husband had lamb shank cooked well but totally tasteless. I had butter chicken, again tasteless. We intended to have a bottle of wine but I ordered a glass to start. This is the first time I was unable to finish the glass. To be fair a family nearby were served good looking burgers and pavlova so maybe we chose wrong. The staff were friendly however so not all bad and it was the cheap end oh what we experienced.Show less

Author: cdevosEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food in Unusual setting
Review: June 2018. We were a group of friends going for drinks and dinner - Mangoes did not disappoint! Lovely, down-to-earth restaurant built with trees all around. We had yummy, refreshing cocktails. Definitely the place to go if you are after Western food. Go and experience something different!Show less

Author: Wander827843
Title: The best wester  food  i n langkawi
Review: We had a great night special dinner just excellent great service thanks to Michel and the team, you should not miss it

Author: ryanconnorsnlJohor, Malaysia
Title: Poutine - Canadian Delicacy
Review: Any Canadians visiting Langkawi and need a poutine fix? This is a close, but not exact delicious taste of home away from home! The Canadian “Poutine” - minus the cheese curds, but very delightful mushroom sauce gravy - thank you Michele, from Ryan & Alicia for nailing our special request :) Show less

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: STILL EXCELLENT
Review: Visited Mangoes for dinner last.We always make sure we visit at least once during our visits to Langkawi...more so if time permits.It is one of our "must go to restaurants", Food is excellent, as is the welcome and service from Michelle & saff. Menu has not changed that much over the years, but why change if you are popular. There is a "specials black board" with daily specials. I had the Chicken, Mushroom and Leek Pie which was excellent. My husband finds it difficult to go past the Liver, Bacon & Onions served on Mash. Prices for food, wine and beer reasonable, and everything is well presented. Just love this small Langkawi restaurant/Bar. It is what Langkawi is all about. Should be more places like it on Langkawi...please do not change Mangoes!!!Show less

Author: Tom_LennieMaidenhead, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent value with a little quirkiness
Review: Excellent value in this open air restaurant. Mostly western food, my wife had the rib eye steak which was excellent, I had the butter chicken which was very good. Not fine dining but excellent value, very good food and a most hospitable host. Recommend without hesitation.Show less

Author: WRtootingLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Butter chicken
Review: Chilled out bar/restaurant which looks out over the sea (in the distance) and a patch of forest. Not the place to go for fine dining but the food was simple and delicious. My wife and I both had a very good butter chicken dish followed by the mango crepe (for my wife) and the walnut chocolate tart (for me). Both deserts were excellent but the tart was the stand out for me. Very nice friendly service and nice doggo making give me snacks eyes..Show less

Author: Eric BBrisbane, Australia
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Lovely little restaurant. Tucked away in a house, the food and drinks were excellent at a good price. Lots of great western fare if you need a break from rice. Had lamb for dinner and the kids loved their burger and steak. Nice margarita and cheap beer. The lady who owns it is lovely as well as the rest of the staff. A little piece of homeShow less

Author: Nigel NSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: We had dinner here on a few occasions and were delighted each time! The food is excellent - I had the beef goulash with mash potato which was so delicious I had to go back for it another evening! My brother had a T-bone steak which was large, tender and cooked just right - he claimed it was one of the best he ever had. On another occasion we had the Cordon Blue chicken which was also delicious. There is a selection of deserts - the rum mango crepe with ice cream is a must try! Mangoes is probably the only place in Langkawi where you can get pork products - they have sausages, bacon, ham and pork on the menu. Overall, the food here is excellent!While the food is the main reason for going to Mangoes, people stay and return because of the friendly service also. Michele and her team all have smiles and a friendly word for everyone - she is great for advice on anything to do with Langkawi. Another reason to go is value for money - both food and drinks are reasonably priced.I've been to Langkawi a few times but only found Mangoes on this trip. Having dined in other well rated restaurants on the island, I can honestly say that we found Mangoes to be the best all round.Show less

Author: junecrazyPerth, Australia
Title: Amazing Bar & Grill
Review: Just returned from Langkawi and found this amazing placeIt's run by an Australian name Michele and serves mostly Western Food so if you need a change from Indian or Asian food this place is for youMichele makes you feel so welcome and her staff is very friendly and their service is second to noneWould HIGHLY recommend a visitOpen Wed to Sat 5pm - 10pmSun 11am - 10pmShow less

Author: CecilieMuPenang, Malaysia
Title: A tropical oasis
Review: What better way to begin Sunday brunch than with a glass of champagne or Bloody Mary! Savoring the gentle sea breezes, we enjoyed a Mangoes Special Breakfast and Eggs Benedict, with crispy, crispy bacon and avocado on the side. A great coffee and a browse through the extensive library completed a wonderful experience. Can also recommend their curries and biriyanis which we had on a previous visit. Highly recommended, don’t miss it when in Langkawi.Show less

Author: ollieturbs
Title: Great food and service
Review: Had a great meal here, both meals we ordered tasted amazing with good portions one of the best meals I've had since travelling. The service was also very attentive and friendly

Author: huck_01
Title: Nice ambient, good food
Review: The food was generally good. We had fish, king prawns, avocado salad, vegetables, fried potatoes and rum mango crepe with frappe for dessert. Avocado salad was the nicest. Recommended!

Author: Educat2018Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Must visit for Michelle's pavlova!
Review: Mangoes, is one of our favorite eateries and we usually visit every month or so. If you hunger for wholesome home cooked meals, this place cannot be beaten for quality and price. We love the wonderful Liver (pinkish!) with mash and the Fisherman's Pie. Always ask Michelle if the pavlova desert is available...if Yes...you must have this classic desert, it is sensational. If you prefer wine with your meal, select a bottle from the small menu as the house-pour is only average.Show less

Author: Gillian Y
Title: Amazing host, hearty food
Review: First time in Langkawi and had the opportunity to visit this homey and hearty place. Thank you , Michelle for the great hospitality. The food was wonderful and had a touch of home to it. The food was great along with the wonderful view. We will be back again when we visit Langkawi. Show less

Author: Nita OHassocks, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic meal
Review: Our family enjoyed a fantastic meal at mangoes. The restaurant is tucked away but our Grab taxi (RM12 each way from Berjaya) finally managed to find it and I’m so glad he did. What a beautiful setting and Michele and the staff were friendly and attentive throughout. There was a huge choice on the menu, we settled on fisherman’s pie RM35, butter chicken RM35, lamb shank RM45 and T-bone steak RM55 all of which were well cooked and delicious. We then completely overindulged and all had desserts which were huge portions RM20 each. Thank you for a fantastic meal, we may be back for Sunday brunch. Show less

Author: lilianacarranzaBoracay, Philippines
Title: Good food cooked well
Review: What a great place! Really sweet people,loved the locals banter. Food was great: garlic bread starter was banging, fish steak was fresh and a delicious/filling spinach lasagna. (also lots of other vegetarian options) The fried potatoes were THE PERFECT side. Michelle's lovely and our waiter was so sweet! Very attentive and seemed very experienced.A great place for a hearty meal and some laughs with an amazing view of the beach!Show less

Author: Mac808Penang, Malaysia
Title: Pretty Good
Review: My husband and I had dinner at Mangoes on 1st July. What a gorgeous spot tucked away at the end of a street, that has a waterfront spot. Michelle has done a fantastic job of planting the area from the verandah out to the water which gives the whole place a very tropical feel. It is a perfect spot to have a meal and watch the sun set but at this time of the year the sun was too far too the right but it did make for some pretty colours. Michelle was welcoming, friendly and attentive, and her staff were lovely. I wasn't feeling too hungry so ordered the pate and a blue cheese salad. It hit the spot and I would recommend both dishes. My husband had the chicken schnitzel which came with a mashed potato. He was a little disappointed in that the schnitzel was a little dry and the mashed potato was not fresh (fluffy) and it may have been reheated in a microwave. He's a mashed potato connoisseur!We would come back again and have already recommended it to others.Show less

Author: SJSLondon30
Title: Fun and friendly
Review: Great place for dinner! Michelle makes the restaurant - super friendly and lovely. Food is great. Cute dog called Honey too :)

Author: AbdulrhmanA240
Title: mangoes
Review: We have been twice in this restaurant.. the place is simple, lovely and worm . the owner and the waiter are nice and smiling all the time. the food is delicious I can only say that it made with love.. I recommend you to try pavlova wish you all the luck MicheleBreeze ☺️Show less

Author: MurrayW53Perth
Title: Average at best
Review: Had a meal at Mangoes , Ihad Lamb with mash potatoes and vegetable. It tasted okay it looked like it had been made for a while and microwaved.The Owner Lady was too busy smoking and drinking at the bar to bother coming and introducing herself. We were the only people at the restaurant with four expats at the bar drinking.If you what an average home cooked western meal then this is the place to come but there are a lot more better and friendlier restaurants to go to.Show less

Author: Tresna WMaida Vale, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Went here for dinner the other day after trying to get here for a while. A bit disappointed actually. Food was tasty but overall just like a good home cooked meal. If you're away and want home cooked dinner this is probably a good place to go but not really what we had hoped for. Nothing much from the staff either. Best thing was the setting and the birds and monkey and the dog barking and running around having fun. Probably won't go back.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Top class restaurant.
Review: We once again repeatedly went to Mangoes for dinner during our three week holiday.Excellent food, perfect service in quiet surroundings.A special mention must be made of the staff running Mangoes on the night the electrical power failed for they worked so hard while controlling the situation with total calmness. They all deserve a huge pat on the back.Of course we will be back on our next holiday, that goes without saying.Show less

Author: NicholasalloverSan Francisco, California
Title: Fantastic food!
Review: Loved this little restaurant! The food was great and the service was perfect. I didn’t have cash because they only take cash, so they let me borrow their car so I could run to the ATM. I just wish they were open on Monday and Tuesday so we could go everyday!Show less

Author: arseniytagaevNur-Sultan, Kazakhstan
Title: Simply great
Review: Definitely one of the best places in Langkawi. Nice house wine for SEA region, good fish and superb fisherman pie, I loved it! The owner and the guys working there are very attentive and welcoming. If ever come back to Langkawi, would definitely go there again.Show less

Author: leanne_dodson1Manchester
Title: Amazing service and lovely food
Review: Michele is an absolute star - as a lone traveller I went here and she recommended lots of great places, trips and things to do! The service is impeccable. I had the steak which was delicious - would recommend the potato salad as a side! Loved everything about Mangoes - a must visit in Langkawi ❤️Show less

Author: Shereen A
Title: Best Service,Amazing Food
Review: I've been to this place solo, with friends, for a date, I just love the food here, never had a bad experience. I've also been ordering different food of the menu everytime I come.And I absolutely loved all of them!The menu selection is broad and I cannot wait for my next visit to try a different dish!The atmostphere is so relaxing, & theres tons of books to choose from if you like to read! You can even take them and exchange with books you'd like to leave behind. Absolutely love the concept of this place.Michelle and the staff are amazing and so friendly, me & my friends absolutely love them!Show less

Author: Sabrina G
Title: Disappointed!
Review: Staff at are very friendly and welcoming and the location is set nicely. My steak was unseasoned and it was not fresh, definitely defrosted! Very disappointed :( Show less

Author: Liz PCairns, Australia
Title: I nearly died tonight!
Review: Mangos is, and has been for a long time, my favorite restaurant on Langkawi. It's been 2 years since my last review and tonight, the pavlova has me waxing lyrical again.One review recently said it was the best pav outside of Australia that they've ever had; well here's a pic of the pav I had a spiritual moment over this evening. But seriously, pavlova is a very sweet desert but Michelle has added fresh cream and 'tart' fruits to cut the sweetness. Fresh kiwi fruit, strawberries and passionfruit makes this desert absolutely exquisite. My waist is crying in mourning over my diet though... Show less

Author: animalMDBZurich, Switzerland
Title: Excellency at its best
Review: After years and years of coming to this wonderful place it hasn't lost a beat it.No matter when you come they are always happy so see everyone and welcome them as it would be their own family.Awesome Epic place and I truly hope they will last for an eternity so everyone can enjoy and experience what makes the palace special.Show less

Author: stalviesSt. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Best Pavlova we have ever had
Review: My wife and I have been coming to Mangoes regularly for about 10 years and have always had a great time. The food and ambiance are great but Michele's deserts are outstanding, especially her Pavlova. We have never had a better dessert anywhere in the world. Top marks.Chris and DiShow less

Author: BradS2713
Title: Excellent vibe
Review: Had a fantastic meal and cocktail here. The vibe is so relaxed and fun, and the food was amazing!! my wife had the lamb shank and i had the ribeye. Great find and would recommend for any visitor to Langkawi Island.

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Menu changes with new management make this place interesting as well as delightful.
Review: Staff is friendly, food great and the location is lovely to view the stunning sunsets. If there is something in particular you want, just ask, Michele is willing to cater to everyone and makes everyone feel special. Am looking forward to seeing this place be the happening place where everyone wants to be.Show less

Author: Pooja K
Title: Lovely evening at Mangoes
Review: Simple and casual dining experience.Michelle being a great host, made us feel very welcome. Excellent service by the friendly staff, very helpful with the suggestions. Cocktails are rather good, we had their Mango madness and Mango Magic, highly recommend if you are not driving.. They have so many house specials, I tried the stuffed Chicken dish and my friend had the very delicious fisherman's pie. Overall a great experience.Show less

Author: Lorimichele
Title: Wonderful Evening At Mangoes
Review: Last night Mangoes had a special dinner. Michele and her staff prepared an Indian buffet. It was the best indian food I have had in 3 years on the island! Congrats to Mangoes! Look forward to the next one and don't wait too long.

Author: dogstalkpoetrySingapore, Singapore
Title: Romantic Restaurant & Great Service
Review: A cozy restaurant that's off the path from the mainstream areas, me and my partner had dinner here and were fortunate to sit at a corner that gave us a peek of the sunset in the horizon. Love the relaxing ambience here, food was great and the restaurant owner was very kind to give us a lift back to our hotel. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: DartydoLangkawi
Title: Outside catering
Review: Mangoes did a wonderful job of catering for our birthday party. The food was excellent beyond and above the call of duty. I would definitely recommend the choice and efficiency of this restaurant.The food is good quality western food so you can try before you choose food for outside catering. Service is friendly, helpful and obliging.Show less

Author: janec737Sydney, Australia
Title: Lovely meal and sunset
Review: Stopped for a beer, found the bar very relaxing, everyone very friendly Ended up staying for dinner, roast chicken special was beautiful, mashed potatoes with caramelised onions, cheesy broccoli and cauliflower absolutely beautiful, my husband had the Aussie burger, not for the faint hearted, best burger in langkawi.Desserts looked lovely, but no way could I eat anymore. Another customer said the chicken and veggie soup with their lovely bread was a meal in itself. So next time think I’ll try that then I can also have dessert.Great setting, sunset lovely.Thanks to all the staff for a lovely evening, will be back soon.Might try Sunday brunch other customers recommended it.Show less

Author: tt53
Title: Great friendly place with great food
Review: Many thanks Michele for another great night at Mangoes. This is always one of our favourite places to go for dinner while in Langkawi.

Author: IanGill99Hook, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: I have had Sunday Brunch and evening meals in this restaurant a number of times and am always surprised how Michelle and her staff always manage to provide such an excellent choice and quality of food. The restaurant has a very relaxed and homely atmosphere and I look forward to dining there again soon.Show less

Author: LovDacSydney, Australia
Title: Lovely dinner... with friends
Review: Enjoyed a lovely, meal of Shepard’s pie. Other members enjoyed the spinach lasagne, chicken and schnitzel.We followed with a Pav. Just love the food, great service and you feel a warm welcome whenever you go. We do visit this restaurant on a yearly basis and love everything about it. The best Bloody Marys, that everyone should try. A little piece of home. Show less

Author: GrandparentsGoGlobalCasper, Wyoming
Title: Casual dinner out.
Review: We went to this resturant on a rainy night in Langkawi and had cold beer and good food. Do not go here for fine dining or excellent wine. Order whiskey on the rocks or cold beer.This resturant is owned by a couple as I understand it and is frequented by numerous regular patrons based on the conversations going on at the bar - everyone knew one another.This place offers excellent, modestly priced dinner fair in a roofed open air setting. There are numerous daily specials in addition to the menu.We would go back but ask to be sat on the absolute edge of the resturant as everyone in this place smokes - there is no way to avoid it so do not go if you cannot abide smoking whilst you eat. It was hard on us as we obviously do not smoke.Show less

Author: Mr_HafLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Hidden gem of Langkawi Island.
Review: The map was correct but it was hidden in the yard. Almost miss it :DThe food is total blast. You like pork and bacon? This is the place in Langkawi! The owner is friendly and amazing <3 ALSO MUST TRY THEIR PAVLOVA even though you don't like sweet <3Show less

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Went for Sunday Brunch with girl-friend and it was absolutely wonderful.
Review: After being closed for a short period due to family emergency the restaurant open in high spirits and the food was devine. The service was friendly and delivered on time considering that they had a full-house! The atmosphere was warm and one of sharing not just good food but good company with table conversation running between tables.Very enjoyableShow less

Author: Ingri-ingri
Title: Lovely Sunday brunxh
Review: Just a beautiful and relaxing place to have a nice Sunday brunch!  The Bloody Mary and breakfast platter are delicious!  Fries are great too.  Awesome joint!

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great improvement in service and quality food
Review: We had two nice diners with friends very recently and were pleasantly surprised by the improvement of the food. Also the staff and some local friends are much more doing there best to please their clients.Apparently "Michelle" has taken over the restaurant and has rekindled the spirit and improved the diners!It is really worthwhile to give this restaurant another visit nd find out for yourselves that you can feel and taste the passion back in this place!Looking forward to our next diner there soon.Show less

Author: Richard  G
Title: Richard & Maggie
Review: Great atmosphere Michelle and Cris great hosts chalk and cheese 1 from Australia and 1 from London. Staff all welcoming food excellent going back again before we go home recommend 100%

Author: Fiona SWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Beautiful food and casual relaxed setting.
Review: Mangoes was recommended to us so we went there last night. The female owner is an Aussies and the food was wholesome, home cooking. The food and drinks are well priced and we’d happily recommend the restaurant to anyone. I had chicken with a Greek salad and my partner had a T Bone steak with a green salad. Both meals were sensational. The hosts and service staff were great. ❤️Show less

Author: tmunyi
Title: Recommended
Review: Ordered lamb, steak & desserts n they taste so good! Very valued for money too. Host is very friendly.

Author: nickytravelsagainSydney, Australia
Title: Great, relaxed place for dinner and drinks. Excellent service as well!
Review: Such a hidden gem. Easy to miss the place as the sign is tiny but don't be put off as the atmosphere is large. Michelle is a fabulous host. Food is great and the drinks flow easily without breaking the bank. Ask Michelle for a discount voucher for the excellent Langkawi zipline as well...another local treat.Show less

Author: tif n
Title: Great spot with affordable drinks and food
Review:
The atmosphere was nice and cozy - a very chill vibe. Friendly staff and a happy atmosphere. 

Very affordable drinks and food! I would totally come back here to chill when I'm back in Langkawi 

Thank you!

Author: _kateis1Brisbane Region, Australia
Title: delicious food, lovely staff
Review: This place was really close to our hotel, so a cheap taxi fare. The food was really reasonably priced and very tasty. The english speaking staff were very helpful. Definately check this place out, especially if you are craving some western food while you are travelling asia. The menu was nice and varied :)Show less

Author: Tricia E
Title: Great place for sundowners and a meal
Review: The warm friendly welcome as you step into Mangoes and the notable meals will keep bringing you back when ever you are in Langkawi. It’s one of the few restaurants in Langkawi that cares about the quality of food and produce they serve. Definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: Ron FCanberra, Australia
Title: Another hidden gem
Review: Well...where to start? Got recommendations from friends and Trip Advisor. There was also some advertising in our accommodation. Nobody was wrong. This place is wonderful. Michelle is a great (Aussie) hostess. The brekkie menu is terrific (yes folks...real bacon!!). The eggs Benedict and hash brown are worth crawling over broken glass for. Coffee is excellent & can I humbly say, a fabbie Bloody Mary. The lunch/dinner menu looks terrific and sounds like home - western and delicious. Coming back for brekkie tomorrow. Don’t miss this place! Show less

Author: Jon A
Title: Super friendly gem on Langkawi
Review: With no reservation and our 1 year old getting hungry. We arrived early on Christmas Eve, and got a table for a quick bite. The Lasagna was perfect for our daughter and brought with us for lunch the next day. The spare ribs was tasty and had heaps of flavor. Staff was very welcoming and attentive and you could see they know many of the guests. Like an extended daily. :) Show less

Author: 704eduardb
Title: Great Christmas experience
Review: Myself and my girlfriend had our Christmas dinner here. It was a great day and we felt as if we were one of the family.  All of the staff were incredibly attentive and the food was out of this world! I'd highly recommend visiting Mangoes.

Author: jessicat755Dublin, Ireland
Title: Christmas dinner in Langkowi
Review: My boyfriend and I were staying in Malaysia for Christmas this year and wanted to find a Christmas lunch for a reasonable price.On arrival at Mangoes, we were welcomed, seated and offered a drink (unlimited drinks were inclusive of the price). Shortly after we were offered the antipasti which was a goats cheese, pesto and sundried tomato on bread. When the food was revealed a short while after, we could not believe that we had found this incredibly festive lunch in Malaysia. The food was absolutely incredible and had everything you could have wanted for a roast dinner.
