An assortment of vegetables, side salads, various accompaniments, different meats and of course sauces and gravy. The dessert came shortly after and was a choice of Christmas cake, pavlova and cherry pie.We enjoyed several plates of food and several more drinks. With Christmas music playing in the background and a friendly atmosphere, we felt like we had found the best place to spend our Christmas afternoon.The staffs hospitality and hard work didn't go unnoticed. They made us feel like a part of their annual traditional lunch and it's one we will not forget.Show less

Author: Island_mischief
Title: A taste sensation and wonderful atmosphere
Review: I rate mangoes as one of the best informal dining experiences in Langkawi. The staff are super friendly and the food is always top notch. The specials are changed often and the most difficult part of the experiences is choosing what to eat as it all looks SO good. Great atmosphere and wonderful sunset views. Great for couples, families, tourists and locals. Mangoes is not to be missed! Thanks again Michelle and team for a fantastic evening. Show less

Author: AnakChanPerth, Australia
Title: Wonderful food in a cozy relaxing atmosphere
Review: Mangoes is a must for tourists who want a break from local food and seeking a well prepared western meal. The ribs is a must-try, and the mash potatoes is smooth and creamy as ever. The restaurant is tucked away on a quieter part of the beach which sets a relaxing and cozy atmosphere as what one would imagine paradise to be. And to top it off, the hosts are also warm and friendly.Show less

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: Wonderful once again
Review: Visited last night (10/12/2017) before heading back to Perth for Christmas.Wish we could find something o complain about, but sorry we cant.We had a beautiful meal, pan fried fish which was beautifully cooked, husband had meat loaf with mash and onion gravy which he said was great. Shared an apple strudel for desert...just beautiful.Michelle, Lutz and staff make everyone feel welcome, and the Christmas decorations adding a festive feel to this lovely cosy restaurant.Thanks guys. Keep up the good work, and hope all goes well with your festive plans, and see you in 2018.Show less

Author: NickPinderKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: THE MARVELLOUS MANGOES
Review: Celebrating the entrepreneurial spirit of a charming Australian lady and her team. The great Mangoes gastropub @ 1, Jalan Kuala Teriang, 07000 Langkawi, Kedah From a cheerful greeting to a sea view seat...The establishment was packed, lucky to get a seat. It was a Sunday lunchtime. Clearly a popular destination for the expatriate community in Langkawi. Situated in a hidden corner by the sea. This simple bar pippes its peers to the post. “It’s not that easy to get to" said my dining companions... But it's arguably one of the prettiest bars on the island. The team work really hard. It's great to see them recognised & patronised, because they do hospitality very well. Their food is incredibly simple, and simply gorgeous. Try the fish pie, try the roast pork... the list goes on...  Mangoes has become a gastronomic respite in Langkawi. It's becoming a cult; the gourmet pilgrims desperate to tick off the five star hotels would be well advised to "chill out here". Yet it is also the kind of place where you can walk in wearing shorts and a t-shirt and order a cold Tiger Beer. Or a Bloody Mary (recommended).This place really grows on you... it's not complicated or poncey, and it has charm.The garden is amazing, with the sea view. And it's doggie friendly!Show less

Author: AlanM579Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Comfy, informal and good food
Review: I like this place. It’s fun. The environment is nice. The views are good. I love the ‘L’ shaped bar where customers can cross talk and engage in friendly banter. Yes. Staff have changed there. But the owners, Lutz and Michele personally control the consistency of the food and sauces so that the dish you enjoyed yesterday can be enjoyed today and then tomorrow. My food favourites are the fisherman’s pie, the lamb shank and now a new and improved pork rib dish. Meat falls off the bone and the sauce is really, really tasty. I usually have to visit Penang to have this, but the Mangoes one is actually better. The eggs Benedict on Sunday brunch are pretty good too. By the way, bring cash. They don’t take plastic. Show less

Author: Julie F
Title: Incredible
Review: Steak done to perfection!  Beautiful scenary.  Amazing ribs.  So affordable and worth every penny.  Will make this a daily.

Author: Cjb54321
Title: Another fantastic evening at mangoes
Review: A great place to go whether you are dining alone or with friends.  Lovely atmosphere, great food . Beautiful tranquil setting.

Author: En0ckSydney, Australia
Title: Europe food - if you are missing it
Review: Lovely location looking out to the sunset through trees. Menu is completely European- mainly British with a good variety of food. I’d describe the food as very well executed home cooking. Price for food and wine are reasonable. The place is difficult to find as it is down a dead end road with only a small sign on the side of the restaurant- worth a visit if you want a change from Asian food for a night. Good atmosphere and friendly, attentive service. We recommend a trip here and would certainly come again.Show less

Author: Adrian PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Want a good European meal dont eat here
Review: Well the ambience is nice, the food on the other hand is well below average with prices that make a dent in your pocket if you add the extras because nothing comes with nothing . The steak medium to well done for my partner came with blood pouring out and cold(probably frozen) the ribs a signature dish were well cooked but the sauce was really disappointing . I would not mind but this is the second bad meal I've had here but giving them a second chance seemed fruitless. I won't be coming back that I will 100% assure you. Please avoid if you possibly can there are far better on the island .Try Co-cos or Gallo Nero now they are good restaurants!Show less

Author: Lisa I
Title: Awesome place
Review: A visit to Mangoes is a must.... great place to go in a group or on your own, you will receive a warm welcome from Michele and the friendly locals, eggs benedict on a sunday are a must.

Author: hongy854Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Awesome desert but little bit hard to locate the place
Review: Use Waze to guide you there. When reach do stop and search around. We nearly miss the place if we do not look closely. The foods was satisfactory, the dessert was awesome (not too sweet). The owner and staff are really friendly and make us feel warmth at heart. Overall is nice, will go there again for sure. Show less

Author: MICHAEL LAdelaide, Australia
Title: Evening meal at Mangoes
Review: With 7 other friends we had a nice evening at the beachside restaurant Mangoes. Secluded, quiet, green setting, ocean view, and under a patio roof with open sides and front. A good sized menu with some interesting and nostalgic dishes for the western palate all at a very moderate price. A welcoming host and good service. We are looking forward to a return visit and perusing the wall of library books they have there as well!Show less

Author: dominiquen515
Title: Awesome service
Review: Food and service are good. Wine is cheap! They even offered to drive us back to our Airbnb! Can't ask for more.

Author: brian s
Title: Best western food we've found in langkawi in the 3weeks we have stayed here overall
Review:
Overall experience was excellent,
great standard of home made food 
Save some room for the 
Homemade deserts they are delicious 
Very friendly and helpful owners and staff 
We will be returning soon

Author: AchonkarPune, India
Title: Great place, yum food, awesome service, cutest dog!
Review: As the title suggests, this is a really nice and quaint little place nestled in amongst the greenery and has the yummiest food and that too at really affordable prices. The service is great and the ambience is just so calm and relaxed. And yes if your lucky then honey the dog will be around who is simply the cutest! Just had a fabulous dinner there and will be back for sure!Show less

Author: starskytlfSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food with cheap price & lovely owners
Review: A hidden gems restaurant, with friendly owners & staffs, nice and clean environment and arrangement. The food are awesome, excellent homemade western food with unbelievable cheap price. We accidentally found the place when we are otw to airport. Thanks to God, fate and Google, lead us to this lovely place. Love the food and environment, sure will come again on my next Langkawi trip.Show less

Author: 991ninedParis, France
Title: Awesome night
Review: The place is really nice, beautiful terrace and trees !I ve had the fish steak and tomatoes salad, it was delicious and my friend had the Aussie burger which was huuuuge! Everything was really good and we ve had a wonderful night ! The hosts are so friendly and so nice ! Thanks again ! Definitely a must go restaurant on the island Show less

Author: X3829ETthomasp
Title: Very good food and kind hosts
Review: My girlfriend and I had a very good donner at this restaurant ! The place is very nice and the hosts are very kind !

Author: belench89
Title: Excellent homemade western food attended by owners
Review: The place is really nice and clean and cozy. They have a short menu but everything is delicious, including the desserts. It's good to go there to escape of Asian food or fancy restaurants. Michelle and his husband are very nice and always there. I would totally go back again, and specially Sunday's for the brunch. Outside it isn't very clear the sign of the restaurant, is too small, but follow the gps and it will lead you straight there. Show less

Author: _D3198VHHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Super
Review: I'm new to this island and was suffering because of a food here. Of course you can eat in local warung but not every day. This place is very special! Nice location and very cozy! You feel like at home, seriously! The lady owner reminds me my auntie! Food is delicious service is excellent! I recommend! This dessert calls Pavlova very light like Russian ballerina Show less

Author: MattwhitepaintLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food, nice setting, GREAT DOG!
Review: Best and probably only spinach lasagna I've ever had in Asia. Made me think of home. Lovely service and quaint setting. But the star of the show was honey the cute little dog that loved attention. We were half tempted to steal her and take her with us :pLots of great food and drink to choose from. Strongly recommend if you're staying nearby Show less

Author: smithsari
Title: Excellent
Review: Very nice food very good service very enjoyable place for hang out and real crispy becon.must visit this place you find in Langkawi original German food and specially Aussie 🍔 just waaaowww

Author: Mkloet
Title: Awesome spot
Review:
Awesome spot with some delicious bloody marys. Very warming staff! 

Also a million dollar view at the beach

Author: riavanderhoff
Title: Again a fantastic evening at Mangoes!
Review:
We had a fantastic spare rib meal and lovely company, as always, at Mongoes restaurant. Al tough just 2 days back from hospital Michelle was alive and kikking! 
We  recomment Mongoes to everybody who likes a excelent Western or Australian meal.

Author: Wan LIn E
Title: Mangoes is Awesome.
Review: They serve the best food in Langkawi. Friendliest host. Awesome place to hang out after dinner with a glass of chilled beer.

Author: 445andreasm
Title: A nice Restaurant with real Bacon..
Review:
A nice Restaurant where Pork meat dishes are available. A good Sunday brunch starting 11am.
We went there and enjoyed the very western dishes.
Nice Service
Clean.
If we are next time on Langkawi we will go there again.

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food.
Review: We visited Mangoes yet again on this our most recent holiday to Langkawi.Enjoyed everything and have but one comment which obviously appertains only to ourselves and that is we felt the music system was too loud for our liking. It was turned partially down but, unfortunately, was turned back up later on making conversation quite difficult.Show less

Author: NikkiAnne2014Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: If you are looking for good food then Mangoes is one of the places to be when you are in Langkawi. Not only is the food good but the ambiance is nice. Set in an outdoor area, well covered against typical tropical rainfalls, it is quiet and has a relaxing atmosphere.The owners, Lutz and Michelle, will make you feel very welcome. Some good traditional German dishes are available but I wouldn't classify it as German. Only open for brunch on a Sunday otherwise open for dinner with the exception of Monday's and Tuesday's. Also advisable to book.Show less

Author: rogerbrauerTaunton, United Kingdom
Title: First class restaurant
Review: As part of our 20 day stay on Langkawi we had to visit Mangoes as we had been there last year and had a lovely time.This visit was no exception and once again a fabulous meal was had, together with great company from our hosts Michelle and Lutz.My wife and I had the specials of roast lamb and mash and roast pork and mash and both were divine.The friendliness of this place is really homely and the service is first class.A must visit if your on Langkawi Thanks once again to Michelle, Lutz and all the staff.Show less

Author: Narcissus666Williton, United Kingdom
Title: Good solid European food
Review: If you are tiring of the wonderful Asian/ Malay food in Langkawi and fancy a bit of home cooking comfort with a European flavour Mangoes is a pleasant retreat. Tucked away in a lovely leafy lane with good views on a clear day its a nice indoor/outdoor experience. A really good and varied menu run by very friendly Australian and German hosts who have created a very family friendly atmosphere. A firm favourite with those returning to the island over and over, ex pat locals and travellers. As a solo traveller and diner and returnee to the restaurant I was made to feel very welcome and at home. Good food, good value for money. Its very popular so its best to book although sometimes you can drop in unannounced and get lucky. Give it a go!! The hosts are also more than happy to organise a taxi to wherever you are returning to which is really useful.Show less

Author: Robert A
Title: Good European food
Review: Great location with a special atmosphere, run by an Australian and German host. Good European food and beverages.

Author: daaiosDunshaughlin, Ireland
Title: Really great comfort food
Review: My family and I ate here this evening.We really struggled to find it but it was well worth the search in the end. All the staff were friendly and welcoming of us and accommodated our children without any problems.The food was great. Simple western comfort food which totally hit the spot. It was to all of our tastes. My husband and I enjoyed our seafood pie & lamb shank so much we forgot to offer each other a taste before it was all gone. The children cleared their plates too, they shared a lasagne and loved it. We all shared a garlic bread starter, which was disappeared by the children in a flash!We also got desserts as we suspected they would be too good to miss. We were right. By far the best dessert we have had on our trip in Singapore & Malaysia so far. Only little quibble was my husband & son informed me the gents toilets were in a pretty poor condition. The ladies weren't so bad by Malaysian standards.Overall I would totally recommend this place. It's out of the way but it's well worth it. In terms of finding it, it's really hidden. Follow google maps and at the junction look out for a big warehouse type building marked Dewan Orang Ramai. (If you pass the police station you have gone wrong, the restaurant is in the opposite direction.) Go left from the warehouse and next there is a large hall type building. At the end of it you will see a little lane way arched over by foliage. There is a small sign on the wall there. Go down the little lane and enjoy a lovely dinner!By the way the bar also looks cosy but we didn't get to try that with children & driving.Show less

Author: MEG1953
Title: Great place
Review: Great food great staff. Every meal is wonderful. A must visit place. One of the most friendly restaurants on the island.

Author: zhihaochua
Title: Delicious!
Review: it has great views in the evening and food was superb! Fresh and flavourful dishes with friendly people running the restaurant

Author: themanfromearthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best ambience in Langkawi
Review: Located a bit out of the way from the hub of Cenang, the ambience of this place just kills it! With a view of the sea and super inviting atmosphere, time spent here was a pleasure. Food is also good and we ordered the vegetarian fare - quite good lasagna and soup. Definitely recommend when in town. Show less

Author: tt53
Title: As good as ever!
Review:
After a break of five years we went back to one of our favourite restaurants in Langkawi,  and was pleased to say that this has not changed!  We love it there - friendly staff and brilliant food at good prices.

What else would you need!

Author: Jazz JMalaysia
Title: TASTY MEALS & FANTABULOUS SERVICE !
Review: If you are on the island Mangoes restaurant is a must go! Whether you'd like to chill, eat or just watch the sunset while sipping cocktails then this would be the perfect place. Michele's customer service is up to perfection! We have tried almost most of the dishes from the menu and the specials, well they were all absolutely delicious ! Liver and bacon is one of our favourites. We booked in once with all our friends , and they all loved it! Once I took some of our Ozzy friends here for dinner and they were pretty much amazed with the atmosphere and the setting.Need I say more, Mangoes still on top of my list and is our all time favourite. Mangoes also caters private functions as long as you pre book in advance. Try it you will not be disappointed! Oh by the way, we've been going to Mangoes since we have been on the island for almost 3 years now , so please ignore the visit year tab.Show less

Author: Heli KHelsinki, Finland
Title: Amazing food and lovely people
Review: This place is a must try when you go to Langkawi. We ended up eating there every night! Amazingly good home cookings: steaks, king prawns, soups and lasagna. I loved everything! And don't forget to try their delicious desserts. I highly recommend the place, don't miss it!Show less

Author: L3945ZAmichaels
Title: A must on langkawi
Review:
The food is so delicious and the Ambiente is very nice and you can spend many nice hours there. And we found also very delicious food for a vegetarian. 
We would like go there again on our next trip.

Author: 511MargaretWGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: AMAZING!!!!!!!!
Review: We had an amazing time at Mangoes celebrating Australia Day with a great BBQ, wine and the most delicious pavlova EVER. From the minute you arrive you are looked after with great service and banter.  Do not leave Langkawi without visiting here, you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: 85carolineGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: REALLY FRIENDLY BAR, GREAT CHAT AND DELICIOUS FOOD
Review: Great restaurant and bar run by Michelle & Lutz.Regular patrons sit at the L-shaped bar chatting and enjoying some real belly laughs! Great atmosphere with Michelle and Lutz getting in on the banter.We moved to a table to enjoy our meals - great starters and mains but leave room for Michelle's Pavlova or Apple Strudel - to die for!We visited a few years ago and were so pleased we went back. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Valerie DBeijing, China
Title: Don't miss it!
Review: Delicious food. Great service. Very nice location. Good music. Wonderful cocktail !Not easy to find so don't hesitate to look for it. It is more like a house than a restaurant from outside and that is the point. When you are there you feel like home. Enjoy!!!Show less

Author: dotk367
Title: Well cooked food and home from home atmosphere
Review: We dropped in at Mangoes on recommendation from sailing friends. Although it was mid afternoon we were still able to order lunch and ate delicious quiche and salads. The service was attentive and friendly, the sea view was lovely and the dogs were cute. We really enjoyed our lunch and spending a couple of hours in what seemed to us to be a little bit of Australia!Show less

Author: HanchwinzReading
Title: Brilliant food!
Review: What a lovely place to find - the staff are so welcoming and chatty, we had a great evening. There are some nice views of sunset from some of the tables. The mango cocktails were absolutely delicious and our food was fantastic. I had schnitzel with mashed potato (better than I usually make myself!) and my partner had steak with gorgeous fried potatoes and he also had apple strudel for pudding which he said was yummy. Really relaxed atmosphere, quite busy we were glad we turned up quite early before the sun went down. I would certainly recommend this place to others, when we left my partner and I were fantasising about running away from England and asking for jobs at mangoes! The food choices make a nice change if you have over loaded on rice/noodles - lots of great sounding dishes such as beef bourgignon, roast lamb and chocolate mud pie. But you MUST have a mango cocktail they were so yummy! Show less

Author: kumeilpMwanza, Tanzania
Title: Speechless
Review: I felt right at home as soon as i entered this cosy place. The owners are prople who would truly go out of their way to serve you a delicious meal. They accommodated me very well. The steak was good, the mango madness signature drink was just wow and a lovely cup of coffee topped that off. I would love to try their desserts next.Highly recommend!!!!!Show less

Author: JillianJanetBoston, Massachusetts
Title: Best dinner and drinks on the island!
Review: Michelle and Lutz, the bartenders and owners, were the best! Made us feel right at home on Christmas and part of a big family! The food was amazing, atmosphere super fun and the drinks on point. Definitely try the special drink "Mango Madness!" We even came back for brunch later in the week and were treated to a top notch breakfast! Definitely the best meals we had on our trip!Show less

Author: TohWeiK
Title: A Very Nice Atmosphere
Review: A great place for having a meal with friends. The food were delicious and the people who run the place are very friendly too.

Author: Kateřina B
Title: Amazing Gulaš and štrůdl
Review: This restaurant offer not only friendly atmosphere and great servise, but also very delicious food. This Gulaš I had with my friend was one of the best I've ever had in my life and I've already had many because I am Czech And this is one of our traditional food and I was same with štrůdl! Really great time there! Highly recommend! Show less

Author: Kathi-HH-HAM
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Very nice place and excellent chicken soup. Loved the book shelves with books in different languages. We went there 2x, Prices are absolutely reasonable.

Author: YeeYin
Title: Great view and nice ambiance
Review: Great place with great view. Owner of this place is an Aussie and is very willing to share her story with us. Portion of the meal is quite big and the taste is unique. House wine tastes great. Place is romantic. However it is quite hard to find this hidden gem.Show less

Author: James DHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Food and friendly staff
Review: Me and my girlfriend have just returned from Mangoes. It is with out doubt one of the best meals we have had whilst in Langkawi. The staff were brilliant, especially considering my gluten and dairy allergy and the food was amazing. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting the island.Show less

Author: ZhannaMa
Title: Very cozy
Review:
We had breakfast there and liked it!
Nice design, good food and friendly service. Recommended. Will be back.

Author: heyst22
Title: Super good and cozy!
Review: Very good food and super service. A little better than Yasmin and similar places! Like visiting your grandmas place with all the nice decorations.

Author: EvenjNSepilok, Malaysia
Title: Great ambiance and tasty food
Review: We have a great time here at Mangoes celebrating our dear friend's birthday and our hols. On the outside the restaurant looks unassuming but on the inside it's a wonderful and surprising gem! The ambiance was perfect, the food excellent and reasonably priced, good wine selection and the dessert was just heavenly! It's a friendly place warmly welcomed by one of the proprietors; Michele, taken good care by Chris on top of the tasty food. A restaurant I'd highly recommend to visit in Langkawi for great food and revisit.Show less

Author: Ratsears
Title: What you see is what you get! Great little place
Review: Good food, great people, nice ambiance, cold beer, very welcoming, and helpful. Sunday brunch has real bacon and the best Eggs Benedict!

Author: greenwave1972Paris, France
Title: Risotto GREAT
Review: We've been to many of the top listed restaurants on Langkawi but mangoes stands out. tonight I had the seafood risotto and the bride had a Chicken ceasar salad...must say that they were the best! only problem was that I could taste any of the ceasar. need to go back again and switch orders! Must try it - and great views of the mangroves and the seaShow less

Author: Cjb54321
Title: Fabulous
Review: Another great time was had by all at mangoes - Michelle and lutz and their great staff as always looked after us brilliantly. The food was delicious as always and made even better by the fact that our table of 14 were all served at the same time with piping hot food. Following that up today with their famous brunch washed down by their renowned Bloody Mary pick me ups xShow less

Author: Adeekul
Title: RMSIR2016
Review: Great ambience! Good food! Amazing service! Michelle the hostess rocks!!! We always come back here whenever in Langkawi!!! Honey and Ginger, the two lil pooches are just so adorable!!!

Author: sharinkeong
Title: Rare gem of Langkawi
Review: Perfect ambience for a dinner. Nice host, really enjoyed conversation with Michele. Great portion of food, and it tastes Super yummy btw!

Author: Jennifer L
Title: Hidden gem with impressive setting
Review: Googled this place and finally came over for dessert & coffee. Worth every effort of it. The chocolate walnut pie was awesome. Hope to come by someday for their sunset dinner. Truly a gem in Kuala Teriang.

Author: avchoyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great hidden cafe 👍
Review: Friendly owner, good food (They serve pork! Yeay!), cozy ambience & there's a wall filled with books for you to unwind with your drinks! Its a little bit tricky to find but just look out for the small signboard at the top corner of the house and you’ll be there .Show less

Author: Katja PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: The Ultimate Steak
Review: To me, cooking a proper steak is an art. Mangoes knows how to cook steaks and they are big! :)You can choose your additional items, for example; homemade mashed potatoes, not the prepackaged crap some others serve. That makes a difference to me. You can mix and match any choice of meats/ fish / salad / vegetables. I truly believe this is where Australia thoroughly meets Germany in the kitchen... :) Show less

Author: 575jannenHelsinki, Finland
Title: Excellent food
Review: This was my second trip to Langkawi and second time to this restaurant. Amazing food and the owners are really nice couple. If I go third time to the Langkawi then it will be my third time at this restaurant.If you think it's too far from Chenai beach you are wrong because this restaurant is worth to visit. I recommend to everyone to go there and have an excellent dinner.Show less

Author: SweehoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place!
Review: This restaurant is a little bit difficult to find but it really is worth the effort! The ambience was perfect for a romantic dinner even though we brought our kids there. The food was excellent especially the meat dishes and the lady owner was very friendly and attentive. This restaurant is thoroughly recommended! Show less

Author: kbeadle02Malaysia
Title: Lovely birthday brunch
Review: A little gem hidden away. My partner booked here for my birthday and I wasn't disappointed. The food was excellent and the service was also excellent. A friendly family run business that gives the food a home cooked quality. The staff are lovely and chatted freely with us while topping up our sparkling wine continuously. The cost was exceptional for the service and food. Would love to come back.Show less

Author: TropikulSingapore, Singapore
Title: Feels and tastes like home
Review: Don't let the exterior entrance to the restaurant fool you. It may look like a normal neighborhood house on the outside, but there is a wonderful restaurant right at the back. We had the pumpkin ginger soup, Lamb shank, chilli con carne, frangipani pear cake, and Michele's chocolate cake and we are happy to report that it was sublime. Prices were affordable and the ambience that of a beach house, relaxed and care free. Champagne was RM10 a glass! Definitely will make a trip down to mangoes again for a meal when we get the chance.Show less

Author: stuartm87
Title: Enjoyed
Review: Went on the recommendation of a mate who lived in Langkawi. The place looks like a house but don't be fooled it has great food cold beer fantastic hosts and a good price too. Would recommend this place highly.

Author: DixonbergMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and lovely hosts!
Review: Friends recommended we visit Mangoes on our recent trip to Langkawi, and it did not disappoint. Great food and atmosphere, very welcoming and friendly hosts, and even a lovely dog, named Honey! Food is Western style, with a great home cooked feel. Good options for vegetarians too, which can be hard to find in Langkawi! Make sure you leave room for the amazing desserts!! It's a little hard to find, as its a bit tucked away, we just jumped in a cab to get there.Would definitely come back here if we visit Langkawi again!Show less

Author: fox7179
Title: went back again
Review: our 2 trip to langkawi we went back to this favorite spot - what a great scene with mangroves and sea and mostly Michele! Must go!

Author: robontheway
Title: Fabulous!!
Review:
Great place to have great food!!
Awesome people with great hospitality. Truly recommend for everyone to try Mangoes! Thanks Mangoes team.

Author: Camper48362
Title: Awesome food and friendly hospitality
Review: Following a spell in Singapore was in Langkawi for 4 nights and wanted some Western food. Reading other reviews on Tripadvisor decided to try Mangoes and was not disappointed. Husband and I both had the Aussie Burger and I didnt know whether to eat it or climb it!!! The meat was excellent. Enjoyed the place so much came back again second night (tonight) and had spinach lasagna, hubby had meatloaf, mash and onion gravy - both really good. Michelle the owner is very friendly and everyone cannot do enough for you. Would definately recommend this place when visiting Langjawi. Top nosh!!! (The Christmases)Show less

Author: Leslie S
Title: Local dining fare in Langkawi
Review: Home style food, friendly hangout with the locals. Great service. This is a good place for cheap but tasty eats in a relaxed atmosphere.

Author: roshanr786Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Awesome Food
Review: Have been many times . Schnitzel was 1 of my best ever had Even you should try the its like fish nd chips i forgot the name but its to good It's reasonable nd its fits in the budget easily The owners are the best . They personally make you feel comfortable. Definitely will go back again and again . Cheers Show less

Author: Simatra2015Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: The best western food on Langkawi
Review: I was craving some good homemade western food and they sure came up with it ,the lamb shank ,real mash and fresh veg was mouth watering ,the lamb just fell of the bone ,lovely setting and they really make you feel at home full marks Michele and Luzt Chris from UK Show less

Author: LauraLe0neNew Hampshire
Title: Best local food!!!
Review: Traveling around the world for a year and when traveling it's hard to find a great local spot but this was perfect!!! Great food and good time with great people. Made us feel like home. Each night they have different specials and it was so delicious. It is great to go just before sunset, there is a view of the water and the sky is so beautiful. I recommend taking the time to get lunch or dinner here, you will not be disappointed!Show less

Author: Ballsy66
Title: Sunday brunch
Review: Amazing food for Sunday brunch together with a glass of champers. Eggs Benedit with salmon or bacon, lamb shank with lots of veggies. A very peaceful garden ambience!

Author: Julian  U
Title: Delicious!
Review: Delicious food at cheap prices, we had the Weiner Schnitzel with Apple Strudel for dessert,  highly recommended

Author: 211stevenf
Title: Invite for some home style cooking
Review: Great little place a bit hard to find but its worth it.Wanted a change from local food had a great steak and lamb shanks for the wife.Wish I was not driving so we could have stayed longer

Author: Zubair KBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Place
Review: My 2 daughters and I came here on the off chance as it was close to our Resort. Wow!!! What an amazing place, lovely setting, excellent surroundings and beautiful views and the Food was just Fantastic.The staff are extremely attentive, polite and very professional and Friendly. When we asked for a taxi back to our resort, the owner went out of her way and said she would drop us back to our resort - you cant ask for better service than that!! If you want fantastic food that is reasonably priced and an environment which is different, come to Mangoes, you wont be disappointed. Cant wait to go again before returning to the UK.Show less

Author: tkornderCologne, Germany
Title: Dinner and Brunch
Review: Great Location feeling like sitting in the Jungle. With amazing friendly service and delicious food.A combination of Australia's lovely conversation and German Kitchen.You need to search for the location, but it's 100% worth it.Brunch with Bloody Mary and private airport transport.Will come again for sure...Can recommend 100% Show less

Author: BR1532
Title: Sunday brunch is a must
Review: Check out this amazing little place about 10 minutes drive outside of pantai cenang. The food is excellent, the staff amazing and the owners are really nice. If you do nothing else on langkawi, visit mangoes and get your food on.

Author: Nomad532913
Title: A quiet gem on the island. Regularly patronized by the locals and expats who want good food.
Review: Settled among tropical greenery with a beach view and nice breeze it is easily the most friendly restaurant on the island. There is a good menu with lots of choice in European style food. I have been going there for years and never disappointed.

Author: treavelmadoxfordshire
Title: Great European food
Review: Treated to a meal here by a staff member from The Danna Hotel just 10 mins drive away. Excellent choice of European Food, even Pork on the menu ! Lovely rustic setting, wonderful hospitality, delicious well cooked food. Had a very enjoyable evening , look forward to our next visit .Show less

Author: ShazzaLeeMelbourne
Title: WISH WE HAD BEEN ABLE TO EAT THERE
Review: Arrived there desperate to find 'safe' food for this coeliac. So hard to find in places in Malaysia. Only to find the premises closed. I was asked to read the business card closely as it was handed to me and there in the fine print. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays. Well advertise this a bit better. Disappointed that we couldn't visit, but pleased to find The Red Tomato in Pantai Cenang instead.Show less

Author: May F
Title: Great dinner!
Review: Had my husband's birthday dinner here. Thanks to the host as we were given a bigger table despite it was reserved as we bring along our 4 months old boy. Food is simply awesome, great atmosphere, nice music, superb sunset view. Couldn't ask for more. Definitely wil come back again for more. Show less

Author: Philippe K
Title: Very good food, familiar service.
Review:
This restaurant is very good. Mangoes has a very relaxed and laid back atmosphere, good western food and a good relaxed service.
We have eaten 3 times in Mangoes and we don't regret.

Author: reflectionsv37Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Eggs Benedict for Sunday Brunch
Review: People had been telling me about this restaurant for more than year. It's a shame their directions weren't as good as the food! I was looking for a location on Google Maps and saw Mangoes pop up. About 3 miles away from the directions I'd been getting from friends. Fortunately, Google Maps has the location 100% accurate.We were headed out that Sunday morning and decided we check it out to see if it was really there. It was!! Tucked away from the noise of traffic with a beautiful ocean view!I had the Eggs Benedict and asked where they find the English Muffins. They make them in house! The other items on the menu look great and I can't wait to go back and try some of there western dinner items. Definitely a place I'll be returning to over and over again.And now I know where it is!!!Show less

Author: Salah R
Title: Good food, friendly atmosphere
Review: friendly people, nice food, great desert, great atmosphere with lovely music, and acceptable prices.

Author: 0505Kate
Title: Saturday night Dinner
Review:
Beautiful freshly cooked food. Well presented in a peaceful setting. Friendly hosts and good prices.
Mango Maddnes cocktail is Delicious!

Author: 382sherisHonolulu, Hawaii, United States
Title: Sunday Brunch!!
Review: A friend of ours recommended Mangoes for Sunday Brunch. We had to use google maps to find it, but it was well worth it!!! I had the Eggs Benedict with smoked salmon and a bit of the bubbly. What a delicious treat!! The restaurant has a charming atmosphere and the owner is delightful. We will become regulars I sure!!Show less

Author: wjm4338
Title: Great setting. Great food. Great owners. Well Worth a visit
Review: Great place. Well worth a visit.Great food. Great setting.Great owners.👍🏻 Enjoyed the whole experience..No complaints..

Author: lee r
Title: Never disappoints
Review: From the moment you walk in you are made to feel welcome and at home. Michelle and Lutz have created a beautiful sophisticated, rustic environment, set in the mangroves at the edge of the bay. The menu is western (I don't think there is rice on the menu) perfect if you are ready for a change from the local fare. A place to meet and chat with the local ex pats, travelers and yachties, with a large book exchange and Malaysian bird life to keep you entertained. Homemade desserts and bread add to the delights. Don't miss the Eggs Benedict for Sunday brunch! EnjoyShow less

Author: Penny G
Title: Excellent Food yet again.
Review:
Very pleased to revisit Mangoes on my last holiday.
First class food, great variety, all served in a very good location.
Highly recommended.

Author: nedwood8you2Greater London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing place to eat you are in the mangrove
Review: fantastic food, fantastic people great variety. It is run by an Australian wife and German husband, so it can get very confusing as the evening goes on. They do specials of the day all food is freshly cooked and varies day to day its open Wednesday to Sunday open all day Sunday. If you jump a cab from the main strip its about 25 Ringgit £5Show less

Author: Fubu1
Title: Nothing soecsil
Review: My wife had the pumpkin soap and I had the lamb shank. Both were barely warm. We also had the garlic bread which was like card board. The lamb shank itself was very fatty and made me feel sick. The only good thing was the fries.Show less

Author: travelitaa1
Title: nice food
Review: Mangoes is a nice place to eat. They serve typical malay or western dishes. Very friendly owners and nice ambience.

Author: rogerbrauerTaunton, United Kingdom
Title: What a gem!
Review: Mangoes is not easy to find, but once you're there it really is a hidden gem!It is casual and really laid back and your host, Michelle is one of a kind. She really is lovely and takes care of your every needs. All of the food is home cooking at its best.My Liver and onions with mash was to die for!Everyone should visit Mangoes if your on Langkawi, you will not be disappointed.Thanks Michelle and your lovely staff for such a lovely evening, we shall be back next year for sure.Show less

Author: Syme0nAdelaide, Australia
Title: Never Fails to Deliver
Review: I first discovered this place back in 2011 when it was still pretty new. As I sampled their rib-eye steak back then, I was transported to a world of no return. Michelle's recommendation may have been quite simple and basic back then; that I give the medium-rare cooking style a go, but her concern and her commitment to her job was what made me fell in love with the place. Five years down the road, after I make my fourth return to eat their delicious cooking, it still never fails to deliver. It is still the best for as far as I could recall but having said that, my vacation was a rather brief one for me to sample the much newer restaurants and bistros that are sprouting up like mushrooms along Chenang Beach.Show less

Author: 538simonmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Service deteriorated
Review: We have been here a few times and always been satisfied. This visit was disappointing as the service had really gone off and the quality of staff waiting was really poor. Food also took ages to arrive and the place was not that busy. Come on Mangoes you can do better !!Show less

Author: Joshua S
Title: A Must Try in Langkawi
Review: The ambience, service and food is excellent. The sheperds pie, lamb n lamb shank is a must try.. For the dessert i will recomend Baileys cheese cake..

Author: SMSteve2009Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great occasion!
Review: My wife and I went to Mangoes on recommendation of our friends. It did not disappoint. The western food (some dishes are German I presume inspired by the German owner) was very good (especially the pumpkin ginger soup) and our hosts Michelle and Lutz were excellent fun. This is about a overall experience in a lovely setting for people who want to enjoy an evening of fun and laughter. If that's you, go along and enjoy! Show less

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre price-efficiency
Review: From my attached picture, you can roughly know what I had ordered in Mangoes. Well, none of those dishes meet my expectation, and usual eateries can beat Mangoes in both the tastes and price-efficiency. Lack of cheese in Chicken cordon blue, normal seasoning in their grilled fish, normal potato soup and mango crepe. My partner could not finish the plate of grilled fish despite she likes to eat fish.The only thing that shined in Mangoes was their service and passion. With a meal costing around RM 100, I didn't see anything to substantiate the price, or value, of their offerings. Although others seemed to be satisfied, there will be no second visit for me.Show less

Author: tgwwgtTravelHermanus, South Africa
Title: Great ambiance - island style
Review: This cosy eatery is tucked away close enough to the beach to see the sun go down framed by palm trees.. We went with island friends and were warmly greeted by Michele (the owner). Service was friendly and efficient.The menu offered a good selection of dishes. I opted for the spinach lasagne which was excellent, The liver and onion served with mashed potato was also good according to my partner Desserts were quite stunning and I would recommend the mango crepe The restaurant also had a small but well patronised bar, where locals and tourists alike were enjoying drinks and good conversation.Show less

Author: irene chan ai l... cIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Very tasty homemade Western food
Review: It sure was difficult to locate the place as it's tucked away at a dead-end. But ask any local and you'll be directed to this restaurant cum home. Such a lovely experience dining in this homely restaurant surrounded by lush greenery. Husband's roast lamb was very well done (he especially loved the mashed potatoes). My chicken cordon bleu was also one of the best that I've ever tasted. Fortunately, we still had space in our stomach so we shared a mango crepe, which was delicious.Show less

Author: LorimicheleLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Never dissapointed!
Review: I have been living in Langkawi for 8 months now, and my favorite place to eat and drink is Mango's. Michele , the owner, is always there with a smile and a welcome. The menu has something for everyone . Some of my favorites are the homemade lasagnes, which includes homemade pasta and ricotta cheese made on the premises! There is a vegetable lasagne which is delicious. Also Mango's homemade potatoe salad and coleslaw I think is the best on the island, which goes great with the chicken schnitzel. The views are stunning and you truly feel like you set foot on a tropical island.,along with all the beautiful flowers and plantings. Most importantly is that the staff is always helpful and friendly. As I said, give it a try and you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Lesley QColchester, United Kingdom
Title: Did not live up to reviews
Review: We arrived to an almost frosty welcome, admittedly we had not booked, but a previous meeting with the owner had said this was not always necessary. We were told that spaces were limited and were shown to a small table where we waited and waited and waited to order a drink, when others who had arrived after us were served immediately.We eventually got to order food, which again did not arrive - the waiter had given it to someone else, who had not even ordered it!He kept assuring s that it was on it's way, but after several reminders and more than 50 minutes we still had no food. We left! Considering all the reviews we had read about how wonderful it all was, we would not visit again.Show less

Author: CaycuPValencia, Spain
Title: Overpriced and overrated
Review: Having read many reviews of people raving about this place, my wife and I thought it would be a welcome change from the lack fare on offer on the island. But I can beat describe "Mangoes" in one word...."OVERPRICED".The hospitality of the proprietress, Michelle, is second-to-none. She's warm and friendly and the place has a relaxing atmosphere. But she is letdown in the kitchen. The menu would suggest simple, tasty "home-cooked" style recipes. But almost everything we ate lacked taste and flavour.....one exception being the pumpkin-ginger soup.If you fancy a change from the local cuisine AND you have deep pockets, then it's not a bad option. But once was enough for us.Show less

Author: JiggomanXiamen, China
Title: A private restaurant with lovely hosts!
Review: Mangoes is hidden away down the end of a small road close to Ocean Lodge Langkawi. It has a private, secluded feel which adds to the charm of the house and creates a warm and friendly atmosphere. I visited Mangoes three times during my visit to Langkawi and found the food and the service most satisfying. I recommend Mangoes to anyone looking for a nice meal and friendly service. They could do with a sign a little further out so that it is easier to find but other than that it is pretty much perfect. Show less

Author: Anniesav28Hawaii
Title: Our fave on Langkawi!
Review: Mangoes is amazing! The food is great, and the atmosphere is even better. Set in a local neighborhood, it's a hidden gem. It's not until you walk around back that the place comes into view. We were on Langkawi for a week, and were there at least 4 times. This is the "Malaysian Cheers!" We felt like old friends even after the first visit. We can't say enough about Michele and the rest of the staff...we even hung out with them on the beach on their day off. By the time we left Langkawi, we felt like we were leaving with new friends. Go try Mangoes...you'll love it!Show less

Author: Tom BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Believe the hype!
Review: Very much an ex-pat place, but after so long in Malaysia we were sick of rice and noodles and needed some home comforts.Lovely location, great atmosphere and very welcoming and friendly staff and regulars. Food was excellent, beer was cheap. Definitely worth a visit.If you're a fan of burgers...have the Aussie burger.Show less

Author: guseva_annablSanya, China
Title: Home away from home
Review: We had an absolutely amazing dinner there with my boyfriend. I've had meatballs and mash and it's was very tasty accompanied with fresh orange juice. The atmosphere is very welcoming and it's definitely a place where you want to come back. The location is also very interesting, though it's a restaurant, but still you feel like you are surrounded by jungles and hidden from other people. A must to go for a great food and friendly atmosphere ❤Show less

Author: Penny G
Title: Excellent restaurant.
Review:
Went to Mangoes repeatedly during our last four week holiday.
Excellent in every respect and greatly look forward to revisiting on our next holiday.

Author: Wenjuan WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice restaurant in a remote area
Review: This restaurant is quite hard to find. You have to drive to the dead end of the road and follow a small signage to reach the place.Nevertheless, the food was worth the search. The food was delicious and reasonably priced, portion was adequate, and the atmosphere is very cozy. The owners were also very friendly and will check with you once a while to make sure you enjoy your dining experience.Show less

Author: Eva U
Title: Hidden place with great food and atmosphere
Review: If you don't know about this restaurant you won't find it. As they don't have any sign on the street or something. They have wonderful food and great dessert as well. Stuff is very friendly and helpful :)

Author: Jenphoenix JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The place is fast becoming an institution
Review: Very popular with expats living in Langkawi and Kuala Lumpur - no trip there is complete without a visit. Best Bloody Mary's in town! The food is home-cooked hearty English and German/European - so it is not halal. Bit of a (cheap) cab ride to get there but just relax and plan to spend a few hours looking out over mangroves to the sea while enjoying the friendly atmosphere and cheap cheap drinks!! Enjoy. I highly recommend it.....Show less

Author: 39tonyjHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Great food, great atmosphere, friendly, casual, relaxed, homely.
Review: The restaurant was recommended to us - and we are thankful to our friends for that! We were welcomed warmly in an informal almost casual but very friendly way. We chose from the blackboard and we were not disappointed - the food was superb - tasty, filling, and a wide selection of wholesome treats. It was so good we went back again the next evening. A real little treasure in a quiet leafy cul-de-sac with the accompaniment of small frogs chirping in the shadows and the staff working their magic to make us welcome and relaxed. A must to visit and dine.Show less

Author: FinMariaLand
Title: Very good buffet food on the Christmas Eve!
Review: I highly recommend this place. We had a Christmas buffet and it was amazing. The food had so many tastes, very versatile food choices for different diets, nice desserts and a friendly atmosphere! The prices are very reasonable, too. Make sure you find this place, it's not the easiest to find without having it as a destination!Show less

Author: 217geraldines
Title: Tropical Island atmosphere with Western food.
Review: There are very few places on Langkawi with a thatched roof and tropical isle atmosphere. Mangoes have it. Small friendly bar, sitting surrounded by a  tropical garden.Michelle, is the hostess,while Lutz oversees the kitchen. Perfect for the visitor wishing for the  famiilar  flavousr of home.

Author: DGB3604Seaford, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly but uninspiring.
Review: The proprietors were very warm and welcoming, our menu selections were well cooked and presented, but the overall experience was uninspiring.The location is rather out of the way, and we found the greater choice in Cenang offered so much more .Show less

Author: Ron K
Title: Great food, great hospitality!
Review: Excellent roasted lamb, pork chops, desserts are fantastic too! -- Mangoes is a great find in Langkawi!

Author: StellasqueaksNew Jersey
Title: The People Make the Place!
Review: When I was a kid I had an aunt whose house was like a revolving door for guests. She'd invite everyone in, and fed anyone who walked through her door a hearty meal cooked with love. This restaurant made me feel the same, exact way. I can here with a group of friends for dinner and it was one of the highlights of our trip. Michele, the owner, was welcoming and quick to offer us a table and drinks. The service was superb, fast but not overwhelming. I had the Impressive Bratwurst, a truly Impressive dish of perfectly cooked sausage, sauerkraut, and mashed potatoes... a comfort food from my childhood I didn't even know I had been craving! My friends had a variety of dishes, the meatloaf, the beef roulade, and the burger, all of which were delicious. We washed it down with their signature Mango Madness cocktails, a potent and secret blend which was not overly sweet or creamy, and came with a little umbrella...you know, fitting in paradise ;-)The desserts were insanely good and homemade, we had the apple strudel, the Baileys cheesecake, and something else I can't remember. Again, delicious. I would recommend this place to anyone, couples, families, day drinkers, brunch goers (they have a fabulous eggs Benedict!), or big groups. You won't regret it!And if you get the Impressive Bratwurst, which you should, do ask for the story behind it... :-)Thanks for our unforgettable experience!Show less

Author: hemanalini81Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Our 6th wedding anniversary dinner
Review: This is our 8th trip to langkawi and we've never experienced such great hospitality and fine cuisine. To start with, it was our sixth wedding anniversary and we were planning to have dinner a special place and Mangoes was more than memorable. I had the lamb and my husband had the pork chop(you must know that it's not easy to find a good pork dish on this island). We were blown away by the meal and not to mention by the hospitality and surrounding. It was by far one of the best restaurants we've dined in during all our stays at langkawi island. Beats all the 3,4,5 star hotels by a mile. Sincerely from our hearts, if you want to celebrate with family and friends, this is the place to be at. Thank you Michelle and crew for the best anniversary meal and pavlova we've ever experienced. CheersShow less

Author: Nicki Ganley V
Title: Girls night at mangoes
Review: We visited mangoes as a group of 9 ladies on vacation in langkawi. We had the best meal, we tried the Australian beef burger, the bratwurst, the meatloaf, the beef roulade, the schnitzels. Everyone loved the food!!!! Everything was perfect, the mango madness drink is a must have, the service is fantastic! The owners are so welcoming and accommodating. The desserts are also great, we especially enjoyed the baileys cheesecake. Highly recommend visiting Mangoes at least once, more if you can!!!!Show less

Author: LoobylouStaffsLowestoft, United Kingdom
Title: Best Eggs Benedict I've Ever Had
Review: My partner and I visited Mangoes for Sunday brunch after several word of mouth recommendations and enjoyed every aspect of the experience. The setting was lovely, our welcome was warm and service was really friendly and attentive. The food was outstanding - my Eggs Benedict was honestly the best I've ever had...anywhere! My partner had the full English Breakfast which he also loved. The only problem here was trying to decide exactly what to select from the mouthwatering menu as everything sounded so yummy - we had massive food envy when we surveyed other tables! Gutted we didn't have room for dessert! Top marks and thank you!Show less

Author: KaseKingRockingham, Australia
Title: AMAZING!!!
Review: My second visit to Langkawi recently with my partner visiting for the First time. I didn't hesitate to visit Mangoes again this trip, after my First experience being about a year and a half ago. My Partner and I ended up visiting Mangoes 6 times within the 13 days we were on the island. Michelle and Lutz are very down to earth people who provide a very relaxing entertaining environment whether you are there for a formal meal or to enjoy a cocktail at the bar.My Partner and I found all meals to be Absolutely Sensational and the service to be impeccable by all staff. If you plan to visit the Lamb Shank is a MUST!Sunday Brunch is a Perfect way to Start the Day, Eggs Benedict was Perfect. A Great Aussie Pavlova for Dessert never went astray. Meal sizing was Perfect and for those who enjoy a Cold Beer there is bountiful on ice.If Mangoes was in my home country you would find me there TONIGHT..!!Show less

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Good or not bad late dinner this time
Review: I never really like this place in the past as I remember my last visits was served with a very pale lamb chop and a pale services from Mr. Lut, however my visits on 21 of November 2015 was not bad I would say. I arrived quite late around 10pm, and only saw a couple in the bar counter and Mr lut was cleaning the table and Mr lut seems like stering up his last spirit to approach me and taking my orders, Michelle seems like having some injuries on her leg and honey the dog was a bit sceptical of my family arrival and keep on barking maybe due to my energy as I just finished massage someone but I manage to cool her down and assure her I am here for peace. I ordered a pork chop and my wife ordered chicken chop and share among my family. My youngest daughter was sleeping on the next table while we dine. The pork chop was ready good and the whole dining experience was above expectation as Michele the host was serving us with her injured leg but walked not as philanthropy as she used to be. Overall good late dining experiences, however we found some mosquitoes bites on my daughter hand the next day morning not sure if it was from the restaurant or else where, I noticed also the red wine I drink used to be rm 7 perglass seems like the price has gone up to rm 8 lately?.. Cheers Michele and lut, Show less

Author: LorimicheleLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: best on the island!
Review: i have been coming to Langkawi for 2 years now and the best by far is Mangoes! I have never had a bad meal. Today I had the pea soup and it was delicious! Also Lutz potatoe salad is amazing! Yesterday I had the meatloaf and mashed potatoes , with onions , and awesome coleslaw. I could go on and on, but don't miss this restaurant if you visit Langkawi. Michele and Lutz are there working there restaurant everyday, and they take good care of their customers. This is why this restaurant is such a success.Show less

Author: Effel54Kew, Australia
Title: Always a great place for Sunday lunch
Review: A lovely restaurant run by ex-pat (Aussie) Michelle. Food is delicious and well priced when you want a change from local cuisines. Lasagna is delicious, as are Michelle's desserts. Last year had the pavlova and this year warm chocolate walnut pie! Only a 10 minute taxi ride from Pantai Cenang. We will eat there every time we are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Doenova18Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Great friendly owners and lovely food
Review: Came here because i was looking for some place close to where i was staying that i knew would have internet. Glad i sid. The owners were super friendly and helpful with information. Had an amazing Shepards pie which was a nice change from all the noodles i had been eating recently. Definitely worth a stopShow less

Author: Jim ZBoulder, Colorado
Title: They Say Western Food, I Simply Say Excellent
Review: When my friends, who live on Langkawi, told us we were going to a restaurant that specialized in western cuisine, I was not thrilled. I wanted to experience as much Malay food as I could during my time on the island, and usually avoid western food, which I eat every day in the good old USA. But this place was really special. From the setting near the beach yet surrounded by jungle vegetation, mango groves and tropical sounds, to the comfortable home spun feeling created by the owner Michelle and her husband, this place is worth a visit. But I wouldn't give it 5 stars if the food had not been excellent, and it was. Every single one of the 5 dishes was outstanding as I had to taste each one. And the dessert, which I usually never order, was special too. And I think calling it western does themselves a disservice. It's some of the tastiest food I have had in SE Asia, reasonably priced, in a wonderful island setting.Show less

Author: monicaj995Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Amaaaaaaazing!!!!
Review: We ate here last Friday, our last night in Langkawi after a local western guy we'd been talking to the night before recommended it to us. We wanted western food as we actually live in Thailand and often crave real western grub!! And that's exactly what we got, the food was delicious and the portions were large! We got a side of potato salad to share which was a hue bowl! We had to take it home as our own dishes were enough, we didn't need it really but we had read about how good it was, and yes it was! We ended up having it the next day for breakfast with freshly cooked roti's, it was random, but delicious! The place is lovely, a little hard to find, but if you look it up/ring or ask around you will find it. It's a gem!! Ambience is lovely, it has a huuuuuuuge shelf full of books you can read ad the staff and owners are really friendly too!! No doubt if you are western or just anyone that loves western food, it is a MUST!! I wanted so much from the menu! Hats off to the staff there, they're all fab and the food speaks for itself :) I didn't take a picture of my fisherman a pie as I just wanted to dive in, but check out the Ozzie burger my boyfriend got! It was HUGE! Show less

Author: Andrew LLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Never disappoints.
Review: The views over the coast and sounds of the tropical nightfall create a special setting, which combined with the hospitality of the hosts and quality of the food makes Mangoes our favourite place to chill out in Langkawi. Having visited on several occasions we have been delighted by consistently well prepared food be it schnitzel, lasagne,quiche or all time favourite of succulent liver, tasty crispy (real!) bacon,onions & mash. The prices of the food and drinks are very reasonable, and given the quality, ambience and service actually the best on the island.Show less

Author: fox7179
Title: Best on Langkawi
Review: We've been coming to Langkawi for over 3 years and eaten in most places - this place is by far the best on the island. Super friendly staff and Michelle is a world class chef!

Author: 934samhBalnarring, Australia
Title: Great food and hospitality
Review: If you're ever on Langkawi you must try the food and hospitality at Mangoes. The owners, Michele and Lutz, and their staff will treat you like one of the family. The food is amazing and it's like home cooking done amazingly. It's a little hideaway bar and restaurant that is worth asking about.....you will never be disappointed and you'll be back again and again. If you're here on a Sunday you have to come in for brunch...including the bloody marys....amazing!Show less

Author: Woosie58Melbourne, Australia
Title: MMM, Great food, cold beer.
Review: If you're in Langkawi, enjoy German food and are really hungry you must give this a try. My wife and I were taken there by a local to try the bratwurst, it was so good and the whole restaurant, staff and atmosphere was excellent, so of course we went back the next night along with more people we just met. Their opinion was the same, excellent food big serves and great variety. It's not an easy restaurant to find, you may need to ask for directions but once you find it I'm sure you won't be disappointed. It's run by the owners Michelle and Lutz which make you feel very welcome.Show less

Author: Susan TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hidden surprise!
Review: We were taken to Mangoes by the owner of where we were staying and it was in walking distance. We would never have found it otherwise as it is well tucked away. What a lovely surprise! It is in a lovely jungle garden setting with views of the sea. The owners are Lutz the German chef and Michele your typical friendly, welcoming Australian. The service was great and the beer was very cold. We had the impressive bratwurst with saukerkrat which was delicious and a very large serve. We actually went again the next night and had beef goulash, blue cheese salad and meatloaf. All delicious and hearty portions. Unfortunately too full to have dessert. Great german food and happy friendly atmosphere. Prices are very reasonable for beer and food.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Repeat customer to this outstanding restaurant.
Review: Once again, on our latest holiday, we repeatedly went to Mangoes to enjoy the setting and excellent food. Like other comments concerning the desserts, the Pavlova is NOT to be missed, we especially ordered one beforehand for our Quarterly Gossip Dinner Meeting thus avoiding any disappointment.First class in every way and sensible prices, one can ask for no more.Show less

Author: Jay C
Title: A restaurant tucked away that you must visit
Review: With a combination of an exotic Australian owner and authentic German owner combined they've created a unique menu with a wide variety of fine cuisine. From authentic German bratwurst to some of the best meatloaf I've ever tasted, I assure you will enjoy every dish this place has to offer. The restaurant environment created by a variety of plants and trees, not to mention a team of hilarious ladies and gents that are running the place helped make our evening better than just a simple dine and go.Be sure to try the owners signature dessert, Pavalova. It was outstanding.Overall our experience was met beyond our lightest expectations.Show less

Author: ayaa454
Title: Friendly owner and good food quality
Review: Friendly owner and good food quality... I recommend this place ...... The dessert is amazing and the meat is super good cooked with jungle atmosphere.. you will her the monkey and the birds ..

Author: Brian D
Title: The Best Burger
Review: Was taken too this place thats quite out of the way by friends that live on the island. The owners are funny odd and freindly i had a burger that looked awesome they say looks aint everything but in this case it tasted as good as it looked. I would say its simply the best burger i have tasted in 59 years. Before this burger i thought hard rock cafe burger was good. But having eating this one its far better. Its like Gordon Ramsay Lanhkawi Style. Thanks to our friends without who we would not have found this diamond of a Bar & GrillShow less

Author: Med Habib S
Title: A place i recommended
Review: A lovely place, wonderful  hospitality&very Delicious food,if visit Langkawi I recommended this restaurant/ bar really it's cool, name of restaurant is mangoes

Author: Baldwin_Mr
Title: Very Tasty Brunch!
Review: We had a very enjoyable brunch and lots of drinks - especially the Bloody Mary's! This is a really special location with great food and service.

Author: suegin
Title: love it
Review: the food is great n reasonable price, the chicken cordon bleu is so delicious. the service was great and the atmosphere is wonderful

Author: sonitvn
Title: Lovely funny little jungle
Review: I love the old style jungle made by Michele & Lutz. Lovely foods & good price. Must be back next time & recommand to my friend

Author: 991nbkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Serene, friendly neighbourhood
Review: I visited this tiny restaurant with my wife in my short weekend trip to Langkawi. I came to know about this place by the recommendation of my friend who was previously working on the island, and this place indeed live up to the expectation:-)The location of the restaurant is kind of secluded and without the help of Waze or any navigation system, it will be near impossible to find, hence making this place even more special, less crowded, and calm.The food is of good quantity and good quality. The owner of the place is very friendly, and attentive. The pumpkin ginger soup we had on that night worth highlight as it is probably one of the best I have tried so far. The dessert of Mangoes is supposed to be very famous, but I can't comment much as I didn't actually enjoy the Rum Mango Crepe very much on that night, it was too sour to my liking, and i didn't have enough stamina to try other choice .Overall, the ambience is serene, the owner and ?family(i supposed) and the pet (Honey) are lovely and polite, the price is reasonable, the food is of good quantity and quality. There is no reason i wouldn't go back for a second visit to this homely warm little cottage. I am really eager to try all items on their menu, and of course, try my luck on the dessert again. Excellent, is my final comment.Show less

Author: sallys982
Title: Great little restaurant
Review: The place is quite well hidden. We were there quite early but missed the Parlova. Enjoyed the ambience of this little restaurant.. Owner was really friendly. Nice place to chill out at night in Langkawi...

Author: 538simonmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely place for dinner
Review: Had dinner here as a result of reading reviews on trip advisor. Surroundings are very cool - it is like you are sitting in the jungle overlooking the seaThere was s great choice of food which is prepared to order. My partner is vegetarian and she had a good choice and had delicious spinach lasagne. I had Wiener schnitzel which was crispy and tender. Drinks and food are reasonably priced. We will come back. Show less

Author: NikitaAzavedo
Title: A place to chill and relax
Review: Excellent food!! Loved the chicken liver pate and my favorite mango magic. The surroundings were magical, the service perfect and the ambiance exceptional. Very impressed with this place.

Author: vibhorgupta70Noida, India
Title: A Hidden Gem !!!
Review: We had dinner here on the last day of our trip, and wished we had come here earlier. I had a delicious Lamp chop with a can of chilled beer, while my wife had Roasted chicken. The food was wonderful and reasonably priced,This place is some distance from the main tourist spots of Langkawi, but if you are looking for Good food do make it a point to go there. This quaint restaurant is open in the evenings only except on a Sunday, when it is open for Brunch too. Do visit, you will not regret it. !!!Show less

Author: Juan J
Title: Great place and food ! Thumbs up ❤️👍👍👍
Review: My friends and I loves the foods and dessert so much ! The price are reasonable , I muse said the food worth more than the price ! Definitely will visit mangoes again ! Thumbs up !!!!

Author: 313alisasPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Just like being home
Review: Very nice and comfy place, amazing and very friendly owners even dog is super friendly! Food is awesome. Like I just was at home eating my mama's food!!! Must visit if u like real juicy schnitzel, cordon bleu or spare ribs! My next visit - trying the desserts. Was too full this time!!! Loved it!!! Will keep coming back!!! :)))) Show less

Author: EthanYWangSeoul, South Korea
Title: A Hidden Gem
Review: We were recommended by our Air B&B host to this restaurant and found Mangoes nestled amongst a grove with lush green trees and facing the beach. One can tell this place sees many frequent return customers and seems Michelle (the owner) knows most of her customers by name. We weren't particularly hungry and almost passed on having dinner. Thinking back my wife and I were glad we chose to dine here. I asked Michelle what would we regret not having tried if we left her restaurant and she said everything is good but The Lamb Shank is a must try. The meat is so tender it fell off the bone, the mashed potatoes soaked up the gravy and complements the lamb so well. We shared a Pavlova that was the best we've ever had and I don't throw that comment around lightly. The egg whites were fluffy, the crust delecate, the sourness of the kiwi blends perfectly with the overall dessert and the vanilla ice cream is just another bonus. Michelle and her husband (the German cook) also has smoke their own bacon and we bought a pack to go for our next morning's breakfast. We enjoyed the food, the setting, the hospitality and Honey the dog chasing after lizards twice his size. Will definitely return to Mangoes when we come back to Langkaiwe!Show less

Author: Christopher_Chandler
Title: Fav meal in Langkawi - should be #1 on TA
Review: This restaurant is a MUST visit when in Langkawi! Such a gorgeous setting and very welcoming hosts, it was like we were family! Our meals were great, just like home and the Pavlova dessert was amazing. Great prices, great service and we even met Honey the family dog! Wish we knew about it sooner as its closed Monday and Tuesday's otherwise we would have been back for sure!Show less

Author: keithhQ4662AL
Title: Friendly welcome and western comfort food
Review: We have dined at Mangoes several times, sometimes with another couple. Always a warm welcome, good music, fast drinks service followed by a lovely meal. The menu has all the favourites at sensible prices. Good ambience.

Author: satusampoLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: I'll be back!
Review: After a longish break I visited Mangoes again and I have to tell that I wasn't disappointed. Owners as nice and friendly as ever. Food great and the ambiance nice. I truly wish that the local restaurant operators would visit Mangoes. They could learn a lot about how to make their customers happy and return time after time.Thank you Michele and Lutz!Show less

Author: The_Traveler010710
Title: Good food with friendly host
Review: Visited this place after reading so many good reviews from TA. No regret, good food and good music. Very relaxing place located next to a 'madrasah'.

Author: Penny G
Title: Revisit to an excellent restaurant.
Review:
Repeatedly visited Mangoes once again on this trip.
First class food at sensible prices in a pleasurable setting.
It is not to be missed and highly recommended.

Author: Liz PCairns, Australia
Title: A Hidden Gem
Review: Mangoes is by-far, my absolute favourite mid-range restaurant on Langkawi. The food is what most westerners would call comfort food; food which brings back memories of home. So, as you could expect, many expats who live on Langkawi often go to Mangoes where Michele and Lutz make us all very very welcome.The ambiance is that of a relaxing, casual verandah style restaurant surrounded by the mangrove trees overlooking the beach and the Andaman Sea. To be there at sunset is a bonus but you'll enjoy and be relaxed no matter what time you arrive. Weekdays it is open from 5pm to 11pm Wednesday to Saturday with a bonus of Brunch starting at 11am on Sundays. In fact, people have gone for brunch on Sunday, relaxed all afternoon chatting with friends and stayed for dinner in the evening. Mangoes also has a long shelving area with a swap library of books in English and several other languages.I have also noticed over the years that many Malaysian Chinese are frequenting the restaurant as well because it is getting a reputation for divine Pork Roasts plus many other menu items that have in-house bacon added. Mangoes has it's own 'Smoker' and prepares it's own delicacies. All bacon is made in-house and if you are lucky to be on Langkawi for Christmas, you will be able to sample smoked turkey and smoked ham. ( I have done a Christmas Dinner review on Trip Advisor that will tell you more about this.)The menu has many choices to whet your appetite, but not so many that it overwhelms you. You can be assured that the plates are a good size and the food upon them is plentiful. You will not walk away hungry and nor will you have an empty wallet as prices are very reasonable. From slow cooked Lamb Shanks, Roast chicken (where you are served half a bird on your plate) or a tender, perfectly cooked salmon steak you will enjoy every succulent mouthful.Of course there are appertisers such as Pumpkin and Ginger soup and the deserts are to die for. All home-made, you have Chocolate and Walnut pie, Baileys Irish Creme Cheesecake, Pavlova or the best Apple Strudel you've every tasted. I see from one review that a taxi driver lied to a passenger about Mangoes. I would guess that he didn't know where it was and didn't want to admit it. To say that Mangoes was closed due to lack of customers was wrong as this restaurant is becoming more an more popular every year it continues to grow.I have a map that I provide my guests with make getting there easier. I will try to upload it so if the taxi driver doesn't know where it is , you will.Show less

Author: ScrumBumJakartaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Home cooking with a laid back style
Review: A small gem of a bar/restaurant overlooking the bay which proved that regardless of fine dinning, sometimes liver bacon and mash is what you need.The portions are great, the service, whilst laid back works well and the drinks keep on flowing. We had an afternoon session with friends including dinner and 6 hours of drinks with a bill that came to RM250 for a couple.... value for money at its finest.Will be back for another chill out session.Note: If you require Michelin Stars and formality, go elsewhere. You want a very relaxed atmosphere, library with an eclectic range of books and home cooking - come on down, as they say on the game shows.Show less

Author: auntyklKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Gem in the dark
Review: Visited this place because recommended from a 5 stars' hotel chef. The restaurant owner is friendly, we take his suggestion to try their day specialty pumpkin soup.I'm not fans of pumpkin however this is so delicious!!! This is a small restaurant, I would suggest make reservation before dine in to avoid any disappointment.Show less

Author: Kirstin F
Title: Great atmosphere and yummy food
Review:
From the moment I walked in I loved the atmosphere and the staff... the food and drinks were amazing!!!!!!! Very generous sizing on the foods and the drinks went down too good.

I would highly recommend for everyone visiting Langkawi

Author: flashman974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Home cooked taste
Review: Have eaten a couple of times here now, and likely to come again, as the food is delicious.Western style menu, with a lot of favourites. My favourite main is the Aussie burger, without a doubt the best I've had in Langkawi. Preceded by soup which I didn't think was going to be a good idea in the tropical climate, totally mistaken, it was delicious also. Topped off with a succulent apple pie dessert. A decent selection of reasonably priced wine too.The hosts are very nice and proud of what they do best.Show less

Author: Sampsa RVantaa, Finland
Title: Nice place with good food and friendly staff
Review: Place is quite hard to find you need to explore little pit.
