Map link in the TA application isn't so accurate.But when you finally found your way to the Mangoes you found this charming little place by the shore line. Food was delicious and reasonable priced also service was really friendly.This place is worth of checking. Show less

Author: nataliea969Ko Nang Yuan, Thailand
Title: Hidden Gem For Food
Review: I was recommened by my home stay owner, AJ's also a good place to go and stay, I was on a quick visa run and AJ recommended I visit Mangoes.On arrival they were so welcoming, I was alone so they took care of me, allowed me to use their internet too to work.The food is amazing, even as a vegatarian they offered veggie quiche, I opted for sides of various salads, all freshly prepared and preseted in shell dishes, a really nice place to sit, homely, friendly, good value for money.Mangoes is a hidden gem, ask at AJ's if you cannot find it, homestay that is safe, comfy, air con, a lovely owner.Natalie, Koh TaoShow less

Author: Peter Sbrisbane, Australia
Title: Best Bar and food on the Langkawi iIsland
Review: This is just one of those secret locations that only the locals know about, but if you're lucky you find them and love them too.Unless someone tells how to get there you would never find.The bar overlooks the sea and is small and friendly.The beer is cold and well priced. The food is great. In a five day stay on the Island went there three times.The owners and the local are friendly. Best place on LangkawiShow less

Author: Banotaaa
Title: Breath taking views
Review: Breath taking views of the islands and the clarity of the water, made us so, relaxed and enjoying the scene in the late afternoon.

Author: standfast2015Kuah, Malaysia
Title: Great atmosphere at Mangoes!
Review: Very popular expat Bar and Grill, comprehensive menu good food reasonably priced. Ideal place for a leisurely lunch with friends and family, especially at weekends. Popular for dinner on Friday and Saturday evenings, it gets very busy so best to book!There is also a "Book Exchange" library where you can swap your books one for one.Show less

Author: foongaili
Title: Fabulous
Review: We went there last nite for dinner with young kids.  Our kids really enjoyed their lamb shank and burstwurt. Oh yeah, the simple pumpkin with ginger is lovely. Roast lamb is popular too. Simple cosy ambience with wine, we really enjoy our evening.

Author: rustytooMansfield Woodhouse, United Kingdom
Title: OMG
Review: Wonderful food. I had roast pork with apple sauce, roast potatoes and veg, bliss, if you like to eat English food while in Malaysia. It makes a very good change from rice.The second time we went had the lamb shank, so tender that the bone just came straight out.The owners are very friendly and helpful. mostly expats in there which is to be expected with pork on the menu. not the easiest place to find but defintlely well worth getting thereShow less

Author: 530deborah
Title: good food
Review: the place is quite hidden and hard to find....bt i'm glad tat i didn't giv up finding this place...a hidden gem...the lamb is amazing....tender and juicy...

Author: Annely T
Title: Very good food and friendly personal,
Review: Excellent place!!! Were here twice at our small vacation .. Great staff and owners, tasteful food and desserts, nice homely atmosphere

Author: Penny G
Title: Excellent restaurant.
Review:
We visited Mangoes yet again on this our latest holiday.
First class food in excellent surroundings. One could ask for no more.
We greatly look forward to our next visit at this outstanding restaurant. 
Thanks to all at Mangoes including "Honey".

Author: SwerdsAustralia
Title: Good home style cooking
Review: We were taken to Mangoe's by a friend who manages one of the 5star hotels on Langkawi and it's easy to understand why it's so popular with the expat community. Michele is a great hostess and Lutz puts on a good spread.The food is good simple home style cooking that you crave after travelling for a while and needing a change from the local cuisines.Not easy to find as it is nowhere near the tourist areas but well worth the effort to take a cab there. Suggest booking beforehand as they are very popular.Show less

Author: creedenceCambridgeshire
Title: We went here on Christmas Day..... and New Year's Eve!!
Review: Our family really enjoyed Mangoes. We went there three times in total. The Christmas evening and New Year's Eve dinners were spot on! The staff at Mangoes are genuinely warm and they looked after us extremely well. We liked both the setting and the ambiance.If we return to Langkawi we will definitely head to this restaurant again.Show less

Author: Gerard_LawrenceKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Christmas Dinner & Quiz Night
Review: We were there for Xmas Dinner & quiz night with friends. Good hidden location off the beaten track tucked in lush greenery. Great food, friendly staff, excellent hospitality. great place to have brunch and catch up with friends over a glass of bubbly on a weekend.Nice seasonal decor and music. Loved the Chicken Cordon Bleu, chicken and leek pie, Pavlova and the special asian dishes cocked up by the staff. This is perhaps the best place for home-cooked western meal and they almost always customize meals according to your likings.Show less

Author: wendy494Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Roast Pork!!
Review: Bacardi & coke & gin & tonic in 1/2 pint glasses - this bodes well…3 more each later - very good Realise the surroundings are really quaintWe order chicken liver pate and garlic bread - both were delicious.One of the specials was roast pork with crackling, apple sauce & gravy - had to have it along with potato gratin and veggies with cheese sauceOrdered some red wine which went rather well too. Not sure how much the bill was as really can't remember - thought it was reasonable at the time though.Great little place & worth a visit - we were told Sunday brunch is good tooShow less

Author: hannahdonaldson15Kallaroo, Australia
Title: Best place to eat in Langkawi!
Review: My boyfriend and I found Mangoes 5 days into our trip and ate there every night until we left. Michelle is so genuinely lovely, warm and welcoming that you feel automatically at ease and comfortable. Her husband is also an incredibly nice man, very charming and a perfectionist. The food is absolutely incredible, Michelle even made us crispy roast potatoes for our Sunday dinner. I had the King prawns and the burger - both delicious and huge! It is by far the best value and tastiest place we ate in during our trip. Thanks guys!Show less

Author: kaos169
Title: Nice food - quiet place
Review: This Aussie-run place is tucked away in a quiet area.  The owner is lovely and happy to chat and share information about Langkawi.  The food was home-cooked and the quiche was delicious.  If you want home-cooked Western food, Mangoes is a good option.

Author: carol967
Title: Xmas day meal
Review: Great service! Aussie hostess, drinks included in your meal price. terrific value and a treat of real roast ham a rarity on langkawi. Just fab. put on your mozzie repellent tho as its outdoors.

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Amazing
Review: Not to be missed, host and hostess with the most. Few owners will speak to you, let alone wait personally at your table. If it is not on the menu just ask. They are great whippin up what ever you may fancy. All reasonable request are met with an amazing attitude. Christmas dinner was to die for. Thank you!Show less

Author: Jean-MarcSGourdan-Polignan, France
Title: A taste of visiting western family in Langkawi
Review: We went there in family with our young daughter during the holidays and we loved it. First and most important the people: Michelle and her partner are making feel at home and the personel is taking care of you nicely. Then the place itself is very cosy, not luxurious but comfortable. Last is the food. It is all traditional family cooking using excellent fresh products. We went there the 2nd time for Christmas eve and the buffet was just great. A warm thank you for making us feel so good. Dear reader now you need to get there too.Show less

Author: siddarthas1984Faridabad, India
Title: Superb food, warm hospitality, chilled-out ambience
Review: Visited Mangoes after reading reviews on tripadvisor, and it was totally worth it. Food was superb, hosts were very warm, and prices very reasonable. It was 10:30pm by the time me and my wife finished our dinner, and we asked the hostess if she could arrange for a taxi for a drop back to our hotel (sheraton beach resort). Instead they were very cool to drop us back themselves. We were very touched by the gesture.Show less

Author: Bondchiu
Title: Good place for relaxing dinner
Review:
Comfortable place with good attitude staff.
Quality of food is awesome.
Reasonable price.
Definitely recommend to any couples or group of friends or even family.

Author: Kristian HMelbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent food and ultra-friendly hospitality.
Review: I felt the most at home than I have in any restaurant I have in Langkawi. Ex-Aussie Michele (co-manager with her German partner) presented an excellent western menu, drinks are cheap and assorted, and the other staff are fantastic.If you are staying in this area, this is your first place to dine. You know what? If you're staying ANYWHERE in Langkawi, this is an excellent homely communal restaurant.Show less

Author: Philip GLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great relaxed atmosphere
Review: Mangoes enjoys a great reputation amongst the expat community as well as the locals.The setting is very pleasant nestled in the jungle close to the sea.A relaxed dining experience with pleasant, courteous and friendly service.The menu has quite a few selections and the food is great and generous.Sunday brunch starting at around 11:30 is a wondeful experience.Show less

Author: jackyHongKongHong Kong
Title: Wonderful!
Review: As soon as we arrived, we felt very welcomed by Michele and her staff who, yes look like happy people. The food is very good and the portions are huge.Very nice settings, with frogs and cicadas (or was it another kind of funny insect?). Beautiful plants all around.Having tried a lot of restaurants in Langkawi, Mangoes is, for us, definitely one of the best.To say it all, we are going back tonight!Many thanks, Michele!Show less

Author: ShereenThamLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Feel unexpectedly
Review: First time went to this restaurant & it's located in the small village that i ever stayed, because my grandpa old house was there. So it make me feel warm. Nice food, nice environment even got mosquito but they had prepare mosquito repellent incense. Affable boss & staff.Show less

Author: Dan TLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Very good European and German food in a nice location
Review: Mangoes is a well established restaurant that is very popular with the expat community they offer a good range of very tasty meals, if you get there before sunset (7.30pm ish) there is a beautiful view of the sea from the dinning area. This place has a very relaxed and friendly atmosphere and the staff are super friendly. They also have a quiz night once a month which is well worth going to if that is your thing but make sure you reserve your table as it gets very busy. My only criticism would be that its a little hard to find if you don't know the island to well but well worth looking for.Show less

Author: Robw1407Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Fantastic food. Relaxed friendly atmosphere.
Review: Food is delicious! We started with the potato and leak and the the pumpkin and ginger soup. Both were amazing. We then had the lamb shank and cutlet with some very nice salads. Finished with the pear tart for dessert. The owners are super friendly and make you feel very welcome. I would recommend the restaurant. It is a bit out of the way but if you go by taxi they will know where it is. Show less

Author: MagElise
Title: same same
Review:
Ex pat hangout........boring!
Reasonable food but with little imagination.
Overpriced as I said before because it's an ex pat hang out
but at least the portions are aimed at the "big boys"....

Author: Melbstevemanchester
Title: Nice food, good prices
Review: We spent a couple of nights in this local bar and enjoyed both occasions. The bar is tricky to find, when you get there you discover a small open air bar surrounded by the noise of the rainforest. There is a good selection of beers and cocktails ( mangoes madness cocktails are excellent ) and a nice western orientated food menu ( even some pork dishes!! ), serving staff are lovely and welcoming and give a nice relaxed atmosphere.Excellent value and worth a visitShow less

Author: AndyB-GCGold Coast, Australia
Title: Great dinner, great night, thankyou
Review: Hosts provided a wonderful friendly atmosphere from the moment we walked in to the property.Food was awesome and had a great night.Highly recommend attendingDo recommend you look at their website for the location directions if self drivinglink: http://mangoeslangkawi.webs.com/locationhours.htmVery easy to find when you know where you are going.Show less

Author: freedomfridayAdelaide, Australia
Title: Foodies and readers will be very much at home.
Review: Found by accident after a referral and discovered it's within walking distance of my hotel. Michelle, a great hostess immediately made you feel at home and the atmosphere, setting, food and bar endorsed this at once.Extensive menu, good selection of drinks and for a reader with time to spare - a great book swap!Show less

Author: Rex_RossWestport, Ireland
Title: Great food and service every time!
Review: Nice cold beer and lovely omelette! full of expatriates and Sunday brunch is buzzing! Been here few times and really love the lush green surrounding and friendly host and staff! Getting here to the restaurant is a bit difficult. But once you are in Kuala Teriang, stop your car and ask around, the local will show you to the restaurant!Highly recommended!!!Show less

Author: MDB-TWVietnam
Title: AWESOMENESS beyond reason
Review: This place is just awesome beyond logic:* Best waiter in Langkawi -> Joly (Please never leave this place!!!!)* Awesomely, friendly and nice owners* Awesome Aussie Burger pilled high to Awesomeness* Excellent awesome Sausages (Bratwurst & Knackwurst) with delicious Sauerkraut* The best and most delicious godlike awesome Potato Salad on the island if not in Malaysia* Beautiful, excellent, cozy and comfortable place to be and of course awesomeIf I could I would eat there every day the whole year.Show less

Author: CostelloSa
Title: Delicious food and cocktails!
Review: We found this place on trip advisor and drove over from our hotel - it's not the easiest to find once you come off the road but look out for the little mango sign! It's a lovely little restaurant with a homely feel. I had some frozen margaritas for about £3 which were lovely. My partner and I had Aussie burgers which were an experience! We actually just fancied a burger and didnt have a clue what an Aussie burger entailed. The owner let us know it was huge and also about it having beetroot - a lovely addition :-) I think I ate about half but it was delicious. Nice setting and a friendly owner. Definitely try it out - its cheap too!Show less

Author: BazSingaporeEngland, United Kingdom
Title: One of the better Langkawi eating experiences
Review: It's actually somewhere between very good and excellent by local standards. A local expatriate recommended this place, thankfully. It's tucked away not too far from the airport and is a pleasant, green oasis (so remember the insect repellant). Owners are a friendly expat couple who deliver a quality experience at reasonable prices. Good food and drink list and attentive staff and they'll call you a cab back to "civilisation" when you're done. Best to book and remember it closes one day a week, I think Monday but you need to check. I would definitely return and in fact will do so in a couple of weeks' time.Show less

Author: hikaru_chingyenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The hidden western meal
Review: It is kinda hard to spot this restaurant, their signboard is quite small, and locate in local housing area. Most of the customer here is western people. Nice food, I guess among all the fruit juice, orange juice is the only fresh made. Friendly owners, staff and dog.Show less

Author: annmci
Title: Home food I never expected to find
Review: Reached Mangoes when traveled out and could not believe my luck, western food that tasted just like a meal at home, only better!

Author: Vanya VPerth, Western Australia, Australia
Title: Mangoes, Forbidden Delights!
Review: Mangoes Bar & Grill menu is like a prayer book of forbidden delights. Shhhh, they have German-style pork schnitzel with home made sour krout too. And this is in a traditionally run halal country. And the apple strudel, baked by the owner who learnt her trade in Austria, are to die for, topped with ice-cream, and decorated with bougainvillaea flowers. Michelle, owner of Mangoes, and a fair dinkum Ozzie, arrived on the island as a solo sailor in 2000. Fourteen years later and a Tsunami, Mangoes has become an institution for expats the island. It has also moved locations after being destroyed by the Tsunami.Hidden on a hill, overlooking a beach, in a little quite village of the island, a few guest houses have sprung up, and it's not uncommon to see backpackers popping in for some good Western grub.Mangoe is for homesick expats, a good place to meet, exchange books and local gossip, and down a few cold beers at the Isobar bar, named after the yacht she sailed from Sri Lanka. Michelle will come and sit down and talk to her dinners, many of them she considers friends. A hug and kiss on each cheek will confirm that. She had 50 guests the other night. "No one had time to light the candles." She has quiz nights too, and arranges outings for the VIP dinners, usually those who eat here more than twice a week.Why do most people end up living here? One diner I spoke to says alot of people originally came on yachts. "It’s safe and tolerant, no judgement on who you are. Mangoes attracts all nationalities. "Mango has it's origins from the noise it makes when the mangoes drop on the roof. It usually gets people out of their chairs in fright. Another beer is placed on the table and they are told to continue enjoying their meal. "You get use to it , I don’t even notice them anymore.""My restaurant," says Michelle, "is a hobby…. it’s not a job it’s my hobby. I serve tables, work behind the bar, and cook deserts … pavalova… make the sauces… and oversea the meatballs." She uses a secret and old recipe for the burgers and meat paddies, Expect to see lots of parsley, sources that blend, and a burger that needs to be kept together by a wooden skewer.Concept is quite simple, says Michelle. " You can live in Asia and eat Asian food, but when you feel like it, you can still have a blast from home." She sources the best ingredients from everywhere "Beef comes from Australia and New Zealand. Avocados come from South America or Africa. " She says most of the fresh produce comes from Thailand and the Cameron Islands in Malaysia The local seafood comes from the the fisherman in the village. And the Holland potatoes from China.Mangos is an institution on this island. And if you really want to know where all the cheap rice and other products come from on the island, the fishing village is only 30 kilometres from the Thai border. But we aren't suppose to go into that. Just the usual, fuel and rice. It is a duty free zone, so why would anyone worry about a little bit of smuggling and profiteering at the border?If you are lucky, Honey, the security dog may come up and jump on your lap. A stray dog that Mangoe's has adopted, Honey is a cross between a cute, and a midget. He's a small dog with a coat of honey coloured hair. Michelle's partner, Lutz, a German, is gregarious. and well lubed with cheap duty free beer. I compliment him on Germany winning the World Cup. We were friends for life. I said if Germany could beat Brazil 7-0, then they deserved to win the cup. I never told him that I only watched the last two minutes of the final.The chiefs, one from Bangladesh, the other a local Malay, have both been working at Mangoe's for the past five years, and done the necessary chief courses. Michelle and Lutz are always looking out for quality control. "But the cooks are so well trained, we don't worry about that," says Lutz, who opens up another cold one. Mangoes might look like a relaxed place, and it may just seem a hobby by the owner. Don't be fooled, they are perfectionists and run a very tight ship. As to the Bangladeshi waiter, he's kept very busy and worth his weight in gold, though somewhat reserved. Picking up banter from happy and usually pissed diners must be hard work.Personally I think Mangoes is for fine cuisine that you don't have to pay and arm and leg for. It's a five-star menu with a one star price tag. Before I forget, there's a wooden boat in the garden and a paddle hanging up on the bar. Both seem to be from another era. Bujang Valley perhaps?Pop into Mangoes, and see what really goes on in the island. A friendly bunch, a close knit community, everyone is welcome. Michelle is the captain of this ship, and sails her boat into uncharted territories of fine dinning. I've eaten too much Indian food, and totally fed up with it. This reviewer is very biased and in need of another "blast from home."Show less

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hit and miss
Review: Hit: tallest Aussie burger to die for. Knockwurst (German sausage) also the one to try. Apple strudel is my favourite. Frangipani tart is good.Do serve apple ciders. Not on the menu. Just ask.Service is top notch. The glass never empty.Miss: lamb loin (300gm+) 3 extremely small piece of fatty lamb on bone. No doubt is 300gm. But half of it is fat and bone. I thought is a whole piece of 300gm. T-bone steak too. Not very nice piece of meat. So, stay away from steak and lamb.Won't be able to watch sunset here anymore. The forest has overgrown. Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays Show less

Author: SubhanOkailyParis, France
Title: Great find on last day in Langkawi
Review: Unfortunately, we only came here on our last day in Langkawi. Otherwise we would have discovered earlier how much the other touristy restaurants just rip you off for not so great food! The place was cosy, welcoming, and most importantly unbelievably cheap! The portions were HUGE and the owner was beyond welcoming. Me and my husband both had the Australian burgers which were huuuuuge! I struggled with it but found it very delicious with great quality meat. My husband wasn't a big fan of the burger mainly due to the fact that it had beet-root and he found that strange. I also ordered and avocado salad as a side dish and it was refreshing. The bill was less than 20$ which was surprising since we got used to paying at least 40$ for any decent meal in Langkawi. My advice to tourists: AVOID TOURISTY RESTAURANTS!Show less

Author: LillyP66Melksham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, very good value
Review: Having read the reviews we got our taxi driver to drop us here after a tour of the island. Great cheap drinks and a menu of hearty dishes including a number of specials. I had roast lamb and my husband had ribs. Both dishes were plentiful and excellent. One if the cheapest but best meals we had on Langkawi. An added bonus was that the owner took us back to the hotel as our taxi didn't turn up!Show less

Author: Sage2724Australia
Title: Homely welcoming and great food
Review: What a surprise greets you as you enter Mangoes. It is situated in a back street, very understated entrance...then you walk into a setting of a veranda in tropical bush, open air, sea views with lots of efficient fans and you are immediately heartily greeted by Michelle and feel totally relaxed and at home. The menu is simple and has lots of variety of western dishes. The meal was generous and really delicious, especially the mango crepe for dessert! Everyone there seemed to be relaxed and having a great time. The service was excellent and prices very reasonable. It is a great restaurant and we will definitely be back!!Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant.
Review: Went to Mangoes on a number of evenings for dinner during my three week stay in Langkawi.Very high standard of food at reasonable prices with many different choices make this a favourite restaurant for me and numerous friends I have taken there.Michele, Lutz and the staff run a first class, unique restaurant which I thoroughly recommend to anyone. You will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Allan CLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Comfy and Traditional
Review: My Indonesian wife and I are now regular visitors to Mangoes where we love the sub tropical environment, the food is simple but great and the service from Michele and Lutz is prompt and pleasant.The open space and lack of a/c is a blessing as you can feel every breeze coming through the trees from the ocean that is only meters away. Thanks Michele and Lutz, will definitely see you again soon.Allan and NiaShow less

Author: Amanda BPottsville, Australia
Title: Very nice
Review: My husband liked the food as he likes spicy, I found that the meal was too spicy for me and the meal was not explained properly on the menu ... I had fish and I thought it was grilled but it came half raw and sent it back to the kitchen. There is no a/c.Show less

Author: tsonoquaSurrey, Canada
Title: Still the top spot in my book
Review: I have been going to Mangoes every time I come to Langkawi and it never fails to deliver a nice home cooked meal.... Something that most tourists crave after eating in restaurant after restaurant on their holidays. Recently I read a review that called the owners racist. They are the farthest from racist of anyone I know. Much of their clientele are asian, their staff are entirely asian, and many of their friends are asian. Is it possible that the writer resents the popularity of Mangoes? Maybe he/she is even a restaurant owner losing business. At any rate, using the slur of calling someone racist says more about the contributor than those fine people at Mangoes. Shame on you!Show less

Author: 545johne
Title: A gem of a place
Review: My third visit to Mangos and as always a pleasure. Great bucolic setting and relaxed atmosphere with genuinely caring service. The owner Michelle (one L or two, I'm not sure) is a real character and gives a hearty welcome. Racist she is definitely not, as my Thai dining companion was treated royally, and an adjoining table of Chinese tourists were well cared for too. The food was a little slow in coming, but roast chicken is best not undergone. It was worth waiting for with its creamy mashed potatoes and onion gravy. The fish steak was fine but lacked accompanying vegetables I thought. The preceeding chicken liver pate was okay but the house white wine was a bit disappointing. I switched to beer. But it was a nice meal and overall great value for money. Will be back again. Show less

Author: Tenshi C
Title: Dissapointed visit.
Review: Racist host that doesn't serve the asian and feedback on food was not well received.Waited there for so long and was not served. A group of Caucasian came in and they were served before us. The 'menu board' was shifted to face the Caucasian and all we could do is wait. If it was not because of the rain, we would have left.Show less

Author: sueekhy
Title: What a surprise !!!
Review: Had my finely made Sunday brunch amidst cluster of traditional Malay houses and shades if trees. A pathway leading to the beach with relaxing music playing in the background would make this place a 5 star by any Langkawi standard.

Author: bonesiaustralia
Title: I'm in heaven
Review: Our second visited this year to Mangoes Restaurant and we had a great time with host Michelle and Lutz. What a dream of a place it's like you are sitting in a beautiful garden with a sea view.Tonight we had the roast pork and scollop potato with broccoli and cauliflower and they even had apple sauce on the side. I managed the pavlova with lashing of cream topped with passion fruit sauce. The don't have Long Island Teas on there drinks menu but for Michelle this was no problemat all she was happy to make them for us. We have been to many restaurants on the island of Langkawi and this rates one of the best if not the best for quality and low prices. Where else can you get good food and drinks at such low prices, you must visit and you will want to go back.Show less

Author: EmmmsBrighton, Australia
Title: Lovely friendly restaurant
Review: It took us a bit of time to find this place but it was worth it when we did. The owners were very welcoming and looked after us and our 2 year old. Food is good and the fresh juices were also a nice surprise. They were not watered down like elsewhere on the island. Great place to visit if you want to get away from Nasi Goreng etc. We had roast lamb and a burger. Both were excellent.Show less

Author: CalebS628KL
Title: Beautiful Sunday brunch
Review: I was there for Sunday brunch. Nice little house with mango trees around and a view of the sea. Greeted by the cheerful owner and they were really friendly. Anyhow I got my favourite sauerkraut, sausage and also chicken schnitzel. Food is good, decently priced and I just love the surrounding. Something very different from the typical commercialized Cenang beach restaurant.Show less

Author: expatcarynShanghai, China
Title: Just charming!
Review: Make sure you don't mix this place up with the pricier Mangos.This is the bar & grill with homemade German/Euro fare.Wonderful cooking with a charming host/hostess to make you feel like you are part of the family. All this for a bargain pricetag!It's off the beaten path and only open Wed - Saturday.Great place.Show less

Author: licensed2travelStavanger, Norway
Title: Loved the Tucked Away Location
Review: Food was delicious and very reasonably priced. Western menu with great choices - we were back twice in a 3-day trip. First time I ordered the Fisherman's Pie, which was good but needed a dash of salt. 2nd time I went for the grilled king prawns and man, this was lovely. So fresh, so succulent. And not badly priced at all! My partner had the aussie burger and I have to say that even though I'm not a big fan of burgers, I wouldn't mind this at all.Loved the restaurant, very cosy, overlooking the beach if you come when there's still sunlight! You'll dine surrounded by trees, with the two lovely owners taking care of you.Show less

Author: jomendoncaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Food in Langkawi
Review: Lovely little restaurant run by michele and lutz , its close to Sheraton Beach resort which has really horrible food , so we ended up eating every night at Mangoes . Great food at mangoes every night , great atmosphere , great people and thanks to michele who dropped us back to the hotel on the last night as it got a bit late for us to walk back .Show less

Author: Moree48Sydney, Australia
Title: Home cooking
Review: We decided on this restaurant after reading reviews on Trip Adviser. We were not disappointed! The food was great and well cooked. The lamb shanks just melted in your mouth. Not a fancy place but service was great. We were made to feel like regulars. We woulfd have gone again the next night but it is closed on Mondays.Show less

Author: Jane PHertford, United Kingdom
Title: Home Cooking!
Review: We had curries most nights during our stay in Langkawi and only went to Mangoes due to the reviews on Trip Advisor. It actually was rather good to have some home cooked food for a change. This is not a fancy restaurant but had a lovely ambience - its was packed the night we went! The host and hostess are real characters and made us feel extremely welcome and our children loved it and wanted to return another night. We will definitely go back if we return to Langkawi - hopefully leaving room the next time to try some of the puddings!Show less

Author: simranb
Title: really nice cafe
Review: has a charming location and great food to boot. the couple who runs the place are friendly and cheery. they were also very accommodating about making pureed fruit for our 1 year old.

Author: robontheway
Title: Fantastico!
Review: Yes, great food and service all way from starters to desserts. Ambience and prices all great! Thanks guys for your superb hospitality.

Author: ZMOHD2010Male
Title: not bad!
Review: + celebrating our anniversary dinner, sort off.. :P+ i have reviewed this place before i came so i think am having a very high expectation and slightly disappointed with the whole thing. + ordered soup + steak, and here i thought it would be something different, but it turned up more or less the same thang of what we could get in KL. so.... ?!+ hidden place but we managed to find it eventuallynways this place suits you when u on this island ...and craving for a nice western food. for locals, just go back and eat masakan kampong sudah.. :PShow less

Author: Baby_CleoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: EXCELLENT FOOD AND GREAT SERVICE
Review: We decided to try Mangoes as the reviews here were very good, and well we were not disappointed at all. We had quite a few dishes as there were 7 adults and 1 child. We had steaks, lamb chops, fish, chicken and prawns and everything was good. The side dishes were also really good and the mash potatoes were excellent!Michelle & Lutz were friendly and gracious and to our surprise prepared the pavlova for us eventhough they told us on the phone that it wasn't available except for special events as they unfortunately can't make small portions of it. It was absolutely delicious and we finished all 5 portions that we ordered!The atmosphere was really nice and cosy which added to the whole experience. The food was really good and we would definitely come back when we are in Langkawi next.PS: Don't forget to pet the resident dog while you are there.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: We decided to try this restaurant after reading good reviews on TA, we were not disappointed. The welcome is as delightful as eating yummy chocolates and drinking delicious red wine in the bath! Our food was some of the tastiest we had on the island and we intended to return before we left Langkawi but due to the being fully booked on the Sat evening and closed on two of the other days (Mon & Tues) we were unable to. Rest assured we will return on our next visit to Langkawi.This is a lovely place with lovely people and a beautiful dog, give it a try and you will not be disappointed.On a personal note to Lutz and Michelle, can I have a plastic chair next time I visit please? I'm sure that you will know who I am. lots of success and happiness xxxShow less

Author: d_elle13South Africa
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: The owners are warm and friendly, and have created an environment where travelers can enjoy an evening of good food that is an eclectic mix of Australian, German with a Malay flair. After having tried many restaurants in Langkawi I would be sure to visit Mangoes again. I highly recommend the Baileys baked cheesecake! Show less

Author: BridgetR50Berkhamsted, United Kingdom
Title: Found it on the last night
Review: Mangoes gets a good write up on Trip Advisor and we weren't disappointed. It's European and has a home cooking feel to it, but the portion size was excellent, the food was really tasty and it was great value. I has the roast pork - well it was on a Sunday and my husband had the Australian burger and we couldn't fault either. The husband and wide team who run it were lovely too. Definitely suggest you go there - but put on some mosi spray, it was the only place we got bitten.Show less

Author: Tobias OMunich, Germany
Title: Very friendly. Relaxing Atmosphere. Excellent western style food incl. german sausages.
Review: Almost everything already side by my title line.During our 8 days stay in Langkawi we visted "mangoes" three times. Two times for dinner and once for just taking dessert on our way home to the Hotel.Only two advises to be given:1) don't mix up the resturant name "Mangoes" with expectation on Asian Food.The concept is purely focused ob western food. with excellen Schnitzel, Steaks, lamp chops, Aussie burger!, german suasages, etc. I like it if a resturant is really focused!2) keep space for the excellent desserts... our favourite was "Mango-Rum-Crepe"!Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Top class restaurant.
Review: Having been to Mangoes numerous times on our previous holidays in Lankawi, we naturally returned to this, one of our most favourite restaurants, during our latest one month holiday.It is excellent in every respect; the food, service, surroundings in fact everything about Mangoes is top class and not to be missed.Roll on our next holiday when, as loyal customers we will be eating there again in full knowledge that it will all be just as superb as the last time.Show less

Author: yellowpandaSingapore, Singapore
Title: great food, good value, friendly service - must go
Review: loved this place - the food was english german mix, and very delicious, and wholesome. everything is home prepared (we had mash and bangles, with lovely meatball soup)the couple who owns this place are a english and german couple - and they are there serving and ensuring everything is ok also a very friendly and well behaved house dog, who would go from table to tableand there is also a bar counter where you could have drinks before the meals/ or afterrestaurant serves about 10 tables - not more - so you need to book in advance to get a tableand they are closed on mon, and tuesnot easy to find - no signages outside - but it is in kulua teriang - you cross a pink ugly bridge, and then after 200 m - you turn left into a car park, and Mangoes in at the end of this car park (so check out location before you go)highly recommened - i would definitely go back next time in town againShow less

Author: poppamooreThunder Bay
Title: Incredible service...Great Food...Take the time to visit
Review: The couple who own the restaurant and involved in every single thing that goes on there, from the cooking, to the serving, to communicating with the guests. The food is incredibly tasty, the sunset view is spectacular, and the service great. I would highly recommend visiting this restaurant, regardless of what part of the island you are on!!!Show less

Author: Swisschesse
Title: Tasty European food
Review: I would have not found this place if it wasn't for TripAdvisor.  Very friendly service, tasty European food if you need a change whilst in langkawi.

Author: sunseanfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 2 Thumbs Up!
Review: Seeing all the reviews here, one would undoubtedly say that this is one of the really good restaurants in Langkawi. Needless to say my experience here was very good as well. Nice and friendly hosts and waitress, accompanied by some really delicious food and ambiance. It was a perfect evening for us. Me and my friends have visited this place several times now and am very satisfied on each visit. The taste of the food is consistently delicious as ever, which few restaurants manage to maintain. My favourite dish is the meatballs and mash potatoes and dessert goes to their apple strudel. The meatballs are so juicy and their mash are so far, the best in town, and the warm apple strudel accompanied with vanilla ice cream is to die for. Definitely is a must visit restaurant in Langkawi!Show less

Author: satusampo
Title: Never dissapointing!
Review: Walking into Mangoes always puts a big smile on my face, knowing I'm going to receive warm welcome and service from the owners Micelle and Lutz. Delicious western food, which is not easily found in Langawi... and with surprisingly reasonable cost!

Author: tristanp2013Lavenham, United Kingdom
Title: A great little restaurant
Review: We made three visits to Mangoes. Whilst the Malaysian food is great if you fancy some good western food this is the place to go. My kids loved the Aussie burgers. Michelle and Lutz are excellent hosts and make you very welcome, the restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere and to food is great and good value. We will definitely go back.Show less

Author: 934samhBalnarring, Australia
Title: Mangoes family
Review: I found Mangoes last year on a trip to Langkawi. It's one of these small bar/restaurants that you hear about by word of mouth. The 2 owners, Michelle and Lutz make you feel like you're part of the family as soon as you walk in. All the expats that live on Langkawi are regulars as well as all the yachties. The food is "home style" large meals that are truly delicious. I highly recommend the Sunday brunch! It's a real social occasion. I had the eggs Benedict while sipping champagne, so cheap and worth every cent. I ate there numerous times, the atmosphere always chatty, friendly and hilariously funny. Do yourselves a favour, seek it out....you won't regret it!Show less

Author: nwillia2West Byfleet, United Kingdom
Title: The warmest welcome ever
Review: We had planned to visit Mangoes due to the good reviews on Trip Advisor which were then confirmed on the plane by an English couple living in Langkawi. We were staying at the Berjaya Hotel (near the Oriental Village) & therefore it was only 10 mins & £5 in a cab so very easy to get to. As soon as we stepped into the restaurant we were welcomed by Michelle who at once made us feel totally at home with the biggest smile you've ever seen. We loved the relaxed atmosphere, good home cooked food and alfresco dining. Michelle & Lutz are most definitely the hosts with the most and Christina the waitress was also lovely not forgetting Honey the very cute dog & Gremlin the cat (who hid most of the time so non-cat lovers wouldn't be put off). If you want a change from Malaysian food whilst in Langkawi Mangoes is a MUST. We rated the steak within the top steaks we'd ever eaten so if you're a steak lover give it a go. However, if you prefer a more formal restaurant with silver service it wouldn't be for you as Mangoes high rating is more for value, friendly service & good home cooked food. We visited 3 times in all and felt like Michelle & Lutz were long lost friends by the time we left. Thanks again to you all for your hospitality and hope to see you again one day :) ROZ & NEIL xShow less

Author: NickyB54Hereford, United Kingdom
Title: Still just as good.
Review: Visited again a couple of times on recent trip. Michele and Lutz still making everyone happy. Good western food, very welcome after 3 weeks of rice and noodles. Good menu choices with specials every day. Very welcoming and pleasant company just like returning home in some respects. Not that difficult to find, very close to Sheraton Beach where we stayed. 10 minutes from airport, 15 from Pantai Chenang. You will be made very welcome by the 'old buggers'(joke) who run it.Show less

Author: ArmedCrossCheckedPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Value for money
Review: The owners (lutz and michele) even took the time to talk, recommend and took meal orders frm their guests. Feel very welcome to dine in their restaurant. The atmosphere is very cozy and relaxing. Wines are cheap and good. Value for money meals for their absolutely wonderful meal.Show less

Author: R_ReginalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Like dining at your families'
Review: Due to its hidden nature, it is a bit tricky to find. It is certainly far from many other attractions; about 10 minutes away from the airport and 30 minutes from Cenang beach. If you feel like you're going to some housing area, you are heading in the right direction.The place is ran by a friendly elderly couple that always seem to be delighted to have guests. Do lookout for their specials. The menu and drinks selection are moderate but thoughtful and they also feature some German dishes in there should you be looking for them while in Langkawi.Food was great and the meat was grilled nicely. Highlight of the place though is definitely the atmosphere that makes you feel well at home. The cheery owners also adds to this and adds a certain charm to the place.It's hard to fully explain what it was like to dine here and it is a place where you truly need to experience on your own.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: First Class Food and Service.
Review: Michele, Lutz, the ever efficient friendly Christine coupled with first class food that never disappoints produce exactly the right combination within Mangoes. We have taken a number of friends with us to enjoy the restaurant and they all, without exception, echo our thoughts.Excellent, we look forward to many more visits to enjoy their hospitality.Show less

Author: Weaponx78
Title: Great place to eat - only cash allowed
Review: Great place to eat, nice atmosphere. Aussie burger and fish fillet spectacular. Service is top knotch, come and enjoy western food. Bring cash no credit card allowed

Author: tsonoquaSurrey, Canada
Title: Fine homecooked meals with wonderful ambiance
Review: I have been a frequent visitor to Mangos from the beginning. For a home cooked meal for someone with a western taste it almost makes me want to go home to Canada. Lutz,, Michelle and Christina are joined by a staff who have long enjoyed working in this restaurant and their quality food is a tribute to this dedication. I love the lamb shanks but there are lots of items to select...all delicious. Going to Mangos is like being invited out to a friends home for dinner...its just that nice. When I return in 3 weeks I will go straight there for a good meal.Show less

Author: grandezza123Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: cosy place by the water side
Review: How many times I had dinner here I can only guess. Never been disappointed. Lutz and Michele are one of their kind and go out of their way to ensure that you get royal treatment! From great salads to German sausages you can indulge yourself. Put it on your list!Show less

Author: Mumie5Viersen, Germany
Title: NICE!!
Review: If You want to be treatet by really good western food I can recommend the Mangoes. My T-bone-steak was excellent and this just for an example. The location is quite hidden, but as it`s well known people can give You directions. Comming from nearby Sheraton Beach Resort You can walk from the beach to Shinis Restaurant and cross the tiny little bridge if it`s low tide and daylight. It`s THE meeting place for expats, easy to meet people here...Show less

Author: Richard TPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Hidden Greatness
Review: Of the few meals I've had in Langkawi, I must say my experience at Mangoes is definitely the best in every regard. It was a bit difficult to find, but the place has a large regular crowd and had no problems keeping the supplies fresh. Awesome setting, awesome service from the staff, and awesome food. Will be back for more on my next visit!Show less

Author: KuroshioLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: My dear Pavlova
Review: I went to have a dinner with my girlfriend in Mango few weeks ago. We had, as usual, a nice evening and a good dinner. Then, it was time to choose the dessert….They recommend me the “Pavlova” dessert, and of course I agree as I like to try new stuff. But I was not prepared for such experience!I took my spoon and try a little piece of it. Then I stood up, with the plate in my hands and went to see Lutz, the cook, who was as a matter of fact, talking with other customers. I looked at him strait in the eyes and I pointed the plate I had in my hands and told him: I love that stuff……Lutz looked at me, with some worries on his eyes, and say: Ok, you love it….. But???There is no “But”. I love it, that’s it! I told himIt was so funny to see him realising that I was happy and satisfied even though my attitude was like someone who wanted to complain! He starts smiling, and I went back to my table to finish that lovely dessert.  Pavlova is a meringue dessert with a crisp crust and soft, light lemon taste inside. A lovely equilibrium between the sweetness of the meringue and the bitterness of the lime.I really recommend it.Thank you for that Lutz and Michelle!ClementShow less

Author: CalypteFederal, Australia
Title: MMMMMMagnificent Mangoes!
Review: Michlle,Lutz and the ever beaming Christina make this a home away from home for many expats and visitors alike. Thankfully the place remains the same after many years even though there are more and more people cottoning onto how good it is. Keep up the good work guys and hope to get back to Langkawi sometime soon. A big hello to Christina from Kas and Vic ( Calypte)Portions are generous and the price is right for what you are getting served. Yummy sweet things too!Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Mangoes Restaurant.
Review: First the "disappointment". During our four week holiday Mangoes was closed for twelve days while refurbishments were carried out. Bad planning on our part.On our last holiday we ate at Mangoes and could not praise their standards more. We are glad to report that those high standards remain firmly in place.Excellent hosts, superb food with many choices, all served by Christine who is a model for all aspiring waitresses on how it should be done. She is outstanding.We thoroughly recommend any visitor to Langkawi to go for dinner at Mangoes in the complete knowledge they will not de disappointed.Show less

Author: Janlampies
Title: Langkawi's hidden treasure!!
Review: Michelle, the owner is the most charismatic person i have met in a long time. Her personality and hospitality with the great food makes it one special place. This is a must for anyone visiting Langkawi.

Author: bonesiaustralia
Title: Sunday roast pork
Review: We just got back from this great restaurant where we had roast pork it was lovely and tenderCauliflower and broccoli with white and scallop potatoes, l could not manage sweets as the roastwas large. So we have to go back to try the pork sausages then l will try one of the many sweets on offer. They did not have Long Island Tea drink on there menu but were very happy to make oneIt was spot on. Don't forget to take the address for the taxi driver as ours took us to the wrong onefirst so lucky I new it was wrong and l told the taxi it's up past the airport.The hosts are very friendly and were happy to have a chat and the waitress was very good alsoShow less

Author: holidaytime26Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but it can add up
Review: Beautiful garden setting. Our food was was nice and looked reasonably priced on the menu but the dish came bare. I had to order mashed potato separately for my goulash when, really, goulash should come with mashed potato. Likewise for my husband's meal. We found it pretty annoying but once we got over this irritation, we did enjoy the evening. The wine wasn't bad either. To put it in perspective, Langkawi is a tourist destination so eating out in other than a food court can be quite expensive.Show less

Author: ScotgalAustraliaAustralia
Title: Still great food
Review: Visited Mangoes again whilst back in Langkawi in April. It was lovely to see Michelle and Lutz again and to enjoy their hospitality.Our meal was so tasty and our waitress was so friendly (sorry I have forgotten your name)Keep up the great work and we will see you next time.Show less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Roast Pork 10/10
Review: We went there on last Sunday, luckily they had special offering for Roast Pork + dessert. It was so crunchy and taste 10/10..Wow simply blew my mind..Dessert I think it was a Lemon Meringue pie which is so light and filling. Thank you for the good food and service..Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Mangoes Restaurant - First Class for excellent food.
Review: We were guided to Mangoes by two local friends. They say "First impressions count" and that was true for us. Friendly owners, Michele and Lutz plus one of the most efficient girls on the planet serving us. The food is absolutely superb with many choices that cannot fail to please. We went to eat on a number of occasions taking friends with us one, of which was a Travel Writer from Korea who was very impressed with every aspect.Highly recommendable to anyone and on our next visit we will most certainly be eating there again.Show less

Author: 658LeeR
Title: Nice food
Review: Managed to find this place on our last day in Langkawi. Staff are nice and friendly and food was enjoyable, all at a reasonable price.

Author: RichardPhuketAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Truly amazing home cooked food
Review: I have been living in Asia for a while now, and as most expats would agree with me that you sometimes really miss the food from your own country and you are dying for a good meatball and mash or a perfectly cooked piece of tender lamb. Well let me tell you this is the place to go for exactly that. Great honest home cooked food with excellent sauces and meat quality, tasty salads (try the blue cheese salad my absolute favorite!) and many other extra sides. Another highlight for me on the menu is the chicken liver pate, it honestly reminded me of my mothers cooking and that hardly ever happens. For me Mango is just the perfect place to relax, have a good and satisfying meal for a very very good price. Knowing full well how expensive some of the western ingredients are on this island, it amazes me that they can produce such high quality food for such affordable prices. Will be back many many times thats for sure!Show less

Author: RizhaoBobBritish Columbia, Canada
Title: Mangoes hits the spot everytime
Review: Mangoes is a lovely and comfortable western food restaurant situated a little out of the way on Langkawi Island in the village of Kuala Teriang. If you aren't sure how to get there phone Michele at 60175898117 and give your handphone to the taxi driver so that you can be guided in. I visit Langkawi two to three times a year and when there probably eat half my dinners and always my Sunday brunch at Mangoes. The food is great but it is the welcoming and pleasant atmosphere that is the real drawing card for me. Lutz (Germany), Michele (Australia), Icki (Bangladesh) and the lovely Christina (3rd generation Langkawi) make everyone feel welcome, whether you choose to belly up to the bar with the local expat barflies, or take one of the tables looking out over the the garden. For Sunday brunch you can't beat the Eggs Benedict with Salmon, washed down with a Bloody Mary or two. For evening meals I have particularly enjoyed the T-bone Steak, the Meatloaf & Mash, and the Shepherd's Pie. The music, mostly selected by the slightly nefarious and totally enigmatic Noel, helps set the mood of slighty off kilter comfortableness (if that doesn't make sense to you, have another Bloody Mary and try again).If you are on Langkawi for a few days be sure to give Mangoes a try and have a taste of the island that tourists seldom experience, and the expat community counts on.Show less

Author: kathleentffLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent! Great job for taking feedbacks positively
Review: Was there at Mangoes again tonight and must really say again that the lamb and fried potatoes were the best in the island. Thank you Michelle for responding to my earlier review and yes, the bill were now itemized. I think you have the best fried potatoes ever :) Strongly recommends this place if you want good food, excellent hospitality.Show less

Author: Katarzyna S
Title: Fantastic food, great atmosphere, friendly hosts
Review:
Good western food. Clean, quiet, small restaurant for dinner with friends.
Wiener Schnitzel & Avocado Salad better when in expensive restaurants  
Michele and Lutz are very good, friendly hosts

Author: Ccher
Title: A great hideaway
Review: I went to mangoes with my boyfriend for Sunday brunch. The food was good and the ambience was nice and quiet. A great getaway from the noisy and touristy pantai cenang. Thumbs up.

Author: Elaine KPerth, Australia
Title: Christmas Eve Dinner
Review: Booked in for the Christmas Eve dinner and clearly this is a restaurant popular with the local western community in Langkawi as it was fully subscribed. We had a nice traditional Christmas dinner with turkey, glazed ham, plenty of types of salad and side dishes and dessert. Clearly Michelle is an accomplished cook. Although we had a good time and food was good home cooking, in retrospect, we should have booked someplace else for Christmas as it would have been nice to have something other than what we could have gotten back home. The cost was RM 100 per person inclusive of free flow drinks, inclusive of beer and wines. We felt it was a tad pricey by Langkawi standards.Show less

Author: obedajaaonang
Title: Best Restaurant on the Island
Review: It is really hard to find a restaurant in south Asia with a real normal European standard. But more than this, the restaurant is really really good, better than most of the expensive restaurants in Germany. In this way I just want to say thanks a lot to the owners. Everything was great. It is a lovable, calm and chilled place where you can enjoy a delicious meal. The staff is really friendly. It is a MUST for langkawi. How to find it: When you come from the airport or chenang, just follow the street to telaga harbor, pass Bella vista hotel, 2 bridges and when you are at Kuala teriang, there is a curve to the right, where a no through road going to the left side. You will find it there on the left side.Show less

Author: 279JulieM279London, United Kingdom
Title: A lovely little spot!
Review: We found the place right before we were leaving Langkawi and its a lovely spot, great food and they serve pork!! Owned by a lovely Australian lady and was very friendly. We didn't book, we still had a lovely table but if we booked we would have found out they had a roast pork special for those who booked, so next time we will book just incase! Show less

Author: Sam HMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Great food & hospitality
Review: Even though I've been to Langkawi 4 times now, I only just found this little gem. The owners Michele & Lutz greeted me with a big Hi as I walked in, introduced themselves and their staff and the night began. The food is home style, great produce and totally delish. Another great thing was the beer was icey cold. I luv the different cultural foods in Malaysia but I really enjoyed my lasagna. Went back and had eggs benedict, bacon (yes bacon.....if you've been to Malaysia you'll understand that), grilled tomato and asparagus and it was amazing. Wish I'd found them earlier. Thanx to Michele, Lutz and the staff for a lovely experience all round.Show less

Author: Travelling_Faerie27Portsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: A very lovely family feel home cooking
Review: We came here to have a break from the Asian cuisine after 3 weeks of travelling, it was a bit off the beaten track so take the address with you just in case the taxi doesn't know where the place is.We went there for dinner and later on for brunch, I would recommend any one to come and visit, to have a home away from home, the moment they came over and introduced them self and show the menu you we knew it would be a long cosy and friendly night, the food was lovely and the service was second to none, If you want some advise as were to visit the owners know where and what to visit so make sure you take note.thank you for a lovely evening and brunch at your restaurant.Show less

Author: Allan C
Title: Had a great time in a lovely tropical environment. Michele & Christine being wonderful hosts. The food is just great
Review: Great food, great location, great service, what more des one want to enjoy a great |Sunday Brunch..Allan and Nia

Author: kathleentffLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Food and Nice Sunset
Review: Visited this place after viewing recommendations on tripadvisor. The lamb was delicious and what I loved most was the fried potatoes. The environment was cozy and the sunset view was fantastic. The potato and leek soup was very good as well. The service there was alright with Michele and Lutz, however, the only set back I would say was that there were no itemized billing. The waitress an Indian lady could almost ruin whatever good reviews of this place. When asked for an itemized bill(which she couldn't understand) she said quite loudly that we wanted to split the bill. Would have rated excellent if the billing hiccups did not occur.Show less

Author: Sinthy
Title: A place to dine and relax
Review: Very friendly,cozy place. The owner, Michell is so warm and makes you feel at home. Fantastic hospitality!

Author: taesp
Title: Best kept Langkawi secret
Review: Fish pie, schnitzel, chicken or pork pate, home smoked bacon, liver and bacon....what's not to love about Mangoes. Add fantastic proprietors - a duo that rocks front of house and whips up a scrumptious fair in the kitchen, plus friendly attentive serve staff that makes you feel right at home and you then have a potent combination. Top if off with a view of the sea whilst you sit and enjoy alfresco dining and you have a winning combination.We've been there with friends, a group of rowdy sailors, a romantic evening, with family.... Michelle and Mangoes have never let us down.Worth the flight to Langkawi just to walk in and have an unassuming meal....if you are lucky to make it on a Sunday, get over for the brunch and THE best bloody mary's. Don't be surprise if you end up staying right through to dinner.Show less

Author: Cjb54321
Title: Langkawi's best kept secret
Review: Fantastic food, brilliant atmosphere and company! Sunday brunch was delicious. Stayed all afternoon.

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Haven from the Monsoon!
Review: I was visiting friends who happen to live nearby to Mangoes and having been caught in a very heavy storm options were limited as to where to dine alfresco. Problem solved as the dining area is enclosed within a courtyard area and we were able to concentrate on our food and wine without fear of getting drenched. Food is first class and beats handsdown what is offered in some of the swankier hotels on the Island.. along with that you get the personal attention of the owners Michelle and Lutz. Added to which a big thank you to Michelle for the must be sampled Crepe for desert, which was adorned with candle and rendering of Happy Birthday as it was delivered to the table. Cheers!Show less

Author: tobilowHamburg, Germany
Title: Reg. Swordfishs post from 7/29
Review: I don’t know which place Swordfish went to. I’ve been a regular customer of the Mangoes fort the past three years. Nothing of Swordfish comments matches the Mangoes I know. Nobody in his/ her right mind could mistake the so obviously AUSTRALIEN, very cheerful and welcoming Lady for a grumpy and patronizing old English Lady.There are only two questions left.What is the meaning of “uninaciativ“?And why did it take you several times to find out that they deliver „uninaciativ“ cooking results?As far as I am concerned friends, family and myself still keep up the five stars for the Mangoes.Show less

Author: HRHSorayaCabo San Lucas, Mexico
Title: Michele and Lutz opens their home ...
Review: Set in the backyard of Michele"s and Lutz's home is the cozy Mangoes Restaurant.Great place to be solo ,as most of the Expats dine here and it's a great networking place .Try Michele's famous Fish Pie and there is a meal to suit every mood .Sunday Brunch is a must ....the perfect cure for the week end hang over and the great way to start the week.Eggs Benedict were the best on the island .Affordable,Friendly ,Comfortable .A must in LangkawiShow less

Author: Thirylangkawi
Title: Friendly, Nice and Cosy
Review: The excelent food and portioning will surprise you, the atmosphere is like in a bistro, all talk and share present and past stories around the bar whit the owners always there to make you comfortable and happy to be there, price are nicely reasonable and don't miss the Sunday brunch served with a bloody marry or a champagne orange bubbly.Thank you Mangos it’s yuummmyyy….Show less

Author: wilfried1957
Title: finally some pork
Review: Found finally a good restaurant with some pork on the menu. Good and service ok. normal expat restaurant.

Author: sheerawr
Title: Just OK
Review: Food is a little bit overpriced but its quality matches. Customer service is ok lah but food delivered late perhaps they could work on this.

Author: ScotgalAustraliaAustralia
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: When you are in Langkawi this is a restaurant that you should not miss out on. We had a lovely meal there the Friday after the Tsunami alert - did try to get there that same night but Kuala Teriang was being evacuated. Taxi drivers still not a hundred percent sure where it is, but thanks to previous Tripadvisor reviews we were able to direct them.The food was very enjoyable, pate to start was yummy, then we shared the cordon bleu schnitzel and the lasagne for mains - well the schnitzel has the best smokey taste, was told by Michelle that they actually smoke the bacon (real bacon) themselves. The lasagne was very tasty indeed.Then of course dessert, even though we were well satisfied - we had to try Michelle's Walnut Pie - so glad that we did!!!!!!!!!!!!All this washed down with perfectly chilled wine and beer.Thank you to Michelle and staff we will certainly be back when we are on the island. Keep up the great workShow less

Author: Nuschko
Title: Good western food
Review: Hidden cosy place, recommended for Western food. Delicious mashed potatoes. Order from the day's menu.

Author: Steve_BrusselsBrussels, Belgium
Title: Super Ambiance, Great People, Good Food
Review: When my wife slipped off a motor scooter and turned up in a wheel chair (before we were repatriated) they were so helpful and nice. Interesting mixture of regular expats, who have "gone native" adoring the island lifestyle, and tourists like us who wander in.Can be a little difficult to find because they have moved a couple of times and their location is rather secluded.Ozzie burger was tremendous as was the dessert. Keep it up!Show less

Author: tt53Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Still Impressive!
Review: One of the restaurants we enjoyed very much on our previous visit to Langkawi was Mangoes so we made it a priority to visit again this time. It did not disappoint at all. We has a numberm of brilliant meals there. The Sunday brunch is a welcome addition!We had one excellent special evening where the staff cooked their favourite dishes and this was most enjoyable. Many thanks to all those who worked so hard to make the evening so special.Rest assured that whenever we go to Langkawi, Mangoes will be top of our list to return to! Thanks to Michelle and Lutz for making such a welcoming restaurant.Show less

Author: Karen D
Title: good western food
Review: slightly overpriced, ordered orange juice and got orange squash ,that was dissappointing otherwise food was good

Author: AusNoah
Title: Great food! Great atmosphere
Review:
Food was so tasty, big portions and had a homely feel to them!
Service was excellent and Michelle and the staff made our night memorable.
We will be back

Author: scratchmark
Title: Truly great european food, lovely location, far from the maddening crowd on the tourist beaches.
Review:
Delicious food and healthy portions in a quiet, elegant and completely charming environment. Popular with a polite and cheerful expat crowd and 'Yachties'.
Bring an apetite!
(oh, and they are dog friendly)

Author: Andrew PDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Food was great and the place was full of character
Review: Although there were a few tourists in when we were there, you could tell from the banter between the owner and the guests that there were a lot of expatriots in as well. Everybody was having fun and it added a lot of character to the place. The food was good wholesome home cooking and the price was pretty reasonable too.Show less

Author: ilikecakes
Title: Brunch at Mangoes - a must!
Review: On our last visit before leaving Langkwi we discovered Mangos now offer an excellent Sunday brunch menu, they start early and finish late.  The food is excellent and the Eggs Benedict is to die for!  And as usual the service and atmosphere is fabulous!

Author: tobilowHamburg, Germany
Title: First place I will go to whenever I am in Langkawi
Review: Also on my second trip to Langkawi I only can highly recommend to visit Mangoes.Besides the perfect sundowner, the warm hospitality from Michele, Lutz, Ikky, Christina, Ti and Prema it’s the food that makes this place so special. There is nothing from the menu that’s not worth a try. The only recommendation I will give is the chocolate walnut pie – it is awesome and you should not leave without having tried it.There are always specials at Mangoes like Burns Night, Australia Day, and a weekly Sunday Brunch which is wonderful. And for special occasions like Christmas and New Years they have a fantastic buffets. Go there and find out yourself - I am sure you will love that special place.Show less

Author: DartydoLangkawi
Title: Mangoes is unique to langkawi as it offers good quality home cooking ( uk and Aussie). Yummy steak , roast chuk with home made g
Review: The first home of Mangoes was an Hemingwayesque old Malay house on the beach. Although now further up the coast it has lost none of it's colonial expats ambience. The proprietors Michele from Oz and Lutz from Germany offer European cuisine with a friendly welcome and great service. Much as we love excellent Malay and Chinese cooking there are nights when you just fancy shepherds pie, steak,roast chicken or lamb etc. At Mangoes you can be sure of a friendly face and it's the one place I would be happy to go alone to sit at the bar for a drink or eat .Show less

Author: globetrotter1979London, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal I had in Langkawi
Review: The best meal I had in Langkawi was at Mangoes. At the recommendation of a local expat, we tried it out and were not at all disappointed. The staff was friendly from the moment we sat down, and the atmosphere was relaxed and laid back. The prices were completely reasonable.. and the food! That was the best part! The lamb shank with mashed potatoes was out of this world - the meat literally fell right off the bone! The mashed potatoes were delicious too! The strudel for dessert was the perfect finish. I had such a great meal here, and good meals in Malaysia weren't always so easy to find. I would gladly return here.Show less

Author: Liz PCairns, Australia
Title: A fantabulous Christmas Dinner without the worry, work, wearyness and waste....
Review: A humungous thank you to Michele and her amazing team who made last night's Christmas Buffet an absolute superb experience. With fantastic food, fabulous friends and a festive atmosphere the night could not have been more of a success from the point of view of one who stuffed herself to oblivion. On a personal note, we've never been huge fans of turkey, being very much more into ham but, that smoked birdie was to die for; so flavorsome, so succulent and that beautiful pink hue to the meat... oh my... then we had to do desert...and the desert just did me. Pick a desert? ..nah I got a sampler with home-made lemon meringue, pavlova, Christmas cake with a lethal after-kick and ice-cream. Michele finished our night off with a surprise which we all applauded vigorously, enthusiastically and damn pretty loudly. Then finally we all rolled out, to head to our much, much needed beds, somewhere around 11pm. The night is on my *To Repeat At all Costs* list for next yearShow less

Author: pam_redbootsnorfolk
Title: not the best in the island - but ok
Review: not sure what all the fuss is about. we had a pleasant enough meal, though the portions were very big. my husband and i went with a friend who lives in the island. we had a lovely evening, but we would have anywhere.the place makes a bit of a virtue of 'home-cooking' - sadly it apparently relies on gravy mixes and the like rather than what we are used to, i found my roast chicken and mash tasted like a tv dinner from a cheaper supermarket range. the puddings were, as others have said, very nice.Show less

Author: IanMakinson1Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Good welcoming atmosphere
Review: From the moment we walked in we felt immediately welcome, especially when we were offered a piece of birthday cake! Mangoes offers a hearty selection of home cooked food and you won't be disappointed at all, prices are equally appealing too. We enjoyed the meal so much and felt so relaxed here we decided to come back for new years eve rather than stay at our hotel and , as expected, a second good night was had as well. The owners Michelle & Lutz couldn't have been more welcoming & this is definitely one of those places you will enjoy.Show less

Author: Semih G
Title: A hidden treassure on Langkawi
Review: Great location and fantastic food. The restaurant is a very clean and tidy place. The owners and the staff are more than friendly. And the food...wow! Very good and reasonable prices. A must go!!

Author: faith_w16
Title: loved the food
Review: we ate here a few times.  loved the food, very delicious!  the wait staff was also great, very entertaining!

Author: ilikecakesAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: The best food on the Island!!
Review: Fantastic location, excellent menu, excellent food, great staff and wonderful service. They are very reasonably priced too and the meals are very plentiful. The food and the atmosphere just can't get any better in my book and to top it all off they have the coldest beers on the island and they keep their glasses in the fridge! Western/German food at it's best in a very relaxed environment.Show less

Author: gypsymamanworld
Title: Good straight-up comfort food
Review: This is a 'locals' restaurant really. Hidden away and not touristy. Just a nice place with nice food ar a nice price. Michelle is a great lady who will see you right staff. She's put together a menu that will suit anyone missingnhome cooked food.. A great change!Show less

Author: TAtonullOslo, Norway
Title: A great break from Asian food
Review: After two weeks with Asian food we wanted a break from it. We were not disappointed. The owner gave us a warm welcome and throughout our dinner gave us excellent service. However, we came for the food and it did not let us down. We both had the days special, which was Lamb steak with mash and gravy, as a side order we had aspargues with Hollandaise sauce, the sauce is the best Hollandaise I have ever had. All in all, highly recommanded and the view is actually great as well, very romantic. Please be aware it is a bit hard to find, even for taxi drivers, but that should not stop you.Show less

Author: AlanM579Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Rain or Shine - a Tropical Delight!
Review: It’s my privilege to talk about “Mangoes”. Let me firstly say that it is NOT hard to find! Most travellers end up in a place called Pantai Cenang (Cenang Beach). From there, you simply follow signs to the airport. When the signs tell you to ‘turn right’, ignore them. Keep driving until you hit a T-junction. Turn left! You are there, and parking is not a problem. Kuala Teriang.Be warned. “Mangoes” is a Western style restaurant. But it is VERY informal. Don’t expect “Would Modom care to see the winelist’”? Or “would Sir care to see the menu”? This place serves good western food. It is run by Lutz (German and not an immediate comedian) and Michele (Ozzie), who,is a bit nuts! The staff are a TEAM! Meet Christina, Chef Ickky, the back of house ladies. They all work as one!I went once with a friend from Mainland China. He had NEVER been called “Darling”, “Sweetie”, “Honey” etc before. (Michele of course). Now he uses that in his emails to address me!.If you want good western food, informal service, reasonable prices and a good laugh, this place is for you! If you want stiff and formal, forget it!It is a real tropical setting! If the weather is fine, it’s lovely. If the weather is terrible, it’s lovely!!!Good food, good service, informal ....and a Sunday Brunch which is great – rain or shine!!Show less

Author: MrTan_sheraton
Title: Excellent food and dessert, great place!
Review: We ordered the lamb shank and crumbed fish.. Both were fantastic! The lamb was juicy and fish was soft and fresh. The mashed potatoes were excellent...you definitely have to order their dessert! The chocolate walnut pie and frangipani pear tart were heavenly and definitely not heavy. One should not leave without trying their desert.This is a homely environment and you will feel as if visiting your friend's home for dinner. :)Ps/ do lookup google map or call for direction. Tripadvisor map location is wrong and you should not be driving towards Kuah town. Show less

Author: Pieter ZHonfleur, France
Title: Home away from home
Review: It was not very easy to find but definitely worth the search. Just keep in mind that it has sea view and is at the beginning of the Jalan Kuala Teriang, so not in the direction of Kuah. Google maps shows the correct location. Tripadvisor location is wrong. We showed up for lunch but the kitchen opens only at 5 pm. We were very welcome though for a freezing cold beer. Apparently on Sunday they also serve lunch. We had some good food with a rib-eye and fish and chips, however, it is more important to leave space for dessert, the chocolate walnut pie is an absolute must. We had 3 weeks of delicious Asian food, but it was nice to have a European menu and spirit for a change. Prices are good value for money with RM 25 for fish and chips and RM 4 for a beer. What makes this place extra special are the owners Michele from Australia and Lutz from Germany (which explains the schnitzel and bratwurst) making u feel at home and sharing their adventure with you. Show less

Author: KeatsLangkawiIsland of Gozo, Malta
Title: Bloody ‘Merries’, Eggs Benny & Bubbles, Oh my!
Review: As one with neither a big appetite, nor a breakfast fan for that matter, I must say that I was pleasantly surprised when I treated myself to brunch at Mangoes last Sunday. I ordered the Eggs Benedict and, for lack of a better description, “OrgasMMMic!” The eggs were poached to perfection, the freshly baked, locally made muffins were impeccable and the homemade hollandaise sauce…oh, the hollandaise sauce… tangy, buttery, light but creamy and so, so, so delicious. Sided with fresh greens and asparagus for dipping, the dish from presentation to consumption (to wanting to be so bold as to lick the plate clean!) does not disappoint. As I mentioned, I don’t have a big appetite, especially early in the day, but the plate-licking fiend that was hid away in the corner?... That was me!Open for brunch every Sunday from 11pm on, Mangoes also offers a wide selection of toasties as well as omelettes and a ‘big breakfast” (consisting of eggs, sausage, beans, tomato, hashbrowns, etc., etc.) To wash it all down, and to make the most of a lazy Sunday, Mimosas and Bloody ‘Merries’ are also available.See you next Sunday, and the next, and the next… (:Show less

Author: WyanSPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: One of the most unforgettable meals in the whole trip
Review: We went there hoping to see the sunset view we read in the reviews but unfortunately it has been raining for quite a number of days. Nevertheless we decided to give it a try and the food was amazing. The mashed potatoes were to die for and the fish & chips are just fantastic.
