The fish was soft and fresh, seems like it could melt in the mouth. The staff and owner were very friendly. The owner kept on insisting we try their dessert which was walnut pie but we couldnt stuff anymore into our bloated stomach but we gave in to her persistence. 4 of us shared the pie and indeed it was superb. Overall it was a great experience dining there besides the fact that it was not very noticeable and we had to ask for directions to get there and also the mosquitoes there have a lot of appetite. Do ask for insect repellents from the staff.Show less

Author: jblarsSauk Centre, Minnesota
Title: Fantastic food, great variety, wonderful people
Review: The best burger I have had on the island! It was Aussie beef & a tower of a burger with everything you could want on a burger & more. We also enjoyed the lamb shank dinner & have to say the mashed potatoes on the side were so good they could have been a meal in themsleves. The lamb was very tender & moist - very good.The staff is attentive & friendly. The owners are wonderful hosts.The setting when you are in the restaurant is like being in a tropical garden with a view out to the water.We will definitely visit againShow less

Author: BC1377United Kingdom
Title: A Must Visit
Review: Make sure you look at their website to find directions to this excellent little restaurant. We visited twice, the food is very good, my favourite was the lamb shank and the best beansprouts in a herb butter you can find. The staff and owner are very friendly and welcoming. I would quite happily work my way through everything on the menu, it's all very tempting. It's very reasonably priced and overall a must visit venue in Langkawi.Show less

Author: jaxx2410
Title: Food, ambience excellent
Review: Wonderful evening last night at Mangoes. Would happily recommend to anyone visiting Langkawi..a must to visit. Try the chocolate and walnut pie..to die for.

Author: NickyB54Hereford, United Kingdom
Title: Find it, it's really easy, and you won't regret it!!!
Review: After other reviews saying how difficult it was to find we were a bit apprehensive. It's not, in fact it's very easy especially if you're at the Sheraton, if not just phone & Michele will guide you in. Really lazy, laid back atmosphere with excellent food at very reasonable prices and you must try Michele's walnut & chocolate tart!!!! After finding them on their night off (Tuesday) we went back the following night and were treated like old friends - when we left I think we were!!! Made time for a second visit before we came home too. Great western food,a super change from over-priced hotel food or asian cuisine. Highly recommend Mangoes to anyone. Michele & Lutz will welcome you and I know you will enjoy it.Show less

Author: Syme0nAdelaide, Australia
Title: Delighted with every bite!
Review: Had some difficulty in finding the place. But the manager was more than pleased to help us. Lovely place. Cozy ambiance. Jovial and chirpy service. Excellent 'home-cooked style' food with spot-on recommendations. Value for money. In summary - worth the hassle for finding the place! Reviews here you can trust and if I were to go back to Langkawi in the near future, this would definitely be in my 'will visit' list.Show less

Author: hikebCanberra, Australia
Title: Honest food
Review: This place might not be the ritz, but it doesn't hold itself out to be either. The place is impossible to find unless you have a good cab driver, which luckily we did, but yet when we went to the back of the building sceptically, there it was and it was full. You don't get somewhere totally out of the way like that full, unless you are doing something right. The food was honest and good. Having grown up on great quality german food, I'm a harsh critic. I'll be honest, when I make schnitzel, it is better. But that is an unfair marker, because it was really good. The owners were friendly, the service great and the chicken liver pate tasted just like my mums - which is awesome. Go here if you want a change in your diet after some time in Malaysia. Go here if you enjoy retro-eclectic good times. It's good, honest, hearty food.Show less

Author: Lim12London, United Kingdom
Title: Bog Standard
Review: After reading the reviews we made a trip to eat there. The owner was very pleasant but the food is bog standard bistro. Certainly Not up to the standards at Nam,Privelege,Mare Blu etc. Just goes to show that one cannot trust the ratings at Tripadvisor unquestioningly.Just for the record we have been going to Langkawi for the last 10 years and have eaten at most of the good restaurants.Show less

Author: tt53Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, great people and wonderful atmosphere
Review: We had read all the great reviews about Mangoes and some comments about it being difficult to find. So we set out when we had hired a car to find this haven. After having tried once going down some small tracks and not finding anything we thought we would give it one more go. We found Michele painting the place and it was closed but neverthe less she took the time to show us round the place and also showed us the menu.We went back the following night and were most impressed. The food was great but much more than that. The place and all the people from staff to other customers were so friendly.We went back a second time during our stay and that just confirmed the first visit.The food was excellent, it was great value for money but it was so much more. The evening was about the whole experience - from food the people to music. Many thanks to Lutz, Michele and all the staff for making the place so special and worth finding. Check out their website for directions!!Show less

Author: mbevoPerth
Title: Couldn't find the place
Review: Our hotel organised a taxi to the restaurant and we were taken to this scary looking deserted building under a bridge. The driver then proceeded to tell us that Mangoes had closed as it didn't receive enough customers.We didn't get to eat there. I recommend the owners befriend the local taxi company or update tripadvisor with address details.Show less

Author: cstrubeSeoul, South Korea
Title: Stumbled upon Mangoes by accident and it was a highlight of our trip!
Review: During our trip to Langkawi Island in December 2010, we rented a car and explored the island. We ran across what looked like a private beachside residence tucked away in lush landscaping, and as we wandered close to the property the owner came out. We were surprised by her kindness in answering our questions and giving us information about the areas of the island that were hit by the 2004 tsunami. She explained that she and her partner -- both of them resident expatriates -- ran a restaurant and invited us back later that evening. We enjoyed superb Western-style cuisine, crisp and refreshing beer and fantastic conversation. The owners explained that many of their regulars are also resident expatriates, but they offered cuisine for all tastes. The fish was superb -- herb-encrusted with garlic rather than laden in thick, fried batter -- and the view was unbeatable! After visiting at the outdoor bar, we were placed at a table overlooking the shore and we watched the sunset in a beautiful outdoor setting. The owners of the Mangoes were overly accommodating.Show less

Author: Blank_ExpressionismPerth, Australia
Title: Fantastic Hidden Gem
Review: Wow... After looking on Trip Advisor and discovering that this restaurant was quite close to our hotel we decided to see for ourselves... Yes, the restaurant is quite difficult to find (indeed our taxi driver was reluctant to take our directions as he didn't believe there was a restaurant in the area we were directing him), so make sure you look it up on google maps and get a general idea of where you are going, or ring Michelle and she will give you the directions you need. The atmosphere was great, it feels like you are going to a really close friends house for dinner rather than a restaurant (which may be a pro or con, but for us it was a pro). Relaxed, lots of people chatting and some good music. Michelle quickly seated us, chatted, brought us menus and made recommendations (also, we were lucky enough to dine on a night of an art exhibition and received a free beer each). We both ordered a T-Bone steak (admittedly, not very adventurous) and Mangoes were happy to oblige my request of 'medium-rare, but more medium than rare' with a potato dish and salad... Food arrived in a timely manner, was generous in portions and was delicious (the salad was homely and nothing too special but was still nice). Dessert was... divine, we ordered a chocolate and walnut pie and an apple turnover, the presentation of these dishes was excellent and the taste was amazing... All-in-all a really enjoyable dining experience in a very casual and welcoming environment.At the end of the night, my partner and I were going to call a taxi to take us home, Michelle was so generous in offering us transport from Lutz (I'm guessing her partner and also the chef). This kind of hospitality never goes astray, we decided to walk but were blown away by the offer.Highly recommend.Show less

Author: UrbanLeeMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food, friendly service, reasonable price
Review: Went there with 7 friends after a long hard day of sightseeing. It was nothing short of luck to get us there. Mangoes, like like precious gems, is hidden from public view. To get to Mangoes, you will need to pray to food gods for mercy, otherwise try to ask a local/hotel on how to get there before venturing there yourself. Once you do see that small sign on the wall reading "mangoes", you know you are in for a treat.Michele (from Geelong, Australia) will make sure everything your night is an enjoyable one. She's extremely friendly and a great source on local touristy things to do. Service is attentive and on par with a good restaurant you'll find in Australia. FOOD IS YUM. Can I tell you we CANNOT and COULD NOT stop eating. Everything was delicious. Because there was the 8 of us, we sampled a range of dishes from the menu. I could not fault any of the dishes. It was the kind of food you would want after a long day in Langkawi. The Rib eye is a must try.Don't get me started on desert. Michele doesn't let you go home unless you pack one of these home. There has only been one bad review of this Langkawi establishment, and I have to say the accusations in that review are unfounded. At no time did I feel like it was an "retirement home" nor were any of the staff drunk. I'm in my twenties, and I felt quite at ease at Mangoes. I was so impressed by the food and service, I went there twice in my short stay on Langkawi.Keep up the good food!(as a suggestion, maybe you should post directions and map onto tripadvisor)Show less

Author: beccaldnLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant with delicious food - highly recommended
Review: This is a fantastic restaurant run by a lovely couple. My boyfriend and I had a really good evening here sat outside in the evening warmth. We really enjoyed talking to the owners, finding out more about their life in Langkawi!There is a good selection of food (don't expect traditional Malay dishes). I went for thehe burger which was absolutely amazing - the tallest burger I have ever had!! It was a challenge to eat, but definitely worth it. The desserts were delicious too - you shouldn't leave Mangoes without trying one!!It is a little bit difficult to find Mangoes because it is hidden away, but persevere because it is definitely worth it!!Show less

Author: RampantSailingLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Guaranteed quality food & service
Review: We have lived on Langkawi Island for 4 years now & were introduced to Mangoes by friends of ours. The experience was such that now we will take our guests & family there when it is important that every one has a great eating experience. The food has always been exceptional & the service friendly & polite. The atmosphere is pleasant & such that it is comfortable to visit whilst eating (no blaring music).It has good value for money with quality food & good presentation. We would strongly recommend this venue for those that wish to experience European cuisine on a tropical island.Show less

Author: singapore111111Singapore, Singapore
Title: Simply the Best!!!
Review: We are regular Langkawi visitors and have been to Mangoes on each occassion. Better food and hospitaly for amazing prices can not be found anywhere in Langkawi. They also cater very well for small children and are happy to do anything to tickle the little tastebuds as well. Our favourite place.Sue and Steve - Singapore.Show less

Author: hughie56London, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding hidden gem
Review: Finding Mangoes requires some preparation! You need to call them and ask for directions as it is not somewhere you would drive by. We stayed at the Sheraton and, through the helpful concierge lady there who made the call on our behalf, we discovered that Mangoes was almost within walking distance.We were welcomed warmly by an Australian lady who ran the restaurant. We had a beautiful view of the sunset over the sea from our table. Food was excellent - freshly cooked and delicious. Wine by the glass was reasonably priced. Clientele appeared to mainly resident expats who used it as a meeting place. They even had pork on the menu - quite unusual in Langkawi!Show less

Author: TCBP
Title: If you love good food, in a great setting, you simply have to go Mangoes!!
Review: Good food, great atmosphere, friendly personal service, value for money; what else is there to say!?

Author: tsonoqua
Title: A cosy spotless restaurant on the beach with lots of ambiance.
Review: Run by a German cook and an affable Australian lady, the western style food is consumed in great quatities by the local expat community. It is the closest thing to home cooking you will find in your travels.

Author: tobilow
Title: No way not going there!!!!!!!!!
Review: you can't leave Langkawi w/o having tried Michele's devine Wallnut Chocolate Tart!!!! Or else u missed out on something in life. (Although on second thoughts that also applies for her Chocolate Trifle)

Author: NhanbreadLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Formidable
Review: Having been to Mangoes several times I can only say that the food gets better every time and the hosts are par excellence ! How anyone can write a bad review of this place is beyond me (and as you can see it was ONLY one so that person must not like food that much) The location can be a little hard to find but once you have been you will want to go again and again. As for VFM ? = Excellent and the portions are very generous too. Keep up the good work guys & galsShow less

Author: RakthiKuah
Title: Friendly owners/staff and superb value for the money.
Review: If dining on a budget on healthy, fresh and delicious western food that's being served (by what must be the friendliest staff on the island) in a warm family atmosphere is what you are looking for, this is the place to go to. (And I haven't even mentioned Michele's "to die for" desserts)Absolutely worth every penny, and a true Langkawi experience.Show less

Author: micocolParis, France
Title: A must for great European food
Review: As regular visitors to Langkawi we always look forward to going back to Mangoes. Great European food at a good price, fantastic atmosphere with friendly and welcoming staff, superb location with great views of the sunsets.As a European we can only take so much of the local cuisine and although we enjoy that too, this is the only place for us to get the best western style food.We will be returning to Langkawi in the next couple of weeks and look forward to meeting our young friends from Singapore there for a great night out.Show less

Author: donvalcourtLangkawi
Title: Mangoes -----simply marvellous!
Review: I have to say, I have been to Mangoes many times and always love it. If you think there is going to be a sunset, that is a great place to be. If you are all on your own, don't worry, the staff are so friendly and helpful, you'll feel right at home. The food is excellent with desserts to die for--------even though I am on a semi-permanent diet I find it almost impossible to resist; last time it was apple strudel, light as a feather with a lovely spicey flavour. Any time I feel like Western food in Langkawi, this would be my first port of call. Valerie.Show less

Author: JETMAN_10Atlanta, Georgia
Title: Great service, Great Food, Friendly staff
Review: As a international traveler I have dined out alot over the years and have filled up 7 passports with many countries stamps.I feel that I am " qualified " to give this restuarant review.Mangoes follows a very basic concept that alot of other restuarants have seem to forget about these days. Great food, Great Service, Large portions and a fair price. Plus owners that really care and clean restrooms to complete the overall dining experience.I hope that if you ever fly over to Langkawi Malaysia you will make this a " fuel stop."Show less

Author: coconutboy_9San Francisco
Title: Mediocre food - over priced
Review: Ate here twice, just to give it a second chance - but still not convinced.The food was edible, but lack lustre. I ordered the cordon bleu - and that's all that was on the plate - just this sad lump of bread-crumbed meat that smelled and tasted or old reheated cooking oil. Where were the vegetables? Ah - well if I wanted vegetables I should have ordered them! I recheck the menu and see that the price of the meal almost doubles if you want veg and potatoes with your meat. This place caters to the local expatriate community - over 60's only please - not that I'm ageist, but there was a certain retirement home atmosphere both times I went. Visitors who are not regulars can wait to be seated or served until the regulars get served. The service was friendly, but drunk (admittedly original for Malaysia) and got steadily drunker as the evening went on.Show less

Author: skrudgeCebu City, Philippines
Title: Wow - run, don't walk to this hidden gem!
Review: Not only is the casual atmosphere among the most friendly and intimate on the island, but Mango's serves the BEST European food on Langkawi, bar none. The inventive kitchen delights of this 'insider' island hangout will please the weary traveler with even the most stringent standards. The food here is made the love that can only be achieved when the owners run the kitchen themselves, and preside nightly over the operation. Note: Mango's serves dinner only - Wed to Sun.Show less

Author: TLC123456789
Title: Lovely place to eat, very friendly staff...
Review: Lovely place to eat, very friendly staff happy to accommodate any request. Good selection of western food, all very tasty and well cooked. Good value for money. Worthwhile place to find.

Author: anakikanengland
Title: no rice or noodles....yeah!!!!!
Review: Having eaten several times at Mangoes i ave to say the food is consistently excellent.Every meal is delicious and filling,portions are good and the attention to detail great.Although a little out of the way from the main tourist area (Kuala Teriang is just a 10 minute drive from Pantai Cenang) it is well worth the trip.Not many tourists even know this place as the local expats tend to keep this gem to themselves....word of mouth is the only way until now.Michelle and Lutz are constantly improving and are a dedicated team (along with the staff there).I especially enjoy the shepherds pie and the lamb chops but everything is so tasty i could eat there every night.Closed monday and tuesday so avoid these days.....sometimes they organise special set meals/bbq nights which are not to be missed.To get there you have to go past the Perdana Residences,over the bridge until you reach the T junction,then turn left to the waterfront area (look to the left and you will find )Lovely setting for a sunset drink and peaceful surroundings away from the crowds.I love this sort of "secret" place where you know not everyone will be lucky enough to find.Sorry if this ruins the tranquility but when the food is so tasty you just have to share the experience.Well done to you both....see you on my next trip....xxShow less

Author: junglegirlxlangkawi
Title: Thank you for bringing Mangoes back!!
Review: It was a hole in my social life when Mangoes temporarily went away. Not to mention the best place for me to get a nice western meal . The new place has a lot of atmosphere and privacy.The food is tasty and the prices average. Do I know them personally? Yes I do, but I'm also a well fed customer. :)Show less

Author: catnougePhuket, Thailand
Title: The BEST place for Western Food in Langkawi.
Review: Mangoes sits on the edge of the mangroves in Kuala Teriang, a quiet fishing village. The dining room is wall-free, as all good tropical venues should be, and faces West, so make sure you arrive early to catch the sunset. After weeks of eating nasi campur and noodles my family were falling over themselves for a 'meat and potatoes' fix. Lucky we found Mangoes. We tested out the lamb shanks on our first visit and came back again to make sure they really were as delicious as we thought. My four year old ate an adult serve of sausage and chips (good German bratwurst, crispy fries) - must have been missing home, the poor little carnivore. Many Western restaurants in Langkawi charge Western prices, but Mangoes main courses start at RM15 (about AUD$5). Drinks are also priced below other comparable Langkawi restaurants. As another reviewer noted, the owners Michelle and Lutz are very welcoming and the local staff are gorgeous. I love Icky's smile! I'll be back.Show less

Author: MissShiny27
Title: Great dining experience
Review: Loved the variety of local and Western cuisine to choose from the breakfast buffet spread. Made to order list was equally good. Eggs were cooked to perfection. Service was amazing. Venue was closed for lunch/dinner due to a private event so we couldn't experience their lunch/dinner menu during our stay at The Danna. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: ramzul135
Title: Amazing breakfast!
Review: Love the variety of dishes to choose from the buffet. The pastries especially danish was by far the best I have ever had. Kudos to the chef!

Author: Lee_Ding_Ding
Title: Great place for your daily breakfast
Review: Good varieties and quality of food , and staff are polite and well- trained. Even with high traffic you do not feel congested as the space is well laid out,

Author: Philip G
Title: Breakfast for Royals
Review: Excellent nasi lemak and char koay teow to accompany your champagne breakfast. Staff are so helpful and responsive  seeing to our every need.

Author: STLbirdie
Title: Beautiful food, excellent service!
Review: There is a lovely range of food at the Planter's. We enjoyed items from the 'Subcontinent' section, as well as the Western offerings.

Author: hunnyD79
Title: breakfast
Review: Very nice food and beverage . Staff are very  helpful and friendly. Cozy environment and comfortable.

Author: AcesGoPlaces
Title: Excellent Staff...but need more choices
Review: Limited brekfast choices. Coffee was excellent and the chef very accomodating when asked for a keto breakfast.

Author: vanessadsouza1London, United Kingdom
Title: Averge food for 5* hotel pricetag
Review: Ate here whilst staying at the resort a few times. All meals were very average for the price and quality/standard met. Not catered to accommodate solo travellers well, so you are left with a table inside as couples are the priority. Managed to get a table outside once I complainedShow less

Author: Ellsy BPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent, excellent, excellent
Review: It's the people. Wrong! It is the hearts of the people that maketh the place. Thank you staff & management of The Danna! I don't need to add any more to the many rave reviews of this awesome hotel and its restaurants, but may I, once again, say THANK YOU !Show less

Author: Devakhi NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food and service
Review: Celebrated my birthday with a group of 20 or so friends and the service was incredible! And to have champagne breakfast here was also incredible. The manager Salim is such an awesome guy. He really did make the trip more memorable then it already wasShow less

Author: Jbps
Title: Great food, great service
Review: The food at the Planter's is great as is the service. Nothing to complain! The food has some special touches and we enjoyed every meal there. The service was always excellent and the breakfast was outstanding

Author: Deborah J
Title: Excellent
Review: We had wonderful dinners at Planters, whilst staying at The Danna, the choice of food and wine was excellent.  The service was first class and unobtrusive

Author: Bonnie143
Title: Yummy
Review: Great food and staff. We had breakfast and dinner here almost daily. They went out of their way for the entire family of various age groups

Author: tasty1111
Title: Great food menu and staff
Review: Planters has quite an extensive menu but all the food we had on our recent stay was cooked to perfection. The smiling Avis and her staff were smiling, charming and very efficient and we loved our meals there.

Author: 646franny
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Every meal we had here was wonderful. Well done chef and all the staff. Thank you for extraordinary service

Author: AlexgpringleCastle Bromwich, United Kingdom
Title: What a lovely place.
Review: Main restaurant at the Danna so open for breakfast and dinner but it is much more than that, it is a top quality restaurant in it’s own right and well worth a visit. A good selection of delicious food both local and international is enhanced by a quality wine list.Service is friendly, efficient and attentive. It is also excellent value for money. I’ll certainly be back. Thanks to all the staff especially Anis. Show less

Author: rh611
Title: Amazing Food
Review: I dare anyone to say they've had a bad meal in here.  The food is sooooo terribly good.  Wish I was there just now!

Author: CheryanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: First time in The Planter's also last time
Review: We had made a reservation and had wanted to sit outside but that was already fully booked. So we had gotten a table inside we were presented with the menu which looks more like a newspaper then a menu, Western, Asian, Malaysian, Pakistani, Arabic maybe I have missed another one. We ordered first a cocktail 1 Amaretto Sour and 1 Whiskey Sour while we were still looking at the menu what to order for starter and then main course. We received a bread basket the bread was nice but the dip to go with it very weird. I finally had made my choice for start Kataifi Prawn and my husband ordered hummus then we were going to share Chateaubriand which would be served with Béarnaise sauce and potato gratin and we ordered asparagus with it. To drink we ordered a bottle of Champagne but I had told the waitress to wait until we had finished our cocktails. We had received an Amuse Bouche which was a small bruschetta but to our surprise under the chopped tomato we found mayonaise never experienced anything like that. After the Amuse we received our cocktails they were well crafted and we enjoyed that the waitress brought 2 cooled champagne glasses but that didn't make much sense since I had already told her in advance not to start serving the champagne while we were still working on our cocktails. We received our starter so I asked for the waitress to take away the empty cocktail glasses and bring the champagne glasses back and open the bottle then we had to tell her not to fill the glass until nearly the rim of the glass. My starter was very small taste was ok my husband his hummus was simply horrible no flavour at all. So we were hoping that our main course would be better. They came with the trolley to show us the Chateaubriand still in 1 piece and they would cut on the trolley we had asked for cooking medium so the waiter showed us the centre piece which was medium but the back pieces were already overcooked. The potatoes in the gratin had not been peeled and the béarnaise sauce didn't even look like hollandaise but more like mayonaise the colour was not yellow had no tarragon in it. I am not a chef but I know perfectly well the ingredients from a béarnaise sauce and I couldn't find any of them no white wine no tarragon no tarragon vinegar and no eggs nor butter.The 2nd sauce was a shallot jus but also no taste. So I eat my meat and my asparagus a little of the gratin and no sauce. We were both so disappointed and regretted we hadn't gone back to the Italian restaurant which is very good. We still took a dessert after all it was a special evening. We both wanted to order Crepe Suzette the waitress told us that it was not possible to have Crepe Suzette so I then told her I didn't want any other dessert my husband made another choice. Not long after the waitress came back and all of a sudden it was possible to have Crepe Suzette that would also be done side table serving. The waitress who made the Crepe Suzette told us the ingredients and started with the cooking she added the alcohol and wanted to flambé it but that didn't work so she used a small torch and then it still didn't work. We started with our dessert when we were halfway through they brought us each a scoop of ice-cream. We didn't have coffee or after dinner drinks we asked the bill and left. A pity it's a nice place but for us what comes on the plate is more important.Show less

Author: Shagun_srivMelbourne, Australia
Title: One of the best Indian food!
Review: Came here for dinner during our stay at the Danna, and Ordered the chicken biryani, lamb masala and nachos chaat. The food was bought out in a timely manner by the friendly staff. All the plates were delicious and the chicken biryani was one of the best we’ve ever tried! Definitely recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: jda100160Kongens Lyngby, Denmark
Title: Work on the basics
Review: In a nice hotel like the Danna, you expect a very good breakfast. This is not the case. Table serving needs improvement: forget orders, deliver when reminded (but even if it meanwhile got cold), mix up tables. Also the buffet itself is a disappointment ... bread selection and cold cuts ... fruit is OK (but not more)As the Danna and the team in general is very good, please attend to this - the guests and Danna deserves this. Show less

Author: Olive M
Title: Nice
Review:
Had a lovely evening here with friends. There food was superb, lots of choice on the menu.
We also ate breakfast here during our stay 
Not a good selection of fruit though. We did however enjoy the complimentary fizz!!!

Author: anne_milley
Title: Good
Review: Pleasant dining place, breakfast is fantastic,food were nice, we enjoyed our meal so huge portion nothing else all great

Author: KevP10
Title: Good food
Review: Very broad menu, great set thali options of Indian/Malay/Chinese food. Went for the malay thali and was not disappointed by the lamb rendang or prawn laksa curry. Wine list good and overall pretty reasonable given the setting. Scallops were also nice.

Author: Arnong
Title: Great food and service. Amazing view

Review: We had a few meals here. The restaurant serves a variety of cuisines. We had mostly Malayan dishes. Easily some of the best food we’ve ever had. I had the same dish more than once, which is saying something! Show less

Author: thefitmum_mumSingapore, Singapore
Title: Planted comfortably in my mind
Review: Had 3 breakfast buffet and twice a la cart dinner here.Breakfast is fresh, staff is taking rounds of fresh crossont and eggs are made to order along with waffles, pancake and porridge.they make rounds of some sp dishes as well like guava smoothie 1 day, coconut water 1 day, Malaysian omelet the other day , boxing chicken, lollypop chicken. Lot of variety with Asian, western and Indian menu. Fresh fruits, juicecsalads cheese and bakery selection.All staff is very very good, I stopped keeping track of names as each and every was good. Rizal at dinner was exceptionally courteous, attentive and accommodating.Child friendly - high chair, kids menu for dinner and also offer colors to keep them engaged.Show less

Author: Kigeth
Title: Poor food
Review: The worst dinner I’ve paid for in a long time. Very poor quality, we would have been better to eat on the street and donate the difference.Show less

Author: Mukul DBengaluru, India
Title: Good ambience and tasty food
Review: It is the main restaurant where they serve breakfast buffet and one can have al-a-carte dinner/lunch too. We had dinner on our first day of stay. I wanted to have some Indian food so I thought to go out for dinner but when I looked into the Menu then I was surprized to see that they serve multiple cuisines and Indian food was one of that. We ordered chicken-tikka and some paneer gravy. Food was very tasty and even my 3 year old daughter liked chicken-tikka. I had bit of flu so I wanted to order some drink which can give some relief to me. One of their staff from bar counter (Siddharth) advised me some drink and it did wonder. I was almost fit by next morning. Special thanks to him.Show less

Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: I couldnt thank enough the staff who went the extra miles that made hubby's birthday celebration super special. From the reservation and planning stage with Mr Asroy and the ground staff on the actual day Mr Bassel, Mr Jasmani (if im not mistaken) and amomg others - they were all warm and accommodating. The menu is extensive and we were spoilt for choices. Excellent food quality and splendid service - whats more to ask for? Impeccable! Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Cat Z
Title: Beautiful!
Review: Delicious food, lots of variety and staff are awesome! Try and get one of the outdoor spaces if you can as the view/ambiance makes the experience even more enjoyable! Show less

Reasonable prices for a 5* hotel. Great service. Limited space to dine outside I would recommend booking one if the gazebo style outdoor areas. Show less

Author: BizT
Title: Average food at best but great service
Review: We were so looking forward to our meal at this highly rated restaurant but we rather disappointed with the food. Friend ordered the spring roll on the menu but it was not available! Already a bad start. Our starters - The oxtail soup was bland and the oxtails itself were chewy. My beef salad was average. Duck was cooked pink but the meat was so tough we really couldn’t eat it. The menu is vast though but all our six items chosen were really sub par. Crepes were excellent however, or should I say the sauce was divine. The crepes themselves were not cooked enough! What a disappointment. Oh well, service was great. There are many better options. Hopefully food quality improves. We won’t be back anytime soon though.Show less

Author: DougReading_BerksUKReading, Berks UK
Title: Asian Cookery Class at Planters
Review: My wife and I just participated in the Asian Cookery class, cooking Malaysian dishes at the Planters Restaurant. I would like to commend Chef Amin and his 2 colleagues for what was a both informative and enjoyable experience. It was a joy to learn new skills and about new ingredients, but most of all to chat informally with the staff and share cooking stories. It’s good to know that as good as the Danna Hotel Restaurant is, the best Nasi Lemak is made by their mothers! The same as home food the world over.We thoroughly enjoyed then eating the Beef Rendang, Nasi Lemak and Laksa Kedah we helped prepareA wonderful afternoon, please pass our thanks to Chef Amin.Show less

All of staffs are very friendly, they always smile to served. Special Thanks to Wenny the host that always helping us during our breakfast - impeccable service! Show less

I wanted to try Malaysian cuisine so had the triple rendang, my wife opted for an Indian lamb dish. We enjoyed both and shared dessert. There was live piano being played, my wife made a request for a piece of music which he duly played - nice little touch. It is pricey but this is a luxury restuarant.Show less

Author: twiggyseymourHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious food
Review: We had breakfast daily here and used it 3 out of 5 nights for dinner due to the wide selection of dishes. High standard of cuisine. Show less

Author: Ayesha K
Title: Worst service ever!!!
Review: I normally never give negative reviews but am compelled to give this one as it is one of the worst, if not the worst experience we have ever had in a restaurant. My husband, family and I are visiting from the US for our 25th anniversary. We spent the day at the Oriental Village in Langkawi and asked the taxi driver to take us to a nice place for dinner. He took us to the Planter’s at Danna at about 6:30 pm. The greeters and reception desk very really nice and said they could absolutely accommodate us without a reservation. That was the only positive part of this whole experience. The main waiter assigned to us, from the start, seemed irritated and abrupt. We asked him to put the tables together for our party of 10 and seemed upset about that although we already explained to reception we wanted to sit together and they said no problem. My husband asked for the view of the ocean in the completely empty main dining room and was told that wasn’t possible as it was for hotel guests, which was fine if that was their policy but it was conveyed to us rudely. The food was served 20-45 minutes apart from each other. My son got his beef tenderloin (which was excellent) at about 7:30 and I wasn’t served my Malay dish until almost 9:00 pm. The food was excellent to subpar. Indian choices were all disappointing. The waitstaff kept disappearing and we had to find them to ask for steak knives, water, etc. When we asked the waiter if this was normal service, he replied he was taking care of the main guests in the dining room! It was not even that they were busy. By 9:00 pm, it was only half full and we were there much before that. The experience was so disappointing, we asked to see the manager. That was when it got crazy! He kept being defensive rather than apologetic and asking us what discount we wanted on the bill like it was some kind of auction and we were complaining just because we wanted a free meal. When my sister in law stepped in to say this was about the bad service and food delay and not about money, he interrupted and told her to let him talk to the ‘men who seemed more reasonable’. Mind you, my husband and brother in law were the ones most upset. My sister in law found the experience so demeaning she walked out of the restaurant. They did end up giving a 50% discount but that does not make up for this awful 3 hour experience in what is supposed to be a 5 star hotel and restaurant. We travel extensively and I will say whether 5 Star or 2 Star, this is by far the worst experience I can remember. I hope that management is trained better. One thing to have a surly waiter, another thing to have managers who can’t manage decent customer service and insult the customer instead.Show less

Author: FJ03
Title: Great food and service
Review: My husband and I came for dinner two nights in a row. The service from beginning to end was amazing.Firstly the menus, the variety of food to choose from is endless and all sounds delicious and something for everyone tastebuds from western food to Indian, Malay and Chinese etc. From the point we walked in we were mesmerized by the layout of the hotel and the ambiance. We were seated outside by the pool which was stunning with the sounds of the fountains and fairy lights glowing in the dark and the wildlife.The choice of mocktails was also really good and the waiters and chefs were very friendly. I would like to say a special thank you to Jass, who was lovely to talk to and nothing was ever too much for him. We will always remember you and hope to see you again. The guards outside the hotel are also lovely and really enjoyed talking to us, a special thank you to Wan I believe his name was. Food wise on the first night I ordered a cod with potatoes and vegetables and my husband ordered briyani rice with chicken curry. Second night I ordered a prawn curry and my husband ordered another type of chicken curry. The food both nights were very tasty, portion sizes are so good and they so not hold back. We also ordered the chocolate dessert with ice cream both nights which tasted delicious.I would highly recommend this restaurant at the Dana, the food, the staff and the ambiance are worth every penny. Show less

Author: BarbieKimberBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Brunch
Review: My boyfriend and I travelled to the planters at the Danna purely for the breakfast with bubbles and weren’t disappointed! The staff were absolutely lovely, the food selection was great and I ended up napping before lunchtime! The sign of an excellent brunch!Show less

Author: morayjtsHong Kong, China
Title: Good food and service
Review: The breakfast buffet restaurant of the hotel . Very good selection to choose from. Menus for the other two meals has a wide selection of western, Indian, Malaysian and SEA dishes. Good service and very accommodating staff Show less

Author: Hashim H

Title: Awesome Breakfast
Review: The breakfast at Planter's is over the top with international food options. The menu changes daily so you do not see the same items day after day. We stayed at the Danna Hotel and had breakfast 5 days and the menu was not duplicated during those 5 days.Show less

Author: 207yurikPetaling Jaya, Malaysia

Review: We had yellow fin tuna as a starter and 2 Indian dishes. The portion of Indian curries were huge. We should have ordered one dish only. All the food we ordered were great. Excellent staff, nice ambience, nice live piano music. Show less

Author: sanjiv101Gandria, Switzerland

Review: We are really happy with the food preparation and service at this very classy restaurant. The chefs are very talented. Show less

Author: rwurbina

Review: I totally love the food at this place. The breakfast in special was super good . I had dinner one night and the food and service was excellent. You cannot go wrong when you have an amazing view of the pool and ocean

Author: ascotchrisAscot, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing dinner
Review: Staying at the Danna, attended a wine dinner which was pretty expensive for Malaysia. The meal was served unacceptably late and did not live uo to the hype. We suspect the food had beed cooked earlier and the result was it was dry and overcooked. Service was v. Nice like elsewhere in the hotel.Show less

Author: scmk3000Littlemore, United Kingdom
Title: Classy restaurant with delicious international dishes
Review: The Planters is within the Danna resorts and it is AMAZING, serving local Malays, Middle Eastern food, Indians, Thai and Pakistani and western food.I ate their twice and first time had the Malaysian Tiffin meal to try few of their favourites. Second time we had their seafood...omg I was given a whole snapper..and as delicious as it was and tried as I might..I couldn’t finish it by myself...had to save room for desserts. Always! I had the Mouhalabieh (sp?) which was a steam milk dessert and another the first night. They are all beautiful.The room is used for hotel breakfast but it’s really classy. They have live piano throughout the night. You can also sit right outside to admire the beach.Really recommend this restaurant for romantic dinner but it’s suitable for all occasions. Show less

Author: adfasdfjklTiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: Amazing breakfast
Review: We drove in for breakfast from the villa we were staying at. I was most impressed with the breakfast buffet. Loved the Eggs Benedict, cheeses, breads, etc. We live in Singapore and this place ranks up there with the top places in Singapore like Raffles and the Fullerton. Great food and great service!Show less

Author: debbie19jBierton, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding food
Review: We ate in Planters 3 times and every day for breakfast. ExceptionalService and outstanding food. A huge range of local Asian and western food. We stuck with local ad we prefer to when on holiday but the chocolate pudding is to die for !!! Show less

Author: MummyTravelsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great range of dishes, very stylish
Review: I ate here several times with my daughter when we stayed at the hotel - as child-friendly as it is elegant, there was plenty on the menu to tempt us both. Not the cheapest option but a wonderful treat.Show less

Author: virginieb958George Town, Malaysia
Title: disappointed
Review: i m a regular client and yesterday something change for a diner. very poor welcoming, staff poor especially a waitress with big stains on the blouse. nobody in the restaurant and i must fight to get a table outside. fish and chips half size less than before and far less tasty than last time! finally we know the manager , very nice and professional lady, we explained it. so disappointed something change.... may be low seasons but the staff is really not on the same level as before. not nice at all. limit rude!!!Show less

Author: AlanD057Napier, New Zealand
Title: The BEST Breakfast
Review: Breakfast at The Planters was amazing . The choice was exceptional , and was constantly replenished . Azmil was awesome , checking each day that we were happy , always greeting us with a great smile !! We also ate here in the evenings , and was excelent as well !Show less

Author: Meg00001Singapore, Singapore
Title: There was an office supply in my steak
Review: The title says part of it. I ate here with my boyfriend 2 nights ago and bit into something hard in my steak (the most expensive one on the menu). I thought it was a herb, but to my horror, it was a staple. Yes, an actual staple. The manager and chef apologised but still tried to make me pay 70% of the meal. I refused. They apologised several times and I thought the fiasco was over. Boy was I wrong. I ended up in the hospital yesterday from the worst food poisoning of my life- and I was in Madagascar last month. I was violently ill and needed an IV drip. My boyfriend called the hotel/restaurant to tell them about the hospital and they never returned his call even though one was promised. I've been to this Island before and travelled extensively throughout SE Asia and I can honestly say I've never been so disgusted and ill in my life.Show less

Author: paulhY2883SQSomers, Australia
Title: Final Night in Langkawi
Review: Last dinner in Langkawi so we decided to finish where we started. Started with lobster bisque and a thai seafood broth.....Both excellent.Followed with Thai beef salad and Fish & Chips.Beef salad was good but the beef was way overcooked. Fish & Chips were adequate without being great. Washed the food down Castelo Banfi Chardonnay /Pinot Grigio blend. Very nice.Service was very polite rather than good.Not as good as our first night at Planters but okay.Show less

Author: janeeeeeceDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Super hidden gem!
Review: Booked to eat here for an evening meal whilst staying at a nearby hotel. Pleasantly surprised with the whole ambience from the moment we walked in. The service was absolutely exceptional with nothing being too much for the courteous and attentive staff. Starters were seafood broth and vegetable spring rolls. The portions were large and the food delicious. The hubby opted for the fillet steak and I requested the tuna (to be well done) as our main course. A really lovely evening, in a beautiful location with great food and a fabulous and hospitable staff. A big thumbs up ....thankyou. Show less

Author: mike c
Title: just great in every way
Review: this is fine dining at reasonable prices, great food, great service, wonderful ambience, relaxing listening to the talented EMZAC at the piano, wine list has something for everyone, at very good prices compared with penang. you will dine very well here!!

Author: CAGreensSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good dinner
Review: Not amazing, but good, and reasonably priced. Ingredients are fresh and tasty but the whole was less than the sum of the parts: the fish was on the fishy side and the beef (thinly sliced in curry) was on the tough side, though the curry was tasty. The menu may be trying too hard to cover too many bases - it offers Indian, Pakistani, Asian, Western... a tighter focus might help. Also how about offering rice that is not white/steamed: we would love to see brown rice offered. My glass of Chianti was meh. Service was very good. Show less

Author: Druut
Title: Best Ever

Author: BrianE726
Title: Great food and service
Review: The Planters is part of the Danna Hotel. An extensive menu sets up this place for a five star rating. For food is sensational great wine list at very good prices. We ate here regularly as it is just so good and relaxed.

Author: McDoovy
Title: Excellent service and meals
Review: We stayed at Danna for a week and were were impressed by the breakfasts at the Planter's. The staff are happy to accommodate special requests, the food was very good and the setting is beautiful!

Author: joeymcbLaunceston, Australia
Title: Delightful Dinner Experience
Review: We weren't house guests but had read good reviews and decided to try this as our fine dining experience on Langkawi. The staff were extremely helpful and friendly both in the Verandah bar and later in The Planters restaurant. A very impressive gin collection had us smiling at the Verandah. We then moved to an outside table overlooking the beautiful infinity pool illuminated cleverly for the evening. The menu is extensive catering for many cultures. The four of us each had appetisers and mains and we were all very happy with our selections. Their wine list is quite reasonably priced and interestingly not as expensive as other venues in Pantai Cenang. We were so pleased to have taken the drive. It was a memorable evening. Show less

Author: katemillyjBathurst, Australia
Title: Warm ambience, great staff and huge variety
Review: You can dine at planters every night of your stay and still never, ever, ever get through the entire menu, it's huge! There is definitely something to suit all tastes, from traditional western cuisine, to Thai, Malay, Arabic and plenty more!The staff are wonderful and the ambience for evening dining is wonderful, the highlight for me is always the live piano music from an incredibly talented gentleman, it's worth it just for the atmosphere and the prices are extremely reasonable.Show less

Author: lmac102

Author: aphsanayasmin
Title: Arabian Grill and the best desserts!
Review: Beautiful food! Staff were amazing and so friendly. I cannot fault any of the restaurants at the Danna

Author: fred a

Author: sarahkudus

Author: jyoti_13

Author: Clairewest4

Author: bonhomieUkUK
Title: Elasticated clothing may be prudent....
Review: Dinner- We ate in Planters including the Friday B B Q 5 times during a 9 night stay and despite a pre-arranged move to another hotel on the island, we came back for our last night! Recommend the Pakistan/ Indian selection and as the title suggests, unless you have a very large appetite, good idea to share a starter - Boti Kebab is sublime.Inside or out, both table options are good, although inside, Emzac will be tickling the ivories for some great background music.Small observation, 1 night we tried the satay, husband no issue but I would have preferred the beef to have been a little more tender.All of the staff so gracious, polite and friendly. Special mention to Jasmani, so busy but still had time to chat with us.Quite unusual for us to eat 'in' so often so I guess that says it all....Yes, a definite recommend if you're staying at The Danna.Show less

Author: Beeteeyork

Author: GrandparentsGoGlobal

Review: Very romantic local cuisine inspired restaurant. Life piano music is played while you nibble away the complementary bread platter and chef's special in awaiting of your meals. Meals are delicious, fresh and nice on the eye. You dont need to wait long for the food to arrive. Best to book in advance to secure a table as the restaurant is quite popular. Local inspired dishes are very reasonable priced under 80 RM. Show less

Author: bloodyhotLowestoft, United Kingdom
Title: Food, glorious food !!!
Review: During our stay at The Danna , we had dinner on three evenings, the first being a Malaysian tasting platter, eight very tasty dishes , beef rendang, prawns, sea bass and chicken, spicy sauces and vegetables accompanied them. The second occasion we decided on the Chateaubriand , absolutely superb !!! Actually, our server complimented our meal by the way he plated up our meal from the lidded silver salver, pure class !! The final meal, lamb cutlets and tenderloin beef, so tasty, so tender, so good !!! For dessert, we challenged our server , Zulhilmi , to his very best Crepe Suzette, no problem at all, another perfect performance , they scored 11/10 !!! With breakfasts and afternoon tea, it was a 5 day foodathon, everything tip-top, Many thanks Ielah and the rest of the girls and boys, you were the best of all.Show less

Author: Emilie_K15Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Ok
Review: Starter of shredded chicken was nice. My husband had the spicy soup with king prawns. Soup was too spicy and boy stipulated on the menu as such. Service and setting was nice, it was a Saturday night and we had booked a table. For mains I had chicken tikka which was very chewy. Wasn’t impressed at all, my husband had the Australian grain fed tenderloin which he thought was nice. It’s expensive. Therefore I’d expect subliminal food and it wasn’t; hence the below average rating! Show less

Author: martjend4
Title: Excellent all round
Review: Delicious food with an extensive  choice of Asian and Western food and wines ,with  excellent service.

Author: Tautvydas MRamuciai, Lithuania
Title: It is the best one in The Danna
Review: Not easy to get in into it as very early booking needed and if You wish to dine outside book it 2 days in advance! Lovely interior , efficient staff and good food. My wife ordered red snapper and I sea bass Malasian style .Both were perfect. Long wine list is there as well. I was delighted to get olive oil for bread instead of butter ,like in Italy.Show less

Author: LilyAyresReading, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, excellent service
Review: We were very impressed by this restaurant. The menu was vast, excellent service and a lovely ambiance enhanced by the resident piano player. The restaurant is smart, but not pretentious. Good for families with children earlier in the evening,The menu consisted of asian and western food. Good choice of both. I would recommend the tuna.Best to book if you want particular table, but if you do not they will still accommodate you. The staff friendly and professional.Show less

Author: jenhl2018
Title: Great Food Great Service
Review: Excellent Breakfast and variety. We have our daily group lunch there, the food is simply fabulous! highly recommended this place

Author: Jen L
Title: Fantastic International cuisine
Review: On Day 1 we had The Northern Indian food, the curry was so yummy! On Day 2 it was international Buffet lunch, On Day 5 we had Thai cuisine , the Tom Yum Gong soup was excellent! Red and green curry were absolutely delicious

Author: HSeeingtheworldWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: First class food and attentive service from excellent staff
Review: We were staying at the Danna and breakfast is taken at Planters. Without doubt the best breakfasts we have had in Malaysia. There is Indian, Malay, Japanese and "American"Everything cooked to perfection! When the curry ( yes curry for breakfast) ran out I mentioned it to the chef who replaced it almost instantly. They also serve sparkling wine to add to the decadence!Last night we had dinner here. We both had the Malay platter which was beautifully presented and very tasty. It looked fairly meagre in 8 small dishes ( sea bass, prawns, chicken and beef Rendang, chilli sauce, cucumber and tomato, pickle and onion) but the portions were perfect. The wine was expensive, but you get used to that in Malaysia and it was goodThe staff, morning and evening were always smiling and helpful and eager to cater to your every need. No wonder this hotel has won the best hotel in Malaysia for 4 years!We will be trying something new at Planters before we leave.Show less

Author: Z186
Title: Amazing
Review: Every dish we tried was fantastic and impeccably presented. The menu is really varied so there is something for everyone!

Author: retiredjan
Title: Elegant surroundings and superb service
Review:
Could not find fault with this restaurant either from the elegance,  service, food or service.
Excellent breakfast choices served by smiling staff.

Author: TamutoscanaDeddington, United Kingdom
Title: A wonderful setting, perfectly reasonable food
Review: We decided to visit The Planter's Restaurant as it had been highly rated on Tripadvisor reviews. We booked an outside table, which turned out to be in an elegant pavilion overlooking the swimming pool with frangipani and the sea beyond. The setting and view were superb.The menu offered a choice of international and Malay cuisine. As we have spent a significant proportion of our lives in South East Asia, we obviously chose from the Malay dishes available to see whether the restaurant lived up to its reputation. We had soft-shelled crab for the first course, which was well prepared. For the main course, one of us had the Malay Platter; the other three kinds of Rendang, which is a kind of stew slow-cooked in coconut milk. Both were perfectly acceptable, but not exceptional. There are four or five restaurants elsewhere on Langkawi where these dishes are as good or better. If you decide to visit The Planter's Restaurant, it is sensible to try to book a table outside, as the indoor restaurant is cavernous and slightly gloomy with a fairly standard international décor. You could be forgiven for not knowing you were in Malaysia or indeed the tropics. We were idly wondering whether to give the restaurant another try, but were advised by the staff that, as we were not staying in the hotel, they could not guarantee us a table outside, as hotel guests had priority. That is fair enough. However, it is a strong reason not to bother to eat at The Planter's.Show less

Author: Michelle PWoking, United Kingdom
Title: Good food
Review: Had breakfast and dinner at this restaurant. The menu is massive and offers an excellent choice. The food is well cooked and presented and tasty. The staff are excellent and very friendly. The price is very reasonable and the outside tables lovely. Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: Jagir_Reehal
Title: Wonderful
Review: We had breakfast and dinner during our stay. The food is very tasty and the staff were amazing. We can't recall any instance where the food didn't exceed our expectations. Highly recommendedef!!

Author: cricketfan97
Title: Service woeful
Review:
Food was ok. Chicken tikka was complete fail. Boti kebab was ok. Veg curries were good. We only tried the Indian menu for dinner. The breakfast was nice. 

However, this restaurant completely fails on service. Serving staff are cold in their attitude and inattentive.

Author: CraigV169Perth, Australia
Title: Good food - Great Service
Review: This is the main restaurant at the Danna Hotel and it really is exceptional. The choice is huge and the quality of the food is perfect. I have tried a great many of the dishes over the times that we have stayed and have had a poor meal on any night.The staff are exceptional and very friendly and really seem to enjoy what they are doing. I would definitely eat here again.Show less

Author: Clive BCaloundra, Australia
Title: Amazing Food and Service
Review: Definitely worth a visit during your stay at the DannaMenu had many choices to suit all of our group of sevenThe service is second to noneDined here twice in the seven days we stayed here and the level of service never altered on both occasions Awesome gentleman playing the piano in the dining room made for great room ambience Lovely dining roomShow less

Author: MDE25
Title: Very good food and atmosphere
Review: This restaurant is serving both breakfast, lunch and dinner. You can sit in og outside. Both choices are fine.

Author: Terry AAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Great setting with 5 star food and servce
Review: Went for New Years Eve dinner, set up was outdoors in the garden, we were very impressed with the work that must have gone into setting up the location and facility, they did a fantastic job.The food selection, quality and service were all near perfect. Highly recommend this restaurantShow less

Author: 1x_2yz_3xyz
Title: Nr 2 behind "The Terrace"
Review:
The main restaurant of "The Danna"
Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Asian and European dishes
For dinner the lights are dimmered too much, you hardly can see your food

Author: satanbugAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Dinner at the Danna
Review: We saw the positive reviews so visited Planters for dinner. It's a nice restaurant in a very nice hotel and if you fancy a change and a bit of class then it's worth a visit. We had plenty to eat and drink and it was still excellent value. Enjoy......Show less

Author: elizabethwu2017Auckland, New Zealand
Title: By recommendation......
Review: We visited the Danna Hotel to book a table at the Planters based on Trip Adviser feedback. The hotel was very obliging and before we dined they allowed us to have a good look around, it appeared to be an excellent hotel. The restaurant itself is very “ fine dining “ in appearance and both the food and wine menus were of high quality. I had the cervice which was superb, the snapper which was great and a local banana milk for dessert, all very good. The total cost for two diners plus a few cocktails was around $ 150 NZ which is cheap in Kiwi world but I guess pretty expensive locally. My only reason for the 4 was that the staff, as they are all over Langkawi, were amazing on the surface but lacked any real knowledge of what they were serving which was a little frustrating. But other than that it’s definitely worth a visit. Enjoy.....Show less

Author: CJT02
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Brilliantly presented excellent food consistently outstanding.Eaten Malaysian food and everything is fabulous

Author: Loz-1988Sydney, Australia
Title: So Disappointed
Review: We stayed at the Danna for 4nights and decided to eat at Planter's after the ranking on TripAdvisor and glowing reviews. Unfortunately we had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant. For a restaurant that is categorised as a 'fine dining' establishment and ranked again in the top 3 in Langkawi, we certainly didn't have a fine dining experience. Staff lacked any and all training of the food and alcohol they were handing out and they navigated the English language with difficulty. For example, when we ordered the Lobster Bisque, the waiter served us and was about to leave when I asked him to tell me what was in it. He replied, "Lobster and soup". I pointed to the sauce that was in the bowl and asked him what that was, he said he'd check with the chef. He came back and said sour cream and I said what's the green leaves in the sour cream and he said it's just sour cream, nothing else (it was either chives or dill). The servers didn't bother to top up our wine glasses with the bottle of red on the table and only cleared our bisque dishes when they were serving our mains. Shame on the restaurant's management and exec chef for not taking the time to educate the servers on the dishes they're responsible to serve and advise guests on. On a positive note, the food was good but lacking. We were served a appetizer of chicken roullade which was incredibly dry. The Lobster Bisque was tasty and the Chateubriand was sensational except for the potato gratin which was overcooked and had an unpleasant after-taste.I suppose I wouldn't be as critical if the restaurant wasn't categorised as fine dining and ranked in the top 3 of Langkawi, but considering it is I am surprised that it is such a high ranking. If you want a truly 5 star experience try Kaya Putri in St Regis which we went to the night before which was truly world's better than Planter's.Show less

Author: rebeccakX3650KESydney, Australia
Title: Superb buffet, amazing service and beautiful venue!
Review: We are staying outside of The Danna and ventured that way to go to the cable cars. Being away from our family we wanted to treat ourselves to a nice dinner. It was approx $258R each + drinks. On our way to cable cart we booked in, they were apprehensive to let us book once we said we are from outside but I think this was to ensure there were enough tables for their guests inside the hotel. They confirmed it was okay after checking with management but if you’re going, I’d suggest calling and booking ahead of time to avoid disappointment. The buffet menu looked amazing but the actual food was next level awesome. As we arrived we were greeted by a beautiful set up of mini carts serving Christmas feast food like chicken, turkey, duck and lamb. There was an amazing Italian pasta bar where you select what you want to put in and two chefs serve and cook it fresh for you. On the left side there was bbq seafood and fresh seafood on the opposite side. Inside the layout was divine with beautiful Christmas crackers on the tables and just as we were getting seated the choir started singing Christmas songs. The enter table was immaculate with fruit carvings and fresh/cooked entrees. Further on there was salad bars and hot food, bread bars etc. My favourite section was the desert bar which was a WHOLE TABLE of delicious deserts, tarts, ice cream, macaroons, fruits. Finally the wine list is extensive and reasonably priced. Overall this was a fantastic experience and we will definitely be going back again next time we’re here. Show less

Author: SIF D
Title: Melting straight to the brain!
Review: Tried the beef tenderloin. The meat, the gravy, the mash and the sauce were just astonishing. Meat & Co may be wandering how to articulate a flavorful and honest taste of this meal. I have tried many of the award winning steakhouses, yet Planters can easily match them. Beautiful and exploding taste that has tickled my brain cells! 12 hours after the feast, my saliva is screaming for another massacre. I wish the chef can be mobilized all around the world so the rest of the human population may taste the art of fabulous food. A spectacular one indeed. Now I have to tame my unimaginable crave towards this meat. Very delighted that I've had the chance to enjoy this food. Kudos to the Chef and team. Definitely deserves the international recognition!Show less

Author: Jessica OMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: During our stay at The Danna Hotel, we ate in The Planters restaurant around 3 or 4 times. Their menu is split between Malaysian, Indian and Western food and we wanted to try a bit of everything! Every time we visited the restaurant, the food and service was fantastic. I would highly recommend the Beef Wellington for two, or the North Indian chicken curries.Show less

Author: Jaja B
Title: dinner
Review: foods serve are delicious. should try the local cuisine mee goreng mamak, spicy but tasteful, variety selection of mocktails to cater muslim guest. the premium Australian beef tenderloin is awesome!! cooked with preferred donning compliment with mouthwatering mashed potato and tasteful sauce. cosy ambience...

Author: brendanfoshLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great breakfast buffet
Review: Friendly waiters and a wide selection of local and western cuisine is what is most striking about The Planter's. The local Malay cuisine ranges and varies from beef rendang to chicken sombal and others - all very tasty. Also on the rotation is a noodle bar, fried breakfast, bread, cereal etc. In addition, they have a daily selection of omelets, eggs and pancakes that they can cook for you.Show less

Author: JuliekassPurley, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: We ate here the night we arrived at the Danna, fantastic three course meal on our half board basis.The Chateau Briande was so good, and served perfectly. Definitely worth a try.Breakfast was also served here and was sumptuous. Great variety of cuisine, no standing around at the egg station as it was brought to your table on request.Fabulous , attentive staff too.Show less

Author: Around917Orlando, Florida
Title: Simply fantastic food, every single time..... (Thanks Jass)
Review: We stayed at the Danna recently and dined at Planters almost every night. The food and service was simply amazing every single time. We simply could not find fault in anything. The staff were terrific, food was more than amazing. Diverse menu to boot. Really can't go wrong ... strongly recommend. Hopefully you get Jass as your waiter, he was amazing.Show less

Author: maria d
Title: beautiful restaurant
Review: the dinner was so tasty,and the view is just incredible, beautiful restaurant in a very beautiful hotel,and the staff so friendly and very professional,i will come back to try more dishes...in my next holiday to langkawie

Author: Yvette PBroome, Australia
Title: Fantastic curries
Review: We stayed for 6 nights and had breakfast here every morning and dinner 3 nights. The champange at breakfast was a treat, and the dinners were very good, the stand out for us were the curries. Staff are very attentive and you are well taken care of.Show less

Author: NeedToSeeItAllPerth, Australia
Title: Great breakfast and dinner
Review: We ate here daily for breakfast, and I found an excellent selection of various food and nice fresh juices. There was also a steady supply of champagne or mimosas which was welcome on a beautiful holiday. The dinner was delicious and very high quality food accompanied by excellent service and live piano music.Show less

Author: April498
Title: Food with a view
Review: Order the beef wellington, it was well worth it, very well cooked.  The chef and wait staff were fantastic in answering all the questions we had.  They also had a great selection of wine too.  We had 5 meals here and all were delicious!

Author: 440linenOdense, Denmark
Title: Ambience, quietness and excellence
Review: My girlfriend and I went for dinner, and I had mailed them prior for the reservation. We came early and enjoyed a drink in their very nice lounge.Everything was perfect! Including the food. We had their Arabic dishes, and the wait staff were very polite and made the evening very enjoyable and relaxing. We had the chocolate pudding for dessert - I would recommend to anyone! Oh - and by the way they're very nice as to guide which foods are glutenfree, it even says so in their extensive menu. A definitely must do in Langkawi if you enjoy a relaxing evening with live piano and mood lighting. Show less

Author: DonnaS957
Title: Excellent Venue
Review: The service was first class from the minute we arrived. Very attentive staff, setting was beautiful, meal was well presented and tasted fabulous.

Author: SamB1368Melbourne, Australia
Title: Spot on
Review: This place is delicious. We have the buffet breakfast every morning and it’s one of the best I’ve ever had. Spoilt for so much choice!!At night the place serves delicious Asian fusion and Western. I’m vego and had one of the Indian curries. It reminded me of being back in India. My wife had the ceviche and trio of Randang and loved it. Maybe a little spicy for her tastes. We are here for three more nights and will be eating there again!!Show less

Author: farahhussain_1
Title: Delicious
Review: Some if the best food in the island for sure. I had a prawn soup and had to go back a few times to eat it again it was truly wonderful

Author: davem427
Title: Eat with taste in style
Review: We where never disapppointed. There is great choice and the staff are extremely attentive and helpful. There is live entertainment and frankly there was never a need to look for alternatives outside the hotel

Author: Mikael KCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Excellent food
Review: Working as chef/ cook in my daily life I do appreciate good food being served, stainless service, clean glasses, starched and ironed linen. In an elegant sober setting, in good company, I really do not understand why people bother eating pizzas in the harbour for same price you get a more than a decent meal with a good choice of wines and beverages...Show less

Author: geraldy3o
Title: Good breakfast spread
Review: They offer a wide variety of food and thr local options are not bad. They also have impeccable service as well.

Author: Moskito_manLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good Choice
Review: As we were staying at The Danna this is the premier restaurant in the hotel. Food is good but inconsistent in presentation.At dinner in Planters the same meal was served different each time it was ordered. For example was the Arabian mixed grill which came with lamb cutlets one day and then with a rack of lamb the next. Both meals were still tasty. Service levels also seemed to drop at busy times but as we were on holiday it was not a big issue. Would recommend most dishes of the menu as we were a party of 4 staying the week so experienced most of them.Show less

Author: veggielover18
Title: TOP notch restaurant at Danna
Review:
Good food excellent service and very attentive staff.
Hats off to Quistina, Salleh siyafina and Chef Jasveer.

Author: 1NONLYSurrey, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic breakfast selection
Review: The Plantars restaurant at the Danna Hotel serves an eclectic varied breakfast buffet which caters for all tastes. The buffet is beautifully laid out and the live piano music is so soothing amidst the colonial setting. Chandeliers on high ceilings create a great expanse of space and the ambience is suitably restful and relaxing in the air conditioned room.Staff are very attentive without being obstructive and service is impeccable.Fizz is on ice should one decide to have a champers breakfast.From local cuisines ( Nasi Lemak , Chinese noodles , roti chanai or paratha and curries and dim sums ) to continental croissants and salmon and cheeses or eggs to order e.g eggs Benedict, one does not go hungry !Many thanks to all the staff for a wonderful holiday and the exquisite pleasure of dining here for breakfasts.Show less

Author: ruwaypink
Title: Lovely breakfast if your are staying at the Hotel
Review:
nice selection of made to order breakfast dishes (eggs, pancakes, waffles) and other local delights that were pretty authentic. 
wonderful pastries provided and sparking wine for those who fancy that in the mornings.  
lovely live pianist at breakfast time made it very special.

Author: adele m
Title: Awesome breakfast buffet spread
Review: Definitely not to be missed ! Well worth the money. Made to order items - pancakes , omelette, Belgian waffles were delish. A good selection of fresh breads n free flowing champagne awaits.

Author: Brian J
Title: Huge menu with options for all tastes
Review: This restaurant has a huge menu that has something for everyone. The presentation of meals is impeccable and the staff are second to none. The buffet breakfast is also great with the option to order a freshly prepared addition to your buffet each morning like an omelette with your choice of fillings, or waffles etc. There is often live piano music played by a very talented gentleman that adds to the luxurious ambience.Show less

Author: BDCondellVilamoura, Portugal
Title: Superb International Cuisine
Review: Planters is on a grand scale with its colonial decor and al fresco poolside dining. The menu is truly international with many interesting dishes you won't find elsewhere. The drinks menu is extensive and varied.If you go there for breakfast you will find a buffet with nothing missing and many things included you would never even consider. Every taste and culture is catered for here.Excellent!Show less

Author: Uliana_sh
Title: Great place to enjoy the food and atmosphere
Review:
I have been here few times, and must say i like it.
they have a good choice on different food, the quality and sizes are nothing to complain about. and its yummy!
nice atmosphere! 
definitely recommended!

Author: skrblik2016Prague, Czech Republic
Title: Great experience
Review: We had a few breakfasts in this restaurant. You can have all you can imegine and much more. Especialy I loved eggs "Rancheros", just perfect like all others. We always spent much more time than planned and drank much more sparkling wine than wanted :-). Very good coofee, what is not ussual even in very good hotels. We enjoyed a grill party outside as well. What to say, just perfect, excellent, fresh and well prepared.Show less

Author: champagnepackers
Title: Excellent
Review: Fantastic well balanced menu with vegetarian and gluten free options clearly marked. Caters for all nationalities and has delightful staff

Author: Eimear N
Title: Fabulous food during our stay at luxurious Danna Hotel
Review: Absolutely amazing food at this restaurant, we ate here for breakfast and dinner numerous nights during our stay, the food is out of this world!!

Author: Zanzibarian
Title: First class food
Review:
We ate at The Planters the first night we stayed at The Danna. The food was amazing and the service matched it. 

The waiters were very attentive and the food was well cooked and excellently presented. 

It's upmarket, but worth the treat!

Author: travellingbackpack
Title: Value of money
Review: For the quality of food and ambience, it was definitely value for money. Do have a meal or two if you are staying at The Danna.

Author: HockLyeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Noodle soup
Review: The best part of the breakfast. I had for 2 breakfast. Others were OK. The first cappuccino took some time to come but the following ones were timely, warm and just nice. The best part was to able to order your eggs the way to like it at your table without having to queue for it. You could also have your breakfast as early as 6.30AM in the morning, in time for your early morning flight out of the country. We had dinner once here. The live piano recital of 70s hits together with the colonial charm and service of the restaurant made up a nice dinner. The menu has a wide selection of dishes from east to middle to the west. I could eat here for many more nights without running out of choices. Dinner was followed by a couple of room service that didn't fail us too.Show less

Author: richgarden
Title: Tasty Food
Review:
celebrating our 40th Wedding Anniversay at the Planters and had a lovely time .
Food was very tasty and enjoined every dish that we ordered.
service was second to none .

Author: vburneikisForresters Beach, Australia
Title: Top quality in luxurious surrounds
Review: As soon as we walked in I could tell it was going to be a great meal! The opulence of the Danna with its high ceilings, manicured garden and huge pool, and the polished service from before we even got through the door tell you this is a different class of establishment. Luckily the food lived up to expectations- favourites were the beef rendang and the salad accompanying the chicken percik which was practically a meal in itself. Deserts were also delicious (we stuck to the western style ones), the only miss was veg spring rolls, with an odd mix of vegetables and too much pastry. Oh, and there's a basic kids menu - apparently macaroni with tomato sauce was ok too! It's not cheap, but the whole experience felt expensive and it's one we'll remember.Show less

Author: FANOOR
Title: Breakfast and dinner at Danna
