Review: Good selection, mix Asian / western / Mid eastern cuisine. Service good, seats outside nice for small kids with fish ponds around. Overall food quality good but can be pricey.

Author: OnlyLuxury
Title: Delicious Breakfast attentive staff
Review: Loved Breakfast here, so much to choose from and suitable for all different ethnicities! Would be coming back for dinner so will review again

Author: RiiiShaaaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great for Breakfast, but Vegetarians won't be happy with dinner.
Review: For breakfast, this restaurant is amazing. So much choice, quick service despite high demand, friendly staff and really good quality food meant that breakfast was a really high point for us - loved it! However, as a vegetarian, the dinner is severely limited - only a couple of options for each of starters and mains, which was really restrictive. Would definitely have breakfast here again, but not dinner - the other restaurants in the Danna are much better choices for vegetarians, but hopefully this is improved going forward in the future!Show less

Author: RamakanthA1
Title: Great Breakfast
Review: we had breakfast a couple of times at the restaurant. There is a wide selection of Asian and continental dishes on the buffet but the key difference is the service and the addition of made to order menu. Don't forget to try the kaya and bananas jams. The attention we received from the wait staff was extraordinaryShow less

Author: BBMC78
Title: Great breakfast!
Review:
We have enjoyed breakfast, different menu a la carte plus buffet everyday! Great service offered by the waiters. 
Overall, great restaurant!

Author: ruoxuan
Title: Awesome spread breakfast
Review: They have a super awesome selection of breakfast as well as excellent service provided to us. Missing the cheese omelette already.

Author: EmDani
Title: Banquet
Review:
Excellent food really really delicious but no roti!!!! We enjoyed the Malay banquet and found it absolutely delicious- excellent honey chicken and rendang 
Very enjoyable

Author: BK_Shanghai
Title: Excellent breakfast selection
Review: We've been staying there for a week and breakfast is great. Freshly brewed coffees and specialties, long daily changing egg menue, sparkling wine, plenty of breads and pastries..

Author: Mckennie
Title: Breakfast 100%... dinner not so much
Review: We came to the Danna for a family vacation and couldn't get enough of the breakfast. there were so many options you could spend hours. All the coffee was made to order and brought out quickly. We decided to book for dinner based on the fantastic experience we had at breakfast. It didn't excite me. One of the curry dishes was too salty to eat and we aren't picky eaters. We actually didnt even end up finishing the meal. hoping it was an one off mistake as the other reviews are great.Show less

Author: Charissa PMalaysia
Title: Good breakfast spread.
Review: Breakfast at Danna is one of its kind. Being spoilt for choices and its food quality, this is really an awesome place to have all of your . Each and every of their restaurants serves good quality food despite the price. We are willing to pay because they render their service with smile and respect. They are polite and attentive. Really love the team at Danna. I hope the management will reward them well and treat them like a prize employee!they deserve it!Well done!Show less

Author: RedWineDivineWest Midlands, England
Title: Best fine dining on Langkawi
Review: We recently stayed on Langkawi for 14 nights and ate at this amazing restaurant 3 times during our stay. We were staying at another hotel but had read about the Danna Hotel and Planters restaurant, prior to our arrival. We loved the ambience of this place,it had a feeling of old world glamour in a beautiful colonial style building. As we entered the dining room, there was a pianist playing and it really set the tone for what was a perfect dining experience. The staff were attentive but not intrusive and also ensured our 9 year old daughter was catered for - as she is a little fussy and often we made slight changes to the menu items. On our first visit, I ordered the caesar Salad, which is the best I have ever had and my Husband chose the pumpkin and sweet potato soup, which was served in a teapot and was delicious!For the main meal my husband and daughter ordered the Chauteubriand, which was served and carved at the table with a freshly made side salad, beautiful sauces to accompany the steak and all the vegetables cooked to perfection. I ordered the Murgh Makhni Indian Chicken curry which came with an array of side dishes and was absolutely divine and authentic. For dessert I ordered the Crepe Suzette which was expertly flambéed at the table and again the best I have tasted. We have travelled around the world and eaten in many 5 star restaurants and this would rival the best. As a result we dined there a further 2 times. As it was the Easter period, all of the hotels were at peak capacity and therefore it was often difficult to secure a reservation.We cannot recommend this restaurant enough and will be sure to dine again on our next visit to Langkawi,It's true that you can eat cheaply at some great restaurants on Langkawi and Planters is certainly at the high-end in terms of cost but actually it was so exceptional that we never even questioned the cost and on reflection felt it was good value when considering the quality and service experienced.Show less

Author: YCT50
Title: What? It's my fault to order the lamp rump ?
Review: Expected a 5 star service especially during low peak season with only about only 6 tables being served but service was bad, all the way with the regular waitress, supervisor and even the manager.It all started with the lamp rump when the waitress wrongly took my order as lamb rack. As a English graduate myself, the local waitress wrongly took my order. When she questioned me (before the order arrived) if I ordered the rack I said no, it's rump. She got nervous and asked supervisor to come and question me. Supervisor questioned if waitress repeated my order I said no. She didn't believe and insisted waitress did and I said second time no. After that she got no choice but to change the order.At end of meal manager came to talk and insisted it was a misunderstanding.That's when I felt all staff are so much of a one team thing and nobody realise it's their own error, that I have to take this to public channel. I will return if they keep the chef but the service team is gone! U know what I me an !Show less

Author: 43cliffg
Title: Holiday
Review: Planters offers an exceptional menu for breakfast and dinner.   World class cuisine and service.   Fabulous wine list.

Author: Wbleeker
Title: Delicious dinner with good food and service
Review: Had some delicious food after a long journey. They serve you very well and you can sit outside next to the see. To much choice for food. I can recommend to pick something and enjoy. Take your time and enjoy the food and atmosphere.

Author: RegH265Thame, United Kingdom
Title: Malaysian Fine Dining
Review: During our trip to Langkawi we were more than happy to eat locally, but due to the recent reviews we decided to take a trip out to the Danna and see if it was worth booking one evening. On arrival (considering we arrived via moped) we were greeted warmly and shown around the various bars and restaurants, shown menus and treated as if we were guests, so we booked that night to come back.It is obvious that they have made this hotel very unique and stylish, with all the refinements to go with, great attention to detail throughout.Once again on arrival we were made to feel very welcome (arrived via taxi!), shown to the small outside bar for cocktails, before being shown to our table.The wine list is immense and reasonably priced, the menu prices likewise are comfortable considering this is high end.We finally opted for the Malay Tiffin tasting menu, to get the fine dining experience of what we normally ate locally.To be honest the food was faultless, the service impeccable and for around 450 ringgits we had a great evening, exceptional.Show less

Author: Sebastian SMelbourne, Australia
Title: "Silver Service all the Way"
Review: Staying in Langkawi for 8 days, we always like to try local street places during the day and at night we like to treat ourselves to some fine dining. Well this place is a gem.From the moment we arrived at The Danna, we were shown around like royalty. The Concierge showed us around the hotel before finally taking us to the restaurant called "The Planters". The restaurant looks magnificent, but the menu for the restaurant had to reflect the ambience of the place and it certainly did. We chose to eat al fresco rather than indoors. As my wife needs to eat gluten free, the menu had so many gluten free options which showed us that this restaurant is in touch with all patrons and guests. We had a three course meal with coffee and wine and left fully satisfied. The food was cooked to perfection and service was impeccable(especially Jass our waiter). We loved it so much that we returned 2 days later and the service was as good as the first time around. Great place to eat and pricing was pretty good too.No hesitation in recommending this as the best restaurant in Langkawi hands down.Show less

Author: TravelwithGarIreland
Title: Wide food choices at Planter's & great service
Review: Had a couple of evenings at Planter's for dinner during our recent stay in Langkawi. You have the option of indoor seating (complete with AirCon) or outdoors cabana style. Personally the outside works better for me & hard to beat dining al fresco - though it can clearly be on the warm side.Planter's offers a wide range of foods with something for everyone's palate. The chateaubriand is particularly good, albeit the accompanying sides did not do sufficient justice to the beef. You can also try a selection of Malaysian foods, well presented or a simple tasty pasta dish.The service is always friendly, genuine and efficient. Pretty good at remembering faces too!Planter's has an excellent wine selection which you can enjoy with your meal.Overall our experiences at Planter's were very positive and enjoyable. Happy to recommend it and well worth the visit out to Pantai Kok and far enough away from the heavy traffic and heat that is Cenang. For after dinner drinks it is worth visiting the Verandah where they have live music & super cocktails.Show less

Author: C7628XPrichardp
Title: 5* Service
Review: Excellent restaurant, probably the best on the island although a little reticent about allowing non-hotel guests to dine.

Author: Narcissus666Williton, United Kingdom
Title: Elegant, stylish and consistently fabulous restaurant
Review: If you are visiting Langkawi and you want to experience fine dining at its very best you need go no further than Planter's at the Danna. From the moment you are welcomed to your table the dining experience is faultless. The stylish interior which accomodates solo diners, honeymooners and families alike in a harmonious way which suits everyone's requirements makes for a lovely, relaxed and intimate dining experience. The piano player who performs several sets a night is an absolute star. This is free form salon piano playing as good as I have ever heard. The service is warm, friendly and attentive. No obsequiousness here just genuine charm and poise but with a huge helping of efficiency. The amuse bouche, which come courtesy of the chef are enchanting and whether you choose the european or asian fusion menu you will not be diappointed. Everything is beautifully prepared and presented, starters, mains and mouthwatering desserts and cheeseboard. The menu and wine list are extensive and cater for all tastes, after staying a whole month at the Danna and eating in the restaurant every other night I still didnt manage to complete this exotic and enticing menu. Haute cuisine at its very best. The lovely manageress Ms Qistina Awang runs a very tight ship, with dignity, efficiency and an ever present lovely smile and humble demeanour. There is not one member of the staff that I could faul or say anything about except offer praise of the highest order. Whether you want to sit inside in the lovely air conditioned main restaurant room or want to dine al fresco in a private cabana you will be delighted with your dining experience. There really is no finer restaurant in Malaysia.Show less

Author: Fazil I
Title: Beautiful ambiance and classy
Review:
The restaurant breakfast was nicely spread with beautiful choices of food...the chefs very friendly and even serves you...the sweet smiling staff was always there to serve you...
Dinner was also brilliantly served and the food was superb. Thumbs up..

Author: jodieh01
Title: Delicious dinners!
Review: We ate here for 2 evenings of our stay and both nights the food was great! Very spicy rending on night 1 and duck curry. And on the second night we had a northern indian dinner for two. All very yummy!

Author: sydneyshutterbug
Title: Malaya Tiffin Box
Review: Order it! Yum = TripAdvisor won't accept those few words so I'm just filling in space to reach 100 characters!

Author: wing_wingggg
Title: Impressive dinner
Review: We had a very nice dinner here on our final night at the Danna.  Great selection of foods and just as importantly a solid selection of wines.

Author: Camilla P
Title: They won't let you book in advance, but just turn up - the food is amazing!
Review: Lovely hotel with great food, we loved our experience of eating here and perfect for our last evening. Our hotel wouldn't let us book here but they accommodated 7 of us on the door (out of peak season though!)

Author: Inspired_philSintra, Portugal
Title: Delicious food in a stunning location
Review: We enjoyed a delightful meal outside the restaurant overlooking the pool and beach.The service is delightful and attentive. The curries were both spicy and well seasoned. Both were tasty and in rich gravies.The restaurant cater well for children (shame the only menu options were Western) but all choices went down well with our son.The home made kaffir lime sorbet was sheer, citrus delight!Show less

Author: Laszlo R
Title: Tasty food and nice vibe
Review: We liked the table overlooking the pool and Bay. Staff were really friendly and our Son was even given some bread to feed the fish. Had a good mango and papaya salad and an overall good lunch experience.

Author: R9708YCchriswTorquay, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, wonderful service, delicious food.
Review: We have stayed at The Danna previously but unfortunately did not get the opportunity to dine in Planters Restaurant. On this occasion we booked asking for a table outside, which in itself was just perfect. The location can only be described as stunning, the staff are very attentive but also allow you space to enjoy the experience. The food was cooked to perfection and served with style. As a couple we are used to fine dining and often frequent Michelin star restaurants. We add this only to put into context that dining in Planters Restaurant is as good as it gets. We will book to eat again in this beautiful place before we leave.Show less

Author: 223mattsPrinceton, New Jersey
Title: Exquisite dining, personalized service and accommodation for vegans
Review: The experience we had at the main restaurant at the Danna was so good that we did not eat anywhere else during our stay. Since my wife and I are both vegan and eat a mostly whole food diet (little/no oil, low-salt, whole grains, etc.) each night the chef would personally prepare custom dishes. They had no problem with us deconstructing the menu to come up with our own or some nights we told them what we liked and they created masterful and delicious plates. I would not want to eat anywhere else on the Island other than at the Danna.Show less

Author: paulchapSwansea, United Kingdom
Title: Great food fabulous tastes and presentation
Review: We stayed in the Danna where the Planter restaurant is based so we eat there several times during our stay, great choice of food and drink and excellent service by all the staff. Marilyn and I tried several local dishes, their Rendang curry was delicious as was everything we ate on our stay. Good place to try if you are stating in the north west area of Langkawi. Try and I hope you enjoy. Show less

Author: 945waleedh
Title: Tasty
Review: We had dinner there and we tried pasta and sea food noodles and both were delicious. The music and the lights were good match for the place.

Author: KatjaP644
Title: Exellent
Review: Exellent food, good service and beautiful restaurang. It's quite expensive but it's worth every pennyes.

Author: gypsy_janeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: We decided to try The Planters as we were staying at The Danna. Large menu to choose from including appetizer, grill, Malaysian, Western, pizza and pasta. My husband and I shared our meal which included two entrees and a main. We selected spring rolls, laksa and chicken tikka. Presentation and taste five star at its best. Portion size excellent and enough for us to feel satisfied. Cost roughly AUD$75 which included water and two glasses of wine. Give Planters a go. You won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: LovDac
Title: Wonderful food... Great service
Review:
This restaurant is 5 star dining in any country. 
Beautiful atmosphere and fantastic food. 

The staff are attentive. Food is remarkable 
A must dine if you are visiting Langkawi.

Author: atiejay j
Title: A tasty spread of buffet!
Review: The restaurant is one of the best places in the hotel for you not only to dine but also to watch the sunset or to chill! The food served during breakfast is excellent, in terms of presentation, colours and taste. The price is affordable too!

Author: Anne MPerth, Australia
Title: Lovely atmosphere
Review: Buffet breakfast here every morning, was a luxurious was to start the day. Dinner was also a very pleasant experience. Table are not too close together and wait staff are most attentive. Food was of superior quality with out the high price tag. Was probably expensive for Malaysia but on a par with a good Australia restaurant.Show less

Author: G9407GHpeterr
Title: Quality dining in lovely surroundings.
Review: This is a top quality restaurant located at the beautiful Danna Langkawi hotel offering good food at affordable prices for saying that it is in a 5 star luxury hotel. Excellent service by friendly staff. Highly recommended.

Author: Olive M
Title: Very nice.
Review:
We had breakfast here every morning of our stay. Champagne flows freely. There are a wide variety of food options, Malaysian Chinese and European.
Great staff.

Author: Amreeta V
Title: Just for dinner & it was amazing!
Review: My husband & I were staying at the Berjaya were the food wasn't great so we ventured to the Danna for dinner on our last evening in Langkawi.The food was absolutely delicious & the service was amazing!! Not too pricey either! Would definitely recommend dinner at The Danna!Show less

Author: suexplorestheworldZurich, Switzerland
Title: Delicious Malaysian dinner
Review: The Danna's main restaurant The Planter's serves a rich choice of Malaysian dishes of high quality. The food tasted extremely good and the outdoor tables facing the pool offer a perfect setting to enjoy a wonderful evening under the stars. The waiters were friendly and attentive.My conclusion: it is a must to have dinner at The Planter's.Show less

Author: Geht_net_gibts_net
Title: Like invitation by best friends, who are best cooks
Review: Very, very good food!!! Even if you do not stay in this (fabulous) Hotel, you should eat there. You can choose between Indian, Asian - including rendang, which I love - and International dishes.  Service is very nice. They must have fantastic management

Author: Wilky62
Title: PLANTERS
Review: Food of the highest quality, extensive choice, wonderful service in a beautiful colonial setting, Incredible Chefs

Author: darnrightdirty
Title: Amazing!
Review: Totally amazing, never tasted food so good. Stayed in the hotel for a few nights and ate here twice. It really is amazing. Even the bread was the best!

Author: 277MimiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Deliciousness at The Danna
Review: After two mediocre meals at The Berjaya I was delighted to discover the Planters Restaurant at The Danna. The menu had a good range of western, Asian and fusion cuisine. The chicken gyozu and trio of rendang stood out and I was sad not to be staying longer so I could try other items on the menu.There is a great wine list and the service is superb.Show less

Author: omranm2015
Title: Great food , lovely atmosphere , Wonderful staff
Review:
Delicious food , wide variety from Asian , International or Indian kitchens.
We were provided with an outdoor table well decorated with candles and roses for a romantic dinner.
Excellent service.

Author: andrewhA3698BUPlymouth, England, United Kingdom
Title: Fuad and his team are simply the best
Review: Fuad Arasu, kartik and everyone in their teams just couldn't do enough for us. The food was delicious, varied and plentiful. The setting so great whether it be indoors where it is nice and cool or outdoors overlooking the pool and the ocean. We just loved it and we love them. Thank you. We will be back xxx Show less

Author: futureacidmouse
Title: Excellent service, delicious food.
Review: As per title! Cannot fault. Every dish we tried was fantastic. Service was outstanding they could not be more polite or willing to help.

Author: ElandieIM
Title: Food to cater for all taste preferences
Review:
We had breakfast here in the mornings and dinner twice. The food was great! Breakfast buffet catered for all without giving an impression of mass catering.
Dinner came with some bread and an amuse bouche, was wonderful.

Author: erdespam
Title: So-so
Review:
Don't eat the italian food...really bad. Go for asian or indian mains and you will be more than happy. Service is very polite. Ambiance luxurious bit not pretentious, nobody cared if you walk in with shorts.
Relaxed food at a reasonnable price!

Author: Life_40Emirate of Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Dinner date on the Island
Review: Our first night, it was raining so we decided to have our dinner at the Planters. Loved the ambiance and the live music; the only thing missing was the voice of Nat King Cole :)However, the menu book is too big and there is too much to read, I'd fall asleep. Since it is a fine dining restaurant I am a bit disappointed that no one even came to explain the menu to us or even offered us to try the signature dish of the restaurant. Our experience was nothing of remarkable except for the Spanish White Wine (SB)Second time to have dinner, we had duck and lamb chops, which is really good!!!Show less

Author: Sumeyye C
Title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
Review: Absolutely amazing food and service! We loved it!! Delicious food. Variety of flavours. Desert amazing. Friendly. Family orientated. High quality. Beautiful building. View the pools and beach, just amazing

Author: The80sTravellersKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great selection of food and atmosphere
Review: Warm staff, great atmosphere and just a lovely restaurant- the high ceilings and mood lighting add to the enjoyable dining experience. Reasonable prices for delicious food, although there is a large selection on the menu each item we ordered was just as good as we expected. I would recommend the mushroom soup, lobster risotto and butter chicken. The desserts are delicately made and the right portion after a big meal. The breakfast is also served here with a good spread for the buffet and give you the option for ordering off a menu. Show less

Author: mamariza
Title: Ramos family
Review: Excellent pool and beachside service and a wide selection of food and drinks! All delicious!! They also had a Happy hour time which was just perfect by the pool at sunset :))))

Author: ahmedadel2
Title: Very classy
Review: Very classy .. yummy food, nice furniture .. very lovely polite staff .. a nice complement for the hotel

Author: budgy26Adelaide, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: We were staying at The Danna and found The Planter's incredibly wonderful. High ceiling with chandeliers; high and huge windows - where natural light streaming tnrough - framed the swimming pool and the view of the bay. Breakfast is served here where we have the buffet plus the ala carte choices of eggs /pancakes/ waffles. There are plenty choices for everyone from smoked salmon to local dishes. The staff is amazing: not only professional ,but very attentive and friendly. Special mentioned to Pak Fuad who welcomes everyone and helped us with old bread to feed the fish. Qistina and many more frendly staff. Guess what ? Breakfast at The Planter's come with champagne; however, I would love to see a fresh fruit juice station added and a couple more of cereal options.Dinner at The Planters is a great experience with high gourmet details and taste. Beef Wellington ; chateubriand ; the cod dish is utterly delicious. There are choices of bottles of wine or glasses of wine. We have had dinner three times here and average MYR 400 for three of us. We love the bread baskets with dukkah the starter on a cute plate of poached salmon on a slice of cucumber layered with ratatouli. Last but not least the Planter's has piano at the background which add great ambience after all. Do make reservation. Show less

Author: 964MichaelT964
Title: Great choice on menu
Review:
Comfortable restaurant with attentive service.Menue caters for all tastes .Had the Austrailian beef and lamb on seperate occasions.
Wine list good but expensive (Malaysian Tax?)

Author: Meekymo
Title: Pleasing
Review: We dined here twice, delish food of a high standard, great menu with varied prices. We were more than happy with our dining experience here.

Author: StoneBarn64United Kingdom
Title: Superb food and service
Review: Great breakfast and dinner here at the Danny's main restaurant. Nice menu, choice of sitting indoors or out. Good mix of Malay and Indian food as well as international choices. The staff were lovely. Great quality of service, charming yet personable and really friendly. All the staff were happy here and it shows. Well done to the F&B manager, Michael, for running a great operation.Show less

Author: Muhammad_Mursyidi
Title: Excellent service
Review: Good spread of breakfast buffet and a cosy ambiance. Its best to sit inside for now as there are constructions going on beside the outdoor dining area.

Author: sumana K
Title: Mr&Mrs
Review: Great for breakfast. Amazing interior. They really kept a close eye on little details. It's modern but but at the same time has a royal English charm

Author: tilis1011Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Great food!
Review: We stayed at this hotel during our stay for the Ironman triathlon. The food at this hotel restaurant was top notch. I didn't have one bad meal while there. They catered to any special requests we had and really made our dining experience enjoyable.Show less

Author: mtvgb
Title: Good food with excellent service.
Review: We had been advised that the food was not that great but we ate very well with some much better than average choices such as the Malay tiffin choice. They are opening a new Italian soon that looked to be good but a bit pricey.

Author: Harrison p
Title: Great meal in one of favourite hotels
Review: Fantastic meal with a nice atmosphere , staff went out of their way to make our evening special . Had the chateaubriand which was cooked to perfection and was cut table side by a very friendly waiter

Author: budinn2015
Title: Authentically Local
Review: Try the tiffin style lunch packed with local dishes or tea with scones and cream ! If you want to try something different... ask for Earl Grey's Teh Tarik... !

Author: firieguyVictoria, Australia
Title: Unbelievable quality at very affordable prices
Review: This restaurant is unbelievable. The service can't be surpassed. They are simply excellent. And the food.... Wow. This is a must for guests at the hotel and those who aren't. It's pricier by Langkawi standards but cheap by Australian standards. Some Aussie restaurants could do to take a leaf out of this restaurants book.Show less

Author: 331kiyam
Title: Beautiful!
Review: Stayed at the danna 10 nights ate here 8/10 as we felt we had to explore a little and both nights we wished wed gone to the planters! Im one to normally go away from my hotel in the evening but everything was perfect here from wine and cocktails to the huge menu and quality of food. The staff make this hotel they are incredible thanks again:)Show less

Author: Nikki M
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Beautiful restaurant, great service with a very comprehensive menu. Excellent buffet breakfast  with a good selection of local and European cuisine.  Enjoyed the amazing pianist!!

Author: BillyA1966
Title: Lovely Location, greta staff and drinks
Review: We visited Planters every day for happy hour between 5 and 7. Lovely drinks and friendly staff, good location and setting.

Author: Mads_KiddHertfordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, impeccable service
Review: We stayed at the hotel for our honeymoon and following reviews wanted to try out the restaurant. The Planter's was as previously stated - the service was excellent and food was lovely. We tried some of the Malaysian dishes and waiters could recommend dishes and drinks very well. We also had breakfast here in the mornings which was the best we have had! A great selection and prosecco provided alongside a piano player and very friendly staffShow less

Author: mohsens115Beaumont Hills, Australia
Title: Mr Mohsen Shahbake
Review: Their restaurant "Planters", served beautiful food that had a very versatile menu both with modern food and traditional Asian and Indian food. They also catered to kids with a delicious menu that my children loved. They also had extremely friendly and professional staff. We felt like part of The Dana family by all the staff but in particular Hafiz, Fouad and Rose from the pool staff. We highly recommend The Dana to anyone who is looking for an amazing unforgettable luxurious holiday in Lang Kawi. My family and I will always remember this special holiday and appreciate what everyone at The Dana did to make it so unforgettable. We will definitely be back at The Dana again very soon. We give this place a 10 out of 10.The Shahbake Family Show less

Author: Clare L
Title: Al fresco dining
Review: Had a lovely dinner with family on balcony outside Plantars overlooking infinity pool and beach beyond. Tasty food with good service, mosquito repeller candles on table.

Author: Shabarna M
Title: Was a lovely experience
Review: Was a lovely experience had had a great time with family and the food was excellent the restaurant manager was very was warm and polite and stopped at our table every time to inquire about how we are enjoying our meal

Author: Bon444Dorchester, United Kingdom
Title: Extensive Menu of Local and INternational Dishes
Review: I've said some of this I my review of The Danna Hotel itself but, in case you're only looking to eat here rather than stay at the hotel, thought I'd review it here too. The menu choice for evening meals is wide ranging and every single meal we ate was delicious. The quality and range of both local and international dishes from which you can choose your dinner is extensive. Once you had ordered they bring a selection of bread with oil and an amuse bouche. I have never eaten lobster or Wagyu beef at any other holiday hotel before and both were delicious! I lived in Malaysia years ago and could not fault the trio of rendang - as good as I remembered this being and, if you like curry, please try it, I don’t think you’ll be disappointed. Other things that add to mealtimes are the resident pianist playing the grand piano, the friendly and professional waiters and the restaurant manager - she’s very good at her job and absolutely charming..Show less

Author: Tamoor
Title: Atmosphere and style. Perfect for the tourist taste buds
Review: We had a very nice dinner here a few days ago. The service is impecable with ao many smiles and thank you's. we tried the chicken gyoza and chicken soup for starters. Both were amazing! for mains we both went for a malay tasting platter style dishes. I thought this would give me a taste of the region but I didn't feel the flavours present instead I thought they had been tailored for the visiting tourists. I guess thats good restaurant to do that but I felt a bit let down. For Desert, The banana friters..not my best ever as its was literally a while banana vs. sliced sideways (probably just my preference). My partner had the pancake which was absolutely delicious! Great restaurant and team overall.Show less

Author: MrsMomTravels
Title: Yummeh The Planter's @ The Danna
Review: Excellent service from the servers. Detailed in serving. Food are delicious. Atmoshpere romantic for dinner. Breakfast was good too.

Author: U5409MDandrewcSydney, Australia
Title: Big portions for dinner, big choice for breakfast
Review: This restaurant at the Danna is very solid even if the menu prices are a lot higher compared to Kuala Lumpur. However, the portions are big and the quality is high. The furnishing, candles, view of the beach and pool and high ceilings make this place special. This is an excellent facility of the hotel. Show less

Author: Nick SGold Coast, Australia
Title: Exceptional Restaurant
Review: As mentioned in my main review of The Danna, the Planter's is an fantastic restaurant with 5 star food and a beautiful ambience. Personal recommendation of the Murgh Makani.Show less

Author: denniss941
Title: The Danna restaurant
Review:
Good food and very nice staff. They offer a very diversified menu from western to Asian. 
The breakfast is buffet style and offers everything you can wish for.

Author: granitavGosford, Australia
Title: Hard to beat this one
Review: After Indian and Dubai hotel restaurants, this must be the next.No wonder the hotel itself sits at number 20 in the world and The Planters restaurant there must be one of the main reasons. Situated at the back of the hotel overlooking the harbour and the huge pool, you are greeted every morning as you arrive for breakfast by friendly and smiling staff and often by the Food and Beverage catering Manager in person who has no problem showing you to your table when they are busy. A piano is playing softly to your right manned by a great friendly and most talented Emzac though his actual name is Muzafri Mansur who will gladly play your favourites, as he did for us, even though no music to read. He seemed to know them all and we were informed he is also the pianist to the King who has aq interest in the hotel.. There is a fabulous hot and cold buffet in front of you with every imagined breakfast dish available and catering for all cultures. They also provided Vegemite for anyone asking though some found it a bit difficult to like. Aussies were delighted. Each morning a different specials egg menu.is given to you and you can order as you wish whilst enjoying all the other dishes from the buffet.Apart from all the other juices and beverages at the buffet champagne is brought to you either straight (my favourite) or with orange juice. They keep refilling you without any problem. Coffee is ordered as you prefer including using Soya milk and it is a superb Arabica blend. Double espressos really go down well especially as you are quaffing the champers which is real French by the way. No skimping here.The evening meals are just as brilliant whether you like Asian, French or Italian cuisine as there is a very extensive menu and the value is unbelievable.A very international wine list is available and you can actually see the bottles at the end of the dining room for you to inspect and choose if not sure. Australia is very well represented on the wine list and also all the meat dishes offered are using Australian beef, including Wagyu, and lamb at wonderful great prices you wont find in Australia or elsewhere.Poolside guests can also order any time during the day and be served poolside from the same kitchen. If never tried you should definitely go for the Malaysian tasting plate a bit like an Indian Tahli plate. Desserts are all easy to swallow and again all great value and variety. Add this to your wish list and dont bother even looking outside the hotel to eat.as you will be very disappointed with what is there and on offer.Show less

Author: baahumbuguk
Title: EXCELLENT BBQ DINNER
Review: We stayed at the Danna for 10 nights. We ate at Planters each morning for a fantastic breakfast buffet, food to suit all tastes and in addition ate dinner here about 6 times. Each time the level of service, ambience and food was spot on. A great variety which can be worrying at times as you believe they cannot cook this much different dishes well. Yes they can, not one bad meal. The highlight for us was the BBQ dinners by the pool. A fantastic setting, great choice of food and brilliant service. Almost forgot to mention an amazing beef wellington, do try that one if you can. Good wine menu and a pianist playing in the background. Excellent!Show less

Author: IDRISMUSTAFA
Title: Excellent
Review:
Excellent service superb serving staff great experience 
If I am in Langkawi will visit restaurant for food not staying in this hotel for sure

Author: Shazzax
Title: The Danna main restsurant
Review: A large space with outdoor seating as well as comfortable well spaced seating inside. A varied buffet breakfast and extensive a la carte menu for dinner. Food excellent as well as staff and service. Champagne at breakfast very indulgent.

Author: Redknaps
Title: Dinner
Review:
Excellent food and fantastic service. All staff friendly and welcoming. 
A great variety of food. Indian curries were outstanding and the raveoli as entree was superb.

Author: Frans_12255060Broadbeach, Australia
Title: Fabulous space, first class ding
Review: We had breakfast 4 times, and dinner 3, so got a pretty good feel for Planters-- and it was all positive!The first thing is the space. It has a soaring ceiling, about 3 stories high, with huge windows overlooking the pool. The tables are well spaced, and the chairs luxurious. Both at breakfast and at night you feel very lucky to be there.The service is attentive and professional. Nothing is too much trouble, tables are cleared quickly, every thing just works.The breakfast buffet was very good, with choices for everyone. The egg dishes were particularly good.We had a buffet dinner, and two a la carte. The dishes were almost uniformly good, with the slight lack of spice in the two Indian dishes we tried the only slight downside. Presentation was great, serves generous, and it was great just sitting and watching the activity.We loved it-- fine dining at very reasonable pricesShow less

Author: IAMTravelBuddy
Title: Good choice for dinner
Review: We had our Hari Raya buffet with price of RM165 nett per person. Delicious food and lovely setup. We also spent our 2nd night dinner at this restaurant with ala carte meal. Price around RM90 per pax.

Author: DaBugsterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic food and awesome service!
Review: I've had the opportunity to stay at The Danna previously but due to such a short trip, we didn't get to experience dinner at The Planter's. Judging from their fabulous breakfast spread, made it a point to ensure we had our seat at the dinner table during this visit! The moment we stepped into The Planter's, we were treated to an enormously warm welcome. Everywhere you looked, you were greeted with a wonderful smile and Fuad, Qistina, Najwa and Paulo, who attended to us, gave such exquisite attention... we wanted to stay forever! We ordered the Chateaubriand and boy, was it marvellous. The meat was so tender, brimming with flavour and the sides were so nicely apportioned that it supported the mains so well without stealing the thunder. What a wonderful experience and definitely a night to remember!Thank you to all at The Planter's for making us feel like royalty! You guys are the best! We'll be back.Show less

Author: Getaway534209
Title: Fantastic Breakfast...
Review: We ate breakfast in the Planters every morning we experienced excellent service from the staff, food was always fresh and there was plenty of variety.

Author: jenmuffieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unforgettable breakfast spread at restaurant.
Review: The breakfast spread at the Planter's is excellent which comes with champagne. There is a fantastic pianist in the restaurant who plays while you eat. Good food and good music! What more can you ask for? Show less

Author: Harold Y
Title: Breakfast
Review: Nice International and Asian choice of foodspread. The Manager resembles Richard Gere. Service is excellent and friendly.Show less

Author: sushicrazy
Title: Outstanding
Review: Just an outstanding restaurant in every respect.  The menu choices are vast, food absolutely delicious, clean, superb service, fantastic ambience and that "we can make it happen" attitude from every single employee encountered! Kudos to the manager.

Author: HENRYTCT
Title: Fantastic Ambience !
Review: Fantastic ambience for dining. Great offerings and choice of delicious local and international food plus Friendly staff attending to our very needs just made the whole dining experience extremely enjoyable,✨pleasant✨ and ✨delighting for me and my family 😀👍🏼

Author: TravelwithGarIreland
Title: Well worth a visit to the Planter's
Review: We had been staying nearby the Danna and had occasion to have dinner in Planter's on three separate occasions during our extended stay in Langkawi.There is indoor and outdoor seating depending on your preference and a wide selection of dishes on the menu, along with a very good wine list. On our first visit we had a recommendation from the Queen of cocktails herself, Nabila in the Verandah at the Danna (makes the best cocktails in Lamgkawi IMHO) to try the Chateaubriand. This can be a hit and miss dish in many restaurants, particularly hotels, but not so at Planter's. The food was excellent, the meat tender and juicy and accompanied by some good wines. The staff provide a friendly and efficient service and on the one occasion when something was not quite right with one of our dishes the matter was handled very professionally. The restaurant caters well for families and kids. There is music in the Verandah next door so it is easy to drop in after dinner for a relaxing and enjoyable evening. We haven't had the opportunity to stay at the Danna but it is something we will consider for our next visit. So, if you find yourself in the vicinity I would certainly recommend both the Verandah and Planter's for a visit.Show less

Author: BerryJaxJacksonville Beach, Florida
Title: Great food. Great Service
Review: We booked here for my husband's birthday and had a fantastic experience.This is a restaurant in a 5 star hotel, so expect to pay 5 star prices. But also expect to indulge in meals worthy of 5 star status. Not only is there a wide selection, but food is brilliantly presented and tastes fantastic. The staff is incredibly helpful in suggesting menu items and making recommendations. They are attentive in their service levels without being intrusive. We even had the chef come to our table.As part of the birthday package, my husband had a dessert brought to him with a happy birthday message and the staff came to sing him a birthday song. They also gladly offered to take photo's of the moment.All in all, a great evening out and can highly recommend.My only regret is that we did not arrive earlier in the evening to make the most of the beautiful view and watch the sun set.Show less

Author: Vicky SPerth, Australia
Title: Good all round
Review: We stayed at the hotel so ate everyday either breakfast or dinner or both at this restaurant. Very good attention to detail.Breakfast a lovely well presented feast with a grand piano playing and champagne on ice.Dinner also very nice, (piano playing too) inside or out in a lovely colonial style setting. Very well trained staff, a good selection on the menu and nice food. A normal price for a 5 star hotel and a selection of different priced wine to suit all pockets and taste. I recommend.Show less

Author: YX S
Title: Classy fine dining experience
Review: Other reviewers noted The Planter's @ The Danna is almost of Michelin star quality, and I can attest to that. The appetizers we ordered (gratin scallops over spinach / wild mushroom soup) were extremely well-presented, market-fresh and tasted sublime. The mains (Malay local set / whole grilled fish) were similarly presented well and a culinary adventure for the palate.With great fine-dining service matching the dishes, you can't go wrong with The Planter's!Show less

Author: paul_t_singaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food
Review: Excellent breakfast buffet is served here and dinner menu is extensive with western and asian dishes. Prices are reasonable as ringitt is not strong Show less

Author: PoojaSachdevMumbai, India
Title: AMAZING!!
Review: I was transformed to another era , we were treated like Royalty!!! best staff ever!! must go...food was ok...but the experience was amazing!!Show less

Author: chrissI6403OJPoole, United Kingdom
Title: Mixed experience
Review: Had two meals here, one was very good and another was awful and had to send main course back. Food is well presented, soft shell crab was good first time less good the second. The whole baby chicken was excellent. Would have rated this very good but could not due to the awful lentil dish which was so watery and almost lacking in lentils. Show less

Author: JilllianLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: Managed to book a table outside which was nice. Both started with fish tartare which was good. Then moved on to the mains which were exceptional. I had Malay taster which was 4 small dishes of various curry with rice - excellent. Andy had sea bass fillets in Malay sauce; again excellent. By far the best place to eat.Show less

Author: Narcissus666Williton, United Kingdom
Title: Great bar, great chat, great cocktails
Review: What more can I say, the title of this piece says it all. Yet another stunning service at the uber wonderful Danna Langkawi. Look for the beautiful and ever smiling Nabila she serves up a mean cocktail on or off menu. a great place to sit and relax before or after your meal. Indulge yourself and eat at the hotel's Verandah restaurant. Wonderful!!! in fact do yourself a favour and take the all inclusive 5 star package and stay at the Danna. Its worth every penny and there is hardly any restriction on alcohol and cocktails. Best all inclusive anywhere I have encountered. I was blown away!!Show less

Author: MischaG84
Title: Perfect!
Review: Staying at the Danna we had both breakfast and dinner here, both were amazing. Book ahead for a table outside, well worth it.

Author: stardust_02Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Great food
Review: During a 7 night stay at the danna, we frequently ate at the planters restaurant.I was never disappointed with my meal, and was impressed by the wonderful service. The lobster and scallop risotto was especially delicious as was the chocolate fondant.It's not the cheapest restaurant on the island but isn't more than several other top recommended local places, and we found it to be well worth the cost. There are a few restaurants at the marina outside, but we decided against eating there as there was an absolute lack of ambience and the prices weren't significantly cheaper at several of the places. Most of the popular aka touristy restaurants are in cennang which is an approximately 20 min drive (or rm60 return ) by taxi and offers a larger range of restaurant choicesWould happily recommended planters to guests of the hotel for both the convenience and quality of food and service. Show less

Author: Sheila FBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Superb food and fantastic service
Review: This restaurant is in a superb location with both indoor and outside seating. The service was excellent on every occasion we ate there. Our first meal of Chateaubriand, followed by Crepes Suzette- fantastic. They also do tasting menus and I would highly recommend these also. The staff were very friendly and attentive without being forever ' in your face'. Although there were other restaurants close by we could find no reason to visit them when we had such a great restaurant on site and only a short stroll from our room.Show less

Author: Bechter A
Title: Great food, great service
Review: We are regular returnees to langkawi and have seen a number of exclusive places and restaurants on the island but nothing tops the food, service and overall dining experience in the planters at the danna langkawi. special credits to mr.kartik from the service crew who never fails to cater for one's needs with his great customer care and very attentive way of serving. We will be back for sure.Show less

Author: Jil-ChrisMelbourne, Australia
Title: Lovely Colonial style restaurant
Review: The Plkanters is the main restaurant at the Danna serving amazing breakfast catering to all tastes. The a la Carte dinner menu covers Western, Indian and Asian. The food is excellent and the presentation superb. As in all areas of the Hotel the service is excellent - wish I had thought to take some photos of the food!!Show less

Author: ChiwitKongNakMuayKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Heavenly!
Review: The Danna is an exquisite hotel and with it comes a a fine dining restaurant,with high ceilings,soft music coming from a grand piano to accompany your meal. The menu is extensive and you will be spoilt for choice. The servings weren't too small,just enough. If you sit outside,you will face the largest infinity pool in Langkawi and it over looks the beach and sea horizon.  We ordered two bottles of wine from New Zealand,( much cheaper ) as some of the selection were fairly expensive. For starters,the Ceaser's Salad,Lobster Bisque and Sweet potato soup. The soups came in a tea pot,very nice and full of flavour.  For mains,the Ayam percik was served in a coconut shell,with rice and some vegetables. Very creamy to taste and well done. The duck breast,cooked in a fusion thai style with basil leaves,papaya strips and under that was pineapple and potatoes is highly recommended. Duck isn't easy to cook and I was extremely pleased with the tantalising taste that lingered on with every bite. The Lobster at MYR250 was a bug one,fresh and well grilled. The lamb cutlet was well seasoned,the salmon well prepared. However,the five of us agreed that the meal was slightly on the sweet side,with their sauces..or marination of the meats..but,the taste is fusion and created well. We skipped desserts and had coffees. My Irish coffee was so so,not strong enough ,very mild in taste. Overall,the setting,ambiance and food was good. I would come back again.Show less

Author: PedritocalheirosPorto, Portugal
Title: Excellent Restaurant with extensive Menu
Review: We've stayed at the Danna and had dinner at Planter's twice, besides having breakfast every morning.The menu is quite extensive with Asian, indian and international food.Everything I've tried is good and on top of that there is also a good wine menu, all with fair prices.There is also a live piano music every night.Overall a great restaurant with fine serviceShow less

Author: sarahlizquinnCork, Ireland
Title: Excellent!
Review: We had the pleasure of dining at the planters a few times while staying in the danna. It was fabulous! The food is spectacular (with a good selection - the malay tasting platter was my favourite) and the service could not be faulted. This is fine dining at an affordable price. I only wish we could go back! Show less

Author: UKcriticLancashire, England
Title: Too many choices makes for lower quality
Review: This is undoubtedly a nice place with accommodating staff who work hard to please. The problem for me is that when you offer everything from North Indian food to Pasta and Burgers on a 60+ item menu it's hard to sustain high quality across the board. We tried a few things which were acceptable but a long way from a memorable experience.The breakfast is also good but around average for a hotel of this size more or less all over the world. Again, no complaints but no Wow factor either.Show less

Author: aadeshjainSalem, India
Title: amazing breakfast buffet
Review: being vegetarians we were worried, but once we requested a chef they made us 3-4 dishes exclusively for us, amazing service, taste & Ambiance. Show less

Author: stephb157
Title: Dinner for two
Review: This restaurant was extremely well organised, show-casing quality ingredients on a very extensive menu. We sat outside by the poolside on the grass and were served by a lovely man Kartik, who had some great island activity suggestions which we took up in the end. The scallops appetiser was my favourite dish of the week. The wine list was substantial, something for all tastes. Show less

Author: Harshrk
Title: Good ambience
Review: The restaurant is very colonial in style. The food has a large variety of different cuisines. You don't need to go out of the hotel to eat the local food. It's excellent in the restaurant. M

Author: ZvanteStockholm, Sweden
Title: Cluttered menu
Review: The Planter´s is a beautiful restaurant, classic colonial style with lots of space between the tables. The menue is very cluttered, lot of awkward combinations, like tuna tartar with goat cheese, Balsamic vinegar and miso? Overworked to large menue. But still good food though. Friendly and very helpful staff, still bit unsecure. Lot of strange factual inaccuracies in the winelist though which you are not expect in this level.Show less

Author: linda882London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely dining experience
Review: Menu choice is excellent. It ranges from fine dining to everyday favourites. Quality really good and staff very friendly and helpful. An extremely well run restaurant with a very attentive Head of Food and Drinks Manager - Yeray. Thankyou so much for making our dining experience so enjoyable.Show less

Author: FfejcGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Restaurant in 5 star hotel, excellent staff, huge menu.
Review: We came across this by chance after walking around Telaga Harbour and not finding any restaurants that looked good. We saw the Hotel and decided to have a drink there and pass some time as we were early.Inside we found a few nice bars, music and the Planters Restaurant.Very friendly and helpful hostess outside showed us the menu and outlined all the different types of food, European, Indian, Malay, Chinese etc, massive choice, and then showed us around inside and the outside tables with a wonderful view.We had a drink and then decided to stay for dinner and we were glad we did,As mentioned exceptional choice, we had a large grilled sea bass and some side meat dishes and veggies / rice. Great drinks / wine lists, just a very good restaurant and excellent service throughout the meal.The downside was that it was quiet and lacked atmosphere, but the service, the views and the quality of the food made up for that. Give it a try.Show less

Author: FazianPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: Best Service, Top Notch Hospitality and Delicious Food
Review: We had the most wonderful stay and experience at the Danna for 4 days in November 2015, for a business meeting. Discussions with, and preparations by Mr Fuad, Mr Redha and the rest of the Danna's staff, prior and throughout the event were top-notch. Friendly, very helpful and accommodating. Food served at the Planters were delicious. I personally love the soft crust of the pastries (bravo to the pastry chef!). We also had delicious lunches and dinners catered and served by the ever-dedicated F&B team of the Danna. I wish to express my heartfelt gratitude and thanks to Mr Fuad and his team, Mr Redha and his team, Ms Jaswinder and Mr Hafiz, and the rest of the staffs in The Planter's and The Danna, for ensuring the event a great success. I would highly recommend the Danna and The Planter's at The Danna to anyone, and hope to re-visit the Danna with my children.Show less

Author: Jule1629Singapore, Singapore
Title: An excellent restaurant!
Review: We had breakfast buffet,a room service lunch and a grill barbecue dinner.huge variety! food tastes good !coudnt find a fault with this place..As with Danna, the staff friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: Niswani J
Title: Best service n delicious food
Review: The hotel offers free breakfast together with the room....and everthing at its best. Love the pastries! Im back home and thinking of it makes me craving for it now! Show less

Author: MichaelO930
Title: High Class Butlins Smash  and Grab Club
Review:
Mad scramble at Breakfast people tripping over each other.
Dropping food smashing plates  at this over publicised Planters Restaurant

Author: ErinAmatoPerth, Australia
Title: Huge choice
Review: Great food and wonderful staff. All the curries we tried were so tasty. The seafood spaghetti was delicious too. Show less

Author: Thiru186338London, United Kingdom
Title: Visit to the The Danna Langkawi
Review: We stayed at the Danna Langkawi from the 25/9/2015 to the 6/10/2015 and enjoyed every minute of our stay at this hotel.I will fully recommend this hotel and will definitley come back. The hotel is of such high standard and service was excellent. Food too as the Danna was fantastic that when we then visited the Shangr la in malaysia the standard in the Shangri la seemed much lower although that is a world renowned hotel. Irina one of the concierge there advised us to take the jet ski trip with Mega water sports and this was such a fantastic trip. I would also like to comment on the well thought out rooms. We stayed at the Grand Viceroy rooms facing the sea and i would recommend these rooms to anyone planning a visit. The Planter's at the Danna served very high quality food that was delicious. The breakfast was fantastic with a wide variey of food. We also ended up having our dinner at the planter's as well as it was so good.Show less

Author: LondonRjpLondon
Title: Food below average
Review: We stayed at the hotel and ate here on multiple occasions and while the setting is nice and staff/service of a very high standard sadly the food just never hit the mark.This is a 5* top rated hotel and the food was well below the standard I would expect.Some was ok, some wasn't great at all but nothing was exceptional.We ate Malay, Indian and more international cuisine. The beef tenderloin was the best dish I had, really tasty Australian beef though having ordered medium rare it was first overcooked (m/w) then undercooked albeit the 'blue' steak was very nice.Poor cuts of meat, small portions, expensive prices by Malaysian standards make me give 2*. Compared to datai and andaman the standard was below par.Show less

Author: Maud RNice, France
Title: Wonderful restaurant
Review: The Planter's is a very good restaurant.With a large choice of food especially for breakfast with an enormous buffet which has a lot of fresh product. We also tried Planter's during dinner and it was a very good experience, we definitely recommend Indian's food.Waiters and managers are excellent, always looking for us, giving food recommendations... Thanks to all the staff and especially to Yeray, Fuad, Kartik and Quistina.We will definitely come back to heard more stories about crocodiles on the island !Show less

Author: Lina SAntwerp, Belgium
Title: 5 star all the way!
Review: After living in Langkawi for almost a year we recently discovered Planter's at the Danna hotel. Langkawi has so many good restaurants for dinner and this one definitely deserves a high ranking on our list. The beef Wellington is a must try (for 2-3 people), the steak tuna is also amazing and then those desserts, yumm :-).. The staff and the manager Yeray are always very lovely and they take such good care of us and when you have something to celebrate they go beyond everything to make it a memorable night! We'll be coming back soon!Show less

Author: nicotrishMelbourne, Australia
Title: excellent food wonderful staff
Review: What an enjoyable experience to be treated to the most beautiful "Crepe Suzette"served with flair at our table; a truely enjoyable evening thanks to the staff.We were also very impressed and delighted when we booked to attend the weekly B.B.Q. This was not just any B.B.Q. this was a gourmet banquet with a large variety of the best food we have tasted for a long time. The amount of delicious food and wonderful presentation was topped off by a poolside venue. Many thanks to Yeray (Food & Beverage Manager) and his staff for such an incredible evening.Show less

Author: 295pipsNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Food review
Review: Wonderful staff and food. Staff often remembered our breakfast order. Yuray, karthik, Irena and quistine all fantastic, friendly and attentive, We couldn't fault the restaurant, good or staff. Part of an excellent hotel. Pip and Matt Show less

Author: Aditi JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Spoilt for choice :)
Review: Super service, Great selection and amazing spread. It is a place for a great morning breakfast! You get way more than what you will pay for. Definitely there are more hotels with great breakfast spread but what was most amazing was the staff, they definitely serve their guests in the best possible way. Thumbs up for the service.Show less

Author: glentromienew norcia Australia
Title: Best service in Langkawi but expensive
Review: We arrived from our hotel to be greeted with the offer of 2 tables inside or outside. We chose the latter. Cushions arrived for our backs and a fan. We ordered drinks and they arrived promptly and an amuse Bouche also arrived. The meal was good but for the price not exceptional. Rack of lamb 110 ringgit and Angus fillet 95 ringgit. We thought the food at Casa del Mar was better and much cheaper. On leaving they said they were having trouble getting us a taxi but could offer the hotel car for 20 ringgit more. After spending 1200 ringgit for the 4 of us either a complimentary transfer or one for the same price would have been a nice gesture. Show less

Author: thanushiaaPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best Champagne Breakfast on the island
Review: If you are looking for a great morning brunch with someone mimosas... This is. The place to be! They have an excellent selection for their breakfast buffet and free flow of champagne that would leave you all bubbly by noon! The ambience is really nice as you overlook the pool and then some sea... Definitely something to do if you want a chilled out relaxing morning! Loved every second of it! Show less

Author: Jordan K
Title: Amazing food and Gluten Free
Review: I stayed at the Danna for 10 nights with my wife who is Gluten intolerant.The staff at the Danna are first class and remember you by name and you preferences. This also extended to the Planter's. It can be exhausting work finding Gluten Free food however the staff made it so easy and always remembered to ensure we had gluten free meals. Even when it came to the complimentary tasters there was always a special gluten free one for my wife which was a really nice touch.Let's talk food. The steaks are cooked to perfection and we kept coming back to them. Overall it was a delightful experience to eat here.Show less

Author: Mohammad Faraz K
Title: The danna
Review: Extra ordinary hotel with extreme convenient location with top class services . early check-in allowed with free WiFi added value to it .Show less

Author: Jimi1000
Title: Good food
Review: Good food and a huge menu. Some of the dishes need improvement but on the whole a lovely place to eat with good food and super staff. Breakfast is excellent.

Author: Her MHong Kong, China
Title: Good service, good food
Review: We ate there twice---our first and last night staying at the Danna.The first night we had ordered prawn & lobster rissotto , wild mushroom soup, lobster bisque and panfried salmon. The rissotto came without prawns and lobsters, and when we asked the waitress about it, she realised it's their mistake and asked if we'd like to change that, or we'd just eat that and then they would waive it off the bill. We tried a bit of the plain spinach rissotto that they had put before us, thought it tasted all right, and so decided to take that. The two soups came in a separate teapot, piping hot. The wild mushroom soup had real bits of chopped wild mushrooms with some pesto oil at the bottom of the bowl before they poured the hot soup over. It was delicious and creamy. The lobster soup had had a similar presentation where one smallish lobster meat and a dollop of sour cream were placed at the bottom of the bowl, and then hot lobster bisque poured over. The small lobster meat was not succulent but texture rather like some old dish cloth. The dollop of sour cream was a nice touch but it somehow turned the hot soup poured from the separate teapot lukewarm.The spinach rissotto was flavoursome and al dente, while the salmon was fresh but could do with less cooking so the flesh could remain a bit more pink & rare. Servings were generous. Bread basket didn't arrive until we asked for it. It consisted of bread sticks, thin sesame wafers and walnut rye bread served with olive oil. Bread sticks and sesame wafers could have been a bit crispier but the bread was fresh and tasty on its own.The next dinner was on our last night where we're seated in an almost empty restaurant as we suspected that most had gone to the weekly BBQ buffet outside. We were promptly seated by the window and service was very good, waiters all smiling and gave us their immediate attention.We ordered two wild mushroom soups, again , persistent to order the lobster & prawn rissotto and a caesar salad with grilled chicken. Bread basket came automatically and it contained the same assortment except this night they gave us sunflower seed bread, which was also very fresh and delicious. Olive oil was served with the bread.The wild mushroom soups came piping hot, very creamy and rich, and seasoned perfectly. They had made the rissotto right this time---lobster was succulent but instead of prawns they used scallops, which was fresh and plump. The shaved cheddar on top was a good condiment. Rice was al dente. Good dish to order.The caesar salad had two halves of hard boiled egg and some thin slices of grilled chicken. The dressing wasn't quite like the usual stuff we normally get, and the grilled chicken was rather bland. It was just a so-so salad that was most nondescript.Both nights we didn't have room for desserts but their vanilla smoothie and strawberry smoothie were nice---rich, creamy and ice cold as how smoothies should be.The lofty ceiling makes this restaurant a comfy place to enjoy a good, relaxing meal. Oh, and they do have good music throughout the night.Show less

Author: adamsclan2015Cheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food and not expensive for the quality you get
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed and actually preferred to eat at the Planter's restaurant at The Danna, whilst holidaying in Langkawi. The quality of food and the way it was presented was lovely. For the price it was well worth eating at this restaurant. The staff were very professional and friendly and the ambiance of the restaurant, whether eating in or out was wonderful.Couldn't recommend the Planter's enough.Show less

Author: vicksimoHong Kong, China
Title: Dinner and breakfast
Review: We had both dinner and breakfast during our stay in The Danna. Let's talk about the dinner first, we shared a Asian lemongrass duck as appetizer, it is fresh but a little bit flat for me as I like strong taste. For Main we have the tenderloin and two glass of red wine. The meat was so soft and tasty and the side dish potato paste and vegi was also very tasty. After the main I was already full but my husband want to try their pasta so we ordered one more pasta and we had finished all. Great food, romantic environment and live piano music. It was a great night.For the breakfast, there are a great variety on the buffet table and they also have the breakfast menu. We chose to sit outdoor and it was a beautiful morning. We are very pleased with the food, environment and the staff.Show less

Author: rachgilbertPoole, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best meals we've tasted
Review: We dined several times at Planters whilst staying at The Danna, on all occasions the food was superb. Chateau Briand for two persons is excellent and ours was cooked to perfection. We were seated outside on the Verandah for a couple of meals, a lovely setting and very romantic! The staff are polite and attentive whilst also maintaining The Danna ethos of friendly, warm, customer service.Breakfast is great too with complimentary champagne and live piano music, the pianist is excellent. We were well looked after by all the staff, Kartik in particular, who made sure we always had whatever we needed. Highly recommend a visit to Planters whether staying at the hotel or not.Show less

Author: Phil_Robert8
Title: Planters Restaurant at The Danna
Review: At the tunes of live piano music we were greeted and seated by a smiling friendly waiter. Relaxed ambience in this airy high ceiling restaurant is nice, classy and with cosy enough lighting. Deciding on the Indian dishes recommended by the waiters assurance that their Indian chef was very capable. We (group of 7) tried different dishes. First came a amuse-bouche and warm bread. Always a nice gesture to get ones appetite going for what is to come. I started with the oriental beef salad. It was a generous portion presented well and tasted as expected. For my choice of sea bass curry, I was presented a fragrant dish with nice flavours. The fish, okra(lady finger), eggplant, tomato together with the combination of spices made the curry very tasty.The Fontella Chianti 2011, also recommened, accompanied the dish very well.Sago gula melaka rounded off my meal. Not too sweet, as I often find desserts can be.Our dining experience here was made plesant by the staff being knowledgeable, neatly dressed and deliverying food correctly. Attentive service was ok. However on previous occasions it has been better. I believe this evening they were understaffed as from what I saw most waiters were tending on patrons in the private dining room.For a well cooked meal in a nice setting with live piano music, this is where I'd like to come. Price wise I think for approximately RM 100 per head it is also good value.Show less

Author: DCT08Singapore, Singapore
Title: Planters Restaurant at The Danna absolutely "one of the best"
Review: We spent 4 nights at 5* The Danna Hotel in Langkawi and had a most wonderful vacation. The hotel proudly boasts one of the best restaurants in this region - The Planter's Restaurant. I travel extensively in this region and you will not find a better restaurant with staff that are very helpful and most certainly know each and every dish on their very extensive menu. My wife and i most enjoyed the attention that we received from staff member Kartik who looked after us each evening in the restaurant and gave us truly wonderful recommendations to all of the local dishes.we will most certainly visit The Danna Hotel on another long weekend vacation and will look forward to eating in our favorite restaurant The Planter's Restaurant Danna Hotel, Langkawi.Show less

Author: IanB1965Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Superb
Review: We stayed at The Danna and had breakfast and dinner each day. Breakfast is a great buffet with superb service.Dinner was incredible each night and at very reasonable prices. There is a wide choice of different types of excellent food. Each night we sat outside, views below.I need to mention the service as it is outstanding , attentive, friendly, yet not intrusive . In particular , Kartik is fantastic, nothing is too much trouble and he is very friendly. I think he is s real asset to The Danna. Show less

Author: Zouille MLyon, France
Title: Wonderful night
Review: This restaurant is gorgeous, there is a live pianist, hight ceiling and perfect view when you are sitted in one of the table outside. We were staying at the Hotel for few days and we did not feel the need to go to any other restaurants since their food selection is huge, from western to Indian. My favorite one though was the chateaubriand carved in front of your eyes. I would like to give Special thanks to the team when on our last night we had a dessert show with a flambee offered.The staff is amazing, always with the smile and the service was flawless. Could not spot any mistakes. I will defenetly come back.Show less

Author: Raoul HCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful dinner
Review: Really nice atmosphere, the service was perfect. We were welcomed by a lovely young lady. We had a Chateaubriand, and it was amazing. They brought the trolley next to our table and they show us how to cut the meat. It was really interesting and nice to see that. On the side, we had vegetables and they were tasty! I recommand this restaurant for a couple or a family!Show less

Author: ManuelaKiran KSydney, Australia
Title: A must go establishment in Langkawi at the Danna
Review: My wife and I stayed at Danna Property in April(first week onwards)We visited the Planters restaurant for their weekly Friday night BBQ. The food was a mix of both traditional and modern cuisine. We were spoilt for choice and bit more than we could chew :-) We would highly recommend everyone who visit Langkawi to try the Planters restaurant at the Danna.But the main thing that stood out that evening was the amazing service we got. The stafff are so friendly and warm. They make sure that every guest is comfortable. They will even go get the food to your table so you do not even need to get up and walk to the BBQ stations. They are very knowledgeable and can explain each of the very many dishes on the menu. The FnB manager Mr. Yeray is awesome!! He walks around and makes sure each guest is happy and is taken care . He has a great sense of humor and this helps in breaking the ice with the guests. Thanks Yeray!And thank you everyone at Planters for making all our visits (including breakfasts) so memorable during our stay.Show less

Author: Duco VAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great food, superb service and a great manager
Review: I was travelling trough Malaysia with my boyfriend and we ended our trip in the Danna.I had heard very good stories about the hotel and also about the Planters.We were planning to have dinner only one night, but ended up having dinner there every night (5 nights).All dinners were amazing. Every night we were served by the friendliest staff anyone can imagine. Both inside and outside tables were very comfortable and luxuriously designed. The staff was supervised by a very handsome French guy, I can not remember his name. A very welcoming and warm person who made all guests feel at ease every night. I believe he was there even during breakfasts!The food is exactly what you expect from a 5-star hotel, big round of applause for the whole kitchen. Try the trio of Rendang.I would recommend this restaurant to everyone. It is really worth a visit when you are on Langkawi, even if you are not staying at the Danna.Show less

Author: mohammed mSaudi Arabia
Title: Nice cuisines with average service
Review: Sitting outdoor under the rain will give you an unforgettable Romantic Dinner experience.They have a wide range international menu that will satisfy your taste for sureIt is expensiveShow less

Author: famousmooSingapore
Title: Amazingly Superb Food & Ambience
Review: The food served was really Michelin-quality! And even for one who has diet restrictions - no gluten, dairy & egg, there were good choices and we even had dessert! Going gluten, dairy & egg free practically rules out most items on a normal dessert menu but at Planters, we had 2 items we could choose from even before we asked the chef to substitute anything! We had - Thai seafood broth (seafood was fresh & soup had just a tinge of lime, really appetizing)- Ayam Percik (chicken curry in coconut milk) served with a salad & white rice- Sesame-crusted tuna served on a bed of mashed potato pattie embedded with edamame (tuna was melt-in-the-mouth tender & pattie was lightly cheese-crusted); the other one of us is ok with dairy!Dessert:- Banana Pengat (grilled banana in sago porridge with coconut milk)- Sago Melaka (sago with palm sugar syrup in coconut milk) Candlelit romantic venue with a fantastic live pianist! Friendly, well-trained & very attentive staff gave great suggestions & anticipated needs. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: JonitaAusPerth, Australia
Title: Delicious beef Wellington and amazing wine menu!
Review: Service staff were very friendly and attentive.The wine menu, although expensive, was well worth it - the wine is cellared perfectly and you can be sure that you won't be disappointed by the selection.The beef Wellington for two is a delicious dish, as was the trio of creme brûlée for dessert.It is perfect for a meal inside the hotel - good food right at the doorstep.The ambience was also certainly enjoyable.Show less

Author: Davidelfa
Title: Great food in a beautiful setting served by friendly staff
Review: I am a regular diner at the planters over the last 3 years everytime I dine there the experience gets better it has now become my comfort zone.Show less

Author: titans123Studley, United Kingdom
Title: Awful from start to finish
Review: It is hard to say something positive about our experience at The Planters - the only positive comment I have to make is that the pianist was good. Approximately 10 tables were occupied - both inside and outside - and the restaurant had no atmosphere. The menu is quite varied including Thai, Malaysian and Italian cuisine, however when the food arrived it was cold and my partner didn't receive his food until 5 minutes after mine - I wouldn't mind but I went out to eat as a couple. No one came to check on us during the meal and when we finished we waited for 40 minutes for someone to come clear our plates, a delay in clearing the plates I might understand if the restaurant was understaffed but there were about 8 servers on duty, all of whom walked past our table as it was located near to the kitchen!! Only when we stood up to leave did one of the team come over to us. On leaving the restaurant we spoke to one of the team about our experience however they weren't interested. By nature we are not the type of people to complain for no reason and quite often accept service we perhaps shouldn't, however in our opinion this was unacceptable - especially for a 5 star luxury hotel. Show less

Author: 636lewisk
Title: Down to earth, friendly Korean restaurant.
Review: Great food, friendly staff and a lovely atmosphere. We ordered bibimbap, beef bbq and steamed egg - fresh, tasty and served swiftly. We even got a free ice cream for dessert!

Author: CWKoh
Title: Great Korean Food!
Review: One of the best Pajeon's I've had! The pancakes were very crispy and tasty - just as it should be. The kimchi was very well-balanced and flavourful. Definitely the best food we had in Langkawi and worth the visit!

Author: m0viesl
Title: Best korea food
