Review: Love the food here. Freshly made and best part, the owner is korean herself. The service was great and friendly, remind me of when i visited Korea before. They served free ice cream and occasionally extra food. I have visited here 3 times.. Highly recommended

Author: mhk1058Swansea
Title: Outstanding
Review: Outstanding from start to finish. Very helpful waiter guided us through menu and helped us make the perfect choices for us. We were given some complimentary tasters before the main meal which was a nice surprise and were lovely.All the food we chose was freshly cooked and absolutely delicious, we all ended up sharing because it was all so good.The waiter also brought us complimentary honey citron tea as well as a little bowl of ice cream. Really nice touches from start to finish.A fantastic experience, easily the best food we’ve had so far in Langkawi and would be very happy to recommend without hesitation.Show less

Author: 599grantd
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: You will not regret coming here. Amazing Korean food!! Highly recommend the pork dumplings and chicken and pork bbq!

Author: 889albertv
Title: Excellent food and even better service
Review: Went in based on all the good reviews and completely lived up to expectations. The manager is fantastic and the food delicious. We went back the next day and we’re not disappointed the second time around

Author: Lifebeforeworktravel
Title: Best Korean food EVER
Review: Make sure you eat here if you're in Langkawi! Portion sizes are very reasonable and absolutely Delicious and full of flavour. We had the chili beef and bibimbap. They gave 3 other complimentary tasters as well as a scoop of ice cream to top it off. We left very satisfied and stuffed. Show less

Author: Riitta_A_E
Title: Hyvää korealaista ruokaa
Review:
Hyvää korealaista ruokaa ystävällisesti tarjoiltuna. Annokset riittäisivät hyvin jaettaviksi. 
Very good real Korean food and a friendly staff. After dining for sure you aint hungry anymore.

Author: GaryS0609Malaysia
Title: Authentic Korean food. little pricy but worth it!
Review: Went there for lunch alone. Order a pork gun mandu as a starter, the portion is big with 8 pcs of hand wrapped dumpling. Mean while my main beef bokeum is super delicious. Free side dishes with kimchi, egg rolls and pancake.Ambience is relax and chill, staff are friendly and welcoming. Overall highly recommend it.Show less

Author: TinpusherCheshireMeriden, United Kingdom
Title: Top notch.
Review: Never eaten Korean before. Struggling with some Malaysian cuisine for Vegetarian and plant based options. Hello Haroo, you saviour. Cannot compare with other Korean food outlets but as tasty enjoyable food with substantial portions goes, this place is a belter. Great service- not sure the spritzing spray was a playful joke or genuine. Reasonable selection of dishes and most importantly some of the nicest non-meat food all holiday. Great for couples or friends. All dishes perfectly explained by the Manager in a very helpful way. Loved the Panjeon (Vegetable pancake). Show less

Author: yenji1Sileby, United Kingdom
Title: Great service and tasty dishes
Review: Me and my partner had lunch here. Ordered the Bimbimbap, haemul japchae and the pajeon All 3 dishes were very generous portions (big) and came with complimentary kimchee, egg rolls and mini pancakesBibimbap was huge , but not in a stone clay pot we were expecting , but still tasted great (4*)Pajeon again very big and chock full of veg and scallions (4*)Japchae was delicious , sweet and savoury, didn’t need the broken bits of shell at the bottom however (4.5*)After the dishes arrived we were given complimentary “korean honey lemon tea” this was in a small glass and tasted fantastic, I had to order another The service was excellent, only one person but he kept checking up on us and made sure everything was fine. Outstanding.Show less

Author: actonexplorer
Title: Lovely and charming restaurant
Review: Went here for meal and experienced genuine Korean hospitality. The care they take of customers is exemplary - and not just because it’s the corporate thing to do - they are genuinely interested in their customers. The food is good and reasonably priced. A great find. Show less

Author: 23mrr
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Excellent food and services. Staff provide excellent services and food is really authentic Korean food. Love the mural on the wall.  Felt the warmth of Korean food culture.

Author: LizandAlbNoosa, Australia
Title: Can’t believe this place gathers
Review: Can’t believe this place gathers so much praise. Was expecting great Korean food, but it was dull and stodgy. The much praised seafood pancake was claggy and very light on (recognisable) seafood, the fried dumplings almost tasteless, the only thing that was good was the kimchi, and it was excellent. The person who made that kimchi was definitely not cooking when we ate at Haroo+. To be avoided, I am sorry to say...Show less

Author: hallothere
Title: We came back again after 5 years
Review: We came for the food few years ago when the shop was smaller. Now it has expanded but the food remains excellent

Author: brett_170961
Title: Haroo hurray
Review:
Great food fantastic hosting and service 
Very good to cater for all dietary needs 
Check it out 
Manager is great manger

Author: Z9231UDmarkuss
Title: Delicious food and 5 Star service
Review: We enjoyed a fantastically meal and a 5 star service. We are definitely looking forward to return for an other meal !!!

Author: T7918RHlisasOslo, Norway
Title: Delicious food and lots of little bonuses!
Review: I’m not very familiar with Korean cuisine, but their menu explains what everything is in detail and the waiter answered any additional questions I had. The food was absolutely delicious and the waiter was very polite and friendly. Got side dishes and ice cream on the house, which were also very tasty. Big plus for asking if I wanted to take home what I couldn’t finish. Very reasonable prices too. Highly recommend this place whether you love Korean food or want to try it for the first time!Show less

Author: KaisaJ68
Title: Suberb dinner
Review: Fantastic customer service, we ate bibimbap and jap chae, and both dishes were amazing. We got complimentary kimchi, pancake and omelette with our main course and ice cream as a dessert. Recommend for a good vegetarian Korean experience :)

Author: SophieChubb
Title: Great food and staff
Review: Had our best meal in Langkawi at this restaurant. The food was amazing and the service was impeccable. Our children (3 and 5) also loved the food and wanted to come back again the next evening. Would highly recommend.

Author: Jacqueline N
Title: Good food
Review: The food was delicious and the host was 5*. Would recommend you go there but bring cash as cash only accepted. Its a 10 min drive to the ATM in Cenang TC if you don't have any.

Author: FaversFaversham, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, but had lost its edge...
Review: Returning to Langkawi, we were excited to return to Haroo +, as the last time we visited it was absolutely top notch! Unfortunately, it didn’t live up to our memories. Last time, the service was second to none, friendly, bubbly, helpful, Korean chaps who made the night and guided you through the food choices...but the service this time was overbearing. We ended up being asked ten times whether the food was ok, by a waiter that needed deodorant, tripped over tables because he was bowing and walking backwards from our table, repeatedly called me sir (I’m female), and guided us to Korean bbq when they only had four tables capable of this, (less than last time?) which were all taken, meaning the food was cooked in the ovens. We were also moved into a room all by ourselves, bitten alive and left with no ambience. Bring back the Koreans!Korean bbq is all about fab service, bbq, fun ambience and great tasting food. The food was great, but the rest was really disappointing after visiting this place in its peak!Show less

Author: LangkawiD
Title: Great Food
Review: Very enjoyable meal, staff very helpful with any questions or recommendations, well worth a visit. Nice touches, with free iced water and Ice cream.

Author: Dion C
Review: Very good service and food. The staff and the owner are both very friendly. Water is free and topped up automatically and so are the side dishes.

Author: entity_13Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Late hour Korean feast
Review: Haroo+ is not your typical Korean Restaurant that serves the standard Korean food with localized flavor. It has the best Korean pancake and the seafood noodle soup in he Kuah area. The Korean pancake is rich in the veggies and not heavy on the pancake and extenders unlike the other restaurants. The Seafood Noodle soup does complement the meal as the Shrimp and mussel flavor is noticeable in the taste of the warm soup.The Citron Honey and Ginger teas are very much close to the Korean teas as these were oozing with the tangy citron zest flavor and spicy ginger taste, not too mention the sweetness was just right . It should be more pround of the hospitality and impeccable service by its staff, as it was difficult to find a decent place that served hot meals outside at the late hour in te Kuah area. Kumar and the staff accommodated us and we were attended to properly at the late hour. Kudos to you, Kumar and your staff! Looking forward to our next visit.Show less

Author: ronnys547Oslo, Norway
Title: Wery good food and Nice staff 👍
Review: We tried the beef and chicken salad. I think this was the best meal we eat the last week in langkawi. The staff was super Nice, and really did what they could do to make our stay as good as IT colud get. I really recommend this place. Show less

Author: janicecG8636ZQKowloon, China
Title: Great food with great service
Review: Very nice food with great service . The waiters have been very sincere to serve with smile , the chef ( maybe the owner of the restaurant ) came out to ask us if the food was good enough. The food is like home made Korean food , with good portion size , great taste . My mum who is a Chinese , seldom eats Korean food, also finds the dinner amazing. They even serve extra dessert ( ice cream and drinks ) for my 3 kids.However , there was only 1-2 groups of people having dinner with us on that night in Haroo plus . I hope they can maintain the business. Highly recommended it to every body. Show less

Author: kellycosmith
Title: Great value, fair price, very friendly staff
Review: Amazing Korean food, the staff are extremely friendly! This place is suitable for vegetarians with a seperate vegetarian menu, we were very satisfied with the meals

Author: artiomg183
Title: Best place on Langkawi
Review: Very good restaurant. Been there with my girlfriend and for the first time in Malaysia we both couldn’t finish the meal, because it was to much. The stuff was awesome and the food as well. Would recommend everybody to check this place out. Also good for vegetarian.Show less

Author: Lim M
Title: Best Haroo in Langkawi
Review: If you are looking to fulfill your cravings for Korean cuisine, Haroo+ is the place. no doubt there are other Haroo Restaurant in the island but they are not comparable with Haroo+ at Pandak Mayah Kuah. The service was excellent and food was awesome! I am glad I stayed nearby the area where I can always go. The most recent visit, I went with a slight flu, the service crew prepared a complimentary ginger honey tea so that I am able to enjoy my meal with ease. Highly recommended Haroo in Langkawi.Show less

Author: ChrisGCardiffCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Food and Service Perfect
Review: We ended up here by accident. So glad we did. First time most of my family had tried Korean food. We decided not to go for the barbecue (cook yourself) option, but go for the traditional food from the menu. They serve pork - which their sister restaurant doesn't and wow was it good. We had a selection of beef, pork and chicken dishes. All were delicious. They will cook to the level of spice you would like. The fried dumplings were beyond good. Better than DTF. We had two waiters Pradeep and Arrfin - both were very professional and were very friendly and helpful. Also met the owners. Very friendly people. Great service and great food :)Show less

Author: HappyTimes6
Title: Amazing food
Review: the Staff Was Very Nice And The Food Was Excellent . They even served Ice Cream! I Had Ramyeon And It Was Excellent . We also Bibim Bap Which Was Also Excellent. Best Korean Food I Have Ever Had And My Favourite Restaurant Too!

Author: 394elieeVitry-sur-Seine, France
Title: Good food and very lovely staff
Review: It was a great experience, we took mainly the grill mix that was served on the grill by our lovely waiter, free refill for side dishes and ice tea was offered also.They also offered us ice cream, because they had to close a bit earlier exceptionally that night, we were gonna leave already so we were not deranged by that, but they insisted on offering us the ice cream!A must visit restaurant in Langkawi! Show less

Author: yvegeny
Title: Excellent Service and food
Review: We had a family dinner for 5, excellent food and great service , strongly recommended if you are here.

Author: Marine P
Title: Great food with vegetarian options
Review: The food is delicious and they have a lot of vegetarian options, most of which can easily be made vegan. The staff is really friendly and always gave us complimentary side dishes or drinks when we went, great service.

Author: t_man1965
Title: Best Korean bbq.
Review:
Great bbq food. Beef was melt in mouth and perfectly seasoned. Amazing service. Complimentary dishes as well. 
Will come again. A little expensive but worth it

Author: Arifin S
Title: Good food
Review: Had a lovely time here.the staff are friendly  and helpful and attractive the , the food and drinks are delicious and lost of veggie options complimentary ice cream for dessert and fair prices,

Author: gohqinen0525
Title: Excellent Service!!!!!
Review: We ordered bbq and the service is extremely good! The waiter is so so so so so caring that he hands me tissue papers knowing I'm having flu. The food is good too! Extremely recommended!

Author: Alexander S
Title: Eat fresh
Review: HAROOT is a calm hidden restaurant serving amazing Korean food. Kimchi Jeon (most delicious vegetarian pancake), we really eat it about every third day, even for lunch and dinner. In combination with the complementary appetizers and ice cream after, the portion is large enough to take home part of it. We simply love it! Pardeep kumar is the most amazing angel here, serving from his heart in generosity and love. He is a pure blessing. Thank you, brother .Show less

Author: Jessica4519
Title: Very good restaurant
Review: We went there for dinner and shared the barbecue menu which was great. We sit on a table were they prepare the barbecue directly in front of you it was fantastic and they served a lot of first plates which were delicious too.

Author: Kathryn DEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Had a superb beef barbecue cooked on our table
Review: We hadn't eaten Korean food for a while so came to Haroo+ for their beef barbecue set. cooked on our table. At RM 120 for two it wasn't cheap, in fact it was our most expensive meal in Langkawi, but it was really tasty and came with extra sides, extra lettuce, Korean sauce. An alternative would have been the port or chicken sets at RM 100 or pork rib and dumplings at RM 150. There is also an a la carte menu.We thoroughly enjoyed our meal, washed down with a few Tigers at RM 8 per bottle. Then we were offered a free ginger ice tea, which I didn't think I'd like but did and some icecream. Delicious and would heartily recommend.Show less

Author: thomascurran32
Title: Delicious food
Review: I don't eat this type of food in my whole life .it's very yummy and delicious.again I say that I don't eat like this food in everywhere in Malaysia .haroo+ thanks for the food .  Keep it up .

Author: lohajg
Title: So good
Review: Recommented by a friend who had visited earlier. We went there for an early lunch .pleasant welcome and great interoduction to korean food  by the service man....

Author: Jin327
Title: Just never visit
Review: Simply worst Korean restaurant in Malaysia. I live in Malayska for 6 years and Im Korean. I saw good reviews and visited here. So overly price but what I got was terrible. Staff was also annoying. He pretend kind but keep bugging us around. Tell us to eat uncooked pork and telling me its ready. I doubled check my order on his paper but still i didnt get rices. Asked for more side dish it took 5 mins to get. Consider we were the only customer. Just please dont go if u dont wanna waste ur money. There r many good ones in KL.Show less

Author: HillB79
Title: Nice little dinner spot after Kuah's night market
Review: We found Haroo+ after wondering through Kuah's night market. Menu was your typical Korean fare - bbq, bimbimbap etc. We were pleasantly surprised at the quality of food and it was delicious!

Author: Richard A
Title: Tasty Korean Fare
Review: Nice, cosy Korean restaurant in the Kuah area of Langkawi. Prices are decent and it carries an extensive menu with signature Korean dishes. This particular outlet is non-halal, but there is another branch at Pantai Tengah that is pork-free.

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Maybe better for lunch
Review: I was looking forward to eating here with all the great reviews! I was a little disappointed to be honest.So I started off with the deep fried pork dumplings and they were excellent. Big portion and piping hot. Loved them!So they don’t have udon noodles, so I ordered grilled beef. It was not bad but it was not great either. The other party did not like it because it did seem greasy. The rice that comes in a bowl and you mix it up, this was my least favourite dish. I just did not like the flavours in this dish.I can’t say I’d return for dinner but the dumplings are enough for lunch so I’d definitely return for this dish at lunch time!Show less

Author: LucasHackethal
Title: Nice foot in a cozy place with friendly staff
Review:
Good korean food with a lot of choices. We did not try their speciality, korean grill.
A few vegetarian choices. Ibim Bap lacked a bit of spices.
All in all good dinner

Author: elsiechen15Taipei, Taiwan
Title: Pricey but big portion
Review: Considering the price, the quality and taste of the food I expected was a bit higher. But overall a decent meal, recommended the seafood pancake, better than the ones I tries in other places around the world. The staff and owner were very helpful and friendly too!Show less

Author: 667limePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: Food quality is decent although not one of best as some dishes tastes slightly overpowering. Pricing is more on the expensive side thus comes with larger food portions.Service is below expectations as staff is not friendly and Not very welcoming.Also severely understaffed as only a single waiter that struggles to serve 2 tables is present during lunch hour.Interior is clean and furnishings are pretty decent with clear inspirations from traditional styles though lighting can be more improved.With pricing and service considered,I personally wouldn’t recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: roxanner2018
Title: Great Korean restaurant
Review: We went several times to this restaurant while our stay in Langkawi and really enjoyed their menu. We recommend the bibimbap and the spicy chicken! The owner is real nice and offered us free ice creams for dessert ;)

Author: jaewooc370Angeles City, Philippines
Title: Nice Korean restaurant!!
Review: Our family was craving for some korean food near our hotel and we found Haroo+. Went there around 4pm with the family, we ordered different food for everybody to taste different foods we were all satisfied. The service crew was very nice. Even gave us icecream after our meal. Free water for everyone and nice side dishes!!Show less

Author: AlexanderT3311
Title: Great service
Review: Good food and very friendly service by the owner.  Definitely will recommend to others. Kimchi and sides were great

Author: wwwwaltwalterSingapore, Singapore
Title: Extra service for our large group
Review: Food and service were great! The group of us came in on a rainy night where it was pretty much empty. The waiter served our every need, even offering us complimentary ice cream and dishes. It's a shame it's not as accessible to those who don't stay in the area.Show less

Author: 984viviens
Title: Great!
Review: Really nice food and Location ! The service is also really kind and helpfull. I would recommend this Place.

Author: jo59oz
Title: Great Korean food
Review: A surprising little gem in the Langkawi Fair shopping mall. The food was delicious. We were given a tasting plate of Korean dishes and ice cream as a bonus!

Author: 654carters
Title: Big portions with a big bill
Review: My family ate here and we thought the food was good with very generous portions, but the bill reflected it. It’s a much more expensive restaurant than most we experienced on the island. The staff was friendly and gave complimentary starter plate and ice cream but was still too expensive. Show less

Author: VintageWernerLudwigshafen, Germany
Title: Nice food at Haroo+
Review: We went for a dinner there and enjoyed the food and the friendly service. Worth to mention that the restaurant is (moderately) airconditioned which makes a dinner more relaxed. Compared to local prices of this type of restaurant, it is rather on the high side, but we would surely go there again during a next trip.Show less

Author: Wei Siong G
Title: Disappointed and Overpriced
Review: Was eager to give it a try especially with many positive comments in TA. Indeed it was disappointing with the quality of the food. Price wise is at the high side in comparing to its portion.

Author: Maninder S
Title: excellent service & food
Review: we got a very pleasant dinner the food was delicious. the service guy was very friendly with us. the place was absolutely fantastic.if we go Langkawi again we would like to come back here .

Author: Shane B
Title: Just dropped in.
Review: Very welcoming and very friendly. Food good and serves wine!(big plus) Their kimchi was amazing. Loved it!

Author: AprilsAngelKuching, Malaysia
Title: It's just ok
Review: Was here for lunch last week after reading the review on TA. Tbh food was just ok. We had kimchi jiggae and the pancake. Maybe the cook had an offday that day, we'll never know. I have tasted better. But on the positive side, service was pretty good though so that's a plus point. And they have wi-fi too. If asked would I go back, probably not. But then again, to each his own  Show less

Author: AllanN595
Title: So-so and a little overpriced
Review: Environment: Pretty cozy.Location: Easy to spot on and very easy to get parking (if you drive).Staff: Very friendly.Food: Hmmm... We ordered quite few dishes but none of them meet our expectation. The pancake we ordered was too thick, but full of ingredients (mostly vege tho). We ordered two set of meals, big portion but not really appetizing and the price is slightly higher compared to Korean restaurants in KL. Oh yeah, about their sidedishes... Not nice.Overall, need to improve on food quality and revise the price. Show less

Author: 722ludovicr
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review:
Everything in this restaurant is nice. From a good and friendly service to an excellent and fresh food.
Been there many times, i totally recommend that place.

Author: WirawanM2
Title: Great food and service
Review: I go for lunch at haroo with my partner its was great experience for me having korean food my partner like the seafood pancake it was awsom n we got side dishes as well i love the kimchi the service man provides us more kimchi it was really tasty with pan cake . I highly recommend this place . After the food done we were served with ice cream which makes our day .Show less

Author: R3125SY_
Title: Good food and service
Review: The foods order was great, love their kimchi. The food served was generous and tasty. Lastly, thanks for the complimentary ice cream.

Author: rj8382
Title: Very friendly and a great bbq
Review: As expected it was a very pleasant meal. The waiter helped with the bbq and was very friendly. The food was excellent and was one of the best Korean BBQ I’ve had anywhere.

Author: Kelly I
Title: Fabulous
Review: My partner and I went to haroo + for dinner, both the food and service were great. My favourite was the bibimbap - awesome! Super generous serve. We also had a vegetable omelette dish which was great and beef in lettuce leaves. The restaurant is very clean and quite nice inside.. overall, delicious! Show less

Author: Roy F
Title: First visit
Review: A visit with friends, great food and service. Either BBQ or menu service. Hot, fresh and filling. The service is first rate, I would recommend to anyone.

Author: kashif1111
Title: Great Food
Review: Delicious and tasty. Atmosphere and seating is comfortable. Quit place to really enjoy your food. taff is very cooperative.

Author: mha28
Title: Really delicious!
Review:
Don’t be fooled by the simplicity of this place... the food here is simply amazing.
We had the Bibimbap,  Spicy Seafood Noodles, and Beef Beokum.  Just lovely!

Author: zaclai
Title: Really good restaurant
Review: I went together with my girlfriend, btw it is the best Korean food restaurant I ever had, NICE FOOD, nice service

Author: 624talula
Title: Average
Review: Not much to say on this place other than it was just average. We had higher expectations based on its rating.

Author: Richard C
Title: Saturday Night in town
Review: We looked at the reviews and we were not disappointed, not haute cuisine but exactly what it said on the tin, BBQ cooked at the table food was interesting and was excellent value, with attentive and friendly service......... a good place to stop and eat

Author: Michael DPretoria, South Africa
Title: Great food with friendly staff !
Review: We ate there twice, the 1st meal was stunning - spicy seafood soup & jap che ( I think that's how you spell it ) & the 2nd meal was fried beef & a mixed kind of stirr fry was just as good ! Each time we received a complimentary cookies & cream ice cream which was served in a cold bowl - such a professional business touch .We have been blessed to have visited 8 countries in the last 10 years & each time we rate one restaurant as the most memorable in the country . Haroo the Korean restaurant is by far the best place we ate at on our trip to Malaysia in 2018 !Show less

Author: Paradise320633
Title: Kuah is a dump...
Review: ...but this place is a real gem. Nice interior, friendly staff and good food. Best kimchi I’ve had in Asia.

Author: Sunnytan30Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food Great Price
Review: Went to the one at Pantai Cenang and realised that they shifted and decided to come here on another day. Ordered Beef Plate (MYR120.00 for 2 person) Kimchi and Seaweed Soup for 2 Adult and a Kid, was more than sufficient to fill us. Staff helped us with grilling the beef, which is tender and juicy, and they served brown rice. Kimchi was good and it comes in 100g for MYR6.00 per serve. Restaurant was rather quiet and I saw only 4 tables for the duration we were there. They accept cash only and remember to bring enough. For those driving, there’re parking lots just in front of the restaurant. Show less

Author: Simin S
Title: Good food with afforable prices!
Review:
Food was good, big portions and afforable prices! Free side sides! Kimchin was spicy! Worth to try! 

Grab services was very convienent in Lankawi too!

Author: nikkitravelsaround
Title: Was let down.
Review: Had the Korean BBQ. Service was good. But the flavours were not. After reading such positive reviews, I was surprised that the beef was not very well marinated. It didn't help that it was also over-cooked and tough. In contrast, every one of the little side dishes was too salty: fish cake, omelete, some kind of vege pancake. Even the gochujang sauce. I know the gochujang is usually quite salty - but the other flavours also need to balance the salt too. That didn't happen here. You might be asking: why didn't I just mix the beef (lacking in marinade) with the gochujang and kim chi, or side dishes, to combine the flavours? I did. I had to. But it was like flavours clashing and fighting - rather than working together like an orchestra. This kind of beautiful harmony was what I had experienced at Daorae Korean in Melaka last week. And after Daorae, this experience really let me down.Show less

Author: CharlieonTravelLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing vegetarian food in Langkawi
Review: Loved this restaurant! It's by far the best food on the island. We actually went to the other Haroo the first day we arrived in Langkawi after we got off the ferry. Both were really good, but we hadn't realised that the two restaurants were slightly different and had a different menu. This Haroo+ had a full vegetarian section on their menu, whereas in the other we had to ask specially for a vegetarian dish. We had vegetarian bibimbap - it was a really unique version of the dish. Purple rice, lettuce, fresh veggies, fried egg, spicy sauce, tofu and a small amount of seaweed. We loved it! There were also complimentary side dishes including kimchi and little omelettes which we thought were a really lovely touch. The woman who I think owned the restaurant truly cared that all of her customers enjoyed her food - it was so lovely to see. Staff were great and all very accommodating. By far the best restaurant in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Jonny1133
Title: Great food - something dofferent
Review:
I’ve never had Korean food before. It was really nice. Good service, too and well priced. I would definitely go again!
Recommend the o-jing eo bokkeum (spicy stir fried squid) and the Maesil Cha (plum and honey tea)

Author: Martin1Locke
Title: Make the journey
Review: This place is amazing, of you are in Langkawi where what you are staying on the island this place is worth the trip I promise you will not be disappointed!

Author: Amigohauer
Title: Great Korean BBQ
Review: Very good food, quick service and nice environment. I would recommend to anyone who wants a good value fo money meal

Author: 721clarkem
Title: Dinner
Review:
Had an amazing bbq dinner at Haroo+ 
We had the bbq for two the pork the service was great food was amazing . Would highly recommend a visit when in Langkawi

Author: NicolamaguoloPadua, Italy
Title: Good Korean BBQ
Review: We had dinner for 2. We chose the beef BBQ set, it comes with free flow appetizers. Selection type of meat could be more, however the beef was tender and fresh. The meat was prepared in front of our eyes by the friendly staff. Reasonable price and portion.Show less

Author: JayC327New York City, New York
Title: Legit Korean Food
Review: We are Korean-Americans from NY on vacation in Langkawi. We were jonesing for some Korean food and found Haroo on TripAdvisor. Based on stellar reviews we decided to roll the dice. We are glad we did. The restaurant itself is in a strip mall and is clean. We ordered soju and Hite beer. It was pretty cool to have some soju in Langkawi. In term s of food, we ordered Kimchi fried rice, Kimchi pancake, see week soup, bean paste soup, soon tofu, bulgogi, jap chat and stir fried octopus. We honestly weren't expecting too much but we were pleasantly surprised by the quality and taste of food. I wouldn't go so far as to say that the food was as good as Korean restaurants in NY but it was definitely delicious and serviceable. Even the banchan (side dishes) was decent. Glad we found the place and if I ever return to Langkawi, I'd definitely comeback to Haroo+.Show less

Author: 852suk
Title: Delicious - just what I needed
Review: Ordered the BBQ set for 2, comes with 2 kinds of beef, unmarinated beef steak & bul-go-gi, bean paste stew, and jap-chae. Added steamed eggs (gae-ran jjim). All delicious and the portions are very generous. You can tell how good the Korean Restaurant is by their kimchi (side dish) and it was very good and perfectly fermented. The owner and the staff are extremely friendly, and the restaurant is very clean and nicely decorated. Show less

Author: Saiqa4jawad
Title: Superb Service
Review: It is located near underwater world. I went there and I was really impressed by the service provided by the waiters and the kind behaviour and well manners of workers have win my heart and the food was lush. Food was delivered in minutes.

Author: Gabriela D
Title: Fantastic Food!!
Review: After struggling to find anywhere that did decent vegetarian food Haroo was a breath of fresh air. Highly recommend to anyone, the food was very tasty and the drinks are great!

Author: emilytheobaldMayfield, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Korean food
Review: We went here due to reading good reviews. We had the chicken with glass noodles and veg and a beef rice & salad dish with optional spicy sauce. The staff were welcoming, food came quickly and we were given other samples of traditional side dishes too. Very tasty and filling dishes.Show less

Author: RosemaryT415
Title: Great food
Review: My friends and I had a sumptuous lunch here . I don't know much abt ordering Korean food but with the help of a helpful and friendly waiter, we thoroughly enjoyed our lunch and all the dishes we ordered..Price was decent too.

Author: Martin18_SKKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Korean food with great service
Review: All meals and drinks are fresh, simple and still rich with various flavors (sweet, chilli, spicy, sour). Not all are same. I recommend Kimchi as side dish or even pancake.Highly appreciate service and really welcomed approach (they adjusted meal for vegan) which is not common in MY (and countries around).One suggestion, I will prefer to pay by credit card as mostly you will spend RM100+Looking forward to come again!Pay only by cash!Visited as couple Aug 2017Show less

Author: CaitLou89
Title: Must Try
Review: Great food and great customer service! The seafood soup is a must try and the beef platter was thoroughly enjoyed by my husband! Not to expensive either

Author: 800lindseyc
Title: Fantastic Good, personal service
Review: Thank you to the team at Haroo.With your help to choose our meals we had a wonderful meal enjoyed by all of us.Without a doubt the best meal whilst in Langkawi by far. We arrived as strangers but felt like we left as friends.Highly recommend to anyone wanting a great experience matched with amazing food.Thank you once again, hope too be back again soon :) Show less

Author: mariofx123Malta
Title: Superb
Review: Authentic korean cuisine. Nice place, polite and well informed staff, superb food! Recommended+++. We choose the special menu and it was worth every penny. You can choose between 3 types of meat and it comes complete with soup, sides and dessert. Well done especially to our waiter who cooked our meat on the table to perfection. Show less

Author: YunKaiL3Madrid, Spain
Title: Amazing food and experience
Review: Great food and very very impressive service! The server recommended us the bibimbap and kimchi pancake which were both heavenly. Even gave us a free glass noodle dish, tea, and sweets! Show less

Author: thuyduyen_no1New York
Title: First BBQ in Langkawi, great experience!
Review: Visited this restaurant on our second night in Langkawi. The food was by far the best meal I had eaten during 6 days in Malaysia. The staff was very friendly and helpful, especially Mr Gery. He would do all for us, all we have to do was just sit back, relax and prep our tastebuds for the best BBQ of our life. When we was gone out to wait for taxi, he prepared chairs for us. It was really touchy! Highly recommend for Korean BBQ experience!Show less

Author: RubiYAYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and staff!
Review: I have learnt that if you enter a restaurant, and it doesn't smell of food, it's probably not gonna be great..When you enter Haroo+:Nice smell- yes Friendly staff (hello to the waiter from Rajasthan) - yesCustomers enjoying their food - yesWe are off to a good start!We had the Chicken glass noodles, which the lady boss modified to make spicy. They're generous with meat and veggies. Our meat was the Beef Bokkeum? Hot Plate (unfamiliar with the actual name, sorry). While we can't comment on the authenticity, they sure tasted good! And so we left with happy bellies and RM90 lighter Show less

Author: KayneLeeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious authentic korean meals with warmth and friendly waiters and host
Review: Their korean cuisine tastes delicious and seems like mum's cooking. We ordered bibimbap and soondubu jjigae. As usual, multiple vegetables are served in the bibimbap with rice and fried eggs, my friend can't really mix them well, so the owner came to rescue and he is really a kind old man and taught us the way to do so. Since we only ordered two sets, the number of side dishes is limited, but I love their homemade kimchi which tastes exactly like "Mum's cooking" even though it may not be the best for all. My soondubu jjigae taste good with the rice as well. Meanwhile during our meal, the daughter of the owner and the chef do came by our table to ask for comments and so. Not to mentioned the politeness of the owner's and his family, even the waiters are so nice. It was a hot day that day, so the waiter finally served us a cup of juice before we departed to airport to head home and this made a extraordinary conclusion to our short trip here in Langkawi with outstanding meals and service in this small yet beautiful island.Show less

Author: sumar93Denpasar, Indonesia
Title: Lunch
Review: We followed the positive reviews of TripAdvisor and came to this great restaurant. The food we ordered was very delicious and the staff was super friendly! Very recommendable! Show less

Author: LizzieBennet1982Petaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Love this place!
Review: Nice deco,good food and best of all the service..the waiter went out of his way to get my husband a slice of cake for his birthday! Thts a service you dont easily get! It made my husband so happy! Thank you so much Haroo! We will be back ! Show less

Author: argenkiwi
Title: Vegetarians welcome
Review: The prices here are no the lowest in Kuah, but are still very good compared to most western countries. The quality of the food is outstanding and we managed to order a fully vegetarian meal for 4 which we really enjoyed. The service and environment are very good as well.Show less

Author: chrisjn2016
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Just been for dinner, 4 adults and two kids. Everyone loved it, great grub, treated really well and hoping to go back before we leave Langkawi. Thanks a bunch!

Author: denise bMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great option for family meal
Review: our group of 15 were looked after really well by Isabella and her staff. Very good korean , with a variety of choices - best foods, glass noodles and vegetarian bibimbap. Show less

Author: dufmak
Title: Great food, excellent hospitality
Review: Two thumbs up! We licked the plates :). If u look for Korean restaurant that serves fresh and authentic Korean, yup u got the right place. If you haven't tried Korean, give a try. You will love it, if you have okay spicy tolerance, you can order pretty much anything, just pick ur favourable ingredient. The owner is always at the door welcoming you and he would love to recommend the dish for you. Hope you guys enjoy this place as we did.Enjoy ur time in LangKawiShow less

Author: MZutphenUtrecht Province, The Netherlands
Title: Incredible!
Review: We came here expecting great Korean food - what we got was exceptional food and fantastic service!We didn't have cash on us, so they offered to let us borrow their scooter to go to an ATM!Afterwards we got a small, yet very thoughtful gift from the owner!!Thank you very much for this, we'll never forget this experience. Show less

Author: smileykoLos Angeles, California
Title: Great Korean Food in Kuah
Review: I was just here for lunch. This is located on the edge of Kuah Town. Must be famous since the taxi driver already knew about this place. As it turned out this lady owns 3 restaurants on the island. Been here ten years. Speaks English well and so are the staff. A handsome young man Tony served me. I had the grilled beef and the wonderful seaweed soup with chicken. Now I grew up in Los Angeles so I ate Korean often. The beef was very good but the seaweed soup was awesome. If you get tired of the local local this is the place to be in Kuah.Show less

Author: Ivar KTallinn, Harjumaa, Estonia
Title: Korean experience in Kuah
Review: Words cannot describe the feeling and tastes of this place. We liked the personal touch at this place too because of the owner of the place who welcomes each guest. BBQ, soups and additional food were all equallt great. I really recommend this place to enjoy authentic Korean food and friendly staff.Show less

Author: lukashatzjamMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing food & service
Review: Fantastic customer service, they were happy to help and genuinely wanted us to enjoy our experience. Food was delicious and not overpriced. Would highly recommend this restaurant. Show less

Author: Paul GBeckenham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food! Great Experience! Don't Miss!
Review: Fantastic food, prepared and served with great care by Isabella and the team. First experience of Korean food and it was just amazing. Everything carefully explained to help us in our choice of dishes and the flavours and tastes were superb. Not just a meal but an occasion and we spent a really enjoyable evening here. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Peter MChalfont St Peter, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food!
Review: Never tried Korean before! Found the food to be excellent; very tasty! The service was polite and very helpful. Being novices to Korean food, my wife and I asked for help deciding on something to eat; we like spicy, but not into hot hot and we're aware it can be very spicy. Our host gave a good guide of the food, we chose a few dishes and waited for it arrive! We were first brought 4 little appetiters to try of which 3 hit the mark! Followed by the most amazing chicken rice dish and a chicken noodle dish - very tasty, demolished at speed and both talking about which night of our holiday to return! Might even try a spicy dish too! We had the Bibimbap and the Jap Chae.Show less

Author: MarlousJ1The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Great korean restaurant
Review: Friendly staff, great food, visited twice,both excellent. The Korean barbeque is a must eat. Enjoy your food! Show less

Author: DmadzPreston, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Korean BBQ
Review: We loved this place. Unfortunately it was very quiet when we visited but we can't understand why. Lovely owner, attentive staff and amazing food. We had the Korean BBQ with beef and thoroughly enjoyed it. Wish we could have it all over again. Highly recommend! Show less

Author: Greg KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and atmosphere!
Review: Thankfully the manager at the hotel we stayed recommended this "hidden gem"! A bit out of the way but incredibly worth the visit.Greeted by the charming Korean owner and the staff was very helpful to explain unfamiliar dishes. We went for the Korean BBQ, which seems to be one of their specialties and it was fantastic! The ingredients of high quality, delicious home made kimchi and a most generous portion. Highly recommended, do not miss! Show less

Author: GuyfromkzAlmaty, Kazakhstan
Title: Good korean house food
Review: We were greeted by owner, which cooks as well. Nice home made korean barbecue and adequate prices. Possibly one of decent places in Kuah town. Show less

Author: Patrick Z
Title: Love everything about this place.
Review: Loved the food. Loved the service and the friendly hosting. Loved the ambience. Loved the price. Overall by far the best food we've had in 4 days on the island. We didn't go for the Korean bbq, instead we had some Korean fried rice as well as glass noodles. And some tapas appeared on our table as well.. Absolutely loved the flavours.Go here and be a happy eater. Show less

Author: SJBMBLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food, Amazing Service
Review: We loved it here, our highlight of our trip to Langkawi!Isabella and the team were so welcoming and happy to explain all the different foods on offer. In particular we loved the indoor Korean BBQ, do try it, its a great experience. We came here several times and each time tried something different off the menu and we didn't have one bad dish, each dish was better than the last. Its rare to find a restaurant that gives both amazing food and amazing service - but Isabella has achieved this - "gam sa hahmida" - I hope I've remembered to say thank you properly in Korean!Show less

Author: tobiaslindforsLulea, Sweden
Title: Great experience!
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed our visit to this restaurant, the host helped us order since this was our first time eating at a Korean restaurant and she even supplied us while we were waiting for our food with lots of small dishes so we got to try the food to the fullest!The place was clean and a very cozy atmosphere , tough the location of the restaurant is central in Kuah it's easy to miss since it's situated a bit "behind" the other restaurants and shopping malls.I would highly recommend this restaurant for anyone that's interested in trying out Korean food!Show less

Author: Mohd S
Title: Good, soulful food
Review: On a whim I decided to have a quiet lunch here and just like the other sister outlets (they have 3 altogether) this one doesnt dissappoint. The menu differs from the other 2, and I would say Haroo+ offers the best spread of what they are really good at making - deeply flavourful dishes served with heart. The staff is super friendly and nice, a mirror of the sweet and affable Korean owner. This lunch, I ordered a bowl of Spicy Tofu and Vege dish, which comes bubbling in an adorable cauldron of sorts, along with 4 side dishes - cabbage pickle, kimchi, vege pancake and ommelete roll slices, to be savoured with rice. Just this order alone satisfies a big eater like myself (and I declined the rice mind you!).I often leave any of the Haroo completely sated and happy with the yummies in my tummy, and this time, it rang true again. If I ever leave Langkawi, I will miss this place sorely.  Give Haroo+ a try and see what I mean.Amazing!Show less

Author: N6374PS_Moscow, Russia
Title: Nice dinner for two
Review: Everything was very tasty, not spicy! Excellent service and adequate pricing. The soups were VERY delicious!Show less

Author: ChristoTngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, Great Service
Review: Visited on 28 Dec. 2016. A Korean family run restaurant that serve authentic Korean food. The young lady host is very friendly and her service staff, a local male staff was extremely attentive to all customer needs, making sure all customer are being taking care of. Very good service, highly recommended.Show less

Author: smgallagher17
Title: Very good
Review: Excellent friendly service , with lovely flavours in there Korean food a bit out of the way but worth the taxi to find it

Author: minjeh1980Alor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Korean food
Review: The place is cosy, food was good. It's authentic Korean food. Kimchi was delicious. It also has Korean BBQ at price of about RM 120 for 2 person. Menu was quite complete with rice, soups, noodles. Portion is quite big, the Bibimbap was good. I considered the prices are quite reasonable. Eg, a large bowl of Bibimbap is price at RM 28, beef platter at RM 60. The hosts are Koreans, very friendly. Service was exceptional.Show less

Author: conorw2015Greystones, Ireland
Title: Delicious food & great service.
Review: This was our first time having Korean food and the woman who runs the place was really helpful. She gave us plenty of recommendations and brought out a load of little sampler dishes so we could experience loads of Korean food. Our main course was really tasty. Will probably return for a second visit.Show less

Author: Colin C
Title: Good korean food
Review: Service by Korean lady boss is good. She is very kind and gave us a free seafood rice ball. Food is nice. Beef quality is good but can be pricey.

Author: corylim2467George Town, Malaysia
Title: Delicious korean food with excellent service
Review: The food here is well-cooked and fresh. The waiters are giving good service politely.The very first time I ate White KimChi here. Side dishes are refillable . This restaurant owned by a lady from Korea . She t9ld me that all ingredients is delivered from Korea & everything is home made .Show less

Author: cecilieliv
Title: Great food
Review: The food was really tasty, and the service great. The owner of the restaurant welcomed us and gave us great advice on the food. We are definitely going back.

Author: Mark53_Chef
Title: Good food
Review: Visit here on Monday, a bit quiet only 2 tables including us. The foods are good we both love the food, very big portion.

Author: yiny915
Title: Welcomed with warmth
Review: "we were greeted with warm and friendly staff as we entered the restaurant. The staff explained clearly what the menu are and this ease us in ordering what we wanted. Foods are served in a nice order, from appetizers to desserts. Food portion is big (to us) and is definitely worth the price. Our orders are delicious and I would like to rate it a 4.5 out of 5.0 . This restaurant is yet to accept credit card payment. Show less

Author: NicodoranBrisbane, Australia
Title: Delicious Korean with exceptional service!
Review: Took my mother here for her first Korean restaurant experience. She was quite impressed by the food. The staff were on point, always checking on us & topping up our dishes. The food was a tad expensive for our budget but worth it for a night.Show less

Author: 222yahoo22Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: You Might Want The Rice To Come Last.....
Review: Great food with nice service....can't ask for more. I noticed quite a number of diners unable to finish the rice. Well I guess maybe I know why.....cause I ordered a meal that comes with rice and I requested to have it without rice. Well it's a nice touch for the restaurant to use brown/purple rice(healthy option) instead of ordinary white rice. However the meals are already of generous serving with vegetables/meat and comes with free appetizers. So I personally think rice became too much for me. If you are new to this place, I would like to suggest that you can wait till all food were served before deciding how much rice you need.They have Kimchi available for take-away.Show less

Author: cyyeoh
Title: Nice Korean Food
Review: Although small restaurant but food here is tasty and nice!Good environment to have a stop and kind service from waiter !highly recommend

Author: gary_han416Singapore, Singapore
Title: Recommended!!!
Review: Clean and hospitable. All the dishes are delicious. Many free pickles and kimchi!Enjoy! Recommend to all!Show less

Author: RachelSingerBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: We really enjoyed dinner at Haroo+. The food quality is outstanding and the service is very attentive. Price is 24 RM to 35 RM for most dishes with kimchee starters and a sweet drink (orange juice for us) at the end complementary. Wonderful Korean hospitality! Show less

Author: reflectionsv37Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Haroo+ just became my favorite restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: Based on other TripAdvisor reviews, we stopped in for lunch yesterday. Haroo+ is everything I love in a restaurant. Spotlessly clean, excellent service and flavorful dishes that look as exciting as they taste.As a foodie, I'm an adventurous eater and always enjoy trying new flavors. Haroo+ does not disappoint. The menu is beautiful and has such an assortment of spectacular dishes that it was difficult to make a decision. The helpful staff made some recommendations and I finally settled on a chicken noodle dish that was so filled with new flavors I can't wait to come back to try some of their other dishes. The four included appetizers just added to the whole experience.Based on other reviews, I was compelled to try the Korean grape drink. It is sweet drink but what surprised me most was watching whole grapes pour out from the can! This is not your typical syrupy purple drink that most think of when you mention grape soda.I can highly recommend Haroo+ and can't wait to return and try some of their other dishes! Superb!Show less

Author: 382sherisHonolulu, Hawaii, United States
Title: A taste of Korea!
Review: The small restaurant was clean and inviting! The wait staff was very friendly and efficient. All the dishes on the menu looked so good that it was difficult to decide. I had the Haemul Pajeon, a type of seafood and vegetable frittata. It was delicious!! They served Kimchi appetizers too. After the meal the waiter brought us some cold apple cider. I can't wait to go back and try some of the other dishes.Show less

Author: pws3932Penang, Malaysia
Title: Travel
Review: The food there is good and tasty, albeit a little spicy. The portion is good. The shop offers free refills for various appetizers upon requests. The only downside is that they are rather shorthanded and requires better air conditioning Show less

Author: Synitta W
Title: Very accommodating!
Review: My boyfriend and I went to Haroo for dinner expecting very few options as we are vegan. The waiter was extremely helpful and told us he could prepare us a vegan meal and assured us it would be meat, egg and fish free. The food was delicious, very tasty.The waiter was very attentive and after our meal the chef came out of the kitchen to ask if we enjoyed our food- very personal touch.Would definitely recommend to anyone! Show less

Author: Muchadoaboutnothing
Title: Authentic Korean!
Review: We had a great dinner and the team were so gracious in preparing porridge for our baby! Authentic Korean cuisine and certainly a must-try! One of our best meals on the island!

Author: 980JonathanMRowley Regis, United Kingdom
Title: Spicy nicey
Review: Me and my partner came here as we were sick of paying over the odds at The Westin and after reading many reviews about this place I'm glad we came.We had a late dinner about 8.30pm and we were the only ones in the restaurant. The service was very friendly and the waiter had a great sense of humour. The Kim Chi tasted excellent and my main beef meal was full of flavour. They also sent us a couple extra tasters which was a nice touch. Our total meal including starters came to about 100RG and we felt we definitely got our money's worth. We highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: Loves_good_service
Title: Delicious Korean favorites and lovely service
Review: My husband and I had lunch here today after seeing the great reviews on TripAdvisor. My bibimbap was full of wonderful fresh vegetables, with some nice crunch let to them. My husband had the bulgogi, which was served with cellophane noodles and broth. And, the kimchi was varied and a tasty accompaniment. On a little side street in Kuah, so there was plenty of parking. Show less

Author: Leonie1124Brisbane, Australia
Title: Spectacular, fresh, delicious Korean
Review: Best Korean restaurant in Langkawi. Price is very reasonable. RM20 for noodles, and RM25 for the hearty traditional Korean chicken, veg and rice dish. The staff offered great service. After a disappointing meal in Cenang the night before, Haroo's food was a welcome relief - fresh and delicious!Show less

Author: SleepyKolaPenang, Malaysia
Title: Great Korean Restaurant!
Review: Best Korean restaurant in Langkawi. Price is acceptable. RM20+ for noodles, RM10+ for snacks and drinks cost about RM8. The restaurant have beautiful korea style deco and a big tv playing kpop mv. We arrive earlier than their opening hours, they open their shop earlier for us as we are rushing for boat. Great service!Show less

Author: quekc2016
Title: Korean BBQ
Review: The service is very good and entertaining. However, the food is quite disappointing. The pork is full with fats and lack of meat. Plus they were quite reluctant to refill the Korean snacks that are usually given for free and unlimited in other Korean restaurants. Although the staff is good and friendly, I do not recommend this restaurant for Korean food.Show less

Author: MellowtraxCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Great Korean restaurant
Review: After reading the comments on Tripadvisor we decided to try Haroo+ during our trip to Kuah. The restaurant was located away from the duty free shopping area, but was easy to find. The selection was very good and the food was very tasty (and spicy). The service was friendly and attentive, the prices are very fair, and I can easily recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: MattMullard
Title: Lovely little Korean in Kuah
Review: Lovely little restaurant with the most amazing tasty food and friendly staff, right around the corner from the night food market

Author: Narcissus666Williton, United Kingdom
Title: Really excellent Korean Food
Review: This authentic Korean restaurant is not much to look at from the outside and is tucked away a few yards down a side street off the main street in Chenang. Top quality ingredients in a very simple and modest session. Don't come here if you don't like plastic plates and a rustic feel. Do come if you want authenticity at absolutely knock out prices. This is very unlike the overly commercial neighbouring restaurants in Chenang. So cheap its unbelievable. Who says you have to pay to eat great oriental food. Lovely hosts who speak little to no English but are welcoming and genuinely pleased if you pick something unusual. Try the nourishing and flavoursome seaweed soup and the Korean omelette. Show less

Author: leroimarcusSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious !
Review: Even though it may sound odd to eat Korean while on a trip in Malaysia, I couldn't quite resist this restaurant, given the #1 ranking in Kuah on trip advisor. I wasn't disappointed. We were 6 people with 2 kids and went there for dinner. The staff were adorable and the food was really delicious. Among the recommended meals are : Sea food soup, grilled sea food, glass noodle with chicken and some minced beef in a pot of brown rice and vegetables (named ~Bibimbo or something like that). The table next to us was having a Korean bbq and I guess that's what I'd have if I was going again.Show less

Author: Simon EReigate, United Kingdom
Title: Great place
Review: just been to haroo+ tonight for the first experience of Korean food all I can say is it was wonderful and a feast on your senses as taste buds.the staff are really friendly and will help you choose a dish if your unsure like we were I really like this place a real gem try it out Show less

Author: Bello183
Title: Best Korea Cuisine in Kuah
Review: A very good service provided by the very own lady boss...good food provided here seriously..will visit again next trip!

Author: erma d
Title: Wonderful simple experience..
Review: Nice food and nice treatment by the staff.. like it so much.. definitely will come back.. the price of the foods are affordable for good food experience..

Author: ellBem
Title: Fast, fresh and tasty
Review: interesting korean food, freshly prepared with care and served quickly. although the service was a little inexperienced on the night we went, samples of other dishes and friendly smiles more than compensated. One of the better meals we had in langkawi

Author: Yingy1986
Title: Haroo
Review: The food was delicious, we had the sea food bbq platter and another dish which was like a beef stir fry, the lady showed us how to eat the seafood platter with the lettuce was a great experience and very tasty Not a huge menu choice but made it so much easier too choose fromRestaurant cleanVery good value for money & fantastic customer service, we would most definitely recommend & visit againThank you Show less

Author: viktor o
Title: Great introduction to Korean food!
Review: Really friendly Staff and good food! It was our first time eating korean and the staff explained to us how  to eat the dishes. Thank you haroo+ for a great night!

Author: leonieruegg
Title: Excellent customer service!
Review: Customer service is excellent - they were really helpful with food suggestions and even brought out small tasters. I loved the plan Kimchi and the chicken porridge. Great food and great price! Would definitely go back when next in Langkawi.

Author: ElleSouthStaffsWest Midlands
Title: A Bit Disappointed
Review: It's perhaps a bit unfair to review this restaurant as the food just wasn't to my taste. Not really sure how it gets to be No. 1, the owner and staff are great but we had the kimchi to start which I thought was horrible and then I was given the wrong main course, I'd ordered something with beef and what I got had beef in it so I assumed it was the right thing as it was my first Korean meal and probably my last. It's a nice, air conditioned restaurant and as I said before the staff are really great compared to some of the other restaurants in the area but, sorry, I really couldn't recommend it.Show less

Author: Changsta888
Title: Great good and great service
Review: The food and service is exceptional the owner is very helpful.  The restaurant is just off the main Cenang road on a slightly dusty track but once you've tried the food you understand why it's so good.

Author: Petejacko87Woodlesford, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: We visited Haroo+ tonight after looking at restaurants and TripAdvisor. We were not disappointed. It was RM12 from our hotel (Westin) in a taxi and the staff opened the door for us as we exited the taxi. The decor was very tasteful but also casual and not over the top. The staff in this restauraunt were very very attentive. And so happy and friendly! This is what added to our enjoyment of the evening. We started with Kimchi. And were amazed at the amount of food that was brought out to us. My wife ate a beef and glass noodle broth with rice and I ate a spice beef dish with rice. And the food kept on coming!! This was the first place that we have encountered in our few days in Langkawi so far that we have tipped the staff because we delt that they deserved it and not because it was the correct/polite thing to do! As we left the restaurant the male waiting staff held the door open for us and the female waiting staff ran after us - because she had forgotten to give us a sweet with our bill. This was a very nice touch! Our total bill came to RM97 for starter/side, 2 mains, 3 beers and 10%service charge. Though we would certainly have paid more for this! We will certainly go back here before the end of our honeymoon!Show less

Author: 742sunilkBarcelona, Spain
Title: Amazing food, amazing service
Review: We had dinner twice there (which we rarely do as we normally like to try different restaurants) and the service great both the times. The food is quite authentic (I regularly have South Korean food in London but this tasted very authentic) and the staff are quite friendly and attentive. I highly recommend this restaurant. Show less

Author: chilledout12345Macclesfield, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant Introduction to Korean Food
Review: We visited this restaurant twice during our stay & are definitely turned on to Korean food! The staff advised us on what to choose depending on our love of spice & on both occasions gave us 4 mini portions of kimchi & other dishes gratis just to try. They even showed us how to eat the dishes. The food was delicious & the staff attentive, friendly & helpful. The place is spotless & decorated beautifully. Show less

Author: CKlow8
Title: Good Korean food
Review:
Friendly environment with superb Korean food. Good serving and using brown rice .

Strategic place in Kuah area near all those duty free shop.

Author: bushiryao
Title: Great Service and good food in friendly environment
Review: The restaurant is quant and clean in Kuah, Neo was friendly and very attentive, food was yummy and fresh and beer cold and refreshing.

Author: MRitaPintoLisbon, Portugal
Title: Amazing food and awesome service
Review: It was our first time in a Korean restaurant and it was the best experience ever. Not just because of the food but also because of the staff. We had these glass sweet potato noodles and their pancakes that were really perfect. We had other dishes but those two were amazing. The staff were really awesome and explained us how to eat every single dish.A compulsory stop in Langkawi, a must!Show less

Author: RwillcardiffBridgend, United Kingdom
Title: Worth a visit
Review: I had never eaten Korean food before, However, trip advisor reviews were all good so desided to give it a try. Apart from the noodle dish the rest was fine. Also, the staff were friendly and guided us through the menu which for first time customers was very much appreciated.Show less

Author: caveinacave
Title: Delicious
Review: Found this place to be very authentic with tasty dishes and very friendly staff. We even got a free jelly drink with our bill :-)

Author: Jocke S
Title: Great experience, wonderful food
Review: Friendly staff made food for picky children while the adults did a Korean BBQ with our own chef by the table. One of the best dining experiences of my 45 years on the planet.

Author: Lucy Z
Title: Amazing food and even more amazing service!
Review: The owner and staff of Haroo were incredibly warm and friendly and made us feel right at home. We had a great grilled beef plate and one of the specials, which was delicious as well. Very fresh and tasty food. We would definitely recommend!

Author: K5327ULMelbourne, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: We went there for lunch, friendly staff and good food. We never tried Korean before so I would say that was delicious but I can't compare to any other experience. Our waiter was really nice, he suggested us what to try based on our taste, perfect choice. We spent 80 rm for two people and we had two mains, two teas, some little side dishes and a taste of a typical drink. The price is a higher than local restaurants but it's worth it! Recommended! Show less

Author: KendrickNSandakan, Malaysia
Title: Friendly, courteous, nice food
Review: Got to this place view google map link available in TripAdvisor itself. Gotten ourselves a RM100 BBQ Korean set for 2. It's nice! The vegetables are fresh. Personally, kimchi was never my favorite before. But the kimchi they served taste a little different. Less sour, more savory. The ladybirds is nice with fluent English. The Burmese assistant could speak very well English too. Definitely a recommend for other users of TripAdvisor. Show less

Author: 807alvinlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't judge the book by it cover
Review: We visited Haroo + on 23 Sept and on the first impression, the restaurant look deserted without a single person inside.. We was like..is this the right place?The menu look interesting enough although the price is higher than KL, but since we're very hungry , we just go for itAnd man, the food is just totally delicious ! The glass noodles cooked in broth is totally amazing, great flavour and very fulfilling !My favourite is the white kimchi, very nice and strong. My bibimbap sure hit the spotGood service on the waiter that try his best to explain the menu and ensuring there no beef in our dish. Great food and service Lastly , they only accept cashShow less

Author: Ana J
Title: Amazing food and friendly staff!
Review: Me and my boyfriend had a meal here today after our visit in Kuah. Found this place on trip advisor and I must say the reviews here are well deserved. The food was amazing and the guy who served us was very friendly. Also the lady who owns the place was really friendly and brought us some tee after our meal on the house. Will come back again and we defenitely recomend this place if you are in Kuah and want an amazing meal at a reasonable price with great ambiance!Show less

Author: Joeychong91Perth, Australia
Title: Good service, good food.
Review: Friendly lady boss who greet us and check out on us several times throughout our time in the restaurant. Love the seafood noodles and grape juice recommended by 1 of the waiter. While waiting for our food to arrive, we get a complementary sour juice from the lady boss. Will definitely come back for more.Show less

Author: natashatheresar
Title: Delicious and affordable Korean!
Review: The vegetarian bibimbap was delicious!  And the gentleman serving us was super friendly.  It's off the main road, so one can have a quiet dinner.

Author: eugeneus-w
Title: Amazing food, people, and service!
Review: Went there after my Trip to tanjung Rhu and was greeted with extraordinary kindness. Warm reception and good service. The food is amazing and the owner is generous. Generally an astounding place to dine in. 5/5!

Author: CAngelineLGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Langkawi's hidden gem
Review: I have been to tons and tons of Korean restaurants, but nothing beats this. I love everything about Haroo+. The incredibly friendly owner and attentive staff, the lovely ambience and of course the exceptionally remarkable food. If you get a chance, try the BIBIMBAP and JAPCHAE! *thumbs up*Show less

Author: Wayne T
Title: Very good food, service and environment
Review: Came here to dine after reading on trip advisor, gonna leave a review on trip advisorPlace is a little difficult to find, but the food is really good. We had the tofu stew, glass noodles and the spicy cuttlefish. All were delicious and are highly recommended.The place is air conditioned and very comfortable. The lady boss was very friendly and spoke very good English. She chatted with us and even offered some extra side dishes which she made herself for us to sample. Would definitely recommend this place to everyone, the location is beside Azio duty free store, so don't forget to drop by for a visit. Not to be missed. The do close from 3pm-6pm for a break between lunch and dinner so don't visit then!Show less

Author: Hiew S
Title: Very nice
Review: Nice place nice food and nice people . The lady boss is friendly and recommended us to try the Korean dong Hun noddle . I love the ambient here. We had lunch before go back to kl. highly recommended .

Author: mattw494Twyford, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner Korean style in Langkawi
Review: If you find yourself in Kuah, which has not much to offer tourists, other than the duty free shops, make an effort to visit this Korean treasure, great food, enthusiastic staff and great with kids. We'd never tried Korean, but plucked up the courage and were rewarded with a fantastic meal - try the Korean BBQ for extra entertainmentShow less

Author: LeeC3800
Title: Korean food :Suitable for all...
Review: Friendly restaurant owner ready to serve the most delicious and traditional Korean food to you....highly recommended for those who travel in kuah town Langkawi.

Author: Edwin165Malaysia
Title: Excellent Korean Food & Service (Directions to shop below)
Review: Okay, I'll first describe the way to the restaurant as it took me half an hour driving in the vicinity before a kind soul pointed out the way for me. (I also promised the kind owner I'd do so)1. Coming from Jalan Padang Matsirat (from Berjaya / Pantai Cenang), go along the main road until you reach a traffic light with a timer (the only one in the whole island).2. Go straight at the traffic light. 3. Take the first left turn (where there is a sign saying 'Pekan Pandak Mayah' - see picture)4. Go straight until you see a Thai Seafood Restaurant on your right. Turn right.5. Go straight until you reach a traffic light.6. Go straight at the traffic light, but turn left before you reach a nearby, small bridge. (Don't cross the bridge)7. Go straight along the block. Haroo+ is on your left. Note: Nearby landmark includes Azio Duty Free and Uptown Hotel (slightly further)Okay, now for my review. This restaurant has had plenty of great reviews so I'll focus on what stood out for me. Firstly, the staff. The young-ish Korean owner and her Burmese staff were very kind and friendly. Besides talking to me and making me feel at home, the owner served me the food personally and even gave me free dishes like a rice with black sauce(don't know the name) and iced plum tea.I ordered bibimbap and seafood pancake. Bibimbap was very tasty - I didn't put much spicy sauce because the ingredients were so fresh and tasty. The beef was soft and juicy, which is rare in bibimbap. The seafood pancake was fantastic. Very flavourful and seafood-y. Highly recommended. Only downside is the (usual) huge portion. Best shared with friends.Finally, nice ambience at restaurant. Verdict: 5 star Show less

Author: Chuilynn
Title: Great food & friendly people
Review: We had our first dinner in langkawi at Haroo+, the food is great and the lady boss and staffs are really friendly. So the night before we leave langkawi we went back to Haroo+ for our dinner again, the lady boss and staff did recognized us and gave us some rice dishes to try, super friendly and hospitality. Great dining experience we had in Haroo+. Will definitely dine there again!Show less

Author: Wongwho
Title: Authentic Korean Meal
Review: The proprietress, a friendly lady cooks a sumptuous home cook Korean meal for a family of 7. Highly recommended for Korean meal in Kuah town.

Author: markjhiggsBeijing, China
Title: Outstanding Korean food and service
Review: After spending over seven years living in South Korea, I am well versed in good and bad Korean food. The food at Haroo is superb. We had the BBQ, the pajeon and sundaboo with the customary side dishes. The food ranked with the very best of eats in Korea, that's how good the food is.The service was outstanding, the lady owner and her staff are very warm, attentive and want you to have a positive dining experience, which we absolutely did.Additionally we had the ginger tea which was delicious, it was medicine in a cup.We are in Langkawi for 32 nights so we will be going back next week and the weeks after despite the restaurant being on the other side of the island.I recommend this restaurant to those who love Korean food, and for those who have never tried it, this is a perfect opportunity. This restaurant offers the very best of authentic Korean food with its flavours deriving from Jellamando province. A truly six star rating.Mark & NaraeShow less

Author: Charles H
Title: The BEST service ever in my life
Review: That's is my most memorable dining together with my family while celebrating my daughter' birthday at Haroo+. The service is excellent and the lady boss is so nice with the free birthday dish (seaweed soup) which os specially for birthday girl. The food is tasty and we really enjoy that moment.Show less

Author: sarahlC9286HQBendigo, Australia
Title: Beautiful service and food
Review: I visited this restaurant after seeing the reviews and it proved to be true. The staff were very helpful, in particular a young lady who is the chef. They made sure I was comfortable with the spicy food. The food was great - I love the kimchi. They also kindly added a few extras to try like a special drink to help with digestion and some miso. Really great Korean food experience. Thank you. Show less

Author: SandyWRAdelaideSurfers Paradise, Australia
Title: Great Korean food with personal service
Review: My daughter and I ate at Haroo after reading about reviews on Trip Advisor. We found our way here via a local taxi and had to wait 15 minutes until the doors opened at 6pm. This gave us time to walk around the local food market which is just down the street.Having not eaten a lot of Korean food we were a little unsure what to order or how much. We ended up ordering two meals for however we could have easily shared one between us.Food was good and the service was great with the chef coming out to ensure we were ok with the cuisine. Felt very welcome.Show less

Author: Ryan G
Title: Absolutely Worth It !
Review: New Branch in Kuah town. Reasonable price with sufficient portion. Best service I ever had. Will definitely visit again when I am back to Langkawi.

Author: John CKuching, Malaysia
Title: Little Korean Restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Owner is korean and very friendly and ask about our food. The foods is okay, nothing much to expect. maybe i am not used to Korean taste. Owner of restaurant is very friendly and asked about our food. She even gave us some Korean special drinks for free after meal. I will prefer to have seafood as there are plentiful in Langkawi. Little restaurant with different taste.Show less

Author: AdelineKooPetaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food, friendly servers. Definitely a MUST TRY!
Review: Had my first lunch in Langkawi there and I'm glad I made the right choice! Food was really good, very authentic Korean cuisine. Even my family that doesn't fancy Korea food loves it a lot! The server that attended us were really friendly and we feel very comfortable dining in there. Will definitely come back if I ever visit Langkawi again!Show less

Author: Tin TManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Baby!
Review: Best customer service I have seen all around in Malaysia, challenged my gf to finished her plate.Food was really blew my gf & I away, and then they gave uou the oppurtunity to taste a free dish which was a win-win situation.Toiletries were in excellent condition. Absolutely come back to Kuah just for this alone.Show less

Author: JoannaLowSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good authentic korean food
Review: Food was very good, fresh, generous in portion and authentic, though a little pricey (e.g. 35 RM for seafood noodle soup, 30 RM for bibimbap). Loved the fact that they serve brown rice! Service was not bad. Air-conditioning could have been better though. Not an easy feat to sip red hot spicy tofu soup in midday hot Langkawi.Show less

Author: rebeccalV4373WRMitcham, Australia
Title: Best Korean we've ever had
Review: Visited this gem of a place with our 3 young children for dinner after reading other reviews. We love Korean food and can honestly say this meal was the best we've ever had.Large portions, tonnes of fresh ingredients and some fantastic new flavors. Wait staff were brilliant and service was extremely fast. Pricing was also very reasonable for the quality of the meal and much cheaper than back home.Highly recommended by all of us!Show less

Author: AlexPhunLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: The Best Korean Food in town!
Review: Located at the centre of Kuah Town and easily accessed (few shops away from Azio Hotel) . If you are looking for nice and decent meal this restaurant will be your top choice. Operated by a group of great and friendly staffs, they will make you feel like friends rather than customers. Because it is only one shop lot space every customer's needs are well attended, be sure this will be one great experience korean cuisine you will have during visit to the island. Recommended food will be "Bibimbap", a big bowl of organic rice served with mixed vegetables, eggs, meat and etc. If you are a fan of noodles try on this seafood noodle, korean noodles served with fresh seafoods, beancurd, vegetables and etc. Every order will come with a few small side dishes ( eggs, kimchi, korean pancake). The portion of every meal is comparatively large and the average cost of a meal will only cost you around 10 usd. You will not regret!Show less

Author: Kevinkjsiah
Title: Awesome Korean food
