Review: Very friendly owner, even better Korean food at a affordable price . A definite must go if you're visiting kuah town

Author: 220ianh
Title: Excellent
Review: We stopped by for lunch by pure luck as restaurant we originally went to was closed. As soon as we walked in we had the most friendly of welcomes. Apparently it was the First anniversary of the restaurant. The owner

Author: madaboutscoobaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice restaurant, lovely staff and wonderful owner.
Review: Been to the Haroo's few nights ago with my beloved future wife. The menu was simple and straight forward and doesn't take much time before we finish could finish smoking a stick of cigarette the food was served. I was actually convinced by my GF to have dinner at this restaurant as she reads so many good reviews on the restaurant and glad that we did. We were surprised by 3 different types of "kimci" as an appetizer to begin with. Korean Honey Tea was also lovely, the only one in Langkawi. The restaurant may look small but the staff especially the lady which I believe is the owner if this place has a big heart. We live in Langkawi. Would we come back come to have dinner here? The answer is absolutely YES!!!Show less

Author: hallothere
Title: One the best best Korean food
Review: Went to the restaurant, it was quiet. The food was very good and authentic. The price was reasonable and portion was large. The owner was very friendly.

Author: teenagesab_87Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Humble . Good . Food . People
Review: Saw this restaurant in the leaflet map and decided to give it a try. Quiet and hidden gem with English oldies, Korean family run Korean restaurant, specialise in serving authentic Korean food, we chose Kimchi JjiGae (tuna and cabbage stew) and Bibimap for 4 since we've had nasi lemak in the car on the way from the rainforest to Pantai Cenang. Haroo+ (bright orange sign) is located near the big duty free shop on the opposite side of the road. P/s: Love the service + smiles of the owners =)Show less

Author: TMac860Melbourne, Australia
Title: One of the best korean meals we've ever had
Review: My partner and I had a lovely bbq korean dinner here. As we were having an early dinner, the restaurant was empty except for us. We had a vey attentive waiter who helped out with choosing our food, and with bbqing the meats. The proprietor also came over to have a chat, and she demonstrated how to eat korean bbq, by wrapping the meats in the provided lettuce and popping them in our mouths to indicate the right serving size! Throughout the meal, we were also given extra drinks, lettuce and sauces without being charged for it (even though these items normally attract a charge according to the menu).Compared to other korean bbq places we've been to, the servings were very large, and very tasty. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: RandGPBeverley
Title: Great food and very friendly staff/chef
Review: Went for evening meal based upon tripadvisor reviews and was not disappointed. Chef took the time to establish what we liked and whether we liked spicy food or not then made recommendations. We had the seafood pancake and bbq beef. As mentioned by others you get free taster and we also were given refreshing drink to cleanse the pallet. Very quiet but it seems to be most restaurants we have been to. Would recommend a visit if in the khua areaShow less

Author: Mianeumann
Title: Best food ever!
Review: Good service, best food ever 😊👍 a must do restaurant to go to. Go go go 😀👍🌴 eat eat eat 🍴 will only eat here and at "Haroo Haroo" (their other restaurant) the rest of our trip

Author: Perth31Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: We went here based on previous reviews and were not disappointed . Extremely pleasantt staff who were helpful with the menu . What we chose was excellent . Nice touches like little extra starters . We particularly loved the seafood pancake and beef platter.We will definitely return for a second visitShow less

Author: risakoC1
Title: Nothing special
Review:
There was nothing special.
The staff is kind & friendly, but the meal was not the thing which I expected.
But better than Korean restrant in KL.

Author: thaw n
Title: Do not miss it !
Review: Went there during staying in langkawiI almost missed that restaurant since that place was not on the main road.I tried korean pork bbq and that was really fantastic !the table was fixed specially for korean bbq and we grilled ourselve.That was fun experience.and they had complimentary side dishes as well .They were small dishes but full of flavour.And again the staff ( he was very friendly and funny guy ) gave us korean ice tea after finish our meal .The meal at haroo+ was just awesomeAnd i am much appreciated of them to give us fabulous food and time.Will definitely go there again if i visit langkawi next time.Highly recommend !Show less

Author: beatricel330
Title: Must Try! :D
Review:
A great place to have Korean Food! Satisfied to the max. Real taste of Korea. Imma happy girl :D
Especially their KimChi, refreshing and taste heavenly!

Author: SiowJoe
Title: Haroo enjoy!!
Review:
went there just last week with my friends. I could say that its the best korean food I've ever ever tried. Everything we ordered seems so delicious. And the interior is so cosy with korean soft music being played. 100% recommended in langkawi.
GOGOGO HAROOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!

Author: SakeSakeNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: They genuinely wanted us to enjoy it
Review: Great meal at Haroo+. Lovely little dining room. Amazing staff. Polite, attentive, genuine.We had glass noodles. The seaweed soup with red rice (delicious)!!! 2 helpings of Kimchi also delicious. They gave us some complimentary tasting dishes to start as well as a tea with plum drink to aid digestion at the end. Via 97 ringgit (£20). Including a tiger beer and a water.A definite recco. Hope this is a useful review my only feedback to the place is to get some dessert in (they had 3 ice creams on the menu but none available! A sin especially after eating all that kimchi we needed a pallet cleanser.)Show less

Author: Sonsie77Darwin, Australia
Title: Fabulous food and great service!
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience at Haroo+, which the two of us agreed was probably one of the best dining experiences we have had in Malaysia. We tried the seafood pancake, kimchee and spicy chicken stirfry with rice. All dishes were noticably very fresh and absolutely bursting with flavour. The service was fast, the waiter was very friendly and the manager came to our table, greeted us personally and served us some lovely refreshing citrus drinks. The restaurant was clean, comfy and modern - even the bathroom was nice & very clean (a rare thing in Malaysia lol). We also enjoyed tasting So Ju (Korean alcohol) for the first time :)We both left full (burstingly full) & tipsy (from the So Ju). After spending about 50 Ringgit each (incl mains, drinks & side dishes) we thought it was excellent value for money.We couldn't fault this restaurant at all & would definitely recommend this as a 'must-do' to anyone visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: Petr K
Title: Best service and great. Happy that I found it.
Review: The restaurant is worth finding. Very helpful staff explaining things. Excellent thoughtful customer service and great food.

Author: engleongy
Title: Authentic korean cuisine in Langkawi
Review: Friendly service, delicious and authentic korean cuisine and a good selection of so ju. Each dish is approx rm30 for dinner. Would definitely recommend if you are in the area.

Author: Filipochlinda
Title: The best place in langkawi!
Review:
We had a hard time finding the place but it was worth the time finding it. Price per meal is around 30Rm.The food was great and so was the staff. Best restaurant in langkawi no doubt.

/Sweden

Author: Ruthie016Wolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant in Kuah!!
Review: We stayed in Kuah for 4 nights and this was by far the best restaurant in town. The staff were extremely friendly, even showing us how to eat traditional dishes and enjoy a traditional Korean beverage. The food was delicious and reasonably priced. The restaurant was nicely decorated and you can see into the kitchen. At the end of the meal the manager even have us snacks to take away. I'd recommend anyone to visit here! Show less

Author: Jazz J
Title: Good Korean Cuisine
Review: Good Korean food. We tried the seafood noodles and Kimchi -fried rice which was quite good. The restaurant was vy quite when we went there for lunch. Price very reasonable, must try.

Author: SKTan91Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and good service
Review: The food was served rather quickly and it was well prepared; authentic taste Korean food. The lady boss was very friendly and actually came out to interact with the us and the other customers after she was done cooking the dishes. She was very friendly and made us feel at home. Will recommend everyone to come try this out if they are in the area of Kuah in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Hilmi93
Title: Marvellous
Review: Great service and delicious food. I tried the Korean seafood noodle and it was really tasty. They made the environment very comfortable and you really fell like you're at home.

Author: henryphillKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A real taste of Korea
Review: A very simple and traditional Korean food indeed. This restaurant isn't lavish but it does exude a homey environment and that made them stand out from the others. They offer authentic Korean food such as the colorful Bimbimbap, Kimchi Jjigae, Korean seafood noodles and much more. You feel more at home when you're enjoying the food. You'll be served by a very warm-hearted owner and they have very good service. Suitable for families with kids, couples and friends.Show less

Author: HertsOldie
Title: Great Crepes
Review: Exceptional buckwheat crepes. If you shut your eyes we could have been in our favourite Crepiere in Guemene Penfao, France.

Author: SeacroftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastique Factory
Review: Oh la la what a fantastique tiny cafe situated on the main strip. Cooked caringly in front of you by a real Frenchman the French Factory serves up delicious crepes and galettes. There's also an impressive ice cream drinks menu. Our banana salted caramel crepe was delicious as was the simple Nutella and almond flakes pancake. A must visit.Show less

Author: zahasvat
Title: INDULGENT CREPES AND WAFFLES
Review:
The perfect light snack, dessert or milkshake place.
The salted caramel crepes are a must
 The waffles are heavenly
Milkshakes were perfect
Staff helpful and happy to assist .

Author: miss_rafterManama, Bahrain
Title: The Best Waffle/Crepe in LGK
Review: Very nice and delicious but bit pricey for LGK price. even more pricey compared to Ben's waffle (B.I.G Independent Groceries in KL served with Kapiti ice-cream from NZ- sorry im trying to compare apple to apple here). Friendly staff. Still i would like to come again if im here in LGK.Show less

Author: nibashniiMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Amazing crepes
Review: Came here after reading raving reviews of this place and it did not disappoint! We were here post dinner and tried one savoury and sweet crepe each. Both tasted delicious! The ingredients used to make the crepes and it’s filling/topping was of good quality, one can tell from the taste. Friendly staff too which is always a winner in my books! Will definitely recommend to others who visit langkawi!Show less

Author: RuaidahIPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: J'adore les crepes...delicieux!
Review: The place which was some where along Cenang Walk....was pretty small. Space for dining in was limited......however, the food and service kinda made up for it.I've tasted the savoury and sweet crepes.....also the waffles, and they were simply TO DIE FOR! The staff were also helpful and kindly assisted us with the items on the menu.I would definitely come back again.....to just enjoy the crepes and watch people passing by....gloating at them, that I'm here enjoying one of the finest crepes in Malaysia!!Keep it up!Show less

Author: Voyage777152
Title: The best crepe in langkawi
Review: I love the taste of crepe here, the chef mose make with a great portion. Very friendly chef and staff. I always come here for their cappuchino and crepe. It's was amazing taste like you were in France. Very recommended.

Author: BoyWanderer97
Title: Great food.
Review: The portion is just nice. Love the taste especially the salted caramel crepe.The price is OK. Will be back soon.

Author: ihazelynz
Title: A must everytime in Langkawi.
Review: We go for the simplest crepe to really enjoy the authentic taste.. Love their salted caramel..can tell that they use really good butter and it's not cloyingly sweet. We were their 1st customer that day, so we have the place all to ourselves.

Author: Citygal12456
Title: a must for every visit in langkawi
Review: My hubby, daughter and i must always go there at least twice everytime we visit langkawi. They have the best crepes - savoury and sweet! The place follow covid19 procedures and are very accomodating with kids requests. Cant wait to go back!

Author: midzurllMalaysia
Title: Its just average
Review: I have been eating crepes for a long time since my wife's family are from Isle de France, we are very familiar with crepes thus we did not order their specialty but instead opt for the waffles. To be honest, it was fluffy and just nice but for the price it is not worth it because there are many others out there that serve their waffles with a few toppings other than one topping just dark chocolate or caramel sauce (For that price). So it was not that big of a deal for us since we could just go to DipnDip for that price. Show less

Author: Cricket03
Title: Authentic French crepes
Review: I cannot rave enough about the food here; if you want authentic French crepes, come here. One bite and you will know the quality of the ingredients. I ordered the chicken and cheese crepe followed by the caramel banana. Both excellent and generous in portion. Service was friendly from the waitress and chef. It’s a very small place but you are here for the excellent food. Such a shame that we only found it on our last day in Langkawi as we would have come almost everyday. Prices are way too cheap for the food standard and quality IMO, I would have been glad to pay double for it. Highly recommend. Show less

Author: MancJRGWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Tres bon!
Review: This is a very small place but wasn't too busy when we visited at 8.30pm. The menu has a large selection of sweet and savoury crepes and waffles - I was spoilt for choice. Eventually I decided to try a waffle with salted caramel topping with chocolate ice-cream. Staff were very friendly, and the restaurant was very clean. Our food arrived quickly and was delicious with great presentation. If you fancy a treat, definitely look this place up, near to Cenang Mall.Show less

Author: Natasha D
Title: My French Factory
Review: Can’t deny the waffles are delicious. However, place is very cramp and the boss appeared unfriendly. Well, don’t know about you but for me being customer oriented goes a long way. Kudos to the floor staff who made the experience amazing!

Author: Kirstie M
Title: Deliscious!
Review: Crepes are great and waffles even better! Would recommend their caramel sauce!! Staff are really nice too and helped us out with an internet issue to get us a Grab :)

Author: lilblackdog
Title: Yummy crepes made by owner
Review: Visited this place alone and enjoyed the savoury crepes and milkshake. Crepes were made by the owners themselves. Space is a little small, but it adds to the experience I guess. Would revisit.

Author: zoe929
Title: Too pricey? It’s worth depends on you
Review: This is the first place using stainless steel straw, that’s good. Yup, too pricey for a crepe. Banana milkshake is absolutely good.

Author: Nik71Malaysia
Title: A true Factory, in taste and service
Review: A Factory?, well it is not, but I guess it is a simple way to show the owner's passion and dream of having a 'factory'. It is actually rather tight place, and one may didn't notice the restaurant, if didn't really looking for it. Nevertheless, it size doesn't mean it also 'small' on it's food. It is really a speciality restaurant, mainly serving crepes and waffles, but the varieties of crepes and waffles it offer just for anyone desire, simply plenty of choices.Beside a great food, one will definitely greeted by its' friendly owner and staffs.For muslim, it is definitely halal food here.Show less

Author: zahasvat
Title: Divine crepes and waffles
Review:
Delicious  crepes, waffles  and milkshakes. 
Worth the wait. 
Friendly and helpful staff.
A after dinner must 
Or a afternoon  snack.

Author: Nippy2013
Title: French Crepe
Review:
I love my dessert.. With banana and icecream. Had it with coffee. Cant go wrong!
They actually have a wide array of selections consisting of creppe and waffel.. Oh mybe i should try the waffel on future visit.

Author: muhammadqayyumtPantai Cenang, Malaysia
Title: Went for dessert
Review: After meal went for a waffle and it was great and amazing. Run by a sweet couple and its always nice to meet them. I wish they will have a bit more bigger space. Wonderful place for crape and waffles. Must visit place if you are in Langkawi. Show less

Author: vegemg
Title: Vegan crepe!
Review: Just went past it, saw the vegan sign and had to try it. The owner, who also makes the crepes herself, had good knowledge about vegan food and shared without me asking how she made the vegan crepes. I had one with banana, roasted almonds and strawberry sauce (freshly made after I ordered!). The crepe itself was really delicious and the bananas were from the Island the owner told me as she served the crepe.My boyfriend got a non-vegan one with almonds and salted butter caramel sauce - he loved it. I would have liked to have seen one option with vegan butter and sugar - but that is just a suggestion. I was really pleased with the crepe I got :)The other staff were also really nice and friendly!Show less

Author: joshua_Solo
Title: Bad quality crepes
Review: Um first off the service was bad, and second the food didn’t taste good. Only came here because Briezh Up was closed. Very poor food and service, small space too.

Author: mooomanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Not just fine, it was incredible
Review: I came here with my partner and we ordered the C5 (Nutella Crepe) and C19 (Bueno Crepe).Within minutes, both crepes were out, having been specially made by the the chef/owner of My French Kitchen. Fast forward 7 mins and I found myself ordering a second Nutella Crepe.This place is amazing in all domains. Show less

Author: Citygal12456
Title: Small but the Best
Review: They have sweet and savoury crepes. I think we tried all that they offered. Went there for lunch, dinner and desserts. Staff are very personable. Highly recommended.

Author: R3dhi11Malaysia
Title: Holiday trip to langkawi
Review: It's a very small shop with limited sitting space, but its service and the food is very goodThe crepe is very soft and the texture is very smooth. The waffle is a must try especially the dark chocolate sauce. Also the french tea which is imported, it's very unique especially the yuzu temple, very refreshing and there is after taste of yuzu.I went for a 3 days trip at langkawi with my family and visited the shop almost very day.Show less

Author: Catherine B
Title: Treat!!
Review: Yummy yummy crepes and waffles, friendly easy-going team too :D we also tried the milkshakes and loved

Author: saundersmb
Title: Enjoyable visit
Review:
Friendly staff and good section of crepes and waffles.
Enjoyed the home made dark chocolate sauce.
Worth a visit.

Author: E L
Title: Not worth the money
Review: Way too expensive for crepe. Totally not worth it and regretted it. Plus it's full of flies and no air conditioning. For that sort of cut throat pricing, I'd expect a higher standard.

Author: myjmd0
Title: Delicious but pricey
Review: The food (crepes and waffles) are as per the many reviews. It is delicious! I minus 2 stars for the price and the quantity.

Author: flammablerose_45Bayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: Wonderfully done dishes
Review: Had always wanted to eat there and the dishes are beyond our expectations! The crepes and waffles are wonderfully done by the passionate owner that you don't think you could get such good waffles or crepes in Langkawi. However, it's quite pricey. Overall, it's worth eating! Show less

Author: Miramenzil
Title: Too pricey for a crepe or a waffle!
Review: I tried the crepe with coconut ice cream, fresh strawberry, almond, and nutella spread. It's delicious but I just think it's not worth the price. The only thing is that they're the only place with french dessert concept across the cenang street.

Author: youceftalbi
Title: Très bonne adresse pour des crêpes succulentes !!
Review: The shop is situated on the Main Street of Cenang , the owner is so friendly. We had crepes and waffles which were delicious 🤤, theirs smoothies are excellent. I highly recommend this place.

Author: Sa_tu86
Title: Absolutely amazing crepes
Review: You can see that this guy has a passion for excellent crepes and waffles. Dishes are done nicely and they taste absolutely amazing. One of the best desserts ever that I had.

Author: carefulhowyouserve
Title: MUST VISIT
Review: I was very happy to find this place on Cenang.  It is a mist visit neat and delicious crepes. A bit narrow for groups of people nonetheless they serve you the real deal. Must try

Author: Cassiecareri
Title: Amazing crepes
Review: Oh my gosh, this is a must to go to when in Langkawi. These crepes were so delicious. Staff were friendly and accommodating. Would definitely go back!

Author: zee94539
Title: Quality, service, real deal :)
Review: Stopped by here for a Nutella crepe. Absolutely yum! 100% French ingredients and you can taste the quality. Pricey but worth it!

Author: najwa1305
Title: Great caramel crepe
Review: Please order their home made caramel crepe. One if the best crepe I've had. the caramel sauce was just amazing, everytime i took a bite, it brings me so much joy. we went on both days we're in langkawi. we also ordered the dark chocolate waffle, it wasnt worth it for me as it just taste mehShow less

Author: odawnz
Title: Legit Waffles
Review: A small quaint restaurant serving up crisp waffles - we had a salted caramel almond waffle and it definitely did not disappoint. Staff were hospitable, warm, and friendly. This place is worth going.

Author: KiylaMalanThailand
Title: A MUST WHEN IN LANGKAWI
Review: My French Factory is a definite must when in Langkawi. We make sure we stop there at least once during our stay in Langkawi every time. The quality of food and dessert is top. Staff and owners are super friendly and always so chatty and welcoming. Not a very big restaurant so you so you better hope you get a spot to sit. Pricing of their food and desserts is also really good for what you get and the amount of effort that goes in the display of your food they serve you. Show less

Author: 22usmanm
Title: Dessert heaven
Review: If you want a proper french waffle or crepe you just try this. One of the best crepes I have ever had. The chefs are amazing and the place has a welcoming and friendly atmosphere. Must visit if you are a desert lover.

Author: siokh2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food with pride
Review: I was sitting in front of the cool looking young chef making crepes and waffles. He did every piece meticulously which made me feel that he really loves what he’s doing. The cheerful Chinese waiter is friendly and seems ready to chat with you. The Malay waitress is warm and helpful. The shop is very small but the multi-racial trio’s service makes good of it. Crepe is not an easy dish to come by in Malaysia so my kids and I were excited to see the making of crepe and enjoying the food. Show less

Author: Evy B
Title: Superb!
Review: Great service, delicious crepes & tea. Perfect for an afternoon in Pantai Chenang. And I looove the fact that they are doing their part to reduce waste. All the best!

Author: irenelim2788Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Excellent staff, professional chef & nice food
Review: We love the food. The Chinese staff very friendly and helpful, bcoz he shared with us the place in Langkawi. The chef very cool and professional and enjoy see him made the food, bcoz he let us fell he put a lot of love to make the food to the customer. Definitely will visit here again in future. Show less

Author: Makurut7888
Title: Great to have teabreak
Review: Wonderful place to have a break after walks.food is great .. must visit .... Won't regret to stopband eat

Author: Alblas23079Groot-Ammers, The Netherlands
Title: Already want to go back.
Review: So, we just arrived home from an amazing brunch at this little place. Both had a savory crepe and shared a Chocolat waffle. It was so good!! Service was excellent, it was so nice to see how the, I guess, owner treated his trainees. He was really trying to teach them and it was working out very well, cause they were great and super polite. It was just a great experience Show less

Author: KGB777
Title: High quality crepes
Review: This was a very pleasant surprise find whilst visiting Cenang Beach with the family. Both the main meal and the dessert were of a very high standard and prices were reasonable. Prompt and friendly service. Well worth another visit.

Author: liliantSingapore, Singapore
Title: Another visit
Review: Yes we came back to them again. Oh yes, they are still around. This time we did not see the lady boss. Anw long story short, they are very popular and it is difficult to get seats. But no issues for us since they close at 11pm.We did see french tourists chatting up with the boss asking for priority in the Q. But they were rejected. As always, they have delicious crepes. Show less

Author: JeaNcyee
Title: Good dessert
Review: Small cafe so need to sit outside. Better come at night or morning as i vame at 4pm sth which is soooo hot. Dessert is good. Can try if you like sweet crepe and waffles.

Author: 12KawasakiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Don't miss the best waffles and crepes here
Review: l have traveled a lot of please,the waffles and crepes here are the best I have ever eaten.The restaurant is no big,but the service quality of the staff here is first class.Especially the friendly attitude of the Chinese compatriot make me feel particularly cordial.This Restaurant is located in the main block of Pantai Cenang.if you come to Langkawi don't miss this place..Show less

Author: Tinamitch1Australia
Title: Visit to My French Factory
Review: The guy cooking the crepes even looked authentic.I choose the crepe with salted caramel topping and requested ice cream and cream on top. The crepe was yummo and the ice cream scoop generous and not tiny like many other places give you. I wish I had found this place earlier during my visit to Langkawi.Show less

Author: skevs91Coventry, United Kingdom
Title: Twice in two days
Review: The subject should explain everything about this place. I visited twice in two days, and the only reason I am not visiting for a third is because I am leaving the island.The first evening I ordered a nutella and banana crepe to take away. They had 2 options, in paper or i can pay for a biodegradable takeaway box. I opted for the paper (so I could eat on my walk home) and it was incredible. As I was leaving I saw a table with waffles and knew I had to come back a second time. I originally ordered strawberries, salted caramel and ice cream on a waffle but unfortunately they had ran out of strawberries. I went back to nutella and banana, always a safe option. It did not disappoint. As well as the food being fantastic, the service is also some of the best I've received when travelling Malaysia. Show less

Author: Salgainz
Title: I don’t think I’ll taste something similar !!
Review: The best place to try the authentic French Crepe !!I tried a lot of places before, nothing I can compare to this one, the staff were so lovely and welcoming, specially Kelvin, such a great funny guy.If I come back again to langkawi, this place will be the reasonShow less

Author: Anthony SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lacking service
Review: In Langkawi many of us stay in Motels, hostels and some in hotels. Most of us have no access to cutleries Especially later at night. Kindly start furnishing your customers with forks knives in order we can eat your good crepes other than with our bare hands. You’re against plastics that’s fine. Offer wood cardboard or any other degradable material. But do please offer something. Thank you Anthony RishaShow less

Author: Carol L
Title: Excellent crepe
Review: Shared a banana, nutella and icecream crepe. Was really nice. Wish we had ordered two!! Staff were very nice too

Author: goekhan-ug
Title: Just great
Review:
Very gooooood. Especially coconut shake and crepes. It s expensive but still worth.
Will come again. Thanks

Author: annibeata
Title: Delicious! Merci!
Review: Anything you can wish for crepes <3 we  were happy to find this cute creperie in Cenang beach street. Service is friendly and the treats are mouth-watering! Notice that Friday is rest day :)

Author: jagritibhatia77
Title: Best waffle ever!
Review: I have been traveling to a lot of places and this was the best waffle I ever came across ♥️ superb job. The place is in main Chenang area and is a must try if visiting Langkawi 😊

Author: devonc918Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Still The Best Ever!
Review: It's our 2nd visit here after 2.5+ years and they are still the best!One of the purpose of our trips to Langkawi was to come back to this humble cafe owned by this French couple which we once tried. At that time, they were still growing and getting used to the island life. And now, we're glad to see them grown so much since then, they've hired help and have also expanded their menu quite a bit.You would definitely be spoilt for choice on their wide selection of waffles and crepes! Overall, a must visit if you drop by Langkawi! The only place here where you get to try a pure French dessert cuisine.Show less

Author: Eric Y
Title: Best crepes in Langkawi
Review: Don't ever miss this place. Tried for dinner the day before but was jam packed. Too be honest, it wasn't exactly a big place at all🤣. Went back for lunch the next day, had the crepes and waffles and it was excellent. 👌👌👌

Author: AvisitoRinTownMui Ne, Vietnam
Title: Worth the wait
Review: For a table, crepes are outstanding.Lack of tables and space thankfully made up for by great staff and food. A must visit place, interesting reviews, and great stories about the Malaysian PM and French guy wanting to open a crepe restaurant.A good experience, give it a try.Show less

Author: Marc FBali, Indonesia
Title: Nice crepes
Review: The place is extremely small. Indoor area is very cramped and hot as the crepes are made in the same room. Outdoor seating area is basically on the sidewalk and limited to a few tables. But the crepes are very nice and service is very good. RecommendedShow less

Author: coedot
Title: Best crepes in Langkawi
Review: I actually didn’t like something that’s too sweet that’s why i was a little bit hesitant to try the crepes. But I ended up ate the whole plate by myself cause it was too good. All perfect, taste, sweetness & the service. Must try!

Author: 88gaian
Title: Best crepe
Review: Really delicious crepe. All are very special and delicious. My favorite will be saltycrepe with blue cheese. Excellent taste and the coconut milkshake are good also. But not have much seat available.

Author: vishalTripAdvise
Title: The Best Thing About Langkawi
Review: Awesome place for Crepes,Waffles & Shakes Authentic place Run by French Chef's we went there Everyday for 3 days we were in Langkawi to try different type of waffles ,crepe , Small but Good Place . Trivia:-Malaysian PM also has dined here.

Author: limwwKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious French crepes & waffles
Review: My French Factory is a boutique shop located along the main street of Cenang Beach. It is next to Cenang Mall. Though not many sittings available, it is worth waiting for. There are a good variety of crepes (sweet or salty, vegetarian or vegan) and waffles. We loved the Nutella & Coconut Crepe and the Butter Salted Caramel waffle we ordered. The plates were totally wiped out!There are coffees, teas and hot chocolate too. We liked the friendly and gentle waitress who served us.Show less

Author: anchtiger06
Title: Good Crepes!
Review:
My partner & I stopped here to grab a bite. We shared a savory crepe and thought it was very delicious.

Very nice touch to read about how the chef came to Malaysia to open the crepe shop. 

Would come back again! Tres bien!

Author: suhaybc2016
Title: Amazing
Review: We met two beautiful souls who made the experience ever so special, everything was beautiful the people, the smiles, the crepes, the waffle and the coconut ice cream. A special thanks to the recently engaged all smiley girl for her hospitality and generosity.

Author: AuromirraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: My 10 year old's most memorable part of our Langkawi holiday
Review: Simpy delicious food. My gal had something with strawberries and ice cream. My son had a super chocolate piece. Hubby had a savory dish that they modified to something delicious because of his food allergies. I had a waffle. My hot chocolate was so memorable. As delicious as the one I had in Paris in Spring. It was truly very authentic taste wise so the prices made sense. It has an amazing originality to it.Show less

Author: albernardo_kungKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: C'est Tres Delicieux!
Review: Ordered their salty crepe with egg, cheese and grilled chicken. At RM21, the egg was gloriously runny, the cheese was wonderful and went well with the grilled chicken. Served with a side salad for a little bit of fibre. The wife was the one who made the crepe and because I went at 3pm, there was no crowd and my crepe was served speedily. Will come back again in my next trip to Langkawi! Show less

Author: geeshariffPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Crepe
Review: If you are not in a hurry and looking for dessert after dinner, this would be a great place to check out. It is a very small shop with limited seating capacity. So you have to queue for sometime and also don't get to sit at your own table or in your own group as you are seated at the semi long table as seats become available. Patience is key here if you want to enjoy great crepe. It is owner operated and it is relatively interesting to watch him and his staff prepare the food in the open kitchen while you wait for a seat to become available. We had initially all ordered crepe but as it was late, I think they ran out of ingredients and they requested that we changed some of our orders to waffles. Crepe was delicious and waffles was nice. Service staff were friendly.Show less

Author: Kelly K
Title: Lovely cafe
Review: Great waffles with Nutella and ice cream. Staff are really friendly. Cost around 20myr each. Would reccomend a visit for a sweet treat.

Author: avidaemesmoumaviagem
Title: Delicious!
Review: We went to the restaurant today. We had 3 delicious “galettes” and also a banana crepe as a desert. Everything was really good. Compared to the local is pricy but totally worthy.

Author: 99MarkR
Title: Do not miss
Review: Delicious French treats await you at MFF. I had a savory gallet and my partner had a sweet crepe, service is awesome and they maybe small but they deliver on everything.  A must go to.

Author: PearlyS
Title: Authentic French Crêpes
Review: Owned by a friendly Muslim French couple from Paris, they literally brought the equipment from France and along with it, the technique in making crêpe with the right texture and consistency. I am partial to their salted caramel crêpe as they make their own caramel to drizzle over. There are other variations of toppings (ice-cream, nutella, bananas, whipping cream, etc.) which you can add to your crêpe, be it sweet or savoury. Many folks fancy the lovely waffles here too though that might require a longer wait. Take note that this place is rather tight for space so if you have a big group, pick a time when there would be fewer patrons.Show less

Author: Glen C
Title: Sidewalk cafe
Review: Hole in the wall kind of cafe, good place to have a break from the beach n do a spot of people watching... Food is OK, dessert crepe pretty enough to warrant a pic, could be more generous with the bananas, (it's not an expansive fruit) coconut ice cream great...Show less

Author: Mamun KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Sweet place
Review: Wife was driving me nuts to go to this place so we obviously did, the place is small but it’s worth it. We got the waffle desert each with chocolate sauce and cream, it was really nice and a generous portion too. The chef is actually French and he knows his stuff. I saw a few people getting their omelettes so those must be nice too.Show less

Author: Rinsan Z
Title: Nice crepes and waffles ice-cream.
Review: Place a bit small , not many seats. Like the waffle, with nutella and ice-cream ,and crepes with egg and potatoes - delicious 😋

Author: timetravel_12
Title: Oolala
Review: Impressed with my cheese chicken and egg crepe. Coffee was bought out missing some coffee ( not full ) seems it happens in Langkawi !! Open every day 11-11pm. Except closed friday. Also have sweet crepes and waffles.

Author: CorneliazzZanzibar Island, Tanzania
Title: The smiles are as good as the crepes and waffles
Review: We had our 'brunch' almost every day here for 2 months. We love the people. We love the crepes, the waffles and the coconut icecream. Many restaurants here don't have dessert options, so we also sometimes came in at night after dinner to have a great dessert! Vincent and Olivia make everything from scratch with the finest ingredients, attention to detail and a big smile. Thanks for all your hospitality, with special greetings to Carmila, Vincent and Olivia!Show less

Author: Akhlaq AKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Such delecious French Crepes
Review: We were just strolling through the Cenang Beach market area and we saw this My French Factory roadside outlet. The crepes looked tempting but we were not sure that they are halal or not. I asked the guy and he assured me that all food was halal there. So we ordered and sat back. When the food arrived, the first bite left us speechless. It was fresh, piping hot, and oh so delicious. Loved them.Show less

Author: sammh1992
Title: Heavenly
Review:
Heavenly.. enjoyed the waffles enough to have them 3 times during our visit! YES 3 TIMES!! 

I must say the waffles at this place are amazing! I’d go as far as to say the best I’ve ever had! 

A definite must!

Author: Asmah MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sweet tooth craving fixed!
Review: Only one of its kind in Langkawi. This place always in my itinerary every time i visited Langkawi. The fresh crepes and waffles with tasty homemade salted caramel sauce is divine! Tried both savoury flavours and sweet crepes but i prefer the sweet one. Ice cream topping flavours are so-so but the plating presentation are lovely and looks posh. Quiet pricey for our local but to get your sweet tooth craving fix while in Langkawi, its worth it.Show less

Author: ArnoFrance
Title: Sweet treat from France
Review:
A very authentic French treat freshly prepared that my whole family enjoyed.
Good service and friendly ambiance.
Nice chat in my native language with French couple running it.

Author: RonitD38
Title: Waffle and eggs
Review:
Lovely food lovely place must try waffles
Just opposite to cenang plaza
Good portion amazing quality

Author: HarambaeXX
Title: GREAT FOOD AND ENVIRONMENT
Review: Food was exquisite and out of this world, went there for my trip in Langkawi. Not much space but worth waiting for. Should totally try it out if ur in Langkawi

Author: PiLaurent
Title: A taste of france
Review:
Nice crêpe and gaufre. A bit pricey but quality is there. Too bad no rum in the crêpe.
Overall better than kl

Author: 401shirleyh
Title: Nice crepe but with limited space
Review: Nice food and can be a bit pricey. Must try their waffle and crepes. Coconut juice is really pure and fresh.

Author: adequate8
Title: Massive portions
Review: Had breakfast and crepes and waffles (with banana/choc) - service takes a while but portions are huge! Delicious food, freshly cooked to order, check it out!

Author: review_princess2010Gatley, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent choice for breakfast!
Review: Great menu with lots of sweet and savoury options for both waffle and crepe. Lovely quality food and decent portion sizes, good value. Service was particularly slow however both to take order and for food to arrive, well worth it my opinion but perhaps don’t go if you want a speedy meal! Show less

Author: KhuramMirzaHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely fresh crepes and waffles
Review: Second visit to this awesome ice cream place in Langkawi, Cenang side of the island. Absolutely amazing staff and hospitality . Desserts prepared to perfection with a touch of artistry with chocolate to amaze their customers. Fresh ingredients, crepes and waffles are made on site and fruits used are local. Kids thoroughly enjoyed and so did weShow less

Author: azr2018
Title: Perfect
Review: The crepes were very tasty and we had the peanutbutter-banana shake, it was also very good. The staff was extremely friendly!!! I can highly recommend this place.

Author: EmmaCourtney
Title: Fantastic Crepes
Review: If looking for a sweet tooth fix whilst in Langkawi, highly recommend this restaurant. The crepes were very tasty and were presented very nicely! Service was also very good!

Author: akilashfPetaling Jaya
Title: Sweet tooth cravings sorted!
Review: Recommended by a friend who is not a sweet tooth! The staff and owner are very friendly. They have interesting options for waffles and crepes, and we tried one of each, and we personally prefer the waffle more due to the texture and presentation. If you are not into sweet waffles and crepes, they have other options as well, so don't worry! The place is small and always full, but the table turnover is fast so just wait for a bit to get a table. It is worth it! Will come back!Show less

Author: Salina JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great crepes!
Review: Try the blue cheese crepe. It was divine. Very crispy crepe. The place is small so if you have a big group like us, family of 5, plan well. We arrived for brunch when it opened at 11am and there were already 4 people there. We had to share a table. Our server was very attentive.Show less

Author: lizksingSingapore
Title: That's where you go for your pancake fix !
Review: Imagine authentic French pancakes at Langkawi ! So glad we stumbled upon this little café in the heart of Cenang. The staff were absolutely lovely but sorry the pancakes were every better! I know it's only a fruit juice but the green apple juice I got was the best ever ... thick with little amount of ice .. truly refreshing. Yes we went there 3x on our 3 day stay in Langkawi. What a nice find !Show less

Author: amrue2018
Title: Taste from heaven
Review: Place is small but nice and clean. Staff are suoer friendly. Portions are ok relative to the prive. We will definitely go again!

Author: wasima52
Title: Devine
Review: We were in lankawi for 5 days. Found this gem on the 2nd day. We decided to go twice more throughout stay. Its a small shop. The staff were welcoming and great at making quality desserts. The overall atmosphere is really good. Would recommend anyone who visits Langkawi to make a trip here. Show less

Author: EMELeicestershireEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: A gem of a find in langkawi
Review: Whenever we remember of holiday in Langkawi we remember the fabulous crepes - so it might have been 14 months but an good review is worth waiting for. Such friendly service with delicious crepes as you watch the world go by - if only we could return.Show less

Author: Chris M
Title: This Is An Absolute Must Do !
Review: Crepes, waffles, very fresh juice and great fresh ground coffee ... combine this with their (to die for) salted caramel sauce and you will have had the ultimate in dessert eating in Langkawi.

Author: johndhope
Title: Delicious taste of France
Review: Went here for lunch, and had one savoury and one sweet crepe. Both were absolutely delicious and quite fairly priced.

Author: MartzuL
Title: Wau
Review: Soooo delicious. Crepe with cheese, sour cream, onion and blue cheese was to die for. Sweet crepe with nutella, almonds, banana and ice cream also perfect. A little pricey, two coffee and four crepes 131 MYR. But totally worth it at least once.

Author: alexis0102
Title: Best savory/sweet crepes
Review: First time visit with my love, we absolutely love the savory crepes! There's alot of choices to pick we picked the mushrooms cheese and sour cream one, and the sweet crepe we choose the Nutella almond. Within 5 minutes we devour it clean. Too nice!! I will definitely come back to visit for next flavors. Thanks for the awesome savory crepes. Show less

Author: sohaibn2018Oslo, Norway
Title: The best dessert in Langkawi
Review: Its a small outlet serving amazing french desserts. The place is a little too small and you need luck to find a sitting place because they have only few tables placed outside. The desserts are really tasty. We tried waffle and pancake and both were delicious.The staff is really friendly and we also got some nice suggestions for roaming in Langkawi. This place is in the main food street in Cenang and a must visit if you ever come Langkawi.Show less

Author: SmartTravellerHK
Title: Good Crepes and Waffles
Review: We ordered a sugar crepe and a chocolate waffle which were very tasty.  My only complaint is the price is a bit expensive.

Author: VivienC219
Title: Yummy crepes!
Review: Friendly owner & yummy crepes! We went back there twice and tried both the savoury and sweet crepes. :)

Author: 827bilalc
Title: To die for basically!
Review:
We shared the strawberry, salted caramel waffle with coconut ice cream! And it was great!!

Though it may be a little heavy on the pocket for a budget traveller but I’d say it’s worth it! Ps sharing is caring! 😉

Author: marlenes783Paris, France
Title: Amazing French break in Langkawi
Review: A really good address to eat savoury and authentic crepes ! I came from Brittany and they are exactly like at home especially the "galette" ones.I would also definitely recommend the sweet one with salted caramel butter! The owners are also very welcoming. A good place in Langkawi for a French break ! Show less

Author: hazimihariri
Title: I had to eat cold crepe
Review:
I really dissapointed with the crepe.
The price is expensive for crepe with banana and dark chocolate which is RM17. I want to take away and what I get was cold crepe. Taste not that great.
But staff is nice and friendly.

Author: H919QInickh
Title: Great tasting food
Review: Although we only went to the french factory once it was well worth it, the waffles were that big we had to share, but tasted amazing.

Author: 729bettinam
Title: Lovely crepes!
Review: Very cosy cafe with authentic french crepes. The crepes were amazing, and the staff was super nice and friendly. I really recommend this café. 10/10

Author: divatina_laSeoul, South Korea
Title: 친절하고 쾌활한 분위기, 맛있는 크레페, 조금 비싼 가격 lively casual ambience, friendly staffs, owner shelf, real french crepe, a bit pricy
Review: 중심가에 있고 눈에 띄는 간판으로 인기가 많은 집입니다. 프랑스의 크레페 전문점만큼 간식용(달콤), 식사용(짭짤) 두 가지 모두 다양한 메뉴 셀렉션을 갖추고 있으며, 음료도 모두 맛있습니다. 여느 크레페리와 같이 주문 후 바로 만들어주는데, 테이블 수가 한정되어 있기 때문에 오래 기다리지 않아도 금방 음식을 먹을 수 있어 좋습니다. 세 번 방문했는데 항상 맛있었습니다. 메뉴판에 사진이 있어 고르기 쉽고, 주문받는 직원도 친절합니다. 단, 랑카위 물가에 비해 저렴한 가격은 아닙니다. 주중에 쉬는 날이 있으니 미리 꼭 확인하고 가세요.Show less

Author: doublescore27
Title: Good crepe, poor latte
Review:
The crepes were good, being prepared by a French man.

My order of latte, however, was lukewarm and disappointing. 

Prices were high by Malaysian standards.

Author: darrenlyp
Title: worth a try
Review:
Drop by and order a desert，out of my expectation
taste good and feel happy when i finish it,BUT my suggestion is more ice cream AHA CONSIDERTING IT 
S too hot here

Author: deepakna10New Delhi, India
Title: Authentic waffles and crepes
Review: I have had waffles with my wife at a number of places. But this place serves waffles that are simply brilliant. So good with all the ice cream and Nutella etc. There is outdoor seating and if you are planning to come here after dinner better be prepared to wait. The crepes too are really good.The service is ok, the pricing is a little on the higher side. But totally worth it. Do visit this place if you plan to visit pentai cenang beach.Show less

Author: agrites
Title: Yummy French food with good vegetarian options!
Review:
We were looking for a place with good vegetarian options and found this on Tripadvisor.

We ordered salted crepes and some beverages and absolutely loved it.

The food was fresh, delicious, and served with a smile :) can't ask for more!

Author: IndySig
Title: Sinful pleasure
Review: Oh yes, it was rich and wonderful and sooo good. The hubby had the salted caramel and caramelized banana crepe and I had the Nutella and coconut with ice cream. So good and we are so going back tomorrow.

Author: Ebony C
Title: Amazing!!!
Review:
The French man and lady were both lovely friendly and great service 
Deserts were amazing and very reasonably priced 
Would defiantly return!!!!

Author: Guillaume M
Title: Amazing
Review:
2 French people installed here to live their dream. As a French guy used to travelling to Brittany I have to admit that their galette were better than most I could find in France!

Amazing experience and friendly staff!

Author: Mr_Haf
Title: Simply Bon Appétit Sweet
Review:
I don't like eating dessert to be honest tho my wife craze for it.
However here, i can stop eating their dessert. I'm not sure why. It was told to be perfection crepe and waffle.

Author: Asfandyar K
Title: Best Place
Review: There crepes and waffles are the best. We came here multiple times and every time left satisfied. The atmosphere is good. The staff is very friendly. Every time we came here the owner greeted us with smile.

Author: saryeahCoventry, United Kingdom
Title: Must go
Review: MUST GO!!!!We where just walking down the main round and came across this little gem! So glad we did we had waffles and they where amazing!! There home made salted caramel sauce is the best I've ever had (and I've had a lot) The rest of the menu looks so good to but we weren't there long enough to go back. If we visit Langkawi again we 100% will be back!! Service was amazing to such friendly people!! MUST GO!!'Show less

Author: Bobby BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wow, delicious!
Review: We stopped by Langkawi for a day on the way to Phuket on a cruise and we wanted to grab some food before hitting Cenang beach for the day. We found this place on trip advisor and wanted to give it a try. As soon as we sat down the smell was amazing and made me so hungry. I ordered chicken, cheese, mushroom and onion (G8) and it was amazing, so savory and delicious. My wife order crepe with salted caramel butter with bananas, wow the caramel was insane, so so good! I was tempted to order another round it was that good. I also had iced cappuccino which was great as well.Highly recommend trying this place if you are in Langkawi!Show less

Author: 921stevem
Title: Great brunch
Review: We stopped in this morning for brunch and we all had different crepes, everyone loved what they had but the caramel sauce was amazing, one of the best ever. The savory was good too.

Author: mcleanar
Title: Beautiful Crepes Done the French Way
Review: I really enjoy a proper crepe done nice and thin with good simple toppings. The homemade dark chocolate and butterscotch caramel was amazing. Didn't have a galette but they also looked incredible. Highly recommend for those who appreicate proper french crepes.

Author: antliewtyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Close for afternoon prayers.
Review: Wanted to try this and because it's on Monday afternoon and it's our last few hours in Langkawi, we decided to drop by for some dessert after our lunch.Too bad it was close for afternoon prayers. But from what I know, afternoon prayers won't take half and hour or more. And most customers are willing to wait. So it was a bit disappointing that the ladies just ask us to get out. It's a Monday afternoon not a Friday afternoon prayers.So it's abit sad that I cant try this. And wish that the ladies could accommodate us. Because in my company too, the Muslim ladies took turn praying. And there were two ladies working.Show less

Author: Mikhail_Istari
Title: Great food
Review: The place is a little small but the service is great. You can choose to get the savoury or sweet crepes. We choose one of the sweet crepes and the food was delicious. You can also choose to add toppings such as ice-cream.

Author: JunctionarySingapore, Singapore
Title: Magnifique!!!
Review: Combine passion for food and being spotlessly clean and this is the place you get. Both the sweet and savory crepes are perfectly done here. The crepe makers create crepes as beautiful as they are delicious. Try the potato, egg, cheese crepe or the simple honey lemon crepe or the homemade salted caramel crepe. We waited a year to enjoy your crepes again and there is not one crepe maker in Singapore that can hold a candle to the crepes here. Please don't let bad customers get you down. Please keep your energy high so you can keep feeding us for years. If we could get drone delivery of your crepes in Singapore we would.Prices are reasonable for the quality of the ingredients. Prices range from 10 to 30 RM and given the high cost of cheese in Malaysia, this is a bargain.Show less

Author: 419charlotteb
Title: Delish!
Review: Great service. Amazing food! The staff were really friendly and our order came out quickly. The food was so so yummy. Very genuine French crepes and the waffles are huge.

Author: parajsaxena
Title: Delicious waffles
Review: I loved the banana and Nutella waffle. The waffles are big, perfectly crunchy and loaded with the toppings. Not a whole lot of place to sit, but we got a seat quickly enough. The price is very reasonable.

Author: P4545IFdennisl
Title: Great crepes
Review:
Had a quick desert here. Great crepes with delicious fruit and Nutella is always a good choice.

Would definitely come back.

Author: christinechanys
Title: Delicious & Friendly
Review: Delicious waffles and crepes ^^ Visited with my family and they love it. Very warm and friendly staffs that greet you with a smile :) Worth the visit.

Author: nezumih2017
Title: Good place to have snack/desert
Review:
We had nutella + banana + coconut + ice cream crepe and chocolate drink. The crepe is good but dont have the wow factor. Quite expensive for a crepe. 
Chocolate drink is not cold enough and quite small in size.  
Great service and friendly staff.

Author: 173s_bastienm
Title: Wonderful !
Review:
Very good experience in this restaurant. People are very nice and took care of us and our kids.
Service very efficient.
The crepes and waffles are amazing. We loved it.

Author: VincentC507Malaysia
Title: Average food with premium price
Review: Saw a lot good reviews in TA, end up had my supper with my family here. Ordered 1 waffle with ice cream and 1 crepes. Honestly, nothing great to share. A bit disappointed with their waffle that charge premium price. Environment is so so (beside roadside) with limited chairs. Show less

Author: SGNCFSingapore, Singapore
Title: Afternoon Tea Break
Review: Visited on a hot afternoon. We were the only customer. Small place with mostly outside sitting and inside with counter seats. This place only serves crepes and waffles. The chef is from France. We ordered waffle with strawberries, home made salted butter caramel with vanilla ice cream. The waffle is made fresh by the France chef. It was served hot and tasted heavenly even though I do not have a sweet tooth! The waffle is crisp! Value for money!Highly recommended to taste it when you are in Cenang. It is located in a shop house next to Cenang Mall!  Show less

Author: nechadi21Lyon, France
Title: Always a pleasure to come back at My French Factory
Review: always a pleasure to come back to eat a good homemade French crêpe and have a good coffee, the owners are always good advice and are very friendly always novelties and crepes of the month are just succulentThey brought the first french crêpes concept to Langkawi in Pantai cenang Thank youShow less

Author: Sunnytan30Singapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty crepe and friendly staff
Review: One of the have to visit eatery in Langkawi according to TripAdvisor. Make a trip to this after the shop that we wanted to visit was closed. Just decided to take 2 crepes and drink. Crepe was tasty and filling portion and best eaten when hot. Tried Peanut Butter and Chocolate Milkshake and it’s rich and nice, highly recommend this for those with sweet tooth. Show less

Author: swtang72
Title: Thumb up!!
Review: Very fluffy crepes and waffles with lots of ingredients. Really yummy. My kids enjoyed the food too😋. As malaysian, good choice if you wanna try something new

Author: rchapman28
Title: Amazing food!
Review: Went for Sunday brunch and was not disappointed! Gorgeous waffles which we were able to customise with fruit toppings. Highly recommend! Good tea and coffee too!

Author: Saiful Azuan AKuala Lumpur
Title: Authentic French Crêpes in Langkawi
Review: Saw this crêperie on TripAdvisor. We are so excited because been looking for original crêpe for a while in Malaysia. We miss the taste of original crêpes and gallete from Brittany. The crêpes here are delicious, have not got a chance to taste the gallete. The chef - Chef Soumie (hope got her name right) is very friendly and we talk about Brittany for a while.Show less

Author: Austin L
Title: An absolute must try!!
Review:
Where to start!. The house special caramel was recommended to us by the wonderful staff. And woah! What a recommendation it was. 

I cant speak highly enough about the friendly staff and wonderful quality.

Author: YvetteY65
Title: Good for dessert
Review: Came by this dainty and welcoming dessert place for some crepes and waffles. The friendly staff make them fresh and my partner and I enjoyed them. But we've had lots of equally good waffles in our country so I think that the place is overhyped and a little expensive. Show less

Author: Dee J N
Title: They do a great job
Review: The resturant is great very good service , homemade , decoration is very welcoming.. great business.open daily

Author: BMagar_UKAshford, United Kingdom
Title: Best waffles in Asia!
Review: We came across this place after dinner! It's very small (i.e. Seating outside) but don't let that put you off! If anything it adds to the charm of this place! We were greeted by the friendliest French waiters. You can tell this is a small family run business as everything they do is with a passion to give you the the best they have offer. I ordered the coconut milkshake and we shared a waffle which was amazing! We'll definitely be going back!!A small slice of Paris in Langkawi Show less

Author: Lai_ni09
Title: Tasty!
Review: I have ordered the coconut Nutella crepe and it's simple but tasty. Staff are friendly and it's good place if you feel like eating something sweet in langkawi:)

Author: 3vilfr3akybabi3
Title: Expensive but Tasty French Crepe
Review: Friendly Lady-Boss, Great Crepe but it is on the sweet side. Fixed my craving for dessert at night. yummy!

Author: Tailer M
Title: Delicious food
Review: A taste of french cuisine. I love the waffles and crepes. We went back on the followinf day to try the rest of the menu.

Author: NNANz87Melbourne, Australia
Title: Tasty French Crepes
Review: Small little cafe nested in Baron Resort next to Cenang Mall offers a really authentic French Crepes at an affordable price and extensive choices of flavor where you can choose the sweet or savory crepes at your liking. I have choosen the savoury one with extra cheese filling,homemade tomato sauce and beef ham accompanied with a garden salad. Totally worth the money and experience, should have try when you're in Langkawi.Show less

Author: dorothyingrid
Title: Amazing crepes and waffles
Review: Crepes and waffles were freshly made as you ordered them. Egg,cheese and grilled chicken crepe was very savoury and quite filling. The salted caramel waffles were also  good. Prices were a little on the high side  but it was definitely worth it!

Author: loht977
Title: Tasty Crepes!
Review:
Average Cost: RM$15-25 per pax
(without drinks)

If budget is not a problem, this has some of the most handlovingly-created crepes in town. You can witness the love and care the shop owners put into their desserts.

Looks good, and tastes heavenly.

Author: michka383
Title: An evening well spent!
Review: Great food. The salted caramel butter sauce really makes my day. Great staffs, was greeted with smiles from all 3 staffs. Amazing view of sunset from across the building. Small place but cosy and clean. And of course heavenly hot chocolate with cream.~

Author: 63dannya
Title: Check this out guys !!!
Review:
Fully recommended!!

Something you must try once you at Cenang beach. Authentic crepes, I’m certainly delighted with the sweet crepes and my wife happy with the waffle.  

We Definitely coming back again. 
Well done to the Chef, Merci

Author: ValerieAnneP
Title: A must!!
Review: I came to this place after dinner for dessert on my last day at the island, and glad I did! I was willing to be naughty with the crepes, but then saw they also did Gluten Free!! The people working there where amazing, helping me make a decision from the very options they have. I was not disappointed at all with my buckwheat (GF) crepe with home-made dark chocolate sauce and almonds!! When I was half way through the crepe it felt a bit dry, this happens with this type of flour, but one of the chef's there immediately noticed that and without me even asking, offered more sauce ... DELICIOUS!! - Merci Beaucoup!!Show less

Author: chloebee3066Hong Kong, China
Title: Tea break in Langkawi
Review: Nice food. Nice service. Ice cream mix strawberry and pancake is delicious:) We will come back soon. Show less

Author: mbbszamanAlor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Rude owner
Review: I had my waffles at this shop with my friend. The waffles was good but our first impression was bad due to the bad treatment by the owner. The guy was quite rude and not friendly. I think he must learn how to talk to his customer and behave. I love waffles but will go to other shops instead this one. The price also high. The menu says waffles with ice cream but u have to pay extra for the ice cream. Doesn't make sense. Sorry guys not my choice!!Show less

Author: Dalibor K
Title: Mmmm
Review:
Pleasant staff, yummy crepes and waffles. True taste of France in the middle of tropical island :)
Recommended for all people who like sweet and delicious food

Author: Tom GFort Myers, Florida
Title: No one can say anything bad about this place
Review: A lovely little place on the main avenue. The owners have a French background and know something about desserts. Crepes, Waffles, ice cream and more...all delicious....The owner is most pleasant and tries to meet her guests. If you are up for something special, you must stop and check outShow less

Author: TeoC668
Title: Really Yummy
Review: Just had it for tea break before I catch my flight home. Super yummy. I had the crepe with salted caramel with coconut ice cream with roasted almond. Small place but well decorated.

Author: jan v
Title: Delicious!
Review: Mmmmmmm, very nice crepes and waffles. Home made toppings makes this a very welcome experience. The staff is wonderful!

Author: MayPhingP
Title: Friendly staff and super nice crepe!
Review: The staff attended us very well and recommend their crepes, waffles and drinks too! It is a total different experience where in Malaysia I still can have a cheaper dessert served by European from Paris. Worth well and love it so much! I definitely will visit again before I go back.Show less

Author: YaSSeR001
Title: The Best
Review: I was the first customer for the day and the staff was welcoming me and my wife. I order salty crepes G5 and sweet waffle W11 and it was amazing. I recommend this cafe for anyone who are looking for wonderful food. Looking forward to seeing you opening new branch every where.Show less

Author: YCh3nMalaysia
Title: Friendly staffs and nice desserts
Review: The staffs are friendly and helpful, always take care of the customers' needs. The foods here are nice and will definitely pay a visit again when going to Langkawi. Strongly recommended their waffles with nutella spread. Show less

Author: HabanawawiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Almost similar fare you have in Parisien Street
Review: We had the dessert after our lunch. The menu is extensive with sauvory and sweet. We had the nutella and lemon honey. Price wise, almost similar in Euro.... It is halal..Show less

Author: ElyysaPerlis, Malaysia
Title: Worth a visit
Review: We had breakfast here, it was delicious. The place was neat and the staffs were friendly and attentive. However the food was a bit pricey.Show less

Author: tiagofm7Macau, China
Title: Nutella and Kinder Bueno Waffle
Review: One of the biggest waffles I've ever eaten. It's a bit expensive but actually perfect for sharing. The French lady worked meticulously with all ingredients and very generous with the quantities. All employees were really nice. Show less

Author: Taqi R
Title: A Slice of France in Langkawi
Review: This little place just near cenang mall is a great place to grab a bite on a shopping trip (which you ultimately end up doing on vacations). The food is great, the service is very friendly and the the ambaince of the place is the sort that it just absorbs you in itself and you feel like u are some how part of the owners story as you eat there. would highly recommend it.Show less

Author: Vishakha70Bangalore, India
Title: Awesome waffles and crepes
Review: The waffles and crepes both were lovely . My French factory had a choice of both sweet and savory crepes . The presentation of the dishes made it even more appetizing . A small place but always full . Show less

Author: ArivaranPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Friendly Owners and Staff
Review: The only thing I can say is that the owners and staff are super nice when they greet and take your order. But other than that I feel that the food served here is way to overpriced. RM 49 for two small crepes and a glass of nutella milkshake is too much for me as a local. I cant be commenting on the food much since i'm not an expert on french crepes. I ordered Banana Dark Chocolate crepe while my partner ordered cheese and toast chicken crepe. Both dishes tasted average to my taste buds as a local malaysian. Their salty crepe really tasted like our indian thosai. No offence but it really tasted like an over hyped thin thosai. But the staff are too nice to you and i didnt have the heart to show my disappointment to them. Just an honest review from a avreage joe.Show less

Author: Chelsea CManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Gluten free crepes!!!
Review: Wow finally I could have a delicious crepe without having to miss out with being gluten free.Lovely staff who make you feel very welcome.Show less

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Crepes and waffles were good
Review: Crepes and waffles were good and tasty and I can see why people like this place. Lots of options and extras (at cost). But I can't help but feel like it was very expensive in comparison with the local places. A roti with Nutella for a couple of MYR at other places whereas we paid 20MYR each. My wife and I were discussing and the prices were similar to back in the UK. The cafe was very small so seating is limited, which isn't a problem but something to consider. Show less

Author: ValueSeeker83Lahad Datu, Malaysia
Title: MUST TRY at least ONCE
Review: I was looking a place for brunch. This shop happens to be diagonally in front of my hotel across the street. I ordered the savory crepe reccommended by the menu. The team of 4 (2 locals & 2 frenches) worked really professionally. The chef was alway serious and the rest were following his order. One of them politely approaches me that they run out of olives, so I chose jalapeno instead of onion. The highlight of the crepe is the AVOCADO ICE CREAM. This is my first time having savory food with ice cream and the ice cream has not added sugar at all. It is uniquely funky. But I like it. Hopefully, the public is ok with it. Merci pour le bon repas!!Show less

Author: Lynndy LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Taste of Heaven
Review: Had the dark chocolate crepe with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and it was heavenly! Despite the size of this little cafe, it was cozy and inviting. Would love to go back and try their other yummy-looking food.Show less

Author: 700lauraFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Delicious crêpes!
Review: We went there in the afternoon and tried two of the sweet crêpes. Service was very friendly and the crêpes very good :-)Show less

Author: ErikaFiuzaSao Paulo, SP
Title: Delicious!!!!!
Review: My boyfriend and I were here for late breakfast this week... The food is delicious and big enough to make us full until late in the afternoon. 2 salty crepes, 1 sweet crepe and water cost around 60 ringgit and was worth every cent. Highly recommend!Show less

Author: TayW88
Title: Delicious!
Review: I love the crepe so much! I will come back again in the future!The crepe price is around RM20 - RM30.Fruit Juice is around RM10.Show less

Author: tobyf80
Title: Lovely French crepes
Review: Visited 3 nights out of 4 for a lovely dessert after dinner. Crepes and waffles made to order, beautifully tasty and thin, with lots of topping. Staff were incredibly friendly. Show less

Author: Haider-V
Title: Cosy French Café
Review: Visited every night during our three day vacation in Langkawi for the great crepes, waffles & the refreshing pink lemonade. They offer a savoury menu as well. Ensuring us freshly prepared and awesome. They made us feel very welcome and my kids loved them. We will miss this place the most :(Show less

Author: HilyahMB
Title: Salty Crepes was like Thoisei
Review: We were spoiled for choice. Drinks came in Nutella Jars. We had Nutella shake that was so good we didn't manage to take a picture!We had the salty crepes with egg and cheese and chicken. It tasted like Thoisei (Indian dish for those of you who aren't sure). Good for the experience but a burn hole in the pocket.Show less

Author: Sanyukta DGurugram (Gurgaon), India
Title: Don't miss it
Review: Fluffy waffles and thin crepes. Was such a delight. The place is closed on Friday. The service is very sweet and the food is yummm.Show less

Author: Samina K
Title: Cute Place, gorgeous desserts
Review: Popped in during our honeymoon following lots of great online reviews. Place itself was small, outside seating for 10 people. Very busy served quickly. We tried a crepe and a waffle, both freshly made and tastes fab. Staff, owner all very friendly and welcoming too. Only downside is space but most shops on this street are tiny anyway! Show less

Author: Celestial25Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Nice crepe!!
Review: I just couldn't get enough of their crepes. Love their crepe and waffle!! Service is good with friendly and polite staff. Must try if you're into crepe & waffle~ Show less

Author: Dev_2126Singapore, Singapore
Title: Salty Crepe
Review: The place can hold abt 10 ppl. Prompt n friendly service. Tried egg n cheese crepe RM15. All pricing RM 15 onwards. Served wif fresh veg. For me it was alittle too salty. Maybe due to lots of cheese. Couldnt finish it. They r closed on Friday.Show less

Author: Danial_ScubaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb French Crepe!
Review: A very delightful experience! Authentic french crepes made by the very friendly and hospitable French couple. Everything is homemade (except for the Nutella of course :P) and they use very high quality ingredients. Prices are reasonable too (RM14 per piece generally but of course depends on what you want). I would highly recommend the salted caramel butter crepe. The taste is divine and you will definitely come back for more! Try it! Location is just after Cenang Mall and before the Underwater World. Its on the left. Show less

Author: EvethetravellersSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tres Bon!
Review: Nice cafe for waffles and crepes but shop is small with limited seats.But the food quality is good for travelers to stop by for dessert.Show less

Author: dianedl17
Title: Best crêpes !
Review:
Delicious salty crepes. Very quick serving too. I ordered a crêpe with cream and mushrooms. Best i ever had! 

It's right next to cenang mall, 200 meters walking.

Author: turkia221
Title: French Cafe
Review:
Traditional waffle & crepe..
Amazing quality of ingredients..
Crispy waffle and thin crepe..
Friendly staff..

Author: andr_b853
Title: Awesome breakfast crepe
Review: Just loved this place. Delicious salty breakfast crepe with egg which is highly recommended. Excellent coffee also. Will be back evey morning when I am back in the area.

Author: NOBYCHAYANSingapore
Title: Super !.
Review: Was too excited to try it out and was rushing from Kuah ... thank God we could reach before last order and ordered a mix of salted and sweet crepes.. so blessed to have the divine crepes ... they made it with love.. service is great with lot of smiles .. must try in Langkawi Show less

Author: KennHettNew York City, New York
Title: Wish i could have pancakes every day:)
Review: Simply The best pancake i ever had. Wish i could try them all. Sweet or salty. Salty carmel was to die for.Show less

Author: Cikubi
Title: My tummy is soo happy here!
Review: Ordered a dark choc waffles, salted caramel crepe, a blue cheese with potato crepe and banana milkshakes. for all the goodies! For sure will comeback again!! Limited seats, must be patient for the seats.. but worth the wait! Quite big portion for waffles ..two person can share one ! Show less

Author: I7372YDmariecGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Crèpes bretonnes
Review: Small restaurant where you can enjoy salty and sweet crepes. The owners are french and follow the original recipe. Our crepes were very tasteful and everything was perfect. Service was friendly and effective. A good place to go!Show less

Author: ammadilyasawanRockhampton, Australia
Title: Breakfast
Review: Very nice food and ambience. Olivia and her team is very cooperative and there suggestions are spot on.It was one of the best food of not only langkawi but also in Malaysia.Add on: we forgot our 360cam at the place and they posted it on their Insta for us to get it back from them!Happy tourist !Show less

Author: Mansoor999Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome desert
Review: Lovely place with great taste authentic French desert. Hosts were lovely and both checked on us. Maya offered advice around Langkawi. Waffles were incredible as were the pancakesShow less

Author: peattielis21
Title: Yum yum
Review: I had a oreo milkshake AND waffles with homemade salted caramel sauce, cream and strawberries on top. I wouldnt normally do both but the menu was that delicious that i couldnt help myself. The food tasted better than it looked which is saying something (it looked delicious). I would definitely come back. Service was friendly and efficient.Show less

Author: cheehangf
Title: Super yummy!
Review: We ordered the salty crepe with egg and cheese and grilled chicken. I will say this the perfect crepe in the world!Show less

Author: Lauren RHamilton, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Crepes
Review: We came here for breakfast one morning and really enjoyed it. We had one savory crepe which had cheese, ham and egg in it, and one sweet which had caramel and nuts. They both were freshly made and tasted lovely. Would go here again.Show less

Author: Hannah C
Title: Incredibly rude
Review: I came here to have a coffee, when I advised what I assume was the owner I would not be buying food and would finish my coffee and go he snatched the menus off our table and asked me to leave as it was for customers only then turned his back on me straight away ignoring my questions about finishing my coffee. I am guessing he did not even bother to look at the table or listen to what I had said to notice that I had already purchased something. I had to ask the waitress who was lovely to please allow me to stay till I had finished my latte. When he was told I had a coffee he just said oh sorry and walked off again. Incredibly rude service.Show less

Author: tayclaireSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Crepes!
Review: Ordered chicken with cheese crepe and the honey lemon crepe. Both were freshly made to order so it came piping hot! Really tasty and I'll recommend this place if you're looking for something different!Show less

Author: ekta p
Title: Awesome crepes and smoothies
Review: Great collection of some fruit smoothies and beverages. French crepes and waffles. It is small place run by some french staff who are super friendly and nice. Enjoyed the afternoon.

Author: PritiKLSingapore, Singapore
Title: Enjoyed the Deserts
Review: We happen to visit My French Factory just as we were passing by. The salted Carmel Crepe was lovely. The staff were very friendly. Though I did not get a chance to try their other items on the menu, would definitely go back in future i am in Langkawi.Show less

Author: n00raishahs
Title: Happy tummy~
Review: A gem! The crepes and waffles here are the best! Visited this place twice during my try because I think I cannot get enough with the sweet treat here! If you are a fan of sweet food and don't really care about the price (affordable but the price can be up to RM20 per dish), this place is a must try!Show less

Author: Eliyazar R
Title: Great food
Review: Good food, reasonable price and friendly staff. We had a nutella waffle and grilled chicken + cheese crepe. It was awesome! Highly recommended. Thank you for the great food! 🤗

Author: IrishRachSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great savory crepe
Review: Dropped into French Factory since we wanted something light pre dinner and wanted to see what all the fuss is about.Ordered savory crepes egg chicken cheese, really good quality, staff were lovely and very attentive. Great crepe, nice ppl , wish them all the best.Show less

Author: sooliwinzKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Desserts - Super Yum!!
Review: This is a must go to place for desserts, located along the Pantai Cenang strip. Absolutely delightful range of crepes, waffles and also savoury flavours if you are looking for a light meal. Show less

Author: Rukia WHurghada, Egypt
Title: Heavenly desserts and such a friendly owne!
Review: Simply perfect!There were 5 of us so we ordered 5 different desserts, crepes and waffles with different toppings. Each and every dessert was made with a lot of love on the spot and the presentation is awesome!The owner came out and spent some time talking with us, she has an incredible story to tell about her passion to prepare dessert and enjoy life... Truly recommended for people who visit Langkawi!!Show less

Author: clairemo61384Denver, Colorado
Title: Delicious!!
