Review: We ordered the sea-salt butter caramel waffle and it was beyond delicious. The kinder crepe was great as well. The owner came out and met us and the staff was so friendly! Great little dessert place.Show less

Author: TaroSgSingapore
Title: Yummy Crepes and Excellent Service
Review: Had to try out the place since it's one of the top restaurants in Langkawi and and wasn't disappointed. Went there for some dessert and was impressed by the service. It's a really cosy place to just chill and hang out. The owner was also really nice to offer my friend a replacement drink for free after my friend accidentally knocked down his drink. It was a really nice gesture from the owner. Thumbs up on both the food and their customer service. Definitely worth a visit!Show less

Author: coralieabLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best crepes in Malaysia!
Review: My friend and I (both French) came here to get some French crepes and got to know the owner who had an incredible story to tell about her move from France to Langkawi!I highly recommend this pancake place as the food is made with love and the service is very friendly!Show less

Author: jessyqBBulacan
Title: Love their crepes
Review: Since it's one of the top restaurants in tripadvisor, we tried it for breakfast one morning and it didn't fail our expectation. We ordered 1 sweet and 1 savory and both we're really good. The owner also tried to chat and even gave us info as to where to get good cheese in langkawi.Show less

Author: Tun M
Title: Total disappoinment!
Review: This is my 3rd and last visit. The shop starts taking order only at 11am though the doors opens and chairs arranged at 10.45am by the time I arrived. Instead of walking around, decided to be sitted at the cafe table while waiting for 11am the staff to start taking order.Surprisingly, I was 'shoo' by the owner french guy from sitting there as the shop is not yet open.  I told them that i can wait for them but the most ridiculous explaination given by the rude and long faced owner (who also took my order without looking at me) was if I sit there, I may attract other people to also sit there and wait. It is supposed to be a good promotion since I am attractive enough to attract more customers. ;)Perhaps it is just my bad day as I understand most of the reviews are complimenting the owners. And I have to find somewhere else to sit while waiting for 11am. I will definitely not coming back to this place again since they are not valueing their customer. They are lucky to have a staff who was more friendly and warm than the male owner whom remembered and welcomed me back.Show less

Author: Robert1967mCoolangatta, Australia
Title: Perfect place for dessert crepes
Review: What an unexpected pleasure having authentic French crepes in the Main Street of Langkawi. We called in for a late dessert. The service was fast and friendly. The table seating was cosy and the atmosphere very friendly allowing a chat with other diners which was nice. Highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: flyhigh_jiyoung
Title: Thumbs up!
Review: I visited the first day myself while I'm waiting for my friend. I tried the waffle with strawberry. It was so nice! Coffee here is awesome. I brought my friend next day. She loved what she tried the food and drinks. It's my last day today. We are going there again before we go to the airport. ^^ Try what the staff recommends. They are very reliable and friendly. If you miss this cafe, you will regret! Show less

Author: 873geraldinea
Title: Surprisingly great food
Review: This was my second visit to Langkawi but I didn't notice this great coffee shop. It may look simple and small but this coffee shop gave me one of the best meals I had in Langkawi. Their crepe particularly the cheese and chicken is simply delicious and filling. We went back again before heading to the airport. The staff is friendly and accommodating❤️Show less

Author: Cameron B
Title: Good choice.
Review: Had lunch here. Both had the sweet crepes. Tasted amazing, only thing I could complain about was the serving portion was a tad small.But thats only for the sweet crepes we didn't try the savoury.Friendly staff.Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: ninamnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Miam! C'est vraiment tres bon!
Review: Somewhere amidst the hustle of Chenang Beach is a tiny little French creperie with the most extensive crepe and waffle menu! Sweet, savory or just what the holiday ordered, you'll be blown away by the generous portions and toppings. (The owner is French and she ensures the authenticity is not compromised.)Must say, these are the best crepes I've had in a very long time. Definitely a must-stop venue in Langkawi. Only thing is it's smack in the middle of the crazy Chenang strip. So watch for the French flag signboard. Don't blink! You may miss it and regret later! LOL!Show less

Author: kbachhavBerlin, Germany
Title: Delicious food personalised to our taste
Review: Again TripAdvisor recommended restaurant was worth it. Must visit place in langkawi. Owner of the restaurant personally interacts with customers and even offers a special customised dish. Thank you.Show less

Author: AdrianY397
Title: Dessert pan cake, fresh juices
Review: Along the street of cenang beach. Small shop, very warm and welcoming. Very good pan cake and juices. Bored of seafood and meaty staffs, this is a good place to stop by for a dessert.Show less

Author: 842kavitabMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great find in a tourist trap
Review: Lovely galette and milkshake - great service and so nice to find something familiar and value for moneyShow less

Author: liliant
Title: Here again
Review:
We revisit this place last week. We like it so we will come back. 

Now they have a competitor down the street. I have ate at both places.

LKW is undergoing many changes and there are more newer hotels and resorts.

Author: caryna378Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Mouth watering
Review: Visited this restaurant twice as it was warm, welcoming and great food. Both times we stopped for lunch which was tasty and very well presented. The Staff are super friendly and even though it is small they go out of their way to accommodate all who wish to eat there. Definitely worth the visit with the family or alone Show less

Author: prettybulletBradford England
Title: Tiny but terrific
Review: We searched for this place after reading about it on TripAdvisor. We can highly recommend it for a light lunch, or an afternoon treat. The first time we went we had a sweet crepe, but the second time(the day after) we both tried the savoury versions.Everything is made fresh, and even the sauces are made on the premises. The savoury ones are made to a different recipe using buck wheat, a tradition from Brittany apparently. This means they are darker in colour, and slightly crispy, and they are absolutely delicious.I haven't worked my way through the menu yet but so far I have had banana and salted caramel, and for the savoury one I had mushroom, cheese and onion with sour cream and they were both worth the very hot walk down Cenang Main Street.The only drawback I can see is that it is a very tiny place with the only seating out on the pavement under cover. What a shame there is no room for expansion because I have no doubt that they deserve to succeed.Thanks again..... we don't fly home for another week, so I am sure we will be back!!Show less

Author: crcrowderDenver, Colorado
Title: Amazing crepes!
Review: A friend and I came here for a late breakfast and loved this place! We both ordered the egg, cheese and potato crepe and were blown away by how good it was. Cooked to perfection. Had I had more time in Langkawi I would have gone back to try some of their sweet crepes as they looked delicious as well. The staff was all very friendly when they served us, and the owner popped over to say hi as well. Although the crepes are a bit pricier than some of the other food options in the area, if anyone has an appetite for crepes I couldn't recommend this place anymore. Loved!Show less

Author: Mitchw411
Title: Good crepes. Keep up the good work
Review: Crepes were delicious. Definitely one of the best I have ever had. Staff a also super friendly which makes it more pleasurable.

Author: MauricemerguezPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Best crepes in South-East Asia
Review: We've tried most crepes restaurant in many countries of SE-Asia where we live since 20 years. The French Factory cooks delicious crepes and galettes, and you'll get a taste of homeland if you come from Britanny. The owner is kind and helpfull. We strongly recommend this place. Show less

Author: Susmita8New Delhi, India
Title: Just ok
Review: Visited the place it is just adjacent to cenag mall , after dinner when we visited the place they told us that waiting time is 15 -20 minutes, also very less space if two families seat then no place for the 3rd family. Also Friday is off, their dessert is not very impressive to meShow less

Author: lalila1234
Title: Very tasty crepes
Review: If you like crepes (sweet and salty ) go there , it was very good and the stuff was super super friendly!!

Author: ladi_badi
Title: Great desserts and friendly service
Review: The desserts were delicious and carefully prepared,  the proprietor was present herself and makes your feel very welcome.  Only problem is the limited seating.

Author: Rob G
Title: Delicious
Review: This place is amazing. Great food and service. The milkshakes rival the crepes and it's easy to customise your own treats!

Author: arunikaekawatiSingapore, Singapore
Title: My fourth times and simply the best
Review: Today is my 4th visit and feeling lucky as always, love the crepes here each every time. What makes it different is the passion and love in preparing it.Every time tries different things and yet never have any doubt and hesitation.Mission:Try each every menu!Show less

Author: aaz8217
Title: Excellent Crepes!
Review: Wife and I tried the crepes. It was excellent. Friendly owners, had a good chat with them. Loved the presentation of the crepes, as well as the taste. Really worth the price paid.

Author: calg93London, United Kingdom
Title: Average crepe and wasn't hot
Review: Ordered the kinder bueno crepe , the crepe came out cold and the chocolate had not melted was disappointed as it was 16r. Bit overrated for my liking sorry guys! Nice presentation though.Show less

Author: 895pierreaBangkok, Thailand
Title: Simply the best crepes in southeast asia
Review: Perfect! After 10 years in SEA region, this the first time i have the chance to eat such a good crepe. This guy knows how, he respects the recipee, the product, the tools ... this is a standard. I am big crepes lover from Brest (brittany). Thank you! Keep the good job!Show less

Author: themanfromearthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy but need more veg options!
Review: The waffles are absolute yum. Softer than anywhere else we have had and with the caramel sauce, yum!!!! For the savory crepes, need more veg options. We ordered the ones on the menu and they were mainly potatoes and cheese while we are used to having veggies et al. Though have to say the actual crepe itself was absolutely crisp and fantastic! We hear the non veg fare is smashing so do check out.Recommended! Show less

Author: pavel387Russia
Title: Delicious
Review: Very tasty cousin.One of the big advantage as well is cleanness and hygienic factor.It is not easy to find on Langkawi a place where tables are really clean Show less

Author: passielees
Title: Love the Crepe Love the Pink Lemonade
Review: Love the food. Just that the shop is a lil' too small to accommodate big amount of people. The Pink Lemonade is my favorite.Show less

Author: JurienBayJurien Bay, Australia
Title: Awesome Milshakes
Review: Would have to be one of the best tasting milkshakes I have ever had. Peanut butter and Chocolate served up in a Nutella jar.Show less

Author: Lynne LKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Best crepe in town
Review: Never a crepe fans. But since it is highly recommended in trip advisor, we decided to give it a try. They made superb crepe. Will definitely come back again for more. Show less

Author: Gene CJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Crepes and Waffles from a wonderful French
Review: Run by a couple originally from France, some of the best crepes and freshly made waffles I've had.When she can, the lady running the place even pops out to chat with customers and even tries to help recommend places to visit if you're in need of some travel tips while there.Do note as it is a muslim run place, they ask for clients to refrain from drinking (no alcohol), smoking and to also toShow less

Author: shiroatklKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Crepes Ever !!
Review: A little small eatery on the main road (next to Cenang Mall to be exact). We had the nutella banana crepes for the 1st time and it taste fantastic. Generous amount of nutella and bananas. Cant get enough of that, went back the next day to try on the salted caramel crepes with homemade coconut ice cream. It taste superb. The coconut ice cream goes well with the salted caramel. The staff are friendly and will this will definitely to visit eatery on next visit to Langkawi.Show less

Author: mavi252mavi252
Title: Scrummy!
Review: This is a tiny place for on the main road in Pantai cenang.Only small so you may miss it, but once you've been you will want to return!Service with a smile & a fantastic menu ! We all opted for the sweet crepes . Which included Nutella & Beuno chocolate!!!! Wow!!!!!!Should not be misse!!!Show less

Author: Ivanna R
Title: Wonderful!!!
Review: Great customer service, which is quite hard to find here. The waffles are wonderful made in the moment. Lovely place to grab dessert or dinner! Would come here again .

Author: gauthamg16Bengaluru, India
Title: Downright superb
Review: This is a little eatery on the main road, which serves superb crepes. We had the savory crepes as well as the sweet crepes, and they were amongst the best crepes I have had - delicious, and general portions. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable and very helpful. This place is definitely worth visiting again and again!Show less

Author: sarazakiboyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fab
Review: We discovered this place on our second night, as I was looking for something sweet. I was definitely NOT disappointed, I had salted Carmel waffle and had to go back again the next night. The quality is next to none and I will definitely go back for my last last night in Langkawi. If u want quality crepes and waffles this is ur place. The staff are friendly and welcoming. Keep up the quality and service.Show less

Author: stevefoutoulisRhodes Town, Greece
Title: Definitely not no 1
Review: Visited this shop after seeing it was number one on trip advisor, it is a very small , cramped uncomfortable place, very expensive for langkawi prices considering how poor the portions are, crepe was cold by the time it was served, read responses of the owner after saying how fresh the batter is , big deal, water , egg and flour !Not worth a visit , would go to Sun Cafe for a sweet fix instead !Show less

Author: farrlleyjShanghai
Title: Best crepes and waffles ever!
Review: The owners and staff pay attention to detail from their immaculate store to their flawless presentation and preparation of the food. These were hands down the best savory and sweet crepes we've ever had! We had the egg, cheese, and potato; strawberry, almond, Nutella, and whipped cream; the banana Nutella; and strawberry, Nutella, Ice cream waffles. We will be back this week for sure! Show less

Author: Futureproof
Title: Lovely yummy crepes
Review: Visited My French factory for dessert. Range of sweet and savoury options were really good ranging from 9RM to 28RM. Staff were friendly and the homemade pink lemonade was really nice. Will visit again to try a savoury crepe before I leave Langkawi.

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Still great quality & service
Review: This is my third time here in two years, and I'm glad to see that the quality is still up to par and the service as friendly as ever. As always, do try their banana & salted caramel crepe (add a scoop of homemade coconut ice-cream for an extra punch). We also tried their "pizza" galette this time (with sauce tomat, chicken & cheese) and while tasty, I think I still prefer their mushrooms, cheese & creme fraiche galette. Keep up the great work! I'll definitely check in the next time I'm in Langkawi! ;)Show less

Author: joshual992
Title: CNY family trip 2017
Review:
Stopping by here before head to airport. Friendly staffs, nice food and relaxing.
Outdoor sitting with breeze and seeing people walking by. Life is good.

Author: mariapI2560DXKoege, Denmark
Title: Delicious pancakes
Review: We ordered two different kinds of crepes and a coffee. The coffee was also good. We got a crepes with salted caramel and on with Nutella, banana and coconutIt tasted really good and looked fantastic. So if u have a sweet tooth u should go there.Show less

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic Breton Galetts Crepes
Review: Excellent Breton Crepes and Galetts, took me straight back to out annual family holidays on the Bretom/Loire-Atlantique Atlantic border at Guemene Penfao. Not the cheapest meal in town in town but the quality was amazing and so authentic, only thing missing was a cup of cider. However it's Muslim owned place so drink the fine fruit juices instead. Don't miss the chance to sample real Breton fare in Malaysia.Show less

Author: m36705Singapore, Singapore
Title: It was Goooood!
Review: Closed on Fridays, which was why I ended up at the Burgersmith place which was comme si comme ca.We had lunch at MY French Factory on Sunday. I ordered the beef ham crepe with caramalized onions and It was wonderful. Wanted to have a dessert crepe but we didn't have time. Next trip!Service was fast and pleasant. The lady boss was kind to explain the use of different batter for the different crepes they serve. (we sat at the counter inside the restaurant)Show less

Author: 1Travelled_the_world
Title: Serously not that great
Review: over priced but if you like french pastries maybe you'll like it here. Not that impressed with the service and l've tasted better from street vendors in Paris. Can't see how this is number one, never that many people in there.

Author: SultanZayedM
Title: The best crepes and waffles ever!
Review: During my entire stay in Langkawi Island I would pass by to satisfy my sweet tooth in this amazing place! Very friendly owners too.

Author: Maria_RapsoffAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Very good Crêpes
Review: My french Factory is run by french expats.I had the salted caramel one and it was really good. Thin and crispy, the salty caramel was perfectly balanced.I had way worse crêpes in France. I could have easily eaten two here- it was so delicious :-).The place is very small and usually busy, so they really want you to finish up as fast as possible because other customers are waiting. Hence, the service is fast but very friendly.Show less

Author: Tun M
Title: Happy tummy happy me!
Review: Good crepè and friendly staff who never failed to smile and making sure you are enjoying the awesome crepè. I went there 2days in a row just to have bfast. Simply irresistable! Will definitely come again.

Author: 342cindyqBlair Athol, Australia
Title: Best crepes I have had!
Review: I went there thinking it would be just a normal crepe and Australia has plenty of the gourmet crepe places. Pleasantly surprised, the crepes were thin and crispy. Texture was great. I would recommended this as a dessert break with a dollop of ice-cream! No airconditioning though, but there are a lot of fans going. Once you sit down and have their cold milkshakes, the heat isn't so noticeable anymore. Show less

Author: zanabj2016Bicester, United Kingdom
Title: YummY!
Review: Lovely food, great location, good variety, reasonable prices and a brilliant service! Thumbs up from me Show less

Author: Kashif S
Title: The Best Crepes Ever
Review: If visiting Lankawi, this is a must visit place.The food is out of this world, and the management is absolutely amazing. We had 2 meals in as many days here.Show less

Author: sherzzzySingapore, Singapore
Title: Very delicious and fluffy crepes!
Review: Friendly staff, good crepes, though a little pricey as they use buckwheat flour very delicious waffles as well. soft and fluffy. wished we had another chance to drop by. do hope you can expand to other countries!Show less

Author: JanneheleLempaala, Finland
Title: Not so special
Review: The service is good and the food is tasty, but it's rather expensive and menu is limited to waffles and greps mainly. So dont really put this as top place in langkawi.Show less

Author: 920fujEspoo, Finland
Title: Good crepes but pricy
Review: In my opinion 25 $ for 2 creps and 2 milkshakes is too much in place like langkawi. The taste of the crepes was good but nothing over the top special. Show less

Author: KiwiJonnyHaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated, but okay?
Review: Personally, I found the place overrated and overpriced. Community may have different opinion to me, which is okay, so it's more of a personal thought.I liked the crepe, it was good. The coconut milkshake was lovely as well.The only thing is, as a first impression... It wasn't terribly great. We sat down and had an empty bottle of alcoholic drink on the table, and instead of menu nor greeting... What we first heard from the waitress was: "Throw that away to the bin there." As she pointed to a bin.I can totally understand restaurant rules (including things like no smoking and no beach wear), but there's no excuse for how the message was delivered.Didn't manage to have interaction with other waiters or the owners/chefs, so can't comment on that.Show less

Author: Shasass
Title: Crepes! And more crepes!!
Review: Unfortunately, we passed by this place after lunch, on our first day in Langkawi! Otherwise we'd have ended up going there everyday! Superb crepes filled with whatever you can imagine! And they have healthy variations, which makes it even more awesome! You can have a crepe filled with cheese, potatoes and beef ham, for lunch. And then follow it up with a crepe filled with bananas and peanut butter for dessert! Or you can simply finish off with a nice waffle!! Amazing stuff! It's run by a couple of extremely nice people from, well, France!!:)) Great stuff! Keep it up guys!Show less

Author: DaFeenaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best crepes ever!!!!
Review: We love the crepes and waffles here. Plenty choices including the savoury crepes. We went for two times. I had waffle and savoury crepe and my darling had banana Nutella crepes. We just speechless in every bite!!!!! Wonderful breakfast especially during the Christmas ❤Show less

Author: Sebastien PYokohama, Japan
Title: Perfect for sweet or salty break lunch !!
Review: After a morning beach time with the family "my French Factory" was perfect for lunch, nice little terrace with worm and welcoming service, Food is very good and offer the real french crêpe, sweet or salty they are both a great choice !! Owner are really nice and the all experience make you feel welcome to this beautiful island of Langkawi !! Show less

Author: Dreamer307602Jersey, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning Galettes and Waffles.
Review: We treated ourselves to a savoury Galette and sweet waffles. We were not disappointed. They are just like you would find in France with all the traditional toppings. It's a tiny place with not much seating, the owner is great. She comes over for a chat & is really useful/helpful with tips and suggestions about Langkawi. It's not cheap but what you expect from European food in a foreign country. Would definitely go again, there's a whole menu of delicious crepes that need making their way through! Show less

Author: lil_eLLyShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Awesome crepes with a friendly smile
Review: Just had both the sweet and savior crepes tonight for dinner. The bf love the blue cheese. Was delicious. The owner and the staffs were really friendly and they helped to recommend which crepes you should go with. A definite must try in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Ahmad H
Title: Lovely delicious crêpe!
Review: Cute cafe serving special crêpe made specially from french chef!.Wonderful taste.We had 2 crêpe with salmon topping & grille chicken mushroom.A must cafe to visit whenever you in Langkawi.Show less

Author: BernardLiowMalaysia
Title: Delightful crepe and snacks but overrated and overpriced
Review: Place for crepe and snacks, on a busy part of Jalan Cenang. We find this place overrated. Very simple crepe with some basic affordable ingredients (eg: nutella, coconut shreds, banana, ice-cream) and charged around RM20+. Well, kids will love the creatively decorated crepes.Show less

Author: Sophia T
Title: Quaint little cafe
Review: Crepes were great! The one with coconut ice cream, Nutella and coconut is refreshing. Mind you, I don't usually take coconut in desserts. I gobbled this one in minutes. Wash down the crepes with pink lemonade served in Nutella jars!  Perfect!

Author: vikasverms
Title: Excellent Crepes
Review: The crepes here are excellent though the vegetarian  options are pretty limited, located conveniently off the cenang beach, totally worth visting

Author: 639abbieCanberra, Australia
Title: France in Langkawi
Review: Well not quite but at least the crepes are as good as you can get from France. There is very little sitting so unless you r willing to wait or want to take away (really cmon) then be there at times outside peak like lunch. Their crepes are great, do the dark chocolate, salted caramel Xmas Nutella all sure win flavours and they did not disappoint.Show less

Author: soj0urnerEarth
Title: ABSOLUTELY LOVE THE LOADED CREPE!
Review: We just had to stop here simply because I love crepe... and it didn't disappoint. We ordered a dessert crepe with 'everything'! Loaded with bananas, coconut, drizzled with nutella sauce and topped with a coconut ice cream made in-house, and fresh waffles. This was a great tea time break. Food prepared by the friendly very tall French owner/chef. There is limited seating, and the pavement next to the seating area is undergoing some repaving but it was ok. Anything for great crepe!Show less

Author: Capricornkeong
Title: We came here everyday
Review: My Girlfriend and I love crepes. I had my first taste of crepes in Paris 3 years ago and I fell in love with the basic sugar crepes that they make everywhere on the street. after that trip I was not able to taste anything close to the ones I had in Paris. This is my second trip to langkawi, I was there earlier in the year in the beginning of Jan and my Girlfriend and I wanted to visit my French factory. Unfortunately it was closed for a few weeks. we were fortunate this time round and we ended up fixing most of our sweet tooth cravings here. I must say the sugar and butter crepe was so good, that it made me come back the next two days to try their other Flavours. My gf had the dark chocolate and roasted almond crepe and she LOVED it! The owners and the service staff provided very good and patient service to us and we were disappointed that it will be closed on the last two days of our trip. Nonetheless, I would recommend fellow crepe lovers to give a try at the authentic and lovey crepes. Lastly don't forget to ask for their special crepe of the month if you like food surprises! Ps: we are camera shy so we didn't post our photos, but you can go and take one yourself! :)Show less

Author: Dragonfli3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: lovely french crepe cafe
Review: Lovely hole in the wall cafe serving all sorts of crepes. Its more a place for dessert or light snack. The space sadly rather small but the food and warm service more than makes up for it.Show less

Author: OTBCJonNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Snack Fast Food Shack
Review: We visited here as we saw this was the #1 restaurant on Langkawi on TripAdvisor.What we found was a crepe fast food outlet selling dressed up crepes with sweet and savoury toppings.We expected to find a variety of French cuisine on the menu but we left very disappointed.Tip: If you do not like crepes then I would advise you not to visit as that is the main dish on the menu.If you enjoy eating crepes for main and dessert then you will have a nice meal but for us we like a restaurant with ambience and a wider choice on the menu.Show less

Author: cheewanthamSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Would like to try more!!
Review: Friend told me that this is the No.1 restaurant rated in Tripadvisor, must give a try. Therefore I walked pass and stop at the restaurant and ordered a waffles, the taste really good and didn't disappoint me. Would like to order sweet crepe but couldn't fill in anymore. The next 2 days was close during my stay, so must come back again for my next visit.Show less

Author: eladly1985
Title: Excellent place
Review: Yummy Yummy,, actually i cant express how happy and satisfied i am,, its perfect delicious clean welcoming place to have your breakfast or dessert, prices are reasonable, waiters waitresses oweners are so welcoming A MUST VISIT PLACE IN LANGKAWI Show less

Author: laotravelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Will return back!!!
Review: Fall in love with this placeMy truth confessionHighlly recommended for thos coming to langkawi,should pay a visit to this cafeThey have lovely food!!!,most friendliest owners and staff ever met and lovely little cafep/s:order C19 and forgot another one but in salty crepe menuShow less

Author: Departure679831
Title: Delicious Waffles
Review: I was passing this shop time and it wasn't a mistake to swing by. The waffle is superb i just can describe how enjoyable the taste was. Yums!

Author: hellosteff_Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome waffle & crepe place!!
Review: One of the best waffle & crepe places I've ever been to. Went here twice for my recent trip to Langkawi, I had Salted Caramel Almond Waffle for lunch and the next day Chicken Cheese Crepe for breakfast. Totally delicious!! The place is a bit small but big in services. Totally recommended!!Will definitely go here when I visit Langkawi again <3Show less

Author: hatong g
Title: Super delicious crepes and waffles
Review: We stay one week in the district and we eat here everyday we can, the crepes are very delicious, made by French owners with their passion and love! No matter salted or sweet, they taste really the best you can hope for! Especially love Le complet with mushroom, ham, cheese. The waffle or crepe with banana or strawberry, whipped cream and salted butter caramel was so delicious..., even just butter and sugar... They all GOOD! As good as those best crepes you can find in France! Highly recommended! Show less

Author: Joanneyeow6Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent crepe and waffle
Review: At first thought they serve lunch, but then realised they only serve dessert. Anyway, we give it a try. Initially, the owner's wife, (shld be) was not really that friendly. There we 3 of us and the place was pretty small so we wanted to sit inside cos it started raining, and she was not very friendly and was saying that is only what we have, take it or leave it. So we were then seated out side.Anyway, after awhile, cos it was raining really heavily we move inside, and asked the husband whether can he get us another chair and he help us with that.After we order our foods, we start talking to the lady and she start to warm up to us.Anyway, the dessert is really good!Show less

Author: pathmosttravelled
Title: Authentic French Crepes
Review: This place serves french crepes as authentic as the owners are french. Delicious! Don't miss out on the waffles either. Friendly and warm people (it's not just the weather that's warm).

Author: hafimoz
Title: Nice french crepe
Review: We ordered the caramel banana crepe for takeaway. Tasty crepe and caramel sauce despite having it 30 mins later. Would return when we're in langkawi. The small place also serves coffee and has nice ambience for eating in. Friendly service too.

Author: Habibah G
Title: yum
Review: best crepes you'll ever have. owners are very friendly and lovely customer service. i will go again just for these crepes

Author: Frank JPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Best French pancakes in Asia by far, and just really good!
Review: As I said above definitely amazing pancakes and waffles too. If you like what you get in France, you're gonna get exactly the same here. Very light, delicious ingredients (I'm thinking of the strawberries or the home made caramel for example). On top of that the owner are really nice and ready to explain you other things worth exploring in langkawi. Definitely a must go place if you're in the neighbourhood ;-)Show less

Author: _F6307DAValparaiso, Chile
Title: Delicious crepes! Amazingly tasteful and fresh!
Review: A highly-recommended place to eat famous and amazingly tasty French crepes and waffles!If you are going here, be prepared for a warm welcome and delicious desserts! :)A couple of French are cooking everything being in a nice union with 2 locals, and it looks very peacuful and friendly which is a good sign of respect to this country IMHO.Show less

Author: StarLord22Blackburn, Australia
Title: Oh my god YES
Review: My French factory brings a little slice of French desserts to Langkawi. Everything is halal and is so delicious that you just want to move there. I recommend the waffles and crepes with salted caramel which are all original recipes of the lovely owner Sumayah, who herself is one of the loveliest people you will meet on the island. She greets you and stops to have a conversation with you providing she's not too busy, she speaks French, English and Malay and is extremely accommodating. Definitely check my French factory out, you won't forget it!Show less

Author: tingjin
Title: Nice!
Review: A good place to try original French food. The restaurant is very small, not a cozy place for dining.

Author: Yasser F
Title: Tasty
Review:
- Nice place to get a french dessert style !! 
- You will feel the hospitality once you step by.
- The cost is fair enough .

Author: amarie10mySingapore, Singapore
Title: Oo La La The Best Crepes Ever!!!
Review: I'd had the longing for a good crepe experience and I finally found it in my favourite island resort getaway Langkawi, My French Factory just gave me one more reason to keep going back to visit. The owner operators are true blue French and they know their crepes. It was so good, I forgot to pay my bill that sent the sweet owner after me. It was funny but boy I got to say they really make good savoury and sweet crepes. My next trip back there will see me and my besties parked thereabouts to dine breakfast, lunch and dinner to try as many of their creations. Salted caramel and banana crepes never tasted so good. A must to do when in Langkawi!Show less

Author: zelles2016Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent dessert place!
Review: This is probably the only decent french desserts place you can ask for! The crepes (sweet ones) and the waffles with ice cream are excellent choices for tropical weather! The drinks are really nice too! The place is a little small but cosy. The owners are really friendly too and a taste of the soft crepes that kinda melt in your mouth. They have salty crepes too perfect for tea!Show less

Author: Millerlight6565St. Augustine, Florida
Title: FABULOUS FRENCH CREPES
Review: We came here every day for breakfast once we had discovereed this tiny little gem of a restaurant, situated on the street, just right of the Cenang shopping mall . It has a very continental feel, it's fun sitting out on the pavement, terrasse style , and the crepes are simply the most delicious we have ever tasted since leaving France.Very lovely staff and the VERY charming french owners, Maya and her husband are extremly helpful and give everyone a very warm welcome.  Can't wait to go back for another delicious Crepe !Show less

Author: TheMohicanFamily
Title: French Connection in Langkawi
Review: Brilliant alfresco concept with simple food for lunch. Good interior inside the shop. Good Service. Truly french concept of resto. Avoid sitting outside due to smoke & dusty from the road works along cenang beach road.

Author: Soon-Heng53Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sugar is Nice, a French Surprise
Review: Crepes and waffles with Nutella and nuts, with homemade salted caramel, with chocolate; and topped with strawberries, with bananas...What's not to like about light, fluffy crepes or waffles with a sweet dressing. And made by a young person who is a native French speaker from that part of Europe.Went to MY French Factory two nights in a row and might again this evening. Last evening I sat beside a couple (in their 50s) from Wales who have decided to spend two whole weeks in Langkawi. They confessed while eating their crepes that it wasn't their first visit to My French Factory. They were there only a couple of days ago.See. It is a place that you'd want to visit again and again to taste the varieties of dressings on the crepes and waffles.Show less

Author: 285tillyc
Title: Best crepes I've eaten out of France!
Review: Such a friendly place, with amazing crepes! So glad we happened to find it, it's definitely some of the best food I've eaten in Malaysia! Worth a visit if you like friendly staff and cheese!

Author: imran3Middlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: lovely crepes!
Review: if you love crepes.. you will love this place!I had the salted caramel crepes on both occasions we visited, once accompanied with a latte, the second time with tea (as coffee machine was out of order). Enjoyed very much. The manager/owner i believe is a french lady. very welcoming and pleasant.it is a very small shop.. with very limited seating, so you may have to wait for a table to clear. The crepes also seemed to take a long time. but you can just sit outside in the warm weather and enjoy the atmosphere while you wait!Show less

Author: 361grahame
Title: Lived up to expectations
Review: When a restaurant is rated #1 you obviously have high expectations. I'm glad to say we weren't disappointed. Although we didn't try the crepes, the waffles were superb. This is not a fine dining establishment, nor does it pretend to be - just a small place serving honest, delicious French fare at reasonable prices. The owners are very friendly and happy to have a chat. Only drawback is that it's closed two days a week and this wasn't made very clear (I think it's closed on Thursday and Friday) - we came wanting to try this place three days in a row, and it was a case of third time lucky. But it was worth the wait!Show less

Author: JSIM78
Title: Fantastic crepes!
Review: One of the best crepes I had ever eaten. We had a great time. Rainy day doesn't help but the food brighten our day.

Author: Z V
Title: Absolutely scrumptious!
Review: We ordered crêpe with nutella, banana and whipped cream. The best crêpe I've ever had! Definitely go here if you're in Langkawi! The owner was very courteous and friendly

Author: Ariez S
Title: Best Dessert you can find in Langkawi
Review: I was curious to try dessert from this cafe, as many peoples say its super delicious.We were having a crepes and waffle wich is amazing, the taste are wonderful same as the presentation.really recomended and we will be backShow less

Author: SunziiRossmore NSW
Title: AMAZING!!!
Review: Tried this place with my husband for the first time Yesterday, we had the waffle with Nutella strawberries and ice cream.... WOW!!! Doesn't even describe the word, one of the best we've ever had, so for our last night here in Langkawi we just had to go back today for more, we also couldn't resist trying the crepe which was also Amazing. They are also made fresh right in front of you.Espresso was really nice too Staff were very Friendly and fast to serve us thank you.We didn't wait long for our plates to come out either and what can I say....... we weren't disappointed at all.If only we could take these Chefs home with us Down under Show less

Author: Verity T
Title: Amazing, authentic French Crêperie
Review:
This is a must visit when you are in Langkawi!

We weren't expecting to crave a crêpe Malaysia but walking past you can not avoid it!
So yummy and very good prices! 
Lovely friendly staff!
Will be coming back here for sure!

Author: ronihanabi
Title: Best food ,best people
Review: I recommending those people to visit langkawi to try this restaurant food was yummi clean and best people merci beaucoup.👌🏻🇫🇷

Author: charlottam2016Stockholm, Sweden
Title: Delicious!
Review: This little cute restaurant was a lovely surprise for us when we went for lunch. The crepes were absolutely delicious. We also shared a pink lemonade, also very tasty. The service was great and the staff was nice! Unfortunately the place closed for a week the day after we visited the first time so we couldn't go back. Show less

Author: GojavasBengaluru, India
Title: Nice crepes but need a more exhaustive ice cream menu
Review: We went here around 4 pm for a dessert and as the reviews mentioned before this is a highly rated place. Unfortunately for us, we wanted to have some ice creams and thought that the crepes would have some ice creams in it but there was only one scoop of chocolate ice cream(you have a choice between vanilla and chocolate).Dont get me wrong, the ice cream was delicious along with the banana,nutella crepe which was highly recommended but we would have liked if they expand their menu to include a separate ice cream section only for ice cream lovers. The lady owner was very friendly as she gave an extra spoon for my little kid to enjoy the crepes but we finished the ice creams and bananas first and the crepe became rather bland to eat all alone. Overall quite satisfied.Note that they are closed on Thursdays and Fridays as we realized that when we went on friday afternoon. They are located in very near the Cenang mall.Show less

Author: MarwanN95
Title: Amazing place
Review: The best place in the word to eating creb with ice cream , the French boy mange shop in LANGKAWI , every thing s homemade , friendly staff highly recommend to visit it

Author: adleena2016
Title: 5 star service
Review: Awesome service with awesome food.. highly recommended.. will definitely come again.. gonna try the savory section next!!

Author: HanifflaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good French Foods in this Malay dominated part of the Island
Review: Good to see a French Couple serving good foods especially their waffles, pancakes & other savories in the middle of Pantai Cendang of Langkawi Island. Good waffles that we ate & we really enjoyed it. The only comment is the place is too small to cater the numbers of customer that kept coming! The young lady owner is friendly which the husband is too busy preparing the foods! Never miss this place if you are in Langkawi Island. Show less

Author: nurulfarhanahaz
Title: Best pancake & crepe
Review:
This is the best original pancake in Langkawi,n i guess in Malaysia. Recommended to all. 

Try the nutella pancake,strawberry salted caramel ice cream,pink lemonade n so many food n drink that really superb. 

It a MUST PLACE need to come in Langkawi

Author: TsaiD
Title: must try
Review: this is a very good place to spend your afternoon they have really good food with nice location , I love their sweet French panket

Author: jazs_jz
Title: super delicious, recommended
Review: staffs are super friendly, food super delicious. the place is quite small so we packed our food and eat it in the hotel room. totally recommended

Author: R3dhi11
Title: Best crepe in the whole malaysia.
Review: One would not disappointed with the aroma of the cheese and the smell of the crepe just melts your heart. Taste exactly like in France.  I just fall in love with it.

Author: lleongkm
Title: Great place to have dessert at Cenang beach
Review: Stopped by for some dessert on a hot afternoon. The place has limited seats, but the service was good and the crepes and waffles were excellent. Highly recommended.

Author: Bhupinder2010Sungai Petani, Malaysia
Title: Nice crepe and waffle but pricy
Review: with some difficulty we found this place after asking a few people. Sitting is limited so sat at high tables on bar stools on the walkway, which was OK for us. The staff who served us was not as knowledgeable as the French Muslim couple who own the outlet and served us. The menu is very readable with pictures to help you make a difficult choice - because everything looks delicious. Pricing is on the high side so we had a crepe and a waffle between the 2 of us as a snack late morning. Worth a trip just to experience it once. Rated highly on TripAdvisor.Show less

Author: salman_farsi
Title: Good crêpe!
Review: Crêpes cooked to perfection. Savoury and dessert style items available. Very tasty and enjoyable. I ordered a fresh apple juice too!

Author: hipdonut
Title: Amazing crepes and waffles
Review: A small cafe but it was very accomodating for my family of 5. Such a lovely place and delicious crepes and waffles. It's best enjoy anytime! Do not miss them in your places-to-visit.

Author: leekeng993
Title: Delicious waffles and crepes
Review: My family ordered a variety of waffles and crepes and were very satisfied with the food. Will visit again whenever I am back in Langkawi. Waffles and crepes were really good and delicious.

Author: Explorer667749
Title: Supèr
Review: Had breakfast here, a lovely egg and cheese with mushroom kick to it. Super friendly chefs and waiters. The chef herself came over to take my order and checked with me into my meal. A nice gesture. Reasonably priced too.

Author: Changee610
Title: Definitely worth a try!
Review: Found this small yet unique restaurant by using this app and yes, I'm not disappointed at all! The seats are limited, which explains why it's always full house everytime we pass by. The staffs are friendly. And its crepe is almost close to perfect! A perfect lunch choice for u guys in Langkawi instead of feeding yourselves with orthodox fast food again :)Show less

Author: yssunilSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fluffy waffles and creamy ice creams
Review: Man o Man... The lively French couple brings Belgian into Langkawi. I followed to this place just because of the TripAdvisor ranking. While I was initially shocked to see that it was a very small dessert place the same time I was Glad that they are no. 1 ranked being a small but unique outlet. That's what make TA a genuinely traveller led portal.It's a street side place with around 4 tables and can fit in at best 20 people. Do try their crepes and of course waffles. Don't forget to try the waffle with their signature vanilla ice team. The creamy milky ice cream sways you away. Again moderately priced and a waffle costs around 16MYR and a drink around 10. Show less

Author: tinkikuttihSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Crepes
Review: Friendly staff. Crepes was delicious and superb. A must place to visit when you are in Langkawi. Love the concept of saving the earth bag.Show less

Author: VincentoslKlang, Malaysia
Title: Great food, warm place
Review: A small restaurant which served great taste of crepes and waffles. Great service and awesome food. Keep it up the good job!Show less

Author: DarienRobbo
Title: Absolutely delicious
Review: Stopped by as a family yesterday - 3 waffles and 2 crepes. All top-drawer - each and every one. Throughly enjoyed the homemade caramel sauce. Iced coffee was perfect too. Definitely planning to squeeze another visit before heading home....

Author: 482shabinas
Title: Holiday
Review: We saw the cafe everytime we passed by... we had to stop... but it was closing.. we went back next day... we ordered savoury and sweet... wasnt too keen on the savoury but the sweet.. omg soooo tasty... small place.. but seated our family of 5... my kids loved it ate every single piece... i tasted everyones and have to say was soooo tasty.. the owner came upto us and asked how it was.. she was very warm and inviting.. read her story.. God bless them both.. wish and pray every success for the couple... not easy giving up your life and moving thousands of miles away from your family.. hopefully on my 10th trip they wouldve got a bigger place and i will be in there for lunch most of my trip.. give it a 5 out 5 for hosting and the food... Show less

Author: mic_80_9
Title: So-so
Review: Was very disappointed...saw the reviews of this place and had very high expectations...nothing to rave about...i ordered a mushroom sour cream and cheese crepe...had to 2 mouthfuls and i had enough. No flavour, not tasty. I've visited other creperies in france and australia and this was not the same standard..definitely wouldn't rate this as #1 restaurant in langkawi...if you're after a true French crepe, this is not the place.Show less

Author: ronaldl872Nigtevecht, The Netherlands
Title: Best pancakes outside of French
Review: Nice small place where they prepare pancakes with love :-) - was absolute positive surprised by the salty pancakes. We ended up eating 4 different pancakes with the two of us. Our breakfast and lunch. And they offer GlutenFree!!Show less

Author: migratoryleyKathmandu, Nepal
Title: Absolutely perfect
Review: Delicious crepes, even more delicious waffles, even even more adorable staff... Just a wonderful place to stop by and have a snack / lunch / dinner, anything.Memorable Nutella milkshake, wonderful refreshing pink lemonade, great affogato. Loved it !!Show less

Author: 257guneetk
Title: Tasty Crepe
Review: I ate the strawberry crepe. It was great. The staff is friendly and warm. It's a cute small shop. My friend ordered the banana coconut crepe. He also seemed happy and satisfied with his order. Should visit for sure. Show less

Author: Maha NCanada, Kentucky
Title: AMAZING
Review: I recommend this place to anyone with a sweet tooth!! Amazinggggh crepes and very friendly staff ❤️. The chocolate they have is amazing I highly recommend this place. Show less

Author: Hamad A
Title: Tasty!!
Review: verry nice place and verry tasty waffles you most try the creep and waffles and also great coffee nice couples you most try it .Show less

Author: Mikekaori
Title: 2 visits within 24 hours
Review: Amazingly authentic crepes and host! Love the galettes, nutella banana and sour cream with cheese! We managed to practise our french with the host too! Definitely one of the highlight of our trip to langkawi.. a tres bientot! Mike et derek

Author: Amrazor
Title: Dessert heaven
Review: This was so good I went back again. I wasn't the only one either. The place is small so seating is usually crowded but u are eventually accommodated. It is definitely worth the wait.Show less

Author: GabstatoriWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Beautiful crepes and waffles!
Review: Visited My French Factory after reading some great reviews and it did not dissapoint! The owners are very friendly and genuinely care about their customers and whether they have had a good experience. We tried the crepes and waffles and loved the home made salted caramel sauce (that actually tasted salted, unlike many salted caramels I have tried before). The waffles were light and fluffy, and the crepes were equally as delicious. I would definitely recommend! Show less

Author: huichingleongSingapore
Title: Friendly staffs and good place to chill.
Review: Had their popular banana + nutella + coconut + ice cream crepe. Ordered one for myself and one for fiance. Too good to be sharing! Stall is easy to spot (right along the main road) but is a little cramp as they are doing pavement renovation outside thus lesser space. But waiting time wasn't an issue as they are so nice and polite. At RM 21 (SGD 7) I think its quite decent!Show less

Author: AymanA_12
Title: Greatest customer attention
Review: Great light food and deserts based on crepes and waffles. Very friendly owners/chefs wife Somaia and husband Vincent (i hope i got the names correct). The food is very delicious. Great attention to customers by the couple owners/chefs.

Author: 222walidb
Title: Culinary delight
Review: The pancakes are amazing!! Very friendly owners! Small place.. but worthy! The pink shake was refreshing and really good!

Author: shalpetrusKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Crepe
Review: Best crepe! We wish to have it in KL too. We tried Egg and Cheese, for RM14 each. Wish to try more but we weren't really well. Will definitely come back and eat other things on their menu. The price is quite expensive though. If you're super hungry, one crepe won't be enough, so adding one more if their best crepe, ur one time meal could cost you for RM40 :PShow less

Author: Joan_Shori
Title: French Crepes
Review: Excellent service and good crepes. Owned by a delightful French couple who wanted to introduce something French for the island. Bear in mind that the crepes are soft and not crispy .. the French style.

Author: LookwhatlauralovesDoha, Qatar
Title: Holy crepe!
Review: Wow! I am so happy my husband and I stumbled upon this cute little French spot on our walk. We usually try to stick to local cuisine but my love for crepes had us stop. The crepes were light and cooked to perfection! From the flavor to the service get your French on in Malaysia! Show less

Author: hamdashian
Title: Loved it!!
Review: Loved absolutely everything about this place, the dessert was an easy 10/10, the service was fantastic and fast, and the staff were so friendly and genuine. Visited this cafe a few times in our stay in Langkawi!! Highly recommend!

Author: oliviacflanaganLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A sweet treat
Review: We visited the crêperie after reading about it on trip advisor and it certainly didn't disappoint. We shared a Nutella, caramel and peanut crêpe as a mid-afternoon snack and it was delicious! The staff were really friendly, especially the Parisian owner, she even makes the salted caramel sauce herself! A must try in Pantai Cenang. C'était délicieux!!Show less

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Very good crepes!
Review: we have been trying to go to this place many times but it always closed later only we realise they open at 1PM! My wife decided to push me to go again in the afternoon luckily there were open! I brought my 3 children there and they enjoyed the food there very much but we found the butter milkshake( if I am not mistaken) was a bit too sweet but no problems when we approached the lady owner they make it not so sweet for us. However there is no toilet in the restaurant and they pointed out to me to go to the restroom in the hotel next door, however when I went in to the hotel and ask for the restroom the receptionist ask me if I am the hotel residence? I said no and walked out and asked the lady owner if I have to be the hotel guest in order to use their bathroom? Then this time the lady owner walked me to the hotel and spoke to them to allow me to use the restroom. I noticed a sign board in the restaurant saying no bikini and alcohol as I was in holiday mood somehow I brought a beer and drink it outside the restaurant. The place is a bit small and the setting in the restaurant might make you feel like eating in a fast food restaurant along pantai cenang road,as the restaurant probably don't allow bikini wearing customer, so sit outside you might see some some blonde girl walk around with bikini swim suite anyway, enjoyed the food as you could see the french chef is cooking it passionately! may be consider take away and wonder if they do outdoor delivery? Will come back again for the crepes!Show less

Author: Patricia T
Title: Great food in a small place
Review:
The crepes and the waffles are absurdly good!
Everything is made with fresh ingredients and it's just amazing. 
The portions are good sized and the price is reasonable. A bit more expensive then the local food. But definitely worth the visit.

Author: Chinthi K
Title: Small place but great crepes
Review: We were looking for a place to have something different from Malay, Chinese food and soooooo glad to spot this small Resturant. The crepes we had for dinner was awesome! And the banana Nutella with vanilla ice cream and kids dessert was even more better. Loved it! Show less

Author: wdavid81Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Food and Service
Review: Ordered 3 crepes and all 3 were really good. Notably, the crepe with the combination of Nutella, banana, vanilla ice cream and fresh coconut shavings was out of this world outstanding. C19 on the menu. Very, very highly recommended. And the staff were really kind and patient. Also privileged to speak to the owner and she is so friendly and enthusiastic and informative. Don't know where she gets the energy since we were there after closing hours. She may be a sugar addict :)Show less

Author: Mona M
Title: Gluten free and wow
Review:
It's a pity they don't ooen for breakfast !!
The gluten free savory crepes are filling enough so one can have a Waffle/crepe desert 
The owners are extremly friendly ...service is quick 
Don't forget to have a pink lemonade

Author: 587maleks
Title: The real french taste
Review:
You have to visit them and you will never be disappointed 
We ordered waffles crepes juses 
Our kids liked this place a lot 
Thank you soumaya

Author: Hatem R
Title: Tiny restaurant, excellent crepe & waffels
Review: This tiny crepe & waffels restaurant only has two tables on the side walk! One can easily overlook it. The place may not look special but they serve really good food. They can do with a larger place with nicer atmosphere.

Author: bruceangelahWest Lakes, Australia
Title: All I Can Say is "Yum"
Review: Gee this was good. Very friendly service. Only small but they can make their crepes quickly so the tables would turn over in no time. Food was terrific and it was nice to hear genuine French accents on Bastille Day. Have dinner then go here for dessert. We will again...Show less

Author: SaRa DStockholm, Sweden
Title: The best crêpes ever!
Review: We found this French pearl here in Trip Advisor so we called to make a reservation and got the answer that they don't make reservations. When we got there (by taxi) we understood why: this fantastic Crêperie is basically a hole in the wall with one table inside and two outside on the bumpy boardwalk. We ordered both "dinner crêpes" and dessert waffles and OH MY GAAAWD they were by far the best I have ever had! I have lived in Paris and love crêpes but I would never have guessed that I would find Crêpes-Heaven on Langkawi island. Well, the charming young couple running this place are French so they know their "art" but this culinary journey just blew our minds. The only negative thing to mention is the smell from the wastewater system running under the boardwalk where you sit outside. But if you have been to Langkawi before you know that smell is quite familiar in some busy parts. Show less

Author: yuxiangy2016Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Small place, great taste!
Review: My first visit was actually a let down, the shop was closed for a few days for the Hari Raya holiday. Passed thru again today and saw the tables set up outside and full of people, so we cancelled our plan to eat elsewhere and immediately looked for a parking spot.We ordered 2 salty crepes and a waffle. The crepe skin was thin and delicious. And it's gluten free! Filled with mushrooms, cheese, potatoes, and an egg. It was very very good. Then came the waffle with homemade salted caramel. We loved it!The place was small, but the host was very friendly and she really took care of their customers. I'm glad we changed our plan. Show less

Author: slwh23PJ
Title: Delicious crepes
Review: We happened to drop in on our last day of our stay. Read the reviews on trip advisor . It was very tasty, food served fast and owners very friendly.

Author: follow_ussg
Title: Not bad, great dessert in Langkawi, take noted it open at 1pm
Review:
It's just about 30min drive from Kuah, it's good to drop by if you visiting the Cenang Beach, the chef and the service staff are very friendly.
We had the Blue Cheese and the chocolate crepe, both are good.

Author: alerrandrocc
Title: Yummy crepes
Review: We had great experience here. Both crepes and the service were good. The only problem is they don't accept credit cards, although almost no place in the island accept it.

Author: Marilyn H
Title: Delicious crepe
Review: The place is small but if you manage to get a seat, the crepe are so thin and yummy! If you have a soft spot or sweet tooth. Go try it

Author: Jehanzeb KIslamabad, Pakistan
Title: Crepe Heaven!
Review: We tried their crepe and waffle. Both were delicious! The next day, we were in a happy food coma and decided to re-visit French Factory. Their crepes were comparable to what we had in Paris, but much cheaper! Their fast & friendly service and great food can not be beat. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: melleessanneKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: SuperDelicious Crepes
Review: This is one cafe you should visit in Langkawi...because everything here is super....from the service to the food and drinks..A tiny piece of France in Langkawi ...The owners are French hence the name of the cafe and the crepes...Same taste in France too ..so better just have one here...:-)The price is reasonable and the decor is simple but the best is their pr and their salted butter caramel sauce on those crepes...Show less

Author: safarin sKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic French Crepe in Malaysia
Review: We visited at 12 noon. Yup a crepe lunch. Very light. While enjoying the crepe we approach by the owner who makes Malaysia second home far away from Paris. Owner were very friendly and open to know how her crepe taste. Had mine Crepe for rm19 -a thin and soft crepe top with ice cream,bananas & Nutella. Pepsi for rm3. My wife had a waffle top with ice cream and nuttella.It was very good, last time I had best crepe was at Melbourne street food stall.Totally recommended.Show less

Author: MsAlies
Title: Purely fresh
Review:
Had the Nutella banana crepe with coconut flakes. Awesome. Super delicious! 

And yes. Super nice owner. The french lady came and greet each customer. 

Highly recommended. 👍👍👍

Author: EagletonyDoha, Qatar
Title: No surprises it's number 1
Review: We visited the restaurant in our last night in Langkawi.. They were about to close, but when they knew it's our last night, they made an exception for us and took the order :)I think it's one of the best deserts I've eaten in my life..We went there to find a young man and woman wearing the PSG jersey and were very friendly :)Should be in your top 10 things to do in Langkawi :)Show less

Author: Radwa MCairo, Egypt
Title: delicious crepe
Review: my friend and i tried the one with chocolate and nuts it was very delicious and sweet the place is cozy and clean with a good place in langkawi what i really liked and made me wrote this review is that the owners actually are very nice they are French i think, we had a sun burn from earlier in that day and when the lady saw us she offered us some aleo vera that she grew and it was very soothing and relieving she saved us from some serious pain :D! i wanted to come back and thank her but we were leaving in the morning so i couldn't overall it was a very nice crepe with very nice people and yes a must try when in langkawi. Show less

Author: JacqieMalaysia
Title: Excellent dessert!
Review: Both the waffles and crepes are simply amazing! Great taste! This is not to be missed when you are in Cenang!

Author: hoechmalaysia
Title: Incredible Crepes
Review: We were searching for a place for dinner and had stopped outside this place that serves crepe which is usually for desserts until..... I saw Savoury Crepe... I decided on the mushrooms, cheese and sour cream crepe and was wondering if that would suffice as dinner..... It was filling! and I savour every bite of it. Soumia was checking to ensure our food was ok , which was just simply delicious. When I found my ice latte to be lacking in coffee, she gladly added another shot of coffee and brought some sugar syrup to sweeten up the latte. While we were presented with the bill, she advised that latte was not on the menu and hence was complimentary! Having read other reviews, I am going back for the sweet crepes!! My French Factory is indeed a dessert place, NOT to be missed!! Show less

Author: Lee M
Title: Awesome
Review: Cheap crepe and very delicious! It isn't very expensive cost around 5sgd per crepe. Please eat this in langkawi!

Author: JessPepp
Title: Delicious Crepes!
Review: My French Factory was a favourite for my husband and I during our stay in Langkawi. The crepes are exactly like the ones you find in Paris. Owners are lovely and their homemade salted caramel is one of the best!

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: THE BEST homemade salted butter caramel sauce in Langkawi!
Review: My favourite dessert place in Langkawi! The crepes here are superb, and the sauces are delicious. So delicious, in fact, that my friend couldn't bear to leave the melted puddle of ice-cream and sauce on her plate, and slurped it all up with a straw! My favourites here are the {mushroom, sour cream, cheese + extra onions} galette (or as they call them, salty pancakes) and the salted butter caramel crepe with a scoop (or two) of coconut ice-cream. Sometimes, with extra caramel. Divine! And the {caramel, nutella, ice-cream & strawberries} combo is positively sinful, but so good you really don't care!Also, above and beyond the crepes and galettes, the awesome service we receive from Soumia & Vincent (and their staff!) is always par excellence, no matter how busy their creperie is, or the time of the day. We once made a stop at MY French Factory for a last hurrah before getting on our evening flights, only to find out the caramel sauce had been sold out for the day. Instead of disappointing us, Soumia asked if we could wait 15 minutes, made more caramel sauce on the spot, and made VERY happy customers of all of us. THAT's what I call service, and business owners who really care about their customers! I'm a fan for life. :)As mentioned by a few reviewers, the creperie is indeed small. However, I'd recommend that you visit just as they open at noon, or between 3pm-6pm, when the crowds aren't at their peak, to avoid the seating issues. Also, if you happen to be driving, I recommend that you park at the Cenang Mall next door, or at the Baron Hotel's parking lot. Also as mentioned by a few others, the place isn't exactly somewhere you go for cheap eats. Depending on your "base" and add-ons, it can come up to about RM25 for crepe + a drink, but I've always felt the price was more than justified, in terms of food quality and absolute satisfaction. :DShow less

Author: robbertl367
Title: Very good!
Review:
Quite inconspicuous little place, but the food (not being too familiar with crepes) was very good! I've never had a non-dessert crepe before, but it was a meal well worth coming for.
The owners are very friendly as well, definitely go there!

Author: JiaXiang C
Title: Awsome!!! the Best crepe in malaysia!!
Review:
this is the best crepe i try in malaysia!!
chef is is very friendly..
environment is very nice..
food is very tasty and fresh!!
u will never regret to eat and enjoy this at cenang beach langkawi!!

Author: Shirrrbyyy
Title: Excellent Crepe in a Malaysian Island!
Review: The crepe was excellent and prices were super reasonable. Unimaginable to have crepe at these prices in Singapore. Went for the savoury crepe and one sweet crepe. Absolutely delicious. Also, the owners are both from France, so the crepes are authentic!!

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Tender crepe
Review: Be frankly, seating capacity of my french factory was quite low. I think they could only comfortably accommodate around 12-14 persons, or 20 person with some messes. Their bosses were very friendly and asked for our opinions for their crepes. Be frankly, RM20 for a dark chocolate crepe is quite expensive even in a tourist attraction. Since I am not a crepe-lover, I didn't see much value from their offering.It is worth noting that their crepe was much tender than those Malaysian would usually have, priced at around RM 4-8. It is a nice experience for first-time eater, but i won't visit there second time.Show less

Author: Chonlada J
Title: Splendid crepe!
Review:
Very delicious crepe both sweet and meet-cheesy crepe, staff are friendly and helpful, good location nearby cennai mall 
Highly reccommend to go there !!!

Author: 617PaulL617
Title: Nice crepes
Review: Quite a small little place, however a really friendly French couple serving and nice deserts for after a meal. Would recommend.

Author: LNB1968
Title: Too good to miss
Review: Everyone has already said it all! This is really a must do when in Langkawi. Food is fantastic, service is outstanding and prices are a bargain. Going back again tonight 😄

Author: nomadsk
Title: Deliciously Yummy!!!
Review: An absolutely awesomely delicious place for fresh crepes..A regular place for us n will be visiting soon again...Thankyou so much for serving these French experience in Langkawi..A must visit..

Author: ptan36
Title: Yum!
Review: The perfect snack for in between meals or even for a late lunch. The crepes were a lovely texture and the waitress and cook were really pleasant as well. Great place to relax and chat and eat.

Author: PriyankaBkkBangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice Crepes
Review: we went there after reading reviews on tripadvisor, and ordered Caramel and Almond Crepe and it was nice, its next to cenang mall and east to locate. we went again on our last day to try other crepes but unfortunately it was closed, may be next time again if we visit Langkawi :)Show less

Author: irene chan ai l... cIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Exceptional crepes
Review: I insisted on trying out this creperie when I read about it on TripAdvisor. And it was such a rewarding eating experience. It was my husband's first crepe experience and he was impressed. Now he asks me where to find crepes in the city where we live. I tell him we probably can find one or two, but will definitely not match those made at My French Factory, Langkawi.We started off with a savoury crepe each. And then shared a sweet one for dessert. Both were really exceptional but the sweet one has really gotten me hooked. They've got a well-prepared menu, so well-prepared that it was difficult to make a decision. Everything looked so delicious and I felt like having everything on the menu!Tres bien!Show less

Author: smles5
Title: Great Crepes and Waffles
Review: Very friendly service. We had both savoury and sweet crepes and both were delicious. The pink lemonade is lovely and refreshing on a hot day.

Author: SydneyGazzaRozelle, Australia
Title: Yes,it's good,but #1?
Review: Sure the crepes were good and the staff friendly so easy to understand that this is a popular cafe and deserves a good reputation. Hard to fault for what it is,although my coffee was not fantastic. But it is a coffee /crepes shop and can't be put in the same category as many other restaurants who prepare complicated ingredients and serve cutting edge food. Good for what it is but not #1 in cenang. Show less

Author: Azamjufri A
Title: Yummy!
Review: Saw this cafe while browsing Trip Advisors. Walking distance to our hotel so decided to go for lunch. Warm greetings by the owner and get to practice my French! Didn't do too bad as she understood what I said. Ordered crepe with eggs and potato, honey waffle, pineapple juice and banana milkshake. Yummy and tasty. All for RM50. Looking forward to go again. Show less

Author: tabzh
Title: Delicious desserts
Review:
Went along here after dinner 
Small dessert parlour next to cenang mall
 busy street with little parking
Desserts were delicious 
Staff were very friendly. French couple run the joint 
Best dessert we had on the island!!

Author: Jennen N
Title: Yummy and really friendly owner. A good business to support in Langkawi
Review: We came here because it was the number 1 food place to visit in Langkawi. We'd like to confirm that they provide great food and exceptional service. Thank you!

Author: sondose
Title: A must visit in Langkawi
Review: A Small restaurant in Langkawi, offers French crepes  and waffles with great taste. . Friendly staff. It is a must visit .

Author: PoojaSachdev
Title: delicous
Review: i had a nutella with almonds crepe...and it was fabulous!!...unfortunately it was the only one time that i visited them...left me wanting more!!...the owner is so sweet and friendly!!!must visit

Author: nikmat07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointingly average ...after all the hype
Review: #1 in Langkawi?? Seriously? It's a fast food crepe n pancake joint that's usually closed. Several fillings are straight out of the Nutella jar or toblerone packet. Every suburban mall has a pretend-creperie place like this tucked away at the back of the food court. It's just NORMAL everyone... You will be disappointed if you are expecting something exceptional Show less

Author: PitbullzLeicestershire, United Kingdom
Title: Bon Apetit!
Review: My French Factory is definitely worth a visit! They sell crepes and waffles, we tried one of each and both were tasty! We also tried a milkshake which was yummy and a very nice pink lemonade drink. They also sell savoury breakfast crepes. There is a variety of crepes and waffles available so there is sure to be something for everyone. The desserts and drinks here were delicious and the staff are very friendly and welcoming and it's worth a visit as its interesting trying genuine French desserts on a small Malaysian island! The items on the menu are a little pricey compared to other dessert shops but the taste makes it worthwhile.Show less

Author: mfar11Malaysia
Title: Fabulous crêpes, friendly owner!
Review: With a few hours to spare before our flight out of Langkawi, we decided to drop-by 'MY French Factory', a cafe owned and run by a French couple (Vincent and Soumia), along the main Pantai Chenang strip for lunch. The cafe is in a row of shops next door to Chenang Mall and has a massive French Tricolour over the entrance - can't miss that! It's a small cafe so seating is limited but we were lucky that there was a table outside for the six of us at the time. The menu offer crêpes as their speciality and you can have either savoury or sweet from their long list. We ordered various combinations of smoked beef, blue cheese, egg, bananas, coconut, nutella and ice-cream. Each and every crêpe was delicious and we would have probably ordered more if not for the limited time that we had. We enjoyed some great milkshakes and juices too.As mentioned in other reviews, the owners make time for their customers with a genuine welcome and Soumia, the young and sweet half of this enterprising couple, spent time chatting with us about their passion for food and travels in Asia. She even graciously shared with us her very French beauty tips for the ladies! If you should happen to read this Vincent and Soumia, merci for a wonderful meal and for the rest of your culinary adventure in Malaysia - bon courage!Show less

Author: Muhammad Faizal K
Title: Excellent Crepes!
Review: Excellent Crepes not in Paris but in Langkawi. A small little shop with a nice variety of crepes.. should try if u are in Pantai Cenang!!

Author: billiefunkyjeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love this place!
Review: This place is on the main road of Cenang located near Cenang mall. The crepes are really tasty! The milkshakes were amazing. There's a French couple running the place. They were so so nice and friendly. You can customize your order with them. I'd recommend everyone give it a try if you're there.Show less

Author: SweeticanHong Kong, China
Title: Great start of my trip in Langkawi
Review: It was our first meal in Langkawi, we didn't do any research before, just walk around and it looks attractive, thats why we try out. It was one of the best crepe I've ever tried before, the owner and staffs are friendly and we talked a bit during the meal. When she heard that it was the first day we arrive Langkawi, she introduced some other good restaurants to us as well :) I've ordered one with cheese and egg, my husband ordered one with Nutella, banana and peanut. Both are amazing. I'd suggest them to add some "create your own" menus so that we can choose the ingredient ourselves :)Show less

Author: abdalafo
Title: Great !
Review: Very nice place and great taste , also friendly staff ... We love the taste ; the greeting and the lovely smile on owner faces , everyone who visit Langkawi must visit it

Author: theinscrutablewSingapore, Singapore
Title: One Amazing Experience
Review: This was the highlight of our Langkawi trip. The best food that we had in Langkawi was suprisinlgy simple crepes and waffles with salted caramel and vanilla ice creams, would have never imagined that. The owners are really friendly and sweet. And their menu is exhaustive, with all kind of sweet and savoury crepes and waffles. If I ever come back to Langkawi I will be back here to try more of their creations.Show less

Author: F274TSmelissacMcCrae, Australia
Title: Ok
Review: This place is ok for dessert seeing as it's hard to find good dessert in Langkawi. I'm usually spoilt for choice back home so that's why this is average for me. Staff is friendly but shop is very cramped, not enough seating area. They need a bigger shop.Show less

Author: Phill2810Singapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic, reasonably priced comfort food
Review: Crepes are one of those foods that even if you didn't grow up in France (I'm English) still resonates as comfort food - simple filling not always good for you but very enjoyable - a real treat to find a proper crepe place here in Langkawi where a lot of restaurants along Pantai Cenang are serving up poor imitations of food or the worst that the US has to offer. The French team running the place are lovely - small place so patience required for your order, but it will be worth it - we devoured 2 savoury and 3 sweet crepes, washed down with homemade pink lemonade - if we were here for longer, we would be going again!!Show less

Author: vn212New York City, New York
Title: Great Crepes, friendly owners
Review: This place is run by a Parisian couple that moved here some years ago to make folks in Langkawi some delicious crepes. You can order some great coffee here too to round up a great breakfast. The location is easy to reach right at the Cenang beach road.Show less

Author: Maeyertravels
Title: Delicious crepes
Review: The place to go for a light lunch or dessert. Authentic French crepes run by French owners. Try one of their homemade shakes too. So satisfied that we went back again!

Author: katerinalouiseEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious crepes
Review: We visited My French factory with high expectations given the great reviews. More of a cafe than a restaurant with just 12 seats outside. there was lots of choice on the menu and my friend and I shared one savoury and 1 sweet crepe. Absolutely delicious and wish we had ordered more! The owners were very friendly too. Overall a good experience at a great price. Show less

Author: LenandJayneKent UK
Title: scrumptious!
Review: We went to My French factory twice during our 5 day visit to Langkawi. Really lovely presented food and great friendly service. Crepes and pancakes are savoury and sweet and it makes a great lunch or stop off for a desert.....a very satisfying desert!The business belongs and is run by a young French couple who took the brave step of setting up a business in a different country.
