They are experts and talented at what they do and are sure to make it a continuing success.Hope to be back in a couple of years!Show less

Author: Alaa A
Title: It's nice but ordinary
Review: The taste is good , the owner very nice the menu has a lot of options but it's just nice , I don't know why it's no.1

Author: jiaaqi
Title: Deserve to be #1 at Trip Advisor
Review:
Friendly owners from France, amazing sweet and savoury crepe - one is simply not enough. Will definitely be back if I'm at Langkawi :) A must-try!

Sweet crepes are more towards the soft side, while the savoury is more towards the crispy side.

Author: miguelsW1145WP
Title: Don't go alone
Review: If you ever decided to treat yourself with a crepe at My French Factory go with someone that is wiling to share his/her crepe :-)

Author: Juunass
Title: Excellent crepes!
Review:
No wonder this is number 1 restaurant in Langkawi acording to Tripadvisor! 
Staff was so polite and nice. Service was fast and crepes were heavenly! 
This place really made me happy :)

Author: adzlishaSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Crepe at its best!
Review: We went on Friday unfortunately it was closed. The shop is closed every Friday. We came back and boy I was so glad that we did! I ordered the Crepe, it comes with one scoop of ice cream and coconut.The rest of the family ordered the waffles. All were really good! The shop opens everyday from 1PM to 11PM (except for Friday) and when we arrived it was already full, it was only 5 minutes after 1PM. The lady owner approached my kids and asked them about the food, being friendly all.Definately will revisit once we're in Langkawi.Show less

Author: TravelGuru7080
Title: Best Waffles and Crepes EVER!
Review: Brilliant customer service, had a small emergency unrelated to the restaurant and the staff went out of their way to help us. Great juices, Waffles and Crepes! Absolutely Brilliant!

Author: smitlakKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: yummy authentic crepes!
Review: We stopped for crepes here 2 days in a row as it had to be thebest dessert on the island. It is run by the owners themselves who are genuine, friendly and sweet.Both the sweet and savoury crepes are yum, for health nuts, choose the buckwheat flour.If you have space, dont' miss the crispy fluffy waffles.Show less

Author: simmo_smp
Title: Delicious sweet crepes!
Review: I had the homemade salted caramel crepes w/ icecream, and they were simply amazing. Absolutely delicious treat for morning tea. My partner had the Nutella and banana ones which she highly rated as well. Will definitely be back before we leave, delicious!!

Author: Duxyx
Title: Excellent
Review:
nice staff, great pancakes and Excellent coffee. if you are going to Langkawi definitely be sure to come see it.
I recommend 100%.

Author: beatricel330
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Food was great but what makes the restaurant amazing is their friendly service. Environment can be better, a bit warm.

Author: charlottel537Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent and high quality crepes/waffles
Review: We had a crepe each and as these were SO SO good we couldnt resist sharing a nutella waffle after that even if we were full, that was so delicious too. We're definitely very fussy with food and we do expect quality products when eating out and we were highly satisfied at MY French Factory. At £3 for a large savoury buckwheat crepe the price is definitely reasonable, Id rather pay this and get quality and fresh food than pay less and have less quality food. Service excellent too and the owners seemed to love what they do and genuinely care about us enjoying the food.Show less

Author: Georgina CYangon (Rangoon), Myanmar
Title: Amazing crepes, wonderful staff
Review: The crepes are delicious, the couple who own this place totally made our holiday - so friendly and welcoming. We went back 4 times in 1 week! Everything is homemade and you can tell. Would definitely go here again if we ever venture back to the wonderful island of Langkawi,Show less

Author: Raffi M
Title: Good food
Review: Visited twice and Great food . Friendly staff and moreover it's just as home,get what you want .will come back again soon.

Author: Hendrik61
Title: Very nice waffle with awesome caramel
Review: One of the best waffle with superb homemade caramel. Not too sweet. If only it has more sitting space. Will be back again soon.

Author: erion980Tirana, Albania
Title: Very good crepes
Review: Very good and quality food. The crepes were very big, at least for breakfast. The staff is also very nice and smiley. Is not the cheapest solution, but you pay what you get. Langkawi is very far from France, but the crepes are the same like in Paris.Keep up the good work!Show less

Author: victor-HUBudapest, Hungary
Title: Great place but could be greater
Review: Been twice during a one week stay. Quality food, great service. I love crêpes, esp. if it's authentic. However as a European traveler i'd expect a much wider selection of fillings. I understand this is just as exotic in Malaysia as something called Ikan Bakar would be in Paris, but we are used to a whole lot more options to choose from. In the light of the limited selection i feel it a bit overpriced. Otherwise recommended.Show less

Author: ryanspce
Title: Great Food!
Review: I loved this restaurant. It has excellent service and wonderful food. I had a Nutella crepe which I thought was magnificent. I would recommend this to everybody.

Author: Rizby_2009Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Creperie
Review: A cozy nook located next to Cenang Mall. Lovely, charming owners from France. I tried the nutella waffle and it was spectacular! The only minus point was the limited seating beacause of its small space. Maya et Vincent, hope you will one day get a larger space as that would be awesome! I missed you on the beach that New Year's eve. J'adore My French Factory!Show less

Author: glutenfree4lifeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing crepes, great friendly service & GLUTENFREE
Review: We went to this place when we came to Cenang beach for some water sports. The reason for coming here was because it showed as the number 1 restaurant in Langkawi on tripadvisor and it over met my expectations. We have a glutenfree kid with us and it's quite hard to find yummy treats which are listed as glutenfree on the menu. The best part was that I didn't realize that they would have glutenfree crepes because it wasn't mentioned in any of the reviews. I thought we'll just have to ask the chef or look for something that my kid can eat. And I was so pleasantly surprised to see buckwheat crepes (glutenfree) on the menu. We had the Nutella one with strawberry and banana as well as the savory ones with ham and cheese and mushroom and cheese. The whole family enjoyed the buckwheat crepes. They were so delicious; we also ordered again. I wish there were many such places in other cities as well. As other reviewers have mentioned, the owners are super friendly; take interest in their customers and the service was fast too. We ate around 8pm and at that time we found a table inside. Yes, the place is small but the quality is great. Seems like the owners love what they do and it shows in the product.The owner told us that the buckwheat is organic and comes from Australia. Show less

Author: pohling_foo
Title: Good crepe
Review: I ordered Nutella crepe. The crepe was really nice. However, it is overpriced. One slice of crepe with Nutella cost rm14. The place is pretty small. Quite difficult to get a seat.

Author: mlkalkMarseille, France
Title: The best french crepes !!!
Review: One of the best crepes I've tried in my life ! And the price is definitely worth it ! The owners are lovely and you can only spend a good time there ! I highly recommend this place for a meal or for a good dessert !Show less

Author: Nicola W
Title: The best crepes and waffles!
Review: We visited My French Factory 5+ times in January for crepes and waffles!The service is great and food even better!Perfect for a treat after an evening meal! You can dine inside or outside.They also offer great drinks including homemade pink lemonade and Oreo milkshakes!Don't miss this place! Author: Fatin Izyani Z

Author: Elif Ç

Author: Grazza2981

Had a hot white coffee that was superb, and a salted butter caramel waffle + ice cream. Just finished it and already looking forward to what I'm going to have next! Show less

Author: 745sergeeEurope

We returned twice to enjoy wonderful french crepes, whether sweet or salted - we highly recommend them. The crepes are extremely nice and taste like the ones we have in France! Did i mention how welcoming and friendly the owners are - it is really worth going there, despite the little seating availability - it is worth queuing or taking away, as an alternative. My wife and Son were over the moon to enjoy such nice crepes, THANK YOU! And best of luck for the future, you deserve it!Show less

Author: Steve HJersey, United Kingdom
Title: Good crepe
Review: Just had a plain crepe with sugar for our six year old who is struggling with spicy food a bit during our travels! Very good crepe and friendly service. It's a titchy place with just one table inside and a handful of tables on the pavement.Show less

Author: shamopi
Title: Authentic French Crepe
Review: The place is conveniently located opposite to Plaza Cenang where all the hustle and bustle is at.Do note that the place closes on Fridays only.I've had the salted caramel crepe and I got to know from the owner that it is homemade. It was unsurprising as the sauce had a perfect balance between sweet and saltiness. The taste complements each other so well that you just can't stop digging in to get another piece of it.Pricing:The crepe and waffles are definitely not cheap. It will cost upwards RM10++. But hey, having crepe made by real French is not an everyday sight. Especially in Malaysia.My take is that this place is a MUST visit for anyone craving to have their sweet tooth fix during their stay in Langkawi. Show less

Author: teaswizzler
Title: Best spot for desert.
Review: Tasty crepes served by a delightful hostess. Most enjoyable desert in this tiny restaurant. Just as well its not near home as I'd be tempted far too often.

Author: 889pantear

Review:
very friendly couple are owning this place, n all food and drinks are simply amazing.

Author: Markus D

Author: Rayan1f

Author: ViperalKuala Lumpur

Author: shanaza2013

Author: Zeyen L

Author: Jingru O
Title: Great for a quick snack/dessert!
Review: After reading all the good reviews, we had to try this before we leave langkawi. Shop is conveniently located beside Cenang Mall and is in a very casual setting where you can see them make the crepes.I ordered the banana nutella crepe with coconut ice cream.. Combination was perfect! The friendly shop owners (a French couple) also made us feel very welcomed :) Definitely recommended place to go!Show less

Author: petercF743ZF
Title: Creative Crêpe Creations!
Review: My girlfriend and I were on a holiday in Langkawi from 5th-8th October 2015 and we couldn't stay away from French Factory to satisfy our dessert cravings two days in a row! Soumia and Vincent's dream was to venture out of France/ Europe and set up something unique, special in Asia ... God bless them for choosing Langkawi. They're extremely friendly and man the shop themselves, only with a helper. Over the counter, have a chat with Soumia about their range of extra virgin coconut oil (sold in small bottles), said to come with many health uses, both for consumption and external application. FF is located on Lagguna Walk, Pantai Cenang Road, next to a pizza shop at the corner, where the Cenang Mall is located on the left. You can hear the band coming from the bar in front of the mall at night. The establishment is small and seating is limited, but it's really with the wait. We were there during an off peak season. We only tried the Nutella + fresh strawberries + almonds + vanilla ice cream on a perfectly done Crêpe. Costs RM28 but there's no question about the price for premium quality. Sweet, contrasted by tangy, sour and burnt almonds plays on texture and aroma. To wash down our dessert, we ordered a PINK lemonade (RM10 for regular and RM18 to supersize it), first for us. Coffee is brewed from Illy's beans, so they can't wrong, but I preferred a cold beverage on a humid day. There's a list of savory crêpes too if you prefer to keep away from sugar but let me tell you that calories would be the last thing on your mind when enjoying FF's crêpe creations. French Factory opens daily from 1pm to 11pm. No service charge and no GST. Show less

Author: 601Jt

Review: Delicious! Located just a stroll from pelangi beach. Friendly staff and delicious food, recommended visit after dinner for dessert.

Author: Wally SGalle, Sri Lanka
Title: Paris Flavours in Malaysia
Review: Everything you love about French crepes is right here: simple, stunning blends of flavours that hit your palate whilst they melt in your mouth. Savoury crepes make a great main meal; with my personal favourite having beef and of course blue cheese folded together into the topping. My partner had the egg version, true to it's historic roots. We couldn't leave without the traditional lemon and sugar and I of course had to have the home made salty caramel version to complete a superb lunch. Prices: savoury less than RM20 and sweets between RM8 and 20, depending on the topping or icecream selected.Show less

Title: What a gem!
Review: Delectable buckwheat pancakes both savoury and sweet. The salted caramel pancake is a must as is the homemade lemonade. I had 3 glasses. Bon chance!Show less

Author: lefortpat
Title: Waffles at its best!!!!
Review: I would go back again and again to Langkawi just to have their salted caramel waffles. A must try! Friendly staff, good location on the Cenang beach. Can't ask for a better combination.

Author: Wmunes
Title: Fabulous pancakes

Author: MohamadR833
Title: Awesome food!!!

Author: MumuiK
Title: Delicious ever

Author: liliantSingapore, Singapore

Show less

Review:

Author: 222jamila

Author: Mui Lan YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dessert after dinner.
Review: We came here for dessert. The owner is french. Limited sit, most of the time you need to share table with others.Show less

Author: gemstar1974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A must go for tea or even lunch!
Review: We read the reviews and decided to give it a try during tea time. Our google maps couldn't get us there and so we had to call the cafe for directions. For those of you eager to try out this place, please note that it is actually located next to the Cenang Mall and it is run by a very friendly Parisian couple. My kids weren't exactly keen on having any of the crepes as they just had a pretty heavy lunch. So we ordered two crepes - one with banana, nutella and coconut ice-cream and another one with salted butter caramel. Guess who polished them off instead? My kids who initially didn't want to eat any of the stuff ended up devouring all of them and fighting among themselves for the last piece. They were simply delicious and perhaps one of the best crepes I have ever tasted in Malaysia. Anyone who comes to Langkawi should really give this a try. The crepes are worth every penny, dime and sen!Show less

Author: BranleubiteKL
Title: True taste of Bretagne, France
Review: It is a small restaurant/cafe located beside Cenang Mall. It is own by a lovely couple, very friendly. They are doing their upmost in quality, by using traditional tools, technics and ingredients in order to serve you the tastiest Crepes and Galettes you can get. And I can assure you that their food tastes as good as what you'd get in a "Creperie" in Brittany (Bretagne) France. Furthermore, while seating/waiting to eat, you can appreciate the whole Crepes/Galettes making process right in front of your eyes. Splendid. You want to try something original/different in Cenang, then try this. Show less

Author: Hummyp
Title: When in langkawi..go to this place!
Review:
After seeing all the raging reviews about this place we had to see for ourselves what the fuss was about.

Author: fikriatif99Shah Alam, Malaysia

Author: Fourth S

Author: semau88
Title: awesome experience
Review: very delicious homemade crepes and waffles, I loved the team smile and hospitality. you feel like you taste it in France.

Author: MinshariffKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious crepe and waffle and awesome hospitality
Review: The cafe was highly recommended by my son who was in Langkawi earlier this year. No regrets. The husband and wife team Chef Soumia and Chef Vincent were not only hospitable but very friendly and accommodating too. We were in Langkawi for 3 days. We went to the cafe everyday. On the first night, Chef Soumia gifted us with a fruit tart to take back to our hotel. For me the fillings and the crust is very important. The tart was not too sweet and the crust was crisp but not too crumbly. Just the way I love it. I got free coffee too when Chef Vincent overlooked my crepe order. For vegans/vegetarians the savory crepe is made from Gluten free organic flour and eggless, served with mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, onions and homemade tomato sauce. My husband fell in love with their waffles at first bite. He had that everyday and refused to try any other things on the menu. On our 2nd visit, it was my birthday. We went there for desserts after dinner. Chef Soumia made me a special crepe which was not on the menu but contained all my favorite things. There were strawberries,Nutella,toasted almond and the to die for coconut ice-cream. On our last day, we went there for lunch. I had the vegan crepe. We ordered the Mini Tiramisu for dessert but Chef Soumia didn't charged us for it. She said it was gift. The Tiramisu is a must try too. I highly recommend this cafe if you are ever in Langkawi. The food is good and the hospitality was AWESOME!Show less

Author: Ler8804Nashville, Tennessee
Title: Delicious, friendly
Review: I stopped by this little shop on the way back from the beach one day and was so surprised. There were three people in the shop, two from Paris and one from Nice. They were friendly, helpful and the crepes were just like I remember from France. Definitely worth a stop if you're around Pentai Cenang area.Show less

Author: live2travel89

Review: This small french factory of desserts is worth a stop. It's got a lot of tasty pastries, crepes , nutella shakes. This is definitely a must visit cafe when you are in Cenang. Right next door you have a great pizzeria too !

Author: wanderlustipsMumbai, India

Had honey and lemon crepe followed by honey and banana....cant forget the taste ...carried with us salted chicken shredded crepes...had with red wine at the hotel...best dinner of the trip ...Show less

J'ai bien aime et j ai passe un super moment aussi. Merci les 2 chefs!Show less

Author: QuarantineKL2K21

Author: Nastenka170986
Title: The way to a woman's heart is through her belly and a Syrian cook!
Review: Food was bloody amazing. Came here when it was raining heavily and thought it was closed. We were sad but waited for a bit then these two men came out of their car like goddes of food or something. We ordered the mix grill and bbq prawns... it was the most amazing food we've had on our trip so far. The waiter was pretty cute as well. Even the garlic sauce was delicious, the chicken was so tender and the prawns was so flavourful.Show less

Author: Marissa2693
Title: Our favourite restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Lovely people, excellent food and overall great experience! Can’t wait to go back when we visit Langkawi again.

Author: TAMardaniahmBali, Indonesia
Title: Fried Chicken masquerading as Chicken Tikka
Review: Shocked to have been served fried chicken the arrogant Pakistani owner claimed it was a chicken tikka?!?!?While it was edible and came with chips.. he made the insistent excuse that it is what we ordered.. seems the customer is not right!The price was too high, in hindsight we should have gone to the KFC in the mall as the portion would have been much larger with the service being much betterHe has lost our business and we won't go back there again.I don't recommend anyone else should try Arang... regardless the place is situated on the beachShow less

Author: Zzzz3456
Title: Delicious food
Review: Best bbq burger I've had. The owners are lovely and we had a lovely chat - perfect start to the holiday. Try the brownies and ice cream!

Author: chuckyJellieGold Coast, Australia
Title: One to try
Review: Had dinner here 3 times. Nice people, plenty of seating inside and out.Limited menu when we went although signage board suggested more.Burger was delicious first time but second visit it had added herbs to the meat and was overpowering.Beers could be colder.Worth trying again.Show less

Author: danielleee90
Title: We ate here once, the tzaiki
Review: We ate here once, the tzaiki was lovely however my partner ordered the burger and it was more like a kebab meat rather then beef. I would go back but not if I fancied a burger.

Author: F9726JEsarahe
Title: Delicious food and good music.
Review: Delicious food and good music. I had the grilled fish and it was amazing. Lovely authentic Syrian / Mediterranean food. Delish.  Wholeheartedly recommend.

Author: koljao131Vienna, Austria
Title: Authentic food & great vibes
Review: On my two week stay in Langkawi I visited Arang BBQ 9 times. The reason I keep going back is simple. The owners care and put heart into it. The cuisine is Western and Middle Eastern. The quality of ingredients is very high, and the chef puts a lot of heart into the food. I can highly recommend their BBQ platters, and their brownies & ice cream dessert!Show less

Author: JintyEdwards
Title: Ok but I was expecting a bit more
Review: We visited because of the high rankings on TripAdvisor. There’s nothing wrong with it; we had a perfectly decent burger and lamb kebab but I was somehow expecting a bit more. It was quiet and we were done within the hour, didn’t quite live up to expectations.Show less

Author: Jonathan HTralee, Ireland
Title: Undercooked chicken
Review: We ate here and saw good reviews, however the chicken kebab had chicken which was not cooked in the middle. I told the waiter and he took away the meat, but did not apologise or offer us a replacement. Not what we expected - very dissappointing.Show less

Author: andi_wilsonWhitehaven, United Kingdom
Title: Good steak, hard potatoes!
Review: Really fancied a good quality fillet steak for a change and certainly got one. If anything mine was a bit too done but the flavour was great, as was the chimichurri sauce. We shared the hummus too based on other trip adviser recommendations and it was delicious. My complaint was that the potatoes were totally undercooked, still hard. A shame or this would easily have been a five star review.The service was efficient without being particularly friendly.Good clean loo too (something which is VERY hard to find!!).Show less

Author: 39trevorl
Title: good burgers
Review: If you looking for a good burger then this is a good choice. Burgers are done fresh on the BBQ. It was quiet when I was there but when I look at the menu it looks like most dishes are cooked on the BBQ. Nice small, clean little place away from the busyness of Cenang beachShow less

Author: Natalie_craig01Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!!!!
Review: We’ve been in Malaysia for 10 days already and have had a variety of great food but this place has by far been our favorite!! We’ve been in Langkawi for 2 days and have come for dinner twice already! The meat is juicy and well prepared with spices and the salad is both beautiful and delicious!!!! We’ve had the mixed grill, fish, and lamb burger all of which we loved. The watermelon lychee juice was so well presented and thirst quenching as well! The staff are all super friendly and can help you make the best choice if you can’t decide. Will definitely be back again!!!Show less

Author: Leigh K
Title: Superb food
Review: The beef tenderloin was fantastic, cooked to perfection, well presented. Friendly staff will definitely be back here. If you're on Langkawi you must eat here!

Author: eatdrinkstayBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious steak
Review: We have been away for almost three weeks and need some different food and this place has a fantastic grill. The steak was delicious and perfectly cooked ! Thanks guys for a lovely meal Three very happy steak eaters .Does not say but only takes cash . A little annoying. Show less

Author: tam431
Title: Great service
Review: This restaurant offers good value. The menu is small but good. The service is excellent. Overall a very good experience.

Author: exploraz
Title: Delicious meal
Review: A relaxed atmosphere able to eat inside or outside. They showed us pictures of the meals before we chose which was amazing.

Author: toniandlewistravelsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food with nice veggie options
Review: Dont be fooled by the location or store front! The food was really good and they Had a nice selection of vegetarian options to choose from! We had the falafel wrap and the Tempe skewers, both of which were great and very reasonably priced! We went twice in 3 days Show less

Author: lottah482
Title: Good food
Review:
Food is very good and well cooked. Portions could be a little bit bigger for that price.
We enjoyed our dinner!

Author: muhanadm
Title: Amazing restaurant
Review:
They have amazing food, really good customer service, a wide variety of food and drinks, good prices, and friendly waiters and environment friendly.

I had a beef burger I really liked it and I recommend it :)

Author: nidz26
Title: Best place for bbq lamb chops and shawarma
Review: Best place in langkawi if you are craving for delicious shawerma chicken or lamb, amazing lamb chops and so generous friendly waiters and owner, so nice family dinner we had in Langkawi, a must place to visit guys !!

Author: adrienneveenak
Title: Nice Gem
Review: Came here for dinner and they have a pretty wide spread menu of Arabic fusion food. Their presentation of the menu comes with pictures. Great ambience. Nice little spot outside to chill out for shisha. Friendly staff. Will definitely recommend to others :)

Author: bspissWien
Title: Good food ‐ a bit pricey and small portion
Review: We were pleasantly surprised that the place is run by 2 guys from Syria. That made the decision to go for the barbecue grill platter for 2 very easy! The dips like Hoummus, Baba Ganoush and beans with garlic and pommegerande were excellent and we just felt like in the Levante. The home made bread just contributed to that feeling. The big disappointment was then the grill platter for 2. Although the included lamp chop and chicken and lamb shish kababs were delicious, the amount of meat provided would barely safe one person in Syrian restaurants back in Europe. The included salad, bread, white and Kebse style rice and potatoe still filled us up...but our hunger for meat was not satisfied at all. What is the purpose of a meat grill platter that does not satisfy your meat cravings? Charging 95 MYR for that increased our dissatisfied feeling and we will keep looking somewhere else to satisfy our hunger for grilled meat.Show less

Author: danielmH8421IT
Title: Great Falafel
Review: Nice small restaurant with very good falafel and lamb chop. Their lamb chop was perfectly grilled and tasty. The hummus and bread was also good.

Author: mohamadsaufib
Title: Food was good
Review:
Food was good,....
Variety of choices available,.....
Ribs for me however could be softer ,....
Ambience is nice and relaxing,...

Author: yannicknoahkDusseldorf, Germany
Title: Normal and ok
Review: So when we arrived we were seated really quick and they gave us the menu as well as an iPad with some ideas on how the food looks. The food was ok. I have to admit that we had far more better food while we stayed in Langkawi. Nothing special. Pita was warmed up in the microwave but was ok. The beef burger was not really my taste. I think there is a little cinnamon in it. Husband had the ribs what was more like pulled. He liked it. The lemongrass punch was very nice. I only gave three points because I expected more from a barbecue grill. Service was not really present: a how is your food? When you’re eating or if you want to pay by card, first answer is yes- second is normally it is cash - so what now? And then the owner has to get away to get the machine. Well overall it was just: ok. Show less

Author: Hsh1983Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great meal even with kids
Review: Their grilled chicken and fish is so tender , juicy, with good flavor. though a bit pricey.. my 8yo likes it so much... If for some people who don't eat spiced rice, the restaurant also provides basic white rice, it goes very well with the meats that we ordered as well. Definitely worth a try!Show less

Author: LaurenRd13Hertfordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Rated # 1, but didn't feel the hospitality of #1
Review: My husband and I visited this place as it was close to our hotel (Aloft, Langkawi) and rated highly. We walked in and were 'greeted' by a blonde lady who clearly did not want to be there - she may have been having a bad day, but reading a few other reviews I don't think that was the cass. The lady failed to make any nice chat or ask us if we wanted any water for the table or anything! Definitely not worth the 10% service charge that gets automatically added to your bill. It's a shame the service was so unpleasant, as the food was actually nice!Show less

Author: dianal963
Title: Authentic middle eastern food experience
Review: Tasty well seasoned middle eastern food served in a relaxing cozy atmosphere - Excellent value for money - Absolutelyworth a visit

Author: 678paolol
Title: Autentic BBQ
Review:
Good and tasty food 
friendly service from the Syrian owner 
Real BBQ under the canopy
The hamburger was very tasty and the smoothie was fresh hand made in front of us.

Author: Rebeccasc6
Title: Tasty
Review: We ate here one night when we wanted some western food. The size was good, beer cheap and very tasty. Service was great and the hosts very talkative. I really enjoyed my Chicken Souvlaki.

Author: Nel44
Title: Great food!
Review: Lovely little restaurant with great food and, nice staff and very relaxing vintage music. Try the falafelwrap, applecrumble and lemongrass mojito. So good!

Author: traveller888a
Title: Great restaurant - highly recommend
Review: Good food,  great setting and wonderful staff - attentive and very considerate. Excellent choice of drinks and good selection of food on the menu

Author: Federico Z
Title: Not impressed
Review: Not impressed at all, hummus tasted acid, lamb and chicken very boring. Too many similar food concepts on the strip and much better choice. Not going to come again.

Author: Tastinge
Title: Grill Paradise in Langkawi!
Review:
Excellent in every aspect! Best bbq in Langkawi, great staff who care about their service and food. Great choices on the menu. 
It's a must to go eat at that place when visiting Langkawi.

Author: Worksetsyoufree
Title: Overrated 5/10 at best. Service charge  rip off.
Review:
Avoid the chicken not great portion 
Lamb burger decent 
Hummus average 
Service charge for no service from a girl who clearly didn’t want to be there. 
Definitely not worth its ranking

Author: Dee52
Title: Great, fresh food
Review: We had a great dinner here. They have a large bbq at the front of the restaurant and you can see everything being cooked. The food tasted very fresh and I would definitely recommend this restaurant!

Author: rjprice-0707
Title: Great food and really lovely owners!
Review: The three Syrian brothers who own and run this were welcoming and kind! Nice setting beside the Main Street and nice ambiance with the smokey bbq smell! Food was tasty - would highly recommend coming here for dinner!

Author: kimv931Helsinki, Finland
Title: Best hummus ever!
Review: Visited place restaurant with my family (five people altogether). Place is run by three friendly Syrian brothers and food was simply put amazing. Tastes are simple and pure, their hummus was best ever. You cannot judge book by the cover and it definitely applies to this restaurant. Location is not best possible (far from it) but quality of food offsets that tenfold. Show less

Author: amyappleh
Title: Best place to eat in Langkawi
Review: We had this awesome dinner at Arang BBQ. Must try their grilled beef burger and hummus. Home made. Best. Food. Ever.

Author: Robert v
Title: Good food , great drinks
Review: After weeks  with a lot of rice and noodles, we had fantastic burgers, drinks ( loved the lemongrass punch;)) and wraps. The people are very friendly and the place is clean ! Highly recommended

Author: 297suzannev
Title: Excellent
Review: Great food and service, highly recommended! The portions were of a good size and we ordered an additional salad as a side dish as it was that good.

Author: hollasdair
Title: Pleased
Review: Friendly staff and enjoyed every bite! I ordered the lamb kebab and trio dip dish to share with my husband.

Author: Julie G
Title: Small portions
Review: We went for dinner. Satays were the smallest I have ever experienced. Meals are also small even kebabs were small as a main. The rice was average like riceariso. Overpriced.

Author: Melinda H
Title: Dinner
Review: Delicious food, friendly staff and service, good cocktails, clean, nice vibe. We ordered four different meals and hommus which were all delicious with nothing left on any plates. The food is cooked outside on a flame grilled hotplate so sitting outside you can see your food being cooked.Show less

Author: Loulou75Oz
Title: Superb
Review: Fantastic meal. Food was fresh, beautifully presented and moorish- even our fussy kids cleaned their plates. The dips were divine and disappeared quickly! Staff are welcoming and friendly. Highly recommend Arang. Will definitely visit again.

Author: simontP9792RO
Title: Excellent!
Review: Beautiful, clean, delicious food. Lovely owners / chefs... our 9 year old wants us to go back for her birthday “because the food was so tasty.”

Author: oblacek
Title: Abraham's meal
Review:
Must try lamb kebab. 

I finally understand  why "Abraham" loved lamb's meals.

The stuff is kind and polite. The place is clean with wooden tabels and chairs. Its owners are three syrian brother that look  handsome too ;)

Author: moosterveerEindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Good and meets expectations
Review: Nice and good restaurant. We went up to see this highly recommended restaurant by Tripadvisor. The BBQ was good, saté as starter nice. The servers were also able to give good advice. Although we were quite early, around 18:30, the beef burger was already sold-out. The lamb was juicy and a very good alternative. Show less

Author: Jacoztraveller
Title: Keep on going back
Review: Sitting to eat here for the third time this week. We just can’t go past the beautiful flavors of the flame grill. Have tried just about everything on the menu from the chicken to the burger and everything is so tasty and tender. We truly can’t go past the homemade hummus, which is so spectacular we can’t even share it... 1 each. The guys here are friendly and accommodating. Definitely give this place a try! Show less

Author: fizzak2019
Title: Amazing restaurant, must visit!!!
Review: Food is very reasonably priced and tastes amazing, must try if you are in Langkawi, the owners are fast and courteous and have excellent customer service, wish I found this place sooner. 10/10

Author: iclare-hkHong Kong, China
Title: Dinner after watching sunset
Review: We waited for long to dine here according to the many excellent comments we could read. We first was very disappointing that the shop closed and not open at 2pm. Yet we chose finally tonight riding back to Cenang beach from Tanjung Rhu Beach after watching the beautiful sunset.There shop keepers are Syrians and they recommend us the white snapper, prawns and squids set with salad good for two (mix seafood RM160). As we needed to finish in a hurry within 1/2 hour. We are so lucky that the dinner prepared in an efficient way within 15 minutes. Those pitta bread, rice and potatoes are all fresh, soft and delicious, I did not feel thirsty afterward, see the presentation in the pictures, with lemongrass punch, I really am impressed, this is the first middle east cuisine I tried and they are healthy and beautiful. Highly recommend though 10% charge will be added to the bill. 根據我們可以閱讀到的許多優秀評論，我們在旅遊的第三晚終於訂了位在這裡用餐。 我們原先在到達浮羅交怡的首天想到這裡吃年飯，卻因為該商店關閉，有說下午2點後會開放。 然而，卻是摸門丁。今天在觀看了美麗的日落之後，我們終於選擇了從Tanjung Rhu海灘乘坐色返回Cenang海灘。 店員們都是敘利亞人，他們向我們推薦白鯛魚，蝦和魷魚，沙拉適合兩種（混合海鮮RM160）。 因為我們需要在半小時內趕緊完成。 我們非常幸運，晚餐在15分鐘內以高效的方式準備好。 那些pitta麵包，米飯和土豆都清新，柔軟，味道鮮美，吃完後我沒有感到口渴，可看下面圖片中的介紹，用檸檬punch，我真的很印象深刻，這是我嘗試的第一個中東美食，他們是 健康又美麗。 強烈推薦，雖然10％的費用將添加到賬單上。Show less

Author: AA662019
Title: Delicious
Review: We ordered kebab and lamb, in addition to the local malaysian meat skewers (satay). I'm not a big fan of the satay, but the dishes we ordered were absolutely delicious. I loved the rice and the meat was cooked perfectly. The portions are just right, not too large. The passion fruit and lemongrass juice was great too. I gave it 4 stars due to the location (no view at all, just beside the road), and the lack of AC indoors.Show less

Author: SBT2602
Title: Amazing lamb
Review: The lamb kebab is a must try! It's very tasty and tender and is served with nice Mediterranean rice. The people working there are also very nice! Definitely worth a visit!!

Author: Trexterra
Title: Awesome Food!
Review: If you come to this restaurant, go for the mediterranean delights. The kebab and the mediterranean chicken is superbly scrumptious! Friendly and helpful staff! Definitely deserves 5 stars!

Author: NopainNogain88
Title: nothing special
Review: absolutely average food and service. I think, that on this island you can find much better places where to enjoy good grilled items. Staff polite, smiling but no clue of what they are offering/selling.

Author: carolinf846
Title: Delicious dinner with friendly service
Review: BBQ grill restaurant with middle east touch combined with Malaysian food. We had a plate with hummus and baba ganoush and marinated chicken. Afterwards we had a hot brownie with vanilla ice cream, which was very delicious too. The staff was friendly and created an welcoming atmosphere. Show less

Author: juliezazoo
Title: Langkawi
Review: Good service, good food, with company of good friends. What more could you ask for? Would  definitely recommend it when you visit Langkawi.

Author: FayeW741
Title: Lovely food with friendly staff
Review:
We enjoyed our lamb steak and veggie kebabs. The food was well presented. 

The service was good and I was able to watch the guy BBQ’ing our food which added to the experience.

Keep it up!

Author: linafreden
Title: Best BBQ in Langkawi!
Review:
Seriously one of the best meals we had in Langkawi! 
True flavours from the Middle East. Place is run by three passionate, social and professional brothers. Definitely a must visit when you’re in Langkawi!

Author: Andycoast
Title: Great food, friendly staff and clean!
Review: This was on outstanding restaurant to eat at as a family. The staff were the friendliest we have met on the island and the bathrooms are also clean. Highly recommend. Great work guys!

Author: mertyc
Title: falafel
Review: amazing falafel wrap! couple of vegetarian options and sides and very friendly staff (-: will be visiting again

Author: Wessel1994
Title: Excellent!
Review: Just had diner in this, from the outside looking, basic restaurant. The staff was very friendly and the food was perfect! Portions were a bit small but sufficient and the taste was excellent. Would recommend it for sure!

Author: cindymarieazur
Title: Chicken Kebab, Hummus and Pita Bread Amazingly Delish 😋
Review:
Didn’t disappoint our tastebuds - the chicken was delicious, tender and juicy. You can taste the rich flavour along with the Mediterranean rice. Hummus and pita bread, geez so good 😋 
Overall, satisfied customers and would recommend to try visit this place.

Author: RubaA_12Sydney, Australia
Title: Great food and excellent service
Review: I was in Langkawi with my family for Four nights end of April, When we first arrived the kids looked unimpressed, they ordered the tenderloin with mash and before we left they were asking to come again, it was in their own words the best steak they’ve had !!!We came back after 2 nights and the staff were so welcoming and gave us complimentary salad.Food was just as nice as the first time we were there, I also had the Mediterranean rice (kabsah) and I highlyrecommend it , it was amazing.I highly recommend Arung BBQ and will definitely visit again next time I’m in Langkawi. Show less

Author: Boeszz N
Title: Verry Verry Nice !
Review: Nice restaurant in A Nice place. Verry good service and ambiance. The food was dilicious and for A good price! You must To come here.

Author: alansP5377KN
Title: Excellent and a Must Visit Place
Review:
Awesome food - A few drinks and beer a great hit...
Must try the appended meals..
Beef sausages + mash
Mediterranean chicken + rice
Beef satay and rice. 
 Genuinely Friendly service too!!!
Family vote of 5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐s

Author: erikhU8815XA
Title: Great food
Review:
Went to Arang with three friends. Ate burgers and kebab. The burger was juicy and tasty with a lot of good flavors. Chicken-kebab was very good, but a rather small portion. 
Staff spoke English very well and were very welcoming. 
Recommended!!

Author: tazk2018
Title: Amazing burger!!
Review:
My son knows his burgers and he can’t stop talking about the burger here. 
The service quick- people lovely and place clean!!!!!

Author: Lifechey
Title: Go eat here!
Review: Super yummy food, very friendly and hard working staff. Just very good! I would recommend everyone to go here when in the Cenang area.

Author: Adrian JBridgnorth, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Barbeque experience
Review: We rolled up on Monday, however we chose the day they were closed. We tried again on Tuesday and were rewarded with a fantastic experience. Not a huge menu but it does not need to be. Syrian Barbecue served by fantastic brothers who left Damascus 5 years ago. Syria's loss and a Malaysian and tourist 5 star gain. They even served up an extra treat when they learnt it was my wife's birthday. A real gem located at the southern end of Pantai Cenang on Tengah, close to Hotel Camara.Show less

Author: Maat75
Title: Langkawi’s best grill
Review:
As my kids said: ‘Can we also eat here tomorrow...!!’
Friendly staff and quick service. Just good food freshly grilled in front of you. Personal touch by the Syrian staff. Tip: nice triple dip as a starter.

Author: _V515NO
Title: Clean and delish
Review: Nice clean resto to have very good grilled food. The salsa was worthy of asking for a second helping.

Author: Keith CCumbria, United Kingdom
Title: Good for BBQs
Review: The food is almost exclusively BBQ and cooked on open charcoals. The staff were great and attentive and the food we had was good. However we are greedy or the portion sizes were a little on the small side. Its the sort of place you have to try will not suit everyone whilst other will love it.Show less

Author: Antonia E
Title: Probably the best food on the Island!
Review: Very nice staff, and amazing food. Ate there 3 days in a row. You have to try the lamb, in all variations. The souvlaki is divine, fresh sallad, mash is delicious. These guys deserve some cred!

Author: CrescentCityGouda, The Netherlands
Title: Probably one of the best on Langkawi
Review: After eating at some of the local restaurants we found this place. You can sit in- and outside and since it was warm we took a table inside.The restaurant is managed by 3 Syrian brothers and one, forgot his name, even took the time to have a talk. He explained the menu, not a lot on the menu but you can make requests so just ask, and we had falafel, chicken and some fries. Both dishes were nicely presented and tasted very good. Everything is fresh, sauces are made in house and good quality.This restaurant deserves to be in the Top 3 of Langkawi.Show less

Author: Michael SOrnskoldsvik, Sweden
Title: Delicious food and friendly service
Review: At Arang you'll get delicious food and friendly service from the two syrian brothers and their staff. It's not a fancy restaurant, just a small place. But they have delicious food. Well worth a walk. Not haram, so they sell alcohol, thank god. Pay them a visit!Show less

Author: Bubssss
Title: Best Bbq Ribs Ever
Review: Haven’t had such an amazing ribs for awhile until I came across Arang in Langkawi. The brothers that owns the place are very friendly and I can tell they whole heartily put in their passion in cooking every meals for their customer. Thanks guys

Author: VpsteveCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Just exceptional
Review: We ate here after a recommendation and weren't disappointed. As a couple we are well travelled and used to all standards so won't bore you with all the details, as there are plenty of reviews. Enough to say that this team serve fresh food grilled on thethe BBQ in total visibility and we never found anything comparable while in Langkawi. It's not local food but is done to the highest standard and the Humus was possibly the best I've ever tasted. Other dishes .. Grilled chicken, beef ribs, and lamb chops. Oh and the apple crumble and proper coffee...... Not your average tourist restaurant ... A cut above.Included is the added bonus of some really cool lounge jazz over the highShow less

Author: Junkbond321
Title: Wonderful Dinners
Review: Our second trip in as many days. Australian beef, ribs, kabob: all was excellent. Espresso and cappuccino were just as good as the food. A must dine in Langkawi.

Author: MosterMaja
Title: Great food, exellent service
Review: Our second visit to this restaurant, the food was great both times. Service was excellent. Can highly recommend this restaurant.

Author: 505sophiew
Title: Great if you fancy a change from local food
Review: We really struggled to find great food in Langkawi so were so happy to stumble across this little gem. On our last day we had had enough of local food and was after something a little different. I had the falafal wrap which was delicious, very generous with the falafal which isn't always the case in some places. The hummus was great and made a fab starter. Service was very friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: bamboozleed
Title: great dinner, nice vibes
Review: had dinner with my partner, we had the lamb chop and lamb kebab. was a wonderful meal, very flavorful (in the mediterranean style) and well presented. would recommend going.

Author: sihuixoSingapore, Singapore
Title: 10/10 grilled lamb chop & 12/10 service
Review: Read about the great reviews and after trying this place out I can say it definitely lives up to it. Our food (grilled lamb chop and kebab) was BBQ-ed right after we placed the order and arrived fresh and hot. Staff was nice and friendly and came to ask us how the food was. 10/10 will recommend.Show less

Author: Dennis KFrederiksberg, Denmark
Title: Delicious, cheap and friendly
Review: I went there with my girlfriend and our daughter. The staff was very friendly and the food absolutely delicious. I had the chicken kebab it was great. My girlfriend had the Falaffel wrap which was also good. Highly recommendable and All the Best to the Guys behind this place who's opened only 1 year ago. So go support this place and have a great meal with great value for your money. Show less

Author: Christopher P
Title: Great service, great food
Review: The food was cooked right after ordering, the service was great. These guys from Syria deserve all the best, we felt right at home. Just the air-conditioning has to be more powerful.

Author: sultanlahham
Title: Delicious food ever
Review:
Very recommended, food is very nice, friendly staff, I have visited this restaurant and I love the food and drinks there.
Recommended 👍must try

Author: 646oliverdKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The finest steak we’ve ever had!
Review: Oh boy! This place is a hidden gem! We’ve eaten here twice now in 4 days and can honestly say it’s the best steak (and BBQ’dchicken) we’ve ever had! ARANG is owned by the most amazing 3 Syrian brothers who pull together hearty and delicious BBQ Mediterranean influenced food. The steak was exceptional quality and cooked to perfection! The staff were amazing with our kids and made both of our visits extremely enjoyable. If you’re looking forsomething other than Curry or Noodles then don’t miss this place! Show less

Author: hena27London, United Kingdom
Title: hard to fault the food and friendly staff
Review: simply delicious food cooked with love and sincerity in a chilled space. as the owner said I only make what my family enjoy. !! my wife is vegetarian and was so crazy about the salad and humous !! I had the lamb burger and souvlaki on our two visits there ( shame we only found their place at the end of our holiday !). The brothers are such warm guys and are always looking to please. thanks guys .. you deserve to be number one ..Show less

Author: naomih364Iznajar, Spain
Title: Fantastic steak !!!
Review: Wow what can I say the best steak I've had for a very long time !!!! Served with JP but we changed to chips as we were craving fried chips !!! With a lovely side salad, chimichurri sauce and a garlic sauce , it was fabulous!!!!!!!!!! The service is great so welcoming and friendly perfect end to our wonderful stay on Langkawii .Thanks guys hope you have a very successful year, you deserve it !!Show less

Author: Katja PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: The Zesty Flavours Of The Syrian Cuisine
Review: This is a place you bring your family and friends. A gem easily missed as it's on the opposite side of Bamboo Ba and next to Alanya Residences, nestled between shop lots. You have both outdoor and indoor (air-conditioned) seating available. The guys that run the restaurant are brothers, they are from Syria and the food is really delicious! They also bring the food to nearby bars so if you are out drinking and fancy a nice bite but do not want to sit down then they can send the food out to you without charging extra.My recommendation is actually to try the Falafal, Showarma or the Trio Of Dips. All food is freshly made so you may need to wait a little longer but it is definitely worth the wait!There are plenty of vegetarian adjustments that can be made for those who do not eat meat.Show less

Author: 566aubreydHounslow, United Kingdom
Title: discriminators
Review: really looking forward to eating here, but unfortunately when we arrived, we were seated, and then ignored. other people who came in after us had their orders taken first, while we sat there totally invisible to the waiter.the place was was pretty quiet so really annoying.needless to say we left, i guess i better dye my hair blonde.....Show less

Author: J8404FKemmat
Title: Affordable and delicious food!
Review: Really nice place with great service and affordable prices. The food was really delicious and we even got free dessert. Recommend!

Author: 498aaronl
Title: Late night feed
Review: Walked over from Lepak at 11pm for a quick bite to refuel before sunba and found Arang... the food and friendly service here is incredible. A must hit place for foodies. Presentation and taste is just incredible. Beef Burger was 5*. Must try.

Author: b14w4k42p41
Title: Great food, great service, and lovely music
Review: My husband and I ordered lamb burger and lamb kebabs. Both were delicious and definitely come back again. Meat were tender and freshly made. Their sauces were amazing! Yummy 😊

Author: ChandraM552
Title: Good Food
Review: It is located near Pantai Tengah.Waiters are very friendly.Food took sometime to arrive eventhough not many customers,maybeit is because it was freshly grilled upon order. My drinks came as how i requested/customized.Cons: They dont accept creditcard, only cash. The ambience inside of the restaurant needs a little touch up. It is quite boring looking.Show less

Author: membuaya
Title: Mouth-watering
Review: Arang offers something different from the usual fare you'd find lining the streets. A great selection of BBQ meals that is both comforting and extremely satisfying. Such a chilled atmosphere where you can just unwind and eat to your heart's content.

Author: amandaszulikCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Much more than expected
Review: We tried this place last night but unfortunately they were closed so we tried again tonight and so so pleased we did the food was amazing. My son (husband & I when James would let us) adored the fresh hummus & his chicken kebab was fantastic; my husband and I had the Malay chicken with rice and it was so tender, the side serving of sauce was so fresh and tasty. I highly recommend this place the guys were so friendly and professional; the decor is very on trend and hipster with the pallet converted seats, music was low key and jazz club esq.Show less

Author: Smileypokey
Title: Good food here.
Review: Enjoyed the food here especially the trio of dips with hot pita bread - delicious.  Also had Malaysian Chicken and Mediterranean Salad - both very good.  Service is friendly and efficient.

Author: JornMichAntwerp, Belgium
Title: Really good meat
Review: Found this restaurant through TripAdvisor and we thought, let’s give it a shot. Because it was low season, the amount of tourist wasn’t that much. So the guys looked pretty happy when we arrived at the restaurant. We ordered a burger and also the beef rib. I wasn’t too sure about the last choice because most of the beef in Asia is pretty dry. To my surprise it was really tender! And it came with a very tasteful sauce! When the dishes arrive, you’ll think the portion is not that much, but it’s really the exact amount. The quality of the food and the price of the dishes are in good balance! Really worth your money and very polite gentlemen. Show less

Author: jacknstewPerth, Australia
Title: What a find
Review: Just had the most lovely meal with my family here. Service was excellent. Food delicious and cooked in front of you vertically. Salads crisp and fresh . Run by Sirian staff here for three years. Wow. Recommend the food . Food to please most tastes. I give 5 stars except decorShow less

Author: Sarah S
Title: Great Food & Friendly Sevice
Review: I’ve visited Arang BBQ and grill during my last visit to Langkawi, as well as my current stay on.  Arang always give great quality food and reasonable prices.  The staff are very friendly and they have a great music selection.  👌

Author: OnAir815876
Title: Food
Review: Very delicious , yummy and very tasty . Suitable for muslim and very nice staff . Also good for child

Author: 867vickih
Title: Recommended!
Review: Lovely food, top notch service and definitely recommended!  Menu had a small but adequate selection Of dishes and everything was freshly cooked.

Author: Adventurer693346
Title: Simply delicious food
Review: We decided to visit Arang after walking up the strip and it has been the best food we’ve had in Malaysia. The menu is simple however everything we had was cooked perfectly. Mixed satay skewers were extremely tasty as was the trio of dips. The lamb chop was tender and soft - cooked to perfection. The Malaysian BBQ chicken was full of flavour. Accompaniments of sauces, rice and salad were also very delicious. Service was also fab and the lemongrass mojito was the best I’ve had yet! Show less

Author: Juninho25Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Good food relaxed atmosphere
Review: We went for dinner on our penultimate night in Langkawi based om the TripAdvisor reviews. The restaurant was empty and looks more like a cafe but dont let that put you off. The servoce was good, menu and prices reasonable but most importantly the food was delicious. Highly recommended if you are in Pantai Tengah and dont want to trek into the main town. We'll go back again tonight if we get chance.Show less

Author: food_critic_tt
Title: Very nice dinner
Review: Love the new grilled food here. Looks very nice whilst cooking outside on big bbq and tastes great too - delicious Mediterranean grilled food. We had beef ribs and lamb chops. Beautifully presented and fantastic service from the staff too. Definitely recommend!

Author: tishytoshy
Title: Really good
Review: Went for evening meal after reading reviews here. Restaurant pretty empty but we had a lovely meal there. Menu not huge but food really nice and staff very friendly and helpful. It’s the sister restaurant to Fat Cupid (we preferred Arang)

Author: 770stefv
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Super friendly staff preparing great fresh proper meals! Nice background music completes the scene. Realy worth a visit.

Author: sabarudinh
Title: Nice western food.
Review: Great ambience!! You have a choice of outdoor alfresco or dining inside with airconditioning. Clean white layout. I ordered the grilled chicken thigh...love it! I celebrated my birthday here with the missus, staff really surprised me with a birthday song and brownie! I recommend their Main courses are yummy and worth the money. Desserts you can skip, as desserts are a little pricey . The owners love music from the 80s, 90s and early 2000s...just like I do. So expect music like Purple Rain by Prince and Pure Shores by All Saints played on their sound speakers to put you in the mood. If you are staying at La Pari Pari, you must check this restaurant out to count your stay as complete :)Show less

Author: Fiona LWoori Yallock
Title: Wonderful
Review: Heard about this restaurant on tripadvisor so decided to try it. Wasn't disappointed. We were greeted and seated by one of the friendly team, ordered a couple of different sangria drinks, hummus with bread,grilled corn and vegetable salad and lamb souvlaki with chips. Everything came quickly. The drinks were yummy and a nice change from beer. The hummus and fresh pita divine, the lamb souvlaki delicious . Ordered another sangria which brought the meal to about 120 ringgit. Great atmosphere and wonderful food. Highly recommend. Show less

Author: Meli92I
Title: Amazing!
Review: During our stay in Langakwi we had to have a snack here every single day. The food is simply delicious, authentic and most important, made fresh for every single order. We recomend the trio of dips and all the wraps.

Author: Kasia E
Title: Amazing
Review: You're in for a treat. Atmosphere, service and FOOD. (Try to get hummus, it's amazing) A great place if you want a break from noodles ;)

Author: AndreyRgv
Title: Delicious meat
Review: When you are tired of all the types of asian food just visit this place and enjoy their burger. Friendly staff, lovely atmosphere and inexpensive  dishes.  Recommend without a doubt

Author: Tessa H
Title: Very nice grilled food
Review: We went here because we had Malaysian food for 14 days in a row. This was a very very good subsitution! The waiters were friendly and quick and the food was well prepared and freshly barbecued. I would certainly reccomend it!

Author: hossneya
Title: Great food, amazing service
Review:
The food is delicious, I went there twice and bot meals were great!
I really liked the atmosphere, friendly and attentive staff!

Definitely reccomended!

Author: mluyer
Title: Great food!
Review: We have had a perfect dinner with delicious food and great service. If you visit Langkawi, you have to go here sometime!

Author: Stig RKristiansand, Norway
Title: Amazing, don't know how to acknowledge this enough
Review: This place is amazing.The service is great.The food is fresh and so tasty.The drinks are very good and generous but not to the point of too strong.2nd day in a row and still considering the third.Try the kebab, lamb was so tender, chicken perfectly cooked and rice and salad frash and so good.Resteooms clean and way better than any other restaurant we bren to in langkawi.Come here and love it Show less

Author: joesgreedyspleen
Title: Amazing food, amazing service
Review: I visited with my friend for food (wraps, delicious) and have returned because I loved it so much. The guys running it are so welcoming and warm - the delicious food is an added bonus, all for a very reasonable price. I’d highly recommend.

Author: sagarika n
Title: Warm hosts
Review: An absolutely warm place to be if you want to catch some late night gourmet food in patai cenang. This pace is run by Syrian refugees and trust me they are such great hosts. They make you feel at home. Don't forget to try the lamb chop dish. Finger licking good!Show less

Author: Rikhard M
Title: Simply amazing
Review: I visited this place with my family as I had heard it’s a good place. I was not dissapointed as the lamb was the best lamb I have ever had. It was so juicy and tender. The delicious food was accompanied by excellent service and atmosphere. I highly recommend ordering off the menu and asking for lamb skewers, as you won’t be dissapointed! Show less

Author: rachel bGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Family dining
Review: Amazing ... we are a family of 5 adults visiting Langkawi for 7 days been here twice already. Food is really really good. The bbq fish platter (enough to feed 3-4) was outstanding as are the burgers and chicken Malay. We will be probably making a third visit before we depart!! Well worth it. Show less

Author: niclasj2013
Title: Great tasty food and friendly service
Review: Went twice in a week and we enjoyed it very much both times. Trio dip and chicken mains are all fantastic.

Author: katherlenem
Title: Good food
Review: Really good food. The trio dips were great and so was the lamb chop. Pricing was good as well  everything was reasonable.

Author: Kirstynicmal
Title: Delicious!
Review:
We visited arang on a rainy afternoon, The food is delicious and the service great.

We both had very yummy lemongrass punch as a drink.. and then i had the souvlaki which was melt in your mouth!! 

Would definitely visit again!

Author: seestanley
Title: Yummy lunch
Review: We had a delicious lunch served up beautifully, my Son and Hubby had the souvlaki and said it was one of the best, wish we had more time we would have definitely gone back, great service great food reasonably priced

Author: LaiLeeC2
Title: Delicious and friendly staff
Review: The foods here meet expectations and delicious.  Lamb grill chop and lamb burger is so delicious and juicy, the environment here also clean and comfortable. Definitely  Will visit again.

Author: Stormy_SAShanghai, China
Title: Amazing food! Awesome atmosphere!
Review: Best food in Langkawi no question about it! The BBQ meats are uniquely seasoned and have a distinct taste. Falafels and Hummus are exceptional, i liked that the falafels are done on the fire and not deep fried. Mash potatoes are to die for! A must visit for anyone in Langkawi.Show less

Author: MinhangLaowei
Title: Everything tasted great
Review: Fair to say the best burger (lamb meat) I ever ate. Excellent hummus. The restaurant also completely redefined what humble mashed potatoes are. The owner was very nice, we had an interesting (albeit short) chat.

Author: Jane B
Title: Great food - great atmosphere
Review: We went here for lunch one day and went back for dinner the next day. Very well tasting food - the humus is the best we ever tried. Great BBQ juicy meat and a laid-back relaxed atmosphere. And the staff is super nice and friendly.

Author: Tracie M
Title: Delicious food!
Review: It is quite difficult finding a place to eat lunch in this area as many places don't open until late afternoon; however Arang was open! It's a very clean restaurant with attentive, friendly staff. We ordered the lamb and falafel wraps, which were delicious and generous. We would definitely recommend.Show less

Author: tomtD1632UG
Title: Amazing bbq
Review: We went here on our first night and I’m so glad we did. The food is brilliant. It might look a little underwhelming but it’s worth it.

Author: MilijanaZEdegem, Belgium
Title: Very delicious food!
Review: We came here one night for a late evening dinner and after that, we came back every other day of our holiday. The food tastes really very good, with delicious Meditteranean flavours. Just simple, but really good food. On top of that, the staff is so kind and friendly. Keep up the good work!! Show less

Author: Cheng O
Title: Quick bite for a family meal
Review: Good food, good staff, good atmosphere halfway in the middle of beaches surroundings and landscape. Music is a bit different from the usual restaurant.

Author: Dominique B
Title: Great Middle Eastern Food in Langkawi!
Review: The service was good here. You can sit inside or outside, in the sun or more shaded area. The restaurant is extremely clean and well kept. You can see the barbecue used right outside and smell your food as it is prepared. The food is great, for both meat and vegetarian dishes. I also recommend trying the sauces offered, creamy garlic was excellent! Absolutely no complaints!Show less

Author: Luke C
Title: Amazing food and friendly staff
Review: Well worth a visit. Staff were friendly and helpful, food was brilliant, place looked very clean and it wasn't over priced.

Author: Wanderer990Somerset
Title: Enjoyed our meal here
Review: We are told about this place by Fat cupid who also own this one. We had a very pleasant meal here although felt the menu was a little bit limited. worth a visit though definitely. It was a bit quiet in there, both when we went in and when we walked past on subsequent nights I think they need some positive reviews to bring the punters in! Give them a try!Show less

Author: Hanna R
Title: Best falafel ever!
Review: Me and my friend loved this place. I’ve been a vegetarian for 7 years and have never tasted a better falafel than this one. The staff was very nice as well. Also really enjoyed the jazz covers playing in the background haha☺️ Will definitely go back here if I ever get the chance.Show less

Author: rigall2016
Title: Dinner with kids
Review: Well, this is a very good surprise. Excellent welcome, customer satisfaction oriented. Excellent cocktails  - i suggest the fatcupid for adults - and good fresh fruits juices. Really good bbq meat as well. Many thanks for all. We will go again.

Author: lukarnas
Title: Very nice place with good food!
Review: I can recommend this place. Nice, clean, with very good service. Food was good, portions not so big but good is enaught. 5/5 for me

Author: EvaA3370
Title: Delicious food!
Review: Stumbled across this restaurant on our search for somewhere to have dinner! Really welcoming staff and friendly atmosphere. Open bbq area so you can see them cooking your food which is cool. We shared the trio of dips to share as a starter - served with warm tortillas, all three dips were really tasty.I had the lamb chop with tzatsiki and Mediterranean rice - it was delicious! Really good flavours. My boyfriend had the lamb souvlaki which had harissa and salad in, served with chips - also really good! We had beer with our meal and I regret not trying the lemongrass mojito! I was too full to order anything else!! Thank you Show less

Author: JiaWen C
Title: Satisfying dinner
Review: Deliciously marinated Mediterranean style chicken with tasty harissa sauce. A main course costs from around RM30 onwards. Lemongrass drinks is fresh and very refreshing. Looks ordinary from the appearance but food is quite good.

Author: ReettaR40
Title: Delicious food!
Review: Food with heart. New and fresh, amazing dishes and tasty drinks. The staff is super friendly and attentive. Came here to eat many days in a row!

Author: JOEY529London, United Kingdom
Title: Very tasty!
Review: I was vegetarian before coming to this restaurant... I tried the chicken from my partner one day, and came back the next to have it for myself it was so good! Very friendly staff running the place, only been open 3 weeks I wish them lots of success! Nice hummus. Show less

Author: dougcY2265KP
Title: Amazing vegetarian options
Review: Great service and ambience but best of all is the vegetarian options. I had the trio of dips with awesome pita bread and 3 dips: hummus, tzatziki and lentils. The Tikka tempeh kebab with tofu was unique and amazing! Topped off with delicious apple crumble and ice cream! I'm stuffed but can't wait to come back for more!!!Show less

Author: MinnaJo
Title: Friendly service!
Review: Good food. We had burgers and kebabs (wish they have been a bit bigger, though), very friendly service. The staff kindly turned down the music when we asked them to.

Author: 537sofiav
Title: The BEST!
Review: We stayed 18 days, and this is by far the best food! Dont miss out on this incredible good food! Waiter and the people working there is very nice!

Author: Shaun G
Title: GREAT FOOD, ATMOSPHERE AND STYLE
Review: Brilliant food, lamb kebabs are top class! Great music all night and the fact they played some spandel ballet on the way in made my night!! 10 out of 10 for any traveller wanting something other than noodles and egg

Author: CallaBudgieFrankfurt, Germany
Title: New place with potential
Review: This nice little BBQ restaurant is run by the owners that operate fatCUPID. When we ate at fatCUPID they made us aware of their new opening so we decided to give it a try as we were always happy at their first place. We were friendly greeted and quickly got our drinks the so called freezers made from different juices. A little bit to icy to drink but tasty. We ordered food and their different combos are very nice with different homemade dips and spicy marinades. Chicken and beef satay and grilled chicken were of nice quality and perfectly prepared on the fire. Service was attentive but needs some more training to handle guest complaints. The quality of the lamb chops was a desaster though. The so called chops were one 200g piece of meet which you could actually eat only 15% or 4 bites of. The rest was grease and absolutely unedible. We complained with the waiter and he wanted to talk to the chef about the meat. We decided to have some ice cream as dessert which was of nice quality.Only when settling the bill the manager came to explain and apologize that they did not get the quality they wanted for the meat because of Christmas. Hey guys, then take it from the menu if it does not meet your quality standards which are obviously existing. Also it would have been a nice gesture to take the dessert from the bill which you did not. The restaurant has enough potential to be nice. When they improve on the described quality issues which are hopefully only some start up glitches there is clear potential for more than 3,5 stars (which I would have given if possible).Show less

Author: aNNaSKLAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Scrumptious BBQ & Grill varieties
Review: We had our opportunity to dine-in here and they just opened their business hours. Ordered grilled lamb chop and percik chicken. The lamb chop comes with Mediterranean rice, green salad and minty Tzatziki. The percik chicken is serves with rice, salad, and percik sauce. You can choose to eat inside with air condition or outside with the sea breeze. In the menu they have some appetizers and salads, a few choices of wraps and burgers, some side orders and extras, variety of sauces and etc. The cold drinks are served in the jar bottle which is quite interesting, and hot drinks are available too.Show less

Author: chriswH3834HI
Title: Asian food
Review: Okay run of the mill Chinese. So so .had lunch it was tastey enough wasnt the cheapest we have had but as we had just arrived  it was the first place we stopped at after  a long travel

Author: NopainNogain88
Title: Cozy Cafe
Review: Clean, tidy and cozy cafe. The curries are very well prepared, juices and smoothies refreshing and tasty. Prices are reasonable and the lady owner very friendly.

Author: Gin_Chng
Title: Good brunch
Review: Nice environment and good food served. We enjoyed our brunch and will be back if we are in Langkawi again.

Author: LPphils
Title: Succulent Cuisine
Review: My Friends and I went for Brunch ,they have limited Menu , but extremely mouth watering specially their pastries, not to mention their blueberry cheese cake, which is specially baked by the owner itself, Soraya. their smoothies are exceptional, originally done by her son. We tried one of their Pastas, Creamy Pesto Pasta done by their experienced Chef Khan, who have an extra touch .... it is a pasta al dente. Beef Rendang which I cannot find it here in the Island, Its only in Yam Yam where u can have the real Asian Flavor & Taste. Place is small but clean, All of them gave us the customer service that we are looking for. We will be back again.Its truly YAM YAMShow less

Author: Polds83Breda, The Netherlands
Title: Bitterballen and home-baked bread
Review: Western-style cafe with simple but effective decoration. We tried the coffee, a smoothy, some slices of the home-baked bread / raisin toast and soup which were all of good taste and quality. Last but certainly not least they have Dutch “bitterballen” (a snack every Dutchman who spends a long time abroad will crave for) which were authentic and tasty. Show less

Author: 436mayaw
Title: delicious breakfast!!
Review:
wide variety, creative and tasteful!
and environmental friendly
you cannot miss it for a great start of the day!

Author: 444kedargSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good breakfast options
Review: We went there for breakfast and it had good variety ...we choose two different types of eggs (spinach and scrambled) ...both were filling, yummy and we also added chicken sausages with it...the drinks are as usual....we had our usual black coffee and green tea, so not much to comment on that ...another day before going out for activities we had got egg sandwich packed...the bread was fresh and crisp and overall the sandwich was good....not that cheap but good setting and lovely place especially for breakfast (menu has loads of all day options as well but we just had breakfast there).... Show less

Author: cmcelroy1988Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Good food, smoothies, coffee, and service.
Review: Really enjoyed YamYam cafe. I preferred the roast chicken salad to the green chicken curry. Had the green goddess smoothie both times (so good!). Coffee did not disappoint. The friendly service and helpful staff made YamYam my favorite place we ate during our trip. Friend ordered two types of pasta during our visits and the berry smoothie, she enjoyed all of them :-). Show less

Author: alice3281Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious 👍👍
Review: I just have a simple late lunch at YamYam, it’s satisfied by a simple Hot Latte & Mushroom Aglio Olio. Food served very fast because I’m visited around 4:30pm while they going close at 5pm, and I’m the only customer of them, appreciated that they still welcome me. Served staff or may be its owner of this cafe, who are very friendly as well. Thank you. Show less

Author: brainygal
Title: Yummy curries and pasta
Review: Love the different curries we ordered when we reach Cenang to check into Aloft hotel. The butter chicken, spinach masala chicken, green curry chicken all tasted divine and the aglio olio smoked duck spaghetti was fabulous.

Author: iheart2travel_8Penticton, Canada
Title: Good breakfast
Review: I enjoyed a tasty breakfast of fruit with yogurt and muesli with a ginger kiwi juice. I thought the service was good, the food and drink came quickly. The restaurant was simple and clean. Great menu for breakfast and lunch. Would definitely recommend for breakfast. Looking forward to going back and trying lunch soon.Show less

Author: BaThongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent place for lunch
Review: I return to Langkawi after 22 years and find this restaurant at walking distance from our hotel Aloft. Food is good and pricing is reasonable. They make their own bread and it’s excellent. I have beef rendang with rice. It’s well cooked, not too oily and mild. We will return certainly for another lunch. One thing that we like about the place, they use metal straw, not plastic one.Show less

Author: 422dericlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth to give this place a try
Review: Expectation is high going into this cafe for my coffee fix.The latte is good which satisfies my thirst. Haha. Ordered a pancake with caramalised bananas which is a bit too sweet to my liking, but still acceptable.Also tried the chicken sandwich. The bread was a bit too hard and i must say it is quite huge. The chicken filling is okay.Overall i give this cafe 7/10 and worth a try. Enjoy folks.Show less

Author: ElenaC1788
Title: Good option
Review: Best coffe in town. Very good salad and western food. Nice atmosphere. Good service. Enjoyed everything.

Author: Irma V
Title: Dutch owner
Review:
Great place with very friendly and caring owners.
Very clean for Malasyan standards. They even serve bitterballs, special dutch treat. Only open for lunch and breakfast. They close at 5pm

Author: 770marthad
Title: You’re gonna want to go back!
Review: Enjoyed a yummy breakfast. Spinach and feta omelet was divine! Make sure you get an order of the homemade raisin toast. Retuned the next day for a treat. You MUST HAVE the coconut milkshake!

Author: santtuli
Title: Good breakfast
Review: We went there for breakfast a couple times. Staff was friendly and the breakfast and drinks were tasty.

Author: uksproutBiggleswade, United Kingdom
Title: Brunch
Review: My wife and I had late breakfast three times. We tried a couple of 'local' restaurants for breakfast but they were consistently poor. Depends on personal taste.We found the Yam Yam to be all that we wanted. Great food, drinks, decor, ambiance and really great service. Yes, it has a more European feel than others, but 'in a good way'. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend it.Show less

Author: 470ccBenidorm, Spain
Title: Defo one of the best!!!
Review: One of the best places I’ve eating on Langkawi. I had homemade muesli, fresh orange and peppermint tea. I’m am such a fusspot!! But this totally lived up to my expectation. We came the next day and it was shut!! It was Tuesday the only day it closes. Show less

Author: Lipsock
Title: Best Breakfast
Review: Close to large hotels, this restaurant is only open for breakfast and lunch. But the service and standard of food is amazing. Very good alternative to hotel buffets. Run by Dutch people, they serve an excellent Western breakfast choice and amazing coffee too. Thoroughly recommend.

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Good lunch
Review: We had been out on a charter boat during the morning and stopped off at Yam Yam for a spot of lunch. I had the egg sandwich which had egg, salad, cheese and delicious home made bread roll. Fresh orange juice accomplished the lunch off. One had a Thai green curry, my wife Spiced Pumpkin soup. Others had a burger or two had Bruscetta, one with mushrooms and the other Smoked Salmon. All enjoyed their food and I am told.they do the best poached eggs on the island. Well recommendedShow less

Author: YingYingOH
Title: Good fill up after island hopping tour !
Review: Great western food - aglio, sandwiches - and also Asian green curry, and make sure you save some space for smoothies, desserts and coffee ! Be prepared to pay some. With plants all around, the environment put us at ease and cozy all at once. Will be back next time we come back to the islandShow less

Author: ShellK8487
Title: Yummy!
Review: This cafe is great for any meal although it closes at 5. My partner loved the coffee there. It had a very relaxed vibe. I had the chicken sandwich it was very tasty. I'll be back!

Author: CEL97
