Title: Delicious food in a cosy environment with friendly hosts
Review:
Good food! Try their cream sauce pasta and brownies - yummylicious!
Mid range price
Friendly hosts too!!

Author: Ciaran85Belfast, United Kingdom
Title: Forget Starbucks best coffee in Langkawi
Review: Came here for lunch with my partner, I had cafe latte to start which made my day! I then had the prawn curry (very spicy) and my partners had the chicken sandwich both tasted brilliantly. On the downside I only had three prawns in my curry. Prices were very reasonable. Overall I’d give it 9/10Show less

Author: yankoh92
Title: Amazing food!
Review: Came here with a group of 6 people. We ordered pastas (smoked duck carbonara is a must-try!!) and their Buccaneer Burger was great 😋 Highly recommended!

Author: saraheV90YZ
Title: Tasty!
Review:
I went there for breakfast, had the eggs Benedict, fresh fruits and a coffee. 
Everything was delicious.

Author: KhaiLingLai
Title: Tasty and friendly!
Review: I happened to stay at the hotel just right beside this cafe and I’m really glad to find it. Had their chef’s recommended Beef Bolognese Pasta. The portion was very big and rich! It tasted like homemade pasta. The staffs and the owners were very friendly. Definitely coming back! Too bad that they close at 5pm. I think I’m gonna have earlier dinner for the next few days of my trip.Show less

Author: SengYPJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: My family and I visited twice in a 4 day visit in Langkawi. My kids love the food and wish the shop is available at our town. I suggest to try on the buttered masaka chicken and also the smoked duck aglio olio. I wouldn't say it is a budget meal but it is a normal western meal charges in Malaysia. Ambience of the restaurant was of a cosy cafe style. Show less

Author: 150pippanManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great find!
Review: Ate here for breakfast three times and also for lunch. Staff were great, food fresh and delicious. We worked our way through all of the juices made fresh every day. Definitely worth a visit during your trip to Langkawi. If they were open in the evenings we might not have left Show less

Author: daniv779The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Western style fresh food
Review: We had the watermelon salad and a burger and they were both delicious. Reasonably priced, unfortunately the waitress seemed to be fairly uninterested but the rest of the staff was very friendly. I think the fresh juice drinks were a bit pricy but I have to be fair, they we're very niceShow less

Author: sarahoward2
Title: Really good breakfast on langkawi
Review: Came here twice during our stay. Kind, attentive staff and delicious eggs benny selections. Prices about 20-30MYR for good portions and variety of breakfast options. If you’re looking for an authentic western breakfast treat, look no further.

Author: Sebastian G
Title: Delicious food at a reasonable price!
Review: I had the pulled beef brisket BBQ burger which was excellent. Came with an enormous serving of fries. The iced cappuccino was one of the best iced coffees I've had on the island.Wife had fresh made apple juice and creamy pesto pasta with prawns. All were delicious. Her only complaint was that we're were only 4 prawns but at least there was plenty of creamy pesto!Bill for BBQ beef burger, iced cappuccino, fresh apple juice and creamy pesto prawn pasta came to less than 100 RM. Show less

Author: Q9865BEmichaelr
Title: Excellent
Review: Delicious western cafe style food especially the pulled beef brisket burger. Friendly service and very reasonable prices.

Author: scottl523
Title: Good coffee and breakfast
Review: My wife and I are searching for good coffee places in Langkawi, and this was one of the places that showed up on our radar. We came here for breakfast. Wife had something like a big breakfast (toast, beans, sausages, bacon, eggs) and I had the smoked salmon eggs benedict. Both were good, and portions are nice and filling. As expected, coffee was nicely done - aromatic, nicely presented coffee art (I got 2 - one was a rosetta, and the other with a heart). Wife had an orange juice which was freshly squeezed. Owner was very friendly - learnt from her that the place set up for 2 years now, but recently suffered a drop in business due to increased taxes on Chinese tourist. The location isnt in the primest of area, but I found it a good spot to chill, and spend a quiet morning having breakfast and a good cuppa - afterall with Grab, how hard / unaffordable is it to get to places these days ;)Highly recommended place!Show less

Author: Richard B
Title: Hearty, homemade food that reminded me of home. Excellent.
Review: Tried the spaghetti bolognese, porridge, tomato soup and carrot cake during our stay. Hearty, homemade food that reminded me of home. Excellent.

Author: asada527
Title: Great atmosphere,hosts & coffee
Review: Had coffee poached eggs & toast. My wife had a juice and brownie with coconut ice cream. Nice neat place, very polite and caring people who serve and welcoming owners. Will visit again for sure.

Author: Vauny1980
Title: Western Food
Review: Was good western food, not heaps of local cuisine on the menu, and found it to be quite pricey in comparison to many other restaurants on the Island. We had sandwiches and the mushroom bruscetta, which was delicious. Only open 9-5pm. Not open for dinner

Author: W7869VRkatiep
Title: Yummy!
Review: Found this cafe on trip advisor. The atmosphere is chilled and the decor inside is lovely! It has outdoor and indoor seating. The coffee is really nicely presented and tasted great, really good quality! We all ordered the eggs Benedict which was very tasty.

Author: Tourist711938
Title: Yummy
Review:
I would visit this restaurant 
When i come Langkawi again ~~~
Food was good taste and good service!!!

Author: spelaserbinek
Title: Good but pricey
Review: We had two fresh juices, the cheesy beach boy and chicken sandwich. It was all delicious, but a little bit pricey. The ambient and staff are nice.

Author: TriStupeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It’s alright
Review: Nice quiet cafe by road of Pantai Tengah. Serves home cooked/made food by an expat family. Very decent quality and good atmosphere. Pricing for local is on the higher side so it caters mainly for tourists with stronger exchange rates. Typically priced average of RM20 (USD5) for a breakfast without drinks (which average about RM10 or USD2.50). Taste is good and portion commendable - not for hungry eater!Show less

Author: KaterinaSydney
Title: Possibly the best coffee in Langkawi
Review: We ate here a few times, mostly for breakfast and for afternoon coffee so we are not able to rate lunch meals. Coffee was always good, I believe the best from all the places we had the chance to try from. Nice little croissants and fruit bowls with muesli. Awesome homemade brownie! On top of that, very nice staff and owners!Show less

Author: subhoshreerMumbai, India
Title: The better bite
Review: The yamyam restaurant is run by an amazing couple. The best thing about the place is the arrangement. Small tables, candles, small show pieces give complete different look to the place during night. The morning breakfast is scrumptious with wide varieties of menu. I am a latte person when it comes to coffee and yamyam restaurant served one of the best coffee to me during my stay at Langkawi. The cafe is just beside the T Star cottage and so it was very easy for us to access the cafe during our stay at the cottage. A complete breakfast is what you need to start your day and deliver your best. They served the desirable on the table. I highly recommend yamyam for their services, varieties and hospitality.Show less

Author: 980duaneu
Title: Good Eggs Benny
Review: I ordered the vegy eggs benny which were very good but I’ve had better hollandaise sauce at other places.  The side of hash browns was cold. The coffee latte was excellent. All in all a bit pricey, no real savings by eating here.

Author: SeowHuiG
Title: Great food made with love
Review: My husband and I shared a prawn aglio olio and salmon bruschetta (home-made bread!) We thoroughly enjoyed our meal that Lady Boss Soraya made with love and passion.

Author: ericvancoffee
Title: Best Coffee on Langkawi!
Review: We had breakfast there and it was just amazing. Jazzy music, nice atmosphere and great coffee. The smoothies are were tasty and  everything is reasonable priced. Also the waiter can speak perfectly English! I recommend to go there!

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful
Review: When you are interested in a nice , Delicious Breakfast or Lunch ?It's a must to go there !Because of a special taste of Sorayas Kitchen ! She cook with her Heart and Love about Details ingredients .And a Great Service from Jaap and Harris Thank you! Show less

Author: jpsquareSacramento, California
Title: A very solid 4.5 for breakfast and lunch.
Review: Breakfast high points were homemade sourdough brown bread toast, chorizo like sausage and the good muddy style Malay coffee. Owner/chef skilled and provides artful and tasty fresh dishes. Everything was good and had its own interpretation. Indoor seating with air a plus. Big brekki is huge. Had a wonderful light but crusty topped walnut brownie.. Best in years. Show less

Author: monethetripper
Title: Best coffee on the island
Review: Not a tag I’d offer lightly but they do have a Marzoca coffee machine if that means anything to you. More western food than I would have liked so I had the rendang which was ok.

Author: soufianm689
Title: Amazing juice
Review: Had breakfast at YamYam twice. It was a good experience and especially the juice Berry Blast was amazing. Defenitely a must order when you are here!!

Author: Steph N
Title: Highly recommend
Review: Delicious breakfast with fresh and good quality ingredients, clean setting, friendly staff. Great coffee! We had the pancakes and fruit bowl, and both were great. Best breakfast we have found in Langkawi, we will be back.

Author: wendyk621Seattle, Washington
Title: Great Spot for A Late Lunch
Review: We read good reviews of this cafe, not too far from our hotel, so decided to go for a late lunch. We shared the chicken salad, definitely big enough for two (which my husband liked more than me because the chicken meat was mostly dark meat, which I do not like) and the pumpkin soup—rich, creamy, came with homemade bread. And we each got a coconut milkshake that was fantastic. Clean, AC, nicely decorated, we left very happy. Wish they were open for dinner!Show less

Author: CurlymikeTPerth, Australia
Title: Lovely lunch
Review: Restaurant was located across the road from our hotel and we had a very very nice lunch here. Prawn pesto pasta and pulled beef burger, both excellent. Good quality food - with the owners and chef all taking a good interest in providing the good food.Show less

Author: k0butKlang, Malaysia
Title: Cosy but expensive
Review: We had breakfast recently during our visit in April 2018. The price is so expensive and the portion is not big. We had to consider buying one meal and share for two. It's important to check out the menu card and the price at the entrance before going in. I got mistaken that the review was given for cheap eateries but actually it's not the case.Show less

Author: Stormy_SA
Title: Absolutely lovely
Review: Went back multiple times for breakfast and lunch. Love the attention to detail in all the dishes i tried!

Author: Luke427
Title: Just awesome
Review: They looked after my friends and I while on holiday last week with some fantastic food and service. We really loved the breakfasts and went back multiple times. Great friendly staff. So so good, thank you!!!

Author: tracyy543
Title: Nice and Cosy cafe
Review: The place is very nice, child friendly. Boss is nice and will come to table to take the feedback of the food. Food is nice too, smoothie is fresh and healthy.

Author: 1001-tastesMexico
Title: YamYam Breakfast!
Review: Their Butterscotch apple pancakes are YamYam as well as their Spaghetti Bolognaise (but there are better places for Spaghetti in Langkawi, see our other reviews). Their coffee is most likely the best on the Island! The staff/owner are really friendly. The prices are on the upper end of the range.Show less

Author: tomtD1632UGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beyond amazing
Review: What a place! The food was spectacular as everyone on the island had told us it would be. Having got their too late twice we were determined to get there before 4:30pm. The local food was great with the staff being really helpful to explain dishes. Plus they use reusable straws and make excellent smoothies — what’s not to love! Show less

Author: ErikaEindhoven
Title: Good quality food and friendly service
Review: We had lunch here and I had a really good spaghetti aglio e olio with smoked duck; it was really delicious! They also serve a typical Dutch snack; home made Bitterballen which is worth to try.

Author: anitac890Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food. Friendly service.
Review: Pulled beef burger was a huge meal and mega tasty. They were happy to make my Thai green curry veggie and it was packed full of fresh veg. They split a tuna pasta to 2 small plates for my children. Great salads. All in all very tasty. Very impressed that they use metal straws. Well done yam yam. Highly recommend. Show less

Author: 703shellr
Title: Great olace
Review: Friends recommended this place having visited often. I have to agree. Great food, lovely service and love, love, love that they used metal straws. Appreciate the lack of wasteful rubbish. Had the eggs Benedict which was delicious and a green goddess smoothies - yum!!!

Author: Jessica R
Title: Worst establishment I have come across in Southeast Asia
Review: This morning I attended this establishment with my husband to have some breakfast. We both ordered poached eggs. When breakfast was served my husband was given 2 poached eggs on toast. I was served 2 partially poached eggs, completely raw inside. I called a member of staff and politely explained that the eggs were raw and I have recently been ill with a stomach bug, so was not able to eat raw eggs. The member of staff tried to explain to me in a patronising manner that poached eggs are essentially raw eggs. We come from the UK. Anyone who knows what a poached egg is knows that is not a raw egg. The member of staff, a male who might have been the owner, then told me: "don't get sick" and then left the raw eggs on my plate, refusing to give me some actual poached eggs. My husband ate his breakfast and went onto pay. As if the treatment I’d received wasn’t already inappropriate, the same member of staff asked my husband if everything was okay with our breakfast. This was obviously sarcasm and further disrespecting. Obviously, he charged us for the eggs (which were taken back to the kitchen without a single bite on them after my husband finished eating his), plus a 10% "service" charge. Having spent the last 3 months travelling SE Asia, I have never come across such bad establishment. If you are a respectful individual who likes to be treated with politeness and respect, I would strongly advised against this establishment. If you do not want to get sick, it is probably a good idea to eat your eggs elsewhere too. It isn't cheap either.Show less

Author: Victoria O
Title: Very good food and good aura 💛
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for a month and fell in love with YamYam first because of their smoothies! Later on we learned that their breakfast is amazing too! If you are looking for a good cup of coffee, their cappuccinos and lattes are great! I also enjoyed the chicken salad very much! Definitely one of the best places in Langkawi! 10/10 would recommend! Show less

Author: Conor RSoham, United Kingdom
Title: Great Breakfast
Review: Nothing but good things to say about YamYams. Me and my girlfriend would eat here every morning for breakfast, we’ve been travelling for a couple of months and our budget is pretty tight but still managed to get a good feed for little expense. The service was always quick and friendly. Would recommend. Show less

Author: Nicola163
Title: Best breakfast in Malaysia!
Review: We had a breakfast with family this morning. The food was delicious!  Best we have tasted in Malaysia. We will definitely be back!

Author: Brooke W
Title: My favourite
Review: I absolutely love this cafe during our stay in Langkawi! Such a relaxed environment and we found the staff lovely and very helpful with any questions regarding the island.I will come back here every single time I visit Langkawi. And having moved on with our travels I’m actually really missing my breakfast at yamyam! Show less

Author: peter wLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Never Failed To Amaze Me
Review: I must say I'm a regular at this little gem simply because their French Onion soup is to die for plus the fact owners Jap and Soraya make u feel at home. Their healthy breakfast and smoothie especially Green Godess add to the list of my favourites. Lately I discovered their Seabass in Pineapple sauc. Simply delicious. Show less

Author: DaniPrice1980
Title: Lovely breakfast!
Review:
If you're missing an English breakfast you must come here! Lovely food, reasonably priced, with lots of options. And the staff were excellent, polite and friendly. 

Highly recommended if you're in Langkawi

Author: 356S-1
Title: Lovely as always
Review: We went to YamYam again tonight and the food was delicious. Service was really friendly and fast. Their chocolate brownie is seriously good! We will definitely be back.

Author: 840justinask
Title: Great alternative for Asian cuisine
Review:
When you miss ribeye steak, chicken salads, meatballs, various types of pasta - visit this place! Smoothies and fresh juices (especially Kiwi Zing) are outstanding! Service is in the highest level.
Highly recommended place!

Author: carlsahnLisbon, Portugal
Title: Yum Yum
Review: Ran by incredibly friendly folks with even better food, Yam Yam is a great place to go for breakfast, lunch and dinner alike!We had all three meals their during our stay in Langkawi, and I'd highly recommend their smoothies above those at other places on the island. Their breakfast is refreshingly well made, with their omelette being the highlight of our table!Show less

Author: 1Travelled_the_worldQinzhou, China
Title: Must eat here
Review: 12 months ago, my wife and I went to our favourite café only to find that it had turned into a restaurant under new ownership. That place became our favourite restaurant. It was perfect, the service was great as was the food. The owners were extremely helpful and very polite. They always had time to chat with their customers, explain the menu and suggest choices that went together. It really was perfect! However, 12 months later we returned only to find that it is possible to improve on PERFECT. This year was an even better experience than last year. The food continues to be incredible. I discovered new tastes and new culinary experiences. The Hosts are both incredible people. They work tirelessly to make sure their customers are always happy. The number of times I heard customers complimenting them on the food was amazing, and to a man they all said we’ll be back. My wife and I ate there twice a day for a month. The consistency of the food alone ensured we kept going back, but what really does it for us is the cleanliness, efficiency of the staff and congeniality of the hosts. No matter how busy they are they always take the time to ask if everything is to your satisfaction, which it always is. If you are looking for somewhere to really enjoy a great meal with great tastes and great hosts Yamyam is the place to go.Show less

Author: mfletcher09
Title: Excellent breakfast option
Review: Really enjoyed our breakfast here. Enjoyed seeing flat whites on the menu and enjoyed the caramelized banana pancakes, eggs benedict with salmon and the tropical fruit bowl. Great service and atmosphere. Two thumbs up!

Author: magbillSingaporesingapore
Title: Once is not enough !
Review: We have been to this cafe & restaurant three times during our visit to Langkawi recently. It's just opposite the Holiday Villa Spa & Resort that we stayed in for seven nights during the Chinese New Year 2018 period. The name of the place and sign board attracted us to check it out. One evening we came in to have dinner. The place is very cosy and welcoming. All the staff were very attentive and warm. We took the Halibut fish & chips as recommended and the Masala Prawns. The food were really great and we enjoyed ourselves. Also we had iced Cappuccino and iced Latte. They came with metal straws ( going green no plastic ones ). To finish up the evening, we had a generous serving of three scoops of ice cream........yummy !!!. Needless to say, we were back at breakfast to try their famous banana pancakes and the Works Breakfast. In the evening we were back again after a seafood dinner to have our fill of dessert and drinks. Those visiting the beach area should not give this wonderful place a miss. The lady boss is very friendly and introduce us the eco-friendly tours run by her brother. We have kept in mind this for our next visit to Langkawi. Cheers to the staff of Yam Yam Cafe & Restaurant. All the best to you.Show less

Author: rigall2016
Title: Breakfast on monday
Review: Excellent european breakfast, fresh orange juice and muesli - home made - plus yoghurt. Good service as well, quite quick compared to what we observed here usually. Good place to know.

Author: Kate M
Title: Great for Breakfast!
Review: Really nice for breakfast, had mango pancakes they were really nice! My friends who are vegan lacked some options but they enjoyed the homemade hashbrowns

Author: esme195Yelverton, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: When found this restaurant a day after we arrived and went every morning for breakfast with another couple from Uk just perfect reasonbly god price the other side the street from our hotel in Pentai. the food and service was great friendly the cafe( Rest) clean tidy the fresh fruit bread ect lovely. highly recommend eating there our only regret was just did not manage to get there for dinner thank you.Show less

Author: KristenDaria
Title: Just eat your food & go!
Review:
Food are subjective to taste, but the husband & wife owners have extremely nasty higher-than-thou attitudes.

If dining here somehow is a must for you, best to skip any conversation with the couple... even if the question is on “How is the food.”

Author: Peter G
Title: Lovely food!
Review: Nice place to have lunch or dinner! Tastefull food and good prices. I can recommend this place to everyone! Just try👌

Author: anjaH444Adelaide, Australia
Title: Wonderful food!
Review: We went to YamYam a few times during our stay, sometimes just for a drink. We decided to eat here on Christmas day as we had been before and enjoyed the food. I ordered the ribeye steak and it was cooked to perfection, I loved it! Both the Western food and the Asian cuisine are equally good here. The presentation is like what you expect in an upmarket hotel, this is a definite recommend from me!Show less

Author: dinouggylondon
Title: Disappointing :(
Review: Went here for lunch after reading all of the reviews saying the freshness and cheapness is great. So we headed in everything being average 30rm plus service charge. We both had a sandwich for 28rm, no salad, no fries, 28 to me is a little steep especially in tengah. The bread was clearly a store bought baguette that has been warmed up and far from ‘fresh bread’ advertised on the menu. It had no flavour and it was so soggy. Our bill came to 70rm for two english breakfast teas and two sandwiches. Owned by a westerner so obviously knows what hes doing. Sits there and count out the money so slowly so we just go ‘keep the change’NO i want my change, you have your service charge for your over priced food. Woods bar down the road has more choice, better service, cheaper food, better food and no service charge. Langkawi is not what it used to be anymore :( Show less

Author: nadzirjamalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Dining Experience In Langkawi
Review: Everyone visiting Langkawi should do themselves a favor and head to YamYam for a meal. Decent value for money with a wide-ranging selection of dishes on top of friendly staff, you could do no better here. Everything Soraya makes is delicious, but i HIGHLY recommend either the seabass or the lamb's shanks. Emphasis on the latter. You won't regret it..Show less

Author: 391craigh
Title: Nice dinner
Review: Highly recommended. We had watermelon salad, spaghetti bolenese, seafood pasta. All very well done. And the house wine is $3/glass. Delicious!

Author: Tricia E
Title: Best coffee in Langkawi
Review:
Amazing coffee and fresh smoothies. 

Love the extensive menu, the friendliness of the owners and staff. Good choice for breakfast, lunch or dinner

Author: SoniaHromadova
Title: Amazing food, really yam yam
Review: We order prawns pesto pasta and prawns masala. Both food was amazing. We enjoy it so much. Nice, clean area with friendly staffs and jazz music. Price is little higher then we expect but fine. Pasta for RM28. Must try

Author: LexypipHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Awesome food!! A definite must!
Review: We found this restaurant up from our hotel. The food was brilliant value as was the wine and beer! I had the the roasted chicken salad which was mouth-wateringly good! My partner had the egg-mayo sandwich which was huge but wonderful! The service was friendly and very welcoming, which always makes the experience so worthwhile! We will definitely be back for breakfast, lunch or dinner during our stay in Langkawi. So chuffed to have found this little gem.Show less

Author: Zoran S
Title: A smile on the face and a wery good brownie
Review: Yam yam is right by the main street, but the atmosfhere is nice and people are really welcoming. The food was good, but the main attraction was definately the brownie.

Author: ariels435
Title: Holidayyyy
Review: The ambience is good. We went there for two days for breakfast and lunch. It was surely worth it. The food tasted good,although it is a bit pricey. Would surely recommend this place.

Author: FwksmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best dinner in Langkawi
Review: We read quite abit about the food, ambience, service and we were curious about this place. Met our expectations and more! Pumpkin soup is flavorful. Smoked Duck carbonara has a good blend of savory and sweet taste and it does not just whet your appetite, and is quite addictive.Pesto prawn has sauce well blended and is quite different from the usual nutty blend. While I asked for chilli flakes, the server recommended that I try chilli padi instead. It was a spicy twist to a creamy sauce. Nice! The pana cotta was refreshing and the fruit sauce was yummy! Place was neat and decor added to the relaxed feel. Great service too - attentive and yet not intrusive. Chef was generous in sharing how she does her pumpkin soup and even recommended where to get coconut oil. Overall a great dining experience without hurting the pocket! Show less

Author: Mathias B
Title: Excellent service and food
Review: I’ve dagen Both breakfast and dinner for a couple of days now, and the service has just been outstanding everytime, while the food has also been super good!

Author: Tania L
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: Went there with hard to please 7yr old and 80 year old parents. Food was awesome. Loved the French onion soup, lamb shanks and Baileys dessert. Will go back again before we leave.

Author: ZBROSECosta Mesa, California
Title: Amazing food, but don't try to work from here!
Review: We visited YamYam today for breakfast after reading numerous rave reviews of the food- it is a little off the main stretch of Pantai Cenang so we rented a motorbike for the day just to get to this place. We haven't been very impressed with fresh food options around Pantai Cenang so far and YamYam was such a breath of fresh air! We ordered a flat white and a long black, as well as a Summer Scent Juice (watermelon and pineapple) - all were wonderfully delicious and well done (so nice to find great coffee finally!!). The food was also worth the visit- we ordered the butterscotch apple pancakes and the tropical fruit bowl with yogurt and granola and a side of eggs. All were fantastic and we LOVED our dining experience. We are full time travel bloggers and work from our laptops, so the quiet, relaxing atmosphere and fast wifi were a dream- but when we had finished our meal and asked if it was possible to move inside for a power outlet, the owners let us know that they "were running a restaurant, not an Internet cafe", and said that use of power outlets wasn't allowed. After our so-far lovely experience it was quite the way to leave Yam Yam! We understand when restaurants have this policy while busy or for people who do not order food, but we ate a full meal with 3 drinks and planned to order food for lunch as well (Since we loved the food so much), and there was only 1 or 2 other tables occupied and a nearly empty cafe. If you're a digital nomad like us, be warned that this is not a work-friendly cafe. We didn't see any no-laptop signs or anything like that, so perhaps they could benefit from that, but for the food alone this place is worth the visit.Show less

Author: Austin L
Title: Lunch and drinks
Review: Was just a fantastic experience from start to finish. The food was spectacular (smoked duck carbonara - highly recommended), and our waiter Rock was a legend. Chatted to us about local culture, national progression and anything else we were interested in knowing. Cant speak highly enough of his level of service. We will go back just to ensure we support this businessShow less

Author: Aussie_Greg_FMalaysia
Title: Excellent food and relaxed casual atmosphere
Review: Breakfast lunch or dinner is all covered. The menu is not large but well thought out. The food is obviously cooked by someone who loves cooking. We have been in Langkawi 3 days and found the food venues disappointing. As expats living in Malaysia we are well aquainted with the local foods. We have been very disappointed in the quality of the food here until we found Yam Yam. The staff are well trained and friendly, the drinks are good (a "real" coffee machine for a great latte!) And our meals even arrive at the same time! How often does that not happen in Asia!? It's a cafe restaurant so do not expect fine dining, but it is easily a cut or 2 above anywhere else we have been here. Show less

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Must to go there when you are in Langkawi
Review: The Yam Yam Restaurant in Langkawi , Pantai Tenga .It's a must ! To visit and have some Breakfast , Lunch or Dinner !The Reason is . First , you want feel a very warm welcome! Second you are very Happy about the Food ! Because the Owner cook by he self with her heart and soul !The Staff want celebrate your Dishes and very good fresh Juice or also cold Beer and a very good Wines ...And the Owner like to come to your Table for a nice Hello and talking !You have a wonderful feeling you are really Welcome to this Place .I can Recommend the Sea bass , the Steak , or Thai Green Curry also his Spaghetti . The Owner cook all every Meal by her own and FRESH !See you again! Show less

Author: Annick J
Title: Not what I expected
Review: Since I’ve read all the reviews on tripadvisor, my expectations where pretty high. Service and atmophere are good. But the food was a big disappointment. A had the red curry prawn. There was more oil in it than anything else. The flavour was blend. And it had 4 shrimps that had to be peeled as well. Not to mention the size of the boil. Was still hungry, and there was nothing really small to pick from the menu besides bruschetta. So I went with the mushroom bruschetta. The bread was really soft. (I mean, bruschetta?!) the mushrooms where baked well, but the sour cream didn’t do it for me. The coffee is way to bitter and the milk far to hot. If you want to make a proper latte (wich you pay for as well) please know what youre doing. The wine is good, so was the watermelon salad. Show less

Author: obxmiriBogota, Colombia
Title: Sea Bass with pineapple sauce is delicious
Review: Our hotel is just a few meters down and we read about YamYam on TripAdvisor. I had the fish with pineapple sauce . It was absolutely delicious. Very fresh with fresh salad and fried yummy potatoes.My husband had the Thai green curry which he also liked . Staff was friendly and everything very clean . In fact you can watch the grill if you like . The variety of dishes is not massive but better less in better quality. Pasta and Dutch meatballs are also on the menu. Guess the owner is Dutch . Would definitely go back for the pineapple sauce and the fresh fish . We have been told they get it from a local single fisherman which whom they support . Show less

Author: pssandra
Title: Great food
Review:
My 1st time in the restaurant and the food is 'Excellent' !
Great value for money with superb service.!

Author: Russell N
Title: Best breakfast we had.
Review: We stayed at the nearby Holiday Villas. This was by far the tastiest breakfast around. the manager made us feel welcome and the staff were very attentive and friendly.

Author: ikarrtiniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food,superb service and lovely ambience
Review: My favourite is Soraya's Dutch meat balls with apple sauce.Not too heavy just right for me! My son's favourite is their lamb shanks tender and yummy.Hosts are friendly and caring that we have now become friends. Away from the hustle bustle of Cenang which I like. Decor cosy and stylishShow less

Author: Wayne D
Title: Great quality, service and environment
Review: This place is known for the quality of it's food and we weren't disappointed. Run by an expat couple with super friendly local staff it was a great place to take shelter from the midday sun!

Author: Yeow LPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great food and service
Review: This was a surprise discovery along pantai cenang. Food here is excellent. Prices are reasonable and affordable. The smoked duck meat carbonara was tasty and the mushroom aglio olio was excellent. We also tried the pumpkin coconut soup which was a thick broth with an unusual blend of pumpkin and coconut. The dutch meatballs were really good too. We enjoyed our first meal so much, we went back again before leaving the island. Do book a table if your group is big as the seating is limited.Show less

Author: tomskovich
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: The food is great and the personnel is very nice and helpful. If you haven’t tried the bitterballs you should really try them! And that’s coming from a dutch guy who’s tried them a lot. Absolutely recommend visiting this restaurant.

Author: Valerie P
Title: Excellent service!!
Review: I came for lunch, and even though I do not consider this place as a cheap eat like tripadvisor has it classified, the food was great, and the staff was absolutely amazing. So helpful, that I even had the barister himself explain to me for 5 minutes the differences between a latte and flat white in a super funny way and ended up drinking a very good quality coffee, because they really cared that I drunk what I expected.10/10 for customer service!!Show less

Author: YenSzeL1
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Excellent food and great service. Loved everything that we ordered - entree, mains and dessert.  Not cheap but reasonably priced for the portion and taste.

Author: FClemente
Title: Delicious restaurant !
Review:
We took breakfast and dinner several times in this cozy and delicious restaurant during our stage in Langkawi . 
The owners are friendly and welcoming. Everything is delicious and very well cooked. I strongly advise!

Author: johnryan195
Title: Lovely meal
Review: The restaurant itself is lovely and clean. The staff were so nice and very accommodating. I had the pumpkin soup which was so tasty and had a red curry after. I was so full I couldn't finish it but it was very tasty. Would recommend!

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Very warm welcome and good service
Review: The yam yam restaurant is a very popular place to sit there and enjoy your food and drinks . The Owners very friendly . The Staff give you a Great Service and the Chef. And good delicious food .Yam Yam Restaurant is a must to go there when you are in Langkawi .Show less

Author: Philippa M
Title: Excellent food and lovely staff!
Review: I had such a lovely evening at Yam Yam, the food was really tasty and the staff were so polite and friendly. I would definitely recommend this for a visit!

Author: sinners82
Title: Great Coffee
Review: Went here for breakfast, service was really quick, coffee was great and the French toast was amazing. Will be returning.

Author: oreostacey88Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Best Coffee in Langkawi
Review: This place is a must visit when in Langkawi. We stumbled across it on our first night on the island. We had a delicious pasta, fresh salad and garlic bread.The next morning we went back to try the coffee and also had some breakfast, the coffee was the best we have had on the island and have been back since.The owner and staff are very friendly and accomodating and the food and drinks are well priced. Would highly recommend this place!!Show less

Author: Levi V
Title: Coffee
Review: Delicious coffee, incredible food, very fresh. The staff at yam yam are extremely friendly and speak great English. Best real coffee we had in Langkawi.

Author: robwI8024XFSouth Yarra, Australia
Title: Great place - not to be missed
Review: Six years ago we spent 2 weeks in Langkawi and had breakfast or lunch every day at a cafe called Troppo. We returned this year to find it was no more and was now YamYam. And again, it was our venue for breakfast or lunch most days, and the odd dinner.The food and service are superb. The pancakes are amazing, plain or with caramelised banana, butterscotch apples or grilled mango. The tropical fruit bowl with yoghurt and muesli is huge. The poached eggs are cooked just right and served with home made bread toast. Amazing salads and curries. And the coffee - about the best I've had anywhere, not just in Langkawi.Show less

Author: 418russelld
Title: Good Coffee
Review: We have been to a different cafe for breakfast each day and this has been the nicest. Poached eggs and hash brown, just need to toast the bread longer. Best coffee by a mile. Closed on Tuesdays.

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Little Cozy Cafe
Review: Had a late lunch here with friend ordering Dutch Meatball, Aglio Olio and Soraya Garden Salad. Dutch Meatball itself is dry but by dipping it into the apple sauce it taste excellent. Oh yeah not forgetting the sauteed potato is good. (Ordered a mashed potatoes but it came wrong. The man was kind that offered to change but I refused. Sauteed potato is good!) Spaghetti was okay. Soraya Garden salad itself is special with lettuce, raisins, olives, corn, mangoes, hard boiled eggs, sunflower seeds and vinaigrette. Show less

Author: Charlotte WBarcelona, Spain
Title: Bad food
Review: Staff were nice enough we ordered spaghetti Bolognese which was ok. Garlic bread and chicken pesto pasta food was quick heard the microwave a few times! Chicken was awful chewy and a grey colour ate it without the chicken as was very hungry and didn't want to make a fuss. Service charge was added to the bill of 10% which in England is optional, we did not want to pay as I was unhappy with my meal. Asked if we had to pay and was told yes you do and laughed! Would never visit here again. Show less

Author: 734andrewnBath, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: A little out of the way but definitely worth going to.The best croissants my Father has had on the island in the past 15 years.Delicious green curry, generous roast chicken submarine and salt beef on sourdough and a rendang washed down with Tiger beer and various fresh juices.Show less

Author: F1287PPandrews
Title: Great place
Review: I had breakfast here and did some work 😬there too on the laptop. Super friendly staff and owners. Oats and croissant and tea fabulous will be heading back tomorrow 😄

Author: Geeske v
Title: Super!!
Review: Excellent lunch with great salad, wallnuts, and bitterballen! Wine served by the glass (or bottle). Nice owner, and wife. Regards Geeske (Doesburg, the Netherlands)

Author: Sandra M
Title: Late lunch
Review: Nice cosy place. The staff and owner of the place are so friendly. Tbe resturant closes at 6pm and we were not fone with lunch but they told us to relax and enjoy the meal.The food was excellent. The Bitterballs are the best I have ever had. Show less

Author: Pat B
Title: Best Coffee
Review:
Really good cafe for morning coffee and breakfast.
Best coffee on island  prepared by trained barista.
Friendly staff and nice ambience.

Author: Chews97Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: Food preparation was terrible, I've ordered a creamy pesto pasta and my wife ordered an aglio olio.The wife aglio olio was bad, pasta over cooked, garlic still whitish and raw, seem to be blanched in oil and boiled pasta water, tasteless and disappointing for such price. There were even parmesan cheese powder given for the dish, which is ....My pesto(which should be hard to fail) turns out bad as well, not much taste of pine nuts more of a sauce just created to suit the color.The prawns were rather fresh though. Show less

Author: Choccylove
Title: Love their breakfast smoothies
Review: So nice to stumble upon this place on our first morning in Langkawi. Love Malaysian food but unfortunately not a fan of their breakfasts,so it was really good to find a Western breakfast option that was very reasonably priced. The tropical fruit, muesli and yoghurt bowl is an absolute winner And they have these amazing smoothies as well. I tried the Green Goddess and it so yummy. Staff are lovely and the food came out quickly..definitely coming back again Show less

Author: 519amieb
Title: Lovely breakfast
Review: Visited yam yam twice whilst staying in the bungalows next door. The breakfast was very tasty and the lady who owns the restaurant is lovely. She also gave us some helpful advice on how to get to our next destination. Loved the mugs as well

Author: Tresna W
Title: Pleasantly surprised
Review: The rolls here are a perfect size and very fresh. Pumpkin soup was also very nice. Free wifi available.

Author: millieWa
Title: Breakfast
Review: Had a good breakfast with the highlight the juices. The owner has a good selection of smoothies also including non dairy options! I enjoyed eggs benedict also. Clean, western style cafe. Has wifi.

Author: Oliver WBerkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!!
Review: My girlfriend and I decided to try out Yam Yam and it was the best restaurant in the whole of south east Asia! The staff are super friendly and the food is delicious!I would recommend the butter tikka masala and the Thai green curry. They also do a fantastic breakfast which is bound to fill you up. Show less

Author: plxen
Title: Great coffee and hangout spot
Review: The coffee here is really good. Environment is perfect for chilling with friends. We had pesto pasta and spaghetti aglio olio. Both were delicious however the aglio olio felt a bit lacking of ingredients.

Author: Chris M
Title: Breakfast - with real coffee!
Review: Great little cafe, with real milk coffee. Hard to get any around this area at all. Reasonable prices, great service. Has indoor ac or outside sitting area. Recommend for a great full breakfast. My choice, the "big breakfast" and the eggs Benedict.

Author: phfoong
Title: Good food
Review: Pumpkin soup was very good and creamy. Had the pesto pasta was excellent too. Clean and simple place. However, the prices are slightly higher than expected.

Author: RubiYAYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wrong order, no service recovery
Review: Having read good reviews, we went to YamYam on empty stomachs expecting good food..Partner ordered a burger. Good solid beef burger but nothing to rave about. He did comment that the bun was a bit thick though. No complaints here overall. I ordered the Dutch Bitterballs, a starter of 6 breaded meatballs. Instead, they confused my order with Dutch Meatballs. So I received a large plate with 5 (boiled?) meatballs, a mound of greasy potatoes, some salad and applesauce. Almost double the price (RM31 vs RM18), so much unwanted food, and sadly, SO BLAND. I had to ask multiple staff before they acknowledged the mistake. To be fair, the Lady boss came over and offered to redo the original order but said it would take half an hour. We were hungry n didn't want to make a fuss, so we said never mind, but only realised our error once we started eating because really, everything was SO BLAND!We peppered and peppered, but couldn't save the bland balls, bland potatoes and overly sweet applesauce. Lady Boss came midway to check on us and could see we weren't pleased (and the food was unfinished) but there weren't any further attempts at service recovery. And when the bill came... yep they charged RM31 for the wrong order, instead of RM18 for what we had wanted. I can see this both ways, but as a customer, this is the least I'd have expected them to do to make up for a mistake they acknowledged. can't help but feel a little upset as I tried to be accommodating by not making them redo the order which I can only assume would have resulted in a further loss for them, so really disappointed that this wasn't corrected in the bill of their own initiative. It was actually our wedding anniversary and we didn't want to make a fuss, so just paid and left ... never to return again...Show less

Author: 506beverlyt
Title: Delish breakfast
Review: Am loving this quaint cafe. Food is awesome and friendly service rendered here. Will definitely come back again.

Author: flyhigh_jiyoung
Title: Best pesto and pancake ever.
Review: I visited yesterday and today. We tried prawn pesto and apple pancake with some drinks. You know... pesto is shocking me. Actually, I don't like cream pasta. But I ordered for my friend and I tried pancake. Oh!!! Pancake itself is very tasty. Apply cinnamon and honey, butter are very good balance. Yammy. The green pesto is thumbs up!!! You will regret if you don't order. Today, I ordered bolonege and salad. It was good too. Last but not least, they accept credit card. Show less

Author: ArinaKoshkinaMoscow, Russia
Title: Best pumpkin soup I ever tried
Review: Very nice atmosphere, very clean and neat, a perfect combination of European and Malaysian culture. Was very hungry hence forgot to take a pic of a food itself, some pics of the place below. Great choice for the breakfast as well as lunch in between sun taking timings ☀️☀️☀️☀️☀️ and yes, the pumpkin soup is great here with a gentle Asian touch, very much recommended ❗️ Show less

Author: Carletto2014
Title: Great quality and service
Review:
Very good homemade food, great customer service! Highly recommend fresh juices as well as pumpkin soup!  

A Gourmet!

Author: laiskfons
Title: Good feta omlett and coffee!
Review: My recommendation, stayed next to it in hotel and soon replaced hotel breakfast with YamYam omelettes and smoothies.

Author: mistergq007
Title: Great breakfast or lunch, steps away from the hotel
Review: If you're staying at the Holiday Villa, don't bother with the overpriced buffet breakfast. Instead, go across the street to Yam Yam and enjoy some great coffee, a filling breakfast and welcoming hosts. The Thai green curry and other offerings were excellent.

Author: KiiraAndMikko
Title: Not a great price quality ratio
Review: Passed this nice looking little restaurant many times and finally decided to have breakfast here. Surroundings and service was nice but to our opinion poor selection of breakfast and prices too high.

Author: evaf45
Title: Delicious breakfast with great staff
Review: As the Café was next to our hotel, we went there for breakfast - and returned the next morning, because the food/coffe is delicious!!! In top you get very friendly, relaxed, and happy staff, who also have time for a little chat. If you're looking for a perfect day's start on the island, you definitely have to go there!Show less

Author: X8395YCmariad
Title: A hidden gem
Review: 3. Time in Pantai Cenang and this time with my 17 year old niece and parents. We found this little hidden gem of a restaurant called Yam Yam. We really loved this place and ended up having dinner there several times. The food is top quality so delicius and very fair prices. I will absolutely recommend the green curry and the butter chicken among other delicius chices. The place is small and very cosy. It has a good wifi which my niece loved, and the owners does an excellent job making everyone welcome. We will be back next year:-) Show less

Author: dgloong83Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Excellent smoothies!
Review: Had an enjoyable time here. The staff were friendly and the environment relaxing. A must try is the Cacao Maca Buzz smoothie. It was absolutely delicious and could be considered a meal in itself, kept me going from morning til sunset. The Eggs Benedict was excellent. On hot, scorching days, the Berry smoothie was refreshing and thirst quenching.Show less

Author: vamosjoel
Title: Truly Yammy-licious
Review: Relaxing ambience, good place to hang out and the smoothies will keep you wanting more. They have friendly staff and it's close to the beach. Come for breakfast or lunch or why not both?

Author: peter wLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: A must-visit restaurant
Review: Yam Yam became our instant favourite eatery whilst in Langkawi. It's Egg Benedict with Salmon is simply delish. Their vast menu selection ranges from pancakes to healthy salads and home made breads and cakes. They also have Asian dishes and my fav are Prawn Masala and Buttered Curry Chicken.staff and owners namely Jap and Soraya are very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: richardsT7045MD
Title: Breakfast with friends
Review:
Really good service and very nice food. 
Great for breakfast with nice coffee. Homemade bread added to the quality.
Good service tops it off.

Author: Wallace S
Title: Breakfast
Review: All four of us enjoyed our breakfast and we all had different things,, absolutely beautiful,, well presented ,, fresh produce and very very tasty ,, 100% recommend you must go when your in Langkawi 😜

Author: MrP6LZhengzhou, China
Title: Best dining in Pantai Tengah!
Review: Very nice food. Not for a budget traveller, but if you and your stomach are best friends this is the place. They include 10% service charge in the check, like most of other places do, except at this place, when you're leaving, you want to give some more tips. Because they deserve ;) The best dishes in my opinion: Dutch meatballs and salmon bruschetta! Show less

Author: Лилия К
Title: The best redturant on Langkavi with the kindness weiter!!
Review: Absolutly recommended to everybody who wanna enjoy food and servise! Very nice owner, anaizing weiter and delicios food! There is "Eggs Benedicte with salmon" on a picture. 22 reng.

Author: lukas h
Title: Lunch
Review:
Super geil . Went there for spontaneous lunch. And had excellent cold beer and even better curry! 
Top choice

Author: 12jnc
Title: Great food great staff
Review: Eaten here a lot breakfasts are good and great value, pate is delightful and the sandwiches are filling but the best part is the staff so helpful the owner can be a little dour but when does smile it's genuine.

Author: J2239VVlisab
Title: So nice!
Review: Everything about the meal was fantastic. Nice wine, excellent prawn Marsala and chicken spinach curry, beautiful sunset, and right-from-the-oven orange infused cake. Chic decor. We'll definitely be back. Highly recommended.

Author: Mikko H
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: Nice restaurant with good dinner. I had sea bass and it was reylly good. Althoug sides were not that special, but fish was excellent. Also so far i have had the best coffee in malaysia here. Really good espresso and capuccino. Service is really friendly and good. You can also pay with visa. Show less

Author: TRRSurreySurrey
Title: Fantastic food and run by a lovely couple
Review: The food here is excellent. Lamb shank is the best my husband has ever had. It just fell off the bone. Al dente spaghetti with prawns very tasty. Sea bass on spinach with sauté potatoes was so delicious. You have got to go there. It is run by a Dutch - Malay couple. Very very nice people.Show less

Author: Wilbert S
Title: Nice food.
Review: Good food, quality and price are right. Friendly staff. Best fresh bread on the island. Lunch, diner, all perfect

Author: Ouseboy
Title: Good coffee
Review: Loved the coffee here, both hot and chilled. Salads are yummy too. Interesting spot to relax and enjoy a casual meal.

Author: DeimanteK2
Title: Perfect from start to an end
Review: Everything was perfect - food (both breakfast and dinner), atmosphere, service, music, drinks. Couldn't expect more. I paid attention to the freshness and quality of the food they serve. High five for high quality!

Author: SMH12017Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food
Review: Lovely Dutch meatballs with mashed potatoes and apple jam. Everyone who likes meatballs should try theese ones. Service was quite fast and friendly. Owner of the place also visited our table and small talked with us a while - very nice guy. Take a note that kitchen is closed between 3 -6pm. Worth to visit and enjoy some tasty food!Show less

Author: xviiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Pasta *Al dente ! *
Review: Pasta Al dente is for me the best signature... When the classic are served perfectly!! I've enjoyed my evening at yam yam with my wife and my 3yo daughter, and they make us feel like home ! Definitely back to try every dishes on the menu!!! Looking forward for the chicken liver path and the seabass selection! Thanks to the team yam yam for this memorable evening! Show less

Author: Road20yearsQuebec, Canada
Title: No return
Review: First morning, for what I thought look like a nice cosy place, I stopped by for breakfast. I got 2 eggs and one toast flat in my plate for the price of a dinner. But what shock me the most was, what I thought was Mr Owner, was his so cold service without a slim of a smile. (I know He could have had a bad night) but...The tip you put on my bill Sir, you didn't deserve it. In 2 weeks stay I just avoid that place.Show less

Author: mariapI2560DX
Title: Delicious breakfast
Review:
We godt breakfast there. Very nice menu with something for everyone. 
The food looked good and it tasted also really delicious. Would defently go back.

Author: rozkev2004
Title: Peaceful, gorgeous food in well designed setting
Review:
The Malaysian lady that runs this place is very friendly and the food is excellent. Presentation and taste get 5 stars from us.
You could just go in for a lovely coffee, we had breakfast twice here and enjoyed it very much.

Author: Ahmed B
Title: Must have breakfast on the island
Review:
Great breakfast and dinner cafe.  I preferred this place over my included hotel breakfast.  Excellent service and the food is served hot and quick.  

A popular place for expats living on the island.

Author: 1Travelled_the_worldQinzhou, China
Title: The place to eat
Review: YAM YAM CAFE - RESTAURANT Jalan Pentai Tengah. Well worth a visit or two. Owned and run by a Dutch - Malay couple. Opened in mid-2016 replacing Troppoco. The staff are frienly and efficient. As for the food it's simply excellent. Great value and great taste. Whether you just want breakfast, a coffee and a snack or a full 3 course meal they have it all. l highly reccommend this restaurant. Open from 9am to 3pm and 6pm to 10pm (closed on Tuesdays) Don't delay visit today.Show less

Author: Wiebke S
Title: Best coffee on Langkawi
Review: Best breakfast and coffee on Langkawi! A perfect start into the day. You can eat a lot of different Food!

Author: Václav Z
Title: We didn't like it
Review: Food was so so and somewhat expensive for what it was. Paying almost 20 MYR for normal smoothie is quite a lot. Service charge of 10% added to the bill.

Author: IrwinTan95
Title: Friendly but Food was so so
Review: They have really friendly stuffs but the food was so so with a little bit higher price. Coffee wasn't at the right ratio and the milk was under steam. The environment was nice.

Author: Clint R
Title: Awesome
Review: Great food, the best coffee we had on langkawi, we had breakfast here everyday and dinner once, we will 100% be straight back there next trip to the island

Author: eric833kuala lumpur
Title: Excellent food,friendly staff and nice ambiance
Review: As we visit Langkawi very often,practically every other month, we are quite familiar with all the popular restaurants on the island. Yam Yam is an upcoming star in the restaurant scene. The food is tasty, well presented and value for money. Try the smoothies,fresh juices,pastas and burgers. They are simply wonderful. Their breakfast sets are also worth a mention. Today the chef prepared Nasi Lemak with chicken curry and its the best I've tasted on the island. The couple and their team running the place are friendly ,efficient and always very accommodating. Yam Yam is situated on Pantai Tengah away from the hustle and bustle of Pantai Cenang. It's a good choice for the whole family or just a quiet dinner for a couple . Well worth a try. Show less

Author: sheyb2
Title: Coffee and cake
Review: We stopped by for some much needed refreshment. Great orange cake drenched in syrup with awesome flavors. Also has the panacotta with a berry syrup. Great service, nice vibe and decor. Little oasis tucked away. Will def give the meals a try.

Author: carabiner1
Title: Fresh start to the day
Review: Great place with fresh products,  clean friendly service with reasonable prices. Great spot especially for breakfast.

Author: Anders W
Title: Excellent service, good food!
Review: Quite enjoyed this little place along the mainroad. Very friendly attentive personnel and tasty food. Good prices.

Author: CatjlynBradley Stoke, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: Absolutely fantastic restaurantWe stumbled across Yam Yam when looking for somewhere that does a decent breakfast and coffee and we were not disappointedThe restaurant is spotlessly clean, the staff are extremely friendly and very attentive (and funny). They cannot do enough for you.Breakfast is the best we have had to date in Langkawi. I highly recommend the Eggs Benedict - all home made (including the muffin) but limited availability.We have also tried the spinach and feta omelette (very tasty) and boiled eggs (it has been difficult finding somewhere that can boil an egg properly)The flat white coffee is really niceThe Orange juice is freshly squeezedWe have also eaten here for an evening meal - a nice small menu and again everything is home made - again the food and service did not disappointThis is a fairly new family run restaurant in a lovely quiet location not far from the hustle and bustle of cenang but you feel like you are a world awayShow less

Author: joanneb402Nightcliff, Australia
Title: Lovely Dessert
Review: The children love the cuisine and desserts we had Lemon Pama Cotta really sharp and very smooth plus the Chocolate Mousse was splendid so very rich in texture yummy.....The boys had a buccaneer burger which they like and said nice and the rib eye medium done with veggies finished of ours. What we enjoyed most is the freshly squeezed orange juice so very authentic...Will come again definitely All the best to them.Show less

Author: Marde012
Title: Excellent breakfast
Review: Best breakfast in Langkawi, a lot of tasty options. Very nice and friendly staff, home-alike-atmosphere, great location. Also very good lunch selection.

Author: lauraaxx13Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Tasty!!
Review: Both the decoration aswell as the food was very very tasty. We came here several times to eat breakfast and lunch which I can absolutely recommend because it was very fresh, even the orange juice. It's a clean restaurant and the owner and staff are friendly and happy to give you tips about the activities on this island. Good prices for the large amount of food you get. You should definitely pay a visit to this place!!Show less

Author: maaritl1Jarvenpaa, Finland
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food
Review: Went there almost every morning when we were at Langkawi. Very good breakfast and coffee place. Last day we try lunch, and it was so good! Salad was so fresh and tasty, and the pasta was very good. So sad that we try the lunch just before we were leaving. Show less

Author: richardlgk
Title: Breakfast
Review:
Sunny and relaxing.  Great food good coffee and comfortable seating.
Yap and Soraya make a wonderful team..

Author: Khuraisms
Title: Wonderful
Review:
Nice place with nice atmosphere and really great menu and foods.

I love it, great laksa 
IT is really yami yami

Author: KarthigaVemmal
Title: Best evening
Review: Our evening was memorable because of Mr Murthy!!! He was superb! All the staffs were friendly and professional. The food was amazing! Will definitely come again.

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Ok food in great setting
Review: Visited CBA for the island barbeque buffet on Saturday. Lovely location on the beach with great sunset views. Salads were very good especially the fetta cheese one. The barbeque items were OK but were cooked away from the restaurant.Wine offer was good, 1st glass only 10 MYR with the meal.Show less

Author: mav2120
Title: Wonderful dining experience and destination
Review: Everything was good from service and atmosphere except the BBQ meaty items full of fats instead of meat. Perhaps need to revisit.

Author: Lydiaizna
Title: Great ambiance
Review: Had the sunset dinner package, the food is great, awesome entertainment. Very warm hospitality by the staff.

Author: kamil a

Special mention to Charles, Jeffrey , Fahmi, Nafsaruddin, zamri, ikhmal, Azizah, murthy, shidi and azmi @cba. Keep up the good work Show less

Author: seakyeo
Title: CBA LANGKAWI
Review: Best place for sunset at beach front with best foods and drinks at good price. Plus the staffs are super friendly and helpful.

Author: Luke P
Title: Nice ambient
Review: Good for couple and family with nice atmospheric. Sound the beach sound and quite relax. Couple celebrating Birthday.

Author: azraiez76
Title: gorgeous sunset view, excellent service
Review: we had reserved a table on the beach during sunset. the view was amazing. even when the placed was full, the staffs were friendly and patiently accommodating our request. special thanks to abu, the waiter who served us last night.

Author: tonysamsamboKulim, Malaysia
Title: Amazing holiday
Review: CBA has left the best impressions and memorable place for life long! Amazing beach facing location, hospitable hosts, delicious dishes, beautiful presentation, best happy hour beverages. The ambiance is very welcoming and charming. Staff are extremely knowledgeable and make great recommendations especially by CBA manager Mr Murthy. I celeberated my Wife Birthday at CBA and it was wonderful with beautiful table decoration by Mr.Abu and the other CBA staff joining and singing birthday song together. This was our 2nd stay at Pelangi and during our 4 days stay here, we visited CBA every day and spent time chilling and enjoying sun, sea and sand. Great job Mr Moorthy and Abu to be very friendly and welcoming. They know what they’re doing and what they’re talking about, and making the customers happy is their main priority. I recommend to everyone to visit CBA! I would like to come back here again and again. It’s a great experience.Show less

Author: Khairil12
Title: Cba restaurant
Review: Best restaurant n bar nice view.. I will give 5 star to cba staff for the service n good food... I will come back again.

Author: TheOverBossPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Gold Medal to All Cba crew
Review: I am writing to express my thanks and appreciation for the quality of service and care that I and my family received at Pelangi Beach Resort & Spa, Langkawi from 31st August to 3rd of September 2020. Our room number is 801. Cba Restaurant - me and my family had a western breakfast at Cba restaurant 3 days in a row during our stay. We enjoy our ocean view side table. I chose to stay indoors - to enjoy the tv program, our table number is CB2. I just want to say that, in addition to a nice perfect meals (something for everyone), we’ve been served and entertained by a delightful staff like Mr Wan Taha, Mr. Hasmirun, Mr. Fahmi, Mr. Zam ‘the specky guy’, and not to forget Ms. Linda. She had just the right balance of friendliness and efficiency. She and other Cba staff members made certain that we had everything we needed. The Cba staff are all pretty friendly and helpful, not to mention, very hardworking, they were very accomodating.Great job as they are following the safety operations procedure (SOP).Show less

Author: Masakovdv
Title: Beautiful view
Review: Amazing sunset with a little drink. you can enjoy Dinner with little breeze from the sea. Very friendly staff.

Author: akadken
Title: Gazebo Romantic Dinner by the Beach
Review:
Great service by Jafree and the five course meal by Chef Saleh, plus an additional dessert on the house. Too bad the weather didn’t permit us to fully utilised the gazebo. Overall, great experience
#cba
#merituspelangi

Author: sacmajeekDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Need to do better...........
Review: Have been staying at the hotel for almost a week now and our experience of eating at Cba has been very average at best. Monday evening was a roast buffet. The meat was cold and I had to ask for it to be reheated in the microwave. Yesterday and today we have eaten lunch here and much of the small lunch menu was unavailable. The waitress did not know why. No salad option at all on both days! Service was very slow today and customers were complaining. We had long finished our drinks before the food arrived and we only ordered burgers. Some of the more experienced staff are very good and attentive but seem to be running at 150% to perhaps make up for the inexperienced staff who look lost at times. In full sun the available shaded space in the restaurant is limited. They could do with investing in more sun shades or a large awning to provide more shade and increase the number of available tables. Some seat cushions for the hot plastic chairs would also be appreciated.Show less

Author: kitkatEaling_londonealing,london
Title: A beautifully situated hotel
Review: Husband & I stayed there recently as clients of Rail Discoveries. We were delighted with our stay. The food was some of the best we have experienced considering it is mass catering ( we were 41 people). For groups it is a 3-course menu, with a choice of 3 for the starter & main course, the 3rd choice being vegetarian. Dessert is one choice but the serving staff offered me ice cream one night as I do not like panna cotta. The rooms were comfortable but the shower was small & fiddly- if you were obese I would imagine that the shower might be a no- no. Obviously added into the original room so challenged for space. The breakfast is better than the usual Continental. The public ferry operates on a regular basis, the private one twice a day. Both stop bang on the hotel's jetty. If you want a lake view be aware it is £350 supplement for the 6 nights we were there. We decided against since we were leaving each day after breakfast , returning before dinner. It might have been different had we been staying there much of each day. I would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel.Show less
