Best to make booking to ensure being seated by the beach wher you can watch the beautiful sunsets. Evening entertainment by resident band was excellent. Service really good. Abu was really good fun, service with a smile. Irene also offered exceptional service and helped us create itineraries for our days out on the island. Beer and cocktail selection very good. Alfresco breakfast was also very good. We will really miss the waiting staff and fine food.Show less

Author: farfyfly
Title: Grat
Review:
Amazing place, with great food and beautiful view. We really enjoyed and we definitely came back .
Big thanks to Irene for her friendly and professional service.

Author: Reshu_248
Title: Cba
Review: Absolutely loved the ambience and place. Amazing spot for sunset viewing. Food was not up to our expectation. Will go again just to see the sunset by the beach.

Author: Keirpalmtree92
Title: Great restaurant on the beach, very relaxing and great for a meal and drink
Review: Had a lovely meal on the beach, great cocktails and lovely food. Beautiful view, chilled atmosphere, brilliant band.

Author: Jayce-96
Title: Review on my visit
Review: This is a great place for a good time. Staff are so friendly. Drinks are just in taste. Will definitely come back here. Keep it up !!!

Author: Melinda H
Title: Lunch
Review: The restaurant has a stunning view across the beach, cocktails are lovely and the local Barracuda Fish n Chips is delicious.  They were also accommodating with grilling my fish.  You can sit out on a deck area which steps down onto the sandy beach.

Author: Heidi T
Title: Holiday with family
Review: What a fantastic place, great location, great food, great staff and to top it all off free bubbly with breakfast.

Author: Priya J
Title: Beautiful
Review: Amazing view, great for the sunset. So affordable and Murthy definitely added to the lovely experience with his exceptional service!

Author: LukeFoss
Title: Best bar in Langkawi, great service
Review: This bar is the perfect location for sunset, the prices are great and the service is even better. A must visit when in Langkawi.

Author: FollowOli
Title: Perfect location, even better customer service
Review: We visited CBA and it was better than expected, Murthy was extremely helpful and friendly and he made us feel very welcome. Would 100% come back!

Author: SimonNeston
Title: Breakfast was easy and good
Review: The Cba serves a variety of dishes for breakfast. The staff need to be a little more efficient in clearing tables for guest.

Author: Miiiiii96
Title: Special dinner
Review:
特別な日だったのでロマンティックディナーで予約しました。海沿いに席がセットされていて景色が最高です！ご飯も美味しくて素敵な時間を過ごせました！every thing is good! About awesome! All guys!
Murphy , abu, ikmmal

Author: christophercZ5613XXSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Anniversary
Review: A special thank you too zamri and Murphy for taking care our dinner such a wonderful place to visit staff are so friendly and cheerful the food is super delicious.will we come back here? That is a big YES.you guys make us feel home. Thank you again. Show less

Author: Vnhjk
Title: Great spot
Review:
Beautiful place right on the beach, great service staff and chill atmosphere. 
Cool beer and amazing sunset as a background.
Many thanks to all the staff for make our visit memorable.

Author: DarrenC1372
Title: Dinner by the beach
Review: One of the best place for dinner in Langkawi. Great food, great service, great environment. Will always go back there every visit to Langkawi

Author: sean ACanberra, Australia
Title: Great for a icy tiger and beach BBQ
Review: Great beachside venue for a cold beer and BBQ, really cool place to wind down after a long day.This is an open air venue right o the beach, the staff are friendly and efficient. The menu for the BBQ featured fresh and local seafood and a selection of beef, lamb and chicken. Well appointed and plenty to go round. Worth the visit.Show less

Author: 1963Gerry
Title: Fantastic Service with a View !!
Review: We dined here for breakfast and had numerous evening meals. The food was delicous with a great variety of choices The manager and staff  provided exceptional service and combined with the sensational outlook over the beach this made it a memorable dining experience.

Author: arielteo94
Title: Great view to accompany you while you eat.
Review: I went to Cba in the morning for breakfast. The atmosphere was blissful due to the nice view of the beach. And they even serve sparkling wine in for breakfast.

Author: ansonchonghs
Title: Sea facing restaurant serve great continental breakfast with champagne
Review: Located at beach side, serve great continental breakfast with champagne, good for family with kid. Good food, friendly staff,

Author: mrsfooChangi, Singapore
Title: Food ok, service lacking, rude attitude from one staff
Review: Supposed to be a five star hotel but service was none. Our family of 8adults and 3 kids had breakfast here. Nobody bothered to clear the plates. When I tried to get the attention of this lady in the pic, she looked at me and then looked away pretending not to see me. Unbelievable. The Chef probably saw and he came over to help cleared the plates. When one of the male server saw, he quickly came to help the Chef. This lady in the picture was only interested to serve the Caucasian customers, speaking to them in a very friendly manner and all smiles. We left feeling very discriminated Show less

Author: peterjlondon1London, United Kingdom
Title: Ignored
Review: We stopped by yesterday during a walk along the beach for a drink, as the restaurant was thinning out after late breakfasters and looked good. There was a welcoming sign saying “come in and take a seat”, so we did.We were totally ignored by the several waiters busy chatting amongst themselves.After 15 minutes, we felt rested and left. Yes, we could have waved to get attention, but we were the customers, and the waiters could not care less. There was no sign of any management at all.Show less

Author: vesko9Sofia, Bulgaria
Title: Nice place, with room for improvement
Review: As said by others, this restaurant is located right on the beach as part of the Meritus Pelangi Hotel. The view is amazing and being at the end of the beach it is quite private. Of course, it is also one of the main hotel's restaurants, so part of it is buffet style for the hotel guests, while the other part is opened for guests and served ala carte. The lunch menu is quite good with many options and the cocktails are excellent. The dinner menu, for some reason is less than half of the lunch menu, and the options are very limited, a couple of burgers, pizza and pasta, with almost no seafood and fish options. The main problem is that nothing from the fish/seafood section of the menu is fresh, all is frozen, which is weird for such a nice location right on the beach. I believe the management should consider including something like "fish of the day" or whatever that would allow them to offer fresh fish/seafood options without being afraid of the logistics. Besides that, the personnel are very friendly and nice and take excellent care of their guests, the wine selection was nice, prices reasonable and the food was well prepared, considering all products are frozen. Overall, if fresh options are added this would become one of the best places on the island.Show less

Author: FionaaN1
Title: Great
Review: Great food, great service and view is amazing plus price was reasonable. Also location is perfect, just by the beach. Will definitely come back.

Author: jo_opaulor553
Title: Charming bar / restaurant by the beach
Review:
Very good bar and restaurant, inside the Meritus hotel. Beatiful view of the sea. Attendant Quayyum was very friendly, thanks a lot! 
Good options of food and drinks as well.

Author: candicechuht
Title: Friendly service and great food
Review: Love to be here again!!! Qnyyun is super friendly and he even prepared  us flower when we r about to leave. Great place to enjoy your holiday here

Author: Col777London
Title: Great Food & Excellent Service
Review: We made frequent visits to Cba during our stay at the Meritus hotel, and recommend it to visitors and hotel guests alike. Outstanding customer-focused service led by Irene and Quyyum made our meals there very pleasant. It’s an ideal spot to watch the fantastic sunsets at the end of each day, whilst relaxing with a cocktail & a selection of tapas!Show less

Author: hugomendonca721
Title: Tapas lunch
Review: We enjoyed a relaxed tapas lunch. The service was friendly and I would definitely recommend their strawberry caipiroska!

Author: Maya762015
Title: Only for cocktail
Review: CBA has a great view on Cenang beach and offer some comfortable sofa in front of the sea. Service is nice and drink a cocktail there is very pleasant. However food menu is very limited and even pasta or burger are neither good neither tasty.

Author: Rohit L
Title: Eating with incredible views
Review: CBA offered a generous variety of foods. The views of the beach were breathtaking. Make sure to slap on some insect repellant at dinner, as there are mosquitoes around.

Author: summerdays83London
Title: Location can’t be beat
Review: We’d migrate here from the pool to feed our kids dinner. We’d sit by the beach in our towels and watch the sun set while playing board games. It’s as idyllic as family time gets! The boys would watch the planes fly by and wave at the hang gliders. They serve the all day menu until 6pm, tapas from 4-7pm and the dinner menu from 7pm. We got into the habit of ordering pizza and pasta for the boys before 6pm then ordering our own meals off the dinner menu (more selection) to come out after 7pm. It worked well for us. We’d take one of the sofas and our 4 month old would roll around happily while we played Jenga or chess with our 4 and 5 year olds.Best thing I had to eat there was the surf and turf. Easily as good as what I’d eat at the best steak restaurants/hotels in KL. Expensive but well worth it.Show less

Author: Ed NMelbourne, Australia
Title: Tough to handle
Review: The ambiance is superb. Right on the white sand. They have 3 areas. Tables almost on the beach. Lounge chairs almost on the beach. Then a large open air structure where you can buffer or dance to a great live band. As food as it gets.Show less

Author: MelindaF317
Title: Langkawi
Review:
One of the Must see@try place in Langkawi!
We had a wonderful dinner with beautiful view to the see with background of sunset.

Author: Gordon G
Title: Great place to watch the sunset!
Review: Friendly staff and great band (play every night except Monday I think). Location location location, highly recommended!

Author: lousturmDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: CBA - lovely for sundowners
Review: We stayed at the Meritus Pelangi hotel and so we dined in CBA restaurant daily for breakfast during our stay in Langkawi. We had lunch in CBA on two days and enjoyed the burger, chicken burger, chicken wings and pizza (not all at the same time) but during our stay there. The food was really nice and the staff were friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: amymK306XB
Title: Good location and tasty food
Review: Slightly more upmarket venue and a little pricier for food to reflect that Compared to nearby restaurants, but small portions. We had beef ragu pasta and a chicken with lemon sauce and spaghetti which were both delicious. Tiger beer was cheap. Lovely view of the sunset at beachfront location. Service was very slow and also lots of cats lingering around. We saw one eat food three times from plates that had been cleared from tables but left outside.Show less

Author: Keith C
Title: Pleasant but lacking charm.
Review: Its a nice bar but seems to lack any charm or ambiance that sets it apart. All very functional offering great views of the sunsets but all in all there are better out there.

Author: Escape17407264347
Title: Breakfast
Review: We had included breakfast and it was continental. Big dislike for the choice of food there. Also drinks were quite pricy.

Author: GeordieThatTravelsNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Great location
Review: This is a fantastic location to watch the sunset. But having been twice thd first time was average and the food very average. We came back a second time just for a drink and to watch the sunset. It took 25 minutes to even be served and I had to flag someone down, they didn't even come over. The first time it took ages too for our food and drinks to arrive. The staff are pleasant but not very efficient.Great location though for watching the sunset, but my friend's soft drink was more than double what we've paid any where else! Show less

Author: dr_anis_slim
Title: Very nice view
Review: You can enjoy your breakfast with very nice view. The sunset is greatful by here. The food is international and contains a lot of variety.

Author: mikajiiVantaa, Finland
Title: Dinner at the beach
Review: Stayed at the resort the restaurant is located. Nice terrance on the beach. They had a la carte & buffet option on the evening we visited. Decided buffet is too much this time and went for a la carte. My lobster burger was mainly excellent. Lobster and sides 5/5. Burger with mushroom wasn’t excellent but good. Drink I had was ok. Service nice and friendly. Could visit again.Show less

Author: Heli PHelsinki, Finland
Title: Lunch on the beach
Review: The only decent restaurant with seaview serving food belongs to Meritus resort. Seating is arranged on a wooden deck, both sheltered and open air. The piece of fried barracuda in the salad was well done, the combination of feta cheese and pomegranate was an odd mix. Service was polite and price level reasonable considering the location. While eating you can watch planes arriving at the nearby airport.Show less

Author: Sarahlgk
Title: CBA sunset dinner
Review: Excellent location for dinner overlooking the beach and sunset. We ordered the buffet option advised to us by Irene and it was perfect. Fresh salads and gorgeous desserts! What made the whole experience so special was Irene and her friendly, excellent service. She is doing an exceptional job. Will definitely visit again and would recommend to anyone looking for a special spot for dinner.Show less

Author: stephanie g
Title: Good place to relax
Review: Really nice spot where enjoying the sunset! We just had something to drink but the restaurant look really yummy! Thanks to Irene for the nice service :)

Author: E4441KDandrewf
Title: 20th anniversary trip
Review: Beautiful surroundings and excellent staff attitude. Excellent food and wine selection. This is how holiday dining should be.

Author: Julia SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: So relaxing
Review: Great place for afternoon drinks. Fabulous views over to Rebak Island. This bar deserves to be used more. The hotel residents seem to spend more time at the swimming pool so Cba is empty most of the time. Great selection of drinks both alcoholic and soft. Choose wisely and it’s no more expensive than any of the other beach bars with the added advantage of being tranquil, with big comfy seats and lovely staff who leave you to relax and enjoy the view. There is an extensive lunch/snack menu, an afternoon tapas menu and an evening menu. This place is really worth the walk up to the end of the beach. Just walk in, take a seat and unwind. You’ll be glad you did!Show less

Author: PETER1348Datchet, United Kingdom
Title: LUNCHES TO REMEMBER
Review: As we were staying at the resort the Cba made a natural place to camp midway through the day and grab a beer and some lunch. The views to the sea were perfect and the staff were equally good in terms of attention and courtesy. Special mention to 1 person. Eileen/Elena (senior front of house in the Cba) Brilliant customer service skills and full of ideas re either things to do or place to go to. Her attentiveness was a real plus and her clear loyalty to the "brand" was exemplary. The mexican starters and salads were all great and I am hoping to sit down there for a cold Tiger in the next 12 months! Show less

Author: Fjodolf1
Title: Excellent place with fantastic view
Review: The outdoor seating on the beach is priceless. Good selection of lunch dishes which are very good. Happy hour 4-7 with 30% on selected drinks.

Author: MagsmuttLondon
Title: Lovely meals in a nice setting overlooking the sea.
Review: We eat breakfast here every day and there was a good choice on offer with eggs cooked to order. We also eat here on a couple of evenings where there was a good choice on the main menu or a bbq option. Lovely atmosphere with a band playing and the staff were very attentive.Show less

Author: Beccadicko7
Title: Make sur yet visit hereb
Review: The service and food were to a very high standard. The staff were extremely friendly and accomdating, not to mention the incredible view of the sunset! I would highly recommend if you are visiting Cenang beach to check this place out!

Author: ezekielcollings
Title: Sunset drinks
Review: Such a great spot! Great food and the staff were friendly and helpful. Definitely would recommend this as a great location for a few relaxed drinks in the afternoon.

Author: Lstewart181
Title: Wish we'd found it sooner
Review: Prestine beach, amazing view, top notch food and really friendly staff!... Not to mention a great happy hour

Author: farfyfly
Title: Perfect sunset and drinks
Review:
This is one of the best place to enjoy the sunset with an amazing drink.
Really chill and relaxing atmosphere and friendly service.
Definitely high  recommended if you spend your holiday in Langkawi.

Author: 470sophiew
Title: Sunset drinks
Review: Came here every evening for sunset drinks while staying the the hotel it forms part of. Wonderful services from the staff, in particular Suziyana and Irene who were incredibly friendly and remembered our room number and drinks orders. You can probably find cheaper drinks along the beach, but from here the sun sets between the islands off the coast, the music isn’t offensively loud and it’s a nice chilled balance. Show less

Author: aliceistallTainan, Taiwan
Title: This restaurant is far beyond fantastic!
Review: The restaurant is awesome. We’re here to celebrate our anniversary and the atmosphere was fantastic with the beautiful sunset and live band music. We enjoyed the time here and our lovely friend, Suziyana,really had us a wonderful experience. We’d highly recommend this restaurant for their great services and the environment as well. The buffet worths the value and the barbecue tastes good. 這裡的環境跟食物都很棒，氣氛很好，晚餐時段可以一邊欣賞夕陽聽海浪聲一邊吃飯，晚上還提供蠟燭，總而言之非常的美好，而且服務生都十分友善熱情！Show less

Author: Jase8213Shoreham-by-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Last night after staying here and trying all the other restaurants in the area
Review: Poor. Service super slow! Food average. Arrived and waited 20 minutes before even being acknowledged and given a menu. Another 15 mins until asked for drinks! Asked for a selection of breads to dip whilst waiting on main a la carte main course, we got sliced white bread!! Steak was good, Lamb was poor, over-cooked chewy strips. Really slow to get another drink or even acknowledged!Show less

Author: eachtraiochtareviews
Title: Amazing and Friendly
Review: Came here in October with my family and was honestly so happy with the friendly service. Everyone was so welcoming and funny, and the food was amazing quality with good veggie options. Lovely view of the sea and beach with live music. Thank you to the staff for working so hard.Show less

Author: Pamela ECarlisle, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect setting
Review: We loved the setting of this bar/restaurant. It is situated at the edge of a private beach allowing uninterrupted views of the stunning sunsets. The impeccable service of the staff was amazing, they are all so attentive and will go out off their way to ensure you have everything you need. Very good cocktails etc and very reasonably priced. The breakfast food has something for everyone and very good. We ate here 4 nights during our stay and the quality of the food and presentation was excellent. I have a nut allergy which can be difficult but the chef and staff were all fully aware as to what I could eat which was reassuring. Thank you so much to all the restaurant/bar staff, we would highly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: GEB568
Title: Breakfast
Review: We had breakfast here when we stayed at the hotel. Champagne breakfast with all the different foods you could think of for breakfast

Author: ericmelvinedward
Title: Great place to chill and enjoy the sunset
Review: Well situated. A very relaxing place and environment. Great place to have few drinks and enjoy the sunset.

Author: SanJK89
Title: Exclusive
Review: It's a nice fine dining place by the beach.. U can enjoy a great sunset dinner.. Its great for couples and also group of frens.. Staffs are frenly and the view is amazing. A must try place in cenang.

Author: neilwC7667CEWalton-On-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Great venue
Review: This is a great restaurant & bar , facing a private beech , ideal for sundowners. They have live music every night , giving it a great vibe . The service is fantastic with great food , with plenty of staff working . A MASSIVE shout out , to the wonderful Irene for her wonderful friendly service 10/10 Show less

Author: 942emilyt
Title: Great breakfast buffet
Review: We weren’t staying at the hotel but came here for the buffet breakfast every morning. It was 75R each and had a great “western” selection as well as included sparkling wine!

Author: Trek02319616221
Title: CBA at the Meritus
Review: An amazing bar/restaurant, right on the beach. They have free flowing bubbles at breakfast and amazing cocktail and tapas at night. Happy hour makes everything quite cheap! Shout out to staff member Sankalp for going above and beyond and recommending local free attractions to do, and his favourites from the menu!Show less

Author: k8candyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful location and delicious food
Review: Yummy cocktails and delicious food. Wonderful location right on the beach, beautiful views and sunsets. Friendly and helpful staff. The live band were brilliant. Very romantic but equally enjoyable with friends. The menu could have been bigger but all food was great.. They could really do with advertising the restaurant more in town or on the main road as it is hidden away so only patrons of the hotel tend to dine here - this was fine for us as it meant it was never full to the brim. We ate here twice and I would definitely recommend it.Show less

Author: sansanbibongHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Surprise service, very good quality food, sunset
Review: Special thanks to Mr Kuan Yew and all staff service that day. I booked too late so the gazebo all bookedThey had 30 minutes to prepare because we didn't reserve. And so so amazing! Everything was perfect from reception to table decoration and especially food.Such a great sunset view and good live music at night! All staffs were very nice and polite. We had a peaceful and romantic evening at Cba. That was an unforgetable memories! Thank Cba so much. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: mrkbsl
Title: Perfect for having a drink watching the sun set
Review: Perfect location right at Cenang beach, you can watch the beutiful Langkawi sun set and enjoy a drink in a relaxed atmosphere. The beer was cheap compared to most places on the beach. The staff was very friendly and open. When we had questions about the area (it was our first night) Irene was happy to help giving us some useful information about the island. Very much appreciated and will definitely come again when I'm back in Langkawi.Show less

Author: agaig_partdeuxchester
Title: BEAUTIFUL HOTEL AND RESTAURANT
Review: We had a lovely, relaxing meal at this hotel in Langkawi last week end. We were not resident but were looked after so well by the Maitre D'. Thoroughly enjoyed our set meal, which was a little expensive but worth every penny. It was happy hour when we arrived so took advantage of this, the Long Island Tea was devine. There was a great band playing at the restaurant, when we walked across to the reception area there was also a duo singing in the foyer, lovely hotel. Would like to stay there one day. Very plush.Show less

Author: Marianne13smLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: I love this place
Review: Every time I come to Langkawi I visit this place. Best restaurant/bar to enjoy the sunset sipping a cocktail and have dinner ( although the food choice could probably be wider).Service is always welcoming and friendly, this time we were taken care by the manager Irene who was very kind and took also a very good care of my food allergies!! Don’y Miss this place in Langkawi!!Show less

Author: LattejunkieMalaysia
Title: Perfect for drinks and sunset!
Review: I was here with my little family staying at the Meritus hence, my husband and I managed to have our own quiet time at Cba in the late afternoon for drinks. It was lovely. Advice is to have more beers, as it is cheaper than the fresh juices and smoothies, I kid you not! Also, I like how they actually have board games stocked at one corner for families and on each table, they have a box that keeps 5 stones and colourful pick-up sticks! Malaysians will know the 5 stones as "Batu Seremban" so it was a nice jog down memory lane as my husband and I tried our hands at it while our baby boy watches and attempted to play too. Overall, very relaxing and serene atmosphere, perfect to wait for sunset. I would definitely come back again to check out the live bands and dinner someday.Show less

Author: Happyanon
Title: Loved it
Review: We were staying in the hotel so would come here often. Food is good, drinks are good and the staff are excellent. Very friendly. Right on the beach so you can watch the sunset. Live music most nights. Fabulous place.

Author: amarpuri90
Title: Very good restaurant
Review: Visited Cba a couple of times during my langkawi trip and it had a very good experience each time. The location over looking the water itself is excellent and food + service by the staff are also great.

Author: natashap897London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely evening - Wine, Food and Sunset.
Review: My partner and I went here for an evening.It was lovely - great location for sunset. Very relaxed and chilled. Cheapest beers on island for pint draught 9ringAmazing food - tapas and drink happy hour 4-7pm (braised prawns I had two portions, chicken burger, Pizza)Music was nice - although they don't need the flashy neons lights whilst the band are playing.Lovely waiter - Das - He was so polite and attentive - but not too much!Wonderful evening!Would truly recommend this place to anyone!Show less

Author: amarkoul
Title: Does NOT Disappoint!
Review: I always make it a point to come here whenever I'm in Langkawi. Value-for-money food and an amazing ambience, why not? Special mentions go to Qayyum who makes every meal more vibrant!

Author: Steve HMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great little bar
Review: We stayed at Meritus so this was like our localBreakfast was just so soStaff were good and attentivePrices on high side but expect that at a resortCheaper than pool bar where prices were ridiculous Live entertainment good at night and great sunset viewsShow less

Author: Kippura
Title: Delicious food but too loud music
Review: This restaurant is located in beautiful beach of Pantai Cenang and its in the hotel area of Meritus Pelangi Resort Beach & Spa. They play live music in the restaurant in every night except Mondays. The music is too loud and it is impossible to discuss with your partner during dinner. We would have ate in this restaurant more but because of the loud music we went more often for dinner outside the hotel area. We booked once The romantic dinner for couples by beach and it was wonderful experience. It was Monday and there was no live music then. The dinner was a 5 course set dinner. The sunset view was spectacular. We ate three hours and enjoyed it very much. The stuff was friendly but it was odd that they didn´t offer to take a photo from us during the dinner. It would have been nice and polite.Show less

Author: VanessaD848
Title: Lovely spot on the beach for delicious dinner and great atmosphere
Review: We stayed in the hotel so went to CBA several times. Every time the food and drinks didn’t disappoint! Atmosphere was great with an amazing live band. Chef came to each table asking how was dinner. Totally recommend CBA!

Author: abbys0712
Title: terrific restaurant for dining and view
Review: a restaurant on Beach side, with marvelous view and high quality food.  very fresh and multiple choice.  all staff were super nice.  and chef Bazeli greeted us during dining period, very kind person willing to offer help all the time.  great experience and highly recommended.

Author: FlightproAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Go for Beer not for food!
Review: Perfect place to sit with great view of the white beach and stunning sunset.However, the Quality of our food was just terrible. If you like deep frozen pizza’s then this is your place to be. If not, then just stick with the Carlsberg beer from the draft. For RM 6 per 1/2 pint it’s a good deal.Show less

Author: nickodemus8Rosebery, Australia
Title: Friendly service, good quality food
Review: We booked a "Romantic Dinner" on the beach, which was a great experience. The service was excellent, thanks to Abu and Kuan Yew. The food was also of very high standards - very well presented, very tasty and of generous proportions (the sea bass came with a while "side" of lobster!). It would certainly rival a lot of the good restaurants in Sydney. Overall, the restaurant was good, but there were a few things that could be improved. The "Romantic Dinner" concept was a bit "naff" (the front page listed in big font "ROMANTIC DINNER", which kind of takes away from the romanticism!). Also, the live band (who were very talented) kind of over powered the atmosphere as they are incredibly loud (they should either be a feature or background music, however they ended up being somewhere in between). With a few tweaks this could be the best beach bar in Pantai Cenang.Show less

Author: euphorialicexzKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Uninteresting, not fresh, very limited
Review: The grill buffet we had on Saturday was limited. They only have prawn,2 types of fish, mussel, squid, chicken, lamb and beef, and also satay skewers. The prawn was not fresh, the fish was not well-seasoned and the squid was not even seasoned. There was very limited sushi spread with no raw fish served. The cold prawns at the salad section were not fresh. There is smoked salmon in the salad section but no fresh raw salmon. The chicken tikka was too dry and not well-seasoned. The dessert spread was laughable. Everything was too sweet and the cakes taste below average. I could have gotten better cakes at any normal bakery outside. There was no ice cream served or local desserts served. Just tiny pieces of sugary flour they call cakes. Not even cheesecakes!The only thing I liked was the Spinach Ravioli but some parts were very floury. The mosquito repellant provided did not work so we were still bitten by the mosquitoes as we were dining. The live band was not-up-to-par. It's mostly just noisy. But we did pass by the lounge at the hotel reception and that singer was much better. I will not return.Show less

Author: Fiona C
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: Perfect view ,food and 100% perfect service ! Highly recommend ! The price is okay not too expensive

Author: SamaneR6
Title: wonderful place
Review: Good food, amazing atmosphere, live music, friendly and polite staff. couldn’t ask for more. The restaurant is located on the best part of the Cenang beach. Highly recommended for people who want a peaceful and romantic evening at the beach.

Author: Chris DWindsor, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Romantic Dinner
Review: If your idea of the perfect romantic dinner is a wonderful 8 course meal, beautifully cooked and presented, with great service, on a private beach, in a gazebo watching an amazing sun set on a beautiful island and a live band playing a pleasant selection of songs, then look no further than the CBa at the Meritus Pelangi Beach Resort and Spa on Cenang beach on the island of Langkawi.We had the good fortune to experience just that on 2nd of August, when we celebrated 38 years together. An unforgettable experience. Thank you CBa and Pelangi Beach Resort.Show less

Author: cssissteBeijing, China
Title: Anniversary
Review: We celebrated our 7 years anniversary in the Cba at Meritus Pelangi. It was AMAZING. The food was cooked delicious and it was really something very special. For 2 people you get MORE that you can actually eat! The staff adjusted the menu according to our requests and we even got the additional “Happy anniversary” desert as a surprise. In the end of the dinner we had the opportunity to talk to the chef and to thank him for really an unforgetable dinner. Highly reccomend! Show less

Author: Marius S
Title: God lunsj og middag
Review: We had both lunch and dinner here today.  Both were really nice. We would especially recommend the romantic dinner at the beach where you sit all by yourself and watching the sun go down. Also, the ingredients were really nice!

Author: Andrei NMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great eye fillet on Langkawi
Review: Went there for a dinner. Very attractive beer prices. Lovely environment. Sunset. Ordered tenderloin with prawns - Surf and Turf as they call it. Unlike other local restaurants, Cba serves real McCoy. Superb service. Very good live music till late. Great place to enjoy a night.Show less

Author: robertaP4828TULeiden, The Netherlands
Title: Great birthday diner at the beach
Review: We had a great diner at this club at the end of the beach. We made a simple reservation via Facebook messenger on the same day as the diner. When we arrived they had a beautiful table ready with a great view of the of beach and sunset. The food was really good and not too expensive. Also the staff was really nice and kind and helped arrange a small birthday cake and song by the band. There was live music during the whole evening. Overall a great diner on a beautiful spot! Show less

Author: asrlt
Title: Great location
Review: Had a lovely meal next to the beach as a couple. Lovely relaxing atmosphere, band in the background and friendly staff. Recommend reserving a table in advance yo get the best seats for the beach and sunset.

Author: Tricia AWeston Turville, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing sunsets and cocktails
Review: Lovely bar with really helpful and friendly staff especially the lovely Irene ! Fantastic location right on the beach with amazing sunsets, really good choice of food at lunchtime and in the evening. Loved the Spanish gin cocktails especially the Only. Thank you for a really enjoyable week Tricia and John xShow less

Author: NataliaJ246
Title: #cba #SYAZWAN
Review: Very nice place, quite good choice of dishes freshly prepared and cooked. Very friendly, helpful staff always ready to have a chat. Highly recommend this place!

Author: stonelfio
Title: Holiday
Review: Fantastic bar/restaurant we’d already read the reviews so we knew it’d be good but the service was fantastic. Huge shout out to Mr Q for looking after us, cocktails and tapas it really was a happy hour !!!

Author: LainneGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing sunsets & cocktails!
Review: Went here for sunset drinks and managed to get there in time for happy hour! The location is incredible for views of the sunset and the atmosphere is great. Syazwan was a wonderful waiter, thoughtful and efficient! Make sure you get him to take pictures of you in front of the sunset - he’s awesome!! Highly recommend!! Show less

Author: 619tyleraGainsborough, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant for a beach sunset
Review: Nice restaurant with friendly staff and good food, the location is great if you want a sunset with your meal, there was a lot of choice on the menu and as my girlfriend and I are vegan we asked for certain meals without cheese which the waitress said this was fine, about 15 minutes later my girlfriends food arrived with cheese on it which was disappointing but also a big inconvenience to anyone who might be lactose intolerant and asked for no cheese on their food. All together a nice place just a shame about the one mistake.Show less

Author: leeernyap
Title: Nice staff
Review: Love this place. Very quiet but peaceful. Friendly and approachable staff , Qayyum did a magic to make the quiet night a bit brighter. :)

Author: AidaM1040
Title: Awesome
Review:
We enjoyed our stay in Meritus Pelangi resort and the various meals we had in Cba. Both food and service were awesome, And thumbs up to the most friendly waiter, Qayyum. 
Hope to visit Cba again next time.

Author: mary gMelbourne, Australia
Title: perfect sunsets....stunning
Review: this modern bar cafe is set on cenang beach with the perfect position to view the stunning sunset. the atmosphere is layback casual and service exceptional. happy hour 4-7 each day is worth the visit espresso martinis cheap $9AUD and to die for. a happy vibe as tourist enjoy the gorgeous surrounds and soft magic lights that light the night sky. worth a visit one of the coolest spots on the beach. enjoyShow less

Author: UnaMayGillespie2016
Title: Wonderful Evenings at Cba Restaurant, Meritus Pelangi Beach Resort
Review: Evening dinner by the sea at the splendid Cba restaurant is unforgettable. The staff are charming, friendly and lovely.The food is excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed every moment. Nothing is too much trouble and everyone went the extra mile to make sure we were happy.

Author: NoorIkhwanMdN
Title: Celebrating Wife's Birthday
Review: Great ambience for special dinner combined with spectacular beach view and sound...staffs are friendly and cool as they were helping me out wif de surprise cake and song..

Author: RENERONO
Title: nice food nice view
Review: nice food prepared by the chefs, good service and hospitality by mt Qayyum, chilled your self from the hot sun with nice cool beverage and food.

Author: Marianne13sm
Title: Good food and service!
Review:
Me and my boyfriend have been here a couple of time for dinner and food was very good! 
We were served by this very friendly and polite guy Amirul ( hope I spelled it correctly) 
I would definitely recommend also for the amazing sunset view!!

Author: joey7782Townsville, Australia
Title: Great service and sunsets!
Review: We visited Cba several times during our week long stay at Meritus Pelangi, sometimes for a meal or just for a cheap pint! Each time the service has been fantastic. Thanks Irene! It is right on the beach within the resort but is open to the public. Best sunset view ever!Show less

Author: Abhay K
Title: Great service
Review:
#cba #meritispelangi. 

Great time at this place. Thanks to qayyum. My Pakistani friend just back from his holiday!!

Author: JoeySarah123
Title: Vacation
Review: We are here right after our check in. The service was excellent. Qayyum really served us well. He made us laugh and attended to our needs, he made sure everything is alright with us. Great hospitality. Thumbs up.

Author: Rossifromthering
Title: Beach holiday
Review: Excellent service #Arvind, and all the team at CBA restaurant beach side. Always happy to serve with a smile, with optional sunglass cleaning service FOC.

Author: Barabbas_10Sofia, Bulgaria
Title: CBA Meritius Pelangi
Review: Well, good restaurant. Its very expensive(considering the prices in Langkawi). We were guests of the hotel and had few dinners here. In general the food is outstanding and the service is quite good and efficient. They have separate menu after 7pm, which is a bit limited in my opinion but very tasty indeed. The view for sunset is quite spectacular and its very romantic. Its good place, but because of the prices might be better to eat outside and come back for drinks.Show less

Author: tomtD1632UGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: An amazing little beach spot. Don’t be fooled by its appearance
Review: Despite looking like part of a high end hotel ( which it is) you will find the cheapest pint on the island here! The food is brilliant and very reasonable. We spent many a day here soaking up the sun and benefiting from the low prices . The l my negative is the lack of music. Show less

Author: RenS1975Sydney, Australia
Title: Great Food
Review: We stayed at the resort and had lunch here several times. We found lunch had great service but the food was pretty slow coming out of the kitchen but the food was really delicious so worth the waitWe went for dinner one night and waited 20minutes and still no one had taken our drink order so we left and went to the other restaurant and was served immediately and had a great experience with the Spice Market buffetShow less

Author: SmartTravellerHKHK
Title: The Breakfast was a Bit Disappointed
Review: We were staying here for 4 nights and had breakfast (included) here every morning. There were few selections and serving the same mediocre food every morning. We saw ants crawling up the pastries. There were few choices for the omelette (no mushroom) and they even burnt the fried eggs. Some of the food are empty and not replaced. The tables were not set up and we have to grab our own fork, knifes and napkins ourselves. The only thing I enjoyed was its location near the beach.Show less

Author: mfilcol2014Lisbon, Portugal
Title: Very nice location..but expensive and not very good food
Review: The Cba it's a very nice beach restaurante.Wonderful location in the sand.Very romantic..The menu is a 3 course meal .Starters and desserts in buffet style.Main courses by choice.The buffets are not very good and the main are just normal.We drunk a botle of an Australian wine.We've payed almost 140 euros for two persons.I think it was a litle expensive for the quality of the dinnerThe Cba is a wonderful bar to have some drinks but a not very good restaurantShow less

Author: keith47
Title: Nice views but a change of evening menu would have been appreciated
Review: We were on half board and while we had good meals for 6 nights we would have appreciated a change of menu. It became a bit limited after the fifth night.

Author: Tarek S
Title: Good restaurant
Review: It is good dinner with good sea view on beach it is great there is boy named #ARVIND good boy he is nice

Author: BehvreeSingapore, Singapore
Title: So bad I puked
Review: Came here for breakfast buffet that was included in our stay. Just looking at the spread was disappointing. I only took a bite on the chicken sausage, a cautious nip at their beef sausage, a spoon of pudding bread and their scrambled egg was so hard to swallow. Food was so disgusting I felt queasy and threw everything out in the toilet even though I barely even ate. Coming from a 5 star resort, their breakfast was really a huge disappoint, no standard, zero quality. I can easily get this kind of breakfast at any 3 star hotel. Plus, their food is not even warm????? Show less

Author: AnttiH_1987Kotka, Finland
Title: CBA - just a lovely beach restaurant @ meritus pelangi
Review: We stayed one week of our honeymoon on Meritus pelangi beach resort &spa, and have to say that CBA offered for us just an unforgettable moments.In first evening we had a (pre-booked) romantic 7 course sunset dinner on the beach, which was really tasty.We visited there couple of times and each time the food was great. This is a another restaurant, where you can get breakfast, too.We were really satisfied to service and can recommend this restaurant. Special thanks to Irene, for taking such a good care of us.Show less

Author: Ger HLimerick, Ireland
Title: Great dinner good breakfast
Review: We ate here 3 nights during our trip to Langkawi as well as every morning for breakfast.Breakfast comes with Prosecco.The options are not bad but after over a week I was sick of beef bacon and chicken sausages!!There is a limited enough dinner menu but what was on the menu was excellent. We worked our way through a lot of the items over our three dinners.The resident band can range from excellent to pure cheese!!!Show less

Author: Chris JCambridgeshire, United Kingdom
Title: What a great place to eat and right on our doorstep.
Review: This restaurant was our daily breakfast and dinner. Book a table near the beach and enjoy. Special thanks to Mukul and Irean who's attention made this a special memory for us. Breakfast is buffet with the addtion of fresh cooked eggs as you like them. Even a glass of bubbly is included. If you're near this area, don't miss it.Show less

Author: Mauro N
Title: Delightful Light Lunch on the Beach
Review: My wife and I were passing the Cenang Beach, and because it was lunchtime, we decide to have lunch in Cba. Although we were not guests in the Meritus Hotel, we were treated super nicely, and Qayyum went out of his way to make our lunch a pleasant experience. The brisket sandwich was undoubtedly one of the best sandwichs I ever had, and the scenery with the white beach in front of us made a beautiful for us.Show less

Author: 1Travelled_the_worldQinzhou, China
Title: Nice spot a little expensive
Review: Really great spot on Cenang Beach. The staff are always friendly and polite, the food is good but expensive, you're definitely paying for the view. However they do offer some good value eats. Their combo is a good choice but again drinks cost an arm and a leg! But of course we will eat there again just for the great service good taste and heavenly view. They offer various themed nights with BBQ and Buffet.Show less

Author: jazz lSlough, United Kingdom
Title: Cba
Review: Just returned from a great holiday in this resort.Staff at the Cba were so friendly.Choice of food was just right with no compliants.Special shout out defiantly goes out to Qayyam, who greeted not just us but all the guests with a big smile and happy voice as he welcomed us into the restaurant.Very busy person but always time for us.His special tea is amazing... being Indian, we love our Indian tea and he always made us the best tea ever!Thank you Qayyam!Look forward to returning for that warm hospitality you and your team provided.Show less

Author: RahulV1000
Title: Super experience!
Review:
#arvind

#harshit
You guys are rockstars. Been very courteous to us and to everyone else as well.  All the best for your future. Thanks for being so helpful. 
CBA 👌🏻

Somya Vishnoi

Author: 80AndyCPreston, United Kingdom
Title: Anniversary holiday
Review: First came to Pelangi Hotel 16 years ago. The Cba had materialised when we visited last year. Not only has this added ten fold to the quality of the hotel, but the Cba is open to non residents too. It's an absolute gem of a bar, quality staff, excellent prices, good food. We will miss this bar and all the staff who look after us so well every night. See you next year !Show less

Author: Светлана С
Title: Cba
Review: A very great place to hang out here... The staff is very friendly and helpful.. I love to come here every day... Waitress muskaan is very helpful and great... Thanks for provide a very great service

Author: tinal725
Title: Wonderful and relaxing place
Review: Wonderful place - Really good drinks and food as well, Friendly service, # Arvind and all the other kind staff

Author: CLIVEH222
Title: Holiday
Review: Excellent service especially from Mukul who looked after us on every visit.Highly recommended. Thank you Mukul.

Author: Jens S
Title: Cba
Review: Cba is a beautiful place, and Arvind is the absolut perfect waiter. So friendly and helpful. My Best recommandation, I want to come back time after time.

Author: Bente Blixt J
Title: Arwind is the Best
Review: Arvind is an AMAZING waiter. He Can talk with the guest, so they fell good. He is helpfull and smiling.Arvind have a Big overview. He is the Best.

Author: SteffannieF
Title: The sweetest waiter Arvind
Review: Such a luxury and relaxing hotel on the beach! And the restaurant has the most sweet waiter who name is Arvind, so look out for him, because he give the absolutely best service!

Author: Jacobep
Title: Arvind is The best
Review: The restaurant is really good and have a amazing view. The staff is really good and especially Arvind is amazing!

Author: Thea J
Title: Great service
Review:
This restaurant has the best service you can imagine! Arvind is the best waiter on the whole island. 
Also, the location is just perfect!!
Definitely worth a visit.

Author: Eugene S
Title: Very good sevice
Review: Cba restoran staff very nice and helpful specialy arvind, and they have amazing bartender (fizi). Thanks for the dinner guys !!!

Author: Marie R
Title: CBA Lang Kai Malaysia
Review: Having stayed at the hotel attached we visited this bar daily. Very good service and excellent food. Staff could not be more helpful. This bar is open to the public and everyone should visit as could not recommend enough! WELL done CBA team!

Author: linaps2017Malaga, Spain
Title: Fantastic service and food
Review: We stayed at the hotel adjoined to this bar ...and ended up eating and visiting most daysGreat person in charge ...Irene....she was great to ask all the tourist questions..The staff were the best we have had anywhere....polite to the extreme..Do not come to langkawi without a visit...fantastic views..great music.Show less

Author: PAULANDJUDERomseyROMSEY, UK
Title: Wonderful place, bring sandwitches
Review: In-edible food, exacerbated by defensive staff. Their large prawns are cooked in their shells then in batter, making them impossible to discern which is head (left on) or tail. The need for crisping the batter also overcooks the prawns. This is personal, but the waitress or manager, not sure which, just gave the normal, first complaint like this, so you must make your own mind up about this as a suitable method for prawns. The lamb was so tough as to be a challenge to any carnivore, but the salmon was acceptable.Show less

Author: Ingri-ingriVancouver, Canada
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: A great place to grab a drink! The view of the beach is stunning! A perfect place to unwind and go for a dip or read a book. We got the snack platter and that was decent. I would suggest more umbrellas/shade for the guests as the sun can be brutal! Our server was wonderful - an intern from Malaysia mainland. Show less

Author: rustytooMansfield Woodhouse, United Kingdom
Title: Service
Review: On our last visit to Cba we had excellent food but not good service We were given menus and asked almost immediately what we would like and not given enough time to decide Once we had decided there was no waiter to be seen except for one who spent most of the time talking to another guest. Eventually our order was taken but the wait for our food was very long. Normally the service is good here so wether there was a shortage of staff on this evening causing the problem I do not know. Over all everything is good Show less

Author: ReiStormPerth, Australia
Title: 10th Wedding Anniversary
Review: My husband and I were holidaying in Langkawi to celebrate our 10th Wedding Anniversary. We decided last minute that a romantic beach dinner would be a perfect way to celebrate and approached the manager(I think) Cba and asked if this would be possible. She without hesitation said yes and asked for 45minutes to set up. When we returned we were blown away with how beautiful the setting looked. Our waiter was so amazing and took several photos of us. He kept checking in on us and knew what we were drinking and only asked if we wanted another one. The food was amazing, but the staff and the beautiful setting topped it. At the end of our night to our surprise the band dedicated a song to us and the waiter brought out a desert. This really made our special day so memorable. Cba will forever be a special place for us!Show less

Author: Wienleoben
Title: perfect sunset - Fantastic Tapas
Review:
We stayed in the Meritus, so we went a few times to the beach bar.
Happy Hour is pretty cheap, but the Food is fantastic!!
You must taste the Tapas!!

Author: RoshanY34
Title: Cba
Review: The best place to hangout in Langkawi.. The service is excellent especially the hospitality from 2 staff members Muskaan and Arvind who were absolutely amazing and warm, will definitely visit again

Author: Luc N
Title: Evening out with friendsver
Review: Very Nice place amazing view excellent staff a big thanks for Angelina Farah Arvind for the good service you deserve a high five this is service with a big smile

Author: oceanlodgelangkawi
Title: Residence Card
Review:

Was my pleasure to go and enjoy this Evening at your Place Cba .
