See you again!

Author: 963nilabhp
Title: Good continental food with awesome sea view
Review: Staying in Meritus and having breakfast at CBA was a very beautiful experience.The breakfast spread is great and some awesome service from our hosts there. Being from India i had some fun conversation with Harshit and Arvind. They were very polite and suggested us good food and places to visit near by. Felt at home.The view from the restaurant is awesome and strongly recommended for a romantic date.Show less

Author: Sourabhsam23
Title: Excellent staff n food
Review: An excellent location to dine with fantastic view and awesome staff, specially Harshit n Arvind...boys were great!

Author: Mark H
Title: Beautiful Location
Review:
Excellent service, great location and very reasonable prices. 

Arvind, who served us on our second visit here was particularly pleasant and attentive.

Author: rogerharrisontho2017
Title: Excellent
Review: Excellent location with lovely attentive  friendly staff, the perfect place to relax with a cold beer and enjoy the views

Author: bader17
Title: Mr
Review: I had good times here and food was good all the stuff here friendly special Arvind I thinks any one here will enjoy

Author: Hitesh KChandigarh, India
Title: Amazing view and great service
Review: A perfect place to have drinks, having a mesmerising view of pantai cenang and Andaman Sea . Service is impeccable. Staff is extremely courteous, proactive, smiling and cheerful. I am a regular visitor from the past 6 months, just because of the staff and their service. I have recommended this place to many of my friends. Liquor is almost same everywhere but it's the service that matter's the most. A big shout out to few of the staff who has always delighted me by their service - Mr. Arvind Saini, Mr. Harshit Gupta , Mr. Mayank Sachdev and Mr. Mukul Narang. Whenever I visit Cba, I always any one of them and it's always a memorable experience of having drinks there. Mr. Qayyum Tahir equally deserves a round of applause for managing the bar with such a great team. Thank you once again to all the boy's and I look forward to visiting cba as much as I can till I'm in Langkawi. Show less

Author: NicosRef
Title: A lovely stay
Review: A good place with an amazing service. Staff are constantly smiling and always paying good attention. Arvind was very nice and helpful. Also cute :) haha

Author: Sumer C
Title: Excellent service at cba meritus
Review: Had a great time, thanks to the great service of the friendly staff especially mr arvind was very helpful and pleasant. Good job guys

Author: 532ayeshas
Title: Excellent visit
Review: We came to the Cba for dinner. Our experience was excellent. Arvind was very helpful and friendly. Our experience at the restaurant was brilliant. Everyone should come and visit this place. 😊

Author: 262andr_k
Title: One of the restaurants with the best service I’we ever been to!
Review: Special thanks to Qayyum for exceptional servica and pleasent conversations. He was always there whenever we needed somethingh, without giving us the feeling of him constantly standing over our table.

Author: Kine G
Title: Great food and service
Review: Had a great time here with 3 other friends. Amazing staff, very friendly and service-oriented. A special thanks to Qayyum, for exceptional service.The food was excellent as well, and we ended up sitting here the whole evening! Definitely coming back here when in Langkawi Show less

Author: Expedition714581
Title: Breakfast
Review: Very organised restaurant, fresh food, friendly & professional  staff. Spessial thanks to sweet waitress Muskoon, she always sucside to make my day beautiful.

Author: EllieRoseBKent, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner on the beach with Gluten Free options!
Review: We stayed at the Meritus Pelangi Beach Resort and Spa, and on our first night we were wandering along the beach at sunset when we saw this lovely restaurant on the beach. We spoke to a member of staff to confirm whether or not CBA could cater for my Gluten allergy. I can't remember the name of the lady that I spoke with, but she was very helpful and talked me through what I could eat from the menu. We made a reservation and walked back to the restaurant later that evening.I've always wanted to eat dinner on the beach, because I'm a sucker for a romantic setting, and we ended up eating here for both of the nights that we stayed in Langkawi. The food is rather pricey, but we chose to stay at a Luxury Hotel and eat at a Luxury Restaurant, so we couldn't really complain, plus the food was well worth the money. On the first night I had Steak and on the second night, a lovely stuffed Chicken. After we finished our meals on both evenings, we wandered to the bar to soak up the entertainment. There was a band playing live and they were brilliant! It truly was a lovely experience both nights and I really hope to go back again.Show less

Author: Gurj C
Title: Cba service No 1.
Review: If you visit this resort do visit the Cba bar. Excellent service with a smile. Arvind was especially helpful and was able to answer any questions i have about the island.

Author: john m
Title: Great experience
Review: I had a great stay in mertius pelangi beach and resorts spa ,the scenery is breath taking and the view is stunning ,must visit cba restaurant,staff is so humble .I specially like to mention about on of their staff ,ARVIND . He was so helpful and polite ,his customer service skills were excellent ,very friendly and it was a pleasure ,thanks for ur service and hospitality.Will come back n recommend.Show less

Author: MaxMaya
Title: Limited Menu But Great View Of The Ocean
Review: Menu is limited and mainly western food. Have a drink there and watch the horizon changes colors as the sun sets. Thereafter head to the Spic Market Restaurant for an awesome local dinner buffet.

Author: JCC-84
Title: Cocktail hour
Review: Friendly staff with a good list of beverages. Cocktail hour is 4-7pm and some popular drinks on special

Author: Tonyc32Tonyc32
Title: Nice view....and that's all.
Review: We came here to eat at the restaurant one evening. The view is great, watching sunset from the decking.Firstly the service is slow. Waiting some 15 minutes just to get a waiter to take a drink order. Then the drinks took some 15 minutes to arrive - not ideal when you have walked along the beach for a mile and are now sitting in the sun.Finally the food is expensive and of poor quality. I ordered a sirloin steak - a tender cut of meat. It was like old leather. It took 10 seconds to cut a simple piece and another 30 to chew!A tip i've learned over the year - when you order a steak and the first thing a waiter sugget is 'well-done?' - run.My friend described her meal as very average.Trust me, you can eat a lot better for half the price in many locations in Langkawi. Have a drink here and then move on.Show less

Author: RobandIwona
Title: Good food at the beach
Review: The food was very good and also the service. The price is higher but the food was tasty and the location was great!

Author: Hwee Mean T
Title: Great food!
Review: Went to Cba with my hubby, parents and 2 kids 2 times per day . We had beef salad and chicken nuggets in the morning.Evening we ordered steak, lamb rack, risotto, ravioli.Food tasted awesome. Service is good even the day we visit was Langkawi Ironman.The cafe is located right in front of the beach. Great sunset!Highly recommended !Show less

Author: Mirage OMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great tropical al fresco dining experience.
Review: My husband and I loved the relaxing tropical ambience of this restaurant and the impeccable service from the friendly staff. Our dinner was cooked to perfection and the complimentary appetizers and dessert samplers were a real treat. We thoroughly enjoyed our leisurely dining experience while being entertained by the performing band. All in all, we had a very good night.Show less

Author: Anki C
Title: Delicious dinner on the beach
Review: Cba is a restaurant at Meritius Pelangi Hotel. The restaurant is right on the beach which makes it a great setting. We had fish and prawns for dinner and both dishes were great both for the taste buds and the eye. Can really be recommended!

Author: taffysboyLlanwrtyd Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Cba Oasis of our holiday
Review: Wife and I + friends used the Cba as our midday drinks and lunch spot. A few years ago it was the Boat House but the change is for the better in our opinion. Some evening we had dinner there with its magnificant sea and distant views. Food was of very good quality and the staff amazing. I'm not naming them they were all great - they made our holiday. We hope they get to see this review.Show less

Author: jeanylea
Title: Nice view
Review: Nice food and nice view. Not a huge restaurant but it is good for hanging out at night with friends as there are live bands performing until 12 midnight.

Author: Nm78
Title: A Magic place
Review:
It’s a magic place on the sea, if you want lunch or drink it’s ok! 
Very good tapas, beautiful staff, 
Not to be missed!!

Author: FiloLavi
Title: Beautiful
Review:
This is the best place to spend the evening in Langkawi! The stunning view of the beach, good music and good drinks. The staff is simply the best, always smiling, very well prepared and very welcoming!
Can't wait to go back there.

Author: Katherine D
Title: Great service, great view
Review: Really recommend! Mr Q was so lovely to us! Beautiful setting of the white sanded beach and great cold drinks and a wide variety of food :)

Author: MackenzieF68
Title: Great view, better service!
Review: Walked into Cba off the beach looking for a beer while enjoying the sunset, and enjoy we did! Atmosphere is relaxed, yet upscale, and the staff are exceptional; thank you Mr. Q for taking such good care of us! Definitely recommend Cba whether you're looking for a casual beer, or something a little more fine dining. Show less

Author: suhailahh2016
Title: Best beach club in Malaysia
Review: Where else in Malaysia can u listen to an amazing band playing n watch the sunset. Perfect setting. Listening to music under the stars with the cool sea breeze blowing on your face.The band The A list was awesome. Powerful vocals n takented musicians. Perfect evening...Show less

Author: 478sallyb
Title: Gluey pasta. Way overpriced
Review: Came here on mother daughter dinner while staying at the resort. Nice atmosphere and good service. Spinach ravioli was dreadful. No flavour. Gluey. Yuck. Won't be back.

Author: jodyreynoldsGreat Dunmow, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing.
Review: If you want a sunset to die for, lovely food, good beer and friendly staff then this is the bar to come to. Had never been made to feel so welcome. Irene, in particular, deserves a mention. She always made time for us and felt like old friends by the time we left. The bar had a band playing most nights. The A Street band were great. They played a mixture of music, English and Malaysian and had a fantastic rapport with the crowd. We can't fault this bar. Show less

Author: Jack R
Title: Review of visiting CBA
Review: We visited CBA resort numerous times while on our stay in Langkawi Island in Malaysia. NOT only were the staff extra compliant and friendly (espwcially Irene, the manager at the time) but the prices were also the best we had seen on the entire beach during our stay. I would recommend visiting CBA to anyone staying in Lagkawi for any duration as it is a place in which they will not only about by a place in which they will want to return to after their first visit. Show less

Author: samrclayton
Title: Great place!
Review:
Amazing spot at the end of the beach and the beer prices are the best around! 
Mr Q and Irene will make you feel right at home! 
Much love! 
Sam.

Author: isaacjlawrence
Title: Wowzers
Review: Amazing service. The best tap beer i've had in Asia! Outrageously cheap price as well. Best on the beach. Such a quiet neck of the woods but this surely can't be kept a secret for much longer. Cheers Cba, you made my life here a lot more drunk Show less

Author: rhclimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good ambience
Review: We had dinner on the second night of our stay and we did not regret it. The ambience was great as it was by the beach. The food served was good and reasonably priced. It is also a good place to hang out in the day although we did not do it.Show less

Author: Downunder44
Title: What a set up
Review: Tastefully decorated , next to beach set up. A la carte menu with very reasonable prices , 3 course menu $40 AUD . Stuff very helpful , manager Irene from Italy very professional and accomodating. Live music with great talents is bonus

Author: matthrelkLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic sunset! Great staff!
Review: The staff at Cba are all very friendly and the service is second to none. Jeff in particular provided us with a great insight into the do's and dont's of Langkawi. We have been to a couple of places along the Pantai Cenang beach and haven't found anywhere better to watch the sunset. With a drink in hand, it really is a special place. Although the food is slightly more pricey than elsewhere along the beach, we really enjoyed it and thought it was worth the extra cost, the coconut beef brisket sandwich is awesome. Matt & Yasmin Show less

Author: Vivek S
Title: Amazing view. amazing food and beer. Amazing hospitalality
Review: I stayed at meritus for 3 days and had most of our meals here. There couches provide great sunset view..a must have! Staff is very cordial and provide superb service. Strongly recommended.

Author: 128diptik
Title: Cba
Review: Amazing view, beer and service!! Was there with family!! Try coming here for sunset! Thr view is awesomee!!

Author: Tan D
Title: A place can't miss
Review: Very beautiful with very good environment restaurant and bar just beside of beautiful beach. Recommended for couple, friends and family visitors. Especially very good service served by Q,

Author: makhn
Title: Chill out
Review:
Nice place to chill out. Kronenberg 1664 is a must 😉 Good aroma 🍺. 
Awesome ambient and dynamic liveband.
Excellent service!

Author: Habanawawi
Title: Late lunch with nice view
Review: Having late lunch by the beach. Looking at the plane landing and taking off. Having our pizza and nachos. Nachos is good with the guacamole is superb. Having some cocktail and the hotness of the day are drain with some other cold juices.

Author: sparklor
Title: Awesome location, great tapas afternoon menu and fantastic staff
Review: Cheap beer all day long and an awesome place to bring your entire family for as rekaxing drink by the sea...highly recommended

Author: tortillajackson
Title: Beach beer
Review: Great place to grab some cheap brews with your buddies. Sunset and the homies, Jeff was an awesome waiter too

Author: Clara_arg
Title: Beautiful place
Review: Beautiful and confortable place to eat good food and drink cool beer next to the beach! Great spot for sunset !(L)

Author: henilansQueenstown, New Zealand
Title: Sunset chill
Review: Having a nice cold beer on a hot day.Perfect place to view sunset.Located next to a beatifull white sand beach in town of Cenang. Perfect place for friends and couples aswell.Very low prices where at first it may seem it may have been more.Enjoyed my evening!Show less

Author: srimart
Title: Amazing venue
Review:
Without question the finest venue in Pantai cenang 

The views are stunning and the food is equally as good 

The service is superb and the atmosphere is relaxed with live music

Author: David HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic beach restaurant (within Meritus resort)
Review: A beach side, mostly outdoor restaurant with wonderful views of the setting sun across the water. Good menu with lots of variety, and the main course includes a buffet starter and buffet desert. You only find this out by watching others! Food was well presented and very tasty and the service excellent. Good choice of drinks also. Jeff the manager was very helpful and really cared that we enjoyed our experience. There is a good band playing every night making the whole experience one to remember. You must give this place a try.Show less

Author: BMColeman
Title: Great service and beer
Review: Great place to go. Service is second to none and the beers are cold and cheap! 8rm for a Carlsberg and they offer a full pint

Author: panjangi
Title: Birthday celebrations plus dinner
Review: I had wonderful dinner plus birthday surprise party at this restaurant. All my planned come true due to Christopher Oog. He really do served me with excellent customer service and understand well my wish. FUI, we only communicated by email. Even though some part unable to fulfill. But I really admire how he handle with etiquette to all my enquires. He really showed what customer service should be like. Five stars for him. Secondly, the manager of CBA restaurant Mr. Jeff Wong. Warm personality and great guy. He really concerned about us. Very friendly guy I must said. funny as well. Not so serious when dealing with me. I like that. So easy to communicated the entire night. He arranged special waiter for us to take care our dinner. I believe customer will like Mr. Jeff so much. . I like everything from the table setting. Very basic but sweet. The pelita's arrangement at the beginning of our table. The most important thing our bonfire. Capture all the attention at the beach. Really make my wish alive. Beach, wind, fire, food and great customer service. What more i can say. CBA's not just did excellent job but beautiful memory to me and my friends. Well done and millions of thank you Show less

Author: moonfoxy
Title: Great place to enjoy food and view!
Review: Been there twice and strongly recommend to go during sunset. the view is spectacular!! Decent food and great service, they are very friendly and good recommendation for food and drink, definitely a go to place if i could go visit Malaysia again:)

Author: William C
Title: Great beach bar
Review: Best beach bar we visited on while on Langkawi. Clean, comfortable, good service, nice food and drinks. Geoff was great.

Author: scott r
Title: Great Service at CBa
Review: Had such a great time at CBa. Jeff was a true professional that looked after our every need! Awesome place for sunset drinks!

Author: Carolina A
Title: Great bar and restaurant
Review: The best place to see the sunset and enjoy a good moment with your friends, drink, eat and beer. The service is really friendly

Author: David Q
Title: Best restaurant on Cenang beach
Review:
Unreal, great pints of carlsberg for only 8RM, unreal views. 
The staff and service are top class!!!
Live music nightly 👍

Author: Ed_G1975
Title: Superb staff and location
Review: Beautiful, tranquil beach setting (sun or rain).  Food, drinks and service all very good.  Staff, in particular, are wonderfully friendly and accommodating.  Well worth a visit.

Author: 588kennethw
Title: All ways excellent
Review: Hospitality and friendliness of the staffs, Cba restaurant severing an excellent quality of food, also being treated respectfully and in a friendly way by the staff and the restaurant manager. all gave us a gorgeous, relaxation and unforgettable memory in the beautiful sunset. Good Job!!! Thank youShow less

Author: Janz0119
Title: Nice sunset and cheaper draft beer only 5rm
Review: I was been there with my girl friend at last week,I not stayed in this hotel but really can't imagine how nice amazing sunset came into my eyes.(Please refer the picture which I attached it) in front of CBA. So we are finally sit down for couple drinks there. It was amazing nice view. Draft beer in CBA very cheaper only 5rm for half pint. Staffs there good smile and friendly. One of Chines guy there was very friendly and we are have a good communication. Kudos I not comment about the food because we didn't take a dinner. But we will return back soon if possible. Show less

Author: sjoerdl339
Title: Perfect food, service and wine.
Review: Great beach restaurant and also perfect western and local food. Perfect service and wines are great. Live music. Recommend.

Author: Trent1987
Title: Amazing!!!!
Review: What a beautiful bar....best atmosphere and food in Langkawi!!! Jess and Q are the best!! Thank you!!!

Author: NicholasW1849
Title: Great views
Review: Great views of the sea and sunsets. Really great place to sit and drink... beer is cheap. Staff really friendly. Food prices are way over the top... handed the menu back

Author: Ian_Macca2
Title: Great Birthday Celebration
Review: Arranged Romantic Dinner on the sand and was a great night, the band played my favourite Bon Jovi song when the cake came out and the chef made a special request dinner. Was a great night thanks to all the team

Author: 830sverrerGran Canaria, Spain
Title: Good besh view
Review: This is a good option if you want lunch on the Beach. There is a wide range of delicious courses to choose from. Happy hour quite earley in the afternoon makes this a good place to have a couple of drinks as you watch the beautiful view of the Beach, the Ocean and the nearby islandsShow less

Author: KirinPancha
Title: Happy hour
Review: Brilliant band and fab happy hour! Tapas are fusion flavours. Can't go wrong best sunset seats in Langkawi!

Author: DucatiMartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap beer, good manager
Review: Don’t choose to stay at the Meritus Pelangi because of this review, better to read my review of the Meritus Pelangi first.The Cba is the Meritus Pelangi’s only redeeming feature and for two reasons:1) They have a very good Pakistani bar manager, who stands out above all the other other staff at the Meritus Pelangi. Maybe the whole place would be in better shape if he was in overall control of the hotel … Sorry I didn’t get his name - he is tall and has a bald head and you will clearly recognise who I am talking about if you go there.2) They sell Carlsberg at RM 8 per pint, which is a good price in the Pantai Cenang area.We only tried a few snacks here at lunchtime, they were adequate, but expensive for what they were.Show less

Author: Oldestbull
Title: Watered down cocktails at happy hour ..
Review:
Was supposed to have live music every night but didnt happen
No Explanation
Was shut down 3 days into our stay 
No notice .

Author: _Wx33_
Title: Quite dinner
Review: Had a small dinner after a very long day of tours and other activities.  I loved the atmosphere, there was live band playing and my little kid loved it!  Food was very good as well.

Author: gezb
Title: Fabulous setting
Review: Had an a la carte meal. This included a free salad buffet which had a good choice of salad , meats, smoked fish, etc. Also a choice of desserts included in the price. Averaging about £20 per person upwards. Excellent quality and service.

Author: IamWael
Title: Sunset Dinner
Review:
Dinner after 7 is quite interesting (pay for your main dish and get complimentary appetizers and desserts).
Tapas are a must (Seabass). 
Strongly recommended ambiance and food for sunset-dinner seekers.

Author: Anna P
Title: Great service by a setting sun
Review: We've eaten at Cba twice so far during our stay and had multiple cocktails.. The staff are all very friendly especially Q who really delivers service with a smile! Food is good with an interesting array of options including tapas (pictured). It's also a lovely place to watch the sunset, right by the beach. Show less

Author: norbertjuneSingapore, Singapore
Title: Get more than what you paid for
Review: Situated at the beachfront of Pantai Cenang, this bar and restaurant serves international cuisine and a wide variety of wine and cocktails.On the dinner we had, we did not make any reservation but still got one of the best spots, the patio right infront of the buffet spread. Yes, they have dinner buffet! When you get any a la carte mains and starters and add few MYR, you can enjoy seafood and dessert buffet.The mushroom soup is to-die-for and the filet mignon is heavenly.Around 8pm is when the crowd started coming in.There's a live singer in the area and the staff are accommodating and approachable.Now that's value for money!Show less

Author: pjcot1Greater Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great tapas, outstanding views, a little oricey
Review: You get what you pay for. Although a little pricey, the service is excellent and the tapas (22MYR) are delicious. The two of us aren't ones for heavy meals in this humidity, so found 3 plates of tapas between us was a perfect meal to finish the day. A "cheap" beer (carlsberg) is 8MYR a pint or bottles/Kronenberg are 12 upwards. Meals are 30 and upwards. Happy hour 4-7The sunset views are the highlight. CBA at meritus pelangi is located at the northern end of cenang beach and as such is a lot quieter than the huzzbuzz of jet skis and tourists in the main section.Show less

Author: ilo2728
Title: Excellent ambience and great band
Review: We had a dinner set outside the restaurant which oversee the sun set and a pleasant array of pot trees in between our table. it was a divine dining while the band sang good music and entertainment,

Author: Fjodolf1
Title: Late dinner
Review: Very good roasted duck and ravioli. Prices are $$$ but with the dinner you get "free" starters and deserts from the buffet. The view over the sea is beautiful. All in worth it.

Author: TravelwithGarIreland
Title: Came to Cba bar for the cocktails - terrible let down
Review: Wow, had been looking forward to sundown cocktails at Cba bar, based on an old recommendation - but what a disappointment. Clear sense that the cocktail crew think they are better than they are.The location is pretty excellent, right beside the beach & perfect for sunset. However, the Margarita barely tasted of any alcohol, completely diluted and tasteless - hard to know how they got it so wrong. I had the Horizon (?) Punch which had most of the ingredients of a Mai Tai, which I fancied, but with the added addition of grenadine syrup. I had specifically asked up front to just add a drop of the syrup, but of course no one listened and I was presented with a strawberry coloured concoction which went straight back.If you are putting yourself out there as a cocktail spot you have to deliver the goods and most especially if you are charging the higher end pricing!We didn't try the restaurant and based on our albeit limited experience it did not endear itself to us. Very easily rectified if there is a will to get it right!Show less

Author: JJSWindsor
Title: The tapas are sensational!
Review: We only had dinner there once which was very good but we had the tapas every day after we came off the beach and they were absolutely sensational!  Malaysian style, not Spanish and freshly made every day.

Author: headwig53Frimley Green, United Kingdom
Title: Hit and miss
Review: For a drink and something to eat it should be good but the service let this place down badly for the first seven days you could wait up to 15 mins to get served after mentioning it to a manager it has got better so it now back up to what it should menu is varied no a bad place to see the sunset Show less

Author: John H
Title: Lager
Review: Carling is 8RM a pint here, rather than 18 just 40m away in the hotel or by the pool. Considering the exercise will do you good. Snacky food, especially the fish and chips, with a malaysian twist, in cheap and tasty.

Author: Joelle85avfcLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Expensive and extremely poor service
Review: We visited this restaurant and bar on night one of our stay at Meritus Pelangi, wanting somewhere close to get an early night for convenience. The hotel itself is lovely, but the bar and restaurant of Cba were just terrible.The pricing was expensive- yet if the quality of food was there and service- we probably would have dined here again. It has fantastic views of the area and right on site to where we are staying, so on first appearance we thought this would be somewhere we would like to come back to.The waiter serving our table was more interested in chatting up women at the bar and disappearing. We went for the menu which was a three course meal regrettably at 130RM each. After each course, we cleared our own tables and kept going to the bar to order our own drinks, this is after asking several times.Having been to the bar at lunch and in the evening thinking it may be a one off- the service is awful. But no, the service is just terrible.Add to that, the dessert had ants all over it and the starter buffet was out of a tin, my boyfriend's risotto wasn't fully cooked, my parents asked for rare steaks (came out well done); it was just an awful meal and a total rip off.It is convenient for lunch and a quick beer; but it isn't worth the hassle. The one positive is beer is quite cheap, but then it is just as cheap everywhere else.Go into the town to find better value and better quality food and service.We went to the hotel next door for one meal, which was cheaper still- but the food was sublime, as was the service. People don't mind paying for quality, but if there is no quality, don't rip them off.Show less

Author: E2052AWdaniels
Title: Wonderful beach restaurant
Review:
While spending the time at the great beach this is the perfect spot to drink or eat something in this nice restaurant.
The view to the sea os just amazing there.

Author: BriIisSomerton
Title: All round excellence and catch the A Street Band while still in residence
Review: Although I had some issues with the Meritus resort where the CBA bar and restaurant is located, the CBA was excellent in all respects. Leading the front of house, Mr Lee, who was there for the first few days of my stay, and Lon for the remainder, were both perfect hosts, and made some very good recommendations regarding dishes and other items, as well as being great just to chat to. Back in the kitchen Chef Bob produced some fabulous dishes, and I felt particularly privileged when after he came out for a chat he made me more than one "Bob Special", including a Chinese style dish with the most unctuous sauce I have ever had with and style of meal.And on top of this the A Street band from KL were in residence; with three years of playing under their belt, they are a tight a high quality outfit who completely looked and sounded the part. Particularly memorable was leader and vocalist Zazalin version of "I Will Always Love You" which she totally owned- truly better than the original.Show less

Author: MJ V
Title: Various choices
Review: There are various choices here but you can get a small bites menu which is plenty adequate while you sit and watch the fishermen at night.  A pint of carlsburg is very reasonably priced as well.

Author: flyingcarrot9
Title: Well located for lunch
Review: Staying at the hotel, so easy place to come for something to eat and drink if not wanting to go out the complex.They serve nice drinks, and thus far have no complaints about the food.You do pay a little more than further down the beach, but not by much.I would come back, more out of convenience,as we would like to try as many different restaurants as possible during our stay.Show less

Author: TomRocky
Title: Very nice beach restaurant
Review:
We had dinner at the beach and the food was good. We had Malaysian chicken, ravioli and steak. Dinner comes with a starter and dessert buffet.

Kids had fun playing at the beach. Service was attentive and Chianti wine was good (at 270)

Author: jomo50blue
Title: First bigh Meal.
Review: As this was our first night at the resort after spending several days travelling we decided to stay ion the resort to have a meal. setting was spectacular but the meal was nothing special meat was tough and bony.

Author: kahiromijpTokyo, Japan
Title: Very attentive and helpful staff
Review: Since first moment the staffs were very attentive and helpful. Specially on our last night the staff arranged a table by the beach and made everything for us to feel happy on our last dinner in Langkawi. During day time we could opt to eat at Cba, at the beach or by the pool. Please try their fresh juice! Show less

Author: Ruby C
Title: Amazing beach view
Review: It,s. a BBQ on the beach with something   for everyone to eat inc vegetarians, give the cocktails a miss not the best. The view is spectacular and certainly very relaxing - dress is casual

Author: Mikhail GLund, Sweden
Title: Dropped quality a lot!
Review: I was here in Jan 2015 and lunch was really good and delicious. A year after, got more or less the same items from the menu, and its like day and night in quality!Beef salad started to use cheaper kind of beef and cuts. Tasteless dressing and missing half of the ingredients listed on the description in menu.Margarita pizza is just a disgrace to cooking... it has large parts of barely cooked dow. Sloppy dumper ingredients on it. When we got it with completely white crust and massive parts missing sauce and cheese, asked to fix it, received same pizza back just being heated more but yet not even colour in it.Show less

Author: Lars S
Title: Dinner on the beach
Review:
Great location on the breach. BBQ buffet night was excellent. All the staff were so friendly. Live music put us all in mood. 
Would definitely come back here.

Author: V M
Title: Relaxing beach view
Review:
A very relaxing place set on the beach.  Good selection of food and drinks with live entertainment.
Nice place for evening drinks on the beach

Author: Vicki T
Title: Part of  Pelangi beach resort
Review: Great location really friendly staff great for drinks and watching the sunset however the night we had dinner with friends they had sold out of most of the seafood and Malay dishes so a bit dissapointing and what I then ordered was a bit average

Author: Laith T
Title: It is worth the money
Review: We discovered this place after deciding to take a long walk on the beach . To be honest , it is one of the top restaurants in Langkawi . The prices are reasonable, the place is very clean , the staff are very welcoming and soooo nice , especially "Qayyum" he is very nice guy , he took us a very romantic picture . You feel the staff love their job . The food is 5 stars and variant , they have good menu . We loved the place and had dinner there 3 times in one week ! Show less

Author: siewfeunk
Title: Little pricey but delicious food
Review:
Good thing is, if you order a main course, the restaurant offered the salad bar for free. So, we had so much to eat and it was nice!

Somehow, the cocktail was not as impressive as what other reviewers' comments on tripadvisor.

Author: Eric Y
Title: Surprisingly good!
Review: My family and I ordered pizzas for lunch and were pleasantly surprised that such great pizzas were served for a restaurant located away from the Cenang road. Great food, great music and great view of the sea!

Author: 361grahame
Title: Awesome location but expensive food
Review: Although the food here was tasty enough, it was very expensive compared to other restaurants in Pantai Cenang. What you're really paying for is the location, set right on the beach. The location is undeniably awesome, and it's a great place to have a few drinks and watch the sun set. Happy hour was from 4-7pm, but was 'only' a 30% discount (unlike the more normal 2-for-1 drinks). Having said that, the cocktails were nice and the RM4 half pint draught beer (available all day) was excellent value.Show less

Author: SteveF3118Cherngtalay, Thailand
Title: Amazing!
Review: My wife and I visited Cba and celebrated her 40th birthday on the beach with a romantic meal. Ben and Quyyan were fantastic in helping me to make this a very special night for my wife on her birthday and it couldn't have been more perfect. We had a special table on the beach, several fantastic courses of lovely food and a bottle of wine. The food was brilliant - our compliments to the chef - the band was great and the service was second to none. All in all, it was a fantastic evening and one we'll remember for a long time. Thank you to all at Cba - you made our holiday!Show less

Author: 130bahjatm
Title: Great
Review:
Good bar 
Excellent service super drinks
Every Sunday there is a band playing good songs
Kind of empty but the experience was good
Cheap beer

Author: 505liamc
Title: Nice... but expensive
Review: Went here as the beach is the calmest and emptiest of Cenang beach. But the prices are pretty ridiculous. Otherwise it's a nice bar. Not sure what it's like at night as I went there during the day.

Author: Haps101Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: beautiful sunset views
Review: This restaurant is right on the beach, so you can have dinner watching the sun set. There is a good selection of meals, even for vegetarians. Live music at night from 9pm. The waiter staff are very nice, especially the manager, who made us feel welcome & looked after us. Pricewise, it is similar to UK restaurant prices, so not too expensiveShow less

Author: kitwalker82Canberra, Australia
Title: great location
Review: Sensational food and even better cocktails! We dined with some people we met at the bar and had a very enjoyable night.I was dissapointed that my entree came out after my main meal so by that time i didn't feel like eating it which was a waste of money but that was the only real negative. The band that was playing was also amazing and did a great job entertaining us. Perfect spot for an afternoon beverage to watch the sunset (that just so happened to turn into a night of us staying until close!)Show less

Author: Helene L
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Great food, good value on dinners as we benefitted from a promotion  with starters and desserts included with the main course. The view on the sea for sunset is marvellous. Very very good place.

Author: TinarieR
Title: Deliciously!
Review:
The menu is great! Served in Big portion even the kids meal. Staff service was very good. Nice view  infront of the beach. Very relaxing and appetizing. If you're still staying at Meritus Pelangi don't miss it!  
Spaghetti bolognese is the bomb! Love it.

Author: 155arndsHamburg, Germany
Title: Outstanding place for dinner at Langkawi
Review: For sure one of the best places for dining at Langkawi island is the Cba restaurant in the Meritus Pelangi Beach Resort. The restaurant is located at the beach front, open to the water between palms. At day open for snacks and cocktails and refreshments the dinner menu changes to haut cuisine. A fine selection of main dishes (fish, beef, poultry, vegetarian) is combined with a delicious starter and dessert buffet. All is served by friendly and service oriented staff. The live music is nice. We recommend to finish the dinner with a cocktail - classic or Cba special, all well made. As part of the luxery resort the Cba prices are high in comparison to restaurants around, but the restaurant clearly plays in another league of cuisine.Show less

Author: 474jeannettem
Title: Delicious!
Review: Beautiful location and food. Good service. More upmarket in meals and price but delicious. Not a lot of choice on menu though.

Author: waelonsyDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent is not enough to explain this place
Review: Cba was perfect in every single way, it's a restaurant that everyone dreams to eat in during a vacation. The restaurant is placed right on the beach where you can have a 5star dish with beautiful representation. The ambience is absolutely beautiful especially after enjoying the sunset you get to enjoy the live band. You get a large selection of high quality appetisers and desserts from the buffet. I could honestly say it was one of my favourite parts of the night after a great day at the hotel.Show less

Author: Chandu_trvl
Title: Excellent and nothing the beat the dinner ambiance
Review: Perfectly located. Very nice dinner ambiance with the live band and view in front. the food is okey. Attentive staff, though you will have to wait a while to grab their attention. Highly Recommended.

Author: TerminatorSarawakSarawak
Title: Average
Review: Friendly staff but food are just average and small portion. The buffet appetizer and desserts are free for those who order the main course. It is kinda dirty as u can see that the food "were attacked and swarmed" with insect here and there. The menu - less choice tho.Show less

Author: JCsAdventuresSydney, Australia
Title: Good food, great view!
Review: We ate a late lunch here while waiting to check in to our hotel. We were eating light--steak salad and chicken Caesar salad, but both were excellent. Raspberry vinaigrette on steak salad was delicious. Waiters were friendly and let us take our time eating and watching the ocean. Music selection was Spanish then switched to English but recognizable. Show less

Author: muhammadqayyumt
Title: Amazing affordable Food..
Review: Best place for dine either Lunch or Dinner at Cenang Beach Area. Calm and cozy .. Staff is very helpful. Live music from *:15 pm till mid night. They have some special cocktails too.. Don't miss if you are in Langkawi.

Author: Wolfgang DHong Kong, China
Title: Noise
Review: I been there for an afternoon snack. The waiter are perfect and the Minestrone soup i have ordered was just perfect in Taste. We also received our order within minutes. The serious drawback and annoyance was that at 3pm the Life Band was there and did some sort of Training session which have destroyed our experience.Show less

Author: TooHardtoPickaNameSydney, Australia
Title: Great beach, awesome sunset
Review: Food is good, not excellent. For local standards prices are very high. They include the appetiser and dessert buffet if you order a main. I had lobster which was good. The prawns on the appetiser buffet were very poor. I enjoyed my salad. The desserts (mostly little cakes) are plentiful and good. But the location right on the beach is awesome (there are other beach restaurants too but this one has the best location on the point).I enjoyed it, but for the price I prefer the buffet in the aim restaurant in the hotel. Show less

Author: K3532HCannak
Title: Amaizing sunset
Review:
This place is made for a cocktail against the sunset after a hot sunny day.
The happy hours make it even better)))

Author: shkaziKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Lovely place for dinner / sunset
Review: The resturant setting is wonderful. Besides the beach which bends like a boomerang. Tables were nicely set. We had our last-day-at-Langkawi dinner / sunset here. We were not disappointed with the buffet (RM 120 per head for Adults and RM 60 for the kids)Service was great. Attentive. Plates were removed timely. Staff volunteered to take pics.Soup was excellent. Starters pretty good. Buffet had great variety of fish, prawns, crabs, lamb, chicken, beef, mussels, vegetable dishes, pizza and pasta. Not everything was great. But plenty of things were good too. I took several helpings of things i loves (Few directly from the grill). 4 ⭐️s are due to overdone beef stake (i take my stake seriously) and the prawns were not large enough. Else would have given it 5/5. Desserts were great too. Plenty of variety. Including fresh fruits, local desserts.Sunset was simply amazing. Lovely memories.Show less

Author: 272SteveNBurton upon Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed Overall
Review: Fabulous beach front location with stunning views. Really exceptional location. Format is that you buy a main and you get free visit to starter and desert buffet. Starter buffet poor. Very limited choice although it included crab claws but no tools to use so impossible to eat. Mains however were great. I had lobster and my partner had tenderloin of beef. Both great although the beef came with no accompaniments. Desert buffet useless. Basically lots of cake and not much else. My wife is gluten free so pretty poor.Biggest problem for us is that white wine option is exclusively a single Chardonnay. This was either by the glass or bottle. In my book that is totally useless. However we think we heard someone ask for Pinot Grigio later and was obliged but we weren't sure.Avoid unless you are happy with one good course and are prepared to accept downsides for the fabulous location.Show less

Author: BL_Leo
Title: One of the best beachside restaurant with a stunning view of sunset.
Review: Price-wise its on the high side but hey... it's a fine dining concept. Expect at least RM100 per head as its main cost from sub-100 onwards... and that haven't included drinks. Happy hour is from 4pm-7pm so take advantage of this.

Author: PerArneK
Title: Good but expencive
Review: Really nice food and perfect location (on the beach). Very good and yummy buffet. Good service. Anyway maybe to expensive compared to other places...

Author: JanetHexLancashire, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely setting, live music but really poor quality buffet
Review: Setting is on the beach - gorgeous - and service was quite good. We had high expectations of the buffet which was 150 RM pp. Unfortunately it was poor - the quality was suited to a 3 star all inclusive hotel - not a 5 star resort. We got tiny servings of fish and meat which were full of bones. 150 RM is £25 - not cheap, and ridiculously expensive compared the other restaurants here. I don't think a single table had a bottle of wine, and no wonder, with prices starting at about 150 RM for what is available in other restaurants for 70RM or less.Show less

Author: jennier706Westward Ho, United Kingdom
Title: Slooooow!
Review: Only ate here once (and didn't try the buffet, but found when we stopped for a drink a few times that although all the staff are lovely, it took an age to get our order taken and even longer for the drinks to come! Very nice touch with the white wine though, glasses had been kept in the freezer and as soon as the chill mist had cleared, we were brought fresh frozen glasses to transfer our drinks into. Good cocktails too, just a shame about the wait times.Show less

Author: José Carlos d
Title: Very interesting
Review: We were very pleased to visit the CBA restaurant. The service was excellent, the food variated and the menu quite interesting.

Author: sarahhT4365SK
Title: Poor service.
Review: The food was average, with some being quite nice. Paella was one of the good ones. The steaks were also nice. The service was slow, refill of food was slow and some were finished. We had to ask multiple times for a baby chair. One weird thing was the desserts were under spotlights, and many of them were melting / losing its shape. Even the plates were very warm to touch. Show less

Author: CheshireJazzladyCheshire
Title: Buffet dinner on the beach
Review: Excellent choice but the food was a bit tired when we came to eat at 9.00pm. We felt the BBQ meat was past its best and although there was plenty to eat it was much poorer value at 125 ringgits than the lunch time at the Spice Garden for 60Show less

Author: jai_family_traveller
Title: no ala carte dinner
Review: Great joint, by the sea on rear side of meritus pelangi.  Staff is too good.  Unfortunately, they promote fixed menu buffet dinners.  Menu is good but price too overly expensive.  Not very crowded since they are too expensive for dinner.  Otherwise, must visit.

Author: kaz747
Title: Great for lunch
Review: Wonderful views over the beach. Cold beer. Chicken tacos were great. Hubby had the Mexican wrap which he thoroughly enjoyed too. Looking forward to returning for more.

Author: airtasker_ausSydney, Australia
Title: Good cocktails but the meals failed to impress
Review: The BBQ at CBA is highly talked about by the staff but at 300MYR per person it is not worth the money. The food is more cartered for western taste and felt like a waste of money compared to the eateries in cenang district. The drinks are quite good though. There also seems to be more attention being paid towards larger tables rather than a couple that have just some to enjoy dinner.Show less

Author: Lyn G
Title: Nice hotel buffet.
Review: We had the bbq buffet here our 1st night in Langkawi. It was typical resort prices but very nice. The location overlooking the water was beautiful. They had a nice wine list & the service was great!

Author: James V
Title: High price for no service
Review: At AU$85 for 2 people to have dinner including 1 drink each + water you're at the higher end of dinning prices. Unfortunately for this you get very small servings & no service. The manager Christopher seems to be the worst especially if there's any issues with your meal. Also double check your bill at the end as they tried to slip on an extra AU$33 for items we hadn't ordered. Happy dinning! Show less

Author: weisze5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Was not impressed with the BBQ Buffet
Review: We had the seafood BBQ buffet on a Friday night. Whilst the service @ the resort has been impeccable during our stay, the service staff @ Cba that night was kind of a let down. it was our first visit and I wasn't sure what to expect. I had imagined that as it is stated that it is a BBQ buffet -- there will be BBQ stations etc however, there was none. and when we were shown the buffet spread, I was disappointed at the lack of BBQ choices. 30 minutes into our meal, we noticed that plates of BBQ food were being served to the tables near us and asked the service staff about that. It was only then that they explained that the BBQ food will be served to the table. It wasn't clear if we had to request for them to serve or what? so we only got our BBQ food after the tables near us got theirs. Kind of disappointing. Having said that, the table setting by the beach was nice. We had tapas @ Cba the next day and much preferred that to the BBQ buffet! Show less

Author: 560JohnMSydney, Australia
Title: Dropped in for a bite & cold drink
Review: Our first visit to Cenang we could only find the small restaurants along the main road and they only offered great food but mostly no alcohol.We were recommended to visit the Cba at the this resort as it was on the beach and had a bar.It was extremely hot when we got there after a slow taxi ride from the other side of Langkawi Island. But the staff were very welcoming at the hotel lobby and we walked through the grounds to the beach where the Cba was located.Along our way the staff welcomed us with hello's etc.On entering Cba we were seated and our order taken while the main dining table was set up. This was completed quickly and our cold drinks came soon after.The food was nice and tasty. I had the black pepper burger while others in my group had pizza and other food items.The cost was reasonable.Just a pity it was so hot as it is an open air venue with no air conditioning.We found this to be nice place to eat and drink even for non resort guests.Show less

Author: 476jacquelinebMarrakech, Morocco
Title: Lovely view shame about the service
Review: While staying at the Meritus we tried the CBA on a few occasions which ranged from ok to awful . First lunch they brought the wrong order for me but I put this down to a communication issue and left it at that . When we asked for the bill we were told to sit down ( I had gone to the bar as no one came over to speak to us after serving our lunch) and then it took another 10 minutes to get the bill . We thought we would give this another go for dinner a few nights later as the views are beautiful . We were seated at a table where and given menus . Nothing was mentioned about anything being unavailable. Within 8 minutes we had 4 different waiters approach us to take our order, we may have been able to read the menu and decide if we hadn't been interrupted so much. On the 4th occasion we placed our order and at that point were told that the tacos were sold out. I asked for a few minutes to pick something else at which point we decided that we would eat somewhere else. It then took a further 10 minutes to get the bill for our drinks ( again not allowed to approach the bar) . Service was poor , the food was average. You're really paying for the view.Show less

Author: Mir1989
Title: Relaxing
Review: Here is the place for you to relaxed i went there just for my dinner during the sunset. The staff was friendly. The food with reasonable price. Looking to go back there!

Author: JCLDN
Title: nice buffett
Review: we did the halloween buffet , was very good and food was tasty. plenty of choice and also entertainment.

Author: luckyikon
Title: Top class food !
Review: One of the restaurants in the Meritus resort, located on the beach facing the Andaman sea. Like the food the view is excellent. Ideal for a nice romantic candle light dinner.

Author: vrhSingaporesingapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Lovely location and views, food very expensive and not of a good standard. One main meal came out 15 minutes before the others so it was cold when the others arrived. One other main course was just warm rather than hot. The lamb shank was overcooked and chewy.Show less

Author: RobynSchroderPerth, Australia
Title: Ocean side, great views, food and service.
Review: We just loved our experience at Cba, it is right on the edge of the beach, with a view across the water to an island not too far off shore. We both thoroughly enjoyed our meal and dessert.Ideal place to eat, watch the goings on and just sit and relax for awhile.Show less

Author: rockya997
Title: Fancy and Cossy restaurant
Review: One of my best restaurant so far among all the restaurants in langkawi for my last dinner here! Well serve with good food! Fancy and large place by the sea and very romantic at night! Recommended to try if u want to spend good time!

Author: myopinion112China
Title: Lovely spot although difficult to find within the resort.
Review: Great location on the beach with amazing views although we would not have found it if we hadn't gone walking around the resort. Staff at the reception just pointed us in a direction and left us to our devices. Loved the "loungy" feel of the décor. Drinks were okay and same prices are most other places. Had some scallops and pulled lamb sandwich which were really good but a pity we couldn't try the Tuna tataki that was finished. Our waitress was incredibly friendly and polite. The guy who we assumed was the manager was a touch overbearing but I am sure he was just trying to make sure we enjoyed our time there but the waitress was doing a perfectly good job of keeping us happy. We were there during the day but I would imagine that the sunsets would be amazing. Totally recommend.Show less

Author: RichardCPStockport, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent beachside breakfasts
Review: We stayed for a week and had excellent breakfasts here every day including a very special table setting on the morning of my birthday, which my wife had secretly arranged with the manager, Christopher, who was utterly charming as well as being extremely competent. On one evening of our stay, Cba hosted a large wedding party in a special place near the water's edge and the service to both the party and the restaurant guests could not have been more efficient.Show less

Author: LaPetiteMaligne
Title: Pricey, average food in a sunny location
Review: We ate here for lunch and ordered burgers. The food was rather average and the prices rather high for what you get. Nice view of the beach but it gets hot and sunny, even in the covered areas as the sun moves

Author: Wmunes
Title: Fantastic place
Review: Just next to the beach, a very good place to chill out with family and friends. Good selection of food, try the wraps, Caesar salad and Margarita

Author: 551erik
Title: Good experience very nice during sun down
Review: Very very helpful staff at the beach, every wish is their command, a lot of choice in food and drinks, happy hour and often live music. Qayyum is very kind.

Author: Mervin RHobart, Australia
Title: 50 metres from the Beach and a superb chocolate souffle
Review: This restaurant is a little hidden gem and about to have a menu makeover. I had a nice sirloin Australian steak, while my wife had ..................The staff were great and the Chef who is Mohn or son of King was just fantastic. Makes the best chocolate soufflé you have ever eaten and we had them for dessert.This is one of the better restaurant venues but the menu suffers from a lack of seafood which locally in Langkawi is in abundance. If they add the seafood the place would be packed.Show less

Author: 333mimih
Title: Nice food... great drinks... wonderful view.
Review: We had dinner whilst watching the sunset which made the whole experience memorable. I have to say this restaurant has THE BEST VIEW of the beach compared to any other restaurant in that area!! I had the immunizer mocktail which was amazing, and we had two pizzas which were good. The prices were slightly expensive but the quality of the food is way better than the other restaurant in the hotel.... and add the view! So I would definitely recommend it over the Spice Market Restaurant. Show less

Author: atruefriend01
Title: Cba
Review: This was am amazing restaurant located on the water. The views were amazing and loved the food. It was one of the nicest lunches and dinners I have had on the island. The staff are amazing

Author: BaGrigYerevan, Armenia
Title: Empty restaurant in a full hotel
Review: I decided to have a dinner in this restaurant on the beach during my stay in the hotel. It was empty which is usually scared …. My first impression was a dead fly inside the menu....I have ordered a sea food plate and duck breast( it was tasty).For dessert i decided to have the chocolate fondant ( it takes 25 minutes to make the order and I was informed about this). I can't say that I am impressed with the dessert but overall the food was good but EXPENSIVE and this is the main reason that the restaurant is mostly empty. Service could be better and more friendly, it seems wait staff members are a bit bored …. Show less

Author: taylort750Sydney, Australia
Title: Yum with a view
Review: We have been here twice now, indulging in delicious drinks and meals. The meals are delicious and not too heavy, leaving you feeling content and enough room for desert. The tradition Malaysian cuisine with generic deserts, is a great way to watch the sunset and enjoy Langkawi's food and beach.Show less

Author: ElenaL384
Title: Cba is it too far
Review: This place has the best view and great seating. The daring are delish and some of their food is ok. The club sandwich is a must try. The prices are mediocre as is the menu

Author: 2014Tim2015
Title: Dinner
Review: Excellent food and service and top wine at reasonable price. Great aspect too. Sea close by and waves lapping shore. Best of our visit to Langkawi.

Author: Shuminkey
Title: Relaxing
Review: A night out at Cba with a cup of drink will chill you out. Feel so relaxed facing the beach with the breeze sea wind blowing. Something different from the city life.

Author: Yun GHouston, Texas
Title: Completely Best Arrangements
Review: Cheap yet romantic waterfront dining.Come here to eat with the setting sun painting the sky crimson. Set a bonfire in an oddly shaped wok. Check out planes crashing into the flush of sunset. Walk with your loved ones in the alpenglow interspersed from distant ravines.The food's so-so la :pShow less

Author: Vishal M
Title: Quiet yet Loud
Review: CBA is located right at the beach in Meritus Pelangi Hotel, hence it indeed has an excellent sea view. It's very romantic n offers some great music with great food

Author: DM6365Newcastle, Australia
Title: Wow
Review: The staff and food at the Cba are exceptional, we had a candlelight dinner in the gazebo on the beach. Five star menu. This was booked prior to leaving Australia. Communication with the Cba was brilliant and they went out if their way for a very special celebration. Thank you so much Cba Show less

Author: Knarain
Title: View to die for..
Review: An excellent bar located smack on the beach. A little pricy for some but overall experience is great .

Author: Gensi52Telford,England
Title: Lacked some atmosphere
Review: Part of the Meritus Pelangi it is the replacement for the old Boathouse / Pub, very modernistic and architecturally out of step with the rest of the hotel. It was taken over our 1st week by corporate groups who occupied the decking area near the beach, and closed one night to accommodate one group. The 2nd week it was mostly empty with staff outnumbering guests. Entertainment was only provided on one night by the duo from the Pelangi Lounge; apparently they were between bands although one was suddenly found for the start of the Langkawi International Maritime and Aerospace Exhibition (LIMA) the day after we left. We had a very nice meal here (Rossini steak) with a drink about £38 for two and the sunsets were very pleasant. The staff were very good. Worth a visit for the sunsets, there is a 10% service charge.Show less

Author: Mel_ng1985Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good view of sunset
Review: If you are looking for a place to have a nice drink while watching the sunset, this is the place. Great ambience and the beach in front of Cba is also way cleaner than the other parts of Cenang beach and has white fine sand. It is pricier than other drinking spots but it is worth it.Show less

Author: coralhillGladstone, Australia
Title: No one seems to know the daily drinks special
Review: We ate at Cba as we were staying at the Meritus resort. Lovely seafront location. Meals were delicious and if you choose the Malaysian selection, they are reasonably priced for a resort. Just watch the drinks though as no one seems to be consistent with the drinks specials advertised in reception. We got caught twice and as we paid on a cash basis we were able to argue the case as we went. Be warned!Show less

Author: clayton6
Title: Lovely atmosphere and views
Review: We only had drinks here because of time restrictions but it was very nice and well situated on the beach

Author: ImadBoutrosErbil
Title: Good place for relaxing
Review: As I said, it's a good place for relaxing with a live band, a bit expensive but they have a few occasions and special deals almost every day as a 30% discount on cocktails i think in Tuesdays and 50% on the wine in other day, the order will cost you about 10$ as a alcohol drink and they have a delicious tapas but still a bit expensive.The only problem i faced that is so hard to call a waiter because they not always around and there's a long distance between the sitting area and the bar where the waiters located.Show less

Author: firdausdarao
Title: Good food, good music
Review: We enjoyed the meals here. the live band performs very well. Excellent place for sunset and night time. you can sit at the beach chairs, watch the moon, have your drink and behind you is the band playing.

Author: LoftusroadW12Doha, Qatar
Title: Nice setting, unspectacular food!
Review: Staying at the hotel, we fancied a quick bite one night and found the food poor at both the Cba and the hotel itself. My advice, go next door to either the Casa del Mar, which was excellent, or walk further along the beach to a place called D-Grill, which was ok and another place which i think was called the Brasserie which was good.Show less

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Be careful and check your bill!
Review: On special occasions we often go to Meritus Pelangi Cba restaurant at the sea front. They upgraded it quite a bit since we saw it in Jan 2014. The food is very good but on the high price side. Water (still) is quite expensive with 24 RM per 750 ml bottle, in all other restaurants it hardly ever exceeds the 10 RM for more ml. Wines by the glass is expensive too, again 24 RM per glass but the house wines are very good.Because it is low season they offer 30% discount on drinks all evening on boards around the hotel. It does say on selected beverages and the little start say, please phone us but no number. We made a picture of this because when we ordered a bottle of wine instead of the usual 4 glasses, no one said anything as they took our order. We asked for the wine list separately and again nothing was said about no discount.After dinner came the bad surprise, no discount on beverages at all. So we asked the waiter and he took the bill and came back with 30% discount on water. We asked again how about the wine and the answer was, No discount on wine list only on all drinks in Menu list which contains also cocktails and strong drinks like whisky. A bit shocked we went to the front desk and explained that it feels very awkward not being told that on the wine list there is no discount.The answer was even more rude, sir all over the island discounts are not on wine list so he saw no problem at all!So be very careful when you order drinks in Cba and ask if discount applies, then when bill come check it as they do not apply the discount to the items that do fall in at category, very bad behavior and very customer unfriendly. Meritus Pelangi should not have to resort to these kind of practices at such high prices!Show less

Author: Aditya_india
Title: Awesome ambience
Review: Its always good to chill at the beach on a comfy couch sipping chilled malibu or exotic wines watching the sun go down...Its perfect for evenings on holidays;)

Author: KandMWK
Title: OK - but don't order pizza
Review: Everything except the pizza (deep frozen) was delicious (burger, satay, sandwiches, pasta). Expensive compared to restaurants in Pnatai Cenang

Author: Rizby_2009Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Food in a Sublime Setting
Review: I took a long walk up Pantai Cenang one evening enjoying the breeze and sun-dappled beach to explore dining options at Cba. Admittedly I baulked at the prices but sometimes when you're on vacation, it is ok to indulge and splurge once in awhile. And splurge I did. It is soooo relaxing to kick back and take in the panoramic views at this restaurant with the swathe of sand expanse spread around you dotted with gently swaying palm trees. Occasionally buffeted by sprightly, salty sea breezes this is the perfect place to take that ultimate chill. Paired with a glorious view of the setting sun and the changing hues of the sky adds further enthralling magic to the experience.I ordered the chicken risotto. So lovely and delectable. Completely recommend for a memorable experience with great friends, family or a loved one.Show less

Author: Frank0870Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely lunch
Review: I had my lunch there two days ago. Very friendly waiters offered me a fantastic seat with a nice ocean view. In advance I purchased a Groupon voucher and they accepted it immediately. Started my lunch with a delicious salad followed by a marvelous chicken breast with risotto. I really enjoyed the lunch with two glasses of white wine while listening to relaxing lounge music from Cafe Del Mar. Excellent service!!! Only one little thing needs to be improved. Waiters should let other guests know, that this amazing restaurant isn't a playground when their kids play around. This was very annoying, so I changed my table.Show less

Author: ammor84
Title: Over price
Review:
This place is too expensive. Do not go there before you make sure you have enough money.
They have a good atmosphere with live performers nightly. But the price for a 500 ml bottle of water is about 21 RM.

Author: Pennina21
Title: Great place for sunset cocktails
Review: We just enjoyed some cocktails here, they have comfy big seats really close to the beach and you can sit here, enjoy your drink and watch the sun go downWe also had some snacks which were delicious. Service was very good and if you go between 5 and 7pm it's happy hour and you get 20% off.It was a really lovely place to spend some time, chill out to the music and enjoy a drink as you watch the sun go down.Quiet part of the beach too, would recommendShow less

Author: BaskieLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great Music
Review: A nice variety of food here. If the weather is good, pls sit outside. It can be very memorable evening. My family & I did it on a full moon day and I can't ask for anything more than this. Everything was so very perfect. They also have a Quatro Band. Very entertaining and my son (11yr old0 doesn't want to get out of the site even after midnight. Ha Ha Ha!Show less

Author: boris mMoscow, Russia
Title: bad service
Review: Hi Everybody,I went from The Datai Langkawi to see the sunset after few people suggested that the CBar at Pelangi Meritus is really nice place to enjoy, which is truth, but apart of the sunset all went wrong.1) we choose our table and were waiting for a service staff for 30 minutes2)service staff bring the menu.. to return another 20 minute to take the order3) 20 minutes to bring our drinks which were not served cold and the ice was half melted4) payment 30 minutes and at the end the waiter bring my credit card to another tableFrom arrival till the end we were served by 4different waiters, all of them without a clue of 5star hotel service, the manager's excuse was they are busy..maybe 20 guest is far to much for him?!I love the setup of the whole bar and sunset, even my guest did really enjoy, but such an embarrassment which the Pelangi service delivered is unacceptable and really disappointing.Hope the managment can look into this matter so the guest can enjoy their facilities including a 5star service which they paying for.Show less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good Ambience
Review: This place's ambience is quite nice. Setting and deco are excellent. Service was great. Well, they have a Philipino live band - 4 piece. I must say it really spoiled the ambience, as the singing were not good, and sound were quite bad. I ordered cigars but they did not cut for me, which I need to cut it myself, and no cigar match either-just a plain box match. Male's toilet was quite smelly, which was dissapointing since this is a 5 star hotel. Overall ambience are great, just need to take note on the items listed above. Show less

Author: RachelleTeiLi
Title: Dining at Beach Grill
Review: A good place to dine with fresh seafood and Aizat services are great. A great evening for family Dinner.Show less

Author: theresa k
Title: Love it!
Review: Celebrated BF's birthday last year and this year came back to Ritz Carlton, celebrating our honeymoon as we love here so much :) always great services and love the sunset and the environment, basically everything :) the employee is very helpful and friendly. thanks to Aiza from The Beach Grill, we had a wonderful dinner. Keep up the good work!Show less

Author: therealayueistoomuch
Title: great dining experience
Review: thank you for the beautiful food, service and ambience. a special mention to aiza and farid for the wonderful evening.Show less

Author: DEESHFQ
Title: Great food ! A good experience
Review: We went there for our honeymoon. The food was fantastic and thank you farid for the excellent serviceShow less

Author: dahliakenangaIpoh
Title: Memorable Dinner
Review: I went to The Beach Grill on 17/11/2022. It was a pleasant visit. The menu was good, the restaurant was situated just by the beach so you had a good dinner with sea breeze and waves accompanying your meal. The ambience was great. I had a pleasant time being served by Miss Aiza whom explained carefully the menu to menu and gave good suggestions to me to try.Show less

Author: FuadaDubai
Title: Excellent service!
Review: Thanks to Farid for his friendly service which make our dinner such a memorable one. Kudos to the whole team for a beautiful birthday decoration. Highly recommended to celebrate special occasion or chillax with friends.Show less

Author: Yazidajid
Title: Great experience to have
Review: Enjoy ours sunset view with very wow food ,delighted and recommend..somemore the staff are really friendly and helpful..like farid and sha very friendly..thnks a lot cause setup a birthday dinner for my wife and me..enjoy the day Show less

Author: Meander64458488946Munich, Germany
Title: Perfect service, delicious food and beautiful sunset view
Review: One of the best restaurants at Langkawi. The service is absolutely great, our server Farid has been very mindful and they always address you with your name which is a very kind gesture. The food is also amazing, we had fresh fish from the grill. The atmosphere is very special with a scenic restaurant and beautiful sunset views.Show less

Author: nixian75
Title: Superb service by the staff
Review: Warm and friendly service given by the team, extremely thankful to Miss Karen, Lily, Azam, Farissah, Rajoo and afa for giving such nice service.... They even notice the tiny details during my dining, their warm hospitality eventually make me feels like a family of them!!!!Food are nice, especially my favourite pandan french toast, compliment to the chefsShow less

Author: yypplai
Title: Amazing Hospitality in Humanity
Review: Jo Yee has provided us with an awesome services directly from her heart and sweet smile at all times. The stay at Ritz Carlton is remarkable purely because of the dedicated servicing staff besides the accommodation and facilities and beautiful scenery.Show less

Author: Kevin6189
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Nice place to chill, friendly staff, nice foods and drinks, nice seaview and enjoy the environment.Nice serving by Sharifah.Show less

Author: STTan1221
Title: Superb views and hospitality
Review: Just couldn't believe my family had been dined in at The Beach Grill for 3 times in February. No doubt,the scenic views, attentive service from staffs, food and ambience certainly were the key reasons attracted us repeating visit.What a coincidence, we've been served by the same server Ms Sharifah in our each visit .She is an observant staff and well prepared to welcome us with warm table set up on our third visit.Our third visit was on 26/2, when we're hanging around before food being served , Paula specially made 3 glasses of mock tail for us called Ritz Wave for refreshing.Surprisingly, the mock tail in blue color just matching the color of my dress, it symbolizes the natural color of sky and ocean.Coincidently, that day was the last day of Chinese Lunar New Year celebration called Lantern festival, the pastry staffs served all guests with their special made glutinous rice balls as desserts, what a big surprise for us!We had a very pleasant evening at The Beach Grill.Show less

Author: aingelina04
Title: DINING EXPERIENCE
Review: Nice service from Nai. Thankyou to all the beach grill staff for having us ☺️☺️ Good food & environment ❤️❤️Show less

Author: Cherrymachine
Title: Good memories with colleagues
Review: It was such a good time spent with my colleagues and managers. Will definitely visit again. Thanks to Farid for the excellent service and the foodShow less

Author: shiaowenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice service
Review: Nice service from Hazlinda, she helped us take nice photos too! She remembers everything that we order too!Show less

Author: jjng2005
Title: Good service & food
Review: Delicious food and nice view, good service from Nai good price and will be gonna back to dinner againShow less

Author: earnchia
Title: Dinner
Review: Good food and service from Anita, will be gonna back to have dinner again, peaceful dinner and nice viewShow less

Author: Man_hakim96
Title: Very good
Review: Very nice with delicious food..will repeat again..thanks to ms sharifah for treat us well..very good knowledge in foodShow less

Author: Doriswong94
Title: Nice view, Delicious foods and good service!
Review: Was having a great dinner and super nice atmosphere environment. And of course, thanks to Ms. Sharifah for good service Show less

Author: Emilyxccy0
Title: Commendable service
Review: Ritz Carlton langkawi service I dare say is one of the best service I’ve received. They were very thoughtful, very detailed in their work, I am very impressed. I would like to take a moment to praise woan xuan, ewe, tony and ritz Carlton team of talents for their warm and welcoming attitude. Author: Izwadilla83
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: Very good...nice food.. Friendly staff.. Thanks to Ms Nai n Mr Kalai for your good treats.... Very very nice person both of them. Very good knowledge in food.Show less

Author: wansien
Title: Good Service
Review: Good service and delicious food in the Beach Grill.Also thanks for the good service from Nai. Have a great moment here.Show less

Author: Siang0614
Title: Good
Review: thanks miss Nai Yeong to give our good dinner experience she very friendly and nicely, food also greatShow less

Author: Ann_afif99Penang, Malaysia
Title: Great Dinner with family
Review: Tq for the amazing dinner experience first class to my server YUSUF ,and tq for ladies & gentlemen at BG RCL ,Sharifah ,parvin,kalaiShow less

Author: Twhar
Title: Birthday treat!
Review: Love all the foods... Delicious! Ambience superbWarm hospitality Served by syukri Nice decoBeautiful views by d sea...Will recommend to othersShow less

Author: othmansons
Title: Enjoy dinner

Author: Q_mane-12
Title: Whole lotta of love

You’ve made my life easier.There are 7 of us but everything went on super smooth and we totally had the bar to ourselfTo Sharifah, thank you so much for the delightful recommendation and totally fit my appetite Here comes our favourite part, the bar!Afa is a talented young bartender who made the most joyful drinks ever! Many thanks for thatAnd last but not least, not just we felt the love among us, but we went thru the entire night felt with super caring emotion from all the Beach Grill staff.What can i say, there’s a whole lotta of love down there!Show less

Author: Swiin93
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: We came for my friend’s birthday dinner .Good food ! Good view ! Sharifah as our server , she is super polite and patient, and she did a great decorating ❤️Definitely will come back!Show less

Author: iqbal7691
Title: Dinner at Beach Grill Restaurant.
Review: First of all The Ritz-Carlton Langkawi is one of the best hotel in Langkawi. Food at Beach Grill was delicious and most importantly the service from their staff is on top notch especially Sharifah...Show less

Author: aimanmus
Title: The Beach Grill: Our anniversary celebration
Review: The place is cosy, suitable for our anniversary celebration. The foods are well-cooked, and the services are awesome! We are served by Qistina, who recommended us to all the fantastic foods. Would recommend this place for all :)Show less

Author: sarra6661Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service
Review: We took the set menu 3 course for rm68, the food are super yummy from the entree to the dessert. I would like to mention Qistina for being friendly with us overall excellent service for the rest of the staff tonight! :)Show less

Author: hannisRaslinLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: good food, good service , good price ❤️
Review: excellent environment at beach grill restaurant, the food was absolutely wonderful from preparation to presentation, very pleasing credit to amar the cheff . friendly service from charlish , afa, and ain the hostess girl, credit to kalai our waiter, your service was excellent and very fast . will be back definitely!!Show less

Author: CLangkawi2020Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Came back for the 2nd time and still as amazing if not better !
Review: Can’t stop praising this place enough for the amazing experience! Hands down - staffs are the best , most attentive and thoughtful service from Sha (your superstar), Kalai, Qistina and Parvin ! Good food, great views - a must visit !Show less

Author: STTan1221
Title: Splendid sunset views
Review: Our second time dine in at the Beach Grill.It is located by the seashore and surrounded by the green. While drinking and eating at the golden hour,I witnessed splendid sunset views. The fine dining food served were so delicious, compliment to the chef.
