The restaurant do provide vegan delights, make the choice more varieties.The staffs here are so friendly, from we stepped in the main entrance, were being served warmth and generous reception.Especially Ms Sharifah, she served us twice on our visits. She's knowledgeable and helpful ,we are so pleased with her service.Show less

Author: Foodlover0926
Title: Revisit The Beach Grill
Review: We really enjoyed going to that restaurant because everything was excellent, the service, the ambiance, the food, and obviously good company as well especially Sharifah who served us , It's a great place for family and friends to eat together .Not just for the delicious menu they have but because of the really amazing view too!It’s a place I will definitely be recommending to other people now that I’ve been and tried it for myself.Show less

Author: Aqinjat
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Celebrate birthday, we try the RM68 set menu. Excellent service, served by miss sharifah. The food was delicious. The portions was enough for us.Show less

Author: tahanisofiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Food Accompanied by Exceptional Service
Review: I love absolutely everything about the Beach Grill. I have dined in at the restaurant more than once, feeling satisfied each time. For starters, the food there is delicious. I highly recommend the Kofta Curry, Rendang Ravioli, Wild Seabass, and Rain Forest for dessert as these are some of my favorites from the seasonal set menu. Aside from the taste, the food presentation is always beautiful. Compliments to the chef!Another reason that always keeps us coming back for more is because of the friendly staff at the restaurant. They always go out of their way to make us feel warm, happy, and comfortable. They were also knowledgeable and helpful whenever we had questions about the menu. Big thanks to Sharifah, Charlish, Ain, and the rest of the Beach Grill team for welcoming and serving us tonight. Thank you for the complimentary drink.Day or night, the restaurant has a nice and pleasant ambiance. It's always great to be able to enjoy our food accompanied by the sea, sunset, and music in the background. I look forward to visiting the Beach Grill whenever given the chance. Thank you for making every visit a memorable one - wish I had more pictures to share.Show less

Author: zowieyew
Title: One of my favourite restaurant in Langkawi.
Review: The relaxed ambience of The Beach Grill was perfect.All the servers are friendly especially Sharifah who served us.The Passion Fruit Mojito is highly recommended ,it tastes refreshing and wholesome.The spicy and crunchy snacks served with the Mojito are perfect match.Show less

Author: Muhyiddin004Bayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: The food was amazing by chef jay and all the servers are friendly like sharifah, farid, linda,qistina and kalai. Im so satisfiedShow less

Author: roryjdoyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Beach Grill
Review: Smart casual dining at the Ritz Carlton Langkawi. Located above the sea shore. Pleasant but unremarkable food with a classy ambience.Show less

Author: nami8319Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great dinner
Review: Portion was huge. I had ribeye and the meat was chunky. The coconut sundae is highly recommended and sinfully satisying. Relaxing ambience Show less

Author: Waniqibah
Title: HAD A BLAST DINNER WITH MY FAMILY
Review: I went there with my mom and dad for a dinner at Beach Grill during a Covid promo. Since this is our first time having a fine dining experience, I'm really glad that we went. I felt a warm welcome by Sharifah, whom I made the reservation with. She even arrange the buggy service during maghrib prayer. Shukri, the waiter, recommend us the menu and he knows every details on it. He took a picture of us, have some great chats since we are also a local. We felt happy with the experience. Thank you Ritz Carlton ! I hope that there will be more promotions for locals in the future xDShow less

Author: katrivagoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beach restaurant, great food, warm staff, excellent service, fair price
Review: Visited here for a birthday dinner. Great coordination by Qistina escalated well to her team. Fantastic table decoration, personalize service. Farid, our service company is warm and helpful. Kalai, the supervisor made our experience seamless. The rest of the team? wonderful! Great food, best shirley temple ever had with Andaman sea sunset view. What an experience! Ladies and gentlemen serving the lady and gentlemen, they have reflected it well. Thank you Show less

Author: MYEL76Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lobster Tacos!
Review: We had a light lunch here after spending some time at the beach and swimming pool and we enjoyed our meal here. I had the lobster tacos which was light and delicious while my husband had the burger which was very good too.Show less

Author: Kimly012
Title: Excellent
Review: everything was great! Seafood served was fresh and well cooked and outstanding services offered by their staffs, especially kudos to staff by the name INTAN which was very helpful and attentive.Show less

Author: celiaclack13Oxted, United Kingdom
Title: Good for lunch
Review: Lovely place to sit for lunch as long as there is a table available outside. Food is good especially the 'Chips and Fish' - not a mistake - this is what it is called !Show less

Author: IbrahimAlkulaib
Title: The beach grill from the ritz carilton Langkawi
Review: The dinner experience from the beach grill at the ritz Carlton was an experience that I will never forget! The service and environment were exceptionally outstanding, not to mention the 7 course dinner while enjoying the sunset with my better half. I strongly recommend to surprise your loved ones with this experience because they will love you for it.Paarvin and Dane prepared our reservation and made sure everything went smooth from our room to the dinner location. They were the best.Show less

Author: jda100160Kongens Lyngby, Denmark
Title: Pure delight
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed a dinner at this restaurant. Great variety of drinks and wine. Excellent seafood with a delicate touch. Tempting desserts. Very attentive staff - THANKS !Show less

Author: KingKongloveCY
Title: Great time at the beach grill
Review: The beach grill is simply wonderful. Staffs are so nice, this is also the pool for kids…my daughter is having great time here…We meet Ain, the "bigger sister" who taking good care of my daughter…we also have dinner there with seats reserved for viewing the sunset…wonderful memory and we definitely we be back!Show less

Author: Peter v
Title: great food in paradise
Review: from the head of F&B, Mr Minken down to the staff, service is awesome and the food first class, well-prepared and a nice blend of local and international flavors. the setting in this piece of paradise is of course amazing. highly recommended.Show less

Author: stampede22
Title: Best dessert of my life
Review: We stayed at the Ritz Carlton recently and dined at the Beach Grill on our last night. The meal was spectacular, with freshly caught seafood and I ordered the best dessert of my life, it really was something special.The service was incredible and the only downside is the expense but sometimes you have to splurge to experience something really wonderful, and on the beach to boot.Show less

Author: pinkasicsSingapore
Title: Great Lunch by the Andaman
Review: Everything about the lunch was great - service, view - only disappointment was the Cendawan burger. My favourites were the Sushi Lautan and Hummus.Show less

Author: Blake S
Title: Amazing Restraunt and Great staff!
Review: We have had a great time Everytime we have visited The Beach Grill. The manager Sham is kind, caring, and makes you feel at home. The views are spectacular and the seafood is great!Show less

Author: GaryS0609Malaysia
Title: Lovely evening
Review: The restaurant is so lovely with the staff, food and ambiance.We serve my an amazing waiter name Sukri, he is so friendly, polite and professional. The food is amazing. We order a seabass from thier catch of the day menu, is fresh and delicuios Highly recommend it.Last and not least the restaurant manager Mr. Kartik, thank you for your amazing hospitality. Show less

Author: timoslt
Title: Simply amazing
Review: Went there for a dinner in the early evening and it was just amazing. Although the weather on that day wasnt the best, the view towards the beach and the ocean was still awesome. We we're warmly welcomed and the service by Mr.Sham was outstanding. The prices aren't to expensive and the food was very delicious. They offered us a lot of different and fresh seafood, common dishes and even a vegetarian menu. It was perfect from the beginning to the end.We would love to come back.T&PShow less

Author: meiling_9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Warm service
Review: The restaurant has gorgeous view and I spent many a lazy lunch there, just day-dreaming my afternoon away with a beer. It's a Western menu (salads, sandwiches, etc) and it's quite tasty. The pool is rather tiny though so I felt that was a bit of a waste. But it does have direct access to the beach and the sport centre. Special shout-out to Paula who made my lazy lunches very pleasurable - great service without being intrusive! :)Show less

Author: 446philipf
Title: Amazing!!!!
Review: We love the layout of the place and the upgrades the mangement has done .Mr. Kartik, Fahrid and Kallay are to highlight. Watch those lovely sunsets with a great view – stunning place. They also serve a good Shisha that comes very quickly. All in all – highly recommended. All of the restaurant outlets from Ritz Carlton are great and offer an impeccable service at a very decent price. Dont forget to sign up to be a Marriot Member as well.Show less

Author: TimothyKlHong Kong, China
Title: The BEST Chicken Dinner We Have EVER Eaten!
Review: The Beach Grill is on the Ritz-Carlton Langkawi property. Although they had a lovely display of fresh seafood on offer, my wife and I fancied the chicken. The portion was huge, the chicken was beautifully de-boned and cooked to perfection. Seldom have I eaten chicken where the juices inside are flavored to perfection. Chicken can sometimes be dry or bland, but this must have been cooked in a special way that made every bite juicy, tender and full of flavor. The meal was also served with lovely veggies and potatoes. This was our best meal of our vacation. Our hats off to the chef and his team!Show less

Author: Roughlauren
Title: Impeccable service, amazing views and delicious food — A perfect way to catch Langkawi’s sunset
Review: Got a drink at The Horizon before heading over to The Beach Grill, and what can I say — the service is simply amazing! I was greeted immediately (by name) and attended by a lovely lady Ain, whom was extremely polite and friendly. Sat at the perfect dining spot overlooking the vast Andaman sea, and served by another lovely lady Mean and Mister Sukri whom very kindly helped me out by offering recommendations. I am glad the food was as palatable as promised. Highly recommended for anyone visiting langkawi to visit and dine at The Beach Grill (and drinks at The Horizon for a slightly different ambience)! Thank you so much for your hospitality Mister Sukri, Ms Mean, Ms Ain and the rest of the crew (sorry didn’t manage to catch all your names); your services are truly top-notch and I do hope your management (@ Ritz Carlton) will recognise and praised the staff for the excellent job rendered — it’s what keeps people coming back :)Show less

Author: kalikome
Title: Lovely views
Review: Had lunch and dinner here and both were good. I particularly enjoyed the sushi box that one day we ordered to be brought to our beach lounger.

Author: Craige1959London, United Kingdom
Title: A lovely start to our visit to the Ritz Carlton hotel in Langkawi
Review: Upon arrival we had a lovely lunch at The Beach Grill at the Ritz Carlton. The shared sushi was unbelievably fresh and have a lovely little kick it. For mains I had a beef Bolognese pasta dish and my partner had a fish wrap both of which were excellent. I have little doubt that we will be revisiting before we depart.Show less

Author: Sanj130
Title: Great setting but mediocre food
Review: Lack of vegetarian choices; food was bland and not cooked properly (some of my seafood was slightly raw).

Author: BobFaircloth
Title: Great Pool Restaurant
Review: One of two at the resort, this one at the "family" pool area. Quiet when we were there, the Mediterranean Mezze was as good as I have had and my wife's Garlic Shrimp was lovely and plentiful. Highly recommended.

Author: WayILikeIt
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: Yummy options by the pool and beach area. Try the sushi lautan. Sushi with a twist with Sambal. Pasta and salad was equally good.

Author: whiterabbitjbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Sadly average
Review: We had a dinner and a lunch at the Beach Grill, both just about average despite the best effort from the amazing staff. Food is good but not great, and poor value for money: you expect to pay a premium given the superb location and surrounding, but not that much of a premium...in addition to that, we were sat for dinner in a table at the back, with no view and just too warm....Show less

Author: LocalMalaysianA
Title: Nice food and family pool
Review: Sunset shot from my phone. Nice and fresh seafood at decent price, with perfect sunset facing Andaman Sea.

Author: Douha T
Title: Best dinner I’ve had In Langkawi!
Review: The food at the Beach grill was absolutely amazing! Im someone very picky, who get sick easily from food overseas, however, this meal was the best I’ve had on this holiday. I ordered the snapper fish and my husband ordered the rib eye steak. The food was cooked in front of us on a grill. The fish was the best snapper I’ve ever had, no lie! When the waiters heard we are on our honeymoon, they surprised us with a cake wishing us a happy honeymoon. I highly recommend this restaurant if you’re after authentic, tasty, gourmet food!Show less

Author: wengloktoh
Title: Great Place
Review: Best BBQ so far in Langkawi with good western food for a change and also good atmosphere and staff is wonderful

Author: wengloktohCalgary, Canada
Title: Good atmosphere
Review: Great place to relax with friends and family worth the visit prices are reasonable and staff are the greatestShow less

Author: MstknsA
Title: nice
Review:
the beach grill has a wide selection of foods and drinks it also have a pool for kids and minors 
have an amazing view

Author: luxurylifeigSydney, Australia
Title: Best of the Best
Review: Where does one start? The location is incredible. Perched absolute waterfront on the chic Ritz Carlton property, with uninhibited views of the ocean and beach. The decor is understated luxury with tiers allowing for privacy while maintaining a view. The staff are welcoming and do their best to accommodate. But this is a restaurant so how about the food? The Signature Sushi Lautan is my favourite being a sushi roll filled with sambal prawn, coconut rice, avocado and topped with a layer of mango. Absolutely delicious. The Tropical Quinoa Salad is a refreshing salad with an incredible fruit which I could not work out. The crab cakes are also recommended.As to the desserts, you cannot go past the Melaka Coconut Sundae. Trust me, order it and thank me later.Show less

Author: HappyamitGurugram (Gurgaon), India
Title: The fine dining experience closest to the sea
Review: There are very few restaurants in the world where you can sit right at the edge of the water and enjoy a fine dining experience. This is one of them. The setting is breathtakingly beautiful and the food and service is great. My little one just wanted to keep looking at the waves as they crashed the rocks upon which we had our table laid. They have a selection of fresh catch of the day on display. Chose one and the chef will make it to your liking. Show less

Author: Perry BHong Kong, China
Title: As good as ever in January!
Review: It seems an eon ago, but it was great to be here again at the start of the year. The spread was as fantastic as ever during breakfast. The level of service was also stellar. The views of the swimming pool and the beach beyond were superb.Show less

Author: capelo1Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ate here more than once
Review: The food is that good. Fresh seafood brought in everyday, pick what you want and they prepare it to your liking. The fact the tables or on the sand also makes it that much more authentic. It is VERY popular so make sure you make a reservation. Show less

Author: andymR9080EQ
Title: Jala
Review: Who wouldn't want to sit and look through an integrated rainforest and pool to the beach? Excellent traditional food and very friendly staff who provide an excellent service.

Author: tedioustommo
Title: Great location and superb fish.
Review:
We went there for a celebration and were initially disappointed in the menu choice but the staff pulled out all the stops and it ended up being a fantastic meal.
The staff are amazing.

Author: G3893QCrobw
Title: great all round restaurant
Review: This restaurant does everything - breakfast buffet, evening BBQ and great all round evening food for all the family. We ate here mainly at breakfast times and for the evening bbq buffet, all great.

Author: mehr66
Title: Jala restaurant
Review: Food was excellent and wonderful environment and friendly waitress  and nice welcome and live music we really enjoyed

Author: VancityAussieVancouver, Canada
Title: Average and needs to do more
Review: We saved this restaurant till last while staying at The Andaman.Expected more than it delivered given the price point. The view is amazing, the live music for dinner was awesome and you can’t go wrong with fresh off the boat seafood.However, the sloppy service at this supposedly premium restaurant was its un-doing.We waited on arrival for several minutes before being noticed.. had to flag down someone for a menu.. were served wine in mis-matched glasses (a red and a white wine glass).. never given a side of bread as promised.. and the food?Given the main of tuna belly was almost 160 MYR, it was tasty but not that tasty.Unfortunately Jala was a letdown, we expected a pricey dining experience but it didn’t deliver a more refined service.Show less

Author: nasimadLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best Christmas Day dinner ever!
Review: We chose to eat here for Christmas Day, serving the traditional turkey dinner. What a place!You get to chose your fish from the display and discuss with the chef how its cooked and what it comes with. We had the best calamari ever, the biggest tiger prawns and the lovely local fish grilled. Take their recommendations on sauces - Jala and the green chilli are worth taking a risk on.Beautiful food in a beautiful location!Show less

Author: Kieran11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood on the beach
Review: We were staying at The Datai and decided to walk down the beach to The Andaman to have dinner at this place. It was excellent - good choice of fresh seafood, great service and a wonderful location right by the beach - the floor is sand so don't wear your high heels :) The only negative was a LOT of noise and shouting from the kitchen - if you want to charge 5-star prices the kitchen staff should have 5-star behaviourShow less

Author: Pedro M
Title: Great food on a beautiful setting
Review: We went to Jala a couple of times both for the a la carte menu and their Friday fisherman buffet.In both occasions we found the food delicious and service excellent.The staff took extra care to ensure they catered for our 2 year old and her allergies.It is pricey for Langkawi with prices more comparable time London, however, you are in a fantastic setting, on a very remote, peaceful and beautiful part of the island. So, worth every penny (or ringgit)!Show less

Author: EllemaySydney, Australia
Title: Fresh seafood 🦞
Review: We enjoyed numerous dinners at Jala Restaurant whilst staying at the Andaman Hotel. We found the food, service and beachfront ambience to be excellent. The restaurant has a lively bar and basically offers freshly cooked seafood which is on display and can be cooked on the hot grill. We found the staff to be extremely friendly attentive and helpful. Show less

Author: Naomi D
Title: Anniversary dinner
Review: We were very happy with the special dinner that we had at Jala, thank you so much for the delicious meal, table setting and attentive staff. I hope that all guests have the opportunity to experience the sunset experience :)

Author: nuaimshedy
Title: Great food & service
Review:
Kitchen team espeacially chef lah, chef siti & chef wan prepared very nice & tasteful dishes. 
Service team are very welcoming & created memorable dine experience.
Well recommended

Author: winedude8888Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not sure how they great these reviews
Review: Firstly very expensive for what it is. Two people with one appetizer 5 shrimps large ones and fish for two over 600 rings. They try hard but service very poor and slow but there very nice just not organized. Our fish was great the first two shrimps were great the three sides were horrible full of butter and oil and just terrible. Than we ordered three more large shrimp they were terrible and sent them back chef came out said sorry and made three more. They were no better the second time really bad. So far in the property The Resturant is the best as all restaurant have there own kitchen. Show less

Author: Simon_ChesneyCalifornia
Title: Fantastic fresh fish
Review: We ate at Jala twice during our stay. We're foodies, with some dietary restrictions. Each time we had the chef help us select an appropriate fish and side dishes (a Pink Snapper the first visit and a Grey Snapper on or second visit), and both meals were outstanding. Not particularly cheap (by Malaysian standards), but good value given the quality, and very enjoyable.Show less

Author: Robert-Jan TBrussels, Belgium
Title: Must visit fish restaurant
Review: The fish restaurant of the Andaman resort is a must visit one. Reservations are recommended. One we entered the venue we could choose a fish from a large table. We followed the chef’s recommendation and the price of the fish is based on the weight. You can choose four sides varying from vegetables or carbs. The restaurant serves a la carter fish and meat as well, but we clearly opted for the fresh fish. The staff served the fish pretty quickly and we enjoyed a great dinner during the breathtaking sunset. One of a kind dinner and highly recommended when you are around or staying at the resort. Show less

Author: 566biaaOttawa, Canada
Title: Local seafood delicacy
Review: What a beautiful,relaxed and nice place beside the beach.you have option of selecting food from menu or make your own menu.We chose to pick our own fish,prawns and squids,to grill,that came with different sauces and side dishes of your choice. They use their own seafood of the area. Food was simply delicious.Staff was so humble & friendly, we were entertained by Leonardi chat about local delicacies,culture and food.bit pricey but worth the price.Show less

Author: Pvcras
Title: Grilled fish at sunset
Review: Fresh grilled fish and huge tiger prawns with sides and veg. Wonderful. Fantastic food and lovely attentive staff. All at a beachfront table and a sunset. How can you better that? Fabulous. Highly recommended.

Author: Alanis C
Title: Average grill food with nice sauces..
Review: It is rather a interesting restaurant on the sands. Overall it is a BBQ / Grill house. Rather expensive too.

Author: Mat-DxbDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Best Lamb Chops ever - served in a boat
Review: we tried 3 out of 4 outlets. Especially the Malaysian restaurant was amazing. We came back 3 times and enjoyed every bite. A must during your stay is the ‘lamb chop boat’, the most delicious lamb chops we ever had. Also, the Malaysian beef was absolutely great. The Japanese was tasty but not cheap. But this is what is everywhere at a real Teppanyaki where the chef is cooking for you.Show less

Author: John S
Title: Malaysia 2019
Review: We visited this restaurant three times having both a la crate meals and special fish meals. I think they are probably the best fish meals I have had. The ‘special’ meal of pan fried silver mullet with different sauces and vegetables was perfect.

Author: Andy M
Title: Authentic and First Class
Review: Absolute best restaurant on the property.  Nightly specials and regular Malaysian and Indian dishes were outstanding. Great wine selection.

Author: Helgs MMunich, Germany
Title: Excellent fish and superbly served with tremendous attention to detail.
Review: We ate here a number of times Enjoying a fish evening on the beach and perfectly placed open to the sea tables on others.The selection of fresh fish is so imores sieve. I must admit to a tendency to selecting the ala carte menu as the balance of flavour is well thought out and creates wonderful examples of flavour and balance.Well worth booking in advance to get a sea view spot.We are looking forward to our return....Show less

Author: Brian C
Title: Food only average on our visit
Review: Located by the beach with sand underfoot so no need for shoes! Our fish and steak was ok on our visit, but wine was good and so was the service.

Author: Queenie2015
Title: Superb Food
Review: We had dinner here on many evenings, beautiful food, wonderful service and would thoroughly recommend the Restaurant.

Author: AvidKLTravellerHong Kong, China
Title: Dining on the beach with dance performance
Review: We dined at the Jala on the day they had their buffet (Sunday). The restaurant set out tables on the beach itself (best to wear sandals or go barefooted). At around 7, the chefs and diners greet the fisherman boat that comes to shore with fresh catch, accompanied by local musicians playing the “kompang”. The buffet spread was quite extensive with a mix of eastern and western cuisine -the grilled seafood was fresh and tasty. The buffet also includes wine, beer and soft drinks. It was lovely enjoying a delicious meal with gentle breeze and watching the glorious sun set. At around 8.30pm, a troupe of dancers entertain the diners with a traditional Malay dance, ending with an invitation to diners to join in on the last dance. When night falls, you get to see the green lights from the squid fishing boats out in the distance.Show less

Author: AnonBearSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant at The Andaman
Review: We really enjoyed the barefoot concept at Jala and the food was good. It was head and shoulders above the other fairly poor food offerings at The Andaman. The service was good and the menu was fairly innovative, the toadstool- based Black Forest gateaux was pure theatre and actually very good to eat. Would return if staying in Datai Bay again.Show less

Author: Eamon12Portadown, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic evening
Review: I had a wonderful meal in Jala. The chinese chef was fantastic, even producing one of his recipes for me to keep. Leonardo was great in advising re the wide choice of fish to chose and what way to have it cooked. Juno and Sovia attentively looked after us throughout the evening. There was a wonderful Malaysian female singer who sang during the latter part of the meal. I only wish I had worn flip-flops as the floor is sand and continues onto the beach. A great spot to have a cocktail to watch the sun going down before dinner.Show less

Author: J6383JGmarcop
Title: Cozy place
Review: Nice concept, fine food in literally in a beach. Nice place and location, they claim to give you just catch fish, and they cook as you wish. Nice, good food, good service, maybe too pricy foe the overall experience.

Author: dordor-SinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food great service
Review: The set dinner menu was good. Restaurant staff all provided good service and attentive to all needs. The seafood and beef were all very good. As a duty free place so wines were cheap too! Simply love the beach bar at jala extending discount based on daily max temperature too. Great deals then.Show less

Author: Peter G
Title: Good Sea food
Review: excellent sea food restaurant.  Both a la carte menu and choice of freshly caught fish from a cool display cooked as one required with several side dishes.

Author: Sultana Rose A
Title: Amazing seafood
Review: We had the best sea bass and prawns here. It was amazing to be able to pick our fish and prawns and have it cooked to our taste. We had a beach view table & the surprise birthday cake for my partner was a lovely touch.Show less

Author: CDH1248London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious fresh fish and seafood prepared as you like it
Review: A wide range of fresh fish and seafood on display for you to make your selection, all caught and brought in by local fishermen. Huge tiger prawns on the grill, sweet and tender; piping hot, crisp deep fried calamari; steamed pomfret; many more, including sea bass, grouper and others. The fish is priced by weight, all clearly marked, and is weighed in front of you when ordering so you know exactly what you are spending-a wide variety of side dishes and sauces come at no further charge. Prices are very reasonable for the quality.If you get there before sunset you have the added bonus of the sun going down over the water, often with beautiful pastel-coloured skies.Show less

Author: mattnalexWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful but not cheap
Review: We went to this restaurant once and had a fab meal. There is an a la carte menu or you can choose fish from the display.Quakity was excellent but price was steep.140 pounds for the 2 of us. With 2 beers, 2 starters and dessert.Show less

Author: lmlucas
Title: Not that fantastic anymore.
Review: In compare with 13 years ago this restaurant is not that special anymore. Now you can eat the kind of food served in an average restaurant anywhere, the terrace is beautiful, especially at night.

Author: JooelleeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh seafoods & nice ambience
Review: Nice ambiance around the restaurant. Knowledgeable and friendly staffs. I would suggest coming here with pair of comfortable flip-flop as the whole restaurant is filled with sands on the floor. It really gives you the idea that u're dining by the seaside. Place table booking in advance for the nice spots at the restaurant. There're two types of ordering method, one of it is to directly order from the designated menu and another one would be picking seafoods from the counter and customizing it with sides/method of preparing it (this will cost more but they'll let you know the price before proceeding). Smokers will need to walk down to the beach to smoke. Most of the places in the resort are smoke free areas.Show less

Author: amyrosylilyAsia
Title: Food is nice, price as expected in a 5-star resort
Review: Nothing too exciting - but we stayed in the Andaman Resort, and we didn't want to drive all the way back in town for dinner, so we picked this place. Nice environment next to the beach, they even put a layer of sand on the restaurant floor to simulate that. Food is ok, and it is pricey as expected in a 5-star resort. Service is okay - we made a reservation when we check-in, they couldn't find it but still manage to arrange a seat right next to the beach for us.Show less

Author: annie23490
Title: An experience to remember
Review: This is an amazing specialist restaurant - choose from a range of freshly caught fish and then choose the style of cooking. Best grilled fish I have ever eaten.The setting on the beach in the evening is so romantic and the service is first class.

Author: Albeen ADubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great fresh fish and lovely easy beach design
Review: We decided the last moment to try the Jala restaurant for our dinner after seeing so many positive reviews and especially also for its location. I love the fact that such a nice restaurant with top service and food is located right on the beach, has sand on the floor and its overall style is nice easy and relaxed. Our request for table was immediately accomodated by very professional lady that also took us to our table asap and asked us, if we want to take our shoes off ;-). That was really nice and something i did not expect. You feel, you can really relax and enjoy nice time with your loved ones. We liked menu selection and could easily picked few plates. However, we prefered the fresh fish for our starter and main course. Both courses were perfectly served, both had some additional tasty sauces and for the main course we could add additional 3 small plates of side dishes. All this amazing experince was underlined by great wine, sunset, amazing weather, nice music. Will remember this place forever and the experience is priceless. Simply loved it.Show less

Author: JinB100
Title: A beautiful restaurant
Review:
A wonderful setting on the beach (sand between your toes as you tuck into your starters!).
The menu is mainly seafood, but there are options for meat and veggies. All dishes are well presented and very tasty!

Author: ENabokovLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh local sustainable seafood with great views of sunset
Review: - Very fresh seafood and they tried to support the local fishermen and making the sea more sustainable by having bigger sized fishes and male crabs only (great job on this)- Service abit slow and not so attentive. The couple next table was heard complaining to the manager.- Expensive. We had a fish for RM300. We traveled alot and understand the need for sustainability. I'm concern if the $ goes to the fishermen or bulk of it still goes to the resort's own pockets.Show less

Author: EmmaCourtneyMelbourne, Australia
Title: Luxurious location & Amazing food
Review: Was an easy process making a booking via email, and the location is stunning! Menu is very limited, but there is the option to pick a seafood with sides and sauces! Food was lovely and service staff were very friendly! Would recommend and would definitely come back! Sunset view is also very romantic, with tree swings very close by!As we weren’t guests at the resort they also offered a shuttle back into Chenang which just topped the whole night off with perfect service!Show less

Author: emmy91Melbourne, Australia
Title: FRESH SEAFOOD DINNER
Review: When i was looking for best seafood restaurant in Langkawi, Jala was the first one that appeared on TripAdvisor and how lucky that i was staying at the resort. The 'floor' was sand which made it even better as the restaurant is facing the beach so you get to hear the 'waves' at night and dine by the beach as well. You are able to choose the seafood and how you'd like it cook the waiter will be able to recommend as well. We had a mix of prawn, squid and fish and they were all absolutely fresh and tasty! The dinner had live band music in the background which made the dinner more enjoyable.Show less

Author: YingHaK
Title: Fantastic dinner at Jala
Review: The local seafood in Jala is so fresh. We ordered grilled tiger prawns and snapper, concluded with the signature dessert. It is delicious.  The sunset view is very amazing. It is a nice place for dinner and we had a wonderful night.

Author: mohsinf882
Title: Fresh and amazing
Review: Amazing fresh squid which was fresh and seasoned to perfection , and a beautiful fish. Cooked to perfection and eaten to the bone ♥️♥️

Author: Foodie_munch
Title: Service was excellent!
Review: Had dinner here during the off peak season. The fish was done well, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not to mention the dish was presented beautifully. Whilst the food was great, what impressed me the most was not the food but rather the excellent service provided by the waiters. They were constantly checking on us to ensure we were alright. The waiters were very attentive and brought us mosquito repellant the moment we started fidgeting in the seats. Restaurant ambience was nice overall!Show less

Author: d0miniccLaunceston, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: Leave your shoes behind it’s a sandy floor so none required!! We ate here 4 times in our holiday at the andaman I think that gives a clue as to how good it was!! We chose fresh fish from the ice counter and left it to the chefs to work their magic and they did every time!! We also managed to see stunning sunsets at the dinner table!!Show less

Author: Prados68
Title: Pick your poisson!
Review: Enjoy picking out your dinner from the array of fish on ice then devise your own meal. Sandy floor and the sound of the sea add to the experience

Author: caesdSingapore, Singapore
Title: Familly dinner
Review: We had a dinner with our young kids during our stay at the hotel.They do have a kids menu despite that it is a fine dining restaurant.Very good location, along the beach, relaxing, service efficient.Perfect for seafood lovers : you can choose your fish, the way of cooking it, the side dishes, the sauce.A bit expensive but it has to be compared with a fine dining in a major city.To my knowledge, the best restaurant in Langkawi.Show less

Author: BelindatpSydney, Australia
Title: Freshly cooked seafood with stunning views
Review: We stayed at the Andaman and dined here once, last night. After trying a variety of restaurants at the resort and on the island we can highly recommend this restaurant.  Upon arrival you can remove your shoes and dine barefoot with the soft sand between your toes!Choose from an a la carte menu where the chefs put together some delicious flavor or choose your fresh seafood along with side and condiments. We ate a la carte for starters and chose a whole snapper for main. It was cooked perfectly and melted in your mouth. The chefs filleted the fish making it simple to eat! We loved the Langkawi green chili sauce as we love chili foods. The squid and desserts were also delicious! Show less

Author: tgrdecker
Title: Excellent fare
Review: had supper one evening, food was very good but small portions.  Very well presented though.  Great service.  Not inexpensive

Author: JacquelineG2306London, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but underwhelming experience
Review: The setting was on the edge of the beach and pleasant. The food was excellent and cooked to a high standard. What was disappointing was the help given at the fish bar. If you are unfamiliar with certain local fish you need guidance in making your choice but our server was a bit indifferent and could have been much more helpfulShow less

Author: Meng Yang NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Freshly Caught seafood by the Datai beach
Review: This is the signature restaurant at the Andaman resort, which has dedicated fisherman catching local seafood for diners to choose and enjoy. Had the sambal squid that was amazingly tender, and the grilled snapper was cooked to perfection and had a lovely smoked flavor. A bit pricey and quite far if you're not a hotel guest. Show less

Author: susan b
Title: Fish all the way
Review: Fabulous fish you can choose which one, how you want it cooked and which what sauce or not and also some side dishes.  We had Golden Pom-fret and it was absolutely divine.

Author: BeeteeyorkYork, United Kingdom
Title: Didn’t meet expectations
Review: Situated in The Andaman hotel this restaurant is in a beautiful beachside setting. The tables and chairs are on sand. It wasn’t straightforward to access as a non-resident, they may not be used to external visitors?The food did not live up to expectations and was pricey. Starters were better than mains. Great prawns but fish of the day nothing special. Wouldn’t rush back.Show less

Author: 803giadapDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent food and great staff!!!
Review: This venue is the best of the hotel in terms of food and staff. You can select the fresh catch of the day from the display and decide how to be prepared with the help of the chef. The concept is fantastic, the prices affordable. Good wine list with very reasonable prices for us that we were travelling from Hong Kong. Special thanks for the Indonesian supervisor, Leonard (apologies for the misspelling), great smile and very professional. The location is great as well. Hope to be back soon, because we had a great time.Show less

Author: blueseaandsandUnited Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: The best asset of The Andaman Hotel is the seafood restaurant, Jala. Great service and wonderful food. An excellent selection of locally caught fish, cooked in a number of different ways with accompanying dishes. The house menu is good, but try the fish from the seafood counter and discuss what cooking method the chef recommends. We eat here four out of five nights and always found something new.Show less

Author: BlueHaywardGuernsey, United Kingdom
Title: Tiger Prawns that are just so big!!!!
Review: We ate in this restaurant 3 times in the week we stayed at The Andaman. The food was fantastic and the staff very attentive. The a la carte menu has an excellent selection of food but if you get the chance have the tiger prawns from the fish counter, do. The only way to describe them is 'ridiculous' for the size and taste!! The deserts are also amazing, so make sure you save space for them as well!On our last night the team finished by providing us with a glass of prosecco to say farewell, which was a lovely touch.Show less

Author: Helgs MMunich, Germany
Title: Freshest fish landed that afternoon!
Review: We watched the fishing boat come to the beach and the chefs go down to meet the boat and check over the catch.Impossible to imagine fresher fish!We ate in this restaurant twice in the week. First time we chose the main course from the al a carte and it was really well thought out and superbly prepared.The second time we chose a freshly landed fish. It was a lovely experience to select not only the fish but, also all the components of the dish.Not sure wish I prefferred as they are quite different experiences , try both?For starters the Jalaksa was unbeatable.Wine selection was well thought out and reasonable priced.Show less

Author: Sidda1
Title: Fantastic fresh fish by the sea!
Review: Excellent food and the location is perfect! Definitely the best restaurant inside the Andaman however 5x more expensive that most restaurants on the island. This due to their remote setting so I assume they can get away with it!

Author: Graham S
Title: Wow
Review: This was our favorite restaurant (fish) no shoes you walk barefooted on sand to choose your fish and the way you want it cooked, The fish was cooked to perfection what a fantastic expereince

Author: 848lucypBrighton and Hove, United Kingdom
Title: Exquisite fresh seafood
Review: One of THE best meals we have ever eaten. We chose our fish from the fresh counter and on the recommendation of the chef, picked complementary sauces and vegetable accompaniments. The chef also offered to cook it in two styles as we couldn't agree on which we'd prefer. Truly a meal to remember - especially when you are sat on one of the most beautiful beaches in the world with your feet in the sand... Show less

Author: Michelle P
Title: amazing food , best restaurant
Review: amazing five star food , the service was amazing and the staff were lovely , we loved this restaurant

Author: Audee C
Title: Romantic Dinner at Jala
Review: Love your concept with the shoe concierge. walk around the restaurant bare footed. food was great, staff was very friendly & good service.

Author: lynda lNormandy, France
Title: Excellent Seafood
Review: Service as always very good. Unfortunately although my husband and I both chose the same main course, they had run out, so had to choose a substitute, which although tasty was a bit disappointing. However, the dish chosen was first class and we enjoyed it. for dessert I chose their take on a Black Forest dessert, which was fantastic.Show less

Author: John S
Title: May 2017
Review: We ate from both the menu and by selecting a specific fish and choosing its accompiaments. The food was simply excellent.

Author: Liam K
Title: Very expensive
Review: Too highly price and I could not quite justify the cost nor the ambience. The sea food was fresh and cooked as required. The dishes were not exceptional. Service good, and the selection of wine acceptable. I would not repeat the experience.

Author: Nandang M
Title: Recommended restaurant
Review: Jala restaurant is fantastic, food was delicious, I had a great dinner right on the beach. What a beautiful place! With sunset view and warm service show by Rinaldy.. I'm definitely come back next year

Author: winejmGuangzhou, China
Title: Ggod restaurant
Review: We went there on a sunday. Food was correct, plates very nicely organized.For kids food was a little too original, but fineShow less

Author: rkigervaronHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Awesome
Review: Great food, great atmosphere/ ambiance and excellent service-- pricey and smallish dishes but a great experience nonetheless Show less

Author: ajaymahendru1988Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: "World Class Restaurant"
Review: The food was absolutely wonderful, from preparation to presentation, very pleasing. We especially enjoyed the special server, name by Linardy.. He was amazing!!!Jala Manager-Alias, was great guy and always assist us at anytime..Milzam Seafood Expert was superd!!! Chef Thorsten Killian, another amazing chef i ever met!! Nova, lovely hostess always with beautiful smile and always offer the best table in Jala...Will be back!!!!Show less

Author: grodenl
Title: Seafoodddd
Review: From the warm welcome to the unique greetings written on the leave. I can't recommend this place highly enough, it was excellent from start to finish, and everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meals. Very nice atmosphere and the food was delicious.Show less

Author: Zainal RMelaka, Malaysia
Title: The Beauty of Jala
Review: Tbh, just sitting at there makes me urge with excitement and anxiousness. While waiting for the meal, playing the sand with my feet is one of the experience that this restaurant can offer. Wait, where does this sand come from?, the FLOOR of the RESTAURANT IS THE BEACH SAND itself. Isnt it unique? Indeed.At the restaurant, me and my wife were sitting at the couple table in which the closest to the sea. But. I couldnt take my eyes off from a long,sturdy wooden table. I dont know where they got that, but its really amazed me by just looking at it. just imagine if i could bring my whole family eating there. Definitely one of these days i shall return and reserved it. The cuisine, i never knew these local chefs were very good, the Golden Pomfret there was excellent and really fresh. How do i know that its fresh? Just after we were eating, we were coincidentally able to witness a fisherman boat arrived at the bay, and the Chefs went there by himself to buy the sea treasure. Definitely i wont be worrying about the freshness of the seafood at Jala. The taste are tasty and really good.Show less

Author: StevieSellarAdelaide, Australia
Title: "May we take your shoes miss?"
Review: The best! Hoping to host my wedding reception here I loved it so much. AMAZING fancy shamancy food, squish your toes in the sand while overlooking the ocean or watching the fire pit crackle at night. PRO TIP: make a booking for the window area, you will have the best view.Show less

Author: MohdA4418
Title: unique dinning
Review: the seafood was amazing, the dinning experience was super amazing. The atmosphere, the stuff, the chef was lovely. Well done.

Author: Laszlo RNuremberg, Germany
Title: The best meal at the Andaman
Review: By far the best place to eat at the Andaman. Great selection of seafood, the best service staff they have, a lovely view, your feet in the sand - heavenly!Show less

Author: FelixT847
Title: NIce View
Review: The stuff is very friendly, the service was good. If you come around 7 to 7.30pm you can enjoy the beautiful sunset at Theandaman beach with your dinner.Show less

Author: tony bMalmesbury, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely time here
Review: We spent 11 nights at the Andaman in March and ate at this restaurant on five occasions. We enjoyed the food very much and found the staff so friendly and also very efficient especially Robin and Thivyaa who could not have done more for us, many thanks.Show less

Author: Julia GCamberley, United Kingdom
Title: Inconsistent
Review: We ate at Jala restaurant the last 2 nights of our holiday at the Andaman. The first night we had a fabulous meal & were well attended to by attentive staff. After somewhat of a hit & miss experience with food & service for the first week of our holiday we were so impressed that we decided to return for our last night. On both evenings the fish snapper and sea bass were cooked to perfection, probably the tastiest fish we have eaten, but the second nights meal left us disappointed in the extreme. Our daughters hot dog randomly turned up by itself & when we asked it for it come at the same as our meals it again randomly turned up 10 minutes later stone cold and the roll was stuck to the plate, we sent it back and she was seved with a fresh meal. All four sides we ordered were lukewarm , we couldn't be bothered to send them back as asking for anything like a drink or more bread involved requesting the said items at least twice and a lengthy wait. To top it off our daughter asked for mint chocolate chip ice cream which we knew the hotel had as it was available from the gelato counter around the pool earlier in the day, our waitress said they didn't have any. We complained to the food & beverage manager who managed to magic up some ice cream and was very apologetic about our experience. Jala is the Andamans signature restaurant and at around £120 for a 2 course meal & 4 glasses of wine for the two of us it should and could have been so much better, sadly a bit like the Andaman in generalShow less

Author: sarah075Somerset, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: We are staying at The Anderman and have dined here twice. The setting is wonderful and reminded us the Maldives, as you take your shoes off before dining!All the staff at the hotel are wonderful and the service at Jala was superb on both occasions. The fresh fish was beautifully presented and the food tastes wonderful. Definitely on par with top restaurants in the U.K. It's not a cheap meal but the price reflects the setting and the quality of the food. Our three course meal ( for three)with a bottle of wine came to 950 ringgits. Highly recommend!Show less

Author: minnieinrichmondRichmond, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: This restaurant is situated within the grounds of the Andaman and is predominantly a seafood restaurant. The food, service & ambience is outstanding. I would dare to say the presentation and taste of the food is some of the best I have ever tasted . It is cuisine at it's best and if you appreciate the finer things in life, it's a must.Show less

Author: RENERONOJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: FANTASTIC FOOD
Review: A while we still planning for our dinner at the town but been introduce by the executive chef fhadrul about this Jala restaurant, nice food and fresh seafood, our fish dishes was marvelous Show less

Author: AndyL71Cowes, United Kingdom
Title: The best fresh fish
Review: Wonderful location overlooking Datai beach. Superb fresh fish to choose a la carte. Great service too. Expensive but thoroughly recommended. Quirky in having a sand floor despite fine dining! You take your shoes off and there is a place to wah your feet at the end!Show less

Author: carboproSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cosy comfortable relax beach side dinner
Review: Usually we do not have much expectation on restaurants managed by hotel themselves. This gives us different view in this place. In the beginning , my friend is quite disappointed with their menu which does not have much choices. The staff ask us to have a lot at their catch of day. There are a whole range of fish to choose from. The staff will listen to your requests and not put you to choose something more expensive. In the end, we choose a fish (~600g) with 2 side dishes. The grilled fish meat is so tender and unlike over cooked fish in some restaurants in Bali. The green chili sauce matched the fish just nice and pair with a bottle of Sauvignon Blanc. All the staff in the restaurants are very polite and they are trained to serve Caucasian/ European customers. This restaurant is worth to visit second time and try the other dishes. Show less

Author: datoZulpenang
Title: good and cozy place to dine
Review: a lot varieties of seafood. expert chef. well prepaired and excelent service. waiteress are friendlyShow less

Author: Fam5housesAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Better Thai food than in Thailand!
Review: The setting of this outdoor roofed restaurant is perfect, sitting on a dek about 15 m above the ground in the rainforrest. The tase is well balanced and niceky spiced. I loved the barracuda with coconutShow less

Author: vwongwtKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food but Overpriced
Review: Arrived on a Rainy Sunday Evening. After Jala opened, we were promptly seated and attended to. Service was excellent throughout. Rain did startup and when the wind blew we did get 'sprayed' but that's open dining at the beach for you! Perused the a-la carte menu and promptly ordered the Jalaksa, Grouper and Black Angus Striploin. Was served bread with 3 dips (Chick peas with Cheese, Chickpeas with Red Pepper and Herbed Goat Cheese with Black Olives) The Goat Cheese with Black Olives was the best dip by far IMHO. The Jalaksa was a take on Malaysian Laksa with a lighter broth but very well done and tasty. Would like to see the option of tweaking the 'heat' level for those who like things more spicy like me. Wife ordered the Soy Butter Poached Hybrid Grouper with coconut risotto which executed very well while I had the Black Angus Sirloin done to perfection with Beef Ragout, Crunchy potatoes etc. Excellent dish. The Jala prides itself of displaying fishes/seafood caught fresh locally but being brutally honest, the prices are definitely suited for the higher income bracket mostly foreign guests. Seafood prices ranged from RM29-RM36/100g. To put into perspective a grouper was quoted at RM32/100g while a grouper in a Chinese Restaurant in Kuah's price was RM8/100g. Granted the selected fish in Jala comes with 4 sides included but for a relatively poor Malaysian tourist is a bit exorbitant. Nevertheless the resort have their own pricing policy which I am sure they have their justification for doing so. That aside, my wife and I truly enjoyed our dinner and the service staff were excellent!Show less

Author: Joseph gBelfast, United Kingdom
Title: fish restaurant
Review: this was our favourite restaurant at the Andaman. The location was stunning, the sand under our feet. Wonderful staff, who helped us choose our fish from the counter & advised on cooking methods. Nothing was to much trouble Show less

Author: Perry BHong Kong, China
Title: Another great seafood meal...
Review: A superb restaurant which provided another splendid evening for us, but this time for our son as well. The seafood is fresh and succulent; the condiments perfect in terms of their being mouthwatering complements to the main dishes. Great service and beautiful surroundings! What more could one ask?Show less

Author: 3PeasInAP0DSydney, Australia
Title: Wonderful Seafood Dining Experience
Review: The food, wine, ambience and service was so good that we ate here twice. If we had of tried Jala earlier during our stay then we would have eaten here more often. This was by far the best dining experience at the Andaman resort. On both occasions, we chose to select our own seafood from the display instead of ordering from the menu. We weren't familiar with all the fish varieties but the staff took the time to explain the different fish (Chef Thornston the first night and the seafood expert the second night). Their pride in the fresh locally caught seafood was evident and this translated into perfectly cooked seafood. Succulent grilled prawns with Jala sauce (similar to red curry), grilled snapper with ginger soy sauce and grilled pomfret with Langkawi green chilli sauce. The desserts were wonderful as well. Our waiters were friendly and the service was noticeably different to other F&B venues in the resort. Jala was expensive but worth it. It was a casual, relaxed fine dining experience - perfect for a tropical holiday.Show less

Author: xavierb371Santiago, Chile
Title: Amazing seafood choice and excellent cuisine
Review: During our stay in the Andaman, we went twice to this restaurant. For me and my family it is clearly our favourite restaurant of the hotel. The experience starts with a selection of fresh fish of the day: you chose the fish you like and the way to prepare it. The way to prepare the fish remains simple, but as for me, it is the way it should be when the products are that fresh! Just excellent!I also loved the place: the restaurant is next to the beach and the dinning room directly on sand. It is a very casual restaurant but yet chic.Show less

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Tasty & fun dining
Review: We opted to check out Jala for our first dinner at the Andaman, but to be honest, nothing on the menu really stood out for us. However, we did decide to give it a go all the same, and ordered a seafood salad and Jalaksa (Jala's interpretation of a seafood laksa), which were both appetizers. The seafood salad arrived under a glass cup of smoke, which was removed by the waiter upon service and imparted a delightful perfume to the dish. The accompanying sauce reminded me strongly of sauce andalouse though; I much preferred the rest of the dish without it. The portion was tiny (fine dining style) but it was flavourful. The Jalaksa was equally flavoursome. A small portion of noodles and seafood floated in a tasty seafood consomme, which arrived in a small glass carafe and was poured over the dish by the waiter. Our favourite part of the experience might have been Jala's ambience. The restaurant sits on a platform right next to the beach, has no walls and features a sandy floor, allowing the outdoor experience in indoor settings - guests are encouraged to walk in without their shoes, kick back and enjoy the experience! It's also great for romantic dinners, particularly at the tables closest to the sea, where you can enjoy the cool night breeze and soft lull of the surf. The downside to it is that the small menu really didn't have enough appeal to it for us, and was quite pricey. Apart from the menu, there was a selection of freshly caught fish and seafood which you could have the chef cook to your preference, but even as people who don't often quibble about the price of food and will happily pay for quality (we eat out at fine-dine restaurants several times a year), we were somewhat put off by the exorbitant prices quoted for that option (a couple of hundred RM for a single fish dish was a bit much, we thought). All in all though, we thought the food was tasty, and had a delightfully unique dining experience where the service was attentive. If expense isn't a factor for you, then do give Jala a try.Show less

Author: AlexK6455Hong Kong, China
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Great fresh seafood with friendly and attentive service. Highly recommend the mackerel starter and anything from the seafood counter. Show less

Author: fox7179Barcelona, Spain
Title: amazing seafood
Review: We keep coming back to the Jala! chef Thirston is one of the best anywhere. Each time we eat here the fish seems fresher than the time before. Must try itShow less

Author: Rachel GShanghai, China
Title: Failed service, subpar food, not worth your money.
Review: If the service had been a touch better or if the curry powder used to season the fish had salt in it, maybe I'd have given it a three. But I guess if you're paying premium to stay at andaman, it's for everything but the food/restaurant service. When I pay prices like these (RM300+ for 1kg snapper, a cheap market fish), I'd at least expect the food to be just shy of fantastic. It wasn't. The fresh fish was executed well, but the grill seasoning lacked salt, or was devoid of any. Flavor came from the jala sauce, a spicy green chili blend. The sides that accompany the main are puny in size. We were offered four sides to accompany. And one of those was a serving of white rice, which came out around 50gram serving - it's like portioning for weight watchers. Waitresses came by so many times to ask to clear our plates, even clearing them before finishing to ask/wait for a reply. Service is so lowly. Even a mamak could do better. Pouring wine, was shy of 100ml, when it should have been 150ml. We had to point it out to the waitstaff before they topped it up. Other staff keep buzzing around waiting to clear your plates, targeting a guest at a time instead of waiting for all parties to finish their food before clearing the table. Coming in and out while others are still eating is rude, and just shows lack of basic training. Prepare yourself for incompetent staff, who aren't busy and ready to clear off your table as soon as they can, just to show they're doing something, and to get you out of the restaurant. Good points - the view (a picnic basket on the beach can give you the same). and the food comes out within 5 minutes of ordering. In summary: you should spend the money to rent a car to drive somewhere else better to eat, and still have change to spare. Show less

Author: Jane PAdelaide Hills, Australia
Title: Average food in beautiful setting.
Review: Overpriced food that was fairly average. The setting of the restaurant was beautiful and the service was good. It is very handy for the guests of the Andaman but I wouldn't make a special trip to go there if you a not a guest of the hotel.Show less

Author: sussexrowmarkRye, United Kingdom
Title: stunning food, splendid location
Review: We ate twice here, having to return on our last night because the food was so good. First time round was in a thunderstorm, which only added to the atmospheric location right beside the sea. We could have chosen a fish from the fish counter and asked for it to be cooked the way we wanted but we opted for the interesting menu instead - and had no regrets. We never do 3 courses when we eat out but the starters and main courses were so delicious we had to have a dessert. And on both occasions our shared desserts were outstanding. The banana and chocolate dish included mouthwatering banana ice cream and a dark chocolate 'brick' which when cut into produced a liquid caramel centre. Nice selection of wines. Not a cheap place to eat but well worth it.Show less

Author: mrs0liverBedfordshire, United Kingdom
Title: An Andaman Luxury Collection Pearl
Review: Really lovely restaurant, shoes of, sandy feet, by the beach side. Pick your freh fish from the counter and chose your cokking style or chose from chalk board. I could eat there everyday.Show less

Author: katel0uis3Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: 2 Very Different Experiences
Review: We ate at this restaurant twice. The first time was not a good experience! Firstly they had run out of the dish I wanted off the menu. Instead we chose a fish out of the cabinet and chose the sides we wanted with it. The fish its self was very tasty, but the coconut rice was not cooked properly, it was cold and very salty. The service was not brilliant and we were made to feel that the waiters weren't very interested. The second time however was a completely different experience. We chose both meals off the menu and the food was cooked very well. The service was a lot more friendly and we really enjoyed it.Show less

Author: Rory A
Title: Amazing
Review: Just amazing, great setting, great food, great service, expensive but still good value for the quality, no more words needed to describe.Show less

Author: David LCastle Douglas, United Kingdom
Title: Sand between your toes!
Review: Set overlooking the gorgeous private beach at the Andaman with the waves gently breaking on the sand below you, diners are barefoot- difficult to resist just toe wriggling with pleasure. Coire is between an a la carte menu presented on small (!) Blackboards, a good selection of fish and meat dishes or to let the friendly knowledgeable staff guide you through the catch on Disley on ice. You can be guided on the best way to have your choice cooked and choose from rice, potatoes,vegetables,salad and dips to go with it.Food is always hot! Staff and service first class. When you leave and collect your footwear you simply blow of the sand with the compressed air guns! Now that's just spot on.Show less

Author: jofrost678Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic choice of freshly caught fish at reasonable prices
Review: Dinner at the Jala is quirkily different. Sand replaces the usual floor with staff and guests in bare feet or flip flops and a chance to clean your feet with a high powered air gun when you leave which the children in particular will just love. The choice of fish is diverse and diners can choose from a set menu or select a fish from those on display and personalise the way it is cooked, along with the sauces and vegetables, etc. Great for sharing. There is also a limited choice of non fish dishes for the non fish lovers. Everything is beautifully cooked and excellent quality and I would highly recommend a visit.Show less

Author: katelg01Portugal
Title: One of our best meals on our honeymoon!
Review: The setting is superb overlooking the beach we had a fabulous meal here that was only a little more expensive than most other places. We were shown the fresh fish which looked extremely good but I am always a little nervous ordering fish at a price per kilo so we went off the menu. All the food choices were really well presented and beautiful. This was a perfect setting and perfect meal on our honeymoonShow less

Author: TequilaDubaiDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Delicious local seafood, a must try when in Langkawi
Review: We ate at the Jala restaurant twice during our stay at The Andaman in Langkawi which is where the restaurant is located. When you enter you are given the option to take your footwear off to enjoy the sand beneath your feet while eating as the restaurant is on the beach. You are then shown a variety of seafood from the catch of the day and this ranges from freshly caught prawns, lobster, mackerel, seabass and more. You can choose how you want it cooked with accompanying sides and sauces, the best ones being the linguine with truffle oil and the lemon butter sauce. Surprisingly, given my service rating for The Andaman overall, the restaurant has good, attentive service with staff who are knowlegeable about the food. Hands down, the best two meals we had during our stay. You can even pre-order your meal as a hotel guest as it runs out fast. And reservations are definitely recommended. A must try for seafood lovers when in Langkawi. Show less

Author: ElenaDosDoha, Qatar
Title: Great seafood restaurant
Review: l've been told is the best seafood restaurant on the island so i set my expectation high; it did not disappoint! everything was absolutely delicious, the starters, the flavoured fish, the desserts. Staff was extremely attentive, especially Thivyaa such a sweetheart, very helpful, she took her time to explain each dishes from the menu making great recommendations. Highly recommend this place. l'll be back to try the rest of the dishes i have not tried. Show less

Author: GinaloveShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: fabulous birthday dinner
Review: the restaurant itself is so beautiful and romantic. the set up is laid back and they have smartly infused the natural island essence into the restaurant by using sand as the floor bed so you can literally dine barefooted with your feet dipped in sand. food was good and the selection of fishes were fresh but... honestly it was pricey and so pls be prepared to pay an average of rm250-rm280 per fish which you can choose to be cooked anyway you like either western or asian style. you can also choose side dishes like fried rice or potato salad at additional cost. the restaurant servers were wonderful and very attentive, and kept my son entertained by making small chats and cracking up jokes. its fine dining in a laid back and non intimidating set-up. no worries... kids are welcomed here if you are wondering,,Show less

Author: Ayla_KosmonovaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Unforgettable meals
Review: Saved the best for our last night at the Andaman. Truly unforgettable taste & experience. We were hard to choose either ala carte or the fresh catch of the day...the waiter was helpful in describing each of the menu on board & provide suggestions. We ordered grilled white pomfret, accompanied with rice, kailan & water spinach. The way they cook the water spinach was soo unique & memorable, what kind of belacan they use? the green chilli dip was nice, tangy & spicy. Everything we had was so nice & we raved about it whenever we dined out in a comparable posh restaurant...there's nothing like Jala, period!Show less

Author: SathishR1
Title: Seafood extravaganza
Review: We had dinner just now. The fish and prawns were delectable. The sauces and accompanying vegetable dishes were delightfully delicious. Epicurean and gastronomic wonder. Show less

Author: Lawrence L
Title: Best Dinner Ever
Review: Been here recently, and was suprised with the service and food. Wanna praise my server Thivyaa for making me feel at home and welcome and to meet to my needs. Never fail to keep a smile on her face. A place and memories that I will never forget and will definitely come back again soon.Show less

Author: HonestTruth88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious but pricey
Review: This is an amazing seafood restaurant by the Andaman beach. You get to enjoy the deliciously cooked seafood of your choice while still feeling the beach sand beneath your feet. Nice place for seafood lovers . We feel that it is slightly overpriced but worth the experience.Give it a try !Show less

Author: Lucy BHertfordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Unique dining experience
Review: If you're staying on Langkawi we highly recommend a meal here!Fresh fish, perfect setting on the beach and great service. The best meal we had during our holiday.Show less

Author: penangowlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh seafood in a unique setting
Review: We dined in Jala during our stay at The Andaman recently. The restaurant is by the seaside with a very unique setting. Instead of concrete flooring, the restaurant's flooring is actually sand from the beach. Guests are invited to go barefoot.Instead of choosing from a standard menu, guests are invited to select their fresh seafood at the main counter. The friendly and helpful staff showed us what seafood were available that night and made some really good recommendations. We had a grilled whole-fish and some prawns. We like the simple cooking style as brought out the fresh taste of the seafood. The selection of sauces and sides provided with each order were great too. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: FrancescaU535Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best meal of the trip!
Review: We stayed at the Andaman for 3 nights, and on the 2nd night, we had dinner at Jala. Unique experience dining on the beach, with the sound of waves crashing just metres away.Bread was served with 2 kinds of dip, and a couple of carrots lying on a bed of cream cheese and chopped olives. It sounds weird, but it is delicious! We ordered the grilled Octopus (RM45) with madras curry, artichoke mayo, smoked paprika cream, baby salad leaves, pickled shallots, with pear & lime vinaigrette. We ate up every morsel, it was that good. We ordered the freshly caught Emperor fish (priced at RM36 per 100g) cooked pan fried, and we chose 3 sides : linguine with truffle sauce, fried potatoes, tomato salad. The food was exquisite, especially with the Langkawi Green Chili sauce. The sauce goes with everything!! We accompanied the meal with a bottle of white wine from Hunter Valley (easy to drink, light on the palate). All in all, worth the price as everything was delicious and well prepared. We'll definitely be back!! Show less

Author: goonettaSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Fresh seafood by the sea.
Review: Nice cosy fine-dining setting. fish was fresh and was done 2 different ways- steamed and grilled. Came with plenty of sides and sauces. The Langkawi green chilli was delicious with good balance of sweet and spiciness. Show less

Author: gagtvmTrivandrum
Title: great place right on the beach!
Review: Good restaurant with quick service located right on the beach. Couldnt ask for a better setting!The menu is quite decent too and we loved the malay selection Show less

Author: RasikaTMBombay
Title: Good dining option
Review: We had quick & good service at an odd hour. Good service attention towards my 3-yeard as well ! Decent menu options.Show less

Author: lynnw251Cullercoats, United Kingdom
Title: Superb Seafood by the Seashore.
Review: When we walked in we were asked if we wanted to leave our shoes at the front desk and experience the sandy floor bare foot! It's a really beautiful setting right on the beach front. The standard a la carte menu is quite extensive with some lovely selections for both starters and mains and then as an alternative there is also the choice of the fresh fish from the fish bar which is priced according to weight and can be cooked in a variety of different ways and with a selection of sides and sauces. We went with starters from the menu board and the the chefs recommendation for some fragrant Asian fish (sorry can't recall the name) it was superb!! Portions of everything are nice sizes so it left room for dessert. We chose the Black Forest. I was expecting a piece of Black Forest gateau but was pleasantly surprised with a beautiful presentation of a Black Forest scene. Amazing. They even made the cherry sorbet freshly in front of us using dry ice. Very theatrical and ultra tasty!! Well done Jala for service, choice, quality and something a bit different. We will come back here again before our holiday ends. Show less

Author: Erica HCanberra, Australia
Title: 2016 Family Holiday
Review: We ate there last night and we all loved it. Miss 7 had pasta with melt in your mouth beef. I had 2 of the largest prawns I have ever seen with a few different sides. Master 6 had the children's fish & vegs. DH had a snapper that he hand picked from the many choices of frest fish along with sides. Mr 10 had some bits of everyone's. Endless supply of bread and kids got icecream. All this for just over $100 AUS$ It was amazing.Show less

Author: 407beccalBrisbane, Australia
Title: Couple
Review: This place is so romantic beautiful setting on the water. Barefoot restaurant with sand floor looking onto Langkawi private beach. Staff are so friendly & helpful. It's a little expensive but converted to Aussie dollars wasn't so bad. 450 ringgit for a whole fish, 1 king prawn, vegetables & 2 fresh juice to drink but the view is worth every dollar! Show less

Author: dietrichateHelsinki, Finland
Title: Excellent food, service and setting
Review: A real pleasure to dine here, with a mixture of Malay and Indian food. My favourite restaurant in the Datai resortShow less

Author: desertdog_11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great seafood that was so fresh the fish in cooler were still flinching
Review: The chef came to our room to organize our seating for 15+ persons to make sure we were able to preorder and get exactly what we needed. He explained all of their options for our group as well as estimated the costs (the seafood is based on eight). They had everything arranged by the time we arrived for our reservation and his staff were very attentive to our needs and made sure we were pleased. So good we went back just as a couple two nights later! Again, fantastic.Show less

Author: MarykarFrance
Title: Great dinner by the sea
Review: We stayed in Andaman hotel, so naturally one of the evenings we decided to try this restaurant. It was a pleasure. Fine cuisine, fresh food with modern sophisticated touch, attentive service, relaxed atmosphere... We even didn't find it to be too expensive for the high quality that it offers! I Really recommend it! Show less

Author: VSNathanGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Amazing dining experience!
Review: This restaurant is amazing! We dined here twice during our week stay in Langkawi. What an absolute fabulous dining experience overlooking the bay of the Andaman Sea. Very fresh sea food selections with the Chefs there to make his recommendations. It all sounded so lovely, but decided to order from the menu on both occasions and we were so happy that we did. During dinner you'll find a spectacular sunset, which makes the whole dining experience more enjoyable. Every part of the meal was perfect. We cannot find a single fault! Service was impeccable; waiters/waitresses were friendly yet subtle. This is a must have in Langkawi as it's truly a fantastic experience which left us all feeling very happy.Show less

Author: Woodster554Greater Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: I had the pleasure of eating at Jala twice last week. both times we selected a fish from the fish counter and chose the accompaniments. I did look at the menu but the choice wasn't very varied and me and my fiancé wanted the fresh fish anyway. The fist night I tried a local fish which was nice and the next time we had Barramundi. The food was create and filleted well and the side dishes where also great. The guy on the fish counter was great in assisting our choice with his recommendations.Show less

Author: ScotsdocPerth
Title: Limited selection
Review: I was fairly excited about eating in this restaurant during our stay at "The Andaman" for my daughters wedding as I love sea food.I was disappointed with the limited choices of sea food available, although the choices that were available were fresh and very well presented.The staff were excellent and very attentive through out the meal, but, I didn't go back for seconds during the seven day stay.Show less

Author: Julia-LeyrisFrance
Title: Excellent
Review: The food was amazing, fine, gourmet, spices and full of flavor! We took Asian meals and it was a very good choice :)Show less

Author: Samsul A
Title: 100 Restaurants u need to go
Review: i went to this beautiful and nice place in langkawi. this outlet is so memorable place. no word can descript this beautiful place, all the staff is well trained. so happy that i happen to experience this beautiful moment in jala restaurant. i will come back to this restaurant for sure. i give my credit to mr ally. my friend call him A's small2 African. we so happy Show less

Author: Nazv89Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantabulous!!
Review: I had a really great dining experience here during my stay. Thank you to Mr. Alias and the team making our stay memorable. Kudos to the team!!!Show less

Author: Capta1n57Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Has been better
Review: Actually feels like ur on the Beach. Your shoes are stashed for u on arrival and you are walking on sand. Lovely. Staff are always good and setting amazing. Menu hadn't changed much since our last visit,but didn't find it as good this time. Not a lot on the plate but my fish was beautifully presented,and very nice. Might be that i am being to fussy and will be backShow less

Author: Rajan R
Title: Excellent
Review: Amazing staff with great food. Superb! A must try venue for all. Just ask for the manager to recommendShow less

Author: Alicia G
Title: TWO Thumbs Up
