Review: Aside from great ambience, stunning beach view, friendly well trained staff, food here is a must try before leaving Langkawi. Nonetheless, I really had a wonderful time dining here with my friends and kudos to Jala's crew for creating an unforgettable dining experience.Definitely will come again on my next trip!Show less

Author: ruzitajPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: GREAT FOOD & EXCELLENT VIEW
Review: With romantic panaroma,great food & excellent services, we really enjoyed our meals. Will come again! ;)Show less

Author: MR4090
Title: Best Seafood Restaurant
Review: Great Seafood restaurant! Incredible concept and ambience. Overall a great experience! Service was impeccable. Kudos to the teamShow less

Author: andraszLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent but pricey
Review: This is the flagship restaurant of the hotel, and the selection and quality of the seafood on offer is truly excellent, but this does come at a pretty hefty price tag. Manager's comment a few posts below made me chuckle - the 'monitored competitor' is the Datai, the only other hotel/restaurant in the area, with the dubious distinction of beating the Four Seasons as being the most expensve one on the island.This being said, if you can afford to stay at the hotel, you can afford to eat here. Taking a romantic dinner will be a truly memorable experience, my reccommendation is when you get the bill just sign without looking, the amount will appear less painful if it is a small part of your total bill.Show less

Author: travelaholic_8Penrith, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic meal and service
Review: Enjoyed a fabulous meal with attentive service. Very relaxed atmosphere.Only downside was the price. Show less

Author: sarakawadriWillesden, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Went to the jala restaurant three times during our visit! Loved the food here! Really amazing view for a romantic dinner! I went with my boyfriend and we loved this restaurant! We went for the a la carte menu as we went for the all inclusive package! It was such nice food! If you like seafood, this is a great restaurant to visit! I loved the seabass! The cocktails were also very nice! Show less

Author: tandaphSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great dining view
Review: Restaurant is beside the beach. Food is ok. But service is great! There are vegetarian options as wellShow less

Author: Paul WFaugeres, France
Title: Great food but check the fish prices
Review: This is a fabulous restaurant on the beach, with a natural sand floor.Everything is great here and we ate here twice.The fresh fish display is very good and on our first visit we chose a Parrot fish which we had eaten elsewhere for the equivalent of £15 so we ordered it and on our bill it came to something near £100, At such a price we should have been informed before it was cooked I feel. It was definitely not worth that sort of money. On our second visit we made sure that we checked the prices before the fish was cooked., and we had a lovely selection of food at a reasonable price considering our surroundings. We will return as we love the restaurant.Show less

Author: wayneh629Melbourne, Australia
Title: Spectacular Seafood restaurant by the sea
Review: Great atmosphere and setting with the restaurant being right on the beach and seeing the waves crash as you eat your food. The restaurant continues on the theme with sand throughout in the floor. The food is out of this world - unbelievably good. My partner is a vegetarian and also had an amazing dining experience. Show less

Author: nadja53South Australia, Australia
Title: Great Food.
Review: A good choice of international and Asian cuisine. Something on the menu for everyone, even people with allergies. The staff are happy to accommodate you and will advise what dishes are not conducive to certain allergies.Show less

Author: joea537Brackley, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent presentation
Review: Essentially an a la carte fish restaurant. Came to just under 1000 MYR for a starter and main + 1 bottle of wine for 4. The Sea Bass with Courgette was the highlight, with the courgette pieces cut with a mandolin and draped meticulously over the Sea Bass to resemble the scales of a fish. Pricey but special.Show less

Author: Ali69_99Beirut, Lebanon
Title: Seafood Galore !
Review: We had our last dinner at the Andaman their. It was near sunset and the food and the scenery allied to give us a memorable experience. Word of caution , the catch of the day could be on the expensive side so inquire ahead price wise. Show less

Author: Gus MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Just the best fish restaurant on the Island
Review: We got to the restaurant a bit earlier than planned and got 30% off the bar bill (happy hour till 6:30pm) which started the evening off well! We then got a table at the far end of the restaurant an enjoyed the wonderful sunset over the bay. The restaurant is known for its fresh fish and so we selected from the catch of the day we had a field day with Grouper, large tiger prawns and Pomfret (a fish from the Indian Ocean) all washed down with a rather lovely bottle of Sauvignon Blanc Cloudy bay.We travelled from the St Regis which was a 45 minutes’ trip so I was expecting, great food, great service and fantastic ambience. The service was rather extraordinary very attentive and amazingly prompt. The ambience with the sunset and the sand ritual which has been spoken about in other reviews was great BUT the best part was the fresh fish which I must say as a uber discerning diner – it was beyond my expectations and I think perhaps the best on the island! It was not cheap but good value – For 4 people the bill was RM 1,615 ( circa £ 320) but the SB Cloudy Bay was RM 340 (circa £70). You can definitely do it cheaper and not eat as many tiger prawns as we did (about 10!) – but the lure of fresh locally caught produce was too tempting. So on the face of it, may seem expensive but it certainly isn’t. We ordered fried squid as a starter (and some grilled tiger prawns); I am unsure how I am going to ever eat squid again – it was so fresh that it was soft and very well-seasoned, spiced and as it was so fresh simply melted in the mouth. The Chef Thorsten Killian came to see us after the meal to ask for our thoughts, I told him that it was better than any of the restaurants on the island he really deserves an applause! Well done Thorsten and the team, and thanks for an amazing evening.Show less

Author: JopepiLisbon, Portugal
Title: Great place & great food
Review: We had a wonderful dinner at Jala (which means "net").The restaurant is beautiful with sand floor and trees inside, by the beach.Two starters and one main dish per couple was enough quantity. The fish is very fresh and cooked in very original ways. The ceviche we had as one of the starters was amazing, the slow cooked seabass was also very good. Only minus was the "black forest" dessert, looked beautiful but tasted somewhat disappointing.The kids enjoyed the food a lot, pasta with fish, and had time to play by the beach while the adults enjoyed the meal for a bit longer.Very friendly, polite and helpful staff.Price was appropriate for the high quality food and overall experience.We'll likely come back a second time before leaving the hotel. Well done Jala!Show less

Author: GabstatoriWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Fantastic Experience
Review: Jala Restaurant is located on the beachfront at the Andaman Resort. My boyfriend and I visited whilst staying at the Andaman and had a lovely meal. Neither of us eat seafood so we opted for the non seafood options. For entree we had the organic asparagus salad and it was delicious. I do not normally enjoy salads however this one was well dressed and the flavour/texture combinations worked very well. For the main my boyfriend and I shared the organic chicken breast and the beef cheek. Both were delicious, flavoursome and well cooked. The beef was so tender it melted in your mouth! Our deserts were equally as delicious and we left feeling full and satisfied. The staff were friendly and attentive, ensuring we were enjoying our dining experience regularly. Overall we had a lovely night and enjoyed the casual coastal vibe the restaurant offered. Show less

Author: SONAL2089Lucknow, India
Title: Great food
Review: Wide range of Malaysian and international cuisine. The staff provides efficient service. recommended for people staying in and around The Andaman.Show less

Author: SONAL2089Lucknow, India
Title: Amazing
Review: We had dinner at Jala. Food was superb and the ambience was breathtaking. Lindsay the waiter there made our experience more memorable.Show less

Author: littlemissmonbonPerth, Australia
Title: A unique, delicious meal
Review: Dinner at Jala was amazing! We managed to get a seat right at the edge of the restaurant, so we had the perfect view of the pink and purple sunset over the bay. I particularly loved the 'shoe concierge' and the barefoot rule for the restaurant - it was so cool having a 5 star service, seafood dinner while you were sitting there barefoot!I was also a massive fan of the display of the fresh 'seafood of the day', where you could pick out your choice of seafood (there was even stingray the night we were there!) and have it cooked however you pleased. I was happy to know that Jala actively supports local fishermen by promising to purchase their daily catch from them, provided they bring in fish and other seafood of size (and if there is anything that comes in undersize, they take them and put them into their coral nursery to nurse them back to health)Show less

Author: plasmrPakenham, Australia
Title: Amazing ecperience
Review: Eating in this restaurant was a wonderful experience. The floor is sand adding to the experience. We watched a beautiful sun set as we ate delicious food. There was a lot of variety to choose from. The food was cooked perfectly, fresh, and brought to our table after only a short wait. Not only was the seafood delicious but the deserts were pretty and a must to finish your meal with. Show less

Author: ojackson1St. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh Fish Done Right!
Review: A lovely beach front restaurant with fantastic views. The waiters and chefs are incredible, service and food on point!A must if staying at The Andaman or visiting Langkawi!Show less

Author: J6085TUmarcoaFrance
Title: Great Seafood at The Andaman
Review: Really good food and a great selection cooked to perfection.The wine list is also pretty comprehensive.The service excellent. Our waiter Linday made a difference and chatted with us about the hotel, the Island and the Monkeys!Well done guys and thank you Linday for making our experience at Jala special.Show less

Author: J6085TUmarcoaFrance
Title: Part of The Andaman Luxury Collection
Review: Great food, excellent service and was always a great start to the day with everything you could need for Breakfast. Luch times were also a pleasure, the pasta was my favourite with a nice bottle of white. The manager Nick was always so nice to chat too and was always genuinely interested in our experience of the resort and restaurants. Hery (Independence Day Boy) made a difference too. Such a nice guy and again he really cared about us. Well done to you all.Show less

Author: KatVit39Surrey, United Kingdom
Title: Great groupwr
Review: The setting of this restaurant is lovely, set on the beach it's not just a beach cafe. It's a 5 star luxury restaurant. The bar is chic on entry. The floor is sand which rather than make it tacky makes it quirky. The seating is relaxed and cool.You take your shoes off to enter the restaurant and walk in sand. Which added to our amusement and the kids were delighted. On entry you pass glasses fridges with catch of the days which you order here. One fish feeds the whole family. You can't get much fresher as all have been caught that day. Plenty to choose from with a god menu of how you want it served.I ordered off the menu and was delighted with the recommendations from my server. I had grouper it was delicious. For pudding I again asked my waitress for her recommended desert. I had Strawberry rou with pandan cake and seaweed. It was nice and different.I would recommend this place as its relaxed but a lovely place. If you want a luxe feel and kids are welcome.Show less

Author: heatherc027
Title: Great food - Great service!!
Review: Great variety of food both European and Malaysian. Staff attentive and friendly and go out of their way to make you feel special.

Author: Michael MWarrnambool
Title: Seafood to die for.
Review: Situated right on the beach with panaramic views across the Andaman Sea to the southernmost islands of Thailand, you can watch the sunset and dine on fresh local fish (you can even choose your own!). Well worth a visit if you stay at or near the Andaman.Show less

Author: Michael M
Title: A great place to eat while you watch the animals passing by!
Review: This restaurant serves a wide range of local Malay and international cuisine. Ravi and his staff provide efficient service with a smile and create a relaxed dining experience.

Author: Alicia H
Title: Best fresh seafood ever!!!
Review: The restaurant is beautifully calming and beach side. Dine with your feet in the sand You can watch the sun go down while dining on the freshest fish thats cooked to your liking! Loved it!!Show less

Author: J0J
Title: Good food, not too expensive
Review: We ate here on a couple of occasions as we were staying here.  Mid priced food, very tasty, mostly Asian with some Italian, pizza etc. Suited the family well. Great service.

Author: mohit0071988Kolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Great food !!!
Review: Superb is the word. Great food and excellent ambience, when they combine its one deadly combination. Show less

Author: mohit0071988
Title: Great food !!!
Review: The food at all the restaurants was excellent. We never stepped out of the hotel for even a single meal.

Author: elaynecswShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Luxury fresh seafood dining on sandy floor
Review: Food quality is fresh and great environment with the big ceiling fan and sandy beach at your feet! Suggest to try grilled squids and savour the green curry bread (starter FOC), tasty Choc desserts!Show less

Author: blackacre03Singapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive,
Review: This restaurant was good but not great, and certainly not worth the cost. We had one bottle of wine, one fish to share with 2 adults and 2 kids, a couple of bottles of water, and two desserts. Total meal was over $300. The fish was good but not great and didn't taste that fresh. The fish was $125. I was not expecting such a high price for a fish when we were in Malaysia and next to the ocean!The view was awesome and we really liked the sand floor.Show less

Author: John HPatong, Thailand
Title: Great location overlooking the pool. Wide choice of cuisine.
Review: Overlooking the pool with a large number of outdoor tables, it has a wide choice of food and they will happily set you up to share one dish, which is great for lunch. Our favorite was definitely Hainanese Rice which comes complemented with Melon broth, condiments of ginger, mild garlic and chili sauce and soy, Not to forget fragrant rice. Perfect. Show less

Author: John HPatong, Thailand
Title: Food highlight by wonderful Datai Bay
Review: At Jala you can eat a la carte or choose your fish from the fresh catch as a whole fish. (Tip: check which days the fresh fish comes in and book for that day.) We chose a hybrid grouper to be grilled. It was an excellent fish complemented perfectly by the Langkawi Sauce and select vegetables. A foody highlight for usShow less

Author: Alejandro BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Top-notch restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Although a bit pricey, it is all worth it. The fish, service and views are basically unbeatable. Make sure you go there early to get the best available fish!Show less

Author: thepenquin
Title: Pleasant position with friendly staff
Review: We had breakfast and dinner here most days. The staff are very helpful and friendly. Breakfast chice is expansive but dinner menu rather limited. All in all a pleasant experience.

Author: Sudhir A
Title: No veg food
Review: Only vegetarian pizza available for vegetarian people like me. rest breakfast is very good. they have some veg food in breakfast

Author: Perry BHong Kong, China
Title: Great seafood and a great atmosphere !
Review: This was a special and romantic experience dining near the beach at Datai Bay and enjoying the fresh seafood. The staff were very friendly and helpful which was an added bonus !Show less

Author: MalachiWilliamsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Pick your fish - it could not be fresher!
Review: We opted not the have starters or deserts here as we had the good fortune to meet the Chef who helped us to select our fish.We opted for two fish for two diners, which was a lot given the size of the fish and the various side dishes and sauces that accompany the meal.It was a good choice! We were completely full.That said, I agree with many reviewers that this not a cheap night out, but it is an amazing setting.The hotel offers a choice of cooking, sides and sauces and it is a little overwhelming at first, but the staff are on hand to explain and to recommend. I saw that someone said that the sides are small. I agree, but I have to be honest, that we ordered such big fish, we did not finish our sides.If it is your last night or a special meal, this is a great place to visit.Show less

Author: traveldiaries22
Title: Loved the food!
Review: The food here is delicious especially the italian! I think I ate the best Napoletana and Lasagne here! Desserts are okay'ish. Tried a few! Drinks - great.

Author: Kirsty39London, United Kingdom
Title: Gorgeous food with the sand under your feet
Review: This place is right on the beach front. It's so close the flooring is sand! I love having sand in between my toes whilst relaxing and eating dinner. This place is much more expensive that other places in Langkawi but it really is done well. Friendly staff and a very relaxed atmosphere. The food is gorgeous and they offer fresh fish of the day which is literally caught that morning!! Now that's worth paying for. When I say more expensive, if you are staying in the Datai or Andaman it really isn't much different from the restaurants in those hotels; we loved it! Every mouthful was great and the afters were good too.Show less

Author: jujo876St Helens, United Kingdom
Title: A lovely setting and excellent food.
Review: We were wonderfully looked after during our stay by Devi and his team of friendly, cheerful and helpful waiters and waitresses. We had some very interesting chats with them and we got to know each other quite well during our two week stay. They saw to it that we always got a table out in the open, overlooking the pool, and our drinks were on the way almost before we sat down. Their steak was melt-in-the-mouth delicious but there was a variety of styles on offer to suit all tastes. Show less

Author: FriedLottiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good variety but average taste
Review: There is a good variety of food but I've tasted better breakfast buffets from other hotels. Premises are big so it doesn't feel overly crowded during peak periods. Staff are attentive, however, they should brush up on their knowledge on credit card discounts. We asked two separate staff on the credit card promotions available and both were not sure and told us that there weren't any (which was wrong).Show less

Author: FriedLottiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and good view!
Review: My family (6 adults & 2 young kids) had dinner here and we ordered two huge fishes (steamed red snapper and grilled yellow tail) that came with 12 side dishes. The food was fantastic, especially the grilled fish. However, I found the portions of the side dishes to be rather small. We had a range of sauces too and it would have been nice if the restaurant could label them. As we were dining, the mozzies (or sand flies?) were feasting on us too. So do put on some mozzie repellent (restaurant also provides them) if you don't want to end up as dinner for the mozzies. The restaurant has a very chilled and laid back feel with amazing views, especially at sunset. It's a little pricey so check with them for any credit card discounts.Show less

Author: 877michelleg877
Title: Great food!
Review: We were staying at the Andaman and so thought we must try the food here. We picked our fish straight from the counter and chose how we wanted it cooked and what accompanying side dishes we wanted. Beautiful views of the beach from our table. It was however quite pricey! Worth the splurge though. Show less

Author: rashedmazhar5587Dhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Poor Service
Review: Food is good. But staff have attitude problem. They have a Ever Busy show off. Nobody really attends you. Each time you need something you will have to shout at the top of your voice to call a Waiter. Prices are higher than most other Restaurants in 5 Star Hotels in Langkawi. Unless you are staying at the Hotel and have no other option to dine since the Hotel is in the middle of no where; I would not recommend this Restaurant. Show less

Author: Perry BHong Kong, China
Title: A sensational breakfast spread !
Review: This is one of the best breakfast buffets available anywhere- not just within Malaysia ! The egg station was a particularly worthwhile place at which to stop, while the resulting salmon omelette was one of the most divine breakfast creations that I have ever had the privilege to sample. Everything was impressive- the fruit trays; the separate, adjoining bakery room; the drinks on offer- you name it. The service was very fine and the decor impressive.Show less

Author: Lolly V
Title: Great Breakfast Buffet
Review: Something for everyone!  Made to order eggs and omelets, fresh fruits, bakery goods, salads, Japanese and Malay foods, coffees, and the best part, make your own Mimosas and Bloody Mary's!  Dine inside or outside overlooking the pool.  Lovely setting.

Author: CHandGTHartfield, United Kingdom
Title: Superb seafood service a little slow
Review: Lovely fresh seafood counter with huge tiger prawns. This is part of the Andaman hotel and is right on the beach. They take your shoes for you and you eat on lovely large tables on the sand. The only thing that let it down was one main course was very late and the service was slightly slow. It is also not cheap but possibly as you would expect from a nice hotel.Show less

Author: John TMelbourne, Australia
Title: great seafood restaurant
Review: I had a great seafood meal here. Right on the beach. Sand floor makes it more casual. The food was all tasty and very fresh. Staff are friendly and attentiveShow less

Author: John T
Title: For breakfast and dinner
Review: I had breakfast here twice, once a buffet once A lacarte.  Buffet has a wide choice including malay, chinese, western breakfasts and prosecco and bloody mary's.....  THe dinner was nice food in a casual atmosphere

Author: JC_5382Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food but Poor Service
Review: 2nd visit here. Despite its pricey menu, the service did not meet expectations. Service staff seem to be ignoring: getting a bill or getting the attention of a waiter is challenging despite the place less than half filled. The staff seem to be playing and talking amomg themselves. Some waitresses are just dragging their feet around. This is very unsightly. Great food though.Show less

Author: David MWoodbridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great choice, well presented.
Review: We ate at the restaurant on several occasions and enjoyed the varied menu. Sit inside if you want airconditioned luxury or outside if you want to see the wildlife gliding over your head (yes, honestly, it's amazing). Food was always fresh and very well presented by the exceptionally courteous staff.Show less

Author: Checkmate1Essex
Title: Fabulous
Review: This restaurant is a much higher level than any others we experienced in Langkawi. You would be hard pushed to beat this for ambience, food and presentation anywhere! We ate here twice. The setting is beautiful, feet in the sand, overlooking a dimly lit beach and lovely decor. The fish was superb and so was the presentation. It's not cheap, but no restaurant is in this area. But if you accept that, then you will not be disappointed!Show less

Author: StevenTTGSingapore, Singapore
Title: excellent seafood and view
Review: I stayed at Datai but decided to try Jala restaurant. The seafood offering there was fresh and cooking excellent. Good place for nice dinner. well doneShow less

Author: ibnbattuta3
Title: Great staff but average food
Review:
The staff are absolutely fantastic and are a credit to the restaurant and the hotel. 

Unfortunately, the food does not match up to the service. I found the food quite bland and thought the Asian dishes especially, had been watered down thus rendering them inauthentic.

Author: Helgs MMunich, Germany
Title: Local dishes excellent events fun and great variety and spread
Review: We ate here a few times and found the quality to be very good reasonable wine lists also. The event evenings were well attended with a very good variety of dishes on offer as well as entertainmentShow less

Author: VT2369toronto
Title: Need a better kitchen crew
Review: Food is no where near the Jala restaurant which should sent the crew to work there for lunch. Very dry bread, no taste olive oil, butter has melted and refrigerated, over cooked chicken, a Malay chief cannot cook a proper Hainan chicken rice, the chicken breast is hard like a rock...Show less

Author: VT2369toronto
Title: Pricy but excellent seafood restaurant
Review: A fantastic beach front seafood restaurant with a crew knows how to cook fish properly. It's pricy but worth it. Show less

Author: TheWoodwardsTorquayDevon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food and staff
Review: This is a great place to eat for all the family. It also serves the buffet breakfasts which include bloody marys and prosecco! Food selection is superb. Staff very efficient and professional. Great menu for the evening including a Japanese and Italian menu which is out of this world. You can also also have lunch here too and eating this outside with the views is quite perfect! Not a place to diet!! Good wine list. Show less

Author: TheWoodwardsTorquayDevon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: This is an incredible restaurant! Fantastic fish display including mud crab, pomfret, parrot fish, giant prawns, bass,and snapper. Service and food is excellent. You eat under ceiling fans with your feet on the sandy beach! Views are just sensational. It is romantic and beautiful Staff very good. Go for the fish display where the chefs help you choose and decide your menu. Great fun! Wish I was there now! We are a mature couple but certainly suitable for all ages!Show less

Author: Dai FCambridgeshire, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxed yet very professional
Review: Outside tables get taken quickly. Always book the day before and eat early (7-30pm-ish) then you can relax for the evening. The staff are very, very goodShow less

Author: Dai FCambridgeshire, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful fish
Review: The fish dishes were prepared to perfection. If you ask for an unusual fish, take the advice of the staff on how best to have it cooked.Show less

Author: Marthe N
Title: What a view!
Review: Insanely fresh seafood, top quality dishes and an amazing dining experience. I really recommend this to anyone visiting the island of Langkawi. The atmosphere and view from the restaurant is unique and you will be positively surprised with the flavours on your plate.The service was perfect and very personal. Everything you would from a dining experience.Show less

Author: ldtc2Hoboken, New Jersey
Title: Very good
Review: We enjoyed their selection of dishes and the atmosphere. Service was excellent. Would have gone back but you have to make reservations and we forgot to. . Show less

Author: akm515Windsor, United Kingdom
Title: Great choice, large portions, excellent service
Review: We ate here for breakfast every morning and had dinner here on a few nights.Breakfast is amazing! So much choice, its almost overwhelming. Various juices, lots of fruit, a huge amount of cooked food and a whole room dedicated to bread and cakes! Staff are fantastic, friendly and helpful. Dinner is also lovely here surrounded by the rain forest. It's a little cheaper than the other 3 restaurants in the hotel and has a bigger menu (with more western choices).We completely over ordered on our first night here. Our advice, ditch the starter and do straight for the main. (they bring complimentary bread too) The Malaysian food is amazing and much cheaper than the western options. Wine is pricey throughout Malaysia but you can get a decent bottle here for about £20.Show less

Author: ingrid040Eindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Good food, nice presentation, bare food in the sand
Review: The jala is the best restaurant @ the Andaman. Pricy but the food is very good. The setting is informal: bare feet in the sand.Show less

Author: SabriMarcCalgary, Canada
Title: Fish here is unbeatable
Review: This restaurant is fascinating, exotic in its decor and food is simply delicious. They offer a la carte fresh catch of the day, which can be cooked according to your likings, comes with 2 sauces and 3 side dishes. Usually the cook suggest the best way to cook the fish we pick depending on the fish flavour and meatiness. Excellent service, highly recommended.Show less

Author: mcbevoWahroonga, Australia
Title: Wonderful
Review: Loved this restaurant - atmosphere plus. Shoes were left at the door before entering and we were seated looking out onto the beach . Choose from the a la carte menu, or the fresh seafood of your choice. Suggest booking to avoid missing out.Show less

Author: Monica M
Title: Could not fault
Review: We went for dinner at Jala, being guests at the Andaman.We chose to pick our fish & seafood and have it cooked to preference rather than order from the a la carte menu.Our starter was tiger prawns grilled with Jala sauce. They were exquisitely fresh and perfectly cooked.Our main was a whole snapper with yellow curry sauce and green chilli sauce with sides of fried potatoes, coconut rice and water spinach. The snapper was perfectly cooked, beautifully seasoned, there was not a dry patch on the fish or a bone to be found. The service was friendly and relaxed and the atmosphere unmissable. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: 406bradmBaulkham Hills, Australia
Title: Bucket list worthy
Review: This is our second visit and our waiter extraordinaire, Linardy, even remembered our drink order from our previous occasion. Although it is the seafood you must come for. Sensationally fresh local food and attentive service on a remarkable sand floor in an unbelievable location.Show less

Author: Lionel888Melbourne, Australia
Title: No Chef Rene & Not Quite Right
Review: Staying at the resort which is still lovely but the service and food at Jala is nowhere near as good as it was a year ago under Chef Rene. We were told this visit that 2 of the dishes we had wanted to order of the main menu were not available, our wine took 25 minutes to arrive and I left most of my main meal and wasn't asked if there was an issue. The bar also doesn't offer drink coasters, nibbles or proper garnish on cocktails for 32RM. I would say all the restaurant and ba needs is a good leader and some discipline. Really disappointed as this was my favourite restaurant last visit. Give it a miss.Show less

Author: Adam FSydney, Australia
Title: Barefoot beachfront
Review: surprisingly good food, especially the locally caught fresh seafood. Service slightly over attentive, although we visited during a quiet timeShow less

Author: dctravelexpatWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Jala is an absolute Star!
Review: This restaurant is brilliant! We dined here twice during our week stay at The Andaman. What a gorgeous dining experience overlooking the Datai Bay of the Andaman Sea. The floor is completely covered in sand, so you can enjoy a romantic, fine dining experience in your bare feet! Lovely ambiance, fresh sea food and excellent service!Very fresh sea food selection with the head chef there to make his recommendations. It all sounded so lovely, but decided to order from the menu on both occasions and we were so happy that we did. During the first visit we enjoyed the amazing King fish Ceviche and the exceptional Sea Bass so much so that we wanted to have both dishes again before leaving the resort. On the second visit the ceviche was even more fantastic, but the sea bass was prepared a bit differently, perhaps the sauce? The Red Mullet proved to be the most memorable- fabulous!!During dinner you'll find a gorgeous sunset. In the moonlight you can see lights from the restaurant's fishing boats in the near distance.When making your reservation, request a table closest to the water. Every table has a sea view, but you'll be happiest by the sea.We'll have lasting memories of our wonderful dining experiences by the beautiful sea. Thank you so much Jala!!Show less

Author: JaJo-LondonLondon
Title: superb bbq fish - great meal
Review: We had a terrific last night of holiday meal at the Jala. The restaurant is fun, being sand floor right on the beach in beautiful surroundings. The meal was prepared perfectly and the fish was delicious. Meal is expensive - with starters and wine was around GBP150 for 2 adults and 2 kids, but totally memorable and worth doing. If you all do bbq fish for main (which you should), you chose fish at the counter and cost is quoted at around 29-35rm per 100 gram, so you end up at 2kg for 4 before they fillet it, so you end up around 600 RM for the fish and all the veggies included with that - but worth it!Show less

Author: shanvallaHong Kong
Title: Amazing fresh seafood restaurant
Review: We ate in the Jala restaurant twice during our stay. It was excellent, great service, amazing fresh fish to choose from, knowledgable staff and a great atmosphere right in the beach. I highly recommend. Show less

Author: amystruttEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Wow!
Review: We have visited the Jala restaurant twice throughout our stay at the Andaman Resort. Both occasions were amazing! The second time we visited the Jala restaurant, I chose fish from the counter, Goldie Pomfret which was well recommended by the chef and all staff were very friendly! Would very much recommend this to anybody staying on the island. Thank you very much :-) Show less

Author: TheSpaceCadet
Title: Glorious seafood - though beware the price!
Review: We headed over from the Datai for some proper seafood and were delighted with the results. We went for the seafood buffet, where fish is charged by the gram. Having narrowly avoided being encouraged to purchase an £80 fish for my meal, which was recommended by the chef, I settled on a glorious Golden Pomfret for less than half the price. The fish came with three sides/sauces, with were obviously shared with MrsSaucy. The favourite being the Green Curry sauce (something of a surprise). The fish was beautifully cooked, and our table right on the edge of the beach. The restaurant's policy of taking away our shoes so that the sand on the floor spread between our toes proved an effective, if gimmicky, concept. Overall, a very enjoyable evening, typical of the Andaman focusing on their proximity to the sea, which contrasts to the Datai's focus on the rainforest.Show less

Author: kingben87
Title: Best seafood in town
Review: We used the Chefs recommendation, the golden pomfret and it was the best fish i ever had. The Service was nice and knowledgeable all at. I enjoy the hole concept of the restaurant .....I would like to recommend this to all food lovers ....Show less

Author: 294ciaradDublin, Ireland
Title: One word....Exceptional
Review: Exceptional food that makes you stop and think, very Heston. The staff deserve a mention too, they looked after us so well. Ask for a table looking onto the beach it made the experience even better.Show less

Author: SvenI_12Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Best dinner experience ever
Review: We haven been for a few days in Langkawi not staying at the Andaman Resort where the restaurant is located but have been recommended to the Jala restaurant from friends.We must admit it was the best dinner experience we had in Langkawi even than at the Four seasons, we had some hick ups to get to the resultant from he lobby however ones we arrived a great evening kicky off.Dining area at the beach, peaceful and silent it was you get & looking for as a couple.Being not buffet fans at all we have met Chef Thorsten (I think he said he is German, however looks Asian) at the stunning seafood counter and he really changed our minds and gave is so many options of seafood and ways of preparations that we couldn't think of anything else. We had a lovely whole red snapper Asian style, few lovely side dishes prepared to perfection and great service too.We felt the wine selection could have been a bit more decent however not in anyway a criticism as the entire place & food was just perfect to us.Thank to Chef Thorsten & his team for making our dinner so memorable.Show less

Author: rekoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb restaurant
Review: Great sea food restaurant. excellent choices of fish and sea food. We had a wonderful dinner at Jala restaurant. You can either choose a la carte or choose your fish from the buffet and the chefs prepare it to your liking. It is definitely worth a visit. So is The Andaman Resort where this restaurant is located.Show less

Author: ashfaaq_wSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: fresh
Review: we went for an evening meal...it was very serene having a nice low lit meal in a fish restaurant with the sea in the background.the choice of sea food was amazing, I didn't know what was what so I kept it simple and chose prawns starter and salmon.once I chose my fish the chef went through cooking styles flavours spices.the meal was one I would go back to... I went to the Malaysian restaurant and that I will not go back to.price wise it is costly but with the setting atmosphere and cuisine style it's expected Show less

Author: jasrynBangkok, Thailand
Title: Rather Touristy
Review: The service here is great. The atmosphere is quite touristy - the floor is covered in sand and you're meant to take your shoes off to really feel as though you're dining next to the ocean. Then, you get to walk over the fish counter and select your own fresh fish to be cooked in a variety of styles and served with your choice of sides (I would however, be very careful in selecting the fish as a number of them did not look too fresh i.e. cloudy eyes)It's a little pricey as would be expected for a resort restaurant. The fish is quite expensive ~RM28-32/100g with most of them around 1kg in weight. The fish comes with two sauces and three sides of your choice.A meal for two did set us back about ~RM400 with two starters, a glass of wine, water and one fish. Overall, the experience was pleasant but not terribly impressive. That being said, this is definitely the best restaurant in the whole place.Show less

Author: 970angelar
Title: Great evening
Review: This is such a lovely restaurant and the food is wonderful. Removing our footwear at the entrance and having dinner with the sound of the ocean and sand in our toes all added to the experience. My husband and daughter chose golden pomfret on the chefs recommendation and were not disappointed. They were able to choose how it was cooked, 2 sauces and 3 side dishes. I had a vegetarian dish which was delicious also. Most importantly the restaurant was able to cater for my other daughter who needs a gluten free diet. She had a meat dish which was adapted for her. The staff even brought her some gluten free bread to have with the dips without being asked. All of the staff were very helpful and attentive. An excellent evening. Show less

Author: Su76KualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service, large portions and good food
Review: Had dinner here - Asian food. Simply delicious, large portions and wait service was excellent. The waiter kept on checking with us whether everything was alright for the night.Breakfast choices unfortunately whilst varied, was the same everyday except for 1-2 dishes. Difficult to decide on the 3rd morning of the stay.Show less

Author: RichardKantonaBrisbane Region, Australia
Title: Stunning
Review: Just fabulous!. Service excellent and good menu. Fish is very clearly fresh and options around cooking styles excellent.Show less

Author: Emma W
Title: Best restaurant on Langkawi
Review: BEAUTIFUL setting; sand under your feet, views of the sparkling seas, well arranged tables. Very very good set menu; prawn cocktail, mackerel, local fish, very good cheese served with figs and three chocolate heaven to finish. Everything was artfully arranged on the plates, fresh, complimentary flavours. Seriously, seriously good.Show less

Author: KtngrlSydney, Australia
Title: Exceeded expectations.
Review: Absolutely beautiful. Every dish was incredible. Excellent service and food came out really quickly. Although we ordered off the menu the pay per gram fresh fish also looked amazing. Wish we were staying longer to dine here again. Show less

Author: Mahi2010Dhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Amazing view with the wave sound of the sea
Review: the restaurant in the beach oh! Lovely. You can hear the wave sound of the sea when you goanna test your lunch. Simply Great.Show less

Author: DianashhCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Husband and I stayed at the Andaman hotel, so we booked a table for dinner at Jala restaurant. The view was beautiful as we got to sit by the beach, it was raining and thundering but still very very beautiful. We loved the idea of the restaurant as the floor is covered with sand and you can just walk/sit there with bare feet (for an amazing experience). You can choose from a good variety of fresh fish, however, the portions were not very generous especially for the appetisers. The atmosphere was very lovely, and we would definitely visit again next time we're in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Kate WHong Kong, China
Title: Lovely restaraunt with reasonable price
Review: I had dinner with my families (5 adults 2 children) in this place. It costs around MYR1000 for quite a lot of food. More than we can finish. And it tastes good and has nice presentation. Very reasonable price and great atmosphere. You can order fresh seafood and it comes with rice and vegi for free. Nice wine too...Show less

Author: mahmoodh472Baku, Azerbaijan
Title: Best sea view restaurant
Review: The staff if very friendly and good service. very nice food very good for couples. especially the fish you chose they will make for you how you want Show less

Author: LondonRjpLondon
Title: Excellent vista, good food..
Review: Restaurant has sand on the floor, terrific view over the sea and food is also good. It is not exceptional and prices are quite high for what it is.Ate in datai the night before, cost was the same and food better.Nice snapper dish and a bottle of wine between 4 ended up being around $60/head.Nice spot and worth a visit, location excellent, service ok and food decent but didn't blow me away.Show less

Author: leonyeo526Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food & service!
Review: We (family of 5) stayed in The Andaman for 4 nights. Through reading the reviews on tripadvisor and recommendation from the hotel front office, we decided to make a reservation for dinner on our first night. We liked it so much that we ended up having dinner there for 3 out of the 4 nights that we stayed. The food is of good quality (their tenderloin steak is absolutely superb!), though can be pricey (especially the seafood), and we only happy with the value due to the UOB credit card promotion. The service is also great, all their staffs are very friendly and always ready to help and serve. As their menu is fairly limited we ran out of things to select for our last night, and upon speaking with the chef he's able to cook something special (not in the menu) which was fantastic! Show less

Author: ElehazelSydney, Australia
Title: Great dinner
Review: Great seafood! Unique setting with sand on the floor. Excellent customer service from the staff. Listen to the waves from the sea while having dinner, it's beautiful! Show less

Author: JC_5382Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Seafood
Review: The seafood was really fresh. The sweetness was just there. Will certainly come back again when I stay at this resort. Why I rated a four is because of the pricing. I would rate a 5 if the pricing was better.Show less

Author: KileseParis, France
Title: Fantastic food in a great settting
Review: The food was great, the setting is magnificent. The portions are a bit small though, particularly the vegetables.Show less

Author: JerryW205London, United Kingdom
Title: Superb seafood and location
Review: Jala is right on the beach at the Andaman on Langkawi.The fabulous setting is enhanced by the sand floor and open space all around, with quiet music allowing you to hear the waves.There is a good menu highlighting local products and the prawn cocktail is an excellent take on a favourite. The real treat though is to go to the fish counter and see the days catch before the Chef recommends how to prepare it. Wonderful pomfret, snapper and spotted grouper alongside squid and prawns. Accompanied by a good wine list with some nice choices by the glass.Well worth a visit!Show less

Author: OllikeHyvinkää, Southern Finland, Finland
Title: Great seafood
Review: Tried this restaurant during stay at The Andaman. Had the 3 course seafood menu but there are also fresh fish presented from which you could choose your own course. Great sea view and delicious seafood. What more can you ask for?Show less

Author: kok_wee_angLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: The loveliest greenest magical beach restaurant with really good seafood and desert..and unique bread w condiments.
Review: Great service, yummy grilled seafood elegantly prepared. It's not pretentious or excessive portions in exchange for quality. The desert was creative and modern. Fantastic condiments..really really nice , prettying and comfortable for our 3yrs old daughter as well. We ran on the sandy beach and when dinner was ready , walked in to eat..food all ready. Our server Linardy was super attentive and recommended good choices. Amazing attitude..thank you!Show less

Author: Dale HPoissy, France
Title: lovely food in a beach setting
Review: Ate here twice while staying at the Andaman. Excellent food, great atmosphere and watched the amazing Colugos (flying lemur) from our table.Show less

Author: MAG45Geelong, Australia
Title: great
Review: Lovely setting overlooking the beach. Variety of food, Western and Malaysian etc. Great for lunch and dinnerShow less

Author: MAG45Geelong, Australia
Title: Staff fabulous
Review: The food was very good and the staff fabulous but the chairs needed to be checked as some had broken backs due to rot from the rainShow less

Author: RUIWEN78Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great combination of malaysian ingredients & western techniques
Review: Really great nice ambience. You can choose from an ala carte menu or select your own fish to be cooked the way you want it to. The fish on display were really fresh. We ordered the golden pomfret which we thought combined malaysian ingredients and flavours really well. Fillets of fried pomfrets sit atop a bed of ulam, panko fried quail's eggs and rice cakes. Really interesting. Show less

Author: spassspassCanvey Island
Title: Fantastic Restuarant
Review: A hotel in paradise with a fish restuarant to match. Overlooking the sea across an expanse of sand gives one a trully tropical feeling of bliss. You select your fish from a good choice of varying size. My wife and I particularly enjoyed the grouper which was perfectly cooked with a side salad and small risolle type potatos completing the dish. We chose to order a bottle of champagne to compliment the food. Brilliant!! Must mention the ever smiling and obliging serving staff who made each visit a real pleasure.Show less

Author: Wendy VSingapore, Singapore
Title: Just go for the custom seafood
Review: Just go for custom seafood. Select your fish, how you want it cooked, and select your sidr dish. Meal is good for 2 persons. Cost us around myr240. With current exchange rate that is very reasonable. We were given table for 2 which has a glass wall on one side and other side facing beach direct so felt like we had a private romantic dinner by the beach :). Show less

Author: EmilieinBarcelonaBarcelona, Spain
Title: Great for fish!
Review: Great evening and lovely food with the sound of the waves.The experience to pick the fish and let the chef explained to you the difference and how to cook it is great .They have also a special kids menu .Show less

Author: JohnB1955Kiama, Australia
Title: Seafood as fresh as it gets
Review: A great experience!we chose a fish and had it prepared with a local curry, it was really nice but too much for two.Service was exceptional, atmosphere is special.Very much worth our visit.Show less

Author: merlin03Kenilworth, United Kingdom
Title: Good location good food
Review: The location of this restaurant is great, right on the beach. The service is good and the range of fresh fish is great. The hygiene and cleanliness is if European standards.Show less

Author: VerwerftHove, Belgium
Title: Seafood
Review: Friendly staff. Original food but a limited choice. Glad to be there but just for a one time experience. Show less

Author: Paulz71Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: The best i tried in 10 days in Malaysia
Review: Great food, great setup, great atmosphere.I didn't mind walking in the sand, it's part of the setup The prawns and fish were very tasty, the staff very helpful, we really enjoyed the 2 hours we spent in Jala, it was a true romantic evening.A bit pricey but worth it. For 600g of prawns, a grilled 600g snapper, a salad and a full bottle of Moet, the bill was circa 700 MYR... not too bad.Show less

Author: 164chelseavCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Romantic meal.
Review: Such a romantic spot, eating very flavoursome food on the beach front, listening to the waves lap the shore and watching the lightning flash over the mountains. Show less

Author: andrew bNeath, Wales
Title: great food great views
Review: Had lovely meal here served great seafood. had great views of the beach really beautiful location. highly recommend for fine dining. Show less

Author: SuperdeluxeParis, France
Title: check your shoes at reception!
Review: We went three times - a finer dining establishment but it’s right off the beach with a soft sand floor (check your shoes at the reception!). Concept is fresh seafood counter where you specify the quantity and preparation of your seafood and they bring it. Wine list prices were reasonable. Show less

Author: BevheatmanWales, United Kingdom
Title: Dining options
Review: Beautiful food, well worth a visit. Would recommend the laksa, asked for this to be chicken instead of prawn and no problems. Staff very courteous.Show less

Author: Nicholas_BooiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic place for seafood
Review: Jala is one of the most unique restaurants within a resort we have been to. Instead of marbles, tiles for flooring, they use sand. I guess it makes sense since it's a restaurant within a beach resort. The food is also reasonably priced for its location. Take your pick from the fishes and other seafood on offer. The staff are extremely friendly and will offer recommendations. I cannot remember which dessert we had but it too, was simply delectable.Show less

Author: ReneKnudsenCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Very nice experience
Review: I dined here as a part of my visit to this extremely charming resort! The atmosphere is very relaxed and down to earth, which I think suits the resort category, and it is not compromising on knowledge, quality or overall experience. Nice selection of dishes, well prepared, and friendly waiters. Show less

Author: pauljohnsadlerSydney, Australia
Title: Stunning setting, excellent service, you won't get better fish!
Review: Stunning restaurant set just off the beach with the tables and chairs set on sand. We specifically came for the fresh fish table, so approached the produce once the "fish expert" was free. He enthusiastically helped us pick out the red snapper (our 1st choice) & helped suggest accompanying sauces (Langkwai green chili + green curry) & cooking style (grilled), whilst offering suggestions on side dishes and wine matching. The food was cooked to perfection & came out very quick. The wine match of a New Zealand Riesling was perfect. The service was friendly, engaging and prompt. The dessert selection was the best we'd seen on the island & the licorise creme brûlée very interesting. The manager Ally came and thanked us for visiting.Highly recommend this restaurant to all. Especially couples. Pricey, but worth it.Show less

Author: CH_globalviewThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Fine dining with the sand under your feet
Review: Seated literally in the beach this restaurant offers a wide selection of fish dishes - both chosen fresh from the ice table and cooked to your taste, or conjured into a very accomplished and well balanced daily menu. Impressive cuisine in a stunning and very romantic setting.Service is on the slower and more relaxed side in keeping with the location and the ambiance so best not to visit with starving kids or when in a hurry. This is a single seating approach with food to be savoured. Enjoy!Show less

Author: Carl-ThomoAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Best Breatfast in Langkawi
Review: By far the most exceptional breakfast in Langkawi, you are quite literally spoilt for choice. There must be over 100 options. English breakfast, Continental breakfast, Malay Breakfast, Indian Breakfast etc. There is just so much choice and no limit to what you can eat!Show less

Author: Carl-ThomoAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Grilled Red Snapper
Review: We started our first night in Langkawi at the Jala, and had Red Snapper which was cooked to perfection. In fact their specialty is fish but its on the expensive side.Show less

Author: ShaunandSam2014London, United Kingdom
Title: Evening Meal
Review: Great selection of options on the menu. Option to choose your preferred fish and style of preparation. Adequate, well priced wine list. Friendly, professional service, although slightly rushed. Be sure to book in advance.Show less

Author: GRB-hsbsbEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Standard Buffet, nothing special
Review: This restaurant is within the Anderman hotel. We had breakfast x 4 at this restaurant and one lunch. The food options whilst quite varied, I think are poor compared to other similar hotel restaurants I have visited in the region. The staff at breakfast were very good, very attentive, and also for lunch. However our lunch seemed to take an eternity to arrive, it was very slow. This restaurant is just OK.Show less

Author: GRB-hsbsbEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic fish, great service
Review: We ate twice here and both times the fish was excellent. The restaurant itself is set just off the beach, and the floor is sand, trees grow in the restaurant and exit through gaps in the roof, so a very nice setting. The staff were very attentive and helpful. The wine choice was good. We did have a starter and desert but on both occasions we opted for the fish counter. You chose the type and size of your fish and they then cook to order, add sauce of your choice and then you have the option of three vegetables including rice. The fish on both occasions was filleted but served whole, so you could also pick at the bones for more more flesh. The downside, not a lot really, maybe the staff need a lesson on how to pour a beer from a bottle, there is a meat option but maybe a chicken for those who not so keen on fish or red meat, but otherwise we had no complaints at all.Show less

Author: Christopher BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must try!
Review: Fantastic restaurant. The floor is sand - so you don't wear any shoes. They have the seafood counter with a variety of fish that had been caught that day. You can choose whichever fish that is there, how you want it cooked, what sauces and sides etc. very reasonable price considering it's fine dining, it's location, and it's seafood!Show less

Author: Christopher BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Standard restaurant.
Review: Many foods from around the world. Relatively basic but pricing is affordable. If you want a nicer dining experience, try Jala.Breakfast is fantastic here.Show less

Author: HappycookiesKl
Title: Low quality food in a five star
Review: Had a sirloin that came like a rump, questioned the supervisor she just said "it IS sirloin" and ran away and never came back. I guess she just don't know how to respond. The steak was rm135.Rendang was soooo salty.The snapper and promphet were alright. Maybe just eat fish when you are here. Show less

Author: TheDonOzKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food and great service from Nova
Review: Thie food is special. Delicately prepared to perfection. I ordered steamed fish with soy and ginger. Excellent! Service was fanatstic from everyone, but Nova made sure that everything was well in hand, always with a smile and very polite.Show less

Author: Ea338Greater London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, excellent atmosphere and stellar service!
Review: An amazing venue by the beach. Had dinner 3 times at the Jala restaurant during our stay in The Andaman and were blown away with the amazing sea views especially around sunset. We had fish from the seafood bar and based on the recommendation of the fish expert Robin, we were truly impressed. Fish was delicious every time and sides were great. I am a chocolate addict, but when I tried their fruity dessert, Strawberry Reef, I was blown away and ordered it again and again. A must have...honestly you wont regret it! Overall, incredible flavors, great atmosphere and service was very professional and friendly. Thank you for making our stay in Langkawi unforgettable.Show less

Author: gemstar1974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Loved the ambience and food
Review: Experience wise - amazing! Having dinner in a breezy open air restaurant facing the sandy white beach against a beautiful sunset is wonderful but having dinner with fine soft white sand between your toes makes it a unique dining experience. The entire atmosphere and ambience was just so relaxing. The cuisine was very good. I had the pan seared garoupa with hoisin sauce, cauliflower puree, onion ring and sautéed bok choy and it was just yummy. It was certainly a blissful dining experience as the wonderful ambience coupled with a delicious a selection of dishes on the menu complemented each other perfectly. One should give it try if ever in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Hungry_Horse72
Title: Excellent service and great food
Review: The main restaurant at The Andaman hosts breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner.The service was excellent from Eros and his team, always attentive and helpful, nothing was too much trouble for them!Breakfast had excellent range of options and the lunch/dinner menu had plenty of choice.Thoroughly recommend the Wagyu steak, quite possibly the best steak I have ever had!Show less

Author: Hungry_Horse72
Title: Fantastic seafood restaurant
Review: We ate here twice whilst staying at The Andaman. A beautiful venue on the beach. Would recommend booking to enjoy diner whilst watching the sunset.Im not a big fan of fish and only went along for the experience but now converted, the Pomfret was absolutely delicious!The staff are excellent, very attentive.The only, albeit slight, negative point I can mention is the courses do seem to come out in quick succession but not a major issue.Show less

Author: RGELLAKuala Lumpur
Title: Very Disappointing
Review: Waited until our last night for a reservation at Jala and in all honesty it is very mediocre. The Malaysian restaurant is much better. Menu at Jala is very limited,almost intentionally forcing customers to choose the fresh fish bar which displays the fresh fish caught during the day. The food is cooked well and beautifully presented but the portion size is very small and pretentious. I hate restaurants where you leave as hungry as you arrived. I won't be coming back to this restaurant which is a shame given its fantastic beach side setting. This continues to be a problem for The Andaman given its isolation in the NW corner of the island. The restaurant choices are fairly limited and offer a fairly niche selection of food. Show less

Author: realitycriticLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Scrumptious.
Review: Another wonderful restaurant. Very good food the portions look small but are just right and so tastes leaving you very content at the end of a meal. Great for a date night. Show less

Author: sabss33
Title: food was ok...
Review: to be honest we tried all the signiture dishes and were honestly disappointed the presentation was fantastic but when you ate it - the food lacked flavour. The deserts however were very good!Show less

Author: Scooby627Daresbury, United Kingdom
Title: Good service but inconsistent service
Review: We eat in here a number of times in the evening after 8pm and we had the restaurant to ourselves. The service is inconsistent and slow but the staff are extremely helpful and accommodating, this sorts of accommodates for this. The food however is really good as well as the presentation. Very tasty and lots of it. Try the satay the sauce its really good. Show less

Author: Scooby627Daresbury, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food but slow service
Review: Nice setting overlooking the sea, with a proper Malaysian feel to it. You get to experience the Malayan way of eating. The food is out of this world, very tasty and we visited twice even in the rain. The service is slow and we waited a while for drinks but if remind them they are very accommodating. Nice friendly staff and very helpful Show less

Author: ryan_barettoSingapore, Singapore
Title: A great birthday
Review: To celebrate my sister's birthday, the restaurant staff surprised my sister with a complementary, chocolate birthday cake.An extremely great place to dine.Show less

Author: 624gemmaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Jala Restaurant
Review: Lovely setting overlooking the beach and a nice touch to have a sand floor. The food was excellent and the set up of having both an a la carte menu and a seafood bar where you can select your fish, style of cooking, sauce and sides was greatShow less

Author: KY GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood restaurant on a Beach
Review: The restaurant was literally on a beach or maybe they made the floor our of sand. Kids like it a lot cause they get to play and carve the sands as they ate. Ambiance and service was great. offering live seafood catch if this is what you looking for.Show less

Author: debworthingtonManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Fab
Review: Had 2 meals here. Both fabulous. My partner said the steak was one of the best he had tasted.Wine expensive (approx. £24 bottle) - which could be rectified.Show less

Author: GiancarloYannoulisSydney, Australia
Title: A Little Bland
Review: As the name implies this is a rather bland resort restaurant offering a wide range of cuisines.By the standards of 5 star resorts the food is adequate/OK and the prices reasonable so long as you go easy on the wine.Show less

Author: GiancarloYannoulisSydney, Australia
Title: An Expensive Feed
Review: The a la carte options are rather uninspiring. The set menus are only a subset of these & not good value. The third option is to buy raw fish by the 100 g and have it cooked to your choice with a choice of up to 4 small side dishes. This gets to be pricey, with the cheapest bottle of white wine & one dessert only the bill came to MYR 582 (about A$204) for 2 people. This seems rather a lot for a (supposedly) developing countryService is OK, if anything over-attentive. Location is good being beach-side and having a sandy floor.Show less

Author: Dmp60County Durham, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional food
Review: We loved the delicious fish, I had cod and my husband had the red snapper, both were delicious and the accompanying macro vegetables were very tasty. Not cheap but not too expensive either.Show less

Author: mbadzaCorfu, Greece
Title: Different
Review: Cool on sand, choice of seafood at counter and explanations etc Resaonably priced Kiwi wine, nice breeze, romantic, eat at leisure, then a stroll on the beach.Show less

Author: fMY13Kajang, Malaysia
Title: It was just okay..
Review: Some of dishes they served is not to my liking. Maybe i expected the taste of the dish differently. the portion was small and expensive. Show less

Author: WangMaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great restaurant!!!
Review: Jala is right on the beach and the food was delicious! You can choose from the fresh fish and seafood selection and ask them to cook to your liking. We had a red snapper that was perfectly grilled, as well as tiger prawns and calamari. If you like seafood, this restaurant is a must. Leave your fancy shoes at home though, as the floor is all sand and you can check in your shoes or flip flops. Show less

Author: Kirstin F
Title: Amazingly fresh
Review: From the moment you walk in... barefoot on the sand... till the moment you leave you are in heaven. Great seafood, beautifully prepared and presented dishes. I loved the bread dips to start and I highly recommend the Strawberry Reef for dessert- even the crunchy seaweed tastes amazing.Show less

Author: 125marklGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Ok but nothing special
Review: As a dinner venue, we had a much better experience at other locations at the Andaman. The food is average,veer ice was poor, and location of not great at night - not on the beach like others. Show less

Author: 125marklGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Great seafood on the beach
Review: This is a great experience. From the moment you feet touch the sand floor ( there is a show concierge to look after your footwear) you can feel this is a great place. There is an al a carte menu on blackboards or you can choose your fish from the counter, which is sold based on weight, and served with a great selection of sauces. Good kids options too. Show less

Author: Martin ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Top quality
Review: The seafood was fresh and well cooked even the kids meals included dishes such as steamed sea bass. Located right on the beach having bare feet was superbShow less

Author: LauraGarbo
Title: lovely
Review: bare feet on sand, candlelight, catch of the day on display on ice, cooked beautifully, nice wine...

Author: ROBERTO tSydney, Australia
Title: excellent sea food
Review: the Jala offers a great selection of local sea food cooked Malay or Thai style enjoyed while sitting bare feet on a sand floor, while admiring stunning views. a must try while at the Andaman.wine selection was a bit limited tough.Show less

Author: ClairbeartanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Zero attentive staff, not proactive.
Review: I totally left after sitting myself for 30mins. Prior to that, i have to walk over to request for a menu, which i am totally fine but is it the fact that i am Asian and 97% of the resorts' guests are Caucasians? I had frustration for being unattended while the rest were totally relaxing. Please, world class resort, impartial service. Such simple theory. Show less

Author: DavidmaxmurrayBelbroughton, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic fish restarant
Review: You can choose your fish which was caught that day, and have is cook to which every way you desire. A great setting on the beachShow less

Author: BigChris67Fareham, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: The Jala is an amazing seafood restaurant situated on the edge of the beach. This is one of the four restaurants of the Andaman Hotel. Jala is the primer of the four. As you arrive, the waiter takes your flip flops because the flooring is all sand. They have recreated the beach in the restaurant. Brilliant.The setting is super and if you are lucky enough to have a 'window' table you can watch the sun set. Very romantic. The menu is predominately fish and seafood but there are a couple of meat dishes on there too. A great wine list also accompanies the menu. You can go off menu if you want to and go to the counter to choose your fish and shellfish for the chef to cook for you. The food is quite simply delicious. Beautifully presented, and the service was fantastic.Show less

Author: BanotaaaAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Tasty food
Review: we enjoyed the tasty food near by our hotel.. we tried the sea food restaurant and the loaf as well, there were offering good options for dinner.Show less

Author: KA1961Calgary, Canada
Title: Good eats
Review: Ambience is great both inside and outside. Local choice are not enough. International selection is good. Prices are reasonableShow less

Author: onlyturnsleftnottingham
Title: Great seafood dinner
Review: Had a wonderful ' birthday ' dinner at Jala.Great to be able to choose the fish you want from the ice counter.Beware though you have to have the whole fish, so if you go later, your choice may be reduced, your fish bigger than you want and your bill higher as a result! Having said that, there are plenty of A La Carte dishes, including a couple of steak options for non seafood eaters. Leave your best shoes at home, as restaurant floor is an extension of the beach- great to feel sand in between your toes during your dinner!! Ask for a sea view table, around 7pm and watch the sun setting- perfect! Show less

Author: Annalisa M
Title: very good food
Review: really good food ... sitting in front of the sea... good set menu. good choice of fish , service a la carteShow less

Author: cheeweisPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great environment and tasty food
Review: Great environment and tasty food served.A bit expensive but it is a great experience and we do enjoy the food and view during sunset.A bit far from town, almost more than one hour drive, so, better plan your trip wisely.Show less

Author: BarryW1970Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Great Seafood Restaurant, excellent view
Review: we ate at the Jala restaurant last night and the whole experiance of selecting the fresh catch of the day, cooking method and sauces and sides worked very well. Our fish (and giant prawn) dinner was excellent. The service was also very good and not overly attentive. If you are staying at the Andanan hotel, I would definitely recommend it!Show less

Author: PRIBOES_87Bali, Indonesia
Title: Gorgeous restaurant
Review: It's was awesome could get opportunity dining at this restaurant. One word " gorgeous ". The staffs was friendly.Show less

Author: Tripper16Australia
Title: Excellent seafood experience on the beach
Review: In a word, superb. In a sentence, one of the best restaurant experiences I have had, and I have eaten in some of the world's best. Jala is right on the beach; arrive at sunset for a magical experience, and sip a cold drink looking out over the beach. With a sand floor, casual wear is the go, and comfort is uppermost. Even so, the service and quality of the food was anything but casual, and was just outstanding. There is no air-conditioning, but fans overhead and evening breezes mean that it isn't needed, and the open air adds considerably to the ambience. Bird calls and other animals sighted nearby made for a very special experience.Once settled, the staff explained the menu to us, and guided us through the choices. The assistance with the wine list was professional and highly competent, meaning that we had a perfect match with the food, and at a reasonable cost. For starters we shared the smoked mackerel, which was very good indeed, and the jalaksa, a clever play on the traditional dish, which although not exactly close had some delightful flavours.For mains, we chose to have the whole fish. This is the hero moment of the night, as you choose the beautifully fresh fish from the selection on ice in the cabinet, choose your cooking method, sauces and sides, all with expert guidance. The result was magnificent, and one of the best fish dishes we have ever had.Unfortunately the price of such an amazing meal was no room for dessert, but it was worth it.All up we paid 560 Ringgit for food for two and a bottle of wine, including the 15% SPG discount (give your SPG number when you ask for the bill). So not cheap, but for the quality of the food, service and atmosphere it was definitely worth it.Highly recommended!Show less

Author: sanns2015
Title: Just amizing
Review: Prefect location the stuff are very nice and helpful the food is just woow bit expensive but worth every piny we had the best fish ever anybody looking for romance need to go there

Author: Mike S
Title: Superb restaurant
Review:
Professional service, very courteous staff. Wonderful. Crusine
There is nothing to dislike. Just pure magic

Author: Hilary K
Title: wonderful restaurant
Review:
feet in the sand, wonderful choice of varied seafood.
Really loved the evening here and would highly recomend

Author: lanny1982
Title: Excellent
Review: I've been there last year and almost two weeks ago and again, this time was amazing!  Great food, Great Staff, Just great environment to be in!!!

Author: Chilledsun
Title: Fresh fish on the beach
Review: Nice menu and enjoyed eating barefoot in the sand. Looks out over the lovely bay. Wear mosquito repellent!

Author: bimodb
Title: Good Restaurant
Review:
Plenty of Choice for Wine and Seafood.
Its inside the ANDAMAN Hotel.
Expensive but Nice ambience though.

Author: Samiraak
Title: Exceptional view / ambience, tasty and unique food, extraordinarily atrocious service
Review: The restaurant is located along the water and on the beach itself. The understated and elegant decor combined with flames was beautiful against the backdrop. It was good to be able to dig our feet in the sand. We dined with our three children, my mother, and sister. Our three children were served off a uniquely healthy and delicious children's menu. And when our food eventually arrived, it was tasty. However, I've seen NOTHING like this in terms of service:1. After we placed our children's order and said to give us a bit, no one came to check in on us2. When they did, my sister and mom ordered. My mother's food came, and my sister's did not. My husband and I placed our orders as well. We soon found out that the server had entirely forgotten to put in her order - she had been waiting for over 30 min3. We had four cloth napkins and no napkins for the children. We requested more and NEVER got them. 4. I ordered additional white rice for the baby, as she had finished her meal and still seemed fairly hungry. It took over 20 min to bring plain white rice5. When we asked to speak with the manager, multiple people came by to ask us if we need anything, but the restuarant failed to act quickly enough to bring forth someone with whom we could address this. Perhaps, they wanted us to finish our meals,but they should do the one thing for which we were emphatically asking. 6. The assistant manager spoke with us and asked us what she can do to make it right. Not sure what she expected us to say, as little can make up for vacation time ill-spent 7. The man who manages the restaurant's space and also other spaces, also came and heard what my husband had to say, including that we are only on a two-day trip and this was a terrible experience. He offered to get some wine and cheese. We passed. And when he asked us what he could do for us, we left it up to him 8. When the bill came, a token one wine glass' cost had not been charged. Not commensurate with a ruined eve on vacation. Maybe they don't care for reviewsThis is all on the heels of my slipping on fruit left on the floor during breakfast in another restaurant. The manager had come to "do something for us" to make up. Nothing has been done yet. 9. The children's dessert came without spoons at all! When brought, they were huge n silver. Finally, plastic ware was brought. 10. I saw the same "manager" man walking around to mention this and how bad the experience was - including missing dessert spoons after we had spoken to him earlier. I said I didn't assess during dinner so as not to further ruin my experience. I tried to be nice and say that maybe the staff had a comm barrier. He just seemed lost and was not helpful at all - as though this isn't of consequence. Overall, the service was one of the worst I've seen. Staff had no idea how to mitigate any of this and didn't bother trying too hard. Would not recommend jala. Save your money and go to the Malaysian restuarant at the resort. Great food and service there. Show less

Author: Phil_H01Sydney, Australia
Title: Very Good
Review: This place is amazing. I have to start the review with that simple sentence as it says it all. Eating dinner on the beach, and this is right on the beach, is great so when you add freshly caught fish, attentive (but not overbearing) waitstaff and an attractive wine selection (if perhaps pricy, but you expect that for wine over here) you've got a killer night.We ordered one of the sauces to accompany our fish and they brought out two, in case our selection was too hot for our liking. It wasn't, it complemented the snapper beautifully. We were also very happy when the chef explained how he made the sauce to us, although I've yet to be able to recreate it.Dessert was exquisite too but you can't go past the mains for the winner. Great night there, we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.Show less

Author: ClodrussSingapore, Singapore
Title: The main hotel restaurant
Review: If you are staying at The Andaman the you will be eating breakfast here, and as well many a couple of dinners as well.Breakfasts were very good with a mix of western and Asian cuisine. Lots of fresh bread and pastries. Eggs and some other items cooked to order. You could order fresh coffee instead of the not so good brewed coffee they serve in the pot.Friendly staff for breakfast and dinner, although sometimes a little off or indifferent, the service in general needs a bit more training.Lunch and Dinners are good but unless you are staying at the hotel you most likely won't eat here, due to the hotels location.During our stay we ate here about 5 times for dinner, quite enjoyable watching the Lemurs flying from tree to tree in front of the restaurant.The kids loved watching the monkeys in the morning stealing the food off the plates...Food was good, portions were as well a good size, really liked the Red Snapper.Show less

Author: StefyKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Exquisite restaurant by the beach
Review: Almost everything about the restaurant perfect: the ambience by the beach, the service and the food. You get to pick your own seafood and sauces to go with them. And the desserts are beautifully presented and just as wonderful to eat. The sandy floor can be a challenge to walk in so slippers are advisable. And the piped in elevator style music can get a tad annoying. But this is wonderful restaurant to come to for dinner if you are staying at or near the Andaman... For the food and the ambience...Show less

Author: FromTurkuWithLoveTurku, Finland
Title: Wonderful food at a wonderful place!
