Review: Perfect dining experience on a paradise beach next to rainforest! Eating fresh fine dine seafood with your feet on sand - thank you Jala!Show less

Author: Елена ТMoscow, Russia
Title: Fascinating food, wonderful place!
Review: We liked very much this wonderful restaurant overlooking the sea. It was a perfect place to relax as enjoy seafood and grilled fish of your choice with traditional Malay sauces or be barefooted in the restaurant.Show less

Author: stevesimmanceWindsor, United Kingdom
Title: Sublime
Review: The perfect evening in langkawi- fish hand picked and cooked to perfection. Setting was perfect, you won't find this to compare anywhere else in langkawi!!Show less

Author: Eleanor Mscotland
Title: Delicious meal
Review: We were staying at the Andaman resort and ate here a couple of times. Fabulous seafood, fresh and cooked to your specifications. Excellent service, unobtrusive but very professional. Advice given re the various options was helpful and accurate. the quality of the cooking was second to none, We ate wonderful food in such simple but tasteful surroundings. Not cheap though!!!Show less

Author: SarahZainalNijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: Thumb Up!
Review: All the good reviews that I have read about this restaurant are true. The food was absolutely wonderful, from preparation to presentation, very pleasing. Everything brought to us was impeccable. The restaurant was exceptional along with the hosts and servers. Not to mention, the ambiance is gorgeous! Great job! We'll be back for sure!Show less

Author: NfariszaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Foodie Heaven
Review: Great ambience, good food and the staff is just far too spectacular...I'm in love. Will be there soon.Show less

Author: Mohsin IKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A night to remember
Review: one of the most romantic place with friendly and well trained staff. Food is cooked to perfection. Grill red snapper was the best.Show less

Author: jmy71Pretoria, South Africa
Title: Memorable Dinning Experience
Review: A friend recommended this restaurant for us to celebrate our homecoming to Langkawi but, did not elaborate further other then it serves fresh seafood with a difference.They have a table to accommodate all 6 of us without having to attach a few tables together, that’s a plus for us. We choose our fishes from a board menu; with choices of sauces and sides below. Highly recommend Mud Crabmeat on Squid Ink Pasta with tomatoes, diced asparagus with water spinach and, Garoupa in Hoi Sin Sauce, topped with a couple of fried onion rings; you will be transported into the culinary nirvana.The service was efficient, the wine selections were out of this world and, the staffs and its manager were delightful. Jala Seafood Restaurant is not the run-of-the-mill seafood outlet for sure.Show less

Author: RichardPhuketAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Fresh local seafood
Review: Visited the restaurant eventhough we were not staying in the hotel. It was a long drive but certainly worth the trip. Upon entry in the restaurant immediately greated by a very friendly young lady in a beautiful green dress. (who ever designed that is a genius!) Lovely local and extremely fresh seafood, sufficient choice and a great selection of sides and sauces. We had the pleasure meeting the Danish chef who runs the place, his passion and enthousiasm for fresh and local food clearly showed. Refreshing as well to see a chef come out of the kitchen and genuinely ask for feedback. Service was just as good as the food, staff has a good knowledge of products and wines. Refreshing experience. All in all something that you have to try when visiting Langkawi island! Great experience!Show less

Author: NovitAdrianDenpasar, Bali, Indonesia
Title: Romantic Dinner
Review: It's the most romantic restaurant we have ever gone to. Dinner with bare feets on soft sandy floor, candle light dinner. Sri (if I am not mistaken) offered us to keep our slipper and so we walked into the restaurant on bare feets and Aloy took care of us very well in service and we are glad to try all the goodies from Jala, especially the grilled fresh, recommended by Robin. next visit will sure try the steam one. Seafood selection are fresh and big enough to share for a family. Strawberry reef was just a perfect dessert, crunchy pistachio nuts mix soft cake, sweet ice cream and bit of sour from strawberry and sauceShow less

Author: Christoph TSingapore, Singapore

Author: SheelaB26
Title: Great experience in Jala

Author: thandekile17

Review: I loved this restaurant! The staff made me feel so welcome, they are so friendly & efficient you feel right at home. The lovely sunset view from Jala is not to be missed. The food was so delicious, I love seafood but the fact that this was fresh & made to perfection by the Chef made it more special. A special thank you to Alias, the Chef from Jala & the rest of the team. I'd give this restaurant 5starsShow less

Author: Veronica L
Title: Amazing sunset,great foods and professional staffs..

Author: nich068Hobart, Australia
Title: Great company, service, food and venue
Review: Title and rating says it all! Quality food with great advice from staff. View overlooking the Andaman Sea, watching sunset is not to be missed.Show less

Author: Virtualpaula
Title: quality food by the sea
Review: This place is part of the Andaman luxury collection resort and we were fortunate to be staying there for a week so we enjoyed this restaurant a few times. Author: Shemar72

Review: Special thanks to Mr.Alias who have taken care my wife and me true out our langkawi trip.we will sure come back next year.Show less

Author: Bendit6269
Title: Nice place to dine..
Review: This restaurant was fantastic.., beach front, good ambiece.., the foods was super fresh, the service was excellent.., well done Jala Team.., will be back if got the opportunity to dine there..

Author: angesmiffyHastings, Australia
Title: Great range on the menu, food yum !
Review: This was an international cuisine restaurant. A lot to choose from on the menu including western and asian foods, plus a 'healthy options' menu. They had little symbols to advise you of signature dishes/spicey/glutenfree etc and the food was delicious !! Great place as if you are staying at The Andaman, there is only four restaurants and with this one you could easily dine there many nights as there is so many awesome options !Breakfast was great, eggs cooked to order. Or I was also told you can take your own fish in and have that cooked the way you like (if you have had a good catch for the day). Beautiful setting on the beach so you can have your feet in the sand but still very classy and fine dining. Loved it Show less

Author: Neilan WColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: not value for money
Review: The setting and food was good. How ever the amount charged was not value for money specially since most of the sea food is from the locality.Show less

Author: joycewong2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food and atmosphere
Review: We had dinner two nights in a row at jala and were hoping to have it again for the third night. Unfortunately they close on Sundays this season. The food was really good. We especially enjoyed the dessert which was old Amsterdam cheese. I had it for both nights! The combination of the cars listed figs and shallots with the cheese was amazing. My 7 year old son loved the pumpkin soup and he told chef Rene that it was to die for. There was also the fragrant coconut rice which he enjoyed tremendously. It would have been great if we had the third night, so that we could try out the fresh seafood selections and have the chef help us build up the menu for us from there.All in all a great experience and I highly recommend it to others.Show less

Author: 967dawnc
Title: Great meal
Review: We had two very lovely evenings here.  The food was fantastic and the staff were very helpful and attentive.  Lovely setting and not overly priced.

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delightful experience, delicious food
Review: We had the most delightful experience dining at this restaurant. It is right on the beach front. with sand floors and a fabulous view overlooking the bay. Fishermen supply their fresh catch to this restaurant everyday and if you are there at 4 pm when they land, you can actually choose your own dinner. The fish were fresh and cooked perfectly, cocktails lovely, staff friendly and view fabulous. What better way to remember our holiday!Show less

Author: jimyuillUK
Title: 9.5/10 Great experience
Review: This was our 4th experience of the restaurants at The Andaman. To be honest, we weren't expecting great after the following - The Restaurant 5/10. The Japanese Restaurant 6/10. Tepan Laut 6/10. Room Service 8/10.But boy, were we wrong. As soon as we walked in, it felt like a proper restaurant and not just a hotel eatery. The staff were well trained and there was plenty of them. The setting was superb. We had a table right on the edge looking out over the sun setting in the bay.The starters were lovely. My only, tiny gripe was that the starters came and we had to ask the waiter where our wine was that we had ordered 15mins previously. I was not satisfied with his explanation that they only keep recommended wines at the restaurant and they had to go to the hotel to get ours. It was a recommended wine we had ordered. That said, my Prawn consumme was delicious, albeit a bit damp by the time we got our wine :)The mains again were delicious and my Red Mullet from the A La Carte menu delicious. Again, another tiny gripe would be why have scallops when they have to be flown round the world? The difference between the mullet and the scallop on my plate was night and day.But all things being equal, 9.5/10. The setting, the service and most importantly the food lived up to the scenery.Unlike the other restaurants and the hotel itself, I WOULD go back to JALA. In a heartbeat.Show less

Author: ilkeaksoySingapore, Singapore
Title: good food, good ambiance
Review: The fish were fresh, the staff knowledgeable about the food, service great, food great, ambiance great. Don't wear heels the floor is sand! Show less

Author: Pilkip1Reading, United Kingdom
Title: Beachside eating
Review: Wide selection of freshly caught fish supplied by local fishermen delivering to the beach cooked as you like it with nouveau cuisine side dish presentation. All tables have uninterrupted views into the bay which are spectacular if lucky enough to have a setting sun or full moon.Show less

Author: Sherrie CMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing and feel unreal
Review: I wasn't stay in the resort and didn't look for much information. Don't even know why we picked the restaurant, but it has surprised me! Price is reasonable, excellent service and extremely nice food.Highly recommededShow less

Author: mrswills1Perth, Australia
Title: Feel the sand between your toes
Review: The floor of Jala is sand, so you remove your shoes which are stored by the 'shoe concierge'. it is a well known seafood restaurant. You can choose a fish to have prepared to your liking and there is a large selection of side dishes to choose from, or you can choose a la carte. The food was delicious and the service friendly and efficient. Show less

Author: sootykingjrSydney, Australia
Title: The best in hotel dining I've experience
Review: I wouldn't usually eat in a hotel and you can eat very good food very cheaply in Malaysia but for the convenience of not having to leave your resort, it's a great setting and very good quality food.Show less

Author: Flurry2011Melbourne, Australia
Title: Fragmented concept in lovely location
Review: The seafood is fresh but the cooking is a bit hit and miss. My lobster was over cooked and dry. I always feel the chef must lack character when a restaurant offers me fish with my choice of sauces and side dishes from a board - feels a bit like a pub in Queensland - why doesn't he or she come up with the gorgeous ideas about the ideal food combination? It is a pretty spot for a nice middle class meal.Show less

Author: SorayaS325London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: We stayed at the Andaman hotel for 11 nights and ended up eating at Jala 3 times. It's beach front, fresh seafood and lovely food. Average meal was around 300ringitts Show less

Author: Heine KIkast, Denmark
Title: Superb...
Review: Went to Jala Restaurant with my mother and Brother an evening in April 2014. The best thing I ever did... The food was JUST excellent and the atmosphere gave the last mile to perfectionism... Have been to a lot of restaurants around the World, but the location and the moode at this place is undescribable. LOVE IT!!! Try to sit dining in a luxorious restaurant with your feet burried in the warm Datai Bay beach-sand. HEAVEN ON EARTH... :)My regards to the Chef and the staff at Jala. An unforgetable evening...Show less

Author: Chow Hock SSingapore
Title: Freshness of the seafood is heavenly!
Review: We stayed in Andaman Langkawi and had dinner at Jala Restaurant. Basically, the menu focus on Seafood, and also catch of the day. The ambience is lovely, warm and best if you are on bare foot to feel the softness and coolness of the sand. The dishes are simply delicious, very fresh seafood, and the service is great too!The beautiful sunset on the Andaman Sea provides the lovely setting for dinner, this restaurant is an attractive draw for many. We love it! Cheers!Show less

Author: RobynwauMelbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing food, service, views and atmosphere
Review: We ate at Jala four times during our stay at the Andaman due to the amazing food, service, views and atmosphere. Between my husband and I we were able to experience a great variety of the different dishes on the menu including the fresh seafood selection ( which we had seen the local fishermen bring ashore that afternoon) that Chef Rene took so much time to carefully advise which cooking method and sauces would suit each fish so my husband could make his selection. Every dish was beautiful, from the beautiful dips, "dirt" and breads through to the stunning and delicious desserts, but we did have our favourites....for me the baby barramundi and for my husband the red snapper and scallops. The staff were all fantastic, but special mention to the lovely lady at the door (Faziya?) who I am embarrassed to say knew our names after our second visit and I am not sure of the spelling of her name after four visits, but she always had a special table waiting for us and the biggest friendliest smile as she welcomed us .Also to Chef Rene not only for assisting us in our choices but chatting to us after our meal, Kamal and to all the wonderful waiters thank you.Taking our thongs off and having our feet in the sand while watching the amazing sunsets that Data Bay put on for us was the icing on the cake.Show less

Author: Sue CSydney, Australia
Title: A true dining experience
Review: This restaurant is a true dining delight, and despite the fact that I don't eat seafood, this did not stop me from enjoying the service and experience of dining at Jala Restaurant.Eating at Jala is not just about the food, but the overall dining experience.To begin with, service was unbelievably attentive. The staff make you feel like you're the only customer around! When I initially made the booking I enquired as to whether there were food options for people who did not eat seafood. At that point in time I thought Jala exclusively served seafood. The staff member who took the booking said that there were things on the menu for me, so I went ahead with the booking. When we turned up the next day, we handed our thongs over as the restaurant floor is sand. The restaurant is undercover but open right on the beach! It was such a care free and lovely feeling. The view of the beach is splendid but don't forget your mosquito repellant! As we were seated, one of the waitstaff actually handed me an ala carte menu and said 'I believe there is someone at the table that doesn't eat seafood?' When I mentioned that it was me, he kindly pointed out the non sea food options before letting us decide.Jala restaurant actually has an uncooked seafood buffet display at the front, where the seafood lovers can choose their fish/lobster/prawns etc, before discussing how they would like it cooked and served with the sous chef who is manning the area. My husband choose this option whilst I ordered off the menu. When you choose your seafood, you also get to choose a number of accompaniments. The chef was more than pleased to make recommendations. The food was fantastic and the seafood fresh. At some point during the evening the duty manager introduced himself to welcome us to the restaurant, as well as to invite us to provide any feed back.The Andaman should take pride in their staff who made such a wonderful impression. At one point in the evening a restaurant staff member grabbed another light/candle to bring it over as it was getting dark so we could see better.Reception and concierge were friendly and most helpful in directing us to the restaurant when we first arrived, and then helping us to organise a cab upon leaving. The hotel driver who drove us home was pleasant, polite and friendly. I believe his name was Ahman/Ahmed.The restaurant even has an area for you to wash the sand from your feet as you leave.The only drawbacks is that the Andaman is quite remote and the cabs will charge about 70RM from Cenang Beach - although I think its remoteness only adds to the wonderfully secluded atmosphere - no traffic, no hawkers, no buzzing from water sports or crowds!The other 'draw back' is obviously the fact that this is a fine dining restaurant and they charge accordingly. I would recommend the Jala experience to anyone!Show less

Author: Aurelie75008Paris, France
Title: Perfect dinner and sceneray
Review: Very quiet and good location , directly on the beach. Design is well thought and very nice. Seafood was really fresh, perfectly cooked. Side dishes are sophisticated and presented perfectly. Dessert list is amazing. Staff super friendly Show less

Author: Rita Marie YSurfers Paradise, Australia
Title: A wonderful experience
Review: We ate here on two evenings. The food is fantastic as you can choose your own fresh seafood - the chef or staff will recommend cooking method. The restaurant floor is sand but there is a shoe concierge for your shoes. The restaurant is on the beach so a lovely view of the bay. Service is friendly and attentive. A memorable meal.Show less

Author: EmmmsBrighton, Australia
Title: Excellent food but overpriced
Review: We visited in April 2014. The setting is absolutely lovely. Make sure you go before the sun goes down so you don't miss the view. The seafood selection was excellent but very overpriced. We had seen similar quality elsewhere on the island at a fraction of the price. The sides are also a little small. That said, you are paying for the location. Service is very good. We had our 2 year old with us and they didn't mind him playing in the sand next to our table. The only problem we had was that we had asked for candles to be put in our son's dessert (it was his birthday). This was forgotten. We would have liked to make a fuss of him.Show less

Author: Gunda K
Title: Excellent and outstanding place !!
Review: Visited Jala Restaurant in April 2014 and it was a very pleasant and new experience to visit a restaurant with bare feet :-) I dined at all the restaurants at The Andaman and dinner at Jala was without doubt the best. So tasteful, well-balanced and well-presented dishes. You enjoyed every mouthful of the 3 course menu. The staff was smiling, professional and attentive, so the evening was a great success.The environment in and around the restaurant is also contributing to make the evening both magical and romantic. The moon sent its rays across the beach and the waves swayed lazily toward Datai Bay´s beach just outside the restaurant.Thank you Jala for a fantastic evening.Show less

Author: AstridFredrikOslo, Norway

Review: Sand floor restaurant with very fresh seafood, try the cod. Nice kidsmenu as well. Reserve well in advance.Show less

Author: sydcarnieRozelle, Australia
Title: Good Italian food
Review: The risoni was amazing. Quality of food was very good. The service was great the night we were there, but the restaurant was almost empty. Great dessert selection.Show less

Author: sydcarnieRozelle, Australia
Title: Good food, apparently

I had the vegetarian lasagne which was very nice. Good options for dessert also. Wine list was good, same as all restaurants at the resortShow less

Author: oliP21London, United Kingdom
Title: fresh fish stale
Review: this restaurant is literally right on the beach - take your shoes off and feel the sand between your toes. My party popped in a few hours before the meal to choose our 'fresh out the sea' fish, and decide how we wanted it prepared, a fun and exciting experience as the fish was literally still moving. the fish were cooked perfectly, so fresh! and were really delicious however everything else was a real let down. The sauces for the fish were too overpowering and the sides were a little confused and on the small side. The desserts were the low point of the meal - too fussy and complicated and didn't even taste good. Oh and the bread and dips to start were disappointing also. Overall then - worth it for fresh fish lovers otherwise I would check out the Datai for equivalent fine dining. FYI responding to every review is over zealous and unwelcome. Let us review in peace! Show less

Author: comfy2Hampshire, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely breakfast -not perfect but close
Review: The buffet breakfast here has all the trimmings - western & Asian foods (hash browns, beef curry, roti canai, watermelon juice, waffle & omelette to order all notable). The red bean pau was a little too dry, there could be more fresh local fruit choices (we are in a tropical location!). Again service was excellent. Show less

Author: comfy2Hampshire, United Kingdom
Title: Fine seafood restaurant on one of the best beaches in the world with sand beneath your feet - what more can you want?
Review: Just are here tonight with kids and grandparents. It has been part of a magical stay at The Andaman - the restaurant is open air but the sea breeze and large fans keep it cool - as the sun sets, we are treated to a spectacular view of the Andaman seas from which the fish we are eating just came from this morning. Red mullet , barramundi, sea bream, crab, scallops are fresh from the ocean and simply but perfectly cooked. The bread starter was ok perhaps a bit hard and not that fresh, but the service was awesome and the manager dropped by too. There is sand beneath our feet as we dine in style. Andaman does take conservation seriously with sustainable fishing and coral reef restoration just offshore so you can eat with a clear conscience. Kids meals were lovely too with fresh fish. Show less

Author: DitaGenier
Title: Dinner
Review: Liked: Fish was cooked to perfection. The sauce was great too. Disliked: Premises too dark for our liking, we hardly see the food. Appetizers & bread served 10 seconds before the main dish came, so we didn't have enough time to actually enjoy them. It was interesting to try but maybe not coming back for second time. Show less

Author: Stella319Portsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: beautiful location
Review: Food excellent staff excellent and the tables and your feet are in the sand - so unusual location = beautiful view of Datai beach and the Andaman Sea.Show less

Author: vikingwarriorOrkney Islands, United Kingdom
Title: The Best Breakfast
Review: First class food, selection and service served in a tranquil setting. A special thanks to Restaurant Manager Mr Ally Abdullah and his team for the kind hospitality shown to us. We would highly recommend a visit.Show less

Author: AnitaC027Sydney, Australia
Title: Freshest seafood ever!!
Review: Brilliant restaurant, undoubtedly some of the freshest seafood we've ever experienced. With a unique concept of having a catch of the day section whereby you can choose your fish/crustacean and its cooking method, you can be sure of having something you truly enjoy. The chefs are top-notch, with the service unbeatable. Cannot wait to come again!Show less

Author: nicinicky96Harrow, United Kingdom
Title: Great choice of food
Review: The menu in here is fantastic, we ate here a lot during our stay and all the food was great, esp the steaks. We founf the staff to be very friendly, esp Pakowan and Alvin.Show less

Author: IcinineDublin, Ireland
Title: Expensive and romantic
Review: Very enjoyable, if rather expensive meal, but the restaurant is in the grounds of an opulent hotel so you kind of expect that. The sunset is amazing there so get a table around that time. Staff are lovely as is the food however if you are just looking for a big plate of dinner, or care more about portion size than quality - this might not be a place for you. Jala is on the grounds of the andaman hotel and is a bit of a drive away. You may have to get a concierge to drive you home - which cost us 70rm so not much extra expense.Show less

Author: rr77ukStamford Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and setting at "The Restaurant, The Andaman.
Review: We had 5 breakfasts and 4 evening meals at this restaurant. Food superb, steaks and sea food and the service 100% and the setting overlooking the swimming pool and forest simply great. I could write too much much about this restaurant, come and see / taste the food!!Show less

Author: rr77ukStamford Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: Beach Restaurant at The Andaman
Review: Great setting for a restaurant on the Datai beach. With sand under need your feet it feels initially strange but the food was wonderful and so was the wine. I had a chat with Danish Cheff René afterwards and congratulate him for the food, great steaks and my wife was more than happy with the seafood. Superb !!Show less

Author: Simona CBucharest, Romania
Title: Perfect place
Review: The seafood is fresh, you get to choose how you want it cooked and the best thing is that you have amazing views of the sea while you have your feet in the sand :-) Show less

Author: JounallerMalaysia
Title: Quirky and Hungry
Review: Guests could sit barefoot on the sand covered floor. Novelty No.1 Waiters look mostly imported from Bali or some Indonesian islands. Novelty No. 2Bread and dips with a generous serving of olives covered cheese tub is the best part of the meal.Appetizer of 'laksa' with snapper and prawn was gone and Ringgit $50/- lighter in two mouthfuls despite the outdated show of pouring the sauce (really a thin broth) at the table. Novelty No. 3Appetizer of Calamari, three thumbsize stuffed pieces deep filed and sitting on a bed of deep purple eggplant cream with some sticks of thin asparagus and all these gone in 3 small nibbles and another Rinngit $50/- gone Novelty No. 4. Seems like the money disappearing act here is faster than some airplane, pardon the mention as it happened exactly on the same day on this visit for dinner.However, the taste is recognizably fresh and the Caucasian couple with their children at another table were pleased and even commented THEIR portions were generous. Thanks Chef for making us pay for you and your friends stay in Asia.Show less

Author: emmagahanlondon
Title: Lovely views from Jala
Review: Jala was my favourite place to eat at The Andaman, the floor is all sand so you must take off your shoes before you sit!The food is interesting and imaginative, i tried things i had never had before.The views are great as its right on the beach, the atmosphere is relaxed and we loved it.Bit expensive but then so is the whole hotel, you must book here as it's popular.Show less

Author: AccentEllaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food in a great location
Review: Highly recommend this restaurant for at least one night during your stay. The fish was absolutely magnificent. A good reason to stay at the AnadamanShow less

Author: LucyP443Shrewsbury, England, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food and superb location
Review: This restaurant is a real gem and we enjoyed our last evening meal in langkawi here as a treat (it is not cheap!). Starters was imaginative and divine and the fish we chose to share for our main sublime (red mullet, pan fried). We saw fish being delivered to the beach in the day so can testify to its super freshness! Accompanying veg were delicious especially the sweetcorn! Service was great and it was a nice touch that the chef came to see how we were getting on. Dessert was delicious... Much yummier than it sounded on the menu for some reason so glad we went for it! The sand floor and ambiance of the place on the beautiful Datai bay is unbeatable... A real success story for The Andaman. Thoroughly recommend!Show less

Author: sumnemilySingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Environment
Review: Me and my wife celebrate our Valentine's Day at Jala. It's a great restaurant, have a nice environment, beside the seaside, dine on the white sand floor, and a good food prepared from kitchen. The food very impressed both of us, the starter recommended fr staff and the fresh seafood introduce fr chef. This dinner give us a good memories.Show less

Author: Tobias OMunich, Germany
Title: Excellent Food and Service!
Review: I pre-reserved a table as I wanted to be 100% sure to get a good table on Valentine's Day! Although we did mot stay at "The Andaman", we were very much welcomed to dine there. The restaurant manager himself answered kindly to my emails and reserved a table for me and my wife.We got a table in first row at the beach front and were able to watch the sun down, blue hour and night fall during the course of our dinner.It was magic evening.The location of the restaurant is very good at Datai Beach.Staff friendly and very knowledgeable. Especially the seafood master did a very good job in selecting the right fish for us: GaroupaFood excellently prepared. Overall its a kind of Asian mixed style if kitchen. Especially our steamed Garoupa was so perfectly to the point. Juicy and far away for being overcooked, which would be the worst for me if you eat fresh fish.The only slight critic I want to mention was the consulting for choosing the wine. The have a huge selection and the knowledge if the waiter was quite ok but could have been better. Nevertheless the Sauvignon Blanc form NZ, which I picked, was excellent.Location: 10/10Service&Friendliness: 10/10Staff Knowledge: 9/10 (wine, see above)Food Quality: 10/10Food Taste: 10/10Price: consider to spend more than 50 € per person if you go for the three course menu and if you take a lower middle priced bottle of wine (which will give you certainly already an very good wine)... For Eurpean income levels still a bargain for what it is and what you get...!Show less

Author: EdwardI28Budapest, Hungary
Title: tasty
Review: Great food, location, service and atmosphere. Loved eating here. Fish fresh and engaging menu. Desserts very tasty. Show less

Author: CanCan40San Francisco Bay Area, Us
Title: food is very tasty and staffs are friendly!
Review: It was a late arrival and we all got tired and hungry.. but they be able to serve us and the service are great. Food is very tasty. We had a good time thereShow less

Author: idenforcer
Title: The Best Breakfast
Review:
Wide array of cuisine and fantastic service lead by Alias.
Service is very anticipate and you will be surprise they know your favorite table.

Author: Michael EHong Kong, China
Title: Best food on Langkawi
Review: Brilliant staff and wonderful food. The location with sand floor is really cool especially when you come during sunset.Show less

Author: KimbaKakePerth, Australia
Title: Simply Devine
Review: Our family and I stayed at the Andaman for 5 nights and we visited Jala on our first night... wow... what an experience. Besides the quality, taste, freshness and presentation of the food itself, the location, layout and design of the restaurant really adds to the atmosphere.We were guided by their fish and seafood expert on what fresh fish we wanted to select (caught the same day) and how the fish should ideally be cooked to achieve the best result (including what sides should accompany the seafood) - oh... what an adventure... from selecting your own fish, to designing your meal, through to the anticipation of it arriving and of course (and most important) consuming it - just an absolute delight. We also had desserts which were fantastic.KimbaKake certainly agrees with all the reviewers on here who have given it 5 stars. Likewise, the staff are helpful, ever present and unobstructive.On top of all this, two days later I was on the beach relaxing when all of a sudden a fishing boat pulled up on the beach and two men came up to the restaurant to sell their fish to the Jala. On hand were a couple of very experience Jala staff (looked like the head chef and another expert) who dutifully examined, categorised and weighed the fish. This was a real treat to watch (attracted quite a crowd!) and it made my meal (which I had two days prior) even that much more special.Thank you Jala for making this an unforgettable experience!Show less

Author: s bDurham, United Kingdom
Title: Food and service of exceptional standard
Review: White linen tablecloths and heavy cutlery indicate a seriously good meal. Good range of menu and breakfast offering is particularly good with sparkling waters, smoothies, tropical fruits and spicy hot food as options. Evenings bring attentive service, generous portion sizes and a genuine wish to please the customer.Excellent dessert choice and children welcome despite the pristine table presentation. Repeat visitors get personally scribed name plates on local dried leaves that leave you feeling special.Highly recommended.Susanne BradleyShow less

Author: s bDurham, United Kingdom
Title: Jala- 'fishing net' in Malay language
Review: Simply exceptional service, food and atmosphere. Kick off your shoes as the floor is sand. Dress up or down, the staff will make you equally welcome. Intelligent, innovative menus using local and other ingredients. Ask the chefs to talk you through the dishes - you will be left with their enthusiasm ringing in your ears and want to cook more at home. Top class location and views. Susanne BradleyShow less

Author: ppourShanghai
Title: Surprisingly Good!
Review: Great service, Fresh yummy Italian food! Really enjoyed the experience. We were surprised more people didn't eat there!Show less

Author: ppourShanghai
Title: An Experienced NOT to be Missed!
Review: Love Jala! Great, fresh locally caught sea food. Great service! Original recipes. Fresh bread with interesting dips/toppings. Very Creative and thoughtful presentation. Every dish was amazing! Only draw back was the kids menu wasn't great.Show less

Author: Deborah DPetersfield, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous restaurant
Review: Wonderful location, right on the beach. Staff are friendly and helpful. Luxurious touches. The fish is wonderful - you choose from a fresh display and are helped by the fish expert. Loved the sandy floor of the restaurant - you can feel the sand through your toes.Show less

Author: stevebH3101GGBeaconsfield, United Kingdom
Title: Superb experience
Review: Park your shoes on the way in and dine with your toes in the sand.The highest quality of fish and loads of variety.Choose your fish and have is cooked how you want, choose from 10 sauces and loads of sides.it's the best at The Andaman but not as expensive as you might expect it to be.Amazing room and location on the beach.We ate their three times and it was faultless.Show less

Author: HONkievOdessa, Ukraine
Title: Fantastic food and atmosphere
Review: What a lovely setting at the beach, sand floor, open fire... very romantic. And that's not it - the food is fantastic! We selected a Sea-bass from the display (good selection), chose it steamed in banana leaf plus 3 side dishes and a sauce. We got some very good breads with different sauces, vegetables with cream-cheese dipping while waiting for our starters. The starters (melon-mango salad and black crab pasta) were good - but the fish fantastic, one of the best I had. It was prepared to perfection, soft and juicy, with excellent taste. They already prepare it in a way you don't have to be worried about the bones.All-in-all it came to US$ 85, which is good value for what we had.Show less

Author: JanKritzHelsinki, Finland
Title: Best in long time
Review: Jala has an excellent setting: sandy beach with the comfort of a restaurantFood is great, fresh from the sea and prepared as you wish.Compared to many - really many - restaurants, Jala offers an excellent and tasty cuisine.Service is extremely friendly, skilled and not at all pushy.Show less

Author: Masood_SheftaAdelaide, Australia
Title: Great, but pricey
Review: Had our freshly caught fish steamed and seasoned to our liking. The restaurant in set on sand, so appropriate shoes would be handy. Also, the oysters were pretty good. Be prepared to spend 200-300RM for a couple for the experience.Show less

Author: markatomSan Jose del Cabo, Mexico
Title: Fantastic
Review: Jala is fantastic - from the ambiance (sandy floor) to the service to the very fresh fish. A must tryShow less

Author: Pauline ELondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food
Review: We only ever had lunch and the breakfast buffet there. I wouldn't bother with the breakfast buffet, but the lunch dishes were all very good.Show less

Author: Pauline ELondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent!
Review: The food was fresh and flavourful. The dishes on the regular menu were all very good, but the options and combinations from the catches of the day were endless and all fantastic. The staff was also extremely helpful in choosing the cooking method and sauces for particular fish/shellfish.The staff were attentive, but never over-bearing. The children's menu was imaginative. Our favourite resort restaurant to date!Show less

Author: loloDLagosLagos
Title: Great fish, choosen from the lot and prepare up to your liking
Review: on the beach.......lovely location, fresh fich offered to your sight, can be prepared up to your taste, grilled, poached etc....comes with a selection of sauce, vegies etc.......of course on a island where seafood is available everywhere, the price is high, but the beach/sea view is worth the meal.......ideal for a lovely lovers night meal.Show less

Author: Aline_BrechtAntwerp, Belgium
Title: My best (sea)food experience ever!
Review: Just back from a 10 days stay at the Andaman resort in Langkawi. Jala restaurant, located on the Andaman beach, opened end of 2012 and has been providing top quality (sea)food ever since.During our stay, we visited Jala several times and tried both 'à la carte' as well as 'choose your own fish from the daily catch' options. What you get from both is an amazingly fresh and surprisingly up-to-date food experience. Fresh ingredients, delicate flavors and savory sauces that, when brought together, deliver a truly wonderful meal.I will always remember the grilled red mullet, lemongrass sauce with baked rice, green beans & asparagus. Nice Australian Rosemount white wine and Calamansi pie as a dessert just made the whole thing complete.Thanks to Jala and its amazing crew (especially Robin who will kindly assist you when going for the choose your own fish option).Show less

Author: ArchersmeadSevenoaks, United Kingdom
Title: Superb!
Review: I saw the reviews on tripadvisor and I wanted the family to experience The Jala Restaurant. Part of the Starwood chain of hotels, but this is different with Japanese, Italian, and a siam buffet on the beach when we were there. We had to wait 30 mins for a table at the Jala but this allowed us to explore the beach, apparently 9th best beach in the World.The Jala has a floor of sand and were invited to remove your shoes. The menu is excellent but the quality of food and service is superb. The presentation, falvours and freshness was excellent. There was also the opportunity to choose your fish landed earlier that day, kept on ice and cooked and served how you wanted it. The staff were excellent. The food and drink is expensive compared to many Malaysia restaurants 4 people approx 1000rg but half that of UK, but it was more than a restaurant it was an experience.Good for older children teenagers to appreciate quality.The hotel staff gave excellent service too and had time to provide real service, providing details of the boat lights catching squid to my son seeing a flying lema in the trees around the pools.What a memorable evening!Show less

Author: PiriwiriAugsburg, Germany
Title: Just amazing!
Review: How can I ever eat fish again at home! It was just an amazing experience, seeing the fisher boat arrive and eating one and a halv later a wonderful tasty meal! So if you go there try to book your table the same day when they get the fresh fish delivered, I swear its just worth it!Show less

Author: dearaprilSingapore, Singapore
Title: Impeccable service with fantastic food
Review: The staff were very helpful and the chef helped us select fishes by patiently taking us through each of their catch of the day, explaining to us the texture and flavours.It was our best meal and the Andaman. Show less

Author: AMPW4London
Title: Incredible food
Review: Beautiful food in a stunning setting....it has a twist as it set by the beach and the floor is sand. You can kick your show off before you go in. Don't worry they have these fab jet air hoses for blowing away the sand on your feet before you put your shoe on.Show less

Author: philippeg302Levens, France
Title: Wonderful view
Review: The Jala restaurant is really a nice place for lovers, the fish are fresh, perfectly cooked, and the Manager is always listening to your comments. Book a table for 2 right on the sea side you will be amazed. Philippe et Kinou from FranceShow less

Author: Sonia216London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: Amazing food with an amazing view right on the beach, my advice is to book your table around sunset to see amazing views during your dinner.Show less

Author: LRE517London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely
Review: We dined here one evening, this restaurant is lovely, set on the beach and encouraged to dine bare foot!The food is delicious and you basically choose fresh fish from the counter, which is delivered daily and then a sauce, the way you want it cooked and three sides. It works out at about £40 per head for food but is well worth the money.Show less

Author: afro88
Title: Food is ok. Maybe not really a 5* Restaurant.
Review: The quality of food was ok. There could be a bigger variety in the menu. Its not really up to the standard of the other restaurants in the resort.

Author: Lionel888Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great set dinner with amazing service
Review: We stayed at the Andaman recently and took part in the special Jing Tea Jala dinner, it was exceptional. The food was extremely impressive and we are foodies so are quite critical on quality of food. The chef even cam to our table to explain the final course and the staff all round were amazing even remembering our names a few days later. I will return and next time I hope to bring my friends to experience the amazing food with an exceptional level of service Jala offers.Guterres FamilyShow less

Author: Stepb4UHarlow, United Kingdom
Title: Nothing so special.
Review: The food was well presented but really felt a little bland. Trying to be a 5star restaurant but somehow missing something. We had sea bass, this is simply pan fried but couldn't even taste any seasoning in it, no salt, pepper and no lemon to squeeze over. Children had steak but again lacked flavour although they were tender. The potato choice was their own potato croquettes. Yuck...again mo flavour just a watery flavoured mash. This is the Andamans Hotel signature restaurant, a. Huge disappointment. The good thing though is the setting it is lovely right on the Datai beach bay.Show less

Author: Weatherspoon
Title: We will return...
Review: We went there a couple of times when Jala was newly opened in January. The service and food then were extraordinary. We came back again early Oct. The staff particularly its manager Richard remembered us! How lovely. We enjoyed our fresh selection of grilled fish and king prawns. Chef Rene came out to personally send our delicious pudding - homemade ice cream. We will certainly return...Show less

Author: daveaisNewcastle, Australia
Title: Food was okay, but overpriced
Review: Meal size was pretty ordinary and you pay too much for the experience. Great views though offset the rest.Show less

Author: Denise IBasildon, United Kingdom
Title: Good Food
Review: I do not eat fish but had steak it was well cooked and the sauce was lovely.However my husband eats fish and said it was very tasty. All food is well presented.The restaurant is in a lovely setting. Also you could not fault the service.Show less

Author: peter wLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Spectacular vew coupled with excellent meals
Review: I've read so many brilliant many reviews on this seafood fine dining outlet and decided to try it ourselves. I would have to say Kudos to the Andaman Hotel for coming up with such a brilliant concept as they are not many fine dining experience on the island of Langkawi,From the minute we entered we're greeted by charming smiles of its staff. Love the idea of the sugary sand floor where we have to take out our shoes and walk on the sand. So no heels ladies.One cannot help but noticed stunning ambience with two giant fans on the ceiling. We were seated overlooking the Andaman sea. Breathtaking. Then came the menu. I asked for the Cod as main course and the tastly Pumpkin Soup. Delicious.Will definitely come back here again...Show less

Author: Adz770322Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Thumb Up
Review: Peaceful views .... calm atmosphere .. a unique concept ... best food choices ... reasonable price ... best service ...Show less

Author: ninamnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Impeccable!
Review: This is a new restaurant at the Andaman. Fine dining delights yet you can stroll in barefoot, letting the sandy floor caress your feet, simulating an on-beach dining experience.Low lights, chillout tunes set the mood. Fresh seafood choices on ice allow you to choose your cuts or just choose from the a la carte menu. Either way you can't go wrong.Met the manager, Kamal. Lovely guy who's passionate about his business and seems to run a pretty tight ship.Delightful experience. Cant wait to come back!Show less

Author: Tony_BockLangkawi
Title: Amazing Food and Beautiful Ambiance
Review: I've been here a couple of times and felt I should write a review for Jala's.The food was amazing with such attention to detail, each dish was a mini masterpiece and there was lots of choice and well within the budget of a fine dining restaurant. The setting and ambiance was stunning, only feet from the beach with a really high class feel to the place. The staff were all friendly, helpful and very knowledgeable about all the dishes on the menu.Top marks, well worth it.Show less

Author: hidee5Leichhardt, Australia
Title: Wonderful food
Review: The food at the Jala is sensational. So fresh. We ate there twice. The Setting is right on the beach. You take your shoes off and walk along the sand in the restaurant. We were fortunate enough to have the table over looking the sea, this added to the incredible food and wine. The fish is cooked to perfection. The appetizers that you receive as a tasting board complimentary are a lovely add on. The staff are friendly and very knowledgeable. A sensational place to eat.Show less

Author: Naximov
Title: Great food
Review: We ate at Jala once, and that was our biggest mistake! This is the place you keep on coming back to. We had a sea front table for dinner, the food was amazing, one of the best I have ever had, the service was impeccable, all in all leaving a long lasting memory. For the standard of food served ( fine dining) the prices are reasonable. Definitely visit this place if you are in Langkawi!Show less

Author: aliya_zKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: top notch
Review: i didn't know what to expect other than perfection, although i tried to lower that expectation a little bit as the whole trip was a surprise for my boyfriend's birthday and i am not a fan of being disappointed. i got the staff to make a reservation for me at Jala Restaurant where they were gonna bring the birthday cake. i don't know if they were really acting by bringing the dessert menu and all, but i was really convinced the birthday cake was not going to happen! however, i was ready to forgive them due to their impeccable service and excellent food. we opt for the creamy king prawn fish soup to start the meal and chose the beautiful char-grilled garoupa. i was never really a fan of cream but the soup was tasty enough for me to say that it was delicious. the fish was very well cooked. we got the staff to choose the sides for us, fried rice, vege and pumpkin (although i almost told him & my bf that i don't like pumpkin), but everything was just perfect and the pumpkin was surprisingly very very good!! service was excellent, all of them were super attentive. being a person who is also working in the f&b/service line, i really admire what they are doing. yes, price is expensive but you should expect that out of a fine dining restaurant. i have to say, it was worth every cent. keep up the excellent job. we will definitely visit Jala again for the whole experience :)Show less

Author: Tommy_Kollberg
Title: Excellent fish and seafood
Review: Had one of my best fish dishes ever! Really nice venue on the beach and good service topped with a really good chef. Show less

Author: errgoSeoul
Title: Fulfilling experience
Review: This place would shine in any major capital city but here, nested in The Andaman, it adds a new dimension to an already unique experience, a contemporary touch consistent with the resort's soul: sustainability, respect, peacefulness, kindness, curiosity, enthusiasm, and a luxury untainted by arrogance.The Danish Chef obviously enjoys diversity, and making sure demanding palates meet new sensations. He revisits the local classics (Jalaksa), reinvents brisket, and invites you to the catch of the day - when, around 4-5 pm, a local fisherman brings the colorful fish and seafood that will end up on your plate.Show less

Author: rjhayter
Title: Great food on a fantastic beach
Review: Great food prepared by an ambitious chef, eaten with the sound of the surf as accompaniment. Lovely.Show less

Author: RObert3363Nederland
Title: First-class
Review: the service that is offered is excellent (staff, manager etc), they knowledge of the ingredients bij the staff are great and professional. the ingredients are so fresh; you taste it; the meals are fantastic, the way of preparation and presentation is also great. The atmosphere is extraordinarily! View, stand, furnishing we liked it al. Absolutely recommended!!Show less

Author: KavaxNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful setting, wonderful staff
Review: The Restaurant can seem a bit familiar as its the same place where you eat breakfast at the Andaman so it lacks a bit of the wow factor that you get at some of the other restaurants but it is still in a magical setting and the staff are incredible, we ate here twice 4 nights apart and the staff all remembered our names, which table we liked the last time and even how we liked our steaks. And the steaks are amazing, who knew Langkawi was a place you'd find great cows but they certainly know their stuff here, mine was cooked to perfection. Prices are reasonable too.Show less

Author: KavaxNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Extremely relaxed fine dining
Review: We loved Jala, it felt like the perfect posh beachside restaurant where you could dress up in your resort chic but turn up barefoot and feel the sand under your feet. The feel is upmarket but so relaxed and the food is undeniably wonderful. We chose ours from the seafood display, all just out the sea and you can choose exactly how you like it from an array of cooking methods and sauces. The squid was ridiculously good and the fish excellent. The service as we came to expect from every restaurant at the Andaman was brilliant. The restaurant is right on the beach and the sunsets are spectacular. It wasnt cheap, double the price of the other restaurants at the Andaman but it was a memorable evening.Show less

Author: j_trioSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice
Review: the fresh seafood is good but selection somehow limited. I would have expected a bigger selection given their access to the Andaman sea....Show less

Author: Blueye2Bundoora, Australia
Title: Magical Setting
Review: This is a new restaurant at the Andaman Hotel it has a unique setting where the floor is all sand. Upon arrival they take your shoes and place in a basket so while dining you can feel the sand. The setting is very romantic as it is undercover, but outdoors by the beach. The menu is AL La Carte and you can select from their very array of fresh seafood. We selected our meal from the fresh seafood display where you can have it cooked it many different ways. We had a feast, we chose prawns and lobster for entrée and chose it have it grilled. It is served with condiments. For main we had the red mullet steamed in banana leaves this came with three different side dishes of your choice. Then there is dessert well all I can say its a must. This is perfect for a special occasion and not really on the cheap side but worth it.Show less

Author: outnabout78Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Good setting with an average taste.
Review: We heard about the Jala restaurant in langkawi and we decided to try it. The restaurant had a big place to display the catch of the day and ways of cooking plus sauces to go with it. We ordered the crab meat with the black pasta as a starter and grilled fish with hoi chin sauce as per Manager's recommendation. My friends chose from the display barracuda half grilled and half steamed , the fish was over cooked and hard to chew for both ways. The restaurant prices are very expensive however we enjoyed the atmosphere and the wine too. Fresh seafood and scenic place yes , but not recommended for gastronomic people out there.Show less

Author: JoanCollarSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unique setting for an amazing meal
Review: The fish can't get any fresher unless you caught it yourself!! It was a lovely evening. The food came pretty quickly and was amazingly fresh and flavorful. The kids had a blast playing with the sand while having dinner and that was just a remarkable setting. I heartily recommend this restaurant if you truly want to have a memorable dining experience!!Show less

Author: Intrepidation
Title: Gastronomically & Visually a Feast
Review: Jala is a bold attempt to fuse an exquisite fine dining experience with a spectacular view of a sunset in one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. In fact this beautiful restaurant is situated on the fantastic beach so this is a rare fine dining establishment that does not encourage wearing one's expensive shoes although you can leave your shoes at a " shoe concierge" .The menu offers a good variety of seafood dishes using local catch as well as items imported from other locales. The service level does not however quite match the quality of the dishes offered and the unique and memorable ambience of the Jala.Show less

Author: longislandfreddieMelbourne, Australia
Title: Yummo
Review: Great seafood bit exy but worth it to trea yourself on Holidays Go for slecetiing your fish or seafood rather than the set menu it makes it more intersting I loved the Shoe concierge also ...my son thought it was hysterical ! Show less

Author: channy81Gregory Hills, Australia
Title: Fantastic views along with fantastic service and food!!
Review: The jala restaurant is situated at the Andaman hotel in which where we were staying. We made a booking for 7:30pm in time to see the sun set which is truly magical. The Jala restaurant is very unique in that it is actually situated on the beach and you dine on the sand. When you arrive they have a staff member to take your shoes so you can experince the uniqueness of the restaurant. Its a very romantic setting with dimly lit lights on each table.We opted to have the fresh fish and squid wich was magnificant one of the best seafood meals we have ever had. The staff were attentive with our drinks. Our food took a little while but that was understandable as we picked the fish fresh and specified how we wanted it cooked. This was an expensive night for my husband and myself however we both felt it was worth it. Again the whole dining experience was amazing and very romantic :) Thank you Jala for a memorable nightShow less

Author: HChanHong Kong
Title: Ridiculously inflexible service
Review: Having heard so many good reviews about Jala, we wanted to try it and booked a table for 7:30. On the evening, we got hungry early and so we did arrive very early at 6.30. The receptionist asked us to have a drink in the adjacent lounge while they got things ready. We fully understood and had our drinks happily. By 7.05, we saw a couple of guests seated inside the restaurant. Since we were hungry and had about finished our drink, I walked over the restaurant to see if we could go to our table. To my surprise, the receptionist said that we had to wait till 7.30 on the dot. Apparently, they have some sort of policy on the number of guests per half hour. I explained that the restaurant only had 2 tables of guests and it seemed ridiculous of them to be so inflexible. The lady said she could try to speak to the manager to see what could be done. But given this was supposed to be a top-notch and expensive restaurant, I didn't want to beg for a favour. I told the lady to cancel the reservation. We then walked over to "The Restaurant" who accommodated our walk-in request with warm smiles and friendly service. Granted, "The Restaurant" didn't have the innovative cooking style of Jala. However, the food was very tasty, menu was extensive and the two fish main courses that we had were very fresh. I've dined at many top restaurants around the world and I've worked at a five star hotel group before. However, I've never heard of such a ridiculous guest policy before, especially since we arrived at a quiet time, and not during their peak hour. Nevertheless, we were grateful to Jala for motivating us to take our business elsewhere as we were very happy with "The Restaurant". Kudos to the great staff at "The Restaurant"!!Show less

Author: RayChaudSingapore, Singapore
Title: Barefoot on the sand!
Review: Dining at the Jala was a unique experience. The restaurant floor is the beach! Situated on Datai Beach The Jala is a restaurant at the Andaman Resort. On the menu is Malaysian/Thai/European fusion food created by an international chef and his local assistants. Try the pumpkin. pumpkin, pumpkin and the excellent selection of fresh seafood bbq or grill with a very interesting range of sauces served with lovely side dishes. The atmosphere is also excellent - ask for the more private tables on the sides if you want a romantic dinner. Given this is a resort restaurant there will be kids and families. Definitely make a reservation as the capacity is limited and resort guests normally frequent this place.The staff were very flexible in arranging vegetarian options for my wife - but you have to ask, its not on the menu. There is also an excellent bar next to the restaurant where you can catch the sunset before dinner. Lovely cocktails and mocktails served here that you can move to the restaurant when dining.This is a unique dining experience - in a large open shelter on the beach - so do not expect air conditioning. There are huge fans (the biggest I've seen) on the ceiling to circulate fresh air and keep the temperatures cool. But be ready to sweat during hot summer days and be prepared for the normal insects and mosquitos - very few eve though it was raining the whole week we were there. So they do take good care. Even by Langkawi standards it is expensive - but you do get what you pay for at the Jala.The only negative - a few of the staff we not very capable. They need some training in communication, service and attention to details. Some of the dishes took forever to arrive - even with multiple reminders they forgot our order and this led to more delays. Work in these areas will make this a five star place for me but not just yet.Fortunately, the food, drinks, the sound of nature, the waves and the wonderful sea breeze paled the negatives. Would definitely go back and recommend the place for food quality and unique dining experience.Show less

Author: Lovetoreviewthingz
Title: Nice place, great view and good food
Review: Went to Jala unexpectedly as we were visiting friends at the Andaman. The setting on the beach is fantastic so making a booking before sun down is a good idea. We chose to eat the fresh fish and were able to pick our own fish out , choose cooking style ( we asked for charcoal grilled) and then sides to go with it. This was an expensive night as we payed more than we would for an everage meal in Perth however we did enjoy the food very much. Show less

Author: angeliuswingsMildura, Australia
Title: Good to see
Review: lovely with lovely people staff always smiling we enjoy the sitting .the selection of wine is just very good i.had a light sauvignon blanc was fantastic .the food was delicious i can t even stand up after .and thanks to RICHARD talking to the customer beautiful atmosphere thereShow less

Author: ileemamaHong Kong, null, Hong Kong
Title: Friendly service with great food
Review: We ate here twice during our stay in the hotel. The staff were very friendly. We took the lunch very early as we arrived at the hotel before noon.Instead of waiting in the lobby, we took our early lunch here.Must try the freshly baked bread. They got us refilled as we were so hungry while waiting the food.My kid ordered the Spaghetti Bolognese in the kids menu. It was great. Just one thing. Perhaps, next time, they could not to add the parsley as my 5 years' old son doesn't enjoy the herbs usually. But it is delicious. We took the rice paper roll with plum sauce. Very fresh and refreshing.Show less

Author: ileemamaHong Kong, null, Hong Kong
Title: Perfect Dinner
Review: Stayed at the hotel. Read the positive comments here and tried Jala with my hubby and kid.All of us enjoyed this lovely dinner. My kid tried the kid menu of the pasta with fish in tomato sauce. Very yummy. (Originally, it is black pasta, but they were so kind to change for us)We selected the grilled lobster and it's just great. Very fresh and grilled with the right time.The Jalaksa was very delicious, too.And the wide variety of wine for you to choose.Show less

Author: chris1979294265Singapore, Singapore
Title: overrated
Review: Been to Jala with my business, it was an important dinner to get a good deal for my business, but everything went wrong, the service was to slow and the fish not as fresh as I expected. At least the chef was very friendly trying to accommodate our needs.Can't recommend Jala Restaurant.Show less

Author: davidhiiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sea, sand and fine food
Review: We were late the first evening and arrived without booking. The restaurant was kind to help us arrange a table after we had our drinks at the bar next to it. So book early and you can catch the sunset while dining bare footed in this fine dining restaurant. There's the sea, breeze and sound of the waves minus the bugs!To start off the "Jala" bread is really nice along with the dips. We loved the fish and had them for our daily dinner while at the Andaman. The kids meal are equally impressive. Leave some room for the heavenly desserts and coffee (if you had the Andaman buffet breakfast coffee, this will show you they have the real stuff in Jala!).My kids ended up at the beach after their meal and only return for the desserts. You can watch them from the comfort of your restaurant seats.The restaurant seems to be was built with minimal destruction to the trees. An old tree still stands tall almost in the middle.Show less

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: The whole ambiance at this restaurant is second to none, as is the food which is excellent and beautifully presented.I had the steamed cod which was served with baby beetroot which may seem quite a strange combination, but tastes wonderful.I loved the whole atmosphere of the restaurant, which is fine dining, has a dress code but not a "shoe" code and it is lovely to sit with your feet in the sand whilst watching the stunning sunset.Service was a bit haphazard at times but when on holiday there is no real hurry so best to just sit back and relax.Will definitely visit here again in the future.Show less

Author: Andrew TCanberra, Australia
Title: Sand between your toes whilst fine dining
Review: Jala Beach Restaurant at The Andaman is in a league of their for resort dining. Besides the food and I'll get to that shortly. The design and atmosphere is just the bees knees for beachside dining. Whilst a respectable dress standard expected its is no shoes! Fresh clean and cool sand between the toes whilst waited on by excellent staff. Not just at tentative to routine matters but the manager and chef personally involve themselves in your choices and how your meal is cooked. Now the food, fresh alright, we watched the the fishing boat run ashore and the chef and kitchen staff sort the catch of the day on the beach. Any type of their fish is superb, their shellfish just scrumptious especially the thermidor lobster with a red curry twist. One of our group was celiac and the chef looked after her like she was the only one there. We had plans for dining one night in the resort and the next out. We didn't bother leaving the resort. The whole family thanks Richard and his team for a memorable weekend.Show less

Author: Natasha157Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Fantastic Food and Impeccable Service
Review: I and my partner was there last month when we on Holiday .The Restaurant ambience and the friendliness of the staffs are really impeccable.We were there during dinner and I must say all the staffs are well train from the first impression of the service.Mr. Alias I guess he is the Manager in charged is on top of that and he is really good with the control flowing of the dinner service, kudos to that.Maria a very fair skin lady I guess has a great smile and we both feel very comfortable.I am definitely recommending The Restaurant to others because of the service and the quality of the food.We will be back in this Hotel and The Restaurant.Show less

Author: MmaniarLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great work by the chef
Review: He's a sweetie and will take care of you even if you don't ask. Great flavours and the catch is so fresh its still cool from the sea water! Frankly the only restaraunt worth eating at The Andaman (apologies to the staff who were wonderful to us! Nothing personal, we just preferred the food at Jala and at the datai!)Show less

Author: LlwyngwrilLlwyngwril, United Kingdom
Title: So Good
Review: Food here is so good and all the staff are willing to help you make a great choice . They converted my husband to fish eating.The steaks here are fantastic best we have ever tastedShow less

Author: Andres DBarcelona, Spain
Title: The place to be
Review: Excellent food with a beautiful view on the bay from your table and relaxing. Staff very friendly and professional. The fish display is very nice and this sand floor with the surrounding is perfect. Thanks you Jala team for this great moment.Show less

Author: DowsonTomlinPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: I don't eat seafood but my wife does!
Review: During our recent visit to the Andaman luxury resort my wife and decided to dine in theJalal seafood restaurant despite the fact I do not eat seafood.I was extremely pleased to find they served alternatives including steak (my main course), but apprehensive as to what the quality would be in a specialist seafood restaurant. I need not have worried because the entire meal was absolutely superb, and I have to say possibly the finest I have had the pleasure to eat.From the starters through to the desserts the meal was truly delicious, well cooked, well presented, and served by friendly attentive staff in truly amazing surroundings.The ambience of the of the restaurant, the beachfront location and the novelty of the sand (with shoe concierge) unbeatable.Thanks to Richard, the chefs and all the other members of staff for a truly unforgettable experience.Show less

Author: Charlesbrbr
Title: Excellent
Review: Amazing food, very good service that makes the Jala restaurant number in Langkawi I have been waiting for such a great experience since a long time!!! Show less

Author: andrewhG9202BXNewbury, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome seafood and steak
Review: Lovely relaxed service but still attentive.......food was Devine, both a la carte and the display menu........three times we ate there and could have done all week!!!Show less

Author: DGchMexico City, Mexico
Title: Best Restaurant in Langkawi
Review: The location, the staff, the food.. This restaurant is so far one of the best restaurants in the island and Malaysia. The amazing selection in the seafood display was amazing. The fantastic creativity and talent of Chef Rene makes it worth paying the price. The service is unique taking care of every detail during the entire evening. The Restaurant also has an incredible nice selection of wines to combine your dinner with. Special Thanks also to Restaurant Manager Richard who has come to create a restaurant that provides amazing dinner experience.Show less

Author: mark lNorwich
Title: Jala dinner
Review: l was immidiately impressed with the ambience of Jala. Relaxed yet stylish. The menu was contemporary and the service excellent.The quality of our food was simply superb! The variety of taste and the way it was cooked suggests this restaurant deserves a very high ranking on the island. Probably 1st place as it was that good.Regardless of where you are staying in Langkawi you should make the drive to Jala as you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: SueLynnTiongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unique dining experience!
Review: Jala at The Andaman boasts an exciting menu of Malay and Western flavours, with a fresh seafood display for you to choose from. The restaurant offers the best of both worlds, nestled between the tropical rainforest and the Andaman Sea.Dress code is resort casual so skip the stilettos and go with flip flops, unless you want your heels to sink into the soft sand. One of Jala’s unique selling points is its sand floor that allows guests to feel as though they are dining on the beach. Jala is headed by Chef de Cuisine, Rene Knudsen, whose has a passion for nature and great respect for the local community.The herb collection was most interesting; everything was edible. Except the pot. Try the Jalaksa, the chef's take on local laksa. This composition of king prawn and seabass fried in Japanese breadcrumb batter, quail egg, cucumber and consommé was as tasty as it looked.On the whole, my dining experience at Jala was very enjoyable. The ambiance was lovely and the seafood was fresh – brought in by the fishermen that evening itself. Flavours were kept simple, and dishes were hearty and unpretentious.For more pictures and a full review, visit: http://www.bangsarbabe.com/2013/04/jala-restaurant-the-andaman-langkawi.htmlShow less

Author: BevOzzy
Title: Fish!
Review: Gorgeous fish you can pick for yourself then cooked to our preference. Very beachy relaxed atmosphere with sand on the floor. Not cheap and wine is very expensive.Show less

Author: MBMWMaarssen, The Netherlands
Title: Great place, worth the trip!
Review: Jala opened just 3 months ago as the seafood restaurant of Andaman Hotel. It is located on the north west coast of Langkawi and it is definitively worth the trip if you are not staying in the hotel, although it is quite remote.We were seated just off the beach, but in the sand in a modern style environment. The place is open, so fresh air. The Danish chef has prepared a number of interesting dishes, mainly local fish.We had great food, a nice wine and a great evening.Very much to be recommended!Show less

Author: 5-BROWNSBordon, United Kingdom
Title: Seafood lover's delight.
Review: Really lovely setting and fantastic food. Although the "catch of the day" seafood was very expensive. Eating off the al a cart menu was just as good.Show less

Author: Henry1975
Title: Great seafood!
Review: Lovely seafood restaurant! Great food and service - tables almost right there on the beach in the sand.Show less

Author: StevenIsWhere
Title: Included breakfast was great
Review: All delicious, and sparkling wine was an added bonus. Both Asian and western choices available, and service was attentive. The waffles were amazing!

Author: StevenIsWhereBerkeley, California
Title: Delicious, but pricey!
Review: We went all out, choosing the catches of the day, and it was worth it. Beautiful, fresh fish cooked how you want it, with an expert to guide you through the process. It was great! And a beautiful setting as well.Show less

Author: alxsuhHillsborough, California
Title: Yum yum
Review: On the beach at the Andaman hotel. Service is very friendly. They buy whatever is good that the local fisherman literally brings in that day from the beach in front of the restaurant everyday at 5pm. So pretty dang fresh.Show less

Author: BobKLAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Fresh Seafood in a great beach setting
Review: What a fantastic new restaurant at the Andaman. Seafood as fresh as it can be and prepared in different excellent ways. Setting is gorgeous, next to the sea with your feet in the sand. The design of the restaurant and adjacent bar is very cool. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: 198DavidR198Sydney, Australia
Title: Great experience!
Review: I was looking for the perfect place to eat when staying for business in Langkawi. But we wanted something special and away from all tourists traps in the main town and beach. What a great choice I made. I contacted the Jala restaurant to make a reservation and emphasized the importance of this diner for me and my business partner. A short taxi ride and we were in paradise. From beginning till end the service was immaculate, we were seated at a quiet table (oceanfront!), wines were exquisitely matched with the food and the food itself was prepared with the utmost care! I cant rave enough about this restaurant, food and its employees. Special thanks to Richard who was very professional, knowledgeable and very attentive. After diner drinks at the bar are highly recommended! All in all: a perfect evening thanks to Jala!Show less

Author: AsiaSteve72Alton, United Kingdom
Title: AMAZING
Review: The new Jala restaurant is a new addition the the Andaman hotel and I can honestly say I had one of the ebest meals i have ever had, the setting is maongst the rainforest but on the edge of the beach with sand on the floors and trees reaching up through the roof, it really has been so well d esigned that before you even try the food your are wowed, the menu is excellent and the hardest thing is choosing what to have as I wanted to try everything, I went for Grouper from the catch of the day which you choose how you want it cooked with a choice of sides, my companions chose from the menu and there fish was equally stunning, starters were amazing the only problem was we had on room for dessert, staff couldnt of been more attentive, the lighting in the retaurant is beautiful, you can watch the chefs doing their thing in the open kitchen behind a glass wall, the wine list is super and the entire experience was one i will never forget, if you want a special meal in Langkawi make Jala your choice, you wont regret it, a truly wondeful addition to this super hotel.Show less

Author: Tom RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: top class fish.
Review: We ate twice in the Jala restaurant during our 5 night stay at the Andaman and on both occasions the service and food were excellent. We both opted to select from the fish bar and the cooking of both meals was perfect on each visit. I would highly recommend anyone staying at the hotel to eat there.Show less

Author: alank2726Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is good but selection is quite limited
Review: Food quality is good, server are attentive, friendly and attentive. The only drawback is that the food selection for lunch is quite limited, so if you are staying for a long period of time, it could be quite boring as the other 2 restaurant is only open in the evening sessionShow less

Author: alank2726Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food
Review: Food was great, service was excellent and do give a try on their freshly caught fish and ask the server to suggest the way to cook it...you will be surprisedShow less

Author: joseph_tan_wong
Title: Top notch!
Review: A restaurant situated in the midst of nowhere with a beautiful view of the Andaman sea. The ambiance is gorgeous... Walking on the sand is a nice touch added to its location. Mouth watering selection of fresh local seafood compliments with different salts around the world. Outstanding service where it is rare to find in an island like Langkawi. Truly a memorable experience for couple, business associates or family gathering who wishes to experience overall superior service.Show less

Author: Damien LLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Experience on sand
Review: First thing that we noticed was the sand floor when we came in, what a fantastic idea, it really connected you to the beach and made us feel completely relaxed the moment we sat down. Of course a restaurant is about the food and service and also here we were impressed. Robin our waiter introduced himself and took care of us the entire evening brilliantly. He explained us the menu’s as there are two choices, one seafood display menu and one a la carte. We decided to take our starters from the a la carte and our main course from the seafood display. The fish was grilled perfectly with nice sauces to go with it, good recommendation from the girl at the seafood display. As starters we took the oysters and the pumpkin soup and they were both very well presented and prepared.We went back two more times during our stay at Langkawi even though we did not stay at The Andaman. If we return next year to Langkawi we will most definitely visit this restaurant again.Show less

Author: JLandBG
Title: Good choice and service
Review: Wide range of options at breakfast with eggs cooked to order. A good choice of Western and Malay dishes on the a la carte menu in the evenings.

Author: JLandBGLoughton, Essex, UK
Title: seafood and an amazing view
Review: We loved being able to choose our own fish and have it cooked to our own specifications. The tiger prawns were amazing and we paricularly enjoed the wine and dine night whilst we were there. it's right on the beach with an amazing view and no shoes are a must as the floor is deep, soft, silky sand. Show less

Author: erwin_perdokGroningen
Title: Great Start
Review: When they told us the restaurant was opened for only four weeks we could hardly belief it. The staff was so well trained and attentive that water and bread was served within minutes to our table, we were immediately impressed by the service.
