We decided to go with the fresh seafood and selected a huge lobster as our main course and a selection of clams and mussels as recommended by the chef at the seafood display. The mussels and clams were poached and served with an nice western dille sauce which was very tasty. The lobster however was even better, nicely chargrilled with a red curry and nice side dishes. You could really taste the food was fresh, we actually saw the lobster coming in during a ceremony on the beach were the fisherman came to deliver the fish and lobsters. All in all a great experience and certainly we would go again. Unfortunately we decided to go on our last day, but if we ever return to Langkawi we will come back!Show less

Author: Donna WKL
Title: angel hair....not
Review: We went for the "pick your own seafood" option where you can select the seafood of choice, two sides and a carb dish. The fish was perfectly grilled. The sides were so so. We ordered the angel hair infused with truffle oil. However, it was more like a fettucine. We enjoyed the meal nonetheless.Most people remove their shoes at the restaurant as they are trying to emulate the beach feel. So, come in flip flops. Also, the restaurant is alfresco. Dress down.Show less

Author: christopherLeeds_UKLeeds, UK
Title: disappointing
Review: We visited the Jala tonight and had fresh seafood, We ordered a starter and a fish to share for main course. We waited almost an hour and both appeared together. The starter of potentially lovely tiger prawns were coated in batter and tasteless, The fish was better but small and barely sufficient for 2 . Only one plate was provided. There was no rice as promised, the veg was ok. Overall we were disappointed although the staff waiting at table were helpful and enthusiastic. In the end though its what happens in the kitchen that counts and there was no sign of culinary excellence. The whole meal with bottle of decent wine was over 400 ringits - a bit steep we felt.Show less

Author: Weatherspoon
Title: Langkawi answer to Rick Stein's
Review: This new restaurant in the posh Andaman has fabulous range of seafood dishes to offer from the simple grilled fresh local fish right to lobster. We had grilled garoupa coated with local herb. Simply delicious. It came with 3 choices of side dishes. Thai fried rice, salad and sauce. We love the 'flower pot', local herbs combined with baby carrots served in a mini flower pot complete with edible soil made of cheese as dip. The friendly staff not only attentive but also very informative about all the various dishes and the beautiful design of the restaurant. We noticed the chef utilises local spices and herbs in most of his culinary creations. Well done. New restaurant new experience. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Nickcoombe
Title: Possibly the next Best Restaurant in Malaysia
Review: What a delightful dining experience we had at this newly-opened restaurant. Its like going through a gastronomic journey coupled with the lovely setting overlooking the Andaman sea. The minute you entered the restaurant you were greeted by the attentive staff asking if you like to store your shoes on the existing shoe rack. Shocking but true. Reason - the raised floor is covered with thick soft sand! Then you walked barefooted pass a buffet full of fresh seafood selection. What caught my eyes was this massive dining table which seated 20. According to the staff it originated from the hotel premises. They gave the Meranti tree a new 'lease of life' after cutting it down to make way for renovation. Then came the food. We were very lucky indeed as Chef Rene, who is behind our delicious culinary experience came to our table. We requested him to rustle up some dishes and he came out with what supposed to be their signature dish Jalaksa, fish broth with thick white noodle accompanied with fish and king prawn. Delicious. Then the superb rich pumpkin soup. Our main course the melt-in-your-mouth Wagyu Beef was to die for. My partner sticked to his seafood favourite, Cod accompanied with beetroot and hollandaise sauce. The service too was excellent. Show less

Author: Becery
Title: Seafood culinary delight
Review: This restaurant had been open 11 days when we arrived in Langkawi but you wouldn't have guessed it. We were extremely impressed with the freshness and variety of the fish, caught that day, locally. We were able to see the fish available from the days' catch and put together our own menu with assistance from the in-house seafood expert. The staff were very informative and knowledgeable on the varieties of fish and cooked them to perfection. The wine list was extensive and very good. (and decent wine glasses too!) The atmosphere was very inviting, relaxed beach meets high quality restaurant. Staff took care of our shoes on arrival as the floor is soft sand. My husband and I cannot speak highly enough of the meal and the experience. We had complementary bread and dips (the Heston-inspired dip is worth seeing!), entrée, main and dessert as well as a bottle of wine and cost was about AU$150 altogether. Easily worth it. Show less

Author: ChaiChristina
Title: excellent Malaysian Food
Review: The best rendang I have had, the assam pedas, the Malaysian desserts were also very good. I will definitely visit the Gulai House again when I return to the Datai.

Author: SyahirSenju CShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Superb Food Superb Service
Review: Me and my wife stay in Casa Del Mar and we decide to dine for dinner at The Gulai House after so many attempt we cant dine coz of pandemic. We start at the beach club having coffee and just to wait 7pm for gulai house to ready. At Gulai House we choose Kerapu Masak Lemk Cili Berapi and Kangkong Belacan and Udang lilit with soft shell crab. We was attended by Mr Rizal as head of team there. The service very warm and welcoming we are served with keropok and kerepek before dinner.The food so delicious and the standard so high with the impecible service from the team make our dinner so worth it. Thanks Mr Rizal for the special lauk treat for us we definitely come again to enjoy the food at Gulai HouseShow less

Author: sara14
Title: Nice mix of Malay and Indian
Review: Nice options of both Malay and Indian food-vegetarian food could do with a bit more effort. Lovely sago melaka dessert.

Author: JC C
Title: Excellent Indian food
Review: We opted to have the Indian cuisine and it was simply delicious.  The tandoori chicken was tender and juicy.

Author: Z5540RIwendyw
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: We are staying at The Danna Hotel and heard good things about The Gulai House so decided to take a taxi up into the hills and check it out. What an amazing experience from the moment we arrived. The food was some of the best, if not the best we have eaten on this trip. The service was impeccable. Well worth a visit, highly recommended.Show less

Author: juneduffy432
Title: Malay cuisine.
Review: Good to try the mix of Asian and Indian cuisine. Only open in the evening and an excellent change from more Mediterranean dishes.

Author: colinpennyfu2
Title: The real deal
Review: A superb restaurant in the rain forest at the amazing Datai Hotel. Excellent authentic Malaysian and Indian food. The food is superb and well presented and served by the excellent service team, who are very friendly and felpful.

Author: VancityAussieVancouver, Canada
Title: Amazing food and great service
Review: Staying at The Andaman Hotel we decided to walk up the beach and treat ourselves after hearing so many recommendations.It was great decision. The stunning jungle views and friendly service set the scene for an epic spice experience.Tasty Malaysian cuisine with a massive wine list and decent prices. Couldn’t fault this place at all.The complimentary buggy ride to / from the beach was a great ride also.Show less

Author: rivelynxo
Title: Fabulous Malaysian Cuisine
Review: Magnificent food and surroundings. Staff are very attentive and make you feel special from the moment you are shown to your table.

Author: NixpeiMelbourne, Australia
Title: This restaurant is a must!!!
Review: This restaurant is a must for anyone visiting Langkawi. Delicious, authentic food, exotic & romantic setting, exceptional wine list & great service. Be mindful that it can be a bit of a trek if you are not staying at the Datai & security is tight, so ensure you have your transportation sorted prior to arrival. The concierge at the Datai were exceptionally helpful. But overall well worth the effort! Show less

Author: colinpennyfu2
Title: Just Superb
Review: A lovely authentic restaurant in the rain forest, which provided a good menu of superb Malay and Indian  food. The staff were friendly and very efficient.

Author: Zaafer25London, United Kingdom
Title: Mango & sticky fried rice to die for
Review: We are staying at The Andaman hotel. We wanted to go to The Pavilion but it was fully booked for my birthday celebration. My wife suggested to go to The Gulai House. It was located deep in jungle & the scenery was beautiful.They do Malaysian & Indian cuisine. The chicken and beef satay was very nice. The size off the portion was big. I enquired if they had the mango and sticky rice for dessert but unfortunately they didn’t. But what impressed me the most was the service I received from Suhaimi. He went above & beyond his duty, he informed me that he will see if we could go to the Pavilion for dessert. Unfortunately they were fully booked. But he informed me that he got The Pavilion to send out two mango and sticky to the Gulai house. He made my birthday that much more enjoyable. He his credit to his team & should be rewarded hugely.Show less

Author: Mrs_alam28London, United Kingdom
Title: Customer service was on point!!!!
Review: We went to The Gulai house to celebrate my husbands birthday and we were blown away by one staff member, his name is Suhaimi. He went above and beyond. We are staying at the Andaman and wanted to go to The Pavilion as they had mango and sticky rice but they were fully booked so we came to The Gulai house. We didn’t get to check the menu as it was booked last min. At the restaurant my husband enquired if mango and sticky rice was on the menu but it wasn’t. This is were Suhaimi went above and beyond, he informed us that he would try and see if we could go to the pavilion for desserts after our mea and will let us know. After our meal he came to tell us unfortunately the pavilion was fully booked and we weren’t able to go, so we said don’t worry it. Suhaimi then goes ‘but what I did was to get them to send two mango and sticky rice for you both. Now that is amazing in my eyes! He is a legend! Not only that but he was friendly and approachable. Show less

Author: Lyndu1
Title: Fantastic chefs and service
Review:
Great resturant, excellent service, highly recommend the Beef redang, but the Chefs own fish curry was best thing ever !
Love the personal touch with the hand written leaves left on your table with your reservation details

Author: KuffyStaveley, United Kingdom
Title: Kampung Creativity!
Review: Following the hotel’s recent renovations, the Gulai House has not lost any of its charm. The traditional kampung style building creates an authentic atmosphere for stunning Malaysian cuisine. The food is simply delicious and so beautifully presented. There is plenty of choice to suit every taste. Staff are helpful and knowledgeable. As the jungle sings deep into the night - dish after dish sets your taste buds tingling with delight. Service is friendly and helpful. It is a most memorable experience and one you will want to repeat. Fabulous! Don’t forget to leave room for the awesome pandan ice-cream served in an ice bowl!Show less

Author: 757bennyb
Title: A beautiful restaurant
Review: Amazing authentic Malaysian food surrounded by the sounds of the forest. Food was delicious. The absolute professionalism of the staff tops off a wonderful dining experience.

Author: Rubi48
Title: Beautiful food and restaurant!
Review: Absolutely beautiful restaurant located in the Rainforest. Although the menu has changed, the food is still of high standard. From the starters to the deserts everything was delicious. I loved the chicken satay and red snapper dish. Beautiful flavours and presentation. Thank you to the staff for being so welcoming and attentive!Show less

Author: Zentrum16Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Lovely kampung (village ) house style decor! Quaint yet beautiful!
Review: Lovely place with options to sit on a chair or the traditional way, on the floor with mats and cushions. We opted for the latter. The place and people were warm and welcoming in old school manner. And the food authentically Asian but without being overly spicy. All the nuances of flavour coming through with every bite! Ate so much had to be practically rolled out of the place!Show less

Author: Alanis C
Title: Fantastic restaurant!
Review: They serve Fine Indian food with some local food selections as well. The journey to the restaurant is also another joyful ride. But do note that their portion is cater for 2-3 pax, and it is quite expensive!

Author: 49karenlSudbury, United Kingdom
Title: GLORIOUS GULAI HOUSE!
Review: The location of the Gulai House is magical - secreted within therainforest over the top of a small river full of frogs and their jungle song! This is another outstanding offering from The Datai.The menu is a combination of Malay and Indian cuisine allexecuted to an outstanding standard. The flavours very from very spicy to just mouthfully moreish! The biggest problem here is knowing what to select from the menu because you will surelyeat here more than once and it is just too easy to repeat the previous stunning meal...... do not keep trying new items ALL OF THEM are just outstanding.Show less

Author: Dxc100Singapore, Singapore
Title: Gems at the corner of Datai Beach!
Review: We are staying at Andaman and was looking for great local cuisine.Found this gems via TripAdvisor, it was fully booked on that day. We managed to book the restaurant two nights later!When we reached the hotel lobby, the hotel staff need to arrange buggy to bring us to another hidden place, the restaurant was built within the rainforest!The ambiance of the restaurant is just next to the nature, you can hear the insects and animals “singing” in the night! We ordered the famous food such as beef rendang, curry, naan. Their food is fine and top of the class!We finished it with the ice cream in an ice bowl for the kids!!Recommended for ppl who loves refine local food!Show less

Author: anjansnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Sumptuous Fine Dining Experience
Review: Gulai House is located in a serene resort - Datai Langkawi. Transportation is by the resort buggy. The cuisine is a nice mix of Malay, Western and Indian flavours. The service is great, and the staff work to ensure that our needs (few vegetarians) were well catered for. Almost all the dishes we ordered had unique flavours, including a cumin turmeric margharita! Recommended for those seeking a leisurely fine dining experience. Show less

Author: swetabhpMumbai, India
Title: Most unindian food ever
Review: Well hospitality and courtesy was upto the mark but the food was not Indian at all. We ordered quite a few recipes including palak planner, dal (lentils) and chicken.. Not a single dish was up to the mark.. Paneer was stale, chicken was chewy and dal was thick as thick as mud.. No spices.. It was hopeless. Though the servers were very kind and courteous.Show less

Author: TheYumL
Title: Stunning
Review: One of the most beautiful settings you can imagine in the middle of the rainforest. Serves local cuisine with a good wine menu and friendly service.

Author: AlanM262London, United Kingdom
Title: Best Indian Food
Review: Have recently stayed at the Datai and had my best ever Indian Meal. Crab salad to start with followed by tandoori lamb chops and tandoori king prawns , lentil dhal with garlic naam and wow it was absolutely amazing. Fabulous setting and service completes the evening- highly recommended Show less

Author: barbarajilloCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Great experience, excellent food .
Review: While staying at The Datai I tried all the restaurants on the property and it’s difficult to pick a favourite because they were all excellent but had separate personalities. This is more Indian with some local Malay influences. The main courses are served with pilau rice which is so good I could just eat it on its own.The fish was well prepared and delicate , it’s a good choice if you’re nervous of generously spiced food . It would be good if the desert menu included some plain individual sorbets to clean the palate. There are accompanying forest sounds as the sides of the property are open , a particularly noisy but endearing river frog made his presence know aurally .Show less

Author: Tangobabe1Haarlem, The Netherlands
Title: Very charming location and sweet staff.
Review: We loved the froggy ambiance here. Explanation: this stilted restaurant is surrounded by frogs, in a way, which creates an ongoing concert of frog-sounds. Some are very loud and almost sound like barking dogs! Maybe this doesn't sound nice, but we liked it. It had a certain charm. We made a reservation and were thus welcomed with a hand-written welcome. Written on a big brown leaf. I love personal details like that. The food was good, but not great.Show less

Author: rothwell40Jalon, Spain
Title: Special buffet
Review: We were lucky enough to attend the Malaysian/Indian buffet which is held every Tuesday evening at The Gulai House. The quality of the dishes served , particularly the tempura prawns & the grilled prawns. The roast duck , roast chicken & the curries including the lamb Rogan Josh were all delicious- in fact we enjoyed everything we ate. The wine list is wonderful & the service exceptional. Show less

Author: iELM
Title: Malaysian food
Review: Try the catch of the day and the crab meat salad. Nothing less than a through delight. Hope to be back soon.

Author: Antony2611
Title: Liked this one best.
Review: We dined here four times during our visit and it was our favorite. Great Malaysian and Indian food. The Tandoori Lamb chops were magnificent. A wide selection of dishes with very knowledgeable staff.

Author: JOValtonenHelsinki, Finland
Title: Malaysian dinner
Review: The Datai was under soft-opening after renovations. We were able to get a table although we were not hotel quests but stayed in the same beach, in the Andaman. Consierge was kind to advise us not to walk there as there might be activity from local wild life. Car transfer was easily arranged from both places. The food was really good and tasty. The place was in the middle of jungle and had a certain charm (and few bugs flying around). Service was very friendly and professional, but still you had feeling that that something was missing. Maybe we had a little too high expectations.Show less

Author: Ralf H
Title: Rainforest magic
Review: While the atmosphere is magic and service is fantastic, some of the dishes there lack refinement and will hopefully be improved over time. And please get Butter Chicken back onto the menu!

Author: Natasha K
Title: Stunning food in the rainforest
Review: We loved every mouthful at The Gulai House. It was so much fun to sit open air in the rainforest canopy listening to the night sounds. Gorgeous setting and decliious food.

Author: KuffyStaveley, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic Food with Stunning Malay Hospitality
Review: The Gulai House is a very special place. The location make it feel like a secret surprise in the heart of the rainforest and in true Malay kampung style.The rustic surroundings create a fabulous atmosphere and the food is made with fresh local ingredients. Malay cuisine has its on distinct style and heritage but also draws on other influences. The Gulai House menu will have familiar favourites such as beef rendang but the flavours are on another level - simply awesome! We ate far too much but couldn’t stop ourselves as each mouthful was just wonderful.The service was outstanding. Staff have an excellent knowledge of the menu to help you choose. They were helpful and friendly. Traditional food with excellent ingredients and modern influences, wonderful service and an amazing setting. It was always going to be a fabulous night out. The Datai is outstanding and consistent in ensuring that its restaurants always deliver the highest quality. We will definitely be going back.Show less

Author: gilly690
Title: Great food.
Review: Great food, very attentive staff, a nice selection on the menu and great wine list.  A very enjoyable experience.

Author: FrancisDDJosephNew York City, New York
Title: Shame they moved it
Review: Looks the same. But walking up to it on a tarmac road is not the same as strolling across the beach and cutting through the jungle as you used to. But the food is good and the service is charming enough. Just not as memorable now as it was before.Show less

Author: M_2027Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very tasty food!
Review: The place has good variety, tasty yet not oily food and a very good ambience. I was staying at the nearby Andaman Resort Abd the place was easy to reach; Datai (the hotel in which this restaurant is located) is otherwise slightly far away from the island center but surely worth a trip to plan! The preparation for crepe souzette was eye catching.Show less

Author: masmahomed
Title: Excellent food
Review: Family friendly with very helpful staff. Stunning setting. The most delicious food, you can choose your seafood and spices and the chef(excellent) cooks it. We ate here twice and both times were faultless, fantastic!

Author: MegzTravelPenang, Malaysia
Title: Did not live up to its reputation
Review: The Gulai House Restaurant is linked to the Datai Hotel in Langkawi. It specializes in Malaysian and Indian cuisine. It is approximately 45mins drive from the Cenang Beach area and is located in the middle of the rain forest. You definitely need a car to get there and also have to be prepared to drive through a winding hilly dark road. It's most suitable for people who are living at the Datai Hotel and are picked up and dropped off by the hotel buggy. The restaurant is beautiful with a rustic ambience and the service is very good but not exceptional.The food is very expensive and below average. The presentation of the food is a big part of the culinary experience especially in an expensive fancy restaurant and they completely failed on that. The vegetable wok was a combination of different crunchy vegetables with little sauce and no flavour. The garlic naan was crispy with no garlic flavour and was hard to chew. The fish in curry sauce was insipid with a very strong flavour of coconut milk. The only good dishes were the grilled meat platter and the prawn in coconut curry. To top it all we ordered their signature dessert called Crepe Suzette which was a complete let down. The preparation was interested and the F&B Director Ms. Noorani has tried to give it an Asian touch by using ingredients like lemongrass, cinnamon and star anise. However, the Grand Marnier and Liquer completely overpowered any other flavours. When it was presented it looked like 4 pieces of squished crepes floating in some brown sauce so once again the presentation wasn't appealing and so was the taste. Our bill was RM650 for 4 items, 1 dessert and 2 non alcoholic beverages. Even if I paid half that price I wouldn't recommend this place for the culinary experience. Show less

Author: 580andym
Title: Strangely bland tasting food...
Review: Great location, great staff, but the food just didn't stand out as that good. It was acceptable and we enjoyed it, just wasn't as tasty as we expected.

Author: TheWanderist
Title: Memorable Experience
Review: Good food, most accommodating and professional staff. The head chef and the Hospitality Manager went out of their way to cater to our needs. A big thanks.

Author: MaggieP72Yokohama, Japan
Title: best lamb chops ever
Review: what a lovely setting and what a greeting, hands washed by the waitress when we sat down in true malaysian style, a welcome leaf for us at the table with our names on and lovely orchids on the table. probably the most tender and delicious lamb chops we have ever hadShow less

Author: september1stMelbourne, Australia
Title: Unique unforgettable pseudo-wild dining in the jungle
Review: We stayed at The Datai five years ago and returned again this year. One place we could not forget from our last stay is The Gulai House, an open air on stilts restaurant in the jungle. On each visit (driven on golf buggies down the lit lanes with towering greenery on both sides of the road) one arrives at their table to find a special personalised note written awaiting you at the table.The cuisine is predominantly Malay and Indian. The menu shows the varying levels of heat and you can opt to add more if you wish. Also be warned- the servings are very generous so make sure you arrive with an appetite.We have been twice to this restaurant on this visit. The sampler of starters is great though the standout is the pakoras- delicious deep fried grated vegetable numbers that would make a satisfying meal in themselves. Thanks Adam for the tip on how to cook these to perfection! The beef rending is unsurprisingly popular - its delicious- so very tender the meat falls apart effortlessly. Recommended.The kapitan chicken curry takes its name from Portuguese colonisation. Delicious and creamy. The absolute standout is the lamb rack tandoori. If it is one dish you order, can we suggest that this is it.Don't forget the biryani rice- this is so good. Adam helpfully suggested a half serve- we would not have ordered this otherwise.We ordered a bottle of rose and awaited a motorbike and staff member from the Datai to deliver said bottle..reminding us of just how extraordinary the setting is- perhaps several kilometres from The Datai lobby.Little geckos run up the posts, the giant gecko or tokay does not stop with its unforgettable call. You might even sense some wild boar nearby though we've been told that the monkeys congregate closer to guest quarters. I can't help looking everywhere for a snake - I'm determined to see one before we leave.So while we didn't see a snake we did see more of the truly remarkable service that makes The Datai and its restaurants so remarkable. It is extraordinary and something you won't forget.Big thanks to Sharif on first evening and the amusing Adam on our second. So attentiveThe Gulai House is a unique dining experience in the jungle. The Datai will close in September for ten months - we suggest you put that on your future holiday itinerary along with dinner at The Gulai.Show less

Author: Adrian PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: What a wonderful setting a pity it closes in a month
Review: Well I've never had the opportunity to eat here but wow the service was impecable the food was great. The Otak Otak was just devine. The down side is the Datai closes next month for a refit for one year. Still I was lucky. Thanks for a great dinner. Show less

Author: Michael C
Title: Limited menu and seafood could be fresher
Review: We had great expectations for the Gulai House as it has its own exclusive facility near the beach.  However we found the menu limited, and the "catch-of-the-day" not as fresh.  The cooking is great, and service ok, but freshness of ingredients must be improved.

Author: bakutaeSingapore, Singapore
Title: First Time in Gulai House
Review: We stayed in Datai Bay for 3 days, and had the chance to eat at Gulai House. The Rendang is so soft, the Satay was so yummy. The waiter recommended the Soft Shell Crap which is heavenly. The dessert is interesting, Pandan Banana with ice cream....We sat outside which surprisingly don't have mosquito. The crowd came in after 7.30 pm....which by then we were almost done with our very satisfied dinner.I will definitely recommend Gulai House to friends who are staying in DataiShow less

Author: Myv55
Title: Beautiful setting
Review: Delicious Malaysian food in a truely stunning setting. We just walked in off our boat & they were happy to accommodate us. Expensive but worth it.

Author: kenzissticSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Indian and Malayan food house within a rainforest
Review: The Gulai house make use of their environment and their culture to provide an inclusive dining experience. Guests were greeted by the staffs, brought to the allocated dining table and you will find leaf of a palm size inscription with greeting message, that's pretty heartwarming. One of the waiters already waiting eagerly help you wash your hands from the water in a gourd shape vessel (a ritual before dining). You can feel that the restaurant and hotel is making great effort to elevate the dining experience, as it did. We had the crab salad and the "highly recommended" tandoori lamb rack. Both were amazing. Sometimes the lamb has overpowering smell but the tandoori lamb rack was served right, the meat was tender and the charcoal grilled fragrant replaced the lamb odor. The Gulai house is a really great restaurant.Show less

Author: Flic222Loxton, Australia
Title: Outstanding service and food
Review: My partner and I visited this restaurant whilst staying in another resort. Don't let the low distance fool you, it took 30 minutes to travel 6.5km and 80R, however we weren't bothered by this on arrival. We were taken by cart to the restaurant, to then be given 5 star treatment on arrival. We were treated to traditional hand washing before our meal. The food was outstanding and presented beautifully. It's reasonably pricey, we paid 450 ringgit for two people for entree, main and drinks but it was money well spent. Definitely a must visit! Show less

Author: absolutevenues
Title: Outstanding Restaurant
Review: We were staying at the Datai and visted this Restaurant many time, is world class, totally outstanding, with great service, the menu is excellent.

Author: juliet lBuckinghamshire, UK
Title: Top class
Review: We are staying at a different hotel but decided to book a table going by a friends recommendation. We had a drink in the bar at the Datai first which has beautiful views through the forest to the sea.We were taken by electric buggy to the restaurant which was great fun and went right into the forest which is where the restaurant is situated. Service impeccable and so courteous and the food was outstanding. Slightly more expensive than other restaurants we have eaten in but still extremely good value compared to U.K. prices. If you are staying at another hotel best value is to get a taxi and they wait for you for a nominal charge the only other way back is to get the datai to use their car to take you back take you back but that was still reasonable 80R for a 25 minute journey (about £13) the taxi is 50R Lovely evening - highly recommended - menu is Malaysian and some beautiful fresh fish and seafood you can select yourself.Show less

Author: udschu2017
Title: Excellent food and service
Review:
A lot of selection of fresh fish, choosable by your own selection in front of the kitchen.
Excellent service arround there.

Author: macneillfamilyLavenham, United Kingdom
Title: Malaysian restaurant at the Datai hotel set amongst the rainforest
Review: We dined at this restaurant twice, while staying at the Andaman hotel, which is a short 10 min walk away. When you arrive at the beach bar at the Datai they will arrange a buggy to talk you to the gulai. Service and food was excellent, and portions generous. Minor point if you like it spicy, ask for very spicy , as the spicy dished I ate were not spicy enough for me. Extensive menu with comprehensive drinks/wine menu, the handmade naan bread was superb, and all the curries very tasty. Crab salad starter also excellent. As we ate our food we could hear a wild boar snuffling for food in the undergrowth. Restaurant is atmospheric, and service impeccable.Show less

Author: Raymond M
Title: Excellent local food.
Review: Only opens for dinner. Must make reservations. Need to go there by buggy ride. Very authentic fare. Malay and Indian food

Author: Francisco DLondon, England, United Kingdom
Title: Typical Indiana and Malay cuisine
Review: One of the best food ever eaten in Malaysia, perfect set up and incredible service. Ever time we went to eat at The Gulai we eat some food as it was delicious ( onion soup, oxtail soup, deep fried fish and tandory meat, also coconut ice cream, fresh garlic naan bread) Show less

Author: Gkrieger
Title: Tremendous restaurant
Review: Outstanding Malay and Indian cuisine. We ate there THREE times and always superb. the chef paid a specific visit to our table and gave us a special desert creation that is part of their ongoing national competition-- they are in the finals and this is no surprise!Show less

Author: tony bMalmesbury, United Kingdom
Title: The flooring must be changed
Review: I have never felt so uncomfortable in a restaurant, the floor noisily vibrated as the waiters walked around and our table was roughly in the centre so it was difficult to relax with the noise and movement of the floor, luckily we were able to move to a table on the edge of the room but still felt the vibrations as we were eating. The service was superb but the food was very disappointing.Show less

Author: Mary B
Title: Eating in the rainforest
Review: Wonderful setting helpful and informative staff and great Asian food with plenty of choices. you can order the hotness of the curries.

Author: mishkabell
Title: Best Malaysian food in the 5 years we've lived in Malaysia!
Review: The food was seriously amazing .. the flavours of each dish were very distinct but not too over the top.

Author: sarah075Somerset, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Indian Cuisine!
Review: We choose to dine here twice as currently staying at The Anderman, next Door to the Datai Hotel. The Anderman will take you by car to the Datai for 20 ringgit and the Datai bring you back for free!The restaurant is a short buggy ride from the Datai and it feels like you are eating in the middle of the jungle. The setting is lovely and the service outstanding. The staff remembered us from our first visit and are very hospitable.The food is definitely the best Indian cuisine we have ever had. The menu is creative and they will adjust the spice level to suit. You can also choose your own fish , from the counter, and sauce if you wish to do so. The presentation is beautiful.You definitely need to make a reservation as they ensure they put their own guests first, before accommodating outside customers. You cannot criticise them for this!If you are staying at The Anderman, i strongly recommend that you email the Datai yourself. We were told by our hotel that our reservation did not exist at the Gulai, after they offered to phone them on our behalf and confirm our reservation. However, when I emailed the Datai they confirmed our reservation straight away! Not sure who is at fault there.Our meal for three with three courses and a bottle of wine came to 950 ringgit.. which whilst not cheap was definitely worth it!!Show less

Author: Abby124
Title: Very slow service and the food was average
Review: The restaurant wasn't busy but the waiters didn't seem to be alert and we had to keep catching their attention. The food was average and clearly overpriced as there is no restaurant outside the hotel.

Author: minnieinrichmondRichmond, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding
Review: This restaurant is superb in every way from the service to the ambience and food . The quality of the food is outstanding and the produce fantastic! Highly recommended and reservations a must ! It's situated within the grounds of The Datai and reaching there is by buggy from the lobby area only! A must in Langkwai. We had 2 alcoholic drinks, 4 soft drinks , 2 mains, 3 sides and a children's meal and it came to £101. Show less

Author: lanvinq
Title: Warmth welcome with great ambience
Review: From the warm welcome to the unique greetings written on the leave and handwashing ritual, the start of this culinary journey was great! Though the food may be rather expensive, this is a full package once in a lifetime experience for me and my family.

Author: Andrew L
Title: Great curry
Review: First class Malay and Indian curries. Excellent service, and the cookery class under the tutilage of the chef is well worth it! Big portions too!

Author: RENERONO
Title: NICE LOCAL FANTASTIC FOOD.
Review: you should visit this restaurant for fantastic local Malay cuisine, nice and typical decor and building .

Author: britta s
Title: Superb setting, food and service
Review: Extremely special in all ways. The incredible traditional architecture opens out onto the jungle. The food is so fresh and expertly prepared. Friendly and helpful servers. Would recommend to everyone - a great introduction to Malaysian classics and gorgeous seafood to boot. Reservation necessary.

Author: petlai
Title: Luxury Authentic Malay & Indian Cuisine
Review: A must visit if you have the time to make a trip to the Gulai House. Make reservations in advance. The food is prepared with a lot of care and attention to the needs of the guests. Perfect treat for your loved one!

Author: Bachas01
Title: Excellent Malay cuisine
Review: As part of The Datai Langkawi resort this is a dining option. Great local cuisine. Excellent beef rending.

Author: KebabloverSouthport, United Kingdom
Title: A Destination Restaurant
Review: Gulai House isn't your typical hotel restaurant. It is a stand alone destination gastro Mecca. A perfect fusion of Malaysian and Indian cuisine. The setting is stunning. The atmosphere relaxed, friendly and welcoming. The food............Oh yes! My wife and I dined on two occasions and had room service on a third. If you want the real deal (authentic), order it spicy. The staff will love you for it. Get involved and go and tell the chefs yourself. They appreciate people that have a love for food. Every dish we sampled was perfection. Whatever you order, grab a roti with daal to accompany your food. A special mention goes out to Edy who was the ultimate host and server.Show less

Author: colinpennyfu2
Title: An Excellent Restaurant
Review: Superb setting,Friendly and very efficient staff, The Malaysian and Indian food is just superb. The home made coconut Ice cream served in an ice bowl is a must dessert.

Author: EmajkWaltham Abbey, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional
Review: I must start by saying myself and my husband stayed at the Andaman which is next door to The Datai beach where you will find The Gulai house is located. We did contact the restaurant directly to reserve a table but on 2 attempts we was emailed by the restaurant that it was full but luckily we managed to get a table when booked through our own concierge so please don't give up if trying to visit The Gulai house. I must this is one of the best ever dining experiences I've ever had and this was my husbands & I favourite restaurant the whole 15 days we was dining. From the moment we arrived we was made so welcomed by the staff. The setting is beautiful,when seated they shortly wash your hands which was a lovely different experience. There are a nice selection of starters and main courses and from experience we recommend the soft shell crab and the Tikka mix grill. The second time we visited The Gulai House remembered us ( over a week later ) and reserved our same table we had the week before along with remembering our names, drink orders and our menu choices! Our 2nd visit I believe it was the manager who was served us again was so lovely and he helped recommend my husband the Tiger prawns from the fresh fish counter and would make a curry for him as my husband loves very hot food.. he said it was one the best curries he's ever eaten. Thank you so much The Gulai House you was the best :) Emma & James Show less

Author: R7747DFjens
Title: Great food - great staff
Review: Excellent selection of original recipes and food. Very serviced orientated staff, which engages with you to understand your preferences without being servile

Author: Cindylc
Title: Can't fault it
Review:
Another amazing dining experience at the Datai.
Picked up from our villa.
Seated overlooking the gardens.
Fabulous Malaysian food with a bottle of red.
Our unfinished bottle was delivered to our room for us to enjoy overlooking the rainforest. 
Wonderful service.

Author: Jane P
Title: Amazing setting and beautiful food.
Review: Be prepared for western prices at this beautiful restaurant.   It is worth going for the terrific service and the absolutely stunning setting.

Author: hanspilotOtaru, Japan
Title: HORRIBLE TASTE
Review: Travelled 1 hour to get to DATAI.Ordered the BEEF rendang,BRIYANI,DHAL,mix veggie,NAAN,pakora...The ambience is great.the greetings were good.staffs were excellent.l really liked it,nevermind the EXPENSIVE price list.However the food doesn't taste like anything at all...TASTELESS BRIYANI with black pepper in it!BLAND Rendang with NO SPICE at ALL.DHAL??u can't call it DHAL...it's just some gravy with NO TASTE!!!!DATAI have to FIRE the chef who cooked such an awful FOOD.Maybe they hired kids to become their chefs...Anytime SYEDS Briyani is better...the name is JUST A HYPE...doesn't live up to the expectation!!!Main issue: FOOD IS NOT TASTY!!!U can't call this a Malay or Indian restaurant!Show less

Author: mrs0liver
Title: Really inspiring menu
Review: A real super experience - the traditional Malysian hut house is an experience. The menu is one of those where you just mull and mull as there are so many items that tempts...

Author: katel0uis3Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Dining Experience
Review: The service was exceptional, after being seated we had our hands washed, water poured over them from a wooden flute and a flannel to dry. The waiter was very friendly, telling us the wonderful stories that lie with the island. The food was divine. We shared a starter which was plenty and my partner had the recommended beef curry which was very tasty indeed. However, what really made this restaurant so special was the ambiance. The constant jungle sounds that surrounded you as you ate. If you are staying at The Andaman like we were I would recommend making the short trip to this outstanding restaurant.Show less

Author: Rory A
Title: Amazing
Review: Just amazing, great setting, great food, great service, expensive but still good value for the quality, no more words needed to describe.

Author: SydneyPaulSydney, Australia
Title: A great introduction to Malay cuisine
Review: We dined here on our first night at The Datai not realising that Chef Wan, Malaysia's quite-famous celebrity chef was cooking that night. It proved to be a first class night. Chef Wan took time to walk us through the buffet and explained each of the dishes. He came over to our table several times during the evening to ask how we were going and answer questions about Malay food. Not only was the food delicious, but thanks to Chef Wan we left with a considerably improved appreciation of Malay cooking and the subtle arts involved.Show less

Author: internetmudah
Title: Very nice place for a secluded dinner!
Review: The food was delicious and service was above-average for my experience with luxury resorts in Malaysia! The jungle-based theme of the restaurant fits in very well with the exterior atmosphere (duh) and is a promising location for a great dinner!

Author: OTT12London
Title: Excellent food in a fantastic location
Review: We visited the Gulai during our stay at The Datai hotel in Langkawi.The location is really fantastic within the rainforest surrounding the area and far away enough from the main hotel area to make it feel special.The food is a clever combination of Malay and Indian dishes and exquisitely cooked and presented. The tandoori and curry dishes are exceptional and a must have.The staff are friendly and attentive and able and willing to help and explain the various dishes. The actual venue is built in local style and blends nicely with the rainforest.Not cheap by local standards but well worth a visit.Show less

Author: GinaloveShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: great dinner experience at the gulai house
Review: lovely restaurant with good food. if you are looking to try authentic malaysian food like rendang or masak lemak, then this is a good restaurant to go to. the gulai house serves a combination of malaysian and indian cuisine. prices are on the mid-upper side but well worth it for the whole experience. they also have kids menu which serves western food should you worry that your kids may not eat local food. just so you know... the journey to the restaurant is an experience by itself. basically you would need to park at the lobby, and they will valet it off for you based on foc basis and from there they will ferry you to the restaurant which is located in the jungle by buggy. what a great joyride for my little one! if you are staying at the andaman, you can simply sign it back to your room. super convenient.Show less

Author: HonestTruth88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Do not miss this !!
Review: My family & I , a group of eggless vegatarians and non-vegetarian had the privilege of dining at the Gulai House thrice during our last vacation. It was truly amazing each time !! When you see the menu , the items on the menu may sound simple but you'll realise the complex deliciousness of the spices and the dish with each mouthful . The Chefs at Gulai House are very flexible and made us some truly top notch tasting local dishes in the vegetarian version. The final night's dining experience will stay with us for a very very long time as the Chefs went all out to give us something amazingly special. Our heartfelt thanks to Chef Hadi , Chef Azmi , Chef Hari ,Subra, Azhari, Rokshit and the entire team. Thank you so much for making all our dining experiences truly memorable and special .Please do include the vegetarian curry ,sambal tauhu and sayur manis masak lemak in your new menu ..... we loved it so much !! The seafood masak lemak , and the Ketayap desert were amazing as well. Loved each item we had !! Thank you :)Show less

Author: Jane LEverett
Title: Impecable service and great food
Review: Moment you enter the restaurant, the level of service and the attention to details by every server is unbelievable. Food is wonderful and we should have returned the next night but because we were staying at the Andaman, we wanted to dine where we could see the sunset. A definite must dine at while in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Ani612London, United Kingdom
Title: Seriously good!
Review: Stayed at the Datai for our honeymoon, can confidently say this was one of the highlights of our honeymoon.Lamb chops were succulent with a mouth watering marinade, crunchy pakoras and a creamy butter chicken-all accompanied by a wonderful and attentive service. Even if you aren't staying at the Datai I'd recommend you take a night out and visit. Show less

Author: 121carleed
Title: Loved it!
Review: The food and service here was amazing! We order way too much but ate it all because it was delicious!

Author: dietrichate
Title: Beautiful food
Review: I can't recommend this place highly enough, it was excellent from start to finish, and everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meals

Author: MichelleBurge
Title: Beautiful traditional cuisine with excellent service
Review: Beautiful restaurant right in the middle of the rainforest. Fantastic service and an authentic appearance to the restaurant. The beef rendang was particularly good along with the chicken coconut curry. I would definitely return to this restaurant.

Author: Marc L
Title: Excellent Malay and Indian
Review: Beautiful traditional Malay restaurant. Warm welcome, excellent wine list for a resort, but the food is the star of the show. I have eaten at this restaurant a couple of times. The service relaxed and professional.

Author: Pat1970512Teufen, Switzerland
Title: Excellent and authentic!
Review: Very cool beautiful location in the jungle near the datai hotel. Very nice atmosphere and the food was delicious.My favorites are the Kapitan and the beef Rendang Taging ( I love it ) the Tenderloin beef was very soft and the taste very delicious!I go there for many years - still very good!Show less

Author: FaisalS1970
Title: Don't come in a big group expecting normal service
Review: We stayed at The Datai and came in a big group (12 of us). The kitchen just could not handle it - they were really slow with their food preparation. Kids became restless and some slept before food came to the table.I guess if anyone intends to come in a big group, tell them up front.Show less

Author: njjrhodes
Title: Beautiful Food and Excellent Service
Review: Was my wifes birthday and they went all out to make her feel special. The food was delicious and well presented.

Author: sarahmM9152YD
Title: One of the best!
Review: We stayed in the Datai and made a reservation here one night and we are so glad we did! Everything about this restaurant is special. The drinks flowed easily, the food was out of this world and the staff were exceptional I couldn't fault at all and hope one day to return. Thank you to the team for such a special night! Show less

Author: Nazrahrahman
Title: Sedap...
Review: The delicious food and great service make it worth every dollar spent. Must have the briyani with mutton masala.

Author: Tamoor
Title: Good food with slow service
Review: We had dinner at the Gulai house on our last evening in Langkawi as a special treat. If you are not staying at the Detai it is a little bit of a trek but worth the food and the experience of being in the rainforest.The food was expensive but tasty. We tried the Chicken/beef satay, Seafood curry, prawn and chicken mince balls and all were well cooked and tasted great. We found the service was a bit slow given the resturant was not overly busy and our drinks didn't arrive until we finished our starters. They said they had to drive them over from the main hotel which is strange for a restaurant.also we asked the hotel to book us a taxi back to the Danna where we were staying and they told us it would cost us 80 MYR which is the cost of a taxi ride for 70 to 80km whereas this was a 10km ride maximum. its also the cost of a single flight from KL to Langkawi. we had no choice and had to take it but it did put a downer on our experience.Show less

Author: Fathima M
Title: Exotic!
Review: Awwww what a dining experience perched on the hillside of the Datai Bay! Fabulous food, excellent service and very very exotic!

Author: Andrew S
Title: Malaysian at its finest
Review: We enjoyed a delicious meal of high-quality Malaysian food in a traditional environment set amongst the rainforest. The food was exceptional in quality, taste and variety. The staff were attentive and great with our two kids, keeping them entertained and comfortable. An absolute delight to have dinner here.Show less

Author: jamiep84Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great service and good food in a lovely setting
Review: Stayed next door at the Andaman and came here one evening, it's a short walk down the beach to the Datai, then five minutes inland to the restaurant. Staff were very friendly, waiter was helpful and the food was good - we asked for it spicy and it was tasty but not too hot which was great. Most of it was really good, however a couple of the mains were a bit tasteless, for example one of our prawn curries just wasn't that exciting. The beef rendang was good though! The food was expensive for Malaysia, but the restaurant is very high end - we also liked the Indian influence on the menu which made a pleasant change.Show less

Author: Kieran11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: THE BEST !
Review: This place is fantastic - rustic setting within the forest with just the most delicious local food I have ever eaten. The nan was the best I have ever had (and I have had a lot) the satay is simply in a whole world of its own .We stayed at the datai for 4 night sand had dinner here for three of themThe service is excellent as well The whole team should be proud of the excellent experience they have created for guestsShow less

Author: trp203
Title: Amazing beef rendang
Review: Our favourite restaurant at the Datai. Good service, food and location. Probably better value available elsewhere on the island.

Author: Linxhooper
Title: Malay and Indian mix of flavors
Review: We wanted authentic Malaysian food and got that in abundance. The fish dishes were delicious with several choices from the catch of the day.

Author: AMMM_44
Title: Wonderfull!
Review: Excellent service. A little bit slow but was compensate afterwards by Manager. Nice food, sympathy and relax environment! congrats!

Author: wayneh629
Title: Romantic Dinner
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed the food and overwhelmed by the excellent service. The atmosphere and location are incredible in the forest - a very natural setting with the sounds of the animals in the background.

Author: Andy C
Title: Still dreaming of the satay
Review: Incredible food. We've eaten in many high end restaurants around the world and our experience here would happily sit alongside any of them. We shared starters, with the satay in particular being a highlight (beef and chicken), and although tempted by the fresh fish on offer, opted for a magnificent mixed grill for mains.Waiting staff were also extremely efficient, courteous and friendly. All in all, a wonderful evening!Show less

Author: Margaret CWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Evening meal
Review: We were staying at the Datai and visited the Giulai one night, the setting is in the middle of rainforest, the food was lovely very tasty, service was excellent we were served by Rizki, very attentive and lovely to talk to. We will definetly be returning we have booked the Datai for next year!! Show less

Author: Casadeflores
Title: Yummy!
Review: Ate here twice during our stay, delicious on both occasions and service excellent as is the norm at the Datai

Author: DGYSYNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: First class fresh curries
Review: This is our second trip to The Datai and the Gulai HouseIt is beautifully set in this magical tropical rainforest and amongst the grounds of this stunning hotel in a large tree house style The manager greeted us warmly and showed me his fresh fish counter where all the fish looked fabulous I chose the special fish of the day in a medium spice local curry my wife had beef RendangThe beer and wine were good thirst quenchers and the meal arrived with butter nan and rices The butter nan was the best I had ever tasted with succulent texture warm and crunchy in part The fish had been filleted and served in the old fish surrounds with vegetables and a beautiful sauce truly first class The beef Rendang was also very good and the whole meal was devoured with great enjoyment and super memoriesTo the manager the chef and the staff our grateful thanks for a tremendous meal Show less

Author: emma d
Title: What a beautiful Indian restaurant
Review: The food here was second to none, a fabulous choice and quantities of food were absolutely fantastic I loved everything about this restaurant. The ambiance was beautiful too

Author: DaveWombat
Title: Yum
Review: Outstanding service - even a personal message written on a big leaf from the forest was used to designate your name and table. Brilliant.

Author: Madeline L
Title: Delicious
Review: Really great Malay cuisine here. We had the beef rendang and the satay and it was divine. We really loved it. Gorgeous wine too!

Author: gazasal2014
Title: Great food and location
Review: We ate here on a couple of occasions and the food was fantastic. Authentic Malay/Indian with the emphasis on seafood. Great location in the middle of the rainforest. Great service as well.

Author: Josanne S
Title: My favourite
Review: My favourite restaurant,I did miss the fact they had removed the wonderful rogon josh from the menu,in fact most of the Indian dishes had gone but the Malay food was great,the best beef randang ,lovely staff always so welcoming and helpful.

Author: kaseysfPenang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Superb 5 star service
Review: My husband and I went to this fine dining Malay cuisine restaurant for my advanced birthday dinner. The ambience was cosy and refreshing as it is located in the middle of rainforest jungle. The service was tip-top as the server explained the menu and cooking method for fresh seafood in detail. After our meal, the server was attentive and offered us a buggy ride from the restaurant to the car parking lot even though we are not the hotel guests. Two thumb-ups from us.Show less

Author: AjdebatRottnest Island, Australia
Title: Could have been better for the location
Review: We stayed at the Datai Langkawi and though the Gulai House was pretty, service was excellent, location was phenomenal the cooking let it down on this occassion. We like Malay and Indian style cooking and felt that it really didn't meet up to the standard of the hotel. It should be 5 star. Show less

Author: chae84Sungai Buloh, Malaysia
Title: 5 Star service with great food
Review: Had dinner recently at Gulai House. Although I had problem entering the place because I am wearing sleeveless shirt when I first arrive after night nature walk. The staff politely explained on the protocol and request me to change the shirt – I didn’t know about the protocol. She call buggy to take me back to hotel for change and drive me back to Gulai House after that.We had Soft shell crab as starter, it was awesome!!! The portion a little bit small but it really taste good with homemade sauce. We ordered Daging Rendang, Udang Masak lemak ulam pegaga, Sayur Lemak lodeh and Nasi briyani for main dish. Daging Rendang was very soft and easy to chew - it is full of taste. truely malay dish i would said. I did comment to the manager for the udang masak lemak ulam pegaga should have a bit more spicy taste since he asked if there is any comment of feedback on the service and food. Nasi briyani full with raisin and nuts. Overall food presentation and taste is amazing especially rending daging.Show less

Author: redpuppetlady
Title: Sumptious Malaysian and Indian food
Review: Excellent service, amazing beef redang, decent wine list and yummy desert. Oh and there were silver boars hanging out in the entrance way to provide us with some amusing entertainment.

Author: Paul V
Title: Unique location , great setting in the jungle
Review: Booked one evening. Food was very good and loved the location and the little touches such as the personalised table welcome and hand washing, etc.

Author: A1460TValexcHong Kong, China
Title: Dining within an authentic Malay house setting
Review: Authentically crafted and set within an amazing rainforest of ancient trees, the setting is simple yet magical.The decor takes inspiration from the traditional Malay house on stilts with both outdoor and indoor dining amidst the glow of lantern lights.Service is attentive while the food is a mix of Malay and Indian specialities like rendang, tandoori, nan breads etc all deliciously made.Definitely a treat at The Datai resort within a jungle like setting.Show less

Author: Audzhe
Title: excellent service and delicious food
Review:
Loved loved loved The Gulai House, the food was divine and the staff was amazing! 
Definitely worth a visit!

Author: Ozzy38Beckenham, United Kingdom
Title: The food was lovely
Review: We dined here several times during our stay at the datai hotel. The menu offers a selection of traditional Malay and Indian food and I have to say both types of food were equally good. The service was good but not too intrusive and the setting was very romantic. Really can't fault it. Show less

Author: CHandGTHartfield, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely local flavours
Review: The food we had was superb and you can choose from a fresh fish counter and have the fish cooked in many local marinades. We ate here twice as part of our stay at The Datai and the only thing I might say is they seemed to be slightly under staffed. The main course crab was delicious. Show less

Author: Lolly VSalt Lake City, Utah
Title: Country Malay Decor
Review: Such a beautiful restaurant. Loved all of the antique Malaysian/Indonesian decor. Indoor or in air con. Fresh seafood prepared how you like or try one of the amazing curries. Presentation is amazing. French wine very affordable. Must park at the Datai and shuttle to restaurant, if you drive there. Make reservations. Show less

Author: yemi190London, United Kingdom
Title: Our Gulai Dinner Experience
Review: The food at the Gulai House is simply mouth watering. I love the buggy ride from the Datai Guest House to Gulai, listening to the rain forest sound at night is just something you want to relive often. Our dinner experience was complimented with the presence of one Malaysia renowned chefs, Dato Chef Wan. It was an unforgettable night the whole 10 of us that traveled; my family, my brother in-law and his family from Holland, his mother in-law also joined us from St Marteen, my niece from London.Show less

Author: AdcyeMalaysia
Title: upper end Malay & Indian fusion cuisine
Review: The environment, service is definitely is the main selling point for this high end restaurant. Their selection of Indian & Malay cuisine though not extensive is definitely not boring. Was blown away by the Beef rendang. Definitely the smoothest consistency and the best I have tasted, loved how they muted the spices into a thick rich silky rendang gravy.Show less

Author: Aline B
Title: Excellent
Review:
We were a bit cautious at first but the food is amazing .
New tastes for us but we planned after the first night there to come back two more times.

Author: moro2014
Title: Excellent Malaysian and Indian food.
Review: Excellent restaurant and service in a peaceful jungle setting. We enjoyed many meals here and the chef even shared one of the recipes with us.

Author: Asha3
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: Went to the restaurant as its part of our hotel. Beautiful settings, warm welcomes and lovely food. Slightly expensive but you get what you pay for and it was great.

Author: sunilmu
Title: Average, not very impressive
Review: We had dinner there, Indian food varieties are not much and the Dal Tadka which we got doesnt seem to be authentic. The ambience is good, however need a buggy to reach there and it is slightly overpriced.

Author: Azure55Monte-Carlo, Monaco
Title: Preferred the old version
Review: Previously this was a rather rustic Indian/Malay restaurant on the beach. Now it has been relocated (due to the beach villas which were added recently) into the forest. So romantic strolls on the beach to come and go are no more. The food is similar, but probably the least impressive of the Datai restaurants. Service is fine. But having to take a buggy to get to and from the restaurant is just not the same as it used to be.Show less

Author: Roger PManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Not what it was
Review: The Gulai House used to be jointly run by the Datai and Andaman Hotels, but it is now just part of the Datai. It has become very expensive, and although the surroundings are attractive to a first time visitor, they cannot trade on this for ever. More importantly, the laid-back friendliness of the staff has disappeared, and one gets the impression that they are just polite to guests "just because it is in the training manual". In the restaurant, there is a display of local seafood, but no-one took us over to see it and explain what dishes could be prepared with each type.Show less

Author: Alan S
Title: Great food in a traditional Malay setting
Review: Top quality food with a mix of Malay and Indian fusion food. Good selection of wines and attentive and friendly staff.

Author: MouriskaMacao, Portugal
Title: Dinner inside the florest
Review: The food and the service was super excellent!!! We ordered, one bottle of white wine (good quality), all the surprises began after... the dishes was tasty and delicious and the sauce was amazing too. For people who like desserts, must try the dessert of The Gulai House!!! We ordered 2 desserts (100% excellent, tasty, amazing).Location, was amazing, you can feel directly with the nature life, service was 1st class and excellent, the front staff was friendly and helpful, romantic atmosphere, and it was fine dining!!!Remember to make a reservation of the table before to go and remember they need a dress code to enter the restaurant!Keep Going and we will be back for your next suprise!!!Show less

Author: AshokAnila
Title: jewel in The Dat6ai
Review: Fantastic location, very tasty food and great service and ambience. Having mentioned our dietary requirements,we left it to the very knowledgeable staff to order our food and were not disappointed.Thank you.

Author: Manreet RLondon
Title: Great service but average food for price
Review: The seafood is the best option here! Stick to that!The service was impeccable and staff were extremely attentive and polite!The food was honestly a bit overpriced for the quality though! Just a bit meh and underwhelming! You're paying for the service and location more than the culinary experienceShow less

Author: Allan G
Title: excellent food and ambience
Review: Top quality food in super surroundings. The choice of food, its presentation and excellent service made for a memorable evening.

Author: 322nataliiak
Title: So so
Review: Food was ok but not great, we expected more from authentic restaurant. Prawns were fine, tandoori selection was rather dry. Was our least favourite from all Datai restaurants. Thai and Beach Restaurant were better.

Author: StevenTTGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor food unfortunately
Review: I stayed at the Datai and had tried all the restaurants in property and I have to say that this restaurant falls short of Datai standard. We went for the special nonya menu. The food was too salty all the time and flavour is rather one dimensional. Disappointed. suggest eating at the Pavillon...way betterShow less

Author: PDKUKNorth Cerney, United Kingdom
Title: FANTASTIC FOOD
Review: Ate in this restaurant 7 times during our stay at The Datai and each time the food was wonderful. The new Executive Sous Chef, Richard Junior, has added an extra dimension to this restaurant and is also an exceptionally nice and interesting person to talk to. The Tandoori rack of lamb is sensational and probably the best lamb chops I have ever eaten. If you want a curry try the Chicken Kapitan, a beautifully balanced dish combining spices with just enough heat to make it truly memorable. Many thanks also to Carlo and Suhaimi who contributed to our meals with perfect service and the warmest of welcomes.Show less

Author: Mark Mbrighton
Title: Jungle dining
Review: The open-sided wooden building on slits surrounded by tropical forest evokes the idea you are eating in a very remote location, but the quality for the Malay food and service reminds you that you are in a sophisticated luxury hotel, in spite of the family of wild boar that crashed through the undergrowth while we ate.My partner is Malay and he thought everything was great. We shared a mixed starter plate which was tasty, innovative and quite substantial. For the mains, his beef rendang was excellently tender, flavoursome and spicy. The chef told us it was his grandmother's recipe. My prawn malabar curry was less successful.Service was excellent, led by Carlos, and our meal was washed down with cool beer and San Peligrino.Show less

Author: Lynn P
Title: Great authentic food
Review: We ate here twice and loved it both times.  The pakoras to start with are delicious!  The rendang is also excellent.

Author: Tredgold1948
Title: Malaysian resturant
Review: Lovely setting ,we picked the set meal ,thinking we would have lots of different food.Quite expensive should have picked al a carte

Author: NickWaltonHK
Title: Brilliant Malay Culinary Experience
Review: Beautiful newly renovated stilted restaurant with great authentic cuisine and lovely staff. Lovely ambiance with views into the rain forest

Author: DesertdaisieCaldas da Rainha, Portugal
Title: No atmosphere and poor food
Review: We were looking forward to this meal but were disappointed by the whole experience. We arrived at the restaurant by buggy from The Datai. The staff greeted us and showed us to a table on the right hand side close to the front. Our view was of the couple in front of us and beyond them the turning circle for the buggies. There were constant arrivals which definitely detracted from the experience. The restaurant was very quiet despite quite a few tables being occupied. Some background music would have helped. There was just no atmosphere. The decor is also horrible on the right side of the room. The left side which is more traditional looked better. Honestly we felt we were dining in a wooden shed. The staff taking our order was a little unsure of the menu. I had the seafood lemak, it was awful. It looked like mush covered in brown gravy. The scallops were so tough i couldnt cut them. The whole dish tasted so bad I didnt eat it. My husband had a chicken dish which was very oily. The starter sampler was terrible, only the satays were edible. The service was slow, it took forever for the food to come out. We were not charged for the seafood lemak, a small recompense. I felt very unwell in the night. A shame as it could be so different. Perhaps the management needs to give it some attention to improve the food quality and the quality of service.Show less

Author: Rutger M
Title: Top diner
Review: A diner in The Gulai House is a special experience. Marvelous food and top personal attention. The location is superb.

Author: Anfibis
Title: Malayan hospitality at its best
Review:
If you like a more secluded and quiet dining experience, this is highly recommendable, we dined there often and were greeted with cordiality and the frogs chorus that live under the stilts. 
Our compliments also to all staff there

Author: kuantannewbie
Title: Scrumptious
Review: Warm and attentive service, a wonderful location and great tasting food! We ate at the Gulai House on three of the six nights we stayed at the Datai. The staff are fabulous - very knowledgeable about the choices on offer. The fish bar is great. The location of the restaurant provides a fantastic backdrop to mealtimes and no mozzie bites either!Show less

Author: SpookybabySingapore
Title: Rich flavours and a peaceful ambience
Review: The menu at this recently renovated restaurant is largely Malaysian and Indian fare, with curries, grills, and traditional starters and desserts. Most of the dishes were rich in flavours, though the spiciness could be adjusted upwards to suit more Asian tastebuds. The ambience was really pleasant, with the cool December breeze in the outdoor restaurant blowing gently, and surprisingly no mozzies or flies at all to bother us. We found the manager and service staff attentive, friendly, and warm. Yes, prices are high but because of its association with The Datai Resort, this did not come as a shock to us. Be prepared to pay 3 times more than what you would normally pay for dishes such as sayur lodeh, sambal kangkong, and cendol. We come back here a number of times primarily because it was the best restaurant in The Datai.Show less

Author: Spooky TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Scrumptious Malay & Indian dishes with attentive and warm service
Review: My wife and I dined at The Gulai House on 3 of the 5 nights that we were at Datai. This is testament to how much we enjoyed dining there.The restaurant serves Malay and Indian dishes but has toned down the typical spiciness one would expect from the local fare. Being Singaporean, we asked for the appropriate dishes to be spiced to local standards and they happily obliged. We tried different dishes each time we were there, except for Sayur Lodeh (a vegetable dish) which we had on two nights as it was a favourite dish. The Otah is excellent, as is the Chicken with Ginger cooked with Oyster Sauce. Needless to say, the Sayur Lodeh is delicious. There's also fresh seafood available for the grill, and the Lobster and King Prawn seem to be popular items among the other guests. They have a range of wines and cocktails available but being teetotal, we asked for Teh Tarik (a local beverage, literally "pulled tea with milk") which was not on the menu. The setting is unique. The restaurant is located amidst the rainforest and the call of the night creatures provides a soothing auditory backdrop to the dining experience. Although we were given tables in the unenclosed area, we were never troubled by insects, neither were we bitten by mosquitoes. They have an enclosed and air-conditioned dining area but most guests chose to sit at the unenclosed dining areas. The only one who chose to sit in the enclosed area was a Singapore family.Service was attentive and always with a smile. The Manager and service staff are ready to provide information and recommendations for the dishes and also accommodate special requests. It makes sense to eat local when visiting places. The Gulai House serves scrumptious local dishes, sans the spiciness, and is worth a return visit. As for the Thai Restaurant at the Resort, Langkawi is in Malaysia ;).Do note that the dress code is Resort Casual.Show less

Author: Percy33
Title: Fabulous Malaysian Cuisine
Review: We had a lovely dinner in the restaurant.  The food was delicious and the service fantastic.  It was nice to have an alternative to the normal "curry" we have at home in the UK.

Author: dushyantmotta
Title: Excellent food & lovely ambience
Review: We stayed at the Andaman next door to the Datai. We visited the Gulai House for dinner. The ambience is very pleasing and the food equally good.

Author: Mahi2010
Title: amazing Night
Review: The warm reception is mind blowing. The cultural night show and the fun I can’t forget. if i can  get chance i will visit again.

Author: nomadskKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Great location!!!!
Review: What an amazing location!!! Located in d midst of jungle where it seems to be interacting with you while you done...Food is nothing great to talk about really but the ambience takes d cake so u don't mind...One has to be a nature lover to Enjoi this place..We had a great experience n loved every moment of being there...Highly recommended!!!Show less

Author: ElehazelSydney, Australia
Title: Always offer great food
Review: Every time I visit Langkawi, I will come here for dinner. Beautiful setting and great food of course. This time we had braised lamb shank, charcoal grilled chicken (loved it! highly recommended), and mixed vegetable in coconut gravy. The host is professional yet down-to-earth. He walked around talking to customers, ensured the food is right, at the same time, initiated conversations with them. Very humble man. The chef (indian chef) came to say hi too. Great conversation with him! We feel very welcomed and well taken care of. Definitely my to-go place in Langkawi.Show less

Author: h_michikoDublin, Ireland
Title: Poor dish with expensive price
Review: The food here are very expensive. We don't have any issue paying expensive food, but it was not really up to our expectation to what was served. The menu need to be revised again. Also, when we went there, we were served uncooked chicken, the chef did came to us and apologize. The environment of this restaurant is very peaceful, to our surprise, we never bitten by mosquitoes!Show less

Author: The_Grumpster
Title: A touch of Malaysia and India
Review: Absolutely brilliant Malaysian and Indian cuisine that is traditional with a contemporary twist and great ambience set amidst a rain forest

Author: GillPhillips
Title: The Gulai House - gorgeous food
Review: Absolutely gorgeous food. Very tasty and wonderful ambience. The staff were friendly and helpful. It was lovely.

Author: kbert23
Title: Amazing Indian Food
Review: The staff was very accommodating and the food was fantastic. We did not finish our bottle of wine, and the staff made sure we could finish the same bottle at our dinner on the following night. Very thoughtful touch.

Author: Dale H
Title: Great food in the rainforest
Review: We came over from the nearby Andaman hotel to this restaurant set in the heart of pristine rainforest. We arrived as night was falling and the atmosphere was perfect. Staff helpful, ambience delightful and delicious food made for a perfect evening. Loved it!

Author: RoohiPiyushBengaluru, India
Title: Great ambience
Review: While our stay at The Datai, we had a dinner at Gulai. They had good options for vegetarian people like us. We tried same Malay dishes as well as Indian. Quantity of one of the dish was little while others were fine. Food was average as for the taste but what is striking is the ambience for which The datai anyways is famous. Gulai has traditionally contemporary settings and we loved our evening here in the backdrop noise of Forest life!Show less

Author: Engee1Kingston upon Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic
Review: Superb food, wonderful service from informative and friendly staff and a welcoming note on a large leaf for our return/second booking.Can't be faulted - eat here for real Malay and Indian food - don't order too much as the portion sizes are not small.Take the electric buggy ride to the restaurant which is fun, but in reality it is no more than a very pleasant stroll back to the hotel along well lit (subdued) roads through the jungle - must do the walk to hear all the different jungle noises.A wonderful experience.Eat here at least once.Show less

Author: fraserwil
Title: Excellent
Review: Had a delicious meal here. The food was exceptional. Great flavours. Service was very good by helpful friendly staff.

Author: stayNview
Title: just eat here while you stay in Datai
Review: excellent Malay and India food. Nice ambience. Exceptional service. Carlos and his team make sure every little need is looked after.

Author: eve74sg
Title: Romantic and rustic restaurant with friendly staff
Review: Restaurant has great ambience. Food is tasty but a little salty to our liking and a little expensive.

Author: johnbQ3125AE
Title: Good but not up to the standard of the other Datai restaurants
Review: The food can be clumsy and heavy. For example, soft-shell crab was smothered in greasy batter which dominated the flavour. The wait staff are pleasant; but don't expect Singapore levels of service.

Author: kenchen1977Hsinchu County, Taiwan
Title: As poor as possible, a LHW?
Review: Wating 20 mins for someone to introduce the menu. Another 30 mins for the starter. Drinking the sparkling wine without spsrkling, no one asks why we left so many food on plate. If The Datai Langkawi is a 2 stars hotel, we won't be so disappointed. Please take care your reputation as a LHW. Show less

Author: JohnB1955
Title: A Very Special Place
Review:
Food is very personal.
We loved our meal and the service was perfect.
The location is very special and if your driver becomes confused, don't worry he will eventually find the way.
Enjoy

Author: liamkirkham
Title: Best restaurant at the Datai
Review:
Great staff - warm welcome, very helpful
Amazing food (Malay/Indian) - lovely selection of fresh seafood for you to pick from
Brilliant location - tastefully set within the rainforest

Author: Bas HDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Amazing flavours (proper spice levels on request) a place not to miss!
Review: While traveling through Langkawi, we experienced the food sometimes is a bit blend.
