If you want to have a really amazing meal in a beautiful forest environment, the Gulai House in The Datai resort is the place and worth the drive.Service is great, as you may expect from an upscale place, the food is delicious (try the corn fritters..) and the surrounding is stunning (you cannot imagine the jungle orchestra you will be hearing).Highly recommended!Show less

Author: KuffyStaveley, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic Cuisine in a stunning setting
Review: The Guali House is a beautiful Malaysian Kampung house in the heart of the rainforest at Datai Bay. From the moment you walk into the wooden building you are hit with the rich spicy aromas.The meal is served in an authentic manner, beginning with handwashing with a bowl and jug and towels. Then the extensive menu arrives and the probldem starts ... what do you choose! Traditional favourites such as buuter chicken and beef rendang are delicious and then there is the wonderful meats from the tandoor oven .. so many difficult decisions. Campur campur is a wondeful selection of starters and the roti tisu is amazing!The only answer is to go more than once and work your way through the menu!We sat on the edge of the restaurant and listened to the sounds of the jungle as we enjoyed the intimate atmosphere of this wonderful restaurant.Any questions then the restaurant manager Carlo is there to guide you through to ensure that you have a magical Malay experience. Wonderful!Show less

Author: mashcom
Title: Spicy traditional Malaysian cuisine
Review: We've been to the Gluai House Langkawi 2nd time since 2008, and enjoyed spicy taste in traditional Malaysian cuisine surrounded by rainforest. We especially recommend you "Oxtail soup".

Author: itravelwith5kidsSydney, Australia
Title: delicious food
Review: i was staying at the datai and wanted to visit this restaurant with my husband, but due to my kids sleeping early in the room i had to go alone while my husband babysat :) wow the for was so nice the decor is very open style it feels like you are eating in the jungle. i arrived via golf cart and it was raining and thunderstorms so it just added more to the feeling that you are fine dining in open air. i had the beef rendang, some prawns and i was full i ordered another rendang for my husband and they delivered to the room. the nan bread is so yummy too,, need to try itShow less

Author: DGYSYNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: A very memorable and special restaurant in the jungle
Review: A lovely restaurant set into the jungle with amazing dishes of Indian and Thai/Malayan food the setting is very special with great service and lovely tables giving a magical aspect of the jungle surroundings as well as the restaurant itself. We had a very good meal here and enjoyed the menu Show less

Author: shankarece
Title: Indian style
Review: I went two months ago to langkawi.If you're indian and you want to taste indian foods in malaysia..them the gulai house restaurant is the best place for you.its nearby frangipani. North indian style foods are available plenty.

Author: BeeOutside
Title: Gorgeous Gulai
Review: We ate her one night and thoroughly enjoyed our meal of traditional Malaysian food the ambience in the jungle is wonderful!

Author: Sook Fun CMalaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: Delicious food, friendly staff, restaurant located at the forest provide good environment to guest. Also provide grill fresh seafood that allow the customer to pick and choose the sea food that they like. Staff is well trained and will able to remember the customer well and address them accordingly. Recommended restaurantShow less

Author: Edeline1989Singapore, Singapore
Title: An exquisite mix of Malaysian and Indian Cuisine
Review: Having lived in Malaysia I think I have never indulged in such delicious Malaysia cuisine yet!We went for an early dinner and the setting in the rain forest was just wonderful!We started our evening off with 'The Gulai House cocktail recommended by Carlo, which contains lemongrass and is very similar to a mojito! As we were the two of us we wanted to try different things so we opted to go for the sharing plate for 2 from the starters menu, this had chicken sate, beef sate, a very tasty peanut sauce, otak otak and deep fried soft shell crab! This was a great appetite opener!We chose different types of roti (bread) to go with our main course which were Beef Rendang and Curry Chicken! We also had a side dish of Dhal which was absolutely delicious! To end this evening we tried home made mango ice cream, definitely a must try!Overall we had a great experience. The staff was very attentive and very quick to respond to any request. Carlo was great at recommending different dishes and wine, he is very friendly and knowledgeable.We can't wait to be back and bring our friends!Keep up the great workShow less

Author: WorcesterHarvey
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: Great setting. Had a table right next to the jungle trees. Service and food were just the best. We felt as if we were the only ones in the restaurant. A bit pricey but worth it.

Author: qpkellytaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Thank god I searched on TripAdvisor!!
Review: I am superbly grateful to have been introduced to this gem of a restaurant by Tripadvisor. I can never imagine eating fine, authentic Malay and Indian any other way!! I absolutely adore the ambiance, sort of like dining in the jungle, in the middle of nowhere! The service is also excellent!!Show less

Author: LaetiTravellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Malai diner !
Review: Everything was great. The service was very attentive. We went probably a bit late so the place was quite empty. But at least it was peaceful. With nice music. The atmosphere feels very local, amongst the jungle. Actually a tad too rough in some ways.But most importantly the dishes were delicious. We both really liked the rendang and the curry.Perfect for trying local cuisine. Show less

Author: LittleElephantsSydney
Title: Great curries
Review: Food was very good. Lovely service by staff, but the kitchen was very slow. The food took ages to come out, even though the place was less than half full. The kids food from kids menu was not great. The beef in the burger was so tough that my son didn't eat it. The wonton noodle soup was very average.Also very expensive, the price guide should be $$$$, but consistent with all the other hotel restaurants.Overall experience was a good one and we enjoyed the experience. Show less

Author: realitycritic
Title: Delicious food.
Review: Really great food, superb service and a wonderful atmosphere. Very romantic and perfect for a 'date night'

Author: ChrisG238Stellenbosch, South Africa
Title: This is a "Bucket List" restaurant
Review: One of my favorite restaurants in the world. It's not often you get the perfect harmony of food, ambiance, decor tradition and heritage.If this restaurant was not in the middle of a rain forest on the remote side of Langkawi island it would have a queue!Great food, great everything!Show less

Author: Chris W
Title: Sensational lamb shank rogan josh
Review: I love a beef rendang however my wife ordered that so I was forced to go off piste and took the waiter's recommendation of the lamb shank. I will be eternally grateful for that as I had what was probably the best meal of my life. We had morning glory and garlic naan to accompany. There are other good restaurants about but The Gulai House is the one I am going to remember from my holiday to the Andaman.Show less

Author: Phil_Robert8
Title: Unassuming and understated.
Review: When you first arrive you are surprised by the sheer surroundings and settings. Your first impression is not one that would lead you to believe they served gourmet food here. They have an open air section as well as an airconditioned. Decoration is very rustic and cosy. We sat outside watching as dusk fell and evening darkness enveloped the jungle. A concert of crickets were playing all around us while we sipped at our gin & tonics.We, a party of three ordered curries to share. The food portions were was generous and the blend of aromatic spices made us clean up everything along with cold beers. We did manage to save some space for dessert, the sago gula melaka was a perfect round off to a very plesant evening.Staff is very good, attentive, service minded and the kitchen delivering what you thought not possible at first. In short, we like coming here for good food, service, peaceful and tranquil ambiance.Show less

Author: rootsandwings55
Title: delicious food in a jungle setting
Review:
This restaurant is a mix of Malay and Indian food...beautifully prepared. Great wines and great setting in the jungle of Langkawi.
Staff were helpful and knew their menu well.

Author: akooltan
Title: Fabulous restaurant.
Review: Great food.  Wonderful service.  Loved the beef rending and lamb chop tandoor.  Romantic setting surrounded by the rain forest.

Author: Denise2300
Title: Authentic food in an authentic setting
Review: Gorgeous Malaysian style restaurant, fantastic chef and staff, wonderful and authentic Malaysian food.  Fresh seafood caught daily displayed in the fridge for your selection and cooking style.  Great food, great service, stunning décor.

Author: kervingo
Title: A must try when staying at the The Datai
Review: We were recommended the Rice Biryani and Butter chicken both were super delicious authentic Malaysian cuisine and price wise is reasonable considering it is inside a six star hotel.

Author: youke_worldwide
Title: Wonderful Atmosphere
Review: Went there for a private event. Found the interior a bit dark but there is an outside verandah which was very nice. Food was local and good.

Author: Jacqueline C
Title: A must place to dine
Review:
Loved the Coconut Chicken Curry . 
Simple structure - with so much charm - and you sit outdoors among the rain forest. 
Staff are so good at recommending specials and so helpful.
Malay Indian cuisine - fantastic

Author: NicoleMDP
Title: Delicious
Review: Malay-Indian haute cuisine at its finest. The handmade breads are delicious and the meat and fish are perfectly cooked and seasoned. Wine selection is also decent. Yum yum

Author: 879bobj
Title: An awesome Indian restaurant
Review: Fabulous food in a really lovely setting.  Amazing food - the tandori tiger prawns are out of this world.

Author: GregD0297
Title: Great food and service at The Datai hotel
Review: Beautiful setting in the forest.  You can walk but most people get a free buggy. Food was great and service world class.  About £50 per person.

Author: Andrew L
Title: Super Gulai
Review: Gulai means curry in Malay, and being from Leicester I'm  quite a judge of curry! The food here is as good as it gets! I particularly recommend the beef rending, and the lamb tandoory!

Author: Clusters4Gold Coast, Australia
Title: Beautiful food with a grand price!
Review: Stayed at the Datai and were highly recommended to eat here seeing as it had some good reviews on trip advisor and had recently won another award. The ambience was excellent- tastefully designed but different from the usual classy restaurants. It is set out doors with no air conditioning and you can get a little warm if not near a fan. You also hear lots of outdoor animals/ creatures which is great. The service was warm and welcoming. A 45 minute wait for the food which wasn't bad at all. Staff knew their menu well and had already arranged our return buggy to our room when they knew we were almost done with our meal.The portion sizes are large and the food was absolutely amazing. So much flavour! We had the sheesh kebab which was amazing and cooked so well and the Dahl and grilled beef which had a beautifully refreshing mango salad. Prices we thought were extortionate- we paid MYR 350 for three dishes and drinks with no starters or desserts. Overall really think it is worth it to go atleast once. Show less

Author: Culture809479Cheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Malay/Indian restaurant on Datai complex
Review: First visited this restaurant 12/13 years ago when it was part of the Andaman Hotel, now part of the Datai. Serves Malay and Indian influenced foods in an open sided restaurant, hidden in the rainforest. We were staying at the Andaman but they drove us down for a small(ish) fee. Food was excellent and enjoyed by everybody in our party of 4. We needed a constant supply of iced water to cope with the climate and the spicy food! Chef made some of the meals a little milder for one person who does not like chillies/hot cuisine. Lovely setting, attentive staff and good food. Would definitely go againShow less

Author: PR_S18Barchi, Italy
Title: Not a Malayan dining experience
Review: returned after 5 years and found that thelocation was better than previous one but service and food worse. First of all the service is really slow. We made a reservation at 7:30 but received our drink at 7:50 , with only 4-5 other tables being occupied. Food used to be tipical Malayan, and is also still advertised, but with dal,nan and curries I found it more Indian than anything else. Although the quality is reasonable, it was not an experience we had hoped for. If service and cuisine stay like this, I will not come back.Show less

Author: David N
Title: Unique
Review: The welcome and ambience of this restaurant was second to none. The service was personal and the food tasty.

Author: colinpennyfu2
Title: Just Superb
Review: Lovely Staff, a warm welcome and very efficient anf polite and firendly, nothing was to much trouble. Lovely Jungle setting,Superb Restaurant with excellent food.

Author: EatDrinkStayTravel
Title: Best seafood lemak ever
Review: This is a very good place to eat. Hard to get to if your not staying at The Datai, but worth the trip just for the seafood lemak! All the food we had we high quality. The curries are flavoursome and good size serving. We went back twice and both meals were fabulous.Show less

Author: Rubeena2000Sydney, Australia
Title: Great food in a great location!
Review: We enjoyed a delightful meal here during our stay at the Datai.The staff were very attentive and polite.The restaurant manager Carlo was personally going around to each table checking on all the customers..A must go if you are in Langkawi.The flavours of the cuisine were outrageously YUM!They offer fresh seafood which you can choose from..Can't wait to go again!Show less

Author: Gabriella M
Title: Nice location, perfect dinner
Review: We come here after reading reviews on tripadvisor. it was a good decision. wonderful place, very good and tasty food. mango sorbet !! perfect

Author: S2vishva
Title: Good food
Review: Overall great choice and good Malay and Indian food. Very delicious and good service. Great tree house location.

Author: CakerBaker
Title: Definitely overrated for the price
Review: Dined 27 Dec 2014.  Excellent service and decor but ultimately the food was mediocre.  Had beef rendang, chicken kari kapitan, otak-otak, kerabu chicken.  Definitely not worth the RM400+ we paid for 4 persons.  Unlikely to return.

Author: dagoeh
Title: Excitics restourant
Review: Nice place, excotics place in the jungle.. We can take the boogey car from the hotel.. Deliciouse local food.. Great experiences!!!

Author: KeepOnTravelling2014Hong Kong, China
Title: Enjoyable Meal
Review: We enjoyed our meal here in a lovely rainforest setting but to be honest we felt it lacked atmosphere and on the occasion we were there not so many guests. We weren't so wild about the food, particularly after we had better experiences nearby at The Pavilion and The Beach Club Restaurant at The Datai.Show less

Author: airiena296
Title: many choices and nice
Review: they have various kind of food. from the malaysian nasi lemak, chinese food, japanese and indian as well. the restaurant just opposite the pool. nice view nice food. just beware of monkeys.

Author: Niky H
Title: definite must for a special night
Review: Mzing location and beautiful building and best Malay/Indianfood in Langkowi! The experience is worth the price

Author: KuffyStaveley, United Kingdom
Title: Malay magic on a plate
Review: This is no fancy restaurant with silver service and penguin style waiters. Instead you get a magical Malay experience reflecting the wonderful variety of the cuisine this country has to offer. The restaurant is tucked away in the rainforest that surrounds The Datai and is built in the style of a village house from a local kampung. With no windows, you can experience fabulous food whilst listening to the jungle hum around you. (No background piped music here, just the real thing!) Simplicity with amazing cuisine ensures for a fabulous experience.Carlo ably leads a knowledgeable team who provide thoughtful service and the open kitchen produces some truly delicious Malay and Indian dishes. Forget the calories and indulge in the amazing tandoor treats, butter chicken and beef rendang. A real must is the roti tissue and the tandoori rack of lamb.Thank you Carlo for a wonderful dining experience, one we need to repeat.Show less

Author: JulioGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Still excellent
Review: Last time we stayed at Datai (2011) they were re-building this restaurant. For still very good - could recommend virtually all dishes from the menu - right length. We ate there three times.Good idea of having wines by the glass (good choice that include Cloudy Bay, top Alsace, white burgundy from Louis Latour).I would say that the new location is not as romantic as the old one as now one does not hear the sea, Also, they say the noise of frogs is not recorded, however not so sure.Perhaps there are other places that serve tasty Malaysian food as this in Langkawi, but I would not think that the tastes are so clean (one can identify separate spices if trained to do so, but they are blended to give the correct flavour to the dish. Of course, it cannot be cheap as it is part of a luxury hotel. Also, not for vindaloo/lager lovers.Show less

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Memorable meal
Review: We walked from the beach of the Andaman to its new location in the forest. Its situation right in the rain forest ensured we had a orchestra of cicadas and frogs to entertain us during our meal. Ayam percik and rendang really superb and cocktails fabulous. Helpful staff arranged transport for us back to the Andaman after dinner. One of the most memorable meals we had on this island.Show less

Author: ilkeaksoy
Title: great
Review: staff amazing, food  amazing, decor great, lighting could be a tiny bit dimmer, frogs very noisy but sweet :) Overall GREAT!

Author: PhilipW141
Title: Not to be missed
Review: Some of the best Malay fusion cuisine in the whole of Malaysia. A pity it was moved off the beach to an inland position in the redesign of 2011 but still a place of food pilgrimage. The beef rendang is to die for. Go.

Author: Flurry2011
Title: Charming and delicious
Review: Really lovely food and service. The lobster with Malay spices was great. Two vegetarians who scoffed the dhal, nicely nuanced flavours in the curries and perfectly cooked rice. We loved it!

Author: SorayaS325
Title: Tasty but pricey!
Review: Stayed at the Andaman so went to the Datai for dinner, lovely staff and food but expensive! Same price as a London restaurant. The seafood was great and friendly staff

Author: NorthStar536783
Title: Great food, great service, great environment. ..
Review: A great way to get to know malay food. We've been here two times during our hollidays and all food we ordered was absolutely delicious. The Gulai House team is more than willing to guide you through the menu, and assist you to pick the most suitable option for you. Show less

Author: MrandMrsOomerBolton, United Kingdom
Title: A truly memorable dining experience in an equisite rainforest setting.
Review: Wow what an amazing place this was! Great place to dine if your celebrating a special occaison or wanting to enjoy a romantic meal in a natural rainforest setting. We arrived at the Datai which looked like a beautiful hotel. We were greeted by a member of the front desk staff, who arranged a buggy to the restaurant. The buggy driver who I think was called Anwar was genuine, friendly and very kind. He took me and my wife around the hotel grounds and the private beach area. He knew how to take great picture too!!When we arrived at the restaurant we were greeted with a warm welcome by smiley faces. The decor matched the natural rainforest theme, the ambience was relaxing and the food was delicious. The food on offer was of Indian / Asian theme. There was also a sea food counter too. We recieved a fantastic and attentive service all evening from the moment we arrived to the moment we left. We had such a memorable evening and would definately come back if we returned to this beautiful Island.Thank YouShow less

Author: ChumpkinPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great Service and Food.
Review: We were staying at the Datai and being curry lovers my wife and I gave it a try....So glad we did, the food was amazing, best butter chicken, banana fritters EVER.Freshly cooked and great service made for a lovely experience. We ate here so often over 2 weeks that we pretty much had our own table with a view into the woodland and the chef came out to thank us for eating there and even gave my wife the secret recipe for the fritters. Car ride to the restaurant and a romantic stroll home along the beach by moonlight...Perfect.Show less

Author: Rita Marie YSurfers Paradise, Australia
Title: A gem of a restaurant in the Rainforest.
Review: This restaurant is set amongst the rainforest; you feel like you are part of the forest, listening to the wonderful sounds of nature. Oh, and the food and service is fantastic. Lots of fresh seafood, I had a wonderful lobster with mango salad; my husband a terrific prawn curry. Presentation of food is so appetising and it tasted as food as it looked. It is a little expensive but well worth it for the experience.Show less

Author: Tam1985London
Title: Wonderful service, delicious food and great location but little expensive
Review: I ate at the Gulai House on 25 April with my husband. From the moment we arrived we were treated like royalty. Even though we had not requested any special treatment (ie we didn't highlight we were on honeymoon or celebrating anything significant) we were given this lovely table that was set slightly away from the main restaurant. It was unbelievably romantic. It was private, candle lit and you could hear the wonderful noises from the rainforest. Thank you so much Gulai House for doing this at is made our meal a very memorable experience. The food was very delicious and presented very nicely. I would highly recommend the lamb shank. The service was great. I would like to particularly mention Carlo who was so kind and friendly.The only thing which stopped me giving the Gulai House five stars is it's price. I know it is based in one of the more exclusive resorts of Langkawi but nonetheless, it was a bit expensive. Our three course meal with soft drinks cost £80. I am glad I still went and would love to have eaten there again but the price sadly kept me away.Show less

Author: DazelemWarkworth, New Zealand
Title: Outstanding food, service and environment
Review: Out of the way if you are not staying at the Andamam or Datai resort....but well worth the visit. Exceptional service and a wide range of great food choices.Indian, Malay or Chinese.The quality and presentation of food was exquisite.Best to make a booking.For Langkawi the cost was high but for three with wine less than 140 USD, so very good value.Show less

Author: lou3Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Very disappointing...
Review: We visited from the neighbouring Andaman Hotel. We'd heard good things about the restaurant and were expecting the meal to be a highlight of the trip. However, we left strongly disappointed.This primarily stemmed from our table location, coupled with a severe problem that the restaurant has with its floor. We'd were seated in the middle of the floor, so the jungle setting wasn't visible to us - we'd had far more atmospheric views from tables at our hotel. We asked whether we could move to a table looking out to the jungle, but were told by the manager that all were booked. This was despite us booking our table two days before, and asking for a good table. To add insult, the next family that arrived, who were sat at a similar table in the centre, asked a different waiter and were moved to a nicely located table.This alone would not have been a huge issue. What did become an issue was the terrible vibration on the floor as waiters passed. Our table, in front of the fish and cooking counter, was passed by every waiter visiting tables and the suspended floor bounced harshly as they walked by. It might seem like a trivial thing but we just didn't relax for the whole meal.The Gulai was by far the highest meal charge of our trip and yet we felt that that the atmosphere was close to the worst. A long way from the intimate 'back to nature' experience that we'd expected.In terms of the food itself, it was ok. We all enjoyed our dishes but they were disproportionately expensive for the quality provided.We also saw another couple walk out after some form of complaint, half way through our meal, but didn't notice why....So, sorry Gulai, not a good experience.Show less

Author: Lorraine B
Title: Great food
Review: Great Indian food and good service and wine. Out in rainforest and we had two meals both great - recommend Malabar prawns!

Author: kent19Mumbai, India
Title: A memorable experience
Review: Located between the Datai and Andaman Resorts, amidst a rainforest, what better dining experience but the Gulai House. Sometimes its just the ambience, sometimes its just the food and on few occasions, its the overall experience that gets etched in the memory. Thats the case with Gulai House.You park at one of the above resorts and get a ride to this restaurant standing in the middle of a rainforest. After a welcome, we were taken to our reserved table with our names handwritten on a leaf. And then we got lost amidst dim lights, sounds of the rainforest, and Malay falvours. We start with the Gulai house speciality cocktail - its refreshing, followed by Otak Otak as appetizer and then the main course and dessert. The food is nice, not great but not bad either. Its the whole experience that one cherishes and herein I must mention the ever smiling Carlos, the Manager of Gulai House.Show less

Author: VincentC990Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful place but very pricey
Review: It is our second visit after 10 years. The food is still good. But the prices shocked us. An Asian dish is close to USD30. I understand opreating cost in a rain forest may be slightly higher. But it should not overcharge guests who have limited dining options at the Datai. Show less

Author: Brian SHemel Hempstead, United Kingdom
Title: Very Good Meal in the Rainforest
Review: We went to the Gulai from the Andeman and had an excellent meal. We understood that the menu was Indian & Malay (Gulai is curry in Malay according to our driver) but the meal we had was not an Indian curry as we know it in the Uk. That said the meal was very tasty, service was very good and the cost was not overly high bearing in mind that the restaurant is part of the Datai.As a bonus the transfer to and from the Andeman was complementary and the bill was charged back to our roomShow less

Author: lovenorfolk102London, United Kingdom
Title: Very good restaurant in every aspect
Review: First of all the staff at the restaurant were truly great. The food we had were all delicious. The restaurant is located amongst the rainforest and you can hear the sound of crickets and frogs while dining which is a change from hearing the traffic instead.Show less

Author: RomaRenatoRome, Italy
Title: outstanding Indian cuisine
Review: This restaurant, which first belonged to the Andamman Hotel and is now owned by the Datai Hotel is located in the rain forest between the two hotels. Very attentive service, and excellent food. We tried the Indian dishes, which were all superb. They also have Malay dishes and a counter of fresh seafood. Our first order was Pakoras, we ordered two but realized that one plate of this starter would have been sufficient. Then we went on to Tandoori chicken, dahl, matter paneer and naan, all excellent. Can only recommend this restaurant, even if it is quite far away for those who do not stay at one of the two hotels on Datai beach. Prices not cheap, but adequate for one of our best meals ever.Show less

Author: Heiko S
Title: Fantastic Malay High-end Food
Review: Its a pricey place but worth it! The food is delicious, the setting beautiful. This place is my favourite among all the restaurants I tried during my stay in Langkawi.

Author: jetlagwooferSydney
Title: I was expecting great things.
Review: Meh. The food wasn't bad, but it wasn't 'wow' either. I was led to believe this was 'the place' for Malaysian cuisine.The decor is interesting. It's an outdoor open air hut style restaurant - between the Andaman and Datai resorts.The food all tasted similar, which was disappointing. We were practically ignored mist of the evening. We served our own wine - I don't have a problem with this if the restaurant is busy, but there were only 5 tables occupied (our of 50!).The Thai restaurant at Datai is better.Show less

Author: Sarah CSan Francisco, California
Title: One of my top ten meals
Review: This restaurant was amazing! The ambiance, the service, and the food could not have been better. I highly recommend it. We had some of the most amazing curries, fish, veggies, naan, and wonderful wine. We came back again for a 2nd visit because we enjoyed it so much.The waitstaff was so incredibly attentive, and they called a car for us to return to the Andaman as we paid our bill.Show less

Author: Nivle
Title: Average food but good ambiance
Review: Love the hospitality but mediocre food. Grilled fish was not so much a grilled fish, doesn't taste like one. Was really expensive.

Author: LRE517London, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect!
Review: My fiancée and I ate here recently whilst staying at the Andaman Hotel. The hotel organised free transfer by luxury car to the restaurant and back again!The setting is out of this world, the restaurant is set in the middle of the rainforest and all you can hear are the natural sounds and all you can see is the rain forest around you.The service was excellent and the waiters were both knowledgable and friendly, they couldn't do enough to make you feel welcome.We started with the mixed satay and the vegetable fritters followed by one rice (more than enough for two people) coconut chicken curry, wok fried vegetables, one butter naan and the lamb shank, with two beers, one glass of white wine and a big bottle of water the bill was around £95 so not a cheap option but for good food and the unique venue I would say this is worth it, plus you will leave feeling very fool as portion size is generous! I would thoroughly recommend this dining venue!Show less

Author: Stepb4UHarlow, United Kingdom
Title: Delightful service, delightful food
Review: Set right in the rain forest this delightful restaurant was perfect. Food full of flavours, perfectly presented and staff that go out of their way to provide a personable service. Unfortunately we only had time to visit this restaurant once in our stay as we both wanted to return. The restaurant is also dull of charm, perfect in every way.Show less

Author: nathanadams13Isle of Man, United Kingdom
Title: Superb and fabulous
Review: The gulai house was one of the best restaurant in Malaysia, My wife and I enjoyed our dinner the restaurant was really a romantic place for both of us the endless sounds of frogs and crickets is a good background music while eating plus a smiling and friendly waiter who took care of us. This place is best recommendation the food is superb and the ambiance is fabulous there nothing i can ask for more even the selection of Malaysian dessert in the buffet section has an amazing taste. My wife was so happy that night she said the food was succulent the same as my food. we beef rendang which tender lovely taste pala paneer with naan bread tandori chicken with naan bread and bryany rice. We had a bottle of wine to enjoy the night. Amazing dining experience. I promise to my wife that we will comeback soon. thank you guys you made our vacation really unforgettable.Show less

Author: Piyush47Lugano, Switzerland
Title: Great Evening and Great Food
Review: We were staying at the Andaman Hotel - and decided to visit this restaurant - really was a magical place in the evening - the whole environment was magical - the restaurant is in Datai Hotel - and in middle of Natural Forest - with the sounds of crickets and frogs - really romantic and not to forget the food was really excellent and not very expensive.Try this place - you will love it ( if you like Malaysian / Indian food) Show less

Author: Alar_ReadingReading, United Kingdom
Title: World class
Review: I can't speak highly enough about this restaurant - the food was superb and incredibly authentic - the mixed starters were very good and offered a great way of trying a few different dishes but to me the main courses were phenomenal - the butter chicken and beef rendang were brilliant as was the palak paneer. Would definitely recommend this restaurant and we may well go back before we fly home!Show less

Author: rjhayter
Title: Great food.
Review: A fantastic mix of Malay and Indian food served in a beautiful wooden pavilion. Amazing fresh fish selection. Exceptional.

Author: Naz3456Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hot and delicious
Review: We ate here on the second night after we went to Thai Restaurant, The Manager Carlo escort with warm greeting, and the staff is helpful with Smile at all time. Had try the chicken tandoori and alogobi is amazing, and they had complimentary dessert buffet at the corner.The restaurant is full with singing of the frogs to entertain you while you enjoy the meals. The restaurant is full with Malaysian heritage set up, and located near by beach club, and rainforest three. Love to return some day when we lending in langkawi again.Show less

Author: aribeeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food and Equally Amazing Service
Review: I ate at The Gulai House 3 times during my stay at The Datai. Wow! The food was amazing and the service provided by the team at the Gulai House just added to the experience.On our first night Carlo suggested we try the seabass stuffed with coconut, I was slightly skeptical but one mouthful soon removed any doubts I might have had. We also had lobster that was cooked to perfection, the sampler platter, chicken and beef satay, the beef randang, soft shell crab ... just remembering all the food is making me hungry!The chefs were also lovely and extemely accommodating, often cooking up meals that were not on the menu and on our last night making my favourite dessert for me depiste it not being on the menu. All of the staff were attentive and friendly. Rona and Benji along with Carlo in paticular; Rona knew our villa number and names on our secod visit and also remembered our pre dinner drink preferences (how do they do that?!) and Carlo and Benji were alsways smiling and happy to offer food recommendations that constantly surpassed our expectations. Each meal was better than the last!Highly recommend this restaurant; it's set in the middle of the rainforset and your meals are accompanied by the sounds of the local frogs croaking (they croak like no frog you woudl ahve ever heard before).Wish we had eaten there every night.Show less

Author: nick b
Title: Malay and Indian Taste
Review: is combination between Malaysian food and Indian food, we had dine here second night we stay, and good landscape with atmosphere of rainforest, good entertain sounds of frogs. service and staff were high train, price is average. Restaurant capacity is big, and Malaysian traditional house.

Author: malaky2013
Title: one of the best in the world
Review: Chiken bryany was really good and they had a lot of good food I ordered 3 meals all of thim were nice and so romantic moment I spent there the price was not bad for honey moon

Author: julespants
Title: Rain forest dining
Review: Beautiful meal in wild surroundings. This is a wonderful place, you can experience a gorgeous meal with fine wine just feet away from all the wildlife.

Author: SueLynnTiongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food in a Kampung-style setting!
Review: The Gulai House at The Datai Langkawi offers guests the experience of dining in a wooden house amidst the lush green surrounding. This “kampung style” setting is further complemented by The Gulai’s unique blend of authentic Malay and Indian dishes, made from fresh ingredients and seafood.I was greeted by my name, handwritten on a place card in a form of a leaf. Upon seated, the staff came over with a ceramic bowl of water for me to rinse my hands and once I had finished my amuse bouche, I was served my appetizer.The appetizer platter comprised otak-otak (grilled fish and prawns in banana leaf), kerabu mangga (traditional style spiced mango salad) and pakoras (vegetable fritters, cucumber raita and tamarind chutney) – well infused with spices and very addictive. Especially the pakoras.I was quite pleased with the Sup Ayam Mulligatawny (Indian Curried Chicken), served in a small claypot to ensure the soup stayed warm throughout. This was thick, chunky from the meat and vegetables and delicious from the assorted spices.I was quite pleased with the Sup Ayam Mulligatawny (Indian Curried Chicken), served in a small claypot to ensure the soup stayed warm throughout. This was thick, chunky from the meat and vegetables and delicious from the assorted spices.For my main course, I tucked into sumptuous servings of rendang daging, udang karang and murukh tikka; each delicious in their own way. The rendang daging (beef rendang) was terrifically tender, well-spiced and very tasty with biryani rice. You can also choose to eat this with naan (there’s an option of garlic, plain or butter) or fresh chapatti and it tastes just as good.The udang karang (wok-fried lobster with Indian spices and curry gravy) was one of my favourite dishes that night. What’s not to love about fresh Andaman lobster, cooked with just the right balance of spices? It was hard to find fault in the Murukh Tikka (skewered boneless chicken), for the chicken pieces were flavourful and tender.Side dishes that night included Aloo Gobi Masala and Sayur Lemak Lodeh, and both I enjoyed. The aloo gobi masala packed a wallop of flavour while the sayur lemak was milder but equally tasty. It was a massive feast – one I struggled to finish.I was too stuffed for dessert, served buffet style. If you want to sample some local kuih-muih, you can do so here. Although, I wasn’t a fan of the Malay cake (ma lai goh) – it was a tad dry. That said, they do a good bubur kacang hijau; thick, adequately sweet and aromatic from the addition of pandan (screwpine leaves) and coconut milk.I love dining in restaurants such as The Gulai because the lush nature adds to the ambiance and somehow makes the food taste better. At least for me. :)Show less

Author: Diane R
Title: Excellent
Review: The Food and the atmosphere nestled in the rainforest was incredible! Enjoyed a bottle of wine with dinner and even saw a wild boar run through the bushes

Author: Intrepidation
Title: Lovely Ambience, Nice Food but Pricey
Review: The Gulai House is situated in within a luscious jungle and is decorated very tastefully with authentic Malay settings. The food items are a combination of Indian and Malaysian based cuisine The service was good and the food quality above average. However the food was very pricey by local standards, with small portions being offered. I would not care to repeat my experience unless a serious attempt is made to either enhance the quality of the menu offering or bring prices down to a reasonable level.Show less

Author: jeannetamHong Kong, China
Title: Dinner for the "Junglewalla tour"
Review: the dinner at gulai House is complimentary to our "Rainforest after dark" tour arranged by Junglewalla. the experience is one in a million must try. the temperature dropped below 28 degree celsius after dark there, and the tree frogs start to sing, nonstop. the food is authentic malaysian and Indian cuisine with delicate combination of natural herbs. nutritionally balanced. The desert is unbelievably good, ice scoop on top with local bean steamed rice drops at the bottom. a large portion and local specialty. Don't miss it when ordering~It satisfy us quite a lot as we were not staying there for this time.Show less

Author: zmyusofKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of those that places you will remember and tell other people about it
Review: The Gulai House is located in the midst of a jungle at The Datai and they serve a mixture of local Malaysian and Indian dishes. If you think that local fare should be typical, think again. This is one restaurant that i will remember always for the ambience and the taste. But i must say that as a local this is not your everyday kind of restaurant since the pricing is quite (read : very) steep. So for that special celebration or occasional splurge, it is definitely worth a visit. As a local, you probably think that you know Malaysian food and expect nothing extra ordinary. I couldn't be more wrong when i tasted the food that we ordered which is simply Otak Otak, Kapitan Curry Chicken and Mix Vegetables. There's something special with every dish in terms of the way they were prepared which turn out be (i dare say) just perfect. The taste is just right and the serving is sufficient although considering the price you paid, you wish you could ask for second helping or perhaps offered a larger serving.The restaurant is situated in the middle of a jungle and one of those places which you can vouch as not typical. I can still remember the taste of that Kapitan Curry Chicken and it makes me hungry.Show less

Author: boris mMoscow, Russia
Title: amazing atmosphere
Review: sitting in the middle in the rainforest, listening to the voice of a rainforest and having such a great food at the same time, amazing setup. It's a masterpiece, would love to share my experience with all of you and can frankly suggest, especially the fish bbq and desserts.Show less

Author: law505Frankfurt (Oder), Germany
Title: great food and service
Review: We dine here only once and its our first experince with malay food.Thier staff did do assit us with choosing of the menu since we have no idea what to order and when all the food arrived on our table then the experiance begin....the beed rondang,grilled fish from live station,stuffed squid its so good and the they do have a good selection of wine list.Service its good and thier staff are very friendly and attentive. If you are in langkawi this is an experince should't be missed.Show less

Author: dickymoningka
Title: Nice dinner in The Gulai House at The Datai Resort Langkawi
Review: We had a dinner at this restaurant serving local Malaysian and Indian dishes. Great food, nice and friendly services by the staff. My children also liked this place.

Author: ndgebeh
Title: "All funtastic"
Review: The best indian and malay food we have during stayed at the datai was the gulai house.The staff was very good and friendly. The food was excellent,especially the otak-otak and chickhen tandori. Its the outstanding food we had during our trip at langkawi island,malaysia.We hope to see u all there and wish all the best for u..Show less

Author: Andrew61443
Title: Fantastic Food...
Review: I visited  LANGKAWI and I had my Dinner at the Gulai House,coz its highly recommended .The location was nici,food was great,staff was so friendly it was a great evening for me and my family..if you visiting LANGKAWI Try to go at The Gulai House...

Author: louis66_13Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Hidden kitchen in the rainforest
Review: The set up of restaurant in the rainforest its so amazing.We did try the beef rendang,stuff squid,grilled fish malay local style it so good and we never try anything like this before. Waiting staff are very attentive and always serve with smile. They do serve complimetary dessert buffet and its a very good oppurtunity for us to try local dessert .I must said bravo the the servce and the kitchendstaff to make our evening so memorable. Show less

Author: MmaniarLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Loved it! Was our home during our big holiday
Review: This is the most amazingly located restaurant in Langkawi. Tucked away in the rainforest, this little gem serves Malay food with an Indian influence. The chef knows what he's doing for sure! And the front of staff are excellent! We loved eating on a raised platform open air building with flying lemurs for company and the noisy nocturnal residents of the rainforest (Whew! Didn't encounter a flying snake, though we did bump into some wild boars, langurs & of course the lemurs!) Highly recommend their curries and their fresh catch! (we saw the fisherman bringing it in earlier in the evening at the beach!) We became regulars at the Gulai house during our Langkawi holiday even though we were not staying at the Datai! Make reservations just in case the entire holiday population of The Datai & The Andaman decide to eat there!Show less

Author: BevOzzy
Title: Favourite Indonesian!
Review: Stunning Indonesian restaurant, part of the beautiful Datai hotel. Cuisine quite hot although they will tone it down if you wish. Recommend the soft shell crabs as a starter!! Set apart from hotel in a wooden Indonesian style so quite relaxed. Immaculate service. Quite pricey but worth it.Show less

Author: wheretonext1973Cheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Food for the forest
Review: During our recent visit to the Datai we visited this restaurant many times. Definitely improved since moving to the Datai rainforest instead of belonging to the Andaman. The restaurant is a delight to sit in amongst the trees and cicadas, waiting in hope to spot the wild boar or flying squirrels.The fish counter is an excellent addition, allowing you to select your fish, then discuss with your waiter and chef which way is best to serve, and of course, enjoy.We tried a whole array of flavours during our many visits, with the fish in turmeric sauce definitely the highlight! The service is impeccable with extremely attentive staff. They made our experiences extra special. There is also the addition of the complimentary dessert table, showing off various indian and Malay desserts and fruit.On our last night we were even presented with a coconut pudding recipe that one of the regular staff, Agus, had kindly typed out. We are now looking forward to preparing our own at home. I just hope its as nice.This restaurant houses indian and Malay food and is definitely worth a visit at least once, if not 2 or 3 times during your stay.Show less

Author: flavorsoflifeBangkok, Thailand
Title: A different experience
Review: Stayed at the Datai and wanted to check out the fair. Food was well prepared catered more for the generally Caucasian clientele.. So if u r looking for an authentic local experience, this is not it. If u want to enjoy some local fair in the area, give it a shot. Nothing memorable.Show less

Author: Donna W
Title: great ambience
Review: Food was ok.  However, the ambience is great.  Right in the middle of a rainforest.  The service was excellent.

Author: MsjaguarBonita, California
Title: Unique Restaurant
Review: It's in the middle of the rainforest to start with. The food was very good with fresh fish and seafood. They allow you to pick what you want and how you would like it cooked. The service is excellent. It's definitely for a special occasion but the staff and atmosphere are worth it!Show less

Author: AJRS92
Title: A great setting for a great restaurant
Review: Gulai House was a great Malay/Indian restaurant with fantastic service. We ventured to this restaurant twice while staying at The Datai and they were very welcoming both times.

Author: SharonL320Cairns, Australia
Title: Best Malay food on Langkawi
Review: My partner and I went here for our last dinner in langkawi and it was memorable to say the least. The restaurant is quite charming and although we were greeted by a snobby staff member, the food and other staff was fantastic. We ordered the grilled grouper, tomato and vermicelli salad, seafood curry, and vegetable fritters and every dish was perfect. We thought Ikan Ikan at the four seasons was great but this one could be up there as one of the best meals I've ever had. Oh and it was in the middle of the jungle! Quite special.Show less

Author: auroracoralsHKHK
Title: questionable service
Review: A bunch of my friends and family were in Langkawi where we stayed at the Andaman for our wedding in November - the event was a bit overcast with a stolen phone the day prior (can read about it on one of the Temple Tree reviews) and the day after the wedding, at the Gulai House. Many reviews had written about how great the service was at these two places so we were really surprised by what we actually experienced.4 of us went to the Gulai House the day after the wedding for a nice dinner (which we did get, albeit it a bit short). Later on 8 of my friends who had just come back from town (cenang beach area for spa, local hawker food) wanted to join us for a quick drink at the Gulai House. I remember specifically asking the driver from Andaman whether we would be allowed inside given our attire (our husbands were both in shorts and flip flops) and the driver said that there is no dress code and we didn't have any problems getting a table for 4. However when my friends arrived from town (via the spa shuttle), they were dropped off at the Datai lobby and were told they are not allowed at the Gulai House given their inappropriate attire (men and ladies in shorts and flip flops), but they asked to be transferred via the buggy to the restaurant so they could at least tell me that they would be back at the Andaman lobby bar. We were impressed with the food, the presentation and the courteous staff but were surprised my guests were turned away in such a manner, especially when I had pointed out that our husbands and the rest of the gentlemen in the restaurant at the same time were dressed in the same way! I am not sure why they turned business away, and after a search on the website still found nothing about a dress code at the Gulai House (do let me know if there is, I still have not been able to find anything), but it was a rather disappointing visit.Show less

Author: tracyctlTokyo, Japan
Title: Great food and service
Review: While my colleagues and my husband and I stayed at The Datai, we decided to try out The Gulai house on our second night. It was really pleasant when we entered the restaurant and saw a welcome message addressed to my husband (since the reservation was made under our villa). The staff were attentive and they didn't mind coming back and forth taking our endless orders. The curries were really delicious and my colleagues loved it. Even though the restaurant was smacked right in the middle of the forest and the structure of the restaurant was not an enclosed building, we had no mosquito or bug problems at all. Definitely a must when visiting Datai.Show less

Author: ChrisinSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the best meals...ever.
Review: My family and I recently stayed at the Andaman for a week and, although we ate at different restaurants each night, most of us in the group (of 8 adults) agreed that this was the best meal of the entire week. The food is largely centred around local curry dishes, so if that is your think this is one to try!Show less

Author: UKHoT_Traveller
Title: as good as ever
Review: for those not too adventurous then this is the place to get great Malay food served in a beautiful outdoor (undercover) restaurant. it's not 'street' food so don't expect to pay hawker stall prices.

Author: MartinSoutterArmadale, Australia
Title: Gulai House
Review: Excellent food in a wonderful rain forest setting. Carlo and the other staff were attentive, professional and very helpful.The food is reasonably priced although if you want to lash out I recommend the lobster curry.Additionally, there are some nice little touches like the bowl of water that is brought around before dinner to wash ones hands and the leaf on the table with your name written on it.Show less

Author: toothfairyjulie
Title: Absolutely Lovely
Review: Staying at the Datai, made this an obvious choice for our first evening meal here and it was superb.  I liked the extra little touch of bringing a bowl to rinse your hands before eating.  Expensive, but a wonderful experience

Author: SamrNZAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Nice food, nice setting
Review: Food was absolutely delicious, the setting was wonderful and the staff were great. Just very small portions and expensive. But, still the best meal we had in Malaysia and a great last night out with the whole family. A bit far away from the rest of Langkawi though. (We were staying at The Andaman next door which does complimentary shuttles to The Datai).Show less

Author: DavidIsMaxOxshott, United Kingdom
Title: Unique setting for great Malay food
Review: We ate twice at the Gulai House during our stay at the Datai (see separate review). Our first tip is to visit after sunset (you could always go to the Beach bar to watch this with a good cocktail in hand!), take a buggy to take you from the Datai reception. It is an exciting start to the whole experience being driven through the rainforest at night – with all the nocturnal animals sights and sounds of the Rainforest – do ask your driver to point out animals as they are so keen to help you see them. The restaurant itself is in the middle of the rainforest. Service is attentive – although on our first visit the restaurant was a little quite and we agree with a previous review that the service was too attentive at times with 4 people trying their best to check if everything is ok. Our first meal the food was fabulous as we choose Malay dishes. The soft-shell crab is start is a real treat, the beef rending was deliciously rich, steamed Garoupa was delicate and perfectly cooked. If you have kids make sure you order the ice-cream as it comes in a perfectly formed ice bowl. On our second visit the food was a little disappointing as we choose Indian dishes and whilst not bad these simply weren’t as good as many Indian meals we have eaten in the UK (for reference we choose Tandoori dishes). Wine list is quite extensive – we found a French d’Anjou rose was a great accompaniment to the deliciously spicy dishes. So overall well worth a visit for the unique experience – and based on our experience our recommendation would be to stick with the Malay dishes.Show less

Author: KerryScouseKellySydney, Australia
Title: Very nice but a little overpriced
Review: Located in the rainforest gardens of the very lovely Datai hotel the setting is great - we even saw a couple of Monkeys in the nearby trees and the local wildlife noises all added to the atmosphere. As we have come to expect in Langkawi the staff we both friendly and attentive....if fact given the place was fairly quiet they may have been a little too attentive with 5 staff in as many minutes come to ask us how we were enjoying our meal and if they could get us anything else....but we can forgive them that.The food was tasty. I opted for the traditional mango salad and my hubby the soft shell crab. We shared curries for main - the butter chicken and beef in coconut along with accompaniments.We enjoyed the evening, the food, the service and the setting but compared to our previous evenings meals at La Sal @ Casa del Mar and Privelage we didn't feel The Gulai House was very good value at over double the price but not necessarily better food.Show less

Author: houb b
Title: Very nice setting and very good food
Review:
The service is very, very good and it is a good place to try authentic Malay cuisine...I particularly loved Beef Randeng and fish there....I did not like chicken dishes there though.
It is pricy...more in the range of $60/ person

Author: expatdave77
Title: Atmospheric!
Review: The food is great and the atmosphere is awesome! It is pricey but for a special treat, it was well worth it.

Author: Beeptwice
Title: Great food an service. Pay with cash
Review: Service was excellent as was the food. Be aware as we had issues with our credit cards and unauthorized charges post eating there. I would suggest paying with cash.

Author: TravellerAnge
Title: Hidden treasure
Review: Excellent Malaysian and Indian food in an isolated rainforest location filled with the sound of frogs - just magic.  The food was fantastic served with a smile.

Author: PeterR931
Title: Rainforest setting and great food
Review:
This is the authentic Malaysian restaurant at the Datai Resort. The actual restaurant is built of beautiful polished hardwood timbers with a thatched roof in the middle of the rainforest. 

Very friendly service and great food

Well worth a visit

Author: Looksee999Southern Highlands, Australia
Title: Exotic location and fantastic food!
Review: The Gulai House is a one off dining experience. The food – Indian and Malay cuisines are the stars of the show. But the restaurant’s décor and jungle setting is the stage for this extraordinary dining experience. Located deep in the jungle, you will find this setting romantic and wondrous. You will dine on fabulous food while enjoying the sound of the frogs and night life in the background. The Datai and the Andaman hotels offer a complementary shuttle service to the Gulai House. A thoroughly enjoyable experience – don’t miss it!Show less

Author: GlobeTrotter010Orpington, United Kingdom
Title: Extremely pleasant experience
Review: Sometimes its the little personal things that make a dinning experience memorial. Like a large leaf with your name and date on and welcome message written and placed on your table. Or if you return they remember your name and room number. This place has great food, brilliant service and a lovely setting.Show less

Author: HRHSoraya
Title: Dining in fine style in the Rain Forest never gets better than this
Review:
My review is very biased as my partner Chef Conny Andersson spearheaded the reopening and the exotic menu @Gulai House 
However don't just take my word for it .
A romantic spot .Luxury Dining .Food that stimulates your every sense.

Expensive ,but worth it .

Author: CarmenR61
Title: My mouth waters
Review: This is the best restaurant on the Island.  Food is to die for.  Curries, location in the jungle, desserts, service, wine list. Can't be beaten!

Author: Jaimecml
Title: Good food but pricey
Review: The food was good (tasty, etc) but for the price paid, I would have expected larger serves!

Author: AJCG
Title: Disappointing. Food OK. High prices. Not worth it.
Review: Restaurant based around the swimming pool - think the real restaurant is being rebuilt? Food was Indian/Malay... very nice but very average especially for the price. Environment very pleasant and staff helpful, attentive etc.... There are much better places to go,,,..

Author: LarryKL
Title: Time for a change
Review: Just returned from Datai Bay only to find out that the Gulai house is under renovation.  Or perhaps more than that. It is being moved/rebuilt.  Hope they can meet our expectations with the 'new' Gulai house after being clients for so many years.

Author: USMC503Bothell, Washington
Title: You must try this place
Review: My wife and I spent about a week in Langkawi back in March or April 2009, and I must say, this place is great! We didn't intend on ever eating here, but we stumbled upon it after walking down the beach at night from, if I recall correctly, the Andaman (we drove to the hotel and parked there). We sat down (no reservation of course, but the place wasn't at all busy), and ordered some food. The food was a tad expensive for being Malaysia, but that is somewhat expected considering it's location (very close to the beach, next to The Datai Hotel). The food was excellent and they even made us a simple souvenir - a leaf they wrote our names and "The Gulai House" on. To make things even better, since it was dark and the tide was coming in when we were done eating, we went up to the hotel (Datai) and they gave us a ride over to the Andaman so we could get our car! Pretty cool place, great experience (sad to see the reviewer below missed out).P.S. I you walk the beach at night, you can see little sand crap scamper across the beach and run into their holes when you shine your flashlight on them.Show less

Author: Coconatty
Title: Interesting and Yummy!
Review: The food and entertainment was superb.  We had a lovely night and enjoyed the authentic feel of the Gulai House.  The only let down was the wine was extremely overpriced.

Author: perthaustinsPerth, Australia
Title: Great service and good food
Review: On arrival we noticed a leaf that had our names painted on it with our booking date, so we are off to a good start. All entrees and mains ha bags of flavour, and really gave me an impression of India. The garlic naan bread was light with a subtle crunch to it. The service was attentive without being overbearing, which was simply perfect. To finish the night we walked out of the restaurant and followed the beach path back to the andaman.Food 7/10 service 9/10 decor 7.5/10Show less

Author: TheBiffsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food & wine
Review: Ate here twice. Nice rustic setting, on the beach but not sure if you can actually see the ocean as we only went there after dark. There is a std seating section, and another where you can sit on the floor. Both times was good. The soft shell crab starter is amazing, also loved the morning glory and the saucy prawn dish which contained tamarind etc.Show less

Author: 1948dmcPenn
Title: Overpriced for mediocre food
Review: Tried this restaurant whist staying at The Andaman. Whilst the setting is ok the food is at best mediocre and vastly overpriced. We have better food at our local town at home at a third of the price.We tried to book a table for 8.00pm only to be told they could only do 7.30pm, when we got there only one table was occupied and by the time we left no more than six tables were in use.Show less

Author: kanymore
Title: Nice Atmosphere, but overpriced
Review: The Gulai House is one of the best places if you like to have a nice Indian Dinner in the "Jungle". It's just five minutes away by car from the Datai, or you can also walk on your own along the beach. The staff seems to be friendly, but my wife and me still argue if they were just friendly at our desk and were joking behind us, as we were not so common how to order the single dishes and which which one fits best to the other ;) But finally we ordered the right combinations with the strong support of the waiter and were fully satisfied about the taste! All in all a nice evening if you don't look at the prices as you easily spend 60€ per person for a dinner including some drinks. Show less

Author: KLSarah
Title: So good we had to go back.
Review:
Amazing Indian and Malay food in a delightful rainforest setting.  
Biggest problem was trying to choose what to eat as it all sounds so good.  Only solution was to go back again!
Staff are so friendly and service is superb.

Author: Cherryburners
Title: Tasty Malay / Indian food in beachside open wooden restaurant
Review: Nice food. Quiet when we went and atmosphere a but subdued. Service almost reverential. No more expensive than hotel dinner and made a nice change. Romantic. Walkable bare foot along the beach.  Be prepared for the ghost crabs.

Author: rabidcowPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Incredible Malaysian Cuisine!!!
Review: While staying @ The Andaman next door for a quick weekend respite, we went over to Gulai House having read reviews both for and against it. Armed with a certain degree of skepticism, we were pleasantly surprised with the result.The food was incredible!!! This is coming from a true blood Malaysian! The Beef Rendang was definitely the highlight of the night while the Satay managed to hold its own! The Satay (Peanut) sauce was plain incredible.The setting amidst the rain forest was pretty brilliant as well, but the path leading to it from the Andaman requires a lot of work. Stumbling through the night in the dark with a muddy and ill defined path is not really our cup of tea.The service, as expected, was just so-so and well below par if we consider this a fine dining restaurant (since the prices are definitely premium for local fare). All in all, the food was incredible and enough to put all other shortcomings into the pale.Show less

Author: rmk029
Title: One of the best in Langkawi
Review: Have the crab soup - awesome.  A bit hard to get to if you aren't staying at the Datai, but worth the trip.

Author: fbt09092019Hong Kong
Title: Arrogant receptionist can ruin a nice restaurant
Review: We went there for our 10 years wedding anniversary dinner, and guess what happened? We walked in to the amazing restaurant set in the middle of a forest. We were really looking forward to it having read many great reviews and also having drove 45 minutes to The Datai. The nature near the restaurant was amazing and we even saw wildlife monkeys on the way to the restaurant. However.... below is the first 20 minutes of our experience at the restaurantUs: "Hi, we asked our ABC hotel to book a table for us under the name XXX"Receptionist: "Sorry, we don't have any booking under the name XXX"Us: "Are you sure? Because we booked a table 2 days ago"Receptionist: "We have a booking under the name XYZ from ABC hotel but not the name XXX"Us: "OOO... could you please do something for us as we are coming here for our 10 years wedding anniversary?"[Observation: the receptionist was not pleased, but she reluctantly agreed to find a table for us. Bear in mind that at the time when we walked into the restaurant, the restaurant was pretty much empty with only 2 tables being occupied.]Receptionist: "Please come this way, we have organised a table".[We were ushere to a table at the back of the restaurant, furtherest away from the front which you can see the beach and the sunset in a distance. We looked at all the empty tables in front of us and thought what the H...?]Us: Excuse me, could we please have a better table, may be table closer to the front? It is our 10 years wedding annivesary. We could not really see the sunset from here.Receptionist: Congratulations! Sorry, no other tables are available.[In the meantime, the sun contined to set.... and all the other tables remained unoccupied. I tried to call my own hotel to double the booking. My hotel promised to follow up directly with the Gulai House. In the meantime, my 3 years old was saying he was hungry so I had to order some food for him.][After waited for about 10 minutes...]Us: Did our hotel try to call your restaurant?Waitress A: Let me check for you.Receptionist: Yes, they did. They said they have made a reservation but we have record of it.Us: So, could you try to move us to a better table at all given that it is our 10 years wedding anniversary? This table really has no view and we are going to miss our sunset.Receptionist: Sorry, we only We have a booking under the name XYZ from ABC hotel but not the name XXX"[At that point, only 3-4 table were occupied, and the sun continued to set. She was basically giving us the "take it or leave it" attitude and could not care less...][We werent' quite expecting this kind of service at a resturant inside a 5 stars hotel. So, we decided to stand up and leave the restaurant.]Waitress A: Sorry mam, you already ordered a childmeal and the kitchen is already cooking it![Obviously, they were not allowing us to walkout without paying for the childmeal!]Us: The service here is awlful, we are leaving this restaurant.Waitress A: But the kitchen has already starting cooking the childmeal[?????]Us: Get me a car back to the hotel reception or get me your managerReceptionist: Please sit downUs: For what?Receptionist: Please sit downUs: Sit down to wait for our transport or your managerReceptionist: Please sit downUs: We do not want to talk to you anymore.[Finally, the manager came.][The manager tried to defend the receptionist and still claimed that they could not find out reservation although our hotel has checked its log and has recorded that they have made a reservation for us.][I told the manager there was really no point in investigating into the reservation history. He finally allowed us to pick a table we preferred. But by that time, the sun had almost set.]We stayed at the end as The Datai was just too far away from all the other places and my 3 years old was starving and we were determined not to let the Receptionist ruin our 10 years wedding anniversary. You should also note that the restaurant had not offered us any free drinks or free desert having put us through the whole drama....It was such a shame - the restaurant was situated in a nice place and the curry was actually not bad... the waiters who served us for the rest of our evening were nice.Show less

Author: DavidK134
Title: Outstanding!
Review: Ate there twice, quite one of the best meals and setting we have had, with superb food, outstanding people looking after you and a price that did not break the bank.

Author: volvoc70mSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very overpriced, food was great, nice setting between the Andaman and The Datai Hotel
Review: Food was very very overpriced!! Rice was at RM$17 and 1 garlic Naan was also at RM$17. Normal squid dish was at RM$80 if i am not wrong. Ridiculous pricing quite honestly, but the food was very good, but it wasnt worth the price at all. I had the same combination of dish at Orkid Ria at Pantai Cenang and it only cost me RM$170. This meal of squid, seabass fish fillet, naan, rice, vegetables and garlic prawns and a bottle of Evian cost me RM$470. As for the ambience, its a nice place, service was mediocre and usually catered for guests putting up at The Andaman and The Datai, otherwise its too far away, least 40mins by cab from the city centre.Show less

Author: amer aeverywhere
Title: Beautiful location, excellent service, mediocre and extremely overpriced food
Review: You feel like you are in the middle of the forest and you are. The location is stunning. It is like a hut on stilts open to the environemment on 3 sides. We went there tonight - 3 adults and 2 kids, as we were staying at the nearby Andaman. There is an a la carte menu and a prix fixe menu. We opted for the a la carte - the prix fixe was about USD 60 per person for a min of 2 people. We ordered the chef's choice appetizer plate. I found a hair in it and sent it back. Out came another plate, and the appetizers were so-so. We also got crab soup - the broth was similar to french onion soup. Not bad, but nothing to write home about. Each of the adults got an entree - my wife and her mom had the fish which they said was good. I had the tandoori platter which was mediocre at best. I agree with one of the other reviewers who said the food is no better than the local carry out back home.The sherbet for desert on the other hand was outstanding. Served in an ice bowl, it tasted like fresh mango.I would not go back here - nor would I recommend this place to other guests. There are too many other places on the island that have much more memorable food for less than a third of the cost. Speaking of cost, for 3 adults, two kids, no alcohol - the bill was USD 240. Extremely expensive for average to poor food, but you are also paying for the atmosphere and location. For finding hair in my food, I would have expected some discount off the bill, but that did not happen.Show less

Author: ms62
Title: Gulai House magic
Review: A fantasitic restaurant situated between the Andmana Hotel where we stayed and teh Datai. Located just off the beach, from where you can walk from both hotels. Beatiful food and services and authentic feel.

Author: Adelaide5000Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great service and wonderful food
Review: AFter having eaten at the Andaman for 3 nights and being seriously over the Japanese restaurant and their other restaurant we found the Gulai House food. It was a revelation - and the kids menu was excellent too. Our 5 year old daughter said the chicken was the best she had ever had. We went two consecutive nights. The first evening we chose from the normal menu, and the food was fantastic. The little touch of painting a welcome greeting with your name on a leaf and the date you were there was special. The service was great and we could not fault it. So we rebooked for the following night. The leaf had 'welcome back' this time and we went with their special Malay banquet rather than the menu. We are fans of the 'bring me food' approach to restaurants. The food was really good, though WAY too much of it. We probably enjoyed the first dinner most, perhaps because we didn't know what to expect and the whole thing was magical.They are surprising child friendly too!Show less

Author: jputnikNew York City, New York
Title: Very Expensive Take-Out Quality Food
Review: If you are staying at the Datai or Andaman, it's a bit of a pain to get food outside the hotel, but I would still recommend making the trek rather than eating at the Gulai House. The food was fine, nothing wrong with it. It tasted kind of like the food from our take-out place back home. But of course the price was another matter. The Gulai House can, and do, charge whatever they want, as their patrons are geographically compelled to eat there. And, of course, they don't have to provide anything more than just edible food, which is precisely what they do. Based on the value for money ratio, I would not recommend this restaurant and I certainly would not eat there again if in Langkawi.Show less

Author: smenneKuala Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast off the main road.
Review: We arrived at 10 30, so well after opening time. There were a few tables occupied and the staff seemed stressed out as we entered. Hence the not so welcoming entrance. We were then informed that we would have a 35mn wait cause they were busy. Not feeling wanted but actually the capuccino came promptly and the breakfast shortly after. So it was not so long and bad afterall. The price came to 10 euros per person.The ambiance is nice. Show less

Author: JPizz_86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent Food
Review: Location and food quality is decent, but service was terrible, it was also clear that other tables were frustrated at how bad they are, one table even walked out without paying cause those food never came and the drinks were slow! Go here if you don’t mind very slow serviceShow less

Author: CapricornKL
Title: Cravings fulfilled
Review: Each trip to Langkawi, my first stopover and meal would be the Nyonya Laksa served only on fatCUPID. The soup /broth is flavourful and has just the right amount of richness to it. And you can never go wrong with their Espresso Martini. Perfect together, perfect taken separately.Show less

Author: kdks
Title: Excellent once again!
Review: We came back to this restaurant after the long lockdown and were not disappointed as always. The food is exceptional and of course Jacky and Karina's company was even better. And as always we will be back again got the authentic food.

Author: Wildcat7400Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Food & Service
Review: We finally got the chance to dine in this restaurant after 3 yearly attempts whenever we were in Langkawi. We had to make reservations due to the Covid-19 pandemic. When we arrived, we were told to note down our particulars & have our body temperature checked before being ushered to our table. Our 30-something waitress was very friendly & helpful. She gave us recommendations & 2 of my friends decided to follow her suggestions. One had the lemon butter snapper & the other had chicken while another friend & I had the same beef burger order. While the fish was exceptionally good, the chicken was just average & the 2 buns of my beef burger were cold. Hence, I had requested them to grill them again. We shared 2 types of salad & one was better than the other though I could not remember which was the better one. The 2 were the calamari salad & the pumpkin & mango salad. For dessert, we also shared 2 types of dessert. Unfortunately, the one which was recommended by the waitress was not nice at all. It was something peculiar, an acquired taste which many may not agree with. Imagine having chilli caramel as a dessert. At least, my order of coconut sago was delicious. Overall, service was slow but perhaps it was due to the fact that there were so many customers dining-in at the same time. The ambience was cosy but it was a little warm although we had 2 fans located nearby.One visit is enough for me.Show less

Author: martinkP4921HMCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Langkawi's best
Review: We visit Langkawi often and always make a trip to dine at fatCUPID a priority. It is really tough to find fault with this hidden gem, the service is just brilliant and the staff are always so helpful and great fun - they really add to your positive dining experience and the food is simply delicious. Try it - you will not be disappointed Show less

Author: SHarvey95
Title: Great food and drinks
Review: Good variety on the menu and great quality in the food. Drinks menu also very ranging. Enthusiastic, approachable and personable staff make a lovely atmosphere.

Author: 477jessicaBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food and good service
Review: We have eaten here twice in four days its that good. The kids love the burgers and fish and chips, huge portions for them but they almost finish. Us grown ups love the Malaysian food. I'm a vegetarian so delighted to have a few delicious options including tempeh rendang. Great value for such good food. Show less

Author: Gabriella HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: Our first night in Langkawi and visited Fat Cupid on recommendation of a friend. Food was delicious with generous portions. Great drinks menu with a great selection of cocktails and gins. Service was fantastic, our host going out of her way to provide recommendations of things to do during our stay on the island. Recommend a night time visit, it has a lovely ambience. Highly recommend :)Show less

Author: Iggies64Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cozy place of a side street with great big, good meals!
Review: Down a lane way we made our way to the restaurant. Tried the fried wontons for starters which were nice. Our host was friendly, informative of the island, the accommodation available, the history of the restaurant as well as attending to meals and cocktail types. It made for a relax full, friendly evening.The mains we bought were the Laksa (which was a huge bowl) as well as beef rendang and a chicken dish I can’t recall the name of, but all got the thumbs up.Might just go back for the gin varieties!Show less

Author: Daisy22dooNerja, Spain
Title: A must visit for the Island
Review: It was so good we had breakfast and came back for dinner! The staff are so friendly and make you feel so welcome. The breakfast was lovely and made a change as we rarely eat western breakfast. Beef sausage and bacon was divine and a huge portion I vouldnt finish! The dinner..... amazing!
