I had 2 cocktails, So good I had the Go Lightly, Pimms with mint vodka and lychee, twice. The beef Rendang was tasty and balanced so well. The chicken Curry was also so good and just the right amount of spice for us as we've spicy. We will be back many times in our stay. Thank you. Highly recommend the Fat Cupid for breakfastlunch or dinner.Show less

Author: easterndazeEurope
Title: Excellent food, and relatively awkward service
Review: The food we had at Fat Cupid was absolutely wonderful, and a highlight in Malaysia, even if pricing is relatively high. They are really just cooking at cooking everything, and it feels. The malaysian curries are a notch above most places, and the continental food is really good. The person who serves us was very awkward unfortunately, a strange mix between waiting for us to bus, being too stressed out, and treating us like it's victorian England again. Strange, and somewhat unpleasant if you don't like awkwardly and pushily being treated like royalty.Show less

Author: russellj691Eccles, United Kingdom
Title: Sadly left a little disappointed with the service !!
Review: As we’ve experienced before the food is 1st class, but sadly this time the service has let it down.We ordered a starter of Chicken & Beef Satay skewers and mains of Beef Rendang and a Beef Hor Fun, having waited whilst others around us starters appeared suddenly our main meals arrived. We agreed not to make a fuss and agreed that if we were still hungry after we would raise our issue. The quality of the mains were very good and filling and we didn’t need to re order the starter. We then ordered a small bottle of water, after 10-15 minutes no water arrived, we asked for the bill, paid it, got our change and then the waiter brought the water, which we kindly declined.It should be noted that the Satay skewers weren’t on the bill and obviously forgotten completely and the water didn’t feature either.We will return again as the food is excellent, just need to brush up on the service.I hope this review is accepted in a positive manner, see you soon.Show less

Author: ben787878
Title: Sophisticated little restaurant.
Review: A little pricier than other establishments nearby but the food is very well made and presented. Great service and lovely atmosphere.

Author: SunSunSunshineNorth Finchley, United Kingdom
Title: Check the bill!
Review: This is a pleasant restaurant with good food. The service is friendly. I would have given it 4 stars but when our bill arrived we found that we had been charged 80 MYR instead of 19 per glass of Shiraz. That is quite a hefty difference and not a slip or a typo which can easily be done. They corrected the bill with no quibble but also no great apology. It all left a very sour taste in our mouths.Show less

Author: MancJRGWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Great experience
Review: This place is situated just off the main road (down a poorly lit track) but worth finding. We visited quite late for an evening meal and got the last table, so might be an idea to book beforehand.The menu caters for local and western dishes and is very well priced. Staff serve you quickly and nice atmosphere in restaurant. We hope to visit again to try more dishes - well done team. Show less

Author: Taroko28
Title: Good Food
Review:
Food is fantastic. Staffs were attentive and friendly! 
Would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Langkawi!

Author: Nahtupatu
Title: Very good food, good service
Review: Very good food, good service and atmosphere.  I recommend this place!  The place is a little hidden, but it doesn't matter!

Author: XYcat13
Title: Nice food, environment and service
Review: Friendly staff and good service. A very nice environment to dine in. Reasonable price with the food portions.

Author: 580jannPaphos, Cyprus
Title: Fabulous
Review: We visited after checking out TripAdvisor excellent food very attentive service , my husband likes a curry but cant take it too spicy so they adjusted the strength by adding coconut milk which made it just right for him ,would definitely go again before the end of our holidays Show less

Author: wyoiling
Title: Big serving size
Review: We were here for dinner. Location is off path and we took a Grab to reach here. Ambient was ok but the food is beyong expectation. Serving size is big and they are generous to provide you decent and good ingredients. We thought only the western food is good but their local dishes is equally tasty. We should have order less dishes cause we are small eater. Do bring mosquitoes repellent is you want to visit there in the evening cause that's the only issue we faced in the restaurant. and yes, no outside beer allowed. We accidentally brought in 1 can of beer so we drank it immediately. :)Show less

Author: RoyStormerGuangzhou, China
Title: AWESOME FOOD!!
Review: We stayed at this hotel and were shocked how much we enjoyed the food at the restaurant. The burgers are massive and actually seasoned!! They have flavor in the patties which is a welcome change and the fries are nice and fresh. We really enjoyed the wontons and the satay as well. My favorite was the beef rendang! It has a hint of coconut flavor and I loved the spices in it as well. It is a very nostalgic dish for me and they nailed it. The breakfasts are HUGE! We loved them all and ended up not needing to eat lunch. Come hungry! We also tried a couple desserts. We enjoyed the "spicy" dessert and the brownies with ice cream. Their sangria's are delicious! The blanco and rojo were our favorites and the make a mean gin and tonic as well. We did not have a bad meal here and once we ate here once we did not leave. The staff is also excellent. They were so friendly, helpful and warm. They really seek to enjoy being in the service industry and it shows. We miss them already!Show less

Author: chriswH3834HIMorpeth, United Kingdom
Title: Cracking little place to eat at
Review: We were looking for somewhere to try a Malaysian beef rang Dan. We were recommended this place by a friend ..and we were not disappointed. Staff were so nice and friendly .food was really good .prices were fair .atmosphere was relaxed .its a couple of hundeed yrds of the main road by pretty well lit.All in all a good night outShow less

Author: seastream2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: From hero to zero
Review: From hero to zeroWe used to love the food in this place and have visited twice in the past 1.5 years while in Langkawi.However today during the CNY when we brought our family (7 pax) the experience was so embarrassing and even offensive that I just can't imagine what an earth happened to them.Our ordering process was easy and smooth: 5/7 of the party ordered burgers, one the recommended celebrational fish and one rendang + a salad as an appetizer. We ordered a bottle of pinot gris but received a sauvignon blanc instead (no appologies, no recognition to customer that they were providing something else than what was ordered). However the wine was nice and we were okay with it, so let this one go.The burgers came with the salad and everyone enjoyed their food so far. BUT then started the waiting for the two main course and after asking for them for two separate times (when the entire rest of the party had already finished eating and it had become a bit embarrassing already) I had to physically to go to the counter and ask for the ETA for the food (as the rest of our party included kids and they wanted to leave already).THIS is where it got very interesting as when I asked after about our food as we had waited like a half an hour, asian looking (blonded hair) older lady just snapped back at me "which table are you??" (..like a customer would know their table number), "the big table??". I immediately said, I don't feel it's fair that after all this waiting not a single soul has said sorry. Even one time. The lady had the nerve to shout at me that "you have ordered 20min ago! Not half an hour!" And just rushed to kitchen and left me stading there. The manner she was communicating was absolutely horrible and I couldn't even say a word to the male waitress after, I was just so astonished of the manner I had just been shouted at in a situation that THEY had screwed up.I took a seat in my table and the older asian lady comes to the table and screams again "you have waited for 20 minutes!" (Which is NOT TRUE. There had been over 20 minutes when the whole other party had received their main course) so I asked "so do you really think thats an appropriate time to wait?" In which she snapped "well this is the way we do things around here!" and left. No appologies, not a single ounce of caring about anything - just scolding the customer in front of the entire table of people.. I literally have nothing else to say that my fish which I FINALLY got was dry and over cooked and the beans around it were way too raw to eat so I had to leave them. The fish was also not seasoned properly but lets face it: On that point I just wanted to get away from the place, not even bothering to send the portion back as I felt so uneasy about the way I had just been scolded..I have to say I'm speechless. Horrible experience and also what on earth happened to the food? This used to be my favourite and now I can never imagine to return. EMBARRASSING.Show less

Author: JyriJ
Title: Hidden gem
Review:
This is supreme and it's a hidden gem. Best service in island. I recommend try their laksa. Its spice but so good.

This one you need to try!

+food
+service
+price

-nothing

Author: L9885SVjohnfEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Worth visiting
Review: We went to Fat Cupid in two occasions. The first for local food and the second because we fancied western and their burgers are homemade.The food and service were both very good, and the environment is quite pleasant with the restaurant overlooking the garden and pool. Prices are a little higher than elsewhere but so is the general quality of the offering.The only reason they didn’t get five stars was because although the dish was tasty, the quality of the meat in the rendang was poor. I’m fine with lower quality meat in a curry, but it needs cooked longer to stop it being chewy and sinewy, and unfortunately this wasn’t cooked long enough. Overall, a pleasant experience and worth a visit.Show less

Author: toniandlewistravelsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Veggie Malaysian food
Review: A beautiful little restaurant at the end off a small road not far from the beach. The vegetarian options were fantastic and very reasonably priced! We ended up eating here twice because we liked the food that much! We had both the pumpkin and sweet potato masak lemak and the rendang Tempe which was incredible! A booking isn’t necessary but at around 8 o’clock it does get very busy so may be worth it if you are a larger party. Well worth a visit! Show less

Author: freyacarbone
Title: Delicious!
Review: We enjoyed two lovely dinners here. The food and drinks were amazing and all the staff were friendly and welcoming. Absolutely loved the "Spicy Blondie" dessert. Highly recommend!

Author: mbk09Norwich, United Kingdom
Title: A real find! Be sure to book...
Review: Loved this place - down an unassuming lane off the main road, but a real find. A small, pretty restaurant in nice surroundings with friendly, attentive staff and a great menu. We hadn't made a reservation but were lucky enough to get a walk-in as another party had cancelled - make sure you book. The food was excellent!Show less

Author: GeoBarn
Title: Amazing food and very gentle people
Review: Amazing people in the restaurant very polite and gentle...also the food was amazing one of the best foods i have ever had! Tasteful big portion and clean ;)

Author: 39trevorl
Title: Absolute favourite
Review: Undoubtedly one of my favourite places to dine,  service is always good and food is fantastic. Local dishes are excellent and western dishes just as good. I would highly suggest one visit in your time in Langkawi

Author: leewarinPerth, Australia
Title: Rescue Mission
Review: Looked up the reviews on this place and they weren’t wrong - excellent setting, cool surroundings and amazing food. I had the Beef Rendang which was the best, my wife had food envy but also enjoyed the chicken burger. We will be back and she will Beef Rendang upon return. Show less

Author: EriKyt
Title: Excellent restaurant with great service
Review:
We visited this restaurant twice in our holiday and both times, it was great experience.
Food is absolutely delicious and service couldn't be better. 
The location is little bit outside main street but it doesn't bother at all.

Author: ChuanSong
Title: Good service and great food.
Review:
Good service and great food.
The service were very polite and always checks on us without interrupting our conversation. Fantastic attention to the experience for the customers. Will return again when possible.

Author: I5964CFjeanm
Title: Did Not Disappoint!!
Review: Was rated highly and met expectations!Service was very professional and friendly!Food was delicious! I had the Laksa, so good! So much flavor! Portion size was good. Lots of meat chicken, meatballs, prawn. Noodles, long beans, mint, bean sprouts, so good!Very comfortable, quiet spot.Show less

Author: Chanshane1
Title: Good ambience. Friendly staff. Average food
Review: Our hotel was within walking distance so gave it a try. Food was average but the staff made the experience better. The laksa was thick and a little curry like. Price was a little high considering the place and surrounding. All in all ok dinner. We wanted to try the breakfast but they only open at 9am.Show less

Author: bacci1977Frankfurt, Germany
Title: Great allround talent
Review: Went to FatCupid several times, driven by the good comments here. Three times for dinner and once for breakfast. They were all right. Very friendly and attentive staff. Food quality on high level. Highly recommendable: Beef Rendang, Curry Kaptain, Beef hor fun. Even, as a surprise , Linguine Carbonara with salmon was a blast. If you have capacity left, go for the spicy Blondie ........ Show less

Author: BeijingFrecklefaceOatley, Australia
Title: Wonderful food
Review: We were staying just a short walk away from FatCupid and have eaten there on three occasions during our four day stay - brunch, dinner and a breakfast. We would probably eaten have eaten here more except that they close on Mondays! We like to eat local food when we travel so ate laksa, wonton soup, fish soup and a beef stir-fry. All were extremely tasty and presentation was beautiful. If we ever return we would most definitely eat here again. Thank you to the very friendly and welcoming staff.Show less

Author: Aiste B
Title: Hidden gem
Review: Amazing place, great for a romantic dinner. Food is very tasty. After trying food elsewhere we decided to stick to this restaurant for our dinners while staying in Langkawi.

Author: Patrice SWestcliff-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: A gem!
Review: We went to Fat Cupid for two breakfasts and two dinners over our four nights on the island. The food was fantastic; they do a range of traditional Malay dishes as well as some western favourites and their breakfasts had a good range to suit most from a full English and a version of eggs Benedict through Nasi Lamak and Kaya toast!The staff are so lovely and take are genuinely interested in your views of the food they serve. You are greeted like an old friend!Show less

Author: coachmelleowMelbourne, Australia
Title: Cupid with a little bit of sting
Review: Was excited to go here because of the rating. Love the relaxed ambience, and the overall simplicity of the place.  And yet not impressed with the food. I ordered the Beef Bacon and Eggs Sandwich and Latte. Just didn't quite hit the spot, a little pricey for that quality. Perhaps I could have gone with the recommendation... Something with Pumpkin or the InFamous Wantons next time. ⭐️Still gave it a 4 Stars. Try it for yourself and let me know.  Show less

Author: kamc2017London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing!
Review: Visited with my family, on arriving the welcoming was warm and friendly. We had a mixed satay of chicken and beef. The accompanying peanut sauce was spicy and just a great combination. The meat was tender and tasty. Chicken won tons were just fabulous! Our mains were nice and hot and as tasty as the starters. Well done to the management! We will be back. Show less

Author: 709shawngPerth, Australia
Title: Off the beaten track gem
Review: Ambling up a typical Malay backroad you come to fat Cupid. After arriving at 6 for dinner we ordered a burger and ling fish. The burger was homemade and what I would expect but the ling fishSpecial if the day was exceptional, flavourful and well cooked. Not being desert people (even thou wife is a pastry chef) we ordered the churros and poached pears. The ice cream was deep and rich chocolate which complimented both dishes. There was also no holding back in regard to the alcohol content of the cocktails. The bill was a lot less than expected and would have been happy to pay much more, as I see to often on reviews about cost but I think people forget where they are from, the fish dish alone would have cost us almost the entire meals cost back home. Will return, find the sign, wonder up the road, over the power line ( if your walking you’ll see what I mean) you won’t regret it. Show less

Author: 948irfanqLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: Great food! Def worth the visit! One thing tho; We were 30 min early as the restaurant opened at 6 so we could not order yet. We could totally understand.What we did find odd is that we were not even aloud to order drinks! The fridge was literally next to us but the waitress just denied :/ Show less

Author: paulr412Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food and friendly staff!
Review: Really enjoyed my meal here! It's a little off the beaten track but easy to find from the main road. The resturant is really relaxed and decor reminded me of a Greek taverna. All the staff are really friendly abs chatty.We had the burger, laksa and brownie. The laksa was huge could off easily shared it and I got no where near finishing it was delious and probably the best laksa I have had in Malaysia.The bill come to about £18 and for the quality of the food was totally worth it.I would recomend to come here.Show less

Author: HarrietJ131
Title: Delish Brunch
Review: Lovely ambience, great service and fantastic food (staff were happy to make an alteration for me vegetarian needs). Would recommend!!

Author: dawn644
Title: Great
Review: Breakfast and dinner here wonderful ..clean and pleasant surroundings. Excellent menu, staff are the best 👍👍 helpful and attentive

Author: cwbush83Armidale, Australia
Title: A culinary treasure
Review: FatCupid was one of the culinary highlights of our three week Southeast Asian honeymoon. My wife’s laksa and my tempe rendang we’re both delicious, as was the appetiser sampler we split - the pizza and wontons were exquisite. The sangria was flavourful, the music was lovely, and the friendly staff were attentive and easy to chat with. We’ll be back!Show less

Author: CommandoBri
Title: great food great staff
Review:
what can I say it's the third time my wife and I have ate there and never been disappointed 
recommend this is one of the places you eat while visiting langkwai

Author: katieholibags
Title: Family holiday
Review: Excellent food, excellent service and lovely setting. Ticks all the boxes. Staff couldn't do more. So many lovely places to eat in area.

Author: Angela S
Title: Dinner last night
Review: Very friendly staff. Great food especially laksa, pumpkin and mango salad. Quick service, good clean restaurant 5stars

Author: GGAdelaide
Title: Dinner
Review: We ate here yesterday.  Four different meals.  All delicious, excellent service.  Beef rendang, laksa, mango and tofu salad and a chicken curry.  Beautifully served in a modern setting by a pool that diners can use if they want.  Couples and families.

Author: Marketa M
Title: Delicious
Review: All we had was deliciaous and the staff was really helpful. I woudl recommend to get the topioca dessert

Author: Akasha2128London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, outstanding service and a great location.
Review: We firstly attended fat Cupid in the evening but unfortunately got there when they were about to close. We went back the next evening and did not regret any part of the meal. The waiter was highly knowledgable on all the dishes available and went through the menu, giving appropriate and excellent recommendations. One of my friends is a vegetarian and the waiter went out of his way to look after his dietary needs. I went for the Beef Rendang and asked for extra spice ( I LOVE spicy food and have an excellent tolerance). Hands down this was the best spicy beef rendang I have ever had. My other friend ordered the Laksa and was delicious. After all this, we were recommended to have dessert and without doubt the experience, the food, the freshness, the service was excellent. If you are in Penang, please visit this establishment. It should be the first place on the list to eat at. Show less

Author: J9279JTnataliepBucharest, Romania
Title: 1. Love 1. Indifferent
Review: Amazing how two people can come to the same restaurant and have such a different opinion as they leave. Me: had the house cocktail (has Malibu in it which believe me is rare these days). Was very different from anything I’ve had before. Thoroughly enjoyed and would’ve gladly had a 2nd. Also they use metal straws so thumbs up for the environment as well. Then I had a beef noodle dish. Was absolutely delicious. Big portion. Couldn’t finish it. My partner: ordered a negroni. Was not what he is used to. Was there interpretation. Very watery. He then had the Nasi Aram Pontay (hope I’ve spelt that right). Beautifully presented but a bit bland and boring. Service was excellent. Waiter offered to make my partner a new drink. Really nice little place. Not pretentious. Vegetarians can get a good meal here. I would come back, my partner wouldn’t. Show less

Author: 822sidneyr
Title: Good national food
Review:
For everybody who wants to eat delicious. 
Seek this restaurant. 

Especially beef rendag, spicy but so good! 
Also the people are very  nice and helpful. 
Furthermore last but not least the dessert 'not your mommy's sandwich' was excellent perfect.

Author: Senile-Dementor
Title: Tucked away restaurant serving excellent local cuisine and great service.
Review: This is the second time we have been to Fat Cupid and not disappointed. Its located away from the main drag but known to all the taxi drivers. Warm welcome when you arrive and seated in a covered outdoor setting. We had expresso martini's while we chose our starter (sharing plater)and main course (Laksa and chicken curry). Wine was reasonably priced for NZ SB. Food came quickly along with the wine. Water and wine glasses kept topped up. Main course was excellent for quality of ingredients, authentic flavours and portion size. We understand all ingredients are locally sourced and prepared in the kitchen. The Panna Cotta dessert is also worth mentioning as it finished the meal perfectly. Staff are friendly and chatty. Both visits have been good so would recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: fOoOOooOOoooDd
Title: very good
Review: the food here was very good i had the falafel wrap which was amazing however had a lot of sauce on it but that’s nothing major all of the food we had was very very nice and cheap and they gave us metal straws it was simple things like that , that really show how much love had gone into the place. Show less

Author: EJJ123456United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing not worth the hype
Review: We visited fatCUPID while staying in Pantai Tengah. First impressions were good, lovely friendly staff, nice atmosphere. Unfortunately the food was very disappointing. We ordered two beef rendang, one mild and one normal spice. They arrived both very (too) spicy and one had a tiny bit of cream poured on the top - clearly their attempt to make it mild. It was still far too hot for my 8 year old son. My daughter’s burger arrived full of toppings that she hadn’t ordered. This was taken back to the kitchen but the fries sat on the table and got cold while she waited for the burger to come back. When it arrived, the burger still had all the toppings that she hadn’t ordered but now was cold. It was also very tough and chewy. My fish and chips did not arrive until everyone had nearly fished their meals. Despite covering ourselves with mosquito spray, we are still feeling the ill effects of the bites from this outdoor restaurant 3 days later. We haven’t had problems with mosquitos anywhere else on the island and we have eaten outside every evening. It might be worth them spraying the outdoor areas.Show less

Author: liong j
Title: amazing food
Review: Too lazy to walk, just grab a bite from fat cupid. Love the local foods they prepared. Amazing drinks and service! recommended!

Author: 569gabbyc
Title: We love this place
Review:
We came here 4 times on our trip, mix of lunch and dinner. 
We love the food, definitely try the wontons they are the best. 
Staff are friendly and service is great.

Author: kirkh226
Title: Great little hidden sausage
Review: Hidden down a driveway which we drove past 3 times! But well worth it once found! Food was great. Ambience is beautiful - nice scenery and music playing. Staff are super friendly!

Author: jcjy77
Title: Lovely place
Review: The place was crowded at dinner time on a weekday! Best ro make reservations. We ordered their cocktails and some snacks. Both were good! We ordered a cocktail that was not on the menu, which didnt turn out as expected so I guess best to stick to their menu. Nice place to chill out with nice music.Show less

Author: Patrick L
Title: Good food
Review: The Food is very good and the staff is very friendly. The price is also very good and high choice of drinks.

Author: deziren1980
Title: Delicious all round
Review: A little hard to find, but worthwhile. The food was beautiful, the set-up serene and the price to match was excellent. It took a little while for our food (approx. 30 mins) but the wait was worth it.

Author: hayley_m04
Title: Sensational!
Review: Loved this restaurant and the staff were fantastic. Visited several times during our stay and would certainly go again.

Author: Steve H
Title: Great
Review: This stylish little place is a class act. Just won the family ‘best restaurant of the trip award’. Food was really good, service was excellent. It oozes style and charm. An off the beaten track location shouldn’t put you off.

Author: lilychung2574
Title: What A Let Down !!!
Review: Experience complete opposite to the reviews. Tasteless Tartar sauce and half cooked fries..how can it be so wrong?

Author: Nicm108
Title: Dinner
Review: Had dinner here after reading the reviews. Staff were amazingly friendly, and food delicious in a very pretty setting. The laksa was amazing!

Author: carpentariaDarwin, Australia
Title: Delightful
Review: My thanks to the other tfavel ad isors who wrote so well of this restaurant. The setting is relaxed, well off the main road surrounded by trees, next to a pool and in the shadow of some significant mountains. Very nice indeed.A great menu that I only had 2 days to sample but it will be re-visited on future trips.The Nonya laksa is superb and very filling. I sampled the Nasi Ayam Pontay the following day. It is superb accompanied by a small presentation of spices that are perfect for this meal.The Carlsberg beer is cold and sensibly priced. The staff are all happy to be there and eager to help. Add some light background music and you have the best lunchtime venue I've seen in Langkawi. Show less

Author: KeithTLLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Food and Location
Review: Read several good reviews and decided to visit. The food, drinks, location and staff were all excellent. We shared the Pumpkin and Mango salad with some Satay, the satay sauce was amazing. Definitely the best food we have had in Malaysia over the last couple of weeks.Show less

Author: Loulou75OzYallingup, Australia
Title: Superb
Review: So glad we walked down the track and found this restaurant. The food is excellent and fresh. One of the best meals we have eaten in Malaysia. We have been back a few times since holidaying here this week. The staff are so friendly, the setting is bright and clean and we can happily recommend this place. Kids loved their food too. Show less

Author: Julie G
Title: Delicious Dinner
Review: The best Dinner experience I have had in Langkawi. Staff so friendly and the food was amazing. So fresh, home made and delicious. Lovely ambience.

Author: simontP9792RO
Title: Must try
Review:
Beautiful food, great menu, terrific staff, very reasonable prices. 

Thank you fatCupid for the best food we’ve eaten in Malaysia (KL, Penang & Langkawi)

Will definitely be back!

Author: de6sHouston, Texas
Title: Good meal in a quiet setting
Review: I went here for dinner one night. Setting is really nice, pretty quiet overlooking the pool. Staff were very pleasant. Menu is extensive and reasonably priced. Had a fish dish that was really tasty, followed by the largest chocolate brownie I've ever seen. I should be ashamed to have eaten it all, but it was pretty damn tasty...Show less

Author: Kate LLondon
Title: Beautiful dinner(s) in Langkawi
Review: We came here on our second night of the holiday and we were so impressed that we came back a second time. My boyfriend had the Chicken curry Kapitan both nights as he loved it so much. We were greedy and ordered the sharing appetizer plus satay on the first visit and we were not disappointed although we were pretty full before the main course! The beef rendang was also amazing, absolutely full of flavour. For our second visit the restaurant was full which was lovely to see although the food did take a little longer to come out but we didn’t mind so much as we knew what to expect.A must visit restaurant if you are visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: benmG3824XD
Title: A must for foodies !!!
Review: After spending a great couple of weeks in Malaysia we found the food to be a little hit and miss at times, don’t get me wrong we ate some great food . But after 10 days or so the good dishes we were eating seemed to keep repeating themselves, and I was left thinking surely there’s more to Malaysian cuisine than just char kuey Teow.That was, until someone in our hotel (Holiday Villa Beach Hotel & Spa) suggested we take a small walk up the road to the hidden gem that is Fat Cupid restaurant. (It is just off of the main Pantai Tengah Road, up a small road which is next to Bam Boo Bar and Villa Molek!). From the moment we arrived it just felt different, wonderful staff, extremely friendly but at the same time very professional, clearly a very close and well run team. The menu arrived and straight away just wow, simply by the way it was written you just knew this chef knows their stuff. The waiting staff explained the dishes expertly which made choosing easy, we are greedy and chose 3 dishes between the 2 of us! When the food arrived It was very clear the chef was exactly that, a Chef! Each dish having depth of flavour but also it’s own individual tastes.If good food, a lovely hospitality and a great atmosphere is your thing this beautiful hidden restaurant will definitely be well worth the small walk off the high street! Thanks team Fat Cupid for a great two nights in a row! Ps. Not Malaysian, I know, but their Chocolate Brownie and Homemade Ice cream (named on the menu as Not Your Mamma’s Sandwich!) is to die for!! Show less

Author: Jacoztraveller
Title: Grandma knows how to cook
Review: We ate here 3 times on our trip to Langkawi. Tried the tasting plate, wontons, satay and grandmas curry. All so good! The staff are wonderful and will make your cocktail frozen if you ask. We loved it here and would definitely recommend.

Author: SalzagalbackpackerMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious food in a lovely setting
Review: The food here is very tasty - there is Malaysian style and western so everyone can be happy for breakfast and lunch. A lovely open setting with helpful staff. A bit more expensive than some smaller places like hornbill but still reasonable and it offers some interesting variety Show less

Author: 194julia52
Title: Excellent Dinner
Review: Had dinner here and it was heavenly.  Its down a lane off the main road so you have to look for the sign at the end of the road.  Charming hosts, delicious food and wine, perfect!

Author: chorp2018
Title: Bad experience
Review: Food is oily. And the sinature malaysia food nasi lemak is no taste at all. The price of breakfast average high! No recommend. Btw the service is good.

Author: JamieM1988Bearsden, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent dinner
Review: After a busy day out we visitors here for an early dinner and it was amazing! Staff were friendly and the food was great! We had the sharing starter followed by beef rendang and the beef dish on the daily specials. One of the best meals we had in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Trevor & Kellie... P
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Awesome food and service. Cocktails were amazing. Hidden down a long dark path but the service and food we were served was the best.

Author: FayeW741Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: The best customer service I’ve ever experienced
Review: We tried to get a table one night and they were full so we knew we had to go back. We were so pleased we did because it was the best food we had in Langkawi.We tried the beef curry off the menu and a beef dish off the special board , the wanton for starter and brownie for pudding . The food was lovely. However I want to thank the staff so their 5* customer service. From the moment we sat down we felt ‘at home’ in this lovely place. They all had a rapor with each other which rubbed off on the customers. We felt welcomed into their space.The couple on the table next to us even had a child free meal while one of the ladies looked after their baby... the baby loved it, and the couple had a break Show less

Author: 448liliank
Title: Delicious!
Review: The food and drinks were delicious!! Enough choice and home made. You should try the beef rendang. Staff was really friendly.

Author: 366kinvToronto, Canada
Title: Traditional food with a twist
Review: This restaurant is quite tucked away so we were lucky to find it, and so glad we did! Its an open-air restaurant but the fans and citronella candles make it a very pleasant dining experience. The food was delicious, and despite being a vegetarian I had lots of options to choose from. The drinks menu was great too. This is a much different vibe than the touristy nightlife of Cenang beach, but a great place to hang out if you're looking for something quieter and more classy. Definitely worth paying it a visit while you're in Langkawi.Show less

Author: EdinburghGirl91Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Laidback dining with veggie options
Review: We enjoyed our meal at fatCupid where the menu offers a range of Malaysian dishes and western options like burgers. Good veggie options were proving tricky to find in Langkawi so we were very grateful to find this gem. We loved the ‘not your mamma’s sandwich’ desert option too.Show less

Author: CCALLO88
Title: Bit expensive but tasty
Review: Yes it was a hit expensive compared to other places but rendang was really tasty. One thing to note, if you're a solo traveller, it's down an unlit path so you might not want to go there at night.

Author: MsLulu1977Bucharest, Romania
Title: Best food in Lankawi
Review: Visited here once during recent langkawi holiday. The food was a welcome change from the usual beach burgers and pizza. We had wonton to start followed by 2 main Malaysian dishes and 2 desserts plus 2 sangria and a bottle of wine. Bill was 265 Ringits which is super reasonable considering the amount and quality of food. Service was quick and friendly and the loos were very clean. The whole place was spotless with lots of mossie coils around to keep insects away. This place is not on the beach and you can't see the famous langkawi sunset from here bit if it is decent food you're after on the west coast then this is the best you're going to get on Langkawi. Show less

Author: ooigracie
Title: Excellent food and ambience
Review: Was a pleasant surprise for my family and I as the cafe was located quite deep in the housing area. First impression was wow! And of course food was excellent and great presentation skills. Humble staff and clean place.

Author: Steady
Title: Still Great
Review:
It is always a pleasure to visit this restaurant as the food is excellent and the staff are very friendly.
This restaurant is quite difficult to find and is at the end of quite a dark road but it is well worth a visit.

Author: locker22
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: We ate here every day whilst staying in Pentai Tengah, either for breakfast, lunch or dinner. All their food is exceptional and incredibly well priced considering the quality. The ambience is truly delightful, beautiful 1940s and 1950s music, perfectly kempt gardens, and friendly and attentive staff. Particularly amazing dishes are the chicken curries, the Spicy Blondie dessert, and literally all the cocktails and freezies. Do yourself a favour and eat here.Show less

Author: Panapur
Title: Ambience and Flavour
Review: A small operation, located off the main strip of Pentai Tengah has a unique and wonderful atmosphere. The outlook on the garden is refreshing to the eyes and the cuisine shows a personal touch such that they care about the details. While it is a tad pricier than other venues, you are paying for the freshest ingredients and fine service. Great music always being played gives the feel of a 1950s resort. Must try the delicious cocktails, watermelon daiquari, amazing desert: spicy blondie!Show less

Author: martinkP4921HMCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Wow! Such great food
Review: Fat Cupid was recommended to us by friends and we are so grateful for their advice. The food was stunning, so tasty, beautifully presented by staff that were super-attentive and proud of their very fine restaurant. Fat Cupid is also attached to a all hotel which also looked lovely. We will be eating there again when we return to Langkawi - a hidden gem Show less

Author: Kingkongkane
Title: Atmosphere suitable for couples, food suitable for those who hates salt
Review: Firstly, the place was pretty tricky to find. The atmosphere was good, but it's catered more for couples. The food, however, was tasteless regardless of what we ordered, with the exception of the fries that came with a bland Ramly patty sandwich. But the price is way too steep. Totally not worth it.Show less

Author: 9MCU4Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food.
Review: My family and I had lunch here when we arrived Langkawi. First we thought the GPS was showing wrong directions as we were going on a really narrow road, inland and away from the main road . When we arrived , a cheerful guy came to help us with an umbrella as it was raining. The food was just wonderful . It took some time to be prepared but it was worth the wait . The Nasi lemak and the beef rendang is simply so good . The sambal nasi lemak was just right . Exactly the was any Malaysian would like their Nasi lemak sambal.The deserts were good too. The Pulut Hitam desert is really good . I would highly recommend it. The pricing was normal for island standard I guess .. Overall the meal , the ambiance and the cheerful people there really made it a great experience ...Show less

Author: cindymarieazurValencia, Spain
Title: Must visit and try Rendang!!!
Review: We had lunch on this hidden nice place. We’ve ordered Nasi Ayam Pontai and Beef Rendang, I was amazed how tasty and with kick of spiciness the Rendang and obviously it’s a winner compared to Ayam Pontai. Friendly staff and relaxing ambience. Overall satisfied and will come back to try dinner next time. Show less

Author: mike cTownsville, Australia
Title: great little bistro
Review: we were taken here for lunch a couple of weeks ago, by local friends, it is a very good place for western & Asian food, icy cold beer, good sized portions, speedy service, huge choice & very good pricing, a great alternate to hotel fare, no frills but very well presented. would go again.Show less

Author: eatinglondon
Title: Delicious and beautifully presented food
Review: A wonderful menu with excellent examples of international and Malay food including the best Beef Rendang on the island. All served in a casual and peaceful environment. And even when our children shattered that peace we were still made to feel very welcome.

Author: Mert TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: We stayed in La Pari-Pari hotel for 2 nights and were extremely happy with this restaurant. The outdoor atmosphere is relaxing and the staff were very friendly. It is good for breakfast lunch or dinner. It gets quite crowded in this restaurant in the evening but we were pleased with the food every time. The fish and chips were delicious and so were the Malaysian specials such as curry and rendang but the main highlight was the dessert. The panna cotta is a must try it is so so rich and mouthwatering. Be sure to try this restaurant. You won’t be disappointed!Show less

Author: 444kedargSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and amazing staff
Review: We had 3 meals here as we were staying for 5 nights at their hotel....amazing food and staff personally looks into your choice and recommend to you....we had laksa, sharing starter platter (which had pizza, bruschetta and dumplings ...good value for money) and chicken curry rice...good cocktails and really nice setting for dinner if you like candle lights and peaceful set up ....must try if you in Langkawi ....highly highly recommended...Show less

Author: RonnieM327London, United Kingdom
Title: Warm-hearted staff and great food
Review: We decided to try Fat Cupid purely on the reviews we read on TripAdvisor (as we mostly do).Setting foot in the premises, which appears to be both the hotel reception and the entrance to the restaurant, we were first greeted by a lovely smiley receptionist who asked if she could help. We said we wanted to eat and she directed us to the restaurant, which is just a few steps into the property. Again, as we set foot in the restaurant, we were greeted by more smiley faces from all of the bar staff and waiting staff. Amazing!The food here is mainly a Malaysian affair. There is also a good choice of "Western" food, but we were there to try the Malaysian dishes. An older gentleman took our order; he appeared to be the owner. His waiting skills are excellent: calm, relaxed, attentive and friendly. We knew we weer in safe hands. The state of hte toilets, I think, is always a good sign of a restaurant's cleanliness. No issues here. I even liked the little basket on the wall holding the spare toilet rolls.We ordered prawn aglio lio and beef pontay for our mains for lunch. The prawns are large and succulent. The only thing is that we had to peel the shells - not a problem as they provide a little finger bath for you to wash. The beef pontay has a rich, full flavour sauce. We also ordered some stay chicken. The whole meal was enough for lunch - we were stuffed.Show less

Author: 214hibaa
Title: Definitely recommend!
Review: Great food, drinks and dessert. Ambiance is also very nice with a view of the pool and mellow music. They have both local and western options for everyone’s taste. I recommend trying the Spicy Blondie for dessert. It is located on a branch of the main street and the lighting is not great if you are going there for dinner, so that is something that can be improved. However, after comparing with other places in Langkawi, I think it is the best place so far!Show less

Author: DN1709London, United Kingdom
Title: Superb!
Review: I don’t write many reviews but if something deserves a mention (good or bad) and helps others, I will. On this occasion, fatCupid was superb! I really recommend this restaurant for good food and exceptional service. Infact we went twice and had our “last” holiday meal here as the whole family enjoyed it so much. The sharing platter for starters has wonderful won tons. The pizza is simply the best - light and tasty. We also had a Laksa on the first visit which was very tasty. The quantity is quite a lot so bear in mind when ordering. The restaurant is off the beaten track but get a Grab taxi (it’s cheaper) and will take you right there. I’d like to mention Bell and Sohan who really made this restaurant special, friendly and warm! Show less

Author: laroo12Holbox Island, Mexico
Title: Best won tons ever
Review: Great food, great service, great ambience. It's not easy to find a perfect omelet, and my 3 egg omelet with extra mushrooms for breakfast was simply divine. We adored the won-tons and the salads - we had the Thai Beef Salas and Calamari Salad. Nice big servings and absolutely yummy.Our steak sandwich was perfect, not dry or burnt and just the right size. Lip-smacking and finger lickin'.Show less

Author: Gunjan DNew Delhi, India
Title: Nice food and great staff
Review: Went with family for lunch.... off the main road coupled with great and calming ambience amongst trees and greenery...The food was great and the quantity too much. The mock tails we tried were too good especially the Watermelon & Lychee one...the hand made pizza was superb Deserves a visit in case u r in LangkawiShow less

Author: unstoppabellAdelaide, Australia
Title: Off the beaten track
Review: FatCUPID is located down a dark side street off the main drag, in the small but quaint La Pari-Pari resort off Tengah beach in Langkawi. It’s not easy to find, but worth the effort. The restaurant overlooks the resort pool and garden. The menu has a mix of Asian and western food, we opted for local fare, satays, laksa and the Nonya Chicken. All the food was great, full of flavour and nicely presented. The restaurant is liscensed which isn’t always the case in Malaysia. The staff were really nice, and prices are pretty reasonable.Show less

Author: packed2goDundee, United Kingdom
Title: Food good but put on midge repellant
Review: As other reviews suggest food here is of good quality and service is nice. Went twice - second time bitten to bits- kind of spoils the ambiance even with repellant candle at your feet!Cactus had no midges, as good food and was 25% cheaper. Both worth a visit tho. Show less

Author: treetop2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: We got a taxi here after reading the reviews and were very impressed. The staff were so friendly and helpful and the food amazing. The location is in a nice quiet area. The food and drinks menu was very varied to suit all tastes and the presentation beautiful. Our favourite meal of the week.Show less

Author: amymK306XB
Title: 10/10 would eat again
Review: Ate here on a Saturday night and was impressed. Friendly service and quite attentive unlike a number of other places on the island. Quite difficult to find as off the main road so we arrived by taxi. We loved the wontons so much so we ordered a second helping. We ate a curry which came recommended as a less spicy dish, and duck rendang from the specials both of which were very tasty. There is also a tasty sounding western menu. We had a few different drinks (espresso martini delicious). Thanks fatcupid for the best meal of our holiday.Show less

Author: Escape17407264347
Title: Hidden
Review: We had difficulties finding the location with a scooter. Dinner was nice, location also. Bit pricy. Do not forget to take „NoBite“ with you. They also give you a candle.

Author: ljwaller42Kent, UK
Title: delicious rendang
Review: tucked away on side/back road away from main road, but worth going to as food great. I had beef rending which was pretty hot but absolutely delicious, my husband had laksa also very good. Service started good but we got forgotten after mains cleared & not asked if we wanted dessert for ages.....eventually we were & we had the brownie which was lovely.Show less

Author: iheart2travel_8Penticton, Canada
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: This is a beautiful little oasis from the busy, noisy beachfront! This restaurant has an amazing menu selection and fully stocked bar and I opted for a veggie brunch (and beer) which was some of the best food I’ve had in the month I’ve spent in Pantai Cenang! They had plenty of fresh vegetables, including mushrooms (which I’ve missed so much) and lovely bread. The servicer very nicely substituted the eggs for additional veggies. Yummy! The restaurant is clean with great view of mountain, with a nice ambiance and chill music. The service was excellent. Had a great conversation with waiter, who was quite an interesting fellow from Bangladesh who spoke flawless English and the chef came out to inquire how I enjoyed food. This place has amazing service without appearing to try too hard. (The only downside was it was a hot day and is an open air restaurant with overhead fans.) Was also shown a room at adjoining boutique hotel, La Pari-Pari which was very beautiful, clean and loaded with amenities. I loved this restaurant...I will definitely be back to try more on the menu. Show less

Author: Halimah C
Title: Delicious food and lovely service
Review: Ate here three times during a week long stay on Langkawi. Really enjoyed the Malay dishes and breakfast. There's a nice balance of of different dishes, including vegetarian options, which were hard to come by at other places. The staff are super friendly and fun. The food was so delicious I only wish we had more room in our stomaches to try it all :) Highly recommend! Show less

Author: tt53Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Great ambiance, great food and great staff
Review: Visited a couple of times during recent holiday and each visit was a great pleasure. Interesting menu with dishes to suit all tastes. Great tasty food and staff happy to adjust spicing to suit different palettes. Service excellent and staff always happy to talk through their dishes.Show less

Author: VpsteveCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding local food
Review: We ate here on recommendation. Nice atmosphere and a very welcoming team. The food can take a little while to come to the table but that's all good as it's obviously produced freshly cooked. The quality is outstanding and the presentation is quite up to date .... Prices might seem quite high in comparison but for the experience it's worth it and compared to so called western prices still good value. Try the desserts too.... They are authentic and not an afterthought.... Tapioca not to be missed. Might be advisable to book... We did and were glad to have done so as they were busy ...another good sign Show less

Author: Sanj130London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food and very friendly and efficient service
Review: We went there for dinner and were impressed by the warm and friendly welcome backed up by fast and efficient service. They have a good selection of western and malaysian dishes with plenty of vegetarian choices. My wife ordered a vege pizza, which was excellent - nicely loaded with a variety of vegetables, a thin and crispy base and great tasting. They made me a chicken rendang (as I don't eat beef) and I can honestly say it was one of the best rendangs I have ever eaten: thick, flavour intensive sauce which was nicely spiced. The price was also very reasonable. We paid 100 ringgits for three of us, including a couple of beers.Show less

Author: LukeysarbearBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect
Review: Excellent service, outstanding food. Both my wife and I are vegetarian and we had 2 different Malay curries both were delicious with just the right amount of spice beautifully presented and most importantly tasty!!Deserts were both delicious, my pineapple was refreshing and sweet while the churros were everything you would hope they would be.We had a couple of different cocktails both very tasty.This restaurant is slightly more expensive than some but it is worth every penny, would command much much higher prices in the west.If I could give more stars I would. Show less

Author: wendi aParis, France
Title: Breakfast
Review: We had breakfast here while staying at the adjacent hotel le Pari Pari for 3 nights. Our choices were limited a bit because we are vegan but they worked with us to find a solution. We noticed people coming from other hotels and outside for the breakfast and it all looked quite good!Show less

Author: Balance_BoundLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty and Tucked Away
Review: We stopped by for lunch in their off the beaten path, open air restaurant. We were greeted by several smiling faces and quickly seated at a nice table under one of the many ceiling fans.The menu offers western style food, southern and northern Malaysian delights. It was hard to decide what to order as many items sounded delicious. We were looking for something a bit spicy so we selected the Beef Rendang and Beef Pontay along with their non-alcoholic juice freezes. Everything arrived nicely presented and was extremely tasty! Breakfast and brunch menu available until 2:00pmLunch starting at 11:00am and dinner until 10:30pm. Nice signature cocktail menu!Closed on Mondays.Show less

Author: joshua_SoloKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great spot!
Review: Came here with my boo and had a delicious breakfast. The eggs and beans are great! Bae’s omelette was huge! Great environment, the music is soft and perfect volume. The scenery is beautiful. Prices were good, definitely come here! Our waiter Sohan from Bangladesh was so nice, the food came out quickly and Sohan made sure everything was perfect. Very great spot. Show less

Author: Emma B
Title: Lovely little restaurant
Review: Sweet well kept restaurant with delicious Malaysian dishes available. My partner had the laksa and loved it, I had a local chicken dish and it was great. Would visit again

Author: ravontanxinyiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Impressed
Review: I’m not always writing reviews. But this fatCUPID, amazed me with their personalised service, creative and delicious food and the cosy surrounding environment. They made me decide to leave a good review. Maybe we are the only customer at that time. But they have the heart of doing extra for their customers. Show less

Author: Wee Kiat PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A fantastic restaurant with great nonya food and a good drinks list
Review: The best thing about Langkawi Island is that alcohol is duty free. So, if you are from Kuala Lumpur like me, you would find drinking in Langkawi a great value experience. Fat cupid has a good dinks list and the prices are good. The food served is nyonya and it is as good as any nyonya restaurant in Melaka. The ingredients are fresh and the food is well prepared and tasty. I recommend the curry chicken kapitan and the nyonya laksa. They also serve an all day breakfast in case u need to nurse a hangover. The staff are friendly and the restaurant is airy and cool. Overall, the food here was the best i had in my entire stay in Langkawi.Show less

Author: clementb564Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for dinner
Review: My friend and I went there for dinner and we were not disappointed. The restaurant is located in a remote area but it worth it. Staff is very friendly and service is great. Food is very nice and original. We had the wonton as a starter, then rendang duck/chicken kapitan and some desserts (sago gula melaka and I forgot the name of the other one).We also had two cocktails (nice ones) and a bottle of red wine. Cost was around 300MYR. Very affordable considering what we had.Show less

Author: inspectorcalls
Title: Superb
Review:
Off the beaten track slightly but we'll worth the deviation.
A great menu, great atmosphere and great staff.
The beef rendang was incredible and very reasonable on the wallet.
We will be going back during our stay.

Author: anniooo
Title: Great food, lovely people
Review: We had two cocktails, shared appetizer plater and two burgers all for under 150 rm. Very happy with the food and service!

Author: bp19902019
Title: Really good
Review: Very good service, food and ambiance. We had breakfast but i bet dinner is also good as they had a good selection. A bit hidden so could use more signs.

Author: 770marthadHong Kong, China
Title: Funny Little Place Worth Finding
Review: Read a lot of great reviews on TA, so went searching for this one. The food is really good. Tried the beef rendang and a laska with chicken and prawn. Spicy level is good, but I wouldn’t ask for extra unless you like to sweat when you eat! Atmosphere was charming with open air to an old-style Resort pool. I loved the French jazz music they played. We were there for lunch so didn’t feel like having a cocktail, but many of them sounded good!Show less

Author: DavidYecal
Title: Best Breakfasts!
Review: We stayed before and now go back for breakfast whenever we visit Langkawi. Varied menu, friendly & prompt service in a secluded location....a great way to start the day!

Author: Bouquet12Wigton, United Kingdom
Title: Ideal place
Review: We visited this restaurant for dinner in December. We were a party of four adults and three children. Supplying food to satisfy everyone takes some doing but this place did it easily. Everyone enjoyed all they ate. I particularly liked the dishes described as traditional. Everything was freshly cooked and beautifully served. The drinks are to be recommended, being most refreshing. The staff are most welcoming, the atmosphere is relaxed, the place is very clean, the view from the the eating area is lovely. We sat and watched the light fade. On our walk back to our hotel we encountered a herd of water buffalo silently making their way to who knows where.We returned for breakfast two days later and enjoyed another excellent mealShow less

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Pleasantly surprised!!!
Review: This place is off the beaten path and after driving down the road I was not too sure if I was in the right spot!I was greeted by Bell a very pleasant lady who works at the restaurant. We had the signature appetiser that had pizza, won tons and bruschetta. We loved them all!! Very good and fresh and served hot.The next dish was the beef with noodles in the secret soy sauce. I liked this as well!The ice tea and signature lemon grass punch were good.I would definitely recommend this spot and I would eat here again!!!Show less

Author: SelenaCool
Title: Little quaint place
Review: Had dinner here. Food is awesome. So is the service. We had the laksa and rendang tempe. The bruschetta was super yum. We also had the freezies. So refreshing. Love the clean and organic look of the place. Will defo visit again.

Author: guidodemmers
Title: Go here!
Review: The food was surprisingly good and the staff warm and friendly! The road leading up to the place is a bit shabby. The garden looks nice, but could use a bit more work. But we just had lunch (burger and the beef rendang)and already decided to come back for dinner. Show less

Author: freddieChch
Title: Gem of a restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Fantastic food - thank you Jackie and team for a fantastic meal and service. We enjoyed every morsel

Author: Jase8213Shoreham-by-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Off the beaten track - but worth finding!
Review: Wow! So glad we read between the lines and looked at the positive “dinner” reviews! Starter wontons were excellent! Thai beef salad, was ok, a great salad, but not quite a Thai beef salad. Mains we struggled to choose with so many great options on show. Needless to say we both chose wisely and after explanation, the others we looked at and struggled to decide would have been just as good, but all we can say is AMAZING! The hostess, Fiza was magnificent! Actually sold us the island with all things to do, bars to visit and most importantly places to eat. Night markets, alcohol, crikey what this lady didn’t know and give us valuable information on wasn’t worth knowing. Cannot for a minute believe ANY of the big hotels or Tourist Board have not employed this lady is beyond me! After 4 days here, many hotel, taxi, restaurant references and opinions, this lady helped hugely for the remainder of our 9 day visit! Would definitely recommend this place to anybody. Food, price and atmosphere perfect thank you very much.Show less

Author: JoandJoe2011Allesley, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous breakfast
Review: We stumbled upon this place - it’s part of the le Pari Pari hotel. A little walk off the Main Street but an oasis in a courtyard . Beautiful terrace , fabulous food. My husband said the omelette was the best he’d had and I had the sweet potato with poached eggs. So impressed, we took a look round the hotel and will book there next time.Show less

Author: SusannaL1111
Title: Delicious dinner!
Review: Burgers and fries were delicious! Service was excellent. Restaurant is nice and the drinks were great.

Author: 50LouiseCLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best meal in Langkawi
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for 9 nights around the Tengah beach area and this is by far the best place we ate at - unfortunately we found it on our last night!! We shared the wontons to start, laksa and spicey beef curry (have forgotten the name - it's not rendang but another local type of curry) and brownie/homemade ice cream with toffee sauce for desert. Everything was beautiful. We expected it to be more expensive but our whole bill was 115rm which was great value for money considering the quality of food we ate. We found a lot of restaurants in the area didn't have enough Malaysian food on the menu but the menu here was great - at least ten different dishes. Then there was a good western menu as well if you want that. Breakfast menu looks great and we're sad we won't be able to try this!Ambience is lovely, staff incredibly attentive and helpful. Highly recommended - don't miss this if you're in the area! Show less

Author: 164bengAirport West, Australia
Title: Have eaten here everyday since being in langkawi
Review: Came here for breakfast every morning, liked it that much, I decided to stay at the hotel they’re partnered with lolVeggie works with poached eggs, the unique juice blends are worth a shot!Fried wontons and beef rendang with just enough chili to open up your pores.Can’t go wrong with what they have to offer in this menu!Show less

Author: juliatryz
Title: Cozy atmosphere
Review: Really cozy environment and excellent service was provided here. We enjoyed the food a lot, had traditional Malaysian. Spicy but still good and tasteful!

Author: billpar2015
Title: Possibly the best laksa ever
Review:
Awesome little ding in Langkawi.
Great service and one of the best laksa’s i’ve ever tried.
Rustic and full of fresh herbs and spices.
Can’t recommend it highly enough.

Author: alsuk84Croydon, United Kingdom
Title: Not bad, not good
Review: Service not bad, a little over the top, and perhaps a little arrogant we felt, perhaps because of the good reviews on tripadvisor? Starter was good; however, I had the beef rendang, which I could barely taste as it was so so spicy, and I don’t mind a bit of spice. Granted, we arrived late for dinner, however, we were not provided with the opportunity to have desert as the kitchen had closed (perhaps they could have taken our desert order before closing the kitchen)?Show less

Author: bentese
Title: Great food-, drink and service experience
Review: We have visited fatCUPUD twice, and we’ll give our best recommedations 😋 Spicey and delicius. Service perfekt 👍🏻 Thank you for dinner/ Jens & Bente, Denmark

Author: Grace S
Title: Great setting, great dinner, great service
Review: We visited our first evening in Langkawi and we’re thrilled with this find. Relaxing and pretty atmosphere, super menu and better service.

Author: andrewgopal
Title: Pricy
Review:
Nice place for a meal if you could afford. Very Pricey. One Nasi Lemak is RM28.00
Suitable for expatriates. Not locals.

Author: Gmoney33Melbourne, Australia
Title: Awesome food and lovely service
Review: We had breakfast at fat Cupid every day that we were in Langkawi. The food is so amazingly good and it lives up to the hype in the other reviews. The service was also great with everyone being so friendly and making the whole experience really relaxing. Definitely try it out!Show less

Author: Edwin_IreneSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Laksa & Tempeh Rendang
Review: Had the Nyonya laksa for dinner at FatCupid --- OMG -- I'm not a mee curry kinda person , but this dish was sooooo good... it was recommended...and till today I'm still waiting to go back Langkawi to have that dish AGAIN...I didn't get enough the last time...Rendang Tempeh - for those vegan/vegatarians - this is something you must try. My wife loved it. The serving was generous, so we doggy bagged it back home.. tasted awesome. The mushroom burger was good too..A crazy variety of cocktails there to choose from.I had breakfast too there, the sweet potato eggs benedict - wah! really nice combination of taste. Savoury and a little sweet from the sweet potato cubes.. really blends well...I recommend you have dinner in Fatcupid... no regrets for sure.Btw, l really like the fatcupid restaurant logoShow less

Author: jdjepLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Mediocre - reviews are not representative
Review: Had the beef burger and curry. Curry claimed to have "slow cooked chicken" - it was not. Burger came out cold twice - the "homemade" beef patty was tasteless and cold to the touch. Staff were less than welcoming throughout the experience. Overall the reviews do not match the quality of food and service. Show less

Author: Linda HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: As good as ever - tranquil location, good food, friendly service
Review: Having stayed enjoyed meals at Fat Cupid in January this year, we returned to see if it is as good as we recall. Happily it is. We were welcomed warmly and it was lovely to see that the verandah dining area (open sided) was just as we remembered, overlooking the small pool and pretty garden. The background jazz music creates a romantic and peaceful ambiance in which to enjoy good food and drink. My lemongrass mojito cocktail was superb. We ate here twice during this December stay in Langkawi and on both occasions our meals were very good, with service to match. The menu is not huge (a plus in my book) but with a mix of Western and Asian dishes. My beef rendang was tender and full of flavour and my husband’s barracuda perfectly cooked and delicious. Fat Cupid is a cut above many of the restaurant offerings in the area. If you’re looking for a tranquil location and good food, this is the place to come. Given the quality of the food, prices are fair and comparable to nearby restaurants. You won’t stumble upon this restaurant as it’s tucked away behind Pantai Tengah main road, but it’s well worth the effort to seek it out. Our favourite restaurant in Langawi by far.Show less

Author: SMayHo
Title: Best Laksa Ever
Review: Came here on a friends recommendation to try the laksa and I must say it did not disappoint. Flavorful and a huge portion. Quite a hudden gem with a romantic atmosphere. But the star is the laksa, a must try!

Author: octopusjason
Title: Langkawi 🆓 and easy
Review: The food is nice and the taste is up to the quality.The pizza need more cheese in it in order to get the cheesy taste of the pizza. The meal in the pic is just nice for a couple, RM70 ++The taufu mushroom burger is normal but the French fries is taste good.Overall, not bad. Show less

Author: Auromirra
Title: Tasty food
Review: The kids and the hubby truly enjoyed breakfast hear. Fresh and tasty. The PIC was very informative about what to do in Langkawi etc. Lovely ambiance.

Author: robertv51Den Bosch, The Netherlands
Title: Great food, served with love (and good cocktails)
Review: Really friendly staff, great food and lovely cocktails. Certainly one of the best places to eat! But make sure you know the way, the place is not on the main road (espacially in the dark a bit hard to find). The pricing is also OK! We had 4 cocktails, 2 main courses and 1 dessert for 180 ringit. Show less

Author: membuayaKuala Lumpur
Title: What a treat
Review: This is the go-to place for great meals in Langkawi. The menu has something for everyone from traditional Asian dishes, like laksa and rendang to Western fare from burgers to divine cuts for steaks perfectly cooked. And even their desserts, though their selection may not be as extensive, are something not to be missed. What sets FatCupid apart is that the food here is not only delicious, it tastes like its made from the heart _ which it is.Show less

Author: Kempston_MillKempston, United Kingdom
Title: The BEST RESTAURANT in Pantai Cenang
Review: Having spent the best part of a week checking out many of the higher rated eateries in this part of Langkawi, we were genuinely impressed by this eating experience.Great selection of local cuisine, prepared to not only taste fabulous, but look good on the plates.Offers more western foods for those less adventurous (eg children) with options including battered fish and chipsAll prices pretty good compared with other restaurants seeking to attract the tourist tradeIt certainly isn’t the easiest to find, and our taxi driver needed to call the restaurant for directions, so don’t expect to stumble across it by chance, but it is certainly worth the tripShow less

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Its the "Number 1" restaurant for a good reason!!
Review: This smallish restaurant, off the beaten track, may be only a "little bit complicated to find"-- but its well worth the effort!! It is currently rated "Number 1" by travellers and awarded TripAdvisor's "Certificate of Excellence". It has a swimming pool and has a marvellous setting and ambience. Its about 175 meters back from Langkawi's most popular beach-- so look at the map. The menu is very diverse... and it's a "quirky" mixture of "Ozzy and Asian food"... Thus one can find amazing fish and chips or a delightful Burger and fries--- or "Wonton dishes", Curries, Laksa and fresh Asian Salads... and the prices are "fair".I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: robo354
Title: Well worth a visit
Review:
Great food , fast friendly service highly recommended. 
Laksa was the best we had in Langkawi and a good lightning display just to add to the night .

Author: Mamun KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Better than expected
Review: Wife found this place online, so we booked it for a 9pm dinner. The place is a little inside but our heroic Grab driver knew exactly where it was. The restaurant was actually really unique, it’s out in the open in a marquee was very romantic to be honest.The head waitress sat us down, gave us the menus and also explained a little about the dishes which was a nice touch. We ordered 2 starters, the tomato bruschetta was really nice. For mains we got 2 local Malaysian dishes, a veg curry and the other was their chicken curry. Both dishes were surprisingly good, we both enjoyed our meals. I recall getting a mock tail too, all in all it’s a little pricier than other restaurants but it is worth it.Show less

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: First time we have visited this little restaurant as recommended by a lovely couple at our hotel. Place is small and is hard to find if walking from Pantai Cennag so would definitely recommend getting a taxi but the food is certainly good. I had a cuury dish which unfortunately I have forgotton the name of but we will certainly be back when we visit Langkawi again next year.Show less

Author: KasturiN24
Title: FOODGASM!
Review: PURE FOODGASM! Had a wonderful dinner, excellent music and ambiance and lovely waiters! A must try restaurant in Langkawi and dear vegetarians,no worries, they have good choices here for ya!

Author: Rach BAbu Dhabi
Title: Yum Yum Yum!
Review: We found fatCUPID through Trip Advisor as we were staying at a hotel nearby. It took us a while to actually find it given that it is off the beaten path and in a somewhat shady feeling area. However once you get past that, it is actually a nice open space. On the first night we were there, we had the assorted appetizer platter (slightly cheezy flat bread, small crispy wantons and mini bruschetta). It was delicious and we really enjoyed everything. We also ordered a prawn pasta to share although I do not remember the exact name. It was also very delicious but a bit spicy for our taste. We would order it again if they toned down the spice. Our cocktails were , the Fat Cupid Punch with a Kich which was amazing and the Midori Illusion both of which were good with the former being the superior of the two. For dessert we ordered the Chocolate Brownie sand which which was a lovely end to the meal. Since we enjoyed our meal so much the first day, we decided to go back again the next night and had the Beef Rendang for the main course. This was a better dish for our palette as compared to the pasta and we really enjoyed it. We tried the Raspberry Panacotta for dessert and also enjoyed this more than the previous days dessert. Overall service was good and quick. It was not too sweet but smooth and a perfect balance of flavours. Do check it out if you are looking for a good place to eat in Langkawi. :)Show less

Author: lina_kiwi
Title: Average food.
Review: Came here for dinner one night and didn’t enjoy it. The food was very average and the cocktails very watery. Nice and friendly staff and nice location.

Author: gt8383
Title: Delicious food n good service!
Review: A boutique hotel serves very authentic local food and very good Western food too. Very homey type. Very friendly staff.

Author: Saraleonard
Title: Delicious food and a beautiful location
Review: Came here on Saturday night with my friends and didn't know what to expect. This place was absolutely beautiful. The staff were attentive and couldn't have done any more to ensure we had a high quality dining experience.I had the chicken roulade which was absolutely delicious. Wish we had more time to revisit but will definitely be recommending this restaurant to friends!Show less

Author: pipburghamHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Fantastic food and atmosphere
Review: We came here for dinner on a Saturday night. The service was great and the restaurant is very pretty, it’s by a swimming pool and there are fairy lights in the garden. I had a rose sangria cocktail which was delicious! There was a large variety of food -both Western and Malaysian. All the food we had was very tasty. I would go back again.Show less

Author: gina c
Title: Average
Review: The view is of hotel pool...wel it looks like a motel but anyway, the beef rendang was good but very spicy! The wonton was amazing and the steak sandwich was worse than pickle barrel. Lemongrass mojito was very strong but hey whose complaining. All westerners. No locals. Very hard to find place, our grab driver got lost for 10min and was so cranky he finally got us lol.Would not come again but got to say we tried!Service was amazing Show less

Author: Vauny1980Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great little restaurant - Awesome Laksa
Review: A little bit random, off the beaten track. It overlooks the hotel pool, which is a little strange - watching the vacationers frolicking in the pool while you eat lunch! But, in saying that, the staff were lovely, and the food was fantastic. The laksa was definitely the better end of the scale, and it can be hard to find a traditional laksa on the island. The chilli beef special was also delicious. Cold beers went down well with the spicy food. It isnt the cheapest on the Island, although the portions were massive, and the staff friendly.Show less

Author: SummitSeekingSherpaIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Evening Meal
Review: This was an impromptu visit. It looked good, the food was acceptable but it was seriously over priced and worse of all the service attempted to be helpful but was false unengaging and basically disinterested despite us being the only customers there.Most telling was the fact that as we were waiting for our food (we chose the local Nyonya dishes which were well presented and edible without being spectacular) a few people staying at the resort all walked through the restaurant heading off to eat somewhere else.Given our experience I’m not surprised by this and will be surprised if the place survives without a major makeover in terms of its front of house staffing who basically let down a decent kitchen in our opinion.Show less

Author: tishytoshyNottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: Varied
Review: Went after reading reviews here. Food variable - starters (we had the sharing platter) excellent. I had beef rendang which was nice but not great but my daughter struggled with her main course as too spicy (although they did offer to make it milder). Limited vegetarian options (2). Show less

Author: 343emeraldlLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful location, great food and cocktails
Review: We loved our visit here!We had cocktails which were really tasty and food which was also really tasty! Service was great too!We had been eating street food for most of our trip so compared to that it was pricey however it’s really not expensive if you compare it to Europe prices! All in all it cost us around £34 for 2 lovely main meals, 3 cocktails and a big bottle of water.Highly recommend this place :) Show less

Author: Rebecca N
Title: Dining experience
Review: We enjoyed Fat Cupid so much we dined there twice on a 5 night vacation to Langkawi. It may well have been a hat-trick of visits but the restaurant has a night off on a Monday. The beef rendang was wonderful, but all meals served to my family of four received high praise. The staff were all friendly and the service was warm, without being invasive. It is also excellent value for money and we spent a lot more at other local restaurants without the same level of dining experience. Wish all at F.C. success in the future.Show less

Author: V6990YNphilipc
Title: Best Laksa!
Review: Herro fatCUPID,The food was fantastic and beers were cheap.They even gave an anti mosquito incense under the table to avoid us being eaten while eating.The place is a little hard to find at night, is fairly off road with minimal lighting. Well worth it though. Show less

Author: travelinmydreams
Title: Beat the reviews
Review: Wow! I certainly understand the reviews now. Absolutely amazing find.  My teenage children were delighted. Veggie daughter happy.  Gorgeous setting, very cute. Fabulous food. Struggle to finish as portions generous. Beef Rendang delicious.  Thank you friendly staff.

Author: Asma B
Title: Disappointed
Review: I didn't like it at all except the service and staff working there who were kind. Not like expected at all

Author: ChTTayBeijing, China
Title: Nice vibe for dinner
Review: Enjoyed a pleasant evening meal here after wondering down a small dark dirt road to find it. The service was solid, if a little rough around the edges. The food was all delicious and about mid-range price wise. They have a nice mix of Malay and Western dishes. The restaurant is outside so there is the potential for mosquito bites. They give you something under the table to help but I found spraying up more useful! Show less

Author: 573veronicatMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fabulous food
