Review: Our family went for dinner. The food was absolutely delicious and the best food we have had so far. Calamari salad, Thai beef salad, laska and beef curry. Great service and cocktails are fantastic, not just your standard list of cocktails. Highly recommend and will be going back.Show less

Author: llyradSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing food!
Review: My girlfriend and I went at around 2.15pm for lunch. The food was really amazing. We order then wontons and the pizza for starters, followed by the rendang tempeh. The rendang was absolutely delicious. Wontons were generous in their fillings and the portions. Coffee was pretty good too.One of the more memorable meals of our trip to Langkawi. Pity they close orders at 3pm and we can’t even order drinks after. We would have stayed longer. Show less

Author: kylef853Thame, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome
Review: Everything about this restaurant was awesome. The cocktails were reasonably priced and really tasty. The service and the ambiance was fantastic. I had one of the local curry dishes and it was delicious. My girlfriend ordered the calamari salad and although the calamari was really tasty the salad could have done with some more exciting ingredients. We also like the fact the dishes came in the order they’re supposed to i.e. starter the main. They even asked if we were ready for our mains, rather than bringing everything out together. Show less

Author: wail413
Title: DElicous
Review: I went there for twice.  The food was delicious and the staffs were attentive and made best recommendations on your favorite.  You can enjoy a relaxing and yummy dinner there.

Author: 8Meena8
Title: Nice wontons!
Review: We felt the staff could have been a little more attentive. Mosquito-prone area unfortunately. The food didn't meet our expectations entirely, although it did have a homey taste, which was pleasant (did not taste commercialised).

Author: Sharne CChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: soooo good!
Review: We came here twice in just 5days because it was sooo good. Service was excellent, the setting by the pool was lovely with relaxing french music in the background and best of all, amazing food and cocktails. It is more expensive than some other places but still cheap compared to a normal meal out in New Zealand so we were happy to pay for such excellent food and atmosphere. And the cocktails were the best we had and they were cheap. Fish stew was soooo good then the next time we shared a starter platter with wontons and other stuff - YUMMY - and we shared a traditional malaysian dish Beef Rendang - very spicy but very good!Show less

Author: lindseyh121Attwood, Australia
Title: Our best meal in Langkawi!!
Review: Wowza! What a place! We loved everything about it! Yes, a little secluded, but the walk there was beautiful. The restaurant has a great setting - super modern but also felt so welcoming! We actually cannot fault the place! We got all Malay food and it was out of this world - delicious! The desserts were incredible too! To top it off, the staff were amazing, polite and so helpful! We plan to eat here again before we leave - perfect! Show less

Author: zoeb813
Title: DISGUSTING
Review: Flies absolutely everywhere (very uncomfortable and irritating constantly swatting them away whilst trying to eat), dodgy smelling eggs, watery baked beans, undercooked chicken sausages and a rude waitress that tried to overcharge us and then round up the bill...unprofessional, SO overpriced...simply AVOID.

Author: Alexander D
Title: Calm and cosy place
Review: The place is very cozy, calm and the food was good. The waitor did wrong with two of our dishes which made the experience less good.. two vegetarian dishes was everything except veg..

Author: jpsquareSacramento, California
Title: Excellent food in hard to find cafe
Review: Located down a narrow paved path.. Signage not good coming from direction of Chenang. Had Ling fish filled over a bean stew.. delicious. My wife's Thai beef salad not as good. Seating near pool with mosquito punks to keep away the bugs. A little $$ for Langkawi but not bad. Show less

Author: Maree DNewcastle, Australia
Title: Worth the trip to find it
Review: This is a bit hard to find but worth perservering. The setting by the pool is lovely and the menu has a lot of different dishes offering a change from the usual. The servings are large, I ordered wontons as I was after a smaller meal but it was huge! We will be back next trip.Show less

Author: monethetripper
Title: Delicious
Review: This was actually the best restaurant we ate at. I wish I’d returned another time. We struggled to find it at first but happy we made the effort.

Author: Tracey H
Title: Great find!
Review: Had dinner here with my husband on Saturday night. Great food, good service and very friendly and welcoming staff. Definitely worth a visit and we will return next time we're in Langkawi

Author: 110kirkr
Title: What a place
Review: This was actually just a short walk from our hotel but it is down a path and not well sign posted but believe me it's well worth it.Their Nonya cuisine is superb but then again so is their western food...trouble is what does one choose? We couldn't decide so came back three times in a row. The ambiance is divine with lovely music and candle lit tables. Great wine list tooShow less

Author: dawn644
Title: Great place
Review: This is a lovely little place good varied menu. The staff are really friendly. It's clean and easy to find ..food lovely

Author: CommandoBriNew Romney, United Kingdom
Title: Good food good staff
Review: Very welcoming staff. Food is very tasty a must if your here.We had dinner and in morning had breakfast both very good traditional meals and they are happy to help you understand the local foods if you wish to askNo faults at all .refreshing change to find a lovely restaurantShow less

Author: aussietraveller1960
Title: Good food in a nice setting
Review: Had brunch at fatCUPID and left satisfied at the food quality at a good price in a pleasant setting.

Author: wendyk621Seattle, Washington
Title: Delicious!
Review: Wandered down the lane off the main road to find this delightful restaurant. A lovely setting, a congenial, hands on owner (I think she was the owner anyway) and the best dinner we have had in Langkawi (night #4). Good drinks, wontons for an appetizer, the special Malaysian beef noodles and Red Snapper with Lemon Sauce. Oh, and a decadent ice cream brownie dessert. Nice soft music playing in the background. A lovely evening. Sure, more expensive than a lot of streetside restaurants. But by U.S. standards, very reasonable. And well worth the cost. Show less

Author: MUDATehran, Iran
Title: Awesome fusion cuisine
Review: Find your way off the beaten track to this little gem of a fusion restaurant in Cenang, Langkawi. Beautifully set within a small resort adjacent to a small pool, it offers traditional Malaysian food served with a modern twist with excellent service. All very reasonably priced and extremely memorable for all the right reasons. Show less

Author: jmullenk
Title: Delicious food and friendly staff
Review: Loved our visit here! Drinks and food were delicious and all that was described in previous reviews. Top notch’

Author: Razina K
Title: Razina
Review: Enjoyed the food here. Good service. Nice and clean. Would recommend a visit here. Had a variety of dishes. All of them were good. Definitely child friendly.

Author: tomtD1632UGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing just amazing
Review: Don’t be put off by the fact it seems off the beaten track. The laneway leading down to it isn’t as long as you’d think and when you get there it feels like an oasis in the desert. The staff are friendly: welcoming you from the moment you arrive. The atmosphere is chilled out with a mix of home comforts and local culture that leaves you feeling blissful. We opted for some local favourites ( although the menu boasts some western dishes that also looked amazing). We loved both of our dishes and before the meal was even over were planning when we would return. Show less

Author: caplee79
Title: Expectations exceeded
Review: Had lunch a couple of times in this cozy small restaurant. Environment clean, bright, modern. Food was properly prepared, nice western favourites and delicious Malay food with a twist. Service genuinely gentle and professional. Good job guys.

Author: Hux_JEChester, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant food, great value
Review: It's a little bit off-the-beaten-track (about a five minute walk down a side road) but this small restaurant is definitely worth a visit. It's an Asian fusion restaurant and had one of those menus where you can't decide what to eat because everything sounds so delicious. It's a little more 'fine dining' than most restaurants I saw in Langkawi but the prices seemed very reasonable. I opted for sliced duck on rendang curry with watermelon rice, which was very tasty with lots of satisfying pops of flavour (and red wine poached pear for dessert). The service was excellent too. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Bru1Christchurch, United Kingdom
Title: "Well worth searching for this Restaurant"
Review: It is part of La Pari-Pari hotel just south of the centre of Pentai Cenang. Taxis are cheap and the driver found the place no problem. Food was very good and we sat outside in a pleasant quiet setting. Very acceptable bottle of Aussie wine about MYR75. Staff were excellent and will certainly come back March 2019 when we leave cold wet UK to return to the beautiful island of Langkawi.Show less

Author: cheekoreekoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hidden gem- super great place
Review: A great vfm place that although a touch hidden was easy to find by the grab taxi driver. Food was freshly prepared, homely yet well presented and our two choices (chicken curry and red snapper) were delicious. Drinks were amazing too with my mint and lime iced drink being a highlight of the trip! Part of small boutique hotel (la pari- pari) which looks great too. Wished we had eaten and stayed here instead of telaga terrace. Music in restaurant is great too, 50s jazz sound. Perfect!Show less

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: Really love this little restaurant and always have an enjoyable meal here and there are some good vegetarian choices as well as the usual pizza and burgers.The restaurant was very busy but service was reasonably quick and the staff very attentive.It is much better now that the road to the entrance has been tarmac'd so it makes it easier to drive to the entrance.Show less

Author: jainrimzim21
Title: Good breakfast
Review: Very calm and quiet place. Nice food. Amazing value for money. Few vegetarian options available. Must visit..

Author: Cheng O
Title: Cupid and full of flavour
Review: We ate nearly all meals here from breakfast to dinner. Meals ar and a cooked to perfection, full of flavour and fast. Totally recommended to anyone.

Author: russellj691Eccles, United Kingdom
Title: Off the beaten track !!!
Review: This restaurant is hidden away behind Haroo about 250m off the main road.A fabulous restaurant serving a variation of meals.However, the main meals are Malaysian, just what we wanted.We had the Wontons to start (12 pieces - enough to share for us) followed by Beef Rendang and one of the specials Beef Hot Fun, all the food deserved top marks.This undoubtedly was one of our best meals in Langkawi and with 4 Drinks was only 138MYR (£25).We certainly saved the best for our last night. *****Show less

Author: emmaandmikeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best food!
Review: Ate here a couple of times while staying at the rooms on the grounds. Lovely location steps away from the main strip but set in a peaceful garden with only the sounds of resident birds and French jazz. Tasty traditional meals (recommend the rendang) and western dishes with a twist packed with flavour and fresh ingredients. The breakfast options were a standout - sweet potato with beef bacon offered something different and the breakfast sandwich was enough to set us up for a whole day of adventure. Look out for the resident hornbill picking out pebbles to impress the ladies! Cabs seem to struggle to find it - ask for pari pari and say it's behind Sunba club (next left, down a gravel lane) if they don't know it.Show less

Author: daniel b
Title: Fantastic restaurant
Review: Lovely place to visit, a little out of the way so delighted we found it, excellent Malay food with a bit of a fancy twist and amazing service.

Author: 552idak
Title: Recommend!
Review:
Very nice place and the drinks and food are great! Staff is the best!
Closed on Mondays and couple hours at afternoon. 😊

Author: jen2951Devon, United Kingdom
Title: Yummy food awesome service.
Review: Visited at lunch time today and the food was just fab.Just find it on google maps as a little off the main road. Amazing Nyonya Laksa and Nasi Sambal Udang perfect portion for two. Really friendly and welcoming service and also had a look at the rooms which are really neat and clean with a lovely pool area and shaded relaxing spaces.The bill came to a very reasonable 100myr £20 including four beers and a bottle of water. Will definitely visit again. Loved it thank you guys .Show less

Author: Samuel M
Title: Go for the Rendang
Review: Best meal we had on Langkawi (although my SO might disagree and say Haroo). To give some perspective, fatCupid is significantly better than any Malaysian restaurant I've come across in the States. We went for dinner both of our nights in Pantai Cenang and ordered essentially the same thing both times -- beef rendang, laksa, chicken curry, and a few sides (prawns maybe?). Highly recommend those dishes!p.s. We were almost dissuaded from going because the profile photo was a burger. Nothing wrong with burgers, but it's not what we were looking for on Langkawi!Show less

Author: Wanderer990Somerset
Title: A very nice meal, beautifully presented
Review: thoroughly enjoyed our meal here, nice setting and excellent service. The meals were very well presented, not huge but sufficient. I had room for a dessert, a very tasty sago pudding with gula Malacca, a particular favorite when I used to live in Singapore as a child. They told us about another restaurant around the corner called Arang which has the same owners. We tried that and enjoyed that as well!Show less

Author: jlssmrdGhent, Belgium
Title: Great place for dinner!
Review: Located in a back street near the main road of Pantai Tengah, this little restaurant offers Malay and Western dishes for dinner (also breakfast, but did not try it). Given the ‘remote’ location, it creates a quiet, peaceful atmosphere to dine. The terrace tables al have candles successfully fending of mosquitoes, which is welcome, however applying a little bit of bug repellent when you come wouldn’t be such a bad idea. The food was both times great. The beef Satay and Aunt Lynette’s Wonton are really tasty appetizers, which I highly recommend. The beef rendang was good as well, just spicy enough for me. Staff was friendly. I will definitely come back again when visiting Langkawi!! Show less

Author: traceyandpeterLimassol, Cyprus
Title: Maybe they were having an off day...
Review: Seeing how highly Fat Cupid was rated, we decided to visit. Tucked away along a bumpy back road, most of the tables were occupied when we arrived. I ordered the beef rendang and my partner ordered the nyonya chicken curry. I had heard a lot about beef rendang so was looking forward to tasting it. Unfortunately, the meat was chewy and bland in taste, although hubby said the chicken curry was 'nice' We also ordered desert, a choc brownie ice cream sandwich and a spicy blondie, which were just ok. All in all, nothing to write home about. We paid 143.55 RM ( £26.50) for 2 mains, a fresh juice, water, a beer and 2 deserts, which doesn't seem bad but we got so much better meals for the same price elsewhere in Tengah.Show less

Author: molkushaBrussels, Belgium
Title: Nice breakfast
Review: We were staying at Fuuka Villa which does not offer a breakfast therefore we took a short stroll to FatCupid for breakfast. Until certain hour (i believe 3pm) they only serve breakfast and no other dishes (i wanted to eat bruschetta). Since I do not eat diary products and eggs I just picked a few items from the ‘sides menue’. Had hash browns (very good), grilled tomatoes (amazing!) and grilled mushrooms (didnt eat them as they were made on butter). Bread was homemade. Everything came with a coconut jam (which was a bit too sweet for my taste). Coffee is best i had on the island. Would recommend also for vegans. Moderately priced with very nice staff. Will come again just be more precise about diet requirements. Show less

Author: ManchesterUKM3
Title: Great food and service
Review:
Great food and service- loved it especially pizza and iced tea.

We also had wontons and satay beef and chicken excellent.  Malay curries very good.

The wine was great and all very inexpensive

Author: 205bentleybShannon, Ireland
Title: Special family holiday dinner.
Review: It was after a long day by the beach, that we wanted a special place for a relaxing dinner. By chance we heard of Fat Cupid, with a little apprehension we went for it. What a delight. A small, quaint and relaxed great dining spot. The service, very good from the time we entered to when we had to leave. The menu was varied with sea food dominant, the food was fabulous and well presented, the wine list good and reasonable (for Malaysia) the dessert was just what the doctor ordered. All in all a great meal, lovely staff and hope to be able to make it back again.Show less

Author: LalaK115
Title: Very nice experience
Review: Good food (especially wonton's stole my heart!), very lovely atmosphere and absolutely first class service anf stuff!!!! Loved them! *hugs*

Author: bobtP1610EXFarnham Common, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and lovely staff
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for 4 nights and ate here every day. The food was beautifully prepared from fresh ingredients. From the succulent satay to tasty salads and grandma’s own Malaysian dishes, it was superb. The staff were friendly and attentive and the prices more than reasonable. If you are visiting Langkawi don’t miss this lovely restaurant for lunch or dinner.Show less

Author: ExploreandTravelKLDevon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food and great service!
Review: We went to this restaurant twice during our weeks stay in Langkawi! The food is really good and the staff are very friendly. The starters were so good we went back and ordered the same food second time round. We will be returning when we are next in Langkawi.Show less

Author: mfletcher09
Title: Great breakfast!
Review: Awesome breakfast option! Loved the iced coffees and 'freezies'. Excellent service and atmosphere. Highly recommend.

Author: MissGreen84Paddock Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Went here last night for dinner and the food was amazing, it had a very relaxed atmosphere and a lovely view looking over the pool. As it was set back off the main road it was very quiet too, get there early if you haven't booked though as it's very popular. Would highly recommend, it was a great find. Show less

Author: KiiraAndMikko
Title: Dinner with friends on a Valentine's day
Review: Fine dining in nice surroundings. Reasonable prices and friendly service. Our second time and still perfect. Recommend!

Author: creamteaanyoneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food and good service
Review: Fat Cupid is a restaurant attached to the La Par Pari hotel a short walk down the main strip of Pentai Tengah and then down a quiet side street.. The food was really lovely, a good mix of western options and modern takes on traditional Malay dishes. I had the Nasi Ayam Pontay - a gorgeous chicken dish with rice and vegetables, which I would highly recommend.Staff were lovely and managed to be attentive without being overly fussy. Overall a lovely restaurant experience.Show less

Author: faliqueburn
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review:
Good - ambience, staff, service, portion
Bad - some food not fresh, too pricey not worth the quality, pizza too dry, location too secluded.

Author: TamutoscanaDeddington, United Kingdom
Title: OK, but not sure what all the hype is about
Review: We decided to eat at fatCUPID because the TripAdvisor reviews were so enthusiastic about the food. I suppose it depends on what you are comparing it to. The food were perfectly decent and probably better than the plethora of largely empty restaurants lining the main road.For the starter, we had satay, which was the best dish. The meat was succulent and not dry; and the sauce was not just the standard peanut curry. We asked if the fish was fresh and were vehemently assured that it was. So we both had fish dishes for the main course. Both were perfectly edible , but not outstanding. The Malay dish was not recognisable as Nyonya cuisine, whatever the restaurant's claims. (As we have both spend much of our lives in maritime South East Asia and eat Nyonya/Peranakan food when possible, we may be rather discriminating judges.) To give fatCUPID a chance to shine, we ordered the other dish from the European part of the menu. It was acceptable but not special. Langkawi being an island with a big fishing industry we hoped that the fish would be really fresh, which it was not. With only a quarter of the tables occupied and so turnover slow, perhaps this is not surprising.Acceptable but not worth going out of your way for, especially if you have a car, as there are far better venues on the island.Show less

Author: alex_v_hkBerlin, Germany
Title: Awesome Langkawi food
Review: We had 4 different dishes - the Langkawi Snapper Steak vegetable stew dish (which was exceptional), 2 different chicken curries and the Beef Hor Fun noodles - all were authentically flavourful and delicious. The seasoning all tasted fresh and was just right, whether it was the gentle aniseed in the chicken curry or the lemon zest in the snapper dish.The staff were very friendly and attentive and the whole experience was delightful.Only suggestion for improvement - add a baby change table in the bathroom.Show less

Author: madbird55Farnborough, United Kingdom
Title: Gorgeous food
Review: Went here as rated by others on Trip Advisor, and I was not disappointed. Although quite small and not smart , the food was fabulous. Satay as starter and I had sweet and sour chicken but all meals good. Service excellentUnfortunately it was a 30 min taxi ride from our hotel but if it had been nearer we would have been back every night! Show less

Author: Pearlie22Basingstoke, Hampshire
Title: The best restaurant in Langkawi in our mind
Review: After we struggled to find local restaurants serving local food, we could not believe our luck when we found FatCupids. The food was excellent, so good we visited three nights out of a four night visit. There was plenty of choice and Bell (the owner we think) was on hand each visit to help us out with choices. The setting was lovely and relaxed and clean. Don’t leave out the dessert as they were so delicious.We would definitely recommend this if you are visiting Langkawi, even if you have fussy friends who like ‘burger and chips’ they can accommodate Show less

Author: ApinnickHampshire
Title: Oustanding
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for 4 nights and ate here 3 of them!Not because of lack of choice but we just couldn’t find anything that matched this in terms of quality, choice and service.The food here is authentic Malay and was new to us, but Bell saved the day. She talked us through the options and suggested dishes we might like to try, and her choices were spot on. There is clearly a passion here for making sure your experience is a good one, as all the staff were very friendly and attentive.The choice of food is excellent, offering a range of dishes, catering for all culinary tastes. We loved it here, if you are looking for authentic local dishes, cooked to perfection and served with a passion for making the night memorable then look no further.Thank you Bell and the team, you deserve all the praise you get.Tony & PearlShow less

Author: darricoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Service, Cosy Ambience, Average Food
Review: Looking at the reviews here in TripAdvisor, we were looking forward to some excellent food. Sadly, the experience fell way below expectations. The chicken pontay, fish asam pedas and beef rendang were average at best. It may have been a matter of preference, but the pontay did taste a little weird to our palate. So did the asam pedas. It may not have helped that we had two nyonyas dining with with us and my other half casually remarked that I shouldn't have brought them for Peranakan food in Langkawi. In my defence I told her that FatCupid came highly recommended on TripAdvisor. Their smoked salmon linguini did them some amount of justice, although that surely wasn't the reason why we drove all the way there. It would have been a lowly two star had the review only been about the food. The service and ambience got them the additional star as I have to say the minimalist atmosphere was cosy, and service commendable. Took a good half an hour plus before the dishes arrived and even then it did taste as though some dishes had the microwave treatment (I could be wrong though). All in, no, I wouldn't recommend FatCupid, especially not for the dishes we ordered. Perhaps their other dishes were better but we won't be going there again. Show less

Author: ShelleyO123The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Nice place with tasty food
Review: After me and my boyfriend went jetskiing, we were longing for a place to get some food and regain some energy. FatCupid was the perfect place for that. It was a bit of a walk from the beach, but when we got there we were welcomed by the friendly people from FatCupid. I ordered the veggie burger and my boyfriend laksa a local noodle soup. It both tasted very good. My burger was very tastefull. The laksa as well, but was somewhat too spicy for my boyfriend. The waitress noticed and offered some extra coconut cream. We really appreciated that, because it helped!Show less

Author: PakaH
Title: Made our stay in Penang
Review: Brilliant cozy restaurant with great choice of foods, desserts and drinks. Off the beach but in a lovely setting. Staff were super friendly.

Author: hafizAiresLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Still Amazing
Review: From the moment we arrive till the moment we leaving everything is flawless. The staff was very nice, attentive and super helpful. Food as always, Amazing. Tried the chicken in kapitan cooking style, and WOW .Would come back to try the duck dish soon . Keep up the good job . Show less

Author: Linda HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A Gem in Pantai Tengah, Superb Food
Review: fatCupid is located a short walk from the main road in Pantai Tengah and is the cafe/restaurant at the small La Pari-Pari hotel. The restaurant is open sided and overlooks pretty hotel grounds and a small swimming pool. What makes this restaurant stand out is the quality of the food and the high level of customer service. We ate here several times during our stay here (I have reviewed La Pari-Pari separately) and on all occasions the food was superb and of a very high standard. One page of the menu offers traditional Nonya/Malaysian dishes and there's a section offering Western style dishes too. We sampled a range of dishes from both sections and were impressed with everything. There's a good range of drinks and our cocktails were excellent. This is casual dining but expertly done. At night the lighting and music (not loud) creates a very pleasant ambiance that so many restaurants fail to achieve. Price wise fatCupid costs no more than other eateries but is far superior, so this represents excellent value for money. A gem of a restaurant.Show less

Author: 178elizabethh
Title: Fancy treat for our last night in langkawi
Review: We loved it here and it’s a really affordable treat. Great veggie options and not to mention so tasty. Really lovely service. I would highly recommend.

Author: noahp876Santa Fe, New Mexico
Title: Serene dining with good vegetarian options
Review: While looking for vegetarian in Langkawi we stumbled upon this hotel restaurant. Just a shot walk up a back road you’ll fine candle lit tables in a garden patio. Good options for vegetarians, meal won’t disappoint. We tried the cocktails and a dessert and both were equally as good.Show less

Author: TanH25
Title: Relaxing environment for a good meal
Review: Loved the all-white setting with all the surrounding greens. Staffs are friendly and portion of food are generous. Worth a visit, definitely

Author: P4545IFdennisl
Title: Quiet place, good food
Review:
This was the best place I had dinner while I was on Langkawi.

Had both appetizer and main dish and both was good. Had some cocktails as well and they where tasty.

Nice service, would definitely come again.

Author: Friederike E
Title: Very good breakfast with vegetarian option!
Review: We came to have breakfast at the fatcupid, very good service, excellent milkshakes and good breakfast. They have vegetarian options.

Author: Kenya U
Title: A MUST place to go in Langkawi
Review: I would recommend this lovely cozy restaurant. The decor and the blue pool right beside the restaurant give you an excellent relaxing time, especially for couples and family. Food was great too. Their staffs are very friendly and you'll like them. I'll come back here next time!Show less

Author: 84dennisy
Title: Excellent environment and service but average food
Review: A restaurant with good vibe and excellent service. Friendly and helpful staff. However the food we ordered were just average and did not worth the money we spent there. Not sure about their beverage.

Author: alysonm120
Title: Lunch
Review: Nice ambience, friendly service, tasty food and great cocktails! Def one of the better restaurants on the island.

Author: 104anderss
Title: Very nice restaurant
Review: Food was great! Good quality malaysian food! You can also have more western like food. Would definately go back!

Author: shyambarr
Title: A lovely experience
Review: This place oozes calming vibes. From the white decor, the blue pool and the lush green setting - I walked in and instantly felt at ease. The 'freezie' lemongrass juice was refreshing and the beef rendeng was the best one I've had in Malaysia thus far. All in all- a lovely experience. I would highly recommend a visit.Show less

Author: reahna2015Melbourne, Australia
Title: A sense of peace
Review: This restaurant has it all. Amazing food, wonderful staff and an outlook onto impeccable grounds an La Pari Pari. A sense of peace comes over you from the time you enter with the soft French music a white decor providing a calming environment. I had the laksa and my husband the rendang. Both were delicious. Would highly recommend the laksa if you are like me and enjoy the coconut base. We are sad to only be in the area for three days, but will definitely be returning during that time! Show less

Author: Kieran B
Title: Tasty Laksa
Review: Came here for dinner one evening. It is a bit of a walk from Cenang beach but was worth it in the end. We both ordered the Laksa and it was very tasty. There was a nice relaxing atomosphere and the staff were very friendly.

Author: Ron FCanberra, Australia
Title: Absolute gem
Review: Read about Fat Cupid in Trip Advisor and was not let down. So far, we’ve had cocktails, dinner and now breakfast. Service is wonderful (especially Michelle and Belle). Nothing is too much trouble. Although a little hard to find, it’s worth the search. The quality of the food is wonderful (including some family hand-me-downs). The 3 egg omelette was especially yummy. Fresh juices are lovely and very authentic. Two things of note- in my view- best coffee on Langkawi and incredibly clean toilets. We will come back again and again! Show less

Author: CallaBudgieFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Very good food and friendly service
Review: Having read the reviews we decided to have dinner at fatCUPiD. Nice setting at the pool area of a hotel. Excellent malaysian western fusion food. Make sure to try the frozen juices. Dessert was great as well. It was well visited the evening we went there and the service was a bit slow but apologized a lot for this. We did not see this as a bad thing as we do not like to be rushed anyway. All in all a rather on the pricey side for the area but well worth the money. Show less

Author: aNNaSKLAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Magical dining
Review: Had our deserts here right under the shining stars and a few strings of the fairy lights. Ordered Not your Mama's Sandwich and also Spicy Blonde. Both are given two thumbs up from me. Cooling ambience at night with some breeze flowing with the swimming pool scenery is quite awesome.Show less

Author: rebeccakX3650KESydney, Australia
Title: Beautiful scenery and menu!
Review: A beautiful scenery and the menu is superb with lots of options. I ordered the Malaysian eggs with the coconut jam on toast and it arrived on a beautifully presented large plate with two eggs in a little bowl to peel yourself plus toast and condiments, I started to peel my eggs and they broke in my hand/weren’t cooked :( I really don’t like raw eggs so I couldn’t eat it but my partner ordered the big breakfast so I shared some of his and enjoyed my mint and lemon ice drink. Thankfully I also ordered some hash browns which were yummy so I didn’t leave hungry haha! Overall the staff are friendly and the scene is beautiful by the pool plus the food is fresh and the venue is clean, we’ll go back again but I will order something different!Show less

Author: bobbyh662
Title: All Good
Review: Great place for food with the family even the 10yr and 15yr old enjoyed the meal and the environment of this little Gem in Langkawi. Staff excellent service. Location just hidden off the main road. Thank You for a lovely evening.

Author: preemnatht
Title: Nice and quiet place
Review: visited the place for dinner with my partner, it was a quiet and calm place. the waiter was  friendly and very helpful. the food was average but the ambiance of the place makes up for it.

Author: MatheiFBerlin, Germany
Title: Nice place and great service
Review: We went there for a dinner and decided to come back for breakfast as well. As a man I really enjoy if the food is just not great, but the portions are in the right size as well ( not too small) and I think that in fatCupid it was really well balanced. The whole place is really well designed, they have thought through all the small details. The waitresses were really nice and proffesional, they also gave us advice were to go on the island. Definately worth visit.Show less

Author: GerryC766
Title: Gluten Free choices too
Review: Fabulous restaurant.  Great service, exceptional food!  Excellent assistance with Gluten Free questions.  Nothing a problem.  Have been twice now, will come again before we leave Langkawi

Author: 446philipf
Title: Excellent
Review:
Loved the laid back style and personal touch the hosts add to the restaurant. 
We saw some rooms, no need to hide with them or the little pool in front. Cool and hip place in Tengah

Author: Elke B
Title: Best Food!
Review:
I loved the food there! Great for vegetarians!
Try the homemade juices!
The location is hidden and placed in a resort.

Author: wengyewh2017
Title: Relaxing ambience, good food
Review: Walking into fatCupid immediately puts one in a holiday mood. The dining area is soothing with muted grey and white paint schemes, and unfussy table settings complement the clean lines of the long concrete bar. A view of the pool and a nice sea breeze gently swaying the trees further adds to the ambience. Food was of a high standard: prawns in our pasta dishes were fresh with generous amounts of vegetables; similarly so in the prawn sambal which had an added spicy kick. They also had an extensive drinks menus including interesting concoctions using local fruits and ingredients. For dessert we had the chendol which was fine but for aficionados of Penang-standard uber chendols this may not hit their spot. All in all a good meal to start a holiday.Show less

Author: Anne F
Title: Excellent food.
Review: Lovely restaurant with excellent service and staff. The beef rendang was to die for as was the white parfait with mango ice cream and praline. Good coffee too.

Author: szjoe666
Title: Holiday
Review: First time in my life and my kids on this trip in langkawi. Fat Cupid was the best choice for our brunch. Interesting menu and cozy atmosphere very friendly staff good food great place for any occasion anytime!!!

Author: JCC-84
Title: Great service with great food
Review: My partner and I enjoyed dinner at fatCUPID.The food was fantastic and caters for those looking for Asian as well as Western meals. Beef burger hit the spot as well as the Beef Rendang! Nice location with a peaceful backdrop. The restaurant is off the main road and down a dirt road, don’t be put off by this. Service from staff was fantastic and our waiter even made friendly suggestions on places to visit during our stay in Langkawi.Show less

Author: oliviad507Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Cute wee place
Review: It’s a bit of a strange walk to get there - down a dark street however it is definitely worth it. The food was tasty and the service was great. Belle the lady who worked there was fantastic - she recommended places for us to go and also best place for massage. I would recommend the chicken laska -was sooo good! Show less

Author: AlexMaxi
Title: Top food, great Service
Review: We had our diner there an it was an lovely evening. The food was perfect (Burger and Fish). And the stuff very frendly and they do what they can if make you an nice diner. They have 4 Highchair for Baby. We'll come back

Author: Annick J
Title: Loved it!
Review: Nice atmophere, and the waiters are really nice and helpfull. Food was good, and so was the coffee. I went here from breakfast. Wich was better than I expected. Poaches eggs where and so was the rest of the plate :) higly recommend this place Show less

Author: louisaknox
Title: Great food & cocktails
Review: Awesome dinner, amazing desserts and a bloody good espresso martini. Don’t miss this hidden gem off the Main Street!!

Author: Carlie1984
Title: Yum!!
Review: Delicious dinner!! So much flavor! Lots to choose from! Desserts were delicious! Amazing espresso martini!! Yum!!

Author: Travellermary1Mirissa, Sri Lanka
Title: Good food - good service
Review: Really friendly service. No language barrier here cause everybody here speaks perfect english. Local specialities and also western style food. They also know about glutein free diet and can recommended glutein free options. If you are bored to local restaurants and looking for more western style dining experience, go to this place.Show less

Author: kimkP56DNSeoul, South Korea
Title: Good ambience, average food, bad portion
Review: I came here for breakfast, the service and the ambience were great but compared to the price that we paid for, the portion was too small. We ordered Nasi Lemak and Smoked Salmon Sandwich. The sandwich was good but it was the chicken in Nasi Lemak that was so bony with barely any meat. But really good ambience and service! Show less

Author: paulsF1068UBCala'n Porter, Spain
Title: Setting, Satay and Superb Service
Review: First night here and decided to find this hidden gem of a restaurant and we were not dissapointed in any way by food or service.On arrival we were greeted with smiles and as we rang in advance a table was reserved and we were then offered drinks and menus on the candlelit table and all staff were very proactive and knew the menu as we asked many questions on the Malay Food. Started with a Superb Crispy Calamari Salad & Mixed Satays which melted in the mouth and after we choose two Malay Curry dishes the Kapitans Chicken Curry and a Spicy Hot Prawn Sambal all were Served with attention to detail and portions were just enough with the Sauvignon Blanc we had chosen with the meal.Overall a fantastic evening which we finished with Churros & Rich Chocolate Ice Cream and a long walk home as we were full to bursting ....And are looking forward to our next trip back to savour some more fab food.Show less

Author: whatwouldgiodo
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review: We arrived close to kitchen closing and the restaurant was happy to stay open for us. Great food and friendly staff. One of the staff, Michelle, was even kind enough to write out a list of recommendations of things to do in Langkawi, which we might of missed it not for her.Show less

Author: Bdance78
Title: The best curry I have ever had
Review:
Food is amazing. Fresh, full of flavour and unique and not over priced. 
Good for kids too with a western menu and high chairs.

Author: P10L
Title: Super friendly Staff
Review: Went there for lunch at noon because most places around my hotel opens only after 2pm or 5pm.  Son had the Work (english bfast) and I had the nasi lemak. Pretty decent food.

Author: pipgreg
Title: Highly recommended restsurant
Review: We really enjoyed Fat Cupid so had two dinners here. Really friendly staff and wonderful food. Really nice setting also. Definitely worth a visit or two.

Author: dukehawkeye
Title: Amazing
Review:
This is an amazing hidden treasure! Delicious food en great staff. 
We had the appetizer for 2. Great but way to much. Followed by the rendang temphé. GREAT. And the spicy chili prawns. Fabulous! Highly recommend place.

Author: stepht2409Wellington, New Zealand
Title: Lovely restaurant
Review: We loved this restaurant so much we went back twice. The location is beautiful and very peaceful, the food is amazing with a great mix of European and Malaysian food on the menu and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. The dessert "Not your Mama's sandwich" was a huge hit with the kids.Show less

Author: Curiosity597556
Title: Jane & Laura
Review: Had a really nice meal there - definitely worth the walk down the road! Service was good especially One - made you feel very welcome. Well worth a visit

Author: nellzbob
Title: Great chilled out vibe
Review:
Nice restaurant set back from the main road 
Great staff attention to detail lovely food 
The staff even ran us to our hotel as it was raining so heavy

Author: Paula M
Title: Breakfast not suitable for Gluten Intolerant
Review: I was lead to believe this restaurant could cater for Gluten free food. When I couldn't see anything on the menu I asked the staff. They suggested the sandwich and croissant. When I told them what gluten was they suggested the pancakes, which also contain wheat. I ended up having poached eggs, baked beans and a small serving of veges. I didn't enjoy my meal. The actual restaraunt itself looked very nice. Show less

Author: Jo1895
Title: Best dinner at Langkawi
Review: We enjoyed a perfect dinner here. The chicken stew dish I ordered was fantastic. My partner's burger was great too. The panna cotta we shared for dessert also was very delicious. Nice athmosphere and warm lights. Fantastic service; we felt very welcome and would love to visit againShow less

Author: pippa681
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Went there twice during our one week stay in Langkawi...definitely one of the best restaurants in the area

Author: KeithandjessieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Malay and western food
Review: This restaurant is something of a hidden gem. Its down a track off the main road so not obvious unless you know its there. The food ( we all had Malay dishes) is outstanding. We had the best beef rendang I have ever tasted. Staff are friendly attentive and give great service. We were only in Langkawi for 4 days but couldnt resist going twice.Show less

Author: YasminZ28
Title: kapitan chicken on rainy day
Review: the dish was lovely. spicy enough by international standard though i could definitely raise the bar higher. it was raining. the sound of nostalgic french song in the air relaxes the lunch atmosphere. it was the place to be.

Author: charlottehI5972FV
Title: Friendly hosts and tasty food!!
Review: We really enjoyed our meal at fatCUPID, they have a good range of food, including lots of options for vegetarians (I had the tofu and mushroom burger which was AWESOME). The staff are very friendly and the atmosphere is very relaxed.  Worth the visit!

Author: Suzie LSunningdale, United Kingdom
Title: Great food nice atmosphere
Review: We found the foodie scene in Langkawi a bit of a disappointment after Penang, so made a last ditch attempt to get to find some great nosh. fatCUPID didn't dissappoint us. The staff are friendly the ambience is really relaxed and chilled out and the food was really good and accompanied by some great cocktails. I don't think I can rate is as the best food ever in Malaysia but overall it was pretty much a great experience for the evening and certainly the best we had in Langkawi. If we had stayed longer I would have gone for brunch or lunch or dinner again. The only challenge is that the location isn't the easiest to find. fatCUPID people better signs please tell the hotel down the road where you are as well or have a few more signs for us tourists that are stumbling around to find you. Make the effort its worth it. Show less

Author: las00796
Title: Not worth the price
Review: The food is too expensive for its quality. I ordered a highly recommended vegetarian burger but it really disappointed me. The taste was so weird and even the fries were too salty, even worse than McD (but the price here is tripled). The customers sitting near us were smoking which really pissed us off. Smoking should be banned here! Show less

Author: Shayak CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food & service
Review: A bit off the road, it is located in a quiet alley (a bit of a bumpy ride from the road) - easy to miss unless you are active on TripAdvisor or other similar apps. We went by the TripAdvisor rating and I must say, they totally live up to their rating. We started off with fried wanton before moving to the main course. While I ordered for the English brunch (chicken sausages, bacon, baked beans, sunny side up, hash browns and bread), my mother and wife ordered for sambal prawn with rice for the main course. We also went for the Lychee lime drink (a blended ice drink) to go with the food. Everything that we ordered seemed to be freshly cooked (specially the sambal prawn) and were cooked to near perfection. Service was very prompt - our food was served within 15 minutes from ordering. The decor is completely white and thus, the ambience has a very casual feel to it. The restaurant looks into a small pool and a garden with small cottages on the sides - it adds to the casual feel. What stood out most was their service. It was raining heavily outside so the staff escorted us till our car with umbrellas (without us even asking for help) - such small gestures add up to a superlative experience. Overall, a must visit when you are in Langkawi!Show less

Author: eleanor_tzy
Title: Worth trying!
Review: The place is not that easy to find as it is quite deep inside and the road is not that developed. The nyonya laksa is really delicious. It is a must try together with it's tasty sambal. The mackerel dish which is one of their special has a very unique fusion taste as well. The ayam ponteh is however not that authentic as the nyonya's. They have an excellent ambience and their service is good. The price I would say is above average. The place is an open area and thus mosquitos can't be avoided but they do provide candles that repel mosquitos.Show less

Author: 518diannes
Title: Excellent food!
Review: A Creative menu with many fresh food choices. It was my favorite place in Langkawi. Fresh juices and salads. Great service as well.

Author: Journ3yLondon, United Kingdom
Title: At the end of a bumpy puddle filled road, but worth it!
Review: It was pretty quiet when we went so the atmosphere wasn't great, but it is a really nice environment and the food (we had the local dishes) was pretty good - seemed to be good quality and nicely prepared and presented. We got a lift so not an issue, but if we were walking the last bit would have been pretty grim as it is at the bottom of a dark, very bumpy and wet road so make sure you have appropriate footwear! Overall we did enjoy it and would recommend. Show less

Author: alex-shapo87Berlin, Germany
Title: Fantastic food ! Not expensive and still luxury.
Review: Hidden secret place here on langkawi! For round about 20rm main course, which taste so awesome! If you are here, you should pass by with your partner/family etc! Nice chilly musik and very good atmosphere as well ... 15 min walk from cenang beach, fully worth it. Enjoy!Show less

Author: kaybrauneSouthampton, New York
Title: Delicious food with local flair
Review: We stayed at Le Par Pari hotel and ate breakfast here every day. The Nasi Lemak was so delicious for breakfast. The western style breakfast was also a large portion and delicious. We also ate dinner here. The menu is varied for all tastes. The service was outstanding. It is a little bit out of Cenang and closer to Tenngah beach. It is away from the craziness of the town and offers a lovely quiet place to have a terrific meal.Show less

Author: Marion19682015
Title: Delicious food! Great service
Review:
Great authentic Malayan cuisine . 
Also serve good wine . The 
Service was very good . Quiet and modern surrounding.

Author: VthyaK
Title: To chill and relax
Review: we went to have an early dinner.. we had the mee curry, which was very very delicious! must try... similar to the ones we used to have in malacca, thick paste and very creamy curry...

Author: Tracey HMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best Malaysian food we had in Langkawi
Review: We stayed at La Pari Pari and had heard the food at Fat Cupid was worth trying...it sure was! We ate there every night of our stay (4N). Fantastic Malaysian food (I think between the 4 of us we must've tried almost every dish) and cocktails. We didn't try any of the western dishes so I can't comment, however they looked tasty. Would recommend coming for dinner, although I believe the main menu is possibly offered at lunch also. Lovely setting overlooking the lit up pool. Show less

Author: Colin P
Title: Lacks Atmosphere
Review: Whilst the food and drinks are ok, the location after dark is a bit frightening for single women. If it has rained then bring your waders. Nothing out of the ordinary and there are more accessible and affordable Restrauent.

Author: NicholasW1849
Title: Loved it
Review: Good menu, great food that was well and interestingly presented. Wine was good value. Staff were attentive and funny. It is not the prettiest place, but it does what it says it does. It was busy despite the poor weather.

Author: F1287PPandrews
Title: Really excellent food and service
Review:
Delightful spot with great menu and lush surroundings. Highly recommend a visit. 
Also great vegetarian selection
Ordered the Tempe rendang which was great but also persuaded to have the albino pizza appetiser which was AMAZING😄
Lychee & lime granita also good
Fantastic !

Author: X3324PTmarktTaunton, United Kingdom
Title: Different Class
Review: Superb food, not only for Langkawi, but for anywhere. The starters were amazing, as were the main courses. I had the beef rendang and my wife had the chicken roulade, both were exceptional. My only regret is that we found this restaurant on our last night! We visited this restaurant whilst staying at Pelangi Beach the day we had a hire car. It is just about walkable and would be easy in a taxi. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: tmlarv
Title: Best in Pantai Cenang
Review: We visited as a family of 5 on our first night in Langkawi. The food was excellent as was the service. My beef rendang was delicious. It's a bit out of the way but get a cab - it's worth it!

Author: Loretta IMelbourne
Title: A Hidden Gem!
Review: We went to fatCUPID based on tripadvisor reviews and it was only a 5 minute walk from the Holiday Villas where we were staying. Walking down the dark dirt driveway leading to it was a little concerning to our 3 kids but we were all very impressed when we arrived. A nice little modern restaurant, serving great food and cocktails!! The boys enjoyed the beef burger and chips, I enjoyed a magnificent & huge Laksa and my daughter ate a beautiful & fresh chicken/mango salad. It was all absolutely delicious and the kids begged us to go back. Slightly more expensive than the few local restaurants we ate at but nice for a change. Show less

Author: Dee8365
Title: Always a delight
Review: 6 of us visited Fat Cupid and the Laksa was delicious, presentation of all meals was excellent. A visit to Langkawi must include a meal at Fat Cupid.

Author: Michael M
Title: Good food, nice atmosphere
Review: Probably above average but not quite 'very good'. The menu is a bit more unique than other restaurants around so worth the visit.

Author: Amanda2495Melbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing!
Review: The food is incredible and the service fantastic as well. We lived at the hotel and had dinner at FatCupid more than once! If you get a chance try the tack of lamb but also their special sangria as that too is amazing. Without a doubt the best restaurant in Langkawi! Show less

Author: thaliaachildSydney, Australia
Title: Lovely Dinner
Review: You wouldn't stumble upon this restaurant by mistake. It is off the main road but only a short walk and would definitely recommend visiting! The food was excellent quality. Samosas to start off with were good for sharing and then we each had a main dish. They have an entire page of western dishes as well so as to please everyone. Their Malaysian style curries can be altered in terms of spicyness also. The service was very good and we thoroughly enjoyed the glasses of sangria we had with our dinner. You are seated outdoors but undercover and the bathrooms were clean and tidy. Thank you for having us fatCUPID!Show less

Author: JoannaG3553
Title: Excellent Service
Review: Highly recommend, this restaurant is a little off the beaten track but worth the trip. The food was great and the service was fantastic. Not only did everything come out fast but our hostess was friendly and took the time to give us recommendations and tips for day excursions on the island.Show less

Author: chrisrX6498UH
Title: Stylish and relaxed setting, fantastic food
Review: Came here for breakfast and dinner. Great selection of modern and traditional food served by friendly staff in a chilled atmosphere. Loved the French music too!

Author: daross1
Title: 5* food and atmosphere
Review: me and and wife went here twice for dinner on our week long trip and also recommended it to another couple we met, who ended up also loving it. not a lot to say except the food, service and atmosphere are perfect and also it is very reasonably priced - which is harder to find on the main strip for this level of food. Show less

Author: RafildaR1
Title: Yum!
Review: The food was good and the staff friendly and accommodating. We arrived on the restaurant day off (Monday) but was invited to join in their staff party. Yaay!

Author: Erikito1Brussels, Belgium
Title: A hidden delight!
Review: We decided to visit Fatcupid after a great recommendation from some friends and oooh boy were they right! I had the rack of lamb and my wife the lemon butter snapper: absolutely delicious. Belle (aka 'Cynthia') served us with the biggest smile and so much enthousiasm that it's contagious. Too bad it was our last evening on Langkawi, otherwise we would have returned for a 2nd/3rd time!It is a bit hidden away, but go for it, you won't regret it.Highly recommended, Erik & Maddy.Show less

Author: hilkojHilversum, The Netherlands
Title: Great place to have dinner
Review: What a great place to have dinner and some drinks. Away from the busy main street, cocktails are great, staff is very friendly and the food is delicious (try the home made ice cream). They even made a special plate of fried rice for our 9 month old baby. They also have baby chairs.Show less

Author: FruitusDoha, Qatar
Title: Great Breakfast
Review: We visited for breakfast twice. Both times the experience was great. The lovely garden location is great, very peaceful and quiet. The staff were excellent, attentive but not overly so. The food was top quality as was the coffee. Took a little finding, but as long as you have a smartphone, you'll find it ok. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: 499kristoffers
Title: Very Good service, excellent Food
Review: The title sums it up! This is by far the best restaurant on the island and we tried a few during our week. What stands out is the service but the food is really good and affordable! The setting is very Nice as well!

Author: Vince S
Title: Delicious food, great staff and nice ambiance
Review: fatCupid is a great restaurant. The location is a bit odd and off the main road, but the place itself looks great. We visited them twice during our holiday. Nice soothing music too, and the décor is on point. Cocktails and wine are proper. Menu has good mixture of local and western.Show less

Author: flierexmelbourne
Title: Just Yum. And so friendly
Review: This was a little out of the way from Pantai Cenang, but I drew a sketch and the taxi driver got us there for 15 MYR. Our guide at Dev's recommended this place to us. From the moment we walked through the door we got a solid welcome from the crew. There was a real atmosphere of casual friendliness, and we felt immediately confident. We ordered mixed satay sticks ( a very generous portion), and a beer each, then a bottle of wine with fish and chips and the slow cooked nonya chicken stew. Both were nice, and well presented. The total bill was 187, which was quitegood for what we had. The setting is lovely - a lovely light open yet undercover area surrounded by gardens. Really nice.Belle was a lovely waitress.I'd recommend this place for a middle of the price range restaurant with authentic food.Show less

Author: NomadShafLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Warm and Friendly Staff - Food was average!
Review: Visited FatCupid after reading all the rave reviews and I would like to share the following points:Pros:Nice and friendly receptionistStaff were attentiveGood atmosphereDrinks were lovelyCons:If its a full house, you can be sure the wait will be +1hr for food to arrive.The food was very average for NyonyaSort of hard to find as its hidden away from the main roadAll in all, a slightly disappointing visit with the wait times and average food but everything else was lovely.Show less

Author: bettyk915Geelong, Australia
Title: Yummy laksa
Review: We went to FatCUPID for dinner. The restaurant is down a dirt road off from the main road. The menu has a mixture of western and local dishes. The laksa is amazing! The staff were extremely accommodating and made changes that we requested for our drinks (eg. adding vodka or gin to a slushy drink). A most enjoyable night out!Show less

Author: Lauren RHamilton, United Kingdom
Title: Delecious Food
Review: We ate here for dinner on our first night as it was close to our hotel (The Fint Hus) and are so glad we did. The food was excellent and the service was friendly. We split the satay between us for a starter which was lovely, then I think I had my favourite meal of the whole holiday with their Nasi Sambal Udang, a spicy prawn curry. It was delicious! My husband had the beef rendang which was also very good. We visited another day but this time for breakfast which was just as good, having smoked salmon croissant and sweet potatoes with poached eggs. I would recommend coming here for any meal of the day as I'm sure you'll always get a good meal served by friendly staff.Show less

Author: MattR4
Title: Great atmosphere
Review:
My wife and I went with our 20month old for dinner! 
Walking distance from our resort (Frangipani Resort)!
Friendly staff great food! 
Had high chairs for little one!
Had the Laska which was great and wife had the chicken sandwich which was good also!

Author: jtsl9Sydney, Australia
Title: Great Ambiance & Food
Review: On our first night after having fun in the pool, we decided to try the hotel restaurant cause we were too lazy to venture out. The food was a mixture of local and western. The staff were friendly and service was good. The food portion was on the large side based on Malaysian standard. The food tasted good just that my friend chicken roulette was on the dried side.Show less

Author: rollingstone83London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Grateful we found a place with such tasty veg and vegan options. (It's not always easy as sometimes dishes show up with a flourish of dried fish, etc when you thought was vegan.)Service friendly and attentive; Setting and decor is minimalist and charming. It's a lovely spot for a quiet dinner. Show less

Author: mb20965
Title: Great Food
Review: We were staying at the hotel and dined here for breakfast and one dinner.  Food very fresh and tasty, amazing cocktails!

Author: JJWriting
Title: Best coffee in Langkawi to date!
Review: Lovely service, nice setting, very nice breakfast. Great coffee has been hard to find in Langkawi and this is the best so far! Thanks fatCUPID!

Author: NunoN880London, United Kingdom
Title: Good for starting the evening
Review: Good bar and prices are ok .. a nice crowd and seems to have ladies nights on Wednesdays and Saturdays free cocktails for girls all evening ( about 4 different cocktails ) .. but tiger beer at 7malasian money and cocktails around 22 .. from 9-11pm buy one get one free ... all around a good bar to start ur evening .. Show less

Author: stevenpN5318FNSingapore
Title: Great flavours
Review: Surroundings non aircon...so it was uncomfortable.Alcohol and drinks average.Flavours of food was fantastic! So very hard to decide if you'd go back. If you're looking for a fun afternoon by the pool side with good food, then this could be it with a group you bring yourself.Quite empty when we went on on Saturday lunch.Food Flavours the only attraction!Show less

Author: annworth2009
Title: Dinner
Review:
Lanka lovely. Big serve. 
Excellent menu with options to suit every dinner.

Explained options on menu and helped with selection.
Desserts again big serve. I had Brownie Sandwich filled with ice cream. Never eaten a brownie before and lovely. 
 
Customer service excellent.

Author: AmstelDaveAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious food (and wine)
Review: Whilst this place is a bit of a walk from the main strip it was well worth it. Excellent menu which was very reasonably priced. Possibly the only place in Malaysia we've been able to get a reasonably priced and decent glass of wine too (22 ringgit for a great Tempranillo rosé at the time of writing). Show less

Author: gusdog28
Title: superb food
Review: a little hard to find but well worth it food and service could not be faulted excellent menu choice very friendly staff

Author: hafizAiresLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Good place lovely environment.
Review: My wife and I been here for dinner. We ordered the tasting plater for appetizer and its amazing especially the pizza. We go for western food as we are local. Must try the dessert 'not your momma sandwich' . But the local food from the menu sounds amazing too. The jazz music is just nice to the place and very suitable with the environment. We will definitely come back next time to try their local food speciality. The staff are friendly and the owner is also a nice lady. Hafiz and Aires Show less

Author: Steady
Title: Still Great
Review:
I really love the setting at this restaurant and have been here for morning coffee and dinner on quite a few occasions.
The fish and chips I had were excellent, the service was very quick and the staff are lovely and very friendly.

Author: davewuyts
Title: Excellent food great atmosphere
Review: We had chosen a Malay dish and a mixed plate for starters. The food was really delicious. The staff very friendly and if you ask a starter they bring it first and wait with your main course . Definetly try this place.

Author: paddygomez1
Title: Hidden Treasure
Review: Wonderful food and Excellent service from the staff. Would definitely recommend this to anyone. Salt water swimming pool that stays warm all the time too.

Author: Freya D
Title: Lovely service, setting and food
Review: Really worth a visit. We had a lovely evening, the staff made us feel really welcome. The chicken curry dish was amazing!!

Author: FunkyMarshmallowBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Good western breakfast
Review: After a long time travelling we were gagging a good western breakfast, after finding this place on TA we were not disappointed. Fairly pricey as it's attached to aboutique hotel but the food and coffe was good, shakes let them down, they use nesquick rather than fresh fruit which at that price is poor but the service is good so we can forgive them. Show less

Author: 356S-1
Title: Amazing
Review: Have visited twice now and food is delicious and full of flavour. Some really good veggie options. Service is good. Well worth the money.

Author: D1308VB
Title: Nice
Review:
Highly recommended, nice staff. Dishes are amazing. Cocktails as well.
Beautiful and peaceful location

Author: Dex M
Title: Big portions
Review:
We decided to have dinner here, and was impressed with the portion and taste of the food. Then, we decided to have breakfast. Again, we were impressed.

Suffice to say, we had breakfast here every single day during our vacation.

Author: PhilsgonemissingBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent western breakfast
Review: After travelling for months i was in need of a decent western breakfast and this place provided it. Set just off the main road in nice grounds over looking there garden and pool. Food is excellent sausage egg bacon beans toast all really well cooked and excellent service. Its not cheap compared to Malaysian prices but worth every penny if you need a decent feed. Veggie breakfast also availableShow less

Author: MattFrederickRotherham, United Kingdom
Title: Off the beat & track
Review: A Little bit out from Cenang (it took 25mins walking) but worth hunting it down.The menu offers a good range of Malay and fusion dishes. It's comparatively expensive but up market, high quality and tasty food.We had mains, pudding and wine for 200 ringgit for 2. This would be a bargain at home in the U.K.!The desserts were FANTASTIC! Make sure you leave room for one as they are different and delicious.Show less

Author: stephanierO2124CXLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food, plentiful portions, chic decor
Review: Stylish restaurant beside a pool and set back from the main road. We had wontons then beef rendang and beef portay. Delicious and generous portions. Solid wine and cocktail list too. Staff were really friendly and helpful, recommending where to head to on Cedang afterwards. Definitely recommend. Show less

Author: leighanna0Bramhall, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: We came to fat Cupid last night and had a great evening. We have the Thai beef salad, beef rendang and the most gorgeous deserts. Service was great. Enjoyed the food so much we went back this morning to sample the breakfast which was equally as good! Thanks Show less

Author: Lee RBognor Regis, United Kingdom
Title: Service charge grrr
Review: Decided to eat at the restaurant having read good reviews here. Greeted warmly by the vivacious owner, who was super friendly. The restaurant wasn't particularly busy, 2 other tables, but atmosphere ok as some quiet music playing.Mixed starters were nice, but 30RM, seemed a little overpriced.The food was nice, although my prawn dish was exceptionally spicy, to the point of nearly being inedible. The food was well presented and the service was very good.On the whole we had a nice meal but I did feel it was a little overpriced, but perhaps acceptable because of the ambiance and the standard of presentation.The food looked better than other meals we had eaten on the island, but didn't really taste better.What did annoy me and leave me disappointment was the fact that 10% service charge was automatically added. I do not like not being given a choice.Show less

Author: shannondE8671ZIPort Macquarie, Australia
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing - the food, the vibe, the service all of it was amazing. The kids took one look at the menu and ordered fish &a chips along with the wontons while my husband chose the vegetarian pizza. I took guidance from our waitress and selected the chicken curry. None of the meals disappointed and the dessert set the bar even higher. Well worth a visit if you are looking for some traditional tastes along with western options. Show less

Author: iamrussellknightLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous Dining Experience
Review: A friend of ours (who happens to be vegan and has a peanut allergy) had been here a few months back and highly recommended fatCUPID. If they can cater for her then we knew we would be just fine.It is located along a little back street to the south of the Cenang beach main drag, if you use Uber it is easy enough to find. We visited in a heavy rain storm and the host came out with an umbrella to greet us out of the taxi which was a nice touch. The menu is enticing and inviting to the point when you want to order everything! However as that is not realistic we settled on a range of started - satay, wontons and we added the Calamari salad as we couldn't go without ordering it. All were delicious!For mains we went for the Laksa an the Nyonya Chicken Curry. I had been craving Laksa for a few days and this sated my craving and then some. I'll put it out there, the best Laksa i've EVER had. Rich, creamy, plenty of vegetables and prawns and the right amount of spice. If i could have I would have slurped the bottom of the bowl.My girlfriend enjoyed hers also but I think she had Laksa envy!I must also mention the cocktails for which they have an excellent range and they are all very well made and hit the spot. So much so that we forgoed dessert in favour of more cocktails!The service was friendly and attentive, very welcoming as to be expected in Malaysia. Little touches like lighting of an insect coil under your table to stave off the mosquitoes are also welcomed additions.Overall I thought it was great value too, certainly compared to some of the restaurants along the main strip. We had plenty of food & cocktails and it came to under £45 for the both of us including service. I wouldn't bring kids here, it would spoil the atmosphere, this would be nice for a couple or group of friends who want something a little special.Highly recommended, and if i'm in town again it will be first on my list!Show less

Author: Aino763Helsinki, Finland
Title: Dissapointment
Review: I stayed at La Pari-Pari and I was very excited that this well reviewed restaurant would be at premises - lucky me! I didn't have breakfast included and because of the fairly high prices I ended up to have the breakfast in the nearby cafe but I was looking forward to have dinners at fatCUPID. My first dinner at fatCUPID was quite a disappointment. I had a portion recommended by the waiter, local food, which name I have forgot. Nothing special. I don't know whether it was the food or was it just something not to my liking. But the chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream for dessert sounded just perfect! Well, it wasn't. The cake tasted like it wasn't fresh and the vanilla ice cream tasted flat, not good quality. The worst part was when felt something chewy in my month. After a while, I give up and spit it out, and it turned out to be a piece of foil. I told nicely to the waiter, and his was just like, oh, so sorry, kitchen is very busy, but hey look, there is a cute birds nest at the ceiling. Ok, nice try to get my attention away from the mistake they have made. He didn't offer another dessert or remove it from the bill, nothing. Not how these situations should be handled.Even after this first experience, I was still thinking that maybe I just had bad luck and decided to give the restaurant another try. Next night I came in, was greeted and showed to table and given a menu. Then nothing. I waited and tried to catch some of the waiters attention, but nope, no one was interested in serving me. I waited for 15 - 20 minutes, and then decided to take my money elsewhere.I was very disappointed, especially when I had such a high hopes about this place. Show less

Author: LarrymanChelmsfordChelmsford
Title: Good but not great
Review: I'd had dinner the night before at Yasmine's and thought that was excellent. I then came to Fat Cupid with high expectations. It was good but Yasmine's is better. It just didn't work for me. The food here is well presented. Restaurant is open and can get hot. It's nice enough. Show less

Author: iamjohnnyThailand
Title: Beautiful Place, Beautiful People, Great Dining Experience
Review: Beautiful Place, Beautiful People, Great Dining Experience - once again after last visit 2 years ago. Brought a friend there for his birthday and surprised with a little cake with a candle the staff sang him a birthday song. Accommodated to my request for some changes to my food with no issues. Lovely dining experience.Show less

Author: JJS123_12London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food in a pleasant setting
Review: Down a dirt road, in the popular Pantai Tengah area, sits this little gem of a restaurant, the beef tenderloin was mouth-wateringly good. Cooked to perfection with a wonderful accompaniment of fresh vegetables and a devine sauce on the side. The husbands pasta was also good and our teenagers and no complaints with their respective burgers and steak sandwiches, but my beef was by far the best!Show less

Author: Paul_LolBoston, United Kingdom
Title: Top spot!
Review: Very difficult to pick the top restaurant that we visited during our 9 nights in Pantai Cenang but for me FatCupid just makes it. La Sal (Casa del Mar) a very close second, partly down to the price being 3x that of FatCupid. Not easy to find. We walked from CDM end of Cenang (a 40 minute stroll). Once you get to Bam Boo Ba take the dirt road to the left immediately after. It's about 70 mtrs down there. Alternately, jump in a cab I'm sure the driver will know exactly where it is. It's a fixed 15MR (£3) for that journey. The owner was very welcoming and happy to spend time explaining all of the 'grandmas recipy' dishes. Warning us of those that are very hot and also offering to tailor those that could be to the required heat level. The presentation was excellent. An extensive wine, cocktail and beer selection. Really peaceful setting. They offered to call us a taxi at the end of the meal, which was a nice touch. A very high standard of food and service. Long may it reign!Show less

Author: Leigh FLondon
Title: Best restaurant in Tengah
Review: Classy, small establishment serving unpretentious home cooked food. We went twice, and on both occasions came away having eaten far too much and having enjoyed ourselves immensely. The Malay/Nonya dishes are truly authentic, and it's bolstered by the owners obvious enthusiasm for continuing to serve her grandmother's recipes. A true delight and I cannot recommend highly enough. Show less

Author: Relaxed575Woking, United Kingdom
Title: Great if you are gluten free. Great if you aren't!
Review: We were recommended to go to the restaurant by a couple of people who had been there a couple of times already. We were not disappointed. Staff were on the ball regarding gluten free options available to us and we're very accommodating. Food was absolutely delicious and huge portions too. Ambience was great. A faultless meal.We will be back!Show less

Author: Adriana_trips
Title: Recommended for pleasant ambience
Review: I liked this restaurant especially for the ambience and the service. They have a selection of good wines and it is appropriate for a romantic dinner.

Author: Robciv
Title: Awesome and Fresh Breakfsat
Review: I would say the best breakfast I had in Langkawi the entire week.. beautiful, fresh and very tasty. Would have had to have been the best coffee in town too! Yummo

Author: phuongn573
Title: Morning talk
Review:
Peaceful, nice and cozy place with good view in garden morning.
It's hard to find this restaurant, not suggest for local enjoyment

Author: AnnabelD999London, United Kingdom
Title: So delightful...
Review: We had a car for a couple of days and this was a bit further from our hotel than walking allows. So we pootled down in the car. It is just off the main road, it's signposted but it's down a dusty bumpy track, so you wouldn't just pass by. But I am soooo glad we went.A lovely Malaysian gent met us by the car park and welcomed us into the restaurant. We had to leave and come back because we didn't realise they only took cash. Although that may have been because there happened to be a short power cut. However he was there smiling again when we got back...It was lunchtime and the restaurant was quiet but so lush to be in a tranquil location away from the hustle and bustle. We sat looking out at the swimming pool and little white Bungalows that they rent out. My hubby ordered a Kapatain curry and I had the Laksa. Both were absolutely delicious. I must admit my big bowl of Laksa was quite ambitious on a hot sunny lunchtime, but I couldn't help but slurp my way though as much of it as I possibly could..!!!! Chicken, prawns, 2 types of noodles, beans and spicy coconut milk juicy soup.. loved it... Definitely worth visiting off the beaten track..Show less

Author: dmile2015Bogota, Colombia
Title: A good meal and a great setting
Review: I came to this place my first day in Langkawi and the visit was worth it. It is not on the main road, you have to walk a bit inside but it's a lovely place. You want to seat there, have a drink and enjoy it. I had a typical dish with chicken and mushroom. It is good though with a good amount of garlic. Staff is really friendly.Show less

Author: RachaelD35Crawley, United Kingdom
Title: Forget everywhere else, you have to visit here!
Review: Hubbie and I visited on the basis of TripAdvisor reviews. So glad we did! Ambience is chilled romance...candles, crickets chirping, soft jazz playing...and to top it off, fireflies twinkling in the trees. Simply amazing, like out of a movie. We ordered a calamari salad starter to share which was delicious. The calamari was still warm where it had been freshly fried. It was soft and delicate and balanced well with the dressing. Our mains of seabass curry (Him) and chicken kapitan (me) were well supplemented with stir fried veges, rice and an onion omelette (mine) - which balanced the meal well. Be careful if you don't like spice, I was advised mine was a mild curry but it's more medium. If you don't like spice, make sure you tell them to go easy! That aside, the flavours of both curries were out of this world; hubbie commented it was one of the best he's had (and he's just come back from a work trip to India!)The panna cotta we shared for dessert blew my mind away, so smooth and silky (much needed after our spicy curries!) with a sweet coulis. Size wise it's enough for one but if you're fairly full (as we were) it's quite a good size to share. We headed the meal up with a glass of house white (cab sauv) and red (pinot noir, which was chilled- nice touch) and both were sublime. The staff are so very attentive and friendly, happy to offer advice on dishes and just chat in general.
