Seriously, if you're in Langkawi, don't waste your time or money on the tourist trap (often seafood) restaurants on the main road. This place is amazing and most dishes are much cheaper, and you'll be made to feel like very special guests, rather than cattle (like you would in other 'premium space' roadside restaurants). Show less

Author: themanfromearthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ambience is relaxation personified!
Review: Had an awesome leisurely unhurried lunch here during my stay in Langkawi. Location is a bit towards the inside from the main road. Food was delicious - the rendang curry and appetizers were quite tasty. The place has an awesome laid back vibe and sipping a few beers with the gentle breeze in the garden is as close to relaxed you can get! Loved the place and recommend. Show less

Author: alexandraw190
Title: A very nice meal!
Review:
We had a very nice and relaxing dinner at the FatCupid! 
The food was nice and the atmosphere was relaxed.
A good choice to get out of the crowd.

Author: cnj-greenSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: Attempt the path, it's worth it.
Review: Attached to a hotel this is a nice restaurant along an unmade road.We visited during the day for a drink (and recon), and returned a few days later half way through our holiday. Needing an 'european' fix we both had western food and both enjoyed our meals. The restaurant was quite busy both times we visited, and service was very good with the barmaid remembering our visit from a few days before. The unmade road may put people off however it is not a long walk and is very easy in daylight or at night if aided by a torch or moonlight.Summary - nice food and very nice ambience, the path isn't that bad.Show less

Author: taram285
Title: Excellent night
Review: Great value and selection for food, friendly staff and so accommodating for allergy sufferers. Good sized portions. Great drinks also! Gluten free and vegan beer and spirit options if you know what you're looking for.

Author: GeorgeKitchen777Bromsgrove, United Kingdom
Title: Very good, if pricey, food - watch out for mosquitos
Review: We had a great meal here, especially the Beef Redang curry. Only recommendation would be to take lots of bug spray as place has a lot of mosquitos as near still water. Pricey too at 90 RM for 2 mains and 2 drinks, and a 10% service charge which is not made obvious on the menu. Overall, good but pricey. Show less

Author: Seaside698340
Title: Pricey, western food is okay
Review: Western food and drinks are tasty, local cuisine there is so so. In fact the local cuisine is definitely overpriced.

Author: healey11
Title: great food, great staff and reasonable price
Review:
we where also guestbook the" le pari pari" resort which is connected ..the place is lovely and the staff is absolutely helpfull

the menu is a wide range of tasty food, nice arrangements on the plate ...absolut made with love and knowledge 

strongly recommended

Author: Peter MChalfont St Peter, United Kingdom
Title: Brillant! Just go!
Review: Food, service and location all brillant! Set 300m back from main road, the fatCUPID did not disappoint. With a menu that caters for both a malay experience or a more western dish. We enjoyed the wontons as starter, followed by a hot Nyonya Laksa curry and a tasty Nasi Ayam Pontay! Although the Laksa turned out to be too hot for us, we were quickly brought some coconut milk to add to it - great service! My wife tried a lemongrass mojito which she enjoyed! Thank you & will return before end of visit.Show less

Author: Mikko H
Title: Excellent atmosphere and malaysian food
Review: Very nice place and the food is excellent. Nice place to have dinner with wife. Service was warm and friendly. They also have nice vine list. My wife had fresh juices and liked them very much. When you go to fatcupid, you have to go through dark alley, don't worry It's totally worth it. Mikko Suomesta kaipaisi tiehen pientä pintaremonttia. Monttuja oli. Show less

Author: Beljondom
Title: Great food
Review: Fab food, excellent service, modern, clean. Will go back again as here for 8 nights. Had vegetarian Malay main flavours very good

Author: gypsy_janeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Incredible!
Review: Incredible Malaysian cuisine at affordable prices. Hubby and I shared a platter with pizza, wontons and bruschetta then beef rendang and prawn sambal for mains. Food and service was excellent! Nice to chat to the owner about the restaurant and wine from our local regions back home (Barossa, Adelaide Hills and McLaren Vale in South Australia). Definitely not one to miss when in Langkawi!Show less

Author: letsallbefrank
Title: Amazing food !
Review: Amazing food. The nasi lemak and laksa were authentic with super fresh ingredients. Beautiful open space. Lovely staff.

Author: Jay-Wye GVientiane, Laos
Title: Amazing flair in Malay food
Review: This is a story in itself when you eat there. I had diner there on a couple of occasion with friends from Langkawi. I wish I also stayed there, in this little, tucked away heaven. Fab cocktails in a charming compound and easy peasy terrace bring you to appreciate the moment. The family run business has developed the food concept or 'Nyonya', food from their gran'ma culinary delights. I can't say if the food is just like their gran'ma would produce it but I am convinced they do. It is simply superb. Don't miss it and find it.Show less

Author: bon_heinekenSouth Australia, Australia
Title: The quiet nice dinner you've wanted but can't find
Review: You grab dinner on the main roads and get ushered in, fed straight away and not cared about afterwards. Plus all the chaos of a busy Asian street.Fatcupid is the opposite. It's off the main road and you can finally have that nice quiet dinner to relax after the day in an intimate setting.The venue is not huge in size (think under a verandah by a pool) but the food is pure quality. Plenty of home style Malaysian cooking and western food. We had Malaysian and it was great. Professional in the presentation and quality food. Apparently based on a grandparent's recipe.Finally no rush either. Got there at 7.30 and left at 10. Normally you're out far quicker elsewhere.One of my favourite places in Asia!Show less

Author: Marie062
Title: So Good!!!
Review: We were so lucky to staying at la Pari-pari and enjoying the good restaurant FatCupid. Probably the best restaurant in the island. They have a good selection of wine also, just go!

Author: MelS377
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review:
Food is delicious and staff are extremely friendly.

Had the Beef Rendang, lemon grass mojito and chocolate brownie. All equally delicious.

Food was worth the price tag. Will be returning!!

Author: Mollymou
Title: Yum!!!
Review: Our best meal so far on Langkawi! Staff are super friendly, prices are good and food is simply excellent!

Author: JuPaBu
Title: Cool place!
Review:
We went there with our 2 sons (3 and 6) and really enjoyed it! The food and drinks were delicious, the place itself very special - a hidden treasure. Very charming atmosphere, considerate service and: they loved the kids.

Very recommendable!

Author: 389innas
Title: Delicious and Huge Portions!
Review: Great food, decent choice amazing quality.Try the prawn Alio Oli and the smocked salmon croissant))))))yuuuuummmmmm, reasonably priced but the alc beverages are above average cost on the island.

Author: Klinsy
Title: Great Service, Great Everything
Review: There was 11 of us for dinner and everyone was agreed that every dish was perfect. The service was great and the atmosphere was pleasant and relaxed. Can't wait to go back.

Author: dicksonc639Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Accessible location, perfect environment, great food
Review: Great location for lunch, located at Pantai Tengah, very close to Pantai Cenang.Try to stick closely to the navigation, the restraunt is located in a hotel compound, accessible by a little passage.The food were great. A meal costs MYR 20-MYR50. We tried the Curry Chicken Kapitan. The portion is fine and the price is below MYR30. The chicken curry comes with a great aroma, with the taste of true Nyonya flovour.The restraunt closes at 2.30pm and continues its business hours during dinner time.Show less

Author: Andre V
Title: Great food, clean and friendly staff!
Review: Staff were really friendly and the meal was the best I've had on the island. Recommend the sticky prawns!

Author: SMH12017Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Enjoyable atmosphere with good food
Review: Meals are very tasty and good sized. We got our appetizer meal about in 10 to 15 minutes and after that our main course. Staff is very friendly and they wanted to know is the food good and are we ok - little bit small talking. The place is little bit hard to find but you should visit there and taste the food. Very nice place!Show less

Author: waltera1977
Title: Tasty food, friendly staff
Review:
Really good food here, lots of local and Malaysian dishes, well presented with friendly service.
The restaurant is simply furnished and spotlessly clean. Western style toilets, also clean, are a bonus!

Author: bwoodsy88
Title: Delicious relaxing lunch with cocktails
Review: Nice peaceful setting,  chilled music / decor.  Good choice of Malay / Thai food,  everything we ordered was delicious.  The cocktails were fairly unique and tastes great.  Fairly priced for what you are getting

Author: ellenharroKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic food
Review: I have eaten dinner twice at fatCupid on two separate trips to Langkawi and really enjoyed it both times. You will need to drive to find it as it is a bit off the beaten track but it can easily be found in a taxi. The dinner menu has plenty of choice and a good mixture of Western and Asian dishes. Prices are very reasonable and it is a really calm and pleasant place to sit. I will definitely be making another very visit when I am next on the island. Thank you!Show less

Author: Amanda TWoolpit, United Kingdom
Title: Wonton wonderland!
Review: Not an easy place to find as off the beaten track but do follow the signs literally, it's not into a field or someone's garden, there really is a good restaurant to be found.The restaurant is clean and well organised with prompt service and a good wine list.Such a warm and fun greeting from the girls which was replicated on other visitsWontons are amazing, fresh crispy and lovely sambal.Veggie curry is excellent as is the chicken curry, tastes like a home made recipe as advertised so we were not disappointed.The desserts we normally pass on but thought we should try a sago & coconut palm Sugar dessert- it turned out to be a ' lay me down and pour it in ' type, I wish we hadn't shared and I vowed and did have one all to myself on the next visit- it really is special! Fellow travellers also ventured out to find and were equally enthusiastic about the menu and meals served.Show less

Author: emelieraSanta Cruz, Portugal
Title: Awesome
Review: A very cozy place with awesome staff! Great food and drinks! The staff was very service minded! The prices was good, we had a 3 course dinner with 2 beers and a bottle of wine for about 300 ringit (60€). This place is a must if you are nearby! Show less

Author: StephanieA3337
Title: Loved my evening here
Review: My husband found this place on Trip Advisor, it was slightly off route back to our hotel but it was totally worth it.The food was on point. Both local and western meals were delicious, we loved it so much we ordered desert too because we were confident it would be just as good and it really was. Service was great, the lady that looked after us was super friendly and personable. Relaxed setting and I felt very comfortable being there with my kids.Best restaurant in Langkawi, we have a lovely evening meal and it ended our day perfectly. Even if your not staying near this place, get yourself and taxi and check it out, they will organise a taxi home for you and it's totally worth it. Show less

Author: Maria_RapsoffAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: decent food, nice location
Review: My partner and I are both vegetarians and Fat Cupid as a couple of veggie options such as a Tempeh Redang. I tried that dish and it was very delicious. The restaurant is a bit pricy but that is ok. The service was very friendy and attentive.Show less

Author: chriscS1444NQ
Title: Great meal, nice resturant
Review: The location of this restaurant is a little funny yet the food and staff were exceptional. This was one of the best dinners we had in Langkawi and the staff were very friendly and helpful.

Author: anttit2016
Title: Nice atmosphere, very friendly service.
Review: We had a Sunday brunch here around midday. Brunch was excellent, and so was service also! Very relaxing and quiet atmospehere, I recommend this place!

Author: whatelsabetHereford, United Kingdom
Title: No brainer family-friendly favourite!
Review: High praise for a great eatery. Great, and I mean great food and service to match!If you're looking for lunch or dinner in this area, this establishment is worth checking out. And, if like us, you're travelling with an infant, you'll be welcomed like family!Show less

Author: 342cindyqBlair Athol, Australia
Title: Romantic dinner in langkawi
Review: The restaurant was quaint and had a lot of candles which added to the atmosphere. The staff were very helpful and even lit a citronella candle for us to avoid getting eaten by mosquitoes. As the restaurant is outside there as also harmless small geckos that crawl all over the ceiling. Which doesn't diminish from the food. The food was great with excellent flavour. However the wine by glass menu isn't extensive, but I find that is the case here with many restaurants. The wontons and fish curry had a lot of flavour but they were slightly overcooked. The satay skewers and lychee & lime freezer is a must have. Show less

Author: Lisa_NerjaNerja, Spain
Title: Lovely food in a great setting. Excellent if travelling with children
Review: We spent 9 nights in Langkawi and ate here 4 times, including our Christmas dinner and the all important 'last meal of the holiday'. (We were lucky enough to be staying only 2 mins walk away at the lovely Fuuka Villa). Owners/staff always greeted us warmly, and our children aged 4 and 7 were made to feel welcome. Everything we sampled was gorgeous and, in my opinion, fairly priced for the quality and portion size. Tiger beer at 6.5RM a glass was reasonable too, but the wine was expensive (cheapest was 70RM a bottle I think). I love the fact that Fat Cupid have their menu in full on their website so you can check it out and whet your appetite before you come! The signature tasting plate made a nice starter for the four of us to share, and we found that the fish and chips and burger and chips were plenty big enough to get one between two for the kids. Same for the chocolate brownie.The Malaysian dishes were my favourite, with the rendang tempe honestly being the nicest thing I've eaten for a long time. The grounds of La Pari Pari/Fat Cupid are very pleasant with some nice areas for the kids to sit and play before or after eating. We had a wander down the pond at the bottom too.This place will stick in my mind as one of the best places we've eaten at on our travels over the years.Show less

Author: NZShan21
Title: Wonderful
Review: We came twice during our stay in Langkawi and loved the experience both times. Great food, great service, and a lovely garden setting. Our children were well catered for too. Very highly recommended.

Author: mookeyesWoodville, Australia
Title: Loved it!
Review: We stayed at LA Pari Pari so therefore ate breakfast here every day...had a dinner and a lunch plus lots of drinks and yummy cocktails...friendly fast service each time ..very generous serves ...and really yummy great food.. French tunes playing in the background too !..thoroughly recommend this funky little place ! Show less

Author: teejaydfromaus
Title: Love it
Review: Amazing food drinks and people, we loved it! The local Nyonya specialities are amazing, why have western food at all!!! The brekky omelette is also super. Thanks for all the fun chats and tips it was great.

Author: sineadschavLondon, United Kingdom
Title: AWFUL FOOD!!!
Review: My husband and I are very fortunate to travel lots (especially around South East Asia) and while travelling get to experience some amazing food - mostly from little local gems that are off of the beaten track. We asked our hotel for a similar recommendation and they spoke very highly of Fat Cupid. We read lots of great comments on Trip Advisor (so we knew it wasn't going to be a local gem but just good Malay food) so were excited to go. What a mistake. The menu sounded lovely with 'recipes handed down through generations' etc. My husband ordered the Thai beef salad (which we have both eaten lots) and when it came to the table, it was a bowl of lettuce with some beef in and no dressing or flavour. I ordered the 'famous' wontons that were so over cooked, I needed the spicy sauce that came with it to take the burnt flavour away. At this point we were both a little unsure about eating our main and noticed that nearly everyone around us were eating paninis (they obviously knew something we didn't). We stuck it out and when our mains arrived I wish we hadn't. We both ordered the waitresses favourite dishes off the menu - chicken curry and a laksa. My husbands curry was edible but not tasty or delicious and my laksa was like eating a bowl of spicy hot water. There was no real flavour, no depth to the dish and even the prawn that I tried was bland. I did not eat this dish. As mentioned, we have tried these dishes in other parts of Malaysia as well as other countries and it has never tasted like this. We asked the waiter for a roti or something similar and he said our roti is square which we'd never heard of but ordered it - we had to laugh when he brought to the table two slices of brown bread!!! The only one good thing the restaurant has going for it, is the staff were very sweet but that is not enough when providing food for paying customers. Show less

Author: sussexrowmarkRye, United Kingdom
Title: 5 stars plus
Review: What a fab choice for our first meal in Langkawi. We walked from our hotel and were unsure when we reached the turning to Fat Cupid - we had to go some way down a lane in the dark, stepping around rain puddles. But what a fine, informal, funky and gay-friendly welcome we had. My veggie version of beef redang was absolutely delicious. The wine list was very well-chosen and the tax-free prices half those on the mainland. Popular place, so booking is probably a good idea.Show less

Author: suziea410Geelong
Title: A bit let down
Review: After reading all the reviews I was expecting more. The food servings were a bit on the small side but tasty enough. Nice wine but a bit expensive. The host was friendly but constantly revered to us as " now children" when talking up her food. Nothing to rave about here.Show less

Author: gcatucciKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Thumbs up
Review: Having spent 10 years in the restaurant and hotel business, I am not easy to to give a 5 to place.This one really deserves it. Starting with the hosting because my friend any I came here on NYE for dinner without reservation. The host managed to accommodate us, and she also warned up that appetizers may take up to 20 minutes to come out. They came out in less than 10 minutes.Calamari salad and the pumpkin salad were both good and fresh. I would prefer less balsamic vinegar, but it's just my taste.I ordered the satay. Although the chicken was a bit too fat for my taste, the beef was lean, tender and juicy.My friend ordered the beef pontay, which was very good with plenty of mushrooms.The drinks are nice too, and don't be fooled by the cocktails light taste - the booze will kick you later.The price is right or maybe even cheap considering the ambiance and the nice plate presentations.Show less

Author: Birdemic
Title: Great food
Review: The food is great, the staff are really nice and helpfull. Will come back to eat here. The drinks are good and make you happy.

Author: smgallagher17
Title: Good Food and service
Review: Good food very friendly helpful staff , would recommend a visit , would probably need a taxi as a bit out of the way from Main Street

Author: Anders W
Title: Romantic restaurant with delicious food
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed this quaint little restaurant a few hundred meters from the mainroad. Very attrictive menu which I would've loved to come back and try more of if I had the time. The Nasi Ayam I did have was great, likewise the chocolate-pear for dessert. Top-notch personnel and service.Show less

Author: DinaMariaT
Title: Relaxing place with good food
Review: Nice and quiet place. Food was good! The owner was very helpful as we were couldn't decide what to order. She was willing to help cook something out of the menu for the kids. I could spend the whole day as it was calm.

Author: olishanghai
Title: Food and service - Brilliant
Review: Great food - very fair price - staff were more than friendly. Booked to go a second time during our weeks holiday

Author: zabrinas
Title: Loved the laksa!
Review: We had some issues locating the place but we didn't give up and fortunately for that! The place is so clean and neat. Very quaint looking with mainly white wooden furniture. The food was really good. Serving was quite large but no complaints there. :) A must try when in Langkawi!Show less

Author: gideon_fooZhongzheng District, Taipei
Title: Beautiful setting but average food
Review: This place is beautiful and overlooking a small pool. The staffs there are very friendly and courteous and smiled most of the time. The downside is that the ayam pongteh which I ordered as recommended by the waiter wasn't up to expectation as it was too salty, perhaps too much soy bean paste was used for it. I believe there are better nyonya food elsewhere but maybe not in Langkawi. Price wise it is more expensive but still affordable, I paid $33 ringgit for food and drink. You are paying for the ambience.Show less

Author: BernardLiowMalaysia
Title: Very tasty Nyonya laksa. Relaxing environment.
Review: Location wise, not easy to locate, need to look out carefully for their signboard on the main road as you need to access through some small road to reach this place, at La-Pari Pari Hotel. Environment of restaurant is quiet beside the hotel pool with some French music in the background. Overall food prices are too steep.We’ve tried breakfast and lunch on 2 different occasions. We had Nyonya Laksa and Beef Rendang dish for lunch, both were superb. The portion was big, especially the laksa. This could be one of the top nyonya laksa I’ve had for a long time.Breakfast was disappointing. We had The Works and Nasi Lemak. These dishes were more than Rm20+ each, but the quality & quantity definitely did not match the pricing.Show less

Author: Ian_70_UK
Title: Great restaurant!
Review: Beautiful little restaurant that serves great food. We went for the Malaysian menu but also caters for Western tastes. The food was delicious and the service excellent. Very reasonably priced considering the all round quality of everything. A must visit!

Author: chimanChicago
Title: Nice Malay food
Review: Very nice food, in a quiet setting, with wonderful, friendly service.  (This is in a small hotel about 100 yards behind other buildings on the main road - worth looking for).

Author: NikolayRomanov
Title: Great.
Review: From our welcome to our departure this restaurant is super.amazing and delicious food.must ordrr their signature dishes.

Author: kaffygirlCanberra, Australia
Title: Sensational
Review: What a fabulous find!!!! I read some reviews on trip advisor and decided to give it a try. The food was out of this world!!! Beautifully cooked and prepared traditional Malaysian food. The service was also wonderful. If you willing to pay a bit more then this is absolutely worth it. Thank you so much for the enjoyable meal Show less

Author: mmkeatsPrinces Risborough, United Kingdom
Title: Good for the soul
Review: We totally enjoyed a couple of evening meals in the Fat Cupid on our recent visit to the island. The food is a fusion of local and international, beautifully served, and elegantly presented. The staff are great, and very engaging, happy to talk about the recipes and cooking techniques, along with tips and advice on things to do on the island. This is a good quality and credible restaurant, with a breezy atmosphere and deserving of its good reviews.Good job team! Thanks for looking after us. Show less

Author: Azran1
Title: Delicious meals in a cozy, quiet setting
Review: Good selection of Asian and Western comfort foods, and the chef happily customises it to your needs. Simple decor and a very warm and personalised service. Very relaxing ambience.

Author: 559bryndNoumea, New Caledonia
Title: Little place of tranquility
Review: So, I've deleted this review twice now due to my fat fingers typing on the keyboard a little to excitedly. So this will be brief.Calm and tranquil setting of the main roadGood mix of Malaysian and western foods all which was deliciousSuper chilled and relaxed staffLittle more expensive then some, but at about $45 for my two boys and I nothing crazy Worth the visit. Do it.Show less

Author: alisonj129
Title: Best in Langkawi.
Review: During a two week stay in Langkawi we will have eaten here 4 times, 3 dinners and a brunch. Everything we've eaten here has been great... starters, mains, deserts, the lot.The service is friendly and very slick and they always seem genuinely happy you're there. We've noticed that meat quality and cocktails are generally not good in Malaysia, but again they are good here too, without being much more, if at all, expensive than other places.They even take care of the little details like putting out a mosquito / insect candle when you sit down.It's a bit of track to get to from the main strip, but for us it was by far the best place in Langkawi!Show less

Author: jakesi2019
Title: Good food in a nice setting
Review: We had a dinner at fatCUPID during the low season and we were almost the only customers during that evening. The cocktails were nice with an Asian twist. Food was good, although nothing outstanding. Service was very friendly and we were greeted several times by the owners, at least so we assumed.Show less

Author: Jwfc87
Title: One of the best places to eat in Langkawi
Review: Finding a good restaurant is not easy in Langkawi. But fatCUPID is a little gem, hidden away down a track.The small menu (always a good sign!) has a range of interesting dishes to choose from, including a vegetarian option that is more than vegetable fried rice (the standard on Langkawi). Show less

Author: azlenemar
Title: good food and ambiance
Review: Good service  and lovely ambiance, we throughly enjoyed ourselves here.The hosts were kind enough to show us around as it was our first time at Pari pari.

Author: sumi83Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fabulous service and food - our third year of visiting!
Review: I have been travelling back to Langkawi and fatCupid every year for the last three years, and visiting fatCupid is always such a highlight. Jacqui and her staff provide such lovely food in a simple but ambient setting. Their nonya laksa is the best I've ever tasted, so don't miss out. In fact, everything on their menu is delicious (try to lime and lychee freeze). We stayed at La Pari Pari, so it's hard not to want to dine at the adjoining fatCUPID for every meal - it's that good!Show less

Author: AKBoden
Title: Delicious local food
Review: Had a lovely evening dining here. The beef rendang was perfectly cooked and so tasty! Atmosphere is lovely with candles and tables are right by the pool. Great for a group of friends, or a romantic evening out!

Author: Janny1974travellerDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Friends and families
Review: The restaurant is located in a hotel (Pari Pari). We went in low season so it was very quiet. The setting is lovely and the food was fantastic. If you want friendly service and excellent food, you can't go wrong. They also have a good wine selection. Highly recommend it. Show less

Author: Susan RFareham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: We found this restaurant easily and the Malaysian food was some of the best that I have ever had. We treated ourselves to wine which was reasonable priced. I didn't enjoy my dessert as I found the chocolate ice-cream too strong for my palate. But that said it doesn't take away the wonderful food that was served. Show less

Author: RonA_Plymouth
Title: Not all that
Review: We did not enjoy the food, the service was unfriendly and for what they offered well over priced. Better everything at other places in the area.

Author: TomasMacBride
Title: Top food, nice place to eat
Review: Nice food here served in a clean, nice environment, definitely worth the taxi to the venue. Would like to go again!

Author: JacqB7Asia
Title: Wonderful lunch
Review: My wife and I had lunch @ Fat Cupid. The setting of the restaurant is quite nice. All of the restaurant as well as hotel cabins are done in white. Beautiful in it's austerity. The music played was at the right level and appropriate for a restaurant. Lots of French tunes, even some tango. Service is courteous and somewhat casual, however you're on Langkawi....... The cuisine served is Baby &Nyonya. We shared a Beef and a Chicken Curry dish. Beautiful presentation, the flavours matched the presentation and portions are good. Truly a "party on a plate"The refreshment list is thoughtfully put together. You'd think when reading this I have an interest in this place........ I don't. Just had a wonderful experience and that should be shared.My wife and I very much enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Terry QNorth Fremantle, Australia
Title: Excellent & off the beaten track
Review: Get a taxi as it is a bit down a track from the main road but well worth the trip. This was the best place we ate in Langkawi, and in Australian terms it was extremely cheap for the quality. Both the food itself and the service was excellent, that must be the best Laksa I have ever had. They provide a mix of Malaysian and western foods. Well worth visiting, excellent atmosphere and beautiful fit out and location.Show less

Author: ThomwaynCanada
Title: Decent Food, but a bit of a trek
Review: This restaurant was kind of hard to find on foot, but it you take a taxi you should be fine. I tried the rendang and it was alright. I didn't find it particularly amazing, but it did the trick. The seating area doesn't have walls so you can view your surroundings quite easily and there's lots of fresh air (although hot days might be super hot). The service was good and I was glad to find vegetarian options here. Show less

Author: alsindbad
Title: Awesome Malaysian food !!
Review: Finally we tried high quality well presented Malaysian food its really delicious the atmosphere is super comfortable and the owner is so friendly she helped us in places to go in lankawi , this is a FINE Dinning place ( the portion is little bit in small direction ) but worth it . Prices range from 25-30 rm per order Recommend it Show less

Author: I4249AFtomh
Title: Visit
Review: Very nice atmosphere with very good food. They serving the food superfriendly. Place to go back.....

Author: KRafteryLimerick, Ireland
Title: Lovely Restaurant off the beaten track
Review: Had a lovely meal here. The place itself is down a roadway off the Main Street in Tengah. It's closed on Mondays which we found out when we tried there first. Setting is really nice-outdoor feel to it. Food was delicious. Lovely Asian dishes and western option available also. Service was excellent-the manager was very friendly and quick to make recommendations. Would highly recommend. Show less

Author: Sven B
Title: Lunch
Review: Just lovely. Jackie the host was very kind and really attentive to us for a pool side lunch. The bruscetta was wonderful!

Author: JasmineL1544
Title: Excellent Interior and Food
Review: Loved the atmosphere the most about this place it really gives off a chill vibe because of the white walls and big space, you have to go there yourself to see what I really mean. The food was well presented and it also tasted as good as the presentation. Would really recommend this place.The service staff were helpful and always checking up on us :)Show less

Author: tracyrM6398IU
Title: Fab place
Review:
Nice restaurant fantastic food, great service from all the staff.  
Great value for the quality of the food.
Had a lovely desert even got a extra one because my husband couldn't decide what he preferred .

Author: noiamin
Title: Holiday
Review: The place abit far from the main road...we hv to used GPS to locate this place..its a quiet place. The price is upscale but the foods was good ..especially the laksa was really good..the serving was quite subsantial..all the price of the main course is above Rm 30.. Show less

Author: sa_oo84
Title: Wonderful place
Review: Excellent food and lovely location, calm atmosphere and very attentive staff. The prices are mid-range, many places along the beach are more expensive. Plus great value, lots of food. The deep fried won-tons are really good! Will definitely be back soon:)

Author: Oscar C
Title: High Quality local food in an extraordinary enviroment
Review: Very high quality local food at La Pari Pari hotel, feel the real experience of local malaysian food in an extraordinary environment ... Unique and at reasonable prices!

Author: ohwmSingapore, Singapore
Title: It Was Fine
Review: My wife had their Beef Pontay Set and she quite enjoyed it. I had rack of lamb which was quite allright as well. We shared a plate of satay too but the peanut sauce lacked a bit of fragrance though. Price was on the higher side, relatively speaking in Langkawi terms. Went there just when they opened for dinner at round 6pm and we were the only customer so its private. Cool jazzy music enhance the vibe but do apply some mosquito repellent as my wife got lots of bites within a very short time there. All in all, its a 6.5/10Show less

Author: CoskarlPatras, Greece
Title: Excellent romantic restaurant
Review: The food is excellent, with professional care, the environment and the music is relaxing and perfect for a romantic dinner. The service is very good and the staff very polite. Prices are a little high, but justified by the overall quality. I would like the same seriousness by the responsible of the restaurant. In Langkawi there is a very bad habit in all restaurants, asking what to drink just when you sit. Obviously made for consumption purposes, but it is very annoying for the customer, especially when he has not even seen the menu and therefore do not know what will eat in order to decide what to drink (wine, beer, water, juice). Therefore, the ironic comments on the choice of drink after ordering is at least recklessly, especially when not consider other conditions such as driving, cost etc.Show less

Author: Indvaux
Title: Really good 10/10
Review: Excellent choice of high class food cooked to perfection. A little difficult to find down a drive about 100 meters from the main road but well worth the effort. Going back again tonight

Author: scorp08
Title: Lovely place to eat and stay
Review: Amazing service and breakfast. And nice rooms to stay with a pool. Nice feel and people. So if get tired being at the beach, visit this cosy place.

Author: J152
Title: Excellent food
Review: Typical malay food, and extensive wine menu. Well presented in a nice ambiance. Even went back a second time during our stay in Langkawi.

Author: simbiane
Title: Best Restaurant in langkawi
Review: Fatcupid is a beautiful Restaurant in langkawi. The menu has local and western dishes. We tried a chicken curry and the beef. Everything tasted delicious, fresh and exciting. I have a Gluten intolerance. The Chef came to our table and told me which dish I could eat. She even doublechecked it. I appreciatet this very much. We also had wonderful desert which was also glutenfree. The staff was very friendly and the quality and the taste of the Food is excellent. Show less

Author: MiRa N
Title: Quality breakfast
Review:
Great service by the staff, quality food. 
Interesting elements of pairing eggs with sweet potato and cucumber and eggplant in the omelette. Yummeerrss! 
Only weird that the complimentary breakfast doesn't include a "proper" breakfast.

Author: JossubKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food and great service!
Review: There is a wide variety of food, and the lical dishes have a lovely nyona twist to them! The ambience is great and the food tasty. There is careful attention to the quality of the ingredients and presentation. Would highly recommend this place, even for breakfast!Show less

Author: Christina CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Meatless Lunch
Review: It was part of our yoga retreat to have lunch here. Though meatless, the food are really good! We had the pasta and asian delight. Both dishes are cooked to order and this added to the bonus. Plus the environment and toilet is clean. Thumbs up.Show less

Author: 129dereks
Title: Great food, great service.
Review: Paid more for worse meals in the area, highly recommended with nice atmosphere.  Cocktails were also delicious.  Worth going off the beaten track.

Author: lleynn
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Went for our first day breakfast. Food was great, service was excellent. But it was on a pricey side for breakfast, but it was worth it.

Author: 955beryltBangkok, Thailand
Title: Delicious Local & Western Menu
Review: Delicious selection of food that is fresh & very tasty. During our 4 day stay we tried a variety of dishes, recommending the Masak Lemak, Nyonya Laksa, Vegetarian Pizza, Sago & Pulut desserts, lemongrass cocktail, Barracuda, Sambal Udang, Wontons, & Chicken Sandwich. Safe to say depending on what you feel like eating, anything on the menu here is GOOD !Show less

Author: bartk275
Title: Great food & atmosphere
Review: The restaurant is somewhat hidden, but definately serves the very best food I've had (up to now) during this holiday!! Even the pizza that we ordered for our kids was delicious!

Author: caitlinr275Dublin, Ireland
Title: Best meal in Langkawi!
Review: A beautiful meal in a very tranquil and romantic setting!! It's a little bit off the main road so make sure you look at for the sign on the main road. They do a mix of western and local food. I had a pumpkin and sweet potato curry which was delicious. Show less

Author: badibayly
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Awesome food. Great service. Food is fantastic, and they can cater for any food allergies too. Worth the effort getting off the beaten track

Author: farquareAl Khobar, Saudi Arabia
Title: went for some breakfast, very nice setting
Review: maybe ordered the wrong stuff for breakfast in 30 deg heat; sausage, hash browns toast and scrambled eggs.Thats my fault though, food was a good although perhaps not what i should have chosen..Really nice setting though, would go back in the evening for dinner and drinks for sure.Show less

Author: Gwen L
Title: Love the Ambience and Service!
Review: I went there with my partner for three times in total. We loved the quiet and romantic ambience, and of course the good food! We liked to order the appetizer ( I forgot what it's called ), which consisted of deep-fried wontons, mini pizza and bruschetta ( if not mistaken ). We loved it so much.The service staff were nice and warm. The restaurant owner was friendly as well, asking us whether everything is okay. Glad that the staff were attentive !Show less

Author: Gabstatori
Title: Fantastic meal and surrounds
Review: My boyfriend and I enjoyed a lovely authentic Malaysian meal at Fat Cupid. The food was delicious, well presented and the service was great. The restaurant is located off a main road in a quiet area and has a lovely atmosphere (perfect for couples).

Author: Lyn1110
Title: Wonderful Malaysian food
Review: Fat Cupid is a lovely restaurant on the outskirts of town. Staff are wonderful, the food is superb as are the cocktails. We enjoyed 2 evenings at Fat Cupid and couldn't have asked for anything more. Great desserts too.

Author: janeyk419
Title: Decent breakfast
Review: We were staying up the road and came down for breakfast having seen the reviews. The food was good, good fresh juice and friendly service. Not our favourite place locally but definitely worth a try.

Author: MarkH6569
Title: Contemporary and Modern
Review: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️The place was spectacular, little place in the background on an offbeaten track. I had my first Laksa in 3 weeks travelling Malaysia; and it did not disappoint. Service was really good, and the staff paid attention to the little things, which many fancy & big restaurants ignore. E.g putting a scented candle to rid the mosquitoes under the table. Show less

Author: beatricel330
Title: First visit with Boyfriend
Review: Had visited this restaurant on the 13th of September, 2015 with my boyfriend. We started our 2nd anniversary celebration in this restaurant having lovely breakfast. Environment, food and drinks were nice but but somehow the food choice is limited. Anyway, worth a visit!

Author: tran1306Nha Trang, Vietnam
Title: Worth every visit
Review: The food here was so yum that we decided to come back the other day. Smoked salmon croissant sandwiches are my favorite. A bite of salmon and creamy cheese on top, covered by a slice of flaky croissant is just heavenly. 3-egg omelette is another must-try. Service is hmm averagely good, but the view and the bar are spectacular. We took hundreds of photos here and all of them are amazingly instagram-worthy.Show less

Author: Trojan_10Hanoi, Vietnam
Title: Expensive for local food but its got flare
Review: We had lunch here and although its expensive for the Malay food its probably worth it for the presentation and the fact you can tell the food is made with love. The curry pastes are obviously hand pounded and although the beef of the Rending was more chewy than I'd expect for the price it was delicious. This might be a place for a special evening meal or for a lunch to impress. Show less

Author: KarliJS123
Title: great setting and authentic food
Review: Excellent cocktails and all meals were authentic, well presented and really tasty... especially the dessert!! Service was great and the setting was peaceful and relaxed.

Author: MamaJacKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Coffee Haven
Review: We only stopped by for coffee after reading about it from Trip Advisor. Nice and cosy and they had french tunes playing. We were there about 11 nish so was kind of in-between meals. Very peaceful and can be rather romantic. Restaurant faces white chalet accommodation called Pari Pari. Service leaves much to be desired; service staff not well versed with menu and was not conversant in English. Had to ask for the receipt after I paid the bill.Show less

Author: Holiday0610
Title: Excellent
Review:
Excellent food, four of us chose dishes from the authentic malay menu. Food was best we have had in Langkawi, and well presented.  Service was friendly and efficient. 
Dont go past this one.  Will go back again.

Author: CoryW363
Title: Ok
Review: Presentation of the facility is impeccable. Food was good without being a standout. Overall it's blah but in a good setting.

Author: SCR26Queensland, Australia
Title: Not too bad
Review: The food was ok. Nothing special. I wouldn't say it blew my socks off. I feel sorry for the guests that stay at the hotel having to use their pool with a restaurant of people peering over at them. Service was lacking, but I find Langkawi is like that. Show less

Author: espenspOslo, Norway
Title: Great place for both dinner and breakfast
Review: We ended up going there twice as it was only a 100 m from our hotel, once for dinner and then the next morning for breakfast. We were very satisfied both times. The wonton starter was awesome, and the satay skewers were also very good. The Nyonya Laksa I got for the main was quite good as well, while the frozen yoghurt lookalike with mango sorbet was very refreshing. Just love mango.The Works breakfast is a favourite of mine, and contrary to an English breakfast, the Langkawi Beef Sausages are very good. All in all, the best place we went during our stay on Langkawi. Show less

Author: 359mattt
Title: Nice environment, good service
Review: Friendly staffs, nice food, I guess a good place to stay too (I was only here for food). The staffs were spending a lot of time with the guests.

Author: Blossom021Kuala Lumpur
Title: Generous portions, and tasty dishes
Review: We have been to Langkawi numerous times, and the one thing we have never raved about has been the food - which can be described as blah at best.This food we have at this trip was a very welcome change from at previous visits. Since we were staying at La Pari Pari, fatCUPID is the where we had most of our meals. Service was prompt and efficient, food portions were generous, and most importantly, each dish that we ordered was excellent. Breakfast : we highly recommend the sausages (chicken or beef). Pure meat, deliciously flavoured. We were told that these are made by a South African lady, and can also be found in the frozen section of higher end supermarkets in KL. The three egg omelette was oozing with cheese and yumminess. Salmon croissants - i had to share this as the three croissants were just too much for one person to finish. Even the simple fresh fruit was served nice and cold, and always just right - not over-ripe nor under-ripe. Lunch - Since breakfast was such a large meal, we didnt really have the need for lunch most days. On the one day we did, i had the nyonya laksa which was another huge portion - but was so good, i finished up every last drop of the curry. We saw a number of non staying guests come in for all the various meals. And a number of them were repeat customers, ie we saw them more than once. A true testimony to how good the food was, that people who didn't stay a the resort were willing to come and try out the food, and not just once, but a number of times. Pricing - comparable to KL prices. But i'd say, very good value as the portions were large. Show less

Author: AreejA143
Title: not as expeted
Review: the food was bad the chicken not very well cooked for satay the mango salad was totally bad sauce bad 8ngredient ..the randang was fine ...very little quantity for the high price ...I just liked the view and the juice ...I will not come again to dine ...I will only have desert ...sorryShow less

Author: laurineq2016
Title: You must go there!!
Review: Best food we had since we started travelling 3 weeks ago! So good we came to Fatcupid twice in 3 days. The prices are reasonable, lovely staff, and the menu makes you want to eat everything! Thank you guys!

Author: Jesskearney
Title: Delicious food, peaceful setting
Review: I very much enjoyed my meal at fatcupid. The restaurant was lovely, quite small and peaceful with candlelight tables. The service was great, the waiter even placed a candle beneath the table to prevent mosquitos. The food was delicious and very well presented. Would recommend.

Author: jchiamz
Title: Excellent food and ambience
Review: Came here for breakfast one morning and was treated with a warm greeting. Food and ambience was excellent! Price was a little higher than most places, but definitely worth the money!

Author: Belleelleb
Title: Great place to have breakfast
Review: We loved the breakfasts they served. Although a little bit pricey, but the environment was quiet and the staffs was attentive. Food was definitely ok and their sausages was awesome.

Author: jenmuffieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Food at fatCUPID!
Review: We had the restaurant's specialty of the day - Beef Pontay which met the expectations of a Peranakan palate. In addition, we had the Assam Pedas Fish (Snapper) and Sambal Udang which again met out expectations and we enjoyed the food tremendously. The lemongrass punch is heavenly!! Show less

Author: miawong2016
Title: Comfort and nice restaurant
Review: Environment are relax and comfort, food was delicious. Especially the mango and pumpkin salad are lovely. Service very good.

Author: Jess AAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best meal in langkawi
Review: Service was that of a 5star restaurant - friendly warm and fast. The food was absolutely amazing. We had the laksa and nonya chicken curry. And sago pudding with ice cream, and panna cotta for dessert. Best restaurant in langkawi bar none. We'll be back for more. Show less

Author: follow_ussgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth for visit and the money, staffs are lovely food are delicious
Review: I strongly recommend this restaurant if you are somewhere near Cenang Beach, this restaurant is very lovely. The staffs are very friendly, always smile and give warm welcome.The food is delicious and unique, I love the Laksa and the braised pork very much.Show less

Author: Sophie MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: High quality food
Review: Have visited this place for both breakfast and dinner. The breakfast was great - we both had the full works cooked breakfast which was huge and yummy. Dinner equally good if not better- the portions were again very generous and nice range of local and international cuisine on offer. The setting is very romantic, especially in the evening. Show less

Author: 81JazzN
Title: Delicious, delicious, delicious!!!
Review: We having our breakfast here. Taste was very nice n the potion quite big too. We will visit this restaurant again in future!

Author: blurqueen80
Title: Happy breakfast environment
Review: Yummy breakfast, the breakfast set is filling. Even the toddlers like the food very much. Not many choices for breakfast but the typical European / American menu can be found.

Author: Helen TDunedin, New Zealand
Title: Arranged meal attached to yoga retreat
Review: We certainly enjoyed our two evening meals here, which were both vegetarian as it happened. The menu had a good range, was tasty, healthy and appealing. The service was excellent and the ambience very nice. We met and chatted with the owner/chef and can recommend this Trip Advisor award winning restaurant. Show less

Author: Rosie M
Title: Excellent food, service and setting
Review: Lovely, helpful staff, nicest setting we went to in langkawi, delicious fried wontons for starters and the rendang curry for main was great. Excellent desserts too.

Author: Marilyn H
Title: Food was good and service too.
Review: Food was good and the description on the menu just makes you want to order everything. However some times there is a lot of flies around and we got a bit annoyed. hahah. else good value for food

Author: Renee1985Blackwall, Australia
Title: Good food and great cocktails
Review: The food here was great, really impressed by the Laksa and some lovely wontons for entree. The espresso martini made for me was A-class too. Hell of a journey trying to find the place in the dark (some lighting down the drive way would be beneficial for those on foot in the dark) but well worth the long walk! Show less

Author: scastiLos Angeles, California
Title: Great find in Langkawi
Review: One of those restaurants I found on tripadvisor that I have to say went very well.Very good dinner experience, you get a bit more refined dishes than you would out on the hawker centers.Taste, service and value are very good, would highly recommend this place.This place is a bit hard to find, the directions are right but as you drive down these back roads, it appears there is nothing there. I finally found a sign for the restaurant. Good thing we didn't give up.This is an open restaurant, meaning there are mosquitoes EVERYWHERE, but I have to admit, all the bites I got were well worth the great meal.Show less

Author: Julia S
Title: Nice place
Review: We had lunch at FatCupid. Food was really tasty, service quick. Unfortunately most of the dishes are very spicy and the only thing they could recommend for the baby was pizza. The place doesn't have any sea view and is not on a main street.

Author: jim2012015
Title: Lovely Restaurant
Review: Had a couple of meals here and food was delicious both times. Service was prompt and staff friendly without being intrusive.

Author: Clare W
Title: Superior Meal
Review: We had our most delicious meal here, after a little difficulty finding it, tucked down the back of some other businesses.  It was worth the trouble, because dinner was so yummy!!

Author: melissaasha1990
Title: Lovely food
Review: Food here is yummy. Slightly expensive but delicious.  You can eat by the pool side. Chocolate milkshake was the bomb :)

Author: steelindustries
Title: Good food and good ambience
Review: Good food, great ambience and good location. Friendly staff and service was efficient.  Food priced higher then expecting though not outrageously high.  Rating 4/5 as can improve on cocktails  (glasses too small and tasted too strong) and food was good but not great.

Author: JessPepp
Title: Yum!
Review: Great Malaysian food if you love spice! We would definitely go back! - beef rendang was delicious and so full of flavour. Definitely recommend a trip to fat Cupid when you are in Langkawi!

Author: Jamierocker
Title: great food - a tad overpriced
Review:
we came because of trip advisor.
the food was lovely and the setting was quite nice. 
it was a tad expensive as all other food around this area was cheaper but we didn't mind.
still cheaper than England

Author: Jaan PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellenet Malay food and service
Review: I found this place on TripAdvisor by its high rating and must say it fully deserves it. The service was very nice with good English and advice about the menu. The place is very stylish and clean, which did not seem very common in Langkawi. And finally, all 6 dishes I tried were really tasty and original. Show less

Author: Soyeh K
Title: Good food
Review: Tried a sambal udang and a chicken pontay for lunch. Good food but not really exciting. Relaxing ambience and friendly staff.

Author: Anna CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Langkawi's best kept secret!
Review: Went there for dinner with my husband. Romantic candlelit ambience, soft jazzy background music, quiet surroundings. Great place to be at to get away from the hustle and bustle of Cenang Beach. The Rack of Lamb was absolutely delicious too! Had no complaints whatsoever about the food. And the service was top notch. Two thumbs up! Show less

Author: Meegan V
Title: Yum!
Review: Brilliant! Best food in Langkawi and extremely relaxing atmosphere. And at a very reasonable price as well. Try the Laksa for sure.

Author: Luvmyholidays9Perth, Australia
Title: A Relaxing Afternoon
Review: We decided to go here for lunch on the good reviews from tripadvisor. It’s off the main strip and we needed to get a taxi as it was too far from our resort to walk, but it’s worth a visit, the food was very tasty we had a steak sandwich, satay sticks, wontons and a couple of their delicious signature cocktails.Show less

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Refreshing breakfast
Review: Their smoked salmon croissant was a very good combination of pea, cheese, cured salmon and croissant. I think it could be little over to have 3 pieces of croissant for breakfast. Regarding their brekkie sandwich, the content of sandwich was comprehensive and healthy, however, they should pair the sandwich with potato wedges instead of french fries. It was quite bad to see french fries as breakfast.It is worth mentioning that we had a scenery view in Fatcupid during the early morning. The dining environment was better than what is showed in my attached picture. Although they listed their breakfast operation time as 9 a.m.-2 p.m., we could order, and had, our meal around 8 a.m. - 9 a.m. This is good for those who have a tight schedule.If I am not mistaken, these two set of meals costed around RM 40, and I think it was fairly priced. This place is worth another visit in my opinion.Show less

Author: onowheremanCampagnac-les-Quercy, France
Title: Thanks, Nyonya!
Review: We loved the Malay cuisine here. Very casual low key atmosphere, very friendly service, and very very delicious dishes from Nyonya Grandma. Laksa, chicken curry, yum yum! Sweat a little, it's good for you. Careful with the chili paste.Very nice panna cotta with coulis for dessert.Chat with the owner, she's charming.Show less

Author: irene chan ai l... cIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Average food
Review: Having read such great reviews of this place, we decided to try it for dinner. Perhaps our expectations were too high; we just found the food average and nothing to shout about. The restaurant is nicely decorated, simple Scandinavian decor. Hubby ordered chicken "pongteh" with rice...it was average. So was my chicken kapitan with rice. The food's not bad, it's just average and not as exquisite as said by other reviewers.Show less

Author: nicole_sparrowLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Oasis of calm and deliciousness
Review: We searched for this restaurant after seeing the reviews on trip advisorand weren't disappointed. 90 MR got us two mains, drinks and water. We chose malaysian fare and were more than satisfied. Generous helpings and delish. The restsurant setting was scandi style, cool and calming. The staff were very helpful and attentive. Show less

Author: christophereeTavistock, United Kingdom
Title: Good mixture of flavours
Review: It's a bit hard to find, set back150 yards off the main road, but worth the trip. Everything we ordered was good, but the mango gelato, yum yum. Well worth a visit, my only small gripe was not being by the beach it seemed to get hotter as the night went on. Small issue really, but do go because we all go for the food really!!!Show less

Author: 2012JAMManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Delish!
Review: My family and I ate at this restaurant on two occasions and we would highly recommend eating here. We were welcomed by the lovely staff at FatCupid and the host had a great rapport with the customers. We all found the food to be delicious and tried different meals on each visit, all were very tasty (recommend the Wontons, Laksa and Chocolate Brownie sandwich - all very yummy). It was great to find a restaurant with great food and a great atmosphere.Show less

Author: JanineF74Toronto, Canada
Title: Vegetarian Malay Food!
Review: I was so happy to have Malay food that was vegetarian and pretty healthy at Fat Cupid. And the lemongrass lychee mango slushy was pretty terrific too! We took a taxi, but if you walk, it's at almost the end of the road, past what looks like a house with tiled red toof on the right. Show less

Author: lylinge
Title: Highly recommend!
Review:
We love the food here! Satisfied both of our tongue and stomach! Will come back again! 
Must order their signature appetizer!

Author: idahoangoneglobalSandpoint, Idaho
Title: Awesome experience!
Review: The service was great, they even put a citronella candle under the table to keep away mosquitos! The food was really good and beautifully presented. Considering the quality of the service, food, and setting, I thought it was really affordable. Great for couples on vacation, and still awesome for backpackers like me!Show less

Author: oliandadele
Title: A return visit
Review:
... that once again loved up to expectations! 

Amazing and delicious food. Our party ordered: fish and chips, beef rendang, salmon pasta, rack of lamb and all were cooked to a superb and tasty standard.  I love this place!

Author: CJBloubergCape Town, South Africa
Title: 1st class!
Review: From our welcome to our departure, fatCUPID is 1st class! The owners and staff were warm and engaging. The setting is most peaceful and relaxed. Jacky walked us through the menu and recommended the most delicious meals (which we savoured). Service was excellent. Beautiful setting. Beautiful atmosphere. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: PoojaSachdev
Title: Lovely meal!!
Review:
it took us a while to fing this place but it was well worth it....yummy food...the owner is so helpful and was kind to understand our requirements before suggesting any food from the menu..also kind enough to modify it a bit!!!
lovely place very tranquil...

Author: markvanvliet
Title: What a romantic place
Review: What a lovely place. Very friendly staff, delicious food & cocktails. Romantic atmosphere; definately a must go with your girl.

Author: 205loucCorby, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely evening meal
Review: This is definitely a versatile venue. Bring your valentine, family or colleagues. We ate main courses and two drinks each. My tenderloin was delicious and Hubbie said after 20 mths in Malaysia this was the best ayam Rendang yet. The children ate salads. We spent 230rm on four meals with four alcoholic and four soft drinks. Worth every penny. Lovely venue too. Thanks you Fat Cupid XShow less

Author: KatieA3Mumbai, India
Title: Best laksa at fatCUPID
Review: fatCUPID is a lovely little restaurant in Langkawi, based at La Pari Pari hotel. It is definitely worth a visit for their Laksa alone, I had it two nights in a row. Generous meals with both western and Malaysian style dishes. Lovely setting overlooking the pool and garden, friendly helpful staff.Show less

Author: rowlandmw
Title: Cupid's arrow found its mark.
Review: Superb food, the barracuda was beautiful. Romantic spot for couples would go again. Lovely owner who personally attended the tables to ensure everything was good. Also a look cheaper than most other places

Author: GrandTour636398
Title: Amazing!
Review:
We went there for dinner, well knowing it is more expensive than other places, but it was worth every cent! The food is fantastic, the drinks are special, the place looks nice as well and the service makes you feel at home. 
Definitely recommendable!!!

Author: F274TSmelissac
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Bit hard to find but once you do, you can relax in the calm atmosphere. Good design and layout of the restaurant with friendly staff.  Curry is tasty, expresso martini has a nice twist and the brownie ice cream sandwich is a must!

Author: Rossco S
Title: Yuuup
Review:
Was highly recommended by guests we meet around the pool. Loved it!!! Great service, menu and quality of food fantastic.
The staff was very attentive, well worth the visit, highly recommend.

Author: jerseykathyljersey
Title: Worth seeking out!
Review: Went here for dinner one evening. It was a bit tricky to find but worth the effort. Had a lovely welcome and it was bright and clean with a relaxed vibe. Good choice of food which was absolutely delicious. The service was excellent and we had a lovely night here. Would highly recommend.Show less

Author: bobN6078XO
Title: Yummy
Review:
Nice variety of food. Chef knows what they are doing. I very much enjoyed it. I am looking forward to coming back and eating again.
They also have a full bar for the night life

Author: MK09XILahore, Pakistan
Title: A hidden gem
Review: Went there with my wife for a dinner and it was an amazing experience. Although at first it was a bit difficult to find but nonetheless a great place. We ordered wontons as suggested by many and they were crispy and delicious. For the mains, I ordered fish and chips and the batter was just perfect and so we're the chips. Would definitely recommend to anyone planning to spend some quality time with their special one in langkawi. A must go Show less

Author: MattMullard
Title: Great food
Review: Went here for lunch and had two great curries. Nice setting and a lovely resturant, reasonably priced and great tasting!

Author: iamkhameelsUnited Arab Emirates
Title: Nice steak. Friendly Staff.
Review: The place is a hidden gem. The area is al fresco. A friend actually recommend this place, I am not disappointed. The food is nice and the staff here is very very nice. Helpful and knowledgeable. Even suggested a good wine. I will dine here again.Show less

Author: 974satuh
Title: Best service and food at Langkawi
Review: We found this restaurant from Tripadvisor. You can't find it if you don't know where it is. Absolutely best service and food. Very nice and truly recommend this place for all.

Author: 300mariaj
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Enjoyed a delicious dinner for four (two couples) at FatCupid over Christmas 2015. Great food, great staff and great setting

Author: BeccajanexoMelbourne
Title: Best food, Must visit!!!!
Review: Thanks to the reviews on TA we visited fatCupid and were not disappointed at all. The food was incredible, the best food we had on our trip actually. We ended up coming back twice because we couldn't get enough. The owner is so welcoming, helpful and friendly and she really made the experience. The food that we ordered were from the Nonya menu which was incredible, if you aren't great with spice get the beef rendang otherwise I recommend the prawn dish. The wantons are a MUST have and so is the sago dessert. If you don't visit fatCupid when you are in Langkawi you are missing out.Show less

Author: KahingKuching, Malaysia
Title: Surprisingly Good!
Review: Was introduced to this quaint little property tucked away along some residential lane. It looks amazing. Part retro part modern with simplistic decor and a very nice forest view. Food was good. Although slightly on the pricey side but at least portion was quite generous. A must try for new vacationers in Langkawi. Show less

Author: shazzykarim
Title: Food
Review: Our first trip here. We had dinner and came again today for breakfast. The staff is more like family here. They're amazing. Great hospitality, delicious food. Family friendly place. Affordable price.

Author: stardust_02Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Lovely visit
Review: Recently stopped at fat cupid after reading the reviews on TA. It's tucked away but well signposted and not easily missed. It has beautiful and tasteful decor with warm and gracious staff. The owner in particular was very attentive and went out of her way to assist us with all kinds of holiday advice. And the food is also pretty good :-) overall a wonderful experience and recommended to anyone travelling through langkawi. Show less

Author: lumieretoujourCape Town Central, South Africa
Title: Attentive service
Review: A most welcome host who accomodated us just as restaurant was closing ; when you're parched and fatigued friendly warm service goes a long way :-). Of course the food was yum , and our attentive host gave us many helpful hints and tips . Go for food and great ambiance . Show less

Author: crazy-kea
Title: Amazing
Review:
We are living since 1.5 years in Malaysia. And this is till now the best restaurant by far. Great food, great atmosphere and great service for a reasonable price. 

Absolutely delicious!

Author: nursyas
Title: Breakfast by the pool
Review: We had breakfast at La Pari Pari's fatCUPID, and it was amazing. The continental breakfast platter was great, though the bread was a little hard. Nevertheless, you'll not go wrong booking a stay in La Pari Pari!

Author: oliandadelePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Delightful delicious western food
Review: Visited resturant on a reccommendation and it was a fantastic reccomendation. My friend and I were definitely not disappointed!Service was friendly, fast and polite. We got told they was a wait for food (which was not a problem we werent in a rush) and the food came it with hardly a wait at all. High expectations?! Nothing was too much trouble and they even ordered our taxi at the end of the evening. Food was was delicious. My friend ordered from the 'specials' - a beef stew and I had the fish of the day. The dessert that we both ordered 'peanut chocolate brownie' was amazing! A ver popular dessert that needs to be ordered quickly to avoid disappoinment. A definite reccomendation for all especially if you want something different after all the malaysian food. Show less

Author: Tasnuva HLeesburg, Virginia, United States
Title: Good food, good service .... GREAT lamb!
Review: Went there last night for dinner. It's a nice, cozy little place with very friendly staff. I felt that the appetizer menu can be revamped a bit. However, other than that ... the main courses abd dessert were great!We ordered the Beef Rendang, Rack of Lamb and the Panna Cotta for dessert. The lamb in particular, was too awesome. Tender, fall-off-the-bone ... accompanied by a well balanced medley of fresh vegetables.Will return for the lamb :) Show less

Author: tententen29
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Great restaurant with good food and relaxing atmosphere with a pool and garden view. Serving good Western and nyonya food.

Author: cheneyblue
Title: Good food and friendly staff
Review: As most reviews say it's a nice friendly restaurant with good food and nice friendly staff. We had the special beef which was excellent. Great times were had by all.

Author: laurynabZermatt, Switzerland
Title: Great food and lovely scenery
Review: We had the most amazing time at fatCUPID! At first it was hard to find as the entrance is covered with the Chinese lanterns so we thought the place has changed. But we tried it the next time and we were amazed! Food is absolutely delicious, super nice staff, lovely white interior and refreshing view to the pool! To make it even better they had romantic French lounge music on! We had English breakfast, salads and panacotta and it didn't disappoint.Show less

Author: brunor363
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Definitely a place to eat at. Food is well balanced, location is ideal (even if a little hard to find) and service is impeccable.

Author: brian_21179West Drayton, United Kingdom
Title: D I V I N E ! ! !
Review: A friend recommended we visit and we obliged ... twice in the space of our 4 night stay in Langkawi. The food absolutely delicious, good choice of wine, lovely setting and friendly customer service to go with.A little more of the beaten track from your usual restaurants in Langkawi, but would not hesitate to recommend.Show less

Author: S9722CImichaelmCalgary, Canada
Title: Good find in Lankawi
Review: Dined here with my wife and 3 kids (9, 7, 2).Staff were very warm and friendly and the atmosphere was very international. I had the curry chicken special, which was quite tasty, while my wife enjoyed the Laksha. The kids split a couple of tasty burgers. We found the portions very generous and we were unable to complete any of the meals! We also ordered a bottle of prosecco, which was very reasonably priced. Overall, fatCUPID probably provided our best overall dining experience in Langkawi. Show less

Author: Maija83Voula, Greece
Title: Unmissable hidden gem
Review: As others have mentioned, this place is a bit off the beaten path, but it's well worth the effort to find it. Visited this place with a group of four friends for lunch. We all enjoyed our delicious meals in a beautiful environment. The menu, service and setting all display the owners' great attention to detail.Show less

Author: AJ1823Brisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent food, nice outlook, good service
Review: FatCupid is a little hard to find, but was well worth the effort. The menu had a good mix of Malay and western food. We had two Malay and two western dishes and they were all very nice. My son's burger, in particular, was excellent. They have wine, and nice wine at that, which isn't that common in the restaurants we visited. We recommended it to another couple at our resort and they loved it too. Price wise its mid-range.Show less

Author: pzam184
Title: Fantastic breakfast!
Review: A little out of the way but definitely worth making the effort to find it! Breakfasts are delicious and the freebies are also amazing!

Author: Delyana NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food and a nice place to chill out
Review: I always enjoy my meal at FatCupid. Run by owners who are passionate about good food and hospitable service, FatCupid receives thumbs-up from me. Family specialties such as 'chicken pontay' and 'sambal udang/prawn' are served in an authentic way and its Western dishes i.e pasta, salads are delicious too. Heard that its rendang beef is superb from a competitor but didn't manage to try that myself. Service is excellent - the owner and/or the lady at the bar will recommend the suitable dishes for children or even the drinks. If you are not hungry, just find an excuse to just hang out and chill at the restaurant; the mocktails are refreshing!Definitely a must-try if you are ever in the island!Show less

Author: DucatiMartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic little restaurant
Review: Located opposite the Frangipani, where we are staying. Came over here for lunch today. Food and service is excellent, I was amazed how special a chicken sandwich could be put together and presented. My wife's salad was equally good and well presented.I would highly recommend this little restaurant and it is well worth the short walk out of town to be greeted by very friendly and quietly efficient staff.The only thing missing is sea view, but that goes not detract and can be had at the sister restaurant on the beach, called Sugar!Show less

Author: Andy P
Title: Hidden gem.
Review:
Had an excellent meal at very reasonable price. Good friendly service, nice presentation served poolside.
Little bit off the road but we'll worth the effort. Probably the best meal we had in langkawi.
Cold beer available.
Clean modern toilets.

Author: Simason
Title: What a great place
Review:
Definitely the best place we've been for breakfast. Set back away from the endless row of other unsatisfying restaurants and cafes.

 Very welcoming with great food an ambiance.

Author: LouiseR384London, United Kingdom
Title: Great breakfasts!
Review: We were staying at La Pari-Pari and Fat Cupid offers a great deal more than just breakfast, but the breakfast selection was great. We also had lunch and dinner there during our stay, but dragged ourselves away to get a little variety. Absolutely no complaints though.Show less

Author: spainedt
Title: Good food, nice ambiance!
Review: Had a great night at fatCUPID. The food was good (recommend the rendang beef) and the wine was fine as well. It's only 10 /15  minutes walk from the tourist area.

Author: Lintu A
Title: Overpriced and overrated...
Review: Ate here twice. The food was lacking taste and was overpriced. Service was good and the bar area nice.

Author: scotpraguevietnam
Title: Fantasic food in a Traquil loaction
Review: We first visited this restaurant based in tripadvisor reviews and the food and service were excellent. On discovering the restaurant and surrounding accommodation we booked 3 nights stay at La Par-Pari which is located behind the restaurant and also serves its guests.The Malaysian food was the best that we had eaten throughout our time in Malaysia, i tried the Laksa, Beef Rendang and also the Satay and if you want to try malaysian food - then this restaurant will not disappoint, They serve a great Mojito with lemongrass and and its very refreshing, there are a number of personalised drinks and meals and so this is a place to eat at more than once- if the want to try a selection of their meals. the location is a 5 minute walk from Pentai beach and the restaurant is is open air with ceiling fans. all the staff are very welcoming and the service was excellent.I can highly recommend eating here and also staying at La Pari-Pari accomodation.Show less

Author: zuraida89
Title: A hidden gem
Review:
Delicious food, nice ambience and a very quiet place. We had mango + pumpkin salad, burger, fish & chips and open steak sandwich. We cleaned our plates :)
The location is a bit hidden from the main road.

Author: adelka5
Title: Nyonya and Malaysian cuisine
Review:
Great place with nice atmosphere, delicious food, very good staff. The manager came after the dinner to ask us, if we were happy and satisfied. 
Go for rendang and nyonya chicken curry, both dishes were really good. 
Reasonable prices, main courses around 30-40RM. Good job!

Author: Ver0nikaDPrague, Czech Republic
Title: Tasty!
Review: We first came here based on the reviews here and we really liked it and when we decided to stay longer on Langkawi we booked into La Pari-Pari and this restaurant is at the same place. We eat here all the time during our 3 day stay and all the food was amazing. They have a selection of Asian and western dishes. We only had the Asian ones and my favourite was chicken curry Kapitan, I absolutely loved it. But everything else was great too, very nicely spiced with loads of flavours. I have a gluten intolerance and the chef happily adjusted the dishes to my needs. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: NiwenjiaBerlin, Germany
Title: Loved it!
Review: Although a bit hidden in the back, it's definitely worth the effort to search for it! The food was very tasty (we had two appetizers and two main dishes of the Malaysian part of the menu), the service was very attentive, the atmosphere was like in the movies: laid back, dim lights, nice music and a nice breeze to keep you chilled. I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone staying on Langkawi! Show less

Author: PatrickMcAllisterChristchurch
Title: Friendly atmosphere but average food
Review: we tried this place with high expectations due to good reviews on Tripadvisor but were very disappointed with the quality of the food. My steak sandwich was average, with overcooked steak (no option to have it rare or medium) on a good crisp Panini and a tasty sauce, with well made French fries. However my partner's prawns were very soft and tasteless, not firm at all as prawns should be, and the spicy sauce they were in was TOO spicy (and she is a person who loves spicy, chilli-hot food). The supposedly stir fried chicken that accompanied it was strange - white squares of rather tasteless meat. To be fair, the owners deducted the price of this dish from the bill, acknowledging that it was not up to standard. The passion fruit cocktail was good.Show less

Author: Susan FStirling, United Kingdom
Title: Great restaurant, great atmosphere.
Review: We went along here due to the trip adviser ratings and we weren't disappointed. The restaurant has a really laidback vibe and it is seriously clean (always a plus!). The staff are very friendly and look happy to be there. The food itself is good and has a good depth of flavour. We have been so disappointed in the quality of food on the island it was quite refreshing to have such a good meal. We had satay followed by Beef Rendang and we'd recommend both. The owner chatted to us and she was a lovely lady who was more than happy to talk about the island and things to do whilst you are here. Highly recommend a visit here.Show less

Author: emmiscoGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Very tasty food
Review: This is really a hidden gem, in that you need to know where you're going to find it!! It's off the beaten track. We went here once for dinner and then went back again for lunch on our last day. Service is very friendly, if a bit slow. The food we had was very tasty, especially the curries. Mixed reviews on the salad (bit grainy), but overall this place is recommended!Show less

Author: wineshiraz
Title: Tasty
Review: Nice menu with a range of traditional and western dishes, something for everyone. An enjoyable evening.

Author: viviyeo
Title: Average food, overpriced, great service
Review: Overrated, food was just okay, nothing special and overpriced, MYR 20 and above for per serving, food was not hot enough, friendly staff and nice environment

Author: metrobirdProtaras, Cyprus
Title: A Gem
