Review: Ask for directions to this place as it's off the beaten track. It is worth the effort to find.We ate there twice during our 3 day stay in Langkawi. Both times food, drinks and service all excellent. Try the watermelon daquiri! Lovely ambience, contemporary decor and great background music. Not cheap, but not expensive either. Good quality doesn't come cheap. Show less

Author: Mark TLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very very nice, great atmosphere, nice cocktails
Review: Very nice restaurant serving a mixture of both Asian and European dishes. The staff were very attentive and made us welcome despite having no reservation - a short wait at the bar with a cocktail and a table became available. The food was well cooked and tasty. Would be very happy to recommend.Show less

Author: martine170Jarna, Sweden
Title: Very tasty food at good price!
Review: It feels home made. And many of the recipes are also said to be passed down in the family, and we understand why. We had the chicken curry stew and today's special, a spicy beef stew. Both fantastic! Each 26-30 RM plus 10% service charge. Well worth the money! Also the white wine was good. For dessert we had their special ice cream Sago Gula Melaka. Very good also but not as fantastic as the mains. Show less

Author: bastijaseg
Title: Good food.
Review: Very friendly staff. The main dishes were nice, however the brownie ice cream sandwich, was a little bit of a let down as the actual ice cream was crystallised and lacked flavour.

Author: Jens R
Title: Tripadvisor winner!
Review: Kind of hard to find but once there we were professionally greeted and set to our table. Delicious malaysian food for a reasonable price.

Author: Chiara BMoscow, Russia
Title: Lovely place for a pleasant dinner
Review: Just outside the most touristic part of the island, fatCUPID is definitely a place that is worth a visit.It's a minimal decorated restaurant, mostly on the white tones, with a pleasant background music. Menu is wide and everything is delicious, including the desserts.Food is well presented and portions are big enough.Price is a little bit on the high side for Malaysia, but in line with quality and standard.Show less

Author: mackim
Title: devine
Review: Friendly welcome on arrival. Food was fab had chicken capitanl and snapper Malaysian style. Service was spot on and owner was very attentive and bright and cheerful. We will return.

Author: Tim V
Title: Seriously good food
Review: The place is a bit expensive but because the food is so good it still has an excellent value for money. Went here for a lunch and it was worth every penny.

Author: KonekoMelMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delightful dinner off the main road
Review: We visited fatCUPID based on TripAdvisor reviews and were pleasantly surprised. The portions were good, the food was flavoursome and staff was lovely. We ordered Satay Skewers, the Laksa, Beef Rendang and Sago with Gula Melaka. All dishes were divine, and I highly recommend the Gula Melaka. Will visit again next time we are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Claud_loongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and ambience
Review: This place is away from the bustling area in Langkawi. The moment we reached the place, we felt relaxing and want to chill at the place the entire evening. We went without prior reservation but was given a seat fairly quickly. The service crews were very polite, helpful and approachable. Right after we were seated, mosquito coils were lit up. Given that it is surrounded by nature reserves, I was surprised that the place (especially the toilet) was very well-kept and clean. We brought our bottle of champagne to celebrate a friend's birthday. Upon knowing the corkage charges, we decided to do without. The friendly crew allowed us to keep our chilled champagne in their chiller willingly until we left the place.The food served was delicious, with reasonable portion sizes and price! I will definitely go back again, and probably, stayed at their accommodation, La- Pari Pari the next time I visit Langkawi again!Show less

Author: kien kiet l
Title: AWESOME
Review:
VERY friendly waiter.
very friendly boss
very nice atmosphere.
very awesome food, I would give it an OMG jz keep smiling while i was eating LOL

Author: Zach M
Title: great food, great location
Review: A little back from the shops and beach but well worth the trip. Great menu and large portions. Also some good smoothies to pick from. Friendly staff as well.

Author: Sush1981Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Atmosphere and Good Food!
Review: We went here for breakfast and the food was good as well as the atmosphere. it was relaxing and the staff was attentive. We had the Works (breakfast menu) and their beef sausage was top notch. My friend had the mushroom & toufu burger and it was juicy and well seasoned.Show less

Author: Eric R
Title: Great Food and Great Atmosphere
Review: Fat Cupid is set far back from the main road, and surrounded by beautiful countryside. It's a very peaceful and calm setting for enjoying great food. The staff was friendly as well. They have a few good vegetarian options.

Author: 766victoriadSurfers Paradise, Australia
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Recommended by the barmaid from Debbie's Irish pub. A Little off the beaten track but what a hidden gemSister restaurant to SUGAR another gem. Staff were excellent and attentive & good fun. Entrees-we got the shared platter very nice & the beef rendang was absolutely Devine Well & truly worth a visit Show less

Author: Gerard B
Title: Fat Cupid
Review: Great breakfast in a lovely setting away from the busy Cenang strip. Wester style breakfast, and also nonya style dishes. Open breakfast, lunch and dinner. Recommended

Author: PeteNHannahBrisbane
Title: Best curry in Langkawi!
Review: We stopped at fatCupid for lunch and were very pleasantly surprised! It is off the beaten track and very unassuming, and the food was amongst the best we have had on the island.The chicken curry kapitan was the tastiest curry we had on the island and the laksa was also delicious. Both came in generous portions and the curry was accompanied by a good serve of vegetables, which was a very nice (and rare) addition!The staff were very friendly and attentive. Show less

Author: ECKLKualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less is More Part 155 - Bohemian Rhapsody
Review: There is a distinct "chillax" factor here. Somewhat secluded off the busy main road (and rather poorly signed) in the Pantai Tengah area. Low one-storey white washed structures (10-12 'villas') clustered around a rectangular courtyard within which lies a small shimmering pool, an expansive lawn and large silhouetted trees. In the naturally-ventilated but breezeless restaurant contemporary jazz plays softly in the background. We arrived 10 minutes late for our dinner appointment to a half-filled dining area. No worries - it was a slow Sunday night. Lights are low and dreamy. Citronella mosquito coils are lit soon after we are seated. The well-used menu circulates and we ordered a couple of local dishes and some fusion - bruschetta, steak sandwich, grilled ribeye, house salad, snapper asam pedas style and a warm sago pudding with palm sugar ice cream. Service is languid and cordial. Nice comfort food - excellent asam pedas set and yummy local dessert. Enjoyed their fruit smoothies. However thought the dressing for the salad was a bit weird - a simple balsamic vinaigrette would have sufficed. Service warmed up as the evening progressed when the youngish owner operator came by for a chit-chat. Flashes of lightning lit up the evening sky signaling an impending late night storm. Two hours later, with dinner done, the ride back to the hotel arrived. The friendly staff escorted us out with umbrellas as the first rain drops fell. I'm pretty Zen-ed out by then. I turned back to wave good-bye to our hosts. They waved back. I thought I heard Freddie Mercury singing over the car radio as we drove away but I could have been dreaming. Show less

Author: HarbinderKMitcham, United Kingdom
Title: Good food- local and western
Review: My husband and I ate the twice whilst we stayed at La Pari Pari. Delicious nyonya/peranakan food.We had the chicken curry, laksa, wontons and the stay. We also had the Panna cotta for dessert.Overall the food is delicious with quality ingredients. The staff are friendly and the service is prompt. Beautiful decor and surroundings.There is also a good selection of non alcoholic/alcoholic drinks, hot and cold drinks.You will have to pay a little extra but it is worth it. We will definitely eat there again when we are in La Pari Pari.Show less

Author: 292shantitPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Simply exquisite
Review: From the moment we checked in we were spoilt with the delightful food from simple delish wontons accompanied by amazing dipping sauce to 5* fine dining with pairing wines from across the continents , brunch with bubbly and amazing nyonya laksa before literally dashing to our taxi to the airport. As i said simply exquisite and tq to Jacky, Karina, Fiza and Shareen and all at fatCupidShow less

Author: Sham C
Title: Asian and Western favourite
Review: Probably our favourite restaurant in Langkawi with its choice of western and local (nyonya/peranakan) fare . Friendly service, smart casual setting,  reasonably priced, consistent quality,  good for lunch or dinner. Our 16 year old daughter cannot have enough of the fried wantons.

Author: bibianasiah12Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: My Chosen 25th
Review: I chose fatCUPID as my birthday dinner. No regrets I would say! The ambience is nice and soothing. We ordered Calamari salad, Nasi Sambal Udang, Mushroom & Tofu Burger, Brownies. Everything was finger-licking good, especially the burger! I wonder how they managed to make the scrumptious mushroom patty! Yums! There is house pouring wines and other selection of beverages available, suitable for a quiet night out! Service is excellent as the staff would advise on food selections! Just ask if you are not sure on anything~Will come back for sure! Thanks for the birthday song! Show less

Author: Ralphvanlavieren
Title: Special
Review: The restaurant is a place you would not expect on langkawi: style, original, service and last but most important: good food. A bit hard to find, but pay the effort, and you will be rewarded at a very reasonable price. To me: top three of langkawi. Show less

Author: voonchuancVail, Arizona
Title: A must visit
Review: As the review rated, it's a very nice place. Soft jazz contributes to the soothing atmosphere, attractive and spare decor reminiscent of mid century modern southern Californian design. Friendly accommodating staff, well trained in high end service. However, a little heavy on the Ikea's furniture with their rooms. (open minded management ) Show less

Author: Sheena BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect for Those Romantic Dinners
Review: Love the ambiance and the slow pace of the world around us when we were there. The service, however, was thoroughly prompt and the smiles were generous. It's one of those eats where you don't have plans afterwards. Just take your time and enjoy the experience. Ps: Food was great especially their burgers. Show less

Author: mike sBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food and ambience.
Review: A bit hidden away but ready well worth the visit. Food was excellent and really enjoyed it. The restaurant and a really nice feel to it, the hostess was really friendly and staff were great. If you want some nice malaysian food then this is the place to go. they have a beach venue too but we ran out of time. Seriously recommend this place. Tip get a taxi!!Show less

Author: aisyahz95
Title: Good food with ambience to boot
Review: My husband and I popped over for lunch. They had quite a variety to choose from ranging from local delicacies and western dishes. I ordered the open-faced steak sandwich as I was sold the second I read in the menu's description of the dish which said they used tzatziki dressing. The dish did not disappoint and it was served with thin fries which made the it just that much better. Service was quick with friendly staff.I initally thought it was a tad pricey but when the food came it became apparent it was value for money!The decor was lovely and they nailed the ambience with some jazzy bossa nova music accompanying our dining experience. I would definitely visit this place again when we come back to Langkawi.Show less

Author: DAshcroft
Title: Worth finding
Review: We happened upon this fantastic restaurant off a side road near our hotel on the Southern end of Pantai Cenang.  Really nice food, excellent wine selection and wonderfully friendly staff.  Go there!

Author: GeorgiaPistachio
Title: Yummy shiraz cocktail
Review: Fell in love with the fruit smoothies and the shiraz cocktail.. Food is fresh and delicious and the staff are wonderful.

Author: RosieMeadowsAustralia
Title: Hmmmmm what did I miss?
Review: I am normally a fairly generous reviewer but I was underwhelmed by this restaurant. Staff were friendly, but service took a long time considering there were only 2 other people dining. Serves were on the small side and I'm a light eater, I ordered the Nyonan chicken curry which consisted of many more pieces of tomato than chicken and the chicken pieces were tough. Maybe we picked a bad day to visit.Show less

Author: Georgia TBournemouth
Title: Well presented, tasty food - worth seeking out.
Review: We were made very welcome on arrival at fatCupid. Probably as it is a bit off the beaten track, but it is well worth the diversion from the main strip.We had fabulous Hendricks G&Ts (several of them!) which were so refreshing in the humidity of end-of-wet-season Malaysia. We shared a starter of satay chicken which I thought was only ok but others rated good. We also had little wontons which were absolutely delicious.We then had Malaysian curries of various kinds. I had prawn sambal and my husband had beef rendang. Both were delicious in their own rights and beautifully presented, but also came with unusual little extras which made the dish a lot more interesting. We had a very good meal here and would happily recommend it.Show less

Author: Kafrin42
Title: Great Atmosphere
Review: Fantastic vegetarian version of a local specialty, great atmosphere, fantastic choice of fruit smoothies, cocktails & mocktails.

Author: Geraldine554Cologne, Germany
Title: Surprising good local food in very inviting atmosphere!
Review: Do not get put off by the location, off the main street behind Sun mall. You're not going to regret if you're looking for local food in a modern setting. Tasty cocktails (we tried them all!), short but ok wine list and this all is reasonable prized! The presence of a very bubbly hostess Visa makes it all even more pleasant.Show less

Author: LomalaisetHelsinki, Finland
Title: Splendid food
Review: The place is a bit off from the main street, but it definitely is the place to visit. We ate here two times, since to us it was the best dining experience we had in our trip in Langkawi. The food was simply excellent in taste as well in texture. You must try the Won Ton’s and Beef Satay was very good. The Beef Rendang was the best in the town.Show less

Author: BJvK
Title: Great!
Review:
Nice people, very nice food and very good ambiance. Owners also run restaurant on the beach called sugar, a great place as well.
Best place just out of the busy touristy area.

Author: Bee0521Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Really nice environment
Review: I really like this place. It was so pretty. It is not visible from the roadside so keep an eye for the signboard. This restaurant is part of the La Pari Pari resort at Pantai Tengah.It was a clean and nice place to just chill and have a satisfying meal.The food was not bad. They serve mostly western dishes.Show less

Author: Kim H
Title: Nice little café
Review: We came here for breakfast during our stay at Langkawi. Nice service, great food and good prices. It is located a bit off the main road which makes it a bit hard to find and you probably wouldn't drop in accidentally. But it is absolutely worth it for the food and for the nice little garden it is situated in. Coming from Pentai Cenang turn left after the little "shopping street" on the left and follow the path passing Fuuka Villa and I&R Tasik Anak Motel. It is one of those cafés you could spent the whole day at if you didn't know what else to do. Also there are some bungalows that you can stay at named La Pari Pari. We didn't see them from the inside but they looked good from the outside.Show less

Author: MJcuac
Title: Excellent food and service!
Review: This restaurant is one of those places were the high ranking is absolutely fair. We went for dinner during October. The menu offers traditional dishes but cooked in an outstanding way. The service is correct, efficient, polite… we liked it so much that we wanted to repeat on our last night there but unfortunately it is closed on Monday nights. However, the person in charge gave us wonderful advices about where we could eat in the area based on our eating preferences. She even offered to arrange a taxi for us if we wanted to go a bit further! Excellent food and excellent service!Show less

Author: Matthew A
Title: Worth seeking out
Review: A bit tricky to find, but good food and friendly service (also free wifi). Meals were $10-15 AU and would happily go back.

Author: YodsIsMeLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Cheers! Where everybody knows your name.
Review: This place is awesome. The food is wonderful. I had the chicken roulade and every mouthful was moist and delicious. Served with the freshest, tastiest vegetables. Not a trace of MSG to be found...a rarity in Langkawi. The panacotta too, it just melts in your mouth. I highly recommend The Berry Thingy. It's a divine slushy type drink that I can't get enough of.On top of that, you have the most amazing staff. In particular, Karina, Jacky and Fiza. They make it THE place to go! It really is like Cheers, but better!Show less

Author: Ken Sheng W
Title: Delicious Food with Peaceful Environment
Review:
- Location is a bit hard to find. Need GPS to help.
- Cafe that attached to La Pari-Pari Hotel
- Food is delicious especially Nyonya Laksa
- Good and efficient staff service

Author: Foodie J
Title: Very cute place with average food
Review: Having read reviews on TripAdvisor, I made it a point to visit this place during my trip to Langkawi. However, I was pretty disappointed with the food. The service and the restaurant itself were great though!

Author: samueldarknightPenang, Malaysia
Title: Great meal
Review: It was my last day in Langkawi before heading back home via evening flight. Had great experience so far in Langkawi and I'm curious about how this restaurant got it's name and it's award from tripadvisor. We came here from our hotel after checking out, my family, parents and 2 sisters, all ready for meal.This place is easily missed from the main road. There will be a sign pointing inwards through a small alley/road.We received a warm welcome from the waiters, great service. Ours was the only table they are serving when we came. It was relaxing with a great view around the hotel. Menu was small, not overwhelmed with number of choices. I couldn't resist the temptation to try the beef rendang since I knew that if it's properly made it would be heavenly. But I instead went for ayam pontay, a traditional nyonya dish with herbs and spices with chicken slow cooked stew style, served with rice. My dad opted for a special menu steak and my mom a sea bass.My sisters both shared a nyonya chicken curry and green curry chicken (I think).It took some time for them to cook and serve our food. I took my time to walk around the compound. Great atmosphere for a relaxing lunch.The food is great. My Ayam Pontay, spectacular. It was filled with great herbal and spice flavors, chicken was tender. The nyonya chicken curry and the green curry chicken was great too. The steak,okay but the seabass was a disappointment.Overall, I would come back for more, I might order both ayam pontay and the beef rendang for myself. Just writing about it makes me hungry. Always opt for the traditional choice.Great service.Great atmosphere.Great food.Fantastic place.Ps: Grandma's recipes are always the best.Show less

Author: AlootikkaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprised to find this gem
Review: Excellent landscaping. They allow you to use the hotel facilities (deck chairs, pool and nice beds to lounge in under the trees and a lily pond with fabulous framing for instagram photos, display-pic worthy). Only sorry that they gave me Beef Rendang instead of the Tempeh Rendang that I ordered. ( and I stupidly didn't know until the bill came, not that I will complain about the Beef rendang. So tender that I thought it was a soy product!) Excellent freezies like Blackberry Thingy and cocktails like something Blackberry Compote and Lemongrass mojito. Drinks about rm15-22. Decent drinks that do not cut you short on the alcohol. Will recommend this place to my friends. Show less

Author: landseairmudWorld
Title: Best place ever..
Review: Doing my work tenure on the island, this was my go to spot. Great service everytime, friendly and smiles is what you will receive during the whole dining experience. I always ordered the beef burger as I am a creature of habit, they do the simple things so well. Occasionally I would order the veggie burger just to mix things up a little. Very serene environment, I don't know how I would have survived if this restaurant didn't exist. Show less

Author: Veronika M
Title: Great restaurant
Review:
Best of all is the fact that they have breakfast menu till 2 pm! 

They really take care about their customers, food is also good.

Author: asianfoodlover2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over-priced food
Review: We came to this place after reading good reviews from TripAdvisor. We went there for dinner. The place was very quiet, not packed with customers (in-fact, we were the only customers there). The ambiance of the restaurant was very nice and clean with a white theme. The sign-board stated "pool-side restaurant" but the pool seemed very small. We ordered the nyonya chicken curry and chilly prawn aglio-olio as our main dishes. The chicken curry tasted good but there was not enough seasoning in the omelette. The prawn was seasoned nicely but was a little overcooked. The pasta tasted bland, too much bell peppers & onions for my liking. The portion of food were small considering that the price for the food were above average. We went to other restaurants along Pantai Cenang because what we had at fatCUPID did not satisfy our palates. I would not recommend this to my family or friends.Show less

Author: K1232WPchriss
Title: Outstanding hospitality
Review: Great service, great food and a great setting (if a little difficult to find). A very friendly and warm welcome followed by some exquisite traditional Malaysian food. Worth a visit!

Author: Evon T
Title: Great place to be
Review: Found this cosy place which is tuck away from the main road, friendly & attentive service, clean environment and good food & drink.... love it

Author: iamjohnnyThailand
Title: One of the best dining experiences!
Review: Love the place. So clean and tidy. Feels more like in Bali than Langkawi. Very beautifully decorated and very calming. Feels like a wedding set-up. Very accommodating when I requested the food altered from what's stated in the menu. Delicious food. Friendly and smiling staff. Great hospitality. Thank you, Jackie!Show less

Author: Nermal KSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Mum...am hungry
Review: Loved the food , ambience and hospitality. Hubby said it was the best breakfast he has had in ages on a trip. Our 2 little girls loved the pizza and we had a chance to roam around the.place while breakfast was being prepared. .it was like homeShow less

Author: mrg3311Wetherby, United Kingdom
Title: Out of the way but worth the effort
Review: Gem of a restaurant tucked away near underwater world you get to it by a bit of a dirt track but it's very clean and quiet, menu a bit limited but this is made up by the fact what they do serve is excellent and it's very reasonably pricedShow less

Author: 921aoifeoCork, Ireland
Title: Delicious meal and great service
Review: Dined here on our first night after finding it on tripadvisor and it did not disappoint. We had the sharing platter for starter including pizza, bruschetta and wonton which was all delicious. Then the beef rendang and a chicken dish for main which was lovely. Desert was a brownie ice cream sandwich - divine. Also the setting of the restaurant is really very nice. Service was also great. It seems to be in the same price range as the rest of the area. Would definitely recommend. We are planning on returning here for our last night in langkawi. Show less

Author: Joeychong91Perth, Australia
Title: Great food with a personal touch to the service
Review: It was such a great experience dining here. We were welcomed by the friendly and attentive staff and lead us to dine next to the pool. I ordered chicken roulade and that was the best dish I had throughout my stay in Langkawi. The attentive staff check out on us from time to time and interact with us. It would have been perfect with air cooling system as it is hot and humid in the afternoon. Nonetheless, I will definitely come back and recommend this place to everyone.Show less

Author: Hsnr_ALangkawi, Malaysia
Title: worth it!
Review: My partner and I went to FatCupid to celebrate his belated birthday. We had really good food, friendly and warm welcome from the staff. I had chicken roulade which is their specialties, and it was so yummy. My partner had steam rice with chicken rendang and he enjoyed it so much. After dinner we went to the swimming pool and enjoyed our drinks. It was a great evening so far at FatCupid. Thanks and we'll be back soon.Show less

Author: WmunesKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Great place with good food
Review: This place is hidden from the road, you have to look for the signage when you are at Pantai Tengah. Ambience is simple yet cool. Food was good, we have the mix platter( a combo of wonton, cheese pizza and bruschetta) was great, salmon linguine( this was awesome) and kapitan chicken curry( was tasty but I prefer it to be slightly more spicy). Will definitely recommend this place for lunch or dinner. Show less

Author: bevfoldsfive
Title: Loved the Rendang Tempe!
Review: I was brought here for dinner and lunch (which was inclusive in my yoga retreat). Apart from there being insects flying about - which is possibly applicable to most of Langkawi anyway at the time - it was a very satisfying experience. I'm not vegan so I never thought I could enjoy vegetarian so much but the Rendang Tempe totally converted me which is basically a variation of the classic Rendang dish.For lunch the following day, they recommended the tofu and mushroom burger, supposedly homemade. It was okay but me being a real meat person just found it a bit bland. Overall, their servings are really generous and I would definitely recommend this for the attentive wait staff and nice backyard-garden ambience - especially if you're staying at the Pantai Cenang/Tengah area.Show less

Author: Lay Kun L
Title: Superb Food with Superb Staff
Review: This place is highly recommended. The food is awesome and the staff are attentive & friendly. We enjoyed the curry laksa very much. The cappuccino is really good. The ambience is cosy and the feeling is like going back to grandpa's home in outskirt and you are having meal in his nice little garden. I will surely come back for the food, people and the peaceful ambience. Show less

Author: Praveen R
Title: FarCupid
Review: We had an excellent lunch at Fat Cupid.It's sort of mid way in Langkawi. Nice decor and excellent seafood.

Author: yanteen
Title: Delicious!
Review: Nice breakfast and ranges of mains. If you stay in La Pari Pari, you may choose for a upgrade of breakfast - it's really good!

Author: 277ashleighbMelbourne, Australia
Title: Lovely food, lovely staff
Review: My boyfriend and I were looking for authentic Malaysian food (and I was craving a laksa!) and we found it! Too much delicious sounding good on the menu it was hard to choose just one dish - the meal sizes are quite big so try not to fill up on entrees! Staff were super friendly, came up for a chat and gave local recommendations :) it can be a bit hard to find, just keep going down the long driveway and you'll see it- Definitely worth the drive/ride! Show less

Author: lizg172Perth, Australia
Title: Hard to find, but worth looking for
Review: We had a few issues finding this restaurant but once we did it was well worth it. Got off on the right foot when one of the lovely staff came out and offered to move a car so we could park and then it just went from good to great. The staff are amazing, very attentive, chatty and know the menu. Great drinks selection and lovely setting. I'm glad we took the time to find the place as it was a little gem.Show less

Author: Emily L
Title: Fantastic
Review:
The greeting was friendly, our hostess was friendly, menu has food for all tasts, atmosphere and ambiance perfect, taste and presentation of food gorgeous....

What else to say...its a perfect place and definitely worth visiting when you're on langkawi!

Author: elinws
Title: Worth a visit!
Review: Never thought it would be a restaurant like that, at the end of the street. Clean, very nice interior, friendly staff and VERY nice food :)

Author: Tommy POslo, Norway
Title: Very nice place
Review: Ate here tonight. It's located 300m off the main road so you won't just walk past this place. Found it here on tripadvisor and we stay at a hotel right down the road.The food was very good! And the service was also excellent. Prices from RM30-50The place was very nice and clean too. Very romantic at night. Show less

Author: Grahamcecily
Title: Don't be put off by the name
Review: Lovely clean restaurant in a modern setting. Welcome was lovely and the food fantastic. Very relaxed atmosphere staff very attentive but not intrusive

Author: ClairBBBOverloon, The Netherlands
Title: Great place
Review: Found this place on TripAdvisor. Great food and really nice waitress! She is very funny and makes u feel right at home!! They have a variety of food the choose from like Malaysian food but also western. The food looks and taste great! Going to get dinner there again to night, can definitely recommend it. Show less

Author: DeeeedooooNapier, New Zealand
Title: Lovely setting, great food
Review: Recipes handed down generations make Fat Cupid a must experience for those who wish to sample real Malay food. The western selection is top quality too, so everyone will be happy. The swimming pool is a great feature when visiting on a hot day and/or with children. The cocktail list is also to be checked out. Great friendly staff.Show less

Author: NoakhaillaBHOOTDhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Very very So So ... Nothing great!
Review: We came here after reading the reviews ... but am beginning to question all those who reviewed and gave 5 ... duh!!!The ambience is nice ... but the food was barely OK. The hostess who was quite impressive .... convinced us that the food would be an art by Michael Angelo ... but the reality was quite the opposite. Show less

Author: Alex Y
Title: Breakfast not up to expectation
Review: I asked the staff...what is poached egg? They answer me thats the poacged egg on your plate. Spoiled my morning breakfast. No more next timeShow less

Author: nicholasn232
Title: Local Food
Review:
Fantastic Barracuda fish and Laksa. The food is delicious.
Nice cool place. Great service
Keep a lookout at the road because it resides in a small lane.

Author: Andrew4everstyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Everything Good...BUT...
Review: 1st at all...we as a outsider come on 4:30pm but their operation time is 6pm but they should be open every single time I means the bar should be open although kitchen is not open...bar should be open and serve the guest this is what I suggest....but everything is good...service good...environment also good...love this place...Show less

Author: filomenka22
Title: White intimate restaurant, hidden from crowds
Review: The food was great, beautifully presented, and very tasty Malay food. The pool is a bonus. Kids played in pool while our dinner was getting ready. They offer accommodation too, in very new stylish bungalows.

Author: E2472FIstephensBeijing, China
Title: Family dinner
Review: Food was great, service was outstanding with very friendly staff willing to help in anyway.Had a look around the boutique rooms, a great meal and got some good advice on things to do in langkawi....Definitely on my list of places to visit again...Also thanks for the loan of the book, my daughter cannot stop reading it....Show less

Author: EAHoodMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food!
Review: We took our family here for evening dinner. (2 adults and 2 kids, 13 and 9). The restaurant was very quiet but the food was amazing and well worth the trip. A real mixture of local Malaysian with a twist of Aussie thrown in. Excellent Tanqueray and Tonic as well. Show less

Author: Diver2020
Title: Excellent
Review: Some of the best food we had on Langkawi. We eat here twice. Everybody in our group enjoyed their meal here. Very good price for both food and drinks. Staff are great.

Author: 621hannahbHong Kong Island, China
Title: Lovely Malaysian food!
Review: We went here for dinner last night. It was lovely. The menu was wonderful, difficult to make a decision so we all chose a dish and shared. Fabulous! The staff were lovely. Very friendly and attentative. Well worth a visit when in Langkawi. Wear mosquito repellant though, they do burn candles and citrus coils but if you're loved by those pesky mosquitos, I'd lather up!Show less

Author: 93jogBudapest, Hungary
Title: Cool place to eat and drink at any time of the day!
Review: fatCUPID is the sister restaurant to Sugar in Pantai Tengah in Malaysia.It is a short walk away from the main street/beach but fortunately very close to where we were staying (Frangipani resort).Great open air restaurant with adjacent pool with a delicious menu for breakfast/lunch/dinner and super friendly staff.When we went for dinner we had the wontons for starters, rendang tempe and Laksa for main with delicious lemongrass mojitos. We returned for breakfast the next day and had the eggs benedict with sweet potato pieces and the mushroom and tofu burger.Amongst the best food we ate in Langkawi. Closed on Monday.Can use their pool before or after dining. Also have accommodation here (La Pari Pari) which is clean, quiet and simple.Show less

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Nice Setting, Classy Even, Food Was ............
Review: First of all, I must qualify my review by being totally honest about the fact that I was brought up feasting on Nyonya cuisine. With spices lovingly 'giling' at the break of dawn and nothing came processed from a packet with a sell-by date :)The setting of FatCupid is a refreshing change from the typical Pantai Tengah / Pantai Cenang foodie scene. You can tell that the proprietors take great pride in maintaining the whole compound. The garden, peppered by lush locally grown spices, is a little oasis in itself.Food-wise was a disappointment. The assam pedas snapper was neither sour nor spicey and the signature nyonya chicken dish lacked any hint of its main ingredient. Both dishes were very watered down version of its original form and obviously adapted to suit non-Asian taste buds. Which is a pity for those seeking authenticity.Nevertheless, top marks for FatCupid's service. Absolutely faultless !Show less

Author: koksiong71
Title: Excellent food with good service
Review: Good cozy location next to a swimming pool. The service staff were friendly, and the food was delicious. Well worth a visit, though the place is slightly off the map. Would definitely visit again next time I am in Langkawi.

Author: taylort750Sydney, Australia
Title: Welcoming and delcious
Review: The fatcupid was a fantastic experience for my family and I. Not only were the staff warm and welcoming, they extended further then just waiting stuff but made extra effort to ensure we made the most of our stay in Langkawi. We enjoyed our delicious Malaysian cuisine for dinner, with the flavoursome food that tasted delicious and had a homely vibe to it. The dining area had a modern beach vibe to it, with a nice outside yet under cover area, decorated beautifully. We went back for breakfast a few days later and the staff continued to be warm and welcoming, where we had a generic homely western breakfast. I would definitely recommend that this is a not to be missed restaurant - particularly for dinner !!!Show less

Author: Vivian_Adram
Title: Fun folks and good food
Review: A trip to Fat Cupid always ends with some chuckles with Jeremy and the other fun folks around! And the food, well absolutely scrumptious!

Author: Manky11
Title: Excellent in every way
Review: Had dinner 3 nights ago plus breakfast yesterday and both were delicious!! Superb food, excellent service and gorgeous restaurant!! A must visit if in Langkawi.

Author: ivan c
Title: Lunch By the pool
Review: Food n service is good. Well priced.  Friendly staff. With quality food. Something different from others. Worth a try.

Author: simply-blissfulLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: A Hidden Gem
Review: we went there after reading the reviews! and was welcomed immediately by the team. Food was amazing and the cocktails were great, I didnt hv a coctail but opt for the freezies....trust me, a must try! U can even choose and spirits that they have displayed and they will make a special concoction for you.Service is amazing and they do have a great and friendly team.Try the asian Prawns or any of their specials. We have been there 3 times out of our 5 day holiday.If i ever go back, I will definitely go back to this hidden gem!Thanks Fat Cupid for being a part by making our holiday a memorable one.Show less

Author: Chonglee LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Cozy & Good Food
Review: The restaurant is not easy to find - while it is very near Pantai Cenang - you will need google maps to get you there (luckily the map is updated correctly!) We received a very warm welcome from the team & found that there's a boutique stay there (La Pari Pari).We ordered fish & chips, salmon curry & a vegan tempe mix. The food served is a fusion of indian & western - which is very nice!Definitely will go there again.Show less

Author: Jo ONewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Loved everything!
Review: We were staying at La Pari Pari so ate here several times and were never disappointed. We made our way through a good chunk of the menu(!) and never had a bad meal. Staff are incredible and the atmosphere is really nice and laid back. My favourite dish was the Nasi Ayam Pontay-absolutely to die for! Slightly pricey compared to other places nearby but absolutely worth it, if you're going to have a special meal one night have it here.Show less

Author: hannah1441
Title: Love love it!!!!!
Review: Great place for couples, quite and elegant for Langkawi! Will definitely go again when I'm in Langkawi! Drinks and food at reasonable price

Author: ShirleylslSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience but not so nice food
Review: Read about the reviews and decided to give it a try. Even has to ask around to get to the right place as the address stated in tripadvisor which is lead by google map not accurate. A dining place with good ambience with good and polite service staffs. However, the taste of food were so disappointing. I order aglio olio prawn and it was totally tasteless. The Lynette's wanton were average but the chili sauce was good. Not a suitable place for young kids. We also find the food were a little pricy. Show less

Author: Hurls88Adelaide
Title: Great little restaurant - food and service fantastic
Review: We decided to come to fatCUPID on our last night staying in Pentai Cenang for dinner. We wished we had found it sooner as the food and service were both amazing. The setting is of the restaurant is modern and white chic and looks over the pool area of the attached hotel pari pari. It was certainly a change in decor in terms of a more contemporary feel than other restaurants we had dined at in Langkawi. We went for Malaysian style food as we generally tend to prefer local cuisine and both the laksa and chicken curry were amazing. The laksa particularly was one of the best we had tried anywhere in the world - all made from scratch. We had the share platter to start which was a good way to kick off proceedings. Despite not needing it we wanted to try desert and both the panna cotta and brownie sandwich were good.What made the experience even better was the friendly and helpful service. That was with the food but also discussing and providing tips for other places around Langkawi. The owner had lived in Melbourne and you really get that feel that there is a bit of that Melbourne dining in the way the restaurant looks and the food is presented. Would definitely recommend! My girlfriend and I thoroughly enjoyed it and were so full we decided to walk our way back to our hotel. Show less

Author: 916DonnaG
Title: Love Fat Cupid
Review: My husband and I dined here and loved everything about the restaurant and the food was amazing.  Hopefully if we go back to Langkawi we can dine there again.  The staff were excellent and very friendly.  We were made to feel very welcome.

Author: SVC17
Title: Very friendly staff!
Review: We stayed in La Pari Pari , so fatCupid was just there. Had a chance to have breakfast here , and I mus t say it was a good one :)

Author: rowenat644Valencia, Spain
Title: Lovely casual setting !
Review: Place was a little hard to find but nothing Google map can't handle . It's a pleasure to see a minimalist decor. Simple and understated but the food was excellent . We both chose local food n they were superb . The restaurant is part of a villa accommodation called la pari pari. Great alternative to a hotel . Perfect for a small group of friends to stay together . Show less

Author: popcin22London, United Kingdom
Title: Terrific atmosphere, average food
Review: We found this place on Tripadvisor and had to convince our lovely taxi driver it did in fact exist as it was a little hard to find - keep an eye out for the sign on the main road! The atmosphere was mellow and relaxing. The music and vibe was perfect, we could have been anywhere - Rio, Barcelona, Ibiza! There are lots of tempting items on the menu and like usual we ordered way too much. We had the sliders and a platter for starters which were just ok sadly. We had to take the mains with us but unfortunately this lacked any real flavour. On the plus side the service was superb and friendly. Perhaps come here for the music and cocktails instead!Show less

Author: ChicagoPairNew Orleans, Louisiana
Title: Overpriced and bland
Review: The place is a bit hard to find as it is not on the main drag and signage is not the best. The setting was lovely, with the restaurant overlooking the pool. The food, however, was not. We found the food to be overpriced and quite tasteless. Probably our worst and certainly our most expensive meal in Malaysia. Perhaps we just hit them on a bad night or ordered wrong.Show less

Author: Don F
Title: cool place to hang-out
Review: Friendly hosts, really delicious malaysian cuisine, great music, a romantic place. The beer is cold an d also serve a nicely presented cocktail . use the pool and feel the peacefullness  while  having a view of the mountains, really a relaxing experience!

Author: Ste KPreston, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food and friendly host!
Review: A nice restaurant tucked away from the main road meant the area was peacefully quiet. We ordered a number of items that were very nice (Western and Asian) and they were presented well. I had the steak sandwich which was nice but the steak was a little chewy and there was too much mayonnaise on it. Although for the price was nice.My only dislike was the hostess whom was very funny, well mannered and very helpful. It was just a little too apparent that she was 'upselling' all the time. We were talked into a starter and hinted at a bottle of wine for the table. Maybe it's just my 'British' ways and like to make my own mind in my own time. Although having said that, the hostess was quick to replace our beers and that is good thing!Recommended if you are passing.Show less

Author: Denise M
Title: Beautiful and fantastic little hideaway
Review: Food was great, service was great. Price is good, and the ambience is really special. Very romantic, and nice for a quiet brunch.The view is just so surreal, and it's a little hard to get there without a car or transport of some sort. However, a wonderful place to visit for a hearty breakfast. Portions are very decent.Would visit again if I'm ever in Langkawi again!Show less

Author: carlingfordgreenwayCarlingford, Ireland
Title: A modern approach to 'Westernised' Asian Food
Review: We visited FatCupid during our recent Langkawi stay on the back of Trip Advisor reviews. To be perfectly frank about Pantai Cenang in general, decent food presented in a contemporary fashion is NOT easy to find . . .Trip Advisor was pretty accurate in our opinion !So, the venue is tucked away off the main road to the southern part of the resort. Our taxi driver had never heard of it but I had seen the sign off the main road and knew where it was....If you are staying at the airport end of Pantai Cenang, it would be a long walk . . . .The greeting we received was very friendly and the environment was clean, bright and modern with 'asian twists' - in fact we got a good idea for our own house whilst we were there. The restaurant is in the grounds soft a 'boutique chalet' complex - and in fact we asked and were shown the holiday accommodation which again was clean, bright, modern and 'minimalistic'. Not sure I would stay there rather than where we did stay, but it is a definite option....The food was very good....I had Grandma's Chicken Curry. It was well presented, it was fresh, it was not over spicy . . .I would say it was the 2nd most enjoyable dinner we had out in Langkawi so I think it does deserve it's TripAdvisor rating. Can't really remember how much it was but I would say mid-range price wise...Service was great - very attentive - but there were only a very few diners so not sure how it would be if it were busierShow less

Author: KbhuatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Classy restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Had dinner at the fatCUPID on the recommendation of our guide from Dev's Adventure tours who said it had the best nyonya food on the island. Well although it serves some nyonya dishes it was more an Asian and Western fusion restaurant. The nyonya/ Malaysian dishes we had such as beef rendang, chicken pongteh and prawn sambal were all delicious and well presented. Their salad too was very good. Overall a very good and classy restaurant.Show less

Author: mytomorrowland
Title: Good selection of food
Review: Love the nyonya dishes and the watermelon lychee freeze drink we tried. There are good selection of western and nyonya food.

Author: J_Tan_KLKuala Lumpur
Title: Best meal we had in Langkawi
Review: While there may be some hassle to locate this restaurant in the first place, but once u found it, you are rewarded with the exceptionally warm welcome by the staffs here. Everyone including the hotel (la pari pari) staffs, the manager and the waiter and waitresses are all attentive and there to make sure everyone had a wonderful dining experience.Our first experience was for lunch on a Saturday. Food and ambience was fantastic. The must order is the Chocolate brownie icecream sandwich.Our second visit was on the same night for dinner but the experience was slightly dampen by the crowd that night. But of course its not the restaurant to be blamed as they dont get to choose their customers. Food and service is still top notch.This restaurant is the place to dine in Langkawi. We have tried several other well rated eateries in Tripadvisor but nothing came close to Fat Cupid.We would love to come again the next time we are in the island.Show less

Author: Lusy KPenang, Malaysia
Title: Wow! Relaxing, great quality food, clean & lovely
Review: Super friendly staff, amazing fresh cocktails, and beautiful food (even my French friend agreed)... We ended up having two desserts each... As the lovely waitress said "have some local and something sinful"It was empty to... We swam, drank cocktails, and ate great food whilst listening to jazz music. Felt like we were in the 1960s but in a gorgeous sumptuous way... Like we were at Andy warhols summer place or something... And like we were the only ones there. Loved it here!Show less

Author: Raymond wGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Great value
Review: We ordered chilli pasta with prawns and smoked salmon linguine. Both dishes were very good quality. We shared a dessert of home made peanut butter ice cream sandwiched between home made chocolate brownie. One of the best desserts we have had. The decor is basic but the service and food are very good.Show less

Author: BetsyBayWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Just beautiful......
Review: We stayed at Villa Molek and I kept reading about this fabulous place on Trip Advisor but couldnt work out how to get there. It was actually very easy- turn left out of Villa Molek , walk for about 10-15 minutes and when you see 'Fat Mum' Chinese restaurant turn left.The food, the decor, the coctails and all the staff were fabulous.My partner had beef rendang and I had tthe vegetarian rendang.....it was absolutely DELICIOUS.We were travelling onto Melbourne and a lovely waiter wrote a whole list of places for us to visit in Melbourne which was so useful when we got there. I would DEFINITELY recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: AnnaJaneStearmanNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Best Meal in Langkawi!
Review: I visited here after finding in TripAdvisor. It was tricky to find but worth it. I loved this restaurant. It was quiet when we were in (Wednesday 8th April) but that didn't matter as it was a lovely atmosphere, sitting looking over the pool. Very modern and clean decor- lovely table settings. The cocktails were brilliant- I tried three and they were all so fresh. The food was fantastic- the chicken and beef satay were gorgeous and my boyfriend has the wontons and they were also very good- both had nice dipping sauces. The mains were amazing- our first time in Malysia and I loved the two curries we had- Beef Rendang and Nyonya chicken curry- both served with a gorgeous Asian greens, rice and an onion omelette. I just loved it all! Very good quality and nicely presented. This restaurant was also very good value. The owner was very helpful and friendly and she recommended a jet ski tour we did with MegaWatersports the next day which was a highlight of our time in Langkawi! You MUST go here!Show less

Author: Damian_76
Title: Excellent breakfast joint!
Review: We stayed just down the road, and this was a good place to get our morning coffee hit. Loved the atmosphere. I'm very fussy with coffee, and theirs kept me happy. Other breakfast items were good (Pancakes, bacon and egg sandwich).The owner is wonderful and very helpful with planning our stay on the island. Would loved to have made it back to try their lunch/dinner menu.One suggestion, however: Blending peeled oranges does not make drinkable Show less

Author: NigelZilwaColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Food Fantastic
Review: Staying at La Pari Pari was so rewarding and the restaurant was no exception. In fact I surprised the staff one evening by ordering the same meal twice in one dinner sitting, thats how good the food was. For 4 days we had nothing but their Grilled Sweet Potatoes with eggs and Hollandaise sauce for breakfast. The Asam Pedas snapper was a joy to my tastebuds and the Beef Rendang was so good it required a second serving. My new favorite drink in the bar's Lemongrass Freezee which tasted like the worlds best tropical party in my mouth. Simple, chic, surprisingly fantastic.Show less

Author: isobelleeSydney, Australia
Title: Nice but underwhelming
Review: The restaurant is small but beautifully appointed with friendly staff and a peaceful atmosphere. Our appetisers (sliders and pizza) were delicious and prompt, however we weren't overly impressed by our mains. My partner found the laksa to be average, and my beef rendang, whilst tasty, was quite spicy for a 'mild' dish. Also, there were a few tables near us who were smoking (whole restaurant is covered outdoors), which I understand is common all over the island, but it's quite off-putting (as a non-smoker) to be inhaling smoke from the table over as you're trying to eat dinner. Overall it was a decent meal, one of the better meals we've had in Langkawi, but it fell short of being a culinary excite.Show less

Author: JLW78
Title: Perfect breakfast
Review: Great breakfast/ brunch in an oasis of calm. Atmosphere of local Malay with style.  Good coffee, smoothies, pancakes.  Friendly staff with good service.

Author: seraph11Melbourne, Australia
Title: Friendly and welcoming with well executed food
Review: My partner and I visited fatCUPID on our last night in Langkawi as he had a particular hankering for curry laksa. The restaurant is a smaller operation, a bit off the beaten path near Cenang. Don't be put off by the short walk off the main road, the food and the service is well worth it. We ate from the Asian portion of the menu, though there appeared to be a wide variety of Western food available as well. My partner and I shared the satay plate, a solid rendition, though I would have preferred a bit more char on the meat. He had the curry mee and I had the sambal udang. Both were well executed if lacking a little heat, tasty and generously portioned. I was particularly taken by the stirfried vegetables that accompanied my meal which seemed to include some unusual but delicious sprouts. I would classify the food as slightly gentrified but flavourful and well executed. High-end Nyonya!It happened to be one of the owners' birthday that night and they were generous enough to serve a slice of cake to all the diners. The staff were friendly and if anything, slightly overattentive since I'm a people watcher and the staff would sometimes think my rubber necking was a search for the attention of wait staff!A wonderful experience and one I would repeat on my return to Langkawi!Show less

Author: alang763Sydney, Australia
Title: Cupid's arrow hits the mark
Review: All the reviews have got it right. It is worth seeking out and do not be deterred by the pot holed laneway - the bumps are worth it. Bright light bruschetta, crisp melt in the mouth wontons and tasty pizza - and that was just the entree tasting plate. My assam fish and her salmon linguini were also spot on. Great place especially if you want to escape the grind of over charging boringly prepared hotel food. And the team is friendly, efficient and full of advice about the area. They have a small hotel as well, which is looking tempting next time we go :-) Show less

Author: OzzyTraveller101Adelaide, Australia
Title: Simply great good, friendly atmosphere, will be back
Review: Me and my wife, staying at the Andaman ate here based on the Tripadvisor reviews, we were not disappointed. The calamari salad was superb as were the sliders. Beef Rendang was the best I've had before, even better than what they serve up at the Andaman for double the price ! Highly recommend if you are in the area or have hired a car or scooter in search of great food.Show less

Author: BendyBonesManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Worth seeking out
Review: Lovely restaurant attached to La Pari-Pari accommodation. Not the easiest place to find, down a side lane filled with pot-holes, but worth the effort. The staff are friendly. The decor is minimalistic, giving off a relaxing vibe. The background (French themed?) music added to the ambience. My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our 3 course evening meal with a few drinks. Definitely value for money and would recommend a visit. Show less

Author: foongailiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for food
Review: During our last four days stay in Langkawi, we ate their twice. First time for tea, we had nice appetizer, the wontons are very delicious and bruchetta is hot and tasty. The second time, we had lunch there. The satay are soft and tasty, for spicy lover the laksa is really yummy. ($28). The breakfast set with sausage and egg is reasonable portion. The restaurant is located in a small corner away from the main road, need to check your Google to find it. Show less

Author: peitihenLoimaa, Finland
Title: Excellent place to dine
Review: In English:fatCupid is one of the best restaurants in Cenang/Tengah area. The food is really good, service is friendly and the environment has been built with taste. fatCUPID restaurant resides within La Pari-Pari hotel, which I might consider my next hotel in the area if the beach and a good pool would not be so important to us because of the children.We ordered NASI AYAM PONTAY and NYONYA CHICKEN CURRY from the list. Both dishes were really good and high quality, but our favorite among these two was NASI AYAM PONTAY.Suomeksi (in Finnish):fatCUPID on yksi parhaista ravintoloista Cenang/Tengah alueella. Ruoka on todella hyvää, palvelu on ystävällistä ja ympäristö on hyvällä maulla rakennettu. fatCUPID ravintola toimii La Pari-Pari hotellin tiloissa, jota Saattaisin harkita omaksi hotelliksi, jos uimaranta ja hyvä uima-allas ei olisi niin tärkeä lasten vuoksi.Päivälliseksi listalta valitsimme NASI AYAM PONTAY:n ja NYONYA CHICKEN CURRY:n. Molemmat annokset olivat todella hyvä ja laadukkaita, mutta suosikiksemme nousi NASI AYAM PONTAY.Show less

Author: srussell300uk
Title: A hidden gem
Review: We found fatCUPID on TripAdvisor and, as it was close to Villa Molek, where we were staying, we wandered down to have a look. Got a bit worried as we followed a rough road and then saw a somewhat dispossessing building ahead but, we got such a lovely welcome we carried on and so into the white-themed open-sided bar/dining area, with views out over a small pool, surrounded by grass, some chalet accommodation and trees. It was ok, but not amazing and we began to wonder if we would be better off in a beach restaurant with sea view ….But, we had a refreshing drink, studied the menu, chatted to the friendly staff, including the lady owner and booked to return that evening.The place is completely different at nighttime, beautifully lit and very charming. The service was perfectly judged and there was a nice atmosphere with good music.We started with salmon fishcakes and a pizza-style garlic bread with cheese and for mains we had Nasi Ayam Udang (type of slow-cooked chicken stew) and the succulent and flavourful Beef Rendang (beef/coconut stew) and all of it was delicious. We pushed the boat out with a decent bottle of red wine, served cool (which is something we like) and thoroughly enjoyed everything.Would agree with some other reviewers that fatCUPID is pricey, but we were glad we went back for dinner, we were bowled over with our choices and left feeling we had certainly had value for money for the whole experience. Wish we had had time to go back.Show less

Author: bavington186424
Title: Fab !
Review: Whilst staying at La Pari Pari for 5 nights we had breakfast every day here, a couple of lunches and four evening meals and they were all delicious !! Efficient,friendly service,reasonably priced wine,all in a delightful setting---wonderful!!

Author: 833duncanaSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Deeeeeeelicious
Review: There are many dining options on this island but fatCUPID was my favourite during a 6 day stay. The food and service was first class. If portion sizes were bigger than i would have given it a 5 rating, although didn't stop me returning there on two other occasions. A must try.Show less

Author: jonsm1thLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent cocktails, beautiful contemporary setting
Review: This place is a real find (caveat: I researched it online, you'd never stumble across this locale). Don't be put off by the uninspiring walk from the dusty road. When you arrive you're treated to polished concrete setting off an open airy room (all the Tripadvisor reviews make it look like its enclosed, it isn't). Like a little part of cool Sydney (in a good way) in Malaysia. The food is high quality, and amply portioned.Great cocktails in a chic contemporary setting.Visited for lunch, if only I'd had more time, I'd have come back for dinner too. Alas, hometime beckons. I'll be back for a pomegranate paloma before you know it, mate.Show less

Author: sue ann G
Title: good food, great service & a lovely view of trees
Review: a great place for food and drinks especially when it's hot-hot-hot in langkawi. love - love the view of the trees.  will be back to try the rest of the menu.  service is great too.

Author: HotelTurnaround
Title: Brilliant restaurant
Review: I ate here twice as it was near to Frangipani where was I staying. The food is ace, the service is ace, the prices are good for what you get. Do not miss out, visit this restaurant. Call in advance during busy periods.

Author: letiaranda
Title: Food for heart and soul
Review: Very cute place offering a great choice of delicious home-made food. Staff was super friendly and welcoming. I will definitely recommend it to anyone.

Author: justaname10Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent service, good place to chill out
Review: Been there two times. Like the designed, everything is white. Like the music, sometimes Jazz, sometimes pop. Like the small swimming pool, if you are patron you could ask the staff whether they allow you to swim or not. Sometimes the weather in Langkawi is really hot, you would feel like you wanted to a cold beer and a swim.. Highly recommend this place to chill out with friend or alone. The food and drink also reasonable price..Show less

Author: Elly LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food
Review: I just have breakfast here since I stayed here for 2 nights. The breakfast was simple yet nice. We did ordered some scramble eggs on top of the complimentary breakfast. It is a bit overpriced but I would said it is worth it too. Well we did not manage to try other food but we will when we visit Langkawi again.Show less

Author: bigmanronLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice meal and location
Review: Treated ourselves to a meal here on valentines. Expensive for backpackers, but still very cheap in the grand scheme of things when compared to home. Food was really nice, service was friendly and the place is really nice at night. Cool, open, and near a lit pool, and quiet.Show less

Author: BilledithBudapest
Title: Extremely overpriced good food.
Review: Great food in a nice setting. The only problem is that it is extremely expensive. We had a great bowl of laksa that cost 28 Rm, across Malaysia, even in tourist areas you can expect to pay 3-6 Rm for the same thing. Their location is slightly off the beaten track and they have a guest house there. I Show less

Author: Pgruppo
Title: Good food and ambiance
Review: The restaurant was simple but well decorated at the same time.  The food was quite good.  We had the beef rendang, app sampler and steak sandwich.  Friendly staff.  Located by a quaint boutique hotel.

Author: GeochongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Food and service with a passion
Review: We went on a Saturday night 8 pm. It was full. Sat down to order. My wife had a cough and the host suggested a hot honey lemon drink which was not in the menu. Food took a little longer as it was full house but the patience paid off with excellent food. I ordered a grilled barramundi which came with an excellent white sauce with capers. Daughter loved the white sauce and we asked for more which the restaurant obliged. Such passion to serve for which we appreciate. The price is on the high side but what we pay is for the service, ambiance and quality of food. There were more foreigners there who appreciate and are willing to pay for such fine dining, something the Malaysians are not quite there as yet. Show less

Author: leila1011Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super food
Review: My compliments to chef Keith. We had breakfast. Mine was scrambled eggs, mash potatoes, beans, toast and vegetables - sounds simple, but it was unimaginably tasty. My friend has similar except with sausages, and she said the same of hers. Later we each had salmon pasta, and nyonya laksa. One western and the other local noodles, but we both were completely sated and satisfied, in body and in soul. An excellent restaurant, and highly recommended.Show less

Author: Lulu S
Title: Best resturant in langkawi
Review:
We orderd 
Beef burger 
And chicken sandwitch
The burger was faboluse 
And the frensh frize was yummy
I will  visit again for sure

Author: lyana_witchKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great café food with a marvellous view
Review: I had the chance to drop by Langkawi for a day and was invited to join a meet up of old friends at the fatCUPID. The taxi driver who brought us there complained about the road to get into the place, but once we arrived- I understand the beauty behind such a hidden alcove. Located within the compounds of a boutique hotel LaPariPari, the scenery from the the open concept café was just breathtaking. I have to admit as a Malaysian, my heart was already sold to the place as we were greeted by a placard remembering MH370 in the garden at the front entrance. But to be having lunch in the breeze and the sun, facing a beautiful pool and the compounds littered with day beds shaded by trees, was just, beautiful. But let's talk about the food. I had the tofu and mushroom burger, which came served on a wooden board with fries. The burger was succulent as a vegetarian burger, with fluffy sesame seed topped buns and salad. From the first bite, it was yummy and definitely a hearty vegetarian meal. I also had my eyes on the tempe rendang on the menu- and would give that a try when I next visit!! My friend had the nyonya curry chicken with rice, and another friend had a breakfast set, with a special request for white eggs omelette. We were all satisfied with each of our dishes. I also had the espresso martini- which flavours were uniquely intensified by the barista's use of gula melaka! A must try, if I have to say so. But I had cocktail envy when my friend ordered the house specialty- a mixture of shiraz and blueberry and other goodies. It was such a refreshing drink and felt so good when I stole a few sips; perfect for a hot day in Langkawi. We finished our meal by sharing the peanut butter ice-cream brownie dessert. After such a hearty lunch, the usually unpopular decision of sharing desserts was the right thing to do- we couldn't finish the dessert but not for the lack of taste! It was yummy and definitely a must-try for fans of peanut butter and chocolate. I have to say that I am looking forward for future visits to try many other dishes! We lazed around on the day beds and even had a dip in the pool post lunch. A place where I will return to when I next return to Langkawi!Show less

Author: ReedRoverManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food.
Review: You have a wide choice of eating places around Langkawi but do youself a favour and try this one its attached to La Pari Pari guesthouse at Pantai Tengah and its worth looking for.Great home cooked food but with a modern twist and in a nice location, it's also spotlessly clean. It's rated the number one restaurant in the area and lives up to the billing, talking of billing the prices are also very reasonable and won't break the bank. We enjoyed the food better than La Sal at Casa Del Mar further up the road and the service was also better.Show less

Author: willb16
Title: Great restaurant and staff!
Review: Had a brilliant meal here, the food was amazing with a varied menu to suit most. The location is quiet and set next to a pool. Cocktails were great and overall bill was about 200MYR for two people with 6 drinks and 3 courses. Amazing.

Author: Cjs5891Scotland
Title: amazing restaurant
Review: This restaurant deserves a great review - the food was delicious, the surroundings are beautiful with the pool as the backdrop and the service was among the best in Langkawi - friendly, attentive and professional. The music is also brilliant and a welcome change to the outdated music you usually hear around Asia! The staff even gave us a lift home after our meal which was above and beyond anything they had to do.Don't miss it on your trip.Show less

Author: wendy494Chelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: 5 star
Review: 5 star review for 5 star service & food Great atmosphere even though there was only about 10 people in this place. Coming and going all the time. G&T and JD & coke cold and good.I then had 2 glasses of slightly chilled pinot noir in a lovely glass that made all the difference to the drinking experience- also great We had wantons (we were told grandmas recipe - lots of family recipes on the menu) and king prawn in batter with honey dipping sauce - both served beautifully - tasty!Husband had red snapper in lemon sauce - light and very tasty. Green vegetables made a lovely change to rice. I had laksa which was huge & filling (family recipe again)We finished off with mango chess cake to share Fab evening watching the geckos run about and also met the resident frog - FreddieDo try it - total bill was 269MRShow less

Author: Sdearbrogers
Title: Great food lovely people
Review: We had some amazing Malaysian and Western food here.  Beautiful restaurant and great cocktails!  The fresh juices were delicious, the service was great, and the staff were all really friendly.

Author: Lindalou022Parksville, Canada
Title: The best.
Review: Loved having a proper size red wine glass, loved the steak sandwich, the smiling service, the fact that they provided citronella candles to get rid of the mosquitoes. I also loved the French music, the entire ambiance and atmosphere. I could take as long as I wanted and it felt so relaxing! It's a popular restaurant for a very good reason.....Show less

Author: ninoamigo
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: If you are staying around Pantai Chenang, Langkawi, come here for the breakfast and meals. Definitely a good experience.

Author: jan o
Title: Spectacular food!
Review: Beautiful food and coffee in a lovely, private environment. Loved hanging out here with the relaxed and friendly staff

Author: charlotte m
Title: Value for money
Review: Lovely secluded restaurant in beautiful quiet surroundings.great value for money and you feel you are out for the night.so clean and friendly staff.much better than usual street restaurants and for same price.

Author: Cholly66Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food enjoyed by all
Review: FatCupid oozes a bit of class with a cool and laid back atmosphere in boutique style surroundings. Somewhat difficult to get to as side roads full of pot holes but definitely worth the effort. The place was half full when we were there (In the early evening) with both the bar area and dining tables occupied. Friendly staff buzzed around attentively. The appetisers tasted great, as did the mains. The beef rendang curry and salmon fillet dshes were particular standouts, both of which were accompanied by a wonderful warm Asian pea shoot salad. If you want something special in both food and ambiance then this place delivers. Would certainly recommend if seeking to impress.Show less

Author: CecilSingaporeSingapre
Title: fatCUPID A Delicious Treat on the Expensive Side
Review: We ordered Ginger Tea 1 10rm. Watermelon daiquiri 2 38rm. Lemon Grass Fuzzy 1 13rm. Fresh Apple Juice 1 13rm. 1 punch 19rm. Margarita 1 22rm. Mini Sliders 1 23rm. Lamb Shank Pie 1 28rm. Barracuda 2 pcs 40rm. Mackerel Assam Pedas 1 45rm. Sambal Udang 1 27rm.Heavenly Sago 1 14rm. Brownie cake 1 15rm. All tasty and nice but expensive in my opinion. Show less

Author: TheLoganFulcherTokyo
Title: GOD'S FOOD
Review: This was the best food I ate in Malaysia, and my biggest regret is going back on the one day they were closed. The chef is not a chef, he is an artist, and if you go, you will be lucky enough to partake in beautiful food. The sliders were the best I've had in my entire life, and the Nyonya Laksa was something that God would be the first thing that it would eat if God came to Langkawi. If you don't go to this restaurant, you're missing some of the best food on the planet. The prices aren't your streetfare prices, but it's not expensive (by Japanese standards,) and it's worth every Ringgit. Show less

Author: kaos169Sydney
Title: Bit tricky to find - make the effort - It's great!!
Review: This place was recommended to us by an ex-Pat who lived on Langkawi. It is a bit tricky to find - down a dirt driveway off the main Tengai Road - but once you get there, it's like a little oasis. Great setting and fantastic food. Every dish we ordered came out beautifully presented and was delicious. Unfortunately we only went there on our last night - otherwise we would've been back to eat more often.Show less

Author: PCASquad
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Lovely littl place with a calming and clean atmosphere. Friendly staff that spoke english very well, we felt welcome. The food was good comparing to other places in Langkawi but couls improve even more to be really tasty. Good place though! Recommend it!

Author: Bumblecath
Title: We enjoyed our lunch
Review: Good food and service. We had both Malaysian and western food. The restaurant  lacks a bit of atmospehere, somewhat sterile.

Author: JohannaEmmaSofia
Title: Good food and service
Review: Vegetarian - go for the tempeh. And try the yummy sago dessert. Watching the geckos climbing the walls and ceilings is great pastime :)

Author: SailendraKuching, Malaysia
Title: Bad service
Review: Poor wrongly prioritised service. I was really surprised that their restaurant would suggest that we would have to wait an hour for toast and tea as their restaurant was full with orders pending. This is especially so as the request was clearly made for someone who was ill plus it was for a simple toast and tea.Show less

Author: Thomas Y
Title: Highly Recommended
Review: Excellent place with great ambience. The food was great. Very friendly owner with noble values, championing the cause for autistic children. Take some time to chat with him. His life stories will inspire you. They hv surely inspired me. The food definitely "inspired" me too. The nyonya laksa and fatcupid salad are my personal favourites. Oh ya... throw in a watermelon lychee freezie too. Great thirst quencher on a hot island afternoon.Show less

Author: 813mayaaDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Exquisite food
Review: We went to fatcupid because of how good it was rated on tripadvisor. The restaurant is hard to find if you're exploring the city on your own. It's pretty secluded but that's what I loved about it. The welcome was extremely warm, we were seated immediately. The menu has multiple choices. We ordered the appetizer platter which was terrific. One of the best bruschettas I've had so far. I had the chicken curry which was a bit too spicy for me but was delicious. Desert was amazing, don't miss out on that brownie!One piece of advice of u hate bugs like i do, don't order flat drinks, i struggled with my daiquiri. If u don't mind, it's very refreshing :)Show less

Author: Elaine308272Shanghai, China
Title: Nice food and ambience
Review: We walked in on Christmas night without a reservation but were quickly seated. The menu is extensive and a good mix of western and Malaysian food. We shared salads to begin with and both the pumpkin and mango salad and the greens with apple and nuts were lovely and were good sized servings. Most of us had local dishes as mains and everything was tasty. We hope to eat here again while we're here. Show less

Author: mercutio1982Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Fantastic!
Review: The starter platter was large and delicious; the lemon butter snapper was grilled to perfection. We had 3 desserts between the three of us (cheesecake, ice cream/brownie and the sago), all delicious. The white wine was perfectly chilled. All in all, a fantastic experience. The espresso at the end of the meal didn't quite live up to the expectation.One of the highlight meals we've had in Malaysia.Show less

Author: Laurence S
Title: Overrated
Review: Just eaten here. First impressions not good.Waiting for a table only to be hijacked by some unruly people who walked on behind us and sat down where we were going to. The staff just said we don't have a table if you would like to wait. No table control first off. Staff were glum at best. Thought it was going to be a great experience eating in at the first rated on Ta. Not so.Food was ok. Different but ok.Ate down the road twice at another restaurant and that was half the money and twice as good.Always busy it seems so try to pre book if you must.Show less

Author: norhaidaa
Title: Nice folks but mediocre food
Review:
We only visited this restaurant because of its rating in TripAdvisor.
The restaurant was empty when we arrived and we were greeted by a friendly hostess. We thought the food was mediocre, and slightly overpriced. I found hair in my salad. Sigh.

Author: Jean-MarcSGourdan-Polignan, France
Title: Nice and good
Review: We had dinner here following TA ratings and comments and were pretty satisfied. The place is neat and clear with an all white painted terrasse. We did not stayed there but somehow regretted it. The menu is various with Asian and western choices and service is excellent. We hope to get back before leaving Langkawi Show less

Author: dean0bennett0
Title: Great food at great value
Review: i am glad we use TA to help us find this restaurant for dinner, it is a little off the beaten track..but worth looking for, the seafood was great as was everything we tried topped off with great, friendly service

Author: Amanda WUnited Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant tucked away in garden setting
Review: We found Fat Cupid in Pantai Tengah by chance and we're very glad we did! It is tucked away off the main road through the village at a dead end in gardens. The food was Asian/Western fusion, the service was great, the wine list short but also very good, and the surroundings stylish in white under an open sided canopy. We thought our 2 meals there were very good value for money - around GBP 60 for 3 people including 2 courses and a nice bottle of wine. We tried both the nonya dishes and the fish main courses - all were very well presented, well cooked and full of flavour. Definitely worth seeking this one out if you're in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Marleen31
Title: Delicious place!
Review: We've had the nasi and the rendang. Very good! Also the desserts were very lovely. Nice people. We were there at lunchtime. Evening is even a better ambiance!

Author: dbottomleyUK
Title: Delicious food, great atmosphere
Review: Dinner here last night was delicious and memorable. Wandered down the road from our hotel and managed to get a table without booking, though it was quite busy. They have a specials board, and we chose chili prawns from here that were huge, succulent and tasty. I then had the Malay chicken curry, and my partner the beef rendang, both well present and full of flavour.
