So pleased that we had room for dessert - my brownie/ peanut butter ice cream sandwich was wonderful ! The staff are attentive, friendly and fun, the setting is lovely. I wouldn't hesitate to go back.Show less

Author: HelenRoseCfBT
Title: Good food and great ambience
Review: We had 2 meals at this chic and trendy restaurant and it was excellent! We highly recommend to travelers who  visit Langkawi.

Author: donrking66Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 5 Star Food And Service
Review: After reading reviews about this restaurant, we decided to give a try before leaving Langkawi. And man.......it was divine!!! It is everything it reviewed to be. From the food to it's service. Delicious, even worth the wait (as it very busy during the time we were there). The service, wonderful as the manager and one of it's boss, were from a long line of service industry. they ensure that the delay in your food are always updated to you and they were never short of apologies for the delay.My only regret is that we were not able to go for a second round of food debauchery as they were closed on our last day on the island. Try everything........the starters, the mains and their fabulous deserts. Writing this article, made me salivating again. Trust me, when it comes to food I am seldom wrong, if you see the pics that I have uploaded with this article. The food and drinks at fatCupid are made with tender loving care and patience, so that every order comes out the exact same delicious way. No regrets there!!!Show less

Author: LpasciHawthorn, Australia
Title: Must visit
Review: Randomly found this place. Lovely setting and looked like a really nice place to stay. We stayed for dinner and had a delicious rendang, wontons and curry. All yummy and all very light. We even had room for dessert- get the sago! Staff were lovely and clearly understand good food. Everything was simple but delicious.Being from Melbourne this place felt like we could've been at the new hip place back home. Just remember the repellant for mozzies they're all over the island. Other than that though would highly recommend this place!Show less

Author: Linda196426Melbourne, Australia
Title: Superb food and excellent service
Review: Decided to try the Fat Cupid after the great reviews here. It did not disappoint. Had a beautiful tasty meal which was delivered without delay.The staff were very attentive and the owner lovely.The restaurant is setback off the main road down the end of a dirt road. It is very quiet and a lively setting. Show less

Author: Fernando G
Title: The friendliest restaurant we went to.
Review:
Liked: the clean, modern, fresh styling to its design.
Liked: the friendliest (genuinely friendly) staff and professionalism. 
Liked: delicious food and great variety: Malay, Western.
Disliked: the fact I only went once.

Author: 303jims
Title: Excellent Restaurant
Review: This is well worth a short walk. On the land side of the main beach road. Down a side street. Very nice white decor. Good wine. Not expensive. Good service. Interesting menu. Good cooking. Excellent staff. Quiet. Relaxing. Cocktails.......

Author: 564marcuswAdelaide, Australia
Title: Happy customer
Review: This place has some pretty average decor but don't be fooled. The food was delightful and the service was great. We had the special lamb shank pie and sliders and both were delicious although one of our pies was forgotten but in return they gave it to us for FREE so it redeemed them. The mains were also excellent. We ordered the garlic prawns pasta, the laksa, and steak sandwich. This place was certainly a highlight of our visit and should be one of yours tooShow less

Author: kalle_sundholmStockholm, Sweden
Title: Hardest to find but most worth the effort
Review: The by far hardest to find, but by far the best in taste! We had a nice family dinner at the place and everyone was amazed on how well the small kitchen managed to deliver. The restaurant is not much of design, but never mind. Try the Barracuda - it was great.Show less

Author: omare781Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt
Title: Style. Amazing atmosphere
Review: This is a wonderful place and the best ive been in Malaysia. Taste, stylish, design, attention to details : beauty. If you are an esthete this is the place to be in Langkawi. Feels like you re in the garden of Eden, with a nice blueish pool in the middle. Food is tasty, well presented and creative ( I loved the Barracuda dish). The cocktails are the best in the whole island, made with lemongrass or passion fruit taken from their garden. Staff is friendly and attentive, putting guest satisfaction first on their priority . Chill, deep house and cafe del mar-ish vibes are the perfect soundtrack for this type of setting (in the rest of the island it seems they only know 80' s rock and poppish stuff - terrible - im not a biker). After eating at fatCUPID me and my wife immediately booked a room at their hotel, La Pari Pari. The owner also has a bar on the beach called SUGAR, wich is the best beach bar in whole Langkawi, the only that can creat a chilled vibe, but sophisticated, atmosphere . Open minded and friendly environment....To put it simply: if you like beautiful things , La Pari Pari, fatCUPID and SUGAR are the only place you should go in Langkawi.Show less

Author: sbrock666Kandel, Germany
Title: Really fantastic Food!
Review: Only the Road to this wonderful Restaurant in the dark, after a heavy Rain, was a tiny adventure, so we couldn't see the potholes.But for this great Food, an afterward a nice Cocktail it is more than worth to visit Jacky and her staff.Regards from my side.Show less

Author: winniebebington
Title: Good choice of local and western food
Review: Breakfast great - lunch/diner menu was delicious malay food was like the menu said was like grannies the western food was also cooked and tasted excellent. Well worth a visit with a very pleasant bar overlooking the pool and gardens very romantic setting.

Author: mingst3r
Title: Coffee and desserts yumzzzz!
Review: Nice and relaxing place to have coffee and desserts! The lemon tart is a must order, seriously good!!! But it's on special only, so ask the waiter before hand. Coffee is pretty good as well. Ordered the flat white and ice coffee :)

Author: irisakbarSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing food, romantic ambience & great people!
Review: We visited fatCUPID after reading the fantastic reviews on tripadvisor, and we were not disappointed! :) the tempeh rendang was the best I'd ever eaten, and my partner agreed that the prawn aglio olio was the best ever (and she eats prawn aglio olio everywhere we go)! The owner, Jacky, was so friendly and accommodating that she made us feel right at home. The restaurant has a romantic feel, and it's great for couples and families! You can even relax by the pool after your meal as fatCUPID and La Pari Pari resort are partners in business. Oh, and Jacky helped us book a cab back to the airport as well. Thank you so much for the hospitality! We will visit again next year just because it's THAT good.Show less

Author: 403stefans
Title: Amazing
Review: Definitely one of the best places we ate. Had food and cocktails on the night and came back 2 days later for breakfast which was also stunning. Owner was very nice and gave me some advice on an oil for my insect bites which worked a treat. Thankyou for a great visit. Definitely a must in Langkawi. Show less

Author: Pete L
Title: Great food, lovely people
Review: Gorgeous little find. Great food in a garden setting, with the friendliest staff in Langkawi! Just off the main road, down from the beach - rooms to rent looked lovely too :)

Author: 479eileendWilmslow, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, friendly service, lovely setting
Review: Can't fault the Fat Cupid - set back off try Main Street down a bumpy track and set in lovely gardens next to white cottages and a pretty swimming pool. Chilled tracks provide a relaxed vibe in this clean and well run restaurant. The owner Jackie was the perfect host, taking time to explain the food, share a quick conversation and check back at intervals to see if everything was okay. I had a couple of salads and the vegetarian rendang. All really tasty, in particular the latter. The lemon ice tea was great too. I highly recommend this place and no doubt the sister restaurant Sugar right on the beach has the same high standards if the Fat Cupid is anything to go by.Show less

Author: tcmengg
Title: overated
Review: very good food but way too expensive.  The service is quite slow but it is worth waiting. Unfortunately we left with a half fool stomach:(

Author: lua8050Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Amazing spot
Review: We loved the location, surrounded by nature, in front of the swimming pool. Also, the decoration is nice and makes you feel comfortable. We followed the trip advisor comments and they were right. Even though this is not a cheap restaurant and the menu is quite simple, I 100% recommend this place Show less

Author: A5764LNgregsAdelaide, Australia
Title: Doesn't Disappoint, excellent food and service
Review: Last time we were in Langkawi we couldn't find this place, so this time we were determined, studying the maps and getting details from staff at the Danna. We found it, yay! It was worth the journey, despite the rain turning the road into a bit of a quagmire. The venue is open on 3 sides and in the back-blocks of Tengah Beach. The food is great, the Aussie Chardonnay price was less than we pay back home. I had their traditional chicken curry laksa, my wife the sliders. The food was dvine, the staff and atmosphere was great. It is worth hunting around in the Tengah burbs to find this little gem.Show less

Author: foodiedeb
Title: Another great find
Review: A warm welcome & great atmosphere.  Friendly, happy staff. Had the sliders - so yummy! Highly recommend it. Will be back 👍

Author: B00yah2013Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Food, Lovely Cocktails, bit hard to find
Review: Yum yum yum. We went there as a family and had really high quality food and great cocktails. Whilst a bit hard to find (they mentioned it was hard to get approvals for additional signage done quickly) it was definitely worth the hunt. The staff were also very friendly and hospitable. Would recommend this lovely restaurant to any visitors whether couples, families etc. and they also offer accommodation in the same place.Show less

Author: Kimbo225Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Excellent food, great service and lovely atmosphere
Review: Fat Cupid has a range of delicious meals for breakfast, lunch or dinner. I was lucky enough to be in Langkawi for a week so I got to sample quite a bit of the menu. There is a great blend of traditional and contemporary dishes. There is also a good selection of cocktails and the wine is reasonably priced.Did I mention there is a swimming pool and lounge chairs too? (for lazy afternoons) - and yes, they will let you use the pool if you pop in for lunch.Show less

Author: JaqlynHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Great food, away from the hustle
Review: Luckily I looked up trip advisor on my last night on the island and Fat cupid was rated number 1. It was only an 8 minute walk from our hotel, was a little tricky to find but worth the walk. Very quiet night as it is the low season but our meal and wine were really lovely. I had the mushroom burger which was truly delicious and a special honey prawn starter that was equally good. If you are a fan of tasty good food and are tired of the main strip of shops and food then definitely head for a night at Fat cupid!Show less

Author: lindsay JMonroe, Wisconsin
Title: Chill spot for excellent cocktails or a date
Review: Lovely, chill atmosphere. Slightly hidden down a side road, away from the beach. The place seems to be attached to a nice hotel, situated right near the pool. I bet they'd let you use the pool if you dine there? Went for cocktails (excellent) and appetizers (we got the sampler platter which was enough for 2 people). Romantic atmosphere is perfect for couples (in fact there were only couples when we were there). Extremely friendly staff and good service. No wifi...Show less

Author: Vincent_TanesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food Nice Environment Nice Service
Review: FatCupid has all the elements that a Good restaurant should have, good food, good environment with very good service!One dish that we were hesitating to order, Fried Wanton, was now the dish that would remind us of FatCupid now. Tasty and crunchy! Overall the food are all delicious! Although we are paying sort of KL price point for the food but we felt worth it for such a nice cafe.Will also consider staying in La Pari-Pari too during our next visit (beside the restaurant)Show less

Author: ruuurdZutphen, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious!
Review: Well, I don't think I can add some extra info to all the positive reviews/feedback people have given before me! It's all true; this place is awesome! Delicious food, kind people and a silent place just of the main road. We'll definitely return to this place!Show less

Author: 889pantear
Title: Beauty corner..good food
Review: Peaceful neat place for couples to enjoy the food. Very friendly staff. Food quality is good .. u can get good variety as well.

Author: FabioS620Malaga, Spain
Title: A must visit placw if you are in Langkawi!!
Review: We have been here yesterday looking at the really good reviews and I must admit everything was true.We took a sharing plate of starter and it was a mixed of italian and asian food - delicious and the portion was huge! Then we took a main each I went for a typical malesian plate and my girlfriend as well. It was delicoious! If I need to find something I didn't like I would say my lemongrass mojito was good but I didn't like all the pieces of lemon grass in my mouth while I was drinking. The service was exellent and quick - they also called a taxi for us. As for the title overall a must visit place in Langkawi!Show less

Author: CerbyWong
Title: Fantastic Food
Review: Best food i ever had in Langkawi, from local to international cuisine, everything is fantastic, especially that the chef can really do a good rare wagyu steak. Even in KL also cannot compete, good cut with great chef.

Author: jazzie161
Title: Try the Nonya Laksa
Review: The restaurant serves great food and freezies! They even cooked special dishes on request for our 9 year old.

Author: FemkeQBreda
Title: Hidden gem in Pantai Tengah
Review: We went to the fatCUPID three times during our stay in Langkawi, even though we where staying at Pentai Cenang it was definitely worth the drive! The restaurant has a special ibiza like vibe over it. The food is great and the owner and staff are very friendly and welcoming. It immediately feels like home! We went here to have breakfast at a very rainy day, and the staff came with lots of idea's what we could do that day, very helpful thank you! We had breakfast, lunch and dinner and everything was great. The fresh juices are amazing you should try them! In the evening there is a great ambiance, the restaurant is overlooking the pool with candle lights everywhere.If we ever come back to Langkawi, this is where we would stay!Show less

Author: GregC170Surry Hills, Australia
Title: Great little find!
Review: My wife and I went to fatcupid a couple of nights ago. As it says in the other reviews, it's a bit hard to find so make sure your cab driver knows where he's going! It's definitely worth the effort. Jackie, one of the owners, looked after us and we had a great meal, wine and conversation with her. We had wontons, the sliders and grandmas chicken curry. All were amazing as was the wine. Jackie told us they have another restaurant on the beach (Sugar) and we will definitely be checking that out before we leave.Show less

Author: Taniae WMelbourne, Australia
Title: Must visit
Review: We dined at fatCUPID in early September during a quiet period and lucky us, we had the restaurant to ourselves! I recommend the calamari salad, tasted exactly like something I could get at home! If you're australian and a bit home sick, then I definitely recommend this dish! The banana milkshake was probably one of the best milkshakes I've had ever. Very thick and I think they use real bananas, not just the syrup. We spent a good 40 minutes talking to the owners, Jeremy I think his name is, and it was so refreshing talking to someone from home who's been living on the island for a while! He even recommended places for us to stay/see/do in Kuala Lumper and Singapore (where we were going next) which was so helpful, thank you! A must visit if you are staying in Langkawi.Show less

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: First Rate Fatty
Review: This is a lovely quiet, delightful location just off the main road at Pantai Tengah. You'll have to search to find it ........ but do that, you will be well rewarded.Lovely setting on the edge of the jungle, lovely calm atmosphere, delightful staff who are welcoming warm and efficient all at the same time. An interesting and quite long menu from breakfasts through brunch, lunch and then dinner. We had salads, the starters tasting plate, chicken, vegetarian burgers, chips - all very good and beautifully served. It is a delight to sit, chat, drink in the atmosphere and the savour the food.fatCUPID - gets a big fat excellent. We are all so pleased that it was recommended to us.Show less

Author: John C
Title: Excellant food & service
Review: There were NO dislikes as everyone did their upmost to ensure the meals were excellent and the service wonderful

Author: RitaSaade
Title: Simply Amazing
Review:
The staff, the place, the ambiance, the food.
I loved the place, it is cosy and lovely.
The staff is so nice and dedicated.
The food was just perfect.
Definitely recommended.

Author: DarylLauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Atmospheric Setting with Great Tasty Food!
Review: Firstly.. this lovely restaurant is quite hidden and took us quite a while to find it. So glad we kept trying cause it was THE best meal we had in our Langkawi trip by a mile. The service is sincerely attentive, warm and friendly make it that much more memorable. Couple that with the serene environment makes this a must visit when traveling to Langkawi.So how about the food itself? One word... YUMMY! I shall let the photos I am attaching do most of the talking. Can't wait to go back to try the other stuff on their menu especially the deserts.To make finding the place easier, just turn into the alley once you see their signboard and travel all the way in and I do mean all the way till you see a white single story house with the signboard "La Pari Pari" and "FatCupid".Show less

Author: Doug KHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Lovely setting, lovely staff
Review: A little off the beaten track (about 70 meters to be precise) and definitely worth a visit. The atmosphere was fantastic, and the staff were very friendly and accommodating, offering advice on the menu and genuinely interested in what we had to say about the restaurant and our time in Malaysia. The food was amazing, and offered a chance to try some traditional Malaysian food for my vegetarian girlfriend which she was delighted about. Special mention should definitely go to the cocktails, which were only 18 ringgits, and were the best we had in our entire journey around Malaysia.Show less

Author: Ping2013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Heartwarming Restaurant
Review: Drop by the restaurant on my last day in Langkawi, and when I went it, I was greeted by friendly owners/staff of the restaurant. Delightful ambiance and the food was great. Ohh the fish and chip was really good! The owner was really friendly as well and you could feel the sincerity from the way they treat their customer. It's this kind of heartwarming restaurant that makes you stand out amongst others.Keep it up with the great job!Show less

Author: penangowlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Charming little restaurant
Review: Slightly off the beaten tracks, we found this charming little restaurant. The waiters were pleasant and kept a friendly face even though we were a noisy group with four very young children.Although it was outdoor, we have no problem with the mozzies as the staff were well prepared with the mosquito repellent under the tables and around the restaurant before it turned dark.The western food was good while the local selection was decent too. There was a decent selection of wine and drinks too but the mark up of alcoholic drinks is a bit on the high side.Show less

Author: Sebastian O
Title: Hidden gem indeed
Review: Google map brought me through dark alleys at night but I found it! to make it easier to find, i'd suggest putting "La Pari Pari" into your GPS. The food was great and the staffs are exceptionally friendly! Great place to go if you are looking for a quiet dinner and is wiling to pay for what it's worth. The best part is they don't include service or government tax in the bill!Show less

Author: Michał LDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent hidden place
Review: Unfortunately we found this place in our last day. It's hidden but taxi driver knows the way. You need to walk 100m from the main road. The restaurant have a spanish style. The service is awesome, the waiter was very nice. The food was very delicious (we tried fish, burger and pizza). The portion are huge. You need to try this restaurant !Show less

Author: Cynthia CSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Bit of a Hidden Gem
Review: The menu ranges from western favorites to local delights. Best won-ton appetizer with homemade filling. Local dishes are the feature and delicious! Great, attentive staff too! The restaurant sits well back from the main road in town - not so easy to find. Once there it's a nice quiet spot though a bit lacking in atmosphere.Show less

Author: Redfella83Reading, United Kingdom
Title: Nice setting off the beach front to relax.
Review: Had dinner here this week and for the most part enjoyed it. The menu is creative with lots of choice of both local and western dishes.Cocktails were excellent and again the list was creative. Service was super friendly though perhaps a little slow towards the end of the night (we waited about 15mins tone asked if we wanted dessert).Portions of local dishes could maybe be a little bigger though the western food portions were ample.Overall is a bit different compared to what else is on offer I. The area and I would go back if i was in Langkawi again.Show less

Author: splorerkiwiSingapore
Title: Delicious food, lovely setting & great value
Review: Fatcupid is a real find & well worth seeking out. The service was friendly and the food fast and fantastic. Mum and I were only in langkawi for 2 nights and wish we were staying longer so we could have another round of satay and nonya chicken curry! Also check out Sugar, on the beach, this is by the same owners and is a great place to catch the sunset with a cool drinkShow less

Author: Lindsey WManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous.....
Review: Excellent food,Super service,Beautiful location,Relaxing welcoming atmosphere....We loved this place and only wish we would have known about the hotel too-it looks wonderful.After reading the information at the front desk regarding how they set up the business I now love these people even more-great job guys-you've nailed it just perfectly-)Best of luck for your continued success.....Manchester, UK.Show less

Author: Alisgenni
Title: Amazing
Review: One of the best dinners of my life, amazing ambience and music, supe friendly staff and stunning food, everything for very good value for money. Perfect, just like the La Pari-Pari resort, where the restaurant is located.

Author: AussieAbroad011Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food and such lovely personal service.
Review: We were recommended fatCUPID by the lovely staff at Sugar and it definitely didn't disappoint! fatCUPID is located in the La Pari-Pari guest house, a gorgeous and new boutique hotel. La Pari-Pari was very clean, isolated enough to be quiet but a short walk from the action near the beach. We were shown around an unbooked room because we're interested in staying there next time and they were very clean and comfortable looking. There's 12 rooms so it's nice and quiet. The staff at fatCUPID are incredibly friendly and offered personal service. We almost felt like we were having dinner at a friends house! The food was amazing and great value for the standard. I think the food is worth twice the price that fatCUPID is charging. Couple that with a gorgeous location, scenic view and great service and it's the best value you'll find in Langkawi. To find fatCUPID it's just next to a 2 storey café type place called Sun ...something. We missed the sign the first time but luckily found it the second time. It's down a little side street/alley way about 100 or so metres off the road. Our visit was so good we went for dinner but were too full for dessert so we walked around the markets and returned for dessert later haha You don't be disappointed.Show less

Author: CyndanaiPenang
Title: Not Worth
Review: We had dinner there n while the service was polite n warm, the food quality was poor - my lamb was over salted n texture was mushy, the baracuda had quite a few tiny bones in it n when I complaint to the server, I was told such fish don't have bones n I had to show her the bones. I did not even receive an apology which I felt should have adequately improved my mood. I was also not asked how I prefer my meats which was too underdone to my preference. There were a lot of mosquitoes n our family were not comfortable. We got out of there as soon as possible n felt that the food was really not worth what we paid for.Show less

Author: bigeckscot
Title: Excellent lunch
Review: Food was very good, I had beef rendang, my wife the Thai beef salad, both excellent. Very good atmosphere, service terrific , we both thoroughly enjoyed it. Recommend highly.

Author: 731catherinecAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Delicious!
Review: What a brilliant choice it was to venture to fatCUPID this evening! fatCUPID is located at Pari Pari Villa's, tucked away down what has to be described as a very rumpty drive way, but do not be put off.We had booked (not necessary this evening) and were warmly welcomed and seated in this delightful open air yet cosy eatery.The wine list is not at all extensive yet large enough for ample choice. We started with a very freshly made wonton entree.We wanted to eat some good 'local' food and on recommendation I chose the chicken curry and my good man, the beef rending. We were not disappointed! Delightfully presented and delicious taste sensations!FatCUPID offers enthusiastic and personal service and delicious food in a quiet setting. Well done!Highly recommended! Show less

Author: Cristopher S
Title: Enjoyable and good atmosphere
Review: All the food was good, and really pleasant atmosphere and decoration.The service was very polite and the manager was alway smiling and brought a good mood. Ask her for advice and she will give you an amazing delight, have to say she has very good taste.Good appetizers, and very original cooking. The burger with egg was a very original pice but I have to say that the meat was not the best. All was great except for the meat, but anyway I was more than satisfied. I only go to the top and this is certainly one. Show less

Author: CrisSpagnaShanghai
Title: Good service l, and good original food
Review: They have a very good atmosphere apart from all the mosquitoes.The service is really good and the manager seems really interested in the client which is very good.The food is not very satisfying I have to say but they have some of the best appetizers I ever tried. Ask the manager for suggestions and you will be very happy. Show less

Author: thinkingdonutPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Quaint & Cozy
Review: Upon entering the cozy dining space, you immediately feel like you are on holiday - the music, the cozy feel of the place and the general warm tea lights against the white decor...An intimate setting without the "claustrophobic" feel I would say.The wait staff were extremely friendly and will check up on you from time to time without being overly intrusive. At appropriate times, they will make friendly conversation with you. The food was very good - we enjoyed the pizza (thin crust with good seasoned toppings) as well as the local fare (sambal udang rice). The dessert (sago layers with gula melaka) was rich and heavenly.Particularly enjoyed the watermelon & lychee drink mix which was a refreshing drink on a warm day.For a traveler looking for a slightly upscale (but still affordable) decent place to dine, don't let Fat Cupid pass you by.Show less

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dining
Review: Mix platter was great. Lamb, steak, chicken, prawn, barracuda fish. First time ever try barracuda. Not bad. For 1 person is RM88, for 2 is RM158. Come with salad.Service is top notch. Wine selection is good. Generally fish dish is great here. Great restaurant for seafood lover. Chicken dish is bland. Ended up leaving half on the plate.Show less

Author: Thomas BCanberra, Australia
Title: Great food at a good price
Review: Came here after reading the positive reviews, we were not disappointed. We drove down from the Meritus Pelangi after phoning to get directions, it wasn't hard to find at all following the advice we received. Started with a Shiraz caipirnha and lemongrass mojito, both were excellent but the caipirnha was a revelation. For mains we both chose traditional Malay dishes which were very fragrant and tasted great. For desert I had a chocolate ice cream sandwich which hit the spot perfectly. While dining we were invited to view the accommodations on site which looked really good and were priced very reasonably. Overall a great place with very friendly owners.Show less

Author: cynthjeanyHong Kong
Title: Glad I came here twice!
Review: Had a quick check on tripadvisor reviews to find this restaurant, then went on to their website and decided to give it a try. The staff is very friendly, very easy going, they asked if I needed help with the menu and gave me some of their recommendations. I was dining by myself and I really felt that they took care of me even though I'm not their hotel guest. As a matter of fact, I almost felt that I wasn't dining by myself as I had a good chat with a few of their staff. So friendly and helpful! Their beef burger was soooo juicy, sooo good. The fries that came with it was lightly salted and not over-fried - which was just perfect! They recommended their Nyonya laksa, but I could only enjoy the burger for the night so I decided to go back for the Nyonya laksa the next day - which certainly did not disappoint! I almost drank up the soup! Very glad to have found fatCUPID and dine there twice even I only had 2 nights in Langkawi! Oh and they play fantastic jazz music, makes it so romantic for solo travelers, couple, and family friendly too!I was interested to take a look at the hotel room, and they were very happy to show me around.Show less

Author: Alex NAberystwyth, United Kingdom
Title: very nice restaurant.
Review: This place is a little out the way, off the main strip in Tengah so is easy to miss. We knew of this place form trip advisor so we went looking for it. Nice, quiet and clean. a little bit more pricy that the asian restaurants but you wont be disappointed. service was VERY good, and the food was nice also !! See for yourself :) Show less

Author: TravelMark85
Title: The Lovely "White" !
Review: Simple menu, lovely restaurant and friendly staff!It is located at Pantai Tengah.Try to seek for Fat Mum Restaurant, is opposite of the road.They do have guest house behind the restaurant with concierge services.The menu is very basic and more into fusion types. MARKShow less

Author: jamesflorraineBrisbane, Australia
Title: That's more like it
Review: After a few bad reviews it's nice to return to normality , from the moment we entered , this was good the service was great, the food was also greatWill most certainly return.We are staying at one of theIslands best hotels with a restaurant but to be honest this is better, the only negative and this really bugs me is that the staff do not. Wait until all diners have finished before clearing the table.This is only minor but please wait until people finish their meals completely before starting to clear the table it makes us feel rushed thank you,Show less

Author: JessOcc
Title: Best resturant in Langkawi
Review: We ate here twice. Easily the best in Langkawi and even better than it's sister restaurant on the beach, Sugar. Fantastic cocktails!

Author: GrantMatthews
Title: Well worth finding it..
Review: Found this hidden gem on the last night and sadly wished it had been discovered earlier in the trip.  Great quality food, friendly service and lovely setting.  Pretty perfect for evening meal.  Best in Langkawi.  Must try the fish dishes.

Author: BelentyMelbourne, Australia
Title: Eat there!
Review: We went to fatcupid for dinner, and I must say I've had one of the best meals during my stay on the island there. Mango and pumpkin salad was very nice, and they know how to make fish melt in your mouth! My son absolutely loved his fish and chips, and he is not easy to please.Their food is presented perfectly! An array of little flowers on top of the fish just reminded me of Masterchef :)They are not very cheap in Langkawi standards but well worth it. All of the staff are super friendly, can give you some advice if you are not sure what to choose. All in all: this is a great little place, I will definitely be back again!Show less

Author: xinemondloveGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: I think this place is romantic
Review: Me and my partner went there for lunch. He loves this place so much. The only disadvantage would be not air-conditioned, as langkawi is quite warm. However, the moment they served us with one glass of cold drink when we are flipping through the food menu, that cold drink manage to give us a refreshing mood. So, it's not too bad after all, dining at a non-conditioned restaurant.To sum up:Relaxing and peaceful conceptGreat customer serviceGood sync with natureGood meal with reasonable priceGood pool conceptShow less

Author: wentheng
Title: Expensive food
Review: The food there is super duper expensive. The environment is nice. I just feel that the food not worth that much price

Author: Indra KMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must try in Langkawi!
Review: We ate at fatCUPID today for lunch and we are so glad we did! We stayed at the Westin so finding this restaurant was a little off the beaten track.. it was difficult to find but once found it was like an oasis. Incredible food, cocktails and service! I particularly enjoyed the Laksa and Sago pudding! Will definitely recommend to anyone who wants a decent meal in a gorgeous setting while in Langkawi. I wish I had found it earlier in my stay!Show less

Author: Gabby848
Title: Good food, staff and setting
Review: It was nice food and service it was quick and nice food the banana split was really yummy too! And you don't need insect repellant they have spray there already and the candles the milkshakes are really yummy over all really great restaurant

Author: Shauna848Darwin
Title: Amazing food!
Review: Our food was delicious and the service was great. I have to say that everything was excellent except Maybe that there was a few Mosquitos but the sTaff was very good about it and gave us some citronella candles and some repellent but after that they were fine I definetly reccomend the fatCUPID resturaunt enjoy! Show less

Author: LynneH918Vientiane
Title: Best food in Pantai Tengah
Review: I wish I had eaten here more during my stay, but for the first couple of days I had booked other restaurants and couldn't find the right lane for this restaurant on another occasion. After e- mailing Jeremy, I got clear directions and am so glad I found the place. The staff were wonderfully friendly and the food was really, really good. I didn't try the Malaysian dishes as I had eaten that elsewhere and was really looking for good quality western food (which is not so easy to find outside of the expensive hotels) but fatCUPID delivered perfectly on that front. I had the salmon cakes as starters both times I ate there as they were delicious and had 2 different fish dishes as mains, both of which were very well cooked and presented and equally delicious The dessert I chose of panna cotta with berry coulis was delicate and delicious, as was the wine and the coffee to finish the meal. Jeremy is a delightful host and the food and service are a credit to him and to his staff. If you want really good western food, don't look anywhere else.Show less

Author: dannyr187
Title: Excellent food, location and atmosphere
Review: The restaurant is excellent with both traditional Malayan dishes, seasonal seafood specials and light eats as well. Had the lemongrass punch and what a refreshing drink, pleasant suprise for the taste buds.

Author: Vallemarie
Title: Excellent fresh food with tasty wine in beautiful atmosphere
Review: They serve Malay and Western style food. Both is excellent and they know how to present the food on the tables. Everything is modern end looks excuisite. Not easy to find, because a bit hidden away from the road. Best restaurant in Pentai Tengah.

Author: Poppy612
Title: Delicious food and lovely staff
Review: We had some really delicious Malaysian and western food. I especially loved the wontons and sago pudding. The staff are super friendly and really care about their restaurant and customers. The food, service and atmosphere was the best we had in Langkawi by far!

Author: Chow Hock SSingapore
Title: Great venue to chill, nice food, awesome service, going the extra miles!
Review: We were lucky to pick fatCupid right after we touched down from Langkawi Airport. The location is within La Pari-Pari hotel. Spot the signage of fatcupid on the main road and it is about 100m from the main road. It was a hot day when we arrived, but the restaurant is a nice place to cool and chill. Nice food and lovely drinks, and a wonderful host to top it all. We really enjoyed the meal and time spent on this lunch. Price is reasonable too. We were fortunate to have the owner to help us swith our vehicle. The vehicle which we rented from the Airport, was already in empty tank. Our vehicle stalled when we were to leave the restaurant. The owner offered to get deisel from the petrol station which was 10mins away. We really appreciated the help from fatCupid. Cheers!Show less

Author: CatOxford
Title: Delicious food in a lovely setting
Review: Delicious fusion food in a stylish setting, hidden away down a side road. Super friendly staff and a laid back vibe made this a lovely place for dinner.

Author: meljabuPerth, Australia
Title: great way to end our time in langkawi
Review: We only visited here on our last night and these great people left us with a smile for the end of our stay. Fantastic service, beautiful food, lovely setting and one of the best desserts we have eaten ( sago pudding). The Italian sparkling went down well on a hot humid night and the staff here are very kid friendly ,so makes for a relaxing dinner. We'll be back next time in langkawiShow less

Author: Robbo0069
Title: The Perfect Start
Review: We went to FatCupid the first night of three in Langkawi. Lovely garden setting by the pool, very tasty food, reasonably priced and the service was exceptional. Overall a thoroughly enjoyable night. Thanks Jeremy and the team for a great experience.

Author: Sage2724
Title: Great little restaurant
Review: We have only been here for lunch but it is a favourite place to go to. This is because of the great choice of interesting dishes offer on the menu and quality of the food. It has a casual, welcoming  and friendly atmosphere.

Author: Roderick d
Title: Eat here. You'll love it (and go to their sister restaurant SUGAR too)
Review: This is an excellent place to eat, great food, friendly staff, great snacks, nice hip furnishings and an extremely cool sundown cafe (Sugar) where you should definitely go too to watch the parachuting tourists narrowly miss the church tower above you :)

Author: Kelly WHong Kong, China
Title: friendly dinner experience
Review: fatCupid is not difficult to find but it's better if you have a car otherwise you may need to have a little walk. We went there with our daughter she was a little bit grumpy that day since she didn't get any rest after a mangrove tour at langkawi but staffs there were very nice and we were recommended the lagsa and hamburger which we finished in 10 mins. will def go again if we visit langkawi again, which we surely will do...Show less

Author: doriens391The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Mosquito madness, but great first impression
Review: We went to fatcupid for drinks and dinner, because of the great reviews. Unfortunately we fled the scene after two drinks and some snacks, because of the huge amount of mosquitos. Despite all the candles and mosquito repellent, we were severely under attack. The food tasted great, so maybe a daytime visit is a better idea. Show less

Author: Charlotte G
Title: Fantastic all-round service, as well as delicious food!
Review: A friend and I went to Fat Cupid for dinner our first night in Langkawi, as we'd read the reviews and also been to their sister restaurant 'Sugar' on the beach that was very nice. It was delicious, local food. Then (perhaps because it was low season) they offered for us to come and hang out at their salt water pool the next day. We actually did this for the next two days, it was so nice! They gave us towels, brought our drinks orders to the sunbeds and were super friendly. They also gave us information on Ko Lipe (the Thai island where we were going next), helped us locate an ATM and currency exchange, recommended a place for a massage and even ordered an early morning taxi for us to the ferry pier. They really went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and get the most out of our stay, even though we weren't staying guests. Absolutely recommend visiting this wonderful oasis if you get the chance.Show less

Author: AndrewRae
Title: A little bit hard to find in the dark.
Review: Once you spot there sign and follow the path for 150m going past the green hotel on route it worth the effort.  Excellent food and excellent staff.

Author: Reubs22London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food
Review: The food at fatCUPID is amazing. They offer both European and Malay dishes. As we stayed at the hotel where the restaurant is based for over a week, we were able to sample almost the full range of food offered on the menu and the quality was very high throughout. The staff are incredibly welcoming, entertaining and accommodating. The atmosphere is calm, relaxing and good for both intimate dining and larger groups. We found the restaurant to be one of the more upmarket and boutique dining options on the island. I'd strongly recommend it to anyone visiting Langkawi and would eat there again should I ever return to the island.Show less

Author: IrishRach
Title: If you are in Langkawi go here for dinner!
Review: Thanks to Jeremy and the team for another lovely meal. The wontons are simply the best and we gobbled all of them in about 2 minutes flat! Great food, great service and a lovely setting. Enjoy...

Author: JHARBER1
Title: Bloody good stuff
Review: This was the only restaurant we'd been to in Malaysia where the staff have been taught how to treat customers. They don't stand over you like vultures to a kill while you wait to order. Bloody excellent!! Food amazing too.

Author: Adya_2012Luxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Brilliant place!
Review: One of the best restaurants I've eaten at, fantastic ambiance, great service and even better food. They catered to all our requirements in terms of vegetarian/non-vegetarian cuisine, with some awesome local veg Malay options. The cocktails are also excellent, the coffee Kalhua is a speacial must-try. Make sure you tell cabbies that you want to go to the Pari Pari resort, otherwise nobody has really heard of this place.Show less

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hidden Gem!
Review: We had a very enjoyable lunch on this venue. Its not on the beach and located down a dirt track at the Pari Pari Resort in Pantai Tengah. The restaurant is located under cover around the resort pool. The food was fantastic and service friendly and prompt. Menu includes local favourites as well as western specialties. Special mention to one of the owners Jeremy who was a great help to us and is also from Australia.I had the Nyona Laksa and my wife had the Tofu Burger.Their sister Restaurant is Sugar which is located on the beach and is a must visit for Tapas and Drinks during sunset.Show less

Author: Steve PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: They have earned their top ranking
Review: A little hard to find - but that's part of the charm. Our GPS put us wrong - but WAZE sorted it out if you're getting lost.From the moment we pulled up outside we were welcomed in to a lovely setting - excellent ambience set amongst a garden area for their hotel. The service was superb - and I can recommend both the beef rendang and the chocolate brownie! It has to the the best presented Malaysian food that we've eaten. The wine list was carefully chosen and we had a thoroughly enjoyable evening. These people are careful about what they do and make sure they do it very well - you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: WaWa1963Brisbane, Australia
Title: Very good Peranakan food
Review: We shared the chicken satay as a starter- amazing! I had the Laksa , which was served with a separate serve of home made chilli so that you could spice up the dish if , like me , you are a chilli head. However the dish in its original state was very well flavoured and packed full of ingredients. I cannot remember when last I enjoyed a,Laksa so much . My wife ordered the rib eye steak and although the steak was cooked to perfection ( medium rare) she found it a bit fatty for her taste even though I thought it was good because rib eye does have a bit of fat on it. The mushroom sauce was a bit bland for her taste and was of the gravy variety.Service was excellent and wine prices were very reasonable! We both were too full to have dessert.My advice would be to stick to the Peranakan dishes which are excellent , although from my perspective the steak was still good. My wife disagreed with me and preferred the steak at Nam.Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: Stan2307
Title: Perfect!
Review:
This place was outstanding in every respect. The food, pricing, service, variety was all perfect. 
Can't wait to go back here and would thoroughly recommend.

Author: noodleberryfin
Title: Gorgeous food in idyllic setting
Review: This restaurant is a wee bit hard to find - follow the off-road bill board for La Pari Pari & at night go right to the end of the dark drive-way The food was absolutley delicious - we had the laksa & snapper - very tasty & reasonably priced. Tables are by a lovely lit up pool & jazz music completes the chilled vibe.Our waitress was a total cutie & recommended we try their sister restaurant 'sugar' which is right on the beach & equally lovely.Our favourite restaurant in Langkawi! Show less

Author: Sugamuxi1980Pune, India
Title: Great food. Relaxed ambience.
Review: The place is so low key that I was worried when I first saw it. But then the service and the food made it a great experience. I had the Nyonya Chicken Curry and my husband had the Laksa. Both wonderful examples of the wonderful aromas and taste of the local food. Wine and beer was also great. So much we had to try the family's other restaurant on the beach: Sugar. A wonderul place also. Some of the best meals we had in Langkawi.Show less

Author: nicholas sLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to eat!
Review: Tricky to find on your first visit, but be sure to persevere! A little more relaxed and classier than most other places. Chilled ambiance, lovely staff, varied menu all well cooked and presented. Had lunch and dinner here and both were lovely. When we go back to Langkawi, we will definitley go back to Fat Cupid. Also check out Sugar on the beach as this is run by the same team!Show less

Author: Bob_and_DonnaNewcastle, Australia
Title: Hidden gem
Review: Quiet spot off the main street. We walked and it was a bit out of the way. Excellent food and the staff could not have been more friendly. Was a good mix of local cuisine but served in nice casual setting. Also served nice fish and chips for daughter who did memoir want anything to spicy.Show less

Author: Sachin188
Title: great meal
Review: great food. the nonya food was rather nice and priced well. the desserts were excellent. the hosts are charming and attentive. would love going back again maybe for lunch next time we are in Langkawi.

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Little nice place but food is great!
Review: We stayed in March 2014 in the hotel but as we stay on the island for a few months we keep on getting back to this little eating place with super friendly staff. But it is all about t.he food, so good at a great price, thus real value for money. it is a bit hard to find, but once you do, we are sure you keep coming back!Show less

Author: tprado3
Title: tasty food with reasonable price
Review:
Both western foods and Nyonya cuisine are good and worth for a try.
Big portion breakfast.
Highly recommended.

Author: HaroldC_42
Title: Good food and ambience
Review: Ate there frequently while we staying at La Pari Pari. Good choice of local food with excellent service.

Author: spark41Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Super poolside food.
Review: The menu has some very interesting peranakan dishes as well astraditional dishes such as fish & chips. Our 2 lunches there were excellent. Thai beef salad, chicken curry and a great mango & pumpkin salad. wine prices were good too, a small but well thought out choice.Show less

Author: tangotan7Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience and great food
Review: We chance upon FatCupid on the reviews from TripAdvisor and decided to give a try. The ambience of the dinning place is cozy and warm. They were short-handed at first but slowly pick up. I personally ordered the mushroom & tofu burger and fell in love with it. The mushroom & tofu patties was very yummy. The service was slowly picking up hence I think it was not too bad. If I am coming back to Langkawi, I will definitely come back FatCupid for a meal.Show less

Author: IntrepidTraveller84Melbourne, Australia
Title: Average
Review: Not sure about all the amazing reviews. We visited with a large group and while the service was good, the food was not very exciting. I had a laksa and others had dishes varying from steak to curry to beef rendang. My laksa was meant to contain prawns and chicken. I had one unshelled prawn, with head in my laksa and about three tiny pieces of chicken. We also ordered dessert which was very average.  This was out of the way and I wouldn't return. Show less

Author: paulhL9502VHAdelaide, Australia
Title: Excellent food and friendly staff
Review: This is a fairly new place which was recommended to us, and we were delighted by the friendly welcome and the excellent food at very good prices. Some of the team have worked abroad and that level of experience shows through. All the Malaysian dishes were really tasty and were explained to us in a friendly but not patronising way. Only the creme brulee was not really the best, but all the other courses more than made up for it - some of the best food we had. Show less

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: a friendly and relaxing place
Review: Went there for a late lunch, not too many people as it was about 3pm. Enjoyed the beef burger and steak sandwich and the jazzy music playing in the background. Karina and colleague chatted with us for a while before and after the meal. Check out the little shop they have there too!Show less

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Good Food & Great Host!
Review: We had our dinner on the last day of our trip in Langkawi in March 2014. We've ordered Lamb Shank, Pumpkin with Mango Salad and Beef Burger. The lamb was so tender and the beef patty was delicious too!All dishes turned out well with the great hospitality from the owner, Jeremy and also the staff.We will recommend this restaurant to all.Show less

Author: JoeyggFootscray, Australia
Title: Wow! Food from heaven- Amazing
Review: Dined here tonight and the food was amazing. This restaurant is tucked away from the Main Street, but it's a hidden gem of Langkawi.Run by a great person in Jeremy, Fat Cupid makes you feel at home and at ease. Laid back , with food that rates higher then a 5 star restaurant, Will defiantly return, and also stay in your cute boutique rooms.Do your taste buds a favour and visit Jeremy and his crew for a 10 out 10 dining experience.Joe and Sophia.Show less

Author: EWJLLondon, England, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional Venue, Brilliant Food
Review: A lovely venue and very stylishly kitted out - really relaxing, a quiet place away from the crowd. Faces the pool at La Pari Pari and some trees. The food is a combination of Modern European but the real highlight is the Peranakan dishes - well executed, and very delicious. Wine list was both affordable and of a very good standard.Show less

Author: yasumi999
Title: Average
Review:
The two dishes we ordered were both rather salty. 

Also, they didn't taste as Peranakan as they should. Didn't sample their Australian fare, not sure if it's any better.

Author: janpero
Title: Quite neat
Review: Place is really relaxing. Ordered tenderloins from special menu, was ok. Pepper sauce was delocious but veggies and potatoes pretty cold.

Author: L-SihuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place!!
Review: Isnt on our itinery but glad we went!If you're looking for a quiet place away from th blusting cenang area this is th place.Dining just right in front of a small pool area, surrounding trees and wind blowing on a hot afternoon.. sounds great isnt it?Th hosts aka owners are all uber friendly!Upon arrival we were greeted by a lady and till we were seated, everyone came over and th food was reaaaaaal good! I had grilled garlic-chilly praws with aglio olio ( without th chilli) and boyf had fish and chips, we ordered th fried wantons too!Fresh honeydew juice and watermelon lychee was good!I tried th ice lemon tea frizzy as well, ITS A MUST TRY!Again, thanks for th hospitality guys!!How i wished i've found this place earlier.. ha..I'll be back for more soon..Btw, did i mention they are a small scale boutique hotel as well? I heard guests are raving on how awesome their stay were! Show less

Author: SmccardleSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great find
Review: Awesome find!!! Service is fantastic we were greeted by one of the owners Jeremy who was so friendly and welcoming. The food was great and really well priced, Jeremy was also able to recommend matching wines to the mains we had ordered. Even at the more high end restaurants in Langkawi it is almost impossible to find anyone who knows anything about there wine list. Jeremy also explained why they have to chill the red wine due to Langkawi’s climate.Show less

Author: Martin P
Title: Cool hangout spot - 68 Revisited
Review: Feet in the sand, great atmosphere, lovely food reasonably priced, often very good bands - sunset can be awesome, very service and truly caring. Nicely shake cool drinks too by the way.

Author: leaht2014Sydney, Australia
Title: not bad
Review: Location is great, the perfect place to watch the sunset. However the service was very slow with only one waiter for the entire place - which was packed. The food is pricey for the amount you get, and so are the non-alcholic drinks. We spent one sunset there, which was very nice, but i wouldn't go there repeatedly.Show less

Author: Osaka_Eats
Title: Loved it!
Review: We were staying at La Pari-Pari, so this was a no-brainer. We enjoyed everything we ate there. I highly recommend the beef rendang and the beef tenderloin for you carnivores out there.

Author: lautrix
Title: Fantastic food, fantastic service!
Review: We found this hotel on tripadviser, and so happy we did! Altough they have only a few vegetarian options, they are all very, very tasty. We even went back the second evening. Staff was genuinely friendly and helpfull. A great find!

Author: georginam898
Title: Relaxing spot
Review: A great little find. The food was terrific and the staff were lovely and accomodating of a chilli free dish. The setting is simple and effective.

Author: Maarten76Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for breakfast
Review: My wife and I chose this place for breakfast on our trip in Langkawi December 2013. The food was good and value for money. The view was lovely and the staff were cheerful and engaging.It's a place I would love to come back to for breakfast.Show less

Author: MagicTravels
Title: Great location for relaxed meal and drinks
Review: I am staying 25 minutes away in Kuah but this was well worth the drive. Lived up to the reviews. Great food, drinks, cocktails, service, smiling staff.... just a real pleasure. Thankyou!

Author: jetlagwooferSydney
Title: Aussies - take note! Relaxed atmosphere and friendly service.
Review: The owner and her family, who've lived in various parts of Australia run this cafe, and another restaurant / cocktail lounge nearby.Friendly and attentive service. They were talkative and full of ideas for our next journey to Singapore. Its open aired - so it was nice to escape the over air-conditioned restaurants. I highly recommend the lychee and lime frozen drink. Yummo!Show less

Author: dkdaliCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Relaxing dinner
Review: Excellent food, drinks and service on a day we wanted a bit of western food. The restaurant is placed a bit away from the main street which make it a great place to go relax. The lemongrass mojito they make is really good and a twist on and old favorite of mine.Show less

Author: PearlyY_12
Title: Enchanted Resort & Café
Review: Read the reviews on Tripadvisor and thought of giving it a go and was truly mesmerized with the setup and design of the place. Would love to stay here for our next visit.

Author: kesharooPJ
Title: Very enjoyable evening with the family
Review: We called up the fatCUPID to make our reservations for dinner for our group of 16 adults and children and informed them that we would also like to have a cake to celebrate a birthday for one of the kids. The request was taken care of with aplomb and no fuss. They even recommended a very nice cake at a reasonable price.The restaurant is simply decorated with some Christmas lights and it looks very decent with its modern looking table and chairs with nice easy jazz playing on the sound system. It overlooks a small pool and despite being in the open air, never felt hot and there were no mosquitoes at all.The food is a mixed of well known Malaysian dishes with a modern twist and western classics. Drinks are made with a slightly differently, an example being ice lemon tea which came ice blended. We began with a variety of their appetizers which we shared and the flat bread and fried won-tons were great with the sweet and spicy sauce. Our mains were also good with a number of us going for the western dishes. My wife’s lamb chops however was a little too pink, chances are the kitchen rushed a little seeing that they were a little busy that night.Desserts were also good with the pannacotta being the favourite but we did not order too many as we had a cake to finish. The service was attentive and good natured. All in all we had an excellent time and would not hesitate to return.Show less

Author: JoannaH999
Title: great food and service
Review: We visited this cute little pool side restaurant for breakfast twice and it didn't disappoint. The staff were all extremely friendly and helpful offering useful information and tips on getting around and where to go on the island!

Author: StudleyToowoombaToowoomba
Title: Calling All Foodies
Review: Yes, fatCUPID is a great little bistro-style restaurant attached to Le Pari-Pari. A good continental-style breakfast - really fresh and filling - is included in the room tariff. OK, for a couple of dollars more you could have the whole bacon & egg catastrophe, but in the five days we stayed there we couldn't ever fit it in - Langkawi not being the kind of place where after grazing all day, you wake up in the morning dreaming of even more food. Nothing could be more pleasant than lazing away a long lunchtime at fatCupid in the super-cool restaurant/bar, watching kids splashing happily in the pool, having an ice-cold beer or two and working your way through the superb Nyonya-inspired menu. Dinner is a bit 'dressier' and lots of interesting guests & non-guests fill it up each night, making it a busy place where I'm guessing it would be wise to book. The bar is well-stocked, wine not over-priced, and the food always absolutely excellent; it wouldn't disappoint in any ritzy foodie area in any Australian city and it sure doesn't disappoint here in Langkawi. Great value & a must to visit - don't miss it.Show less

Author: ZA_Mark
Title: Modern atmosphere and friendly people
Review: We ate at fatCUPID twice (one dinner, one brunch) and the food was good, atmosphere was contemporary (appropriate music, white furntiure with glass and all tables overlook the pool) and the family behind the restaurant were extremely welcoming and really looked after us.

Author: ElynYongKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Love the jazz music!
Review: Visited this place for brunch and I must say the environment and food are equally amazing! Love the base colour of white, clean environment that match the tranquillity of the surrounding. Jazz music playing nonstop and it is simply the perfect genre of music to match with the mood.Food served in adequate portion and taste was perfect! Had a sandwich with mushroom and I must say the mushrooms are cook perfectly. Sandwich was packed and firmed enough to hold it up with hands for a bite without having any ingredients dropping and falling apart onto your plate. It wasn't a clumsy sandwich!The waitress and owner are very friendly to us by checking on our food after it was served. I think their friends were dropping by and it simply feel so warm with a bunch of true friends having a cup of tea or coffee in such an soothing environment. I would suggest to have a couch maybe? Just two cents of my words.Overall, I love this place and will definitely come back again next time! Show less

Author: sunseanfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food with great service
Review: Visited a friend staying in La Paripari and we had a nice quiet dinner here. I like the quirky name of the restaurant as it certainly raises my curiosity to come try out the food. It was quite the hunt to find the location of the restaurant at first as it is located further down from the main road. However, this makes it nicer as the place is far away from the noisy crowds and we get to enjoy our evening with chit chats in peace. The portion is not huge as mentioned (I guess the portion is tailored more for asian tummies), but it is just nice. Leaving your tummy with a little bit of space for their desserts. We ordered their recommended starters, lamb, pasta and chicken. It tasted good. I admit it is not over the top good but it was okay. The service was over the top excellent, not in the professional way excellent (not that I'm complaining), but in a very friendly, welcoming and warm way that makes you feel as if they are your friends that you can hang out with, which is much better. We enjoyed our evening here and would definitely come back again.Show less

Author: Kim RSydney, Australia
Title: What a find for our last dinner!
Review: A real treat. The food was delicate and delicious and the friendly service fabulous. It took a bit of asking to locate this restaurant recommended by our guide but well worth it. The pool and hotel area looked very inviting too. Might be worth checking out next time for a complete stay.Show less

Author: Krati sBengaluru, India
Title: If you are a vegetarian this can save your life! :)
Review: Langkawi is not really the best place for vegetarians, and worse if you are Indian. It could be a bit hard to find good vegetarian food and most places have food that has a typical Malaysian flavor to it (a bit sweet in everything). But at Fat Cupid the food was great! It felt very authentic and global and the quality of the food in terms of the flavor was great too! The presentation of the food was super and the ambience is cozy and refreshing with a pool view and soft lighting that sets the mood for a good conversation. & Good music! :) The host here Jeremy is a fun and warm person. Its always fun to chat up with him and he will make sure you have a good time and you're happy with the food.Being a vegetarian this was a life saver for me in Langkawi. Thank you FatCupid!Show less

Author: juhapekkatHelsinki, Finland
Title: Great food superb service.
Review: It's always hard to find a restaurant suitable for families. We visited them lunch time and this visit was such a success. We felt our selves very welcome and waitresses took so good care of our little baby girl while she had her nervous brakedown and not wanted to eat. 10 minute walk with a waitress turned it all for success. Super friendly staff, very nice satay and reasonable price. Hope they'll find a better place near the ocean.I'll go there again.Show less

Author: TravelNotes15Melbourne, Australia
Title: Brunch place in LGK found!
Review: The food was absolutely delicious! We did not regret we put the extra effort to find the restaurant as the food, atmosphere, and the service were worth it. The owner really knows good service and how to create the right atmosphere for a relaxed Sunday brunch. He also gave us some good advice on where the cleanest and safest beaches were located.Show less

Author: mafletcherSydney, Australia
Title: Good food friendly people
Review: Had dinner here last night, the food is modern and has depth of flavour. The nonya dishes were the pick of the crop for us, literally had to defend mine from my wife. The brownie and peanut butter ice cream sandwich was a great way to finish off the meal.The staff were great, very friendly offering us tips of what to do and see whilst here. We will be going back.Show less

Author: TjuBakka
Title: Nice place, good food and friendly people!
Review: After finding this restaurant on TA, we thought we would give it a try. The food was great, relaxed atmosphear and attentive staff. The place is a bit hidden, make sure to look for and follow the signs and you will find this restaurant.

Author: 718lucilleb
Title: Nice food, good service!!
Review: Very nice romantic location, very good food, not a average menu, thats made it special!!! The owner is a very gentle Guy, good staff!! If you go to Langkawi, don't forget to eat at this place!!

Author: kaiyomaSan Francisco, California
Title: One of the best restaurants in Langkawi
Review: Came here twice (breakfast and lunch) and had some wonderful meals. The veggie works breakfast is perfect: filling, colorful, healthy, and delicious. For lunch I had the mushroom and tofu burger, which was definitely the best veggie burger I've had in Southeast Asia. The lychee and lemongrass freezies are awesome too!Show less

Author: kirbsterLondon
Title: Great food, great service
Review: This is a really good restaurant that is worth taking the extra effort to find. Great food at a reasonable price and a really nice atmosphere. Highly recommended

Author: Ben WMelbourne
Title: Amazing little find - World class Beef Rendang
Review: The Beef Rendang was one of the most beautiful dishes I've ever eaten. It's to die for. The setting is great, and the service is terrific. And a Little Creatures beer to wash it down! Awesome. Great to talk "Melbourne" as well... ;0)Highly recommend it, don't be discouraged by the location, the food makes it all worth it.Show less

Author: Vindi G
Title: Memorable 30th Birthday Dinner
Review:
We picked this place purely based on the amazing looking dishes we saw online and the Aussie connection. We were not disappointed at all!

Perfect service, great cocktails and food to die for. Recommend any prawn dish.

Author: Kevin Yao Lung K
Title: Great service. Good food
Review:
The food here isn't as mind-blowing as what other reviewers make it out to be but it's good nonetheless. Service is sincere and very attentive.

The people behind fatCUPID will go far given their dedication to what they do.

Author: Thierry2Pepieux, France
Title: Do not miss "Fat Cupid"
Review: Geolocalization: do not be discouraged by the difficulty to get there. Just check online before you start. And it is worth the search ... Location and atmosphere: in a garden, facing a pool, a tasteful decor, a very good lighting (not so common is asian restaurants) and very relaxing atmosphere. Important detail... nice relaxing background music. Food: it is just fantastic. If you lack of inspiration, just try the "grandma's speciality dishes". One of the great things about this place is the fact that they can cook the real asian way or adapt the taste for westeners. The dishes are never too oily. Only one criticim: the portions tend to be a bit too small. Service: this crew likes to cook and serve food to people: it shows, you can feel it; they just enjoy that, and that's what we like !Honestly, it is for us the best place for food in Langkawi, and we have tried many of them !I recommend it with no reservation.Show less

Author: hannajomeansMalaysia
Title: Outstanding service from start to finish
Review: The food was good (not the best I've ever had), but definitely good!! The service was outstanding. The atmosphere is laid back and open air. There are many good choices on the menu. It's hidden off a back alley behind the main street, but worth it.Show less

Author: Lorange_Tran
Title: Overated
Review: Did not try all the foods there but maybe they are not my things. And everything was a bit costly.Staffs were good and attentive.

Author: gabyrd80Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Excellent customer service!
Review: We went there following the Tripadvisor reviews. They did not lie! My friend suffers has a delicate stomach and they were kindly enough to accommodate to her specific needs. She claims it was a very tasty meal even with all her food limitations. I ordered a cocktail, it was similar to a sweet mojito, yummy!My meal was very good too. They mix old Malay recipes with international food. The result is a small, but great, menu that caters from local to world food. We couldn't be happier. The place is off-beaten path, so it'll be helpful to show a map of the restaurant to your taxi driver. If I ever come back to Langkawi I'll try it again.Show less

Author: R_ReginalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cute decor and attentive staff
Review: The place is slightly tricky to look for. It's about 100 meters away from the entrance. Look for La Pari-Pari sign as well as they are the same place.It has a moderate food selection featuring a selection of western and nyonya cuisine.We were greeted warmly and were seated by the cute resort houses, blanketed by nature. Try the sampling plate for a delightful taste of what's to come. I had a steak burger that was cooked nicely while my partner had the unique nyonya chicken rice. The food was of good quality and tasted as good as it looked.The owner goes out of the way to greet the customers and for me, this goes a long way to providing a wholesome dining experience that I would love to revisit in the future.Take note though since it is within nature areas, some small pests are to be expected but none too intrusive.If you are in Langkawi, do visit this place to experience it on your own.Show less

Author: IzyanSuhailaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly service with awesome food
Review: We were only at the premise during breakfast hours, but we really liked their awesome breakfast/brunch sets. As guests of the hotel, we got discounts but they remembered our usuals and are super friendly, which definitely perks up our morning. Try out The Works or Sweet Potatoes with Egg Benedict, prices are a bit on the high side given Langkawi's standard, but we can't complain, as the portions are big and last us the whole day!Show less

Author: Watmel
Title: Perfect spot to relax
Review: We dined here tonight and were not disappointed. Quiet and calm setting, beautiful food, and friendly people. Definitely recommend fatCUPID to others. Menu both western and Malaysian, Delicious.  A very welcoming spot to be.

Author: finediner78Sydney, Australia
Title: Lovely place
Review: This place is a little off the beaten track (a RM6-8 cab from cenai) but we are lucky enough to be staying here so get to experience the restaurant every day. The staff are great, and the food just as good. Best hash browns on the island! Cute French music billows out of the speakers as you eat and there's a little gift shop as you come in. Show less

Author: JaqobSweden
Title: An oasis
Review: Hidden on a back road lies this fantastic place. When the rest of Langlakwi is based on cheap furnishings with plastic chars, this places is very nicely designed with glass tables and white walls. The food is really good, nicely displayed, and reasonably priced. But the best thing about this place is the people who works there. They make you feel special, takes time to talk, and are just very nice persons!Show less

Author: WiemomoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: We will fly here just to eat!
Review: We arrived at La Pari Pari in the evening, and decided to have our dinner at the property instead of venturing out after a long day on the road. We'd expected the food to be 'just alright' like most restaurants in hotel/resort/chalet properties, but were surprised to find that the quality of food was extremely good. All of us enjoyed the atmosphere (right by the pool) and most importantly, the food and the service! Although we're spoilt for choice in Kuala Lumpur and can usually find very good food, the dinner we had here was so good we thought we might fly in to Langkawi next time just to eat here in future! fatCUPID is not just another restaurant by the property, it IS a gem on its own!And you MUST try the sago dessert - I'd say it's to die for!!!Show less

Author: RHamzaniPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Friendly
Review: Went at 12pm for brunch. Thank god they serve bfast till 2. The staff were all friendly. They even introduce me to their sister pub, sugar. Just that I don't have time to go there since it was a short visit. Nice environment, laidback n no fuss.Show less

Author: eliz27
Title: over-rated
Review: The atmosphere is good. But not the food. The beef sausage and the beef bacon is too salty. The pancake is not fluffy enough and a little bit dry. The staff is friendly. But for the quality of food offered, the price is too expensive.

Author: Hayleykok
Title: No where else but fatcupid.... ^^ wonderful dining experience surpassed my expectations
Review:
14 sept 2013...we were here for english beakfast mostly because its highly recommended by a friend... 

Music, view, ambience, food, service, staff, decoration, location, dining experience-----> excellent

Relaxing and unforgettable dining experience... :)

Will definately return for our next trip in langkawi...Definately!!

Author: vmilmanCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Place with a difference
Review: Cenang is full with eateries; it's two streets lined up with restaurants and hawker places. It's not easy to make a difference, but fatCUPID manages it successfully. First of all, they are off the beaten track - one simply would not find it without tripadvisor or similar service. Hence their website is excellent and somehow they do manage to fill the small dining area (all outdoors). Staff are all super attentive and helpful, food is a good sample of the local cooking. I would certainly go there again if not for desire to try out various other options...Show less

Author: Zedddd
Title: Amazeballs
Review: Very very friendly meeting with super efficient service. Front of house/ manager is fabulous. Waiter is very attentive and accommodating. The ambience is relaxing, trendy, shabby chic and intimate. The menu is small but perfectly formed and the food outstanding. Home cooked family recipes from Malaysia and western takes. We're food snobs and were hesitant but the Fat Cupid surpasses even a very good London restaurant. Keep looking for it because you won't be disappointed. Show less

Author: muiyeeKL
Title: A different kind of restaunrant in Langkawi...
Review: their service is nth to say...it just more den excellent which I compare it wif others Malaysia restaurant...before I go I saw someone comment that this place is hard to find bt when I'm thr...I saw a sign beside the cenang road...which is not too hard to find it...bt unfortunately the first day I went...the shop is close n the staff thr tell me to come tmr...n I really did...I only able to order appetiser because before that we had lunch in somewhere else...n would like to try this high rating shop... its just lik some western feel restaurant...wif the food taste n also wif the service n the atmosphere...its a pool side restaurant...young generation should hav a try...Show less

Author: Butterflyfeathers
Title: Great atmosphere and good food!
Review: Good value for money. Food is good and staff friendly. They serve local peranakan food, so this is a good place to try some local food on the island.

Author: 129vickicAdelaide, Australia
Title: Delicious Dining & Super Service!
Review: Hard to find - down a narrow lane near the Sun Hotel (same side) and just past the Frangipani resort (opposite side) - but don't give up looking because you wont be sorry.The food was delicious - the service was 110%. Jeremy was super helpful and friendly and it is a family owned and operated business. The seafood was fantastic, nannas prawns were spicy and delicious and the panna cotta was amazing......Show less

Author: Pennina21
Title: Must go, amazing food!
Review: Ate here today and the food was amazing, best we've had since we arrived. We had the Malaysian dishes and they tasted so good, I had the passion fruit cocktail which was delicious, my Bf had the milkshake which was great too.The restaurant itself is really nice, very chic, you could go here for a special meal. There is a bar then all the tables set out, a choice of magazines to read if you go for breakfast or brunch ....The people who run it are great and stop for a chat which adds to the friendly atmosphere.I would recommend it to anyone, we are going back tomorrow it was so good! Thanks for the delicious food!!!Show less

Author: bsoemxb84Singapore, Singapore
Title: Must Visit
Review: Fat Cupid is a must visit if you are ever in Langkawi. Our only qualm is not coming here sooner. We've heard about this place but chose only to check it out on our last day as the rain kinda ruin our plans a little.This place tucked away nicely in the Pantai Tengah area. Look for La Pari Pari hotel, and you'll find it this place. The food is great - Nyonya and Australian together at last! Here's you'll get a fine spread of local and Aussie cuisine. I would definitely go again when I'm in Langkawi!Show less

Author: JMacOzMelbourne, Australia
Title: The best dinner in Langkawi
