Review: Fat Cupid is tucked away in Cenang beach. Trip Advisor and Google Maps had the incorrect locations (Jul-13). When you find it.....it's worth it! The food is sensational with amazing authentic Malaysian which is out of this world. The Australian wines and cocktails (especially the Espresso Martinis) went down nicely. The venue is lovely and peaceful and my partner and I felt incredibly relaxed. The host of the night - Jeremy - was amazing, lovely, fabulous and witty making it one of our best experiences in Malaysia! Highly recommend this place to anyone. Enjoy!!Show less

Author: aamirjavidLahore, Pakistan
Title: Delicious Food
Review: They have exceptional meals in all respects -- menu and food preparation are of the highest quality from start to finish. I was impressed with the hospitality of Jeremy and the way he gives menu options, recommendations, and pairings -- really appreciated the attention to detail by a very professional young man. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: sumi83Singapore, Singapore
Title: A must visit!
Review: We liked fatCupit so much we dine there three times. Once was a dinner as part of the group where we had the snapper, a range of delicious salads and desserts. The brownie and sago desserts are wonderful. We visited for brunch twice too. Loved the laksa and rendang tempe. Jeremy and the team are truly wonderful, helpful hosts and were a highlight of our trip. Will definitely come back. Oh also, visit Sugar, their sister Bar on the beach which does a great pimms jug. Perfect sundowner. Show less

Author: loopy_lou_6530
Title: Nice food, lovely staff
Review:
We had dinner here and really enjoyed it.  Reasonable prices.  We tried the chilli prawns and the lamb kurma which were very nice.
Would happily eat here again.

Author: Alex MAustin, Texas
Title: Awesome
Review: IGNORE THE MAP because it's wrong. Don't know why the address is so wrong! Search for La Pari-Pari because it's basically part of the small hotel (see http://www.laparipari.com/ground_dining.php). We stumbled upon this place while walking down Jalan Pantai Tengah and were so happy (because I read the great reviews on tripadvisor, wanted to come, but we decided against it because it looked like it was on the north side of the island!). We were not disappointed and enjoyed very attentive service and delicious food.The staff is really great. We loved our waiter although I forget his name. He recommended that we head to Sugar (their sister restaurant down the road) the next night to watch the sunset and have drinks and snacks. At Sugar we talked with one of the co-owners, Jeremy, the chef Richard and Belle the waitress. Everyone is great. I recommend the appetizer with 3 dips, the satay, and any of the champagne cocktails or Pimms lemonade pitcher.Update: I revisited Sugar in July 2013 and everyone remembered me! We had more delicious cocktails and snacks.Show less

Author: FrienderZJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good but not yet great.
Review: The tasteful, well appointed chalet style accommodation & airy bistro style eatery have the potential to be a hidden gem! We almost didn't keep walking down the narrow track but we persevered on the back of other reviews. The ambience and lighting was good and although not extensive, the chosen items from the menu were more than pleasing. Although to concur with another less favourable review, the contents could've been more substantial. The mixed platter to share as a starter is a delight and cocktails better than average. The lady in charge of the restaurant is very warm and welcoming and the service is very good. Just one top tip for improvement: Proprietors or staff smoking in the dining or bar area (between handling/serving customers) is NOT a good look.Show less

Author: SvetskyMoscow, Russia
Title: Truly Asian food! And service is not as a Datai! Where you have to wait for cap of coffee for half hour :)
Review: I love Asian food but will be afraid to try at local restaurant ! I am allergic to MSG/ajinomoto !! Almost all Asian restaurant using that! But not at the Fatcupid ! I could eat and enjoyed real test of Asian food with natural flavour ! If you need any info about island .. Karina and Jeremy will help you with that ! I am strongly recommend you try laksa,beef short ribs and chicken curry ! Price is very reasonable ! Fish and chips is only 18 rm? Have to try next time :) Fish and chips plus glass of wine at Four Season is 150 rm ! We were happy with that too even on duty free island !Show less

Author: nishiKualalumpurkualalumpur
Title: must meet Jeremy
Review: We stumbled upon Fat Cupid and had the best fried wontons with a fresh chilli sauce and the best pana cotta ever. Aslo an excellent thin crust pizza. What made the meal more special was the excellent service by Jeremy who was so friendly and informative and it was a real pleasure to be served by him. The management must realise what an asset he is to the company. Three cheers for you Jeremy!Show less

Author: mahteckKlang, Malaysia
Title: Ate several meals here....and all good!
Review: We stayed at La Pari Pari, so naturally we had breakfasts here. The included breakfast was simple (please see photos of all dishes described in this review) and suitable for a light start to the day. But as we wanted to try more variety, we "upgraded" to their brunch offerings. The sweet potatoes, poached egg and bacon remains memorable! The smoked salmon in croissants were very good too.For lunch, we has the braised beef short ribs and the curry(gulai) salmon. Both these dishes demonstrated the range that Chef Keith can whip up. Truly excellent offerings! And not forgetting the mackerel steak which was so good that Jackie collected back a totally clean-up plate when we finished. And Jeremy was always on hand to make recommendations for us and make us laugh.We ate at other Trip advisor listings in this food tour, and I must say that fatCUPID deserves to be Number 1. The prices are also very reasonable for the hefty servings we got. We'll be back soon to enjoy more of your great food.Show less

Author: hilltribeimportPhuket
Title: A bit disappointed
Review: Atmosphere was fine, service was excellent but food and pricing were disappointing. I ordered fish and chips, I think it was 18 myr, the portion was big but unfortunately they served the cheapest farmed fish that you can buy. It's mushy and has a slightly muddy taste. It happens often and is a real pet hate of mine, 18 ringits is good money and we're on Langkawi where seafood is plentiful, give me half the serve but make it fresh caught fish please. Then there was the glass of wine, 15 ringits I think and only just okay. Remember Langkawi is a duty free island where they just about give the booze away so for what I got it was just too expensive.Show less

Author: krissylouGerringong, Australia
Title: Great place!
Review: Dined here while in langkawi. Had laksa and snapper - both were delicious though my partner felt the laksa was missing something and wasn't as tasty as he expected. Snapper was cooked perfectly and matched well with sauce and vegetables. Cocktails were fantastic as was the service. We didn't stay for dessert as we were so full! Sweet, modern setting that looked like it would be lovely at sunset. Prices were a bit pricey for langkawi but still reasonable. Thanks for a delicious dinner!Show less

Author: adnazoSydney, Australia
Title: Relaxed atmosphere with great service - will be back tomorrow!
Review: Took a while to find FatCupid because Trip Advisor's map is incomplete (head towards Pari Pari Resort - it's the same location) but it was worth it. The service was so natural - it was professional and responsive but our hosts also made it easy and comfortable. We could have been having a summer BBQ at a friend's place! The open space and outdoor play area for young kids was perfect for our toddler - who was entertained by this as well as the lovely staff - and the food was delicious. The signature drink is great - perfect refreshment and works well with many of the dishes. Lots of personal touches and personality - we enjoyed an early dinner and will be back to try lunch : )Show less

Author: Smaltese84
Title: Amazing!
Review: Firstly, the map isn't correct, head toward the yacht club on Jalan Teluk Baru. Food caters for everyone. If you don't want to be adventurous, have a killer burger. You want to experience fantastic Asian you will experience old family recipes. The service.. AMAZING!!! It made our night! The price is fantastic for how much food you get! This is THE restaurant in Langkawi.Show less

Author: PackMyBagsOz
Title: Lovely food and great staff
Review: The food here was a little less local and a bit more western than we expected, but that said, still great food.

Author: D_4Liverpool
Title: Amazing food! Amazing service!
Review: We went to this restaurant two nights on the run it was so good. The restaurant is set in a very nice garden location and is very clean. The staff are very friendly and helpful attending to your every need including having a friendly chat with us. The food was amazing! Very good quality with excellent presentation. A definite must for a guaranteed good meal in langkawi. Show less

Author: Lovetoreviewthingz
Title: Friendly personalised service
Review: Dropped into fatcupid for some dinner after drinks at sugar ( sister resturaunt) We had two fantastic nonya dishes and a great bottle of wine. Most impressive was the personalised and very warm service, we felt so welcomed and we will definitely return.

Author: GeirH
Title: Great place !
Review: The food, the service, the hospitality was all excelent. A nice little place somewhat hidden away but it is absolutely worth the visit. Be aware, the Tripadvisor map is totally wrong !

Author: YSmith30Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food and friendly staff
Review: We dined at FatCuipd on our first night in Langkawi, it was situated off the beaten track but its definitely worth the walk in. The co owner was really friendly and chatted to us. The staff added the extra touch and loaned us insect repellant (which is highly essential if mozzies love your particular blood group). We ordered lynette wonton for starters followed by prawn aglio oglio and chicken peranakan dish. The food was amazing. The dessert topped off our expectations. The choco brownie and gula sago melaka was soo delicious and we would have ordered another serving if we werent so full! A++++ for service and food!Show less

Author: shir13Singapore
Title: SUPER SHIOK RENDANG!
Review: They serve Nonya cuisine as well as a breakfast menu and we set out wanting to try all the items on the Nonya menu while we were staying at La Pari-Pari. The Nonya laksa and beef rendang were soooooooo good. We had that upon arrival and were so excited to try their menu we didn't even bother to check in first. HAH! On our second night, we shared 3 mains from the Nonya menu (that's with three bowls of rice) between the two of us and we still felt like we haven't had enough because the food was that good! So we had dessert as well and omg the banana coconut crepe is a must try! One of the very best desserts I've had! The ambience of the diner was really cosy and open concept so there was good ventilation and fans and soft blue jazz playing in the background all the time. Really good place to chill out and forget about everything and just attack the food! The staff were really friendly and helpful too and totally didn't judge when we order enough food to feed 4 people! :DShow less

Author: AngmoFoodieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent. Do yourself a favour and go...Brilliant!
Review: It's hidden away off the street, but well worth finding it. Laksa was excellent, the service and atmosphere was first class. Not something I expected in langkawi. The decore was very modern and stylish. But this was out shone by the food... Simply amazing. Highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: Miriam CWuxi County, China
Title: Fantastic food & helpful staff in a cozy restaurant
Review: We went there for dinner and the good was fantastic from starters to desserts without forgetting the wine.They also have rooms "little bungalows" for rent, a pity we were in another place.Even in a rainy afternoon we enjoyed the view to the swimming pool and the garden with good background music.Even the waitress volunteered to take care of the baby so we could enjoy our meal! (I know, that might sound a bit weird or even scary, but it is a common practice in Asia)Show less

Author: JoJoFDagnall, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly, Classy Fat Cupid
Review: Visit Fat Cupid for something a little more relaxed and a lot more classy than the other island restaurants. The atmosphere in the restaurant is very chilled (quiet jazz, birdsong) there is a pool you can use with day beds under the boat wood trees for a day of lounging. Try the local and family specialities, they are delicious! Fat Cupid is run by an incredibly hospitable family who know their stuff (and also run the new beach bar Sugar), we felt very looked after and all of the recommendations - including the wine - were much higher quality than anything esle we had had on Langkawi. When we go back to Langkawi, we will definitley go back to Fat Cupid.Show less

Author: TonyL595Melbourne, Australia
Title: Worth the visit
Review: It may be tucked away - but it is a little bit of paradise with great service and food. We enjoyed the laksa, the curries and the entrees as well as some good value for money cocktails. It makes a great change from the usual array of restaraunts in the area and with its modern touch and twist - it's well worth it!Show less

Author: sciencegeek101New Zealand
Title: A wonderful experience - highly recommended!
Review: We went to fatCUPID for dinner during our stay in Langkawi in May. When we went there were no other diners which was a shame. It is tucked away at the very end of Cenang beach down a driveway, but it is definitely worth the effort to find.The owner of the restaurant, Jackie, came to discuss the menu with us and help us choose our meals. We shared three mains - lamb kurma, nasi sambal udang and seafood laksa. All the food was delicious. I also had a cocktail which was very nice. The coconut crepe for dessert was something different and very tasty. The decor is modern and fresh and the restaurant is open with the outside. The staff provided insect repellent which was a thoughtful touch.Probably some people would say it's expensive compared to street food and other cheap eateries in Cenang beach, but compared to what you'd pay in Australia it was fantastic value for money and the food was great, and much better than other meals we had in Langkawi. We thought it was better than the meal we had at Privilege Restaurant which is the number one restaurant in Langkawi on TripAdvisor.Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Sally1601London, United Kingdom
Title: Perfectly nice
Review: We recently went for dinner here. It is tucked away a bit, so if you're staying at the North end of Chenang beach, you probably need to get a cab there, but it is no more than 5/10 mins to get there. It is decorated really nicely - minimalist but arty and bright and refreshing. The food and cocktails were good, not excellent, but definitely worth a trip.Show less

Author: kezzar00Melbourne, Australia
Title: Good food, great service
Review: Restaurant is down a lane way off the main road. It's in the La Pari-Pari Hotel. Jacqui helped us pick from the menu and explained the dishes. We had Nasi Sambal Udang (prawns with veggies), Nyonya Chicken Curry, Chilly Prawn Aglio-Olio and a Small plate of veggies with garlic butter and oyster sauce. The food was very tasty and we enjoyed our meal. They lit citronella candles under the table and gave us bug spray if needed for the mozzies. The drinks were resonably priced.Show less

Author: AnneEScott
Title: Good food - lacking atmosphere - service ok
Review: A nice location off the beaten track. Good on a rainy night cos it's covered. Food is great - delicious Nonya curries. Service was well meaning but a bit disjointed. Oodles of mosquitoes...so be sure to spray up before you go.

Author: MakRempitKodok
Title: Lovely and cosy spot
Review: I always make sure to drop by FatCupid for a drink, whenever I am in Langkawi. The drinks are delicious, the service is good, and the owners friendly. I particularly love that it has a lovely and serene view of the forest.

Author: ScotgalAustraliaAustralia
Title: A lovely little spot
Review: We had dinner here one night after being told about it by a lady in Trader's Hotel Kuala Lumpur. Jeremy is one of the nicest hosts you will find, and he will guide you through his menu which has many of his grandmothers recipe's. The staff are very friendly - thank you.The food and atmosphere were lovely - you should give it a try. It is on the grounds of La Pari Pari in Pantai Tengah.We will return when we are back in Langkawi.Show less

Author: SarahAustraliaAustralia
Title: Amazing food !!!!
Review: My small children, husband and I stayed at La Pari Pari for 5 nights and pretty much ate in the restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner !! The food was just amazing. Super tasty, good value and lots of helpful advice ! Our children were even given their rather random requests at will .... Such as plain pasta with cheese ! Would highly recommend it ! Also a very relaxing atmosphere and great location !Show less

Author: kathleentffLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and excellent service
Review: If you want to dine in a natural atmosphere, this is the place to be. The food was good and the best of it all, is the excellent service. I would not say, make you feel at home but the staff there were friendly and made you feel so welcomed. This place is a part of the La Pari Pari resort, a small but really beautiful place with a swimming pool facing the restaurant. The resort is surrounded by lots of trees and I felt so nice dining here. Definitely recommended if you like good food and good service. Their service put many bigger restaurants and hotels at shame. Way to go Fat Cupid!Show less

Author: RalphAshenhurstLondon
Title: Disappointing experience overall
Review: Encouraged by the positive reviews we made the effort to find this restaurant which is down a lane off the main drag in Pantai Tengah. As we went in to the entrance to the Par Pari hotel there was a very spartan area which was the restaurant. I found it hard to believe this was the number 4 restaurant in Langkawi. More positively the staff were very helpful and friendly. Also the food was good and well presented. The spartan atmosphere was offset a little by the good music that was playing. Unfortunately it was turned off when the kitchen staff left leaving us to finish our meal in silence. I went with high expectations and left feeling satisfied with the food but disappointed with the overall experience.Show less

Author: AshwKuala Lumpur in Malaysia
Title: Cozy place with delicious food
Review: Don't expect it to be some kind of fine dining restaurant. FatCUPID is simply a cozy place which offers nice food for people who want to be away from all the hustle and bustle of the tourist spot.While the menu may seem to have limited choices, the quality of the food is not compromised. Just the burger alone is enough to make you going back for more. The burger patty is so juicy and tender. Definitely worth the money.I've also tried the fish and chips. The fish was very fresh, better than a lot that I've tried in KL. Love the greens on the side, so much and fresh of them.The sandwich in the breakfast menu is so filling and delicious. I could have that everyday for breakfast.If you want some quiet time with nice food, fatCUPID is the place you would want to go.Show less

Author: Sharm S
Title: Great Night
Review: Was recommended the restaurant by a great friend and truly had an amazing evening. Great food, atmosphere, drinks and of course wonderful Malaysian hospitality. Did not get to stay at the host hotel, Pari Pari, but did do a site and loved everything we saw. Even managed to soak our feet in the pool prior to dinner. Great evening had by our whole party!Show less

Author: gravityplan
Title: Great food and lots of fun.
Review: Let me get this out of the way and say that the food and drinks are great here. Yes the menu is limited and yes it's not the easiest place to get to but it's still worth it. I think it's really important to mention the service here. I don't think I've ever been treated so well and in such a friendly manner at a restaurant as I was here. I left feeling like I had been invited to a friend's house for a backyard lunch. Great place. Show less

Author: a_beach_pleaseLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Go-to restaurant, amazing manager
Review: We dined at Fat Cupid back in September 2012 and I've guiltily just realised that I haven't left a review as promised.Yes, it's a dinky quiet little place. But the manager is so, so friendly and accommodating, the setting is fabulous and the food is really, really good.I'm a fussy pescetarian and the manager bent over backwards to help me find the right dish.It was refreshing to find a menu that didn't take an hour to trawl through and to be able to discuss the contents in detail.It's the kind of place I'd seek out on a potential return to Langkawi.Show less

Author: DoadodoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simply Overrated
Review: We dined at fatCUPID because it was high on the TA list. However we left the place really disappointed because the food were pricey and the menu was limited. Food was mediocre, with similar restaurants serving the same thing for a much lower price.On the upside, I think the place is nice and quiet, but a little too quiet. Service was top notch of course, but I can't help but wonder if its because we were the only table on a Saturday night! All in all I think there is plenty of room for improvement. I'm sorry to say but I think many will be left disappointed after reading all the reviews in TA and expect it to be a top notch restaurant- it simply isn't. I think if I were to stumble upon this place, without any prior knowledge about the ratings/reviews of this place, perhaps then I will be impressed.Show less

Author: Josh_OShannassyMelbourne, Australia
Title: This place rules!
Review: Food: Excellent! (Burger filled a 3 month craving from travelling through India)Drinks: Excellent! (Lychee based 'freezies' Are amazing and a great hangover cure)Service: Excellent! (Go above and beyond what is required, friendly and up for a chat)Location: While off the main street it is so relaxing to just sit there and chill out with a drink with the pool and grass area right there.Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Jayce1964Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Warm Hospitality , off the beaten path
Review: We have visited Fat Cupid for breakfast one morning while in Langkawi and end up staying and enjoying the family like hospitality of them all during the rest of our stayKitchen prepared a special dish for me following a lacotsio / gluten free diet , their other brand new venue Sugar serves also fresh good meals and its great location to spend your day and stay until sunset.over all a comforting , beautiful affordable place on the Island!stay at Fat Cupid and enjoyShow less

Author: Ikku
Title: It's like sitting in your backyard eating well!
Review: We went to this lovely place twice. It's peaceful, beatiful and the staff is excellent and caring for their customers. Both Asian and Western food were tasty and their pannacotta is perfect! Would definitely recommend this place.

Author: Tim FJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Simply wonderful
Review: FatCupid is situated within the La Pari Pari guesthouse and the two complement each other perfectly. Being able to stay in a beautiful little hotel with such great food on your door step is a recipe for a great holiday.There are certainly cheaper places in Langkawi to go for dinner but I can guarantee you that none will leave as much of a lasting impression as FatCupid (except maybe its sister restaurant, Sugar). A lot of this enjoyment is directly attributable to the people who own and run FatCupid. Jeremy in particular is a force of friendliness and fun unto himself. The team always went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed and never missed a beat in looking after our ten-month old.If I was to pick one fault it would be that the Beef Rendang portion is too small (its so good that this is actually a complement!).Show less

Author: Sandy LSydney
Title: Great place to eat!
Review: We went for dinner tonight and the food was DELICIOUS!!!!!!!!!!! FatCupid can be located once you find SunBa albeit a little hard to find but if you are coming from the main beach, turn left just after SunBa Retro Bar and follow the road all the way down to the end.Other reviewers complain about the small quantity of food which may deter people who like to enjoy big meals, but the quality of the food is amazing. I was actually quite full after my cocktail and my Chicken Pontay. My husband had the Lamb. Both were amazingly nice. After 3 drinks, 2 mains and the sago dessert, our bill came up to 120RM. That may seem pricy to people who may want something cheaper. I really enjoy the decor, it reminds me of a cafe that could belong in Sydney. It is simple, clean cut but the beautiful chairs and rustic jars make it a relaxing experience after a long day driving around the island. Service was exceptional too. Owners are so lovely. Can't wait to try brunch!They also have a new place thats asian fusion with tapas and cocktails by the main beach, but my husband and I were unable to locate it due to the fact that we were so full! Would really like to check it out though.Show less

Author: Brucie0304
Title: Ok meal, but shouldn't be number 1 on trip advisor
Review: My fiancé and I went here after reading the reviews and seeing this was number 1 on trip advisor. The restaurant is down adirt track off the main drag in pantai cenang and is connected to a hotel. On first impressions, we were a little disappointed. The restaurant area was empty other than 1 other table (we were there over Xmas break and it was 8pm) and the restaurant is sparsely decorated, so there wasnt much atmosphere or great feeling. The staff were really friendly, the menu was ok and food was nice, however I would recommend cads del mar, priviledge or the cliff restaurant over fatcupid.Show less

Author: wrldtrvlr86Canberra, Australia
Title: There is a reason why this restaurant is rated #1
Review: FatCupid is tucked away behind the green village centre and is well worth the effort to find. The food is delicious and fresh and the owners are friendly and welcoming. We spent two hours working our way through the cocktail menue, had an appetizer sharing plate, two mains and dessert. We highly recommend visiting this fantastic little spot.NB: there is accommodation on site called la Pari Pari. There are 12 villas owned by the restaurant and it looks like a nice getaway spot. Keep it in mind if your looking for a place to stay.Show less

Author: kon1czGermany
Title: If you want to leave quite a lot of cash on the table and leave with an empty stomach then fatCUPID will be your No. 1
Review: Yesterday we visited fatCUPID because it is rated No. 1 on TA. We hoped for excellent food at a moderate price level since TA suggests you could have apparently the best food even for $5 or somewhat more. Here are our observations:+ Quiet location+ Very friendly waitress+ The taste of the food is not bad (but for sure not good enough to be ranked as the No. 1 on Tripadvisor)Unfortunately these were the only positive facts about fatCUPID. The weaknesses are as follows:- True, the location is quiet, however the fatCUPID belongs to small resort and as such many guests pass regularly through the restaurant area greeting the staff and having small talk which disturbs the atmosphere after a while- Right next to the restaurant area is the hotel’s pool area, so do not be surprised if a hotel guests jumps into the pool while you are having your first bites of food- On first sight the restaurant area seems inviting, but if you take a closer look you realize that the service area is poorly organized. For instance, the restaurant uses glass tables which look truly elegant, however the staff does not use coasters for drinks and plates, especially if you order cold drinks the table quickly turns into a swimming pool when the cold drinks get warmer. Furthermore, it might be beneficial for the restaurant to decorate the tables with some accessories- By now you might think that we are quite picky, but please note that you pay a relatively high price (the normal avg. price for a dinner including an appetizer including one beer will cost at least $10-15) for a dinner which you could get somewhere else $2-5. For this amount of money you would expect everywhere else really good food in a very charming atmosphere, unfortunately the fatCUPID fails in both aspects- The amount of food is really small, smaller than in an ordinary kitchen stall right at the next street corner, you will get a big plate with a small portion of rice and a fairly small cup of your main course. If they did not decorate the plate with cabbage (or whatever it was) the plate would look actually empty- We took the recommended fatCUPID starter for two (~ $9) expecting a wide variety of their best appetizers. Unfortunately there was no variety at all. Not only the outer look of all meals looks very similar, but also the taste of each dish is similar. For instance, at least two out of three meals are based on tough, while the remaining meal involves a deep fried coating. If you aim for any sorts of vegetables, do not expect it in the fatCUPID starter for two.We paid approx. $36 for a starter (for two), two main courses, a smoothie as well as a beer. Unfortunately we left hungry and quite disappointed. After all we would not return to this restaurant anymore, at some point we felt even ripped off. We still do not understand how this restaurant made it at the top of TA. This review sounds really harsh and we are aware of that, but this only a mere reflection of our huge disappointment. Do expect decent food for $5 for this money you will only get some drinks.Show less

Author: KixanKarlstad, Sweden
Title: Best meal in Langkawi
Review: Proffesional staff and high class food. The place is hard to find and doesnt look like anything special. But the food was superb! I can warmly recommend the Beef rendang. And dont miss the plate for appetizer. We are so satisfied after this meal. To dessert we shared a chocolat brownie. You must visit this place. Appetizers, two maincourses one dessert, two glass of wine and two glass of beer = 149 RM.Show less

Author: ismewlin
Title: nice environment
Review: Try the fatCUPID special starter, it is very special and taste nice. other food is nice as well but dinner menu choice is limited, next time would like to try for the lunch.

Author: LondonJammerlondon
Title: OVERPRICED,OVERRATED,AWFUL
Review: We went with some friends who live on lankawi and were very disappointed.The portions were smaller than an air asia meal,i had 4 pieces of beef in my beef rendang and a thimble full of rice and if this was not bad enough the beef was like chewing leather.The bill at the end of the meal was the biggest shock,totally over priced and abysmal quality.never Again.Show less

Author: NKT77London, United Kingdom
Title: Our best evening in Langkawi
Review: Once you find the restaurant you'll have an amazing time, all the staff and the owners Jeremy and Jackie were extremely friendly and make you feel really welcome. The dishes are authentic malaysian cuisine, and as we were in a group we decided to order all of grandma's main dishes which were deliciousThe bar is really nice too, and has a wide selection of drinks and cocktails, so we found it nice to just chill there and enjoy your evening before and after dinner.Show less

Author: Susan TMalaysia
Title: Great breakfast !
Review: We had the Vegetarian Works - it was fantastic, great portions and yummy eggs and hash browns. Service was 11/10 - highly recommended as a quieter spot for romantic dinner. You can see the sign for fatCupid from the main road, and turn in to walk about 200 metres (?) to find the restaurant, which is also part of La Pari-Pari.Show less

Author: Rawtalent
Title: Something missing......
Review: Booked for the Christmas Eve dinner. The front of house service was wonderful but the food just didn't live up to the hype. Everything was OK it just didn't have the wow factor....something was missing...maybe the chefs don't love their job?

Author: Dean M
Title: fusion
Review:
Small, but well selected menu combining traditional Malaysia dishes with a western feel.  Service, quality, ambience all top rated.
Will definitely return.  A delight

Author: MeenanairLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Not bad for the first time..
Review: I had a very high expectation on their food after reading trip advisor. The restaurant is a nice place to dine with impressive decor,very warm and friendly staff which I think everyone would like to go but nothing special on their food. We were 5 of us and 4 of us had Nyonya laksa (curry mee) and the other one had nasi sambal udang .From our personal opinion this is a very basic food. By the way we also had a signature tasting plate (appetizer) which not enough of choices whereby the staff keep on coming to our table twice to apologies asked us to choose either one . Fat cupid salad not bad but still nothing great. Overall they had limited choices yet they were run out of certain food. I think they have lovely place,calm and cozy ambience , friendly staff - GUYS you can do better than this in cuisine. Their dessert menu had only 3 options so I decided on their "vanilla panna cotta with berry coulis" . For me in simple words after tasting it -vanilla pudding or some calls it as vanilla soft milk pudding. Their food is good but nothing special. Overall good food but not as expected.Show less

Author: eeleeyahPetaling Jaya
Title: Delectable.
Review: For a person who completely loves spicy food, I must say that I'm impressed with the level of spiciness of their dishes. Spicy enough to satisfy a local, not too bland, and not too spicy for anyone not used to hot food. The nyonya laksa, nasi ayam pontay and steak sandwiches are delicious. The satay is a complete must-try! Sweet and juicy. Though the nasi impit could do with some work. Desserts were heavenly; especially the panna cotta.Show less

Author: Sherelle88
Title: Worth the hunt
Review: For everyone that reads how good this restaurant is but can't find it here is a easy way to do so. The restaurant is down a side alley near the sun bar, you drive around a but of a dirt road and you will see a sign for la pari pari. Jeremy is a great host and the food was great, they make a great mojito which is hard to even find one that makes then on the island. Highly recommended :)Show less

Author: pedrobrioSardinia, Italy
Title: Very good dinner
Review: The location is quite hard to find, but it is worth it.The dinner was delicious, but the portions a little bit too small.We had a sensational fish ( not remeber the name ), and a very good grilled salmon.The calamary appetizer was good, but too salad and few rings.The kid had a pizza, which was ok....and do not forget the service was amazing friendly !I would recomend itShow less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Friendly and Cozy environment
Review: Eventhough its location is a bit hard to find, but we managed to find it eventually. Was greeted promptly, environment was quiet and cozy. We had some drinks, service was great and friendly. They even showed us their rooms in La Pari Pari. Good place to hang out and relax..Show less

Author: Fred oAmsterdam
Title: Raw hamburger
Review: Ranked number 1 in Langkawi here on Tripadvisor and I get a raw hamburger! I like steaks rare but getting a humburger that is completely raw inside is just not on.Chips were fine but all in all very pricey lunch with nothing to run back for. Won't come again.Show less

Author: McGhiePerth, Australia
Title: Beautiful lunch
Review: Spent my 40th birthday lunch at this restaurant and it was an amazing experience. The food was sensational and the setting was lovely, the kids enjoyed a cool swim in the pool while the parents enjoyed a lovely cocktail. Jeremy was a great host, giving us lots of advice and laughs. Thanks Jeremy and staff at Fat Cupid we really enjoyed our afternoon. Show less

Author: Jamie BChina
Title: Delicious food in a great environment
Review: FatCupid is a great find in Langkawi - beautiful environment, exceptional service and great food! I tried the laksa, a recipe from the manager's grandmother. Very fresh and full of big flavors. I highly recommend it! And who can argue with a couple glasses of wine by the pool?Show less

Author: johanbodo
Title: sad experience
Review: Went there with expectations. Turned out to be a nice but overrated chicken place. One of the many on this island. Nothing special. Good but like i said nothing to add to the culinair experience one might expect. But friendly staff etc.Hard to find.

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Oh Yes.....
Review: Firstly, FatCUPID is quite difficult to find and if I had not been with a friend who knew the location, would probably never have found it!Secondly, do not visit here if you want a romantic meal for two because you are greeted as a friend and introduced to everyone who is there, thanks to the enigmatic Jeremy who is excellent as front of house.I opted for the Laksa which was wonderful but very, very spicy for my English palate. Not a problem. It was whisked back to the kitchen and toned down slightly. This did in no way detract from the flavour and was still excellent. I was too full to even try the puddings - which for me, having a sweet tooth, is quite a major disaster.Would I return - in a heartbeat. Great evening with very friendly staff.Show less

Author: wendywoo63Woldingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great find!
Review: We ate here as a family a few nights ago.Food was wonderful,ambience lovely and the staff first class...what a great bunch of young people working hard to make a success of this venture.Jeremy was brilliant,should get tour advisor job if he could fit it in!gave us great tips for thing to do on island and a future trip to oz......good luck.......you deserve all the positive ratings you get!Show less

Author: Cheryl GTweed Heads, Australia
Title: Loved It
Review: We stayed at La Pari Pari and had our brekky here every morning, we loved the setting sitting in the open pavilion by the pool with the trees nearby, no road noise and great service.We also had the occasional lunch and dinner.The food is fresh and very tasty,a lot of the recipes are family recipes.They also make drinks to die for both alcoholic and non alcoholic, my husband had what he described as the best lemon tea he has ever had my fave was a drink with lemongrass in it and for the life of me I can't remember the nameJeremy is front of house and will describe and advise you on all the menu.Show less

Author: Vanessa R
Title: Yummo!
Review: Fat Cupid is a very nice place. The menu is very modern and the food tastes great. The staff are fantastic- really welcoming, friendly and helpful. Would go back in a flash. Enjoy!

Author: Ben4manLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Unbelievable service and food.
Review: We found fatCUPID on trip advisor more easily than we did the restaurant, but it was well worth the look. The restaurant is quite small which allows for a wonderfully intimate atmosphere and personal relationship with our server. I went for one of the 'Asian Persuasion' meals because I thought I better experience some true Malaysian food. To the contrary, my sister went for the Ribeye steak, and I can confirm that, as expected, the food was delicious; very wholesome and well rounded. After the meal, Jeremy sat down with us and was an incredibly useful tourist office, pointing out the dos and don'ts of Langkawi, and giving us help regarding a potential future holiday to Australia, since this is where he has lived for a large part of his life. I would highly recommend eating at fatCUPID, for the food, and for the most personable staff I have ever encountered at a restaurant.Show less

Author: 279JulieM279London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Really nice place, a bit off the main road but worth the 10 min walk. The food was fantastic and Jeremy was the perfect host and really helpful and chatted to us for ages with recommendations of things to see and do in Langkawi. I had Grandmas special prawns and they were fantastic. A must see for everyone and I wish we had stayed in the Hotel!Show less

Author: BelSheppardAustralia
Title: Worth the hard work in finding fatCUPID
Review: fatCUPID is hard to find. Taxi drivers do not know where it is. Take a look at an earlier review (about September/October) which will give you good directions. Now ... to the food, the food at fatCUPID is super yummy. We had Laksa which was devine. We had the special of the day which was a Crispy Skin salmon in a Malaysian sauce which my husband and I both devoured. We had our two boys 9 & 11 with us and they were treated so kindly by the owner. They were invited to swim in the pool while we dined and also were allowed to venture and play in the cubby house that had been built. The wine was icy cold and the restaurant is crispy clean. There are also some rooms that you can stay in and they are well worth a look. Great prices and very very clean. fatCUPID is in our "must do" list when we return. Oh and the dessert was "to die for".Show less

Author: hazydazy01
Title: awesome food
Review: nice place. Great food! We had vegetarian food there and it was surprisingly nice. The vegetable stew was sooo good.

Author: Joner85
Title: Simply amazing!!
Review: We received the warmest of welcomes before sitting down in the lovely dining area, the atmosphere and ambiance were just perfect and the whole place is clean, modern, and very stylish.The staff were super friendly and helpful. They were especially helpful when dealing with our spice preferences which in my case involved tweaking the dish to suit.The food was just fantastic, we opted for Asian cuisine and we didn't regret it! You could tell the time and effort that went into creating and preparing the dishes and its no wonder the staff take such pride in their work.Dessert was also perfect. Absolutely great meal and night, could not reccomend it more. We are definitely going back (probably tomorrow)So that's great staff, great setting, great food, great price.You must go!!!Show less

Author: NeilB81London, United Kingdom
Title: One not to miss!
Review: A really nice setting, although tucked away and not the easiest to find. The won tons are a real treat, and not to be missed. Dishes are very tasty, although portions could be a little larger if you're hungry. Drinks were very good, including the Fat Cupid punch! Jeremy was the perfect host, and couldn't have been friendlier or more helpful - made it a very enjoyable night, and one of the best we had on the island. Tis is one place not to miss during your stay,Show less

Author: O SParis, France
Title: excellent cuisine
Review: A bit hard to find but so far the best laksa we had. excellent fusion malay food( Beef satay with a touch of lemongrass). nice service.bad luck for us the menu was a bit short probably due to the low season and the wine was not as good as the dishes.Show less

Author: Ronnie_Kandler
Title: The Best!
Review: Eating at the fatCUPID was an excellent experience from A-Z. Everything from service to food was way above our expectations and we highly recommend the restaurant to others who appreciate good quality and good atmosphere.The restaurant is not easy to find, but call the staff and they will give you directions :-)Ronnie Show less

Author: 250_swbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hard to find but easy to love
Review: A new enterprise, and the realisation of a dream for the various young family members involved, both front & back of house.   The whole setup is novel, good to visit and a breath of fresh air.Set around a central garden and small swimming pool, the complex of buildings comprises 12 smart bedroom suites and a main social area with dining tables and a long bar.   Whilst open to the elements and therefore not air-conditioned, a generous host of ceiling fans keeps things comfortable.The menu splits neatly into two parts.   A western line-up is Australian-inspired and reads well but wasn't sampled.   However if it lives up to the standards of the Asian menu from which we chose, it shouldn't disappoint.   The latter was a high point of our trip to Langkawi.Whilst removed from gritty south east Asian hawker food, the kitchen's output nonetheless doesn't lose sight of it roots.   Presentation is slick & professional, but it's authenticity which still rules the roost here - and the earthy tastes & textures of the east which still shine through the modernity.Service was informal & attentive, although (disappointingly) we were the only two diners on a midweek evening.   Prices for food & drink were very sensible across the board, certainly to one conditioned to European rates.One  point is that Fat Cupid wasn't easy to find, so do keep eyes peeled for the sign which lies on the opposite side of the road fom the turning.   And beware google maps, which depicts the address at completely the wrong spot!   However persistence will be rewarded with a real treat, and one you'll want to return toShow less

Author: gsamkuala lumpur
Title: Great food and excellent service.
Review: The restaurant has very good food and excellent service. Jeremy the bartender is a great host and will fix you some good cocktails. The chef Keith is a Malaysian from Australia and has so the menu has a mixture of local and western dishes with an interesting twist. Jackie who in front of the house is friendly and has a wealth of local knowledge.Show less

Author: Mynameissecret
Title: Greatest FOod in Langkawi!
Review: We went there the other day and it was hard to find. The staff were amazing once we were there. Beautiful food and it's nice as not many people eat there because of itbeing hidden. You can't miss it if your in Langkawi! The resort is also nice. I see why its better than privellage!Show less

Author: IrishRach
Title: Amazing Laksa
Review: A bit hard to find but it is worth it. Chilled out atmosphere. Lovely staff and great tasty food. Have the Laksa...it is granny's receipe!

Author: SpaSeeker13Clifton Hill, Australia
Title: Too good to miss
Review: Make an effort to find this restaurant. It is on the dirt road just past the Sunba complex. The white sign is on the sea side of the road and opposite all the other glaring signs. You walk down past another outdoor restaurant and it feels like you are going nowhere then you come to a white washed Hotel La Pari Pari and fatCUPID is within this hotel. Enough directions. The food here is stunning; family owned recipes,semi outdoor resturant overlooking gorgeous pool. Food is contemporary Asian with some Western options also. We had laksa and an Asian chicken dish with potatoes - hard to describe but brilliant. The pumpkin mango salad was refreshing also. Dessert -sago and panna cotta were exceptional. Also the owners Jeremy and Jacki were incredibly friendly and also sat with us to recommend other restaurants in Langkawi. They also showed us their hotel rooms - only 12 rooms either king/twin. They looked magnificent; spotless, 6 months old, all white and so cheap-275RM per night per room (maybe low season price?). Make sure you visit fatCUPID and I am sure staying here also would be stunning.Show less

Author: mayquen86
Title: Fat cupid strike on under
Review: Fantastic restaurant tat gives u a relaxing atmosphere and warmth service...menu sounds popular but the food is extremely delicious n u can feel the effort they hav made. As a airline crew i would highly recommend tis to my customer when they travel to langkawi...p.s/signature lemongrass drink is a must to tryShow less

Author: FionacShanghaiEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Well worth visiting
Review: We had a great experience here. The staff are super friendly and gave us lots of advice about where to go and where not to go in Langkawi during our stay. We had a mix of Asian and Western food which was excellent. The warm friendly atmosphere really makes this a great experience.Show less

Author: scrn1974Melbourne, Australia
Title: Friendly, beautiful, & yummy!
Review: We ate here for lunch during a yoga retreat and the food was fantastic. If we had stayed longer we would have come back for dinner! The staff were extremely friendly and accommodating - brewing us up a fresh batch of iced tea (which was the best I had had). Pasta and salad was very, very fresh. The ambiance was peaceful and relaxing. The perfect place to sit and have cocktails too with a shaded bar and over head fans. Perfect on a hot day. We tried to stay at the hotel but they were booked. That's OK when we return to Langkawi we will be back.Show less

Author: Tara MMelbourne
Title: Breakfast Lunch and Dinner
Review: fatCUPID is food like no other on the island. You MUST experience a fatCUPID meal when visiting Langkawi. It is a little difficult to find the restaurant if you don't know where it is and because it is still new, some taxi drivers are not aware of where it is. The staff are lovely and make you feel right at home. I was in Langkawi for eight days and ate at fatCUPID four times. Their traditional malay dishes are out of this world and for those who are after a more Aussie dish can choose from meals like fish and chips and a hamburger (the hamburger is to die for!!!)Get there and enjoy a wonderful and memorable experience. Show less

Author: isabellas333Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: It's absolute great dinning affair
Review: We had the most sumptuous dinner ...a baba & nyonya cuisine with a twist ..Chef Keith possess the art of mastery when it comes to this local cuisines ....from the chicken pontay , nyonya laksa.....right until the mouth watering desserts which Jeremy the hostess with the mostest tempted our ever eagerly taste buds ...we didn't want to miss a thing so we tried it all until the last drop. Karina the proprietor of LA Pari-Pari was so gracious and never lacking in conversations made it more fun and enjoyable evening.The ambience of the restaurant really compliments the elegant beauty of the resort and what more there were two efficient staff Amelia and Tracy created a homey atmosphere added more zest to an already stylist and trendy team....FatCupid and La Pari-Pari my kind a place .....I can bet on it.Show less

Author: Alana PLangkawi
Title: Not to be missed!
Review: This restaurant is AMAZING!! Have been staying in Langkawi for 3 months now and have just discovered fatCUPID, wish i had found it sooner! You cannot find better burgers on the whole island. Their Nonya food is so tasty and a real treat, you can tell it is made with a lot of love and dedication to the chef's family background. Jeremy is all you could ask for in a host. Always happy and ready to tackle any request you can think of. And of course always good for a chat between courses. Have tried almost all of the cocktails on the menu, the variety and flavours are a lovely change from the normal found in langkawi. For a quiet, romantic dinner for two, or a big bustling table of friends, this is definately the place! You'll want to come back time and time again, I know I have!Show less

Author: sweetnov86Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: A Hidden Gem in Langkawi
Review: Before my first visit with my client to fatCUPID, I've heard a lot of good stuff about this restaurant. Although I wasn't sure about it, I decided to take the chance. We made a decision that day which we'll never regret for the rest of our lives - visiting fatCUPID and meeting the awesomest Jeremy, whom provided top-notch services. Most importantly, my client was happy!Keith, cousin of Jeremy is a great chef who cooks from the bottom of the heart and brings excellent home-cooked dishes to guests' tables with consistent quality and flavours. Some of dishes on the menu are foods that Jeremy and Keith have been having since small. One of the local dishes that is worth trying is their signature Nyonya Laksa - A mildly spicy coconut cream base Laksa, served with a choice of rice vermicelli or egg noodle or mixed, comes with fried tofu puffs, halved hard boiled egg, long beans, shredded chicken, fresh prawns and garnished with mints and local fragrant leaves. Great recommendation from them and it's a love at first bite. Oh! Their chocolate brownie is to die for, a sinfully divine dessert to end our meal. They said that once struck by cupid's arrow, you will fall instantly in love. fatCUPID is the new hidden gem on Langkawi Island. I'm definitely coming back for more, even though I've dined there three times already.Show less

Author: Ben_Jenkins1
Title: Superb food, location and service at a good price!
Review: My wife and I recently had lunch here after reading good reviews and also having heard good things about it from the local people we met.We were not disappointed. The food was tasty, exciting and different from anything we have had out here. The restaurant itself is a little oasis away from the hustle and bustle of "the strip". Jeremy, one of the owners, injects flare, humour and charisma into the service. All the boxes are ticked!Show less

Author: migrantnativeElmore, Vermont
Title: SUPERB
Review: This food is made with love and care. Each dish I enjoyed was thoughtfully constructed with subtle complexity and exceeded my expectations. To top it off, it was delivered with a smile and good conversation. Delightful meals for breakfast, lunch and dinner. You will not be disappointed and you'll likely find yourself coming back for more!Show less

Author: izzatun_nashiin3004Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Local taste as its best
Review: well i always come here to Fat Cupid/La Pari-Pari like literally every time i visit to Langkawi island ;D Excellent food with good service and friendly & fabulous staff especially Jeremy and Karina.they are awesome.Service was top quality, food was so nice with plenty of choice, cool and cozy environment.The restaurant had a delightful and amazing ambiance.As you walk inside the restaurant you notice that it was been very simply nice and tastefully decorated.Talking bout food,i really love the dessert made by their lovely chef,it was a Panna cotta with Vanilla Beans-always been my favourite! :) the place location is very remote but the surroundings are so calming and peaceful that's why i feel so comfortable whenever i come here.Highly recommended if you're in Langkawi and wanna taste a great food & service.Definitely worth it!Show less

Author: Adventureful
Title: Oasis in Langkawi
Review: We dined here four times during our stay in Langkawi - for brunch, lunch and dinner. The food was fresh and delicious and the staff were extremely friendly, attentive and helpful. The open air and stylishly designed restaurant makes for an enjoyable eating experience at any time of day. Show less

Author: OchanzPerth, Australia
Title: Soul Food of Langkawi!
Review: If you're looking for a great time your search ends here! FatCUPID is an amazing little heaven.It's like home away from home, Jeremy and his staff are very friendly and welcoming. There is a great selection of meals and drinks without being overwhelming and very affordable. Great salads, amazing Nyonya food. My favorite dish is the Laksa, the thought of it makes my mouth water! The place itself is clean and tastefully decorated, easily accessible, in the heart of Pentai Tengah. You can head there for dinner and/or drinks then walk to Sunbar if you want to boogie :).A must try if you're on Langkawi!Show less

Author: CE_Mami
Title: Must try !
Review: Love the signature drink 'Freeze' -- a lemongrass & mixed fruit drink. If you can take spicy stuff, try the nyonya laksa. My kids love the fish & chip and the pudding dessert.

Author: Wijnstijn vKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: cosy atmosphere, refreshing menu and amazing host!!!
Review: The host Jeremy and the hosts of the adjoining hotel Pari Pari made it a unique experience!!!! I enjoyed the warm welcome of all of them and had a really good time chilling out at fat Cupid, be it in the bright lovely morning for breakfast, or a groovy chillout night hanging around the poolside or at the bar. Still remembered the adventurous jackfruit pancake which was really delicious. The authentic nyounya food in the menu was also lovely, reminding me of home cooked food. :) A must try!!!Show less

Author: Vanessa WLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: You feel the love!
Review: The warm welcome to all guests is genuine and creates an instant relaxed environment. Can take your time ordering and eating and always willing to chat with guests as well. Food is healthy and eclectic, so something for everyone. Also diverse price tags, so even if on a relatively tight budget you can have a filling meal and savor the experience without spending a fortune. Having eaten there on numerous occasions, there is always something new to try so never a boring repetitive menu. Highly recommend!Show less

Author: CharlieP317Canberra, Australia
Title: Food good, staff GREAT
Review: While the food at fat Cupid is a stand out, the highlight is the warm and friendly staff in particular Jeremy who explains all of the dishes and stops and has a chat if you feel like it without being too pushy. We stayed at the attached guesthouses for two nights and had to force ourselves to try things outside of this restaurant as the food was reliably and consistently good. The nyonya dishes were the best we had in two weeks in Malaysia, and the western food was very much like home. Fresh flavours and reasonable prices. Highly recommend this place and a swim in the pool as well. Show less

Author: Julia SKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: fatCUPID= faNtASTIC!
Review: My experience at fatCupid was nothing short of just ridiculously wonderful...so much that I went there twice in a two day vacation on Langkawi, with lots of other restaurants to choose from. The food was a total experience unto itself (I salivate just thinking about it). It's one of those places where you see that dish on the menu that you didn't know you wanted but then absolutely need and it comes out of the kitchen even better than you thought it could be. And the staff - a real pleasure. There is a bartender who's older and makes some mean cocktails. As a seasoned bartender, I was very impressed and they certainly did the trick. The manager and owner are super friendly and fun, awesome to chat with about all things beautiful in life. Um, hit this place up, you'd be stupid not to.Show less

Author: KawidawnHong Kong
Title: Foodie Heaven
Review: FatCUPID is the restaurant within La Pari-Pari and offers Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner or just pop along for early evening drinks whilst watching and listening to the Hornbills.FatCUPID tantalises your senses and leaves you wanting to go back for more. Front of house Jeremy is witty, sparkling and passionate about life and food culture. Jackie is passionate and loves nothing more than to explain their dishes & ingredients origins. Then there is Keith the chef behind the taste and aromas that make up their fab menu. The atmosphere (especially Fri - Sun) is lively, fun and chatty.There is choice for all tastes but personally I always want to eat local dishes wherever I travel. As Laksa is my all time favourite Asian dish I had to try their Nyonya Laksa and I wasn't disappointed. It was a silky coconut based version with oodles of noodle, tofu, chicken etc.. The portion was huge enough for two but I wasn't in the mood to share. My husband choose Nasi Sambal Udang and asked for it extra spicey and they happily obliged. On another evening we had wontons and salad and again these were delightful. Prices are higher than maybe some of the local Malay eateries but well worth the money. They don't have a proper coffee machine yet but apart from that I can't think of anything else on the negative side.When we are back in Langkawi we will definitely be popping in for lunch or dinner or both.Show less

Author: IsabelBVkuala lumpur, malaysia
Title: Great hosting, good creative food
Review: We were there 3 times as part of our yoga retreat and we enjoyed every single meal there ! It's usually hard to get food of this quality in Langkawi restaurants . Also the team here Jackie and Jeremy and chef Keith and La Pari Pari 's Karina definitely add to the experience as they are warm and inviting .You feel you are dining with friends. Food is even served with an artistic flair. Since it was the restaurant of La Pari Pari , we managed to see the rooms ...clean , good ambience and good value for money. Thumbs up ....both establishments have added more character to the island life ! Show less

Author: TomWilliamsonJr
Title: Our Week at Langkawi and fatCUPID
Review: We spent a week at La Pari Pari and ate often at fatCUPID. Excellant! fatCUPID catered to my wife's gluten free diet, satisfied our 14 year old son's continuous hunger, and I enjoyed every meal. Check it out, you won't be dissapointed.

Author: saywai
Title: Nice but pricey
Review: We had dinner one day here as its in our hotel. The nonya sambal prawns was nice, but a tad pricey. Service was excellent

Author: RiazatLondon
Title: Great food, lovingly prepared, sparkling service
Review: Came here for dinner with a friend who knows her Malaysian food. We ordered a tasting platter, which was very good but not great. But then for a main I had a laksa and it blew me (and my friend) away. It was gorgeous. I like the setting of Fat Cupid, I like that it's intimate and the staff have a great rapport with hotel guests and non-guests alike. FC has a proper drinks menu, the food is not mass produced or left sitting on a hot plate for hours and the team know what they're doing. It's something of a gem, tucked away from the brashness and same-same stuff you find all over Cenang. I really want them to do well (but not so well I can't get a table). In terms of formality, you don't need to wear closed shoes or a tie but the prices are slightly more formal than the dress code, if you see what I mean. I would go back and I'd definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: joyroberts55
Title: Atmosphere, service and food!!!
Review: We were welcomed by Jeremy who's just the best Maitre De!! I love casual dining with good food and and wine ; and that's exactly what we got. It's new and a bit quirky ..... good stuff

Author: belltingting
Title: very very great!
Review:
i was spend 3day 2 nite at langkawi , and have the great breakfast at fatcupid.
that breakfast is awesome , i really like that atmosphere at fatcupid ,is easy and relaxing!
I AM SURE I WILL GO BACK!!!

Author: JamesliKuala Lumpur
Title: Come one guys you can do great things here.
Review: Off the beaten track but nice surroundings, quiet and with very impressive decor. Welcoming and friendly staff with bags of enthusiasm. However...... I found the menu a little limited in choice and imagination. After seeing the creative surroundings I was expecting rather more than a fish and chips and hamburgers based menu. my wife had the fish and chips, good value, but the dreaded 'dory fish' (come on this is Langkawi with some great fresh sea food) and rather more batter than fish in her portion. I had the local Malaysian prawn and fried chicken dish, it was fine. I think the management here need to stretch themselves a little more with their menu, I suspect they can do great things and will surely be back there again to see them move beyond burgers and chips. Come on guys I know you can do it!Show less

Author: HRHSorayaCabo San Lucas, Mexico
Title: Not to Miss .....
Review: The stylish duo of Keith and Jeremy introduces to Langkawi a Culinary Speciality and Personal service like no other.Be Induldged with their mom's secret recipe as you bite into their Wantons ,or Thai Beef Salad ,and if you're lucky get Asian Persuasion with the "Aunties",Nyonya menu ...while sipping on fine wines and cocktails .It was a treat to dine here and it has quickly become my local.Show less

Author: DartydoLangkawi
Title: great new restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Great food and service in the lovely setting of Lapari-pari resort. Jeremy is a great host and welcomes his guest with friendly informality. The menu offers western delights and yummy food.Wines have been specially chosen. The service is swift and excellent. I enjoyed a great lunch here with all my friends (20 of us). We sat with a view of the pool which we could have dipped into if we hadn't been eating and talking so much. The food was great, fish and chips the favourite and yummy salads for the veggies. This is my 4th visit and has rapidly become on of my favourite places to eat in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Elaine BSubang Jaya
Title: The best western food in Langkawi
Review: Order something off the menu nd a bottle of wine, then get ready for a rocking good time. fatCupid serves awesome food, excellent conversation and front row seats to Lapari-pari (a beautiful resort)'s swimming pool. Start with the signature tasting plate (and a glass of wine). Then invite Jeremy for a chat.Then go for the hamburger and the pumpkin and mango salad. Both are juicy and absolutely yum. The breakfast menu is another must-eat. The best poached eggs that I have ever had in Malaysia is served hereShow less

Author: MiaFarizzaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very Impressed
Review: Crazy good food & drinks! Super Service.Typically, I'm not very forthcoming with praises especially in Langkawi. Have encountered too many so-so food with atrocious service and just about given up on this island (service & food)BUT fatCUPID made me pretty upset that they are not in Kuala Lumpur. Seriously. First of all, Jeremy is a darling & a half who whips up drinks like a magician. His cousin, Jacky is amazingly attentive, professional and polite. She has a way of making you feel really comfortable & just don't.want.to.leave.I tried the fruit juices mainly (I don't really drink alcohol) and it was really good. Jeremy gave it his little twist and it was really good and refreshing.It's casual dining with a really nice island-y vibe (which faces the pool btw) I love the atmosphere: white walls, a simple concrete bar and pretty dainty flowers in cute bottles on the glass top dining tables. It can get a little warm in the afternoons though but if you dine here, they let you use their pool. Nice touch!We tried the salads (Caesar,Thai beef salad) The Caesar salad is good with juicy chicken breast done just right (i usually don't like chicken breast), surprisingly the vege (lettuce, rockets etc) are really fresh. The Thai Beef salad is something else. Apparently the chef Keith makes his own sauces & it is just magnificient. The beef was done just right as well. In fact you don't even need a lot of dressing at all. The Wantans was out of this world. Seriously it is the best wantans i have ever had. The breakfast was also superb. Great generous portions. I tried the sweet potato chunks on toast with turkey bacon w/ poached eggs. Absolutely delicious! We ordered the Thai beef salad & wantans 2-3 more times in the following days. That was how good it was.Show less

Author: BeanettaLangkawi
Title: Beautiful food. Great ambience. Fantastic service.
Review: fatCUPID is so good that I've been back again and again. Everything tastes great but my favourite must have dishes have to be the wontons, amazing chicken sandwich and the heavenly pannacotta.

Author: Melephany
Title: Awesome veggie breakfast!
Review: After eating here last night (I had pizza bread and bruschetta followed by mango and pumpkin salad) I had to come back this morning! Being vegetarian I find it hard to find something special and Fat Cupid nailed it! I had poached eggs with gorgeous homemade hollandaise and mushrooms and veg on side with tasty beans and the nicest hash browns in Asia!!!!!!! This place can be found behind sunbar on the road by green village. The best bit is the fact you can use the pool upon dining here!!! Staff are so welcoming and we are glad we stumbled by entirely by accident!Show less

Author: Captainmatty
Title: Awesome everything
Review: Food and service is brilliant, steak sandwich was perfectly cooked, staff are super nice, will defo be coming back ASAP :) to try the rest of the food

Author: Mimi K
Title: Best won tons ever
Review: Great food, great service, great ambience. It's not easy to find a perfect omelet, and my 3 egg omelet with extra mushrooms for breakfast was simply divine. We adored the won-tons and the salads - we had the Thai Beef Salas and Calamari Salad. Nice big servings and absolutely yummy.Our steak sandwich was perfect, not dry or burnt and just the right size. Lip-smacking and finger lickin'. I also had "The Works" - typical English or Aussie brekkie that doubled as lunch. So good! Nice selection of wines and Jeremy also mixes slamming cocktails. Try his special Starfruit Caipirinha. Simply magic :) Show less

Author: VanilloSungai Buloh, Malaysia
Title: Not a strictly Italian restaurant.
Review: Go-to place for a good afternoon or evening meal. They cater for your tastes, menu is decent... bit of local, western. Price works for a restaurant like this. Staff are friendly and accommodating. Decent coffee. My favourite area of Langkawi.. beats the hell out of Cenang. During MCO, they open at 2pm. So no breakfast. Chilli Padi in your Cabonara (ask for it..)Show less

Author: ekta p
Title: Loved the food!!
Review:
We asked for vegetarian options and the lady said whatever you want, we can make vegetarian. And she did not disappoint. Pasta was delicious. Pizza was good. I did not like the drink though. 
The lady running the place was fantastic. Will come back.

Author: GGAdelaide
Title: Continues to impress.
Review: We have been to Sun Cafe a number of times on separate visits to Langkawi.  The food is good and the staff are lovely.  The toilets are always worth a visit.

Author: Bryan Redstone ... C
Title: Excellent food & service
Review: Great food, helpful & friendly staff. The Lava Cake is a must.  Just to make sure went back a couple of nights later - creme brulee this time & wasn't disappointed.

Author: tt53Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Always a warm welcome here
Review: This is one of our favourite restaurants in Langkawi. The menu has choices to suit everyone - from Malaysian staples like Rendang to pizzas, pastas and plenty more. But the most special thing is the warm welcome you get from Jeffrey and his very special team. Love it here.Show less

Author: 984ivanavCheb, Czech Republic
Title: Friendly staff
Review: We were on our way back to our hotel that was just close to the cafe, so we popped in to have a quick lunch. The food was tasty, the place stylish and the staff friendly and talkative. Prices might seem a bit higher compare to typically local places.Show less

Author: MancJRGWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Nice cafe with friendly staff
Review: This cafe was situated close to our hotel so we thought we'd give it a try. The cafe was very clean and nice decor. Staff gave us a choice of tables, inside or outside and took food and drinks orders quickly. Good presentation of meals, food was very nice and reasonably priced. Good choice of dishes on the menu so would suit most tastes. Show less

Author: Silvepp
Title: I highly recommend!
Review:
This place is amazing! Very clean and beautiful, food is delicious! Staff is super friendly and sweet!
We visit this restoran twice and I would come back every day if I would stay here longer :)

Author: mckaylewisDerbyshire, United Kingdom
Title: Best service in Langkawi!
Review: Me and my family stumbled across this hidden gem one evening whilst taking a walk in the opposite direction of the beach. We were greeted by a member of staff and felt at home right away. The staff are very professional and their knowledge of the menu is brilliant. The food was immense. The atmosphere was brilliant. We felt as though we had been visiting here for years. We payed another 2 visits to this restaurant and on our last evening, they reserved us a table and really looked after us all. I consider this one of the best restaurants on the island and we will all be returning when we're next in Langkawi - Thank you!Show less

Author: Stellainbirmingham
Title: Good food, good location
Review: We enjoyed our meal in this busy restaurant. Clean, good service, OK wine. Only one dish for non meat eaters which was a shame, but the veggie curry was nice and spicy.

Author: emeneMartigny, Switzerland
Title: at first, they greeted me
Review: at first, they greeted me correctly ... There was even an effeminate waiter who called me darling, which I moderately appreciated. then the atmosphere deteriorated following the laughs I made when seeing all the staff kissing old English women who giggled ... I asked a waitress how much she had kissed old English people that evening but since she didn't must not have humor she did not appreciate much. So tonight I was received like a dog in a game of skittles and that spoiled my meal. As I'm going back to Thailand in a few days for the rest of my vacation, I don't think I'll come back to this restaurant and I won't be deprived of it! Next year, we'll see ...Show less

Author: Keith T
Title: Great food in a relaxed atmosphere
Review:
We have dined here a few times, and we always receive a wonderful greeting from all the staff, we are treated like family.
The service and food are consistently great
Love the tempura vegetables

Author: Kirstie M
Title: Brilliant food
Review: The best thing about this restaurant is the staff! They are so friendly and make you feel very welcome. Food is also delicious and reasonably priced.

Author: tam431Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: We have been to this restaurant 3 time already on this holiday,and will be visiting again before our holiday is over. The staff are so knowledgable about the menu and so friendly. They also speak good English which is a great advantage for us. The food is amazing and the presentation fantastic. This is a must visit restaurant .Show less

Author: Star201080Doha, Qatar
Title: Tasty tasty food!
Review: We had amazing lunch here and it is a restaurant with excellent service. Food is really tasty and it has many options including traditional Malaysia's food. Recommended for a dining or even for a sweet and drink short stop. We got this super b recommendation by a local lady and it was worth it to go.Show less

Author: KCChye
Title: Great chocolate lava cake and creme brulee
Review: Great chocolate lava cake and creme brulee and the staff are very friendly. Restaurant is clean and bright. Hello Fauzi.

Author: DablooWSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, excellent service, beautiful ambiance
Review: Went on Christmas eve with 4 adults and 2 kids. Food was very good. They had good vegetarian option as well.Pumpkin soup was very good. The beef rendang was excellent.But the best part was the the excellent service. Even though the restaurant was packed, everyone, all the servers, the owners, everyone was very attentive and friendly.The owner brought Frangipani flowers for all the ladies and girls, a very nice touch.The food came very quickly, literally within 15 mins.When we were leaving, multiple servers came to wish us good night and Merry Christmas.Would highly recommend for a fun evening and good food.Show less

Author: Bowi72Kriftel, Germany
Title: Pleasant restaurant with hearty staff
Review: Pleasant restaurant with a nice terrace. The place isn’t the cheapest though the staff is hearty and helpful. The menu offers local, international and italian specialities. Feel free to come by car since there is a parkinglot just in front. We came cashless which isn’t a problem since credit cards are accepted, which was important to us and which is not obvious in many restaurants in Langkawi.Show less

Author: khushtush
Title: Good food!
Review: Me and my family had come here for dinner and we all felt that the food and the service was good.The staff were friendly and nice too.We had ordered the cheese burger, sun burger and the fettucioni carbonaro. All the dishes tasted amazing! The fat fries with the sun burger has an awesome pesto sauce flavour, and the cheese burger has an enormous patty. The fettucioni has the right balance of cheese and cream. Overall a good experience.Show less

Author: 230gemmad
Title: Super yummy food!
Review: We went here twice for lunch, because the food was super delicious, the drinks were fresh and yummy and the staff were really friendly. Definitely recommend

Author: DazDoof
Title: We were staying not a stones throw from here.
Review: We were staying not a stones throw from this restaurant and I must say the staff are great, funny, and very helpful, the food was lovely, it was busy every night we passed, the owners are lovely people.

Author: Darbuka
Title: Last dinner in Langkawi
Review: Visited earlier few years back. Friendly service and personal is good. Food is ok and will meet most european customers need. A bit pricer place anyways.

Author: satya2008
Title: Superb experience... A MUST TRY
Review: The staff was friendly. The lava cake was the specialty and is a MUST TRy. They cook it fresh and the taste was like being on cloud 9

Author: shawnli2010
Title: If there is minus star, I
Review: If there is minus star, I would have given it. Ordered seafood pizza and chicken satay. Pizza got shells and fish bones in it, like literally.... satay got chicken skin and taste hard as rock. I think we’ve been served with overnight food... absolutely horrible...

Author: 949uuuuum
Title: Super expensive for what? Horrible!
Review: Super expensive for what? Cold hot fish? They say not spicy but they distroye your stomach? Their horrible salad? For double the price of everywhere else? What a scam.

Author: TheLookCambodiaSihanoukville, Cambodia
Title: Every meal was delicious
Review: We had lunch and dinner several time at Sun Cafe during our stay in Langkawi, as is was located close to our hotel. Every meal we had was very delicious and well presented. Service was impeccable and the staff was very nice. My wife and son which are rather "difficult" eater enjoyed this place as well very much. Highly recommended for young and old. We would certainly go back to Sun Cafe if our travels would take us back to Langkawi. Thanks for everything!Show less

Author: Geordieboy88
Title: Great food
Review:
Went here for dinner one evening. The service and friendly staff were excellent, really helpful and attentive. 
The food was excellent with a nice choice of both western and Malaysian. 
Great price and great service!

Author: finbarandroy
Title: Yum
Review: So good we went twice. Steak, satay, salad, lamb shank, pizza, lava cake and brulee. All absolutely delicious.great cafe with lovely attentive staff. Good value for money. Highly recommended.

Author: zhinying
Title: Nice place with great view!!
Review: Quite amazed by the view and decorations in the cafe. Good food too!!! The coffee is great to wake you up in the morning with the stunning view!!

Author: Steffi_C_V_91Bern, Switzerland
Title: Great Restaurant
