Review: The restaurant is really cool and the waiters are very nice. The food is delicious. We had some Malayan curries which were spicy but not too much, so if you are used to eat western spicy you can do it. The lava cake as a desert was just perfect. We would highly recommend this restaurant! Show less

Author: essexalison
Title: Good food, friendly staff 😊
Review:
First time visit to Langkawi and returned twice as food was so good.
Attentive staff and cool toilets all added to the experience.
Variety of foods to choose from, both local & western options

Author: J9279JTnataliepBucharest, Romania
Title: Food and Toilets
Review: This is a really cool cafe in Langkawi. Waiters and waitress are incredibly friendly and attentive. We both had a pizza which were delicious. Not an extensive menu but it seems what they have they do well. Good selection of alcohol at a reasonable price. Then I went to the toilet... can’t quite describe the experience. Was like no toilet I’ve ever been to before. I won’t spoil it by describing it but will add that it was very clean. A must go to place in Langkawi. Good for couples and families. Show less

Author: 2lucky2goMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious
Review: We intended to eat some where different each night of our stay, but ended up returning here 3 times.The food was not only yummy.the staff were wonderful, welcoming and made you feel at home. You have to try the Barracuda its so flavorsome and delicious. Also If you like dessert, the crepe suzette and creme brulee was our favorite. The Lava cake popular and presented beautifully but you need to allow 20 mins. EnjoyShow less

Author: GDayMateAustraliaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Outstanding toilets!
Review: Not only is this a great place to eat, the toilets are beautiful. You will have to visit to see why. Really good Malaysian food. We had the curried prawns and chicken curry plus amazing marguitas. Service was outstanding, friendly and efficient. There is a warmth to this place, almost like dining in someone’s home. We loved it and will return. Seek it out whilst in Langkawi. So relaxing and delicious. Can’t wait to return. Show less

Author: Doris R
Title: Doris Robertson
Review:
The sun Cafe is lovely we visited there three times and enjoyed it
.the staff remembered my friend and I from five years ago even remembered what we had for dessert so I would recommend you visit it

Author: william l
Title: Relaxt
Review:
A special place with good service and food.
I liked the tempura with vegetables very much.
Best place (for lunch) in the neigbourhood.

Author: EJJ123456
Title: Delicious food, welcoming staff and great desserts!
Review: We visited Sun Cafe for dinner twice while staying in Pantai Tengah. The food is a mix of Western and Malay dishes. Lovely staff, reasonable prices and delicious food. My boys loved the lava cake for dessert!

Author: Glyn KFalmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great food wonderful service
Review: The menu is a good mix of traditional Malay dishes and western so something for everyone. The food quality is excellent and we enjoyed it so much we made a return visit during our stay. Best of all is the wonderful service from all the team, they really make a special effort to talk to the customers and make them feel welcome, absolutely fantastic and this made the Sun cafe our favourite restaurant during our 3 week family holiday to Malaysia. Brilliant!Show less

Author: fOoOOooOOoooDd
Title: excellent
Review:
the staff are so so so lovely and genuinely  care for the cafe and the customers and the food was amazing 

+ the toilets :)

Author: JoniM620
Title: Lovely place
Review: The food was good. Great service. The staff really seemed to care about the customers. I recommend this place.

Author: 569gabbyc
Title: Good food, friendly staff
Review: We loved this place, we came here a few times and found the food was great, wine was cold and staff really friendly. Love the spring Rolls and the Sun Burger. Definitely worth a visit even if it’s the middle of the afternoon for a drink. Show less

Author: Stevo M
Title: Food is good and staff is friendly
Review: We enjoyed the food here. The staff is friendly and helpful to our demands. They can improve on the air inside the restaurant as it was quite hot at 3pm in the afternoon.

Author: EdwardLiew128
Title: Nice Cafe near Cenang
Review: Easy accessible from main road in Cenang.  Nice ambience and nice setup.  We ordered Latte, Black Coffee and Chocolate Milkshake.  Of course, staffs are attentive and polite.  Great place to chill with the hot weather at 3pm.

Author: 306cathrynn
Title: Good service and great food
Review: Really tasty food with friendly and attentive service. Fairly priced. The barracuda dish was delicious. Plenty of choice. Highly recommended.

Author: Cassiecareri
Title: Great food, nice setting, lovely staff
Review: The food here was really good! If you love chocolate, the choc lava cake is to die for. It was the best lava cake I’ve EVER had! Would definitely go back again.

Author: AimanHafiz
Title: Amazing dinner
Review: What a lovely welcome. Good food,good service and the staff was a very friendly. Thanks for the amazing dinner.

Author: NickyLeics
Title: Delicious Lunch in Langkawi
Review: What a lovely place to stop for lunch. The beef rendang and chicken satay were delicious as was the triple decker toasty. The staff are all really friendly, and it was a really nice setting to have lunch.

Author: Nicm108
Title: Dinner
Review: Came here for dinner Twice during a one week stay. Staff were lovely and friendly and it’s a pretty setting. We ordered the beef rendang 2x,  sirloin steak  and cordon bleu and they were delicious.  Would definitely recommend!

Author: Irena LHong Kong, China
Title: Food
Review: Food in this restaurant tastes nice and staff are passionate and kind. It is a place which is quite good for breakfast, brunch and dinner. I have tried this restaurant ten years ago and their dishes taste the same which is delicious and the environment is comfortable. It is recommended for people who want to enjoy both light and heavy food.Show less

Author: Kate LLondon
Title: Dinner in Langkawi
Review: We came here as a last minute decision after walking past the restaurant. The setting is lovely. We ordered the satay and spring rolls to start which were good although the satay a little undercooked. For mains I had the barracuda which was nice and my boyfriend had the beef rendang which he really enjoyed. For dessert we opted for the lava cake which was delicious. Service was really good. Overall a good dining experience.Show less

Author: CristelynC
Title: Best Beef Rendang
Review: The food was good. We ordered pizza and beef rendang.Despite the price we paid for thr rendang, it was to die for. Will definitely come back just for that!

Author: Chinosgal
Title: Hmmm...not worth it!
Review: Unless it’s the ambience that you want, then you can eat here. The food is expensive and taste just so-so. We were the only customers during lunch time, so service was fast. I was disappointed after reading the good reviews!

Author: Ruchi B
Title: Good place!
Review: Liked the malaysian curry with rice and also the pesto potato wedges. Pinacolada was great and so was their mai tai. Nice place overall.

Author: Trevor & Kellie... P
Title: Excellent service
Review: Excellent service and the food was delicious. Service with a smile and visit from the pet cat. Would definitely visit again.

Author: Kasthuri T
Title: Late Dinner
Review: I think we reached just before 10pm and they were going to close at 10pm. They accepted us in happily and politely advised in advance that they won'y be able to add on orders. Food was delicious. Arrived quite fast at the table but it's a bit difficult to comment on the speed coz at that time we were the only ones there!Show less

Author: Isaac L
Title: Dinner on last day in langkawi
Review: Couldn't make up our mind what to have for dinner on our last day in langkawi. Our stomach has been working very hard for the past 1 week eating non stop ... Thinking to eat something light.. At last sun cafe was chosen base on review from fellow trip advisor comments. Order 2 different type of soup.. pumpkin soup and leek with potato . Well.. pumpkin soup wasn't up to expectation and it taste salty..couldnt finish it whereas the leek with potato soup was just good but not thick enough. Main course was the grill barracuda comes together with a plate of potato casserole. Overall taste for the main course 6.5/10 as found it too salty on the fish and the service was 8/10. There is a service charge 10% on top of your main bill. The place is clean and well lighted. Show less

Author: renatkhasanov
Title: Brilliant place
Review: Very very very nice place to have a food. Very delicious food, excellent service. I highly recommend to go there once you are in Langkawi.

Author: CkyyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good environment, food and service
Review: Been to this place three years ago which was our last visit to Langkawi. The place is still good with good and reasonably priced food. Environment is good and relax with friendly service staff.You have to check out the washroom which is unique and have a open air concept.Overall its a place to go to for a bite and located at the end of Pantai Cenang.Show less

Author: RoueG
Title: Best Beef Rendang!
Review: The resto’s location is very accessible. They’re situated along the road at Pantai Tengah. The staff are very accommodating and their beef rendang is to die for! Highly recommended.

Author: IsaXa2009Singapore, Singapore
Title: Outstanding food and service
Review: Absolutely a place to recommend. We enjoyed a great family dinner with a large selection between Asian and Westernese food; barracuda fish, prawns, noodles and Cordon bleu. With a great sweet finish; we particularly recommend the hot chocolate lava cake and the Crepe Suzette... Amazingly delicious! Service was to the level of the food, Super attentive and friendly staff. Thanks for the great time! Show less

Author: Mel A
Title: The staff make you feel so welcome
Review: The menu here is good, but what really makes this place, is the friendly staff. They are very professional and fun.We ate here on a few occasions, and were always made to feel very welcome. We noticed that the staff treated all their customers very well.The Crepe Suzettes are a must, and my husband really enjoyed his souffle. Definitely worth trying!Show less

Author: lenak637Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Simply Wonderful
Review: We went to this place after reading about it on TripAdvisor and came back for a second time the day after thanks to the wonderful service and the delicious food. The place is very cozy and romantic and the staff made us feel very welcome and at home. Food was perfect and the cat Lulu was super cute. Thank you so much Sun Café we will Come back next time when we are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: andretms2019
Title: Great service
Review: We dumped in at closing time craving desert and the place did not disappoint. We had thw chocolate lava cake and creme brulee. Both very good! staff was super pleasant and all smiles!

Author: Kathy A
Title: Wonderful dinner
Review:
Our best meal (delicious and reasonably priced) in our 4 day stay in Langkawi.  I would strongly  recommend the food and service/attentiveness to anyone.

Keep an eye out for the entertaining monkeys on the trees and hydro wires.

Author: Olive PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food
Review: Jeffrey and his team provide a great restaurant, with well cooked food and a variety of Asian and Western food.The restaurant is always spotlessly clean and Fauzi, Syasha, Jennifer etc. go that little extra to make the diners feel special.If there has to be a negative, it would be for an updated menu.Prices are very reasonable .Show less

Author: Bru1Christchurch, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous "Grilled Fillet of Barracuda"
Review: Been to Langkawi many times but first visit to this restaurant. On recommendation ordered the Barracuda for my main dish and wow it was simply stunning. The restaurant is very clean and the service service was excellent. I was able to bring my own wine and pay a small corkage charge but they also sell wine. Another bonus they accept credit cards. Just off the main road and we had no trouble parking. Certainly one of the best restaurants I have tried in that area.Show less

Author: linda g
Title: Fabulous
Review:
Cafe in name only - this is most certainly a restaurant which knows how to both cook and present beautiful food.

The staff are very welcoming and to top it all off they play great music

Author: SarahNJosh
Title: Lovely lunch stop
Review: We stopped here with family members who had been before. had a lovely meal and drinks. Nice relaxing location .

Author: ljwaller42
Title: Great restaurant
Review: We ate local dishes that were delicious but they also had western dishes that looked nice. We shared thai beef salad to start, delicious, then 2 different malaysian mains, both lovely

Author: LukeysarbearBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: More than just a cafe
Review: Both of us had delicious King prawns, cooked in a tasty sauce with great sauce and sides. We followed it up with a delicious chocolate pudding. Service was great and overall the price, while not the cheapest around was fair for the standard.I'm docking it a star only as the outside seating is next to a car park.. Albeit a quiet one. Show less

Author: tt53
Title: Love it here
Review: Food here is great but what makes the place so special is the great team of staff.  It is always one of our favourite places while we are on holiday in Langkawi.

Author: bostonbear75Boston, Massachusetts
Title: For the people don’t like salty food, please stay away!
Review: We came with high expectation because of tons of good reviews. However, those who gave reviews did try to give their honest opinion based on their experience. Unfortunately, I chose to ignore them and ended up writing a bad review about this restaurant. Well, my bad........In general, their food is salty. Maybe it’s ok with them, but to us, it’s quite salty, especially we asked in advance and also emphasized not to add any salt or salty seasoning to the food. They might not add extra salt to our food, however, their dressings to salads (we ordered two different kinds of salad) are both salty than the average. And they also lack the sense that they could put the dressing or sauce aside for customers to fix it themselves. After we reflected the salty issue, the first waiter didn’t try to fix the problem for us. Instead, he asked us to order a new one! Even though it was a waste, we had to return the salad. The second waitress was nice. She tried to solve the problem with other solution. We did appreciate that. The cheeseburger and the gravy for the lamb shank were also salty. For those who are not fans of salty food, please stay away from this restaurant.I didn’t experience the wonderful service or great food as other reviews mentioned. I will not return.Show less

Author: Bellview011St Austell, United Kingdom
Title: FANTASTIC
Review: The Sun Cafe, what a find, we have visited Langkawi 3 times now, and have just recently returned from there after a 10 night stay and 8 out of the 10 nights we ate and drank there. My husband had the Barracuda, which he enjoyed immensely. The whole menu is very comprehensive and ALL the staff, without exception, are a credit to the ambiance of the place. Love it......Thank you Sun CafeShow less

Author: 362deanab
Title: Delicious
Review: Wow. The suncafe is amazing. The staff are brilliant and so is the food. They always make a special effort to look after my mom who visits every year. Well worth a visit.

Author: IanLoveAyr, United Kingdom
Title: AWESOME
Review: We decided to eat here on our last night based on a recommendation from a fellow hotel guest - what a good decision that was.We were quickly shown to our table inside and this really is a very pretty restaurant as well as being spotlessly clean.Ordered my customary bottle of wine and we decided to share a Thai Beef Salad to start and it was great, we both decided on the Barracuda for main course and it was once again absolutely beautiful and very large portions. We had to have the Chocolate Lava Cake to finish and it's one of the nicest desserts I've ever tasted.One of the best meals on our holiday, fantastic food, great service and really reasonably priced - give it a go you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: Q9144ZYmariadNottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: Unexpected Gem
Review: Taste sensation! This place is something else! Due to the name, I'd underestimated how amazing this place could be.We were immediately greeted and shown to a table, given menus and left to decide.Blue lagoon cocktail and a mocktails arrived swiftly, complete with fruit decoration and frangipani flower. They looked and tasted incredible!Barracuda came with steamed vegetables and creamy potatoes au gratin. I'm not one for fancy food, I prefer mine set out on the plate, not all piled up like nouvelle cuisine, so when it arrived looking all fancy, I'd wondered if I'd made a mistake eating here. I was so wrong! An exotic explosion of flavours danced tantalisingly with me, as I savoured every mouthful! I couldn't speak. This really was so good! Every attention to detail was there, including the slices of mushrooms and delicious potatoes, but the barracuda was beautiful. Although I thought there wasn't much on my plate because it was all piled up, I was quite full up.The beef rendang was very nice indeed, very tasty.Dessert: I was a bit too full for dessert, but agreed to have it. I wasn't keen on any of the menu choices, but settled on icecream after starting I really didn't like vanilla. It came out as a beautiful bowl of strawberry and chocolate icecream with cream over exotic fruits, and, full as I was, it was so delicious that I ate it all!Chocolate lava cake - "it was beautiful". It looked great!The only down side was that the eager to please and friendly hosts tried just a tad too hard to please by repeatedly trying to interact with us. We just wanted a quiet meal. They didn't need to try so hard, because they're lovely people and their food is by far the best we've had in Malaysia.I very highly recommend Sun Cafe. It isn't a cafe, but a wonderful restaurant with incredible food.Show less

Author: ViajeraMc
Title: Horrible food
Review: I ordered chicken curry and it was awful. Honestly this place is not worth the money you pay. I left everything on the plate

Author: Wakey40Aus
Title: Last night in Langkawi
Review: Visited this great little find with 4 other couples for our last night in Langkawi on a recommendation from friends that had eaten there previously.It was well worth the visit, friendly and helpful staff where nothing was too much trouble, great selection of meals from traditional through to the tried and true Chicken Parma. One person in our group rated the lamb shank as the best he has ever had. And apparently the chocolate lava cake is one that you could keep going back for.Show less

Author: MillieB151
Title: Love This Place!
Review: We first visited the Sun Cafe 14 years ago and loved it! This was before the days of mobile phones and the thought of using something like trip advisor or Facebook was something we'd never imagined existing! The food is just as incredible as it was when we first tried it; the warm welcome and amazing team are just as fantastic and we even recognised a few faces!The memory which lasted with us was how incredible the toilets are (a weird thing to take away) but have you ever been somewhere there's a waterfall in the bathroom? Anyway, if you're on Langkawi, it's well worth a visit or two. The staff and the food are fantastic and we hope to visit again soon!Show less

Author: nymak
Title: Lovely Cafe
Review: Excellent staff and service. We just had tea and coffee but it was a really lovely little spot to sit and relax and take in the sights and sounds of beautiful langkawi.

Author: DavidJTurley16Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Restaurant!
Review: This restaurant was close to the hotel that me and my girlfriend were staying at in Langkawi. We had dinner here on our first and last nights in Langkawi. The food was amazing; I had a chicken curry the first time and a burger the next time and really enjoyed them both.The staff are also friendly in there and give the restaurant a really good name! Well worth a visit if you’re in Langkawi! Show less

Author: kassif3778
Title: Happy
Review:
We are happy that we found a good restaurant with best hospitality and best quality food. The environment is so calm and let us enjoy our moment .... Tq SunCafe for your existing in Langkawi. 

For me price is reasonable. 👍👍👍

Highly recommended.

Author: Alan FOldham, United Kingdom
Title: best food on pentai cenang/tengah
Review: visited early December.we have been to the sun for over 14years and as always been consistently very good,the same owner from the start.the staff are fabulous very attentive and helpful with the owner usually in the background with an eye on business ,this is the key to success be interested in your clientel.with so many restaurants closing and gone over the 18 years we have been visiting pentai cenang this place stands out as the only good food around outside of an hotel.oh did I mention the food is extremely good and the place is sooo! cleanShow less

Author: Etienne257
Title: Must visit
Review:
Too bad we found that place on our last night in langkawi.
Delicious food served by extremely friendly people.
The chocolate lava cake is unbelievably delicious!
Very good cocktail aswell.
Thx

Author: 566aubreydHounslow, United Kingdom
Title: relaxed
Review: nice ambiance, and welcoming stafffood was well presented, but the barracuda, although generous in size, was too over seasoned.my burger was equally salty, and the meat too finely minced,but the chips and bun were fab!crepe suzettes were microwaved to a tee.overall though, a nice evening.Show less

Author: ZeeHamdan1989Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Perfectly Cosy
Review: Need I say more? This is highly recommended! The barracuda was perfect! We had that, along with the cordon bleu which was excellent, not oily at all. The chicken was perfectly cooked yet moist and juicy. The marinara spaghetti was divine! If you’re here, don’t forget to order the chocolate lave cake, it’s a dream come true to all chocolate lovers! All in all, everything is perfect, good food even better company. Zi & fazzy xx Show less

Author: Andrew O
Title: excellent service and food
Review: Very nice staff, and a particularly nice vegetarian curry. Desert was also very good. Its only a short walk from Camar Resort and was quite pleasant outside as there was a breeze.

Author: luckyeddys
Title: Nice food, great service
Review: We ate here on a couple of occasions and also had just drinks a few times. Food was well presented and very tasty. The staff, especially Shasha, Jennifer and Fauzi were friendly and efficient and always had time for a chat and a laugh.

Author: GrahamStephensPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Simple menu well done with excellent service.
Review: This cafe close to Pantai Tengah and set back from the main road is open all day and serves a simple menu of breakfast, lunch and dinner items. Easy parking. Environment is clean and service is with a smile from all the staff. We always gravitate there when staying in the Frangipani resort which is just across the road. One of the main attractions is that the house wine is very drinkable and very good value. The food, while fairly traditional cafe style, is tasty and the staff will adapt menu items to your liking if they can. Mostly western but with some local choices too. No air-conditioning but with many ceiling fans I have never felt uncomfortable there. You can choose indoor or al-fresco seating. Even at popular times you can find a seat and tables are cleared and cleaned promptly.Show less

Author: simonv361
Title: Good food, excellent service
Review:
We had some good food with a good price/quality rate. We paid 150 for a starter, main cours and dessert. Cocktails where good to, mixt in front of our table.

Oh, the toilets are special ;)

Author: jerry3162
Title: Sun cafe 14 years on
Review: Still the best cafe 14 years on when we first visited. Great staff and the standards of the restaurant have still been kept high. Would recommend lunch or dinner.

Author: SBRoq
Title: Lovely place which reminded me of Bali
Review: Very beautiful place with good food & drinks andere very Nice people.... With also the nicest toilets... Which looked like you where entering a Spa !

Author: BritinUSA6Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great
Review: This place was walking distance from our hotel, but is a little out of the way. It was very quiet the evening we visited. The menu was extensive and they were happy to adapt the dishes to suit us. Very friendly staff, really made us welcome. Would definitely recommend.Show less

Author: sunnygarg27Mumbai, India
Title: Most amazing food in Langkawi
Review: Hi, we went there for one of our lunches when we were staying in Langkawi.We loved the Italian food and it was very tasty.The people managing were really great and hospitable.It had a great ambience.We loved this place.Soup, pizza, pasta, garlic bread were amazing.They recommended us desert. I don't remember the name but it was very yum.If you are visiting Langkawi, please do visit and enjoy your food out here.Show less

Author: Smileypokey
Title: Friendly place.
Review: Nice restaurant with friendly service near our hotel.  We had tempura to start then shared a chicken curry.  Food is good and prices reasonable. Best is the friendly staff.

Author: Wildcat7400Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food, Excellent Service!
Review: We were supposed to go to Fat Cupid for a late lunch. However, they were closed. So, we headed to the Sun Café as it was not too far from where we were.The restaurant looked inviting & a little up market than the rest. We chose a table & found the ginger coloured resident cat asleep on one of the chairs. Not wanting to disturb it, we chose a different table. Shasha, the friendly staff saw our bags of chocolates & offered to keep them all in the restaurant’s chiller while we dined in. We were so grateful & warmed up to her instantly. She was quite a character & very friendly. She made light conversation with us & gave many pointers for other local eateries & chocolate shopping places.Tasha, another staff was also very helpful. She gave some recommendations & we went along with it. I shared the barracuda with a friend. Two other friends had a pasta & a burger, respectively. For dessert, between the 4 of us, we had devoured the crepe suzette & the chocolate lava cake. The barracuda meal was a winner in my book. I am definitely going back for another round next year & this time, I won’t be sharing!Loved the ambience & top-notch service from the friendly staff but most importantly, kudos to the chef for creating such mouth-watering dishes. The only complaint I had was that the restaurant was not equipped with any air-conditioning. It could get very hot in the day & we were quite sweaty even with the ceiling fan above our heads. Also, the price we paid for lunch was a little expensive but it was worth every Ringgit & sen. We hope that they will open a branch in Kuala Lumpur soon.Show less

Author: Trish H
Title: Bloody terrible
Review: Went here for dinner . Should have known by the weird taste of the piña colada that the meal would not be good. Had prawn mee goreng. Left 95%. Just horrendous. Went there with local Malay and they couldn’t eat their dinners either

Author: timetravel_12
Title: Welcome welcome
Review: Clean comfortable place,extensive menu and the staff friendly. Free wifi. Enjoyed meal (photos ) will return before going home.

Author: Patrycja C
Title: Smacznie i przemiło
Review: Wonderfull staff, delicious food in good prices. If u dont know where u want go for dinner defenitely go there

Author: nomadridrebBengaluru, India
Title: Probably the best food ive ever had
Review: When I travel I put in a lot of time & research into finding the recommended places to eat in. But sometimes fate plays a crucial role and you walk into a restaurant not knowing the ratings or reviews and have some of the best food of your life ..... This was one such place ..... You are greeted so warmly when you enter ...... My friend is allergic to egg and they patiently told us what he could and couldn't order ..... What I love is the menu has pictures of what the food looks like so as a foreigner to this country that's something that really helps .... I loved this place so much I went back again the next day for dinner ..... The people running the restaurant remembered us and gave us a small souvenir since we were leaving the next day .... The first time we went we ordered chicken Satay , beef rendang and pesto potato wedges and choco lava cake ...... The second time we went for a light dinner and ordered bruschetta , garden salad and creme brule ..... Each and everything we ate was cooked to perfection the flavours so perfect ....the salad was probably the best salad I've ever had in my life , so perfectly balanced ....the crunch , sweet , sour all perfectly balanced ..... The hosts are amazing people who take sometime to get to know you ..... For someone who loves food and appreciates good service sun cafe is a must visit .... I wouldn't mind coming back to Langkawi just to have a meal here and then rush back .... Show less

Author: Sarah KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: We visited this restaurant 5 times during our 11 day trip, which tells you how impressed we were with the food. It serves Malaysian and western food, which is really tasty at a reasonable price. It has a laid back atmosphere and the staff are amazing, really chatty and friendly. I would highly recommend this restaurant as one to visit during your trip.Show less

Author: SkwhyteLondon
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: My partner and I recently visited the Sun Cafe for dinner as previously read great reviews and our experience did not disappoint! We were lucky to get a seat and grabbed the last table as they were fully booked!! Both of us had the Barracuda dish which was lovely! This came with spinach, gratin potatoes(which were unbelievable) and a sauce. This dish was great! We then finished off with the chocolate Lava Cake which has everyone talking and boy did we know why!!!.... we added a scoop of ice cream and it was so rich and indulgent!!! The meal was fantastic and to top it off the staff were great too! They even helped us call a taxi to take us back to the hotel. All in all im sad this restaurant isnt back home!!! Show less

Author: 65Graham65
Title: Our Cafe haven
Review: Just next door to Villa Molek is perhaps the best cafe in Langkawi.   Great food and drinks and to die for Creme Brouley.   Very friendly staff (just like Villa Molek)  comfortable, quiet, convenient, not expensive, just a great cafe/restaurant.

Author: Wanderer787440
Title: Fabulous Food
Review: I can highly recommend this restaurant. Food was out of this world and service was magic. Will definitely be visiting here again before we leave 😁

Author: F00die_SamBolton, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food!
Review: What a great find! We ate at the Sun Cafe last night and it was wonderful from start to finish. We chose this place after reading reviews and were not disappointed. The staff were so friendly and the food was exceptional. We took advice on recommendations of the fresh fish and it was really tasty. There was a great choice for everyone ranging from fish, meat, pasta and pizza. All reasonably priced and beautiful surroundings. The chocolate lava dessert is the best pud we have had in Malaysia! Make sure you give it a try.Will definitely return. Show less

Author: SharonJT
Title: Chocolate Lava cake is sensational
Review:
We loved it so much we went back, and the staff remembered our names from our first visit!
Fantastic service and food.
The food is great and the desserts are to die for.

Author: Simon BHong Kong, China
Title: Gourmet, not Cafe
Review: We first tried Sun Cafe just for some cool and refreshing drinks mid-afternoon whilst walking pass on the way to our hotel. The very first thing that strikes you is the friendly staff. Before you have even sat down you are greeted with a big warm smile. While having our drinks we browsed the food menu and decided we would return to sample the dishes on another evening.Upon our return the next day we were greeted like family and quickly seated. Drinks orders were taken first and delivered quickly so we could cool down and browse the menu.The menu is diverse but not too extensive. Which is reassuring as it is better to do a few dishes well, rather than many dishes poorly.We dined as a family of 4, 2 adults and 2 teenagers. We started with Bruschetta and a Caesars Salad. Both of which were packed full of flavour, without being over seasoned. This was a sign of good things to follow.For main dishes we ordered a very eclectic mix. Spaghetti Marinarra, Nasi Campur, Chicken Cordon Bleu and a Lamb Shank. All of which were bursting with flavour and with a sensational taste. Everything tasted freshly prepared and nothing seemed pre-prepared, but common sense tells you that during dinner service a chef has to do some prep! This is a testament to the skill and quality of the kitchen team. The rich mushroom and onion gravy that came with the lamb was superb and I had to order some garlic bread (the owner actually rushed the order through the kitchen to ensure my gravy didn't get cold!) to soak it up and wipe the plate clean and suck the bone dry!We couldn't resist the Chocolate Lava Cake, so we ordered 2 to share, but in truth the teenagers ate 90% of them, but from what little we could grab it was a chocolate delight. Any experienced home cook can tell you that to get that sponge and the inner chocolate sauce bomb to be perfect every time is further proof of the skilled chefs.As another reviewer said, the Cafe in the name does not do the quality of this dining experience justice. Do not be fooled, this has to be one of the best places to eat in this price range. We had all the food detailed previously, plus 10 drinks and the bill was RM 372. I recommend you dine here at least once during your stay.Praise also has to be given to the front of house team who will spend time chatting about anything you want and seem genuinely committed to ensuring your time in their care is enjoyable.Oh yes! And there is the resident ginger & white cat, who obviously enjoys the food served here too, haha!Show less

Author: N9512OEpaulp
Title: Nice establishment
Review: Very nice European oriented dishes. Friendly staff and a clean restaurant. Walking distance from Frangipani

Author: Jennifer W
Title: Super clean, decor' excellant, food wonderful
Review: Great food, great prices. Crepe suzette amazing. Wonderful staff especially Jennifer. The cooks are first class, would not be out of place anywhere in the world.

Author: Candyandrichard
Title: Don’t be put off the name!!
Review:
This is not a cafe,the food was amazing,staff were really friendly and it was really reasonable!
It was highly recommended and really pleased we tried it as all the food was incredible!
My friend and I had a barracuda special which was amazing!

Author: CMay193Farnham, United Kingdom
Title: A great find
Review: We were recommended this place by the owner of our villa and we weren't disappointed. The food was amazing and lots of choice to suit our whole party of varied tastes! I had the barracuda fillet which was incredible. The staff were really helpful and friendly and the cocktail we're good too. A lovely evening.Don't be put off by the name as we nearly were, apart from the lovely relaxed atmosphere there is nothing 'cafe', about it this is a fantastic restaurant.Show less

Author: V6990YNphilipc
Title: Good local place to eat.
Review: Herro Sun Cafe,We had our lunch here and the food was fantastic. We only ate the Malaysian food though they serve a variety of different dishes such as pasta and pizza.Waiter was friendly and they have a cat :)The duty free is also right next door if you want to pick up some cheap booze for your trip.Show less

Author: huck_01
Title: The best food in Langkawi! Must try!
Review: We had Thai Salad, Lamb Shank and Black Pepper Steak. Both lamb and steak were very tender and delicious! The soft music was a great addition to the great ambience we had during the dinner. Highly recommended!

Author: VickyC2496
Title: Dorset
Review:
Lovely warm welcome, great food. Toilets an experience in a good way. A first for me!!
All clean top marks

Author: Zul A
Title: Barracuda Fillet!
Review: Had a lovely dinner with the Missus here. They Offered a friendly and helpful service. The waiter recommended their barracuda fillet and it was very-very good!. Not so much for its chicken ham aglo - olia though.Would really recommended others to have a quite a lovely time here as its location is not as busy in chenang beach road plus they have plenty of parking options.Show less

Author: kaw27Brisbane, Australia
Title: GREAT ROMANTIC DATE PLACE
Review: Had dinner here because looking for a closer restaurant near our hotel. This restaurant is just across our hotel, Tropical Resort. Upon arrival, waiter and manager came to greet us. 4 tables were already occupied as dinner crowd. Ordered pizza and pasta also the lava cake for dessert. Service was efficient and promt. Clean and very spacious restaurant. Very nice toilet at the back. Food was delicious and the manager was sweet to hand me a flower for picture taking. Also a resident fat cat around. All in all will def come back. Show less

Author: Pupae L
Title: Good food!
Review: Good food, fresh and delicious! Nice place to hang out and have lunch with your couples, friends and family!

Author: Ashish B
Title: Amazing Italian food in a small cozy place
Review: This place was small and cozy with nice porch to sit outside in evening. Their Italian was finger licking good although the price was little on the higher side. Must try for pizza lovers.

Author: mindlesspaul
Title: Had a great dinner
Review: Really nice place with an excellent staff. The food is great and prices are reasonable. The lava cake for desert does it. And, like other reviews mentioned, make sure to visit the bathroom.

Author: monethetripper
Title: Avoid
Review: My dinner was rather unenjoyable. I chose the Nasi Lemak but it was dry and not as nice as other establishments. Plenty of other places to try instead.

Author: Sumeetbasrani
Title: Great view and ambience
Review: The restaurant has a very warm ambience and a great green view if you’re sitting outside. The food was also good

Author: Frank0870Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A must when in Langkawi
Review: I fly to Langkawi every year, and it’s a must to have dinner in this restaurant. Waiters still recognise you and wish you a very warm ‘Welcome back!‘. I like the atmosphere, very good service and very delicious food. Yes, it’s a bit more expensive than other restaurants. However, mostly you sit alone in the other restaurants and the food is not as delicious as in Sun Cafe. Keep up the good work. I‘ll be back. Show less

Author: 110kirkr
Title: Stunning Cafe
Review:
Gorgeous choice of food, elegantly presented and very good value.
A must for any LGBT travellers and just people who would like good food at very reasonable prices with a laid back atmosphere

Author: michaelleekk
Title: Delicate fruit juice
Review: The fruit juices is very delicate and smooth presented. The ambience is open and natural. We like it so much!

Author: aussietraveller1960
Title: Very well presented food
Review: Loved the way the food was presented at Suncafe. It really added an extra touch to a tasty meal. Just be aware that Suncafe adds a 10% service charge to the final bill.

Author: dave wNowra, Australia
Title: amazing
Review: this place is an amazing place. the staff are super cool and the ambiance is great. the food is fantastic and a range of choice even for vegetarians. they have cocktails and beer. and even the bathrooms are wonderful with a view!! what makes this place great though is the staff are friendly welcoming and fun as well as very efficient. they make the place so good we went back several times over the two weeks we were there. we were a group of five in our family and always enjoyed our lunch or dinner hereShow less

Author: Esther L
Title: foods okay, slightly pricey
Review: the foods were satisfactory. the staff are friendly. Place are clean but without air-con so it was hot during the lunch time.

Author: wendyk621Seattle, Washington
Title: Pleasant Dining Experience
Review: We had dinner here, vegetable tempura, grilled king prawns, chicken cordon Bleu and creme’ brûlée. Reasonable prices, good wine by the glass, very friendly servers. Not gourmet food but definitely edible. A huge rainstorm with thunder and lightening came up while we were dining and they had to close all the doors to keep us dry. It was kind of fun to be nice and dry and sipping wine while the short lived storm unleashed its fury. All around a pleasant evening.Show less

Author: AusKIWIPerth
Title: Was very good super clean
Review:
We had two meals a late lunch which was perfect Then an evening meal again very nice.
Not a lot of local food however a nice change. Drinks good

Author: 1001-tastesMexico
Title: Delicious but pricey
Review: We went there for dinner. You should try their potato gratin! That gratin can easily compete with European made gratins! We had there also a Chicken Cordon Bleu and a Pizza Margherita. Both were delicious but there are even better places for Pizza in Langkawi (see our other reviews). You also should go to the toilet, what fantastic place ;-) ! Show less

Author: caplee79
Title: Nice simple restaurant
Review: We chose this restaurant for the vicinity to our resort and didn’t regret it: good Malay food and some western options. Friendly service.

Author: mikehillchefHeathfield, United Kingdom
Title: Best bar restaurant in lankawi
Review: 4th visit to langkawi and as ever the sun cafe is still the best place on the island.Food drink and atmosphere are first class and cannot say enough about the most fantastic staff who have become friends and recognised us as soon as we walked in.It’s just such a wonderful place and can’t wait to go back next year .Show less

Author: amarab2018
Title: Terrible customer service
Review:
Really disappointed with the food   Terrible customer service overpriced for crap food steak was that chewy it was like Trying to eat rubber. 
The Chinese lady owner is very rude stay away from this place

Author: 338andriym
Title: Excellent
Review: We have found this place nearby our hotel, quite, comfortable, cozy, really nice staff, good selection of european/western and Malay food ( the best we have eaten during our stay in Malaysia), reasonable price.

Author: AlexandraDKGermany
Title: Tasty dinner, fresh juices & cocktails
Review: This restaurant was a great discovery - highly welcoming personal, inclusive and open for jokes or chat. A nice place, luckily not too close to the street. They offer a wide selection of dishes - most recommendable was the grilled Barracuda and the fresh juices (!!!), as well as the desserts menu (crep Suzette)Show less

Author: Brooke W
Title: Wonderful!
Review:
My husband and I came here for lunch, very nice and prompt service. Staff were friendly and made you feel welcome. 
Food was delicious and my husband loved his burger so much he wants to try and re create it at home!

Author: traceyandpeter
Title: Pretentious and overpriced
Review: Food was just ok. I usually keep the receipt to remind me what we have to eat but I didn't even bother here. The menu read very well and was very evocative, unfortunately when the food arrived, it didn't live up to that promise.

Author: Dale TWellingborough, United Kingdom
Title: What a Great Restaurant
Review: After arriving in Langkawi on Chinese New Year we needed somewhere to have a good meal and Sun Cafe was mentioned and we where so glad we visited (3 Times). Great place with friendly staff we a good sense of humour who made the experience worth while. I would recommend a visit so remember to dress accordingly and enjoyed the great food. Note this restaurant is above the standard of most over Restaurants in the area and well worth the extra Ringets!!!Show less

Author: Jilldubbs
Title: Well recommend
Review:
Many people that we spoke to at about hotel recommended this place. Well worth a visit, the staff were very helpful with the menu and the food was delicious!
I’m sure we’ll be making another visit before we go home

Author: BernardD88Panama City, Panama
Title: All around great experience!
Review: We were in a near by hotel and it was mentioned by someone as a real good food place. We went there 9 people, they welcomed us and made a quick table to accommodate us on the terrace as we wanted to dine out. Service was provided by what I believe is the owner, she was a real pro, recommended many different things, and got all our orders right! Not my usual experience lately in Indonesia and Thailand. Food was excellent for everyone, I heard no complaint what so ever. I tried the barracuda, it was really tasty, well done, served up on a bad of spinach and vegetables, it came HOT (as in warm, not spicy) and with the warm plate and hot sauce it remained hot throughout. (I hate, but often get, plates that arrive lukewarm and get cold rapidly) All around great experience and IMHO not at all expensive for the quality they serve.Show less

Author: MelisaHa93
Title: Very overpriced and cheating on drinks
Review: We went here because of the reviews. We honestly don’t understand why this restaurant got this high in the ranks. The food is very overpriced, 22RM for an “okay” cheeseburger. Besides that we ordered 2 cola’s and they use 1 can for the both of us by putting it in glasses filled with a lot of ice. So you end up paying 12RM in total for 1 can of Coke. I asked two staff members about the cola, the first one said the can is finished and later showed me from the bar 1 finished can of Coke. We were like okay you used 1 can for two glasses, that’s exactly what we were saying. That’s why I asked again to another staff member who was serving the food why we won’t get 2 cans instead of two small glasses filled with ice. (After some time you’ll notice half of your drink is water as on the pictures.) The staff member said that a lot of restaurants do so and that I needed to ask for a can. The staff members didn’t even try to fulfill our needs. When guests try to give you feedback face to face to work it out and to make your restaurant better, I don’t think you should ignore that. Show less

Author: Soopau
Title: Two nights running. ...
Review: Visited after recommendation. So pleased we did. Superb food and excellent service. Fantastic value too. Really worth a taxi ride from Cenang beach if the walk is too far .

Author: KiiraAndMikko
Title: Afternoon meal
Review: This place has the most impressive and beautiful toalet ever seen!  We came here a year ago and and some of them still remembered us🤗Food and service still great. We had burger and pasta for a change.

Author: Hoss_Kar
Title: Must try the best in Langkawi
Review: We tried many others eaterys in Langkawi and found this one to be every professional it run very well. The food was delicious and the service was well organized, both meals came together, it even had cloth napkins a first in Langkawi.we will return.

Author: cmsflorence
Title: Nice place for a drink.
Review: Good place for drinks. The prices are right and our drinks were made well. I had a delicious pasta dish. The food around me was enjoyed by the patrons.

Author: Sumayah50
Title: Good
Review:
We tried the lava cake, crepe & cappuccino they were good
The waitress was a bit on a hurry but she was nice

Author: 623allenhLisbon, Portugal
Title: Great food, excellent and friendly service.
Review: Recommended on Trip Advisor and deservedly so. The staff make you feel really welcome, so good we returned for a second visit whilst in Langkawi. The Cafe / restaurant is comfortable and welcoming and the staff were excellent, friendly but not pushy. The menu has a good selection, we tried a few of the local dishes and enjoyed good sized portions and very tasty food.Drinks are not expensive and the cocktails were strong!Recommend the lava cake and crepes - excellent desserts.Cost approx. 200MR for a 3 course meal for two with drinks. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: HungryTravellerAscotSunninghill, United Kingdom
Title: Worth a visit
Review: This is a good restaurant. The staff are very friendly, it is clean, the service is excellent and the food is very good. The wine is at a sensible price - about £14 for a drinkable bottle of imported Shiraz.Compared to most of the restaurant down “the strip” this is certainly one of the best.Show less

Author: zalnikor
Title: Average food
Review: Small menu for vegetarians.Nothing exciting or special.Tried their potatoes au gratin,which were fine.on one of the main roads.

Author: DENC0322Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding restaurant
Review: We visited this restaurant on a recommendation and were not disappointed. The food was outstanding. We both had starters and local dishes for main, and even found room for the very special lava cake desert. The food was so good we returned a coupe of nights later and were really pleased we did. The grilled prawn dish was as good as any other prawn main I have ever tasted. I couldn’t recommend it enough. The barracuda was also fantastic. The staff are amazing. They really make a special effort to accommodate. Wish we were staying longer just to try this place again!Show less

Author: zzzoodashna
Title: Excellent Local food!
Review:
I’m guessing the chef is local because the local dishes here are to die for...absolutely excellent! The quality of the food and flavours was really beyond my expectations. Lovely ambience and lovely service. 
I really recommend the noodles....I just couldn’t get enough!

Author: _bvigsnes
Title: Feel like coming home
Review:
The food and service was exellent.
On our first dinner we felt like home so we went back again and again. 
Most higley recomemded.

Author: G9418QPsamg
Title: Cold and soggy pizza but...
Review: It's a shame I'm writing this because everything was good except the pizza. It had the makings of a great Italian thin crust but the chef ruined it. We had the Bruschetta to start and it was delicious. My girlfriend ordered the Carbonara and it was good and served piping hot. However, my pizza arrived cold. I asked them to warm it up twice and finally it came back hot. Sadly I suspect the chef used a microwave because it came back a soggy mess. The staff didn't charge us for it and offered to make a fresh one, the service was very good. If you arrive and it's very busy consider coming back another time. Show less

Author: 158kareldBrisbane, Australia
Title: Good food, good service
Review: We were warmly welcomed by the staff/owners. The restaurant is nicely set up with outside and inside tables. The menu has a good selection of Western and Asian food. We ordered Baracuda, chicken parmigiana, prawn noodles and satay chicken. Every meal was beautifully presented. Unfortunately the prawns were overcooked and the chicken tasteless. Otherwise a lovely experience! Show less

Author: danidee2014
Title: Service first class food A class
Review: Absolutely lovely staff ,friendly talkative and helpful serving lovely well presented food in an all round good atmosphere.

Author: tink58Roma
Title: Very pleasant
Review: Sun Cafe is always good for lunch, dinner or just a drink. The staff are welcoming, the food is good, the decor is attractive and the bathroom is something else!

Author: HappyfeetII
Title: Worth checking out
Review: We went for lunch. Had the barramundi, king prawns with fettuccine, margherita pizza, spaghetti napolitana, lava cake and ice cream.Love love love the barramundi and napolitana. Lava cake - I’m a darkchocolate lover - find it too milo-ish for me and not dark and bitter enough for my liking. In a tourist island and that kind of price, this is still a good find as food is prepared with care. Worth checking out. Show less

Author: HenryMsiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Didn’t have a fantastic dinner....
Review: 1) Restaurant is hot despite many fans are turned on at highest speed. 2) Smoke from fire burning leaves came into the restaurant, not so pleasant while dining. 3) A Cat was sleeping on the chair next to our table, not so hygienic. 4) 2 Dogs were going in and out of the restaurant for a while. 5) Spaghetti Bolognese is way TOO SALTY! Show less

Author: dan24lennon
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Had a very good time with family. Service very nice and menu had lots of choice. Had a beef renang there which were fabulous and the lava cake just wonderful.

Author: javier_por_el_mundoJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great restaurant, excellent service
Review: We had dinner two times in Sun Cafe while during our stay in Langkawi. Tried several dishes all very good. Pasta was al dente (a concept that even most Italian restaurants in Malaysia don't know). Salads fresh and creative. Attentive staff that engages on good conversations. Midrange price. Don't miss the warm chocolate cake with ice cream..Show less

Author: Devraj1974Canberra, Australia
Title: Excellent cafe with a personal touch
Review: We really enjoyed Sun Cafe. The owners were very nice and made sure the guests are well looked after. The fresh watermelon juice was amazingly refreshing. We ordered some asian food for lunch which was yummy and the portion size was very good. If you like a good cup of coffee then this is the place.Show less

Author: only1invillageLondon
Title: Good western food, mid range price wise
Review: If you need your fix for western food, you cannot go wrong here for select dishes. The barracuda is very good. First came here 8 years ago when there was a souvenir shop attached to the restaurant. Still the same bar man that I recognised! Modern looking restaurant and clean western style toilets out the back. Value for money is not great especially for the fresh juices and salads. Having said that, it is of course, still cheaper than London prices. The ice cream dessert was just three scoops from a big supermarket bought tub. The creme caramel was good. The Malay dishes are bad value for money. The bread in the toasted sandwiches is the usual sweet bread and the cheese was the processed type that gets peeled off individual plastic wrappers. Show less

Author: janek11kowalskiWarsaw, Poland
Title: Cheating on drinks
Review: We went there with my family for a lunch. We have ordered some wester food - hamburger and carbonara. The food was ok, not bad even. But I was shocked when they served me coke - it was a little pricey- costed 6 RM but it contained not more than 150 ml of coke, the rest was ice (look at the picture). I felt cheated because I expected at least 330 ml can or bottle. Such good restaurant should never use such cheap trick to get more profit. And the second negative - you can not decide on the tip, mandatory service charge is included. The food was also quite expensive - 22 RM for hamburger is quite high. I can not recommend that restaurant.Show less

Author: mikelennon2018
Title: Excelence
Review: This is a restaurant. Excelent food, value for money, good taste, professional service. The restaurant is very clean. Keep it up guys....

Author: 11Globetrotter11Johannesburg, South Africa
Title: Great food that is well presented
Review: Popped into Sun Cafe for lunch and had crisp fried spring rolls, a delicious pizza and a fragrant Malay chicken curry. The service was friendly and efficient and the food was really good. The restaurant is open and airy and has a great ambiance. We paid just under 100 Malaysian Ringets for a good meal that included two beers.Show less

Author: syashak2017
Title: Amazing... Love the food,place and staff.
Review: Most of the restaurant was full during new year eve,luckily i get one table for me and friends. They selling set dinner and ala carte that night. Surprisingly, for rm88 per person i get 3 courses dinner..and it was yummy,good and fantastic. It was so busy,but the staff still give us smile and keep coming to our tableto make sure we are ok..I chose seafood combo for my main,its a very good combination,their top menu: barracuda and grill king prawns!The staff told me the menu its only during CHRISTMAS EVE and NEW YEAR EVR DINNER! I'm happy with the food,the service... HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.. Show less

Author: ApplefeeEstonia
Title: One of the few really neat and tidy places on the island
Review: Most eateries and cafes seem to be quite run down here, not very well maintained, not always clean, tidy and pretty. That can sometimes put us, Europeans, off even if food is all right. Sun Cafe, however, is actually nice, clean, well maintained and tidy, newly renovated and airy. Consequently it’s also a bit more expensive but drinks are chilled, coffee is freshly brewed and service quick and friendly. Didn’t try the food but there seemed to be quite a lot of western dishes on the menu as well as some local ones.Show less

Author: ps810Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely food
Review: We had lunch here. Had the lamb shank and it was cooked to perfection. Really enjoyed it. We also had the spring rolls which were tasty. The cocktails were good too. The staff are so friendly and make you feel at home. Will definitely recommend this place. By the way this place has maintained its standards since I first visited in 2006 and have been coming back whenever we're in LangkawiShow less

Author: JamieS781Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Christmas Day Dinner
Review: Loved it. Been 2 years ago since we last visited but booked for Xmas Day evening meal. Food was excellent and service spot on. I had the Sirloin Steak and it was excellent. The teriyaki sauce was a great addition to the beef. Got to be a 5 from me !Show less

Author: JoL855
Title: Tasty food and friendly staff
Review: We had a tasty lunch. Service good and prompt. Recommend seafood pizza and the barracuda fillet (served with mashed potato and spinach). Fresh and piping hot. Hope to eat here again soon.

Author: Expedition714581
Title: Family diner
Review: Waitereses is not so friendly, food is not so tasty as expected,my sea food pasta was really less quantity of the sea food only pasta,my sweetmellon juice was absolutely taste less i ask them to change it, they did it but they charge me double, when I ask why is that, manager start to argue with me keep interrupting and telling that I suppose to ad sugar in it, but the mane idea of the juice is to be fresh and healthy I guess he is not aware of this. So guys think twice before deciding to visit this place.Show less

Author: theberntravelerPhilippines
Title: Wonderful service and food
Review: Went here with our local friends who recommended their chocolate lava cake (with ice cream!) a lot! It happens to be one of those long enduring restaurants outside busy Pantai Cenang, while seeing a lot of patrons still. The cake takes time to make as it is done fresh and served presentably. Their crepe was also nice, as well as the barracuda fillet. There are wines in this restaurant as well, and they pride much in their hospitality. Show less

Author: Keith C
Title: 13 years and still going strong
Review:
Excellent fine dining whilst others come and go. 
After many years away from Langkawi, it is very pleasing to find a restaurant of this high calibre is surviving whilst others around it come and go.

Author: RobandIwona
Title: Good food, friendly staff
Review: We had a good dinner at Sun Cafe. My wife has allergies but they were helpful so she had a good meal. Good fish and I had lovely sateh. Staff is friendly and the toilets are wow!!

Author: Digory
Title: Good service and food
Review: We ate here as it was near to the hotel and highly rated on tripadvisor we were not disappointed. the food choice was good and well explained. Service was impeccable.

Author: Marwa312
Title: Lovely place to eat
Review: Nice food and excellent service. we came here for dinner and lunch during our short visit to Langkawi and it did not disappoint either time. The lamb shank was delicious and the watermelon juice was lovely! highly recommended.

Author: Carlie1984
Title: Awesome
Review: We ran in here for an escape to the rain on our first night in langkawi! So glad it rained! Delicious food! Good prices! Very friendly staff! Yummy cocktails as well!!

Author: GerardTonlegeeDublin, Ireland
Title: Great food and service
Review: Tried this restaurant three times, twice for lunch,. The staff were extremely friendly in an all ready friendly place. The cocktails were great and the food was excellent. It was to their credit that you could see th e kitchen and know that each dish was individually prepared. Unusual for the island there was a small wine list, as against a list of red or white! There is a Chianti Classico single estate bottle at c€14, fantastic value. But you will return for the great food and extremely friendly service.Show less

Author: AlexMaxi
Title: Great Food, frendly Stuff, frendly to Kids
Review: We had a nice evening here, the stuff was very frendly to us and our Kid. It's was clean, and the food great. We'll come back.

Author: paulsF1068UBCala'n Porter, Spain
Title: Fusion of Western & Malay
Review: During our stay locally we read reviews and went along for dinner one evening and was not dissapointed in the least in all aspects from Service, Staff , Food & Drinks.The team servicing were extremely friendly and explain there menu and there after we made the decisions to order and share our Starters Thai Beef Marinate Salad & Vegetable Tempura with a Soy Dipping Sauce both were executed from the kitchen and colours and flavours were superbFor our Mains my partner ordered the Lamb Shank and I went local and ordered the Malaysian Dish of Nasi Compur being various tastings of Malay Dishes accompanied with Rice , Sambal and Crackers which was also great in flavour.For Dessert we shared a Crepe Suzette my absolute favourite and although we declined wine on this evening we had some great cocktails and local beers.The cost for the evening including 10% Service was 250.80 Ringets being £50.00Anybody looking for that special evening or relaxed ambience check this placeShow less

Author: MMPGR
Title: Good food and friendly staff
Review: Menu has a nice variety and the food is good. Staff is very friendly and speaks good English. Only minus is the location, it is quite near the street and not very “cosy”.

Author: Theakk
Title: Disappointed
Review: Ordered chicken satay, the meat had a really weird texture; chewy and fatty. Sent it back, and had spring rolls instead. Average and overpriced food!

Author: Lainey34Kettering, United Kingdom
Title: Island Delight
Review: It is well worth the walk from town, across Boom Boom corner to the clean and friendly Sun Cafe, located in the Sun Mall. The staff are attentive and friendly, the menu is varied Asian to Western and the food is freshly cooked. The atmosphere is pleasant with music playing throughout, a well stocked bar, an ideal place for brunch, dinner or just a nightcap before retiring.Show less

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: Smokers
Review: Hi, have been dropping into Sun Café ...for coffee, beer, lunch and dinner over some 18 years and have never had a complaint, however today (15/10) we were a bit disappointed when two ladies sat at the table next to us and both chain smoked. Yes we could have moved, and we did.We are both ex smokers ourselves, and consider ourselves to be very tolerant when to comes to other smokers, and do not mind considerate smokers in our proximity.We did not complain but probably should have asked if they would mind moving to another table as it was impossible to stay where we were. Its been many years since we have seen a chain smoker, but having two next door was just too much.It will not deter us from returning to Sun Cafe, but just wondering Geoffrey maybe you could consider having a few tables set a side for smokers?? Appreciate your thoughts.cheersShow less

Author: Yegrus_hsa
Title: Worth the walk
Review: A bit off the beaten track for us bur worth it. We both got the grilled prawns which were delicious! Served with creamy linguine and saluted veg, lovely combo and a nice change.

Author: KenolyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Essential stop-over cafe
Review: A Must-stop on every visit to the island. Very clean and comfortable atmosphere for dining or even a short siesta, A Very well comprehensive menu for Asian to Western tastes.Adequately stocked bar, most notable the friendly and approachable attitude of the staff. Traveller friendly with very efficient WiFi network, with soothing music in the background.Prices at the end of the session are not bottom of the budget, but at the quality of the beverages, food, ambience & Service, definitely Value for money. The reason this restaurant is a Must stop location on every trip I make to the Islands.Show less

Author: AzRatArizona
Title: Great food and service
Review: Visited Sun Cafe many times during a stay at nearby Villa Molek. Great expresso drinks in the daytime and two evening meals. Very friendly service, felt really comfortable here. Nice clean, bright spot set back from the road traffic. I have no decent comparison for pricing - I was on holiday and it was way less expensive than the world I'm from. Dishes samples were bruschetta, pizza blanco (excellent cheese), prawn mee goreng. Very good food. Very nice service. Nice space to relax in. Free wifi. What more do people want? Again I was on holiday and money is not a prime concern for me, so my value scale may be different than other reviews. Highly recommend if you are nearby on Langkawi.Show less

Author: Siew M
Title: Super overpriced
Review: Food is normal but way too expensive. RM20+++ for fried noodles (they used instant noodles). Coffee is just very normal. Ok cafe, but their prices for mains between RM20-40, is really quite pricey for the small portion as well

Author: peter5kLinlithgow, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Food & Service
Review: I had been recommended this place before I went and everything I had heard was true, it is a very nice restaurant with very nice food and attentive staff. of all the eateries in Langkawi I visited this was by far the best and served a good selection of dishes. I will definitely be back.Show less

Author: Esha ASingapore
Title: Yummy food+ excellent service .Vegetarian options available.
Review: We were in a hurry so we asked the waiter to bring the food quickly and voila! it was served within seven minutes.The food was tasty and very presentable.The cafe might be pricey compared to the ones around but it was worth it.Lovely music,clean place, yummy food, nice decor and friendly staff with excellent customer service.Show less

Author: achenriot
Title: Good cocktail place
Review:
Had dinner in this restaurant and it was pretty good especially the barracuda filet even though the sides were probably can or frozen food. 
Cocktails are highly recommended :) 
Staff very nice!

Author: NathanL123Penang, Malaysia
Title: Surprisingly good food
Review: Ended up here as our first choice across the road was closed. Didn't look to impressive at first appearances, but had an amazing grilled Barracuda dish and a lovely vegetarian curry. Kids enjoyed the pizzas (not amazing, so wouldn't go for those, but other food really surprised us with the quality). Show less

Author: PETER M
Title: Great Restaurant
Review: Charming staff with a Malay chicken curry to die for ! Excellent new facility with a menu to cater for a variety of tastes . Traditional Malay plus western style food . The staff are very friendly and chatty and helpful .

Author: robwI8024XFSouth Yarra, Australia
Title: Still good 6 years after our visit
Review: How nice to walk in after 6 years to have a staff member recognise you as a previous customer. All the staff were friendly and efficientWe ate here mainly for lunch and the odd dinner. They don't open until noon so no breakfast.All the food was great but our favourite was the tempura vegetables.Show less

Author: AakritiAgg
Title: Awesome Place!
Review: Stepped in here for an early lunch. The food was great, the wine chilled! Very friendly staff. Great place to grab a bite & relax :-)

Author: Erfannariman
Title: Good food, nice service
Review: We went here for lunch, the food was good and finally good service in Maleysia! Plus there are 2 adorable cats there, lovely place. They have local and western food.

Author: Camille M
Title: Hidden gem!
Review: The Sun Cafe was recommended by friends who frequent this restaurant, we were not disappointed. Around the bend from the Aseania hotel and walking distance from the main road shopping area.

Author: Pat M
Title: Dragon Boat Regatta
Review: Our team from Newcastle had several meals at the Sun Cafe and enjoyed the hospitality of the staff, Sasha take a bow, and the quality of the meals. Will be back again next year.

Author: RosemaryT415
Title: Yummy food
Review: My friends and I were supposed to head towards a Japanese restaurant but it was closed for lunch so we wondered along and chanced upon Sun Cafe. No regrets as we tucked into a delicious and sumptuous meal . The waiter was surprised at our ferocious appetite !# Show less

Author: F1287PPandrews
Title: Great spot!
Review: Popped in to have a cup of tea and snacks. Staff were so friendly and the menu looked interesting so stayed for dinner too! Pumpkin soup excellent... worth a visit... certainly not drawn down to the level that some other local establishments offer...

Author: Chantal D
Title: Had to eat somewhere else after visit
Review: Portions here are so small that we had to eat somewhere else after our visit. We had spaghetti and a salad and paid 100 RM for just that and 2 wine. Really disappointing. After indicating that it was not enough, they gave us the card to order dessert.Show less

Author: Haider-V
Title: Best in Langkawi
Review: Tried several restaurants in Langkawi, this one being the last on our trip. The food is exceptionally good, with the right balance of flavours and presented very well. We were made to feel very welcome as a family. I would return in a heartbeat & happy to recommend. Show less

Author: IraCortes
Title: One of the best restos in the area.
Review: We were looking for restaurant that serve decent food and this plae delivers.  We ordered pasta marinara and curry, satisfied with the food.  The drinks though were a little watered down.

Author: JulietaC116Montevideo, Uruguay
Title: The best in Langkawi!!
Review: Excellent place, it was 40mts away from our hotel (Villa Molek, also excellent) so we went for lunch the first day and after that, we could not stop. The food is very good, simple, super fresh and the place is spotless! Probably the cleanest place we saw around, and the staff is the kindest, all of them. We tried several dishes in the menu and they were all very good quality. And the desserts are super worth it. Totally recommendable, we would definitely come back if we go to Langkawi again! Show less

Author: Susan BGold Coast, Australia
Title: Very pleasant place
Review: We had our first lunch here then came back for a dinner the next day and on our final day had lunch again. We loved the ladies who worked there, the drinks were amazing and the service excellent. We really enjoyed the food too, the portions were just the right size. Their pizza is amazing. Loved the fact that they had cats running around in and out of the restaurant.Show less

Author: l_xinying
Title: Nice but a bit pricey
Review:
Overall the foods are nice..We six person spent about RM270 so it's a bit pricey but still acceptable.
Their toilet is very unique..:)

Author: denisemY7115BJMy An, Vietnam
Title: Good food
Review: We went here for a small lunch. We ordered bruschetta, potato wedges and a beef and rice dish. Everything was pretty tasty. Prices were moderate. The servers were nice and attentive and the restaurant itself was clean and well decorated. Recommend to check out this place if you're in the area. Show less

Author: Shereena SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Extremely bad service!!!
Review: We planned for a dinner there with family and friends. Upon arriving, we decided to order some appetizers to begin with. One of the male staff members took our order. A few minutes later when we wanted to add on another appetizer order he immediately told us "I'm not comfortable taking an order like this one by one, it's better you give me your order together". I was shocked!!! And so were my friends!!! I will never ever recommend this place! Service was shoddy and inexperienced. They had absolutely no tact in attending and dealing with paying customers!Show less

Author: Judygran
Title: Always a Favourite
Review: Wonderful evening and the grilled bbq prawns were a hit. Served by very friendly staff, a great night was shared by six of us. Definitely plan on a re visit.

Author: Flemming K
Title: Great food
Review:
I was there with my wife and two daughters and we had a great evening with good food there were presented very nice and pleasant service.
Thanks!

Author: Alex_HamoPerth, Australia
Title: Absolutely Delicious!
Review: I visited this place after hearing good things about it. It did not disappoint. Entree of bruschetta, garlic bread and spring rolls were not only delicious but presented well (so well I was too slow to grab a snap before eating!) For mains I highly recommend chicken parmigiana and satay skewers. If you're fussy like me you'd love to know the parmigiana is chicken breast! Staff were great and friendly. Highly recommend this place!Show less

Author: carolineaB9919NY
Title: Family dinner at Sun Cafe
Review: Excellent service and food! Wonderful setting with quiet surroundings in an otherwise somewhat busy city.

Author: peattielis21
Title: Good food and service
Review: Have been there twice now and have been happy with both meals, they offer a great cross between western and malayan food. Friendly and attentive service. Would go back.

Author: alexmfsKarlsruhe, Germany
Title: Salads for lunch
Review: Sun cafe was 10 minutes walking from our resort so we decided to go for a lunch ! They offer several dishes, from soups, salads, starters, to pizza and main dishes. We just ordered two salads: tomato and mozarela and gardens salad. They are quite nice and the price was adequate. Nice staff. Good atmosphere.Show less

Author: 白石 e
Title: Great atmosphere
Review:
Nice choices. Family friendly. 
Liked their curries and pasta. 
Very clean, happy to accommodate vegans if needed. 
Friendly staff.... Will come again

Author: Stan S
Title: Fantastic food and service!
Review: You must eat here! The food is great and so is the service. Prices are very reasonable with both local and western food. Seating is both inside and outside and restaurant is quite modern. Very good coffee and delicious desserts, especially the crepes!Can see why it's rated no.6 best restaurant by trip advisor....and it is very family friendly. The staff love families! We have already been here 3 times in two days!A must!!!!!Show less

Author: muiwonl
Title: Average food and must try lava cake
Review: Their lava cake was superb other than that was just average nothing special. The air conditioning was not so good even outdoor is cooler den indoor. And this is my personal thought that they're more likely to serve foreigner than local, felt the different between serving them and us.Show less

Author: Tresna W
Title: Wonderful barracuda
Review: A good spontaneous decision to dine here. The barracuda was wonderful and the lamb shank was very good. Staff are very friendly, service was very good and the Irish coffee an excellent way to finish my meal.

Author: Paul M
Title: Nice place to visit
Review: Have a cool drink and a chat with the very friendly staff. Staff speaks very good English (wish more people could in Langkawi). In here a client is a client

Author: gerrym646Lusk, Ireland
Title: Lunch
Review: Superb little restaurant, excellent food and very attentive staff.Closest to home hygiene I have experienced in a cafe in Malaysia the place is spotless.We had the prawns grilled with pasta and cheese, cooked perfectly and even though pasta isn't my thing it was fabulous.Unfortunately they had run out of creme brûlée which I believe is a speciality of the house - so I'll just have to go back again later today and eat there again !Highly recommend this restaurant keep up the good work guys !Show less

Author: bettyk915Geelong, Australia
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review: I love this place! Dishes are from various cuisines... Everything I've tried has been amazing! The vegetable tempura is to die for! Staff are super friendly, and even recognized us from our visit last year and greeted us like long lost friends. Service is always fantastic. Nice to sit and relax and have a nice meal and good drinksShow less

Author: Lauren R
Title: Lovely restaurant
Review: This is a lovely restaurant with friendly staff and good food. Lots of variety to choose from and everything cooked well.

Author: auh1963
Title: In search of good pizza
Review: If in Langkawi, then don't miss Sun cafe, delicious food, lovely staff, good verify if food, amazing pizzas, value of money off course.

Author: bubneetarora
Title: Great food n service
Review: Food is great and so is the service. The bianca pizza was awesome.It's a nice cafe . Very neat and clean.Service is quick n the staff is extremely courteous.Jennifer was specially very hospitable

Author: Victor DNorthants
Title: Poor menu, food ok
Review: We went here for dinner with family on the strength of the reviews. We were disappointed. The cuisine is confused, not Malaysian, not western, not much of anything to be honest. Service was ok but a smile would have helped. The food was ok but nothing to write home about. In conclusion, expensive, poor menu, food ok. Targeting western tourists who don't know better.Show less

Author: RubiYAYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not bad eh?
Review: We drove past looking for Cactus, but they were closed, so we dropped in here as the place looked clean and inviting from afar. We had 2 beers, 2 mains (burger and mee goreng) and 1 dessert for RM110. Decent meal in modern environment for a slightly above average price. Staff are friendly, and so are the bushy tailed resident cats. And no, we didn't get charged for Wifi ✌Show less

Author: 364louiser
Title: Nice people, lovely food
Review: Nice place for drinks or to eat. Very friendly staff and varied menu. Looks out over the road, but within walking distance of many resorts

Author: Ursula DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tropical chic and good food and drink
Review: We had dinner on the veranda of this cool, trendy restaurant located between Pantai Cenang and Pantai Tengah. The décor is modern tropical, yet keeping the traditional touches of rattan chairs etc. Lovely, laid back ambiance, relaxing background music.My Mai Tai didn't quite follow the original recipe, but tasted very good and looked very pretty as well.
