We shared a portion of chicken satay, and we both enjoyed it. My partner followed with a vegetable curry, while I tried the beef rendang - Malay cooking at its best. My partner liked the variety of vegetables in his curry but wished it could have been a bit spicier. I was very happy with my rendang. The beef was meltingly tender, and the gravy beautifully aromatic with cinnamon, chili, star anise, and many other spices. There was a nice little garnish of tomato and courgette, and both dishes were served with rice. The food did not just taste good, it was also visually very appealing. Well done!Service from the waiting staff is friendly, yet efficient, overseen by the owner (or manager) who has a chat with everyone and loves to talk about the food, and the island. prices are a bit higher than in the run of the mill places along Pantai Cenang, but you get a more refined ambiance and good and ambitious food. We paid MYR120 for a cocktail, a beer, one starter and two mains. A good place to spend an evening!Show less

Author: flyhigh_jiyoung
Title: Nice & friendly.
Review:
Best place to chill out. ^^ 
We just tried drinks so we can't say much about the food actually. 
But atmosphere is good and the staff are friendly.

Author: jesseywaleswales
Title: Lovely
Review: This is just across the road from Frangipani . Well what can I say , the welcome was happy . I don't know what the mans name was but he was so funny , we were sitting waiting for our dinner and he came and asked if I had been to the toilet, I said excuse me!! And he said to go and have a look , well we don't expect to be told to look at the loo but it was fab , a river running throug it an you could see the sky and stars , spotless, Any way after a tour of the toilet our meal arrived , you will not be disappointed it was lovely and presented .We ate here a few nights give it a try Tripadvisor plaque on the wall .Show less

Author: Ellimacdiarmid
Title: Amazing food
Review: Food is very nice and well presented . The staff are really well organised and friendly . The prices are reasonable . The cafe is very modern and very nice to eat in.

Author: BigTone72Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Had dinner at Sun Cafe 4 times over the past 11 days. Great food especially the Barricuda dish! The pastas & Randeng are very good too & the Java cake. The staff are very pleasant & the restaurant is very clean (bathroom & kitchen). I highly recommend eating here you wont be disappointed.Show less

Author: Lorraine2010
Title: great to be back
Review: Again this was one of my favorite places to eat on a previous visit. Food is good; nice atmoshere. Just the service was very, very slow this time but we weren't in a hurry.

Author: travellingal02Perth, Australia
Title: Good service, good food
Review: Had an evening meal here and sampled quite an array of mains. Service was good and everything arrived in a timely manner. Menu options were varied and every dish from the seafood pizza, lamb shanks to the fish was tasty and well presented. Great western food choices. Very nice bar too.Show less

Author: LeahX24
Title: Amazing
Review: Sun Cafe is one of the best places to eat in Langkawi. Even our 10 and 5 year olds wanted to go back. Great hospitality from all staff with amazing food.

Author: martyna_polskaSingapore, Singapore
Title: A bit fancier than the surrounding
Review: It's a nice open space restaurant with the lovely stuff. Food is fine, I had pizza which was just OK but my boyfriend was delighted with his barracuda served with potatoes and spinach. Lava cake in the end is a must! I also loved the design of the toilets. Quite pricey, but it's a good value for money. Show less

Author: waelm725
Title: AMAZING
Review: Amazing atmosphere and delicious food. We have tried the pizza bianca , potato soup is yummy.  Highly recommended

Author: hamuraabi
Title: Nice place, friendly staff and tasty dessert
Review: We had coffee and java cake which was so delicious. Place is really nice and clean and staff were welcoming and smiling all the time. Highly recommended.

Author: riccbcn
Title: Good
Review: This place was OK. I had a beef redang and chicken satay. It was a decent meal, nothing to write home about. The service also was OK, but nothing more.

Author: antgreenbank
Title: Great Place
Review: Very nice place to eat and drink afternoon or evening.  Reasonable prices and goid food. The waiter reminded us of Lesley Chow from the Hangover! In a good way!  Make a point of visiting.....

Author: Fridaojansson
Title: Not worth the money!
Review: Went here because norhing else was open and I would go elsewhere. Had a pasta with tomato sauce and it was seriously 4 bites and not super cheap either. Just not worth it at all!

Author: Catherine CLeeds
Title: Best curry in the world!
Review: Oh my god my mouth is watering just writing this review!! I loved Sun Cafe when I was in Langkawi last month. They do such a good veggie curry, I think it's the best tasting curry in the world. Malay curry is like a mix of Indian & Japanese/Chinese curry. The vegetables are so fresh and tasty. The rice is perfect. The staff are the friendliest. Also you must try the lava cake! On top of all that I think the toilets are the best toilets I've ever visited. Don't miss Sun Cafe when in Langkawi! Show less

Author: veeral2017
Title: Very good food ❤
Review: Nice staff, and all salads and soups we eat  was ❤❤. Don't have to wait long time your foods. Very clean place, also kitchen.

Author: Wim SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and excellent service
Review: Tried the fish, recommendation of the waitress. Pretty good. The gratin was a bit cold but that could not spoil the taste.Service is great. They even asked whether I want my coffee first or with the dessert. I was pleasantly surprised by that question.Happy I used TripAdvisor before I picked a place for my dinner tonight. Didn't let me down. Show less

Author: Les OMurcia, Spain
Title: MISS IT AND YOU WILL MISS OUT
Review: This Restaurant is refreshingly different....whether you are looking for location,ambiance,good food choice,Wine at a very reasonable price,as well as friendly personable staff......you will experience it here.WARNING..Find it early on during your stay on Langkawi,because you will want to return.Have no wish to spoil your enjoyment,so,go see for yourself and enjoy as we did,on morethan one occasion.Show less

Author: MissCLMGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Cafe
Review: My friends and I visited the Sun Cafe several times while on holiday in Langkawi, it was so good we went twice one day - for lunch and then dinner lol! The staff were so warm, friendly and accommodating, the food and drinks were delicious and great value for money, and the bathrooms are beautiful, and spotless! Definitely recommend the Sun Cafe.Show less

Author: JurienBay
Title: Great food
Review: Brilliant food and excellent service. If you go here you must try the Creme Brulee. On a side note they also have the best toilets in Asia.

Author: HarukaK75
Title: お洒落なお店
Review: お値段は他のローカル店に比べると若干お高めですが、ここのメニューにハズレはないと思います‼︎ 盛り付けの見た目が美しく、味もとっても美味しいです。お店の雰囲気も良いです。ここの料理は基本、辛くありません。どの料理にもチリが1本、お花のようにカットされているのが付いてきます。辛さは自分で調節です。私のように辛い物がダメな人でも美味しく楽しめます。素晴らしいと思います。all dishes looks nice and very tasty! Restaurant's atmosphere is also nice! Basically dishes are not spicy so there is chili cut like a flower beside it. So I can adjust how spicy it is by myself. This is very good idea!!! actually I can't eat spicy one and I think there are many Japanese like me ...so they also will happy.Show less

Author: Lynne L
Title: Dinner at Langkawi
Review: Nice food, good ambience & friendly staff. Love the barracuda especially. Nicely grilled to perfection. Served with spinach and tomatoes.

Author: dmile2015
Title: Amazing lava chocolate cake
Review: I came for diner and had the chicken satay and the lava chocolate cake. The lava cake is really good. The wine is of good quality. Staff is really nice and friendly. Very good place to have a dinner in Langkawi

Author: richardsT7045MD
Title: Lunch with friends
Review:
Had a very nice lunch with nice wine and some dishes to share. Enjoyed the atmosphere and service from lovely staff.
Make sure you call on

Author: Barb566
Title: The only place to eat in Langkawi
Review: We went there 3/4 nights to eat. The food is wonderful, service is exceptional, prices are very reasonable, and they have reasonable drinks to enjoy. It was our go to place!

Author: flora fRhodes, Greece
Title: Best restaurant in langkawi!
Review: We stayed in langkawi for two weeks in February.We visited plenty of restaurants during our stay, but Sun cafe was by far the best one.They had what we would say, the fool package.The food was very tasteful, beautiful presentation.The restaurant, clean and well maintained.The service exceptional, and the prices very reasonable.We liked it so much, we went twice.If you want quality you must go there!!!Show less

Author: CatLady37
Title: fantastic atmosphere
Review: Excellent food and the friendliest people ever ! We were made welcome from the minute we arrived til when we left.

Author: JanineF74Toronto, Canada
Title: Charged us for Wifi but didn't tell us
Review: So we went to Sun Cafe again....and I didn't realize it until later when I looked at the bill, but they charged us for Wifi! We always ask for the wifi password when visiting a restaurant/cafe etc....and I've never seen them charge for Wifi. Even if they were charging for Wifi, it's not okay to just add it to a customer's bill without letting them know beforehand.Show less

Author: tt53Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Special place with very special people
Review: Was one of our favourites from previous visits to Langkawi. Have not been back for five years but Sun Cafe is as good as ever. Staff remembered us from all those years ago. Where else would tat happen? Great atmosphere, great food and great music. But what really makes this special are the staff. Thanks to you all.Show less

Author: My-name-is-Ann
Title: Beautiful, Amazing food
Review: Food is as tasty as this place is beautiful. Great vegetarian food and ambience too. Slightly pricey but worth it. Decent sized portions. Everything we had here was delicious.

Author: edwina c
Title: Popular for a reason!
Review: The Sun cafe was recommended to my husband and I by people staying at our hotel (Frangipani). Very clean. Wonderful food. Friendly welcoming staff. We went a few times and really enjoyed it.

Author: K9319TNchrisbWaterlooville, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant in town!
Review: We were recommended by a couple we were chatting to earlier and it exceeded our expectations! The food was delicious and the service excellent, all the staff were extremely friendly but not overbearing. I think you can always judge a place by the toilets and these were exceptional!Show less

Author: fifi232017
Title: Best meal in Langkawi
Review: The food was fresh, properly prepared, and a great value for the price. We highly recommend it. Add this to the best dining experience on the island as it adds up to perfection!

Author: mahdishami
Title: THE FOOD WAS DELICIOUS!!!
Review:
Best restaurant in Langkawi Island, hands down. The food was absolutely wonderful, from preparation to presentation, very pleasing.
Anonymous

Author: LadyLynndraEsperanza
Title: Worth it!
Review:
We were not disappointed with Sun Cafe.. what is written on the TripAdvisor review is truly 100% truth. The food was delicious, the staff was friendly and kind.. 

Yes, I would recommend this place..

Author: mavis37Suffolk, UK
Title: Excellent!
Review: We visited Sun Cafe on a previous trip to Langkawi in 2013. We visited on 3 occasions on this holiday and again experienced excellent cooking and excellent hosts.excellent. The moment you sit down you are made to feel welcome. The staff are excellent hosts, they are attentive, but not too much; they all talk with you during your meal and again we felt special throughout our visit.I ate Malysuan food each time, which was delicious, and beautifully presented. My husband prefers non spicy food, and exclaimed that he sampled the best burger he had ever tasted at the Sun Cafe.The Restaurant was full on the 3 occasions we visited!Don't change a thing Sun Cafe; 10 out of 10 from us!Show less

Author: 997MichaelB997Brittany, France
Title: Unchanged perfection!
Review: Back in Langkawi for the umpteenth annual visit! Always come to the Sun Cafe for the first night of our stay and will be here several times during our holiday.Always a warm and friendly welcome from the owners and staff.....you feel like one of the family!Same varied menu but why fix something that is not broken?Service is attentive but not intrusive or rushed.Lovely location and ambiance.Try the thai beef salad starter and the barracuda main course. Always superb!You would pay a lot more for this calbre of food and service in Europe.Top marks....a must to visit.At Pantai Tengah....quiet and away from the ratrace of Pantai Cenang.Show less

Author: VickyG1806
Title: The best in langkawi
Review: The best restaurant I have been to in a long time. The friendly, attentive staff, the comfortable easy atmosphere and superb food. We ate here three times in three days, even a simple thing like bruschetta was delicious. As for the creme brûlée, I broke my diet twice for it!Show less

Author: FutureproofDormansland, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to eat
Review: This cafe was fairly pricey by Malaysian standards but if you are looking for a break in eating Malaysian food this place is for you.Staff were friendly and were happy to make recommendations. Not that well catered for vegetarians, but I was talked into trying the veggie curry which I did not regret.Show less

Author: June F
Title: lovely place beautiful people
Review: I love Malaysian food but if you want a western break this is great. Loved it and staff are all beautiful eclectic and freindly people.

Author: guidoh756
Title: Great food
Review: Clean and modern restaurant with great tasting food, I'm no fish fan but they recommend the Baracuda which turned out to be excellent. Staff were very friendly and always stopped for a chat.

Author: JMQLD16Brisbane, Australia
Title: Delicious dinner with impeccable service
Review: After reading about this restaurant on TripAdvisor and word of mouth we tried it last night. Food was so good, lovely restaurant and wonderful staff. I had beef rendang which was delicious, one person had the barracuda which was amazing. The others had pizza and a pasta which were also delicious. My daughter and I had dessert she had the chocolate lava cake this is a must for anyone who loves chocolate and I had the creme brûlée. Simply wonderful place and a must go if you are in Langkawi Show less

Author: sunshinebobspain
Title: Great burger
Review: I had a hankering for something non asain and wandered up from the beach. Its 20 mins walk and rather warm so be aware. Anyways the food was real nice and the staff pleasent. Odd toilets but i eont spoil that surprise for you.Others said try the barracuda at night but get a cab.. Show less

Author: Abhishek_K_Singh1New Delhi, India
Title: Good Food
Review: Had a dinner at the place during our stay in Langkawi.The service was good and the staff courteous and willing to offer suggestion.Upscale restaurant amongst others around the area.Menu was a mix of local and continental stuff.Limited options if you are a vegetarian.The fish (local) steak was good and should be tried.Good experienceShow less

Author: Amanda TWoolpit, United Kingdom
Title: Don't believe the name- after dark it's a good restaurant !
Review: We stopped by to look at the menu and were pleasantly surprised as at first looks like a cafe but has nice seating and is very clean and tidy.Menu very good with pictures for those who cannot decide which meal to choose.The tempura vegetables were ample for two.Lovely noodles and Malay food by homely recipes by local peopleNice wine list and a lovely ambiance, fun cheery staff and reasonable costShow less

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Not quite there
Review: Great ambience in an attractive structure, staff are very pleasant and efficient. What keeps me from giving it an excellent rating? The food and drinks offerings are not quite top-notch.My wife's planters punch was rather underpowered thoughshe had had a better one the last tine we visited. We shared a vegetable temporara that was good although the dipping sauce was rather bland. I had the barracuda and my wife the beef rendang. The barracuda was slightly over cooked not a patch on the same dish we had in the Fat Frog last week. The beef rendang tasted good but the beef was dry rather than succulent as we had over the road at Malayu All in all it was not a good meal but lacked that little extra something.Show less

Author: THSpur1976gg
Title: Good for lunch
Review: Good lunch option in Langkawi. Nice coffee and milk shakes for the kids. Recommend the Caesar salad.

Author: emeliera
Title: Nice staff
Review: Not so cozy place but the staff was very nice. The food was ok but not a wow moment. A little western influenced place.

Author: ScotgalAustralia
Title: Still a great place
Review:
Once again visited Sun Cafe and not disappointed.
Staff are so friendly and helpful.
Food and drinks are very reasonable considering the quality.
Definitely would recommend to others

Author: 1Travelled_the_worldQinzhou, China
Title: Friendly
Review: Good food, well presented and great staff. We've been regular customers for the past 3 years. They haqve the same staff who all seem to have incredible memories. Without having to ask every time, they serve things just the way l like it. Good tasting food and fair value. Not the cheapest but by no means the most expensive. They always try to please. An enjoyable dining experience and good location. Show less

Author: KathandbabyLancashire, United Kingdom
Title: Made everybody happy
Review: One of the hardest things on our holiday has been finding a restaurant where the food would be to our liking(traditional Malay) but also appeal to a fussy 9 years old. The Sun Cafe was perfect,while our son feasted on Hawaiian pizza we sampled some of the best beef randang ever. Must try are the fresh juices and mocktails, the staff is super friendly and loves children and the place is inpeccably clean.Show less

Author: lorrainer517Bolton, United Kingdom
Title: Just ok
Review: Menu wasn't anything special. Staff were very overwhelming. You couldn't eat or talk without them wiping the table moving the salt back after I used it. The place was lovely and very clean. Staff just need to chill out. Also a little but pricey for what it is. Show less

Author: Sachin09New Delhi, India
Title: Great food, awesome presentation, fabulous service. This has got to be on the Langkawi must eat places
Review: On the outset Langkawi is blessed with incredible food options and outside of the food we ate at the Berjaya resort where we were staying, the food was absolutely fabulous across the different cuisines we tried. The Sun Cafe would have been a miss, had it not been for our last day when we went for Lunch before our flight back home. On a grey wet afternoon the staff was extremely attentive, made good conversation and helped validate our food choices from the menu. The menu is a blend of cafe food from pizzas, burgers, grills, pasta and Malay food options. We tried the grilled Barracuda filet and the thin crust Hawaiian Pizza and both were absolutely fabulous. The barracuda was Delicately flavoured on a bed of Spinach with a side of baked potatoes. The pizza was flavourful and while I would reach for a herb/chilli seasoning, this needed none. Wish we had more time would have made it back for a second meal and stayed longer to try the Creme brûlée. Here is my Top 3 restaurants in the Langkawi, it's a coincident that these 3 happen to be in the Pantai Cenang area. This is the must dine at list. 1. The Sun Cafe2. Yasmin: Great Syrian/Mediterranean food. 3. FatCupidSome of our friends were vegetarian and all the above do have good number of options available. The Orkid Ria was another restaurant that we ate at for Sea food but despite the large format, long queues and good sea food selection just doesn't come in the same category of the restaurants listed above and would probably be a Number 7 or 8 on my list. Must try at Sun Cafe: Get Grilled Barracuda and Hawaiian pizza. Not to forget to mention, the Cafe has the nicest, clean toilet that you're likely to find in the area. Show less

Author: mookeyes
Title: Yummy !
Review: This is a really lovely  quite ritzy cafe ....shiny clean !.. lovely friendly staff ...quick service and delicious food ...slight negative my husband would have liked a bigger serve of the beef randang..as there wasn't very much of it ...but delicious!!..great place !.. 😃

Author: JodyB994Perth, Australia
Title: Lovely evening for family group
Review: Enjoyed lovely food and atmosphere here at an outside table in the early evening . The group of 5 children from toddler to teenagers were well catered for with the friendly and attentive staff happy to feed the children first and then let the parents and their guests settle into their conversation and meal selection at a comfortable pace.The lava cake is exceptionally good and finished off a delicious meal with good wine. Washroom facilities were ultra modern and very clean ( thank you !)All in all a lovely evening.Show less

Author: Flint_piggyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very very expensive
Review: An immaculate cafe, very clean, very professional and great customer service. So why only 2 stars ? The prices are exorbitant, for example, a piece of garlic bread costs 8 ringgits. Taking a look at the menu prices we opted to get something to drink. 3 non alcoholic drinks, RM38.50. This cafe is only for lazy tourists, if you walk 100 metres down the road you can pay less than half for the same food.Show less

Author: Shasass
Title: A nice option for dinner
Review: We initially wanted to go there for lunch, and they were packed to capacity, along with a party of 20 odd people. So they told us the food preparation would take at least 45 mins. We were starving, so decided to come back another time, and ended up coming there for dinner the same day. Very hospitable and cheerful staff. Extremely nice and open ambience. The food was pretty good too. My wife wanted to try everything Nasi! So the hostess suggested a Nasi platter of sorts, to be had with rice. It was pretty good. Even the Chicken and Noodles was very nice. But the dish to take away was the gooey Lava Cake. Absolutely lip smacking!! A must have if you decide to eat here! A nice place to unwind after a hectic day at the beach and the pool!!:))Show less

Author: Barry S
Title: Lovely food and nice relaxing atmosphere
Review: Superb little restaurant right ay end of Pantai Cenang (Pantai Tengah end). Staff are very friendly and welcoming. We've been to Langkawi several times as a family and we always return to this gem. Make sure to try the steak and for dessert the chocolate lava cake is to die for!!Show less

Author: dreamiconKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: over price & un-friendly staffs
Review: I cant believe why this restaurants has high reputation on TripAdvisor. Well,, I can tell this place is for mainly western people & they served over priced food which taste is just average. Also the staff (lady staff) is well-trained but not friendly. I dont recommend. Nothing special in here.Show less

Author: Sarah B
Title: Yum!
Review: On the pricer side compared to the more local style restaurants nearby, the food is worth it though. Presentation is creative and the portion sizes generous. The fish was delicious and caught locally. The dessert is also highly recommended!

Author: Rorokey D
Title: You should not missed
Review: No mistake everything is nice and food supper tasty . Place very clean . Staff so friendly.  Wifi available.

Author: OrdinaryTravellers
Title: Thoroughly enjoyed
Review:
Lovely restaurant. Staff are very welcoming and friendly

We had the beef randang and it was lovely...very reasonably priced too

Would recommend :)

Author: acpw19Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Lovely, lovely, lovely
Review: What can I say ..... everything about this place is LOVELY!Everyone in the cafe is polite, gracious and friendlyThe food is absolutely delicious! We tried the Barracuda fish which was really delicious, creme brulee, spaghetti, pumpkin soup and burger. No complaints. Even the fruit juices were ever so fresh!!!!Show less

Author: syashak2017
Title: COMPANY DINNER
Review: Went here with 12 all us.. Most of us ordered LAMB SHANK and CHICKEN CHOP. Food was delicious.. Service was outstanding... Highly recommended...

Author: Maz1974Exeter, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible
Review: We visited based on the Trip Advisor reviews as it was also near our hotel. Luke warm food and over priced on all levels. My food was sent back and it still returned luke warm. It was barely eaten and they still tried to charge it in full. There was about three other tables eating so there was no excuse. After nearly three weeks in Malaysia, this was the worse meal we encountered and at twice the price. We won't be returning.Show less

Author: MatSall
Title: Nice food, Nice place
Review: Nice food, with subtle touches that don't often find in Langkawi. Reasonable selection of well prepared food in quiet location.

Author: jjmack7191Ottawa, Canada
Title: Delicious!
Review: The barracuda is absolutely delicious and my husband thinks they have the best creme brûlée ever! A little pricier than some meals we've had, but worth it - we don't mind paying more if it's really top quality food. The couple who own it are lovely. Service was good. We plan on going back before we leave!Show less

Author: Doug R
Title: Great value
Review: We happened to spot this place on TripAdvisor while we were literally outside on scooters. Very friendly owners and great value food.  We had the barramundi and grilled prawns - finished off by the chocolate cake. Def worth a visit.

Author: 818rose
Title: very impressive
Review: A real gem. Tastefully furnished.  Beautifully clean and tidy. Very professional staff.  Menue given very quickly.  Food presentation of high standard.  Can highly recommend, you wont be disappointed

Author: OTBCJonNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: A lovely birthday meal
Review: At time of writing The Sun Cafe should be the #1 restaurant on Langkawi IMO above the current #1 which is a fast food outlet.So if you would like a quality meal with cocktails and top notch service then you most give the place a visit. This is my third visit and the quality of the meal and service never disappoints. The cocktails are also well presented and reasonably priced for a restaurant.My tip for food to try: Barracuda for main and for those that love deserts the chocolate lava cake.This is my third visit and I shall be returning again.Show less

Author: alfie50
Title: Tip top tastic
Review:
Lovely restaurant
Great friendly staff
The food here is of the highest quality.
We had prawn mee goreng and beef redang, very tasty.

Author: Dreamer680998
Title: Awesome place!!
Review: Food is so good and staff so nice and friendly!! Pizza is maybe the best in langkawi! Pasta was also very good and desserts are as tasty as they are beatyful! Many different kind of coffees also and price is not too high. Restaurant is very clean and also there is very clean toilets. One of the top restaurants/coffee places in langkawi for sure!Show less

Author: m wLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Salad
Review: We hid out here from the rain and had a lovely chicken salad, as we wanted a lighter lunch. It was delicious!! The waiters are friendly and for anyone who has been backpacking around, the toilets are fancy and worth a trip (it's partially open to nature)Show less

Author: Marlene M
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Just had dinner here & food is 1st class & amazing !! Staff are fantastic & very friendly. Even the house white is lovely .. all in all a fab night & would highly recommend when in the area

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Quiet Restaurant
Review: Been here for twice with my boyfriend. Food was decent at a mid range price. Just 5 minutes away from the nearest tourist attraction: Pantai Cenang. Nothing much too great, but if you would like to have a simple and quiet lunch, this will be the restaurant.Show less

Author: 559bryndNoumea, New Caledonia
Title: Rainy day, but sunny inside
Review: My two little men (8 & 6) and I ate here just the other day. Because of that it was pretty early, so probably unfair for me to comment on the atmosphere as there was only a handful of people inside. It's nice and clean and set back from the road a little. If you've come expecting ocean views or such like then you will be saddened. A empty massage centre is next door and the road in front. You can watch people go by though and imagine what part of the world they have travelled from.The menu, as do most places in Langkawi caters for most food options. My youngest is fussier than Donald Trump's wig maker though, so if spaghetti bologna is is on offer then I'm interested.He gave it a half thumb up and said it was about as good as my bolognaise (although he also prefers about 32 other bolognaise's over mine so it may not be saying to much).The beef redang my older son and I had wasn't bad, a little dry perhaps, but had a good flavour.Staff were helpful and attentive. Will we become lifelong friends ? Alas not, but we weren't there for friendship.So in short, after a rather long winded review, the food and setting aren't bad, the staff are helpful. Cost us about $30 Australian dollars for three mains. Not pricey, not cheap. Would I return? Probably not. Show less

Author: revslideSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bring your date here with a fat wallet and partially-filled stomach.
Review: Modern and nicely-decorated fine-dining restaurant. Feels to cater more for the typical caucasian traveller. Service standard was prompt and well mannered but feels cold and insincere. (Smiles to you one moment and a care-less expression to you later and repeat) The food quality is decent but not great. (The rendang had taste but cooked too hard). The food portion is somewhat little for a typical male.Show less

Author: KatieN198Dunsborough, Australia
Title: Lovely food, lovely staff, lovely atmosphere.
Review: In the Cenang beach area of Langkawi, there doesn't appear to be much choice in good food but we found a little gem at the sun cafe. It's just off the main strip and away from the plastic chairs and paper table cloths!!! We had the Mee Prawn noodles and the chicken curry, which came to about £11 total. Well presented, delicious food. The staff are ultra friendly, and the atmosphere feels relaxed and romantic. Wonderful end to a wonderful day.Show less

Author: alisonj129
Title: Would recommend.
Review: We visited Sun Cafe twice as we were staying in the area, once for dinner and again for lunch. On both occasions we were very satisfied with what we ate, more so when ordering Malaysian food. Our experience when ordering Western food and cocktails was less impressive, so I'd recommend sticking to Malaysian dishes and beer, wine or soft drinks.We couldn't think of anything about this place that makes it worth 5 stars (also having high expectations as it's so high up on the rankings), but it's certainly worth making the trip to try it out.Show less

Author: Ozbob101
Title: Great food, service and staff
Review:
We had dinner on two of our five nights in Langkawi at the Sun Cafe and they were both very tasty and the service was first class.
If you get the chance drop in and you will not be disappointed.

Author: jmpossum
Title: Food
Review: We went there and the food and the staff were very friendly. I loved every aspect of it. Would go again

Author: Dee8365
Title: Best western dinner in Langkawi
Review: 6 of us visiting fromPerth West Australia had a very enjoyable night at Sun Cafe. Food was very good and house wine was excellent. Staff were also outstanding. Toilet facilities were the bêst we have ever seen anywhere. Cannot say enough about the whole eperience

Author: TravellingMelayu
Title: Nice food, good service, comfortable atmosphere
Review:
A nice cozy cafe on Pantai Tengah.  Staff are attentive and friendly.  
Food is good on quality, portion and taste.  Not many independent places are like this in Langkawi.
Atmosphere is superb.  Very relaxing.
Highly recommend.

Author: Nomaddictives
Title: Great food and excellent service
Review: My partner and I were looking for some western food as it was day #15 in Asia. We ended up going there and we were surprised. Would recommend to anyone for sure.

Author: Hockeyfollowers45
Title: Great meal friendly people
Review:
I'd like to agree with everyone else. The barracuda was amazing and the potato served with it complimented the spinach and sauce so well. 
Great food,friendly service,lovely people and place. 
If you are on Langkawi try to go there.

Author: JulieH6061Perth, Australia
Title: No complaints here - professional and slick service
Review: I was surprised this cafe is still as good as it was when it started, it hasn't fallen apart from lack of maintenance as can happen so easily in Langkawi - very tidy and modern western inside, nice decor with matching tables and chairs and expensive fittings etc. and very clean and slick.The staff are very professional and very good and the menu is extensive with some good choices.This is a very nice place to go if you feel like a taste of home I guess - nice wines, nice atmosphere, good coffee and great food with good service.Recommend if you are tired of eating local food (which by the way is fantastic!)Show less

Author: dramitraj
Title: Professional staff with emotional touch!!!
Review: You will never regret the food you order here, service is good, food quality is great. It's absolutely value for money. Location is also silent though near to pentai cenang.

Author: MichellinousThe Netherlands
Title: Very good food and professional staff
Review: The food was the best we had in Langkawi and very well portioned so that you can calm down the worst hunger you can ever have - like mine. Funny was that the place is in the same group as our hotel (which we also like very much), Sun Group Langkawi. The staff is very polite, helpful and joyful. We've promised to come back but we didn't, we were too curios to experiment other places. But if you don't like experimenting with your food, this place is perfect to eat every day.Show less

Author: Jacky C
Title: Excellent
Review: We had our lunch just when we landed at about 3 in the afternoon.The atmosphere was absolutely wonderful. We ordered a Hawaiian pizza and a signature barracuda fish as recommended. The food served was excellent. Service given is wonderful.

Author: rgasioreEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in town but for its price
Review: We ordered beautiful barracuda fish, extremely tasty with interesting new, non-fishy character, served with baked tomato and italian like twist - baked, thick aka béchamel sauce side with tomato and cheese. For starter some juices, and for desert cream brûlée - again great and reach taste. The place is space'y, tidy, well decorated, clean, and its toilets along a stream are just amazing! Service responsive and understanding.The only drawback was that vegetarian options were limited to western cousin dishes (like pizza) so if that would be not your cup of tea prepare for some super tasty basics like brochette.The quality comes with the price - we paid for the above around 80MR which is probably two/three times more than in other places so it is not a place where you would eat regularly unless you have really big budget. It is surely worth more than all the touristy, yet not well run places in the town centre that don't care whether you would come back. Here you could feel that they treat you as if you could come again the other day. So yes, - for expensive fancy food come here, for cheap skip this and the touristy semi-restaurants in the town and go somewhere fully local for 7MR. Last thing worth to mention: across the road there is a nice Malay food restaurant which we tried for resort breakfasts only, it looked great and had local Malay food and prices looked far more reasonable than at Sun Cafe, just saying as I regret not trying it.Show less

Author: erikas109London, Canada
Title: 7 dishes in 3 days
Review: This place was so good, we had to come back twice. Every dish we had was delicious, though we highly recommend the barracuda (I'm not much of a seafood eater, but this was an exception). The staff was so incredibly friendly and helpful. I cannot recommend it more.Show less

Author: Salem N
Title: Very nice food
Review: Myself and my wife loved the food. Staff were very friendly. Recommend to anyone coming to Langkawi 🙂

Author: GMiuMiuKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Love this place
Review: It's become a ritual to make this the first stop from the airport. Even before the hotel. My Favourite is a gin tonic followed by pasta. While my Friend tends to enjoy the Pimm's. The washroom is worth a visit too. Friendly staff and always had a high quality meal.Show less

Author: watsonworld
Title: Great Light Lunch
Review: Staying in a villa next door, we tried Sun Cafe one afternoon after a massive hangover. Great burger & chips plus a life saving orange & pineapple juice !

Author: Saiful Zareek YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth Splurging For!
Review: We came across this place by accident - and didn't regret it a bit.The barracuda was out of this world. The grilled prawn on fettuccine was excellent and generously served.And don't order drinks other than their fruit juices - so good, we had to ask for a second helping!Show less

Author: coljdf
Title: Great food and service
Review: A fabulous find in Langkawi. The food and service was excellent. The fish (a house speciality) was devine. Great atmosphere and attention to detail. Good drinks menu too. Thoroughly recommend.

Author: Terry QNorth Fremantle, Australia
Title: Excellent Food and Atmopshere
Review: Fantastic place to both eat and enjoy the atmosphere. Food was of a high quality and the service was brilliant, staff very friendly and helpful.The waiter joked we had to try the toilets, and when we did they are amazing (never thought I would write that in a restaurant review) but that shows the care that has gone into both the overall design of the restaurant and the level of care taken with the food. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: R3dhi11
Title: Superb food and service
Review: The food we had has the Mediterranean taste. The fresh seafood with the knowledge of making it.  Makes the money worth spending on. One must never miss when u are here.  Ambience is nice too.

Author: JasmineL1544
Title: Excellent Place to Dine
Review: Loved the food from this place as I could see that the chef took a lot of effort to plate the food. I had a king prawn linguine the portion of the food was just right for me a handful portion of prawns and the right amount of pasta. The food was wonderfully presented and it did taste as good as its presentation. Compliments to the chef. Service staff were really helpful and welcoming when it comes to suggestions for food and drinks. :)Show less

Author: 856vishalsNew Delhi, India
Title: Delicious Yes, Expensive Hell Yes!
Review: We had reached Langkawi and checked into our hotel after traveling for almost 10 hours and we're completely exhausted. This place was near our hotel in Langkawi so we decided to give it a shot. The staff was courteous and quick in servicing us. We were travelling with an infant and asked for milk which to our surprise was not charged for. Overall the quality and the presentation of food was good. We ordered a cold coffee, a watermelon juice, pasta bolognese and grilled chicken breast. The total bill amounted to 79 RM which I thought was a little over priced but who cares when the food was good. Show less

Author: Sheena BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place
Review: We were staying at La Pari Pari and wanted to eat at a place nearby. They recommended Sun Cafe and it did not disappoint. The four of us ordered different things (Asian and western) and although it was slightly pricey, the service and ambiance made up for it. My beef burger came with delicious fries and although the beef was a bit soft for my liking, I was happy with it. My friend's pizza was really really good and I believe, is the best bet for this place.Show less

Author: salman_farsi
Title: Good pizza and selection of starters
Review: The pizza at the sun cafe instantly reminded me of home and it was as good as pizza express. The pumpkin soup was very good too!

Author: Coldcuttrio
Title: Worth the money!!
Review: Omg this cafe has the best food ever! This cafe is a definetely must try in Langkawi. The portion of the food is huge, it's cheap and the way they display the food is like a high class restaurant! Service is good and i will definitely come back there again!!Show less

Author: kinyipnSingapore, Singapore
Title: First meal in Langkawi
Review: After landed on Langkawi, we grabbed a car , we were hungry and zoom to this cafe. It was a rainy day, no many patron inside. We order spaghetti , sandwiches and fish chip. Food were awesome and delicious, my family was glad to spend our lunch here. Overall 4.5 starsShow less

Author: Anita Phyderabad
Title: Great food , great staff
Review: One of the best meals i have ever had. The staff is very friendly. They had a good collection of wine. Also the main course dishes were very unique. We tried prawns curry , one lamb preparation and pasta. All dishes were very tasty and unique. .Show less

Author: tawhaa
Title: Good Food
Review: We had dinner at Sun Cafe . It was near to our hotel Ambong Ambong. The hotel driver pick and drop us ! The food was good. We ordered pizza and drinks!

Author: Z8545KIahmeda
Title: Super delicious and generous portion
Review: Have been there with family on 28.08.2016 for lunch, we ordered pumpkin soup ,tempura, grilled prawn over linguine and barracuda grilled fish.All were fresh delicious and generous portion, the waiters/waitresses are kind and helpful.We ordered juices which were real refreshing.Got off really happy as we have made a good choice for lunch after long activity day.They accept credit card for over 50RM.Give it a try if you are in Langkawi, no remorse.Show less

Author: WynnTLY
Title: Nice Food and Desserts
Review: Pizza burgers and desserts are delicious here! We were hungry thus there's no pictures of the main dishes. Tried the desserts and we ordered another round after tasting how delicous it was. Good place to chill out as well.

Author: Indvaux
Title: Prawn curry was a triumph
Review: If you want a well cooked prawn curry go here. I ordered extra rice to finish the sauce because it was so good and I didn't want to waste it.

Author: Stephen MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good Food & Wonderful Staff
Review: This little gem helped to make my trip to Langkawi memorable. The menu offered choice without too many options, the food was good, coffee wasn't bad and the drinks were reasonably priced. Best of all were the wonderful management and staff; one of the senior team members, Jennifer, could not speak highly enough of her employer and this was reflected in the service. On my last day (of 5) I had cause to use the bathroom facilities, very cool!!Show less

Author: AntGore
Title: Went there 3 times the manager and owners were very nice.  Prawn curry dish was superb.
Review: Best service and food I had in Malaysia.  Kuala Lumpur food dreadful and expensive.  Penang above average.  Langkawi a good improvement

Author: IvanaL1993
Title: Nice food but not excellent.
Review: The drinks are really great. Nice fresh juices! The food is oke! It taste good but isn't very special. If you are with many people it is a great restaurant because they have different kind of things!

Author: claireBournemouthBournemouth
Title: Yummy food in a beautiful resturant
Review: We ate at the Sun cafe twice during our recent holiday to Langkawi. The food was absolutely delicious, we sampled various starters and main courses which were all superb! The creme brûlée for desert was to die for! But most importantly the service was outstanding, we had our two young daughters with us and all the staff were so accommodating, giving them stickers and generally making a fuss of them. Both our girls wanted to eat there every night!!! The restaurant itself was very well kept and the toilets were so clean! We would not hesitate to recommend the sun cafe and will definitely visit again when we next holiday in Langkawi. Show less

Author: AsiaNewby
Title: Great Staff - good food
Review: The best thing about that place is the staff - so lovely, you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The food is good, fresh - a bit expensive but I think the entire island is a bit over priced. The place is neat, quiet and relax.Show less

Author: simbiane
Title: Ok but nothing special
Review: The Food was ok but nothing special. We had Nasi Campur and the taste was a little bit boring. Not spicy. We also had a Thai beef Salad with small pieces of beef and a lot of boring salad. The sauce was pure sugar. I would say the place is ok for people who don't cook and don't apprecciate very good food. Not for foodies. For traditional Food better go to the small foodstalls where its cheaper and better taste. If you are looking for average Western Food suncafe might be a good choice.Show less

Author: Latenighter1
Title: Beautiful food in clean modern cafe
Review: This cafe is very modern in presentation.  Food was excellent and the service great. Thoroughly recommend.

Author: erdigoker
Title: Excellent service
Review: The staff is very helpful and you can meet good from worls kitchen. İt is very hygenic and clean. İt is close to hotels in pantai cenang

Author: Pam C
Title: Something for everyone here
Review: Very friendly welcoming staff, efficient service, very varied menu including western options.  Superb mocktails.  Food really tasty.  Very clean and comfortable and tasteful decoration.  Set back from the road away from traffic and open smelly grids. Plenty parking area outside.

Author: Bethany WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fabulous dinner and fun!
Review: We spotted this restaurant only because it was close to our hotel, and I'm so glad that we chose to have dinner there. The food was delicious - I had the barracuda, and my husband had mee goreng with prawns. Plus we treated ourselves to the lava cake, and I suggest that you do too! Staff was friendly, fun, and professional. Have a lovely evening and eat here! Don't forget to visit the unique washroom :)Show less

Author: 182sheree
Title: Great Cafe!
Review: Great wee cafe, went here for an evening meal, very friendly staff and welcoming! Food was tasty and well presented. Would recommend as it's just a short walk from holiday villa resort. Modern premise and clean.

Author: Thomas R
Title: Great cafe for lunch and dinner
Review:
We kept coming back here during our stay and the food was consecutively great. Pizza, satay, breaded chicken, pasta and desserts. 

The staff spoke great English and were very friendly. The prices were all reasonable and the scenery was good.

Author: t4miracles
Title: The best as always!
Review: Back again to Langkawi. Back again to the beloved restaurant! Food is delicious again! Staff is friendly! So nice to be back to the best restaurant with wonderfully cooked and served european food in Langkawi!

Author: FumiakiI10
Title: Nice hospitality(^^)
Review:
Nice atmosphere, kind and brilliant hospitality!! Am really enjoying the fantastic dinner!!

地球の歩き方でも泊まったホテルでも薦められたレストラン。ホスピタリティは素晴らしく、ひとり旅のディナーがステキな時間になりました！

Author: seaalllGeylang, Singapore
Title: Good service and food
Review: Went for lunch and dinner. Overall in august there aren't many places where a vegetarian can eat at Pantai Tengah. We eat at suncafe where I ordered a pizza and the vegetarian curry. The service is quite good especially as compared to other places in the area. Our food was fine and we'll presented. Non vegetarian food tasted better than veg. As everywhere else in town there very limited vegetarian options here such as pizza , pasta, veg curry.Show less

Author: farquareAl Khobar, Saudi Arabia
Title: very impressive barracuda
Review: Had breakfast here one day then went back for dinner a few nights later. Breakfast was good but the evening meal was excellent.i'd recommend the barracuda, it's as nice a fish dish as i've had anywhere in the world. Size, presentation and balance of flavours were excellent and i came away quite surprised and glad we'd went back.Show less

Author: peter sSingapore, Singapore
Title: Relaxing cafe
Review: My girlfriend and I were going for spa at alun alun spa at 8pm which was located opposite the cafe so we decided to visit. Had a Hawaiian pizza(delicious), coke, a bottle of Corona and chocolate lava cake. It was quiet at that time, just one or two people around so it was very peaceful. WiFi was available, just needed to ask the staffs for the password. They were welcoming and happy to assist. Show less

Author: Mark G
Title: Nice food
Review: Beautiful food and friendly staff.  Just over the road from Tropical Beach Resort Cenang. Quiet and relaxing

Author: Amrazor
Title: Not as amazing as I thought it was going to be
Review: We had a full range of good from pizza through Malay and steak burgers with salads and fruit juices. The fresh orange juice was nice. Presentation was also good with a nicely knitted out seating place. Now the food, The steak was not cooked properly, the beef in the salad was raw and chewy the teriyaki steak was smothered in too much soy sauce, the Malay dish was nice everything else below average. There are much better places to eat within walking distance. Show less

Author: espensp
Title: Good food
Review: Nice local cafe. The Beef Rentang is tasty, as is the Springrolls and Fried Vegetables starters. Not too expensive either.

Author: JIa Y
Title: Fine Dinning Resturant at Jalan Teluk Baru
Review: Very pleasant dinning experience, the host is super friendly and you will feel you are well taken care of. Food is freshly prepared, even the desert. Even the desert the freshly baked upon order.^^ It is right outside the cenang area. Three of us (guys) had one main course each one grilled fish and 2 lampshanks, 2 beer and 1 mango juice. plus one larva cake (shared). The food taste great, the serving size is just right, as we had some fruit before going there. It cost us RM 206. Host has a super cute cat named LuLu something, super cute. Great experience overall. It is worth the price.Show less

Author: Louleedee
Title: Delicious food, great service
Review: Food was lovely, lava cake really is amazing.  Cocktails wonderful. Service was great. So glad we went.

Author: Natures B
Title: Great food, great hospitality
Review: Very nice hostess and she recommended the grilled fillet of barracuda. The place had a nice ambiance to it.

Author: SCR26
Title: So good!
Review: Beautiful little cafe with outstanding food. This is a must try if you are in Langkawi. We thoroughly enjoyed our 3 course lunch. Thank you for an amazing meal. 😊

Author: CoryW363
Title: Yummy and affordable
Review: This place was well presented and the food was of a high standard. Full marks to the staff. I would return to eat here.

Author: tomfromaustralia1
Title: Delicious! Order the traditional Malay food
Review: Ordered the traditional malay food, and it was delicious. The service here is great, and it has a lovely atmosphere. Would highly recommend, probably the best eatery on Langkawi island.

Author: Darbuka
Title: Desert and some drinks after disapointed visit in other place
Review:
Due our visit in another restaurant and their food problems we needed some comfort. Sun Cafe made a smile back to our faces and Ice Cream portion  and Creppes Susette was very good and service outstanding.

They have also hot dishes as well.

Author: lanvinyeo
Title: "Owner was friendly enough"
Review: we enjoyed coffee alot so we ended up in Sun cafe ordering ice cold coffee, potato wedges and fish and chips. Definitely recommending the potato wedges!

Author: KellyL4375
Title: Double Standard Staff
Review: was wandering around to look for food. and then me and my group of friends saw Sun Cafe and decided to walk into this beautifully setup cafe. instead of being warmly welcome. the first lady who came to us, ask us are we first time here with the her judgmental look. as we say yes, she replied, 'then i think you should take a look at the menu first.'yes, we are local. and wearing quite casual. but does not mean that, we does not deserved to be welcome in a better or at least a polite way. we are hungry so we sat down. staffs that came and order with us and clean our table was polite. one of them actually check with us hows their food. other staffs was ok. but her. when other foreigners customer walk in to the restaurant. her welcome was so loud and clear with the big bright smile on her face. so, yes. double standard we thought. ordered spaghetti, pizza, chicken chop and salad. food was ok worth the money i must say. but not the staff (the first lady). Show less

Author: VIVEK710
Title: excellent chicken burger and pizza
Review: Excellent place to visit for burgers,pizza and pasta.Nice ambience,very neat and clean.Staff is very polite and hospitable.

Author: Khuen555Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice lunch
Review: Had our lunch before going to Airport. They are located at Sun Mall, next to Kasina car rental. The staff gave good recommendation and we took it. For dessert, we ordered the crepe as well as the brownie. Personally, we prefer the brownie to the crepe.Show less

Author: Matt P
Title: Great spot
Review:
Had lunch here several times and was very impressed with he staff attentiveness, quality and presentation of food and decor.

Great place to relax with friends and enjoy good food.

Author: Rinchen_purpleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly & Cozy Ambience
Review: We drove around trying to find a place for quick dinner that's near our hotel, and we found Sun Cafe that's about 3 minutes drive away~ had Indian food the previous night so something different would be nice~We approached the friendly personnel if they serve dishes that are suitable for vegetarian and he immediately recommended some pizza and pasta that meat/seafood are able to be removed. We ordered Pizza Supreme sans turkey ham, Vegetable Curry serves with Rice, and Pumpkin soup~ the staffs are all so friendly and smiley, YES I mean ALL of them! Some are owners I'm sure :) The food presentation of the Vegetable Curry & Rice is so unique (look at the picture ^^) and it's delicious, could be slightly spicy to some but we are ok with that. Pizza is good too and I like my pumpkin soup~ The interior is tastefully decorated and children friendly too~ Price is considered a little on the high side for local, but overall it's a place we would go back again the next time we visit Langkawi ~ Show less

Author: nedwood8you2
Title: Sun Cafe
Review: Well what a great restaurant / bar all staff very friendly helpful nothing is to much trouble. Food is fantastic . Toilets unbelievable

Author: mozzieauGorokan, Australia
Title: Wonderful food and lovely staff
Review: Our group of 4 had 2 wonderful meals at sun cafe. The staff went out of their way to look after us and our meals were tasty and presented beautifully. My partner being a ceoliac disease sufferer was shown extra care in ordering his meal choices. A lovely Canadian lady consulted with the chef to make sure his choices were suitable for his gluten free diet. We would recommend sun cafe for anyone looking for a great meal delivered by staff who look after their customers like friends. Show less

Author: bonesiaustralia
Title: Cream brûlée
Review: Started of with two ice coffees they came with sugar syrup and creamer in little jugs.We shared the beef burger, chips and salad also a plate of bruschetta. And finally there famous cream brûlée I was not disappointed still amazing the best one I think out off the many restaurants we have been to.Show less

Author: jim2012015
Title: Lovely restaurant
Review: Just across from our hotel with a great menu and service. Everybody made to feel really welcome and seemed to be full of returning clientele

Author: AnneHastie
Title: both food and service is top notch
Review: service is excellent, food is very good. the restaurant seems to be the favorite hub of langkawi expats and most of the diners are westerns.

Author: Clare W
Title: Fabulous
Review: We had a really delicious meal here - friendly staff, great food, and highly recommended to any travellers looking for a varied menu to suit all tastes.

Author: limaaron
Title: Great food, great atmosphere, decent price
Review:
A restaurant offering slightly more affordable Western food compared to others. Food was great and staff service was very friendly.
Only open during dinner time.

Author: Rhett G
Title: Great up market restaurant
Review: We really enjoy this restaurant. Jenny and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The menu is very diversified. The facilities are great and the toilets very unique and tidy. Prices are a little higher for Langkawi but well worth it if looking for something a little special.Show less

Author: 533vitaliyk
Title: Did'nt expect so great place on island
Review: WOW!!! Food, drinks, place, service are so on high level! Price is amazing good. Realy recommend this place.

Author: Traveller4217Gold Coast, Australia
Title: A good Saturday night
Review: Nice people and good food. A bit of local and a bit of western. I agree with the previous reviewer. It is good for soft tummies. Having said that, I had a mer goreng with added chilli. Very nice.The people were very friendly and we enjoyed our night Show less

Author: shery111Budakeszi, Hungary
Title: Safe food for sensitive stomach
Review: They are offering several kind of food including European which is good when your stomach is exhausted from the local dishes. The restaurant is really nice and clean so as the food. Actually I really recommend to try the local quisine since in Langkawi I did not have any digestion problem.Show less

Author: Willy S
Title: Nice people, excellent food
Review: Warm welcome at the Sun Cafe. No problem for sharing dishes in our group. All food was great,If you are a fish lover, go for the barracuda. You will not regret!

Author: christophereeTavistock, United Kingdom
Title: Subtle tastes
Review: Both of us went here last night, and we found the place very clean and the staff very helpful and always smiling.the most important thing is the quality of food, which was very good. The flavours were very subtle and not overpowering like in some other local restaurants. It's already on our list to return to in the next ten days. Enough said!!!Show less

Author: JanineF74Toronto, Canada
Title: Tasty Food, Would Love Air Conditioning
Review: Eight of us went to this restaurant, and the barracuda was very popular with the people who had it. The food is good quality, and the fresh juices are fantastic. There weren't a tonne of choices for vegetarians but overall this worked for all 8 of us who were there. Show less

Author: CJBlouberg
Title: A definite must!
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed two dinners at Sun Cafe. All their meals are presented well and are delicious - barracuda is a definite winner. Service is excellent, staff are warm and engaging, facilities are clean. Highly recommended!

Author: Rhosesmor1Chester, United Kingdom
Title: Best service ever :)
Review: This is the probably one of the best location for service ever, having visited this place many times ( over 7 years ) and returned this year after 3 years, the service here is welcoming, genuine and warm.The food is great and caters for all our (fussy) family. Great variety and prices, all with a welcoming smile. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: sunwitch16Los Angeles, California
Title: Tasty Food, Nice Ambience. With a Resident Cat!
Review: Good food and friendly staff. We went twice, and noticed both times that most of the patrons were foreign tourists. Both times we were the only mixed group there. Quiet although it was a tad warm (rare heatwave). The food made up for it though, we had the cheese pizza which had a thin crust, and was simply marvelous - not too doughy at all like many pizza crusts. One of the best pizza I ever had. Others in our group had the cheeseburger which I was told was very flavorful and chicken satay (authentic but contained some chicken fat/ligament which this diner did nto like, byt some people might). I had the chicken chop with black pepper sauce, and is the best chicken chop I have ever tasted, bar none.Will definitely go there again next time we go to Langkawi! Terima kasih, Sun Cafe :-)Show less

Author: MariaMorrelloNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: A marvellous place to vist whilst in Langkawi!
Review: We have been visiting this cafe for many years, it never fails with great food and service. The Barracuda was a fantastic recommendation along with the scrumptious cocktails which I thoroughly recommend ! If you want reliable, nicely presented food in a lovely cleaned setting I would urge anyone to visit.Show less

Author: 205louc
Title: Walked by and popped in
Review: Lovely meal for four.  Couldn't fault the food, cocktails or service.  Very clean and good atmosphere.  Just outside our hotel so will pop again this week.

Author: bobN6078XO
Title: Nice
Review:
I had the pleasure of eating here.... twice.  Food is outstanding. 
I would recommend just about anything.
I found the cheeseburger to be really delicious. ...  tell them to hold the mayonnaise and add pineapple instead.  Wow!

Author: Giedrius K
Title: Do not want to look something else if you find realy good place
Review: Tried 4 different restaurants in Pentai Cenang, but this seemed to be most cosy and dishes most tastefull. King prawns and local burger worth to mention especially. Returned there 3 times. Good luck Sun cafe!

Author: katerinalouiseEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food with a very warm welcome
Review: Really enjoyed dinner in the Sun Cafe. The staff are incredibly friendly and made excellent recommendations from the menu. Even to the point where we were going to order a bottle of wine, and was advised to get the cheaper house bottle as it was nicer! Food was delicious, really fresh and tasty. Will definitely be returning. Show less

Author: 997MichaelB997Brittany, France
Title: Classiest restaurant in Langkawi for the price!
Review: We dined here nearly every other night of our holday and have been coming to Langkawi for years!This place is the ultimate restaurant for cleanliness, friendliness, good service and great food and ambiance.You are welcomed like a friend as you step into the place and bidded a fond farewell on leaving.No detail is missed! Attentive service from the start....napkin unfolded onto your lap....water and wine constantly topped up....friendly chat from the staff if you want it!Service here is better than many five star restaurants I have visited in Europe at a fraction of the price....and the attention is genuine.Menu is simple and has not changed but everything served is delicious and beautifully presented.Try the Thai beef salad to start. It is unbelievably good!Also the barracuda for a main course.Great chocolate fondant dessert too....or creme brulee!Cannot praise the Sun Cafe too much.A must for a wonderful evening.NOT TO BE MISSED!Great hosts Sacha and Jeffrey and their wonderful team.Thanks guys....see you next year!Show less

Author: Juunass
Title: Overpriced and tasteless
Review:
Ordered Spaghetti napolitana and salad. In spaghetti you couldn't taste anything else than parmesan cheese. Salad was oily and tasteless. 
BUT staff was friendly and garlic bread was ok.

Author: EmmaPietersBrussels, Belgium
Title: amazing welcoming
Review: We visited Suncafe on the first night we arrived in Langkawi. The experience and welcoming was fantastic! Everyone was very warm and helpful. On top of that, the food was fresh, delicious and as we were a group of 12 people, they really made an effort to bring our food at the same time. Briefly, we had a wonderful night with good food and cocktails and would recommend this place to anyoneShow less

Author: BeccajanexoMelbourne
Title: Great food
Review: This restaurant was a short walk from our accommodation which was great because we really liked this place. We ended up coming back twice because the food is great. I was surprised it wasn't busier but I think that is because it isn't on the main strip. It is definitely worth a visit. I recommend the King Prawn mainShow less

Author: Nico EBrussels, Belgium
Title: Fantastic experience
Review: This was a great experience from start to finish: smooth, quick and friendly service backed up with delicious, fairly-priced and well-portioned dishes. We had a wonderful evening, and crazy as it may seem, the toilets were the icing on the cake. You can not miss this if you visit LangkawiShow less

Author: O L
Title: Good food, bad way of serving drink
Review: The food was tasty and almost same as last time we've visited Langkawi. But drinks was really considered as milking cow for this restaurant. We ordered soft drink (ginger ale), she poured one glass of can for both of us in as tiny glass full of ive. it was like drinking water. (charged 6rm) if you're going to charge customer 6 rm at least bring the can for each one of them. Show less

Author: barryf975hong kong
Title: Little seen, sadly
Review: Away from the main beach strip, out on the road to the west of Pantai Cenang, the Sun is a smart bistro designed to be an above-average international meeting-place in a small roadside shopping development. Given enough time and funding, it will be well placed to attract tourists seeking some cosmopolitan flair in their food, drinks and ambience. Its barracuda house special was a special treat. Very friendly service.Show less

Author: Kebab65
Title: Wonderful food with very friendly helpful staff.
Review: We did not go for the piza etc. so there is a fairly limited menu but still plenty of choice.  This is now one of our favourites in Pentai Cenang - We will be back!

Author: Rosemary797Meyssac, France
Title: EXCELLENT
Review: We ate twice in this restaurant and both times the food, service and staff were excellent, yes the menu is not extensive but something to suit everyone. I had the lamb shank and king prawns and both were brill, if you want to get away from the hoards of restaurants on the main drag, eat here for that special occasion you won't be disappointed. Tables inside have air conditioning and fans and have a look at the loo's with your camera........ Must be the most photographed toilets in Langkawi.Show less

Author: Philippe DHuy, Belgium
Title: Ok
Review: We went for dinner last night based on the review. There was a lot of customers mostly westerners. The service to take and serve the orders was fast and efficient. The menu is quite limited and not very exciting. Nothing special, just the regular western cuisine dishes. We opted for two pizza. There were just ok. The dough was not very fresh and quite soggy. Topics were ok. We sat on the terrace and there was a strong smell outside. Not bad but nothing special in this very common and average restaurantShow less

Author: tracypangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Best place ever
Review: We had our dinner here. All I have is one word to describe this place - EXCELLENT! From starter to soup to main course then dessert...everything we ordered was excellent. Staff are very helpful and friendly. We loved the ambience. A perfect place to come and have a good meal.Show less

Author: alan s
Title: Sun Cafe
Review:
If you only eat at one place on Langkawi you must visit Sun Café!
Great food and really great staff!

Author: grilledlobster
Title: Dishes between 20-45 Malaysian ringgit
Review: Food is tasty, staff is friendly location is good to escape the midday sun. All in all a good recommendation.

Author: HMBudgeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Always delivers!
Review: We first visited here 2years ago, and were impressed enough to ensure if was our first stop when we returned this year.Drinks are great, especially the cocktails, and good price too (RM18). The food also is presented well and delicious too. We both opted for their Barracuda, a speciality, and we weren't disappointed! Highly recommended!Show less

Author: Brad1017Tokyo, Japan
Title: Excellent
Review: Had the Barracuda with spinach and cream sauce. About as good as fish can be. And I like fish! Then had the chocolate lava cake. Same. I cannot imagine chocolate lave cake being better. Service not great. But simple and clean restuarant. Not luxurious. But fantastic food.Show less

Author: Mark HCheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent and good value.
Review: Whilst actually a main course, we shared a prawn noodle between the 2 of us as a starter and it was delicious. we both then had the barrracuda and it loved up to all of the previous reviews that raved about it. Wine was the best value yet as for the first time on the island, we went with the house white (Chile sauvignon) and it was really nice. Overall, we really enjoyed it and thought it was probably the best value for money dinner yet.Show less

Author: tonyjonesmetaTaunton, United Kingdom
Title: Great choice and quality
Review: We first eat here when we arrived after a 16 hour flight from the UK. We chose familiar comfort food which combined with the welcoming and efficient service helped us to unwind.After that we visited another couple of times for meals and became more adventurous in our choice of meals from their extensive menu. Each time the food was of the same high quality and really good value for money. As all the staff were so welcoming we also dropped in for beers and coffees on a number of other occasions.We were very lucky it was only about 50 metres from where we were staying.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Great disappointment considering reviews.
Review: Four of us went for dinner based on the reviews.We ordered four drinks and all of us concluded that it would have required highly specialised, scientific equipment to have measured the alcoholic content. None of us ordered any other drinks.Slightly under forty five minutes later our lukewarm food arrived on cold plates. One of the dishes ordered, a Lamb Shank, was swimming in cold gravy and had clearly been marinated in pure brine. The remaining three dishes proved to be marginally better but sub-standard compared to other restaurants.The evening was an unmitigated disaster and, hopefully, one we can erase from our mind.Show less

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best on the island
Review: Sun Cafe is undoubtedly one of the best restaurants on the island. It is spotless as is the kitchens and toilets ( a must visit if at the restaurant). The restaurant serves a mixture of local Malay food, European plus pasta's and pizzas. My wife's favourite is the local dish Prawn Mee Goreng. I love the Barracuda,served on a bed of local spinach and accompanied by creamy potatoes. I also love the Spagetti Marina. The staff are fantastic and friendly, prices reasonable and atmosphere great.Show less

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Most photographed washroo
Review: Was surprised why there is lots of washroom shots here. It is because it is open plan with a stream beside and overlooking coconut trees. The food here were presented like in Bali. The rice come in a cone or pyramid. The food...coffee and tea was great. Balacan was gorgeous. Only thing is beef rendang was reheated or microwaved. Coz the rendang start to become watery before I can finish it. Visited at 12pm.Top notch service. Ambience was great. Ended up have 4 cups of coffee.Show less

Author: scotpraguevietnam
Title: Great food in a nice location
Review: We ate here a couple of times and really enjoyed the food. The staff were very friendly and helpful. The malaysian curries were very authentic and the fish special was great. The decor is nice and there is outdoor and indoor dining, the staff were also very good at dealing with food allergies and requests.Show less

Author: MeghalaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, Great Environment & Very Friendly
Review: I would say one of the best restaurant in Cenang Island. Good food but more importantly they have really good customer service. As we are vegetarian the staff did asked us whether we are vegetarian or not. When we said we are, she literally suggested us the type of food we can have. The food taste good as well. Very concern staffs. I really enjoyed my dinner here. Apart of that, they really have the best washroom :) Do have a visit to their washroom. Overall very satisfied :)Show less

Author: michaelo230
Title: Great food and very friendly
Review:
Have eaten here four times on this trip and enjoyed every meal. It's a little way from the bustle of Pantai Cenang so no traffic noise. 

The signature dish appears to be grilled barracuda and it's superb. Prices are very moderate too. 

Recommended.

Author: vaivaz2015
Title: The best restaurant in Langkawi!
Review:
Surely best plase to eat. 
Pleasant staff, quiet surrounding and amazing fond. 
Good value for money.
Highly recommended.

Author: derfabianATVienna, Austria
Title: Perfect presentation of the food
Review: The Sun Cafe has Western as well as Malaysian cuisine. The food was very tasteful and the service just great. The food was really nicely presented. The prices are a little bit over average.Try the homemade lava choco cake! Plus, the cafe has with no doubt the nicest toilets in Langkawi. ;-)Show less

Author: Denise CCape Town, South Africa
Title: Welcoming and delightful.
Review: Wonderful place to sit back, relax and take your time over a glass of wine and a meal.The service is superb, so friendly and welcoming. I ordered a burger which was way better than I expected. The house wine was very good. Overall a great solo dining experience.Show less

Author: richardvh
Title: Good food
Review:
Had some lunch here.
Nice malaya food and great desserts.
They also have more Europeaan food
Will return again this week for sure.

Author: Melissa S
Title: Absolutely amazing experience
Review: Now we're tourists from Australia and I can say this with 100% certainty that I've never been to a better restaurant/cafe ever. This place; wow! Its super clean the main waitress there was SOOOO friendly and welcoming, she really gave great recommendations. She knew everything about the menu. I remember having this creamy pasta (I believe Alfredo) this was amazing and kept me coming back. My husband had a prawn dish and he said it was the best prawns hes ever had and thats something being the seafood lover he is. & desert was amazingly oozy and yummy.I have to mention this, the restrooms are out of this world! lol. I remember coming back from going and sitting quietly and whispering 'You need to use the restroom, like now'. Its actually pretty magical. :PShow less

Author: metrobird
Title: Very nice
Review: The food and drinks were great. Delicious Creme Brûlée dessert. Good service, relaxed atmosphere. Inside is quite brightly lit at night, so we sat outside. Maybe a little bit pricey for a cafe, but it was very nice all the same.

Author: Polcaro
Title: Never disappointed !
Review: Sun Café is the restaurant we'll always visit when we come to Langkawi. Their cooking staff is skilled (the barracuda is a must try !), the staff is very friendly. A very good place for both parents and kids.

Author: PAH2008London, United Kingdom
Title: Don't be fooled by "cafe" this is a wonderful restaurant
Review: So good we came 2 nights running. Wonderful food, excellent friendly service, pretty restaurant and outside tables. And prices so reasonable I kept thinking they'd missed things off the bill. BTW a trip to the loo is not to be missed. Seriously. Even if you don't need to. You must go. Show less

Author: heidisholiday
Title: Felt welcomed, very good service and good food
Review: I highly recommend this place. Staff was polite and smiled a lot and talked to us. The restaurant is very clean and the decoration is beautiful. Food was good and the prices were ok :)

Author: mackim
Title: fab restaurant
Review: Ate here last night had barracuda and prawns, it was delicious.  So friendly staff, service was great. Only problem was mosquito bites even though we had lots of repellant on. Will come back but will sit inside.

Author: GarryB464
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: Clean, quality food, great staff, best tempura veges i have had, the only let down that stopped me giving 5 star was using processed chedder squares in the sandwich and they were still cold from the fridge.

Author: Alicia847
Title: Scrumptious food!
Review: We received a complimentary dinner at this restaurant from our hotel as it was Christmas and we absolutely loved it! Their seafood is superb and lamb shank was as tender as chicken breast. Highly recommend!

Author: donalb129
Title: Fabulous
Review: Ate here twice,brilliant service and even better food.spring rolls and prawn curry out of this world.very reasonable prices also.a must visit from a very picky food eater

Author: Laila&andrew R
Title: Good food
Review: We had food here many times and of course we loved it .. my husband and I had a lamb shank and it's delicious :) we're  going back for a dinner sometimes soon !!

Author: JamieS781
Title: Excellent Steak
Review:
Had a great family meal here on 26th December 2015. Staff were excellent, the drinks cold and the food excellent! I had the steak in teriyaki sauce. Loved it.

Nice clean restaurant. No faults.

Author: fls2016
Title: Excellent service and delicious food.
Review: You only can find excellent service and delicious food in Sun Cafe.  Sun Cafe is a must try and it is in Sun Mall.

Author: _B6427HZ
Title: Good food, nice staff, a bit overpriced menu
Review: Quite decent restaurant. I have tried barracuda there. It was good, but not excellent, the prices might be more appealing. The staff is very friendly and kind.

Author: Tim DIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Revisit after 11 years - still very good
Review: We visited this restaurant 11 years ago for dinner - this time we visited for lunch. It was very good. The service was excellent, the food tasty. The croutons were a bit weird on the Caesars salad and the Thai beef salad was missing peanuts. The Carbonara & beef rendang were perfect. The same unique bathrooms :-). Hope to visit again sooner than another 11 years. Show less

Author: 277junyic
Title: Great dinner after a long day
Review: After a long day at Perdana Quay, we had our dinner on our way back at sun cafe. I saw my friend's review and it looks good there. And it didn't disappoint us at all. The salad, milkshake, pasta, fish and rice are good.

Author: Devaguru
Title: Good Food !!
Review: This was my first visit to the restaurant, good food, great people and had a great time with my family, love the staff !

Author: 896nilesht
Title: Great and friendly atmosphere
Review: Definitely coming back for more. The atmosphere is great, the staff super friendly and the dessert and tea were wonderful. Will be back to try other food soon.

Author: Musab A
