Title: Small portion sizzed cake and fries  .....expensive
Review: Really nice place , relaxing, yet the cake was 18 with a scoop adding up to 21 coming with the size of a  cupcake with fancy chocolate shaving

Author: TheMartiansKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Place for Lunch or Dinner
Review: Brought my family and friends from Singapore to this place for lunch. They have lots of varieties of Western and Asian cuisine. Food tasted just what we have expected for a decent food. The outlet is along Pantai Tengah and its opposite of Frangipani Beach Resort.Show less

Author: RosieMeadowsAustralia
Title: Surprisingly good food
Review: My daughter and I came here to eat twice during our Langkawi stay. The staff are lovely, really helpful and incredibly sweet. There is no problem making alterations to the menu either which was great. Food was fresh, tasty and really well presented. They make great mocktails too. Show less

Author: Steve HJersey, United Kingdom
Title: The best of both worlds
Review: A very comfortable, civilised and up-market place open for lunch (from 12) and dinner. It offers both European (pizza, pasta, fries, burgers, etc) and excellent Malay options. Free wifi. We had a cheese toastie and pizza for the children along with Beef Rendang and Nasi Campur for mum and dad, everything was excellent. The staff are friendly and efficient. Seats indoors and outside.Show less

Author: Nancy NSingapore
Title: Great food! I am going back tomorrow!!
Review: We ordered barramundi (it came with a portion of potato gratin), Thai Salad, leek and potato soup, and saved some space for dessert - creme brulee. Excellent food and nice place to be. We are going back tomorrow for dessert and going to try the lava cake or crepes =)Show less

Author: traveljetter_11
Title: Good quality of food
Review:
Nice restaurant with good ambience und high quality food.
Therefore slightly higher prices.
Good service but 10 % service charge.

Author: piotrbogWarsaw, Poland
Title: Nice barracuda and king prawns
Review: We were there twice. Barracuda with spinach was yummy. So do king prawns. We also ate spring rolls which were just good. Marinara pizza was a nice surprise (we did not expct much but received good italian pizza). Prices are reasonable. House wine was even cheap. Staff is very nice. Much recommended.Show less

Author: Suanne CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Food even their gas system down
Review: We were told that they had a problem with gas piping so food was limited, only curry chicken, rendang and some pizzas were available. We still go for it since we arrived on Monday and many places were closed. The food turnout to be quite tasty, portion was big and before it feed your stomach, it feed your eyes first. The ambience is cosy and relaxing, service is friendly. We spent Rm100 for 3 main meals and 2 fresh juices. Reasonable for that kind of standard. There were many cafe and restaurant like this in Langkawi but Sun Cafe was strongly recommend by the local if you are looking for something in the middle range. Show less

Author: paulineburnett012Inverness, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic find
Review: The food here is absolutely fantastic ! King Prawns with noodles and the Barracuda were delicious , staff so attentive and prices were very reasonable A shame we didn't have space left for dessert ! The restrooms in this gem of a place must be seen, very quirky with no wall in one side only a gorgeous water feature. Kitchens were open air and immaculate Show less

Author: Mag147Windsor, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome
Review: Fabulous food, service and cocktails cannot fault this place. Has both Malay and western food if you need the option. We had Malay and fish. Everything was perfect - king prawns were the best I have had. Staff gave good advice and made changes when we requested it. Great shop next door too which is part if of the cafe. Reasonably priced as well!Show less

Author: IamwatchingULangkawi, Malaysia
Title: I have to go back!!!!!!!
Review: I've been meaning to try this place for at least 2 years! Kicking myself i'ts taken that long. Absolutely gorgeous. Food amazing, service so friendly and the whole atmosphere in general is fantastic. Lovely setting, great music, awesome menu......what more can you want. :-) Oh, and the restrooms are out of this world. I felt like was in a day spa. Love, love, love this restaurant.Show less

Author: ScotgalAustralia
Title: Great service
Review: Stopped by here for a cold drink after walking from the far side of Pantai  Cenang. Decided to stay for a while and ordered some snacks, which were very tasty  The staff were so friendly and service with a smile.

Author: yswahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service and delicious food
Review: The service was friendly and the food was delicious.Their menu had a good selection without being overwhelming.Their signature dish, Grilled Fillet of Barracuda was delicious even if the fish was just a tad over cooked.They have been in business for 13 years, it's not surprising to see how because based on our overall experience - the service, the atmosphere, the food - makes this a keeper!Show less

Author: d_swissy
Title: Dinner
Review:
Tasty food (looks great, too), nice atmosphere, good music. Lovely service staff.
I felt very welcome and stayed for quite a while

Author: MJcuac
Title: Perfect place for European food
Review: We were searching for some European food and we ended up in Sun Café. What a Wonderful Surprise! It was Monday night and we were more or less alone. However, the waiter was absolutely polite offering an excellent service, never rushing us, allowing the right time between plates… we had a barracuda fillet (cooked to perfection!) and a filled chicken breast and both were really, really good. Also the toilets were outstandingly clean and with such an interesting architecture! Moreover, the kitchen in the back part is open and everything looked absolutely clean.Show less

Author: PJH244Woking, United Kingdom
Title: Great for coffee and dessert - and lots of other things too!
Review: I visited this during a period of heavy rain whilst walking back to my hotel - what a little, lovely oasis! Friendly staff, decent wi-fi, really nice coffee and the creme brulee was a delight. Further visits led to more menu tastings and everything served was lovely Show less

Author: t4miracles
Title: The best european restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: Very clean and comfortable place! Wonderful service and delicious european food! You will feel yourself like at home. All the dishes we tried here were just marvelous! I advice this place to everyone who likes good food and great service!

Author: jinnywren2013Pwllheli, United Kingdom
Title: So relaxing , friendly and reasonably priced
Review: We have been visiting Langkawi for many years and always make sure we visit the sun cafe . The staff are very friendly and always make us so welcomed. It is spotlessly clean and the food and drinks/cocktails very very good. Try the tempura vegetables and the crepe suzzettes.Show less

Author: M MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice food and ambience
Review: We stopped by this peaceful stretch of shops adjacent to the south section of Pantai Tengah (beach). We were there at a traditionally quiet time (4pm) but everything was available. The decor is very nice the wine a reasonable price (myr 12)and the chicken curry was a very good flavour (myr 22).I had the potato gratin as a snack and it was very nicely done at myr 7. The staff are very friendly. Show less

Author: Neena2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food with reasonable price
Review: It's really a nice restaurant. Nice decoration with nice soothing music at the background. Pleasant and friendly staff. Good selection of food, not many, but enough to make you salivate by looking at the photos. Food is really tasty with good portion and reasonable to the price that we paid.Show less

Author: Veronika M
Title: Excelent!
Review:
Probably the best restaurant on Langkawi. We were satisfied with every food we had, friendly staff and pleasant environment.

We loved their pumpkin soup and Sun cafe sandwich but also some Malaysian noodles were great. Try Baracuda, it was great and huge portion!

Author: Kelvin_penang
Title: Interesting menu choice and Friendly staff
Review: We were pleasantly surprised to find this place with a peaceful aura to it. Tasted our first baracuda there. It was ok, but the other dishes were quite tasty. Good for a quiet evening be it for couples or those with families.

Author: Joanne M
Title: Good food and wine
Review: Had a wonderful lunch.  Great satay and wine was reasonably priced. Gorgeous open air toilet looking over a water feature.

Author: Labbit-DQ
Title: Must try!
Review: Recommended menu are Barracuda fillet, Chocolate Lava Cake, Maitai Cocktail.  Very cosy and elegant setting.

Author: LindsayBOZ
Title: Great food
Review: Great food, juices and cocktails. The lava cake was like heaven! The staff sang for my bestfriends birthday. Very clean!

Author: dr_harshal
Title: Good staff.. Good cocktails
Review: Friendly staff and their pussy cat! Good range of cocktails.. Pizza was yummy too! Good place to relax

Author: Emily L
Title: Lunch
Review: Nice looking restaurant with good atmosphere. Western and asian dishes,  our choices tasted great! Quick service,  nice juice.

Author: JLCHUASingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice restaurant and friendly staff
Review: The prominent signboard attracted us while we pass by this place a few times during our 4D3N vacation at Langkawi. We finally decided to have dinner here on the last day and the ambience here was great. We ordered the Hawaiian pizza, chicken chop and fruit juices. The food was good and recommended. There were a few other patrons while we were dinning and appeared to know the staff from the restaurant. I assume they were regulars which frequent this restaurant due to the good atmosphere. Overall great place, friendly staff, nice ambience, good food at reasonable price. Show less

Author: TinksEyeView
Title: Delicious relaxing cafe
Review: This is a real gem, bizarrely for Malaysia, we found the food in Langkawi just so so but The Sun Cafe is a real gem, serving local and international cuisine that is excellent. Would highly recommend it and the sublime Lava cake ;)

Author: DeeeedooooNapier, New Zealand
Title: Pricey but worth it
Review: Very fine food and great welcome is what you should expect from Sun Café. The owners have obviously got excellent taste in everything (their shop opposite the cafe is an attraction in itself and offers some very fine objects too).Another reason to visit is that their toilet is most definitely, without the shadow of a doubt, the most beautiful in all of the island and possibly Malaysia. They even got some awards for it.Show less

Author: SebastienC222London, England, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful food
Review: We loved it so much we came back the day after for more... The service is excellent, the food is excellent, the ambiance is excellent, you do not need more. You must try their Barracuda filet, the chocolate lava cake (heaven) and their Mai tai cocktails made with fresh pineapple juice. Show less

Author: ShaunandSam2014
Title: More than a cafe
Review: Good selection of dishes served by very accommodating staff. Cheap house wine. Visited twice as it was opposite the Tropical Resort Hotel where we stayed. Barracuda and Tomato Mozzarella Salad both notable. A recommendation for an early lunch, seemed to be very popular.

Author: CatAdorer
Title: Go there~
Review: Lovely place, excellent food and cocktails and next to great design and artifacts shop which is owned by same operators.

Author: NomadicBoysLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great staff yummy food
Review: Came here on a Weds evening. Staff were so welcoming and friendly.We had between us the Supreme pizza and Barracuda fillet with potato gratin and spinach. Both were really tasty but we were fighting over the barracuda dish. Get this - it's their specialty.Washed down with a really nice chocolate Lava cakeShow less

Author: Corinnes23Melbourne, Australia
Title: Fresh, Healthy Modern Cuisine
Review: If you a looking for a break away from the traditional cuisine and love fresh squeezed juices and a place to take the family yet enjoy a menu with options for all you cannot go past the Sun Cafe. Great comfy dining and the staff are relaxed and can't help you enough. Wi fi, cocktails and smooth background music tops it off!Show less

Author: Bee A
Title: Outstanding and absolutely gorgeous
Review: We went to the cafe for a light snack and discovered a beautiful, modern, up beat place that is great for families, solos and couples alike! We later came back for dinner as we devoured our food from earlier on and amongst return discovered the food was just as great! I myself had the vegetarian curry and it was beautiful! The flavours were magnificent! for dessert we decided to go for the speciality... And let me tell you it was AMAZING! Chocolate lava cake that was exploding in richness with divine tasting chocolate! I highly recommend as this little place is holds a beautiful atmosphere with lovely staff and outstanding service! 11/10!Show less

Author: Maddy S
Title: Modern and a must!
Review: Decided to have a bit of an afternoon snack, the service and people were lovely and happy to give advice on what's good to eat and loved to have a chat! We thought it was so good we came back for dinner and was just as impressed as earlier the evening. My mum had the grilled prawns which were cooked perfectly and tasted amazing. There is food for everybody, good for kids and adults! They have a great selection of food for whatever you feel like. The atmosphere is wonderful and super clean and modern! Really recommend coming to the sun cafe when staying in Langkawi! Show less

Author: bbchuHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious creme brulee
Review: It's just opposite to our hotel, Tropical Resort Langkawi. Relaxing environment with ceiling fan. I tried the famous creme brulee, as recommended by Tripadvisor member and my wife an ice-cream combo (I forgot the name).Both are delicious. Creme brulee with an orchid as decoration, got thick and crunchy caramel top and creamy custard. The custard part is a bit too sweet for me but it's delicious.Ice-cream combo is good according to my sweetie.Overall, a bit pricey but the staff is very friendly and helpful. Even told us the new address of a moved shop. But unfortunately, we still cannot find it. No big deals, it's holiday, just relax.Show less

Author: clare2901
Title: Friendly staff, good food
Review: They have a range of Malay and western food on the menu. The bruschetta and supreme pizza were very tasty. The drinks were very affordable. The staff were friendly and attentive. Would definitely visit again.

Author: Marco RLisbon, Portugal
Title: Great atmosphere, Great asian fusion food
Review: We were staying at the sunsetbeach resort and in one of the nights in langkawi we met this restaurant.It was a surprise, because we only know the location at night and arrived there by foot from the resort, the road had some movement but was not enlightened, as we approach the site seemed an island of light in the middle of so much poor lighting.In addition to the restaurant there are also other shops, including the sunflower handicrafts, which belongs to the Group of resort and restaurant.Comparing with the existing in Langkawi, particularly in Pantai Tengah, this restaurant was the most sophisticated of all we've tried.The restaurant offers varied types of food, from the Western to the Malay region, but as we like to experience the traditional food of the places we visited, we proved some traditional Malaysian dishes and with the refinement that this restaurant has.We were welcome by the employee, the service was exquisite as the dishes presented. It was a lovely experience.As a curiosity, we were delighted with the ambience of the toilets. A presentation of space with quality and refinement in Asian style with the surroundings of a small waterfall.It seemed to us an area that is frequented by many Westerners, in part by the prices and also by the Western-style dining offer.Have meal service but it seemed to us have more bar service, but with refinement above the practiced at Pantai Tengah.The prices were more expensive than most other restaurants but the service and quality makes the difference.Show less

Author: sunny2342015
Title: Nice resturant and friendly staff
Review:
The food is a bit slow. But we are having holiday. So, what are we hurry for? 
Food are nice and the decoration and view is so relaxing. I and my friend wanna fall asleep. The wind comes so comfy.

Author: KarthikS24
Title: Great for Money
Review: very nice foods and very good service. very good ambiance. will definitely go again. small issue was with the WiFi and foods was quite slow but overall nice experience.

Author: 111Laura111London, United Kingdom
Title: Service with a smile
Review: We really enjoyed lunch here. The staff were incredibly friendly and we thought the local food on the menu was delicious and exquisitely presented (they also serve some western dishes). If you're looking for a beer/G&T with your meal, this was one of the few places in the locality where you could order alcohol. They also have wifi.Only thing to note if you're prone to mosquito bites is that a lovely little pond stretches along the back of the bathrooms. I'll spare you the details, but I wish I'd applied some deet beforehand!Show less

Author: hana_j0909Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Great service, ambience and food
Review: We were here for dinner and it was one of the most pleasant dinners we had in langkawi. The cafe had a modern and beautiful interior deco, staff were friendly and the menu had a good variety. We had spaghetti and rice with fish which was really good. I'm a sweet tooth so I had creme brulé which melted nicely in my mouth, what a perfect ending to my dinner.Show less

Author: RasandPenrith, Australia
Title: Great Food Great Service
Review: Visited here a couple of time for dinner & found it to be very good. The wait staff were good & very helpful. The food was great & there was a good selection. The prices were very good & would highly recommend you have a meal here.Show less

Author: Damian_76
Title: Great for cocktails and desserts
Review: The wait staff are really lovely here. Stayed down the road, so often stopped for a drink on the way to somewhere else. Had cocktails on a few occasions here and they were very good. The desserts (Chocolate cake and creme brulee) were divine. Other dishes (burger, thai beef salad and chicken satay) were all decent. Check out the toilets!Show less

Author: Red_Bear_23
Title: Relaxing lunch
Review: Decided to visit Sun Cafe for new lunch venue. Staff were friendly and service was good. Menu had a lot of choices including western food. All of our meals were delicious. Good value for money

Author: zandieboy
Title: Nice western food local ingredient dinner
Review:
Very nice looking interior and exterior, especially compared to the places surrounding. Menu is a mix of local and western food.

I had the barracuda filet with spinach and gratin dauphinois. 

No remarks on this, was delicious!

Author: tink58Roma
Title: Nice!
Review: We had lunch here a couple of times and really liked the food and the service. It's clean and modern and the staff were all friendly and efficient. Loved the salads and fresh fruit juices. It's pretty popular in the evenings too.

Author: ABIZAK
Title: Lovely Cafe.
Review: We had lunch and  coffee here recently . Lunch was very good. Cafe is spotless and food was excellent. Their toilet facilities are among the nicest I have ever seen. Great Standards.

Author: robbiem256Lennox Head, Australia
Title: Great food Great service
Review: Thought we'd try this restaurant after reading about it on TA.We were not disappointed as the service and food was second to none.The waitress was very friendly & helpful with our selections.I ordered the barracuda while my partner ordered the cordon bleu.Both dishes were delicious and priced very reasonably.Would recommend this place to everyone as it's quite modern with a relaxed atmosphereShow less

Author: Sara B
Title: A little gem!
Review: We loved everything about this and it was unexpectedly good! It just looks like an ordinary cafe but the food was lovely, good range of cocktails and all reasonable priced. Great staff and a lovely, friendly little cat too!

Author: charlesandrhona
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Nice restaurant and centrally located. Large selection on menu and staff very knowledgeable with good command of English.

Author: PJW4
Title: Amazing Sun Cafe
Review: Terrific staff, and great food, especially desserts (especially the creme brulee) also lose to the cheapest duty free store on the island.

Author: Niko_staKotka, Finland
Title: Outstanding service
Review: She made this restaurant worth of visiting few times during my stay in Langkawi, what a woman with a warm caring hospitality and smile:) Food was nice and house wine excellent. This is a place for a people who loves enjoy their holiday and become spoiled with in modern style atmosphere. Go to visit toilets and you will find out that everything is just made for you. They closed the restaurant far too early at 10 pm:(((I saw her one night in Sunba night club and told, there will be a review belongs to her.Show less

Author: 997MichaelB997Brittany, France
Title: Annual favourite!
Review: We have been coming to Langkawi for years.This is one of our favourite restaurants and never disappoints.Best service and great ambiance here.You would be lucky to find this in a large city....never mind on a small island!Great menu.Try the Thai beef salad for a starter....you won't taste anything better!The barracuda is to die for!Highly recommend for your evening out!Show less

Author: NadaMB
Title: Good food , Very nice service
Review:
Went with some friends for new years dinner
Costly but delicious food & nice friendly waiters
near the cenang beach (walking distance)

Author: brookey1989Bovey Tracey, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely cafe in the heart of langkawi
Review: Friendly staff, delicious food,wide range choices of food and drink to accomodate everyone. I visited langkawi 3 times and I keep coming back to this cafe. Highly recommend the local malay dishes and the pizzas! :-) also you need to check out the toilets, one of the best toilets i have seen!Show less

Author: O L
Title: Not bad, polite staff
Review: Had our launch here today, nice atmosphere, average sandwich, good salad, the nonalcoholic mock-tails were awful ...

Author: KeithSco1
Title: Lovely facilities, amazing outdoor bathroom and open kitchen. Bland food .
Review:
Average and acceptable place for a bite to eat. 

Highlight of your trip will be the trip to the bathroom and wash basins.

Author: Carolyn A
Title: Very friendly place to eat
Review: This is a nicely decorated and pleasant place to eat. The menu is extensive and the service delightful. Would highly recommend you have a meal there.

Author: WanZaidi
Title: Simply good dinner
Review:
Open concept with a casual and warm atmosphere. Service is excellent as well, it feels genuinely friendly and they really care about your dining experience.

I also love the toilet ! it is really unique and very nice ambiance as well.

Author: Vinepre
Title: cute lil cafe with beautiful views but at the rear...
Review:
it was a cute lil cafe with beautiful views but at the rear..
loved... the vanilla milkshake and coffee.
n yes...free wifi ;)

Author: Eric O
Title: Food is Average, proportion small.
Review: I ordered grill barracuda fish set for the son. One of the most expensive item on the menu. I don't think the fish fresh.The price isn't cheap but I expect higher standards. The portion of pasta is tasty can't make me full even though I am a small eater.Show less

Author: ghoulies_2Uppsala
Title: Not sure what the big deal is
Review: After having tried the bottom rated place (see my Kitta review) I wanted to try one of the top rated places.Went for supper, just something small to eat and drinks. Can't complain about the food (pizza) but can't give it high rating either. A bit stingy with the ingredients (mushroom on the pizza apparently means 1 mushroom, sliced) but the overall taste is OK. But nothing more than that, all in all it feels like a very average place and not something that should get an award of excellence or be top rated.All in all this place can be summarised in one word: Average.Show less

Author: KenJean2014
Title: Excellent Coffee
Review: We only ordered coffee but it was excellent. We really like the decor and atmosphere. We felt very relaxed. We liked it because it was across the street from our hotel.

Author: Scorpio048Penrith NSW
Title: Great Lunch Experience
Review: After reading a couple of less than positive reviews I had to share our experience. We had just arrived in Langkawi this morning and are staying at the delightful Villa Molek. Short stroll across to Sun Café and our lunch experience was excellent. Unlike JessicaFay90 our chicken satay sticks were beautiful - tender and cooked to perfection and the sauce was very moorish. We also shared the vegetable spring rolls and one extra appeared on the plate. My café latte was excellent, house wine very drinkable. Service excellent - prompt and very friendly. Pity that patrons are able to smoke inside and outside the restaurant (we are so spoilt in Australia).Show less

Author: JessicaFay90
Title: Don't order satay!
Review: I love chicken satay and I think the only way you can mess it up is by giving someone all the left over chicken carcass which is what I think the sun cafe did to me! It was like lumps of fat and gristle on skewers! Overpriced and enough to put even the biggest lover of satay off! There is much better places to eat in langkowi, try the yellow beach cafe! It's the best Show less

Author: Helen HSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic deserts!
Review: Stopped here for quick meal as it was near hotel but far better than anticipated. Pleasant restaurant set back from busy road. We ended up having 3 courses, Malaysian mains which were beautifully presented and fantastic deserts. The best creme brûlée EVER (and I'm a bit of an expert!) husband had crepe suzette which he said was brilliant too. Do visit the bathroom - it's quite an experience!!Show less

Author: Jazz JMalaysia
Title: Sun Cafe?? More like sad cafe
Review: What can I say, it looks vy modern n upclass but I wish I could similiar about the staffs. I was there yesterday with my small puppy , was sitted After 15 mins the waitress came to get my order. All I wanted was just a drink. Anyway I did get served. Went there again today with my puppy, my husband was already there since he decided to hv lunch bt were told then by a local waiter that pets are not allowed?! Really surprised I said how come I was served yesterday, but the lady boy mentioned that it was a mistake?! What the heck?? We left immediately, but my husband joked saying,oh ok lady boys allowed n not small puppies! Please put up a sign if you don't accept pets at the restaurant cos this would really help, and please be professional when telling your customers on what is allowed and not allowed.Sun cafe is not a stall it s a quite a shic restaurant so small "mistakes" like this will definately give you a bad reputation.Show less

Author: sethutchinson
Title: Chocolate Lava Cake!
Review:
Great food, good-looking restaurant, customer service was always attentive!

I would go back to Langkawi just for the Chocolate Lava Cake!

Author: DianeL508
Title: Great food, reasonably priced
Review: We went here for lunch, we ordered some tempura vegetables and a sandwich, the food was very nice, the pesto wedges were delicious and all very reasonably priced.  Would highly recommend for lunch time.

Author: hellemondslex
Title: Lava chocolate cake
Review: Nice and friendly staff. Great hostess who runs the place. The food is great and the desert is even better. Chocolate lava cake is a must try. Only thing that does not fit in the hosanna atmosphere is that there is a car park directly near the terrace. Show less

Author: Balpreet SJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Mind Blowing
Review: I past by this place almost everyday but never tried at this place. I went there with my family and I have to say that the ambience is fabulous. The staff are super nice. The food was so good that you want more. The price is reasonable to the portion of food served on the plate.Overall, a very nice experience and will return again. Highly recommended to all. Definitely a must-try in Langkawi. Show less

Author: marijndeman
Title: Very good
Review: We went here for dinner 2 times. Very friendly staff and great food. We asked for theire specialty what was the barracuda, very tastefull. As desert, the lava chocolate cake...

Author: 545johne
Title: Best tempura vegetables
Review: My third time at this restaurant over the past three years and excellent as always. Excellent selection of appetizers and I highly recommend the tempura veggies, cooked to perfection. The grilled fish was delicious while the prawn dish my companion had looked stunning. Nice atmosphere, love the mosaic tile floor, and the service was very good. My friends favorite restaurant on the island and I can understand why. Show less

Author: Thomas BCanberra, Australia
Title: best chips in Langkawi
Review: Came for a quick lunch and would definitely come back. I had the cheeseburger which was tasty, the chips though were the most perfectly cooked I have had since being in Langkawi. My wife had the Thai beef salad which had an excellent authentic dressing including lemongrass, kaffir lime and fish sauce. The establishment is very well presented with a lot of fans to reduce the tropical heat, the staff were very friendly.Show less

Author: Vicki S
Title: lovely cafe with good food
Review: Nice location on the main beach road. Has an extensive menu, something for all palates. If you're craving a good toasted sandwich with oozy melted cheese between three slices of bread and great fries, go here! The bathrooms have been are just beautiful

Author: Cheeky_monkey12345
Title: Ok food
Review: The decor is quite nice and set up for westerners. The food unfortunately was only average and added up to 200 rm for 4 people which I thought was too pricey for what it was

Author: xinemondloveGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Romantic atmosphere
Review: The atmosphere is relaxing and with a very brand new washroom concept as well. I love all of the food served. Went there few times and still find it a good place to have our dinner. I wish they could come out with more types of desserts especially cakes. And more improvement on their customer service to make u feel more relaxing. It's not to say that they don't provide a good service, but there's still some space for improvement Show less

Author: Krystle H
Title: Good Food!
Review: Great food and I love their cabonara the most! Frest fruut juice and friendly staff! Worth my money!!!

Author: Marianne02_13Calgary, Alberta, Canada
Title: Excellent food!
Review: Surprise find just across tropical resort where we stayed! Had lunch and dinner . Lunch we ate the chicken satay and dinner the vegetarian curry. Booth were excellent. Very nice presentation of the food on your plate and the nice smelling flowers.Service was excellent ! Very clean and modern !Show less

Author: lilyfabuloso
Title: Great food, and great service
Review: Love this restaurant. The food were delicious. My kids love the pasta and my husband and I really enjoyed the fish dish. The service were great and they have good wifi too.

Author: Genikitty G
Title: Food display is attractive but taste average
Review: I ordered barrucuda fillet and the fish was a bit hard. The potato gratin tasted good though. My friend ordered tiger prawn but it tasted a bit hard too

Author: Dec D
Title: Just amazing
Review: Just 100m from the Frangipani Beach Resort. this busy and popular restaurant is outstanding and great value. A real surprise! We had two evening meals, quality Malaysian cooking beautifully presented. I could eat there for a week! A good selection of international dishes and some nice wines, the place is tastefully decorated and the staff are very good. I failed to get internet access but that was probably my computer.Show less

Author: senfaaa
Title: A nice meal
Review:
There was no air conditioner in this café!!! And our visiting hour was during the noon.
However, the internal space wasn’t that hot after all. 
We ordered carbonara spaghetti, Hawaiian pizza and a parmigiana plus fruit juices.
All tasted very nice!
So, no more comment.

Author: Pim VUtrecht
Title: Delicious
Review: Delicious food. Had a malaysian dish which was perfect. Finally tasted true Asia! I had the Nasi Campur, which was delicious and spicy! Also loved the setting and interior. The staff is very kind and we already came back a second time to this restaurant because we know what to expect! Everything is clean and the dishes are perfectly made up. Loved this place! Show less

Author: shalanelodderSiem Reap, Cambodia
Title: Delicious food, really clean restaurant
Review: Sun Cafe has it all, and its actually the first restaurant here in Langkawi which we really liked. Friendly staff, nice menu, very pretty restaurant en everything is really clean!I had a pizza which was perfect (and trust me its hard to find good pizza here in langkawi). My boyfriend had the sate chicken which he really loved. Definitely a place to visit!!Show less

Author: UngleFIN
Title: Best food and service in Langkawi !
Review: Food is excellent, nice and enough :) ! And service is first-class. Milieu is nice, toilets ...WOW !

Author: bonesiaustralia
Title: Revisited and still excellent
Review: Since arriving in Langkawi we have been 3 times to the Sun Cafe, everything on there menu is worth trying. My husband had the Lamb shank it was very tender with veg. I had a very large lasagne with salad, but the best for me is the creame brûlée with a very thick toffee coatingIt is a sweet persons heaven in a dish. They open just after 12 o'clock and the restaurant is very clean and the staff always smilingThere is no rush for you to decide what to pick from there menu. We will be going back before I leave LangkawiShow less

Author: Max G
Title: Wonderful
Review: Staff friendly and the service is good. Food is great too and price still acceptable not very expensive....

Author: Steve PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unexpected find - we went back!
Review: The menu covered all the cafe options - pizza, local, pasta, salads etc and great desserts. We initially went just for a coffee which was pretty good and then decided we had to go back and eat there. The staff were friendly - the food was good - excellent value and well worth a trip. Check out the toilets too - quite possibly the nicest setting in Langkawi - it just shows that they care!Show less

Author: Liv MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Drinks & Ice Cream
Review: We stumbled across this cafe on a very hot Sat afternoon. My husband had a chocolate milkshake which he said tasted just like melted ice cream & he loved it. It came garnished with cream, cherries & Choc sauce. I enjoyed a very generous Singapore Sling cocktail (15 Ringot) garnished with a cherry & we shared the ice cream from the dessert menu which was described as being 2 scoops of ice cream with whipped cream & fruit. It was a very generous 2 scoops (more like 4 scoops) & had delicious fruit as well as nuts, Choc sauce & plenty of whipped cream all for about 13 Ringot. A perfect hot afternoon treat. Staff were friendly & attentive however it was not busy when we were there - only 2 other tables of people.Show less

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Worthy of the high ranking on Tripadvisor!
Review: This restaurant was only a short walk away from our accomodation Villa Molek (upon exiting the hotel turn left on the same side of the road and only a couple of doors down) and as it was highly ranked on Tripadvisor we thought we would try lunch here. I had the Nasi Campur and my wife the Prawn Mee Goreng. Both meals were presented fantasticly (check my photos) and the staff were excellent but a special mention to Sasha for her great service. Prices are a little more than other places around but worth every extra Ringit spent.Definitely one of the better dining options in the area.Show less

Author: traveller1_9_8_3londLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing. A must visit.
Review: The food is amazing from start to finish. Well worth the money and must visit when in town. The staff are amazing and after 3 visits in a week stay the customer service got better and better. A huge thank you to all staff who made dinners an enjoyable evening. Show less

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great place, great food, very friendly staff
Review: The place looks really good and is in pristine condition. You get napkins of cloth and the food and wine is of excellent taste. I truly value for money place worthwhile your visit. The Nasi Campur is probably the best we had on Langkawi, very nicely layout, the eyes eat first, and many small tastes.Show less

Author: tprado3
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Sun cafe serve tasty foods. Fresh fruit juice, coffee, cocktail. A good place to hang out and get yourself a chilled noon after a long and hot walk.

Author: FruFrub
Title: Great service & great food
Review: Enjoyed 2 evening meals here. Staff friendly & tasty food. The cafe is set back from the road so easy parking. It has modern decor, everything clean. Very reasonably priced with quick service.

Author: tshuker
Title: Absolutely fantastic food, service And atmosphere
Review: My husband and I are in Sun cafe at the moment. Just discovered it today and are going to be regular customers whilst here. The service is the best we have come across in the 5 days we've been here and the food is excellent

Author: spark41Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: still good
Review: This is our 3rd trip to Langkawi over the last 5-6 years, and we always go to Sun Café. New staff but still good & friendly. Lunch was excellent - thai beef salad and a curry campur. My only complaint was being for 2 cappuccinos for one double shot cappuccinoShow less

Author: S9301EXsarahb
Title: Great Food
Review: Good selection of more westernised food. Cooked fresh and delivered to the table quickly by friendly staff. Good selection of drinks - lovely fresh juices beers etc. Good location from our hotel Frangipani Langkawi Resort.

Author: kelmick51
Title: Great Food, Drinks & Atmosphere!
Review: Fantastic Margaritas! we stayed at close by Villa Molek and dining here was a pleasure we indulged in a few times. Good menu with lots of variety, highly recommend a visit.

Author: stufnotstubLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely pizza.
Review: We enjoyed great pizzas here - thin and crispy, just as they should be. The staff were very friendly and even played us a song on the music system as we had been talking about it. Usually busy in the evenings, we couldn't understand why they never appeared to be open earlier during the day.Show less

Author: SonjaW698Ashford, United Kingdom
Title: chocolate lava
Review: we ate here twice during our stay in langkawi,due in part to its proximity to the resort we were staying in. On both occassions we choose to have Malay style starters and main course,which were delicious and the portions were ample. I would certsinly recommend to go for the chocolate lava,its worth the 20 minutes it takes tp prepare. The staff were wonderfull and welcoming. Show less

Author: Blondeonwye
Title: Beautiful decor
Review: Unfortunately the Satay sauce was watery. Service just so so. Ceiling fans were turning but to little effect. By comparison we have had better but I am sure all experiences and thus reviews depend on a myriad of interconnecting elements

Author: DominiqueUlteeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Drinks at Sun Cafe
Review: We had ordered two drinks (Martini on the rocks and a glass of white wine) at $27 MYR. Sounds like a good deal but the portion was absolutely small... We were stunned...We didn't even stay long since we finished the drinks too quickly and we were not tempted to order the second (small) drink...The cafe looks cozy by interior but maybe we ordered the wrong drinks... so we were not that impressed...Show less

Author: Sawan_BangaloreBengaluru, India
Title: Awesome food and hospitality!
Review: After a tiring morning by the Cenang Beach, we were looking for options to stop by for lunch. And we are glad that we chose the Sun Cafe. Great food and the staff was very courteous. A special mention about their loo - it is open on one side!Show less

Author: pege
Title: Best food in langkawi
Review:
We stayed 12 days in Langkawi and tryed several resturants , to give Sun Cafe our highest points was not difficult. We had 3 dinners and 1  
Lunch. Lamb - barracuda.The staff is funny and very professional.

Author: Andrew ONewport, Vermont
Title: A great dinner option right across from Tropical Resort
Review: My wife and I enjoyed a very leisurely dinner at this restaurant on 2 February 2014. Excellent food and service. The manager on duty chatted pleasantly with us about contrasts between the local dishes and the Singaporean cuisine to which we are more accustomed. This was the only place where we ate that we hadn't researched online: it happened to be right across from Tropical Resort Langkawi, so we stopped in for dinner after an exhausting day and left quite satisfied. We definitely would have eaten there again had our trip been longer, and I've recommended it to the same friends and family in Singapore to whom I recommended the hotel across the road.Oh, and I don't want to give away the surprise, so I'll just say: At least visit the restroom, even if nature's not calling at the time. More places should design restrooms like this.Show less

Author: yasumi999Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to be on a very hot day
Review: As many reviewers mentioned, this place has very good service. Staff are enthusaistic and friendly. They make you feel welcome.We ordered a fish and a pizza. The fish was slightly on the salty side, but the pizza was perfect. And they both came with big portion so it's really value for money.I like the fact that their kitchen is open. More confidence in the cleanliness that way.Though not a very important point, their toilet is unique. Very soothing design.Will go back again if I ever visit Langkawi in the future.Show less

Author: mings86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: poor food
Review: i was actually pretty surprised at amount of guests present that day, i was with a friend of mine and thought we should give this cafe a try. My friend who recently visited the Sun Cafe claimed that the ambience was good, not giving us much reviews on the food though. I must say that the staffs were very friendly and helpful. The setting of the restaurant is gorgeous but we were absolutely dissapointed with the menu. My friend and I had chicken chop and chicken cordon bleau. The chicken was tough, and the batter was soggy, cheese poorly done. What i had was mediocre in terms of taste and consistency. I would'nt recommend this dish to anyone at all.Show less

Author: reza h
Title: Nice
Review: It was good and friendly staffs . The food was good but not great. It had very nice restroom! I love that restaurant and i will say you should go there and if you go there you would love it!!!

Author: alison dNewcastle, United Kingdom
Title: fantastic as ever
Review: We have been coming to Langkawi for many years and have several trips to the Sun Cafe every year. All the staff a really nice and friendly. The food is always superb, always fresh and hot. The black pepper steaks are fantastic as are all the deserts. Yet to have a meal we have not enjoyed. Please Geoffrey can you add the pesto pasta that used to be on the menu at Sun Sutra as I missied it this year. See you all at christmas again.Show less

Author: hewieandcoWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Nice Food and ambience
Review: After our late arrival to our resort we ventured out to find somewhere to eat. This was one of the first restaurants we came across, given the time and tired kids we ventured in. This was the most "Western" restaurant we had eaten in on the whole trip. Prices were a little more then what we were used to - we opted for pizza,garlic bread and spring rolls for the kids and my husband had Beef Rendang and myself the Mee Goreng. Food was of a very good quality, service was very good but the highlight for the kids were the toilets! A nice highlight I will stress! Would recommend but we did walk further up the street the other evenings to find some more local cuisine.Show less

Author: Violetdb
Title: Best crepe suzette!
Review: This place was recommended by a French lady we met who had glorious reviews about their crepe suzette. It certainly lived up to our expectations. Best crepe suzette ever! Also had the bruschetta and coffee. Coffee was below average but bruschetta was really good too!

Author: GoggsylLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very good value, no frills restaurant
Review: Recommended The Sun Cafe by concierge at The Danna hotel where we were staying. It's setting/view is not what you would go here for, however the staff (including the owners) were excellent & very friendly, and the food was great plus our meal for 2 starters, 2 mains, 1 dessert & 5 drinks was £40! The chocolate torte is a MUST have! Show less

Author: Freddie1234567899Schalkwijk
Title: nice food, nice place, not so good view
Review: Place looks nice and clean. Diner was great, food was good, service was good. Only downside was view when dining outside. The view consists of a large parking area. We also had a lot of mosquitoes flying around. If you like spicy food, try the local dishes! I would also recommend a visit to the bathroom.Show less

Author: Katrina BGrand Cayman
Title: Great atmosphere, delicious food.
Review: We came to the Sun Cafe for late afternoon drinks and snacks. It has a great atmosphere and the food was delicious. If we spent more time on Langkawi, we definitely would have came back for dinner. The service was fantastic and we had a lovely chat with Sasha who runs the cafe. She works very hard and is definitely a main reason why the place is doing so well!Show less

Author: Rizby_2009Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh Delicious Flavours and Friendly Unobtrusive Service.
Review: This is actually my second time here, having tried it during my previous trip back in December 2012. I loved the inviting open air breezy feeling of this cafe and its quirky decor. Last time I had gone for lunch ordering one of their burgers and it was delicious. This time I went for dinner, and the ambience was no less detracted. It was a fairly busy night but again the service was splendid and prompt with the waiter being friendly but not overly so. I ordered a "white" pizza which was a tomatoless pie. It was really good, hearty and sprinkled generously with italian herbs. I loved it. Price-wise it was decent and good value for money. Will I come back? Definitely. A must do pit stop in Langkawi.Show less

Author: KL_home
Title: Good food
Review: Place has a nice atmosphere and friendly staff. They have a variety of food; mainly western food with some local food. We had the bruschetta and chicken cordon bleu; both were very tasty. Convenient for those who stay along Pantai Tengah.

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Still Brilliant
Review: We were delighted to be back in Langkawi and couldn't wait to return to Sun Cafe for its fantastic food and people. Everything was just as good as before and we enjoyed several evenings sampling the wonderful food and chatting to Fousey, Sasha and the rest of the lovely staff.This year we enjoyed:-Tempura Veg - the best I have ever had!Pumpkin SoupLeek and Potato SoupMalaysian Vegetable CurryMee GorengPeppercorn SteakTeriyaki SteakLava Cake and Ice creamTropical Fruit and Ice creamAll of the food was first class and very inexpensive. This is a great place for lunch, dinner or drinks all of which are served in stylish surroundings. Give it a try. If you do, Im sure you will be back for more of the wonderful hospitality and brilliant food. We will be!Margaret and KevinShow less

Author: Nadiana BLangkawi District, Malaysia
Title: Love the food, love the ambience
Review: The warm greeting from the Sun Cafe Staff is a good 'appetiser'. We had a lovely lamb shanks & hawaiian pizza for dinner. It is value for money, love the food & enjoy the warm ambience and enjoy the sweetness of choc lava cake & creme brulee dessert. I will definitely come again and recommended this place.☺️☺️Show less

Author: petap282Sydney, Australia
Title: Great staff and food
Review: We had dinner and a late coffee and both were great. Dinner was way too much for me and sadly couldn't fit it all in. Stopped for coffee and an awesome brownie one night and had a good joke with everyone. Short of wanting to lick the choc off the plate was YUMMY! They had great mai tais too. Love going to eat where the staff love to have a laugh and do a great job. See you next time!Show less

Author: 350stefank
Title: Very nice food
Review: Food was superb (had prawns and a pumpkin soup) , very nice staff, very quite - good contrast to the busy main beach.

Author: davida354
Title: Excellent restaurent
Review:
Dined here last night- Dec 7th- very good service brilliant food recommend trying the Barracuda on a bed of creamed fresh spinach, delightful. Experience slightly marred by a European family with 2 rather unruly kids. 
Certainly give the Sun Cafe a try.

Author: lelly28Ascot, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful place to eat!
Review: We were recommended this cafe by guests at the place we were staying at. As it was literally 5 minutes stroll from where we were staying we thought we would give it a try. How glad we were that we did! We ended up eating there for at least 3 of the 8 nights that we were in Langkawi. Fabulous people, so warm, welcoming and friendly. Food was lovely with plenty of choice. Desserts were amazing! Service with a smile and excellent value for money. Do give it a try, we can assure you that you won't be disappointed and will want to go back again.Show less

Author: Dave MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A must do
Review: This café is more than it first appears, from the range of meals to drinks and the quality of service. When I visited I had just come from KL and was feeling pretty jaded. The staff welcomed me with open arms and asked what business was I doing in Langkawi, I had long trousers on and a shirt, I had to explain that I had some very nasty mossy bites and had to keep them covered. When they saw them they informed me that they were sand fly bites and should be treated more vigorously. Their info helped, along with some antibiotics. but getting back to the food, I must have tried one of almost every variety of cuisine served here and could only praise them for the quality and to somewhat scold them for the quantity, too much for my meagre appetite. Beef Rendang is brilliant, I love stews of this type and quality.check out the toilet, very strange, and quirky.Show less

Author: Lenobasso
Title: Great
Review: We are eating here right now. Food presentation is great along with great taste and has a nice little outside area. I would come again.

Author: ltweed
Title: Mai tai and
Review: Barricuda excellent and I had the Udang Icapitan..... I have never tasted anything like this!! I am now on the look for ginger flower!!! Sacha?  In UK ? I think not!  See you next year

Author: VanmelVancouver, Canada
Title: Amazing food!!!!!
Review: Stopped by this restaurant for lunch and ended up going back for dinner too. Ordered a traditional malay nasi goreng, cheese burger and potato leek soup for lunch. All were delish!!! The potato leek soup was exceptional...creamy and satisfying. Burger was generous size with lots of veggies and fixings. The nasi goreng was really flavourful and beautifully presented. Met the owner and fellow Canadian, Sashi-ko (sorry for the spelling) who was so nice and kind. She recommended the barracuda fish and she was soooo right. For dinner, we ordered that along with penne with mushroom, beef rendang, nasi campur, pumpkin soup and potato leek soup (again!!!!). One word to describe the barracuda fish...amazing!!!!!! We all agreed that we could eat this dish again and again. The moist fish was perfectly cooked and seasoned, presented on a bed of ka-kong (on choy) and served with potato gratin. Even the fish haters loved this amazing fish dish. We all agreed that we could of eaten at Sun Cafe everyday. Price comparable to Canadian restaurants...some may find expensive compared to other traditional Malaysian restaurants but our consensus is that it is well worth it. Give this restaurant a try...bright, clean, attentitive service, and amazing food. P.S. Sun Cafe has the most unique spa-like bathroom too...go see for yourself. Show less

Author: cosonthebrink
Title: Good Burger and Drinks
Review: I've been to this place twice and loved it each time.  The hamburger was fabulous and good value for money.  Even the trip to the loos in the back is pleasant with a little stream running through.  ;)

Author: monophobia
Title: Pricey for Average food
Review: We ordered a cheese burger & grilled fish, the food presentation is fine but the taste is so so average. It's pricey too, rm80 for a lunch for two person, however their  service is very good, staffs are attentive & quick

Author: Marcopollo2010Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing staff
Review: I had dinner twice in this lovely cafe. On 11 , 12 September. Friendliness of the staff caught my attention. They are very welcoming and attentive. The food is tasty and the ingredients are fresh. I tried chicken chop and orange juice and chocolate milkshake which were fantastic. I recommend going there once which will lead to multiple visits.Show less

Author: Ranaakkad
Title: One of the best
Review: The food is very good and tasty the service is excellent the staff are so welcoming a must visit restaurant

Author: llandaffazArizona
Title: Nice enough
Review: Visited this restaurant after reading the rave reviews here so maybe my expectations were too high.It is a pleasant cafe serving a wide variety of pleasant food with pleasant staff.If you are looking for a "safe" place to try some Malaysian food without leaving the confines of touristville this would be a good choice. They also serve Western food so good for members of your party that are looking for more familiar choices.Because we are used to eating at hawker stalls and not in Pantai Cenang the prices seemed high to us.I feel somewhat bad giving Sun Cafe an 'average' rating because I doubt we are their target customers but I really think that the reviews stating that they have the best food on the island are vastly overstating!Show less

Author: Susan GPeregian Springs, Australia
Title: One of the best restaurants in Langkawi
Review: We visited this restaurant twice on our recent visit to Langkawi. The meals were fantastic and cooked to perfection. I had the swordfish and it was amazing. Fantastic service too. The staff were so friendly. The toilets are a must to see - never seen anything like them anywhere else.Show less

Author: nadia iMelbourne, Australia
Title: best food in town
Review: the sun cafe would have to be the best food on the island.my partner and I love this place.this is our 3rd trip to langkawi and the first place we visit.They open for lunch and close late.I have never had a bad meal ever.The food is amazing the drinks are to.get syasha to make you a mia tia. A big thank you to the staff for making our holiday unforgettable.we miss our table for two xShow less

Author: Zanimo
Title: Not to be missed.
Review:
We visited here a couple of times whilst in Langkawi. Food is lovely, fresh and very tasty. Great service, so welcoming and helpful!
Toilets are a must visit. Very cool.
Overall we will be back. One of our favourites in Langkawi.

Author: loopy_lou_6530
Title: Great food and great staff
Review:
We ate here twice as we enjoyed it so much the first time.  Great menu with a large variety at reasonable prices.
Recommend to try the melon freezie drink (no alcohol), just delicious.

Author: ricmesMilan, Italy
Title: best in langkawi
Review: i have been here with my family tonight. friendly staff, excellent food (i had the barracuda, delish) very nice layout. i highly recommend the sun cafe also for a burger.try the creme brulee, my favorite dessert, which i seldom find well prepared in eu and which was perfect here.Show less

Author: mozilla_monsterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Langkawi staple
Review: Located at a quieter part of the Langkawi tourist belt, Sun Café is a good place for your comfort food.The service is prompt, and friendly, and there is a large selection in the menu. The food never fail to deliver, and while they taste great, they won't win awards either. Having said that, they are consistent, and the food is always fresh and tasty, so, no complains.The Malaysian / Asian selection is what I consider to be their best work.Their prices are not high by Langkawi standards, so it's what I consider to be a good deal.Show less

Author: mavis37
Title: Lovely food!!
Review: Food was wonderful, I had Naci Campur...beautifully presented and tasted fantastic! Staff are very friendly, attentive and chatty! Whatever you do make sure you visit the toilet..WONDERFUL & QUIRKY...quite rightfully the owner was very proud, and so she should be!!

Author: hilltribeimport
Title: Great food at a fair price
Review: I've been to Sun Café many times over the years and it's consistently good if not excellent and for what you get the pricing is fair. Make sure you leave space for desert because both the crème brulee and crepe suzette will blow your mind

Author: globalthierryParis, France
Title: Food, atmosphere and staff are all great
Review: A little island of clam and atmosphere in the " Sun mall". Open air but covered with ceiling fans. Nicely decorated. Manned by a very efficient, pleasant, competent set of people and serving excellent food. A wide variety between pizzas, western dish (Meat and fish, soup and salads) and local food. A good wine selection, fresh fruit juice. Not cheap by local standards (around 38 Ringhit for a main course), but not expensive and worth every penny. Do try it. When you are finished go to the store next door to look/ buy the artifacts from Malaysia, Thailand, Burma, Indonesia... Beautiful stuff.Show less

Author: alfredyeap
Title: Delicious food!
Review:
Moderately priced, very delicious food.

The ceiling is old, pick your table well, don't sit somewhere where the ceiling is in very bad condition.

Author: bonesiaustralia
Title: Great western meals
Review: We went for lunch the staff are very good and the meal I had was perfect chicken Parma with mash potato and for sweets I had cream brûlée with thick toffee on the top and espresso coffee. In fact the cream brûlée was the best I have ever tasted. We visited a few times every thing was perfect and large servings.Show less

Author: RShahrin
Title: Lunch
Review: We had lunch at the Sun Cafe. I had a thirst quenching watermelon juice. My sons had burgers and I had salad. The food was good and delicious and service was good too.

Author: Tina CBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: fantastic food, super staff, tremendous toilets!!
Review: The food is amazing and really good value - around £5 a meal. Glass of wine £2 (Langkawi is duty free), the staff are so attentive and remember little bits from previous times, it makes you feel a valued customer. The kitchen looks clean and hygienic, the food arrives quickly and hot. The loos are a must see - so cool! The Cafe does not open until mid-day, but worth waiting for.Show less

Author: Kevin RPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Satisfaction
Review: Looking for somewhere to eat in Langkawi? Regardless of where you are on the Island, make time to visit the Sun Cafe. If its a welcome you are looking for, then this is the place, if its good food, served with style and perfection, then this is the place, want to be made to feel special, this is the place. We cant wait to go back. Once you've eaten there, believe me you will want to go back.Show less

Author: relaxgabby
Title: food are not bad and friendly staff
Review: As a solo traveler it was always nice to have friendly staff when going to a restaurant, giving me tips on where I should visit in langkawi. Of coz the food was good, but the price is slightly high.

Author: Christina89137
Title: Lovely
Review: Lovely cafe clean well organised staff friendly, food great. Would definitely come back here again when in langkawi.

Author: Suunytimes
Title: Nice cafe and good food
Review: We went here 4 times for lunch as it was close to the frangipani where we were staying. The food was really good, nice fresh juices and good service friendly staff. A must for lunch if staying nearby.

Author: john_barwell2
Title: One of the best
Review: Beautiful food friendly staff very good service.the atmosphere is relaxed .Can be a little expensive but for a special occasion it is a must.

Author: Jpw222London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service, good food
Review: We ate in Sun Cafe twice given its convenient location right across the road from our accommodation, Tropical Resort. Both times we got polite service with a smile and excellent food. It is not the cheapest restaurant in the world but no more expensive than the other places we ate in during our week in Langkawi so this was not a factor for us.It has a modern wide menu with enough choice to keep it interesting. It's decor is also modern, clean and well kept adding to the overall pleasant experiences we had there.Would definitely go back if in Pentai Tengah again.Show less

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: This is a great, stylish restauarant which scores high for quality of food, service and a relaxing evironment. PositivesFantastic food which is cooked and presented very well. Varied menu- there is something for everyone including Western and Malay dishes Wonderful cocktails, mocktails and wine Great ambianceStylish surroundings Excellent service which is friendly but not obtrusiveReasonably priced, we have paid much more elsewhere for an inferior meal and serviceNegativesI cannot think of anyOverallYou will not receive a better welcome anywhere. The restaurant is very pleasing on the eye and has an expensive contemporary look to it but in actual fact, it is very reasonably priced. This isn't a fine dining restaurant but I have enjoyed my visits here much better than those restaurants on the island which claim to be such with fussy service and sometimes hard sell ( on one occasion we went for a meal to one of the fine dining restaurants and the owner never left the table even when we were eating and bulldozed us into looking around her accommodation with a view to staying on our next visit to Langkawi, never again!). We visited Sun Cafe many times and tried different dishes and on each occasion left feeling full and very happy after a very enjoyable evening. The staff help to create a happy and informal dining experience by being genuinley pleasant and attentive without being over the top.Give Sun Cafe a visit you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: HolidayHighsBournemouth
Title: Loved it so much we went twice in 5 days!
Review: From walking in to the restaurant we were greeted with such friendly service, smiles and were made to feel so welcome. The menu selection is great and the price is good too. There is a mixture of local dishes and western dishes to suit all. I can highly recommend the cocktails too!The tables are presented beautifully with fresh frangipani flowers on the napkins which smell amazing. The decor is simple, elegant and modern. We ordered brushetta to share to start which was lovely and fresh. We also had on recommendation from the waitress the chicken special and the barracuda both were amazingly good! We didn't sample the puddings as both were full but they looked good too.Would highly recommend coming here. We ate here twice and both times had fantastic meals and service.Show less

Author: Sarah_says_so
Title: Fantastic service and food!
Review: Reasonably priced for what you are getting.  Excellent quality and price.  The staff and service were fantastic.  The atmosphere was wonderful...nice and upscale.  Would recommend to anyone to go here, anytime.

Author: Stephen BOxford, England, United Kingdom
Title: Great quality beverages!
Review: Almost in the wrong direction from the main stretch of bars and restaurants along Pentai Cenang, but worth a detour if you have time. A nice atmosphere and a more sophisticated feel if you fancy a relaxing coffee or two somewhere quiter. Friendly staff lovely decorShow less

Author: Carolmac44
Title: Good but pricey
Review: Always looks closed during the day.  Had a lovely meal, staff very friendly and cheerful.  Not sure it is worth the Western prices.

Author: 997MichaelB997Brittany, France
Title: You,won't find better service anywhere!
Review: This is so much more than a cafe! It is a wonderful experience. You won't get better service anywhere. The staff are so attentive, friendly and genuinely caring.The ambiance is superb from the decor to the background music and the tableware!Menu is a mixture of local and western dishes but so well cooked and presented.The Thai beef salad is my favourite starter and the barracuda is absolutely delicious.Have been holidaying in Langkawi for years....come here every other night! You won't find better cuisine for the price which is very reasonable by western city standards.Highly recommended!Show less

Author: veggissAsker, Norway
Title: Great tasting food
Review: We had lunch here on the day we left Langkawi. We bought some local dishes, and they where presented very nicely on the plates. It tasted good as well. The price is quite steep for local food though, but we found it worth it. They also have western food on the meny if you favour that.Show less

Author: HaidhauserinGermany
Title: The best restaurant in the Cenang Beach area
Review: We've been in the area for about a week and really had trouble finding acceptable food. Sun Cafe was THE exception. The people were lovely and understood the word 'service'. Food was pretty good, though I think I do rank it a bit higher because of the poor competition. Menu offers good fusion selection with a bit for everyone. Restaurant, kitchen, toilets - all super clean. We spent our dinner on New Year's Eve there - they've done a great job. Certainly the best restaurant we found in the whole area.Show less

Author: gmjngrs
Title: Where traditional meets modern
Review: Traditional Malay food with a modern twist. Nice atmosphere. Friendly  staff. Also wurthwile visiting is the shop Sun Flower just opposite the restaurant. Delicate gifts.

Author: kirstenmdkuala lumpur
Title: Delicious and Delightful
Review: This was one of the best meals I've had in ages. A great little menu, with some tasty local dishes as well as fresh fish and a range of tourist and child friendly choices. My friends were delighted with their beef rendang, ayam (chicken) masak merah, and pizza margarita. I had sea bass which was perfectly cooked and so tasty. It's a lovely little spot, and don't fail to visit the bathrooms, they are quite special. The food is quality and well worth the price which is actually quite reasonable. I was sad we did not have time to go back there and would recommend it to everyone!Show less

Author: dreamlander78
Title: good service, good food
Review: we have a quick lunch there as we need to rush back to hotel for our afternoon tour. Food was good, the service staff is friendly and pricing was average (not too expensive for the ambiance/environment). Overall i would recommend this place.

Author: ffmwolfFrankfurt, Germany
Title: very friendly people with excellent food
Review: without any doubts this cafe has excellent food. very nicely designed and served. the price is good, even a bottle of wine is affordable. the location is quiet and toilets are clean and even decorated with flowers. especially the waiters are friendly and give you a warm and welcome feeling. Show less

Author: kasiap778Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for a week, tried 4 different restaurants before having the dinner in Sun Cafe. I can definetely recommend every dish from their Malaysian section, it can also be adjusted to the preferred level of spicyness (none for me and very spicy for my husband). The stuff is very friendly and helpful and this is why we came back there every day for a dinner. Twice we were treated with free desert as to say thanks for coming back :) I will definetely go back there whenever in Langkawi!Show less

Author: Ameisenigel
Title: Awesome!
Review: We like the place, the food i very delicous, also the cocktails and the staff is so lovely! We hope to see you soon!

Author: Johan H
Title: Quality and great service.
Review: I only ordered an espresso with some water. The espresso was tasting perfekt. Not to burnt and not to soft. I got a lime and a glass to my bottled water which was a nice touch. The waitress was friendly and attentive. Add the comfy couch I sat in on the outside. The design was thoughtful and warm. The wifi was also great and it was just to connect. A perfect place for a homesick traveler. They also had a nice interior with AC for those who need that. Felt like a classy café as I would have been in Sweden. Sometimes that option is nice to have when you visit Langkawi.Show less

Author: burniejim
Title: Sun Cafe
Review: We liked every thing about the Sun Cafe, the food was delicious, & the staff were very happy to answer any question, it is very beautifully decorated, & they have great milkshakes, black rice dessert, which was wonderful

Author: MickHM
Title: Best wedges ever
Review: We had lunch at this restaurant. They have the best pesto wedges we have ever eaten and our kids had the best mocktails they have ever had. Highly reccomend.

Author: a-girl-goes
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Well worth a visit. lovely location. We ate here for lunch and dinner. Loved the food and the presentation.   Great menu and good for kids.

Author: Theexecchef
Title: Decent enough
Review: Went their for a quick bite, food ok and the restaurant is very clean..don't cater to vegetarians much....

Author: MeinKLWells, United Kingdom
Title: good food and lovely staff
Review: We really like the Sun cafe - it's open and airy and the food is consistently good. The staff are really friendly and the decor good. Great toilets and we love the fact that the kitchen is open so you can see how clean it is. The prawn Mee Goreng is really good.Show less

Author: SteveC33
Title: Nice place
Review: Had a nice meal with some friends and family. Unusual decor and toilet facilities. Food was tasty and good value.

Author: Shee T
Title: fantastic
Review: love the ambiance and the decor. we came very late at night and felt very welcomed. unfortunately the.kitchen was already closed and we couldnt sample any othee food except for the cake displayed. And it was perfect. We came back the followinv.night before.leaving the island the next morning. Would definitely come back to sun cafe. Look for Nasya and Siti. Their service is excellent.Show less

Author: sarahipHong Kong
Title: Loving it!
Review: The people in here are so nice with effective service. Food is wonderfully delicious! Pasta, burger, rice, brownie, ice-cream, fresh fruit drinks, latte, yummy~ Though the menu doesn't have many choices. The price is very reasonable! The decoration and music are so relaxing. You can sit for long and nobody will challenge you. Why not have a try?Show less

Author: Jim C
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: The Sun Cafe deserves a higher ranking!It is a clean,modern restaurant that serves excellent food at reasonable prices.The staff are friendly and efficient.We ate there twice but would have gone back again if we had discovered it earlier in our stay.Go there!

Author: Michael J
Title: Value for the money
Review: Nice atmosphere - finest toilets of Malysia - good food

Author: Dicko88Kuala Lumpur
Title: Stolen iPad!!!
Review: We have been to Langkawi for a girls weekend for the past 2 years and we love the food at Sun Café.On this trip one of my friends accedently left her iPad on the chair at Sun Café, we went back no longer than 20 minuts later but it had gone. The member of staff that cleared the table had gone for her dinner, when she returned she said that she did not see the iPad. They also said no other people had been near the area where we sat, so it must have vanished into thin air!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! They also dont have air-con and it can get very hot.This has now tarnished our thoughts of the Sun Café and will NEVER return again.Show less

Author: Rhosesmor1
Title: Great food and Service
Review:
Another great gem!

Great food, great friendly service.  Have been coming for the last 4 years and its still as good as ever - whether its for a drink, lunch or dinner - highly recommended

Author: scotmark2004
Title: A bit chainy
Review: Okay for a cooling cocktail or snack, but the Sun Group have a lot of ventures in the area and the waiter spend most of his time trying to persuade us to try them all!

Author: ClovaTheWestie
Title: Good food, great surroundings
Review: Really enjoyed our meal at the cafe. the food was delicious, well cooked and staff friendly.

Author: Kawidawn
Title: Great coffee, relaxed atmosphere
Review: Great place for coffee, lunch, dessert etc.. with western and local dishes. Good place to kick back and watch life go by. You can even learn alittle Malay in the process the guys working there are always willing to help with your pronouncations.

Author: Woktraveller
Title: Excellent food
Review:
We ate here quite often as the food was excellent and very reasonably priced
Highly recommend.

Author: Chris TPerth, Australia
Title: Lovely Asian Food
Review: Four of us visited the restaurant on 3 occassions. Friendly, efficient staff with delicious well priced food. On the first 2 occassions we had Asian food which could not be faulted. However on the 3rd visit we all opted for Western Style food which was quite disappointing. My advice is stick to the Asian food for complete satisfaction.Show less

Author: john_barwell2
Title: Beautiful food
Review: This is a beautiful restaurant ,the service and presentation of food is the best for miles around. The toilets are worth visiting !!

Author: Joyi_Ng
Title: One of the best F&B options
Review:
Had our lunch here and the quality of food here, very good at reasonable price. Good service as well !! Try the Hawaiian Pizza !! :-)
Located @ Tengah Beach

Author: Jamesli
Title: Nice decor and great food.
Review: A laid back cafe atmosphere, great food seemingly an east/west fusion menu, the fish dish I enjoyed particularly. Perhaps better to visit in the evenings than at lunchtime, on the sunny day we visited it was a little warm without air con.

Author: OliveandgrayLondon UK
Title: Sun, Sun, Sun.............Cafe!
Review: We have been backwards and forwards to Langkawi for many years and since it opened always but always visit Sun Cafe for its great food, great staff/service and the general friendly ambience.Keep up the good work Jeffrey - See you in February 2012!Olive & GrayUKShow less

Author: nickLangkawi
Title: excellent staff
Review: go here and enjoy full time service. food isnt bad either

Author: aurfei
Title: Nice hangout
Review: Had a late night snack here. Desserts were good and had a nice and comfortable setting.

Author: LittleBee1
Title: Modern trendy place
Review: Very tastefully decorated, great food. Pesto wedges were a nice variation and the food is well presented. The creme brulee is a must here!

Author: htss
Title: Yummy
Review: Cosy restaurant serving delicious food with reasonable portion sizes. Will come back again!

Author: lsparrowKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cosy restaurant with good food
Review: The restaurant looks posh from the outside but you'll be surprise that the price is similar to that of small eatery in Pantai Cenang.The restroom at the back is nicely decorated as well and have cold towels to freshen you up after a hot day in the sun.Will definitely come here and eat again the next time I'm in Langkawi.Show less

Author: TDHZAdelaide, Australia
Title: Nice modern cafe with great menu
Review: We stopped in here on our first night in Langkawi, loved the decor and the relaxed feel. The menu was great, had a good range of cuisines and food for our little ones too. Staff were friendly and spoke excellent english. Two of our party have severe nut allergies so they made sure nothing was in the dishes we had ordered could cause a reaction. We had a lovely night and were back for coffees the next morning. If you visit here make sure you check out the toilet out the back - amazing, like something in a 5 star resort! Show less

Author: Will74
Title: Great ambience and good food
Review: The staffs we friendly and the food was priced reasonable.

Author: gypsymamanworld
Title: Don't Bother - They don't
Review: My partner and I stopped here for lunch. The service was not bad and the lunch was edible but everything was just too casual. I especially objected to the Club sandwich which was just food piled on a hamburger bun. It really seemed the chef didn't care about it. I'd been to the restaurant a coulple od years ago and had a good food experience so that's why I was really disappointed. It's a lovely restaurant and I am sad to see it ruined by so-so food that's not worth the price. I hope they were just having a bad day.Show less

Author: cosonthebrink
Title: Yummy Hamburger
Review: Really great food, if a little more pricey than I had hoped.

Author: AikZuShyong
Title: Beef bolognaise awesome
Review: I love the beef bolognaise. The chef really knows how to balance the flavor of herbs+salt and texture of the beef. Spaghetti's are just right (not too tough not too soft). Friendly waitress.

Author: blockbusterjude
Title: Mushroom soup is great
Review: I had the chicken chop, it came with sweet and sour topping which made it weird. The mushroom soup was fantastic though.

Author: Ian HManchester
Title: Good food and friendly service
Review: Visited a couple of times on this trip and both the food and the service have been consistently of a high standard. The cafe is immaculate and the staff attentive and remembered us on our second visit. The Nasi campur and Mee Goreng were both great and served as generous portions. The Western food is also good, my wife had a cheeseburger and chips the second time (as she had a hangover:-) ). Comes highly recommended!Show less

Author: Charliez78
Title: This cafe beckons you to come in
Review: Wonderful staff who were very informative with recommendations of Langkawi 'must dos'.  We had lunch and the food was outstanding.  Lots to choose from the menu from western cuisine to high quality malay cuisine.  Highly recommend the Nasi campur.  Very modern design and clean cafe.

Author: chait123
Title: Great food, informative staff...
