Review: Great place for dinner for a couple... Food is outstanding and has definitely one of the widest food & bar menus in Langkawi...

Author: Kathy_Ba77Berlin, Germany
Title: Great Restaurant
Review: It was really fun to eat there. The stuff offers a great service and the food is of a very good quality. It is stylish furnished and openly designed with a slight Asiatic design. The same can be said about the food. It is like modern fusion of Malai and European cuisine.So you can make a break of the traditional Malai food which you find in the streets.Show less

Author: Lenny A
Title: Pleasant Surprise
Review: Was very close to the hotel we were staying, so we just sauntered in for Lunch. We ordered local food as well as pasta and it was great. Decent service, reasonable pricing. Not too crowded and they serve decent cocktails too

Author: Alywin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice relaxed setting, food is alright
Review: Located within Sun Mall, Sun Cafe has a relaxed setting. Service was prompt with no complains. We had the grilled prawns with pasta, thai beef salad and black rice pudding (a tad too sweet). Food is alright, nothing to shout about, but overall fresh and tasty.Show less

Author: Roadtoholidays
Title: Nice atmosphere, disappointing cappuccino/cocktails and ok food.
Review: Nice setting and atmosphere. Service was above average. Cappuccino and cocktails were of disappointing quality. Food was ok but nothing special. Overall not likely to come back.

Author: carolinebee
Title: Clean and chic
Review: Went to Pantai Cenang for the day and saw this cafe, and although not heaving, looked pleasant enough. Found the interior to be very chic and immaculate. Food also good and great value.

Author: BenRo
Title: Nice for lunch, dinner or drinks
Review: Lovely staff here and a fab place to grab a bite in the day or evening or have cocktails and drinks. In a nice liitle spot just in between Cenang and Tengah.

Author: Explore79915
Title: Tasty food in a nice setting
Review: We had both lunch and dinner here. During the day it has a cafe vibe but at night it feels more like a restaurant, napkin rings and all. Loved the photos of all the different people from all different cultures that were up on the walls. The waiting staff were friendly and deficient, especially at night. They do the best fresh pressed orange juice and The food was always tasty. Look out for The rice served under a leaf cone! And if you go there take a trip to the toilets - they are designed with only three walls!Show less

Author: Ideavirus
Title: Nice little place to drink n dine
Review: A nice little cafe with good food n reasonable service. I tried their chicken burger which was very good. Drinks are a little expensive but overall the cafe is a nice place to visit.

Author: Geoff HPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Garlic Heaven! If You LOVE garlic
Review: I have eaten great food in restaurants and I've eaten bad food in restaurants - this is the first time I haven't been able to eat the food in a restaurant at all ! My companions thought their food was OK - I made the mistake of ordering the pastry topped lamb and it was totally inedible, unless you like lamb with your garlic! I had one taste of the sauce because I smelt the dish coming from 3 metres away. No big deal if the menu had suggested that the dish even contained garlic - but it didn't!That in itself would not have been so bad, except the manager insisted that the dish contained a 'normal amount' of garlic and refused to accept that there was anything out of the ordinary in having guests send food back untouched.When the bill came - not only did they charge me for the dish but insisted on adding the service charge to it because "Garlic is the basis for all foods. It was my fault that I couldn't eat it". Take my advice - smell someone else's food before you order or be prepared to be told that the food is perfect - you were at fault. as a PS: I love garlic bread - it's only lamb steeped in garlic oil I can't handle.Show less

Author: garyknivetonGlastonbury, United Kingdom
Title: A cool place on a hot day.
Review: We generally visited the Sun Cafe during the day to cool off after a long walk along the beach or through the town. The place is set out in a modern style and provides great snacks and light meals. The staff were always friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: quepasapd
Title: consistantly good food
Review: I eat here regularly and the food is nothing special but always good. The place is well maintained, clean and the staff are always welcoming. This is one of those places you can go back to in the day time and not be shocked.

Author: Marie HPerth, Australia
Title: amazing food
Review: On our recent holiday in Langkawi, we dined at the Sun Cafe 4 times.The food is of top standard. We had both Western and Asian dishes andall of them were excellent in presentation and taste. Service and value formoney is outstanding. Don't forget to try the Lemon Mousse Cake.Show less

Author: theowldullsvilledullsville
Title: We miss this cafe: Wish I was back in Langkawi
Review: This Cafe is an absolute gem, its spotlessly clean , modern, wait until you see the bathrooms they are worth a visit for their uniqueness, the staff are friendly and welcoming the service is excellent the food unreal.We went back a few times during our stay we got into the routine of cocktails and cake around lunch time { after a big hotel breakfast} we called it C&C's The desserts are heaven, my partner fell totally in love with the chocoalte brownie drowning in chocolate sauce { ask for vanilla ice cream ] and I loved the lemon mousse cake on a fruit sauce - yum ! The food we had other meals also was beautifully presented this place really is a good find and the souvenir shop next doors is also theres and has some lovely bits and pieces to take home As for the cocktail aprt of the story well the blue lagoon and mai tai can be vouched for as can the melon ball and singapore sling The king prawn pasta dish and the pineapple rice were fantastic also - so make sure you do not miss itShow less

Author: peedicrack
Title: Great Place
Review:
I love this place. Very relaxed, friendly people and interesting decorations.
The food and drinks are yummi and its a nice mix between local food and international.

Highly recommended!

Author: Pioneer46185375892
Title: A gem for vegetarian
Review:
Such a gem for vegetarian food in Langkawi!
Good service good food with vibrant artsy ambience. The space is quite limited though.

Author: Lina E
Title: Delicious banana pie
Review: Quaint ambience, good service and tasty banana pie. Worth a visit.The upper floor section is also nice

Author: visit11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super place, great flavors and service.
Review: Super place with great tasting good. Visited on 3rd January and booked small table for two as had a recommendation and needed a change from staying in the Westin hotel. Sat inside ordered chicken and mushroom dish for my wife and the lamb shank for myself along with mashed potatoes and mint sauce. Both were fantastic and best meal all week. Started in happy hour 2x1 beers 5-7pm and brought our own bottle of duty free wine, with a 30 Ringgit corkage charge. Great service with a smile and choice of inside or outside tables. All in all, a great Langkawi option. Give it a try...Show less

Author: 697ant
Title: Really lovely food and great atmosphere
Review: A really nice Cafe with great fresh food and good vegetarian options. Good mix of cuisine. Friendly staff too.

Author: jenjira111Tanjung Bungah, Malaysia
Title: Pretty but pricey.
Review: Latte was mediocre in flavor - it was pretty, nice foam but not great :( Also had a ginger snap fresh juice - very tart! No sugar which was a nice change but probably wouldn’t order it again. Food is pricy for what u get. 15RM for garlic cheese bread. 20 for buttered noodles. Nice chill vibe tho. Legit art, and music covers.Show less

Title: Good Food
Review: Interesting place with artwork on the walls. Good Food, excellent service. Food comes out very quickly.

Author: Sharesz
Title: A great place to chill with fresh food and diverse choices
Review: Great atmosphere, chilled ambiance, we drove all over the island many times just to come here to hang out and to eat. Eclectic menu, fresh food and juices, the lamb shank was fantastic, and we we had a nice chat with the owner who has been doing a great job successfully running this place for the last 16 years!Show less

Author: Patrick DBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Outstanding venue and outstanding food
Review: My friends and I live in Cenang and visit Kuah fortnightly for a grocery/grog runFor the last four times, we've gone to the Arts Cafe and between us, we've just about eaten the menu. My favourite is the the lamb shank which is huge, surrounded by vegetables and mashed potato and is absolutely melt-in-the mouthWe've also had salads and pastas all of which are very generous portions and beautifully presentedWine and beer is very well-priced - overall a very pleasant experienceShow less

Author: chuckyJellie
Title: Good coffee
Review:
Visited Arts Cafe after recommendation from friends. 

Warm welcome by owner. Excellent coffee and the carrot cake was delicious.
There is some street art around the cafe which is worth checking out. Lots of parking.

Author: Travelmonkey016
Title: Awesome!!!
Review: We came across this cafe as an incident. We read lots of good things. And, it was true. We ordered lamb shank and beef + rotti. The shank was very tender and yummy. So as the beef. The rotti was out of the world. It was crusty, flaky and buttery. It was like the shell of high-end cheese danish. The staff is very friendly. Would totally recommend.Show less

Author: Peter0999
Title: Very good
Review:
Menu includes many western
dishes for those needing a break! Pasta and sandwiches contained good/plenty/fresh ingredients - very good. Asian dishes also very good. Good coffee

Author: sezzyloulouHarlow, United Kingdom
Title: Pricey compared to other restaurants nearby but tasty
Review: Mixed reviews for this place, but only staying round the corner and fancied a break from noodles, rice etc...so decided to give it a try. Quite a small place, but nice and clean, artwork on walls.I had Cottage Pie and it was delicious, generous portion and piping hot. Service was friendly and efficient. Sat outside, got there just before a large group (x10 ppl) arrived, so perfect timing. Could of had probably four meals in local street food places for price, but still just under £20 for two including glass of wine and two beers! Made a nice change from local food ( which is delicious) Show less

Author: paulwaldnerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: I think this is my first negative review on trip advisor. We were so disappointed with our lunch here, maybe we ordered the wrong dishes (cured meat platter and spring rolls). Both were pretty bad to be honest and my gf thought the coffee was very average as well. Cool cafe though and staff reasonably friendly but we wished we went elsewhere Show less

Author: 993andrews
Title: Excellent restaurant with great atmosphere
Review:
Excellent restaurant with great atmosphere and friendly staff. 

Menu is wide and varied with something for everyone. 

The food was exactly as described in the menu and tasted fabulous.

Author: Lavangee123
Title: OK
Review: Food quality was ok. Not great value for your money. Would not recommend this place. Trip Advisor rating does not reflect true indication. Trip Advisor needs to re look at it rating system. Trip Advisor needs new algorithm.

Author: Resort66228364623
Title: Pricey and over rating
Review: Price too expensive and i guess too over rating, maybe afternoon no many choices, the only positive thing ia the environment and decor

Author: NicoleSheHuik
Title: Pricey and not worth
Review: Pricey because the foods not as tasty as shown in website or promoted by blogger. The drink also very simple but costy

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Really lovely place and food
Review: The cafe is lovely and the food so good we visited twice... And on both occasions our choices were beautiful.

Author: 199sharond
Title: Holuday
Review: Wonderful food.. amazing ambience ... curry mee so delicious ..music is not so loud and the staff is so friendly

Author: MrMmmmmmmmmmmmmHuizhou, China
Title: The atmosphere is great
Review: The atmosphere is great; there is calming music playing, comfortable seating, fans and friendly staff. The menu is ideal for a brunch/lunch. My wife and I had the salad with wasabi dressing and the tomato soup with cheesy garlic bread. Both were prepared and presented well. We would come here again, definitely. Show less

Author: MactoekSchiedam, The Netherlands
Title: Best cappuccino in Langkawi.
Review: Best cappuccino in Langkawi. We only had drinks here since we already had eaten something. We were craving for good coffee. This place has it all!Nice scene and atmosphere, back ground music, so relaxed and there is nice art work on the walls. Outdoor terrace and a upstairs to sit, relax and enjoy food & drinks. Menu has great pictures which matches the real foods and drinks and a nice variety of both local and western food.RM 8 for a hot cappuccino. Nasi Lemak RM 26, fries noodle RM 24, whole Pizza RM 28, ceasar salad with chicken RM 24, gado gado RM 24 etc. It’s not the cheapest off course but worth the money.Also the toilets are clean, no water ballet in the ladies :), floor is dry and if you do want to splash there is a fountain and enough toilet paper. A big yes for us and we will definitely be back, keep up the good job guys and best of luck in future business!Show less

Author: Joaser
Title: Nice quiet place in Kuah‘s
Review: Nice quiet place in Kuah‘s main shopping area. Lovely decor and clean toilets. Very varied food offerings and good variety of drinks. Good service and free WIFI. Okay prices

Author: meixin
Title: Staff not attentive
Review: Found nothing special with this restaurant. Food is ok with big portion. Staff is very unattentive or I would say bad service. I have to order my beer twice eventhough my glass is empty for about 10 minutes. It’s a small restaurant with not that too many tables and guests at that time. No one offered to ask eventhough they saw and passes by. I was sitting just beside the counter about a meter away. Anyway will not return to this restaurant again. Show less

Author: Kraburi
Title: Coffee
Review:
Just went to have a black coffee there, taste good. Clean place nice decoration.
Location center  Kuah town.

Author: pan701
Title: Just good food
Review: Great food variety on the menu always high standard very good prices Staff friendly toilets always very clean which is a big plus in Malaysia

Author: GoAllPlaces
Title: Great coffee & cakes
Review: Came here with our family of 8. Everyone loves their coffee, cakes selection and service. Strongly recommended!!

Author: ZtayobBrisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent food
Review: Pros1. Place is very clean and presentable2. Staff very friendly3. Ordered pumpkin soup, garlic bread , Italian nachos and lamb shank. All the food was absolutely gorgeous. Well presented and very tasty .4. Prices were very fair. Good value for money. 5. Service was fast and efficient .ConsNone Show less

Author: JennieWHampshire
Title: Lovely lunch
Review: We came here for lunch (two adults and a 3 year old). Air conditioned, lovely toilets, friendly staff, lovely food, accommodating to our little boy. Would def come here again!

Author: SophieChubb
Title: Yummy food
Review: Really delicious food, friendly staff and a cool place. Definitely recommend. My kids loved the food as well.

Author: joday013
Title: Great food
Review: Went for lunch and dinner.  Ordered Asian food but there was plenty of other tucker on the menu.  Beer was cheap and cold.  The staff were awesome.  If you are in town and want a cheap feed pop in.

Author: Bil CMiami Beach, Florida
Title: Delicious food, great vibe, screamin' WiFi
Review: We were exploring the shopping district in the SE part of Langkawi and walked into this gem of an eatery. Friendly staff and lovely paintings on the wall. Cottage pie and Caeser Salad were excellent, and the WiFi is the fastest I have seen in SE Asia!Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Bitterballenbruid
Title: Good food and wine
Review: Nice food. Not delicious, but decent. White wine 12RM per glass. Beer 7RM. Lots of Western dishes, but Asian options too. Come if you’re in the area but don’t make a special trip.

Author: V00DooKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Review of Coffee only
Review: Had a coffee while deciding if I wanted to eat here. For RM8.80, my cup was not full and the flat white had too much foam (almost a cappucino), thin and extremely bitter. Quite stingy with the milk, and the espresso pull was too long, resulting in the bitter notes. I suspect that the beans are not 100% arabica either, I definitely tasted some robusta. Was expecting better coffee given the reviews, but was sorely disappointed. Service was so-so, cafe decor is quaint, toilets are clean, air-conditioning excellent.Show less

Author: Chriselle B
Title: Quaint cozy cafe
Review: This cafe was so close to our hotel that we were really sad we didn't know of it earlier. We would have probably gone here both the days, it was that good. Great ambience, food and drink. Would definitely reccommend it!

Author: ShimaM22
Title: great staff good food
Review: spoilt with choices - western and asian even fusion style of food - big portion one order enough for 2 pax - tried the vietnamese spring roll - superb pie's - yummy desserts

Author: KayBeeSun
Title: I came for the coffee and it didn't disappoint
Review:
Quirky cafe with great air con.  Worth the 15 minute walk from my hotel to have a decent coffee. 
I came several times and wasn't disappointed!

Author: dannyliu93Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia
Title: Long waiting time & questionable food?
Review: Too much sauce for carbonara & too dry for the sandwich. Along with long waiting time(1 hour). Overall will not come again.Show less

Author: 654paulinel
Title: Yummylicious
Review: Great ambience with good food. Portions are big n value for money. Never miss this cafe when u have an opportunity to visit Langkawi. Show less

Author: Lama SCalgary, Canada
Title: Nice Cafe with a good selection
Review: Went there a few times during our stay. Decent food and good coffee. Has a good selection for breakfast and lunch; including some international options.Show less

Author: Penr15The Netherlands
Title: Nice pasta
Review: Cosy place for a western dinner. Proper homemade pasta dishes and nice fruit smoothies as desert. Price-quality ratio ok. Nicely decorated with modern art and free wifi to book a grab car back.Show less

Author: ethanwongha
Title: Nice environment but way overpriced
Review: Price is pretty cutthroat for food options. Coffees are pretty much the more reasonably-priced option for tourists/locals looking to get the best bang for their buckShow less

Author: perthstorm76
Title: Great food
Review:
Read some good reviews about this place and were not disappointed. 
The food was excellent,  fast service and generous helpings. The Spaghetti Bolognese was beautiful    
Highly recommend this resturant

Author: Gary S
Title: Nice place
Review: Enjoyed the breakfast and the coffee. If the coffee was hotter I would rate the place higher. Went there twice but only lukewarm

Author: YanHui_415
Title: Worth the price
Review: The portion of food was super big and foods we ordered were delicious. Worth the price and if visit Langkawi again, I'll definitely visit again

Author: travelgirlforyouBengaluru, India
Title: good for breakfast
Review: this place has a good breakfast option and is close to bayview hotel situated near the traffic signalhowever place is tiny with hardly 4 or 5 tables and I would say not really suitable for a group over 4 peoplefood is good so if you can adjust a bit its a good place for breakfastShow less

Author: JUnniMorgan
Title: Lovely cafe, good portions.
Review: Cozy ambience. Approx 100 for dinner for two with drinks. The portions are big, and tasty. Had grilled salmon, cottage pie, milkshake and juice. The cheese was thick on the cottage pie, almost chocked on it. Lovely painting for sale cover all the walls.

Author: Isaac L
Title: Breakfast in kuah town
Review: Decided to give this a try after reading all the positive reviews. Order a set long black comes with orange juice and pancake plus a yogurt with fruits. It was our best breakfast ever.. Especially the pancakes was done so good garnish with coconut flakes and blend well with basil leaves and cream that melts in your mouth. Thou is simple but trust me.. It is best breakfast after so many days here searching for a good breakfast. Yogurt was little sour but compliment well with the cut fruits . Long black is a little acidity. Ambience 8/10 , taste 8/10 , portion is generous and value for $. "Ka ka" older sister aka "the cook" speak little English but we understand that she cook with love. That's what bless our day happy! Show less

Author: anonymous8808
Title: nice
Review: went there for lunch on our 1st day along with 2 kids. food taste was not bad even it is a bit pricey. friendly lady boss.

Author: Gin_Chng
Title: Nice food👍
Review: Nice food and environment. We had the nachos with bolognese chicken, duck dish with mashed potato and a fried rice. highly recommend the nachos and duck dish.

Author: eileen24Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely relaxed cafe
Review: The iced ginger tea was delicious here. I loved the Art Deco and feel this lovely venue has. The food brought out to other customers looked so delicious, sadly we’d not long had breakfast. It was so quirky and friendly and was obviously a go to place as we got the last table.Show less

Author: eho1628
Title: Breakfast
Review:
Excellent set menu for breakfast.  Great coffee!  Nice atmosphere with artworks displayed!

Friendly staff!  Great location near the Bayview Hotel!

Author: cindymarieazurValencia, Spain
Title: The place itself very artistic and food is good to have
Review: We’re very curious to taste their food due to great reviews. But when reached and ordered their local dishes, we thought that nothing so extra with their dishes compare to places that we’ve been to. I Guess they changed their original local dishes spiciness for tourists and that lose the authenticity of its taste. Overall, happy with our dishes but not so extraordinary. Great for tourists to try but for me authenticity and local taste not there so much.Show less

Author: Kathryn DEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and cold beer
Review: We ate here on a couple of occasions. Firstly we tasted their cakes - a fruit berry strudel and a banana crumble cake with vanilla icecream - absolutely delicious at RM 12.50. Our second meal wasn't quite as good - a very strange mixed meat platter for RM 36. The other food we saw looked great, though.Still, the beer was always cold at RM 7, with happy hour 5-7 with buy 1 take 1, and the restaurant itself is very attractive with plenty of modern art on the walls, which is also for sale. Small outside seating area. Seems very popular with locals and touristst alike.Show less

Author: Natty M
Title: Best Rosti and Rendang!
Review: Had the Rosti with a fried egg over top - possibly better than Melbourne brunch rosti. The Rendang tasted amazing with the fresh roti, melt in your mouth! Finished off with some tiger beer and a Banana boat (banana split). Great little cafe. Would recommend for sure.Show less

Author: NorthStar755948
Title: Delicious food and beautiful place
Review: It is very aesthetic because of the paintings creating a cute vibe. The service is also friendly. There is a big variety of food and smoothies. Very comfy seats. All in all a beautiful place in the heart of Langkawi.

Author: chiajeel
Title: Nice food, excellent service
Review: Despite only one waitress working, she still managed to provide superb service! Also, the food looks instagrammable and delicious!

Author: N4630EVterrycNewcastle, Australia
Title: Awesome.
Review: What a great little cafe/restaurant.Lovely atmosphere, a little quirky with the ast work and gbs food is just great. We're had the seafood aglio olio and the beef rendang. Some of the best food we have had in our month of traveling around Malaysia and the prices are very good. Highly recommend!It's terrific to find such a small, local spot, easily overlooked with the other restaurants but it holds itself with any of the bigger (and pricier) spots. Show less

Author: 185matt
Title: Yummy breakfast and coffee!
Review: Staff were friendly, food and coffee was really good quality and moderately priced - I will definitely come back again.

Author: markbH1478XKVantaa, Finland
Title: Good food, But Very Slow Service
Review: I came here for lunch on Saturday. The food was very good but the service was so slow. I ordered a simple salad, but it took around 30 minutes to arrive. Far too long to wait, I think. And no apology from anyone for the delay. Also, while I was eating, one of the waiters was hovering around my outside table, possibly to stop me if I tried to do a runner without paying?I was going to order a dessert but I didn’t want to have to return to my hostel in the dark.If they improved their service, definitely 5*.Show less

Author: stephenlM7233QR
Title: OverRated feedback
Review: I went to this place in the early of the morning and order foods for 7paxs. Food are just ok but I personally like the oriental fried rice and the rest of foods are really average .The potions of food are big enough . If someone have small appetite and i recommended order one food and sharing by two .I like the decoration and the atmosphere are nice . Really suitable for ppl who like to relaxing and have small chit chat and reading book .The staff are friendly and the foods are pricy as in this area.Show less

Author: echoleo71
Title: Awesome cafe
Review: Wonderful cafe for the family and friends. Great setup, good food at good price. Friendly staffs. And must try the apple crumble, it's the best i had ever tried. And free Wi-Fi.......

Author: midmagColwyn Bay, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Small but cosy restaurant, we had western food for a change, the lamb shank with mash and vegetables was huge, I had lasagna which was packed with beef and really tasty. Another reviewer has said drinks were expensive we certainly didn't find this, in fact for the quality, size of portions and service it was very reasonable.Show less

Author: hanaburn
Title: Cozy & friendly staff
Review: Nice and cozy place to “ngopi”. Friendly and considerable staff.willing to turn off the air con knowing that mt sister on fever. We tried the cakes-satisfied with the portion. Tq 🥰

Author: JamesBrrrrrrrrrwneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cesar salad
Review: Visited cafe for a light dinner and ordered 2 Cesar salads. Both salads were covered in mayo and Un edible.Our drinks were good the staff friendly toilets clean. We did not complain but paying and leaving quickly with both plates with food on should have alerted the staff. Worst meal to date in Malaysia.Show less

Author: sihuixo
Title: Relaxed atmosphere and superb Lamb Shank and Nasi Lemak
Review: Service was excellent and the environment was perfect for a relaxed meal. Nasi lemak was 👍 and the sambal chilli was nice and spicy. The lamb shank was superbly cooked, savoury and filling. Highly recommended!

Author: Flori201
Title: Excelent food
Review: We find this place during our vacation of 8 days and we have been here almost every evening. Every evening we have been eating something else, and the food was grat every time. They have great cakes home made. I recommand with confidence this lovely place!Show less

Author: 367calluma
Title: Great Food - Reasonable Price
Review: I had the Spaghetti Bolognese and Cheesy Garlic Bread, as I was desperate for some western food whilst traveling Asia. I have to say that it was great - one of the best pasta dishes I’ve had in a very long time!

Author: bobrB618NLNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Small and perfectly formed
Review: Excellent little bar/cafe.We were a family of four adults and everyone of us praised the food.It was simple malay cooking served with a smile.The cafe was exceptionally clean ,including the western style toilets.The price for the group for a two course meal+beers and wine ,was £10 per head .Taxi back to the westin hotel ,15minutes drive was £1.60 .highly recommended.Show less

Author: aliemad47
Title: Delicious food in langkawi
Review:
Highly recommended
Kind staff 
Delicious food
Clean restaurant
Soup and appetizer main courses and drinks were great

Author: tathagatab2019
Title: Great taste!! at langkawi
Review:
We had butter chicken with tandoori roti for the main course with chicken wings for starters... I must say the food was cooked well and delicious 
Highly recommended for those travelling to langkawi

Author: RhodaGoodwinSwanage, United Kingdom
Title: Expensive
Review: Cracking food, cottage pie 26, sandwiches 23, these were the cheapest dishes, a little on the pricy side but great for a western fix. The low rating is for the rip off drinks, asked for a water which in the menu is 1.20 or 4, I asked for small thinking this would be 1.20, no it was 4! The 1.20 water was distilled water, apparently standard price all over, it's definitely not standard!Show less

Author: andreahex
Title: Great vibe
Review: Lovely restaurant in the town, close to,the Westin, cheap in grab To get there. Lovely pictures on the walls , good service and excellent food, not many good restaurants in Langkawi of this standard at reasonable prices.

Author: katwildoGold Coast, Australia
Title: Friendly and very arty cool
Review: Hi. My second visit to Langkawi and couldn't wait to take my friend along this time to visit Arts Cafe. A warm welcome back from the staff - what a memory - even remembered the healthy fresh juice I ordered last time. If I loved ok n Langkawi I would visit every day for the yummy food, delightful ambience and coffee. The staff are hard workers who really care about their customers and take pride in their product. The prices are very reasonable because the products are made from scratch. The delicious breads and cakes - such a treat. My friend had the NZ lambshank which is slowcooked for four hours. I'm a vegetarian and loved the moddle eastern style pizza bread that had a tangy thick yoghurt base with olives and capers and melted cheese. Tangy, salty and yummy. Thank you for oir lovely lumch and looking forward to our next visit. Show less

Author: Raumbegrenzer
Title: Mediocre
Review: Banana Pancakes are just plain pancakes with a third banana chopped as a side. The syrup didn't taste like anything but sugar. Orange juice was anything but tasty, I don't know what they used to make it.The coffee is great though!!Prices are very high, local food is 1/3 of the price.Also, a service charge of 10% is added automatically.Show less

Author: LEE_SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice banana crumble witg coffee
Review: We went there for a cup of joe and to have a slice of cake. Good ambience and is cool on a hot day. Capucinno is good and so is the slice of banana crumble. Ice cream may need an upgrade though - the vanilla ice cream does not do justice to the home bake pie.Show less

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Definitely worth a visit!
Review: After 2 weeks in Langkawi I was looking for something different. I was pleasantly surprised after stopping in on my last night for dinner.The garlic cheese bread is good, as long as you really enjoy the flavour of garlic as this definitely is packed with garlic!The crispy chicken wings was my favourite dish of the evening. Loved the wasabi salad on the side and the wings were perfect!The chicken Caesar salad was good. Not your traditional kind, but non the less very good!The chicken carbonara was ok, but it was more like pasta in mushroom soup. Not bad but not that great either. This was my least favourite dish of the evening.The service was great and I can tell you the WiFi here is much faster than what I have at the Westin hotel. I would definitely return to this restaurant and I would recommend it. You gotta try the wings if you go! They are surprisingly delicious!!!Show less

Author: gjmcginty
Title: Cool n charming cafe
Review: Good menu, excellent food n coffee. The cafe is located close to the Bay view hotel in kuah langkawi.

Author: ken gAdelaide, Australia
Title: An unexpected gem in Kuah
Review: Was attracted by the art works on display. The cafe staff were happy for us to come in just to look at them. We weren't expecting to find such stunning art in a Kuah coffee shop. Stayed for a fruit juice of pineapple with a touch of lime and it was great too.Show less

Author: 930meshala
Title: A most to visit kind of restaurant
Review: We have tried pizza ,tomato soup and salads, delicious for breakfast and lunch, i went there two times in a row

Author: Sian G
Title: Good food, lovely owner
Review: We had lunch twice at the arts cafe with my family. They were very accommodating with my toddler, the food was good and the owner is lovely lady. Reasonable prices. Highly recommend

Author: Danny DKuala Ketil, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food and great vibes
Review: The place is truly magnificient and have this energize vibe as well as scrumptious food. The service provided is excellent and friendly. The chef's are superb local langkawi housewives and you feel like being at home, enjoying mom's tasty delight. Truly a place not to be missed and a must go to.Show less

Author: belnico75Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Great Dining Experience @ Arts Cafe, Langkawi
Review: Saw so many great reviews of this cafe, and sure this cafe is a great one. Food was fantastic, all made from scratch. Had a chat with the owner, Belinda and she is a very humble hostess. Good place to hang out and food - yummylicious... portion was great too! Cafe was packed and she told me today is the busiest day in her 15 years running this business but she made sure she apologizes to all her customers personally...literally stopping at every table to say sorry for being too busy! What great customer service, plus her good food, I can only say all nice things about this place. Visited this cafe today @ 30 Dec 2018. Good way to end my 2018!!Show less

Author: cookiesncream97
Title: Delicious and decently-priced food
Review: Came to this cafe when it was pretty full and had to move to the upper-floor which is not air-conditioned. Ordered our food and we waited. Our drinks came fairly quickly maybe at most 10 minutes and they tasted very fresh. My mom had pineapple juice and it tasted like they were sugar free. Drinking water is free if you ask for it (rare nowadays). Food in the other hand took pretty long. I would say around half and hour to 45 minutes. My mom's had Sheppard's pie whereas my dad had some vegetarian fried rice, my sister Carbonara spaghetti and for me I had the shredded potato with chicken? (Can't remember what it was specifically). I would definitely advice that you order only one set of food to share with another person. The portions of the food are very large.The food here tastes excellent! Everything is homemade so you won't see any frozen food here. We talked to the friendly owner Belindah and she explained that all the food here is freshly made. Even the pasta is made by themselves. She also apologised to each table because they were not used to the crowd of the day. Apparently she had never had a crowd like this in the 15 years she operated the cafe.Show less

Author: J1520RVjonathans
Title: worth it
Review:
Quiet. Decent food. Attentive and friendly service. 

Photo: Potato Rosti with Mushroom sauce and Chicken

Author: makeupexhibitBangkok, Thailand
Title: Cozy, comfortable and cute
Review: Wonderful food.Wonderful service.Wonderful ambience.We had the Banana Pancakes, Cajun Chicken Sandwich and Vegetables & Chicken Soup.The detox drinks and coffee were also bangin'.☕They gave us Christmas biscuits as we left which was a nice personal touch.One of the wait staff there also helped us with our Grab which she really didn't have to as we had already left the Cafe at that point.The bathrooms were also dry and clean.The WiFi was working well. Double storey and spacious.Alcohol is also available. All wait staff speak proper English and are very attentive. Show less

Author: limww
Title: Good food & drinks and variety of choices
Review: Visited this cafe upon recommendation. Most of the time while we were there, it was packed (though they have ground floor and first floor). Lots of choices (Asian and Western) from their menu. We enjoyed what we had ordered.

Author: LydiaNatasyaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food!
Review: Decided to drop by after readibg its review. My oh my! The food was sooo good! Salmon was fresh. Crispy on the outside and juicy inside. Wasnt overcooked either. Ambience is good. Great for hanging out or chilling. Pricing is considered on the higher end but for food that good, it is worth paying for. Do drop by if you happen to be in Langkawi! Its halal even though it serves alcohol, partly to cater for foreigners.Show less

Author: facadetragedy
Title: Awesome Dining Place!
Review: I visited Arts Cafe with my family, and all of us had really enjoyed the food there. The cafe served great food with a really reasonable price tag to them; will definitely recommend this cafe to my friends who are visiting Langkawi!

Author: DaneomiteSaskatoon, Canada
Title: Greatest place EVER
Review: Arts cafe is the warmest and most welcoming cafe I’ve potentially ever been too. The staff are amazing and treat you like family. The food is homemade and is unbelievably delicious... the desserts are beyond amazing as well. If you’re on Langkawi this is a must stop. Seriously. A. MUST. STOP. I feel bad for anybody who’s been to Langkawi and hasn’t eaten at this restaraunt.Show less

Author: Fred_MRU
Title: Always a pleasure to be there... the perfect place to chill to eat and drink...
Review: i have been enjoying breakfast & lunch, relax and catch up on work also (yes unfortunately :) ) since beginning of last year. i've been coming back still and as much as i can... The staffs there are great and friendly, the food is awesome; local dishes with a twist, from snacks to main courses. yummy .. :) Another asset is that they have an upper floor... great if you want to do any kind of celebrations, get together and meetings in a casual atmosphere.The location as well is good near the shopping malls and not far from the jetty.Show less

Author: Kosmos777Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Best place in Kuah
Review: we are all subjectives in our opinions so i start with this thought. For me its the best place to eat and relax in Kuah because they have healthy choices, no sugar added as all over the town or unhealthy and tasty stuff, so for everyone.. The prices seem to be fair for what you get, great Wi Fi if you want to hang out working spot also, music incredible good, no the BOOm BOOm stuff so u cant have a discussion or stay with your thoughts to peace your mind on the reasons who make you travelling you:) maybe the paintings from inside are not deep art stuff to make u think or imagine but at least they are some spots of colours.. The staff really good english and they always give me stuff out of menu, shaping my desires...thank you so much for this!Show less

Author: Chungtb
Title: Great cafe
Review: Good food, excellent atmosphere, attractive decorations, quite pricey, helpful staffs. Had relaxing moment here.

Author: 382sherisHonolulu, Hawaii, United States
Title: Lunch
Review: We had a relaxing lunch in this cute art filled Cafe. I had gado gado my husband had fish and chips. I also enjoyed a hit ginger tea that was wonderful. The food was good, the wait staff could have been a little more attentive. We will go back to try a few other dishes. Show less

Author: pearl_lynelyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Surprisingly Good Cafe in the Middle of the town
Review: My husband and i was searching for a decent cafe in the afternoon when it was raining in Langkawi for us to take a break from our trip. We found this cafe through online research and we were very happy to find this gem. The ambiance of the cafe was very calming, and the food was amazing. We love the pizza and couldn't stop snacking the nachos! The only setback is that the cafe only had one baby chair when i need two at that particular of time. Others, AMAZING~Show less

Author: jo59oz
Title: Good food
Review: We visited Arts Cafe a couple of times and had great food and service. The Asian dishes were very fresh and tasty and the desserts and coffee were yummy. Great place for a meal or just coffee and cake. Recommend highly.

Author: Rinsan Z
Title: Nice little cafe and food
Review: Food was nice and good. Especially the banana crumble with ice-cream , awesome. Manage to have a little chat with the owner and chef. The cafe has been around for 15 years and the chef has been there for ten years.

Author: Joeinshenzhen
Title: Fantastic
Review:
Wondeful experience here. Warm welcoming staff. Artistic cool vibe with paintings on the wall.

Extensive menu. 

I had to salmon.  Was excellent.  42RM. Lots of choices. Big portions. 

Seriously you have to go here

Author: 227susan
Title: Just craving for coffee
Review: Step into Art Cafe when you are tired of shopping in Kuah Town.  Had a nice quiet time looking at people walking by while sipping my usual cappucino.......

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Little Cafe with lots of Oil Painting
Review: Ranked as 20s in TA made us visited this cafe before we took the flight back to KL. The food was good with very generous portion. The ambience are very relaxing &’cosy. There were not many people when we came to the cafe. Food was good and we will come here again next time.Show less

Author: faytelling
Title: Cafe arts
Review: Very nice little restaurant stopped in a couple of times for drinks and food, staff very polite and friendly food was beautifully presented and was very good. Would recommend

Author: sandra_evenstar
Title: It's a treat for the eye & tummy
Review: comfy, cosy, colourful and friendly ambience. Affordable food with extraordinary taste. you can even store your choice of wine there for future consumption.

Author: Educat2018
Title: A great spot for lunch
Review: My wife and I often visit Arts Cafe for a tasty lunch when out shopping. The service, food and ambience are all very good. Loved by most expats!

Author: P458MKtimr
Title: Great Malay food
Review: Lovey little place with a great artsy feel. The Malay dishes were the best we ate in Langkawi including the best spring roll I have ever eaten!All round a good experience and well worth its rating. Good portions. Fairly priced. Good service. What else can you ask for?Show less

Author: HK C
Title: Potato Rosti was unique I suppose..
Review: Uh it's far from being a 5/5 restaurant quality in terms of overall good taste (I feel it's over-rated by many or their standards are just too low). This is probably a 3-4 ish. Having just one option for the choice of egg(fried lol) is enough to not get 5 stars for the best possible brunch choice...try having more choices like half-boiled, scramble, poached? Chicken sausage taste familiar with another 2-3 other western restaurants available here...same supplier? :P try to make your own sausage like your arts that you are selling ;)Ambience of the place is definitely a spot on based on its name. you should consider removing the price tags though, better to just make a private list and tell the price when a customer wants to buy it... (Makes it feel like the food is second to art sale) idk maybe I'm just sensitive to details.Show less

Author: GaryS0609Malaysia
Title: Food quality drop.. microwave food??
Review: Been visit this cafe a year ago and it was lovely.After a year I return to Arts cafe and find out the food quality was actually drop ?! I ordered a carbonara pasta and turn out actually is a pasta with chicken & mushroom creamy sauce . Sad to said base on the chicken texture I'm pretty sure the food is microwaved and is partly cold in the middle!! How come a lovely cafe served a partly cold microwave food that cost 24 MYR? or the chef is too busy in the kitchen?Anyway, the service staffs are amazing and the happy hour beer promotion still made me satisfied. :) Show less

Author: traceyq_13Sydney, Australia
Title: Delicious menu
Review: We dined at the Arts Cafe with a group of 6 friends, all choosing different meals and we were all extremely satisfied . From soups to pub fare and local cuisine all served hot a delicious. The staff were friendly and helpful with food choices. I would definitely recommend eating here, we stayed at the St Regis and this restaurant was a great alternative to eating in.Show less

Author: Catherine K
Title: True to it’s name Arts Cafe
Review: The moment you walked into the cafe, the various art pieces on the wall just takes your breath away. So immersed by the decor it took a long while before I flip the menu to select my food. And true to all the reviews I read about the lamb shank, its one of the best I have tasted. We ordered the grill salmon too and was not disappointed. Cha, our friendly server showed us the first floor, tastefully done up and great for private functions. Definitely a great place to hang out & chat when you are on holiday and not rushing for time.Show less

Author: ChloeL1269
Title: Good ambience but staffs need training
Review: As intentional we visited this cafe due to many good reviews, I would say that it has good food. However, Staff customer service experience wasn’t up to standard. I sat at the corner of the sofa bench chairs and since the table and bench was narrow, there was an obstruction and sharp corner of the bench, I knock myself at the knee and it was so painful. The staff just look at me with the poker face, no asking of how am I, he simply stand there like a stone, (owner, you can see from the cctv on 2 July 3pm onwards), then I wanted to go up to view the layout of the cafe, the staff said we can go, after viewing we came down, was shock that another customer took our seats and table, wow! I was pretty shock the staff didn’t reserve the table for us, we simply went up for less than 5 mins and came down with our seats taken by another customer ?The staffs also didn’t greet us when we enter. Show less

Author: ShallineeRSungai Petani, Malaysia
Title: Right in Kuah ! Great hangout ! Wonderful food !
Review: We went after a heavy lunch so just opted for ice creams and drinks. The ambience is wonderful, the staffs friendly, the price very reasonable and the service fast. I had the Banana Boat ice cream which was done perfectly. The place is on the same row as the famous duty free shop in Kuah town, Haji Ismail. Give it a try if you love Western or local delicacies with a twist.Show less

Author: Kevin G
Title: Western quality
Review: Good food and drinks and the owners are willing to please with requests and make customers feel welcome with a smile. Great meeting place for westerners and those that appreciate art.

Author: wail413
Title: A relaxing place
Review: Food was a bit too spicy 🌶 with the mixed sauce  and yet it was a relaxing place to spend time.  If you live in another end of Langkawi, it was not worth to spend the traveling time to there.

Author: agerrard
Title: Relaxed Cafe
Review: Stopped off here for a coffee and western style breakfast. Was a nice relaxing place and friendly service

Author: KanagsS
Title: Beef rendang is the best
Review: Nice cosy place with a very good ambience. Paintings all around. The beef rendang is a killer and the kampung fried rice was great as well. The garlic bread had a little too much garlic. Overall a good experience.

Author: S3259CUsusanlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Ambience 👍
Review: Is our first time on holidays in Langkawi during the Muslim ramadan fasting month. Most of eatries are closed. This cafe is located in Kuah town. It is a small cafes with 2flr. 2nd level have lots of painting on the wall. It will be great if is air conditioning where the guests can enjoy a cuppa drinks in upper level which is quiet. I had Grilled chicken salads and Fried drumsticks with chips for my kid. This is the best salad I had in langkawi. Prices kind of steep for budget travellers but with tasty foods and friendly crews is worth it.  Show less

Author: beckyt951
Title: Lovely little place
Review:
Came across this place after seeing a review on Facebook. 
It’s lovely. Food was fantastic and staff were lovely. 
Very relaxed place and prices very reasonable

Author: usepoints
Title: Surprisingly good food for a little cafe.
Review:
Friendly cafe.  wanted something easy and local.  so decided on this place.
the chicken wings werr FANTASTIC.  the spring rolls good and the potato top pie very nice.  apparently the pizza was good also.  cheap quick friendly and affordable.would return

Author: Kitkat071Canning Vale, Australia
Title: Tasty and very hot
Review: Four of us who are staying in langkawi decided to try art cafe for dinner. Staff are really friendly and we were seated in booths. Highly recommend the spring rolls. They are super tasty. The cafe has wifi that you can access. It's moderately priced and they have a number of choices.m plenty of parking out the front of the cafe and they have some fabulous art work that you can purchase. Show less

Author: 288thiruaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice setup...
Review: We went for lunch... The food was decent and the portion was quite big for us. One thing we really liked about the place was the setup of it. We sat on the top floor, it had quite an interesting deco and sitting arrangement. Since we went for late lunch, the top floor was empty and we had the entire place for ourself, and it was quite as well. Food wise it's on the pricier side. I guess you pay for the environment more so then the food. Will visit again if we needed a place to chill out only if the price is a bit more reasonable. Show less

Author: Alvin A
Title: Must eat place
Review: Delicious grub and drinks for this unassuming place. Food was surprisingly good with generous portions. Highly recommended.  We were there for dinner and had a good time enjoying the food and paintings sold in the cafe.

Author: rikkejchristensen
Title: Delicious!
Review: I would recomend this place to everyone. The staff is so friendly and kind, and the food is amazing.

Author: AnjnMei
Title: Great place
Review: Nice ambience. Great desserts ❤️We enjoyed the banana crumble and nasi lemak. The art pieces are great deco as well.

Author: AllanN595
Title: I love it!!
Review: Environment: Very cozy and artsy! Its small but I really like it! Staff: Very friendly! Location: Located in center of Kuah Town, pretty easy to spot on. Food: We ordered mushroom soup, apple nutty salad, pasta and also pizza... Yummylicious!!! Mushroom soup thick and creamy, salad full of almonds and other nuts (Very generous!!), pasta was creamy and yummy, just that the main ingredient, pasta, a bit soggy. As for the pizza... Love it!!! By the way, the portion very big and the price... Totally worth it!!! Overall, I would definitely come back for a bit chat session with friends while sipping some drinks from this cafe, kudos!! Show less

Author: robsonh2017London, United Kingdom
Title: Incomparable brunch
Review: Just by walking few metres from my hotel,taking a walk outside I got surprised when I glanced over the café and I decided to stop for a breakfast. I've got a warm welcome, best service provided by Cha which could take my order and food was served promptly. On the top of that, I spent 10 minutes admiring those marvellous pictures. Thanks Cha Show less

Author: Axel5171
Title: Nice place
Review:
Popped in here for a drink and ended up staying for food.

Having walked around Kuah Town, this looked to be the best option for us as vegetarians, and we weren't disappointed.  Cheese sandwich with roat potatoes and some garlic bread - delicious!

Author: Nigel H
Title: Small, fun, interesting art
Review: Average food, wide menu choice. Staff very polite and service top quality. Lots of interesting art on display and for sale.

Author: Roy FIbiza, Spain
Title: Artsy Cafe
Review: A hidden gem, As soon as we walked through the door we were welcomed not by a smile from the waiter, but by a blaze of colour from the arts that decorate every spare inch of wall space. The menu is large enough and varied, and the food was served hot and fresh. If you are visiting the area, of possibly post night market then this would certainly be a good choice for a visit.Show less

Author: Angelina A
Title: A relaxed friendly atmosphere
Review: A surprising find. Behind a screened off outdoor sitting area, you will discover an eclectic blend of food choice and art covering the wall of the entire cafe, even down to the 'life lessons' to read of, whilst sat on the loo. The food was served deliciously fresh, from the soup starter through to the grilled salmon and roast potatoes ...which were amazingly like a taste of home, served with a chilled white wine (although the wines are not stated in the menu... you have to ask). A charming cafe with interesting art work, especially the 'real female' version of the Mona Lisa. Show less

Author: 1973MrTtravels
Title: Stylish Cafe with fusion foods
Review:
Very happy with our tasty dinner tonight at the Arts Cafe. Great flavors and great atmosphere in this cosy, artsy Cafe. 
Definitely worth another visit.

Author: Pooja K
Title: Surrounded by arts coming to life
Review: After a tiring walk though the busy Night market, Arts cafe was a huge sigh of relief for us. A lovely little corner cafe, with variety of options for food and drinks. Friendly staff and delicious food.

Author: TjantekMulusSpaGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Nice art's deco
Review: One of famous cafe in Kuah Town. Decoration inside nice. Art lover will definitely love this cafe. Food average. I tried nasi kerabu taste so so, very dry. Pricing quite expensiveShow less

Author: londoner2304London, United Kingdom
Title: Decent
Review: We visited for dinner on our first night in Langkawi. They weren’t too busy. We tried the beef rendang and a salmon dish – both were very nice, and we especially liked the accompanying roti canai. They serve beer, but not other alcoholic drinks. Service was reasonably efficient. Our meal came to a very reasonable RM 100, including a couple of drinks. A pleasant meal on the whole, although I’m not sure if the high ranking on TA (currently #11) is justified.Show less

Author: nisha_ddh
Title: Delicious food.
Review: Our first lunch at Langkawi was at Arts Cafe. Small cafe, good service, tasty food. Do try the coffee here.

Author: 116dave
Title: Great Food
Review:
We visited the Arts Cafe several times during our 5 week stay on Langkawi, and whether it was for Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner the Food is amazing and the staff so friendly.
They also make a dam good cup of coffee.

Author: saarah68
Title: Amazing!!
Review: We had such a great meal. The rendang was 10/10. Desert was peanut smoothie and the choc cake. All was so tasty. Reasonably priced and great service. Highly recommend

Author: AdamsWednesdayLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food & artwork
Review: We came here for dinner one evening whilst visiting Langkawi. The food was really good and the portions were of a good size. We particularly loved the spring rolls - very tasty! Our server was lovely. The cafe also has some great artwork on the walls that you can admire whilst you eat!Show less

Author: b19tam
Title: Best Coffee In Langkawi
Review: The Arts Cafe is lovely very friendly staff and a relaxed atmosphere and best of all for a coffee lover like me a great Cappuccino easily the best on the island.

Author: 356S-1
Title: Lovely cafe
Review: We have been here a few times and the food and drinks are always good. Service is also friendly and efficient. Great menu with lots of choice including veggie options. Reasonably priced. There's more art to look at upstairs too :)

Author: james bOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Attractive cafe with great atmosphere
Review: I really enjoyed my visit to the Arts Cafe in the centre of Kuah. I had a few beers and an excellent meal. The cafe had a nice relaxed ambience. There are some good local paintings on the wall. This is definitely worth a visit for anyone staying in Kuah or passing through. A good place to chill out with some great food.Show less

Author: KittideSchrefere
Title: Really nice place!
Review:
We had a great time at arts cafe. We ate the garlic bread, beef redang and italian nachos bolognese. Everything was really tasty and the service was very friendly!
Thank you arts cafe!

Author: PeterC7505
Title: Great spot
Review: One of the few places in Kuah, apart from hotels where you can get a decent coffee.Meals available, good wifi and cold beer.Some very good art displayed.Staff very friendly and good service.

Author: Jess M
Title: Amazing
Review: Such a good find! So happy to find yummy vegan and vegetarian options! We loved everything we ordered for dinner & came back the next day for breakfast! An adorable & cozy cafe!

Author: deanoc433Brighton, United Kingdom
Title: Great menu & fabulous food
Review: What a great find..A cracking menu. A great mix of Asia & western. We opted for homemade chicken & spinach pie & a homemade shepherds pie. Both were absolutely delicious. The staff are brilliant, speak excellent English. We were given a free portion of birthday cake to celebrate a staff members birthday.The cafe walls are adorned with fantastic art work & if I wasn’t travelling & had a wall to put them on I would genuinely have considered buying a piece or 2. Well worth seeking this place out in whilst in Kuah. Show less

Author: Chloé G
Title: Lunch
Review: Nice café, lunch is really good! everything on the menu looks also really tasty so it's hard to choose! my boyfriend loved the beef and peas potpie and I orderd gado gado, also very tasty!!

Author: doublescore27Singapore, Singapore
Title: Large portions
Review: True to its name, the walls were lined with art pieces for sale.Even the mushroom soup had art on it! Sadly, the toast that came with it was nondescript in look and in taste.The servings were huge. The salad that came with pan-grilled salmon would have been enough for 2 persons.The serving of salmon was generous well. Unfortunately, it was overdone. As a result, the meat was dry.Show less

Author: humeparkChuo, Japan
Title: Nice food but slow in serving food
Review: Food is pretty good, just it took quite a while for me to have my food, perhaps because they were running full house when I was thereShow less

Author: duncanfitzg
Title: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner options
Review: The Arts Cafe is tucked away in a quieter part of Langkawi. This is one of the many positives of the place as it is away from any crowds. We visited this place on multiple occasions during our stay on Langkawi. It was a good breakfast option and we also found it a good spot after a big day out somewhere. Plenty of options for kids (the banana pancakes were fantastic) and the range of choice and quality of the dishes that we ate was great. A great spot to relax for an hour or two on a hot day. Show less

Author: Ben R
Title: Great little hidden restaurant.
Review: After a long day out, my family and I discovered this cool little spot on one of Kuah's backstreets and it was great because we were served within 5 mins if ordering. Lovely decor, local art on the walls - some of which I could have happily taken back with me. The music was relaxing and the staff were friendly. Highly recommend the lamb shank braised with apricot: absolutely wonderful. My wife and son had the pizza and salmon and were both happy. I recommend this place to all weary travellers after a long day out. The bad reviews are probably a sign of uppity standards and short tempers. This place shines in an otherwise drab Kuah restaurant selection. Good work, guys. Show less

Author: Anny O
Title: Disappointed
Review: We decided to give it a try after the good recommendation from TripAdvisor.GOOD ambience but the food really out from our expectation.the carbonara really taste bad , the white sauce really plain no taste at all.Maybe we should not order their western food.The pizza just ok . service was slow and pricey.will not come back again .Show less

Author: SteveY8888
Title: Expensive Mediocre Food
Review: Overpriced for most of the dishes. To avoid their Western food items and go for the Asian food. I believe the chef(s) doesn’t really understand Western cuisine or having very little knowledge in preparing them. Latte art failed despite being Arts Cafe ... bring your money elsewhere.Show less

Author: sana j
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: I really loved this quirky small food place - the food was largely on point and tasted amazing. Me and my husband really enjoyed this experience.

Author: Heli PHelsinki, Finland
Title: Colourfull cafe
Review: A modern cafeteria designed with good taste was a nice and surprising find among all the tax free shopping in Kuah. The interior is full of colour and paintings, even a new mural was being created on the outside wall. The delicious banana crumble cake was served hot with a scoop of ice cream. I wish I hadn't found this place only on my last day in Langkawi. Must surely return next year.Show less

Author: betsyt26Los Angeles, California
Title: Lunch
Review: Wow! What a lovely surprise! A great treat and a welcome and tasteful experience for this area of Kua,Langkawi. Belinda, the owner warmly greets her guests and explains that she serves you only what she would serve to her family, ie all fresh veggies and fruits, fragrant herbs and delicate spices that make each dish special! Original artwork hangs on the walls with a real fish pond upstairs! The staff is competent and friendly and the experience begs for more visits! In fact we went back the next day! A definite positive memory from breakfast,coffee lunch or dinner!Show less

Author: misquared321Singapore, Singapore
Title: My Kind o’ Heaven
Review: So grateful my husband stumbled across this restaurant in his frequent visits to the chandlery down here in Kuah. We have yet to find a more genuine expression of love and creativity on this island than Arts Cafe. Belinda and her team have created a mini Eden of handcrafted decor, neat art for purchase and of course fresh, well prepared and healthy food. The spring rolls and the nutty salad were so satisfying, and Belinda is so attentive always nearby to answer questions, provide a backstory or explanation of ingredients and preparations and eager to continue learning what her guests are craving. To top that, everything is clean, comfortable and cool (a feat in this subtropical environment) and parking is easy. We will be back. Maybe every day Show less

Author: bat-andBarcelona, Spain
Title: Pricey and nothing special
Review: Food was ok but too pricey. Bar was nice, personnel should be more interactive with people. I recommend drink only coffee there (it's good) and eat somewhere else cheaper! Show less

Author: rcroweDublinDublin, Ireland
Title: nice surprise
Review: went to Kuah to buy duty free and saw this across the street , looked busy so we wandered over.it turned out to be a lovely spot we had a nice dinner , service was very friendly . Pretty mixed menu , I had pasta and my wife had Asian , with a nice bottle of wine we found it great value and would return.the owner arrived just before we left and she was genuinely interested in our dining experienceShow less

Author: Felicia V
Title: Loved the food, the decoration and the people
Review: Arts Cafe was my favorite place in Kuah. I enjoyed the place, the decoration is amazing, the paintings are very beautiful and the food was good. I recommend it.

Author: jannes657
Title: Nice place
Review:
Nice place and delicious food
Can really recommend the chicken with mushroom souce and the cappuccino

Author: bertlee86Miri, Malaysia
Title: Not bad, not bad...
Review: Nice small like artsy cafe with a variety of dishes served. We had the pan fried salmon which was good. Love the wasabi mayonnaise dressing on the salad. Home made linguine pasta was pretty good as well and they were generous with the prawns. But the creamy mushroom soup was terrible, was more a starchy can mushroom soup rather than a creamy fresh made on. My opinion anyways...Show less

Author: SilverBack4
Title: Honest local food with good service
Review: Great little restaurant serving fantastic home style cooking very friendly with a good menu clean and well worth the effort

Author: Nouf A
Title: Excellent Food!
Review: The cafe was small, cozy and was all decorated with canvases and frames of art for sale. The menu is quite varied.. I was really surprised with how good the food was! We ordered Spring rolls, mushroom soup, Tomato soup, Lamp on mashed potatoes and Crispy chicken with rice. And it all tasted AMAZING! The portion was generous. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Ana A
Title: Great vibe
Review: I stayed in Langkawi for a month and Arts was the place I visited the most. I really enjoyed it, I find it quite inspiring especially the upper level. It's nice place ti chill with friends or alone with a good book :) they also have nice coffee and cakes. Good deals for breakfast and lunch. The owner and staff are friendly and welcoming. I enjoyed every visit and would go back if ever in Langkawi. My favourite is the mousli bowl with fruit and yougurt and the veggie sandwich. It's worth a try.Show less

Author: tmunyi
Title: Overrated
Review: Food taste normal and pricey. Food served very slow even during non-peak hours. Will not visit again.

Author: D3218WRvictoriac
Title: Very good & cheap
Review: The art in the café is really beautiful. If you want to buy the art you can do that to. It’s cheap & the food is well cooked.

Author: AmmarLondonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing little cafe
Review: Go here. Have the coffee. Enjoy the art. Take pics from the upper floor. Really nice place. I would return The food was really nice too. Simple fingerfood. Just loved sitting outside and upstairs and soaked in the art and the atmosphere. Would visit again when I go back there. Show less

Author: ChoueeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed...
Review: Given the rating / ranking on tripadvisor, we were expected a great place. Instead we were disappointed to find an average Cafe. Positive: a menu mixing western and local food incl. breakfast items, a good coffee and a big food ration in the plate which will not leave you hungry. But nothing we ordered was really tasty, and the final bill very expensive. You have better options around.Show less

Author: Lou JGodalming, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service
Review: Having reading positive reviews about the Arts Cafe we gave it a try one evening.It's a very casual place to dine in but we were made to feel so welcome by the owner and staff. The food was delicious, plentiful and very reasonably priced. Had we been staying longer we would have definitely made a second visit.Show less

Author: AnilJRSydney, Australia
Title: Great food and ambience
Review: We had lunch here on our first day in Langkawi 3 Jan'18. A good variety of western and some authentic Malaysian food. Great for my 11 year old who enjoyed the fried chicken. My 16year old, wife and I enjoyed the Malaysian cuisine. The roti canai was delightful. The ambience is lovely. A must visit for travellers to Langkawi.Show less

Author: bernieandyvonneYass
Title: We found this delightful cafe by accident - we weren't disappointed
Review: We stumbled across the Arts Café in Langkawi when simply taking a break from our bus trip and deciding to have lunchThe menu is excellent (plenty of variety) and the portions are huge and very tastyCoffee is great (we had cappuccino but they have many other varieties)The staff are very friendly and the manager Belinda Koh speaks good English likes to spend time chatting with touristsDon't miss the experience of eating at this café when you're next in LangkawiIt's situated reasonably close to Langkawi's namesake the Lang Kawi (brown eagle)Show less

Author: P4545IFdennisl
Title: Nice special place.
Review:
Was there one night with my girlfriend and we had a Malaysian dish. It was spicy for sure but it was good and the service was great.

The art was a nice touch to make it something special.

Author: Sue FPerth, Australia
Title: Hidden gem!
Review: We were looking for somewhere nearby and special to have dinner outside of our Westin hotel and had heard good things about this place. Easy and cheap to get there by Uber and it was well worth the effort. The food was very good and the menu offered a good variety. Desserts were definitely worth saving room for especially the banana crumble.The decor was nice and staff friendly. The magic really happened when the owner came into the room, she took the time to stop by our table to tell her story about the cafe and it was incredibly interesting as she talked about the menu choices and how it came about.I would strongly recommend the Arts Cafe if you are looking for a special, casual night with real homemade food and local produce and very good prices.Show less

Author: oanad2018
Title: Very good!
Review: Very good! Excellent place, clean and nice. The food is really great and the restaurant is very nice decorated!

Author: ManuGrim
Title: Best place to eat in town!
Review: The place is very nice! The food was great, refreshing natural juices and they have a wide variety menu to please everyone!

Author: ErickySPHong Kong, China
Title: Good food and great people
Review: We had dinner this week and we really enjoyed all of it. The staff was very friendly and the food was really good.Malaysian, Thai and Indian food, even a pizza! Recommend to all who stay in those late hotels to get some local food and flavor. Show less

Author: Jan C
Title: Good food, great company
Review: I've eaten here several times and the food is always good. Lots of variety on the menu, and they serve meals outside the usual eating times. Nice atmosphere. Supports local artists. The service is friendly and efficient. I will eat here again 😊

Author: augustinwee
Title: A restaurant with a high standard food
Review: We were there for our breakfast, the food was great, tasty and of a high standard. Great ambient and decorations with many nice paintings hanged on the wall, if you like it, you may buy one for yourself too.

Author: O8965DCtimc
Title: Breakfast in Kuah
Review: Have had breakfast with the family now several times while staying in Kuah. Food, service and atmosphere are all excellent.

Author: _davidwalker963York, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Food
Review: This is a great place to eat in Langkawi. The interior is nice, the staff are friendly and the food is both excellent and well presented.The cafe is quite small but you can book online if you wish and the owner is very helpful. Its certainly worth a visit we went a few times and recommended to friends while we were out there.Its is very good value for money and you won't leave hungary.Show less

Author: Globe-Girdler2016London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food - great service
Review: The list of foods available was ample and the portion is more than enough for the price paid. The restaurant is clean, stylish & the owner (lady) takes time to go around to ask all the guests about their experience. The staff are very friendly and this is only true when you ask for any help - no hesitation. We travelled 10 mins by car after reading fellow Tripadvisors to this place, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a classic mix of local cuisine with a Western twist. Show less

Author: Karin W
Title: Great food and very friendly staff
Review: We ate at this restaurant twice when we were staying in Kuah, Langkawi. We've tried a variety of food on the menu, the soup, garlic bread, nachos, curry, cottage pie and one of the sandwiches. All of the food was really good and tasted nice and fresh, the fruit juices were also very nice. The staff is very friendly and the waiting time is not too long. Would recommend to everyone staying in Kuah! Show less

Author: alibobshaddersCheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Arts Cafe
Review: Had a recommendation to visit the Arts Cafe from a family who were staying in a local hotel. A charming place with plenty of paintings by local artists which you can buy if they take your fancy. The menu offered lots of choice and the food was plentiful. The owner came to introduce herself to us (Belinda) a charming lady who took the time to tell us her story, beliefs and work ethic, it was fascinating to here how she ended up the owner of the cafe... I won't spoil it all for you but as a taster she runs it like home and employees housewives ( not chefs) who produce home cooking from the tiny kitchen. You get your food when it's ready not in the true orderly format of a restaurant. Thus best to order food to share and all tuck in. If you like quirky and great food you won't be disappointed. I am sure we will be paying another visit very soon.Show less

Author: Sunnytan30Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Artwork available
Review: We made a trip purposely to this cafe as it was one of the top cafe in Langkawi. Worth the trip and they offered many nice pieces of artwork for sale here. Tried their banana pie and it taste crunchy and tasty topped with vanilla ice-cream which makes it sinful. We longed for a bowl of hot noodle soup and the Udon Noodle Soup was great break from what we had over last few meals. Place can be easily found on Google Map and there’s quite sufficient parking space available. Went on Friday and parking is free. Show less

Author: pkganJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Review: A cafe that make people feel comfortable to be in to have good meal. Creative creation every where .... Food is nice. Vege Pie- yummy! Enjoy apple nutty salad, refreshing. Because Langkawi was super HOT! Mmm.... A little pricey cause never thought of paying that much in LANGKAWIservice was just ok.... Show less

Author: jennycP7700JEKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unexpectedly good food and service from a quaint and artistic cafe.
Review: A pleasant surprise from a shoplot environment cafe that not only provides good food and good service but a wonderful ambience creatively done through paintings, old retro furnitures and topped off with a lovely and airy environment on the upper floor of this cafe. The food served is delicious with a slight tinge of European flavor and price is reasonably priced though not the cheapest. The cafe amenities are clean and service is brisk and professional. For me, the menu and the cafe captivates both the young and the old. I loved the Ceasar salad and the lamb shank which overshadowed the average tasting roasted chicken pizza. But me and my family all agree that we will definitely return to this cafe on my next trip to Langkawi!Show less

Author: Casper65Laupasat
Title: Nearest cafe to Westin
Review: The ambience is good, staff is very friendly and the art on display , quite awesomeThe food is good but not excellent.We had a few dishes over 3 visitsWe had one sandwich which we found the chicken a bit too dry and hardOn another visit we had the fried rice and fried noodle. Both were good but I liked the rice betterThe cheese strudel was better than the banana crumbler But the coffee was v goodAnd honestly , this is the most decent cafe we found closest to Kuah town(There maybe another we weren’t aware of)Show less

Author: Brandon T
Title: Fantastic fusion food
Review: Great Western and local food choices. Nice ambience, our family loved it. We will visit again in future.

Author: Orange_Penguins
Title: Scrumptious!
Review: We went here twice. A wide menu and a few veggie options too. Portions were good sizes and delicious.

Author: Repokettu58
Title: Place to visite
Review: During our holidays we visited few times, and every time service/food was perfect, it didnt matter if we were looking for a pizza or a dinner. Specially tasty bolognese products..

Author: hongy854
Title: Breakfast, so full
Review: Visit on the weekend morning. The waitress is friendly, the food serve quite fast, the food portion is big. Overall the food taste satisfactory, maybe it was highly recommended so I have a high expectation. The environment is nice and cozy.

Author: JoL855Ramsgate, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and friendly service
Review: Visited here twice in our week long stay in Kuah.on both occasions the food was excellent, service good and friendly owner. Serves a mix of western and local dishes-all good. Tasty pizzas and sandwiches, beef rendang, banana crumble, sour cherry strudel - recommend all. Clean and comfortable. Can sit indoors or out. Our favourite place to eat in Kuah.Show less

Author: Jonny1133
Title: Nice Lunch
Review: We came here for a quick lunch, for or first day in Langkawi when staying near Kuah. Good service, well priced. The pizzas are easily big enough to share between two!

Author: HarrisonC240
Title: The food here is so so so good
Review: Our eyes were hungrier then our stomachs, meals are very big and so so so so so tasty. Definitely recommend coming here.

Author: ong2017
Title: Would definitely go back if there's chance!
Review: Creative menu! Especially love the hummus & cheese platter. The prices are reasonable too for that portion. Went there with my girlfriends, we bought a booklet of parking tickets for this cafe and Eagle Square, and the boss was so kind to offer to buy the rest of our coupons since we won't be needing them anymore. Me and my friends refused to get his money and later on we were on 10% discount off our bill. Too lucky!Show less

Author: DevonfishEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent lunch time
Review: The food is international, you can choose local or not. I chose a chicken sandwich and that came with salad and a surprise twist, roast potatoes. Brilliant. We had heard good things about this place and were not disappointed. The desserts are great to we both chose things that had been baked in house.Show less

Author: AlexMaxi
Title: Good Food, but slow Service when full
Review: We take our diner there, and the food and the fresh juice where very good. It was Sunday and the Cafe was full, so the staff had much work and so we had to wait 15min for Drinks and 45min for food.

Author: msq002
Title: A lovely place to visit
Review: Prices are reasonable. Most of the food tasted good. The mango smoothie was so so good. Would go back to this place? Definitely!

Author: En0ck
Title: European or Malaysian selection
Review: We went with Malaysian- excellent spicy food with modern presentation with a reasonable price but not cheap. Surprised for a halal restaurant to server wine and beer.

Author: Sandra APenang, Malaysia
Title: Great coffee, average food!
Review: This is a nice little cafe to visit, but don’t set your expectations high based on some of their TripAdvisor rave reviews. The food is just average, but the coffee is very very nice. Their menu prices are quite high by local standards. Good quality food, but I was expecting it to be tastier based on all the excellent reviews.Show less

Author: SK1808London, United Kingdom
Title: Great little place!
