Review: We went to the Art Cafe last night with our 2 year old after looking at some good reviews on trip adviser. We loved everything about this place- the decor,the Art,the service and finally the food! We ordered the spring roles which were amazing followed then by some of the local dishes which were also extremely good. Prices very reasonable too. All the food (lots of western food) looked really good! This place is defo worth a visit!Show less

Author: Carolyn V
Title: Gem of a cafe
Review: We loved this cafe. Fantastic art everywhere, great atmosphere and service. We had a vegetarian platter which was fantastic & great coffee. Highly recommend

Author: Steady
Title: Great
Review: Lovely little place where the food is brilliant and they do some really great health drinks.  The artwork on the walls is very impressive too.

Author: 721clarkem
Title: Awesome
Review: Great food, great service, awesome service  and the art is impressive as well. Could not recommend more highly. Simple as that.

Author: JoanneInvernessInverness, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious!
Review: We visited this restaurant twice during our time in Langkawi on trip advisor's recommendation. Otherwise, we probably would've walked past it. My son-in-law had the best green curry he's ever tasted (high praise indeed) and our dishes were equally yummy. There's some really lovely art decorating the walls and our only grumble is that we'd have liked to have seen more Malaysian dishes on the menu. You won't be disappointed, so please do give it a try. Show less

Author: zhenee
Title: Lovely brunch place! Recommended!
Review: Not like other cafe that the chef heat up half-ready food to accommodate the busy crowd, this cafe only prepare and cook the food upon your order. Highly recommended if you have time and want to have a wonderful breakfast to kick up your day.

Author: 158kareldBrisbane, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I must admit my expectations were probably high; so when the pizza arrived it was a let down! There were no olives as advertised and the crust was thick and undercooked (it advertised thin and crispy). They added pineapple (which was not on the list). Our friends had the Vietnamese spring rolls which she loved and the chicken sandwich. The latter was good and could have easily fed 2 people!The decor is funky and the place always seems busy!I think I just made a bad menu choice! Show less

Author: Myx L
Title: Quick vacay
Review: Food was great and worth the price. The ambiance was chill and had lots of interesting artworks. The location is at the city proper and is minutes away from Eagle’s square and malls. 👍🏻

Author: Jadenyj92Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great dinner
Review: I found this restaurant from internet,so me and my friend decide to give a try. The restaurant have a very good environment to having dinner and i very enjoy the food.We order "green curry rice","pumpkin soup", "beef lasgana", "nachos with beef bolo", and also "beef goulash".Overall the food for me is yummy.. Good job!!!Show less

Author: Candz33
Title: Yummy home cooked food.
Review: Lovely intimate restaurant, very friendly staff & owner. Fabulous success story of the owner’s start up. Food was delicious & freshly prepared & tasty. Artwork is good & well priced too.

Author: aobudRiyadh, Saudi Arabia
Title: Delicious food
Review: I came to this Restaurant because of the recommendation that I read from this website that this restaurant is the best in Langkawi, after I tried it, is so true.I ordered the bolonies chicken, veg pizza and homemade spring roll, delicious food , and the staff especially “Nadia” is perfect and very helpful.so I recommend this restaurant to anyone who comes to Langkawi.Show less

Author: iamgedeonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unique Ambience and Great Food
Review: I'm a big fan of the interior design of the cafe. There are 2 floors in the cafe. The ground floor indoor is beautiful with many oil paintings hanging on the walls. My personal favourite is the upper floor, which gives me a chill and relaxing ambience. We ordered a Spaghetti Aglio Olio with grilled chicken and olives. The food is tasty and the portion is enough for 2 people. Highly recommended for cafe hopping and nice photos! Show less

Author: gavinwelman
Title: Nice and relaxed
Review: As a regular to Arts Cafe, I am never disappointed. Simple cafe food and drinks nicely prepared and very tasty

Author: davidhighett
Title: Stylish artistic cafe
Review: Belinda is the gracious and welcoming host in this indivual and stylish arts cafe - featuring works by local artists. The coffee is good and the food varied and delicious.

Author: Sushant SNew Delhi, India
Title: Wonderful place to be
Review: Totally in love with this place. Environment is good and charming, we will come back next time for more...Went here with my family and it was amazing. Very positive and lively ambience. Excellent and fresh meals...Owner and her staff are very friendly and helpful, she even gave us chocolates as a token of love ❤️❤️Also she gave very useful tips about eating and roaming in and around kuah.Its a must visit place if you are near this part of Langkawi...Show less

Author: pepamint_leeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Huge portions
Review: Nice decor, cozy place.Ordered Apple and nut salad, and it was the size of a mains! Also ordered a chicken cottage pie, and an Asian fried rice, with 2 non alcoholic drinks. Cottage pie was really tasty, wished the salad had more apple in it, fried rice was alright.Whole meal cost us $99.50 probably expensive by local standards but I guess what we ordered could probably feed 3 persons..Walking distance to many duty free shops and a taxi stand.Show less

Author: WoanT3
Title: Yummylicious and Cozy Cafe
Review: Friendly lady boss & staff.. delicious and value for money. My kids love the pasta..Visited twice in a row for lunch & dinner.. must order Gado-Gado, Lamb Shanks..

Author: PeenieMPerth, Australia
Title: Delicious food like home
Review: Delicious hearty homey meals. Huge portions and fabulous service made this a highlight of our trip. My husband ordered the bolognese and I had the cottage pie. The fresh made spaghetti was melt in your mouth good, and my cottage pie certainly didn't skimp on the cheese! Te beautiful art on the surrounding walls added to the lovely ambience, and I have never tasted such a great coffee in Asia!Show less

Author: 61wiliamm
Title: Cosy and Delicious!
Review: One of the best western cafe in town. Love the ambiance and quality of food. Price is very reasonable! Would visit again for lunch!

Author: KawidawnHong Kong
Title: Gado Gado to die for
Review: The food, customer service, atmosphere & Art are all amazing at The Arts Cafe. Great selection of food and if your like me you have some foods you can't eat they are more than willing to switch things around to suit.The Gado Gado is particularly good and one of the best I have tasted in a long time. The Peanut sauce is to die for, I am told it is made from a family recipe. They also have a Happy Hour. Oh and if that isnt enough a fab selection of Art adornes almost every inch of space produced by local Artists (for sale)Show less

Author: srimart
Title: Artistic excellence
Review:
Since our first visit to this lovely venue,we have been several times since

The food is excellent and the menu has great choice 

The nicest venue in the area with a really relaxed atmosphere and excellent service

Highly recommend a visit

Author: YCh3n
Title: Great Services and Nice Foods
Review: It's located near to Kuah Jetty. The staffs are friendly and helpful. The foods are quite big portion and the taste is nice. For those who couldn't finish it alone, may consider to share with your friends. Highly recommended lamb shank and pizza.

Author: Rahul DSingapore
Title: Great food great ambience!
Review: Went here for lunch around 3pm. Good selection of food. Had the flat rice noodle with gravy and chicken and it was yum! Spouse had the pan fried salmon and liked it as well. There are paintings on the wall by the owners friend (I think) and they added to the charm of the place. You can even buy the paintings if you want. Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: JacobB2583
Title: Best food and art world
Review: Just had lunch today loved the place. Very positive and lively ambience. Excellent and fresh meal. Tried the salad and sandwich. Owner very friendly and helpful for useful tips for tourist like us. A must visit place if you are around the Koah town or market when you are buying duty free items. Show less

Author: jacintas2017
Title: You must go here while on Langkawi!
Review: We had lunch here as a family of 4, and all our meals were super fresh, healthy, and tasty! It's a cute little cafe, kitchen and bathroom were spotless and the service was great. Very affordable too. Highly recommended!

Author: db7andy
Title: Get out of your resort & try this place
Review: We wanted a change of scene so used TA and found this place.....we were not disappointed. The food was exceptional, the menu varied, the staff lovely and the prices very reasonable. Seriously, pop in for lunch or just a change of scene.

Author: RahmanMahani
Title: Awesome yet relax setting and great food
Review: Best dining place in Kuah town. Plenty of mixed cuisine, reasonable prices and good atmosphere. Easy access and plenty of free parking (at night only). There are not many this type of restaurant around where able to cater to all walks and tastebuds and this is among the best and you will not regret it. Show less

Author: Cecil Chooi M
Title: Pleasant surprise
Review: I was really doubtful as I stumbled upon this cafe in Trips Advisor. The amount of 5 stars review is astounding and I was really sceptical and keep questioning the truth and worth in those reviews. So me and my fiancee decide to check it out.The cafe has a really soothing and peaceful vibe to it. The decor gives you something to look at while waiting for the food, with the music more to jazz, blues, all the soothing genre. Simply relaxing.Got the menu and the price is indeed a little high, not unlike those in KL, within my expectations as shown on the app with the money sign $$-$$$. Starting from around RM25.Ordered a chicken fillet with creamy mushroom sauce. Not a food junkie myself but I got to say it's worth the price. The quality IMO is top notch, to the point I finish the whole plate including the gravy, to the last drop.My fiancee ordered a Hawaiian pizza. I'm seriously doubtful as previous experience told me pizza served in places other than pizzeria is just non consumable, again this place proved me wrong. Crispy with just enough cheese, the taste and the aroma.. Very nice. I can see the owner replied smartly to those bad comments with pride, and I finally understand. With food like these I cannot see the source of those bad reviews.Definitely coming back if I have the chance to visit Langkawi again, enjoyed every little thing about this place. Cheers!Show less

Author: xiaomeic467
Title: Excellent food
Review:
食物烹调的方式好用心，味道调得恰恰好，中西餐都能煮得好，真是太棒棒了，连续三天都吃晚餐在这。。。
Food portion worth of money, tasty and fantastic, environment was good and charming, will come back next time for more...

Author: Mustafa P
Title: Best Cafe in town
Review: This is the one and few Europion style cafe in Langkawi which serves beer, good food and cafe.. You try it if you tired of locals

Author: 378stanley28
Title: A nice place to have a cup of coffee
Review: The meal was in big portion. The lady owner had the courtesy of asking its patrons on the food quality and whether they were satisfied with their order.I would highly recommend this cafe.

Author: Lotte D
Title: Must do!
Review: Real good food for a very friendly price! I had the curry mee and it was delicious! We were also surpised by the speed of the wifi. And last, but not least, there is happy hour from 5 till 7!!

Author: Gabriela DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent foood
Review: Best pizza I have had in Asia and delicious white house wine. Believe all the positive reviews below, it was a great experience coming here after struggling to find decent vegetarian food, a little pricey compared to other restaurants in the area but worth paying extra for the really tasty food.Show less

Author: jeanjacquesM53
Title: Great home made food !
Review:
After 2 weeks in Malaysia, this is one of the best place we went to
Friendly people with a simple but tasty menu

Author: JennLSingapore
Title: Arts in many ways.
Review: This cafe is conveniently located. It is spacious with 2 floors to accommodate big and small groups. Some of the art works displayed in the cafe are for sale. These are artworks done by local artists. It is so good of the cafe to support local artists. The food is good and reasonably priced. It serves mainly western food. Even if you have taken your meal, it is a good place to chill out with a dessert or a cup of tea. The staff are friendly and very accommodating. This is a must-visit place when you are in Langkawi. It is located next to the popular The Spa Shop of Langkawi.I am impressed by the artworks exhibited in this cafe, the art of interior decoration, the art of food presentation, the art of hospitality and the art of management, etc.Show less

Author: emilytheobaldMayfield, United Kingdom
Title: Welcoming and tasty food
Review: We came here due to other great reviews and were not disappointed. It is a lovely environment for just a drink or a meal with a wide range of colourful art on all the walls. Upstairs has a really relaxed atmosphere with plants and water feature.Would recommend the delicious peanut butter and banana smoothie and curry mee if you like it hot and spicy. Belinda is very welcoming and made an effort to talk to all the customers. She had beautiful, intricate henna designs on her hand and she now has a henna artist come every Wednesday for customers to book appointments with. So I did and went back the next day. So pleased with my design and how lovely all the staff were. Show less

Author: vinceiceySingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome food & lovely ambience!
Review: Super impressed by the generous portions of food served! We ordered lamb shank & chicken thigh. The delicious mashed potato tops a fantabulous meal! Had a really filling & enjoyable brunch @ Arts Cafe! Many thanks to Belinda who offered snacks & shared with us the history of the cafe. Little did we know we'd find such hidden gem in this quiet lil' town of Kuah! Would definitely recommend my friends to visit! Well Done! :)Show less

Author: clem1791Singapore, Singapore
Title: A cafe to try out in Langkawi!
Review: If you are in kuah, be sure to try out Arts cafe! Cosy ambience, the meals taste good and are in large portion (great value for money!), coffee aroma was there and good services!The boss, Berlinda, was a friendly and engaging host as well. There are many reviews recommending Arts cafe in kuah, and I have to agree that it is indeed good and worth to try at least once!Show less

Author: Jackster_05Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Amazing little find
Review: We found this cafe on the penultimate day of our trip to Malaysia through Trip Advisor as we were a bit bored with hotel food at the Westin and Fishermans Quay. The food and ambiance are quirky and eclectic with a menu to suit any taste! We had spring rolls, pizza and green curry all of which were excellent. Large portions and all home cooked. Choc brownie and ice cream for pud was also awesome. The lady who owns the cafe is warm, friendly and passionate about her food. Also loved the music and chilled vibe of the place. The owner and her staff also advised us on where to get henna done and ended up getting this done in the cafe itself, a bit of a bonus! Highly recommended. Show less

Author: RosemaryT415
Title: Great food and service
Review: There were 7 of us foodies and we enjoyed every dish we ordered as recommended by the waiter who was helpful n polite. Ambience was good too. Delicious food👍 and decent pricing. Dessert like cakes  cld be better tho.

Author: shintok94London, United Kingdom
Title: Came 3 days in a row!
Review: The food here is fresh, home cooked delicious food. We came for dinner here for 3 consecutive nights & were not disappointed. There is a variety of options, from western to Asian, so you are sure to find something to your liking. The owner is an absolutely lovely woman who clearly displays her passion for her restaurant, & provided us with food recommendations, kind gestures & top service. When I was feeling unwell, she made me a complimentary herbal tea which was so sweet! The little things really make a world of difference & arts cafe is a beautiful place with beautiful food. Do not miss this in langkawi! Show less

Author: stevenh2014
Title: Trendy cafe lovely ambiance.
Review:
Fresh homemade food which was fabulous, ambiance and service excellent. Lots of variety on the menu to suit all tastes. The homemade spring rolls were the best weve ever had and the potato rosti was delicious as was the pizza.
Highly recommended eating here.

Author: frexioPontianak, Indonesia
Title: Do come here for the ambiance
Review: Do come here for the ambiance, not the food.I tried their pasta, it looks good but taste awful and the pasta itself, a lil bit over cooked, so the texture become mushy (it's paste hey, not porridge).I don't fully blame on Arts Cafe as my sister (Langkawi Residence) blaming me for trying the pasta but not trying their breakfast set (My sis said their breakfast set is one of the best in town). I guess I shouldn't doubt their breakfast set as they freshly produced their bread everyday or maybe twice a day, I guess?And my 4 star is for their ambiance! For those selfie crazy, you have to come here for taking photo. The spot here is confirm instagenic (instagram-able). I did take a photo of my food and the ambiance as well as my own product. So, it's a 4 star spot for taking photo. Show less

Author: Berrly1
Title: Slow service
Review: We waited for an hour. Everyone else tko. Food and drinks taste are fine though. Just be very sure you're not rushing and have plenty of time.

Author: rookylondon
Title: Fantastic
Review: Really lovely cafe, excellent food all home made on the premises including the bread and pasta. In fact it has the best pies east of London bridge ! The staff are great very friendly and helpful, and the original art is great . A must visit if in LangkawiShow less

Author: Colin P
Title: FRIENDLY LOCAL RESTAURANT
Review: Great place for lunch. Had the ham and cheese sandwich with salad. Fresh and delicious and very filling. Friendly staff, clean toilets and lovely atmosphere with a small gallery upstairs. If you like mango then you must have a mango smoothie delicious.

Author: Judygran
Title: Cute Little Cafe
Review:
Very friendly staff who obviously have a sense of humour.
Lunch was great and their mango smoothies are divine.

Author: AmmarLondon
Title: Amazing little cafe
Review: Go here. Have the coffee. Enjoy the art. Take pics from the upper floor. Really nice place. I would return

Author: Tony G
Title: Good food and great value
Review: You can eat well here for a reasonable price. Lots of choice and attentive service. And they have a happy hour from 5-7pm which makes a beer great value. I went twice and enjoyed it both times.

Author: john1604Sydney, Australia
Title: fantastic best coffee and food in kuah town
Review: what a great relaxing place.this is what langkawi needs great friendly service high quality food and coffee to sit back and enjoy.the greatest find in kuah town.a must for those who enjoy good food service and not over priced.cannot not speak more highly i loved it.Show less

Author: nikheel11
Title: Good and thick pizza
Review: We took the veg pizza and it was very filling and worth the pizza.also the menu selection is quite vast..will go back again in the future

Author: PAULINE712Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: Arrive on 17june with family. We ordered different food from the menu. Cheese pizza, garlic bread, Nasi Lemak and lasagne I tried. Nasi lemak did not have coconut taste however the overall Chili and rice is very nice. The rest are as good. Nice cosy place. Met celebrity artiste Jessica Liu. A sweet and pretty lady. Show less

Author: SuzySkyeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely for Western food
Review: A nice cafe with oil paintings on the wall, and a menu with mostly Western dishes although they do have some local options. We had a pizza and lasagne, both delicious which generous topping of cheese. Prices are on the high side, comparable to a typical cafe in Kuala Lumpur. Location is at Kuah town close to all the duty-free shops.Show less

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: What a lovely find.
Review: Met with a local here on Sunday for brunch.Had a wonderful brunch, and impressed with the quantity, freshness and prices.Good wine selection, and were blown away with the attention to detail provided by the staff.We are looking forward to returning soon to sample more delights.Show less

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Very good local arts cafe!
Review: Good and nice place for a locals delight or a beer. You should not miss it if you are in kuah town area just next to a shopping mall. Calming and cosy with a twist of its unique interior design and its painting. The food is nice too they serve both western breakfast and local cruisine for lunch and dinner. Supposingly the upstair is a beer garden but I think they need some good music to create the vibes. Highly recommend it !Show less

Author: 434ekaterinak
Title: Yummy!
Review: My family love this place. Delicious food, great atmosphere, clean tables and toilet. Near restaurant you can find shops with duty-free chocolate, alcohol and etc.

Title: Nice service nice place
Review:
Nice service and i like it very much and the place is very easy to find.
Highly recommend because our hotel at kuah and it is really hard to find a place to eat.Luckly i found this place!

Author: tayclaireSingapore, Singapore
Title: Artsy, Comfortable, Tasty!
Review: Nice artsy cafe with really bright paintings all around. We ordered the mushroom soup, pasta and Hungarian beef goulash. It was tasty and decently priced, plus portions were huge!! Wide selection of food choices from burgers, pasta, salads and asian choices. I enjoyed my lunch here and would recommend this place! :)Show less

Author: RubiYAYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Food coma!
Review: The first thing that hits you upon entering the cafe is a warm toasty bready smell... and you just KNOW that good food will emerge from the kitchen!We had the lamb shank for RM38 and it was of the huge, dropping off the bone, melting in your mouth variety. MUST EAT! And enter food coma thereafter..We also had the Cajun chicken pizza for RM27. Nice crispy base with lots of toppings! The only suggestion would be for the onions to slightly more cooked, rather than so crunchy.. but it's a small quibbleThe Superstar juice for RM12 packs a gingery punch and makes you feel like you're really detoxing! Let the juice sit for a bit so that you can avoid the gingery solid bits Show less

Author: Vinod A
Title: Awesome
Review: Food taste nice and simply delicious, not that pricy as the rest, worth the food for the price. Recommend to come.

Author: eliotc611
Title: Amazing
Review: 3 days running we have been to this place. Seriously good food and extremely friendly owners! Made Langkawi that much better.

Author: samhus
Title: A beatiful break to escape the heat
Review:
It is a unique place full of Artistic gestures. Clean and organized with free wifi and good service.
The coffee and the ice cream  were delicious and the atmosphere is nice but it is a bit small.

Author: jhons738
Title: Great food taste
Review:
Nice manager and food is cheap and nice
Fully recommend
We had couple breakfasts over there and manager keep giving us free samples to get our opinion

Author: MaksmumMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great for lunch
Review: This restaurant is very near the Bayview Hotel and we went for lunch while waiting for our room to be ready. The menu was fairly extensive and the chicken caeser salad was different but excellent. My friend had a lovely platter with an Arabic influence. Fresh, well presented food with a slight twist makes the Arts Cafe a place to visit for good food and a very nice environment. I would happily eat here again.Show less

Author: 3egg
Title: nice place & food
Review:
good food, nice environment with all the arts, but the price is really expensive.

one thing, coffee doesn't come in standard with 2 shots. additional shot costs RM2.

Author: AdrianY397
Title: Lamb shank!!!dessert
Review:
1. Lamb shank 
2.apple tart
3. Very very very value for money
4. Very comfortable environment 
5.2nd floor cafe have a very unique design
Worth a visit and I will come bcc again.

Author: teohginnaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: Impressive when first step into the cafe by the decoration and the paints on the wall, the table and chair etc. We were further impressed when we checked the menu, different variety of foods on the menu, you can find western delight and local food on the menu, sandwiches, pasta, pizza, soups etc. and you can find at least 1 or 2 options for vegetarian in each category. We went back second times before leaving Langkawi returning home, you probably can tell how good the good quality is.Recommend Nasi Ulam, Nachos and Vietnam roll. This is vegetarian friendly restaurant. For those vegetarian who come to langkawi for vacation, this restaurant is the place you should NOT miss. Highly recommend if you are looking for a place to chit chatting with friends for a relaxing afternoon. Strategic location, it is located in Kuah, about 10min drive from Jetty Point. Show less

Author: jayspot1Lynnwood, Washington
Title: super cool baby - yeahhhh!
Review: Went for breakfast and had a hard time trying to decide what to order from their extensive menu- ended up ordering toast, sausage egg and coffee which were all good and reasonably priced. Staff was super chill and friendly and what I loved was the beautiful design of the place and the various paintings and art work along the walls.Show less

Author: denise bMelbourne, Australia
Title: Charming & Great menu
Review: Such a delighful place, from all aspects. Ambience, menu, service, wine. We had a large group and we were looked after so well by Belinda and Ronnie , all of the family loved their meal - Thank you .ps- if you like hot and spicy dishes, they have some great choicesShow less

Author: 836lottac
Title: Nice bananapancakes
Review: I took bananapancakes for breakfast and they were really good ones. A little bit too sweet for me so if you do not like sweet things so maybe you can say that they won't put any syryp..

Author: Rachel CTorquay, Victoria, Australia
Title: Great place!
Review: we stayed in the Westin so the Arts cafe was really near us. We ate here a few times and the food was lovely. The art was the thing that got us coming back! Some really stunning pieces, especially upstairs. We met the owner who was really pleasant and told us about some of the art and the artists behind it. We bough a really interesting piece to take home with us.Show less

Author: GaryS0609Malaysia
Title: Lovely place with high value of food
Review: Went there with my friends last month and find out the place is quite nice although is a small cafe. Cheap beer during happy hour and some limited choices of main course but the this really satisfied me is the portion! The portion is huge! It's delicious anyway. Is a ideal place to hang out with friends and have some nice food. Of course the waiter is so friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: XyLi J
Title: Lovely place
Review: We visit this place for lunch and really enjoy everything!!! Nice design, great hospitality and amazing food‼️for sure 5⭐️ and have to visit👍🏾

Author: michmac33Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Nice coffee
Review: There aren't many places about to get a good coffee but we found this little place for our morning hit. Staff were nice, although coffee is expensive by Malaysian standards. Show less

Author: donjeanne642
Title: Best in town.
Review:
So impressed with everything about the Arts Cafe! The food was excellent where a simple sandwich became a gourmet lunch. Friendly staff and value for money too. 
All round - highly recommended.

Author: LaPalmaPizzaCafeEttalong Beach, Australia
Title: highly recommended
Review: Very nice and quite generous meals, excellent quality and friendly peoples owner and staff, highly recommended. We'll be back there again.Show less

Author: DuksooK1
Title: Wonderful place Delicious food
Review: It was my first time travelling to langkawi with my families and it was really nice and great. The food was delicious, have tried many kinds of food and all the food were super delicious. Tom Yam bee hoon noodle was my highly recomend food. The service was good server serve us with their best and food preparation time was fast too. Great experience i had! Thanks Show less

Author: LangkawimyholidayLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: A good spot for lunch and diner
Review: Food is excellent and for sure a lot choices on the menu card you will like. We had tradition nasi lemak, lamb chop, cottage pie and all were delicious and in the mean time a place we often come back.Show less

Author: xxept0Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't come here for the food
Review: I had the carbonara and mushroom pasta while my fiance had the cottage pie. It was honestly an extremely uninspiring meal. Not to mention the price is comparable to that of cafes in KL city (we paid RM24 for the cottage pie, which was essentially bolognese sauce with julliened potatoes and a layer of cheese. The rm22 carbonara tasted like it was made with a canned sauce base). My flat white was more like coffee-flavoured milk, while the iced mocha was over sweetened. It was just a disappointing experience overall, ESPECIALLY since the rating on TripAdvisor is so high. The art was nice, but service was just so painfully average. We expected so much more.Show less

Author: kavya3149Noida, India
Title: Awesome Cafe
Review: Arts cafe was on my list to visit. It was closer to my hotel as well(Bayview hotel). Must say after an adventurous day spent I was in search of place like this. Very well maintained.Beautiful and creative architecture. Very well prepared food(ate spring rolls, my favorite garlic bread, cold coffee and hot coffee both are nice). Just go order something of your choice , sit and relax. Worth a visit.Show less

Author: catherinemP6385EH
Title: Well worth a vist
Review: This place is amazing to buy your souvenirs or just about anything else. Make sure you visit the Glass Blowing in the building above the main complex. My husband spent 2 hours watching them make some wonderful things.

Author: Marwee3Mobile, Alabama
Title: Don't eat here!!
Review: After reading all the reviews for here, I decided to give it a try for lunch. What a waste of my time and money! The food was lackluster and just smothered in mayonnaise. I had ordered a cajun chicken sandwich and it contained more mayonnaise than meat. It had more bread than veggies in it as well. The place had art in it but the ambiance was uninspiring. The service was subpar and I wouldn't recommend anyone to come here. Look else where for a nice coffee shop.Show less

Author: Vylan T
Title: MMM!!!
Review: come here for a great breakfast! I had the banana pancakes and they were so good. Fluffy and light! Beautiful plating job, great coffee, prices reasonable and portion size good. Service is really good, and they have wifi. We wish we could have tried more dishes - everything on the menu looked really healthy and delicious. Clean bathrooms too!!Show less

Author: Vincent2727Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Interesting cozy place
Review: Was in Langkawi for 3 days business trip and on the last day before departure back home the tour bus took us to Kuah for duty free shopping. We are eagerly looking for Starbuck after shopping but was told it's about 20 mins walk so someone directed us to this cost place.... no regrets....cozy and nice coffee.. but of course don't expect Barrista type... just good coffee.Show less

Author: nuranysaa
Title: Best in Kuah!
Review:
We really love the authentic food here love the ambience and the friendly service.
The salads are pizza are on the top mark a place not to miss if you are in Langkawi 2 thumbs up!!!

Author: 116dave
Title: great breakfast
Review: My wife and I had Breakfast here today, very good food, had chicken sausage, fried egg freshly baked bread, juice and great coffee. will be back.

Author: Dmadz
Title: Good food, good service
Review: Good food at reasonable prices. Service was very good. Unfortunately they'd run out of the beef pie when we visited so we ordered a pasta dish and a salmon dish - both tasty. Worth a visit if your in the area.

Author: BeanettaLangkawi
Title: Fantastic Lunch!
Review:
The food is amazing.  The spring rolls were amazing and I highly recommend the banana pancakes with coconut and maple syrup. Yum!
Definitely not a place to miss!

Author: CameronG931
Title: HIts the mark properly
Review: Admittedly, I am bit of a snob. I gripe about food places often, but this place was a rarity of what exactly the level of nicety I can appreciate. The wifi is pretty good shy of gaming, the portions are ample, and the food quality is on point. The best meal I've had on the island so far. A long way from the semi rowdy ilk otherwise. This place is light years ahead of everything else on the island and would measure up fine to my yuppy west coast US coffee boutiques.Show less

Author: BritnieS5
Title: I went on TripAdvisor just to rate them
Review: This place is really great. The staff are friendly, the food is delicious, The atmosphere is relaxing, and the art is well done.

Author: Sanaz K
Title: Great food!
Review: The best place we have eaten on so far during our trip in Langkawi. The cafe is beautiful and colourful with art hanging all over the walls. The food is fresh and tasty. The prices are reasonable. We had breakfast at our hotel but chose to come to this place and have our breakfast here. Thumbs up for Arts Cafe! Show less

Author: Christoffel B
Title: Awesome
Review: This is probably the best place ive been in Langkawi. It has a fun, creative vibe. The staff are super friendly and there are so many choices to choose from for a vegetarian like myself. Well done guys. Two thumbs up.

Author: Jessamyhardie
Title: Incredible western food good for vegetarians
Review: I live in Langkawi and every once in a while I need some western comfort food.The food at arts cafe is absolutely delicious, as good as home, and as a vegetarian there are lots of options for me. The smoothies are great too and the cake is to die for.Yum yum yum can't recommend more.Show less

Author: sirpao2016Espoo, Finland
Title: Wery nice cafe
Review: Good coffee and breakfast. There are also lunch and dinner portions available.Atmosphere is nice and you can enjoy piece of art during your stay.Service is friendly and nice.Menu is a bit limited but is compensated with quality.This cafe has found the way to differentiate from other cafes.Warmly recommended.Show less

Author: jrodrigo135Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love the Ambience
Review: Overheard: "Good place for coffee and cake" In fact Arts Cafe offers much more than good coffee and cake and other scrumptious dessert. The Gado Gado was excellent. The Energiser smoothie I started with was good too. And now I am ordering the chocolate and coconut ice cream dessert. It is called an Arts Cafe for good reason. There's art everywhere. Acrylics and oils and a lovely rendering of a rotund Mona Lisa.It has wireless and an upstairs space. Inspirational ambience.Show less

Author: CruisingNanna2013Langkawi District, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast with a difference
Review: We visited twice for breakfast and enjoyed the large meal. There are options within the meal: home made bread or rosti (yum), choice of sausages and beverages. Funky art and decor with exceptionally attentive staff. A wonderful option for those who prefer a more western style breakfast.Show less

Author: Patrick Z
Title: A bit too expensive for what it is.
Review: I'm writing this review based on a breakfast meal we had at this place. Had something like an English breakfast and a pancake.Portions were quite small which surprised me given the rather hefty price of about 25 or 30 per dish. Left the place a little hungry...As to the food: nothing special but not bad either.Lunch / dinner may be better. Show less

Author: shima23
Title: Quaint..nice find
Review: This place is unexpected and the decor is nice. I had the cottage pie which had absolutely no salt. Having said that the staff were friendly and attentive. Go if you want something different, but I'm not too enthused by the food.

Author: tiggerone
Title: Little gem
Review: We found this little gem while on holiday. The staff are very helpful and friendly.  The owner was lovely  always had time for a chat. The food and presentation was excellent and the beer chilled to perfection.  Certainly highly recommend this cafe. First class.

Author: cjb61241London, United Kingdom
Title: Just what's needed
Review: Kuah town doesn't attract many tourists away from Langkawi's dream-like beaches, but if you find yourself in town for supplies (excellent pharmacy across the road, plenty of 'duty free' shops closeby) or in transit to the ferry, this is an oasis of good coffee, juices and excellent breakfasts - in a colourful arty setting with wifi. Nothing else like it in the area - loved it.Show less

Author: Яна К
Title: Must see
Review: Must see on Langkawi island!!! Fast service, friendly staff, delicious, romantic atmosphere :) I recommend!

Author: flashman974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great menu selection
Review: A nice atmosphere and decor, plenty of artwork to admire and buy if tempted. Friendly staff, service good, and a wait for dishes ordered means freshly prepared. We chose mushroom soup, nachos, bihun, gadogado followed by a banana crumble. Soup, nachos and crumble were excellent, bihun apparently not the same delight, and the peanut sauce for gadogado a little bland. But we would return to sample other dishes. Reasonably priced, definitely one of the better restaurant cafes in Langkawi.Show less

Author: ChristoTngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food with nice service.
Review: We had dinner twice at this place on 27-Dec and 30 Dec. So needless to say that we like this place.We loves the chicken pie and lamb shank.The owner Belinda is always on a friendly big smile and working hard to keep this restaurant at its best levels in terms of food quality and service standard.Highly recommended for people who wanted a good western food in Kuah town.Show less

Author: Kyle M
Title: Best Food in langkawi!!!
Review: The owners are super friendly and the food was amazing!!! We had a lovely conversation  with the owners and staff. Highly recommended!

Author: 952kenlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth a try
Review: A place to try if you in Kuah and not sure what to eat as they have both western and local cuisine. Price is not that cheap I will say, almost same as in KL. Boss is friendly and can ask for advice for your trip. Show less

Author: Jan C
Title: Lunch
Review: There was 6 in our group, and it was a very busy day for the cafe. The staff were very friendly and efficient, and apologised for the delay in bringing us our meals due to the number of guests there that day. It was worth the wait though. The meals were delicious. We ordered lasagne, nachos and the chicken pie. Big meals. Very filling. Thank you, Arts Cafe Show less

Author: MeiyennN
Title: Great tasting food, friendly owner :)
Review:
Love the ambience, food & staff! Would definitely pay a visit back to this cafe! 👍
As a local Malaysian myself, I find it difficult to search for cafe/restaurant that serves good food, but this place wasn't a disappointment at all!

Author: Sebastien PYokohama, Japan
Title: Feel like your mother's food !!
Review: This is probably our best experience with food so far in Langkawi, Amazing service, very social owner and food is just amazing, Every thing we try was fantastic, so much that we went back there a second time, I really advice this place for couple or family !! Show less

Author: TinjaP
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: A cozy little place. Tasty food and drinks. I really liked the salads there and the serving size was big enough. Service there was also good.

Author: 217geraldinesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Chicken Pie With Style.
Review: The chicken pie is one with style, served in a large individual casserole, filled to the brim with chicken + vegetables in a creamy sauce, The pastry is fine,crisp, and piping hot, as it is baked only when you orders it, Now that is a treat indeed.It is all a Yum affair in a cafe with perfect ambiance.Show less

Author: Rachel C
Title: Beautiful morning
Review:
Went back again to the lovely Arts Cafe.
Filled with wonderful aromas of coffee and yummy sour dough😍bread.. simple and so yummy😍

Author: ss1520
Title: Nice food and worth for money
Review:
Nice deco and cozy place for dining. Felt like eating at home :)
We had our lunch here, food was good and reasonable price, but serving time kinda slow and the staff missed orders. 
Overall are find and recommended.

Author: Rachel C
Title: Beautiful...yummy food.. hot coffee☕️
Review: Such a beautifully decorated place with yummy food and good hot coffee, really sets the tone for a beautiful day😊

Author: Deniz U
Title: WONDERFUL
Review:
Central location, wonderful food and great hospitality.
I had the chance to meet the owner Mrs. Belinda who loves art and we had a great chat with the delicious ginger tea she made..
It was great to know her and her arts cafe :)

Author: jingy950
Title: Bad service
Review: Saw the reviews of the others here about this restaurant before going. Me and my friends were so excited when we reached UNTIL we ordered the food. The food and drinks suck-Lava cake It don't actually have lava and is actually JUST a choco cake. Why no molten choco at all?-CarbonaraTaste bad. -Mushroom soupThe bread taste like plain yeast-Honey lemon God, it gives me diabetes. Too sweet!Service is poor-The waiter bring us the wrong food-The waiting for the food is too long!The pricing for the food is alright, but the quality of service and food just makes me feel like it is not worth it. Thank you Show less

Author: Daynee C
Title: A Nice Place to be.
Review: The decorations and the cozy environment of this cafe is definitely a good place for any occasions. The flavor of the food is tasty and remarkable . Their home made mushrooms soup is a must to try. The chicken pie is my favorite too. They have many varieties in the menu. We certainly have a great time there. Show less

Author: pianocelloShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Good selection of food
Review: There's a good selection on the menu and depending on when you go, parking is not difficult to find. While waiting for your meals, you can also browse the artworks. There's also fast wifi. Bear in mind this place is more suitable for small families and couples as the tables are rather small. Also I found it odd that they would try to censor some of the artworks. Show less

Author: freeredcazPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: A small cafe with an interesting menu.
Review: A very pleasant boutique restaurant with an interesting menu. It's rare to be struggling with what best to choose to eat. I chose the lamb shank, which was the best I have had in Asia so far, the mash was good, as was the delicious apricot sauce which had a little heat in it. Presentation and service was good and the atmosphere mellow. I would advise avoiding the house red as it is extremely sharp, but I saw plenty of patrons enjoying the other wines, especially the whites.I look forward to returning in the next few days to try the goulash or creamy mushroom chicken fillet with Rosti. I'm very sorry now that I didn't take a picture of my dinner but I was so eager to tuck in.Show less

Author: rixon82Coventry, United Kingdom
Title: Good
Review: The food was actually really good it just never came out together ! Pie and chips and the chips never came lol but we came again and the same happened again the side never came out and the side veg never came out with. The main ! Show less

Author: Helenrandwick
Title: Fantastic and friendly
Review: Brilliant. Went for lunch a couple of times. Food is cooked fresh very tasty.all meals looked absolutely delicious.  Belinda is most welcoming. Nothing like a cold beer on a hot and humid day. Highly recommend a visit here. Top place to visit in Kuah

Author: Billie KSandakan, Malaysia
Title: THE BEST WE HAD THIS WEEK!
Review: We wanted something authentic after couple of days in Langkawi and didn't mind the long drive from our hotel in Pantai Kok to Kuah to seek out this restaurant after reading the excellent reviews. We came back 3 days in a row for lunch and dinner and we must say every meal and every dishes we had were really amazingly good!We enjoyed the good portion and reasonable pricing.....every thing were fresh and with good quality. Highly recommended expecially the salads, pasta, salmon and the pot pie! Pizza and homemade soups too!Show less

Author: DAB12014Dubrovnik, Croatia
Title: Fantastic!
Review: This is the best place to eat in Kuah! Fresh local and western food cooked to order!Great spot to drop into for breakfast , lunch or dinner. Lovely clean and welcoming place. Particularly loved the fresh salads and the bakso! To make it even more superb , there is cold beer and a fantastic selection of wines to wash it all down with. Hard to beat anywhere on the island ! Oh and the staff are happy to serve you! Service not being a strong point over there!!! Just great value for money too!Show less

Author: Christian SHobart, Australia
Title: As good as at the beginning in August.
Review: The Arts Café is a standout in Langkawi. It keeps up its standart of Excelence visit after visitBelinda is a consumate operator and keeps a daly check on her staff and what comes out of the kitchen, taste and presentation. I never yet have used salt or pepper on the food I have eaten there. Every dish I had looked apetising to the Eye and tasty to the palet. I have nothing but full admiration for the Team and its Leader at the Arts Café. Deffenitly worth a trip in to Town from wherever you are.And the atmosphere, surroundet with all the art works., tastfully arranged adds to the concept.Add to it good Coffeé, fresh juices and other drinks, what else would you want. The number 1 place for me in Langkawi.Show less

Author: winter4716Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Holiday in Langkawi
Review: Kuah is the only town in Langkawi, and Arts Cafe is the only "eating" house in Kuah which is centrally located - delightfully decorated, offering peaceful breakfast, lunch and dinner - appetising presentation of dishes - and best choice of dishes suitable to hot days and rainy days. All round pleasant experience. I would go backShow less

Author: timbr0
Title: Pies & curry
Review: Great selection of food and fantastic quality, service really friendly and good value. Recommend to all, could not fault.

Author: Darrell M
Title: Darrell
Review: After being in Langkawi for 2 days we found this great cafe-but it's more than a cafe it's a great place for a beer and absolutely wonderful traditional food. They also do a lovely traditional English meat pie with chips. The owner and staff are very friendly it's well worth a visit.Show less

Author: MichaelandrebeccPaignton, United Kingdom
Title: Very much needed
Review: We came here for lunch after just finished 14 hours of travelling. The staff we were very friendly and the food was so tasty! We chatted to the owner who says the style of cooking is the same as at home which makes it even more authentic. The curry me had a wonderful kick to it and the spring rolls were delicious. Definitely try get back there again this weekShow less

Author: 637captnp
Title: Nice place for lunch
Review: Had the pleasure of dining at Belinda Koh's Arts Cafe in Kuah Town, Langkawi.  Great atmosphere, service and food, particularly the spring rolls and curry.   Well recommended :)

Author: Nick2103
Title: Completely satisfied!
Review: From the time we walked in we were greeted with a warm welcome by the owner and staff. Had the arty iced coffee (delicious) location (easy to find) seats inside and outside(lovely) and the best part was the pot pie (absolutely divine) apple crumble with ice cream(perfect). Owner is very hands on and helpful ( the way a business should be) all in all a perfect and satisfying experience. Keep up the good work. Wishing you all the success with your business. It's easy to see why your restaurant is so highly recommended. Show less

Author: karenmeye4Petak, Indonesia
Title: Delightful!
Review: What a gorgeous little cafe. Owner really hands on. My husband had the beef pot pie and it was huge and really delicious. I had the apple crumble and that was devine. Coffees were great. Staff couldnt do enough and the owner was lovely. She has taken great care in her business. The cafe is clean and interesting. It was good seeing such great hygiene in Asia. Well done Arts Cafe.Show less

Author: Departure587782
Title: Dinner at the arts café langkawi
Review: Close to the night market, very good food (asian and western), friendly staff, we had a great dinner!

Author: johnrajivPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A bit pricy but nice good food!
Review: Decided to stop by before flying off. Ordered the Nasi lemak, it was super hot and nice. Managed to meet the owner of the restaurant while I was there and she did mention that her Nasi lemak and tom yam dishes are cooked spicy hot like how the locals love it. Pizza smells nice. Haven't tried it yet....maybe on my next visit.Plus point: Cozy deco and nice toilet! Also it's just across "langkawi saga", duty free shop that has one of the best/lowest prices for chocolates and alcohol. Show less

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Is what you need after a hectic day!
Review: This restaurant was previously located in Langkawi Fair before moving to this new location, Pandak Mayah. It gave me a totally different feeling when moving to this new location. Visited this afternoon in an afternoon with my boyfriend, ordering Caesar Salad with grilled chicken, Chicken Pie, Grilled Salmon with Mashed Potato, Hot Honey Lemon Tea and Hot Ginger Tea. We spent hours in the restaurant enjoying the food, novel and calligraphy. Will definitely revisit this restaurant for another afternoon. Not forget to mention, they do have friendly staff, especially the Chinese Lady, assuming the owner of the restaurant.Show less

Author: Q3KRbarbarapLangkawi
Title: Yummie!
Review: Second day in a row for lunch. Yesterday I had the Bakso ( noodles, chicken balls and vegetables in a clear broth). Today I had the "Nasi Ulam" with chicken wings and cucumber salad. Tomorrow? Not sure yet what I'll have, trying to work my way through the menu! Good service, nice clean loos, great decor, comfortable and of course great food!Show less

Author: CharulataM1
Title: The best Pasta and Pizza
Review:
They make their own Pasta  and it's fresh and delicious,try their pizza too,
a heaven for vegetarians ,Curry me ,popiah and so much more.

Author: PeterN1052
Title: A fresh venue in Langkawi
Review: Art cafe recently moved location.  It is fresh, spacious, artsy and the food the great.  The staff always friendly and professional.  I suggest the chicken pie!

Author: Kito H
Title: Best Place to chill
Review:
很文青 很舒服 老闆娘很溫情
有空可以來享受享受
環境悠閒舒適 很適合各種聚會活動哦
下次再來Langkawi 一定再來這裡享受一下
😍
Super nice and cozy place to have a rest
The Lady boss here super nice and friendly 
If i ever come to langkawi i will come here again.
😄

Author: AkimotoK3
Title: Nice location, excellent environment.
Review: Come here with my gf for relaxing trip and come by, very vintage and nice environment. The boss is very friendly. We talk alot abt politics, wat happen here and how gov's new financial plan will affect us. Drinks and food is very nice and recommend.Show less

Author: Karolis P
Title: Simply an amazing place!
Review: Very nice cafe full of paintings. Has a modern feel while also making you feel like you're in an art gallery. Food is great - very fresh and full of taste. Drinks are great (you must try the arty iced coffee!). Came back the next day and sure to come again whenever in LangkawiShow less

Author: MalteGeerdes
Title: Really good lunch
Review: We went to the arts cafe for lunch and it was really nice! They have traditional asian food, pasta, pizza and some other great main dishes. The atmosphere was nice and the service very quick. We would really reccomend it! Try the mexican nachos and the iced chocolate! Its really worth it. Show less

Author: ClaireD3768
Title: Superb!
Review: Came across this place while lost looking for our hotel, absolutely amazing food and the owner is lovely, highly recommend :)

Author: Joms M
Title: Simply amazing!!
Review: Passed the beautifully looking cafe on route finding hotel and so glad we did we came back for food and it was so nice words cant describe! Such an array of different home cooked foods I went for a chicken pie and was not left disappointed!! Such a beautiful way to start a day I strongly recommend this place and the owner is lovely!!Show less

Author: Yoonfook S
Title: Simply Amazing and best!
Review: We have viewed the reviews on the net and decided to have our meal there with 12 of us. We were there for an early lunch and the lower floor was nearly packed. The manager has suggested the upper floor and it was an amazing set up, we loved the tropic feels on the 1st floor with the little garden and a small fountain, the back ground music were just right for the place.It was indeed the best meal since we arrived 3 days ago....we have more to compare but the quality of food here were simply amazing, reasonable price too. We were there again the next day again for dinner and every dishes were so good! The portion were good too and we love their home made pastry and pasta....everything were on the top mark.You need to make a trip here to believe it!2 thumps up!!!Show less

Author: linweisingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Saturday Lunch
Review: After visited Eagle Square, decided to have lunch in Kuah Town.Read on Tripadvisor about Art Cafe. Restaurant is located opposite a Pharmacy. Visited and dine there. Clean cosy colorful restaurant with many paintings. Indoor and outdoor seating (smoking area) with about 22-30 persons seating capacity and free Wifi. Sat down and the waiter came with the menu promptly. Ordered mushroom, tomato with cheese sandwiches ($19.50) and cajun chicken sandwiches ($19.50) with coke. Cafe has 10% service fee. Cash term only.After eaten the meal. Had a short chat with the staff and realised that the cafe made their own bread and pasta. Wow, really amazing.Enjoyed this simple local meal at affordable price. Show less

Author: _F6307DAValparaiso, Chile
Title: The best cafe in Langkawi we visited
Review: As soon as we entered, we felt as we are at home of our old friends - so warm greetings, very nice aroma in the air, comfortable sofas and pleasant music.First, when we tried fresh juices from mango and orange, we understood that this is the best cafe we have visited in Langkawi! So nice and smooth taste without anything not desirable to have like a lot of water or ice inside. Everything just like it should be! Then, when they served pizza, green salad and salmon - we were amazingly surprised with the quality of this food - it's like homemade, as we are visiting our friends and they propose us the most delicious meals! Extremely good! And we have a lot to compare - this one is not only the best one in Langkawi, but also is one of the most good places on the planet. Definitely. If you don't believe, go and try yourself. :) Show less

Author: mlim71
Title: Delicious food and nice ambience
Review: There are pretty good choice on the menu. Amazing food with huge serving size. The Chicken Pie and Mee Curry were just THE BEST. Loved the feel of this place. I definitely make Arts Cafe my regular.

Author: 214azharaSeoul, South Korea
Title: Food paradise
Review: Enjoy the food that we ordered. Cozy embiance. Nasi Lemak, nasi kerabu, salmon grille plus banana crumble was awesome......finger licking good. A come back for sure. Owner & staff are friendly too! Show less

Author: StarStevensFamilyPipera, Romania
Title: Great spot for lunch with the family
Review: Stopped by here with friends and family for lunch before an afternoon exploring Langkawi. We had a great meal and the kids (two 6 year olds and a 3 year old) loved the space and their pizza's. The Malay food was delicious at this quaint and stylish, yet cozy, restaurant.Show less

Author: Lev1973
Title: Great tasting food
Review: Lovely food Homestyle cooking Big portions ' and. A great price too ,very cheap compare U.K. prices. We loves the chicken & spinach pot pie, chicken salad sandwiches , delicious coffee. We will come back again .Show less

Author: gypsymamanworld
Title: Great Kuah Cafe
Review: We had a great lunch at Arts Cafe. The decor is eclectic and so is the menu. There's something for everyone. I particularly liked being able to have a great salad. These can be few an far between in Asia. My partner had a good pizza while our friends tried the Asian soup. All good!Show less

Author: CaptainEvaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Far more than just a cafe!
Review: After being kicked out from a shopping mall the desaster for Belinda turned out to be a lucky one for her and us as her guests. Belinda's husband materialised and built the dream of a cafe that Belinda had in her artistic and genious mind. Art's Cafe in Kuah. It is not easy to impress me but this is indeed a must go let alone by the design and the atmosphere. But the menu and the drinks are equally impressive and truly great value for what you get. A huge variety of healthy but delicious dishes from Western to Asian cuisine. The pasta and bread are homemade. A portion starts at 18 ringgit. Kuah has not much of a scene for restaurants but this is worth to visit no matter where you come from. EvaShow less

Author: johnhornbookGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Please Note ! " Arts Cafe Kuah, Langkawie " A Must Visit Experience!
Review: As you approach the Cafe it generates a certain glow. It is tastefully decorated, has seating areas both inside and out. My wife and I were served very quickly and given good time to chose from an extensive menu. We both had breakfast and a hot drink. It was excellent, thoroughly enjoyable. We left the place already making plans to return later for tea and cake. After a few hours strolling through the duty free shops nearby we returned to sample the most amazing banana crumble cake and carrot and walnut cake. Both home made. We spoke with Belinda, the Owner and her husband who are thoroughly nice people; they made us very welcome and we had a great laugh together. Food is exeptional, every mouthful is to be savoured. So this is what I am saying to you-if you are in the location of Kuah, Langkawie - Destination " Arts Cafe "Show less

Author: Gayathiri K
Title: A wonderful place to visit
Review: While Kuah town is famous for local cuisines Arts cafe indeed one of the kind to provide satisfying western cuisines. Here I had my Cajun chicken sandwich. What a yummy lunch and the portion was huge. Totally worth my money. The place is beautiful with many art decorations and the background songs create a pleasant environment. The staffs are very friendly as they always welcome you with a smile. A must place to visit at Kuah Town, Langkawi. Show less

Author: billym331Northampton, United Kingdom
Title: Impressive
Review: Simply a superb little cafe/bistro. There's a great menu serving both western and local dishes. The bakso is delicious and the curry laksa is the best on the island. Generally if you see the local people eating there then chances are it's good. This place is very good with a relaxed ambiance, thoughtfully and tastefully designed and furnished and with excellent attentive staff. A wonderful dining experience, a great find and we will be back. Show less

Author: shihui C
Title: Best cafe in Kuah town !
Review:
My friend and I chanced upon this cafe during our first visit to Kuah town.
Ambience was really nice, lady boss is very friendly and food is fantastic! I'll let the pictures do the talking !

Author: samdigs
Title: Delicious
Review: A quiet haven in the bustle of Kuah town.   A beautiful venue serving delicious food in a friendly way.  Perfect for a pit stop when shopping, highly recommended.

Author: Paul HPetworth, United Kingdom
Title: What a great surprise.....well worth seeking out!
Review: On our first visit to Langkawi we certainly weren't expecting to find such a brilliant café. The menu was an interesting mixture of Asian and Western food and the service was truly excellent. What really made this cafe so special for us was the tasteful décor and the wonderful art collection scattered right throughout the café. The owner has obviously gone to a lot of trouble to create a great atmosphere for eating, drinking and socializing....so much genuine atmosphere. We loved it and will be back soon!Show less

Author: Savvytravellerr6789Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia
Title: Best cafe in the area!!
Review: The interior design of this cafe is enough alone to make you come!! My large group of friends and I sat upstairs in this new cafe. We could have stayed all day admiring the surrounding artwork and design. There's even an indoor garden feel upstairs. The coffee is delisous and the barista is great! The owner is so kind and although we went for just coffee and cake, it was all delicious! Fair pricing too:)Show less

Author: June K
Title: Be sure not to miss the new ARTs Cafe !!!
Review:
Delicious menu of local favorites & western selections. Breakfast, lunch & dinners. Salads & large portions. Just enjoyed the Hungarian goulash with mashed potatoes & salad. Yummy :-) 
Enjoy this great place. Easy to sit back & relax and be with friends.

Author: yogesht49Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Still the best !!!
Review: You would know in an instant , if you are a regular tea/coffee person , whether the place you are in is worth coming back to . Art's cafe has definitely brought me and my friends back again and again . A wide selection of food and drinks , and the desserts is simply fantastic . If you are a Vegetarian , this place will not disappoint you . They have a wide variety of Asian and Western Vegetarian food on their menu . Since relocating from Langkawi Fair to this new place in Kuah Town , they have extended their menu . And check out their cosy first floor . I did my wife's surprise Birthday Party here . It was terrific . Thanks goes out to their team , who will serve you with smile and for people like me , a Vegetarian , they will go out of their way to make sure my orders are met with suggestions of dishes . A must try !!!Show less

Author: ickeydropspanglesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Best coffee in Langkawi!
Review: Stumbled across this cafe by accident - a great find; we will definitely be back! Friendly owner, fab surroundings, extensive menu with veggie options & the best coffee we have had so far in Langkawi. Ideal spot for tourists to sample good standard cafe culture in Kuah Show less

Author: Yoonfook S
Title: The best restaurant in Kuah!!!
Review: We were introduced by some locals that Arts is a must visit if we are in Kuah. It was the best meal we had since we were in Langkawi. I love the homemade pasta and the freshly baked bread,The Best.

Author: Michymosh
Title: Definitely Ticks ALL the boxes!
Review: Convenient location in Kuah Town, easy parking; stimulating ambience with lots of art works adorning the walls, creative use of colours and decor, just the right music, friendly service, fantastic menu variety choices! Delicious! Free WIFI. A must go, breakfast, lunch or dinner!

Author: sannickLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: welcome addition to Kuah's limited dinning options
Review: a very nice lunch, plenty of choice of both western and asian food. good quality food and good portions. Very laid back atmosphere and pleasant efficient service. Wine and beer avaliable at reasonable prices. Nice to have a place to stop for a meal or just a coffee when shopping in KuahShow less

Author: Caroline670225
Title: Nice place for food & hang out
Review: Good food, nice & pleasant place for hang-out with friends & family. Good decorations combination with good food that is really something, just awesome.

Author: yogesht49Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Still the best !
Review: You would know in an instant , if you are a regular tea/coffee person , whether the place you are in is worth coming back to . Art's cafe has definitely brought me and my friends back again and again . A wide selection of food and drinks , and the desserts is simply fantastic . If you are a Vegetarian , this place will not disappoint you . They have a wide variety of Asian and Western Vegetarian food on their menu . Since relocating from Langkawi Fair to this new place in Kuah Town , they have extended their menu . And check out their cosy first floor . I did my wife's surprise Birthday Party here . It was terrific . Thanks goes out to their team , who will serve you with smile and for people like me , a Vegetarian , they will go out of their way to make sure my orders are met with suggestions of dishes . A must try !!!Show less

Author: Ronnie P
Title: Great place for food & relaxation !
Review: Some great dishes with reasonable pricing, try out the Chicken Pie, Hungarian Goulash and Lamb shank. Bound to keep you happy and satisfied !

Author: Shaza HLangkawi
Title: Bakso is life
Review: I miss the old venue because it was one the reason why I shop at the adjoined shopping mall, but to be honest this new location is so much better. I'm a sucker for Ibu's bakso. It's definitely my favourite Saturday breakfast ritual and sometimes I even ordered take away for dinner.Arts Café also opens the top floor for quieter, open-air dining and perfect for working lunch. Running a remote tech company from Langkawi. my clients are just dying for the opportunity to have casual meeting here. Now we have just the right place!Show less

Author: JPEZ2013
Title: Warm friendly atmosphere
Review: The new venue is even better than the original. Great food. Expansive wine menu. Friendly local service. Convenient location in the middle of Kuah

Author: Chian Yi K
Title: The best Cafe in town
Review: Get to know art cafe since 2004 if I am not mistaken...With relocated to this new location, better ambiance, better concept, and much much more varieties!!! And it's awesome:)I love the Grill Salmon, Grill Chicken, and not to forget my nephew favourite - Pizza:)Show less

Author: KPEvelynKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy food and value for money!
Review: We went to the restaurant for late lunch. It was a relaxed environment to eat with family. The curry mee was heavenly. Big servings and value for money. Will definitely go again as it is a great place to eat and hang out with family. Highly recommend it! Show less

Author: KemtaitLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Langkawi needed this ...
Review: When the Arts Cafe left its premises in Langkawi fair, many of us felt that something had happened in Langkawi... and not for the better.Belinda and her gratifying welcome to all has allways been able to create a unique atmosphere in the area...something precious had gone.Since it came back in Kuah many a saoul in Langkawi was tremendously pleased to recuperate this lovely place where everybody can meet and enjoy a drink or a meal from an improved and varied carte Belinda is now proposing us. Welcoming staff has followed .... all is well again.Show less

Author: Gerard Rodney G
Title: Dinner for two
Review: Nondescript restaurant. Nice ambience and food quality and service very good. Will definitely visit again on the next trip to Langkawi. Good selection of wines too. Expected it to cost an arm and a leg but was pleasantly surprised. Worth a visit.

Author: Christian SHobart, Australia
Title: A place to hang out while in Town.
Review: This is a place to hang out while in Town. This Café offers everything that you are looking for. Great atmosphere, good music, excelent Staff and owner Belinda is a true professional. A variety of drinks including Beers and Wine, fruit juices and excelent coffeé.The food is fresh and delicious and made on the premises. Bread and Pasta ere made fresh on a daly basis by her two chefs, June the more western style and Avi more Asian home style cook. Tasty and generous seems to be theyr moto and it hits the mark. Food available all day and every day. Breakfast-Lunch-Dinner and all times in between. Or pop in for sweets and Tea or coffeé. If this Cafeé would not excist it would have to be invented. The place has been tastfully decorated by Belinda and her Builder Husband in a very short period.It is a place to go when ever you are in Town and tired from running arround.Go and relax at the ARTS CAFEÉ.Show less

Author: 217geraldinesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: A Great Find..Smart Cafe/ Wine bar.Super atmosphere like home..
Review: Newly opened in August 2016. Interesting wall Art, comfortable cushioned chairs, natural wood, river stones, tinkling water fountain upstairs,, tropical tall plants, a sitting outside for the smokers.Belinda ,the owner/operator has hit this nail on the head. Along with her well trained and loyal staff. It is light ,airy, with back ground musicThe new menu has fresh bread and Pasta made on site. Crusty pizzas, tasting plates Swiss Rosti, comfort food like lamb shanks with fresh vegetables. Familar food, flavoursome, colourful food. Its Yum.Also Asian dishes .And the house wine is delicious and not that over acidic liquid. Big beer range. Its Fun. Prices 15 -mid 20's..Pop in for coffee and cake specialities, or juices. A sweet table for two/ one just inside the door way is perfect for a laze and a graze.Oh all day breakfasts also..Car parking at the rear of the building a must in this banking area.Show less

Author: Ollike
Title: Small Café, good lunch
Review: This is a very small Café hidden inside the Langkawi Fair mall. We had curry for lunch and it's definately very Well done and of reasonable price. Recommended over some of the more generic restaurants in the Fair.

Author: TravellingDish
Title: Good food and decent hospitality
Review: We stumbled into this place as there wasn't much on offer in the mall but were pleasantly surprised.  We enjoyed looking at the art on the walls and the Green Curry was particularly good.

Author: merlin03Kenilworth, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent find
Review: This is a cafe in the main shopping centre in Kuah. The food quality is excellent and service very good. Each dish is authentic and well priced in a clean and friendly cafe. I had the raw vegetable spring rolls which were really well put together.Show less

Author: 220ianh
Title: Quick lunch
Review: Just stopped by for quick lunch. Food was good and service was too. Went back later for coffee and a desert.

Author: rohan h
Title: Great, Inexpensive Local Food !
Review: Had an amazing freshly cooked meal. They even made fresh curry since of the guests was allergic to onions. Must Visit !

Author: ruby16_13
Title: The food just got better
Review: kudos to the staff... The food, quantity, and price just got better I loved the salad it's so fresh.

Author: ruby16_13
Title: excellent
Review: i've been to this restaurant many times though and i can say it's good price for the value... with big portions of food and please do try their homeade cakes specially the banana cake... it was always good to eat here.

Author: Madmoo1103
Title: Quick visit
Review: We stopped for a quick snack with the children.  The girls had chicken soup which was all eaten. We had toasted sandwiches which were very nice. Worth a quick visit and good friendly service.

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: A cosy place
Review: Somehow, I've always been attracted by this cafe in the Langkawi Fair mall, been there on at least 3 different occasions. Maybe it's the art, the smell or both.... the art is not particularly great but provides some visual interest nevertheless. OK for a drink or salad/sandwich but not sure about the other food they offer. Had Indonesian bakso (noodles with beef balls in a broth/soup) this time; it tasted OK, the portion was large and the ingredients seemed fresh but I didn't think that it was what you would get in Indonesia. My friend had the tuna salad, no complaints there. Pity the mall has become rather quiet with many shops closed/vacant.Show less

Author: Hayleykok
Title: Food served taste weird!!!
Review: 15 sept 2013....decided to have a late lunch here due to its impressive decoration and ambience....ordered a bowl of mushroom soup and potato leek soup each.... Taste weird and bad!!!Mushroom soup taste overly cheesy n salty while potato leek soup taste-lessLeft the cafe with dissapointment and with the two bowl of soup barely touch.Show less

Author: Loriens
Title: Tried local food
Review: Great Coffee. Food very nice.  Staff very pleasant.  A nice cool spot to stop and relax.  All foods fresh and baked at Cafe.

Author: jonotennisCheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Clean & well maintained Cafe with a good choice of 'western' food & drink
Review: The Cafe is located within a Langkawi Fair Shopping Mall, next to a Levis store and opposite an Adidas sports store. The mall also contains a McDonalds. It's approx 10 minute walk from the Jetty Point/Eagle Square. Pros:-Free WiFi - ask staff for password-Friendly staff-Clean and well-maintained premises. Attractive artwork (as the cafe name would suggest), which is all for sale, on the walls. Tiled floor. Nicely lit. -The whole mall is air-conditioned. -Menu includes soups, sandwiches, local specialities, pasta & pizza, desserts, ice cream. Beverages include coffees, teas, milk shakes, beers (Carlsberg/Tiger), fruit juices and smoothies. I had a ham, cheese salad toasted sandwich, a banana crumble and a latte. -Newspapers to read -High chair for toddlersCons:-No toilet (not unusual for Langkawi), but the nearby mall toilet is free.Show less

Author: Baskie
Title: Nice
Review: Nice place to chill. my favourite here is the vegetarian curry mee. Must try. The cappuccino & cafe latte here is heavenly.

Author: 5hams
Title: Enchiladas with beef carnitas!
Review: Food and service was great. Perhaps the band could gear their vibe and music more towards the theme of the restaurant - mariachi may be an option.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Bienricomedia
Title: Gathering night
Review: The food and the service was okay.. but the band is quite boring.. the buskers outside were way better
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: W6135UKjanes
Title: Great food
Review: Stumbled upon this restaurant. It is inside a small mall. Friendly staff, great food. Live music. We ate at this restaurant twice in one week, we enjoyed it so much!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Gurin HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not authentic Mexican
Review: Not authentic Mexican. This place is in no way Mexican or TexMex by any imagination. All the dishes were dull & tasteless. The drinks were so so and the band was tuneless - the buskers outside were way better. I think it’s best to stick to local Malaysian or Chinese while you’re in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Shnarajad_95
Title: Amazed!
Review: Food was extremely good! We ordered platter that comes with taco, quesadillas and burrito! The nachos was great! Really recommend place to chill with family and friends. The staffs are friendly !
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Vanessa751988
Title: Great Live Band
Review: Great drinks, great Party!! 🥳🥂 We spent a great evening with loads of fun 🤩 The live band was amazing and made the evening perfect!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: n0tmadn0madAmsterdam, The Netherlands

Author: antlersandstuffSittingbourne, United Kingdom
Title: Best Mexican outside of Mexico.
Review: What can I say about El Torro – this place was an absolute gem and I would eat here every week if I could. When you’re spending a couple of weeks in a place like Langkawi and looking for some of the best places to eat, you won’t be alone if your mind doesn’t immediately think ‘What I want is a good Mexican’, but you won’t regret it if you do. We were looking around one evening for something a bit different and hit upon this place almost be accident – it’s right up on top of a building down near the aquarium, accessed by a side staircase and essentially based on someone else’s roof – it shouldn’t work, but it really does. Once you’re up on the roof, the restaurant itself is across a couple of levels, with a covered deck area on the same level as the kitchen and bar and, if you go up another stair, a rooftop level above that. The views from both levels are stunning and I would highly recommend being up here at sunset. The staff were really friendly and seated us quickly, offering details of the food and drink available. Drink is simple, you can get a bucket of beers at an excellent price, but they also do a range of other options to suit all tastes. The food is absolutely to die for – the enchiladas were, hands down, the best I have ever had – covered in the most beautiful sauce that just screamed out flavour. In addition to this, we tried the tachos and the quesadilla which were also absolutely gorgeous – the ingredients were all fresh and the cooking was spot on. I understand the restaurant sources a lot of its ingredients directly from Mexico for authenticity which was very impressive. Ended up coming back to this place three times over the course of a couple of weeks, mixing up different items to try and sample them all – truly stunning food!Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: MichelleS9742
Title: Mexilicious 👌🏼
Review: We sat at a table with a great view to watch the Sunset.El Toro has a small menu, but with very good choices - we ordered homemade nachos with salsa, the combo plattern with tacos, burrito and quesadillas and the enchiladas - food tasted delicious!!!! And its the perfect alternative to all the malaysian street Food!Very good and friendly service - we will definately come again!!Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Julie GSydney, Australia
Title: Drinks A Ripoff
Review: Went to El Toro for some drinks and Nachos. They had no Nachos left. Ordered 2 Margaritas and 1 Mojito. There was NO Alcohol in these drinks. We could not even drink the Mojito it was so bad. Pity as this place could be great. So disappointed. Don’t bother going here.Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: sirisweetcorn
Title: Nice little party!
Review: I had a night out with friends to see the sunset and have a few drinks! The service was great and the bartender kept the place open longer than usual, just for us. Really great service!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: n0tmadn0madAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Best tacos in Asia!
