Review: Came by to this hidden gem at Cenang beach and was positively surprised by the taste of the food. Normally I dont expect much from Mexican restaurants in Asia but this one really had the flavors. I was talking with the chef briefly and he told me that they import chiles from Mexico and use them to marinate the meats and for their home made salsas.Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: 33carlos33
Title: my second home
Review: so nice i call this place my second home in Langkawi. Gorgeous view, fun staff and delicious food and drinks 🤤🤤🤤
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: mariiversen
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Super drinks and good food. Staff is super friendly and great atmosphere. Will definetly come again.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: MiniMac FGrimstad, Norway
Review: AWESOME food..really good. For 50 myr you get a tray with little of everything and it'seems enough for 2 people. The drinks are amazing tooffers!! they got really good drinks, milkshake cocktails etc. Loved it. You can smoke there too because it's on a roof top. Really cool and chill place. The staff are really polite and nice. Loved this place!!Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: emiliemagn
Title: Good food and nice atmosphere
Review: Good and cheap food and drinks. Nice staff and atmosphere with nice view. Would definitely come back.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Yellow_GumbootsMudgee, Australia
Title: Best tacos on earth!
Review: Okay so I haven’t been to Mexico but the tacos at El Toro topped absolutely every taco I’ve had in Australia. The spot is really nice (up a bunch of stairs but so worth it) and would be a great spot for sunset.The service is great, staff are all very nice and the owner came and had a chat to us after our meal which was really good. Great attention to detail with staff pre-setting you with cutlery according to what you have ordered.We had beef and chicken tacos, chicken quesadilla, and the enchilladas. Then went back for more tacos! Everything was great but would 100% recommend the chicken tacos!!! We’ll be back tomorrow for 4 chicken tacos and 4 beef tacos!Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Lostsoulpe
Title: Very slow service
Review: Bad service.We had to wait for one whole hour to get our food.very disappointed, otherwise food was okay.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Camper63112484883
Title: Well worth it.
Review: If you're wondering whether it's worth the walk up the bizarrely-small steps...it is. Simple menu of classic Mexican options, cooked well, presented nicely, and priced very reasonably.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: annahE6800UFGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service and nachos
Review: We went there only a couple days after it had opened. The service was excellent, the waiter was really nice and helpful and seemed like a really nice person. Sadly we didn’t get any dinner as the restaurant was not fully open yet, but the home made nachos were great! We were on the roof and would recommend to go there to look at the sunset. Show less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Indira V
Title: I’ll be back!
Review: So impressed with this place, super hard to find a place with such a nice atmosphere and amazing food to go with it. Been here for drinks and dinner, the cocktails were amazing and everything is great value. Would highly recommend this place!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: PalaceChrisBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Genuine Mexican in island of fakes
Review: We found this by chance and at first were suspicious as a number of close by "Mexicans" also offered Italian, Malaysian and Thai food from the same kitchen. El Toro keeps it nice and simple with quesadillas, tacos and burritos. We had a plate made up our all three and it was excellent. It was also insanely good value. 99 MYR for the sharing platter, a beer and three double G&Ts. It's only just opened so quiet for now but I can see it really kicking off in the futureShow less
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Ingvar J
Title: Mexican Fiesta
Review: Brilliant experience, delicious food, and amazing drinks. Could not ask for a better beginning of my Langkawi stay, will be coming here every evening!!!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: 717rashaa
Title: Nice view
Review: Very good  margarita and amazing view .but food was  average  i craved tacos but it was below average .recomonded for a sunset drink   .
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Tori T
Title: Hidden Gem !
Review:
Delicious food, friendly staff and perfect spot to watch the sunset. 
Highly recommend! 
Love the cute little cactus glasses🌵
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: sirisweetcorn
Title: Hidden place for Mexican foodies
Review: I have been here for so many times and I love it.It is a small restaurant, hidden on the rooftop with delicious RM5 taco Yummm!!!! 🌮🌮🌮
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: 401Ne-d
Title: Soup is good
Review: This place is new place in the place of old, by the sea. Waiter was rude and too interrupting. Soup good.

Author: ExpatAussie26-07
Title: Great bar / restaurant
Review: Awesome bar, looking out to the beach. Really great food, drinks and service. Loved it so much we went twice. Really easy walk from our resort at Pelangi Beach Resort & Spa!

Author: goh890
Title: New Thirstday isn’t as good as the old.
Review: Prefer the old Thirstday with cozy design. Food is the same which is average. Service is good. Try the tomyam.

Author: ChattyPeaDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Perfect for sunset drinks.
Review: Perfect for sunset drinks. Service is excellent although we ordered mojitos, the first order was excellent the second was different with the first one, watered down too. Bars should keep a cheat sheet for their bartenders so the drinks are consistent. The calamari were awesome though and the ambience made up for it.Show less

Author: hawaazman132
Title: Good place good service
Review: Good place to hangout in Pantai Chenang. Very chilling and relaxing! Good hospitality tho not so cheap! They played 90’s music and it reminds u of good old days especially in this pandemic time. We had our times and we will come again definitely.

Author: JAMSTERLeeds
Title: Good spot for a drink and watching sunset
Review: Lovely spot for a drink and watching the sunset. Drinks are ok and not too expensive, service a little slow at times but everything else was good.

Author: industrial-gypsie
Title: Sundowners
Review: Nice place to sit and watch the sun go down, no happy hour I recall but prices ok music ok, and good food.

Author: roryjdoyle
Title: Overpriced
Review: Pleasant interior restaurant. Could do with some steam fans for the outdoors tables. Not a big variety of food. Pasta very oily and heavy. KL prices rather than Langkawi prices.

Author: willkucia
Title: Good food and drink
Review: Food was really good. Surprised as it looked more like a bar however the food is really great. Would highly recommend.

Author: BHoody
Title: Lovely bar and restaurant
Review:
Lovely bar amd restaurant on the beach
kid friendly staff really nice and food was amazing.
All SOP being followed and was very clean inside a definate if staying in Langkawi.
We ate here every night. Hope to be back soon

Author: cheeyongl2020
Title: Thirstday bar and restaurant
Review: Thirstday bar is resume back to operation! I visited twice last week, the atmosphere there is still warm and friendly especially the very nice sunset view with some alcoholic and the very delicious highly recommended "fried calamari" and spaghetti seafood. Do visit them if you are looking for a place to chills on with your friend or families, you will not regret .Show less

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent for sundowners!
Review: Thirstday occupy an excellent spot on Cenang beach.They've got every element right though.Cold beer. Excellent cocktails. Great food. Outstanding location. They also create a chilled atmosphere with some banging tunes. Service is top notch. At one stage a bit too much... 3 staff asking us if we want another drink within 2 minutes. No, credit to this bar. Provides everything you would want for some early evening drinks whilst the sun sets.Show less

Author: Caryn CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: They’re reopened!!
Review: Love this place. They’re reopened after a fire. Food is delicious. We ate there on our first night and just had to go back again before we left Langkawi. Staffs are very friendly too. The sunset view while having our dinner just took our breath away.Show less

Author: Pioneer415045
Title: Best Bar and Restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Thirstday never disappoints. Great thin crust pizza Excellent drinks. Beer is kept cold with their signature Thirstday “keep cold” bucket. Works well especially when it’s a hot day by the beach. Best time to go is 6pm. Then you can view one of the most beautiful sunsets ever over the next 2 hours. Thirstday is the best.Show less

Author: StuzukiLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Gutted to confirm closed
Review: Here now and place had been burnt down but work is underway to rebuild. Feel very sorry for those that owned and worked here as such a great place. Good luck for the future reopening Thirstday bar. Sadly missed at mo especially the ice cold Guiness. Show less

Author: 950mikaelan
Title: This place is burnt down now.
Review: This place is burnt down now. Apparently it burnt a month ago. 😢 don’t know when or if it will be built up again..

Author: freyadevlinAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Perfect, just perfect!
Review: I've been in Langkawi for a week with my family and we end up at this restaurant for 3rd times in a row! The food is so yummy and the cocktails is so nice. We spent rest of our evening enjoyed our dinner and watch the live band. Good song selection and I love it, especially the drummer. We had a chance talk to him and he's so nice to us. Besides, he's very talented and adorable, to be honest!Definitely will come again.Terima kasih!Show less

Author: georgetaxi
Title: Great drinks amazing sunsets
Review: A great bar and restaurant with a good choice of cocktails and cold beers with the huge added bonus of being on the beach and watching the stunning sunsets

Author: shrill
Title: Great steak
Review:
We ate here several times whilst staying at Pelangi Beach Hotel.
The food was always good quality and well cooked. We tried, fish,pasta pizza and some excellent steak.Loved the beer in its own ice bucket.

Author: 39delphi
Title: Watch The Sun Go Down
Review: A great bar and restaurant where you can watch the sun go down whilst sipping cocktails. The seafood plate and seafood pizzas are highly recommended.

Author: flattopsteve
Title: Consistent quality drinks
Review: Consistent quality drinks and stays open quite late. Fairly loud music but that just adds to the party atmosphere. Right on the beach

Author: 118chan118
Title: The restaurant is just beside the beach
Review: I enjoyed the sunset during my visit. Food is western style. The drink is cheaper as duty free state. No tax at all. Don't take ur meal near the exist as people will smoke there and you will smell it.The staffs are friendly, the toilet is clean, the food is okay. Overall I enjoyed that day I visited Langkawi.I spent RM 120 + RM10 tips for the dinner.Show less

Author: HeidySoCool
Title: Burned down 😔
Review: We went there because of the great reviews but to our dismay it’s burned down. Hope they open it again

Author: C1086VGandreww
Title: This place burned down 3 days
Review: This place burned down 3 days ago- the guy in the restaurant in front of it showed me a video of it in flames....

Author: lilblackdogSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Best drinks in Langkawi
Review: You have to walk through Orkid ria to get to this somewhat hidden pub, but it is definitely worth finding it. The best Bloody Mary and nachos I ever had. Beautiful beachfront place. I visited alone and didn’t find myself out of place. Staff were friendly and attentive. Live band was playing when I was there.Show less

Author: grisa300
Title: Nice place next to beach
Review: We did ate here in the sunset. Nice place, if you come from the street its pretty hard to find because of the street renovating. If you have bigger group, recommend you to come earlier.. there was six of us and we arrived 7:00PM and afrer one hour hole place was full! Food was good, staff was friendly but maybe a bit lost, too much people trying to do the same thing. We were happy that they were also serving red wine! Portions were maybe a bit small, but luckily we did have appertizers also. Pizza and seabass was delicious! Also maybe a bit higher prices, but not too expensive still.Show less

Author: emmmdeeee
Title: Beachfront - great location!
Review: I visited this establishment with my husband based on a recommendation from a local. Service was excellent. Very affordable. Loved how they served the beers to keep them cold. Great view of the sunset. Food lovely.

Author: RoyStormerGuangzhou, China
Title: Drinks, food, beach!
Review: We came here twice, once for drinks and another time for dinner. They have good cocktails and the pasta was nice as well. The satay was tasty and the pizza was decent. The lack of pork pepperoni really hurts them, but can't take points off for that. You get a nice view of the beach and sunset so it's a cool place to get a bite, drink, and take in some scenery. Show less

Author: Cameron C
Title: Great Food, great location.. and the drinks are good too, What's not to like
Review: This is a great beach bar/ restaurant with a view to die for. A great place to have a few drinks and watch the sun go down.

Author: Hilde EWestern Norway, Norway
Title: No better place to eat, drink
Review: No better place to eat, drink and enjoy the evening while at Langkawi Osman and the rest of the staff are excellent, service minded and genuine interested in your wellbeeing! Food is not typical Malaysian, but still, excellent! Live soft music every evening Thank U for the 5 evenings we have spent at Thirsday, well never forget! Loooking forward to one last evening there on saturday Show less

Author: G4350IUmelanieh
Title: Good cocktails
Review: We enjoyed some cocktails and satay here. Satay was expensive but good. Cocktails and the kids mocktails were lovely!

Author: Sasha S
Title: Great Food
Review: Good service and great food for a reasonable price. Ate Fillet Mignon and Satay 😁 both tasty. Nice position looking out to sea with music and clean loos!

Author: monaj956
Title: A really nice place!
Review: A really nice place - good drinks, good service, nice atmosphere, good live music.. we went there few times as the place was that nice.

Author: JLeong1965
Title: Awesome dining
Review: Fantastic ambiance and food is good. Service is professional, friendly  and prompt. Had a wonderful sunset dinner

Author: georgeew1994
Title: Brilliant cocktails!
Review: Lovely bar watching the sunset, great staff, great cocktails for a great price! Would recommend a Long Island ice tea and mojitos!

Author: Clearyhh
Title: Lively spot
Review: Great bar and restaurant well situated in pantai cenang.  Great selection on menu to choose from.  Worth a visit.

Author: 725mariahi
Title: Another awesome sunset..
Review:
Just to chill out for drinks and sunset of course..
The place gets packed...so be there early to get the best seat for your sunset. There's music and live band too..

Author: josiemills73
Title: Fantastic food and cocktails
Review:
Fantastic food and cocktails 
We popped in for a quick drink and ended up staying for three hours! Beautiful sunset, squeaky clean toilets, delicious food, helpful friendly staff, gorgeous cocktails.

Author: NtBaskaran
Title: Amazing sunset view
Review: My family celebrated our mom's 70th birthday here. The food was tasty. The sunset was amazing from where we we sitting. Although It was crowded but the staffs can handle it. Food and drinks was served fast.

Author: Guiness1307
Title: An awesome place to catch the sunset
Review:
An awesome place to catch some
Good vibes and great drinks and the food is amazing.

So not miss the sunset here

Author: ShrutiN79
Title: Best in cenang
Review: Live band,beer,cocktails and food.Band could take fewer breaks.Table seating and barstools. No band on sundays.

Author: Coolshanks
Title: Trip with Andy Family
Review: Good locatin. Right beside Pantai Cenang beach. Open aia concept. Kids friendly. Very reasonable bottle prices..

Author: Vacation825132
Title: Nice atmosphere!
Review: First time visiting the restaurant and my first impression was this restaurant attracts foreigner especially bcoz of the atmosphere and the western food.If can sit facing the sea it would be much more better view for us.Pricing is higher than other bar there. It could be described high class restaurant.Food is quite nice.Suitable for couples for enjoying the romantic dinner there.Show less

Author: travelqueenrednazeing
Title: Great Food - intimidating staff
Review: Great location and great menu however the staff need to be less in your face. From the moment you are handed the menu you are asked what you want to order they don’t give you a second, we asked for 5 mins and within one minute another waiter comes and asks the same and this is repeated again and again. In the end we said please leave us alone and let us look. It was crazy, they all have ear pieces in and it’s as if they are being told by someone watching on a camera to get the order. So management take note the food is great, the setting is great but the staff need to back off. Give each member a few tables to look after so they can understand what the client wants which in our case was just a few minutes.Show less

Author: Amylogue12
Title: Great view  and good times
Review: It’s right on the beach so it’s an amazing view. We had drinks and food there and it was all really good! The staff are very friendly also. Would highly recommend for a drink or even dinner to watch the sunset.

Author: I5964CFjeanm
Title: Really cold beer!!
Review: Great spot! On the beach. Sunset views! Just had beer and appetizer this time! Will definitely be coming back. Menu selection looked very good! Loved the way they bring your beer in its own ice bucket!

Author: 668ren_evRome, Italy
Title: We loved everything!
Review: The food is amazing and very reasonable prices! We had the filet mignon, chicken, pasta and pizza.(2 different nights) And for dessert we tried the Apple tart and the crème brulee. It taste so good!And the view is amazing!Oh, and they serve really good cocktails aswell! Definitly a place to visit when in Langkawi! Show less

Author: alexandrakategarlandLondon, United Kingdom
Title: This place has lovely views
Review: This place has lovely views over the beach, especially for sunset - a great place to enjoy a drink! The staff were really friendly and service was good. We also stayed for food which was really good! I had the vegetarian linguine which was very tasty, and shared some bruschetta - also very good!Show less

Author: israasamir44
Title: Western Food!! YYYAAYYYY!!
Review: If you are not a malaysia cuisine fan like me, this will be your perfect place to have lunch or dinner in Langkawi. The place is clean, their music is cool and the staff is very friendly.

Author: Naro1982
Title: Attentive and smiling staff
Review: Attentive and smiling staff. Good atmosphere with live music. Nice location in front of the beach. Western food (mainly) but pretty tasty (try the spicy wedge potatoes). Beer service with ice bucket to keep it cold

Author: Citygal12456
Title: Nice location
Review: It is a nice bar by the beach. Food is okay. Their drinks are good. Annoying that staff are constantly talking loud to each other.

Author: jtserio1971
Title: Good drinks, great atmosphere
Review: A great little place for food and drink on the beach.  It is VERY hard to find (you have to walk through a seafood restaurant to get to it) but it's worth looking for.  Great service, cold drinks, affordable food and a killer sunset!

Author: Geordieboy88Linslade, United Kingdom
Title: Great music and drinks
Review: We went here a couple of times, all though only ate here once.The food and service was good, but the place itself is excellent. Right on the beach front so having cold beers, wine or cocktails overlooking the beach is really cool.And both times we went, the live bands were superb. Just a really nice place to relax and enjoy, with friendly and quick service from the staff...Show less

Author: cheryld271
Title: Friendly staff, really quick
Review: Friendly staff, really quick service, they are constantly walking around clearing your empties and offering more if you want. The piazza is really good, beers and cocktails are also good. Love band turned a quick drink and bite to eat into a really great evening.

Author: mcnamee11Oxford, United Kingdom
Title: sunset
Review: perfect location to view magnificent sunsets, excellent menus for food & drinks, live music every night, food was delicious. i came here 4 nights in a row perfect every night except for occasional rain, Zairi is my friend there perfect host to one of the best bars in langkawi.Show less

Author: Picster73
Title: Perfect
Review: Ant restaurant that served a Heineken in a small bucket of ice is DEFINITELY paying attention to the details.  A great Filet Mignon with a mushroom sauce to make your toes curl! And the perfect beach setting.  Definitely 5 stars!

Author: but-first-we-eat
Title: On the beach
Review: Came here after dinner on a Friday night, great vibe and friendly staff. Live band offering a good atmosphere for a drink and dessert. Right on the water.

Author: Izfredrick
Title: Superb Beach bar
Review: Top bar in cenang beach. A cocktail with foods and sunset at Thirstday bar was superb. They also got a band and shisha nearby.

Author: oadeba
Title: Business Dinner for 8 by the sea
Review:
The food, (crab, prawns, fish, rice and noodles) the service, the location, wow!!!
I enjoyed every minute spent there. Will be back.

Author: Catherine B
Title: Good spot
Review: In the quieter end of Cenang beach which is great, perfect spot to watch the sunset. Loved the beer coolers and pizza :D

Author: amandaanneB
Title: Good
Review: Good location by the beach. Good music,cheap beer,tasty food but cocktail is not up to standard (average)

Author: TwinTwistersLenzBengaluru, India
Title: A dream cafe on the beach!
Review: Please explore the beach first. This place is a very nice place to be in the evening. They serve late night upto 11.30 PM. The candle lit dinner with great music with make you evening a romantic one. This an upscale bar so prices a slightly on the higher side but its a must visit place.Show less

Author: jenscwernerMarkt Schwaben, Germany
Title: Fresh and young Beach Restaurant
Review: There are plenty of bars at the Cenang Beach (Pantai Cenang), some of which are more authentic than “Thirstday”. This Beach Restaurant got more food variety (not great but decent quality), and offers various drinks including some decent wines (due to Langkawi’s tax privilege not as expensive as in Malaysia mainland). Show less

Author: 910marielleh
Title: Good location, mediocre food
Review: To sit right at the beach, enjoy a beautiful sunset with a drink of choice in your hand, what could be better?This is what you'll find at this place. Excellent service and very helpful staff adds to the experience. But the food. Quite expensive and nothing special very plain. Not particularly bad but I was expecting more for the price.So all in all, I would recommend a drink or two here, but go somewhere else to eat! Show less

Author: Annabel H
Title: Great food, views and atmosphere
Review: We went here on our last night in Langkawi and it was amazing. We were seated with an amazing view of the sunset. The food was outstanding, it wasn’t traditional malay food but the quality of everything was very yummy. The staff were very friendly and when it started to rain they gladly moved us to a table under shelter. The drinks were very delicious as well. Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to watch the sun go down on the beach while having a bite to eatShow less

Author: TimH-UK
Title: Great food great atmosphere
Review:
Arrived just before kitchen was due to close, no problem for them they made me aware that needed to order food first and then organise drink but not rushed and service was great

Would recommend the stuffed chicken, live music and great location

Author: 456emmadCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect👍🏻
Review: What were we to do ? 2 welsh people looking for a great location to watch Wales v Australia in the rugby World Cup????Then we found it!!! A great location and great staff more than happy to search for the right T.V. Channel, they even pulled a table and 2 stools up in front of the screen and cheered Wales on with us Needless to say after some cold beers and Guinness we needed some food and weren’t disappointed by the quality and more importantly the quantity. Great place to watch the sunset with a laid back vibe and cafe style music as the day endsShow less

Author: Ferenerie
Title: Great!
Review: Great Places to chill out with friend & family... The Bar is placed along the Cenang Beach.If you going on dinner time or late evening is recommend to ring for a reservation due is almost full occupy on weekends.Food was nice in fusion style ... yum!Show less

Author: Chriselle BMumbai, India
Title: Great Bar with a view
Review: This bar was right on the beach and hence would be excellent for the location. The food was western but decent and so were the cocktails. We had the Singapore slings that were decent. Would definitely reccommend it for the location and the laidback beach vibe and service!Show less

Author: Aleina T
Title: Cool
Review: Not tried the food there, only cocktails. They were pretty good but not perfect. We had wiew right to the beach. More western people there than anywhere else we've been. Will go again.

Author: JosephWT78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Every little ting is gonna be alright
Review: Cool bar/restaurant right on the beach in pentai cenang. Service was excellent, we were there for a good 4 hours and we were so impressed. They bring little ice buckets for each beer, great touch. There was a live band on who did some bangin covers of oasis, Bob Marley, G n R and everything in between. Food was not quite 5* but was still pretty good, plenty for veggies too.Show less

Author: joby69
Title: Great view, food and Singapore Slings
Review: Great vibe and view.  Nice mix of people and tables.  On the beach.  Great selection of food and drinks.  Brilliant Singapore Slings and food was plentiful and great quality

Author: PhysicalDaveAbbots langley
Title: Great bar in Patnai Cenang
Review: We stayed in the north of Langkawi and got a taxi into Cenang on Saturday 31/8/19, as we knew it would be lively on a Saturday night, coupled with Islamic new year and Malaysian Independence Day. The town was buzzing, very friendly everywhere and a great night out.We spent a couple of hours at Thirstday bar until about 1am. Bar staff were great, drinks were reasonably priced and the band were superb.Loved their renditions of Muse, Radiohead and Oasis.Met Brandon and his big bunch of fun Swedish mates too.Recommended for a fun and friendly bar, welcoming all ages.Show less

Author: IreneI450
Title: Worth to recommend
Review: Good choice ! The environment and atmosphere are good , price not too high , staff are friendly, live band also is a plus, worth to go.

Author: maureencym77Dhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Good Food, Good Drinks, Good Music, Good View
Review: I would call it one of the greatest places for some chill in Langkawi. Great ambience, well-behaved staff and sea breeze to enjoy your food and drink. On crowdy days, the service is quite slow but still we couldn't resist visiting it a couple of times.Show less

Author: Nadia PFerndown, United Kingdom
Title: Don't get the hype? Greasy & dry.
Review: Good points first... the view is beautiful and the bar looks good and modern. Live music goes down well. Staff were smiling.Bad points... We wanted to enjoy our last night in Langkawi somewhere with great reviews so we could have a special final meal. This place seemed a winner. We arrived early, 6ish, and ordered chicken satay, chicken wings, fries and wedges. The portion sizes were big, we could easily have shared the fries/wedges if we'd known, but the quality was poor. There was no way the chicken satay was cooked fresh for us, it was dry and very hard to get off the sticks, even with our teeth. None of the food was piping hot when it came out which confirmed this to us. The wedges were greasy, we both really needed to wash our hands afterwards. The food also comes out with clingfilm wrap all over it which the staff have to take time carefully unwrapping. We were suspicious of the reason for this - never seen that before!! Also, at a time when the world is reducing its use of single use plastic, we did not think this was good to see unless there was a justifiable excuse. All in all, a huge disappointment on our last night.Show less

Author: sallysouthofriverLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing- food, cocktails
Review: This place is awesome- lovely menu (of western food only really) but it’s totally delicious. Big portions. The spicy wedges are seriously nice. Cocktails brilliant & beer served in its own ice bucket. Staff are lovely. Right by beach & often live music. It’s a Langkawi must visit. Show less

Author: jcjy77
Title: Nice place to chill out
Review: We only stopped by for drinks and dessert since this is said to be one of the happening places now. It is a nice place to chill out. It's just next to the beach, nice breeze, TVs to watch some live sports events and the band here is quite good too (for Langkawi standard). This place is just behind Orkid Ria Seafood Restaurant and apparently under the same owner, so I guess the food should be good. Would recommend this place to friends looking for a nice place with nice music to hang out.Show less

Author: R1865ZJjuliaw
Title: Awesome ... views, staff and food
Review: Really enjoyed a few nights here, the staff go out of their way to help you, the views are stunning and the food is excellent ... a must if you are in this area

Author: cofycofySubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Don’t go for the food , extremely slow service
Review: It was the last day in Langkawi for me and family , the experience here pretty much ruined half of it. Do go for the drinks and view, but as for the food, We waited for 1 and a half hours , our food wasn’t even served completely, we then decided to just cancel it and leave the restaurant. We ordered the food around 750pm, by 930pm we left with an empty stomach. Show less

Author: jenniferbailey1Chester, United Kingdom
Title: Wow - my favourite meals in Langkawi!
Review: This place serves THE BEST food. My partner and I actually ate here twice because it was so good!!The chicken satay skewers are to die for and you get a generous portion. The steak is spot on. Prawns also good. The second time we went was for a quick pizza before we caught a flight back to KL. We have never had pizza like it. My boyfriend ordered Margherita which he demolished! I ordered the Satay Pizza which I was dubious about but it was absolutely delicious and a complete game changer. The pizza dough is very light, thin and crispy. I have never eaten a whole pizza but this was completely gone within 10 minutes. The location of the restaurant is fab - right on the beach. The staff were very helpful and quick to respond with menus / drinks etc. The only downside is that they didn't open at lunchtime (we were there in July - maybe they do open at lunch time in the busier season). If we ever come back to Langkawi we will most definitely return to here!!Show less

Author: 647AlanMNew York City, New York
Title: The best little beach bar in Chenang
Review: Breathtaking sunsets, friendly staff, good drinks and ice cold beer. The place can get busy so be nice to them if the kitchen takes a while. On a quieter day, though, they are sometimes willing to bring seafood through from their partner outlet next door, Orkid Ria. A welcome supplement to their predominantly bar food menu.Don’t miss this place.Show less

Author: Scottishswimy
Title: Great bar for cocktails after sunset
Review: We made Thirstday a regular stop on the walk back to our hotel after dinner.  The location, staff and drinks were all great.  A perfect end to some great nights out in Pantai Cenang.

Author: 560mattLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome family bar ..!!!
Review: Hey guys,My first visit to Langkawi after many years in Thailand..!!!What a place...!!!Thirst day bar is amazing...!!!What fantastic staff...Super friendly,After the first night,Staff knew what we were drinking ,And would bring them to the table before we asked , Alongside a bowl of olives..!!! Which they knew I loved...!!!As for the band..!!!Legendary..!!!These guys need to be signed to a record label...Again , as we walked in, they would sing our favourite songs...!!!For me , you couldn’t top this place...!!!Everything about this place is perfect...The staff, the live band, the food , the setting,Is beyond expectations...!!!Only thing I ask is name of the live band,So I can see if they have a cd to buy..!!!You made my holiday guys...Love you all ...xxShow less

Author: deziren1980Armstrong Creek, Australia
Title: Brilliant Beer Garden
Review: Loved the look of the place when walking past - it wouldn't be out of place in Port Douglas or Airlie Beach. When I ordered a pint of Tiger and it came out in it's own mini ice-bucket, I was sold. Ate here a couple of times and although expensive by Malaysian standards, the food was delicious, service was great and the whole feel of the venue was awesome.Show less

Author: redstar999
Title: Super chilled, epic vibes.. Great food!
Review:
We first came for the beer by the beach. Then came again for 'date night' and lobster..
Loved the laid back, smart casual vibes.. In house band is very good.. Fastish service. Nice lay out.. Good food.. What more can you ask for?

Author: CassiecareriMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must go to!!
Review: We came here for dinner one night. We got a table straight away despite the place being quite full already. Atmosphere is great, I loved the setting or the bar/restaurant. Menu had a variety of foods. The fettuccine need ragout was bloody good. They had live music playing and it is situated along the beach so you get great views and a lovely breeze. Would definitely go back again!Show less

Author: theboredpandaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect for a party or date
Review: Such an amazing place. Strolling for hours on Pantai Cenang beach, we spotted this place. It looked great with some terrific ambience, groovy music, and beach facing open air seating.The staff is really nice and hospitable. The food and cocktails were great and not highly expensive for such an experience.Do try this place if you happen to or plan going to Langkawi. Show less

Author: amysX1419PU
Title: Do NOT visit if solo female traveller
Review: Visited this place alone a couple of times. The bar itself is fantastic, food and drinks delicious. During small talk with one of the waiters I mentioned that I was flying out the following morning. When I arrived at the airport the next morning, he was there waiting for me and said he had been waiting there for 3 hours to see me. I was very freaked out by the whole experience and don't recommend any single females to visit as I expect this isn't the first time this particular waiter has behaved like this. Show less

Author: popeye64
Title: Good food and setting
Review: Been before so looking forward to the return. Pizza was great. Gets busy around 6pm for sunset so don't hesitate. Setting is great right on the beach always something to look at. Worth visiting.

Author: waggy21
Title: Nice views
Review: We found the food to be very good as was the service. The view over the Ocean was very nice and it had a good Atmosphere about it.

Author: Melinda H
Title: Sunset drinks and food
Review: Very cool beachfront bar with amazing views over Cenang beach to watch a beautiful sunset. Cocktails were good, beer is served very cold in a small ice bucket and the food was delicious. I had the Seabass with coconut sauce, this sauce was really delicious. Pizza was woodfired and massive.Show less

Author: Casey CNilai, Malaysia
Title: Great place for drinks n food n watching the sun set
Review: Hidden behind the row of restaurants n shops is the gem of a beach bar - Thirsday Beach Bar. You can just relax here with your favourite drink watching the sunseekers on the beach doing their thing .. paragliding, jet skiing, banana boat riding, or just sunbathing on the beautiful beach...while waiting for the sun to set yonder...reasonable pricing of drinks n food. Recommended.Show less

Author: MariaMerceraMalaysia
Title: Is just ok....not that great
Review: I order chicken chop I got KFC the black pepper sause was disgusting my friend order pizza and it was under yes was undercook! the pizza was raw!...we was sitting still finish or dinner and they start cleaning the tables and removing the little candles from the tables....I ask them to place back the candles...place ok no fan very humid sitting outside all and all 2 stars....but staff really really friendly...they just need to improve the Quality of there food...western food is not that difficult to prepare...check your food and the Quality before you sending out to the custumer...in the end I'm paying for my food.Show less

Author: pauldM4517UV
Title: Fantastic again
Review: Third time back to Langkawi and we headed straight for Thirstday bar. Great menu for drinks and food, good staff who are friendly and welcoming. Keep up good work.

Author: SerhatSozen92Rotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Drinks Okay food Nokay!
Review: Good drinks to order especially the smoothies they serve. Nice location, always busy, good overview. But the food is totally not worth it. We tried the nachos and the spagetti with chicken. I thought that they serve the nachos like the mexican, but this was just opening the chipspackage and dumped in to a plate! And the spaghetti was like a warmed up meal!Show less

Author: TracyT312
Title: Medium done came well done
Review:
Had drinks on 2 occasions..nice live band on Friday night.
Last night when for dinner..order mignon- medium but it came to be well done.. tough and dry.

Author: rebeccagray102Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: So good that we came again and ordered exactly the same dishes!
Review: My boyfriend and I spent the last two weeks travelling round Malaysia and we both agreed that this was our favourite restaurant. The food was absolutely fantastic- I mean we came twice and ordered exactly the same dishes (me: sea bass with spicy coconut sauce, him: seafood pasta and shared banana fritters for dessert, although on the second visit he got his own tirimassu). The staff were lovely and very attentive, as someone that has worked in catering since the age of 16, I'm aware that catering can be tough and often thankless (I couldn't help but notice a man two tables to my right being unnecessarily difficult). On which note I'd like to thank Saroj who was our main server on the second night who was especially lovely and friendly. It was a perfect place to watch the sunset, toilets very clean and essentially, a restaurant that I cannot fault Thoroughly reccomend! From a price point of view: 3x cocktails, 2x white wine, 1x whiskey, 2x main, 2x dessert on our second visit was £48 which I think is fantastic value for money Show less

Author: oadeba
Title: Dinner for 8
Review: Great view. Watch sunset on by the sea. Dinner excellent.  Chilli crab, Sweet and sour prawns, deep fried fish, vegetables,  chinese fried rice and Langkawi local vegetable fried rice, toped with red wine. Wao. Will definitely be back.

Author: bertieb88
Title: sunset
Review:
Great food, excellent beer in ice buckets, superb place to see the sun go down. 
Staff are brilliant, plus good toilets are always a benefit

Author: Christie D
Title: I will keep going back, great location, fantastic service and reasonably priced food
Review: Cold beers served in ice buckets, spot on service, great pizzas and other dishes at reasonable prices.A fantastic location right on the beach. especially for sunset. Great decor including palm trees and good, clean toilets

Author: lisasmithieLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The BEST pizzas, beers in ice buckets & sunsets!
Review: I absolutely LOVED this place! I went twice during my two night stay in Langkawi, I would recommend getting there for about 5pm to get a good spot for the sunset. Both occasions I ended up meeting people as the atmosphere is so great. Music is on point, love a 90s jam! The beers are served in individual ice buckets which was so good to keep it chilled. One of the Dutch owners is really lovely too and introduced me to other guests who seem to return day after day! I wish I could go again tonight!! :)Show less

Author: jaspertjee
Title: Super nice
Review: One of the only western style restaurants with a great ambiance! Food is reasonably priced and the setting is perfect!

Author: midnight-moon
Title: Surprised we like it
Review: Popped in for a drink, friendly staff and lots of tables. Started to rain so decided to stay and really enjoyed our meals. Would usually rather more authentic food when travelling but would recommend Thirstday for both drinks and food

Author: Doyouevenliftbro
Title: Fisherman’s platter for 2
Review: What a location, very nice overlooking the beach with a lit candle. The seafood was amazing and wasn’t to pricey. Service was good, nice place for a romantic dinner and a beer or 3 😎

Author: Dornehl
Title: Great steak
Review: Amazing place for its views, steak, alcohol and service. Definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended. Varied menu with decent prices.

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: Well we are very confused.
Review: Have always been a big fan of Thirstdays Bar and Restaurant. Have given several 100% reports in trip advisor...but tonight, sorry to say we are totally confused.as to where they are going.Called in for a glass or two of wine and once again enjoyed the great music...however come around 11.00pm ashtrays were handed out freely and guests were allowed to smoke .Prior to this smokers were asked to go down to a designated area and smoke on the beach.Is there a smoking ban in resturants in Langkawi or not?? Sorry if you think we sound like winging ex smokers, which is probably true but having witnessed a lung cancer death in our family we try to make the healthy option when going out socially.We did query this with staff and were told guests could smoke freely at tables once food service had finished.. Does this mean Thirstday no longer serves food after 1100 although we did see food on tables...Very disappointed Thirstdays.Show less

Author: Dannyg555Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Meals
Review: We enjoyed this restaurant on a recent visit. We were well attended to and enjoyed the ambience of a beach side restaurant. The four of us all chose differ meals and were more than happy with what was served. In fact, we thought the food was great. Moderately priced. Highly recommend this place. Show less

Author: eileen24
Title: Great cold beers and amazing sunset
Review: We had a great time at Thirstdays drinking freezing cold Beers and watching the amazing sunsets. The food was tasty and staff super friendly. We loved this place.

Author: rugrat2412
Title: Great pizza
Review: Found this place while walking along the beach, wow it is a gem.the feel of the place was great from the start, staff are great sunset views spectacular and the pizza’s the best I have had here.A must try if in Langkawi.

Author: Emily C
Title: Spot on food, service team and music
Review: Came here based on the many good reviews - and it was everything and more. Loved the way that the service team was tastefully attentive and have a strong system in place to ensure that everyone could help watch the customers tables to cut down waiting timeShow less

Author: E8263ZGpeterf
Title: Yes, yes, yes !!!!!
Review: A must try !!! If you’re a chubby traveler like me, who enjoys great food, service and genuine hospitality then add this place to your list. Not only is the location amazing, the staff are great too!! Very relaxed, chill and comfortable vibe here. Beers come in an a cool ice bucket, keeps your beer nice and cold. After 2 weeks in Malaysia, this is the best place to visit!! Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!!!!!!!Who ever the owner is - great job ! Great staff! Great food !Thanks you, thank you, thank you !!!!!!!Show less

Author: Hannah MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Staff, Lovely Food, Lovely Sunset
Review: Brilliant restaurant/bar specialising in mainly western food but all done to a high standard both taste and presentation wise! Were very accommodating when adding toppings to my tasty pizza. Myself and my two friends went here for three nights straight we enjoyed the food and appreciated the friendly staff so much. Everyone in this place seem happy also! Must go for cocktails with a lovely sunset view!Great for vegetarians with multiple dishes (pasta, pizza, spring rolls - all yummy!)No gluten-free pasta or pizza though.Would recommend to everyone!Also a cute cat nearby called Jack Sparrow that loves a cuddle!Show less

Author: Jessica S
Title: Great service, great food
Review: Everything was spot on. Fast and kind staff and very good food. If you're in Langkawi, definitely pay it a visit. Also live music and a beautiful view of the beach. 10/10 would recommend.

Author: U6648CLelaines
Title: Brilliant Cocktails
Review: We visited this bar most evenings and were greeted by the lovely staff.The cocktails were lovely and reasonably priced.The staff work very hard and are always on hand to relocate customers if there is a rain shower.We didn't eat here as we were half board, but the food looked excellent. The pizzas and pasta looked amazing.Thank you guys for looking after us!Show less

Author: martinkP4921HMCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Best bar / restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Please, of you visit Langkawi, go and enjoy the atmosphere at Thirstdays. Live music, right on the beach, great food (love the pizzas) and super kind and fun staff. I have been to this bar a number of times now and can vouch that it is super-consistent and always delivers. People go there tomorrow have fun and I know do not leave disappointed. A must when you visit Cenang / Langkawi. Show less

Author: AS71
Title: Most popular dining and late night spot
Review: Definitely the most popular live music venue in Pantai Cenang. Efficient and polite service. Good quality European food. Live music (quality of which is very much depending on the mood of the band). Must see.

Author: donliew
Title: Great Party Place
Review: The atmosphere in this place is buzzing with a live band playing when I was there on a Friday night. Drinks are expensive by Langkawi standards.

Author: pmason1974Prescot, United Kingdom
Title: Best all round bar in Pantai Cenang
Review: Went here a few times during my holiday, service is good, staff are usually straight to you to find you a table, it is very busy and your best getting their attention when you want another drink or you will wait.Ate here twice and the food was good and decent prices also.They have a live band or singer on every night, often the same band singing the same songs though so gets a bit repetitive, also they have very good and clean toilets which is not the same in every bar in Langkawi.I suggest you sit if possible at the tables which have fans above them, even though it is on the sea front there is very little wind to cool you down.Show less

Author: Barbs25Staffordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect dinner spot
Review: Stopped here for a quick drink to enjoy the sunset and stayed for a few hours in the end. Plenty of drinks choice, food too and all reasonable prices for the location. Our spot was perfect on the higher chairs facing the beach and sunset directly absolutely gorgeous. Drinks were reasonable, cocktails 22RM, spirits and mixers 15RM. Good prices for food and delicious, we both had pizza and it was one of the best I’ve had. Definitely worth a visit we’re hoping to go back later this week!Show less

Author: C5837GBpatriciah
Title: Great Bar
Review: Great place to watch the sun go down with a cool beer. The staff are great and the prices reasonable for both food and beverages

Author: Marie17979Preston, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, good feel, good location
Review: Walked along the beach from our hotel to this bar. Planned on having a snack but had a feast. Food was really good. Mainly western. Mash potato with the chicken platter was amazing. A few seats with fans above but nowhere to sit if you want to cool off but worth a visit. Show less

Author: 444kedargSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place with good music
Review: Out of all bars we loved this one the most coz of its amazing vibe and great live music ....good variety of drinks and food for everyone ...prices are bit expensive but that’s coz they maintain the standards...always buzzing more so during sun set hours ....highly recommend ...Show less

Author: 647bj_rnb
Title: Nice place good service good drinks by fair prices
Review: Perfect bar on the beach nice sundowner good drinks the staff really friendly cold beer in ice water served

Author: 574sallyanneh
Title: Great live music
Review: Great bar and live music. Food is western but good pizza, nice wine and a very chilled atmosphere. Waiters are very friendly and attentive

Author: suzy_ruckstar
Title: Beach side
Review: Great service and good cocktails.  We have had 3 dinners here in a row. Ambience is just relaxed. Ordered the basil pesto pizza a couple of times and salads. Family friendly too I highly recommend this.

Author: inspectordaybreak
Title: Fantastic food
Review: This is a lovely p,ace to either eat and drink or just drink as you watch the sun set. Lovely food, probably more expensive than usual Malaysian prices but worth it.

Author: DennisKW84Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic place to unwind
Review: Ideal location for sunset with a glass of beer before dinner. The staffs are very courteous and attentive.The food is marvellous especially the Chicken Carbonara(the sauce is rightly rich in taste) & Kings Prawn(gotta dip those fried prawns into the sauce provided) which we've ordered. Show less

Author: mikajii
Title: Nice place at the beach
Review: Directly on the beach walk. Great vibe & staff. Good drinks and pizza was also good. Come early if you want great table to enjoy drinks / dinner while watching sunset.

Author: Gordon G
Title: One of my favourite places to eat in Pantai Cenang
Review: Couple of visits this trip and as usual really enjoyed it. Good atmosphere right on the beach front. All good! Strangely toilets seem to be on a bit of a slope! Recommend Thirstdays any day! :-)

Author: Renee K
Title: Loved it
Review:
We went there for 2 out of our 5 nights in Langkawi and loved it.
The Sea Bass was gorgeous, as was the Salmon and pizzas. The cocktails were fantastic and great value. You can tell everyone loves working there.
Would definitely recommend!

Author: Rgw18762019
Title: Great location and good food.
Review: We had dinner here in our first night in the island. The location is fantastic, right on the beach. Although the price is reasonably high the quality of the food is such that coupled with the view and nice relaxed atmosphere it is well worth a visit.Show less

Author: trinhn2018Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Good dinner and had nice 🍷 wine
Review: Very nice place to enjoy with live band for music in this restaurant outside beach.we had very good wine for drinks and listen good music.so busy customer enjoy drink and sing songs with live band music.good place enjoy when you get holiday from langkawi.im love back and listen music again from Thursday bar.Show less

Author: StuzukiLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Ice cold Guinness Draft and Excellent food
Review: Nearby to our hotel and visited nearly every night of our stay. Cold beer including Guinness (at a reasonable price too) served with ice buckets to keep it cold as this great venue benefits from the tumble drier effect sea breeze. One of the few places now selling alcohol along the beach so very popular .We also ate food in the restaurant area which was of the highest quality. Will definitely visit on our next return to Langkawi. The one thing (other than the Guinness) which really makes this place is the efficiency and friendliness of the staff. they are all linked by radio earpieces and cannot do enough to help. There is also live music at night.Show less

Author: lousturmDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great bar
Review: We walked past this bar on our way back to our hotel after dinner and heard the band playing so decided to pop in for a drink - and ended up staying for 4 hours! The cocktails were lovely (and strong) and the band were great. The bar also accepts card which is helpful. Show less

Author: Bingercat
Title: Great ambience and food
Review: Love that this bar & restaurant sits right on the beach line, offering a relaxing event evening chill out spot. There’s a live band playing to different music genres; warm and friendly service; great party dining and drink options...the one place to visit in Langkawi!

Author: Andrew MSwinton, United Kingdom
Title: Great evening venue
Review: This is a great venue to sit and watch the sunset with a drink in your hand. The staff are all very friendly and give excellent service. There is a good variety of food on the menu which was very tasty. Beers wine and cocktails were all reasonably . The highlight of an evening there was the live music from a local band.Really enjoyed the ThirstdayShow less

Author: Antonia EHudiksvall, Sweden
Title: Our favorite place in Langkawi.
Review: Food , service, music and drinks are excellent. Our favorite place on Cenang Beach.The garlicbread is a must try, the meat is delicious.They serve beer in a ice bucket, and strawberry daquri is very good. Live music almost every night! Clean and nice toilets except for the big inclination on the floor haha. Show less

Author: SofC971France
Title: Excellent address for drink & dinner on the beachside !
Review: I had amazing night there ! my Margaritas was perfect, and I ordered the spaghetti Con Vongole so delicious ! with the authentic ingredients ! and the staff so friendly ***and good ambiance with a live concert !And my bill was about 16€ for 2 margaritas + my meal. Noted, if you want to pay by Debit Card, you must at least spend 50 ringgits, under by cash only.Show less

Author: Tessa DPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Right on the beach
Review: We visited this restaurant bar 3 times in total. Situation right on the beach, it has a beautiful outlook. The place was always bussing and the staff very efficient. We enjoyed the meat sharing plater, fillet steak, pasta, everything was cooked perfectly. There was no rushing you once you had finished and later in the evening there is a bank playing. Definitely a place to go too for any age.Show less

Author: Cfaiers
Title: Cool place to hang out
Review: We ate here for lunch and dinner during our stay, and enjoyed both meals very much. We had a tuna pizza and chicken Caesar salad for lunch, then the pan seared sea bass for dinner. The sea bass was to die for with the slightly spicy coconut sauce, and served with mashed potato and veg. I had the tiramisu for dessert, which was ok, but not like a traditional tiramisu. A little bit disappointing if I'm honest, however, the banana fritters were lovely. The chocolate milkshakes were also fab. Great views over the beach, especially at sunset. We found the staff efficient and friendly every time we visited. We ate thereon Sunday night when there was a saxophonist playing, who was very good. We weren't as impressed with the singer/guitarist who followed. Good toilets (it is hard to find a place with good toilets in Malaysia!). Show less

Author: Keith CCumbria, United Kingdom
Title: Great Setting
Review: A popular bar that serves pretty standard Italian style food. We ate there once and it was perfectly ok but we preferred a more ethnic choice of food when in Malaysia. Great place for a drink to watch the sunset and enjoy a beer or two in the evening.Show less

Author: Michael S
Title: Excellent service and good food, and, YESSSS, they serve alcohol here
Review: A restaurant with friendly atmosphere, really good food and drinks. You can also ask them to add alcohol to their excellent fruit drinks ;-D . Pay them a visit, have first a drink and see the sundown, and later a really good meal.

Author: iantF7178IWSturminster Marshall, United Kingdom
Title: Evening meal
Review: Food is pretty good and it's a great location, however it's not particularly cheap. They also had live music which was good. The Nacho's were weird, just a bag of Doritos essentially on a plate with a side of guecamole. The mains were much better, steak and salmon - the vegetables that came with the meal were delicious.Show less

Author: DhennverNg
Title: Nice place to chill
Review: This is a nice place to chill. The ambience and decor is good. Quiet and allows you to absorb all that is happening at pantai cenang. However, it is very pricey. The banana fritter was good. The staff has good attitude and service.

Author: Alexander GManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Decent steak
Review: Service was friendly and efficient.The cocktail my boyfriend ordered was awful and just undrinkable. I ordered a Greek salad to start with which was utterly bizarre, consisting of mixed salad leaves, soft cheese, brined olives and nachos with balsamic glaze! Fortunately the fillet steak was very tasty and well cooked. The wine was also drinkable and the view with the sunset is what makes it worth going for.Show less

Author: linda gDevon
Title: Good value for money
Review: This is a lively restaurant/bar right on the beach with a good vibe and value for money food.Food was good - we went there on our first night when we had arrived after a long flight and just wanted something quick and easy before bed - the pizza was great and the cold beer served on ice most welcomeShow less

Author: James H
Title: Great bar right on the beach
Review: Beautiful sunsets to be seen from the beach edge bar! Reasonable priced drinks and friendly staff make this an ideal spot to grab a few beers in the sun, or late into the evening

Author: 717jillianw
Title: Fabulous restaurant and bar on the beachside
Review: Had satay chicken to share to start followed by fillet steak. Very good food and friendly staff. Live music on an evening too.

Author: lynbirch
Title: GREAT LOCATION ON THE BEACH
Review: Thirstday Bar is upmarket and on the beach.  The menu is not extensive however the food is beautifully presented and tastes great.  The Cocktails are excellent.  Very enjoyable place for drinks at sunset and/or a meal.

Author: joshua_Solo
Title: Fantastic
Review: Salmon was amazing. The vibes are great and the reggae band was killin it. Right on the beach, good tile to be there to watch sunset.

Author: rothwell40Jalon, Spain
Title: Excellent!
Review: Fantastic location for watching the sunset while having a delicious cold drink. As others have mentioned the ice buckets for the beers is a simple but genius idea & much needed in this climate. My husband & I have eaten here twice so far during our stay at a nearby hotel & we thoroughly recommend the food. We’ve tried the pizzas which were great but the fillet mignon was outstanding & reasonably priced at about £12.50. Service is friendly & efficient.Show less

Author: wazurpFarnborough, United Kingdom
Title: Live Football on TV & Cold Beer
Review: What more can you ask for!This bar is on the beach & behind the main restaurant. It is buzzing at night & the staff are extremely switched on without being over attentive. They don't stand over you but as soon as you want another drink they will be there to take the order. There is a main well lit area to sit at tables to eat in groups, or alternatively a more secluded dimly lit area more suitable for couples to sit on bar stools around high tables. This area is perfect & very popular to watch the sunset. There is live premiership football on the Tv's although there is no sound on. They either have a live band performing or music playing. Drinks are reasonably priced in comparison with other bars & the food looked amazing. The glasses of beer come in an ice bucket to keep them cold.It's easily the best bar to visit in my opinion. Good value, excellent service, great atmosphere & generally a nice breeze to keep you cool.Show less

Author: VikkiC789Epsom, United Kingdom
Title: Great place
Review: Great beach bar in the evenings. Opens at 3pm.Fantastic view of sunset and the staff are very friendly and helpful. Live music every night, not so loud that it ruins your evening. Great prices for beer and spirits.We had dinner in the restaurant at on the main road which is in front of the bar and the food and service were fabulous.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Despina TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great view and service
Review: The setting of this restaurant is excellent. It is right on the beach and all the staff are extremely friendly. We had a beautiful sunset the time we visited. We ordered: Seafood Pizza, Spaghetti Carbonara, Penne with oil, parsley with garlic marinara and Seared Salmon with vegetables. All our meals were served promptly and all were delicious. Will definitely visit this restaurant again when in Langkawi.Show less

Author: 740sabimFuerteventura, Spain
Title: Cold beers !!
Review: Beautiful setting, right on the beach, staff are friendly and gets quite busy at night so theres a good atmosphere Food was wonderful and reasonably priced. As mentioned in other reviews the beer is served in it's own ice bucket so stays cold till the last mouthful . Went back twice, loved it there.Show less

Author: M8184JZlauraf
Title: Oh yes!
Review: Just superb! Visited with family. Lovely staff, good food & music. Reasonable prices, very quick service. Great atmosphere☺️

Author: Stefanie I
Title: thank you from the singapour-sling lady with his ricard man
Review:
The peoble who work their are juste amaizing. 
The drings are good the food is fine and this all on the beach.
Thank you for everything we enjoyed each time we came their.

Author: carpentariaDarwin, Australia
Title: Hard to beat for a cold beer and sunset
Review: Very professional servuce and I love the individual ice bu kets with every beer you buy - bottle, glass or handle. Right on the beach and obviously quite new. Nonetheless the prices are very reasonable by anyone's standard.If anything, there's an excess of staff walking around watching for empty plates or glasses.Perfect view of the bay.Best wishes to Harry and the other staff. Show less

Author: tang043
Title: Beach Front Beauty
Review: Visited this great bar from out cruise ship stopover. Great bar right on the beach with a fantastic choice of food and drink. Very busy at night so expect a wait for a table.

Author: HannahkatenDoha, Qatar
Title: Excellent evening meal
Review: We visited here after walking on the beach at sunset. Well decorated, nice and simple yet modern. It was quite busy but we managed to get a table at the back on the bar stools. There was plenty on the menu and we were served within a reasonable time. Food was very well presented and tasted delicious. Steak was cooked perfectly! Staff were very friendly and efficient. Thank you :)Show less

Author: W3884AUhannahbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service with live music
Review: If you want a great beach location with great food and very friendly, helpful staff for a sunset meal with a western basis then this is your place. They regularly have live music to go alongside all of this and offer mini ice buckets with drinks to keep them cool in the tropical heat. Service is quick and friendly without being overbearing and one of the few places I have experienced in Malaysia of making a point of bringing the card machine to the table.Even in a downpour what the staff manage to fit in to the smaller undercover area is an impressive feat! Show less

Author: NIKINY
Title: Sunset hot spot
Review:
Great place to see the sunset. Gets busy so get a table around 6:30. Pizza was good. Drinks and service we’re
also good.

Author: lettuces54
Title: Great beach front bar
Review: Great food. Great staff. Great location to watch the sunset. Live bands and great atmosphere. A real find. I would recommend 👍

Author: Rimpula2019
Title: Amazing Thirstday
Review: This bar/restaurant became our favorite one during our stay in Langkawi. Amazing service and food. Ordered King prawn and steak,  would really recommend!! Also many drinks to choose from, good ones. Staff is very friendly and the sunset from here is beautiful.

Author: Fjodolf1
Title: Very good food
Review: Recommended for the food and drinks. Usually very crowded during sunset. Would probably be a good idea to come after 20-20:30 if you have not reserved a table. It took quite some time for the good to artive (henve 4*, not 5)

Author: alexmZ9402FGKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What a restaurant. Couldn’t ask for more
Review: Came here for a late evening meal. There was a singer and saxophonist playing for entertainment. The food was wonderful. I ordered a rack of lamb and my girlfriend ordered coconut prawns. They were cooked to perfection. The setting is great as it is right by the sea. Will be visiting here regularly over the next week.Show less

Author: materian
Title: Superior food quality.
Review: One of the best king prawns ever! Really great. Also deserts are just delicious (try bananas with ice and burning brandy).

Author: PaulineK364
Title: Good atmosphere !
Review: Great place to watch the sun go down, good range of drinks, nice food, friendly staff , worth a visit.

Author: alltimetraveller91
Title: Wonderful food and ambience
Review: Seabass and salmon are highly recommendable to try, very flavourful food, nice ambience with live band sea view. Nothing can be better dinner in Cenang beach than this

Author: yvonnet165Sydney, Australia
Title: Great place to chill
Review: Our group of 10 dined here on our last night in Langkawi. We arrived justbefore sunset and got the best view. The food, drinks, especially thecocktails and staff and were excellent. Their meals were good sizedportions and their banana flambé was really good. Got some great photos ofthe sunset, watched a fire show that was just past the restaurant on thebeach. Show less

Author: chjahHarrogate, United Kingdom
Title: Good Bar Serving Good Food
Review: We visited this bar and restaurant several times during our stay sometimes just for a drink and other times to eat. There was always a good atmosphere and the service was good on each visit. Food was also very good the fillet steak for £13 was excellent as was the salmon dish. Beer is served in a glass with an ice bucket to keep it cool. It also accepts credit cards.We recommend this both as a bar and restaurant as it is a better than some of the other alternatives on the beach.Show less

Author: visitor150811
Title: Great for early evening drinks
Review:
We stopped by here for early evening drinks almost every evening to sit at the front and watch the sun go down, before heading off for dinner!

Very chilled atmosphere with incredibly efficient service!

Author: becksoclock
Title: Fillet Mignon Amazing
Review: Went here on our 1st night in langkawi and the food was amazing! My fillet steak £13 was cooked to perfection and my partner enjoyed her meal. Good service and great value for money would definitely recommend

Author: inbox_ali
Title: Really good vibe and food
Review: I have there few times and it’s lovely, good food, nice staff, good location, great wine list, and good music and a live band after 8pm.

Author: Tracy C
Title: Pizza on the beach
Review: Great food, perfect location, ice cold beer, great music, there is nothing not to love. Waiters are friendly and love to serve you. We sat and watched the fire show on the beach one night eating dinner.

Author: neilhassallLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beach views, big portions and ice cold beer - what's not to love?
Review: We visited for lunch during our first day at Cenang beach and we loved every minute of it - the restaurant is smack bang on the beach and you know you are onto a winner when they serve you your beer in its very own little ice bucket - we ordered a anchovy pizza and a portion of chips and both were huge (the bucket of chips alone could feed a small army). More importantly, they tasted great too. We'll definitely return to Thirstday before we leave (note it gets crazy busy at dinner so if you want to guarantee a beachside spot, consider going for lunch).Show less

Author: ACDC29
Title: Beach Side Bar with Nice Vibes
Review: On the sand, good staff, drinks and cocktails. Live music. Food is no great but not bad. Perfect place to unwind for sunset and some people watching.

Author: JoandJoe2011Allesley, United Kingdom
Title: Great good and drinks
Review: We visited twice during our week long stay. A really good atmosphere with live music playing too. One time we just did drinks and pizza the other, we did dinner. Fabulous! We did Surf and Turf platter for two. It was so good, with great sauces to compliment the dish. Not too badly priced considering the quality.Show less

Author: 822lesm
Title: Love your attention to detail!
Review: We have been to this bar a number of times and we have been impressed with what we have seen. The food is great and the service staff go out of their way to make sure customers are happy. The highlight of our many visits was the New Year's party that was held to welcome in 2019. Excellent music from the live band and DJ. Great organisation of the party in terms of security too. Keep up the great work.Show less

Author: RJCF1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Sundown Bar
Review: This is probably one of, if not the best, bars in Pantai Cenang, it is well worth the trip. You can get to it from the beach side path or walking right through Orkid Ria Seafood Restaurant, you do feel a bit self conscious walking through the restaurant but many people do it so don't hesitate.The place is busy just before sunset and then goes a little quieter once the sun has set. The staff are very keen to please and are well managed by the bar manager.The menu is not too extensive but the food we had was very good, the choice was very much Western bar meals.This place is well worth a visit, if you every wondered where the lights shining out at night then you will know once you visit this bar.The live music was good when we were there, the acts seem to change every night.Show less

Author: vitaminzee1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great live music
Review: We just drank here one evening whilst listening to an amazing singer backed up by some talented percussion players. Drinks were reasonable and I had a good espresso martini here. I didn't eat but saw people eating huge pizzas! The view is lovely, right on the beach. Can access this place from the street or beach. Show less

Author: AvisitoRinTown
Title: Up Market Bar
Review: Serving good food; vast array of drinks and cocktails. Great service and a good vibe from the live music being played. Can recommend the place for a sundowner or two.

Author: abbiechang0124Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Great place!
Review: We bought the party ticket for New Year’s Eve and it was awesome! Super helpful and friendly staffs, nice drinks and good food! We visited this place many times during our stay in Langkawi! We think it’s the best bar on the beach. Will come back again for sure! Show less

Author: TalithaMM
Title: Good for sunset, dancing and drinks
Review: Another popular place on cenang beach. The staff is super friendly, they have live music (and also live sports if they're on). Good drinks, fair prices!

Author: Jannef1
Title: Good service and excellent food
Review:
We come 21.30
It was busy but we have good service and the best food! Spaghetti with tigerprawns where delicious. 
We will be back.

Author: soeedy_74Kauniainen, Finland
Title: Excellent food and great service!
Review: Stumbled on the place after a bartender recommended it. They do not serve a lot of asian food even if there are some courses on the list. Our food was absolutely fabulous, everybody liked it (we ordered more western food after 1,5 weeks of asian). The staff is extremely helpful and effective. We will come here again before departuring from Langkawi. Thumbs up Show less

Author: Monika NAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great place!
Review: We have visited Thirstday 4 times in a week which is the best review on itself. All my friends fell in love with their pizzas, they have a great flavours like duck and mango or satay chicken, you can get traditional ones as well. Presentations of other dishes are beautiful, great selection of alcoholic beverages. Very nice live music band in the evening, cool decorations, really good vibe.Can get a little bit busy with slower service but all of the staff are super nice so they always try their best to give you the best service.Definitely must visit in when in Langkawi!Show less

Author: benjamingeorge1Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Wow
Review: What a wonderful place to go for that special occasion or even just because you can. Food and drinks menu extensive and delicious and delightfully presented. Staff very friendly and welcoming. Listen to live music and relax and take in the view and sounds of the sea. Sure to return when once tried.Show less

Author: martinkP4921HMCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Great food, grear atmosphere & great setting
Review: We've now eaten here on 3 different occasions and on different visits to Langkawi. Each time the restaurant is alive with atmosphere, the staff welcome you with smiling, happy faces and then deliver on that promise by really looking after you. Service is also swift and efficient. The food is very good, as are the cocktails, and no visit to Langkawi would be complete without enjoying an evening here. There was also love music the last time we ate there. Inafact, we are going again tonight, our last night for this trip. Highly recommended - enjoy Show less

Author: andrewgopal
Title: A Place to Chill
Review:
Nice place to chill. Beautiful sea view. Good food and drinks. Friendly staff. Price is reasonable.The place to be when in Langkawi. 
.

Author: asit20132013
Title: Superb
Review:
Just returned back from Langkawi

Awesome restaurant food service location, value for money.

Clean and tidy. Toilets could be better

Author: llinia
Title: nice place to watch the sunset
Review: very nice bar with a large cocktail menu. They also serve Western food (not Asian food) and a small bar menu. Prices are ok for this area.

Author: KrisGartner
Title: Great Bar and Restaurant
Review: Good food and a variety of cocktails at the beach. Service was excellent. Prices were adequate so definitely worth it.

Author: jenny pStockport, United Kingdom
Title: Great bar and restaurant
Review: Lovely restaurant bar overlooking the sea. Great views while eating and drinking. Food was lovely, fab spring rolls and potatoe wedges. Beer was served in a little bucket with ice.In the evening there is music and it has a lovely atmosphere . Staff were really lovely.Show less

Author: XueLi14Malaysia
Title: Bar with sunset view
Review: Come here for a sunset view. You will amaze by the sunset view. It’s a good place to chill with a beautiful sunset view. The food is good. We’ve ordered pasta, pizza. The taste is good. Nachos is recommended eat with avocado sauce is really nice. And the price is reasonableShow less

Author: Hels15
Title: Great restaurant with delicious food!
Review: Fab restaurant overlooking the beach! Delicious food at a reasonable cost. Spring rolls were amazing! Plus your beer is kept cold as served in individual buckets of ice!

Author: kvohra
Title: Best
Review: It’s is by far the best bar by the beach... very lively attractive and great seating. Food and drinks are great

Author: HeenaJain
Title: Lovely plc with food good and humble staff
Review: We visited this plc to spend some evening quality time.. They are tight in front of sea plus good food, lovely staff and great music.. We thoroughly enjoyed there 👍

Author: lavanian2014
Title: Amazing view and ambience!
Review: Nice ambience and lovely location. Chilled and good beers. Nice place to chill and relax. One of the best bars around

Author: thisguytravelsLondon, England, United Kingdom
Title: Great little spot on the beach, perfect for watching the sunset
Review: This is a great little place on the beach. (Can also walk through Orkid Restaurant from main road to get to it) Perfect for a drink watching the sunset or a casual dinner. Great list of drinks and food. Mainly western foods/snacks. They do the most amazing thin based pizza (with a super crunchy crust!) Great atmosphere, music and sports tv(although not a sports bar at all) and they have live music every night. Would definitely recommend!Show less

Author: Pinkstar000Horsham, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic location, sea views and live music and excellent food and service😊
Review: We found Thirstday by accident and went in for drinks, we were so impressed by the service and the friendly staff we decided to stay and eat there..The food was excellent we all had different dishes, the steaks were perfect and the tiger prawns were really fresh. Would not hesitate to recommend this place. Also has live music and sea views. Great evening would visit again without a doubt,Show less

Author: SER508
Title: Great place to watch the sunset
Review: Really lovely beach setting, wine was great and snacks we had were good. Did go for dinner but was very westernised bland menu so ended up going elsewhere. would recommend adding 1 or two more local dishes on top of what they already have

Author: mias207
Title: Good drinks, food and view
Review: Fantastic view and friendly staff. The drinks were very good and the food really good. Would definitely recommend this place

Author: niehonin
Title: Trendy beach bar
Review: Nice place, quite trendy. Prices are a bit higher, but you get a good service and a nice view on to the beach

Author: tonyandelaineDurban, South Africa
Title: Relaxed venue on the beach
Review: We had a light supper here & were very happy with our choices. The tuna pizza was particularly good & the beers were kept cold in individual 'ice buckets'. A nice touch! There was live entertainment, but it was pretty average, but seems to draw in customers. Show less

Author: prashantkatariabangalore
Title: Great restaurant on the Beach
