Review: read good reviews of the place and landed up around 7:30 pm. loved it so much that we stayed till closing time and didn't move (though we had planned on pub hopping)! the staff is great and they had a live band playing which was nice. the fact that this place is right on the beach added to the attraction. the drinks were good and the vegetarian food was good too!Show less

Author: 336stevenjMelbourne, Australia
Title: Storms and beer
Review: The team at Thirstday did a terrific job when the heavens opened up!Everyone was relocated under cover and served as quickly as humanly possible. We had cold beer and good cocktails with some fast pub food: spring rolls, satay, wedges and prawns.An umbrella was offered to get that to the car - nice job!Show less

Author: Logos Engineeri... A
Review: Nice place to hang out for 🍻🍹. Food are nice and the staffs are friendly. Like the environment 👍🏼👍🏼.

Author: Cromps_from_PerthPerth Hills, Australia
Title: Great Place to Watch the Sunset !
Review: This is a great place to watch the Sunset with a beer or cocktail. If you get a pint of beer they will put it in a ice jug for you to keep it cool which was a great idea! There is plenty to choose from on the menu and the prices aren't too bad. Once again the staff are great & service is quick and friendly.A must on the beach!Show less

Author: 973s_renm
Title: Nice bar
Review: Laid-back bar with live music the time I visited. Really a nice place to enjoy some music at the beach...

Author: JuddyParisPerth, Australia
Title: Fantastic. A must do beach bar. Made for sunsets with a drink
Review: This is the place to be especially in the evening. Sunsets are great. The place is very clean new and modern.Service is spot on and menu of drinks and food great. Menu is quite western orientated. Food was great tasty and quick. Live entertainment some nights. Drink menu quite expansive and everything well priced. Do yourself a favour and go. Show less

Author: G1201MJseand
Title: Thirstday Bar
Review: Lovely bar on the beech front. Good food and chilled vibe with great cocktails. Well worth a visit in Langkawi

Author: Kempston_MillKempston, United Kingdom
Title: Good pizza and attentive staff
Review: Great close to beach location, and the staff are keen to meet your needs for drinks and food.Pizza was pretty good and the 1litre beers were a welcome change from the smaller measures elsewhereBest bit is the view and at sunset it is something else so bring your camera Show less

Author: p_cl7
Title: Best Bar in JP Cenang
Review:
Really rate this place.
The Food and Drinks well priced.
Good quality food with excellent service.
Wide range of cold beers and cocktails.
The band are very good as is service.
This is our local for a week....

Author: alexchandran84
Title: Awesome environment
Review: Attentive staff and great service. Awesome for sunset cocktails and dinner. Will definitely visit again

Author: thimokasper
Title: Delicious food
Review: Very good food and view! Prices are not cheap but okay! In particular, the fettucine Carbonara were great

Author: leanne051019Hong Kong, China
Title: Friendly staff, good food
Review: My steak was good but not the sauce. Spaghetti tasted fine but just in warm. The duck pizza was the best. All waiting staff gave us full attention but a bit much. They took every single dish away once we took the last piece of food. Show less

Author: j0n0339Barnoldswick, United Kingdom
Title: The only place to go.
Review: We were in Langkawi for 9 nights and came here every one of them as it's that good.Perfect location,brilliant friendly staff,great food and drinks,mostly good music in the background and clean toilets.By far the best place at that end of Cenang beach.Give it a try,you won't be disappointed.Show less

Author: Alan_Bligh
Title: Nice spot in Chenang beach
Review: Nice place to hang out for drinks on Chenang beach. Friendly staff too. Deco also simple and nice. Definitely come back again

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Most enjoyable seaside bar, Restaurant & Music.
Review: Langkawi has many beaches and even more fine and fun bars and restaurants. This is restaurant/bar is rated ( by travellers) #1 on the most popular beach... and awarded TripAdvisor's "Certificate of Excellence". The restaurant menu is also "Vegan/Vegetarian friendly". The bar is also a great place to enjoy the very memorable sunsets. In addition to their kitchen, one can order from the adjoining very popular "Orkid Ria Seafood restaurant". The music also adds to the laid back atmosphere and beach side ambience.I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: LisaClareS
Title: Perfect
Review: Awesome beach bar and restaurant. We’ll be back thanks! Right on the beach with chilled live music. Great cocktails, food and service. Love the high bar stools and tables and the greenery.

Author: 751carolinel
Title: Great location and great food
Review: Welcoming and friendly staff. Good food and drink. Great location overlooking beach. Great place to watch the sunset

Author: Escape83102
Title: Best sundowner bar
Review: The owner has nailed it! Fantastic beach setting, well trained staff en beautiful food presentation. So glad we didnt miss this place!

Author: scmk3000Littlemore, United Kingdom
Title: My favourite hangout in Cenang
Review: Been back for dinner three times (out of 6 nights) that’s how good we think this place is.It’s right on the beach and the staff is friendly. The FOOD is very very good and is of great quality. Most meat from Australia and price tag is quite reasonable. Highly recommended for all occasions.Show less

Author: Adrian H
Title: Best location with cold beer
Review:
Great location along cenang beach 
Beer served in ice bucket so it never gets hot 
Great food and friendly staff

Author: langkawiboddam
Title: Mr & Mrs Gray
Review: We were there for two weeks enjoying so much,food was delicious . staff is helpful & pleasant. Service is good. Thirsday  open at 4pm to 1am .

Author: Nick C
Title: Dinner & Sunset
Review:
Had 2 great visits to this restaurants which has a fantastic view of the sunset! Great meals a little on the pricey side but good!
One of the best restaurants during our holiday!

Author: Mamun KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Thirsty for more
Review: During our 6 nights’ stay at Langkawi we visited this restaurant twice, once for lunch and once for dinner. I have to admit this place is really cool, it’s on the beach and great to dine at with the sunset view. The music is just right mainly slow jams. They have a lot of staff who were all skilled and I was pleasantly surprised at how clean their toilets were.Wife and I got nachos, chips, tomato bruschetta, veg linguine and chicken aioli spaghetti. Both times the food was all fantastic, the chicken aioli was one of the best Italian dishes I ever had. Their mock tails are nice too, especially the Pina Colada.If you are down Langkawi I would recommend to give this place a visit for dinner for sure, get there early as it gets quite packed.Show less

Author: sneha0202Hyderabad, India
Title: Fine dine in langkawi
Review: A great place by the beach with even better food and service. Do try the pasta, the grilled veg and the pizza. Liquor is expensive given langkawi is duty free and you get the same drinks way cheaper in the stores. But all in all the overall experience is greatShow less

Author: marycK3413VDCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Just ok
Review: A busy bar on the beach, just behind the Orchid Ria. We went there twice and thought it was just ok. Nothing special about it but it is obviously popular with tourists. The food looked ok, but saw quite a few unfinished meals. Just didn’t do it for us.Show less

Author: SetchielEdmonton, Canada
Title: Done right!
Review: Where do I begin? Seated quickly by English speaking staff. Drinks on the table, served in ice in under two minutes. Food was on our table, served all together in under 10 minutes and it tasted and was presented very well. Atmosphere was energetic, music playing was appropriate and not overwhelming. Servers returned to ask how our meal after noticing we had both begun to dig in. My only regret was that we didn’t find this place the first night. We will be returning for our remaining evenings. If you travel the Asia Pacific you’ll appreciate how rare a place like this truly is.Show less

Author: aDoodle123
Title: Great bar
Review: We went here nearly every night we stayed in Cenang - great bar, really friendly staff, good music and nice spot on the beach. Definitely worth a visit!

Author: Jeff-HTC
Title: great spot to watch sunset
Review: Beers were cold! Wine selection good, not great. Drinks tasty, on weak-side for our tastes. Good range of spirits. Prices, however, much better than anything in Singapore. Food was "typical" of global pub food. This food is meant to accompany the drinks and the sea-view.

Author: ahalvdanBaton Rouge, Louisiana
Title: Sunset visit
Review: Came here to enjoy drinks in a nicer setting for the gorgeous Cenang sunset. The sunset didn’t disappoint, and the location is great but this restaurant/bar sure did. A frozen margarita took over 30 minutes to come out, even after multiple inquiries. The LIT was passable. Could taste the liquor for a change. Considering the location and the duty free nature of the island, I think they are gouging a bit unnecessarily on drinks. Food we had was a bit bland and unmemorable. Saw some other people with pizza that was definitely undercooked and soggy looking. Can’t say I was impressed by any of the food I saw. Bottom line, if you want to splurge a bit for ambiance with your drinks and then stay there to eat, you could do worse but I’d suggest elsewhere. Show less

Author: The_Traveler010710
Title: Little Restaurant @Pantai Cenang
Review: Located just about 100m away from the hotel that we stayed, Thirstday Bar is a nice place to chill with good food and beautiful scenery.

Author: AgaSzSzLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best in the area
Review: We walked around the beach and found this place by coincidence. This was by far the best dining experience we had in the area. Service was very attentive and the view was great during sunset. I would highly recommend this place. Also, they had the cleanest toilets I found in Malaysia:).Show less

Author: PASully46
Title: Perfect view
Review: Perfect view of the beach with great beer served in ice buckets, Guiness is good and food as good as home. Beautifully presented western food, great service and delicious cocktails. Very good bar/ restaurant relaxing by the beach

Author: BhavarthP1
Title: Wonderful place with wonderful people
Review: Eye appealing view plus delicious food made our day...staff working there was very friendly and very attentive...you will wish like the evening should never end after reaching this place...i just loved this place

Author: 749binaj
Title: It was a Marvellous Thirst
Review: Thirstday hats off to you for the place you choose to keep ur restaurant.its breath taking marvellous view when it comes to food we are vegeterian only thing that scared me was will it be good or not bt this restaurant went above my expectation. it served delicious Vegeterian pizza and garlic bread. The Drinks were also damn awesome.and special thing about the restaurant was the all Waitress were very humble nd courteous and was always at the table and ever ready to serve guest even the Hostess was doing clearence nd also welcoming the guest one must atleast try once to go THIRSTDay and you will be every day thirsty to go the same bar i will surely come again only thing was missing is the music if music was there it was a complete pack of joy Thankyou everybody to make it memorable day Kuddos to every1 Show less

Author: Steve H
Title: Best bar
Review:
Best bar in langkawi
Great views of the sunset although get there early
Even give you a little ice bucket with each beer you buy

Author: nixon4nixon
Title: Fab beach bar and restaurant
Review:
Visited here twice during our stay.  Great service and although menu is small the food was great. 
Get there early and grab a table outside to watch the beautiful sun set

Author: Anaz R
Title: Enjoyable night
Review: Great view and great spot for someone who looking for restaurant-bar in evening time. Always be a favorite place for me and my friends to hang out there. Staff very attentive and always give they best to guest, special mention is Zairi who make our evening special. Show less

Author: G M
Title: Great bar!
Review: Love the whole vibe of this place! Nice cocktails, perfect location, went there several times while in Langkawi, highly recommend!

Author: Carolyn B
Title: Our Langkawi Obsession
Review: We had eight nights in Langkawi, ate here for six of them! Food is amazing (we tried everything from pizza to prawns, lamb rack to ragout), and the cocktails were as sensational as the whole vibe of the place. Don't miss it!

Author: sg745
Title: Excellent beachside ambience
Review: We were in search of gud place to drink and chill. Think no further, one of the best in area to have a few cocktails and listen to live music.

Author: benkH8751OU
Title: Great cocktails, better view!
Review: We went here for dinner and drinks and got a table on the sand with an amazing view of the sea. The cocktails are lovely with a cool vibe in the bar with live music etc. The food is nice but nothing too fancy.

Author: kateisnot0nfireSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Cool restaurant with an amazing view
Review: The food was good, albeit it being on the pricey side. You're paying for the awesome view, after all. The tiramisu wasn't worth the price though, as it's just piles of cream and a few coffee soaked biscuit fingers in it. The staffs were attentive and friendly. Will definitely come here again because I love this place. Also, I won't be ordering their nachos again because I was expecting to have like proper nachos, not supermarket bought tortilla chip snacks that I can easily get from my local sundry shop.Show less

Author: Shantanu B
Title: Good place to hang out!!
Review: Its a beach property, has live music, good food and hospitality. The menu has good options, worth a try.

Author: SolK100
Title: 로이킴 다녀갅
Review:
정말 너무너무 친절한 스태프와 끝내주는 분위기!
really nice armosphere , and very very friendly staff:) was happy being there

Author: JoyD1491
Title: Beautiful spot
Review: This place is simply lovely and beachfront. We sat here at night and had a few beers and cocktails. The decor is stunning, the live music was very pleasant and the waiters were friendly and quick service. The beer came in a small bucket of cool water+ice, and the cocktail was delicious. Highly recommend their strawberry dacquiri. The only issue we had was the very noisy work going on next door but they cannot help that and so we have not marked them down for this. Would be a nice spot for a group who like to relax but also romantic spot for couplesShow less

Author: EAB_78South East England, United Kingdom
Title: One of my favourite restaurants in Malaysia
Review: We came here for 4 nights in a row. The first three nights we only had drinks but the last night, we had food and drinks. The beer and wine is lovely and chilled. There is a good selection of both of them. The food is so delicious and I wish I could go back and I would if I ever came back to Malaysia! Nice soothing music and the staff are very friendly!Show less

Author: Ezequiel SSurrey, United Kingdom
Title: Best bar in langkawi!
Review: As an Italian i gave this place a proper test. I ordered a pizza, espresso and a negroni...not easy to master those three!The result was perfection. Pizza very nice thin and crispy, the espresso was the best coffee I had so far in the island and the negroni was spotless.That's not all, the place has an amazing location in front fo the sea, and the atmosphere is cheerful. The employees are quick and friendly... They joke, smile and even dance giving a great and effective service. Best facilities I came across so far here too.Don't go anywhere else... This is the place to be in langkawi for a couple's dinner or a animated group celebration.Thanks guys! Keep it up! Show less

Author: Soham NEmirate of Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great for a nice evening drink and meal
Review: Its on the beach so very convenient to access both from the road as well as the beach. The service is really amaing and super fast. There is also a restaurant attached to the same bar so you can either have pre dinner drink here and then move to the restaurant or the other way around. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: anna_h05
Title: Amazing food we ate the same thing twice!
Review:
Fabulous food, right in the beach, we forced ourselves to go somewhere else after eating there 2 nights in a row which was a mistake! 
Must definitely visit for dinner. I think it was sea bass and spicy mango I ate - awesome.

Author: JoD1628
Title: Fab bar
Review: We visited this bar a few times. Staff are friendly and efficient. The atmosphere is good. On the nights we went there was a live band.

Author: jaycM222ZNSingapore, Singapore
Title: Recommended for vegeterians
Review: It is hard finding vegetarian food in Langkawi, however we found ourselves coming back to this restaurant for dinner during our 3 day stay at Langkawi. Service was top quality, always went beyond to make sure we were satisfied. Immediately informed us when a table on the beach was open. Food portions were great and taste was very good. Live music on a Saturday night when we were there. Price is reasonable too. Would definitely recommend to all my vegetarian friends looking for western style food in Cenang Beach area. Show less

Author: chantiks
Title: Easy going
Review: Chilling out after a day of watersports with Megasports . Easy going modern clean upmarket ! Awesome!

Author: Bernadette B
Title: Loved Thirstday
Review: Service and atmosphere were superb. Great place to watch the sunsets and all of the staff were friendly and helpful.

Author: joancheca
Title: Cool place to see the sunset and have dinner
Review:
We were surprised about this amazing spot at the beach. Having a beer and dinning is charming and cool. Food is good, but the best is the ambient.

Highly reccomended!

Author: pbuesBregenz, Austria
Title: Dinner and drinks at the beachfront
Review: We were lucky and got a table up front where we enjoyed a great sunset!The food was very good. I had penne marinara as main and for desert the mango pineapple which was very delicious! The staff was very friendly. The beer comes in a fancy ice water vessel to keep it cool! Much better than to put ice cubes in ;) Show less

Author: IanS4761
Title: Fun in Langkawi
Review: was looking for something casual beachfront to start off a brief stay on the island and was not disappointed. Lovely outdoor venue overlooking the beach, good food & beverage selection, live music & friendly and fun staff.  Great for family, friends or backpacking.

Author: Davidis50Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: David Murphy
Review: This is the first time I have ever left a review. I have always been rather sceptical about people who would leave a review....But we had one of the best experiences i have had in over 30 years of travelling around the world. (make that two as we went back tonight too) . My daughter said that is the best meal she has ever had in her life ( steak). The food was exceptional, the staff were amazing (truly took service to another level) and the ambience was first class with great entertainment. Do not miss this place when you are in Langkawi. Best wishes David Show less

Author: pravshin
Title: Great food, service, music and view.. what more one wants!
Review: I had evening dinner at Thirstday. It was a great experience, staff was courteous, food - I tried pizza - was one of best I had, I sat facing beach with candle lights and with live performance in background. Perfect!

Author: kpnuts12Salisbury, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful
Review: Been here a few times and never been disappointed, staff amazing, food good, setting lovely. Be very surprised if anyone doesn’t like it. If you are not in mood for Asian food this is the place to go, also owner of Oarka Chinese restaurant both always busy with good atmosphere. Show less

Author: craig o
Title: Steak is awesome
Review: We ate here one night and the food was great. 58rm for a ribeye steak was very good value for money. Service is excellent and a great ambience right on the beach.

Author: KeithB3194
Title: Best Bar Cenang Beach
Review: Excellent prices, wine well presented in ice cold bucket, good service. Note: Walk through to front from bar and you have the best resteraunt [great curry].

Author: siatt16
Title: Nice ambience and good food
Review: Lovely spot on the beach. Nice decor and furniture and food is good. We had a pizza and Greek salad- both fresh and tasty. Wine also good.

Author: Emily 8
Title: Cocktails and live music by the beach!
Review:
This was the best place to drink in Langkawi, we went their several times in our short stay.
Food was also amazing but is more western than Malaysian.
There are loads of waiters so you get served almost instantly.
Would recommend!

Author: popeye64Nelson, New Zealand
Title: Great beach setting
Review: If you like good food a cold drinks and a sunset then you will like it here.The setting is great. We arrived around 7pm and had a wonderful pizza with cold beer and wine. Plenty to watch as the jetski operators pack up the equipment and families enjoy the beach. Menu is large and prices fair. Staff are friendly so recommend.Show less

Author: Jsanto2014Adelaide, Australia
Title: A must do in Langkawi
Review: Before stumbling across Thirstday we tried a number of restaurants and were disappointed with all of them. We only wish we had found Thirstday earlier, and ended up returning several times during our week in Langkawi. The food (particularly the desserts) was better than pretty much everything we tried in Langkawi, and very reasonably priced. The beachfront location is a bonus, and a great way to end the day. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: johnrajivPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner at the beach!
Review: Food is nice and portions are slightly big. Service was really good. All waiters are alert and they make you feel welcomed. Good thing about this place is that some of the tables are on the beach and they have a live duo sing at night. This place is expansive and its mostly for the ambiance.Show less

Author: RoshniS222
Title: Best beach bar restaurant in Langkawi's Cenang beach
Review: This is the beach bar I was looking for! There's seating right on the beach, with shade! Good pasta and pizza - the guacamole and chips weren't very fresh or tasty. Stick with items like french fries. Loved the atmosphere, loved the meal.

Author: Angela W
Title: Pre Wedding night out
Review: We had a really good night listening to the live music and cocktails, in a perfect on the beach setting.  Staff were very friendly and never left waiting for our drinks.  Good fun.

Author: 857travelbug02Darwin, Australia
Title: Wonderful Staff
Review: The staff here are just lovely and very attentive. When we arrived the girl serving us asked for our names and explained that she was in training, she done a wonderful job at looking after us for the evening. The food here is fresh and tasty with good sized portions and the whole place has a great atmosphere.Show less

Author: MazzaM-LondonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beach bar gem
Review: After an evening stroll on the beach we decided to dine at the Thirstday Bar. It has a buzzy feel, there were people just having a drink and others dining. I chose a cocktail and my husband a large beer. My cocktail was nice, his beer arrived served in it's own ice bucket - great as he'd complained that his beer got warm too quickly. He chose a steak and I had a pizza - both were tasty. The staff work well as a team, service was efficient, delivered with a smile. When we were there, there was a band playing - live music, a nice cocktail, a beach view - whats not to love.Show less

Author: SJS82Singapore, Singapore
Title: Sunset dinner
Review: The staff were excellent. The food was great. Go just before sunset.. order your food..sip on a cocktail from the extensuve menu and take in the sunset with the friendly staff on standby to help you take photos while waiting for the food to arrive. A perfect evening.Show less

Author: Debbbbiee
Title: Awesome staffs and atmosphere!!
Review: Everyone was very friendly and ensure that everything is ok. They take care of every small details and make you feel comfortable. Atmosphere was awesome as well as its located at the beach however do be prepared for insects and bugs ard. There will be live bands at nights too Show less

Author: davideX537KDCanberra, Australia
Title: Great venue
Review: Stayed in Langkawi two nights and drank here both nights. Staff very good, reasonable prices and beautiful outlook, some of the best sunsets in Malaysia from the comfort of a bar stool. Cocktails (strong) atound $8 Aus (23 MR) and coronas for about $5 Aus or 15 MR. Great setting, great service n great times, highly revommendedShow less

Author: jojom467Nusa Dua, Indonesia
Title: An Enjoyable Evening
Review: My husband and I tried Thirstday Bar & Restaurant after reading reviews on TA and we were not disappointed.We started off being greeted by friendly staff providing seating options and we decided to sit at the front on high stools. The staff then quickly provided a drink and food menu. I had a champagne and hubby a tiger that came in it’s own cooler bucket. The service was great and staff friendly. The bar has a casual beach dress code with young, old and families all enjoying the beach, drink and food. The staff provided free crackers which you can’t help but eat and they kept them coming a nice free touch.We decided to have the chicken wings for a snack, which hubby really enjoyed as we watched the sunset.The toilets were clean which is always a bonus for us ladies.We decided to move to a table and chairs for dinner and ordered the seafood platter for two. The platter had only two very large tiger prawns but this was stated on the menu. We had mussels, clams and scollops. The platter had a stir fry of vegetables and two mounds of mash potato a nice change from greasy chips. It was also accompanied by three sauces which were amazing. All in all a really enjoyable evening. We would definitely go again and suggest you try it too.Show less

Author: Will M
Title: Great place to chill and watch the world go by.
Review: Good beer, sports tv and great and friendly staff. Food was well priced and tasted great. Good music and vibe.

Author: GloriaSomeHobart, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere good food, great value
Review: We visited Thirstday Bar three times during our five day visit to Langkawi. We really enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere and the fantastic views , particularly at sunset. This venue is very popular and you can't always get a beach view seat or table but if you let the staff know they will move you when one becomes available. The food is tasty and reasonable, I was happy I could enjoy sparkling wine by the glass and it didn't 'break the bank'! The staff are pretty busy but we didn't feel neglected at all. I particularly enjoyed going to Thirstday for a pre dinner drink as it started the night off really well.Show less

Author: 619tyleraGainsborough, United Kingdom
Title: Favourite restaurant in Langkawi
Review: I went here for dinner with my girlfriend, it is in a great location on the beach and the staff were quick to make us welcome and give us time to decide our order, we are both vegan so it was nice to see vegan choices on the menu and we were also told we could ask the chef to make most meals on the menu vegan by removing meat, dairy etc... the food was ready in good time, tasted great and was a good price for the quality.Show less

Author: hortonmary
Title: Great beach location.
Review:
Beautiful food in a beautiful setting. Right on the beach with the sunset in the background. Great food and really good cocktails.
Great place to eat.

Author: lindseyh121Attwood, Australia
Title: A spectacular meal
Review: My husband and I enjoyed an amazing dinner here last night! We shared the surf and turf platter for 2 and it was so delicious! It came with 5 warmed and homemade sauces to accompany each meat/seafood in the platter. The service here is incredible and everyone was extremely polite! A meal worth remembering! Oh, and their location right on the beach meant we got this beautiful view to eat dinner with :) Show less

Author: seestanley
Title: Dinner
Review: We had a lovely beach front table on the sand watched the sun go down and had a great cocktail and evening meal, staff were awesome really friendly and it didn’t break the bank

Author: pauldM4517UVBackworth, United Kingdom
Title: Best bar in Langkawi
Review: A hidden gem of a bar. Access via Main Street through a restaurant not linked to bar or go via beach. Customer service is brilliant with prices really competitive 10rm for a bottle of Chang £2 in an ice bucket. Food is good to but views and ambience is what this place is all about. Check out their fb page. Highly recommended Show less

Author: JonathonG98
Title: Lovely sunset dinner on the beach
Review:
Great food and good service. Finally, a place in Langkawi that knows how to mix cocktails properly.  

Truly, the best place in Langkawi.

Author: Mansi T
Title: Great food and entertainment
Review:
Went on a weekday and the band playing was great, the service is fantastic and they have good vegetarian options.

A must go place in Langkawi

Author: clml2015
Title: Nice place, nice view, good food.
Review: Look like a touristic place only but the service is excellent, very nice view for sunset, food is a bit pricey for Malaysia but it’s real restaurant food not cheap beach snack food. I had tiger prawns, the mash potatoes and vegetables were really yummy. I definitely recommend this chill place. Show less

Author: rachaeld1980
Title: Beachfront Cocktails
Review: I didn't eat here but stopped here for a couple of times for cocktails with my husband in the afternoon and watch the world go by. the staff very friendly, cocktails were good,and the best thing was the toilets were clean.

Author: PeachytravellersGold Coast, Australia
Title: Great beachfront restaurant & bar - Perfect place to enjoy the sunset 🌅👌
Review: Thirstday is great beachfront restaurant & bar . It is the Perfect place to enjoy the sunset or relax and have a drink or food on the beachfront! Food:They offer a wide range of Malaysian & western food.It is a little expensive, however this is s nice restaurant on the beachfront.Travel Tip: Get there before sunset to enjoy the beautiful views! Service:The staff are all well presented, friendly and provide good service.Show less

Author: annecarlton59
Title: Beach front Dining
Review: Fresh food great pricing sitting on the beach with the sand under foot,  Best nights, have had dinner here twice and dessert once during our stay in Cenang,  Definately a recommended spot

Author: Nina A
Title: Tasty cocktails, nice food, live music
Review: It was our local beach bar. Very friendly staff, affordable prices, tasty cocktails, clean toilets (which is quite rare here). Live music in the evening. Overall very pleasant place to spend your night.

Author: Andica79
Title: Amazing crew, location and service
Review: The best bar ever!!!The staff is more than friendly, with all heart and soul. Service is just perfect.

Author: N PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice settting
Review: Nice location just off a bit of a tatty street and a welcome improvement on many of the surrounding restaurants. Good ambience with a live band who're playing and singing in the background. On the beach perimeter although can't comment on the view as it was dark. Looked nice though. Food was mixed and service very friendly but very haphazard. Got asked what I wanted to eat and drink repeatedly by different wait staff. Chicken wings I ordered to start ended up being chicken thighs and has no marinade. As is asked for them to be spicy, they offer my chilli flakes.... wtf? Ordered a rib eye which comes with bbq marinade but requested it plain and with a separate pepper sauce. It came out with bbq sauce so I sent back which they were happy to do. Girlfriend ordered sea bass fillets which were extremely dry. My replacement steak came out and the sauce was like pepper gravy. Steak itself was quite good, especially as it was £12. Shame I had to eat after my girlfriend had eaten. No offer to compensate for error but they were apologetic and very pleasant staff.. Funnily, I would recommend as I think I may have has a one off bad experience and it was highly recommended and busy. Also, as with all Langkawi outside the 5* hotels, cheap. Show less

Author: BSmith25Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect setting and excellent service
Review: The location is absolutely perfect - on the beach front with a great view of the sun set. The food is good - a bit on the pricey side and mostly western food.The best part was undoubtably the service; all staff were so friendly and helpful! Show less

Author: janetw148_12Perth, Australia
Title: JUST CAN'T GO PASSED IT!!
Review: Just love this relaxed local bar & restaurant overlooking the Cenang Beach.They are doing everything right...warm friendly welcome, attentive service but not over the top. If you want a meal or snack the menu is great, or if you just feel like a drink, you name it they have it.This time of year (just starting the wet season) means unpredictable rain. Thirstdays seem to have a connection with the "rain God" and seem to be able to predict when the rain is coming, and hence makes sure everyone is under cover and keeping dry.Right now from 9.00pm they have live music through till midnight. Small foursome, who set the scene with easy on the ear background music. The volume is just right. You are able to talk and hear conversation with your friends, as well as appreciate the great music. Good addition to Thirstdays. The group is there every night except Monday.Keep up the good work Thirstdays...you are doing it well.Show less

Author: Raine101Little Hereford, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic beach bar and restaurant
Review: This must be one of our favourite bars we have been to pn our travels. The staff are so friendly and polite. The food is excellent. We were here for 6 nights and have eaten here twice and had sundowners every evening. Fabulous setting and laidback atmosphere. Not to be missed.Show less

Author: TwitterEnglandOxhill, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best
Review: Thirstday is positioned right on the beach and if you are walking past the Fish restaurant on the main road it’s sign posted there as well, in fact you can walk through to Thirstday.The welcome is very warm, the staff do everything to please. The food is fantastic, the prices very reasonable. Pints of Tiger are delivered in an ice bucket to ensure they keep cool.We ate at various restaurants during our 16 day stay but kept going back to here as it really offered everything we wanted and was very close to our hotel the Casa Del Mar.Show less

Author: ISMADI B
Title: The best pizza
Review: The pizza was fantastic, Friendly staff and exelent service, keep it up,will come again for next few months

Author: k_a_t_e_010203Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: We visted Thirstday's after reading the TA reviews but were very underwhelmed by our visit. The location is great: beautiful views over the beach and the restaurant itself is modern and new.However the menu was small and uninspiring: pizza, pasta and fried snacks. Little in the way of fresh food. The pizza we has looked good, but was bland. Very much a case of style over substance. Pasta portion was tiny.Cocktail menu again looked impressive but didn't deliver. Hands down the weakest cocktail I has on the island (and by no means the cheapest).Show less

Author: jonak_10United Kingdom
Title: Vibrant
Review: On a walk along the pathway on Cenang beach we came across this modern beach restaurant. Very inviting and perfect for cocktails and watching the sunsets. Ordered Lamb Chops for a Sunday dinner and cooked to perfection. I found their cocktails however, watered down/very weak for the price. Stick to Beers! Show less

Author: ESaxtonPerth City
Title: Amazing place
Review: I was lucky enough to visit this bar/restaurant on 2 occasions during our holiday! The first time i went with my husband and we had food and cocktails, both were top notch, the steak was amazing! The second time i went with the whole family, it was just as good as our first visit. In addition to the fabulous food and drinks, watching the sunset is absolutely gorgeous. 100% Recommended :)Show less

Author: ArjunK545
Title: Great cocktails
Review: Beautifly locater right at the.centre of pantai.cenang beach . Great cocktails and friendly staff . Nice place for sundowners and light food

Author: NaturalPestControl
Title: Staff not friendly
Review:
Didn't feel welcome here.
The price for a beer is good. The satay tasted great, they only charged us 3rm for little bit extra sauce.
The staff look more like police. 
There are other beach bar with more friendly staff.

Author: Margie D
Title: Thirstday- fun, great place overlooking the beach and a great selection of food and drinks
Review: Great atmosphere, lovely friendly staff and great service with a smile. Very reasonably priced drinks and a huge selection of yummy food!  Clean restroom  too which is very important to me.

Author: edo_endo
Title: Best place for chilling
Review: I went to so many bar and restaurant here in Langkawi before but Thirstday probably is my fav. Great location, view and a very friendly staff. I love all the food especially the satay here. Eat it while having a glass of beer. Wuhuuu. Totally recommended!Show less

Author: dave wNowra, Australia
Title: great location
Review: great place right on the beach to watch the sunset. food is excellent and the cocktails really good too. the staff are welcoming and look after you and the place has good vibes. we came here several times as it is one of the best places on the beachShow less

Author: LCath
Title: Great food on the beach
Review: We had wine, cocktails, chicken satay pizza and the prawns with lemon cream sauce and all was incredible. Beautiful view, sat facing the beach, we had great service!

Author: robontheway
Title: Awesome!!
Review: Been here eating, drinking, chilling and watching sunset on first line at beach with friends so many times now.This business is a fully satisfaction regarding superb quality of food, great staff and prices.Its a must in Langkawi to enjoy here, dont miss it!Can also inform if come here for lunch its a pleasure, can find excellent meny, shadow for chill or sleep by the beach in a sunbed.Great time!and thanks again for time spended with friends and crew!Happy days!!!Show less

Author: BelindatpSydney, Australia
Title: Perfect escape out of the sun
Review: Stumbled into this place after a hot and sweaty walk along the beach. Was just what we needed to escape the heat. Enjoyed a chilled drink. The mocktails where delicious and the alcohol served strong.Located on the beach in front of the Orkid seafood restaurant Great atmosphere and friendly service! Highly recommendedShow less

Author: MUDA
Title: Appalling Service
Review: Waited over 1hr for some very badly cooked wings and nachos. Had to work hard with defensive management to convey my disappointment and then received incorrect change to top it off. Looks great, is awful.

Author: sandgrownun18Blackpool, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, wine, beers and service.
Review: It's a little bit pricey by Malaysian standards, but you couldn't fault the quality of the food, or the extra pleasant service. We had a drink in here every night of our holiday, and were never dissapointed, the beers are served in a lovely clear ice bucket to keep them cool, which in this heat is a great idea. We ate twice, and the food was excellent.Show less

Author: anavarr2Cabo San Lucas, Mexico
Title: Amazing set up, awesome service, food needs to improve alot!
Review: We visited twice during our 3 nights in Lankawi. The first time we only had a drink and we loved the atmosphere and view. The second time we decided to get appetizers and drinks. The staff was supper attentive and friendly but the food does not meet the standards of a place like this. We ordered Nachos(they where chips from 7eleven), bruchetas(very little tomato) and samosas with coriander sauce(there was zero coriander in the sauce)....in general the appetizers were overpriced...the music played both times was cool...we would ONLY recommend for a drink and the ambiance....Show less

Author: Sheila f
Title: Good food and atmosphere on the beach front
Review: Great ranged of cocktails and food - steak was very good, desserts were excellent - banana flambé used a lot of rum and made great flames - tasted good too. Pretty busy - backs onto Orkid Ria (same owner)

Author: Louloubelle979Hedge End, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic setting and Food
Review: We ate here on 3 separate occasions whilst we were in Langkawi. We loved the atmosphere and perfect place to watch the sunset. The drinks menu is good with a good selection of wine, beers, cocktails and mocktails for the kids.The food was consistently of high quality, presented nicely and really tasty. The menu had good variety from appetisers, meat from the grill, fish dishes and pasta. The steak, seabass and King prawns were a particular favourite. A must visit if you are in the area. Show less

Author: 827laurenmLondon, United Kingdom
Title: View is the saving grace
Review: Lovely view, food is good, not amazing. Service is incredibly slow. Staff helpful but absent. Waited 45 mins for our mains and 20 mins for our bill. Would I go there again? No but pleased that we went because of the view and good music. Worth going, but probably for drinks rather than dinner!Show less

Author: tomtD1632UG
Title: Cheap and easy food ( western)
Review: If you want to get a salad or other western food this is the place to go. The food and drinks are well priced and the menu is made for western guests.

Author: cmwithers91Rugby, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food, drinks and view.
Review: This place is a must see. The staff were lovely and the view of the sea is beautiful. The food is a good price and portion sizes are really good too! They even put your beer glass into a bucket of ice to keep it cool. We will defo be returning here before we leave to try their pizzas and a few more mains! Honestly worth a visit even if it’s just for a few drinks! Show less

Author: StarsagainLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding value for money!!!
Review: We rocked up to the Thirstday bar thinking we were going to just have a couple of beers! But we found ourselves still there 5 hours later after 8 beers a bottle of sparkling wine, a pizza, salad, and tempura prawns!!! The staff were so attentive and friendly, they really went the extra mile! And what’s more, there’s a lot of staff working hard, so even though the bar was really busy, you didn’t have to wait long to order drinks and receive them! We shall be visiting a few more times whilst we enjoy our holiday here! Show less

Author: trent1000
Title: Fab restaurant
Review: A fantastic vibrant restaurant.  If you want a bustling place then this is the place to be. Rite next to the beach and views over to Thailand watch the sun go down is a show of awesomeness.  Great food and beer at a good price.

Author: heidiboo123
Title: Beautiful evening & Food
Review: We went here with friends and it was a lovely evening. The service was good and the food was excellent. We would defiantly go here again. Beautiful bar and surroundings.

Author: 98aj11
Title: Delicious!
Review: We had a wonderful experience. Service was prompt and polite. The food was really good too. The pizza was loaded with cheese and a good size. The real MVP though is the deep fried king prawns with coconut dipping sauce. Oh my goodness - absolutely wonderful! We had a lovely sea view with our table as well. Show less

Author: Sunroars
Title: Great place with beach and sunset view
Review:
Right at the pantai cenanag beach, great choice of drinks and food, nice ambiance.

We went there around sunset and stayed till dinner, this is indeed a great place to hangout chatting with your friends & family while enjoying sea view and breeze.

Author: David HThrapston, United Kingdom
Title: Nice position on the beach........
Review: We ate here 3 times during our holiday and it was good on 2 occasions but very poor on the third visit- we did not go back after that. They forgot to deliver our food to the table at the right time so it came to us cold, we sent it back and left.....disappointed.Show less

Author: leopardpinkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good ambience but poor service
Review: Great refreshing ambience for hanging out overlooking sunset/ beach with relaxing acoustic music. We arrived before sunset and the restaurant wasn’t that busy. However, waiters forgot two of our orders and my pasta was cooked with the ingredient I clearly told the waiter to exclude. Pizza was good though. Most waiters speak poor English. I feel that they do not even understand the food menu. When we complained about the pasta, manager was quick to offer an apology, offer a replacement (which we turned down) and didn’t charge for it. Thumbs up for addressing the issue without any hassle!Show less

Author: peter bLondon, United Kingdom
Title: "Amazing Place"
Review: Could not have asked for anymore what a great place this is for a relaxing ice cold beer served by the very friendly staff that always make you feel welcome i have now visited here on a few occasions and never been disappointed.even the manager takes time out to have quick chat with you.it as a great location right on the beach front with stunning views.Show less

Author: ShellsO
Title: Tasty
Review: Great location. Food was very good but perhaps not quite as good as some other restaurants we visited. The standard in Langkawi was quite high. So all up, an enjoyable experience. Service was great. Food good.

Author: Elane26
Title: Good ambience
Review: Love the ambience and friendly staff. The steak is nice and I like the beer. They bother to put the glass of beer in the ice bucket for all guests. This is a plus point!

Author: sherenep86
Title: Underwhelming Food and Drinks
Review: We were a party of 4 ladies whom initially went there just for the drinks as a couple of us had been there for drinks and said that it was great. We decided to have dinner there too as it was our last night at Langkawi and thought to splurge a little. The location and ambience is great however the food had no flavour plus very small portions and not a good value for the money! We had the slow baked salmon (no seasoning), cod (not fresh and tasteless), ikan panggang (not fresh and unauthentic), soft shell crab (not fresh, fried in old reused oil), butternut pumpkin and sweet potato soup (bruschetta was good, but the soup was way too sweet).We all ordered different cocktails and tried each others but were utterly disappointed, especially with their Margarita and Bellinis. When my friend tried to provide feedback to the waiter just before we left of our experience, we were told that they catered for European taste buds. Gee thanks. I for one will not be returning any time soon.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Amzwright
Title: Relaxed, friendly atmosphere, wonderful staff.
Review: Amazing food and great service. The staff really took care of us including making a little sofa bed for our 2 year old who fell asleep during the meal.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SelinawonggKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful Sunset Dinner with Great Food
Review: Definitely make a reservation before you come for dinner, due to the limited tables available. Located on a quiet part of Cenang beach, with beautiful views of the sunset. Drinks are reasonably priced, with good selection available. Food was definitely the highlight here. A bit on the pricey side, but worth the quality and taste of the food they served. Amazing ambiance in a nice hotel with great service. Overall an enjoyable experience. Note: I was lucky to have been there on a great clear day to watch the sunset. cloudy days might dim the experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hannisRaslinLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: good food 😋
Review: this is a second time ❤️this time we try set menu for berbuka puasa . excellent environment, friendly service , great menu . we were all impressed with the food. highly recommended. will be going back and the hosts were great. it was flawless, great value. thank you all Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ivanachristys
Title: Very cool drinks and good food
Review: Nice ambience. A good choice of food that was done well. Drinks menu was very interesting and there was a lot to choose from. Toilets were super as well Show less

Author: Jodiejodes17
Title: Delicious lunch!
Review: We just visited Casa Del Mar for lunch and we loved it! Really great service from friendly staff who were very attentive. If we had service like this only for lunch visitors I can only imagine they’re even better when you stay here as guests. The food was wonderful, we had salads/starters and dessert and everything was great. The prawn starter was the highlight! We will definitely visit again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BobAMarpleMarple, United Kingdom
Title: First class restaurant
Review: We were actually staying at the Casa Del Mar and ate in the La Sal on four occasions during our 7 night stay. The food and service were excellent and the setting on the beach just made it an memorable experience. Would highly recommend the restaurant and hotel if you visit Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Richardrw1402Old Hunstanton, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant on the beach
Review: We were staying at the Casa Del Mar resort and our package included dinner at their restaurant - La Sal. The setting on the beach at sunset and then by candlelight is fantastic and the quality of the food and service is first class.We enjoyed it so much that we ate here 3 times during our 7 night stay.Highly recommended.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Pam MAscot, United Kingdom
Title: Top class restaurant on the beach. We loved it!
Review: Excellent food and service, not cheap by some standards but great food and wine. Very romantic! Malaysian platter was the best!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Keith T
Title: Wonderful setting, wonderful food and superb staff

Author: T3TCAEssex, United Kingdom

Author: negronipv

Author: flattopsteveGrays Thurrock, United Kingdom
Title: Top notch

Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mark GLlantwit Major, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We were staying at Casa del Mar anyway and had a couple of 3-course meals included in our room rate. We ate here three times during our stay and all meals were very good with the exception of one dish.My partner had a chicken dish that she was not overly impressed with but apart from that everything was very good. Staff were superb as we knew them from the hotel, and we were probably treated better because of this (maybe).We had everything from Barramundi and prawns to Beef Rendang and all were excellent. Location on the beach was a nice touch but if it was windy I would not appreciate sand in my soup.We also ate here every day for lunch and food and service were again excellent. Could not fault the food and staff.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Thebegbies103warrington
Title: Excellent service and food
Review: We ate at la Sal twice in our stay in Langkawi and on both occasions the food and service were excellent. The location is amazing, sitting on the beach watching the sunset as we were served cocktails. A particular mention to Halim, who was running the restaurant both nights, he was a fantastic host and attentive to all our needs. Great experience. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: W8967VEsusanpHong Kong, China
Title: Under par
Review: We visited the Restaurant on the basis of the reviews we read on TripAdvisor, which was has a very high rating...All the tables were set on the beach, nice start..Umm, great if you are wanting to see four wheel drivers going up and down the beach in front of you collecting the watersports equipment etc, after the day's activities. Food was served by people that really don't have any time for you. Talking about the food, it is mediocre, I really don't understand why people rate it so highly, also whilst eating our food we had to listen to loud music from a place near by. If you are wanting a romantic evening I certainly wouldn't recommend this place.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ClearyhhDublin, Ireland
Title: Really good place to eat
Review: Ate several times in La Sal on our recent stay in Pantai Cenang. Good selection on menu, great quality of food and reasonably priced. On a good evening they set the tables out by beach - really lovely. Staff were excellent. Well worth a try.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: annemaariemAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great food, service on the beach!
Review: We had a nice stroll and ended up at this restaurant. Food was excellent, service as well. We will definitely return!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: fareham22Portsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: A great restaurant
Review: The food here was excellent and having dinner on the beach at sunset provided a perfect backdrop.The menu choice was extensive and the meals we had were exceptionalShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RandA2016Surrey, United Kingdom
Title: Chef and staff could not do enough for us
Review: We stayed at Casa del Mar for 7 nights and we are not usually ones for eating at hotel restaurants as we prefer to go out and experience the local food. However we dined here 5 out of 7 nights as the ambience (sitting right by the beach), service and food were excellent and at what we felt was good value price wise. What particularly impressed us was that Chef Kai was happy to prepare dishes for us that were not on the menu provided we gave 24hrs notice. Wines also good at acceptable prices.Should also mention the breakfast which is one of the best we have had - a wide selection of Asian and Western dishes all made to order - not buffets full of ageing food. The fresh fruit was prepared by hand at a fruit station where the lady cut the fresh mango and papaya into beautifully presented plates made to order. All the breads and jams (huge selection) are home-made. Excellent cappuccinos and again the staff were exceptionally friendly and could not do enough for us.Would certainly recommend this restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: The best "fine dining" in Langkawi!
Review: Langkawi, and Pentai Cenang have many good "local places" to enjoy an Asian or Western Meal- BUT, this restaurant will really appeal to those who appreciate wonderfully prepared Asian and Western Dishes. prepared by well trained, professional and knowledgeable kitchen staff. For those really dedicated, there is also a "cooking school, staffed by their very professional chefs! The ambiance of this small/intimate "high-class inn" is conducive to an excellent culinary experience! Whether one feasts on an Indonesian favourite... Beef Rendang or a Thai delight... green curry duck... or any other the other delicious offerings... the impact will be definitely "most memorable". They also have a very good "wine list" as well as very tasty cocktails. The Restaurant and Inn have received TripAdvisor's coveted "Certificate of Excellence"- based on feedback provided by travelers like you and I!!I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food
Review: Cannot fault the food at La Sal and the Beachfront dining location is perfect for watching the sunset. They have a great choice of local & foreign cuisine along with specials of the day. If you get a chance you must give this restaurant a try.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mynameisbannedHobart, Australia
Title: Cooking class and lunch
Review: My partner and I were staying at a neighbouring resort and looking for some local cooking classes. We enquired at Casa Del Mar after seeing a poster out the front and it sounded perfect.The staff are amazing, including the two chefs who host the class. We were fully guided through creating a 3-course meal and loved every minute. The food we were (strongly) guided in creating was the best we had seen so far on the island and made a great beach-side lunch.We were so impressed we came back for dinner that evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sandra_evenstar
Title: Food is fantastic
Review: We came over to try the cuisine as it was highly recommended. The beach side table and it's view accompanied by multiple scrumptious meals was absolutely mind-blowing. The staff were really polite and accommodating. We would definitely go again!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Brammers68
Title: High budget prices, low budget setting
Review: After seeing such rave reviews I really am at a loss to see what the fuss is about. Perhaps it's because of the season and the fact that we couldn't have dinner on the beach, but I was disappointed with our visit.Very expensive for this area, especially the wine, bearing in mind it's duty free here.The setting is ok, but more like a decent café than a classy restaurant. Nothing special.As a Yorkshireman I could have choked on my starter after paying RM48, unfortunately there was not enough to choke on. Two prawns and two tiny scallops. You can do better than that, surely.To be fair, both our main dishes were very nice but again, really rather expensive for what they were.Service however was good, the waiters were polite, friendly and helpful.Walked along the beach, found a cool bar called Thursday bar, had a couple of drinks and a dessert, live music, right next to the beach, wish we had eaten there.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: chapmanracSomerton, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and service
Review: I can honestly say that the food and service could not be faulted. Great choice and quality to suit all appetites. The evening menu is well thought out and delivered without fault. The “La Luna” meal by the beach is a must. A big thank you to Dom and Azura, for excellent service.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Susan C
Title: La Sal restaurant
Review: Wow, fantastic, by far the best place we ate at on the island. Everything we ate was lovely, well thought out and very tasty. We also had a special dinner here during our stay, they paired great wines to each course, the staff were friendly, helpful and lovely. Definitely must try it.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CraigHWSouth Australia
Title: top food
Review: on previous visits La Sai has been acceptable but not outstanding. On this trip it has reached new heights and we can only sing its praises. The menu is diverse, the quality of both cooking and presentation was fantastic. Being able to sit on the edge of the beach and experience the lovely sunset etc added to the experience. We had a mini cyclone go through Langkawi right at meal service time and caused massive disruptions to the service at Casa Del Mar and the whole Island suffered much damage. The staff were outstandiung and within 20 minutes they had every one reseated and the food and drinks flowing. What a great effort.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Marguerita TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hotel restaurant with good offerings
Review: There's decent food offerings to be had at breakfast, lunch and dinner at Casa Del Mar's main restaurant. They allow walk-ins but priority is given to guests and even so, guests too have to make a reservation for dinner as there's limited seating. Dinner tables are laid by the beach and if you are lucky, here's where you get the best view of the sun setting over Langkawi. Items-wise, portions are generous and use the best ingredients. You probably could find cheaper fare else where but if you want some pampering, check this out.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DaphneTA
Title: Memorable dinner next to sandy beach
Review: Our dinner was memorable ...... dinning with a beautiful sunset view sets the mood.Food was delicious accompanied by friendly n efficient service. Location n ambience is great be it for a celebration or a family dinner or even business dinner.You wont be disappointed.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Having the tables right on the beach was lovely and it was super relaxing. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KJfamily67Geelong, Australia

Author: Mrs-Dalloway-hereKuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Panapur

Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: vesko9Sofia, Bulgaria
Title: Very good food and service
Review: The restaurant is a part of the hotel with the same name, but unlike most hotel restaurants has a very nice ala carte menu, with daily offerings of fresh fish and seafood. The cocktails were also very nice, with just the right amount of alcohol in them, unlike most on the island. The service was also nice. The beach part was closed due to the weather and the roofed part doesn't have as nice ambiance, but I can imagine that when the beach section is opened it has a perfect view. Overall highly recommended restaurant if your preference is to have Malaysian food with fresh ingredients in a more upscale environment.Show less

Author: PhillipNarelleWollongong, Australia
Title: Great Food, Great Service, Great Location
Review: Where can you get the "Cocktail for the Day" at breakfast ?? La Sal at the Casa Del Mar ... Each morning brings the fantastic of freshly cooked pastries mmmm .. The food selection at tea time was above what i was expecting & the taste was scrumptious.Show less

Author: cindymarieazurValencia, Spain

If you want to visit this place be ready with their menu price.Show less

Author: StuzukiLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Top food and service with a great view
Review: We stayed at eh Casa Del Mar and our meals were included in our getaway package. Was a wonderful experience as was the overall stay in the resort. Cant wait to returnShow less

Author: Ja5ja5
Title: What a wonderful evening!
Review: We wandered in off the beach after my fiancée had eaten here the week earlier with work and raved about the food. The staff were excellent, highly attentive and very welcoming. My fiancée had the fish of the day and I had the chicken breast, both excellent! (Indulge in the chocolate trio for dessert, you’re on holiday, it’s worth it!). Couldn’t recommend this place enough.Show less

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: The magic is gone
Review: Up to some years ago, La Sal at Casa del Mar was a magic spot, where you could have dinner right on the beach, with a glorious sunset. An easy 5 point rating and you had to get up early to secure a spot at the "front row" in the evening. But nowadays, La Sal had to retreat onto the hotel grounds (on a stone floor) behind a newly constructed public pathway. Over this pathway pedestrians, bicycles and motorcycles pass the restaurant tables in short distance. Furthermore, Casa del Mar has got nowadays some very noisy beach cafes as neighbours, so loud pop music from the neighbouring cafes can be heard during the meal. The only magic left, what is humanely impossible to destroy, is the magnificent sunset. Unfortunately, these things are outside the power of the management and staff to improve. What is within the power of the staff hasn't changed. That is the food and the dedicated, friendly service of the staff, always a strong point of Casa del Mar. But without the magic, prices of the food are rather steep.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Tessa DPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: This restaurant is set up on the beach front. The staff are amazing and can not do enough for you. The food is excellent as was the service and attention. Presentation was the best while in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Keith CCumbria, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food in a great setting

Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: linda gDevon

As a non seafood eater the menu is a little limited especially for the first course but the duck and the caesar salad were both lovely.The setting right beside the beach (no longer actually on the beach) is very romantic and the waiting staff are very attentive. .Show less

Author: mikepE7412DY

Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ericd233Oostduinkerke, Belgium

Author: E4441KDandrewfGrappenhall, United Kingdom

Author: Katrina MGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and staff

Author: lachlanj1Ipswich, Australia
Title: one of the best
Review: So glad that we decided to eat at the hotel's restaurant on the one night that we stayed as guests. The setting of this out-door restaurant, just off the sand on Cenang beach, is quite beautiful..We arrived a little early and without a reservation, so we enjoyed a couple of drinks on the sun-beds, while watching the sun set. The staff were great. They were very attentive and helpful and took the time to explain the dishes and made some excellent recommendations. My wife, who is unable to eat large portions, had an entrée size prawn dish and I had the Malay taster set … both were so tasty! Now that we have returned home after 28 days on the road, this dinner by the beach in Langkawi is up there with some of our most memorable moments of our holiday.Show less

Author: PaulineK364Sunderland, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous food !

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Family
Review: We had a table on the beach booked for 7pm but arrived at 6 for cocktails. I had a Pina Colada and my wife and daughter had Singapore Slings and our friend a glass of wine. There is a tradition at the Casa del Mar called "Spin the Wheel". The bar counter is made up of square coloured tiles. You place whatever drink you have on a coloured tile and then spin the wheel attached to the bar upright roof support. If the colour on the wheel matches yours it's a free drink and you have three goes at it. We were lucky and won a Pina Colada and two Singapore Slings. After this we took our table for dinner. They have a very extensive menu. My friend and I started with Chicken Caesar Salad. It was delicious. My wife had the Asian Seafood Salad which consisted of Poach Prawn, Torch Scallop, Mango Jelly, Slipper Lobster and Orange Thai- Dressing. My daughter had Pan Seared Hokkaido Scallop & King Prawn with Salsa Verde, Cherry Capers & Crustacean Glaze.For main course my daughter and I had Crustacean Farce. Slow cooked Risotto Rice in Seafood Bisque, Grilled Scallop & King Prawn, Asparagus and Mushroom Caramelized Grapefruit Rind. Our friend had Skewered Boneless Chicken Tikka, Saffron Rice, Naan Bread, Cucumber Carrot Raita and Makhani Sauce.My wife indulged in a Fabulous Authentic Malaysian Pallet. This consisted of 9 pure Malaysian dishes which she said was delicious. We washed all this down with a couple of bottles of NZSB. My daughter decided on a sweet with two spoons. A trio of Chocolate. It took 30 mins to arrive and when it came it was with 4 spoons and was delightful. This restaurant is not cheap but the food, atmosphere, ambience and service are excellent. Well recommended.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: alltimetraveller91Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great set lunch! Huge portions
Review: Tried the grilled chicken from their set lunch menu. It was a little salty but really worth it, portions were huge and superb tasty with great beach view. Exceptionally friendly fnb staff too. Show less

Author: ken gAdelaide, Australia

Author: nicholasp512Newport, Rhode Island
Title: Posh Bar
Review: While not staying at Casa Del Mar, stopped in for a cocktail on the beach.Swanky spot for a drink with very friendly & accommodating staff.Some creative drinks like the passion fruit mojito which are in the 30 RM range.Bar is open & airy & tables set along the beach.Recommended for a quiet cocktail.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Aigerim K
Title: The best restaurant in langkawi
Review: Definitely the best restaurant in langkawi. Delicious food, tables on the beach with breathtaking views, especially good in the evenings and excellent service. Highly recommendShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 774stevedHendersonville, North Carolina
Title: A diamond in Langkawi
Review: This is an amazing restaurant, dinner served on the beach with outstanding service. Let me first say this is not a cheap backpacker dive so you will have to pay up, but is worth it if you are a foodie looking for a gourmet meal. Don’t get me wrong, we love Malaysian hawker food, but once in a while it is nice to move upscale. Western and Malaysian Food are both excellent, creative, and very well plated. The cumin, sea salt, mint rack of lamb was the best I ever had. Baby octopus starter was also excellent. Would liked to have seen a larger salad served. The pear tart was excellent. We have booked for a second night this week to try more delectable dishes. BTW, to a large extent prices reflect the cost of high quality imported ingredients. Dinner is served on the beach and I love taking my shoes off and rubbing feet in the sand while watching and listening to the sea while enjoying dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 63ourHolidays2019
Title: Special Evening - La Luna Dinner
Review: I First contacted the hotel - La Sal Restaurant via email as a few months prior I intended to book a special meal their 'La Luna Dinner' experience whilst we were staying elsewhere in Langkawi in intended to propose to my partner after the dinner. The Staff were great in Particular Mr Don Anuar, as there was quite a bit of correspondence in regards ensuring everything was perfect.I needn't have worried as every detail was taken care of from flowers, rose petals champagne and the special location on the beach to printed personalized menus.I felt in safe hands, The food was incredible with pre selected wines from the tasting menu only enhanced and made the evening very special for both of us. I couldn't have asked for more, a special thank you to the team for our memories of that amazing evening on the beach under the stars, she said 'yes' by the way :-)Would whole heartedly recommend La Sal Restaurant to anyone, you are also in safe hands if you intended to make it an extra special evening too!Thank you all.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Alex KMontpellier, France
Title: Incredible
Review: We ate here twice in our week on the island. Incredible standard of food on a beautiful beach setting. Exceptional service! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Alan FOldham, United Kingdom
Title: too dark
Review: we stayed here 3 years ago and thought we would dine one evening.we were sat on the beach much against my better judgement but we would try.the tables are lit by a battery lamp and it was so dark on the table we could not see our food we was give an extra lamp even so it was just too dark.this spoilt the meal which was quite good.should have followed my instincts and ate insideShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Graeme641Perth, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: We booked a table to celebrate my wife's birthday. We started off with cocktails which were great and good value for money. We had a table overlooking the beach and the food was excellent, probably the best we had in Langkawi. The beef rending was great. Service was great. I'd definitely recommend this place to eat. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: michaeljon49Kingsbridge, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect presentation and flavours
Review: Superb spot - great for romantic meals by candlelight. Quality international food, well presented by courteous, friendly table staff. Must be the best in the area.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Linda HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: We had high expectations for our dinner at La Sal Restaurant at Casa del Mar, but sadly they were not met. The eating area (I hesitate to call it a restaurant) is a cluster of tables set out in the open in the hotel grounds, facing the beach. We are not talking white tablecloths here, just regular cafe type tables. Yes, you have a nice view of the beach and sunset, but from 7 - 8.30pm, while we sipped pre dinner drinks and admired the view, there was a constant stream of cars and trucks dragging all the jet skis off the beach for the night. This is not a tranquil location by any means. Also there’s a constant stream of people walking along the beach path in front of the dining area. We thought ourselves lucky to have bagged a table nearest to the beach, but I’m not sure it’s the best spot as the world shuffles by along the path. The menu reads well and a look at the prices raises expectation of fine food. Our dishes were well presented but failed to impress on taste. One problem was that once the sun had gone down the tables are very dimly lit and this made it hard to see what we were eating. Definitely more table light needed. My pre dinner cocktail was excellent and service all round was attentive and courteous. In light of the mediocre food, high prices (our starters were around 45-50RM and mains around 100RM) and disappointing ambiance this restaurant did not impress.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Explorer112251
Title: Best in Cenang
Review: This is our forth time coming back, one of our must eat place in Langkawi. The ambience is warm, cozy and perfect for beach sunset, staffs are friendly. Everything we ordered are nice, some great especially the lamb. Great house pour as well.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Stunning Restaurant with outstanding "Culinary Delights"!
Review: This classy, intimate, seaside restaurant is located in a small, luxurious hotel which is on Langkawi's most popular beach. The sunsets are outstanding as well as being most memorable. For those people with a discriminating palate [perhaps "foodies"?] this restaurant should not be missed. Its Asian/Western/"Fusion" menu covers many seafood and "meat" choices-- all of which are presented "artistically", by very professional, well trained staff. We preferred mixing our choices and types of cuisine in order to get the best feeling for the restaurant's amazing approach to food preparation and presentation. The drinks- alcoholic and non-alcoholic are simply GREAT-- as are the deserts!I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: leanne051019Hong Kong, China
Title: Luxury lunch
Review: It's a bit pricey comparing to other nearby restaurants. It doesn't matter as we are on holiday. The mango moctail has more banana flavour than mango. The lobster is smaller than a king prawn. However, the crumble is nice. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: macksterzAlmere, The Netherlands
Title: Wow....at the beach and excellent food
Review: Staying in the Casa del Mar resort we had diner here every night. We walked around and saw other nicepleaces but always ended u herea gain.Food is awesome! Try the rendang.Nice wines and very friendly and good service.Location cant be beaten.Hope to go there again some dayShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PerachaSLahore, Pakistan
Title: Fell the taste
Review: one of very few restaurants in Langkawi who does have such lavish & memorable taste food with awesome presentation. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Food is Amazing
Review: We have most of our meals at La Sal while we stay at Casa del Mar with the odd night out to try other local restaurants. The food is delicious and the service from the staff is amazing. The sunset view is spectacular although due to current Government legislation it was beachside rather than on the beach like it used to be. Luckily this is my preference. I would certainly recommend the Thai style beef salad from the starters menu.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jeff-HTCCincinnati, Ohio
Title: Lamb was best in SE Asia thus far!
Review: We've lived in Singapore for over a year. Australian lamb is ubiquitous. Preparation by CdM chef was best we've experienced. Seafood and beef rendang were also outstanding. Prices SO MUCH more affordable than Singapore.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Dining @Beach
Review: We dined in this restaurant on the last night we stayed in the hotel after heavy rain on the first 2nights. Weather was perfect on that day with beautiful sunset. We ordered pumpkin soup, pan fried red snapper, Angus beef & Pear crumble for dessert. All tasted delicious except for the fish with a little bit of fishy smell. Other than that, the food was awesome with 1st class presentation & taste. The staff were also very helpful & courteous. The hotel hired the right people for the right job. Keep up the good work! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Aslam_SaleethLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best restaurant with good vibes
Review: One of the best dining spot in Langkawi with great atmosphere! You will definitely love their sunset dining setup and the staff who will look after you! Big kudos to Mr Anizan and his team for a wonderful gesture and service! Indeed they’re the most loving people I’ve met in Langkawi throughout my journey!! Should definitely try their local cuisine and the chef is amazing talented person! So many delicious dishes with creativity! Worth going!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Du3a3London, United Kingdom
Title: Lunch is terrible
Review: Lunch was ridiculously overpriced and absolutely terrible, staff not friendlyI think their dinner menu would be a different experience so make sure to come after 7 We called and told us they were open Bad experience Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GastroKingaVeszprem, Hungary
Title: Luxury experience
Review: Delicious dishes, nice beach front View, kind waiters!We tried and recommend Andaman Sea Kataifi Prawns and Ikan Bakar! Also try the Malaysian pallett to taste malaysian dishes on one plate.I hope they will have Laksa also on their menu, because its my personal favourite and I really want to try here somedayShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: crossbordertravellerGreater Sydney, Australia
Title: Soft Shell Crab Salad is a must
Review: We had a few meals at La Sal while we stayed at Casa del Mar. The food was always delicious and the service could not be faulted. The view is spectacular.
