We enjoyed the relaxed setting while we enjoyed many lovely meals here. This is a quality restaurant at the most amazing resort.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: zmk1Sydney, Australia
Title: La Luna - Romantic Dinner on the beach!
Review: I made a trip advisor account so I can inform you all of how amazing our experience was here. I booked the La Luna dining experience for my partner's birthday and it was genuinely one of the best dining experiences I have ever had!The setting alone was beautiful - we got to watch the sunset throughout our dinner experience. This was made better with the amazing customer service provided by Don and his team, and the delicious 7 course meal we were served (the meals came with matching wines so be prepared to get boozy!).I cannot recommend this enough for a romantic date night. Don and his team went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time, and also gave my partner a personalised dessert, a gift of chocolates and a birthday card, and I was even given a bouquet of roses!!Don and his team were very welcoming and very accommodating to our needs, I cannot give them enough credit for their amazing effort. Thank you again!If you are travelling to Langkawi with your partner, I URGE you to go here!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KeithB3194
Title: Dinner on the Beach
Review: Food and service was excellent. Try the slow cooked lamb cutlets - best we have tasted in our many years of travel.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ViolettafmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great dinner on the beach
Review: Fabulous ! Both the food and the experience of eating in front of the ocean with our feet in the sand, at the beautifully decorated table wonderfully served !Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tilly099Melbourne, Australia
Title: A very special experience
Review: My family of 4 had dinner tonight at La Sal on the last night of 6 beautiful nights at Casa Del Mar. It’s a very special option in the most beautiful of settings - it’s not cheap but its not that sort of place - everything at La Sal, from the setting, the service and the food is beautiful. At our table on the sand, watching the sun set, we had the seafood platter and carbonara - both very nice - we followed this up by sharing the banana fritter and chocolate trio - both stunning. A very nice way to wrap up a perfect stay at Casa Del Mar and Langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JeanetteO661Oatley, Australia
Title: Wow!
Review: We dined at sunset on the beach at La Sal while staying at Casa Del Mar for a special night for my husband’s birthday. The service was superb nothing was too much trouble. We shared a soft shell crab for starters then my husband had the slow cooked Beef Rendang and I had Green Curry Duck. Both were presented on it’s own platter with condiments papadums and rice. They then surprised my husband with a complimentary slice of cheesecake on a decorated plate with a candle and sang happy birthday. The meal was accompanied with a bottle of 2007 Chilean Red. It was all a culinary delight! If I had to be picky they didn’t have the Australian Riesling we first selected and the papadum didn’t seem to be freshly cooked as it was soft. This wasn’t a cheap meal but it was a special night and we thoroughly enjoyed it. Would definitely revisit. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JeffW3631
Title: Romantic restaurant ever!
Review: Perfect environment,nice food, very supportive staff and friendly, just everything perfect for my proposal plan in here. Thanks to the team for helping. A very memorable places for us.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: popeye64Nelson, New Zealand
Title: A must do
Review: This is our 4th visit and still up there with the best. Location on the beach the menu options the quality of the food and most of all the friendly staff. Sure you will pay more than most places on Langkawi but if it's a special event and want an evening to remember then look no further.We will be back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LynSmith66Melbourne, Australia
Title: A glorious night on the beach
Review: Our table was right on the beach, so we were able to watch a beautiful sunset. Service was first class and a fantastic choice of food and drinks. My seafood was superb, and my wife had a green duck curry, which was also very good. Would highly recommend this restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DDDownsouthAdelaide, Australia
Title: Great Food and Dining on the beach
Review: Staying for nine nights at the Casa Del Mar gave us many opportunities to dine at La Sal every meal was a pleasure. The staff and atmosphere are amazing and we will be back many more times.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 919crismMelbourne, Australia
Title: Perfect
Review: Great food great service perfect location. Assorted food and drink choices staff were friendly and very knowledgeable. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ranice YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Horrible horrible attitude
Review: We were looking for a beach side restaurant along Cenang beach and came across Casa Del Mar’s beach side restaurant. Before settling down into our seat, we needed the toilet so we approached the staff to ask for directions. The guy at the front of the counter said, “toilets are for hotel guests only”. He then arrogantly asked for our room numbers. So others cannot use their toilet??? This is absurd. Not sure about their rooms but please avoid the restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: francescamE9872UNLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good meal
Review: Food was very nice. I had the green duck curry and my partner had the Malaysian platter which consider of different curries and veg as well as crab. We sharef ice cream for desert and had two drinks in total. The bill came to aprox 250RM. Fish was pricey, mostly around 100-120RM. The fish of the day was 88RM, but I didn't have that as I had that the night before. Expensive for Langkawi but the view of the beach was lovely and food was nice. They did charge us for two ice creams despite sharing one ice cream portion. We asked for two scoops of two different flavours. I don't quite understand how two scoops justifies two portions of ice cream. But it was tasty nonetheless. We wanted somewhere a little bit more posh and special for our last night. We found that around the main beach area most of the dining options were authentic budget options. Which is great, but we wanted something a little bit more romantic. Overall a good meal.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AnnaH375London, United Kingdom
Title: Worth the price
Review: We came here for dinner after finding the place we had chosen to go was closed. We were shocked by the price (RM88 for a fried fish!!) but when the food arrived it was delicious and my husband's whole fish had all the bones removed. Incredible! The setting on the beach was beautiful and we were treated to a lovely sunset.The food was so nice that we came back again the next evening. The staff were very friendly and remembered us from the night before. Unfortunately dinner on the beach was rained off by an epic storm but it didn't seem to disrupt the service flow at all and the waiters worked very hard to get everyone and everything inside before the storm hit.The passionfruit mojito was very nice and not bad value. We would recommend trying the ikan bakar which was really delicious.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gary DBusselton, Australia
Title: Sunset, Beach, Great Food, Wonderful Service...
Review: We were lucky enough to have 4 x 3 Course meals in our Package here at Casa Del Mar's La Sal.....all of which were fantastic.6 People...24 entrees, mains and deserts and it would be fair to say we covered all bases. The Kaliffa Prawns were a sure fire winner from all bases...and the deserts were well tasted and tested.  All part of the Casa Del Mar experience....great food, service and ambienceShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Holidayviking22Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood platter was fantastic
Review: Their seafood plater was awesome and the dessert Pear Crumble served with Vanilla ice cream was great.. And great cocktails too.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: richiemelfBrooklyn, New York
Title: Amazing!!
Review: Food incredible, wonderful and attentive service. Gutted we only found this place on our last night here. How many times do you get to eat on a beach under the stars?? Extremely reasonable prices to add!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Maree DNewcastle, Australia
Title: Early dinner
Review: We were here early evening after a day driving around and wanted to eat outside of our resort for a change. The menu was good and service excellent. There was a happy hour for guests on at the bar and they included us in the celebrations and gave us free drinks which was very much appreciated.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TwitterEnglandOxhill, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: We dined here because of its rating and for the life of me I can’t understand why the ratings are so high!It was way over priced, the menu was very limited, the service was very slow; this is based on the other restaurants we visited.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sarwar09
Title: One Of best budget and beautiful sun set dinner
Review: I had visited LA Sal at casa del mar langkawi on 4th may 2018, to celebrate my wife’s birthday and its turn out most beautiful and memorising birthday ever with view and delicious food, thanks for friendly staff and clean atmosphere. Make sure early booking to avoid disappointment due to less sitting capacity. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: therealhenrysugarCape Town, South Africa
Title: Very poor seafood
Review: I took my wife here for her birthday. The setting was nice enough, on the beach but close to a noisy bar and under the flight path. The service was very good but overall the food was very poor. We ordered cocktails to start which were not very good, very sweet and with no attention to detail. Our starters were not good at all. The Hokkaido scallop with prawn was tasty enough but the scallop was no bigger than a thumb nail, rubbery and clearly not fresh. The soft shell crab was tasteless and unseasoned and served on a very disappointing pomelo salad that mostly consisted of bad tasting grated carrot. The mains were no better - the crab pasta was oily and unpalatable made with tinned or frozen crab. The fish was well presented and well deboned but tasted very earthy and served with over cooked stodgy rice. We couldn’t finish any of the food. Overall very disappointing seafood in an average setting. It was by far the worst meal in our month in Malaysia and also the most expensive. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: derevorSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Peaceful Romantic Dinner by the beach
Review: Excellent service, not noisy yet not too quiet. Music can be heard from the other restaurants nearby but not disruptive. Very reasonable food pricing.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sheila f
Title: Romantic and sophisticated beach dining
Review: Wicker tables and chairs on the soft sandy beach at sunset. Whole baked sea bass was amazing - totally bone free but looked whole. Limited menu, tasty food and beautiful presentation on large ceramic platters. Just add a cocktail from the bar.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 896ulrikkem
Title: Great food, beautiful location and very friendly staff
Review: We have eaten at La sal many times both for lunch and dinner as we stayed at the hotel Casa Del Mar. They serve both local Malaysian and Asian dishes as well as European dishes like pasta and pizza. At night they put the tables out on the beach if the weather allows it. It’s recommended to reserve a table if you want to have dinner there. The food is delicious and nicely presented. I mostly tried the Asian dishes which was really tasty, but also the pasta is nice and we tried the small pizzas for lunch a couple of times. The staff at La sal is really friendly and service minded! If you want somewhere special or just great food while in Langkawi I highly recommend this place. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TalalA484
Title: Great
Review: This is a great place to have dinner right before sunset. Can't give recommendation because it differs from person to another. However i would suggest to go for seafood. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ger HLimerick, Ireland
Title: Great meal on the beach
Review: We were staying at the nearby Meritus but after seeing the good reviews for this restaurant we booked it for our last night.We call into the hotel to make the booking and we were made feel very welcome, they even got a F&B manager to speak to us.The setting was lovely, on the beach, but away from the crowds.The food was excellent. We shared a seafood platter.It is not cheap but it is well worth a visitShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MichielB35
Title: Wonderful diner at the beach
Review: We had the traditional Ikan Bakar and the mixed plate of local dishes. Although more expensive than the rest of the island, it was totally worth it, especially the scenery!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sue W
Title: Beach meal watching the sunset
Review:
Lovely food in a beautiful situation.
Some of the price deals include four "free" meals.
Try the beef rendang..
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: russellj691Eccles, United Kingdom
Title: Great Evening Meal on the beach
Review: I'd been waiting for this for two days !!!I tried the Beef Rendang curry for breakfast as part of the 'authentic' section and fell in love with it !!As a main dish it didn't disappoint, with the relishes that were served with it both my wife and I fully enjoyed our Braised Beef Rendang.The only issue was extremely minor in that the poppadom's were a little soft, but I guess in the heat and humidity here at he moment it maybe difficult to keep them crisp.Would we eat here again, yes we would. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: UnaWWatford, United Kingdom
Title: Romantic setting, delicious food, great service
Review: We ate 2 lunches, 4 breakfasts and 4 dinners here over the course of a week. We stayed next door at Meritus Pelangi but did not enjoy their food, service or noisy crowds.Staff at La Sal looked after us so well. Mr Fauzi came along to say hello and check all was well. All the staff were super nice and very efficient.Eating on the beach at night was pure magic. We were never rushed, even when we arrived late one evening and were last to finish.The creative cocktails were yum. Loved the saffron and vanilla martini and the spiced mojitos. We ate tender Aussie beef, melt in the mouth lobster and plenty of local fish.The roti canai we had for breakfast were so flaky and crisp. Fresh fruit cut to order, juices freshly squeezed and tummies full enough to last until evening.Worth every penny. Thank you all so much from U and D, UKShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ilovemyjollies
Title: Beautiful food
Review: We were staying at the hotel and ate here on or final night. The food was a little more expensive than some other local restaurants but well worth it in our opinion. Couldn't fault what we had, and the beach and sunset made it feel very romantic. Highly recommend if you want something special. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AliZ836Baghdad, Iraq
Title: Great tasting food
Review: I went there with my wife had a angus fillet and my wife had a meal of the day ... we enjoyed the taste , the great service ... this is one of the best restaurants in langkawi with view of the beach . Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dale TWellingborough, United Kingdom
Title: Great Hotel & Restaurant
Review: This was far the best food we had in Langkawi and well worth a visit so book if you would like a romantic meal on the beachShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 932deetGosford, Australia
Title: Hit and Miss
Review: Breakfast superb. So much choice and very good. Lunch nice if you have salads or sandwich. Dinners for first three times not good, service friendly but very slow, served dessert one night at 20.55 and ones left in restaurant, it took thirty mins to arrive. One dinner superb but we found out head chef back after being off with sick child, why a hotel of this caliber doesn't have a good underchef beats me. All in all disappointing in such a fantastic resort. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Road757550
Title: Away from it all.
Review: Really cannot fault anything at Casa del Mar. Disappointed not to have had any Grand Marnier though! The staff were friendly and attentive at all times. The food is very good with a range of English and Malaysian dishes. Dinner service at times was slow, but this was mainly due to the number of diners. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Soopau
Title: Beach side pleasure
Review: Fabulous meals in beautiful surroundings. Food choice excellent. Sea bass was fabulous as was the Prawn massala.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 9cx3h4Yokohama, Japan
Title: ROMANTIC　DINNER　TIME
Review: I had dinner for about 5 degrees with INDULGENCE package etc, but DUO is recommended for fish dishes. Australian steak was tasty for meat dishes. Starter is ANDAMAN, dessert is chocolate cake ❓Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Doug HToronto, Canada
Title: great beach location
Review: Food was really good and the service also. On the beach a good wineselection. Pricey . Highly recommendedMoreShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: R1049WWdeborahwKauai, Hawaii
Title: Dinner on the beach is both good and bad
Review: Food was very good...a bit pricey, but very flavorful and refined presentation. The service was great. As i said it is right on the beach which is good, in that the ambience and feel, especially a sunset dinner, provides a beautiful background. The bad--well, sand has a way of getting everywhere!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sherpa703001
Title: Excellent
Review: Went for dinner at La Sal to celebrate my wife's birthday. The service was top notch especially from Anizan FnB staff, very friendly and he also bought an ice cream for my 2 years old daughter. Thank you so much!Food was great and the view was magnificent. Price is a little pricey but worth it with the delicious Angus Beef my wife had and 'Ikan Bakar' for me. The only downside is the lighting and the variety of the menus. I would love to see a variety of western food in the menu just to attract local people like me to go and have a dinner or lunch there. Most of the food is local dishes which is good for foreigner to get a taste of local foods. The area is dark and only 1 light on the table which make us very difficult to eat, especially when I had 'Ikan Bakar'.Overall experience was great. Thumbs up!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Michelle PWoking, United Kingdom
Title: Expensive but tasty
Review: Good menu, tasty food (if a bit cold when served) but much too expensive (especially the wine) for what it was. Staff friendly but inefficient.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: V2090WWdanielpKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No service mind at all
Review: On the way back to our resort from Cenang beach, my wife was quite in a rush, so couldn’t help but entered Casa del mar for restroom. When she went in to the rest room, one staff approached me and asked me whether I stay in the hotel. I said no. And the staff started scold me. He told me that using he toilet you are not stay with is like break into the house and use the toilet there. So sorry for the using the toilet even Im not stay there. Thanks to the staff, we cancelled the booking for the dinner there for the day after the event. They need to learn about what is the hospitality is. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 645pamlWarlingham, United Kingdom
Title: Don’t come if you’re vegan or vegetarian!
Review: 1st night despite being told beforehand, there was very little to eat. I was served with curried noodles ....noodles with curry powder.... it was inedible so I went hungry! And it left a horrible taste in my mouth. No imagination whatsoever, & very disappointing.Surely it’s not too difficult to make laksa ?? Great pity. I am not a fussy eater at all but I am dreading breakfast Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JillBob11Witney, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent as usual.
Review: Attentive staff with a smile, food 5* again, the chef excels himself each time we visit. Wine and cocktails worth going for a visit.We will be back on our next trip.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mickeygian
Title: Dinner for two
Review: Excellent view good service Pina colada  was well made . For the price especially in Langkawi  a touch too expensive .
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: satanbugAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Breakfast only.....
Review: We stopped in just for breakfast based on all the positive reviews. The Hotel itself is sat on the beach with a really nice outdoor area, pool, bar and dining facilities. The breakfast buffet was a little short of inspiration but the a la carte choice was good and my food was excellent. Enjoy.......Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hamiltrjAberdeen
Title: top quality
Review: we were not staying at Casa Del Mar but wanted an good quality meal during our stay in Langkawi.it is expensive compared to most of the other restaurants in Pantai Cenang but the quality and service levels justify the additional costs. really good food!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: asriawangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good dining
Review: Very good breakfast, with wide choices from the buffet and a la carte menu. Fresh juices on request, adequate choices of starters with selection of smoked fish and cured meat and sushi rolls, mini glasses of yogurt with fruits, a selection of cheese and the ubiquitous nasi lemak, which was surprisingly tasteful. Interesting a la carte choices. The Egg Benedict with Salmon (on request), the french toast and the pancake were very good. Excellent service.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SURREYMurrayYateley, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner
Review: Dinner was good but over priced Beach front dining very expensive bar Over rated Service was attentiveShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: IFeetPerth
Title: Dinner on the beach
Review: Wonderful daily food choices, fresh fish and super desserts. A good wine list (although the rose was disappointingly 'off' for our whole week) and a lovely experience overall.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mark SBetchworth, United Kingdom
Title: Food
Review: We ate there as non residents, good food and lovely setting on the beach of an evening, looks very nice place to stayShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Knut U
Title: Best restuarant in Pantai Cenang
Review: Went here twice and the food was really good and the service also. On the beach. Brought my own wine and only paid a small cork fee. Prices a bit high but for Norwegians quite cheap. Highly recommendedShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: linda gDevon
Title: Dont miss the opportunity
Review: We had breakfast each morning of our 10 day stay and enjoyed every one. We had dinner here more than once and whilst more expensive than other food outlets in the town the meals were the best we had in Malaysia.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: must_travel_soon_10
Title: Fabulous breakfast
Review: The breakfast is amazing, so many choices and all well prepared. Lunch and dinner are also quite good and a great break from the casual hawker stands. Good attentive service.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kjayedSydney, Australia
Title: Great food, excellent service
Review: We stayed at Casa Del Mar while in Langkawi and ate at La Sal many times during our stay. We enjoyed the food (the Beef Rendang in particular was absolutely delicious) and the service was outstanding. The prices are reflective of the quality. For in-house guests, the breakfast selection at the restaurant was really impressive (I recommend their banana pancakes!) and best of all - the coffee was really delicious. Highly recommended, and deserving of it’s high TripAdvisor ratings.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: david9138halifax
Title: Good equality food
Review: Great food at cheap prices ,wide selection on offer ,can recommend the classic burger ,and the selection of local dishesShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KeslyneSingapore, Singapore
Title: A must try restaurant even if you are not staying at the hotel
Review: We had 2 nights of dinner at the beach and all the food from appetizers to mains to desserts were delicious. Beautiful ambience and attentive staff. I would definitely come back for dinner on my next visit. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: garycF1382JSPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Went for lunch
Review: The trip to Casa Del Mar was nice. The setting was lovely. We went for lunch having read excellent reviews. Perhaps, given the glowing reviews, the dinner is better. The food was good. However, it was a bit expensive for what we got. In particular, the cod skewers were a disappointment at that price.Overall, glad I went to try it but wouldn't go back. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JIKA_1965Hradec Kralove, Czech Republic
Title: Perfect kitchen
Review: We were there with a bigger group so we tried almost all foods – local and international – from starters to deserts. Everything just perfect. Even the steaks – not common in this area. For us the best kitchen far and wide.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: adrianabU4229FLKirrawee, Australia
Title: Breakfast Yummy!
Review: Our room already included breakfast which was excellent! We loved the variety of the food. We also had lunch and dinner which was excellent.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: John S
Title: Great setting
Review: Quality restaurant in a beautiful setting overlooking Cenang Beach. Walkway on beach provides access to other choices too
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tako14New York City, New York
Title: Delicious!
Review: We have visited Langawi in April. Found this place via tripadvisor, as we wanted to try something different other than our hotel restaurant, food was amazingly delicious. Loved the ambiance and service. Went there for dinner as well as lunch. Both great.Would highly recommend.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bernadette t
Title: Sea-breeze patio, inviting furnishings, and cocktails making skills; surely the best hangout.
Review: the exquisite boho-design of this place and the perfect location call for a toast and there's no place more fitting than the pool bar. the bar is a retro' dream, facing a perfect sunset setting. a must-go for creative cocktails.Craving hand-shaken drinks and creative libations that used tropical fruits, fresh herbs, and handmade bitters. Even a glass of white wine give you the idea that passionate and creative people is working at them.Particular mention: staff is polite and friendly. After eyeing the panorama around along the way, you'd probably look for a good bar to mull over your observations with great drinks.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: brocdogSanta Cruz, California
Title: Fantastic setting, great food
Review: Enjoyed the setting sun from a table out on the beach at this waterfront restaurant...recommend trying the Malaysian food pallet (sampler), which featured beef rendang and other spicy curried dishes - delish! Whole sea bass also recommended - all in all, excellent quality food and service - some of the best I've had in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: shey_La20Singapore, Singapore
Title: sunset best viewed
Review: you will be seated in front of the resort so you have an amazing view of the sunset. the service is really excellent but the food serving is not that much but it taste good.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Samsgrrl00San Francisco, California
Title: Amazing food beautiful setting
Review: Literally the best on the island as far as I am concerned.I had three meals here and all of it was perfection. Watching the sun set and seeing a dramatic thunderstorm move in. All of my meals there were memorable and lovely. Staff is also so amazing, warm ,and lovely.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tmlarv
Title: One of the better places in Pantai Cenang
Review: Visited as a family of 5 adults for dinner. Lovely location right on the beach. Good food, well cooked and served professionally. More expensive than other restaurants in the area but then still good value compared to U.K. One of two restaurants I would return to in Pantai Cenang! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JajgeeCoolangatta, Australia
Title: Delicious, stunning venue, great staff!
Review: The first day we tried a burger (amazing) and a ceasar salad which the presentation was very impressive! Dressing was a little fishy for me but as a whole, was tasty.The cocktail selection complimented the food with your run of the mill cocktails to fruity combos and creative options. I loved the Berry Shortbread!The second visit we got a nachos and a some cocktails. The staff are friendly, helpful and welcoming. The prices aren't too expensive.Such a beautiful location! On the beach and over looking the pool. Stunning.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: malc444Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Romantic Beach dinning
Review: Excellent choice of starters, fish is really fresh and cooked to prefction, sweets are to good to missShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: C8389OWstuartmSydney, Australia
Title: Amazing food to go with the location
Review: Top notch food to go with a top notch location. Sitting right on the beach watching the sunset , having a bottle of wine from a fairly comprehensive wine list, is what this restaurant is all about. The food is flavoursome, the serves are a good size, not too big, and the seafood is exquisitely fresh. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SE18DwellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food, friendly service but not great value
Review: We're judging this based on the fact the hotel sells itself as an upmarket boutique hotel.We ordered...Chef's special Prawn Curry from the daily menu for RM98Oven baked chicken tikka for RM68. Plain rice had to be ordered in addition.3 cocktailsWaterTotal bill was RM315The meal is a story of two halves. I had the chicken. It was really tasty. The selection of flavours and textures I'd not experienced in other dishes in Langkawi. It came with some lentils and a salsa type dressing and I was left happily full at the end. My girlfriend was neither happy nor full but acknowledged that the curry was tasty. Her rice serving was smaller than mine and whilst the prawn 'gravy' was also tasty, there just wasn't enough of it. There were 3 prawns in a small bowl - not overly large prawns either - so, when you consider the cost vs volume, it didn't represent good value in comparison to other local restaurants. The cocktails were tasty but a little less sweet than they should have been. The daiquiri, whilst tasty, still had all the berry seeds in, which should have been strained out. Basic stuff for a 5* place. The location, sitting on the beach was lovely however, the outdoor bar with fire jugglers about 100 m down the beach was playing 90s dance tunes that were clearly audible to us so that ruined a little of the tranquility. It wasn't really a problem for us but to others it might be, hence me mentioning it. Similarly, our table was beside the walkway so people walked past only a meter or two away from us. The other thing I found annoying was the lighting. There are small table lamps on each table but even with that moved to the middle of the table I still couldn't see what I was eating properly. Other tables were over lit as they were closer to the main lights, whilst my food was invisible due to my own shadow.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: flierexmelbourne
Title: lovely restaurant, great staff
Review: We ate here three times, and although it was expensive by local standards, the food was very good. The seabass was a particular favourite, and waitress Azura absolutely lovely. Portions were large and lovely wines available extensive, though by no means cheap. I would certainly recommend it as a lovely setting and a change from some of the offerings locally.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: James B
Title: Good food, great service.
Review: Stayed at the Casa Del Mar and ate breakfast here every morning. Good selection from the light buffet selection or you can order off the menu. I enjoyed it and the staff were very attentive. Had one non-seafood dinner at La Sal and it was cooked properly and was quite tasty.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 275lisantGeldrop, The Netherlands
Title: Best food in langkawi
Review: Very very good restaurant everything was perfect! Romantic table at the beach, te view is amazing around sunset! The food is absolutely the best in Langkawi, we paid 120 rm for a main course and that was the most expensive one. The staff is also very professional! You pay a little bit more but its worth every penny!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ChezPapaPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very pleasant
Review: It's such a treat to stick your feet in sand and dine under the stars by the sea and this is exactly what La Sal offers you.The food was amazing especially the Thai Beef Salad and Lobster.Could not give La Sal and excellent review because half the wines on the wine list was not available, so perhaps it's time to reprint? Also, we had to top up our wines ourselves many times - there's nothing wrong with that, except for the fact that at least 4 waiters were chatting amongst themselves ( we had two bottles). Also, by 10pm, they seemed in a hurry to close, so we never got asked if we wanted dessert. Good for our waste lines, I suppose.Nevertheless, thank you La Sal for a great evening, and we shall be back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LBaker1804Singapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful dinner
Review: Had a gorgeous dinner with friends here. Situated on the beach front, this restaurant is a winner! The staff were attentive and friendly and the food was delicious. It's a fine dining sort of place so the portions aren't enormous but they definitely fill you up and hey, if you're still hungry then order dessert because that was also to die for! I highly recommend the fish dishes - so fresh and tasty. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: silkdaleAustralia
Title: Best in Langkawi
Review: The food is as good as any 5 star restaurant anywhere. One of the best steaks I've ever had. The tables are placed just far enough apart that you aren't listening to other conversations. The staff are the best as well.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sergey YPhuket, Thailand
Title: very nice dinner by the beach
Review: Went there with friends for dinner, came around 7pm and the beach was still quite crowded, a lot of vehicles towing various watercraft passing by. But when the sun set down the sunset views were absolutely stunning. The food was fabulous, very well prepared and mouthwatering tasty. Wine list is nice and extensive. Would recommend to visitShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: slbhdLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Could be better
Review: While visiting the hustle and bustle of Pantai Cenang, did not come across any decent restaurants for a meal, after checking TripAdvisor came across La Sal, called them and they advised that they might find us a table. We reached the restaurant which is inside the Casa Del Mar restaurant (still cannot understand the good reviews this hotel gets, the place did not look appealing at all!), we were asked to wait while they sorted a table in the public beach.The setting could be excellent, however having cars driving around the beach it kinda takes the novelty away.The service was average and the staff could have been more welcoming! The food was to a good standard but nothing to rave about, the trio choc dessert was the highlight of the meal.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RegH265Thame, United Kingdom
Title: Great beachside cocktails
Review: If you want a great evening view with really good cocktails then the bar at La Sal is one to try. The service is polite and relaxed, there's no rush here and its worth just watching the world pass and the sun set.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cameron B
Title: Excellent
Review: To start with, when we first arrived the service was pretty slow.We were sat at a table on the beach. But once they got into the groove it was on point.Staff are bery polite and professional. My wife and I both started with soup (pumpkin and the other tomatoe) which was amazing.I had the steak and the wife had the cabanara, both meals really good.Trio of choc for desert which I would highly recommend. Views are amazing especially over sun set.It is reasonably pricey but the quality of the the food is well worth it.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dorea GSingapore, Singapore
Title: Incredible quality of food & drinks!
Review: We had the salmon and the "fish of the day" - pan fried halibut with crab rice, and both completely surpassed our expectations. The halibut was melt-in-your-mouth and the salmon was accompanied by the most delicious lemon butter sauce. We tried their special spiced mojitos and they were perfect too. Unfortunately it was raining and they could not set up the beach dining area, but the ambience of the restaurant was nice enough. Price of each main course and cocktail was about MYR 80 and MYR 30 respectively. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sdhilawsingapore
Title: Romantic dining on the beach
Review: We recently had dinner at this excellent restaurant. It offers al fresco dining right on the beach. The food is excellent - they offer a mix of Asian and Western cuisine. It's not cheap though but still highly recommended if you have that budget reserved for a special occasion.There are 2 big downside:- there is a convoy of vehicles driving past right on the beach taking the jet skis out for the evening, and- the hotel next door has loud music pumping which is quite jarring to the lovely atmosphere It's shocking that the Langkawi authorities allows vehicles on the beach !Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tascha007
Title: ok
Review: honestly i did not think the food here was that great, a lot of the time we would eat at restaurants outside the hotel.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MiziMohammadLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Wedding Anniversary Celebration!! 5 stars
Review: THANK YOU VERY MUCH to all staff that was very helpful for the surprise arrangement for my wife, 5th Wedding Anniversary. Best service crew and very nice environment on the beach. Really like the menu selection and will be recommended to all my friend. Sure will come again for next event.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: arunikaekawatiSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of my favorite place
Review: The first impression was ok, from 1 - 5, it was 2.We arrived quite late at 2130hrs, the welcome can be better. COLD! The staff mentioned "kitchen is nearly close, you must order very quickly".Made up our mind with a bottle of champagne ordered, then the staffs attitude changed to become somewhat friendly.The most important part was food and ambiance! Wow......Romantic dinner at the beach, top quality of food! Will come back certainly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MattFrederickRotherham, United Kingdom
Title: Fine dining to make a change....
Review: Booked via email for our last night on Pentai Cenang. Staff confirmed the booking and it appears you get the table for the night, from 7 onwards.Staff very professional, polite and attentive. More of a fine dining experience with the usual attention to detail you would expect.The menu choices where interesting and a great range of flavours to suit all. My starter (stuffed chicken breast with pear & blue cheese) was beautiful. Unfortunately I had the crab linguine for main which was very average. However, the puddings again where great.Good choice of wines but the prices go up excessively (& unnecessary) steep.Cheap compared to U.K. Prices but very expensive for Langkawi. We had a better meal at FatCupid for less (but it's more effort to get to!)Overall I would recommend if budget allows Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DaveandCaz44Abergele, United Kingdom
Title: Food gets even better !
Review: We stayed for the fourth time at Casa and once again enjoyed fantastic food, service and ambience at La Sal. The food seemed to have improved even more since we last stayed 5 years ago, not that we thought it could. Service is prompt and the staff are all incredibly helpful and friendly (list of names to thank will be in our separate review of the hotel itself). Due to unusually dodgy weather during our stay, we didn't get to eat on the beach, however on the one occasion we tried, but only got as far as starting our main course before a storm hit, the staff were brilliant. We ran for cover and they brought our food inside so we could continue.Al in all we ate dinner at the restaurant 7 times during our stay even though our package only included 4 dinners...why go anywhere else ? The 2 times we ate dinner away from La Sal were at another very special place on the Island which we knew we wanted to go to....otherwise we would have been happy to eat there every night !Breakfast, lunch, tapas, dinner.....every morsel we ate was fantastic. Thanks La Sal....Jumpa Lagi !Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: smurfgal02Melbourne, Australia
Title: Rude staff at dining area
Review: I wanted to dIne there and was greeted with a rude staff at the dining area. He was discriminating me as a solo female traveller .I blatantly told him that I just wanted to dIne there and I liked the place . He told me the place was full despite many empty tables.I was turned away without any apology and I felt discriminated as a local malaysian.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Still amazing
Review: La Sal is the perfect place for beachside dining and if early enough to watch the sunset. Large menu choice (mainly fish) but other local and international dishes to try too. Food is cooked and served to a very high standard. What are you waiting for give it a try.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: WinternsummerBahrain
Title: Best in the area!!!
Review: WE stayed at this hotel, and thought we should try other restaurants also, but in the end the best meals we had were at this restaurant. Maybe not cheap, but worth it. Rather pay a bit more for great food, then pay a bit less for terrible food, which did happen in other places!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SmillaRydeRyde
Title: Better than excellent!
Review: We didn't stay at Casa Del Mare but had booked a table to have dinner and luckily the weather was good so we sat right on the beach. The tables were beautifully decorated and who doesn't enjoy warm sand as the floor and the sky as your roof! Well we did! As we were a group of 7 we had a variety of dishes and they were all amazing. The service was exceptional, I'd say second to none and we had an unforgettable evening. It's really a place not to be missed! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: _H1413NRSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice dinner at the beach
Review: We had some very good cocktails and pasta for dinner. Attentive staff with reasonably priced food. I would go again for a romantic dinner on the beach watching the sunset. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Joanne HMalaysia
Title: 5th time likely our last
Review: We've been to La Sal 5 times in the last 14 years. We got married here 14 years ago, where we booked out casa del mar, as it was newly opened. It was magical then. But it's far from magical now. Granted we didn't make a booking this time around, but we didn't expect such a huge drop in service. We were happy to wait for our table and ordered prior to being seated (as suggested by one of the wait staff), so that the food would arrive promptly once seated.The food was rather disappointing, all the pastas we ordered were very salty (there were 4 of us). The waiters were talking loudly from across tables and stations. Lots of clanging as they cleared tables and you could hear them cracking jokes from their wait station. Service was a real let down and a far cry from what it once was. There were no warm bread served, or an offer of mosquito repellent - this was once the standard.Flickering candles replaced by electric/battery lamps. Operational convenience to replace charm and romance. Pantai Cenang is incredibly busy and very commercialised, so be prepared for a ton of noise and vehicles bustling up and down the beach.Perhaps we might return to the place we tied the knot, but only because of memories, not because we think highly of the food or service. At least, not anymore.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: danqbrHamburg, Germany
Title: Excellent dinner
Review: We experienced this restaurant during our stay at Casa del Mar (as a stress less alternative for our last evening) and got excellent quality in nice atmosphere with a high variety of beverages and really nice staff around. Also the possibility to take a drink afterwards at the bar close to the beach. Absolutely recommendable.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Teacher2014Kuwait
Title: Worth Every Penny
Review: Great sunset with awesome service. We had 6 drinks and three course meals for three of us and was less than 150 usd or 660 myr. The food was deliah with good presentation. The ambiance of the beach was great.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: melanieishSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely place for a romantic dinner.
Review: The food was excellent and the service was really good. Food is not overly priced and you get to watch the sun setting. I will definitely come back for more!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: angelmaya
Title: Best Dinner Ever and Nice View
Review: Was great evening at Casa Del Mar .. The napkin was so warm when presented to me.. Felling so good... The food was feeling wow, really tasty and the desert was amazing.. Waiter was Harun who look after us... Very friendly and always ask our satisfaction which makes our dinner to be wonderful. Will come back again and will look for waiter Harun to be my oder taker.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Salmac102Inverness, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food, service & sunsets
Review: We ate here on a few occasions during our stay at the hotel and thought the food was very good, a little more expensive than on the street restaurants but worth paying the extra for good quality food. Cashew chicken was good, everything we had was good. The chocolate desert was particularly worth the wait, so delicious. Just loved our stay here and would not hesitate to go back. Dinner on the beach-marvellous! A shame though there is some beach traffic, 4 x 4s towing out various jets Skiis and boats etc, didn't bother us too much, otherwise it truly would be paradise, we witnessed terrific sunsets while enjoying dinner. Only thing I would suggest, some better lighting during dinner other than that we enjoyed our meals.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: moggiemo50London, United Kingdom
Title: Love,y location superb food
Review: Right on the beach, food is very high standard, wine reasonably priced. Service impeccable. If you're in Langkawi you should give it a tryShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Michael F
Title: Hot march day Food
Review: We took refuge from the heat at the restaurant. Western . Burgers, fish and chips. The usual expensive Langkawi LIMA prices. Taste was good.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rby25PERTHPerth, Australia
Title: Dining on the Beach
Review: This was our second visit to Casa del Mar(4yrs previously). The previous visit just to dine was excellent, a great choice of menu, highly recommended and lived up to all the reviews we had read on Trip Advisor...a great place for a special occasion.It was my husbands birthday ,so our first choice this year was Casa del Mar ..it was disappointing, a vast change to our previous visit..Firstly, it really isn't the place to have a special dinner...the tables are no longer on the premises of the hotel but all on the beach, with a boardwalk behind the tables!!!!! A constant stream of people all evening...so much for the romantic dinner!!!!!! Added to that is the noise from 4wd vehicles...and I'm sure no one really knows how to drive on sand as nearly everyone became bogged which led to the revving of the engine, digging theirselves deeper into the sand, and even louder noise and fumes!!!! It was a constant flow of people , noise and vehicles.....we could have been in Bali!!!! As for the menu there was hardly any choice for vegetarian dishes , and the fish portion my husband had was quite small. This menu was so disappointing.The service was good. considering the ratio of tables to waiters...but sad to say this Hotel/restaurant is just a time of change now as is Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Howard RToronto, Canada
Title: Dropped in for lunch at the beach
Review: Food was good but pricey. Convenient beach location with a beautiful view. They were out of one of the 2 items we selected.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: shamuddinsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wedding anniversary dinner
Review: March 15, 2017 was our wedding anniversary and since we are in Langkawi for a seminar, we decided to celebrate it here. Based on my search and recommendations La Sal came top. True enough the sitting arrangement was excellent - by the beach with nice breeze and we managed to enjoy the sunset. Food was excellent and the staff was very friendly especially Marwan and Dean. They truly made our dinner memorable. Will certainly recommend and promote La Sal to my friends.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: smileykoLos Angeles, California
Title: Five Star Dinner with your Feet in the Sand!
Review: I was there last week in Langkawi and I didn't stay at this hotel. I found it by walking almost the full length of the beach La Sal is on. It's not a restaurant in a tradition sense. But this place is special, I was glad when I got here. The staff very welcoming. I had no reservation. They set up another table for me on the sand. Feel free to kick off your shoes, I did. The wine was chilled just right, service was warm and attentive. Everyone was at the bar drinking. At once during the beautiful sunset we all took pictures then all sat down almost at the same time. The food, now the food is not beach or jungle it's fine dining. I told them to take their time, what's the hurry? The moon is coming up. This is a place you will think about for years to come.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bray363London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: Super food fantastic staff best place to watch the sunset while having a first class meal best beef rending I have ever had as well as super cocktails if your in Pantai Chennai treat yourselves you will love it .Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Happyholidayer7Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional Food and Service
Review: Popped in here for lunch. This time we were on a cruise and having covered most of Langkawi in the past, whilst the others went on trips, we did our own thing and headed for Pantai Chennai. We had previously stayed at Casa del Mar and liked the restaurant so decided to return for lunch. The service was every bit as good as it was 7 years ago. After choosing our table, we were presented with the cold mint smelling towels I remembered from before. When they realised we had stayed before, they brought over a glass each of the Bellini they are reknowned for. Lunch could not go by without ordering one of their cocktails and I had the five spice mohito. They do the best cocktails I can recall anywhere and they don't taste of cheap fruit juice. We also ordered the lime juice which comes with a small glass of sugar syrup should you wish to sweeten it.The food was as delicious as ever and so well presented on a plate topped with a banana leaf. We both opted for the chicken rendang which was accompanied by about 4 condiments rangeing in heat intensity. Afterwards we were served with the complimentary iced lollies I remembered receiving each afternoon whilst relaxing by the pool or on the beach. It made for a nice way of whiling away a few hours until we returned to the jetty. The staff are the best and I would recommend this restaurant, and if looking for a small friendly hotel, with great service, you can't go wrong with Casa del Mar.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Peter M
Title: Great cocktails
Review: Stopped here for cocktails after dinner. Great list of cocktails to make your way through - and unlike some other locations the cocktails makers know how to make the drinks named! Nice views from the beach area!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: massimomaniloCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Very overrated and uber-overpriced!
Review: We booked a table in the restaurant for dinner for my birthday celebration. Very overrated and uber-overpriced! Bad food ,slow service and very expensive .Such a shame.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: VamosBoyCrete
Title: Excellent!
Review: The prices her are on the high side for Malaysia but the quality of food, excellence of service and location on the beach at sunset make it value for money in European terms.The food was very tasty and beautifully presented. We had soft shell crab to start and then the rock lobster risotto and the "pallet" of Malaysian dishes for main. The Malaysian food was lovely with a good level of spice and the rock lobster really tasty. We also had a bottle of Sauvignon Blanca which, having just come from Thailand, seemed good value.Pantai Cenang has many local restaurants serving cheap tasty food, but La Sal offers much more; wonderful service and an evening to remember. Worth every cent.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HollySKLeeds England
Title: Spectacular Sunset
Review: We visited for dinner. The resort looked very nice, upmarket, small boutique and on a great beach location.Beach cocktail bar was busy and we arrived for happy hour. Great cocktails and great value.We had reserved a beach table for see the sunset and were not disappointed. Good service and we were given a frontline table.We shared a prawn starter and had the lobster risotto and Malay prawn curry. All the food was delicious. The wine was also good and again reasonable priced.Very nice evening. Get there early for the sunset.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Carole T
Title: Excellent food
Review: Really enjoyable meal on the beachfront. Good portion sizes and not haute cuisine as a lot of fine dining is. Great service, lots of choice and looking forward to eating there again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Despina TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious food with an unforgettable sunset view
Review: With our accommodation package we had four dinners included. For starters I would suggest you try the delicious Caesar Salad with chicken which looks amazing and tasty great. I had this every time and every time it was delicious. I also tried the Fettucine Carbonara and thoroughly enjoyed it. We were a group of six and every time all of us enjoyed what we ordered. For dessert you must try the Deep fried Corn Crumb Banana fritter as it is a piece of art on a plate. Great staff but service can sometimes be a bit slow. The view is magnificent and extremely tranquil. Would thoroughly recommend this restaurant to anyone who visits Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Maggie WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food and friendly attentive service
Review: Coming to Casa del Mar hotel is like coming to stay with friends. Ate at their restaurant on the beach and were looked after very well. I had the beef rending, tender meat and just the right amount of spice. Their crispy soft shell crab is also excellent. Good choice of wines too. We keep coming back here. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JMQLD16Brisbane, Australia
Title: Truly beautiful dinner with amazing sunset view
Review: We were guided to a table on the beach as the sun was setting. The service was impeccable as was the food. We were given bread to start and I followed that with an entree of prawns and scallops it was delicious. For main I had the Malaysian platter which gave a taste of different flavors also delicious.this restaurant is expensive by Langkawi standards but to get the view the standard of food etc in Australia it would be double the price so I think it is good value for the money. You do need to book here. Make sure you don't miss this when in Langkawi Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Tom P
Title: Great setting
Review: Had dinner here for a special occasion, and it was very special. We had a table right on the beach watching the beautiful sunset. We both ordered the sea bass which was superb. The chef had deboned and reconstructed the fish, which was a lovely touch. Recommended for a special occasion. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GEORGE1953Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Eating on the beach
Review: This is a good experience of eating certainly different, eating your meal on the beach .the service was good the food was good bit expensive for what you get.The wine per bottle is quite expensive about same cost as we would pay in a nice restaurant in the UK.but worth it just for the surroundings. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sunshinebobspain
Title: Good food on a great beach
Review: Romantic beach front tables with good quality food and excellent service. The starters are a little thin to be honest but you won't struggle to find something but the mains are top notch.The cheese starter makes a fantastic desert along with some rather passable port.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bwoodsy88Fleet, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing dining on the beach
Review: Stunning setting for sunset. Food was amazing, I ordered the Malaysian pallet to try a few different things, the cocktails were also great. Definitely would recommend, particularly to sit on the beach for sunset! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TomRockyHeilbronn, Germany
Title: Beautiful beach restaurant
Review: Very nice setting and kids friendly. We had chicken and fish, the kids enjoyed burger. Chicken was a little try but overall nobody should expect Michelin star kitchen. Only problem was that we had to use our flashlight apps after sunset in order to find the food on the table.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sooria_PragashPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dinner on the beach sand
Review: My son and I wanted to experience Dinner on the by the beach, so we went over to La Sal at Casa Del Mar. Its not easy to get a table here is its mainly reserved for in-house guest. We were lucky to get one as our timing was good. I tried the local Malaysian dish Ikan Bakar and it was delicious. This place is perfect for Couples.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ellenharroKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner and cocktails at sunset
Review: I had a wonderful evening at La Sal. We booked an early table for dinner at 6:30 and enjoyed cocktails on the the beach whilst watching the sunset. Cocktail menu is extensive and has good choice and variety. Dinner food was tasty and we ended the meal with a round of Espresso Martinis which could not be faulted. If you are looking for a place to enjoy a special meal or celebrate a birthday this would be just right. It is definitely worth getting there early to watch the sunset too. It's an early start to the evening but worth it. The spot is so picturesque.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: V2090WWdanielpKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So so
Review: You can enjoy your dinner with chilled sea breeze. But I think this place is not as good as its reputation. I'm not sure that it was because of the darkness, but most of the staffs were emphasized on chatting than look around for better service. Our drinks were served long time after our order and food was much more like cold when they were served.(Was 295RM Cuisine) Anyway, Cashunut Chicken was nice. Finally we decided to shift to another restaurant which was more welcomed and delicious. Will never visit again. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TheAstuteTravellerSpain
Title: Excellent
Review: Dined here twice in three days as their menu included approximately 10 delicious Gluten free options with an amazing pear crumble for dessert. Fantastic beach front restaurant. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: _wawashiraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner by the beach
Review: Had made a reservation and we were seated in the indoor seating due to the wet weather. Initially we wanted to have the sunset view but due to unforeseen weather, we did not experience the beautiful sunset. Disappointing but hey its not the restaurant's fault though. Anyway, on the table was provided with a mosquito spray. Yes, mosquitoes. I wore a long sleeve cardigan so yeah, no bites. The servers were pleasant and welcoming. I saw they explained to the tourists of the Malay food they ordered, that's good. We ordered prawns n scallops for starter and Malaysian platter for the main. The main course was exceptionally delicious, on point. But the starter was a disappointing one. I would have rate this as 4 star if I was able to experience the sunset, thus 3 stars for that. But, service wise does not fall short. Will def come again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Amanda TWoolpit, United Kingdom
Title: Fine beach dining!
Review: Escorted to the table with menu offered promptly.Extensive cocktail list and would recommend the Bellini rangeStarters of crab and prawns were delicious and such imaginative presentation.Main meals chosen were the Malaysian pallet and steak, both being equally well presented and no skimping on size! Bottle of dizzy complemented the meal with one banana fritters dessert and 2 spoons to finish.All in all a ' Very nice meal' -Had in a lovely location under the moon and stars.Only negative comment would be the noise from the bar next door with a constant boom...but then neither is the public footpath that seems to seperate the hotel from the diners on the beach or the local 'Freeway on the waters edge' with 4x4 vehicles pulling boats from the water or local louts speeding along the sand - so strange and less than romantic for either reason as little Calm and peace under the night sky. But that's pantai Chenang for you and not Pentai Tengah which is much quieter!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JoeyMumblesLincoln, United Kingdom
Title: "Dining at Dusk"
Review: Based on the beach at the front of aforementioned Hotel/Resort.Nice setting although be prepared for Mozzies and other associated bugs. Repellent is providedTables dimly lit by lantern though they do give you a little torch to read menu.Food was v good had tangy Asian beef( v good meat for Malaysia) salad and is personal favourite of mine to start.My main Ikan Bakar(burned fish) a Malay speciality which was grilled sea bass with a tangy thick sauce inside and had a sambal to accompany which was v addictive. Wife had hot and spicy green duck curry which again was excellent.Nice white Bordeaux to accompany. Service was v friendly but a tad haphazard and after we initially sat down we did have to remind waiter we were there. Also after wine was initially poured it wasn't again and no check backs. Food worthy of 5 ⭐️ service although acceptable not so. Price reasonable when compared to be back in UK obviously not the cheapest option option in Panti Cenang but amongst the best.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FHMillenniumhotelOslo, Norway
Title: FABULOUS!
Review: Omg! This was the absolutly most incredable dinner on our whole asia trip for months! My boyfriend had the angus beef with chives truffle mashed potatoe and mango salsa and I ate the most amazing lobster with risotto. Unfortanley the beach tables were not available for dinner even tough we had hoped to watch the sunset while having dinner. But it had been raining the whole afternoon so be aware of that if you really want to sit on the beach, call them before and ask. But food and drinks tasted amazing anyways. Super cute and professional service! Only - Mango daquiri wasn't very good. TastelessRecommended for everyone who really like to expirence a classy and amazing dinner when visiting Langkawi! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GoodGodYesOslo, Norway
Title: Perfect Dinner on the Beach
Review: Stunning views, amazing food, gorgeous attentive staff and just a generally lovely sunset dinner. They are NOT stingy with the alcohol in their cocktails, the wine is devine and they have an awesome cheese platter to go with the beautiful food. I already want to go back to try out more of their cocktails and food options, I couldn't order everything I wanted as I already needed to be rolled out of there full of food and drink, fabulous 40th birthday dinner. Totally recommend.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bianca J
Title: Beautiful dinner
Review: What a beautiful dinner we had here in the beach. Attentive staff (especially the bar staff!!) and delicious food in the most stunning location on the sand. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sandie DEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Romantic Experience
Review: Fine dining, fabulous food. Great experience. Wonderful location.Expensive in comparison to the local street cafes however a real treat which is worth it for an occasion.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Avril K
Title: Nice
Review: Nice dinner on the beach last night. The beef rendang was the best one I had during my trip to Malaysia. Just had ice cream for dessert and it was half melted by the time it arrived. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CBear888Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: Lovely staff, lovely food, amazing place to sit and watch the sunset while dining on absolutely mouth watering food, we went back three nights in a row, just brilliant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kahiromijpTokyo, Japan
Title: Romantic dinner at beach
Review: Delicious food and very nice staffs who helped to chose the food and pair it with a good wine. The atmosphere at the beach and the candles complete the romantic scene. The only negative thing is that reading the menu we had no idea of which food would be spicy or not, I think it should be described. The place is not cheap, but I really recommend a try.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: janicew766Hong Kong, China
Title: We visited here 3 times in 5 days
Review: The best thing in Langkawi that happened to us.Tasty and creative dishes.Nice drinks (except Singapore sling, I'm afraid)Lovely cat.Tranquil atmosphere.Pretty, handsome, cheerful and helpful staff.And very fair price!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: robharry2015Perth, Australia
Title: Excellent food
Review: Also staying at the hotel . Food is awaesome , beautifully presented . Value for money good . By far the best restaurant in the island .Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JOF2702Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, great service!
Review: We stayed at the nearby Pelangi Meritus Resort, but came here for the food. The service is good - the server chatted with us and is conversant in English. The food is good, though they came a bit slower than I would like them to be. What I like most is the dessert - the banana wrapped in pastry and deep fried - a reinterpretation of the malay classic goreng pisang. Simply deliciious!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: adambZ1562XZ
Title: Very enjoyable beach side lunch
Review:
Really enjoyed Lunch at the La Sal Restuarant. Everything we ordered was promptly served and the food was of a high standard. The Staff were attentive and keen to help. 

All in all a great experience.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ivan HToronto, Canada
Title: Food poisoning. Extremely disappointed.
Review: Was here on a 3 day trip and stayed at Meritus right beside. I decided to treat my family to a nice dinner here on the last night when I found this place as one of the top restaurants on TripAdvisor. Well the food was great, probably as good as it gets on the island. I had the duo of lamb which was the most expensive item on the menu and my brother had the special of the day - red chicken curry. My mother had the cod. We all shared each other's food BUT my mother didn't have the red curry. And middle of the night both my brother and I woke up puking for a good hour everything we had inside. We went back first thing the next morning to talk to staff so they could do something about it hopefully no one else gets sick but they didn't respond very well claiming we are not guests so it must not be their food - that was not cool. No apology. Nothing. We just wanted them to heck with their chefs and kitchen to make sure no one else will get sick. Very disappointed and would recommend anyone to skip here and try the other top restaurants. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Vicki TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Right on the beach
Review: The tables are set up right on the beach head there before sunset and watch the sun go down .The menu has great variety of local and international dishes with a good wine list to match .Good service provided by the staff a really nice experienceShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ss1520Malaysia
Title: Great beach view and good service
Review: Celebrating husband birthday here together with friends. It was a nice experience as the tables were set on the beach with nice view. Dishes were up to standard and great customer services. However, the price was a bit at the high side and the place was dark after sunset. Kids complaint on mosquito and not able to see what they aet :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TamGuna
Title: Great view and service and food was good
Review: This restaurant had great service and a great view (being right on the beach). The food to me was good but nothing special and definitely did not match the price.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SarahN4174
Title: Beautiful atmosphere with good food.
Review: My friends and I were looking for a nice (somewhere not too casual) restaurant to wrap up our Langkawi trip. In terms of price, La Sal had one of the most reasonably priced menu amongst other places that we called and surveyed. The dining experience by the beach was just spectacular. I ordered the Ikan Bakar (Grilled Fish which was also the Chef's Specialty) and it surpassed by expectations. It came as a whole fish, with rice, some cucumber and carrot salad and some pickles and sambal (chili paste). If you're looking to try something different, I would definitely recommend this dish.price: ikan bakar RM89, salmon RM 78, pasta RM48 - 60++To top it all, we were served with bread and garlic while waiting for our meals to arrive. Tips: Do come early to the restaurant. We came at 7.15 and just about missed the sunset. Heads up: Mosquitoes. So apply the mosquito repellent (which is provided) before sundown.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BernardLiowMalaysia
Title: The perfect place for our wedding anniversary celebration
Review: This restaurant was the right choice for our wedding anniversary dinner. The tables were set on the beach area, sand was soft and not too windy last night. The setting was romantic, with a great view, but it was cloudy so we didn't get to see a beautiful sunset. I thought this place would be even better if there is some light music, currently its quiet and peaceful which isn't that bad either.We had soft shell crab for starter, angus beef fillet and cod fish for mains, and a bottle of Chandon wine. Everything's good, we loved it. The restaurant knew we were here for our anniversary, they surprised us with a delicious cheese cake dessert on a nicely decorated plate after our meal.Overall very good service, attentive and well trained staff. We were served mostly by Faiz, thank you for the wonderful night! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Travelcat90
Title: Disappointed
Review: I had heard good things about this restaurant so my partner and I went along for dinner one night. The customer service was great. Staff were very attentive. Unfortunately the food was below average and over priced for what we were given. The pasta I had was very basic and could have been made at home easily, def not anything to brag about. The cocktail I had was a lot better than others on the island, however over priced for what it was Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LoughCorkAlbufeira, Portugal
Title: Not value for money
Review: All four of us at the table agreed that the meal was poor especially for the top end pricing. The steak was over priced and sub standard. Very disappointing. My wife and I had actually booked a 5 night stay for next year. We had the meal, and immediately cancelled our booking.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TheScoutGlen Waverley, Australia
Title: Fabulous
Review: Best food we had in Langkawi. Great service and friendly. We sat on the beach and had 4 fantastic meals . The views are great - what a great way to spend a balmy evening. We had lots of drinks, beers, bottle of wine gin and tonics. 4 entrees and 4 mains. Bill was RM850. So not cheap by local rices but good value for Australians.You may need to book a table at busy periods. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TravelerFarnhamUKLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant in Casa del Mar - creative food and great service
Review: Ate here a few times during our one week stay in Langkawi. Good menu with some interesting Malaysian dishes and some that are little more fusion. When the weather is fine eating on the beach is lovely. Good choice of wines and all the staff are very friendly and professional.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jeroen vHoofddorp, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
Title: Lunch was a treat at Casa del Mar
Review: We stayed 4 nights at the adjacent Meritus Penlagi Beach Resort and we were looking for another place for lunch. It was a gift finding the restaurant at the Casa del Mar This hidden gem has a beautiful setting on the beach and offers amazing food and service. Service was excellent and staff very attentive.The crispy soft shell crab with mango grapefruit salsa dish I had was amazing and worth every bite. We tasted one of the best lunches in Malaysia so far. Compliments to the chef and staff and highly recommended for all travelers.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BartV750Kapelle-op-den-Bos, Belgium
Title: Great location with good food
Review: Had a weekend getaway from KL at Meritus hotel and decided to go for dinner at La Sal next door, based on the food ratings. Perfect sunset location in combination with good food. Pricy nut classy with good food. The Surf and Turf starter was a bit disappointing, dish looked great but meat was dry. The Mek Mek Mek dish (lamb rack) was good. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kariishma
Title: Awesome food and great experience
Review: We went here to have lunch. It was a hot sunny day so preferred sitting inside. The orders we made were customized as per our taste and preferences. The experience was value for money.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LaosLifeVientiane, Laos
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: There's always an expectation visiting a high end restaurant. This one coming highly recommended from the TripAdvisor community.I'd say it didn't disappoint, but it didn't surpass expectations either. It was quite good for what it is - but don't expect too much!Me and my wife both had a three course meal with drinks. Bill was about 500 MYR. All food was nice, though nothing that was really standout. Service was pleasant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: daviditovey
Title: Great staff - always friendly and helpful
Review: One of the highlights of our holiday was dinner on the beach. Excellent food and 5 star service. We have also enjoyed snacks and cocktails, and the hotel's brilliant breakfast. Thanks to all the staff for being so helpful and endlessly attentive.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FahmiK87
Title: THE BEST DINNER IN LANGKAWI
Review: The best dinner in the island,the foods is fantastic and marvellous,ask the chef and they will gladly cook it for you.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: amac1974Il Gzira, Malta
Title: Birthday Meal
Review: I celebrated my birthday with a wonderful of the beach at La Sal and it is safe to say I was very happy! Although we were familiar with the staff as we were guests at the hotel the level of service was still second to none.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 286zubairk
Title: Best Restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Just had a great memorable meal by the sea at La Sal. Everything was sublime and every dish was well thought of and executed perfectly! The chefs and waiting staff at this restaurant must be the finest on the island, if not the country!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DaHotstepperLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best dining experience in Langkawi
Review: Booked La Sal at Casa del Mar for our last evening in Langkawi. I now wished i had booked to stay at the hotel itself too. From the moment you walk through the doors, a cool, fresh minty aroma hits you and the experience has begun.The route to the restaurant area on the beach is that of a quaint and boutique set-up.
