Set on Pantai Cenang's stunning beach, romantic meals as the sun sets is what this place is all about.The service is second-to-none with staff both personable and gentle - nothing brash or overbearing - which i cannot stand when dining out.I had myself an incredible Malay Platter which was an orgasm of flavours and an experience which will stay with me for a very long time.'Chiro', the lovely gentleman that made my wife, daughter and i very welcome whilst tending to us, is to be commended for his level of service. Polite, courteous and attentive, he had a little chat with us towards the end of the meal which was a nice touch.The only downside (if i can call it that) - not enough highchairs for babies. Although one did become available later in the evening when it became vacant on another table.We didn't consume any alcohol, both had a three-course meal, and the bubba had a few dishes too and all came to around RM350 - around £70! Not bad i say!! Oh, and please leave room (and time) for the dessert as the 'Trio of Chocolate' is both worth the wait and the experience - just delicious.All-in-all, one of the best dining experiences i've ever had. If ever i'm in Langkawi again (and this was my 2nd time in a decade), i will both stay at the hotel and dine at the restaurant without fail - highly recommended.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GJTMILF1988
Title: Not the greatest based on price
Review: Food was okay. Paid quite abit for small portioned average food. Service and atmosphere was nice though.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: angelachau87
Title: It was an average feed.
Review: We went to this restaurant as it had great reviews. The service was friendly and attentive. My husband ordered a chefs special. It was a steak dish which costs around 118rm. The meal was nice although I have definitely tasted better. Overall, an okay experience.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Still Great!
Review: Was here 2 years ago for the La Luna dinner, been here again on the 25th of September to celebrate 3 years anniversary with my boyfriend. The caesar salad is still amazing and never fail to satisfy me. Ordered a grilled chicken for my boyfriend and a cod fish for myself. He requested for a chicken breast but ended up served with chicken thigh. Not really a good environment for dining if you prefer a quiet and romantic setting because 4 wheels drive truck just passing by all night long. Anyway, food is great! Will be back!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 477carlan
Title: Perfect
Review: We are now guest at casa del mar. When the weather was good we ate at the beach. Perfect diner!  Great view, good food and nice personal.  We are gonna eat here again before we go home for sure! !!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: barnabo
Title: Nice food
Review:
We took the seafood platter. Food was good, but there was too much of crab and maybe not enough prawn or fish.
Overall well satisfied but can be a bit pricey
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ASTMAY
Title: Amazing food and romantic setting
Review: Amazing food. We had beef redang. Best beef i've had in a while. Sat on the beach to dine. Meal was £80gbp for two people, two courses and a bottle of white wine - and worth every penny.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: xvii
Title: Dinner at the beach
Review: Best sunset view,  tender beef and good wine for a romantic dinner!  Service high quality and professional, highly recomanded for couples
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: EliseFarezaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: “Disappointed”
Review: We made reservations for 5 people for my close friends birthday party.This was recommended by another friend.The surrounding and atmosphere is beautiful,the service very friendly and helpful, therefore the dishes really disappointed us.We had 2 Beefsteak, 1 Oriental Beef Salad, 1 Ikan Bakar, 1 Soft Shell Crab and 1 Halibut Fish (forgot the name of the menu. As a steak lover I ordered rib eye and ordered medium rare and well done but was served medium cooked (not even medium rare) and well done they're hard to cut and chew with plenty of beef fat and is not fun to eat.The chef should trim the fat off of the steak before serving the meat. The Seabass from Ikan Bakar was frozen and the taste really horrible. Both of the meats are not fresh. The Soft shell crab are small portion and price is high compared to the quality of the food. The Halibut or Cod fish is salty and oily so we can't eat.The only good is the Oriental Beef Salad.We pay expensive food for not a great experience and we can't even finish our bottle of wine.Overall our friends didn't enjoy and we wouldn't go back. The waiter gave us discount of 20% and didn't charge one of the beefsteak but the whole experience is not worth especially during my best friend birthday party.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: terrymarcScottsdale, Arizona
Title: Magical Dinners on the Beach
Review: We dined here four nights of our five-night stay (plus three lunches and five breakfasts). The food standard is extremely high for all meals with many gourmet selections from which to choose. We especially enjoyed dinners at the restaurant's beach side tables (they set up tables right on the beach -- well spaced and very private). The sunsets are magnificent and the food and wine choices are reasonably priced and perfectly prepared. Candles on each table add to the romantic atmosphere.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: wana2013Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good food, great service
Review: Was here for my anniversary dinner. Reservations done via email weeks before. Very responsive. Helped out with my last minute request for roses. Thank you.Try and reserve a table on the beach at sunset. Staff were really friendly and attentive. Had Baked Salmon which was good. Overall a good optiom for a romantic dinner on Cenang beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Melody812Kuala Lumpur
Title: Revisiting again
Review: Travelled in last week and made reservations for 2 at La Sal. Always have a dinner here even it's just for a dessert.This time the menu have changed and there are a lot of localized dishes. Therefore, I just ordered a starter and dessert. The prices have hiked but it was worthy - relaxing dinner with great view and amazing food. So far I've finally tried all the desserts. Strongly recommend the chocolates, they're worth for every penny! I wouldn't recommend the banana fritter for locals. Main dishes, soup and starters are always a delight. Didn't like the sphagetti. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bambikerr
Title: Fabulous food! Recommended.
Review: We were fortunate enough to stay at Casa del Mar and the restaurant is on site. The food was amazing. The views, especially the sunset is beautiful. We had great service and really good value for money!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Raemike
Title: Amazing Meal  by the beach
Review: Magical experience with very tasty food and huge portions. Had whole Snapper and Malay sampler plate - truly an amazing experience with perfect atomshpere.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kitwalker82Canberra, Australia
Title: amazing lunch
Review: I almost booked this report as our accom for the week so was really keen to at least dine here and sample what the resort had to offer.We were treated to a table overlooking the beach and i had some of the best fish and chips I've ever had.The staff here were so friendly and attentive. I'd love to visit this apace again. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: melissamN6312ESBrisbane, Australia
Title: The best beef rendang on the planet!!!
Review: Don't miss this place if you are in langkawi and definitely dont stay anywhere else other than casa del mar (boutique hotel) where La Sal is located. We had beef rendang for breakfast daily...it was that good!!!The Chef came out and shared his rendang recipe. We missed his cooking class as we just ran out of time.We'll be back to stay and eat here for sure. This hotel has many many returning visitors each year and there is no absolutely no doubt as to why once you see this place! You won't want to holiday anywhere else once you've stayed at casa del mar...Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Wen An T
Title: Picturesque beachside dinning you won't regret
Review: We went for a romantic dinner. The food was amazing, the view was stunning the service was great. The waiters and waitresses were really friendly. Clean, no flies etc... Highly recommend if you want a quiet and relaxed dinning experience.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sloeber12
Title: Very good food, dine on the beachfront
Review: Classy and good restaurant. Rather recommended for some seafood. We dined on the beach, romantic setting. Food was really up to standard. Good, professional and friendly service, nice wines. Higher prices however
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jem752016
Title: Yummy food and good service
Review: LA Sal at Casa Del Mar is a yummy food experience and if you are able to dine on the beach i think it would be an even better atmosphere.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: IvanaL1993
Title: Very nice food and great location!
Review: The restaurant is on the beach so the view is great! My advise is to make a reservation ore call first because the aren't much tables. The food was also very good! It's worth the money!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: salmamarsafy
Title: Dinner
Review: Went and had dinner with my bestfriend. The place is really nice, and the staff are friendly. The food wasnt great for me but the atmosphere was.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AsiaNewby
Title: For special occasions
Review: During our short Langkawi break - we have a celebration to do and wanted to do it well...so we have booked a table at La Sal (recommended to us).While for some reasons, the staff make it difficult for us to book (maybe because we were staying in another hotel...) we somehow manage to get a table...at a supposedly full restaurant! We counted, they had 4 tables the entire evening....The food was very good, the cocktails amazing and the staff could use a bit of smile but the entire evening was a success and it s just a beautiful spot right on the beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Y6815ZTvanessah
Title: Ms
Review: Fabulous Hotel - beautiful rooms - lovely pool - very friendly and efficient accommodating staff - on the beach with stunning views
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ausra D
Title: Best place in Lagkawi
Review: Without any doubt the best place in Langkawi. Went for dinner 2 nights, everything from service to food/wine just great! Huge difference from other places on the island. And really not expensive for this quality!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JopepiLisbon, Portugal
Title: Good lunch with great view
Review: Had lunch with family and friends. Very calm place with great view to a white sandy beach.Shrimp noodles and Caesar salad were very good. The kids food was not as good, especially the pizzas surely made with some frozen ingredients.Staff was very friendly. As in most places in Langkawi the food took a long time to come, but that is local practice.Price was as expected, main dishes at about RM 35-45 range.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: VanishingNerd
Title: Undercooked
Review: My wife ordered Pesto Penne. The penne turned out to be slightly undercooked. My salmon, though, was ok, albeit certainly not as awesome as their prices would suggest upfront.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BR1532
Title: Amazing cocktails
Review: You pay for the quality and it is worth it. Very romantic venue with a very pleasant menu. The staff are friendly and the cocktails are really amazing. This is a gem, small and expensive, but worth it.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GabstatoriWestern Australia, Australia
Title: A Lovely Meal and Atmosphere
Review: My boyfriend and I ate dinner at La Sal whilst on holidays in Langkawi. The restaurant is located on the beach front in the popular tourist district of Cenang. The staff were very friendly and attentive and provided freat service. I ordered the baked chicken tikka and it was delicious. The only slight issue I had was the chicken thigh had a couple of bones in it. For dessert we had the trio of chocolate and the 'soft chocolate cake' had a lava like centre which was delicious! It was a beautiful meal in a stunning and more peaceful location. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Despina TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Romantic dinners on the sand
Review: While staying at Casa del Mar we had two complimentary 3 course dinners with our accommodation package. The food every time was delicious and beautifully presented. Our family tried various dishes such as: Andaman Sea Kataifi Prawns and the truly delicious Caesar Salad with chicken. We also tried the Angus Beef Fillet, Rustic Rib Eye steak and the Salmon. All the mains were delicious. The Sago Melaka was very refreshing and something different. The trio chocolate is for anyone looking for a chocolate fix. The deep fried corn crumb banana fritter is also another one for those who have a sweet tooth. Both dinners were a thoroughly enjoyable experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mohamad R
Title: 5 star service
Review: We stayed 2 nights at Casa Del Mar. We visit this place 2 times during the stay. We have good feeling and we enjoyed very much in both occassion. The food was nice, nice view overlooking the pool and the ocean . The service was very good and the staffs were friendly too.Highly recommended for all travellers.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kdbkathmandu
Title: Expensive and average food - nice location
Review: Restaurant review (not accommodation) - I paid 65RM for some spring rolls and boiled vegetables with tofu with no flavour, and a plunger coffee for breakfast. Disappointing food and expensive - the location is great though.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GlenT870London, United Kingdom
Title: Malaysian fusion
Review: We had a couple of lovely candle-lit evening meals at La Sal while staying at Casa Del Mar. A gorgeous setting on the beach overlooking the sea and the sunsets. The food was superb, a fusion of Malay, Asian and western cooking. Local favourites such as beef rendang were dished up with a little more finesse and pizazz. Good service, nice wines and a great menu choice. The chocolate deserts were to die for! Very enjoyable evenings.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: suanliu29Raleigh, North Carolina
Title: Totally Satisfied
Review: We had dinner with friends who stayed at the hotel twice during our stay on the island. We were wowed on both occasions. Dinner by candle light on the beach was perfect. They have a large selection of wine both red and white.The chef seem to take delight in each meal that came out of the kitchen, when I saw the presentations I was skeptical that the taste wouldn't add up,,, but I was oh so wrong. Everyone enjoyed their starters and main courses.We had zero complaints ~~~~ well done chef!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nigletti
Title: on the beach, great food
Review:
Excellent restaurant with great service 
[Four Seasons Take note!],
Quite a fun setting with lots of life & fun all around.
Great food, well served a delight!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FreshprinceofBAKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Great long breakfast
Review: Stayed here for 2 nights and never missed the breakfast like what I used to in some hotels. They have a small buffet counter with nasi lemak, breads and cereals, cold cuts. The do also offer ala carte menu with no additional charge. The menu covers a wide variety of choice, East to West.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MamaJacKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointed Tourist
Review: Heard so much about this restaurant.So hopped in on our last day to have lunch before heading to the airport. There were 2 male servers and 1 female server. The female server was not at all friendly and was unapproachable. Perhaps we were dressed in shorts and t shirt so she gave us the look like "we couldn't be potential diners". Ordered the Salmon Kofta which turned out disappointing as it was tasteless and hard. The soft shell crab dish saved the day and we were pretty pleased with it. Although it said on the menu that the bread is home made blue-pea bread, i think it was just a poppy seed bread. Nevertheless the dish was the saving grace. A male server who turned up later was very attentive and gave us big smiles. COuldnt help but wonder whether it was because the Chef and a lady boss later occupied the table behind us. Complimentary coffee did not stack up. Might as well skip it. Nice ambience, clean but old toilets. Would not be on my To Do list of restaurants to visit in Chenang.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ahmedeA4934GDDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Glad I tried that
Review: We visited this place after reading some raving reviews and it did not disappoint.The second the soups were served it was clear the chef here means business as the presentation was really slick. And then we tasted two of the best soup dishes we ever had. Highly recommend the roasted tomato soup and the sweet potato soup.For the main course I ordered the Authentic Malay Pallet, which includes little bowls of authentic Malay specialties. My favourite was the butter prawns.My wife had the Angus beef fillet and she really enjoyed it.The place is at the beach. Recommended to dine at sunset, incredible view.The staff are wonderful. They bring crayons and colouring sheet for your child while you wait for your food.You must book in advance.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: wanderingoffagainSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful start to our first night
Review: We booked this restaurant for our very first night's dinner and we were indeed blown away by the coziness of the setting on the beach, with few tables and each table has its own privacy, very unlike other places like Phuket or Krabi. This place is really amazing! We tried a couple of dishes and they were all very good, especially the fish. Cocktails are quite sweet but nice. Prices are not cheap with this experience, but it's a relaxing time for us. :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dudleydog99Melbourne
Title: Wonderful food in a beautiful seaside setting
Review: We ate at La Sal 4 times whilst in Langkawi staying next door at Meritus Pelangi Resort.In all occasions, we had a table on the sand and it was beautiful to watch the sunset whilst eating dinner. The food was amazing and pretty well priced for a restaurant located at a 5 star hotel. The staff were lovely and we got to know them well over our dinners there. They would even provide a chair for my handbag so I didn't have to put it on the sand. The insects started to bite as the sun went down, but each table has insect spray which is a great touch.The cocktails were great and the food (esp. Malaysian curries) were amazing.Would highly recommend this restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CoryW363
Title: Very nice
Review: Had a fantastic dinner here. Great at sunset. Mosquitoes are everywhere in langkawi but they offer repellent at the table.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SCR26Queensland, Australia
Title: Outstanding
Review: Nothing compares to enjoying an amazing dinner watching the sun go down over the water. Food was absolutely amazing. One of the best meals I have had in in Malaysia so far! They are even kind enough to have mosquito repellant on each table. Thoroughly enjoyed every minute of this dining experience. This is a must do! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: codyr760
Title: Great food and setting
Review: Really good food and atmosphere. Mosquitoes are annoying but they are everywhere throughout Langkawi.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: dljobe
Title: Perfect spot
Review: Most perfect spot for a quiet cocktail before dinner.  Dinner and lunch also pretty perfect.  Would love to stay here next time.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: slwh23PJPetaling jaya
Title: Delicious dinner
Review: We visited during 2 nd day Hari Raya. Book in advance as we saw people turn away as restaurant has limited seating especially when it rains. Dinner was delicious. There was even a kids menu and the waiter was attentive to my daughter s needs, bringing her crayons and colouring paper while waiting . Dessert was exceptional! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Filip-Poulsen
Title: Super, romantic meal on the beach
Review: We can really recommend this restaurant. The food was really some of the best we have had and the staff were friendly and very professional.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: laurineq2016
Title: Very nice restaurant
Review: We had a lovely diner at this restaurant, our feet in the sand and eyes on the sunset. The view is amazing, very good food as well even though a little bit expensive for us (students). We had a very romantic diner, thank you! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Charlie190262Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic
Review: Wonderful food, we ate here 4 times during our stay in Langkawi and we were not disappointed once. Staff friendly and attentive, atmosphere is lovely, next to the sea.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: lynnePerthperth
Title: Simply delicious
Review: What could be better, beach setting on a full moon night, great company and amazing food. The Malaysian Tasting Platter with an array of curries, and sambal and rice was beautifully presented and was simply delicious. Everyone at our table commented how good their food was and was served with a lovely spanish wine. compliments to the chef and staff A1.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Hippodribble
Title: Nice setting for a romantic dinner
Review: You can eat on the beach at tables set in the sand, or near the bar and pool on solid ground. If you have paid for the Romance package at the hotel, you will be seated away from the other tables on the beach, and surrounded by little candle lights. And you'll get a half bottle of champagne. Frankly, I could have stood a full bottle.The food seems pretty good, with seafood and western dishes supplemented by a combination of Malay favourites. If you like Malay food, tell your waiter. Malay food with little or no chilli will just make you sad.There's an awesome cocktail list. Working your way through it can't really be done in a single sitting, although there's no harm in trying. It's very nice to hear the waves while you're eating and chatting over a bottle of champagne. Service is quick and discreet. Tip: for the Romance package, book early as there's usually only one such table. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: damiens1960
Title: Magnificent sunset, sipping wine, on a white sandy beach
Review: You cannot get a fine dining experience in Langkawi so close to the water. Tables literally sitting on the sand at the northern end of Cenang beach, away from the hustle and bustle (and noise).The superb view of the ocean and sunset is uninterrupted. The mail meal was quite good, not outstanding - perhaps only 4 stars. But packaged with the ambience, it more than made up for it. The desert was to die for - chocolate molten cake, chocolate ice cream and chocolate sticks!The service was great, our waiter had worked there 15 years (since its opening). He was an excellent conversationalist in English and an allround nice guy.This is worthy of a visit. I will definitely be back next time I am in Langkawi Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: llhleonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent choice for our wedding anniversary
Review: We stayed at the Casa Del Mar on the Romantic Package, and were rewarded with an excellent dinner under the stars and with captivating views of the sea and the sunset. The food itself was competent - you can choose three courses (we had scallops and prawns for starters, angus beef and lamb for mains, and panna cotta and trip of chocolate for a sweet ending) from their rather extensive menu and along with the package came a half-bottle of Moet Chandon.I highly recommend this experience should you wish to add something special to your trip to Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: leilao349London, United Kingdom
Title: Romantic sunset dinner
Review: This was one of our favourite meals this holiday - the view, the surroundings, the food and the service were all spot on. Watching the sun set was the highlight. It was breathtakingly beautiful. The cocktails were delicious (I had lemon grass and lychee - quite sweet!). The presentation of the food was excellent. The waiters were very polite and the service was excellent. We left with big smiles on our faces! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: rebeccarH9114OHBendigo, Australia
Title: Lovely dinner by the beacj
Review: We had breakfast everyday (due to staying at casa del mar) and it was excellent. We had a three course dinner by the beach one night. The presentation of the food was amazing. Though I was a but turned off due to a few bad bits of chicken. Overall, the meal was very nice and service was quite good. would definitely recommendShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Renee1985Blackwall, Australia
Title: Breakfast here is a must
Review: We stayed at Meritus Pelangi but visited La Sal for a decadent breakfast and it was really lovely. We had mimosas and rounds of great food - the buffet is great and it's a nice and relaxing location. A must-do while you're at Cenang!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ArthurWang095Taichung, Taiwan
Title: Great Experience
Review: Best breakfast in the city & great quality in dinner too!住了很多家飯店，這家的早餐最棒！精緻、多元、好吃、好服務，望著近在咫尺的沙灘和海，這真是起床後的最棒享受！晚餐也好吃，腳踩著沙灘，聽著浪聲，看著星光下的海面，沒有多餘的音樂，這個飯店內的餐廳賣的除了美食和好服務外，我認為「生活風格」是她的重點。Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sandyhV9799ZICambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Beach dinner
Review: Lovely location to sit with your toes in the sand and listen to the sound of the sea and sip a cocktail as the sun goes down. Not much of a sunset yesterday but fun to watch the activity of packing up all the boats and jet skis at the end of the day before the lights and candles turn the tables into a romantic dinner. Lovely bread to dip, excellent fish but sadly the ice cream was almost liquid and not nice so we abandoned that but everything else was perfect. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: travelitaa1Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: good restaurant and nice food
Review: i visited this restaurant twice, and although it is more expensive then most of the restaurants they serve nice food. I really like their cheese platter and their pastas. Their soups are al so really good. The staff is very friendly, the view is amazing (right on the beach).Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: madxkatzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Accommodate to request
Review: Halal food. Food was slow but very good. Good seafront location. Must try healthy fried banana fritters ice cream.. Must reserved your seat and note different lunch n dinner menus. For drinks, they served alcohol at its bar.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Enjoyinglife60
Title: On Beach Dining
Review: We booked a table for 9 on our second last night. Sunset was gorgeous. Food was a mixture. Some good steak, some tough. Finished abrupty with a thunderstorm. Hotel kind enough to offer us a champas until weather cleared. Was overall good night.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: steelindustriesbrisbane
Title: Wow
Review: Amazing location and brilliant food and cocktails. Amazing experience and consider it a 'must do' if on Langkawi. Book an Oceanside table and book for a time taking in sunset. Order the tomato soup as a starter, profoundly amazing flavours and easily best I've ever been lucky enough to eat. Passion fruit cocktails were really great also. Will definitely return if ever here again. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Amberonhertravels
Title: Dinner on the beach with delicious food
Review: I'm so glad we booked la sal for one of our nights in langkawi. It was for our anniversary dinner which I had informed them about over the phone when booking. As soon as you step through the hotel lobby and outside by the pool area, you can see the tables and chairs on the beach for dinner. We arrived just before sunset ( the perfect dinner time while at the island) and were seated at a table overlooking the beach and waves. It was a memorable view.. After scanning the menu we decided to order the following starters:Tuna with nori seaweed, mango, pickled onions and tomatoes.Scallops with fois gras and mushrooms.Both dishes were beautifully presented and tasted great too! However half way through I realised there was no fois gras on the scallop starter. I don't remember tasting any or seeing any. So I called the waiter to tell him. He said it might have been there but a small size.. I know when I eat some fois gras and I definitely didn't. He bought a small rather tiny piece a couple of mins later and I added it to the remaining scallops. It certainly made a difference to the dish. Shame it was forgotten in the beginning. For mains we orderedBeef rendang Seabass in Malaysian spices Both dishes were presented in huge platters with rice, pickles, sauces and salad. I thought the presentation was really stunning throughout the meal. Even better than that was the taste of the food. Both dishes were delicious and I can't find fault with them. We were pretty full at this point but to now not try their dessert would be a sin! My husband ordered the banana fritters with pistachio ice cream. It arrived and looked just as stunning as all the other dishes did. My husband took one bite and I could tell he loved it! I had to try it too.. He was right. It was such a simple yet moreish dessert. I would have liked a little more pistachio flavour in the ice cream but other than that, it was flawless! We asked for the bill. After a few mins our waiter came and asked if we had asked for the bill to which we said yes. He ran off and we were rather confused. A few minutes later we recieved two plates each with 2 scoops of ice vanilla and chocolate ice cream with happy anniversary written in chocolate on each plate!!! It was such a sweet gesture by them, although we had just finished dessert too so it was impossible to eat that as well.. Service was good, maybe a little difficult to catch a waiters attention sometimes but all in all I highly recommend La Sal for dinner to anyone visiting langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: holakenNairobi Region, Kenya
Title: Amazing dinner place
Review: The restaurant was just amazing and the food out of this world of Coz the price tag is a bit high but worth every cent. We had a beach side dinner with my wife and the place looked amazing, seating outside at the beach and enjoying your meal was just amazing. I'll definitely come back Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Laine1956Perth, Australia
Title: very nice
Review: A very creative chef and presentation is excellent. Friendly helpful staff. The slow roasted tomato soup is amazing such depth of flavour. Had some very enjoyable meals hereShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: richardhwareNewcastle-under-Lyme, United Kingdom
Title: Eat on the beach
Review: Very fine cooking either western or Malay. Excellent presentation and service, choose to eat dinner on the beach watching the sun set. If there is any negative comment it would be the shortage of seafood/fish dishes but still an excellent restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Luvmyholidays9Perth, Australia
Title: 5 Star
Review: We had our anniversary dinner at Le Sal, the ambience, food and service were perfect, we couldn’t have asked for anything better.I was really impressed with the food it was mouth watering the flavors were amazing, we had scallops for an entrée, parmesan crusted halibut for the main, the mojito cocktails were excellent and we given a complementary glass of bubbly which was a very nice touch by the restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KandlesGawler, Australia
Title: Gorgeous sunset dining on the beach.
Review: Loved the setting. Right on the beach. Really, on the beach. The sunsets every now get were amazing and the food was fabulous. We ate here twice, each time the service and food was outstanding. And the cocktails!!! Try the toblerone, huge!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ElaineWBBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: We ate at La Sal on 3 nights and the food was exceptional. The staff are delightful and can't do enough for you. The beach setting is wonderful and the sunsets are incredible.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hilary_hudsonAmersham, United Kingdom
Title: Candlelit dinber
Review: We were staying at the Casa, and enjoyed a lovely dinner on the beach.The service of the staff is excellent, but be prepared to wait for your food, which is a small price to pay for the quality of the dishes served.Whilst this was our most expensive meal in Malaysia, it is worth every MR, so much so, that we also had lunch in the hotel on several occasions.Thanks again to all concernedShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: shkaziKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Memorable. Must do in Langkawi
Review: Went on the first day without reservations. Luckily they were able to adjust three of us.Setting is lovely. Romantic. Serene. Dinner on the beach, sand under the feet and stars / moon over the head and soothing sound of waves with a playful wind add to the ambiance.Food was superb. Fettuccini, Malaysian platter and Malaysian sea bass (recommended by the staff) were simply delicious. Presentation is another 10/10.Definitely it was the best dinner during this trip (KL + Langkawi)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Melissa BGuildford, United Kingdom
Title: Food, service and setting all superb
Review: Stayed at the Casa Del Mar and ate here our last night. It is definitely the nicest setting to eat in Pantai Cenang, with uninterrupted views of the sun going down behind the islands. It is expensive compared to lots of places in the town but not if you compare to western prices (cost us about £120 a head for four of us, including a drinks at the bar before hand and a couple of bottle of wine with a two course meal).Al our starters were lovely and the slow cooked beef rending mouth-watering. Should definitely be on the top of you list for that ‘special night out’ on your holibobs. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Olli PKouvola, Finland
Title: Great Dinner on Beach
Review: We had two evening Dinners in this place as part of our Hotel package. Dinner tables were set by the Beach overlooking the Bay and Sunset. Food and Wine were delicios, service was outstanding. Will certainly et here again .. Booking in advance seems to be neededShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 783RogerS
Title: Excellent Cocktails on the Beach
Review: What, can be said simply the best cocktails since Raffles, had a loverly Toblerone chocolate, the food and service were pretty good too, a loverly little beach bar and Resturant right on the sea front, and really nice people.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bandit6901Preston, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful setting!
Review: The feel of the restaurant felt intended for couples however I was here with my sister!Was still great, food was really nice and staff are very friendly and helpful :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Glen7_11Gloucester, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Food in a Beautiful Setting
Review: La Sal restaurant is part of the Casa Del Mar hotel. The tables are set up on the beach each evening. It is a lovely setting on the beach with the bay in the background, and if you time your table booking right you get a perfect view of the sun setting. I would recommend you book your table as it is very popular. I witnessed one family of four walk in and having been told it was either fully booked or there would be a long wait storm out through the hotel air conditioned reception leaving all the doors wide open. So please book to avoid disappointment.The menu is quite extensive (something for everyone) the soup was superb to taste. the main course were very well presented and cooked perfectly. We were impressed as we all chose different main courses we had a good opportunity to see and sample a good range of food.Waiters/ waitress were excellent, very friendly and always service with a smile.If I was to pick up one point it would be the waiting time, as they are so busy we found we had to wait a little longer than we would normally expect.However with such a lovely setting it was not really a problem.We would certainly recommend a meal on the beach at La Sal.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Grace88Brisbane
Title: Beautiful food and location. Make this a definite on your list to eat at.
Review: We celebrated our 20th anniversary here and we couldn't of been happier. We chose the special 3 course romantic dinner. Where they set up the table away from the other guests. We could not fault anything from the food, service and the most spectacular sunset. Definately include the restaurant in your list, there is nothing like dining on the beach watching a beautiful sunset with beautiful food. You have to book in advance. We also are lunch here nearly everyday, really reasonably priced and everything we had was beautiful.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pershore123West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely birthday meal
Review: A lovely meal sat on the beach watching the sunset , food was very nice a bit delayed but they could not applogise enough. They even bought me a cake and a candle out with a drink which was a lovely touch. Thank youShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Phill2810Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, very slow service
Review: First things first, the food here is good - as good as anything we had elsewhere barring maybe Bon Ton - the view is onto the beach and the hotel is a charming boutique establishment - so far so good... The service however is ridiculously slow and this lets the whole show down - for the prices they are charging, everything should be precise here but we were left waiting 30 mins for drinks, food came at funny times and we were served after other guests who came later than us - shame as it let down the food which did deliverShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: csillay2015Twickenham, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food with kind and friendly service
Review: My husband and I were on a one week holiday to Langkawi. We were actually staying at a neighbouring hotel (Meritus Pelangi). However, the lunch available at our hotel was not the best unfortunately. So we ventured to other places for our lunch. We ended up having lunch almost every day at Casa del Mar! There was a selection of Western and Malaysian cuisine. We were looking particularly for authentic Malay dishes and we found this in the tasty Nasi Goreng and Char Kway Teow.We also had dinner one evening on the beach and this was equally pleasurable including, a Malaysian platter. Dessert was excellent too. The pricing of the dishes were also very reasonable especially given the quality.The surroundings of the meals was pleasant and clean. What made the experience all the better was the staff at lunch, in particular, the manager Anizan (worked here for 14 years!) and also Faisal. The staff were friendly and helpful, which made our meals very nice. They clearly appreciated our custom and offered us a kind gift before we left the island.If we were to return to Langkawi, we would certainly consider staying at this hotel if the food and service is anything to go by! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: wardiemark
Title: Poor service
Review: We called in on the off chance of a table and surprise, surprise - we got one. although "fully booked" we could have made a choice from at least three.Scallops for starter were good. My partner ad steak which was also good and whilst I enjoyed my halibut, it did remind me slightly of a satay. So, 8/10 for the food Our big problem was the service and the problem in trying to get the attention of a waiter. Okay, so our G&T was too weak. No problem, when alcohol is so cheap on the island, just bring the bottle and sort the problem. They didn't. In the end, a pint of lager instead of a bottle of wine was our way forward - eat up and leave. Nearly there guys but not quite.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PMB1231Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely setting
Review: We ater on the beach by candle light- Excellent food and service - English prices but excellent quality Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CDP PSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: A Restaurant on the Beach
Review: We just ate here once. The sitting arrangement on the sandy beach was superb with mosquito repellent device under every chair we were saved by being bitten. The food was excellent which was served very nicely. However, as the sun had already gone down and the lighting being not so adequate I could not decide what I was eating but it was very good indeed. The nicely laid table and very nice smooth decoration of the area it felt like a festive day.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MandyH121Johannesburg
Title: Outstanding Food and Service
Review: It is one of the best places to eat on the island , the food is delicious , the menu is extensive and everything we ate was scrumptious .The service is top notch and best of all , it is right on the beach , so you can dangle your feet in the sand , while eating by moonlight with a magnificent view and fantastic wines and drinks too :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: katerinalouiseEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely setting, good food
Review: We had a lovely meal at La Sal. Situated at the back of the Casa Del Mar hotel, it's right on the beach front so offers a really romantic setting. Perfect view to watch the sunset. It's slightly on the pricey side for langkawi, but you can see why. The food was very nicely presented, and tasted delicious. The staff were very attentive and offered recommendations from the menu. My only comment would be that there was only a small candle on the table so it was a little hard to see what you were eating, but it tasted so good it didn't matter! A lovely restaurant in langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: travelhunter54Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Dining on the Beach
Review: The quality of the food at La Sal is without doubt excellent, but add this to the location, on a stunning very quiet beach and you have a perfect dining experience.one tip = book in advanceShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MellowtraxCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Best restaurant in Pantai Cenang
Review: This is without comparison the best restaurant in Pantai Cenang. The location (the tables are directly on the beach), the service (very friendly) and the food (amazing) makes this restaurant to a must try if you are in the area. The restaurant is a part of Casa Del Mar hotel. We went without booking, and they didn't have any free tables, so we made a booking for the following evening. It's an amazing feeling to sit directly on the beach, enjoying a fantastic cocktail, waiting for your food. And the food is absolutely amazing here. Although it's not cheap, it's affordable and worth the money. The service was fantastic, friendly and very attentive. The only regret I have is that we only had dinner here one time. Definitely recommendable.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MattMullard
Title: Nice setting, quite pricey
Review: Went here for dinner and found the resturant on the beach in a great setting. Food was fairly expensive and what we ordered was OK. Better places on the island. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mary DHuddersfield, United Kingdom
Title: Unexpected treat
Review: Visited this restaurant as we were staying at a neighbouring hotel. We were not disappointed. The beach setting is lovely with a romantic atmosphere. The service was impeccable and the food was divine. I had salmon with mango and dragon fruit (pictured) and it was simply delicious. Pricey for the area but worth it and fairly standard for hotel prices. Would highly recommend. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jenny T
Title: Amazing
Review: We arrived to find the restaurant full, but they put extra tables out on the beach.  The food was amazing, so many layers of flavours, my best meal.  The beach location was lovely, the sun had set, but there was sufficient light on the tables.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BeccajanexoMelbourne
Title: Underwhelmed
Review: We went here after reading the reviews on TA. The location was good and the view of the beach was great especially watching the sunset. The food was pretty good but we waited 45minutes for our entree before asking where it was and then it came out 10 minutes later. Usually this wouldn't bother me but 3 other tables had arrived and ordered after us but had their entrees ages before us. The service was not fantastic. We didn't stay there and apparently that meant that we weren't as worthy of great service. When we arrived we asked if we could go and sit down so we chose a table as they didn't take us to one and then once we were settled someone told us that because we didn't stay at the hotel we may have to move tables. We didn't end up having to move but I found this very rude and disrespectful especially because it could've been avoided if they had seated us. The service during the meal was fine but when we asked for the bill we again waiting for about 15 minutes before receiving it and ended up waiting another 20 minutes for our change which I only received because I was walking out the door. Overall we were really disappointed and have already told family not to stay or go there.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: K PSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, we were underwhelmed by the food
Review: This restaurant is right on the beach, literally. Very atmospheric and different from other places along the beach. They make mosquito repellant available so that you are not bitten as you sit and eat!. The service was very good, helpful and discrete. The soft shell crab starter was brilliant and whetted the appetite for the main. I went for the mixed plate of local food but it was disappointing. The meats were tough and poorly cooked. The fish lacked taste. The prawns were good. Given the cost and our mixed experience we did not return, despite the good location.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: marieb002Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food, great location, great service
Review: I went there with my friends for a late lunch and drinks, and we decided to stay over for diner as the location was great: seating on the beach, in a quiet and relaxing place: fantastic!I had a grilled fresh fish from the day, with a slightly spicy sauce, a small salad, 2 other sides of vegetables, and steamed rice: everything in this dish was delicious and the fish was perfectly cooked.The service was very good as the staff was really attentive and friendly.Also there were mosquito repulsive spray available as well as repulsive candle under the table, which happened to be really useful.I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking to have a great diner on the beach in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: dottieDRolleston on Dove, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, fantastic location
Review: Super food served on the beach in a very casual atmosphere. The staff are excellent and eager to please, attentive without being a nuisance. We had several meals here as part of our package, so we tried lamb, steak, fish, seafood and all the dishes were well presented and tasty. We are not that bothers about deserts so generally had the ice cream.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SimonBoon
Title: Superb food, attentive service and beautiful setting
Review: Tables set out on the beach, lovely setting and excellent food. Everything presented well on beautiful plates. Seemed to have a different waiter/waitress for every course but all very good. Would thoroughly recommend. Only slight downside was the amount of other customers around us smoking, though tables are spaced quite well apart.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jimbob185London, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner
Review: Had a lovely dinner here last night. Tables are set on the beach with fantastic views of the sunset. The menu and service were great with a good selection of wines. After dinner we had a couple of drinks at nearby beach bars and after struggling to find a taxi home we walked back to the hotel reception where the lovely lady sorted a taxi for us within minutes. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MaryG2694
Title: Number One Restaurant
Review: I have stayed at  this hotel and eaten here many, many times. You will not be disappointed. The beach setting at sunset is a must. Enjoy
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kebab65
Title: Best food in Pentai Cenang, but at a price
Review:
Wonderful location on the beach, with tables nicely spaced out.

Food is superb, service is also brilliant.  However it is not cheap, but it is still very reasonable compared to comparative restaurants in Europe.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jennier706Westward Ho, United Kingdom
Title: Last night treat....
Review: Lovely location, dining tables out on the beach. We visited here for dinner on our last night as a thankyou to friends who had looked after us during our stay on the island. Very nice food & mostly attentive service. We were all forced in off the beach before our main courses though, due to a rain storm, but this didn't disrupt our evening too much - and there's not much they could have done about that!Not cheap, but a cut above other places locally, we paid 1200RM (about £200) for 6 of us, with a cocktail each and wine throughout.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Car0lienHAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: One of the best
Review: This is one of the best restaurants of the town. We were not the only people who wanted to eat in this restaurant so I would suggest to make a reservation (otherwise you cannot sit at the beach).The starters were very good. For dessert I had the Asian grand dessert which was delicious and my husband had the chocolate trio which was also very tasty.I have only one negative remark: immediately after eating at this restaurant I became sick (of the food). Because the food was so good I do not want to complain but I would suggest to the restaurant to be aware of the hygiene.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: clarissas486Singapore, Singapore
Title: Top notch food, top notch service
Review: We stayed at Casa del Mar and had two dinner services here as part of our package. We had experienced excellent service during our stay and dinner was no exception. The beach dining experience was one to remember. The servers ensured that we were comfortable and placed mosquito coils at our tables, and provided insect repellent to keep the sandflies away too. We didn't have to wait long for our food and drinks, which was sublime. Highly recommended if you want to treat ourself to a fine dinner along along Cenang Beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ali_EshaghiTehran, Iran
Title: Perfect food
Review: I had a lunch there and i believe this place is one of the best restaurant in Langkawi, clean and like a luxury place atleast in comparison to all restaurant in langkawi. You can expect seafood, western food and local foods and more, with any type of drink and beverage.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SimasonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great beach restaurant
Review: Brilliant setting, excellent service, very welcoming staff, amazing fine dinning food and a nice bar to chill in before and after. Highly recommend Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CheshireJazzladyCheshire
Title: Dinner on the beach with palm trees!
Review: We always have a romantic dinner on the beach when we come here. The ambience is wonderful, service is excellent, food is very good, We paid about 300 Malay ringgits, for a shared starter, mains, pudd and 2 glasses of wine. At just over 6 to the £ it is great value for us Brits at the moment.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: annelooengland
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: Ambient restaurant with good food. I don't know if I would rate it above any of the other restaurants we tried in Pantai Cenang due to service and price but for a nice night out it was worth a visit.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: chrisbowditchHobart, Australia
Title: Great view, great food!
Review: We went here to celebrate our wedding anniversary whilst on holiday. We had a chicken tikka and beef rendang and shared a chocolate dessert. We also had a few drinks. Considering the quality and setting it was cheap really (ended up costing us about $80 Australian).Also as the wife is pregnant she's been drinking the mocktails on this trip. La Sal had the best mocktails we've found. They actually put time effort and flair into them as opposed to most places giving you glorified fruit juice.Definitely worth a special night out whilst in Langkawi!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ellBem
Title: beautiful food in gorgeous setting
Review: Sitting with our feet on the sand while the sun set over Cenang beach, we ate fresh and interesting food, carefully prepared and beautifully presented.  A lovely evening.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: allycat3030Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Great setting
Review: Right on the beach. Great place to see the sun set while enjoying beautifully prepared meal.Kumera soup and big eye Tuna were very tasty.Service generally good although it could have been more attentive at times.Worth a visit on a nice evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: michaelo230Llandudno, United Kingdom
Title: Up itself
Review: Stopped here for a drink and a meal. The bar staff were more interested in chatting among themselves than looking after us. We asked for a table and were told to wait and eventually had to go and ask again. The fans were spinning but not disturbing the air so it was uncomfortably hot. The food was fine but not special. The only high point was the waiter who served us who was pleasant and attentive. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jtblin
Title: Great restaurant on the beach
Review: Food was excellent, service was great. Located on the beach, perfect to watch sunset and enjoy the night. Highly recommended.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AnasuyaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent location, food and service
Review: The food was top notch, location on the beach excellent and service great. Its the best place we ate at in Langkawi Make sure you book in advance as it gets full Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AnkitmittalSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good for a nice sunset dinner!
Review: Good food, not much of vegetarian options on the Menu though. I had emailed them for a reservation from Singapore itself and was assigned one of best tables next to the sea. This is literally on the beach.Very very good service. Loved every bit of drinks, main course, and desert.A bit pricey , but worth visiting if you are staying in Pantai Cenang for a memorable sunset dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mary AMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious food
Review: We went for a late dinner as a party of 7. The setting is wonderful on the beach with funky subtle Fat Boy lights. Food was great and the portions were generous - even the kids burgers were oversized. We ordered the lamb rack, Langkawi seafood platter and the Langkawi traditional platter. All were good.Service was friendly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Chris_Tang2013Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food marred by slow service
Review: We had to endure a 40 min wait for dessert that we ordered at the start. We checked in with the staff twice for assistance. Once, they asked if we had ordered dessert at all, but it did not seem to speed things up. We also waited too long for our check. In the end, we walk over to the bar to pay and found the staff chatting.On the plus side: the location affords an impeccable of the setting sun. We had the soft shell crab for starters which was tasty and flavorful. For mains, my companion had the duck green curry and me the carbonara. She loved the rice and curry. The carbonara could have been more balanced portion wise; it had too much pasta and insufficient portions of everything else.Overall, the place offers great value but we felt let down by the speed of service. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ClaireJBrady
Title: Best meal in Langkawi
Review: Probably the best meal we had on the island. All dishes were very tasty & the setting is fabulous. We sat down at 7pm to watch the beautiful sunset and left the table at 10.30pm. Nothing rushed, all part of the wonderful experience. Very helpful & friendly staff. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pohling_fooGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: I went for lunch
Review: I didn't stay there. I only went for the lunch as I read good reviews on the food. We wanted to go for dinner but it was fully booked. So we went the next day for lunch instead. I had to say I'm disappointed with the food. We ordered two pastas. The lobster in the pasta wasn't fresh. The cutleries were old and there was stain in the glass. I wouldn't recommend this place.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SanaSardar88
Title: best food
Review: the food ,the view ,the service ! it was really just great! the taste of the wedge potato still in my mind just perfect ! thanks to all the staf there for their great work ,i wish everyone could enjoy this place as much i didShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kevinw263Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect for a romantic meal on the beach admiring the sunset
Review: Just a wonderful experience. We dined here on Thursday evening and it was superb. The setting on the beach, not by the beach but on the beach, is just spectacular, with a fully clear view of the sunset. They offer a great choice of food, well prepared, and served by friendly, attentive, staff. Good value for money too, but just make sure you book ahead of time as it seems they are normally full.Thanks for the perfect romantic evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: heza86Sulaymaniyah, Iraq
Title: Amazing
Review: Hello, my name is (Hez). This restaurant was the best to both of us in the whole of Langkawi island, maybe in the whole of Malaysia. Thank you for the great cheerful staff, esp Dila, Boy and the beloved bartender. Thanks for the great chef, great food and great drinks. Unfortunately, we couldnt take advantage from the hotel as room reservation. I think it would feel amazing to stay at this hotel too. Beach, sand and pool. Great. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: leeds29Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Consistently good food
Review: We stayed at the hotel for 10 nights as a family ,and sampled breakfast,lunch and dinner.Breakfast had a large choice for everyone at the buffet and cooked breakfast as well.great pancakes and salmon bagels.Lunch had a variety of options the girls enjoyed the salads and the men had spicy chicken pasta which they really enjoyed.Christmas day and NYE we had a 7 course meal the great thing was we had 3 non fish eaters and the restaurant manager altered the menu to our choice of food which I don't think many places would do .The food was excellent with fantastic staff,we were never short of a drink,the tables were beautifully decorated ,well done to everyone who made it such a memorable evening for all of us.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: borneoibanSunset Valley, Texas
Title: This customer was delighted!
Review: I've been on vacation for almost 3 weeks now, eating my way up the Malay Peninsula from Singapore through Johor, KL and now Langkawi. I really thought that there wasn't much left gastronomically that could impress me at this point.And then, I ate dinner at La Sal. Apparently, this grinch's heart still had 3 sizes left to grow.First of all, the ambience can't be beat. You dine al fresco on the sand itself. There was a pleasant and constant breeze throughout our meal, which made the experience very comfortable.Our appetizers were competently prepared and presented, and tasted great. But the bit that really impressed me was the "Ikan bakar" entree (BBQ fish). When it arrived, it looked like a whole fish, but once you cut into it, you discover that they managed to remove all the bones, while keeping the fish intact. Impressive as this is, the chef didn't forget to impart an excellent flavor profile. We were thoroughly delighted by this dish. I only regret that it was too dark to take a photo.If there was one thing I had a quibble about, it was our "Ayam Percik" second entree. It's chicken thigh served on skewers. The flavor profile was again great, but somehow, some small pieces of chicken cartilage managed to stay in the meat. Perhaps it's a delicacy, but it wasn't something I necessarily appreciated.My wife and I had initially planned to dine elsewhere along the Cenang Beach strip for our final night in Langkawi. After the excellent experience at La Sal, we quickly made a second reservation so that we could enjoy other items on the La Sal menu.Tips: If you book ahead, you can call dibs on a table on the front most row on the beach. This will afford you an unimpeded view of the sunset and the sea. To be perfectly honest though, I think any seat will be great.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LaurenceMacraeDoha, Qatar
Title: Some good some bad dishes
Review: We took in the sunset here with another family. Positives lovely location on the beach to watch the sunset , very nice staff and some good dishes which tended to be seafood. I also had tomato soup as a starter which was excellent. Negatives my wife and her friend had chicken tikka which was really not very nice , they complained to the waitress who apologised and when we got the bill both dishes had been taken off. The manager also came up afterwards and apologised , they seemed to be genuinely distraught at everyone not enjoying the food. When we left we realised that my daughter had left her phone , she returned back and one of the waitresses had handed it into reception so you also can't fault the honesty of the staff. Not as good as we expected but if we came back I would go back , the tikka wasn't good but the prawn masala I had was very good so worth a visit. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: davide160Melbourne, Australia
Title: All class... But even better service than expected
Review: We stayed at the hotel for New Year's Eve and a part of the package was a 7 course meal... Open bar from 7:30 to 8:30 and then French champagne at dinner... Which was a table for 2 on the beach.. The food was excellent... The friendly service exceptional and from meeting the manager, you can see that his nature has been transferred to all of his staff.... To top it off as an example of how good the management and staff are, they are an employer who will also employ special needs people which I believe is an example of actions speaking louder than words....We had breakfast which is a buffet but also a-la-carte .. The eggs Benedict were cooked perfectly!I highly recommend this restaurant! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Peter RBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: The best meal on the Island!
Review: We tried a variety of places/cuisines to eat on Langkawi, and by far had the best experience at La Sal. The food was quality, the staff was kind and friendly, and the decor was very pleasant. Other restaurants would get low scores due to cleanliness or overpriced food 9lack of value). Looking for a special night out, book La Sal!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 896nilesht
Title: Ove rated, overpriced and not friendly
Review: Not friendly, ove rated and overpriced. They were not flexible in menu items and did not offer much food with vegetarian options although could have been easily done. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 983sabrinapVienna, Austria
Title: Romantic dinner & awesome food quality!
Review: Unluckily we detected this jewel only in the last evening before departing. Very nice atmosphere, stunning sunset & for sure best food in the hood. Excellent service quality from staff. Reservation is necessary. Go there! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Becky H
Title: Fantastic
Review: Beautiful food in a great setting, best in Langkawi.we had an amazing duck and fish dish along with fantastic wine and brilliant service.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: krokodillekeHemiksem, Belgium
Title: Middag lunch
Review: We order a pasta and a dish with chicken we have to wait 45min and there were no people in the restaurant when we had our Food it was Cold the staff is not intressed in there guests the only thing that they do is playing with there phone it's a shame there are other places on the island much cheaper much so much cheaper !!!!!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: L C
Title: Amazing service
Review: Beautiful restaurant on the beach. Shame we didn't manage to catch the sunset as we were too busy shopping. Really fresh prawns and sea bass. Good cocktails too. What made a difference was the captain's outstanding service. Shame we didn't get his name. A Malay gentleman with glasses, super professional and happy to help with any request. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NemcovaSydney, Australia
Title: Fantastic food right on the beach ...
Review: Fantastic food right on the beach. Eat under the stars. Recommend Fabulous Authentic Malaysian Pallet or the Slow Braised Beef Rendang.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: travellingKitchLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice location mixed opinion
Review: We went here based on the reviews online and had a mixed experience.The venue is lovely, set on the beach and vey romantic - I would suggest it for couples or a quieter evening. Good location to move onto the bars down the beach cause later on however.The service - the staff were very nice and came to the table frequently, however we did have a bad experience in that something went wrong with our order and we waited nearly an hour for our starter. When we asked about the wait we were told the order had not actually been processed due to an error. To be fair to the staff once this was identified they were very quick to resolve and made up for it with a complimentary drink while we waited.The food was good, high standard but I wouldn't say it was outstanding for the price. On par with a very nice UK restaurant.Overall it was a nice evening but may have been somewhat tainted by the order problem.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Athena WPerth, Australia
Title: Beautiful dinner with amazing sunset
Review: Simply amazing setting. Right on the beach facing the sunset. The food were exquisite perfectly complimented the setting. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AshishGuptasfoSan Francisco, California
Title: Amazing dining experience
Review: Having eaten at a lot of world renowned restaurants all over the world this was truly a memorable experience. The tables are set right on the beach and I highly recommend getting there just before sunset like we did for a sundowner. We both decided on the three course dinners so that we could sample more of the menu. For starters we had the soft shell crab masala, the tuna tartare, and the pumpkin soup, all were delicious.For the main's we had the sea bass and the baked blue prawns. The sea bass was served with lots of side sauces and salads. The spicy sauce is very spicy. The prawns came with two delicious sauces as well. For dessert we shared the green tea upside down cake, which was served with fresh fruit and had a complex bouquet of flavors. The service was attentive but unobtrusive. They even provided little spray bottles of bug repellent as you are sitting right on the beach. We hope to return before leaving Langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Lamps
Title: Recommended
Review: Lovely food and reasonably priced. Beautiful location for a meal on the beach. The Beef Rendang is the best.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AllimurrayLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good meal
Review: Went here as it was recommended and was a good meal. Was within walking distance of hotel accessible by the beach and road.We ate on the beach and the staff were welcoming and professional.The food was definitely worth the price.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LHPSMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food in a beautiful setting
Review: We enjoyed a DIY beach BBQ which was all set up ready for us to grill - delicious satays and seafood. Beautifully seasoned and accompanied by tasty sauces and a fresh green salad. The view from the table right on the beach was peaceful and serene. Staff were helpful and attentive. A very nice way to dine indeed!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kalle BSavonlinna, Finland
Title: Our best dining in Langkawi
Review: Service was good, location beautiful just next to the beach. Setting was nice&clean and overall very inviting.They paid good attention to our kids so dining experience for parents was good too. Food was best that we had in Langkawi, fresh and very tasty. Portions well worth the price.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RwillcardiffBridgend, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely meal
Review: We were not staying at this hotel but give it a try because of the trip advisor reviews, we were not disappointed, The food was really lovely with good service. Book before you go we did have a long wait to be seated!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: paradisecatcherBarcelona, Spain
Title: Disappointing option for last night luxury
Review: Decided to spend our last night in Langkawi at this restaurant, after deciding to throw our budget out the window for a farewell meal. Considering how little we had been spending in Malay places for good food we were expecting to see a big jump in quality along with the price, and arrived salivating.The starter was excellent, but the main course was average and the desert just Ok. The wine was overpriced, as was the water. Ended up wishing we had saved our ringgits for elsewhere.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Effel54Kew, Australia
Title: Delicious food
Review: Had three meals here during a seven night visit to Langkawi. Each of the meals was delicious, especially the whole fish and beef rendang. They make their own bread here too, which was good.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MissRed77Dublin, Ireland
Title: Delicious meal but make a reservation
Review: This is a hotel restaurant. We visited by chance without a reservation and a table was not available for two hours. We enjoyed some very nice cocktails while waiting at the bar and when a table eventually became available, we had a really nice meal, sampling some delicious Malaysian cuisine. The kitchen was closing as we approached dessert and so ice cream was the only available option. We didn't bother with dessert. It was a reasonably priced meal and our waiter was charming and chatted with us as we waited for our taxi. Would certainly visit again, with a reservation and leave time to try dessert. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Toni M
Title: Great food & location
Review: Lovely restaurant on the beach, luckily it was where we were staying so that was a bonus. Great waitstaff & beautiful food. Highly recommend!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Peter V
Title: Exceptional - great setting on the beach
Review: Yes you can eat in much cheaper places in Cenang as the price list is similar to European cities but the food is really delish. It's not going to break the bank and certainly worth a visit. We just ordered two main courses (& of course wine!) - Beef which was very nice but the Seabass was really gorgeous.When you get used to all the Mosquitos and just take in the setting, you couldn't be in a nicer restaurant. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LondonGeorgiaGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Actually as good as everyone says it is!
Review: I kept going out of Casa Del Mar in search of good, authentic, Malaysian food but kept being somewhat disappointed. It was always in the plan to eat at the hotel as a result of the reviews but this evening we were invited to dine here by the GM Patrick.This was the best meal we have had so far in Langkawi and I think we have decided to stop searching and just accept that unlike most places in the world where good food is often found out of the hotel the best food is actually at Casa Del Mar!Not only was the food incredible but the staff truly are amazing. Everyone is super friendly and very attentive without being overbearing.We have a few more nights left here and I think we will work our way through the menu!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 778stevem778Cork, Ireland
Title: You must try this place
Review: When you are ln Langkawi you must try this place . It is one of the best on the island Lovely setting great food staff alway helpfull and smiling ( try the fish and chips )Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HARRIS Q
Title: Very romantic
Review: Stayed at the hotel for my honey moon and so we ate often at this restaurant. We tried a lot of different places at langkawi and this place was one of the best, not just on the island but anywhere.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sian GWarialda, Australia
Title: Beautiful
Review: Wonderful food in an intimate setting. We stayed at the Casa Del Mar where this restaurant is situated. The tables and chairs are set on the sand on the beach. A table lamp illuminates your meal. I was expecting good food. What I got was Amazing food. Bread with balsamic and olive oil on the table. Classic Mojitos. I had the beef that was melt in your mouth. My friend had the fish and it was whole. Dessert was an incredible intricate chocolate delight. Yes it is on the expensive side, but what a setting, view and taste. I will returnShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: myopinion112China
Title: Just perfect.
Review: We had the most scrumptious meal with the most amazing service and the most fantastic bottle of wine at La Sal. The chef's fish and duck of the day specials were incredible. So many flavours and textures packed in to one plate. I really can't say enough good things about this place. We were there at night so we could hear the sea but couldn't see the view although later in the week we did walk past it and I am sure it will be great for a lunch as well although a little bit pricey for a quick bite.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RichardCPStockport, United Kingdom
Title: An outsanding meal with great ambience.
Review: We visited at lunchtime for an aperitif at the Pool Bar and asked to look at the menu with a view to dining there the next day, which was my birthday. La Sal is a beautifully positioned beach-front restaurant with views to other nearby islands and enjoys picture-perfect sunsets as a bonus to the excellent food. Because it was to be a special occasion, we chose the fixed-price La Luna package which is a sumptuous tasting menu with matched wines served at a special private table on the beach. Since we visited during the monsoon season, inevitably, it rained and we agreed that it was better that our table was set up indoors. (this is an exclusive form of dining needing 24 hours notice and only one La Luna dinner reservation is available per evening.)I won’t describe the actual food in any detail because it will almost certainly be different when you go (which you really should!) but after an introductory cocktail, the meal began with a half bottle of Moët Imperial Brut and the seven (I think) courses were introduced at comfortable intervals with their accompanying wines – the evening finishing with a last cocktail and an unexpectedly accomplished musical serenade. I am a retired professional musician and rarely appreciate such offerings in restaurants but this was really rather good. This is not a cheap evening but the ambience and food were exceptional and could not be faulted for a celebratory degustation for two.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: OshnaShimoga, India
Title: Amazing View with Amazing Food
Review: It's a beautiful place with an amazing view. And to top that the food is simply irresistible.. We tried their specialty, nasi goreng, and we could just feel our palettes's emotions.. We had a super time and I would say its a must visit for a nice lunch or dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Andrei NMelbourne, Australia
Title: Superb food and (sometimes) service
Review: Ate there many times: breakfasts, lunches, dinners, "romantic dinner" on the beach. The food was always great. "Romantic dinner" was served on the beach far enough from the main area. The waiter was like from a top notch establishment in Europe. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kbert23
Title: Dinner on the beach
Review: This was a wonderful experience with a friendly staff and amazing food while enjoying sunset on the beach. The drinks were awesome, as well. I highly recommend the Passion Fruit Mojito.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Heng L
Title: Food
Review: The relaxed atmosphere means you need to catch the waiter's attention before you get anything. Food arrived and tasted good as compared to many other food places. However the service needs to be improved as there was hardly anyone around to help if you need anything.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: markwA8237FCMindarie, Australia
Title: Heaven on earth
