Review: The setting is absolutely perfect and the food if a little sparse is mouth watering. Everything we had just melted in our mouths and the service was as good as I've ever experiencedShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AristoratnazKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Try not to steal the cutlery.
Review: As many reviewers have said, the food is scrumptious and delectable. The chefs have perfected the art of both Asian and Western cuisine. The rendangs and curries are spot on exactly the traditional way, the breakfast pancakes, eggs and french toasts are perfect works of art. For the main course, everything I've tried from the seafood to the poultry to the red meats, all prepared perfectly and always served at the perfect temperature. The restaurant itself is always clean, dinnerware is free from any chips or scratches (i'm a fan of these things so I pay attention) cutlery appears to be made from pure pewter (only when the actual food arrive did I stop gushing over it, much to the amusement of my date)Price wise, I'd say the price is quite up there, even for a hotel. HOWEVER, I would say that you get good value because the portion size is more than generous, and the quality is unmatched. The only complaint or shortcoming if i were to nit-pick, and this is really nit-picking here... is that the dinner menu can be somewhat limiting. They only do one meat in one way. Chicken in one way, or fish in one way, or lamb in one way. For example, if i wanted chicken, it only comes in one way with a particular sauce, If I didn't like that sauce, I'd have to have something completely different, like a salmon, which again only comes in one way. Took me a long time to choose what to eat because of this. Tip: desserts are to die for... next time I'm just going to order desserts all the way. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shereen ACairo, Egypt
Title: Stunning food
Review: OMG stunning food amazing staff . The seabass dish is not from this world! !! The view is awesome and the seafood platter is a must tryShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Pei WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for a Romantic Dinner!! We love it.
Review: If you are looking for a romantic dinner out, this is a great consideration. All elements were there with awesome food, view, and ambiance. Service was overall satisfying with slight difficulty in capturing their attention especially towards the end of the dinner. One of our dessert did not turn out well but the staff were apologetic and quickly replace it with another dessert. Slight delay with email communication but manageable.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: verdas2015
Title: Excellent food and great location
Review: Woow! Just wooow! We went to La Sal because of the recommendations on trip advisor. And we absolutely don't regret it.The restaurant is right at the beach, so you have a beautiful sea view. The personnel is very kind, their English is good and they absolutely know how to serve their guests. The best services we had so far in Malaysia. And then the food. The food is more than excellent! We had 3 courses. I absolutely recommend the Malaysian platter: all kinds of Malaysian dishes. Great way to taste the Malaysian kitchen. All the 3 courses were very tasty. They also have a extensive wine card with good wines. Expensive? Maybe a bit for Malay standards, (not for western standards) but absolutely worth it! And the portions? Moreeeee than enough. The only thing we could do after this delicious dinner was laying down and notmove anymore. I absolutely recommend this place!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: flange2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Superb
Review: Stunning food. Beautiful setting, great wine and cocktails - but the food is the thing. We were staying in the hotel next door, and although the food there is great - but expensive - this place has that something extra. We tried most of the menu over a few nights - fish, chicken, beef, seafood - all of it exquisite. Starters, mains, desserts - excellent fusion of Malay and European styles without losing any authenticity in terms of spices, flavour and integrity. Am now half a stone heavier and couldn't care less. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: steph1oz
Title: Fabulous food
Review: Beautiful meal. Location, ambience and quality of food was exceptional. The only downside was that after asking for the wine menu, we then had to go looking for someone to take our order. Highly recommendedShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: glentromienew norcia Australia
Title: On the beach
Review: A great setting and quality food sitting on the beach. The Andaman prawn entree and Caesar salad were highlights but the fish of the day, rack of lamb were of similar high quality. Friendly service..Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BarSideDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great food , stunning location
Review: Could not find anywhere better to eat in the town! Food and location are great! Feet in the sand whilst you eat is great for me! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Marina RSydney, Australia
Title: dinner on the beach
Review: We did this one night & it was a nice evening. Tables on the beach. Menu is varied & the our choices were good. Service is very efficient & friendly. Cheaper meals to be had outside the hotel but this is a nice quiet option.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AlHowdLondon
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Visited La Sal with my wife for a special meal on our last night in Langkawi. The staff were very attentive and friendly, the beach location stunning and the food was excellent (my wife had the tuna tartare, steak and crème brulee. I had the Malaysian platter. All were beautifully presented and very tasty). The prices were very reasonable considering the quality of the food, the portion sizes generous and we had an amazing meal. The only negative thing I could mention was that my wife ordered a cocktail which wasn't very good (she actually didn't finish it which isn't something that has ever happened before...). Though this was just a minor mark against an otherwise great dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: huiyeeg2015Kuala Lumpur
Title: Great ambience & good food
Review: Good for couples where you can dine at the beach side and watch sunset. Reasonable price for the food. They provide mosquito repellant as well.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CarolineKay2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful Service Staff & great food
Review: This is our first trip to Langkawi for a weekend getaway, so when I found this restaurant in Tripadvisor with good reviews I knew I had to try it too! Esp when you also get to watch the sun set at your table and dine under the stars. Perfect location to have a nice meal for your vacation.The prices are rather high on the menu but don't let that deter you cause the food was simply amazing! I had the 3 course Prix Fixe for RM150 - the crispy soft shell crab to start which was delicious, light and crab was fresh and it was not oily at all. I ordered the Ikan Bakar for mains and the grilled seabass was done perfectly, fish was fresh and the sauce and accompaniments went very well with it. My hubby ordered the Fabulous authentic Malaysian Pallet RM79 - like its name everything on his plate tasted very good and the portions were just nice. For dessert I chose the Choc Molten cake with ice cream - Simply Divine!It's not just about the food but every staff working in the restaurant and bar were very pleasant and they are always smiling so the whole dining experience was simply wonderful. I did not realize that I left my hat on the seat when we left the restaurant after dinner. I only realised it when I was packing to leave in the morn.I immediately call the hotel and when transferred to the F&B, the gentlemen on the other end immediately recognize my voice when I asked if they have seen my hat, he knew I was the lady from Singapore and said they tried to look for me after I left but could not find me in the busy street. Knowing that I could pick up my hat on my way to the airport, we decided to stop by to have lunch and enjoy one of their popular cocktails "Thai Spicy Mojito" before heading back to Singapore.We will definitely return here if we were to visit Langkawi again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Baldwin_MrSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very cool beach bar
Review: We had afternoon cocktails here, the staff are great as are the drinks and atmosphere. You're overlooking the beach - gorgeous! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Barun CStamford, Connecticut
Title: Great food but maybe the regular bartender was on vacation
Review: The setting is wonderful: we had made a reservation and got there at 7.00 pm, got a table on the beach and watched the sunset. We had the Malay/Asian dishes and the food was delicious: fresh Sea Bass, Beef Rendang and a Prawn and a Duck dish. The waiters were nice. Unfortunately, the cocktails were lousy, made by someone who had very little idea of what they were doing. Would recommend going there but would suggest maybe to get a beer or a glass of wine instead of a cocktail. The place is somewhat pricey, but, other than the cocktails, worth it.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: engsoontPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Best dining with sunset view
Review: Nice and romantic dining on the beach, the staffs are very friendly and attentive, food are cooked to the perfection, no doubt this is the best dining (with sunset view) I can find in langkawi so far, just one thing to take note, the mosquito repellent may not be sufficient during the evening and when we highlighted then only the staff find out the repellent device under the table is not workingShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jorge DMadrid, Spain
Title: Amazing
Review: Oasis in the chaotic pantai cenang area. Amazing food, cooked to perfection. Sunset view from table on the beach at just 5m from the sea. Probably the best one in the island for those expecting good food, western style and good atmosphere.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Teamtravel_12Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food in a beautiful setting
Review: The best restauarant Langkawi has to offer.Friendly staff, Beautiful setting and very nice food.Highly recommend dining at Casa Del Mar if you are in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CoalsacksBury St. Edmunds, United Kingdom
Title: Stayed at hotel and ate there twice
Review: Food excellent and staff so friendly. Me he both western and Malay choices. Good to watch the sun go down and if there for happy hour with a difference. Spin the wheel and get the colour right and you get a free drinkShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: nicolah750Taif, Saudi Arabia
Title: Exquisite food , service could be better
Review: The food is amazing and the beach setting beautiful , but the staff need to be better and more attentive Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Karen5021Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fabulous
Review: Everything was fantastic, food, service and view. Absolutely perfect. I recommend making a reservation for around 7:00 PM. This gives you time to place your order and sit back to enjoy the sunset.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Davo35
Title: Excellent Range and Taste
Review: The menu had a raft of options available to choose from for both lunch and dinner, with almost everyone we tried being superb
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BubutokiMalaysia
Title: Best dinner in Langkawi
Review: We had our dinner on the beach, service was excellent. We ordered Cod fish and Salmon, the presentation of the food and taste is 10/10! Husband ordered Pimms cocktail which is not on the menu, the bartender fulfilled his request and it was nicely done. He said it was the best he ever tried. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Chris C
Title: Excellent food service and location
Review: We had a pre dinner drink at the hotel bar overlooking the beach followed by an excellent meal on the beach. The food and service was excellent and the view great.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kirstieyatesLondon
Title: Pretty average food
Review: Not sure why this is rated so highly, we were quite disappointed in the food. Can only think it is because of the setting - which is stunning - and the fact that there are limited restaurants to compete with this USP. My friend had the beef rendang (the meat was quite chewy) and I had the chicken thigh with pumpkin curry. I was quite excited by the latter, but it turned out to be just pumpkin slices, rubbed in spices and grilled - hardly a curry in my opinion! My whole plate was very dry and I actually sent my first lot of pumpkin back as it was under-cooked and inedible. Overall the dishes sounded a lot better on the menu than the reality.This place has great potential and is worth a visit for a drink at least, but I feel the food is far better in other restaurants in Cenang. With CBA newly re-opened next door I think they need to raise their game here...Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Therese K
Title: Geweldig diner
Review: Best restaurant the past 5 daysRomantic seance, great food, wonderful well priced wine listThanks Pieter & Therese from the NetherlandsShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Phil_Robert8
Title: Food by the beach?
Review: How many places can you go to have a relaxing good meal by the beach along with nice settings? With two friends thats what we thought when we went to have a late dinner by the beach. It was 22.15 and we were shown to a table. The kitchen was closing at 22.30 and we were told it was alright to order. We did so straight away. Twice the waiter came back and informed us that the chef/kitchen could not cook what we ordered. Realising the late hour going elswhere we finally managed to order something the kitchen was prepared to cook. By this time it was almost 22.30. What the three of us managed share was one starter, one main and one dessert, which all came at once, as they were now closing the kitchen. Never have we been so rushed to eat. The food was alright, but mixing the three dishes at the same time should not be recommended. Perhaps a good suggestion is that in the future the kitchen staff should be more in sync when it comes to taking last orders. For RM 300 it was money down the drain. We felt it would have been more appropriate if the waiter would have informed us that it was too late to order, rather than serve us something no one was happy with. However we did afterwards manage to have a few drinks by the bar to quench our hunger and thirst until they too closed!We are sure that during other circumstances the outcome would have been more favourable. The location and settings here should prove much better experiences. However this time it turned out to be as they say here, "Malaysia Tak Boleh".Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: meenamelb
Title: Deliciousness on the beach!
Review: The food is amazing. May seem a bit pricey but worth it. The service is second to none. Amazing setting right on the beach watching the sunset while being served. Delicious cocktails!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KevinCoral
Title: Lovely food
Review: We had excellent food for all our meals, the service was great and the personal attention was lovely, it was a fantastic place to see the sun go down.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JoshuaMark
Title: THE BEST ON THE ISLAND. AMAZING :)
Review: I went to La Sal for dinner and it was absolutely amazing. We had dinner on the beach itself and it was so romantic and beautiful. Had the meat of the day and it was really reasonably priced. One of the best restaurants I've ever been to. Because the food was good and the view was breathtaking. Felt the night sea breeze while enjoying my food. The staffs were also very friendly. If budget permits, this is one place you have to check out. It rained Midway while having dinner at the staffs were so quick and efficient in transferring all of our food and items on the table to the covered seating area. Definitely coming back soon. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PaperStoneScissorsPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful setting
Review: We had a celebratory meal here one night. The food was fantastic and the setting perfect. The wine list was good and not overpriced and it was nice not to be rushed by the very attentive staff. We had a wonderful sunset too which was the icing on the cake.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ElenaL384Melbourne, Australia
Title: Magnificent location
Review: Casa Del Mar was absolutely beautiful. It's alittle pricey but the view of the open beach and the rest of island were to die for. We dined on the sand and the food we had was delicious. My girlfriends and I tried the following: pesto & mushroom pasta, the tasting platter & chicken tikka. It's a must do, even once Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PhillipNarelleWollongong, Australia
Title: MAGNIFICENT
Review: This place is superb, the choice & selection is extensive. The way to my heart is through my stomach & certainly this place hit the spot. Staff very polite & obliging, nothing is an issue for them, just ask & you will receive. Menu great choice especially for me as I am not a fan of spicy food. The chief very accommadating with my wishes, certainly worth the visit, "l'll be back"Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sharyn1969Golden Beach, Australia
Title: excellent value for money
Review: Great food and even better service. have always found staff understanding and welcoming. During our most recent dinner we even had the chef come out and talk to us and asked about our meal and asked could he do anything more. our favorite dishes were the pumpkin soup, rack of lamb, soft shelled crab, sorbet and the Malay tasting plate. watching the sun set on the beach is absolutely beautiful. BTW the breakfast is amazing here too. all pastries jams made fresh on premises. big thumbs up from us. mouth watering menu can't wait to come back and taste more.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kate WHong Kong, China
Title: Lunch
Review: Food is okay but not outstanding. Services is horrible. U have to try really hard to have their attention even tho we are the only table. When I ask for the bill, that tall guy give me a look like he felt annoying. Service is a joke here. The other slim guy took our order is very nice and proper though. Just that tall fat guy is extremely disgusting. We visited on 4 June lunch. Don't go there unless u want a unpleasant meal. And it's quite expensive compare to other restaurants in that area. Cheap for me cause restaurants in Hong Kong is quite pricy. We spend 170 there. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: edhuangsg
Title: Poor
Review: Good was poor for the price. Can't believe a RM100+ steak came with corn and peas. Completely overrated. Not coming back ever.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: YankieDownunderWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: The best in Langkawi
Review: We dined here three times in our 5 day stay on Langkawi, and we never do that. La Sal's lovely beach setting and beautiful food kept us coming back even though we were staying at another 5 star resort. Their execution of Malay dishes was the best we found on the island. They used prime cuts of meat and fresh ingredients, something we did not consistently find in Malaysia. We tried their nasi goreng, beef Rendang and several chicken dishes and enjoyed them all. By far the cleanest, tastiest and most elegant restaurant we found in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ChrisMaeMumSydney, Australia
Title: Michellin standard
Review: Fresh local & fresh imported ingredients, prompt service from stove to table, a good range of choices for breakfast. To top to the excellence, wait staff embrace personal touch to recall one's favorite order.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shoobish
Title: great location and service
Review:
A stylish place to watch the sun set,  staff are switched on and the decor is relaxing and stylish.    Great attention to detail generally.
The food is good if not absolutely great,  but compared to local options it stands out
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ViolettafmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing dining and a very good service !
Review: I was travelling to Langkawi with my parents and we have very much enjoyed La Sal at Casa del Mar dining experience.The food was excellent as well as the overall setting on the white sand beach.I highly recommend the tasting seafood menu and the Seabass.As well I wanted to thank Azura, who served my parents a few times when they went to La Sal after I have already left Langawi. Thank you for all the arrangements and service.We definitely come back to the restaurant when we are back to Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: carlingfordgreenwayCarlingford, Ireland
Title: Probably the best restaurant in Pantai Cenang
Review: We stayed at Casa Del Mar and so enjoyed a number of dining experiences at La Sal during the week we were in Langkawi. The food was very well presented and contemporary in approach, unlike almost everywhere we tried. It is not cheap by Langkawi standards but you get what you pay for ! Service was extremely good on the whole and the staff are very professional and friendlyShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mikeandkaren1
Title: Wedding Anniversary
Review: Location: on the beach, great views and sunset!Food: we had crab and the prawn to start and both followed with the Angus beef. Starters were good but chilli vinaigrette overpowered the crab. Beef was good too but one piece a bit chewy due to a layer of sinew. Strange mash potato with pickled silver skin onions. A bit odd!Desert was the soft chocolate sponge. Came with chocolate mousse and ice cream. Sponge was excellent, mousse average and the ice cream full of ice crystals.Wine: glass of Chillian Sauvignon which was OK but this was the only white by the glass. A Muscadet or Chablis style would have been better with the seafood. With the main course we had a Coonawarra which again was OK but lacked the depth and complexity of those we have tried in Australia.Service: friendly and pleasant but we must have seen every waiter in the place. Nobody seems to be responsible for particular tables as in most good restaurants.Overall a nice meal in great surroundings BUT nothing special and expensive for what it was.We rate this as average not compared with other local restaurants but with quality places elsewhere.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ScrumBumJakartaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Romance and fine food
Review: Booked a private romantic dinner on the beach and was not disappointed. The food was excellent, service quite yet efficient with a sunset and tropical breeze adding to the whole evening.Worth the price.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: miss-b20Manchester
Title: Beautiful setting for watching the sunset
Review: The sunset stole the show here. The restaurant is perfectly located on the beachfront which is really romantic. Red sangria was yummy. White, not nice at all. (Can't win them all)The food was delicious, although once the sun went down it wasn't so easy to see.The chocolate pudding was outstanding. Would love to go back just for pudding and cocktails. Overall this was my favourite place we ate on langkawi. I would definitely revisit if we come back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Raymond wGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: Small selection but very good quality. We visited twice and both times the food was well presented and of a high standard.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: lia80
Title: Dining by the sea. . .
Review: There is not a better choice !!! Exceptional dishes offering local and western options.Reasonably priced concerning the quality and the location. Perfect service by willing and friendly staff.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 456LeoSUster
Title: Excellent food.
Review: very good choice and outstanding quality brought to you by waiters who become your friends. Add a Chardonnay to the wine list and things will be perfect.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: shuggy48MuscatJohannesburg, South Africa

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: Casa del Mar is a truly wonderful boutique hotel where standards and service are absolutely first class and these qualities have been carried through to the dining experience at their al la carte restaurant, La Sal.We dined here on four occasions during our two week stay and have to say that every meal we had was fantastic. What complimented the food was that on three of the evenings we were blessed with clear skies so we could dip our feet in the sand, sit under a star filled sky, savour the food delights and sample a glass or two of well priced and flavoursome wine.... Heaven!There is a well balanced menu offering something for all tastes but our favourites are the soft shell crab entree (and we both usually hate crab) followed by the rack of lamb which is the tenderist we have ever had. During our stay, the recently appointed new chef introduced a new menu choice which thankfully still has our favourites on it but also has other dishes which we look forward to trying when we return.Service for us is just right being not too hurried and not too slow, the experience here is not just about the food but soaking up the wonderful setting and ambiance. If we wanted an express meal then we would choose to go to MacDonalds! The staff are simply delightful ( as are all of the staff at Casa) and they really strive to please. We witnessed a very rude couple agressively verbally attacking Halim over some issue and in front of other guests and he and the other nearby staff were clearly very upset and took the criticsm very personally. Yes service is not top speed but this is Langkawi and if you want food on the table in 5 minutes then Langkawi is not for you. Life on this island is about chilling and getting off of the rapidly moving treadmill life at home and spending relaxed quality time with friends/your partner whilst enjoying the delights of this beautiful island.Cost is high end for Cenang but in our opinion it is good value for the food and experience.As I write this review it is taking me back to those wonderful evenings at La Sal and I am already counting the days to when we return in November.Sincere thanks to everyone for superb meals and a wonderful and memorable holiday and many best wishes to Robert in his new venture.Margaret and Keviin from the UKShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pandt2013Sydney, Australia
Title: Exceptional food with great location
Review: Our first visit was for a lunch time snack based on TA reviews and location. Food was tasty, decent selection and good atmosphere. We decided to book in for dinner for the next night and had a table on the beach with our feet in the sand and mood lighting. Great location to sit and watch the sunset while enjoying our entrees of prawn ceviche and Caesar salad. We decided on Stonier Pinot Noir wine as we drink this at home. Reasonably priced at MYR 149. Our mains were Malay tasting platte and beef rendang. Finished on an old favourite of banana fritters. What a meal! Food was delicious with atmosphere to match.When you compare the restaurant to what else is on offer along the beach street this really is a diamond in the rough. A must try, great location,food to match and a reasonable price for a wonderful dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: titans123Studley, United Kingdom

Author: WaWa1963Brisbane, Australia
Title: Variable service but GREAT food
Review: The only reason for the less than perfect rating is the variable service. Our party of 4 dined at La Sal twice in the last 5 days and the food was amazing- delicious flavours and everything cooked to perfection. Author: jonmegsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Exquisite food and setting
Review: My wife and I ate here on four occasions during our 7 night stay at Casa del Mar whilst celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary.Simply superb food, first class quality served by enthusiastic, friendly staff who aim to please. Thanks to all the wait staff who ensured we enjoyed every aspect of our time at La Sal. Credit to all.We ate various dishes - 3 courses.Starters - fresh cooked on site bread served with your choice of delicious olive oil with a dash of chilli (our preferred choice). Lovely way to start and relax whilst enjoying our drinks which were served not long after being seated & ordered.We had prawns, soft she'll crab for entrees along with several others during our stay. Prawns in my view are a stand out.Mains - order off menu or chose from chefs specials of the night - usually two choices. They were superb too. I'm from Aust and I had the best Aust tenderloin steak ever! My wife's tuna was also truly amazing. We also tried beef rendang, Malaysian tasting platter and various other mains. All were delicious and high quality & quantity meals.Desert - we couldn't go passed the choc pud on most nights. Delightful. (We did run along beach every morning so we could justify eating all the above)Beachfront setting - romantic, quiet, and stunning. Some of the Most stunning sunsets I've seen.Staff/chef & kitchen crew - our sincere thanks. You were simply the best. Once you've finished and Bobs lifted you out of your chair, wobble over to the La Sal bar and enjoy a nightcap served by Mood, Murphy or Boy. Enjoy the stories of other travellers and laugh along with the staff who'll keep you entertained for as long as you stay.Thanks to all at La Sal,JonShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RobertJGrayGisborne, New Zealand
Title: Let down by slow service
Review: We ate twice at La Sal, first time excellent and could not be faulted however the second time we waited an hour for our starters. The staff were appologetic and the mains followed within minutes. Desert however was again a long wait (I had to go and ask again) and we could not help notice that the staff had descended into a chatting huddle and seemed to have lost interest in the restaurant service.Perhaps it was because it was the weekend? Anyway as we left they the waitress ran after us wanting us to come back and sign the bill. The meal was excellent on both occasions and the location is splendid but it seems that the service can be patchy. Pity. Luckily Cenang Beach offers lots of choice for dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: petergJ4933MLChina
Title: Good food, somewhat pricy for Langkawi
Review: We recently visited the restaurant in February 2015. We were with friends who had visited there last year. The restaurant pitches to the higher end of the market. Unfortunately it falls slightly short. The location is fantastic, slightly away from the madding crowds that are the norm for places such as Yellow Beach Café. Able to view the sunset in all its glory. The ratio of waiters to customers was on our night high, which meant the lack of attentiveness by the waiters was strange. The starter's were excellent. The main meals were similarly excellent, although the Western meal (Australian steaks) were fairly small portions. The local Malaysian and Asia meals were much more sizeable. The meals seemed to take some time to be prepared, given that the restaurant not overflowing that evening. There were a number of meals that require a 24hr notice period. If you are not guest at the Casa Del Mar hotel, this is an inconvenience which would necessitate a second visit during your holiday if you wished to order the succulent looking meals. Overall very good but some polish in some areas would make an evening meal for a non hotel guest a truly memorable occasion. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: It is still a magic spot, but some things have changed
Review: I have enjoyed dinner at the front row at La Sal for many years now. I have always marked the front row in the sunset as a magic spot in the world. It is still a magic spot, but this time I could not help noticing that some things have changed since last year. What did not change were the restaurant tables on the beach, the sunset, the friendly and dedicated staff and the menu. However, since my previous stay the chef of La Sal had found employment elsewhere (The Danna I hear) and a new chef had taken office. Although the menu had not changed noticeably, there was a marked difference in the preparation of the dishes. Not the starters; I can vouch for the tuna tartare and the beef salad, they were as delicious as ever, but concerning the main course, I found that the portions had become noticeably smaller and my digestive system told me afterwards, that probably a flavor-enhancing substance like MSG was used. MSG is used by Chinese restaurants in the Netherlands too often. As I am sensitive to MSG I avoid these restaurants in the Netherlands. Don't get me wrong; the food quality of the main course was still above average, but different from last year. Furthermore, due to the ongoing increasing popularity of Cenang Beach with tourists, the ambiance has changed. Were in the past only scattered tourists and local families on the beach, enjoying the sunset, now numerous towels with sun bathing tourists are deployed in front of the La Sal Restaurant. These tourists may be playing ball games close to the restaurant. Once, as I was enjoying my first Tiger beer of the evening, sitting on the front row, I had to duck sharply in order to avoid being scalped by an erratic thrown frisbee. Also jeeps with trailers and water scooters are moving to and fro. But also changed were made on the positive side. Freshly baked bread and olive oil is always served to enjoy while studying the menu. Now a choice can be made between six flavors of olive oil. A nice touch. To sum up: La Sal is still a magic spot in the world; I would reserve a table on the front row even if only a burger and fries would be on the menu (It is not of course, the menu is extensive), only to enjoy the sunset and being waited on by the excellent and friendly staff. However expect the menu price to be in the upper bracket.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 204LauraM204Melbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious meal in fantastic surroundings
Review: Excellent meal on 2 occasions at La Sal, a perfect setting watching the sunset. Staff were more than happy to take photos.Great choice of both Western and Malaysian dishes on the menu. We could not recommend La Sal more, I would have gladly dined here every night.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ZaaoaiMelbourne, Australia
Title: La luna dinner

If there was a 10 star button i would definately choose that option. The wait staff and robert the manager were just amazing. They exceeded expectations.We were definitely impressed with our table, the sunset, the atmosphere, the service the food. I could not critique anything about this experience. You gave us the perfect beach dinner experience on our anniversary, something we will cherish forever. Until next time...Show less

Author: TurquoisePortTokyo, Japan

Author: beckkiWaterlooville, United Kingdom

My husband had the tuna tartare and I had the crab for entrees. Both yummy. Then I had the rack of lamb and my husband the beef tenderloin. Both beautifully cooked and extremely tasty. Followed by the crime brûlée and panacotta. A reasonably priced bottle of Merlot washed it down. Would definitely come again. Show less

Author: ReedRoverManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great Location
Review: The title of the review sums up our experience really. Tables set up on the gorgeous beach with a view to die for will always boost the overall feel of a place.Don't get me wrong the food was pretty good, I enjoyed my Tomato Soup more than my somewhat chewy Steak I ordered for my main course (medium). Whilst my wife was happy with a starter of soft shell crab and a main of Tuna. Both the Panacotta and Creme Brulee hit the spot.We enjoyed a bottle of chilled white wine but noticed no water was brought to the table or offered by the waiting staff, a mosquito coil around the table would also be a good idea. We also had to endure one member of waiting staff constantly running through the sand between our tables in order to reach the romantic isolated table, this spoiled the ambiance, you don't expect to see a waiter literally running between the tables.So to sum up, the service let the evening down a bit because the location and food seems pretty good, for the money paid the waiting staff should respect customers expect a bit of decorum and perhaps a jug of water on the table.Show less

Author: LarsJ399Stockholm, Sweden
Title: Perfect food
Review: This restaurant, just at the beach, serves excellent food. I especially liked the asian dishes. The asian tasting platter was excellent, the sea bass superb. The wine list is god and you can always find a nice wine to your food,Next time on Langkawa I will probly eat all meals here :-)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: James SMelbourne, Australia
Title: Watch the sun set with a great meal
Review: We dined there twice for dinner, once casually and the other for their private couple degustation dinner which you need to book in advance as they only do one per night. The food was amazing, the service was good and the view is worth the price you pay, which incidently is very good value. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: StapattKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Romantic dining
Review: We had a very nice dinner at this restaurant over the weekend. The setting is right on the beach ... very nice to sit down for a lovely meal with your feet in the sand.The selection of menu is pretty good as well as wine and drinks list.We had tuna tartare and soft-shell crab for starter and both were pretty good and tasty. Then we follow up with grilled cod and seafood risotto ... again both were great. A small comment on the risotto, it was just slightly too much sauce but everything else was great.Then we finished off the meal with Lime creme brûlée ... very refreshing and creamy at the same time.For drinks, we had red wine and "Tom Yum" Martini ... talking about spice up your drink.The staff was nice and polite.Overall we enjoy the the dining experience. We actually went back again for lunch the following day.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shakey031062Wellington, New Zealand
Title: Wonderful way to see out our holiday
Review: We booked Le Sal at Casa Del Mar as our final meal on Langkawi and we were not disappointed.We arrived at about 0730 as the sun was setting over the ocean to be shown to our table on the sands. Every table is beautifully set and has its own lampThe views and this setting are really extraordinary. We ordered cocktails and took in the viewsOur Starters were beautiful I had the Tandoori chicken on skewers and my wife had a delicious tomato and red peepers soup. For my main I had the Australian Lamb Rack with sweet Potato cake and it was beautifully cooked and the sauce was magnificent. My Wife had a Malaysian tasting plate that came with 6 small dishes and 3 dips as well as popadoms and rice. There was beef rending, a chicken dish, a fresh fish dish, a prawn dish among others and it was beautifully presentedAs deserts my wife had the Lime Creme Brûlée and I had the home made coconut ice cream. All three courses were brilliantly presented and tasted wonderful.They have a very extensive drinks list and within It some really excellent wines.You can hav three courses here for 120 RM which is great value for the he standard of the food.The food is top class. The service is wonderful and friendly and the setting is to die for this is a must do venue if you visit LangkawiShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: travellerQBK
Title: Great atmosphere ok food ok service
Review: Went here based on tripadvisor reviews. We reserved a table on the beach to watch sunset, VERY romantic and cozy :) The food is quite good compare with other cheaper restaurants in Langkawi, but with the price like that I expected more.. Service was good through out the meal, the staff were all friendly especially the one who took our orders, he was very helpful and patient. Though in the end some different staff forgot my boyfriends's coffee 3 times... Then the waitress came with a half spilled coffee and she even asked if she should change it...? Well, I think she shouldn't have served that spilled coffee at all in the first place..!Overall I think the atmosphere is the best part of this resturant, worth a visit.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PamK45Leamington Spa, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Ate here a few times and the service, food and wine was extremely good. The modern Asian cuisine was perfect and my favourite was the platter of Asian taster dishes. The onion rings were also the best I have ever had! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: fosterk409Sydney
Title: Great Food
Review: OMG the food here is delicious we recently ate three times at La Sal and everything was perfect from entree main to dessert all was excellently cooked and presentation was faultless highly recommend this restaurant the setting on the beach is fantastic make sure you arrive in time to watch the sunset and enjoy the magicShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Anne W
Title: The best meal for our whole vacation
Review: The restaurant was situated next to our hotel. We originally "sounded" it out in the daytime and couldn't work out if we would like it but booked a reservation. On arrival in the evening the bar was busy, the cocktails excellent and all the tables were beautifully placed on the beach. The service was excellent and the food was a tasty selection of local and international dishes. It was so good we managed to go back again on our last night. A must for Langkawi Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: EmilyAnnaEmmaScotland, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous
Review: One of the best dining experiences of my life. Our table was on the beach, watching the sun set, listening to the sea, beautiful lighting, out of this world food, and first class service. The cocktails are also wonderful. Beef Rendang was fantastic, as was the prawn starter. Didn't want to leave, and even went back it was that good. Very romantic, if you were planning to pop the question this would defo be a place to do it haaaa haaaaShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Zilonis
Title: Al fresco dinner with mosquitos
Review: At the outset we were shown that we are not welcome there. There was a mix up with our booking, not sure who is to blame, Sal or our hotel. The front row of tables was supposedly for the hotel guests - some of them stayed empty through our entire dinner, but we were not allowed to sit there:( The day was nice, so the tables were set at the beach. Nice sunset. By the end of the meal we had multiple mosquito bites. In fairness, they give you mosquito repellent to spray over your body but you need to ask for it.The starter was not nice, the mains were good. So overall no desire to go there second time, but if you are staying long enough in Langkawi, it might be worth a visit, but make sure you do it on a fine day. There is no reason to go there and eat indoors. People might be smoking next to you, so brace yourself for some passive smoking.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Amanda SPerth, Australia
Title: Delicious!
Review: The food here is fantastic, some really delicious items on the menu!The chefs are extremely talented and friendly, and I was lucky enough to have them teach me how to make the Beef rendang, which I'll try to perfect when I get back home.We celebrated New Years here and the food and service was sensational, the kitchen team really did an outstanding job.The wait staff are very friendly and attentive. We've eaten every meal here for the past 8 days and haven't even felt the need to leave as the food and selection has given us a lot of choice and also the opportunity to re-visit menu favourites.Thank you! We love this place!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kate83_11Trigg, Australia

Review: Great location, on the beach with your feet in the sand watching the sunset. Great atmosphere... Food was fantastic and staff are all very friendly and accommodating. We ate here for lunch, dinner and returned for New Year's Eve - that pretty much sums it up!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: S2vishvaGurugram (Gurgaon), India
Title: Food was nice but not great
Review: Food was not the best though overall ok. Either too spicy or not the kind we expected from a trip advisor recommended restaurant. Also it was pricey as compared to the food quality. Ambience was great though. Very Spanish and next to the beach so great view and ambience . Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AussieJonoSydney, Australia
Title: Fabulous food, magical setting
Review: After a stroll along the beach my partner and I stopped for a meal, the service was fantastic and the food delicious. We dined on the beach enjoying terrific cocktails and food. Whilst there are cheaper option it represents good value for money considering the quality of the dining experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: diegoehvEindhoven
Title: They made our xmas night unexpectedly more amazing
Review: We didn't really plan anything, but decided to go for the #1 rated restaurant on tripadvisor for our Christmas dinner. When we arrived they said they were sorry, because for Christmas they had a special meal that started for everyone at the same time and they were at the last course.We were a bit bummed, (it was our fault for being late, we arrived at 9.30pm) but before we even could ask a question, the waiter said, we may have ran out of certain food, but I can ask the chef if he is willing to make you the 8 course dinner and adapt it a little bit.They ended up having us as only table after everybody was leaving or started to hang out at the bar. They even situated us at a spot that we didn't feel the last table and they put so much effort in creating this amazing experience for us. The 8 course meal was absolutely fantastic and very creative. They gave us little xmas presents and the staff was friendly, fun, service minded and entertaining. We can't thank them enough for creating a lasting memory! Great job!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HuugslikWarsaw, Poland
Title: Great place
Review: We had a really nice diner outside, with a view over the sea. The prices are higher then other restaurants but the quality of the food en service are great. Really nice place for a romantic diner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Maria V
Title: Excellent meals
Review: We had 4 dinners at La Sal so tried a number of items off the menu and all were delicious. Also, the portion sizes are very generous. Ambience is lovely and service is excellent. Cocktails are also very good.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mercutio1982Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Everything that could go wrong, did.
Review: The restaurant highlights were the coconut mojito (very generous and you could actually taste the rum in it) and the soft shell crab appetizer. Unfortunately, our mains and overall experience made this my worst outing at a restaurant ever.I called to make a reservation almost an hour before arriving and was told there was no need. I gave our arrival time, number of people in our party and my first name anyways. None of it was noted down and our reservation was not found when we arrived.This only meant we had to sit by the bar, rather than inside. There were 3 tables inside that were never occupied the entire time we were there.The service was absolutely terrible. It took 30 minutes for us to get menu, order and receive our drinks. It took me requesting menus and a lady who seemed to be the manager to remind the bar staff of our drinks for this to happen. Nonetheless, 3 people had already come to the table to deliver serviettes, cutlery and placemats.When our drinks and food came, the waitstaff didn't know what or to whom they were serving (the crab was served as prawns, the cod served as salmon). The chicken tikka, supposed to be boneless, was not. One of our dishes was supposed to be non-spicy and our request wasn't honored.At the end our meal, my sago took a long time to arrive. When I inquired about the wait (20min), the waiter came with it immediately (meaning it had been sitting on the counter and no one bothered to bring it).There were two aspects of service that I had never witnessed before. At around 10pm, the entire staff had their backs to the customers and seemed to be organizing cutlery into drawers, folding napkins, dragging red buckets to and from the beach. There was no one minding our table, a couple having a romantic dinner, and a party of six inside, the last customers still there.The second thing is that there didn't seem to one waiter or waitress assigned to us. Between calling people to ask for menus, we probably interacted with every member of staff. This is probably why the delays -- no one was responsible for getting things to us.From the reviews, It expected the food would at least make up for the service. The two menu items I chose were unavailable, and the main I chose was mediocre.From the other reviews, it seems the management is intent on improving this issue which is why I made a point of writing this extensive review. The staff were nice and friendly, and the location is interesting. The restaurant has a lot of potential, but as of my experience, does not deserve a place in the top 10 in the island.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bpmelloPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: No, no, no.
Review: I'm glad that they were fully booked for Christmas, otherwise, it would be worse.We tried one more time, and when we called to make reservations, we were told that it was not necessary.When we arrived, the receptionist was shocked when we said that we had no reservation. The restaurant was quite empty, but she insisted on 'fully booked', and said that the only tables were outside (it was raining, but covered, so it was fine).After 15 minutes, my husband had to ask for the menu, and 30 min later, we ordered. 45 min later, a third waiter showed up asking if we ordered drinks, so it was when they started.We specifically ordered something non spicy, which of course came inedible (chicken kaptain). My dish was plain (cod fish), and my husband's was ok (chicken tikka), but nothing special. They had no idea what we ordered, since 3 or 4 different waiters came to our table every time, so they even delivered our order to another table.We had to ask for the dessert 2x, and we took our chance and asked for the bill.We arrived at 9:00pm and left 11:20pm. A lot of waiting, and the restaurant was not packed. Only one group arrived after us (and were served before), the other tables were empty all night, and before we left, they were cleaning the place in front of us.I'm not the one who complains, but it was a waste of time, and an unpleasant experience. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 785crystaljSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good mix of western and local food
Review: We ordered seafood risotto, whole sea bass, and a tuna tartare with goat cheese. Very delicious and nice environment. You can have a nice walk on the beach after your dinner. However, there were lots of Mosquitos when we first sat down (maybe because it just rained) so don't forget to apply your bug spray beforehand.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: roeyDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: "Heaven"
Review: Eating at la sal is truly heaven, all our meals we have eaten here have been a delight to the taste buds. The service has always been faultless.The location is great, we have made a point of choosing various dishes on the menu, from all courses.we have enjoyed every meal.The food is as good as it gets in langkawi.thanks David&CarolShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cherry B
Title: Excellent resaurant
Review: The restaurant has an interesting range of dishes at reasonable prices. Very good friendly service  amazing breakfast
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sarah FOslo, Norway
Title: lovely
Review: the best food around if u prefer western style, great service, cozy hotel. great location....very close to any activity u would like. i like that its a small hotel, only 35 rooms.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: oneroa
Title: Eat in house, no need to leave the hotel
Review: We ate here most nights as the menu was good and the food just fine. A comprehensive menu which should suit all tastes
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NRS221Chennai (Madras), India
Title: Excellent
Review: We stayed here and ate a lot of times. After getting out to eat at outside restaurants, we realized that we were better off here rather than other places.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Vincent_TanesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dining In Cenang Beach
Review: Thank you to Mr. Robert, the restaurant manager of La Sal. With his kind help, my proposal arrangement by the beach is perfectly carried out. As for the food, we ordered 2 set dinner (choosing from the menu for appetiser, mains and desserts) and turned out all above our expectation! Value added to the nice ambient where tables are set up by the beach and you dine under the sunset, serving by the always smiling staff, your dining experience just got even better. The cocktails, which we had it in the afternoon, is as good as it said from other reviewer! It's highly recommended to dine here for the nice quality and tasty food, for the ambient and most importantly, it's not expensive than what we thought it should be!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: driz95Malaysia
Title: Cosy ambience, lovely food & service
Review: It was a drizzly evening and thus we didn't dine on the beach as is the norm here, and instead were seated inside under the verandah overlooking the pool. It was a particularly pleasant evening, soft lighting,and very cosy atmosphere. Waiters were extremely polite and helpful and always with a smile.We had both the western and local main courses. The western was the cod prepared with mango and bok choy, and the rack of lamb, both of which were prepared to perfection. The only downside was that the portions were really small! Our asian fare was the baked seabass which was exceptionally fresh and is served with rice and a side salad, and prawns cooked in coconut broth and vegetables which was equally lovely. For dessert, we tried the tiramisu and chocolate pudding - both were ok.We had a lovely bottle of Chilean white to complement our meal - there's a fairly decent wine selection but it is a tad pricey given that we're on a duty free island. There was also complimentary bread served with olive oil which was a nice additional touch.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Susan RFareham, United Kingdom
Title: Great Birthday
Review: A great meal for my birthday and the staff even decorated my dessert when they found out. The staff were brillantShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ullailtolaAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Try the local flavours
Review: Such a nice restaurant! We tried the Malaysian tasting platter and everything was just lovely. It is a very romantic place and the service was superb. They even had mouthwash in the restrooms!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gary DBusselton, Australia
Title: Eat and Stay here...you CANNOT go wrong!!!
Review: Third visit to Casa Del Mar..6 nights this trip. Ate here 6 breakfasts, 5 Lunches/Brunches/ Snacks & 5 dinners. We sat on the beach one night, on the verandah others...near the bar others. Food, service, wine list, and cocktails...all supplied by some of the nicest, friendliest and helpful people you could ask for. Between 6 adults, I am sure we gave everything on the menu a good taste test. I can't recall any misgivings about any meal that any one of us ate...lovely presentation, tasty and delivered promptly to the tables (well timed delivery for all of us). The Prawn entrée wrapped in fine wire noodles, The Caesar Salad & the Chicken Tandoori Skewers were all regular orders...whilst the King Prawn Risotto,Tuna plus Grilled White Cod main were all superb, whilst the Lamb Rack and the Beef Dish, which were also popular. Deserts: The Chocolate Trio/ Crème Brulee were heavily patronised. Cold Beers, Fresh Juices & Great Mai Tai's (plenty of them consumed)...beautiful setting. Lunch was varied with lots of options. Check the Menu out on the Website...fantastic. Wishing I was back there right now...watching the sun set with another Mai Tai!!! JUST PERFECTShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mknormanSydney, Australia
Title: Best Degustation Ever
Review: My partner, two friends and myself had the La Luna degustation menu whilst on holiday in Langkawi. Our table was on the beach, surrounded by torches and candles. The food and wine were amazing, very generous portions for a degustation, and the service was exceptional. The food was some of they best we have tasted anywhere in the world, and the accompanying wines were chosen with great care to compliment the courses. At the end of the meal, the ladies in our party were presented with flowers and chocolates, which was a lovely touch and a fine way to end the night. I would urge anyone visiting Langkawi to eat here - the prices are very reasonable - and all in all it was a magical evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: spam66
Title: Beach setting
Review: Lovely setting on the beach (when the weather is dry)! Great food, friendly service, and make sure you arrive in good time for a cocktail or two at the bar before your meal!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: islandlover39
Title: Very nice food
Review: The food was delicious and the flavours were very well put together. My beef was a little over-done but I can forgive that as the rest of the plate was exceptional - as was the desert.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jazz JMalaysia
Title: Lovely view and good service
Review: We were here for dinner 2 nights ago. Lovely view of the beach and nice ambience. As for the food we ordered local dishes- I had the Chicken kapitan and my husband had the beef rendang. Both dishes were quite sweet and not very authentic. The presentation of the meals were good, unfortunately we were quite disappointed with the taste. The local dishes best suite the tourists so maybe it's best to get something from the western menu. Besides the food the service is excellent and the waiters and waitresses are very attentive. It's ideal venue if you prefer to chill out with friends for a drink or two.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ChriszelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and excellent service!
Review: It was my post birthday vacation at casa del mar and my wife has mentioned that it was a belated birthday trip for me. The restaurant staff surprised us with a birthday song on guitar as well as a cake, it's such a sweet gesture! Food was also superb! We ordered the beef rendang which was fabulous as well as the special of the day sea bass which was fantastic! Excellent service displayed by service crew! Thumbs up! Best regardsChris & HazelShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: welovehongkong27
Title: Simply delicious
Review: Good service, delicious food and a great location. Who could ask for more? Except maybe being able to return soon :)
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: junp308Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Amazing foods and venue for couple...
Review: We have selected again and stayed at Casa del Mar Langkawi for our short holidays. Service was usual fantastic from the moment we checked in. The staff cheerfully made my reservation at the beachfront dining for us the next day. We are pampering ourself and ordered the Seafood Plattter for 2 person. Lucky for us, the weather was kind to us that night, although a bit windy (and heavy rain right after our dinner ended). Since this trip is like reward for ourself, we ordered a nice recommended bottle of red wine to go with the scenic view of the sea just infront of us. They have an extensive list of wines too. The foods were fresh, appropriate portions and amazingly tasty, came with prawn, fish, squid and lobster.I must say the services were attentive and tip top, and not too intrusive. Overall, both of us have a marvelous dinning reception and both of us retreated back to our home with the biggest smile and satisfaction!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: dolcevita_68United Kingdom
Title: VERY DISAPPOINTING SERVICE
Review: We booked weeks in advance and received confirmation, as we wanted every day of our Honeymoon to be perfect. We chose La Sal (over many other restaurants which we wish we had chosen instead), for it's location and reputation on TA for a romantic evening which was also my birthday. When we arrived there was no one at reception, when someone showed up we told them of our booking and we were waved in the direction of the beach bar. Again we mentioned to bar staff we had booked a table but were simply asked what we'd like without even being shown a bar menu. In short after an hour on uncomfortably high bar stools, having finished our drinks long before (being offered more drinks constantly - we're not accustomed to drinking vast quantities of alcohol prior to fine dining) and several requests as to when our table would be ready we were eventually shown inside to the darkest & most humid part of the restaurant, we'd specifically requested an outside table weeks ago. When we asked about this two words were barked at us "Fully Booked". (Yes, maybe but we were one of those "Booked"). There were only three tables with people seated the rest were empty yet everyone seemed to be restless as if waiting for food, menu, drinks so I think the service in this place seriously needs addressing. I was so disappointed and frustrated that we'd had to wait an hour to be told this & explained that I didn't want to stay if it meant eating in a dark corner. No apology was offered and when I again asked if he had record of our booking the waiter just said he'd ask the manager. I left without wasting more of limited holiday time. This ruined what was supposed to be a special honeymoon/birthday evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 88goldcoasttravellerGold Coast, Australia
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: We stayed the the casa del mar and I am so glad we had this restaurant so close to us. The most amazing food and service, we had dinner with the sand between our toes and candlelit very romantic with the most amazing view. We also had dinner in the gazebo as well which was very nice and romantic, we even got to have dinner one night with another couple in the gazebo. Very friendly staff and helpful. This is great for couples and a great dinner with friends as we'll. The cocktails were unbelievable along with the food!from the entrees to the mains to the desserts we tried something each night and you can't go wrong with anything on that menu, we'll worth the price. So fresh and the food is presented so well. A must try, you won't be disappointed :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 807KimP807
Title: Fabulous food in beautiful setting
Review: We ate beautiful Malaysian food at a table on the beach lit by torches. The service is exemplary with lots of added touches. The ambience and food is amazing and something that we would certainly recommend.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RitaSaadeStockholm, Sweden
Title: Fancy place
Review: Good foodLovely view It is located on the beach, the place is great if you are planning a romantic dinner.It is calm and probably perfect for sunset Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JasmineTaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good mains but overpriced desserts
Review: It's a breeze making reservations over the phone. The front row tables are reserved for in-house guests only so if you don't stay there, you can only sit at the 2nd or 3rd row.The menu on their website is not updated and the prices are different. I ordered the Baked Chicken Capitan which is spicy chicken served in an open top coconut. It is SOOO good! My husband ordered the Australian Beef Rendang and it is the bomb! Awesome awesome dish! I kept stealing from his plate! Try these 2 dishes if you love local Malaysian food. :)Service is fast and prompt. Really happy with all the wait-staff here.Only slight complain was that the birthday cake aka "cake of the day" costs RM24++ and it's just a small slice of cheap quality chocolate cake. Very disappointing. Most restaurants offer a complimentary slice of birthday cake or dessert for the birthday person.. I wouldn't mind paying but the cake really tasted lousy. Thank God my husband was not a fussy eater like me and he polished it off.Overall, highly recommended for a romantic dinner date! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jan CMelbourne, Australia
Title: Absolutely Perfect!
Review: Have just arrived back from dining at La Sal at Casa del Mar. It was such a great experience that I needed to write a review immediately! While La Sal is certainly not budget dining it was absolutely 'value for money'!Although I hadn't booked (low season) and was not a guest at Casa del Mar I was immediately made most welcome in their beautiful restaurant by the sea. Service throughout the meal was prompt, courteous and genuinely warm. Guests were offered bread with a choice of oils and balsamic before dining. Delicious!I choose the Malaysian Tasting plate from the wide menu and there was no problem in substituting the two meat selections with seafood, including amazing soft shell crab. For dessert I also went 'local' trying the sago pudding with Gula Melaka syrup. Yum!The house wine was reasonably priced and the coffee served with an amaretti biscuit really finished off the meal.My only problem was that I was unable to take clear pictures of my meal to post with my review, due to the muted, romantic lighting. Will have to come back for lunch for some bright pics!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: marfPerth_WAPerth, Australia
Title: Fantastic
Review: Had dinner on the beach with a great view of the ocean. Meal was delicious and fresh. Cocktail was also great. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KenJean2014South Jordan, Utah
Title: Very Romantic Evening
Review: It was the most romantic evening we had in Langkawi. The price is a little expensive but the atmosphere and eating dinner on the beach was well worth it. We did not have reservations but they accommodated us anyway. The was great too. This was our first time ever to have a meal on the beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ghostriverKlang, Malaysia
Title: Awesome restaurant with outstanding staff !!!!
Review: I came here for candle light dinner. I made a booking with Mr. Robert and actually this is surprise dinner to my wife for our wedding anniversaries. I’ve got Mr. Robert's help for the dinner arrangement and he is very helpful and really supportive. ENVIRONMENTThe environment is so perfect if you’re looking for a romantic, calm place. There are table set up inside the restaurant and also on the beach. Our table was set up on the beach, with flowers. So perfect! The lighting around the restaurant and also on the beach also perfect. Really put you in the mood.They didn’t have any live band here. I believe what you want to hear when you have dinner at beach is sound of wave, not sounds of loud music which will ruin you’re the calm environment. FOODThe foods are delicious. It is worth it to wait for the food. No complaint at all on the foods. STAFFStaffs here are very friendly, really supportive. All the staffs that we meet wished me and my wife happy anniversaries. The staff also wish us on our dessert plate! Awesome!At the end of the dinner, the Mr. Halim and his team gave us greeting card and chocolate for our anniversaries, which are something unexpected and extraordinary services. This is something that we will never forget especially on their great services.Conclusion:5 stars for Mr. Robert, Mr. Halim and Team for your really great support. You guys rock!!!!I really appreciated your great assistance and my wife really enjoy our romantic dinner here. Thank you for the wonderful night and tip top services provided to us while we had our dinner here.Travellers - Try their signature dish and you will not regret!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Diana RTheydon Bois
Title: Disappointing
Review: Sadly the night we dined here was a bit windy so not the best experience sitting on the beach. Having ordered, service was very slow so by the time food arrived it was pretty well dark. With only a small candle lighting a table for 4 it was hard to see what we were eating. This is a shame as one of the very important senses in eating is vision as well as taste. And that brings me on to flavour which was really lacking. No lovely spicy food and the beef rendang was really chewy. Really disappointing as we had our hopes up after reading recent reviews.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: orquidearojaCatalonia, Spain
Title: Food was superb!
Review: I have made a reservation at La Sal for our Company Annual Dinner on 30th August and our table was booked outdoor and on the beach. Eventhough the Food was a bit pricey, however you will be satisfied with the excellent service from the Restaurant crew and of course the food was extremely superb. Great atmosphere. Will definitely come back in the future. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MonkeyCastle
Title: Amazing locatin > Awesome food > Great Service!
Review: They got it in all categories! Food selection, food quality, location and super friendly and professional service! Simply the Best and not easy to find in Langkawi!!! Great wine selection at reasonable prices!!! The Best restaurant on the island, if not one of the Best in Malaysia!!! Location-Location-Location!!! Sunset dinner is pricless there!!! Right on the beach!!! A must for a perfect holiday!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pocky_11Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated?
Review: Walked in without a reservation on a Sat night around 9pm+. Was a night that was raining so there was no outdoor seating, only indoor. Well, i thought it was kind of a mature place with clientale all mostly in the 50s age group. Slightly overpriced food and drinks - can be missed for other more hip beach side joints along the beach. Place closes at around midnight.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bronwyn BSydney, Australia
Title: lovely food
Review: diners on the beach were beautiful , we ate here 6 nights and every meal was delicious, service was greatShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: byenebergenBergen, Norway
Title: Great food and service
Review: We sat right on the beach but had to move inside due to a heavy shower. But staff moved fast, getting us inside. Offered great service, good choice of wine and great looking food (also very tasty!). Also make sure to try their drinks and cocktails! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: THa187309Munich, Germany
Title: Absolutely amazing food and drinks!
Review: It was just an amazing evening and night at LA Sal. We were there for dinner and from the beginning on we were warmly welcomed and the staff was great and caring. The food is extraordinary and worth the price even it is expensive for Malaysian circumstances. Also the drinks were great - different kinds of martini cocktails and Mojitos additional to the classics. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 731catherinecAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Fabulous Meal, fabulous location
Review: We have been staying at this amazing property for the last 8 nights, this is the second evening dining experience here and we both agree it has been the best meal and table service we have had all week. The threatening rain stayed away and we dined on the beach, just the perfect spot to spend the evening with the most gorgeous man in the world. If you book ahead you can have special candle lit settings just to yourselves, very romantic! My tuna tartare and my husbands coconut wrapped prawns were amazing starters, we both chose to followed these with the sea bass, so delicious, perfectly cooked and full of sensational flavours. We matched our meal with a very enjoyable Italian Pinot Grigio.The very friendly and attentive waiting staff were there when needed or required.We were not able to do justice to the dessert menu even though it looks amazing.We will be back to not only La Sal, but to stay at Casa del Mar, in our opinion it would be hard to do better on Langkawi.As a PS, we have lunched at La Sal almost everyday this week, there is the simple and the more exotic on offer, a menu not to be overlooked for your midday mealShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Karen HCanberra, Australian Capital Territory, Australia
Title: Food is fantastic you will not be disappointed. The menu is suited to everyone even to those who are vegetarian.
Review: The menu had a great variety & we liked that the food was cooked to our liking. Service staff were kind, friendly and also had a smileShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cristopher S
Title: Original food
Review: This restaurant belongs to the king of Malaisya.Good service but slow, they forgot our orders a few times I have to say. The food was very good and satisfying. And there main speciality is Malaysian food. The desserts were amazing.In conclusion really friendly service and will defiantly come back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Emma BUnited kingdom
Title: One of the best meals we have had.
Review: Absolutely fantastic restaurant. We came here from our hotel (meritus pelangi, where the food and service were not great), however at La Sal, a few meters from the pelangi, we were blown away by their hospitality. Beautiful setting on the beach, quiet and romantic. Impeccable service from friendly ad attentive staff. This was before the food came out which was incredible. My husband had the tandoori chicken to start and the beef rendang. Both of which were beautifully cooked. I had beef and mango salad and chicken curry, which were again fantastic. The previous reviews are very accurate. Wonderful restaurant in a truly beautiful setting. We will be coming back. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MelV212Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great food and amazing view
Review: It would be hard to try and top this dining experience back home in Sydney. We loved the food which was 5-star quality and the cocktail list is extensive. The restaurant opens at 7 pm so my only suggestion would be to arrive at 7 pm on the dot so you can enjoy the sun set and admire the action on the beach - it gets dark quite quick!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: huanyinchanMalaysia
Title: Far Below My Expectation
Review: I have my dinner at La Sal at Casa Del Mar last few weeks during my business trip with a group of friends. The restaurant is far below my expectation overall. The ambience no doubt has been created beautifully and nicely in romantic way. Food is a big letdown- nothing special to shout about. The taste is good if this is just an average ranking restaurant but not par with the high ranking as it gets now with expensive price. I will pay a visit again for a glass of good wine but not really a proper dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: anasophianorrisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Magical experience and romantic place to have dinner
Review: Absolutely amazing. This was our first visit but we will definitely be back! The food was exquisite, the atmosphere was magical and the service was supurb. A special mention and thank you to Robert and the team!From,Ana and GraemeShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sandraho27Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Thumb Up for the foods & services!
Review: I highly recommend this if you're looking for a great ambience and quality food for dinner. The location is easily located, staff were friendly. We ordered the 3 course meal menu (comes with appetizer,main course and dessert) and all the foods were so nice! if you don't know what to order, just go straight to the chef's recommendation and you will not go wrong! Must order the lamb!tender and juicy! Only drawback will be the irritating Mosquitos (you can ask for the mosquito repellant) and the foods came out quite slow. Well, after all this supposed to be a relaxing dinner. No complain! =)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NAmath14Brisbane, Australia
Title: Romantic dinner on the beach
Review: My husband and I had dinner their our first night at Cenang and really enjoyed the food and the ambiance. It is pricey though. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Thomas BCanberra, Australia
Title: Very well presented food in a beautiful location
Review: La Sal is expensive by Langkaw standards but the food is very good and the location lovely. We started with the soft shelled crab and Thai beef salad, both we nice although the beef could have been cooked a little less to retain the tenderness. Mains included the tuna which was just touched on the grill just how I like it and a red curry with pineapple which worked very well only thing I would say is that we could have done with a few more pineapple pieces. Desert of crème brulee was truly excellent as were both cocktails and the service.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SLP98
Title: gorgious
Review: location, food , service and atmosphere couldn't be beaten. A unique experience. Wines reasonably priced too!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: portiaw571Sydney, Australia
Title: The best!
Review: The restaurant was a fantastic experience. We chose to sit on the beach with our feet in the sand. We arrived at 7:30 just in time to see the sun set behind the island-So gorgeous! The thai beef salad was so delicious, as was the chocolate pudding! At the end of our meal the manager came out and enquired about our dining experience with topped off the already top notch service! Definitely a must do whilst in Langkawi- my family loved it so much we returned the next day for lunch :) Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: smjharrisonPerth, Australia
Title: Beautiful sunset meal
