Review: What a fabulous restaurant.Had a great table on the beach, very romantic. Food was great, wonderful menu with great variety. The also have a kids menu. I would suggest booking, as the place is busy. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Zackd1989Brisbane, Australia
Title: LA LUNA DINNER
Review: I recently organised the La Luna dinner at the La Sal restaurant at Casa Del Mar for my girlfriends 30th birthday. As it was a very special birthday I wanted everything to be perfect. We were very lucky with the weather as it had rained the previous few nights but was a beautiful evening for us. The setting of the La luna dinner was beautiful, right on the beach, very romantic and secluded from other guests. The 7 course meal was absolutely amazing. Every course was delicious and was paired with the perfect wine. Highest compliments to the chef. Our personal waiter (whose name, unfortunately evades me) was very helpful and personable and made a real effort with us. And all the Casa Del Mar staff were amazing. Even singing happy birthday to my girlfriend and presenting her with flowers and chocolates. (much to my surprise) If your looking for a romantic evening and don't mind spending the money on a really great meal. You can't go past Casa Del Mar. Thankyou Robert and all the Casa staff for a great eveningShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SkjkingLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant we visited on the island
Review: We had a lovely meal just as the sun was setting. Excellent food, lovely atmosphere and the staff are lovely. We did not stay at this hotel, but they were more than happy to squeeze us in with out a booking. If you like being organised, its worth booking a table here. They also serve nice wine (something of a rarity on the island).Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LynneH918Vientiane
Title: Excellent food and fabulous martini!
Review: It is expensive by island standards, but what you get for your money is very good value. The setting is lovely and their cocktails menu is the best in Pentai Cenang - the Lychee martini was absolutely delicious. I really enjoyed the meal as the food was as delicious from start to finish as the cocktail. I found the staff to be cool and professional rather than warm and welcoming which I would have preferred, but that is a minor 'nit pick' rather than a serious complaint. I would highly recommend La Sal for at least one dinner whilst on the island and definitely if you have something special to celebrate.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MRSV787Sutherland Shire, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: During our stay at Casa Del Mar we ate at La Sal on two occasions and we were NEVER disappointed. The food, location and service are excellent and if we would have stayed longer we would have certainly returned again.The Malay tasting plate, grilled prawns and the Salmon were some of our excellent choices. Not to mention dessert.The location right on the beach is very romantic and the portable lamps on the table add gentle lighting and a romantic touch, while looking across the water to the twinkling lights off the nearby islands or under the stars.With the warmer evening weather of Langkawi, the bar just steps away and the excellent service from the wonderful staff at Casa Del Mar what more could you ask for.Of the 6 nights we stayed at Casa Del Mar, La Sal was always quite full and I would say of very satisfied customers. Well done Casa Del Mar and La Sal on your number one status. we cant wait to return. Thanks to Jiha and all the CDM team for their excellent customer serviceShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Geoff ASydney, Australia
Title: The best dining experience that we had during our 2 weeks in Malaysia
Review: We were thinking of going here for dinner based on TA anyway, but after chatting with another couple who dined at La Sal the evening before who highly recommended it we made a booking for 7 PM, about half an hour before sunset.The dining tables are set up on the sand on the beach with brightness adjustable table lamps just in front of the main bar. The atmosphere at sunset is sensational. Service was excellent and both our entrees and mains were delicious and beautifully presented.Understandably, La Sal is not cheap but not unreasonably high either.A must do Langkawi dining experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LoftusroadW12Doha, Qatar
Title: Very good and very well done!
Review: We dined there one night and promptly emailed them to book another night! The setting helps and the CdM is not overcrowded and did not seem to have kids marauding out of control. Get there early and have a cocktail as the sun goes down. The use the beach as the dining area and it was done well and not cheesy and neither were you hassled for being on the beach.The food was excellent and no complaints at all in this regard. Staff we found to be very good and based on our two visits, I could not recommend the place highly enough,Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: lisababy88New England, North Dakota
Title: food delicious-Staff Arrogant-Double standard
Review: Bad service.Not feel welcome.Staff seem to feel that they are more important than the guests,slow and very unhelpful unless you are white, not worth for the money even the food is SUPER DELICIOUS.. It is very obvious that the staff in restaurant has been oriented to be extremely courteous to Caucasian guests and treat Asian guests indifferently. It almost feels like my money is not good enough for the hotel and that the other guests have paid a lot more than I have.its really horrible when your staff give super VIP service to the guest seat next to our table and seems nobody CARE bout our table.I even unfold the napkin by myself.Empty plate took about 15 min to clear.Not offer any second drinks.Staff just walked pass and busy chit chatting with each other using weird language that annoyed.My overall feeling is that i will never go back.The view is great, but we really didn't have a good night.-Remember,ITS MY 1st ANNIVERSERY.plus no table on the beach as I wish coz of weather,but this acceptable.But the service is TERIBBLE.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BeePingTSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Memorable Evening
Review: Thanks to the F&B manager, Robert, I have managed to plan a memorable evening for my brother and his wife, on Father's weekend , also my brother's birthday. Robert had personally greeted them and arranged a birthday song presentation. The food was excellent and service impeccable. I will recommend this restautant to everybody.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: philt44
Title: Delicious
Review: We ate in the restaurant whilst staying at the Casa del Mar and every meal was absolutely delicious. The staff were also particularly friendly and enthusiastic.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BlazeyPNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent!
Review: We ate here and decided to go for the 7 course dining on the beach experience for our final night in Langkawi. The weather had been a little changeable over the day but the staff still set us up on the beach with some shelter by the nearby Palm trees.Firstly the food. I have eaten at many high class restaurants including during my stay in Malaysia and this was without doubt the best food I have had for quite some time. Every dish was superbly presented and there was a very good selection of wine to complement each dish. The lamb signature dish was exquisite and I also absolutely loved the king prawns served on salsa verde. Delicious.The service was also superb, Soffian waited on us hand and foot. He was always careful to check our drinks were topped up and also not to rush between courses. Robert the food and beverage manager also came to check on us and was happy to chat which was very nice.This place is truly an experience and is worth spending that bit more if you want a romantic setting to end a holiday.The only word of warning with a serving of wine between courses my wife was a little tipsy by the end of the dinner but she absolutely loved it nonetheless.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: thetrysteroKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awful head waitress with an attitude pretty much spoiled the night.
Review: Food isn't much to shout about. All the five stars you see here on tripadvisor are probably due to the ambience at sunset, which is probably the only pro of this place. We came here and was seated at a table next to the beach by a waiter. The (head?) waitress came up to (presumably) take our orders. She was incredibly rude and caustic. Her: "You know we close at 10pm right?" Me: "OK we'll be out of there by then" Her: (Making toxic face) "OK, what do you want?" Me: "Can I have a watermelon cooler and ..." Her: (Cutting me off) "You know that this table is already booked by another customer right? He's showing up at 1030pm" Me: "Ummm... didn't you just say you close at 10pm?" Her: "Yes, we're keeping the restaurant open for them.." Me: (Unsurprisingly perplexed) "Umm ... OK ..." Long story short, if you're making such a great effort to get people to *leave* your restaurant, why sit them in the first place? If your waiter made a mistake, maybe it would've been better to take the matter up with them, instead of taking it out on your customers in with passive aggressiveness no? We were looking forward to coming here after the numerous positive reviews we read online, so it was quite a disappointment to be received in such a manner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: WheresMyShirt
Title: Magnificent Food
Review:
A few bland dishes, but the Malaysian sharing platter is well worth a try. Absolutely delicious!

Afternoon tea is also great, especially while on the beach.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mandrtravels
Title: Great food, romantic setting
Review: Perfect location, on the beach. The food is fabulous, service attentive and friendly. A must do at Langkawi.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: delishldishBendigo, Australia
Title: Food was brilliant
Review: The location is what sold us. We were strolling along the beach and this place just drew us in . Amazing setting beachside all table with crisp white linen tablecloths and napkins . And a mild evening with a slight breeze . Not to hot. Well presented menu . We opted for satay sticks for entree the chicken was nice and the salsa that was with it was fresh and flavoursome. My partner ordered beef tenderloin on top of mash with beans . I ordered chicken tika with lentils , potatoes My partner said his steak was delicious. And cooked perfectly . Mine was tasty also . The only let down was that our drinks didn't arrive until we had almost finished our mains mane two or three mouthfuls to go . After asking three time about there where abouts. This was certainly a let down . But we were not charged for them . I still would have liked to enjoy a drink with my meal . Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner under the Stars
Review: It is always a lovely experience to have dinner at La Sal, especially if the weather is good and you can dine on the beach. There are beautiful views of the sunset from here.The food is always beautifully presented although I am quite disappointed at the limited choice for vegetarian meals unless you want pasta, which luckily I did.The service is excellent and the staff very attentive, without being intrusive.Looking forward to my next return visit.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dave RLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food but poor communication and overall experience
Review: I ate here with my family on the 6th June 2014. I booked this based on previous reviews and as it was our last night in Langkawi I wanted to dine somewhere special.We we're seated by 7 pm and child menus where provided promptly. we ordered our meals opting for a 3 course option for myself and partner and settled down to enjoy the fantastic sunset.After a reasonable wait our childrens meals where brought to our table which where well cooked and of a high standard. Unfortunately this is where things started to go wrong.25-30 mins later our children had finished their meals. While we were still waiting for our starter we where approached by a member of staff who asked us if we were ready for our main course.We explained that we had not yet had our starters, the waiting staff were very apologetic and went to enquire what had happened, Another 10 minutes passed before we where told that my starter the Tandori Chicken skewers would take another 15 mins or so, At this point we had been waiting about an hour since we were seated and as you can imagine our children after finishing their meals long before this had become a bit bored and irritable. So unfortunately we had no choice but to skip the starters.Main courses were fantastic the Malaysian tasting platter was beautifully presented and so tasty.Desserts took another 30 mins or so to be brought out to us but again after us having to chase them with the waiting staff and again being told that my dessert would be another 15 mins or so 1hr 45mins after our order was taken.We were given a round of drinks and we were not charged for the desserts for the inconvenience of having to wait for so long but at that point its fair to say our evening was ruined by the lack of communication between the kitchen and waiting staffAll in all excellent location, surroundings and food. Let down by poor service.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 659anacLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner on the beach with a flare
Review: This was a lovely setting and I'm not surprised it is at number one for Langkawi. The service for what the standard generally is in malaysia and Langkawi is quite good. Nevertheless our experience was not flawless: when we order a bottle of red wine that tasted like vinegar we had to repeat about 5 times to the waiter that the bottle was not good and had to go back. They must be all too used that people will just drink any wine and proceeded to show the cap as to say 'just opened now, so it's good!'. Clearly knew very little about wines as the fact the bottle has just been opened is no guarantee that the wine is good, especially in a climate such as Malaysia's. So there this was the minus side: we almost had to apologise for it!On the plus side, the risotto was lovely and the asian dishes were ok, but aiming at 'international' taste - i.e. quite bland with little spices and little chilly, but we were not asked what we preferred! Probably a best choice to go for the international foods I'd say. They will clear the lights out of all the other tables if you stay a bit later so not for late dinners, best not come later than 20:30 if you don't want to feel pressured to leave...Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dee78
Title: Great food in a beautiful location
Review: I ate dinner at La Sal and the food was delicious. The staff here is very friendly and accommodating. The best reason to go here is the location. The view is spectacular, eating good food on the beach.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Brocklebec
Title: Dining on the beach
Review:
Terrific food in a terrific location. Eating the best watching the sunset - what could be better? 

The menu is extensive and something to suit all tastes.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: glenn b
Title: Excellent
Review: Really good food, excellent prawns and soft shell crab and the Australian Tenderloin was delicious...
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: watpar
Title: Easily the best in resort
Review: Overall we found eating out in Pantai Cenang fairly poor the one exception was this restaurant. I would recommend you eat here to remind yourself what good food looks like.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: L1755FVpaulmDun Laoghaire, Ireland
Title: Very professional
Review: After a mix up with our booking we couldn't find fault with food or service.What they did for us to make up for a problem is a lesson to all restaurateurs!My wife's birthday was celebrated in a way that I can retire in kudos for a whole year. Bear in mind the sea row of tables are usually reserved for residents. Hats off to you guys!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shruthi CCanberra, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: We stayed at CDM for 6 nights and had breakfast, lunch and dinner at La Sal for most of our stay days. We loved everything and could not fault it. Our favourite was prawn dish which they served with mango and avocado (cannot remember exact name) and whole fish served with rice, pappadum and salad. We also had tempura prawns, tandoori chicken skewers, fresh bread served with hummus, Daiquiri cocktail was amazing. For breakfast we had malay omelette, Mediterranean omelette, yoghurt with fruit, their freshly made breads, chocolate croissant, freshly cut fruits and juice.I would like to mention that if you do get a chance try La Luna degustation because this was a stand out for us. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: thomashulmeIsle of Man, United Kingdom
Title: Quality dining on the beach
Review: We stayed at the Casa Del Mar Hotel for 4 nights and so it was natural to try the hotels own evening restaurant. Many people walk up and down the main street at Pantai Cenang but it's actually along the beach that you will find the best places, and this was the best! Great food, varied menu that combines western cuisine and Malaysian influence. Beautiful setting, with candles and the sand between your toes and probably the best part of the beach with a great sunset view of the surrounding islands. So good we went twice during our 4 day stay, tried different food and both were excellent. Staff are all a credit to themselves and the hotel.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: crista16Melbourne
Title: Five stars on five star beach
Review: An absolute must if in gorgeous Langkawi - a table on the beach with amazing views, candles on the table, your feet in the sand, delicious a la carte dishes with a good bottle of Australian wine....bliss! Be sure to make a booking as it fills fast, do yourself a favour and enjoy....whilst your there please give my love to this lovely island and it's beautiful people.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HelloWorldPhiladelphia, Pennsylvania
Title: Amazing dinner and backdrop
Review: If you want awesome food and a simply amazing beach side setting for dinner, this is the place in Langkawi. Eventually I had a hard time deciding later, which I liked better: the delectable food or the gorgeous sunset and ambience. Our dinner was spectacular, the dishes cooked to perfection by expert chefs. I had the roast duck in red curry kind of dish, the husband had the sea bass and both were unforgettable. Our service was perfect, just the right amount of attentive! And the ambience and sunset backdrop was just amazing. During your stay at Langkawi, at least one evening should be reserved for an evening at La Sal.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: junp308Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Service was top notch and the view was just awesome..
Review: We didn't make any reservation at all, assuming its just a restaurant and should be no problem at all getting a table for 2. Unfortunately, it was full, and we were the 4th couple on the waiting list. However, was greeted by the Manager and he was very helpful and asked us if we can wait and have few drinks at the Pool Bar, while he tried to get a table for us as soon as possible. After about 15 mins, we were ushered to a table by the beach. The view was fantastic, and i must say the ambiance was just awesome and that really light up our feel for the night. Foods were fantastic and their service by their staffs were spot-on. Both of us left the place, feeling contented and definitely will come back again for sure.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Miss_DiebaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Not worth it.!!
Review: Felt cheated by good review. Go for dinner after reading good reviews and comment. Very bad service, waited for 30minutes for dessert even already ordered it early with main dishes. Finished main dishes but nobody come to pick our empty plate. Have to call the waiter to pick it up. Then dessert only come after 30minutes.Very bad service. Bad bad service!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Queeny_May
Title: Champagne Breakfast!
Review: Serves your own free flow of a glass(es) of champagne,A Great way to starting my relaxing day ;) Breads are homemade and love the varieties of homemade jams as well
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MrsT28London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing, especially La Luna
Review: We dined at La Sal three times, each time having a different style dinner.The first night, we had booked the La Luna dinner, where the staff set up your table away from the main restaurant and surround it with candles for an extremely romantic atmosphere. The La Luna is a set menu of 7 amazing courses with accompanying wines. I loved the little touches such as the bouquet of flowers, the menu printed with our names and the petits-four being presented in a little gift box (we had them when we got back home!). We were fortunate enough to have the most wonderful sunset that night, and it was honestly the highlight of our honeymoon.The second night, we had a DIY barbecue on the beach. You have to book 24 hours in advance, and I think Casa del Mar should promote this service more as we only noticed by chance that they offered this. You choose your food in advance from a range of steaks, chicken and fish - we had red snapper, chicken satay (gorgeous!) and the mixed grill, along with chips and vegetable kebabs. The staff set up the barbecue for you, bring out the prepared food and leave you to it. Great fun!The last night, we ate at the main La Sal restaurant. I had their signature prawn starter, which I highly recommend. All the food was lovely and the service was friendly and unassuming.Definitely the best restaurant in Cenang, if not Langkawi. Well worth at least one visit here, especially for special occasions.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: licensed2travelStavanger, Norway
Title: Amazing Food Worth the Price
Review: We came without a reservation but the kind manager got us a table even though they were fully booked out. Very nice. Even though we weren't guests at the hotel everyone was smiling at us and making sure we were comfy. After a drink, we were sat down at the beach under a coconut tree, lovely! We both ordered the 3-course menu, which allowed us to pick one started, one main, and one dessert. I started with a crispy soft shell crab, and this was average, then continued on to the main which was a risotto with king prawns and other seafood. Now, this was the star of the evening. I've had many risottos around the world, but this was perhaps one of the most delicious. Every bite was heaven on my tastebuds and I had to finish it even though I was feeling extremely full already. Dessert was panna cotta which was also lovely. Just the right texture. Partner was also very happy with his food - soup, steak and creme brulee. Only gripe was the slow service, but since it comes with a smile, and we were on holiday, it was no matter.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jacquiw610Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible service
Review: We were excited to go to La Sal for dinner after hearing and reading many positive reports. Unfortunately our experience did not meet these reviews. Some of the food was great and we highly recommend the chicken cooked in coconut husk and the lime creme brulee. These two dishes were delicious. Unfortunately the Malaysian tasting platter and soft shell crab were average. Had this review been based completely on food it would probably have been given a 4/5 but when I consider service the score drops dramatically. We had booked a table for three and were seated at a table set for two and an additional chair and place setting were only added once we asked for it. A kids menu was not offered to our eight year old despite them having one available. Drinks and service were beyond slow and we sat with empty drinks and plates for long times. Wrong drinks were brought to the table and we had to work to get the attention of waiters. To top things off as we were waiting (again a long time) to get the bill we had asked for we saw a mouse run out from the bathroom and beside a table behind us. This just topped off an otherwise disappointing dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Had service not been so slow rating would have been 5!
Review: This place was ranked very high on Tripadvisor and located on the beachfront in a lovely resort down the far end of Pentai Cenang so we decided to give this place a try for lunch. The menu emailled to me was very appealing and had mixed Western and Asian choices.We shared Entrees of Tempura Prawn with Wasabi Mayo & Snapper Fillet with Ginger Miso Dressing.Our mains consisted of Crispy Soft Shell Crab with Cos Lettuce Tomato Mango & Grapefruit Salad on Homemade Blue Poppy Bread & Char Kway Teow.The food was excellent with prices acceptable for this quality venue. There are cheaper options available though. The ambiance is fabulous at this higher end resort. Views are fantastic overlooking the pool and beach with a native beach bar where we started with some pre-lunch drinks. Tables are also set up on the beach so I assume that lunch can be set up there for you if so desired. We chose the restaurant to dine.There were only two other tables occupied so they were not busy for lunch service. What was totally unacceptable was that it took over 2 hrs to get our entrees and mains. This was pointed out to staff who insisted on serving us a complementary round of drinks as compensation.If service not been so slow rating would have been 5 out of 5.Must visit dining venue if service is improved.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LIVETOTRAVEL8Burpengary, Australia
Title: Awesome feet in the sand tables.
Review: Setting romantic. Arrive for drinks before sunset. Sunset awesome. Staff friendly. Can get busy and booked out. Can be a wait for food. Good wine list. Food hit and miss. Need consistency in dining. We had duck was perfect. The next time had duck in edible. Lamb twice served raw. Food can be too hot spicy. Yet soup delicious. Chocolate pudding delicious. Crab entree. Needs some work for food to match prices. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: WaWa1963Brisbane, Australia
Title: Best on the Island
Review: We have eaten at La Sal over a 3 year period on at least 15 occasions , including both lunch and dinner. The lunches are great - perfect for lazing around the pool or beach. However the star of the show are the dinners. The menu is extensive and caters for both local and western tastes. We have sampled a wide array of dishes and they are always bursting with flavour. Favourites for dinner are soft shell crab , kataifi prawns , duck breast , steak ,beef rendang and seafood risotto . The lime Cree brûlée is a standout. For lunches the burger , fish and chips , pizza , tempura prawns or calamari are great choices which never fail to satisfy.The setting , particularly at night is fantastic with the setting sun making for a very romantic dining venue. Service is attentive , particularly from Halim , the head waiter. This restaurant deserves the acclaim heaped upon it by other reviewers.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jane PHertford, United Kingdom
Title: Probably the best meal we had in Langkawi!
Review: Taking everything into account this was probably the best meal we had in Langkawi. The service was very good and the setting was just perfect. I just love sunsets and to be able to sit directly on the beach and watch the sun go down whilst eating delicious food was heavenly! The food was excellent and we had our children with us, so having a kids menu with western food kept them happy. Every table was taken the evening we were there, so there was a lovely ambience too. Will definitely make it my first port of call if we return to Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HKchicKilbirnie, New Zealand
Title: Very delicious food!
Review: We ate here three times during our stay at Casa Del Mar - 2 x dinners and 1 x lunch. All meals were very good! Prawn starter is amazing! We also enjoyed the lamb and steak! Not the cheapest place to eat in Langkawi, but you do get good quality food in a lovely locationShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CharlotteBada
Title: Delicious food
Review: We ate twice - once on the beach and once by the bar.  Food is delicious and very reasonably priced.  Service is great - make sure you book to get a table on the beach
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nella_85Toolamba, Australia
Title: Great beach-side restaurant
Review: The La Sal offers a mix of modern fusion and Malaysian dishes, with an emphasis on seafood. We (two couples) dined there twice during our recent visit to Langkawi. The deep fried prawns wrapped in crispy vermicelli noodles and served with mango and avocado were delicious as an entree, as was the tuna tartare and soft shell crab. For mains we tried the Malaysian tasting platter which was easily enough for two. It contained a serve of rice, four portions of curry (including two seafood options), two small salads, sambal, pickle and papadums. The curries were delicious and very diverse in flavour and style. The beef and chicken were mild, whereas the fish was very spicy. We couldn't fit in sweets, but there were western and Asian options (soft-centred chic pudding, sticky rice with coconut & mango - yum!) Tables right on the beach. My only criticism is that service was a little sluggish/inattentive at times. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mistys_adventureWorcestershire, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food...
Review: Visited for a late dinner on the beach at this lovely restaurant. The staff were very friendly and acommodating, even though we didn't have a booking. The barstaff were characters too! We ordered and food arrived quickly - I had the rendang and can honestly say it was one of the best meals I have ever had. Beef was gorgeous and tender. Pudding lovely too (walnut cheesecake). So glad we went and now have lovely memories of great food on the beach with the sand between our toes.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Pwaller
Title: Dinner as the sun set
Review: This restaurant was on the beach although if the weather is bad it is in a different location. The food was great and the service good. We were on our 20th wedding anniversary and it would have been hard to have found a nicer spot.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pateliusVantaa, Finland
Title: A perfect way to end a perfect day
Review: During our recent stay at hotel Casa Del Mar I and my wife had two dinners at La Sal included in our Getaway Package. In addition we had once room service dinner from the same menu. La Sal restaurant seemed to be in harmony with the hotel in terms of ambience and service. We were gladly surprised by the informal atmosphere which doesn’t mean that the level of service or food was somehow mediocre, on the contrary. I would like to mention some of our favorite portions: Pumpkin and Sweet Potato Soup (starter), Baked Marinated Premium Australian Rack of Lamb with Sweet Potato & Feta Cheese Bergedil (main) and Australian Beef Fillet with Chive Mash (main). It is nice to start your dinner at dusk, enjoy the sunset and linger in the darkness.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tbent2013Wenvoe, United Kingdom
Title: A great end to a lovely day
Review: You know that tripadvisor is full of too many haters, after reading some of the recent unpleasant reviews of this lovely place, I cannot believe they were genuine, we had cocktails to start, sat on the beach at our dining table , watched the sun go down and ate a lovely three course meal with wine, followed by Cuban cigars ( a very rare pleasure for me) and this capped off a lovely very memorable day.The price was good for the great meal we ate and I could not fault it, yes it was not the greatest food we had ate, but certainly one of the best positions. Haters get lost from tripadvisor.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SheffieldKatsheffield
Title: Dinner on the Beach
Review: Stayed at the Casa and had lunch and dinner here which I can highly recommend. Lunch time very generous portions, recommend the burger and potato wedges. Evening more upmarket for dinner on the beach. Price wise not too expensive for quality dining, worth a trip if you fancy dinner on the beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Keith R
Title: Very impressive menu and presentation
Review: We stayed at the hotel and ate in every night. A varied and reasonably priced menu with quality presentation. The food has style and is very well prepared
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: urgatron593Worcester, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent sea bass
Review: This restaurant is in the hotel casa del mar. We mistakenly walked past it at first on the beach since there is no 'la sal' sign.The service was very good, a cut above the usual staff in other places. We both had whole sea bass and it was really good. It's a bit more money than elsewhere but compared to the uk it's still really cheap and you get some amazing food right on the beach.Great for a splurge Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: cooky65England
Title: Disappointed
Review: After reading reviews was looking forward to the experience but was left very disappointed. On presentation our expectations where raised as large bold plates where presented although the food was at best bland with rendang curry made with what was described as tender Australian beef far from tender and very dry and sea bass nothing special.The chocolate desert was fine although not a large enough portion and the apple crumble was a tart which should of been served with a knife as to stop pastry being fired across the sand when attempting to cut through with spoon and fork.All in all a very disappointing experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ronimoon
Title: Not to be missed
Review: What a beautiful restaurant on the beach. Great food, good service can't go wrong. The place is so picturesque and the meals are wonderful. Try the tasting plates and the Chili muddled drink
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Adventureoverseas
Title: Beautiful!
Review: Beautiful setting, what an oasis! Not cheap but definitely top quality. It was great espresso coffee which is difficult to find in cenang. I would return again but next time without our  restless children
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nazri_Hendra
Title: Romantic dinner by the beach.
Review: The restaurant ambience is very relaxing, staff is super friendly, food was amazing. Went there for our 2nd Anniversary and was surprised with a cake from the restaurant. Thanks to Robert and his team for making our dinner a wonderful experience.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ILYA_MEDMoscow, Russia
Title: A Perfect Evening
Review: I could easily describe dinner at La Sal as one of our best evenings in Langkawi. If you are looking for a place to go to for a special occasion dinner with one of the best sunset views on the island then this is definately the right place. The food was simply delicious. The staff is very attentive and professional and even though there was a little misunderstanding with the resevation they did everything in order for us to forget that minor aspect and enjoy our perfect evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SiobhanTim
Title: Dinner by the pool
Review: Had dinner by the pool bar while there in August 2013. We were staying on Rebak island so we were on the mainland for a few hours. Food was ok but expected better from reviews. Service was slow but in fairness while we were there hotel guests gathered by the bar for their welcome drinks. They were being well looked after and the drinks were being topped up every few minutes.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LucyP443Shrewsbury, England, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful valentines meal!
Review: My partner and I pre-booked the admittedly very expensive (for Langkawi) valentines meal on the beach. The setting was simply beautiful with about 10 tables set in a heart shape around a heart sand sculpture lit with candles on the beach. We arrived in time for pre-dinner drinks to watch the sunset which was wonderful.The staff could not have been kinder or more attentive and the additional little touches of flowers and chocolates were very gratefully received.The food was generally very good... Particularly the beef and portion sizes just right so we could manage the six courses fine. As others have said the hotel is super and whilst we were not staying there as it was full at the time of booking we could certainly see the draw. A memorable meal in a beautiful location, thank you. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: David BDublin, Ireland
Title: Disappointing overall.
Review: The location is unequalled - right on the beach, a great place to have pre-dinner drinks and watch the sunset in a truly beautiful location. The staff are lovely - very friendly and efficient - but thefood - - - - the starters and mains were just too fussy, unattractive and over-cheffed and fiddly that it made the whole menu difficult to select from.All the tables were full, all the diners were of european ethnicity, and many of them were eating Australian steak. If this is the sort of thing you've travelled all the way to Langkawi for, then this is for you. Although we have eaten here several times over the past few years, we will not be coming back again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Linandmik
Title: Perfect
Review: Me and my partner spent a magical valentines evening at the restaurant and it was definitely worth it!! The view was amazing and food was very flavoursome too! We were seated promptly with the sun slowly setting in front, was just incredible. My partner had soft shell crab for entrée and cod fish for main, while I had tandoori chicken for entree and fresh whole sea bass for main. My chicken my slightly a bit dry, but still tasty and everything else was very tasty too especially the sea bass, so fresh that it was just so soft! The serving was huge though and I could not finish it .... Our deserts took quite awhile though and I had to ask the waiters 3 times before it was served. I was getting a bit annoyed and would've been fine if any of the waiters I spoke to had told me how much longer. However, the last waiter did and desert did come soon after and they also gave us complimentary drinks which was very nice. Once we got the bill we were suprised that they didn't charge desert as well, very unexpected and it definitely left a good impression on us both!!Overall I loved the experience and was glad we came here for dinner. We are currently staying at the Danna and love it , but after experiencing such good service from the restaurant I will definitely want to try out the hotel next time I'm in langkawi!! Thanks to all the lovely staff who were nothing but friendly and always providing service with a genuine smile :) Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Scrad01Perth, Australia
Title: eating awesome food on the sand
Review: Was a great night. Myself and girlfriend weren't staying here and rocked up with out a booking but were lucky to be accomodated for after a short 15 minute wait by the bar drinking a cocktail.The food was incredible and the scenery was better. It was a bit tough to signal the waiters attention all night, but that didn't blemish how good the night was.Even though it was the most expensive place we ate at on Langkawi, compared to Australian prices it was a very, very cheap 3 course dinner for a very classy set up.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rjuesd
Title: Candle dinner with sea view and sunset + halal food
Review: fabulous dinner experience with affordable price. Sweet moment and excellent service + view + environment
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Seth BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Over-rated
Review: The location on the beach is excellent, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The food, though, is something of disappointment. It's reputation, and the price, suggested that we would have our best meal on the island there but the food did not compare with other restaurants in terms of quality of flavour. My tuna tartare was very tasty indeed but the other dishes felt 'safe' and didn't have strong flavours. If you want a beautiful location for dinner then this is the place to go but there are better places to eat on the island.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: This magic spot is worth the journey
Review: Being on the front row @ La Sal @ Casa del Mar, with the restaurant table on the beach and the Langkawi sunset as backdrop is sheer indulgence. So we won't look at the price list but order a bottle of wine all the same. We are spoiled for choice with the dishes, presented on the menu, but my first choice is the oriental beef salad for starter and seared tuna for main course. Yes, La Sal is relatively expensive, but the good things in life come not cheap sometimes. We have had the good luck to be at the front row a couple of times during our stay and we look forward to our next stay in Casa del Mar, in order to be first in line. TripAdvisor reviewers are correct again. La Sal is in a head to head race with Privilege Restaurant for being the best restaurant in Langkawi. I noticed in other reviews some criticism about the service of the staff. I think a mistaken interpretation of the service is the cause of that. I find that the staff is polite and friendly in the correct Malaysian way. And, as Casa del Mar offers places for students in the hospitality sector, we should make allowances for slight mistakes made by the students.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GoggsylLondon, United Kingdom
Title: One of a kind setting on the beach
Review: We were recommended La Sal at Cafe del Mar by our hotel & we weren't disappointed. A beautiful setting once you come off the main road in a Spanish style hacienda setting - the restaurant has tables on the beach with lanterns & you couldn't get a nicer more romantic location. Fantastic food too which makes it a must do in Langkawi. We will be back! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: L-SihuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed visit
Review: Read all th reviews and marked as a must try on our list!Manage to reserve a table on our fourth night at langkawi..Food was great, had beef tenderlion and meat of th day for boyf. We had th prawns for entree, cheesecake and apple pie for desserts.The downside was th service, as i do expect more for th service. The restaurant seems short-handed and im not sure is it because we were asians, we felt kinda left-out and not really welcomed at first. Staff were not attentive. However, kudos to th manager which went from table to table and chatted with guests.Overall, it was a great experience but i might not go back again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TaylorKlasMelbourne, Australia
Title: Idyllic Peaceful dinner
Review: On the main road but you would never know as it feels like you’re on your own special beach. Beautiful restaurant, excellent service. we are vegetarian, and there were plenty of options mainly for entrees, Had the fresh tomato and red pepper soup which was delicious, the avocado and mango salad had too much creamy salty mayo dressing for our tastes, but otherwise good. The main was braised vegetables, with condiments and was also very good, huge portion and well presented.This restaurant is well worth it!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kazza13
Title: Great food amazing setting
Review: Absolutely a perfect setting for dinner on the sand. Service and food excellent. This restaurant is part of the Casa Del Mar resort which is absolutely beautiful and I would recommend a drink at there bar before dinner. Mai Tais were yummy
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Asterix1969Venice, Italy
Title: A must in Langkawi
Review: I don't know if this is the bestrestaurant in Langkawi. I can only saythat it isthe best asian restaurant i met during my trips in Asia.not only goodand fresh food, but a real gourmet experience. This is imho the gap between one of the many good places to have a dinner and the real excellence.La Sal is in the excellence category. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cat AQueensland
Title: Amazing Location, Great Menu But...
Review: we were both ill after a meal at the restaurant. I was up all night - not want you want on a romantic holiday! To be fair, I did order duck, which was not the best choice in a hot climate. However, my husband was also unwell and he had fish. It's not what I'd expect from a five-star restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Hazel AAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic menu
Review: We were staying at the hotel (which was fabulous) and ate in the restaurant 3 times, each time choosing a different dish. The malay curry platter which gives you 4 different curries along with chutney, salad, rice and popodom was excellent. Easily big enough to share although I did manage to eat it all by myself. My all time favourite was the peppercorn tuna steak, the best tuna I have ever had. A 3 course meal and bottle of good quality wine costs around half the price we would pay back home in the UK. The setting is wonderful and service extremely friendly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: enwest
Title: Delightful beachside location, excellent variety of food well served.
Review: The location is first-rate, with excellent sea and sunset views across the sandy beach. Food selection is varied and uniformly well presented.A good wine list. Service is attentive and efficient.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kttan1970
Title: Nice setting but average food
Review:
Dinner here with family.

The setting is beautiful and lovely.
Service is good
Unfortunately the food is not great for the price you pay. >$100US for 2 adults with no wine
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HONkievOdessa, Ukraine
Review: Why 3 points? Let me first point out that Langkawi is as far from food heaven as is Bangladesh from paradise.We've stayed at hotel 'Casa del Mar' and normally we try to avoid the restaurants in our hotel. But since we weren't able to get decent food nearby we stepped into 'La Sal' to get something to eat. And what a surprise, we've been surprised, positively:- the location is beautiful, right facing the sea with the feet in the sand- unlike most beach front restaurants the food was very good, international- as well as Malay fare- prices for the quality served are okay, neither cheap nor expensiveafter dinner you've got the possibility to visit a very relaxed beach bar (go on the beach, turn left and walk 200 m. You'll see small tables, candles. This bar is far more romantic an relaxed than the bar at La Sal/Casa del Mar. You're laying on the beach, watching the stars, listening to very good music and have a nice cocktail at 15 Ringit).So, due to the good experience we gave 'La Sal' another try the next day. We arrived 21:25 (had a reservation) and placed our order. People around us were served, eating... and we were waiting. More and more people finished dinner, paid and left... and we were waiting. Waiters watched our table until approx. 22:20 we were the last guests. The waiters started to clean all tables to prepare for shut-down. Suddenly 22:30 the starter we ordered (a salad!!!) arrived without explanation. When I asked 'why?' the only explanation was 'Sorry, Sir', with a huge smile.We denied and food and left the restaurant, very disappointed. At the reception we asked for the manager who immediately came, even it was his day off. He also was quite shocked, excused for the situation. We left the hotel and went to a small Indian restaurant just across the street (Restauran Almaz, very basic but good Indian food). The manager came over again, excused, took care of our meal. When we returned to our room we found a bottle of champagne and a huge plate of dessert as an excuse for the situation.Therefore La Sal get's 5 points for the first visit, 1 point for the seconds - which makes an average of 3 points.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Martin PKyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Meeting high expectations
Review: The beach might be busy some times but the sands are awesome and the sunset great! The hotel is probably the best managed one and the food, most likely the finest on the island. Would we go back to Langkawi, this would be the place. No doubt whatsoever.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: reviewsf0ry0uPerth, Australia
Title: Great Malaysian food
Review: We really enjoyed our dinner here. The food was excellent. They had gluten free bread which was nice too. We had entree's and mains. For Mains we both got the Malaysian taste plate. It was delicious! We unfortunately couldn't fit in any dessert : ( We also enjoyed meeting the hotel cat!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: leaht2014Sydney, Australia
Title: best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: We walked along Cenang Beach on our first night and stumbled across La Sal. We didn't know what it was, but thought it looked incredible, so we decided to stay and have the 3 course menu. We were given a table right on the beach, and had the most amazing meal - the best in Langkawi. The staff were extremely warm and friendly, and very attentive. The food and the whole experience is well worth the price tag. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mercier11
Title: Excellent food
Review:
Try the Australian beef, tuna tartar and the shrimps, it is wonderful.
But I missed the chicken satay. Why isn't on the menu anymore ?
Saskia
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TedBielanskiKrakow, Poland
Title: Must visit restaurant with amazing food
Review: Absolutely great location (dinner at the beach) with delicious food! Menu has good choice from European and Asian cousins, sea food absolutely class, service a bit slower than usual but must forgive as distances from beach to kitchen is not a short as in standard restaurants. Staff absolutely friendly, drinks very good from bar as well. Great experience at very reasonable prices!!! Remember to book 1-2 days in advance to avoid disappointment! STRONGLY RECOMMEND, BEST PLACE IN THIS PART OF ISLANDShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HelenavdVegtThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Bad service, overpriced and mosquito invested
Review: We waited 50 minutes for our 2 overpriced drinks all the while getting merrily eaten by mosquitos. If you want something fancy irrespective of good quality then this is for you. If you want good quality and don't mind a less posh setting, try Raffii's a few 100m down the beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bel1aSydney, Australia
Title: Very Romantic atmosphere with good food but slow service
Review: Lovely dinner at La Sal, Food was delicious, staff friendly but service was slow. We decided to dine here after reading the recommendations on TripAdvisor. Upon arrival we were pleasantly surprised as we had not expected that we would be dining on the beach itself. It was very romantic. The menu had a wide range of selection western, local & seafood. We ordered some cocktails pre dinner. Sadly it took a while for our order to be taken or even to be served a glass of water. It then took ages for the cocktail to get to us, infact out starter arrived well before the cocktail. We were given 2 small pieces of bread in our bread basket. The bread was very fresh& delicious but it was the thinnest slices of bread I've ever seen (no offer to refill bread basket) The food is good. However service was a let down. It took ages to ask for the bill and to pay the bill. When we finally received the bill it was calculated incorrectly. It took the staff ages to fix the bill, at one point it looked like they were not sure of how or what to do. Given the price and type of restaurant we were really expecting far better service. The table infront of us had the same complaint too. We had initially booked for another dinner here but decided to cancel after the 1st time.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: janedoe81London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food, relaxing location
Review: We had dinner at La Sal a couple of nights ago. We chose it after reading the good ratings, and we were not disappointed. The staff was very helpful, although we did not have a reservation (and the restaurant was quite busy), they managed to sit us down within a few minutes. The waiter was really friendly and the service excellent. We had prawn tempura for starter, really well presented and tasty. Both of us had the Malaysian tasting platter for mains - every taster dish was perfectly portioned and full of flavours.The atmosphere is very relaxed, perfect for a romantic dinner by the sea.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AmrendraRus
Title: A nice relaxed lunch
Review: This restaurant was just next to our Meritus Pelangi resort. We had a relaxed sumptuous  lunch with very good cocktails. We chose to drink rum based cocktails and all of us were totally satisfied with what we got. Highly recommended.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Tanmay K
Title: An Oasis
Review: Amazing location on the Cenang beach, well trained staff, beautiful property with all details mapped out, very good mix on the menu, right size restaurant and personable staff, delectable taste, totally worth the place, clearly one of the highlights of our visit to the island
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LauraDeLaCruz
Title: Nice tasty food
Review: We stayed at the hotel and ate at the restaurant at the hotel nearly every night, something we don't usually do, as we like to try different places, but found the food nice and the setting, right next to the beach, really good.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: A Wonderful Experience
Review: Cocktails, food and the whole experience was delightful. In fact it was so good we returned 5 nights later for our last evening in Langkawi. Yes it is more expensive that many of the other restaurants on the island but the whole experience is worth very ringgit! Try it you will not be disappointedShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NickalbondigaIrene
Title: Not what we expected.
Review: We arrived with high hopes and although the mis en scene was perfect (tranquil paradise beach surrounded by palm trees and illuminated by moonlight), ultimately the food was very average.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DylanSoh
Title: nice food
Review: the food was nice the cocktail was very good. had a nice sunset dinner along the beach .Sat there for almost 3 hour to enjoy the drink , the food , the beach and the sunset.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Claireben12Port Hedland, Australia
Title: Amazing!!!
Review: We went there because of these reviews and we weren't disappointed. We would recommend booking if you aren't staying at the hotel. The cocktails were brilliant, service was great and food just lovely. The tasting plates were large so if your having a stater and dessert you could easily share one. We didn't and couldn't eat all our beautiful food. The venue is beautiful right on the beach. It's recomended very highly by my partner and I. Enjoy!! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NouranYaAbuja, Nigeria
Title: perfect taste
Review: I was staying in Casa del Mar, and every morning I was enjoying a very nice breakfast in La SalI tried around 6 plates from their breakfast menu, and each one was better than the otherI had a chance to try the dinner one night, and as expected, it was with the same quality like the breakfast, specially the shrimp started (the one in the attraction picture) unbelievable taste and textureI loved the restaurant, and dinner their is so romantic, and they have an extra romantic atmosphere if required ;DShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Prema RBengaluru, India
Title: Awesome food with awesome view..
Review: We had an amazing lunch at La Sal. The fish was very fresh and cooked to perfection. Special thanks to one of the hotel staff who came running and handed over my hat which I had forgotten at the table. Just in time before we stepped into taxi. Could not get the staff's name, but thanks a lot. Will definitely come back again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Morgo87
Title: Excellent food, service & location
Review: Great dinner on the sand! Well worth going to. Service is friendly and food is great. Excellent cocktails also
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: UlishoesMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fantastic food
Review: I was staying at the resort so over the course of several days ate here for breakfast, lunch and dinner at different times. The food was universally great. And nothing on the mixed cuisine menu feels tacked on. The wine list is a bit overpriced given it's a duty-free Island, but otherwise highly recommended. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: GTGTGTGTLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice location good food
Review: Ate here several times on a recent trip. Had good food every night - expensive but ok overall. Wine list seems pretty overpriced to us coming from London and considering the island is duty free prices are the same if not more than in KL.Best to reserve a the staff are not good with dealing with walk ins even when they have tables free. One day we reserved in reception (about 10 meters away) and they did not give our request to the restaurant. This caused a huge consternation with the staff even though they had free tables - they don't seem to be trained to manage anything out of the ordinary.Very quick to clear the tables - they do that annoying US thing of clearing pleats as they are emptied rather than waiting till everyone is finished. Also very quick to over pour the wine and water which then gets warm in the glass. Enjoyed the Malaysian menu more than the a la carte - they re very free with the squirty decorative sauce bottles which don't really add anything to the taste. On the beach in the dark it is hard to see what you are eating in any case..Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: trala
Title: Absolute must for your Langkawi holiday!
Review:
Nothing beats a fantastic meal, on the beach, at sunset!

Absolutely wonderful, the service was great and the food was delicious! 

We had the soft shell crab entree and the grilled sea bass. Very flavoursome, and the entire experience was the highlight of our trip.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: THE_LAMINGSSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: A must try!
Review: Four of us dined at La Sal. We decided to try it after seeing the positive reviews on trip adviser, so expectations were high, and we weren't disappointed! The restaurant is on the beach of a small hotel. From the moment we arrived the staff were friendly and attentive. We hadn't booked but within minutes a table had been arranged for us, right on the beach, a really great spot.Once seated we were given ice cold mint scented towels which was a really good touch as it was an extremely warm evening. The food was lovely, to start three of us had the soft shell crab, and they said it was the best they had eaten on this trip (they have had it a lot as it's a favourite). And I had the prawns with avocado and mango which was really yummy. For main course we all opted for a Malay dish, as we are in Malaysia, and it feels wrong to eat something you can have at home. Two of us has the beef rendang, which was the best I have ever has, one had the chicken kapitan which was served in a coconut and was really tasty, the other dish ordered was the Malay tasting platter which had an assortment of dishes which also great. The portions were huge and we were all thoroughly stuffed, leaving no room for pudding which was a real shame as I had my eye on a chocolate and caramel tart with mascarpone! Well never mind it gives us an excuse to go back!The menu has something for everyone, a good mix of Western and Malay food. You can also have you own private BBQ if you request it!Drinks were really good, a good selection of inventive cocktails, I would recommend the coconut mojito - really yummy! The boys in the group were happy as they could have draft beer.Overall I would thoroughly recommend this restaurant, we have eaten in some really good places on the strip, and it isn't the cheapest by far (ave main 50-60 rm) but it certainly deserves its number one spot on trip adviser, a really great location with equally great food! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Fernando FLisbon, Portugal
Title: Excellent food and amazing view
Review: We went to La Sal @ Casa Del Mar twice for dinner, and in both nights we had some fantastic moments. La Sal its not only about food, its about having a tremendous experience. In the first night we booked with one day in advance, so we had a table in the first line of the beach. The staff were great, extremely nice with us, always willing to take us some pictures to remember. The food was delicious, the drinks were also very nice . The sun sets goes in front of you, so i recommend to book earlier in order to see all the magic ambient that surrounds the restaurant. If you are looking for a moment to remember, so you are in the right place. Me and my girlfriend had one of the best dinners in our live here, so i strongly recommend this restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: orangegenieUnited Kingdom
Title: Exceptional food
Review: The last time we ate here was 2 years ago and we were worried it may have changed but we booked for my birthday dinner last weekend and both agreed it is still exceptionally good and definitely worth the taxi ride from the Berjaya.We started with mojitos - I had the 5 spice with apple which is out of this world and my boyfriend tried the thai spiced which was nice but not quite to our taste. We took the 3 course set and to start I had tuna tartare followed by lamb rack and he ordered the prawns and then beef tenderloin. All the dishes were beautifully presented and tasted delicious. We were already quite full after the main dishes but shared the cheese platter for dessert which had a good selection of cheese with biscuits, grapes & pear paste. We realised afterwards they forgot to offer us our tea/coffee which was part of the set but overall service was very good.There were many other dishes on the menu that I would like to try and they also offer some special set dinners for couples including a seafood platter and DIY BBQ. Just one request to Casa del mar - can you put your menus on the website - you emailed them promptly when requested but I'd love to be able to check back and see for myself what new menus you offer in the future as I will definitely be back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sophiebw25Twickenham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: We came back here after going twice on our last trip to Langkawi and a year on we could still see why. The setting is beautiful - on the beach looking out over the sea. The wine is reasonably priced and the food is all delicious! We had the tuna tartar to start, then the lamb rack and the beef rendang. It was all delicious and really good quality. Unfortunately we didn't have time for a desert as we had to get to the airport but I'm pretty sure when I last went there they were delicious.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rob L
Title: Great meal
Review: Great meal, beautiful setting but I could do without people smoking around me.  Yes it is outdoors but it put a damper on the great meal.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: aaong86Singapore, Singapore
Title: Magnificent place, excellent service, friendly staff!
Review: My girlfriend and I were here for a candle light (electronic candles though) dinner on the beach while watching sunset. we reached early to make sure we managed to catch the sunset. the food was ok, the service was excellent and the staff was very friendly. the ambiance was great, very romantic. highly recommended for couples. make sure you make a reservation in advanced cus I believe all tables were reserved and tables are limited (only 12 tables if I am not wrong).however, there are 2 things i dislike abt this place. firstly, mosquitoes! even though the staff placed mosquitoes coils under all tables (i was telling my girlfriend I don't think there will be mosquitoes on the beach but I was wrong!), I was badly bitten throughout the entire dinner. secondly, it was too dark to see what we were eating. a little more light would be great.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gary DBusselton, Australia
Title: Quality food, surrounds and service
Review: As guests, we ate here regularly....or 8 times according to the bill...plus breakfast daily Wonderful attentive service with a smile. Be it by the pool, on the verandah, or a beach table running you feet in the sand...during the day and by sunset. Couldn't fault the food, wide variety of cuisines, good cocktails list, varying beers and wines. One of the top 2 we have eaten at on Langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 56Wendy
Title: Delicious
Review: After three weeks of noodles and some mediocre food the choice here was excellent, well cooked and presented, excellent value for money and a lovely end to our holiday
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SBokAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Absolutely Fantastic
Review: We stayed at the hotel for a week and thoroughly enjoyed every meal we had here. The chef is brilliant and the restaurant surroundings are lovely sort of relaxed fine dining. The restaurant was full most nights so it is advisable that you book, we saw 3 taxis full of tourists being turned away as they had no booking. The braised prawns and the beef rendang are great. I also had some of the nicest lamb I've ever had. The prawn starter with the Wasabi mayonnaise is also recommended. Oh, and I better not forgot the malaysian tasting platter we had. Huge platter and we couldn't finish 3 courses when we had the platterWe are actually a bit annoyed that we ventured away from the hotel a couple of times.Just go! The food is brilliant, you won't be disappointed.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rosy14Australia
Title: Loved the meals here
Review: We just loved the food in this resturant, It was consistantly good. The duck was amazing, the fish curry was very tasty, beef randang yum and the Malay tasting plate was great as it gave you a taste of various dishes. Sitting out on the beach by candlelight is my way of dining. One evening when everything was set for dinner the clouds looked threatening. While guests were enjoying free drinks at the bar (something the manger does each week to get guest together and to introduce the staff) the staff had quietly rearranged the venue to the inside area within moments. The staff were attentive and friendly. GREAT GREAT GREAT! Thank youShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NatsfunSydney, Australia
Title: Great (western) food, great location
Review: We ate here 3 times for dinner & twice for lunch during our 2 week visit in Langkawi. We purposely avoided it in the first week because we wanted to eat authentic Malaysian street food but had pre-planned the degustation (7 course) dinner for early in the 2nd week. The weather wasn't great for an open air beachfront dinner so it was served in the private pavilion on the beach. We were celebrating a special occasion & the staff were both attentive & discrete. The food was rave worthy, but the matching wine fell short. The meat fell off the bone and the flavours were delicate with Asian influence but cooked in a modern western style. The food was as delicious as any 5 star in Sydney or Melbourne. It was this opulent meal that prompted us to try a la carte later in our stay and we weren't disappointed. We tried too many dishes to list, but my go-to starter was the tempura styled soft crab-shell. Delicious! I have to mention the cocktails which were inexpensive and delicious- fresh fruit and made with a smile.To try to put the dining experience into context, I would say it is close to fine dining, without any pretence in a casual beachfront setting. It is expensive compared to street stall or local cafés -- but that's not a fair comparison and we never tried another modern restaurant in Langkawi to compare with - price wise it was cheaper than the seafood restaurants we tried in Langkawi. If you want traditional Malaysian food, you are I the wrong place! P.s. Make a booking to guarantee a seat and if the weather is good pre-book a seat on the beach. We saw some very disappointed people turned away as seats are kept under cover for those seated on the beach in case the weather turns while they are dining.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cypher BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best location on the beach but average food
Review: You can't argue with most reviews that rave about the location. This place is situated on the nicest part of Pantai Cenang. However the food is massively over-priced and fairly average. We paid more for some dishes than we do in top London restaurants. We stopped for lunch and also for dessert. The food took absolutely ages to arrive even though the place was fairly quiet for lunch. The burger ordered was very disappointing: the beef had been over-cooked and the chips arrived cold. The sandwich ordered was also bland: it arrived without one of the ingredients requested which was not mentioned to us when the food was set down. When I noticed the error I was simply told: "oh, we haven't had our delivery of that yet." There are better places for lunch and dinner for a fraction of the price.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: maca222Singapore, Singapore
Title: The highlight of my trip to Langkawi
Review: We made a bad choice of hotel where food was not good at all. We decided to take a taxi and try somewhere as far as possible...and we reached this fantastic place. Small, quiet, delicious. I can imagine how gorgeous it must be during sunset. I had an amazing virgin mojito with apple juice, a mang-avocado salad and a pizza with zucchini and salami. Everything was amazing. The ice creams are a delight and the coffee is well done.Waiter with a smile and very nice. Atmosphere was great. One thing that caught my attention was that guests were only western...maybe its the kind of place..Prices are not cheap but totally worth it. Thank you, you changed my trip!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RantsfromragzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner@Casa
Review: We went to casa for dinner on Sunday night.Despite the slight drizzle, our request for an outdoor table was met. We ordered a three course meal starting with a prawn appetizer which was absolutely amazing.Followed it up with chicken and lamb main courses where lamb took the obvious win. The staff was very friendly, ambience very classy and a convenient parking slot available.Total bill was a little over $100 (SG) which we feel was worth every cent.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Thierry2Pepieux, France
Title: Too westernized ...
Review: This is what happens when you try too hard to adapt a traditional cuisine to western palate ... you may cook something nice and rather tasty, but you loose the whole soul of it. This is the cuisine you may find in an Asian restaurant in any capital of the world. Of course, the beautiful location, facing the sea, is quite unique in this town where most restaurant are open on the street side and turn the back to the Andaman sea. Of course the service and welcome is warm and friendly. So here is a message for those readers who enjoy the real Asian cuisine: this place is not the place for it, and above all, this is way too expensive for what it is. I may be in disagreement with the majority of Tripadvisor reviews, made mostly by western people who are hesitant to go too far from their comfort zone in matter of cooking: this place may be a good place, but certainly not the best asian food of the neighborhood. Oh, I forgot. My zife is Asian and definitely agrees with that !Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 445arih
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Menu is built whit good taste and the food was also Very good. Personal is Very helpfull and friendly
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hannajomeansMalaysia
Title: Excellent food, view, and service
Review: The only thing you should consider is making a reservation if you want the best seats, which are the ones on the beach (particularly at sunset). The food is great, the service was great, and although more pricey than most other places on the island, it's comparable to what you would pay elsewhere. Well worth the time!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: flaneur-w
Title: very good restaurant
Review: The service is good and the food is very good. I wish the satays are available on site. The location is excellent.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: OzzieMuseSydney, Australia
Title: Nice food
Review: Ate here and found the overall experience was good. Food was reasonable in size and flavoursome. Only negative was with the dessert. It was listed as sorbet granita. Now I'm not an expert but I thought they were 2 different things. I assumed incorrectly that is would be like sorbet. Nope. It was granita. And for I think 12 ringit too expensive for flavoured ice in a small bowl. Please change your menu and say granita. Using sorbet will cause confusion.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Moxy103
Title: Best in Town
Review: Food is fresh, unique, well cooked and plentiful. Served by friendly staff. Don't waste your time and money by going anywhere else- this is the best- I 've tried the rest.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Clodagh01
Title: Just perfect
Review: From our arrival we were welcomed so warmly and had a wonderful table on the beach.  The food is beautiful and the staff are so friendly and helpful.  This restaurant is a must with the most perfect setting.  A real winner!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: salahunreal
Title: High class resturant
Review: Nice view over the sea and the staff are very friendly. I've ordered an Australian beef and my wife order some Malaysian sea fish. Both were tasty and the presentation was cool. Expensive though.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Magpie2222
Title: What a great setting for dinner!
Review: To be able to sit right on Cenang beach (with your table on the sand) whilst watching the sunset was an amazing experience. The fact that the food was amazing as well was a real bonus. We loved the meals the chef served up each night.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Chaslyn
Title: Sunset dinner
Review: Service was fantastic, Food the best and view to die for.There is something very special dining on the sand with a cool breeze and great food.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Watmel
Title: The place to eat in Langkawi
Review: We are in the middle of a 10 night stay at Casa Del Mar and can not emphasize enough how beautiful La Sal is. The food is delicious, presentation is perfect. The service stands out - friendly, efficient, timely. Dining under the stars with our feet in the sand, with food that is certainly worthy of note , is an experience we have loved and luckily will be repeating in the next few days. It is reasonably priced, servings are generous ( the Malaysian tasting plate is just 'WOW') and the ambience is perfect. Admittedly we haven't had a spot of rain yet, but even in inclement weather, La Sal would be lovely.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Alastair SWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome, unbelievable food
Review: Selection of food was terrific. Location was amazing, right on the beach. I have never before had such a truly wonderful steak cooked to perfection. We enjoyed the food so much we went four times in a week. Service was brilliant, one waiter in particular, 'Ari',from Jacarta, was out of this world. We enjoyed so much talking to him and learning all sorts of things about the area and culturesShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: StarJ11
Title: What a place!!!!
Review:
Brill rest and bar, professional staff and you must go and see a sunset from there!!
Def be staying here next time!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: adityaole
Title: the price worth the experience!
Review: sea side view, extremely friendly staffs telling a lot of things, joking around in a seaside with a tasty foods from the kitchen! main course, desserts is just, perfect!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: IamKistinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great view and customer service
Review: Had late lunch with friends. The service was excellent, I couldn't find fault. We were greeted with a smile, the ambiance of the place made it perfect with the view of the sea. Had char kwey teow, one of the chef recommended dish, but find it just ok. They have fresh fruit shakes and even had us try their dessert on the house. Overall, it was a great dining experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gerri H
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Eat here while staying in this wonderful hotel. The setting was amazing, the food totally delicious and the staff were just great.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AnnetteIncePlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: During our stay at Casa del Mar we ate in the La Sal restaurant for five dinners and two lunches. Four of the dinners were part of our package and each one was a wonderful occasion. There was an excellent choice on the menu offering local and international dishes. The food was well prepared and cooked to perfection. The portions were very generous, especially the Beef Rendang.A special mention must be made to the the waiting staff who were always very attentive and provided and excellent level of service.Finally, a mention for the bar staff at the poolside cocktail bar. These guys worked their socks of to provide excellent refreshments and an amazing range of cocktails. Thank you to Bobby, Sparky, Kree, Mood, Anzian and the others we have forgot to mention. You all made it a wonderful holiday for us both.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: WidowmafiaAdelaide, Australia
Title: Gorgeous setting and delicious food
