Review: We have dined at La Sal many times and every time the food and service has been excellent. Ensure that you have some creative cocktails at the bar before dinner - they are devine!We also had the cocktail degustation during our most recent stay - great food and great fun - thankfully, we were staying at Casa del Mar thus the 10 metre walk to our beachfront room post-dinner was welcome. A memorable night. We strongly recommend to dine at La Sal at least once during your stay in Langkawi. To dine barefoot on the beach and enjoy the sunset is an experience not to be missed. Sublime. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: uggy10
Title: Excellent
Review: Fantastic meal in a beautiful location. Great staff and well priced. There is nothing like dining with your feet in the sand.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Tony C
Title: Great food
Review: We stayed at Casa del Mar and ate at La Sal. The food was excellent and the waiting staff were attentive and friendly.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Laif F
Title: Raw Pizza, but decent cocktails
Review: Have a drink but do yourself a favour and AVOID the food unless you like overcooked, tasteless pasta or undercooked pizza. That's what I had and I feel sick.My fault for coming here when there are other dining options nearby, I suppose. My bad.Avoid. Avoid. Avoid.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: regmasterKL
Title: My Favorite Bar in Langkawi - The Best!
Review: I happen to know about this Bar when I was staying at the resort itself, of course it's the famous numero uno Casa Del Mar, when we checked I took no time and went straight to the bar, and it was to my surprise that the GM, Tom Blachere who served me my first pint in La Sal Bar. We talked and being a loyal Hard Rock Cafe visitor, and happen to be that he was GM for HRC in Bali before so we get to know each other well. From the first visit towards the bar, and it continues everytime I went to Langkawi for holiday, due to the busyness of Casa Del Mar, it's hard to get vacant room in Casa Del Mar some times. This is definitely a must visit Bar in Langkawi, the best! Of course they have excellent and friendly staff like Jack, Halim, Bob and Deen serving you, they are the best and most of all they can remember your drinks very well! I love this Bar.with That, this bar will be default bar whenever i am in langkawi.BR//Paul AlbertShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: b3achbuddyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food matched the Breathtaking view
Review: We've reserved a 3-course dinner, it's quite expensive but it's expected as it's part of Casa Del Mar. When we walked in, we're greeted with a nice ambiance, courteous staff and a soothing view of the sunset. I know from then that I will have the best Langkawi experience there. The food I ordered was out of curiosity and since it was new to my pallate, it was good! It's a burst of flavor. The crew was very attentive and fun to talk with. You'd always feel that they're willing to take another mile just to give what you need. They're very attentive to the customer's needs, we haven't even raised a finger yet and they knew what we want. That's how good they are! When you go to Langkawi make sure to try this once! :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Arijit D
Title: Good food with Great Environment
Review: This restaurateur i think has the best environment to have the dinner. But the food is very very expansive compared to the other restaurent.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: melindal721Levanto, Italy
Title: Great view with fair food
Review: We didn't stay at Casa del Mar but across from it. The view of the restaurant is gorgeous and the services was attentive. The price is OK considered the location and view. Not the cheapest in town for sure. My son ordered steak and it was too thin and overcooked. My Malaysian noodle was ok but cannot be compared with those at the night market. The soft shell crab salad seemed to be the better dish. All in all, ok food but you pay for the view.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Biomoney
Title: Very romantic, but..
Review: The atmosphere is just wow. Eating on the beachside is very exciting and romantic... Ofcourse this is reflected in the price...But the food is not as good as it sounds...I must say the food is average, they have some good stuffs but they have to make improvents...Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ranaakkad
Title: The food wasn't good and the meat  seemed old as well the fries
Review: The food wasn't good at all the meat seemed old as well the fries thought its better but couldnt eat anything.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bounford
Title: Cracking food in a beautiful setting
Review: We ate at this restaurant 3 times during our stay, as we were staying at Casa Del Mar. The food is outstanding, and quite reasonably priced (compared to uk prices, not local prices!) Can't recommend it enough
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DavidAndrewMatthews
Title: What a great location to have dinner
Review: We had a special celebratory family dinner as the sun set, the food was of fantastic quality, especially the seafood. Desserts also great. Watching the sun set was breathtaking and super relaxing. Only slight distraction were the people getting tanked at the nearby bar and making noise, but even this did not lessen our experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ziKiQKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: La Luna - Breathtaking
Review: We booked the La Luna dinner on our last night in Casa del Mar. The table was set up away from the dinner dining area on the beach and it was breathtaking. The staff obviously paid attention to every detail on the table.I have attached photos of the table setting and the menu but I don't think my pictures does the overall ambiance any justice.There was quite a bit of food and alcohol. The choices of wines and a half bottle of Moet were splendid.The food however didn't really meet our expectations but everything else about the dinner made up for it 10 fold.I would like to pay special thanks to Anizan and the rest of the staff that made our evening incredibly special on 31 August 2013.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HariNavasothy
Title: The best food we have ever tasted!
Review: We went to this restaurant after reading all the amazing reviews and it was better than what we expected. The service is excellent too. We have been travelling the world and this restaurant is the best we have ever been to!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Blueye2Bundoora, Australia
Title: Great Food on the Beach
Review: My husband and I had dinner here one night it is in a great location by the beach on Cenang Beach. The service was great and the food was delicious. Our entrees were our favourite having the soft shell crab and the prawns on a avocado salsa. Nice place for a romantic dinner would recommendShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: karenw860kazw
Title: Great birthday dinner on the beach for 6 couples!
Review: our friend's 50th birthday celebration was perfect - the setting, the food, drink, company and we got chatting to some hotel guests (we were staying next door)!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JillHAustraliaPerth, Australia
Title: Bon apetite
Review: What a wonderful opportunity to have dinner on such a beautiful beach. Be sure to arrive early for a cocktail to enjoy the sunset.As guests of the hotel we ate at La Sal on several evenings. One evening it was so wet that we needed to sit under cover - this didn't deter us from having a lovely dinner.The menu for vegetarians was a bit limited but absolutely delicious. If you were staying inhouse and wanted to eat exclusively at the restaurant then it might be an issue. The menu for meat eaters was extensive.The food is presented beautifully and the portions are on the larger side. They offer a three course dinner for a set price - it was a struggle to finish all three courses!Please make a booking as the restaurant fills up quickly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JacobLinda_WStockholm, Sweden
Title: Excellent food on the beach
Review: We visited La Sal two times during a stay in Langkawi in july 2013. It was the food more than anything that brought us back the second time - even if it should be said that the lovely setting by the beach is worth a visit in its own right. The staff doesn't seem to know too much about wine/food combining but that was not a problem for us. A bit pricey for Langkawi, but well worth the extra money you have to spend. If you go we recommend the Chicken Kapitan (main) and the shrimp/avocado starter. Btw, La Sal is also great for cocktails!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ruth BDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: So much potential but sadly misses the mark slightly
Review: We ate twice at la sal as outside guests during our stay on Langkawi. Once for lunch and again for dinner. The location is gorgeous, right on the nicest northern stretch of beach at Pantai Cenang. Personally we really didn't like the more southern bit of beach, it's quite skanky and very over populated with tourists. Up by la sal it's quiet with lovely views of neighboring islands and white soft sand. This was the main reason for the visit. We're a family of 5 so we ordered the burgers and the kids ordered one spag Bol and one kids burger. The adult food came first but 20 mins later it became pretty obvious that they had forgotten about the kids. Cue another 20 mins to prepare the food. To be fair, the management were really lovely and apologetic, we got complimentary drinks (all of us) and when the bill arrived they had also comped the kids food. I have to say that it's refreshing when management of hotels or restaurants admits fault and even more refreshing when they rectify it somehow. The food was very good quality, so were the cocktails, and it turned out to be a lovely lunch.Second meal was the following night for dinner and again the food didn't disappoint. But sadly again the service was below expectations. When I booked I had reserved a baby chair, but on arriving was told they were all being used. And after waiting way too long for the bill we ended up with someone else's and had to wait again for them to find it. There are a few things that La Sal does very well. Food is very good, especially for the price compared to other similar places like Bon Ton. And the location is just gorgeous. But service (although with a smile and lovely staff) is a bit below par for this kind of place. Also so much more could be made of it as a venue. It's by far the nicest place to hang out on that beach so my advice would be to add some cool lounge music, nicer seating for the sunsets and please please allow paying guests to use the wifi... This is after all 2013 and wifi should be free to all!!! La Sal has a lot of potential. It would be great when we come back sometime in the future if we could see it realized.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NckiB
Title: Great service & Good Food
Review:
Great service and lovely food with a wide variety on the menu. Beach setting makes it even better. The extensive cocktail menu is worth a try too.
It's popular so you'll need to book.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Roza BSydney
Title: Overrated
Review: Yes, it has the idyllic on-the-beach location, but this place was overpriced.We had the three course + tea/coffee package. It started so well - the crab, and the prawn house specialty were fantastic. Then it steadily went downhill from there. The beef randang was dry and although a big serve (prerfect for the hungry man in your life), it was pastey/dry and needed something more - like more curry sauce. My fish was quite good. The desserts were a real disappointment. The cheesecake was below average.I am not sure if it's just a co-incidence but my boyfriend was violently ill all night after dinner. The only thing we didn't share was the ice-cream and I recall him saying it tasted as if it had melted and had been refrozen, which is never good re bacteria.The service was ok - but with the beach tables far away from the other tables and kitchen, we often struggled to get attention when trying to reorder drinks etc.On the up side, the cocktails are great!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BeccJ
Title: How's the serenity
Review: My first on-the-beach dining experience and it didn't disappoint. Picturesque view, lovely service and beautiful food. I recommend the signature prawn entrée. Delicious! Would dine there again.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Means-2-endPerth, Australia
Title: Wonderful celebration and dining experience..
Review: A small group of us have recently celebrated my birthday at the La Sal restaurant at Casa Del Mar.Location is just wonderful if you are celebrating an occasion--not that you need a special occasion to dine at this wonderful establishment!There are not too many places on this wonderful planet where you can sit, dine and watch the sunset on clean, white beach sand whilst sipping a glorious Strawberry & Mint champagne Bellini!!Food and service get top points. Everyone is still talking about our experience, so a huge thank you to everyone involved. Absolutely no complaints from us. Robert and his team looked after us beautifully. Book well in advance and sit back, relax and dine at one of the best restaurants in beautiful Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Guide804606
Title: Romantic beach restaurant
Review: It was the most fantastic experience of my life! Eating dinner on the beach with the sunset is new and beautiful .. foods are not bad and the service was really good!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Missdidee1606Melbourne, Australia
Title: Beautiful location and lovely food
Review: On our first night we booked with the restaurant at the last minute, they were very accommodating, setting up a table for us. The food was lovely (I had the prawns, cooked a little to long) we ordered a special - Entree, Main and Dessert......wow so much food.....we also did our last night at La Sal and only ordered Mains....had the steak was so yummy. It was great to sit on the beach and have dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: QcruiserQueensland
Title: Beautiful location!
Review: The location of La Sal is absolutely beautiful. You sit on the beach in comfortable chairs watching the sun go down. They have quite a good selection of food, both Asian and International. This time we chose the recommended meat dish and the recommended fish dish. Both were very good and the only complaint we had is that the portion of the fish dish was very small. Not enough for my husband, while mine was more then enough. Unfortunately the weather turned nasty and we were all moved undercover. The staff was very helpful and friendly!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: krissylouGerringong, Australia
Title: Amazing!
Review: Dined here three times while staying at Casa and it was incredible every time. The location is definitely a highlight - watching the sunset with your toes in the sand, eating amazing food and drinking beautiful cocktails was a great experience. Service is fantastic and the menu is impressive. Wouldnt hesitate to recommend this restaurant to anyone!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jonas S
Title: Dinner is romantic and memorable
Review: Dined here and loved it, great food, great service and the feel of this place is awesome. If you can, I recommend staying at this hotel and you must try the food here. Dinner is romantic and memorable
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Carry-0nsBrisbane, Australia
Title: Take a big appetite!
Review: This was our favourite of the restaurants we tried in Langkawi. The food is delicious, and the servings are also quite large. We are not dainty eaters by any means, and yet we couldn't finish our meals both times we had dinner here! We only have two gripes:1. The staff are young and friendly, but sometimes that turned into young and having-too-much-fun-with-my-friends-to-serve-you, which was a bit annoying. We had to get up and chase our bill on one occasion. 2. I had a seafood dish that was very tasty, but also very very spicy! There was nothing in the description on the menu to indicate it was at all spicy, otherwise I would chosen something else. I couldn't enjoy it towards the end because my mouth was just on fire.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mangopudding1
Title: Great food and great setting!
Review: On our last night in Langkawi, we came to La Sal to be a bit fancy. We booked ahead of time and when we arrived, were shown to our edge-of-the-beach table (we were the last table between the hotel and the sea). The four of us ordered and were then served bread. When we tried to get any waiter's attention, it was to no avail and another table actually signalled for us to get attention - which was nice of them (seeing that we were a group of students), but disappointing that the staff did not give us the same attentive service as the rest of the tables. When the food eventually arrived, it was a decent sized portion (I had the salmon and my friend ordered the duck). It would have been nice to be able to see what we were eating at times but it was not a huge problem. The salmon was cooked very well, juicy and a great texture. The pasta served beneath it was al dente and tasty too. The sea and beach were very nice, but there were quite a few mosquitoes attacking my legs which wasn't pleasant but not enough to ruin a good dinner! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Marian AStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Anniversary Marian & hamid Alavi
Review: If you want an excellent experience checking in to the Casa de mar the staff are fantastic & very friendly, rooms are big & spotless i& it is the little extras that make your holiday so wonderful, when I visit langkawi in the future this is the only place I would stay. Thank you for Casa de mar for making our holiday so wonderfulShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Intensive
Title: Great Pool and beachside restaurant
Review: Excellent restaurant and service. Good value too. Dined there three times during our holiday. One of the best on the island.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ZephyrCanberraCanberra
Title: Perfect spot for dinner on the beach
Review: The restaurant at Casa del Mar serves breakfasts, lunch and dinner and as guests there we enjoyed all three. Breakfast was generous and tasty, you could help yourself from the buffet or order from an imaginative set menu. Most days the food was great, although on one morning my poached eggs arrived cold! Dinner on the beach at La Sal is a memorable occasion. As the sun sets behind the islands the lights along the beach glow and superb food, both Western and Malaysian is produced by the friendly staff. Even when it rains, dinner on the veranda is an occasion. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Madison LPerth, Australia
Title: Awesome food, service and views!
Review: We were here in Feb 2013 and we had a wonderful experience. I prebooked a table online and Robert was very prompt in his responses. On the evening we arrived, we were quickly seated by the beach and were able to see the pretty sunset as we decided on our dinner. It was Valentine's Day so there was a special area set up for Valentine's Day diners with romantic candles lit every where. We decided on the 3 course set meal and were not disappointed. The food was yummy and we were all so full afterwards. The only downside to my dining experience was that there was mossies biting me and the wait staff never bought me any insect repellant even though I had requested for it. Other than that, it was excellent.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: eachschoolholidaysSydney, Australia
Title: Amazing meal
Review: We had such an awesome dinner, we went back on our last night. It was the same price (if not cheaper!) than the buffet at the Meritus and the quality of the food was amazing. Make a reservation so that you get a front row seat for the sunset.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KMariaD
Title: Wow!
Review: Try the steak. It is amazing... Soups and salads as well. It is all very fresh and tastes very good. Costs are much higher then in most of the other places but it is worth it.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: semsaAdelaide, Australia
Title: Great setting, wonderfull food. Definitely recommend.
Review: There is a good reason this won the 2013 travellers choice award. We stayed at the Casa Del Mar and ate pretty much every meal at La Sal. There was just no reason to go anywhere else. They have a good selection, and meals taste delicious and are presented beautifully. When the weather is right, you dine on the beach, and when the weathers poor, they pull you inside. Eitherway, the setting is wonderful when you eat. Definitely recommend.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JohnMcCane
Title: I should have stayed here
Review: I loved the food and the hotel looked perfect.  Made a big mistake not staying here.  Had one of the best meals in years at the restaurant.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AfifahJSri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: tasty!
Review: we went as per review from TA. excellent customer service. we asked for popular dishes such as fried shrimp for stater, seabass malay style and australian beef steak. the food were excellent.loved the shrimp. but my steak wasnt properly cooked. i asked for well done but got medium rare.didnt complain as starving. dine by seaside equipped with mosquito repellant. excellent mixed of cocktail. massive seabass for one person. didnt try dessert bcoz we were bothfull. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: dpstirfry
Title: Great setting, appetizer and main course great, dessert below expectation
Review: This restaurant is a fantastic place for a sunset dinner with your special someone. Regarding the food we were really impressed with the appetisers and the main course risotto and seabass and somewhat disappointed with the desserts. Overall a great experience.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ContentedTraveller51
Title: High quality food in a Stunning location
Review: All food is of the highest quality and cooked to demand rather than congealing for hours in a Bain-Marie
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: wilftrunks
Title: Beautiful views, ok food
Review: The restaurant is lovely and the service was good.  The food was fine, not great, not bad, but did the job.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: d_jboxsingapore
Title: Wonderful host and most sumptuous dinner
Review: The manager, Mr Robert, was warm and inviting, dining by the beach was an awesome experience. We were given good recommendations on our orders and truly, we were utterly satisfied. It was indeed the best meal we ever had in our stay in Langkawi, even my children pleaded to return on the following night! You will be sorry if you miss out on this!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: drinkingcocoaGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent taste
Review: Had a seared Australian beef with stewed mushrooms and Langkawi buffalo mozzarella salad for lunch with bruschetta topped with the mozzarella.The meat was tender, juicy and the taste was accented with hints of lime and herbs. The salad was well dressed and the combination of the leaves, olives and the cheese was just right. Very good hospitality when the salad was a wrong item and was given on the house. Definitely will return.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kcr852Hong Kong, China
Title: Disappointed - seems overrated.
Review: We dined here our last night in Langkawi, early June, after looking at the reviews here on TA. We arrived just after 7PM and decided to order the set - 120 ringgit for a starter, main, dessert + tea/coffee. I ordered an ice tea and my partner a gingle ale. Our waitress was not unkind, but wasn't particularly polite or attentive either throughout our dining experience.After about a ten minute wait, we were presented with the menus. Another ten minutes later we were able to order, and after about twenty minutes we were presented with our first course. I had the 'oriental beef salad', and my partner had the soft shell crab starter with pomelo salad. The oriental beef salad I felt was quite lacking in flavour, and didn't have the punch you would typically expect ordering this type of meal. The quality of the beef was good though, and that is about all that was good in that meal. My partner's soft shell crab meal - the batter was a lot thicker than we would have liked, but otherwise tasty - and so was the pomelo salad - which did have a punch!We then finished our starters, and it took about fifteen minutes for staff to realise we had done so, and another twenty five minutes for our mains to arrive. By all means, this restaurant is set on a beach and has a perfect ambiance for relaxation, but knowing we had to still pack and leave early the next morning, we were not really in the mood to be sitting around. I noticed other customers also turning their heads frequently in the direction of the kitchen, and each time we heard a waiter come, everyone would look at the dishes in the hope it was theirs. I had the lamb chops for main, and my partner ordered the salmon. Both of the proteins were of good quality, although they did trim the lamb chops a lot more than I personally would have liked - but to each their own on that one. The mint aioli they made was delicious! The accompanying sweet potato was presented in a sort of crispy pancake type thing, but I found it really dry inside, when it could have been much creamier. The vegetables didn't do too much for me or my partner at this stage, but probably because we had been waiting so long.We then had dessert. one spiced cinnamon creme brulee and the other a pannacotta with a grenadine jelly. The creme brulee was OK, nothing spectacular but all right, a 5/10. The pannacotta on the other hand wasn't so nice, and the grenadine jelly on top was not very nice at all. We finally got the bill and had a bit of a disagreement with the waitress as to whether or not iced tea was tea as they charged it additionally (which it is in Hong Kong where we are from and I can't see it being any different in price). Finally they agreed to take it off the bill, which, considering we hadn't ordered the included drinks, was extremely kind of them.....So perhaps for us not the best visit, but if you have more time on your hands and don't mind sitting on the beautiful beach for a while waiting for your food (which you shouldn't really on holiday), it probably is quite a nice experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KP_Aus_83
Review:
Every single meal we had here was perfect!!!
Local cuisines are delicious so don't be afraid to give them a go and the seafood is amazing!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kal P
Title: Delicious!!!
Review: We stayed 5 nights and tried most things on the menu. Every single meal was completely perfect, without fail. I especially liked all the local dishes, as they were excellent value for money and you were always guaranteed to walk away full!! YUM, YUM!!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Glenn4648
Title: excellent food and service
Review: It may seem expensive compared to prices in restaurants along the main street but yo don't get the location or service.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Tiffany T
Title: Romantic Place for Dinner
Review: Dinner at the beach and facing the sea. Food was good. Place was relaxing. Very Romantic place for dinner.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mickdina
Title: Friendly staff and lovely food
Review: Highly recommend the Beef Rendang which was the clear standout in our opinion. Very friendly staff and lovely setting.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: moreno65
Title: Super location
Review: The place is beautiful and the staff is very friendly. The choice between western and malaysian food is good.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cheryllove
Title: Paradise
Review: I'm here now laying by the pool sipping my piña colada and everything about this place is perfect. The good, cocktails, as well as rooms, service and the view couldn't be better. Can't recommend it high enough.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Brenda TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Staff and Great Food
Review: My boyfriend and I went to Casa Del Mar with expectations of a nice view. Upon reaching there, we were told that it was full house and that we had to reserve in future to secure a seat. Disappointed, we decided to try other restaurants nearby. The staff (a tall Chinese man) was extremely helpful as he recommended other places to us. However, as we drove along none of the restaurants' ambience were as good as Casa Del Mar's. We drove back and decided to wait for a table at Casa Del Mar. Skipping forward to the meal - my boyfriend ordered the Australian Beef Steak and I had the Special of the Day Salmon. The beef was nothing like we have ever tasted before! The meat was so soft as we sank our teeth into it, it was like a plate a warm food from God. Not forgetting the salad as well! I do not particularly like greens but this was an exception. My salmon was well prepared as well. Definitely try the mojitos there too; refreshing and tasty! We had Apple Pie for dessert, it was the BEST we have ever tasted yet again. The staff were very attentive and friendly, which made us feel taken care of and satisfied. After dinner, we decided to take a walk by the beach shuffling out feet in the powdery white sands. We looked up at the skies and saw many stars "shine bright like a diamond". It was the perfect way to end a night.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LetsDoCurrySydney, Australia
Title: Relax at La Sal
Review: Not sure where this ranks as far as restaurants in Langkawi is cooncerned but definitely No. 1 in our book. It ticks all the boxes and the food on the two ocassions we have been there has been superb. From satay to noodles to curries to vegetables, this kitchen has all the bases covered. If you're wanting good Malaysian food, service, view and lounge music - this is a venue not to be missed - 9/10Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: lyndaholgatePerth, Australia
Title: Not open till 7pm!
Review: We saw this as No1 on Trip advisor & where very keen to try it! However, we had to go a bit earlier as we where staying at Reback Island & our last boat was at 7.45..... So when we arrived at the La Sal@ Casa del Mar hotel at 6pm, we asked where the restaurant was and was "Pointed" in the direction of "Outside the back". So off we went to end up standing on the beach wondering where it was for 10 minutes!! Eventually we where approached by the barman who must have seen our confusion only to be told the restaurant didn't open till 7pm!!! Think it would have been nice to have been informed this when we first entered. I think the times should def be advertised. :-(Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jiang XBeijing, China
Title: Killing view
Review: I had my dinner there in the last day of the trip in Langkawi, the sand on the beach is so white and soft, the view was breath taken. I was the first table to be served at that day, and the waiters were warm to introduce the best local delicacy, all good, a very good experience. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: What can top the front row on the beach @ La Sal
Review: The answer is: I can't think of something offhand. The front row of La Sal is one of the magic spots in the world. My wife and I have had the privilege a couple of times, while staying at Casa del Mar, to sit at a table at the front row and enjoying the delicious food and be taken care of by the dedicated and friendly staff. You have to be early in the day to secure your front row table in the evening; it is an advantage of course to stay at Casa del Mar. But the experience is magic and not to be missed. Close your eyes for the prices on the right hand side of the menu (The price level is of the European variety) but order the meal, maybe a bottle of wine, sit back and have an unforgettable evening. By the way, if you decide to have a three course meal, a special menu price is offered by La Sal. To zoom in on my personal preference, the tuna steak is prepared to perfection. We have already booked our stay @ Casa del Mar for next year and look forward to several evenings @ the front row.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Vivian JAnn Arbor, Michigan
Title: Exquisite
Review: We got there a bit early for dinner (doesn't start until 6 or 7) and had drinks at their poolside bar - unfortunately, they wouldn't let us sit on the beach chairs since we weren't hotel guests, but the drinks made up for it. The cuisine is incredible (I had the beef rendang) and the service very nice, although sometimes it was a bit hard to get a hold of a waiter. Very lovely beach side dining (with two friendly cats who roam around)! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bigfox81Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt
Title: An unforgettable experience
Review: Oh my god!!! I never thought dining could be this good! I can still feel the taste of the incredibly tasteful pumpkin soup in my mouth, although that was one month ago. I tried malaysian dishes and international cuisine and all were unforgettable. And there special moonlit dinner... wow!! Will return again for sure.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: lin9lin9
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Great atmosphere and food is generally good. The tuna tartar is slight disappointing, and dessert is not great. Anyway, it is worth visiting for a romatic dinner on the beach.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Wuff_kinKojonup, Australia
Title: Amazing food right on the beach
Review: The food and service are outstanding here. really top quality. We had lunch here 3 times and dinner on our last night, right on the beach, by candle light was very special. There is an extensive cocktail and wine list and prices are reasonable.A must!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Brokenback
Title: Great food & service
Review: As always great food & service, the hotel sorted a special seafood platter out for my birthday - wonderful
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Renee APerth, Australia
Title: Fine dining on the beach
Review: The setting was spectacular and the food was to die for. Included in our package was 2 x 3 course dinners and although this meant we had less opportunity to try alternative places in Langkawi it was by no means disappointing. We had 4 people dining each time and on both occasions every bite was amazing and therefore every morsel was eaten. And being able to eat such magnificent food with your feet in the sand made it all the more enjoyable. This is a must if you are near Pantai Cenang.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ASaran
Title: Good food and nice staff
Review: This restaurent is a part of one the best resort at Langkawi, where the staff treat you like a family. Excellent service and very nice food, so we just had to visit the place again - we stayed there for a half day.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Olly070
Title: Top!!
Review:
The choise, the possibility to create a 3-coursedinner as you like it. Every day he catch of he day or the meal of the day. And all this every time just made fresh, after you have ordered.
|For us, higly to recommend. (Worthwile a Michelinstar)
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NurHalimSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best dining i've been..
Review: Im reviewing only about the restaurant as im not residing the hotel.. Dine there on 20-5-13.. Made a walk in reservation a day before in advance.. Helpful staffs leading to expected best seats to the sunset.. On the day, ordered two meals for me and fiancee with juices.. After meal, one of the staff (seems like a supervisor named "john" if i aint wrong), propose a special casa del mar cocktail "green island" to fiancee while i have chivas on the rocks.. Nice drink.. And what made our night is he waived both of our drinks.. Really value the money and great service.. Nothing bad bout this place, seriously..Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TimBLeeds
Title: great location
Review: lovely food and service. great views of the sea and quiet and romantic for those who want it thatway
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bgainhuntaBrisbane, Australia
Title: Very good food...Try hard service...
Review: Cannot beat dining on the beach and enjoying the views and fresh air. Food quality very good - lamb rack cooked to perfection and prawn risotto was delicious! Well priced good selection of wines. Only opportunity for improvement would be in training staff in some service basics. Overall excellent. Highly recommended.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mark n Sue B
Title: Fab meal on edge of beach
Review: Stunning food at a table right on the edge of the beach. What more at the end of a hard day's sunshine
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Laid Back Dining
Review: No trip to Langkawi is complete for me without an evening with my feet in the sand dining at La Sal.As a vegetarian, I usually opt for their pasta dish, which is always cooked to perfection and extremely tasty. Coupled with a nice glass of white wine - what could be better!!There is a very laid back feel to this restaurant and the staff are efficient and very friendly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ScotgalAustralia
Title: Best food on the island
Review:
The food is so fresh, the Katifa Prawns and Malay tasting platter my favourites. Not to mention the rack of lamb and beef rendang.
The location is perfect and could only be better if some romantic music was played during dinner
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JanineH14
Title: Beautiful
Review: Went for a meal for my birthday, so good I would go back and stay at the hotel as resident. Fabulous food and lovely staff. Could not get any better!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jenniferivars
Title: Excellent!
Review: Great and friendly service, delicious food and magic location at the beach! A bit pricey but totally worth it!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Austin PAdelaide, Australia
Title: good food and serve
Review: la sal is superb. First time there on a date and i felt so welcomed. The staff are so polite and kind, the food was gorgeous, never had monkfish but now i will and often! The whole environment is clean, tables set out well, toilets sparkle clean... Overall i have nothing but praise for the restaurant.... Would definitely go again... "Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: rwlidPerth
Title: Unique Place for Dinner on the Beach
Review: We were staying at the Casa del Mar and ate four times at La Sal as part of a package deal. The restaurant is literally right on the beach and an ideal place to watch the spectacular Langkawi sunset. Get there about an hour before the sun goes down and have a cocktail or beer before dinner, I can definitely recommend the Mojitos. The dinner menu is a mixture of Asian and Western inspired dishes. Everything we ordered was excellent and we can particularly recommend the Deep Fried Kataifi Prawns and Grilled White Cod. I also tried a fillet steak from their western menu which was also very good. Desserts are worth trying too and there is a great selection of New World and European wine at reasonable prices. I would also definitely recommend an Irish coffee to round the evening off. Their lunch menu is also good and you can get a great burger or club sandwich. Along with the Privilege restaurant, La Sal is a must visit when in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MBMW
Title: Perfect dinner on the beach
Review:
The setting is wonderfull, on the beach, in front of the hotel, lit with torches. Very quiet, which you do not expect from the streetside.
Food, wine and service are great, as you might expect in this category.
To be recommended!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bernie D
Title: Dining at its best
Review: Take the time to enjoy dinner on the sand looking at the sunset, very romantic. The staff will ensure you have an exceptional dining experience with great food cooked by talented chefs. Bookings are essential.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ben S
Title: Romantic sunset dinner
Review: Perfect spot for a romantic sunset dinner.  We had a beautiful evening.  Excellent food and service.  Ask for a table right on the front of the beach.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect Beachside Dining
Review: This restaurant is a perfect setting to enjoy a romatic meal on the beach. As we were staying at CDM La Sal is our restaurant of choice, why go anywhere else when you have something so amazing a few steps away from your room. The food is excellent with plenty of choice, I would have to recommend most dishes as I think between us we have tried most of them. For me the special of the week 'cod served with blueberries' was amazing and I am just hoping it appears on the menu again when we visit again next year.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: drjmurphyCentreville, Delaware
Title: Perfect stay at Casa del Mar
Review: Stayed at this small (34 rooms) hotel on the beach in Langkawi. It lived up to all of the positive reviews. The accommodations were perfect;,our rooms opened onto a small terrace and then to the pool. The beach was pristine and 30 m. from our room and the breakfast was perfect. As Americans we are not used to the variety and abundance of fresh fruit. If you are going to Langkawi, stay here .Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BirminghamSelenaBirmingham
Title: Amazing meal at La Sal
Review: Having seen this restaurant on tripadvisor we decided that this was the perfect venue for an intimate meal to celebrate our wedding anniversary. I contacted the hotel to make a reservation and had a very prompt response from Robert Khor confirming this and asking how many years we had been married. On arrival at the restaurant we were been seated on a lovely table right on the beach - a perfect setting to celebrate and watch a wedding reception taking place at the hotel that evening. In fact this was perfect to see the happy couple have their first dance and for us to remember our wedding day.. Food was amazing and beautifully presented and to top it off Robert had arranged for a lovely suprise with our dessert to mark our anniversary. Quite simply an amazing evening so thanks to Robert and all at La Sal Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Justyna DAlmaty, Kazakhstan
Title: Outstanding!
Review: We've visited this restaurant tonight and everything about it was more than 6 stars. We are hugely impressed with the extremely friendly and well mannered staff, beautiful food and the setting. I have even got a cake and the staff sang happy birthday to me. We will definitely be back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jena MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful Setting, Delicious Food
Review: We stayed at the Westin during our trip, but heard good things about this restaurant and wanted to try it. We booked 2 weeks in advance, which I would highly recommend. The restaurant books up very quickly and they were turning people without reservations away. The setting is lovely, we sat at a table in the sand overlooking the sea. The staff is very attentive without being suffocating. The food was the best we had in Langkawi. The low point of our meal with the tuna tartar with goat cheese - the texture if a bit off and the cheese does not go well at all with the tuna. If you truly like tuna tartar, this dish is probably not for you. The beef salad was delicious and I would highly recommend it. For a main course, I had the Beef Rendang and it was delicious! Some of the best I have ever had. The portions are quite large and you will not leave hungry. The prices are not cheap, but more reasonable than most of the big hotels around town. They have a good wine list for Langkawi - heavy on Australian wines. We really enjoyed our dinner here and will definitely be back!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nick RBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Nice Setting !
Review: We visited this restaurant while on our 10 day trip to Langkawi setting was great food was ok superb soft shell crab & my wife had a nice risotto however my chicken kapitan dish was a little bland & the chicken was very dry & as always seems to be with Langkawi our white wine was served tepid so we had to keep it in the ice bucket for 15 minutes.The main gripe we had is at around 10pm most guests were leaving the staff left our finished plates from our mains on our table for 15 min before clearing in fact i had to draw their attention for our table to be cleared & then they never even offered us the desert menu in all fairness we did not want desert but that is beside the point very poor service we thinks. It is as they had just stopped serving at 9 30pm we also observed another couple that walked from the beach & sat down on an empty table at around 9 45 they sat there for 10 min waiting to be served & were totally ignored so they got up & walked off !!This is not a chaep restaurant & the service is not up to standard !!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PirulinaLausanne, Switzerland
Title: Best price quality ratio on the island
Review: Asian inspired menu with a twist. Book early, so you get a table at the beach, to get a nice sunset view, other tables are within the hotel's premises. Appetizers are pretty generous, I would say even too large, considering the portions of main courses. The chef uses first grade ingredients, dishes are elaborate, my only suggestion is to go easy on the quantity of mayonnaise used to dress salads and to enrich sauces. Restaurants has a nice wine selection, naturally, Australian wines prevail. I recommend to try a funky cocktail before the dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: huxleyladCrediton, United Kingdom
Title: Superb setting
Review: we stayed at the Danna but went here for a meal one evening. Great menu and the setting was second to none - on the beach as the sun set. We played their alternative happy hour and won 3 drinks each for one which was a bonus!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PGMD2013
Title: Excellent views
Review: This restaurant has great views and eating on the beach was very nice. The food was ok however we expected better. Maybe it was our choice of meal. Great place for a romantic meal.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: r-taratiaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: the best in langkawi
Review: i had checked trip advisor on this place and wanted to give it a try. booked the place earlier and was lucky to get it for the evening. lovely dining on the beach. the drinks are must try. the food just great. must try to find out. price is high but must try to find out at least once. only tried main course as we are all samll eaters. will go again to try the dessert. book ahead.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tiglet12London, United Kingdom
Title: Best restaurant on the beach
Review: Lovely restaurant right on the beach. We were staying here so had breakfast every morning, which was lovely. The Nasi Goreng was delicious! The Tandoori chicken skewers and Thai Beef salad were a favourite at lunchtime and also ate here a couple of times in the evening so all in all would highly recommend.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HolidayHighsBournemouth
Title: Lovely dining but did have a few problems
Review: I booked a table the day before by going into the hotel and speaking to the staff giving them the details of where I was staying and they wrote it all down on the reservation sheet. We turned up at the restaurant the following day to be told that I had no reservation!! I said that I had been in the day before and it had all been written down on their booking form but they just said sorry and that it wasn't there! They said that they could make up a table for us but it would not be on the beach. I was not impressed and said that it was not acceptable as I know I had made a reservation! I then spoke to the Restaurant manager and he apologised and looked again at the booking list. I asked to check it too and we then found that my booking had been scribbled out! Not a good start! He apologised again and gave us a table on the beach which was lovely. He came over to talk to us and advise us about the menu and choice of cocktails. We were soon relaxed and forgot about the beginning of the night. We ordered the chicken satay and King prawns to start which were beautiful and the chicken curry and Lamb rack for our mains again were beautiful. We then sat for over half an hour waiting for our plates to be cleared and to order our pudding. In the end I had to catch the attention of a waitress who then said that they close the kitchen at 10pm so was implying that we could not have our pudding. I then said we had been waiting for someone to serve us for ages and she did apologise. The restaurant manager by now had gone and the service seemed to suffer quite a bit without him.For our puddings we had Creme brulee and Chocolate fondant cake. They were both average and not what I expected. The presentation was no way near the standard of the rest of the meal and a bit of a let down.Over all I would recommend it as the food and location were very good. But the service needs to be improved for the price that you pay!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: parsial71
Title: Best restaurant on that beach - located at Casa del Mar hotel
Review: This is simply the best restaurant on that beach in Langkawi. The rest of the restaurants just lack the level to produce better cusisine...
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Veronica LShanghai, China
Title: Romantice and nice cooking
Review: The restaurant is well worthy of it's reputation and I really love the lambs. We ate on the beach for our marriage anniversity celebration and it is really lighted me up. I really feel an exceptional customer experience at here. Also, I appreciate the talk with its manager Robert, who is a nice guy.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: h_liae2018Leamington Spa, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: La Sal is a fabulous restaurant on the beach, which serves fresh, fabulous food and drink on a daily basis. It is romantic and peaceful, and service is great. We stayed at CDM which included 4 meals at La Sal, and we expected some sort of buffet. However it comprised of a 3 meal a la carte menu, and tea and coffee. What more can you wish for? Highly recommended.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tebbNotts
Title: An absoloute gem!
Review: What a fabulous place. We ate at La Sal to celebrate my birthday and we were not disappointed. A beautifully situated restaurant, right on the beach, which is charming in itself. The staff are so friendly and the service is excpetionally good but it's the food that steals the show! A mouthwatering selction of wonderful delights await you, so go and enjoy!A top restaurant that is priced accordingly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tsferguson
Title: Candle lit dinner on the beach
Review: Such a romantic setting and the food does not disappoint.  The staff were very attentive [unlike other parts of Langkawi where service can be slow] and the restaurant is well worthy of it's reputation.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Marloes020
Title: An absolute treat
Review:
The food is amazing and the setting on the beach is beautiful (when you make a reservation you can telle them which table you like)
Good service as well. Very friendly.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: IdB11_NL
Title: Superb tuna...
Review: Had dinner at casa del mar. Really loved the ambiance, and of course the food! The tuna they served was excellent! The servers were polite and did a good job!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rachel RKyoto, Japan
Title: Wonderful food with a beautiful atmosphere
Review: We initially poked our heads into the Casa del Mar resort to ask directions to another restaurant, but the staff at the front desk were so gracious and friendly, encouraging us to explore the property when we peeked at the pool, we decided to return the next night to sample their intriguing cocktail menu. The bartender was friendly and personable and the drinks we had were creative and delicious. We were so taken by the sight of the simple candle lit tables on the beach we asked for a food menu and although we had been advised to make a reservation, they easily accommodated our small group as it was quite late. The service was warm and genuine, and the server made an effort to remember all of our names. Even when he kept calling one of our party the wrong name, he was so sincere in his efforts, we didn't feel the need to correct him :)The food was rich, thoughtful and delicious, we especially enjoyed the lovely light tuna tartar and the seafood risotto. We thought the prix fixe menu (RM120) was an excellent deal, especially considering the generous portion sizes, and included an appetizer, entree and dessert. We were celebrating a birthday that evening and the birthday girl was treated to a complimentary piece of cake with her name (carefully checked for spelling by the server) written on the plate in chocolate sauce, as well as a glass of champagne. The attentive service and wonderful details really made it a special night for the birthday girl and we all enjoyed the fabulous setting, especially with lightning flashing in the distance. Thanks to Casa del Mar for winning us over with a high level of service; I sincerely recommend this place to anyone looking for a special experience in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LordandLady469Perth, Australia
Title: Hit and miss
Review: Dined here last night and to be honest it was just ok. Location is lovely, service a little unattentive as had to get staff attention for more drinks etc. The prawns for entree were the highlight but the malaysian taste plate, although huge wasn't very exciting and a bit bland. Dessert was probably the worst creme brulee I've ever had, scrambled egg custard would sum it up. I won't be rushing back but I did hear the lamb was very good, perhaps I just ordered the wrong things?Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JillBob11Witney, United Kingdom
Title: Just great!
Review: Again when staying at Casa del Mar, we ate in the restaurant several times and were not disappointed. The meals are always nicely presented and nice sized portions, staff treat you like royalty - a nice touch you feel like you are the only ones there. Thanks again for all our lovely meals x. We will be back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: A magic spot with magic food
Review: La Sal @ Casa del Mar is the restaurant, embedded in Casa del Mar resort. It is a magic spot, because outside tables of the restaurant are actually situated on the beach. Hotel guests have preference for reserving a table on the front row. Here you enjoy the magic beach front dinner in the Langkawi sunset. A unique spot on the earth. Not only the spot, also the food has some magic. You can compose from the menu a three course dinner. Compliments for the chef, the dishes are prepared superbly, fitting for the ambiance. My preference is the beef salad for starter, the tuna steak for main course and the creme brulee for dessert. However, the Australian beef for main course is also tempting; then you can order a bottle of Italian Montepulciano d'Abruzzo to make the meal perfect. To enjoy the dinner at La Sal, be prepared to pay Western prices. The staff of La Sal is very friendly and make you feel at home. I have some remarks, which won't discount the full five point rating, but aim at enabling the management in further improving the restaurant. We had dinner several times, but on one occasion we had to wait 45 minutes for our main course. A table in the front row at La Sal is not a spot you wish to leave in a hurry, but I noticed that guests at other tables, which had ordered their (three course) meal at a later time, were served with their main course much earlier. This events points to a problem with the sequence of preparing the meals in the kitchen. Furthermore, the lunch service in La Sal leaves something to be wished. On one occasion we had to send back our lunches, because the French fries were stone cold (Fish and chips). The fish was piping hot. This sloppiness in the kitchen (I referring of course at the lunch time staff) should be addressed. But, looking back at my beach front dinners, closing my eyes, it is really magic.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SonouloupSaint-Denis, Reunion Island
Title: Romantic and very friendly staff
Review: We had dinner on the beach at this place and it is truly romantic and nice. We recommend that you reserve a table in advance if you want to be on the beach.Food was nice although the tuna tartar did not meet our expectations because it was served in a kind of sauce that did not give the impression we were eating raw tuna. But the crispy salmon was delicious.Service was fantastic and very friendly and we had lovely time. Definitely a place to go !Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ClaireMelb
Title: Yummy!
Review: We ate here twice and the food was delicious.  I highly recommend the steak but everything was great.  Very romantic and great service
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Brucie0304
Title: Favourite restaurant in langkawi
Review: Had a lovely meal here during a new year trip to langkawi. Food was fantastic although very very filling! We had seats outside, and whilst the restaurant is a decent size it still felt private. Great romantic location to go with your other half and one not to miss if you're in langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: krsw20
Title: Our favourite restaurant in Langkawi.
Review: The staff offer excellent service. The food is excellent and priced accordingly. Wine and cocktail lists offer lots of variety. All wait and bar staff were very friendly and helpful. We ate here many times during our stay in Langkawi. Book early as it is very popular.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SK3986Perth, Australia
Title: Great food and Cocktails
Review: Would recomend booking a table, we waited till 9:30 to be seated but it was worth the wait. The cocktails here are the best on the island, little more $$$ at average 22RM. Spicy Thai Mojito was amazing. Great view of the beach while dining. I wouldnt recomend this place for kids, more friends or a romantic night. Fantastic food, best beef rendang I have ever had. The service was fantastic here, was a great night.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Justyna_and_ArturWarsaw, Poland
Title: Good food but lousy service
Review: Following the Tripadvisor recommendation we booked a table on the beach at the La Sal restaurant.We were offered a second row of the tables (the first one is booked for the hotel guests).The restaurant has great views of the see (magnificent sunset), good food, decent wines and terrible, terrible service. You can see the guests chasing the waiters for everything (menu, wine, food, name it). You never know when you get your order and in what sequence. Anyway - worth doing if you have high tolerance for a bad serviceShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MartinB628
Title: Amazing place
Review: We have the set lunch and we were not disappointed. Great view and service minded staff. Quite small portions.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ozTravelGirlMelbourne, Australia
Title: For romantic couples
Review: We were staying at this hotel for our honeymoon so we ate here one night. Service is good, views are wonderful, food was delicious, and it's not too expensive. It's not really a place for children, more for couples. I would highly recommend coming here for at least one night if you are staying in the area. Recommend you reserve early!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bela1977
Title: Amazing food!
Review: We ate 4 times in the hotel and every meal was amazing.  Dinner was a real highlight for us. There is a great selection of food, all the starters, mains and deserts are delicious. I'd really recommend eating here!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: justaskingnowShanghai, China
Title: Great food, great location
Review: Loved the food here as well as the location on the beach. The prawn appetizer with the mango avocado salsa was delicious. Make reservations in advance as it looks quite busy for dinner. There is room for improvement in their service but the food quality makes up for it. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FarshidSamieJonkoping, Sweden
Title: Terrible
Review: Saw their ranking in TA and wanted to try them. Unfortunately it wasn't our night. I booked a table for two 4 days before visiting the place and when we were there they had lost our reservation. We were placed on a corner nearby the WC. After the starter it took them almost 50 min bringing our main course. We have ordered not spicy and even this was a failure. But I admitt the atmosphere is great.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: WestAussie117
Title: Ideal for a treat while on holiday
Review: There are plenty of cheaper places with equal views but this is a great place for a treat, lovely service, wonderful sun set views right on the beach. Excellent food. Family of four it was R250 with drinks.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: zeepadSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best mojito ever (& yes the food is very good too!)
Review: My husband & I had dinner here 2 nights ago, & what a lovely evening it turned out to be! Everything about La Sal is designed to please - the location (right on the beach so you can watch the sunset); the service - warm & genuine, attentive without being in your face, the food - well balanced delicate flavours & the cocktails - very creative. I first had the spicy thai mojito (with a little trepidation as I am not a huge fan of chilli) but it turned out to be amazingly refreshing with beautiful notes of lime, ginger & mint. Highly recommend this. For our starter we shared a Katapki prawn & that was sublime - I would have gladly had the mango avocado salsa accompanying it as a starter in itself! For our mains I had the malaysian seabass -excellent & my husband had the malaysian platter - very good, especially the beef rendang (very different to the traditional beef rendang we have had before).My only suggestion to La Sa would be - reduce the portion size. Its a crying shame to waste such good food but I ended up eating only half my seabass & my husband too couldn't finish his platter.Thank you La Sal for a lovely evening. And a special "Thank you" to Robert the hotel manager who took the trouble to come & spend a few minutes talking with every customer, getting feedback & ensuring that everyone was having a good timeShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: seekingthesun1980Melbourne, Australia
Title: sand in your toes
Review: Amazing seafood, fantastic location, right on the beach with your feet in the sand, watching the sunset - highly recommend the traditional whole fish - amazing! Also the South African two oceans sauvignon blanc was great! With excellent service - offering to take pictures of us:) Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: me1000ukGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: excellent view and decent food
Review: We went to La Sal on what was a rainy day, but they sorted us out with a good table (weren't guests at the hotel but booked the day before).Beautiful setting and the menu was varied.The Kataifi prawn starter was amazing and definitely a 'must-try'. The mains and deserts were decent but not mind-blowing. They had a 3 course meal deal which was good value considering the setting, and the food was well presented.Definitely one of the better places to eat in Langkawi and worth seeing. Service also was great and a special mention for one of the service staff named Pat, who was incredibly helpful, friendly and helped make the dinner a pleasure!Go there for the atmosphere, and the 3 course meal deal for dinner. A great romantic locationShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NewcastlePeterDNewcastle
Title: Best in Best Cenang
Review: Ok, so you will pat a little more than in most restaurants in Cenang but it is worth it. The food is exceptional, the location amazing and the service is fantastic. By UK standards the food is very reasonable. As an example a main of Australian Fillet of Beef, which was delicious and very tender, was around GPB £14. For a dish of similar quality you would expect to pay atleast double that price.If you get the chance and don't mind paying Pub-Grub prices for a fine dining experience, this is not to be missed.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gavontheweb
Title: Came back for more
Review: We had two fantastic meals here, fresh, nicely served meals right on the beach with great choice of cocktails and wines. Definitely recommend.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: garlyn1960brisbane
Title: Excellent food
Review: We stayed at the Casa del mar and one night we ate at the La Sal, they had an offer for a 3 course meal for 120 ringett, the meals were excellent, we were so full afterwards but would recommend this restaurant. We ate on the beach, we very pretty. The staff were very attentive and we enjoyed our night very muchShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JacquiB616Sydney, Australia
Title: Average
Review: Nice setting, clean and spacious. Staff were not particularly friendly but efficient. Food was quick and clean, but not extensive or at all impressive in range. Average taste and pretty small portions for the price so don't go in the mood for taste sensations or a full belly.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hunt4adventureVictoria, Australia
Title: Amazing food!!!!
Review: We read the reviews and decided to have dinner here, we were amazed by the food!We had cocktails and watched the sun set at the bar. The bar staff were excellent and choices of cocktails was very interesting!! It was raining but the atmosphere was still very nice. We hadn't booked so we had to sit a bit further back from the beach, but we still had nice views of the beach.I chose the 3 course dinner for RM120. I had a prawn and avocado dish which was absolutely amazing for entre, then the Malay tasting platter for main, again amazing!!! Too much food we really should have shared the platter! My husband had the pumpkin soup and the tika chicken, huge servings and excellent quality!We had to ask for dessert to be sent out as it seems they forgot, but it came quickly after we had asked. The Cree brûlée was delicious!!!! The service can be a bit slow at times, we ordered drinks before any food and they only arrived to us with the main course, hence we stopped ordering drinks after that. The food and the setting is amazing, would highly recommend it, however make a booking first to get a good table!!! and if they forget something, ask again, or you may be waiting a while!!! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PaulDoranBelfast, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and service
Review: We spent nine nights at Casa del Mar and ate in the restaurant for at least one meal each day. We found the food to be delicious and very nicely varied. The Malay Platter is a particularly good way of familiarising yourself with local cuisine. I also really enjoyed the miso prawn ciabatta available on the lunch menu. I think I only let one day go past without having the chef's excellent roti canai for breakfast. Great food in a wonderful location.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ianvic_on_holiday
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: We had breakfast lunch and dinner here on different days as we were staying here, food and atmosphere was fantastic, could not fault anything about this Hotel or restaurant.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: George G
Title: Decent food, nice location
Review: The food is decent, more European/Western than I would have liked, but if that's what you are looking for, it's a nice place to hang out, just off the Cenang beach.  Service is slow, but gets the job done, and friendly/helpful.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Boojie
Title: nice views, but go elsewhere for good food
Review: overpriced and not so flavorful. the atmosphere was fabulous though. wish we had stayed at this hotel.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KickstonMadrid, Spain
Title: A must
Review: We stayed at Casa del Mar hotel and off course we wanted to have dinner one night at La Sal due to several recommendations, however we also liked to go out and try other restaurants outside. We tried, but didn't find anything that we liked as much as La Sal, so we had dinner the three evenings we stayed at Pantai Cenang in La Sal. Two times inside, and once on the beach, right on the sand. Very special and romantic.Food was terrific, we just went for Asian food, it was delicious. Very well presented and tasty, and also generous portions.The service was slow, but very helpful, attentive and extremely nice. If we repeated this restaurant the three nights during our stay, it was because it deserved it. Do not miss a dinner at La Sal..Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: chrisbmt
Title: Loved this place
Review: Dined here 3 times and loved it, great food, great service and the feel of this place is awesome. If you can I recommend staying at this hotel and you must try the food here. Dinner is romantic and memorable
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Pangu_RitesHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious- would definitely recommend!
Review: I came here with a group of friends after reading good reviews on Tripadvisor and we were not disappointed.The staff greeted us warmly and were very attentive all the way through. We had gone to the spa just before dinner, so we were dining until quite late, about 11pm, and were the last party still dining at this point- however we did not feel rushed at all and the food was delicious.I had the soft shell crab to start, and a risotto to follow, all courses were delicious and very large! Would definitely recommend this place- there are however a lot of cats if you have a phobia!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gary OManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food, Great Service
Review: Followed the recommendations from Trip Advisor and was NOT disappointed. We went into Casa during the day to reserve a table for that evening. The manager was most helpful and invited us to come in for a drink and to have a look at the menu. He explained that we could choose from the A La Carte menu or take the 3 course Prix Fix for 120 Ringgit.I went for the 'famous' King Prawn starter with Mango Salsa. This was unbelievable, extremely fresh and a good sized portion. For main I had the rack of lamb which was cooked to perfection and for afters I had the Chocolate Caramel tart. I really cannot speak highly enough about this place. Our table was set on the beach, where we watched the sunset whilst drinking Dragonfruit Mojito's. The perfect place for a special occasion but cheap enough to go 2 or 3 times in a week!!!! I must say we tried Bon Ton aswell which my partner had steaks at both places...........Casa wins hands down. This please is a must!Can I also mention the waiting staff were very attentive and friendly...much appreciated guys.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: QcruiserQueensland
Title: Magic location but..
Review: Everything was great dining at La Sal, the location, the food, the service, except for the constant traffic on the beach. The high beam carlights driving on the beach were very annoying. To avoid this, you have to dine later. Why this allowed, we don't know but something should be done about it, not just for the holidaymakers but for the eco system of the beach as well. The food was excellent. We had the Malaysian tasting platter and the Beef Rendang and both were very tasty. The portions are very generous, so we could only manage 1 dessert between the two of us, which also was delicious!! The staff is fantastic. We felt like royals the way they treated us. The night we had dinner there the sky was beautiful and we took many photos!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Silverswisstracksuit
Title: Delicious food, great cat
Review: We went here for a quick lunch and were delighted with the great food, friendly service and the wonderful resident cat, Domino. Domino curled up on my lap for all of my lunch and was so incredibly sweet he made the trip! The Mojitos were delicious and the noodle plates we had were very good. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ShanghaiGoughs
Title: Great views, good food but not convinced on the VFM
Review: We ate here one evening. Had been raining so ate inside vs on the beach, although it cleared to reveal an amazing sunset.Soft Shell Crab starter was delicious and my wife's Beef Rendang was also very good. My cod was so-so and so was the chocolate caramel dessert.Would stick to their recommendations on the signature dishes. Overall the most expensive meal on the Island and yet not the best (see my review on Priveledge, which does not match the views and ambience but beats on food and VFM).Service was good but had to correct overcharge on bill and felt that all the staff were a bit too in your face.But there are limited high ends on the Island and if you choose wisely then should still be on your list - especially on a good sunset day!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ipOi TBogor, Indonesia
Title: Simply beautiful for cocktails sunset
Review: Located in one of the best hotel in Langkawi, the view of sunset is amazing, make sure you book in advance and ask for table on the beach. The food and drinks are excellent, coctails also. If you enjoy coffee u should try their flat white, and their service is the best so far, all of their staff is very caring including the manager also, they always ask about the food, drinks. well done !Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AlexanderA617Moscow, Russia
Title: The best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: We stayed in Casa del Mar hotel and did not miss a chance to eat at their beach restaurant. Though we usually avoid "hotel restaurants" due to higher prices and lower food level compared to restaurants in the resort areas but this one was outstanding. You shall have a table on the beach or on the open air terrace with see view and be served by very professional, friendly and helpful staff. The menu and courses are quite special and very delicious remaining reasonbly priced. We tried the most interesting to us postions in menu: tuna tartar, Thai soup, Malay testing plate, risotto, Australian steak, deserts...and everything was great. Total cost of dinner with drinks was about 40- 45 USD per person. One thing we did not like: we waited for main corse for over 30 minutes.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: VincentChaseUSA
Title: Wonderful way to spend an evening
Review: Located on the beach front, try to go at sunset for a breathtaking view. All the food is really excellent from the bread they provide to the tea/coffee. Portions are very large so come hungry and all dishes are very well designed a d taste exceptional. The 3 course meal for 120 MYR is good value when compared to the 5* hotels on the island. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Efthymi0sKStockholm, Sweden
Title: A magic dinner
Review: We had a magic dinner with my wife in La Sal few days ago.I do not remember exactly the names of the dishes but for first course we had the famous specialty with the fried prawns and the avocado-mango salsa. Then for main course we had fish (my wife) and the mixed plate for my self (which includes chicken, beef, prawns and shrimps with 2 different sauces and 2 salads if i remember well). Finally for dessert we had the two most famous , the chocolate tart and the chocolate filled brownie. We also had coconut juice (real coconut cleaned and server cold). Everything was really tasty and good but the first course is the best we ever had in any restaurant around the world. We already miss it!From the very first moment the personnel was really nice friendly and helpful. They explained everything to us and they helped us choose our food. Btw there is a good offer , for 120 RM you can have any 1st course, any main course and any dessert.Especially 2 guys, one with glasses ( I am really really sorry that I do not remember your name) and Pat they are amazing. It is a privilege for any hotel to have employees like them. I am sure that their manager will give them all the praise they deserve.The restaurant is very clean, the atmosphere is magic, the music, the lights everything is wonderful. You can sit by the beach under the coconut trees admiring the sunset but there is always some backup in case of bad weather.With my wife we decided that we will stay in Casa del Mar next time that we will visit Langkawi.Thank you for the magic dinner Casa del Mar!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TTB75Brisbane, Australia
Title: Magical
Review: Beautiful setting, menu options and value. So many menu options - hard to choose but ask the staff for a recommendation - you can't go wrong. We dined one night and had to return the next night it was so good and such great value for a hotel (we were also staying at the Hotel). The tasing platter is a MUST! and the prawn entree!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ben_Jenkins1
Title: Good food, great views and top service!
Review: My wife and I saw the good reviews on trip advosor and a couple we met also recommended it.We were not disappointed. It is a bit more expensive than some of the local restaurants, but with very good reason. The food is a league above the others we have tried. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: admin37
Title: not as good as we thought
Review: we had high hopes for this place but the food was only average and the service was slow to the point we had to shout to get noticed at times
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ruben1951
Title: Scrumptious
Review: The perfect mix of european and asian food to be found here in this small paradise called Casa del Mar
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ai-VernKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
