Title: Excellent food and atmosphere!
Review: Food is excellent! The scenery is amazing, food is delicious and portions are decent. The ceaser salad with prawns is a must try! Went there with my gf on our first trip together, and it is an absolutely perfect place for a slow romantic date. Only problem is that mosquitoes can be a problem.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NeeNee_ChoPenang
Title: Candle light dinner on the beach
Review: We booked the table for dinner before sunset, it was a windy evening. Watching sunset at the beach, with the sound of the waves and having our foot on the sands. When the sun goes down, the candle light up. Slow pace and relaxing dinner with great food. There is no place else can beat this special candle light dinner experience so far for me. Last but not least, if you plan to go, please make sure you make your reservation earlier especially during weekends and holiday season.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: dianep195253Perth, Australia
Title: the whole package
Review: my husband and i have just returned from CASA DEL MAR last week 28th August 2012What can i say it was outstanding ,from the little extras in your rooms to the staff nothing was to much trouble.It was our 30th wedding anniversary we celebrated with La Luna a romanticdinner on the beach the food the wines the service outstanding.We have never had a more relazing holiday.Cant wait for next year we are heading back ,the family as well.All i can say if you want a fantastic holiday in a small boutique hotel theres only one place Casa Del Mar langkawi DianeShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dina HAdelaide, Australia
Title: AMAZING!
Review: Wonderful restaurant, great food, absolutely magnificient service! My husband and I stayed at Casa Del Mar for our honeymoon and we were not disappointed. We tried almost everything on the menu and it was delicious! They even gave us a complimentary bottle of wine, which was very sweet of them. It is the small touches that count, and they are the best at that. Much recommended. Can't wait to go back!Dina and Rami HaifawiShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cadet137Sydney, Australia
Title: Really Special Place
Review: We were celebrating my Wife's birthday at the La Luna Restaurant right by the seaside with a 7 course menu accompanied by the matching wines and champagne, it was a night to remember, the food, the sunset, the romance in the air, was a spectacular night!Special Thanks to Robert Khor - Restaurant Manager who went an extra mile to organise a CD player and a power for us as I brought my wife's favourite music collection CD and also our dedicated waiter Pat who looks after us very well.Would highly reccommend the La Luna to everyone who wants an unforgettable romantic and culinary experience, many thanks from Mark and Angela from Sydney, Australia.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: stki
Title: Excellent
Review: We stayed at the hotel & ate at the restaurant every 2nd night. Great food & location was perfect-right on the beach
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: fuenu0111
Title: Nice enviroment & delicious meal
Review: romantic, nice environment,just at the sea side.. enjoyed the dinner there, food are delicious..especially the desserts.. try Affogato al Cafe w. Espresso, Frangelico, Vanilla Bean Ice Cream & Biscotti!! my favourite dessert..
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Mara3004
Title: Love this place
Review: The food at this restuarant is fantastic.  Breakfast, bar menu and dinner was tasty and nothing is too much to ask for.  All the little touches make this a wonderful place to dine.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: WorksOnly2TravelPerth, Australia
Title: Great spot for lunch
Review: I wasn't staying at the Casa del Mar, but after a jetskiing tour on the beach was looking for somewhere to have lunch.My boyfriend and I grabbed a table under the shade and ordered the fish and chips, water and some mocktails. The food was fantastic - huge pieces of fish, plenty of fried and a serve of salad. While it may be pricy compared to other food in the area, it was worth it! The mocktails were amazing - we were parched after 4 hours on the ocean, and they hit the spot.The staff were attentive and polite.The location was gorgeous, the pool looked inviting and the beach just meters away!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: isa1953
Title: so romantic and fine dining
Review: the food quality equals fine dining in europe but for 1/4 of the price. Pleasant waiters, great location (you can reservation on the beach)
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: esalmin
Title: good reataurant on the beach
Review: Located on the beach (tables right on the sand).  Very romantic atmosphere, food is restaurant level for restaurant price. Good for romatic dinner. For "just to eat" choose less expensive.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: travellingsal
Title: beachside bliss
Review: As long as the weather hols, this is a lovely romantic spot to have dinner. Food portions are a little on the small side but are delicious and the vibe is very relaxed and intimate. Staff are wonderfully helpful yet unobtrusive.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Louise J
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing food, amazing sunset, service very very good - recommend this restaurant - it was our friends birthday and the waiters arranged a surprise cake and cocktails to add to the occasion. Definitely recommend.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KerryScouseKellySydney, Australia
Title: Beautiful setting, tasty food and very friendly service
Review: We ate dinner at La Sal @ Casa del Mar yesterday evening and it was lovely. When we arrived it was quite busy and as we had not booked we thought we would have to try somewhere else. The staff were very chatty and friendly while the checked to see if a table was available and it was. The setting on the sand was very lovely indeed. My hubby ordered the soft shell crab for starters which he wolfed down, then the fish special for main which was also tasty but maybe a little on the small side. I had the beef rendang which was a very generous portion size with sides. The waiter explained the food and came over for a little banter and there were plenty of staff around to make sure our glasses we frequently topped up. We finished with the creme brûlée ...delicious. Well worth the visit for the setting alone.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Saudi01Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, bad service
Review: 5 of us ate here last night. The location is great, right on the beach. They had to set up our table so we went to the bar first. Cocktails were good, very original (the pineapple mojito was the best). Once seated the menu looked good and we ordered. I had the sample plate (shrimp, sea bass, beef rendang, chicken kapitan), my wife had the sea bass, and others had the rack of lamb and the chicken kapitan. I also ordered a chicken tikka appetizer. From here things took a turn for the worse as we must have waited nearly 45 min for the food, and then as has happened way too many times in Malaysia all the food came at once. Why is it called an appetizer if it come with your main???? The restaurant even has a '3 course set menu' deal, do they bring all three at once?Anyway, the food was good, my prawn and sea bass were the best, the beef rendang and chicken kapitan on the sample plate were tough, but the chicken kapitan full meal was very good so it's possible just the sample parts aren't as tender. The rack of lamb was good, but tiny. All in all the food is good, but not amazing and the service wasn't that greatShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Raymond-KIpoh
Title: Nice Restaurant with Beach Setting
Review: Food is good with reasonable portions, and it was set at the beach. Love this place, very relaxing, and good service from all staffs.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HannaKbrahmsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Incredible Dining Experience
Review: Dining in La Sal @ Casa Del Mar was one of the highlights of our family trip during our stay in July . We decided to dine there after much contemplation but it turned out to be one of the best decisions we made. We didn't have a reservation and had to wait a while to be seated but the staff were friendly and it was worth the wait as we were given a table on the beach. The ambience was excellent and the weather very much in our favor. The F&B Manager, Robert Khor was extremely helpful and very friendly. It was the good service provided by him and his staff as well as the quality of the food that made it a memorable dining experience.The mains are priced on average at RM 65 and we had a pitcher of Sangria priced at RM 75 which was reasonable. The Lamb and Australian Beef were recommended. All of our dishes were seasoned to perfection and delicious. It is advisable though to make a prior reservation as it is quite busy on most days. All in all, a wonderful and memorable dining experience. Highly recommended for those who expect quality from your food and excellent service during your dining experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Leesa2009Perth, Australia
Title: Beautiful food and exceptional service!
Review: This restaurant is on the beach and is so special. Eating dinner by candelight is very romantic. The food was spectacular! I thoroughly enjoyed the prawns and the cod fish. I would recommend the Malay tasting plate a great way to try local delicacies. Thanks so much to all the staff for three delicious meals!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KIWIKEITHNEW ZEALAND
Title: Pick a good night so you can dine on the beach.
Review: We cancelled our original booking because of thunderstorms and as we were staying at CDM waited to a fine night.As it turned out we picked the best night to go as the weather was no good after that.Unfortunately we never saw a perfect sunset but came close.The meal on the beach is what I felt made the whole experiance better than Privalage but the food was on par if not bigger portions.We both enjoyed our meal while watching the sun set.Lanterns were lit and shoes were off.If the weather does turn nasty on you there is still plenty of room in the dining room for a quick retreat.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nikola180
Title: Prefect if the weather is kind!
Review: During our 11 night stay we only ate on the beach one time because of the weather. We loved the food, service and sand under our feet and fully intended to return. However the rain and wind had other ideas.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Adnan W
Title: Great views
Review: This is a nice place to relax and enjoy thegood quality food.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gianluca_C77Leiden, The Netherlands
Title: Enjoying excellent dinner with feet in the sand
Review: Great restaurant, my favourite one in Langkawi. Food is very good, the service is superb, and the location is the top. Tables are set on the beach, very close to the sea. Soft illumination from candles completes the picture. You can also enjoy some nice cocktails before or after dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sophie B
Title: La Sal @Casa Del Mar - Excellent
Review: Wonderful spot right on the beach. Amazing food ! Extensive and well priced wine list. Highly recommend
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cookiemonster171Knutsford, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food but they need to vary the menu
Review: You definitely won't be disappointed at La Sal if you are staying elsewhere but if you're a resident the meals can become a little samey. 3 or 4 daily specials are sorely needed to stop you getting a little bored. The lunches are actually better than the dinners in a lot of respects. As with any CDM facility, the service is exquisite.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Joanne Lkuala lumpur
Title: relaxing and enjoyable!
Review: We decided to come here for sunset drinks since we heard rave reviews of the hotel. The restaurant is located on the beachside with a very beautiful view of the sea. It was very peaceful and tranquil although the price is quite steep compare to other places (not surprising considering how much effort put to make this place special). After we ordered 2 drinks, the service staff approached us telling us that we are entitled to 3 spins each on this wheel of fortune at the bar; just choose a colour prior to spinning and if the arrow lands on the chosen colour, the person will receive another similar drink for free! I won on my second try and immediately they pour me my free drink. After about 15-20 minutes later, the service staff approached us again saying that they will be spinning it this time. All we had to do was choose a colour. I won..again! but I gave the ‘prize’ to my mum which the service staff was more than willing to do so. It was a great experience not just because of the free drinks but the staff are so easy going and happy with their work which makes the visit albeit a short one memorable. Definitely will think of staying here the next time I visit langkawi. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Anna RWoking, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food and atmosphere
Review: We came here once for lunch and once for dinner and loved it both times. The dinner was fantastic- tables on the beach with flamed torches and lights everywhere. Very beautiful setting and the staff were lovely. The food was a bit more pricey than other places, but definitely worth it since it was fresh, good portion sizes and an all round perfect experience. Also had a spiced pineapple mojito that was delicious. The lunch menu is delicious and fresh, and the roasted vegetable and pesto fettucine was fab.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Melissalouise74
Title: Overrated
Review: Small portions, sloppy presentation. Excellent service and perfect location.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Baz853Leigh on Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Incorrect price guide
Review: The price paid was 120MYR (£27) per head for set menu wine not inclued. Bad wheather, so we could not sit outside. Staff friendly. surrounding OK. You had pay more because of the look the place, we found other restuarant near by just as good food quality.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Paul TBrisbane
Title: The food is so good you don't want to eat anywhere else
Review: We were staying at the CDM and had 3 meals at La Sal. one was the 7 course La Luna special.There is no doubt that this restaurant has a great chef accompanied by wonderful front of house staff. The food options are wide and you can choose from Malayan samplers to Aussie beef.Out of the 26 courses we ate during our 3 visits, there was not one bad course to be had. If you are on the island and want a treat, book a table at La Sal, try for a calm day and the beach side tables are fantastic.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 16Kerry
Title: A great chef
Review: Dinner on the beach. Fine dining. Wonderful.Good value. Could only ever manage the main course as servings very generous.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Lucy CAlbury, Australia
Title: Good coffee
Review: Was nice to get a flat white coffee and the chairs were comfortable but compared to the rest of Malaysia, it was very expensive - $12AUD for 2 coffees.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 3leggedplatypusNew Zealand
Title: Great way to start the day and end it.
Review: My partner and I did not stay here but what an amazing place!! We started our morning every day here with a fruit drink and a coffee. One of the only places outside of Australia and New Zealand that make flat whites. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly! They provide amazing service!! The cocktails are to die for. Fantastic mixologists. I wish we could have eaten there but I obtain a terrible case of food poisoning from another place nearby, which did not allow me to enjoy the items on their fantastic menu.I would go back to Langkawi to stay and eat here. Well done!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: margaret076Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: European Food if you want it
Review: Great food and European choices. The Malaysian dishes were superb and the environment what you would expect from a good quality hotel. Would recomend this for a romantic night out except possibly around 7pm on a Tuesday when there is a get together at the bar.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Beckstar25Melbourne
Title: A lovely night on the beach
Review: We had a really lovely dinner on the beach at the restaurant at casa del mar. The food was lovely and they had a great range of Australian and European wines to choose from. The ambience was amazing and the staff were really friendly. I would highly recommend! Avg main meal was about $70MYR, you could get a 3 course meal for $120MYRShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Catherine HSydney, Australia
Title: Wonderful!!
Review: My husband and I just loved the Casa del Mar's La Sal restaurant. The food was amazing - all the ingredients were really fresh. The service was also great. The staff were really friendly, helpful and we never had to ask for anything. It was so nice to have dinner on the beach watching the sunset in the distance with sand between our toes. The price is obviously significantly higher than many of the other restaurants along the main strip of Pantai Cenang, but it is definitely worthwhile eating there at least once during your stay.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BrettpocockBrooklyn Park, Australia
Title: Service poor food average
Review: Went last night for dinner the main course was very good, I had the duck with green pea risotto, which had some really good flavours. The let downs came with the service, we had to continually ask for more drinks, no one offered us coffee or desert, they didn't even ask how our meal was. We ordered the cheese plate for desert which was woeful, the double Bree was actually off and smelt disgusting! Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BarryT47Basingstoke, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful choice of food
Review: Not only is there a wonderful choice of food there are plenty of gluten-free options for any coeliacs and these are clearly marked on the menu.The service is great and being able to sit at a table that is actually on the beach was wonderful.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CarmenR61
Title: Dinner with friends
Review: barefoot on the beach..how perfect. Wine list was great.  Food and service was great. Equally as good as Nam at Bon Ton
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LushAni
Title: Great food and gorgeous location
Review: We had dinner on the beach, it was magical and the food was delicious.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Moochop24
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: Stayed at CDM and ate here several times.  See hotel review for further details.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: relaxa18
Title: great little bar
Review: nice friendly staff, clean great drinks. Mr mood was very friendly
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: IntlnabersIndianapolis, Indiana
Title: Stunning- both the view as well as the cuisine!
Review: La Sal is located in the Casa Del Mar boutique hotel. Um wow. We want to stay here next time. Absolutely stunning views from the tables perched in the sand at the beach and even better food….we dined on calamari, seared Ahi tuna, and the Malaysian platter of favorites…plus we toasted to Cinco de Mayo with a margarita:). We finished off our meal with the most amazing warm molten lava cake….heavenly!! What a romantic evening out!www.internationalnabers.comShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: wudz24Singapore, null, Singapore
Title: One of the best in Langkawi!!!
Review: We went here straight from the airport. As check-in starts after 3.00pm at our hotel so we decided to grab some lunch here because I've read some rave reviews about this restaurant. And true enough we weren't disappointed. Food was exceptionally good and staff were friendly. The view is great but I bet is better during sunset. Food is a bit pricey but well worth it. Dining here is a must when you visit Langkawi. You won't be disappointed, we weren't!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: easysides
Title: Best in Pantai Cenang
Review: Lovely restaurant, good food, nice view of the sunet from our table on the beach and the staff are exceptionally friendly.  Good value for money.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TheMuchasBrisbane, Australia
Title: Can't go past this dinning experience
Review: 2 words... BEEF RENDANG. ok i said it. La Sal is the perfect dinning experience on the island. The views match the food, simply perfect with all the small things which ensure your dinning experience one to remember. We did venture out to Privilege Restaurant & Bar 1 night yet left disappointed with atmosphere. (Only 2 tables were being used at the same time). I can see what they are trying to achieve but it simply does not fit with the island surroundings and the food at times was overworked. Don't change a thing La Sal, you are No1.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FeildingTraceyFeilding
Title: Fabulous Food and Staff
Review: We ate at the restauraunt every night, the food was so good we didnt want to be disappointed by going elsewhere.Breakfast had a great selection of cereals, yoghurt, bread and pastries, also the cooked menu has a great selection. Freshly squeezed orange juice and lattes to die for.The service is 1st class, well done to the staff of Casa del Mar.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ScarletPerthPerth
Title: Beautiful Food, Great Choice and Value
Review: Arrived without booking but easily accommodated on Sat night. Sat outside on sandy beach looking at the beautiful sunset but quickly hurried inside (under sufference) due to looming black clouds which turned out to be nothing in the end. Anyways, ambience not as nice inside but food was great ... S$150 for 2 starters, 4 mains, 3 cocktails... Pretty good value. Would go back for sure. Staff very pleasant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ScotgalAustraliaAustralia
Title: Will return again and again
Review: Once again we enjoyed a fantastic meal at La Sal. Sitting watching the sunset with a CDM cocktail in hand, and feet in the lovely white sands you are in paradise.This was probably the best meal that we had whilst in Langkawi. The whole meal was delicious but the Rack of Lamb and the Beef Rendang - highly recommended by Robert the F&B manager were just perfect. The presentation is superb and just by looking at the plate you know it is going to be a delightful experience.Thank you to the lovely staff, especially Azura and Adilla - your smiles are amazing.We did not stay at CDM this trip as they were fully booked - but we will be next year, see you then.Keep up the excellent work - the refurbishment looks really good.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sarah M
Title: Delicious
Review: Food is very nice, breakfast, lunch and dinner.  We did the La Luna arrangement and wow, what a nice experience!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: dsykes65Perth, Australia
Title: Excellent Food and Service
Review: We stayed at the Casa Del Mar for 9 nights and had some lovely meals at La Sal Restaurant. They have a good selection of food, the quality of which was extremely good. The setting on the beach is lovely, specially if you are there for sunset.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Carmelo G
Title: beautiful
Review:
The restaurant was excellent and the meals have very fine taste.
At the beach bar are fine cocktails.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: C1945
Title: upmarket.
Review: As you would imagine very upmarket, staff attentive meal lovely. This is for special occasions.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: minghuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: good light lunch, cocktails.
Review: went there at about 5pm on a saturday evening, hoping to catch the sunset. however, was told that sunset was between 7pm to 7.15pm. staff was very friendly and quickly showed us to a table. the tables by the beach were fully booked for the evening. ordered a grilled white snapper (MYR$42) from the LUNCH menu. i must say it had the best potatoes ever! and the snapper was good as well. food was slightly oily though, hopefully it's olive oil. the prawn salad (MYR$40) that my partner ordered was not fantastic though. we didn't like the fruit in it. we also had cocktails. the restaurant has a large variety of cocktails to choose from, and they are rather unique as well, which i really love. i ordered a mixed berry caprihina (MYR$25). i really loved it. alcohol content was slightly high, but there were real fruits in it, extremely value for money. staff at the bar were also very welcoming and friendly, engaging the guests constantly.i'll hope to visit this place again, for drinks and dessert next time!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shane BHervey Bay
Title: Nice, but nothing to rave about.
Review: We chose this restaurant following the ratings and comments on trip adviser. It was our last night and we were looking for something special. We made a prior reservation but when we arrived we found that there was a communication problem and our reservation was not listed. They managed to accomodate us, though we were left standing for 10 minutes whilst our table was organised. We could have been taking to the bar for a drink whilst this was happening. Service was ok and it certainly is a more upmarket establishment. Meals were of good portion and taste. The beach setting looks fantastic however a late afternoon storm meant our tables were off the beach and back inside the resort.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: carolinegourriLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent. Excellent food, excellent service, excellent location. Excellent.
Review: We dined at La Sal twice on our vacation. We had been advised to go by friends and had such a wonderful time that we decided to go a second time to celebrate my husband's birthday. We were not disappointed.. Robert made us feel so welcome. The food was amazing (both times) and the staff fantastic. Robert went to a lot of trouble to make sure my husband's birthday dinner was really memorable. Not only did the staff sing him happy birthday, we were given champagne and the most wonderful deserts! We loved our two visits to La Sal and would 100% recomend that everyone who visits Langkawi eats at this restaurant at least once. Dining on the beautiful beach was amazing. We weren't staying at the hotel but we were made to feel so welcome. Simply wonderful.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: elnha
Title: Good food
Review: Nice layout and romantic view. Best dining experience during breakfast and dinner. Wide selection of western dishes and Malaysian cuisines.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Margo05
Title: Beach Setting
Review: Beach dining with beautiful sunset, and wonderful food.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Bernie D
Title: Best place in Langkawi
Review: You cant find a better place on the island. Must be experienced to be believed!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ddfoodlover
Title: Great dining on the sand
Review: Great place to have a romantic dinner on the beach and watch the sunset.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pinkynperkydoncaster uk
Title: Hotel food never been better
Review: We visited whilst staying at the berjaya on the opinion of ratings,and once again,delighted.To be honest,we arrived in the dark in front of an ordinary looking,small frontage looking hotel,but,after being led through reception,we were delighted to see a lovelly outdoor decked area,tastefull and intimate.staff were very attentive and even though we hadnt booked,made us feel very welcome.very good choice of menu with presentation 10/10.A must visit if you are lucky to visit.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SirMrMits
Title: Decent Grub!
Review: Excellent food especially in terms of the freshness, only downside was the waiting time!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: L0uiseAndNeilWinchester, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful setting, quality food
Review: Went for dinner at casa del mar. We weren't staying at the hotel but it didn't matter-the staff were very welcoming. Ate on the beach watching the sun set-very romantic! Delicious food. Priced as would expect in the uk-which is why I rate this 4star in comparison to privilege restaurant which manages the same, if not slightly better for a much cheaper price!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Didine8279Paris, France
Title: FABULOUS!!!!
Review: This place is magic!!! The hotel and bar are beautiful. People are really nice, helping, and caring. The cocktail are fabulous!!! Ask Moon about his banana daiquiri: you won t forget it!!! And you mustn't live the place without trying their beef!!! Either the renddang or the western are delicious!!! the first is spicy but not hot, really surprising. and the western just melt in your mouth.... A really great moment that just make you want to come back again.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: I-do-love-travelling
Title: Lovely ambience on the beach
Review: Very nice location for dinner - on the beach as the sun sets. The food is nice, though a little expensive, but great choice for a special meal
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ericcwh
Title: Haven for dessert
Review: Its a fine dining restaurant hence the price is expensive. However the deserts chocolate pudding and vanilla caramelized pistachio ice cream is heavenly. If you think to have a full course dinner is to pricey, just have the dessert. You will not regret it.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Beamer23Perth, Australia
Title: Top quality, excellent menu
Review: Wait staff possibly need a little more training as attention seemed to be lacking most of the time (I was a bit tired of having to attract someone's attention every time I needed something)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JenW1080Cheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful setting; superb food; fantastic service.
Review: I treated my mother to a stay at Casa Del Mar and we ate in the superb restaurant, La Sal, four times. The setting was stunning; to dine on a beautiful beach as the sun set is something we'll never forget. The tables were nicely spaced and the staff were attentive and friendly, without being intrusive. There was a good choice between Western and Asian food and an extensive drinks list. Every meal was a tasty delight and the portions were generous. I hope to return!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Warren CLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and Variety
Review: We Stayed at Casa del Mar, during our honeymoon to Langkawi so ate at the restaurant quite a lot. The variety of food was very good it was always served quickly and the quality was always high. Definitely worth eating here even if your aren't staying at the hotelShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TVRNzNZ
Title: Best bar in Langkawi
Review: I admit I'm biased as I stayed at the hotel but Jack and Mood make the best cocktails on the island! Even if you don't get a chance to eat here it is definitely worth popping in for a drink. We ate at the hotel a couple of times as well and most of the food was very good. We did have the lamb dish which I found tasted very strange and not at all what NZ lamb typically tastes like, but other dishes were delicious. The seared tuna was particularly good and I would also recommend the tapas platter which was a nice taster of some Malaysian specialties. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: cookieinc
Title: Great
Review: Beautiful and delicious food, ate here on numerous occasions.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: staminazSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best service, great service, friendly staff
Review: Had dinner today here. The food was ok, we expected more because of the good reviews. However the service was great! We had dinner on the beach with sunset view and the host Robert is great! Make sure to make a reservation first. Try the cheese cake which has a good solid bite and not too sweet. The staff is the best a lot better than were we stayed(Berjaya)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: florakaty
Title: Delicious
Review: Beautifully presented and delicious.  Ask for your table to be on the beach, it is a magical experience
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Becky SMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best Steak
Review: Sitting on the beach, by the glow of a lamp, it was a scenic way to eat a meal. The Aussie beef fillet is hands down, the best meal I have ever had. The meat was delicious, melting in your mouth. They had plenty of Malaysian dish as well.The service was great, friendly and quick.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: James GBrisbane, Queensland, Australia
Title: Fantastic
Review: Valentines day and deciding to go to cenang for the first time coming from the westin was a risky choice.... it wasn't looking romantic until we stumbled across Casa Del Mar at the end of the road! The meal was spectacular being the best Malaysian Platter I had in Malaysia and the service was perfect!! Definitely recommend and saved my valentines day! Thanks Guys!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ian B
Title: Beach Dinning
Review: Dinning under the stars with cool sea breezes, makes this a very pleasurable experience.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LLAKTravelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Sand between your toes and a smile on your face = special dining option!
Review: We travelled from one side of the island to the other after a work colleague had recommended dining here.......I must thank her when I get back!! Most of the restaurants tables are located on the beach as you enter via the hotel Casa del Mar's lobby. Lanterns strung between the trees escort you down past the beach bar and onto the sand where we got the final glimpses of a sunset. The menu is extensive and has a good blend of local and international dishes to cater for all tastes. In addition there were about 8-10 kids options. We managed our pre dinner drinks and entrees before the weather closed in and the dark clouds meant we had to conclude our meal inside but this took nothing away from the atmosphere and relaxed vibe that Robert and his team had created on the night. The cost was about 350 RM for 2 adults/2kids - 2 courses/bottle of wine/desserts for kids/pre dinner drink. All in all a thoroughly enjoyable,tasty and atmospheric night on the beach.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jenn2778
Title: Eat here!
Review: Awesome food, beautiful view sitting on the beach by candlelight
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Linklater
Title: Wonderful and beautiful
Review:
As we came outon the beach, there was sunset, and the tables were beautifully laid. The service was excellent, as was the food.
It was an uforgettable experience, very romantic and magic. Hope I can return one day.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Deborah D
Title: Sophisticated Food
Review: Excellent, grown up food on the beach. Beautifully presented, great quality, impressive wine list.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: EllieOlliBrisbane, Australia
Title: Gorgeous setting and food to match
Review: Thes best resort on Langkawi- Casa Del Mar- has the restaurant with the best view and atmoshere in the world! Set on the beach- literally in the sand- under palm trees with the gentle sounds of the ocean only metres away-it's a romantic dining experience you'll never forget. Wonderful food with exquisit presentation - this is five star elegance (mind you with a price tag that reflects this only by local island standards) But to all who travel far and wide to this idyllic place, the price is actually very affordable. Well worth it!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BERYEAM
Title: Excellent quality of food and the 'wow' ambience! :)
Review: Love the setting and food but the price is a little steep for Malaysian.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: IanLove
Title: Fabulous
Review: We went here twice during our stay and it was without doubt the best restaurant we visited. The food is superb the location beautiful and the staff extemely friendly and efficient. Try the rack of lamb or the tuna you will not be disappointed.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LittleLadyTravellerUpminster, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food
Review: We ate here one night, sitting on the beach candle light all around was a lovely atmosphere with the sun setting in the distance.The service was a little slow but once you got the attention of the staff they were brilliant, just a little busy. There are about 20 tables so its not over crowded.Lovely food, atmosphere & good drinks selection - this looked like a lovely hotel for adults - gorgeous pool and lovely hotel (no sign of kids anywhere hence grown up hotel) - a lovely boutiquey hotelShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ACHIA_69Singapore
Title: Mi Casa Su Casa Indeed
Review: Went to the restaurant 3 times. The first time we had dinner on the beach and enjoyed a bit of drinks before and after the meal. Initially I was not quite sure as they were struggling to find our reservation as the reservation book went missing. The young staff left us hanging about for around 5 mins before a more senior server sat us down while they hunt for the reservation book.We were finally sat at our assigned table and could enjoy our pre-dinner drinks to enjoy the sunset. Food was great but be warned that the portions are huge for us. good thing we stuck to mains or we would have struggled. Both of us had the local fare - Ayam bakar and Beef Rendang for our mains. Most of the time, service was efficient and unobtrusive. Some mild annoyance was very loud conversation between the restaurant manager with a chinese couple across from our table which sets the ambiance back a bit. When he came across, he just assumed that we were chinese nationals as well and insisted on speaking loud mandarin to us. When told that we do not speak mandarin (well my husband doesn't speak any), he seemed to be a bit taken back. Despite all, we did stay on for more drinks and wine and moved on to the bar to relax. All in all, we really enjoyed the experience, food and ambiance. So much so that we went back for lunch the next day before we went to the spa for treatment and ended up in the bar again after dinner at another placeDefinitely highly recommended for the place for good sunset view (reservations definitely recommended and ask for the front row tables to watch the sunset). Food is great but bear in mind the big portions for dinner. Worthwhile to be here slightly before sunset and a few cocktailsShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Farisai82
Title: Yummie
Review: Very good food with feed in the sand -what could be better!?
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JitenS_12Mumbai, India
Title: Romantic ! Romantic ! Romantic !
Review: The setting just blew us away. The service was nice and the Sangria nicer.Ordered just the main course and dessert and both the courses were fantastic. Both the sea bass and salmon in the main course were perfectly made with just great flavour.The panacotta, although a small portion was beautifully made.Will come back if we make it back to Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: cheesebunKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place, food and service
Review: My bf made a dinner reservation here to celebrate my birthday and a table were prepared for us by the beach. The food was delicious and we really enjoyed our dining experience there. The staff was friendly and attentive to us. The most surprising thing was by the end of our dinner, they brought a complimentary dessert and on the plate, it was written "Happy Birthday". That was really sweet and thoughtful. It may be a small gesture but I really appreciate it and it made my day :) Thank you so much. We hope to return here soon and hopefully we will get to stay here next time.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ub44
Title: Nice
Review: Good fish and fast service, location is also great on top of the beach
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mariah001Marlow, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional food, team , setting and night!
Review: My husband Michael and I came to stay with you for 11 nights over New Year. We saw the reviews on Trip Advisor and they helped us make a decision about staying. We were not disappointed and have now also written a review too. However, we are very aware that the people who get many mentions are front of house and that behind these people there is an exceptional team making it all happen seemlessly day after day and night after night. We did see you all on New Years eve and it made us realise just how many of you work so hard to make every guests stay so memorable. So, a big thank you to all the boys and girls that we don't see and don't get named but make every bit as much of a contribution to a truly wonderful experience. We hope to see you again this year. Have a wonderful 2012 and see you all again soonHelen and Michael CawthraShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: François GMarina del Rey, California
Title: Great foods, great service, great place!
Review: La Sal restaurant is just an amazing place by the Sea in Langkawi!We stayed with my wife in this hotel for 10 nights and we had 4 dinners and 6-7 lunches.The Hôtel is just fantastic, the rooms. the cleaness, people, this is a charming small hotel with the service of 5 star!About La Sal restaurant, this is the same comments!The quality of the food in outstanding!I definitely recommand this hotel&restaurantShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DianeEaston001
Title: Exquisite Dining
Review: Beautifully presented dishes, attentive staff, flavours of the food truly wonderful
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sarah HMelbourne
Title: Loved it so much we kept going back!
Review: We ate at this restarant one night and loved it so much we ended up eating there 3 nights out of the 11 that we were there. The food was fabulous and you cannot go past the location. The view is amazing because you sit and watch the sun set while sitting on the beach. On our last night there the wait staff had got to know us and make up some celebration cocktails for us (a couple of which were complementary) which was great. Would recommend this to anyone looking for a nice night out in Langkawi. The prices are expensive by Malaysian standards but only about $10-$20 Australian for a main meal which is really reasonable (especially considering the location).Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: oli82uk
Title: Amazing beach dining experience
Review:
Book early and you get the best view in the house. On the beach viewing a super sunset, with great hospitality and super tasty food.

Good value for money in our opinion for a romantic meal.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Dickabit
Title: Eat on the beach
Review: good food and can be eaten by the beach while you people watch
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MAFCHenley
Title: Superb food
Review: We stayed at the hotel and decided to give the restaurant a go and weren't disappointed. The food was great with a wide choice of both Western and more local dishes. There is a great selection of wines and the service is great.The tables are on the beach and it is definitely fine dining. The food is not at the cheaper end of the scale but it is fine value for what you get.It was so nice that we decided to have our last night there and were not disappointed.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Resh_8Klang, Malaysia
Title: Romantic beach setting
Review: Made a reservation for a dinner in the gazebo for my husband's surprise birthday treat...was truly fascinating...they set up the gazebo and we had a wonderful 4 hr dinner in a romantic setting....and when it started raining a little and all other guests needed to be shifted indoors, I was glad that I booked the gazebo and didnt ruin his bday dinner at all....food was awesome and the choc pudding was brought to the table by a friendly lady singing 'Happy Birthday' gave a wonderful finishing touch....will definitely go again.....Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TeroLehtoEspoo, Finland
Title: Great food, reasonable prices for fine dining
Review: La Sal was our favourite restaurant in Langkawi, so we ate there twice, even though we usually look for a new place every night.I enjoyed their fried prawns, tuna and fresh fish. I also tasted their prawns with a chili sauce, some chicken and some other tapas with a Malaysian favour.The service was professional, and this was one of the few places where would bring our starters and main courses correctly at the same time for all of us five persons. They also had a better wine list than other restaurants we tried during those nine days we stayed in Langkawi. The restaurant has an amazing location at the beach, and you can watch the beautiful sunset if you go there before 7:30 PM.La Sal is more expensive than local restaurants, but I had two courses of meal, a drink and some wine (2/5 share of two bottles of Australian red wine) for about 200 MYR (about 50 EUR).This was closest to fine dining we had in Langkawi, so I find the prices were reasonable enough.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: HellbraunWalchwil, Switzerland
Title: Excellent, Excellent, Excellent
Review: The food was superb and the fact that it was reasonable price made it even more enjoyable. Both for dinner and lunch. The staff was always helpful and tentative. For dinner we tried several dishes - one was a local beef dish our waiter's suggested, which was to die for and another the Australan beef steak with chive mashed potatoes, which just melted in our mouths. Even the kids menu met the approval of our 6 year old daughter. The size of the dishes will not disappoint even the heartiess of eaters. The drinks selections and prices are good too. And eating on the beach is so romantic. Also nice was that you could come casually dressed or as smart as you wanted without feeling uncomfortable or being treated unequally.For lunch the selection is brillant too. You can't go wrong at this restaurant at any time of day.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: RockWindWater
Title: A great place to enjoy a drink while looking out to the beach
Review:
Amazing outlook onto the beach with crystal blue waters and the tropical backdrop of coconut trees.
The sorbet very yummy.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mercier11
Title: Excellent food
Review: The presentation of the food is very beautiful. We always enjoyed lunch and dinner ar La Sal. If you make reservation you get the best seats at the beach :-)
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: travelistanr1
Title: Asian fusion or malaysian food : all delicious on the beach with fire-burning lights
Review:
Nice service - excellent selection from sophisticated Asian fusion to down to earth curries
Lovely, romantic location
pricier than simpler restaurants around but worth it
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gareth YSydney, New South Wales, Australia
Title: Fabulous setting on the sand
Review: We visited this restaurant after strolling past one night and loved it's ambience with tables on the sand lit by candles. In also then found it on Trip Advisor after looking for Top 10 restaurants in Langkawi. Best to book in advance to make sure you can be accommodated as there is only about 15 tables. Fantastic service, lovely and quiet and perfect for a romantic dinner looking out over the water. Cocktails are great. Menu is a combination of modern plus Malay. We went the Malay option and so glad we did. I had Beef Rendang which was huge and serviced on a giant round plate. My other half had the Sole fillet, which again was very testy. Service is good and helpful and the manager visited every table during the night. Entrees came quickly, however mains were almost too long (maybe 10 mins too long) and we were starting to feel like we needed to ask them to check up on it. We noticed three other tables peering around in the same manner. We also feel they did forget about filling water glasses or seeing if we would like another drink especially when we were waiting for our mains. As a restaurant owner, we would think that they would want to keep our glasses full by buying more drinks. But all in all, a lovely meal and not too expensive. We had 2 cocktails, 2 entree and 2 mains and it was just over 200Rgt.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: simonjynx
Title: Worth every cent
Review: perfect setting, perfect food, perfect service.  What more could you want.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hereandthere98
Title: Great service and good food
Review: Our meals were lovely but the service was superb - this is what sets it apart from other restaurants.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BerkshireNellReading, United Kingdom
Title: probably the best restaurant we visited in the whole 17 days
Review: and that included restaurants in Langkawi, Singapore and Koh Lipeh. A romantic beach setting, excellent service, really fabulous food, and a reasonably priced wine list (good choice to buy either by the glass or by the bottle)In fact, it was so good that we decided to go back again on our last night of the holiday - (not always a good idea to go back, as expectations are then very high, and it is easy to be disappointed) However, needless to say it was as good as the first visit - we would thoroughly recommend it - fine dining but in a relaxed casual setting. There are many cheaper places to eat in the area, but all in all, you definitely get what you pay for here.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tnbms162016
Title: Best meal we had in Langkawi
Review: Large portions of excellent Beef Rendang, at a table on the beach with the sea yards away. Friendly service.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SFLeonceMunich, Germany
Title: Outstanding food, service and location
Review: Recently stumbled upon Sal for lunch as we tried to escape the main street of Cenang and were absolutely impressed. The setting is amazing, directly along the beach and the grounds of the hotel are beautifully designed and maintained. The service has been amazing and so has been the food. We only went for a light lunch, so had salads (with large grilled shrimps, which were delicious) and Malay dishes, all of which tasted superb. The portion sizes were very adequate.As lunch had been great, we decided to come back for dinner and were not disappointed either. The setting at night with the lights was wonderful and very romantic. The food was creative, fresh and very well seasoned. We had lamb, steak, seafood - all of which was expertly prepared and tasted extremely good. We would definitely go back.Overall, the prices were not exactly low, similar to main European or US cities, but the quality and the setting were amazing. Highly recommend this restaurant.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Sacha S
Title: Simply amazing!
Review: An extensive range of exceptionally good european- and local-style food. Book a table for dinner right on the beach - sunset, candlelight, and the sound of cascading waves, it cannot get more romantic than this!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jenni N
Title: Breakfast
Review: Amazing breakfast, huge variety on the a la carte list
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gaye-tripIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Great !
Review: The atmosphere of the restaurant,the service was very very good. There was a plate that includes diffrent types of malay food is highly recommended. When you compare the prices wih other restaurants in Langkawi this one is a little higher but if you prefer to eat your meal in a very nice place then it is worth it. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: the2sues
Title: Romantic beach Dinner
Review: Seated at a table on the sand, lit by 'candle' light, excellent food and a free lightshow as a distant thunderstorm passed.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: karlamilneSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful restaurant
Review: La Sal restaurant at Casa del Mar was a surprise. I didn't expect it to be so wonderful. I usually like to go to a variety of local places for food when I travel and I started off doing this on my recent visit to Langkawi but after one lunch at La Sal I couldn't bring myself to leave the hotel for meals again. There were so many things on the menu that I wanted to try and I was not disappointed. The food was fresh and beautifully prepared and presented as well as delicious and of course it was a joy to eat it on the beach each night!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: roger_batten64LYMPSTONE
Title: Hotel Restaurant
Review: Hotel on bed and breakfast terms. Breakfast could be DIY, with a Bucks Fizz,or Bloody Mary. A wide range of cooked choices were available, all excellent, I prefered the local delicacies. The evening meals also 1st Class, could be taken Shirley Valentne style overlooking the Andaman Sea. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sarianne i
Title: Excellent food
Review:
Excellent food- western and asian and fusion kitchen. Liked the breakfast especially. Healthy options.

Asian food was so good: mee goreng and nasi goreng were delicious. 

Did not get one single bad portion of food during my trip.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Arcadi0DLas Palmas de Gran Canaria
Title: Amazing menu! Great staff!
Review: My wife and I spent few days in Casa del Mar and we enjoyed some meals at La Sal, one of the best restaurant we have ever been! The menu is amazing and the staff is really really kind, they make you feel very relaxed and comfortable.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: monper
Title: yum yum
Review:
yum yum
Costs extra, but worth every penny. Mainly ate lunch here. Thanks to the chef who gave us these wonderful memories. Beautiful views and surroundings. friendly service
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: roamieDoha, Qatar
Title: Not impressed!
Review: I had high hopes for this restaurant, given the reviews on trip advisor but I found the food to be mediocre, at best and certaonly overpriced. The spicey chips served with our drinks were stale and the Langkawi Tapas appetizer was a let down. The location and setting are picturesque and quite gorgeous but not worthy of an overpriced meal. Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AllieJon
Title: Great food
Review: All the food is fabulous and service excellent.  Dinning on the beach is very romantic.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Margaret7598
Title: Romantic beachside setting
Review: The best part of dinner in la Sal was the romantic beach setting, food was very good, we had the specials, sea bass and chicken curry. Great for a special occasion, there are other better-value, equally good food restaurants but few with the setting.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TravelWithBender
Title: Lucious, Lovely - Must eat here!
Review: On the beach watching the sunset... Where else would be better for our anniversary dinner and what a treat? The staff were friendly and attentive. They remembered our names and were prompt. The food was amazing. Its been a long time since I had such a special meal and all under $80 - entree, mains and dessert. For that quality you would usually pay plenty more, let alone the view and service. They surprised us with dessert bringing out chocolate sauce writing happy anniversary and a free ice-cream for me. If you are in Langkawi - GO! You will not regret it one bit! I know you think its alot of money, and we know. We spent $5 across the road on lunch for 2 people, but this is special and I will be going back for sure!Visit my blog http://erineatsthat.wordpress.com for more info!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TechnoProfHarrogate, United Kingdom
Title: A truly wonderful experience
Review: Having tried a few restaurants in Langkawi, this was without doubt the most refined, atmospheric and with best food. The beach setting is special as is the the service and genuine care and attention. Food style is Malaysian and fusion dishes with great creativity and flair. The choice of wines is excellent and a wide choice of cocktails.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KernowKid7London, United Kingdom
Title: What more can one add
Review: Well Casa Del Mar really doesn't need anymore glowing reviews but I'm going to give it one anyway.We stopped by for a meal on our final night on the beach and the experience couldn't have gone any better. As many have pointed out the managenment clearly take great pains over staff recruitment and training. Incredibly welcoming and personable.The tables are on the beach itself but there is a covered section should the thunderstorms roll in. I love a cocktail and it's always a good indication if they can make a good mojito which is a deceptivly hard drink to get just right. Well they must have been pretty good as I had three of them.I also had the fillet steak on the recomendation of another guest who'd stayed there and it's no exageration to say it was up there with anything I've had from the Gaucho Grill. Perfectly cooked and incredibly tender. Wonderful.My wife had the Sea Bass in blood orange glaze with med veg in mini tortillas which was also beautifully cooked . You can certainly eat for a lot less in Langkawi but you proably won't eat much better and four cocktails, a glass of wine and two mains for 250myr is still pretty cheap by London standardsShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Alpina_B3_LuxWincheringen, Germany
Title: Gorgeous setting, fantastic food
Review: We spent 6 days in Langkawi, and used each evening to visit another restaurant recommended by Tripadvisor. We really liked all of them - but the La Sal stood out even among such excellency. As we were staying in a hotel in Pantai Cenang, we walked there which is quite fun in the evening, as there are people everywhere and restaurants galore in any direction. We were greeted very friendly at the reception of the Casa del Mar (which also seemed to be a really nice place to stay) and were directed towards the restaurant. The best spots to have dinner are the tables placed directly on the beach - although you'll also have a nice view from further inside, the atmosphere is really best when you're close to the sea. The staff was friendly, enthusiastic and attentive, and the decoration of the tables simple but luxurious; in fact, if it were not for the exotic location, it could also have been a high-end European restaurant. We ordered a cocktail for starters while waiting for the food and enjoying the gentle sounds of the sea. The menu itself is well put together and has a lot of variety, with in particular excellent fish and seafood dishes. We went for a menu and loved every dish - the quality was really fantastic and had nothing to envy to really good restaurants that we are used to in Europe. We also had wine to accompany our dishes (a white wine from Australia which was really excellent) and immensely enjoyed the whole evening. Warmly recommended, in particular for couples who want to spend a nice romantic candle-light dinner at the beach!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JackT1957Assen, The Netherlands
Title: A place to enjoy great food
Review: During our stay at Casa del Mar for 6 nights in August, the staff managed to serve us superb meals all the time and it didn’t matter if it was breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner or anything else. The menu offered a great choice and the service was to the same high standard. As a guest you are able to thank staff in the restaurant personally but generally you do not meet their colleagues working in the kitchen. So especially a big thank you to the chef and his/her staff via Tripadvisor!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ConCon_82Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice dinner by the beach
Review: We were lucky that we went early enough as walk-in customer as most of the beach side table were booked. Although dinner started at 7pm we ordered cocktails and enjoyed the beautiful scenery while waiting for the food. We ordered grilled lamb rack and King Prawn risotto with Thai beef salad. Food was good and up to standard. Staff was polite and enthusiastic. Given this was our first trip to Langkawi, I would rate this the best dinner of the 4-day trip.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MariaS26Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Place for Special Occasions
Review: We had dinner at La Sal @ Casa del Mar. Food was good. Especially the Calamari and desserts. We had the chocolate pudding. Even though Trip Advisor indicates prices are between $10 - $20, look at spending quite a lot more - although the food is displayed with style and located again on the beach front. Atmosphere excellent.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JoaoCardosoFernandes
Title: Sand in your toes and great food to enjoy by the sea
Review:
You seat in the beach, with the sound of sea waves as background. Just perfect!

(You must reserve if not staying in the hotel, otherwise you can't find a seat...)
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KnurReykjavik, Iceland
Title: Fabulous!
Review: We recently stayed at Casa del Mar and ate at La Sal 3 times. The food was great and the atmosphere was wery romantic. The malaysian taste platter, beef steak and the chocolade cake were our favorites. When in Langkawi dont hesitate to eat at La Sal. While not cheap, La Sal is still wery affordable by western standards.We will definitely return one day.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: suemcnic
Title: Romantic setting and superb food
Review: Dining on the beach at night with wonderful food is an unforgettable experience at Le Sal. Highly recommended restaurant. Service is fantastic, menu innovative , mixture of modern with traditonal.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SlippasYorkshire
Title: A amazing experience
Review: We ate here on valentines night of our honeymoon. We didn't get the special honeymoon menu as that was a little too expensive for us, instead we ate from the usual menu. The food was great and we had a candlelit table on the beach. The staff were great and the whole experinece was amazing, I'll remeber it for the rest of my life.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Ochanz
Title: Best dessert ever!
Review: The food and cocktails are great...but what brought us back was the chocolate pudding! The best I have ever had! lol
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Louise RLondon
Title: Outstanding
Review: The restaurant at Casa del Mar is fantastic. The food is excellent, a really good mix of Malaysia and western dishes. They also have a lovely bar with great cocktails. We ate on the beach when it was dry and loved the views. The staff are exceptional, it was a friend's birthday one evening and they prepared a special desert for her and sent over sparkling wine which made the evening extra special! Without a doubt the best restaurant in Pantai CenangShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jason KFiji
Title: A must visit in Pantai Cenang
Review: This was an last minute decision to dine in La Sal and having been there before, we have to say that we had a very nice evening. Great food (particularly the Ayam Bakar & Scallop Risotto), good service (thank you Nordin and the team) and the ambience and location is hard to beat. The cocktails were as good as ever and very creative and interesting.Would recommend and go back again. Thank you for a very nice evening.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: stepheng456Nottingham
Title: Brilliant food
Review: We stayed at the Casa del Mar and ate in on a few occasions including every lunch time. Each time the food was just as tastey as it read on the menu. We had the moonlight meal on the beach which was a great night to remember!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Lynn D
Title: A romantic experience
Review: Delicious food at fair prices in an amazing setting.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JOH99Melbourne, Australia
Title: Absolutely beautiful
Review: I have just returned from a 2 week holiday in Langkawi with my mother and sister. During our stay, we dined at La Sal 3 times and each time was absolutely delicious. The service was fantastic, the wait staff are so friendly and always up for a chat. We had quite a few things on the menu and were never disappointed. The steak was incredible - a highlight during our time in Langkawi! Also the ayam bakar and beef rendang are delicious. The restaurant/bar itself is beautiful, very well designed and you can't beat having your feet in the sand over dinner watching the sunset. On our last night in Langkawi we decided to eat here and the waiters were kind enough to give us a couple of free drinks and make our night fabulous. It is slightly more expensive than other eateries in Langkawi but it's worth it and La Sal is considerably better than many places we've been to in Melbourne. Anyone staying in Langkawi must eat here, highly recommend it! We couldn't fault it. If any of the La Sal staff are reading this, thank you so much and keep up the great work :)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: john b
Title: The place to eat in Langkawi
Review: The menu is fairly comprehensive with a good variety of European and Malaysian styles.We could not fault the food either in quality or in presentation and would highly recommend this restaurant.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Thava_CSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Unforgettable experience!!!
Review: I planned a surprise birthday party for my friend. The entire team was so pro-active and helpful. We don't remember of having a wonderful dinner with such a beautiful atmosphere like this before at any timein recent memory. Thanks to the outstanding service we received.  Rest assured, we will be back again :))Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shurid FBrisbane, Australia
Title: food and atmosphere both were great
Review: my partner and I went there for lunch. the service was really prompt. I ordered a chicken dish which was great, specially the coriander flavor was awesome. overall, the food was great. A bit expensive compared to other options available in Langkawi, but definitely worth at least one visit.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Charlie-Ed
Title: AMAZING ****
Review:
Amazing food especially the meal of the day, we had fish one day lovely and then steak which I have to say is the best steak we have ever had!!

Amazing chef amazing staff beautiful hotel, gorgeous country what more could you ask for!!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: patatjeAlmere, The Netherlands
Title: Ambiance is amazing
Review: but the food is average. The ambiance is well worth it though. Employees are polite and provide good service. However, they need to brush up their wine knowledge. When we asked what white wine they would recommend, they told us `Cabernet Sauvignon´. This is definitely a special occasion place..the breeze, the sand, the torches make this restaurant unbeatable.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LoriK1710Melbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing Food, Staff & Location Best in Langkawi
Review: We stayed at Casa for two weeks and we had a package that allowed us 4 meals on the beach front by candle light. We ate at La Sal more than for just the 4 meals and we had only one bad night where both the steak and the chocolate pudding were lacking in quality compared to a previous nights and the staff lacked their normal attention to detail due to being very busy and under staffed. The menu choices are vast at first but when you stay for 14 days and are limited for places to eat it can get a little boring. The food overall is excellent quality comparative to what you get in a top Melbourne restaurant and you cannot beat the service (unless you go on an off night) and location.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: steveandlibbygrappenhall
Title: Great food in a magical setting - what more could you ask for?
Review: My wife and I spent 7 fabulous nights at the Casa Del Mar in Langkawi. We had 2 meals at the hotel's La Sal restaurant during our stay. The setting is fantastic...dining on the beach under the palm trees.The food was of a very good standard. Try the seafood risotto or beef rendang...you will not be disappointed! The menu has been put together thoughtfully and . offers something for all tastes. We also thought the the wine list supplemented the food really well. A special mention to all of the staff at the restaurant. They were courteous and very attentive throughout the meal. Two great evenings in a great location.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: rwlidPerth
Title: Food Good in Parts - Fantastic Location
Review: We were actually invited by friends who were staying at Casa del Mar and we had a table right on the beach with a specular view of the beach, the Andaman Sea and the outlying islands. My starter of Tempura Prawns with Wasabi Mayonnaise was wonderful, but the Ayam Bakar Chicken which followed was a little disappointing. Desserts were good though and considering we had a good time with our friends and the unique location, it was a great evening all round and if in Langkawi we would surely go back.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: pilch_999Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Beautiful location - just don't have the Tapas
Review: We saved the restaurant for our last night and I wish I'd read a few reviews first! The service was great, the location beautiful but the Tapas a REAL let-down! My husband ordered from the specials menu and his meal was good, but not amazing. The Tapas were POOR. The fish was dry and it all tasted like it had been re-heated. Try 'Sagar' near the Franjipani Resort for the best Indian food on the Island!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: B_and_M80Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great spot, bland overrated food
Review: Magic spot, great service, but food very ordinary. Cannot believe this is rated so highly and ranks second only to Privilege .... Now that is an excellent restaurant that fully deserves its ranking. Wonderful food, a passionate owner - easily the best malay top end meal we had in malaysia by a country mile.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ellaellaellaStockholm, Sweden
Title: Extremely overrated
Review: This should not be ranked so highly among restaurants on Langkawi. I would only recommend people to go here for a tasty cocktail and enjoy the view. The food is unfortunately disappointing.The dinner we had here started out great with a nice table on the beach, overlooking the beautiful sunset and great cocktails. But the following food was bland and boring. Malaysian food at its best is complex and packed with flavour, so bland is far from good. It wouldn't matter if the prices were half of what they are, I would still be disappointed in the food. We tried two appetizers, two mains and two desserts and none of it was remotely good.Apart from that the service is good, it's a beautiful setting and everything seems clean etc. But what does that really do when the food is bland?I would recommend going here for a cocktail, since the bar staff are really good at their jobs, and going someplace else for dinner.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: NeeNee_ChoPenang
Title: I will go again!
Review: We visited the restaurant as it is recommended in TripAdvisor and it turns out very aligned with the recommendation. We went for lunch but I think it will be greater during dinner. The food is top class and the staffs are very friendly. I will definately go again!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MilauradPerth, Australia
Title: Perfect place to stay
Review: This hotel does not disapoint. Stayed for our honeymoon at Casa Del Mar. La Sal Restaurant impressed us with every meal - both the western and Malaysian options were varied and very pleasing. The seafood was fresh too. No need to leave restaurant to eat - you have your own beach, pool and bar. Staff at bar play games with the guests. Sometimes the cocktails were not mixed well (too strong etc) but all else about Casa Del Mar including the wonderful breakfasts and very friendly staff leaves you wanting to return to this hotel again. ps - their spa is absolutly fabulous - we've had a lot of massages in Australia and Thailand - however The Spa at Casa Del Mar was the best massages my husband and I have ever had.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Zainab R
Title: Amazing food
Review: We had our lunch at La Sal and loved the food..it was the best in langkawi!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ML2011Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Beautiful settings, disappointing food
Review: Of course, a candle dinner on the beach is wonderful! Staff are professionals. Scenery is unbeatable....But the food is really disapointing: the Langkawi tapas as a start was nothing exceptional, the squid risotto was far too peperry and tasted more like a fried rice than a risotto, the lamb was pretty bland. Even the desert, the so popular sticky rice and mango, that is so easy to find everywhere in southeast Asia was nothing great: the mango was still green and not sweet at all.....could not eat it all.As a result, for the price we paid (350 Rm per person), we could expect wonderful food! And we did not get it!Great for a romantic dinner...but not for the foodShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CookingwenchieAylesbury, United Kingdom
Title: A quality, contemporary, adult dining experience, With a carefully chosen fusion menu.
Review: Yum yum yum it's what I will start off by saying, this restaurant was one of our best finds. The service is outstanding, on arrival a cold towel, followed by attentive service throughout. The thai beef salad is a must try along with the salmon fillet and risotto. Oooo and not to mention the amazing cheese board. A must try restaurant if ur in the area. A little more expensive than other places but well worth it. Five stars! ;)Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: balleeRhein-Main
Title: First Class !
Review: It's not easy to find when approaching the hotel from road side, because there is no notice for La Sal outside. But if you once found it and enjoyed a dinner, you will surely return!Friendly staff and perfect service make your stay comfortable, the menu is small but diversified, the taste is excellent, of course with a mediterranian touch, but this makes the difference :-) Try the St.Claire Pinot Noir and don't skip the affogato.Finally: It's a must to sit at the beach and watch the sunset.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SheryleMoon
Title: Great fresh food cooked with spice and love
Review: Excellent fish and seafood though the beef rendang was also tasty and authentic. You can eat on the beach in a romantic setting of candles
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 255060Jennifer
Title: EXCELLENT
Review: This was a restaurant that excelled itself, with the food, service, prices and atmosphere.  It might not be as cheap as down town, but at the end of the day, it rates higher than all the others.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MandM255100Melbourne, Australia
Title: Fabulous food, great service, magic atmosphere!
Review: We stayed eleven nights at the Casa del Mar in late March/early April 2011. The in-house restaurant, La Sal, was excellent - so good that we hardly bothered to eat outside the resort! Breakfast was fabulous. In addition to a range of fresh fruits, cereals, cheeses, breads and pastry options, there is an a-la-carte menu with a choice of hot breakfast options. While you eat your first course selection from the buffet, your hot breakfast option is cooked for you - no filing past endless cloches filled with less-than-appealing soggy choices! The menu included Asian dishes (including a fabulous mamak, nasi goreng, and roti chanai) and western-style options (numerous egg dishes, yummy pancakes, French toast etc.). Even though you think you'll never need to eat again after each breakfast, eventually lunchtime seems to beckon. Again the La Sal menu never failed to delight, with a range of Asian and western choices guaranteed to please. The lunch menu was available from midday through to 6pm and included tapas-style options (quite large servings!) that were great for a light lunch or for a nibble with a late afternoon cocktail or beer. Dinner, from 7pm, was again, a magnificent affair. When the weather is fine, you can book a beachside table on the sand and enjoy the fabulous sunset and beautiful night-time view up the beach as you run your toes through the cool sand. Magic! If sitting at a table on the beach doesn't appeal however, there is a lovely covered decking-style restaurant area, or the terrace section of the main building - overlooking the beautifully-lit, palm-tree surrounded swimming pool. Again, a wide-ranging menu (with daily specials) offers entrees, mains and desserts for every palate. The biggest problem is choosing (and being able to finish the generously-sized meals - hard to find room for dessert!) The drinks list offered a good selection of wines at reasonable prices. The cocktail menu was extensive and well-priced, and the bar staff provide a fun and welcoming environment in which to sit and enjoy a relaxing drink and a chat. The restaurant staff were a delight - friendly, efficient and always helpful. All in all, a really wonderful dining experience!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Chriswarbi
Title: Casa del Mar fantastic get away.
Review:
The Casa del Mar is a fantastic place to stay the staff are very helpful and the hotel is very clean.
Would be more than happy to stay agian and if only all hotel could be this good.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BillionzBrunswick, Australia
Title: Cocktails + Beach = Perfect
Review: We ate here a little while back - and while the food was good, like many of the higher end places on the island it didn't really pop.The bar, and more specifically the cocktails, however are a different story.They've got a really well thought out list of cocktails: classics, reinterpretations of classics and some unique creations as well. Every one we tried (and there were quite a few) was excellent.Prices for cocktails were on par with other places about RM22-25 each.Definitely recommend getting a table on the sand, but don't forget insect repellent - it's still a tropical island after all.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: djzooey
