Title: Cocktails on the beach
Review: Ate here last time I visited but this time just came for the cocktails. Delicious! While comparatively expensive in this country, they're priced similarly to Babylon at around 25 MYR.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: princetownPrincetown, United Kingdom
Title: you only get what you pay for
Review: we eat here on our first night on langkawi, starters spicey chicken wings/cesear salad followed by steak/mash and beef curry, starters salad was perfect, light, dressing just right on the mark like i said perfect, chicken wings were tender got about six really tasty.steak tender full of flavour the mash was creamy, excellent choice, curry beef, was tender not what i expected in a curry but it was my first taste of a malaysian curry, service was on the mark good all around.afternoon lunch, spicey king pawns about 5 very tasty not too spicey,both had beef burger and fries, should never had the starter the meal was hugh good value for money excellent. top quality food for the priceShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: titanwizTokyo, Japan
Title: Above average food...friendly but not efficient service...just OK
Review: Ate here one night during our stay and it was OK. For the price it was average at best. The atmosphere and setting is great, and it's a nice place for a romantic date. The food is decent but from a value perspective not worth what you pay. Martinis we had were expensive and not terribly good or terribly bad. The service was just sort of all over the place...we had at least 3 different servers ask us for our drink, entree, and mains orders even after we have given the order to another server. They weren't intrusive and they were very nice -- just seemed somewhat disjointed. Overall it was just kind of a "meh".Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MaradardiLa Foye de Vinax, France
Title: Not as good as it was...
Review: On our first visit to Langkawi in 2005 we had at least 5 or 6 meals at La Sal and loved every one. So it was high on our "things to do" list to go back and have another memorable experience. What an anti climax!! The service was slow and indifferent, the food was very poor, I had eaten far superior food in the local food markets! The prices were incredibly steep even for a 4* hotel/restaurant. The setting is lovely, but as outside visitors, we were not allowed to sit at a table overlooking the sea, which are reserved for residents only, I understand and appreciate this. I am only thankful we went for lunch, which we incorporated on a day trip of the island. If we had made a special trip for dinner I would have been extremely disappointed!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SuzTravelsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Loved it
Review: I've just returned from a week's stay at Casa Del Mar with my husband. We ate at La Sal many times during our stay, partly because we couldn't be bothered leaving the resort and mostly because the food is great. The menu is extensive and every dish we ate was delicious. I agree with other reviews that the service isn't particularly quick however the staff are incredibly friendly and utterly gorgeous. Besides, when you're on holidays with your loved one, sitting in a beautiful restaurant bang on the beach, just enjoy the views - and ask for more bread if really hungry!! I higly recommend at least one meal at La Sal while in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Traveler22079Athens, Greece
Title: service very poor and slow
Review: amazing location,food quality ok,service very poor,expensiveShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Snow1985Munich, Germany
Title: Nice beach side location
Review: We ate here on a whim without a reservation, despite there being free tables on the beach we were given a table off the beach as those we're apparently being reserved(throughout the whole time those tables were still empty). The staff are very friendly and the location is really nice. Its all lit by candles and lanterns, which can make seeing what your eating pretty tricky. The cocktails were pretty good, I wasn't a fan of mine but my gf's was very nice. The food itself was pretty average, not the best I've had but not the worse, the portions could be a tad bigger. The location was very nice and worth taking your other half. It was quite pricey for the isalnd.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Maccke
Title: Interesting drinks & very good food
Review:
I'm happy to recommend this bar and restaurant to anyone visiting Langkawi. Was here twice, and especially their Australian beef is excellent, but also their chicken is very good.

They specialise in Dry Martini cocktails and exotic Mojitos, such as Mango Mojito.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Cyrus_Ng
Title: Perfect Beachside Dinner in Langkawi
Review:
Nice place, best service and nice food!
Highly recommend both of u who travel to Langkawi
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Msafarman
Title: Best place in langkawi
Review: During my 5 days stay in langkawi.  I have went three times. Best place ever. Expensive but really worth it.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hazelmurfOldham
Title: Give this one a miss.
Review: Very very pricey - expensive poorly mixed cocktails ,poor bar service .Got a warm cosmopolitan in a champagne glass.We left after the cocktails and did not eat here as we did not care for the atmosphere.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jrawlingsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning food - western and Malaysian dishes both amazing
Review: We regularly dine out at many of the great restaurants in London but La Sal had absolutely no problems exceeding our expecations coupled with the fact it had the amazing location on the beach, watching the sunset and somehow manages to remain mosquito free - unlike the other restaurants we visited in Langkawi.Our biggest problem was deciding what to have as we were truly spoilt for choice, despite eating there almost every night of our stay, and there is a lovely bar with a great atmostphere for pre or post dinner drinks.We can't recommend it enough and are missing it now we're back home!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: chris-di-tourWell, United Kingdom
Title: almost perfect
Review: We have used Trip Advisor many times all over the World, (with mixed results) but for us this is by far its greatest success. We are spending18 days in Langkawi and have been to a variety of the reviewed restaurants. La Sal is just brilliant, the food was great, the setting stunning, the staff very friendly and informative and the cost when compared to other similar restaurants represents incredible value. If you want a Brilliant, Romantic meal just go there.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: teliskungenParis, France
Title: Wonderful setting, world-class service
Review: I chose to have my birthday dinner at La Sal based on Tripadvisor recommendations and I was not disappointed. The restaurant staff were extremely helpful right from the start and we got a great table right by the beach. Dining straight on the beach can be a truly wonderful experience and this certainly was. The service we experienced throughout is among the best I've had anywhere combined with the atmosphere it more than well compensates for the fact that the food is not mind-blowing (but definitely very good with Langkawi standards). The staff was extremely attentive and made sure everyone's glass were always filled, extra orders were accommodated and that the whole party got their food more or less simultaneously. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone coming with a bigger group to celebrate, you can expect to have a great night!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: hughie56London, United Kingdom
Title: "Michelin star"-like quality at reasonable prices
Review: This is a marvelous restaurant that had just about everything: beautifil setting west facing overlooking Pantai Cenang (beach) within the casa del mar hotel. Food was freshly cooked and beautifully presented. Waiting staff were suitable attentive without being excessively so. Choice of wine by the glass was excellent.Make sure you eat here one evening while you are in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DerbyshireGazzaSwadlincote, United Kingdom
Title: Great restaurant setting
Review: Found this restaurant from trip advisor and decided to try and was not dissappointed. The manager was very friendly and was going around the tables to have a brief chat with the clients. We enjoyed our inital meal that we decided to go back for a further meal and to see the location/setting. We sat this time right on the beach, which was atmospheric with a pianist providing background music which was very romantic to complete the experience. The food was very good and we enjoyed each of our meals on both occasions/visits.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MayJacksonCape Town Central, South Africa
Title: disappointing
Review: This is a romantic beachfront setting, perfect for a candle lit dinner. But our food took a long time to come. The fish dish was excellent, but my beef salad was a bit chewy.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mangoesmicheleLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wish I could afford to go every week!!!
Review: We were fortunate enough to be taken out for dinner at this restaurant. Can't say enough!!!Food was brilliant. Superb seafood entree, juicy tender steaks and mouthwatering desserts. All this while wriggling your toes in the sand watching a superb sunset with icy cold beverages in hand. Keep it up!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: PerfectStayNedre Eiker Municipality, Norway
Title: Almost perfect
Review: This is the restaurant with the most romantic and best atmosphere I have ever eaten on. You are right on the beach with candles and oil lamps listening to the waves. The food was good and the number of possible selections was fair. The food we got when we ordered from the menu was fair, but I did taste better while I was in Langkawi. We also did the La Luna dinner experience at the restaurant (look at their webpage for details) and the food we got then was fantastic. Service was very personal and only complaints would be that the food often took too long from you ordered until you got it served (Still this is not the type of restaurant you go to if you want "fast food")To sum up. There are some minor flaws but the experience overall outweights this and makes this a must when visiting Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: foodexperttBristol, United Kingdom
Title: It could be better
Review: The food really have nothing special. My Thai beef salad wasn't as good as I expected too weak and the beef was chewy! My partner ordered beef burger it wasn't bad.The atmosphere is good in the restaurant, outside sitting so you can sit by the beach and enjoy the sun(well if you don't mind too hot to eat your lunch) It was very noisy when we were eating our lunch because they were doing some work which ruins the atmosphere quite a bit.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mimesLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Ambiance, wonderful service, disappointing food
Review: Although the service and ambience were lovely the food was disappointing. The meat was over cooked and the flavours were underwhelming. Four out of four mains were taken away not even half eaten. Although I should note that we had breakfast at this restaurant daily and it was good.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KathyRBrisbaneBrisbane
Title: Excellent
Review: We celebrated our 32nd wedding anniversary and dinned at the wonderfl restaurant at the Casa Del Mar Hotel, after having a nice drink sitting overlooking the sea we were seated on the beach with the beautiful clean white sand under foot and very nice well presented table.The food was absolutely delicious and the service was impecable, we dined in the fading light to enjoy the best sunset that you would experiance anywhere.This was a most romantic setting and would certainly recomend it for honeymooners or "old timers" such as us.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: DAllen68
Title: Healthy & Tasty!
Review: Execellent food at a great value.  The ability to eat healthy and clean while on holidays is a priorty and Casa de Mar met all expectations.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: maki2Triesen, Liechtenstein
Title: Dinner at the bach
Review: Four times we had dinner at La Sal in Langkawi and each time it fas great. If the weather is good you can sit with your feet in the sand. There is nothing more romantic! The food is delicious. If you have room for a dessert you really have to take the chocolate pudding-heaven!The staff is super attentive and I really thank Mega, Faizul and Azura for their great and friendly service.If you're in Langkawi the La Sal is a must.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: AmiteshPatroBhubaneshwar
Title: fanstastic setting By the Beach;)
Review: Hav to Sit back,relax, wine& dine with ur SweetHeart by the cenang Beach.the service is great,must go for tourists who are used to proper hotel establishments by anywhere they go..Luvly cocktails and helpfull front desk staff...this is the only real Decent /plush place of a Standard by the beach with sober music and mood lighting with torches in the evening which makes it soooo romantic.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: notredame999
Title: Fabulous food and location
Review: my husband and I ate here with our 2 kids. the menu was great, views fab. Portion sides are massive and is good value for the quality of the food.  I would highly recommend.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: adampaton
Title: Definitely deserves it's place as number 1!
Review:
My gf and I booked a table here last night after reading these reviews and it was the bollocks!

Food was amazing and staff were brilliant. Amazing setting too, right on the beach. Thank you La Sal!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: harry_the_schnauzerPerth, Australia
Title: Romantic setting, average food
Review: My husband and I enjoyed a romantic dinner at La Sal last week. The setting was amazing, tables positioned right on the beach to enjoy the sunset.Great, friendly, knowelegable service. Prices high for Langkawi but still very reasonable given the setting and quality (compared to AUS/UK/USA).Unfortunately the food was rather average. The presentation was beautiful but it really lacked flavour. My hubby had the salmon tart tartar then rack of lamb, I had the satay chicken then barramundi in sambal. I really wanted to rave about La Sal and maybe we just ordered wrong. It was very very bland I ended up leaving half of my main.The setting is also very dark. It's lovely to sit on the beach during sunset, but once the sun set, we couldn't actually see each other, or the food we were eating! When we ordered dessert, we wanted the lemon curd choice, but the waiter told us we would prefer the chocolate lovers pudding - because everyone loves chocolate. Actually, I don't like chocolate and wanted the lemon - but he wouldn't let me order it!La Sal has a lovely setting and okay food. If I wanted a really special night out - I'd head to Bon Ton.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: fbt09092019
Title: Very chic, relaxing and romantic
Review: The local influenced dishes were very yummy.  The view was fantastic - great whether it rains or not.  If you stay at Cenang Beach, you should give it a try!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: thisisnotmysandwichSingapore, Singapore
Title: I went today to La Sal because I was...
Review: I went today to La Sal because I was curios since it was number one in Langkawi's restaurant recommendations. However, the dissapointment was absolut.We ordered two Malaysian dishes and they were completely tasteless. While food presentation is nice, the food itself was bland.One thing you have to give the restaurant is that the setting is beautiful.We have dined twice at The Andaman and the local dishes are incredibly tasty. Pity I decided to trade such a good restaurant for something as bad as La Sal. Do yourself a favour, don't go thereShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Natben60
Title: Highly recommend the tasting platter!!
Review: We followed trip advisor and ate at La Sal on our 1night in Langkawi, we're so glad we did! The location is right on the beach, very romantic and the service was fantastic. And the best of all the food was outstanding. Go for the tasting platter we still talk (and dream!!) about it now!! It hards to comment on value it depends on personal budget but compared to UK this was excellent value for money. So go book a table you wont be disappointed. Try spicy mojito too!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Magpie69melbourne
Title: One of the Best Restaurants in Langkawi
Review: I went to La Sal last week for dinner. The restaurant is right on the beach and its a vibrant part of Langkawi. The service was a little slow because they were so busy BUT the food is amazing. Everything I had was delicious & probably the nicest meal i had in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: Stylish & innovative fine-dining
Review: Was there yesterday ( 7 March 2010) for dinner. Chose to sit on the beach to hear the waves and catch the sea breeze. However, it was too windy and dark ( seems all the table candles were lit earlier but got extinguished by the strong wind ). As a result, we could not see the food clearly when it arrived. So our advice is to sit on the terrace around the bar or beside a lamp on the beach at night !Service was friendly. There was bread to keep us occupied before the main course arrived ( we didn't have any starters ) rather quickly. Unfortunately, they somehow forgot about our drinks/juices but water was served with the bread, so we weren't too bothered.I had the lobster risotto which had interesting flavours, I think that there was some citrus something or other in it. Being risotto, it was filling. My friend had the tuna which came in a sizeable portion. As the fish was seared with the middle still rather red and raw, it may not be everyone's cup-of-tea. But then it was supposed to be Japanese-inspired. The malay barramundi on the menu looked interesting, perhaps for the next visit......Not one of the cheapest places on the island but you get value for money.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: sbacon1London
Title: Delicious food in beautiful surroundings.
Review: We booked through the Casa Del Mar's website and they confirmed withing the hour. When we arrived we decided to have a cocktail at the bar (i would recommend a Peach Bellini). We were then seated on the beach looking out toward the sea. For starters my partner and i both had chicken satay on lemongrass skewers. I think mouthwatering desctribes them best! For my main i had the duck and my partner had the Beef Rangdang. Both beautifully cooked and full of flavour. The portions sizes where spot on, as was the price.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Haze95
Title: Romantic beach restaurant with very good food
Review: If you are looking for a special night out during your Langkawi holiday this is the place. Picturesque setting, attentive relaxed service, great pacific rim food and good wine list. Try to get there for a lovely sunset, drinks at the bar nice as well.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tradeformChateaurenard, France
Title: Pleasant, but pricey
Review: It is pleasant to sit on or next to the beach on a balmy evening. Service is second to none, The food is good, but for the price paid one would expect that. More local dishes on the menu would have been appreciated. A bottle of mineral water tasted disticly "off" so we drank the local water in preference. Overall a pleasant experience, but we enjoyed other restaurants more which charged 1/3 of this one.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: neilg21
Title: Top Class Dining Experience!
Review:
We ate here twice after reading reviews on Trip Advisor. We were not disappointed...
Service, food, ambiance and location were stunning! A seriously upmarket dining experience!! Thoroughly enjoyable!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jcannan01uk
Title: An unbeleivable experience, a must do for romantic foodies
Review: Dined at La Sal /La Luna restaurant at the Casa del Mar with my wife in Feb 10. Booked from the UK where Peter Ting was incrfedibly helpful with regards to setting up the entire process which was a romantic suprise for my wife ! On arrival at the restaurant, we were seated on a table on the beach, set aside from everyone else and completely surrounded by tea lights and candles, was incredbily romantic. We chose the degustation menu which was a 7 course tasting menu complete with different wine choices with each course chosen to compliment the food. The chef is clearly very skilled, and this restaurant is hands down, and i mean hands down the best on the island. Food highlights were chocolate souffle with caramel sauce, cod with blood orange sauce, and the most tender fillet steak imaginable. Cost for the 7 course menu inclusive of wine with each course was circa £180 / 200 for 2 people which was great value, If you are looking for a truly memorable and romantic occassion, this is for you. I seem to remember the quality of a holiday based on the best meal we had during it. The restaurant / and meal at the case del mar means that Langkawi goes down as one of the best. An absolute must do for romantic foodies. Would recommend to anyone, anytime,Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: paula67Adelaideadelaide
Title: An exquisite dining experience
Review: On the recommendation of Trip Advisor reviewers, we visited this restaurant at sundown and experienced one of the highlights of our trip to Langkawi. The dining tables were set amongst torchlight overlooking the beach where we dined from a menu offering a mouthwatering selection of delectable dishes. The setting looked as if it was straight out of a gourmet magazine, the staff was attentative and friendly and the food was superb. We repeated our visit on our last evening and we weren't disappointed. Although we ate at different restaurants each evening of our 7 night holiday, nothing matched the experience.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Frqnt-trvllerLondon, England
Title: No 1 restaurant in Langkawi for a reason!
Review: My husband and I had dinner at La Sal one evening in December. This restaurant is rated No.1 in Langkawi, with very good reason - the food was exquisite! Mostly local Malaysian food, and cooked to perfection... Do not miss their desserts! Also an extensive drinks menu, including some very interesting cocktails. Beautiful surroundings right by the beach (we had a walk on the beach before our meal), very romantic, piano softly playing in the background... A truly enjoyable dining experience in Langkawi.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Gordon-Maggie-Nov09Melbourne, Australia
Title: Superb! Exceeded expectations.
Review: Good friends highly recommended this hotel to us. We were not disappointed!The appetizers, main courses and dessert were all excellent and the very best of all the many great meals we had in our 9 days in Langkawi. The wine too .... a Malbourgh Sav Blanc was one of the best (and one of cheapest) wines we bought in Langkawi resturants. I would have paid twice as much for the dining experience and not been disappointed. Go There! Gordon and MaggieShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ImmersMelbourne,Aus
Title: Wonderful dinner on the beach.
Review: We did not stay at Casa del Mar but had a very enjoyable evening at La Sal.We arrived early and enjoyed the sunset at the bar before being shown to our table on the beach.The food was of good quality and the service was excellent.Anyone travelling to Langkawi and looking for a nice romantic dinner of the highest quality, I would definetly recommend La SalShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mattypnlondon
Title: a truly devine setting, lovely staff and gorgeous food
Review: We ate at this restaurant every day during our three day stay on Cenang Beach. The only down side was that we were not actually staying at the hotel! The restauarnt serves a huge range of different meals for lunch and dinner. Although it's obviously more pricey than your average meal in SE Asia, for the quality, service and beach side setting it's an absolute bargain. Whether you want a traditional Malaysian curry or steak and chips, you won't be disappointed.A special mention is also due to the staff. They are genuinely warm and friendly, and go out of their way to make you feel welcome.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: talltaff
Title: Great food in a fabulous setting
Review: Food was beautifully prepared and served. The Malaysian tasting plate was great and a good selection of drinks at the bar.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: samuelle63Perth, Australia
Title: All that it's beatten up to be
Review: We are staying at Casa Del Mar. We had diner at La Sal on our first night here. The food is absolutely delightful. We both had one of their signatures dishes which was a pleasure to look at and very very tasty. The service is outstanding and the setting is absolutely beautiful.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: scottsYork
Title: Beach side restaurant with sunset view
Review: We stayed at the Pelangi beach hotel and this restaurant was next door.  The location is fantastic.  The service was very professional and the food was excellent.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Jennifer321Perth, Western Australia
Title: Dinner under the stars
Review: Be sure not to miss a special treat of dining at the La Sal Restaurant at Casa del Mar hotel. The food is beatifully presented and served and the staff are attentive without being fussy. Prices are very moderate for such a high standard and the overall atmosphere is divine.Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: bg205
Title: Amazing food and view
Review: Had dinner on the beach. The food was amazing - One of the best meals we had in malaysia. You can have your meal on the beach during sunset.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CaptainEvaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Don't miss out a dinner at La Sal
Review: Since almost 4 years I live in Langkawi and one of my favorite restaurants is La Sal. The service is really great and they put all effort to make sure that you are not wasting your money or your valuable time. I have been there as often as I can afford it and never been disappointed. Beautiful for sunset. Rack of Lamb and the Tuna are my favorites! Plan your evening early enough to enjoy a drink for Happy Hour at their scenic beach bar. Try the CDM Bellini!EvaShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Andrew_and_DebSunshine Coast
Title: La Sal Restaurant - fabulous food - just go!
Review: We were fortunate to discover this restaurant early in our holiday and kept going back. The food was sensational and well priced for the quality of all our meals. We indulged ourselves with wonderful cocktails we've not discovered anywhere else, and which are apparently unique to the hotel Casa del Mar where La Sal is situated. The location is amazing, it's right on the beach, with a great view. The Langkawi Bellini and Stardust Martini cocktails were our favourites, although we tried quite a few others before deciding! La Sal's menu offers something for every taste, but the Kataifi prawns with avocado mango salsa were mouth watering and definitely a favourite. We also enjoyed one of the best steaks ever - the Australian beef fillet with chive mash - now we know where all our prime Australian beef goes, as we haven't had a steak that good in Australia for a while.Finally, I don't think we'll every recover from the delightful, and much talked about Soft centred chocolate pudding with vanilla icecream - no one else's will ever be as good!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: presse111
Title: Great spot on the beach
Review: This is an upper class restaurant but not expensive for westerners really. The position is great on the beach
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: letterengland
Title: Not just for romantic dining
Review: Great food, good wines, attentive yet not intrusive service and on the beach! La Sal at Casa Del Mar is certainly my first choice for dining when in Langkawi.Friends & I have worked our way through a large chunk of the menu and cocktail list!!! All tastes are catered for (& special food requirements as well!).When people ask me for recommendations for places to eat when in Langkawi, La Sal is top of my list.Enjoy!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Erin KAustralia
Title: The best place to eat in Malaysia
Review: I visited Langkawi in December 08. On my first night I enjoyed a candlelit dinner overlooking the beach. The atmosphere was perfect. The venue was so calming and welcoming, very romantic. The staff were quiet and friendly, very genuine. I had the best meal of my stay in Malaysia at the La Sal restaurant at Casa del Mar in Langkawi. The food was delicious, sensational! I can't wait to go back again! Definitely a must if you ever travel to this gorgeous little place known as Langkawi!!!Show less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LindaNewZealandNew Zealand
Title: My favourite restaurant in Langkawi
Review: During November/December 2008 we enjoyed many wonderful meals at La Sal which is Casa del Mar Restaurant, Pantai Cenang , Langkawi.Starting with the first part of breakfast which was well laid out and plentiful you can then order from an a la carte menu which caters for all from simple egg white scrambled eggs to Asian dishes .The evening meal menu is comprehensive, the dishes we ordered were all delicious .Service was prompt , friendly and efficient .We recommend Casa del Mar and it's restaurant to visitors to Langkawi IslandShow less
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nordiba
Title: The best seafood restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Just super yummy!the seafood are fresh.prices are very reasonable.look out for the owner Michael and he will suggest the right dishes.restaurant is open air and clean.

Author: suwannitcKedah, Malaysia
Title: Coming back for more
Review: This is a return trip after a year. Booked a table for 2 and ordered 3-flavoured fish, salted egg squid, nestum prawns, mantis prawn and veggie. They all tasted extremely good. Seafood were all fresh! Better still, it was so cheap I wished I can come back often. Michael, the guy who served us was super-friendly.Show less

Author: rebnmayz
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: We had an amazing experience- everything was great from the food to the service. The queue is long however, although the restaurant team does a good job with quick turnarounds. 10/10 would recommend for any travelers looking for some delicious local food.

Author: Dream64636237413Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Amazing! Awesome!
Review: Me and my family have been enjoying the foods for the last 20 years and will continue appreciating the restaurant. Never doubt their Halal foods. The owner and staff are super friendly. I am from Penang but I cannot get such an excellent food at my place. Travel on yearly basis to enjoy the foods with my family. Thank You Atun!Show less

Author: jokl78
Title: Cheap nice seafood
Review: We had fish, prawn, squid and tofu. 3 of us with some drinks. Total bill only RM100. Super fresh seafood and cheap. Can't get this anywhere else.

Author: 454adelinecKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food, Fantastic Price!
Review: Walked-in to Wonderland Food Store because we didn't have a reservation (always place a reservation beforehand at this place, it gets packed!). The waiting time was relatively short given the long line. We were served swiftly once we got our table. Food was fantastic! We ordered a steamed fish, stir-fried vegetables, fried mantis prawns, two chicken dishes, and a soup, accompanied by white rice and a jug of cold drink. The price was very good compared to places like Wan Thai. One of the staff explained that the food arrived a little late because there was only 1 cook on duty that day albeit the food arriving at a reasonable pace by our standard. Service was good, food was better, price was great! Couldn't ask for a happier dinner.Show less

Author: JamesKMTan
Title: Great food
Review: I was recommended by the locals to visit this popular restaurant. It was quite packed even at 8.30pm. They have a very big variety of dishes. The seafood noodles was excellent. It is THE place to for tasty seafood.

Author: laurentay
Title: Excellent seafood at reasonable prices
Review: Came here twice during our stay. Seafood is fresh, reasonably priced and there's a wide variety to choose from. Steamed fish, salted egg yolk squid and the belacan kangkung is a must order. Food is yummy so look no further for seafood.

Author: Yongyong2020
Title: The food is amazing and excellent.
Review:
The food is amazing and excellent. Staffs are super friendly and kind. Location and area is easily accessible. 
Most importantly, food is cheap and very reasonable. A must try to those who are visiting Langkawi😊

Author: DoctorBakar
Title: Seen better days but still good
Review: Helpful friendly staff but food quality has dropped since the last 2 years. Open 7 days a week and still packs a crowd after 7pm but is still popular as it is pork-free. A BYO place.

Author: Traveller007Plus
Title: Food Review at Wonderland Seafood Langkawi
Review: Fish lime garlic, squid salted egg, crab black pepper, butter prawns n longan jug are all rated 4+ star. Will come back. Good food reasonable price at tourist place like Langkawi.

Author: SSLeongTripAdvPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Seafood restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Great food with reasonable price. Got to be there early, like 6pm otherwise may have to wait in queue. Not many tables inside (maybe 10). Must order the salted egg squid and the cereal prawn. The waiter called 'Ah Tun" is very helpful and friendly - they will know how to advise you on the food.Show less

Author: Kevin OShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Not Great Ambience but Great Food Quality
Review: The ambience was not great but the service was extremely efficient. The owners definitely were eager to please. Seafood was fresh and it looked like many others came just for that. The fried lobster was great and would definitely recommend that. Overall a good experience and wouldn’t mind a second trip back. Show less

Author: Kevin TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A true Malaysian restaurant
Review: The restaurant had less people now compared to its heydays. I remembered the long queues. Nevertheless, the crowd was still there and the kitchen was busy as usual. We ordered the lime fish, butter prawns, seafood fried bihun and fried oyster omelet. I was quite disappointed by the serving because I was expecting the fish to be sour and spicy but it came out to be a little on the sweet side. We wanted to order the lala fried bihun but they do not have that; instead, the waiter suggested seafood fried bihun but the bihun had gravy despite being told it would be dried. The fried oyster was also strange. We were expecting the usual fried oyster with egg and starch but the batter was more like pancake with no sign of eggs. The only consolation was the prawns which was satisfactory. I am not too sure but maybe this is the Langkawi-style seafood. So, better drop off all expectations and be surprised. The service is good and it is great to see many Muslim friends frequent the restaurant. It felt like true Malaysians enjoying a good meal together. That should be the reason to come to this restaurant.Show less

Author: triples90
Title: sugary sugar
Review:
Coming from a seafood hard-core lover, I think there is unnecessary amount of sugar added to the food-evry dish! probably the sweetest tomyam I've had in my life!
 .
service was good
.
price was very reasonable.

Author: Kamesam SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service, good food, reasonable prices
Review: Went for dinner with family. Good selection of seafood, friendly service, everything fresh and tasty. If you are going, I suggest the tiger prawn instead of the lobster - similar pricing but more meat. Prices were reasonable - not super cheap, but good value for money. Would go again.Show less

Author: Discover788593
Title: 2x Excellent Dinner
Review: On our first night here, we ordered 8 dishes with 2 jugs of water which is RM35 per person; we are 8 people. Very cheap and reasonable price here in Langkawi island. We ate like crazy. As we are enjoyed, next day we went dinner there too! The seafoods are freshly frozen. Great dinner!Show less

Author: Salina-Soon Lin... CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood dinner
Review: Good, fresh and affordable seafood dinner. Shop opens only at 6pm daily. Very friendly and attentive service. Great for a group dinner, as more dishes can be ordered. Nevertheless my husband and I did full justice to the 4 dishes we ordered- crispy fried soft shelled crabs, salted egg squids, grilled prawns and stir fried bean sprouts (taugeh)with salted fish and black mushrooms! Very good dinner!Show less

Author: FatinoaVivatin
Title: Good food bad service
Review: The food here are undeniably delicious. All the dishes we ordered were. But it take them 45 minutes to prepare them. Luckily we were not in a rush.

Author: AnnaK16984
Title: Overrated
Review: Visited the food stall today but it’s really more for tourist. The seafood was just average and disappointing.

Author: yyl84
Title: 💯 SATISFACTION
Review:
The seafood are sooo fresh & cooked beautifully. The owners and staff are sooo friendly! Prices reasonable and so worth the long travel to this gem! (I stay in Cenang)
MUST GO!

Author: siobhaindoyle
Title: Fresh and delicious seafood.
Review: Fresh and delicious seafood. had a brilliant experience with my family and will definitely come back here. recommended.

Author: roryjdoyle
Title: Wonderland
Review: Simple outdoor setting Chinese restaurant serving really excellent fresh seafood and excellent value for money prices. Recommended.

Author: yuenyuenbeeIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Always My Favorite Restaurant in the Town
Review: This place is always is a must go for me whenever i visit the town. The food is good and not too overprice. Surprisingly this place is not too pack like usual maybe due to recent RMCO. However, the food is always tasty and food serving is fast too.Show less

Author: demhemsem
Title: Great food
Review: Affordable food with a very local touch. Always a must have when I'm in langkawi, the prawns and crabs are delightful

Author: khairain
Title: Superb Food
Review: Food is superb and  delicious. Price was cheap for me if compare to other places in  Langkawi. Service is fast  and  the staff are very nice to us. Butter Lobster is all time favourite. A must try for those never been to this place.

Author: Cam87Johor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Wonderland Food Store
Review: We had a wonderful dinner at Wonderland Food Store by the riverside. The soft shell crabs were absolutely delicious. The lime sauce with the steamed fish was sensational, and we enjoyed the fried fish as well. The staff were very friendly and efficient. It is an open air restaurant, and we enjoyed viewing monitor lizards in the river from a distance. We hope to return soon!Show less

Author: Juice17995
Title: Loved it
Review: Really good food at reasonable prices. Was booked solid so you know the food is great. The soft shell crab was great!

Author: Chinh PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic place for local food to explore Langkawi
Review: Love the place and we ended up eat here 2 days in the row. The seafood is excellent and very very fresh ans It is vert reasonable price. It is not for someone who is looking for a luxury but it is a typical local sea food, plastic table and enjoy the local food. Strongly recommended place to have a good food. Cash only and no credit cards.Show less

Author: pvanmerch
Title: Fantastic food and fairly priced
Review:
Firstly know that the tables and seats are plastic. That helps describe the bustling atmosphere. The service is efficient but cold. The fish is top too notch.
Awesome spot for a social and drinks.

Author: Caryn YLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh seafood at great prices
Review: We were really happy with the quality of food, prices and service at this casual, open-air restaurant. It was so good we didn’t bother to try/find a different restaurant throughout our stay and dined here 4 nights in a row. We tried a good number of dishes and our favourites were:1. Clams with ginger and spring onion2. Steamed fish in soy sauce3. Fried flat rice noodles with seafood4. Baby kai lanShow less

Author: 20junel
Title: Exceptionally good food
Review: Exceptionally good food and very cheap had Tiger prawns in garlic, fried squid,seafood  noodles  and fried rice with beer for the two of us.( very fast service )

Author: Tracey SNewmarket, United Kingdom
Title: Good food as always
Review: Visited here tonight, was here same time last year. Food still as good as always was. Good quick service. Good range of food to choose from. Family run business all very friendly. Had two main meals , veg, rice and four soft drinks £15.00 for two of us. Going back tomorrow.Show less

Author: Babyface421JohnC
Title: Almost perfect!
Review: Very busy restaurant,but staff try and get you served has quickly has possible,my wife had tiger prawns and rated them highly,beers was cheap,meal was on the expensive side.

Author: 316myatChelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: The food served was delicious
Review: The food served was delicious , we enjoyed it very much as a family . Had the steamed sea bass, tiger prawns cooked in garlic and butter , egg yolk squid , mixed veg and fried rice . For the price , I must say it is very affordable with such fresh seafood cooked well. This is a very good restaurant, if you are looking for ambience and poshness rather than the quality of food served at affordable price , this isn’t for you. Show less

Author: Traveller5970
Title: As good as
Review: Visited this restaurant on recommendation from staff at our hotel (St Regis). Everyone of them spoke highly of this facility. We had the red snapper (whole fish), 8 mantis prawns, seafood fried rice and fresh vegetables in addition to 8 tiger beer all for the princely sum of 230 MR. The food was delicious and service excellent despite the restaurant being full of patrons. Certainly well worth the experience. Show less

Author: xadiqSingapore, Singapore
Title: Had a great family dinner
Review: Food was really delicious. Chinese-style seafood and halal. A personal recommendation of one of our hotel's staff and it didn't disappoint. We came back the next night because many of the other restaurants recommended by TripAdvisor were surprisingly closed! Not sure why, but fortunately we had a second good family dinner. Staff were really friendly and accommodating. Pricing is pretty reasonable too.Show less

Author: Rogaldornson
Title: Hungary
Review: The food was delicious and more-more better what you think, dont judge at first site. The staff was very polite and helpful. Just go there and try it. You wont be disapointed :)

Author: nwy624Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Famous but food is average
Review: Came here to try since it has highest review score. Maybe this is the reason I have high expectations on their food. We ordered teochew steamed red snapper but it doesn't suit our taste bud as it didn't put in sour plum and good salted vegetables. The taste covered by oyster sauce instead. The Kam heong mantis prawn is not that good - lack of fragrance with curry leaves and dried chillies. Stout and Heineken are RM4.50 per can whilst tiger and carlsberg are RM2.50 per can. Show less

Author: creative3responseAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: A Chinese restaurant but the food cook is halal. This restaurant was recommended by a Muslim staff at a Duty Free Shop. Staff is polite and the service is good. The food is excellent and taste is good. Price is reasonable. Environmental is good and clean. Show less

Author: Jennifer L
Title: Delicious food at a reasonable price
Review: Very tasty food. We ordered a variety of dishes and all were good--fried squid, seafood noodles, vegetables, sweet and.sour chicken, spring rolls. Cheap beer. Fast service. Reasonable cost.

Author: mdemolondon
Title: Best restaurant in Kuah
Review: We were staying at the st Regis nearby and wanted to get away sometimes in search of local food.wonderland did not disappoint. Portions are huge ( the kind manager did warn us we were ordering too much) we were even able to bring our own wine and Langkawi being a duty free island was an added bonus compared to many SE Asian resorts. Tiger prawns were exceptional and the owner will call a Grab for you when leaving. We ate there 4 times out of our 9 night stayShow less

Author: Nickoky
Title: Amazing and cheap seafood!
Review: Amazing and cheap seafood! Worthwhile to stop by if you are at Kuah Town! We spent about 110 ringgit for 4 dishes (excluding crab)

Author: S AToulouse, France
Title: Very average Chinese restaurant
Review: I was told that this restaurant is 'local Malay'. It isn't! It's a Chinese seafood restaurant. I didn't see any Malay dishes on the menu.There's a big queue which starts around 6.15pm and my two dishes took an age to arrive. Nevertheless, the kitchen is extremely well managed. Unfortunately, the food was nothing special. My bill came to 12 euros for one person including hot tea. I wouldn't go back. There are tons of similar restaurants like this in Penang.Show less

Author: Farida PMinneapolis, Minnesota
Title: Seafood lovers- Just GO!
Review: Nothing I am saying here is going to be different than what other reviewers who gave 5 stars have already said. So I’ll just outlined what we had and how much everything costs. We had 2 sambal prawns (400g), 3 garlic Tiger prawns (300g), 1 grilled prawns (200g), 1 butter fried prawns (200g), rice and kangkung belacan. 2 sprites, 1 Tiger beer and a lime juice. So, almost 2.5 lbs of prawns, rice and a veggie dish and everyone got a drink. All were great, we’d order every single one again. Total bill RM 139 = $35. (See photos)We already plan on going back for dinner to order the same items tomorrow night. EXCELLENT place to have a seafood dinner!! Show less

Author: ChrisandCatherineRLeeds
Title: Cheap amazing Chinese food
Review: We decided to venture out of our hotel at the Westin for a cheaper meal and to see what was out there. This restaurant marked highly on TripAdvisor so we decided to give it a try. It was organised chaos in the kitchen when we got there at 8.30pm and we had to wait for 5 minutes for a table as the restaurant was full. We ordered whilst we waited and then were shown a table. There is one kitchen at the front and brings out some amazing looking dishes (mostly fish & seafood) to their customers who sit at plastic furniture outside in a street food market set up. The food came after about 30 mins and was superb - sweet and sour chicken, chicken and ginger, stir fried veg and egg fried rice. They then ordered us a taxi for our ride home.Highly recommend this restaurant for food but is very casual. Show less

Author: PatriciaT3785
Title: Cheap Seafood with Fast Service
Review: Great seafood with super fast services despite the crowd. A must try in Kuah town as it is definitely worthwhile compared to those along Cenang beach

Author: TzeHaw
Title: Worth to try.
Review: Acceptable price with tasty and quality food. Especially at those tourist location, most of the food will be sell in expensive. But this food store for sure sell in reasonable price.

Author: KarenBenji
Title: Delicious!
Review: After reading reviews on trip advisor we decided we must try this restaurant and we definitely weren’t disappointed! We were staying at Berjaya but totally worth the trip! Delicious food and excellent service.

Author: NickCavanagh
Title: Wonderland = wonderful
Review: Our family ate here multiple times during our stay in Langkawi, the food was so excellent we had to keep coming back! The manager works tirelessly and was a fantastic host. He greeted us personally on each visit and made sure we were looked after including even arranging transportation. He helped suggest food items and the kitchen delivered what could only be described as top notch cuisine at a very reasonably price. Would highly recommend a visit to Wonderland!!Show less

Author: NtBaskaranKajang, Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food
Review: My family consists of 9 people took our dinner here . It only cost us around rm300 for 9 dishes including 2 type of fish. The food was delicious and the staff was very friendly. But be prepared to wait cause the queue will be long. Will be going again soonShow less

Author: YangyennnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Misrepresentation
Review: Ordered oyster omelette, baby KAI lan, sotong with ginger and red snapper. The food was tasty and cheap, but they served a sea bass instead. Didn’t want to change the fish so we continue to eat. They insisted it was a snapper when billing but u can still see the sea bass head on the plate!Show less

Author: EatDrinkSleepDo
Title: Get there early!! Before 6.30pm
Review: Langkawi has been an amazing holiday. Food exceptional. Wonderland is a MUST stop for all those looking for an authentic experienceWe where told to make sure we got there early to secure a table. It was incredible to see the packs of people flowing in once we were seated. As for food - AMAZING. $280RM for the lot. 3 adults and 2 teenagers. Price was increased by about $100RM because we chose to have a full lobster as well (probably to only disappointing dish we ordered). We also had 6 Tiger beers ($3.50RM each) and a couple of cokes for the kids. We dialled up the chilly on a couple of dishes - YIKES!! Thank Goodness for the beers. Restaurant is cash only. Show less

Author: Soon Fatt Y
Title: Does not live up to reputation
Review: The quality of the food is not as good as it sounded, they changed the chef before and still living on the reputation built before. It taste like the average KL hawker store food, which is normally not so good.However, the price is low compared to others which is the best thing we can find a there.Show less

Author: wander-travel789Sydney, Australia
Title: No frills cheap seafood
Review: This is a local restaurant so don’t go there expecting a hotel / fine dining experience. About 25 plastic tables with chairs are outside in an undercover concrete area next to the small indoor kitchen. We arrived at 8pm on a Saturday and there was about a 15min line to order and get a table - this place is very popular! We ordered lobster (~600g), calamari, kway teow seafood, fried rice and a few beers. It cost us about $AUD80. It would have cost a lot less if we didn’t have the lobster. Once seated there was a ~45min wait for the food but when it arrived, it was very tasty. It’s clear this place has grown expeditiously and is trying its best to provide quality food with the small kitchen it has available. The owners spoke English and provided excellent customer service (ie. they stopped to check on our meal and at the end of the night, ordered us a Grab back to the hotel). I would recommend this place as a great value for money local dinner experience as an alternative to the usual fine dining in Langkawi. Give it a go! Show less

Author: LizandAlbNoosa, Australia
Title: No frills, but excellent food!
Review: In Langkawi for only five days, but have eaten here twice, and although completely lacking in any “decor”, this restaurant is consistently packed with locals which is a good indicator of the quality of food served. Crab seemed to be the big draw, with most tables tucking into this delicacy in some form, but everything we tried was fresh, and freshly cooked and promptly served. The fried baby calamari were crisp, delicious morsels, the clams with ginger and spring onion were so sweet, prawns cooked in butter with prawn floss just sublime - the list could go on and on. No wine, but beers and soft drinks are available, we were the only Westerners on both occasions, but felt totally at ease, the owner spoke excellent English, and explained the menu and assisted us with our selections, as well as ordering us a cab after, to get us back to our hotel. This is a must visit for foodies, in spite of its inauspicious appearance, and inexpensive - both visits our bill for 5 courses and a couple of beers was approx AUD $25 total. Strictly cash only though, so make sure you bring some local currency. Show less

Author: Lcy0712
Title: Holiday
Review: Easily to find the place and the restaurant staffs are so friendly and also the food so delicious and cheap.

Author: ChanshaneSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Clean Chinese Food in Langkawi
Review: Good find in Langkawi. We took a grab from Pantai Tengah area two days in a row just for this. Cheap good fast clean. It is packed with local. We went on a Thursday. It was opened. Upon checking, their off day is not fixed. Good food. Worth a try if you are in Langkawi. We ordered two mud crabs and it cost about RM60. The fried seabass we ordered on day one costs about RM45.Show less

Author: sc0819
Title: Price reasonable. Taste average
Review: Price good. Seafood very fresh. Taste wise average. Lots of people thou. It is actually kind of like a road side stalls.

Author: Molly KPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Superb taste with reasonable price
Review: we went twice for dinner, if they open in daytime,we definitely going there for lunch. we loved the fried b join, slated eggs squid, salted eggs mantis, deep fried squids,lemon steamed lala even simple fried veggie also delicious, eggs steamed prawn. portion is big, services is good, most important reasonable price. we enjoyed our meals there, and recommend to friend when back home... definitely will visit againShow less

Author: donnypusawongSan Francisco, California
Title: A must visit in Langkawi!
Review: So my wife and I staying at the Four Seasons hotel in langkawi. We wanted to venture out of the resort for some local seafood. Everyone had recommended this restaurant! It cost us about 45 ringit (close to 10 USD) one way to get there. The place is no frills and the service is fast and quick. The food is awesome!Show less

Author: Deena C
Title: Best food in the world
Review: This place is best place to eat,  we visited 3 times, the last 2 times we didn't even talk as the food was so good all you can do is eat it.

Author: allspice502016New Westminster, Canada
Title: Seafood cooked to perfection
Review: Extremely popular and busy restaurant, go early to get a seat. It has a large covered seating area beside the river. Line up is usually very long, therefore they take your order while in the line-up, this makes service somewhat faster. The waiter does his best to recommend and explain the menu. The seafood was fresh and very well prepared, the steamed bass was excellent, though the soft shell crab was somewhat disappointing. Overall it was great local food cooked to perfection.Show less

Author: shanana21Singapore, Singapore
Title: A must go for great local food
Review: Travelled a distance to get to Wonderland for a late night dinner. It was past 10pm and the place was filled with diners relishing all the fresh seafood placed on the table. It’s a local family run business by a few brothers. We were received by Michael the owner as our friend had called ahead. It felt like eating food cooked in a relatives’ outdoor kitchen. Nothing was short of perfect. Loved the special house chilli that went well with the fried Kway Teow. Crab was fresh. Fried squid was delectable and every other dish we downed was a good workout for the stomach! Enjoyed the dinner surrounded by a thunderstorm-didn’t perturb any of us as we were enjoying the food too much. Don’t worry about the toilets if you don’t see any on the premise. There’s a little story behind the toilets. Next time you are in Langkawi be sure to pop by Wonderland Food Store. Just don’t expect a restaurant with air conditioning just pure good local food served up by a family who believes in sharing their love for food and the Langkawi hospitality!Show less

Author: Discover15624314152
Title: Amazing seafood.
Review: The seafood was fresh, delicious and well priced. My bf loved the salted egg squid and lobster. Must visit restaurant in Langkawi.

Author: flammablerose_45Bayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: Best seafood ever!
Review: The food portions were big enough for 8 people, excellent customer service as they have pretty good recommendations and they practised not wasting food. The food overall was excellent and well worth the price! The steamed fish was so good and the taste was on point! Will definitely go again and again and again!! Show less

Author: lizziem27
Title: Returned after 2 years-still fantastic!
Review: Great seafood, authentic street eats experience and very cheap. Delicious black pepper sauce and whole fish, great experience.

Author: KereruHuggerWellington, New Zealand
Title: So good we went two nights in a row!
Review: First up we have to commend the service, in particular Michael who helped us decide what to eat, and remembered us from the first night. Working off the adage: go to the busiest place, proved very true for this restaurant. Seafood was just so fresh and special sauce made at the restaurant is delicious. Great to have greens with garlic (they are all good...fresh, cooked and tasty), steamed sea bass with lime and chilli, crab with pepper sauce, deep fried squid the freshest we have ever had anywhere, seafood Kuey Teow, and all super reasonably priced, including the beer. Great atmosphere too. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: simonl00indonesia/south africa
Title: Surprised ... great seafood & great prices !!!
Review: First impression for any Westerner like myself will be ‘ oh my fingers crossed this will be ok “ I was reassured by the sheer amount of locals dining that this had to be good . Seafood was fantastic , tasty & fresh topped off by great service & will make sure our family goes back again before the end of our vacation.Show less

Author: Tim029Dorset, United Kingdom
Title: Great chilli crabs and prawns
Review: Came highly recommended as Kuah's top seafood place. Arrived as it opened for the evening to avoid the crowds. Ordered the chilli crabs, steamed large prawns and several local vegetables. The chilli crabs and the prawns were delicious. The crabs were cooked to perfection in a well balanced sweet garlicky tradional chilli sauce. The large fresh prawns were streamed correctly with slivers of ginger in Cantonese style. (My preference over the pan fried dark soy sauce version)All finger licking tasty and such good value too. Crabs and some seafood are subject to market prices.The restaurant is now managed by the next generation but with family elders still very much involved.A well deserved commendations.Good food list ticked.Show less

Author: Rebecca Y
Title: Delicious!
Review: This was one of the best meals we had in Malaysia. The food was cheap and outstanding. A great spot with kids.

Author: 920michellecDa'an, Taipei
Title: Order the fried snapper - it’s sooooooo goood!
Review: Quick food, good service but the food is great. We chose the fried calamari and tamarind prawns which were quite good but the standout dish was the fried whole snapper - beautifully cooked and the flavour was to die for. I grew up eating freshly caught snapper but this was the best snapper I’ve ever had (and it was also unbelievably cheap). Would eat this dish every night if I could.Show less

Author: SteadyLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant
Review: It is quite a few years since I last visited this restaurant and, as always, the place was packed, but luckily my friend had booked a table for us.It always seems very chaotic but you do notice that the staff have everything under control, including the long queue of people waiting for tables and queue jumping is definitely not allowed...!My friend ordered the food so it was lovely just to sit back and eat the excellent food that kept appearing and the quality and taste was exceptional.Our bill for five persons, lots of food and even quite large Tiger prawns, was less than 300RM.I am definitely not going to leave it as long before a return visit to wonderful Wonderland.Show less

Author: Kalamazooweefamily
Title: Seafood
Review:
Delicious,  great price and we all love it!
Will come back again.  Must try restaurant in langkawi.  Enjoy!!

Author: FaversFaversham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and ambience - definitely worth a visit!
Review: This place is bustling, busy and packed to the rafters! ... and rightly so! The food was great... fast, cheap and very very good. The service was friendly, the other diners even more friendly, and happy to welcome you and help out.Great meal all round!Show less

Author: LindaP346
Title: Good food
Review: We ate here and on the recommendation of  hotel staff. At first glance underwhelming as it is basically a street food restaurant, but Food good, staff friendly and efficient.

Author: earniezaSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: above expectation
Review: a warm owner, a clean kitchen, a yummilicious menu!!!!!!!! and the prices is so cheap! the owner even offer us to devide our jenahak into two and one side steam lemon and another side 3 rasa! i never been to any restaurant that offer such serviceShow less

Author: mmfGZ
Title: Just go !! ( High value for money )
Review: When you have to queue for a dinner at ~20:00 evening,at a Street restaurant. they must be doing something correct. And they DO !  They are busy, but Well worth the wait. Price tag,,, Try it !! I was very surprised.😄

Author: Kif K
Title: Loved it so much, one of the best in langkawi
Review: Amazing food we loved it, not too pricy, clean, lovely staff the guy recommended good food for us since we lack knowledge of Asian cuisine.

Author: BigcohunaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Local food at its best
Review: After looking for places to eat locally we found this place, wow the food was sensational and the staff friendly & helpful in recommending dishes. It may not suit everyones dining taste as just tables with plastic chairs but we came for the food & was not let down6 dishes of food and 5 cans of tiger for only $115 ringgit Definitely going back before heading homeShow less

Author: AprilflameKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh seafood
Review: The seafood here was very fresh. We tried a selection of fish, crabs and prawns. Price was reasonable. The restaurant is outdoor but didn't feel too warm. The restaurant gets a big crowd but the service is quite fast. We were a party of 9 people and the food was ready within half an hour of ordering. Go early i.e. by 6PM to avoid queueing. There was also a fish crackers seller parked right outside the restaurant that is worth trying. He sells ready to eat packs of crackers which make a good starter while waiting for dinner. If you're after fresh seafood, this place should be on your list.Show less

Author: K13_FADLoughton, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner with friends
Review: By far the best fish I had in langkawi. Opens at 6 but dinners allowed in before 6 to place order. Decent meal (650g) fish will cost in the region of RM50. Rice in plate is more than enough for one person so except someone with a big appetite, a plate of rice should be good. Seating is outside so may need insect repellent. Food is good value for money. Show less

Author: snhrianie
Title: Affordable and nice food!
Review: At first we were hesitant as we dont know if the restaurant is halal but there’s a malay lady who works there and inform that the food is halal just that they serve alcohol. Thankful for that! It was crowded and advisable to call in, reserve and order in advance. We waited for 20 mins for out food to arrive but it was worth it. The food was amazing!! For table of 5, the price was really affordable. It was RM290 which is only SGD96!Would return to if i ever come back to Langkawi!Show less

Author: michaelgI2594WTNicosia, Cyprus
Title: Last night for great food
Review: This place is amazing order what ever you want via fresh seafood and all the rest of the food is fab we went last night for the first time and tonight was a repeat. Again brilliant. From king prawns lobster clams squid rice noodles. All fantastic. Well recommended. Many thanks wonderland. 10-10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ must try the drink lychees Show less

Author: LuxurousPlusNew York City, New York
Title: Great Chinese Seafood
Review: This super casual Malaysian-Chinese restaurant definitely wins my award for the best bang for the buck after 10 days on Langkawi. There is no alcohol except beer, but the food was exceptional. We ordered the lobster in fried butter sauce, mud crabs, steamed red snapper, clams in black bean sauce, and a variety of other dishes, and everything was great. The English menu is a little hard to navigate, so I would recommend looking at what other tables have ordered and then ask the wait staff to serve you the same dishes. Also, you should be aware that this is real Chinese food, so if you are looking for General Tso’s chicken, beef with broccoli, chow mein and the other slop that usually passes for Chinese food in the West, you will be disappointed. However, if you like real Chinese seafood dishes, this is the place for you. Show less

Author: tiffinykinan
Title: Crab black paper
Review: Nice food and the best of seafood in town,friendly of bos ...but take time for food delivery because they everyday full house

Author: CraigHWSouth Australia
Title: So busy, so good
Review: We chose Wonderland after reading reviews and a recommendation of the concierge at St Regis. A short cab ride and thank goodness we booked. Every table of this large restaurant was full with a queue of at least 20 people that continued for over an hour, so book or come after 8 pm! It is a typical local eating area open on all sides with a metal roof, wooden tables and plastic chairs. The beer and soft drinks were cold and welcoming.As you reached the front of the queue you placed your order then sat, because of the enormous volume of people and orders you wait awhile for the food but you are occupied looking at everyone around you and the great staff literally running to keep the service flowing. The food was typically local but very tasty and worth waiting for. The two of us ate and had 2 beers each for 45 ringgit ( about $16 Aus).Show less

Author: Lisa H
Title: Incredible food, great staff - loved it!
Review: The food is excellent, the prawns were delicious and fresh. The price is also really good. Most importantly, the staff went out their way to ensure we enjoyed our visit - chatting us through the menu, making recommendations, being super clear with the pricing of the fish.Couldn’t recommend more - would recommend however, turning up around 6pm as some of the most popular dishes (eg crab) had sold out by 8pm/9pm.Show less

Author: Jude88Sydney
Title: Three visits in one week!
Review: We loved the food here so much we returned 3 times in our week in Langkawi. We never waited more than 10 minutes for a table, though I think it was low season. Highly recommend this place - the atmosphere is really fun and the owner who takes the orders and seats people was really lovely.Show less

Author: Peter W
Title: Fresh and good!
Review:
Atun and Micheal, again very nice diners at yours, For the 3rd year, We will come back once.
Visitors of Langkawi have to visit your restaurant.

Author: Geoff BMelbourne
Title: Good at what it does
Review: The nightly crowds of mostly locals are testament to the quality and the value of the seafood meals at this outdoor restaurant.My partner and I recently spent a week on Langkawi, in the Kuah area, and visited Wonderland twice. Be prepared to queue, but not for too long, depending on the night or the time.The staff are harried but pleasant and accommodating, the kitchen staff energetic and focused. There is an element of chaos to the proceedings, but all is pulled off pretty efficiently. A lot of food ends up on the concrete floor, deliberately, and the occasional cat wanders through. All great theatre.The food was delicious and very reasonably priced. The menu is extensive and alcohol is available (beer, red or white wine, or BYO with MYR10 corkage per bottle). The chilli crabs are fresh, still alive at time of ordering.This isn't haute cuisine or fine dining. Rather, it's an experience, the focus being well-cooked seafood and entertainment provided by the mostly large, animated groups of diners.Show less

Author: BoardingPass77988
Title: Seafood dinner
Review: Affordable good seafood. Beers are cheap. Go early as it can get crowded. Good service from the boss and staff.

Author: Blue_GedLocks Heath, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, very cheap
Review: Recommended by taxi driver. Plastic tables outside but clean and friendly. Food was really good ( not into fish but heard it was good too). Dirt cheap , 4 dishes , rice noodles and couple of beers was about £7. Cash only and no atms close by.Show less

Author: aleksandersony
Title: terrible environment....
Review: the environment of the restaurant is bad interm of view and the smells of that stagnant sewage .....the food is ok but the service was really slow...

Author: Ajay7171
Title: very crowded restaurant
Review: Don't come to this Restaurant....is very crowded and the food is just average...nothing fancy and WOW.....service is not really good ...over all I won't recommend this place ...

Author: Educat2018
Title: SCRUMPTIOUS SEAFOOD
Review: Just plastic tables and chairs and simply the best seafood in town at the best prices. We are regular visitors and love every delicious morsel. Also good cold Tiger beer! A must go restaurant.

Author: annemaried351Artarmon, Australia
Title: Delicious and great value
Review: Recommended to us by our ‘Grab’ driver, we would recommend Wonderland to anyone staying in / near Kuah. Definitely not fine dining, with no need to dress up, Wonderland has plastic tables and chairs with a concrete floor and no walls. Estimate it seats about 100 people.As we were warned about queues, we arrived at about 6.30 and while there were plenty of tables, there was quite a long wait to order and then receive our meals. Seemed to only be two waiters taking orders. By the time we finished at about 7.30, the place was full with a queue of about 15 people.Wonderland also serves chicken but we stuck with seafood. Most protein can be ordered with a choice of a long list of sauces. Prawns with fried butter was a generous serve and delicious. Lobster with garlic sauce also delicious. Lobster cost was approx AUD7 per 100g and super expensive compared to the rest of the meal, but very cheap by Australian standards. Highly recommend the fried rice and also steamed greens ( we asked to have both based on seeing them served to a table of locals). They serve beer; unsure if they have any sweets / desserts. Cash only.Would have liked to eat there again during our stay. If we every visited Langkawi again, would definitely make time to visit.Show less

Author: hollebollegeezaHaarlem, The Netherlands
Title: Value for money
Review: Wonderland food store was recommended to us by our host. After reading some reviews we decided to go here although I wasnt that entousiastic since I am not much of a seafood lover. Place was already busy when we arrived (around 6.30 pm). We had to wait for a table. Menu is extensive. All real affordable dishes, even the lobster and crab. Chicken and vegetable dishes we received were tasty. Also ordered sweet and sour fish which was good. Big portions compared to other restaurants! You can order a small portion with some steamed rice which will be enough for one person. Drinks are also cheap (can of tiger beer for 3.5 RM!). Kitchen looks fairly clean and is open so you can see the food being prepared. Speedy service. With a total bill of only 50RM for two people we left.Show less

Author: FlopslouiseMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best Seafood in Town!
Review: There is a valid reason you may need to line up a short time to sit at a plastic table and chair at Wonderland! The food truly speaks for itself. The tasty and very affordable seafood with a dozen chicken and non vegetarian options are Malay/Chinese cuisine. It felt like we were eating with a local family. We enjoyed a marinated sea bass, large prawn, large chicken ginger dish, noodles, rice and two beers for $30! Outstanding! Thank you for the meal and calling us a taxi, Wonderland!Show less

Author: J0a88aSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great seafood at very reasonable price
Review: Over our 6-day trip in Langkawi, we had dinner here twice because the food is way better than the other seafood restaurants we went to. Even the highly rated ones. Staff was friendly and attentive. The steamed garoupa with ginger and soya sauce was good, but not the red snapper. The salted egg yolk squid was extremely delicious. The sambal kangkong was spicy and sedap. The clams in ginger and spring onion was also good. Lobster and prawns were just ok though. The black pepper crabs were quite well done too! Overall this is our family's fav dining place during our trip!Show less

Author: 1Fynn
Title: Good crowd
Review: The dishes were alright. Not particularly tasty. There was diverse crowds there. Can see there were locals and also foreigners having a meal there.

Author: Kym PMiddle Dural, Australia
Title: 2nd time. Even better then last so returned for a 3 rd visit.
Review: Wow wow wow. Just incredible food and service excellence. We came 18 months ago and it was just outstanding. It was one of the reasons we returned. Can I say with such expectations sometimes it hard to live up to. No it just got better so much so we returned 2 nights after. The food especially the pepper crab. Is the very best. Michael works his tail off and is incredible. Highly recommended it’s a must if in Langkawi. Thank you Show less

Author: CarmenSehwailAmman, Jordan
Title: Reasonable priced seafood restaurant
Review: We went to Wonderland last week for dinner. We ordered steam sea bass with ginger and onion which was excellent, deep fried octopus also good, 2 grilled lobster were excellent as well, grilled shrimp was very fresh, kam heong lala I don’t really like. The rest of the dishes are stir fry vege, rice and noodles which were good. Overall very reasonable price restaurant. They required u to line up and order before u get to sit down. This may be weird for a lot of people but I think it’s very efficient and it helps to prevent customers trying to book a table by standing next to table where customers about to finish food. Show less

Author: Isaac L
Title: Seafood dinner in langkawi
Review: You need to Q and order your food from the menu before you are given a table. Takes about 1 - 1 1/2 hours and after which takes another 1 hr to 45mins for the food to be serve. Because, we are tourist who search for good reviews and try no matter how far and long the Q is. Until when we eat then we know... The Food quality 5/10, taste 4/10 , service 5.5/10 , cleaniness 4/10 . It is a Chinese Muslim resturant. Price will leave it up to you. IMO, it is overrated and not worth the visit. Show less

Author: Extraordinary114039
Title: Summer Holiday in Good Seafood Restaurant
Review: We visited the Wonderland seafood around 5.40 and there are alot people already sit at the restaurant and still waiting. Around 6 pm they start to serve the order yhat we already order before. The food was at very good price and delicious. If we visit Langkawi Island again, we will visit this place again. Really good to take for our dinner. But we have wait for a long queue, but its ok for the food and the price.... Show less

Author: zzoggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: You wait for average food!
Review: After reading all the stellar reviews, Wonderland was a must visit for my family. We arrived around 830pm and the place was packed on a Monday night! There was no clear system, some people waited on the sides and others in line holding a menu. You wait in line for a good 20-30mins before placing your order and thereafter you are taken to your table. We waited for about an hr before our food came. While I don’t mind the wait if the food was good, this place was average. Here is what we ordered:Stir fry kang kung / fried egg - normal Steam prawns in egg whites - prawns were large and fresh but unfortunately it was a little over cooked so the meat was rubberyChicken in soy sauce & ginger - nothing greatDeep fried Salted egg squid - deep fried to death until the meat was chewy and too much batter was usedSteam fish in lime garlic - the worst dish of the night. Not only was the fish beyond over cooked, the meat was so so dry! the lime sauce tasted too artificially sweet and I’m pretty sure instead of fresh lime these idiots used lime cordial to cut corners. Overall a very disappointing dinner! Waited an hr and 20mins for nothing. While reasonably priced, will NOT return even if there was no wait. AVOID, not worth the time!Show less

Author: BenedictL97
Title: Delicious
Review:
So good that I came here for dinner twice on both the 2 days I spent in Langkawi. 

Food is fresh and really really affordable. 

It’s like a normal coffee shop / kopitiam experience and the service staff were really friendly.

Author: Zillione
Title: Worst customer service ever! Business owner extremely inconsiderate.
Review: They let people queue for hours and after have a seat, have to wait for another hour! Our whole night plan ruin for wasting time stand and wait for the normal food!ITS SO HOT AND NEED TO STAND FOR QUEUE FOR 3 HOURS! They said no matter u are pregnant or old folks also have to wait! They should let customer know the actual waiting time and care for customers. Not feeling proud for let their customers stand and wait! Show less

Author: datin_tan
Title: Worth to wait!
Review:
Delicious seafood and price is reasonable.! Service was friendly too.
Go early before 6 to skip the long queue!

Author: prokit
Title: Excellent Seafood Food Store
Review: If you have visited Langkawi, You must visit this eating place as the taste of the food is  excellent. The price is also affordable. However the place is just like a normal food store. They opened till very late night and be ready to queue.

Author: jackkjlimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Seafood Restaurant
Review: First of all, the place has no aircond, pork free (Halal), and usually packed even before they started their operation. They will have u seated, take your order, and wait till their chef to arrive and the show will begin. Food serving is fast, and accurate. Food tasted average and some slightly below average, price was good. Stir Fried Balacan kangkung totally out, kam heong lala was even worst.They must be something that we were missing, we can't understand the reason behind of the never ending customer waiting line.Show less

Author: NI3-279Bengaluru, India
Title: Wowww...Yummy...Food....Friendly Family
