Review: This is probably the best sea food restuarant in Langkawi...You need to make sure that you are there as soon as it opens in the evening......if you are late only if by few minutes....you will be surprised to find number of people already there....Be patient and prepare to wait....It is run by family and they are extremely friendly and even help you with selection of food..During all the rush they did not forget my request of making the food spicy....My second day visit was great well...with another round of yummy food.... Seafood fried rice and Noodle soup...were probably the best i have had in recent times.Show less

Author: 422dericlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Busy restaurant with yummy food
Review: Read many reviews about this place and we decided to give it a go. Luckily we arrived 530pm and already 70% of tables filled. We quickly placed our order and wait for the kitchen to start cookinnnng.The food portion is acceptable as fish prawns etc are based on price per gramme. Prices are decent too.In summary, the food are yummy. Do go early and judge for yourself.Show less

Author: Laura C
Title: Amazing seafood and lovely people!!
Review: Please go to this restaurant! The food is incredible (would recommend the sea bass!) and the service is great. Very reasonable prices for fresh fish and local chilli crab

Author: HillB79Melbourne, Australia
Title: Simple food done well
Review: If you are after typical Malaysian Chinese comfort food, this is the place for it. Well priced for fresh seafood and cheap beers. Don't be put off by the location. It's well worth it, we have been back twice in 3 days. Get in early or you'll be queuing from 7pm.Show less

Author: XInternational
Title: Nice Budget seafood
Review: Very friendly owner ,fast service.Reasonable prices. Food is OK for Langkawi standard.Will recommend if you're staying in Kuah. If you're driving,there is parking available but limited parking lots.No toilets, have to cross the road to reach a public toilet.Inconvenient for disabled or elderly people.We were quite late the second time we went there and the mud crabs were sold out.Have to settle for the flower crabs.No complaints though.Show less

Author: roger134Ipswich, United Kingdom
Title: Down by the Riverside/Roadside !!
Review: My wife and I were in Langkawi attending the wedding of the son of a friend to a Chinese girl he had met in London . Her parents live in KL so they had chosen to marry on the beach at a five star hotel close-by. The hotel food was very good of coarse but we chose to eat-out on two occasions after the wedding party had returned to KL. We had been advised that Wonderland was the place to go. Squeezed between the road and a river this shack produced some fantastic, mainly fish dishes in record time, including our favourite, a lobster served on an oval dish and covered with an orange net ,carved from a single carrot by an elderly Chinese man sitting in the road outside. The whole place had a most dynamic atmosphere about it. The staff did everything at full speed. If you ordered a drink then a tin of Tiger beer would be on your table within 2 minutes. Yes you might have to open the can yourself because the waiter was on his way and did not even "break step" as he passed your chair.We had two wonderful evenings at Wonderland but this was sadly ten years ago (2009) Robert & Ling, the young couple, now live in London, have two young children and are today (05/04/2019) in Langkawi celebrating their 10th wedding anniversary. We wish them well.Show less

Author: Faizwoodrose
Title: Good food
Review:
fresh seafood at reasonable price. We had red snapper, Swuid, Chicken and Fried rice.
If interested in Far East food Shd visit

Author: susanklu
Title: A nice surprise
Review: Saw the crowd and decided to try this eatery.  Was very pleased with the simply cooked but excellent quality food served.  Would recommend it.

Author: tmwnycNY, NY
Title: Great Local Seafood Spot in Langkawi
Review: We ate here twice in Langkawi during our fivenight stay. It's very good food - seafood, fried rice, noodles, chicken, etc. Very simple food - and a local favorite. about 80% of the guests are Langkawi - just a few tourists. Dinner for two is about $20 USD. It's cash only though, so go to an ATM first!Show less

Author: Alexander G
Title: Delicious fresh food
Review: We loved this place so much we visited five times. Super friendly staff and the food is incredible, and very good value! I normally avoid Chinese food in the UK as it’s usually greasy but this place couldn’t be more different. Check it out!

Author: Dot1972Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Was recommended to try this restaurant so had a taxi from hotel only to find it was closed! Taxi took us to another restaurant which wasn’t brill but we were hungry by then.Next time we went we got the hotel to ring first to confirm it was open and we had a really good meal and very well priced .Don’t be put off by appearance from the road but the fact that it was packed was a testament to the food . Four of us had really great food .Show less

Author: vishal3176New Delhi, India
Title: Best Seafood
Review: I went to this place it is the best place to have dinner in langkawi , sea food over here is awesome you can bring your own booze . Always ask for Steve he is the best server and he guides you the best to order . I had a lovely time , if I go back to langkawi i will go back to this place for sure . Show less

Author: Vithya B
Title: Amazing food
Review: What an amazing place to eat, quality of food is amazing and unbeatable Even though a very humble and modest set up the quality of food Smashes fine dining out of the park.I would happily queue and wait for a table here will be definately be worth the wait.Show less

Author: midmagColwyn Bay, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: You cannot go wrong with this restaurant as proved by being constantly full with people queuing to get in. The Steamed bass is great and the prawns they serve are the tastiest and juiciest I’ve ever had. Despite being busy service is fast friendly and efficient. Price wise we’ve always come away amazed at how low the bill is.Show less

Author: Andy SCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Good food great value
Review: so Reading other reviews I don’t understand that if you turn up and dont like the location why stay?. You are right, it’s river setting isn’t the best but it is what it is, leave if your unhappy. This a very much a basic street side eatery, but they can be the best. It was very busy wen we went and a lot of locals eating there. Food was spot on and the staff couldn’t have done enough ( even sorted us a taxi back to resort ). The only thing that visitors need to be advised of is that there’s no restroom !! That’s across the road and it’s a public facility. Not great, but I found that quite amusing in this day and age. I would say this is Kuah version of a greasy spoon cafe back home. Good honest food, and to have 5 dishes and beer for £20!!!!! Was fine for us.Show less

Author: vinothm2014London, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, great value seafood restaurant
Review: Wonderland serves good quality seafood for a reasonable price. We enjoyed it so much we came back on 4 occasions during our 2 weeks stay. We also tried Orkid Ria on Pentai Chenang but found food quality is the same for a higher price. Do get there early as it gets very busy with locals and tourists alike. Would recommend the fish in nonya sauce, salted egg fried squid, chilli tiger prawns and seafood fried rice. The chicken dishes are also good!Show less

Author: skdcitravellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Loved it!
Review: We thought we’d over ordered with Kim Heung prawns, fried fish fillet in ginger & spring onion sauce, mixed vegetables, bean sprouts & noodles (for two persons) but it was so delicious we ate the lot! With beer & lime juice the bill was 74RM (£15).Regardless of the fact that there are no plush surrounding the place was full with mainly locals. When we settled the bill the proprietor offered to call a cab which we gratefully accepted. The Grab car arrived within a minute & was half the price of the cab that took us there. We will visit again this week.Show less

Author: tempesttraveler
Title: Devoid of locals
Review: This is a tourist trap. My perception is: any place that is devoid of locals is a clear sign that food is not that good. This got reinforced as I ate here. Nothing good to write about this place. Stay away!

Author: 882will
Title: High quality cheap for seafood
Review:
Highly recommended for seafood lover. 

Friendly boss. Enjoyed the different type seafood, fast and tasty. 

Reasonable price compare to most of the restaurant at Pantai Cenang.

Author: sihuixoSingapore, Singapore
Title: High quality seafood, cheap beer at best prices
Review: Was recommended to visit here by many locals, after visiting Orchid Ria as well and I must say this is definitely much preferred over Orchid Ria. Seafood fresh, service was great (despite the crowds - go early to avoid waiting!), and price was much more reasonable than at Orchid Ria. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: bobrB618NL
Title: Hot steamy brilliant
Review: It’s confusing,hectic,noisy,but I doubt,you will find better food in langkawi.Dont be put of by the outside,go in and have your senses assaulted by the taste and smells of Asia.

Author: tiger_l1lly_Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: We fist visited the place 10 years ago on our first visit to Langkawi - one of the best meals we had that trip.We returned to this place 10 years later with our now 7 year old and was not disappointed, the place was very busy again and we had to wait for maybe 20 minutes for the table but well worth the wait.Ordered 2 beers, 2 coffee's 2 juices, soft shell crab, fried fish, tiger prawns and stir fried vegetables all for about 200RM (£36) Definitely recommend and will visit again.Show less

Author: bamboozleed
Title: amazing dinner at amazing prices
Review: dinner was wonderful, we had fish, tiger prawns and 2 other dishes, all were delicious. service was fast and prices were incredibly good. would definitely go again

Author: Deena C
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Staff are brillant, food is best we had eaten on the hoilday, we visited 3 times, the staff were so helpful when trying to decide about what size to order of fish and rice, they even ordered a cab for us.

Author: LEE_SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh Fish and Prawns at Great Prices
Review: This is my favorite place for fresh seafood. I loved the steam Garoupa at Rm$8/100g in Teochew style that is done just right. The Nestum prawns at RM$10/100g is also awesome - crunchy and yet melts in your mouth. My favorite place for dinner ... Including drinks, we rarely spend be more than RM$120 for a nice seafood meal.Show less

Author: AngusS906
Title: Go there
Review: This place is amazing. It’s basic with its plastic chairs and tables but has brilliant food. That’s why it is always full. Bring your own wine or beer and they’ll provide glasses. All the seafood is excellent, the giant prawns exceptional. It was so good and cheap we went back twice with the family. Show less

Author: Virginie T
Title: Really great chinese food
Review: We had fsh, prawns, clams which was really tasty. We had 1 fish but the staff was really nice and suggested that we could try 2 different tastes.We wanted to try the mud crab but when there at the end of the servie so few things that we wanted to try were out. Tips : make sure to get there earlier so you'll have more options :)Show less

Author: 1111JSLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hands down the best Chinese on the island
Review: So our trip to Langkawi with food has been a hit and miss in most places, and nothing particularly stood out until we arrived at Wonderland. As soon as you arrive you know its good when you've locals and tourists lining up to 10-20 minutes for table only to wait for the staff (who are working frantically). However off putting the aforementioned sounds, please ignore that, as the meals that come out are absolutely amazing, definitely the best meal on the island and of up there with my top 2 meals in Malaysia. The seafood was fresh and at such reasonable prices, it actually cost less than our breakfast. The drinks there are cheaper than the supermarkets and again the flavours were just perfect. I wasn't the greatest Chinese cuisine fan but i am converted. It was so good, that I forgot to take the pictures of all the dishes and ate the fish dish partly before realising and taking a picture; sorry. You honestly can't go wrong here and I would say its a must. Enjoy the food, we did. Show less

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: It just doesn’t get better than this!!!
Review: We ate here 5 times in 2 weeks and I can tell you that this is definitely the BEST seafood restaurant in Langkawi!It’s a MUST go to place!! Here are the best dishes to try. The deep fried fish with the ABC secret sauce is fantastic! Try the pepper chicken, I think it’s the best I have had! The morning glory is great, the calamari and the chicken fried rice you can’t go wrong. If you go at 6 pm there is not a line up, at 7 or 7:30 most likely you will have a line up. No matter what the wait is well worth it, the food here is fantastic!!While it’s not fancy, it’s all about the food here! It’s fresh, it’s tasty and it extremely affordable!!The service is really good and to be honest I can tell you I have been coming here for 10 years and it’s just as good if not better today than it was in the beginning.I highly highly recommend this place. If you come to Langkawi you MUST eat here! If you don’t you have missed out on a great dining experience that you just can’t find ANY where than here in Langkawi. It’s cheap, it’s extremely tasty and it’s just darn good!! YOU MUST GO!!! This is my favourite restaurant in Langkawi and if you go you will understand why!!Show less

Author: fifi090Stamford, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: Don't be put off by the outside when your taxi drops you off. The food in here is the best Asian food I have ever had. Its very basic so don't dress up and you may have to queue or share your table but its worth it for the taste. Very busy with a good mix of locals and tourists which makes a great atmosphere. Speedy efficient service and you can see the food being cooked.A huge meal and two beers each set us back £15 UK. Excellent value for money.Very highly recommended.Show less

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best Chinese in Langkawi
Review: It is 3 years since I visited this establishment and nothing changes. Still the same staff, Atun managing the restaurant with his usual efficiency. The food never differs, always top quality, fresh and excellently cooked. We were a party of 7 and started with a large plate of deep fried squid with chilli sauce. To follow we had a large Sea Bass with sauce on the side Fried rice, baby kialam with garlic. Plum chicken, ginger and spring onion chicken, naked prawns, bean sprouts, soft shell crab and wine (brought ourselves) and tiger beers. The whole lot, and there was masses of it came to just over a £5 per head. No other Chinese restaurant on the island matches this place. FantasticShow less

Author: jaxx2410
Title: Always busy every night
Review: Great Chinese Restaurant. Based in Kush. Always busy with a mix of locals , expats and the odd tourist. Excellent range of food. High quality always. You can get beer but take your own wine . We went for friends birthday.

Author: neilhassallLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Wonderland
Review: We visited Wonderland Food store as it was recommended to us by our Grab / taxi driver and it is right next to Bella Vista Hotel - we visited on a Saturday night and it was packed out but we still got good, prompt service. The menu was extensive and although we didn't go for any seafood (their speciality), our noodle and veggie dishes were good (not the best ever food we've had but all good). Beer also very cheap (3.50 MYR a can).Show less

Author: Adam0418George Town, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the long waiting time
Review: The line was really long and we had to wait for more than one hour and some types of seafoods already sold out The food are good but not great. Prices are reasonable as most seafood restaurants near by. Not worth the long waiting time.Show less

Author: DelwinkrielSydney, Australia
Title: Best Seafood dinner restaurant in Langkawi
Review: We had a great experience, if you are staying at a hotel have concierge book you a table for 6pm when they open to secure a spot, otherwise rock up just before 6 and you will definitely get a table- by 6:30 the restaurant will be jam packed. The food is great, you can have small, medium or large dishes of all items on the menu, very affordable and great outdoor atmosphere. There is a small section of soft drinks and beers available. Service is quick and efficient- once you finish you walk up the the cashier and point out your table and pay the bill.Cab/taxi are available from the front of the restaurants.Make a point of meeting Michael the owner and take a picture with him - great personality.Wonderland food store is highly recommended.Show less

Author: 88gaian
Title: Good service but the food are below average
Review: The service was fast and prompt. Food also very Fast serving. The crab we ordered are deep fried until dried and tasteless. The steam prawn with eggs are good. Other food we ordered are so so only. Deep fried soft shell crab are good by the way. Recommended to go early as you will need to queue for a long line if late. Show less

Author: PhuahKTKuah, Malaysia
Title: Average food and beverages
Review: The food here are just average. A bit disappointed as it was rated very high in trip advisor. The crab was over fried and its very crowded. If you really wanna try this restaurant, suggest to come early around 5.45-6pm to avoid the crowds. The service was good but the food taste is just average. Show less

Author: TravellerStar12
Title: Fresh seafood but crowded
Review: We have our first dinner at here leaded by the high good comments.It wasn’t disappointed try. Seafood are fresh However, seafood Tom yam soup is not recommended. Not niceIt is very crowded, luckily when we get before 7pm, the queue is not long. Waited about 25mins Maybe they are too busy, the stir fried vegetables have the burnt taste. We ordered crabs, plier did not come with it. You have to ask for it. Maybe it is a small little thing to improve Overall, worth to visit.Show less

Author: mariahL2073SD
Title: Good Food, especially fish
Review: Food is very good for a good price. The place is always crowded, nur things move fast. Eventhough you might have to queue, it is worth waiting. Fish and baby kailan are our favorites.

Author: Murali2778
Title: Good food at cheap price
Review: Unable to believe we could get food for such price in Langkawi. No wonder the queue was long but it was moving fast. Only regret we did not order more.

Author: Maggie_cmc
Title: Satisfy
Review: Food is nice, price still acceptable in this tourist place. Is very crowded, need to line up for table, food is fresh, but is quite many mosquito.

Author: 560glenmAscot Vale, Australia
Title: Great value
Review: Don't be put off by the long queue. These guys get it moving pretty quickly.Was so worth the short wait. Amazing variety of seafood which came cooked in an even wider range of styles to choose from.We were very pleasantly surprised by the bill (we ate our fill for about 20AUD each).The only thing of note is they have a small selection of beers but no wines or spirits. Having said that, they're very happy to accept BYO. Show less

Author: Edwin_Irene
Title: Food still great as before!
Review:
3rd time here  - never missed dropping by this place everytime in Langkawi.
Fresh, fast, tasty and reasonably priced. FYI - Halal.
If you come to Langkawi - don't miss coming here, no regrets.

Author: heatherrjollyEdzell, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner visit
Review: We were told about this restaurant by a taxi driver. We arrived early at around 6.30 and the restaurant was very busy. However we got a table and the menu. We had fish fillets, sweet and sour chicken. Egg fried rice and two tiger prawns. The bill was £26.00 for all this food but half of this was for the two tiger prawns which were indeed delicious. The restaurant was packed by the time we left and I would say it is excellent value for money and would definitely return.Show less

Author: adeline_potterCanberra, Australia
Title: Great value for money with delicious local food
Review: This place was recommended by the concierge at our hotel St Regis, and we were very glad we made a reservation before arriving! We were seated straight away but we noticed other customers had to line up before a table became available. This place is packed and it’s a testament to the quality and value of the food. We had oyster omelette, fried prawns, sambal squid and noodles, and a Heineken. All for RM58, which was extremely good value. The food was delicious and gave us the opportunity to try the local street food. The staff could also speak English and the menu was easily understandable with clear prices marked for each dish. Show less

Author: Chungtb
Title: Great place for dinner
Review: Taste good, reasonable price, fast service despite the full house of customers. Only open at 6pm. Great choice for dinner.

Author: RickyH2Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Reasonable Price for 2 person
Review: The salty egg crab is delicious. The staff is attentive and efficient. The location is easy to find. We had a good dinner and we saw many customers including locals and foreigners. Clean environment compared to other restaurants. The boss is very polite and friendly to all customer. No complaints for us being first time to visit here. Highly recommend for those who seek for cheap and delicious dinner or supperShow less

Author: claudiabsyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food with reasonable price
Review: This place is more for locals compared to those seafood restaurants along Pantai Cenang. Food here is good, price is reasonable. Service was great and waiting time is reasonable. We came here twice during our recent visit to Langkawi.Will recommend this place to those looking for local food / seafood. The mantis prawn was a hit.Show less

Author: octopusjason
Title: Langkawi 🆓 and easy
Review: Shalom... Fish is fresh & nicely cook with well decorated, it is nicely keeping the fresh and taste of the fish . We ordered the Nyonya style fish , highly recommended if u can handle the spicy food. Prawn is fresh and the fried egg is delicious.Only the "Gam Hiong" chicken ,Not as much as the taste that we expected as the gravy wasn't the "Gam Hiong" but too sweet.We tested the Nyonya style fish, fried egg , oat & cereal prawn , fried butter prawn , and the vegetables call "Choy Sam".The Choy Sam vegetable is too old and not delicious, abit disappointed as well as the Gam Hiong style chicken .Overall was and will back again to try other variety of foods when we come again.Thank you so much. Show less

Author: VigLigDigMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious late night supper
Review: Was a cheap 8MYR Grab ride from our hotel. Loved the efficient service and local feel. Had char kwoy tiao, tiger prawns and some greens. All very yummy. Super cheap beers. And the restaurant seeing that we were clearly tourists, volunteered to organise our ride back to the hotel!! The food was yummy and absolutely great valueShow less

Author: ruff48Ohio
Title: Our go-to place for good cheap Chinese style seafood
Review: Crowded on our weekday nights but tables were available. No aircon where we sat. Service was quick & very personable by a young man who was cheerfully helpful with requested suggestions & did not try to upsell. All our dishes were well executed to our tastes. We are Malaysian Chinese (local & migrated). They only have limited choices of canned beer but cheaper (taxfree) relative to the Malaysian mainland. Restrooms are paid public across the road but clean & attended. Would make this my go-to restaurant for future visits.Show less

Author: typ1226
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: Been here for the first time. The waiters and waiteress are superb and efficient in carry out their job. The seafood is very fresh and delicious. The price is very affordable compared to the portion of the food.

Author: norkhairiahaKampung Subang Baru, Malaysia
Title: Good and cheap seafood
Review: Looking for a good seafood place in Kuah you should try out this place. I went twice for dinner and on both occasion the food was delicious and reasonably priced. On the first day we had Asam style fried siakap, kailan cook with garlic, squid fritters, butter tiger prawn, omelette and garlic lobster. The dinner for 6 person cost us RM330. On the second night we had fried siakap with soya sauce, kam keong prawn, vegetable soup, kailan garlic, salted egg squid and omelette for 5 person which cost us RM180. The service is fast especially if of peak time after 9pm.Show less

Author: sybariteAylmerGatineau, Canada
Title: As good as they all say
Review: Very busy indeed but we'll organised You line up to give your order. As soon as it is given you are assigned a table. Overall within 20 to 30 minutes your food is on the table. Everything is cooked after you order so extra fresh. Amazing crab,( a little small) and delicious clam soup all at a very reasonable price. Show less

Author: anwaralfayiz
Title: Big like
Review:
I like the food its very delicious
They don’t have bread all staff friendly I will visit this place every time

Author: Priteshshah74West Horsley, United Kingdom
Title: Simply stunning!
Review: A gastronomic delight! Wonderful food at a great price. Four of us ate for £25 which included a mud crab in a sweet and sour sauce - wow! Look past the setup when you first see, adds to the experience. Tip: take your own tissues if you are having the crab, a messy experience which makes it taste even better!Show less

Author: BenedetoM1
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Best Quality, best price and awesome service!! We ordered plenty of food and it came in less than 15 mins. The restaurant was completely filled with happy customers.

Author: Mark DPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best Seafood & Best Prices!!
Review: This is NOT a "food store"... BUT is a super restaurant/place [located in Kuah-- the main city in Langkawi], if one likes to eat "local style" with fish/seafood their speciality [but there are also chicken dishes, fried rice, french fries],,, and all dishes are prepared very well. As it opens only at 6PM, and is very popular with locals as well as travellers, it is very busy until later in the evening. However, the food is prepared and served hot and the turnover of tables is pretty fast. The food is very good and the choices- mainly Asian and Malaysian- at lower prices than almost all other comparable restaurants. It is definitely a very worthwhile place... and you will also remember it!I hope that this Review has been helpful.Show less

Author: michbaz
Title: Good Chinese
Review: If staying in kuah this is definitely worth the visit we liked it so much we ate here 3 times in our 7 day visit , great Chinese for really cheap price and quick service

Author: simone6789Melbourne, Australia
Title: Decent food, but beware queues
Review: Food here is pretty good - not amazing - but really good value. Probably one of the cheapest seafood meals we've had during our trip to Malaysia. We had steamed fish, chilli crabs, baby kailan, salted egg calamari and butter prawns. The chilli crabs were not great - would suggest trying a different sauce. Everything else was delicious. One thing to be aware of is you will have to queue up for a table, so perhaps think twice if taking kids here. That said it was kid friendly and there were plenty of families dining here. We waited about 20 mins. Service was super quick once you order though - they take your order when you get close to the front of the queue. The staff were very efficient, and helpful. Show less

Author: Venuslowly
Title: Worth to eat !
Review: Very yummy and worthy try to this local seafoods restaurant,  very fresh and delicious every dishes,  please come early as today we came ard 7pm,  it was long queue.

Author: Nick C
Title: Great food
Review: Had dinner with my family and all enjoyed! Good service, great food, cheap drinks. No wonder it's busy all the time!

Author: amyrosylily
Title: Great food at great price!
Review: Environment is very local, sit in half open area. Very efficient service. just order whatever you want and the waiter will recommend the right portion to make sure you are not ordering too much ;)

Author: avadnani
Title: Super Place
Review: Amazing sea food with local taste. you will have to queue or wait to get it, however it is worth it. It reasonably priced, service is good and the place is neat and clean. Would recommend

Author: APBnew
Title: VERY GOOD RESTAURANT
Review: It was very interesting to dinner two times in this restaurante, because the food (fish especially) was first quality, and the service very efficient, with a normal price. We were to much pleased knowing the two brothers owning  and managing this interesting place of restauration.

Author: EmmeCY
Title: Good affordable seafood, lacks WOW factor.
Review:
Went there around 6pm for dinner so the crowd was still slow. Service was quick and friendly.

Food was nice and all but nothing too impressive if you have tried seafood in Sabah/Sarawak.

Author: 469elvinc
Title: Great & cheap seafood restaurant
Review:
Great food, had to wait for a bit but overall experience is fantastic. Love the squid cooked with salted egg, oyster egg, veg & clam soup. Overall rating for the food is 9.9/10. 
- 0.1 because of the wait. Haha XD

Author: chanlilKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh seafood at reasonable price
Review: We visited the place twice and both dinners were good.Seafood was fresh and there are different ways of cooking. Price was reasonable. We reached the restaurant before 7pm and there was already a queue to wait for your table and place order. It was worth the wait.For the second visit, we reached there around 5:45pm and there were already a few tables occupied. If you wish to try fresh crab, be there early as they only have limited quantity.Show less

Author: Voyage814482
Title: Nice food and good service
Review: Fresh seafood with reasonable price and good service. Definitely worth it! Make sure to make a reservation before you come when you visit langkawi at peak season.

Author: Moonchild444Sydney, Australia
Title: Cheap seafood.. but beware of MSG
Review: My partner and I dined here twice. The second time was to give benefit of the doubt. We ordered -whole lobster with Kam heong sauceFried squid Stir fried prawnsFried riceMixed vegetables The kam heong sauce was too overpowering for the delicate lobster. The fried squid was ok. The fried rice and vegetables were lovely.Our second visit we ordered lobster in garlic butter and,disappointingly, it too was overwhelmed by sauce.. a little goes a long way! However, on our second visit, the undeniable use of MSG in these dishes left us feeling a little queasy & thirsty topped off with a whole night of insomnia. Show less

Author: jackwee78Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful food & great value for money
Review: Had dinner with my wife n 6yr old. We ordered 1) fried mixed vegetables2) soup3) garlic prawns4) salted egg crabs5) drinksThe crabs were live and we were encouraged to choose our own crabs from the big orange bin. We chose 2. Food were delicious, service was fast and despite it being quite packed, our order were served in less than 20mins. Will visit again soon.Show less

Author: spiderhopper
Title: Good food
Review: Good food and friendly people. This place has the best Chinese food in Langkawi. Go early as it gets crowded. Food serving is big.

Author: GertrudePicklesAdelaide, Australia
Title: Great food at a reasonable price
Review: This restaurant is worth the wait in a queue for a table. Fantastic food and the staff are amazing in dealing with large numbers of patrons. The duty free wine shop across the road is handy to buy wine to enjoy with a meal. We returned the very next night and booked a table this time to ensure we didn't miss out.Show less

Author: Aslam_SaleethLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best seafood in town
Review: One of the best and most delicious seafood you can find in Langkawi!! Although it’s packed and have to wait for some times to get a seat but totally worth it and hard to get up after their delicious food!! Highly recommended place for seafood!! Must try Show less

Author: LindyD90
Title: Great food, great service!
Review: The food is amazing with great service. Highly recommend this restaurant! Just ask the taxi driver to take you there! 👍

Author: fabandnatCrans-pres-Celigny, Switzerland
Title: The most defined Malaysian food of the holidays
Review: very friendly staff who helped us find a restaurant when Wonderland was fully booked. So we booked for the next day and were not disappointed. All our dishes had something special. Nothing was overpowered by spices letting us enjoy the varied tastes of the chef’s cooking. My wife and daughter ‘s seebass was exquisite. My squid was also fresh and soft. All portions were large. We thoroughly enjoyed our diner and evening.Show less

Author: ychaos
Title: Good price good food
Review: Pretty fair pricing and good quality food. Service was also pretty good as well. However, it’s outdoor and very casual. If you’re looking for good quality food this is the place!!

Author: Sagar423
Title: Best seafood in town
Review: The food in this restaurant was so delicious that we came here almost everyday. My kids loved their food a lot and even after all these months they keep asking for food they ate in wonderful. During weekends it gets crowded so, you may have to wait for sometime. Lime garlic steamed fish was to die for. Tiger prawn, butter prawn, Lobster, mud crab etc. were yummy. The portion was good enough. The price was very reasonable and after having meals in few other restaurants we could say this was the best. Be prepared to wait for half an hour or more if you are visiting at peak hours. Must try restaurant if you are in Kuah.Show less

Author: ShazyeanSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner super satistying
Review: This restaurant is really good, recommend for sure. It is also serves no pork. The family stayed at Dayang Bay and were looking for a cheap but good place to go for dinner. We found this gem. The ordering was really good and useful. He sized the meal well balancing, the best is we had fish, squid, prawns, clams up to 10 dishes for 9 people and it cost us RM250! That was like RM27 per person. To top it off the food was really tasty. Show less

Author: judescottphotoKuching, Malaysia
Title: Slow and food average
Review: Was eager to come due to the review given. I don't mind the queue but after order is taken, it took more than one hour for the food come. Food on the other hands, were not worth waiting for. Tasted average. For me this place is over rated. Show less

Author: TravelBulletin
Title: The B-E-S-T
Review:
The cheapest seafood in town. Can't beat the price and the staff's service is good as well.

In terms of food wise, extremely fresh. Moderate in cooking style thou.

Author: SummitSeekingSherpaIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Evening Meal
Review: Despite being busy and full to the brim the local staff always make me feel welcome here. It took them less than a minute to set a small table for us in an adequate space between some other tables.Our order was taken just as promptly and attentively and we were left to chat over our cold drinks that also arrived promptly.The wait for the food was rather longer than we would have liked as two hungry hikers but given how busy they were it was totally understandable. When it arrived it did not disappoint and nothing was left which is perfect testimony to the not just the service but the cooking capability of this typically bustling local restaurant.All in all this is a must place visit to dine at and typifies all the great things about Malaysian food.Show less

Author: moeyh007Auburn, Australia
Title: Great Seafood at a reasonable price
Review: Came to this place after receptionist at my hotel suggested it. Also they had good ratings on trip advisor.We ordered steamed fish, lobster and a few other dishes. The food was great. The lady that servrd us was excellent. Unfortunately I came to this place at the end of my holiday.Will definitely come back here again. Great ttasty seafood and not very expensive at all.Show less

Author: abhishek1285
Title: Awesome food at reasonable price
Review: The steamed red snapper with Nyonya sauce was simple awesome. We also had butter garlic prawn which was good. The service is very fast. The people were very courteous and helpful in explaining and suggesting the food.

Author: Silverpig2Bacup, United Kingdom
Title: Great place for good grub
Review: Our taxi driver recommended this place & we had seen the good reviews on here.Lots of tables outside and obviously a hit with the locals.We had menus brought over by nice friendly staff.We ordered Seabass,Tiger Prawns ,Vegetables,Rice and Chilli Crab.Service was pretty quick and the food was amazing.Very tasty and good price.I can highly reccomend this place and it was very busy which is also a good sign.There's a sink outside to wash your hands which was needed after eating the crab with our fingers.Show less

Author: 99Tifanny
Title: Fresh seafood and reasonable price
Review: This place is crowdy on weekend, especially dinner time always a long queue, so make sure go earlier if possible. Their food is delicious and fresh! Local, tourist, Malay, Indian.. is there everywhere so can see that this place is famous for all ppl, must give a try when you visit to Langkawi.Show less

Author: VintageWernerLudwigshafen, Germany
Title: Wonderful food at Wonderland Food Store
Review: During our trip to Langkawi we went several times for dinner at Wonderland Food Store. The environment is simple but the food and service was always great. We had mostly seafood (very fresh!) dishes but also some with e.g. chicken. All were very tasty and authentic. Good value for the money. Strongly recommended :-)Show less

Author: nuriamdiaz
Title: Great fresh food and and affordable price
Review: Great staff and fast service.Crab,squids.prawns and lobsters are fresh and perfect cook.Affordable and nice terrace.Most clients were locals.Well worth a try or two.

Author: tsun006
Title: Fast and Furious
Review: Great food delivered to your table with quick efficient service and a fast paced atmosphere. Very friendly staff, great value for money. Must go. Had the fish fillets, chicken black pepper and egg noodles, all great. Cheap Beer too ($1 USD)

Author: Stephanie C
Title: Food is cheap and delicious
Review: We are lucky to get seats immediately when we arrive at 730pm and saw long queue after that. We ordered 2 salted egg crabs, 1 fish, 1 vegetables, 4 tiger prawns for 2 person with drinks and rice.It cost MYR 180 which is at least more than half of price of orkid kia.The lobster is MYR20 per 100g. The salted egg crab is marvellous. Should go and eat if you want to try seafood.Show less

Author: Cbrowne23Barwon Heads, Australia
Title: A great authentic Malaysian seafood experience...a cheap beer.
Review: Such a great place! Awesome vibe! Lovely staff who speak perfect English and provide honest tips regarding the food. A must visit when you’re in Langkawi. PS: the crispy squid is amazing!!! PPS: ask the host to arrange a taxi home. He offered this service and our trip home was effortless. CheersShow less

Author: ShallineeRSungai Petani, Malaysia
Title: Long wait but great food and service !
Review: We too, alike many, found this via Tripadvisor. The food is tasty. The service is good too. They will attend to you soonest possible, find you a table for seating and take orders. The drinks arrive pretty fast. However, the wait for the main course will be rather long. You may get tired of waiting and it may put you off a little, but trust me, the food is tasty and flavourful. Lighting is dim so find a well lit spot and avoid the tables by the river where mosquitos swarm freely. Also, try to go earlier possible to beat the crowd and waiting time. Pricing is very very reasonable in comparison to many other Chinese seafood eateries. The place is also somewhere easily accessible in Kuah town and Waze should bring you there easily, if you are driving. Show less

Author: Grace CMalaysia
Title: Be prepared to wait
Review: Reading the reviews on TripAdvisor, we make a trip to this place when we were in Langkawi for holiday. However very disappointed. We had to wait for 11/2 hours for food, there's no lighting bright enough to see your food, plenty of mosquito, food under seasoning. The only perks is price is reasonableShow less

Author: agerrardSydney, Australia
Title: Cheap and Tasty
Review: We ate here twice for dinner. We were staying at the Westin but thought this place was better given the amount of locals who were frequenting here with friends and family. We ate like kings (prawns, clams, mixed here, steamed rice plus two tigers) for around 50RMWould definitely visit again. Show less

Author: ivonneloiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Normal Chinese zi char
Review: Nothing fantastic. Just normal Chinese zi char. It is cheap though. Go early, avoid dinner time. Otherwise it's going to be a long wait. Please queue up and dont just take any available table. It does not work this way. The signature chili crab is very sweet instead of spicy. Not recommended. Show less

Author: jeffreyo450
Title: Nice food
Review: Lovely economy seafood with fast service the seafood is fresh . Parking is a bit problem . Place is clean

Author: TanJC
Title: Best cheap eat in Kuah town
Review: The restaurant offer a good food with definitely cheap price. That's why you need to queue for hours for table during the peak hours. Suggest make a phone call to reserve a table to reduce the waiting time and reduce your bad mood.

Author: AL1084Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great food, however lots and lots and lots of waiting
Review: Excellent food with lots of wok-hei, super busy kitchen and lots of enthusiastic customers, however be brave for the waiting time can be more than 1.5 hours. Must queue to order, then must queue for table allocation, and then must again wait for food, and once more must wait for bill to come ... hence if you want good food = must wait and queue ...Price is reasonable in my view.Show less

Author: David-Traveller15Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Dinner shouldn't MISSED
Review: Been there twice.. On the 1st day the store was full house and long queues. Have to go back on the 2nd day. Reached at 5.50pm, only left 2 tables available. Most of the tables are being reserved and guest already start eating.This food store price are reasonable and food also delicious. So shouldn't miss this dinner if visit Langkawi Island. Open from 6pm to 11pm. It's good make reservation in advance. Show less

Author: FujiwaraY8
Title: Fresh Seafood and Reasonable Price!
Review: My friend recommend here to have dinner on the first day of our trip.Luckily we reach there at 6.00pm,still have a lot of seat.Its quiet a long quene after 7.00pm.One of the menu we order is Lime Steam Fish(forget the name but something like this),is very delicious and fresh!The price for seafood is very reasonable.We decide to have our dinner here on the second day too.But is too bad cant make reservation there.Will go again in futureShow less

Author: sunnybatuKuching, Malaysia
Title: Never Disappointed
Review: Read a lot review stated this is the best in Langkawi so we decided to give it a try, We reach there at 7.40pm but there was a queue up for table at this restaurant. But it take around 15 mins to get our table. We ordered the food before we sit down at out table. We ordered omelette, steam red snapper, fried beehoon with seafood, sweet and sour chicken, crispy squid, Yao mat, baby kailan. The steam fish is overcooked but the taste is still good. The chicken and fried beehoon were in average standard, suggest not to order. We heard neighbor table said should order Oatmeal prawn. We haven;t tried yet but will come back for this soon. The staffs quite friendly and the ordered food delivered to our table ard 30 mins. But it was so hot that day. We enjoy our food with sweating in hot weather. The price really very friendly.Show less

Author: spunkymonky
Title: Best Seafood in Langkawi
Review: Wonderland seafood is a must when in Langkawi. Hands down one of the best seafood joints I’ve been to. The food is delicious and although being packed you get your food really quick.

Author: Shane BGeelong, Australia
Title: Brilliant! Welcoming!
Review: We had an amazing meal at this popular local restaurant. The staff/owners were amazing and very happy for us to bring a bottle of white with us. Hidden on the chair next to me of course! All of the food was so good! We will return!Show less

Author: mucip_bontang
Title: YOU HAVE TO TRY IT!!!
Review:
Meal was good, came twice with different menu and all are great.
Price was cheap for seafood.
Service was excellent, as we are muslims and they prioritize us to Buka Puasa first.
Parking lot and restaurant space need to improve somehow.

Author: serene_tanshAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Highly recommended tasty with cheap price.
Review: An authentic local Chinese restaurant which served most seafood and the price is like half of the price offered in Cenang. You can see the crow start q ING to get number to have their seats. Most important the foods re super tasty with very reasonable price.Show less

Author: Penny GRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent, genuinely old style Far East restaurant.
Review: This is a restaurant that still holds the unique atmosphere and character sadly long forgotten by most modern Far East eating establishments.Each and every night it is packed which bears testament to just how popular it is and so it should be.Superb food at reasonable prices. A must place to visit.Show less

Author: Cosmopolitan808986Suwon, South Korea
Title: Highly recommended!!
Review: Butter fried prawns , crispy fried squidAnd Kam heong clams(spicy)were really good with Reasonable price!All staffs were helpful and kind. The one who seemed to be the owner of this restaurant was really friendly and helpful(explained kindly about the food menu and the amount of seafood grams so I wouldn’t order too much)I will definitely visit again tomorrow :)친절하고 맛있어요~저는 메뉴포장해서 먹었어요. 버터프라이 새우 꼭 드시구요!Kam heong 스타일 조개는 맵고 맛있어요 레몬그라스랑 바질잎이 들어있어요.(허브류 거부감 없으신분들에게 추천합니다 신랑은 레몬그라스향 난다고 잘안먹었어요)오징어 튀김은 맛보라고 주셨는데 맛나더라구요! 그냥 오징어 튀김도 되고 매콤하게 해달라고하면 튀김자체를 매콤하게 해주시더라구요~사장님으로 보이시는 남자분이 있었는데 너무 친절하셨구요~제가 새우 그램수를 많이 잡으니까 두명이서 너무많으니 우선 반만 시키고 모자라면 더 시키는게 어떻겠냐고 물어봐주시고 아니면 반은 버터프라이 반은 다른스타일로 주문하는게 어떤지 친절하게 물어봐주셨어요.늦은시간에 가서 게가 떨어졌네요~내일은 좀 더 일찍 방문할 예정입니다. 리조트에서 볶음밥 하나 룸서비스 시켰는데 서비스차지붙은 그 가격과 이곳에서 해산물 두개에 야채 하나 볶음밥하나 일반 밥 하나 시킨가격이랑 동일해요! 가격 진짜 굿~~~~Show less

Author: 880cindywChichester, United Kingdom
Title: Very good seafood
Review: We were recommended to eat at this place by our hotel The Danna. It's very busy so advisable to book. Packed with locals, a really authentic experience. Many tables under a tin roof overlooking the road so not glamorous but the food is just wonderful. The waiter suggested he halve the sea bass and we try 2 different sauces - brilliant idea - one with black bean and one garlic and ginger. We had chilli prawns and squid, local cabbage dish and fried rice, 2 beers and all for 111 rg! Very pleasant staff - great experience Show less

Author: Elaine R
Title: Terrific food
Review: Food served at the speed of light and so delicious and freshly cooked. Staff will organise taxi for you when you have had your meal. On one of the nights we went two monitor lizards could be seen in the river outside the restaurant.

Author: Chantellepartner
Title: Unexpected
Review:
If you want a busy, bonkers eating experience with fantastic fresh food this is the place for you 
Fine dining it ain’t. Just luvli authentic Chinese food on plastic chairs & tables at 100 mph 
The price is a pleasant surprise too

Author: Chandler L
Title: Value for money
Review: The food was good and cheap! Staff are very helpful and fast service. The place was packed with crowd when we were there however not waiting  too long for table. Transparent pricing on menu so wont be worry about overpricing food.

Author: SCT369Sungai Petani, Malaysia
Title: Taste Good & reasonable price
Review: It was 1st recommended by my colleague who visited Pulau Langkawi. I asked her if there's a place with good food and reasonable price. She recommended me this place and I went there on last Sunday. The place is packed with people due to the good rating but it is worth waiting for the food. The tastes are exquisite, they have the price on the menu to ease the customer to make decision on ordering the food. I will definitely eat at that food store again if there's another trip to Pulau Langkawi.Show less

Author: safety_pin11Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, good value
Review: Went there based on recommendations on trip advisor... got the hotel to help us call a taxi, and we were charged rm14 to go there. Was disappointed that the crabs were sold out, we were there at 6pm, ordered fried seabass with sweet & sour sauce, salted veg with tofu soup, fried soft shell crab, egg omelette, oyster omelette and clams with garlic and spring onion sauce. Service was excellent, able to speak English, food was good and tasty. Prices were reasonable, at only rm107 and we also had 2 beers and a fresh apple juice. Just be mindful that flies can be an issue.Show less

Author: phuiannlimPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Super cheap and tasty!
Review: We went two nights in a row because the food was so tasty and cheap! Staff are very helpful and fast service. Dinner time 8pm is super crowded. Business slow down around 9pm. Never afraid to get cheated if you are foreign tourist,all price stated on the menu. No tax or hidden charges. Seafoods are very fresh!Show less

Author: Esther LMalaysia
Title: nothing special
Review: We came due to the good rating but was a little disappointing. We asked the waiter for recommendation. He recommended salted egg squid but we find that it was so-so only.The steamed fish he recommended also nothing special.Environment is not so good. The staff are friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: Ronnie20182018West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: So glad we came
Review: Read the reviews and needed to go. Glad we did as food was just superb. Full of locals so must be good! Staff were really helpful and gave advice on which dishes to order. We had prawns, soft shell crab and red snapper all with sauces recommended by our waiter....not too spicy but very tasty. Washed down with a couple of beers. It was excellent and less than 100 myr! Will return before we go home. Show less

Author: 850petrv
Title: Excellent seafood
Review: Absolutely delicious, no more comments are needed. The visit is necessary if you are on Langkawi.….........................

Author: 1973MrTtravelsSingapore
Title: Nice dinner but nothing exciting
Review: After reading so many reviews I was determined to visit Wonderland before leaving Langkawi. It was very busy so the wait for good was a little longer than expected but entirely understandable. I couldn't order garupa as wanted as they were too large so ordered red snapper but got sea bass instead. Fish was lovely. Not nice being surrounded by tables of smokers though. Show less

Author: OhX5
Title: Dishonest food.
Review: We ordered red snapper and came out to be sea bass. When we asked for confirmation, the boss insisted that it was a red snapper. Not only that, fried oyster egg came out to be awful. There was only six pieces of oyster but it cost us RM20 which is ridiculous. The rest of the food were as well plain and small portion.Show less

Author: MilijanaZEdegem, Belgium
Title: Fresh food!
Review: We decided to come here for the lobster and ended up ordering the tiger prawns too. Both were really fresh and the flavours were very good. Don’t expect any high-end tourist restaurant, as this is a place where the local people eat, which makes this place even more appealing. Prices are very very fair. Definitely worth the trip from Cenang to Kuah. Show less

Author: basio
Title: Had to try, didn’t regret it
Review: 1st of all, I don’t like Fish!!! Like not all, but the restaurant had one of the best reviews I ever saw, so i couldn’t resist.What i loved about it, is that it was an authentic experience, it’s not fancy or elite, it’s a good local restaurant that you will have memories about trying it.We were 3, ordered 2 fish plates, crab, 2 rice plates, and sea soup. It costs us around 150 rem.Show less

Author: TrailBlazer675909
Title: Cheap But not great
Review: The food was cheap but it was not great seafood. Can’t complain much for the price we paid. Ordered the deep fried soft shell crab which came out slightly burnt therefore tasting a little bitter. We also ordered the Dried Chilli Mantis prawn that tasted like deep fried chicken instead of prawns & black pepper chicken which was ok. Overall it was a pleasant dinner.Show less

Author: Walid101Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: You will be surprised
Review: We were 2 families , total of 12 persons including kids, when we first walked into the place we started looking at each other whether to go back to the hotel, but we decided to stay and everyone ordered different dishes and fresh juices.It was just amazing food , as you you can see from the empty plates And the service was just perfect We visited the place twice during our stay in Langkawi , I think it’s one of the best seafood restaurants in the island Show less

Author: MattO533Melbourne, Australia
Title: There’s a reason people queue
Review: So happy to have made the way from Batu Ferringhi. We had soft shell crab, deep fried squid and amazing fish cooked in lime and ginger that blew me away. The hectic pace of the servers flying around between tables is great to watch. Locals and tourists alike all seem to love Wonderland and I’m happy to be one of those. Show less

Author: prime09
Review:
Fresh seafood..
Delicious..
Reasonable price..
Friendly & Efficient Staff..
You will not be disappointed..

Author: 932gretag
Title: Great Seafood & incredible sauces
Review: Cozy location by a river with very nice and friendly staff. The food was amazing for very reasonable prices. Especially the different sauces we had on our dishes were amazing. I would recommend this place to everyone who loves good seafood.

Author: Tun M
Title: Great food , quick & awesome service
Review: I was recommended by the locals to try this eating place as the food is good, and price is affordable. And it was not disappointing. The friendly waitress was helpful in recommending their signature dishes and portion to order since I travel solo. I ordered 3 dishes but she was kind enough to advice I better start with 2 first or I will end up getting my stomach burst. The food was reallyy good and the waitress was right.. the dishes ordered was just nice for me. Will definitely come again as it worth the money and the tummy.Show less

Author: Letranger90Hong Kong, China
Title: Well worth a visit from your beach resort
Review: We weren't the only visitors to Langkawi who tried this restaurant (the driver who picked us up from the airport recommended it, and while we were there, it got steadily busier with tourists, including from China and eastern Europe). We were all served briskly and efficiently, with the service extending to the staff even called a taxi for us on the local Uber service. The food was cheap and good, and the visiting cats well fed too.Show less

Author: Marie RUnited Kingdom
Title: Not to my expectation
Review: With all the hype, we decided to try it on our last night in langkawi. They serve only seafood, no other meat on the menu.I found the vegetable dish expensive for small portion- MR12.I find seafood in Penang better and cheaper than in Langkawi. Show less

Author: BriguszBudapest, Hungary
Title: Wonderland is wonderous
Review: My first impression of the place was: No, I don’t want to eat there... but, then I saw the many many people and family havng fun around the tables, and the fully tabled restaurant terrace, then I had no choice I have to try this place. And, it was AMAZING!!! The waiters are gentle, fast and very kind. The food, I can not describe it by words, you have to try this place!Show less

Author: RichardStevenson1960Doncaster, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous Food
Review: Having seen the reviews on trip advisor we visited this restaurant on our first night in Langkawi and it was fantastic!!!! We ate a full Sea Bass, lobster, prawns and all the trimmings and it came to 200RM (£40), not the cheapest we have eaten but for the food we got it was very cheap. We returned again today for a second meal and once again it was fabulous. Staff are all friendly and the service is speedy, it has to be for the number of people that eat there, just don’t expect any luxury - it’s basic but we can’t recommend this place enough, probably one of the best restaurants I have ever eaten at!!!!Show less

Author: twilightdiver
Title: Get there early!
Review: Wonderland is something of a local phenomenon! If you don't get there at 6.00 pm you may well join a queue for a table! Very popular with the locals which says a lot! Had a pleasant meal at  a reasonable price.

Author: Wei Hao LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Affordable and quality Chinese food
Review: Service was prompt and crew was polite. Food was served rather fast despite the crowd. However I think its quite popular so may have to wait for 20mins to get a seating. Definitely worth the wait and I will come back for more. I included the recept for reference. For the fish the waiter even recommended to do it 2 kinds of cooking method. Superb! A must go restaurant. Show less

Author: okopcanada
Title: Had to try the place out
Review: So after reading all the reviews we had to try this place out the first night in Langkawi. We took GRAB from the Westin and arrived at around 6:20 - I believe they open at 6:00 and within 15 mintues of us being there the place was packed......people waiting to be seated.This place is the average out door local eatery so if you are looking for something fancy that is super clean and the area does not smell that this is not the place! LOL. We first ordered a few beers which were cheap compared to anywhere else and just relaxed for bit.We ordered some rice, vegetables to share - I ordered breaded shrimp which were kind of soggy and small - I expected some larger shrimp for sure. My wife ordered lobster - he has asked how she wanted it made and she said buttered/grilled.......something to that effect. it came almost battered and deep fried or something? ....and wasn't really that cheap if I recall.Anyway, we were glad we stopped by but didn't return - we were going to but just ended up not working out.When we left we found it very difficult to find a ride back to the hotel..I was running off of wifi and couldn't find any so we just started walking down the street and not one cab came by that we could flag down.It was starting to get dark and we ended up at the Gold Sands hotel just a block off of the main drag and I found wifi there outside and hailed a GRAB car.Show less

Author: lis_elle7Malaysia
Title: Good food at a good price
Review: Went there with a family of 6 adults and a baby. Honestly, I’ve tasted better seafood elsewhere in the world, but the price of the seafood here can’t be faulted and makes you feel good. Our main attraction was the lobster, which was cooked well. I personally loved the oyster omelette.The only drawback was the queue. We went there at 6.30pm and waited for approximately 7.30pm to be seated and another 30 minutes for all the food to be served. Considering I have a baby with me, I thought this feat was commendable. Not for the super hungry who wants food fast, anticipate to eat later.Show less

Author: DeniseKentSouth East England, United Kingdom
Title: A real experience.
Review: Ok its manic and there is always a queue. Join it as soon as you go in, dont waste time looking around for a table as you wont be given it. Be ready to give your order as they are so quick. We ordered a whole sea bass, king prawns in sweet and sour sauce, fried calamari, rice and noodles. This with 4 beers came to just under 100 ringits (around £20) Food is good but not amazing, but so cheap. Show less

Author: Sanasu
Title: lip smacking food at unbelievable price!!
Review: we found the reviews about this on trip-advisor and made sure to land here on the first evening at Langkawi...omg..can the food get better?? no!! the variety and the taste will give you foodargsm !!

Author: LEE_SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food for a good price
Review: A must go food experience. But be prepared for long wait and crowded tables. If you can tolerate the wait, you will not be disappointed. Chance to try a wide variety of seafood without burning a hole in your pocket. Great place for family outdoor dining.Show less

Author: DoraYeapNagoya, Japan
Title: Reasonably priced seafood with average taste
Review: Visited the store on a friend's recommendation.Lucky to get a table without having to wait as we went early.Go later than 7PM and you can expect a 15-30mins queue(not worth the queue, to be honest)One should try out their PRAWN specialty.Other dishes are average at best and you can certainly find better seafood elsewhere.Prices are very reasonable at 'local price' although tourists make up to more than 90% of the clientele.Show less

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Authentic service
Review: Food is either good or very good- depending on individual taste.One dish went wrong- possibly the chef forgot the seasoning for the fried rice. The manager was kind to not charge for that one dish.Needless to say- they had wait staff who took time to hear what you like & to plan the menu with you. Show less

Author: KristiH433Beijing, China
Title: Best seafood on the island!
Review: We stayed in Kuah for five nights and ate at Wonderland for four. All the food is amazing an you can get it cooked a variety of style an sauces. We had the whole fish, clams, squid, prawns, mantis prawns, soup, mud crabs, fried rice, oyster omelette, and a few types of fresh juice. I highly recommend the mantis prawns with the dry chili sauce: it was so yummy! The services also very friendly. They are very busy, so if you need something, don't be afraid to stop anybody just walking by.Show less

Author: marinbalaicOsijek, Croatia
Title: Fresh street food
Review: Busy safood restaurant that looks rather unimpressive but food is good, prices are low and overall impression is very positive. We waited a bit longer for our orders (around 45 mins) because it was a busy night but our food was really enjoyable. I went around it to shoot some footage of food being prepared in the kitchen, everything was fresh and they are impressive team. I definitely recommend to everyone. Show less

Author: rcroweDublinDublin, Ireland
Title: good street food
Review: went here on TA advice, its really a streetside café with really quick service and fresh seafood. We had starters mains and a drink for small money. If you want a fresh seafood meal cheap then you cant go wrong. Try to it away from the river as it can be quite smellyShow less

Author: Yags81Sydney, Australia
Title: An abundance of seafood
Review: We came here for Dinner with family, there were 14 of us in total so made a booking luckily we did because the place was packed, we ordered a huge amount of food which inlcuded crab, fish, calamari, pippis, fried rice, and more all the food came out hot and tasty had a really nice dinner overall. Its not 5 a star restaurant more like an outdoor diner but the seafood was very tasty and satisfying plus our waiter Michael was awesome. This place is definitely worth a try only thing is if your coming in the evening bring mosquito repelant.Show less

Author: MandM5960Lancaster, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding food
Review: Forget the setting think only of the great food. The owner discusses how best he can cook the food for you when he comes to take your order. We wanted fish but neither a whole fish steamed or fried, solution split fish and do half and half. Even better he gave us sauce separate so we could enjoy a little or as much as we wanted. Also tried oysters with egg, it was basically an omellete but it was really good with chili sauce. Also tried the prawns fried with chili and garlic only can be described as"wow". Key here is not to be afraid to ask any questions or concerns you have. For sure you'll get a meal tailored to what you want you'll enjoy it much better. Don't miss out and not visit one of the very best.Show less

Author: viktorm990
Title: The best dinner in Lagkawi
Review: This was the best meal we had in Langawi ever. Very fast, very good and waiter was very helpful. I recommend it.

Author: ShahiedCTCape Town, South Africa
Title: What an Interesting Eating Experience
Review: I read about this place when researching our holiday in Langkawi 2-3 months ago, so glad we did not miss the opportunity to dine here.We were vacationing in Cenang and was on a drive exploring the island when passing Kuah late afternoon, I set the gps to wonderland for supper, and drove right past when I saw the restuarant, was kind of disappointed, looks can be very deceiving, unless you knew about it, you may give it a miss. My wife asks me why I drove past, and I say "it does not look so good", but she made me stop and go back. It was 5pm and they were still preparing, so we looked at the menu, made our choices, and as they open at 6pm, went to the duty frees in town. On our way back after 6:30pm the place was almost packed with guests.Then we were greeted with tables loaded with all kinds of amazing looking things.We are small eaters and ordered soft shell crab, mantis shrimp, squid and seafood rice, as we have never had the first 2, and wanted to try and come back again if we were happy. It was really little money well spent on food that we enjoyed so much more. What we liked was the freshness, easy fuss free eating style, portion size options making it possible to try many dishes without having to waste. We drove back the next evening for some of those whole fish & prawn dishes we saw on the other tables, but to our disappointment they were closed for a few days just after new year. Our bill was under RM60 including cooldrinks.Show less

Author: sunnykhandelwal5Nagpur, India
Title: Fast moving, value for money, not the best ambience. Overall 7/10
Review: This is a fast moving, busy restaurant in Kuah. The ambience is not great, from outside it looks like a shady place. But the food is great. Its very cheap, very good in terms of value for money. Make sure you go here early. They dont take any reservations I believe. Its first come first serve. The sea food variety and taste are both top notch. Its an open kitchen. If you're a vegetarian or hindu by religion and are not used to the smell of the seafood, avoid going here, coz you can see the kitchen, and you can also see lobsters on other people's tables which are quite close by haha! Anyways, if you're a sea food lover, you will really relish this place! EnjoyShow less

Author: jennajewelworcestershire
Title: good but not amazing
Review: so this place is hyped by many travellers, and yes, it's good but defiantly not amazing (in my opinion). we were set up with a table outside of the undercover eating area, right next to the canal! which we didn't realise until the odour rose every so often... the restaurant is very very very busy, and queues form from time to time. the waiters work very hard trying to cover all of the covers. Our order was brought out in 3 different stages over a period of about 5 minutes (we eventually got hold of a waiter and pointed out that one of the main dishes had not arrived). The food we had was good with nothing to complain about, but on the other hand nothing to shout out about either. Prices are probably a little too high for this type of eatery. portion size, mmmm ok, not large, although there is the choice as with most places to order small, medium or large portions. so I guess you could say they do actually reflect this.Show less

Author: randipb0304Malmo, Sweden
Title: Amazing food! Left us licking the plate and our fingers.
Review: The perfect friendly, chaotic and hawkerish Malaysian experience, with absolutely amazing food to complete the five star review they thoroughly deserve.We ordered lots of different thing during our 3 visits and everything was in the range of delicious to jaw dropping. The kind of food I won't forget for years to come.Show less

Author: VaskarUDhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Fresh and Tasty Seafood
Review: We had butter-prawn and sweet and sour fried red snapper, some vegetables, small portion of fried rice and two lime drinks. Food were excellent. All the items were fresh. Quantity were way more than enough for two of us. With all these items the bill didn't even cross RM 80.Show less

Author: only1invillageLondon
Title: Tasty, cheap, wide variety of seafood
Review: Recommended by a Malaysian friend in England. Got there at 6.15pm to get a table. By 7pm, people were queuing to get a seat.Wide variety of styles to cook the fish and seafood, from steamed to deep fried. Soft shell crabs a favourite. Steamed snapper was tasty. Good, friendly, fast service. Veggie dishes and tofu dishes were not too salty and gloopy. Rice and noodles not too greasy. Wanted to come again but it was shut on the Wednesday night. Not sure if this is a regular thing or just bad weather shut them down for the Wed night. Cheapish prices, not outrageous. 180 MYR for 5 people who can eat a lot!Show less

Author: Mikhail_IstariSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cheap, tasty seafood
Review: I arrived here close to 7pm and the restaurant was already almost full. Luckily we only had 2 people and manage to get a table immediately but we had to wait quite a while to get our food. Queues were already forming after 7pm, so I recommend others to come down earlier at 6pm or make a reservation with them. Staff were very busy but are friendly. The food was great for me and cheap compared to other places. Would definitely come here again.Show less

Author: antliewtyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not be mistaken the one at the main road with almost the same name
Review: There a restaurant nearby almost the same name. But it's not the same. Food court kind. We thought it still not ready to open when we were there at 5:45 pm. But actually we are at the wrong location. When we get to the actual place, we have to go through a long queue of waiting customer.Food wise is cheap and reasonable. Taste wise it's just okay for me. But still lots of fun. And good seafood at kuah city.Show less

Author: nuurulmaulidya
Title: Love their Flower crabs
Review: I would say this is the best seafood restaurant in Langkawi. We always here for their steam ginger flower crabs (depends on the availability), it's cheap! My husband loves the sambal sotong as it's always fresh and generously amount served on your plate. Now didn't go there as heard it's not the flower crab seasons.Show less

Author: markgK3725PU
Title: Fantastic food you might have to queue but it's worth wait
Review: Best food experience in Langkawi really good quality and v cheap authentic Chinese fair in a great atmosphere

Author: markwho
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review: among the local restaurant they offered the best valued food.  They were honest on what's good and fresh on the menu.  Prices are very reasonable.  They were able to accommodate to use non peanut oils for all dishedd..

Author: Lou JGodalming, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh food, tasty and very cheap.
Review: If this place hadn't been recommend to us we probably would have driven straight by ( it's really nothing to look at) - plastic tables and chairs under a cover. No reservations so you join a queue for a table. Fresh ingredients, freshly cooked Chinese food, mainly seafood but plenty of other options too( no alcohol served). We ate here twice during our stay, the second time whilst waiting for a table the children went to pick out which crabs they would like to eat and unfortunately there were told they'd run out of them. About 20 minutes later the manager came running over to tell us they'd managed to get more fresh crab - nice touch. The lobster here was divine. The first meal was about £22 for 4 of us. The second (with large lobster) was about £70 for the 5 of us (we ordered too much food). Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Officially_Sanjay
Title: Over-rate Seafood
Review:
The food is over-cooked. We had the spicy mantis prawn and they smouldered with dough which was not cooked properly

We also had the steam lime chilli seabass and it was sweet

Author: Hongmei26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Overrated...
Review: We went with a family of 13 on our first day of arrival at Langkawi as a results of great reviews. The place was packed and we have to queue for at least 30-45 mins for the table.The food is just so-so. We had many better food in our next few days in Kuah. Quite disappointed with the food.Show less

Author: _C759FQ
Title: Wonderland is seafood land
Review: 1st time come to Langkawi island.everyone are kind,friendly and funny.This restaurant is same.Staffs are recommended a lot of fresh seafoods.I recommend cram soup with ginger and onion.

Author: Philip CAdelaide, Australia
Title: Good flavour, cheap, don’t go hungry
Review: Excellent food and price. Flavours are great. Just don’t go hungry. Lines start forming straight after hey open at 6pm and even after ordering you’ll be faced with a 40-60min wait for food. Service is good. It is an outdoor restaurant. Quality of seafood is good, with much of it fresh on he day. Show less

Author: SoniaHromadova
Title: Amazing food, Amazing price
Review: We was visit this restaurant many times and we enjoy it a lot of. Perfect taste, fresh food, friendly people, good price. Thank you guys

Author: Cutiehoney16
Title: Average
Review: Heard from friend that this is a quite nice restaurant, but actually just a normal restaurant provide seafood, not so nice but also not bad, average.

Author: evalA317RA
Title: Reasonable price and tasty food
Review: We like the seafood there, visited twice during our holiday. This food store is quite popular In Langkawi so we have to wait for the food at least half an hour after ordering but it’s still worth.

Author: dominico789Hong Kong, China
Title: Good seafood but not expensive
Review: Being recommended by local friends from Langkawi, we went to Wonderland Foodstore at 7pm. There was a queue waiting for tables. It was full house at that time. We waited for 20 minutes before getting a table but people came around 8pm had to wait for more than 30 minutes before getting seats. The food was reallly good especially the red snapper fish was fresh and steamed just perfect. I was surprised the prices were so reasonable. Value for money. Worth waiting to get the table. We planned to come again before our departure this week.Show less

Author: chiawingkeong
Title: Good service
Review: Nice staff and good service. Value for money fresh seafood although it is not live. Book the place first as it is crowded.

Author: LastingWanderSingapore
Title: Wonderland Food
Review: This is the seafood restaurant most of the locals we spoke to recommended. Apparently, Hole in the Wall used to be the top recommendation, but Wonderland now takes the top spot.We reached there at about 7pm and the place was already packed. But we managed to get a seat pretty quickly. I must say that the staff work very quickly here, resulting in a fast turn over of tables. We ordered the sweet and sour fish, fried butter prawns, dried chili prawns, oyster sauce kailan and tofu with vegetables. To be honest, the taste of the food was nothing to crow about, though we especially liked the kailan. Nonetheless, the food was decent and fresh. Further, all that food (and one drink each) only ran us RM80. So, it was definitely value for money. Overall, it's worth a trip down for cheap decent seafood.Show less

Author: Simin S
Title: Long waiting time with substandard food
Review:
We waited for about 1.5hours for our food. There were soooo many people visiting the venue every day. The famously fried butter prawn was tasteless. The fish was fresh tho. Overall it was cheap. RM135 for 7pax. 

Not worth the wait totally.

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Simply Wonderful
Review: Had my dinner here recently and found this Chinese seafood restaurant quite crowded even at 6pm. Food was slightly heavy handed on salt but all the dishes tasted good and fresh. Try their flowers and mud crabs .one word of advice is sit away from the riverbanks because sometimes it smells. Overall will come back again Show less

Author: Repokettu58
Title: One of the best seafood restaurant in area
Review: Had family dinner for 2 adults and 3 kids, as it’s very popular prepare to wait for a table. Nice and tasty food

Author: JohnKL89Kuala Lumpur
Title: Excellent service but so-so food
Review: This place was crowded with people willing to queue. I must say the food is very reasonably priced and quite worth it. However, I thought the cooking style was only average but perhaps we did not order the right dishes (our squid was deep fried and mantis prawn also laden with heavy sauce so it's hard to say if the seafood was fresh). They had a really good queue system and people were seated pretty fast despite the crowd. I would recommend a visit for the low prices but perhaps try and order the steamed seafood to test their freshness.Show less

Author: JennLSingapore
Title: Dinner
Review: Popular with the locals n tourists because they are reasonably priced n the food is above average. Opens at 6pm. Long queue starts from 6.30pm. Outdoor only. Vegetarian options available. Carpark nearby. Only has public toilet across the road. Not very wheelchair friendly but manageable if you can overcome the kerb, the narrow passage n a few steps. Situated by the river. Very breezy in December. Has other food outlets nearby if you don’t want to queue. Show less

Author: Sharon H
Title: Cheap and tasty food
Review: The food is cheap and taste good. Expect to wait. Quite disappointed with the crab as the size is quite small, hence not much meat. But the reasonable price made it worth a bisit

Author: monica2506Sydney, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: The food was great and very cheap. Great fast service too. I have a bit of a dodgy stomach and am always wary eating out overseas but can safely say this place was great! We ate there twice and enjoyed it both times and the owner booked us an Uber back to our hotel after we finished our meal both times. Show less

Author: tomwT9095YP
Title: Great Seafood
Review: Great food, fast service, good prices. Very busy until late at night, we arrived at 10pm and ate quickly.

Author: huanyinchanMalaysia
Title: Extremely reasonable but average food
