Review: If you are looking for life seafood, skip this place as the food quality is more like any others average food stall in Malaysia. The price is no doubt very reasonable but the taste of the food is very average at the same time- do not put very high expectations on the food. Show less

Author: Duncan Y
Title: Great food good value
Review: I love this place. Food is delicious. We enjoyed the soft shell crab, clams and squid... it got really busy really quick. I would get there early. The price is good and offer 3 sizes for most meals. With 2 and half people this allows us to try a few meals.Show less

Author: En0ckSydney, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: Plastic tables and chairs in an extremely busy, big, outdoor restaurant. You get fast efficient service with superb food at an amazing low price (for whole fish). If you haven’t booked it doesn’t matter - wait 5 minutes looking at the menu and you’ll be seated. This is simple fast wholesome Chinese food - don’t miss it. Show less

Author: 408yukaa
Title: Good seafood restaurant
Review: I had Butter fried prawn (S) 20 RM, Baby kailan (S) 10 RM and Tiger Beer 5 RM. It's great and staff were good. All dishes looked good :) They open at around 18:00.

Author: zs29
Title: Outstanding food
Review: Delicious local food in a no frills environment. Some of our favorites were Steamed Snapper, Squid, fried rice, and king prawns. Super affordable and definitely worth a visit!

Author: menu85
Title: So fresh and tasty
Review:
Found this place on trip advisor.
If you are in the neighbourhood make sure u drop by to try this amazing chinese seafood.
We had the salted mud crabs and the lemon steam fish.
Price was affordable.
Friendly and accomodating staff.
Would definately come back.

Author: mmmellissaaa
Title: Value for money
Review: Enjoyed my meal here. Be sure to go early before the crowd comes. Seems to be crowded even at 9-10pm! Ordered squid, prawns, soup, vegetables and rice for 2, bill came up to RM56. Highly recommended!

Author: Daniel D
Title: Amazing food!
Review: The tiger shrimp and the tamarind sauce is amazing. Theres not one bad thing about the food here. 100% recommend this place.

Author: Han953Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good choice of seafood
Review: We went there on Friday night around 8 pm and the restaurant is full, we took a queue for table and wait around one hour. Still have people coming in around 9 o'clock. Although waiting hour long but is worth it. The foods is so tasty. We spent around RM100 for four of us. Show less

Author: Sweetiebun
Title: It's a Wonder when u dine here...
Review: This Restaurant is always full and serves good Chinese food. Fast, reasonable and tasty food. It has always been recommended by many when visiting Langkawi.

Author: Pow_ExplorerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good choice of seafood in Langkawi
Review: The place was packed full and we have to queue for table but the staff was friendly. I'm impressed with the services of the staff, from ushering us to the queue and table, recommendation of food, the speed of cleaning the tables, until mending the roof when heavy rain hit us. Food comment, among the best in Langkawi and cheap seafood. Definitely will visit this place again.Show less

Author: christinecY5166CAKamakura, Japan
Title: Really overrated
Review: The restaurant staff are friendly and polite. But, the food there really average but not fanatic taste, probably not much choice in langkawi push up the rating. Also, the restaurant taking care Muslim customer, some dish style is exactly Malay’s way to cook the dish. Taste is ok but glad that one malaysia restaurant indeed. So, monitor your expectation and you will enjoy .....Show less

Author: SK1808London, United Kingdom
Title: Great recommendation!
Review: We went here last night after receiving 2 recommendations from different Uber drivers. The food was so so good. We had sea bass and squid. The place epitomises everything I love about South East Asia, basic establishment, great quick service and above all outstanding food for a great price!Show less

Author: kayathiric
Title: No Vegetarian Food in the menu
Review: We went to the restaurant as per tripadvisor reviews. Seafood dishes was delicious but for vegetarian options, they only serve vegetarian fried rice or vegetarian fried noodles, upon request. Very less vegetables were included in the fried rice even we have insisted to include in a lot of vegetables. Plus,they do not include any vegetarian option in their menu as they proclaimed to be vegetarian and vegan friendly restaurant, which is misleading.Show less

Author: Kacer99
Title: Superb food and great price
Review: Ate here 3 times on our stay in Kuah, food is delicious, service is friendly but go early or book because they were queuing out the restaurant when we went. Great value, had lobster, tiger prawns, noodles, rice, veg and several beers for about 30GBP

Author: Smudge43Lancashire
Title: You need to give this place a try while in Langkawi
Review: From the outside you would most likely give this place a miss. But trust me, I thought the same but the food and service was fantastic.If you like authentic, freshly cooked sea food this is a must while visiting the area.We had the Red Snapper, Seafood Fried Rice, Baby Kailan (superb) and chicken. The waiter brought the Red Snapper over filleted it at the table. I have to say that it one of the best tasting pieces of fish I've had. He even removed the cheeks which are lovely and sweet and probably the best part of the fish. The overall price with a couple of Tiger beers was 80.00 RMWhat a find, lovely people and a great dinner - ThanksShow less

Author: jadeharrison13Jersey, United Kingdom
Title: Super tasty
Review: Such reasonable prices for very decent meal sizes. Lovely host who explained menu to us as it was our first visit.We went for a rice each and three chicken dishes between the two of us. Cost 43RM with a soft drink each. We were very full so could’ve just had 1 dish each.Food was some of the best we’ve had in Langkawi! Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: bossyteacherWalton on Thames
Title: Saturday evening dinner
Review: We had been recommended this eatery by friends who visited several times in August. We really enjoyed it too. Cost about 30RM from our hotel by taxi as we are in Cenai. Looks nothing special but food was great and good value. We went with recommendations and had flower crab with black pepper sauce, tiger prawns with fried butter and squid in soy. Fried rice was literally that with a bit of egg. Crab was good but I made a mess as am inexperienced! Prawns were our highlight. Delicious. Staff really friendly and good English. Food and drinks came quickly but we did follow advice and arrived before 6.30. Large water, two cokes and a beer and the bill was RM 120. Prices maybe high for street food but great value for tiger prawns and crab. WD would love to to go back but taxi fare adds to the cost.We visited the night market and would mot not go again. Roti with banana and Nutella made it worthwhile but we did feel very touristy!,Show less

Author: NNANz87Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best Seafood Restaurant In Langkawi
Review: We went on a recommendation and didn't know what to expect as it was a shack really with plastic chairs underneath a canopy. I can honestly say that it was the best food in Langkawi and among the best food we have ever eaten which is a pretty big call!Not surprisingly it is always packed (mixture of tourists and locals) and you will need to wait for a table, while restaurants round about are empty or have a couple of tables filled. Highly recommendedTips: Get there early to reserve you seat otherwise please bare with the waiting to get seated.Show less

Author: Rettabubba83
Title: Dinner
Review:
Had an amazing dinner there last night 18 people in our group still very quick and all the food was amazing 
Great price for the food and drink 
Would highly recommend

Author: GeorgethesealVancouver, Canada
Title: A bit overrated
Review: In Kuah, this restaurant was busy.. Very busy. In fact more seating than their staff were able to cope with. Waited over an hour for our food to arrive.Food is very good here but too long a wait for it.Prices are very good and in line with cheap Malaysian cuisine. Show less

Author: murlocs
Title: good food
Review: very good place to eat consider the price.if u dont have any idea what to eat,ask the staff,they will give good recommendations on their menu.

Author: gowrin2014
Title: An awesome halal seafood fare with a great price!
Review: We waited 10 mins for our table and 45 minutes for our food to arrive. We were already forewarned by the staff. Packed place and great service by the staff despite the crowd and thank god the food was very much worth the wait.We ordered up to 9 type of dishes for 7 people and it came to RM 202 which was very much worth it!We boticed the crowd was lesser after 9pm.Show less

Author: sari135
Title: 全て美味しかった！ everything was delicious!
Review:
ランカウイ滞在中トリップアドバイザーを見て3日間毎日通いました。
料理はどれも美味しく、安く、スタッフもとても気持ち良い接客でした。
顔まで覚えて下さり、日本人に好まれる味付けや量の提案等もして下さいました。もし、ランカウイに行く事があれば、一度は行ってみる価値有り‼︎
夜のみ営業の様で、毎晩混んで居ます。
ちなみにお店の右手側に手を洗える場所もあります。

This place is absolutely popular and delicious. We have been 3 times while we were in Langkawi.
Food is affordable, staff is friendly and great service. 
Hope to go back again!

Author: loht977
Title: Delicious Flower Crabs
Review:
Well deserving of its reputation. We had flower crabs, mantis shrimps, tiger prawns, clams, and some tofu.

The flower crabs cooked with black pepper sauce is some of the best crabmeat I ever had.

Author: rookie_manikMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food and cheap..
Review: The food was cheap & tasty. Its a place with limited car park on the front of the shop however there a some parking area across the road. The shop provides various of food to choose from and its Halal also for Muslims. The shop will crowed with food lovers during busy hours with some waiting time added. The working staff was very efficient and also checked our menu for any missing ordered items. Show less

Author: Jeyjey05
Title: Good seafood with great taste
Review: First visit with my family. Awesome seafood. The steamed fish was mouthwatering particularly. Others were also good. The staffs were helpful. However one must be early to avoid large crowds as by 7pm the place gets busy and crowded. Highly recommended Chinese seafood in langkawi.

Author: Wanlin28
Title: Must try seafood (zi char) in Langkawi!
Review: I don't usually write reviews in TripAdvisor but this place really deserves a review.Tried 2 types of fish:grilled red grouper and steamed sea bass with Nyonya sauce. Both were awesome! Cooked to perfection and the sauces were so delicious. Almost every table ordered a steam fish so I guess this is definitely their speciality.Sambal Kang Kong was also very good so were the cereal prawns and lala. The dishes were reasonably priced too. Staff was friendly and efficient and I saw one of them (could be one of the bosses) taking the trouble to check with each table if the food was ok. He even ran after us after we foot the bill to ask if everything was ok and if we drove a car. Such good service! Interestingly, there are patrons of all races-Chinese, Malay and Indians. I didn't see a Halal sign but they do not serve pork.Ample parking space just beside the food store or across the road.This is a MUST TRY in Langkawi! In fact it is so good that we ate here for 2 nights during our 3-night stay in Langkawi. Worth to drive over even if you are staying in he Cenang area. If you stay in Kuah area, you will have dinner here more than one night, I promise! Show less

Author: TheXtravellerTimbuktu, Mali
Title: Great Food!
Review: No wonder this restaurant is rated # 1 for seafood I’m Langkawi!The place was packed which is a good sign. The order taking was spot on and the recommendations were genuine. The food took time to come out but was definitely worth it!Fresh seafood and well cooked. The pricing was also extremely reasonable. We had crabs, tiger prawns, Garupa fish, vegetables and rice. Our bill was under US$ 60 for 4 people!Yesterday we tried Shin Mi and we feel even more disappointed after the experience at Wonderland Food Store tonight!We are going back tomorrow night!Show less

Author: jjschonhoffAlbany, New York
Title: Amazing first dinner
Review: We had just arrived into Langkawi and out Uber driver just dropped us off at our hotel. He pointed out Wonderland and said this place is one of his favorite’s. Then while checking in our front desk agent said he oh yes! It’s great over there, so I guess that made our decision pretty easy!!We started off with some Tigers (Beer), has some calamari, steamed sea bass (Lime and Garlic) and finished it up with some grilled tiger prawns. The lime and garlic sea bass was amazing!!! Plus our waiter was so helpful and kind. After we paid our very reasonable bill a huge thunderstorm rained down on us for 30 min. The staff was so kind and nice that they asked us to join them for seconds, while they had their staff meal. What a great place with amazing food and folks at Wonderland. Show less

Author: Nancy1079
Title: Good But Expensive
Review:
Its in kuah town , walking distance from the place we were staying 

Food was good but Expensive compared to the quality and standard of the restaurant.

Lobster was fresh and tasty

Author: Orange3JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Affordable Good Food
Review: Wonderland Food Centre: Serves excellent seafood and Chinese styled dishes at very very Affordable prices. Very popular with locals. No pork and no beef. Go early 6-6:30pm or go late 9pm. Otherwise very crowded and wait can be 45minutes. Went there for dinner 4 nights in a row . Tip: No toilet there except a public toilet across the road (use at own risk) Show less

Author: LZEFSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great seafood
Review: I would recommend this place to my friends when they visit Langkawi. The food here is really good and affordable. Serving was also a lot. We ordered the buttered prawns, salted egg squid, steamed sea bass, fried rice and veggies and it cost us 108rm including the drinks. Place was packed and we had to wait a while for our food to come. We really enjoyed our food and will definitely come back here again. Show less

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Unbelievably Awesome!!
Review: You may have to wait for a table, but it is well worth the wait!! This is an outdoor seating restaurant that serves fresh seafood and local cuisine.I had the fried fish in ABC sauce that was great, morning glory was the best I have ever had, the black bean clams are a must try even if you don't like clams these are incredibly good! The jumbo prawns were really great, the fried rice and baby guy lan are a treat!!This place deserves a 6!!! The food was hot, tasted great and the service was great considering how packed this place is!! If you have only one night in Langkawi this is the place to go hands down!!!! If you have 2 nights you will probably go both nights after going the first night. Great great food, great service, great experience!!! Six stars for sure!!!Show less

Author: Kym PMiddle Dural, Australia
Title: Best black pepper crab ever
Review: Michael who runs this family business works his tail off. It's a well oiled machine Everyone we spoke to recommended this place. We were not disappointed, we highly recommended it to others and would return to Langkawi again especially for Michaels crab. The chilli one was also very good. But the black pepper what a standout. Enjoyed our time very much. Show less

Author: Peter J
Title: Nice but little expensive
Review:
Its a nice place , good food .

Its in middle of the city , little far from cenang ..good seafood option .

Less vegetarian choices , service staffs are helpful

Author: Agnes1118Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap seafood
Review: We went twice for this food store.Their crab very cheap, we ordered 2 flower crab only costs us RM30.Their Fried squid also nice, I saw every table will order this dish.We order butter lobster, which the staff recommended to us.But i don't like fried lobster meat, so i feel this dish no worth it.Show less

Author: lizziem27
Title: Great Local Experience
Review: Busy atmosphere, friendly staff and awesome seafood. Cheap n cheerful place to eat and enjoy the best fresh seafood in Langkawi. It started raining halfway through dinner and they whisked us to another undercover table smoothly. Try the ABC sauce in your  fried rice!

Author: PeenieMPerth, Australia
Title: Must visit if in Kuah area
Review: Who am I kidding? My husband gets travel sick and said he'd happily drive the 50+ minutes from the other side of the island to come back! The place is unassuming at first, and you walk around the back to find a huge undercover seating area. We had the signature chilli flower crab, garlic tiger prawns, black soy sauce, seafood fried rice and two cokes and our total was less than $40 AUD.... The food was amazing! So good in fact that we returned for dinner the following night - this time swapping the crab for chilli clams and having fried butter tiger prawns (these were my stand out meal!). Everything was perfectly cooked and the atmosphere was wonderful. The tiger prawns were 200g EACH, and the squid was the best I've ever had. If you're in Langkawi, do yourself a favour and check it out!Show less

Author: 65djv
Title: You just have to go here!
Review:
The food is great. It's very busy, but that's good, it enhances the atmosphere. This is what you want from authentic Malaysian street food. Good taste, cheap, busy, chaotic. We love it!
Did I already mention how awesome the food tastes? It's the best!

Author: DorothyCheongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Satisfying meal
Review: Due to the high recommendation in TA, we do not want to miss this place. It was closed on our first visit due to public holiday (confirmed by the staff). So, we went back the 2nd night for our dinner at around 6.30pm. Manageable crowd was there but they are very efficient to get you seated and shortly to place the order. Food arrived pretty fast. We ordered oyster omelette, baby cabbage (to them is baby kailan), salted eggs squid, etc. Price is reasonable for a seafood stall.Overall, service is excellent and staff are courteous and friendly as though we are regular customers.Show less

Author: nickyhmd
Title: Excellent food
Review: Excellent seafood, value for money. I would recommend this restaurant for good seafood. We enjoyed dinning here, though the waiting time is quite long.

Author: lim622Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for seafood lover
Review: Nice place for dinner. Very fresh seafood and warming, friendly staff!!! They speak well English and Chinese, menu are in English and Chinese, so is convenient. The prices are clearly stated on the menu. They will tell how much the seafood cost before they cook for you. Drinks prices are reasonable. Show less

Author: Ming JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome
Review: Good food with average price!! We visited twice to try different type of seafood there.Restaurant served good food.Please be bear with long waiting especially on weekend, as both local and tourist have dinner there.Overall satisfied with their food especially egg yolk salted squid and we had it for both nights!! Highly recommend for those visit to Langkawi and if you are looking for chinese style seafood.Show less

Author: ZGrand_VoyagerRome, Italy
Title: Good sea food restaurant but very crowded
Review: First and foremost, you must wait and sometimes it can be long... For all those wishing to eat quickly, pass your way.Quite friendly staff but overworked.Seafood are very good and well prepared with a lot of choice.Reasonable price : it is not a dirty cheap or an expensive restaurant.Crowdy but the terrace is acceptable.Show less

Author: NicWangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious and affordable
Review: We went there twice on our 4D trip. We had steam red snapper on both occasions and we really enjoyed the fish! Fried kang kong, oyster sauce chicken, soft shelf crab, prawns and oyster egg were not bad too. Too bad we didn't have a chance to try the chilli crab as it was just after the Hari Raya Haji holiday and crabs were not available.We didn't quite like the mantis shrimp which was deep fried in some sweet sour sauce. Taste of the sauce was too overpowering.Show less

Author: fifitrixvinoColorado Springs, Colorado
Title: Awesome!
Review: Ate here last night and it was great. Ordered chicken fried rice and a baby cabbage dish loaded with a delicious garlic sauce, egg fried rice for our vegetarian daughter and the biggest tiger prawns I've ever seen. 2 prawns weighing around 600 gms in total. Beautifully cooked and seasoned. Butterfly cut, so easy to eat. Staff are friendly and helpful with the menu. And you can get an ice cold beer. From the road go behind the building to the tables. Will definitely eat here again to try some other dishes. Show less

Author: Vicky W
Title: Pricing are average
Review: The environment are ok. Price are average reasonable. No pork at all in the menu. As for the taste are average.

Author: Backpackertje
Title: Good food, fast and friendly service
Review: Really liked this place! The food was great, nice portion. It is always busy but we got a place to sit right away. Staff is friendly and fast even though it is busy.

Author: Jeffery W
Title: Wonderful food
Review: Friendly staff with good fresh seafood. Reasonable price. Worth paying. Comfortable environment. Recommend for travellers.

Author: 279benitarBurradoo
Title: Casual dinner
Review: Great local restaurant in heart of Kuah. Very busy with locals and visitors but tables turn over quickly so never really have to wait for table. Lots of variety, everything very fresh and cost minimal. Note only beer served - no wine or spirits. Loved it so much went back twice. Show less

Author: Theresa LOrpington, United Kingdom
Title: What can I say..... perfect!!!!
Review: Visited Wonderland while on a 10 night stay in Langkawi, we had read the reviews on Tripadvisor and so thought we must pay this restaurant a visit, we ended up visiting 5 times. On our first visit the amazing owner approached our table and began to give advice on how we could have our prawns, squid and fish cooked. Each dish that came out of their kitchen was gorgeous. On every visit the owner would come to our table to offer more advice which we always took. This is an incredibly busy restaurant which opens at 6 pm, if you arrive at 7 then expect to wait for a table but it will be truely worth it. You must try the crispy baby squid, naked prawns in tamarind sauce, baby cabbage with garlic and the wonderful ABC sauce on the chicken fried rice all washed down with a few cold tiger beers. A huge thanks to all staff in the restaurant for making each visit so memorable. We will definitely revisit when we are next in Langkawi.Show less

Author: meowleng92
Title: How Fresh, Nice & Affordable
Review:
Order whatever you want till super full and the price is very affordable.
The taste is fresh and just nice! Go with group friends is better because can order a lot of dishes and sharing. Able to taste as much as the food.

Must TRY!

Author: annies933London, United Kingdom
Title: Scrumptious and affordable
Review: We arrived early (5:30PM), but the owner was gracious and accommodated us. We ordered based on his recommendations and it did not disappoint. The fish was really fresh and steamed in a mouth watering broth. The dinner for 4 adults was about RM150, which included drinks, a vegetable dish, oyster omelette, fried rice noodles, seafood soup and a steamed grouper.We would have ordered more, but the establishment only accepted cash. Show less

Author: davidwplairdFreiburg im Breisgau, Germany
Title: Busy reliable good food really cheap
Review: I do not know why this is called the Wonderland Food Store. It is the Wonderland restaurant. It is always busy in the evening and quite often you have to wait but never very long. The food is good and fresh. The service is fast and effeicient. No wine but you can take youor own I think. The prices are really cheap both for food and beer. You have to sit on the ubiquitous plastic chair !Show less

Author: jonmather88Christchurch, New Zealand
Title: Great food
Review: The menu here is not big but that is usually a good thing in Asia as they are not trying please everyone by doing mediocre western food this place just does great local foods mainly seafood but they also do chicken.we had to wait for a table but didn't mind as the atmosphere was buzzing and the waiter gave us menus and some beers wile we waited. We ordered a selection of prawns sea bass chicken rice and vegetables all of which where great. Definitely recommend the chicken in sour plum sauce! Show less

Author: U8571YMdavids
Title: Asian, experience
Review: Chance to try different foods that are always tasty and don't break the bank. We always have some fish dish and it never disappoints. Like the hustle and bustle of the restaurant with families and friends always having a good time.

Author: TayW88
Title: Best Best Best
Review: The food is really nice, fresh, cheap and friendly staff. Two of us have Soft shell crab, clam soup, lobster, vege and fried salted egg yolk squid. And 2 fresh coconut. Wonderful dinner!

Author: ebhavsarUnited Kingdom
Title: We wanted traditional Malay; we got traditional Malay!
Review: Do not be put off by the basic appearance of this rustic Malay restaurant. The mere fact that you cannot get a table without booking says a lot. It is full of locals and tourists from all over the world. The staff are friendly and have a good sense of humour: our waiter even told us to call him by his name!! Overall the food is fantastic and really is very cheap. If we had to be picky, the only criticism we have was that there were no desserts. If you are in Langkawi, then Wonderland Food Store is a must!Show less

Author: HidiO
Title: Not impress
Review: Recommended by a friend and thus we come here to give it a try. But compare with Paradise seafood restaurant (same row and walking distance to wonderland), we found that1) the price is slightly higher than paradise2) food is so so. Especially the Lala soup has no taste but salty. And the signature chili crab is taste like sweet&sour crab. It's disappointing....so compare to Paradise is much more better, which crab is big and fresh and cheaper.3) food portion is small. Come straight after sky cab activities and we are like hungry ghost. 5 of us order 6 dishes but feel nothing after finished all the dishes. 2 out of 5 dishes has sent us wrong dishes....Overall, so so.Show less

Author: UPTapes
Title: Good Seafood
Review: Good vibe and good food. Open air space on the main side street in Kuah. Snapper in like, garlic, pepper was delicious. Will return!

Author: ccyamaJapan
Title: Good value n taste
Review: Had an early dinner to avoid the queue at wonderland. It was nice to hv several seafood dishes with a variety of ways to cook. The Kam Heung sauce and saltedegg yolk sauce. Great value as what we ate was half the price of some other seafood dinners we went to. Recommend if you can openair food stall n cats around.Show less

Author: LilyNana89Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: MUST VISIT - Great Food and Price
Review: This restaurant serves very good food. Local people also dine-in here. The price here is reasonably cheap! We ordered fish , squids, prawns & other veges , plus beers for RM160 total bill. Must try the kangkung belacan. It's my favorite there. Need to come early some even pre-book it!~Show less

Author: Jennifer C
Title: AMAZING
Review: This restaurant is amazing not only because it is delicious, but it is also cheap and run by lovely people. The staff were so kind, the food was so fresh, the sauces were amazing and the bill was surprisingly waaaay cheaper than expected! We visited this restaurant twice in our 4-days visit! Show less

Author: Berrly1
Title: Nice people.
Review: It was 930pm with a very huge crowd, waited for nearly an hour but we were nicely warned beforehand. Staffs are nice and friendly. Foods are not bad, with fixed price on menu.

Author: 316aqibaKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Spectacular
Review: It was the best sea food resturaunt ever. I was treated with alot honour and respect. They were honest, sincere and modest. No greedy advice. They were friendly and service was awesome. We didn't have to wait much and atmosphere was perfect. And it was very affordable. Left me speechless.Show less

Author: toons519
Title: Good food, bad service
Review: The food we ate was quite good, but it didn't make up for the fact that all of us got our meals at different times and our rice arrived 10 minutes before our 'main course'

Author: BBMC78
Title: Okay!
Review: This is a normal restaurant, seating is outdoors under a tin roof, plastic tables and chairs. Wasn't impressed with what I paid.

Author: jonw246
Title: Excellent food
Review: We looked this place up on trip advisor as we love seafood . This is the best seafood we have ever had . For taste , quantity and quality .

Author: L559DOdavidm
Title: Excellent seafood, outstanding value, great service
Review: Just ate dinner here with my family. Sensational mud crab, soft shell crab, while fish and prawns.  Absolutely recommend this place!  Don't miss it!

Author: missimple88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: crowded & yummy
Review: Went there for dinner with family. We ordered the fried butter prawn, la la soup, a steam fish, vegetable, oyster omelette & kam Heong mantis prawn. It was enough for 5ppl but If you love to eat more prawn, would advise you to order medium or big size otherwise you can only eat 1 or 2 prawn for small size. Total spending for the dinner is only 146++. Price is affordable and the food is delicious as well.Show less

Author: VivLambert
Title: Best restaurant in Langkawi !!
Review: Fabulous food and superb service. Owner spent time to explain his menu and recommended dishes to my family. All food was delicious. We will definitely be back!

Author: Lester L
Title: Must Try The Steamed Fish
Review: An outdoor casual dining that offers very good value for money seafood in Langkawi. We have been there more than three or four times and have not been disappointed. There is no "live" seafood on display but the fish tasted fresh. The menu is very simple ... select the food and the style you would liked it cooked. That's it. If you select fish, you could choose from a wide variety of cooking styles ... we loved the steamed teochew style with salted vegetable. We also had the prawns cooked in garlic soy sauce. If you are looking for local crab (not the large Sri Lanka species), they also do a good job.Show less

Author: HYun19
Title: Local Gem
Review: Most websites recommend tourists to visit Orkid Ria for good seafood so we planned to go there initially. But, a local guide that we met during our snorkeling tour recommended Wonderland Food Store. He said that the food tastes delicious and the price was comparatively cheaper. According to him, it's a place where locals go to get good seafood. Indeed, as the local guide had said, the food there was really good and the price was affordable, even for budget travelers. We ordered butter prawn, fried squid in salted egg yolk, greens, chicken, white rice and Chinese tea for four. It costs only RM17++ per pax. The place is always packed with locals and it only opens for dinner. (Tip: Go there slightly earlier to secure a table, or else, you will need to stand by the side to wait for an empty one.)Show less

Author: sapphire0514
Title: Great seafood at low price
Review: We were worried when told that all the seafood are frozen.  But our flower crab, tiger prawn and fish taste great.

Author: SallyP30468Healesville, Australia
Title: Fantastic local food
Review: I would never have come here originally but I was brought here by a local the first time. I have now been back a different year as a tourist and both times the food has been exceptional, fresh, tasty and plenty of it.Well worth the visit and very reasonably priced. It is very busy so don't be surprised if you have trouble getting a table.Our table was for 8 people a total of RM303Show less

Author: SL0406Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Fresh and tasty seafood with reasonable price and friendly staffs
Review: We arrived around 7pm, the restaurant was almost full, anyhow we didn't wait for too long to have the food served. We like the dishes very much as the seafood is fresh and tasty. Price is reasonable and staffs were friendly. We will definitely come back again.Show less

Author: bowenvale321
Title: Fabulous. Cheap and Cheerful.
Review: We loved our evening at Wonderland.. the setting (right by a drain/creek) is interesting but the food, service make it irrelevant.. fresh, tasty, friendly and such good value..

Author: Scott MMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best Value in Town - a true Family Affair...
Review: Highly recommended by all the staff at our hotel and didn't disappoint at all. Michael the host is one of the busiest guys I have ever seen in this busy chinese/asian restaurant. It's all about the food so don't arrive expecting a flash dining space. Specializing in seafood the fresh fish is brilliant and comes in many way. highly recommend the steam groper in garlic, lime and chilli that melted in your mouth.Show less

Author: Jamshed k
Title: Tasty food " fish with sweat and sour must eat"
Review: Staying about 13 km away but visited twice. The food is tasty and the staff are really professionals.

Author: AinN195
Title: Must go!
Review: Really good food. Reasonably price and good service. Halal also. It's within the Kuah shop houses vicinity. One of the best seafood Chinese place I've tasted. The seafood fried rice and the tofu is the bomb.

Author: BavaLeelaAlor Setar, Malaysia
Title: A great eatery run by a good hearted man
Review: This place has been around for almost 30 years. The proprietor's son has taken over from his father and partners. He's doing a great job with the staffs, menu and ambience. A simple place by the coast with a variety of delicious dishes that bd whipped up in a jiffy. A definite place for anyone looking for good tasty local Chinese- Thai- Malay dishes ... cooked wholeheartedly with lots of love , care and concern for customers satisfaction.Show less

Author: trisarahtopstravels
Title: Delicious and cheap.
Review: This place is popular for a reason! Great selection of food for reasonable prices. Super friendly and attentive staff. Definitely recommend visiting while you are here.

Author: margaritaparrishSydney, Australia
Title: i adore this outdoor restaurant !!! And yes, lobster , crabs, and tiger prawns are all within your budget!!!
Review: The food was fantastic, served in what seemed seconds , and all the staff were amazingly helpful!. The ambiance was Asian heavenly and the temperature gorgeously balmy.It is essentially a seafood restaurant and the prices are just too amazing for words.We were attended by Michael who on being asked about the possibility of a cheakywine ( they only sell beer) told us to go across the road get a bottle and the staff kept on topping the ice bucket all evening to ensure the wine stayed cool.We had a glorious evening and will be back tonight !Show less

Author: BidyutS
Title: Good food, good value
Review: Good quality food served  in a modest environment at a reasonable price. Satisfied the taste of different age groups.

Author: drlcs1
Title: recommended: great seafood, good cooking; good value.
Review: It was so good, we returned for dinner the next day, to try out the rest of the menu. Restaurant is clean. * this is an open air place-- and you have to be able to eat comfortably in that sort of setting. ** if you arrive late the wait can be long.Show less

Author: sharifaha204
Title: Great seafood in Langkawi
Review: Even though this restaurant is chinese owned, the food is halal. A good selection of seafood cooked chinese style. Delicious!! Will definitely go again.

Author: VeronicaL651San Francisco, California
Title: Great seafood, great service
Review: We asked a local where to eat, and he recommended Wonderland. It's a great spot all outdoor seating, with just ceiling fans. Prices are a little confusing on the menu but don't worry about it, it will still be a very affordable meal. The service was friendly and spoke English. Our waiter basically planned our meal for us and suggested since there was two of us and we didn't want to over order but still try a lot of things, he suggested we order a fish, split it in two and have it cooked two different ways. What a great idea! So we did and it was an awesome option that I'm glad he suggested. We got to try steamed fish and grilled fish, and prawns, and some noodles and local vegetables. It was all delicious and such a great deal. I'd definitely want to come again with a large group to try more things. The place is so busy that I imagine all the food to be really fresh.Show less

Author: omega132857Chichester, United Kingdom
Title: Just could not wait to eat here.
Review: After reading the good reviews on T.A we simply had to check this place out.So Just after sunset we got a taxi to Wonderland. Nothing special to look at, just some plastic table and chairs, but the food is fantastic. Michael, the owner came over and made us feel really welcome. We placed our order and waited with a cold beer. we ordered manta, prawns, deep fry chilly squid, one whole fish, fried shrimp rice, and some veg dishes. The food was very good at very good prices. After our meal Michael came over to see if we could guess what the dinner for 4 came too. We were all way out, it was way under anything we said. Go there and enjoy.Show less

Author: dawntosenja
Title: Good food at good price
Review: We came early, just before 6pm and there were already tables of diners finishing their dinner. It was full by the time we left, with a queue for tables.Seafood was simple and good. Reasonably priced. Our order for family of four adults: flower crab in some sweet spicy sauce, steamed red snapper, kam heong lala, oyster omelette, seaweed soup and a veggie dish.Steamed red snapper was good! They didn't have meat crab in stock, so we settled for flower crab, it's okay. Note: It's at an open area along the river bank, with plastic chairs and table. Lots of other dishes and cooking styles to sample, reasonable prices.Show less

Author: AiniyapPasir Ris, Singapore
Title: It so-so
Review: The price- reasonable Fresh-not so Speed-fast Taste -eeehh Basically its okey, but its not what you expected from all the review you read. The thing is the food taste is not that good. The taste is actually quite bland. What you pay is what you get. I do not recommend the chilli crab. I do recommend the honey chicken. This is my opinion. Show less

Author: Mary-Anne T
Title: Wonderful wonderland
Review: What a surprise this restaurant is.  Wanted local food and came across wonderland by accident.  So good.  Glad we found it. The staff were friendly and helpful.  They offered advice on plate size and ingredients.  Excellent dishes.  Really recommend this place.  Cheap too.

Author: FalconVisionMumbai, India
Title: Amazing Seafood
Review: Wonderland Food Store happens to be on the bucket list of everyone visiting Langkawi. So, after visiting this iconic restaurant, I knew exactly why!!!It's open only for dinners and once it's open, it's jam packed with tourists savoring delicacies and enjoying the laid back atmosphere.We had an enjoyable dining experience here... Had some real fresh Oysters and Red Snappers cooked delicately in A.B.C sauce (Yumm!!)... This is the place to chill out and have a gala time with family and friends.Show less

Author: Helen MLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great local restaurant experience!
Review: Wanted to try some local restaurants whilst staying in Langkawi. Went to Wonderland don't let the very basic outdoor eating area put you off as the food is amazing!! Staff were friendly & really helpful in choosing our courses & sauces to accompany them. Giant tiger prawns were great, as was the sea bass cooked 2 ways & chicken in black bean sauce. Wish this was my local takeaway! Great food, great value!Show less

Author: Sweetpea1000
Title: Best seafood in Langkawi
Review: Wonderful authentic experience.  Great food and very friendly and welcoming staff.  Fillet fish with ginger and spring onions and a little spicy sauce was my favourite but it was all really good.  Definitely worth a visit!

Author: llyeoh2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Cheap but taste could taste better
Review: We went there on a Friday night, it was full but could fine a seat right before the kitchen. It was very busy. We ordered Crabs, Squid, Clams and Mixed Vege, 2 drinks. Total bill was only rm70! The portion was just nice. Crab to us was a little too watery and it doesn't taste that fresh. Squid was good - covered with salted egg yolk but a little chewy. Lala was also just mediocre. Show less

Author: Jamela09East Grinstead, United Kingdom
Title: Seafood!
Review: Went there with my hubby, the tall guy waiter was really helpful with explaining and recommended the food we should have, we were so happy with our meal, tasted so good. We had squids, prawn, crabs, rice and some mix veg with drinks only came around £20! You should go to this place if you in the area, its wort it, in fact we went there few days after to have our 2nd visit and the same waiter served us and it was another enjoyable and delicious meal again! Happy tummy Show less

Author: Sheena890Malaysia
Title: Reasonable price & fast service
Review: I'm surprised with their popularity.. We went there after reading some good reviews but i would say its little too much for them..i ordered butter prawn since it was recommended by them.. My advise don't order butter prawn because their butter egg floss are very tick. You may go for ginger clamp, nyonya style steam fish, salted egg soft shell crab. Kam heong style was never taste as it is but its not that bad too. Their price and service are very decent. Overall choosing right dish is important.Show less

Author: MES_LondonLondon
Title: Solid Food
Review: Wonderland is like a typical food place on Langkawi with a simple open seating area. The food (mainly seafood) however is very good and reasonably priced. The service is friendly and very swift. Wonderland is a good alternative for a casual meal outside of the hotels should you be on the south side of the island. Show less

Author: Blackmee
Title: Great value
Review: The restaurant is within walking distance from our hotel and the food was great and prices were very reasonable, we went there twice, go early to avoid waiting, there is no booking, just first come first served.

Author: Vinod A
Title: Awesome
Review: One of the best seafood shop I would recommend to travelers. Variety of dishes, just name them they will cook for u, it's not to pricy worth the food taste. Do not miss the chance of going here, add on to ur list..

Author: JoC9999
Title: Nice food and reasonable price
Review: Ordered salted egg mantis prawn, Kum Heong crab, salted egg squid, one fried noodle and one lala soup. Total price was rm88. Salted egg dishes were very nice. Would definitely come again.

Author: DrKhant
Title: Awesome Meals
Review: Went at 6pm to avoid crowd queuing up to get a table. Order 6 type of seafood from salted egg squid to signature chilli crab for 2 of us, the food is simply fantastic. High class fish for very cheap price. Worth every single penny. Recommended to do list in langkawi.Show less

Author: LJ_Lim
Title: Fresh, tasty and reasonable price
Review: The restaurant is quite easy to find, just next to the main road. The seafood is fresh and tasty. Price is very reasonable as well. We went there during off peak season around 6 pm, the restaurant was already packed with customers.

Author: Speedbird747Weybridge, United Kingdom
Title: A hidden gem
Review: Found this restaurant on Trip Advisor and was not disappointed. This is a very basic place with outdoor plastic seating and tables with melamine plates in typical asian style. However, don't let that put you off as the food is really good. Our waiter couldn't have been more helpful in making sure we ordered food we'd enjoy and offered some suggestions.The food itself was fresh and delicious and we really enjoyed our meal there. Happy to recommend it.Show less

Author: lmtanyaMalaysia
Title: Never tired of this place
Review: Was introduced to this place by a Malay lady during Matta Fairs before my 1st trip to Langkawi in Year 2008. In Year 2013, bought my friends from Singapore to try the food here and they love it. My last trip was September last year, and my uncles loves the fried noodles served. For every trip I had my dinner there on daily basis. Love the food and the prices are reasonable.Show less

Author: chiragg163
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Ended up here on a busy Saturday night , even though  the place was packed the food and service were excellent . They recommend us some excellent prawns and crabs which went down well with our beers .

Author: ARK_TravelersInternational Traveler
Title: Popular but Frozen Outdoor Seafood (& Chicken)
Review: The restaurant is very popular as evidenced by the large number of people willing to sit outside in hot weather and not so great surroundings for seafood & chicken. The staff is very helpful and will do whatever they can to prepare the food to your liking and explain the menu. However keep in mind that most of the seafood, except the mud crabs, are frozen in Langkawi no matter where you go and that is true here. Show less

Author: dilz303
Title: Good value
Review: Food came out quick and was good. There were lots of options. Was very busy and we had to wa it for a bit for someone to takeep our orders. Best for groups as you could taste lots of different things but OK for couples.

Author: 308alicer
Title: Do not miss - tasty and value for money
Review: This was some of the best food we had while on the island. I was recommended to go by a friend from home and thank god we did. The seafood and service were fantastic but it was also amazing value for money.

Author: 420adizGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Unbelievable
Review: Decided to give it a go after the rave reviews. True enough, it was as what we expected. We ordered five dishes - grouper, prawn, squid, vege and clams (all different types of cooking). All of it were unbelievably tasty. I didnt particularly like the nestum prawns but my wife loved it so i guess it must be good. In terms of service, it didnt take long for the food to arrive and they have plenty of workers to attend to patrons' needs. Anyway when we got the bill, i was shocked. It only comes to around MYR105. So i just paid and bid my goodbye for now because i know i will be back again. Truly awesome little place.Show less

Author: lefthandbdrPerth, Australia
Title: Eat where the locals eat
Review: This is the place you can try the 'eat where the local people eat!'Good variety seafood dishes, including the mud crab at reasonable price! Only open for dinner. Chose your seatings near the fans or bring a mosquito repellent spray. if you don't have get one at the minimart opposite the restaurant. It's natural and cheap. Then truly enjoying your crabbing night!Show less

Author: 544alessiam
Title: Really tasty food
Review: Ate here for three nights in a row. Food was really really good, so tasty and good portion size. The staff were very friendly and the service was quick. Would definitely recommend to anyone. Extremely good value for money.

Author: Kw60Dublin, Ireland
Title: Amazing seafood and service
Review: We dined here two out of our four nights in Langkawi. Our first night we arrived on a busy evening, even though the staff were run off their feet, they spent time helping us make the best choice for our taste, even so far as testing our chili tolerance and making some sauces without the chili! It's mainly a seafood restaurant but there are some chicken options. We had sea bass, red snapper, clams, prawns, chicken fried rice and veggies with a mix of different sauces. There was more than enough and price was extremely reasonable. Show less

Author: lovekmCleveland, Ohio
Title: Worth the trip!!
Review: We stayed @15km from this restaurant and my friend recommended the drive. As we passed other top rated places along the route, I was praying this place was worth it! We finally arrived and the food was BEYOND expectations! Food was fresh, hot and extremely tasty...service was great, prompt and the bill inexpensive! Portions were plenty as everything family style (we ordered 6 dishes/3 people and were well full). Highlights were the Lime garlic sea bass, grilled lobster, seafood rice...every dish was a winner. We also met Michael (one of the owners) and waiters...works very hard in his place and it shows. Worth a trek if you are staying Central as beats a fancy fine dining tourist experience and captures the local spirit. Show less

Author: jovant379United States
Title: Delicious!!!! Must go
Review: The food at this place was so good. We ordered the lime and garlic sea bass, calamari, kailan, lobster, seafood fried rice and prawns and everything was delicious. The lobster had this homemade BBQ sauce they called it and I could eat it everyday it was perfection. The preparation of the sea bass was visually interesting and it was cooked fresh. Everything was made to order and the service was great. Michael and his family helped us with our order and I am happy with the whole experience.Show less

Author: Donnakatrina
Title: Food was nice and cheap!
Review: My hotel was near to this restaurant. And I always bought food here as I travelled alone. I tried almost in the menu and it was all nice and very cheap.

Author: Lothar K
Title: Good  experience
Review: Thank you to Atun, Micheal and the whole Team. Also thank you for the receipt of the nice Homemade Sauce. Wenn we are nearby we will show up again.

Author: GracabuDelta, Canada
Title: Scrumpdilicious Seafood!!!
Review: What more can you ask for?!! It's inexpensive, fast and friendly service and yeah the food was deliciously prepared. We kept coming back to this restaurant and it was satisfying! This is a family run establishment, the guy "Michael" who you'll see running around like a busy bee taking orders from table to table is part owner along with his brother (one of the cook) and sisters. We had a short chat and a picture with him on our last day on the island. Ask him for suggestions, which we did on several days we were dining there. You can't go wrong; everything was delicious, comes piping hot, and oh sooo tasty. Try the baby kai lan (we ordered two on our second visit); even though there's only three of us... Order the lobster, tiger prawns and calamari, all were yummy! Also try the green apple with salty plum drink it's refreshing.Show less

Author: DarwintaffRockingham, Australia
Title: Worth a visir
Review: Recommended by the concierge as one of two good seafood places to eat, but also the one that didn't inflated it prices if you were a tourist.It was busy and by the time we left there were people queuing for a table. For the 4 of us with drinks including Lobster which was the dearest thing on the menu bill came to around $20-25 AUD a head and we over indulged, so if you like seafood, a cold beer and a great bill at the end, then this is your kind of place. Enjoy Show less

Author: Crystle77
Title: Good value for money
Review: Not too bad for a side stall. Portion is good and not too pricey for a quick seafood meal. Auntie at the counter was very friendly too, thumbs up for the services.

Author: chengyeekinIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Cheap and good
Review: I visited last week, 3 nights in a row with my gf for a holiday in the island. I must say for that kind of price, its worth.Why 3 nights? Because the first night itself captured our interest with the cheap price. Can't believe our eyes with the first item in the menu that "Lobster @ rm20 per 100g" when other restaurants had gone mad with their prices. Then the "Flower/Blue Crab @ rm15 per 100g". We were like "What?". Probably not very good we thought so we won't wanted to waste the Lobster, we ordered the Blue Crabs. With the idea that live seafood are fresh and should be eaten best steaming them, so we asked the captain "Are the Blue Crabs alive?", he answered smiling "They were when they arrived". So we decided to order Sweet & Sour Sauce Blue Crabs(the picture below), not taking any chances that they might not be fresh. When the dish came, it does surprised us that the crabs are still fresh(80%) and the sauce made them splendidly delicious. For that kind of price? Then the Oysters Omelette, the Salted Egg Squid and the Golden Fragrance Clams(Kam Heong), they are all delicious. The Beer and the Orange juice, not bad. Its only rm76 for all these!So we decided to enjoy another 2 nights of seafood before we left. And the third night, the captain could recognized we were there for the third time, he gave us a surprise and thank us for our support. What surprise? I've promised him that I'll keep it a secret but you can find out about yours if you enjoy as much as we did.This is the top cheap and good restaurant you should visit.(The third night, we actually waited for an hour just to get a table, so go early.)Show less

Author: amil1974
Title: Excellent sea food at reasonable price
Review:
We ordered a steam lemon grass fish, black pepper chicken and fried rice.  Taste wad excellent. 
Also Apple plum fresh juice was awesome and refreshing. 
I Recommend this place

Author: MattFrederickRotherham, United Kingdom
Title: Worth a visit
Review: We try to avoid Chinese restaurants on holiday these days as we are nearly always disappointed. Not this time! After a recommendation, we went for dinner on ur 2nd night on the island.We were seated quickly, and served with drinks very swiftly. After taking our order, we thought the food would take a long time as the place was virtually full, however it didn't take too long at all. We had 3 dishes, rice, fried noodles, washed down with 2 beers. It cost 86 ringgit and we were comfortable full. We could of ordered more but it was enough. Tasting, hot and fresh food so all in all, very happy.Looking at other tables, we spotted some great looking crab and lobster dishes so we need to go back and try them!Show less

Author: carl b
Title: Amazing food and value
Review: We had read other reviews on TA and decided to get a taxi from the hotel and give it a go, we had already passed the restaurant in the daylight and had dismissed it, but after dark this place comes alive. Let's be honest it's a street restaurant and when we arrived people were queuing for tables and I would say that tourists were in the minority. 5 mins and we were seated, it's a pretty basic 1 page menu, but after ordering 4 small dishes and one rice for the two of us we waited and watch a very busy place, the staff are amazing efficient and friendly with it. The food came out after about 20 mins and was outstanding, the fried soft shell crab our favourite. We were suitable full and with 2 beers and a sprite the bill came to 55RM (£10.50). We are planning to go back and have the lobster.Show less

Author: 202mikkvTartu, Estonia
Title: Best U can get
Review: It was a true blessing that we found the Wonderland Food Store. We spent about a week in Langkawi and had dinner there around six times. We had the best service in our lives and felt so welcome every time. The owner Ah Tun is the friendliest guy ever and he knows everything about the food they offer. The menu consists of fresh seafood, different vegetables, chicken and brilliant sauces. Feel free to try everything and be ready for the ultimate dining experience. Show less

Author: 836lottacHelsinki, Finland
Title: Great fish
Review: We had great dinner in this restaurant. We took snapper, one side steamed and other side grilled. It was delicious and I recommend to ask recommendations from the waitress. It was growded when we arrived there and it took some time that they find a table for us. Service was excellent and We did not have to wait that long for the table. Show less

Author: JJS123_12London, United Kingdom
Title: Couldn't find fault! Everything was delicious!
Review: We had a very haelpful waitress and she advised on which way to have the fish and tiger prawns, everything was delicious! Kids ordered sweet and sour and fried rice and they also said it was all really good. Portions can be orders smaller,medium and large, so plenty for everyone. We went about 6pm, so the place was busy with locals, but by the time we left, there was a steady stream of tourists coming in too. We really couldn't fault this place, great service, excellent food for a very reasonable price. They even ordered a taxi for us at the end!Show less

Author: ACIDBURNCRUSH
Title: I Wonder How They Land in First Place for Seafood in TripAdvisor!
Review: Food - Every item we ordered sucks! We ordered Fried Rice, Fried Sotong with Butter, Cereal Prawns, Tiga Rasa Fish, Steam Fish with Black Bean Sauce, Flower Chilli Crab, Kai Lan with Garlic and Mixed Vege. We've been to all over Asia and tasted these dishes before. None of them in Wonderland stands out. The cooking is flat and not much flavour. To the point, we didn't even want to da bao back the leftovers. The Chilli Crab was the biggest disappointment as the chilli was not fully cooked.Service - Food took a long time to come and it's difficult to get the servers' attention. Price - Not that cheap too. I could get much better food with these prices.Can't believe they rate it No. 1 for seafood in TripAdvisor! To think I'm celebrating my birthday dinner here! Such a disappointment! Would never step in there again!Show less

Author: bubblypiee
Title: Totally worth our visit
Review: The service was great & fast! Strongly recommending the salted egg yolk squid. This place is rather filled with tourists.

Author: OliverSJDBarnet, United Kingdom
Title: Must visit when in Kuah
Review: We visited here having read all the positive views on TripAdvisor. We arrived @ 6pm on a Saturday evening, were seated on customary garden table and chairs.The owner Michael talked us through the menu and we eventually chose Lobster, King Prawns, Sweet and Sour Chicken, Chicken Rice and washed it all down with 4 beers - all for £34 - great value for money.The restaurant is popular with locals and gets very busy. By the time we were leaving each table was full, so recommend you arrive by 6.30pm or later in the evening after 9pm.Show less

Author: Kcheong9Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy seafood, cheap price
Review: Special shout out to Michael, the guy who took our order.my boyfriend and i found this place from tripadvisor and decision to give it a try.This place is awesome. We ordered lobster, snapper, clams and kangkong. 4 dishes for rm 178. Where else could you find with great taste at that price. Michael is super friendly and he is able to give great recommendation.go check it out.Show less

Author: Sean L
Title: Cheap and fast, but normal
Review: The seafood is much cheaper than one of the famous seafood restaurants in Cenang Beach. The food portion is bigger too. The food is average to me - may be I have too high expectation after reading all the good comments and recommendations?The clams are not very fresh and not clean thoroughly. The clam that fulled of sand had spoilt my clam soup.Show less

Author: SerdangJo
Title: Great food at reasonable price
Review:
Fresh seafood prepared in delicious ways. Prices are very reasonable considering Langkawi is a tourist spot.
You have to come early as the place gets full very fast and there is a wait list. 
Their chili crabs and fish 3 ways are great.

Author: Nhanha88
Title: Food served very fast although crowded
Review: Their business is very crowded but surprisingly the food served very fast. Food is overall acceptable.

Author: TraceyC2279
Title: Awesome!
Review: Great food! I was very impressed with the steam fish and the asam bakar fish. It was very fresh, highly recommended food as well as the salty egg squids. The service is good, staff are friendly and food are served fast! Price is reasonable, value for money.Show less

Author: Estelle M
Title: Amazing
Review: Excellent food, exceptional service, my boyfriend and I ate here at least 3/4 during our week visit. Great little street food restaurant go go go and tell them I sent you.

Author: TarHeelHootenannyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 5 for tasty food
Review: Might not be much to look at but the food sure is good! Service is prompt and helpful. Ordered fish filet with the ABC sauce. Fantastic! The chicken Sam also was pungent and good as well. Also had cooked cabbage with garlic which was also scrumptious along with fresh veg salad. The Tigers were plenty cold, too. The place is right on the river and, again, the restaurant itself is low key (plastic chairs & tables, etc.) but the sunset was nice and cool and the food was delicious. Giving it 5 for the food and service!Show less

Author: Elraulo
Title: Can't get any fresher
Review: Great people great service the server made most of the recommendations and he really went all the way to make sure we had a great meal! If you are in langkawi it's a must.

Author: dmile2015Bogota, Colombia
Title: Amazing food
Review: I came to this place recommended by a local and his recommendation was exactly what I was looking for, a good local restaurant to enjoy sea food. The food is really good. I had calamari and prawns and were really well prepared. The staff is really friendly. The majority of the clients are locals rather than tourists. For me, it's a must to try while in Langkawi. In this place you eat really well and don't pay that much.Show less

Author: erickB6171CO
Title: Beautiful food
Review: Wonderland is a real hidden gem if you want to eat local food with local people at local prices. The food was that good we went twice during a one week stay.

Author: AmyspazMelbourne, Australia
Title: A Credit to the island...!!
Review: Being recommended this restaurant via our hotel and then happily stumbling across it on our travels we were not disappointed. Our host Michael, a credit to the establishment helped us put together the most delicious meal for the evening, and gave us an invaluable experience. Price, atmosphere, staff and of course food were all a 10 from us! Show less

Author: Kartini1980Ayer Tawar, Malaysia
Title: A must go restaurant in Langkawi
Review: My friends and I have the chance to dine in this restaurant on 3/3/2017. We arrived around 8.00 pm and the tables were all full. The staffs were very efficient as they ushered us on the spot once there was available seats for us. We have to wait a little bit longer for the food to arrived probably because it is a full house that night (presumably the other night too). The food taste good and the price is affordable. We ordered steam fish, butter prawn, kam cheong chicken, fried kangkung and fried squid. Yes, we have a huge appetite. For 4 persons we spent about RM115.00 only. Definitely will come here again.Show less

Author: midmag
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: A great restaurant, fast efficient service, really friendly staff but above all superb food and the biggest plus....the price, at least a quarter of the cost if we'd had the same meal at our hotel. Don't miss this little gem

Author: Ivar KTallinn, Harjumaa, Estonia
Title: Wonderful food:-)
Review: Wonderland is wonderful:-) After 18 hour trip from Europe to Langkawi we needed a place to have a good meal. Someone recommended this place and it sure was a good place to eat. Prawns were delicious, also any fish is good. I recommend the combination of sauces with the fish. Just go there and enjoy seafood.Show less

Author: bremen1018Hong Kong, China
Title: We had been here for 2 nights
Review: If you are tired of fine dinning in the hotels or resort, this restaurant is definitely a good choice. Seafood there are fantastic and the most importantly, not as expensive as dining inside the hotel. If you are worrying of how to go back to your hotel, just tell the restaurant, they can arrange for you. Don't bother about eating at open area, that will be another kind of experience. Major setback is, the toilet is located far away from the restaurant, you need to go across the road and walk for a while until you can reach the toilet. Anyway, taste is good and attractive price. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Positano1905
Title: Wondeful
Review: The food here was excellent as was the service which was friendly and with a smile. Would definitely recommend the prawns on the grill.

Author: CevinW2
Title: I would travel to Langkawi for this place
Review: This place is honestly the best food place on my SE Asia trip so far. Even tho it isn't a expensive restaurant the staff sure make it feel like it is .It's worth going to langkawi just to visit this place in my opinion. If I could give it a 10/5 I would.Show less

Author: Christina GSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food and you should try as well!
Review: Super service, friendly staff and good food. I've stayed at Langkawi for 4 days and we spend 2 days dinner here. After try the food on 1st day, we decided to go again on the 2nd day for dinner as we wanted to taste the lobster. The outcome was awesome and really enjoyed the food. If you decided to go here for a dinner be early as the shop always occupied with lots of people. The price is cheap as well and worth for the meal. Enjoy! Show less

Author: pandfjonesscotland
Title: Amazing Amazing Amazing!
Review: Back to our favourite restaurant in Malaysia. Our 5th trip here and certainly not our last!!Atoon the owner who we know well set us up with free drinks and complimentary squid!We had Dry Chill Mantis Prawn , Fish cooked 2 ways beautiful wok fried vegetables and beers - we got a bottle of wine from D/F which atone put in a wine bucket for usThe bill was 73 Malaysian Ringgits - just under £14 . Food doesn't get much better!Show less

Author: susanmY2474UHBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: We ate here three times, the place was very busy with a short wait for a table. If you are not sure what to eat there was one waiter who spoke very good English and he was incredibly helpful in suggesting whether to have fish steamed/fried and which sauce would compliment the fish best.My husband was unwell and they even did a take out for him.Very good food and a good price.Show less

Author: uzair_frFrance
Title: Quick service and tasty!!
Review: Location : accessible by any mode of transportation in Kuah town Ambiance : cozy and could be crowded as the space is limited. Food : various choices of fresh seafood, chicken, meat and etc. They can cook based on you taste bud (based on your level of hot and spicy)Price : cheap and affordable.Service : Fast and friendly! Show less

Author: MissA M
Title: Very Good
Review: Food is nice and recommended. The price is affordable but you have to line up because the are many customers.

Author: vg2555Seattle, Washington
Title: Tasty seafood, great prices, very popular!
Review: We ate there 3 times out of 5 total in Langkawi because we liked it so much. We saw several other people returning there as well. Not really fancy (which was perfect for us!), friendly and very quick staff, English-language menu, many seafood options, portions are very generous considering the affordable price. A large seafood dinner for two people with 4 Tiger beers was around $30. Our favorites were: steamed lime garlic sea bass with spicy A.B.C sauce; prawns; seafood rice; crispy calamari. Seating is outside under cover. Bathroom is across the street, but the restaurant has a sink with water/soap where you can wash your hands. Depending on the time/day of the week, you might have to wait in line (yes, this place is popular!) Show less

Author: 116dave
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Lots of choice, great food, very busy after New year but they will get you in just have patience the wait is worth it.

Author: lasatuArgenton-sur-Creuse, France
Title: Friendly service good food
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by people in our hotel. We arrived just after 7 and the place was already busy but we didn't have to queue. The waiter was really helpful - going off to bring back a sauce to see if we liked it before ordering. He didn't push extra dishes on us and made sure that we ordered what we wanted. We had a variety of dishes and paid 179 ringgits ( for 4) with 3 beers and two fruit drinks. If we hadn't had the tiger prawns we would have paid around 100 ringgits. The food was tasty, we didn't wait too long even though the restaurant was packed and when we left they were happy to call us a taxi. I would happily go backShow less

Author: mavis37Suffolk, UK
Title: Full every night!
Review: If you see a restaurant full, with people queuing to eat, you know its on to a good thing.We ate at Wonderland regularly during our stay and would recommend to anyone. Lovely food in a fast paced and happy atmosphere. Food delicious. Waiters are great too!Show less

Author: Lance W
Title: Unbelievable value
Review: So there's a few mixed reviews floating around. Hope I can clear a few things up for those who are unsure.Service.This is a cheap Chinese Malay restaurant, not some Michelin star restaurant. It's very busy and very crowded, you have got to make yourself noticed to be served. If you're still having trouble, go find a waiter. I'm guessing there are around 30 tables. Each with seating up to 10 people, it's actually quite difficult keeping everyone satisfied when there aren't designated waiters (try playing one of those restaurant multi tasking games). Special mention to our waiter, a lot of restaurants will try to get you to over order, more money for them. But our waiter insisted that we eat what we ordered and see how we go with portions, that deserves a special rating or something. Food.Did not get to try many dishes as there were only two of us. Had the mud crab, prawns and two veggies. The crab was fantastic. When I went to pick them they were live and kicking. You could tell just how fresh the crab was by the sheer volume of meat in the shell. Zero shrinkage of meat. That feeling when you crack open a claw and you get a perfect mound of juicy tender crab meat, makes you salivate just thinking about it. If you're not sure what kind flavour you want your seafood to be, just ask, or look around and ask some other happy customers. No one's gonna bite. If you're really picky about food, just stick to what you know. Overall.This store is well worth it. It's no frills. It's like the budget airline of seafood restaurants that makes great food. Give it a shot or not, your loss.Show less

Author: freshm6Malaysia
Title: Best FOODS & PRICE!
Review: A place that i will recommend more than Orkid Ria. This is because this place has very good taste for there foods and also the price are really cheap. While Orkid Ria is more famous than this place. Wonderland do serve Wonder Foods. A must restaurant in Langkawi.Show less

Author: ducakCheras, Malaysia
Title: Truly Dissatisfied
Review: Wonderland and I really wondering why so many positive reviews and highly rate to this truly poor restaurant. We ordered the famous Lime steam fish and it tastes absolutely disgusting and terrible. I completely doubt the freshness and where they get the lime sauce from. It tastes alike artificial syrub. It was on fish, can you tell how disgraceful ?Salted egg squid was another disppointed dish ever we did order ! Taste was so plain, squids were so mini & you couldn't tell if that's salted egg. Possible to get another restaurant. Otherwise, Instant noodle could be a better option if this restaurant is your least choice. Show less

Author: jeroene2017
Title: Best fish on Langkawi
Review: Best restaurant on Langkawi because of excellent quality (fish is super fresh) very friendly staff and low prices

Author: Guyfromkz
Title: Cheap and fresh Chinese food
Review:
PROS Very quick, very friendly staff, Open kitchen and fresh seafood
CONS A bit over fried 
Good for quick snack

Author: Educat2018
Title: Without a doubt the best value seafood restaurant in Langkawi
Review: A wonderful market atmosphere with plastic chairs and tables this outlet is always crowded for two very good reasons. The food is fabulous and the prices are incredibly reasonable. We often visit this wonderland for delicious seafood and great service.

Author: mashie44
Title: Great fish, morning glory and tea.. great price.. Hectic
Review: Great experience, great food, especially the steamed grouper.. and tasty soft shell crabs. Fried prawns could have been fresher perhaps..

Author: RogerB976Brixham, United Kingdom
Title: Superb in every way.
Review: Seldom to I offer such high praise for a street restaurant, but I feel this venue is a must for visitors to Langkawi. Arrive early or you will have to wait. Everything is very "rustic " and local. Fish is excellent, Staff are very helpful and pleasing. Lovely meal for two with beer cost less than £15.Show less

Author: RPJ34gBury, United Kingdom
Title: the most amazing seafood
Review: We was recommened this place by a member of staff at the westin langkawi hotel where we was staying, in terms of looks its very basic but by god the food is wonderful, the four of us went there on three occasions while we were in langkawi, we had lobster, seabass, king prawns, rice ,noddles and couple of veg dishes all for 170 RM with beers (£32).... we also had mud crab, softshell crab, clam soup and squid on our visits, the proprietors Atun & Micheal who are super friendly will advise and cook your fish any way you want, they will even cook your seabass half steemed half fried... go check them out, you want be dissapionted Show less

Author: robert h
Title: A Local experience
Review:
Ate here twice in our stay in Langkawi, We loved it. Staff friendly and helpful.
Food to die for. Very busy, lots of locals always a good sign. Real Malaysian seafood cuisine .Enjoy the food and soak up the experience. Highly recommend.

Author: eve0987
Title: Very good
Review: We ate 4 times in this restaurant. Food was great every time. Staff was also great. This is a fish restaurant but there was also good chicken. You have to be there at 6 pm, because this restaurant is so popular.

Author: dotk367
Title: Well worth a visit
Review: We were introduced to Wonderland Food Store by friends who had enjoyed a night out there before. It was great to see many locals at the table tucking into delicious seafood. The very helpful waiter helped us decide what to order and we were able to watch the chefs at work cooking up a storm. The food was really delicious, the bill very reasonable and we had a great evening. We have made a return visit introducing some other friends to this great restaurant and they too loved the experience. Show less

Author: ElandieIMPretoria, South Africa
Title: Wonderful Wonderland
Review: Very popular with locals and tourists. Be prepared to wait a few minutes for a table and your food. The wait is definitely worth it. Excellent seafood with various basting options, making it easier for people not liking it too spicy. Very reasonably priced. Definitely worth a stop!Show less

Author: zeyada693
Title: Best seafood in Langkawi
Review: Went there on honeymoon had best fish in city and cheap with the most friendly waiter ever! Must try!!!!

Author: Nicholas C
Title: Cheap and best
Review: Been here along with my girlfriend and the food is juz simply delicious and the price is worth it . I will really recommend to come here to have a meal . Be sure to reach there before 7pm . I reached there at 7pm and had to wait an hour for the food . However it is really worth the wait as RM120 for 6 seafood excluding crabs are simply extremely cheap . I missed out on crab as within 1hr of opening , the crabs are all sold out . Will be back on my next trip to langkawi Show less

Author: GingerRandyG
Title: Delicious seafood and good service
Review:
Very nice and friendly service but should make a booking while during peak season becos their place is limited.
Suggest to order their salted egg crab.

Author: Jcb KMalaysia
Title: Simply the best !
Review: Quite full every day, this street food place provide the best, tastefully, enjoyable cuisine. Even if tables, chairs, plates are all plastic, what you are eating is amazing experience. You choose your main ingredient like fish, chicken, prawns, crabs, noodles, rice and then the dressing like tamarind, black soya, lemon and garlic, nyonya, etc. Every dish is really, really good.My favorite place in Langkawi, definitely.Show less

Author: StephanieA3337
Title: So good....
Review: Great seafood / street food, really enjoyed it here and went back again the next day. Great price and really tasty food. But you have to be willing to wait as it gets very busy. It's busy because it's good though and worth the wait.

Author: Patrick Z
Title: Not as cheap as you may think but still very good.
Review: The restaurant is definitely trending. Very busy so you might have to wait 10-20 minutes to get a table. Service is a little slow (because it's busy!) but friendly.You cannot fault the food - it's very fresh and good quality seafood. I was hoping for a smaller price tag given the $ symbol on TripAdvisor. This was the most expensive local meal we've had in 3 weeks of Malaysia. I know it's fresh seafood which obviously has its price. But it's not $! More like $$- $$$.Paid around 110 to feed two people on a veggie dish, a sea bass and 250g of prawns. Plus a few drinks.Show less

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent seafood at budget cost
Review: 5 years since we were last in Langkawi and Wonderland is as good as ever. We arrived at 19.00 and we're the last seated before the queue started. As well as lots of locals and a scattering of expats there were several large groups of tourists from China. The ones on the next table were from Shanghai. We ordered soft shell crab, grouper with abc sauce cabbage sambal and rice plus a 2 tiger beers, in total RM 76, just under £14. The crab was delicious as was the rest if the food. We plan to return several more times before we leave Langkawi.Show less

Author: 342cindyqBlair Athol, Australia
Title: Undersized seafood and lacking flavour
Review: We went to this restaurant based on a TripAdvisor rating. It is a hawker style restaurant which very basic tables and chairs but relatively clean. When we got there, there was a wait. But the staff were extremely nice and gave us a menu to read while we waiting for a table. Very attentive service. We had the mud crab, red snapper cooked two ways (deep fried with sweet and sour, steamed with soy and ginger), tamarind prawns and baby kailan. I loved the baby kailan and it had great flavour with the garlic sauce. However the other dishes lacked spice which is something you would expect from Malaysian Chinese food. The seafood would be from our standards extremely undersized which made them difficult to eat. The plus side would be the friendly service and the price which was very cheap. Show less

Author: veldry
Title: Worth to Wait!
Review:
Fresh delicious seafood! Waiting so long, about 30 minutes untill the foods were served, but all PAID with delicious taste!
The place very comfortable and its windy..

Author: 942richsSouthport, United Kingdom
Title: Best Seafood going
