Review: I have spent the last 3 months travelling all of Asia,and this is the best seafood I have had! My wife and I ate here 3 out of the 6 nights we spent in Langkawi. Not the cheapest place going, bit the food is amazing. Always a queue, but worth the wait! Try the sea bass and the soft shell crab!Show less

Author: HAN3_12Amman, Jordan
Title: Very good
Review: The restaurant is huge and busy. When we got there, although we had previously booked, we needed to wait to grab the attention of the waiters to seat us. We ordered lots of items including tiger prawns (delicious), yum tum and sea food Soup (very good), fried rice (delicious), lobster (excellent) plus a few veggie dishes which were also really good. All in all we had a good experience and we ordered a lot of food. It was quite pricey and beware they don't accept credit cards. Service attentive with a very basic outdoor setting. Show less

Author: SJBMBLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good Seafood but very busy
Review: We ate here twice and enjoyed both meals. When you arrive it is really busy but there is a method to the madness. Find the guy in charge, he's wearing a baseball hat carrying a note pad and he will give you a number, then take your menu, rejoin the waiting masses and wait for your number to be called. Tables are turned quickly so the queue doesn't take too long. The time in the queue gives you opportunity to study the menu and to also people watch and enjoy the atmosphere.When they take your order, they are good and will tell you if they think you are ordering too many prawns, they will give you an idea of portion size.This place isn't posh (plastic tables and chairs outside), but the seafood is good and the atmosphere is buzzing.2 things to note, this place is cash only and it does serve alcohol but only beer.Show less

Author: MK_Lai
Title: Wonderland Wonderful
Review:
Great place to have seafood in the town. 
Popular among local people and tourists. Come early to avoid crowd during dinner our. Open from 6pm-11.30pm.

Author: skyemahSydney, Australia
Title: Ok food for good prices.
Review: The quality of food was above average. But the price was very good. Some waiter don't seem to understand what you are trying to say even though you are lifting up an empty beer can and having 2 fingers up in the air. The seating area is beside a drain so expect to wave away some flies. The food came out quick enough, clams, veges and mud crabs. Was recommended this place by a friend, but wasn't good enough for us to return for another meal tho. If you are in the area, they are popular in that area and you know you will have above average, value for money dishes. But if you are further away, maybe save the trek. Show less

Author: SanJukta87Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Sea food
Review: This place opens only for dinner .Starts at 6 PM, the tables get occupied by 7 and then the waiting starts...totally worth the wait ... delicious sea food in decent price.... definitely try their kam heong sauce with prawns or crabs....its yum. The sea food fired rice is delicious. Definitely a place to visit if you are fond of sea food.. There is huge crowd all the time so the average waiting time after you order food will have around half an hourDo visit between 6-7 pm if you want to avoid the queue... the queue reduces after 9 but the chance of getting crabs diminishes if you reach late.Show less

Author: Яна К
Title: Delicious!
Review: Great place for dinner: delicious, fast, large portions of meals, but we need a little time to wait, we need to take a turn.

Author: secretlypien
Title: Enjoyed  seafood with kids
Review: Nice food. Relaxed atmosphere. The road next to the restaurant will not make a save place for really small kids and can not stay put on the table. Owner of the place was so kind to bring us back to our hotel tonight.

Author: teh s
Title: Fantastic dinner
Review: Looked at review from TripAdvisor for a great place to dine and this place popped up. The place was quite easy to find but parking a bit limited. We were there around 8pm and it was already quite packed. But they were fast to get us a table for a group of 8. But please don't go there if you are starving. We had to wait almost 35 mins for our food. The boss was most apologetic to see us slumping at the table. But the food was indeed good with reasonable price unlike tourist area like Pantai Cenang. The fried rice was good but maybe a bit over rated. Should definitely give this place a try if you are in Kuah around dinner time. Just go earlier..Show less

Author: vmangrove
Title: Second best and Consistent
Review: Not the best seafood restaurant but the second best and the first choice for entertaining working friends.Menu is simple, price is economy, taste suits most of the people including children, ambience is lovely and lastly park on the service road that is on the opposite of the restaurant. Muslim friendly place too.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Felicia TMalacca
Title: Nice food with reasonable price
Review: Never expect a tourist place will have such a good food with reasonable price. Although the shop / stall is not impress at all( don't expect aircon or fine dinning style ) but the food and the crowd is impressed.We feel safe to have our almost every dinner there because you won't feel like being slaughter because we are tourist.Plus the serving is not slow.Tips: go earlier if you want to avoid the crowd.Show less

Author: jasikaur_16Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food
Review: We was around that area and saw this place was very pack, so decided to have dinner there.Waited for about 15 minutes to be seated and another 20 minutes for the food.But the outcome was amazing!!!so it was very worth the wait that we went thru. So if your hungry please avoid this place but you have patience and wants amazing food this is the placeShow less

Author: Mihai S
Title: Amazing food
Review:
Great, 100% authentic restaurant. Food is amazing, very friendly staff. Looking forward to go back. 

Veeeeeery resonable prices !

Author: maryasyk_13
Title: Amazing place to eat!
Review: We came here almost by accident, were nearby and got hungry, went on TripAdvisor and found this place. It's totally worth visiting and this is definitely a place not to miss when you're at Langkawi. Absolutely delicious!

Author: minjeh1980Alor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Good food at reasonable price
Review: In a tourist destination like Langkawi, a lot of eateries hike up their prices but at Wonderland, prices remain reasonable. RM 20-25 is more than enough to feed a person sufficiently. Food is good, unpretentious. Staffs were efficient, and helpful. A good place to have a good meal. If you are looking for something extra, they also served the usual seafood.Show less

Author: dreamiconKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: I expected to try here cuz this place shows high rate among sea food restaurant in Langkawi. However, I couldn't find any special in this restaurant. A lot people que up to get a table & service time is too slow. I waited the food more than 40mins. Lobster was really good but other than lobster everything was an average. (Do not try their seafood fried rice) Over ratedShow less

Author: gcatucciKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: As good as 5 years ago
Review: I have been here 5 years, but I don't recall people waiting up to 45 minutes for a table, which by all means is worth.We ordered steam steamed red snapper nyonya style, and it was to very good.Of course don't forget to order the fries oysters with egg, but be ready for a bit oily taste.Everyone orders fried sotong, so what heck. We ordered it too, and it is as I remembered from 5 years ago.It is not as cheap as people claim, but it not ridiculously expensive.If yuh get here around 8 to 8:30, you will have to wait and wait for a table. Show less

Author: zebandcurly
Title: Excellent Dinner
Review:
Very helpful to choose what we would like.  Seabass prepared in two different styles both excellent.
Super value for couples and families.  Highly recommend and planning to return for further meals.

Author: MachnilPune, India
Title: very busy place
Review: we reached this place around 8pm and it was very crowded. but the staff manage the rush very efficiently and in organized manner. we had fired prawns, Ikan bakar and fired rice. prawns and rice was very good. ikan bakar was okay but not the type we expect from malaysia. service can be a bit slow, which will give you time for conversations and look around other people's tables if are a curious foodie.Show less

Author: Laurajoshb
Title: Don't miss out.
Review: After a disastrous trip to Bali, I was nervous about coming to Langkawi. A local friend provided advice that if a restaurant is overflowing with locals - it indicates the food is both safe to eat and delicious. It was this thought process that made us sit down to a meal at Wonderland. The service is friendly and welcoming. The food is quick, varied and absolutely delicious. The decor suits a Malaysian hawker style restaurant so don't expect fine dining. The prices are extremely reasonable.It was so good we went back for dinner the following night. Show less

Author: carabiner1
Title: Best place for seafood in Langkawi
Review: This place is packed and there is a reason for that. Everything tastes great and prices are very reasonable. The staff is very helpful too. I would recommend to go early to avoid the waiting line.

Author: GinaloveShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: yummy and cheap
Review: If you are in town..please plan to visit wonderland as part of your makan places to go! the restaurant is usually packed with people so come early. they serve local chinese seafood which is sooo yummy and affordable. we had assam fish, salted egg crabs, crispy calamari, butter prawn and veggies. all so yummy and for 5 people..the bill came up to rm120 only!!! so worth it. yes nothing much to comment on decor, its a laid back restaurant ala hawker style. typically malaysian and you can see all races eating there. Show less

Author: sophiesR2625EW
Title: Delicious!! Go there now.
Review: Wow. Amazing. Love it. Delicious, hectic, packed full of locals. Proper Malay food. Super cheap. Super good.

Author: LoongmeisterBaa Atoll
Title: Fabulous food for an unassuming restaurant !
Review: Last nights dinner was really good. A small non assuming beer garden type restaurant in Langkawi that came highly recommended by our taxi guy. Seafood was very fresh and the cooking style was really tasty ! The fried garoupa in black chili padi sauce was unusual but really sedaaaaap (tasty) ! Wishing we had found it sooner !!! Best meal in Langkawi so far ! We will be back ! *cash only. No credit cards. The meal below for the 3 of us , including a fried rice (not pictured) cost MYR160/- about USD40/- Show less

Author: GardenCafeInKemaman
Title: Wonderland Food Store
Review: This place provide sea food with reasonable price. The place was packed but the service was good. Recommended for dinner.

Author: KappalynSydney, Australia
Title: Excellent food and friendly service
Review: There are many similar restaurants in Langkawi with fresh seafood dishes. We tried the one 2 doors away and the food was very good . However the main difference between 2 restaurants was the service - in particular Michael, who although very busy, took time to chat with us and to explain the dishes, even bringing us a sample of one of the ingredients to try. The food was excellent but Michael made the experience friendly and welcoming. When we visited again for a 2nd time, he recognised and welcomed us and when we finished called an Uber for us to take us back to our hotel. Definitely recommend Wonderland for good food and friendly service.Show less

Author: philvincent0Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great Seafoid and spectacular value
Review: Chinese-Malay style food. Community restaurant.Food Wonderland is easy to review - top marks in two major departments - food and service. The decor is simple, functional and al fresco but it does not detract from the experience. The range of beverages is limited to basics but no one is likely to mistake this for a cocktail bar. And let me urge you to ask the wait staff for their recommendations - they do know what is in season and can advise about the degree of spiciness that will suit you.Service is carried out at a brisk walk - but dont let that make you feel rushed. I am amazed how the four or five staff get round more than twenty large tables at a canter and still have time to help with menu suggestions.Local recipies, fresh produce and a welcoming atmosphere - makes Food Wonderland well worth a visit (or two).Show less

Author: hunshiongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value For Money
Review: We came to the stretch of road by recommendation of our hotel.We decided on Wonderland because it was the only eatery which was full whereas the others were mostly empty.Food was delicious @ reasonable price. Staff was friendly & helpful.It's definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: ecSoviet
Title: Fabulously Good and Cheap
Review: Fresh, tasty and cheap. We ordered crab, prawns, squid, seabass and kang kong. We left the place fully satisfied with the price and quality.

Author: ShaneLiuwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Seriously good and cheap eats
Review: Must recommend this restaurant! Just randomly driven past this restaurant looking for dinner and it was packed while surrounding restaurants were either empty of half filled. Came to a conclusion that it must be good so we decided to make a turn back for it. Best decision ever! RM$288 for 6 dishes and those are not cheap ingredients as well. We had butter Lobster, steamed fish, cereal prawns, salted egg squid, stir fried clams and sambal kang kung! All very very good dishes! Favourite was actually the deep fried salted egg squid!Show less

Author: JuanJuanCSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super Reasonable Priced for Such A Tourist Hot Spot
Review: Food are delicious. Recommended for tourist to taste local food. Price are fixed (except for seasonal food) with menu. Come along with family members & friends to have a happy time.Would advise to reach by 06.00pm, to have a 'peaceful eating atmosphere'. Otherwise, you will need to queue appx 15- 20 mins for a table to be ready. Or other tourist would be hanging around & give you that 'why-are-you-not-leaving-despite-finishing-your-food' look. Wah ha haShow less

Author: BernardLiowMalaysia
Title: Better option for seafood in Langkawi
Review: We were recommended this seafood place by locals. The prices would be 2-3 times cheaper compared to Pantai Cenang.There was a small queue and we have to wait around 10mins to be seated but it is fine as we discussed what food to order during waiting time. There are also a few other seafood restaurants nearby but this was the busiest. Ordering food was fast and easy, but he was probably a foreign worker, would have preferred to chat with the Chinese local owner/supervisor for food recommendations.We ordered 3 seafood and 1 vegetable dishes, ingredients are fresh, maybe due to the constant flow of customers daily. Taste good and worth the price. Would recommend a shopping trip to Kuah duty free shops, some walk around Eagle Square, visit the Kuah night market (Saturday) and end with seafood dinner here.Show less

Author: 639abbieCanberra, Australia
Title: Delicious Wonder
Review: Tips - the place does not take booking so be early, it accepts BYO drinks, best dishes are prawns, steam fish and noodles and salted eggs calamari. They open at six anytime after 7 you will be in a queue and hard to find park. Service is great and so is value for money. Enjoy!Show less

Author: Lee Poh T
Title: Food taste normal
Review: Food tasted so so and priced little bit expensive. Four of us ordered 5 dishes and cost us RM 130. Fried squid is a must-try dish at here.

Author: byron t
Title: One of the Best Restaurant for dinner
Review: One of the Best Restaurant for dinner! Very nice and affordable. Fish is superb and Wat the heck everything is yummy! Just try and you would agree esp pricing is not too much. Strongly recommended!

Author: RiikkaI26
Title: Good vibes only
Review: This place is definitely worth visiting! Both the food and service is excellent and fast. I have never before eaten so good seafood than I have here. Price-quality ratio is also suitable even for backpackers. 5/5.

Author: rixon82
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing !! Best food I've had in langkawi wish I'd come before my last nite ! I would have been here lots more

Author: AnnSholemCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous food and wonderfully helpful staff
Review: We've had two delicious meals here and for both a member of staff recommended what we should choose. He was so helpful and the food so delicious I can confidently recommend this restaurant. It's very popular and busy but we had no problem getting a table Show less

Author: hintsmy
Title: Nice dinner
Review: The foods we ordered were served fast and taste good too whilst the price is cheap as well. You have to be there by six or else long queue after seven.

Author: Huong T
Title: good
Review: the food is very good, good taste. If you go to the restaurant on rush hour without booking before, you have to wait for a long time.

Author: jessie bMalaysia
Title: Cheap
Review: We have ordered lime garlic steamed fish, butter lobster, chillies crab, steamed prawn with egg, fried squip with salted egg, salted fish fried kailan & lala soup. The seafood were fresh but taste just ok....fish was overcooked, prawn was well done...the butter lobster was over fried....The best part here were the service and the price.....Show less

Author: Pavlianito
Title: Delicious dinner
Review: Absolutely delicious dinner, ordered a few smaller plates to share, all were very good.  Cheap as well.

Author: Joey C
Title: Delicious and affordable
Review:
Location : easy to find, plenty of public parking space.

Food : excellent and fresh

Service : good

Price : reasonable. RM70.00 for 4 plate of rice, 1 plate of jenahak stim nyonya style, 1 plate of kam heong prawn and fried baby kailan.

Author: ShamimR59
Title: Great Food Worth The wait
Review: Food was amazing, they had really long line up to get a table. Michael, the owner had warned us that it will take long to get the food since the restaurant was packed and wait list for tables. It was the best food we have had in MslaysiaShow less

Author: Season2118Langkawi District, Malaysia
Title: Great Food and Amazing Service
Review: we were recommended by our hotel to go eat there. The food was really good, very fresh and best we have had in Malaysia. The owner, Michael was very hospitable. The restaurant was fully booked and had a wait list for the tables. Michael had warned us that it will take an hour to get the food and it was well worth the wait.Show less

Author: Joanneyeow6Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very fresh seafood and reasonable price
Review: Went to this restaurant for dinner. Is was a good choice that we chose this place. The food is superb ! We have dinners there for 2 nights.On our first night, we have crab, tiger prawns, veg, chicken and fried rice and the price come out to less than RM100.2nd nite we hv lobster, red snapper fish, veg, chicken and tom yam and is only RM160. You definitely cant get it in Kuala Lumpur with this price and with lobster too!Will definitely go back to this place if I go to Langkawi again.Plus the boss is really a nice man to talk too and he will recommend the types of foods to you too.They only open in the evening from 6 p.m. Go early as later there be more people and you may have to wait for table.Show less

Author: Edwin_Irene
Title: Cheap & fresh
Review: The best place to go for a tasty and fresh seafood meal at langkawi. A must place to have dinner. It never fails to make you happy.

Author: Whitestar78
Title: Lobsters for ever!
Review: the restaurant is located near the night market. it's quite "rural" but the food is amazing and fresh, it is also very cheap. It is frequented also by locals.

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Where the locals and tourists always look for!
Review: Been here several time with friends and colleagues for different occasion. Their food are delicious with affordable price. No corkage fees will be charged if you bring your own liquor and wine. Michael and others staff are friendly and helpful. Do order soft shell crab and butter prawn. Fresh and simply delicious.Show less

Author: arunikaekawati
Title: Very happy happy customer
Review:
Pros :
1. All foods are exceptionally affordable.
2. Nice ambiance and environment.
3. Easy parking.
4. Fresh food.
5. Delicious.

Cons :
No credit card payment

Author: wansyaslizamCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food
Review: First time here. A bit skeptical when we saw no Muslims here. Checked again online to confirm it's halal. Nice & fresh seafood with reasonable price. We had butter prawns, chilli crab & sambal red snapper. Really nice!! Hard to find something similar in Kuala Lumpur.Show less

Author: Yap90Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food and good service
Review: We have soft shell crab, oyster fried w egg, baby kailian, chicken and fried squid.The total cost for 4 was MYR $103 including beverages.We like the soft shell crab ( 3 pcs cost MYR $ 21 ) which is crunchy.Overall the food and service is good.Show less

Author: tingjin
Title: Delicious food
Review: The fried squid is very crispy, the chili clams is very delicious, etc. Price is reasonable. They serve food is very fast though full house in the store.

Author: natashalee07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood Haven
Review: It's good food, at affordable price. A sure winner. The staffs & the boss, Atun is very friendly and attentive. And ordering has never been simpler here. Just tell them what you want, be it fish, prawns, squid or clams & they will recommend they best way for it to be cooked. And it never fails to disappoint. The produce is always fresh. No other seafood restaurant in Langkawi compares to this. I will take this place anytime over the others.Show less

Author: Asteroid2015
Title: Greet food not expensive
Review: Had lobster and prawns for dinner and the bill came to less $70 with drinks as well. Beer is $1.50 a can. Food was great

Author: zafers753
Title: Good fish restaurant in Langkawi
Review: This is probably one of the best options for fish in Langkawi. Quite affordable and tasty food. Chinese style fish restaurant with many options. Not a fine dining though but if you are looking for taste it is good choice.

Author: Duffgleamer
Title: Good seafood place
Review: One of my favourite place to visit for seafood inner when Im in Langkawi. Prices are not too overpriced and the food is good.

Author: TheMohicanFamilyLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Always for dinner
Review: Very good food, excellent customer orientated, good vibes & respect the regulars.Recommended for anyone who stays in Kuah town area. Do not expect ample parking lot. Avoid the weekend or do come early for the seat. Look for Mike to get the fastest service or order. Looking forward to come again.Show less

Author: KiddySingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Some dishes too sweet, seafood overcooked
Review: My friend and I ordered 6 dishes here, which I dare say is a representation of how good the restaurant will be. I was disappointed with all but the char kway teow. The shellfish was tough and overcooked. The vegetable and no soup dish was very average. The chicken was way too sweet and non mushy. Most zi char stores in Malaysia or Singapore would do much better. Show less

Author: Andy_C99Singapore, Singapore
Title: Crowded, but service is good and fast
Review: Was at this restaurant to hv sea food dinner with family, a total of 7 of us. The place was crowded, but managed to find a table. The staff taking our order was a Chinese lady. She knew her stuff, and was able to provide good recommendations. We ordered 2 crabs fried in black pepper, 2 crabs fried in chilli sauce, one plate of oyster omelette, one plate of squid fried "kong poh" style, one plate of cereal prawns and a plate of sambal kangkong. Includimg rice and drinks, the cost came up to MYR222.00. Really reasonable.Show less

Author: esctasty
Title: nice food
Review: was recommended by the taxi driver. The food is cheap and taste good! we had a very enjoyable yet full meal. It's located near Adya hotel with a 5 minutes walk all the way straight.

Author: Stephy0653
Title: Great Seafood & Services
Review: Is a halal seafood stall ! Staff very nice. The boss will recommend the food and arrange a suitable portion of food for you. Food taste very nice. Many visitors and you may queue and waiting for more than a hour for serving food.

Author: Knight356London, United Kingdom
Title: Best Seafood
Review: Excellent food and service. It was recommended that I check this place out and I’m glad I did. It is not a fancy restaurant and the family owners were cautious of naming it so. Instead they suitably named as a food store. Tables sprawl out at the rear of the kitchen with plentiful space for dining. The best seafood I have eaten. We returned on multiple occasions and it consistently delivered. Very affordable, popular with the locals with warm service received.A must when in town.Show less

Author: vogue_baba
Title: average, but excellent service
Review: many people come here for dinner. The restaurant next door Kaoboi if I'm not mistaken is not bad too.. can try if here is too full with people

Author: bew11000
Title: Great food!
Review: Friendly helpful staff, extensive sea food menu at a good price. Delicious fresh sea food. Well worth a visit. The proprietor speaks good English and is willing to explain the menu to those who are not sure of what things are.

Author: amirhamjarNarayanganj, Bangladesh
Title: Dinner
Review: We r in cenang beach but went to kuah only for diner in wonderland food factory. Believe me it was just awesome. Great taste of foods. We ordered big tiger prawn with butter, dry prawn fry , seafood fried rice, chicken n juices. We enjoyed our meal n it also cheap. U must try.Show less

Author: uzicarlaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: I've been to this restaurant a few times and always been satisfied. Don't expect extravagant fine dining. This is seafood cooked at its simplest, like a home-cooked meal, and at a very good price. There is always a queue during dinner time so be there early.Show less

Author: realeslieManila, Philippines
Title: Indeed a Wonderland place to eat
Review: Cheap price, great food! Really the best seafood restaurant in Langkawi. Great service. When we come in, staff immediately greeted and accommodated us, until we leave, they'll thank and wish you goodbye. They will always smile at you.When we came there, I have observed, not even an hour yet when they open and it was already full.Thank you and will definitely come back when I visit Langkawi again.Tips:* Come early* Prepare your storage in your stomach* Eating bare-hands is greatShow less

Author: lewiszx
Title: Better !
Review:
Nice ! limited menu make the dinner treats within budget ! Their staffs, especially owner welcome guest with smiley faces and friendly approaches. 

Recommendation from them was sincere and up to expectation.  

Good try !

Author: 662_t_p_nka_Ostrava, Czech Republic
Title: Great reastaurant- we kept comming back
Review: We loved this place. We usually prefer to visit lots of different restaurants but after the first dinner at Wonderland we kept comming back. It's not a poshy place- just plastic tables and chairs and the surrounding is not the most beautiful either but their fish and sea-food was just excellent. The owner was nice and friendly and prices very good for the quality. Don't miss.Show less

Author: huiyilooPenang, Malaysia
Title: Highly recommended seafood restaurant!!!
Review: This place is almost always full. The dishes served are delicious and the price range is surprisingly low. The 3 of us ordered 5 dishes, consisting of 4 seafoods and 1 vegetables, with the total price just around RM100. A must try if you visit Langkawi!Show less

Author: VeryWhiteBrit
Title: With that size of queue to get in, it looked good, and was.
Review: Worth the wait to eat here as the food was excellent and the service very quick and efficient. There was a good selection of dishes and you would select your own crap if you wished. Very reasonably priced too.

Author: suwei8866
Title: Taste of cooking average.
Review: Taste of cooking is average, normal. Fish is fresh. Kong poh mantees taste no good. Normal price..normal taste.

Author: Changee610
Title: A must try!
Review: First of all, the taste is perfect. We had our dinner twice during our two nights in Langkawi cuz we missed it after the first night! You gotta wait at the peak hour but it's definitely worth it. Kangkung and Lala soup are my personal favourite. The egg and oyster there is kinda different from my hometown here, which means this dish is a must try too! For sure I will recommend my future gang to come here next time when we visit Langkawi.Show less

Author: zentanc
Title: Nice food at reasonable price
Review: The seafood is fresh and scrumptious. I must say the cuisine quality is very good compare to other famous restaurant here. Very Malaysia style street food environment but the hygiene level is acceptable. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Very good experience with friends and family here.Show less

Author: WynnTLYSingapore
Title: There are better options are around the area
Review: Tried this place as it is ranked #9 in langkawi and nearest hihhest ranking local eateries from where I stayed. However the food was quite disappointing. Dishes are sweet, sweet, sweet with a tinge of spicy, sweet and sweet. Maybe the chef forgotten that he has added sugar in and adds again. I dont know how a lime ginger fish can taste sweet. Will give it 2 stars if not for the char kuey teow.Show less

Author: fearsomepuppyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overated
Review: Afraid to report that my opinion of Wonderland is that it's way overrated as per reviews on tripadvisor. We visited Wonderland which is like an outdoor yet covered hawker stall for dinner and ordered a number of dishes including chili crab, steamed fish with ginger, squid and morning glory. The food was ordinary at best, where the crab sauce tasted more like sweet and sour to me and the fish was over cooked. Overall disappointing compared with other options at comparable prices in Langkawi.Show less

Author: eshwaryk
Title: Best food in Langkawi
Review:
If you're looking for tasty food with reasonable price, this is the right place. 

PS : we had tasty steamed fish too. But forgotten to take a picture. We are in hunger :p

Author: HazrinaH4
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: Recommended by a friend to eat here. Initially doubt it as the shop doesn't look appealing. We just braved ourselves to sit and order. Greeted by one of the workers and recommended few dishes. Very honest with his recommendations. Dishes was fantastic, fresh seafood. The price was unbelievable with the amount of dishes we had. We would highly recommend. We might even fly to langkawi to eat here :)Show less

Author: AlinaJoseph
Title: Great place
Review: Our first visit here on the first night. Price is slightly cheaper compare to other restaurants. Food is nice especially prawns and fish. Fresh and delicious. We had butter prawn, steamed red snapper with lime garlic. Yummy.

Author: josd704
Title: Great food but too unorganized
Review: We had good food here. We are used not getting the dishes at the same time but the dishes came so late and with long intervals that it became inconvenient. One of the dishes never arrived. Food was great.

Author: 988denisel
Title: Finger licking good!!!!!
Review: I'd dinner here with my family on our last night at langkawi. We had seafood dinner on every night and to be honest, this is definitely the best seafood restaurant in town. Food is freaking awesome and the price is very reasonable too!!!! We reached at approx. 7pm and had waited for almost an hour. It definitely worth the waiting. Do come earlier to avoid the queue. They were 10 of us and we enjoyed our dinner so much. We will come back again for sure!Show less

Author: sunnyboy9Singapore, Singapore
Title: Old Style Seafood Treats
Review: Roadside store, not quite a restaurant. Plastic chairs under awning with (many) ceiling fans to keep hot air circulating. Chinese Dinner for two for less than 70 ringgits (~18 USD). Sea fresh fishes (we had the grouper), prawns and veggies, beers thrown in. Fish is done many ways with Teochew steam and Cantonese steam most healthy. A good time was had. All for less than What our nearby hotel would charge for a club sandwich. What more could we ask for?Show less

Author: RonnieT96Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Read the excellent reviews and went for dinner last night at 8:30pm with great anticipation. You see, we love our seafood!.1) First disappointment - When we were ready to place our order, the waitress told us the mud crabs were sold out. Disappointed that there was no mud crab left at such an early hour of the night, we placed an order for black pepper steamed flower crabs instead.2) Second disappointment - Five minutes after the order was taken, the waitress came to inform us that the flower crabs have run out too. We were truly disappointed and thought of leaving, but since the rest of our orders had already gone in, we decided to stay on. We reluctantly changed our order to steamed king prawns. 3) Third disappointment -When our vegetables came, we realized they served us kang kong and not kailan. We did not make a fuss as the kang kong looked fresh and nicely cooked.4) Fourth disappointment - The garlic lime steamed fish was served next and unfortunately, it was not fully cooked. The parts near the bone were still red and raw. We had to send it back.Overall, the quality of the food was average, tending towards a sweeter taste (due to a generous use of tomato ketchup as a flavoring) which is not to our palette. Pricing was however reasonable. Would I recommend my friends to visit? Probably not as there are far better alternatives across the road.Show less

Author: fresky_xu
Title: Food is very good
Review: The food is very good, and the price is lower than Cenang area. You have to wait in rush hours. Opening from 5pm to midnight.

Author: timotimo87Singapore, Singapore
Title: Cheap and nice seafood
Review: Like everyone else, I visited this place because of the good reviews. For the food, you really won't be disappointed. The price is consider cheap, if not, very reasonable.The seafood was quite fresh. We have 2 crabs, 2 giant prawns which look the size of lobster in my country, fried rice, one veg and seaweed soup, and 2 drinks. The portions were good. We paid around 150myr.The food took quite long to serve though. But the wait is well worth. We waited slightly more than half an hour. If you come too late, there might be queue and you will have to wait to be seated.The location doesn't have a view of course. It's beside a canal right opposite 24 hours mini mart and shop houses. People just come here for the food. You can park your car opposite the restaurant below the shop houses. There are parking lots there. Or simply just find a place to park.Show less

Author: cathykualalumpurkuala lumpur
Title: family holiday
Review: Food is good n very reasonable. We only manage to eat here on our last day in langkawi n found it to be very good. get here early as it gets crowded fast n u may end up waiting for yr food. Servers were friendly n helpful too.Wish we had came here earlier to hv all our meals!Show less

Author: cowabunga2020Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty fresh seafood
Review: Food is good. Fish and clams were fresh and cooked well. I notice the other tables having very good looking crabs and huge prawns. Price is within reasonable range.Situated along a busy street. Not very big space so it'll be a little crammed up. It's really popular so either be early or be prepared to wait for seats. Worth it.Show less

Author: Ronnie L
Title: Kick myself
Review: We have visited Langkawi many times and have patronised several seafood restaurants with varying degrees of satisfaction. Wonderland has been recommended to us. I have also read good reviews of this restaurant even viewed it but did not patronise it because of the crowds there etc. However, this time, we tried Wonderland and I should kick myself hard for not adopting Wonderland as my default seafood restaurant years ago. It will certainly be our go to seafood restaurant in Langkawi in future.We were impressed by the freshness and taste of their lime and garlic fish plus the salted egg squid. Other dishes like squid in batter and prawns were acceptable. Their crowning glory is their reasonable prices. With such good food and prices, it is no wonder that Wonderland attracts many customers and unless one is there about 6pm, the wait can be 30 minutes or worse than that, every table may have been taken.Show less

Author: gracewpy
Title: Great taste and great value!
Review: Went there for dinner and it was my best meal in langkawi. Food was served relatively fast despite the full house.. The crowd doesn't disperse as its on-going. Service was fast and the food was great tasting and very very reasonable price.

Author: Mohd S
Title: Cheap Delicious Seafood
Review: This place is perfect for people with big appetites yet 'small' wallets!Be ready for big crowds especially now that Langkawi now has a direct Guangzhou-Langkawi flight 4 times a week. Service can be slow during peak periods. Come early (7 pm) for dinner if so.The waitstaff are friendly but not all are particularly knowledgeable about their specialities. So be sure to peruse the menu properly and share your likes & dislikes with the waiter taking your order.Show less

Author: PuSPa_TaNa
Title: Must try
Review: We waited for an hour after order. But I found its worth for waiting. The food very tasty and cheap.

Author: dawsonpdMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fresh authentic seafood on a budget
Review: This had been recommended to us and the food exceeded our expectations. It was ramadan so we went early. The waiter/owner greeted us and recommended the whole fish which he did two ways by slicing it length ways. Service was fast. The lime chilli steamed fish was the stand out - just brilliant and the deep fried dry chilli fish a little dry but still was great. The soft shell crab prawns and lobsters were done with varying dipping sauces. Go with his recommendations and if you like it hot tell him as they will reduce the chilli count for caucasians. Tiger beers for all on a hot 32 degree day. The only down-side is the "river" next to the restaurant which was a bit smelly so better to be in the undercover area. Get your orders in well before sunset as the restaurant suddenly fills with families to break fast and the whole wait staff disappear to hit the tables with food at exactly sunset - these are the regulars and tourists are second best. This was not a detraction but just a great way to watch the locals. Well worth a visit. For 5 adults 3 beers each $A100 the lot. Great value.Show less

Author: U8571YMdavidsMacclesfield, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and price
Review: Even with the pound falling so quickly and the exchange rate changing before I finish putting in my pin number, the value and quality of food here is great. It's not for everyone but my experience here is, always tasty food (fish is very good) and a vibrant atmosphere.Show less

Author: KarliJS123Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great value, delicious seafood!
Review: Read about this place on line and thought we'd give it a try. The place was packed and seafood was fresh, perfectly cooked and such great value! Our waiter, Michael, was very helpful and honest about quantities of food needed. The soft shell crab and steamed fish with ginger is a must!Show less

Author: LewCHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth a try
Review: Went there on a Monday night, from roadside, we saw it was packed with people. Nevertheless, we would still give it a try. Workers there helpful and efficient. Surprisingly, food came out quite fast. A plus point! Dishes were tasty. Another plus point! Price was decent. Overall, no regret.Show less

Author: NiglettiMelbourne, Australia
Title: great local restaurant, excellent value & service
Review: Lovely service, most helpful to explain dishes & not over order. RM125 for 5, including a couple of beers. Nonya fresh local Scnapper, was excellent, crab good, kids loved the chicken with oyster sauce [not spicy, thick juicy sauce] & fried rice, sambal squid was ok, some might say a bit fishy.Complaints about location? Well you see what its like before you sit down, so yes its a bit grubby, but the food was good & a fun quick meal. We ate at just after 6. By 7 it was filling fast as at Ramadan the locals eat after 7. Why complain if you see a big queue? I've waited 25mins at MacDonald's.....for crap food too.The staff were lovely, most helpful, always a smile.Show less

Author: Chris WLowestoft, United Kingdom
Title: My type of place
Review: As a seasoned traveller to Malaysia my wife and I love the food and Wonderland didn't dissapoint, found the place by chance but you can always tell the good ones full of locals. Staff were helpful and good gave advice on the dishes served very helpful. Show less

Author: MelissaF750
Title: Believe the hype!
Review: Multiple taxi drivers recommended Wonderland and it didn't disappoint... We got the lobster fried in butter, fried rice and mixed greens. Super tasty and reasonably priced. Beer is pretty cheap too!

Author: sushsf2016Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Wonderland
Review: Delicious food and very resonable price. Bring your own beer and pay only RM 1 for ice per person. Must try salted eggs soft shell crab n Kam Heong prawns. Fish is also extremely fresh as such steam is best. Go earlier before 7 else its very crowded. Too bad it only opens for dinner.Show less

Author: Vanness_V123
Title: Very cheap seafood restaurant
Review: We found out that this was the most crowded restaurant along the street. We ordered 5-6 types of food + 5 plain rice + drinks and only paid RM99!! Very cheap yet delicious. We will come back again soon.

Author: Lummussingapore
Title: reasonably priced but lots of flies
Review: I must admit after few days dining in Langkawi, this restaurant is the most reasonably priced and food is good and fresh! the place is so popular that almost all tables are reserved. AN interesting sight as half of the tables are reserved by Malay for break puasa. Will definitely recommend for people looking for good seafood .. not too many choices in selection though.Show less

Author: TheMohicanFamily
Title: Favourite place for seafood
Review:
Always came here for dinner. Good food, delicious, can even customise the dish.
Staff friendly. Valuable price. Thanks Michael for take good care of me.

Author: SzeNeeT
Title: extremely cheap seafood!
Review: dropped by for dinner as the place is highly recommended by a local blogger, and the restaurant certainly did not disappoint. portion were huge and cheap, and prices are clearly stated on the menu so no bill-shock!service was pretty good too, we were attended by a staff soon after we arrived despite the large dinner crowd. and food came within 10-15 mins after we placed our order, super efficient!must revisit when i come to langkawi again!Show less

Author: miawong2016
Title: delicious
Review: Friendly service, they will recommended food suit us. Fresh and delicious seafood, valuable price of food. After 7pm was full of crowd wait for dining.

Author: Maggie JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Finger Lickin Good dishes with Reasonable price
Review: The dishes are super delicious. Servants are friendly, most importantly no extra charges or mark up for non-locals !!! Be there around 5.30pm (not much customers), servants will recommend some off menu dishes ;) Must try items, butter prawn, steam egg prawn, omelet, chili crab !!! Show less

Author: Muchadoaboutnothing
Title: Still the same years on...
Review: Great seafood at great pricing! Always crowded so be sure to go early. Always recommended if you're staying around Kuah. But be prepared that it is situated next to a large canal so you get whiffs of the smell from there!

Author: shees2015
Title: Food is delicious and the price is reasonable!
Review: We waited for 40 minutes as what the boss of the restaurant told us. The food served was not disappointed us. We ordered fried sotong, fried rice, oyster Omelette and a garlic fried kang kung, and the total price for four of us was only RM 69! It's very cheap! The most delicious one is the fried sotong. The fried rice had a lot of sotong... Yummy and satisfied!Show less

Author: Orchids P
Title: nice food
Review: This is what I call seafood. The stall is a little bit run down and clamp. Still acceptable. Food service is fast.Should have come here compare to orchids ria that I ate the yesterday night.Think the rice is free flowWonderland Food Store - Hala.Food wise GOOD, Fast and Price...reasonable.98RM for all the food and drinksShow less

Author: maith1Oxford, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, bad hygiene gave us food poisoning
Review: I don't think this is restaurant worthy of 5 stars. Although the food was nice at the time, it's next to a small canal which smells awful. Additionally doesn't look the cleanest of places no gloves etc. Our fears were confirmed the next morning after we woke up with diarrhoea and painful aches in our stomach. Maybe it's just that we come from the uk. But I've been to 5 star rated tripadvisor restaurants, but this doesn't come close to any! Show less

Author: Michael CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great value, 5-star service, overly seasoned food
Review: This is a very popular seafood restaurant, conveniently located along the main road in Kuah. No one will complain about the prices (e.g. RM49 for a 700g steamed snapper). Service is 5-star resort level, quite unusual for a road side open-air stall. They go out of their way to be helpful. You just raise your hand and somebody will come over within seconds. Even called for a taxi for us for our trip back to the resort.The food is good but not spectacular though. Firstly they use frozen seafood. Our mantis prawns were fried beyond recognition - could have been fried mystery meat. Secondly, probably to compensate for the less tasty frozen seafood, they over-season just about every dish except the steamed rice. Too much salt, soya sauce etc. Our soya sauce chicken was swimming in a pool of soya sauce. I think they should be more confident of their ingredients and tone down on the seasoning.Worth the trip for a good dinner. Just expect your food drenched in maximum seasoning!Show less

Author: wildaurigaSingapore
Title: Value for money dinner in Kuah
Review: There was a bit of a wait for the food, but we were informed when we were seated that it would take about 45 minutes because of the school holiday crush. I thought it was worth the wait! The service is brisk but polite, I thought it adorable that they garnished the prawn plates with little butterflies made from carrots and cucumbers, and I appreciated the waitress being honest about whether we were over-ordering for two people. We had the large tiger prawns in two styles, grilled and butter. The butter prawn was very tasty, as was the grilled prawn that came with sambal. The fried squid was deep fried and battered, you couldn't taste how fresh anything is if it's deep fried and battered, but it was nice enough! I'd echo the sentiments of another tripadvisor reviewer and highly suggest putting in an order of salted egg soft-shell crab, and either having a bit at dinner first, or just having the entire lot to go. It's a good midnight snack that keeps it's flavour even after a drive back to the hotel. Show less

Author: Tay-SherdanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value for $$
Review: After reading all the reviews about this restaurant, I decided to give it a try when I am at Kuah Town. This eatery is very popular and crowded. Please go early as is difficult to find car park and good tables (away from the evening sun). We reached around 5.15pm (open at 5.30pm) but they are ready to take our order. There is a large drain besides the eatery. Thankfully, it doesn't stink much and not many flies. There were fans and are enough to take away the heat. The prices are cheaper as compared to Orkid Ria. The seafood served here are frozen seafood and that probably explains the cheaper price. We have 3 adults and 2 kids. We order 1 veg, lala, 900g lobster, 2 flower crab, 2 sting ray. The total bill is about RM 200 plus including drinks. We wanted to order mud crab but we're disappointed that they do not have any that day. I am from Singapore and to be honest, our Singapore Chili crab and BBQ sting ray taste better. Perhaps is a different style of cooking. However, the food is still tasty and if you want a value for $$ seafood, you can patronise this eatery. Show less

Author: YLKwanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 5-star Services
Review: The food is ordinary, just like any seafood restaurant that operates for many years. What makes the restaurant creating a lasting dining experience is the attentive services provided by the staff, especially a gentleman who walks around, assigning table numbers, taking orders, etc.He is sharp, observant, polite and accommodating. The staff are friendly and helpful, too. I give the service five stars.Show less

Author: EmLai2310Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent seafood with reasonable price
Review: The seafood was fresh and good. Price is also reasonable. There are only 2 of us and we are not very good in ordering seafood. But the boss provided good recommendation for us and being very honest by didn't put in a big portion for us. We had a great time here. We will be back!Show less

Author: Delia D
Title: Holiday enthusiasts
Review: Awesome dinner . Very delicious and reasonbally priced.  Definately a must to visit while in langkawi.

Author: SeanDoyle1401Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very delicious seafood yet exceptionally low prices
Review: I went there with my family of five. The overall bill was about even though we ordered 5 or six large platter of a variety of seafood dishes. Although we waited for about 15 minutes (most customers will have to wait for an average of this long unless you come late) the food came quite quickly in large plates at unbelieveably cheap prices. Fantastic.Show less

Author: roryjdoyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best value for money and quality seafood I've had in a long time
Review: Really simple place by the side of the road. Tarpaulin cover over the restaurant but do not be mistaken, the seafood here is outstanding and incredibly good value for money. An excellent kitchen and possibly relatively low overheads make this restaurant my favourite and best value chinese seafood restaurant in a long time. No pork. No credit cards. Cash only. No toilets either.Show less

Author: caligirl4ever79San Francisco
Title: Delicious seafood at unbelievably low prices
Review: Terrific service and a wide array of delicious seafood at prices that are almost ridiculously low! We ate steamed fish, clams, fried mantis, butter prawns and kailan, plus drinks (non alcohol) for less than 100 ringgit. Very local outdoor atmosphere and you will spend a lot of time swatting away flies and bugs, which is the main downside. Look out for the water lizards swimming in the river in front - don't worry they're not alligators!Show less

Author: Rawon J
Title: Best menu
Review: My first choice to have a great dinner with friend and family. Fully recommended for butter prawn, siakap stim ginger, pandan chicken. The price is reasonable. Will come back for sure...

Author: Anthony C
Title: Great price n quality
Review: Very busy restaurant, best sweet and sour chicken I've had. Service quick and food delivery even faster. Flower crab could have been better, but overall a great little place.

Author: Eddy_LeongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Food
Review: The food is only average and try not to take their recommended dish. Because all recommended dish are deep fried and you will be tasting flour more than the dish taste.It might be my high expectations however I don't the same feeling like the same as other reviewer.Show less

Author: Hiew Y
Title: High expectation
Review: With the good reviews from others, me & my hubby decided to try this foodstall. It really a crowded place, luckily we went early & there is available table for us. We ordered many dishes with the recommendation by the staff, i.e. steam fish groupa with lime sauce, black pepper flower crab, fried soft shell crab, salted egg fried sotong, butter prawn & salted vege taufu soup. The taste average only except the fish, quite fresh. Sotong very small size, too much flour & overfried till hard to chew. Butter prawn ok, big size & fresh but taste normal. Black pepper flower crab too spicy till can't enjoy the crab meat taste, preferably sweet & sour or fry. Fried soft shell crab too much flour & cut in small pcs, make us difficult to differentiate between the flour & meat. Overall the food is average, but the price quite cheap, only RM141 for all including drinks & rice. Can have a try if you are staying at Kuah town if u wish to enjoy a budget seafood dinner.Show less

Author: 31CMD
Title: "Wonderland" - A great meal at a great price!
Review: We have eaten at this restaurant dozens of times over this last six or seven years and the food has always been the same top quality.   Once ordered, food is served quickly and efficiently and always with a smile..  Excellent value and highly recommended.

Author: RoumbaSofia, Bulgaria
Title: Best seafood restaurant on the island
Review: We visited the restaurant twice for dinner and for a reason. Although service is not top and staff are running around at a hectic pace, making mistakes and sometimes bringing what you never ordered, the food is what keeps a steady flow of people there. It is fresh, well prepared and on top of that it is best value for money when it comes to seafood on Langkawi. Nothing fancy about it, but really good value.Show less

Author: Abby L
Title: Affordable price for a delicious meal!
Review: Ordered Steamed fish, 500g of fried soft shell crabs, squid, baby clams, a plate of tofu, fried vege and fried egg. It was a hearty meal for 9, and it only costed us exactly RM199! The food was superb and was quick to be served.

Author: James M
Title: Cheap and certainly cheerful!
Review: Smashing Chinese food and cheap beers. My suggestion is to order one thing at a time as everything comes out at once. The benefit to this is you can chill for longer and drink a few more beers whilst enjoying the food. Small meals are aprox RM 10 per dish and beers are RM 4.5. Highly recommend.Show less

Author: davebB2210TYVirginia
Title: Wonderland: Awesome Chinese Seafood; best baby clams I've ever had
Review: We selected this restaurant from the reviews on Trip Advisor. It was within walking distance of our hotel in downtown Kuah. It definitely lived up to its positive reputation. The Baby Clams with Black Bean Sauce were the best I've ever had. My wife had the Fried Fish with ABC Sauce. Very tasty, as well.Diners were almost all large groups of Chinese-Malaysians. A few gringo couples like ourselves. Very busy, but service was reasonably prompt.Restaurant is all on outside patio. Canal on one side. Busy atmosphere. Draft beer (Tiger).Price was very low. Lower than equivalent restaurants in Thailand, which was a surprise to me. Everything in Malaysia was cheap.Without a doubt, the best meal we had on Langkawi.Overall: Highly ReccomendedShow less

Author: godeater206Melbourne, Australia
Title: The Family Gorge
Review: My god what can I say we ordered 10 dishes including a 500g soft shell crab takeaway, and it tasted great for what we paid. Make sure you ask what fish is fresh, also they will give you recommended dishes for those fishes. The food itself is 3.9 out of 5 stars, and the price is a delicate balance of reasonable. To the business owner good job and don't increase prices hold it steady, ps the butter prawns is awesome. So... 10 dishes plus drinks is RM211. 50Show less

Author: sbkhan
Title: Great food
Review: Great service, Great food and very reasonably priced. Location is not the best, if that's what you are after. Highly recommended for their food though

Author: Wen P
Title: Please go for it
Review:
They served delicious food with reasonable price
I would recommend to try their nyonya style fish , spicy and sour taste

Author: glennc434Hoofddorp, The Netherlands
Title: Absolutely fantastic food
Review: Not much in Kuah but this is a must vist if you like fresh seafood for a reasonable price. Had dinner here twice and it was so so good. Fresh fish, had that grilled and one steamed with lime and garlic. Tiger prawn a big as a child's arm , vegetables very very tasty. Totally stuffed (2 adults / 1 child) with a couple of drinks for just 90-100 MYR. Can be very packed though, either be there around 19:00 or later at around 21:00, peak times in between could leave you waiting for 30-45 minutes, as there are 1-2 chefs in the kitchen working their behinds off to create some beautiful dishes.Show less

Author: Simon L
Title: Reasonably priced
Review: Food is reasonably priced. Food tasted good too. A tad hot as there is no air condition. Take a bit of effort to find some car park. Muslim friendly restaurant.

Author: Joyce6804Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Price Saving
Review: Service was good even with big crowd. Food arrived very fast although many people occupying the tables not served with food yet. The chilli flower crab was a bit of dissapointment as the crabs was not fresh and there was not enought meat. The kamheong lala was served with the thin lala and it will be good if this was replaced with the thick one. Price is very reasonable and we were charged less than RM120 inclusive of 5 dishes and drinksShow less

Author: evie558Penang, Malaysia
Title: Affordable seafood
Review: This place is crowded every night with both local and international tourists. Service was quick despite the overwhelming number of customers. Waiters were polite and prompt in serving the customers. The food was great and very very affordable. On our first day, we ordered fried squid which was one of the best I have tried! The chili flower crab was a bit of a disappointment as the crabs were not fresh and there was not enough meat. The kamheong clams on the other hand was superb! On our second day we ordered steamed sea bass (siakap) teochew style, kamheong mantis prawns, and fried butter prawns and kangkung. The sea bass was average, I have tried better and fresher ones in other parts of Malaysia. The kamheong mantis prawns were overfried and tough instead of crispy, which was abit of a letdown. The saving grace was the butter prawns - delicious, juicy and fragrant! Our total came to about RM 76 (approximately AUD 25) , which is REALLY cheap considering the amount of seafood we ordered for three people. Highly recommended if you like delicious seafood at a great price! Do remember to ask the waiters for what seafood is in season and for a recommendation.Show less

Author: stu_le_brew
Title: worth a visit, fast service very good food
Review: loved this place, it fills up very quickly, surrounding places were left empty, nice peopl very tasty seafood

Author: Isi_99_100Budapest, Hungary
Title: 7 dinners out of 8 nights
Review: Our hotel was very close to this place and we found it here on Tripadviser. On our arrival as it was very late, just managed to get some food before they closed. This gave a good opportunity to meet the owners. Michael is a very nice guy, full of energy and very friendly! The food we had was really wonderful!! So during our 8 days stay we had dinner 7 times as they were closed for one night. Each time the food was super with very fast service! The last night we had a speacial treat from Michael, thanks for that again! Thanks also to Atun and the Chef who makes these perfect dishes! Highly recommended place! Very good value!!!Show less

Author: LiquidMeisterHunenberg, Switzerland
Title: Super Food!
Review: Went there in search for some local fare. It was so good, we went back the following day with our friends again.You must try the soft shell crab, black pepper crab as well as any other local delicacy.It's busy on the weekends, so plan ahead.Show less

Author: lihwei84Sapporo, Japan
Title: Very cheap and delicious seafoods! Friendly and helpful staffs too!
Review: Went there in December 2015 for dinner with my gf based on good reviews from Tripadvisor. When we arrived, the restaurant was full and we needed to queue for the table. However, we were not waited too long because the staffs were quite efficient. Ordered few dishes (as can be seen in the photos). The foods were delicious! 3 seafoods (squid, prawn and clam) and 1 vegetable for 2 person only costed less than RM60. That night we were full with satisfaction. We ended up went there again the second night and were not disappointed too!Show less

Author: vtrmech
Title: Bang for the buck...
Review: Excellent sea food at reasonable price..crabs, lobsters, sambal prawns are great..must visit in kuah...service is good...Near to Bayview hotel...

Author: asien_as
Title: Great food
Review: Went here coincidentally. But end up happy about our choice. Great food. Value for money.. Would like to come back some day

Author: timeinthesun63
Title: Not bad
Review: We went there with some friends .The meal was ok but not out of this world.It was a bit of a let down,after all that we herd about this restaurant .I feel the other restaurant My Chef was alot better.

Author: CLYong
Title: Good Food at Great Price
Review: The seafood and dishes was served prompt and all orders in one go. However, can be crowded at times and may need to wait for seats.

Author: Dynamo1510
Title: GOOD FOOD
Review: Food is excellent. Have been going to Langkawi for many years now and still we family come back to the same restaurant every night. Normally we are there early as 6.30pm.

Author: Xin-FangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap seafood
Review: During our visit, foul odor from the nearby drain, luckily not throughout our dinner. No toilet in this restaurant. One needs to across the road and walk further for public toilet. Car parking is limited. The waiter was friendly and attentive. We ordered a steamed red snapper (RM38.50 for 500 grams), small portion of fried squid (RM10.00), small portion of stir-fried baby kailan vegetable (RM10.00) and small portion of mantis prawn cooked in kam heong style (RM10.00). The drinks included a glass of apple juice (RM3.50) and a glass of hot chinese tea (RM0.50). Steamed white rice was RM3.00 for three persons. Total bill was RM75.50. The food was acceptable, nothing fancy. The kam heong style was different from what we have tasted all these years. Well, perhaps this is the style of Northern Peninsular Malaysia. Overall, the food is considered cheap. What I heard from the waiter is that their seafood are frozen type, not those freshly swimming in the tank. Hence, it explained the cheaper seafood price here.Show less

Author: SasiKumar_SK17
Title: TASTY - CHEAP - GOOD CUSTOMER SERVICE
Review: Me and my wife had an awesome dinner here. Food is cheap and tasty. Highly recommended to those who would like to have a good meal in Kuah Town!

Author: EnAjOeKlang, Malaysia
Title: Good seafood n good price in Kuah
Review: Only open for dinner, go as early as 6pm. After 7pm would b too crowded. We reached abt 6.30pm, service was good n food were served promptly. It was only abt 10 mins wait after ordering. Assam fish was good n very appetizing. Do skip the fried osyter (recommended by the shop) coz it was mainly eggs. Kam heong bamboo lala was good too. Didnt manage to try many dishes as there were only 3 of us. Definately will go again. Show less

Author: AsiansharkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Affordable and good seafood
Review: Chose Wonderland over Orkid after reading reviews that Wonderland is less touristy and cheaper. We arrived at 830pm on a Saturday, I expected a long waiting time but the staff came to take our orders promptly (actually we were still deciding what to eat). Drinks arrived soon and food followed faster than expected. The waitress noticed that my table was a bit shaky and she went to get a piece of cardboard to place under the leg of the table, without us asking. Great scores for service! Food wise, the salted egg crab was crispy and tasty. Not much meat but it was flower crab, they are not huge. Chilli clams was spicy and appetising. The Kai lan was a bit bland. Sting ray was good but a bit small, but it's ok there were only 2 of us eating. Total bill, including 2 cans of Carlsberg, was only 71RM. Overall happy experience! Show less

Author: PoojaSachdevMumbai, India
Title: Cheap and fresh food!!
Review: on our first night in langkawi, we went here for dinner...i must say...efficient service, tasty fresh seafood, a very humble place....nothing fancy to offer in terms of ambience...simple plastic chairs and uneven tables...pls carry mosquito repellent!!!the food here is reallly really good!!i also loved their litchi drink..Show less

Author: 421RichardMMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fantastic.
Review: I have eaten at Wonderland a few years ago, and wanted to see if the food was of the same quality.After reading other reviews I decided to book for 6pm, We were the first guests on arrival, this happened on a subsequent evening. The Decor is the same, plastic chairs and un level tables with sweep fans overhead.But you do not come to wonderland for the ambiance but for the food. Michael the owner was great to deal with, we ordered two large prawns barbecued with garlic and chilli, Clams in spring onion, ginger and garlic, a sweet and sour braised cabbage dish ( delicious) deep fried squid. As the local shops were closed for BYO wine, Michael was able to provide us with a lovely sauvignon blanc. On our return trip we had re snapper steamed in a light soy sauce , very delicious, clams in Chilli, and also Chilli crab, with a light fried rice, all very delicious and would strongly recommend Wonderland food store.Show less

Author: Muhammad Faizal K
Title: Great cheap seafood!!!
Review: Excellent seafood with affordable price! Don't  expect fine dining or luxurious setting... but the food is good and cheap!

Author: MarcusTan94
Title: Finger licking good
Review: Come early because it get crowded, fantastic and delicious food. Really really cheap too please just do yourself a favour and try this

Author: Yeap76Bayan Lepas, Penang
Title: Cheap Seafood; Fast service but average taste
Review: I was recommended this place by someone whom frequent Langkawi. The place located beside a huge drain and at times, it emits a foul smell. The price is quite reasonable and the owner is also very friendly and able to recommend some dishes without breaking your wallet. I like the spicy squid. The other dishes we tried were average like fried chicken deep fried squid; stir fried vegetables; fried rice and noodles. The service is also good and overall a reasonable price. Show less

Author: clementsim
Title: Ok, But Overrated on TripAdvisor
Review: It's very busy. It took 15 for our drinks to be served. Food was ok, nothing bad but nothing fantastic either.

Author: F274TSmelissac
Title: AMAZING
Review: This place knows exactly what they are doing. Fantastic food! Wish we found this gem sooner! Much cheaper than Cenang.

Author: Bewdley45Kidderminster, United Kingdom
Title: Nothing to look at but don't be fooled!
Review: What lovely food......Tiger Prawns are amazing especially when they were steamed with chilli and lime.This place really is a little gem don't be fooled by the plastic furniture and plates. It is also one of the few food places - apart from the hotel Restaurants - that you can buy alcohol. We ate here four times! Wonderland your food is really Wonderful! Show less

Author: aldrienmGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Superb seafood at good price !
Review: This is a place where honest cooks put their heart and soul into every dish, and a great boss that only wants the best for their customers. We stumble across this restaurant on trip advisor, decided to drive 30 mins away to eat. Blew our taste buds off!! Fresh seafood, great flavors and bargain price ! What more can u ask for ?!Show less

Author: Hannah S
Title: Nice affordable food
Review: Hawker centre style restaurant. Dishes are deliciously cooked. Waiter recommends which seafoods are freshly delivered on the day. Price is cheap and doesn't take long to serve.

Author: Suanti K
Title: Delicious food
Review: Highly recommended !! 👍 the seafood is fresh and with bargain price.. will come again ❤ especially lala .. nice

Author: mopbcgSurry Hills, Australia
Title: Yummy seafood at bargain price
Review: We visited the stall in January based on tripadvisor reviews. Initially abut hesitant as we were worried about the wait and service but boy are we glad we did. The menu is quite extensive, and reminds me a lot of the stalls in Jalan Alor in KL，except this one is more seafood base. I would recommend ordering the lala, the king prawns, and the crab. The service is efficient and we didn't have to wait very long for our food. The place is busy so we were pretty entertained just doing so ppl watching. It was so good we went back the second night! Unfortunately on the second night, we were late and the lala was all sold out! The waiter that time told us to expect a 30min wait for our food, but I think all food came after 20 min of ordering. All in all highly recommended. Both time we ordered enough food for 4 and only paid around $30-40 AUD. Show less

Author: reddragon5860
Title: Delicious Seafood
Review: We went there 3 times out of 5 nights' stay in Kuah Town. Tiger Prawn was the best in Langkawi. Staff were friendly and gave us good recommendations on how to cook seafoods to our taste.

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Simple, Affordable & Delicious Food in Langkawi!
Review: Came to this restaurant when came for office branch visit. We ordered fried rice, fried meehoon, fried squid, kailan, fried oyster, lemon steamed fish, Nyonya style fried fish & dried chilli chicken. Overall, the food is good & waiting time is a out 15mins. Total bill came to MYR180 for 8person.Show less

Author: Teeeeeeva
Title: Fried Sotong and Onion omelette
Review:
Food was delicious and waiters are friendly and helpful.
If you reach there around 8pm, you may need to wait for very long. (Friday and weekend)

Author: Yrneha
Title: Delicious seafood
Review:
Excellent food, friendly ppl. Must try their lobster...very good. 
They even cater for vegetarians. Not much choice but cant complain...

Author: Sofia S
Title: Wonderful lah!
Review: One of the best place for food in Langkawi! They have fresh seafood and obviously it's very cheap compared to alot of other places. But be prepared to wait for a table. I've been here a few times and have been full most times. Just come earlier to avoid having to wait :) They do not have pork but they do serve beer. You know it's a good place when the locals dine here too!Show less

Author: melaniea326Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best Meal Ever!
Review: Wonderland was recommended to us by staff members at our hotel so we decided to give it a shot. We arrived at 9pm on a Saturday night however the place was packed and we were told that the wait for food would be 1 hour. We were still eager to try this restaurant, so we returned the next night at 6pm (would recommend going at this time or booking a table). Wonderland Food Store is not a fancy restaurant, it's casual - outdoors with plastic chairs and tables but the food was absolutely amazing. I'm a fussy and careful eater but I felt more than comfortable eating at Wonderland.When we arrived we were greeted by a worker who spoke perfect english and gave us a run down of the menu. He was more than happy to help and suggested some dishes we should try in relation to what we had told him we enjoyed eating. We ordered the Fried Squid, Soft Shell Crab (Crispy), Chicken in Oyster Sauce, Baby Cabbage and some fried and steamed rice. All in all it cost just under $75RM which is ridiculously cheap!It was easily the best meal we have EVER eaten. I repeat, the BEST meal.We will be going again tomorrow night, and have some regret that we didn't find this place earlier, as we would have gone every single night.Show less

Author: Mário RMacau, China
Title: Wonderseafoodland!!!
Review: We got there as recommendation by the hotel staff. I couldn't imagine a best place to go to someone that just arrived to the Island and is tired of the trip. More casual atmosphere is impossible, completely packed with both locals and turists and the food is beyond the word bargain. Very cheap and tasty!Show less

Author: pandaadbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful food and freat staff
Review: This one here has been a bit of a random choice for us. Recap: We arrived at our close by hotel and tried the "Asian delight" off the menu. This was a terrible mistake. We must go out. We walked around Kuah for a bit and ended up here. I admit it, this had a few reasons:1. Very close by2. Very well visited3. I saw them serving beer What can I say, I like having a beer with dinner.Anyway, we were seated and the waiter was by our table in minutes. They have a few people on staff speaking great English for people like me who don't speak any Malay. Beers were super quick, food moderately. I have to say, it got quicker with each visit they recognised us. We ended up going back to this place 3 times simply because we enjoyed our selves and felt taken care off. We tried heaps off things:Plum chicken, sweet sour chicken, Thai chili prawns, Fried rice, steamed fish, fried nuddles, fried vegetables (several), Soft shell crabs and so on .. I felt like we were trying to work our way though the menu.All of the above were delightful! But what's even more important (for us at least), is that the staff will try and avoid letting you order something that they think you might not enjoy. They base this on their experience with tourists etc. For example: We were tempted to eat a different style of prawns and chose one sauce at random. Turned out this was one of the spiciest dishes we could order. The waiter told us what it was we were getting and told us exactly what to expect. In addition he then recommended a different sauce, brought the ingredients back from the kitchen to let us smell the aroma and even offered for our prawns to be peeled. Delicious! I think my favourite were the prawns with fried rice (the fried rice came with a different secret sauce for us each time, and we loved it!) The prices are super affordable. Quite frankly, if you don't order beers, you'll have one of the cheapest meals of your life! And you'll be full, full, full! A very great place, visited by locals and tourists the same. Great service, do however keep in mind that if you order a steamed fish, it'll have to steam for an hour. And this will - yes - take an hour! (we did hear people complain about their dishes when preparing them already takes a long amount of time). Our experience: First night, steamed fish, around 45 minutes.Second night, Rice, noodles, fried vegetables, fried chicken. Around 20 minutes Other nights, similar style dishes, 15-20 minutes.Drinks are being brought out right away, so don't worry and just enjoy sitting outside.Show less

Author: Ritchie Y
Title: Casual atmosphere, great food
Review: We were keen to find a restaurant that offered great food at reasonable prices. We ended up going to Wonderland on two consecutive nights because... well, that's just how we roll.

Author: ellBem
Title: Meh
Review: this restaurant was highly recommended by our hotel, and others, said to be the best seafood in Langkawi. We were pretty disappointed - the fish fillets were frozen, the noodles looked and tasted like 2 minute noodles, the vegetables tasteless and the prawns floury.

Author: Jiggle11
Title: Yummy cheap food
Review: We ate here twice, really enjoyed the prawns and stir fried greens ! Quick friendly service, well cooked, fresh , cheap food one of the best eateries of our holiday

Author: benquintens
Title: Excellent and honest seafood
Review: This is not a fancy tourist trap restaurant but an honest place where they prepare fresh seafood on a style of your preference. Don't expect fancy preparations or presentations but honest, very good tasting and affordable seafood.

Author: NicolaV307
Title: Great food, service and ambience
Review: We ate here three nights, the staff were attentive, explained the dishes and even though incredibly busy the food was served quickly, well cooked and tasty. Well worth a visit. This is a family run business ... Thank you for three really great meals.

Author: AnnAnnL_13Malaysia
Title: Tasty! Value for money!
Review: The restaurant is located at Kuah Town. The environment is not as great as those fancy seafood restaurants at Cenang Beach. However, the food served is awesomely tasty and fresh. Most importantly, it is value for money. The portion of the food is bigger than what the others serve. Definitely the cheapest Chinese seafood restaurant in town as four of us spent lesser than RM110.00 for more than 8 dishes. Awesome!Show less

Author: orchid55Melbourne
Title: Good & tasty food
Review: We quite enjoyed the food here. We ordered barbeque fish which was very fresh and tasty, sambal prawns which were also good and soft shell crabs that were crisp fried - not something I would recommend. We went there around 8.30 PM and were able to get a table straight away. Show less

Author: Wildcat7400Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Food With Amazing Prices!
Review: My good friend told me that I should check out this restaurant when I'm in Langkawi. Even my cousin mentioned that it was her favourite seafood restaurant. Curious, I decided to visit the restaurant to see whether their claims were warranted. They were & we had gone back twice for dinner! My girlfriend & I enjoyed every single dish that we had ordered for the 2 days we were there. The first time, we had 5 dishes and that cost us RM70! I was so shocked. It was too good to be true. The second time, we shared 5 dishes too and the damage was RM67! It was simply amazing since the food were extremely tasty. The only regret was not being able to try their fish & chicken dishes. That will be on our list the next time we visit.Service was fast and the staffs were very helpful and friendly when we asked for recommendations. Thus, look no more. This seafood joint is really in a class of its own. Just go for it! You won't be disappointed. It had surpassed my expectations and that is saying a lot because I'm very particular with my food! Enjoy peeps!Show less

Author: Rogerio A
Title: The food is great
Review: The food is great and the service, even though weak, it is the best in the region. Always crowded, Arrive early.

Author: invisible999Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh and tasty seafood
Review: This location get very busy during dinner time, with long service time and seems most people in reviews are frustrated about this. So to avoid disappointment, arrive a little bit early, around 5:30-6PM and you will be fine.
