You can also order takeout instead of seating and this also will considerable shorten service time.As far as for food, pretty much anything in the menu which is seafood is excellent. WShow less

Author: jollimsingapore
Title: Long wait for Good meal
Review: We were there on a Tuesday Night, waited almost an hour when we placed order at 6.30pm. Late comers pick up a q no and wait.Go early by 6pm, and pick outside seats away from kitchen.Food is reasonably priced and average Zhi- Char style. Fried fish with 3 sauces is a must try. Plain rice came in a pot, actually enough for 10 average eaters.There was a Oppo shop opposite, can buy SIM card at RM$37.80 for 2G and RM$8 talk time. Better than the ones we bought at Airport, DIGI RM$24 (UP RM$29) because we bought 3x only with 800mbs and RM$5 talktime.If u can wait, go to this place and get SIM card, took 20 mins to set up new SIM, so must have time.Show less

Author: silvana g
Title: Tony and Silvana from Fremantle wa
Review: What a great place to eat. And it's outside. Thankyou Michael and all the staff their and for Michaels dad for a lift back to our hotel. Thankyou.

Author: Changsta888London, United Kingdom
Title: Long wait but exceptionally good food
Review: Had wait a hour for food as it was at peak period but when it arrived it was exceptionally good and fresh. The staff are courtesy and gave advice on recommended dishes as well as portion sizes. Highly recommend this place but arrive early before 8pm otherwise its a long wait for a table and service.Show less

Author: kien kiet l
Title: Delicious food. The price actually shocked me a bit
Review: The food is so damn good especially the lobster. But the price is a bit...jz a bit expansive..? Depends on you la.

Author: Angeline GPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: We ordered food that were simple (like the oyster omelette, kangkung belacan..). The foods weren't as good as expected as most of the reviews. Also, the workers aren't that friendly, the only friendly face was a lady, I assume is the owner of this restaurant. We actually came here the second time having that when we came the first time it was very packed, with the attendant being rather impolite (so was the second time), fyi. However, the price of the food here is quite reasonable.Show less

Author: 742sunilkBarcelona, Spain
Title: Tasty Food, Great Value for Money
Review: If you are keen to try out, cheap asian food, this is the place. Its crowded and service takes a while (thanks to the sheer number of orders processed by a limited number of chefs) but the food was quite tasty and authentic. Tip - Remember to have cash with you and try to be there by 6.30 p.m. as it gets really crowded after that.Show less

Author: chilledout12345Macclesfield, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, good fun.
Review: We tried Wonderland because of the good reviews & weren't disappointed. It doesn't look much, plastic chairs & tables & utter mayhem as it's bursting with customers, but it's so worth it! Michael looked after us - sometimes you have to take a number & wait for a table as it's so busy, & occasionally the food takes a while, but it's not a problem as there's always a beer while you wait & the food is gorgeous. The seabass we had was fabulous, Michael informed us we'd missed the best bit, the cheeks, which he swiftly sorted for us. We also enjoyed the fried chicken, which sounds a bit pedestrian but was just lovely. Michael even remembered our names which was astonishing! Do yourself a favour & try it. Show less

Author: Alex L
Title: Overrated
Review:
Seafood Fried Rice - Nice but oily
Sambal Kang Kong - Nice but lack of chilli punch
Fried Sotong - Average
Fried Prawn - Average

Author: Nguyen T
Title: prawn and clam is fresh. soup and vegetable is not good
Review: we came here in dec 2015 at about 7:30pm and ordered 2 grilled tiger prawn, 1 sea weed soup, 1 mixed vegetable, 1 chili clams. we had to wait about 45 mins until the food were served. the tiger prawn and clams were fresh and delicious. the grilled tiger prawn was served with a special fish sauce like in vietnam. the chili sauces with clams was okie. However the sea weed soup and mixed vegetable were not good at all. They used baby corn to cook with sea weed (tofu as well), but it didnt match with sea weed at all. The vegetable was cooked with too much oil and too sweet. Total for 2 persons was 121 RM. Show less

Author: Justalson
Title: Seafood hunter
Review: Read the review and went there to experience. You gotta wait for a while in order to get the good food. It's packed with  tourist and local customer. Price are reasonable and the food are delicious.

Author: Tammy7767Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is really overrated
Review: I usually like to support local businesses but the purpose of this post is to manage your expectations. Like many of you I hv read the glowing reviews of this restaurant and had build up a certain expectation of the quality of food. I went there on 27/Dec with my family of 6, and like everyone else waited over an hour for our food. We ordered steam fish, veg, oyster egg, mantis prawns and clam soup. For those of you who are used to good Chinese food you will find the taste and quality here lacking, I am sorry to say. They use frozen fish hence it was not fresh, the oyster egg was more starch than egg and bland, veg was ok, clam soup was passable bad mantis prawns was so so.. Am sorry to say everything was not up to expectations. It was a real disappointment for us, although the price was reasonable at RM148 for 6 of us. Show less

Author: Cynz87
Title: Be patient slow service is waiting around 1,5 hour
Review: The food is totally plain, doesn't have taste, under my expectation since I need to wait around 1,5 hour until food coming...

Author: midreefSingapore
Title: Sumptuous dinner, good and value for money
Review: We went in the evening at about 5.30pm after touring Kuah town. The place is highly recommended by the staffs at the hotel. We found the food very good and value for money. In fact, we went back again the following night, because my family enjoyed the Fried Chicken, Fried Oyster Omelette and Garlic and Spring Onion Venus Clams. The service is prompt and waiters are very friendly, and make a number of good recommendation too. Place is very crowded by 6pm, it is good to make a reservation if possible.Show less

Author: 618ginal
Title: Delicious, cheap, authentic Chinese
Review: Didn't know what we were walking into but this little gem ended up being delicious! The 2 of us ordered about 8 meals to try everything and 2 beers and the bill still only came to approx. AUD $20pp.Make sure to try their special chilli crab and the clams! Lobster and while fish also looked great!Show less

Author: Gooner1759London, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to eat local food - give it a try.
Review: We were put on to this place by some fellow guests. Would admit that I may not have chosen this place on first impressions however any local restaurant that is full of locals must be a good sign. Welcomed from the start by the Owner? Michael who sorted out a table for eight we had menus and drink orders taken before we could settle in our chairs. He was welcoming and attentive from the start and given how busy it was he moved around the tables keeping everybody happy. Good selection of Fish, meat chicken and vegetarian dishes, orders taken by his team and soon we were tucking into freshly cooked food prepared by the team in the open kitchen working there socks off to deliver the food hot and fresh. We have been back once and plan to go again before our holiday is over. And the final plus after the good food and good service - the price. Great value for money. Give it a tryShow less

Author: Millennium_Falcon888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Slightly overrated
Review: Since we were staying in nearby Bayview Hotel, we decided to go for Wonderland for dinner, based on good reviews in TripAdvisor.After waiting a short while for a table (the restaurant was packed that night), we finally got ours and proceed to order what we wanted. It was seafood as usual (very fresh in LGK) and we went for stuff like Deep Fried Squid, Chili Crabs, Stir-Fried Grouper, Stir-Fried Clams, and Vegetable-Beancurd.The food was merely okay (although quite filling, at the same time) and honestly speaking, we can get nicer seafood at some of the more "little-known" restaurants in other parts of Langkawi. Maybe it's the convenient location that makes people come to Wonderland (near the town center of Kuah) and sample the seafood here, without trying other hidden gems that the island has to offer!Of course this is merely my opinion and others may feel differently about the seafood at Wonderland Food Store!Show less

Author: tpshSingapore
Title: Food is okay
Review: We went to this store twice.Total for 8 pax: RM 196. The food was satisfying. Fried sea bass with black bean sauceSweet and sour crabs - 3 flower crabs (surprising there's meat. Pretty good)2 veggiesOmelette甘香chickenSalted veg soupDrinksTotal for 8 pax: RM 195. This was less satisfying except for the fish, pepper crabs and you mak choy.Steamed fish (teow chew style)2 chilli crabs (spicy and taste is only so so)2 pepper crabs (not too dry. Good taste)2 veggiesChicken in ginger and spring onion (bland and tasteless with chicken beast meat)1 jug of lime juiceStaff can get you a seat quite quickly within 10 mins. The wait for the food was much longer for our second night. You might also want to consider Ka Kee Lang which is a few doors away. Show less

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Still the best Chinese in Langkawi
Review: I am back in Langkawi after a years rest away. Wonderland is a fantastic Chinese Restaurant. Tonight 4 of us went for dinner, the place was packed, every table full. We waited approx 10 minutes before being taken to the table. We took our own bottle of wine ( no corkage charges ) and my friend and I had 6 cans of Tiger between us. Food was, plate of Fried Rice, Deep Fried Squid, Butter Prawns, Sour Plum Sauce Chicken, Noodles, and a vegetable called Baby Kalian. All this food, together with fantastic service, for four of us came to £16.46. This really is the best Chinese in Langkawi.Show less

Author: shirleychau
Title: Good valuable seafood
Review: Fresh seafood.  Very cheap and very convenient location, just outside Bella Vista Resort.  Value for money but go early as it is packed with diners with limited tables.

Author: Kelvin TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food with unbelievable price
Review: This place is packed to the brim. The waiter would help you seated. He knew the weather and would advise if you needed a place under the shade.He was very honest in recommending food. Although the clam is one of their specialty, he advised me not to order it as it was not very fresh. And so he didnt cook that for us. Mantis prawn(medium), soft shell crab, chilly kangkung, red snapper fish, fried sotong, rice and lime juice cost us only RM121!!! Unbelievable for the great taste.Show less

Author: You S
Title: The food is nothing compared to the ones in KL/Selangor
Review: The only thing I'd credit this restaurant for is probably the service. But trust me, if you're from Selangor or KL you would've been to better seafood restaurant that serve much more delicious seafood. Idk why it's called the 'best seafood in town'. I don't think it can even survive a year in KL or USJ or even Kota Kemuning. Show less

Author: Wee hong G
Title: Good reputation restaurant ! Very popular !
Review:
No frills restaurant recommended as the most popular in Kuah town.
Went there on first night but walk away as the wait is too long.
Went back on second night and we are not disappointed.
Tasty food at a good price.

Author: SG_ExcursionistSingapore
Title: Delicious Food
Review: This is local food wonderland, prices are affordable and the food is delicious. We ordered at least 8 dishes including fish, prawns, chicken, crabs and 2 vegetable dishes and drinks for 9 pax and the final bill came to RM206. The pepper and chilli crabs were well executed however, they were quite small and not very meaty. But other then that, the food was tasty.Show less

Author: dianed265
Title: Great seafood!
Review: Great place for a family of 5. Delectable seafood, however the fish was only slightly fresh. Highly recommend the oyster omelette, buttered prawns and fried cuttlefish. The price was reasonable (RM 107 for 5 dishes) and the open air concept was a definite plus point.

Author: Azmi B
Title: Makan time
Review: Service is excellent.... Tq Michael. Food esp omellete with oyster, steam fish lime n chilli , chilli lala is superb. Even though it is packed the food is fast without compromising on quality

Author: AkbarBirminghamBirmingham
Title: Well cooked seafood at a reasonable price
Review: We ate here on our first night in Langkawi. Although it took us a while to find the restaurant we were impressed by the quality of the food there. We were really hungry and the place was so busy, but food was served fairly quickly. The lobster was delicious and the other dishes were also well cooked. Really good standard of food.Show less

Author: Peter EKalkan, Turkey
Title: Get there early
Review: We arrived around 6pm having watched the new Bond movie at a cinema around the corner. A very similar dining experience to our recent meal at My Chef around the corner. In fact the menu is pretty much identical .This is by no means a high end seafood restaurant but the food was tasty and ,for Westerners ,very good value - less than 90 ringgits for a substantial meal for 2 with several beers.Recommended for a cheap night out!Show less

Author: rebs101Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing, cheap, local food
Review: We were recommended this place by our taxi driver. It really didn't look much but we mixed with the locals, the food came very quickly, tasted delicious and 3 mains, rice, noodles, beer and two soft drinks cost us RM 50 superb value for money. Staff even offered to help us get a taxi and suggested places for us to go onto.Show less

Author: MandyCheangGenting Highlands, Malaysia
Title: Delicious & Reasonable Price of Seafood Restaurant in Kuah
Review: We are group of 15 people to dine in the Wonderland Food Store. Staff are friendly & good serviced. Time served food was acceptable. Price was reasonable for our big group of 15 people. Food was tasty & delicious. Highly recommended for those love seafood. Have to reserved table to avoid waiting at there. Show less

Author: lyla1lyla1
Title: Just average
Review: If you're around town, try it. Otherwise don't bother, not worth a trip there. We had a fabulous seafood dinner at Orkid Ria the night before with similar dishes and found Wonderland to be sub-par. Service was excellant but food was just average. We did not stay in Kuah and a trip there took us 20min so it wasn't worth a trip there for us.Show less

Author: prawnzKuala Lumpur
Title: Average seafood experience
Review: This place is really famous among tourists as every tour guide recommends it. The great thing about this place is the price which is reasonable and affordable. It also caters to groups of friends with various races as its serves no pork. However the food is just average.Show less

Author: Brian H
Title: nice seafood and not expensive
Review: The price of sea food can vary a lots, but Wonderland Food Store provide nice seafood and it charge affordable price.

Author: WelshmandownunderKenilworth, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderland in every way!
Review: Loved it! The buzz if amazing, the food great and the service really great!We had soft shell crab, squid, prawns, Chinese veg, fried rice....tone of food all for less than £10 for 2of us...oh, bottle of wine was £6!Yes, it's rough and ready but the guys were so helpful and we loved the place...going back!Show less

Author: fookent
Title: Fresh seafood with reasonable price
Review: The dishes here basically in a quite big portion, our trip gt 6 people and we ordered 4 dishes that enough to fill up our tummy..haha...the seafood here is very fresh and is a must-try dishes. The price is RM 125 for 6ppl with 4 dishes ( fish, pork, chicken, kailan).Show less

Author: dharmin2000Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap & Good-Seafood
Review: The restaurant serves a variety of fresh seafood dishes. The prices are reasonably cheap without compromising the portion and taste. It is rather famous with both the locals and tourists alike, therefore you can expect the restaurant to get crowded during the dinner time. There are ample space and the turnaround for a table is quite fast. The service is good and the food is served quite promptly, depending on the crowd. Generally, it is value for your money and you are never going to be disappointed. I say this because i've been to the same place for dinner 4 times since 2010.Show less

Author: paulwV7231RWLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: best restaurant in langkawi
Review: I cant understand how people cant rate this place 5 stars. the food is great and the price is unbelievable. Yes, you sit on plastic garden furniture and eat from plastic plates but who cares? the food is what matters and here it is top notch, you can also have a beer with your food, for 5 ringet.The owner of this place was very friendly and helpful, the place was packed but he said we would get a table in 5 minutes, and he did. he did not forget about us even though he was run off his feet. he had time to make sure we were taken care of and even had a nice chat with us, lovely chap. He even go us a beer while we waited.So, this was my favourite restaurant in Langkawi and if you're reading this then I recommend you go.Show less

Author: stefanvonfalkTrondheim, Norway
Title: Busy place with good food
Review: Me and my gf was there yesterday and eat.The place was crowded with tourists and local people. That's always a good sign.We asked the waitress to recommend a fish dish and a dish with chicken.Both where excellent!On the downside the kitchen mixed up the order. Gave me a small portion and my gf a medium one.We also got steamed rise when we ordered fried. Send that back, but we didn't notice the size difference after half way in the meal. Show less

Author: Rimbabelantara
Title: good
Review: Best and reasonable whatt ever food you order it'll satisfied you.location old Kuah town. camo early coz many others will pack the restaurant

Author: Jajourney06
Title: One of the best seafood restaurant on the Island
Review: Wonderland is one of the best seafood restaurant we try at the island before. It located at kuah town but 3KM away from Kuah town jetty. Usually crowded on weekend dinner because the food here quick tasty. Food price is affordable.

Author: Tricia LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very local - cheap and delicious!
Review: Found this place based on reviews and it did not disappoint. Although a bit chaotic, the staff have a sort of system going and will find a table for you. The food was better and cheaper than the other seafood places we ate at on the island.Show less

Author: Y2012VFahmedeCairo, Egypt
Title: Delicious
Review: We heard about this resturant from the Internet & decided to try it. It seems a family busses all the stuff is more than friendly, the atmosphere is simple and local, so don't think about the luxury and fine! Menu has lot of variety, I recommend to choose the small size with lots of choices rather than large size of two or three choices. prices is quit good and portion is bigger than we thoughts to price.YOU NEED TO VISIT while ur stay at Langkawi Show less

Author: jinnywren2013Pwllheli, United Kingdom
Title: If you visit langkawi you have to visit this place
Review: We have been visiting langkawi for many years and always make sure wonderland is high on our list for several visits. It is an experience not to be missed and the food the best and freshest available. An absolute must to visit. Anton and his staff are fabulous !Show less

Author: angiesiew
Title: Cheapest yes, food so so
Review: Would say this is the cheapest seafood around but the food is not exceptional. So so but no harm trying :) We only paid RM110 for 6 dishes and 1 fried rice :D

Author: ckyprosLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Name could improve, Food A1!!
Review: We arrived to a busy restaurant after a reluctant recommendation from the hotel, we wanted to eat where the locals eat, Concierge worried about the plastic Chairs. Run by 2 brothers and great front of house with Michael in charge, we enjoyed it from the moment we arrived till we left, lots of atmosphere and great food at value for money prices. so good we wents twice! Try the fish and the lobster!Show less

Author: mk_steven_rKuala Lumpur
Title: There's something you should not order! Really not worth it!
Review: I always visit wonderland food whenever im in langkawi, this i guess is my 4th visit. The food here no doubt is very reasonable & fresh. I would not say it is cheap, as "cheap" is very subjective and its the matter of you the paying customer to decide. I say its reasonable is because its not located at hotspot which is cenang beach. We ordered 7 dish for 4 person, the taste wasnt bad at all expect for 1 item. the CHILI CRAB! it was RM15 per crab and the crab was small & bland. Not much of a taste nor meat. So i would suggest you to skip the sea crab!Other than that food tasted nice, atmosphere is fine, sometimes need to wait for table, so be early! like 6pm or so.I grew up in malaysia eating chinese food all the time, i would say taste is above average. We will come back again,Show less

Author: Chris SCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: A great meal for a great price
Review: Several local folks recommended Wonderland, so my wife and I decided to give it a try.When we first sat down to order, we weren't under the roof. The owner soon came over and asked us to move inside because it was threatening rain. Sure enough, about 20 minutes later, there was a downpour. We were very grateful that the owner knows the weather and was looking out for usWe ordered the fried soft-shell crab, fried rice, vegetables with oyster sauce and a couple of beers. All of the food was excellent. When the bill arrived, I was shocked at how cheap it was.Show less

Author: raylgk88
Title: Taste good and cheap.
Review: Taste awesome and really cheap for the seafood. Been there twice. Their seafood is fresh and will even show it to you for a look firat  before they cook it. Friendly stuff and quick service too.

Author: Camelia467
Title: Amazing food without the price tag!
Review:
Don't be confused by the decor. What they lack in appearance they make up with their tasty food and service. 
This place is a must! Amazing and fresh seafood and great service! 
Highly recommended for anyone that is looking for an authentic experience in Langkawi.

Author: DeividzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best bang for bucks.
Review: Had prawns, fried squid, eggs with onions and vegetables with rice. Food was good. Price was excellent. Cheaper than another store 2 units away. You like cheap and good? Then you must go to Wonderland then. Open only for dinner. Come early or be prepared to wait....Show less

Author: Shammy11hundredKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly owner and good food
Review: The food is reasonably price and very good. The owner recommended to try dry chilly mantis (a type of shrimp), steamed fish, kailan and kam cheong chicken. the dry chilly mantis and steamed fish is the star of the show and tasted very good. The kailan is also good with a hint of some oyster sauce. The Kam Cheong chicken is a bit disappointing, the chicken tasted liked some left overs fried chicken cut into pieces. The owner is very friendly and keep checking on our food ( it was a fullhouse at that time and we waited over half and hour to get our food) and even taking time to thank us when we leaving. Total bill for 2 persons is RM85.00 for beverages and food which i think is very reasonable.Show less

Author: 98pamdTampere, Finland
Title: Fresh Seafood
Review: Recommended by a local and it was excellent. We had the flower crabs, grilled tiger prawns, fried kangkong (morning glory), fried rice and topped off with Tiger beer. The tiger prawns were huge and very tasty. Recommend going fairly early in the evening as the tables fill up quickly. We are going back tonight!Show less

Author: juliaalenaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonable and good food
Review: We ordered fried sotong which was yummy (which the waitress forgot to record but it's ok, thank goodness we didn't have to wait too long for it). The vegetables were great, we had stir-fried kailan which was yummy, and some stir-fried tofu and vegetables. The black pepper chicken is worth ordering too.Show less

Author: xiaojie00
Title: Service good
Review: Not what I expected got some disappointed. But the service is good, they will recommended few food not in the menu.

Author: bigohbenjayFrankfurt, Germany
Title: One of the "must-eats" on Langkawi!
Review: Amazing food, great value for money. Michael, you and your team are making a great job. We had some good restaurants on Langkawi but the wonderland was alway worth the travel from the other end of the island. Definitly a "must-eat" on Langkawi. Wonderland makes its name worth being - wonderland of food! 5 of 5! Sarah & Benjamin from GermanyShow less

Author: PinccasAlor Setar, Malaysia
Title: A Must Try!
Review: It is definitely a decent spot for those who love to have seafood in a very affordable price. We ordered 2 plates of rice, 4 dishes and 2 drinks for dinner which only costed us around RM60 for 2 persons. The portion of the dishes were quite big though we just ordered all small ones. The food all tasted very good and satisfying. The downside of this restaurant was the food took a long time to be served. The restaurant was busy preparing food for the customers of the reserved tables first on the day we went. It is advisable to go earlier preferably before 7pm as there will be many customers in the restaurants even during weekdays.Show less

Author: SimmonetteSarawak
Title: Great value, delicious seafood feast !
Review: Always have to visit this restaurant whenever we're in Langkawi, great seafood at really affordable pricing, good service too ! We always bring our own wines and they chill the wines for us at no extra costs too. Must order their stir fried salted egg yolk crabs...two thumbs up !Show less

Author: Ijaig
Title: Great food and service
Review: The must place to dine whenever in Langkawi. Definitely cheaper than the usual price for the same dishes served in Kuala Lumpur or Johor Bahru. Taste and quality are still the same since we first  dined here ten years ago.

Author: angiepoon
Title: Good food cheap price
Review: Was highly recommended by a local tour guide. Truth enough.  200g butter prawns costs RM16 only. The portion is big, delicious too. The price is cheap. Service is good.

Author: lizg172Perth, Australia
Title: Basic but so, so tasty
Review: This restaurant was recommended to us by a chef at the hotel and we weren't disappointed. When we got there about 6.30pm it was already busy and within 15 minutes people were lining up. The food was absolutely amazing, my husband and I shared 3 dishes and rice and it was probably the best meal we had in Langkawi. Would recommend a visit if you head this way!Show less

Author: derting123Kolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Cheap seafood and delicious dishes!
Review: Strongly recommend to dine in this restaurant.Clean environment, Reasonable price with delicious seafood.Really worth the price!The food portion is big and well-cooked. I think the medium size is big enough for 5-6 people.Especially the prawn, and kangkung~We order 6 dishes-fish, prawn, kangkung, toufu, chili calm and mixed vege(all in large size), and it only cost RM 127. It definitely cant be found in other places.There are a lot of people there and you need to take number to queue up.The service was nice.Show less

Author: seyenepoSydney, Australia
Title: Good Value Seafood in Outdoor Setting
Review: This is like a hawker centre, so don't expect an air conditioned restaurant with lovely decor & atmosphere. Outdoor, plastic seats & tables, close to road & a few fans blowing away. We had steamed fish (2), calamari & kailan. The food was great & the kailan was the best we had in Malaysia. It was laced with garlic, so if you're not a garlic fan, don't order. Very friendly & helpful service. Priced well. Would return.Show less

Author: Charles H
Title: Perhaps is cheapest in town with seafood
Review: This restaurant was introduce by my friend who has been there before. And I search the internet review with mostly good comment on it. Therefore, I try it and it's really affordable price with good food. I would said this is the cheapest dining compare with my another 3 dinner held in langkawi. I've tried another chinese restaurant with the almost similar dishes, the food is slightly better than Wonderland but the price is 30% higher than it.If you want budget dining and good food, you must try this.Show less

Author: thader88
Title: Taste good and reasonable price
Review:
Taste good and reasonable price.
The seafood is fresh and various of choices. Always full of customers. Better be there before 7pm especially weekend.

Author: MelanieTriesToReviewJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Place is not nice but FOOD is EXCELLENT
Review: More like Chinese cuisine is what they are serving here. The Seafoods they served were fresh and tasty. The staffs are so fast moving yet still finds time to talk with their guest and make sure they being serve well. Don't mind the ambiance and just enjoy your food. Show less

Author: sallys982Singapore, Singapore
Title: Vey good food at very affordable price
Review: We visited the wonderland based on trip advisors review and we are not disappointed. The seafood is really fresh and great value for money. Too bad they didn't have the mud crab and stingray. But we throughly enjoyed every bite of the seafood we ordered. Definitely will recommend it to friends.Show less

Author: VaniessaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Affordable and decent seafood
Review: We've heard of good reviews of this place and i would say their food are decent,and of course very affordable for the amount of food we ordered. We ordered like about 10 dishes for 10 people and the bill came up to about RM 230 only! Some of the dishes such as the oyster sauce vege came out slightly salty however the mantis in "kam heong" style is a must try! We tried calling for reservation however it seems that they never pick up the phone hence if you go during dinner hour you might need to wait slightly longer.Show less

Author: bigjewelMalaysia
Title: OK food but not OK crowd
Review: Food was good and reasonable. Coming in to eat for dinner and crowded will have to make you wait one hour before you can see food placed on your table. So, be prepared to wait if you want to eat here. It's not that they are the best but others can offer almost the same too. If you can't wait, go to those next door. Anyway, their senior chef of 20 years of service has left and opened his own restaurants 3 months ago. Price list is almost the same, quality of food too. Out of respect, if you really want to know the names of other restaurants, please PM me.Show less

Author: ctb1968Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent food at affordable prices
Review: This restaurant gets filled up very early. We were there at 6.30 pm and there were already 3 tables, by 7 it was full. The food preparation is not bad but limited, a lot of the recommended stuff are deep fried and not much else. However they do recommend the steam sea bass which was excellent and the butter lobster which was also very good. Admittedly the battered fried squid was a little hard as well as the mantis prawns. Is it a deal breaker, not really. The seafood fried rice was also good. Would I go back, yes but I would also give the restaurants along the road a try as well. As a Malaysian, pricing was very reasonable.Show less

Author: MarcusOoi
Title: Worth it
Review: U wont believe it until you step into it and try the food. They are delivious and big portion. Price is very reasonable compare to other restaurant. You dont need to wait very long even they are packed with customers. Double thumb up

Author: Sailormoon12Seremban, Malaysia
Title: Local Chinese cuisine Yummy!
Review: Went there for the first time for dinner. We arrived at around 6pm and at that time, the crowd was not many. Sad to say that their famous Chili Crab was not available when we were there. They recommended soft shell crabs and it was delicious. We also ordered Kangkung vegetable. Surprisingly the dish was not oily and it was yummy too. Overall, RM54 for 2 persons for 3 dishes plus beverage. It was affordable!Show less

Author: tyv_yvonneKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious and affordable rate
Review: We stayed in Langkawi for 3 days 2 nights and we settled our 2 days dinner over here so you can imagine, how delicious their food is. The first day we ordered their Sweet and sour chicken, Tom Yam steamed fish(Hong Zhou), fried squids, Kai Lan and steamed eggs with 2 tiger prawn and total costed RM101 ONLY! The second day we ordered one big plate kangkung, steamed fish with ginger sliced(Hong Zhou), one Nyonya style chicken, Kong Bou Har Gu(a type of Prawn) and Lala soup. Total cost for our second day meal RM84 only :D The meal for first day taste better and I found that they are good in cooking with those heavy taste but not the easy type like steam with ginger or plain type food. Strongly recommended you to visit if you wanna save your wallet but enjoy good food :) Show less

Author: Especkerman
Title: Reasonable and tasty
Review:
The steam fish with garlic and lime was excellent
Should not try the chili scrampi or sweet sour chicken, gotten tastier ones but maybe the cook was on his off day!!!!

Author: MikeS5048Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great food and value for money.
Review: Basic decor with no fancy frills but exceptional tasting local seafood. Michael, our waiter, looked after us with suggestions to suit our tastes. We had king prawn, crispy squid, spicy chicken, soft shell crab and rice which, along with 6 beers came to RM120. Definitely worth a try.Show less

Author: RaveenRoshanSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Reasonably Priced and Tasty Food
Review: We went here for 2 nights, first night we waited for about 30 minutes for food, and 2nd night we went earlier and was served faster. Overall the price was very reasonable and the food was tasty and fresh. Highly recommended. The management folks are very friendly and cool people. No regrets. My family enjoyed eating the food here.Show less

Author: mnasiruddin
Title: Delicious and cheap.
Review:
A simple place with good food and friendly operator.  
Food served to you speedily after ordering.
Try the steamed fish and buttered prawns, very delicious.
To avoid the crowd go there before 7 pm.

Author: kenc288Perth, Australia
Title: Excellent End of Trip
Review: This place was recommended by the staff at our hotel (Four Seasons). They claimed this is where the locals go and eat seafood. At first when we arrived I was abit disappointed with no live tanks to choose the seafood but Michael (owner) reassured us everything was caught and delivered that day. The quality / taste of the food was amazing and I was very happy with the freshness especially when this is very important when eating seafood. When the bill came I was double surprised at how much it costed especially after paying for lunch and dinners at our hotel. Of course the experience is totally different but this is a very good down to earth place so if you are in town it is a must try.Show less

Author: FatBankerStockholm, Sweden
Title: The best seafood
Review: The food in this place was incredible, and it's clearly a local favourite with every table packed. The chili crab was fresh and delicious, and a few of the more unusual options on the menu were equally tasty. No wine, but beers were cold, cheap and plentiful. We did find the service was a bit slow but without an empty seat in the house this was understandable. The seating is all outdoors which was fine for us on a relatively cool evening, but could be a problem on a hot/rainy day, although it is under cover and packed with fans. The only toilets are also the public toilets which, judging by the string of directions we were given, are quite a distance away.Would recommend for great authentic local cuisine, will go back if in the area.Show less

Author: schnoopzmqKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap Seafood
Review: We got greedy and ordered steamed garoupa, fried squid, kam heong style mantis prawn, fried rice, vegetables and several fruit juices. The seafood were fresh although I find the taste to be slightly bland but it's acceptable. The bill came slightly under RM90 only! Definitely cheapest place for seafood I've tried so far.Show less

Author: Kayleigh V
Title: Amazing!
Review: Michael is a fantastic host. Loved this place so much we went 3 times in a week! Had 4 tigers ready for us as soon as we got there, even got rid of the prawn legs and heads! Brilliant. Perfect restaurant :) thank you!

Author: jeff1955malaysiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Chinese Seafood Resto
Review: It is located about 150 meters off Kuah Town. If you are in kuah town you can take a walk to this place. They serve very good seafood at very reasonable prices and very tasty. They have an extensive menu and the waiter is there to recommend to you the different styles of cooking. At night it packed with people but the service is good and staff are attentive. You will be satisfied with the prices at this joint.Show less

Author: live2travel89Chennai (Madras), India
Title: The best in Langkawi !
Review: Read about this place in Trip Advisor and after a long ride from Tanjungh Rhu to Kuah we found this place right about 2 kms from the eagle square. It looks pretty unassuming but once the dishes are ordered and you dig in, its probably the best sea food you ever had in Malaysia. We started off with few fresh juices which was pretty mediocre , but the food more than made up for it. Prawns , squids , Sting rays any dish you order is perfectly cooked and sufficient enough for 4 adults to dig in. We found the quantity and the price unmatched by any other in entire LGK. This place is run by 2 brother , localities - 3rd gen immigrants from China.So this is probably the most authentic Malay food there is in LGK. Totally must visit. Cheers !Show less

Author: heenja
Title: Great food at amazing prices
Review:
The food was awesome especially at the low price that they charge.

Service was amazing also considering the price. I would return every time i am in Langkawi

Author: HweekengSingapore
Title: Good service and value, food is not bad
Review: The people there are nice, ready to service and assist with order. Ordered squid, fish, vegetable, Kangkong (water spinach), plum juice and white rice. Except for the fish which I don't find not much taste, I enjoyed the rest of the dishes. The price is very reasonable too.Show less

Author: Tim CHong Kong
Title: Location and Service
Review: I cannot fault the above. Our order comprised red snapper, black pepper chicken, fried squid, hor fan and Chiuchow-style oh lwa. For me personally, the food was quite acceptable though some of our party were not too impressed. Note to the mayor of Kuah : Please provide a pedestrian crossing outside WFS, or at least nearby, so that diners can easily cross the road to use the public toilet and/or purchase beverages to accompany their meals. At the moment, we have to wait for a gap in the busy traffic.Show less

Author: pilgrim_gsaNew Delhi, India
Title: Good Food Affordable Prices
Review: The food is well cooked and there are many offerings to choose from .The service is quick .Location not far from the Bayview Hotel , it is a in a simple roadside joint ...but that makes it more local taste and cheaper .Certainly it is a delight to be there and many tourists flock having heard about this place .Show less

Author: Rob_de_VriesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Good Chinese food, nice price but go minimun 4 people
Review: This is a very local looking but good Chinese food court. The staff is very helpful and friendly but English is not their strong point. So speak slowly and short sentences helps.Like most Chinese restaurants they sell portions in sizes and a small portion is enough for two because the small portion rice or noodles is big for two persons. Hence I recommend that your party is 4 or larger, than you can share small portions together and taste different delicious dishes.They also serve beer and if you come a bit more often do not mind if you bring your own wine, they will get you a glass for free (not a proper wine glass).The place can be very busy, if it is expect a waiting time or look around for some other food court, plenty around, but their food is a bit of a wait worth!Show less

Author: drugslitsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious and affordable seafood
Review: My family and I had dinner here and we absolutely loved the food! For about 125RM (35USD), we had 2 crabs, deep-fried squid, sambal kang kong, sambal prawns, oyster omelette, half-and-half red snapper (steamed and grilled), fried noodles, rice and drinks for everyone. The staff was friendly and the service was fast and efficient.I would definitely recommend this place if you're in Kuah and looking for an affordable yummy seafood dinner. You should come here early if you want to avoid the crowd!Show less

Author: ReneKnudsen
Title: Fresh seafood
Review: Was here with a couple of friends and had a variety of seafood. Food was nicely prepared and portions were generous. Good place for a indigenous dinner to capture the essence of Malaysian dining experience

Author: profmelfiky
Title: Dinner
Review: We had dinner there with a friends. We had nice food but not comparable to other places in Langkawi. The service was slow. The weather was not the best that night, it was about to rain so the waiter moved us inwards. The food was not as tasty and gave me personally discomfort the next day. The place had many foreigners which should imply a good cuisine but it was average as I said to other restaurants we tried.The prices were average for seafood in Langkawi. I personally did not enjoy the experience that day.Show less

Author: shirleycL6342OI
Title: Fantastic as always
Review: A great little restaurant serving great tasty food especially the seafood at a bargain price and run by a charming Chineese/ Malay man. A place not to miss & very popular with locals & tourists.

Author: 37hanaa
Title: Low prices, high quality. Must try!
Review: We arrived to Kuah quiet late and we went here just becouse it was in our way, but food was sooo delicius that we came back every night. Speed service, friendly staff, fresh fish. Try butter prawns and a grilled Seabass.

Author: Sean L
Title: Low-Priced & Highly Satisfied Local Seafood
Review:
1. Considerable cheap for both locals and foreigners
2. Fresh seafood with decent recipes
3. Friendly staffs and speedy services
4. One of the best restaurant in Kuah town

Author: jessil_dxb
Title: Hidden Treasure
Review: best sea food which we had in langkawi, very friendly staff and reasonable price, if you need to enjoy the local sea food this is the place. :)

Author: vagwinEngadine, Australia
Title: Amazing seafood and aervice
Review: We told the waiter what we did and did not like, he gave us some great choices and we barely had to look at the menu. my husband loves chilli whilst I don't, so we got different sauces on the side. We were introduced to new produce and herbs and ingredients that go in to marinades/sauce to help us choose.I would love to eat there every night! Show less

Author: BootleggerweldingBembridge, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Well this was our fourth time back in Langkawi over a period of 6 years. We were introduced to the delights of Wonderlands food on our first trip and it has always been consistently tasty and of a good standard. It is superb value for money. Tony who runs the establishment is a very good front of house, he is very friendly and helpful in advising with food choices . Great staff superb food deafinatley a must if your in Kuah .Show less

Author: Digitalz
Title: Good & Cheap food
Review: Well this is a place for good and cheap food at langkawi. Ordered 3 dishes, including a siakap (fish) and the price was cheap considering that we had one fish.Located in kuah, we drove all the way down from cenang and we could say that the staffs there were friendly too!Show less

Author: cf l
Title: Slow and Cheap
Review: Service are slow, seafood is cheap but not up to standard. Dishes are mostly salty but seafood are fresh.

Author: b_lo_zer0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly Service
Review: Dropped by Wonderland Food Store based on a friend's recommendation. It is located along an entire street of seafood stalls. Service was friendly (no problems with English), and dishes were served promptly. Didn't order lobsters or king prawns, so perhaps missed out on their specialty?Had soft shell crab, sambal sotong, and found it decent, but nothing too spectacular. Definitely nothing to complain for the price paid however.Show less

Author: 1df9
Title: Nom Nom
Review: Superb food, Super friendly host, and quite cheap prices. Nothing more to say. Ask the waiter to recommend. He will suggest the freshest ingredients they have. Definitely is a must-go.

Author: Mandy C
Title: Reasonable price
Review: Friendly staff and reasonable price. we ordered butter prawn for rm 12, salted egg squid for rm 10 and omelette egg for rm 4 with  2 rice.. total rm33.50 for 2 person. Worthy price and will visit again!!

Author: RandGPBeverley
Title: Authentic Malaysian food at good prices
Review: Very good helpful service and good tasting food at very fair prices. A definite place for locals and busy but they were attentive and very helpful in what was freshiest of the fish. Also helped in limiting spices so we could enjoy more. We had a main of Snapper two ways, one with BBQ sauce which still had a kick according to my wife. The other half was in ginger and soy sauce and much tastier.Show less

Author: Jonas t
Title: Delicious!
Review: We ended here by a coincidence and this ugly and spartanious restaurant served the best food on our 3.5 week trip in malaysia/thailand. Seabass was amazing. Fried chicken was yummy. Fried rice was very nice too. A welcommed plus in Langkawi where we everywhere else have been quite disapointed with the Malayan food.. Try it!Show less

Author: GmittensLimassol City, Cyprus
Title: Speedy service & great food
Review: On returning to Langkawi one of our first meals was enjoyed (again) at Wonderland. Don't worry if it looks full as the staff will quickly bring out another table if necessary. The restaurant is generally busy with locals, always a good sign on my opinion. The menu is mostly Asian, but omelettes are also available, and you can expect to pay about 50 - 55 Ringets for two meals with beer. Well recommended! Show less

Author: ZachR1982Stavanger, Norway
Title: Good food and value for money
Review: We went twice to this place for dinner. For 4 people having whole fish, prawn, chicken and vege with rice, we paid aroumd rm 80. Really cheAp indeed. The services were good and fast. Seafood was fresh and tasty. Not a posh restaurant but worth to try hawker food place. Lots of tourist as well. Show less

Author: Dubo1
Title: Excellent food, excellent value
Review: We have been there several times during our stay. Excellent food, if you are not sure what to eat just ask the boss, he will explain. Friendly staff. Highly recommended....

Author: dawnymayersFleetwood, United Kingdom
Title: still excellent
Review: having been several times over the last few years we always worry incase the food isnt as good as before ... no need to worry EXCELLENT, quick service excellent value for money and still delicious if you are in Kuah give it a try you wont be disappointedShow less

Author: rockandrollD
Title: Good value, good food!
Review: We went to the Wonderland Food store twice during our stay on Langkawi. Lively atmosphere and full of local people which is always a good sign. The Chinese food was excellent and the service quick and efficient.

Author: markymark_travel
Title: Mediocre at best
Review: Maybe it was just our luck. fried sotong (squid) was soggy, and the fried egg cockles (orh chien) tasted bad, real bad.

Author: abdul rahman t
Title: Great chinese seafood, reasonable prices
Review:
Another eating joint that we wont miss everytime we are in Langkawi.
Very reasonable prices for fresh seafood.
Beats the upmarket hotel outlets...

Author: SakeSakeNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great vibe for outside night time dining
Review: This is what Asia is all about. Warm tropical evening, a busy dining area, no frills plastic seating, chattering in the background and the clanging of woks and knives and the sizzling sound of frying and the slurping of food.Great atmosphere. Helpful, enthusiastic, patient waiter, we had not heard of half the menu. We ate snapper 2 ways (fried in local petal leaf which was stunning and steamed with soy sauce and tofu-ok). 1 large grilled prawn by UK standards it was more like a small lobster. Squid with dry chillies (didn't rate this). Fries local greens (delicious).Good experience. Enjoyable food. Definite Recco. 4/5Hope this is a helpful review?My tip- try the fried fish with local petal leaf it was delicious.Tip 2- don't be afraid to ask questions on the menu. Staff spike good English and were extremely helpful in assisting with ordering.Show less

Author: JamesstewardBrigstock, United Kingdom
Title: Seafood Wonderland.
Review: Great place for fresh seafood at very low prices. The fact that Wonderland is nearly always full tells it's own story. The way that they can serve so many people with such good food in so little time is nothing short of miraculous and they still have time to make you feel welcome. A genuine must go to restaurant if you are in the Kuah area.Show less

Author: Irean Y
Title: Superb!
Review: Must try in langkawi. Very nice and sweet staff. Crab from Sabah, RM100 per kg but worth to try. Suitable for old folks. All seafod are fresh and taste super duper good.

Author: sonnyng58Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a must eat place
Review: First time eating here due to the high ratings it received.ordered simple dish like grilled fish,tonyam soup,fried Lala,nyonya chicken,vegetable.Total 8 dishes.All the dishes eatable,of all the food we ordered,grilled fish is the best while the fried Lala os the worst.The food portion very small especially we have 10 people eating.The price considered very cheap ,around rm 150 only.After the dinner ,notice quite a number of guests eating craps and prawns.Maybe that is the restaurant top menu.If only one night to have dinner, I will definitely won't patronize this restaurant. For me Rootian is a must eat restaurant Show less

Author: Brookie15
Title: Absolutely amazing
Review: Absolutely incredible food place. So good we went back twice! Steamed lime and garlic fish was just incredible, as were the soft shelll crabs and all of the other food. Safe to say I'd love to go back.

Author: 246kelvinl
Title: Great chinese food at reasonable price.
Review: Awesome seafood fried rice. Steamed red snapper is very fresh but the source is salty, Fried sotong is good. In addition to the great foodfare, the service is good and prompt. Lovely chinese food. We even had a lovely sunset stroll at the nearby seaside, a 4 mon walk from Wonderland Food Store. Show less

Author: Anita B
Title: Family restaurant, fresh seafood
Review: Owned by Chinese family, each days fresh seafood, nice service, we introduced with Michael - one of family member, who serving visitors, very attractive guy! :)

Author: Seah L
Title: Yummy & affordable
Review: The seafood here is good at affordable price....excellent & friendly service  any time better than a 5 star restaurant....local & foreign diners seems to know this place....yummy....

Author: P. C
Title: Best sea food choice
Review: Topissime! Our fav dinning. Very friendly team. Its a busy place, not for an romantic date 😉 // Delicious crab black pepper sauce

Author: Lam S
Title: Value for Money
Review:
Liked: deep fried sotong, fried prawn, lemon ginger steam fish, sambal lala
Disliked: Thai style chicken, black source sotong,  oyster fried eggs

Author: maiaradh2293Wichita, Kansas
Title: Its cheap. & that's about it.
Review: Being a local from Kuala Lumpur, i know my chinese seafood dishes well. We came here for dinner as we heard about how good the restaurant was so;waiting time: 30-45mins, and thats just waiting for the food. It would take about 10-15mins to even find an empty table as its really crowded.the food:--there were no more crab available-we initially wanted to order the grouper fish but the waiter said that it was "not good" so he recommended the sea bass, steamed with lime & garlic. The fish was not as fresh as we expected it to be & the dish was a little too sweet. -tom yam prawns. this came as a soup dish with only 5 prawns. Again, prawn wasnt was fresh. And the tom yam tasted a little weird. The combination of flavors was just not right to be called a tom yam dish.-calamari. this was alright. just average although it could be more crispy but that's just the way i like my calamari.-kam heong mantis prawns. Hmm! Now THIS was a disappointment as i love mantis prawns! It was too deep fried with way too much flour that we couldn't taste the meat at all! & the sauce. I have tried kam heong dishes! Heck i even know how to make it. The flavors were just wrong. -lastly, beancurd mix vegetables dish. This was alright. Well, you cant go wrong with this right?To be honest, the waiter was friendly, and fast and basically the service was good BUT we felt that he gave more importance to the foreigners. ANYWAYS, the bill came up to RM97 only with drinks. And that is a really cheap price compared to what i'd probably have to pay in KL or even any other restaurants in Langkawi. Quantity was there. But thats just it. Again, the flavors were just wrong. But you know, i guess i cant expect much from only ONE chef working to cook for a huge crowd of customers.Show less

Author: KirRoyaleSoo
Title: Cheap and fresh seafood
Review: Very good price. We had prawns, fish, squids, chicken and fried rice.  Price Less than RM100. Saw a lot of regular customers. Service is quick but have to wait a bit longer for food because the restaurant always full.  Must try, strongly recommend.

Author: xtrailmeShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Good Seafood Restaurant
Review: Had dinner with my wife at this restaurant on 20 Dec 14...Read all review and comments in forum beforehand whether it is halal and pork free..It is situated between rows of chinese seafood restaurant at Kuah Town.Few muslim families already enjoy their dinner which make us feel comfortable to try the food. Ordered fried squid , prawn masak asam, egg, vege, lobster garlic butter and Chinese tea. Unfortunately no crab that night since we really want to try chinese chili crab. Comment is on the lobster garlic butter where the garlic and butter was overpowering the lobster taste. The price was RM120 after towkey herself gave discount.Overall the price, service and food is good. My wife n me really enjoy the dinner. Next time if i want to having dinner at chinese restaurant at Kuah Town..this is the first in my list.Show less

Author: AliM1879
Title: Foodies must visit
Review: A must do for those who crave excellent food above all else. Fresh, delightful, fantastic value, fabulous service. A place you would not mind repeating during the visit. Its really that good.

Author: Eriece
Title: Worthy place for seafood dinner
Review: We had Tomyam prawns, Chili Crab and Beancurd here. Only RM45..and Lady gives us discount too. (It is supposed to be RM48.50)

Author: Dan TLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: If you love your Chinese seafood
Review: If you are passing through Kuah town this place is definitely worth a look they do very good Chinese seafood and it's also very good value, the scenery is nothing to write home about but the food is worth the visit. You can also bring your own alcohol (there is an off-licence over the road) they do have an number of their own beers but if you want wine you'll need to take your own. One of my favourite Chinese places to eat for sure.Show less

Author: benoy_thomas
Title: "Superb restuarant for seafood at reasonable price"
Review: Our dinner for the day--Chinese Tea, Ice Tea, Chicken, Prawns, Squid, Clams and finally Crab. Best seafood i had ever in my life. Very reasonably priced and all these items cost us only around 80 MYR. Service is very good and they even advice us on suitable items we can have in case we are not able to chose on our own.Show less

Author: Nikki-maria S
Title: Brilliant...a real taste of langkawi
Review: My boyfriend and i were walking through the streets and noticed how busy it was here. We ordered 6 dishes and 4 beers which cost us £14/ 60mr. The staff were friendly and very very attentive and also helped us to choose food that we would enjoy. Every dish was a taste explosion and if we had stayed longer in langkawi we would of been there every night. Theres a great range of choice and what impressed us the most was how diners can see the chefs preparing there meal. If you want to experience street food at its best go herr for the friendly atmosphere and most of all the excellant food!!!! Show less

Author: LianChong
Title: delicious food
Review: Love to come langkawi. Having a nice food here. U all having a great job. Keep it up! Hope to visit hrere again.

Author: JustinHong
Title: Fresh and reasonable price
Review: A variety of fresh sea food available and prices are really reasonable. Service is good and fast. We, the 10 of us went there during dinner time and it was packed. They were short of workers but nevertheless served with smile and efficiently.

Author: MartinRi65189Germany
Title: One of the best seafood Restaurants i visited
Review: Been there with friends twice.Second time the staff recognized us and got us a better table and the drinks and food where served even faster. They have a huge variety of seafood and fish and we tried a lot.Various fish, clamb, squid, tiger prawns (the biggest i have ever seen), crab and an outstanding lobster. all served with freshly made sauces.Exept crab and lobster (well, you won't get them cheqap anywhere) very reasonable prices, drinks pretty cheap.The staff is very efficient and friendly. Asks for your wishes and recommand dishes with changes to your taste. If you love hot food, that the place to go.Hardly recommandedShow less

Author: MmouseKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food & average price. Nothing special
Review: Went to Wonderlands for dinner after read all the good reviews fr tripadvisor. Was dissapointed as we drove all the way from Pantai Cenang for a good 30mins drive and was expecting a good dinner. We ordered steam red snapper (Rm8 for 100g) and was recommended lime & garlic steam. It turned out it was too sweet & taste nood good & not to our liking. We also ordered Kong Poh chicken, the chicken was very hard & difficult to chew & swallow. I think it was overcook.Another dishes are assam prawns and fried vegetable. The taste for both dishes was so so and it was not hot when it was served. We paid Rm78 for the 4 dishes. All the serving was very small. Only good for 3 small eater. I do not mind to pay a bit more for better taste/quality food. In my opinion this restaurant was overated. I don't think I will come back again..Show less

Author: Springrolllim
Title: Tricked by Wonderland Food Store
Review: My friends and I decided to try out this place after reading its reviews in tripadvisor. Yes even though there were bad reviews we decided to go for it. How wrong were we and how we seethed at our own stupidity! We arrived at the restaurant and because we did not make reservations we were given a queue number. The restaurant was at the peak of its traffic and we waited 30 minutes for a table and another 30 for the food after ordering. We ordered steamed red snapper, a chili crab, sambal kangkong, sambal cabbage, fried calamari and tofu. The tofu never arrived, the fish arrived as a seabass, the chili crab had one part missing and somehow looked much smaller than the one we had selected. We debated if we should raise this to the restaurant but decided against coz firstly we were 3 girls in a foreign land, and I didn't want to spoil my holiday in case a quarrel ensued. The dishes were pretty edible so we let it pass. We continued but the best is yet to come.The bill came and one of my friends and I noticed that we were charged RM10 for each plate of veg. We remembered it was supposed to be only RM4 for small size. I asked the auntie cashier and she immediately told us we misread the menu. She even took out the menu and pointed out that I must have made a mistake. We conceded and even joked with her that we must have read wrongly and paid up. The meal cost RM120 which was really affordable to us. We were complaining back at the hotel about the fish and the crab when suddenly my friend burst out that there must be 2 types of menu! One for the tourists and one for the locals! This revelation swept us over and we actually laughed because we remembered that auntie and she was very good at it! She even told us RM4 could not get you any stalks of veg, let alone cook and sell it. So there you go- our experience. It wasn't the worst but it's the pits to know you have been swindled even though the amount was small.Show less

Author: Ivan Y
Title: Cheap like no other
Review: One word for this restaurant. Cheap !!3 person including me had groupa 700g, mantis prawns, squid, lala and tofu for only rm 100 !!No other restaurant could beat this cheapest bargain and the food is awesome !! Your loss for not trying it. Note. The best food always come from a small and hidden placeShow less

Author: DarylLauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty and So Reasonably Priced
Review: Located in Kuah town, this was our first meal at Langkawi. The food is tasty and was served relatively fast considering the place was quite packed when we arrived. The only concern was that some fried dishes we ordered was a tad oily. I dislike using the word 'cheap' but that is the best way to describe the pricing here. Great great value!Show less

Author: Rasoul K
Title: Very bad
Review: One days before we tried orkid ria , for 2nd night we decide to try some where near to our hotel ', so we went to this restaurant , 1: service is very bad and not clean really 2: good not taste specially prawn 3 : price , we really got shock even price is higher than orkid ria Show less

Author: waimingloh
Title: So tasty I'm drooling just remembering.
Review: Great, fresh seafood. Known amongst locals (my auntie and cousin both live/d and work/ed there) as the best on the island... my tastebuds agreed.

Author: ConvoiKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: It was a family trip and twelve of us were in the group. We were attracted by the good reviews of this restaurant and wanted to give it a try. And we never regret it. The food is great! The seafoods were fresh and well prepared. And the speed of service? No complaint at all. We've been here in Langkawi for two days so far and this is the best meals we've had. Show less

Author: AsterooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average food with good price tag
Review: Simple home cooked style of food with a cheaper price tag. Closed on Fridays. Opened 6pm til 11pm. The chilli version of the crab dish is more towards the thai style (sour and slight spicy). Location is just right outside Belle Casa hotel along with other street stores. All outdoors with no air conditioning but the weather was nice to dine there in the evening time. Show less

Author: mokshagurl
Title: Not as the review
Review: went for a dinner..taste wise soo soo only..not really liked their food...had butter prawn...not that tasty..price was okie..

Author: Aped308York, United Kingdom
Title: Best place for Chinese seafood in Langkawi
Review: Having experience one of the worst restaurants ever in Langkawi (Thai Town seafood), it was such a relief to find a reasonably priced restaurant with great service and dishes. It is not your typical indoor airconditioned restaurant, but don't let this put you off. It is outside and open air. It is also quite popular (all tables occupied by 7 pm) compared to the restaurant next door, which only had 2 tables occupied. The diners there obviously haven't read reviews on Tripadvisor!!!Show less

Author: arazd
Title: Amazing Chinese food
Review: Really good cheap fresh light Chinese food. You'll struggle to find better anywhere! Try the ginger squid or pick your own crab to be steamed.  The sour plum chicken is delicious too.

Author: Sandraho27Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated
Review: kind of disappointed. The foods were just so so! Portion very small. The fried oyster pancake was so oily and deep fried calamari was over-fried. However, price wise consider reasonable! If you just looking for seafoods, this the place. Or else, I'm sure there's better seafoods restaurant in langkawi.Show less

Author: JSTehPenang, Malaysia
Title: Probably the best food you can have on the island.
Review: Good food, good prices and good service. Nothing else to say about this place. My wife and I really enjoy the food here and it is very reasonably priced as well. Although the place is always packed, we get our food quite fast. Highly recommend this place to food lovers out there. Especially seafood lovers!Show less

Author: wimbara
Title: best food in this island
Review:
i'm an gardener and have a project in langkawi, mostly every two week i come to langkawi, and never miss to get a the best seabas with garlic sauce in this restaurant.
the price is very reasonable.

Author: CoolMan_12Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent Food and Service - period!
Review: We had heard a lot about this place and with great hopes reached it afetr searching it a bit. The experience on our first visit to this place, visually, was kind of usual but heavily bustling with people and the staff was seen zipping between the tables. We were acknowledged within seconds of our arrival !!! and requested to wait, though that was within a minute I guess that we were at a table while it was being prepared for us.The order taking was instantaneous garnished with suggestions from the staff, as we decided on the menu. The food arrived much earlier than expected considering the people in the restaurant and the food was awesome, to say the least.The place has nothing swanky of it, but the service, the food quality and the cost, all put together was just adorable. We returned to the place after two nights to relive the experience and lo behold, our host recognised us instantly and was his usual, cheerful self much to our delight.I wish we could eat more and would certainly, certainly ( yes, repeated) visit again. Highly recommended for all to visit.Show less

Author: Peggy TIpoh, Perak, Malaysia
Title: Delicious seafood that is value for money!
Review: We love, love, love the food here! Service is good and prompt, the seafood is fresh and delicious, the price is so reasonable! The waiters are so friendly, all that they recommended was yummy and everything was polished off ! No praises is enough for this place, and we seriously recommend this place to everyone who visits Langkawi. We will definitely come back again on our next visit to Langkawi. By the way , they are opened from 6pm till 11 pm daily, they close on Friday.Show less

Author: RaccaTKDargaville, New Zealand
Title: Exciting atmosphere with delicious food
Review: Our taxi driver took us here without any research and it was great. Busy, bustling , full of locals. Sometimes it's hard to beat the plastic chair experience and reminded us of some great places we had eaten. Our friendly waiter was given the task of helping us decide and out came the food which was enjoyed by all in our party of 9 including kids. Well done Wonderland, this was our first meal out in Kuah and it was great. Fantastic value.Show less

Author: wentheng
Title: Nice
Review: I miss the food here so much. It is really delicious. The price is reasonable. Seriously it is a must visit place.

Author: AdeleAustraliaHawthorn, Australia
Title: Great seafood, great value
Review: Can not rave about this place enough. OK, so it's plastic tables, chairs, plates, beer out the can etc etc, but the seafood is so good. My mouth is watering just recalling our meal over a month ago. We had soft shell crabs, king prawn, octopus, snapper and lots of beers and walked out of that cafe so full for under $A18 per head. Show less

Author: RajeshRajesh
Title: Good one
Review: My wife liked this place. Must visit if you like sea food and located around Kuah. Looks like they are open till late night

Author: SingaporeCasey
Title: Like a typical coffee shop in Singapore
Review: Price is reasonable compare with most restaurant. Food is okay, but does not wow me. I noticed many local malaysia patronize the store.

Author: gcstrata
Title: Lobster in Langkawi
Review: We have eaten at Wonderland twice. The first night we stuck with prawns and squid, the second visit we had lobster- beautifully prepared  (though not as tasty as the boiled crayfish in NZ) and presented this was a rare treat for us and great fun.

Author: vinnybrodeur
Title: wonderful place
Review: Very good food, great value, we had steamed snapper, Mantis prawn, Kaplan, omelette, etc for 66 rm, and service was great, nothing bad to say, to get there, if u coming from kuah going towards the mall when the road splits into a v at the light, bear left and stay straight it's on your left across from the big castle resort, enjoyShow less

Author: Karis WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Money worth and food is excellent
Review: We had crab, duck, squid, asam prawn etc the food is really excellent and cheap. We definitely will visit this restaurant. The only disadvantage is hard to find, if you are not familiar there, we drove 4 to 5 rounds finally we found it very worth going for it.Show less

Author: Aley S
Title: Cheap and delicious..!
Review: Fried squid big plate only RM20..? Butter prawn medium plate, small plate chicken creamy sour, mee hoon for 3 peaople, mixed vege and kailan, hot chinese tea total RM85 for 5 people.. Happy with the delicious and cheap price..! Recommended..

Author: J0hannaA
Title: Great value food!
Review: This was probably the cheapest food we had in Langkawi yet one of the tastiest. The buttered prawns were amazing. Make sure you try it!!!

Author: HPS28Bristol, England, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic seafood, friendly and efficient service
Review: We stayed in langkawi for 2 nights and went here both nights. We would have come back for lunch but they are only open for dinner and closed on Friday. It was almost full when we arrived the first time at 7.30pm. It soon became clear why: friendly staff were quick to take our order and happy to offer recommdations. Try the red snapper with lime garlic or nyonya sauce. The lobster looked amazing. We had fried prawns the second night which we dipped in the nyonya sauce of our second red snapper (we had lime garlic the first night) and it was spectacular. Menu consists of crab, fish, lobster, prawns, squid, chicken and which you can have steamed or fried with various sauces. Ask for advice, the staff speak good English in general. The lychee and lime juice are both good. The carbs are separate so order noodles or steamed rice (I would recommend the latter with steamed fish). It is an open kitchen so you can see the chefs working furiously to get to us order to you. Enjoy!Show less

Author: YousefZ83Hurghada, Egypt
Title: Wonderful sea food
Review: Wonderful in almost everything!Great taste, big variety, value for money and helpful staff! Only tge out door seating looks cheap but it is clean and fine.Originally, we were going to another resturant but it waa closed when we reached it, then we picked the nearest and highest ranking resturant on trip advisor application, and we will surely visit it again during our short stay in Langkawi.Show less

Author: LumbazzKuala Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Wonderland simply wonderful
Review: My partner and I had the grilled Lobster, butter Prawn, Sting Ray, Salted Egg soft shell crab, fried rice and char kueh teow. & these were awesome until I saw the neighbouring table ordered the Tiger prawns, the size of the prawns was just jaw dropping awesome (Wished we ordered those Prawns) Overall, thumbs up for both the food and service. Will definitely come back for more. Show less

Author: 3vilfr3akybabi3George Town, Malaysia
Title: Above Average Seafood Store
Review: Went there for our late dinner (9:30pm). Manage to get a table for 13 of us. Quite a variety of food but not tofu. If youre a tofu lover, sorry, you can only choose japanese tofu. We ordered 7 dishes, all in L size. Dried Chillie Prawn Mantis is recommended. Chicken is a little bit hard but chew-able. Fried sotong was good too. Got a very good price for all the 7 dishes (less than RM200)Will definitely come back again.Show less

Author: allie1904Louth, United Kingdom
Title: Good food.
Review: Wonderland Food StoreWe are here twice whilst on Langkawi. It was a few minutes walk from our hotel. It is a basic set up. Plastic tables and chairs. We tried numerous chicken dishes from the menu, all were good. The fried noodles (no gravy) were good also. On average a meal and drinks for two cost 28 RM. The restaurant specialises more in sea food so only around 8 meat dishes. We particularly enjoyed the black pepper chicken.Waiting staff very friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: JounallerMalaysia
Title: Worth the Visit.
Review: After mistaking another store for this, which is really at the extreme corner of the entire food centre. the order was placed and in a short while the main dish and noodles were packed and ready to dig in. No fussYummy, comfort food and friendly staff too.Show less

Author: Ine D
Title: Amazing seafood restaurant.
Review:
Here you can eat the freshest seafood for an excellent price. Waiters are very kind and help tourists to choose from the extensive menu.
The Mudcrab in Chili sauce was amazing!
I would definitly come here again!

Author: deepsatSydney, Australia
Title: Lot of hype but OK
Review: After reading all the reviews on TripAdvisor, I was hoping for some great seafood but it was not worth the hype. The seafood was enjoyable but some of it seemed to be frozen than fresh. In fact, the prawns were not even cleaned properly. The lobster looks great but lacked the flavor; Just an average food experience at Langkawi.Show less

Author: Kugendran96
Title: Yummy
Review: Had a great dinner there the food was like wow.. My tummy was so full when I came out of the shop and also I was happy to eat a good food like it.. Go ahead and try it out..

Author: Sabrina JGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: thumbs up
Review: The people here were polite, friendly and good customer service. Although the wait for food was awhile but they never fail to update us on the status of our food arrival. The food was good and price wise reasonable. I must say its a thumbs up from me. Show less

Author: c1scottcsan francisco
Title: Womderfully Delicious fish and vegetables
Review: The hour-long wait proved worth every minute. Wonderland's chef provides a wondrous display of skills as he prepares dishes in the open kitchen. The lime-garlic sea bass remains among one of the best dishes I've eaten. Ever. The morning glory made here rivals the best rendition of this dish anywhere in Thailand where it is a famous recipe. We wish we had had the appetite for the fresh crab.FRESH, fresh crab! We saw our waiter take an order from a nearby table, then go to a cooler to extract two live crabs and carry them to the kitchen to be turned into chili-crab and sautéed crab with greens. Show less

Author: Katrina B
Title: Great value of local seafood
Review: This was highly recommended by the locals and did not disappoint. Definitely a must try in Langkawi - best plastic chair and table restaurant on the island. Great seafood at excellent prices.

Author: Samer AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the Best Traditional Food Restaurants in LGK
Review: I had been to this restaurant around 4 times during my stay in Langkawi. The food is great and customized. This is not to mention that the prices are very affordable even for the best meals. For example, a big meal with couple of beers would cost no more than 70MR . An average meal would be about 40MR. The staff were very friendly and they could serve a meal on average of 15min.Show less

Author: Esa V
Title: Great seafood in local style
Review:
Very tasty, great value, authentic local atmosphere.
Nyonya sauce was a new for us, try with any of the fried fish!

Author: Jahunga
Title: Really enjoyable
Review: Wonderland offers wonderful food dished up in an authentic environment.  If you are looking for a great food experience, this is it, just don't expect a fine dining experience, but do expect plastic chairs and tables with queues of people waiting to be served!

Author: Philip G
Title: Great Food, friendly atmosphere
Review: This is a friendly place with great food and very affordable prices. The staff are very accomodating. A must for visitors to Langkawi.

Author: amlabundaSydney, Australia
Title: Great local restaurant!
Review: After several recommendations from the locals, we went to Wonderland on our first night in Langkawi. Don't expect fancy surrounds as it's a typical local restaurant - al fresco style. However the food and efficient service is great! Everything was fresh and tasty although I'd highly recommend the black pepper sauce. The service was quick and friendly, they even organised a taxi for us after the meal.Show less

Author: ZainLalaniWaterloo, Canada
Title: Fresh, Tasty Seafood, Great Prices, Organized and Quick Service!
Review: Must Go! We had heard lots about Wonderland Seafood on Langkawi Island, Malaysia. We went there the first evening we arrived. We had Chilli Crab, BBQ'd Prawns, Kai Lan Greens and Steamed Rice. Everything was prepared fresh, served hot.Washed it all down with a couple of ice cold Tiger Beers! Nice outdoor, patio location, very friendly staff, great prices.Show less

Author: Chizzamerica
Title: Great food
Review: Enjoyed the food and atmosphere at Wonderland. Does get busy late on but we timed our visit well for about 7.30pm. The steamed red snapper was perfect!

Author: WorldGluttonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not up to our expectation !!
Review: I was told this is the best seafood restaurant in Kuah Town, thus we went to try it out for dinner . It was not up to our expectation. The Teochew steamed Red Snapper Jenahak is missing the sour plums, clams soup is flat, kangkong belacan is sweet with no belacan taste at all. Chillie crabs is totally just chillie sauce , butter prawns were soggy , we would give the food score a 4 out of 10. Moreover the pricing is outrageous , we believe that they have overcharge us for the crabs.The restaurant is very busy probably due to the great publicity but service from waiting staff was insufficient. We basically have to wave our hands to get their attention to get additional drink orders.,Show less
