Author: rekalALSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must try it!!
Review: The food and the price nothing beats it. The only thing they can improve is since they are very famous now they must at least move to a bigger and nicer place to accommodate more people and to make the dinning experience more pleasurable and neat. Show less

Author: OnbarefeetEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: "Wonder food" at Kuah
Review: Our overall rating: 3.5 (above Average)Popular to tourists and expats and even some locals, this restaurant is an absolute gem. If looking to try and experience good local seafood in a local setting (hawker style), plastic tables and chairs, then this is a must-try. Walk-in okay but can be busy from 8pm onwards (dined during Christmas season). Service good but waiting can be between 20-30 mins. when very busy. Must order food, lobster! Kang Kong (swamp cabbage), crispy crab, and fried frice equally good. Beer available. Very good selection of seafood including crabs. Food fantastic providing good value for money. Staff can call a cab for guests back to their hotel.Warning! Credit cards not accepted. If dining in big group, be sure to bring enough cash. A nearby (2-3 min walk) ATM, available. Public toilet also available.Show less

Author: ReyionKuching, Malaysia
Title: Best seafood restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Just went on 22nd Dec 2013. The place was a bit difficult to find though we had looked up at Google Maps. Turn after the sign saying "Perdagangan Kelana Mas" or find Bella Vista hotel which is opposite the store. You won't miss the big yellow signboard "Wonderland". Please be aware of the waiters at the restaurant next door "persuading" you to their tables and saying that sitting at their area is the same. They are not from the same store. Trust only the servers with the uniform saying "Wonderland". Chilli crab is their famous dish. And oh boy, those giant crab claws are just huge! The rest of the meal is subpar compared to the dishes served in the Malaysian mainland but they definitely have the best and cheapest seafood in Langkawi which the locals enjoy too. Cheaper beer than the rest of the seafood restaurants too. I usually trust where the crowds go for good food cause the restaurant is always packed with people! Tips of the seating: don't sit near the canal as sometimes the foul stench from there, can change your appetite.Show less

Author: jeffaynShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Worth to recommend !
Review: This food establishment is definitely worth for me to recommend to everyone, why ? Because the person who take my order is very considerate and truthful about their seafood, He told me what is live, what is frozen, what is good, what is nice to eat, what is worth to eat....I planned on to order the lobster but he told me the tiger prawn is worth better for value... rare behavior for restaurant employee, but deserve my highest praise.In general the food is good, definitely tasty and the pricing..well.. is definitely reasonable and affordable, great thanks for keep honesty way doing business in such a high touristy place like langkawi.Five dishes only 120+, 1 vege, 1 soft shell crab, 1 asam prawn, 1 fried sotong(calamari) and 1 larger than stretch palm size tiger prawn, that what i call a reasonable and affordable dinner.Highly recommended, even you don like seafood, you can consume your normal dinner here with no fear of "suprise bill" , beside, all item clearly priced in the menu, no hidden cost :DJust little extra info, this is a food stall like restaurant, is not even a shop, is a premium stall, so is definitely more like family dinner venue, not a couple romantic dine in venue.Show less

Author: gidnani00
Title: Excellent
Review: Its an excellent restaurant good food at a value lots off people visiting the place during the nights

Author: lilevelingkl
Title: Price was ok, food nt ok.
Review: Ordered 5 dishes teochew steam siakap fish (gav wrongly, we actually order red snapper), fried oyster w/h egg (1big, 1 small portion), butter prawns & stir fried green veg. All dishes taste below average compare to normal Chinese style cooking. The price is reasonable. Total RM105.Show less

Author: YasiraBGold Coast, Australia
Title: Yum, yum on a budget!
Review: Delicious food, at a very reasonable price. We went there twice it was so good. Very basic setup but the food is so fresh and delicious you won't notice! Try the chilli prawns, sambal red snapper and fried rice. Beers are delightfully cheap too at RM2.50 a can. The service is fast and pleasant. A definite must if one is in langkawi. Both nights our bill came to less than RM60 for 2 main dishes, 2 sides and 4 beers. Portion sizes are good tooShow less

Author: Hanim71
Title: Value for money seafood experience
Review: This seafood stall ( not an actual restaurant) was located in Kuah.Judging by the crowd, one would definately conclude that this is a popular eating spot for locals and tourists alike.Its best to book a table especially if one has a large group unless you are willing to wait for a table.The service is ok except that the servers may get confused with orders for 2 tables.Despite reminding them repeatedly of our orders, 2 dishes did not arrive at our table. We finally gave up reminding and ate what were sent to our table.The food is worth the money paid.In the end, Its a typical food stall experience!Show less

Author: Rena BRiga, Latvia
Title: Try shrimps
Review: We went based on reviews. Service was great. We tried sweet and sours shrips with fried rice and soft shelf black pepper crab. Shrips were great, while i was not so happy with crab as it indeed was too much pepper, but maybe that is only my opinion :-) Otherwise nice,crowded place and good feeling to be in middle of that.Show less

Author: Artms181
Title: Delicious
Review: Great food, fresh and tasty and service was quick, friendly the setting is like most on Langkawi, definitly will come back again!

Author: shueshueScheveningen, The Netherlands
Title: Fresh and tasty
Review: The setting is nothing special but the food is fantastic and service is fast and comes with a smile.We went here twice for dinner in the week we were staying in Kuah and both times the food was fabulous. Very fresh crab, squid, veggies, fruit juices etc. You can choose from many different sauces. Chinese style, Malay, Spicy, non-Spicy etc.Show less

Author: Christine HPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Real Malaysian food
Review: We went to this restaurant that we had read the reviews on.It was typical of what we expected from our first trip to Malaysia.The food was very good indeed.It was a very busy place and the food was very fresh & hot.Not the best looking place but don,t be put off by that as you have to give it a go.Show less

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Affordable, tasty, fresh ...
Review: A large group of friends & family members, 16 of us landed at wonderland. This is our 2nd visit and they have not changed much. We were late from our initial booking time, but the chief arranged our table within 5 minutes of waiting. Our order of fish, prawns, lala, tomyam, fried rice, mantis prawn, vegetables are delivered within 20 minutes of waiting. Their taste have not changed, quality ingredients are used and service is prompt. That's why wonderland is always packed with people.Show less

Author: GeochongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Food looks goodtbut not so tasty
Review: we ordered lobster - full marks for presentation but lacking in taste. same for other food we ordered. Service was great though as the chef personally allowed us to change a vegetable dish without extra charges as we thought it was Hong Kong kailan but it was some other kailan.Show less

Author: Samantha8989kkw
Title: Cheap seafood found in town
Review: The foods are not really super good. But it's nonetheless delicious and cheap! Give a try. Friendly staffs

Author: PhilSpruceHong Kong, China
Title: City surprise
Review: You pull up outside on the main road and it looks a bit grottty because the kitchen fronts the street. But you go round the back and there is a nice terrace alongside the river. Excellent prawns, crab, clams, 2 styles of the same fish and squid. From someone who is spoilt by Hong Kong seafood, this is up there with say, the North Point Dai Pai Dong or Happy Valley. I regret not having the lobster which I saw as I paid the bill. The guy who looked after us was Soon who was friendly, quick and very helpful. Also, not unimportantly in a place full of Moslem restaurants, Wonderland serves lovely cold beer.Show less

Author: YvonneTravelsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cheap seafood!
Review: They do serve really cheap seafood, as compared to the ones found in Cenang. I liked that they can cook 1 fish, in 2 different ways; you could choose one side to be steamed and the other to be BBQ, etc. They had rather fresh and tasty seafood food too but I still prefer the one in Cenang. But, it's definitely one of the place you can go try, if you are looking for Seafood meal in Kuah.Show less

Author: Padilharun79
Title: One of the jewels in Langkawi seafood arena..
Review: It is simply one of the nicest surprises that we found in Langkawi. We did not expect its a great restaurant, we stopped by at the restaurant because we saw a good number of crowds there. However, it turned out to be one of the nicest seafood restaurant that we have ever been: Good service, fast, great taste, simple but suits your taste buds, good ambience, good price.. What more you can ask from a restaurant?? Highly recommended!!Show less

Author: Dave C
Title: Great food
Review: Fantastic seafood at such a cheap price, great people. Seafood was so fresh, very clean restaurant, the main service guy was so friendly and accommodating we went back the 2 nights later, he remember us even down to what we drink last time!!!

Author: CheddarCharlieSomerset
Title: Busy, nice fresh food, cheap
Review: Bargain food and drink, cooked fresh and very tasty. So cheap too £20 for family of 4 with beers and soft drinks, seafood. Location and restaurant is basic but we liked that as it is so different. Full of locals which is always a good sign.Show less

Author: chaipeng
Title: Resonable food in town
Review: This is one of the non-halal restaurant in town.the food serves in very fast speed.however there is not hot enough..some of the dishes ady cool when serving..however the price of the food is resonable as not too expensive for the ordering food..the services of the waitress not bad.Show less

Author: dipsDee
Title: good food great value
Review: Exceptionally fresh seafood & great value for money.Dont come here expecting ambience & decor.Its a no nonsense plastic chaired joint but more than makes up with the fresh food & price.

Author: Apgeroy
Title: Nice Outdoor feel
Review:
Outdoor ambiance and view of the streets of Langkawi make this an authentic experience.  Crowd from the adjacent restaurants adds color to the nightlife here.

Likes:  fresh seafood 
           nice tom-yum
           outdoor ambiance

Author: GrayNomadsBrisbane
Title: GREAT Food!
Review: Good value, Great food and Michael really looks after his customers...and there are a lot of them...guess that's because it's a great place to eat!!

Author: VisitorfromWales123
Title: Incredible
Review: Fabulous food and friendly service. Incredible value for money. If you love seafood come here and you will not be disappointed.

Author: GanYY2009Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for dinner
Review: we came here after a mediocre experience in Orkid Ria in Pantai Cenang, and we didn't regret it one bit. Ordered a total of 7 dishes for 5 adults for only RM 140. Most are seafood too, although the portions are all small. Now that's value formoney. Service is speedy if you come early, but risk sitting for a long time if you come later than 6.30 pm. The owner is pleasant and friendly, and the food is delicious. Show less

Author: john1604
Title: the love has gone
Review: i always make wonderland a first stop for dinner.i find each year the charm  and quality falling.in my opinion there is one excellent waiter who keeps the place going but it needs to be a team effort.maybe it will pick up again.

Author: Cammal_BrownBoyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Affordable seafood. Seems overrated.
Review: After reading numerous reviews in TA, I told myself that I should try this place! I was here with family on a weekday. It took us a while to locate this restaurant as we thought it would look like any other seafood restaurant. This is a small restaurant where the kitchen is facing the main road. Now I understand why tell are called Wonderland food store. So the seating area is a little bit hidden. Finally we spotted the restaurant sign and parked at the opposite side of the road. We came here early to avoid busy dinner time. There was only a handful tables occupied. We did ask for the chef’s recommendation and was told everything is good. Means they don’t have any speciality dish? It sounded weird then and it still does now. Anyway we ordered oyster omelette, red snapper steamed Thai style (garlic and birds eye chili), Stir fried Baby kailan, Nestum Prawns, Thai Sauce chicken and rice. The wanted to order the fresh lobster however didn’t do so as it seems expensive (can’t really remember how much it was). The food was prepared fast. The only delicious dish here is the steamed fish. As for the rest, it seems like a normal dish just like any other restaurant. Just like any other restaurants in Malaysia, you can inform the cook/chef that you want your food to be spicy, etc. It cost us RM87 for the above mentioned food. It seems affordable but I will rate it as average. I think some of the 4/5 star rating would have derived on the price factor alone, at least to my opinion.Show less

Author: Sophie BAdelaide, Australia
Title: Great quality, service and price
Review: Had a meal here with three friends and shared a few of the different dishes on the menu. The seafood is delicious, all fresh and made to order. Your can have a whole fish or they will fillet it for you. They are also happy to tailor any meal to suit your wishes (level of spicey-ness, substitute with different meats/veggies etc). The owner is very friendly and clearly a hard worker, constantly running around from table to table serving and checking on patrons. A large meal for four people ended up costing only $35 (australian). Basic setting and atmosphere, but the food is worth the visit. Clearly a favourite with the locals, was busier than any other restaurant on the strip.Show less

Author: Lets_travel_well
Title: Fantastic seafood, great service
Review: Had dinner there twice. Excellent seafood, fast service, very clean. Not expensive. Pleasant staff. Can highly recommend as the best Chinese Seafood Restaurant.

Author: Vicente5715Phuket, Thailand
Title: Seafood delight!
Review: Fresh seafood from Langkawi served in this Chinese Restaurant. Nice View as the restaurant is located at a waterfront. One regret is that the restaurant is halal so it doesn't serve pork. But in overall a great place to eat-out and we enjoyed our meal nonetheless.Show less

Author: Susan LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good if you know what to order..
Review: I read many reviews on Wonderland and it was mixed reviews. I was not too sure if I should try the food here, but fate has it, the place we wanted to try was not open and we ended up at Wonderland.The chef came to take our order and it was good that he did not pushed us to order the expensive seafood in the menu. He was patient for us to choose the seafood, and once we've decided, he would recommend the best way to cook it.The average:The fried rice, oyster omelette, veggies and salted egg squid were fine, but nothing to shout about. {these were our choice, we didnt ask for recommendations)The fantabulous:We order a red snapper, chef recommended it steamed with lime juice, bird's eye chilli and garlic. Super, super appetising and just cant stop eating this.We also had the tiger prawns (RM180/kg). It does feel expensive, but its worth it. For one, I cant find tiger prawns this size (about a foot long) and as the chef guarantees it's freshness. Since it's fresh, it more common (for Malaysian chinese) to ask for it steamed, but the chef recommended it grilled instead. He reasoned that grilling brings out the sweetness and the flesh will be springier. No regrets, it was lip smacking.Thinking back, I should have just asked the chef to recommend all the dishes..bet would have fared way better..Show less

Author: Mohan K
Title: Great food
Review: Loved the food and the service as well....definitely a culinary delight. Liked the location of the restaurant and the varied menu offered.

Author: reneeSingapore
Title: Average, overrated restaurant
Review: I personally feel that this is an overrated restaurant.  Food was just average.  I have had better seafood in another seafood restaurant.

Author: tsh791127
Title: Great Food
Review: Great food & value for money. Order 8 dishes came all in big portion & total cost only RM158. Value for family pack. Had 2 times dinner at this restaurant.

Author: SKBrizzles
Title: Great food, great value
Review: We really enjoyed eating at Wonderland and would definately recommend it. The steamed red snapper and the sour plum chicken were amazing. If we had more time in Langkawi we would loved to have gone back.

Author: ChesireCatsLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Nonsense Food.Overpriced!
Review: An utter nonsense.The food was horrible. The "3 Rasa" fish is the worst I've ever tasted in my life. Services was fast but that does not compensate the terrible food served on the table. We paid almost RM400 for nothing!! I wont recommend to anyone and I wont return.Show less

Author: Odette_myKuala Lumpur
Title: Wholesome seafood dishes with a Thai touch
Review: The main selling point for Wonderland really is the value for money. Really really reasonable by Malaysian standards and one gets good fresh seafood prepared in a rather less commercial style. There is a slight Thai influence in the preparation of the dishes. Generally the food is palatable though I must admit not the best in the area from a foodies point of view. Main pull point - price and freshness of the seafood. I would recommend this place for a relatively simple meal at reasonable prices.Show less

Author: pigbitKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Recommended place for seafood
Review: We went there after reading all the reviews, basically quite satisfied with the price and seafood. As majority of the seafood restaurant in Langkawi charge unreasonably high on seafood, Wonderland is somewhere you can have a good meal without worrying of being overcharged. The price is stated clearly on menu, seafood is fresh, serving is quick. We had a fish (siakap), lala, mantis prawn and vegie @ only RM 59. Only flaw is the environment where there are many insects flying here and there, but overall it's still a recommended place to have dinner @ Kuah town (opposite Bella Vista Waterfront resort).Show less

Author: HimmelswesenDuesseldorf
Title: Tasty and a good value for the money
Review: After more than one year living on Langkawi island, I finally made my way to Wonderland... what a shame I have missed out this place for such a long time.You might think, "it's just another seafood restaurant" but it's so much more. Compared to all other places I have been to before, Wonderland is serving a much more tasty food with absolutely reasonable prices.Whenever you are in Kuah, give it a trial!!! They open at around 6 pm.Show less

Author: ShanghaiPukekoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great service, lovely food
Review: We we a party of 5. The menu is just 2 pages, but what they do, they do well. The service was fast and efficient, the food came as soon as it was cooked. We ordered deep fried squid, grilled prawns (awesome, not too much flavour to kill the taste of the prawn) fried rice, noodles and dried chilli chicken. All were perfect... Really tastey. Very reasonable prices... R100 for all the food plus 8 beers. Bargain on top of superb meal, will be back soon. One warning... As it is an outside restaurant, the nearest toilets are across the road behind some shops. They are public, squat-style which some people may wish to avoid. Show less

Author: BudgetPaikKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb Dinner
Review: We were a party of 6 adults. We had chilli crab, omelette oyster, eggies, taufoo, fried squid, 6 portion of rice, 4 cans of beers, 2 glasses of juice and.4 different styles of prawn - asam, butter, salted egg and steam prawn with egg. Total bill was RM200. I'm not sure if this is reasonable or not (as one of my friend said it is way too expensive?). To us, it was all worth it. The prawns were fresh. The chef was the one who took our order and recommend us what he cooks best. The chef even came to our table to check our satisfaction once all the food were served. Service was quick. We had an enjoyable meal. I would highly recommend this restaurant to travellers in Langkawi. It is easy to locate.Show less

Author: Mteng T
Title: Cheap and delicious
Review: very cheap seafood and delicious.. located in Kuah and very easy to find.. it's open air area and no air-cond..

Author: Lilly01234
Title: Will come back again definitely
Review: Fantastic service, very nice people, wonderful food, We loved to spoil the cats and feed them. We will love to eat there again.

Author: mynameisalwaystakenLondon, United Kingdom
Title: First choice in Kuah Town
Review: Dining experiences in Kuah Town can be a bit limited, but Wonderland gives you everything you need. Reminiscent of street food areas in Kuala Lumpur, Wonderland constitutes a small 'shack' where all the cooking is done and some plastic chairs and tables. Do not be put off by this, it's all part of the rustic charm and the food is more than worth it.During a two week stay, we went around 5 times. Food is cheap and good quality and service is with a smile..after we had been once, we were remembered and welcomed back each time. We tried a variety of dishes; fresh fish, prawns, clams, squid, fried rice and steamed veg, all washed down with a few tiger beers. On average, we paid around £16 for dinner which was real value for money.The place has a real buzz about it and is often packed to the rafters..however you are unlikely to wait more than a few minutes to be seated. Check for closing days [general hours are 6pm to 11ish] - when we were there they closed on a Fri and Sun - so you don't end up disappointed!Show less

Author: rsitch12Northants
Title: Great food - good service
Review: One of the busiest outdoor eateries in Kuah. Not the Ritz, but the quality and value of the food are what you go there for. If you want wooden furniture, fresh flowers on your table and a maitre de, then go to one of the 5 star hotels on Langkawi - and pay around 8 times the price. Well worth a visit, but you may have to wait.Show less

Author: VR747London, United Kingdom
Title: Don't miss out
Review: We were told this was the best seafood restaurant on the island and I can see why. We went twice and both times asked the waiter to choose dishes for us. Very friendly staff and delicious dishes at very good value. And one of the members of staff even drove us back to our hotel. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Danderyd1
Title: Great seafood good prices very friendly:)
Review: Perfect food. Good pricing. We are so happy:) GO there! Very nice staff. Great if you like lobster and giant prawns.

Author: Tazel
Title: Average
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by several people and thought we would give it a try.    The service was very good but it was an average meal.

Author: JEONG_HYEOKGI
Title: GOOD AND GOOD
Review:
It taste pretty good. 

 Was good

Was the trip which was near the hostel.

However, the more guests, the order is difficult.

Author: Irene_G1206
Title: Cheap & Good
Review:
Chinese Restaurant behind Bella Vista Resort & Spa Hotel
Open evening around 5.00 pm onwards 
Food is taste nice and with reasonable price

Author: AnnechadLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Got to go there
Review: It is in Kuah town, every taxi driver knows where. Plastic chairs, formica tables but great food. If it is not on the menu let them know and they will do it for you if they have the ingredients. We did not of course expect porK in a Muslim country but were rather surprised and disappointed that they did not have beef - just a small point but would be nice to see it on the menu. Otherwise, an excellent place.Show less

Author: patpoMalaysia
Title: Value for money
Review: The food here is good and obviously cheaper that those restaurant @ Cenang Beach. We ordered a red snapper, small fried squid, small prawn mantis, small clams, medium fried baby kailan, 5 steam rice, 4 drinks and 2 Heineken for a price less than RM100. But my husband and I were a bit disappointed with the size of the crab and clam. Both were rather small for our standard. So we didn't order the crab...By the way, the restaurant closed on Friday.....Show less

Author: EW2003
Title: Awesome
Review: We had numerous diners at Wonderland during our 11 days in Langkawi. Friendly staff with an exceptional quality of service, quite outstanding prices for excellent quality of food. Congratulations.

Author: JoelD81
Title: Great Sea Food
Review: We had heard about Wonderland restaurant from one of our friends in Kuala Lumpur. The food was absolutely great. We had ordered Squid fry, Prawns and Lobsters. We loved the food and service was good. Must have sea food here if you visit Langkawi.

Author: singchiAsia
Title: Decent Food, Definitely Not Great
Review: Location - Strategic in Kuah Town.Food quality - Decent, Not as Great as what others had mentioned here. Steam fish was cold when being served. Chili Crab was not spicy at all. Seaweed soup was very salty, couldn't even finish it. The rest of the food were nothing fantastic. Service - Fast and attentive. Waiter is honest and courteous.Price - Price is moderate only. (not cheap)Facilities - Toilet is located away from restaurant (dont go alone) at isolated place. Summary - Overated. May be one of the better seafood place in Langkawi, but does not deserve even a 4star if rated against the other seafood offerings in Malaysia. Nonetheless, the people running the place seems to be putting in their best to ensure patrons enjoy the food. This review is not meant to criticize Wonderland, but only to provide my personal opinion to re-align the expectation of those who may set high expectation after reading earlier high praising reviews of this eatery.Show less

Author: Radro2011
Title: Must go when in Langkawi for a real experience
Review: Amazing food and service. Highly recommend eating here at least one night. Street type stall but really super clean and seafood is amazing. The tiger prawns are huge and every dish was really good and quite cheap.

Author: Brentwood-Traveler
Title: Great Eats
Review: This is one great little restaurant - great food, great service, great prices. The selection of dishes is the best and you can let them know what level of seasoning you want.

Author: Edwin_IreneSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Cheap & Good
Review: We know this place for its fresh food and the cheap pricing.We ordered:1.Fried squid - Good.2. Nestum Prawns - Good.3. Baby Kailan - OK.4. Steamed Lime Fish(Siakap) - Could have get a better flavour, wasn't so great.Unfortunately we overlooked the lobster, will try that next time.Show less

Author: Jarmo_YVantaa, Finland
Title: Fishrestaurant in Kuah (Langkawi)
Review: This is the place, if you like to have good food in nice price. They have several fish, grab, schrimps and chickenmeals. All done and served with care of their customers. They even get me a "taxi" when we left the place. One of their employee drive us to hotell with his own car. WowShow less

Author: waterwoman85
Title: Good Seafood in a Spotty Restaurant Town
Review: Prices are great and seafood is fresh which is the case at nearly everywhere you go. For the best meals, walk down to the hawker's area where the locals eat lunch. The Tum Yam Soup comes three ways and the noodle dishes are freshly made.

Author: MK_Lai
Title: Good food,service & reasonable price
Review:
I"m had been here several time since 2003...is still remain the same....
i come with the expectation and going back with the satisfaction.
Wonderful Wonderland...You should try out here....!!

Author: wrldtrvlr86Canberra, Australia
Title: Cheap Eats
Review: This restaurant is hidden by the canal in Kuah Town. While hard to find, the food is cheap, fresh and delicious. We had two fresh crabs for 24 RM (aka: less then $10 AUD). Amazing. The only complaint from us was the stagnant water in the canal so in rainy season make sure you bring your bug spray. Give this local gem a try, I think you will be pleasantly surprised.Show less

Author: jcwo
Title: Average taste
Review: I read the reviews of this restaurant and decided to try this restaurant.  The food that I ordered tasted average and there were nothing spectacular about it.  I liked the fact that food was served relatively fast after ordering.

Author: Graham LZurich, Switzerland
Title: A little disappointing.
Review: We ate there tonight and 2 of our 3 dishes were good, 1 was awful, but we'd never had it before so bad choice or bad food???. Service was ok for us but the place was manic so definitely an eat and go place. 2 table complained about the service and 1 managed to not get any food at all despite asking a couple of times and just left in the end. Price was Kuah average, and my tip would be go after 21:00 as it went really quiet, before 18:00 might be ok, but between 19:00 and 20:00 expect to stand and wait whilst the chaos unfolds around you.Show less

Author: JariK236
Title: Excellent cost/quality ratio!
Review: Small restaurant providing tens of different portions of seafood & chicken. Personnel was kind enough to provide us support when choosing what to eat. We were there twice, both times place was busy (not that full we could not get in though :) fast service, highly recommendedShow less

Author: 018Simone
Title: Delish!!! And super cheap
Review: Great friendly service, greats food, so cheap (50 cents for a drink, 30 cents for rice, $3 per main). Lobster was about $20 but came out with a "net" made from carrot! Which was fun and then the chef gave us a demonstration on how he had hand cut it! Went back again the next night :)Show less

Author: Denwkh
Title: Up to standard Malaysian seafood.
Review: Good seafood restaurant, Rm60.00 for 2 person with prawns,clams, steam fish, vege , soup and rice. Will come again

Author: MimiPetalingJayaPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great value for money, fast and courteous service and excellent food!
Review: The service was really fast despite having an almost full house. I think it boils down to how organized they are, from service staff to the kitchen staff. Most importantly, the staff are local Malaysians and they do not hire foreign workers. When we asked for cilli padi, the service staff took the trouble to ask if we wanted spicy ones and went about trying to fulfill our wishes. Although they ran out of that particular variety, it did not matter as the effort mattered more. Food was excellent and I regretted not ordering the lobster, which, at RM18/100g is one of the cheapest in Langkawi. The prices are reasonable. They are only open for dinner, not lunch.Show less

Author: dreamlander78singapore
Title: A Must Try if you go to Langkawi
Review: We went there upon reading other good reviews online. And this turn out to be the best meals we had during our stay there. The other places we tried (also upon reading good reviews) were rather disappointing. The speed at which they serve their food is also amazing fast! Go give this place a try!Show less

Author: turbozmr2Westhill, United Kingdom
Title: Great local seafood
Review: Found thanks to other Tripadvisor reviews, this Chinese seafood place is not something you might pay attention to from the street. But, go around the back and the outdoor (undercover) seating was getting busy after sunset. The service was good and we had a selection of chicken, crab, tiger prawn and fish dishes. All plates were cleaned by the end, washed down with some cold, cheap Tiger beer.Show less

Author: SaveTheShark
Title: Highly Overated!
Review: Went there on October 2012 with some frens from China. We ordered Assam prawns, sweet sour grouper, clams, oyster omelette and vegs.  Food are very average to local Malaysian standard. Nothing to shout about.

Author: heenja
Title: Value for money
Review: for 55RM you get a very good meal for 2. Pretty surprised with how good and genuine the service was also for somewhere so cheap. It will definitely warrant a revisit the next time i am in langkawi.

Author: mrsliwang
Title: Awesome!
Review: Amazing seafood!!! Fast service, attentive and friendly staff. Very good price. It is very busy and outdoor seating only. Good ambience.

Author: Collin3012
Title: Nice, reasonable and good food
Review:
A nice, affordable and good food...

If u r bring friends/ family, the food here is kinda good. 
It's NOT pricey too.....

A restaurant to think about when U r at Kuah town.

Author: hunt4adventureVictoria, Australia
Title: Great food, quick service!
Review: The Place isn't much to look at when you walk in, and the food isn't served on fancy plates, BUT it is amazing quality!!! We had the fried calamari, the mixed veggies, the sweet and sour chicken, the fried rice, and 200g tiger prawn barbecued!! We ordered small size dishes, which we were glad we did because there was so much food!!!! Staff were wonderful, very welcoming, suggested some dishes for us, very fast service! Great for a quick meal this place! Dishes are cheap. Fried rice RM 5, small chicken dish RM 10. The only more expensive item was the prawn, but it was a good size and they split it when they BBQ it, so it's very easy to eat, worth a few more dollars, 100g was RM16. I ordered a 200g. But when all other dishes are so cheap the bill at the end is still very cheap!!Will eat here again before we leave! Show less

Author: NameIWantedWasTaken7Lennox Head, Australia
Title: Good food and value for money
Review: We got a recommendation for this restaurant from our host and were not disappointed. Eating is outdoors under a roof. Service is swift, food is fresh and great, prices are cheap, staff friendly. There were a few other westerners eating the night we went but the clientele were mainly locals - or maybe Asian tourists - which is always a good sign.Definitley a cheap and cheerful dining experience. Like most other restaurants on Langkawi it specialises in fish and seafood. Delicious.Show less

Author: burniejim
Title: Eating at Wonderland
Review: Wonderland was just great, the food was well worth the trip in to town. Nothing to look at but the atmosphere was terrific, & very reasonable prices

Author: FaunaFloraEcoLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Needs a little changes if wanna attract more muslim customers
Review: about the food, although its not the freshest in langkawi, but i think its the best value for money on the island. the cooking are unquestionable good also. but the only lack coz they're also serve alcoholic drink. for the non muslim its ok, but for some muslim its not. yes, they are muslim customer such as me who come and still eat over there, but if they wanna attract more muslim customer, i think they should kick the alcoholic beverages out from the menu. But its up to them, non muslim of course will prefer alcoholic, but its the opposite for some muslim. If they didnt serve beer anymore, it will be the best example of 1Malaysia restaurant!Show less

Author: JW845
Title: Excellent Food/Service
Review: Ate here 2 times during our stay of 5 days for dinner.  Fantastic food and service at a great value.  Wonderful seafood and asian dishes.

Author: TPP18Singapore
Title: Do not try this restaurant
Review: If you have tried the any good chinese zhi char before, you will know the food in Wonderland is not considered high quality. The tom yum soup is far too sweet. And the chef must have poured the whole bottle of chilli sauce into the "hei ko bak" we have ordered, making it too sweet and juicy. We felt like eating chilli sauce. The 3 tastes fish is too salty. Only the sambal chilli kangkung tastes normal. Do not recommend this restaurant at all.Show less

Author: Imtiaz_Alam
Title: Good food
Review:
We liked plain rice - good for Bangladeshis - and grilled prawn.
Fresh juice and other prawn items were good too.
Good service.

Author: esteekho
Title: Great food with valueable price
Review: The price of this stall is really really reasonable and the fish are actually cheap....and i had agreat dinner there...i would suggest the salted vege toufu soup !!! It is really yummy.....great food with great price...will be there again for second visit

Author: Subash VKajang, Malaysia
Title: Value for money
Review: The restaurant is not one of the fancy ones that you would be expecting. It is located at a "medan selera" as the locals would call it. There are also lots of other nearby stalls around.The good thing about the place is it's food and pricing. The waiter would actually advise you should he/she feels the portion you are ordering is too big. The staff working there are very friendly as well.The pricing is reasonable as the dishes come in small, medium and large. The only dish that might blow your budget would be the lobster and fish as it goes by weight. However, it is worth a try. Wonderland does not sit at a very big place. Hence is would be advisable to make a reservation or be there early.Show less

Author: PortfairymumMelbourne, Australia
Title: Wonderful Wonderland!
Review: What can I say - What a great place to eat with the locals . We gave been asking the locals around Kuah where was the best place to eat and Wonderland kept being repeated. The Taxi driver knew exactly where it was and when we got there we just asked what was fresh today and what would be recommended , and what we got was sensational . There was only 3 of us and we slightly over catered by ordering medium sized dishes - small would have sufficed. The beer was cold, service fast, food delicious ! Best to get there between 6-7pm to be guaranteed a table. Will definatly be going back.Show less

Author: RalSan1177Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great Outdoor Restaurant with a Roof/Seefood to Die for
Review: Not far from the Bella Vista is a food court area. One of the restaurants is Wonderland. Good service. Cold drinks. Warm outside open air with a roof.The seafood is excellent. You could go and eat there every day and not get tired of the selection. Especially the sateh prawns. Will be back there again in October. Cannot wait as I miss the food so much.Show less

Author: Thai MHa Noi, Ha Noi, Vietnam
Title: Not Good. Don't mistake again between Fresh and Live lobster.
Review: I came there on Aug 9, 2012. They don't have live lobster. Only fresh, or freeze lobster in ice. I rather pay more money for live lobster that sell in Pantai Cenang than for the freeze one. It's taste terrible. I ordered lobster bbq, so when it was served, only few pieces of lobster meat. Too expensive for few pieces.After came back to Kuala Lumpur, I found that Jalan Alor was sell fresh lobster with good price and more and more delicious than one from this restaurant.Inclusion, please don't check this restaurant. If u live around Pantai Cenang, check some restaurant in there, they have same price level but all taste fresh.Show less

Author: mangopudding10Australia
Title: Hard to find, but decent
Review: We came looking on recommendation from a friend and wow, it was pretty hard to find. Tucked away off the side of the main road, Wonderland is the busiest place. You can tell straight up, that the food they serve, is better than the similar dishes on offer for a restaurant just next door. It was pretty late by the time we got there, but the food was still good. it's pretty tasty and probably better value than most restaurants with the same type of cuisine on Langkawi island. The people there are honest about what's fresh and waiting time as well. It was a pleasant experience in a pleasant surrounding.Show less

Author: Torzas
Title: Disappointed
Review: I dont think the food is that great. Food is basically sweet, had 4 dishes and 3 tasted sweet. No salty no peppery but sweet. Only vege tasted ok. Points up for their service.

Author: AndyO84Sydney, Australia
Title: Wonderful Wonderland
Review: By far the best seafood Resturant in Langkawi !The staff are exceptionally curious and the service is quick ! We have been here 4 times and every time have had consistently great foor great service and a great nice ! A must while you are in Langkawi. A perfectly run family businessThank you Wonderland ! We will be back !Show less

Author: jaxxj
Title: best choice for seafood in langkawi
Review: the calamari, crabs & spicy fish were great. there are other restaurants in the same lane, but this is the best, dont look further.

Author: john1604
Title: busy but tired
Review: this was our third visit found the staff tired and the service not as good as usual the food again was not up to standard

Author: savvyauntyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great value and good food
Review: Gave this place a shot after reading good reviews on tripadvisors and some blogs which appears on google search. Indeed, the seafood was good and the price was really reasonable. 5 of us had a whole table of food and it only cost us RM109. The staff was friendly and service was prompt. The chilli flower crab was below expectation but everything else was good.Show less

Author: Cookiemonster171Knutsford, United Kingdom
Title: Best food we had in Langkawi
Review: The manager of the hotel recommended this superb restaurant and he was so right.  The food is absolutely superb and very fresh whereas the cost is local prices RM183 for 6 people including beer.Their idea of what a big portion is might be a bit different to Western appetites (if they say that it will be enough for 3 it's enough for 2) but that's a minor point. Absolutely superb and definitely recommendedShow less

Author: Edwin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good seafood, but avoid the rest
Review: This place came highly recommended by friends and locals alike. Perhaps my expectations were unfairly built up, but I don't think it was that fantastic.The seafood was good (& cheap!), but unfortunately the other dishes we ordered fell short. The chicken in plum sauce in particular, was quite inedible. There were other local eateries that served better food.Show less

Author: rk-artLombok, Indonesia
Title: popular place with average food
Review: Maybe it was the wrong choice of foods, i found the food is average and slightly expensive. We were looking for crabs, as that is the most popular choice, but its not available. the waitress was kind enough to offer us to order from the next restaurant if we want it but we refuse the offer. we had chilly mantis, very average, kangkong belacan, which is quite tasty, and the so called grill fish, which looks like far from being grilled.. its cooked though but the fish is tasteless unless you eat it with the topping, and the rice is not soft either.. there are plenty of other seafood restaurants along the road and i certainly will give a second thought of going there again.Show less

Author: niinanordstrom
Title: food that make your dream come true...
Review: dont know what to say but that mantis in chili i will never forget.......recomended.....

Author: JamesChanSing
Title: Great prices, good chinese seafood.
Review:
Good mix of locals and tourists, in fact more locals (which is a good sign of course).  Order the butter prawns!

Cheap beer as well.

Author: Tigerbeth
Title: Best local food
Review:
Very busy local eatery in Kuah , serving great food for about 30 ringgits ($10) per couple.!!!
Dont be put off by the plastic chairs etc.... staff were fantastic ,really helpful

Author: warden535Reading, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing amazing amazing
Review: We were taken to Wonderland in a taxi and I didn't want to get out. I am so glad I did it was the most amazing food that my family and I have ever eaten the manager helped us pick and it was just the best. We even went back a few days later. Don't be put off its not a posh restaurant but it is everything I want the best of the best Please don't leave Langkawi without trying 'Wonderland' It was a wonderful experience.Show less

Author: Fengli
Title: Good place to dine
Review:
Stay at langkawi for 4 days. Been to a few restaurant, find wonderland the best.
Food is good, price is reasonable. Should try if you are in Langkawi cos not much varieties available in Langkawi

Author: KrinaLangkawiLangkawi
Title: Wonderful food at wonderland already for 5 years
Review: We are staying regularly on Langkawi and visit Wonderland now for 5 years and it is unbelievable that they have always a very good quality of the food, they serve the food very quick and they are always very friendly and nice to all their quests. Never leave Langkawi without visiting Wonderland.Show less

Author: busytraveller59
Title: Excellent food and great friendly service
Review: This restaurant is a must for those who like to  experience local food at the highest quality.

Author: vasavaprLappeenranta, Finland
Title: An average Restaurant
Review: I am not a fan of south-east type of food. Also I hate sugar in my meals. It was my first time and it was not good. I hated what I ordered and did not eat it at all. My wife ordered crab curry which was surprisingly good.Show less

Author: becksangel7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: OK for a seafood meal in langkawi
Review: I would say there aren't many recommended places to eat in langkawi that are of "must-eat-before-you-die" standards. This place serves a good menu of seafood and at an ok price (it wasn't that cheap compared to KL prices). Taste was good enough for langkawi standards though i have tasted much better in KL. If you're looking for a seafood option in langkawi, then i would recommend this place.Show less

Author: Stuzzly
Title: Great Kuah Town chinese eatery
Review: Happily escaped the overpriced Westin hotel for dinner at Wonderland. Fast, fresh and fun - great buzz, lots of food, good prices. Very good place to eat and feel like a local.

Author: brittncathya
Title: Great seafood experience
Review: My favorite thing about this restaurant is that they offered to remove tails and heads on the prawn I ordered!  My husband loved the price for quality seafood.  A great place to eat in Kuah!

Author: Chelsea Choy-yi L
Title: yummy seafood~
Review: it does not have the ideal best seaview ever, but the food is fresh and yummy, and price is very reasonable. Must go in Langkawi!!!

Author: LLS0811Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Judging from the crowd, we thought that this restaurant would be worth a try. We were quite wrong. If you are looking for Chinese/Thai dishes, there are better ones down the same road, a short distance away. Service was fast but they got 1 of our orders wrong. We ate it anyway. I found nothing impressive about the dishes. The prices were reasonable.Show less

Author: poptartlr
Title: A bit overrated
Review: This restaurant got talked up a bit but it was a little average - service was very slow and uninterested despite the number of staff, and the food was quite bland.

Author: Nuschko
Title: Best place to enjoy seafood dinner
Review: The best place for seafood if you are in this area of Langkawi. Unbeatable price-quality ratio.

Author: Lee R
Title: Good meal here
Review: Good food, noisy fun atmosphere.  Great seafood at good prices.

Author: pumpkinIzmir
Title: Best Chinese in Langkawi
Review: Several people recommended this restaurant and we were not disappointed. Get there early as it gets quite busy. We several dishes, all exquisitely fresh, cooked to perfection. And so cheap! Service excellent, friendly and helpful. King prawns to die for!

Author: rossm330
Title: Excellent food at cheap prices
Review: Local food cooked by local people. Very tasty. Highly recommended.

Author: Fadfodeh
Title: Very good seafood
Review: Great seafood with great prices. I tried the tiger prawns and they were very fresh

Author: Claire_le_RouxHexham, England, United Kingdom
Title: this restaurant is a MUST
Review: I have never dined so well for so little and been entertained at the same time!!! Plastic chairs and tables and amazingly low prices fool the clientele into thinking they may be at a fast food joint. No way! The meals are fantastic, freshly prepared, the service personal with very accurate recommendations and the chef extremely talented! He doesn't mind giving you a few presentation tips for your next dinner party either. Thanks Atun and AsunShow less

Author: JustOneThing
Title: Best street food in Langkawi
Review: Forget the smelly river nearby and the plastic tables and chairs and the location... this is the best street food in Langkawi. Go there!

Author: FplusVPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Very Salty Food
Review: Had dinner here today and must say the food was extremely salty!!!! We had seafood tom yam, very salty. Baby Kailan with Oyster Sauce, also very salty. D/fried calamari, so so only. Oyster omelette a little oily. Only thing good was the Chinese tea very hot.Standard has dropped tremendeously....can bypass this restaurant for nowShow less

Author: PTCCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good Food but beware
Review: The restaurant is located at the main road in Kuah and you can park by the road side. It is located in a food court next to the river.There is no toilet in the food court and you need to cross the main road over to the corner of another row of shop-lots and it is quite quiet at night.The food here is delicious and it is often pack with people. If you are tourists, need to be more careful as they tend to recommend more expensive dishes.We tried to order butter fried prawns but the person taking the order says that they have not more sea prawns but offered grilled tiger prawns instead. The 2 large tiger prawns came to about RM 110.00 per dish. Later, the next table of us (locals) got their order of fried butter prawns but they came later than us.Not so honest after all.Show less

Author: padawan0223Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must try!!! Best seafood with cheapest price in Langkawi!
Review: I've read some reviews about it before I proceed to try on this restaurant. Local claims that this place sells cheapest and tastiest seafood in Langkawi. We tried it and yes, their seafood is really fantastic! Service is prompt and friendly. Price for seafood is really cheap. Price for vege, soup, drinks are slightly expensive. Not only locals visit their restaurant, foreigners enjoy it too. My wife and I tried once during dinner time on 2nd day of our visit to Langkawi, and we have no doubt to return to this place on next day.This restaurant is just situated behind Bella Vista. It does not has many tables. Do come early before 7pm to avoid the queue, especially on weekends. Otherwise, call them for reservation. But even this place is full with people, you can see that people are willing to wait, even though they are aware that two seafood restaurants next to Wonderland have more empty seats/tables.Generally RM20-30 per person is good enough to enjoy a satisfying seafood dinner. No service tax, government tax, etc.Show less

Author: RobertKhorPulau Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Awesome
Review: I haven't been there for a while but when I bring my family & my close friend, Chiam's family, you know what.....it is just "AWESOME".....for 6 adults and 6 kids....it just RM 160.....we had Fish, Mantis Prawn, Squid, Chicken, Japanese Beancurd and Vegetables, all were so delicious, yummy and Mama Mia.......not forget the drinks as well....hehe...for me they are the best in the island....don't be surprise if you see more non chinese then chinese....hehe.....actually the place is halal and thats why many muslim like to go there......so if you guys here in Langkawi, this is the place....a must try....you won't regret it....cheersShow less

Author: ejh25
Title: Great food at a cheap price
Review: We had lobster, big prawns, soft-shell crab, fried rice, and two beers for $45! Everything was fresh and tasty.

Author: Karen D
Title: brilliant food
Review: this restaurent is great to go with a group of people it brings the price down its also more fun very busy restaurent,and great chinese food

Author: StevieBCheshire
Title: Brilliant and cheap
Review: The first in a row of seafood resteraurants we had a recommendation and it was well worth the trip. Had soft shell crab deep fried , absolutely wonderful and really cheap

Author: Lim12London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food, very fresh ingredients, steal at that price.
Review: Had 2 very good meals with very fresh fish,prawns and veggies. Service very good and attentive. My wife had a fit of hiccups after biting into a HOT chilli. One of the waiter immediately brought her a glass of water without being asked. Wonderful.The patron and chef is very charming and was helpful in suggesting nice dishes. Will definitely go again next year. The price is ridiculously cheap. Very fresh good food, excellent service and cheap as well--winning combination as witness by the packed house. Show less

Author: Colin Y
Title: The place to eat in Kuah
Review: Best bang for your buck in Kuah.  Great Chinese dishes and good service even when busy!

Author: ReleveeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: awesome~ great lobster
Review: My bf and i went there by car at night. This restaurant is full of customers. Even need to stand to wait for empty space. Anyway, the best time to go is before 7pm. Two of us ordered lobsters, crab & kangkung vege. Total price is around rm110. Encourage more people to go , so that you can order various of food there and taste more dishes in 1 table.The Lobster quite big. RM18/100g . Normally , lobster there will not exist RM90m for 1 lobster.Great not even for tourist, but i aslo noticed alots of local customer prefer this seafood restaurant! i definitely will go there again.Show less

Author: Andrew P
Title: Great Value
Review: We got a way with a seafood banquet for hardly anything and it was delicious

Author: Romuluz75
Title: Excellent seafood
Review: This restaurant is located in the outskirts of Kuah town and next to the Bella Vista hotel. Its famous for reasonably priced and very good seafood.

Author: FishCatBadgerBarcelona
Title: Delicious food - and amazing value!
Review: This was recommended to us by the guy we hired our car from at the airport, and what a place! It's basic - a few plastic tables outside by the river in Kuah - but a definite must-visit restaurant in Langkawi. The food is so fresh and tasty - probably the best we ate on the island - the owner is so friendly and will recommend dishes, and it's certainly the cheapest. I wish we could all have local restaurants like this place!Show less

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Best Chinese on the Island
Review: Ate here last night. 6 people in the party - loads of food between including large fresh Grouper fish, rice, noodles, squid, vegetables and at least 3 different chicken dishes- loads of beers and softies and the total bill only came to RM180 which works out about £6=30 a headShow less

Author: outnabout78Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Wonderland...Wonderful Sea food Restaurant !!
Review: I heard and read a lot about this famous sea food restaurant in kuah town . Until I had the chance to try their famous signature dishes ( black pepper chicken,mantis prawn with dry chilies, stir fried cabbage with soya sauce,grilled sea bass with abc sauce...the list goes on).the staff are quick in taking orders friendly too , especially the owner ( Ah tun ) . It was worth the try very and highly recommended .Show less

Author: pitwoodsusan10Larnaca, Cyprus
Title: great food and great value
Review: We read about Wonderland restaurant and so decided to try it. It was very popular with both tourists and locals and both times we ate there we had to wait for a table. The choice of food was excellent. Seafood is their speciality and we loved their sea bream and garlic prawns. Highly recommend it!Show less

Author: AnneHastie
Title: My favorite resto in Kuah!
Review: Food is really up to standard, service is quite slow, ambiance is of average.

Author: titanium0808Singapore, Singapore
Title: Over hyped
Review: Every we asked recommended tis place for seafood, together with Orkid Ria. Orkid is worth going to for live seafood. Not Wonderland. It is situated in the Kuah town centre, facing a canal (smelly river). I wouldn't hold that against the restaurant. But the seafood wasnt live. It wasnt even very fresh. (For newbies to Malaysian and Chinese seafood, LIVE means the fish and crabs and so on are live and swimming in tanks you can see, and you pick the one you want. FRESH simply means already killed, perhaps chilled, perhaps frozen) The steamed fish certainly wasnt live. Even the teens in the group could tell that with one taste. The calamari tasted like it had been cooked in oil refried many times. The so called herbal prawns weren't even fresh; they had the texture of frozen prawn. Factor in the 40 minute wait for the food and the dinner was a dismal failure. One thing though - prices are low. But don't waste your time here. Try another Chinese seafood eatery five minutes by car away - Dragon Inn restaurant has heaps better food, as we discovered the next day.Show less

Author: Sujd
Title: Excellent Seafood
Review: Had dinner here 2 nights and found the seafood fantastic, is a bit more expensive but worth it.

Author: dlbspace
Title: Cheap seafood but cooking is averge only
Review:
Steam fish was fresh
Sambal squid was no gd
Kailan was just passable

Author: htss
Title: Fast service
Review: Considered cheap if you compare to other food prices at Langkawi but most impressed with the speed the food came out although the place was crowded!

Author: IzzyKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy seafood at a cheap price!
Review: We ate there two nights in a row. Service is very fast, the food is yummy and the price is excellent. If you're lucky, like we were, you get to see a chef's demo - we got to see a fancy carrot-peeling session. Try the softshell crab and fish dishes!Show less

Author: Gaye-tripIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Do not miss
Review: What a great food what a positive service.do not expect so much for the ambiance since it is a very simple local place. But if you would like to have very good seafood for a very affordable price you should go there.All of them were great especially big prawn was awesomeeeShow less

Author: Jack R
Title: Cheap but food is not that good.
Review: Price is cheap. Service is very fast. However for taste factor you should eat in Penang.

Author: Matkailija58
Title: Go and enjoy the local food and atmosphere
Review: Try different types of prawns, mixed vegetables also excellent. All in all great food, cheap prices. (There´s no toilet in the restaurant, but one public one on the other side of street, at least for men)

Author: ChepstowBob
Title: Great sea food
Review: Brilliant fresh food and cheap. All the locals use it!! go early before 7:00pm

Author: BeachesAreBest123Columbia, Connecticut
Title: Good seafood choice in Kuah
Review: We ate dinner here one night. Service was exceptional and food was good, if not phenomenal. The fried fish was delicious, the Assam Prawns less so. Crabs were tasty as well. All in all, a good seafood choice for the city, very fresh fish, and prices cheaper than the restaurants at Panai Cenang. Show less

Author: huih
Title: Good food!
Review: Very good food and reasonable price!! I liked the Ikan Bakar so much! Other food are nice too. If you really dont know what to order, just ask the waiters to suggest! I like the boss there!He is so friendly!

Author: wbsailor
Title: great food, unbelievable prices
Review: Excellent, tasty food: first night for ten pax including beers...MYR175.  Last night food including GIant prawns and fish and beer, MYR280.  YOu won;t do better than this....not pretty but has a charm of its own.

Author: lee y
Title: Good Chinese Food
Review: the price was worth for very dish we ate. eventhough everything was new to us it really tasted good.

Author: gr00vychickDubai
Title: Great restaurant
Review: The food was AMAZING, although i read on TA how wonderland was a bit of a rip off i never felt that our total bill was RM 45 which included a whole fried fish, grilled prawns, fried rice and fresh cocounut drink. The fried rice was sooo good the best i have ever had.Show less

Author: CheshireIanP
Title: So good we had to go again
Review: A great chinese fish restaurant. astonishingly good value for money in an informal setting and atmosphere - my favourite restaurant of a two week holiday. Everything we ordered was beautifully cooked.

Author: RohmaybalKlang, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Seafood - Reasonably Priced
Review: We read excellent reviews about this restaurant from Tripadvisor. The last time we had to give it a miss since it was closed. We arrived at around 8pm and there was already a queue for tables. The restaurant needless to say was packed to the brim. We did not wait more than a couple of minutes. Service was quick considering the crowd. We had some fish, chicken, noodles, soup and flower crabs. For the 3 of us, the bill came up to RM76/-, which I found to be very reasonable.Show less

Author: maddiesteoSingapore
Title: Good food
Review: After a trip to Kitta Restaurant, Wonderland is a godsend. Not only was the food cheap, it was also good. The portion isn't too much for two and we were able to try almost all the seafood. The mantis prawn wasn't like the rest but it still tasted delicious. It is definitely not of restaurant quality but more like home-cooked, the good, old and comforting type with wok hei. When we couldn't finish our beer, the lady was nice enough to do a refund from the bill. We were in Langkawi for 4 nights and went for two dinners there. For the price and quality, it is a worthwhile trip. Parking is limited but you can find a lot if you park a little further or opposite. We were hesitant about visiting after reading so many reviews on the extreme. But we were glad we did after we tried it. For a roadside stall,the food is awesome.Show less

Author: Irene L
Title: Reasonably Priced
Review: The restaurant has a lot of local and foreign patrons.  The price of seafood are consider cheap and reasonable.

Author: Sibylistic
Title: Poor service & lousy parking
Review: Not toilet provided, service was horrible, food is very low quality (according to Chinese cuisine standard), crab they served us was not a very fresh one, and cooked improperly.

Author: KewLAng
Title: Affordable and tasty
Review: We had prawn, garoupa fish, premantis prawn, squid and vege, beers and Chinese tea, all for rm87, table of 4. Going back there again tonight...

Author: Libby CHua Hin, Thailand
Title: Wonderland is Wonderful, Wonderous and Wonderamazing!
Review: We were recommended to Wonderland by every taxi driver, shop owner, massage centre and hotel concierge we came across!!! We've never had such an emphatic recommendation for somewhere to eat and we weren't disappointed. Whilst the "ambience" isn't 5-star the service and the food certainly are and it's no wonder it's always well attended by both tourists and locals. The owner "Toon" is just the perfect maitre'd and he was so helpful with our choices. In fact it was so fantastic we took our friends back there and they've said they'll return before they leave Langkawi. And we couldn't believe how cheap it was considering how great the food was!Show less

Author: ovelaurBergen, Norway
Title: Very good cheap food
Review: I think people are trowing around their 5-star reviews, I am not one of those. If I where, I would for sure give this place 5 stars. So now I have already said this place is worth a visit or more (we are maybe going back this evening, and I will write a new review if my mind changes).So why not 5 stars?5 stars means EXCELLENT.Frozen food is not regarded excellent.Hygiene is not excellent, but fair enough compared to local standards.Food taste very good, and service were excellent.Show less

Author: Katja PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great Food with Fluorescent Lighting
Review: One thing is for sure in Asia, never judge a book by it's cover. Wonderland is not a romantic attraction but it's definitely a fantastic place to meet up with friends. BYO without a corkage fee, the owner personally waits tables, introduces himself and you can even guess the amount of the dinner at the end. If you are right, then you get the dinner for free! :)There are three extremely competent chefs in the small kitchen who always make the same quality every-time you come to eat there.I recommend this to any person, any age. There is no loud music but there are some mozzies, so bring mosquito-spray with you. The restaurant will always be busy after 6:30pm and they are not open on Fridays.I do believe they make the best squid dishes and they have a fantastic butter prawns that you must try! :)Show less

Author: AustraliaSydney
Title: best local food
Review: If you love local food go to Wonderland as you won't be disappointed.  We had 9 days in Malaysia and I would say this was one of our best meals.

Author: Sandra2505Adelaide, Australia
Title: Fantastic cheap food
Review: Enjoyed the food so much on our first visit we went back on our last night in Langkawi. Both nights it was extremely busy but the service and food on both occasions, was exceptional (as was the price). The staff are more than happy to explain the various dishes, even though they're run off their feet!! At the end of our meal the owner offered to book a taxi for us back to our hotel - certainly wasn't expecting that type of service.Show less

Author: ssw88888Melbourne, Australia
Title: Sensational and CHEAP
Review: We happened to stumble upon this gem by talking to the pool staff at the Westin who suggested we try this restaurant. The food is amazingly fresh and the seafood is sensational. We ordered fresh whole groupa, tiger prawns, soft shell crab & the staple char kway teow including numerous beers. The bill was RM$100!!! Our taste buds were buzzing and the staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful and made us feel very welcome. On a very busy night, the manager even ordered us a taxi and walked us to the taxi!! We never received this service even in 5 star restaurants where we paid multiple times more for the meal. We highly recommend this and recommend this for anyone looking for sensational food without the price tag and great service!!Show less

Author: CheshireLady_9Chester
Title: great atmosphere and good value for money
Review: We found the restaurant by accident - we wanted to go to a Thai restaurant but found it was closed because of Ramadam, the owners suggested we tried Wonderland. The owner and staff were really friendly and advised on which dishes were good. We had some fantastic gigantic prawns - about a foot long! The restaurant was really popular with locals (always a good sign) and was full all evening. The service was quick and friendly and the food was delicious and also not expensive. Definitely give it a try one night if you are in Langkawi.Show less

Author: El_GizmoSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Affordable fresh seafood for dinner
Review: Location: Convenient and easy to find.The place is a small stall next to the road in Kuah Town (driving towards the town, turn right at the traffic light to Bella Vista hotel and the stall is along the road few minutes away). Open-aired sitting under the shed. It feels very homey with many locals patronising there. Food: Delicious and fresh!We ordered a small seabass (steamed with black taucu), a plate of vegetables (stir fry) and a plate of mussels (kam heong style) with 2 plates of rice and 2 cups of juices. It only cost us RM43 for 2 pax. The fish was fresh, smooth without any trace of "fishiness smell". I enjoyed the fried mussels in kam heong style. It was a bit Thai-style since there is a combination of sweet, sour and spiciness in the sauce. Recommended by the car rental guy. They do not serve pork ; presumably halal. Value: Affordable and worth while. Will go there again the next time to try the other dishes. Would have loved to try other kind of mussels but there was only that one type.Show less

Author: TanYH
Title: Great food & very reasonable price
Review: The seafood is so fresh and tasty. Service is fast and good.

Author: mk_steven_rKuala Lumpur
Title: Fresh,Tasty & Best Seafood Restaurant of Langkawi
Review: I got to know this restaurant by blogging. Saw some people blogged about it and it had a good review, i went here with a group of Hungry Friends!The Crowd:It was really large! we waited 20mins to be seated. You will have to be early as possible or else you will not get a place, and most of the time the tables are booked!The Food:Just one word! :Awesome! most fresh seafood we have ever eaten in entire langkawi. The taste was really good too! this is a NO-PORK restaurant, we saw a few malay families having dinner. My Fav: Butter Prawns!The Price:Very very affordable! we went there 5 person and spent RM100 for plenty full food we ordered. inc. prawns, squid, tofu , vege, mantis prawn, lala, chicken.I would recommend this restaurant to other travellers visiting!Show less

Author: wecollectAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Surprise, surprise.
Review: A very welcome change from the Westin food and especially the prices. Two seperate people advised us to visit Wonderland. It does not look flash, however the food is. The massive prawn and soft shell crab were delicious, not to mention the coconut rice and cheeky chicken!! The service was very good with the owner advising on our selections. He also pointed out the local bottle shop over the road for a bottle of wine with the meal. We paid 70mr for a good feed for 2 and 30mr for the wine. The wine was 1/4 of the price of the resort. The cab cost 8mr to get back to the Westin. Wonderland is used by both locals and tourist, it gets busy however service is very fast, so lots of bums on seats. TAKE CASH, no cards taken, I had to walk 1/2 km to the cash point over two main busy roads. A great find, keep up the good workShow less

Author: kiwigypsey
Title: Great food,great value for money
Review: Always eat at Wonderland when in Langkawi & never disappointed.Food always freshly cooked & delicious.Great price for such yummy food &the service is fast & friendly.So good we have been 3 nights in a row & will go again tomorrow. Fantastic place.

Author: CharlieT1994Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome Food, Awesome Value....Just Awesome.
Review: Should be number one restaurant in Langkawi, wait, why stop there, should be number one in Malaysia! We went here for our first meal out, then for my bothers birthday, then when some of our friends from England arrived, then again when some more friends arrived and then lastly on our second last night when it was my sisters and one ofour friends birthday were there was a grand total of 16 of us and the food still arrived no more then 10 mintues of ordering! Wonderland is cheap and cheerful with plastic plates and lovely staff and the fun game of guessing your bill at the end making it a memorable place to eat. We worked out that on average it cost around £3-£4 per person including 2-3 drinks and piles of food! Some of the food i would recommend is the crispy chicken, dry chilli chicken, fried squid, chicken fried rice and crispy soft shelled crab and ordering all of them in large as you will eat alot of all the food! We all went home full and happy each time! I love Wonderland and wished i had a local one in Newcastle! You would be crazy not to eat here if you visit Langkawi!Show less

Author: Ali RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great seafood - value for money
Review: We visited wonderland in June, and were not disappointed. Ordered fish, prawns, chicken, egg fried rice, calamari, and three types of veggies. None of the dishes disappointed us. The service was good, and the food freshly prepared within minutes of our order. Do ask the manager to serve you their special "ABC" sauce which is fantastic. Spicy and sour, and goes well with fried fish. Well worth a visit while in Langkawi, best with a group of four or more so you can try a variety of seafood. Best part, it's Halal.....sorry folks, no porky pork on the menu.Show less

Author: Tigershark11Clemson, South Carolina
Title: The reviews are spot on, great food and super value
Review: We hit Wonderland for dinner thinking this could not be as good as the reviews, and we pleasantly impressed. Michael took care of us from ordering dinner to a taxi home. We loved the fish two ways (steamed with ginger and shallots, and grilled on banana leaf), chicken special, soft shell crab, baby cabbage and rice. Add half a dozen beers and still less than Rm100!Although the restaurant backs onto the canal, we were under the covered area with fans and never noticed any smell, so maybe that's the key to avoiding the problems some other reviewers mentioned.If you're in the Kuah area looking for good food at great prices you shouldn't miss this place.Show less

Author: scottry
Title: VERY GOOD FOOD
Review: This is a very basic restaurant, but the food is exellent and very cheap.

Author: terriandersonQueenstown, New Zealand
Title: Amazing!!
Review: This was our favourite meal of our whole holiday!! The food is so fresh and so so sooooo tasty! Mainly seafood but chicken and vegetable dishes too. We order dishes off the menu and shared them, our waiter did an excellent job of suggesting what we should order and we loved his recommendations. The whole snapper was beautiful as were the prawns (they were the size of my forearm!). The owner was lovely, he had a nice chat to us, he is very switched on! The restaurant was clean and open, with fans. The beer was cheap!!! Very very cheap!! So was the food!!Show less

Author: memoriesinthesand
Title: NOT TO BE MISSED - AMAZING FOOD
Review: The best seafood ive ever had. the prices were unbelievably cheap but the food was anything less than amazing. after we found this hidden gem, we came back every evening of our stay for dinner =]

Author: pokemon_sSingapore
Title: Seafood is not fresh, had food poisoning thereafter
Review: We read the positive comments and decided to give this restaurant a try. Great disappointment! We ordered a lobster, is not expensive but not fresh. We ended up with mild food poisoning that evening. Over-rated eatery. This restaurant is next to a dirty and smelly channel.Show less

Author: pdoebel
Title: Best Value Meal
Review: The atmosphere is very local and the prices are cheap, but the seafood is excellent and local.  This is a must try place!  The staff was very friendly and spoke good English.

Author: Cher-SzeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Affordable and Delicious
Review: When you're at Langkawi, rent a car and start driving around!Our friend who works in Four Seasons recommended us to eat at this restaurant.When we got there at 8-ish, the restaurant was in full motion, tables were full, the staff were busy and the aroma of food was in the air.Seafood is a must order in Langkawi.We ordered..1 Steamed Fish1 Large La La Soup2 Tiger Prawns (huge ones)1 Small fried squid1 Small fried Veg2 Soft Shell Crabs (Fried)2 Bowls of White rice 1 Small Egg Omelette with Onion (which the staff promptly void from our bill coz we said tt it was too salty)and drinks..Total Cost: 170 Rm..It would have been cheaper if we didn't order the tiger prawns..the 2 prawns cost 82RM!imagine how cheap this would be without the prawns.but that's besides the point..the food was really delicious and it was served piping hot to our table.the guy who served our table was really friendly, he actually gave us advise before we left the restaurant..he told us to be real careful when we're driving back to our hotel coz langkawi is 92% malays, 6% chinese and 2% xx? if you knock down the cows while driving back, you'll be in trouble1how nice!overall experience?WONDERFUL in WONDERLAND.Show less

Author: Berkan_76Phuket, Thailand
Title: Best food in Langkawi!
Review: I was in Langkawi for 8 nights, and had dinner at Wonderland for 7 of them! The food is sensational! Whether it be seafood or lamb/beef dishes, you simply can't go wrong. The place is always hectic and always full of locals. The hotel staff at the Westin highly recommended Wonderland, and I can also vouch for it. Ask for Atun, he pretty much runs the show at Wonderland, not only does he provide recommendations from the menu, but he also provides a lot of entertainment. If he likes you, he'll also give you a Wonderland polo shirt as well.Make sure you go when in Langkawi!Show less

Author: JilnickSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rooms for improvement
Review: We stayed at Four Seasons and this place is a good substitute if you don't feeling like driving to Cenang for the multitude of F&B choices. The prices are similar to the Cenang restaurants but the experience was kinda hit & miss. Service is good & friendly, the French onion soup was a definitely hit but the seafood curry is a disappointing miss. Using Dory fish for the curry just didn't cut it for me considering fresh seafood is available in abundance on the island. I'm suspect the Dory fish is the frozen version, likewise with the squid & shrimp. Big let-down. The chicken rendang was passable. Scarborough next to Four Seasons is a better option albeit the menu is somewhat limited.Show less

Author: dmilera2111
Title: Such an amazing place
Review: We were surprised how soft the beef rendang was (definitely must try ) and the chicken butter masala was fantastic, it was a little bit spicy for myself (I'm Russian) but for my husband (Malaysian) he thoroughly enjoyed it very much.Upon requesting for yogurt the waitress even made the effort offering us to make the dishes less spicy.We really appreciate the thought but we opted for just the plain yogurt to be served by itself. Yogurt was amazing on its own!5 ⭐️Show less

Author: dyaz1412Malaysia
Title: Can be better
Review: Read good review online about this place so I decided to try, I love the deco of the restaurant, the cleanliness of the place and the friendly staffs but im just a little disappointed with the food. We ordered set for 2 people which consists of starter, main dish and dessert. Starters were samosa and sping roll (which were nice but too small a portion for 2people, main course were Thai seafood(prawn,squid,fish) and Fish sambal, serves with potato and cauliflower. The portion was okay but only the Thai seafood is good, the fish sambal(i believe is dory fillet?), doesnt quite taste like sambal, and potato/cauliflower didnt quite compliment the other two dishes. That with pineapple juice and mango dessert cost RM165. But I wont skip this place entirely next time. Maybe will come again and try different food.Show less

Author: dbasha
Title: A total letdown !
Review: We went there for lunch recently but there was no paddy field to see from the restaurant! There was only incomplete construction and a wall which completely obscured the view. And the prices were very high. Simply not worth the trouble.

Author: solidtraveler
Title: The best Seafood Butter Masala!
