Review: I love their Seafood Butter Masala. It contains decent amount of prawn, squid and fish fillet. They’re so fresh, so tasty and simply melt in your mouth. Highly recommended. The portion is quite big for 1 pax. I also ordered beef rendang but didn’t quite like it. Its abit salty for me. Though they offer alot more other options that I would love to try. I definitely will come back here next time. The place is very peaceful and the cleanliness is superb.Show less

Author: balirunner88Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: A Step Above
Review: While driving a car on a rice padi trail originally designed for a motorbike isn't for the faint of heart, this trip was well worth the effort. It is clear that Pia is passionate about her food and her husband Jimmy does a great job working the front of house. The beef rendang was soft and tender (unlike some tough and stringy versions I've had here in Malaysia), the butter chicken masala was perfectly seasoned and the homemade kulfi was not cloyingly sweet like many desserts here. Pia's is definitely on our "to go" list for our next visit to Langkawi.Just a note, the rice padi view has been replaced by a concrete wall. Pia and the team have done a great job with the wall turning it into a water feature that helps cool the restaurant during the heat of the afternoon, but if you are counting on enjoying your meal with a view, this is no longer a feature of the restaurant.Show less

Author: gasman62
Title: A cosy, romantic hideout around a padi field
Review: A cosy place within the area of a padi field. The road to reach the place is a little tricky as it is very narrow. The ambiance is fantastic. Food is good. Serves mixed Indian and Malay cuisines. Owner very friendly. It was a wet evening when we paid our visit there. Show less

Author: uniqmover
Title: Still Good as ever!
Review: We headed here for lunch, had the beef rending , lamb jalfrezi and lady fingers masala. All was absolutely tasty! To top it off the customer service is excellent! Waitresses were very attentive and prompt. They do a mix of Thai, Indian and Malay cuisine.

Author: mohdoqbaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food with wonderful view
Review: Literally in the Pedi field, Off the main road narrow access road between the fields took us to this cozy place. It was good idea that we went there for lunch or else would have missed the wonderful view. Local and asian influenced Yummy tasty food. One of the best beef rendang I ever had. While visiting Langkawi this is one of the must eat places.Show less

Author: azrin73Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Good food but a bit expensive
Review: Food Quality : Good. I took the set for four Rm 330.00 Which consists of free flow can drinks or fruit punch. Menu was appetizer samosa, main course chicken butter masaala fish sambal thai seafood beef rendang specially prepared cauliflower and potatoes. For dessert we had mango kufli, chocholate cake and apple strudel. Serving portion was just nice but my personal opinion the overall menu pricing can be improve do feel its a bit over pricedService by the owner : Excellent. Did my reservation thru whatsapp and Jimmy the owner was excellent handling my request keep it upService by the staff : Average. Staff are friendly and courteous but needs more training more tactful when communicating with customers need to be at 4-5 star service level for the price customer is payingAmbience : Good. Nice view of the paddy field, water features, very cozy and comfortable. I was there for lunch i guess it will be more romantic kind of restaurant for dinnerShow less

Author: Aileen C
Title: JIMMY'S BACK - HOORAY
Review: Visited Pia's the Padi for lunch today, 1st time since lock-down and was delighted to see Jimmy & his Family after so long. As always the food was excellent, very good service & hospitality 2nd to none. Very relaxing atmosphere, no rush & can't wait to go back again. Can thoroughly recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: kdks
Title: Excellent once again!
Review: Came back here again after a long lockdown. As usual...never disappointed. Good food, good ambience, good service and of course Jimmy's company.

Author: sarra6661Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff, good food.
Review: Had our dinner last night, staff were friendly and the place is where you wanted to dine and enjoy the environment. Had our golden fried as our starter which is been handmade by the chef, our mains were superb with butter chicken masala and chicken Thai style. The last touch were apple strudel and i was surprised because it is so hard to find in any restaurant it was delicious sweet ending for us. Kudos to everyone ! :)Show less

Author: ProfWPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food
Review: Happened on this place by chance after climbing Gunung Raya. Used to Malay food so ordered the Beef Sambal. Rice was excellent and fluffy and the Beef Sambal was to die for. Made better by the nice view over paddy fields. Had the Mango Kulfi for desset and that was also excellent. After a range of average meals in Langkawi, this place redeemed my thoughts on Langkawi food,Show less

Author: Lizzie SJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food from a friendly family team
Review: My friend and I visited Pia’s the Padi for the first time for dinner and we were blown away with the food, service and setting. The curries were delicious and excellent portions. My ayam sambal was full of flavour and I had plenty of rice and roti to go with it. With the set menu you have the option to have free-flowing drinks (including beer and wine). We decided to just have a couple of beers each.During the meal, we were very well looked after by the waitress. Also, the head chef Pia and her husband Jimmy (both the owners of the restaurant) took it in turns to visit their customers and check on us. They were lovely to talk to. I also really liked the setting. We sat next to a veranda with a mosaic floor of colourful tiles with a padi field beyond. The other side of the restaurant used to have a very good view of the next padi field but because of a construction site being put up, the owners understandably decided to erect a wall next to it which now brings a soothing water feature to the restaurant.We were so impressed that we decided to book a cooking class for two days time. More on that in another review.Show less

Author: Gworb
Title: Great home cooking !
Review: Really enjoyed our dinner here, out in the paddy fields. Homely simple restaurant, plenty of choice, and lovely family running it all. Great beef rendang - lived up to all the rave reviews.

Author: Dantay80Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Not for locals
Review: We picked this place for dinner as we thought of a nice dinner with paddy field sunset view. Sadly there's none as there's a wall separating the restaurant, blocking the view. I think this place are more for tourist and overpriced. Nothing much to comment about the food, not to our liking and no intention in reputation damaging. Show less

Author: kdksShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Never a disappointing time at Pia's The Padi.
Review: We came back again after the MCO and guess what...nothing has changed...it only gets better with Jimmy at the helm and Pia the wonderful chef with their daughters providing amazing service with a smile.Lovely food, lovely ambience and fantastic company. 5 stars as usual. We will be back. Cheers.Show less

Author: anthuh
Title: Good food with beautiful views
Review: The staff were friendly and helpful. Loved the Beef Rendang and Fish Sambal. It was a bit pricey but well worth a visit.

Author: rjsahota
Title: Very bad service
Review: The food was average, nothing to shout about but tbe service was very bad. Overly priced and not worth the visit. Highly not recommended

Author: jenifershibuya74
Title: Best day
Review: Surprised to see full house. Well, it is the festival season. We all enjoyed our meal, it didn't took long, only 20 minutes and I had fresh cooked food on my table. How did Pia's kitchen do it? Thanks for the food and hard work in hot kitchen. Your food is indeed home cooking like my grandma. I miss this kind of cooking. Keep this traditional taste because the NEW GENERATION never had the right food. Good food make from scratch always need time to cook. Thank you Chef Pia!Show less

Author: Siti98
Title: Terrible service terrible food
Review: I went there with friends to eat for lunch and it was terrible. Food was so so, overly priced in a nutshell not the kind of quality we’re expect to get given the price point. There are better place to eat within the island and cheaper also. Staffs were not as friendly as described in Tripadvisor. In conclusion, pls improve.Show less

Author: FarahAzureenA1Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: If you’re hungry , dont come
Review: If you’re hungry , dont come here . Had to wait for 2 hours for the food to arrive and it taste normal . Only the sambal chicken wow me , other than that so so . Spring roll not good , sauce too sweet . Show less

Author: dustyjulian
Title: Fine family food! Fresh ingredients
Review: Fine family food! Fresh ingredients + skill + care = exquisite meal which initially silenced all chit-chat at our table; soon followed by appreciative murmurs. Even the rice tastes good. Beef rendang & prawn sambal to live for. Thank you.

Author: NAIN1N
Title: BEST LOCAL CUISINE IN LANGKAWI
Review: The restaurant strategically in paddy field. The view is really calm and great. The price are quite reasonable with the great portion that you get in the main dish. The staff are super super friendly, even the chef are super nice, when she came out from the kitchen and started to talk with us. The vibe are suitable for people who want to eat local food with great view.Show less

Author: AdamW4187
Title: Amazing views and delicious food with very large menu and choice!
Review: We had a fantastic meal in March where we were treated to many delights! The Fish curry and Beef Randang are particular highlights. Pia and Jimmy are incredible accommodating and create a really lovely atmosphere to dine in! The cooking is exceptional! We even managed to get a takeaway during the lockdown! I would highly recommend visiting for dinner!Show less

Author: CheryanLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Very disappointing
Review: We were send to this place by a friend of ours who had lived previously in Langkawi. So we decided to give it a try and went on a Saturday evening only 1 other guest was there. So we were seated gotten the menu and were served a salad with sambal. In the sambal I found a hair so I told the waitress. She removed the dish and said she would bring a new dish which I had told her that I didn't wanted another one. But still she brought it out. I didn't touch it anymore. In the meantime they had taken our order.We had for starters samosas & spring rolls and we also had ordered 1 portion of pakora. The samosas were not real samosas since they were made with the same rice paper for the spring rolls and samosas are made with much different dough. The pakora also didn't have a lot of flavour. I was already getting a little nervous about our main dishes we ordered what they would look like and taste like.I had ordered the prawns in sambal with rice and my husband had the yellow prawn curry which taste awful he asked me to try a little I couldn't even swallow it the taste was so bad. My prawn sambal was ok but not to wow about. We finished our drinks asked the bill paid and left not to return. Show less

Author: Deen_69
Title: Best home cook meal when traveling
Review: We went over for family lunch. Tried the set meal for 10 pax. Very nice indeed. Excellent ambiance, cosy right in the middle of paddy field. The best dishes were seafood sambal and beef rendang. Thumbs up Pia! Well done.

Author: DornehlPorto, Portugal
Title: Best Beef Rendang every
Review: Better beef rendang you won’t find anywhere else - I can promise you that! They are open from 12 - 3pm and again from 6 - 10pm. Well worth the trip. You will not be sorry. Highly recommend the set lunch. It easily feeds 3 people.Show less

Author: rohana_rashid
Title: Pia....the best food n service
Review: Always the best place to eat lunch n dinner. Just love the  food n the people here. The chef, Pia is very nice n very accomodating.

Author: avsikkink
Title: A great cooking lesson and great food!
Review: We came for a cooking lesson with Pia and had a really wonderful experience - we came away brimming with ideas for new foods to try at home. Warm but clear instruction by Pia and a lovely chat around making and eating the food - great hosting also from her lovely family/team. For a private lesson for multiple dishes plus drinks and pudding it was super reasonably priced in my opinion and turned into a highlight of our two week holiday in Malaysia! We can't wait to give everything a go on our own - big thanks to all!Show less

Author: phoenixbiKlang, Malaysia
Title: Good Desserts !
Review: I read all the good reviews however I already had my lunch during at the Mangrove trip but I told myself not to miss this restaurant so i decided to go and have desserts . We ordered 2 desserts and coffee , they are so good ! Please make sure you set a day for dinner or lunch .Show less

Author: MrsBr1ghtsideМосква, Россия
Title: Nice place with perfect view
Review: We knew about this restaurant from recommendations of our host Mimi’s Pine Meadow which the nearest guest house to this place. Food is amazing, very friendly guys working there. Perfect place for a dinner. Works from 12 to 3 pm and from 6 to 9 pm. Chiefs menu definitely recommended. Many thanks to owners for the hospitality and delicious interesting food. Show less

Author: grisa300
Title: Amazing experience!
Review: Ate here twice, first night restaurant was empty besise us but the food was delicious! Beef rendang was probably best food we had ever eat! Next day we did came here for cooking class, wich was super fun. We did make 7 different foods and eat them all! Same evening we went to dinner again and hole restaurant was full. Recommend you to book a table for here and taste the beef rendang!! Owners are super nice people and the chef Pia is really lovely person. In my opinion portions are really good and you dont have to leave here as hungry. Prices are a bit higher, but totally worth it!Show less

Author: Farida PMinneapolis, Minnesota
Title: Good stop
Review: Reviewing restaurants in Malaysia is hard because people come from all parts of the world and have different expectations. I’m a U.S person who have travelled most of Asia and lived in Indonesia and China for many many years, and these are my expectations. We stopped here on the way to our Airbnb. Not Cheap for Malaysian standard. Definitely not a place where locals would come to eat. But We liked the food. We had the garlic bread first. They’re very buttery goodness!! We had the spring roll, meh... just ok. next time we would try the samosa instead. We had chocolate and mango milkshakes. Both were serviceable. obviously, we’re not at a malt shop, so, take that with a grain of salt. For main course we had butter chicken and sambal prawns. The sambal prawns is not on the menu. They made it for us upon request, and both were tasty but the sambal prawn was our favorite. The meals came with a big pot of white rice. I had Indian masala tea for the 1st time ever, so I can’t make recommendations because I have nothing to compare it with, but basically, it’s black tea with milk and added some spices, though I didn’t taste much spice to the drink, I liked it, would order again. Note that the portions are not big at all. The 3 of us (2 adults and 1 kid) didn’t leave feeling very full but also not hungry. For 3 adults, though, you’d need 1 more entré. All that... a little over RM 200 = +\- $50. Like I said, not cheap, but nothing was disappointing us. Show less

Author: barbs259Segovia, Spain
Title: Gorgeous sunset, delicious food, sweet people
Review: We loved Pia’s! Come for the food — Indian is the speciality but there is an amazing variety — and enjoy the sun setting over the rice padis. We especially enjoyed the roti, fresh pineapple and lime juice, fish sambal, beef rendang and mango kulfi. The waiters were very nice and made good recommendations. All in all, we had an evening of great happiness. Show less

Author: 497bj_rnh
Title: beef rendang it is
Review: The beef rendang just blew our mind! This is what rendang needs to taste like. Located in the beautiful padi fields, directly next to the entrance of Gunung Raya, this is where you get your awesome food fix from

Author: randy1186
Title: I decided to try this place
Review: I decided to try this place because of the good reviews, and I was not disappointed. The food was incredible, and the setting sublime. Pia herself came out after I finish my meal and talked with me for quite a while. She is a lovely person and an amazing cook! If you are staying in Langkawi, you must eat here, you will remember the experience for a long time. Show less

Author: Leanne S
Title: Excellent
Review: My partner and I decided to eat here for lunch. Wow, what an amazing experience. This family owned business was awesome. The food was so authentic and tasty. Pia the chef came out and spoke to us and her gorgeous daughters were our waitresses. They gave us recommendations on what was good and we went with them and we were so happy we did. The dishes are a very generous size too.This place is a must if you come to Langkawi. The scenery is beautiful also.Show less

Author: 375EmA
Title: Amazing!!
Review:
Such friendly staff and lovely atmosphere, but most importantly, sensational food. A lot of care goes into preparing fresh and authentic dishes.  
Easily some of the best food in Langkawi! Definitely worth a visit.

Author: MahnazNW
Title: Wonderful staff, fabulous owner, incredible food and a beautiful space to enjoy food!
Review: Highly recommend this amazing restaurant if you visit langkawi. Authentic food by an authentic chef in a homely setting. You won’t be disappointed!

Author: DennisTan2018
Title: over priced food
Review: While the beef rendang is nice, its not worth the price. Don't order the fish especially, which in my opinion, is probably vietnamese catfish.

Author: Lindsey8413Knutsford, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful warm family and incredible tasting food!
Review: We ate at this restaurant a few days ago and had such a delicious meal, we very quickly booked a cooking class. Jimmy, Pia and their daughters are lovely and friendly, and make a real effort to talk to all their guests. They take great pride in the food that they cook and are always focused on flavours the guests will enjoy. The setting is lovely looking over the rice fields and we had a very relaxing evening! Try the chicken butter masala and beef rendang and you won’t regret it- literally divine!!! We learnt how to cook a good variety of dishes today and they were happy to tailor to what our likes were (I.e. my husband isn’t a big fan of fish), and we had a great laugh too!! Thanks so much for a wonderful experience and hope to see you all again in the future!Show less

Author: Lorrae NBangkok, Krung Thep, Thailand
Title: Amazing food best in langkawi and lovely staff!
Review: Myself and my partner, keen foodies from New Zealand love dining out back home and on our holidays! After a few days in langkawi and being somewhat disappointed by our food so far we came across pia’s on trip advisor. Just a cheap grab ride away from our resort in Pantai Tengah (18rm) so although it is a little further out the ride wasn’t exactly penny pinching. We ordered the butter masala, samosa, beef rendang, chicken curry and the roti! All of which were delicious, the beef rendang I must say the best we have ever tasted! The staff were attentive, friendly and the chef and owner even took the time to have a chat with us and ensure we enjoyed our meal! I would highly recommend this place! Oh and the view.... unbelievable- peaceful and relaxing away from the hustle and bustle of Cenang! That good we may even come back tomorrow :-).Show less

Author: melaniecT2011XH
Title: Good Food
Review:
Enjoyed the butter chicken.  
Home cooked food kind of feel.  
Ambience is nice. Great sunset view surrounded by padi fields.

Author: juliyana09
Title: Best food ever.
Review: Beef rendang, butter masala is marvellous! They have western food too. It is very delicious that you may keep coming back for more. Chef is very friendly. There’s cooking class. Venue has the nice view of paddy field.

Author: JmyJohan
Title: Authentic and tender beef rendang is must try!
Review: Enjoying lunch; especially beef rendang which is not that spicy but it has enough spices and fragrance. Can eat the beef rendang on its own or with rice, surrounded by padi fields

Author: mohamadsaufib
Title: Good food
Review:
Food was good,....
Ambience nice,...
Place was surrounded by padi fields which was great,....
Felt so calm,...
Staff friendly,....

Author: Nsulor
Title: Lunch at Pia's The Padi
Review: Traditional malaysian dish and western spread. Clean n beautiful restaurant settings. Chef very knowledgeable and willing to share tips of good malaysia dish cooking.  We love the beef rendang, dory fish sambal, mixed vegetables and hot sambal belacan!

Author: Birdy123_0Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Go for the set menu
Review: After good recommendations we made it to Pia for dinner. Go for the set menu with choices of delicious meals and free flowing drinks. After the meal Pia came to the table, a very personal touch. Great food, we even went back there for lunch. It's not cheap but well worth it. EnjoyShow less

Author: R LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the price
Review: We thought to drop in as we were near and it had a good review, but were disappointed.For the price charged, which seems to indicate something upmarket, you get frozen seafood, nothing the name Sea Treasures on the menu would indicate. They should call it frozen farmed seafood with fries.The best thing about the fried squid, fish and prawn dish? It's the fries that come with it. Don't order this dish! Show less

Author: richchc
Title: Cooking school and dinner the following night.
Review: One amazing cooking school by Pia and her daughter Sarah. They made it fun and informative. The dinner the night after was sublime beautiful food and a great atmosphere with awesome service.

Author: 7shasha7Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food with a Fantastic View
Review: Went there without a booking on a weekday at 6pm and luckily for us we had no problem getting a table. There is a wide variety of food - from Malay to Indian and Western fare. The Chef really can cook. We took the set meal for 4 pax: rice, omelette, mixed veggie, beef rendang and sambal fish (which we substituted with a squid sambal). We added on steamed fish. This was certainly way above average Malay home cooked meal. The beef rendang was superb! In fact, we wanted more but because there was already a lot of other dishes, we couldn’t order another bowl. Highly recommend just polishing A LOT of rendang with plain white rice. The meat was tender and very very flavourful. It’s not spicy at all. The staff is very friendly and since we went on a Tuesday evening early, we had time to chat with the friendly Chef. They have cooking classes in the morning so definitely a great place to come and learn Malay cooking (I’m Malay but can’t cook many Malay dishes!) My 10 year old son wants to compliment the beef rendang (he polished half the bowl) Show less

Author: Frankehv4Eindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Perfect rendang
Review: The food is super tasty. Best beef rendang and chicken masala we had in Malaysia! Mango ice cream as desert is also superb.It’s not on the tourist hotspots, but really worth the extra detour. And you get a great view of the rice fields (padi).The restaurant is family run, with lots of Malaysian hospitality! We had a lovely and long chat with the family after our dinner. They really go the extra mile to make you feel welcome!! Definitely a place I would go back to in a heartbeat.They do cooking classes in the morning. We don’t have time to participate, but after our dinner we did get some recipes and quite some tips and tricks. So I can only imagine that their cooking classes are on the same high level as their restaurant is.Show less

Author: wesmith2017
Title: An excellent meal
Review: Pia‘s the Padi  is a fine restaurant serving authentic local cuisine. It is a friendly family-run establishment: the service is first rate and the food the best we have experienced in Malaysia so far. The beef rendang, in particular, was historic.

Author: mimi1065
Title: Delicious Food...
Review: Had a fantastic meal here the other night in such a lovely setting. Though we didn’t get to meet the infamous Pia, we were greeted by her lovely daughter & husband Jimmy who was very entertaining. Seriously though, the food all freshly cooked in a really quaint restaurant over looking rice fields. Highly recommend this restaurant if you want something different than what is offered in Cenang Beach.Show less

Author: rmelogouveiaCoimbra, Portugal
Title: Kitchen class , THE BEST!!!!
Review: This is a house of very nice people , with a lovely family.Me and my wife went there for a kitchen class , Pia did the honor and tough a lot of plates.We advice the 3h food class , because you could learn more things and they don’t have to be in a hurry.The best thing we did.Thank you so much for the lovely time!We miss you and your plates already!Rodrigo e PaulaShow less

Author: sean11_leeNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Romantic ambience with great food
Review: Lovely experience. You will need to drive to get here as it's a bit further away from central tourist spots like Pantai Cenang or Kuah (15-20 minutes by car) but it's absolutely worth the trip. Food and service was excellent including classic Malaysian and Indian dishes with a European twist for some of them. Enjoyed the romantic ambience.Show less

Author: L3637KQbenj
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: We were so lucky to find Pia’s during our visit to Langkawi. The curries were the best we’ve ever had! We enjoyed it so much that we came back a second time. It is a family run restaurant in a very scenic setting in the rice fields. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: but-first-we-eat
Title: Amazing find and local experience
Review: Discovered this gem and so happy we visited, the food was amazing accompanied by the friendly helpful staff and setting. All the dishes are authentic and hearty, the owners are a delight explaining to us all the dishes. Pia also offered cooking classes, which I wish we knew prior to the trip as I would have loved to do one. She offered us to take photos of the recipes and talked us through how to make them - most of which we ate for dinner. A must to try when visiting!Show less

Author: splim123
Title: Nice Rendang
Review: We ordered set dinner. The beef rendang was excellent. Dory fish sambal was also quite good. Omelette average. Stir fried mixed vegetables, too many types of vegetables. Price a bit on the high side but worth it for the beef rendang. Service is commendable. Getting into the the place can initially be a nightmare but it wasn't too back on hindsight. Getting out is much easier.Show less

Author: apassionfortravel1Perth, Australia
Title: Fab Cooking Class
Review: We booked in a cooking class here. Jimmy was wonderful to deal with the whole time. We had our class with Pia who was amazing and a talented chef. We feel very lucky to have the chance to cook with such an amazing lady. This is an experience not to miss. We both cant wait to get home to cook these meals. This is an amazing family run restaurant.Show less

Author: NgaiMun
Title: good local food
Review: i would recommended this place for great authentic local food surrounded with lot of green scenery& friendly staffs

Author: shimamahyonJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Fine dining at Pia
Review: Im just back from Langkawi with fond memories from the taste at Pia.My hubby and i having most memorable dinner at Pia.The most unforgetable is the beef rendang and the mango kulfi.This hidden gem that i surely look for when i visit langkawi again.Show less

Author: louisandrea_yee
Title: The most authentic Malaysian Cuisine
Review: I found the class very fun and informative! I loved learning about the rendang paste and the techniques Pia taught us. It made it easy to know I can do it from home. It was definitely worth the money! It was wonderful to take so much away from it!Show less

Author: kawaidessaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Pia The PaDi-elicious
Review: Drawn by the reviews from previous patrons, we decided to see it (and eat it) to believe it. Guided by Waze, we found the restaurant in the suburbs of Jalan Ulu Melaka, Langkawi. The restaurant set up was cozy and intimate with a picturesque background of the padi fields. We started with vegetables pakora for starters.Pakora was fresh and crisp with aromatic spices. Deliciously spicy sambal belacan and salad was complimentary of the house. We ordered the dinner set menu with no regrets. A must have would be the very succulent and flavourful beef rendang which was the house special. Butter chicken massala, fish sambal and even the seemingly simple omelette takes your memory palate back to the warmth of home cooking. We finished off with mango kulfi for dessert which was definitely worth the calories. We were privileged to meet with Chef Pia, her husband Jimmy and her beautiful family. Overwhelmed by her love and passion for her cooking, writing this review is the very least we could do to show our gratitude for such memorable dining experience. Will definitely return!Show less

Author: Noohri
Title: Recommended!
Review: I was so satisfied with the food especially beef rendang! The service was excellent and the staffs and chef were friendly.. Definitely gonna come back soon and gonna recommend it to my connection! Love it! Keep it up!

Author: Sarah_Shafari
Title: Bad service and rude staff
Review: Very bad service, overrated and overpriced for a place placed in the outskirts of Langkawi. I was shouted by the owner for giving a feedback about the rude staff.  Don’t open a restaurant if you can’t accept constructive criticism especially from the customer.

Author: Grace PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Food and Delicious
Review: The restaurant food is delicious, we do our lunch and order Chicken Rendang serve with white rice for 2 sharing and spring roll and dessert for coconut ice cream.But the dish per plate is abit pricey, but the cooking is very tasty for not spicy level. The place at Ulu Melaka, a bit far from Pantai Cenang area.Show less

Author: Haimin25Singapore, Singapore
Title: Tummy Yummy
Review: Went to Pia's the padi the day before yesterday (21 aug 2019) for lunch. It has quite a spread. Due to lots of positive review, we headed there plus it was very near to our stay.Had a set meal of 4 person and spaghetti bolognese for the children plus additional mutton curry. Set meal consist of chicken rendang, fish sambal, vegetables (chop choy) and salad with rice and dessert (mango something).Honestly, all of the dishes are delicious and amazing. The taste of all the dishes were just nice and not overwhelming at all. U can taste all of the ingredients compliments each other. It was outstanding. I did not like dory fish but i ate till its gone. It was even a surprise to me. My son who IS a PICKY EATER ate the spaghetti bolognese like its his favourite! The sauce is home made and the sambal belacan OMG!..Not forgetting the ouh so humble, sweet and warm Chef Pia checking on us and the food we had. She also shared about her experience and principles of being a chef. I can taste her sincerity and love in her food. It is all about the experience and appreciating the food on the plate. Love it! Ouh! It feels like 5 star fine dining with the desert. I got home happy, ecstatic and joyuos feeling in my tummy. My son whom never hugged anyone, hugged the chef out of appreciation.It really feels like home... Thank you, Chef Pia! ❤️Show less

Author: GrandTour259659Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Amazing food and even better people who run the place!
Review: We wanted to try authentic Malay/Indian food and so found this place on trip advisor which had pretty good reviews.The restaurant itself is literally a hidden gem, the road turning into the restaurant is so small and is very difficult to spot in the night, we drove past it twice before eventually making the right turning..take care if driving in the dark the road is tiny with ditches on either side, we made it in 1 piece phew!The staff were so friendly and welcoming, upon arrival we were offered water and drinks which was lovely. The menu was explained well and our order was taken without delay.We had the beef rendang which was delicious, the meat was so succulent and the flavours were huge. We also had the butter chicken which was gorgeous, very creamy and rich in flavour, we had another veg dish which I can't remember the name of but again tasted amazing.We were a family of 4, 2 adults 2 kids and the set menu was enough for all of us, the drinks were free flowing. I would recommend trying the pineapple and lime cocktail it was so refreshing.We loved this hidden gem and were so glad we didn't give up on trying to find it. The owner was a lovely gentleman who was so lovely and attentive to us. He even gave the kids a gift and me lots of blessings, a really touching gesture as guests in Malaysia. Show less

Author: Roundeye78
Title: Fantastic Indian/western lunch in Langkawi
Review:
Fantastic lunch, really over the top!!😃
We would highly recommend this restaurant which is in the middle of Langkawi’s rice paddies.

Author: thekyd
Title: Amazing food
Review: Amazing delicious food well worth the drive. Get the set menu and prepare to get into a food coma. Butter chicken and beef randang are go tos

Author: Krupali D
Title: ***** food
Review: Jus go n try urself...a lady lyk ur mom/grand mom is waiting n cookin fr u wid al heart...her daughter n husband bth are kind hearted person...its run by dis small fmly who serves wid all der heart...gud location too n vry peaceful...dey dnt chase money...langkawi trip is incomplete widout goin here...***** fud at reasonable price...to da whole fmly "be hapi n blessed"...thank u fr servin us. Show less

Author: SitiHamim
Title: Good food, calm ambience and good conversation with Mr Jimmy
Review: The food recommended was good and delicious. I enjoyed my dinner with the sunset view. The mango lassi was just nice and the best part of my dining experience is having a good conversation with the owner, Mr Jimmy.I will definitely come back for the food. Thank you and it was worth the wait and the penny of course.Show less

Author: RichardBanjoHong Kong, China
Title: Homely comforts
Review: We visited after tiring morning of island hopping and mangrove inspecting. The restaurant is clearly family run and not at all glitzy but the food, prepared with care and love by Pia was tremendous. Jimmy (her husband) was a fun host - butter fish ( sea bass）and the mango lassis really hit the spot. We are looking forward to returning!Show less

Author: huifang1234567890
Title: the restaurant is really warm-hearted, meticulous, pay attention to the details
Review: I would really give this restaurant five stars. It is the best restaurant that I have gone in Langkawi, or probably the best restaurant that I have been to in my life. The ambience is really very good. It has a very romantic atmosphere. The boss and the workers in the restaurant are really very dedicated, really care about the customers. For example, we mentioned to one of the workers in the restaurant that there are mosquitoes near outside, and we requested to change seats, and after that, the worker bring a mosquito coil for us and put under the table. Overall, the ambience, lighting, music is nice, comfortable. Excellent ambience for dinner. The food is extremely nice too. We ordered chicken in mushroom sauce and 2 bowls of mushroom soup. The chicken is very good. For someone who doesn't like chicken breast, I actually think their chicken breast is quite good. As for the mushroom soup, the bread which came with it is very nice too. You can really see the effort, care and dedication that the cook put in- the bread is toasted just nice- brown but it is not charred. It is crispy, just nice. The effort and thought while making the food I could really appreciate it. Overall, I really like this place for its true sincerity.Show less

Author: FirstLast1234Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: My must go place in Langkawi
Review: I have been visiting Jimmy every single time i visit Langkawi and this is probably my 7th visit. This time around I brought along another family so there were 9 of us.As usual, we leave it to Jimmy to prepare our lunch. And as usual, I'm not disappointed as the beef rendang (my favorite dish at this restaurant) and the sambal fish is simply fantastic!! The kids loved the butter chicken too.It was certainly a good place to send an afternoon with good food and good company. Thank you Jimmy for the wonderful meal and I will certainly be back in my next trip to Langkawi.Show less

Author: Prabz0507Jakarta
Title: Good food, unpleasant experience
Review: I believe credit must be given when due..food is unquestionably good, (though a bit pricy for local standards)Nevertheless, it was spoilt by an unpleasant experience. Our family of 8 drove a long way to have lunch here. We were on holiday and just chit chatting and laughing, when a waitress called us out from across the counter, scolding us for being loud, because there was a baby sleeping many tables away, we didn't even see. . It was very unprofessional! When we reported it to the owner, he was more concerned about containing and closing the subject, after a quick cynical apology. You don’t service your customers by embarrassing them, fortunately for us, only 2 tables were occupied. If we were foreigners or whites, I’m certain we would not have been treated this way. All said and done, the starters were good !! Show less

Author: kcsiow
Title: Must go place in Langkawi
Review:
Small airy place, tucked in a corner. Nice ambience with delicious food. Best beef rendang I ever tried & many other more. Prices reasonable, I got to say, "Bravo"
Must go, if you are in Langkawi. 
Thank you

Author: SerhatSozen92Rotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Good food but bit expensive!
Review: We visit this place based on a foodblogvideo and the reccommendations of tripadvisor. We took the chicken butter and sambal fish, it was the best choice! The food was really incredible, super tender, warm, fresh and created with love. But unfortunately i found the prices not really proprotional. The chicken dishes are charged at the same prices as the fish and the lamb for example. Furthermore the setting of the restaurant is not extraordinary compared to the highend restaurants and currently there is a development ongoing in the area. And at least but not last there are many foodstalls in Langkawi were you can get the same taste for at least half of the price. Show less

Author: andreaR3712BN
Title: Amazing food
Review:
What a great place. Very friendly and welcoming service. We had the redang beef and butter chicken and it was absolutely delicious.
You will not regret a visit.

Author: jenifershibuya74
Title: Returned and wasn't disappointed.
Review: We returned again to Pia's the Padi and were not disappointed. Food cooked to perfection, need I say more.

Author: StephLungSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must visit in Langkawi
Review: It’s our 4th day in Langkawi and this is the best meal we have had; in a very well decorated space.Menu is a pretty extensive, from Indian toMalay and Western. After a couple of Malayand Chinese meals, hubby and I opted for Indian tonight.My girls 10 and 11.5 years ordered some garlic bread and the kids pasta bolognese and napolitana. They both think it’s the best pasta they have ever had. The sauce was rich, well stewed over time, and very tasty.Hubby and I had Chicken Korma, Lamb Mushroom Masala, and Vegetables Butter Masala.Lamb was so tender and the fresh julienned ginger adds a nice refreshing finish to the dish. Chicken was cooked in an aromatic coconut curry, well spiced and creamy. The veggies curry was tastefully done though we wished for more veggies than potatoes. Overall all dish was on point in terms of flavour and execution, and service was excellent. Portions sizes are generous, we couldn’t finish our curries and they gladly packed it for our takeaways. Prices are on the higher side, but they made up with the quality of food, setting and service. Would return again and urge you to try too.We also met the very friendly Jimmy and her wife Pia, who cooked these amazing food. Pia is gregarious and warm, cooked to please!! So happy we ate her tonight! Bellies full and satisfied!Our bill came up to RM220 including 2Strawberry shakes, 1 mango lassi and 10% service charge.Show less

Author: ajpforeverSydney, Australia
Title: Pia's Food Excellent, Jimmy Off-Putting
Review: The food was delicious and could not be faulted. The meal was cooked by Pia. However, Jimmy the owner, ruined the experience for us. He claims he is a hotelier responsible for 27 hotels, and prided himself on his service. However, he could not leave us in peace to enjoy our meal, and kept telling stories about himself and how great he thought he was. He was rude and sexist, and appeared drunk. Not only did he insult one of the guests at our table, but he was rude to his staff also.Show less

Author: JTS_HKSAR
Title: Great Meal!
Review: Had an excellent time at Pia’s. Great view, great ambiance and most importantly great food. Jimmy is a very warm and hospitable host.

Author: shuicai301Geelong, Australia
Title: Fantastic lunch
Review: Welcoming and friendly staff, lots of choices on the menu. Food cooked from the heart. A Family member required a gluten free selection , there were plenty of choices available and staff were super knowledgeable. I wish we lived in Langkawi so we could visit here often. Show less

Author: DenandALondon, United Kingdom
Title: BACK AT PIA'S THE PADI ONCE AGAIN
Review: Until a couple of weeks ago it has been l year since we last visited Pia's the Padi and its even better. We returned for dinner and then returned again for lunch and each visit was out-of-this-world; the atmosphere is so relaxing you feel quite at home. The service was lst class and the food we had on both occasions was sooooooo good. For dinner we took a friend and it was his first visit, he was so impressed he's planning on taking his wife for dinner. Jimmy is always on top form and his lovely Wife is charming. Jimmy is always willing to guide you through the menu if in doubt. Can't wait to make a return visit, Pia's the Padi is an absolute dream.Show less

Author: HillB79Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great little stopover for lunch
Review: The restaurant is off a main road amongst Malaysian homes and next to a massive field (there were not rice padi's as it was dry season). It was peaceful and a nice breeze on the day we visited which added to the atmosphere. We had beef rendang and sambal fish. It was delicious! Both proteins were cooked to perfection. The fish was the highlight for us, melt in your mouth John Dory fillets. Curries were served with rice and a little salad.Show less

Author: alicemiller2016Hong Kong, China
Title: Proper Malaysian Food!
Review: We were recommended Pia's the Padi for it's infamous Beef Rendang, and it didn't disappoint! The owner Jimmy is a real character and was very warm and welcoming on arrival. We went for dinner and ordered a Beef Renand and Prawn Sambal - the food is all cooked fresh and all the pastes are made in house by the team. Overlooking a peaceful padi, the restaurant is very relaxing and has a lovely ambience. There are also a selection of western dishes available too. The food was so good we ended up going back 24 hours later! Pricing was around 130 MYR for 2 including drinks. Cannot recommend enough - we will definitely be back one day!Show less

Author: LizzyReviewsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Private Event - Thank you Jimmy and Team!!
Review: After visiting this restaurant on a few occasions, we decided to hold our Pre- Wedding Dinner here! We are a British couple living in Singapore so had 50 guests from around the world. Jimmy (owner) pulled out all the stops! From printing a congratulations banner, to arranging flower decorations on the table, to arranging my sisters birthday cake - nothing was too much for him.For the food, we had a buffet style so our guests could sample a range of local delights. EVERYONE loved the food! Home cooked and delicious! We would highly recommend this place to people in the future.Show less

Author: oceanlodgelangkawiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: FANTASTIC DINNER !
Review: When you are in Langkawi .And you want try special , FANTASTIC Dishes . It's a must to go to the Pias Padis Restaurant !One of the Reason is Jimmys FANTASTIC Food ! Another Reason is the FANTASTIC Location of Pias Padis Restaurant .Middle of the Rice Fields , FANTASTIC Sunset !We can really high recommend this Restaurant . Pias the Padi !See you again!Show less

Author: Shahscapades
Title: Rename it to Pia's the 'Bad'i !! Horrible Horrible !!
Review: Horrible place ! The owner is extremely egoistic and rude ! Served us the Roti canai with the appetizers rather than the main course. When asked the servers, they would'nt understand and said that it is supposed to be served with the appetizers. The owner 'Jimmy' who was sitting right there when this happened agreed that there has been a mistake.Please note that the Roti Canai was not consumed by us and he suggested that we do a take away to which we gently rejected as it was extremely hard. He said the servers do not understand very good English and that you have to pay for it.The point was not paying for the dish but just the general attitude of the owner. Do not waste your time here. Many better places in Langkawi to eat rather than this.Beware of the owner Jimmy, he is more interested in the money than the customers !The place is extremely expensive !Puts Malaysian Hospitality to shame !!Show less

Author: Indira U
Title: The wonderful time in Pia's the Padi
Review: We highly recommend you to go to this restaurant, the beef rendang is the best you can find anywhere in Langkawi island and any other dish is also top class! All of that is at very reasonable prices! Go and enjoy the best Malaysian and Indian/ western cuisine at Pia's the Padi restaurant! We really enjoyed our time in this lovely place! Show less

Author: S_hrei
Title: Nice food but little ambience
Review: The food was good, though seafood I suspect was frozen rather than fresh. It’s a shame the menu is way too big, would be much better to stick to Malaysian cuisine. The fence did spoil the view of the sunset and the decor was more of a cafe than a restaurant. The evening came to an end when unfortunately the restaurant was inundated with a swarm of beetles flying in as soon as the lights came on. Not sure if this happens regularly but insect screens are a must if it does.Show less

Author: KimmyM354Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Meal !! Thank you Jimmy & Team
Review: Our last meal in Langkawi & it’s also the best one !! I’ve read so many positive review about place but didn’t get to see its menu online , when we were there on Monday night we were the only 8 people in the restaurant. Jimmy the owner greeted us personally & suggested us to take the set for 2 person @ 165 ringgit , so we had x 3 set of that , mix & match the order, I don’t eat beef so ordered the lamb curry which was served hot , the meat was so tender & it came with so soft potatoes just the way I enjoy it . It totally reminded me about my mums cooking . The steam rice here is special. We were told It’s cooked the day before & it’s steam before serving so it’s really fluffy. We were all so pleased with the meal here & service was so good .its definitely worth a visit if you are in Langkawi. Show less

Author: BigDave23109Whitstable, United Kingdom
Title: Better late than never!!!
Review: It was actually May 2015 that we visited, and I wanted this to be the first place I wrote about as I’d always said I would, and never got round to it. This place was amazing. Found it through trip advisor and thought we’d try it as it just seemed so different to all the beach front restaurants. And it is. The views and scenery is fantastic and if you can, time your visit with sun set, you’ll get the most glorious views out over the fields. The food was equally great and plentiful. I can’t remember exactly what we ate but do recall that the meal was fantastic. All while chatting to the owner, Jimmy, who was welcoming and friendly. Could not recommend this place enough. Show less

Author: MilosK309Singapore, Singapore
Title: What a wonderful little family restaurant
Review: We went to Pia’s after reading online reviews hoping to have some decent local food. We got something much better than that. This place was the best food we had on the island!It was Monday evening so the place was very quiet. In fact, we were the only ones in the entire restaurant. Jimmy, the owner, immediately greeted us and explained everything we needed to know about his place. He even throw in free flow of beer if we ordered the set menu which was a great gesture. The main chef in the restaurant is Jimmy’s wife who we also met. She explained how she made some of the dishes and the entire menu is pretty much entirely home made food creation by Jimmy’s wifeWhat not to miss: beef rendang, chicken butter masala, fish curry. In fact, just order the set dinner as they will put their favourite and best foods on the set menu and you will eat the best food you can get.Absolute 5*, will go back again any time I visit LangkawiShow less

Author: Andy17
Title: OK, but Very overpriced
Review:
Way overpriced, in just 2 words.
Food was good, portions were big, service was ok.
But for a little restaurant in the middle of nowhere, with no wifi, it was way too expensive, even by Langkawi standards.

Author: Thomas N
Title: Don’t Miss Pia’s
Review: A trip to Langkawi isn’t complete without a meal at Pia’s in the Padilla. Enter to hear Beethoven or other soft piano music and partake of some of the best Malaysian, Thai, or Indian dishes you can buy. The owner/cook, Jimmy, comes out to greet guests and ensure you’re happy with the food. If you like a bit spicy, the beef (and chicken) rendang is outstanding. And is dessert is to die for.Show less

Author: HertsOldie
Title: Great Japanese Cusine
Review:
Authentic Japanese cuisine. I had the cold soba noodles, dipping sauce and tempura grilled snapper followed by macha ice-cream. My wife had the bento box followed  by redbean ice-cream.

Fabulous food  the high point was the smoked ell in the bento box.

Author: LingElegant
Title: A piece of Japan in Langkawi
Review: The Japanese chef and his team serves delicious food - the sashimi included fish from the local waters, the atmosphere is casual and warm. Totally would return there on my next Langkawi trip.

Author: EmilioRR9669
Title: Great food
Review: Authentic Japanese food. Love the ambience and the setting. Its a bit pricey but OK. Would love to be back.

Author: Der_Macher68Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best restaurants on the island
Review: Honestly, I don't understand how somebody can leave a review saying this place is terrible or not good. This is for me the best restaurant in the island and probably among the top in Malaysia.Service is just great, food is amazing, everything tastes fresh and, when cooked, is just done perfectly. Price is reasonable, when you consider to eat fresh fish, sashimi or premium beef, it cannot be cheap, quality cost money.I have been here 4 times during my staying, trying to taste as many dishes as I could and, I will come back again, once visiting the island. I strongly recommend the place, for couples, friends, to celebrate something or just to enjoy top Japanese food.It is advisable to book, a good restaurant has always lots of customers.Show less

Author: jinnjinnip
Title: Hmmm. To be honest below average.
Review:
Hmmm. To be honest below average. 
Doesn’t tastes good and it pricey. 
Not worth it all. Not recommended to dine here. I’m very disappointed.

Author: 732richardBatam, Indonesia
Title: We became regulars at Unkaizan!
Review: We were stuck in Langkawi for three months during lockdown, Unkaizan was close to where we were staying and they did some great take-aways! We became regulars - at least twice a week! We really enjoyed their food immensely and the prices were good too. When some relaxation to the lockdown came, we ate at the restaurant itself and that was wonderful too. Great food and lovely staff to look after you! We miss Nita!Show less

Author: Laipengchin
Title: Good food as usual.
Review: Again another of our favourite place for foods. It never let us down. Especially the grilled salmon and california rolls spicy with own grown black chillies. Love it here will always come back.

Author: Meg P
Title: AMAZING
Review: I love this restaurant. It's one of my favourites on the island. It is a very small restaurant so you should really call and make a reservation. The food is fresh and fantastic. The staff are extremely helpful and the service was excellent. I've been a few times now and every time it's magical.Show less

Author: Blanca R
Title: Amazing!!
Review: We went there for dinner after a week of exploring street markets and going to Cenang and Telaga Harbour Marina in search of local food (no local food in Telaga Harbour Marina whatsoever btw), and we wish we had done it earlier.The quality of the food is amazing, they serve the sushi quite warm (THANK YOU! Sushi is not served fridge-cold!!) and everything was more than delicious.We totally recommend if you’d like to escape from the everyday local market food. Also, the staff were the friendliest!!Show less

Author: 316myatChelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Good quaint Japanese restaurant
Review: Not a very big restaurant , but location is convenient for those staying along hotels at Pantai Tengah/ Cenang area. Service was excellent , the waitress was hospitable , attentive and efficient . Food was good , fresh . We had the noodles which came with a clear tasty broth . And the bbq fish which was fresh. The fried rice was delicious. Ingredients and taste appear authentic Japanese, and you can tell they prepare food from their heart. Thank you for a lovely experience !Show less

Author: Traveller5970
Title: Disappointing
Review: Visited this restaurant after reading the reviews. Food was disappointing, sushi and sashimi were served at room temperature and definitely not cut fresh obviously pre prepared. Chicken teriyaki, bbq chicken and steak were okay but rather tasteless. Visit certainly was what we were expecting following previous reviews... disappointingShow less

Author: phoenixbiKlang, Malaysia
Title: Best Japanese food
Review: What can I say ? Nothing is bad about this restaurant , good service and delish food.There were so many awards hanging on the wall and latest they are in Malaysia Tatler . We ordered Australia Wagyu , Moriawase Umi , Sashimi and deep Fried Grouper , Fried Rice , EbiShow less

Author: wyoiling
Title: EXCELLENCE SERVICE
Review: Great atmosphere with excellence service. The waitress serve with heart and they are very detailed oriented. We celebrated our friend's birthday there and they helped us to arrange a surprise to our friend duly. Food quality was good but the green tea was slightly below average during our visit. Nevertheless, a great dining experience.Show less

Author: BistroDelPuerto
Title: The best restaurant in Langkawi
Review:
Don't miss the ebi fried prawns (the best prawns I ever ate) and the sushi. And all of this, whitout trying waqyu beef :)

Very friendly staff.

Author: Van LLondon
Title: Delicious food and great service
Review: We had dinner here and we loved it. The food was absolutely delicious and the fish was very fresh. The service was great and the staff very friendly, helpful and polite. Pretty good value for money and well worth the visit. We really enjoyed our dinner here and would highly recommend it.Show less

Author: DablooWSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent ambiance, friendly staff, below average food, slow service
Review: Went in Dec 2019 with 4 adults and 2 kids. Orders the grilled fish which was good, but the sushi was below average. The unagi was not fresh, didnt taste good at all.We sat outside which was really beautiful but it was infested by mosquitoes. The service was really slow, food took over 45 mins to arrive, one dish at a time.Show less

Author: Patrick DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Was ok
Review: Chicken Katsu was excellent. Sashimi platter however was missing a fresh pallet taste. Wasabi seemed that it was out of a packet. Our 2 starters did not come together and my partner had to wait 15 minutes for hers to arrive. Service and food did not match the bill at the end. Show less

Author: huat3434
Title: Nice grill fish
Review: Nice jap restaurant, food is good at a decent pricing but pls remember to make reservation before going down

Author: bashariahIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Try the prawn maki!
Review: The restaurant is near to my stay and I can’t resist to try any good Japanese restaurant based on other reviews. Last order is at 10pm and I made a reservation informing I’m on my way around 9.45pm. When I reached there, there were only a few tables occupied and the staff brought a small white board to explain on the special menu. Excellent explanation and recommendation by the staff. Didn’t catch her name but she guided me which one is Halal or not since there are food mix with alcohol. She recommended to try the prawn maki and I just love it! I ordered Unagi Kamameshi and Prawn Maki to satisfy my appetite alone I came back with my husband for second round and we ordered salmon grill and prawn maki! Super good and yummy Make a reservation before you go cause it is always full during dinner time.Show less

Author: amr_m_younes
Title: Sushi
Review:
Sushi is very delicious and tasty , great customer service 

Although restaurant was full, service was great

Author: Birdy123_0
Title: Tasty sushi
Review: If you are in Langkawi and craving sushi, this is your place to go. The service is fabulous and the food tastes delish.

Author: michalisgias
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food
Review: The staff were very friendly and helpful. We loved the sashimi and the sushi. The shrimp croquettes where great. We suggest this restaurant without second thought!

Author: Thricey37Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Japanese Restaurant in Langkawi
Review: It's a must to visit this restaurant if you are in Langkawi! The food is really great! Awesomeness! The way the Japanese chef prepared the food and cook it, I can only say its amazing! I don't eat Oyster but the way he cooked it, Omg! It's really fantastic! The sauce is really good I must say! Very fresh! The Japanese waitress is really very helpful and gave us very good recommendations! Thank you! Show less

Author: PKC88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Food with Amazing Staffs!
Review: First time here after 1 year residing in Langkawi, my superior brought me and my another colleague here to have our birthday retreat. Thumbs up to Wulan the lady who attended to us from the moment we entered. Great service and she is very friendly. Keep it up!Show less

Author: StuditskayaGelang Patah, Malaysia
Title: Hidden food pearl of Langkawi
Review: The restaurant is a bit “hidden” but definitely worth to go! Very nice atmosphere, helpful and attentive stuff. We didn’t book in advance but they still found the place for four of us in the peak dinner time. The service was fast and the food just delicious - the squid and hot ice cream are must try Show less

Author: aleem1975
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: The best japanise food what i've ever eat. Traditional japanise food in excellent quality. The staff is really kind.

Author: jingtaotanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simple and good food, grilled dishes are a specialty
Review: Ordered two sets: grilled salmon set, sushi + soba set, and a special of the day order of salmon belly sashimi. The fish was fresh and tasty, chawanmushi even tastier. Can't find any fault unlike how some of the older negative reviews mentioned.Service was attentive and polite, so no idea why some older reviews mentioned rude service.One review mentioned that additional soy sauce/wasabi is charged at RM1 per request - this is not true, it is only RM0.20 and even so the standard serving with the dishes is more than enough.If you choose to sit inside, it may get a little smokey if a few guests order the grilled dishes which are served on a charcoal grill. If you sit outside there is insect repellent provided, a nice touch. Show less

Author: choppedsteakDoha, Qatar
Title: Trust their special of the day
Review: I always visit here when I drop by Langkawi. This small cozy authentic restaurant always have the same friendly and helpful staff to assist you select the right choice for your dinner. This time I bring my wife here for our honeymoon dinner in Langkawi. We started of with some sashimi and oyster. I am very glad we tried their swordfish Toro sashimi and Washington Oyster in ponzu as it was remarkable. The chef knows the best for their sashimi.The price for their sashimi is absolutely reasonable for its quality instead of a crazy mark up from other high end Japanese restaurant chain. Next we had the grilled seabass from the Andaman sea, it's a good choice for tourist trying out Malaysian seafood as the preparation is very simple enough for you the taste the freshness of the seafood.Finally, the Japanese Wagyu ribeye is abit too lean for its cut to be served. I would highly suggest if you love steak with juice go for striploin or tenderloin. But the preparation of this char grilled steak is pretty good to enjoy a juicy tender premium steak.It's definitely a hidden gem in this island. Show less

Author: JasonOSB
Title: Excellent quality of food and service
Review: The best Japanese on Langkawi by far. The quality of the food and service is top notch and I certainly would be looking forward to returning again!

Author: flammablerose_45
Title: Best Japanese food!
Review: All the dishes ordered were so fresh and wonderfully done!! The service was also excellent! Definitely will go again next time!!

Author: Pioneer313434
Title: One of the best Japanese places I’ve been to!
Review: One of the best Japanese restaurants that I’ve been to, everything o ordered on the menu was delicious. The staff are amazing and prices compared to other parts of the world is super affordable... in a nutshell amazing experience

Author: TarunNPVBengaluru, India
Title: A slice of Japan in an island of Malaysia
Review: Amazingly authentic Japanese food and drink. Choose your food well. They are made with care for sure. Prices are a bit steep but the quality is excellent. as is the service The restaurant is located at the Ambong Ambong villas and one needs to have reserved in advance . Show less

Author: GabrielVieira5518
Title: Best Japonese Restaurant
Review: This restaurant has the better food. The staff is kind and work very well. I reccomend  that restaurant.

Author: CraigHWSouth Australia
Title: A surprise
Review: We had heard and read good reports on unkaizan so tried last week. It is Japanese and excellent quality food. It is a little out of the main area but well worth visiting and was busy, so others had obviously also heard good reports. Every dish we had was enjoyable and well presented. The main front lady was terrific and their trainees tried hard to please. We will return before we leave Langkawi.Show less

Author: Mulrobs
Title: Disappointing food and service
Review: Positives:Sushi was delicious. The tiger prawn and salmon the tastiest I've had at any restaurant.The setting is cute, nestled in trees and tables on the terrace are intimate and provide a nice atmosphereNegatives:Overpriced for what is served - surprised to be paying uk prices for food on LankawiService poor - they forgot one of our meals and attempted to clear the table. When we said we had more food to come that we'd been waiting over 15 further minutes for, we were told it was "being prepared". If you forget a dish, just apologise, don't lie. The server checked back the order upon placing, so clear it had been forgotten. Granted though, they did have some trainee servers on this night which might explain things a little.Finally, second dish was overcooked and chewy. Most annoyingly, when asked how our dinner was on paying, we explained our disappointment, only to be met with a smile!Spend your money elsewhere!Show less

Author: JkieChong
Title: Beautiful ambient for dinner
Review: After reading lots of good reviews about this restaurant, decided to try out this place. Restaurant ambient are amazing. Site scenery give you a zen feeling. Cover with trees n plants. Overall enviroment is good for photos. For foods, they are over rated. Food taste average commom like any commercialize japanese restaurant. They dont have any signature dishes or special dishes of their own, menu same like any other japanese restaurant u can find in the city or shopping malls. Price charged are worth for the restaurant ambient scenery but not for the food quality served.Show less

Author: Jean RRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: What a pleasant surprise at a very reasonable price.
Review: After 2 weeks visiting different places in Malaysia and mainly enjoying local food, we wanted to experience something different. We were recommended to try Unkaizan and that was really an excellent restaurant. The sushis were amazingly fresh and good. We then had squid teriyaki which was sublime too.The team was paying attention to all little details and the overall atmosphere of this place was relaxing. If you want a real Japanese experience while visiting Langkawi then you should seriously consider this place. Show less

Author: KhaiPgPenang
Title: Little gem on the island
Review: Amazing find on this island. A must try for Japanese food lovers. We did not try the wagyu but the grain fed char grilled ribeye was tender and delicious. Unagi meshi was excellent and highly recommended. My children liked the cold cha soba too. The service was very good and friendly overall. Show less

Author: Chinchin1Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Over-rated. Food taste average,. The price wise also priced accordingly to singapore restaurants but the usual cost of food tends to much lower in Langkawi vs Singapore. Location: Up a small slope, inconvenient without a car. Some will consider this to be exclusive. So it depends on preference. Service can be improved. We did not make a reservation and walk in at 6pm with a baby. Thus, we ordered takeaway and seeing the empty seats, we just sat down waiting for the food. The staff were very rude and requested for us to stand at the entrance. The restaurant is half empty and our takeaway should be ready in 15 mins kind. I do not understand how inconsiderate they can be towards a family with infant. Show less

Author: SITI67Monte-Carlo, null, Monaco
Title: Never ending love story
Review: Each year we are back to Langkawi and we never miss to dine at Unkaizan. The food is delicious, so elegantly presented, the service is perfect and the place is beautiful. Unkaizan is more than a culinary experience.If you fall in love with Langkawi as we did many years ago, there's a big chance you get addicted to UnkaizanFabienne & Henri Show less

Author: NopainNogain88
Title: very good japanese restaurant
Review: one of my favourite spots on the island. Quality consistent, lovely service staff, reasonable price and really good food. Keep it up!

Author: Sian G
Title: Superb Japanese food
Review: Outside of Japan probably one of the best Japanese restaurants we have been too. Delicious food, lovely ambience and great service. Even my toddler sat still and fed himself in record time for the entire meal. Good value too. Highly recommend this restaurant

Author: KennethYee78Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: My family had the unagi, cod fish and salmon for individual meals and a nice Kuroge Wagyu for sharing. Food quality was excellent and we thoroughly enjoyed the meal. As for the service, the waitress gave us plenty of time to make up our minds while being friendly and polite. Everyone had a great and relaxing time.Definitely will visit again when we come back to Langkawi.Show less

Author: KGB777Singapore, Singapore
Title: About the best Japanese you'll find in Langkawi
Review: Not too many Japanese restaurants to choose from in Langkawi. This one has a good location with a great view out over Pantai Tengah, but the outdoor seating is very hot with insufficient fans and mosquitoes are also a bit of a problem - we all had a few bites each. Food is ok, but I wouldn't rave about the quality. Prices seemed reasonable.Show less

Author: albertbY6797IW
Title: Enjoy freshly prepared Sushi
Review: Unkaizan is a good Japanese restaurant with friendly personnel and - most important - freshly prepared food. The ambiance of the restaurant is nice and quiet. We enjoyed the variety of Sushi and the delicious sea food and fish; the grilled Mackerel is really good!

Author: nnjh90
Title: MARVELLOUS !!!
Review: A must go! 100% 5 star service plus their peaceful ambience. It’s worth the penny you’re spending cause everything is just delicious! 😋

Author: 851charlottew
Title: Amazing athmosphere
Review: We have eaten twice at this Restaurant and were fully satisfied with the delicious food and especially with the service.Wulan, a beautiful Indonesian lady, was responsible for the service on the terrace. We loved her kindness, her humour and her professionalism, so we had two great evenings with a lot of laughter and amazing dishes. Thank you, Wulan, for the 2 wonderful evenings.Show less

Author: Eduard_R15
Title: Great Food!
Review: The menu was quite extensive for a small place. The prices were reasonable and the food delicious and authentic. The staff were extremelly attentive.

Author: AyoubKSA
Title: Best Japanese Restaurant
Review: Try the special menu, the restaurant is surprisingly too good considering the location, and the staff are super nice and welcoming.

Author: vas o
Title: Great atmosphere, delicious food
Review: The place is cozy and the staff friendly and kind . Menu has big variety of sushi , meat and Japanese dishes. Food tasty and fresh and the chef is doing a really good job . Medium prices

Author: Sander S
Title: Best Ribeye I had in my life
Review: Just amazing. Friendly staff. Great food! Highly recommended. Sushi and sashimi are also amazing quality

Author: ireneteot
Title: Fresh sashimi and excellent teppanyaki oysters!
Review:
This restaurant was highly recommended by a Friend and it’s certainly worth a trip!

Freshest sashimi and very well done oysters have warmed our stomachs and made us very hAppy on the pretty island .

Author: toughskinAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Best Japanese restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Nice tasty food, sushi was great, black cod was very delicious, my wife don’t like seafood so she order a steak and according to her was excellent. It is little bit pricey with little bit small portion and if you are driving you need to be careful with the entrance because it is a small two way road and you go up hill. Show less

Author: KimberJet
Title: Not As Expected
Review: We were highly excited to have finally come to eat at Unkaizan... but it was below our expectation.  Un-impressive... Service was kinda slow... food was average.  And prizing?  Expensive.

Author: IanLoveAyr, United Kingdom
Title: FABULOUS
Review: We decided to try Unkaizan based on previous reviews and it didn't disappoint.We sat at one of the outside tables in what is a very pretty restaurant with a very nice ambience.We ordered drinks and a nice bottle of wine which was a bit more expensive than normal but not excessive. My wife decided on Swordfish Sashimi to start and it was beautifully presented and fresh looking whilst I had the spicy California rolls, both starters were delicious. For mains my wife ordered the black cod which she absolutely loved and I pushed the boat out and had the Wagyu Ribeye steak with fabulous fried rice which was awesome.Our waitress was a lovely Indonesian girl called Wulan ( I think) she is a credit to the restaurant and was very knowledgeable about the menu and dishes and was always happy to have a conversation and a giggle.Do your taste buds a favour and give this restaurant a try.Show less

Author: Taranarani-96
Title: Special place
Review: Love the place, the shushi are fresh a bit pricey but is ok, because all delicious. Love the miso sup so much, Definitely will back again!

Author: Nicole_711Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Great fried ice cream for dessert
Review: Japanese restaurant is not normally known for fried ice cream but have to mention this here coz it sure was delicious! Sake was served in a custom made wooden sake mini-crate, with a shot glass inside. Note that there is sake in the shot glass and the mini-crate! Typical Japanese menu and on the high-price range.Show less

Author: Manny17
Title: Superb Japanese
Review: We had a superb dinner at Unkaizan. Our waitress was superfriendly, although not from Japan herself, she really knows wat hospitality is. We ordered sushi as starter and Salmon and Wagyu Beef on the charcoal table grill as main course. The waitress could not guarantee it would be served in that order. And so we had a table full of delicious food. As a tip if you like your starter and main seperate, maybe order them seperate. Show less

Author: natashap697Melbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious Japanese!
Review: We had dinner at Unkaizan, and was very impressed. We had sushi, sashimi and noodle soup. All were delicious and the udon noodles were hand made. There are a lot of awards hanging up on the walls, and the food was definitely a testament to that! Service was friendly and attentive. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: PaulyDC_AUS
Title: There is a reason it has won so many awards!!!
Review: You understand why the Unkaizan restaurant has won so many awards!!! The food is so delicious!!! By far the best restaurant on the island!!! You'd be fool to pass up the opportunity to eat dinner here!!!

Author: Natalie A
Title: Delicious food and ambiance
Review: Loved the spicy california roll and charcoal grill wagyu. The teppan style prawns were amazing as well. Wished we had more space to try more of the menu. Must visit if you are in Langkawi.

Author: 164beng
Title: One of the best Japanese out there
Review:
I could eat this sushi and sashimi everyday of the week, tuna, octopus, liver grouper, snapper, Inari, scallop.
You name it they have it

Author: alsuk84
Title: Very average and expensive.
Review: Service was very good, however, was extremely overpriced in my opinion. Food lacked flavor. Did not go for the steak, as prices were close to expensive steak restaurants in London.

Author: FCR_Bayern
Title: Must visit
Review: Went here two years in a row. Service and food are as good as last year. Great sashimi and steak choice. Excellent and professional service. With alcoholic drinks and plenty of fancy protein don’t expect to pay more than 50 usd per person.

Author: chs22
Title: Delicious
Review: Best Japanese food!! Fresh fish, delicious rice and amazing service. I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone!

Author: schmga
Title: Very good
Review: This is a great Japanese restaurant with excellent food, a peaceful setting and very professional and friendly staff.

Author: PalinaKozyravaCologne, Germany
Title: Best Sushi ever!
Review: The very best sushi we ever had. The quality of the product is insane and the place is decent as well. The staff is attentive and super kind. Honestly it was a perfect night! Definitely sit outside at the japanese tables to get the original feeling.Show less

Author: Melvin_ctZ
Title: Best Japanese Restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: Greeted with a smile from the hostess which gave us a very warmth welcome feeling. Our table was taken care by your server, Akane which was exceptional at her service at table. Food was very well presented and my friends are all very satisfied with the dinner! Thank you. Will definitely be back again when i visit Langkawi in future.Show less

Author: RedDaisy88
Title: Delicious!
Review:
Try the eel! It was amazing! 
Very pretty location too. More expensive than other places in the area but I think it’s worth it :)

Author: geeshariffPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Japanese, Great Staff
Review: Ambong-Ambong guests gets 10% discount and free ice-cream at Unkaizan Restaurant. Staff were all so very friendly, informative and courteous especially Khairol and Akane. Before you order you get a little briefing on the different types of available food, complete with a chart. Food were of good quality, authentically Japanese, very nicely presented and delicious. Place is nice, clean and beautifully adorned with numerous greeneries. I really liked the huge hanging planters/ferns. We all enjoyed our meal here. Not cheap eats but worth the experience.Show less

Author: tuomasn551
Title: Perfect dinner
Review: High quality food and service in a very nice restaurant. This restaurant is located on a small hill which makes together with the plants and water elements the athmosphere very likeable. It’s not cheapest restaurant in the area but worth of every penny.

Author: tk63
Title: Very nice, authentic taste.
Review:
Authentic Japanese restaurant, with an excellent choice of menu's. 
The sushi was extremely fresh and the rice was excellent. 
We had a set menu with extra sushi. Prices are low for a Japanese restaurant and even moderate for Cenang restaurants.

Author: 507renas
Title: Delicious food and superb service
Review: Find out about this restaurant while staying at Ambong pool villas. Squid was very delicious, we ate different types of sushi, very fresh and tasty. I also reccommend to try their noodles and rice, a truly Japanese experience!

Author: Peter KAustralia
Title: Not bad Japanese but ...
Review: We visited this Japanese restaurant close to the hotel Holiday Villa and Spa last year and were so impressed we went back agin this year. It may be a case of trying to repeat an experience sometimes never quite comes off but were disappointed this time. Give it a go yourself as it it very authentic if a little expensive for what else is available nearby ...Show less

Author: ZoeY54
Title: Best Japenese Restaurant with moderate price
Review: One of the best Japanese restaurant I've ever been to. Their sashimi was melted in my mouth. Definitely fresh as they caught the fish from the aquarium inside the restaurant and made the sashimi. Their Matcha Ice-cream is a must try. I don't like matcha ice cream except for this one. It doesn't have the bitter taste like the rest of the matcha at all. This is the only place I miss the most in Langkawi.Show less

Author: 207yurik
Title: Favourite Japanese restaurant
