Review: We first visited the restaurant in 2004 for and we absolutely loved it. Visited again in 2014 and we were so happy to find the restaurant 10 years later. We are here in 2018 and loved it again.

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: The best Wagyu steak
Review: Just visited Unkaizan for a 6th time and yet again the food was perfect. I opted for the Japanese Wagyu steak which was served over charcoal, it has to be the best steak I have had in a long time. My husband had the Black cod which again was perfectly cooked. If you love Japanese food then this place is a must but don't forget to book in advance so you are not disappointed.Show less

Author: ValueSeeker83Lahad Datu, Malaysia
Title: Learning something new. KAMAMESHI
Review: As going there alone, I opted to have a la carte items as I am afraid that I could not finish the sushi set meal. However, I ended up ordering more because of one delicious meal. "Kamameshi". I have entree (Sashimi), main course (Salmon Kamameshi), side-dishes (Prawn tempura) and dessert (Deep-fried matcha ice cream). Love all the dishes, except that the batter for the deep-fried matcha ice cream is a bit too thick to my liking. But I highly recommend their "KAMAMESHI" if you go there the first time.Show less

Author: CalvinT210
Title: Fresh seafood and excellent service!!!
Review: Fantastic food coupled by great service! Exceptional place to go when in Langkawi. Thanks to the great staff for such a wonderful experience.

Author: sdm0910
Title: Good food, good service, good night
Review: Yet another example of the excellent service provided at Langkawi establishments all over the island. Menu was extensive and enough choices to satisfy pretty much anyone. Food was delicious without being exceptional and no hesitation in being recommended.

Author: 33carlos33
Title: Opening hours wrong
Review: Claim that they are open untill 11 pm but we got ther just over 10 pm and were told kitchen closes at 10 pm so no food for us.

Author: 446danahDoha, Qatar
Title: Disappointed
Review: We took a cab all the way from the North side of the island to eat here based on reviews. Place is simple and cute and staff are super kind and polite BUT restaurant was so full and it almost took 45 minutes between our appetizers and sushi and the other stuff we ordered. Staff were overloaded. Regarding taste: we ordered a grilled sea bass which was amazing and the sushi rolls were good too. I ordered noodles which turned out to be a different kind than the ones I’m familiar with ( too thick for me) the price is not cheap at all (we paid 180 rm for these, in the end we weren’t full) we wanted to order more sushi but orders took forever. If ur going there better to go before it gets crowdedShow less

Author: rosihanjuaraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Japan at your backyard
Review: The 1st time I was here was 10 years ago and the place still kept its charm and exquisiteness. The food is top notch, the service is very friendly and the specials are always exciting. Not to mention the ingredients are fresh. The mosquito-infested terrace is worth the al-fresco dining experience due to the nice smelling insect repellent feeding your extra sensory. Show less

Author: amita1999
Title: Great service and food
Review: We visited for a family meal, location is nice, the staff are very good and attentive. We tried various dishes including sushi, sashimi, tempura etc. Would definitely recommend a visit.

Author: tishytoshy
Title: Lovely meal
Review: Excellent food particularly the sushi (although we ordered too much!). Good vegetarian options. Friendly staff.

Author: traceyq_13
Title: Amazing Japanese
Review:
Japanese food and service as good as it gets anywhere in the world. 
Definitely make a reservation as they are alway fully booked.

Author: Ken Sheng W
Title: Fantastic Green Tea Ice Cream!
Review:
- Went for dinner and table was reserved
- Fresh and delicious food provided
- Waitress is very polite and friendly
- Green Tea Ice Cream is the must-try dessert

Author: RalpoStankicHangzhou, China
Title: Very poor quality
Review: We tried because we were advised by the holiday villa langkawi people that it was the best Japanese good serving outlet in the island. It is stylish and cozy with detailed ambience and decor. Service staff are good and friendly, the prices are reasonable. But it stops there. The food is nicely presented but it's awful. It is not clear Japanese food, doesn't have any taste, it's served very late and it is the most distant food from Japanese that you can imagine. Just call it creative Asian cuisine but not Japanese otherwise you are doomed to disappoint your dinersShow less

Author: Vikki WLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A wonderful evening!
Review: Unexpectedly stumbled across this restaurant after being disappointed by the restaurant we had set our hearts upon nearby being closed and having to change our plans last minute. Couldn’t have lucked out more - this place is genuinely such an experience and one we most definitely won’t forget.Went with my mum who’s never eaten Japanese before and it most certainly didn’t disappoint. From the moment we walked into the restaurant to the moment we left ( and we were the last to leave!) we were treated with such grace and politeness I cannot thank the staff enough for being so attentive. The food itself was exquisite - a range of sushi, sashimi and a delightful seaweed salad; the combination was just perfect. If you can get the beef wagyu sushi you will not regret it! Thank you for such a memorable experience.Show less

Author: tomcat365Melbourne, Australia
Title: So fresh...
Review: After a recommendation from the hotel concierge we took the long taxi ride from Kuah to Cenang Beach. Boy are I glad we did. Greeted by an unassuming & traditional building, we were treated to some of the freshest and best Japanese food we have ever enjoyed. Standouts were the swordfish sashimi, tuna sushi, prawn croquettes & the karaage chicken. With heat of the evening it was great to enjoy iced cold mugs of Sapporo. The service was excellent our server was one of the best I’ve experienced in a long time. All in all a must restaurant to visit while in Langkawi Show less

Author: 518cz
Title: Great experience
Review: We loved this restaurant. Great service and food in a little tropical paradise. The grilled 3 day marinated salmon was our favorite dish!

Author: MeganLove
Title: Japanese close to Ambong Ambong
Review: An ideal restaurant to go to as it is on site with Ambong Ambong. Lovely service and the food was delicious and traditional to Japanese culture.

Author: Margie D
Title: Great Japanese Restaurant!
Review: Lovely atmosphere, friendly and professional staff and great food , reasonably priced. Try the sparkling Saki

Author: R3125SY_
Title: Delicious Japanese Food
Review: Having sashimi, unagi rice and seabass in teppan style here. All the foods served was fresh and delicious. The sashimi was thick and melt in the mouth and i love the unagi rice so much.

Author: emmaf1991Zurich, Switzerland
Title: Expected better
Review: The atmosphere and service was wonderful. The garden is particularly inviting, not a detail missed. However, we expected more from the food. Perhaps it was a bad choice on my behalf, but the “tempura set” was, I would go as far to say, completely tasteless. As well as that, it wasn’t really enough food! The portion was quite small, and considering the price, I would have liked to come out of there feeling full and satisfied. We ate at a night market on the previous evening for 3 ringgit and it was definitely a better and more tasty meal! Show less

Author: CurlymikeTPerth, Australia
Title: Special
Review: Everything was lovely, food, drink, service, setting. The waitress explained all the meals on the menu carefully if we queried anything. The sushi and sashimi were fresh and tasty, beer cold and red wine by the glass was much better than most other places. The special crab and rice dish was also very tasty.Show less

Author: JacquelineG2306London, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: This was our second attempt to eat out locally and we were really looking forward to it as it was number 1 on the hotels recommended list. The service was very friendly but the food was poor. My black cod was dry and the rice had bits of grisly chicken in it. We would definitely not go back there and don’t think it should have been on the Four Seasons listingShow less

Author: Beeteeyork
Title: Small, casual, good food
Review:
A good place for seafood lovers, in particular sashimi. Oysters were a treat.
Excellent service. Good beer and wine. Worth a visit.

Author: 196shazat
Title: The sushi was okey.
Review: We went with our 9 month daughter to have a early&quick dinner. They told us the table inside was reserved, so we had dinner outside. We couldn’t relax because it was too hot and a lot of miscitos. When we left, it was stil 3 free table inside. Some of the sushi was good but some of the maki was too dry. Show less

Author: RachelG497
Title: Great value Japanese food
Review:
I had the sushi set with hot fresh noodles and was so full. The sushi was fresh and delicious and very good value.

Doesn’t cater that well for vegetarians.

Author: UnaWWatford, United Kingdom
Title: Safe and upmarket food
Review: We had a very good quality and authentic meal here. I had the tempura combination and my husband had salmon and sushi a la carte. Also some sparkling sake made less sweet by freshly squeezed grapefruit which was lovely and unusual.The sushi and tempura were as good as any we have had in Japan and it was clean and comfortable. An uber ride from Pantai Cenang where we did not much fancy the dodgy looking cafes and surrounds. This is a safe, clean place with spotless toilets and friendly service from charming staff.Show less

Author: carlsahnLisbon, Portugal
Title: Best Sushi In Langkawi!
Review: Out of the limited options for sushi in Langkawi, Unkaizan should undoubtedly be the first pick. The environment is immediately noticeable, with hanging plants arranged on an outside deck for beautiful seating. The food and sushi were great, ranging from the individual sashimis and nigiris to udon combination platters and more!The service was perfect, accommodating our large group of 12 people well and even allowing us to split the check at the end in an organized fashion. Overall, if I were to return to Langkawi, I would have to return to Unkaizan as well! Show less

Author: 1Travelled_the_worldQinzhou, China
Title: Good taste.
Review: The service was excellent and the food was good. It is in a beautiful position halfway up a small hill and within walking distance from Pantai Tengah. There are choices of seating. Inside with AC, outside on a deck or lower in the garden but with Japanese style seating which was uncomfortable for me. However, the staff was very accommodating and helped us move. My one or two complaints. 1 the menu is too complicated and the specials board also has too many things on it. 2 No sugar free drinks other than water or fresh juice which are in fact not sugar free. All-in-all an enjoyable meal and a place I would visit again but I would restrict myself to the set menu choices.Show less

Author: Rawtalent
Title: Lovely
Review: Beautiful garden setting with views to the sea.  We each had a set dinner, which was fresh and well presented.  The home made ice cream and watermelon finished off a great meal. Service was impeccable.

Author: ValueSeeker83Lahad Datu, Malaysia
Title: Japanese food with big portion
Review: Coming here because of the great review on Tripadvisor. However, I am unsure if I am overexpecting the food to be exceptionally fresh. My tempura prawns are a bit powdery and my prawn in the sushi is quite funny as well. Probably, I come at a time where the prawn is not in season. However, they can improve their way to preserve their raw seafoods.Show less

Author: Dutch_Couple_Utrecht
Title: Delicious
Review: Kind service, tasty meat and fish. Sushi here was the best I tasted. Sake was also very good. We went there twice during our week stay.

Author: Mr_HafLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Hidden Japan in Langkawi
Review: If you ever been to Japan, when you walk through this place you will feel that japanese vibe flowing through this place. The place was very Kyoto-ish. Inside a cute japanese waiter that is very good in english is so friendly taking order and serving. The food is very authentic and yes SAKE! <3Show less

Author: only1invillageLondon
Title: Fabulous customer service, fresh sashimi and matcha ice cream
Review: Book in advance. They will give you a 30 minute late time and then they will cancel your booking. Best sashimi you're going to get on an island, outside of KL. Prices are western prices, not Malaysian prices. Some of the servers are Japanese and have excellent English. Mosquito heaven outside, so book a table inside, if you're a mozzie magnet like me! We had nigiri sushi, sashimi, chuwan mushi, maki, grilled chicken which was particularly succulent. All very good quality. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: TanH25Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing
Review: Love the authentic Japanese setting, the staffs are really friendly and attentive too. We ordered fresh raw oysters, toro sashimi, unagi kamesan(I think) (grilled eel rice set) and black cod fish rice set which are all absolutely delicious and very beautifully presented! Just felt that the black cod fish is a little pricey for the portion, as well as a little burnt for my liking. Definitely worth a try for authentic Japanese food in LangkawiShow less

Author: beberson
Title: Best Sushi
Review: Relatively pricey, but the best sushi I’ve had in a very long time! The waiter was extremely nice and the place looks great! Definitely coming back here to try the rest of the menu.

Author: RickHansen
Title: Niiiice
Review: We thought we'd try here just for the sake of it and we were suprised at the overall feel and freshness. the staff were helpful and the food was great.

Author: GL O
Title: Delicious and great settings
Review: Very good service and good quality food always draw customers back and we were there 2 nights in a row!

Author: Ron FCanberra, Australia
Title: Good experience!
Review: Unkaizen is a good Japanese restaurant with a very pleasant ambience. The food is typical Japanese (sorry no sukiyaki). Sake is good. Price are inexpensive for Japanese restaurants. Service is as you would expect - lovely! Worth a return visit. Be aware of scary driveway and limited parking! Show less

Author: augustinweeSingapore, Singapore
Title: The Best Japanese Restaurant on the island
Review: This is by far the best Japanese restaurant in Langkawi island that I found, with excellent food quality, very polite and patience staffs, attentive to customer requests with good service quality too. Most importantly, the food serves were very fresh, nicely cooked and presented on the table.you know what... we patronized the restaurant for 2 consecutive nights, for our dinner! Yummy!Show less

Author: AndrewS701
Title: What a surprise
Review: Super find!  First class food, high quality and reasonably priced.  Menu was both familiar and also some unusual additions to standard Japanese fare.  and the liquor was remarkably good value too.  Nice staff!

Author: dominico789Hong Kong, China
Title: Good food and dining atmosphere
Review: We visited Langkawi 10 years ago and had dined several times at Unkaizan at that time. We went again tonight because we like the food and services of this Japanese restaurant. The local fish was fresh and tasteful. The fried rice and steam rice both were good. The tiger prawns in grilled and pan fried were not as good as before. Prawns were frozen too long. As a whole, we were satisfied.Show less

Author: GyojoNMalaysia
Title: Best sashimi
Review: I was lucky to have booked a table at the very last minute. It is advisable to make a reservation earlier if you wish to dine in there. The staffs were polite and knowledgeable, patiently explained everything detailed from the menu. I had a local fish sashimi, it was the best sashimi I’d ever tried. With a mere RM20, I could taste the freshness and sweetness from the sea. The teppanyaki beef and Unagi rice was very delicious, overall it was very pleasant to dine in there. It’s a must if you’re visiting Langkawi.Show less

Author: Zaith05
Title: Worth it!
Review:
Sushi was extremely fresh and delicious! Would recommend the tempura too. However try not to eat the beef or steak as it was not as good as they claimed. It's tough and dry.

Still would visit if given a chance for the sushi!

Author: Trip466846
Title: Good, but not the best in Malaysia as claimed
Review: Food was good i must say, had the swordfish and tuna sashimi, both so fresh. Ebi tempura was nice and meaty. They don't give you skinny prawns like some places. The chicken bbq and miso soup were just okay, not special. Service was good. So overall it was a good experience, just that we did not think it was any better than the excellent Japanese restaurants in KL. So if you already frequent places like Iketeru or Kampachi, a trip to Unkaizan will not be necessary. However, the prices are decent, unlike in KL. Show less

Author: JudithE393Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: A Japanese Gem
Review: A packed restaurant which is a good sign. Menu a bit confusing at first, but we soon got the hang of it and made a great choice of sashimi, tempura, sushi and barbecued chicken.The chicken arrived on the table on its own cooking pot/BBQ grill. Deliciously moist chicken. No rice or noodles required.The Japanese staff are beautiful and very attentive. A great evening with wonderful food.Worth the 49 minute journey to get to Unkaizan.Show less

Author: Markeverett
Title: Very pleasant
Review: My wife and I visited this restaurant recently and enjoyed the variety of food and thought that the table service and friendliness of the staff was excellent. Well worth a visit.

Author: Louise L
Title: Amazing food and service
Review:
We visited here twice on a 3 day visit. Need I say more! 10 out of 10

Beautiful setting and great attention to detail

Author: notebene
Title: Great tempura !
Review: Really great tempura prawns and tempura vegetables.  Fish was very good.   Great service too.  Best to book.

Author: CatTurnTravAdelaide, Australia
Title: Fabulous Japanese
Review: This was our favourite meal in Langkawi. Would be easy for this place to be complacent in delivering quality value for money dining experience given it is the only Japanese restaurant on Langkawi .......but they are not and excel at what they do.We didn’t book but I would definitely recommend you do especially in peak season. November is low season and Unkaizan was pretty full by the time we departed! It’s popular for good reason.Friendly, knowledgeable staff.Lovely atmosphere set above the road amongst the forest.Food....yum yum yum. Fish of the day was Skipjack (tuna) caught fresh that day served sashimi but you could have had as sushi or another choice which I can’t remember because the sashimi was just yum.Miso soup with sushi setTempura vegetables done so well.Agadashi tofu for my friend who said it was one of the best she’s ever had.Everything we saw come out the kitchen looked fabulous so ‘eating with the eyes’ was exceptional.If you like Japanese food, do yourself a favour and dine here. It’s worth it.Show less

Author: mpk28
Title: Beautiful and delicious
Review: Food is fresh, delicious and beautiful. Great place to try something new like squid teppan-yaki. Red snapper teriyaki was delicious too! Lovely staff.

Author: cath_SporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Superb Japanese food!
Review: Such a great find in Langkawi. A drive from sky cab took only about 30min. Service staff were very friendly and attentive. Food was fabulous! We ordered a two portion of BBQ beef, BBQ Japanese squid, unagi rice set, green tea ice cream, California roll, etc for 5 of us.Will definitely visit again when I visit Langkawi againShow less

Author: Lai_ni09
Title: Best Japanese restaurant!
Review: This is the 4th time I visited langkawi and this is the 4th time I visited this restaurant. They provided good service and good foods to customer. I would said this is the best sushi I had in Malaysia!

Author: Frederick K
Title: Best Japanese Food in Langkawi Island and Malaysia
Review:
This restaurant is operated by Japanese owner serves best Japanese cuisine in the country, my picky partner has mentioned about the dinner several times after her first try, no choice but have to bring her back sometime in near future.

Definitely worth to try.

Author: denneicec
Title: Great food
Review: The food was excellent and the service was excellent. My husband said it was the best sushi he has had and my grilled white fish was very good. Bit expensive but worth it.

Author: Emma T
Title: Good food, quiet place
Review: It was nice to find this place away from the crowds. The customer service was great and the food good - the prawn tempura in particular was delicious.

Author: Adrian H
Title: Good quality food; worthy the $$
Review: I like the environment,it is nice, their staff are very well manner and friendly. Their food serving are worthy the money you are paying. Whereby the restaurant is kinda far if driving from Kuah Town.

Author: ZKat85
Title: Excellent sashimi
Review: Convenient location as the restaurant is on the foot of the hill of where we stayed, Ambong Ambong. Sashimi was fresh and delicious - we had both imported and local fish. Unagi and prawn tempura were also very tasty. Staff were very attentive. Will definitely come back again! Show less

Author: jan v
Title: An very fine experience
Review: We had a great evening here. The recommendations are very good and worth while following. Charcoal at the table, nice tender meat and succulent sushi made this meal not easy to forget.

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: The sixth visit and they are still excellent
Review: Fortunate enough to stay and work in Langkawi giving me the chance to dine in this restaurant for a few times. Was here again today for my dinner, ordered Assorted Sushi Combination Set with Hot Noodles, as well as their favourite Matcha ice-cream. Food was served in big portion. A big bowl of Udon served with 6 pieces of sashimi sushi and 3 little pieces of salmon hand rolled sushi. Sashimi today was so fresh love every bit of it. Udon was served with clear soup and seaweed. Was so full but still I could stuff my stomach with another scoop of Matcha ice cream, so nice I couldn't resist! Enough compliments to the food and I would thank to the staff. They were so friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: snarfley
Title: Good food, convenient to Ambong Ambong
Review: We got a discount as guests at Ambong Ambong and visited twice during our stay (quite handy when it's raining!). Nice Japanese food, lots of specials daily.

Author: TimOeySingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place, great food!
Review: Our friend recommend this place and we went to this place for my wife birthday dinner, it's a lovely place with great setting. Anywhere you seat (indoor, outdoor, or the hut) you will feel cozy. Do take note that as much as the hut looks cozy and nice, the mozzies will start to check you out when the sun is set, they did their best by providing mosquito coil and spray repellent, but we still got bitten. I think if the indoor seating is full, the next option would be outdoor seating as with brighter light, there should be lesser mosquitos. The small fish bowl on the table was a great touch. The people work there are as nice as the place itself, they really knowledgeable and will explain to you their menu as well as their current promotion. We did have some interesting conversation with the staff who taking care of us during our dinner.The food itself were tasty and nicely presented, price-wise? Alright, I don't think it's consider expensive considering the service they provide, food quality, and nice ambiance.Will definitely recommend this place and re-visit the place when we back in Langkawi.Some side info, they did not take early reservation via email, so you can always give them a call few hours before the place open.Show less

Author: frexioPontianak, Indonesia
Title: Probably the best Japanese in town
Review: Try the nabe soup and you'll fall for it! This restaurant had my highest recommendation for Japanese food in Langkawi. Last but not least, the matcha ice cream is definitely another item that you must try.Service excellent. A little bit pricey but it is worth more than what you've paid for! Show less

Author: KarliJS123
Title: Authentic Japanese for a great price
Review: The location and setting of the restaurant is beautiful on top of the hill in Pantai tengah. All food was delicious,  fresh and presented well, especially the crispy skinned salmon. Waitresses were very helpful and explained the menu well. Would definitely recommend a visit here!

Author: C8389OWstuartmSydney, Australia
Title: Authentic Japanese in Malaysia
Review: This place is genuine Japanese food in a Malaysian beach location. Be warned it is constantly busy so even in the low season and Ramadan you cant be guaranteed a walk in tableWhilst a little expensive (for Langkawi) the food is genuinely good. Chicken Kat Su was genuinely flavoursome ad great texture. Serving was a good size and plenty left over with rice and vegetables. The steak is expensive but really tender.One thing to check is the time of day, it is further away from the busier parts of Cenang so its a taxi or moped ride, and a little higher up the hill. At dusk the bugs are ferocious so if your sitting outside watch outShow less

Author: SenLee
Title: Love at first visit
Review:
Unforgettable sashimi! Fresh and tasty. Highly recommend. Set meal is generous in portion especially the rice. Unagi bento set is delicious. 

Advise everyone to make reservation as this restaurant is often full. Get the indoor seat as there are annoying mosquitoes on the outdoor deck.

Author: smurphetteeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Unagi in Town!
Review: The restaurant is located a little out of town but it was worth the drive up. You would never have thought that this small Japanese restaurant sitting on top of a hill would serve the best Japanese food in town. The restaurant specialises in meat individually served on a charcoal grill - especially their Unagi Kabayaki that simply melts in your mouth in every bite. I ordered the Full Set and I left the restaurant with extremely happy and full stomach (and mind you, I have a big appetite!). I'm a big fan of sashimi and their special of the day (Swordfish sashimi) was fresh and had me craving for more!The food cooked by Chef Katsuji Takebayashi (and run by his partner Megumi Takebayashi) is worth a return visit to Langkawi again! I would rate them 10 out of 5 if possible!Show less

Author: josephcH9554PC
Title: Best Dinner with my girls on this vacation
Review:
Great place, great food.
A little out from the Cenang Beach hotspot but definitely worth it.

Carpark is limited but the roadside is safe.

Definitely a must try if don't feel like a pizza, pasta or a seafood dinner night.

Author: VPP C
Title: Excellent Japanese Food
Review: food and service was amazing. Great views and a really chilled out atmosphere.... One of the best Japanese restaurant in Malaysia. Value for money.

Author: fjjjjtjd
Title: Great food, great service
Review:
Enjoyed everything about our food here, the food was wonderful and beautifully prepared, the service was great
And I really enjoyed the atmosphere, we sat outside at a table with many plants around us, lovely night.

Author: TravelmilesawayWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Japanese Food
Review: The Black Cod is to die for, glad they still have this on the menu. Food here is excellent if you like Sushi, Sashimi & Teppan style cooking and for those that aren't keen it is not all fish.A little disappointed that they no longer open the upstairs dining area where you had to sit in the traditional cross legged position on Tatami mats.Show less

Author: shannondE8671ZIPort Macquarie, Australia
Title: Worth the Taxi Ride
Review: It was about a 25 minute taxi ride from where we were staying but WOW it was totally worth it. There were a variety of specials and the set menu had plenty to choose from. When the meals were delivered everyone was happy! The salmon sashimi was a standout!! Show less

Author: Leigh FLondon
Title: Great Japanese
Review: We went twice. Sat outside at a western table and then outside at a Japanese style table. Both instances were superb as was the quality of the food. I definitely recommend asking for an outside table as the restaurant is quite brightly lit. Had sushi,sashimi, teriyaki squid, noodles, and everything was perfect. Show less

Author: maxims765Moscow, Russia
Title: Japanese style
Review: Really good Japanese place, nice and cozy, friendly staff - Malaysians trained to follow traditional Japanese style. Very good and tasty food, medium portions. The same only minus (but not for everybody) is the price tag, which one at least in a location like this would expect lower. Show less

Author: Mark Mbrighton
Title: Worth a visit by taxi
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by people we met at our hotel on the other side of the island, and after reading favourable reviews on this site, decided to give it a try, for dinner after a visit to the nearby Underwater World. If you do the same, take a taxi. We walked and it was a bit too far in high temperatures and humidity.At the restaurant we saw the executive chef from the Datai, eating with his wife. If a chef of his calibre eats here, it must be good. And so it was.We began sitting outside on a normal height table, but moved inside later to benefit from the aircon. Luckily we did, as there was then a torrential downpour, but the outside tables did seem to be well protected.Soem reviewers on this site describe it as possibly the most expensive restaurant on the island. Believe me, it is not. This was actually the most affordable meal of our trip. But it is more expensive than other joints in the Cenang beach area. You get what you pay for. Unkaizan imports a lot of its produce from Japan, including sashimi grade fish.The menu covers most of what I love in Japanese cuisine, but a couple of sashimi items were sold out on our visit. Nonetheless we started with a selection of three types of fish sashimi, then we had the grilled eel with rice platter, which came with miso soup, pickles and some other items. It was very delicious, and went down well with ice cold Sapporo beer. At the end the friendly staff called us a taxi.There were plenty of Japanese customers, whites always a good sign.Show less

Author: meyrickt2015
Title: Proper Japanese food.
Review: We visited Unkaizan for dinner. The service was very attentive and helpful. The food was good with a very large selection. I had the Ribeye charcoal steak which was the most tender ribeye I have ever eaten. Had made udon was amazing to try too.

Author: Marie062
Title: Delicious
Review: We were so lucky to enjoy a dinner at Unkaizen. The food is amazing and so fresh. We had a wagyu steak, omg!!

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Best Japanese food in Langkawi - not an exaggeration!
Review: A friend & I were idly browsing through Tripadvisor restaurant recommendations, and were a little skeptical at the rave reviews Unkaizan had received, so decided to try it out for ourselves.We weren't disappointed! For a small restaurant, the menu selection was fairly comprehensive - it definitely covers the usual suspects and provided sufficient variety to keep us wondering what we ultimately wanted to order for dinner; ordering everything that caught our eyes would've resulted in a dinner for 8 pax rather than 2! There was also a long seasonal & specials menu to complement the regular menu!In the end, we had an oyster appetizer and unagi kamameshi set from the seasonal menu, and sashimi moriawase, salmon shioyaki set and tori karaage from the ala carte menu. The food was supremely delicious, and the ingredients fresh. The oyster was sweet and lightly grilled with ponzu sauce, the sashimi was flavourful (the maguro melted in our mouths), the salmon shioyaki was perfectly grilled and juicy, the karaage batter was light & crunchy with juicy chicken pieces and the unagi kamameshi was so fragrant and bursting with umami flavour that I literally finished every single grain of rice. After, we were served with fat slices of perfectly ripe watermelon to round off our meal, compliments of the house.The restaurant also features small gazebo-type seating for 2 or 6 pax outdoors, and it was really nice to enjoy the delicious meal with the nice breeze and setting sun - I highly recommend the experience (but seating is akin to sitting on the floor, though, so cross-legged instead of chairs).Service is attentive and conscientious, and while it definitely is not cheap eats, it didn't burn a hole in our pockets either. Being huge Japanese food aficionados, we can attest to the provision of quality, satisfying portions and value for money by Unkaizan.All in all, we had a delightful time there, and even seriously considered returning again for dinner the next day (but we decided to spread out our experience instead). Nevertheless, I'll definitely be back on my next trip to Langkawi!Show less

Author: GuyfromkzAlmaty, Kazakhstan
Title: Great place for an authentic Japanese food
Review: We visited it after a trip to cable car. Location was not close to us, but we are Japanese food lovers and were seeking for a authentic Japanese place. Sashimi, sushi, tepanyaki, hand made udon... all was great. Price is not cheap, but it fully corresponds to quality of food. 600myr for a family dinner, fair enough for a feel of visiting Japan in Langkawi ;)Show less

Author: 809neilf
Title: Great food and staff
Review: Really nice meal in a nice setting. Staff were great, would  recommend a table outside in the evening.

Author: Amanda TWoolpit, United Kingdom
Title: Close by our hotel but only just worth the visit
Review: We visited on our first night and were not akin to the local prices, variety,and food so feel it was a bit extravagent in price although the food was ok.Fresh fish o be chosen from live tanks but my husband chose the Wagyu beef and although very very small in size he said it was very good Wine expensive here and service okWould not be a place to rush back to. Show less

Author: roshanr786Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Wonderful Japanese Food
Review: Very secluded restaurant, if you don't get proper directions, you will have a slightly difficult locating it. Very friendly Chef Take & service crew. Anyway, try the gindara cod, the best grilled fish i ever had in my life. The fried rice, chawanmushi and sushi selection is superb with my favourite is the California Roll and ebi roll. I don't mind going back there again in the future.Show less

Author: emeliera
Title: Ok
Review: Cozy place and friendly staff but the food wasn't served at the same time. The food was ok but not a wow moment.

Author: Hazri Rohilio HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Exquisite Japanese in Langkawi
Review: Came to Unkaizen for birthday dinner. Was impressed with the service, food offerings and pricing. Sushi chef and owner really knew what he was doing, and the young local waitress be also knew her stuff. Ambiance was authentic tropical Langkawi a'la Japanese. We ordered live snapper made into Sashimi and Char grill. It was fantastic, the live snapper sashimi was cool treated before served- important to release the flavour of the raw fish. Swordfish sashimi Toro was so so, though. Homemade udon with tempura was good. We ordered deep-fried macha ice cream; batter was a tad thick but homemade ice cream was excellent. All in all one of the best Japanese restaurant experiences for me in Malaysia.Show less

Author: Josephine CSydney, Australia
Title: Best Japanese in Langkawi.
Review: If you are craving some Fresh Japanese you can't go past this restaurant. It was a bit of a drive from our hotel but only 5 minutes away from night markets and shopping. Sashimi was incredibly fresh and the wagyu beef melted in your mouth. Everything on the menu is delicious and the service was excellent. Highly recommend this place for authentic and traditionally served Japanese cuisine. Definitely make sure to book as it becomes booked out days in advance. Show less

Author: teejaydfromausSydney, Australia
Title: The best Japanese ever
Review: I can't say enough about the food here. I'm pescetarian and the seafood was delectable here. We had the miso salmon, a seafood teppanyaki and a tuna sashimi salad, all were amazing. Staff were beautiful. Hard to get in do hook early or be prepared to eat late - they seated is at 9pm and people were still arriving then! You won't regret a visit here, it's the only Japanese in the area but the best, a must try!! Oh and gets matcha green tea ice cream to cleanse afterwards, stunning! Show less

Author: WeiLynnGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: A Japanese dinner at Unkaizan – fresh, natural & simply exquisite
Review: We read about Unkaizan being rated as Malaysia’s best Japanese restaurant and it was evident to see why. Upon stepping into the Japanese hut on a hill, we were greeted and served by the pleasant and friendly crew that made you feel very welcome. We dined in the cozy restaurant – twice in 2 days because we loved it so much – where we savored salmon sashimi that melts in the mouth, sea bass lightly salted and grilled to perfection and fragrant salmon kamameshi (salmon and rice) cooked and served in an authentic Japanese iron pot (which I later googled up and learnt that it was called a kama). Even the miso soup and chawan mushi that came with one of our set meals were simply delightful! The chef was clearly a master in skillfully preserving the freshness and natural taste of the ingredients. Oh, what bliss… couldn’t have asked for more!Show less

Author: Jun751310
Title: Good Food
Review: If you like Japanese food you should try. Everyone say is good. For me the set dinner is value for what you get. I would recommand this place for those who like Japanese food.

Author: Quiscalus
Title: recommendable
Review:
The food was delicious. 
We sat outside (table). Nice view.
You can also sit japanese style in pavilions. 
Very friendly and attentive staff.
Reservation recommended.

Author: kekmuc
Title: Very good food and service
Review: Nice experience, a little expensive as most of the Japanese restaurants which offer very good quality ....

Author: chimanChicago
Title: Nice Japanese restaurant
Review: Good food and nice service.  Menu had a nice mix of fresh seafood and Japanese beef. Staff is friendly and the setting was very nice (we sat outside on the veranda - mosquitoes were not a problem).

Author: beatricel330
Title: Always great
Review: Was here several times with friends and boyfriend for dinner. Authentic Japanese food with authentic Japanese restaurant settings. Do not prefer their sushi but would always go for their cooked dishes. Good to visit during happy hour to get 50% of the drinks.

Author: CondeNastTraveller88
Title: Average Japanese food
Review: We went there for dinner after seeing so many complimentary reviews about this restaurant. We tried their tuna sashimi, (thought I ordered salmon sashimi but apparently I didn't because it never came) unagi, wagyu sirloin, ribeye and sushi set.We wanted to have our meals in sets with rice but somehow our requests were lost in translation. The tuna sashimi arrived first and it was so fresh we were so excited to try the rest of our order. The beef had been frozen too long so there was a freezer burn taste to it and the charcoal did nothing for the beef except make it even chewier as it wasn't hot enough so the steak was just stewing.The unagi was great especially after we asked for more charcoal as the measly one piece of charcoal it came in originally did nothing but for show.The sushi set was great but the selection of seafood was pretty regular. Salmon, tuna, butterfish, cooked prawn, cooked octopus and three pieces of minced tuna maki.The meal was ok but definitely not mind blowing and didn't use the abundant seafood available in langkawi.Show less

Author: wanzhung
Title: Delicious Japanese dinner
Review: You need to make advanced reservations otherwise you will be disappointed. Very good service and recommendation for today's special with fresh seafoods.

Author: Selalupergi
Title: Great Japanese restaurant
Review: Best Japanese restaurant on the island. Everything is fresh and excellent. Great service, very nice staff. Not to be missed

Author: GuunGoh
Title: Very good service
Review: I only can said this restaurant is very good. Excellent in their service and the food. The owner is the Japanese chef and this restaurant is awarded one of the best restaurant in 2016. The price is slightly higher but is worth for it.

Author: Melody812Kuala Lumpur
Title: Must try for Langkawi visitors - great Japanese cuisine
Review: This is my special spot in Langkawi. I cannot express how much I love this place. I strongly suggest anyone who visits here order their unagi kamameshi (Unagi with hot rice in a pot). That's a dish that I couldn't find similar experience in KL.Their sashimi is thicker than usual ones, so it's personal whether you would like it or not. My new darling is their saba shioyaki. Not to worry as they have some daily specials which will be written at visible corners in the restaurant. It is advisable to order some of their specials. They are mostly delightful.The ambience is quite nice as long you don't sit at outdoors (insects and mosquitoes will ruin your mood). If I remember correctly 6-7pm is happy hour, you can have 50% discount for some drinks and sake? Anyway my favourite at there is their Japanese plum wine. A good choice for ladies. Please try to make reservations. I noticed sometimes they are almost full and at least 4 reservation tables for every hour. You can call in around 3-5pm as they only open from 6pm. Sometimes off on Wednesday night. Service is always amazing with their friendly staff. They will always make good recommendations for you which ends up with a tasty dinner.The price range would be expensive for some people. Usually I would spend about RM 130-330 for two persons here inclduing sake, maguro sashimi, kamemeshi, natto, desserts and etc.Show less

Author: scarymary_real
Title: Good restaurant
Review:
Intro by the staff in ambong ambong says this is a must try restaurant. 
The food is good, friendly staff, mosquito free for outdoor seats - isn't it amazing?!
Please pay a visit if you are there in Langakawi.

Author: weiwulah
Title: Good food at a premium
Review: Food here is really unique and nice, but can be quite pricey depending on what you order. We had a baby with us but they couldn't accommodate... had to sit in the outdoor dining area and risk getting mosquito bites =(

Author: E5679WQsarahc
Title: Awesome! 2 thumbs UP!
Review: Unkaizan is definitely THE Japanese restaursnt to dine at. Fresh sashimi and very delicious Ika Teriyaki and chicken katsu. Very polite and helpful waitress too! Superbly satisfied!

Author: Dylan T
Title: Very Tasty Japanese Food
Review: As the restaurant is a bit secluded, i am very surprised by the number of diner.The balcony sit will allow you to have a good view of the sunset. The japanses is by far one of the most tasty one i had. I am so tempted to eat more even when i was very full.The staff is very friendly and will assist diner in any way they can. Thumb Up if you dun mind paying slightly more :DShow less

Author: SiNo_MoHaiTemerloh, Malaysia
Title: Family Dinner @ Fav Japanese Restaurant
Review: I came here because this is my favourite Japanese dining venue... & also my husband's. The taste of their food served during each visit is always consistent. The chef & his kitchen team are always on the dot when it comes to dishing out our orders... never experienced any delay, even when they are busy. I've tried quite a number of dishes & my family love them all, can't recommend any personally as taste buds may differ, but if you wish to go on an adventure, come here! Before i forget, a special mention goes out to their lovely managress & staff; nothing is too much trouble for them. Show less

Author: Planet76Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: No need for a trip to Japan when you have Unkaizan
Review: The sushi (California & Ebi) done by Chef Také came up tops on my family's list of favourites. The chicken teriyaki, grilled beef, green tea noodles, miso & garlic fried rice are prepared to perfection... testaments to the consistency that Unkaizan is renowned for. The chef's lovely restaurant manager, hostess/cashier & service staff are super friendly, professional & knowledgeable, reflecting their oriental philosophy of getting things in order, emphasizing more on quality rather than quantity. No wonder they have a permanent fan base. Will not hesitate to recommend Unkaizan to anyone who is game for some gastronomic Japanese authenticity. Looking for to our next dinner here.Show less

Author: Ahmed_ElmadaniAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best sushi experiences
Review: Tried this restaurant based on the tripadvisor reviews and it was fantastic. Honestly I did not expect this sushi level at Langkawi and we were surprised by how good it was.We tried the nigiri, salmon, tuna, eel, octopus, etc.. and it was very good, the salmon nigiri in particular stood out, salmon was fresh and rice perfectly cooked. we also tried the rolls and they were very good as well to say the least.Best thing about this restaurant is that it is authentic Japanese, you dont see many items in the sushi and sashimi sections, only nigiri and rolls which is very traditional.We also tried the tepenyaki squid and shrimp tempura which was excellent but the highlight of the meal was the sushi, you have to try it.The service was very good, they called a taxi for us after finishing our meal as it was late and the place is a little out town.And by the way, the restaurant prices was very reasonable too.I would definitely go there again if I visited Langkawi again in the future.P.S. I suggest to make a reservation before going if possible as they were able to accommodate us without one but we had to wait for 20 minutesShow less

Author: davidV5335RQ
Title: 5 minuties from our room
Review: Tried a lot of Japanese food I had never eaten before and loved it all My son had the eel and loved it

Author: Ching LWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxing dining
Review: We fancied something different on the island and discovered this little gem. We initially we booked Mizumi at the oriental village but the staff weren't particularly helpful. We wanted to sit in the tatami area but because there were only two of us, we were abruptly refused unless we are willing to sit at the normal table.Back to Unkaizan. It is a small intimate restaurant. Staff make you feel like it is a family run establishment. We sat outside in one of the booths. They have extremely comfortable cushion for you to relax on. You can easily fall asleep on them! The other nice touch is that they provide mosquito repellent. Food. Tasted and presented well. Huge selection for whatever you fancy on the night. We had eel, a selection of sushi and sashimi etc. They tasted fresh and delicious. You can have fresh seafood to choose from the tanks by the entrance too. Price wise, in contrast with the cheap food you can get around Langkawi, it was quite expensive. I would say it is a good place to eat for a rare treat. We finished our dinner only to realise that we left the headlights on. We couldn't start the car at this point. Staff came out to see if they could help and eventually the chef came out, moved his car, took a jump lead out to recharge the battery. They did go out of their way to assist us. Give this place a try if you want something other than street food. Relaxing surrounding with nice food.Show less

Author: LWCheahSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Good Japanese food hidden in a corner of Langkawi
Review: One simple word - EXCELLENT !The seafood is fresh and the environment is pleasant. If you do not mind an early dinner, you can catch a great sunset from a hillside view.Advisable to phone in and book in advance. On certain days, it is completely booked.Show less

Author: ChefKaylaTravels
Title: Tempura prawns.
Review:
I have never had tempura prawns like I did here, and the food and Sake was 10/10, homemade IceCream too! 
wow just wow, would come back 100 times over. 
Lovely people too

Author: StefanieTan
Title: Refined japanese dining experience
Review: A great selection of authentic japanese food served in a cozy restaurant. A must try if you are in Langkawi but do make reservations as the place is often packed even on weeknights.

Author: MitteSartoKolind, Denmark
Title: The most amazing fresh fish and steak
Review: We went to this restaurant and had a little sushi, a few different salads with fresh grilled fish and wagu steak. Everything was absolutly amazing. Compared to Malaysian standards a very expensive restaurant, but compared to Danish stands so much value for money. The meal would have been at least double price in Denmark.Show less

Author: amuromahmoud
Title: It was a nice experience
Review: The food was lovely and tasted amazing, the staff was really friendly and nice. The restaurant had a nice location for romantic dinners.

Author: BarryOilyDave
Title: Great meal
Review: An excellent restaurant, in the rainforest, with a great menu selection, and authentic Japanese food

Author: Jess AAdelaide, Australia
Title: Relaxing and delicious
Review: We didn't have a booking but were still accommodated with a lovely Japanese style sitting table. The waitresses were all friendly and polite. The seafood and Angus beef tepanyaki were delicious with drinks at happy hour prices from 6-7pm. Handmade green tea ice cream was also creamy and delicious.Show less

Author: Nicholas TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Still the best Japanese restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: It has been more than a few years (maybe a closer to a decade) since I have last been here and I remembered that the food and service here was good. Well - we were not left disappointed. My guests and I had a great dining experience here - the food is good and the price reasonable for whatever we ordered. A must-visit if you are in Langkawi. The location is slightly off the main stretch so I recommend getting a cab / driving there. The restaurant was nice to help us get a cab for our trip back.Show less

Author: joshgeeePhu Quoc Island, Vietnam
Title: "THE" Japanese restaurant in Langkawi!
Review: Unkaizan restaurant is located in a small secluded area. Their sign is a bit small (easy to miss; your attention might be fixated into a bigger signage in front of it). So those who are driving might want to look closely. The place is not that big yet felt really comfortable once we were seated on our table (did an early reservation). Japanese decorations, kimono-wearing staffs, traditional japanese music -- Simplicity! The staffs are friendly, warm and accommodating. You can see them smiling all the time. They gave us oshiboris before handing us the menus. We waited around 10-15 minutes before our first order was served. Everything was fresh; from the seafood to the beef. Food here is amazing!Undoubtedly one of the best in Langkawi. Not cheap though. But you will definitely get your money's worth. Show less

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Japanese fine dining
Review: My partner and I visited Unkaizen around 7 p.m. and there was only one table without reservation. We were lucky to have the last table outside their indoor venue.Their waitress was effective and passionate to have some common chit-chats with their customers during the order, and offered you enough time think about what do you need actually. I liked the way their waitress conveyed the information of their special offerings, and reconfirmed our order. Everything was polite and friendly.In terms of food, I could taste the freshness and moderate seasoning in all of their dishes, e.g. grilled saba, assorted grilled seafoods, cold soba with tempura and homemade ice cream. None of the mentioned dished failed to delight me and my partner, and we spent more than one hour to pair our meal with Unkaizan's scenery and breezy surrounding.Kindly note that total damages for this meal (2 persons) were around RM 150 and I was satisfied with the price tag since everything was excellent. They did provide mosquito repellent for outdoor diners since there were many mosquitoes outdoor. Kindly book a table ahead of your arrival since Unkaizen was fully seated even during weekday night.Show less

Author: Teny_W78
Title: Good but not amazing
Review: steep prices for average food. We didn't have a booking but managed to get a table. However staff were friendly and helpful. The inside of the restaurant was hot and stuffy bordering on being uncomfortable.

Author: wheelercraig
Title: Great sushi place in Langkawi!
Review: Friendly service, lovely view from typical Japanese table and yummy sushi, thank you! Happy Hour is between 5-7 at sunset!

Author: jiaaqi
Title: Price on the steeper side but really decent Japanese food
Review: Be prepared to fork out at least MYR70 per person (excluding drinks!). You get what you paid for - service was exceptionally good and food was pretty decent- probably one of the better Japanese restaurants here in Malaysia. Come here before 7pm for a picturesque sunset view. You can choose to dine at the El Fresco outdoor seat (mosquitoe repellent is provided!) amidst a nice garden & sea view, the traditional Japanese seats upstairs or the normal seat seat. Happy hour from 6pm-7pm. 50% off drinks!Show less

Author: katerinalouiseEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible Japanese food
Review: Really enjoyed our meal at Unkaizan. It's a little way out but worth the visit. Whilst the atmosphere is not like those of some other restaurants in langkawi, as there is little view and no music / entertainment, it makes up for it in service and food quality. Our waitress was fantastic, her English was very impressive. She explained the menu in thorough detail and made recommendations. The food was really good, particularly the tempura prawn sushi. Black cod was the equivalent of £12! A great little find. Show less

Author: QinVinLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Psycho Steak and Sashimi!
Review: This is a second review of this restaurant. The level of food quality and dining experience has increased again. Started off with a superb delivery of menu and daily speciality from the new team member. First we had California roll, with all the ingredients being to distinctive in taste. Continued with steak set and it was warm all the way until the end. Unique experience.Managed to convince a rookie to try raw fish and he liked the Tuna sashimi after a second slice (belly part with fats in between). Finished off with green tea ice cream. A very solid meal. Thank you!Show less

Author: scottdacurtyErfurt, Germany
Title: Actual japanese Food (without good vegetarian options)
Review: This restaurant offers a nice japanese experience with good food. The staff is very, very friendly and makes you feel welcome. They even have a menu for vegetarians. And in the menu there are different kinds of vegetarians listed (if u eat fish or not, if you eat egg or not) which was super helpful because just because a dish is called "vegetable tempura" it doesn't mean that it's vegetarian(it was fish stock). What I didn't like is that they had no real options for vegetarians who neither eat fish or meat except for cucumber maki and white rice, and for a bit pricier restaurant it's a bit sad. There are ways to prepare actually japanese food in a vegetarian way but that apparently seem like too much of an effort for them. Show less

Author: Sidewinder456Tallinn, Estonia
Title: Good
Review: Went to Unkaizan one night to order food for a takaway. Staff was really friendly and gave us advise what is what. We choose our dishes, and agreed with staff to pick it up later, after returning from our walk from the beach. When we returned our order was ready. The portion was big and the food really tasty. Deffinetly recommended to visit.Show less

Author: YMCA24Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty authentic Japanese Cuisine, Ummai!
Review: This restaurant is about 2 km away from Holiday Villa Langkawi, which is almost reaching Awana Porto Malai. Classy place and we were served by bubbly and charming Siti. She explained the menu in details for us to order correctly. Basically we ordered the King crab leg rice, teppan seafood and clams in sake broth. The cooking style is strong in flovour and salty, suits me well, but maybe not for those with light taste buds. Enjoy the meal and hospitality there and highly recommend. Price is on the higher side, but the ingredients were fresh and well cooked. Kudos..Show less

Author: Rona N
Title: Good as always !
Review:
Been here many times and really always enjoyed the food. Good service and friendly staffs .
And wish can comeback again and again !

Author: StevenAEIPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Corporate Trip to Langkawi
Review: Exceptional meal and a wonderful experience for myself and my sales team.I had been to Unkaizan many times and they have never fail on my expectations. My entire staffs also get the chance to enjoy their dinner and many commented "delicious"The unkaizan waitresses were at all times very friendly and service oriented.Great job.Show less

Author: jjjakobchef
Title: nice place for japanese food
Review:
great service - food is good basic japanese - ambiance is very nice outside ..
best to book before to get good seats ..always busy , have laso sake but limited addition ..wines a few

Author: LSCheongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome! Didn't disappoint!
Review: Got a seat in the garden, was expecting it to be hot and uncomfortable, but was surprised to find such nice little sheds for individual tables (seating jap style, folding legs).Food was above our expectations and service was top notch! Can't recommend this place enough!Would surely be going back for more visits. Enjoyable and memorable experience for my wife and I. Show less

Author: 680zulrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Japanese restaurant on the island
Review: The restaurant comes in 2 different section; indoor and out door. I opt to sit outdoor at the Sala. Food consider a bit pricy but truly fresh and delicious. Staffs and services were amazing. Due to surrounding nature, I found lots of mosquitoes and it's a bit annoying. Other than that, highly recommended for those visiting the island.Show less

Author: Richard G
Title: Kampai!!!!
Review: Amazing food and service. Anyone who doesn't like this restaurant doesn't have working taste buds. Be sure to check out the excellent range of Saki's!! 🐠🐟🐡👍🏻

Author: BallardBeaverSeattle
Title: Disappointing in So Many Ways
Review: Let's start with the sunset view that they advertise. Their website touts the wonderful view from the dining room or the terrace. What they don't say is that they have now built three gazebos with Japanese-style seating (i.e., cross-legged) that totally block the view of the water from either the dining room or the terrace. Very frustrating and I'd say their website amounts to nothing less than false advertising.Then, the food...My companion, Elizabeth, ordered a combination of sushi and cold soba noodles. I ordered a combo of the cold soba noodles and tempura. We both thought that even dipped in the cold soup that accompanied the noodles, the soba was disappointingly bland. The sushi was, Elizabeth thought, "tired:. My tempura was good, although it came without the normal dipping sauce. When I asked about the missing sauce I was told that they expected me to dip the tempura in the soup. When I objected that the taste was not at all the same as tempura dipping sauce, they, somewhat grudgingly, brought me the dipping sauce.,Elizabeth finally ordered two pieces of their special salmon belly nigiri sushi and thought that it was excellent and that the rice was better than the rice with her other sushi.With a glass of beer and a glass of shiraz (at happy hour prices) and a 10% service charge, the bill came to 176 ringgit, about $42.00.Overall, this was a serious let-down..Show less

Author: shiyanl2016
Title: Decent but overpriced - still worth a visit
Review: Food was of very good standard. The assorted sashimi platter was very fresh with the exception of the salmon pieces. Sukiyaki broth was delicious but beef arrived fully cooked through which was a bit of a disappointment. Service was exemplary.

Author: CurvermacSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food not Fresh
Review: The Wagyu beef appeared to have spent time in a freezer. Cooked to perfection - medium rare yet not juicy.The Tuna shashimi was fishy. Should have known. When I asked for the better cuts- toro-was told that the get whole whole fish which the butcher and all the best bits were sold out. Which must have meant that we were eating the remnants of the fish which must have been hanging round for a long time.The restaurant is in the back of beyond and definitely not worth the cab fare. The staff were cheerful and knowledgable but let down by the quality of the raw materials.Sat outside for the sunset but when it did happen, was hidden by trees.Show less

Author: Jennifer SManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Wow - fantastic food, best meal in langkawi
Review: We ate here on Christmas Eve and had a memorable meal. The food was utterly fantastic and delicious. We had blue tuna fin sashimi that melted in the mouth and the fish cooked on charcoal was perfect. To finish we had the deep fried ice cream that was so light it wasn't stodgy at all. Would recommend to anyone in Langkawi who wants a treat meal. Show less

Author: JaJo-London
Title: Unimpressive japanese
Review: Should have tasted great as restaurant was packed, sea bass swimming in tanks but it all seemed a bit tired by the time it got to our table. Specials not that special etc.  Not worth the 30 minute cab ride from the hotel

Author: _B6427HZKyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Good japanese food, but a bit overpriced
Review: We had a good stay there. The personnel, as it seemed from our perspective, were too much kind with a lot of nods and overpleasing. The sea food was great, they serve grilled dishes with a plate heated by coal. The view is spectacular at the outside area. We had no problems with mosquitos due to available repellent, additionally they organized repellent fumes near each table. The fruits we had ordered from the set was given to us only in the end. The dishes in general are two times overpriced comparing with Cactus restaurant located nearby. Recommended because of very specialized menu, some dishes you can try only here. Book the table in advance as the restaurant is very popular. We waited for 15 minutes.Show less

Author: PeteNHannahBrisbane
Title: Nice dinner
Review: We had dinner at Unkaizan towards the end of our stay on the island.The food was tasty and service was friendly, but it was very pricey compared to other places on the island and for some of the portion sizes.If you stay at Ambong (which we did), you will receive 10% off your bill and complimentary ice cream.Show less

Author: massivewheelsBolton, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic Japanese Food
Review: We booked for dinner on Christmas Eve, the restaurant was busy and it gave a pleasant environment to eat in. The food was very authentic and tasty, the staff were friendly enough, but when we asked for recommendations they didn't really listen to what we'd said.That aside, it was a delicious meal.You can sit outside and watch the sunset too.Show less

Author: RamseyNY6Spring Valley, California
Title: A hidden jewel in the mountain!
Review: This restaurant is hidden in the mountain, with a great view to the sea. Architecture resembled Japanese culture, mixed with Western. They serve excellent food with wide range of choices including sashimi, beef, sushi, udon, cold noodles, dessert, alcohol and many more. Above all, it comes with high-rated service (staffs served with patience, smiles and offered guides in choosing the food)Show less

Author: ECKLKualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less is More Part 152 - Delightful Forest Izakaya
Review: Being one of the top two Japanese restaurants on the the island, lured by the TA reviews and located at the doorstep of our hotel made it inevitable that we dined here during our three-night getaway to Langkawi. Reservations were essential and with the assistance of our hotel, an 8:30pm seating was secured. The restaurant looks like a cottage hidden in a jungle, very rustic, charming and resembles something you would find in the Japanese countryside. It's very small (the indoor portion probably seats no more than 20). The serving staff was very helpful and ever so polite especially Siti.We ordered both from the ala carte menu and the specials of the day - a half-n-half sashimi-chargrilled live seabass, chargrilled Angus ribeye, King Crab rice, Assorted Sushi (Umi), Prawn tempura, Oyster miso soup and a very delightful Bansyaku set (a warm sake with 3 appetizers). Have to say that everything was well prepared, well seasoned and well presented albeit a little simply but not out of place given the casual rustic countryside look and feel. Its authenticity vouched for by chefs from Osaka.Quality is quite high so the premium prices are justifiable. As guests of Ambong-Ambong, there's a 10% discount if you pay by cash. Unkaizen has happily found her niche market here where there's a plethora of cuisines like Indian, Turkish, Middle Eastern, Chinese, Malay - many only serving inexpensive tourist quality food. Unkaizen is on a much higher level in so many ways and seems resolute on keeping it so. Bravo!Show less

Author: Sham CKl
Title: Authentic Japanese
Review: Rare to a restaurant in Langkawi (not in a hotel) so dedicated to its cuisine. Aided by two fluent speaking Japanese staff at front of house, the Japanese chef/operator is known to be meticulous to his craft having cooked for the serving King of Malaysia . Pricey (depending what you order) but well worth it. My husband's favourite is the grilled salmon head and the kids love the home made ice cream. with specials of the day, this is the real thing.Show less

Author: Jonny L
Title: Lovely place, lovely food
Review: The food is great and the service is awesome. We were greeted with a smile from when we arrived till we leave.

Author: Sage2724Australia
Title: Very good
Review: We have been to this restaurant in the past , about 12 months ago and it has been excellent in every way. This visit we were still very happy with the food which is interesting , delicious and well presented. The waitress was lovely and helpful. We did notice that the actual restaurant seating area needs a bit of a tidy up. The bar was so cluttered that they could not rest drinks there. They were washing bar cloths in a transparent machine which you could see from the table. And our accompanying rice plates came out after we had eaten our fish which seemed odd and unnecessary. Also all of the wines are so ridiculously expensive for a duty free island that we just had juice. We rang to book at 6pm and were told we could come at 7pm or 830 and that they would only hold our booking for 1/2 hour. We opted for the 8.30 because we were quite a way from Cenang, and when we arrived there was only one table occupied. It is still a special place to go for lovely Japanese food, they just need to improve the bar area and delivery of dishes.Show less

Author: JennYong
Title: Unexpected Japanese Gem
Review: When we were recommended this restaurant by a Japanese hotel staff, we were abit unsure... But we saw so many good review that we decided to give it a try. It was definitely a good recommendation as we were there 2 nights in a row!!! The pricing is reasonable and the food quality was fantastic!!! The current seasonable live fish is sea bass so we had it done half sashimi and half grilled. This fish tasted so good grilled that on our next night there, we ordered it all grilled.If you are sake lover, must try is the sake set @ RM45 which includes a 300ml bottle house sake and 3 appetizer. The sake is a good quality house sake.The bento set dinners are definitely good value for money. We ordered the tempura udon set and Sanma Shioyaki set and they were all around RM30 to RM35 for each set. The taste were also very authentic Japanese... No short cut despite it located in Langkawi, not a place known for Japanese food.Another 2 seasonal winners were the Grilled Ika (RM32) and Japanese style Claypot Crab leg rice set (RM45).Don't miss this place and reservation is a must!Show less

Author: kengster
Title: As good as reviews
Review: Hidden off the street of Cenang area, his restaurant had withstood the test of time and remained popular. We ordered the sets which were good value. Portions were generous and probably more than enough for most adults. Good service, always ready to help with requests or advice on Langkawi sightseeing Show less

Author: Alex MPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Japanese food, very friendly service.
Review: We had an excellent Japanese dinner. The food is very good and the seafood is very fresh. All our orders came out really over our expectations and portions really well. Yes soy sauce is not free, but is just to prevent wastage. Food this good, u don't even need soy sauce.As for service,the staff is overly friendly and helpful. All smiles around even with our kids around. Don't know why some say they are unfriendly.Price above average, but I don't really mind as the food is more than worth it.Been there 10 years ago and then last night. Definitely will dine here again next trip. Show less

Author: Teresa B
Title: Very good Japanese cuisine!
Review: We had a very nice evening, with delicious food and drinks! The sushi and main courses were very good and the wine list has some good wines to offer as well.

Author: simply-blissfulLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Never Disappoints
Review: As a long time resident of Langkawi, if there was ever a place that I want to go and have good food and good service, this would be one on my top 10.Of course, it helps that they know what my friends and I want...so personal recommendation is the Spicy California Rolls, the Yasai Salad as appetisers. Main course - you can never go wrong with the Sushi Gozen but if you are not into sushi for some reason, go ahead and get any of the grilled fish options or the Gyu Katsu Ni and for dessert, try the green tea ice cream with red beans.I would also recommend an advance reservation as even long time customers would have trouble just walking in to get a seat as there are nearly always full.Show less

Author: GeochongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Geeat food... but charges for soy sauce?
Review: We ordered the rice bento set. Foos is great the sashimi is fresh. Only surprise is that if you ask for additional wasabi or doy sauce they charge extra RM 1. Waitress says someone abused soy sauce and wasabi hence they are charging it now. I think the management should be fair and allow only one request for additional soy sauce or wasabi. Can't be so calculative for an expensive restaurant. I would have rated it excellent or very good other than this point. The service and ambience is great.Show less

Author: Gab_RachSingapore
Title: Must try - great Japanese food!
Review: This is by far one of the best Japanese food I have eaten. The restaurant had a great ambience and the staff were all very friendly and responsive. The food was amazing - sashimi was very fresh, salmon grilled to perfection, tempura beautifully fried and the california maki was delicious. It is located just next to Ambong Ambong - they even have special offers for guests staying there! A must try when you are in Langkawi!Show less

Author: zahairi
Title: Not much to say
Review: Go there & let the food do the talking. Guaranteed satisfaction. Not to forget the service that match the food.

Author: Bethan BHaverfordwest, Wales, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing service
Review: Amazing service, I wish I could remember the lady name that served us as she was very helpful. We were not entirely sure what everything on menu was and she was great at explaining everything to us. The food was very quick and very tasty. Definitely recommend this place to anyone.Show less

Author: huanyinchanMalaysia
Title: The right place for Japanese Food in Langkawi
Review: I heard a lot of good reviews about Unkaizen all this while but I have not got any chance to try due to the itinerary arrangement s although I have visited the island few times before. It is located at the entrance of Ambong-Ambong Resort and right in front of Lanai. We were family of 5 and I have called to make a table reservation on the day itself. The restaurant has 3 dining areas- ground floor indoor, 1st floor indoor and outdoor. I have requested for outdoor seating and the lady who received my call kindly advised me to seat indoor instead as there will be lots of mosquitoes outdoor and it is not that suitable for children. We arrived slightly early and have been brought to the long table near to the outdoor dining area. Unkaizen is a rather smaller type of Japanese restaurant and nothing to be shouted about on the design. However, the food we ordered was majorly delicious and fresh. We love the grilled sea bass with salt from the special menu particularly. The teppanyaki lobster however was slightly over cooked. Between, the way of rice serving in a steel bowl could ensure the warmness of the rice and the blue fin tuna salad that served with seaweed sheets also quite impressive.Service was quite attentive especially the Malay lady and the Japanese from Kyoto who served us mainly. The price is not cheap but it was acceptable for the quality of food we received. I will not compare Unkaizen with some others top notch Japanese Restaurants in the Capital City however is a right place for Japanese food in Langkawi.Show less

Author: alix159
Title: Good Japanese food, great service
Review: I've had better but this is good for an island. Run by a Japanese chef. We sat outdoors for the sunset view (which, by the way, wasn't actually that spectacular and there were many insects), but was nicer than sitting indoors.We ordered the catch of the day (seabass, in sashimi and grilled), sushi, sashimi, teriyaki cod, sake, and ice cream in cinnamon and macha. The seabass, sake and ice cream were excellent. The others were not bad but not outstanding. Our server Akane was very friendly and attentive, and definitely helped make our dining experience that much better. Worth a visit overall if you are craving Japanese food, but recommended to book ahead as it was crowded.Show less

Author: Praveen R
Title: Award winning Japanese Restaurant in Langkawi
Review: This award winning restaurant serves fantastic food,the teriyake and sushi platter are truly awesome.

Author: LipSengYap
Title: The one and only Japanese Restaurant worth it in Langkawi
Review: Highly rated as the best (and only) proper Japanese Restaurant in Langkawi, service is always good, food fresh and authentic. Price is a little on high side, but worth it.

Author: huiyeeg2015Kuala Lumpur
Title: Great food
Review: We had dinner here. We ordered a grill seabass, a seafood soup in claypot, and ebi tempura dinner set. I really love the soup.Suggest to make reservation before visit as there are limited seats. Parking bays are limited as well, you may have to park at the road side and walk up the slope to reach the restaurant.You may request to get the seats on their first floor to view sunset. I did not get to see sunset as the weather was not that good. Anyway, I enjoyed the food a lot.Show less

Author: Claire K
Title: Wow !
Review: What a great place ! Food is not only good but amazing ! We rediscovered the world of Japanese food thanks to this place. Quiet and cosy the patio is most def one of the best place to eat in Langkawi ! Thanks !!!

Author: Danielle S. L
Title: Excellent choice
Review: We were happy to find this place. The staff was quite friendly, the food was of very high quality, and the setting was beautiful.

Author: Her MHong Kong, China
Title: Not exceptionally good but good
Review: We came here because the ad in our local map says it's "winner of Malaysia's Best Restaurant since 2005". Given that they only have three Japanese restaurants in Langkawi, we're not surprised that Unkaizan is rated so highly.We tried to book through our hotel concierge earlier in the day but they replied saying a table's only available at 9pm. We thought that was a bit late so we just declined. Then when we're done with some activities nearby and it's past 8:35pm, we decided to give it a 2nd try and this time they could book us back in the 9pm slot. They asked us if we'd like downstairs ( tables and chairs ) or upstairs ( tatami ) and we opted for the latter. We're really very close by and when we arrived it's 10 mins to 9 and the young lady smiled and apologised that the tatami wouldn't be ready until 9pm, so we said it's ok to swap to sitting downstairs.Service was prompt and friendly, a native Japanese waitress explained everything on the ' Daily Special ' board and those on the menu. We ordered green tea and no sake.The salmon sashimi was very moist, fresh and the 5 pieces were thickly sliced. The spicy california rolls were good but not that spicy. The 2 pcs of ikura sushi were generous and fresh with the roes bursting at the bite. We were still hungry so we ordered a 2nd round of sushi rolls. Each roll comes in 6 pcs, and we ordered again, spicy california roll, salmon & spring onion roll and shrimp tempura roll. Before all these arrived, our tempura udon and hot udon in plain broth arrived. The udon was al dente , the tempura had two good sized shrimps in a light batter, yet the broth was not piping hot enough but just a bit more than lukewarm, so that marred the overall taste as hot stuff has to be served very hot. As in their green tea, it was not hot enough so we requested some boiling water to refill our pot.Then our fresh sea bream arrived, the size we requested, caught live from the tank. It's 16RM/kg and ours was 750kg. It came on a small grill with red charcoals under the net. It was the same fish that they had shown us when they netted it out of the tank, as sometimes in unscrupulous eateries they could show u one thing and cook u another thing, but Unkaizan was honest. The fish was very fresh and juicy, but the meat albeit firm was on the tough side so u needed to chew quite a bit. The grated white turnip accompaniment added zest to the taste, otherwise just eating that fish with no condiments could be bland. We also ordered the wagyu beef on a hot ceramic plate, which was tender and juicy but far from the word 'delicious'. Very ordinary dish indeed. Perhaps they had used a bit too much bicarbonate of soda to ' soften' the tissues to ensure it's not tough, but that way the texture of the meat was not ' meaty' enough but just some very tender flesh nicely fried. The sauce was also on the thick side, so this wagyu beef did not exactly live up to our expectations.Then the additional sushi rolls came.
