The salmon & spring onion roll was nondescript, and the shrimp tempura roll was also ordinary, in fact, the end ( tail ) bit that stuck out was hard. The ginger was good though, moist and fresh.We were too full and only managed one home made green tea ice cream, which came as a big scoop served with some red bean paste. The ice cream was good and rounded off a good meal nicely.The ladies were very friendly and ordered a taxi for us to take us back to our hotel, which was a 30 min drive. I would not say it is a must to eat in Unkaizan but if you lower your standard and do not expect top notch Japanese food, then this place is a nice alternative to some very stodgy food. Cos even though we're stuffed to the nose when we left the restaurant, it did not leave us a heavy dull feeling, apparently because their food was really fresh and almost grease free.Certainly warm and cheerful service helped a lot.Show less

Author: Irina KMoscow, Russia
Title: Come and enjoy
Review: We stayed in Ambong Ambong and therefore could not avoid visiting this restaurant which is located next to the hotel and highly rated. After reading all the reviews and ratings we expected a bit more, probably more decor in the interior which was rather simple. However, the food was good and the portions were impressive, staff was very attentive and gentle, the overall atmosphere was calming and friendly. We really enjoyed it. Just to note that we were offered to sit on the mats not on the chairs, this is rather exotic way for Europeans and you have to be ready for this. Ladies, better to wear pants in this situation.Show less

Author: NomadicBoysLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Yummy Japanese meal
Review: We came here on the back of recommendations from staff at nearby Ambong Ambong and were not disappointed.It's not the cheapest but worth every penny. We had a sushi starter to share then a bento each (eel and chicken). Everything was very good and staff smiley and welcoming.Show less

Author: MyTyLoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Japanese Restaurant in the Country
Review: Over the years, the ambience has gotten warmer and the food ever so good. Specials--from time-to-time--spice up available options but we always enjoy sashimi, California maki, nabeyaki udon, salmon kamameshi and green tea ice cream.Ever since we dined here, we have generally stopped eating at Japanese restaurants anywhere else.Show less

Author: MChall8Coventry, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food, Great Staff
Review: We visited this Japanese Restuarant after we had a spa in Chaneng and was quite late in the evening. However, the food was amazing, staff very nice and it was in a good little setting. I would recommend you get a taxi to the restaurant as it is a bit out of the way at the end of the "Strip" but it would be worth a visit.All the food was good, sushi i'm told was amazing. There is a lot of choice and the price is reasonable as well. You can see on entry they have won many food awards and that shows in the cooking as we really couldn't fault anything we ate. Just to warn we did sit outside and it was late, mosquito were about. The restaurant do put insect repellent on the table. We had the choice to sit inside which we probably should have done now but wanted the breeze. A great restaurant, would defiantly return.Show less

Author: IntRKuwait City, Kuwait
Title: Best Japanese restaurant
Review: The tastiest Japanese food I ever had.Head Chef is the owner of this restaurant.It holds yearly awards as the best Japanese restaurant in Malaysia starting from 2005.Prices are much lower than I was expecting and I loved the environment and quality of food.Visited twice in two weeks.Highly recommend to visit.Show less

Author: bbchuHong Kong, China
Title: Friendly staff, above average seafood, nice sunset view, fair location
Review: My wife and I booked for a sunset view dinner, several weeks ago by email with friendly reply from Akane. She also serve us on the day with suggestion on the food order with bright smile on face.We've order seabass (half grilled and half sashimi), a sake (recommended by Akane), blue fin tuna sushi, moriawase uni (?) and a traditional mince fish salad (i forgot the name). Food is freshly prepared. The seabass is superb in both style. But I think the rice in sushi will taste better if not too soft.Sunset start around 7pm. The view is magnificient. Every outside table got mosquito repellent spray, good service. But it's just a bit hot sitting outside. It's still acceptable.The restaurant is a 20min walk from our resort. Just a straight road walk with a final little bit uphill. It can be found easily with Google Map.Food price is a bit pricey but it is still acceptable with the service and atmosphere. I think more smile in waitstaff can impress customers more.Show less

Author: sallys982Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Japanese food
Review: Theres hits and misses. Hits are excellent service, really really fresh n delicious sashimi. Orders the ribeye steak set, value for money. Disappointing is the lobster tepanyaki which was on the special menu of the day. It taste a bit mushy and was not as fresh as I had expected. Show less

Author: jianan1981
Title: One of the best Japanese food
Review: Decided to try Japanese food in langkawi. Searched through trip advisor and decided to give it a shot after reading so many excellent review. After our delicious dinner with warm service given by the staff, it would be unjust to the restaurant if I didn't provide my review. The food taste was authentic and delicious. I had the sea bass and salmon and sushi, they all tastes fresh. Despite pricey, in my opinion, it is worth the spending. Also, while the location is not one of the easiest place to locate it is worth the hunt too. Anyone who would like to get some authentic Japanese food in langkawi, one should NOT miss this place.Show less

Author: lcksyd
Title: Go here
Review: Solid Japanese fare. Good prices. Friendly service. May be the best Japanese in Langkawi. The sashimi is good but the best are the grilled dishes. Salmon grill is recommended. There's even red bean ice cream.

Author: DavidL11707
Title: Possibly the BEST Japanese restaurant in Malaysia with friendly staff..
Review: The food served was very nice and fresh especially the sashimi and the BBQ salmon .... Besides of food, the staff was very friendly and some of them came from Japan too, they are really friendly and I could feel very comfortable and enjoy when dining in. The price is reasonable and valuable. The homemade maccha ice cream is a must try Many Many likes for this restaurant ^^ Must go again when I go Langkawi next trip ~~Show less

Author: BeanettaLangkawi
Title: Exceptional Quality
Review:
Everything about this restaurant is amazing.
The setting. The attentive staff. The reasonable prices.
The quality of the food is outstanding. It is a melt in your mouth experience. One you shouldn't miss!

Author: Gwen H
Title: Exceptional Japanese food
Review: I must say that the food at Unkaizan was definitely of above average quality. Service is impeccable too. Do try the teppan lobster. The best I had ever eaten. A bit pricey, but worth it!

Author: ivan c
Title: Dinner on the hill
Review: Only japanese restaurant in Langkawi worth the money. Knowledgeable and friendly staff. Quick service and well priced. Vast selection on the menu. Comfortable ambiance.

Author: WyvernsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Would go back again for more!
Review: We didn't make a reservation, so I would consider us very lucky to secure the last table for the night yesterday. The service was excellent throughout and we were really pampered. We sat outside and had a beautiful sunset view! Insect repellant was provided and for good reason. But the food more than made up for it. We had grilled salmon, grilled eel, udon kamameshi, cold soba, and the sets came with all the usual add-ons so they were filling. In fact, the salmon was so good I ordered another serving! The daily specials are written on s blackboard - look out for it!Cold green tea free flow at 2RM was refreshing. Honeydew juice cost only 10RM!We hardly had space for dessert - unfortunately they were not serving teppan ice cream last night. I'm surprised this restaurant was named Malaysian Tatler's best restaurant for several years running. It's quaint and cosy. The prices are very reasonable and I would want to go back again if I have the chance.Show less

Author: ShiF9
Title: Fresh sashimi with real Japanese touch
Review: Tried their catch of the day called "kisu" fish, really love the freshness of the fish and crisp tender fresh fish. would recommend this restaurant. it's not like any normal japanese chain restaurant like Sushi Tei or Sakae sushi, it's fine japanese quisine. although a bit pricey.Show less

Author: bambu3lifeLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Always Good
Review: First came across Chef Takae in 1997 at the Andaman hotel and have followed him to his own restaurant at Unkaizan. Just had a quiet evening over a grilled Salmon head simple set meal. The meal, like always is prepared with simplicity and full of soul. The restaurant is very Japanese in every sense with a distant flavor of an Izakaya homely feel. It is the approach to simplicity and quiet attention to detail that set the food apart from other fine Japanese restaurant in the ASEAN region. I rate it as the best one can ever have outside of Japan. Indeed a rare gem and proud its in Langkawi. Show less

Author: SuzKL12Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Gem
Review: Loved the food here so much that I'll probably come back for more. Had the grilled Salmon with the steamed rice and Salmon belly sashimi. It was heavenly. The salmon belly is so fresh. Also try homemade macha ice cream. Price is on the upside. But the food was worth it. Definitely will come back whenever I'm in town. Show less

Author: CoherixMattSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic and very enjoyable
Review: The chef and many of the staff are actually Japanese. The quality is very high and the food is delicious.We paid a reasonable amount MYR240 for two people, including drinks and dessert. The seafood was quite fresh.We would love to go back again during our next Langkawi trip.Show less

Author: bal_agilSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Oishi!!
Review: As far as Japanese restaurants go, this one is quite decent. I love the food - had Salmon Shioyaki and Salmon Sashimi. Simply marvellous! And don't forget their homemade matcha ice cream. Yums! The waitress, Kanako, is very attentive and helpful. Appreciate her effort to explain and recommend dishes to us. The place is quite small, so if possible, make a reservation. Try the outdoor / terrace seating, good place to catch the sunset. And worry about the price :) order food and enjoy. Bask in the ambience. Show less

Author: Phj78
Title: Worth a visit
Review:
Try the soba nudles - Yum! Friendly and serviceminded staff end very good food :)
Surroundings are stunning

Author: worthymcbitersonTokyo, Japan
Title: Excellent service
Review: Ordering is key -- I recommend any local fish. A bit pricey, but we splurged on sashimi and sea bass from their tanks. Wasabi is free; the charge is if you need more. Mostly, though, I was impressed with their service; the hostess came running after us to let us know a table had just opened up (at first there was a 2-hr wait). Make sure you book in advance! Even in low season, the place was full. Inside is a little shabby, but the patio is lovely, especially at night.Show less

Author: Nick RBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Arigato Gozaimasu Unkaizan !
Review: Second time after our last visit when on holiday a few years ago & definitely worth the 40 min cab ride from our hotel.This restaurant is run by a Japanese family so as far as we are cocerned is very original in taste the menu is extensive & although not cheap compared to UK it is still reasonable, fab sashimi salmon belly, & grilled langoustine, sushi was fresh & light,& the eel set with rice was an absolute winner.Good fresh food wish i could have stretched to the Kobe beef but way out of our budget our waitress a Japanese student was also very charming & knowlegeable the only criticism is that there was a long gap in between our drinks i am quite a quick drinker & the Sapporos did seem to take a long time to land.Always a good sign is that is is a little off the baeten track it did seem to attract a lot of affluent locals always a good sign wish we could have visited again in our ten night stay but it was just a little too far from our hotel !Show less

Author: AnuarAhmadLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Nice View Food Quality OK not Great
Review: The reception area is dirty, run down and desperately need major uplift. Look like a no star restaurant.The food served is okish, nothing to should about for Japanese Restaurant. The restaurant smell is not very inviting. In fact try the Japanese cuisine at Meritus Pelangi Jalan Pantai Cenang, it would easily beat Unkaizan and 10 times better.The outdoor tables near the garden is better so you don't have to deal with the smelly fishy odour that just wont go away ( I need Oxygen). If you want to give it a try, get the outdoor table with fresh air. Show less

Author: vikt_12London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Arrived late on our first night and decided to give this a go as it's in the grounds of Ambong Ambong villas - what a great place and great food, especially there homemade ice cream as well as the shock on my g/f's face when they bring you the live seabass in a basket.Service with a smile.Please try their fresh King prwans tapan style - very delicousShow less

Author: sj6565Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not fresh,not worth, Countculative
Review: Sushi and salmon not so fresh. Insists to charge for the small plate of wasabi although we already rejected when the waitress served it with the sashimi. Need to wait for almost 30mins for a bowl of white rice cause there is no ready cooked rice to be served in this restaurant. One time visit. Show less

Author: David HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Dinner & Service
Review: One of the specials yesterday was swordfish which you could have either Tempura, Sushi or Sashimi. We had it as Sashimi and it was so fresh and tender it melted in your mouth. We also had California Roll, Deep fried Prawn Sushi and Soft shell crab Tempura. Also some fresh Udon Noodles.We also enjoyed an excellent Sake.Also the service was excellent. We had the pleasure to meet and be served by Akane from Kyoto. It was obvious that she enjoyed her job and meeting people from all over the world.It was our first time there but we will be back next year when we go back to Langkawi.Show less

Author: Colours49Singapore
Title: Great food and excellent service!
Review: I stayed at Ambong Ambong and so the restaurant was just down the hill and I had dinner thrice in the 4 nights I stayed there. The first meal was arranged as part of the yoga retreat and it is vegetarian - the stewed rice is just too yumm.. Understood later that it is not on the menu but was made specially for participants of the retreat. I have sushi, sashimi and the grilled salmon head over the next two other meal. The unagi sushi, chutoro were particularly good.. But what's even amazing is the grilled salmon head, cooked with so much care and attention that I can taste it coupled with the attentive n friendly service staff, I had a few awesome meals and enjoyed it tremendously. The homemade ice-cream is a great finish to the meal. The meal may not be cheap by Langkawi standards but the quality n the care in preparation and cooking made it worth every cent. I will be back should I get to Langkawi again.Show less

Author: Ansvloet
Title: Perfect food perfect service!
Review:
Top restaurant, Top service.  just at the corner of Ambong Ambong Hotel.
We enjoyed our evening, celebration my husbands birthday. 
The food so good.., special the BBQ lobster with o lot of garlic.. was so jammie, jammie.. we will come back

Author: travellerQBK
Title: Authentic japanese food
Review: I regret that I didn't come to this restaurant earlier! We had a table outside, very nice surroundings, lots of green, even had mosquitoes spray on the table. They had the day special so we tried 3 of those dishes. Tuna toro sashimi salad. Fresh seabass half made into sashimi and half grilled. Tenpanyakki tuna toro and sword fish. Omg it was amazing. We had Mitarashi Dango as dessert, rice ball served with soya sugar sauce on a grill. Very interesting and we loved it! The staff were extremely friendly and helpful even thought the resturant was full of people. The price is not cheap compare to other cheaper restaurants here but it's totally worth it :) Show less

Author: CecilSingaporeSingapre
Title: Unkaizan Japanese Restaurant
Review: December 2014 visited Langkawi island in Malaysia and was truly and pleasantly surprised by the quality and service of this Japanese restaurant. Japanese chef and you can feel the warmth of the everyone in the restaurant. The Ottoro was simply succulently tasteful not to mention even their hand made fruity ice cream. This restaurant alone made my stay in Langkawi worthwhile.4 adults and 2 children and lots of order came to rm500. Fair.Show less

Author: K1151LMjohnw
Title: Awesome fish, Ok Sushi
Review: Our second visit to Langkawi and we finally located Unkaizen. Having heard much about it from our base at the Andaman, where the chef and owner originally worked at their Japanese restaurant, we had very high expectations.The place itself is just so so, decor could do with an update but the staff were very friendly perhaps even a little too helpful in explaining the menu to seasoned Nipponfiles. The had fresh belly tuna the day we went, the only place on the island to have it and it was good.. Black cod served on hot coals exquisite! In fact all of the hot fish dishes were very good indeed. Sushi was just OK though and we had better several times the hotel.But if your after choice and exotic Japanese style hot fish and seafood dishes this is the place to go.Make sure you book, it's very small and fills up quickly.Show less

Author: cnge23Kuala Lumpur
Title: BEST Japanese restaurant in Malaysia!
Review: Truly the best Japanese restaurant we have ever eaten at in Malaysia and we are huge fans of Japanese food. The seafood was super fresh, the cooking style very traditional and it brought out the sweetness of the fish and prawns. We loved everything that was recommended by the very friendly, warm and helpful staff. We loved it so much, we came here TWICE during our 3 day stay!! We wish we had a private jet to fly here everytime we want to eat Japanese food because it really is remarkable. Pricey though but worth every penny!!! Get the daily specials, they are really special in every way :)Show less

Author: Lissabon1
Title: Not worth eating - worst Japanese ever
Review: Don't ever eat at this place!!! Food of bad quality which had nothing to do with Japanese food or any good food in general. We even had to pay for the disgusting food!!!! Go somewhere else.

Author: tracysth
Title: Delicious Japanese cuisine!!!!!!!
Review: Good environment, atmosphere. Friendly service. The meal is big, and tasty. Enjoy the sake and shochu, you gonna love this Japanese restaurant.

Author: Leon S
Title: Very very nice Japanese food restaurant
Review:
~good service
~good advise for customers
~make some explanation to customers before customers confirm the order
~a bit expensive then some Japanese food restaurant but it is worth
~customers can choose normal or Japanese style when having Thierry meal
~fully Japanese cuisine

Author: dean0bennett0Basel, Switzerland
Title: Great wIth amazing staff
Review: a little out of the way but worth the trip. I spend one week a month in Tokyo with my job so know good Japanese cuisine and this is up there with prices a 1/3 of Tokyo pricing. Ikane-San was amazingly helpful and everything we had was great..we even ordered seconds on some..make sure you try the homemade ice cream when you are done..Show less

Author: Amanda WUnited Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Japanese meal!
Review: We stayed at the excellent Ambong Ambong just up the hill from Unkaizan so it was our nearest restaurant. We really enjoyed the authentic Japanese food, the excellent service and the view from the terrace. We found it good value for money in comparison with Singapore where we are based - about SGD 120 for 3 set meals and a good bottle of wine. We'd definitely visit again if in Langkawi.Show less

Author: JudithCSMTanah Rata, Malaysia
Title: Worth every cent
Review: We decided to dine here after reading all the excellent reviews. We were not disappointed! Both the food and service was good. We ordered a Bento Set and an Unagi Set. I have to say the Unagi here is the best I've had in Malaysia so far. The prices may be a bit steep compared to franchise Japanese restaurants around Malaysia but the authenticity and quality of the food here is 100% better. While you are on holiday in Langkawi, why not indulge in a little Japanese deliciousness?If you want a variety of things definitely get the Bento set and it is cheaper compared to the Unagi set. It has tempura veggies and seafood, unagi, sashimi tuna and salmon and ice cream as well as tamagoyaki in addition to the other set staples like rice, miso soup and chawanmushi. I don't usually like tempura but the tempura here was really good.We initially sat outside to watch the sunset however, the mosquitoes were relentless despite the repellents placed around the tables and the repellent sprays provided. We moved inside eventually. We were told at certain times of the year you will have a direct view of the sunset from this location. When we were there we only managed to see the still beautiful sunset colours but not a view of the sun.Show less

Author: SJLoh
Title: Authentic Japanese food
Review:
Always a Japanese food lover and do not expect to find such an authentic Japanese restaurant on the island. The restaurant is operated by Japanese. 
The price is on the high side but the food quality is worth it.

Author: NickOng
Title: The place to go for Japanese food!
Review: The food was fresh, expertly prepared by a Japanese master chef and served in a beautiful garden dining setting!

Author: 479eileend
Title: Little gem
Review: Fabulous service and excellent food. Winner of best Japanese restaurant in Malaysia since 2005. I can see why.

Author: Eriece
Title: Oishiiii~
Review: The ambiance is super nice. Good food, good people. The waitress are just nice, they going to chat with you like a friend. But the price is a bit costly if you a budget traveler.

Author: MinnieChewKuala Lumpur
Title: Delicious Japanese Food
Review: I'm impress to know that Langkawi has such nice Japanese restaurant. Staff are friendly and they explain to us about their menu. Overall this restaurant is worth to visit although is expensive. By the way, I think the food portion is quite a lot for me. Show less

Author: Reef20000Buren an der Aare, Switzerland
Title: Nice japanese restaurant
Review: A little bit off the main food-area, but not too hard to find lies this nice japanese restaurant. The sushi is very delicious and all the food looked really fresh. The prices are bit higher than in other restaurants in langkawi but very fair for the quality you get. The staff is very nice and courteous.Show less

Author: Sera C
Title: The only Jap resto I would recommend
Review: The place is up on a hill so it's very romantic I would say if you are seated outside. Authentic and premium quality produce. Always a must for me whenever in Langkawi.

Author: garylim007Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Overated!
Review: My family love Japanese food. Unfortunately, our experience here was not good. The food was average and service was slow. We did not enjoy our dinner. Personally felt we could easily find a much nicer Japanese restaurant at half the price in KL. Still do not understand how it received so many good reviews here.Show less

Author: Amiiigo
Title: Akane and the Tiger prawn
Review: I tried sushi and grilled tiger prawn, then the fried icecream. all are delicious. and service from AKANE is superb. The 5th point I gave is for her attitude.

Author: serena8313Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: local red snapper sashimi
Review: the service from akane was superb. we had the live red snapper from langkawi water for sashimi and grill. the fish was shown to us in a plastic basket before it was taken to the kitchen. flesh was fillet out for sashimi and balance (fish head, bones, tail) was grilled. I enjoyed their own made udon in hot soup with tempura. the udon is chewy texture and it was very different and nice . My husband had the unagi cooked in water rice and oil and it was tasty as well. the grilled ribeye served on hotstone was nice too. My 2 sons had the set menu ie grilled salmon set (served on the wire mesh with charcoal at the bottom) and chicken katsu. overall the food is awesome. the price is on the steep side though. you need reservations, if you don't want to wait cos the waitress told me that they are usually fullShow less

Author: Jazz JMalaysia
Title: DON'T MISS IT!
Review: We were here yesterday, the customer service is fantastic, and the food is excellent. No doubt is pricey but its worth a try. If you are fond of Japanese cuisine then this is the place to go. Setting here is something anyone would enjoy , go here during the day if you prefer to sit and dine outside. Indoor seating needs reservation. Try the eel rice which comes in a set - this is quite a filling meal it comes with miso soup, custard and pickles later the fruits. The eels is placed on top of the brown rice. Sashimi is good and tuna sushi was great. Try not to miss this restaurant if you are in Langkawi! Thanks to all the friendly staff! Oh yes the hot sake went well with the whole meal!Show less

Author: Charlene C
Title: Amazing food with excellent service
Review: The sashimi was AWESOME! It's a quiet place where you have friendly staff to serve you great japanese food while watching the sun set.

Author: Cynthia C
Title: Japanese for Real
Review: Really delicious range of authentic Japanese fare. Recommend sitting upstairs for view of sunset and better atmosphere though all tables there are low Japanese-style with cushions. If you'd rather sit at a table, choose the ground floor instead.

Author: Redfella83Reading, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Had dinner here during the week and it was a great experience. Really friendly service and they were helpful and informative about the dishes on offer. We ate way too much and had a great time. The quality of the food was absolutely top notch and the Japanese chef ensures authenticity.We met the owners whilst there and they are a charming couple also. I wouldn't hesitate to go to his restaurant again if in the area and it was one of he best meals we had in a 3 week trip around Malaysia.Show less

Author: NatandaymericoFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Fantastic japanese food - Amazing service
Review: My wife and I were there as we were staying at the Ambong Ambong restaurant. First we came in and the waitress Akane gave us the feeling that we were just arriving in Japan. After this the food (Sashimi, Maki, specialities) were very delicious and not typical like in other japenese restaurant.Book a table in the japanese room were you can seat on the floor ....Show less

Author: hikaru_chingyen
Title: Should try
Review: Very friendly Japanese waitress Akane. We enjoy the food a lot, forget to watch the sunset. Compare with other Japanese restaurant in other city, price is kinda expensive, but value for some of the food, excellent service and atmosphere.

Author: bigeckscot
Title: Very enjoyable
Review: Very nice food, good service, all four of us thoroughly enjoyed the atmosphere and all aspects of the dinner. Not the cheapest but good value overall.

Author: KongThien
Title: Authentic Japanese restaurant
Review:
This authentic Japanese restaurant staff mostly are Japanese, according to the very friendly Japanese waitress, Akane, the chef are Japanese too. 
The service was excellent, the food was very good, the restaurant ambience was nice, just the price are a bit expensive.

Author: Alex NAberystwyth, United Kingdom
Title: Eat here!!!!!!!!!
Review: best restaurant on the island. Best to book in order to guarantee seats upstairs. Authentic japanese restaurant. Expertly prepared fresh food and fantastic survive. alot more expensive than other restaurants but thats the price you pay for real japanese food and such great service. We stayed in Ambong Ambong and went to this restaurant several times. the first time we got there early and sat upstairs on the floor, the second time we sat outside and watched the sun set. A must visit restaurant! Show less

Author: Sam_Kin_KitKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food, good atmosphere, friendly staff
Review: Tried the unagi and gindara set, very well prepared and worth the money. Price is a litte high, but that the price for a genuine japanese food, no regret, esp with the staff that really took care of us. The dessert, teppan ice cream was great! yup, teppan ice cream! we ordered with mango, and it just nice!Show less

Author: CurvaceouslassKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh food all the way
Review: We ordered a Sea bass sashimi which was so fresh and tasted fantastic. At the same time we were greeted by the fantastic sunset view from the 2nd floor. Overall experience was fantastic. Would recommend everyone that visit to Langkawi to drop by this restaurant. Truly an authentic Japanese restaurant.Show less

Author: rlloyd2605
Title: Genuine Japanese food and service
Review: It takes some effort to find this restaurant, but the effort is well worthwhile. excellent Japanese food, prepared by a Japanese chef  and with a mixture of Japanese and local waiting staff. A lovely relaxed, friendly  and peaceful ambience. Highly recommended

Author: dannyr187
Title: Excellent food
Review: If you love Japanese food then this is the place to visit when in Langkawi. Try the chef specials to experience an Osaka Malaysian dinner. Do call ahead to ensure seating is available.

Author: Mark H
Title: Must go here
Review: Great place up the hill. Totally different fron the restaurants on the strip. Relaxed place, great staff, lovely food. Relatively expensive but worth every cent. Take care to check facebook page for opening dates.

Author: romancing-india
Title: Great Japanese Food
Review: Must experience. Small place. Friendly staff. Nicely tucked away off the main road on a hill. The sushi, sashimi, the ebi, the tuna, the salmon.............very fresh and well done. Reasonably priced too!

Author: Gita_Niketh
Title: A gem of a place...
Review: Great food and awesome hospitality. Thanks Zu. e ordered different types of Japanese food- all served on a low table with floor seating. Soft spoken and friendly staff.

Author: ChingFuiMalaysia
Title: Beyond Expectation
Review: We went their after reading lots of positive comments of this restaurant. We glad we did as it exceeded my expectation and we had a great dinner at there.Our table was on the first floor which is a Japanese Style dining area with a scenic sunset view. The food was excellent, the sushi was fresh, the staff were very friendly and helpful, services were great, atmosphere is superb...and etc. Although it is kinda pricey, but it was worthy in our point of view.Show less

Author: senfaaaMalaysia
Title: Extraordinary
Review: It was my most favourite restaurant in Langkawi during my visit last month.The location was somehow partially isolated and the building itself was very Japanese.We were welcome upon arrival by the friendly staff and they were helpful in explaining the signature dishes. Our seats were at second level, indoor. We ordered blue fin toro sashimi, salmon sake saikyo yaki and three sets of sushi yama, with mango sorbet as dessert. Although the prices weren't cheap, I like the toro and salmon the most.Some drawbacks were the toilet wasn't matching with the restaurant at all and there was a lot of mosquitoes outside the restaurant. So I reckon outdoor sittings wouldn't be recommended.I will certainly return to this restaurant during my next visit. =)Show less

Author: HKchicKilbirnie, New Zealand
Title: Amazing Japanese Food!
Review: We went to Unkaizan on recommendations from other guests at our hotel. And we were not disappointed... the food was really amazing!! Fresh sashimi and sushi and amazing teriyaki and grilled salmon. We really enjoyed it and would highly recommend to anyone who enjoys Japanese food.Show less

Author: kajambeCanberra, Australia
Title: Great food, friendly knowledgable staff
Review: If you enjoy Japanese food, eat here! Great menu, with a big specials board focused on the freshest produce, and the waitress explained that in some cases only small quantities of each were available. Three cuts of tuna were offered, and you could choose to have it served as either sashimi or sushi. We ate toro (tuna) sushi, battera (pressed mackerel) sushi, salmon sashimi, agedashi tofu and salmon fillet coated in miso and barbecued, which came served at the table sitting in an earthen dish over hot coals. Everything was brilliantly fresh and delicious.Plenty of staff, all smiling and helpful, and our friendly waitress (an older lady) was a real gem. All round great meal.Show less

Author: MonkeyinsingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Almost mytical
Review: It is set on the foot of the eco-resort, Ambong Ambong. The quality of the food is so authentic that it makes you feel like you are in a little charming sub-urban restaurant in Japan. The view at sunset sets the mood for a romantic dinner.Show less

Author: Josip S
Title: Great food
Review:
In 6 days while we were on Langkawi we went there twice. We do love Japanese food and this one is a great choice. Fish and lobsters are fresh, prepared very well and prices are fine.
Do not miss if you are Japanese food fan.

Author: JonasYeo
Title: Overpriced and poorly maintain
Review: Restaurant definitely need up keeping, run down condition. Tableware are in poor conditions, yet charging premium prices. Very average food. Regular Japanese restaurant in KL & Penang are much better and cheaper.

Author: Corynne T
Title: Good food, poor pricing
Review: We love the service of a waitress; a middle-age, short hair lady with spectacles (too bad I din get her name). Food is good, though the price is on the high side. It's a place to indulge; not for daily meals because of the price.

Author: Imanuddin I
Title: It was quite average...
Review: Arrived at 6pm. Restaurant just opened, my friends & I were the first customers. As I'm a big fan of japanese cuisine & been to many japanese restaurants around South East Asia while traveling, I find this place to be quite expansive BUT there is a reasonable amount of quality in the food. And it is really NOT a place for budget travellers. I would recommend the Bento Set which my friend had. Its worth the money. Salmon & Maguro sashimi is good, their home made Green Tea ice cream is great, but could be too sweet for some tastebuds. The Unagi that came with the set was quite good too. That was enjoyable.Also we had the Toro sashimi (Blue fin tuna belly) but I dont think the quality was there compared to the ones I had in Singapore which had awesome Toro sashimis (fats from meat literally melts in your mouth!). So I wont recommend spending RM55 for the 5 slices. Lastly we waited for about an hour before the food arrived & I think its probably because they just started up the fire in the kitchen so I'll be fair in my judgement for that. So if I was to judge quality for pricing, I would stick to my earlier judgement that it is quite expansive. You can get better quality for around the same pricing (or a little cheaper) in Singapore & Mainland Malaysia. Hope this review was worth your time.Show less

Author: sizzolWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful food
Review: We had a meal in Unkaizan last week. We were staying in Ambong Ambong just up the hill from the restaurant and it came highly recommended. We were not disappointed!! We had the steak set with sushi starter and ice cream to finish. Cannot recommend this place highly enough and the serving staff welcoming, friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: Tobias OMunich, Germany
Title: Overrated!
Review: We were there yesterday.Overall, sushi was ok but nothing fancy with strangly warm fish. Teppanyaki, not what one would excpect. Service and kitchen tooooo slowwww!Upfront, we are no greenhorns if it comes to sushi. My wife and i go often. e.g. I ate excellent sushi in Japan itself and in NYC.Firstly we ordered sashimi, nigiri and maki. We already stated while ordering, that we might take some meat if we still feel hungry after that. We waited around 20 minutes! for our drinks... And around 50 min for the sushi! Sushi was ok, but strangely it had room temperature... Which is here in Langkawi about 25 degree Celsius... It's kinda strange... I would expect it slightly cold between fridge and room temp. Still fish seemed ok, as we still are ok today :-D. But I have slight stomach issues today, but this could come from sth different, as my wife has no issue at all. The tuna was melting like butter on the tongue but it was not very good selection cutted. As it had this quite hard and difficult to chew white layers between the meat. I give a 7 out of 10 for the sushi.So after sushi, we still felt hungry and ordered teppanyaki sirloin steak... It took about 50 min! to come with a ready made steak on a mildly warm stone plate! This is certainly not what you expect if you order teppanyaki. The minimum I expected would have been a DIY set. Hot stone plate and can grill it on your own! The taste of the steak and the quality was quite good and well prepared, medium-rare. I give a 9 out of 10 for the steak and a 0 out of 10 for the misleading 'teppanyaki' description. So to be nice an overall 5/10 for the steak.For the check I waited another at least ten minutes. Which made me totally upset and we went directly to the cashier, where I reported about my disappointment on the service but especially on the long waiting time for the second order... I was offered as compensation free fruits at the cashier desk! Ridiculous!Service: 4 out if 10 for being friendly.Totally a 5-6 out of 10 or like Tripadvisor makes the rating 3 out 5 is the max I can give and that comes really with a good will.Show less

Author: BenLYKSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the drive
Review: We drove almost an hour to reach Unkaizan and it was definitely worth it. We sat upstairs where we had a nice view of the sunset but i think it got a little too dim once night set in. Food was good and presented well. Try a wide range of what's available on the menu - this place is a little pricey for Langkawi but the experience was worth it. It can be a little difficult to find the entrance - drive slowly and do make reservations as the place is not that big. Kid friendly restaurant provides paper and colour pencils for kids while waiting for the food. One slight downside is that we felt a little thirsty after the meal but we did not think that the food was overly salted - could be due to the crispy garlic pieces found in some dishes.Show less

Author: yellowpandaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great find in langkawi when you fancy some Japanese food
Review: the location is nice, and it is set aside up the hill in a nice little villa - it shares with the Insan Spa2 levels, and downstairs is table and chairs, and upstairs you sit on mats on the floor. when we were there the upstairs was reserved and booked.restaurant has a cosy feeling, nice quiet ambience, and a good crowd - enough to have buzz, but not overly busythe owner is the japanese chef, and he is in the kitchen supervising / cookingfood is good, tofu was great, and fish was fresh and very nicely cooked. sushi depend on which you order was sosoice cream is very good, and is home madethere is also sake - so for a bit of a night out - there is good choicesrecommened to goShow less

Author: L-SihuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome food!
Review: Went there on a monday evening, only a couple of tables when we were there..- ambience was quiet, doesnt seems like a busy restaurant.- service was great, th lady who served us was attentive and friendly- food wise, ordered salmon and blue tuna sashimi, 5slices each, really fresh!.. tempura udon, karage set meal, unagi sushi and fried ice cream.. th fried ice cream was handmade on th spot and you could give it a try too!Spent bout 200.. Worth a try when you're there!PS:// you might miss th place when night falls, its a lil deep in and one might miss th entrance as th signboard couldnt really be seen..Show less

Author: kazza13
Title: Overated
Review: Food here was ok setting was disappointing and service ok. After reading some of the reviews I was expecting so much more. Also if you are sitting outside you will need insect repellent.

Author: WendyH678Brunei
Title: Poor customer service
Review: The atmosphere was really comfortable and food was fresh! The restaurant was opened for a few hours only and menu was limited but still good!The reason for the poor service was because when the ice cream we ordered had a long string in it! When we told the waiter, he only nodded and did not do anything to resolve it. We finished the dinner and spoke to the cashier who was nice enough to investigate and apologise. We were hoping that the ice cream to be taken off the bill but because the overall experience was decent we didn't argue. We were probably just unlucky because they were closing the restaurant.Other than that, recommended and worth a visit.Show less

Author: HONkiev
Title: a real surprise!!!
Review:
We didn't expect to find a real Japanese restaurant on Langkawi - but we did.

We had very good Sashimi and Sushi, where the relate of fish and rice was excellent.

Very nice atmosphere incl. outside seating, plus friendly service (something rare in Malaysia).

Author: David_Mardashev
Title: Extremely good!!
Review:
I was not expecting to find such a good Japanese restaurant here. Was lovely!!! Highly recommend. 
Wagye beef was a little bit over cooked but tuna sashimi was just yummy!!! And Ice cream as well.

Author: rolandf624Melk, Austria
Title: good place to spend your money!
Review: the place was hard to find - it is not placed correctly on the 'lonely planet' map, but for the rest of our visit i have no negative aspects to write about: top service, top sea food quality of the sushi! the green teee flavoured deep fried ice was not my taste but, taste should not influence my rating. been to many sushi bar so far, this was my #1.Show less

Author: 140ChrisP140
Title: Very tasty!
Review: Pricey for the area, we only chanced in there because the waiting staff at old town white coffee were so inattentive, but if you like sushi, it is hard to go wrong! :-)

Author: sunseanfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: All the great reviews on this place is true
Review: No wonder it is one of the most frequented and much talked-about Japanese restaurant in the island. It definitely is the best. Everything is perfect. From the service to the food and the restaurant itself. I have nothing to complain about. Food is fresh and and delicious. I love their sashimi and the home-made green tea matcha ice-cream. It is to die for. Service is friendly and efficient. Staff is always around and helpful and most importantly, they are always smiling. Unlike some local restaurants here where they pull faces at you if you make extra requests. The restaurant is located up on a hill, giving it a cloud of mystery around it. I like the place as it is far away from the busy crowd and is very quite and relaxing. However, try to avoid sitting outdoor though, or else you will be giving the mosquitoes a feast! I understand now why it is one of the highly rated restaurants here and very well recommended by all its patrons. Definitely worth every buck paid!Show less

Author: nathandulce
Title: A hidden gem
Review: This place has a fairytale like charm to it; it's located on a hill and hidden very well, so you might miss it easily. The interior is great but the food takes a bit long to arrive. Nonetheless, ambience was great!

Author: EtienneB693
Title: Delicious sushi
Review:
Had great sushi. Especially water eel sushi was excellent. California spicy roll sushi was delicious. A must try.
Prices are ok. Didn't try the Kobe Beef as I found MYR 350 (€85) for 200gr pricey and wasn't that hungry.

Author: 926cheemingt
Title: Fantastic food and service
Review: Located at a quiet area of Pantai Tengah is this amazing and authentic Japanese restaurant with one of the nicest and freshest sashimi we have tasted.During our visit, we were introduced to their seasonal special - blue fin tuna sashimi. Their serving is fresh, thick and juicy; the same applies to their salmon sashimi.We also had their moriwase yama which consisted of 8 sushi. Needless to say, the raw seafood was naturally sweet and the sushi rice was tasty without the starchy feel.Special mention to their wasabi too!Really highly recommend this restaurant even if the price is on the costly side.Show less

Author: FerrisXLAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Pleasant surprise
Review: Did not expect to find authentic Japanese food on the island of Langkawi...but Unkaizan offers exactly that. What a pleasant surprise! This restaurant easily rivals the qualilty of Japanese restaurants of major cities elsewhere. The food and the atmosphere were both very good. If you prefer to be seated in the typical Japanese way, ask to be seated upstairs. The service experienced was a little slow (the restaurant was full that night) but the staff very friendly. Can recommend.Show less

Author: Kevin Yao Lung KShah Alam
Title: Simply amazing!
Review: The quality of food here can trump any Japanese restaurant in KL. Yes, the prices on the menu may appear to be on the high side but once you taste the food and see the serving portions, you'll think it's cheap!We eat twice at Unkaizan over the course of 4 nights. Simply outstanding!Show less

Author: flaneur-w
Title: the place to have japanese in Langkawi
Review:
Excellent japanese food (sushi, sahimi, temaki and saba shuyoyaki). The ice cream (cinnamon) was good too.

Cons: tempura and tea just so so.

Author: Samantha8989kkw
Title: Best Japanese foods
Review: I saw this restaurant and gave a try in a evening. Advice: it's either you reserve a seat at upstairs or you better go early(they open at 6pm) coz you can enjoy your dinner with sunset! Friendly staffs. And the foods were awesome! A bit pricey. Rm122 for 2 sets! But I sti enjoyed my dinner thereShow less

Author: Kathryn ZLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very good if you are in the mood for Japanese
Review: We found the service very good. There is a choice of three seating areas: outside, upstairs sitting on the floor Japanese style, or main dining room which is fairly plain and brightly lit.We ordered a sushi combo plus a few daily specials. The best dishes were the specials which included a whole grilled fish and some mackerel sushi. Dessert of fried green tea ice cream was very good.Show less

Author: vmilmanCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great japanese food
Review: Very decent, properly japanese cooking, with warm attentive and, most importantly, helpful staff. The three of us had very good sashimi, kaisen teppan, tempura moriawase, lovely creamy chawanmushi (steamed egg custard), and special fish of the day. Everything was delightful.Finally we had a very entertaining desert of mitarashi dango (rice balls in lovely sauce that you grill at the table yourself). All in all, very pleasant evening.By the way, there is a separate floor for customers who are prepared to eat as in Japan (no chairs/tables). Note: website link from tripadvisor is broken; it should be http://www.unkaizan.com/en/Show less

Author: 870travellerEindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Japanese expierience
Review: The hospitality was excellent and off course the menu chart. It was a unique location, on a hill, a beautifull sea view. Opening times are excellent. It's the best restaurant of the Island. Nice climate, the make dining outside much more convenient by adding mosquito-spray at every table they have outdoors.Show less

Author: CL041192Montreux, Switzerland
Title: Bravo!
Review: I didn't count how many times I have been to Unkaizan, but everytime when I go to Langkawi, I will be there for a nice dinner, staff service is good, they will always recommend the special of the day of us, they are honest, they told us the sashimi we ordered is not fresh enough, they will recommend another for us. But I like their Unagi (water eel), which grill on the small charcoal stove and place on the table for us.Before were always my boyfriend and I went to Unkaizan, this time we brought our friends together, they enjoy so much! Next time would definitely bring our families here again.Show less

Author: GSIreland
Title: Yum
Review: This restaurant is well worth a visit. Very friendly staff explained the menu to us. Food was presented beautifully and tasted delicious.  Restaurant is spotless and is in a lovely location. Would definitely visit there again.

Author: Syme0nAdelaide, Australia
Title: Top Notched Japanese Food in Langkawi
Review: I've visited and dined in this place three times now in years 2010, 2012 and 2013. And the very reason why I would make the extra effort to dine in this place each time I come to Langkawi Island is quite apparent. They have the best genuine Japanese food in town and there's nothing like it. They are a definite second to none in almost everything, ranging from customer service to seating arrangements overlooking the beautiful sunset beach and as well as their friendliness plus their scrumptious delicacies. Diners are allowed several dining options; be it dining outdoors, indoors on the ground floor with chairs or the traditional Japanese cultural dining on the first floor where you sit on the floor cushioned by a pillow. Either way, it still gives off the feeling of dining in an ambiance that reflects the origins of Japan coupled by a backdrop of Japanese melodic tunes. The place is owned by a Japanese couple who has decided over time to settle down in Langkawi and open up a restaurant to share in their country's finest cooked meals. And how grateful am I to them for such an applaudable effort as they truly remark perfection as their aim. Unkaizan is located in Pantai Tengah, which is slightly further up if you are coming from Pantai Cenang and it is not difficult to locate. A tip or two to ensure that you get the best out of your dining experience, I would advise you to call up in advance for reservations as it can get quite occupied during dinnertime. They are after all, the best there is in the island. The place would appeal to romantic couples, family and friends get together and as well as for business/leisure purposes. So the next time you plan to come over to the island and have this craving for only the best Japanese cuisine, make sure Unkaizan is on the top of your list!Show less

Author: Shirley HHong Kong
Title: Best authentic Japanese food
Review: From the reviews in tripadvisor, Unkaisan seems a bit pricey. I have hesitation when Danna's staff suggested us to go. They said advance booking is needed otherwise no table for you. It's lucky we have a table and it's lucky we listen to Danna's suggestion. It's the best Japanese food I've ever had before, especially sushi. Once we arrived, a Japanese lady is standing in front of the entrance to welcome us, lead us to the seat and serve menu. We ordered lobster sashimi, tempura set, beef teriyaki set, sushi board, deep fried pork chop set, 4 green tea ice-cream. Portions are big and all the foods are fantastic, especially sushi ..... wow..... taste so good that I've never had in HK. We are so full and will definiely come again if we stay one more night. The price is cheaper than HK, so don't worry, just go for it.Show less

Author: cheehooiPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Awesome service, Good food, but prepare your pocket
Review: Food : I had the sushi which is mediocre but the chicken katsu don alike thing, is really awesome, including the rice which is really big in portion for the full set.Ambience : Go there before the sun goes down to enjoy the beautiful view, if not it's all black only.Price : it's not cheap, for a sushi set and 1 full set of food, it's about RM100Service : Best I've seen, the japanese lady brought up the mobile credit card terminal for us to pay via credit card and even offering to call us a Taxi as well! Top NotchConclusion : Go there for the good service and decent food with Great Ambience, a must to visit at least once!!Show less

Author: monica2506
Title: Excellent
Review: Great service, amazing food. We ordered the sushi board, prawn tempura and sizzling steak and it was all fantastic!

Author: PiggyWong83
Title: Best Service and Foods
Review: Great Japanese Foods and service was excellent. The restaurant environment is very warm. They provided me a best meal and service during my trip with my family. Even though is quite expensive, it is worth.

Author: YH T
Title: Nice ambient
Review: Nice ambient Japanese restaurant, good food and bit overpriced. I ordered Bento Set (RM 85++) and taste alright. At tourist attraction this price is alright

Author: Lovetoreviewthingz
Title: Can't believe this find!
Review: Such great food with a large selection ! We were surprised and very happy to have found this place. Service was excellent, very genuine and warm. Wine list has a good selection however slightly more pricey than other resturants in the area. Is suitable for large groups or couples.Show less

Author: SallyP30468
Title: Awesome!
Review: Great Japanese food, excellent service, not many car spaces so get here early but certainly worth it. Great experience, thank you.

Author: QinVin
Title: Best Japanese food in town with great service!
Review:
The title says it all.

I entertained many of my guests here. Every experience was great and flawless.

Author: drinkingcocoa
Title: Quaint
Review: Lovely place on top of a little hillside. Fresh tasting sashimi is the highlight of my dinner. The chawanmushi is the smoothest I've ever had. Definitely a place to go to for a quiet meal for two.

Author: Shahid SLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Stunningly good food in a lovely environment
Review: We ate at Unkaizan for our 5th wedding anniversary on our last night in Langkawi (staying at Ambong Ambong) and we were not disappointed.We had decided on the impromptu spa treatment that evening , but I managed to push back our reservation with no fuss. Looking at it, it seems to be a place that prepares delicous food in an unfussy, simple environment, that doesnt need to be heaving every night.We ordered far too much food, but when it's this good, why not? We started with scallop sashimi, which just melted in the mouth, and I had maguro yukke (tuna tartare) that was incredibly flavourful, and in a goiodly quantity. My wife went for the moriawase umi sushi set, which had a lot of variety.For mains, I chose teppanyaki rib-eye steak, which was oe of the best steaks I've ordered in a restaurant. Cooked to perfectioon (medium-rare), incredibly tender, and with a lovely bit of fat, it was heavenly. I was slightly pressured into ordereding rice to accompany it, and I ordered the Santen set, which was kamemeshi rice (Kettle rice), miso and pickles. The rice was immensely tasty, and you could tell the difference with it being cooked in this method.My wife opted for the nabeyake udon noodles, and this came as a massive bowl with lovely thick homemade udon noodles, delicious broth and tasty veg. The service was unfussy, but helpful, and they made sure that we could share all our dishes by providing lots of plates and bowls (at least I wanted to share...!)Dessert was complimentary ice cream as we were staying at ambong Ambong (also amazing!) and a 10% discount too.Can easily see why it's been awarded best restaurant by Malaysia Tatler.Show less

Author: MyMichelinSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the best jap food!
Review: Visited the restaurant some 6-7 years ago, and no changes to everything. This trip, we missed the food so much that we went to the restaurant 3 days in a row, the food is just amazing and the service is awesome!It has the authentic Japanese food taste and the atmosphere!My 18 months toddler loves the food there too. I would definitely go back to this restaurant again if I go back to langkawi :)Show less

Author: yan85kwanIpoh, Malaysia
Title: 'just the BEST'
Review: yummy and wonderful Japanese food in Langakawi, simply the BEST! Staff recommended promotion which was excellent. They r so friendly, and you can get a lot of information about langkawi from them.The foods are superb,tasted fresh from the sea... pricey(so, beware of your wallet) but it worth the try. Lastly, the Japanese house looks awesome, it make you feel like in japan Show less

Author: xy_0811

-corkcoach available

Author: RichardPhuketAmsterdam, The Netherlands

Bill in the end for high quality food and rare sake only 400RM, really decent. Impressed sure to return..... Only minor improvement point could be that the decor and interior feels a little bit old. Author: rink521Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Huge Disappointment!

Overpriced, unremarkable cuisine with lackluster service. There is nothing redeeming about this restaurant - feel free to skip as there are much more authentic, interesting and enjoyable restaurants on the island!Show less

Author: JaseyOPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best of all, A MUST!
Review: Found this restaurant while on my way to Awana hotel. Rated as Malaysia's best restaurant, so out of curiosity, we give it a try.Everything is so fresh! The sashimi and the special board menu are just a way too perfect!Even the salmon with steam rice (though its kinda plain) but the sweetness of the salmon make the meals go well.Strongly recommended to everyone!If possible, try to go during the sunset to enjoy the view.Show less

Author: Nick RBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Oishi Sashimi !!
Review: I have lived in Japan & this restaurant was very quaint & had a traditional feel i think the owner is actaully a Japanese lady service was friendly & efficient .We sat upstairs on the floor did not do my back any good but was great fun & the food was sublime belly of salmon sashimi was melt in the mouth & my blackened cod was delicate & light i sometimes i think reading some of the other reviews of this restauarnt that people do not understand Japanese cuisine it is never served in big portions is always very delicate & yes is always a little expensive because its quality rather than quantity & Unkaizan does this well !Show less

Author: Liisi79Harjumaa
Title: Disappointment! AWARE! menu price is different from the invoice price
Review: We ordered grilled fish, udon soup and sushis. Waiter suggested to take sushiset, which costs 100 MYR. Later, when we received invoice, we saw that all the sushis where seperatly. 6 pieces about 19 MYR. Total of 150 MYR, plus fish and soup.Total 309 MYR.Extremely expensive, considering that WAKABE offers exactly the same food at half price!Be aware!Show less

Author: Hwee Chong CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Uninspired, average Japanese food at disproportionately high price.
Review: Summary: Our most expensive meal at Langkawi turned out to be the worst.Tip: Order some less pricey, standard Japanese fare and try it out first. If you are convinced that they are the real thing, never too late to burn that hole in your pocket.We ordered items from the chef's specialties menu (written on a whiteboard), naturally thinking that they would give us a good representation of the chef's repertoire. We ordered their full Bento set (RM85), grilled fish and an appetizer of salmon belly rolled in seaweed. All the items were very average tasting even though they are charged at a premium. To fellow Singaporeans, just think Ichiban Boshi standard (in fact Unkaizan is slightly worse) at twice the price. Our meal, without the sake (RM75), came up to RM180. We went back still hungry as we could not bring ourselves to order more of the overpriced food. We might be the unlucky ones to have stumbled in on an off-day. Having said that, we could find no excuse for such a poor dining experience for the price we paid.Show less

Author: Titi_und_GolfbaerKoblenz, Germany
Title: Wow!

Author: FoodCeejMelbourne, Australia
Title: Sushi critic delightfully satisfied

The salmon sashimi was melt in your mouth, tempura was light and the sushi was fresh. We asked for a few rolls to be made spicy and by adding some chili, they had just the right kick. A definite for Japanese food fans. Show less

Author: Jayce1964Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Traditional Japanese
Review: We had a very special dinner at Unkaizan while visiting Langkawi.warm hospitality , professional attention , confident host that suggested some very special japanese dishes.we have had among the best experience while trying some very well prepared and presented Tuna dishes.a must if you are Japanese kitchen fanShow less

Author: Lim12London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food

As it was our last night in Langkawi we decided to push the boat out and ordered the Kobe beef plus a few sashimi and sushi dishes as well.The beef was to die for, so tender (melt in the mouth) and delicious. We will try the Wagyu next year.The restaurant did us proud by the quality of the food and service. All in all a wonderful evening and we left Langkawi happy. WILL BE BACKShow less

Author: hellywelly
Title: Yum!
Review: The best Japanese food I have ever eaten!  So fresh and so beautifully prepared!  The cold seafood platter was served in a seashell and each dish was just perfect.  No wonder this place has won lots of awards!

Author: Putret
Title: Superb
Review: Han an amazing food.. Teppanyaki Rib Eye Set absolutely fantastic,, garlic fried rice was nice, very reccomende for Japanese food lover

Author: thecuriousdeeKosice, Slovakia
Title: Great!!!
Review: We love Japanese and don't have a good Japanese restaurant in our hometown, so whenever we are on vacation, we try to make up for it. Unkaizan was a pleasant surprise, so pleasant that we went twice. It is hidden away - I don't think I could have serendipitously bump into this restaurant (thank you, Tripadvisor) . It is a simple looking little house on a little hill just off the main Pantai Tengah road, surrounded by a lot of greenery and when dining there, one almost feels like he is in the middle of rain forest. Word of caution - if you decide to dine outside, use the repellent provided shortly after arriving or the mosquitoes will eat you alive. Service was good, they even fold the napkin into your lap. Sometimes when we wanted to ask for extra things, we had to wait a little...so I would rate service 4 out of 5. The attitude of staff was very nice though, they were smiling and remembered us when we returned the second time around. They actually seemed genuinely happy to see us return.Food was great, so was the wine. Sashimi was fresh, macha ice cream with red bean paste was amazing. Unkaizan was fine price wise. I never really expect to pay little in Japanese restaurants and taking into account how wonderfully fresh the fish was, I dont think we paid a lot. We even had a very nice bottle of wine that cost 69 myr which is a very reasonable price. Everywhere else, it was hard to find a nice bottle under 100 myr.Overall I give Unkaizan thumbs up. My husband liked it so much that every night when deciding on where to dine, he brought up Unkaizan and asked, if we can go for a third time.Show less

Author: max k

Author: Kjelst

Author: ChiaLoo
