Author: ErksomeMaldon, United Kingdom
Title: Great Dinner
Review: My family and I enjoyed a delicious dinner during our recent stay. Excellent choice and quality but it is a little expensive, worth it though. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone, including those with non sushi lovers in the party as there is so much more to Japanese food than just sushi, and this restaurant provides plenty of options.Show less

Author: Vivien CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Full of pleasant surprises
Review: I am in Langkawi for 5 days (Departing tomorrow... *sob*) and discovered Unkaizan on my first day there. It was a bit far away from my hotel on that day (Temple Tree), as in it wasn't within walking distance, but it was totally worth the trip. My first trip there was on a Wednesday. The restaurant wasn't busy and I was lucky enough to get a table without reservation. The staff were really friendly and introduced me to the special for that day. I went with their bento set, which was great! The sashimi was very fresh, and the rest of the dishes was just spot on. It comes with their Ice Cream Teppan -- ice cream made fresh on the spot on a cold plate. I would say you have to have their Ice Cream Teppan, it'll bring out the child in you again. I did a takaway after my dinner. I had seaweed salad as takeaway to have on the next day. The seaweed salad is to die for! It comes with 3 types of seaweed with cabbage etc, and homemade sesame sauce. It's a bit on the salty side so it goes perfectly well with white rice. The total bill for these (Bento, seaweed salad for takeaway and hot green tea) comes up to be around RM120. In fact, I like the place so much that I introduced the place to my parents and sister when they join me in Langkawi two days later. This time round, we had the teriyaki chicken, hot soba noodle, seaweed salad again (I couldn't help it), yasai tempura and a grill salmon bento. The grill salmon bento is out of this world -- very very fresh salmon served on a small oven grill. The chef timed it such that when the salmon is served, it's outer layer is just cooked, with crispy skin, but the inner part is still a bit raw. As you are savouring the outer layer of the salmon, the charcoal continues to cook the rest of the salmon. So by the time you are ready to have your next portion, it's just cooked, fresh and warm and oh-so-tender. Words can't describe it. The teriyaki chicken is really good too. Crispy skin and tender meat. Probably one of the best terikayi chicken I've ever had. The total bill for these is slightly less than RM200 for 4 person. Please note that we weren't very hungry on that day so we did not order full size main courses. You might want to budget a bit more if you are very hungry, but trust me, it's well worth the money. It's really hard to describe what's so good about Unkaizan -- to be brutally honest, the decor is not 'cool' or 'top notch'. It's not 'designer' for sure. But it makes you feel like you are having dinner at a friend's place (in a small village in Japan). Yes, it's expensive for Malaysian standard, but well worth the money on an international level. The food is not innovative. It's traditional Japanese food, served by staff and chef who take a lot of pride in their food. Their BBQ is perfect (in fact, I think perfect might be a bit of an understatement for the salmon I just had...). Don't come here with the expectation that this is going to be a big night out Western style -- dress to the nine, wine pairing etc (though they do have a selection of alcohol). Come here as if you are going to a Japanese friend's place for dinner and you will go home (or back to your hotel) with your stomach full and feeling very very happy.Enjoy. This is the first time I'm lost for words as to how best to write a review that justify a restaurant/hotel. I'll just show them how much I like them by going back again tomorrow before I fly off (Thank goodness my flight is at 8:45pm. Will have to do a really early check in and sneak out of the airport just to have another dinner there. Totally worth the effort).Show less

Author: BeadsbbSurrey, United Kingdom
Title: Great food!
Review: It's hidden away, kinda close to Pantai Tengah. Best to book in advance to avoid disapointment. The food is a bit expensive, but with this comes great quality and taste. The food was to die for! The staff provide an excellent service and are very attentive, if I could I would eat here everyday!Show less

Author: scrn1974Melbourne, Australia
Title: We went back 3 days in a row!
Review: We were fortunate enough to stay on site at Ambong Ambong. We had access to many other restaurants but we couldn't stop coming here once we ate here. Every meal was delicious and don't miss out on their homemade ice cream! To die for. Friendly staff and various seating options - downstairs is table and chair seating, upstairs is traditional floor seating on pillows, and you can enjoy outdoor dining too (they offer all natural bug spray, but mosquitos were not a problem).Show less

Author: AlexanderA617Moscow, Russia
Title: Unreasonbly priced medium Restaurant
Review: The only reason we went to this restaurant is the number of positive feedbacks at Tripadvisor. I wonder guys who wrote good reviews have you ever tried good Japanese sushi and food? After just visiting this restaurant I can't miss a chance to share our the most negative experience. The only advantage of Unkaisan is the friendly staff, all the rest is below average. You shall face the following when you come to this restaurant: 1) price is twice or three times higher than it could be for this level of restaurant, tremendously overpriced compared to alternative restaurants in Langkawi, imagine 3-4 USD per 1 Peace of Suchi, it is higher than in NY, Bali, Milan, Hongkong and even Moscow. Total bill over 120 USD w/o alcohol drinks. 2) canteen or fast-food design of the restaurant, it is just a cafe interior, nothing special. 3)location is in the middle of nowhere. 4) the number of positions in menu are out of stock (for example we were offered special tuna instead of ordinary at 6 USD per piece, guys are you nuts?) 5) the crab is in the abundance in this area but don't expect it in salads, suschi or rolls - Unkaisan uses ONLY crab sticks which has nothing in common with real crab meat. 6) Steak and salads were very poor. As result full frustration and my first such a negative review at Tripadvisor. My recommendation - don't waste money for this place, you might find cheaper "frustration" or much better place at this price level in Langkawi.Show less

Author: wongbengyawKlang, Malaysia
Title: Just too yummylicious!!!
Review: At first, me and my wife are having a big doubt in our mind whether to try this Japanese restaurant as some mention here is quite pricey. We decided to give it a try at last and this restaurant deserves the best restaurant award for the money that we're paying. The food is just too delicious and fresh. Even the ice-cream recommended by the staff really got both of us flattened as it is way too good. Recommended place for anyone who wanna visit Langkawi!Show less

Author: NeeNee_ChoPenang
Title: I like it!
Review: This restaurant was recommended by another restaurant owner I went earlier, we were warned that the price for the dishes are not cheap but it worth what we are going to pay for. The truth is, I do not feel they over-priced on what they are selling. Yes, it is not cheap but for the quality of food we are getting, it worth what it cost. The restaurant is located at a nice spot giving us a different view on the island. The staffs are very friendly and helpful in explaining the daily special of the restaurant. We ordered a blue fin tuna sashimi, fresh! And a battera (pressed box sushi), first time found this in Malaysia, yummy! Also a salmon shioyaki set, very fresh and grilled to perfect fish, I like the way the present the food! A cold soba and lastly teppan-ice cream which is highly recommended by the staff. I requested to help making my own ice-cream and had fun!Show less

Author: Jason L
Title: Top Restaurant on Langkawi
Review: Unkaizan serves arguably the best food on the island, albeit not a local menu. Highly recommended if you appreciate Japanese cuisine! Sashimi is the freshest you'll find on the island and almost every menu item is excellent and won't disappoint.

Author: shortrib
Title: Great Sashimi
Review: We really enjoyed dinner on the outdoor terrace here.  Service was very sweet and sashimi was delicious.  Informal atmosphere.

Author: BrianT22Canberra
Title: Great Japanese in Langkawi?
Review: Yeah, we were surprised. You have the option of a regular table or they have tatami upstairs (sitting on the floor, which is what we chose).The food was delicious - we had salted salmon over hot coals, soft shell crab, a bento box, and tuna sushi. Prices were a little on the higher side but by no means expensive. Service was very friendly and the atmosphere in the place was really relaxed.A highly recommended option in Langkawi if you like Japanese food! Show less

Author: JudyChu1987
Title: My friend say the
Review: Nice location, sits back on a mountain with nice sea sunset view. Tatami seat on second floor is very comfortable. My friend who taste sashimi in Vancouver says Singapore's Sushi Tei's sashimi does not have the taste of fish. However, in Unkaizan, the sashimi is as good as Vancouver. (Although I cannot tell the difference between Sashimi in SIngapore and Unkaizan in Langkawi). The white fish on the hot stone, must try. Good and not expensive. Lobster Sashimi 300g is too few for 4 persons, and too expensive, 50 RM/100g (comparing to Orkid Ria live lobster 25 RM/100g), 300 g lobster, only 2 small bites each person. However, the taste is indeed quite unique. The cold udon and soba is very traditional, similar to the restaurants in Japan. We have our most expensive dinner in langkawi in Unkaizan, 4 persons, one soba sushi set, one udon sushi set, one lobster sashimi and one hot stone white fish, cost 420 RM. Another good thing is it sits right besides the Trip adviser langkawi No. 2 plance to go "Ishan Spa". Go to one place, enjoy both food and spa.Show less

Author: jufu007Singapore
Title: Incredible good Japanese food!!!
Review: We were a group of five and we all really enjoyed the excellent food.We had all kinds of different dishes, from maki rolls, nigiri, teppanyaki, soba and udon noodles.Everything was fresh and of top quality. Very comparable to a Japanese restaurant in Japan. I could not believe to find the best Japanese food outside of Japan on an island in Malaysia (I haven't hat such good Japanese food in Singapore so far)!The fish was so fresh and the meat so tender!!Yes, it is a bit pricey compared to other restaurants on Langkawi, but absolutely reasonable for what you get. For that quality it is actually well priced.The teppanyaki ice cream is also very tasty!The only thing I would complain is that every one got their food separately, so in the end we wait quite a while until the last got served.Try to get a table outside. The scenery there is nice out there (they also provide mosquito spray =)).Don't miss that place on your visit to Langkawi!!!Show less

Author: italyItaliaitalia
Title: Good but very expensive food
Review: This restaurant serves autentic japanese food but prices are outrageous for Malaysia. Service is quite slow and portions are small expecially in the set menu options. The owner don't speak english very well so to understand the differet options of the menu you have to be a little bit familiar with japanese cuisine.Show less

Author: John LMelbourne, Australia
Title: Fresh and tasty Japanese food
Review: Amazing Japanese food at a very reasonable price. My wife and I shared edamame, a sushi platter, soft shell crab and agedashi tofu and everything was perfect.For dessert I had green tea ice cream with red bean and my wife a deep fried chocolate ice cream and both tasted great!Service was unbelievably friendly and we will definitely return.Show less

Author: Louise J
Title: Amazing
Review: very very good food and service excellent - a little uncomfortable sitting on floor cushions but adds to the experience.

Author: Leesa2009
Title: Very fresh Japanese food!
Review: The sashimi was fresh and tasty. The miso chicken soup was served over heat and really delicious. I enjoyed the edamame and the beef was yum! The service was excellent and I highly recommend the hot sake. A really lovely dinner.

Author: rk-artLombok, Indonesia
Title: truly japan
Review: the chef is a japanese, the waitress are japanese, the food tasted japanese, to top it up, the wasabi is the real thing! the fresh grilled lobster was superb! the sushi's has its own special taste, even with the squid on top, it tasted good!! the thick udon noodle has its special thick taste, it was hand made i was told, hence the thick tasty taste.. with Saporo beer instead of sake, it's just great! you may choose to sit on the floor like the japanese do to rich your experience but chairs are also available. it opens from 6pm to 11pm and it's not difficult to find the place. Its best to go there before 7pm and choose the first floor to enjoy the sunset..Show less

Author: Jellylim
Title: Do not miss !
Review: the environment is top notch, food are good and very authentic. The highlight of this restaurant is definitely the sunset that we all enjoy. simply magnificent.

Author: ianbealeLuton, United Kingdom
Title: GOOD FOOD
Review: Stayed at ambong ambong resort , which is located just above this resturant. We wanted to sit outside , and this did appear to be a problem to start with , but was quickly rectified. Hotel recommened eating here , so thought we would give it a try . Food was tasty and hot. 10% off was also offered to hotel guests , which helped us choose this place,. We were not dissapointed in the least. Authentic cuisine Show less

Author: MEU1980
Title: Lovely
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed the food, service and sunset from your lovely restaurant. Thank you

Author: prettycaiLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Japanese as good as it gets in Langkawi
Review: Servers are attentive and courteous as in Japanese tradition. The atmosphere is like typical Japanese - simple and low key. Food is well-prepared and with attention to details. However, the ingredients fall short of it. It's not surprising considering that we are in Langkawi and far away from proper Japanese food distribution channel. Salmon sashimi beat Blue Fin Tuna sashimi 5 to 1 eventhough the odds normally should be much in favor of the latter. The sashimi at 5 medium-size pcs. each was a bit undersized but was beautifully displayed with 3 types of seaweed salad. However, the seaweed was not pickled and far too salty for the delicate flavor of the sashimi. The separate order of seaweed and vegetable salad was very good and well balanced with the salty seaweed. California rolls were good but had too much mayonnaise which is a Japanese love-affair I have never understood.The hot green tea was excellent and well-served which showed attention to details. Green tea ice cream was very good with a rarely found proper consistency. Considering that we are in small town Malaysia, we can rate this place 4 stars and we will certainly come back as we live here. Show less

Author: CareTaker77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellence Foods
Review: I had dinner here with my family. The foods was excellent and it really Japanese taste. Had a good time there, the restaurant location was great and cozy, just like the typical local Japanese restaurant you can find in Japan. I had salmon cooked over coals it was great. My wife like the cawanmushi, she told me the best cawanmushi she ever tasted, not to forget the miso shiru was nice too. (Miso shiru is my bench marking with other Japanese restaurant). The fish taste fresh!Had opportunity to speak Japanese with Aki San. She was friendly, and a bit surprised when I started to speak Japanese with her :)Overall, the foods was superb, the location was nice and cozy and the staff were friendly.It was a bit pricy, but not a big deal for me as everything else was excellent!!I like!Show less

Author: 5866GotTheBugBendigo, Australia
Title: Best sashimi we have had
Review: You don't imagine that humble little place can serve such exquisite food. We had a mixture of sashimi which was the best we have had. The salted salmon cooked over coals on the table was great.We also tried the tuna chin/cheek. Basically a quarter of a tuna skull, marinated and grilled. The meat was very moist and tender, similar to beef cheek in texture. The flavour was intense and really needed an accompanying salad or vegetable to break the intensity. It would have been good if the wait staff had recommended this as an option.Show less

Author: Madzcastro
Title: best japanese restaurant in Langkawi
Review: it was good and i like the foods but its expensive. but the money worth though...

Author: HUANG Y

Review: I'm ELLA from Guangzhou,CHINA.I have been to Langkawi for two days with friends.It's great pleasure we can have dinner in UNKAIZAN JAPANESE RESTAURANT,the food is best taste and the service is so great.

Author: VanGerven
Title: authentic Japanese food

Author: LinklaterOslo, Norway
Title: Excellent food !!
Review: the food here is unsurpassed by few. Just excellent and tasty. The restaurant is situated on the side of a steep hill, one can see the sea in the distance. The furniture and interior could do with a stylist, but it does not matter. The wooden chairs and tables reminded me of a log cabin in ... Canada..? but never mind. With some cushions it was actually extremely comfortable. Upstairs, they have a teppanyaki area with low tables. The food is the most important, though- and it kept every promise. The staff was wonderful. Had, among other things, fried tofu, so delicious! and Wasabi Ice Cream - yes, it was good!The restaurant is owned and run by a Japanese lady.A must when in Langkawi, (if one is into Japanese food - if you have never had Japanese food before, this will make you an aficionado!)Many guests/clients - a popular place.Show less

Author: Andrew P
Title: Fantastic Salmon and Black Cod
Review: The food at this restaurant was really delicious and the staff were very thorough with their explanations. Sitting outside was nicer than inside and the gardens were tranquil. Very much enjoyed the evening.

Author: Lim12London, United Kingdom
Title: A chef who takes pride in his craft
Review: After the awful meal? at Mare Blu 3 nights ago we came to Unkaizen to see if our faith in finding a good restaurant in Langkawi will be fulfilled. Well -- YES. This restaurant has very good food and their noodles were very well made-not the mess I was served at Mare Blue and refused to eat. The sushi are FRESH and not a CRABSTICK in sight. Only downside is that they serve Bluefin tuna from Indonesia which is an endangered species-we told the very charming waitress of that. Maybe this message will reach the owner who will take it off the menu-just like Sharks fin in Chinese restaurants-No No No.Hope other customers will take the same attitude. Sorry about the rant on eating unsustainable foods.Show less

Author: RichardvanArk
Title: Excellent place to eat Japanese
Review: Best place in Langkawi to enjoy Japanes food. The sushi and beef are excellent. The location is very peacefull and the staff is very friendly. From the moment you step inside you are getting a great service. BEST PLACE TO EAT IN LANGKAWI

Author: Toppaset
Title: Just splendid!
Review: Lovely welcoming service from the beginning, their sushi was heavenly and cannot complain about the beef teriyaki either. Not to mention getting Asahi beer! Price was ok, at least when comparing to what u pay in Finland :)

Author: Weeli
Title: Great food
Review: 1st time in ukaizan. We order set menu and sake!service was fast! I love chicken teriyaki. We will back one days! Thank you for great food

Author: Aliz77
Title: Best meal in town, fresh ingredients, authentic japanese food.
Review: Awesome dinner. Worth every cent. Attention to detail.Friendly waitress. Try the azuki icecream. Oishi Yummy food. Great food presentation.

Author: Stefan SStockholm, Sweden
Title: Great taste and lovely smiles
Review: Situated a bit off, this place is worth a visit. You need to book in advance, at least one day. We had sushi, and it was fantastic, especially the salmon sashimi. The service is also top notch with a lot of warm smiles and a genuine feeling of being welcomed. The place is not very stylish when it comes to the interiors, but that's doesn't matter really, it felt very genuine all the way.Show less

Author: HellbraunWalchwil, Switzerland
Title: Great Japanese food at a reasonable price.
Review: Great Japanese food at a reasonable price. Service a bit slow and seemed a bit ditzy. Had been told need a reservation and could only come either at 7 or 9 pm so sounded as it would be really busy but when we got there it was plentily occupied but not full so walk-ins are possible. Show less

Author: XhelleHelsinki, Finland
Title: Too expensive
Review: I liked the food but for the price it wasn't that worth it.13MYR for a beer,About 30MYR cheapest for the main course.My Father in law ordered barbequed for 2,the meat was great you just need to cook it yourself.Mosquito repellent for FREE..Overall,if you have budget you can try it. But there are still some other local restaurant worth to try than this one.Show less

Author: 143DavidboyBeijing, China
Title: Classic Japanese Cuisine
Review: It is always a bit a challenge eating Japanese in the tropics, but Unkaizan didn't disappoint. The service was excellent and the sashimi/sushi was fresh and delightful. While it was a bit on the expensive side, we have come to expect this of a quality Japanese restaurant. The only down side was the lighting in the second floor dining room. Could have been a little less bright. Overall, as good as it gets outside of Tsukiji!Show less

Author: Froggystyle
Title: Quite ordinary and overpriced
Review: Just ate here after reading all the great reviews and quite disappointed in the quality of the food overall. The fish used in the sushi was of mediocre quality with the exception of the Salmon which was very good. Of particular surprise though was how much wasabi the chefs used as a number of sushi pieces brought tears to the eyes. Inexperienced chef perhaps?We also had both hot and cold soba noodles, neither of which was great, no excuses for this really. We were seated downstairs and the atmosphere was pretty dull and the seating was uncomfortable. The Malaysian waitress was nice and attentive though. All in all, it's hard to expect great Japanese food on a tourist island but at the prices being charged, it should have been delivered. Show less

Author: huih
Title: Good Japanese Food!
Review: I really like the food there! However, the price there is high for me. I enjoy the sushi there! and also Misho soup!

Author: heenja
Title: Second Visit and will go there more
Review: Fantastic and authentic Japanese food with really good friendly service. Fresh fresh fresh. Try the fried wasabi Ice cream. Loved it. Wish I could find something like that here.

Author: Pwd2383
Title: Great food for a reasonable price
Review: Heard good things about this restaurant so I decided to give Ira shot. It is off the beaten path and seats about 30 so beat make a reservation. They have everything from sushi to wagyu beef. I ordered a set menu that came with fried rice, miso soup,salad,sea bass and fruit for desert. 68 RM and I was full! That is about 26 USD. Well worth it Show less

Author: AikZuShyong
Title: Great place to eat
Review: This is a real japanese restaurant serving great Tempura udon. Grilled tuna. The service from the captain and her team are superb. Very relaxing place to be for dinner.

Author: mariablossDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Amazing experience..
Review: Have been there a few times with my family and friends. The food is delicious, especially I would recommend to try one of their sets (salmon or chicken terriyaki), which are just outstanding. Loved the auethentic atmosphere of this place and it is very suitable for long evenings in a family round.Show less

Author: hhccnn
Title: Really good food and friendly service
Review: The japanese food was really good and fresh. Good ambience as well. The service is also excellent. Go early to avoid disappointment or make a prior reservation. Will return if ever visit Langkawi again.

Author: Kiwipinot
Title: authentic japanese and great service
Review: A restaurant reccomendation that was very good.  Excellent food and very good service. Highlight was the Tuna Special.  Plan to arrange a taxi back as it can take a while.

Author: chocolatekaraAdelaide, Australia
Title: Almost Forgettable
Review: Not sure if upstairs was better than downstairs, but downstairs is very old and tired looking in this restaurant... It kind of felt like we were in someones kitchen at home, but still OK.Food was OK. Not of high Japanese standards, but still tasty and we still enjoyed ourselfs :-)Try the Wasabi Ice cream!!!! If you are after excellent Japanese food go to Oriental Villiage and try out Mizumi.Show less

Author: king2828Bury St. Edmunds, United Kingdom
Title: Great food!
Review: Agreed with all the previous reviews. True gem on this island. I would have gone to eat there again if we stayed for extra night. The restaurant was closed on Wed. Very warm greeting as we arrived, we did book the table via our hotel, fantastic service by all staff. Loved the plum wine!! The spicy California roll and eel roll were delicious! Even my boyfriend is not a Japanese food fan, he finished his plate of Sea Bass Teppanyaki! I had the Bento set on their special menu, which included almost everything, sashimi, steamed egg custard, grilled eel, pickles, etc... ended with my favourite green tea ice cream with red bean!! We were offered to sit upstairs, tradition Japanese setting, ie. on the floor. But we preferred downstairs, but the kitchen extraction was not great, but I didn't mind smelling all those lovely cooking!It could be a slight difficult spot to find, especially in the night, but it is all well mapped on tourist guide map, so quite easy to find.Price is really resonable for the standard, certainly much more expensive if in UK. Great option from all those on the Pentai Cenang!Show less

Author: Ochanz
Title: Amazing food!
Review:
I have been there twice so far and will definitely go back!

The food is simply amazing... Taste, presentation everything! :)

The staff is also great, could not be better :D

See you again soon!

Author: Hippothehutt
Title: A little out of the way but worth the trip
Review: We went here on the recommendation of a friend and were not disappointed.  The fish is very fresh and the service was exceptional friendly.  Recommend you visit if you feel like a  low key start to your evening and good food.

Author: kimsantosRoskilde, Denmark
Title: Food is absolutely perfect
Review: During our vacation to Malaysia and Singapore we visited Unkaizan three times. The food was perfect every single time.Staff was so friendly and so focused on providing a great service that you could not ask for more.I had sushi twice and it was perfect. I especially loved the unagi. I also had the Wagyû steak one evening, which was so delicious, and one of the best steaks I have ever had. Love the place.The atmosphere upstairs inside the restaurant leaves something to wish for though. The dining area could use some more decorations on one of the walls and maybe a different kind of light - I remember it as being a little too bright one evening. Nothing major. We ate outside on the terrace during one of our visits. I can definitely recommend this. Beware of the mosquitos. We did not try the downstairs dining area, which I would recommend for families with children.I cannot recommend this restaurant enough. If you are in Langkawi do not miss out on this one. You will not regret it.It is no wonder that Unkaizan ranks as one of the best restaurants on Langkawi.Show less

Author: Chris C
Title: Amazing service, average food.
Review: The food failed to impress but the service was keen, friendly and a breath of fresh air.

Author: 01SKP
Title: The best, absolutely!
Review: We went there twice within two days, having the very same portions! Amazing garden, great staff and wide option of sushi and other Japonese food. Must try the Japonese plums wine Umeshu and the teriaky - both chicken and beef are perfect.

Author: CharlieT1994Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Best Food On The Island
Review: The best japanese food i've ever eaten (but i've still to go to Japan!). This is up market eating for the Island and even though its expensive for Langkawi, its worth the treat! Even though fish isn'tmy favourite food i found the Black Cod yummy, Ribeye Steak was superb as well as the deep fried chicken and the sticky white rice was really good and went with all the dishes we had! I recommend eating here at least once!!!Show less

Author: Alywin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good Japanese food
Review: Food quality was very high, great service very attentive. There is an option of outdoor/indoor sitting, indoor for us, couldnt stand the heat and the mosquitoes. We had the bento set, sea bass sashimi & grilled sea bass. The food was very fresh and the taste was well balanced.Show less

Author: patatjeAlmere, The Netherlands
Title: Possibly the best Japanese restaurant in Malaysia
Review: We have eaten here a number of times and have never been disappointed. Food here is fresh and authentic. In fact, I would consider it more authentic than many Japanese restaurants (even those run by Japanese nationals) in Kuala Lumpur. Pricing is on the high side but well worth it.Show less

Author: ValerieHuangTaman Molek, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Japanese Restaurant
Review: A friend recommended this place with high ratings, and the fact that he is SUPER picky with Jap food means something! Was a little sceptical to have Jap food in an island, coz usually the ones in the cities are usually much better and I have high expectations for food too.We were greeted by friendly staffs and the owners are Japanese, so this should be good I think - but I was wrong, it was AWESOME!!!We ordered a sushi platter to start off but it tastes pretty normal except for the Salmon and Sea Bass sushi.. The one that took my breath away was the Salmon Sashimi!!! It was so so fresh and succulent, I almost wanted to shout with joy because it has been a long time now since I had such good quality salmon sashimi! We ordered an extra plate because this is just too good.Hubby ordered Unagi full set which was good, while I had the Sirloin steak set which again make me wanna jump around because it's just so perfect! The beef was juicy and their special sauce makes the taste feels really fantastic!Before the restaurant, I told hubby I won't come back to this island in future but after the meal, we will definitely be back just for the food!Bill came about RM300 but with the quality of the food, it's worth every single penny! Absolutely in love with this place, can't thank them enough for having such good Japanese food! Officially on my top number 1 list!Show less

Author: Fun_Boy55Gelugor
Title: Yummy!
Review: Nicest 'cooked' Japanese meals ever had and not just a regular sushi & sashimi joint. A must try is Blue fin (Woww!!!!!!!!!!!!) , Japanese salad & homemade greentea ice-cream. The staffs here speaks very little English but being a Malaysian have no problem with that but they are well trained. The restaurant looks very very old and very tired but the food here is amazing. Our bill came to RM290 but well spent RM290 :-)Show less

Author: _de__Graaf_75
Title: Amazing fresh food in a warm and friendly environment
Review:
We have been here twice in our holiday. We enjoyed it very much!
Both diners were perfect in every way:
- food is fresh and tasty,
- personnel is friendly,
- the location is on a beautiful setting.

Author: raffjonesLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Our best meal in Langkawi
Review: OK, the bill at the end of the night? 400 ringgit. Triple what we paid for any other meal (except at the hotel) - but thats about £83 all told, including service. Try that in London... no, wait. You can't get the sunset view over the bay or the lovely seats outside...Delicious fresh sushi including an Osaka speciality of "battera" - mackerel compressed with the sushi rice into layers which was just fantastic... plus cold noodles with tempura, salmon bento boxes for the children, lovely drinks and just a delicious meal with excellent attentive service.They were really good with our children too, providing drawing sets, big colouring pencils and - eek, GLUE STICKS - the moment we sat down. This made the ice cold Sapporo beer taste just that little bit better as the little ones were distracted.Great place... looks like a nice spa above it too. We'd go back in a shot.Show less

Author: pugwash123456
Title: Excellent  authentic Japanese food
Review: This was our best dining experience in Malaysia. Food was fresh and delicious and we had excellent service. Not the easiest place to find.but locals all know the place well.

Author: Dae89Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Japanese Food at a very Reasonable price!!
Review: My girlfriend and I went to Unkaizan for dinner during our 1 week holiday in Langkawi, the staff were all really friendly!! Everyone were smiling at us, gives me the feeling of been in a 6 star hotel;D We decided to dine outside which was a big mistake, at first there wasnt alot of mosquito but it gets really bad at night;( The sashimi were all resonably price and the staff even took out their board and explain clearly to us each of their special dish for that day;)) All the food were super fresh especially the salmon sashimi and tuna sushi;)))) We order alot to get a taste of every dish and in the end the bill wasnt that insane, cost only about 200+RM for sashimi,sushi,soft shell crab,grill beef,cold noodles and grill salmon;))))) The owner was friendly and polite and even came out to ask if everything was okay, I have to say this is the best japanese restaurant on the island;)))Show less

Author: watchfreakSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Must-Visit Restaurant
Review: For any Jap food lovers, this is a must go restaurant in Langkawi. The restaurant settings are very nice. They even have the traditional settings (using tatami mat as chair). The staffs there are very friendly and always smiling. Not to forget the food there is very nice too. We went there on 17/12/2010 night and had some sashimi and beef together with hot green tea. This restaurant is only open from 6pm to 11pm. Definitely worth to check it out!P.S. The spa above this restaurant is very nice too. I would recommend to go for a spa first then eat at UnkaizanShow less

Author: Chin R
Title: Excellent!!
Review: Good Service & Excellent Food! Definitely will come again when in Pulau Langkawi.

Author: kllsy
Title: Nice food excellent service!!!
Review:
the foods nice, staffs are welcoming and care to customer. make ppl feel warm..
definately will go again once in Langkawi.

Author: mistermike9Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: The Japanese restaurant to go in Langkawi
Review: They have a good selection of seafood in the live tanks and daily specials on the menu. We had 800gm live lobster served 2 ways - Sashimi & teppanyaki, 3 live large prawns as sashimi, california roll, nabeyaki udon. The seafood is fresh and you can pick directly from the tank! I am impressed with the Kamameshi rice which gives the restaurant its Japanese authenticity.The japanese server was very pleasant and explained each special items on the menu. We sat indoor and found it quite amusing looking at the outdoor diners constantly re-applying their mosquito repellants.Show less

Author: CaptainEvaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: What a surprise? Great Japanese food!
Review: Shame on me - it took me almost 5 years to get out for dinner to Unkaizan. And it was a nice surprise - I did not expect that here on this little island.We shared a plate of different sushi/sashimi as a starter and it was excellent! Two of us had a some steak and said it was outstanding. I kept on with sashimi and loved every bite of it.The service was very attentive and the wine was a really good price.The set up is not as nice as it could be but still good enough for a great dinner.I will become a regular customer.EvaShow less

Author: MillyLincolnWelton, United Kingdom
Title: say hello to your fish
Review: we eat here for the first time in January this year on our 5th return visit to Langkawi.\we thought we were being shown the bread basket, instead it contained the very fresh (alive) we were going to eat. Delicious meal and staff very helpful in finding your way around the menu. Will definately be going back when we return in Jan 2011Ann and Steve- LincolnShow less

Author: hazinheiraSingapore, Singapore
Title: The japanese style, unforgetable!
Review: We had a wonderful service in Unkaizan restaurant. It's possible to eat outside, with a view over the see, but it was a rainy day. The food was very good and the friendliness of the staff was remarkable. It's kind of isolated (extreme south of Pantai Tengha) but worth a visit.Show less

Author: jialormeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: So full! Of nice food and people.
Review: This Japanese restaurant is located beside Ishan Spa, which is tucked away in a quiet corner.We each ordered a set meal which comes with fruits and soup, and we have difficulty finishing it because the portions were so big!The Tori Karrage which i ordered was crispy and tasty, but the prawns in the Mixed Tempura were not really that fresh though.And on the downside, there are mosquitoes buzzing around you if you are sitting in the open-air section, although they did provide mosquito repellent for the customers.Other than that little flaw, the staff were really nice and polite (although one waiter took a wrong order for us) and the restaurant manager was really friendly.A good place to hang out with either your traveling companions.Show less

Author: a_freq_traveller
Title: excellent place
Review:
Staff are extremely friendly, quality of food is outstanding (we were there twice) and value for money is good too.

Our favorite place in Langkawi

Author: Nice_One_DougieAustralia
Title: Great sushimi
Review: I have to say walking in you do not get that wow factor. However, the service and the food greatly make up for this. Whilst we where there, they had 4 different cuts of Tuna which were amazing. The food just kept coming and we kept enjoying. Well worth a try on one of your nights in Langkawi.Show less
